payload: {"id": "p_81fc340fa6d0fbe6", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 0, "text": "太祖武皇帝，沛國譙人也，姓曹，諱操，字孟德，漢相國參之後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "b56a2f5e6a3bfc940e23a9e12ba7dc3f1656901b35c309052b7fc9294d4b438c"}

{"id": "p_145a5d45afaa46c1", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 1, "text": "桓帝世，曹騰爲中常侍大長秋，封費亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "bb6fdd48584e20e314abca7c027cd310bab69efe41146c3b04989aa2263de96b"}

{"id": "p_4ad82257bf11d11d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 2, "text": "養子嵩嗣，官至太尉，莫能審其生出本末。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "628cc3bccd1830670c41f009ffb68c8dada26a42c3fff76fa8397af62122c5e4"}

{"id": "p_5a7fbf84e29d907e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 3, "text": "太祖少機警，有權數，而任俠放蕩，不治行業，故世人未之奇也；惟梁國橋玄、南陽何顒異焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "2f016cf6afe7626d082d5d976be74300977ffeecc40e88f2fbbaa67a7c08fa99"}

{"id": "p_84c2619bb8eac66d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 4, "text": "玄謂太祖曰：「天下將亂，非命世之才不能濟也，能安之者，其在君乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "a1619b520c90c643e0ed9a6158cc0e77b2f20742058fc352e8e9ab6b0871ab3c"}

{"id": "p_3d67bfd5eb6d0fa0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 5, "text": "」年二十，舉孝廉爲郎，除洛陽北部尉，遷頓丘令，徵拜議郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "c372c6a7075493de120ffe811ee1ac473e9bf36dd42186f2105883b00bf7b3d9"}

{"id": "p_8f14109733a594cd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 6, "text": "遷爲濟南相，國有十餘縣，長吏多阿附貴戚，贓污狼藉，於是奏免其八；禁斷淫祀，姦宄逃竄，郡界肅然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "b16e74fb4797a1e428dc0c4c885175223227f50bf1c30164253d0f966e94b099"}

{"id": "p_53bb20a56f810492", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 7, "text": "久之，徵還爲東郡太守；不就，稱疾歸鄉里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "402eb2989fe0c135cfc63f587cf1252d0995ab4d60689b17189a020378cc974d"}

{"id": "p_5288e05bcd6d4d6c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 8, "text": "頃之，冀州刺史王芬、南陽許攸、沛國周旌等連結豪傑，謀廢靈帝，立合肥侯，以告太祖，太祖拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "50339faa9cf43d8c2a8af28d3be31ee6b752f9581c5c2e47c3f21cf585b90df9"}

{"id": "p_54e852c4fbc6bdd9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 9, "text": "金城邊章、韓遂殺刺史郡守以叛，衆十餘萬，天下騷動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "0adb2c0f53e26d7803d14ff79e2b17e6675aeca5cfbeeed52c755bad8e4723f2"}

{"id": "p_8c5c70ed757468bd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 10, "text": "會靈帝崩，太子即位，太后臨朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "a20fea7f682ca8ebd6f0fa00cd8b0e121844efe232fc23eaa36d54532deea7c2"}

{"id": "p_60eda70ab150f349", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 11, "text": "大將軍何進與袁紹謀誅宦官，太后不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "e6a605bba9086ce9600c5694e8411fad880d4ac8d6007c3fec637a96ec046576"}

{"id": "p_3f451cfbf50a895a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 12, "text": "進乃召董卓，欲以脅太后，卓未至而進見殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "ab2bab753f09d763236b730d893fe1cf61bdae64ba5d82b409f30f728a17c7cc"}

{"id": "p_165f0c265428cf68", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 13, "text": "卓到，廢帝爲弘農王而立獻帝，京都大亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "9289d0809c799c3ea6108b6d9ec4f91b0ae8f9a5d0e75316a5158ef1103b4008"}

{"id": "p_2b4023c41b1b2e44", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 14, "text": "卓表太祖爲驍騎校尉，欲與計事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "cef427268f6f3687857a7c8427fa0efbd687ed331b24347aeb0c9ce85ea557e2"}

{"id": "p_b7443c992302d880", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 15, "text": "太祖乃變易姓名，間行東歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "0b4e9dc4fb912df04650055121e3e5c1d011e03779173e5c95d4b0f5acd2b41c"}

{"id": "p_159d80fd25f2f2db", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 16, "text": "出關，過中牟，爲亭長所疑，執詣縣，邑中或竊識之，爲請得解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "fc560340cb4935913dfbb589627ea8af5053ee7d71bd5911dbcdb5a1ab729b3e"}

{"id": "p_b2db335c81ffddd4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 17, "text": "太祖至陳留，散家財，合義兵，將以誅卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "1cb0d23492da55ccecce30fa8d566632941c1a0632571a80af8daaf92b02601d"}

{"id": "p_b8ed31dd1cbe135b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 18, "text": "冬十二月，始起兵於己吾，是歲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "cf1d6a8a88a651a314ddd44fcdd33560932f3a98badebdad2a877bbb993d7565"}

{"id": "p_79a23747b4151e15", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 19, "text": "春正月，後將軍袁術、冀州牧韓馥、豫州刺史孔伷、兖州刺史劉岱、河內太守王匡、勃海太守袁紹、陳留太守張邈、東郡太守橋瑁、山陽太守袁遺、濟北相鮑信同時俱起兵，衆各數萬，推紹爲盟主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "eaa8ad01a7f56a7c1d084e9e48e636f59041e388c2fc89ad29be23435c09a217"}

{"id": "p_e0b80f22b8dabf7b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 20, "text": "二月，卓聞兵起，乃徙天子都長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "cb8a2f0ae71ff458773133ab337c0d72a5d4511bd041d6769552b14faf422986"}

{"id": "p_d613c7acd41f0047", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 21, "text": "是時紹屯河內，邈、岱、瑁、遺屯酸棗，術屯南陽，伷屯潁川，馥在鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "9f66cfb5fc03c7cc910d99de290ff7f6416ce8f74441098f1e0381e8d4ecdf25"}

{"id": "p_b73849ce2ea4ef28", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 22, "text": "太祖曰：「舉義兵以誅暴亂，大衆已合，諸君何疑？", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "d222eb9bb6abb107fa69499da6556ed1a37f49ea7fba678fb9e36c6381e0426d"}

{"id": "p_90f774b75cd43823", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 23, "text": "向使董卓聞山東兵起，倚王室之重，據二周之險，東向以臨天下；雖以無道行之，猶足爲患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "969bb932e170e7ecb556a2a1d3a751929974b53872aecb34629f9f153e084bad"}

{"id": "p_984344cdd963f8cd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 24, "text": "今焚燒宮室，劫遷天子，海內震動，不知所歸，此天亡之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "88b91ce7e2ef242f030df26e6f0b15018d9f2f18995e7caae427c1e4805b6492"}

{"id": "p_d71734e73ab4e3c6", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 25, "text": "一戰而天下定矣，不可失也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "3e239b1e8c9910e8271f090491d81339a2c4a0320b87a2846111bdcf14b50bd6"}

{"id": "p_d0fb0d7f48e1c4d8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 26, "text": "到熒陽汴水，遇卓將徐榮，與戰不利，士卒死傷甚多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "929e3d36826e7b7a8655ee275cc7fbae29e82df759ca760c1d9850370e8cb9fe"}

{"id": "p_5fa5d5d0d39c00e0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 27, "text": "太祖爲流矢所中，所乘馬被創，從弟洪以馬與太祖，得夜遁去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "78cec888ec07831bb6004e6a4cd327b129e7762ec4b3813dbd42fc54155f8046"}

{"id": "p_29079d476ded143d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 28, "text": "榮見太祖所將兵少，力戰盡日，謂酸棗未易攻也，亦引兵還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "b1bcf49fe8c9271a1ce683c9d7e606ba4978b9dabfd48d33a07d2cf3efdc645c"}

{"id": "p_b0081af506cce763", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 29, "text": "太祖到酸棗，諸軍兵十餘萬，日置酒高會，不圖進取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "ade06f06ce839eef2d9cbeb7dadd6918068b7acc60935d76368805208b97bc9a"}

{"id": "p_3b59cc848784653f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 30, "text": "太祖責讓之，因爲謀曰：「諸君聽吾計，使勃海引河內之衆臨孟津，酸棗諸將守成臯，據敖倉，塞轘轅、太谷，全制其險；使袁將軍率南陽之軍軍丹、析，入武關，以震三輔：皆高壘深壁，勿與戰，益爲疑兵，示天下形勢，以順誅逆，可立定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "f43e9f8b101e25da1236126baded5bf4b90017f098c3f52c748d0edcfe298795"}

{"id": "p_0d022d37feaac209", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 31, "text": "今兵以義動，持疑而不進，失天下之望，竊爲諸君耻之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "4e857e235fce0aba65818e20428ac300395c92d6577023cb4b8a118e66c8e19b"}

{"id": "p_eccaf62ad8d9480e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 32, "text": "太祖兵少，乃與夏侯惇等詣揚州募兵，刺史陳溫、丹楊太守周昕與兵四千餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "2462950fe1b96268f82f9f2d0c7ab9c52c709df34f245e73a242736ded7e4109"}

{"id": "p_c1549c327bb7e5fb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 33, "text": "至銍、建平，復收兵得千餘人，進屯河內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "d41bd130ee6c2cdf5785b6500d07495c0121a2f9a0ee74c4bcbefb80b244b91e"}

{"id": "p_d2c5510467d99845", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 34, "text": "劉岱與橋瑁相惡，岱殺瑁，以王肱領東郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "0a3be5e13ef6eaa6870b8799c84b8914a8c9d1224195d752c3a2dee860d61698"}

{"id": "p_b2c777a2f2781e59", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 35, "text": "袁紹與韓馥謀立幽州牧劉虞爲帝，太祖拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "ef39f428495f19168b68c86fd0ae3bef4b98ced8187b1dcffcae1e9aa9f51a21"}

{"id": "p_145d496adab8e4c0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 36, "text": "紹又甞得一玉印，於太祖坐中舉向其肘，太祖由是笑而惡焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "ed928d896a848a3f3efcafce34df983aeb74a31c38efa07ec0cb71f5c25c176e"}

{"id": "p_7e57132f28bacb74", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 37, "text": "二年春，紹、馥遂立虞爲帝，虞終不敢當。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "28817873d4c0a1711910bcabdf4d1f40bfbd75f325bbffb5388dda0cc3295319"}

{"id": "p_dcb6b4820cbff190", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 38, "text": "秋七月，袁紹脅韓馥，取冀州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "eea325b0d8c9cb9397eb0adb5c482365711eda7e990555a2ff92bbd90a8a0a15"}

{"id": "p_cb7a20bcde74101b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 39, "text": "黑山賊于毒、白繞、眭固等十餘萬衆略魏郡、東郡，王肱不能禦，太祖引兵入東郡，擊白繞於濮陽，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "ca4007bdc81245e83049830cc1c5ebb5e9e14bfb5694c4423de5003b06807b38"}

{"id": "p_19442400a3b24678", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 40, "text": "袁紹因表太祖爲東郡太守，治東武陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "9a9bba498b1580fb6a45e613d659e002bc415e35ec7bda7a393a3149fbdffa99"}

{"id": "p_4b22327aa98ee803", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 41, "text": "三年春，太祖軍頓丘，毒等攻東武陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "c6d19d3476ed8d3c562d0df643a5e5b14d08a703032d5b6b1fad3fab08c71a0a"}

{"id": "p_ee6a857bb9ce2e23", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 42, "text": "太祖乃引兵西入山，攻毒等本屯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "6d1e0323c74b1ccad97fe86089dfba618eb4d5fccdbc0d64fafdb9d37997c795"}

{"id": "p_e8bfbc0f0b5e1d6b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 43, "text": "太祖要擊眭固，又擊匈奴於夫羅於內黃，皆大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "f5b6177907ed2123c177cdfb3743e7ba041bd3b8154527b026865121bcb8981b"}

{"id": "p_569798f0876878a1", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 44, "text": "夏四月，司徒王允與呂布共殺卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "0a00afa91dc8624785ed98de662fa58d9b4b94601fb43bc1806e741db80efa57"}

{"id": "p_2ffd02e7a77c5548", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 45, "text": "卓將李傕、郭汜等殺允攻布，布敗，東出武關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "94a72bb9631e8098bfa6505a1da6013727f3adef6349567dbe07ff19f7675738"}

{"id": "p_aa6484960ba84ae7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 46, "text": "青州黃巾衆百萬入兖州，殺任城相鄭遂，轉入東平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "56274228652ad299b64e198ca75ec88b3073129f94436aa6081d6a800dead304"}

{"id": "p_6f4ab00e579bc509", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 47, "text": "劉岱欲擊之，鮑信諫曰：「今賊衆百萬，百姓皆震恐，士卒無鬬志，不可敵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "2b712e25a0bbb94bc145a943c6b602ef3eaf6b25abe68aeff05354e6be39dd42"}

{"id": "p_352776790ef51294", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 48, "text": "觀賊衆羣輩相隨，軍無輜重，唯以鈔略爲資，今不若畜士衆之力，先爲固守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "7f0db70f50f3d967339355be7d258968b0d556aab5d5ff1b1a727f1d050911ab"}

{"id": "p_10b99aee3db586ad", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 49, "text": "彼欲戰不得，攻又不能，其勢必離散，後選精銳，據其要害，擊之可破也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "aeaf06ec6ea2b2e33573d62bd95aef6c66f53db046005fa71589d52549610998"}

{"id": "p_c47ba6d41fa2e613", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」岱不從，遂與戰，果爲所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "294c7890dc29a6ddd4293a97bbf373aef5e3757f24b0545eb2804cdadeb90755"}

{"id": "p_1a937201d5a06f43", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 51, "text": "信乃與州吏萬潛等至東郡迎太祖領兖州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "19e685e35e4776ca0552f2d17762f62535e006075de8c6f007dd6522c55c7d62"}

{"id": "p_70cab86f0cc95925", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 52, "text": "購求信喪不得，衆乃刻木如信形狀，祭而哭焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "d549efadfaf0ea6b7607adf4630804d4007d57f12a8b02b65ad7057e9290d4ed"}

{"id": "p_96047462b0a44c18", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 53, "text": "冬，受降卒三十餘萬，男女百餘萬口，收其精銳者，號爲青州兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "ce93e15bdb37f8d187fec4a9a2bdc174d0a763d24d1d6f3472d3b339481797f1"}

{"id": "p_21afed13b493293e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 54, "text": "袁術與紹有隙，術求援於公孫瓚，瓚使劉備屯高唐，單經屯平原，陶謙屯發干，以逼紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "d651658da5c789264eafc71b136ba9bd13fe2d060adf8375862e04512e20ff26"}

{"id": "p_5bc10b867723bb66", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 55, "text": "荊州牧劉表斷術糧道，術引軍入陳留，屯封丘，黑山餘賊及於夫羅等佐之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "16ebc10ca1c2ba2806a88aeeebe734847c9cfce88251b8ebbdf1ac46e350b9b3"}

{"id": "p_87de454bfa10096f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 56, "text": "太祖擊詳，術救之，與戰，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "212c8adc213695f46b6cf1c049ad41e2907b2c9bc91381f312aded29017ba82a"}

{"id": "p_fe13afe1f2a8afe0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 57, "text": "術退保封丘，遂圍之，未合，術走襄邑，追到太壽，決渠水灌城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "2be040822cd7f6c80e6f7ae1e4c725bb273fa8e41771c50927fa30cb458ce4e1"}

{"id": "p_b9dbe680de63ca2c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 58, "text": "走寧陵，又追之，走九江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "020bb406c8355eb0361e33cc8b3246f879956de51a5d934d7f4cdb174158ad8c"}

{"id": "p_619784e0e3613e2a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 59, "text": "下邳闕宣聚衆數千人，自稱天子；徐州牧陶謙與共舉兵，取泰山華、費，略任城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "55ab6aa0b827e38e054cbd85670294adf6495b0cb81591b2b6dd799fb34dd2a6"}

{"id": "p_da1be7a03f77c7d5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 60, "text": "秋，太祖征陶謙，下十餘城，謙守城不敢出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "c222a5d01af3acd84afeb61af41c2c89d128194690ff3d58e87f58eb91f92cb4"}

{"id": "p_7b1d9e137635df38", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 61, "text": "是歲，孫策受袁術使渡江，數年閒遂有江東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "3fd8e408b7e8a4f49447a9bad4817150c9f258898213b73601a257a82a7becb0"}

{"id": "p_a049df85acd61b58", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 62, "text": "春，太祖自徐州還，初，太祖父嵩去官後還譙，董卓之亂，避難琅邪，爲陶謙所害，故太祖志在復讎東伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "977a336623622ebd838070a4a098455f42a6d66e5486c9c5cbc03026dcf73c9d"}

{"id": "p_0e53efa1e2dcc7cb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 63, "text": "夏，使荀彧、程昱守鄄城，復征陶謙，拔五城，遂略地至東海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "8399e1cf2272a04531845d410cf59007a7b7642b0f6947f2da71cc9b9f0945cc"}

{"id": "p_f6ce06025e0409a5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 64, "text": "還過郯，謙將曹豹與劉備屯郯東，要太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "37e8e63a7e8f6ad6be0a714c16d08e4f3ffe2276d0cf0fd0c4843cde32e9fdcd"}

{"id": "p_8980ce5b65e5b95a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 65, "text": "太祖擊破之，遂攻拔襄賁，所過多所殘戮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "cc048173b6f3662bf473fa7fd759be43994cce817e081692bf4c680b8f95edb9"}

{"id": "p_0258cb46a6507a36", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 66, "text": "會張邈與陳宮叛迎呂布，郡縣皆應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "7e4fe0dad45df4c951ea8982c92942b3640925d9cc50207cb8a32e143471bb33"}

{"id": "p_03054132ea92baca", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 67, "text": "荀彧、程昱保鄄城，范、東阿二縣固守，太祖乃引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "8ec82d98d56bac7e58bf4a5d435fee914b2095e05605f64325bf10ebb0d243a3"}

{"id": "p_a00bf86e96ebe1dd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 68, "text": "布到，攻鄄城不能下，西屯濮陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "6c3400d6d9c838503431488c7dbc960ca080759b2c6aaabae005fb87e1e398e6"}

{"id": "p_1a1909825c5e7c30", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 69, "text": "太祖曰：「布一旦得一州，不能據東平，斷亢父、泰山之道，乘險要我，而乃屯濮陽，吾知其無能爲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "00bcfdeb889c6f429a9317ff35d1cca5f5c58153cf2e68d6a97e71b4fc270997"}

{"id": "p_ddad7f22ea69e1d9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 70, "text": "布出兵戰，先以騎犯青州兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "3d5136a07c82935a257766b9dbc4db25fb9690f891d89a2a88c2d735d0d7324a"}

{"id": "p_f9f79bc5585e072e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 71, "text": "青州兵奔，太祖陣亂，馳突火出，墜馬，燒左手掌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "cb3c2257d997c0de162b045f4e39ce6f4e1d6273ffdb19ef363bead902d076a0"}

{"id": "p_778f889d3240c348", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 72, "text": "司馬樓異扶太祖上馬，遂引去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "70fb9b4e0736c3813ed52b79cafdfaad9c1dca1920ee433c8c4315497a1ff675"}

{"id": "p_1107575dcb977c0f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 73, "text": "未至營止，諸將未與太祖相見，皆怖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "2706ddf07319a910283024f6ca4f6b017fdcf9a151154331435a443e2fd51194"}

{"id": "p_02291bb5d06596da", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 74, "text": "太祖乃自力勞軍，令軍中促爲攻具，進復攻之，與布相守百餘日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "f5a76d707f88ec09e55676cf84af805738ab3e92ef49c5dd2d7202599914956c"}

{"id": "p_5daba33f61c8b3b5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 75, "text": "蝗蟲起，百姓大餓，布糧食亦盡，各引去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "0a72779207eb288ef3148194faae53c7b46c6df50eaff20d027d69dc139a0822"}

{"id": "p_bba894354df4689f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 76, "text": "布到乘氏，爲其縣人李進所破，東屯山陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "e6f9480ac7eb8e6dd1e0d00be19543a5ea55a340f2b231770b944949838e56c5"}

{"id": "p_1af4ee0de8a9c53d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 77, "text": "於是紹使人說太祖，欲連和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "81f5a7c67ab1ecc27aca11fc7031f19348a67c14143f2ad4e973d4ad9bb74d5b"}

{"id": "p_4bf2492495a2cc14", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 78, "text": "太祖新失兖州，軍食盡，將許之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "58e89c11390357f83a1fbb5b93c6a5ec9d3e6736c706a509e49ab03e28cde53b"}

{"id": "p_f7b5b878fafe5067", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 79, "text": "是歲穀一斛五十餘萬錢，人相食，乃罷吏兵新募者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "577fc065f96b69231f8417c5bb8640b68220c3ebc6b22c768ba91ff078734217"}

{"id": "p_1b929787c4174a23", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 80, "text": "濟陰太守吳資保南城，未拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "85238deda40a6c7c4d5c46558f5c37b700eb0125976ceb0cacaa1b3505beedf4"}

{"id": "p_a0868688bad57b16", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 81, "text": "夏，布將薛蘭、李封屯鉅野，太祖攻之，布救蘭，蘭敗，布走，遂斬蘭等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "ddfe5ee13e076955d36723bfd07224403944ae15926c579bec163abe88734095"}

{"id": "p_bb15dc90419bdb18", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 82, "text": "布復從東緍與陳宮將萬餘人來戰，時太祖兵少，設伏，縱奇兵擊，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "3118489bd0d4571657908e00936d168f40e8df2a0cd716ceee6829e037814f5f"}

{"id": "p_846ef361177794a2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 83, "text": "布夜走，太祖復攻，拔定陶，分兵平諸縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "9260eb4124493daee16b8b540f0471ca2a224385549f8a02984baf467f40c847"}

{"id": "p_f50d0050aab24281", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 84, "text": "布東奔劉備，張邈從布，使其弟超將家屬保雍丘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "ffcda7bbe0b075705b7c897e2a2bfe16c1dae32735f5577ecb425b76f309efa6"}

{"id": "p_76cdbf142a1c708f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 85, "text": "冬十月，天子拜太祖兖州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "d008a55d511fee9cc39c1622592ce8e57cad0fb21bc66e22ded560fb397ff85e"}

{"id": "p_91691cad3c2b997b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 86, "text": "十二月，雍丘潰，超自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "76f0140cfab55706a2219791ab0ef49fc8c337702990b624fe9d48376c38baff"}

{"id": "p_6dc222326d8896da", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 87, "text": "邈詣袁術請救，爲其衆所殺，兖州平，遂東略陳地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "7406e3dbec0fa0797852d074956cdb504cda21c39e9cd257754918972b58e0fa"}

{"id": "p_f2c362db505efc85", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 88, "text": "是歲，長安亂，天子東遷，敗于曹陽，渡河幸安邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "2bb97c9bd2ced30602b1dac87ff392a6be752a7ec903b1b9ebaf63372823c86d"}

{"id": "p_0b9c56fd0da92834", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 89, "text": "春正月，太祖軍臨武平，袁術所置陳相袁嗣降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "9118a65b17b1a89bd813daae512a430178f00536c91abba9efb5f5cd36615ede"}

{"id": "p_18dc802ed23401e9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 90, "text": "太祖將迎天子，諸將或疑，荀彧、程昱勸之，乃遣曹洪將兵西迎，衞將軍董承與袁術將萇奴拒險，洪不得進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "ab7171bab88947c9152ce4966356a77767e286c7737b8ec0f48b7b7c2ee44255"}

{"id": "p_90af6932628bb865", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 91, "text": "汝南、潁川黃巾何儀、劉辟、黃邵、何曼等，衆各數萬，初應袁術，又附孫堅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "86538d1b3ff612527b1bd7d3bbc5c859c96f6ec42000b93b22c55c62bdda38db"}

{"id": "p_3fb0b34e5f9141ff", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 92, "text": "二月，太祖進軍討破之，斬辟、邵等，儀及其衆皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "7fef96d613a16e016bd94b9d7f69408cf66d90a957480d0ad9f671699964ef09"}

{"id": "p_a47b78500e43e472", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 93, "text": "天子拜太祖建德將軍，夏六月，遷鎮東將軍，封費亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "9db8ca6427312e2f9cd3dc07d3e7906667248df6ad0c99cef9cd365557b137f3"}

{"id": "p_bf1212593c579e68", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 94, "text": "秋七月，楊奉、韓暹以天子還洛陽，奉別屯梁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "b449cb01a3c6624ffaf18cd4c00183332d87cd9a289ece335866b97bdb009e44"}

{"id": "p_179483b10dd535de", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 95, "text": "太祖遂至洛陽，衞京都，暹遁走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "829536e77eb7428d404d20dc69181c631f0c7758c41af0d1ee504e62405efe08"}

{"id": "p_2068c7d8af4886a5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 96, "text": "天子假太祖節鉞，錄尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "755c1255a32d69fbd95db38bc219eb3677318cc929adcae8b539e1933731f06b"}

{"id": "p_6a4e848c70aca2cb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 97, "text": "洛陽殘破，董昭等勸太祖都許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "1165eff9497a75c2ca8c82ecd0ff2ebb87bc6d050b20fccdf9000efac4686143"}

{"id": "p_c2158080b5c373e4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 98, "text": "九月，車駕出轘轅而東，以太祖爲大將軍，封武平侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "fbc7fb1f2a8f0517b56f9faa58d7a7e31767d4cec6ab1ded6b2b3ebacdb3bd1f"}

{"id": "p_8593ccab15f883fb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 99, "text": "自天子西遷，朝廷日亂，至是宗廟社稷制度始立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "ddc2465f2a8751b62f4cea7473e451e3e9750f3721c1940d6cfdbb9e6223ee9e"}

{"id": "p_7c24c443774bf8ae", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 100, "text": "天子之東也，奉自梁欲要之，不及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "ff9444300e9426eaf79bb799e5902ddb4bc846cbb3cbb5ad6a61b2b47213207c"}

{"id": "p_c0c1e7fa2057e0d3", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 101, "text": "冬十月，公征奉，奉南奔袁術，遂攻其梁屯，拔之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "a36258640205ab49f3a7039037599e6f178e38073b0dc2180c7b97a69cd7b444"}

{"id": "p_5be917cc28dfdc96", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 102, "text": "於是以袁紹爲太尉，紹恥班在公下，不肯受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "cc4a9dcf38ed1734eaf69107dcdf40d6d546b09630cb575d7655bc94f017b406"}

{"id": "p_f8c65983e62bed40", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 103, "text": "公乃固辭，以大將軍讓紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "c8880413b3522eb684ce20e5e41645068910a89b87446df790956e780501253c"}

{"id": "p_8fc83cafd30fe54a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 104, "text": "天子拜公司空，行車騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "f4d9e398db777944e2e0107cc2efe3eac8a8d858a11f2dc3071d791634dfebf5"}

{"id": "p_1f76125a34fd8854", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 105, "text": "是歲用棗祗、韓浩等議，始興屯田。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "e766c76c78a33b37a66b11aa23ac7bb9ad1c4a2e5b8d641915fd66299f4d44d6"}

{"id": "p_325594eca6e7cdf3", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 106, "text": "程昱說公曰：「觀劉備有雄才而甚得衆心，終不爲人下，不如早圖之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "dee8e61ab6d676b96a8ce7b46f4440354cc59e9324b6a989e12c49a907ddf6ff"}

{"id": "p_10795b8b539f9f81", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 107, "text": "」公曰：「方今收英雄時也，殺一人而失天下之心，不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "2ce06dd8ec7593622ce52418d4b4416fb2e7d0fa12a808368d9a2acbbddd3dbf"}

{"id": "p_7fd76e97d461cd6a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 108, "text": "張繡降，旣而悔之，復反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "3e74d2cac4514e41e2576b68c1906ab3b76e0a49cb770175f10b9264b6c4e3d5"}

{"id": "p_36f4a4e4c6872d81", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 109, "text": "公與戰，軍敗，爲流矢所中，長子昂、弟子安民遇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "5d5891fe4c7b4043fa9887668ac9848f32a5887d6035b512bbad3c910990f243"}

{"id": "p_a2afba388d0069e7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 110, "text": "公乃引兵還舞陰，繡將騎來鈔，公擊破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "89956cfe9ca6c43630e815c32dadd813674a8e78b89921b3c2e42d79fa095c58"}

{"id": "p_7e0bfc3b8b5f8869", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 111, "text": "公謂諸將曰：「吾降張繡等，失不便取其質，以至于此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "7f6ca9e34652b9a0121afae3a4e673f86aaf619680f7c36a542faa26b45caa42"}

{"id": "p_1d6a2f41b5107988", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 112, "text": "諸卿觀之，自今已後不復敗矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "4bb53d92889f8a32c8cdd6314f0e307de255e7e0534e286acd61fb7aeeed02a4"}

{"id": "p_575697f6d6581af5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 113, "text": "袁術欲稱帝於淮南，使人告呂布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "1843a7e592002472bf0f0db8981f22dce0bb0138641b1a1a1ce8a46caf08ef6a"}

{"id": "p_c0d1565e2d92259b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 114, "text": "秋九月，術侵陳，公東征之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "b695c0fe9060bb18a0db65d2765e8e7cfa0f6b4d522f1bca515193342dbaebe9"}

{"id": "p_20825699a486c8ab", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 115, "text": "術聞公自來，棄軍走，留其將橋蕤、李豐、梁綱、樂就；公到，擊破蕤等，皆斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "5d1bb7857efdb4e67fb443dc27d880103f531f4add92986d74ae144394a48a15"}

{"id": "p_f7dbad3dbfe0af19", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 116, "text": "公之自舞陰還也，南陽、章陵諸縣復叛爲繡，公遣曹洪擊之，不利，還屯葉，數爲繡、表所侵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "b8f4e1d95856603aa62bcdaa32f40e19b13f08c41249c886a4857793da7edb8e"}

{"id": "p_0a530777049363f2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 117, "text": "冬十一月，公自南征，至宛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "05b28d883e461dc4978509e2270570c899defe3de547f96faa3b210835be49f8"}

{"id": "p_ed140e94faadf536", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 118, "text": "攻拔之，生禽濟，湖陽降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "c09288d2282275ead47b30760afebc0c835ea7ac80901020b9b16d52cac18f78"}

{"id": "p_48ca9cd10b8edc74", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 119, "text": "三年春正月，公還許，初置軍師祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "bdd9a84aa58aeb7570c5645a9979db6e05013479029892301ea7636aed17050c"}

{"id": "p_05ae5d26c7fc2bb0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 120, "text": "夏五月，劉表遣兵救繡，以絕軍後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "89c89dabd4403802e6024d2f593635e6fb92a1e8ecd577f5ea27140b5f146b82"}

{"id": "p_960cae5573cd3cf8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 121, "text": "公將引還，繡兵來，公軍不得進，連營稍前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "63caaf309ae7dc4fa437c5ce91e92049fdde08eb8d2efcb9ae6ec548e87f17b9"}

{"id": "p_237b718f32516f18", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 122, "text": "公與荀彧書曰：「賊來追吾，雖日行數里，吾策之，到安衆，破繡必矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "2909ec0fb4d4391ec5e234f97c2c77b6193b9a56922b03d2ceafd5a7e0ecb3a9"}

{"id": "p_d7342aee74f5e4e2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」到安衆，繡與表兵合守險，公軍前後受敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "14f1f151a8cdf35b0ab025dbaa9b6936e61d0e1ae83263613d3eb4a674b84044"}

{"id": "p_d6f9379ae05f2cf8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 124, "text": "公乃夜鑿險爲地道，悉過輜重，設奇兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "d4bdb8d384d89d50d44ba1faebde0f17e3b17b5fa7d00a4bce9f0d3a610be827"}

{"id": "p_46eaff94dbc4036b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 125, "text": "會明，賊謂公爲遁也，悉軍來追。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "aa5118af949d3c973d2f5d3157fe14d97786870c126966dce968e776335aeaf4"}

{"id": "p_4c8bb5982780d5cb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 126, "text": "乃縱奇兵步騎夾攻，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "2d1bcb6534db77c276b34ee6828c6cf945fb3095c45013563fe9cdc3729a83c1"}

{"id": "p_a8852988c9d0ac46", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 127, "text": "荀彧問公：「前以策賊必破，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "23c60b97db5da65cc624c3edf5e575b26867ecf0a60e9b7b1ce2a2725e7c9642"}

{"id": "p_805d273038d06a2a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 128, "text": "」公曰：「虜遏吾歸師，而與吾死地戰，吾是以知勝矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "bd8917c008d92d80775537136f8b84ff23e9be6c953b6539f63ae21f45064914"}

{"id": "p_adabca0ec6d854ba", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 129, "text": "呂布復爲袁術使高順攻劉備，公遣夏侯惇救之，不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "c9bd12d7d0ed5133c5e31e5c6fa7b8c258328e8f833461030a7b48f9d835c665"}

{"id": "p_702db9c5de295a64", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 130, "text": "冬十月，屠彭城，獲其相侯諧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "7a6e4d5c9ef7dee5ae043822fdffa18711ecf0b4256603babf586860c97148ce"}

{"id": "p_b53c892a5f252773", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 131, "text": "進至下邳，布自將騎逆擊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "fe75e593b513c0d1348831c3b0e34906a196c5a7435abc0b2b711449f69cc196"}

{"id": "p_bc58aaa8c154db42", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 132, "text": "陳宮等沮其計，求救於術，勸布出戰，戰又敗，乃還固守，攻之不下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "3b2e6387843f718222f3ab5efcd30a8461e597f68f4db0ead9033bcc7d6e1f92"}

{"id": "p_8ace07a2fe62dec8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 133, "text": "時公連戰，士卒罷，欲還，用荀攸、郭嘉計，遂決泗、沂水以灌城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "c5781a7478bb504013d2ac618c61313e7860c1fdb91b8f4b1ba1749db27103b9"}

{"id": "p_92a4e0478f953ab2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 134, "text": "月餘，布將宋憲、魏續等執陳宮，舉城降，生禽布、宮，皆殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "602a9773b9e7746e5585f018d20e622a68ba30bd1a9bc195c31bd807b39f6572"}

{"id": "p_6f1216d4f9a80c47", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 135, "text": "太山臧霸、孫觀、吳敦、尹禮、昌狶各聚衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "efd435aa9848013e3cedcf3b322fbce98d186c5f5852e1dfa19d0592a2612a8f"}

{"id": "p_94f4b874cfc2ac61", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 136, "text": "布之破劉備也，霸等悉從布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "d4cb95f5b871ee36e8ca2d1f1cbb27875f29cbf3320d960a9435f6b9d094ca52"}

{"id": "p_f03d5189eb4a62d6", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 137, "text": "布敗，獲霸等，公厚納待，遂割青、徐二州附于海以委焉，分琅邪、東海、北海爲城陽、利城、昌慮郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "14a246bda76be9bb905358e74abc44b0358cd60b85773dd555b07c4691849031"}

{"id": "p_21e8ffa6d9359ff7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 138, "text": "初，公爲兖州，以東平畢諶爲別駕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "8bd53a77e9d1fae3a91e4d599da1fd9a7e5524c2a51887c8e6c6229bbd1c2979"}

{"id": "p_7a2f7bb1fc4c7491", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 139, "text": "張邈之叛也，邈劫諶母弟妻子；公謝遣之，曰：「卿老母在彼，可去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "170fb3654418e5907a27528ad38db337e35204cd85244abe3e93381b8129ca13"}

{"id": "p_8ebabee3506cab2b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」諶頓首無二心，公嘉之，爲之流涕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "7c6a4269838d27267822e479e4ce6f113b562d2c15a3ee5ba7b8fe0b083ede55"}

{"id": "p_177332f4b95bb5c6", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 141, "text": "及布破，諶生得，衆爲諶懼，公曰：「夫人孝於其親者，豈不亦忠於君乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "a7be13caca555886bbc88d4c96c9339447394fade2a6ea925f524428baf0bed4"}

{"id": "p_f0ed35452ac56bc1", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 142, "text": "四年春二月，公還至昌邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "bedf8a51529e6c89e8e312176bafe39b571f99a9ca7846ee4b03dfc960c97a2b"}

{"id": "p_324f5882f8bdb606", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 143, "text": "張楊將楊醜殺楊，眭固又殺醜，以其衆屬袁紹，屯射犬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "ccf1e1b4109039058331ae2f6a597fc1971a4e6d0f8de4b8417b6769b0fb5d3e"}

{"id": "p_6eb3772d3e694c76", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 144, "text": "夏四月，進軍臨河，使史渙、曹仁渡河擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "8e7e6a5242efc45e51aa44918a51eb2f78ffc28161f6f85c1d345ebebb6c85a7"}

{"id": "p_9375f2dbb5d0faa7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 145, "text": "固使楊故長史薛洪、河內太守繆尚留守，自將兵北迎紹求救，與渙、仁相遇犬城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "1bfeb95be20db4d2998b071e4a6cd7f33ea5f083bfc6fa026650ae3c9af9d23f"}

{"id": "p_c1aac22e59b34fd5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 146, "text": "洪、尚率衆降，封爲列侯，還軍敖倉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "545d80eb32a7a1be226def6bc1d885959796db5fb30386c87d30c441c2b8ee6a"}

{"id": "p_af226a65c26cd258", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 147, "text": "以魏种爲河內太守，屬以河北事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "13116226472476dc41bb00a293445386fbdea9500d8b44b1b340500d14bdc83c"}

{"id": "p_1f12936578ace6ad", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 148, "text": "兖州叛，公曰：「唯魏种且不棄孤也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "d210205a6ec1c6127d9c5b1594add6167452ff361a6f50b4744d86cb953d4bf4"}

{"id": "p_97111f149ea2e919", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 149, "text": "」及聞种走，公怒曰：「种不南走越、北走胡，不置汝也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "ab2dc041c499571a705731755bd740b15eac900213fd3686a368c7debb46068b"}

{"id": "p_c26d7fb4c583ca39", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」旣下射犬，生禽种，公曰：「唯其才也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "58065dd3aba6dc35c0f8d99c5fb666cc2023cd4b81250824264d8e6f5b105019"}

{"id": "p_aec3e8f7078e4daf", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 151, "text": "是時袁紹旣并公孫瓚，兼四州之地，衆十餘萬，將進軍攻許，諸將以爲不可敵，公曰：「吾知紹之爲人，志大而智小，色厲而膽薄，忌克而少威，兵多而分畫不明，將驕而政令不一，土地雖廣，糧食雖豐，適足以爲吾奉也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "c19d6aa4511fb83e478c01c7b0f5377d23d1cd6b5b5e3522bfbbd093d88a93b2"}

{"id": "p_d0a10641808a24ac", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 152, "text": "」秋八月，公進軍黎陽，使臧霸等入青州破齊、北海、東安，留于禁屯河上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "67c301b216cb4e464ac3702574c24d070f7468bbf4bb12ee6067a6d70de92bda"}

{"id": "p_36a994746f2e44f6", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 153, "text": "九月，公還許，分兵守官渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "efe9777c75eb889be2051e39db89ff56fce26ccb7bdbc85fe458a95d2984155a"}

{"id": "p_5326bac8eca089e8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 154, "text": "冬十一月，張繡率衆降，封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "d168d08eab5e8a4c603d4c8dd884fc51d85254af7011b519eb6ef783b0a35100"}

{"id": "p_eba54904f632c384", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 155, "text": "袁術自敗於陳，稍困，袁譚自青州遣迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "857e7c12154e070c3e74db062bde8a5a3d383ad562f419fa8bbb59ae70676bf2"}

{"id": "p_4c95f3bd6689e996", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 156, "text": "術欲從下邳北過，公遣劉備、朱靈要之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "446fc7c18ea9e348254407251abe2d37cafe3fec504c05c701d8c606a4c12f78"}

{"id": "p_d16577b9bb985f72", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 157, "text": "程昱、郭嘉聞公遣備，言於公曰：「劉備不可縱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "b08706696105bcca3de1b861b36e5d7404187b4007d898bd58e0abb438cde91d"}

{"id": "p_e35dd271a2e01c8e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 158, "text": "備之未東也，陰與董承等謀反，至下邳，遂殺徐州刺史車冑，舉兵屯沛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "c551c526155b2ff57c7df3c98c106b1fb9edeed2740192b15dd881e2b7cbd3d5"}

{"id": "p_97093fa578853fe4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 159, "text": "遣劉岱、王忠擊之，不克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "4f15fb947668454363b690b214e65fc6b044e57709dc057cfb64e53f76361a9d"}

{"id": "p_9e28d481c93c6fec", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 160, "text": "廬江太守劉勳率衆降，封爲列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "6b204c9e3cd9f15a58d424e8b7102e66295b0967b1a55c3fe5536e3629b2d1dd"}

{"id": "p_b9301e8e33e00aef", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 161, "text": "五年春正月，董承等謀泄，皆伏誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "824d5307fccfd33ea85f288a568f29f3d480255bab92afe4b86a912481b2c501"}

{"id": "p_ae6a4f20a8c7fdcb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 162, "text": "公將自東征備，諸將皆曰：「與公爭天下者，袁紹也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "237556d49bc9c3b48ea5a12bd764dbe4df5a3d910621e3870d230f2d614500a8"}

{"id": "p_e287d4e521c39d4b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 163, "text": "今紹方來而棄之東，紹乘人後，若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "7bcd6c3c0a2fd3e8f10db5853f78185f5a4d332ac5c85f43976f5ac9ec95db1e"}

{"id": "p_4c284e5444074e0c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 164, "text": "」公曰：「夫劉備，人傑也，今不擊，必爲後患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "adc7e8f8923305635599ba62e1aacf0d0641540e0782b48ae176cb850eb2e929"}

{"id": "p_0f54053498381420", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 165, "text": "袁紹雖有大志，而見事遟，必不動也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "26855997e4ad6585e0cf8f95c466d99be5ac7e6d91a8f5367f111c056bd2847c"}

{"id": "p_e61c0a0f9fce26f9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」郭嘉亦勸公，遂東擊備，破之，生禽其將夏侯博。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "bd9986b12154cf88c0097a1b73a14c1c9744b7ad169919189dd9a6b0a598841b"}

{"id": "p_41338c6400ae79f4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 167, "text": "備將關羽屯下邳，復進攻之，羽降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "91bce64168bc33fb109a545618bc6bebdff2c4e7779c5c50f0bf1e75a97b6885"}

{"id": "p_1ee8da5a1bfe9ea4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 168, "text": "二月，紹遣郭圖、淳于瓊、顏良攻東郡太守劉延於白馬，紹引兵至黎陽，將渡河。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "130b6011163e742a18c6487e5f774b1d0e8d1a66f13aeb16dcd7fe2840465c3d"}

{"id": "p_832bd12d500ced3c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 169, "text": "荀攸說公曰：「今兵少不敵，分其勢乃可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "54a70d71e5b25b3ed7d81f63b802fedee015c7a5fe32f6ff605206e52a3471d6"}

{"id": "p_0216f310b4cc3375", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 170, "text": "公到延津，若將渡兵向其後者，紹必西應之，然後輕兵襲白馬，掩其不備，顏良可禽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "e9eafe7560757504312627fe2b23cf4cd6caf8562c650ece2ccb6d4ad69c56bf"}

{"id": "p_b4a6f8d68f81fd14", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 171, "text": "紹聞兵渡，即分兵西應之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "78f23eb2875db61fa3f86acbd01d8773543488dbafad342d4e7faaf096a15ed2"}

{"id": "p_baf9948a22a1fa49", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 172, "text": "公乃引軍兼行趣白馬，未至十餘里，良大驚，來逆戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "9355d0607c0cf6d6013ba8d4d3b858ea73fdcbac068b33c015f1c0303fdec651"}

{"id": "p_25cf8b3cb6cd67f9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 173, "text": "使張遼、關羽前登，擊破，斬良。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "3f85eb81f4b49f6882650d6a9bda87dbf751729708aab39101e7e30196f32b84"}

{"id": "p_e7ffd7c436fc5269", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 174, "text": "遂解白馬圍，徙其民，循河而西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "bcb770111edeb79b4485778777aa36e10593cb8deb7cf6fa02c2d0d96bf219dc"}

{"id": "p_fba5cdb21fc9a9dc", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 175, "text": "紹於是渡河追公軍，至延津南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "5a74076b973ba678bcb5268fc72716cf7ced926cae92c374d2c692a4b4d47f9d"}

{"id": "p_21a034886ef443c2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 176, "text": "公勒兵駐營南阪下，使登壘望之，曰：「可五六百騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "a5d068c093d9e850ed0b768d5b3c9a43ed080e3de1ec07c0c066c9a3d7609363"}

{"id": "p_ecc5a9c34400c2b1", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 177, "text": "」有頃，復白：「騎稍多，步兵不可勝數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "56ae8a9437443a5200dccad3eac164f8cd3749c7caece6187b0a36feec46c6c0"}

{"id": "p_4e4bc267e1370d12", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 178, "text": "諸將以爲敵騎多，不如還保營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "7324e3aa438f4595f98202bf866fb6bdab5a033ed91fd113d4e538bd62dbb785"}

{"id": "p_3ec5746a7e1cbb5c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 179, "text": "荀攸曰：「此所以餌敵，如何去之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "551cb02e9b69c9669abce1ea25832679cad4393c4431d65052df2422383f0ba7"}

{"id": "p_fbf78c0f46b9bb2b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 180, "text": "」紹騎將文醜與劉備將五六千騎前後至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "e3c6e56ea68c3eaa8a6cf0ae9231f7c9fc00acb45cdec89242ecd1ae3c2e9edc"}

{"id": "p_55e9a73fbb47e378", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 181, "text": "」有頃，騎至稍多，或分趣輜重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "28dcd79853d33f5b9be441e05b7ed7366bcf959d96fde67977f6d05c25a67fd0"}

{"id": "p_9a98baf65c1295c7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 182, "text": "時騎不滿六百，遂縱兵擊，大破之，斬醜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "c5c4ec2b45b334dd02f4d12ac0dc62f97fc8dcaa98527035cd47017af4389f3b"}

{"id": "p_2910a6b10d46e55a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 183, "text": "醜、良皆紹名將也，再戰，悉禽，紹軍大震。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "bf67b64bc3210ff93eef0d97967e2d61ecd332c668968d50be9fcadaed0cb1b6"}

{"id": "p_38b7ee3d7cbacacc", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 184, "text": "八月，紹連營稍前，依沙塠爲屯，東西數十里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "2cf3fee072b0600d02dc5d1ba870e2defc5e02c11d7f93378d5509df22cbdd43"}

{"id": "p_d315bca58762e869", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 185, "text": "公亦分營與相當，合戰不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "be2b6cd1f9ed423c98329400a51dd6060be5168ad5b10fb12c6f1d4a1d23cd2e"}

{"id": "p_7921e627ce72ec42", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 186, "text": "時公兵不滿萬，傷者十二三。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "e098ba6bfbbb3b74789f525cee6a0043ba0177ce8411eb78d5a20323df16cf34"}

{"id": "p_19fad5891bb2adac", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 187, "text": "紹復進臨官渡，起土山地道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "3bc19c03e7719cd593f3d2ea9b1daad696cb564fcf514264d50941e481d965fd"}

{"id": "p_75689908ffb69bab", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 188, "text": "紹射營中，矢如雨下，行者皆蒙楯，衆大懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "a93242c3389082fc526a18de157d720e8547889a2d37cde1dea0dbad5de1f097"}

{"id": "p_df017dbc90e7472a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 189, "text": "時公糧少，與荀彧書，議欲還許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "b72ecb7987c91264717bcd69d56d4b405a003370bc6970b53f2221cfaf809676"}

{"id": "p_f56d5da6f2f02aeb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 190, "text": "彧以爲「紹悉衆聚官渡，欲與公決勝敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "3c3020fe6a072ed2c49583047492cee1cb26d0954ad484b362d9308aaf8de000"}

{"id": "p_6ea2a4f2e5c52bdd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 191, "text": "公以至弱當至彊，若不能制，必爲所乘，是天下之大機也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "164c5f58165efdcb18d45299c8c790f457de93daeffaf79cf0c953e907f10dd4"}

{"id": "p_9ccc0a0932c6e7fd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 192, "text": "且紹，布衣之雄耳，能聚人而不能用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "33b5037bcd11271d85259a52c612500ffafd84e5dce55edcf23ebc0e6c5cc1ac"}

{"id": "p_6f265493b03ac254", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 193, "text": "夫以公之神武明哲而輔以大順，何向而不濟！", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "867f0e89cde7f6e0c9a378d9ed931ffc2404253e7445c79b115f84977178786e"}

{"id": "p_5e75a5a44a778894", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 194, "text": "孫策聞公與紹相持，乃謀襲許，未發，爲刺客所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "bbc7a0d9f3255c4e0255b2d87deec9a0fa98f379637205ce4b7d6e2e55f8fbec"}

{"id": "p_c06146a59689300b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 195, "text": "汝南降賊劉辟等叛應紹，略許下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "4ac3ec72a50b6e57b357816662d552d74820df3441d9e18b10109faa7790045d"}

{"id": "p_be7171c08be9f9e4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 196, "text": "紹使劉備助辟，公使曹仁擊破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "12499d24cda8a9b459b458a32e6af1ac67375dc65204bd088499c9bdba56181d"}

{"id": "p_8017a59fd65b4abb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 197, "text": "袁紹運穀車數千乘至，公用荀攸計，遣徐晃、史渙邀擊，大破之，盡燒其車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "87c96e2d5df871b6151790c9f7b10945342abfda9104cc12a09ebc86f61f91a9"}

{"id": "p_599fe391c3b35056", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 198, "text": "公與紹相拒連月，雖比戰斬將，然衆少糧盡，士卒疲乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "88e90a8cd2f7862c0dbb34ec52151f15650541052a4d3044b873a8a8879099ad"}

{"id": "p_7b79a75acfebba4f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 199, "text": "公謂運者曰：「却十五日爲汝破紹，不復勞汝矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "c2957a80b60c5f3b7b3a0660e64a381ce3f1f6e99a4d83be74a5c58e6916df36"}

{"id": "p_4befae67890e5b83", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 200, "text": "」冬十月，紹遣車運穀，使淳于瓊等五人將兵萬餘人送之，宿紹營北四十里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "d79019a144b9c0b3568bac0e339cc46db0d2d0c827263b1f2ed5686110925486"}

{"id": "p_dcd92048da90a5e1", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 201, "text": "紹謀臣許攸貪財，紹不能足，來奔，因說公擊瓊等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "d74399a9c878818e42dd7811deac19d42580a628b371a97a8f812a91e1684f7b"}

{"id": "p_a4d38cdd739477b9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 202, "text": "左右疑之，荀攸、賈詡勸公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "6d8e40127d1e63e7057b61f3c11048f948995f02ec31597a195538d7905f4cad"}

{"id": "p_2a2599c7cc0f8a3d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 203, "text": "公乃留曹洪守，自將步騎五千人夜往，會明至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "9b2ed4e94ea76168b1dae9a0ea88bc1dcac8f329e0c66d55365afbacdce49523"}

{"id": "p_d2edb94f2b98233c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 204, "text": "瓊等望見公兵少，出陳門外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "6c6c3b760a4c8f12eb950f65dc65201f98faecf7a7c1f379766c909f612e31fe"}

{"id": "p_961a127181cec036", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 205, "text": "公急擊之，瓊退保營，遂攻之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "55984b22cc9c23ba7650bf66d907848defdc8783fcc04c1444b26811f75f999b"}

{"id": "p_b88594a45a92eba9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 206, "text": "左右或言「賊騎稍近，請分兵拒之」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "9fc5956ee5b3ab9ba602e5b9fe3fb4eb125e0b90a9175ac7ff70597bde4e09ee"}

{"id": "p_726d6ff73fbe0b13", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 207, "text": "公怒曰：「賊在背後，乃白！", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "ce3ba61f773dad2818d0cf86973b4939c83516f4d60c3c9c4b1f6d5c7bf475b2"}

{"id": "p_1434ebb96845571d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 208, "text": "」士卒皆殊死戰，大破瓊等，皆斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "42c8c9f803659c377743a65b2e0f1220f1b6f96589b00a94cf6a98f8ad7bf599"}

{"id": "p_0828c8acbf3ec4ac", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 209, "text": "紹初聞公之擊瓊，謂長子譚曰：「就彼攻瓊等，吾攻拔其營，彼固無所歸矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "c1d35b35968bfe4dd93c7752fcc2579dfc7c9896d778d8fe99535ab462aecaa6"}

{"id": "p_f6003499410f6716", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 210, "text": "」乃使張郃、高覽攻曹洪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "381d70b86dfbb403d5b1803339b5103fdbb5dacbe802fb566838414cc930cb42"}

{"id": "p_418d58a325453a99", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 211, "text": "紹衆大潰，紹及譚棄軍走，渡河。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "aa9bc458d3958a3c61ed5fcf38b6e05b6fafe8c07518e9ecefd35e999b4252ed"}

{"id": "p_10a0bde57733c0a2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 212, "text": "追之不及，盡收其輜重圖書珎寶，虜其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "804bf9448353e6844e37b6cdef0f628a140ff5016495ef3b6a11b0bee341ee4c"}

{"id": "p_0196222de2b7dcb9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 213, "text": "公收紹書中，得許下及軍中人書，皆焚之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "2ce7ddf86a3f13d8ac5008bfef2725270fd0772f1ecb6cdc7abd44d9cf24f619"}

{"id": "p_6a38c51929858b7b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 214, "text": "初，桓帝時有黃星見於楚、宋之分，遼東殷馗善天文，言後五十歲當有真人起於梁、沛之閒，其鋒不可當。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "8f6c635d2902ff7aeed2ade81a47ecaf7031c626590e7b7a8cd49c7b66529693"}

{"id": "p_9b81090518221830", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 215, "text": "至是凡五十年，而公破紹，天下莫敵矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "9fa8ed2144e00a253b3a8d903baa860fea3e57297e913a9903bc8d54799f2ee5"}

{"id": "p_3dd71d9cddb62b6e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 216, "text": "六年夏四月，揚兵河上，擊紹倉亭軍，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "1988bf5268863dc345de207bbb07bd925c60c5272a1bdda145f8d4f2735e0d9b"}

{"id": "p_d996640dd7f4c330", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 217, "text": "紹歸，復收散卒，攻定諸叛郡縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "cab57d3d17b24785d36009290a8127937467ced0495b2a14ec1ff22c278d4e2f"}

{"id": "p_8f1fda307f7e747a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 218, "text": "紹之未破也，使劉備略汝南，汝南賊共都等應之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "781a0a12fc928f05b770a8e78d10b621060669a900439ba3ababa0ac1c10f1c7"}

{"id": "p_a1daeb6cb509d778", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 219, "text": "遣蔡揚擊都，不利，爲都所破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "c05b92d19394b76761e0274c6e285a7953be110e526ac7413924aafd0dbe61d8"}

{"id": "p_5447120cebed8b7b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 220, "text": "備聞公自行，走奔劉表，都等皆散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "b47e5ae062b29899fc6cb26df51d35d6d6f7738dfdba414134493ca21a9f64a6"}

{"id": "p_0c58a441cbe3b7a2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 221, "text": "七年春正月，公軍譙，令曰：「吾起義兵，爲天下除暴亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "cd89daea66b5fd4783167106c87877dfb926dd686b2b1f6761ce7218ad646acd"}

{"id": "p_8aa42b63b44b27af", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 222, "text": "舊土人民，死喪略盡，國中終日行，不見所識，使吾悽愴傷懷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "c90091ac45304edbee4c2168374868f4674aa00187a7d3cccd3c85f856f2f82c"}

{"id": "p_365a4e2f8e242aeb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 223, "text": "其舉義兵已來，將士絕無後者，求其親戚以後之，授上田，官給耕牛，置學師以教之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "0d8bcb59c97bf8c0227c1a32fced4f55eea3cb9357ffab8c3129f8810d011778"}

{"id": "p_73a655715c1a7832", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 224, "text": "爲存者立廟，使祀其先人，魂而有靈，吾百年之後何恨哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "1c3855f94566a42b45ccd08850dd3366ea39e1167d219344e3352988573c9c2b"}

{"id": "p_bf3bfbf2353f2c89", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 225, "text": "」遂至浚儀，治睢陽渠，遣使以太牢祀橋玄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "8addcc1866d7d12ba2ef04290417263f62f0acf574da829df9f19b7e97f8f233"}

{"id": "p_2a96a08d6ee16ee3", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 226, "text": "紹自軍破後，發病歐血，夏五月死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "c45f37ce37b6572c21fec5a3d864af232c3d248161dbf92df1a7e34c6aa76629"}

{"id": "p_02267f62fdc8579a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 227, "text": "小子尚代，譚自號車騎將軍，屯黎陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "6d0cb6de70d5ebc6720e75e9641977e8ab372df35391f49e767faae68e6189e8"}

{"id": "p_0fea7a02832d0de5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 228, "text": "八年春三月，攻其郭，乃出戰，擊，大破之，譚、尚夜遁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "ba68423ef96f33090f13201a11798306072a8943ab369e3078465524f39c62fd"}

{"id": "p_760285516f24d311", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 229, "text": "五月還許，留賈信屯黎陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "de312f3e5c03c7effb3a0881b4e681c6651bb6c268dea795341013fa248f4d56"}

{"id": "p_1cf20dfcd7fe4518", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 230, "text": "己酉，令曰：「《司馬法》『將軍死綏』，故趙括之母，乞不坐括。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "897c01265997f374ccf830746e456cf81258b053c236d6d543330982840ce87d"}

{"id": "p_ee1be448d0411a40", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 231, "text": "是古之將者，軍破於外，而家受罪於內也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "99485e295df13dcdae3afc75ed53dae6f4fb8eda6ffc4a2bcc84b2105fa46845"}

{"id": "p_8263a49c25ed3af1", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 232, "text": "自命將征行，但賞功而不罰罪，非國典也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "b0c63754973eb0dec48b063b0a5605c9ae14480e5f5df88e6421f4ea35e5803a"}

{"id": "p_164af101ec610c32", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 233, "text": "其令諸將出征，敗軍者抵罪，失利者免官爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "a253b6cc9c654f3886808c9bedb25d40390c5442d9acff5ae72487d7cafc8a55"}

{"id": "p_5a1772fc5da694f6", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 234, "text": "秋七月，令曰：「喪亂已來，十有五年，後生者不見仁義禮讓之風，吾甚傷之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "e41a027a859c883480257c79cd32b73054db96f82c92f5629461da14fca17f18"}

{"id": "p_d37160dd6d7bd37d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 235, "text": "其令郡國各修文學，縣滿五百戶置校官，選其鄉之俊造而教學之，庶幾先王之道不廢，而有以益於天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "3719bdfb425602da856579a606bd45647e6ed565d6ce25681272355e61811e5c"}

{"id": "p_17a34b1998cb4a3b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 236, "text": "八月，公征劉表，軍西平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "9257ce1e3dc96748e54ca2ad8624f67dc7224aba71904acca10e9f51ddcb730b"}

{"id": "p_d5b24aece844542a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 237, "text": "公之去鄴而南也，譚、尚爭冀州，譚爲尚所敗，走保平原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "312ae34b00088d7b1f28985b1229445412600f762a7289fd929d75f6161b8f9e"}

{"id": "p_d896b24034a3fdf5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 238, "text": "尚攻之急，譚遣辛毗乞降請救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "af5d89939b0d00ea884353e2482db7de5b3fca147273563dd5533fbc671c948e"}

{"id": "p_be83ba95d32203fd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 239, "text": "諸將皆疑，荀攸勸公許之，公乃引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "857ff1625bb92d16ecdded447db7542d672774389d137f99904d0cbebaaab535"}

{"id": "p_0a970edb98e3ef2b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 240, "text": "冬十月，到黎陽，爲子整與譚結婚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "51dc7469565f74632d0ca52ce16f36db332445e9803cf40acd943fb252e253b8"}

{"id": "p_7329402968c17485", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 241, "text": "尚聞公北，乃釋平原還鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "5a69919f6780e08f0d5cd375e599e96e214300a47ef008b4246dda87faeb7a91"}

{"id": "p_c3311969560793f2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 242, "text": "東平呂曠、呂翔叛尚，屯陽平，率其衆降，封爲列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "fe171f2d1f79ba56e648eb99d696ccb0c494a0a9f90eb64b7038e896bf36fc34"}

{"id": "p_1d9c7473912fdd78", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 243, "text": "九年春正月，濟河，遏淇水入白溝以通糧道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "7ed2bd4bef114431001c873cd83d0248dc1ad34091cc6f33b8151b5459efce98"}

{"id": "p_ef700ebe969cc798", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 244, "text": "二月，尚復攻譚，留蘇由、審配守鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "af321fcc89d2699aec9dacb07f83d218cf92c355ebdade029436411d07df9ad8"}

{"id": "p_d0fbec6cc2a0aa4f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 245, "text": "旣至，攻鄴，爲土山、地道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "1bb86a9d5466d77aeb1c55eb9808ba7da61dfc249fa34759f27856936d1b3442"}

{"id": "p_cee1b4e536815846", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 246, "text": "武安長尹楷屯毛城，通上黨糧道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "e9755c29664892a4ff88c24975721a3551ecd70c0ffd2d791d1264fa54a64871"}

{"id": "p_70055cd8b8d5058b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 247, "text": "夏四月，留曹洪攻鄴，公自將擊楷，破之而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "2b0d9a0cce5f86afe5ec6273381df3f436c1b109f02c5240f88320b2fdfe05b4"}

{"id": "p_056a6cbed44a0cfe", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 248, "text": "尚將沮鵠守邯鄲，又擊拔之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "e0dd0342222858d934a2446e35225d3c6b1f201f169d9dae32fc51fdaf30dc2f"}

{"id": "p_56e7ce7cfce309c0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 249, "text": "易陽令韓範、涉長梁岐舉縣降，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "6b0d75d922f5a8eddd11ea981a8c1eda80053765840d5779cc0512edd826f0b5"}

{"id": "p_69ceaaa74dcd9ac5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 250, "text": "五月，毀土山、地道，作圍壍，決漳水灌城；城中餓死者過半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "af57ce683a9400b7efbee79669b299192f66f327adf75d39f4ee3797f7005eac"}

{"id": "p_db47b16bc5f92a08", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 251, "text": "秋七月，尚還救鄴，諸將皆以爲「此歸師，人自爲戰，不如避之」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "577e36698970841dfd7a3ea7e28699f264c45b7b7c9147b354826159748925c2"}

{"id": "p_f83c65a90964f47e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 252, "text": "公曰：「尚從大道來，當避之；若循西山來者，此成禽耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "652a56cd331cc015d815ece5b33e0d32d2888dffeefbe6570cc6fcb3b49acc6d"}

{"id": "p_76ec4fb914f19b47", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 253, "text": "」尚果循西山來，臨滏水爲營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "49a859e2e80c2b5b8323064246a7aad079ac64fc180c4e880f1254e7112e8633"}

{"id": "p_008ccd3a00f299b2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 254, "text": "夜遣兵犯圍，公逆擊破走之，遂圍其營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "a206821e0f6aa82b956771497ee0e094ca3f74cc248d576e8d75f7549e7b3f98"}

{"id": "p_a34fffad742b0510", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 255, "text": "故豫州刺史陰夔及陳琳乞降，公不許，爲圍益急。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "a2a8048c118f9d48abe98aa235cb3e3435b41569867ab3f9acb8a9b062970a5d"}

{"id": "p_b14cb255a6a8b06d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 256, "text": "尚夜遁，保祁山，追擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "3fc1e76dda284fe5696b2e5383ce686b87857eccdc1aa38a60255737ae69c50d"}

{"id": "p_b2a98f6de700a703", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 257, "text": "其將馬延、張顗等臨陣降，衆大潰，尚走中山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "cfa0a32983a5071ef181f5772d89b7298db71a5b39d72ee868132436adb52bf1"}

{"id": "p_a832ce92a2c17d32", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 258, "text": "盡獲其輜重，得尚印綬節鉞，使尚降人示其家，城中崩沮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "d8b81f8fd467672374cf4b5a572d58f291daf51e27c82cce2415bf6368a5d379"}

{"id": "p_258e77b36de4d1fd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 259, "text": "八月，審配兄子榮夜開所守城東門內兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "090bf57cfa3ee8d51fbe0997ffce2301e492e5b1a8a22eb152424cf744600218"}

{"id": "p_0b87eb5db3d683b3", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 260, "text": "配逆戰，敗，生禽配，斬之，鄴定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "8e7b070299fb3db38f4cab608c4ab93b686a45d3c5913d2c151207b687de594a"}

{"id": "p_5682e56f5f5f6959", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 261, "text": "公臨祀紹墓，哭之流涕；慰勞紹妻，還其家人寶物，賜雜繒絮，廩食之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "6d03e2cbe8acbac3c34e310488532a45eefd7c906d8ce574f7651973ca052e46"}

{"id": "p_eb83e04a40bc13e9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 262, "text": "初，紹與公共起兵，紹問公曰：「若事不輯，則方面何所可據？", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "60282d5e9818c459bc65d2ae73558e0fe5263f3b139a4cea8b7000c1bf3a69fc"}

{"id": "p_1179b1add2e060d9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 263, "text": "」公曰：「足下意以爲何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "ea8b0f630b38853d50c395602149586ab0e4deb4001c7c1529a769c7f8b67c9f"}

{"id": "p_f5d25797994adc4a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 264, "text": "」紹曰：「吾南據河，北阻燕、代，兼戎狄之衆，南向以爭天下，庶可以濟乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "6e807a15ecbbe74f88aa948c86e304e8d67c441cdebb1769b669034613eb485e"}

{"id": "p_61fc1ed4c822ab47", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 265, "text": "」公曰：「吾任天下之智力，以道御之，無所不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "a9bda2bd4be43997ceba0ef0b54713909ea0aa80794f4473f29243e9f5bac682"}

{"id": "p_c790fdc1931a5e6c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 266, "text": "九月，令曰：「河北罹袁氏之難，其令無出今年租賦！", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "9c7638cdf8b9bc82908bca2ef0179b5b7ca2875ae4724e1337536468b0735ae0"}

{"id": "p_517df182ead25560", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 267, "text": "」重豪彊兼并之法，百姓喜恱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "270582e8cd236ca7c41237ac1c1e7fb7c9fdb644dcabe9a4c017d5421cb1d555"}

{"id": "p_7cd2f5bd5da50bc1", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 268, "text": "天子以公領冀州牧，公讓還兖州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "7588d4b29662834e83f36d8010215a9b8de8404a52418868355109625ba03ec5"}

{"id": "p_3cccb57a459f5225", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 269, "text": "公之圍鄴也，譚略取甘陵、安平、勃海、河間。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "d135fd5daade6ea2fcb8e622519d305cdafc7924992119cc6066302ec7b9408c"}

{"id": "p_c4298dc05cefb146", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 270, "text": "譚攻之，尚奔故安，遂并其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "29af1fabcefb9f0e4696d054439ee89ea001f854cdd90b8559fb1ff504ea6387"}

{"id": "p_7e77d9d1672121c7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 271, "text": "公遺譚書，責以負約，與之絕婚，女還，然後進軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "a9c68668dc2a4592821b4e44f0f9cdf6220bd27bae68f86e6438aa55ef1e705e"}

{"id": "p_e4b97557bef20992", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 272, "text": "譚懼，拔平原，走保南皮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "ee52dc6244663b1d5d82df392ac95683165c62b2d194394c2e440c407e124403"}

{"id": "p_0a65bc2b95e92610", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 273, "text": "十二月，公入平原，略定諸縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "14413c752690acff6e410a7710691e58d7a0224e81af3cc248404492a3f384fa"}

{"id": "p_1a97937f715e5a57", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 274, "text": "十年春正月，攻譚，破之，斬譚，誅其妻子，冀州平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "b8e418893cf24b80cca4d531683a03cc345a30ca8397bbf7db28478bd029df26"}

{"id": "p_c5863c1e14f88a5b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 275, "text": "下令曰：「其與袁氏同惡者，與之更始。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "4b3a098fecfc9938a63965d0d29bdd1629bac60d38d185b3002b207ad65f0ae3"}

{"id": "p_4e56aa67a539309a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 276, "text": "」令民不得復私讎，禁厚葬，皆一之於法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "407382a2560cfce3a16d1283c982201b44c759406268ca3fb6ad1f59ea8fb943"}

{"id": "p_ce44a3f8c501812d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 277, "text": "是月，袁熙大將焦觸、張南等叛攻熙、尚，熙、尚奔三郡烏丸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "0ba9348b7c80328df70a6405176b2ce2b2ce45608768c674246acb97f9ab500b"}

{"id": "p_e9f183005ce984bf", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 278, "text": "觸等舉其縣降，封爲列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "5653a8e29f39a2448a866a802dabb8bc35113ded0854c990f0828fb17d506f20"}

{"id": "p_7601d9dbb1d0ae1b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 279, "text": "初討譚時，民亡椎冰，令不得降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "f7c379a0013e2bd38765ffae6b9c7f4dced8fcfcf160278bf21dd645f3c8fe6a"}

{"id": "p_142d4397fd8cfda6", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 280, "text": "頃之，亡民有詣門首者，公謂曰：「聽汝則違令，殺汝則誅首，歸深自藏，無爲吏所獲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "5f960ee7e455ca78b68bbd0a4e54b0684f856fc68b1bea513a84bda8bfcb33d8"}

{"id": "p_b07ec8a8f372c8a1", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 281, "text": "」民垂泣而去；後竟捕得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "fd3509b5ed2345f47b7d5c40d647bd6fc3e54363578717d71ee9f3b24deebcc6"}

{"id": "p_75f18e266aea3a2a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 282, "text": "夏四月，黑山賊張燕率其衆十餘萬降，封爲列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "103ff52423ba90af665788bf07e9b987da49970415de0929b6421bf28085957d"}

{"id": "p_6ba094b4b48df6c3", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 283, "text": "故安趙犢、霍奴等殺幽州刺史、涿郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "888d606224a8d517ce93b47867a854402494176d56beffd400ac650b52423f3f"}

{"id": "p_5163df1cac8f3341", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 284, "text": "三郡烏丸攻鮮于輔於獷平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "164420508ab8a86b1cff59a823ae7e4493ee51d53a7fbaf00daa52b704b50cec"}

{"id": "p_1bb038d3548aba42", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 285, "text": "秋八月，公征之，斬犢等，乃渡潞河救獷平，烏丸奔走出塞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "3f4774528ad69be22b0f9d19373a260e7cbbb1d471e0dfdccef3d901c46acbe4"}

{"id": "p_7007905fb1340d8e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 286, "text": "九月，令曰：「阿黨比周，先聖所疾也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "eeca917e98236c70702f88fd9ac9a7061496f35fb5733da4033ba31ea0122499"}

{"id": "p_c2455a2929768457", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 287, "text": "聞冀州俗，父子異部，更相毀譽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "3b818d2899f699eb332618ee176b8ffd0ec655519f6e7b9b8cd1d5d873672eef"}

{"id": "p_ac79d67fdff838de", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 288, "text": "昔直不疑無兄，世人謂之盜嫂；第五伯魚三娶孤女，謂之撾婦翁；王鳳擅權，谷永比之申伯；王商忠議，張匡謂之左道：此皆以白爲黑，欺天罔君者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "dffbcc5234f340fee630c39fc50303d654d4e41fdabc1fe80115d15e684c4017"}

{"id": "p_678366f05b58107f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 289, "text": "吾欲整齊風俗，四者不除，吾以爲羞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "a1cd86803ec2fee2f7d1673be40c968cc810d3dd9ca049fc2d8b1ee26a678cdf"}

{"id": "p_f5f68f261dd79ae9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 290, "text": "初，袁紹以甥高幹領并州牧，公之拔鄴，幹降，遂以爲刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "6115c34d608df5c4a49701b810ca1a74e7024ea74f5934e9e02580caf832c408"}

{"id": "p_a5c9b766a00a67a0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 291, "text": "幹聞公討烏丸，乃以州叛，執上黨太守，舉兵守壺關口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "2bcf735c741f7ad747ba38a10ee0a64b4d10a53e6c3293fc04537240aefd0246"}

{"id": "p_c4d34722327d92a0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 292, "text": "遣樂進、李典擊之，幹還守壺關城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "313fe8214500ad4cc46dcbdf7b16acc31d3e4810eb990d76c3b9982c33b22bd3"}

{"id": "p_42fd0c4919a0b242", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 293, "text": "幹聞之，乃留其別將守城，走入匈奴，求救於單于，單于不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "13ca68d1fe4c1619508a9dfda0c8bd97abeae7e6e5a8470e47986e078e11000c"}

{"id": "p_3c4fb51b18288f5e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 294, "text": "幹遂走荊州，上洛都尉王琰捕斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "e0a3067750db09abcb9887d4a1ce46e1c3e9e65ceb103ead33506325cb3b3cdf"}

{"id": "p_d7d41608e16af6e7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 295, "text": "秋八月，公東征海賊管承，至淳于，遣樂進、李典擊破之，承走入海島。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "cfec6232c5afb971bf297c582403a891d70c16903def85f573d1f5e7dae7228f"}

{"id": "p_2f29ce96fcc53c48", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 296, "text": "割東海之襄賁、郯、戚以益琅邪，省昌慮郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "7f92112dd2bf9ce6a316221f43ac3e133363668ec835f8ffee4926fc74bbe898"}

{"id": "p_f19cedf3319bf5b4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 297, "text": "三郡烏丸承天下亂，破幽州，略有漢民合十餘萬戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "823c706fdbe40618a5811737058aec051acdb3728c36652981bbc3b7965fcdf1"}

{"id": "p_82fc208852d90107", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 298, "text": "袁紹皆立其酋豪爲單于，以家人子爲己女，妻焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "b54fb8de7251f6c2d131cff54e1f978ffffd07db5099c4c547299d3af6d1499e"}

{"id": "p_4c08eed07c6cacc8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 299, "text": "遼西單于蹋頓尤彊，爲紹所厚，故尚兄弟歸之，數入塞爲害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "03518b0b81f31864928d959554e95aee217b5b29b0bd66056a4bded3d6391a81"}

{"id": "p_085fb284eab49f65", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 300, "text": "公將征之，鑿渠，自呼沲入泒水，名平虜渠；又從泃河口鑿入潞河，名泉州渠，以通海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "9dc886f50dd10e5fb29803609b2cd5ed5a9e68b3b53dbd4766a7891cc6d1916d"}

{"id": "p_3e4881e4c14a4c0c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 301, "text": "十二年春二月，公自淳于還鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "08696c1849937adcaa2dc31cc3c67e2be5d8b11dbd9f717eb7e047068472d1e9"}

{"id": "p_1a7e105f0715e48b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 302, "text": "丁酋，令曰：「吾起義兵誅暴亂，於今十九年，所征必克，豈吾功哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "6ac0897848197ba077de3dcfd9e9d706f3810ae19c09390fcc4a26a93025ceda"}

{"id": "p_34e3c9771ee57f15", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 303, "text": "天下雖未悉定，吾當要與賢士大夫共定之；而專饗其勞，吾何以安焉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 303}, "text_hash": "ef053fe51e7a27ff605cb4acefff2601d4821a5cb96cc3e1563b5335c971fa23"}

{"id": "p_47bf41f94f31cf6e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 304, "text": "」於是大封功臣二十餘人，皆爲列侯，其餘各以次受封，及復死事之孤，輕重各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 304}, "text_hash": "13e1412edb10d9d3f9e26026720d061f62ef13b535dac1b387f5fd750439c534"}

{"id": "p_ba3806cc47a7a4d4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 305, "text": "將北征三郡烏丸，諸將皆曰：「袁尚，亡虜耳，夷狄貪而無親，豈能爲尚用？", "locator": {"ordinal": 305}, "text_hash": "dd2f39ed86019cf238b3f59ba248a3849539ab5c11f4713bd198625d0a474acd"}

{"id": "p_815c3be5bc0cf5fb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 306, "text": "今深入征之，劉備必說劉表以襲許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 306}, "text_hash": "6834bdf9da54026891d4f648c5fa97b1358069d2d31fd2857d76a4d09512116e"}

{"id": "p_6cee094acf42e003", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 307, "text": "」惟郭嘉策表必不能任備，勸公行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 307}, "text_hash": "8295fc0590de7237308ad61265d1e02011f376eaebb6414bbe49c26796d81a9e"}

{"id": "p_b0fe654f2cefd895", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 308, "text": "秋七月，大水，傍海道不通，田疇請爲鄉導，公從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 308}, "text_hash": "6b397a709bdd689c1befe53b58a68553d79ce65b90e601d7e0dd102eedfe931e"}

{"id": "p_dbb4588ac72a66d5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 309, "text": "引軍出盧龍塞，塞外道絕不通，乃壍山堙谷五百餘里，經白檀，歷平岡，涉鮮卑庭，東指柳城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 309}, "text_hash": "9e840dc26cb853ae84f3b1d99e72a077d1a98626c77edd0b3c010f72ce22ee12"}

{"id": "p_ee68017639578f4e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 310, "text": "尚、熙與蹋頓、遼西單于樓班、右北平單于能臣抵之等，將數萬騎逆軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 310}, "text_hash": "bd96b96aef18bed4bd47fc12413a48578b5afc556cfcd30cedfbcc96c341d86e"}

{"id": "p_c706a5b2e4472ed8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 311, "text": "八月，登白狼山，卒與虜遇，衆甚盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 311}, "text_hash": "f900ffa13a408b68984a00430ace19b9487693455f2203a097e6d734d388a7b1"}

{"id": "p_eb1bd7fb517fb202", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 312, "text": "公車重在後，被甲者少，左右皆懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 312}, "text_hash": "43eaa3e4677429ad636be797973781e7e7196ebc01772ae5cc0a05e90d139659"}

{"id": "p_2c00f2402d9d90eb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 313, "text": "公登高，望虜陣不整，乃縱兵擊之，使張遼爲先鋒，虜衆大崩，斬蹋頓及名王已下，胡、漢降者二十餘萬口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 313}, "text_hash": "314f112e59d741d68f6ca76de8c844edc2bb85c81d439b913ee89bf58f87d415"}

{"id": "p_211f881ceb71377b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 314, "text": "遼東單于速僕丸及遼西、北平諸豪，棄其種人，與尚、熙奔遼東，衆尚有數千騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 314}, "text_hash": "6d5e9ebab7519a30a7020cbab9d84a9cfaa640eb89099e8afd8e734bb3d4c336"}

{"id": "p_eb66760512cd212b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 315, "text": "初，遼東太守公孫康恃遠不服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 315}, "text_hash": "b5e489d40c1720af28984c4f7d9c500edfaa94ddc7df2426c02eaf3f1c6906ce"}

{"id": "p_56bb1612d239e19f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 316, "text": "及公破烏丸，或說公遂征之，尚兄弟可禽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 316}, "text_hash": "d6161974589d8046726b233f9a6efcc9243e521b6ab5d1dcc54f52d9ab5e89e1"}

{"id": "p_f4c297886a0600ae", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 317, "text": "公曰：「吾方使康斬送尚、熙首，不煩兵矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 317}, "text_hash": "087118f028bb7ad30cb425d0adddf07666a008a7314266fb1fd7f596542553a6"}

{"id": "p_aa2b86b22ce620f4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 318, "text": "」九月，公引兵自柳城還，康即斬尚、熙及速僕丸等，傳其首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 318}, "text_hash": "796735c665778510aca1be16f28ce60e0a5549bafaede1c516248ec3adaf6aa3"}

{"id": "p_d5e4119e2630a579", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 319, "text": "諸將或問：「公還而康斬送尚、熙，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 319}, "text_hash": "9367e14daefd924df83427b5da1e79658bf9cfb852cc67d168e0ae7e35467e02"}

{"id": "p_1c1128b1d2b1c5fe", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 320, "text": "」公曰：「彼素畏尚等，吾急之則并力，緩之則自相圖，其勢然也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 320}, "text_hash": "5f107534d1b98fdc9d5c5db8a0deeb08a2b09eef79860c1748876e9516ffcc7e"}

{"id": "p_82c730c54226e198", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 321, "text": "」十一月至易水，代郡烏丸行單于普富盧、上郡烏丸行單于那樓將其名王來賀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 321}, "text_hash": "7d588e435a86d9aa9d7ae9173d46743b48b563a603f2013bbaa619868694e757"}

{"id": "p_ced11095509b4366", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 322, "text": "十三年春正月，公還鄴，作玄武池以肄舟師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 322}, "text_hash": "b2ecffc91fe3bdb58d595f016e923fa70229460c3c9528e045e21c820a1dcda2"}

{"id": "p_d6ab422b414f3b06", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 323, "text": "漢罷三公官，置丞相、御史大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 323}, "text_hash": "9719408b075bac6927f5fcacf47f9df3329ba14d453e696755a4f28dd965517d"}

{"id": "p_324f28fc6db3fd81", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 324, "text": "八月，表卒，其子琮代，屯襄陽，劉備屯樊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 324}, "text_hash": "0e156c252f68d99ab8ba93de7c36d1130e0b85286427655fcbc74ef6c585d568"}

{"id": "p_e26add617047eded", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 325, "text": "九月，公到新野，琮遂降，備走夏口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 325}, "text_hash": "0e80bae1eb29802e7bb1253317dccf2b2148d1a1604f4ede738b4d2f429b3112"}

{"id": "p_ab3f5d26a606085a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 326, "text": "公進軍江陵，下令荊州吏民，與之更始。", "locator": {"ordinal": 326}, "text_hash": "2036558bed7391cada31b103d115552c213e644b4004e886a9893d2e066ef8b7"}

{"id": "p_ae0e48b9d82cd441", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 327, "text": "乃論荊州服從之功，侯者十五人，以劉表大將文聘爲江夏太守，使統本兵，引用荊州名士韓嵩、鄧義等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 327}, "text_hash": "9583f3ecfa0305248be33badafba9639341789e47ac3ca39204daf595fabef5c"}

{"id": "p_870f5ff423caa86d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 328, "text": "益州牧劉璋始受徵役，遣兵給軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 328}, "text_hash": "841727e3b87b663fee2efc8d63158c70ca61947d0aad9a7e0dd13535d2bc8b46"}

{"id": "p_f9be4696f0245200", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 329, "text": "十二月，孫權爲備攻合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 329}, "text_hash": "ee5591360e5d9ac1e996a9b8998434a01913ee8473ba8b2d66964748c7b959bf"}

{"id": "p_280796a0cce781bc", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 330, "text": "公自江陵征備，至巴丘，遣張憙救合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 330}, "text_hash": "62fc0c05cf4da3190077cb8b4790f8ffb15fe593ee91678fc9c42ca653ed47f5"}

{"id": "p_54253d95e7955d07", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 331, "text": "公至赤壁，與備戰，不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 331}, "text_hash": "3353a4e22caabb7026623e5f8a7e69874f9470f01219bb3d33f2a86db1e93634"}

{"id": "p_277da9f84725e417", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 332, "text": "於是大疫，吏士多死者，乃引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 332}, "text_hash": "6d39834eaea917e2ce68e825a425e6f0a86aa8dea5420ebbdeff157649d32619"}

{"id": "p_6a616bebc9c76233", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 333, "text": "十四年春三月，軍至譙，作輕舟，治水軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 333}, "text_hash": "a4adb3d600255190916f543eb5c4f6688b78a204264382182909fd1bf6bc129a"}

{"id": "p_3ddcb90fec08329e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 334, "text": "秋七月，自渦入淮，出肥水，軍合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 334}, "text_hash": "6893df2a12f9151536e73925866be9ef4ee74848dda6110608164f4d0ec315a0"}

{"id": "p_053f5c0cad4c4f19", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 335, "text": "辛未，令曰：「自頃已來，軍數征行，或遇疫氣，吏士死亡不歸，家室怨曠，百姓流離，而仁者豈樂之哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 335}, "text_hash": "c18d2b0fc293a17b59e5e6a073ee850244897c2f9b65c4713cc62dfb11384388"}

{"id": "p_5005899cf450312d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 336, "text": "其令死者家無基業不能自存者，縣官勿絕廩，長吏存卹撫循，以稱吾意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 336}, "text_hash": "eff70649590425a741a36ab17a15698cc09ed26a979ac8fbcbbe60248547b389"}

{"id": "p_2cdb80d18bb5f1cd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 337, "text": "」置揚州郡縣長吏，開芍陂屯田。", "locator": {"ordinal": 337}, "text_hash": "1f627d5f0c18c5aff881883b82af2c4caca5b169500ccd4870dc15ad9e293a71"}

{"id": "p_7b7ed850f3b16b9d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 338, "text": "十五年春，下令曰：「自古受命及中興之君，曷甞不得賢人君子與之共治天下者乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 338}, "text_hash": "35ecbe8b909fced843fc7e5c89cc155e05778a0237fc94c5e9463ee5d2367760"}

{"id": "p_b08fcf9d4687bfd4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 339, "text": "及其得賢也，曾不出閭巷，豈幸相遇哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 339}, "text_hash": "fbc1d608f65f819dca50763b02c5b97da199702611db15fb17f32315c2441c37"}

{"id": "p_ad5dc99f091e2766", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 340, "text": "今天下尚未定，此特求賢之急時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 340}, "text_hash": "6c67f0b4584c66d8e3ca6d94f5764b408690c3f1ea61903a97cb73f5c4d5d4dc"}

{"id": "p_52d623a718ca256f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 341, "text": "『孟公綽爲趙、魏老則優，不可以爲滕、薛大夫』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 341}, "text_hash": "1145e6bcbf5e1b7f0e7e4d68dcb09b5c61e5c60376568ccd47c5b701fc9a29c7"}

{"id": "p_a2b1579d3d71f640", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 342, "text": "若必廉士而後可用，則齊桓其何以霸世！", "locator": {"ordinal": 342}, "text_hash": "1877b13b45bc1930dcb3dc7869ad4252e0e7a187ddd8c795d8cca111952dd524"}

{"id": "p_106fe6a2333f7417", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 343, "text": "今天下得無有被褐懷玉而釣於渭濵者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 343}, "text_hash": "d144e033b9aa5648ecdc664f1abe27ef0502a7b4cc2b0077d29f2d85e45b3a4f"}

{"id": "p_7e1bd2a23e5a50a6", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 344, "text": "又得無盜嫂受金而未遇無知者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 344}, "text_hash": "e0b6c5177bd6f2fcedbb0e17cb5410aac4b165014d73fef9f8ee67009bd7f7e2"}

{"id": "p_8eb5151049e4f03f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 345, "text": "二三子其佐我明揚仄陋，唯才是舉，吾得而用之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 345}, "text_hash": "0c0a49f6de70f6662b42ef15ce1c8fdba1d3a59a594e53864bc3f6aefabf4c3d"}

{"id": "p_ed3aae5c4e50e4fc", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 346, "text": "十六年春正月，天子命公世子丕爲五官中郎將，置官屬，爲丞相副。", "locator": {"ordinal": 346}, "text_hash": "0e215188bd583b542ce1651f41a86ff5b0455f98579c2677926914d26452c802"}

{"id": "p_83ae31fac391d8ab", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 347, "text": "太原商曜等以大陵叛，遣夏侯淵、徐晃圍破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 347}, "text_hash": "964d7c912d9051b4465a11223501cbc808caba15c31a7f4dbf675ea877b1f3e1"}

{"id": "p_c2aad00318c253ab", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 348, "text": "張魯據漢中，三月，遣鍾繇討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 348}, "text_hash": "75d1781931744e2a4c0ae2c599b1343c8f8b04121fe5baa1ff268a0d69627da6"}

{"id": "p_c4077ee3d1a893f9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 349, "text": "是時關中諸將疑繇欲自襲，馬超遂與韓遂、楊秋、李堪、成宜等叛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 349}, "text_hash": "0742412fe89534f3973552ad6d8ab1e31a151bc76004a253a7d98145966453dc"}

{"id": "p_80a4eb50c9887cb8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 350, "text": "超等屯潼關，公勑諸將：「關西兵精悍，堅壁勿與戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 350}, "text_hash": "abe185f9962e9785388f7b4d5b0502c766a91ab4db6038456e8a0d97bf4ecce5"}

{"id": "p_78e3c79c92af5945", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 351, "text": "」秋七月，公西征，與超等夾關而軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 351}, "text_hash": "9209ee3ed06f217867c68ff945a7bee356cdab4c96c0cfc9122dfd4a539880e9"}
