{"id": "p_7b93b025201f7af9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 352, "text": "公急持之，而潛遣徐晃、朱靈等夜渡蒲阪津，據河西爲營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 352}, "text_hash": "1201e875bb3774a6ad26a5aa4e88c308f5622964e5c5eeeecf6aae4b8c3797ed"}

{"id": "p_3fcc33da54fb16f7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 353, "text": "公自潼關北渡，未濟，超赴船急戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 353}, "text_hash": "913469f81f01ef5e6d1734587f65377b7405aad33ff29021cd4a249e118abb39"}

{"id": "p_08269c000cfe87a0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 354, "text": "校尉丁斐因放牛馬以餌賊，賊亂取牛馬，公乃得渡，循河爲甬道而南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 354}, "text_hash": "51f89bac46b034016c66ae714bf0c7b3f78f16c6d7d4cdbd8ce0f7e6bf732dc1"}

{"id": "p_c8b29e566d603e0a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 355, "text": "賊退，拒渭口，公乃多設疑兵，潛以舟載兵入渭，爲浮橋，夜，分兵結營於渭南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 355}, "text_hash": "aeab3d253ac2aa3eae137985c6d86f585d874c79326c738fa0c87ae42efbee1e"}

{"id": "p_275348d9ca3d0e6d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 356, "text": "超等屯渭南，遣信求割河以西請和，公不許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 356}, "text_hash": "74bf6d9fb74171d6f22b25602a42ad9d678de7188bff3ed84d5575526bba38e7"}

{"id": "p_2bbd77135fc4cd26", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 357, "text": "超等數挑戰，又不許；固請割地，求送任子，公用賈詡計，偽許之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 357}, "text_hash": "1c562bce6a248c5f91429d4bf557d8266cf514ddaa9be5d108fc501772296084"}

{"id": "p_d78b230fa29c01e4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 358, "text": "韓遂請與公相見，公與遂父同歲孝廉，又與遂同時儕輩，於是交馬語移時，不及軍事，但說京都舊故，拊手歡笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 358}, "text_hash": "1ec0a48a469055eb6d75f2eb8a05e3667f852a4c3015bbe320485a69033d11bd"}

{"id": "p_650abc323327e5fc", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 359, "text": "旣罷，超等問遂：「公何言？", "locator": {"ordinal": 359}, "text_hash": "420f89b338ebc37aedaa231441a1b78a7d1d8ac118d428f65723ad17f6e05d59"}

{"id": "p_b5647d350325543b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 360, "text": "他日，公又與遂書，多所點竄，如遂改定者；超等愈疑遂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 360}, "text_hash": "5497f23bd8d35b3ba5ef4766c09d61ad739e424b904f851f3dbcf54877681c4f"}

{"id": "p_a94382be8344ddc3", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 361, "text": "公乃與克日會戰，先以輕兵挑之，戰良久，乃縱虎騎夾擊，大破之，斬成宜、李堪等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 361}, "text_hash": "1c0d1f2302ffb8f55696c1f588f77b839dae44f91007630600ca81a3b3098b5d"}

{"id": "p_d12968e3fa791585", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 362, "text": "遂、超等走涼州，楊秋奔安定，關中平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 362}, "text_hash": "5f6622f79a058eb01129f8ab0ed18f72f3f5b40f665b20f594e32916198b20d2"}

{"id": "p_1760cac274c5f5bf", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 363, "text": "諸將或問公曰：「初，賊守潼關，渭北道缺，不從河東擊馮翊而反守潼關，引日而後北渡，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 363}, "text_hash": "e105fbf05f48404dbf5c61cf078fa8bf64a8855bcd6aa69037e0c67eb2f4df43"}

{"id": "p_b39a533277ff350d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 364, "text": "」公曰：「賊守潼關，若吾入河東，賊必引守諸津，則西河未可渡，吾故盛兵向潼關；賊悉衆南守，西河之備虛，故二將得擅取西河；然後引軍北渡，賊不能與吾爭西河者，以有二將之軍也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 364}, "text_hash": "be333185b8d847e93fa76e2b8cae442e6281bef0e40b728339a727234f578b6c"}

{"id": "p_7e75c864560f88a0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 365, "text": "連車樹柵，爲甬道而南，旣爲不可勝，且以示弱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 365}, "text_hash": "a073a85db6b99c07aecf2449ab5311164d6a6b9d5c4aa7d89edfc5a250df40c5"}

{"id": "p_30abe485f16b172c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 366, "text": "渡渭爲堅壘，虜至不出，所以驕之也；故賊不爲營壘而求割地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 366}, "text_hash": "a33cedbaff3fcceeef21b63381cdd182793c8a3b2cab1e54001fed9ecddafcf6"}

{"id": "p_d204b533bf28cee8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 367, "text": "吾順言許之，所以從其意，使自安而不爲備，因畜士卒之力，一旦擊之，所謂疾雷不及掩耳，兵之變化，固非一道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 367}, "text_hash": "9d1da416d7de9516acb2c36a34a33926858ab51ba153d704937d788e9a5ad079"}

{"id": "p_d270ff3484b6b4df", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 368, "text": "」始，賊每一部到，公輒有喜色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 368}, "text_hash": "f38d990445c585e94c2860819a06384e7b2f97570d8e582c20d77535ba789da9"}

{"id": "p_e5aa4973df2f266f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 369, "text": "公荅曰：「關中長遠，若賊各依險阻，征之，不一二年不可定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 369}, "text_hash": "5d222aed33b2957531aec635350a52692abc51fdd15f3b850ad93495a7ed8ff8"}

{"id": "p_eb340f28a2bdaf51", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 370, "text": "今皆來集，其衆雖多，莫相歸服，軍無適主，一舉可滅，爲功差易，吾是以喜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 370}, "text_hash": "463b208672a4a9f64ceb2c33c6545c1ce4c593a0fb9cb6a2c5018f1a8921983b"}

{"id": "p_e778bb827d7d042f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 371, "text": "冬十月，軍自長安北征楊秋，圍安定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 371}, "text_hash": "f999421f6fd3a50fe05386b840826d5a2ec5e79c557e08db4c2e80161884a864"}

{"id": "p_5c01a4ac2620fb25", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 372, "text": "秋降，復其爵位，使留撫其民人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 372}, "text_hash": "f16375b83e122d59ff08175256240452eeeed67aeeae36c14f1e2614b1339f67"}

{"id": "p_190d8ef70e6e9a60", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 373, "text": "十二月，自安定還，留夏侯淵屯長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 373}, "text_hash": "de170ffeaa20cc6af766af0e7394c7c579b6c8454197013d0f105655be1cf28d"}

{"id": "p_6ee4db3f4e0dc97c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 374, "text": "天子命公贊拜不名，入朝不趨，劔履上殿，如蕭何故事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 374}, "text_hash": "b6a1d44ef9f9bd888fc4c7769f61d3f0403ce4d9e382c0bd64551fb0818ef8ee"}

{"id": "p_994564e562968259", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 375, "text": "馬超餘衆梁興等屯藍田，使夏侯淵擊平之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 375}, "text_hash": "bfe2a701db92f33439c362637f91d064d0f035ce422fc5bbb63f0ba3d5a34005"}

{"id": "p_838418b8a9c47c02", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 376, "text": "割河內之蕩陰、朝歌、林慮，東郡之衞國、頓丘、東武陽、發干，鉅鹿之廮陶、曲周、南和，廣平之任城，趙之襄國、邯鄲、易陽以益魏郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 376}, "text_hash": "d2d9b5f4b80bf890166e92348d4934d1e628be4cb29edba87b5ae94e28985747"}

{"id": "p_7a25f00d203969c2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 377, "text": "十八年春正月，進軍濡須口，攻破權江西營，獲權都督公孫陽，乃引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 377}, "text_hash": "191c0021c44d82368f14e9eb3195fb65f7c1936ad35eb73013f865888863c2f8"}

{"id": "p_d4414f7c00d96431", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 378, "text": "詔書并十四州，復爲九州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 378}, "text_hash": "c028bd071b2de3ae89064be8e73b799d5ea189f809dba93518d910c9092d0ece"}

{"id": "p_eef437a55bd25a2d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 379, "text": "五月丙申，天子使御史大夫郗慮持節策命公爲魏公曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 379}, "text_hash": "4418a17441e7da6ca48756b0cb82b87cbddca142059dd2ec44f63bbac68204e0"}

{"id": "p_09b0ca8291d72331", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 380, "text": "朕以不德，少遭愍凶，越在西土，遷于唐、衞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 380}, "text_hash": "8c4a12dcede8472e90bc246526c716f924f6bab486aebe538607e55e87980883"}

{"id": "p_617b0e673a21273c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 381, "text": "當此之時，若綴旒然，宗廟乏祀，社稷無位；羣凶覬覦，分裂諸夏，率土之民，朕無獲焉，即我高祖之命將墜于地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 381}, "text_hash": "43a6e9bcc0dc4847a9aa181cbaab7f4c6289ea5eaaf320e3f4b57872ee1d3570"}

{"id": "p_444e898a7cd45e89", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 382, "text": "朕用夙興假寐，震悼于厥心，曰「惟祖惟父，股肱先正，其孰能恤朕躬」？", "locator": {"ordinal": 382}, "text_hash": "a1448aa426e2e43223224339760bea4f94cc58924c959a0d284a6286616af126"}

{"id": "p_48033d51de19ae21", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 383, "text": "乃誘天衷，誕育丞相，保乂我皇家，弘濟于艱難，朕實賴之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 383}, "text_hash": "8ff4efa3d8bc81b0723c22b6c73df4e82339b1c3b3ece3a88f46bd72640ea27e"}

{"id": "p_7ea40ffff0bda440", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 384, "text": "今將授君典禮，其敬聽朕命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 384}, "text_hash": "972324aa374c026960bd0e7a8e7490b791274f90559774c44c6c00d2ea22fa30"}

{"id": "p_ebe5d81c804e67d1", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 385, "text": "昔者董卓初興國難，羣后釋位以謀王室，君則攝進，首啟戎行，此君之忠于本朝也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 385}, "text_hash": "7b87e00e3d4ec5077695fd487870ea250ce4466703dff469c7c4b9f4a2b8e9b8"}

{"id": "p_e4dbaed5f1ee906d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 386, "text": "後及黃巾反易天常，侵我三州，延及平民，君又翦之，以寧東夏，此又君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 386}, "text_hash": "5f62dcfe28f5ff35fd09f8376322da08167326d5ab4e995d6d02c6189947deac"}

{"id": "p_775bb2fd927529ca", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 387, "text": "韓暹、楊奉專用威命，君則致討，克黜其難，遂遷許都，造我京畿，設官兆祀，不失舊物，天地鬼神於是獲乂，此又君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 387}, "text_hash": "11c2d1164cc540c7b3bcdbe8384ee616226a47976f3fa9a1eae61165695497c8"}

{"id": "p_87e1ee3fa843d296", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 388, "text": "袁術僭逆，肆於淮南，懾憚君靈，用丕顯謀，蘄陽之役，橋蕤授首，稜威南邁，術以隕潰，此又君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 388}, "text_hash": "206de8bca8204a341906705dff7707e05970b13515f750a73821c7da975e851c"}

{"id": "p_0461bd1d59169050", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 389, "text": "迴戈東征，呂布就戮，乘轅將返，張楊殂斃，眭固伏罪，張繡稽服，此又君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 389}, "text_hash": "b37e97dfe97e6bdfac37234636c6c3e0ef6dca7db6f9d6b2d99bb0c81b0cdcd8"}

{"id": "p_3c44cab85e04d638", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 390, "text": "袁紹逆亂天常，謀危社稷，憑恃其衆，稱兵內侮，當此之時，王師寡弱，天下寒心，莫有固志，君執大節，精貫白日，奮其武怒，運其神策，致屆官渡，大殲醜類，俾我國家拯於危墜，此又君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 390}, "text_hash": "acf547a6d656e87ce799b17907ba137c92913c60dc8120db1996dd8c1a07f637"}

{"id": "p_6886b6f0d54213e5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 391, "text": "濟師洪河，拓定四州，袁譚、高幹，咸梟其首，海盜奔迸，黑山順軌，此又君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 391}, "text_hash": "2790447875d7e2d97dafd2b58a5ab57c2092005b369f48bf1da3b45027bb8074"}

{"id": "p_eca33aaf95a0c370", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 392, "text": "烏丸三種，崇亂二世，袁尚因之，逼據塞北，束馬縣車，一征而滅，此又君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 392}, "text_hash": "974fe125495d7da63ee4c2200475b9343fe378aa0bb950cfe4f7573442d5461f"}

{"id": "p_ed1471519eb489a4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 393, "text": "劉表背誕，不供貢職，王師首路，威風先逝，百城八郡，交臂屈膝，此又君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 393}, "text_hash": "5c2db2df063380edaedf066575e1469d87917ed3b3dee21081a2998e9cae31e4"}

{"id": "p_003648e6a6f04c05", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 394, "text": "馬超、成宜，同惡相濟，濵據河、潼，求逞所欲，殄之渭南，獻馘萬計，遂定邊境，撫和戎狄，此又君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 394}, "text_hash": "c5e6569ab8e196b89cd0380561714ecbb49c887b1db97d53fc19f2b95bd286e4"}

{"id": "p_6b63bca54ac47c6f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 395, "text": "鮮卑、丁零，重譯而至，于、白屋，請吏率職，此又君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 395}, "text_hash": "88f991737bbcbe2462507cdaa89cc3b0ce5087a0e2ae70ac1ce3c19096cb4e29"}

{"id": "p_00ca7a8f1f2b5769", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 396, "text": "君有定天下之功，重之以明德，班敘海內，宣美風俗，旁施勤教，恤慎刑獄，吏無苛政，民無懷慝；敦崇帝族，表繼絕世，舊德前功，罔不咸秩；雖伊尹格于皇天，周公光于四海，方之蔑如也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 396}, "text_hash": "ffa1b95db02024d698a4c06ec88e3318ab637bd7528e129e698bcc0f26319864"}

{"id": "p_fed8725a8f8513bb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 397, "text": "朕聞先王並建明德，胙之以土，分之以民，崇其寵章，備其禮物，所以藩衞王室，左右厥世也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 397}, "text_hash": "07a2f6a28d1d0a6f1184bde271d686a1728269a176dff569afd3022d975d29c6"}

{"id": "p_2685e76fc5c553b8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 398, "text": "其在周成，管、蔡不靜，懲難念功，乃使邵康公賜齊太公履，東至于海，西至于河，南至于穆陵，北至于無棣，五侯九伯，實得征之，世祚太師，以表東海；爰及襄王，亦有楚人不供王職，又命晉文登爲侯伯，錫以二輅、虎賁、鈇鉞、秬鬯、弓矢，大啟南陽，世作盟主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 398}, "text_hash": "9d395986bdb24ae6436d706bbf3bcdfb36e89109d4d5061d39db2021b526d707"}

{"id": "p_804ceb5ac5b1b517", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 399, "text": "故周室之不壞，繄二國是賴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 399}, "text_hash": "978e72cd2cf1664cb90d0c2bbdaa2ebb50f435c8271c38437c2ae723dc338fda"}

{"id": "p_9d64c1855e80dae4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 400, "text": "今君稱丕顯德，明保朕躬，奉荅天命，導揚弘烈，緩爰九域，莫不率俾，功高于伊、周，而賞卑於齊、晉，朕甚恧焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 400}, "text_hash": "44221d6c61518e13ec70c2064c86a77566b882c76c2c2f4b3816082dad9f495c"}

{"id": "p_447a201223521bca", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 401, "text": "朕以眇眇之身，託于兆民之上，永思厥艱，若涉淵冰，非君攸濟，朕無任焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 401}, "text_hash": "2d6481deb13750474953efa04349cfb28ac9ae3546624b679b9d461b2a9b1de0"}

{"id": "p_83ed94b870b096a7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 402, "text": "今以冀州之河東、河內、魏郡、趙國、中山、常山、鉅鹿、安平、甘陵、平原凡十郡，封君爲魏公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 402}, "text_hash": "0a9a035d2840c6dd709e325599255565df4ee446ab8ed3f3d4339e5ed4894980"}

{"id": "p_f5a06cbadf3f23c8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 403, "text": "錫君玄土，苴以白茅；爰契爾龜，用建冢社。", "locator": {"ordinal": 403}, "text_hash": "bda3124b7f353d48a47959abf33f18470a24c3e88b6b51f12dc55eb31e27021e"}

{"id": "p_585dd03df7e11399", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 404, "text": "昔在周室，畢公、毛公入爲卿佐，周、邵師保出爲二伯，外內之任，君實宜之，其以丞相領冀州牧如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 404}, "text_hash": "e3174996107db9b9dd9df8ac743e5ace3aea38c2d43a10b56bce875428fc427d"}

{"id": "p_2bbd15f7e8a61de3", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 405, "text": "又加君九錫，其敬聽朕命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 405}, "text_hash": "4cd9c387fb97366c42c2e1696c9f4a7d084bc6144e1273132c5ced693e7b1e5f"}

{"id": "p_9c8ffc20a40b68e9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 406, "text": "以君經緯禮律，爲民軌儀，使安職業，無或遷志，是用錫君大輅、戎輅各一，玄牡二駟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 406}, "text_hash": "4b8aaa7d27cf7c08bf9924fcd7f05eaf28a35a772bc32a5554075341a204a969"}

{"id": "p_7f27ff6a936fe8cc", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 407, "text": "君勸分務本，穡人昏作，粟帛滯積，大業惟興，是用錫君衮冕之服，赤舄副焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 407}, "text_hash": "a5e97cb92b0f514bec20217be0fab7ce854ef4766990af8effadeed395d41f02"}

{"id": "p_0d942f9d50b50f4c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 408, "text": "君敦尚謙讓，俾民興行，少長有禮，上下咸和，是用錫君軒縣之樂，六佾之舞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 408}, "text_hash": "0fa17508113693b3f00f46d664406caf5276c4494ac26ea26371c118b0e13fb1"}

{"id": "p_cb5369358972d82a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 409, "text": "君翼宣風化，爰發四方，遠人革面，華夏充實，是用錫君朱戶以居。", "locator": {"ordinal": 409}, "text_hash": "add55b1a57d6d4281c1de8a5e62615ba274b109a2c77e6aff4087bd25c2317ea"}

{"id": "p_44b843adbb2b39ae", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 410, "text": "君研其明哲，思帝所難，官才任賢，羣善必舉，是用錫君納陛以登。", "locator": {"ordinal": 410}, "text_hash": "532b6ef0de58675bb896830d4639de5ae550469b4b4a177a7575399b2d230d24"}

{"id": "p_958df0793df628e8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 411, "text": "君秉國之鈞，正色處中，纖豪之惡，靡不抑退，是用錫君虎賁之士三百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 411}, "text_hash": "d50056e0f1a0918a5da8f16ce67f4078a4be356ccd57b395109ff16361421371"}

{"id": "p_01028d5a3d835c6a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 412, "text": "君糾虔天刑，章厥有罪，犯關干紀，莫不誅殛，是用錫君鈇鉞各一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 412}, "text_hash": "0e6e7cd1c671814d7927a449c644048f158fbe35cf528350680d69bdd1df6f8a"}

{"id": "p_db51272ee45b34bd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 413, "text": "君龍驤虎視，旁眺八維，掩討逆節，折衝四海，是用錫君彤弓一，彤矢百，玈弓十，玈矢千。", "locator": {"ordinal": 413}, "text_hash": "0890479329740537f51d8ff50e180dfe49714b259c4f62bbbbdaed39ba1172fd"}

{"id": "p_ab9692354c14a0ab", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 414, "text": "君以溫恭爲基，孝友爲德，明允篤誠，感于朕思，是用錫君秬鬯一卣，珪瓚副焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 414}, "text_hash": "be25e786c4503fd42d1c8b76eeca72ec8d2ea7e89ff27915d5c00ebf314d3bbc"}

{"id": "p_57b4f7a24e4a56b9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 415, "text": "魏國置丞相已下羣卿百寮，皆如漢初諸侯王之制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 415}, "text_hash": "f18c9a65dde48372689f7f90cadd5c73cffe0587d083bf999efa8e5b5e67ad87"}

{"id": "p_ac0972242d2f92d0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 416, "text": "簡恤爾衆，時亮庶功，用終爾顯德，對揚我高祖之休命！", "locator": {"ordinal": 416}, "text_hash": "38186ded5dffac12ad4fee9af091dafdf49b489e80ceb99826f546258d5507e3"}

{"id": "p_028410a1d610e4b4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 417, "text": "秋七月，始建魏社稷宗廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 417}, "text_hash": "43b04bc78ba7f29898181c201e96a870ebb0b190c475023f68b79e1e58543b72"}

{"id": "p_9c5dbb71eaf08a12", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 418, "text": "天子娉公三女爲貴人，少者待年於國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 418}, "text_hash": "101f30ae4ca07a8fa41981c4727d11f60ecc2ecb560c4b77d55c11290c5e343f"}

{"id": "p_32bb5b8181a87029", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 419, "text": "九月，作金虎臺，鑿渠引漳水入白溝以通河。", "locator": {"ordinal": 419}, "text_hash": "f454b1dce2f73b343b5a57d6dc63d7daab2966afc2b6211f0af1ff235bc0fcc7"}

{"id": "p_9828f006a812349f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 420, "text": "冬十月，分魏郡爲東西部，置都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 420}, "text_hash": "51567db93bf032fd38da3a60e375a88b56880096a6103f0835d8ac47e740c103"}

{"id": "p_d711f44fa4fea6c3", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 421, "text": "十一月，初置尚書、侍中、六卿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 421}, "text_hash": "fc83f11a821df220579c94cb425e4521d360f8dc57fd33cc56f0b1740201286e"}

{"id": "p_7cbd86dc24aaa14c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 422, "text": "馬超在漢陽，復因羌、胡爲害，氐王千萬叛應超，屯興國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 422}, "text_hash": "25f0d59b7aa1923d419252229bdedc06d651042e5aaf6b1661bbb1c9ab79e339"}

{"id": "p_5eb7b7e1be91a48d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 423, "text": "十九年春正月，始耕籍田。", "locator": {"ordinal": 423}, "text_hash": "e63fb7c89793a6baf93dd165f6c3f9c42e94abf20ad2739fd165128fc6fb88a3"}

{"id": "p_670db063c17147af", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 424, "text": "南安趙衢、漢陽尹奉等討超，梟其妻子，超奔漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 424}, "text_hash": "3cf2529fb1d50276295cd714bac82fa1e4afd5947d79b9ff58c7f224f1e3c697"}

{"id": "p_3d2f7684faa091f2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 425, "text": "韓遂徙金城，入氐王千萬部，率羌、胡萬餘騎與夏侯淵戰，擊，大破之，遂走西平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 425}, "text_hash": "22c3f6d25a8482bd2be0481c57757528280e312b8ce3eb3fbde632df78bf0e28"}

{"id": "p_394ea9b2a66a0b6a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 426, "text": "安定太守毌丘興將之官，公戒之曰：「羌，胡欲與中國通，自當遣人來，慎勿遣人徃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 426}, "text_hash": "bce8be6c5d1b1ca27863059381f2d95ac79e209a9616c7f04280a55640ec3154"}

{"id": "p_e107a70b9f9dd7bf", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 427, "text": "善人難得，必將教羌、胡妄有所請求，因欲以自利；不從便爲失異俗意，從之則無益事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 427}, "text_hash": "20d63f5bdf1e6707ceb67798716d8d6a70b9bae7388bc875d1af01d8a686a5ed"}

{"id": "p_43dc1ae55080487f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 428, "text": "」興至，遣校尉范陵至羌中，陵果教羌，使自請爲屬國都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 428}, "text_hash": "b93ed3ea06a97b4dfac5b660b825d2a190067ee1f71aa95791808c4027676eb1"}

{"id": "p_922d61afd0655daa", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 429, "text": "公曰：「吾預知當爾，非聖也，但更事多耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 429}, "text_hash": "cad6df7ec7fd12f63f23cb3410e3adb742fb96a22cd1c688251fa64564b3dfe6"}

{"id": "p_812f2f43ae49128c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 430, "text": "三月，天子使魏公位在諸侯王上，改授金璽，赤紱、遠遊冠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 430}, "text_hash": "23cfb3f39051487be2230eaa9fb4bd8d5a28bf01decb60bb97a353959b4b85a6"}

{"id": "p_e2e4aab51840f58c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 431, "text": "初，隴西宋建自稱河首平漢王，聚衆枹罕，改元，置百官，三十餘年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 431}, "text_hash": "85e2deb9634929d1eea0e77e33d7e1497fe5887b22054ae00d5fb93103a2957d"}

{"id": "p_689602c399e1b496", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 432, "text": "冬十月，屠枹罕，斬建，涼州平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 432}, "text_hash": "3472173c8690b3b53e42c386174b214c4cc2443a0fed922c205b65a5ab061113"}

{"id": "p_c61bf7e8bdcc4824", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 433, "text": "十一月，漢皇后伏氏坐昔與父故屯騎校尉完書，云帝以董承被誅怨恨公，辭甚醜惡，發聞，后廢黜死，兄弟皆伏法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 433}, "text_hash": "94036cb0fe60e7b5afae58b93cc180d4f042d1eccb2d4a74cc8881ebb9b5a410"}

{"id": "p_517085e9a713d157", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 434, "text": "天子命公置旄頭，宮殿設鍾虡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 434}, "text_hash": "3b2618b02f2739832e8e5644c075ffb2da882d4abb80b0ffba3a2e7a1cfe5076"}

{"id": "p_1ad9b3c190aa1dc5", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 435, "text": "乙未，令曰：「夫有行之士未必能進取，進取之士未必能有行也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 435}, "text_hash": "b21b5787a7257ba476030467f2190e04433ecfe90aa03ab3af58da831da56831"}

{"id": "p_e148678f1f148240", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 436, "text": "陳平豈篤行，蘇秦豈守信邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 436}, "text_hash": "579f674cd3d6648b98aac4eea6260a4b4095d08493299ac46730958fb9269b24"}

{"id": "p_9b5412086c2c8ebf", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 437, "text": "而陳平定漢業，蘇秦濟弱燕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 437}, "text_hash": "dc68400eb50fe15711347a9eed9673adf69313c5449d2e2a3d75a42a67b5590e"}

{"id": "p_2815ad17d36bbd8f", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 438, "text": "由此言之，士有偏短，庸可廢乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 438}, "text_hash": "fe4426a1cf668b38b04e1578e21dd39b63073bef5c9ccb63fe31b6ea57a66b09"}

{"id": "p_ca6d287c6a590aae", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 439, "text": "有司明思此義，則士無遺滯，官無廢業矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 439}, "text_hash": "5be8c76421cd4cd0578b8cd52f96ee5c79de4cfd10bc071c77a4d3e90cdc5156"}

{"id": "p_74f6ac76c017e93c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 440, "text": "」又曰：「夫刑，百姓之命也，而軍中典獄者或非其人，而任以三軍死生之事，吾甚懼之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 440}, "text_hash": "8d9f6a1575ec1730fbe7cf9f1db10c2348448ad19f6bfef6c842a7be5697c077"}

{"id": "p_6fbb3b7b3c874df7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 441, "text": "其選明達法理者，使持典刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 441}, "text_hash": "905ad25ce66a9c440b09a8620a7a361221306c877d469f78af341588a5ce4089"}

{"id": "p_b97a308a60fba1aa", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 442, "text": "二十年春正月，天子立公中女爲皇后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 442}, "text_hash": "e10563496d551effaeb97b9284eb9b4fcec22e78eb0ec80898bb58054cca0181"}

{"id": "p_09a0098fbbe66505", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 443, "text": "省雲中、定襄、五原、朔方郡，郡置一縣領其民，合以爲新興郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 443}, "text_hash": "10c82cdb84303d123fe6410a13182dbe7a6535a5163d572857ccd59c9190d996"}

{"id": "p_31aa38c6294ef97e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 444, "text": "三月，公西征張魯，至陳倉，將自武都入氐；氐人塞道，先遣張郃、朱靈等攻破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 444}, "text_hash": "ea2c3fcdc050b00eaa02fd8c9aeef5feb15301ba3ca3f41231f8d403e0c3c06e"}

{"id": "p_df30b923b7c60fb7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 445, "text": "夏四月，公自陳倉以出散關，至河池。", "locator": {"ordinal": 445}, "text_hash": "c98335f5c6d0352d84ab59b32607d886d5cad5e84d514d656eef1055274b69e9"}

{"id": "p_a94030a586c0bac3", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 446, "text": "氐王竇茂衆萬餘人，恃險不服，五月，公攻屠之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 446}, "text_hash": "7f2679d07fadd7bbeadf863dd137e5864af0be89c1de85dcad4a50343584b19f"}

{"id": "p_7353cedd1ae24a63", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 447, "text": "西平、金城諸將麴演、蔣石等共斬送韓遂首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 447}, "text_hash": "112c1b3925981bee0924224bc8e3d760d04d31248cb5ed45f31dbb3f93efd279"}

{"id": "p_24f138b67667553b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 448, "text": "張魯使弟衞與將楊昂等據陽平關，橫山築城十餘里，攻之不能拔，乃引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 448}, "text_hash": "f30f46c9a95a8005ac50f48833f1bbd1118d4fd5e079b4fa9914492782895150"}

{"id": "p_143614f6a9a6493c", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 449, "text": "賊見大軍退，其守備解散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 449}, "text_hash": "0b920998b858d09bd88c5bb9cb2ba688ee41ac07525c0cb8066018d385da4b0a"}

{"id": "p_ba493704295a56b8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 450, "text": "公乃密遣解、高祚等乘險夜襲，大破之，斬其將楊任，進攻衞，衞等夜遁，魯潰奔巴中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 450}, "text_hash": "cfe7af9b3f03fe8c0c21a66a8a6d275cd0a6314d3089cec02a5d680a9496950e"}

{"id": "p_60c5431f3f5a3d30", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 451, "text": "公軍入南鄭，盡得魯府庫珍寶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 451}, "text_hash": "49da1942e065e86a77b4ce106e5fca12e55c5010c9660943f11bea841b2b9457"}

{"id": "p_50d30dd7ad6f1b39", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 452, "text": "復漢寧郡爲漢中；分漢中之安陽、西城爲西城郡，置太守；分錫、上庸郡，置都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 452}, "text_hash": "db4d9a849d25d4b15f9774460207cf985f015e49c49d68567ef28a87f70e1d2c"}

{"id": "p_c3e62b96f85a20e4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 453, "text": "八月，孫權圍合肥，張遼、李典擊破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 453}, "text_hash": "988ebdcbe7aa3999a4b49b8a1e5f0f6acf625f7a373b6dd760b5ae5621054509"}

{"id": "p_9f2d9213b9dfd33a", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 454, "text": "九月，巴七姓夷王朴胡、賨邑侯杜濩舉巴夷、賨民來附，於是分巴郡，以胡爲巴東太守，濩爲巴西太守，皆封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 454}, "text_hash": "f02a2638fc5e4c387d56f176f02d2da38a50e486f400c7e1fdb29862ae87889f"}

{"id": "p_f815b667da923476", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 455, "text": "天子命公承制封拜諸侯守相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 455}, "text_hash": "ccb66706428cf12db73a5a072cac2bff5736362996e3ac6171bc8802476874a6"}

{"id": "p_bb903eb2fa99cebe", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 456, "text": "冬十月，始置名號侯至五大夫，與舊列侯、關內侯凡六等，以賞軍功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 456}, "text_hash": "8ea3fd93a127dbc79676a81cd79a7d394373a46b7c227feb74257413c0776ef0"}

{"id": "p_f2e633075345b2b8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 457, "text": "十一月，魯自巴中將其餘衆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 457}, "text_hash": "0d4642d3076861792c0dfead675b3842f027da6984329cf8574b99557461d430"}

{"id": "p_38d732a338cd6c7d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 458, "text": "劉備襲劉璋，取益州，遂據巴中；遣張郃擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 458}, "text_hash": "08adfa5410249eca038335510c1b4a1a217b3d9365c5b1d2eda24dd9efc2d09f"}

{"id": "p_7d427a41227e955b", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 459, "text": "十二月，公自南鄭還，留夏侯淵屯漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 459}, "text_hash": "6f155457e72488df56c3a51f635bb2ca6f4a6ee26dae56afbcf5822e8e2cc4b2"}

{"id": "p_ee0d08778f751acd", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 460, "text": "二十一年春二月，公還鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 460}, "text_hash": "79ca94ce09929aadd8b92ee6a46f487f0392dac6e85fb39da28caa4d95e09513"}

{"id": "p_22242d586d2b602d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 461, "text": "夏五月，天子進公爵爲魏王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 461}, "text_hash": "08ed2bb046d332177bc6b7fb79e10dbae6fc19155ca07382b33d86131bf5d2db"}

{"id": "p_9308bde70b4ccf66", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 462, "text": "代郡烏丸行單于普富盧與其侯王來朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 462}, "text_hash": "5d3cbb0953d8c834b7ebdf8bc13babc01179bb2a40eebd2221135ac1f1b5808a"}

{"id": "p_d266787de3b2c8e8", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 463, "text": "天子命王女爲公主，食湯沐邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 463}, "text_hash": "e44f81e45fd1a1c138829544ecc06a4ca67e65ef3bdd87b68d1d89c4cdf663f3"}

{"id": "p_12b88fcda874ff05", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 464, "text": "秋七月，匈奴南單于呼廚泉將其名王來朝，待以客禮，遂留魏，使右賢王去卑監其國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 464}, "text_hash": "55a9edb44b4d66f3a7ca1bb2ab0b646e09a791822251ead747141cb1a7e30c5b"}

{"id": "p_99cbcd4752b79351", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 465, "text": "八月，以大理鍾繇爲相國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 465}, "text_hash": "28be9fde5f46b68431b587b6059359a1374abfc6668324741450af08bdaa152c"}

{"id": "p_9feb9a7269e3d4e6", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 466, "text": "冬十月，治兵，遂征孫權，十一月至譙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 466}, "text_hash": "25c8085d6015ee3a5089e89c04a5f606102bf9033ffe1f4a8f3a2e45dfcd59f3"}

{"id": "p_9172924a5bb9a356", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 467, "text": "二十二年春正月，王軍居巢，二月，進軍屯江西郝谿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 467}, "text_hash": "d057de19ccf144933958f60fdd642dcc6186901124df261368043021002a212f"}

{"id": "p_d7c644bffadb73e9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 468, "text": "權在濡須口築城拒守，遂逼攻之，權退走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 468}, "text_hash": "8d552980d17ade68650f99a27e9d00cc9c7161c565bcdb1af5970c15271a3b42"}

{"id": "p_5e34fc984f46aae2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 469, "text": "三月，王引軍還，留夏侯惇、曹仁、張遼等屯居巢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 469}, "text_hash": "db8ebeb9288353f3a2a87a5af7d85d1a4944681dd39914916df33b23edf0975f"}

{"id": "p_bafcc616136e2f20", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 470, "text": "夏四月，天子命王設天子旌旗，出入稱警蹕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 470}, "text_hash": "47785ef92860870d811473609ca8687bb2c596fb6ac571a19c5a9c480a32817f"}

{"id": "p_6cfa2d67305afadb", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 471, "text": "六月，以軍師華歆爲御史大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 471}, "text_hash": "8fabf37e085ad41107e63950c420dbe4329e1a1cfd795ede174be5fff3d3a810"}

{"id": "p_c731b24ffa4cf6ef", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 472, "text": "冬十月，天子命王冕十有二旒，乘金根車，駕六馬，設五時副車，以五官中郎將丕爲魏太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 472}, "text_hash": "ceb948f48f56511696878ba6d01852e412aa9ac886c6c5c95b563d99486f736f"}

{"id": "p_3ea8531dfba2bfa2", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 473, "text": "劉備遣張飛、馬超、吳蘭等屯下辯；遣曹洪拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 473}, "text_hash": "4b9b99f1285e3a766f544a0ed6f1d0f6e8131cd072482a36e583648c60aab746"}

{"id": "p_d1043f93578b9e16", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 474, "text": "二十三年春正月，漢太醫令吉本與少府耿紀、司直韋晃等反，攻許，燒丞相長史王必營，必與潁川典農中郎將嚴匡討斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 474}, "text_hash": "ac755474989fa40d4fd9f9c44c4e8737e2ddee30602d3ed15b313df6d4b4ae3f"}

{"id": "p_550fcd6a7dc5c372", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 475, "text": "曹洪破吳蘭，斬其將任夔等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 475}, "text_hash": "1553c2c9b31feace6066572bf9e764dcb528bca98fe54c3bd890aab7dd36be1a"}

{"id": "p_5c6469aef9a408af", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 476, "text": "三月，張飛、馬超走漢中，陰平氐強端斬吳蘭，傳其首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 476}, "text_hash": "ea86599cf4e0413e98f28898c74ce8509e65fc05a2b8cda87a587a3c8d1116f5"}

{"id": "p_0868ca591286c647", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 477, "text": "夏四月，代郡、上谷烏丸無臣氐等叛，遣鄢陵侯彰討破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 477}, "text_hash": "db302012d47c171f0c5131bf2e0ef799ab40bd1f6d0efebdad6ceb195b4e2076"}

{"id": "p_69571b72fc045ad4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 478, "text": "六月，令曰：「古之葬者，必居瘠薄之地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 478}, "text_hash": "526069c1ba5993df9e0023d07a050562a91449e3ce0407252aebdb6612506300"}

{"id": "p_59611e61dfb51d90", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 479, "text": "其規西門豹祠西原上爲壽陵，因高爲基，不封不樹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 479}, "text_hash": "fb29df106762fa71a3c211b97146ad10c53b078177fabb168c0549a895f5e4ee"}

{"id": "p_18535a2307151c30", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 480, "text": "周禮冢人掌公墓之地，凡諸侯居左右以前，卿大夫居後，漢制亦謂之陪陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 480}, "text_hash": "ea3871517084200ea930bd4a0303b58439ba2c1097eb4246e839c34cf4ce1405"}

{"id": "p_1807d8fb9b305db7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 481, "text": "其公卿大臣列將有功者，宜陪壽陵，其廣爲兆域，使足相容。", "locator": {"ordinal": 481}, "text_hash": "91f66b36c74b57c1bd664d8d11a7e987d40d7ad0951ec70b50c428505baf5656"}

{"id": "p_5bf142d333ab29b0", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 482, "text": "秋七月，治兵，遂西征劉備，九月，至長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 482}, "text_hash": "86956f64760303bd4a32a1439bc15972c06a38676d9c2c150ec526594c9ce030"}

{"id": "p_b1eab8ca49f33685", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 483, "text": "冬十月，宛守將侯音等反，執南陽太守，劫略吏民，保宛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 483}, "text_hash": "68fc5980199c47385ef54e1ad3214ffff24c2639bed49d701e546acfbfe3cc82"}

{"id": "p_e2c05477e4fa4568", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 484, "text": "初，曹仁討關羽，屯樊城，是月使仁圍宛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 484}, "text_hash": "ac5d1a573ece994aa0f913c83f7d2ae96fca74edb98e8fac9b4903f003c5612b"}

{"id": "p_ca0cb4a3cd2fb0ac", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 485, "text": "二十四年春正月，仁屠宛，斬音。", "locator": {"ordinal": 485}, "text_hash": "06f8dda5fa14685ac8785a1d6e7a0fbf6269f6fc4e2ec07fbb9db7678d340e7b"}

{"id": "p_4ade5a5212c37a36", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 486, "text": "夏侯淵與劉備戰於陽平，爲備所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 486}, "text_hash": "a565a6beb84bd56d403c57801ee0ce287c18d1c3cd9e83fca630a1581449c11c"}

{"id": "p_4f127658aeef672e", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 487, "text": "三月，王自長安出斜谷，軍遮要以臨漢中，遂至陽平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 487}, "text_hash": "039479a6c7beb8ab5b2d66a4148382f95c712f632435ad587ce08d11a4bf9134"}

{"id": "p_f9fc67885668fb0d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 488, "text": "秋七月，以夫人卞氏爲王后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 488}, "text_hash": "e7cb0c004af2bb4e0d196967bf1d797c016691edbb7f3fc1e2c98773eba19d73"}

{"id": "p_fb31df22f126e866", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 489, "text": "八月，漢水溢，灌禁軍，軍沒，羽獲禁，遂圍仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 489}, "text_hash": "eda8126220d5946760eb047ab4fa3362288bebee18a72cf613a0c3a1b6792eb3"}

{"id": "p_37875bc379121d84", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 490, "text": "九月，相國鍾繇坐西曹掾魏諷反免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 490}, "text_hash": "3e0c005f1eb63bc6363e318d413600587634ba65cf6e710aca1b37053373f1ed"}

{"id": "p_32260aea553aeccc", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 491, "text": "孫權遣使上書，以討關羽自效。", "locator": {"ordinal": 491}, "text_hash": "62b43ef6d127bb0bacc66d56e8c71c323644c282611aae4e154407c1e1cd65a4"}

{"id": "p_a1b64839327b5d09", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 492, "text": "王自洛陽南征羽，未至，晃攻羽，破之，羽走，仁圍解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 492}, "text_hash": "9482d496d5631a063aef4994a291c958dd826fef1a944c5c501adda087998cfb"}

{"id": "p_74783b085f83b6fc", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 493, "text": "二十五年春正月，至洛陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 493}, "text_hash": "bcf7f22522e2cf881c35debc7852a86c21483784e4ed85b11f7dcfaaf576fc11"}

{"id": "p_7452d1b86d63036d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 494, "text": "庚子，王崩于洛陽，年六十六。", "locator": {"ordinal": 494}, "text_hash": "5e767af89762c970e15e5bdd3a247fb6dd288624c4a2c2c95a098b3e0b53b104"}

{"id": "p_0818c8e73c780aa4", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 495, "text": "遺令曰：「天下尚未安定，未得遵古也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 495}, "text_hash": "d0723fc870a0aeba264fa7a06b59b79bd1fd4feeaf2e3b53496c98b16a2d3a6e"}

{"id": "p_4e8640f8dabd6f2d", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 496, "text": "其將兵屯戍者，皆不得離屯部。", "locator": {"ordinal": 496}, "text_hash": "a20fe8d004d92abbb75bab52813a6f349da4cee7e98cc436cc42271440977417"}

{"id": "p_7db24e6a6c784cf9", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 497, "text": "斂以時服，無藏金玉珍寶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 497}, "text_hash": "d2e3f2156a24fc7bfe4f3b567a7ffb042856df4e37da5a29ee24360a6dd669fb"}

{"id": "p_485a28f6d56b58bc", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 498, "text": "評曰：漢末，天下大亂，雄豪並起，而袁紹虎眎四州，彊盛莫敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 498}, "text_hash": "a481a8f1645ee3d191e1552051e253ef7941b46f077f9bfe76d5c82bd497bbcd"}

{"id": "p_4f93cf891153c0c3", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 499, "text": "太祖運籌演謀，鞭撻宇內，擥申、商之法術，該韓、白之奇策，官方授材，各因其器，矯情任筭，不念舊惡，終能總御皇機，克成洪業者，惟其明略最優也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 499}, "text_hash": "4659a88de6c11f21661ab7d3dc8f99955cef81cea10ac718bd5c42b2fc15795b"}

{"id": "p_c1ac2d22637085e7", "source_id": "src_8d3056db6591b2ee", "ordinal": 500, "text": "抑可謂非常之人，超世之傑矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 500}, "text_hash": "284006dbff1c0334b797d082a04bc0eb51a1f8dfdc14fa70728fd30617f83f34"}

{"id": "p_e845f15ca3bf63ae", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 0, "text": "文皇帝諱丕，字子桓，武帝太子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "800ca2d9a4083c58ee7a120d5ca76854f7365bc3f03f25cf118a86bdef45a482"}

{"id": "p_5437976e2cfb0141", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 1, "text": "，爲五官中郎將、副丞相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "b5c276d29edfe39a4c454e63169c2db29c0102b30a8e4b6cebeac9b7b4345f16"}

{"id": "p_9819ce6186353dff", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 2, "text": "太祖崩，嗣位爲丞相、魏王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "41dfa35bfd2c3daef21dbe64f21bc5992899d51a33ba2f386e9fcaf8dc48dc96"}

{"id": "p_be63e4f35917a94e", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 3, "text": "元年二月壬戌，以大中大夫賈詡爲太尉，御史大夫華歆爲相國，大理王朗爲御史大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "5fc2868205556febcdcdbd9a7b83f885a6dd60bf706202f7bac0d76cf907c047"}

{"id": "p_213d9f1cc04dbde5", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 4, "text": "置散騎常侍、侍郎各四人，其宦人爲官者不得過諸署令；爲金策著令，藏之石室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "f630e44bf9569c561b4e929e2f7c5dbcc686e099a3ac0f0c5e8223f4268c5b90"}

{"id": "p_ed4b240c5ac0db9c", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 5, "text": "初，漢，黃龍見譙，光祿大夫橋玄問太史令單颺：「此何祥也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "f6dbbef246ad0c94b64d25259c4614a31ec85e49f52566ca06defa10362a2eb2"}

{"id": "p_e8b6238071142e43", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」颺曰：「其國後當有王者興，不及五十年，亦當復見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "7ec11aacc925098a4c15180c89de1b1299e0f330bb3380c1dcef4dbf08146df5"}

{"id": "p_ac67b8248fb347c6", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 7, "text": "三月，黃龍見譙，登聞之曰：「單颺之言，其驗茲乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "ea9e2596fba0aa2a7a1500c1236bd51b7cb67e961e85a63b8626d89a84a1109a"}

{"id": "p_060848305d481c1f", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 8, "text": "己卯，以前將軍夏侯惇爲大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "4c1c80a272b91c0441746d3b37984f6501c7f17e924b1f9a87aa5cd8b2f86962"}

{"id": "p_971b59c46f8f5d71", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 9, "text": "濊貃、扶餘單于、焉耆、于闐王皆各遣使奉獻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "476f62bec1642da0b598c5cc6ffb4198db462b618bc2ce93b54a6fb8cb83c049"}

{"id": "p_0aa7bbb1161a1aec", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 10, "text": "夏四月丁巳，饒安縣言白雉見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "55c2532cd6ad53d56e733a2a7d70a6ed4d7e7c8a4ab3816820e873ef38a47abf"}

{"id": "p_3ebd419634c7d88f", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 11, "text": "五月戊寅，天子命王追尊皇祖太尉曰太王，夫人丁氏曰太王后，封王子叡爲武德侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "9db2e0a150c44778df3138a56d7a314275e834046e3163c8ff3abbc4e9c3cb56"}

{"id": "p_9068d35158627052", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 12, "text": "是月，馮翊山賊鄭甘、王照率衆降，皆封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "832102884c760b7e9b81c43d7091ccaabc52a4c7ad428f4f0f80c31a7d0683cf"}

{"id": "p_644ecb5f0fda18a1", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 13, "text": "酒泉黃華、張掖張進等各執太守以叛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "f40a738cb32e3ab34b1e2b5f25827de411955d7f0a54daa9e69b31d6578683db"}

{"id": "p_1a4711429419a9e6", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 14, "text": "金城太守蘇則討進，斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "917adaefb9fbf5260d05ac7ba410492f4cf01c726a2a5a6c24a2fec62f26f9e6"}

{"id": "p_bc4823bd679e3022", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 15, "text": "六月辛亥，治兵于東郊，庚午，遂南征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "c69ff1572f542cc58f9fcd314d8c1786c11a9ad1c0654a1c140c3da017ad3fb8"}

{"id": "p_22d9f56aa49a4d88", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 16, "text": "秋七月庚辰，令曰：「軒轅有明臺之議，放勛有衢室之問，皆所以廣詢于下也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "10a810d867e9fbaa74b42148011396c02398c02723249698922e3633753bef9a"}

{"id": "p_095808a555182883", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 17, "text": "百官有司，其務以職盡規諫，將率陳軍法，朝士明制度，牧守申政事，縉紳考六藝，吾將兼覽焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "20e840228570103595a1eff54c20e2f2f44eb1c068a4411ed2c02b4870d5ca99"}

{"id": "p_e153afa8a2c3c7fc", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 18, "text": "武都氐王楊僕率種人內附，居漢陽郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "8b9c1f2500ad13b73d4cc046e1e32e5737dc25dbe27a5692651cf2740dbde239"}

{"id": "p_a8f73e1e90867bce", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 19, "text": "甲午，軍次于譙，大饗六軍及譙父老百姓于邑東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "9ae3a0b275992a3800f1782da5909974d2465170153105935b9c6873964c7a50"}

{"id": "p_166fe7da86af220c", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 20, "text": "冬十一月癸卯，令曰：「諸將征伐，士卒死亡者或未收斂，吾甚哀之；其告郡國給槥櫝殯斂，送致其家，官爲設祭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "6d9c1d590efc37995e30a0f969e42acb0d15b128c34749055b8f3887059e6261"}

{"id": "p_0b3ec75d77fe6b5e", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 21, "text": "漢帝以衆望在魏，乃召羣公卿士，告祠高廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "bda3be9d726e71e9e6278946ccae685f9463770cfa85a78e359ede0db94d1d40"}

{"id": "p_925115458c08df90", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 22, "text": "使兼御史大夫張音持節奉璽綬禪位，冊曰：「咨爾魏王：昔者帝堯禪位于虞舜，舜亦以命禹，天命不于常，惟歸有德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "ab0b8fcf85de53512a3d09ddb08bbdffd2f928c19038586eb169b08ef13ad7e2"}

{"id": "p_8ad894dc9003bd7f", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 23, "text": "漢道陵遲，世失其序，降及朕躬，大亂茲昏，羣兇肆逆，宇內顛覆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "603e7b13f805f886bcfb70474dda8e3140c0af8eeffedc1907e87ba8a0411b5e"}

{"id": "p_49543512c246166d", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 24, "text": "賴武王神武，拯茲難于四方，惟清區夏，以保綏我宗廟，豈予一人獲乂，俾九服實受其賜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "76ccca562613a369ef31eb488876cc84e1122f09317184806fbe1f0b027fff35"}

{"id": "p_f90caeaf233f236f", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 25, "text": "今王欽承前緒，光于乃德，恢文武之大業，昭爾考之弘烈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "f27337e6a516e09f446267a523aec5a30f4ab710f0c11a11dbd6b20c1caba799"}

{"id": "p_05a4c87ff26b8a28", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 26, "text": "皇靈降瑞，人神告徵，誕惟亮采，師錫朕命，僉曰爾度克恊于虞舜，用率我唐典，敬遜爾位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "551344c6b330307e983ca1fb46cafbc4a5792af37a7f1b8a8d6079259270fc1d"}

{"id": "p_cfafe65d616c05d4", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 27, "text": "天之歷數在爾躬，允執其中，天祿永終；君其祗順大禮，饗茲萬國，以肅承天命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "03edc19182537c5888da8a2c5c1dc9027089e5347719c12804b703a9b26f811d"}

{"id": "p_54bd287178c4ee74", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 28, "text": "庚午，王升壇即阼，百官陪位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "bdfc23796b07ae03487bfbb7cc88d7c0e0aeb455e85e0fc820152607822c5fb4"}

{"id": "p_af98e66a37353839", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 29, "text": "事訖，降壇，視燎成禮而反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "3ea24a43384453303eaff4ff223a78363533bb085faafd0b7aceb561cdc45e56"}

{"id": "p_8e8c87348a2fc589", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 30, "text": "十一月癸酉，以河內之山陽邑萬戶奉漢帝爲山陽公，行漢正朔，以天子之禮郊祭，上書不稱臣，京都有事于太廟，致胙；封公之四子爲列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "bffa24a9f1ce941f7489894f9522483ed6924b23fc2f66ed83a696c863b48af5"}

{"id": "p_e305df365f133311", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 31, "text": "追尊皇祖太王曰太皇帝，考武王曰武皇帝，尊王太后曰皇太后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "89b6f7a1e7e5eda394fe5ca36fd1be71eebf16a6385de2c301574e2379cc3273"}

{"id": "p_e0000ab60e4caf32", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 32, "text": "賜男子爵人一級，爲父後及孝悌力田人二級。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "a514365f6f21025b599570df83e6ec1607fd03a544fbb6b10aa44fe37eb18af9"}

{"id": "p_4ac5f9d1f64e4b6c", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 33, "text": "以漢諸侯王爲崇德侯，列侯爲關中侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "0fa16d31586923aa56eadb8eebc51060b36b5af065805dc0082201278bc363b9"}

{"id": "p_515285df49f3ff96", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 34, "text": "以潁陰之繁陽亭爲繁昌縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "831889d58b8c399415c8213bebab22573f45b7ad11368799e7de3d66e87997f3"}

{"id": "p_ab775433b37fa8dd", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 35, "text": "改相國爲司徒，御史大夫爲司空，奉常爲太常，郎中令爲光祿勳，大理爲廷尉，大農爲大司農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "0d62d4de16759ab6c68115d7da297a278130759ea2660ebc3a9184dc5a69919e"}

{"id": "p_02c7580ebf703360", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 36, "text": "更授匈奴南單于呼廚泉魏璽綬，賜青蓋車、乘輿、寶劔、玉玦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "34faf1ffcf66d96731cd8626d69cf96b9ac33ecf312ad3e2c55f109f50127591"}

{"id": "p_0f39ad910c865a47", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 37, "text": "十二月，初營洛陽宮，戊午幸洛陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "01483642f49b6f9a8cef13729d57184612731d83ad45108af0e25e7442e4fd50"}

{"id": "p_5bc16f93c470c163", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 38, "text": "是歲，長水校尉戴陵諫不宜數行弋獵，帝大怒；陵減死罪一等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "36b9c3db99915eb04ff3cd55a45ce6ae83a5099ebdee38f4bd2c129e6c42b622"}

{"id": "p_ce65d279306c3132", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 39, "text": "二年春正月，郊祀天地、明堂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "c24fd885e4d2821223f828dece6bf3955f9f462c0cd37563b6d1f36b3ce314b4"}

{"id": "p_652516bb6efaf7ff", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 40, "text": "甲戌，校獵至原陵，遣使者以太牢祠漢世祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "1c980256e2a840e22f17d9738459d506d2537caff84b72776bb10e5fa449e728"}

{"id": "p_90dc0bade5a23acc", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 41, "text": "初令郡國口滿十萬者，歲察孝廉一人；其有秀異，無拘戶口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "f9f12724ee90036975db7ca41e2ecb707135d33281d5198aa03ee55225d78f36"}

{"id": "p_a6a11d7036b1cda7", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 42, "text": "辛巳，分三公戶邑，封子弟各一人爲列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "d7d3da95b57b18b18e7093bb5fd4dc107745074d4a9ed2a57ae3436149fa0329"}

{"id": "p_b6d9d0ad91dbf099", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 43, "text": "壬午，復潁川郡一年田租。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "e43ccfc163f063da01c85c029d7a28d6cd38e966be957c38e47304f7c63b2e74"}

{"id": "p_59cd668d4d0d7c5f", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 44, "text": "以魏郡東部爲陽平郡，西部爲廣平郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "00ce3e0a89b3a7a58a877c4fe5a9902e58b39f7310e7611d83fa1406396ec08e"}

{"id": "p_283f74e98f96bc6b", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 45, "text": "詔曰：「昔仲尼資大聖之才，懷帝王之器，當衰周之末，無受命之運，在魯、衞之朝，教化乎洙、泗之上，悽悽焉，遑遑焉，欲屈己以存道，貶身以救世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "dbfa61fc65db119691927a5af35269fde025aea61b694a4d82bc11f0990e3a07"}

{"id": "p_7a1b8a709d847c46", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 46, "text": "于時王公終莫能用之，乃退考五代之禮，脩素王之事，因魯史而制春秋，就太師而正雅頌，俾千載之後，莫不宗其文以述作，仰其聖以成謀，咨！", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "1c22f1cb3513a1720eb69fa2b4ef173dc421414e54d8da702c06d35f093ded90"}

{"id": "p_d439bc990b7ab5d6", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 47, "text": "可謂命世之大聖，億載之師表者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "798a3fa1251c82b140cc89bb201bcd1a8ae9ec8c8eafe5ecb5a3dbb27e0c3d53"}

{"id": "p_6dcabc6c16f25786", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 48, "text": "遭天下大亂，百祀墮壞，舊居之廟，毀而不脩，襃成之後，絕而莫繼，闕里不聞講頌之聲，四時不覩蒸甞之位，斯豈所謂崇禮報功，盛德百世必祀者哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "765adb067ab3ece690374d6ff5c21ffddead0dc2bedc0cb518a4375d3a10c684"}

{"id": "p_dc854fdcbf6d4cfa", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 49, "text": "其以議郎孔羨爲宗聖侯，邑百戶，奉孔子祀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "7975a089d02341398dabc889088d3d39cdeca45f182b0c23bbd18843f8f62952"}

{"id": "p_ce4a594b4408b7b1", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」令魯郡脩起舊廟，置百戶吏卒以守衞之，又於其外廣爲室屋以居學者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "0b9ab777e4078911f1d839743115b65c11ad6ab7593cb6b73f1f180223cfaf76"}

{"id": "p_baa4a9bfc255264c", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 51, "text": "三月，加遼東太守公孫恭爲車騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "00f2a304fb6d48b0ea0e7423f9f028a775b1422deedb8b71a16d82e62e297607"}

{"id": "p_f2b6fca6ca07673d", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 52, "text": "夏四月，以車騎將軍曹仁爲大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "da87cebc5d9e8549129c5a522fdedf120a4775c44a5ca5615c7ec8b258041cfd"}

{"id": "p_338c4e7ec707f39c", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 53, "text": "五月，鄭甘復叛，遣曹仁討斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "505f2272f095d25c9bed664c753356df49f1b45cbf6286ba1246fb8648766e76"}

{"id": "p_632657888f103a10", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 54, "text": "六月庚子，初祀五嶽四瀆，咸秩羣祀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "7dd87fba76f8d5d1331f0a4014f84355421dd69ca28d332a424cfb9520fdfe7d"}

{"id": "p_f84a1193c88c850c", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 55, "text": "戊辰晦，日有食之，有司奏免太尉，詔曰：「災異之作，以譴元首，而歸過股肱，豈禹、湯罪己之義乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "b4fae15578a7f1cd93cf6e2fca64ce178143cc40f9a59d0a454fe339f8a83317"}

{"id": "p_d3af6cb8d2c43936", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 56, "text": "其令百官各虔厥職，後有天地之眚，勿復劾三公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "09bf6d572d864472fe8a27d1f7e34978dacad999b65a105be6ab4be1417843aa"}

{"id": "p_2d30d09cbd86a27c", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 57, "text": "秋八月，孫權遣使奉章，并遣于禁等還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "ced513ef36dc98bdb5849c968b7780e5b45ae2ee91bb8057c31deef720a8e2a0"}

{"id": "p_18ba3551cd4c8972", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 58, "text": "丁巳，使太常邢貞持節拜權爲大將軍，封吳王，加九錫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "368fa24cc5e5682f0994a23ad6971880a11eaab3196d77d63f9ac237849e6173"}

{"id": "p_d66ee3afd3df1d10", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 59, "text": "冬十月，授楊彪光祿大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "f6489bacf22dc889fd76a4ab4b2b5c5dc716e1c08c89dbeafc02d22006dfa2db"}

{"id": "p_d17305b1af92687a", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 60, "text": "己卯，以大將軍曹仁爲大司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "ffdf6ff2bfff029582846caa686b20db52b53f28cfc0339bcfb380fadef75aae"}

{"id": "p_38e90816be7ae263", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 61, "text": "三年春正月丙寅朔，日有蝕之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "ff32a5fdc2830fded61cfb1fd7ac44c58db6da86de1c89750361cbe2efeb2cf9"}

{"id": "p_1b74f2fc6d700d95", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 62, "text": "詔曰：「今之計考，古之貢士也；十室之邑，必有忠信，若限年然後取士，是呂尚、周晉不顯於前世也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "4d978b453ce020b9558a660bdb66b7345fbc116bcadac575b65ff6968e85153e"}

{"id": "p_a16f78bd7374e144", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 63, "text": "其令郡國所選，勿拘老幼；儒通經術，吏達文法，到皆試用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "c0c7ff26bcbd5436d650c93e4ef52680b6d1d7e6bbcd3ecc99d9fde56ff1d493"}

{"id": "p_5fc7f2fb3a4abaeb", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 64, "text": "二月，鄯善、龜茲、于闐王各遣使奉獻，詔曰：「西戎即叙，氐、羌來王，詩、書美之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "ec45f933fe4bee1783e0d494f1d2ab3cc2cbd449a937087d5edfbb02dbf3ac0e"}

{"id": "p_a8099322adcac38a", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 65, "text": "頃者西域外夷並款塞內附，其遣使者撫勞之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "0d7ea7b3b0f90db79d07838c1afeeaeb3c1974d3c43b954f380a1ddb8cb7c909"}

{"id": "p_3f3d5c773bd13319", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 66, "text": "」是後西域遂通，置戊己校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "6bc3195cc0e9fc96d00f8584bf4dbb3415493666c0bbdddbbfa398a59fc36c44"}

{"id": "p_a3d9bebf2f63dfeb", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 67, "text": "三月乙丑，立齊公叡爲平原王，帝弟鄢陵公彰等十一人皆爲王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "550cbeac64b35ecd51a03315bdd7311f98cabe7ecd840593c8cd0399db5a5d98"}

{"id": "p_9db50aca500966af", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 68, "text": "初制封王之庶子爲鄉公，嗣王之庶子爲亭侯，公之庶子爲亭伯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "f8ca5d5f40376eded776489a049b71f39eb84582d07fbfea3cf74d964a850a95"}

{"id": "p_7ac7cb1e4740801b", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 69, "text": "甲戌，立皇子霖爲河東王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "2776d1ed15c5dfc6a48fb3a13ef7ed5af797020c11f8cee10af89884214b8dba"}

{"id": "p_bc87e7ae64bcf979", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 70, "text": "夏四月戊申，立鄄城侯植爲鄄城王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "c788eb98a0afd728040d197a08619181a8393af217c35a447f12c699a044edfc"}

{"id": "p_e71e2a1676af1f87", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 71, "text": "五月，以荊、揚、江表八郡爲荊州，孫權領牧故也；荊州江北諸郡爲郢州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "94b1c07242b859e16b802226be3ff6496120395a74df80e2b2f27230e2687daf"}

{"id": "p_9e8f7671c4ac86df", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 72, "text": "閏月，孫權破劉備於夷陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "efa993d102b3c519f5ca15abf28e99d016fe30eada7337934bb038a9db212b1e"}

{"id": "p_1a23f83454fe0c09", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 73, "text": "初，帝聞備兵東下，與權交戰，樹柵連營七百餘里，謂羣臣曰：「備不曉兵，豈有七百里營可以拒敵者乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "8d6c09304d5a42667494e12dfbcb5a9d42d2fa51ad16ba4f58cffb0b18839504"}

{"id": "p_42fc62ce446603fc", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 74, "text": "『苞原隰險阻而爲軍者，爲敵所禽』，此兵忌也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "58b6dc841db37aa5b38f50c337d76b8ac4e8ce5041077b9b3f61587a2989db56"}

{"id": "p_39c31579075d3cf7", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 75, "text": "秋七月，冀州大蝗，民饑，使尚書杜畿持節開倉廩以振之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "985cc7dc83956c27df01a431dd8496a7858408b3b403d5ef8e86604a681d1319"}

{"id": "p_7de0be104c66f511", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 76, "text": "八月，蜀大將黃權率衆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "48fe08f3f086bd0b1bbd738ad666207eaa580cb30ab5534bc168d4465e0a1d67"}

{"id": "p_70c9a0fa568a2bef", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 77, "text": "九月甲午，詔曰：「夫婦人與政，亂之本也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "b3a9096e2111ee0d69800ab535f7f46be819a9356d4041b564b423eabe939337"}

{"id": "p_921f3b44b755fbfd", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 78, "text": "自今以後，羣臣不得奏事太后，后族之家不得當輔政之任，又不得橫受茅土之爵；以此詔傳後世，若有背違，天下共誅之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "b3a3b32d084238d0d1b11d3a32cbf2b12f11bc1063e787f785bef0ed4a173430"}

{"id": "p_ed172416cc853ae0", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 79, "text": "賜天下男子爵人二級；鰥寡篤癃及貧不能自存者賜穀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "d88c0098a419f0ce9f1b8779be9020e9d0565bcf5863a5fdc08b3b4545838c00"}

{"id": "p_946f1e41ba3be7b6", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 80, "text": "冬十月甲子，表首陽山東爲壽陵，作終制曰：「禮，國君即位爲椑，存不忘亡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "328eeabe596305ff570ceac45ff6630ba92b7b07ad0068f1650b86bf8793bc53"}

{"id": "p_6f7af12df051766a", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 81, "text": "昔堯葬穀林，通樹之，禹葬會稽，農不易畝，故葬於山林，則合乎山林。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "1a1abd28e929e5b36d16f86846e1ddc6fbcf8cd2866af0671b38833ca9baabbd"}

{"id": "p_5f895376fcb3e4a7", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 82, "text": "封樹之制，非上古也，吾無取焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "75ff63f03a1082a10fed180b38a370cc0b5518e346825792fdfdec61d48b4f0b"}

{"id": "p_0097e4822d46f27a", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 83, "text": "壽陵因山爲體，無爲封樹，無立寑殿，造園邑，通神道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "acdd371cfa03175c6d006027eb37eb77f1bf2566267b9a2f4bfb759dc3d9526a"}

{"id": "p_be6407f1c2722259", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 84, "text": "夫葬也者，藏也，欲人之不得見也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "b3a6a44c328aa7af1c6f0b05367fa5969343ad85d37eecc65d5b7e0f0a4d8125"}

{"id": "p_5c4102881f820d8f", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 85, "text": "骨無痛痒之知，冢非棲神之宅，禮不墓祭，欲存亡之不黷也，爲棺槨足以朽骨，衣衾足以朽肉而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "e36b3419e30d9d13ca3823ffedda87261c2d405fdd9c230434680179a20e2169"}

{"id": "p_d71c94bf7ebe58f7", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 86, "text": "故吾營此丘墟不食之地，欲使易代之後不知其處。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "4ecf989b3d8e8ee3e9a95fde2e51db302c0e2b3fcb25d0a740989eac21cf42bd"}

{"id": "p_eeab04eddb6c6fb7", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 87, "text": "無施葦炭，無藏金銀銅鐵，一以瓦器，合古塗車、芻靈之義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "a1f270bd91455581f690c1dcd9c378fec7da25e3b56c1b1de4c381601bcedbf1"}

{"id": "p_98e6536798c0b107", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 88, "text": "棺但漆際會三過，飯含無以珠玉，無施珠襦玉匣，諸愚俗所爲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "76cc7c2834888b3d03e9df2dcb9f79d4587451c8c11a90c91f3d3039c13a2cfc"}

{"id": "p_177ec76d223364fb", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 89, "text": "季孫以璵璠斂，孔子歷級而救之，譬之暴骸中原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "61087350ed480c298f55fcc0b0258240abaf0c0eca54458cf54c7f0201460a04"}

{"id": "p_c50e69480623865a", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 90, "text": "宋公厚葬，君子謂華元、樂莒不臣，以爲棄君於惡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "79827313d6e4cd17cd1163901b9d3a6ba07059324d082e0b5dd890c6196df4ec"}

{"id": "p_8d02c4e740243f13", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 91, "text": "漢文帝之不發，霸陵無求也；光武之掘，原陵封樹也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "5877b9874e9b5fb2cff07233d6f70531ba3a71a3e3ae6cb94c6e63ca2ca9157e"}

{"id": "p_e3166333a91ddd84", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 92, "text": "霸陵之完，功在釋之；原陵之掘，罪在明帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "699d2dc13de348425507691d742ff35a18d3173ad298312bd9bd10ba5bb89897"}

{"id": "p_2b717c19a39505f3", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 93, "text": "是釋之忠以利君，明帝愛以害親也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "78d6ed30d1297e8e1d052bd9e3093823282060d87ce3df6ab9fb013f7929979e"}

{"id": "p_4fd2f727e22824c1", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 94, "text": "忠臣孝子，宜思仲尼、丘明、釋之之言，鑒華元、樂莒、明帝之戒，存於所以安君定親，使魂靈萬載無危，斯則賢聖之忠孝矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "4ebb7f6e8efe47c1ab1b083e9e6fd37715dee02b710136c9bbefe2108216f4f8"}

{"id": "p_978e16c8099fdc12", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 95, "text": "自古及今，未有不亡之國，亦無不掘之墓也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "22ec131f3d0e0823280b0b27708ba38a7b12892437d01e9f32355a3e92ed84be"}

{"id": "p_2c3fc8e8b4d2d5c9", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 96, "text": "喪亂以來，漢氏諸陵無不發掘，至乃燒取玉匣金縷，骸骨并盡，是焚如之刑也，豈不重痛哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "92d9dd77f0949cda2cb97f835c564341d0ae746a54fb51d9b057f9b58cdb5e99"}

{"id": "p_466472b62cc20b38", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 97, "text": "『桑、霍爲我戒』，不亦明乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "52139e31210abadad90bf2bea12254001d109e5b13e504a76156428447a5b095"}

{"id": "p_2631a6bc9f53469e", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 98, "text": "其皇后及貴人以下，不隨王之國者，有終沒皆葬澗西，前又以表其處矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "c9c9e01909c8e25aa9ffde607fc1803f355f3e6d8e56e496c8408ca742def1ab"}

{"id": "p_21e692d2f89990e2", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 99, "text": "蓋舜葬蒼梧，二妃不從，延陵葬子，遠在嬴、博，魂而有靈，無不之也，一澗之閒，不足爲遠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "8ff82ce07a6c3915404267b9e9c544050d7bbcce4553cbc16273ae7618e4d751"}

{"id": "p_b33becb375cc00c8", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 100, "text": "若違今詔，妄有所變改造施，吾爲戮尸地下，戮而重戮，死而重死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "387d4e7283474dba5f18abd8508ae9bc71d2df3821c62d2aa596600293b46683"}

{"id": "p_aacc54d7f58127ff", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 101, "text": "臣子爲蔑死君父，不忠不孝，使死者有知，將不福汝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "4a04297222d750d10c1496e1ae1a3d43de586f201c08125241c6c186358723db"}

{"id": "p_d3580c72e07ba35a", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 102, "text": "其以此詔藏之宗廟，副在尚書、祕書、三府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "ff7d07fe48ca2c6c99541113253c3cd4d4618e01d2f27b06cd4b4d9e992c337e"}

{"id": "p_309ed6b29159c0bc", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 103, "text": "帝自許昌南征，諸軍兵並進，權臨江拒守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "ca675677ac8bc8be77e0d1ebea551c3eb95951744a465b72592f055b3424f28c"}

{"id": "p_80fc55f52a9ff293", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 104, "text": "四年春正月，詔曰：「喪亂以來，兵革未戢，天下之人，互相殘殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "c1f5adf9e907f92172b80d119630291a4ea2091169399df542bc874b3f12cdaf"}

{"id": "p_3fe2a2f0bbd3b298", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 105, "text": "今海內初定，敢有私復讎者皆族之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "36b31a7dee14f5dbbca2aac56cf24b159f2194f6c62658f40a7199b99d86cc9d"}

{"id": "p_c27f65fd7cc17188", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 106, "text": "三月丙申，行自宛還洛陽宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "ff20a25a41f1e3840a2c5de35f79430b25bddbd6827177b10dda6330849adb8d"}

{"id": "p_e53ce3e055b9648e", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 107, "text": "夏五月，有鵜鶘鳥集靈芝池，詔曰：「此詩人所謂污澤也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "4cd7c5b83b2be713222a19f1e980e550c6fd1b1cd45f501cf1c7a927f38f38fd"}

{"id": "p_1f584e0c48f8eaf1", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 108, "text": "曹詩『刺恭公遠君子而近小人』，今豈有賢智之士處于下位乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "acfd918f28981058dd5f9f873776f00bf02aef0ecda7ea5956076a6fbeebcbf6"}

{"id": "p_377ce4ca2a3decaf", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 109, "text": "其博舉天下儁德茂才、獨行君子，以荅曹人之刺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "35f7934597d913e99ae357b4b8e5e009dbb63c419c995a1df3e0a909d35dff0d"}

{"id": "p_13bb946a30f564c0", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 110, "text": "六月甲戌，任城王彰薨于京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "d18a71423bb7a2bb91a4680ddc904d43175698972a9a484b8bf8522478d8c222"}

{"id": "p_a4ae23615626d947", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 111, "text": "是月大雨，伊、洛溢流，殺人民，壞廬宅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "f7791eca36e7b3a1013984a26db64a44180abc0e46837ccc8ac2838a157602ce"}

{"id": "p_b16a1c3690651cc4", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 112, "text": "秋八月丁卯，以廷尉鍾繇爲太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "6c71dd75396867af725450ce0f1b1174d1dde665a10fe6321f4bf87d663a36ac"}

{"id": "p_a1d6ebb49459ae03", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 113, "text": "辛未，校獵于熒陽，遂東巡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "cb55a8697977110ec27878f3439e705875f55b825d12519b26246345a3d58d4d"}

{"id": "p_e447ab3efa3458fd", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 114, "text": "論征孫權功，諸將已下進爵增戶各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "96634ec84260d312a70721817aa6f07a0b18c41759ff5f911b2d971739ae599a"}

{"id": "p_9607f87095d4fcbb", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 115, "text": "五年春正月，初令謀反大逆乃得相告，其餘皆勿聽治；敢妄相告，以其罪罪之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "7a2e31a9c2b4a5d51961442a3fbe1a3becdff8959ed66863493c9ba50de425af"}

{"id": "p_59279c450d9342b9", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 116, "text": "三月，行自許昌還洛陽宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "412c375b5698222d65aed4af3de9038e00bcbfed608472c7db177084da15efb3"}

{"id": "p_8fed348b06cf0bba", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 117, "text": "夏四月，立太學，制五經課試之法，置春秋穀梁博士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "0ca1d4aae1951d2178f4f79f3efffb96c99b604ffa1902eb761db6c22402bcce"}

{"id": "p_413391dc0d593317", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 118, "text": "五月，有司以公卿朝朔望日，因奏疑事，聽斷大政，論辨得失。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "8fd0bb6bd31a757debd6a1d019669463bd2112bb861d4cb32f62f614f223aeb6"}

{"id": "p_224ad72b01c803c6", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 119, "text": "秋七月，行東巡，幸許昌宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "924f64c3dff61139c7b27b625310601ce48d94590fa7e5a74f552b8e0b8cc4a7"}

{"id": "p_500a484a49ccfd88", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 120, "text": "八月，爲水軍，親御龍舟，循蔡、頴，浮淮，幸壽春。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "e20abf4ecc5e42b02e40905bc61c47a0deaec0fb1108059c35b7eb426a332d80"}

{"id": "p_0f0144d961cc038f", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 121, "text": "揚州界將吏士民，犯五歲刑已下，皆原除之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "2e06c74a3a6a92bd33b76fc5fdc5ae0852ad306e2475665b8c998474d72a1f16"}

{"id": "p_250e3783aa572345", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 122, "text": "九月，遂至廣陵，赦青、徐二州，改易諸將守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "86a0dffea07be2939991f55a035788df9c081711797ebf5f1887b8924f1cbf96"}

{"id": "p_86d920b2b1520f64", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 123, "text": "十一月庚寅，以冀州饑，遣使者開倉廩振之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "fe8f1edba767d848332cb53ea34ae2de93cea387a4a5e42e787027ea5735b794"}

{"id": "p_f37d748abe1f5788", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 124, "text": "十二月，詔曰：「先王制禮，所以昭孝事祖，大則郊社，其次宗廟，三辰五行，名山大川，非此族也，不在祀典。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "442fec68f627d17be67cadb44554969646920744962807548537c5a5561e4982"}

{"id": "p_419d5513fa164844", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 125, "text": "叔世衰亂，崇信巫史，至乃宮殿之內，戶牖之間，無不沃酹，甚矣其惑也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "c8d5290dff526c80fc34462ce013dde94ee17e01f5a944215a0254241ef33760"}

{"id": "p_246f19c9013bdf9d", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 126, "text": "自今，其敢設非祀之祭，巫祝之言，皆以執左道論，著于令典。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "0d67dcda5b87556565330d4bf2073de2be1778b08f7ee232dee436f9a27db853"}

{"id": "p_8733fba02d69bc9a", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 127, "text": "六年春二月，遣使者循行許昌以東盡沛郡，問民所疾苦，貧者振貸之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "97581ce520a9c62b8dbc52e980a7263bfbd0526ada063868a53823594bf4b29b"}

{"id": "p_5119a9508ccc06d9", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 128, "text": "三月，行幸召陵，通討虜渠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "a3d7a9e5d38391f1833a689784bf6a05127e7245eda3b0b76d6aad4e5d592591"}

{"id": "p_a2b4aaedad564ae6", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 129, "text": "并州刺史梁習討鮮卑軻比能，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "f37e73cab026f937f15dde7a509b9fe6fd3c8382c57b143a40f56bf5ce2bb3cd"}

{"id": "p_c5b1ca9a55e1bfd7", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 130, "text": "六月，利成郡兵蔡方等以郡反，殺太守徐質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "74342c67a846a093ad72263beba6ea678da3b0908bce715064b4b25a314a86c5"}

{"id": "p_6149b44ed873b709", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 131, "text": "遣屯騎校尉任福、步兵校尉段昭與青州刺史討平之；其見脅略及亡命者，皆赦其罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "736710a590c52bba811b20e587dccbb57a0d22a45e473779cd408d81202285b9"}

{"id": "p_1e3710fc9e942abb", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 132, "text": "秋七月，立皇子鑒爲東武陽王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "9fe53c72623df04cdfa08cfeae6e610b0db384ddb591bc3f843d19fb3de80813"}

{"id": "p_e642d59800878b81", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 133, "text": "八月，帝遂以舟師自譙循渦入淮，從陸道幸徐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "0f4657da900ff662acd1700547419c2fdc89e98f4ef61f2d2363410b571088a9"}

{"id": "p_b410adff75fa893f", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 134, "text": "冬十月，行幸廣陵故城，臨江觀兵，戎卒十餘萬，旌旗數百里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "3e94a072c20f6a159bbf063ea931a37b629e7bfea1bde21132b24f1b2a7f3497"}

{"id": "p_f7204450a0aea818", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 135, "text": "是歲大寒，水道冰，舟不得入江，乃引還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "e90cd66e357d4bbc8153a0aec60b8869e11c42bff58abf2f2a573707a8192714"}

{"id": "p_865cb671c0af50c9", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 136, "text": "十二月，行自譙過梁，遣使以太牢祀故漢太尉橋玄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "ce6d5a3aab704fc1dd6e0d45d5856537073af51afa8beb5499dc82d350950d9f"}

{"id": "p_e4ac76e2e68e9c3e", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 137, "text": "七年春正月，將幸許昌，許昌城南門無故自崩，帝心惡之，遂不入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "b1106a24b14ede2a22d7e2ac3b0c5b197f10129c84349b1ca4a7ac0be2f34acf"}

{"id": "p_a53523f332ba29ca", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 138, "text": "夏五月丙辰，帝疾篤，召中軍大將軍曹真、鎮軍大將軍陳羣、征東大將軍曹休、撫軍大將軍司馬宣王，並受遺詔輔嗣主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "91546707e84f41b5fc69fff9cf1be42f60bad0d46cc26f38369b6bf342331efd"}

{"id": "p_8855d80745a2b178", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 139, "text": "遣後宮淑媛、昭儀已下歸其家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "f55a12092e467f441683efe03d38836f8faf83ed7b78d8006a0bba4ff0678676"}

{"id": "p_fbde15b4e1d02c25", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 140, "text": "丁巳，帝崩于嘉福殿，時年四十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "c7c71702ebad71529be68bd87de6dcfb9d19658a671be8dfaf825fd3ebdc78ce"}

{"id": "p_a6f07a511e24d71b", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 141, "text": "自殯及葬，皆以終制從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "5cc0fed0e9cb320b0dc9d814bb1808e7bf55df600838b804716cd4fff409b13f"}

{"id": "p_cb469ad8d247d536", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 142, "text": "初，帝好文學，以著述爲務，自所勒成垂百篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "86498c28b46b57d7d355c41f61bdd7799300539b95d1540cedb5eae01de853b4"}

{"id": "p_d72c3ade983a9c89", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 143, "text": "又使諸儒撰集經傳，隨類相從，凡千餘篇，號曰《皇覽》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "13718cf23fc920d90542369400486f7ddbf76a0f306d9701f6143e2f4ef49a2b"}

{"id": "p_aa7dddf6bdfa8d31", "source_id": "src_a6a479cca39999a8", "ordinal": 144, "text": ":評曰：文帝天資文藻，下筆成章，博聞彊識，才藝兼該；若加之曠大之度，勵以公平之誠，邁志存道，克廣德心，則古之賢主，何遠之有哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "1cf25615d5ccecd042e6f82903fba0d68be1c20ddc379cef4c24fd2bd9c0fd46"}

{"id": "p_ca9e3c943bfc48cd", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 0, "text": "明皇帝諱叡，字元仲，文帝太子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "a9d8dceef53a051ec6837ba5bb875c2083285a425c3ed3734a573f31c61fc83b"}

{"id": "p_2d044dd6a65a30e7", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 1, "text": "生而太祖愛之，常令在左右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "4b1f2d5c8f0875ee2d8e3f333f4827ca17d61a58ab8b8ec41c3cb6f9333e99f8"}

{"id": "p_1d9d5971dc05ef44", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 2, "text": "年十五，封武德侯，爲齊公，三年爲平原王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "508ebf21056e294b8eac530934983fe818cc222c50a4e926397a4dde948dd85d"}

{"id": "p_fed9762056ae3ffb", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 3, "text": "七年夏五月，帝病篤，乃立爲皇太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "00bf756708fdeab19c39604b0ecd68948d37ce8eac6b8af9afc475cad7853c40"}

{"id": "p_ba04f4753bada677", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 4, "text": "尊皇太后曰太皇太后，皇后曰皇太后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "c63817fd4902eb97c6a9dee6c7833505f390f290e6f9ba21ca109fa87fed80c2"}

{"id": "p_770ad95b3c9234d8", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 5, "text": "癸未，追謚母甄夫人曰文昭皇后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "1adf84abdaacd7858f670e5aec037f3b1a3c7b7856c3f807bb92de81ce7ce06b"}

{"id": "p_2d3fd2041f8545b9", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 6, "text": "壬辰，立皇弟蕤爲陽平王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "a2937bb7d07cdcfde87756f04437cba94fae44d5080aa2ca5221b011895c7db8"}

{"id": "p_887977ccd5ac4046", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 7, "text": "八月，孫權攻江夏郡，太守文聘堅守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "083d5991f4355832fb78a4f10a7efe4d42ede156ea0e66aa86f52669ba2731c5"}

{"id": "p_6948c55deb4444ff", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 8, "text": "朝議欲發兵救之，帝曰：「權習水戰，所以敢下船陸攻者，幾掩不備也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "8f33f8964e1d06686ddc22db0550d0540495bca1803330a325dbd4aa8d95750e"}

{"id": "p_6b60602a26326d6b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 9, "text": "今已與聘相持，夫攻守勢倍，終不敢久也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "1ab71a4ac725f62d6ec9698ac3973940f3ce4778007fe55905df6e15908a8910"}

{"id": "p_e70e823392082558", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」先時遣治書侍御史荀禹慰勞邊方，禹到，於江夏發所經縣兵及所從步騎千人乘山舉火，權退走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "c770942036c6987040d86102d93660343888844a1e486f985d903c081275203d"}

{"id": "p_6ea4152e8e1c81a2", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 11, "text": "辛巳，立皇子冏爲清河王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "079ed225a5e05dfd60889bc8ac4c134e8663b608493761102ded8cd9b04eb3b6"}

{"id": "p_89ee78a485c1b23f", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 12, "text": "吳將諸葛瑾、張霸等寇襄陽，撫軍大將軍司馬宣王討破之，斬霸，征東大將軍曹休又破其別將於尋陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "0642740929f24e3a6eb1519bc7e0598d952d75dd0ac7344c7965f2b5494ce7d5"}

{"id": "p_9d0ae40438cb2a3e", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 13, "text": "十二月，以太尉鍾繇爲太傅，征東大將軍曹休爲大司馬，中軍大將軍曹真爲大將軍，司徒華歆爲太尉，司空王朗爲司徒，鎮軍大將軍陳羣爲司空，撫軍大將軍司馬宣王爲驃騎大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "5761ba969db61a73e65f651929873d31cd5f5aa89ce1507e047a744e5584b50b"}

{"id": "p_8aade5cf1f3022d4", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 14, "text": "春正月，郊祀武皇帝以配天，宗祀文皇帝於明堂以配上帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "92032c08b6c4e6de50fe2466bf2d3ebf44deb43993581a796efe5e928fa6c2cc"}

{"id": "p_ba16dda659556887", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 15, "text": "分江夏南部，置江夏南部都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "e92aa90f7e5fd62a08c4cc8ba6ad10eb4810c64af33956db1ed97d143ea42ed2"}

{"id": "p_d6385aba6cd02644", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 16, "text": "西平麴英反，殺臨羌令、西都長，遣將軍郝昭、鹿磐討斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "598d826321d596eae309fa0e63126e0be16a45493f4397e0e7a147fffe650e8b"}

{"id": "p_30387379157fe133", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 17, "text": "辛巳，立文昭皇后寢廟於鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "e45ebaee026591553c04b3868ebaa98c424faac91556e3315e5deb9e37e4a219"}

{"id": "p_e6c784a3d9c9f5ac", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 18, "text": "冬十月丙寅，治兵于東郊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "8d365d11d58c5fe51a70656d2ef8e79b0d7b434b9567ff2ac5b8dd20dbfd4113"}

{"id": "p_2d3ec70bd5f8ec08", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 19, "text": "賜天下男子爵人二級，鰥寡孤獨不能自存者賜穀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "aab65558b36528ac5f45e9a5fb7560d813cea9817d22b7cca38c3404be350303"}

{"id": "p_794bd37a9b05ec3a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 20, "text": "十二月，封后父毛嘉爲列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "04d538a2a4e3468957e1a32aa0d717f4afe8aa8c3ab7a96f67647a390586d9dd"}

{"id": "p_648c1be73116ced5", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 21, "text": "新城太守孟達反，詔驃騎將軍司馬宣王討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "b459f40ae6e68fec8acde90ba2894d33de932d6198bd98e38250300f94957fe3"}

{"id": "p_1ad8479852c8faae", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 22, "text": "二年春正月，宣王攻破新城，斬達，傳其首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "a4ff31ddd32bc6078f525f62db8ee7d1a090ad93dcab3418e505546c34b3806e"}

{"id": "p_893a381c83f82adc", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 23, "text": "分新城之上庸、武陵、巫縣爲上庸郡，錫縣爲錫郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "ab1e445dc2e5f44a291dd06dc0efc589cb9fda08478e04f63fa76a4d92e7fa78"}

{"id": "p_66504e493fc0bd76", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 24, "text": "蜀大將諸葛亮寇邊，天水、南安、安定三郡吏民叛應亮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "98af53dc008a90f2583555dd0f590d772a8971f0ffed6e44a7ce2a82500339f8"}

{"id": "p_01881b619f09338e", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 25, "text": "遣大將軍曹真都督關右，並進兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "0ed428f42ad54b4315dd264b418534cc5b75ce9074dd9e810e96202baa6cb727"}

{"id": "p_87bc7c9c80f6852f", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 26, "text": "右將軍張郃擊亮於街亭，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "0b04f7ccd1f425ad98193b3760d49c2ee455b96c47f9a7dfe0b2f6a3c84616b9"}

{"id": "p_56b33b923a9d6e0b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 27, "text": "乙巳，論討亮功，封爵增邑各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "84fcad0ccb0d6cd7d8652738a1b83df9078802fa0df024d2fcde393c8fc8fef6"}

{"id": "p_f69540ec661fb005", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 28, "text": "六月，詔曰：「尊儒貴學，王教之本也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "5db6f42933d424865a79e289789b73f05e6e3a05061a5a23b9aa7673cc16b496"}

{"id": "p_643ecd6dee7ba1c1", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 29, "text": "自頃儒官或非其人，將何以宣明聖道？", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "23a3beb2179c5d777bae88241f50d500e64c6a1a1438764db6bd7e01c39e040a"}

{"id": "p_a1ddacfe5dfb43e3", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 30, "text": "其高選博士，才任侍中常侍者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "8a88bff348dd3ed8629c194575eccca67db58f76e8cc82eec99271c2f25f9b61"}

{"id": "p_fe4bbbcc6811297a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 31, "text": "申勑郡國，貢士以經學爲先。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "58403def9ab68389b25900990aafecb27b4ca4f2f4a8d29eca0a0d86b6694093"}

{"id": "p_0d856c27ba33f38a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」秋九月，曹休率諸軍至皖，與吳將陸議戰於石亭，敗績。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "b0622e534bc89062383f9470f85d69b73ca4fca7b80783669b685143a6907048"}

{"id": "p_8bb040c2565c75e4", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 33, "text": "乙酉，立皇子穆爲繁陽王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "4ed1d24249f816cde28a04293e423a4a3ff8367a9b6f7def47f1b05d3219ea9e"}

{"id": "p_b1056a923d6a9156", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 34, "text": "冬十月，詔公卿近臣舉良將各一人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "bf63f2896c7bb0dd215aaec64e75a26b5a0249d42c5366687f5924badd1e65a0"}

{"id": "p_856eb9fec508f296", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 35, "text": "十二月，諸葛亮圍陳倉，曹真遣將軍費曜等拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "ae46aec9ac8134b45074740335c4b301c42d3bd91be163050ba2cfa8655c1a09"}

{"id": "p_831d3925c36fa084", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 36, "text": "遼東太守公孫恭兄子淵劫奪恭位，遂以淵領遼東太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "1eb392df120632e3934014910baa74bd30365030edaa97db76e739b54e648a6b"}

{"id": "p_14cbeda6e3979ebb", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 37, "text": "三年夏四月，元城王禮薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "3928e8db924b0010bdc09981a477fe4bf6648c287fedba9c08e318e969ddac81"}

{"id": "p_c59847c53414350a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 38, "text": "戊申，追尊高祖大長秋曰高皇帝，夫人吳氏曰高皇后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "2934e5eae7fd344d31d19611d7138a37533bb3234cb6ad4dd80e96175f810670"}

{"id": "p_3ea9a4d6d7009324", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 39, "text": "秋七月，詔曰：「禮，王后無嗣，擇建支子以繼太宗，則當纂正統而奉公義，何得復顧私親哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "f5539c6ef0af6ff338a2a79caa923e1f0ba189442881f41754a8bdc8e03a0baf"}

{"id": "p_4329e76ce4809244", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 40, "text": "漢宣繼昭帝後，加悼考以皇號；哀帝以外藩援立，而董宏等稱引亡秦，或誤時朝，旣尊恭皇，立廟京都，又寵藩妾，使比長信，敘昭穆於前殿，並四位於東宮，僭差無度，人神弗祐，而非罪師丹忠正之諫，用致丁、傅焚如之禍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "fd04c4ddc4075d6a3139297f051797818bda74b24399e74dffe88f6dccc07cab"}

{"id": "p_743d11cc7617d432", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 41, "text": "昔魯文逆祀，罪由夏父；宋國非度，譏在華元。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "6e0d297190970aaeb8b32a03b92c7ab06f22ba0c8128012b93afaa830f182483"}

{"id": "p_8852f483de44bb7b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 42, "text": "其令公卿有司，深以前世行事爲戒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "9a95d1c4dac3411c6521a4271121ba31b52c5dd77e80d5fb3322ae4ece12a657"}

{"id": "p_6c6b4a45e994654e", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 43, "text": "後嗣萬一有由諸侯入奉大統，則當明爲人後之義；敢爲佞邪導諛時君，妄建非正之號以干正統，謂考爲皇，稱妣爲后，則股肱大臣，誅之無赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "cadb55f916a3eb85d89a2c8f9515756b8980171bd5b9c5fd654a9c3dad6cfd6a"}

{"id": "p_027d77a63ccaad9e", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 44, "text": "其書之金策，藏之宗廟，著于今典。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "be45351caba4b7900dc97063fce7ad0f8d0ce8dbb2fe8d9a4fe7a8ab9072874d"}

{"id": "p_16532b124c0f4a4d", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 45, "text": "冬十月，改平望觀曰聽訟觀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "c3089e00d73166efe6dc11ace7dabb0daae93e5e32757acc2819b704d62221c0"}

{"id": "p_ed7a2546f75e1636", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 46, "text": "帝常言「獄者，天下之性命也」，每斷大獄，常幸觀臨聽之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "56caca7827b7a4ea6395991e5a20918b3626d5436ced2a73ca6988a51401b9ce"}

{"id": "p_ab526f4d82c9b093", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 47, "text": "初，洛陽宗廟未成，神主在鄴廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "5be12302ba2552f76f8e415ea63f67888214dfb3fc7a9ff8c87cb2d8448d9c74"}

{"id": "p_1054cf8fb3a0b381", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 48, "text": "十一月，廟始成，使太常韓曁持節迎高皇帝、太皇帝、武帝、文帝神主于鄴，十二月己丑至，奉安神主于廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "0f0630df3196dcb08a5ae9200138ca6fe4f3a6ab804a4ae9bb55da7694e49e54"}

{"id": "p_8e38432cbba0ced8", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 49, "text": "癸卯，大月氏王波調遣使奉獻，以調爲親魏大月氏王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "0f31ff699c47a353aba8ceb39ccfd0fc504a3f5ad6ad43586b21bd08ecfbebe3"}

{"id": "p_4ecb5e80a4772c40", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 50, "text": "四年春二月壬午，詔曰：「世之質文，隨教而變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "c947025d364a4d235df725226b519fda935848dce949a9a5779167c37d02e10a"}

{"id": "p_6aa56a809f54075a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 51, "text": "兵亂以來，經學廢絕，後生進趣，不由典謨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "77de1a45762cb90a5d5a7ef8297263c4ba18e7f77987282a405422a08c529e4c"}
