{"id": "p_88b813e33fbafb94", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 52, "text": "豈訓導未洽，將進用者不以德顯乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "ba7e2c3278224c893608734e71ce87af3b87606a79969231861d420b6ddce15d"}

{"id": "p_e2215d7ed19937b9", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 53, "text": "其郎吏學通一經，才任牧民，博士課試，擢其高第者，亟用；其浮華不務道本者，皆罷退之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "d9dd2ade398a491eb7d32ab1e0df00abc44f4cd868d64db246b062052e0fc440"}

{"id": "p_4e623854bb2bc10b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 54, "text": "」戊子，詔太傅三公：以文帝《典論》刻石，立于廟門之外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "fa8c624675c342efdd127e8fab1f56132a215d6502c483a5aed6db61979bb0e6"}

{"id": "p_3e750ecb9a502e7c", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 55, "text": "癸巳，以大將軍曹真爲大司馬，驃騎將軍司馬宣王爲大將軍，遼東太守公孫淵爲車騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "6e95ddc24770ed49e13c68a3530017c6da24fbf0412bd9158ed0115f7b7af8be"}

{"id": "p_559adf6b0c2f9b60", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 56, "text": "秋七月，武宣卞后祔葬于高陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "b54a366e9018886b25293a681051da17f7e36d9944e6dcba1ed540f636df900f"}

{"id": "p_48aa092f285b07ee", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 57, "text": "詔大司馬曹真、大將軍司馬宣王伐蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "91ba7af3813656938ff72965ff2131ae8d6ad302353ebf7eeaf1194056f80a95"}

{"id": "p_fdcb20648e6c1869", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 58, "text": "八月辛巳，行東巡，遣使者以特牛祠中嶽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "841293eebb87fb7b5110071f9b04b4106bdeec9513e56d35ea8537b1dc401938"}

{"id": "p_cbdb9766db5b8de2", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 59, "text": "九月，大雨，伊、洛、河、漢水溢，詔真等班師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "bcfad7cdd1b2cf82e810af6627cd52555a9e3653d209bb057d188df8a586b195"}

{"id": "p_f0b82a8adc8024f6", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 60, "text": "冬十月乙卯，行還洛陽宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "e2835f87e4ff33209f2caae6b8e00b5b754276d034e0351f9c4b2508c9e9ae5c"}

{"id": "p_ae3aebf9e054e404", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 61, "text": "庚申，令：「罪非殊死聽贖各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "fc57060ac55fc8690cf164a4ab45dd7f872f47a80685c56d4b88617f7cf8088a"}

{"id": "p_59611dda7914337b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 62, "text": "十二月辛未，改葬文昭甄后于朝陽陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "93b74801a7d5c1b8fac39156c01b2b7ad80fefda9c6c19027abc0009456987c7"}

{"id": "p_25c87f89b7b6c5af", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 63, "text": "五年春正月，帝耕于藉田。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "d3ee637419f1265b482265fcc1ac23032f72c8847a869f39b84700c17be61b29"}

{"id": "p_83120dfd3e949e65", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 64, "text": "諸葛亮寇天水，詔大將軍司馬宣王拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "ef96870c782d1e7fc58b899c031c1f00bc15ce8c6675b7709fb31a1d0ea4428a"}

{"id": "p_57d1fefdc5b62fdc", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 65, "text": "自去冬十月至此月不雨，辛巳，大雩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "cdb091137ec94b7226c613122299f167b02980b0c4767ed7015f2e17f655b8a2"}

{"id": "p_7fc96d977d963cac", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 66, "text": "夏四月，鮮卑附義王軻比能率其種人及丁零大人兒禪詣幽州貢名馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "0f0769216a258be179c834b41da440688200eaeae0a145ceccad165d0504e431"}

{"id": "p_3370ce3eda85d573", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 67, "text": "秋七月丙子，以亮退走，封爵增位各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "0bc608d190f049909820e154f5cef8c52572710cb1f18be3cc4603888113c134"}

{"id": "p_7db9aab67fb11c8f", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 68, "text": "八月，詔曰：「古者諸侯朝聘，所以敦睦親親協和萬國也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "57cbf7240021b4555af04b1b81c69fc61b8f295b277c4cc0b5cf8cec12ebe941"}

{"id": "p_1b5d3a003dd7fb6c", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 69, "text": "先帝著令，不欲使諸王在京都者，謂幼主在位，母后攝政，防微以漸，關諸盛衰也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "9c733b531431a9061cbcdb2f63fe6feed9bf2aa7b925016fc92da7acf0a63ab9"}

{"id": "p_f8cbe8b9f435b87a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 70, "text": "朕惟不見諸王十有二載，悠悠之懷，能不興思！", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "86a9b451996acb61935aa65205027144d007bde201ebd9d657402e7370c842a2"}

{"id": "p_20f9b31c439eb2a6", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 71, "text": "其令諸王及宗室公侯各將適子一人朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "a0999a1ddfd5310002100a2d989235a1a71ccb9f2c560130b65edaf2c95057e8"}

{"id": "p_d185a28960574ef1", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 72, "text": "後有少主、母后在宮者，自如先帝令，申明著于令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "c4043357d0e000ea47822ead5263dfba58adc9002f1de968444784b490f0fd6a"}

{"id": "p_6525cbac7cd3ee76", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」十一月乙酉，月犯軒轅大星。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "2e8f8dfe30da5b0a99e126a34244eeb09dfb055d914aa99b81a69b9676f9779f"}

{"id": "p_dc4f558065a538c1", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 74, "text": "六年春二月，詔曰：「古之帝王，封建諸侯，所以藩屏王室也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "6c7b40848472f5dab309d4b41a73217f5a63231072721946926a35b9234bb4ec"}

{"id": "p_09b7a21a4af38668", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 75, "text": "詩不云乎，『懷德維寧，宗子維城』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "238a152c3e5eae21524294ebb3a2266b7154d03817679533ca361aacc165c7f5"}

{"id": "p_a4983286ef0b3575", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 76, "text": "秦、漢繼周，或彊或弱，俱失厥中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "f96e9d186020304bc6f2c9cdf15c0331973b82b9c5aae573fafeb1f63a887432"}

{"id": "p_6efe9c4b06e0c4bc", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 77, "text": "大魏創業，諸王開國，隨時之宜，未有定制，非所以永爲後法也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "714d7e98a00e872bd10d624d526a87a7a96f438276f729caa8f397482cbe6d45"}

{"id": "p_cbb240cca8d0218b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 78, "text": "其改封諸侯王，皆以郡爲國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "1c84ecbe014616b8de341a381317c30c8e1e63f32960f60acf8f84b540be9e3b"}

{"id": "p_a2908e23f3d23ca8", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 79, "text": "」三月癸酉，行東巡，所過存問高年鰥寡孤獨，賜穀帛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "2493f9d5abc20fc8fb1ccf11a6aa1b2a658bc87af07c54961b3eec886b71a2ea"}

{"id": "p_3392728f9205d69d", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 80, "text": "夏四月壬寅，行幸許昌宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "c7d8c5f8c64c662945a7251172eabe10d5997a849424b7a048b8e260615acecd"}

{"id": "p_8a9270392f41b8b6", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 81, "text": "五月，皇子殷薨，追封謚安平哀王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "db62331b46770b124093a81ee82e29954ebd99aecd35c3040b11eebdfaa376e5"}

{"id": "p_b5028758c1ba9be4", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 82, "text": "秋七月，以衞尉董昭爲司徒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "226019f272bd906dbf250c2d36fba0b32794f11523bbcbb44149fdc2ffb59284"}

{"id": "p_389bfc45cd6e307a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 83, "text": "九月，行幸摩陂，治許昌宮，起景福、承光殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "6c7445d0b0bc947daae472ec2a4b685aaf650139a386126b464f63734554fa6d"}

{"id": "p_cffab60f56bd62c2", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 84, "text": "冬十月，殄夷將軍田豫帥衆討吴將周賀於成山，殺賀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "b3a26a89bde7d798c0034c6152f8b95d52741add47dce6f2f8897992aa048d66"}

{"id": "p_ff83493368a0d8e8", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 85, "text": "有星孛于翼，近太微上將星。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "1b571fb130d352b5b0db4e1d79c4081a9e333ebb1613f31cc0952713a5963a55"}

{"id": "p_158da7325772199e", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 86, "text": "春正月甲申，青龍見郟之摩陂井中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "73d1d5700a45c817588c70af89d1ae34afc94b7582336d641824ff294cb8930d"}

{"id": "p_330b63542a42bb8a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 87, "text": "二月丁酉，幸摩陂觀龍，於是改年；改摩陂爲龍陂，賜男子爵人二級，鰥寡孤獨無出今年租賦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "a3938013c62dbb3ab709d52106cba99dcbddde6f346a2bb7509cc9fc00a3284e"}

{"id": "p_8455357de8b244d4", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 88, "text": "三月甲子，詔公卿舉賢良篤行之士各一人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "fb9467372cc80a18168cb20763b46e7d076facc72720da9db41207e099e3011e"}

{"id": "p_96ae3999f7cd77e2", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 89, "text": "夏五月壬申，詔祀故大將軍夏侯惇、大司馬曹仁、車騎將軍程昱於太祖廟庭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "714a452aa5f8144b2810a8838298d13109c97a111a847745371533a166736c3d"}

{"id": "p_777a30cb388acd41", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 90, "text": "丁酉，改封宗室女非諸王女皆爲邑主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "78e881f4ea6c0cfb0884530f235284380ef01563e25325d802b76cb3d2d4395f"}

{"id": "p_e76619035f0d628e", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 91, "text": "詔諸郡國山川不在祠典者勿祠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "27f54a88d0c4cafe4ada2cd26f3e1036a4464384919e76d5d1f481e55ba0b183"}

{"id": "p_a6f67201a0ac3229", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 92, "text": "保塞鮮卑大人步度根與叛鮮卑大人軻比能私通，并州刺史畢軌表，輒出軍以外威比能，內鎮步度根。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "3b6fb52846abd3ac930061a477cf2b6f0f6b9abc913c4c6bb5db0ccf71e50c82"}

{"id": "p_2e2dc2325fb76988", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 93, "text": "帝省表曰：「步度根以爲比能所誘，有自疑心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "aa6fd583100f4d59bb955e4e1ac6e766eec6315a31067b96d25b40b595393529"}

{"id": "p_ed8390b3a8de4748", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 94, "text": "今軌出軍，適使二部驚合爲一，何所威鎮乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "c7570422d950a54c232dc6b3e08c56447f690eb9357be6c321757b0d54289420"}

{"id": "p_b90fdf946703714f", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」促勑軌，以出軍者慎勿越塞過句注也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "d182b369691369081411b164f1fd0622147c590bc99cd3715191459cc0525e79"}

{"id": "p_c1284a90f62f9afb", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 96, "text": "比詔書到，軌以進軍屯陰館，遣將軍蘇尚、董弼追鮮卑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "32aaac1f9f6f3f274c2d547fd092616af8f7f17c6ae30e968b4b617f72578867"}

{"id": "p_e483e1231904bf8a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 97, "text": "比能遣子將千餘騎迎步度根部落，與尚、弼相遇，戰於樓煩，二將敗沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "745e074526f376efdab6e5e7ad630245aa455f87d1caa5ef8f7ad8ab88b45b28"}

{"id": "p_81e2a857fc8dc9bb", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 98, "text": "步度根部落皆叛出塞，與比能合寇邊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "b23e339320fc74419bc3276f0b376a004f4aba04319b828caf04e0de634b9237"}

{"id": "p_d2abd5fcaf64fb64", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 99, "text": "遣驍騎將軍秦朗將中軍討之，虜乃走漠北。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "09a9090e90ad81632622e7263cfe2384b7ec7de44482b24ffd3248c61d7de0fb"}

{"id": "p_44b50d2dcdf1f60e", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 100, "text": "秋九月，安定保塞匈奴大人胡薄居姿職等叛，司馬宣王遣將軍胡遵等追討，破降之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "f9182070c156461e5f0cd3e3b4c730e0ff9c4baf938760630ff261d4a379e6de"}

{"id": "p_4de872b75ee428a7", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 101, "text": "冬十月，步度根部落大人戴胡阿狼泥等詣并州降，朗引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "7fc3f79bf6a9e4d183ede2ff88cb127c931ff667134cb5b1afebf69c3290615b"}

{"id": "p_3def33fbf2fcfd85", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 102, "text": "十二月，公孫淵斬送孫權所遣使張彌、許晏首，以淵爲大司馬樂浪公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "674c9de68460bdf2b42771e4372add367702e6c4cb60ceb999d7473641415764"}

{"id": "p_1d7ded247550bad1", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 103, "text": "二年春二月乙未，太白犯熒惑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "2a81a7a4fb68c438c66b81fe48f3de557190fac3629a69c340c8f28754c627a7"}

{"id": "p_cb9cd635cddab26b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 104, "text": "癸酉，詔曰：「鞭作官刑，所以糾慢怠也，而頃多以無辜死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "93cea51b5ba6b726df282f97cf1fda5d60fb63a13a5f0f8f43e101fde8d15615"}

{"id": "p_46ab5269ed2bc14c", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 105, "text": "」三月庚寅，山陽公薨，帝素服發哀，遣使持節典護喪事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "655c5eee67d0be63683757fb313851e7d09a25fa37d0219061a0daa4db8c009d"}

{"id": "p_48f9168fd46f066b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 106, "text": "丙寅，詔有司以太牢告祠文帝廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "cff90b93fa34f7adf0a62237b8f03b9f62ad7b0b57bb6e4b8dd8465d1b00de47"}

{"id": "p_8407f05725b82c22", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 107, "text": "追謚山陽公爲漢孝獻皇帝，葬以漢禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "e8230bb21b205c7dc9c519688cab61fdfc45462b5ce82d3758260924e90dd7c2"}

{"id": "p_9d317420c4081dda", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 108, "text": "是月，諸葛亮出斜谷，屯渭南，司馬宣王率諸軍拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "276032a9a586b404719db22299c4af3b30c8e557ef21a21a5c59352c0900745e"}

{"id": "p_daabf6be59e71c10", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 109, "text": "詔宣王：「但堅壁拒守以挫其鋒，彼進不得志，退無與戰，乆停則糧盡，虜略無所獲，則必走矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "86eaaa1ce4e477ec13fe9299c6dc4ea2f50a3a6f61a7a675ceebb993120b3698"}

{"id": "p_b5a5cea98790113b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 110, "text": "走而追之，以逸待勞，全勝之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "1403b654158144dc77c8319649c0dc9159fea11316a31a04de4205300eb86e5c"}

{"id": "p_b7edc625a65ecbc2", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 111, "text": "孫權入居巢湖口，向合肥新城，又遣將陸議、孫韶各將萬餘人入淮、沔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "4f1e038c27b2a24c6ae103829bf1e5cd536cb63204d537b25410baad3db66b07"}

{"id": "p_336f99b92f81a267", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 112, "text": "六月，征東將軍滿寵進軍拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "8f9f5e1aa7a141b4f788c3d91c97130f32e2ae6ca1b3aa9d84e6b1a800da7c67"}

{"id": "p_d58597b6c14aaf06", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 113, "text": "寵欲拔新城守，致賊壽春，帝不聽，曰：「昔漢光武遣兵縣據略陽，終以破隗囂，先帝東置合肥，南守襄陽，西固祁山，賊來輒破於三城之下者，地有所必爭也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "8fec2d0cf0c5637f57b8b6a31853249b624b60bf54d73525564eb1fe4b5f217b"}

{"id": "p_7a98f06e27d6f493", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 114, "text": "勑諸將堅守，吾將自往征之，比至，恐權走也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "191edb1718fd09f2b4a96bad3d67072005e201b7c1f8ba4dce80616579d858b7"}

{"id": "p_6a5d2c533bd957fb", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 115, "text": "」秋七月壬寅，帝親御龍舟東征，權攻新城，將軍張頴等拒守力戰，帝軍未至數百里，權遁走，議、韶等亦退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "6e038c805ead35701150ef694fc320656f39289ef6da93bd0fdb8af2cb7cc7ff"}

{"id": "p_a8237a3c1c779040", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 116, "text": "羣臣以爲大將軍方與諸葛亮相持未解，車駕可西幸長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "9300e9d6d5f6e8e3cf8878b8e70ddc59a10cc6d2de8d5d34cd34ade06f20c2a9"}

{"id": "p_29a0fef9cf015ceb", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 117, "text": "帝曰：「權走，亮膽破，大將軍以制之，吾無憂矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "f47b43de05ad92493e25d0291e8d40568d052d2de43846a1070d197e2c9985d9"}

{"id": "p_d1600832cb9d9a4c", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 118, "text": "」遂進軍幸壽春，錄諸將功，封賞各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "aa0aaf36ec665d027669119bd4b43c93bdb42d7ec24cbd1516dc5446bbc5fb95"}

{"id": "p_ca2f579a82f4b1f4", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 119, "text": "八月己未，大曜兵，饗六軍，遣使者持節犒勞合肥、壽春諸軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "d109fb92c3ec31fc55dd3d82b52c80315b851427846f669901e33ab6f6c78b98"}

{"id": "p_bf749479560f5e42", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 120, "text": "司馬宣王與亮相持，連圍積日，亮數挑戰，宣王堅壘不應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "e4c07b8104743d9971f207db893505a1bff582ce4d38854527db167ce911fcc6"}

{"id": "p_94ab6cbe6f08c13b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 121, "text": "冬十月乙丑，月犯鎮星及軒轅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "5cfa115244f0b919a344a1d04575e074f542166d9ae56f58c4897a4c41e75933"}

{"id": "p_5b1a4531f9c4df16", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 122, "text": "十一月，京都地震，從東南來，隱隱有聲，搖動屋瓦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "b74858323ec6091945e37b99029b6909d786767d7d5b265857284f485237576f"}

{"id": "p_d7bc30b540df7666", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 123, "text": "十二月，詔有司刪定大辟，減死罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "1dc03f2cb675b6796a2980d4d471c78bbcf7207416883ddc8edcdbf37661d6c3"}

{"id": "p_1e2324b11dd44dbd", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 124, "text": "三年春正月戊子，以大將軍司馬宣王爲太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "0de831fc34e2beef2e9dd2bfe4f2122c5f2c2805d907203c9b7fd75809769160"}

{"id": "p_e49f8e8817c5888d", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 125, "text": "三月庚寅，葬文德郭后，營陵于首陽陵澗西，如終制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "802a72d575e162800dbc17a47247a60e18c46fba7f5b3a1deec235c88562a272"}

{"id": "p_891cae578407b63a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 126, "text": "是時，大治洛陽宮，起昭陽、太極殿，築緫章觀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "c06455e58ad0a8b100d046654a0169c410cf647c23f42f679a8220b1eaa123c1"}

{"id": "p_f71d218abc4823ba", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 127, "text": "百姓失農時，直臣楊阜、高堂隆等各數切諫，雖不能聽，常優容之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "e5faa609e67066c8630378c3e9ab8af6bd3a7d083ecc1028337a198e8dc1fba3"}

{"id": "p_794570dcaa317e84", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 128, "text": "秋七月，洛陽崇華殿災，八月庚午，立皇子芳爲齊王，詢爲秦王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "51b950d29eeecb5959fd6779a5f4254166ef6764cefad967e00d218c4d35d83d"}

{"id": "p_43619f688fbad891", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 129, "text": "命有司復崇華，改名九龍殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "dc49f5dd77abb1b21234731a12b61f43506ddc3d65cba86b1286bf3bbe3b7f02"}

{"id": "p_9e5f427df89a4e79", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 130, "text": "冬十月己酉，中山王衮薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "34a18b6e21865e2860cde0734f27f6cc24be6001d296f60e9d870455f4bdf123"}

{"id": "p_b827dc9c36695d13", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 131, "text": "十一月丁酉，行幸許昌宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "052180aab83895ea2667eaa62acb69c15ec7c3eef1896ac6b6d4fb0c4e71f5ca"}

{"id": "p_d78875a845cfa6d1", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 132, "text": "四年春二月，太白復晝見，月犯太白，又犯軒轅一星，入太微而出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "c80d7462ba24927925109bb38e686b61789692c7bfb4883079db8dbeb9dc0994"}

{"id": "p_6646f45bcd57f11f", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 133, "text": "夏四月，置崇文觀，徵善屬文者以充之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "9fc80508686862a11ec0f2404c18c94d87f87266f487902da1cce050464f17f2"}

{"id": "p_d777771d66c5626a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 134, "text": "六月壬申，詔曰：「有虞氏畫象而民弗犯，周人刑錯而不用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "ef9f4e1693f3b4001f48d758db8aab769e151a76072050c00578c1e2592096b7"}

{"id": "p_72f1c63bfda1fc21", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 135, "text": "朕從百王之末，追望上世之風，邈乎何相去之遠？", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "be0311de3628865499d231d7c4f78a58fb7eb1de31f02ce210d8db209df82aaa"}

{"id": "p_a18a3a028e746817", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 136, "text": "法令滋章，犯者彌多，刑罰愈衆，而姦不可止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "f7ce352ddc350cc9c53de1c86fede54f2994307e9002fbe0a1a8f4fa03c8f7f5"}

{"id": "p_cd879259f13cf7d8", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 137, "text": "往者桉大辟之條，多所蠲除，思濟生民之命，此朕之至意也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "7ed151713af58825457ffe679dfade97572b4ea18535815fb7a958c6ddbd81e9"}

{"id": "p_3e124fce4caa1c41", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 138, "text": "而郡國斃獄，一歲之中尚過數百，豈朕訓導不醇，俾民輕罪，將苛法猶存，爲之陷穽乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "81098920c13caadb473dbfe973ec9b3fad076585e8aee26868b451ff9b58df12"}

{"id": "p_4cdd30d1658448a4", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 139, "text": "有司其議獄緩死，務從寬簡，及乞恩者，或辭未出而獄以報斷，非所以究理盡情也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "a248ceb9fde77be10c3b3b912c44ad81cb576603a41317eca6f01f374251b7ab"}

{"id": "p_b9454cece540504d", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 140, "text": "其令廷尉及天下獄官，諸有死罪具獄以定，非謀反及手殺人，亟語其親治，有乞恩者，使與奏當文書俱上，朕將思所以全之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "3921e43c85fe12a25fee9a0e9761031de904a344be4f1f115444d0df60b86640"}

{"id": "p_d5274b138b0a7bb9", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 141, "text": "秋七月，高句驪王宮斬送孫權使胡衞等首，詣幽州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "f56fda274528dca0c8ef1e7b020e9a9ef36b7ffb8cae6cc8117a5928b011c337"}

{"id": "p_eb19a92ff0ff2ad5", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 142, "text": "冬十月己卯，行還洛陽宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "4165d417f18d1eb74c55f1ce57382e0e3b2e8d9060547eaeec0559a5c7077132"}

{"id": "p_69daa75398e63a73", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 143, "text": "甲申，有星孛于大辰，乙酉，又孛于東方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "a4d436c4905f83e4dc39e95d68b55ef840ef5d79611a60fa01d0457da683ed33"}

{"id": "p_1b054876cea0439e", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 144, "text": "十一月己亥，彗星見，犯宦者天紀星。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "4c8f0ba2fbbf12d45f09c4aff4a462534e0db9a3594251110213fd3f55c11702"}

{"id": "p_e4f327d88bac40ef", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 145, "text": "十二月癸巳，司空陳羣薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "fce2259b674c7856e66905343b4dbcb845a138f6ea8bb842174eaa7990611fd2"}

{"id": "p_82e331ba66eb5bd7", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 146, "text": "春正月壬辰，山茌縣言黃龍見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "974d81f5348fd64a29aa9e9d12725257e07cb64d211230560ead19a615b0984d"}

{"id": "p_8f43bc588a474bc9", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 147, "text": "於是有司奏，以爲魏得地統，宜以建丑之月爲正。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "9f6094f399bd3c6105596703210aa9248345ad2d7dc3082dd5b0dfdd8a5476db"}

{"id": "p_406b4298fd4e2c2d", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 148, "text": "三月，定歷改年爲孟夏四月。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "06d0ba1facd2fc7957b427e21ce2c213016afd2d71623c04e42ceb9cbaa4efcb"}

{"id": "p_23ef4a9f44602e87", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 149, "text": "服色尚黃，犧牲用白，戎事乘黑首白馬，建大赤之旂，朝會建大白之旗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "e511ea1509bb4bdbba41c7d5ea627e97f35cfe121d43082696bbe95fa2400b82"}

{"id": "p_5fd0788e4276c43c", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 150, "text": "改〈大和歷〉曰〈景初歷〉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "6c1574bd60a29182c9c7626ba7cab3e2a3793cf70688d8ed6eafa6886695ae29"}

{"id": "p_d31a4e4e29892f57", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 151, "text": "其春夏秋冬孟仲季月雖與正歲不同，至於郊祀、迎氣、礿祠、蒸甞、巡狩、蒐田、分至啟閉、班宣時令、中氣早晚、敬授民事，皆以正歲斗建爲歷數之序。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "ad3a9ac40d705ba42a9b902ce36b840aee8f962f5e357f76116b2f4c4ffad7cd"}

{"id": "p_efe6b6c3e09041e2", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 152, "text": "己亥，以尚書令陳矯爲司徒，尚書右僕射衞臻爲司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "7589d4ae288e6e0044f147f0ff90548043a750b915c5632a2e977bc7274f38ab"}

{"id": "p_525a95ff8c25f903", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 153, "text": "丁未，分魏興之魏陽、錫郡之安富、上庸爲上庸郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "a38596536fe0791a584a7d2ef88054e2acb1c1f8eb6070e428335e833d7b7f23"}

{"id": "p_faf4b97771641b47", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 154, "text": "省錫郡，以錫縣屬魏興郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "b23ad8fdbc3d043afcfb0e20b1855e6364f2d33950e802046db84d6e2257493b"}

{"id": "p_f6425e8cea9a4199", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 155, "text": "有司奏：武皇帝撥亂反正，爲魏太祖，樂用武始之舞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "fe626bebe9b79e598672966590856e9ea7ea9fc461bddbb57962b1db8f5d69f0"}

{"id": "p_acb6f18c46f71f05", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 156, "text": "文皇帝應天受命，爲魏高祖，樂用咸熙之舞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "03c44adf5d1479d7ccae660620361f0e6ff5de4b014ddfc237a500b17e2195de"}

{"id": "p_e41abf610a0f7398", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 157, "text": "帝制作興治，爲魏烈祖，樂用章武之舞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "c947837e3b79faa6b4503fcb28be3287cd1e25e6768065726247a1cb29ebee60"}

{"id": "p_b1dda86151e61127", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 158, "text": "三祖之廟萬世不毀，其餘四廟親盡迭毀，如周后稷、文、武廟祧之制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "cd63a35747061eadce6b643fda86a745bd03f2c0f88a5f5b0a042f702cca03d9"}

{"id": "p_d3f2382de509a727", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 159, "text": "秋七月丁卯，司徒陳矯薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "363ad0b08c70ed2e4ba463d69fb90a555bf97318e511424e5e4eba3842a5d250"}

{"id": "p_782f5a7446f762c3", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 160, "text": "孫權遣將朱然等二萬人圍江夏郡，荊州刺史胡質等擊之，然退走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "5a05bd471248a695b33379f8590faa1440ea2aa252044568ec0a82f513554793"}

{"id": "p_76f90cf3e4cb3f67", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 161, "text": "初，權遣使浮海與高句驪通，欲襲遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "10be8d9473ada29b9f1d363732df551fbf72ad0f22ab040278474d95a6de0dd7"}

{"id": "p_9781885decdf2437", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 162, "text": "遣幽州刺史毌丘儉率諸軍及鮮卑、烏丸屯遼東南界，璽書徵公孫淵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "3f006b27fd6b4b1f3f242046abeac17c0b2c49c23277110018c0f69d1ccb95fa"}

{"id": "p_4ad7ef31394620d0", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 163, "text": "淵發兵反，儉進軍討之，會連雨十日，遼水大漲，詔儉引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "efda6eb1c16525a5a616f5214b3683dccb5962e665d4713c37bdf71950f0b90a"}

{"id": "p_c2701ee31b160a74", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 164, "text": "右北平烏丸單于寇婁敦、遼西烏丸都督王護留等居遼東，率部衆隨儉內附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "f9cf6520dda9b9082ec8bb1b723f1e124bfabeb9ff63f66004f345ca8768b77a"}

{"id": "p_3f449793ba3b4722", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 165, "text": "己卯，詔遼東將吏士民爲淵所脅略不得降者，一切赦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "f499956d7f6a4dea3e2b22d40e5b82afc2081028ed3a42bce1a02fff41963060"}

{"id": "p_4861c49584357d65", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 166, "text": "淵自儉還，遂自立爲燕王，置百官，稱紹漢元年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "3e28e05a43cc483028703ebef83bff1cf2c1de345567cab6a29a488de172aae7"}

{"id": "p_6e13975a0063d7a2", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 167, "text": "詔青、兖、幽、冀四州大作海船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "937c7d5c081bf68c9766bea5754a6f8b811df93f330018daeff9304f1a2226e0"}

{"id": "p_1e1af4243fc605f4", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 168, "text": "九月，冀、兖、徐、豫四州民遇水，遣侍御史循行沒溺死亡及失財產者，在所開倉振救之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "539d3cf1f90f805681c8ee02a75155a50188516a75dea8f8f95fb13917769a54"}

{"id": "p_f99aa3b5f1310208", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 169, "text": "乙卯，營洛陽南委粟山爲圜丘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "09d5972dad6bcee531bcb1da712760c1a6954ac30e81e314970d4d87bb4fe7ed"}

{"id": "p_dcd793727a6a610e", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 170, "text": "丁巳，分襄陽臨沮、宜城、旍陽、邔四縣，置襄陽南部都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "52737c0c1b872441dc90cbc456804504698d98d3adc1237dc0d8affe16f8ca51"}

{"id": "p_112c21cf1b303957", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 171, "text": "己未，有司奏文昭皇后立廟京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "7e332ab1ba03d6038d171c39ce6aed8d9829d0f59e782d4ac54fe49d9d8d44d4"}

{"id": "p_9d7f12c123799a7f", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 172, "text": "分襄陽郡之鄀葉縣屬義陽郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "501de82caa2717f7068357c14a24fc13ebf53a47f6f195976903e98f54f476b3"}

{"id": "p_b58450fe090e8aa1", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 173, "text": "二年春正月，詔太尉司馬宣王帥衆討遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "e8c3b718240572aa07e20ed2c8558d48c86506b106841aff99e668784b4194ca"}

{"id": "p_2ebd1b7cf1c1d180", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 174, "text": "二月癸卯，以大中大夫韓曁爲司徒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "ef84bf1e5a0c57014caea5bd5bf0b281a0a456142cc59449dfc242eb245ae541"}

{"id": "p_44b5c3e7039bf799", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 175, "text": "癸丑，月犯心距星，又犯心中央大星。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "a509c1b4725fe15c7164d2c40f4c0189152ce39bbb228fe7b70b1cdac9605b5b"}

{"id": "p_dfac5e41c073f0eb", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 176, "text": "夏四月庚子，司徒韓曁薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "4e6e24b139c50713ca4598a29a74380c6fe5a731930918232440a44f3f725da4"}

{"id": "p_6d1ba7d14241a641", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 177, "text": "壬寅，分沛國蕭、相、竹邑、符離、蘄、銍、龍亢、山桑、洨、虹十縣爲汝陰郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "888df0bab8beeb99161e00ee7600feb0c60aedfb40fbaba807fd69b40312046e"}

{"id": "p_2aa0dbd484e2448b", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 178, "text": "宋縣、陳郡苦縣皆屬譙郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "21e213cc25da9c601b3099a7161a7aefc88f869fd1b011d8ec2f169981ee425d"}

{"id": "p_db1bf06d35b5503a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 179, "text": "以沛、杼秋、公丘、彭城豐國、廣戚，并五縣爲沛王國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "f1560b98aaaf470bee0e7b2cc102f460040b93b65595f60da6fbf4b085a9df27"}

{"id": "p_4e108c33c0f59dd2", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 180, "text": "五月乙亥，月犯心距星，又犯中央大星。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "8c44a8e3fd7310e6430afdfcdc4fa0fe43a6771533c3a42df31b0da076f1bcd6"}

{"id": "p_085e04c7c288e88d", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 181, "text": "六月，省漁陽郡之狐奴縣，復置安樂縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "2322f05dd5bb0e948f74f7b2817186ffe36055f128076e87d63c1d0daa4bdd57"}

{"id": "p_300334bcef7bb100", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 182, "text": "秋八月，燒當羌王芒中、注詣等叛，涼州刺史率諸郡攻討，斬注詣首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "0a6dd24cf6034ff45c5f1401c86616ecc350df046a08666cad22123e17c4deab"}

{"id": "p_4c0f85491efaab55", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 183, "text": "丙寅，司馬宣王圍公孫淵於襄平，大破之，傳淵首于京都，海東諸郡平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "b618d52ba8c061e32b818b3ccdff498130140f57bf22ca1c294b61fc295faabd"}

{"id": "p_32becdcba745729d", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 184, "text": "冬十一月，錄討淵功，太尉宣王以下增邑封爵各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "00a0c8f539335e67a2f9534c605007c11bdb1b38f2e9e5958a44b2a2c48393c6"}

{"id": "p_6df9d6e818bd685e", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 185, "text": "初，帝議遣宣王討淵，發卒四萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "cba485b265fb55ccc63eaee7ef6256f3769f472d63260bb0783f29fbd22bb490"}

{"id": "p_85a3a601630988b6", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 186, "text": "議臣皆以爲四萬兵多，役費難供。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "2347f8cb2045cf5c7117ba8af545dc21bde372bdd20ddfc8a515cd771367b1aa"}

{"id": "p_225600d20faac2a2", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 187, "text": "帝曰：「四千里征伐，雖云用奇，亦當任力，不當稍計役費。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "83ec54f467accc5d2000f8e18905c80cb1922d4db1827d6c899036fba659e35d"}

{"id": "p_3eb47dff6aba00fd", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 188, "text": "及宣王至遼東，霖雨不得時攻，羣臣或以爲淵未可卒破，宜詔宣王還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "1f0951e53325a1e2e148438ac9a374bf9c397c33e0ca575e99f457d0a9d460f2"}

{"id": "p_bd925ac3d5841e71", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 189, "text": "帝曰：「司馬懿臨危制變，擒淵可計日待也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "69c679d29eced7e414b6e2be008dcc4a31513082cb9bb38e28270733574136ec"}

{"id": "p_566d1036617fb734", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 190, "text": "壬午，以司空衞臻爲司徒，司隷校尉崔林爲司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "e369fbb2475a1d29eb44c7c18967e2e3730b25e581308ee92fe9ef8cd5360862"}

{"id": "p_d3eb4e723d5824ae", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 191, "text": "十二月乙丑，帝寢疾不豫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "c7da0c275503ec74088583b409f486be7c23182552e3e2276307db8b351bc526"}

{"id": "p_3ebd5cfc89d600dd", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 192, "text": "賜天下男子爵人二級，鰥寡孤獨穀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "b6dec4420175b32097879aaaf59c254e0d86ff73eace6e0a45ca85cd863304e8"}

{"id": "p_d41ad32f794d9619", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 193, "text": "以燕王宇爲大將軍，甲申免，以武衞將軍曹爽代之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "7d44cc475561c7cc6dbfad22d425e4ef2db99db1687ebf9439822dfba7e272fa"}

{"id": "p_23dd1e6d5f5088b6", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 194, "text": "初，中，壽春農民妻自言爲天神所下，命爲登女，當營衞帝室，蠲邪納福。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "5d387b2b83dc5a389d1939c169dbb217de2a74d6adb98f11b76705fd03809dea"}

{"id": "p_93fd7c6d18697be6", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 195, "text": "飲人以水，及以洗創，或多愈者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "65cd9576bcf3b668f8690a7e58a603d7fcefe7e9ce654dca635fc8eb9136ebc0"}

{"id": "p_0efad21010314deb", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 196, "text": "於是立館後宮，下詔稱揚，甚見優寵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "fca0c0e0f277d1fac240d893eef634aced0a464379f9c9e01a77ae8681113358"}

{"id": "p_ab74732705bde40a", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 197, "text": "及帝疾，飲水無驗，於是殺焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "423a0d540cd649bfc66d5cf457be3d559722411dda5455a233ea81d1503b3341"}

{"id": "p_a6ff1435e154a908", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 198, "text": "三年春正月丁亥，太尉宣王還至河內，帝驛馬召到，引入卧內，執其手謂曰：「吾疾甚，以後事屬君，君其與爽輔少子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "a81689658993b78c1d3301a916140b47a9c5aa38f5263d6e64c97850c1a27148"}

{"id": "p_95b55e48f97a698f", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 199, "text": "即日，帝崩于嘉福殿，時年三十六。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "aa3774c4860afc07aaace27a3993592d2484bf52f55ffa5a3d92c5cb14a60675"}

{"id": "p_5feb1177d8a80671", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 200, "text": ":評曰：明帝沉毅斷識，任心而行，蓋有君人之至槩焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "eea0439927eeea69613c177514885aeb37e370312fde706296fdb771088569e9"}

{"id": "p_3d3f47a6854fc662", "source_id": "src_228ec535c85f848e", "ordinal": 201, "text": "于時百姓彫弊，四海分崩，不先聿脩顯祖，闡拓洪基，而遽追秦皇、漢武，宮館是營，格之遠猷，其殆疾乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "4d4a6c9f49403ee341bfa29105dc1be38e56bef50c8f3cfdf6ac1390df5ca1e6"}

{"id": "p_0207ce4e51031b2a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 0, "text": "明帝無子，養王及秦王詢；宮省事祕，莫有知其所由來者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "1ab2f838544f396393975b72105cc3174019e6732e21205bc19778923a4efc93"}

{"id": "p_6b3c1bf5f1fe06b0", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 1, "text": "正月丁亥朔，帝甚病，乃立為皇太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "5552446da9514184a71e7096083f52e3c1a96b947a794ba5d22ce976ff433888"}

{"id": "p_3198ea592f163a1c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 2, "text": "大將軍曹爽、太尉司馬宣王輔政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "ee6e10e413a68d3cbd74052ecf57674213f01a0ac4c7cad2c3df9bd40baa662d"}

{"id": "p_847619442a0f477b", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 3, "text": "詔曰：「」二月，西域重譯獻火浣布，詔大將軍、太尉臨試以示百寮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "607095d45068dc6a5949b4c1d574647fff0a01ddd2e35c2348d94e5f45e31fe2"}

{"id": "p_0b33d01777981581", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 4, "text": "丁丑詔曰：「」三月，以征東將軍滿寵為太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "5ad122edbec15f33cdb346ada7d372111c4a32b56738603d49d40500f4016ad3"}

{"id": "p_2262f532d85dac92", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 5, "text": "夏六月，以遼東東沓縣吏民渡海居齊郡界，以故縱城為新沓縣以居徙民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "95882295202e27c8eb9af09bd6664e17123bc9f9117678c0941ab032859b2eb2"}

{"id": "p_4f8910551b6f928c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 6, "text": "秋七月，上始親臨朝，聽公卿奏事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "b54a3563e8039c0c0912d387119bb6a23f1e13f725e517f5d25dd4880bba0efa"}

{"id": "p_34aa60d182437b81", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 7, "text": "冬十月，以鎮南將軍黃權為車騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "6a6c5c734ceaefec2af545a7e2b5581456bcf29095f9618d0b83e6ea21ab9f7d"}

{"id": "p_00dd84a43d869e10", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 8, "text": "春二月乙丑，加侍中中書監劉放、侍中中書令孫資為左右光祿大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "03f2e28f16d6de7ce8005f98c16db6a0a5b001f56203ac0c4ec499dae0343633"}

{"id": "p_65231d60ea29dccf", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 9, "text": "丙戌，以遼東汶、北豐縣民流徙渡海，規齊郡之西安、臨菑、昌國縣界為新汶、南豐縣，以居流民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "f720b7d69c8526b7f7850042958a6249532492ddc8d484f978ba847c110d3c0b"}

{"id": "p_141c91f0cccb30a6", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 10, "text": "自去冬十二月至此月不雨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "5b6091a4e497a4c0e2114d992d25cd70035875e18876fe8b324f3dfc1680e967"}

{"id": "p_c2d11173e0c62b79", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 11, "text": "丙寅，詔令獄官亟平冤枉，理出輕微；羣公卿士讜言嘉謀，各悉乃心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "58c80a297f3e1705ad8acb677c406fe1295e4d1b5240a4935ffc756befae3939"}

{"id": "p_9c4a0cf234e6a51e", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 12, "text": "夏四月，車騎將軍黃權薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "3c192a32b608d74cfb6363d105704443dec6ee662c992f2710ec5261b98b3d2c"}

{"id": "p_01fa43bb7ce0d61c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 13, "text": "秋七月，詔曰：「」八月，車駕巡省洛陽界秋稼，賜高年力田各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "17dff91b30657577e2f3da71aa06faeb40f8ac52e5e4916c9416eea93e7d241e"}

{"id": "p_cd48e0b55f49da44", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 14, "text": "二年春二月，帝初通《論語》，使太常以太牢祭孔子於辟雍，以顏淵配。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "feef3773f49359167a82c5088f5508e017eed1cd10200c5e8473fc427a254169"}

{"id": "p_c73d388533c4667e", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 15, "text": "夏五月，吳將朱然等圍襄陽之樊城，太傅司馬宣王率衆拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "5236d73705b449910fac034fe0855d0060d40dc57fc3e474454ebfb6edeab280"}

{"id": "p_9c199bac2df1e2f8", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 16, "text": "己卯，以征東將軍王凌為車騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "d0276753530fc5558f0b09017bbd212c7daca8bfd7a6f845a2934f10c88f7f5c"}

{"id": "p_e2c56f3f2bfc7645", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 17, "text": "三年春正月，東平王徽薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "a6b052a051a520782303e26e838cfd8106bdc1a3b8c2c1e877bb412320c4a602"}

{"id": "p_0c03174461c95736", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 18, "text": "秋七月甲申，南安郡地震。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "d79faac7ee694769bc6461934ca5830e7b37f5b6dbe8f7096f4d3c0e4a911205"}

{"id": "p_6deae6f2cb8d259a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 19, "text": "乙酉，以領軍將軍蔣濟為太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "16f17506695ffa7421b6fd7be2886ad153b16617ae7cf903924e8fd4bb6ce388"}

{"id": "p_0eea382fe9824185", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 20, "text": "四年春正月，帝加元服，賜羣臣各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "a3eea3edc4ea07ba65158ada916ab86d057a23a01d273a52dffc075a02e369c8"}

{"id": "p_7d04be1ca20212a3", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 21, "text": "夏四月乙卯，立皇后甄氏，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "2e61f0a87eaca63f79088eb318f9d63d96d389cd4f556d0811ce29c95d91a6eb"}

{"id": "p_6f1dc7c488740140", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 22, "text": "秋七月，詔祀故大司馬曹真、曹休、征南大將軍夏侯尚、太常桓階、司空陳羣、太傅鍾繇、車騎將軍張郃、左將軍徐晃、前將軍張遼、右將軍樂進、太尉華歆、司徒王朗、驃騎將軍曹洪、征西將軍夏侯淵、後將軍朱靈、文聘、執金吾臧霸、破虜將軍李典、立義將軍龐德、武猛校尉典韋於太祖廟庭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "f239a91db4139e033e62a4ebe9fe6ac998d1b01ff1e381d63f0da7ce539d4848"}

{"id": "p_2278adee99e64614", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 23, "text": "冬十二月，倭國女王俾彌呼遣使奉獻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "beddc4e87c5bc6b7e2ddf1026c21df41763ac3528ba3540eee4f04fb8a02e744"}

{"id": "p_ea0310b46d721249", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 24, "text": "五年春二月，詔大將軍曹爽率衆征蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "a43e93e53d5d294d06edbded4b8b55424be108005cba02d74f8bbe9b48fb26b0"}

{"id": "p_481648e2e62ccd75", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 25, "text": "五月癸巳，講尚書經通，使太常以太牢祠孔子於辟雍，以顏淵配；賜太傳、大將軍及侍講者各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "6a8fa34550b7fffcd6b7de110741c6e33ecd6270496314dfb98f6860383da78c"}

{"id": "p_0d0eca85b8e49241", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 26, "text": "丙午，大將軍曹爽引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "f6f4fc9c19fb472648dfe200025c05d7ec3d2b0c287ca051a4e7df12bd3da3f7"}

{"id": "p_354fbf2b5579934f", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 27, "text": "九月，鮮卑內附，置遼東屬國，立昌黎縣以居之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "3dbe9e658d38e713989bcc0251bd0007301ca0dd2bfb55352e7b3faf62136479"}

{"id": "p_5832213751bd06a1", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 28, "text": "冬十一月癸卯，詔祀故尚書令荀攸於太祖廟庭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "5167d53b2e0e420d611974ba6ac49b6fa699dc7cb7f16cf307c5e10b857ee42d"}

{"id": "p_2a4818cc18482ed4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 29, "text": "六年春二月丁卯，南安郡地震。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "35eead82aa5830eba527b4bf4dae96fd2b050ddc6f0970392f4dc294778cb577"}

{"id": "p_770cbf47d6d2a195", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 30, "text": "丙子，以驃騎將軍趙儼為司空；夏六月，儼薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "6120e19ed317aa72416eec368749e033c62325bf429dffeeffedb917563b3f68"}

{"id": "p_17158534793a1235", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 31, "text": "八月丁卯，以太常高柔為司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "91b9865cf6bccb1606576e1ec3c2e326c6fc0f1c1b0d5855731bba6e6220bc4e"}

{"id": "p_40ab352f653f65c6", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 32, "text": "癸巳，以左光祿大夫劉放為驃騎將軍，右光祿大夫孫資為衞將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "3fc865b5e07509079420d4f92e1394b3c72d5896d28bc4b3a4caedc9f18ec830"}

{"id": "p_62219515e09167ea", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 33, "text": "冬十一月，祫祭太祖廟，始祀前所論佐命臣二十一人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "d158d1995f174c19dc48b2fab638bc7075085718fbddd90d14e7075547d048b5"}

{"id": "p_3582586564c89e1a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 34, "text": "十二月辛亥，詔故司徒王朗所作易傳，令學者得以課試。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "90121adb04737737ccf3625a8c9fa338d280562022344915e42fb0c8289d79f0"}

{"id": "p_9eb116865d40be9f", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 35, "text": "七年春二月，幽州刺史毌丘儉討高句驪，夏五月，討濊貊，皆破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "f5e5bb329fe00740f1f9a20e45f29dbea434f4eee4ba0125003bd3d0c252e30a"}

{"id": "p_28072967cfa9252d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 36, "text": "韓那奚等數十國各率種落降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "91f7604011755219dc42d45ff64e15d5ebf59b3fdd7e952408dc5895f6f5a859"}

{"id": "p_93d7d8e6e38b5a08", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 37, "text": "己酉，詔曰：「」冬十二月，講《禮記》通，使太常以太牢祀孔子於辟雍，以顏淵配。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "59e4162268d8021fd37f8bda207f42f8e307ec99c9a5bc7fa3d7a7bd4e755506"}

{"id": "p_95d84166907120a7", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 38, "text": "八年春二月朔，日有蝕之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "a4a0aadc971f3f722595f55aa1d382077a00692f1e4de5b70941342c404d25f3"}

{"id": "p_10f279f9a6776787", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 39, "text": "夏五月，分河東之汾北十縣為平陽郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "38da2a05c841bcf96235b7197a7c435dd6a1b393333d3202c85f5010b52a3c27"}

{"id": "p_f7eb36e9ed7f970d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 40, "text": "秋七月，尚書何晏奏曰：「」冬十二月，散騎常侍諫議大夫孔晏乂奏曰：「禮，天子之宮，有斲礱之制，無朱丹之飾，宜循禮復古。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "6b2a2ace8223d6f49a4637cf59baa1865c4eed0a2fa668f27892bdbe2ecd94fb"}

{"id": "p_0da27b9b4ef17f29", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 41, "text": "今天下已平，君臣之分明，陛下但當不懈于位，平公正之心，審賞罰以使之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "c74b75f45b0b9d4474cb816a98e3107bf7c0e62d0faa98371440be074e151a25"}

{"id": "p_6df091b46646a0ff", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 42, "text": "可絕後園習騎乘馬，出必御輦乘車，天下之福，臣子之願也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "e67cb8f69dd658c97f72f2c532f7c0d62afe94532056167ef7b0879d7427dc62"}

{"id": "p_646d239a5a007604", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 43, "text": "九年春二月，衞將軍中書令孫資，癸巳，驃騎將軍中書監劉放，三月甲午，司徒衞臻，各遜位，以侯就第，位特進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "7a57288ebca95dba2669d435b987e55f48063078bea1b3c077a717990642a8b8"}

{"id": "p_0db09b7fe6ace854", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 44, "text": "四月，以司空高柔為司徒；光祿大夫徐邈為司空，固辭不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "13b5e5f3341a95f62a958b877c62c006ccd89a54c7ee4dd2e5cade1eb8f213ad"}

{"id": "p_040e3b07459828d3", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 45, "text": "秋九月，以車騎將軍王淩為司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "3286993cced58e366961f19171e53e9cd70d9e34cbb5d5ae0e629803dfe7bead"}

{"id": "p_55103b3f850be22d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 46, "text": "春正月甲午，車駕謁高平陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "7da46647e9931cff99bc77c20f72ce56300affc72d07436253d41acad8ba1a06"}

{"id": "p_61149f45fe67d1d0", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 47, "text": "太傅司馬宣王奏免大將軍曹爽、爽弟中領軍羲、武衞將軍訓、散騎常侍彥官，以侯就第。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "14b15cc45acbdfa48c2abc1611c2543b81b9feb6dab875f9ff0124c226cd2c44"}

{"id": "p_5c3a4959175be17b", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 48, "text": "戊戌，有司奏収黃門張當付廷尉，考實其辭，爽與謀不軌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "add406b83e040c88fe975c31c73772f09f66d09ae755d0694af426114240ac9c"}

{"id": "p_f7068ebd55aa9c90", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 49, "text": "又尚書丁謐、鄧颺、何晏、司隷校尉畢軌、荊州刺史李勝、大司農桓範皆與爽通姦謀，夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "584a3f1c816da2ebd49de3a374f07cee2848fb60145dc6995ed3cf3009fbb3a8"}

{"id": "p_c734004db7b0bb8d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 50, "text": "丁未，以太傅司馬宣王為丞相，固讓乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "dd7aca41fd73932ba8e72b177deff05c29a65b78fddd7f3003033caaeff65b4e"}

{"id": "p_9969a5c244c40afc", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 51, "text": "冬十二月辛卯，以司空王淩為太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "bd7560e9336220903c1d03a56b2040c93983dbe8c531809021ba9aee1fce3a04"}

{"id": "p_c9b6a3470ab20463", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 52, "text": "庚子，以司隷校尉孫禮為司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "317401e4cdde8bab232ca42f6d5ee7b616e5dab0b3e5a62565819bd8ce944b64"}

{"id": "p_dd57e5213de2f17a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 53, "text": "二年夏五月，以征西將軍郭淮為車騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "44283e025bcd6a406c9efee09aac069e4c4af89451a8cc26ddd5a3079840f36f"}

{"id": "p_4a3e54a69e118277", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 54, "text": "冬十月，以特進孫資為驃騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "32ba4bc54abd62fcf97361a1e42e960a722875eae367b5a1a1c47b63912ad099"}

{"id": "p_e1ab3501c5dbe714", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 55, "text": "十二月甲辰，東海王霖薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "881676fbcd0c86554662fc238ef84e39b34486ab2233abae910ffd2c7a922465"}

{"id": "p_ea206ef27a0a42a2", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 56, "text": "乙未，征南將軍王昶渡江，掩攻吳，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "5b696b2afe9726f85074f04ef346f1aaca9846cbcfe399b7bc8bb707277ce9fd"}

{"id": "p_d75f2834928bc3f5", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 57, "text": "三年春正月，荊州刺史王基、新城太守泰攻吳，破之，降者數千口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "9699cacc4530a0eace1bc104a9da1d0315ca92e068b4d3d6a2d03b8f86405715"}

{"id": "p_5f89dfdcb3a97023", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 58, "text": "二月，置南郡之夷陵縣以居降附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "c3cf3557a008ae41d377f0c057da63d9f2125bc511f4d9a06c2bbba08d93edc9"}

{"id": "p_b73a682bc5724bbd", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 59, "text": "三月，以尚書令司馬孚為司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "df078d4c0bbb7b2d1b9c13e66e83158fccc95f62d856e0fc3b1d40bbc382f83f"}

{"id": "p_14b66801ada52bd1", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 60, "text": "四月甲申，以征南將軍王昶為征南大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "43a70f5b32bfc220cabe5f5f37f8da0139c3aee0a27c351674e9eacb67245acd"}

{"id": "p_cb9381435fcd78f1", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 61, "text": "丙午，聞太尉王淩謀廢帝，立楚王彪，太傅司馬宣王東征淩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "6b1b417012eaa6aa938d291255cd519830e11812eefc0a174bb92e5295438f38"}

{"id": "p_97c6ade31dc6a38e", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 62, "text": "秋七月壬戌，皇后甄氏崩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "8749c0cd0c3c89cfa2a741efa5d6d89a0e131166d71b0623093fe22a62e9be90"}

{"id": "p_e920b4bf176f714f", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 63, "text": "辛未，以司空司馬孚為太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "35d0d4a837873834c6286763715b5ae08bcb9146a796677cfabc5463e79a2fd6"}

{"id": "p_7c448712f762b852", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 64, "text": "戊寅，太傅司馬宣王薨，以衞將軍司馬景王為撫軍大將軍，錄尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "93b9da155a342fa2677e7dad474c809fa0de37e7ab25b24eb3fb4fab592cbaec"}

{"id": "p_4476dbdda5c534eb", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 65, "text": "乙未，葬懷甄后于太清陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "88cceac6989aca9d17f160964cd64dfd742dff2187d0c356534ef14f819b5a2e"}

{"id": "p_7826d7b8d90f2431", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 66, "text": "十一月，有司奏諸功臣應饗食於太祖廟者，更以官為次，太傅司馬宣王功高爵尊，最在上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "c48bcd07abe576634d80a7882d18d5610e605b465473ab00d6407bfac8111304"}

{"id": "p_09723bd5bb9ae624", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 67, "text": "十二月，以光祿勳鄭冲為司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "2bedb8d82b8bd37e21e714b5cbc47387cf0c64e8cbcc59e2ccda6e7b8a531e00"}

{"id": "p_fb291da4ff2d95ec", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 68, "text": "四年春正月癸卯，以撫軍大將軍司馬景王為大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "f172b16194c09f26992e281f2fde1bf69e357d15be8a13ed8f772c5bac10a663"}

{"id": "p_4a0c5f58e06ada1a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 69, "text": "二月，立皇后張氏，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "01fca8d4a4d9629ab2ed3d9c26e41c89550db15ee1220f9f965be8eaf1837137"}

{"id": "p_ce33a643371097f4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 70, "text": "夏五月，魚二，見于武庫屋上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "79195e84c5295a020e15cb11f81ab0c3bec4a23936e1c25a05dd8baf5839f216"}

{"id": "p_8a166ed725679406", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 71, "text": "冬十一月，詔征南大將軍王昶、征東將軍胡遵、鎮南將軍毌丘儉等征吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "e3399666ef6c738a829e2c119628e652fe35c4e95902d5664723dd90986131ab"}

{"id": "p_79b9dbd8af84fc59", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 72, "text": "十二月，吳大將軍諸葛恪拒戰，大破衆軍於東關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "2929f555befbcabc952abbfae03e9d27f59d485965b23b34e0de9a1277fbb78b"}

{"id": "p_2d7f864db0ee97fc", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 73, "text": "五月，吳太傅諸葛恪圍合肥新城，詔太尉司馬孚拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "7423b50b47fe02e2f3e094fe5434535fb02f354255e4da75a7b7eafdd062bec1"}

{"id": "p_b0787f13ab6a9005", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 74, "text": "自帝即位至于是歲，郡國縣道多所置省，俄或還復，不可勝紀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "066e549767af6a27a4cd9eb833766f360f3d38b93e809792bd836f43de70c0df"}

{"id": "p_671f6aeeda99141a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 75, "text": "六年春二月己丑，鎮東將軍毌丘儉上言：「昔諸葛恪圍合肥新城，城中遣士劉整出圍傳消息，為賊所得，考問所傳，語整曰：『諸葛公欲活汝，汝可具服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "e1c66154549ba8231ecd38dd9595452f4b3441722f3daf733604268207cbe2b5"}

{"id": "p_10a82c0befe909d5", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 76, "text": "』整罵曰：『死狗，此何言也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "c87e1cd1c613b91733ddac6fdb3b94cd2586ca69f9586b6792a71e8f3f781b46"}

{"id": "p_620cefcec6d79400", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 77, "text": "我當必死為魏國鬼，不苟求活，逐汝去也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "896ecc62e12636ee2ab21fab44d7c911de37fee6d65aea128bb1d2ff0c8baef6"}

{"id": "p_c0729190f3090e8a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 78, "text": "又遣士鄭像出城傳消息，或以語恪，恪遣馬騎尋圍跡索，得像還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "bb86f07e02449e9746226a91dc0e1108da6ed0fee35db6b89a1022bb00844f06"}

{"id": "p_3f8a64e868a85675", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 79, "text": "四五人靮頭靣縛，將繞城表，勑語像，使大呼，言『大軍已還洛，不如早降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "294d00be1b27b0e5fbcd82fab0b84719d3be00cef2ccdd8e93560c724ffd31c9"}

{"id": "p_13837514384494f5", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 80, "text": "』像不從其言，更大呼城中曰：『大軍近在圍外，壯士努力！", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "5333135891c6c75e66c7d3690207a33f2ba588012d6b851752b5cde158a0f590"}

{"id": "p_02e61ac1b8bf2df8", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 81, "text": "』賊以刀築其口，使不得言，像遂大呼，令城中聞知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "d891bda7e865c6fc3e8a76dde7ed1046a59b671cfed216e3b025e918fc442f1c"}

{"id": "p_ead77adabadccd00", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 82, "text": "整、像為兵，能守義執節，子弟宜有差異。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "e33e011597eb53e9d7384bff9fc8f660508877f92f41afcd064b32a22daa2070"}

{"id": "p_f3e0f7b9dd8ae8e7", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 83, "text": "庚戌，中書令李豐與皇后父光祿大夫張緝等謀廢易大臣，以太常夏侯玄為大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "e081027321936442f1db79d2c16cbcb9e6920940b48c6ec70511b62a97c2e537"}

{"id": "p_558051f4b8e90d32", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 84, "text": "事覺，諸所連及者皆伏誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "6b1b3e8742d262fd409c414eb2d7f40bd905ae749e3d5c061e15039928a14a98"}

{"id": "p_ac96cfc0ed0f714c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 85, "text": "夏四月，立皇后王氏，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "ec9ac2515b47f8a22a1a9bb076a282e2d37ef0c3d1d4e99d5ef4b12821ceb074"}

{"id": "p_c6908231621d5ca4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 86, "text": "五月，封后父奉車都尉王夔為廣明鄉侯、光祿大夫，位特進，妻田氏為宣陽鄉君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "0b3d9e9b35a9bb71b959f88f19ee296fde578629be909788b65a0b94d5b2903e"}

{"id": "p_e810a8afc322effa", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 87, "text": "秋九月，大將軍司馬景王將謀廢帝，以聞皇太后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "80ae01f390379f7bcd4326348e4103edae13c20a48251e627bc5589a614d35d5"}

{"id": "p_086d7f3dad224a3c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 88, "text": "甲戌，太后令曰：「皇帝芳春秋已長，不親萬機，耽淫內寵，沈漫女德，日延倡優，縱其醜謔；迎六宮家人留止內房，毀人倫之叙，亂男女之節；恭孝日虧，悖慠滋甚，不可以承天緒，奉宗廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "d7b365b77eeb22fef238c75bf15acded496ce550ecca0483b56a0c73a9ad2761"}

{"id": "p_056b582873f76e86", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 89, "text": "使兼太尉高柔奉策，用一元大武告于宗廟，遣芳歸藩于齊，以避皇位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "b2afdb084390f5cce6099a50cbcf25a2adcfa5f460629fd9188c5e9780876352"}

{"id": "p_99d6515802adc3e0", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 90, "text": "」是日遷居別宮，年二十三。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "09cf55e1af5fd4a687584cd39bf133980ef150c15e0c5b62b5268e6a0c31878c"}

{"id": "p_6bbf94d16ec04359", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 91, "text": "使者持節送衞，營齊王宮於河內重門，制度皆如藩國之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "5364e27b690326ee79f4891f6fd90c8a28a58e3e06d925041a6138d86260a066"}

{"id": "p_1bb6aaaa4b3763b2", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 92, "text": "丁丑，令曰：「東海王霖，高祖文皇帝之子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "fe2e008bb0de325c0affa47dda83764298034b42bdb1449ad8a624c92dbc5b22"}

{"id": "p_704fc09ee540c59d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 93, "text": "霖之諸子，與國至親，高貴鄉公髦有大成之量，其以為明皇帝嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "4aaa31b45215565c511b98e8a13284a82fe60ffb8c913492ea7b0ca973001eb3"}

{"id": "p_f6414669747e5298", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 94, "text": "高貴鄉公諱髦，字彥士，文帝孫，東海定王霖子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "98501c5928f5ee54d385aaffc972627f9f9990a68f71203bf8c22d20678965ff"}

{"id": "p_7d0cafcbe22dcc5d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 95, "text": "十月己丑，公至于玄武館，羣臣奏請舍前殿，公以先帝舊處，避止西廂；羣臣又請以法駕迎，公不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "92ff22643c2a2c7f79a0c34288d09469a56bd14fe0ace10adc6435336990e530"}

{"id": "p_5ff35663cb86920c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 96, "text": "庚寅，公入于洛陽，羣臣迎拜西掖門南，公下輿將荅拜，儐者請曰：「儀不拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "db64d11fac164776caf8170ef8bada6d86257c724c955260d380d88b3d7cdf2f"}

{"id": "p_663398957a22d58f", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」公曰：「吾被皇太后徵，未知所為！", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "99a21d70654e9a6e178c62cba340ef104ac5505c0a598cad8af9175e5717067f"}

{"id": "p_c9f8e246b7ec8ffb", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」遂步至太極東堂，見于太后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "a84febb4b4a9c183a7d1331e16d6da2a7571d80828d8a5c7d94076e6a9d25129"}

{"id": "p_9b21c7bc76fb3509", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 99, "text": "其日即皇帝位於太極前殿，百寮陪位者欣欣焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "d499321d695c2c2bef09eccb68c2269663669cce35b2d829b3d226f57b70b3a4"}

{"id": "p_f46047da7fe73ade", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 100, "text": "減乘輿服御後宮用度，及罷尚方御府百工技巧靡麗無益之物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "e0e418a671fe121e659335d7f1922811531d1579414fe652958c9e2c36060d06"}

{"id": "p_44a449edc9f6c7c6", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 101, "text": "冬十月壬辰，遣侍中持節分適四方，觀風俗，勞士民，察冤枉失職者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "0fb4367acdddb7b92ec79c109dab8f19f18ed3a3f904340fc8799287d2423d0f"}

{"id": "p_946dd1fef0dbfba4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 102, "text": "癸巳，假大將軍司馬景王黃鉞，入朝不趨，奏事不名，劒履上殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "ecc420ced513e55c881207635acc7ed88e52924afd46d0037d34e439c1b4580e"}

{"id": "p_d6e7ffcc9fd7cb87", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 103, "text": "甲辰，命有司論廢立定策之功，封爵、增邑、進位、班賜各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "28b7f6f385d98ca129fda71f652d359a4fcf6fb068212b1c956edc74637aa9d2"}

{"id": "p_d179fea549f83f93", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 104, "text": "二年春正月乙丑，鎮東將軍毌丘儉、楊州刺史文欽反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "bfe643282645ad8a4422b7004a11da8343e10d64aacc70d79710b301eb3adba5"}

{"id": "p_3a45297d3ec09be5", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 105, "text": "戊，大將軍司馬景王征之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "278aa49024175782e717772a318d6a8c58aa62dd5f17355c24bac585a0c07d1c"}

{"id": "p_221a385caf717d97", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 106, "text": "甲辰，安風都尉斬儉，傳首京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "5d7c1bbef4ebc6041bded645e2e94d4b516b414943798ffbb5a4159e13a7ce66"}

{"id": "p_dce9d7504a608e74", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 107, "text": "壬子，復特赦淮南士民諸為儉、欽所詿誤者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "9e2dfcf58a71bc22e72f384a9a075fe26444463edd59e88bc09a8964313ad2a9"}

{"id": "p_35b693e59090e18f", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 108, "text": "以鎮南將軍諸葛誕為鎮東大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "d72ee99c710bace3ec4ad0bdd10418d918d1c6032fab435f08d466b652f3dc28"}

{"id": "p_76a51de31980b4eb", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 109, "text": "二月丁巳，以衞將軍司馬文王為大將軍，錄尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "861e694d0fb08339f47bd5aef5c87c4856e259f40ebc19063a5dc3d5ef8294d5"}

{"id": "p_4c3f2c4ac8fab746", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 110, "text": "甲子，吳大將孫峻等衆號十萬至壽春，諸葛誕拒擊破之，斬吳左將軍留贊，獻捷于京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "21bbde31ddcf0de1f9def786d457674b47d0a39b3e211a962519201fecc0efa4"}

{"id": "p_6972a510ad816f51", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 111, "text": "三月，立皇后卞氏，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "e7427d29962740144c016dcc643fdca81f9063381e479caca627fa292982bea4"}

{"id": "p_cfd482e401e6dbb3", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 112, "text": "夏四月甲寅，封后父卞隆為列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "b58eebd463539b25bbdc7f829bf883a5bda218176ce713996a64d0144752f0be"}

{"id": "p_3797158a86fc2a18", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 113, "text": "甲戌，以征南大將軍王昶為驃騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "cc36a7964b6b050d64d9ac9e4ba374f99aa0a1e05dc0342afcb3f0485604cc4a"}

{"id": "p_a8bb05fd64c7663e", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 114, "text": "秋七月，以征東大將軍胡遵為衞將軍，鎮東大將軍諸葛誕為征東大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "ed2ddb37b29271984a6ca0e61f4f09cc6170edc3544b2519514879b5f96beaa6"}

{"id": "p_534a9609955a355d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 115, "text": "八月辛亥，蜀大將軍姜維寇狄道，雍州刺史王經與戰洮西，經大敗，還保狄道城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "f3b598c126c2499f25fae24bee1e5f140a13d3d39579ef778435e67ffa937419"}

{"id": "p_960cb76cfb240dad", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 116, "text": "辛未，以長水校尉鄧艾行安西將軍，與征西將軍陳泰并力拒維。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "fb4044cad58f17a221b2fca0b15d7ff711f655ed4aa6cedec8476d047617c7a8"}

{"id": "p_c73724f132ac8002", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 117, "text": "戊辰，復遣太尉司馬孚為後繼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "d71a33354e75c8347bd012a4bf01cf798fef95d6ffe8715144dc7b42b118bc77"}

{"id": "p_4465bb06d92ac57a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 118, "text": "九月庚子，講尚書業終，賜執經親授者司空鄭冲、侍中鄭小同等各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "396882cd086b5d5902b6b2452670912420f6d2b30fbc32e9a64e3bdfcdca9df6"}

{"id": "p_695b759c294c26e1", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 119, "text": "十一月甲午，以隴右四郡及金城連年受敵，或亡叛投賊，其親戚留在本土者不安，皆特赦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "e7c7a6c7363dfd65c256180db93dee01000472fa5f8f6efd3bab89bc8b466435"}

{"id": "p_0e0056a44d71114b", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 120, "text": "春正月辛丑，青龍見軹縣井中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "ecafee2ac48aea94f7ac36ab2124e63bc42398737cfe8384ed81d3a5f367a48e"}

{"id": "p_670718b4b1ab5ed5", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 121, "text": "夏四月庚戌，賜大將軍司馬文王衮冕之服，赤舄副焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "d5cc68a421c48e46c48a69c827456fe5edf7f9e50898181ac4f2238d5dba117b"}

{"id": "p_6fc3dcf28a8f7fd7", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 122, "text": "丙辰，帝幸太學，問諸儒曰：「聖人幽贊神明，仰觀俯察，始作八卦，後聖重之為六十四，立爻以極數，凡斯大義，罔有不備，而夏有連山，殷有歸藏，周曰周易，易之書，其故何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "5e089e131c27cb1241eb48b6394f81a21042bb61935b9dce474d0264196b7578"}

{"id": "p_4be9fcd5e8846e77", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」易博士淳于俊對曰：「包羲因燧皇之圖而制八卦，神農演之為六十四，黃帝、堯、舜通其變，三代隨時，質文各繇其事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "f2733c6b6ea4f73f2e67c5d6ff3d2400e59ce754325a42efe2b7b3e806b3ed53"}

{"id": "p_3fcd080430efeb26", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 124, "text": "故易者，變易也，名曰連山，似山出內雲氣，連天地也；歸藏者，萬事莫不歸藏於其中也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "a1237445119207a68170fdbf45f5cf17fec177ee593ca91adbceee723595c6c7"}

{"id": "p_5997e18baf0413c5", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 125, "text": "」帝又曰：「若使包羲因燧皇而作易，孔子何以不云燧人氏沒包羲氏作乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "8459c3da29f968be64aeeb127dfba602560a51a8eab264ce70848c2666289f4e"}

{"id": "p_6372397ec950411e", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 126, "text": "帝又問曰：「孔子作彖、象，鄭玄作注，雖聖賢不同，其所釋經義一也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "e69952feac30c33d985f1412002735e47e6e7bd35a5f2d2ad380647e558b982e"}

{"id": "p_15100015f27eb4e9", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 127, "text": "今彖、象不與經文相連，而注連之，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "14169b16e7a28e7fce75542f98bb7e3beae294346e2e687b3a42f100bf30e253"}

{"id": "p_6e106d3f6eaa75cb", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 128, "text": "」俊對曰；「鄭玄合彖、象於經者，欲使學者尋省易了也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "381e21cf7cf598927dd912632339e67cc17ff15d0357745ad4da1fd405f176bb"}

{"id": "p_91a03e1c4df13a81", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 129, "text": "」帝曰：「若鄭玄合之，於學誠便，則孔子曷為不合以了學者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "fbe7606de3b85a3ddb104a8145af6b3deff3d110e3f8e7ceb4b57e1fd453cb7b"}

{"id": "p_e26591c6ed491851", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 130, "text": "」俊對曰：「孔子恐其與文王相亂，是以不合，此聖人以不合為謙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "11c500f7dbaee9af8843a7b81209aed87e6dbc384558cc96dc58e56be2bbedf4"}

{"id": "p_3a714db516247f0e", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 131, "text": "」帝曰：「若聖人以不合為謙，則鄭玄何獨不謙邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "aeda09871ac04a690aef424105cdf261b48189d68762e7aac31df4baec028579"}

{"id": "p_ec14120eb234341d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」俊對曰：「古義弘深，聖問奧遠，非臣所能詳盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "bca1e5bcd11c9cc41c4ca2b2ab5f18aecce1a6bd55fc6f38ef2bfcd0aecc13a5"}

{"id": "p_93c0f1a7efe6910c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 133, "text": "」帝又問曰：「繫辭云『黃帝、堯、舜垂衣裳而天下治』，此包羲、神農之世為無衣裳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "e96d7b08d5a10856881572beeea19c1c32bd079ff97f0ca6f119e2a882ccbe67"}

{"id": "p_67c7dbbda8d7463f", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 134, "text": "但聖人化天下，何殊異爾邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "5a682f894aed1a01c5bc7f5cc9bc47d449c7040de42455885772acc5145117cd"}

{"id": "p_f501489f0a03b2d4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 135, "text": "」俊對曰：「三皇之時，人寡而禽獸衆，故取其羽皮而天下用足，及至黃帝，人衆而禽獸寡，是以作為衣裳以濟時變也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "638afb511e06542a5dd8933b39e6027caab41e74e49f95a8592ffe9cbf06ad02"}

{"id": "p_708a179ca90d2abd", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 136, "text": "」帝又問：「乾為天，而復為金，為玉，為老馬，與細物並邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "3951c827c99f3b10e9af8d69c76bf0d7adb3c373aa0397c4ff4508f586c1e4e3"}

{"id": "p_aa51abd238f11bfb", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 137, "text": "」俊對曰：「聖人取象，或遠或近，近取諸物，遠則天地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "534349e84086717fb97f0dc871f657af6afe6bd39cac62c89de974838c8f4f4c"}

{"id": "p_56e5432d061a394c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 138, "text": "帝問曰：「鄭玄云『稽古同天，言堯同於天也』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "c88b2530170f218975ca817f1e0db1286f93dd1f70f69e2a28a5e64832729be6"}

{"id": "p_3f0f59fd7510e111", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 139, "text": "王肅云『堯順考古道而行之』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "c6d4719c8fe325e5c77b36fcfe667d75fe4a6cbce044c502ec238afcfb1dfa06"}

{"id": "p_315eae6447812644", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」博士庾峻對曰：「先儒所執，各有乖異，臣不足以定之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "9e0a19fb4354ac3543c0f06b774fca599e63690a084c7ab7b502eb0005c32cc3"}

{"id": "p_ba504e486f7b1896", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 141, "text": "然洪範稱『三人占，從二人之言』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "e607c971e16ceb4a093cd17c193708880b42d296fdaf9ece78361be21ffed4b1"}

{"id": "p_a345066a75206420", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 142, "text": "賈、馬及肅皆以為『順考古道』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "3707e4d5dadb4f091e4788e2c68b6f81d6cd8fab5849787cf11cc8066b73f6f5"}

{"id": "p_5ce257bc98e0a091", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 143, "text": "」帝曰：「仲尼言『唯天為大，唯堯則之』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "0d4dece036050baab304d9732d2295cc1645d69f97cb42acc3a36f5f24f5f880"}

{"id": "p_2ccc0fbe8802104d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 144, "text": "堯之大美，在乎則天，順考古道，非其至也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "e6d870a130233d3e424f6618ee8946da28749424a4e8e0952355ed4cdb89e5c1"}

{"id": "p_b6d2e162735c70b1", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 145, "text": "今發篇開義以明聖德，而舍其大，更稱其細，豈作者之意邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "e290de001f502da5608009e78a833b0b346304fb20fea1279af1f3fdf20819eb"}

{"id": "p_5fa6a2b755440a3c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」峻對曰：「臣奉遵師說，未喻大義，至於折中，裁之聖思。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "6307d2000565cc4b5ff07306cde2454c7738734dc17e956247edd67e74183b06"}

{"id": "p_82354502920798a1", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」次及四嶽舉鯀，帝又問曰：「夫大人者，與天地合其德，與日月合其明，思無不周，明無不照，今王肅云『堯意不能明鯀，是以試用』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "765ab66596a81153e659d8854394bc44c525f75ce9dccde3b5905c71695ac3a8"}

{"id": "p_aa20f7638cb692e8", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 148, "text": "如此，聖人之明有所未盡邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "02d032c013517162032924bc840e6c93110c5be0143681fbdb0f54f4cca94980"}

{"id": "p_3f12c2917bc9ecc5", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 149, "text": "」峻對曰：「雖聖人之弘，猶有所未盡，故禹曰『知人則哲，惟帝難之』，然卒能改授聖賢，緝熈庶績，亦所以成聖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "270f947d4244dd53444057b98aaa0888956abfb515602afda39fc1411a146ce1"}

{"id": "p_ba6a71cbf046a7d1", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」帝曰：「夫有始有卒，其唯聖人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "cd156882340a4bda91dc621fd950f15a3a6de7cc659b8b0150e4267d33fe7eb7"}

{"id": "p_dfc210c13a1b0136", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 151, "text": "其言『惟帝難之』，然卒能改授，蓋謂知人，聖人所難，非不盡之言也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "660faecfb8bff44b9e71e329c6c2352b2658e1a28e252c04433a66daaac27bf1"}

{"id": "p_2804eada69ba7789", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 152, "text": "經云：『知人則哲，能官人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "5370b308a47597aa421d704ce5615ceee149f796a9f8b667288a4d45e2afe686"}

{"id": "p_faaaeb277e372de0", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 153, "text": "』若堯疑鯀，試之九年，官人失叙，何得謂之聖哲？", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "10bc2da55aa6ba2c0497ed12349c5a59cf4a2989fe70ae2378dd5a918fdab013"}

{"id": "p_3fe96a7c83cd3203", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」峻對曰：「臣竊觀經傳，聖人行事不能無失，是以堯失之四凶，周公失之二叔，仲尼失之宰予。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "b3843939f1fe7237831293d5d601884420603ff9cb884a0bfd6775b3786f64e0"}

{"id": "p_fbdb7c1c7b789ff5", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 155, "text": "」帝曰：「堯之任鯀，九載無成，汨陳五行，民用昏墊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "2ce7725821b0329bef460d81d27df9d2b62a6f4257008d29a642f8fa80b44091"}

{"id": "p_fd3acc9870e4f162", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 156, "text": "至於仲尼失之宰予，言行之間，輕重不同也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "ee6a7087d6cf202d3edd2cdf888a9acd5fee77835f7bc1fe8c10abb238fe3ca7"}

{"id": "p_1fb36aac151cb78a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 157, "text": "至於周公、管、蔡之事，亦尚書所載，皆博士所當通也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "4bcff1fd7faf5aa2bf46c5e22555b4bb76364423098494f6a22090f576d60e15"}

{"id": "p_8cd3609783fc8069", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 158, "text": "」峻對曰：「此皆先賢所疑，非臣寡見所能究論。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "7577e1deecc88a5ed6d3c24e42840bfbebc4aa412cb2e992a3cf9b8a0d63319a"}

{"id": "p_22865dc9b732e585", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 159, "text": "」次及「有鰥在下曰虞舜」，帝問曰：「當堯之時，洪水為害，四凶在朝，宜速登賢聖濟斯民之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "a7942a0fd9007e0f7aa42243f8da664459e578bd9ca1285d57a6874d61a78182"}

{"id": "p_5cae42f57d9e0bbc", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 160, "text": "舜年在旣立，聖德光明，而乆不進用，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "4da4d73b10ec3686f764f12bda41b3fe355954b24a8c734da985c43e0ab07f3e"}

{"id": "p_84d8760019bbb5b3", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 161, "text": "」峻對曰：「堯咨嗟求賢，欲遜己位，嶽曰『否德忝帝位』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "e7304d1b6353ade3df0fec1702e66f946f0295239ed3fb2d0d7f721850760798"}

{"id": "p_0e0e75e77f572ec2", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 162, "text": "堯復使嶽揚舉仄陋，然後薦舜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "9915e9d5dd6b935aec4ea03021103f0224829bd56e3edc19220638c0293e77bb"}

{"id": "p_f5e325fe9f93a298", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 163, "text": "薦舜之本，實由於堯，此蓋聖人欲盡衆心也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "96e97eee30b1813f4a01809aec67a565d053dfaf83ee6e4e400cac0cc81961df"}

{"id": "p_8cd7c5231b37d9ad", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 164, "text": "」帝曰：「堯旣聞舜而不登用，又時忠臣亦不進達，乃使獄揚仄陋而後薦舉，非急於用聖恤民之謂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "33eb02be7e4ed7f196cb5900a0606bf4a2ca522f3fae16a7ff756b6ebaa9006e"}

{"id": "p_197025c6c6b8b91b", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 165, "text": "」峻對曰：「非臣愚見所能逮及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "707acba47be743b71854411ee6f4fd7ecb3834202def2644e65cb21c43a7b60f"}

{"id": "p_0bd670b7239ceb78", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 166, "text": "帝問曰：「『太上立德，其次務施報』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "00924f51167a3caab8d36763336bafe25f9fc5da530ceb9fe5abee650150515f"}

{"id": "p_fb80497192197e13", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 167, "text": "為治何由而教化各異；皆脩何政而能致於立德，施而不報乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "1b6137430634ff492187123f62c9b64c281878c679e2a0c19a1f411740299dae"}

{"id": "p_f3f555778cd39618", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 168, "text": "」博士馬照對曰：「太上立德，謂三皇五帝之世以德化民，其次報施，謂三王之世以禮為治也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "eb392cf3341e6e9563de3a23a9eabe76d16a6ab3340e7a56cc0116f0bfed90be"}

{"id": "p_e6ce771949e2da25", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 169, "text": "」帝曰：「二者致化薄厚不同，將主有優劣邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "51b55d24cc33b1f96238159f2c4ae942bb7d9db231ab98c81b5b5bb0d7c8532a"}

{"id": "p_c562e6efb31bc0d2", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 170, "text": "」照對曰：「誠由時有樸文，故化有薄厚也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "f0c72be3fe3c9e04276cf10336a011aa7d37e6036a8fc2767fdb2d9b3c158a11"}

{"id": "p_14c0b03a78119044", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 171, "text": "五月，鄴及上洛並言甘露降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "ae6d4545fecb7e1c128682488db929b527bc1826b47090f1ce072190425ab6c6"}

{"id": "p_59a8f7c1df032bc8", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 172, "text": "夏六月丙午，改元為甘露。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "672e867f283c34815a32f05d2568a4d7910a423a7402bff03e3e23fcd0250b30"}

{"id": "p_3320524a608f47bd", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 173, "text": "乙丑，青龍見元城縣界井中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "24e72e6f52da22610d29215848fba1421d234b6c8cb3b34c7be6b7a4acd15578"}

{"id": "p_3202ec0bc25ad4e4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 174, "text": "秋七月己卯，衞將軍胡遵薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "2dfc9cf29b2f8201bd1d81e15ae05bb120e4a0741a5d2b8096fb289e1bf098a1"}

{"id": "p_af905c08f36e1c7d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 175, "text": "癸未，安西將軍鄧艾大破蜀大將姜維於上邽，詔曰：「」", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "6de840d64780787bd3f2adf302a600567eb5887dbbbfab25dd7048ea4d8d88a1"}

{"id": "p_0dc19d48b5898baf", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 176, "text": "八月庚午，命大將軍司馬文王加號大都督，奏事不名，假黃鉞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "79c2b96099c831133888aa9ae7a8035e0e29ef0115ff3affc6d245c781f284f1"}

{"id": "p_a56dc92890911f1d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 177, "text": "癸酉，以太尉司馬孚為太傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "2fa6826f5a210316bed7eeb708561caa33bf4b6a395f952b56e9c76ea6279e7a"}

{"id": "p_5cbedf009f2333ce", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 178, "text": "九月，以司徒高柔為太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "513e8cd4fecabd6fdd47ee7ddfefb78a2190a442b3b33d8f0bb5bc99e145d5bb"}

{"id": "p_a13d5ad6c50b8f8a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 179, "text": "冬十月，以司空鄭沖為司徒，尚書左僕射盧毓為司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "ac2eade7dbbde7c526e1b680bddf8f339c40f723cb76ac14a9ed6f99099ea91b"}

{"id": "p_0760f028f6a5c488", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 180, "text": "二年春二月，青龍見溫縣井中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "ea3bc271340d1e9ebb4d02397c5165d6750f651df1b067ac66bd434a29bfe642"}

{"id": "p_8265cf7692fd00f9", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 181, "text": "甲子，以征東大將軍諸葛誕為司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "5ebef731686b0e347a7d10128628a4dfc54f3afcb16b2099b283c7b4ae528e6b"}

{"id": "p_a3bcdfdf351a4f4b", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 182, "text": "五月辛未，帝幸辟雍，會命羣臣賦詩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "f7948d51c450170eadbb34bfb3d0a01c29cdc36b99df9c46819d2297856fa2e8"}

{"id": "p_b02e5230f4924df0", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 183, "text": "侍中和逌、尚書陳騫等作詩稽留，有司奏免官，詔曰：「」", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "ff209a46b11eb3067c28fbc62edd58fcc195b2e702f19eddc2a1aa084ec4638a"}

{"id": "p_9292e99889b3ac59", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 184, "text": "乙亥，諸葛誕不就徵，發兵反，殺揚州刺史樂綝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "91b53749efbba7fa0532f39d2c2784e8c1f33b98bc8bd57890e0fe170c6d19fd"}

{"id": "p_102d89cc18d9b76f", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 185, "text": "丙子，赦淮南將吏士民為誕所詿誤者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "2f0cbf8d7701a13ed8a4532f0fa3fac4bc9115c5440235da1f92c32657563c78"}

{"id": "p_6947649e1ceb419c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 186, "text": "丁丑，詔曰：「」己卯，詔曰：「」", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "0a8113c9bd5c751ac8c16564f4dc4d0ba20d9594e7c5a997f1a9f6c9a4afae54"}

{"id": "p_3a177606334d836d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 187, "text": "冬十二月，吳大將全端、全懌等率衆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "cd2d9a5033ff8e4ab89cfd17cdd54bb9ac7cb7db7d4b781c7e252f8d158786c3"}

{"id": "p_c8154942574bb1e3", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 188, "text": "三年春二月，大將軍司馬文王陷壽春城，斬諸葛誕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "b33c314fadf79b1c153478fcc035bee10f5cd03d7b4f0711117b752811800e39"}

{"id": "p_bed7dd9b847f32ad", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 189, "text": "夏五月，命大將軍司馬文王為相國，封晉公，食邑八郡，加之九錫，文王前後九讓乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "d23ec35991ba2d04834d221a383b07532ade4f6495dd3e0b74d31df27ceda978"}

{"id": "p_da1fff866ac145b9", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 190, "text": "辛卯，大論淮南之功，封爵行賞各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "2e8d267b07380cc42ce37414336dfd68e50d3bee6597999afcd8974f145b79bc"}

{"id": "p_daf29206b6318159", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 191, "text": "秋八月甲戌，以驃騎將軍王昶為司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "01a306d77e82b57f47e942eb0798335593215474dc6e735ac48e51c2350a7bf5"}

{"id": "p_c8a3db74904484c9", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 192, "text": "丙寅，詔曰：「」車駕親率羣司，躬行古禮焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "98de2c13a4bea298eb9bb426b6e1a5192c8ada211376b795ae8fdd9cda20b4a4"}

{"id": "p_3158adc071fbcd13", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 193, "text": "是歲，青龍、黃龍仍見頓丘、冠軍、陽夏縣界井中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "a3692ff072eed52843c133da83a51ccf3d764232568f9b7739621e0a0618020e"}

{"id": "p_c8bffd07cd055c0a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 194, "text": "四年春正月，黃龍二，見寧陵縣界井中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "8c908af8ab0fbf14d6a1552ab94b344c3a161f9b96a022dcf24bf84e10effe79"}

{"id": "p_82694f169a0cfbe8", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 195, "text": "冬十月丙寅，分新城郡，復置上庸郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "f36ed03ae120c2a5457c362a38af7c259dab0d403ce2ae850f7e6601e3a4a658"}

{"id": "p_2aa2600d16233d5b", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 196, "text": "十一月癸卯，車騎將軍孫壹為婢所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "d39826f07d27417fc34c19b3f04de8b7d21524904a2a62c2a3611df5de26426d"}

{"id": "p_430f2caeae05e982", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 197, "text": "五年春正月朔，日有蝕之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "60bdd5320685c34c1a86faf4482bbb03660c1f21bfb4d2e5d04d5b1db2eef9ba"}

{"id": "p_6b46b3eb901860d9", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 198, "text": "夏四月，詔有司率遵前命，復進大將軍司馬文王位為相國，封晉公，加九錫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "30880a3247a0835c5c6e04199abaeb200beb792f99101fbae216dd4564ad6140"}

{"id": "p_e51f665a1fd88530", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 199, "text": "五月己丑，高貴鄉公卒，年二十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "21a0c29d3baf2bf02eb51e424375c2ec4a0209804ddd08a03c738eb56860fe2f"}
