{"id": "p_9cc93721d3e20ebf", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 200, "text": "皇太后令曰：「吾以不德，遭家不造，昔援立東海王子髦，以為明帝嗣，見其好書疏文章，兾可成濟，而情性暴戾，日月滋甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "93fcced51da2778b0f7b9fcda5cecb05800c68b4ef6ccf75ea643811d93769bd"}

{"id": "p_164595fd8b28a67e", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 201, "text": "吾數呵責，遂更忿恚，造作醜逆不道之言以誣謗吾，遂隔絕兩宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "b8237c976296684a55bdecfcafde3c5dfba114f89a8c8ac9190dc431cd2aa676"}

{"id": "p_8d4e7cd96fe11874", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 202, "text": "其所言道，不可忍聽，非天地所覆載。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "0e795f1d5c2d86e2f593f7b3e2d1a23654665001539036e04536b7978e0414fa"}

{"id": "p_173d809b1cee027c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 203, "text": "吾即密有令語大將軍，不可以奉宗廟，恐顛覆社稷，死無面目以見先帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "34f8f8c3a5dac1e7b2756cbdef2ee88b32fc2cd6d087dd03a620ac612127197e"}

{"id": "p_27f6411f4a52f011", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 204, "text": "大將軍以其尚幼，謂當改心為善，殷勤執據。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "a5047f0eabe2f9c8f3787a8301892eee4f3c9afb4aab3a54ab8883919a5eec7f"}

{"id": "p_79744d2a0e607dc9", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 205, "text": "而此兒忿戾，所行益甚，舉弩遙射吾宮，祝當令中吾項，箭親墮吾前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "9d81f9014ab3e49b1d5639290eab55c59138a889aa8a00cbe811bd4e1feb7c42"}

{"id": "p_450bf3f0d20b4c3e", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 206, "text": "吾語大將軍，不可不廢之，前後數十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "a0e98322a1afc2d7e0be14f4ee1d32b1e546b3db82462fdb35555690eb0371bf"}

{"id": "p_7f987d2747222763", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 207, "text": "此兒具聞，自知罪重，便圖為弒逆，賂遺吾左右人，令因吾服藥，密行酖毒，重相設計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "b18419024a77b05811c86e910d560eb00b3f9c5001bac6809d5096f8d4b8ba7b"}

{"id": "p_beccd3ef1232c10b", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 208, "text": "事已覺露，直欲因際會舉兵入西宮殺吾，出取大將軍，呼侍中王沈、散騎常侍王業、尚書王經，出懷中黃素詔示之，言今日便當施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "59d4ad5444bcea19581056e7df1194ea4ff5b64d3423c365ff2de832afba4211"}

{"id": "p_c613fb451cd80c87", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 209, "text": "吾老寡，豈復多惜餘命邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "9a984357d978984f5260f5f2eb8c047628a6c69834c729985355914f87b62fce"}

{"id": "p_c28827072c0205e3", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 210, "text": "但傷先帝遺意不遂，社稷顛覆為痛耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "1b988f061bc3b87818e2652dc600f1a7ae9f623e472829461600270205eb245c"}

{"id": "p_c0bae6e9d6be6252", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 211, "text": "賴宗廟之靈，沈、業即馳語大將軍，得先嚴警，而此兒便將左右出雲龍門，雷戰鼓，躬自拔刃，與左右雜衞共入兵陣間，為前鋒所害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "5a3abbf1b1c4862f3875ee9469a191f341f3b72cf41439b10b3a643d41bd71bf"}

{"id": "p_3e4b71b38a3091a1", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 212, "text": "此兒旣行悖逆不道，而又自陷大禍，重令吾悼心不可言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "bb60c7ca09a52a8e803ec5da8bd82250412b8846a6837ce67775e15e0e5ef655"}

{"id": "p_49e572e5f05e461c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 213, "text": "昔漢昌邑王以罪廢為庶人，此兒亦宜以民禮葬之，當令內外咸知此兒所行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "357a24303cb8f284299322e6010dbaff62c4a8b118ffdd40d8b0bdb3c3cd5197"}

{"id": "p_40111c45de9f47c8", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 214, "text": "又尚書王經，凶逆無狀，其收經及家屬皆詣廷尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "8a1d8b0ba687daffc1a5bc1cfc56e474918662d1322efdc2ec825c724599631f"}

{"id": "p_c58f65f9cc9bc48f", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 215, "text": "庚寅，太傅孚、大將軍文王、太尉柔、司徒沖稽首言：「伏見中令，故高貴鄉公悖逆不道，自陷大禍，依漢昌邑王罪廢故事，以民禮葬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "0ca296ec1d94b62e5ffecbee5db516418517bf8081949bc589c51439cc655089"}

{"id": "p_034272af25cfeb06", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 216, "text": "臣等備位，不能匡救禍亂，式遏姦逆，奉令震悚，肝心悼慄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "7be2c4e58dc84bbad2f9b6501aeaec1d5bf8064c9c87a07dda168e4ab4878bec"}

{"id": "p_772d551415ad8c51", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 217, "text": "春秋之義，王者無外，而書『襄王出居于鄭』，不能事母，故絕之於位也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "d8997801838035113e37ed3b6913eaccc1aecad89ed29489f7a87f4ee9d2f33d"}

{"id": "p_0b8bbb2ee6dee458", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 218, "text": "今高貴鄉公肆行不軌，幾危社稷，自取傾覆，人神所絕，葬以民禮，誠當舊典。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "2ea73519877cf0d0e9cd51238ea5d5f7d7c504f0ebf45ff7ce3ebfb0e0a1c486"}

{"id": "p_d54023591b6bb6e4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 219, "text": "然臣等伏惟殿下仁慈過隆，雖存大義，猶垂哀矜，臣等之心實有不忍，以為可加恩以王禮葬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "7e21821bcc07ab16a46ac551f4574f3603e899099eb6e7b34aa3a2c29ad488ef"}

{"id": "p_11a6b5b85eb0e941", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 220, "text": "使使持節行中護軍中壘將軍司馬炎北迎常道鄉公璜嗣明帝後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "d98c00385d51531500fcfa669bc5710a9b5b9c124378cbef1aa3d7b2e0a6bf21"}

{"id": "p_5c8315a0853bf59c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 221, "text": "辛卯，羣公奏太后曰：「殿下聖德光隆，寧濟六合，而猶稱令，與藩國同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "6b2b96d3a50d442b75669cb5b082cb6b4cbdb6705ee0fc9ac5d7e208f976b94f"}

{"id": "p_7b3cb114fddc2776", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 222, "text": "請自今殿下令書，皆稱詔制，如先代故事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "1ab4dbaf123ff6a4850147b617eb17b1e98d3c94199078b449d38c2dd0954b8c"}

{"id": "p_19df92dbd46bad52", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 223, "text": "癸卯，大將車固讓相國、晉公、九錫之寵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "c92edc64d160aba748732610bd212e2f53e1d472ef41a6703dc1b4905866e552"}

{"id": "p_0a8c99783d280492", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 224, "text": "戊申，大將軍文王上言：「高貴鄉公率將從駕人兵，拔刃鳴金鼓向臣所止；懼兵刃相接，即勑將士不得有所傷害，違令以軍法從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "fff64f7bdedcbce098d7aa00558dc65fcbb4b9d650413638d693a44de6f9c108"}

{"id": "p_82a9f2ae88abf1c2", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 225, "text": "騎督成倅弟太子舍人濟，橫入兵陣傷公，遂至隕命；輙收濟行軍法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "7f26334ab1038fc73771d594f6b655664d3fe1f0ff748195cd86dd47b59b0e00"}

{"id": "p_02e2c7e8737cf0ef", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 226, "text": "臣聞人臣之節，有死無二，事上之義，不敢逃難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "3f3dc1f9bd9e03cbac7123209c262cb58cdd3cdf1ce940aa07946b6378267e59"}

{"id": "p_e9921019367ebc5c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 227, "text": "前者變故卒至，禍同發機，誠欲委身守死，唯命所裁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "527fa3408c9d2a056560399a896466bc236b88693a74b5437047cc713a45bc53"}

{"id": "p_2470b2814a9e74ac", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 228, "text": "然惟本謀乃欲上危皇太后，傾覆宗廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "0d200c8b63de3e425751897cde720c33f628c61128599036715bf2c6a2494007"}

{"id": "p_f66571d10efaa211", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 229, "text": "臣忝當大任，義在安國，懼雖身死，罪責彌重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "ed6f0c8e2f2f24fa6aa868e64b872a0ab92037e933070006d8695e1ad1acdce5"}

{"id": "p_9a354a3027852c04", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 230, "text": "欲遵伊、周之權，以安社稷之難，即駱驛申勑，不得迫近輦輿，而濟遽入陣間，以致大變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "9e06fb719476eee1fe6b8acbef5f6126ea58ce41eae619aa785f38fb16e15365"}

{"id": "p_d1c97e0a50b4e773", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 231, "text": "哀怛痛恨，五內摧裂，不知何地可以隕墜？", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "82cbfe61d7b3defe0868649fa23c3d212c800d0fd6fcc8292fdb5244e5b514e3"}

{"id": "p_f8129a676efe7beb", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 232, "text": "科律大逆無道，父母妻子同產皆斬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "67eab6b8f815d360910d2fea6507ce4198ca429be9869aaa529983cc797fa411"}

{"id": "p_b2ef97e8549cece4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 233, "text": "濟凶戾悖逆，干國亂紀，罪不容誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "d6b0f6ee27e794d825ca440988fb9efa46b2fb62acdc0a897934ff3a3e9e9089"}

{"id": "p_0d2d4e2c16c40fe4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 234, "text": "輒勑侍御史收濟家屬，付廷尉，結正其罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "2be319753cfc88476300ccdfaa57d85770c3ea58084ebabf3607340f621989a8"}

{"id": "p_f9a055e3dae8114c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 235, "text": "陳留王諱奐，字景明，武帝孫，燕王宇子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "ccf6a8874520208993e8b064b71932ed89116cf1149435faaab8e85c7b6ca0d7"}

{"id": "p_9d8e9ba041f06653", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 236, "text": "高貴鄉公卒，公卿議迎立公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "38cac4cbd899ff3a70020739ea14e0b1e9af8187f0c8845d0bc8d5cb809a6436"}

{"id": "p_01e4f1aa6028619c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 237, "text": "六月甲寅，入于洛陽，見皇太后，是日即皇帝位於太極前殿，大赦，改年，賜民爵及穀帛各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "45f39d66c3a56c62107948214f7638f5e205b049af49de26445d222f21b9e3f9"}

{"id": "p_aba61b17132932a6", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 238, "text": "夏六月丙辰，進大將軍司馬文王位為相國，封晉公，增封二郡，并前滿十，加九錫之禮，一如前詔；諸羣從子弟，其未有侯者皆封亭侯，賜錢千萬，帛萬匹，文王固讓乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "b53e5aa40bb630578c28b7dd4bc8dab7282f11e4b0ce19a5acb5ac40013ae598"}

{"id": "p_bdc06a42707781f6", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 239, "text": "己未，故漢獻帝夫人節薨，帝臨于華林園，使使持節追謚夫人為獻穆皇后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "62209a8d0476657e0f2099c550eb54086c6f55a10ec6dff4080aa0c258d98b50"}

{"id": "p_f6f5b35fe16aa828", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 240, "text": "及葬，車服制度皆如漢氏故事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "54753fdf062cab692de236aef0f02cb25129a535ff8c45997dfbaa01cb7e7533"}

{"id": "p_783e0cf01062693e", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 241, "text": "癸亥，以尚書右僕射王觀為司空，冬十月，觀薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "85410575b62e2451f45d6726cd6282e2a1ee8afde05a8d640e3602bdcf36f701"}

{"id": "p_4d5bbfcd9791be24", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 242, "text": "十一月，燕王上表賀冬至，稱臣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "9131305bdab6b9a33e8d91af25d031f2b08a0ddababfef85e20fe2d5cc0c0208"}

{"id": "p_259729733dedc293", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 243, "text": "十二月甲申，黃龍見華陰縣井中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "ca0cc8c096327f79e2b2118ea323f82bf7e761c62e2669aac41ce110df75369b"}

{"id": "p_884cf63d96e829d2", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 244, "text": "甲午，以司隷校尉王祥為司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "1e73d1dea32ef2afe029852aa28691aed3a187db6298c56bd79ea91846a9b2d7"}

{"id": "p_1c45ce0a0ca8c8df", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 245, "text": "二年夏五月朔，日有蝕之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "a0937220de7288140021482821589d7a33dc2d1f45793da3631499980ef1c679"}

{"id": "p_73abca9537eb16b9", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 246, "text": "秋七月，樂浪外夷韓、濊貊各率其屬來朝貢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "f0fac2f040d033ace9f3af198fd07aeb372751d49f19120d859cac26ad768b50"}

{"id": "p_02e546651741078c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 247, "text": "甲寅，復命大將軍進爵晉公，加位相國，備禮崇錫，一如前詔；又固辭乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "8abfce249c07e373c28f99608cebaabb6070636563aa4b5ab653628a98e5f6d7"}

{"id": "p_728d8dc47a2d448a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 248, "text": "三年春二月，青龍見於軹縣井中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "ccca13eaee8a1bff519a61c46a4217670575607f032105a0b1816acf4c8aab03"}

{"id": "p_2c8b534e3d570bfc", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 249, "text": "夏四月，遼東郡言肅慎國遣使重譯入貢，獻其國弓三十張，長三尺五寸，楛矢長一尺八寸，石砮三百枚，皮骨鐵雜鎧二十領，貂皮四百枚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "045d7d22ba7a807e2c0da44860ab82a8b4935be70f3dae79dd24edbfdc3053dd"}

{"id": "p_527ddeead61e7912", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 250, "text": "冬十月，蜀大將姜維寇洮陽，鎮西將軍鄧艾拒之，破維於侯和，維遁走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "04e2c5f40c9d0f0720f6fb07d8248db5c26ae774d72dca0e8e2473d0e46b920b"}

{"id": "p_ac6f587fdb999920", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 251, "text": "是歲，詔祀故軍祭酒郭嘉於太祖廟庭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "e4f32887b94cce896e6961423adb0144c4ba09fa6d776d2c7dccba94c8efbd27"}

{"id": "p_8e7698c3b5d69a71", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 252, "text": "四年春二月，復命大將軍進位爵賜一如前詔，又固辭乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "b1f8bcb3ed6c2bce44ec05e3b3bed3060f4a6305e7f0d1f42e72ea523ec42e47"}

{"id": "p_2f9241368e8ce3f4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 253, "text": "夏五月，詔曰：「」又命鎮西將軍鍾會由駱谷伐蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "b7227cefe8260cff373125bd2363c1af3fd65e9c8eb8416d2b6186b5c49f5f2f"}

{"id": "p_0ae5580ae45f8478", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 254, "text": "冬十月甲寅，復命大將軍進位爵賜一如前詔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "bb158a1f077c62e0395fde5b6b6acc36ce86006703d8e53c21df355ebe8d8ddf"}

{"id": "p_89779377c76f0241", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 255, "text": "癸卯，立皇后卞氏，十一月，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "b513dc7a79b0b5be1cc4203406d2c86debb7bc7753ff7b139050d6380740aaf6"}

{"id": "p_4d2b790b6effc161", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 256, "text": "自鄧艾、鍾會率衆伐蜀，所至輙克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "8b40b408a10cc7da79845d08af9124e1143eb87ee89d4768e1330d043d4d0a70"}

{"id": "p_e59aba8b5ae49d56", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 257, "text": "是月，蜀主劉禪詣艾降，巴蜀皆平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "0d98eeebbfc9ae1c4663653aaa49a15bd4ae9b9ae50e5f63ee130ed0a6d34812"}

{"id": "p_34fb32b45d2fa08c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 258, "text": "十二月庚戌，以司徒鄭沖為太保。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "77ab0bf87c7ea6610552d13fbd8e2042717dd972595392d76ecbcf8ffa6764b5"}

{"id": "p_51d6adb615803cee", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 259, "text": "癸丑，特赦益州士民，復除租賦之半五年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "1ad88d9f4bdf1df2e1b98f5ea1569b4b88540fd8a0a259f809a4b409ba85b180"}

{"id": "p_6b6c708e9ae2f733", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 260, "text": "乙卯，以征西將軍鄧艾為太尉，鎮西將軍鍾會為司徒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "4a451032d0bf9d49a7e95eca8e51fa4c6e55351e871b040ca2b9b904cbccfe9b"}

{"id": "p_14f108f1ce79ea69", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 261, "text": "春正月壬戌，檻車徵鄧艾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "7fc3b8925af7317399bcce1eedc985a43ef80ab8c617b4e2d25fa932f18f7372"}

{"id": "p_141f60e8f667f8aa", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 262, "text": "壬申，使使者以璧幣祀華山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "5fbcaf80cc6b018cb53e394a53bbd4c5571571927ae82a67cdb31f291477c18e"}

{"id": "p_a026f8c722622dbe", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 263, "text": "是月，鍾會反於蜀，為衆所討；鄧艾亦見殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "92cecbbb29c70014568e46d0a8df3d49f498fc9eabe8487674a66df7a6dfb23c"}

{"id": "p_cec7f3dace0a985f", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 264, "text": "二月辛卯，特赦諸在益土者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "307e201ff6a4d67abf0e26267fd3a8b698d8ab3a62c71b0227a59292880507be"}

{"id": "p_66fd4c90e2b57567", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 265, "text": "三月丁丑，以司空王祥為太尉，征北將軍何曾為司徒，尚書左僕射荀顗為司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "17ec9d680581b66a2127079b61c45ce4f349747f3af7f906372826cfadc91e64"}

{"id": "p_56afe826dbbae98a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 266, "text": "己卯，進晉公爵為王，封十郡，并前二十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "6179c1af0fe9866e5fff2962492229718dc9b23f6cf5da4d18b3ed31f1560973"}

{"id": "p_c8d922ca0393e32a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 267, "text": "夏五月庚申，相國晉王奏復五等爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "7c57315b25c12a20b80a6b1fecbfe63eed490da8cb65b572a4d180b672f16951"}

{"id": "p_bfc2aae9feffd2c7", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 268, "text": "癸未，追命舞陽宣文侯為晉宣王，舞陽忠武侯為晉景王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "c7ccaaf83e2f86967dc07a0d729f1e5dfb88129e1b25fb43d42679496c10228d"}

{"id": "p_6fe8e74d59aca699", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 269, "text": "六月，鎮西將軍衞瓘上雍州兵於成都縣獲璧玉印各一，印文似「成信」字，依周成王歸禾之義，宣示百官，藏于相國府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "698cb08d62d7e527ceae068a8117224b95644b1fddcecbd5b77c2bb28d110a45"}

{"id": "p_0409bdf1b49b6ae6", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 270, "text": "初，自平蜀之後，吳寇屯逼永安，遣荊、豫諸軍掎角赴救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "1adc52dca371162b0c6a65dd3f195355efe4db1b4b3ebe3c31ac926ed3866316"}

{"id": "p_1e5dbeecac6acbf3", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 271, "text": "八月庚寅，命中撫軍司馬炎副貳相國事，以同魯公拜後之義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "58e860c989a4b526ecfa77773b2dfc01723f7398c76310042f717f60dc93bbc9"}

{"id": "p_078f1b4f2aa5e1fe", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 272, "text": "癸卯，以衞將軍司馬望為驃騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "db61914acd8844843cb42dd11d0c1729a233a601c3dd79532cb02f25deaa4e46"}

{"id": "p_848d37158307e650", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 273, "text": "九月戊午，以中撫軍司馬炎為撫軍大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "acc9e16eaf2f672e131dcfd79d22472ba6b9535e1115769b3abfcb7f4a419077"}

{"id": "p_5fad61c05dca5f9b", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 274, "text": "辛未，詔曰：「」策命未至，興為下人所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "00309df9456a1123e504dc76bfce50a994f141df227d441fd78b4f2136c932a4"}

{"id": "p_8ea41cb78ff75e80", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 275, "text": "丙午，命撫軍大將軍新昌鄉侯炎為晉世子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "5f3c43b493db1fe9d89eeaecda7e5f1f29333e86b8e283ccbfe1bbc248a17019"}

{"id": "p_d17a916e8f84da62", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 276, "text": "是歲，罷屯田官以均政役，諸典農皆為太守，都尉皆為令長；勸募蜀人能內移者，給廩二年，復除二十歲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "2c87466877893ad7b3b04cf3c8b10323ac3ef9ec1aff8b695bb898ce078a366f"}

{"id": "p_8831549085c414b4", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 277, "text": "安彌、福祿縣各言嘉禾生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "145a2dc5e5f3007804f1dd9d58c215b0267ce30a82e5753993a85c468986c519"}

{"id": "p_9d3e4d869ec2c26a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 278, "text": "二年春二月甲辰，朐䏰縣獲靈龜以獻，歸之于相國府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "a653050e9e699827fca67d2db1dba8d18fdf8688b61282c33536c3c89c0fea9b"}

{"id": "p_44890980bc364956", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 279, "text": "庚戌，以虎賁張脩昔於成都馳馬至諸營言鍾會反逆，以至沒身，賜脩弟倚爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "8a76e9f0fe2cf99022f7e728b4f29af679d514b0b6748f137b2790692c455d4f"}

{"id": "p_9bc7efa3aceb63cf", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 280, "text": "夏四月，南深澤縣言甘露降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "315422c8509d2e232158f0cffaa6862385cdd1787b2f4e78cf05af02d9b40fe6"}

{"id": "p_a60575d43ecd3b88", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 281, "text": "五月，詔曰：「」王固辭乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "67dfa8f54bd54711afc20d1f1e465dbe369270d8e21f6c89c26f77349e7713fd"}

{"id": "p_5c5ab3ddb7c3bc8d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 282, "text": "又命晉王冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根車、六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲䍐，樂舞八佾，設鍾虡宮縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "8d0047266f50ebaf6d0cccc887ab77b2e8b1b0d06cbd2191ab39f24dd226a867"}

{"id": "p_0bb4cc154098858d", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 283, "text": "進王妃為王后，世子為太子，王子、王女、王孫，爵命之號如舊儀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "25a918773f838a1de7b37bff2099db0cb0600b5dc0b78e76d1cac6ba51a22f5e"}

{"id": "p_4e3e8c44218dc607", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 284, "text": "秋八月辛卯，相國晉王薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "7c10cbe68288e029033fb637fd862c3312580f417d374b2b3059d8c9a476c78d"}

{"id": "p_70902ba8942efff0", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 285, "text": "壬辰，晉太子炎紹封襲位，總攝百揆，備物典冊，一皆如前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "607dace53685f870729e87de65e047612b2cf351427f90d561525991ee88e07c"}

{"id": "p_e2c27086fb9cf198", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 286, "text": "是月，襄武縣言有大人見，長三丈餘，迹長三尺二寸，白髮，著黃單衣，黃巾，柱杖，呼民王始語云：「今當太平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "38ede79c79c325042b33efbaaa5406b01d2336a2d61a64fda46010df103169ce"}

{"id": "p_49f7002c9fafedde", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 287, "text": "戊午，司徒何曾為晉丞相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "c373da2ecb54f8622a8f4805d4e18559d6ee1fcd885f3c4206161383b9148091"}

{"id": "p_925e1c8ec581ccc9", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 288, "text": "癸亥，以驃騎將軍司馬望為司徒，征東大將軍石苞為驃騎將軍，征南大將軍陳騫為車騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "758734d687e80804384e061e486c02e46b1d0592e0beb66679723c83c55c5629"}

{"id": "p_729810a368ac2619", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 289, "text": "閏月庚辰，康居、大宛獻名馬，歸于相國府，以顯懷萬國致遠之勳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "54a8f96c15ac6464881bcd9758ea86a863bb0b8350ffa73752fdc809c6bba401"}

{"id": "p_748ffb3eb77e257a", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 290, "text": "十二月壬戌，天祿永終，歷數在晉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "047a195bb0b942529798045c10f29c608547cd31b313309e194d5d9965e16b88"}

{"id": "p_1ae57e3ec583ec41", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 291, "text": "詔羣公卿士具儀設壇于南郊，使使者奉皇帝璽綬冊，禪位于晉嗣王，如漢魏故事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "95d538bee1b45cd446331255ce9b65ff8209c8ad71ca5267ee956f926237bc9a"}

{"id": "p_3ff523ed1d760a58", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 292, "text": "遂改次于金墉城，而終館于鄴，時年二十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "830631ad01731ced1e80987243ec3e8e846d33a9a23bb2ee52aec6179352404c"}

{"id": "p_8c50f6d71b808619", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 293, "text": "評曰：古者以天下為公，唯賢是與。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "e11aa82c65fcb281adcce172b4d68e7cfeaac3d2ec920781a4700b48c6c6781d"}

{"id": "p_f67fd32fc8743d9f", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 294, "text": "後代世位，立子以適；若適嗣不繼，則宜取旁親明德，若漢之文、宣者，斯不易之常準也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "d9927a27bbbda6185a380f5b51527c40be518707ce09915fe67ccf8655ddda58"}

{"id": "p_4e515704f1f4ddb0", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 295, "text": "明帝旣不能然，情繫私愛，撫養嬰孩，傳以大器，託付不專，必參枝族，終於曹爽誅夷，齊王替位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "0489a6a22f740c6479686ea9fa2d71dd70d8fade930b0105e88209ae5be86bc8"}

{"id": "p_b26537ba44b9efaa", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 296, "text": "高貴公才慧夙成，好問尚辭，蓋亦文帝之風流也；然輕躁忿肆，自蹈大禍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "473a3f64e906f1305ce619a4eb020ce6fabe713768a3aebfc750a4d0b6835433"}

{"id": "p_a21d2ec705a6013c", "source_id": "src_89aedc7875ae791a", "ordinal": 297, "text": "陳留王恭己南面，宰輔統政，仰遵前式，揖讓而禪，遂饗封大國，作賔于晉，比之山陽，班寵有加焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "05d57d88841105d17c2701dcc7ccbeebd06d73eb5d76b78e0940aeeb26c37831"}

{"id": "p_3770a6b07362c510", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 0, "text": "易稱「男正位乎外，女正位乎內；男女正，天地之大義也」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "4724f835173d1d9f6597a9d782ae07c2eb48f3f613ad18d9e2363a854e39adea"}

{"id": "p_d99860e647faf30b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 1, "text": "古先哲王，莫不明后妃之制，順天地之德，故二妃嬪媯，虞道克隆，任、姒配姬，周室用熈，廢興存亡，恆此之由。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "a5a7e95c38324a45409b1d33418ca74b1e6744c456d96412883c3caeee925ed1"}

{"id": "p_222a2d1c8e2902d7", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 2, "text": "春秋說云天子十二女，諸侯九女，考之情理，不易之典也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "ea1b0b1be8304027251829aea91fdb3a59db2ebcb408e512d0a060e2c93e7b09"}

{"id": "p_d4e421932d753ab1", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 3, "text": "而末世奢縱，肆其侈欲，至使男女怨曠，感動和氣，惟色是崇，不本淑懿，故風教陵遲而大綱毀泯，豈不惜哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "dd0d8546bbb90f19789dc7b6f22a303afbdb9e8627d6c36c76d6b292ca92fe0b"}

{"id": "p_5837e653f08db31d", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 4, "text": "嗚呼，有國有家者，其可以永鑒矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "f260a28e9e7056da1d8c0d12ba0f83172e6853f9f785c3293b434ba5da74ee18"}

{"id": "p_e3bb166df5cf9e28", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 5, "text": "漢制，帝祖母曰太皇太后，帝母曰皇太后，帝妃曰皇后，其餘內官十有四等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "d589f1de8a4e49c2c835edddbb4320cf21afbee65f661c9700d4622bb28d4867"}

{"id": "p_49ed65746017a0ef", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 6, "text": "魏因漢法，母后之號皆如舊制，自夫人以下，世有增損。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "0f0b4b62ef75737be34bafd858a6063dc3ca0ba9d7db722772600e52a9349789"}

{"id": "p_83500bcc00731262", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 7, "text": "太祖建國，始命王后，其下五等：有夫人，有昭儀，有倢伃，有容華，有美人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "0335fc85f5b0c67c16bd4cdb852820844e246269a82303189e604acb402cebd3"}

{"id": "p_726c6b5c299cfd74", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 8, "text": "文帝增貴嬪、淑媛、脩容、順成、良人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "f3c555c17f32b09fe080a8ff26fdfa352b6329ad45b87ea18daf361796448035"}

{"id": "p_e6935eab1fb2838c", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 9, "text": "明帝增淑妃、昭華、脩儀；除順成官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "9df962d429ddc98d0819560d0dc47365dec1767a7746eff276895031cbde69d3"}

{"id": "p_277dfcd9f6f8b9c0", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 10, "text": "太和中始復命夫人，登其位於淑妃之上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "32c69d6e9a206afabc097444a42b4622b76fdfb5d307d7629a4701879f7665fb"}

{"id": "p_d21f2b16fab6b80b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 11, "text": "自夫人以下爵凡十二等：貴嬪、夫人，位次皇后，爵無所視；淑妃位視相國，爵比諸侯王；淑媛位視御史大夫，爵比縣公；昭儀比縣侯；昭華比鄉侯；脩容比亭侯；脩儀比關內侯；倢伃視中二千石；容華視真二千石；美人視比二千石；良人視千石。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "4acf261e2cbe49116a4697cadd064d1b0a764f86167c06791ea5446446e4a513"}

{"id": "p_0bbdbf2ab4d75863", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 12, "text": "武宣卞皇后，琅邪開陽人，文帝母也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "df2466f1c776dba942dd9f573db178e28759a8103f3d3aeb439af595e635702d"}

{"id": "p_3112aaaa7e3d2688", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 13, "text": "本倡家，年二十，太祖於譙納后爲妾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "3f027c85e03def792dc52ce6cecfabeb1d33ca3a4dbfec1e70f8552bd00dcf05"}

{"id": "p_923d206c6ee14796", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 14, "text": "及董卓爲亂，太祖微服東出避難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "99d8da0c5c8282d1768bd1e0ad6cd27c81567dd160911f90448a51ce754c18e8"}

{"id": "p_f0afc44225757f64", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 15, "text": "袁術傳太祖凶問，時太祖左右至洛者皆欲歸，后止之曰：「曹君吉凶未可知，今日還家，明日若在，何靣目復相見也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "d328967d04f6b4943ac3651ca3e20a517d5d7e2d38277cb942d1b0e4327e1f7d"}

{"id": "p_a36475160d160d84", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 16, "text": "建安初，丁夫人廢，遂以后爲繼室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "8d96543f67f9504854e7723955474da5801649f2cf41542f221dfea11c3db4c0"}

{"id": "p_dfe6b64ebcfbb8fc", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 17, "text": "諸子無母者，太祖皆令后養之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "73d3f20d28ec36f3a91ed37f8d28233a9bd981cd321729ea9510b6eb4407e7d6"}

{"id": "p_597295a8476113a9", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 18, "text": "文帝爲太子，左右長御賀后曰：「將軍拜太子，天下莫不歡喜，后當傾府藏賞賜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "987fb2a8eb7ae23d7df34658d4d899dbf98f155496c8807d0996309daa6a851c"}

{"id": "p_b9c4a37ab3d924e1", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」后曰：「王自以丕年大，故用爲嗣，我但當以免無教導之過爲幸耳，亦何爲當重賜遺乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "51541a975daced9e9927745150ce735cd0f0f3046709591c60cf9f46d779e1a6"}

{"id": "p_ec598e0d6b7b918b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 20, "text": "太祖恱曰：「怒不變容，喜不失節，故是最爲難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "fe544866ef3597d78ba37776b1ed2ed4587ac1c5e5258de32a34e06ab878fa87"}

{"id": "p_66564c2d6986cd16", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 21, "text": "二十四年，拜爲王后，策曰：「夫人卞氏，撫養諸子，有母儀之德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "a62b2d3200c3ea9ff51be57afd7dbbaef228daa5e6231c0bfce290aa9f0874e7"}

{"id": "p_225fc8c9b6d5f6a6", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 22, "text": "今進位王后，太子諸侯陪位，羣卿上壽，減國內死罪一等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "4931bf77d10fe1e11ad2b0dd624a9ca130c11083c2f7dbe6f3256596ce82e502"}

{"id": "p_4e03df2b0ab5be51", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」二十五年，太祖崩，文帝即王位，尊后曰王太后，及踐阼，尊后曰皇太后，稱永壽宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "b37e8737e5620e58b59058fe8f207aa8efd5bab6391af9925d6b6f31d8e3b121"}

{"id": "p_2f2f700a23052b23", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 24, "text": "明帝即位，尊太后曰太皇太后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "fc927f6caa3fb02b53e538c0ac90b7d711f8a04505883b49f5b9bd575dc91838"}

{"id": "p_a8bc1c2e781a3f4d", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 25, "text": "黃初中，文帝欲追封太后父母，尚書陳羣奏曰：「陛下以聖德應運受命，創業革制，當永爲後式。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "735f1ef7b8e34e4bf080cd6609b75d4a3e0d6994af77563e8543978806d59dd7"}

{"id": "p_9b8519d8866e1c03", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 26, "text": "案典籍之文，無婦人分土命爵之制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "37c745ae8d4622b52e12fcff5f83dfa7340fc336c1b28f8cef9aa524615a3b77"}

{"id": "p_f22430979dba3ac3", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 27, "text": "秦違古法，漢氏因之，非先王之令典也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "e2fadbc489369835d00eb20c06db72c2651fe0165a1f0fdc5abfa8ebf2ba54a5"}

{"id": "p_198efe0a3f9d8a3f", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」帝曰：「此議是也，其勿施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "e93db2df02a6069afe12d1521a178e310580a23240e74ac36af1daff84e23bd5"}

{"id": "p_89e757b59d2e8fea", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 29, "text": "以作著詔下藏之臺閣，永爲後式。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "ccf8098f7ddfeaa4d1d4113105a762120a7f32280c40a20659c6bd4c7121bcdd"}

{"id": "p_71cab9d5008ccf21", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 30, "text": "」至春，明帝乃追謚太后祖父廣曰開陽恭侯，父遠曰敬侯，祖母周封陽都君及敬侯夫人，皆贈印綬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "5f1ddd8aba6df6dd991bbba036156ef6b3cfd9847ef3b695ea29bf738a99a1e4"}

{"id": "p_b791bdc301197c2a", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 31, "text": "初，太后弟秉，以功封都鄉侯，進封開陽侯，邑千二百戶，爲昭烈將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "b0a856ff40d691c1ec751591c86407999d5af0908c166588ca6f5affe5a99cf9"}

{"id": "p_41741e92a84546d7", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 32, "text": "少有才學，爲奉車都尉、游擊將軍，加散騎常侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "97ae5472a88397fbfa2523498d477c1121ff7d2ffe1a9e3f6ea985ee21e52c8b"}

{"id": "p_c73b09955caae95a", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 33, "text": "又分秉爵，封蘭弟琳爲列侯，官至步兵校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "b53cde3250e32f5ad612326f395c4acbb0bd98b9c3fed7f30ee6c35e629cdbd4"}

{"id": "p_47112cf7cfaf2bcf", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 34, "text": "蘭子隆女爲高貴鄉公皇后，隆以后父爲光祿大夫，位特進，封睢陽鄉侯，妻王爲顯陽鄉君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "c9bd93bb418e2e24c35922828ec60ef136353837b554ddfdc23927443a7c31a7"}

{"id": "p_e23884002bff43e5", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 35, "text": "追封隆前妻劉爲順陽鄉君，后親母故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "2447152799e907aa5362033782ea01f96ad4efe1dec13fb48fb97e7c862bf4b1"}

{"id": "p_56bcefc4a20b35fd", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 36, "text": "琳女又爲陳留王皇后，時琳已沒，封琳妻劉爲廣陽鄉君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "959e0b7f979deb5de5c531641ad6ccba18d170cb9d02265d360d1d959fedefb5"}

{"id": "p_7c730b910c507008", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 37, "text": "文昭甄皇后，中山無極人，明帝母，漢太保甄邯後也，世吏二千石。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "e39006e8c52977636469f00aa0558f72f790e9fbd3638a754c781872d9daf9c8"}

{"id": "p_a6500488c68ed28b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 38, "text": "後天下兵亂，加以饑饉，百姓皆賣金銀珠玉寶物，時后家大有儲谷，頗以買之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "f3ef29986a8688600fa88acf8795d948b212a8e31494ef4b15183644457b05b3"}

{"id": "p_d468fa977fc42d31", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 39, "text": "后年十餘歲，白母曰：「今世亂而多買寶物，匹夫無罪，懷璧為罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "d4bc4e08a5667865b88b4fde33e56a90da3aff0bc5803b4500dd16440a6e9d38"}

{"id": "p_b8667135894113d1", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 40, "text": "又左右皆飢乏，不如以穀振給親族鄰里，廣為恩惠也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "2fa60a2fbd5bc0067bb21ca0511253e329b275f9f1b65a6cf4840d5972237b5c"}

{"id": "p_2e849b29048e43e1", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 41, "text": "建安中，袁紹為中子熙納之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "91f06966054f0c45bc2ad4e58de00a30b0925f319e6e112318daccc2b1256c94"}

{"id": "p_aa1dfa9ea41bb904", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 42, "text": "及冀州平，文帝納后於鄴，有寵，生明帝及東鄉公主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "9a0eb766fc2657f3eefe714e62448657d6ddf015ec11036764602931afc0942a"}

{"id": "p_0c90e4ff45bb8571", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 43, "text": "正月，文帝即王位，六月，南征，后留鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "ef11661d95dd6407cc10fa1f0961486dcc8b93f468453f41dd59a155013ee086"}

{"id": "p_25edda247e688dfb", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 44, "text": "踐阼之後，山陽公奉二女以嬪於魏，郭后、李、陰貴人並愛幸，后愈失意，有怨言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "62c7aeebf31e0c61d4934e30a64d2595260cd8a9d655a341e7bf0bc6b5a36e6e"}

{"id": "p_76a15d3cdcbf5bfd", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 45, "text": "帝大怒，二年六月，遣使賜死，葬於鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "69f5efa219ab019426d435b0f0e91af7118fd4283a2d2d1cb824b2ed2b18dc2f"}

{"id": "p_595ce55f8521a2fb", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 46, "text": "明帝即位，有司奏請追諡，使司空王朗持節奉策以太牢告祠於陵，又別立寢廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "217081adbc3588e0f42e4851e82c49ec3c75c8af2098a0db9b1cc1abac58de4f"}

{"id": "p_633c92aa667973b5", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 47, "text": "三月，以中山魏昌之安城鄉戶千，追封逸，諡曰敬侯；適孫像襲爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "b26dc172bc511d1e9f2739966e77d0eed0669ca6697348c2d1f644deac7f8a3c"}

{"id": "p_baae09740709a06d", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 48, "text": "四月，初營宗廟，掘地得玉璽，方一寸九分，其文曰「天子羨思慈親」，明帝為之改容，以太牢告廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "b324f56d7a5a7f9e0ba199e91f087281b1044edb6ec373e95d6cf2ea751efb49"}

{"id": "p_019436d1e467430a", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 49, "text": "又嘗夢見后，於是差次舅氏親疏高下，敘用各有差，賞賜累鉅萬；以像為虎賁中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "f6cf892a4f9561e3a4826c8ea24304fb8703e501d864904528db29d58c7a932c"}

{"id": "p_926dcd0b8d92256c", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 50, "text": "是月，后母薨，帝制緦服臨喪，百僚陪位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "93843c1955400d9e7384402a6f064f67f59a7df6e0b655601d23fa1076ed423e"}

{"id": "p_b4eb31947b7398c9", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 51, "text": "四年十一月，以后舊陵庳下，使像兼太尉，持節詣鄴，昭告后土，十二月，改葬朝陽陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "0865815f13eed4c8cb5fa4643b37134f95f33103992ced50ec669868345d7d1d"}

{"id": "p_c7c74fb8b4bd6d30", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 52, "text": "春，追諡后兄儼曰安城鄉穆侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "44d7563f09c07a267ae7d858036cd678a2d2993a4c99124e6668074c1aaf1df4"}

{"id": "p_3227162ca2228ed9", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 53, "text": "夏，吳賊寇揚州，以像為伏波將軍，持節監諸將東征，還，復為射聲校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "8fe76a8e463196ed9288ca54e29108b307c553d9bd2afebd001ec116bb1529e8"}

{"id": "p_006f6a8ffc4e039f", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 54, "text": "三年薨，追贈衛將軍，改封魏昌縣，諡曰貞侯；子暢嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "a7bcfa2aa99f5811a607f2757d1106ae3ae9f2d6dbc39c90f4818fa94e461f42"}

{"id": "p_1dcb16631ee90359", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 55, "text": "又封暢弟溫、韡、艷皆為列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "ac06c5dcce3e51fc76f5bf1b23b41c9fcae9b7e78905ce6b871d6d92d6c371ff"}

{"id": "p_caa414f95821bfee", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 56, "text": "四年，改逸、儼本封皆曰魏昌侯，諡因故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "cc3357287b608b2bb7729300083f24d4e26376cf3889db229b3843cd42127e5c"}

{"id": "p_e62c4a2d70aa4ac9", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 57, "text": "封儼世婦劉為東鄉君，又追封逸世婦張為安喜君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "0072e40ed57fc9608e0f4aef4987b895df8acd63620b10ace1536746b2141594"}

{"id": "p_5b87bd563aeb920e", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 58, "text": "冬，又奏曰：「蓋帝王之興，既有受命之君，又有聖妃協於神靈，然後克昌厥世，以成王業焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "af7ccf96c7882edc3ceb0eda11b925234d2d794bba6676a3843723d726073d32"}

{"id": "p_f51e27d85b4b2e97", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 59, "text": "昔高辛氏卜其四妃之子皆有天下，而帝摯、陶唐、商、周代興。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "e1288b86a05b1759441b17fc5d04ca29f0ec9c811ea31bf3294ff94e1eb4daf6"}

{"id": "p_48e2f5456f10e90d", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 60, "text": "週人上推后稷，以配皇天，追述王初，本之姜嫄，特立宮廟，世世享嘗，周禮所謂『奏夷則，歌中呂，舞大濩，以享先妣』者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "13bb6e2b2691395b2db12b60ad8b69e7a774f60c264e12b973b56f58086c84cb"}

{"id": "p_4f9897b42a5a790f", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 61, "text": "詩人頌之曰：『厥初生民，時維姜嫄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "1068bc63e7f6ee9235b016b0467aac05d7c1f683da60621ef74c749b031607bf"}

{"id": "p_99a2b8b9d1b7972a", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 62, "text": "』言王化之本，生民所由。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "dedaad4e90c4ca436c9e2268db877848568475a4d7774d2be8531c42e24265c1"}

{"id": "p_ede845ee46383bb3", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 63, "text": "又曰：『閟宮有侐，實實枚枚，赫赫姜嫄，其德不回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "dd544712fb3968c1b857730d9803a16176a22650783573a08f773534ad376403"}

{"id": "p_fea00456cd1e79bd", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 64, "text": "』詩、禮所稱姬宗之盛，其美如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "210236066f80faa19cd3683bc797b1478660011ab9b3ba99e33aa02c81de94b9"}

{"id": "p_5dedd00092af2318", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 65, "text": "大魏期運，繼於有虞，然崇弘帝道，三世彌隆，廟祧之數，實與周同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "055c989a13445628e81e37e6f6c68831c95dd7acc7580f931fcd0eb4692647f5"}

{"id": "p_9b338cde17787094", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 66, "text": "今武宣皇后、文德皇后各配無窮之祚，至於文昭皇后膺天靈符，誕育明聖，功濟生民，德盈宇宙，開諸後嗣，乃道化之所興也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "7b100ac3aeedd5437b4e4fd4aa64cc84617cee63764410a791ac7c40ea2e36f1"}

{"id": "p_8b742a20e0fb13db", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 67, "text": "寢廟特祀，亦姜嫄之閟宮也，而未著不毀之制，懼論功報德之義，萬世或闕焉，非所以昭孝示後世也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "a2198af4bb064b8b5201eb1e45759dd8f28563ef742c27e3c9a387987bdda361"}

{"id": "p_933437f00d6bf0dc", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 68, "text": "文昭廟宜世世享祀奏樂，與祖廟同，永著不毀之典，以播聖善之風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "c059a2a3e9c032fb821d1db61334aef9ebca8b7aa5964aa7d29d1e23608e3fc7"}

{"id": "p_26c71f9732d3895a", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」於是與七廟議並勒金策，藏之金匱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "00a87a843e525713f3c92fd97801a0565571304082157e2a652d2e5c81aa2d3d"}

{"id": "p_45c695f5d7193625", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 70, "text": "暢尚幼，景初末，以暢為射聲校尉，加散騎常侍，又特為起大第，車駕親自臨之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "b877d3c52bdea38b19d5b309549fbf407982d6cbdb9d09415475ef3ae0e16f22"}

{"id": "p_6f8079df34fca1db", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 71, "text": "又於其后園為像母起觀廟，名其里曰渭陽里，以追思母氏也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "0c48b5551ae2d97173bb1c341b5357bd3661a030218597cd5f2a16baf3f4f367"}

{"id": "p_bed26d576134b8bf", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 72, "text": "正月，暢薨，追贈車騎將軍，諡曰恭侯；子紹嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "0d427b19dabc7870ff3950da6bf21f09d08efe5c3245e99904a5a950450a360c"}

{"id": "p_cc54e539d4824694", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 73, "text": "，明帝愛女淑薨，追封諡淑為平原懿公主，為之立廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "89ad62c4c9662145b7f72fe4a461aea7416d94816d33abb0220f685ba938a6c7"}

{"id": "p_a27699f617de973b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 74, "text": "取后亡從孫黃與合葬，追封黃列侯，以夫人郭氏從弟德為之後，承甄氏姓，封德為平原侯，襲公主爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "ebde97b7763040fc19930d456e560156af614bc0d23c50dd156cdada905e40ad"}

{"id": "p_a8f2f9be2bd82f34", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 75, "text": "青龍中，又封后從兄子毅及像弟三人，皆為列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "40dfa6956426de5280741c4db2668bc7acce00fcd8c4d2b9a3f755b5505df820"}

{"id": "p_9ed76e35ebfeb714", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 76, "text": "毅數上疏陳時政，官至越騎校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "58a4139938539a79836d2ef11df52d1b43bd04cd2b6c1afde0b15b04f6c336b7"}

{"id": "p_6393a0fb089c1228", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 77, "text": "嘉平中，复封暢子二人為列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "b82cdab183f4400c48dcd008e2c9d4ad8a05695e99240a7b154239582ecd6065"}

{"id": "p_df4e2b3ca1a61110", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 78, "text": "后兄儼孫女為齊王皇后，后父已沒，封后母為廣樂鄉君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "d286aecd1eec025fd66ad62990aae9b33614469ccabf505c0aa0a9cb70085fbe"}

{"id": "p_c7b7cd45245ed6d9", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 79, "text": "文德郭皇后，安平廣宗人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "b9ba3dfce0fe1a3bf50a9f1207ea16c4890b3bc6e3e10b0381843d40fcd31a3d"}

{"id": "p_28c8aa86ffe44477", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 80, "text": "后少而父永奇之曰：「此乃吾女中王也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "7a843902162b64a9584ec52cd8122441376afe4a5fa9489111839e7e40659483"}

{"id": "p_b964e70dde0859ec", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 81, "text": "早失二親，喪亂流離，沒在銅鞮侯家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "39c26ff205a5c3cad4b032fc2da8c0425077cf0ace3685fdd22f6081f65cde99"}

{"id": "p_0eaaa21b04f1d5bb", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 82, "text": "太祖為魏公時，得入東宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "751e99ba56fa28712aeb250d42aadc278e96510d8f76051dac520247d45375e6"}

{"id": "p_6ac19ece139d08aa", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 83, "text": "后有智數，時時有所獻納。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "56669e9df52b879678e4b6a4b6994309cf5c616cb46eadb81d89067eca25e57a"}

{"id": "p_c7f5993661d19347", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 84, "text": "太子即王位，后為夫人，及踐阼，為貴嬪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "edab081417725331f0cc2043cb401fa09092535097d2a5dd5e5f59214fd4f9e1"}

{"id": "p_1477debb89a17b16", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 85, "text": "，將登后位，文帝欲立為后，中郎棧潛上疏曰：「在昔帝王之治天下，不惟外輔，亦有內助，治亂所由，盛衰從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "3de06757c068482ef5fe70f17bd230eafa70dd29d5b35881371aa5f836fa0976"}

{"id": "p_4a993bc912b2ef83", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 86, "text": "故西陵配黃，英娥降媯，並以賢明，流芳上世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "706b6824ef1f0111a43016817182add19d066b9ad81c1b1a494b33544ac24727"}

{"id": "p_5143e7c9d64251e9", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 87, "text": "桀奔南巢，禍階末喜；紂以砲烙，怡悅妲己。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "de1a326f01231c291c309ad7f3c60e260be9cb14c45adbf98ee28c24bcac5bf4"}

{"id": "p_5208c08b350dc48e", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 88, "text": "是以聖哲慎立元妃，必取先代世族之家，擇其令淑以統六宮，虔奉宗廟，陰教聿修。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "5448e1020b1b7d36d9d06433be5a48d8f58a73fdbda969919d3ca8e677b45171"}

{"id": "p_7f5b3c7205112179", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 89, "text": "易曰：『家道正而天下定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "08867ef09f514e937350cba7285dd17775f608d5eec8c151b7c8ac21f5acdb93"}

{"id": "p_f31e023ed13e6a8b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 90, "text": "』由內及外，先王之令典也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "3527c44a93b1031248c48dbb53a29edc129527b89b60416720e12c0da03efce0"}

{"id": "p_231814ef34a26e60", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 91, "text": "春秋書宗人釁夏云，無以妾為夫人之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "2bc5f1dcee5c54b18e827f528342ec3f5bbd5723457599d6d3d3112008f5c293"}

{"id": "p_40a857c7fca4bab6", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 92, "text": "齊桓誓命於葵丘，亦曰『無以妾為妻』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "f94430ef5c5484db1a1ce550ef907cb7aad8ba110c2dca6ac5475f90a29ddd5d"}

{"id": "p_6e087da54356b984", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 93, "text": "若因愛登后，使賤人暴貴，臣恐後世下陵上替，開張非度，亂自上起也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "77f825f25a1d3132699d54da93e8a835c2ff4d9125605ed2a5586ee6c74000a5"}

{"id": "p_c37bc2a60ea381a7", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」文帝不從，遂立為皇后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "96e8b71088d802d6b577040beff156d8fe515fc7876dc00a09f407b1fb43fdef"}

{"id": "p_db38ec23668bbcc2", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 95, "text": "后早喪兄弟，以從兄表繼永後，拜奉車都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "e455b6ceb065ab033e96180d590e43478aabfee5fde14778343be7b484016820"}

{"id": "p_f7a95c28ece54f13", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 96, "text": "后外親劉斐與他國為婚，后聞之，敕曰：「諸親戚嫁娶，自當與鄉里門戶匹敵者，不得因勢，強與他方人婚也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "26c1d5b2e7c5df86b09e100deef14163ce7c70505ac3fbce2d6aea2f4855a4f4"}

{"id": "p_d512cb7394a9694e", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」后姊子孟武還鄉里，求小妻，后止之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "e205e05831f6b42d4419fb69a0021285181b4615717ad35af95b128b6529e4c3"}

{"id": "p_42c300d14ce52b9a", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 98, "text": "遂敕諸家曰：「今世婦女少，當配將士，不得因緣取以為妾也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "d992e239b13709aaf5eb0729ce917d5846225f67d6ce9593f44e45fe4a0c3ecc"}

{"id": "p_a4e44d98fa6378b6", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 99, "text": "五年，帝東征，后留許昌永始台。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "a0c3b01f1b3f71cb18516557626abfc4515b607ffb10fcf8909652ce563314c9"}

{"id": "p_39d0865846f80857", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 100, "text": "時霖雨百餘日，城樓多壞，有司奏請移止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "28ee53ef59a08a5e9411d190e62d52e8b4cbc140d08550b1eaf2749f7a17d506"}

{"id": "p_41e55b7714ddcfe3", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 101, "text": "后曰：「昔楚昭王出遊，貞姜留漸台，江水至，使者迎而無符，不去，卒沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "e91239e86d7ffb49c5e33d0b1bf00563755fb3715b2ce21a2ed7f77f22c7969f"}

{"id": "p_a7d78e6567f3c61a", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 102, "text": "今帝在遠，吾幸未有是患，而便移止，奈何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "89102c10fa12341c50a538cd888192526b0e17714b3a5b0cb596e1cb95e6fb35"}

{"id": "p_06dfaf0909e88c64", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 103, "text": "六年，帝東征吳，至廣陵，后留譙宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "db4077f3f9cde129f9ab6d1de158ae864b2a8ee327b0a5245e195fb55656af75"}

{"id": "p_1f7915057e5ceba6", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 104, "text": "時表留宿衛，欲遏水取魚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "f1a3b81a09c07ededa4c18d45923f1940ecf071277ad4b0ee0dd3691d403e92a"}

{"id": "p_ae1981b70cd367ff", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 105, "text": "后曰：「水噹通運漕，又少材木，奴客不在目前，當複私取官竹木作梁遏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "374353590529f60a9934b1710f7a66848ef3b01b21d116a669b0b4d0debf81ae"}

{"id": "p_98950de43b35127b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 106, "text": "今奉車所不足者，豈魚乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "ddfe6c34dcb0c7f2e0811c71efc788f2b4206647410214fa69993b56b20b2e56"}

{"id": "p_6bf8788e6d5aa074", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 107, "text": "明帝即位，尊后為皇太后，稱永安宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "86ccd84bba6810bc31572e3c21b90efd15dcd055b6790c74a82f05cb7f48c361"}

{"id": "p_e9a1fc9a251d5eb9", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 108, "text": "太和四年，詔封表安陽亭侯，又進爵鄉侯，增邑並前五百戶，遷中壘將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "ce56910418ac8bbfd214b94e226b3274f49e22a141ec512954cffdb87561bbb7"}

{"id": "p_33bf0179f9ab3d65", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 109, "text": "其年，帝追諡太后父永為安陽鄉敬侯，母董為都鄉君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "d377df8408af9a87e44cada19977301c9349ba5592e8fa0c99518d9e257163ac"}

{"id": "p_9992893bdff78d5c", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 110, "text": "遷表昭德將軍，加金紫，位特進，表第二子訓為騎都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "bb6052054aa0e047549eac992fc793b547c5a66033a32ac7ab9497e1bb06d6a2"}

{"id": "p_1e846a1b84d9a0ea", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 111, "text": "及孟武母卒，欲厚葬，起祠堂，太后止之曰：「自喪亂以來，墳墓無不發掘，皆由厚葬也；首陽陵可以為法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "49454b0df852dcaf7530bd7d00ed4eb33f6227fbfc096664de4676c0af84d763"}

{"id": "p_4b4811a84be5789b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 112, "text": "」春，后崩於許昌，以終制營陵，三月庚寅，葬首陽陵西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "71b0fd40c14a49afbfac86d35c1e8b689b55f4d1c42e11a8c2e5e6073bb96879"}

{"id": "p_5a3a5c58e90a699b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 113, "text": "帝進表爵為觀津侯，增邑五百，並前千戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "2a3ffb0c01e9d2785b05520354d84ec8e73de72c38edd20ffdedd78f224c6f35"}

{"id": "p_eb5bcf201e6a1646", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 114, "text": "四年，追改封永為觀津敬侯，世婦董為堂陽君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "b1afffb94ec5206a16572c54769198c100b59144d39e2509e5a86fcfe073af9e"}

{"id": "p_9425048c9ccc6cb8", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 115, "text": "追封諡后兄浮為梁裡亭戴侯，都為武城亭孝侯，成為新樂亭定侯，皆使使者奉策，祠以太牢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "878ff3a7f2e05bf744c5ab396cf21dd46b8b2ead87e46ed37eeb3c079372b372"}

{"id": "p_d872ae20b510f4c3", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 116, "text": "表薨，子詳嗣，又分錶爵封詳弟述為列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "72e12aff8797207b7d90e31c46541fe6f2953ade52384e1c81c25ae3fe7aa591"}

{"id": "p_27b98a74b7b4262b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 117, "text": "黃初中，以選入東宮，明帝時為平原王，進御有寵，出入與同輿輦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "8b6f519407f3adffe7dfe3994cb7e4209174458959cc85292abd0bd652c91c71"}

{"id": "p_8a39666934e56022", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 118, "text": "后父嘉，拜騎都尉，后弟曾，郎中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "c85ea3fbdea383b9a2baab852d73c7bee3f2861b01cc6505f2eb0e316e62ff29"}

{"id": "p_5b15061a5c784551", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 119, "text": "初，明帝為王，始納河內虞氏為妃，帝即位，虞氏不得立為后，太皇后卞太后慰勉焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "9ae10461552d72ad433fb766412fccb30e9d9ff39db65f62b4d0c34ab4df806a"}

{"id": "p_adc75d1012e529b9", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 120, "text": "虞氏曰：「曹氏自好立賤，未有能以義舉者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "452cd72642fabccbc583758354b688194b76fecd8f7563dcff62ccfd08aeb350"}

{"id": "p_3afbd818dc0b4daf", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 121, "text": "然后職內事，君聽外政，其道相由而成，苟不能以善始，未有能令終者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "d43e6a784ab949e2f68709a8a3de97c5f732c39f8080845e73cf9eefababc3d9"}

{"id": "p_5668ef857faa7e38", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 122, "text": "進嘉為奉車都尉，曾騎都尉，寵賜隆渥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "3326308ee553dfb117f16854626a82cf9bbae0dac5e234ed6f229918880f2130"}

{"id": "p_1298063e2f4ba8d8", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 123, "text": "頃之，封嘉博平鄉侯，遷光祿大夫，曾駙馬都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "a03c1f862a6c0c1414bc932a2995493c52e73746675e7c6f4fb5d1e3e82957be"}

{"id": "p_70f0e8364603452b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 124, "text": "嘉本典虞車工，卒暴富貴，明帝令朝臣會其家飲宴，其容止舉動甚蚩騃，語輒自謂「侯身」，時人以為笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "f01a513979441194726a52231488d3d35dc941024c228105e54745a1cb41d6d2"}

{"id": "p_1cc8b33ddf91c825", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 125, "text": "后又加嘉位特進，曾遷散騎侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "2f30aae14827c0745f2afb152e901b62e63bd3189c4cd129cb0b67ab1dafbc6e"}

{"id": "p_25a3d53299abc46a", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 126, "text": "，嘉薨，追贈光祿大夫，改封安國侯，增邑五百，並前千戶，諡曰節侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "0c4b1ec3b315ceea280896f9a18ed56bdd530a27f4cb98e465431cb0c94170f1"}

{"id": "p_51d21cb03ede1aa6", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 127, "text": "四年，追封后母夏為野王君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "728fa1a9aca9eeea6de1a68025d2023ced01b6d458bf9e6d25c6aa45eaaab442"}

{"id": "p_97821c6f7d958d6e", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 128, "text": "帝之幸郭元后也，后愛寵日弛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "93cbe6f2d08a8f6ecfe61fa7d16641e79a261d21952eee3999ce3c5d2e5681dd"}

{"id": "p_ae7d82b7c0aafc2a", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 129, "text": "，帝遊后園，召才人以上曲宴極樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "757390fb1d97cd63ce6125470f7f9d356e246bfddf1f3451958c1c0bdccdb7b2"}

{"id": "p_9f5867d7690414a3", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 130, "text": "元后曰「宜延皇后」，帝弗許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "5d083f84ca51cfd34cfe7579b92f9af3846307596948cee5c8ea29f44815de6a"}

{"id": "p_761c6d2faf66df70", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 131, "text": "后知之，明日，帝見后，后曰：「昨日遊宴北園，樂乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "39ad02ccd333f7ef118af53f6dde48da16cd4b0310bf4eca50d46db57cc4e2f5"}

{"id": "p_7c9f32790d266b7b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」帝以左右洩之，所殺十餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "eaf30ff58b8040be8557f5576d0b80fb6ec6ffade1ed3ca48bf98df8389b29a7"}

{"id": "p_e3f8a1301e0ab017", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 133, "text": "賜后死，然猶加諡，葬愍陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "e5031c9f13588be3f72e2018d6036aaa5a0ac0d1fb7caf9a91cecb15010c1784"}

{"id": "p_29b378590d64fcf7", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 134, "text": "遷曾散騎常侍，後徙為羽林虎賁中郎將、原武典農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "d038c5223caa97db1d9049a24cf6af5c432664818c68fe497ce3ddc82f77c931"}

{"id": "p_9825a7711e72ac0c", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 135, "text": "明元郭皇后，西平人也，世河右大族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "6306dc29372fc69f2c63133532496688a8332ce8bcdf9b169a848ea4dc9238f2"}

{"id": "p_5a45fd136011c44f", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 136, "text": "黃初中，本郡反叛，遂沒入宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "40acf3b406a3369e50e04aab8e4ce25fa45d55e38fedee51882350f5ad041e96"}

{"id": "p_fedbd2acd2ee4fe7", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 137, "text": "明帝即位，甚見愛幸，拜為夫人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "ca1f5442a6fb78704f349cbf39f33ad92611f3269542e86111f3d3f7a875f02f"}

{"id": "p_9706d7f16295782a", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 138, "text": "叔父立為騎都尉，從父芝為虎賁中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "1ddb48ef6c5841f51d0e104d880ff2ec65eebe433e85b2684556f98de5725912"}

{"id": "p_bf41b450e691ca2d", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 139, "text": "齊王即位，尊后為皇太后，稱永寧宮，追封諡太后父滿為西都定侯，以立子建紹其爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "90a626c2961d6b44cb307fad810b95ef295a2a474a2632bbf1d6da18822f6b7b"}

{"id": "p_c1e514e1213bbc78", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 140, "text": "芝遷散騎常侍、長水校尉，立，宣德將軍，皆封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "f008e1637b5b153f84bdbfd87b7005bf51472a702d2f1d8eaa072f5db19d13b3"}

{"id": "p_232ea8174f414bec", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 141, "text": "德及建俱為鎮護將軍，皆封列侯，並掌宿衛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "52303663243e47a8befd16b98109094a4e6a1e0122016e827f783327ec057126"}

{"id": "p_39f2bab42c1ebcfc", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 142, "text": "值三主幼弱，宰輔統政，與奪大事，皆先諮啟於太后而後施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "d52d3870ce2377589e11f825f29387e1d020e2e5916fdcec6336b5b93c0dbc25"}

{"id": "p_5c310c0bbb4f36f0", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 143, "text": "毌丘儉、鍾會等作亂，咸假其命而以為辭焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "42a683a483e1799ece9220f72bff1af6af45b859aaf72aea417c8485db1f2e38"}

{"id": "p_92e86122b33644a6", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 144, "text": "十二日崩，五年二月，葬高平陵西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "eb76741fc037cf98fd41ed9a09813bad6e1591537d05e7130b00bd8ccbe41586"}

{"id": "p_d8b46f539d3f681b", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 145, "text": "評曰：魏后妃之家，雖云富貴，未有若衰漢乘非其據，宰割朝政者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "9145b8375f11f2793a45fea99b4f266dfe7d198e25a5ae3a734d3f370020aa94"}

{"id": "p_1d367a4c7ec09888", "source_id": "src_136c141aac4e87ed", "ordinal": 146, "text": "追觀陳群之議，棧潛之論，適足以為百王之規典，垂憲範乎後葉矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "e4bf1ba7bf10816ec3bf838ad8c8fee56f725863a6d67a7e0450a199cec1d71c"}

{"id": "p_367fa56ec539f8a7", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 0, "text": "董卓字仲穎，隴西臨洮人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "d77b7bddb797e96a377b829a06e752bee59ab964c525b4470c9b38f0be3c8bb2"}

{"id": "p_d989e9ce92727040", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 1, "text": "少好俠，甞游羌中，盡與諸豪帥相結。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "93fa091a5be53558b3474f70aac14a770c6c37ee4367162f77d518a73a3f01b3"}

{"id": "p_2ca7d00651c59f6c", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 2, "text": "後歸耕於野，而豪帥有來從之者，卓與俱還，殺耕牛與相宴樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "f2db66e5e7a27dfae7ee5d14ee2b65179347db618a3beb8239a7da87b0f95ac9"}

{"id": "p_8ee050cfc390be01", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 3, "text": "諸豪帥感其意，歸相斂，得雜畜千餘頭以贈卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "d108e48c1980b08c046d0bf38cf6d25d161357e94dcb8d109e82854361717719"}

{"id": "p_a9245a373cb682d8", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 4, "text": "漢桓帝末，以六郡良家子爲羽林郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "783ee002579bc81da1e87e7869154342b6d981c205fb5cdd35066f913e0b2e59"}

{"id": "p_96bb44101c562477", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 5, "text": "卓有才武，旅力少比，雙帶兩鞬，左右馳射。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "86e36556f557145375e481d2c134854f12146871f169aa526a3bed7aad5a34f7"}

{"id": "p_52f0809d5be37f05", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 6, "text": "爲軍司馬，從中郎將張奐征并州有功，拜郎中，賜縑九千匹，卓悉以分與吏士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "1e81f1bc4322cd32062d4057c3568b70d03a8089ff775ab7d880fa19935123d5"}

{"id": "p_42a3e160d45ce305", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 7, "text": "遷廣武令，蜀郡北部都尉，西域戊己校尉，免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "6611700ef835af6ea7ca1ffbd339d0aba8963ba94119a1ec10caa44dab938c8d"}

{"id": "p_67e64c1957b1f2f2", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 8, "text": "徵拜并州刺史、河東太守，遷中郎將，討黃巾，軍敗抵罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "7dc54ded59c9693ce8981f09e391e8ba35e21707ec99b5e42e5c7a35713c8bc6"}

{"id": "p_e7465b3eae372ccf", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 9, "text": "韓遂等起涼州，復爲中郎將，西拒遂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "91224c6c3ab236fe4038a1508c343220b585c56dee6a95dd22a2db7fdb9a7722"}

{"id": "p_52a8f69c0984ffa3", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 10, "text": "於望垣硤北爲羌、胡數萬人所圍，糧食乏絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "ba14501e504e60bd2fbc2ec127108e08932802e5380a28437d0c1780f26a6aaa"}

{"id": "p_9b03bb37c6addd2f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 11, "text": "卓偽欲捕魚，堰其還道當所渡水爲池，使水渟滿數十里，默從堰下過其軍而決堰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "2df123b86765f6a3bcad45055d37d9d4b40c6e1d5dd8c3f4a85504d40487fb68"}

{"id": "p_efa1302959383437", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 12, "text": "比羌、胡聞知追逐，水已深，不得渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "6d17394d384856b477fbe8b7b3f513032e048c08bc64a6cff84fa26ff7008d7a"}

{"id": "p_b1d5544ed4dc437b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 13, "text": "時六軍上隴西，五軍敗績，卓獨全衆而還，屯住扶風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "be4fd0e39f1cb8ee05304595abae8b36618a1ca0704d12b3a1dcc8f3cd173e1c"}

{"id": "p_eac5574c895d18ff", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 14, "text": "拜前將軍，封斄鄉侯，徵爲并州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "d288ba9dbdd51cfc19378202140a276c13a9d8071bc6090ae4fa0228abf0beff"}

{"id": "p_e319149df2147d20", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 15, "text": "大將軍何進與司隷校尉袁紹謀誅諸閹官，太后不從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "a51c42697474350957b2793385b6de38eba96c9d4299d14b1a5663ffb30d567d"}

{"id": "p_d2f17fe9779593c7", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 16, "text": "進乃召卓使將兵詣京師，并密令上書曰：「中常侍張讓等竊幸乘寵，濁亂海內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "0f59bfb48b0634f9c72589ba9df497b2c9854c43d4f96f3a4163ecd161071fea"}

{"id": "p_5e6f09b80040b6bb", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 17, "text": "昔趙鞅興晉陽之甲，以逐君側之惡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "fc2c717663f2abab34c3fae7a5049e22daaa25441c9fc18d39c3b776a152825e"}

{"id": "p_f5f3f109c1691a74", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 18, "text": "臣輙鳴鍾鼓如洛陽，即討讓等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "8534cbc479534c0d37826b391323c01e61a29efdccb3b81c1bf14b1bc28e52f0"}

{"id": "p_b9f251dea99ee73d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 19, "text": "中常侍段珪等劫帝走小平津，卓遂將其衆迎帝于北芒，還宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "e56fdf236c48a2796063a09c5a9e5609839d290be3f8b2ea90e93679bf601547"}

{"id": "p_f17a019ebdd7b23d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 20, "text": "時進弟車騎將軍苗爲進衆所殺，進、苗部曲無所屬，皆詣卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "48a21f73477a65c7253f45ddecd595e9db4a6aab21be5ba09aaaab4f3d9ff58d"}

{"id": "p_60310fec3a5cef37", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 21, "text": "卓又使呂布殺執金吾丁原，并其衆，故京都兵權唯在卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "5bce06c79b3be563aa2a567e577ea7752c2d36fd49ba53a22987bd7d52642bff"}

{"id": "p_63fb628f00fcb48c", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 22, "text": "先是，進遣騎都尉太山鮑信所在募兵，適至，信謂紹曰：「卓擁彊兵，有異志，今不早圖，將爲所制；及其初至疲勞，襲之可禽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "df3c5356054a2a193a983e7fb3eb68e413e42d5833d05f0950e4861782b01c6d"}

{"id": "p_898d74a03d680e9c", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」紹畏卓，不敢發，信遂還鄉里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "19a939d4c9c6c8c4df2dae14cd1f4b0818614840a259ab829f2099feef0eb41d"}

{"id": "p_875de32c817225b9", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 24, "text": "於是以久不雨，策免司空劉弘而卓代之，俄遷太尉，假節鉞虎賁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "48098b5c5d22da1823308ae698d94c546d0dc46a633bcdab10d1913ffb365af6"}

{"id": "p_62bd41dda08b52ca", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 25, "text": "立靈帝少子陳留王，是爲獻帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "19f57932bf0c54fd21f1a0870feef8f0cedf1e08d25b8f2db2053d599f3eb904"}

{"id": "p_7f4fc7b0bdc1c503", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 26, "text": "卓遷相國，封郿侯，贊拜不名，劒履上殿，又封卓母爲池陽君，置家令、丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "f9365ac5a5f47eb9d1ab5ed94a35bad0346f57e20b3c09f825512ed3deecb986"}

{"id": "p_f61e1d8a5be600bb", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 27, "text": "卓旣率精兵來，適值帝室大亂，得專廢立，據有武庫甲兵、國家珍寶，威震天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "6bab49b1de12aa559a70878adfd4cea3686e9b262e790d88b2bb55e11f5aa095"}

{"id": "p_938e78d679169f73", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 28, "text": "卓性殘忍不仁，遂以嚴刑脅衆，睚眦之隙必報，人不自保。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "e01eddee765dc29a3bf3af09506b1f57a621ab408de87efb8b7b69e93b04f09c"}

{"id": "p_c9cced8ccf5dda24", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 29, "text": "時適二月社，民各在其社下，悉就斷其男子頭，駕其車牛，載其婦女財物，以所斷頭繫車轅軸，連軫而還洛，云攻賊大獲，稱萬歲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "1b90afd1a8d06aedab14a24f2e0b42363ef2acb883d09c25e76c4aec29291777"}

{"id": "p_052fd3e204d74be7", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 30, "text": "入開陽城門，焚燒其頭，以婦女與甲兵爲婢妾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "44bcbeecb3adf91699f162509c4995080a7e1c082b964d5184e46b10ff350a32"}

{"id": "p_1cbbb0711c5de611", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 31, "text": "初，卓信任尚書周毖、城門校尉伍瓊等，用其所舉韓馥、劉岱、孔伷、張咨、張邈等出宰州郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "db9703078ebfa77b93818acca64fac30b90c448f4d54a719cef55279d9e6fc7c"}

{"id": "p_375048baf9196fa2", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 32, "text": "而馥等至官，皆合兵將以討卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "c510dde7ee162b30ea650fbc0ad22739ecc69215ce57c8b0419203b22c5a375b"}

{"id": "p_09ea12e649075e2e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 33, "text": "卓聞之，以爲毖、瓊等通情賣己，皆斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "ab90f95ddc1b61777f6e1da4b6b0748cac3a15d1c5d136cf10b6e3a13078ddaf"}

{"id": "p_3aabf26525f39f2f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 34, "text": "河內太守王匡遣泰山兵屯河陽津，將以圖卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "784bd2ddda15fb3ac55d32e45a085b38169605d9ed6fb0df9d938bce6bc99d37"}

{"id": "p_2214cd3c7c81be71", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 35, "text": "卓遣疑兵若將於平陰渡者，潛遣銳衆從小平北渡，繞擊其後，大破之津北，死者略盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "326f4621d557f6c81e8513c36db17ac02fd2d12e10eb634e078807d329a282ea"}

{"id": "p_3b98b5e6c75b8196", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 36, "text": "卓以山東豪傑並起，恐懼不寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "be7c8295c0aba9e3b5a7aa7188c12d19aa5fd5177bf51c8cfdc739641b9193d6"}

{"id": "p_9ed1d9825433795a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 37, "text": "焚燒洛陽宮室，悉發掘陵墓，取寶物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "89914763f1bc2ef6702407ee944ec947b22283ed8db853dbfba632df9c10f17a"}

{"id": "p_b244178ca1e20299", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 38, "text": "卓至西京，爲太師，號曰尚父。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "242974a73ffafe4a8fbcf176644b81648c0e46c80c841e4a907fe1a93726f996"}

{"id": "p_40fd6e5bf4b74454", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 39, "text": "乘青蓋金華車，爪畫兩轓，時人號曰竿摩車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "04afb27554a7c3f05c1cd54e9b537933267b1090f9c681c3e7c0e0ea995d0996"}

{"id": "p_982988ae62c2ecc4", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 40, "text": "卓弟旻爲左將軍，封鄠侯；兄子璜爲侍中中軍校尉典兵；宗族內外並列朝廷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "4ee4233f52c990170e041ae54a5bbc4cbce56cc7418267ed9b3c7e82530c4e26"}

{"id": "p_69d3155e31b62ff6", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 41, "text": "公卿見卓，謁拜車下，卓不爲禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "5f96d0e296d9da2895bc4b9fb45104e7c56c314b04f9a5739d225223c78dafbd"}

{"id": "p_0c0dca7b96551f90", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 42, "text": "召呼三臺尚書以下自詣卓府啟事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "1e757fcc872faea60d4edddebc5498b65752029ec3d38ddd1442c6c9d97f1584"}

{"id": "p_358562bc3e9ca5af", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 43, "text": "築郿塢，高與長安城埒，積穀爲三十年儲，云事成，雄據天下，不成，守此足以畢老。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "2d1242d83cbcbd6f6f172e4db028fed59b53a0aded83a26fb29d4d49f0a19b57"}

{"id": "p_acb8e80248990a86", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 44, "text": "甞至郿行塢，公卿已下祖道於橫門外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "f975eac008511c15a4698523084d252d2edd829e64615120ce7a9a00cb502a98"}

{"id": "p_22b90db621077161", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 45, "text": "卓豫施帳幔飲，誘降北地反者數百人，於坐中先斷其舌，或斬手足，或鑿眼，或鑊煑之，未死，偃轉杯案閒，會者皆戰慄亡失匕箸，而卓飲食自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "c28fc4dc6ff6e22a3b0cd149a6e846038762def04961b3f0d5303c918dd287ce"}

{"id": "p_72f7f7a68ce2d50a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 46, "text": "太史望氣，言當有大臣戮死者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "b243f618decc25f444b9efca47cbccb4d2477dfd1f12d70400761e3ff587324a"}

{"id": "p_8f4637ee06820d26", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 47, "text": "故太尉張溫時爲衞尉，素不善卓，卓心怨之，因天有變，欲以塞咎，使人言溫與袁術交關，遂笞殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "144f524dee385f835e251f0f84ae0190176ed5f1e738d5f3288866d0e4ef684e"}

{"id": "p_88e33066fb3eefae", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 48, "text": "法令苛酷，愛憎淫刑，更相被誣，冤死者千數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "e007e53f21b0dd12a52889d9e7a07954ed1cc66375e5bc0af349e14548c9deb3"}

{"id": "p_6deb28cbafc29b5b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 49, "text": "悉椎破銅人、鍾虡，及壞五銖錢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "022c82b4bcefeef55ab8ec9202eef4060180a37df88d5dd3875b34b2ea891298"}

{"id": "p_8ed98fa6f87bc210", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 50, "text": "更鑄爲小錢，大五分，無文章，肉好無輪郭，不磨鑢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "24816e558841072555e5c8d2ce6aef225560bdc17fe117f5ec40633fcc53934f"}

{"id": "p_130e8f8869a83a64", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 51, "text": "於是貨輕而物貴，穀一斛至數十萬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "92527789faddbc7d8b26f929dae44374771e23ddf3bcef95babb0107bb7745ce"}

{"id": "p_3754ebeb568d29c1", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 52, "text": "三年四月，司徒王允、尚書僕射士孫瑞、卓將呂布共謀誅卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "c51b06a30d7f50a38212e1743494d15735c6d78b41324176febcbad04120b4f2"}

{"id": "p_63d4e610ba1b3867", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 53, "text": "是時，天子有疾新愈，大會未央殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "ffc1979ad7573474735dd5b62fb75f5e2e47b1668c20ccebeb1f2fcb9a687b7c"}

{"id": "p_feeab910ac1738cc", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 54, "text": "布使同郡騎都尉李肅等將親兵十餘人，偽著衞士服守掖門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "fd2ca6f76cb0c3e77b34ae11a11c96360e443e3cbe9a9c65e1b982c9e6852f08"}

{"id": "p_06fd3ff4aba52ce3", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 55, "text": "布曰「有詔」，遂殺卓，夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "c40bb34dc8dbcb5064d932ed7a81dc787db39a827b9a7620d49d76508ed0cbbf"}

{"id": "p_e2d7f5fe362cf414", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 56, "text": "主簿田景前趨卓尸，布又殺之；凡所殺三人，餘莫敢動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "139ff9f2588c53ada2db6c82c223844bd728b080595181d04e2e3cd50d0601bf"}

{"id": "p_971248fa38910e15", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 57, "text": "長安士庶咸相慶賀，諸阿附卓者皆下獄死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "c96cd41be0310566faac7d52e20180ba7f2808901740c1f6961166e2c86a07ff"}

{"id": "p_9db78ebe89e2e1ab", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 58, "text": "初，卓女壻中郎將牛輔典兵別屯陝，分遣校尉李傕、郭汜、張濟略陳留、潁川諸縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "245eebf5f903049d6075e89e086183444fcc0d39ae5ca4ff20ef9cc6e8af14ed"}

{"id": "p_485b0bf377663cf2", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 59, "text": "卓死，呂布使李肅至陝，欲以詔命誅輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "f7d2659c0a382225235c0d7e79ea5f3d419bf7020c101128d59a7ee01afad453"}

{"id": "p_1b61a1017e87b7da", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 60, "text": "輔等逆與肅戰，肅敗走弘農，布誅肅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "d2fe42dc26b1688c2e01159b48257d6baacecccdde22a2a28605b90adf3cfe05"}

{"id": "p_51ef35b7cdd7717b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 61, "text": "其後輔營兵有夜叛出者，營中驚，輔以爲皆叛，乃取金寶，獨與素所厚友胡赤兒等五六人相隨，踰城北渡河，赤兒等利其金寶，斬首送長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "619f5d33aa3bdf53c155a3214dc60e9fa90d9b0675e1919714eeaf4aba95074d"}

{"id": "p_f04c48e13b79d765", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 62, "text": "比傕等還，輔已敗，衆無所依，欲各散歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "bbfc19d9b22e060fc1806a7669d49e51ae203e9bc43ab534d57ebd9b30644b24"}

{"id": "p_06e573c943e37d55", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 63, "text": "旣無赦書，而聞長安中欲盡誅涼州人，憂恐不知所爲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "c62feb6c7967e28319df5a8e173e8625020baa7e5762b024a15839e87d0d8354"}

{"id": "p_6a716ec56208d5bb", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 64, "text": "用賈詡策，遂將其衆而西，所在收兵，比至長安，衆十餘萬，與卓故部曲樊稠、李蒙、王方等合圍長安城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "f9679aa071096dcfdd17b6e9523331724f1e5f5b5f0526f0408659f491b408d3"}

{"id": "p_714074ea56e109b0", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 65, "text": "十日城陷，與布戰城中，布敗走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "3cde68c144f201631e943eaee2eeb6d04c018a4cbe0285b9b9ecb3f49590a518"}

{"id": "p_f134c3d5b9fb78fb", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 66, "text": "傕等放兵略長安老少，殺之悉盡，死者狼藉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "043bcc319fcbc6baee896b340d004657806187ae7b9e5439adca4797e5a4c8ee"}

{"id": "p_4bf38090a343943c", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 67, "text": "葬卓於郿，大風暴雨震卓墓，水流入藏，漂其棺槨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "d36f0502f8a711b601ffd9e317d120f5e1e8e8173fcb1e71e08cab767c278b78"}

{"id": "p_febb93545ede2640", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 68, "text": "傕爲車騎將軍、池陽侯，領司隷校尉、假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "f1676f8fab7f550b0ba5f27a309480bb833ba4cb0776463cae324acc576bd534"}

{"id": "p_e5bf8a927e8a2756", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 69, "text": "濟爲驃騎將軍、平陽侯，屯弘農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "e1c065eb30909ec68dbdc2d8bda97351ee578aaa4fbbe349cfd0522bd11a81e7"}

{"id": "p_12b60412762218d3", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 70, "text": "是歲，韓遂、馬騰等降，率衆詣長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "27daa2cf9b242c11a5f19b7468c36d64631f5233e9d0a9c93640ea36067bed64"}

{"id": "p_7da441b4c49b3508", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 71, "text": "以遂爲鎮西將軍，遣還涼州，騰征西將軍，屯郿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "63707c57f7af69e04c7213646884c2677f976be8d754bd794fe1b19e2b1c3946"}

{"id": "p_21e5d4344767e59e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 72, "text": "侍中馬宇與諫議大夫种邵、左中郎將劉範等謀，欲使騰襲長安，己爲內應，以誅傕等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "b88447399690bbc15de5fafa0d7135950aa7f655525ba50e7636bb75f26cbb80"}

{"id": "p_8122f5345fcf29b5", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 73, "text": "騰引兵至長平觀，宇等謀泄，出奔槐里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "17108531967254a702e746b876e973c02762a7ea1ac50fc7f2d66080d35f7773"}

{"id": "p_3b442d638a19fba5", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 74, "text": "稠擊騰，騰敗走，還涼州；又攻槐里，宇等皆死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "94585cd3a58a0fcd3e07741ec888c6f0642a2238654ee216168730e31e2992b4"}

{"id": "p_735d99a6f9a07ba9", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 75, "text": "時三輔民尚數十萬戶，傕等放兵劫略，攻剽城邑，人民饑困，二年間相啖食略盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "6a89015f56d898d0e470f86b2226f5e431bfa405e73a0f405fb61dc6636f0cbd"}

{"id": "p_d42d1b7cc4624e5f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 76, "text": "諸將爭權，遂殺稠，并其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "e521eb993b4623bf154a6da4dba45801630c857f3880f731f9fc25f4b63ab777"}

{"id": "p_4d5e6bebd48138d9", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 77, "text": "汜與傕轉相疑，戰鬬長安中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "1aef52d8343500a9b435aff9ac90581f1e1facda5f5318459feca3655cffb2ac"}

{"id": "p_c1022b368c40886f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 78, "text": "傕質天子於營，燒宮殿城門，略官寺，盡收乘輿服御物置其家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "5d111a183b94edb3db571ea73c6f4c774db1f35016f33548c4700a72f953d900"}

{"id": "p_d9bdaf0fec204bdd", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 79, "text": "傕使公卿詣汜請和，汜皆執之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "e931746ffb3decf1f9d2ceeebeb3e70e4d214c875a776ac79b208547b45760a0"}

{"id": "p_de8b88cd2c1e411a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 80, "text": "傕將楊奉與傕軍吏宋果等謀殺傕，事泄，遂將兵叛傕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "d60d7ddeb6d084e39bcb2218b1cd4d19effd19c733fb8bc67c6a7b3638e0877e"}

{"id": "p_f58a350fa4a7c7d2", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 81, "text": "張濟自陝和解之，天子乃得出，至新豐、霸陵間。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "59be8922d1c71b23fbaa16306942282f9da25b5520082d9350a4b655e975c5d2"}

{"id": "p_dc545a546d938487", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 82, "text": "天子奔奉營，奉擊汜，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "c040e967a6e0a765927cf558858cfd1cd08caf1cb61b68de66ed6b93c02e9373"}

{"id": "p_d385decebac74768", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 83, "text": "汜走南山，奉及將軍董承以天子還洛陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "48da075548ccc17026651e69bbb3f95ec2c32bedd3be5c3b2628e085c3cc70eb"}

{"id": "p_0d36df1cac527767", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 84, "text": "傕、汜悔遣天子，復相與和，追及天子於弘農之曹陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "c711ed64e7aa94e8c39f868c4ff73c2a31ba6854387089eb508ce3c349286371"}

{"id": "p_a0c3575aa534d853", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 85, "text": "奉急招河東故白波帥韓暹、胡才、李樂等合，與傕、汜大戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "126bea66349102a2e47b1a7c0c6cfec8a5334158619233e5a36c7fe914f962c6"}

{"id": "p_1ace9958a6ccaf0a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 86, "text": "奉兵敗，傕等縱兵殺公卿百官，略宮人入弘農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "5e7467c21d88135d554e7759bc1de8fff20534afa559c52401e98e1abcbefe6c"}

{"id": "p_47f3c8ee581a4544", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 87, "text": "天子走陝，北渡河，失輜重，步行，唯皇后貴人從，至大陽，止人家屋中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "7b84927a728e856ca79c01b04e31e5a57cfbddfa64f84a453494268932522d30"}

{"id": "p_2edf12c1563cbb0d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 88, "text": "奉、暹等遂以天子都安邑，御乘牛車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "889c9c2c6fe33abd50db67c0dd2087664ea7a2fa58a2daa18f0ec431cb1beb26"}

{"id": "p_ebfb000aeec11b5d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 89, "text": "太尉楊彪、太僕韓融近臣從者十餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "b14199cf1809e5a8fbafcb1c5bcb2945abd13e52d2a4e42b07245f512b6c77a6"}

{"id": "p_d0c90dc50bbc7112", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 90, "text": "以暹爲征東、才爲征西、樂征北將軍，並與奉、承持政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "a1169f7d7f980315b918eaa803e38adbcf67c54b75152e82eb2e069ed20a1491"}

{"id": "p_8ab806f17f7028da", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 91, "text": "遣融至弘農與傕、汜等連和，還所略宮人公卿百官，及乘輿車馬數乘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "9437277ea438830331e63d7744707401fb0c0e51460c37e1188cbec78a051780"}

{"id": "p_7a5483dea1af47ad", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 92, "text": "是時蝗蟲起，歲旱無穀，從官食棗菜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "39d450a9ab0a173a8a05b5cc62cc80f872533a378955a6f8553071c2ab0fb9f1"}

{"id": "p_d96971b3b8b0930e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 93, "text": "諸將不能相率，上下亂，糧食盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "6fbc5c69f60651f736be7e18d11c9c8d636ed729e4ab2de7094e76986037ec1f"}

{"id": "p_4400f392fb530df4", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 94, "text": "奉、暹、承乃以天子還洛陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "7745abe75e74aea974622a1a00683b6c6259f45f6202051dab1d9dd914ca18e8"}

{"id": "p_e549dd80984cd5db", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 95, "text": "出箕關，下軹道，張楊以食迎道路，拜大司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "916cb03d11dea8163a71400cc669d64450995849ff75f0799a0215a805a23fd1"}

{"id": "p_df8318777251a0c0", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 96, "text": "天子入洛陽，宮室燒盡，街陌荒蕪，百官披荊棘，依丘牆間。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "bd23484d224926efc46971ef16d7c5446dc5bf59da9f37c4f0f8b8d073a66ba1"}

{"id": "p_90fb541bd8a22482", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 97, "text": "州郡各擁兵自爲，莫有至者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "2c0352ef9dc4ca47452ab6b86fa607c197975fe28a573b763a80db46942e07d5"}

{"id": "p_cb7e9734209cd1b7", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 98, "text": "饑窮稍甚，尚書郎以下自出樵采，或饑死牆壁閒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "50c0f3fa2534e54d33985371f10467efffec10585bf58524654cb8ea00d1cee2"}

{"id": "p_6b643372cc95de0c", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 99, "text": "暹、奉不能奉王法，各出奔，寇徐、揚閒，爲劉備所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "5c743fe8f83f1f857d72ff91721ce4c20d2aa544262217932e539df751581e23"}

{"id": "p_28bbc3f0e133ee98", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 100, "text": "，遣謁者僕射裴茂率關西諸將誅傕，夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "09af56bc1686d2f138e70de7907b0dee096281cc81d653eef8338833e0142659"}

{"id": "p_f4936de9e84d987e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 101, "text": "汜爲其將五習所襲，死於郿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "25088bf13b2162f0dc1da2c12654f255be550c034f0703806b399389a2360d57"}

{"id": "p_0b409c6e81edb659", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 102, "text": "濟饑餓，至南陽寇略，爲穰人所殺，從子繡攝其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "d540b763f83a374b2b8cabc91de8ead276bb3689064f3a5abb14dcee768e573d"}
