{"id": "p_0c3cbc5fa6b5463e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 103, "text": "才、樂留河東，才爲怨家所殺，樂病死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "821bfdfde6388e8be9b0d8c726c5567d880c824e2c1f5fe4f7d1707a8c85469f"}

{"id": "p_75672bd678414a83", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 104, "text": "遂、騰自還涼州，更相寇，後騰入爲衞尉，子超領其部曲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "57bdf63f3dd97a2f4e43d659c0c0f276972e5e9a19bfcdd06b146710c6a63a18"}

{"id": "p_3fc6fa91501f0870", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 105, "text": "十六年，超與關中諸將及遂等反，太祖征破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "4fbc778215878a45110b2861edbe46f98c1401fc17d0d4d8f72f70b5e7482c03"}

{"id": "p_654aa84454ffa517", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 106, "text": "趙衢等舉義兵討超，超走漢中從張魯，後奔劉備，死於蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "ddc5f5e0a9511cab199fed2adca42d1b0ae124781c31668867606b2d89661f99"}

{"id": "p_c77da9190a54d11a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 107, "text": "袁紹字本初，汝南汝陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "77abdf89b7d1cc2964b5b154a4d1e125b4e69f0680d2879dfe9ef5876c44dec1"}

{"id": "p_03ed9d116879782a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 108, "text": "自安以下四世居三公位，由是勢傾天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "81de1f76427e9d9d5261885db458e05c2bceaab833e61570633a5d3206237fff"}

{"id": "p_c5c547685e2d14a4", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 109, "text": "紹有姿皃威容，能折節下士，士多附之，太祖少與交焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "35f12c651971086b41aeaca5651bb7e25bb1263f415b8b1fd268a53295e3e762"}

{"id": "p_0cab6f37acce0633", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 110, "text": "以大將軍掾爲侍御史，稍遷中軍校尉，至司隷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "a0123e34948d024a9666e39894469323890e7cf475177881976993459838fe78"}

{"id": "p_a22ea380dfee03cf", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 111, "text": "靈帝崩，太后兄大將軍何進與紹謀誅諸閹官，太后不從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "d75b732549f8e09aebc817c3a7d0d1362c4e4772c041358bb1e06c7b6011710c"}

{"id": "p_bb9d1d7d83ae986a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 112, "text": "常侍、黃門聞之，皆詣進謝，唯所錯置。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "d11572014e2ffb07d6c453e93c0ab08ba6663f6732d1bd35755c8bbf2564e896"}

{"id": "p_9beda8e44a32aebc", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 113, "text": "時紹勸進便可於此決之，至于再三，而進不許，令紹使洛陽方略武吏檢司諸宦者，又令紹弟虎賁中郎將術選溫厚虎賁二百人，當入禁中，代持兵黃門陛守門戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "37cbf0dd29b1279c06f43bc5c11528c2c1dccd2f791f5016094f560cad5f52ec"}

{"id": "p_7405a4dc6dfe3d4d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 114, "text": "中常侍段珪等矯太后命，召進入議，遂殺之，宮中亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "2cb400b7bceb1b73c0e5e5236557e504d49ddaf41f8f1916e5412b4b067557bd"}

{"id": "p_79d9497923df3cb7", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 115, "text": "術將虎賁燒南宮嘉德殿青瑣門，欲以迫出珪等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "171d988d74ca9d14308abd1a2288c1948fef4fc0af8db26c842eda561c46b70f"}

{"id": "p_67d029a5e9eec20e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 116, "text": "珪等不出，劫帝及帝弟陳留王走小平津。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "78e62f683a007b18f6b28451ff5d783545e8758fc4b7160ca6b480b537a3b746"}

{"id": "p_d7e088355719a476", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 117, "text": "紹旣斬宦者所署司隷校尉許相，遂勒兵捕諸閹人，無少長皆殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "d5e928c2ff834ba4f323b58cfc6156eabd461bc4d1a9b2edbabc653f83bf80cd"}

{"id": "p_1830b35d7a1b3e44", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 118, "text": "或有無鬚而誤死者，至自發露形體而後得免，宦者或有行善自守而猶見及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "2cbbe18086f179e4a8328e8e6e381578b12547d97f051a5309c1f2569bb0b48d"}

{"id": "p_73687e060dba9a3f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 119, "text": "急追珪等，珪等悉赴河死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "27cf73b1006e07b1d55624f80d1f70cd73be89af5eff46b681c8eb8b2d9445ca"}

{"id": "p_fbeb51e646b3daaa", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 120, "text": "董卓呼紹，議欲廢帝，立陳留王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "5e48d914a19d3e0ad5faa047f20e2e64e3e791f4cfc85a8b1625bfce7c3237ed"}

{"id": "p_0f01fbd1b16d754b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 121, "text": "是時紹叔父隗爲太傅，紹偽許之，曰：「此大事，出當與太傅議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "93bdeafce1f86bffec1273abc9184027903c8d151e650e669042bb61b2a498ab"}

{"id": "p_b02ab3b16b9c2b4f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 122, "text": "」卓曰：「劉氏種不足復遺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "dfe4491cadf1d1a133214444cc4fbdac6f431296527c24a525f90059dffe82e6"}

{"id": "p_116da274f0bdd846", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」紹不應，橫刀長揖而去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "66666f797f6afcbc9b8b473e8537b5e918840c8729bd5e72f244ab21d76db02d"}

{"id": "p_dfe6fe12650d5eff", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 124, "text": "侍中周毖、城門校尉伍瓊、議郎何顒等，皆名士也，卓信之，而陰爲紹，乃說卓曰：「夫廢立大事，非常人所及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "f75a0813a51f7a684e796428eb610cb2ce14affaf596e51f583633a31de99d5f"}

{"id": "p_c86ee768487af99b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 125, "text": "紹不達大體，恐懼故出奔，非有他志也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "ce3cef6ee203f4578c8731e4a84936f6e10dc9fc7c35585c9669865e983d514c"}

{"id": "p_ba306498b30b78ac", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 126, "text": "袁氏樹恩四世，門世故吏徧於天下，若収豪傑以聚徒衆，英雄因之而起，則山東非公之有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "3d171e6fe80e0f1822e3aee1e7d2783576fcf889b03ae605546d37a03dbd040d"}

{"id": "p_84fc060004731a9b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 127, "text": "不如赦之，拜一郡守，則紹喜於免罪，必無患矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "fb48b68ba502941060226f803f0a00ef81407b9802ae20ef3c4232ebc5195c29"}

{"id": "p_610889b7a4418083", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 128, "text": "」卓以爲然，乃拜紹勃海太守，封邟鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "e72073b1375bb8ee22b2ff22e6721a65460be5603637c93c62e28ee35d99722d"}

{"id": "p_0828c7684d599c92", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 129, "text": "紹遂以勃海起兵，將以誅卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "bd50db57d45f61bf420dfccdb3913a4a382e2ba0b44628de906578a0bc9d9648"}

{"id": "p_b6d6d209483d163a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 130, "text": "紹自號車騎將軍，主盟，與冀州牧韓馥立幽州牧劉虞爲帝，遣使奉章詣虞，虞不敢受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "a7bf332b897304e357c452df18c517e37c3ed3080e223d0bfca9e0de24acd418"}

{"id": "p_a9f14e1d9472e815", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 131, "text": "後馥軍安平，爲公孫瓚所敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "f51bdb624c67a5f3e17ac612e0594db285ce8ee248a2f45d0841701b897f0fe8"}

{"id": "p_4a5cbcd6418e038e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 132, "text": "瓚遂引兵入冀州，以討卓爲名，內欲襲馥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "48847dcdffc2b9f4877b7f7f56bebbb1bf5da6ab532c726a3043d698b7f8e821"}

{"id": "p_0a310dfe29e343c6", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 133, "text": "會卓西入關，紹還軍延津，因馥惶遽，使陳留高幹、頴川荀諶等說馥曰：「公孫瓚乘勝來向南，而諸郡應之，袁車騎引軍東向，此其意不可知，竊爲將軍危之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "3453c392f7d6f709ff0126c5e13c6d7a15dd3661a82d599ff139e937bd198ca6"}

{"id": "p_29000909ae4c9cac", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 134, "text": "」諶曰：「公孫提燕、代之卒，其鋒不可當。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "99938bd2d83d7ba25b14b08ed26f6d04a3c73279fde44682cd04a835bb098d02"}

{"id": "p_94f41f8415772b44", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 135, "text": "袁氏一時之傑，必不爲將軍下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "3527420c8b830b723772ef98b7ab3634524ac766f4b330b44ca155d960691212"}

{"id": "p_ccc8ec6c380fe0fa", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 136, "text": "夫冀州，天下之重資也，若兩雄并力，兵交於城下，危亡可立而待也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "7928ddd6da030b1ff4a14c181c02df3a9c3996117ad85cab1b6e616ab90714c6"}

{"id": "p_f6a4b000437f33b6", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 137, "text": "夫袁氏，將軍之舊，且同盟也，當今爲將軍計，莫若舉冀州以讓袁氏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "16a67916e957bc98d7bfbecb31f642a8cc4586a978a1cebce02377235a7035b9"}

{"id": "p_67d12fbbae34a0bb", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 138, "text": "袁氏得冀州，則瓚不能與之爭，必厚德將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "a6e520ddec782017d4f615406021a79226f3cad828ec560eff4feaf478709d29"}

{"id": "p_727161ac0378a43b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 139, "text": "冀州入於親交，是將軍有讓賢之名，而身安於泰山也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "1138d34aadb47f22f1fcfef7a641498a6f211ead689988bea43cb91070d45168"}

{"id": "p_bdb7c82d6ffeed26", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 140, "text": "馥長史耿武、別駕閔純、治中李歷諫馥曰：「冀州雖鄙，帶甲百萬，穀支十年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "7a2e597f8803b26bf8d082132729a9707604a5595c29d3ef5c7a33a21cfbb4b7"}

{"id": "p_52b71700df5f8109", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 141, "text": "袁紹孤客窮軍，仰我鼻息，譬如嬰兒在股掌之上，絕其哺乳，立可餓殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "2c430ec13139153fa03b6acbf8cb3be7fc0970b8bc927b523c1da50084f43742"}

{"id": "p_76f6d46e4d24bb79", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 142, "text": "」馥曰：「吾，袁氏故吏，且才不如本初，度德而讓，古人所貴，諸君獨何病焉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "cef101c1f9c9df273a5ee0ec988d27efdab824f54c3e7e553d31c9dc8e8265e1"}

{"id": "p_634e3009576641f9", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 143, "text": "」從事趙浮、程奐請以兵拒之，馥又不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "79cde1379c7554c993516cb96b29788a970b74a7b1b28ed69e09fa170884fc8a"}

{"id": "p_3a6cd9e604c6940d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 144, "text": "從事沮授說紹曰：「將軍弱冠登朝，則播名海內；值廢立之際，則忠義奮發；單騎出奔，則董卓懷怖；濟河而北，則勃海稽首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "5dee8c5d977f7c9f8251563452ca8caef0b213da5ed35fdf7928f683bb21dbfd"}

{"id": "p_9187abe18a319104", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 145, "text": "振一郡之卒，撮冀州之衆，威震河朔，名重天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "6523bca0489cf2e13af9219e1b850eb1f3cab508ddea4a48df6a504467f45756"}

{"id": "p_a8398ffd1678ac6b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 146, "text": "雖黃巾猾亂，黑山跋扈，舉軍東向，則青州可定；還討黑山，則張燕可滅；回衆北首，則公孫必喪；震脅戎狄，則匈奴必從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "83d90193ec4eb9fbdbd776c7cb8dbdb9848fd04a1323e77af63a1b976e303a6f"}

{"id": "p_8e3a3d77a9d9bb78", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 147, "text": "橫大河之北，合四州之地，收英雄之才，擁百萬之衆，迎大駕於西京，復宗廟於洛邑，號令天下，以討未復，以此爭鋒，誰能敵之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "e44dcfc017bb1bcc02ce2c0f16cb3075012b6ca06468769896e6c6bbfd01dbe5"}

{"id": "p_ab56ba695c4cde8f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」即表授爲監軍、奮威將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "e1a39a1eae1f7725e0a455f934a3c9d14772261fad78a5643f61e8ce1d35547f"}

{"id": "p_1ffa973c15d7ec94", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 149, "text": "卓遣執金吾胡母班、將作大匠吳脩齎詔書喻紹，紹使河內太守王匡殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "895ccf7f742900788205fcb101c088f1b66707c59fe99b63b0170d57e8d87853"}

{"id": "p_6e7f653c28b61854", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 150, "text": "卓聞紹得關東，乃悉誅紹宗族太傅隗等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "1bf697411f390c4e3c90d730fb340c77b9abf30e9f370c54c40bfb577892ff12"}

{"id": "p_7d10df5e76428a45", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 151, "text": "當是時，豪俠多附紹，皆思爲之報，州郡鋒起，莫不假其名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "854227d94d63273a40a352b5faa12e82a1a88d4417b807214e9215e358a29b36"}

{"id": "p_1ef3c986e28486ee", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 152, "text": "馥懷懼，從紹索去，往依張邈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "f0cd399d8c0576f62eb78c9dfaa57f955e4fa9db16744c6d8aa3edfe1dff21c6"}

{"id": "p_c9cc825f9298083f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 153, "text": "後紹遣使詣邈，有所計議，與邈耳語。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "b5a9fffec75aaeeb50acea18d76de963905e4624bbe55492ad9d77496ef97ba4"}

{"id": "p_18849eb6ee0433c8", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 154, "text": "馥在坐上，謂見圖構，無何起至溷自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "831b0237e692caa37fc4cfd3ba1c097d28dc78c33a78258888c7a353b04e9e7d"}

{"id": "p_4a519e053d74a2dc", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 155, "text": "初，天子之立非紹意，及在河東，紹遣潁川郭圖使焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "69d832715241b05f6f37ce5d4542e1821022812015fe24e1d5b81c690e781fac"}

{"id": "p_16635aa384be19eb", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 156, "text": "圖還說紹迎天子都鄴，紹不從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "ef02326443311af50cdebcec04ad20a5b90b0b72b6e732a7ea62d171908a57de"}

{"id": "p_1399d6eac869923a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 157, "text": "會太祖迎天子都許，收河南地，關中皆附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "4f0f96fbfaf9a4799b2796b82f0d3ee5247faa98196b1545dfb3a7c9c5b07b39"}

{"id": "p_1622ba8d20e649c0", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 158, "text": "紹悔，欲令太祖徙天子都鄄城以自密近，太祖拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "3e732d9ecb14eae4520cf7ceca4818df9fad068d224cb90d7824265b7beba62d"}

{"id": "p_f1517eb9d0cd8e52", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 159, "text": "天子以紹爲太尉，轉爲大將軍，封鄴侯，紹讓侯不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "de003798ee308c18ce5e6c8d0c5a57bffa43f41950cc8289254e28a5274812dc"}

{"id": "p_36fe457d2e5a340d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 160, "text": "出長子譚爲青州，沮授諫紹：「必爲禍始。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "4529b6d97118d35d87c081281812cd86e76605143b1d2ac2e6bf64a5416d4f04"}

{"id": "p_d20c899f9ef20640", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 161, "text": "」紹不聽，曰：「孤欲令諸兒各據一州也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "edfae6e56af42bc17e406d94b437773d27b4a157eaf8a19c525db1a8507a7b75"}

{"id": "p_fb71f999106f4c78", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 162, "text": "」又以中子熙爲幽州，甥高幹爲并州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "0179ded9a43b7aa7345def82170ba7442402cc6153f63f172469d333796026d7"}

{"id": "p_27ebf1f942808489", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 163, "text": "衆數十萬，以審配、逢紀統軍事，田豐、荀諶、許攸爲謀主，顏良、文醜爲將率，簡精卒十萬，騎萬匹，將攻許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "4f5f594fe6aaac81fcb6d3ba56968134b736161696f0d3ff79f5958add4d5287"}

{"id": "p_2fd3fc9e53f7a3f7", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 164, "text": "先是，太祖遣劉備詣徐州拒袁術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "de8e4c49a9cfaadf08e878b2a19ba5c96ce1fb2c6c43d928b73e3af8992752c0"}

{"id": "p_de8744595afbea4f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 165, "text": "術死，備殺刺史車冑，引軍屯沛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "2bd9e63f06e3d43700fb46272f5129e8efc77c83dabe3231a9fdd2c8ac786915"}

{"id": "p_0159a1863dbfdad2", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 166, "text": "太祖遣劉岱、王忠擊之，不克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "6a95cd6195bb44074895a2b6f0e1f3e51ec8cb1f0d528f6428ca4fb4a0ffd036"}

{"id": "p_43833635a8e57251", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 167, "text": "田豐說紹襲太祖後，紹辭以子疾，不許，豐舉杖擊地曰：「夫遭難遇之機，而以嬰兒之病失其會，惜哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "69906e2c24d8847bccb4d01d9386c61e592041c36d1004e6d484725328fc7af7"}

{"id": "p_187a114e84d5cf14", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 168, "text": "」太祖至，擊破備；備奔紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "04e6f3ff0d5d5617ae226ce8c2d1f4159f0a9fecb92ce2fc865fbc527cb7be32"}

{"id": "p_5479a67b5b0d3212", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 169, "text": "紹進軍黎陽，遣顏良攻劉延於白馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "c1bd0fcfe31b3b22a58998aa2dadde9970c8d5a87c86d115c20c3bd498533461"}

{"id": "p_b73e34fdc7a3fb11", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 170, "text": "沮授又諫紹：「良性促狹，雖驍勇不可獨任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "74adafb090ced9999a72a3495318ec141a8d58555458d69769b4c02676d73219"}

{"id": "p_f63249cf4a341d13", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 171, "text": "太祖救延，與良戰，破斬良。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "065aff3b8585805a209f9e2eae168978acf2bdb128e99d3b81c61a0c9a3e91ba"}

{"id": "p_18b1d9b7cc31a373", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 172, "text": "紹渡河，壁延津南，使劉備、文醜挑戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "b37a679920560b249154cfa3c0ea775885edb33caa6ae0696ad8ccdce936d915"}

{"id": "p_237581543ab7b633", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 173, "text": "太祖擊破之，斬醜，再戰，禽紹大將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "f95223a6104d8ee06cd316255b672af4916980e51383614c6d0f78bcf7b3fe5e"}

{"id": "p_579b261c21ab7d6e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 174, "text": "沮授又曰：「北兵數衆而果勁不及南，南穀虛少而貨財不及北；南利在於急戰，北利在於緩搏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "66995d2068df7490f4aa6eee6c73dec79ff6834713cec17402ea8c3e10ceb447"}

{"id": "p_612715056988e2b7", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 175, "text": "連營稍前，逼官渡，合戰，太祖軍不利，復壁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "697dec77ae0ea4d44d3c6e7993b9466d0df30ac9cd3cc64d0080b6fa89433688"}

{"id": "p_ceef8a99923cfaf8", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 176, "text": "紹爲高櫓，起土山，射營中，營中皆蒙楯，衆大懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "e6373f0e3ec1f2870b8fbc60fdde8e6fb1be7aa141914ff5465c53407be35003"}

{"id": "p_7bd8c79677ae56c8", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 177, "text": "太祖乃爲發石車，擊紹樓，皆破，紹衆號曰霹靂車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "f0c3246d62c3c060438e3678b50388ba48cfa940c1f15f5f3d48292f0adfbe89"}

{"id": "p_9842c320524b9edd", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 178, "text": "太祖輙於內爲長塹以拒之，又遣奇兵襲擊紹運車，大破之，盡焚其穀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "c3c270bdf2bd94be436cfb4fd48898e353232c294366a471dd9a6718d9cb9ca0"}

{"id": "p_e9a1595056284914", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 179, "text": "太祖與紹相持日久，百姓疲乏，多叛應紹，軍食乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "deab14e7b54572e8775525c2a1e5fc927dc75ce8a7d6657234a3d4845b487992"}

{"id": "p_2a67da4523b6ca0e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 180, "text": "會紹遣淳于瓊等將兵萬餘人北迎運車，沮授說紹：「可遣將蔣奇別爲支軍於表，以斷曹公之鈔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "2cd49f9beeb871e339df965dcc977866d81ac73d726d558f1d6645324336130f"}

{"id": "p_eba8a49b993a48d3", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 181, "text": "瓊宿烏巢，去紹軍四十里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "d8be3fc72dd1ed610c2b5960c2930455223ef214e1de4be7cb1c425857a07dc2"}

{"id": "p_e3f11a0c67ea261a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 182, "text": "太祖乃留曹洪守，自將步騎五千候夜潛往攻瓊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "2a63bed651c86540cac8e2440a8e7fed550a2e51129fc953d5ce7ca1a5929a22"}

{"id": "p_a92120ce7c615dce", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 183, "text": "太祖還，未至營，紹將高覽、張郃等率其衆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "95a7678af0b1bbf6fe0746df895f869360c46190f651e470d7ca595dea334eef"}

{"id": "p_2ba3400e6167fda2", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 184, "text": "紹衆大潰，紹與譚單騎退渡河。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "a61301e15ff3bbd9781e55667f9b2644378c081d4ed0fbad60e9d35b47de2863"}

{"id": "p_4b9022c5333d8a4d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 185, "text": "沮授不及紹渡，爲人所執，詣太祖，太祖厚待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "26fc0863c86307a108575b2bb63c911793f0929bf4af4a4aea581a3eecc7fb47"}

{"id": "p_609a7413cb3181af", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 186, "text": "初，紹之南也，田豐說紹曰：「曹公善用兵，變化無方，衆雖少，未可輕也，不如以久持之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "a1c0629ee49accb544aae5edb623323ec62b6edeb4fa997ca1502a470a40f55c"}

{"id": "p_2b9725f7e63d6434", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 187, "text": "將軍據山河之固，擁四州之衆，外結英雄，內脩農戰，然後簡其精銳，分爲奇兵，乘虛迭出，以擾河南，救右則擊其左，救左則擊其右，使敵疲於奔命，民不得安業；我未勞而彼已困，不及二年，可坐克也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "f60444d0a324a1f90b1444f1096696eea3c63f1b2a078bc4f46dfa477daa4ffa"}

{"id": "p_b5af20ed1345e43f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 188, "text": "今釋廟勝之策，而決成敗於一戰，若不如志，悔無及也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "4c6a50163065a4b222db80bbd791e37539fbeef7e83bb8d6732a871d4ad67e13"}

{"id": "p_e47df2183a2ca11b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 189, "text": "豐懇諫，紹怒甚，以爲沮衆，械繫之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "836e10678056adaa0e13760254147b31cbb7087a658fc15260be833d63dd5ac2"}

{"id": "p_65959579f6674d20", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 190, "text": "紹軍旣敗，或謂豐曰：「君必見重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "534c603306fd63f63c28c6d2e124cbe6dd4e83de693a3c2d3557c496b0363d72"}

{"id": "p_cbd0fb0bc4914446", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 191, "text": "」豐曰：「若軍有利，吾必全，今軍敗，吾其死矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "c8d7b6bf420ec9c70ddd27b370096bb2d45f80da2d8fc1a437e8968665f70e14"}

{"id": "p_bc9683fbca49ac3a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 192, "text": "」紹還，謂左右曰：「吾不用田豐言，果爲所笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "332a746ac95a4f43472b38ac06a6986fc19522cd9c675694bac5d4581aa32b4a"}

{"id": "p_563de3ad2d98c93b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 193, "text": "紹外寬雅，有局度，憂喜不形於色，而內多忌害，皆此類也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "a93a336798c1a3d66dfc76329e56cb06c95ca70b63821c1930023fd55da28ee6"}

{"id": "p_51a8945f7880aeb3", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 194, "text": "冀州城邑多叛，紹復擊定之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "ffb6dd3d80820b969b7593fbfbc09a40fdd0685122bbf73142f132bebed6f5f2"}

{"id": "p_1e11598d173b84cf", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 195, "text": "自軍敗後發病，七年，憂死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "959af9a11dc601a02cc96d9e4e9ebec2d895899979a05a1eb8078ed06fe108a1"}

{"id": "p_ce462284ac997997", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 196, "text": "===子 譚、熙、尚===", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "0d6d826b9e5cad405c7bb2bedc821c464c8ddcf280b3cc6d3b3c1d66dae9a174"}

{"id": "p_7869bb9dda90965f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 197, "text": "紹愛少子尚，皃美，欲以爲後而未顯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "9918d433dbf9edf1f04c33875ac6cd08889d649c53b3a0c7fbba21a625222906"}

{"id": "p_59c344bc62490d64", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 198, "text": "審配、逢紀與辛評、郭圖爭權，配、紀與尚比，評、圖與譚比。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "32e72ab1bc478336e0b50559ab5b3658846d6a0c224799d318b307bb75979e15"}

{"id": "p_bc60896125062d7f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 199, "text": "配等恐譚立而評等爲己害，緣紹素意，乃奉尚代紹位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "bc86fa0fc47d3dedd2555b08dcb232de9025ca48816dde8e8a4b516fdd2a83e6"}

{"id": "p_15f7fb16822aab21", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 200, "text": "譚至，不得立，自號車騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "2b9b6ce25fda6a0499d1af31547f2b74f2e64ec153a0213f0546470d4f701d35"}

{"id": "p_592103893a9bc89d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 201, "text": "譚軍黎陽，尚少與譚兵，而使逢紀從譚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "6694fa2905d916df47395a4c4514951fe87d82e8a0ba231af7c2b7433176ce6d"}

{"id": "p_47b805515ba99b49", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 202, "text": "太祖渡河攻譚，譚告急於尚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "8b35b40d77348460216fa2245308b75c5473ed09d9099fa578643a60ea749841"}

{"id": "p_99140f489cb31e60", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 203, "text": "尚欲分兵益譚，恐譚遂奪其衆，乃使審配守鄴，尚自將兵助譚，與太祖相拒於黎陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "a63eb8dbb2ddc83d376244ae50dfa6b2195e7ffc4172ccbab1bb3549eaeaa66a"}

{"id": "p_b7d1c5b7664df851", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 204, "text": "自二月至九月，大戰城下，譚、尚敗退，入城守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "42e1dedab6025e81de4a4e71148c17f551e04345344307ead5bd478714dcbb44"}

{"id": "p_dd645fa86e4194fe", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 205, "text": "追至鄴，收其麥，拔陰安，引軍還許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "e2ab385ad6093a3908343cc345c42e38181843a43575fab11483d63c73d7b11c"}

{"id": "p_d25262e8ab46f91b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 206, "text": "太祖南征荊州，軍至西平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "ffac4fba831cd9adac6cbab60daefe418a94d153b3debf186ba83c35440ee34c"}

{"id": "p_b10c40cb9596ca12", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 207, "text": "譚、尚遂舉兵相攻，譚敗奔平原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "4b1eca0221ac3c90658385f8b28986e4f97759aa7d6253cbec5d62cba199117f"}

{"id": "p_bb1d8ee9657944b6", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 208, "text": "尚攻之急，譚遣辛毗詣太祖請救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "19f25ef78578b6a2c59ffdc43df388fb59eae1cf1a783ff951a766b76883aee3"}

{"id": "p_074b44bb00b7251d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 209, "text": "太祖乃還救譚，十月至黎陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "caf0699672c62f56aa777b8668c50e1d2129b262525d48d648df4f697212a5a9"}

{"id": "p_cffda0a00ddd996d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 210, "text": "尚聞太祖北，釋平原還鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "d7fe84e6701eefa0933918107754f7f01101883ecdfbc5d1387f641d884310fe"}

{"id": "p_e7d44129d5fabcd6", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 211, "text": "其將呂曠、呂翔叛尚歸太祖，譚復陰刻將軍印假曠、翔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "2e72d3b695fd9db6030121611151c69f8b5d004ba3c3087b14a366449241e2f8"}

{"id": "p_1fda3df8b1fb16f4", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 212, "text": "太祖知譚詐，與結婚以安之，乃引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "03935d1e9f2b5284d70e877541e2a381dd5e8385469f2a1f33508aca11e08443"}

{"id": "p_ec137ee7ee8fb5b8", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 213, "text": "尚使審配、蘇由守鄴，復攻譚平原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "8688553c8bb7952ab7b8711ddf13b0a8e1f5aa6e5294bfa17580814877f65893"}

{"id": "p_ce203c81dc341f56", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 214, "text": "太祖進軍將攻鄴，到洹水，去鄴五十里，由欲爲內應，謀泄，與配戰城中，敗，出奔太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "e12c0f1b1b74b7319b7cfdc461290c6c69e791aed62755d4fd85645cee7fed00"}

{"id": "p_bad1235f375c6b99", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 215, "text": "太祖遂進攻之，爲地道，配亦於內作塹以當之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "3cb35f62abcdbeed8a4c74540e4c9c81dc04d413e633625a936dcc64b791eca0"}

{"id": "p_4fe9fbde9cb99993", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 216, "text": "配將馮禮開突門，內太祖兵三百餘人，配覺之，從城上以大石擊突中柵門，柵門閉，入者皆沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "8c726d5d2513599ffaaebf269564074322429518fee904b17c3e44b6eb69517b"}

{"id": "p_419832e0b444d3ba", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 217, "text": "太祖遂圍之，爲塹，周四十里，初令淺，示若可越。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "69e31f902002ce923ebbd161a1b86f0652643b00b9af5f230ba128be12bd704a"}

{"id": "p_5736112d1fd2a782", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 218, "text": "太祖一夜掘之，廣深二丈，決漳水以灌之，自五月至八月，城中餓死者過半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "f19eed73c30603818a6696ae0497d9b64ab3c93a29f8923897866718f9b61f47"}

{"id": "p_eba8b6211bbcd79b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 219, "text": "尚聞鄴急，將兵萬餘人還救之，依西山來，東至陽平亭，去鄴十七里，臨滏水，舉火以示城中，城中亦舉火相應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "2e8d2987d0cd268d7d787e8018fe7edd85899361fd5a17ec4829f1d782d56d31"}

{"id": "p_fb9f0fa01b359854", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 220, "text": "配出兵城北，欲與尚對決圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "a6228e5488ef546b10e0f93414f16bf535c1a2c912d77c113f55c6511e005921"}

{"id": "p_e53f583282f30d08", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 221, "text": "太祖逆擊之，敗還，尚亦破走，依曲漳爲營，太祖遂圍之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "89c02cefa14d08328040e9444b3b69534812eaea6a27c520d322f05c8b919cf3"}

{"id": "p_d80ee62f9d37848a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 222, "text": "未合，尚懼，遣陰夔、陳琳乞降，不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "719e8e226cf41c17da01019c36b3f27a3630032692dffa9eec89c4b87cd08564"}

{"id": "p_188848e08f823e2e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 223, "text": "尚還走濫口，進復圍之急，其將馬延等臨陣降，衆大潰，尚奔中山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "2b4678f121984ba37d138147747a87559cdb67f9d93554eb2703ed4aef9f1fdf"}

{"id": "p_94996d6e0fedb419", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 224, "text": "盡收其輜重，得尚印綬、節鉞及衣物，以示其家，城中崩沮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "64a05006c18c42c74f99aa7400b6baf74a72eb09948f8282b2e142493447ab1c"}

{"id": "p_41a1fe547a7a01a3", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 225, "text": "配兄子榮守東門，夜開門內太祖兵，與配戰城中，生禽配。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "fe8af03ece3561eb5d3e37ce1774c4c345132d7ec2ef5d2e25e15026ae1dbd8f"}

{"id": "p_9249904d6e939770", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 226, "text": "配聲氣壯烈，終無撓辭，見者莫不歎息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "0e3f060826279535a64d39dbab51793345ac82c446db5aad3fec1510a677d27c"}

{"id": "p_053511ee88834d86", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 227, "text": "高幹以并州降，復以幹爲刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "f139c8586ab82061ae447350f45f41bbd95ff887c085fac749b5fab5dbe6a3f3"}

{"id": "p_025a0908e33d19fd", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 228, "text": "太祖之圍鄴也，譚略取甘陵、安平、勃海、河間，攻尚於中山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "e5ab25ff536757e2133a8cfc6b7870518f433ca6e62d4de17ad4924a6da0d26a"}

{"id": "p_783d4055b50f0e8b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 229, "text": "尚走故安從熙，譚悉收其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "3e915ac535efa5514d186aa3aace07cde1b501d9cee1c7a9e0077dbf5977beec"}

{"id": "p_783fd5b171430005", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 230, "text": "太祖將討之，譚乃拔平原，并南皮，自屯龍湊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "dab72f03e09dfc223bbfe22e1f99766d485969b4d4da4baa4fcc8e1619d52f9b"}

{"id": "p_106799e255d3f900", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 231, "text": "十二月，太祖軍其門，譚不出，夜遁奔南皮，臨清河而屯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "bb98e7197237683f52bbf452680f45df1805706e6ae6732a042711234e602eee"}

{"id": "p_cb956c9132721531", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 232, "text": "十年正月，攻拔之，斬譚及圖等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "058ffffc6f9ab6d03b1382d59d37ad83f6891b30c6ce6934bdbb02b8ad08f7e2"}

{"id": "p_9bfbc0d108267273", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 233, "text": "熙、尚爲其將焦觸、張南所攻，奔遼西烏丸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "89bd38ca2914b8de4fa1de0d163be91c121c7160e169f1eeea8ad8e07921c3d0"}

{"id": "p_0b77ff09082f06fd", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 234, "text": "觸自號幽州刺史，驅率諸郡太守令長，背袁向曹，陳兵數萬，殺白馬盟，令曰：「違命者斬！", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "64199e30c6298a909876c212b51d2a67d2ba10642047e1195c68250b583582df"}

{"id": "p_a58d68f1a4a35690", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 235, "text": "至別駕韓珩，曰：「吾受袁公父子厚恩，今其破亡，智不能救，勇不能死，於義闕矣；若乃北靣於曹氏，所弗能爲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "3f6ec4229b20b0dbb2d12068826b75dbd1a4f61cca80a5b122e70ba7206ef07d"}

{"id": "p_664134ac1acff87d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 236, "text": "觸曰：「夫興大事，當立大義，事之濟否，不待一人，可卒珩志，以勵事君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "0d430101e98965cdf5f7899544bccfa76c355ba78157e6769764dd0d55c35998"}

{"id": "p_fca15358f651fd90", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 237, "text": "」高幹叛，執上黨太守，舉兵守壺口關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "2c0767372f22b10c828fb1008d138c23dc7d3678b9f1bc4d19ea0077550ad5fa"}

{"id": "p_ffb0858e1fd8587a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 238, "text": "遣樂進、李典擊之，未拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "dfab2bdfe4c7fc7b304ab8f64bfc99f899618cb2a493a07155cb75442a8dcd9f"}

{"id": "p_44435447f1180641", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 239, "text": "幹乃留其將夏昭、鄧升守城，自詣匈奴單于求救，不得，獨與數騎亡，欲南奔荊州，上洛都尉捕斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "b5629b2ed2088d67fb5e4963157ec6b4e07e12d4a2eb454299a9ec61034b7c9a"}

{"id": "p_2989b19150b793e2", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 240, "text": "十二年，太祖至遼西擊烏丸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "ef8e53957a94e86f029d37cd52c359e430758b1aee8fd02a77d3890ea82afd61"}

{"id": "p_e4d45194f0a0ba86", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 241, "text": "尚、熙與烏丸逆軍戰，敗走奔遼東，公孫康誘斬之，送其首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "e378901ea0886e240f78f14e280b23bf6edcd24523f01498aa25af33f3e88b79"}

{"id": "p_18f352bb91bbc97d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 242, "text": "太祖高韓珩節，屢辟不至，卒於家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "f01c28bbf4cc81f3ec1fa8f66a3d25aa9c8eddd877653b016e6106304e221cfa"}

{"id": "p_24e8546a9663b688", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 243, "text": "袁術字公路，司空逢子，紹之從弟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "e09722b88a1b2e177c83894082ca321c7f27e74c029b56930b997c92e5364838"}

{"id": "p_c7ca3d480604063d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 244, "text": "舉孝廉，除郎中，歷職內外，後爲折衝校尉、虎賁中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "86f3ed211e5bbb01090321e0febfb8d257d73182810c00667822616fc08bd171"}

{"id": "p_8d6dd2538ee6723e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 245, "text": "董卓之將廢帝，以術爲後將軍；術亦畏卓之禍，出奔南陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "51d7ce4304c841a105ed008947a48f71279c3715d3788751148e143929e68b2e"}

{"id": "p_375f63a6786b5682", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 246, "text": "會長沙太守孫堅殺南陽太守張咨，術得據其郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "c49e047891fca616ea244fd81295e2b3e9add3a6c03057042731d5e5b06b3235"}

{"id": "p_081f29d3a6534533", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 247, "text": "南陽戶口數百萬，而術奢淫肆欲，徵斂無度，百姓苦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "69cff93aeda8cadf614bd393d9a4f44cbf3652c221469b31c7a649bf818d3322"}

{"id": "p_c92f8a56356b573b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 248, "text": "旣與紹有隙，又與劉表不平而北連公孫瓚；紹與瓚不和而南連劉表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "beb5df180861e67d3a21f537e223dd00b0420c1d8d58327428d835fdeb9f200a"}

{"id": "p_f65ee93259653440", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 249, "text": "其兄弟攜貳，舍近交遠如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "1f1bc170520df2171d5ec84f6ae99bdab40444f81e89b61870b43c9b4eea763d"}

{"id": "p_382f77da7e239492", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 250, "text": "太祖與紹合擊，大破術軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "9d83fb613efec31784552d49b8a70199e3f0af49ea6ad7e31b326fb92f80d512"}

{"id": "p_77d08604f3be3bb2", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 251, "text": "術以餘衆奔九江，殺楊州刺史陳溫，領其州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "4099e577ed4b559140ba45e29766960955c96ef993ee7801025a4bef487fd4c8"}

{"id": "p_aba51f9fea1b1144", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 252, "text": "以張勳、橋蕤等爲大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "068658a8b2643be68ae4128a2735411fd07433974f39ef1a54c24d0007d00553"}

{"id": "p_6d0d9c440ee6f6de", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 253, "text": "李傕入長安，欲結術爲援，以術爲左將軍，封陽翟侯，假節，遣太傅馬日磾因循行拜授。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "4f4e0dc396eca931864cbed71fb9acabc085f2957a5bd16e44dafc79e82240ab"}

{"id": "p_449a7064cf2ca464", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 254, "text": "時沛相下邳陳珪，故太尉球弟子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "f0bc9bf09255c395ac0fdaffd3d03c2f4e4a82fefa7431abbd70f489af914ba4"}

{"id": "p_8f2f85443f404e71", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 255, "text": "術與珪俱公族子孫，少共交游，書與珪曰：「昔秦失其政，天下羣雄爭而取之，兼智勇者卒受其歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "d1c99e54f74439aabcfe3aa723ed72080c1a51096a672007e8754424e2d8b600"}

{"id": "p_625f36ae83bf9235", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 256, "text": "今世事紛擾，復有瓦解之勢矣，誠英乂有爲之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "b7c2b9853f44ce5cbac8751bfd8b7f15aff2620101ac8c38cf00e00ae4cd516e"}

{"id": "p_10bfb0385559908c", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 257, "text": "與足下舊交，豈肯左右之乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "7f2438f1bb0055c3cce4efe174a7c873447c562eab66c531a16003444f584e38"}

{"id": "p_0963a9df947801a4", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 258, "text": "若集大事，子實爲吾心膂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "d5d46c7dbe4169936141803bffcd415832103ac1dafd28862e312a233b061643"}

{"id": "p_2e3cd12195e4f553", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 259, "text": "」珪中子應時在下邳，術並脅質應，圖必致珪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "2e47c33d2c290370a118c01071b51888d1eaf83c8d6fd87fd07b0a850e3d8e61"}

{"id": "p_9e6b9dc88be98a1d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 260, "text": "珪荅書曰：「昔秦末世，肆暴恣情，虐流天下，毒被生民，下不堪命，故遂土崩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "e2d242d51e104d37c6d1bb46785baa722f2f144fa2f25b7ab8801965f00510e3"}

{"id": "p_25c1ae4a9388c876", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 261, "text": "今雖季世，未有亡秦苛暴之亂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "3d59e60da0d44c8a87d4e584b13de5fc61c0e333d4ef1350dbf1043a5b8a31b5"}

{"id": "p_e854a2681d98c9e1", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 262, "text": "曹將軍神武應期，興復典刑，將撥平凶慝，清定海內，信有徵矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "750fb9c24cede66a7c52fafcb681ebc3eba5becbbaf60c3673015a5a5cdb63ad"}

{"id": "p_c0ecb2ab6f60eeb4", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 263, "text": "以爲足下當戮力同心，匡翼漢室，而陰謀不軌，以身試禍，豈不痛哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "0dea0618116e717315c35ed1270b76a3fb3320799a9a7ab7d385e72c736e7180"}

{"id": "p_7db5120c6c2f0e1d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 264, "text": "吾備舊知，故陳至情，雖逆於耳，肉骨之惠也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "3ddc21d496d959b3c868c4c59c00837f35e91d9a97e1a7212dbcf2deab9a6466"}

{"id": "p_fe4b0579b69a75f9", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 265, "text": "欲吾營私阿附，有犯死不能也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "057a5e7de2a9a08c575ce175c906c30aaecef9194d7fc0f11dc86c1c36b4e04a"}

{"id": "p_45f6215d1e3f70dd", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 266, "text": "術會羣下謂曰：「今劉氏微弱，海內鼎沸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "9c050504ca7056ea1ad2a63567c81bc87dc5ea6c73e95b6d2aee9cce9784bbf0"}

{"id": "p_3788eaa47854293c", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 267, "text": "吾家四世公輔，百姓所歸，欲應天順民，於諸君意如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "5ed50790218d72be5ae077d26d004f19618fa41daa31ba8af8f6255ba7799896"}

{"id": "p_e947e26708454b05", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 268, "text": "主簿閻象進曰：「昔周自后稷至于文王，積德累功，參分天下有其二，猶服事殷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "2e3edf4323e7ca9eea04194de8e8f096d1c0891326c79b5cf61c12edfb13516c"}

{"id": "p_2588e1bb8ce36e99", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 269, "text": "明公雖弈世克昌，未若有周之盛，漢室雖微，未若殷紂之暴也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "f0e86657fb2dd05bb7a63975f58ec8bdbcbc07274aa3289bc34a4770937754fe"}

{"id": "p_7bd5f4bd7bb038b7", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 270, "text": "用河內張烱之符命，遂僭號，以九江太守爲淮南尹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "03bc08e4dcbdd2f0b27d3c8f65723fee73e223b71a9ad217e447a5b7a5914d9f"}

{"id": "p_88a1bcd1e1a32957", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 271, "text": "荒侈滋甚，後宮數百皆服綺縠，餘粱肉，而士卒凍餒，江淮間空盡，人民相食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "437bc82681896299cb0042db4dbd31602fa4c5398b999a972be100d27d908b59"}

{"id": "p_d71f846f33910c9b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 272, "text": "術前爲呂布所破，後爲太祖所敗，奔其部曲雷薄、陳蘭於灊山，復爲所拒，憂懼不知所出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "8e7911ba6215d9ba89c92e9a4ce5fb1051758a58a30591ec4f0796c309bd242e"}

{"id": "p_f63f862a4c8fad04", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 273, "text": "將歸帝號於紹，欲至青州從袁譚，發病道死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "1cc7e46ff14ccac4aca5dcdcf6efadb46742ebb6b11598b43df35988f5d88f75"}

{"id": "p_23d76767ded061e9", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 274, "text": "妻子依術故吏廬江太守劉勳，孫策破勳，復見收視。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "74514a737ff5a9db22a094e0ff1835abdb1e6e7b410ae7b714bcb44271235617"}

{"id": "p_91c3b3402475c3d4", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 275, "text": "術女入孫權宮，子燿拜郎中，燿女又配於權子奮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "027ef4f8449796bb3c93a9b6c98fe063dc0315b74967c955c56f4f5fb133eb42"}

{"id": "p_8ca95fe40afcaa83", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 276, "text": "劉表字景升，山陽高平人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "f6fbb5651f377c4692686b680f74d3f3e07f2dbb63ad3cf2748d7acfbf650a9b"}

{"id": "p_2c518e01383e06fd", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 277, "text": "靈帝崩，代王叡爲荊州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "00417d680158faee60d6b21653c0cbba59148c9cce5906a89304cde7e31db283"}

{"id": "p_424978d5e3a7843b", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 278, "text": "是時山東兵起，表亦合兵軍襄陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "f673a716d5fc67ad2d13dbe7a3ae3cc3ba01a626b0d0a759faf5297dafcd5e66"}

{"id": "p_421762a5da003e75", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 279, "text": "袁術之在南陽也，與孫堅合從，欲襲奪表州，使堅攻表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "73128e448fd260bc6b167fe71b0b2df4b1f82a5e3a8d47cd43ab78dabb457578"}

{"id": "p_b76c0be747104163", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 280, "text": "堅爲流矢所中死，軍敗，術遂不能勝表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "bf516d1c5ae9d406ea6543235b131ff633749c313de6c0fca1acbf18e91bc526"}

{"id": "p_db261521619f720e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 281, "text": "李傕、郭汜入長安，欲連表爲援，乃以表爲鎮南將軍、荊州牧，封成武侯，假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "e66b9a0fad72ecc683310ea9cbd76df4b26671f6968b8ca37d2d3b8b5e548224"}

{"id": "p_9553389f0f5bdb0d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 282, "text": "天子都許，表雖遣使貢獻，然北與袁紹相結。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "6a3d4403babcbd473ce300f7bfd091c4a4ca23b8c0d10e4418d53837ddd20c67"}

{"id": "p_8912932cb3d2f2f3", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 283, "text": "治中鄧羲諫表，表不聽，羲辭疾而退，終表之世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "2fdf86089d58b1f22e930382406da2c77c745a2a8e23a5ed4fd2d030314dc2f5"}

{"id": "p_552ceacb28349e59", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 284, "text": "張濟引兵入荊州界，攻穰城，爲流矢所中死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "bf285beeaba2c747b79059e6326db3853816baa1ae39d1b16cce5a29dec68e67"}

{"id": "p_b09a6769dabf0216", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 285, "text": "荊州官屬皆賀，表曰：「濟以窮來，主人無禮，至於交鋒，此非牧意，牧受弔，不受賀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "7f3edc71664ac3d962dda92f31c685ae604f6f46bf3eee90e54e509229867e03"}

{"id": "p_804f91313beef0ca", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 286, "text": "」使人納其衆；衆聞之喜，遂服從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "6d659d23c00cbf3ab4cb9b0067ed94d8cd64cc298ef9bb5504cd3412c6a574b5"}

{"id": "p_79ef48fd37cb3475", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 287, "text": "長沙太守張羨叛表，表圍之連年不下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "6a45f52dc93839af5182c023fee0f263796aedda20e72b0f2e755a1c9f5070fd"}

{"id": "p_0b053327772168d4", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 288, "text": "羨病死，長沙復立其子懌，表遂攻并懌，南收零、桂，北據漢川，地方數千里，帶甲十餘萬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "a14cda2f507f1dc842e22e07cc3f3013540d7c8b7da2a6ffbd484d37d1d4cfb8"}

{"id": "p_adc3f92a17524d5c", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 289, "text": "太祖與袁紹方相持於官渡，紹遣人求助，表許之而不至，亦不佐太祖，欲保江漢間，觀天下變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "ba1d58cb360759ff300e02e9107b72a9544aaa1ceb57bf5d13db7e171691b4ef"}

{"id": "p_808ec8d1be233a40", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 290, "text": "從事中郎韓嵩、別駕劉先說表曰：「豪傑並爭，兩雄相持，天下之重在於將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "e4759e5f2619da233afe32c5bd356651c9e2ced7656b99aece1525cdcc31d898"}

{"id": "p_cb42c1b4dc54e83a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 291, "text": "將軍若欲有爲，起乘其弊可也；若不然，固將擇所從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "b87cba7a22269beb211ade401ade66dd8a8c826ce84c8c4efb79d6dc1233c095"}

{"id": "p_504ffc0f7a16317d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 292, "text": "將軍擁十萬之衆，安坐而觀望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "abe06557a3a9ca3aa0aa57bf2616f68d3af4c8fcb6b33082e2218d58bec21542"}

{"id": "p_48fc1573ace372eb", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 293, "text": "夫見賢而不能助，請和而不得，此兩怨必集於將軍，將軍不得中立矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "44db8b6173633b4865c68e0a5797a3f6485bf97ed24ca925878d543c23a44bda"}

{"id": "p_12331ebcd280b908", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 294, "text": "夫以曹公之明哲，天下賢俊皆歸之，其勢必舉袁紹，然後稱兵以向江漢，恐將軍不能禦也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "2d37127e9039b24d16f90732e0061e788f86f8db9aa36d34d03e365062ad02fc"}

{"id": "p_a7d8c9039bbf50ca", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 295, "text": "故爲將軍計者，不若舉州以附曹公，曹公必重德將軍；長享福祚，垂之後嗣，此萬全之策也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "afc0982ebedc3f5a062cbe42ddaa811e1f041694c40452c4c70437dd26b3dfdc"}

{"id": "p_48851bb014ac5b74", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 296, "text": "」表大將蒯越亦勸表，表狐疑，乃遣嵩詣太祖以觀虛實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "34c2533371bb225036f38a360118802812a8cf9900ab4b76c0f233e938119580"}

{"id": "p_4f05b1b793f2e198", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 297, "text": "嵩還，深陳太祖威德，說表遣子入質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "0b23c76e0d9c28bd23d233cecd26753666fdf0d97efa9d9cbe2d61c547367e1c"}

{"id": "p_7462408b9b9edc03", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 298, "text": "表疑嵩反爲太祖說，大怒，欲殺嵩，考殺隨嵩行者，知嵩無他意，乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "9caf62b726aa9970df7410647e1485a7323b2003bc3908e925dd9280c1cf2cac"}

{"id": "p_b4a77c30393bd92c", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 299, "text": "表雖外皃儒雅，而心多疑忌，皆此類也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "84b34bd19b3003ac604e2c82906bafdf1bdcfab44646f125ec5a1cc728d5dbf5"}

{"id": "p_7db68fff7286b7fa", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 300, "text": "劉備奔表，表厚待之，然不能用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "db1cc9eb53d6f981b546da837558a8b3fa3a3185224824515dac5f05961fdb85"}

{"id": "p_10b3a558893df7b5", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 301, "text": "，太祖征表，未至，表病死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "5fd190cb623ab7e1e97b45519baebdacfb3e54c0394852be957fb804f7435a2e"}

{"id": "p_dffcd68fa3e02282", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 302, "text": "初，表及妻愛少子琮，欲以爲後，而蔡瑁、張允爲之支黨，乃出長子琦爲江夏太守，衆遂奉琮爲嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "d213b56c6270f47cd9ee392b94fd377f6032c1715e1e65b76cf68d719a645f60"}

{"id": "p_cf7bbd431ddae49c", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 303, "text": "越、嵩及東曹掾傅巽等說琮歸太祖，琮曰：「今與諸君據全楚之地，守先君之業，以觀天下，何爲不可乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 303}, "text_hash": "e7b2d52983dbd7951d877eafde214435a8489f50cd6735dc4626200f8da84258"}

{"id": "p_30faa614b5704a6d", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 304, "text": "」巽對曰：「逆順有大體，彊弱有定勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 304}, "text_hash": "81e9739ee91203f4ac43d100eb2d7cdcd94c0a01eb99310af0e50dbf98f64600"}

{"id": "p_cc69b2134216c83e", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 305, "text": "以人臣而拒人主，逆也；以新造之楚而禦國家，其勢弗當也；以劉備而敵曹公，又弗當也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 305}, "text_hash": "d8d1191b34f7fb46c75dc4a804092e10d7273c3432e81fedfbd569dedd9e5b73"}

{"id": "p_5fc17e40dd6c211a", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 306, "text": "三者皆短，欲以抗王兵之鋒，必亡之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 306}, "text_hash": "e1ef01677f19138a78b1009ce4f25e8c99960d33a88ac4c0f4a0aacc8a76bd96"}

{"id": "p_b78c0157ba31db30", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 307, "text": "」巽曰：「誠以劉備不足禦曹公乎，則雖保楚之地，不足以自存也；誠以劉備足禦曹公乎，則備不爲將軍下也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 307}, "text_hash": "b1a565adff008043f7335378148247b4c7c8756d364bca9a6f296bae85f3c1a3"}

{"id": "p_24fd80a2b5cae78f", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 308, "text": "」太祖軍到襄陽，琮舉州降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 308}, "text_hash": "dbf17c267690e69bd8573df2745550ad86fe903dacb7fedb012ea546d7446b78"}

{"id": "p_cd2437b4da3d5d83", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 309, "text": "太祖以琮爲青州刺史、封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 309}, "text_hash": "26086e8a9aecb71539fc36bd059d9dd40c9ece697c3c45d02e5828bdeae69702"}

{"id": "p_7bc32d2276b92b64", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 310, "text": "越爲光祿勳；嵩，大鴻臚；羲，侍中；先，尚書令；其餘多至大官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 310}, "text_hash": "ca2ea8ff247b8ee1b12ba0b3e89a585f098a429961c748fcf6730e67ac1973ac"}

{"id": "p_5bce4aa602d62fb3", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 311, "text": "評曰：董卓狼戾賊忍，暴虐不仁，自書契以來，殆未之有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 311}, "text_hash": "f8501fee59c01bd799bc0f7e0d3178d764c40bf14a1efd14a4ec9b597e04fdee"}

{"id": "p_e9644e5b970ff0d2", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 312, "text": "袁術奢淫放肆，榮不終己，自取之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 312}, "text_hash": "bf627c4e7963861f4739f26028f41e6423a7356108ecb97725dfb5341d80428d"}

{"id": "p_630026d3c6418a30", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 313, "text": "袁紹、劉表咸有威容、器觀，知名當世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 313}, "text_hash": "9a650131524e335d39aef8c464adf581e559f33b40db90d5b4fc3d63efe2a817"}

{"id": "p_cad1a64ae4d841a7", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 314, "text": "表跨蹈漢南，紹鷹揚河朔，然皆外寬內忌，好謀無決，有才而不能用，聞善而不能納，廢嫡立庶，舍禮崇愛，至于後嗣顛蹙，社稷傾覆，非不幸也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 314}, "text_hash": "affbcb09d905a74763b259e3dcd698662cc4db2b1fa37aefde17b7987cb95292"}

{"id": "p_82a06986e6e59985", "source_id": "src_cfca5b7fc88466ad", "ordinal": 315, "text": "昔項羽背范增之謀，以喪其王業；紹之殺田豐，乃甚於羽遠矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 315}, "text_hash": "be52ea72b3bae2fe992beb50d71f7f0fe0a249aa7913b232311b03eea62cbfa6"}

{"id": "p_98f7808763815e18", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 0, "text": "呂布字奉先，五原郡九原人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "db5eac6212f418a354100b27b53fbde0fc66bb08854140e8c7f8899b81c25317"}

{"id": "p_906cee1709199ec8", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 1, "text": "刺史丁原為騎都尉，屯河內，以布為主簿，大見親待。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "d1596b72ead569b3d0e4c621b96d378716682c40e31211b9156dc12a0c0f86e6"}

{"id": "p_db75fb0036837e92", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 2, "text": "與何進謀誅諸黃門，拜執金吾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "f173ceb5a49e4851360afdb2d8ef69e87915a1033cf5be80e6e3f9a969a92cd7"}

{"id": "p_c868d400e61662eb", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 3, "text": "進敗，董卓入京都，將為亂，欲殺原，併其兵眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "4575a397c0782211e4facd0a667edc7d28dc2453d078d7f787d891ca9496c275"}

{"id": "p_714e38954d863bd6", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 4, "text": "卓以布見信於原，誘布令殺原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "e6b5c2144f3b58484f4bd9d330872902cbbf703e1035eef7575280c4660b5e98"}

{"id": "p_63176ff3e525437b", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 5, "text": "布斬原首詣卓，卓以布為騎都尉，甚愛信之，誓為父子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "daadd29ba65cab8d96985e5f098f91c2f2242b6dd827d07f31121c2b1d6817ad"}

{"id": "p_0742aa0325b40073", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 6, "text": "布便弓馬，膂力過人，號為飛將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "09c2ec0b0e5cb1c0c2662c6ca7ee9e8640e8b04e555141c442610ca4cb69e166"}

{"id": "p_4039a013e8b225aa", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 7, "text": "稍遷至中郎將，封都亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "a57e9923f50562e9eafcc3c4aef0fd3fb05de8abccf732c6af7b19b5fcc81329"}

{"id": "p_8c9d1c54d3234657", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 8, "text": "卓自以遇人無禮，恐人謀己，行止常以布自衛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "2e5ef7f2f9a0c793da886af12a2977dbb7ab2a1b992725cfc5b70a219fcf44f2"}

{"id": "p_f00f3aa483a6d854", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 9, "text": "然卓性剛而褊，忿不思難，嘗小失意，拔手戟擲布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "fccab8df6a2063a7a8c0f0830bb1f6b06a4edeb6821afdcfda8cf0d81af58eb6"}

{"id": "p_ace4a576f451865b", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 10, "text": "布拳捷避之，為卓顧謝，卓意亦解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "96021759364ab24b4ebf15d2344c9609bbcffac830570c0e924333dd520ac62e"}

{"id": "p_84621758455f033c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 11, "text": "卓常使布守中閤，布與卓侍婢私通，恐事發覺，心不自安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "e216db90222fcbdc559973204ae730b21ba166e6e1678801e2d4542e964fb25d"}

{"id": "p_7733e1b79a6d7dfc", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 12, "text": "先是，司徒王允以布州里壯健，厚接納之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "99be8ce732b65479b9244cc1a0040d50cf600fa61dc4d6663af72aa66f895802"}

{"id": "p_dcc55dbe2a4afff8", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 13, "text": "後布詣允，陳卓幾見殺狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "9bbff92568a1abc07a59059b961ccb83f6a5c63194b23419fdbe295f458c822f"}

{"id": "p_b19e6f45c769c055", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 14, "text": "時允與僕射士孫瑞密謀誅卓，是以告布使為內應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "c5c1f97a054584fdda3614e7eb3f3aee442c15ba9ba347ba762ee68985309f18"}

{"id": "p_748139ba63795526", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」允曰：「君自姓呂，本非骨肉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "d8e54c237587675916fad1deafbd919947d1ee240c9713a3c18d26379ed65e77"}

{"id": "p_62f733902c99155d", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 16, "text": "允以布為（奮威）〔奮武〕將軍，假節，儀比三司，進封溫侯，共秉朝政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "23bb4010835de654d2c6ccb92e188f52fddd53f15a2668c16d34b24846061347"}

{"id": "p_cd2f81708cfbb5f1", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 17, "text": "布自殺卓後，畏惡涼州人，涼州人皆怨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "13d14a4377116d9fa20eb73689033fabcc8db0a2cb94b6397837441bc7172ccc"}

{"id": "p_9aa8dd95f151be61", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 18, "text": "由是李傕等遂相結還攻長安城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "7f14c80e912673c87600a55fb3ff059a974ae80b54d48ea9cf3a32acc254501d"}

{"id": "p_f8ac579f43dbe1cc", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 19, "text": "布不能拒，傕等遂入長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "e767672b12d0212726253fc0d42ffdeb87bc173000226884fa3e4f2070debaaa"}

{"id": "p_eca2478aaf078db3", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 20, "text": "將數百騎出武關，欲詣袁術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "42e84cf31ee13c8d1281028e875f71f18206b89ceed0d0b610eaf1991eddb300"}

{"id": "p_8ca414c73334868e", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 21, "text": "布自以殺卓為術報讎，欲以德之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "64a06add60197c57393cd335bfc4b7ff61bae8af6b3211cf31faff1958a5c20f"}

{"id": "p_9f40fa6b3c8cf929", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 22, "text": "北詣袁紹，紹與布擊張燕于常山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "781a0261e889853608853d677db79ef64e7e5f1d2a27a688dd7d535504bf1223"}

{"id": "p_07d15f226eddefa7", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 23, "text": "常與其親近成廉、魏越等陷鋒突陳，遂破燕軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "c2e509335abcd966bf8b62f2390d93163ff14b1547708d737621a1e568cd0d79"}

{"id": "p_1e27dd266d66a1a1", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 24, "text": "而求益兵眾，將士鈔掠，紹患忌之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "386cf153eec5f57364c2a31a118c2916e980bdb780ed837c693ac42db859f996"}

{"id": "p_66c672979162ab87", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 25, "text": "紹恐還為己害，遣壯士夜掩殺布，不獲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "31d25db7c86e4110ef8046f211c41572334849b8cec38cde1e16b70ecd3ffee3"}

{"id": "p_eaec8e74b6204ec7", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 26, "text": "事露，布走河內，與張楊合。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "5c449e2995787489bb6a434fa6ed3340247cc32a0a46cec5b48e22640155ca2c"}

{"id": "p_4037a2e8fa412039", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 27, "text": "紹令眾追之，皆畏布，莫敢逼近者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "5315782c5ac08bd647c851dd78d767922b2412e3a9a607760b72b16985c9c581"}

{"id": "p_6350732244ade93c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 28, "text": "張邈字孟卓，東平壽張人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "e4768914efaec099fadb70c8e525abd376b7db521d96de5188f28cf58d37522e"}

{"id": "p_6031ff479c1ceb2f", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 29, "text": "少以俠聞，振窮救急，傾家無愛，士多歸之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "556ca30e5b8b74ba849e663130c48262bfa2784db280ba2f353b96de5df0a632"}

{"id": "p_91393ac8ced962f9", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 30, "text": "辟公府，以高第拜騎都尉，遷陳留太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "8ece327a80eb37f4b489d220cf90a46658fe4e19d607f8c8b701b2e3c8d61b5a"}

{"id": "p_71694f118727d9da", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 31, "text": "董卓之亂，太祖與邈首舉義兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "2a67e3e19258fc2402504616fe6e38a6032317d6c06b8644c177fec459a76bf5"}

{"id": "p_0fe3221c87854227", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 32, "text": "汴水之戰，邈遣衞茲將兵隨太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "ba1eb2516eb699602c77ecf5c8e93962724ebb33ef777f23aa7e92858f864fcc"}

{"id": "p_90504d4a668afb08", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 33, "text": "袁紹旣爲盟主，有驕矜色，邈正議責紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "8111416ab657777474cee99535e5a2e482ffea988fd069b64b9e7a61de218015"}

{"id": "p_9c3bf0754d9ebdcb", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 34, "text": "紹使太祖殺邈，太祖不聽，責紹曰：「孟卓，親友也，是非當容之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "e856a554a70925635324c508dc57a17eb14e176bd905785f29c0fddcad397778"}

{"id": "p_7f4ccc61f8384308", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 35, "text": "今天下未定，不宜自相危也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "d07c2402741f27112aa8a9ae072c76cfaec9cd1ffd70bc50b14620626219ca68"}

{"id": "p_45e2c8d99683e219", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 36, "text": "太祖之征陶謙，勑家曰：「我若不還，往依孟卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "9e1e16ed8ec3aed31ec72c1fc42149e3b3e21a813174a135be244ef51c1f71a8"}

{"id": "p_6344e551b1d134c0", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」後還，見邈，垂泣相對。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "865496d7c15ca3a25179fa542851d84f3d3806429396f2c5fe914d55acf7b963"}

{"id": "p_2b20f50771468b47", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 38, "text": "呂布之捨袁紹從張楊也，過邈臨別，把手共誓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "29649c3176a8bbc3e84e45ed7e2cb19c1f9045adffc2d1a9b40d3ce1bd0aacc6"}

{"id": "p_b1f385221e8af8a8", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 39, "text": "邈畏太祖終爲紹擊己也，心不自安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "8552c8f14057e56cce60b7ffdc1cfabab83a21d96da99cc3f8bce2c323c4ba78"}

{"id": "p_0396dffa01da36a6", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 40, "text": "，太祖復征謙，邈弟超，與太祖將陳宮、從事中郎許汜、王楷共謀叛太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "fbcc9ed758bf0e07ddca8a86a17d467f19f75edadc827f26eabd5e774a219661"}

{"id": "p_937742881e2f6d0c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 41, "text": "宮說邈曰：「今雄傑並起，天下分崩，君以千里之衆，當四戰之地，撫劒顧眄，亦足以爲人豪，而反制於人，不以鄙乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "8a6ab5039027e62859fb4168d284d31f78ac89b594617f9bf91d576ce03a307e"}

{"id": "p_6958a67427a4477e", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 42, "text": "今州軍東征，其處空虛，呂布壯士，善戰無前，若權迎之，共牧兖州，觀天下形勢，俟時事之變通，此亦縱橫之一時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "7358755a8d0a6931b5cd6fc2f87d072ea8b0cafc72fcbd7c430dda141ff3d171"}

{"id": "p_4c3a66b48894c6c6", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 43, "text": "太祖初使宮將兵留屯東郡，遂以其衆東迎布爲兖州牧，據濮陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "262009d44dcb57d073981e21f5ff12ac5e7ce297239a0be3e142b5f8f746bdcb"}

{"id": "p_a7748c9c076473f1", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 44, "text": "郡縣皆應，唯鄄城、東阿、范爲太祖守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "e8605d68808d6b2f536431d28a695f3f0f41895c1d3e37fe6630473dca224792"}

{"id": "p_e72383a24899c20a", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 45, "text": "太祖引軍還，與布戰於濮陽，太祖軍不利，相持百餘日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "3a11ad97487a14ed8613965f3082bef5c3e16051ddd60ae0c4a0a69cbd72543e"}

{"id": "p_c8a1b8ad7ac53827", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 46, "text": "是時歲旱、蟲蝗、少穀，百姓相食，布東屯山陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "d5164cc4c66363dccc26f061f25a91771d403380af5ec6b82636c7cc9e1067cc"}

{"id": "p_b99dfd0fbe6a1ac3", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 47, "text": "二年間，太祖乃盡復收諸城，擊破布於鉅野。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "365aad58670bdd401432c142f96b61c527270663489790731eb0ecdadd482591"}

{"id": "p_bc3fc5e2b5dd9219", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 48, "text": "邈從布，留超將家屬屯雍丘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "be67e12029de2e4b4804b3a5e38fb219adcb587c14e25a8979f0199c58f46caa"}

{"id": "p_0cc603cadc623920", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 49, "text": "太祖攻圍數月，屠之，斬超及其家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "4339215702153d15fef45d987c6672c0736bc615f52a474ea3c17ddba9bc3eed"}

{"id": "p_343b44788953bbeb", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 50, "text": "邈詣袁術請救未至，自爲其兵所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "45a203945e261be7e6dd89bcb76cdd1ee4aba48435a40b85a6ea997275bedf8e"}

{"id": "p_0bacbc1794bf788a", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 51, "text": "備東擊術，布襲取下邳，備還歸布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "ea9f5555a119cdd4e27dfb9ba5e146deacb4e9ab9a1d84bb2e7bab4bc87c6bcb"}

{"id": "p_9d19b6e1b03d1af1", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 52, "text": "術遣將紀靈等步騎三萬攻備，備求救於布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "680e7c1e8c02870fe7ceb829ae5f4e007add2f1f198d827250de6196195d2661"}

{"id": "p_8cf96db7cd2e725f", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 53, "text": "布諸將謂布曰：「將軍常欲殺備，今可假手於術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "32266e9f410b2bbf6fe51b4082eb8950269c75a716ba00dfa65c4124bc9878b6"}

{"id": "p_508d28670e71d1ed", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 54, "text": "術若破備，則北連太山諸將，吾爲在術圍中，不得不救也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "43170b04a55b808e2e16ace30a4588dd26157b5db7042c5fdc5980a823fa7f5a"}

{"id": "p_e72d9ac2545f6f90", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」便嚴步兵千、騎二百，馳往赴備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "376ba96a92e93a44d5cd790ddbf7f28de598b454b840c3e836a01e358e04be9b"}

{"id": "p_a5f7bfb95cb4b76d", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 56, "text": "靈等聞布至，皆斂兵不敢復攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "093808c2238644c9d16c3560f0cbaed9c8a36c1bb36d3e1bffbbca63793ff4a4"}

{"id": "p_068c1b22910edf48", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 57, "text": "布於沛西南一里安屯，遣鈴下請靈等，靈等亦請布共飲食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "8dadd29effba6340aab4a73cdd1c6dd2561b24bb1adcfa4f692d620bfdff8653"}

{"id": "p_ab65580560dfa62b", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 58, "text": "布謂靈等曰：「玄德，布弟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "db511ddcff638aab44669990c4b7abe22ecbbf481ee34762bea7bdd6f7747067"}

{"id": "p_c542dcfa789c490f", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 59, "text": "弟爲諸君所困，故來救之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "ee3a0c98387ab4e27a35e63ec34026fffc69c26f181764393a65b71b45787e79"}

{"id": "p_c59442ba98ec36db", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 60, "text": "布性不喜合鬬，但喜解鬬耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "b874520430c45034bfb03e43eb55b94c469f3129def45b0b38c64479c856819e"}

{"id": "p_cf97ec194f48062f", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」布令門候於營門中舉一隻戟，布言：「諸君觀布射戟小支，一發中者諸君當解去，不中可留決鬬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "6656cea05fe739605af78e41ef6deb6db309dd690ea50ac2948c5acaa517eae3"}

{"id": "p_d305a3958748b9c9", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」布舉弓射戟，正中小支。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "29aefe4ee1f312c8002ea31cd41e592f8fba4090e1bd4031ad74ce0b42de47d6"}

{"id": "p_ecefc6964101a895", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 63, "text": "諸將皆驚，言「將軍天威也」！", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "73e7216a4cd64f2d6812811805c8658470b26c17b03d7f658ddb767d4456f27d"}

{"id": "p_bc2db8f847f377a0", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 64, "text": "術欲結布爲援，乃爲子索布女，布許之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "fbbcbf0e5da1799a3dfd1f82ff85454eec5fd78a0a709be8c030e310c45f6ef9"}

{"id": "p_4656c4165e6fac48", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 65, "text": "術遣使韓胤以僭號議告布，并求迎婦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "7335a9db5e8d4e0c8e669211ab4c3f472e55aef7739bf36763f6d0ff8e7f8db0"}

{"id": "p_ca6c23bf4aa4b83c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 66, "text": "沛相陳珪恐術、布成婚，則徐、揚合從，將爲國難，於是往說布曰：「曹公奉迎天子，輔讚國政，威靈命世，將征四海，將軍宜與恊同策謀，圖太山之安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "37450c79313bddb0f2a7d37b21a1efc7b4a8dc95a52f184d520209294f32e5d7"}

{"id": "p_2fae747e326f1b44", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 67, "text": "今與術結婚，受天下不義之名，必有累卵之危。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "9559af933085155e936effb8bde679d04b67d476699d3ac56fb9227d591d4f1e"}

{"id": "p_d36d0e0f2f29b160", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 68, "text": "」布亦怨術初不己受也，女已在塗，追還絕婚，械送韓胤，梟首許市。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "1e09892c40141d1c35382256a95eccde1c32526d1de0633c2395409bdf2eb93c"}

{"id": "p_a707f81756a45ed4", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 69, "text": "珪欲使子登詣太祖，布不肯遣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "bef24769a0482ac2329b9d03250cb9b852d5379f034a990b083490f2125a807f"}

{"id": "p_8c04db414d2da3b6", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 70, "text": "布大喜，即聽登往，并令奉章謝恩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "59655555171bdf7135fff7f9f055ff21cc9070636ce34c8d0d494a3672af7fe1"}

{"id": "p_ad0a66802bee0d87", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 71, "text": "登見太祖，因陳布勇而無計，輕於去就，宜早圖之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "6bbbc4167ef33ee3b8c1b26a9b5d2e7020dfa56d8a5e30569aa6d19da62ad83c"}

{"id": "p_4c2906014083102e", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 72, "text": "太祖曰：「布，狼子野心，誠難久養，非卿莫能究其情也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "4a6eaea5453997393292a805957659ea55c52c86754cfba37053f072c42dcd74"}

{"id": "p_e546750aea606485", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」即增珪秩中二千石，拜登廣陵太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "37bff1705f51e7b6ffe9c7b7f6005300942492aa39cd1c5415417063bbc9e4ca"}

{"id": "p_b825cadd224f292d", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 74, "text": "臨別，太祖執登手曰：「東方之事便以相付。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "6ed5c5b7fe418ffde1a2987938df0d7992aa57d41a43f2e9a11787f72cb39d8c"}

{"id": "p_0fdedbe07a630b02", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」令登陰合部衆以爲內應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "02ad306160deafaf2d5b44a790c1c7af3e142fc6816399cfb44bbe346caff17d"}

{"id": "p_9a86cc2d840136ba", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 76, "text": "始，布因登求徐州牧，登還，布怒，拔戟斫机曰：「卿父勸吾恊同曹公，絕婚公路；今吾所求無一獲，而卿父子並顯重，爲卿所賣耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "32c3558f8fff9762b581b832249cfe5304d695031cf218a7d9b2b8865c482586"}

{"id": "p_9a4920701f02e5ac", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」登不爲動容，徐喻之曰：「登見曹公言：『待將軍譬如養虎，當飽其肉，不飽則將噬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "3fb471cf05e7576a2f403a9dc83987c9abf1b003cd6ca399618db22fdc298365"}

{"id": "p_780d02f6a7bcee0c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 78, "text": "譬如養鷹，饑則爲用，飽則揚去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "c518c84d3451e89b3bc89c33186a23f407bbba37bb6797b126db48e9f5b585f9"}

{"id": "p_12d2cb5bf8aa84cd", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 79, "text": "術怒，與韓暹、楊奉等連勢，遣大將張勳攻布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "12ebc723f5781d74a3c22e6cd5c71f5312832a4b0bd6ffc16336ec26f5400275"}

{"id": "p_23138a696087b731", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 80, "text": "布謂珪曰：「今致術軍，卿之由也，爲之柰何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "d33ff7a6e887c9dd878f4ef397fa2160ed0d62b7a47e863d46de6ffa0e568c4e"}

{"id": "p_19995d112c306bea", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 81, "text": "」珪曰：「暹、奉與術，卒合之軍耳，策謀不素定，不能相維持，子登策之，比之連雞，勢不俱棲，可解離也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "3a4076c06e47de169a0651e78d5218e26996c94a0aa8f59b81287453226fe168"}

{"id": "p_d204a509e7e80da0", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 82, "text": "」布用珪策，遣人說暹、奉，使與己并力共擊術軍，軍資所有，悉許暹、奉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "d6529f014f40d4f7cbab1be98c1f9e278a8c3327d86ecb8db1a7d16e536429ca"}

{"id": "p_466a5b6581f7ca7a", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 83, "text": "於是暹、奉從之，勳大破敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "0491c5a69c3c7396b48d3fa0d0b20dd2cb87eb7a969483cedb93e1c4da3e0b96"}

{"id": "p_2c34c7bf9f19cb3a", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 84, "text": "，布復叛爲術，遣高順攻劉備於沛，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "c3fed7cc38bd90f197ed6ea4fa025a27a0784e0205538aaa333a780fd3a4670d"}

{"id": "p_0b82378cade9caf5", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 85, "text": "太祖遣夏侯惇救備，爲順所敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "1a1d8b62d9edd498a3817ed69b5ad73831698db93d2eb7fd5ebefbaf0b75286b"}

{"id": "p_140e32952e0fa00c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 86, "text": "太祖自征布，至其城下，遺布書，爲陳禍福。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "ddab341edafc8e1b021923df64921316eb9156a05a84bd1ec8f396161f89b875"}

{"id": "p_72abee1703e350a1", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 87, "text": "布欲降，陳宮等自以負罪深，沮其計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "0cd6b38e23db0c92240cfc14943b83393e009a026babf46fabffcaa886141c84"}

{"id": "p_61ed38a5e4209c17", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 88, "text": "布遣人求救於術，自將千餘騎出戰，敗走，還保城，不敢出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "1aad4e71853472b5f0ba1895dd889efbe1454ac7f8b17deb5107bb57f974bcf1"}

{"id": "p_aeb4dbe6378525e3", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 89, "text": "布雖驍猛，然無謀而多猜忌，不能制御其黨，但信諸將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "05492f2ab9b6b7631129174645875d1eeae4095bb83a2a780c500b85b772ac23"}

{"id": "p_9c1cc9dfd01110ff", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 90, "text": "諸將各異意自疑，故每戰多敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "8e13e502a78a0ad86ff9d66a6b20575714556a6f1e9607a673b9c18f53f65178"}

{"id": "p_9d062a22b944dd8d", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 91, "text": "太祖塹圍之三月，上下離心，其將侯成、宋憲、魏續縛陳宮，將其衆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "18c9cb14b5a0b1401c2f4bdaf7d7bf00bd8275e55425030dec1be9a0da3a442c"}

{"id": "p_37503858b15b785c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 92, "text": "遂生縛布，布曰：「縛太急，小緩之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "d32e8fd8e9a16973805d5ed3e599446766069b4964ef1b5c38ea90cae4e5f91a"}

{"id": "p_04f94910d1d1e81b", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 93, "text": "」太祖曰：「縛虎不得不急也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "5390b7ed26aaee2986a60ce8cc8d9a6e4868ee8367ec47f6e5ff010ac31825f1"}

{"id": "p_8af7d630321577c8", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」布請曰：「明公所患不過於布，今已服矣，天下不足憂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "2d0793d865c36f071e54f13a636a0e04bc84402bed5fdb2c038f64d2358993c0"}

{"id": "p_76493234d202bfa6", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 95, "text": "明公將步，令布將騎，則天下不足定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "c86f165384113881f9e08a839fe96109f0d8c7f37d532d0bb31e8fdcce43d4e7"}

{"id": "p_2231809e2535147d", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 96, "text": "劉備進曰：「明公不見布之事丁建陽及董太師乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "8ea8393bcb5fbe5715cd813a9c2737ac9878b35c968a675f9918a3122151227d"}

{"id": "p_5af171e62bc8971b", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 97, "text": "布因指備曰：「是兒最叵信者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "7a95a051b41c7dce8e09c1f5d2a62bb4916446fa869e8ff825434ccaf6944e71"}

{"id": "p_627b75af65011288", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 98, "text": "布與宮、順等皆梟首送許，然後葬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "784eec36f1d48acd331a1e0862ecd95cb830a9d91bc1fad098a756146bdbe795"}

{"id": "p_a474b7e7176b3ab0", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 99, "text": "太祖之禽宮也，問宮欲活老母及女不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "5e25f8243b9cfae6d6ab4e6fb0152229c34e7a42a60610be80559dbd36e99f7b"}

{"id": "p_d95a92bfff14624f", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 100, "text": "宮對曰：「宮聞孝治天下者不絕人之親，仁施四海者不乏人之祀，老母在公，不在宮也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "9451ac7d0cb956b21e5fd74cefd969370d20e920b0b48ce88208260dd42e2418"}

{"id": "p_2cc14e73e41cdc18", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 101, "text": "」太祖召養其母終其身，嫁其女。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "fec605518c1f6d60bf49929aed1bd8f08af17ae269c1f855a792dbf526761838"}

{"id": "p_c8f8656ca2b342c7", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 102, "text": "陳登者，字元龍，在廣陵有威名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "601e6ad620357c9d3b2218a18d2f9b90dd8338f2e055ec0c295c07382e87abfc"}

{"id": "p_0d761c1c82ecc4ca", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 103, "text": "又掎角呂布有功，加伏波將軍，年三十九卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "b7f84986dd56858229c52b1cb46ad1831cddfbd87d1863bf698470f57322ae68"}

{"id": "p_668ffaadcc34b6f4", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 104, "text": "後許汜與劉備並在荊州牧劉表坐，表與備共論天下人，汜曰：「陳元龍湖海之士，豪氣不除。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "b81cd2e09e06bb5651fccce5b69f05dd0806de929228a94eb7eae48b8b198665"}

{"id": "p_8a6c65848bf598f3", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 105, "text": "」備謂表曰：「許君論是非？", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "41d750373f7cbfed27f0cc2bb463e6273a846bb42d6bcd51e3504abe15eb8dc2"}

{"id": "p_72ceebc1e89b10f2", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」表曰：「欲言非，此君爲善士，不宜虛言；欲言是，元龍名重天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "db5da29646e65449a614cff5e27dae4def2c79fb3ae3725625f00c87371e645f"}

{"id": "p_802da89bd1577f62", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 107, "text": "」備問汜：「君言豪，寧有事邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "5f1e77d9b4ec7c3bd4f38ba4f85597d9dae40c0940e0d818de05dfddfb4cd118"}

{"id": "p_db8d855e576653a3", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 108, "text": "」汜曰：「昔遭亂過下邳，見元龍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "1a0f5b92c8475607c75edf07bf36dc19445ad017c1afeeec0077f253117359ad"}

{"id": "p_86c44c057de4152a", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 109, "text": "元龍無客主之意，久不相與語，自上大牀卧，使客卧下牀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "b2ca1faec758c7d6dada01473db95814dd4d3bb0d8223e7a048fbc2ccd5b1253"}

{"id": "p_dfa2ace48b250047", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 110, "text": "」備曰：「君有國士之名，今天下大亂，帝主失所，望君憂國忘家，有救世之意，而君求田問舍，言無可采，是元龍所諱也，何緣當與君語？", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "b37d69161eeaec391183d0ef481d8a120a9034be8dde99953f6dec65e2e606c2"}

{"id": "p_828ae8b03df0baba", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 111, "text": "如小人，欲卧百尺樓上，卧君於地，何但上下牀之閒邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "3130a624bafb621a9be2b0210a5a4977a58729edac16b3fd7a18592df65ecaa4"}

{"id": "p_ecf3b6be5977ea07", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 112, "text": "備因言曰：「若元龍文武膽志，當求之於古耳，造次難得比也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "894bbd51a415dbb5622b6efb0d6094d1aece4779311eea1eb0b0c6e67a5eb9a9"}

{"id": "p_2a2964e73ff73610", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 113, "text": "臧洪字子源，廣陵射陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "cc9b87eb2ce2645b0629f3bcc3698087efdcba565b6df8f1a756a51fa916cbdc"}

{"id": "p_a44b4fe5dc182c9b", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 114, "text": "父旻，歷匈奴中郎將、中山、太原太守，所在有名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "733b6c4a0ef37da69aba8416cd57ffb2d119977108d07daf93ef99e11c275cc0"}

{"id": "p_26c12324d1c15ee1", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 115, "text": "洪體貌魁梧，有異於人，舉孝廉為郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "18b64c451fc2706296d2983703508da256b0667ff29dc29594a6d7c70b2a1dd8"}

{"id": "p_f982e245cc432d6e", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 116, "text": "時選三署郎以補縣長；琅邪趙昱為莒長，東萊劉繇下邑長，東海王朗菑丘長，洪即丘長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "2c6e44690bf1cbabd32d3e1aed05793a37c0b2562adffb2e96f163bf03a3fe72"}

{"id": "p_5a29fed6752a42a0", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 117, "text": "靈帝末，棄官還家，太守張超請洪為功曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "fff3a96a5ae3f9dc8554e9173d204812f71712ec69b29bec44c6672e154d29a1"}

{"id": "p_813474e5fe21bff1", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 118, "text": "董卓殺帝，圖危社稷，洪說超曰：「明府歷世受恩，兄弟並據大郡，今王室將危，賊臣未梟，此誠天下義烈報恩效命之秋也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "8b51511204f92e1feaa7fb4a3e550e10188f5c79a28a64ee580fe76225bcff33"}

{"id": "p_fcba8bdede8205f6", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 119, "text": "今郡境尚全，吏民殷富，若動枹鼓，可得二萬人，以此誅除國賊，為天下倡先，義之大者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "759424c438f70e39ff3ebda6c304d3045cc343b58e0000e3bbbceb436cf3b49c"}

{"id": "p_923a9701ea766054", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 120, "text": "」超然其言，與洪西至陳留，見兄邈計事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "eb487dcf04539bb4c31be86635228ca05d7fd8a85d44a27fcb231fdeb466c9c2"}

{"id": "p_53ee861188486fae", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 121, "text": "邈亦素有心，會於酸棗，邈謂超曰：「聞弟為郡守，政教威恩，不由己出，動任臧洪，洪者何人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "b172e180e2829dd1f5436ccba60bdba61fc8c5a7fc141446acca146029cbd315"}

{"id": "p_4dc9070f48300782", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 122, "text": "」超曰：「洪才略智數優超，超甚愛之，海內奇士也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "b5a8f34367db6d785a2ed6ef544d2d22dc8644fa1da360a88c9ee8a0b914b628"}

{"id": "p_f1cc616f71c2abe9", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」邈即引見洪，與語大異之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "bf6d8e42e9a08a5723c9ee07dd4f8329c69fea8a1b8ae7b7f768af9a11e632e0"}

{"id": "p_4a36f851b7b8cac9", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 124, "text": "致之於劉兗州公山、孔豫州公緒，皆與洪親善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "c2f99169c70a304fb340da4ea98037e68047e0054d36299cafcd2da407a327ad"}

{"id": "p_6eb0090917001d9a", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 125, "text": "乃設壇場，方共盟誓，諸州郡更相讓，莫敢當，咸共推洪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "1c2c1dd839030bf7f8a80dd221c2df6d0bb31703ca1621c1c72af5441115d4dc"}

{"id": "p_3fdc2c6412519d54", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 126, "text": "洪乃升壇操槃歃血而盟曰：「漢室不幸，皇綱失統，賊臣董卓乘釁縱害，禍加至尊，虐流百姓，大懼淪喪社稷，翦覆四海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "384063e4feb310ac176123f083acad9826610660ff9053e0989e657dc5f88c61"}

{"id": "p_58cbbe1a69ad6e57", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 127, "text": "兗州刺史岱、豫州刺史伷、陳留太守邈、東郡太守瑁、廣陵太守超等，糾合義兵，並赴國難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "aa2579a31a24ffdd6f007baf5ced3961e5d45fa7583337607320d5ff1da77c5c"}

{"id": "p_dbe69febd6a3add9", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 128, "text": "凡我同盟，齊心戮力，以致臣節，殞首喪元，必無二志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "11447991bcb3a087f25aadec9dc9174f31d6331526644783d38537c621509d4f"}

{"id": "p_03fb71240ec0450c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 129, "text": "有渝此盟，俾墜其命，無克遺育。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "199639b5ec794f2980faab50f3ee5cb66ad7e7532ff2a5df14a6739752327e32"}

{"id": "p_71a1011df12ebdac", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 130, "text": "皇天后土，祖宗明靈，實皆鑑之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "384f540099fad0edc9f03f5b1b54dfc42c7286a741b11cd916e33a8bea556612"}

{"id": "p_bfa85e4704a2402b", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 131, "text": "」洪辭氣慷慨，涕泣橫下，聞其言者，雖卒伍廝養，莫不激揚，人思致節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "3ea852328a926224309d75c6c8aabbf9659b1ce8fb4d39c6c56da942c00265db"}

{"id": "p_114bc19b49b63e84", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 132, "text": "頃之，諸軍莫適先進，而食盡眾散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "7c1f9cd08cfe8c5f1a9f379bc45589ea7a89bda9fa3eecd5522db61c966ed9cf"}

{"id": "p_240c98973de5cdc6", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 133, "text": "超遣洪詣大司馬劉虞謀，值公孫瓚之難，至河間，遇幽、冀二州交兵，使命不達。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "09834f917e61e7317d58614aa7903cd2b8e7a8db536a7835d56956a82646ad94"}

{"id": "p_d11f1abbbb15611b", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 134, "text": "而袁紹見洪，又奇重之，與結分合好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "6c64ea6ad60c6480ae43164d7aa9bc6adf3d997a57e0e5e5c2228556903432a7"}

{"id": "p_1c11b42f0362afe3", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 135, "text": "會青州刺史焦和卒，紹使洪領青州以撫其眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "1e8e237b963f6a67471ba0161b8b82846c8fde94da650a603430670c49b9fa16"}

{"id": "p_989c849e6f2ef05c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 136, "text": "紹歎其能，徙為東郡太守，治東武陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "3dbd504ed369d95df20af5f533994b09bee9726de7a05a798a83f5ea3c101b77"}
