{"id": "p_21a1595831931bfc", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 137, "text": "太祖圍張超於雍丘，超言：「唯恃臧洪，當來救吾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "19f889e47208fb57eea682cefa5b679a5474ec623aced02b97498f17b39cfea2"}

{"id": "p_a75fdadc0752a958", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 138, "text": "」眾人以為袁、曹方睦，而洪為紹所表用，必不敗好招禍，遠來赴此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "2156b6c73d17501baf1464db241fc43f0774d01e3ec012646f7f07a39a424a6b"}

{"id": "p_5ac2a1e5ea6d053a", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 139, "text": "超曰：「子源，天下義士，終不背本者，但恐見禁制，不相及逮耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "553ddb39672dfdeef2bd6f0f249f95f3c1dca33a7eb2617c130b095a83cd8fd3"}

{"id": "p_af842bcdda9b5826", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」洪聞之，果徒跣號泣，並勒所領兵，又從紹請兵馬，求欲救超，而紹終不聽許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "ca88f676326029b4fa9c9414dcf160b4a5679b5f0f74b8b7832b21b4bb77bf10"}

{"id": "p_9d7ac185c32d6653", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 141, "text": "紹令洪邑人陳琳書與洪，喻以禍福，責以恩義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "aaceff3d396091cd7ff1d365e343bc3c7d855406132f0584e76eb5308268b13e"}

{"id": "p_b220c4b1c66293d4", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 142, "text": "紹見洪書，知無降意，增兵急攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "0a2cbc65174a57c76742c689f76104a27a058dc71d0f1ef114b3bb5bd24413a5"}

{"id": "p_6749f0f90d982ce3", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 143, "text": "城中糧穀以盡，外無強救，洪自度必不免，呼吏士謂曰：「袁氏無道，所圖不軌，且不救洪郡將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "ccf90ae8f8a1da852ac6d52c5dd8fbc353b065c48240ae82c71ee47d3202b220"}

{"id": "p_8cf9fa2304d139fc", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 144, "text": "洪於大義，不得不死，今諸君無事空與此禍！", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "0bb8f8c19a82522dffcb93f772d99e1726cabca8c67acc4e6f639ad81409cb9c"}

{"id": "p_387b978354d90b2f", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 145, "text": "」將吏士民皆垂泣曰：「明府與袁氏本無怨隙，今為本朝郡將之故，自致殘困，吏民何忍當舍明府去也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "e17ceb4b2a38f22c5629d1ac50ae13ae290c7f8d42c7e82b17f98461ea932da3"}

{"id": "p_31fd4bfa174a1695", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」初尚掘鼠煮筋角，後無可複食者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "d7448285dcfa862a94cc3fca08452c1ffc61681363cada9abee9b82068e82c43"}

{"id": "p_43dba5bfcb144ce2", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 147, "text": "主簿啟內廚米三鬥，請中分稍以為糜粥，洪歎曰：「獨食此何為！", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "f22fead6090cee2316129599ca840aac48c1faf78f0ee8e3bc7258edcebda7c1"}

{"id": "p_412694280e94e7f0", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」使作薄粥，眾分歠之，殺其愛妾以食將士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "42be22f66fcb344fd931ca9e6f546cf4c9d9ab6cd287343c3d8067170d079e86"}

{"id": "p_e86874ad191643d1", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 149, "text": "將士咸流涕，無能仰視者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "5a4b1222c3283443f4b173f884b32cae9f825d537a188ec254e15a02d43921fc"}

{"id": "p_f2836d341cdc44e1", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 150, "text": "男女七八千人相枕而死，莫有離叛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "5cacfb5b61a927b1edeb0ea249fe485187cd8e874c15ecd13766926f5d768a81"}

{"id": "p_8e7ad2a1ab91619e", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 151, "text": "紹素親洪，盛施幃幔，大會諸將見洪，謂曰：「臧洪，何相負若此！", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "443ba2c05742ada277c74915af2ac18a53af757fa20423203864b2aa8dec7a79"}

{"id": "p_3ceb0f156ecc7ddf", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 152, "text": "」洪據地瞋目曰：「諸袁事漢，四世五公，可謂受恩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "f3c2579fbb1cb6821fdd49b95088c2cd373e8ce57a81476ddb692fa23ff7f15e"}

{"id": "p_30fbae3e401f5135", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 153, "text": "今王室衰弱，無扶翼之意，欲因際會，希冀非望，多殺忠良以立姦威。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "79810cbe1c06f74412ba8f898856f5c91e4c6fe7db07bad6e1441c75b8de9b2b"}

{"id": "p_c4ae5333e3b6d339", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 154, "text": "洪親見呼張陳留為兄，則洪府君亦宜為弟，同共戮力，為國除害，何為擁眾觀人屠滅！", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "85617c899a10a56813fc8f6a5b6dbe64f547cedd70d85b1c74f1a6089bca3603"}

{"id": "p_03d883a5c52a5ff6", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 155, "text": "惜洪力劣，不能推刃為天下報仇，何謂服乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "bbe8c25f81eab8fbf6c17396452bf798bf668ef6a09b7480f69e10c42a2e606c"}

{"id": "p_b3c4136965fe4056", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 156, "text": "」紹本愛洪，意欲令屈服，原之；見洪辭切，知終不為己用，乃殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "263626f5f3208d9ccbf1fce365e99b6ccaf8681cf4d4da8f3a335fa0d7f3d93a"}

{"id": "p_1e899bd96a51edaf", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 157, "text": "洪邑人陳容少為書生，親慕洪，隨洪為東郡丞；城未敗，洪遣出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "edc15094c770969ff8f21e1aaacf8940f2aa4c46f297cbd4b704b68fbadbf21c"}

{"id": "p_4ffdf3be783ce95c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 158, "text": "紹令在坐，見洪當死，起謂紹曰：「將軍舉大事，欲為天下除暴，而專先誅忠義，豈合天意！", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "c489e4abd72c38081fd7d59e99bcf8ef365d2f691f44ba905f63ccf58f10c0ee"}

{"id": "p_bafc458c6b056ca7", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 159, "text": "臧洪發舉為郡將，奈何殺之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "5d9dacfbf89e5c3b36fdad5d1dcdd407d95bd518e4c7c3d5c0fd3c1c15ddde7a"}

{"id": "p_0508a3eb77ee4370", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 160, "text": "」紹慚，左右使人牽出，謂曰：「汝非臧洪儔，空复爾為！", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "3067699dcde6a43f1f7ce874ba098160f4df516e9f3f850f8e4b4629d9de5bf6"}

{"id": "p_90ef71894ac22fa5", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 161, "text": "」容顧曰：「夫仁義豈有常，蹈之則君子，背之則小人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "2a0378ced01dba26f20547660eeafe0dd9567ce00cf6fea2c4dd281a74825ed1"}

{"id": "p_47709e52b9cfdd89", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 162, "text": "今日寧與臧洪同日而死，不與將軍同日而生！", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "f95e893fed014fc2e9b0bd9593866f5bedf9ae93c8c816803284c57b5be028fd"}

{"id": "p_5355dc0e178df88d", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 163, "text": "在紹坐者無不嘆息，竊相謂曰：「如何一日殺二烈士！", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "f966602c406bf4d1ae91c0e377abf74413033a95dcd48a50f2422bec0a5e6d72"}

{"id": "p_341fedf403928886", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 164, "text": "」先是，洪遣司馬二人出，求救於呂布；比還，城已陷，皆赴敵死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "482d93710356ef42f1751d199d2201fb0cf13e5de947c55baea0689d61a1cec2"}

{"id": "p_564ef291c3eb56ed", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 165, "text": "評曰：呂布有虓虎之勇，而無英奇之略，輕狡反覆，唯利是視。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "775cfd38c999bcf0e3f6225078479eda71e437b67246cae02b1daacb1e86b3e1"}

{"id": "p_e2c2899189b5188c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 166, "text": "自古及今，未有若此不夷滅也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "56b7a77067368c5ecce9ac1b9803865cbaea79c9e9d54becfbe6cad7e4c02df1"}

{"id": "p_4423a805e91ed94a", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 167, "text": "昔漢光武謬於龐萌，近魏太祖亦蔽於張邈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "38e9ea8c724c0b28dcba0ed516cfeca12d539e2e56abfc7ecf94475a740241aa"}

{"id": "p_514a9df88ef4b29c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 168, "text": "知人則哲，唯帝難之，信矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "fd27a1de3964cbc667ccc3b75dce79b1aae0a67c14f6ad705f57c3a7a1f7f45b"}

{"id": "p_a71cb5e7cdf35b8c", "source_id": "src_4aae3fc96fd79407", "ordinal": 169, "text": "陳登、臧洪並有雄氣壯節，登降年夙隕，功業未遂，洪以兵弱敵強，烈志不立，惜哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "08d4af29b51e120b9777cf46f761c8092b13cb1d25ed19288f87eb5f305a999d"}

{"id": "p_4ed7dceeb1fe3e98", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 0, "text": "公孫瓚字伯珪，遼西令支人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "209a9d0a058a0b892933b40b283080f6f2b849dbdcb6d2b9478e81628a33973b"}

{"id": "p_db716a7b7914daa0", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 1, "text": "有姿儀，大音聲，侯太守器之，以女妻焉，遣詣涿郡盧植讀經。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "d11fa4085a8006490c2d4a6f646ad7a3bbb1fa2e19f068d82c0d0419adcf8c86"}

{"id": "p_017c731d4bdc2fd5", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 2, "text": "劉太守坐事徵詣廷尉，瓚為御車，身執徒養。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "df4eef682f32ce42a1aa61e3d4b5689063ddc43d3a606e8ecfd75dda0ba66c2f"}

{"id": "p_452dc94425995ae6", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 3, "text": "及劉徙日南，瓚具米肉，於北芒上祭先人，舉觴祝曰：「昔為人子，今為人臣，當詣日南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "dd9f7527654d8d7629f4f1571de53f47be68dcfcf53ea4e28d97239e0cc7360d"}

{"id": "p_e8a126e43ea87852", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 4, "text": "日南瘴氣，或恐不還，與先人辭於此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "e2a20ec384b77b4df79a0ae53bd94a39b7f30fb970f9b3ef05f57305c0194d09"}

{"id": "p_5c61300ebba2f255", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 5, "text": "」再拜慷慨而起，時見者莫不歔欷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "ffb3b405760b1a4909d4f38741a86fe010c11313be6ac6273b17e7449c14fef4"}

{"id": "p_dc32ea1eb7d229a7", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 6, "text": "瓚以孝廉為郎，除遼東屬國長史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "dc910ec5a8c3ad2d8f2a211f86cd0975cee10479008d3d858633a32701799205"}

{"id": "p_1d76bf1a8528aa2f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 7, "text": "嘗從數十騎出行塞，見鮮卑數百騎，瓚乃退入空亭中，約其從騎曰：「今不沖之，則死盡矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "bea60750614fd6f9406db8bf4edd3a047be978336c595124b10382834815c745"}

{"id": "p_b24076d4249c45c1", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」瓚乃自持矛，兩頭施刃，馳出刺胡，殺傷數十人，亦亡其從騎半，遂得免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "2ca09d9dfb1d7b1c9ba225f98332917c0386aea24ac4c29e2245fdaca4194daf"}

{"id": "p_3cc64131da9e9c3d", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 9, "text": "鮮卑懲艾，後不敢復入塞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "16d3537db8c43d4c1587b2c8eb0fbaf26c24987cc27c22179c6710ddef03fb88"}

{"id": "p_54a638d491667887", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 10, "text": "光和中，涼州賊起，發幽州突騎三千人，假瓚都督行事傳，使將之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "171394a4eeab69e19a758a280b19d22ae7ac325a6f9be205979457e75448d554"}

{"id": "p_678007a442e1d64a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 11, "text": "軍到薊中，漁陽張純誘遼西烏丸丘力居等叛，劫略薊中，自號將軍，略吏民攻右北平、遼西屬國諸城，所至殘破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "ab236afce20bb809df17409753b7ae7df1dfa1faac820df8024a5026f34af275"}

{"id": "p_2badde726ff896be", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 12, "text": "瓚將所領，追討純等有功，遷騎都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "417aace9818c71339156ab3b9f3cd4d5b082295f8e2cc66d904a6dbb9383584d"}

{"id": "p_24daccda9a5fea88", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 13, "text": "屬國烏丸貪至王率種人詣瓚降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "3a5b781a513b01ab9d530440c4f0b6f602f36e402e7058fcf6d6d4dee16a32ef"}

{"id": "p_48c1c994c342306a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 14, "text": "遷中郎將，封都亭侯，進屯屬國，與胡相攻擊五六年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "29b41d55837a09a14aab91ca4c94d6b53b7c83d74b15eab79898683bb6c38e86"}

{"id": "p_74a1d23137903433", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 15, "text": "丘力居等鈔略青、徐、幽、冀，四州被其害，瓚不能禦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "2e1703fa7b97ca615f7084a3e6a3f7ead8644975efa3b7428c4aafbfac3206d4"}

{"id": "p_a7391082a8c8a7d2", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 16, "text": "朝議以宗正東海劉伯安既有德義，昔為幽州刺史，恩信流著，戎狄附之，若使鎮撫，可不勞眾而定，乃以劉虞為幽州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "5fbc7652f18a0d0444f07dedb7754dd6db2accedb29093c2c755fe0b7682a7bb"}

{"id": "p_b02870d9a1146630", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 17, "text": "虞到，遣使至胡中，告以利害，責使送純首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "11494cbdc81f5cde415fc01b85c84ba8302bd8c8919375c073e112a381279d32"}

{"id": "p_acc3228343e530e8", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 18, "text": "丘力居等聞虞至，喜，各遣譯自歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "7ea0157de2efa2c937d066b5db90088ca87d0cbd0c7ad4f228a24dd2e07c3ddc"}

{"id": "p_310bb61979d18221", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 19, "text": "瓚害虞有功，乃陰使人徼殺胡使。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "38ce6fc9fbd6581c6ec30d7dbab7a44837926e770fe3961ec653a81b4b88ea2d"}

{"id": "p_9be8deeb687f29dd", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 20, "text": "虞上罷諸屯兵，但留瓚將步騎萬人屯右北平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "5cfe2caa531925613bce1c32bcfc33dabbbaa21125b28ef551b73f7b6ee0e39c"}

{"id": "p_2654079e139af5cc", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 21, "text": "純乃棄妻子，逃入鮮卑，為其客王政所殺，送首詣虞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "4e349112f02a8f4bfe8abc31331072466aa51eca54aa06f542b4f21d234cbec8"}

{"id": "p_fcd22755be7bc88f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 22, "text": "虞以功即拜太尉，封襄賁侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "279c019556297596321f2f6f602bdee8861328ad92722fba26a4fbde00d838d6"}

{"id": "p_9148378050d09f6a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 23, "text": "會董卓至洛陽，遷虞大司馬，瓚奮武將軍，封薊侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "f5fb22781e2b151ff1ad761681163f23eef3f9cbed3861568a6df649ed13078c"}

{"id": "p_a1c618933e6c70dc", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 24, "text": "關東義兵起，卓遂劫帝西遷，徵虞為太傅，道路隔塞，信命不得至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "3e35b37e6cadf712918620c750257361207e2089fd0d04f85f29ef3fa752f006"}

{"id": "p_6d9eb73662b1f994", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 25, "text": "袁紹、韓馥議，以為少帝制於奸臣，天下無所歸心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "0654fa90399cd0dab54c14b73ec7294a5f0043fbdfc588153c65b1c257ab20bc"}

{"id": "p_7bf552ab830fbc5f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 26, "text": "虞，宗室知名，民之望也，遂推虞為帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "fa7bbafd62f0d9d0e869d16e657c4ccc491ad8b448327dcb3534a3a5b7fd8327"}

{"id": "p_b076a7262ebda6f3", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 27, "text": "紹等復勸虞領尚書事，承製封拜，虞又不聽，然猶與紹等連和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "3978d44501c72c6f5d69d04ec1c8e93d0d990982b832de9a74971ad31a5aa4b6"}

{"id": "p_c7e2faaba6ef954a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 28, "text": "天子思東歸，使和偽逃卓，潛出武關詣虞，令將兵來迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "864a6b6d8f54db59390724f3e3aa17b8dd1f62bfde1353c535418896d9423083"}

{"id": "p_3509ae197d8de51e", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 29, "text": "和道經袁術，為說天子意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "c606b3afc29848c9593e0dc755caca7ec414f2a8fc62b622533f95b17bc616d1"}

{"id": "p_8c8eb6eac365edbf", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 30, "text": "術利虞為援，留和不遣，許兵至俱西，令和為書與虞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "13b3d1828f974980116108a9c196e48da7f1bbea4bb01a772a7c4298afc94a54"}

{"id": "p_afa24ccddea554e9", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 31, "text": "虞得和書，乃遣數千騎詣和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "cb038563b3e2bb8bf4b2e21054def80a4af42f71008b518d4f1045a60080cef3"}

{"id": "p_2017613c8173a31b", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 32, "text": "瓚知術有異志，不欲遣兵，止虞，虞不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "782b61cc9565b383a1f1f51899dfe190cbf672aaafba3f15576c933202d70b19"}

{"id": "p_2f4d30af1cd2c442", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 33, "text": "瓚懼術聞而怨之，亦遣其從弟越將千騎詣術以自結，而陰教術執和，奪其兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "0225d8f0ad44c50a7beb76588e63124218817f7abb1c0d232754714710b256a9"}

{"id": "p_76954503171f22e1", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 34, "text": "和逃術來北，復為紹所留。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "1f053716b41787534aff7238e6e41dcc8fb88c3a00fe3f0694575079b6dbb5d2"}

{"id": "p_309b27662922df59", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 35, "text": "是時，術遣孫堅屯陽城拒卓，紹使周昂奪其處。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "2ade12e6a0a5c4084436258ecef77a802d5f1603141386ae13dd0f048cce69f9"}

{"id": "p_e784596c562f3ad5", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 36, "text": "術遣越與堅攻昂，不勝，越為流矢所中死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "1314c1c201a5873977747304d5f7f11a4d44b95b2bf7e54863443f84cedfe56a"}

{"id": "p_18988b4a84e6b031", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 37, "text": "瓚怒曰：「余弟死，禍起於紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "d6cc186727bbc93fd3684222832b8693eb7aa0b9852b17e7b329f766ac09e61a"}

{"id": "p_e82491317b53df0b", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」遂出軍屯磐河，將以報紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "e47b8b5c370effae5199b74e9dd35ca197cb77c77e05830218ab5d9592c6c8b7"}

{"id": "p_249efcdc3f186808", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 39, "text": "紹懼，以所佩勃海太守印綬授瓚從弟範，遣之郡，欲以結援。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "8ff1181bf95925c5dcfb0e2000d854c902811e718c0644964ffb21e67b2dd547"}

{"id": "p_f966c3a7a861b129", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 40, "text": "範遂以勃海兵助瓚，破青、徐黃巾，兵益盛；進軍界橋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "13fac100637cf36d7f0d464803127f519ac0e90e0e64527fc782554ac3ea7ae2"}

{"id": "p_1bf4332703b69e14", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 41, "text": "以嚴綱為冀州，田楷為青州，單經為兗州，置諸郡縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "2083e8ddf9a88b355c88d32c28761fefa2264e1a5ad45afad6b5fe04611b2f2b"}

{"id": "p_a0f02e9f0161784c", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 42, "text": "紹軍廣川，令將麴義先登與瓚戰，生禽綱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "10f5b304ba0b5d828d36584b4478a9ec4d6b5b514c47248df2315852e2ed3f44"}

{"id": "p_0e84a59be9eba11d", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 43, "text": "瓚軍敗走勃海，與範俱還薊，於大城東南築小城，與虞相近，稍相恨望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "bb9c8f4126b21e5d6bad57acbd39d7b3916a765f4d5ef50f99237f94fbbe9e15"}

{"id": "p_9b9e3f1f31a6ae37", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 44, "text": "虞懼瓚為變，遂舉兵襲瓚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "484e28dbf8e93246e68f9d4643e8db09b638fc9ca9df2162cadde66821039f41"}

{"id": "p_cab8a2de5920dbb3", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 45, "text": "瓚攻拔居庸，生獲虞，執虞還薊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "a103870413238e5bd0754428e1d9a49abafa6bb541a0f973ded3f1e09b9bb229"}

{"id": "p_021c5a6a3f22fa7f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 46, "text": "會卓死，天子遣使者段訓增虞邑，督六州；瓚遷前將軍，封易侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "276e55f8a321c4a320d0c3a93c2da1d75d2ca920a7d5af6ad385ba8b3c664157"}

{"id": "p_436bb65123b04cf9", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 47, "text": "瓚誣虞欲稱尊號，脅訓斬虞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "ff49fcf7aaa5f96c04ca394ce1ba77cde8b19d4cf4439cc25bdaad6ce40b301b"}

{"id": "p_f7aa5b016e56fdd5", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 48, "text": "瓚遂驕矜，記過忘善，多所賊害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "cb950c087f7d630880c8610a45deb2e4533cbd8672428184dd0f7881c4f0f88a"}

{"id": "p_cc8da14010b46dcc", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 49, "text": "虞從事漁陽鮮于輔、齊周、騎都尉鮮于銀等，率州兵欲報瓚，以燕國閻柔素有恩信，共推柔為烏丸司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "a756b7ee80dadd93e1e2873aa212f773cf29b0ed42e05f07ee820063e2cb44ec"}

{"id": "p_1a04c46ab86c71ec", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 50, "text": "柔招誘烏丸、鮮卑，得胡、漢數万人，與瓚所置漁陽太守鄒丹戰於潞北，大破之，斬丹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "399e99d28315049774a6ebfc6a03204576d724b556d9d6f5a74d39c02b9dd230"}

{"id": "p_8d76ce2318e376dd", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 51, "text": "袁紹又遣麴義及虞子和，將兵與輔合擊瓚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "f26ddb9fdda8c93b4284ca148096e647f6ba01fcb2defc853f9038c21de9a6da"}

{"id": "p_3541d375adaf72f0", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 52, "text": "瓚軍數敗，乃走還易京固守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "d159e998bb5389ae2d8e6138df3a19a608bac49e553289382ff8672aa1ffb52d"}

{"id": "p_f144b0c106721d75", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 53, "text": "為圍塹十重，於塹裡築京，皆高五六丈，為樓其上；中塹為京，特高十丈，自居焉，積穀三百萬斛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "831e1f9563aba9de011c739ce67366c01c98f3166a325e4e8c91a8d9eb6ac6a9"}

{"id": "p_35d865d84e3a78d0", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 54, "text": "瓚曰：「昔謂天下事可指麾而定，今日視之，非我所決，不如休兵，力田畜谷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "a33713fb3b43aae7cd38412620206db00e3c689f1d88beba3dcb50879029f16d"}

{"id": "p_aaca60e39b51aca1", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 55, "text": "今吾樓櫓千重，食盡此谷，足知天下之事矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "d7f6441dc04a086e77498605e4eb1508941c3cb01d249d63ed3d7df6b667f13b"}

{"id": "p_5d322723d3e700c7", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 56, "text": "紹遣將攻之，連年不能拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "d4fe35e45b7d3ca007feb8f00f2dc25a5661d8dc9e220a6ba24dc178bf9bd4e7"}

{"id": "p_037d1652993fceb2", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 57, "text": "瓚遣子求救於黑山賊，复欲自將突騎直出，傍西南山，擁黑山之眾，陸梁冀州，橫斷紹後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "8cf3a6c37b943ad7712c18f13d12b6240f3680d55b7855d388e48542791dd4a5"}

{"id": "p_3a7c96774ff370c5", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 58, "text": "長史關靖說瓚曰：「今將軍將士，皆已土崩瓦解，其所以能相守持者，顧戀其居處老小，以將軍為主耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "d150d0b50e567fcdda27673593592b2d6b043e0ff93829f3f0d2a668de60cfab"}

{"id": "p_8b63287061bd85bf", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 59, "text": "將軍堅守曠日，袁紹要當自退；自退之後，四方之眾必復可合也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "8096b289ac3ab77e84f681c2b96c1141240a619fcef64f0ccefce55ab660cec2"}

{"id": "p_99abe7923d536bd5", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 60, "text": "若將軍今舍之而去，軍無鎮重，易京之危，可立待也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "bdb1a7d6a4780a7e16b9913b09f1c01a98211ee58e122e689d89055012621bad"}

{"id": "p_5d2d1d0341c7fd91", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 61, "text": "將軍失本，孤在草野，何所成邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "a8c30c3f69434bc136cff7f1a014887ddfc3c8aeea6fb1b7a7e035996de3f19b"}

{"id": "p_f9a38979df09d74f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 62, "text": "遣人與子書，刻期兵至，舉火為應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "427f06e25c0e4709c7f53207b1e17cf694a6271f0f7d376e11019395ae014c90"}

{"id": "p_f741b5ffca8992fa", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 63, "text": "紹侯者得其書，如期舉火。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "a742c732c5355854b4d5dd3d58be6dcbe9dc077dd65b4b3ba13034e7a901ee78"}

{"id": "p_ea9d3b3c4382b5f1", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 64, "text": "瓚以為救兵至，遂出欲戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "8202a3ed7c37ca8e25a72696e4e609316e08b0ca4c0d9654ca9c76db218e30e4"}

{"id": "p_f627f7b6eb69754a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 65, "text": "紹設伏擊，大破之，復還守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "7646d185d45edf3038a1def2108bfa9de197cf084c778e67198e88203f29cb3c"}

{"id": "p_1e94e58a14f19b7f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 66, "text": "紹為地道，突壞其樓，稍至中京。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "6672602685b7ec4d174542a6e56ca7430c6867a40064b0ddc5a1a4e8ddf00d5f"}

{"id": "p_acddfb2f5e75bf6a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 67, "text": "瓚自知必敗，盡殺其妻子，乃自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "4823d14d68cb138da9304bf05863c4351f9b517344d662cbda20b6cbab02450c"}

{"id": "p_e09eb8580ab64dad", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 68, "text": "以輔為建忠將軍，督幽州六郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "3514903c4b3165a9888e019f2fb8f101df1bf5fa973d2a54a2990511fcb4375d"}

{"id": "p_12593533a6d3e2ee", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 69, "text": "太祖與袁紹相拒於官渡，閻柔遣使詣太祖受事，遷護烏丸校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "2725057318db095d20ea0f83d9e26d945ec621958a455ee2af4ee3eae55bc5da"}

{"id": "p_bdbca720865bdc9b", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 70, "text": "而輔身詣太祖，拜左度遼將軍，封亭侯，遣還鎮撫本州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "3f11c00b7a5a9c28ce24c756d3ed828760448542ba28d30162a00ca283b47f30"}

{"id": "p_ec05211805dda15a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 71, "text": "太祖破南皮，柔將部曲及鮮卑獻名馬以奉軍，從征三郡烏丸，以功封關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "dace5ca66d9d04b473e48246f5009e55a5fd78aa7dff7895830e4097f4c4a07a"}

{"id": "p_ab0c0079eb5c2a86", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 72, "text": "文帝踐阼，拜輔虎牙將軍，柔度遼將軍，皆進封縣侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "c87519d532fa777b8b7bcfb307d2107097ad0fab60adfb9c603d3f195ef28b14"}

{"id": "p_f27e5e35c967efd0", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 73, "text": "少好學，爲諸生，仕州邵，舉茂才，除盧令，遷幽州剌史，徵拜議郎，參車騎將軍張溫軍事，西討韓遂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "e275167f1f0f067e804cf7d064b001dfbb3bf88cd8b2048dd586924a870fb002"}

{"id": "p_207e6a7c35106146", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 74, "text": "會徐州黃巾起，以謙爲徐州剌史，擊黃巾，破走之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "85a609c0ff947693c3d19f62f68b182e792b24b1a9b5c75fbd6d73c320b9b280"}

{"id": "p_b987b74b75429a24", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 75, "text": "董卓之亂，州郡起兵，天子都長安，四方斷絕，謙遣使間行致貢獻，遷安東將軍、徐州牧，封溧陽侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "f4d84386d5b20810275debb0a92fefd3d06c8f96d12bf8368a9a7d9ae6468c67"}

{"id": "p_38aa713f104df943", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 76, "text": "是時，徐州百姓殷盛，穀米封贍，流民多歸之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "f762dc5812868050c4699405157333287de8a5f450b9d8cafe53d4c4a4af8894"}

{"id": "p_098cb7240e42ac57", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 77, "text": "而謙背道任情：廣陵太守琅邪趙昱，徐方名士也，以忠直見疏；曹宏等，讒慝小人也，謙親任之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "714a7fa62a4afc880acce45d13e413ea1332da5c174c3e913881f876d14407bd"}

{"id": "p_ac5df0648f1c68c7", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 78, "text": "刑政失和，良善多被其害，由是漸亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "b673da95b3c7f5994ac3f36b45d323d44209a79ee473efba094943776f77d7ad"}

{"id": "p_8468f087b4ce80ff", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 79, "text": "下邳闕宣自稱天子，謙初與合從寇鈔，後遂殺宣，并其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "6a8c9adcf152260f894c655a3138d78ff4dca0a123a7a73e25464a4ac72841e6"}

{"id": "p_c521bb4fe61418d9", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 80, "text": "，太祖征謙，攻拔十餘城，至彭城大戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "22465808d53309ad350a87577e1252f47a061c5d108e6284316c23d2a18504da"}

{"id": "p_c01b5ff441e4e601", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 81, "text": "謙兵敗走，死者萬數，泗水爲之不流。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "5d631c2182953cbe69e10e737af591d3d68bc5a5133c6e7f93f571b96779e725"}

{"id": "p_00c5f9464dceb535", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 82, "text": "，復東征，略定琅邪、東海諸縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "ff1119921177826e0ae7df65fbe54f030609c96d867fc76ba3c53e6d48ff9ecb"}

{"id": "p_f1e4d84208cb1b01", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 83, "text": "會張邈叛迎呂布，太祖還擊布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "13e76b0dfefc202daacf5284d823d7a2a0a46a1ea08426b6068373ace949058a"}

{"id": "p_e8907d25dd5c2681", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 84, "text": "以武勇給并州，為武猛從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "16f6b223ae69cf48e9da60a0c6085e2ecf247ba31f8bb778edc618e6fa852372"}

{"id": "p_b589cc21944bf643", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 85, "text": "靈帝末，天下亂，帝以所寵小黃門蹇碩為西園上軍校尉，軍京都，欲以御四方，徵天下豪傑以為偏裨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "87c10e8537eb354beef0dd0d484dc75a616bd4ae39886201433874fefb7ffebb"}

{"id": "p_f48768d6292e235d", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 86, "text": "太祖及袁紹等皆為校尉，屬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "5d0564e9c9bea30d4ce1417232c6d9e638d107c66e946f9887c341809c85a3ff"}

{"id": "p_052d8dd10f578e91", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 87, "text": "并州刺史丁原遣楊將兵詣碩，為假司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "e957b34a1bff46c6d1990d4b16aadc0f4fcc19171b478f0b6866a31072d89d01"}

{"id": "p_f1b372ddf0d520ea", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 88, "text": "楊復為進所遣，歸本州募兵，得千餘人，因留上黨，擊山賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "4ca295919a3f55e9b221943bf70e3e3a6a06b0e12afa3a392a7ed67babd2cfa7"}

{"id": "p_eb320ce824b28962", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 89, "text": "楊遂以所將攻上黨太守於壺關，不下，略諸縣，眾至數千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "3f07a09852a5985f7efe0ea90162429ff2110062c333d0135a4e4147e241f787"}

{"id": "p_7e149cbd0e6a9819", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 90, "text": "袁紹至河內，楊與紹合，復與匈奴單于於夫羅屯漳水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "d2130267442dd49bd6c35c5355088e076bf4e80a78315eab75b5a92a7a7cf408"}

{"id": "p_f10cff3d1553c47e", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 91, "text": "單于執楊與俱去，紹使將麴義追擊於鄴南，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "a31d3e8b166a7a5ba0cfdc179756466dd065b79c31057f4433d6e7d87c766a3e"}

{"id": "p_f161b6f202d8c033", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 92, "text": "單于執楊至黎陽，攻破度遼將軍耿祉軍，眾復振。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "63aee64f15041dba6534b04cb4111aaeec3d65406e872ff3bccc311d49231c04"}

{"id": "p_3d62befe98a85ae8", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 93, "text": "卓以楊為建義將軍、河內太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "8f96974eca844864042a142db11b33cd88e1b89a0a4c57001225376330e8e178"}

{"id": "p_eafcf3bdeba01c70", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 94, "text": "天子之在河東，楊將兵至安邑，拜安國將軍，封晉陽侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "c9751a188743960bef487f959b96f47e2bf576e17e23f6f3ac613791ea56d4ad"}

{"id": "p_4557b46058b2762c", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 95, "text": "楊欲迎天子還洛，諸將不聽；楊還野王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "84ad2713392f9d238c30269fd3573946bf8127b20eea77c7c99d4decacb65490"}

{"id": "p_3e66785b09268526", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 96, "text": "，楊奉、董承、韓暹挾天子還舊京，糧乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "535770ce3218675ddb7c22b732c5063de681051928d3b02f9c9dc40cc0b30e12"}

{"id": "p_6258953b5cc17d86", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 97, "text": "楊以糧迎道路，遂至洛陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "10a711c6e9a6893768e38b061b81a04036d52981963a43396dd7b65e71d4ce04"}

{"id": "p_5b30b021cf9345f7", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 98, "text": "謂諸將曰：「天子當與天下共之，幸有公卿大臣，楊當捍外難，何事京都？", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "fb6be5b476c6dc3650345333b7ed1ea0df2876bd64069ff0f928a7fefd50a37f"}

{"id": "p_e88a3b189cb974a9", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 99, "text": "太祖之圍布，楊欲救之，不能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "3d2a0559906f2fcdbc399e13c0a97b9111479c2d549707a8137761c6c279ad6f"}

{"id": "p_e54e9f23206dddce", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 100, "text": "其將楊醜，殺楊以應太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "8f7261e1e9e0818e8c4bd3266dbde647f7d434c3d9586a3f6fca26226d9465d3"}

{"id": "p_778450c0351cef8a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 101, "text": "楊將眭固殺醜，將其眾，欲北合袁紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "b4822a0905752fe76c2273b7a395094788fba5709ab103893209661b3eb427b7"}

{"id": "p_260d7fb43d5cb95a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 102, "text": "太祖遣史渙邀擊，破之於犬城，斬固，盡收其眾也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "ad21edd3f7df8f6aa53db4ea37d839d488fd6bf98ea26128bddb56c37aea2187"}

{"id": "p_f5108ff77e635403", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 103, "text": "公孫度字升濟，本遼東襄平人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "52d8806fd8242c418016a9e8c3a0d16cb2d3fed1220bc3e82e29848dcc40b811"}

{"id": "p_0d785b3ef2d85120", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 104, "text": "度父延，避吏居玄菟，任度為郡吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "2982b5b0c5cc749bcbb90b7b35fec4bd133234900974eff45d276f40b59bb4ae"}

{"id": "p_551e3a23893b3c04", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 105, "text": "時玄菟太守公孫琙，子豹，年十八歲，早死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "34c36880530051c451f6f0ff1db24156bb0be990aa158b3cc15ac530203dc935"}

{"id": "p_76840fefecef50bc", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 106, "text": "度少時名豹，又與琙子同年，琙見而親愛之，遣就師學，為取妻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "9418710e45b82ea4f56f7826f8d30dd55fca873b0f4de8564bb7bbbd5171a3f0"}

{"id": "p_9affac8f202ae22f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 107, "text": "後舉有道，除尚書郎，稍遷冀州刺史，以謠言免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "f1e6a04a9ae257f4b961645a9d456c48ee5974bac1d63b9a75e090a089b9cb06"}

{"id": "p_a59e0f9179305e13", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 108, "text": "同郡徐榮為董卓中郎將，薦度為遼東太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "ba3f5a5ada524cd9e4f7fdb515021bc9afe1e491fce73a9f2db75b181c3785f3"}

{"id": "p_786d8d86538d867c", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 109, "text": "度起玄菟小吏，為遼東郡所輕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "2ce63f8bfdf8b01e0f0abccd8cda3ef00685de378b12eb881a9971b080b12416"}

{"id": "p_a687cde7fd7d0580", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 110, "text": "先時，屬國公孫昭守襄平令，召度子康為伍長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "eda28a8ede3ab3bed1ba883bc5def818f3c47999c7bff2c372fa31eef7a1e092"}

{"id": "p_8d14bfcce193fef9", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 111, "text": "度到官，收昭，笞殺於襄平市。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "512d22b17dbe97db792be6aa576ee89d65dd01d3d3630b14db53fff775e33a17"}

{"id": "p_f301f73625105c7f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 112, "text": "郡中名豪大姓田韶等宿遇無恩，皆以法誅，所夷滅百餘家，郡中震栗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "b2e72710414e2d21ee49f68be277caa7d60235b82649efa6d8b5a88f327b6730"}

{"id": "p_1df3dc4808be5e35", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 113, "text": "東伐高句驪，西擊烏丸，威行海外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "067b54b69326d60ff80c2726f18e9ea441799231ee6f7edb75496e8c1b0c57d1"}

{"id": "p_a014892c17917903", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 114, "text": "，度知中國擾攘，語所親吏柳毅、陽儀等曰：「漢祚將絕，當與諸卿圖王耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "ee976305c199940583f8ea2aa0e6e43144957388236450283f7ff6899b33be24"}

{"id": "p_a235b2ed6c35fb12", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 115, "text": "」時襄平延里社生大石，長丈餘，下有三小石為之足。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "2d470cd589dc6da00831798f7c26f158825d0463cf12c06c23d823eb15a7e178"}

{"id": "p_e96a98a9d98ac80a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 116, "text": "或謂度曰：「此漢宣帝冠石之祥，而裡名與先君同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "ff2d50046b82e29ecb368a8bf515f95cdf3b17e5ee97e03329b6b2b8923f9bb6"}

{"id": "p_36c83a3e51739756", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 117, "text": "社主土地，明當有土地，而三公為輔也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "8cad5488ced97442457e9019029fc843806f0f860e7fb827cd74f918ad02dc50"}

{"id": "p_b77d11ea52a57040", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 118, "text": "故河內太守李敏，郡中知名，惡度所為，恐為所害，乃將家屬入於海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "b2a05b6d17c3add653f8f779a9b2f0f74a4b26a5b7f5f5816740bcf7679a61dd"}

{"id": "p_4aa8059a07c79637", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 119, "text": "度大怒，掘其父塚，剖棺焚屍，誅其宗族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "b81e503b846e404cff446cb00c26bd09fe69aa9318c40e3d168ae6b1228e5bac"}

{"id": "p_8b80cddb608f1385", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 120, "text": "分遼東郡為遼西中遼郡，置太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "f6cfffbe641bc44b34d5a2ca7bd2156ffb829cef8757f4717f3e440aa1fe46fd"}

{"id": "p_753bfa76397f0854", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 121, "text": "越海收東萊諸縣，置營州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "d923876348e241f5071051debed13f7ce8479389062717e8bffa392687dc17fa"}

{"id": "p_93b405f9a59b2fe3", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 122, "text": "自立為遼東侯、平州牧，追封父延為建義侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "483f540a17d193a9f61a2ca72ba03f2d34ca41b64c7ef80a69d267da89905561"}

{"id": "p_8945a47f82a274f9", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 123, "text": "立漢二祖廟，承制設壇墠於襄平城南，郊祀天地，藉田，治兵，乘鸞路，九旒，旄頭羽騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "33546b0d6cfb70214c14bfb800bed80ebbed4f57a3df23ccfec3b6b3e2b2d192"}

{"id": "p_84662b5454e4e857", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 124, "text": "太祖表度為武威將軍，封永寧鄉侯，度曰：「我王遼東，何永寧也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "aca9d2d900fdd305f869fec86b05a6529425f0c41226da75cb28bef123adfaed"}

{"id": "p_bbfdfade5f91a51d", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 125, "text": "度死，子康嗣位，以永寧鄉侯封弟恭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "c369b11f18fb1e46176eeea496520e854011621bd512bfec34239c8e41dbb110"}

{"id": "p_d04c97ee18526d58", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 126, "text": "十二年，太祖征三郡烏丸，屠柳城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "8a4180e7908d7b91875d07acbd6355338cbdd5f082ee6e9d6a3230802f1ba7cc"}

{"id": "p_e79414d6ade5b37a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 127, "text": "袁尚等奔遼東，康斬送尚首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "ddf7fbd64d506bdb7d3babd6c64b2f4bc2c72db5a15b618acdad890afdd60a00"}

{"id": "p_5b0ebd5c2f27bcf5", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 128, "text": "康死，子晃、淵等皆小，眾立恭為遼東太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "c83ad98bb31d72af8658f66af648dae8429a61f524a3f712bca26081ccbd3eb4"}

{"id": "p_3d70597fa36e51d7", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 129, "text": "文帝踐阼，遣使即拜恭為車騎將軍、假節，封平郭侯；追贈康大司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "af53ed7917472d62bdac0909a4889861471174314abe2399e3ffd499518f6dfd"}

{"id": "p_48f8375404ed3f93", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 130, "text": "初，恭病陰消為閹人，劣弱不能治國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "b0b69c6e80db17b3382c5e4e3f1ed754ce0260e9980adb4658a58c74d148ca28"}

{"id": "p_6f18e6cd0716109a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 131, "text": "明帝即（位）拜淵揚烈將軍、遼東太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "04b7b9f41a401a9b3f411d334f691908cee392f575bb7cb1b0c70ccb95ee0377"}

{"id": "p_bc6642935acb6d8f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 132, "text": "淵遣使南通孫權，往來賂遺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "9bd2b6ac594fd347b315ee4607d9abad57c94c5a8f9e7342ed53cf845a236126"}

{"id": "p_211bd412ab989aeb", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 133, "text": "權遣使張彌、許晏等，齎金玉珍寶，立淵為燕王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "aa4eeec8b69caf112aa4d2c0103f96331c31520e2d68466a0b67b8771ebd3cbe"}

{"id": "p_5d40ac09e359c978", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 134, "text": "淵亦恐權遠不可恃，且貪貨物，誘致其使，悉斬送彌、晏等首，}", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "1dbc45e30eca4134696803ee0e034490af68bb3e3c3da994b266b0b9ab415b38"}

{"id": "p_2b6b2052cf3d660a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 135, "text": "明帝於是拜淵大司馬，封樂浪公，持節、領郡如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "4380e73a39d2a1bef608be5f3774a058c5913dcb16627f67267910f518858a82"}

{"id": "p_56142b910a8f140e", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 136, "text": "使者至，淵設甲兵為軍陳，出見使者，又數對國中賓客出惡言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "b81a5e832bccbaacba3645df4da281a4566145f898df556b4fefd81191932689"}

{"id": "p_8acc3a1717606030", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 137, "text": "，乃遣幽州刺史毌丘儉等齎璽書徵淵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "b3880b286b37549511790075529f2e3791f43551afaceebe1c4670a4f68ac0fa"}

{"id": "p_b78005ca8b373353", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 138, "text": "淵遂發兵，逆於遼隧，與儉等戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "b99385dc0c407692bfbbcb8f3c87ec47f57f9a699c2d8ec9b336befdf82a6c43"}

{"id": "p_865efa9563dc643b", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 139, "text": "淵遂自立為燕王，置百官有司。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "185456222f2ee48a05254e15f6545cdda3b434afbfd96bec493459a342b92096"}

{"id": "p_17beb22cdf9d0a7a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 140, "text": "遣使者持節，假鮮卑單于璽，封拜邊民，誘呼鮮卑，侵擾北方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "4d0f07c5d91688712d7462894d64838fa84b63cd020c6c44b0c0cc1541c7896d"}

{"id": "p_53b4a331caf88ac5", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 141, "text": "二年春，遣太尉司馬宣王徵淵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "2a22fce865414ade6e07cd16f870375fa23943d9ec501cb46ba95af5c1a81764"}

{"id": "p_1e28ca00b3b577c2", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 142, "text": "淵遣將軍卑衍、楊祚等步騎數万屯遼隧，圍塹二十餘里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "5ba81d2327a09c64cd92d18b5f0835fd38b0bf82973ba18d3b4b285c94474d14"}

{"id": "p_1fff694263d05e25", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 143, "text": "宣王遣將軍胡遵等擊破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "5202bb260678e2ff2eb7edf4fcc11b6fa7ba5be88ec37e486c230b07403df15b"}

{"id": "p_31e389520f8c1163", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 144, "text": "宣王令軍穿圍，引兵東南向，而急東北，即趨襄平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "2c3f670a203e20a97d83374ed7cbb0b721e109a9a6930d484a4b1aa09bff2be8"}

{"id": "p_fd714b8be5e934cb", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 145, "text": "諸軍進至首山，淵復遣衍等迎軍殊死戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "0a75526776a8c868186847de9a0761e1d5268a225bf0ca30d44a9e41316b4d82"}

{"id": "p_6f16b8fb1b21071a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 146, "text": "复擊，大破之，遂進軍造城下，為圍塹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "369ec1031b6ff4c2296023a1603e1a8e5a6ed690c3fb62f564e1b46f76ced534"}

{"id": "p_9287823a749e9f4a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 147, "text": "會霖雨三十餘日，遼水暴長，運船自遼口徑至城下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "e3ce237adae4398de2904006933f4620b73ef6c251bf3dad1ac74b40a3d3d1d5"}

{"id": "p_1067dc8f6906ba22", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 148, "text": "雨霽，起土山、脩櫓，為發石連弩射城中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "a0b6cb4d2811f41c5ecb92af3805b0d42ed3b3d3bfb52b1e7831f2d837602905"}

{"id": "p_9762d8d7939c431f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 149, "text": "糧盡，人相食，死者甚多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "f2e24ae4f82127dbf12e3dc64663a6bb420f4b32e8f378148b5423c8813e9ed6"}

{"id": "p_9a48774be485413a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 150, "text": "八月丙寅夜，大流星長數十丈，從首山東北墜襄平城東南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "83f38680861d32738cec29d0a0d324ce1810e9c006df2a1373cbe8e710b21218"}

{"id": "p_fe053ea8b62b7c48", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 151, "text": "壬午，淵眾潰，與其子脩將數百騎突圍東南走，大兵急擊之，當流星所墜處，斬淵父子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "5c9be3ef2e616e89e55923ba2dc47cacfa5134105a0994a19017abaff0e17645"}

{"id": "p_570a4cf4eb635a98", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 152, "text": "城破，斬相國以下首級以千數，傳淵首洛陽，遼東、帶方、樂浪、玄菟悉平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "96eb940ee9c9b52e94de3f076617dabeab398ecdd597f69883e118a12d8d48ff"}

{"id": "p_edd73d3d46b4df85", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 153, "text": "初，淵家數有怪，犬冠幘絳衣上屋，炊有小兒蒸死甑中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "0aee2059818019f26cbb0be492bd9756d7558a9e26aa8fa93ef11e0f5a5aaec1"}

{"id": "p_9fe386368a5c1915", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 154, "text": "襄平北巿生肉，長圍各數尺，有頭目口喙，無手足而動搖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "85d7fccfb7bf03c3019526469deb25b2b6ef2525c0af150847386cf363a03ab4"}

{"id": "p_f9b632d2d8ced951", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 155, "text": "占曰：「有形不成，有體無聲，其國滅亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "86854115298dbca0898ddafb9f6ef23ab37758e6cd0c9f97eb05e100795a594d"}

{"id": "p_793585148be2a262", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 156, "text": "」始度以據遼東，至淵三世，凡五十年而滅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "a59644b8e81cac8f127ffd6b6bab8265de6613dea4c4af40c25776d20eedae21"}

{"id": "p_338d10a11b28fd9d", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 157, "text": "張燕，常山真定人也，本姓褚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "c468c6b1933a86df81f7d62ab097418a323e7b150ee6cdbd0beebc783ae69d79"}

{"id": "p_3f67e2531a3e039e", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 158, "text": "黃巾起，燕合聚少年為群盜，在山澤間轉攻，還真定，眾萬餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "b0d238f3cb67496189b8145a032761a2c1d5389cb6fec88d821fceb68e59dc85"}

{"id": "p_29282b88e13b54a8", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 159, "text": "博陵張牛角亦起眾，自號將兵從事，與燕合。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "1dfb7cd34d8bb6fdd4209adf0d466de6c72ba8b6c6fa56f91116949a3cbc63fe"}

{"id": "p_d276f4e4598629ed", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 160, "text": "燕推牛角為帥，俱攻癭陶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "44fd12d18466c7606a9942fd22f6e3e36f28df6a969c7d9d366e229b75861288"}

{"id": "p_84bd7a3141a8dfeb", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 161, "text": "被創且死，令眾奉燕，告曰：「必以燕為帥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "7d577272f4cc02d41f29c73b2807790e004b056b48cae3084ef6cdc5bf091d52"}

{"id": "p_fb3cd7372fec087a", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 162, "text": "」牛角死，眾奉燕，故改姓張。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "d986729c0f9109dd71b18a8d224a3377f66d1b165e70e646928dc5571da276f7"}

{"id": "p_4f1b400dd47bd2ee", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 163, "text": "燕剽捍捷速過人，故軍中號曰飛燕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "66ff1a6bcd1c32589d56cf222ef3f68facf83ba79cc47e07c493e5de3dc976af"}

{"id": "p_60e84b5d5dc41606", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 164, "text": "其後人眾寢廣，常山、趙郡、中山、上黨、河內諸山谷皆相通，其小帥孫輕、王當等，各以部眾從燕，眾至百萬，號曰黑山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "f61f9e4691e67da6592f15f171a19923745ff456c528df005552bc539071b645"}

{"id": "p_39f488ff05528aab", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 165, "text": "靈帝不能征，河北諸郡被其害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "f2e32954493f524f5f095d801ccd40f512115eb68e6f7fe41be5a355c64c998c"}

{"id": "p_6c76c0da1610d0ec", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 166, "text": "燕遣人至京都乞降，拜燕平難中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "011948d4ea6ddcb5a68b369941c069cb413a24ff2d3e1518ab20b429992917a5"}

{"id": "p_80eddfe2a88e0753", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 167, "text": "是後，董卓遷天子於長安，天下兵數起，燕遂以其眾與豪傑相結。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "7b4343701f3b76141e24e2a4c657efb77b1500d21103cc9ad4d599c1c58ec681"}

{"id": "p_f03920f817099151", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 168, "text": "袁紹與公孫瓚爭冀州，燕遣將杜長等助瓚，與紹戰，為紹所敗，人眾稍散，太祖將定冀州，燕遣使求佐王師，拜平北將軍；率眾詣鄴，封安國亭侯，邑五百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "a70fe60482b40af3ae1a3cc52c7e513c82fb8e0ef02f711133f0db0322c7f8e4"}

{"id": "p_7c56bd5db7ab535e", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 169, "text": "張繡，武威祖厲人，驃騎將軍濟族子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "81c662bccd52409429fddfe8ef54a68bd7e4e486cf1290531e5d7898ed4044f5"}

{"id": "p_59a15d237797ac57", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 170, "text": "邊章、韓遂為亂涼州，金城麴勝襲殺祖厲長劉雋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "2dba02ca018c74950f533279bae5a56ed8bd514ff6675f2f3f2880e782d2b2f0"}

{"id": "p_80228204b5657330", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 171, "text": "繡為縣吏，間伺殺勝，郡內義之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "2f173135cc8cae7b8c4cede6eef4016f7805bec2db30f0611dfe7b42ff97a117"}

{"id": "p_828bbf1e9d284980", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 172, "text": "遂招合少年，為邑中豪傑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "29c1dad9d119ca23e42670f180c232718d1076838ac1f281b80b6df66067fd8b"}

{"id": "p_a1512d8ccf9616cc", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 173, "text": "董卓敗，濟與李傕等擊呂布，為卓報仇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "5491f05f6793c69caf0229b2a6272be2a5b5091e8018a7885f46c870ffe9f943"}

{"id": "p_14058b7fefb457cc", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 174, "text": "繡隨濟，以軍功稍遷至建忠將軍，封宣威侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "285513cf648e83bf186c82cb99a9a018c7ec4210b75392aca256e7723951f847"}

{"id": "p_73512edd7195251d", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 175, "text": "濟屯弘農，士卒飢餓，南攻穰，為流矢所中死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "d2d9bd2c60b50db292d912b1cd906972843833e1ff4fda6d8318958a90798dee"}

{"id": "p_fef9b5edf97e4c72", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 176, "text": "繡領其眾，屯宛，與劉表合。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "757241ba908072245497469c53e815ab19ffafabb62cac43f9d6d1b2187b5261"}

{"id": "p_a34038d5fb54c49f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 177, "text": "太祖南征，軍淯水，繡等舉眾降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "540b0fa3f7c80447375f98e0b7cdd8051bda722b5c49fff338aa9e68b00ad54b"}

{"id": "p_504a1dfcec9b9a8d", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 178, "text": "太祖聞其不悅，密有殺繡之計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "a09d155440da13d561507583c0a8af400c2bb879bb8aa734a28e0a2afffd055d"}

{"id": "p_da595ed68d729553", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 179, "text": "繡還保穰，太祖比年攻之，不克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "bc355330a4f18a502fe0e193e691dbd573c5040fe2ae7944dec2d94e6b11ac71"}

{"id": "p_54fdcead60da7690", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 180, "text": "太祖拒袁紹於官渡，繡從賈詡計，復以眾降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "593eabdb161f14e73e04af7f991be595008082d588473d92e60c80513ee9d235"}

{"id": "p_00b46e541d9a6a75", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 181, "text": "繡至，太祖執其手，與歡宴，為子均取繡女，拜揚武將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "42ee63c0c0a784c3dba9e284d2b49cfb5c623c62c4bd0350a21247c6aa92fdc5"}

{"id": "p_a68affb377d63628", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 182, "text": "官渡之役，繡力戰有功，遷破羌將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "5ea1a1e679afd857b6f96507b70f88f44487f5257ef6944d39d763d459b6a408"}

{"id": "p_7a99d383e45d4f11", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 183, "text": "從破袁譚於南皮，復增邑凡二千戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "9def4f3020efc2c15c15fb1b0ac100a0a04bdb2462966a9c0df2d3289fb61cd0"}

{"id": "p_4416d5c70a5c5422", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 184, "text": "是時天下戶口減耗，十裁一在，諸將封未有滿千戶者，而繡特多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "4790e5f35a46401cba3dabba07f5d4fc4fb6f1385c4c617a70292655e4bcf13e"}

{"id": "p_d0848758f1482a95", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 185, "text": "從征烏丸於柳城，未至，薨，諡曰定侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "8465c586e00cd911bef50171258a87fcc83a14f54a32066f7b0518cce4038795"}

{"id": "p_7b1851c945e7cc0f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 186, "text": "子泉嗣，坐與魏諷謀反誅，國除。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "edab618ff8921dadc9d22ad5ecf70a82a3b559c37e88e574fb7f7b810ace50ff"}

{"id": "p_4a69c4f1906540dd", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 187, "text": "張魯字公祺，沛國豐人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "410401263d329e299019c77503192d1ed7ea68e3d8e30da01a1edf2b5acec3f2"}

{"id": "p_5bbf603f6ae5e492", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 188, "text": "祖父陵，客蜀，學道鵠鳴山中，造作道書以惑百姓，從受道者出五斗米，故世號米賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "71f65199d9aa69e6ef0c7f6a273d33cd8daf203ec9fcf48fdbb3d2ded32eea93"}

{"id": "p_750bb3f4a608bc38", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 189, "text": "益州牧劉焉以魯為督義司馬，與別部司馬張脩將兵擊漢中太守蘇固，魯遂襲脩殺之，奪其眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "dd2f11ebef15037c3d89dd3b298a1a4302c47552a566414598a591c8a7a46789"}

{"id": "p_1917d4b74f5fc8c2", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 190, "text": "焉死，子璋代立，以魯不順，盡殺魯母家室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "352dac4d9384167f1029d1d1b2365be82c5523cc73790df432f0756fa13add09"}

{"id": "p_722bc608f50037e4", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 191, "text": "魯遂據漢中，以鬼道教民，自號「師君」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "736d851c8affd0967cdf8761fef1524dad11575d605561cb16099b7156de1393"}

{"id": "p_f5114f822f019b70", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 192, "text": "其來學道者，初皆名「鬼卒」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "3bb9724af80cfa329f0a344790d4ab5d5181968f0c5aac48e308848d2f7873d5"}

{"id": "p_36b6ccbe5bc14368", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 193, "text": "受本道已信，號「祭酒」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "8aeee13336b7f35f5a8caf7b78777a1dbe209d6de419908a1efa628d82d25f97"}

{"id": "p_28cef5dba7962a5f", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 194, "text": "各領部眾，多者為治頭大祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "19ee4ed13a00039821ab1cc81835c137e64327ab3db12422aaed75c464ddcbac"}

{"id": "p_4173af83feec6452", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 195, "text": "皆教以誠信不欺詐，有病自首其過，大都與黃巾相似。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "76bab48d7da48e64353c5f0f45b4dadb8dbc7564e612ac5cb23b04e81c62d56f"}

{"id": "p_423ef53750cbf8a3", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 196, "text": "諸祭酒皆作義舍，如今之亭傳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "1ace038b83eb696eddef972d8f7d40cd6b745055325c2336e45650b6f9afe39d"}

{"id": "p_4287626911ad3463", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 197, "text": "又置義米肉，縣於義舍，行路者量腹取足；若過多，鬼道輒病之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "fcf0e697941ffaa910ec6f5db0bd480aed57f7e7ef2d9c6f97c724146e1574d3"}

{"id": "p_e2ade33c1f1e01d4", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 198, "text": "犯法者，三原，然後乃行刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "f4be189126128be6533aa25e036ef2cfd6c6f9461630a2014126152450abfa89"}

{"id": "p_b182fa3f8fdb4124", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 199, "text": "不置長吏，皆以祭酒為治，民夷便樂之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "d28f8abd6fe43a3e57321efb77936f0ed8a3d74f15b35d9126d200cf2ceaa5e7"}

{"id": "p_b7c83f9a24ae2bef", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 200, "text": "漢末，力不能征，遂就寵魯為鎮民中郎將，領漢寧太守，通貢獻而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "940e11e09d6ac843908e9078fd30323c30e5ecb1ab94dceb9974e9ffe81ebd19"}

{"id": "p_ef1c6f078d0d9522", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 201, "text": "民有地中得玉印者，群下欲尊魯為漢寧王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "2e6a2f16f2696dc0c4e89e0b7199956314094aeeb299bf1d6052ee6af0ebbd9e"}

{"id": "p_67068312aedd60de", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 202, "text": "魯功曹巴西閻圃諫魯曰：「漢川之民，戶出十萬，財富土沃，四面險固；上匡天子，則為桓、文，次及竇融，不失富貴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "e029b81a34122aa912566283b7ebfd174f7fea898da4b54926275cdb2058e2da"}

{"id": "p_af3ba8aec6be0627", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 203, "text": "今承製署置，勢足斬斷，不煩於王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "f6a47d437e9d3508e1150080a912a133276e46459d1d445c00b23858aaa9ccd7"}

{"id": "p_00db46f2bc1a4336", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 204, "text": "韓遂、馬超之亂，關西民從子午谷奔之者數万家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "62a77efe0e22b5e1b593c8a50d05c83bc20958060dd9a9de9dc09848021e4f29"}

{"id": "p_b82a319105cc75bf", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 205, "text": "，太祖乃自散關出武都征之，至陽平關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "96cb8a41bf54ffd75c534d94476760fd9270ba8467e575abae54fc53f8a96451"}

{"id": "p_e9b62cceb2965ccf", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 206, "text": "魯欲舉漢中降，其弟衛不肯，率眾數万人拒關堅守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "e48629c18103481e31de2e7d826423ee5274ad906c1778f4c191c20db7faa0c4"}

{"id": "p_152ea57b95644bc5", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 207, "text": "魯聞陽平已陷，將稽顙〔歸降〕，圃又曰：「今以迫往，功必輕；不如依（杜灌）〔杜濩〕赴樸胡相拒，然後委質，功必多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "99d182e4d51548eaf4d2b7500bbc4adadf130fc35b13b8056a7adc64dea98bf0"}

{"id": "p_32b8f8b2dbb39ad6", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 208, "text": "左右欲悉燒寶貨倉庫，魯曰：「本欲歸命國家，而意未達。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "b4be237169f643debdc2f9fbe8cf56e848b4cdfe2ce99c846607f58160ab79a5"}

{"id": "p_d55060f786fafd4c", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 209, "text": "今之走，避銳鋒，非有惡意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "832264f1b922f5713b1fa1df62e672e55d7b83936528f8ab13a98c8ab73132f8"}

{"id": "p_0a4e274d8fb96c16", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 210, "text": "又以魯本有善意，遣人慰喻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "83ad9a30b4652a6984939d6a5de26cdfd8424ce234815af0c22b951b3f4b956e"}

{"id": "p_b97680d6c1502ead", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 211, "text": "魯盡將家出，太祖逆拜魯鎮南將軍，待以客禮，封閬中侯，邑萬戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "9c356bafdff633573c65e0042ea69fc344d682b4f04142e09d735e7a664f8fb8"}

{"id": "p_d81d93b084c06f70", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 212, "text": "封魯五子及閻圃等皆為列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "2258569f6cb94226aa22ed33d5a28edd253a27d162324322ae4f9a4fbbf5f9e9"}

{"id": "p_e60547f66a579485", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 213, "text": "評曰：公孫瓚保京，坐待夷滅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "7259bc9b49c7cde2e101aa36b6ef24b099f2d874f591d17431c0377fc68fe60b"}

{"id": "p_5f84d49f394c0426", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 214, "text": "度殘暴而不節，淵仍業以載兇，秪足覆其族也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "f8e01f8bf001d6d908c170a7c85ab2e65d1c685d6b67f6819a572ea8536dca53"}

{"id": "p_0258fb578b9652ad", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 215, "text": "陶謙昏亂而憂死，張楊授首於臣下，皆擁據州郡，曾匹夫之不若，固無可論者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "eeb2b275d17ceb33a300edccd129fecacdaa9672704ab012571e383484048748"}

{"id": "p_afcb3d60bdcaf040", "source_id": "src_5ef3e4223e8075f3", "ordinal": 216, "text": "燕、繡、魯舍群盜，列功臣，去危亡，保宗祀，則於彼為愈焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "39a145e91c13521c7380f7d53e2f1a7570d628f134b3eeff3c08efac88fcc606"}

{"id": "p_924c8cf59af9eb29", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 0, "text": "夏侯惇字元讓，沛國譙人，夏侯嬰之後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "428c1b744202d594f591d82b0196e2f630f4064c03e14af858485289985a2303"}

{"id": "p_cd4638d6d31f7aa3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 1, "text": "年十四，就師學，人有辱其師者，惇殺之，由是以烈氣聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "9b3119aeaf687c37e50c17194f79fe35ea9c0a0b5038945c3b2bf076b161db2a"}

{"id": "p_9c7b581d280de7f9", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 2, "text": "太祖初起，惇常爲裨將，從征伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "4a565a5c9785f767227c4c77de32252a0e45a71ea8dd56f1c3782cdee3c168f1"}

{"id": "p_131f1a8f5c5fd9bf", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 3, "text": "太祖行奮武將軍，以惇爲司馬，别屯白馬，遷折衝校尉，領東郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "3642549b1aa32ede31f2fba2bf9ac2227f27541813d8274cce1449b5f4e1b876"}

{"id": "p_56a47b34883142fc", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 4, "text": "太祖征陶謙，留惇守濮陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "d2c0bcf3a48ad73cc1aa9624b526b89958a35ca838e677a605603ed95b4f6b2f"}

{"id": "p_90e68c3d27610e23", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 5, "text": "張邈叛，迎吕布，太祖家在鄄城，惇輕車往赴，適與布會，交戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "03ed4d88c5f81dfa209f181cd09f9ceb6d48f70fc9fa5e479de56e33a74020c6"}

{"id": "p_2e6b7447044fa299", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 6, "text": "布退還，遂入濮陽，襲得惇軍輜重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "ed402f1931f9cd9dc3dfe3ad08c5fad356c7e9b200840936ca3dfaef32d72dac"}

{"id": "p_a712d532c67a4f03", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 7, "text": "遣將僞降，共執持惇，責以寶貨，惇軍中震恐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "3c981a8aa8fdbc5bae5cd03bb5bf9ddbe97d4a5a13901ebcf93f82875ffcdd99"}

{"id": "p_6813d5247adca519", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 8, "text": "惇將韓浩乃勒兵屯惇營門，召軍吏諸將，皆案甲當部不得動，諸營乃定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "cb72c05765c199ba71827acd269e3d2c2ac8c6666fcfcd2bca1a7bfd0edbb880"}

{"id": "p_678b40bc66374334", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 9, "text": "遂詣惇所，叱持質者曰：「汝等凶逆，乃敢執劫大將軍，復欲望生邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "d0409bdd98d5cc0987729fd7b9853d6bf5a03d4801d356d4e205e693a1b34650"}

{"id": "p_4c8f6b5aa8857ddb", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 10, "text": "且吾受命討賊，寧能以一將軍之故，而縱汝乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "f2e5e06517548ae2e87036d9908bf9927c475460b1d990bc27f5f9ea8e2e7f9b"}

{"id": "p_b69eb535d148a67e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」因涕泣謂惇曰：「當奈國法何！", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "fac306d7a959e9895e146875787efdae83a552946dff95f1cdc5a6727a313bc4"}

{"id": "p_5f8b5df1064b962d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 12, "text": "持質者惶遽叩头，言「我但欲乞資用去耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "3be4894d102e70f81821f4a70354305862a5d6b9bdebb372a97afe58e7769577"}

{"id": "p_d392559b11edff09", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 13, "text": "惇既免，太祖聞之，謂浩曰：「卿此可爲萬世法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "ea2db4ddb138fe01927f397314fbea029e44df870e9cfd35f457d2f5a96ca074"}

{"id": "p_6a4d5070f176707f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」乃著令，自今已後有持質者，皆當并擊，勿顧質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "60f98015fddddb02605b1ce423984e67645a55bf803211f5e88ef3dd82bf0285"}

{"id": "p_0253710ef78d576e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 15, "text": "太祖自徐州還，惇從征吕布，爲流矢所中，傷左目。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "4aa6b268817f516d9ae294f5a90c56a85b5409ba952eb2522d98e7204b2c4b9a"}

{"id": "p_985db81d12097aaf", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 16, "text": "復領陳留、濟陰太守，加建武將軍，封高安鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "bd299a2dbcbd6607667d11c4010bd4b1f41b1c76a7f54ace6d4426947bac821a"}

{"id": "p_731a64ab60da5be5", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 17, "text": "時大旱，蝗蟲起，惇乃斷太壽水作陂，身自負土，率將士勸種稻，民賴其利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "c8c29b6fafe5f4a204f9a81a6211518c76dce36fdb638d6556281f89b1c73014"}

{"id": "p_93f50bbfdb4324ca", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 18, "text": "太祖平河北，爲大將軍後拒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "e24bc1a56884b221bbc81099a0bf3c950e90fa541fa3d5257d3364f8f4efe868"}

{"id": "p_4c56246a5f57185f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 19, "text": "鄴破，遷伏波將軍，領尹如故，使得以便宜從事，不拘科制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "d7af99856344edb91980cfa7877d5816a7f43f892505d9a24cf6afc646288049"}

{"id": "p_b7f9498156827d51", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 20, "text": "，錄惇前後功，增封邑千八百户，并前二千五百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "197d4908d02d2f614ee406717e565e705dd82357f4b02f46df98ac7320653cc4"}

{"id": "p_8a42a1d254ffe9b4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 21, "text": "二十一年，從征孫權還，使惇都督二十六軍，留居巢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f0cf74ab3a1a5b15bba1dd7abae093b39752c854018d2d26985a1c0b1f838109"}

{"id": "p_da4d6d296cafb79d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 22, "text": "賜伎樂名倡，令曰：「魏絳以和戎之功，猶受金石之樂，況將軍乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "dde48ded59c089c99c5caf1ec976ac54b08a79f6d31c3af3a43824f9659d3f7e"}

{"id": "p_6acc36516092faf6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」二十四年，太祖軍於摩陂，召惇常與同載，特見親重，出入臥内，諸將莫得比也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "63f6891ef51e1a92227988b46c2fdfa81a07bf673ffc459bce782d7ad6eef8d3"}

{"id": "p_ca7936557d73f42c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 24, "text": "拜前將軍，督諸軍還壽春，徙屯召陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "b4ba9b58221d7f466fe2d653065c8cfba5ff7697f156323d0b8c228ddb599ced"}

{"id": "p_271b72177122ac89", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 25, "text": "文帝即王位，拜惇大將軍，數月薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "d2045034a2b9847267a960e3b22823d3299d98f8bffb611046043c19d15959cf"}

{"id": "p_9d4ca42eb99d725f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 26, "text": "惇雖在軍旅，親迎師受業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "bfdf1e46edb34ddc23b42761fa3d7428c47ce8880c6d5cadc39bcd9780ae9071"}

{"id": "p_1f0f5d76ad6ee65b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 27, "text": "性清儉，有餘財輒以分施，不足資之於官，不治產業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "72fb0f54e3e044bdb15fdc5af1d2d810068931366aeaab2b6edd9c9ee97dbba1"}

{"id": "p_37a733fcb9459b58", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 28, "text": "帝追思惇功，欲使子孫畢侯，分惇邑千户，賜惇七子二孫爵皆關内侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "8d2342bb05d3370ea55335e7803431bcfa26b29340895a597c742dd274f1a6b1"}

{"id": "p_fe151d5af2769cda", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 29, "text": "惇弟廉及子楙素自封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "4728ca87a275961ec86b591fe266f254b6f7fd1924fd52e7c7fc974b3cb01d4f"}

{"id": "p_577ec343ec0a278d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 30, "text": "初，太祖以女妻楙，即清河公主也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "f02984f681535c737360c14c32b893348410b9235889e7737c698ac0163068b1"}

{"id": "p_33d228a9917de950", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 31, "text": "楙歷位侍中尚書、安西鎮東將軍，假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "4ea00efefaece6860376ec6080a1fe878f6309b6ed319902ac48998f30e1911f"}

{"id": "p_8bb06ff97d5d46b7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 32, "text": "及沛國史渙與浩俱以忠勇顯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "d0c7fd53bdbad720410d79c149fd927c741e6bc4b0d747c3577d0c5097c61496"}

{"id": "p_84d09e0e3e515b39", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 33, "text": "浩至中護軍，渙至中領軍，皆掌禁兵，封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "d21a0e166872ba9384dd05c53a545f104734425843e23e454cd806f1db0d451f"}

{"id": "p_8df51155e490d57d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 34, "text": "夏侯淵字妙才，惇族弟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "381592cf16bda09857de6f2f692c6847ad1bb6ff4dd63efa4d4c87110f972232"}

{"id": "p_6ef7436b8b6f7eed", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 35, "text": "太祖居家，曾有縣官事，淵代引重罪，太祖營救之，得免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "56852d67aa8ce19ae17bfd89e4983c8b70fa07e5ce8872d7354a124377c1ac8b"}

{"id": "p_75a888a3c020ba85", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 36, "text": "太祖起兵，以别部司馬、騎都尉從，遷陳留、潁川太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "ce1b9fc2787520f4533af874d3ba8fae216c7e989924d89275115ac4d6b28c7b"}

{"id": "p_facb7424beb60c06", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 37, "text": "及與袁紹戰於官渡，行督軍校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "0506e6e08c2d1aaef20d823722dc133b0c571bf5ef2b1f626e67cd94abac24e8"}

{"id": "p_9b8bc39ede6ceb81", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 38, "text": "紹破，使督兖、豫、徐州軍糧；時軍食少，淵傳饋相繼，軍以復振。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "415d761ee5ac55bee8b17511784e5a90a54eca8ba3e99ef07828c68ef00b3969"}

{"id": "p_514fd6fdcc8f35ad", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 39, "text": "昌豨反，遣于禁擊之，未拔，復遣淵與禁并力，遂擊豨，降其十餘屯，豨詣禁降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "bee3ee06b2dcfeb62e0d47687a0a393f61ec84150a90f80254bedfdecdb611f3"}

{"id": "p_49f6b00eac10c834", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 40, "text": "濟南、樂安黄巾徐和、司馬俱等攻城，殺長吏，淵將泰山、齊、平原郡兵擊，大破之，斬和，平諸縣，收其糧穀以給軍士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "a80be50ae27e2ca0224b7ca6739f6be478ecd0688db7141ac8b95629bf52c110"}

{"id": "p_0fe182ee4ee8483c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 41, "text": "太祖征孫權還，使淵督諸將擊廬江叛者雷緒，緒破，又行征西護軍，督徐晃擊太原賊，攻下二十餘屯，斬賊帥商曜，屠其城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "c24554e943d7add9cea73100a706a07886df7be42b2765aedd5889fbf9bab67a"}

{"id": "p_fb04a9342ff3420f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 42, "text": "十七年，太祖乃還鄴，以淵行護軍將軍，督朱靈、路招等屯長安，擊破南山賊劉雄，降其眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "67460d797c2f4b27f7afd7c00ae99d97f44037efb4c800ab56f381ac570b8fb1"}

{"id": "p_d1b0e007e4939bc5", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 43, "text": "圍遂、超餘党梁興於鄠，拔之，斬興，封博昌亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "24bc4dec6ecc8f149285d7c378f3de0f0f7095375537e9bc179f2761b4518d32"}

{"id": "p_321f324ed2084ada", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 44, "text": "馬超圍涼州刺史韋康於冀，淵救康，未到，康敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "36a6121054e9d17673e36b86b1bb21798bb36e99e9181f34f144abb4fc703a95"}

{"id": "p_81823492a1de8dc2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 45, "text": "去冀二百餘里，超來逆戰，軍不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "8b38aea3b5c70a0ae452c0fee0b880b9c8f9c6be58ba7aeeb7fe3df13a05402a"}

{"id": "p_fe0063b936b39f7c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 46, "text": "十九年，趙衢、尹奉等謀討超，姜叙起兵鹵城以應之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "3f1fbfa7ba51779ebf76d3ad55a8d24b2fe950a93567a4004208dd6df6ea3f65"}

{"id": "p_c0b037b6e34cb416", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 47, "text": "衢等譎說超，使出擊叙，於後盡殺超妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "0df4f38cd32cdacb6aac389b7a0f72fb9bebdca7a7c14186025b4d2dea420fef"}

{"id": "p_1ccdb868a6f60a17", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 48, "text": "叙等急求救，諸將議者欲湏太祖節度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "e22fc0bfac70e84ad250de844b0349ace2124373d71a0fadb04fa9d1daf198c6"}

{"id": "p_27aa8e305743f101", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 49, "text": "淵曰：「公在鄴，反覆四千里，比報，叙等必敗，非救急也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "0ff0542427da0197c3e8c0fe53a39fde226cf4c8a21ef168ae7a6af492dc5b68"}

{"id": "p_83fea5e3cc96f2b1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」遂行，使張郃督步騎五千在前，從陳倉狹道入，淵自督糧在後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "6a4ecd84d47eec235a6dbc70bfd0ee51ec504068661f4edbac9f5c92cc080611"}

{"id": "p_dbeb0cdd29e63f17", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 51, "text": "郃至渭水上，超將氐羌數千逆郃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "8e139596dd575ef1b0315ff57d903b4a1cd44e469733ed6edd828c901b9d132d"}

{"id": "p_bc450bad17b001b4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 52, "text": "未戰，超走，郃進軍收超軍器械。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "6f41086e12c962a902247cb4fa6b30238788f8235a344384d5bbfc50f36a5145"}

{"id": "p_1cd82ff5d53f7bf0", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 53, "text": "韓遂在顯親，淵欲襲取之，遂走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "e5479649ca1478b53f7cd6f9d4e5b13daaf48135081e8afe9c54d64d4e209004"}

{"id": "p_354384f0003472e9", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 54, "text": "淵收遂軍糧，追至略陽城，去遂二十餘里，諸將欲攻之，或言當攻興國氐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "c9dcff6f32e5ee8ed99d838b9b9504b49fcb6813086e3950d95788c5f98bbdd8"}

{"id": "p_28e901e012cca7a9", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 55, "text": "淵以爲遂兵精，興國城固，攻不可卒拔，不如擊長離諸羌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "14f585dc7c8a2e7df9660effd76f2d81f811645e8e37e1bcd56585c4ef596a7f"}

{"id": "p_d27696de380fc9dc", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 56, "text": "長離諸羌多在遂軍，必歸救其家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "3f2fc43389dbb1a9888081c967fa5bff4882265dc9dc0e669a7449d424dcb306"}

{"id": "p_4dd87b23c5b07dbd", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 57, "text": "若羌獨守則孤，救長離則官兵得與野戰，可必虜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "b031a51a0e73655331030b99d82dd9bc39185562971280e6d713173e3f10702c"}

{"id": "p_fc73ee461be7b7c8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 58, "text": "淵乃留督將守輜重，輕兵步騎到長離，攻燒羌屯，斬获甚眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "77d93efb8e09ecfff543e9007203418dfd07768219702d914aad37ba8d8dd8bf"}

{"id": "p_1b5fd005712f3c05", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 59, "text": "諸羌在遂軍者，各還種落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "a4a744146a15bc4100c792486dd62a8b49471924b9d20c200605b3d31e50f3d6"}

{"id": "p_91d092917d3de4ec", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 60, "text": "遂果救長離，與淵軍对陣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "be22774caec97f130b420b7842d7c8d3864da3853988d79c8ae717c68fbd153c"}

{"id": "p_9b53313422e6a881", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 61, "text": "諸將見遂眾，惡之，欲結營作塹乃與戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "25ba136e4ac16e4aa9e1c91147a270f89de54ff304c53663f39b26042365db44"}

{"id": "p_946ca003566bec14", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 62, "text": "淵曰：「我轉鬭千里，今復作營塹，則士眾罷弊，不可久。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "f98940633bca8698911d04ce79ae9256950a6e4e9abe1a0da76bc74a8b330c8c"}

{"id": "p_b1c3fbaa446de43e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」乃鼓之，大破遂軍，得其旌麾，還略陽，進軍圍興國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "6e7de4c724b02d0ce95c6fde7260551d35c38eb3d7186710cd592b303df23e40"}

{"id": "p_0c7d50724a7f8156", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 64, "text": "氐王千萬逃奔馬超，餘眾降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "a282eb69c79a2b45c637b3b64502be300e4d14fcaba5732cd22bd0127f4456bf"}

{"id": "p_f9bdd5b6e4f6680b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 65, "text": "轉擊高平屠各，皆散走，收其糧穀牛馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "a8fdc31bea41ca094f9b5484b4da146c31e9884fe750b7d09fb9e17074bb5194"}

{"id": "p_fff4d9aa517874b6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 66, "text": "初，枹罕宋建因涼州亂，自號河首平漢王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "1de4ac1ecc36d979b257aa1385d7589337f241cbead5748704fa2d86a8bb9bba"}

{"id": "p_9526278afb999319", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 67, "text": "淵至，圍枹罕，月餘拔之，斬建及所置丞相已下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "54db4c31f4464a040c6f9fc30d4030d80652da7e803e73d96273c5a0f60792bb"}

{"id": "p_e8a942bde90074d6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 68, "text": "淵别遣張郃等平河關，渡河入小湟中，河西諸羌盡降，隴右平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "b023592e5e262f688f80ba750fe56bb2711a511f44ab6d0082e87eddcba59c76"}

{"id": "p_aa1accecd31e66f4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 69, "text": "太祖下令曰：「宋建造爲亂逆三十餘年，淵一舉滅之，虎步關右，所向無前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "36f40061bf5a68bb2539b4cacf82faf0bcd27eab4bf7a4a3cbe9a27e9e5edc4a"}

{"id": "p_7691a6638d73c308", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 70, "text": "仲尼有言：『吾與尔不如也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "9de591c74f7678b9ae5966077ebba64a1dac75cea9778b421df2acdff0795d29"}

{"id": "p_4579e74258245250", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 71, "text": "』」二十一年，增封三百户，并前八百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "3e6122ff0d50e491da6653410eb8c6ef11d4ac6e75f70330131159cda53157ef"}

{"id": "p_818d2d1ea1fd42ad", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 72, "text": "還擊武都氐羌下辯，收氐穀十餘萬斛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "375c151b25af06a273a6683411fab23c4abbfff66ec591a99abb8b067cab122c"}

{"id": "p_1724df924b35f81a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 73, "text": "太祖西征張魯，淵等將涼州諸將侯王已下，與太祖會休亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "8b408f748d174538d1843594f06a3626f7d405001bdd213a16b1045c8a821395"}

{"id": "p_1a7558c20f3ff34e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 74, "text": "太祖每引見羌、胡，以淵畏之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "4c9ed46f9c9df13397e02ef6450fade7165cf4e24443512c57f7be3a1edcd13f"}

{"id": "p_d150a577f603e419", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 75, "text": "會魯降，漢中平，以淵行都護將軍，督張郃、徐晃等平巴郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "64c48db7ad892d1f39d01ff96d8f227c49e0dc18b37b0030fa1caee097647521"}

{"id": "p_1dc97b0a87ce2e1e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 76, "text": "太祖還鄴，留淵守漢中，即拜淵征西將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "6e3717709b45625a865c0ce8b7ea848fa13f655a12ca140f2482e5e60494ebd6"}

{"id": "p_ce59542d5bdddb9d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 77, "text": "二十三年，劉備軍陽平關，淵率諸將拒之，相守連年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "2c2830b871da299ed0b7105ae0f4791b6fd46987a69ece6664d997af4a499bc1"}

{"id": "p_dd10994eb5d38d10", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 78, "text": "二十四年正月，備夜燒圍鹿角。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "1f1336d87ee9628901a5748865e974062e56759f6bc16d3f4d7a3a42abb37502"}

{"id": "p_fcc1ea4831249790", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 79, "text": "淵使張郃護東圍，自將輕兵護南圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "90e867965c201e0a711e853bb0158d44384bf7b6a30f4be82c4c32c90ae0d1bf"}

{"id": "p_275971bbbe03d4a6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 80, "text": "淵分所將兵半助郃，爲備所襲，淵遂戰死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "0c8b30974eb3f0f4442c91382674d3f3d5662d4cc5f2c33534179cfbbdb5845c"}

{"id": "p_37eb0b086a9ddfc2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 81, "text": "初，淵雖數戰勝，太祖常戒曰：「爲將當有怯弱時，不可但恃勇也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "bb064ffd38ed37f55e12ab853baa1cbe9c9518880ac56c76882bb61fac1a6ba3"}

{"id": "p_986491d734de93ca", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 82, "text": "將當以勇爲本，行之以智計；但知任勇，一匹夫敵耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "4247a5af744d317852ebc6cdb743bbb2506865a72399611efd543124e3f565d7"}

{"id": "p_c35ff696e0672f4c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 83, "text": "長子衡，尚太祖弟海陽哀侯女，恩寵特隆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "3203e4808e972a4805baac1b07991db019135dd451ee3d611869951137f28d16"}

{"id": "p_5a6c54163cbd8a9c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 84, "text": "黄初中，賜中子霸，太和中，賜霸四弟，爵皆關内侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "df0d5885776a88a6ab63e65facd11436b50f9ed34fb5c51bed5884f6702b0c63"}

{"id": "p_948f276532207ec0", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 85, "text": "霸，正始中爲討蜀護軍右將軍，進封博昌亭侯，素爲曹爽所厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "2b4f7da4e59dae346b031ce100b5b6f34828c6053c48b6ed79fe5a190f4981d8"}

{"id": "p_c84f4d2659dafd76", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 86, "text": "以淵舊勳赦霸子，徙樂浪郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "a4fe557fc3272b7d3bb7cc82071139769bcdd167b481322725fa99625c05079b"}

{"id": "p_3ece61d6b4413d6f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 87, "text": "衡薨，子績嗣，爲虎賁中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "ae1d53d0515d4a2ccbccae20c82a43cc147f12616e4acc00354e86d07a602bc0"}

{"id": "p_392228590d074921", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 88, "text": "曹仁字子孝，太祖從弟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "a5aa7ed1a2b72d4bf2c24212dd3a1aa3b1c4758918860af7217a997446dac9f1"}

{"id": "p_3610f5f8687b4e98", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 89, "text": "後豪杰并起，仁亦陰結少年，得千餘人，周旋淮、泗之間，遂從太祖爲别部司馬，行厉鋒校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "8f84f6a112b1ea61104fefd6bbe57c8227ddedbff10dec083568a3beb295a59b"}

{"id": "p_0f38b6a7f728becf", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 90, "text": "太祖之破袁术，仁所斬获颇多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "d39cbed51dc8de77cf29e746ab45a6b7b8f8519e64170c76f13db90ba3d89fc9"}

{"id": "p_cfe2d1ab1617555e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 91, "text": "從征徐州，仁常督騎，爲軍前鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "cd187d3a9fb46adebba7642cb4f1ce696de2560e1fd7ec5f3e620a2557a72a60"}

{"id": "p_a35c22229f6ca655", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 92, "text": "别攻陶謙將吕由，破之，還與大軍合彭城，大破謙軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "8e9e3d51e1fd7d14827703b2fa00e1281aabe8455c039542b57804b961fe72a3"}

{"id": "p_e192411320110044", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 93, "text": "從攻费、华、即墨、开陽，謙遣别將救諸縣，仁以騎擊破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "eaa200040f88aac4d882e5aff22a9254563057c77922948c3491707cf980f3ff"}

{"id": "p_af28e906aedf6537", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 94, "text": "太祖征吕布，仁别攻句陽，拔之，生获布將劉何。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "01c869f77ace9e3b5f3d6232cfe03071647851604c99f50998c67dd921d49423"}

{"id": "p_ef1935f193ac2131", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 95, "text": "太祖平黄巾，迎天子都许，仁數有功，拜广陽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "95f2ed96459eecfb8621f869a555d25dbf98f923d2aeb3b9f68e4772476cbb31"}

{"id": "p_d3c15fe07a99fc86", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 96, "text": "太祖器其勇略，不使之郡，以議郎督騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "1ca5d22610c95c05bb7f0f78f4816047d0f97a755d877190db3b2f414895aab9"}

{"id": "p_e3a50bd39433cb7e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 97, "text": "太祖征張绣，仁别徇旁縣，虜其男女三千餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "df1860698326d71638caccbb10fcffafd63cecdf64cb307d7fbf1a57e25a4041"}

{"id": "p_e1796300dd716368", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 98, "text": "太祖軍還，爲绣所追，軍不利，士卒喪氣，仁率厉將士甚奮，太祖壯之，遂破绣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "c28aabb78e1c4e18e403f954c98e8a11081137debc7ce1447d41dced140e6964"}

{"id": "p_cb0074cb755d0c18", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 99, "text": "太祖與袁紹久相持於官渡，紹遣劉備徇㶏彊諸縣，多舉眾應之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "dbf7270a8a7b01b993af56669f44283f90058a9af3eb1563149b06de62ea04be"}

{"id": "p_260b6b2472b96412", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 100, "text": "自许以南，吏民不安，太祖以爲憂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "aa48dc266b91b2f3ff0e4426e8fab268f2cf06385db80e51311c2679dcc07411"}

{"id": "p_4c65dbfd9c488a0c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 101, "text": "仁曰：「南方以大軍方有目前急，其勢不能相救，劉備以彊兵临之，其背叛固宜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "1b331184137f4cecd2190ff0b19192c48dfe15151818a63834e3ec2161262635"}

{"id": "p_aa299ecf84517858", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 102, "text": "備新將紹兵，未能得其用，擊之可破也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "3c5c65f7a48e2552d964080c0605de2eb624dd8e347744c9489112353e1ba271"}
