{"id": "p_8942c3b9ee5326d1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 103, "text": "」太祖善其言，遂使將騎擊備，破走之，仁盡復收諸叛縣而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "01bf1f97475b5213aaea2d44dfa292c72f14e9e928262376e0892ea6564ba5ca"}

{"id": "p_52603831e7e82fa1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 104, "text": "紹遣别將韓荀钞斷西道，仁擊荀於鸡洛山，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "b2511ef9bff0eaa744b7eb8653bc6ea365c37e02bcc82961bb15259df21bb962"}

{"id": "p_a122faf5a32b7749", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 105, "text": "復與史渙等钞紹运车，燒其糧穀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "b945829865a887890d978c8ee86ae60d4055e414649efd29ab250de3e39ae27b"}

{"id": "p_13d47e31a785147e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 106, "text": "太祖令曰：「城拔，皆坑之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "1bf8afd1b41e4b0977a736ec9df57b3c03e15a9e0e4437457ddb164ab76e3ffe"}

{"id": "p_475e7e9f220bd900", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 107, "text": "仁言於太祖曰：「圍城必示之活門，所以开其生路也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "e8e20086809504c39606aad10d574965cba60dfd4e315f9bbfa7b00752ef0b4a"}

{"id": "p_d929cab5fc4e9ca6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 108, "text": "今公告之必死，將人自爲守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "5ed5bac4660d82c273c3c8c76884c416c2910e537d20b9d153ee476a36ef8e5b"}

{"id": "p_28ade6cdd0e5ef75", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 109, "text": "且城固而糧多，攻之則士卒傷，守之則引日久；今顿兵堅城之下，以攻必死之虜，非良計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "1950bf29b11df5e4c45e864d21389db75c70e19179c07616ad22c3f12463fac2"}

{"id": "p_e95b07d8cbd1b2bc", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 110, "text": "於是錄仁前後功，封都亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "6f905fab5859a8fb22734ac255a446508a80d75c8b939ae2b7abbeae993272e1"}

{"id": "p_0377d6c2a3d9474a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 111, "text": "從平荆州，以仁行征南將軍，留屯江陵，拒吴將周瑜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "34814fcb9eec04a69b3d9b5d3ef17c15e3b87f789b0ed273fc3943aa2709eab1"}

{"id": "p_7078b579451853ad", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 112, "text": "瑜將數萬眾來攻，前鋒數千人始至，仁登城望之，乃募得三百人，遣部曲將牛金逆與挑戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "4e744cf01fe46ad205fa5e93621116e1dd8ec29f6c9f3642a0252d04492e9d5b"}

{"id": "p_cc227557dca399d1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 113, "text": "賊多，金眾少，遂爲所圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "4fdd7176c454c5038816782515641ff367246f0bfe7ba47dd7cce237901afb6a"}

{"id": "p_bce0a6b43c3dd2b5", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 114, "text": "長史陳矫俱在城上，望見金等垂沒，左右皆失色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "cf8d98eeb9e4d7d0b205159d18d16d140ad108cd0fd54db478ad0b54bc11bc7f"}

{"id": "p_94c604cd8fd62e5d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 115, "text": "仁意氣奮怒甚，謂左右取馬來，矫等共援持之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "79f0b44676162d034d96100e56e46497ce5e9b0da47f2b6f13cf69df06648fc6"}

{"id": "p_1541e616132691d0", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 116, "text": "謂仁曰：「賊眾盛，不可當也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "1bac34f934d0759e9f0f20f92cd8e74d6123b4bf4db7c401b3c262287a144883"}

{"id": "p_8e1f4dc8ce407ba1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 117, "text": "假使棄數百人何苦，而將軍以身赴之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "25d31216858e5794e8076cadb961b50f6f19f7458b8a90760f07fbad8b3e8703"}

{"id": "p_eb06142b8f59629c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 118, "text": "」仁不應，遂被甲上馬，將其麾下壯士數十騎出城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "101dfb8666c55a28be4bb2e2e98d051e1a9ebd803df183dfebe67df176c406e6"}

{"id": "p_8d3b186dbaa347d1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 119, "text": "去賊百餘步，迫沟，矫等以爲仁當住沟上，爲金形勢也，仁径渡沟直前，衝入賊圍，金等乃得解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "b551ab5337e9b72143b3514a406cff22a7e935a1114bf23d627d5d481dd3cdca"}

{"id": "p_793ff80b2b2c3712", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 120, "text": "餘眾未盡出，仁復直還突之，拔出金兵，亡其數人，賊眾乃退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "c07b7e2369d14fbbb3f3125ae6a55918e78af8e95d6182502f43fb92920d7afe"}

{"id": "p_df0a12ada054e84d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 121, "text": "矫等初見仁出，皆懼，及見仁還，乃叹曰：「將軍真天人也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "224c81f6083a7219db5790a3b4255ff20c1dbdbe23b6cd57b904fb13265d9678"}

{"id": "p_5b90357d2a60ddca", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 122, "text": "太祖益壯之，轉封安平亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "a826031d1d79a52334622c823ecab4afa07bb8340ab61d9ba802fc1285c86d9d"}

{"id": "p_f6ce127548ee3db5", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 123, "text": "太祖討馬超，以仁行安西將軍，督諸將拒潼關，破超渭南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "9c835ba452a320e9951ff9dde4f383b76d609bc73131756756bb63c1fa359ad4"}

{"id": "p_2f1246eb81e805f4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 124, "text": "苏伯、田银反，以仁行骁騎將軍，都督七軍討银等，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "28733c848d0e832db17986cd4f77ca7cadcce6797ababfec1398ab06e5fe1073"}

{"id": "p_41fe64988c2f7457", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 125, "text": "復以仁行征南將軍，假節，屯樊，鎮荆州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "a6c104e9615370bb4003bf54ec9f4c50bec4a54bda8bef45b631979ade39ef31"}

{"id": "p_dcda419b1fc91a84", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 126, "text": "侯音以宛叛，略傍縣眾數千人，仁率諸軍攻破音，斬其首，還屯樊，即拜征南將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "7b28f14d8936b230bd82ab63ac9ac620c44079d7c823b47a255a9cb80939a313"}

{"id": "p_996aea7601c32788", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 127, "text": "關羽攻樊，時漢水暴溢，于禁等七軍皆沒，禁降羽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "46d09c01752760eb4068715a89e58b85704c602ac193353019bca6bcba254e51"}

{"id": "p_55dc55f164b32c79", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 128, "text": "仁人馬數千人守城，城不沒者數板。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "3696c4c75cad16aed4428be0da6b3d1c2675b39e1339e4e1c16b13bb75c3cdca"}

{"id": "p_30c1470abf8d8a9e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 129, "text": "羽乘船临城，圍數重，外内斷絕，糧食欲盡，救兵不至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "2630c2374df29b7296ed3a12a4a2e7178ad19eb6f4af9fa120d6659e2904d350"}

{"id": "p_887aa1642dbf29a3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 130, "text": "仁激厉將士，示以必死，將士感之皆無二。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "42dbb8392369ba15df9ffb01618b3fdaffc7681479e80bee78255444d5a6cd12"}

{"id": "p_371c25cabe57f40f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 131, "text": "徐晃救至，水亦稍减，晃從外擊羽，仁得溃圍出，羽退走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "1c68692e40f1ef47bb3d8d023efdfe55715d7d7c77592d831c6a56ac8fc8e7d2"}

{"id": "p_d63af8bf207545bb", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 132, "text": "仁少時不脩行检，及長爲將，嚴整奉法令，常置科於左右，案以從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "c590b1b0add1677658d686aff17afefee7051d3c1278dd632f5e9d8d55881232"}

{"id": "p_5722e108dcec8a92", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 133, "text": "鄢陵侯彰北征烏丸，文帝在東宫，爲書戒彰曰：「爲將奉法，不當如征南邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "a832a8cb3d5821a4cbe3b645cd32a3b71c5b95c421defdb75f9d99f766880312"}

{"id": "p_a729e386400ae05b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 134, "text": "」及即王位，拜仁车騎將軍，都督荆、揚、益州諸軍事，進封陳侯，增邑二千，并前三千五百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "a96d6746d97ce84b57d17cff3f0a22bbd4a7fc723fe75f683a3be8991d1b6cea"}

{"id": "p_355f218fa2f9c52d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 135, "text": "追賜仁父炽諡曰陳穆侯，置守冢十家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "11857ca03cf300a0c89c4dade51b097354f03ae55cee0249808f96f49cc8c739"}

{"id": "p_99cc974b27cd14d4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 136, "text": "孫權遣將陳邵据襄陽，詔仁討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "838f35a50f8d53df50ac18ba8eac9dbe6d5a8194aa9302a18ae61fe44b98de3c"}

{"id": "p_fc30e12f44bf2b9b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 137, "text": "仁與徐晃攻破邵，遂入襄陽，使將軍高遷等徙漢南附化民於漢北，文帝遣使即拜仁大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "3f41ab33282489c0035eba82b26c1cdf28f59087d3e8944f6595e4c822d61524"}

{"id": "p_a91c14d335e98262", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 138, "text": "又詔仁移屯临潁，遷大司馬，復督諸軍据烏江，還屯合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "ef8539bb0ca9dc2e5903d247a996d8dbd5d52c0e54525433c075378dbbcd6f03"}

{"id": "p_b4cf1e5378fc5357", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 139, "text": "子泰嗣，官至鎮東將軍，假節，轉封甯陵侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "1086728926d83fd93a0df63b0668ce142827bb29a20c0b81181933c461788dff"}

{"id": "p_0ba161b8a35eb24a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 140, "text": "又分封泰弟楷、範，皆爲列侯，而牛金官至後將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "ef878276fa3778a6f5a66ca69bb32a51cc81078eb7cba2aaaa69679acc78b079"}

{"id": "p_26ab71e47dfa8095", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 141, "text": "仁弟純，初以議郎参司空軍事，督虎豹騎從圍南皮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "0bb23fdbd70514c13aa2717b76dada82b6aab2654f08f8e01b1d5ab1d4209c4a"}

{"id": "p_d3ef24a5bf790e5b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 142, "text": "太祖欲缓之，純曰：「今千里蹈敵，進不能克，退必喪威；且縣師深入，難以持久。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "08e7ca51a8e26b99cbd931588e8da69d96eeaf9398d659f53d01e64766a437fb"}

{"id": "p_174cc357114074b6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 143, "text": "彼勝而骄，我敗而懼，以懼敵骄，必可克也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "7214e193d3add7bccced0473f254481e285ae42f3591f4755d94e2345a110c59"}

{"id": "p_ebb6a80bfb335b96", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」太祖善其言，遂急攻之，譚敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "1370abb639941b0e6fe82f640cdc81555ae9ba444b99cac7d01ce45095ba04f7"}

{"id": "p_5b9f940abe1a541d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 145, "text": "及北征三郡，純部騎获单於蹹顿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "21494eebdf6935018d2d303b201195e3d10f0f7254fcb7557bd5a01367972be2"}

{"id": "p_e7d18153942d9b10", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 146, "text": "以前後功封高陵亭侯，邑三百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "8cf247697b682a6c85dbca17429b71b4350d9128ff8aa5633ba6d996494d3544"}

{"id": "p_84589b44010c88a4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 147, "text": "從征荆州，追劉備於長坂，获其二女輜重，收其散卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "f4018cbf2f349eda704cd6a03f0f6276dc139b883e9f6db0e0c2d56b67721f8f"}

{"id": "p_0231cbf8192d2122", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 148, "text": "子演嗣，官至領軍將軍，正元中進封平樂鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "c423daebf6b401b7dd921ca9be7e26b9edcde2101b1d9a2eeb731b6053ffda43"}

{"id": "p_a6976c979d5a885d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 149, "text": "曹洪字子廉，太祖從弟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "56855e0d2b6fcb658500ba49450abc97e50f4a13c6fda7871c2e53701af2e1ec"}

{"id": "p_2df595374db21e08", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 150, "text": "太祖起義兵討董卓，至荥陽，爲卓將徐榮所敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "0ec3cc1bc61012dafb8d2e1cea36f07652c982405cd8cf24ac09c4427be17081"}

{"id": "p_6952ac0567c6750f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 151, "text": "太祖失馬，賊追甚急，洪下，以馬授太祖，太祖辞讓，洪曰：「天下可無洪，不可無君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "997eabedfe3d67032e4081c4fea293b1f31d0fa03a35a15ae5f495cfae52334d"}

{"id": "p_4154f77714102461", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 152, "text": "」遂步從到汴水，水深不得渡，洪循水得船，與太祖俱濟，還奔譙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "6769f3c99aab8d3c9b977cc83fe5a79ab8dba4ecb4c32b5489ad9fa6e03bd1e3"}

{"id": "p_95c18158db092921", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 153, "text": "揚州刺史陳温素與洪善，洪將家兵千餘人，就温募兵，得廬江上甲二千人，東到丹楊復得數千人，與太祖會龍亢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "98d02de6343ecc55e97aaaf77f34b748052cc02274ffa58ecd38b4604d0a5177"}

{"id": "p_f7c676c8882c9675", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 154, "text": "太祖征徐州，張邈舉兖州叛迎吕布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "6fbdf9a82ee96be8b39cf5477eefbcb57596b11c444a6aa4abbe4464bb43a646"}

{"id": "p_ae47924a7a5c8ca7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 155, "text": "時大饑荒，洪將兵在前，先据東平、範，聚糧穀以繼軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "2b8d305da5a03cff4632cc0a6df125ae1f385ecd12e502e09dfd691eae7e7dc1"}

{"id": "p_8a9db1a4f165bdc7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 156, "text": "太祖討邈、布於濮陽，布破走，遂据東阿，轉擊濟陰、山陽、中牟、陽武、京、密十餘縣，皆拔之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "81b1730462bc3b09c4108f40202b4cb22e769068aae103275e1ddf5e30b44f9a"}

{"id": "p_7d4590849fdf9ae3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 157, "text": "以前後功拜鹰揚校尉，遷揚武中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "920f875a3047f724b7b328423ab49e5d65dadb784bae8db44c3437ffbafac483"}

{"id": "p_c1df90438d81acad", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 158, "text": "天子都许，拜洪諫議大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "8999053dbeab45e42c02ef36c851232f8a2a191bca25fe02bf0f9e003638cb01"}

{"id": "p_3cf3f8e2c7859b20", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 159, "text": "别征劉表，破表别將於舞陽、陰葉、堵陽、博望，有功，遷厉鋒將軍，封國明亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "48680657fcd98fb002834310f7077708a7a2a4884f02dd052d85a2d706338b54"}

{"id": "p_28587d8b5223cfbb", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 160, "text": "文帝即位，爲衛將軍，遷骠騎將軍，進封野王侯，益邑千户，并前二千一百户，位特進；後徙封都陽侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "4eaab44dc2b76d42ac86913a0bae564024217000024103d625b6fe7865a4d2da"}

{"id": "p_cc4411af29070d35", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 161, "text": "始，洪家富而性吝啬，文帝少時假求不稱，常恨之，遂以舍客犯法，下狱當死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "5e35ff34b5422129f9539e82d3772d264aa752fd791297e93b57d537b608e347"}

{"id": "p_61b2482c39d5e4d0", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 162, "text": "卞太后謂郭后曰：「令曹洪今日死，吾明日敕帝废后矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "7403b1ba81cb97bea03234d467b3a615d333748d59502e9df25996dc46445157"}

{"id": "p_0ff27631a9192892", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」於是泣涕屡請，乃得免官削爵土。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "7ec4cb3fc783a509f25349cd9168491dceb8274e313a8187f83e7082377e036e"}

{"id": "p_91a196f0b0b0cc32", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 164, "text": "洪先帝功臣，時人多爲觖望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "63185b417c408b70ed3eb46f75b8ce2ca62bf48a76dfbce5097a04c34f46417a"}

{"id": "p_0100187c41b7740f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 165, "text": "明帝即位，拜後將軍，更封樂城侯，邑千户，位特進，復拜骠騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "d9de0601e64ba2f58c18b783922e15cbec7dda593d9b234781c321ad6c0ea17d"}

{"id": "p_6e5ee60018ada144", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 166, "text": "初，太祖分洪户封子震列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "288d384561982a0af5d021dbc5612c1d71ff962bef27df85ea4953f677183a02"}

{"id": "p_ed7f3702be8fe092", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 167, "text": "洪族父瑜，脩慎笃敬，官至衛將軍，封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "103fc10f21b0a69899cca3b440ac61c2bdfa0d3b0825735fa56cea64ab03f607"}

{"id": "p_4309bb25c0f3cf06", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 168, "text": "曹休字文烈，太祖族子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "ee461d29d60d8134fcb3f91ca9e74078c03672813e277aa5044372b566996eb1"}

{"id": "p_f7a0a1165840e697", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 169, "text": "天下亂，宗族各散去鄉里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "2f3a2ac1e3f14739503c08cee7834a48675c6bc6b02850d61a8799b2eb01bfa9"}

{"id": "p_d52bc3592b6f12c1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 170, "text": "休年十餘歲，喪父，獨與一客担喪假葬，携將老母，渡江至吴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "0edba51e4613b3e787e9264fe5e6e4c463f7f428d79f5b4e9b4559f0ba32c5ca"}

{"id": "p_c9bf73ac3ab8d714", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 171, "text": "以太祖舉義兵，易姓名轉至荆州，間行北歸，見太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "7ebe75807e2bd7f4398124d4596c93b26f6092cbbd03e4fcf9b24cbcd74260c1"}

{"id": "p_c4ce0afac8a95326", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 172, "text": "太祖謂左右曰：「此吾家千里驹也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "559b5fd177fc041b01752eecfa9f3f5f885ab6cf4e944ef090eacf45e399548d"}

{"id": "p_9883adf6c66155cf", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 173, "text": "」使與文帝同止，見待如子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "b26023190c40236cbb64a0e853437b39cc3e1b4d5939a0c83ee78869c3aa2707"}

{"id": "p_f1c3f42389bdd523", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 174, "text": "常從征伐，使領虎豹騎宿衛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "ebd1e81635ccc18d4e4744496d165f6529989a1262f22a6b5ed0729478b7f7e1"}

{"id": "p_214e92405050f7d7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 175, "text": "劉備遣將吴兰屯下辯，太祖遣曹洪征之，以休爲騎都尉，参洪軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "ab39d0d6ec20273bf59e9fa1f2f9993a344868d5cb83819e7bc4f3972a05d191"}

{"id": "p_902c1868793128e8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 176, "text": "太祖謂休曰：「汝雖参軍，其實帥也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "df21bc0173f254bf5908e2e680fef42d779908b8438a176ef4c26d0cc5a73d9e"}

{"id": "p_a5af2f71ba652882", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 177, "text": "」洪聞此令，亦委事於休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "35b02957c0a736bb9257dd36faa60eafdfbbb48d8fee9593f8c103fe1c52d5ea"}

{"id": "p_c754bec06f7a4045", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 178, "text": "備遣張飛屯固山，欲斷軍後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "956b900507246abe194546744675d61ede6f06292b7bb347bfdf1caf3ff838e1"}

{"id": "p_05a11e9f7bdd6ded", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 179, "text": "眾議狐疑，休曰：「賊實斷道者，當伏兵潜行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "ae81ea8d417fe270afc833f6ac2ff1bd34908da7519799c3cc7d0f2a95cc7d5b"}

{"id": "p_7c70744de8c822bf", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 180, "text": "今乃先張声勢，此其不能也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "d7b671b3447cec27e78a2a68387ca2199961dad3b80187deda2f4b2e8abd612f"}

{"id": "p_9708185342332269", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 181, "text": "宜及其未集，促擊兰，兰破則飛自走矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "83ad38ed2968dbd65fbd6c8bf5a44b2512eb31ee4c00de005a5a89bbcf6d0bd1"}

{"id": "p_55913415447548a4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」洪從之，進兵擊兰，大破之，飛果走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "bd0ece1ccbb1b408fe1119cae302ed208ea7936fcc61bcddb297bb12313ae241"}

{"id": "p_043d22f0d8b1c5f8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 183, "text": "太祖拔漢中，諸軍還長安，拜休中領軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "60940fa957a0927969d7a1b7149e602deb2c3111a097a867d572d9a8acffe76b"}

{"id": "p_0425577687184822", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 184, "text": "文帝即王位，爲領軍將軍，錄前後功，封東陽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "50c5a69d15fe92813f00c63437b25d26b6d3000fc68b261322c831cd64095972"}

{"id": "p_e2acaf64fc504cbd", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 185, "text": "夏侯惇薨，以休爲鎮南將軍，假節都督諸軍事，车驾临送，上乃下舆執手而别。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "bafcce368ec8f349c7e975e48773341e20d160f468da00201b9002e5a20e32e6"}

{"id": "p_13bd7988a0f4dd47", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 186, "text": "孫權遣將屯歷陽，休到，擊破之，又别遣兵渡江，燒賊芜湖營數千家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "5b2033a21848b0c5222aa77b9935c41eae44ff50ffbf835aed63bbd6ecf9305c"}

{"id": "p_45c75f33143abc01", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 188, "text": "帝征孫權，以休爲征東大將軍，假黄钺，督張辽等及諸州郡二十餘軍，擊權大將吕範等於洞浦，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "4b981ac52cf5115e23601a56d162e563086b40df6d4a48dfbb9e7c40681d1ee3"}

{"id": "p_570429d19e0f6546", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 189, "text": "吴將审德屯皖，休擊破之，斬德首，吴將韓綜、翟丹等前後率眾詣休降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "e0f01adf0343e55af2d45e3a1591b643753406fbacb30f3cbbe48e2ec54dfc04"}

{"id": "p_5ab08a35d3b6b8f6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 190, "text": "增邑四百，并前二千五百户，遷大司馬，都督揚州如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "ff349dbc550e5784c579f84c784528ae8411d7a3be889c189dffe8eb47716db7"}

{"id": "p_3b7b04b5faeadff3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 191, "text": "，帝爲二道征吴，遣司馬宣王從漢水下，〔休督〕諸軍向尋陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "0ec81814b076adadf709f694825314ee32dd337fcd0b61b1b49bcb08a77514bb"}

{"id": "p_ba93049c0dd424f2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 192, "text": "賊將僞降，休深入，戰不利，退還宿石亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "dcadcc22bcbef0d33565ba92a24782b985d14e097517cd1c08cd74dad2e114e5"}

{"id": "p_e69d9859a5b022d9", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 193, "text": "軍夜惊，士卒亂，棄甲兵輜重甚多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "a71fa24ba4b4152e876cb69a8b61ff00779ab2a15fc615e49e72d710820b1d39"}

{"id": "p_51b4d01986fff259", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 194, "text": "休上書谢罪，帝遣屯騎校尉楊暨慰谕，禮賜益隆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "c0323e2f91816a85cce6ef2d22e19f012cdd78ea77ac20a2ea7e247d6b7b2367"}

{"id": "p_77f24c52bd8fe380", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 195, "text": "休因此痈发背薨，諡曰壯侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "0a9ec9da45963345045589e9d1e8034beecd0141cd6fbc964129b54fd1a86303"}

{"id": "p_9e5aaa1feaa58698", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 196, "text": "肇有當世才度，爲散騎常侍、屯騎校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "e57992d85928a8ed6ec0c6b49d6a57d3ca779d6be66831447bfb6261e532e145"}

{"id": "p_e07a753e852dbfe8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 197, "text": "明帝寝疾，方與燕王宇等屬以後事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "0b1061e2382635aeb1d70e39d7dc288de2138cdf01131045b2fcd0f020226ff2"}

{"id": "p_20b7dd40c8f3de98", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 198, "text": "帝意尋变，詔肇以侯歸第。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "b9ba288a264d687247f63e86918b4688f5932c258cbef0e27046ad0f8931b7a7"}

{"id": "p_16ef1bda4fbad119", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 199, "text": "初，文帝分休户三百封肇弟纂爲列侯，後爲殄吴將軍，薨，追赠前將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "4168c4ec11ec0a5a9a61e55960d23ba5a3b0c0cbe182a30b0a411fa116e2dd80"}

{"id": "p_b9a00f5632bb52aa", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 200, "text": "曹真字子丹，太祖族子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "9f274c3c00b699418e2605155316a40af92921148dd658e156e1590349da4034"}

{"id": "p_c8711165a939066a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 201, "text": "太祖起兵，真父邵募徒眾，爲州郡所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "698889d0931d16efd80c7c26402a18eaedbf2c08ef5697a4e06879be5a691f68"}

{"id": "p_d76ef167afa52262", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 202, "text": "太祖哀真少孤，收養與諸子同，使與文帝共止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "609ccfd1d5515d6ba4902e3491651fcb7c8412412e7008740d4b1a74514d7535"}

{"id": "p_0900fabf55c91db8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 203, "text": "常猎，爲虎所逐，顧射虎，應声而倒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "57ef8e266a94cf78277012db0fc93dc98995964039584c8afa8dd26632ecae44"}

{"id": "p_3ebf5c5217ce01e8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 204, "text": "太祖壯其鸷勇，使將虎豹騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "1a8a981816cc151147100ba1771ca674d2cf04b3392e25e6310c7c9779b4dd4b"}

{"id": "p_e629220579368ed1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 205, "text": "討靈丘賊，拔之，封靈壽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "5c820c999d965d059965870c80821ddc8196ea8ec4c286a4e058804fb4b89875"}

{"id": "p_f39ddb25a6fc5cad", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 206, "text": "以偏將軍將兵擊劉備别將於下辯，破之，拜中堅將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "8d0881839d186c660fe4fb74985cb837c26429857d9aae75339c9448eccf4c04"}

{"id": "p_507ab78b55db6cbd", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 207, "text": "是時，夏侯淵沒於陽平，太祖憂之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "a2745cc9db39785c4042cfb62870c5ce49b086c5ac02d2c5e1acc957918ff42b"}

{"id": "p_316a4138c5b00a45", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 208, "text": "以真爲征蜀護軍，督徐晃等破劉備别將高详於陽平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "3386a3768a063f3df484fc92ae92c2085d439e2db2516c966faa97b92fa12260"}

{"id": "p_e1b905afbdc452dc", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 209, "text": "太祖自至漢中，拔出諸軍，使真至武都迎曹洪等還屯陳倉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "86d6d37b0a15dc53c1351dff3d4ff45dfbb06d731b9e28efcb4506d3bbdda4ba"}

{"id": "p_809610c2e63200d2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 210, "text": "文帝即王位，以真爲鎮西將軍，假節都督雍、涼州諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "781c5b3d25a67a2da6d57a300930eff0a8b8198e122c190008a94058df1e1c16"}

{"id": "p_68156bf4bde6b195", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 211, "text": "張進等反於酒泉，真遣费曜討破之，斬進等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "fb8df0b192981417a589ec8c128c1e5571c10962644fc860105df8669c1375eb"}

{"id": "p_3e5f62866c2581fa", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 212, "text": "還京都，以真爲上軍大將軍，都督中外諸軍事，假節钺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "e169c77130c0dd4dfb400d67844f9c1da8d5684f471b626620b2f1a0a15b18d9"}

{"id": "p_35957b630fc1ae59", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 213, "text": "與夏侯尚等征孫權，擊牛渚屯，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "eff342e2e22b2d29c945b2a5cfe1af6ff4683a991307cdfb9c6d900efbe0067e"}

{"id": "p_9211785f0520fdd0", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 214, "text": "轉拜中軍大將軍，加給事中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "3a80a8b2274a9a2d94f035a272a67efe1ad7c7d0077df6495b2180e758301dad"}

{"id": "p_a6ae1bf7ad01c71e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 215, "text": "七年，文帝寝疾，真與陳羣、司馬宣王等受遺詔辅政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "691ca940fe714ad92f64a5d53b5793ff25706fbf93dff92d911a4cc76ca2054e"}

{"id": "p_0cacdd667d8d4869", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 216, "text": "明帝即位，進封邵陵侯，遷大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "433f68951ab79179aa3feaa73df1e6286faf6c0766e896af54021f60edd98eb5"}

{"id": "p_acf952aa1e04263c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 217, "text": "諸葛亮圍祁山，南安、天水、安定三郡反應亮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "25198c83f829effd9ea39b7cee726cb3874ca6d087cada08342d6c5a395ff415"}

{"id": "p_4d1665482a2418b7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 218, "text": "帝遣真督諸軍軍郿，遣張郃擊亮將馬谡，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "6aebdc76f32bf0618d69bcaea2465dd54a96f6228967366c2916d6d972a89067"}

{"id": "p_07be810476e7ed60", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 219, "text": "安定民楊条等略吏民保月支城，真進軍圍之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "14e4674ee6f49f5be6594069d60e49b8f623f145b9b0d7ad507c0c3770edf0ed"}

{"id": "p_dfc8e41548d587b8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 220, "text": "条謂其眾曰：「大將軍自來，吾原早降耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "66a2235bcf20cab494bad9416d4f435138140324f93a7b965c75cc0bd61bc81b"}

{"id": "p_1b83375fc71873d8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 221, "text": "真以亮惩於祁山，後出必從陳倉，乃使將軍郝昭、王生守陳倉，治其城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "485a3f32d5904459716af5c7a6b062f5f16a03f3b9b4e14bf062cea05e4bed3d"}

{"id": "p_ca25917042190cf8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 222, "text": "明年春，亮果圍陳倉，已有備而不能克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "961aab09f71e4fe56dded26d457f0ad700e6b67d1019ca451b1f94eee4d95976"}

{"id": "p_79ff1296e2bb7333", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 223, "text": "四年，朝洛陽，遷大司馬，賜劍履上殿，入朝不趋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "0fbfe8d55970983335d04ec7d463abc1fe55891a11525a3be81a1dd52466c272"}

{"id": "p_00a03a4d64b9baa7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 224, "text": "真以「蜀連出侵邊境，宜遂伐之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "e92bb7c6d7e5ed0276b8ebca9ffa6a88a5edda119bff8955d31c31850335e9ef"}

{"id": "p_045b5a89138b348c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 225, "text": "真以八月发長安，從子午道南入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "f4df8d24a68a2cac5e9b0ca3595561b5ce849af84a7d94fd3669a7c56b29fe0c"}

{"id": "p_8f603743ce1fdbde", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 226, "text": "司馬宣王溯漢水，當會南郑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "52ac2fc742fe113501ac3c2215436ccf03fe75091a1f2cac9202032fb801d782"}

{"id": "p_432cf9f6f031ad82", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 227, "text": "諸軍或從斜穀道，或從武威入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "a19456822cd009dbf5b02fc3314ea8682348eb1de0aee573a9ac1b5d3c58c769"}

{"id": "p_3cc702e685c0f22a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 228, "text": "會大霖雨三十餘日，或栈道斷絕，詔真還軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "ca01955540ae9ebde9d4e241d5f8ddb7f2f7839bc8d13c6560ca811138a6692d"}

{"id": "p_d42c7536715204ca", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 229, "text": "真少與宗人曹遵、鄉人朱赞并事太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "c870638445dd74ab57b0101d7c02226fe2f507aa5236625610fc6aec59b11707"}

{"id": "p_94f67d760f290178", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 230, "text": "遵、赞早亡，真愍之，乞分所食邑封遵、赞子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "097f7dc7e919aa6d16c4f3ec98258c26abf84a6404f0cbe7a735ae753e19ab81"}

{"id": "p_5acf067ba5dfa7f3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 231, "text": "詔曰：「大司馬有叔向抚孤之仁，笃晏平久要之分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "f4d2caaae2666e4fb29e842ca846f61d2a004ffa515d64d4c89ce455cdd062f7"}

{"id": "p_4660dd6fcd365ff5", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 232, "text": "君子成人之美，听分真邑賜遵、赞子爵關内侯，各百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "9808b79ee17cf1efc308c251d026d9d069cfa610663f92c8938a33cd2e855dfe"}

{"id": "p_c39c5dee683324be", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 233, "text": "」真每征行，與將士同劳苦，軍赏不足，輒以家財班賜，士卒皆原爲用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "44bd7e244c661915d1fff19b2d079426f71d01311414196aac8875953142c413"}

{"id": "p_750bc7888d42198e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 234, "text": "真病還洛陽，帝自幸其第省疾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "28a3c7f143b34a60d3fc1ce4b85ea3b79095d128d23fbfd898ab1f7c95a931e3"}

{"id": "p_6f6d20289231aa19", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 235, "text": "帝追思真功，詔曰：「大司馬蹈履忠節，佐命二祖，内不恃親戚之寵，外不骄白屋之士，可謂能持盈守位，劳謙其德者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "952c9313e461633fdaef0fd74283dad012c351fc5b9ec549f3b42bec5e66fdf5"}

{"id": "p_873f8bc82d429c33", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 236, "text": "其悉封真五子羲、训、則、彦、皑皆爲列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "c11c4c8ac60ae4055539def3382ec374e0bc30ae4c3dfd8b6a974df13937a862"}

{"id": "p_126eb35439d03b07", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 237, "text": "」初，文帝分真邑二百户，封真弟彬爲列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "3ae2a449843ffa8fe4dd73edd5e5e154ae6f60870b8a1d003e20fc3ecb3f0ce1"}

{"id": "p_afe44c7a17246a0a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 238, "text": "爽字昭伯，少以宗室謹重，明帝在東宮，甚親愛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "56a3b49005625ae4148cc9ec59f2b38a36c663b886d645429c3a2d4213e2382f"}

{"id": "p_505b62338f201f56", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 239, "text": "及即位，爲散騎侍郎，累遷城門校尉，加散騎常侍，轉武衞將軍，寵待有殊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "96fc6673d9ed67a54af6e038137038cf719311dad9ad71ef64a18e810febf9c4"}

{"id": "p_e9bd70cd619ad0e8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 240, "text": "帝寢疾，乃引爽入臥內，拜大將軍，假節鉞，都督中外諸軍事，錄尚書事，與太尉司馬宣王並受遺詔輔少主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "7a78aa983da8c04d312812293d5215693596b7ba8b91d4170eccde2da2772c88"}

{"id": "p_14f3f62ed3be8a8f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 241, "text": "明帝崩，齊王即位，加爽侍中，改封武安侯，邑萬二千戶，賜劒履上殿，入朝不趨，贊拜不名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "80c8229d3390f0b11264bd7f5e3d4d8195c8be91dad2584f91c58b700472c075"}

{"id": "p_b2b66ec9938b0679", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 242, "text": "丁謐畫策，使爽白天子，發詔轉宣王爲太傅，外以名號尊之，內欲令尚書奏事，先來由己，得制其輕重也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "dbd9c224d83fb5374fc9004aec0a275eb5f269287a53a0e5b75cf774af662de3"}

{"id": "p_7572b157b44169c2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 243, "text": "爽弟羲爲中領軍，訓武衞將軍，彥散騎常侍侍講，其餘諸弟皆以列侯侍從，出入禁闥，貴寵莫盛焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "08067b4451ee0d6fe873249303ad236ffaa69b4e4f3251ef22abb7ecc77c9f4c"}

{"id": "p_2fb11994350237f0", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 244, "text": "南陽何晏、鄧颺、李勝、沛國丁謐、東平畢軌咸有聲名，進趣於時，明帝以其浮華，皆抑黜之；及爽秉政，乃復進叙，任爲腹心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "c2ec88f14a829c6d5b7ffc97084946690aebcb062c932758c7d1a378ca5b1cf4"}

{"id": "p_6dde3a2e7a6973be", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 245, "text": "颺等欲令爽立威名於天下，勸使伐蜀，爽從其言，宣王止之不能禁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "393782f705910a724678cb56341bcc22a556f90ec187f62fc3f97fdfe4602e03"}

{"id": "p_7a42d67aa477a0d1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 246, "text": "，爽乃西至長安，大發卒六七萬人，從駱穀入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "31ffdf557e115be22a590c8a6d2da62b5706aff51a07f1133e9f985af3642005"}

{"id": "p_52c29f3b0705ef72", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 247, "text": "是時，關中及氐、羌轉輸不能供，牛馬騾驢多死，民夷號泣道路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "ece0779314f661c47b8e6a630e0eb9c7a0c2b06286b58fbd68d31426b43f931e"}

{"id": "p_35c48d8b6431fe39", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 248, "text": "入穀行數百里，賊因山爲固，兵不得進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "c8ad5478bd9f28e0cddf420d9aceb31467d106e9a6aac04a42b52dd9fcbce7a6"}

{"id": "p_341f824c56a8146b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 249, "text": "爽參軍楊偉爲爽陳形勢，宜急還，不然將敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "9cfdb6a3a790d450c82efe960207a7304e4d150d29ee4631815c9a4d15c0f2c4"}

{"id": "p_f7ebbbda2113c7d4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 250, "text": "颺與偉爭於爽前，偉曰：「颺、勝將敗國家事，可斬也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "c82508d88eefd020e4d27a0e04c06533f6cc640f510a1612378219c00245366d"}

{"id": "p_b5d14854b058241a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 251, "text": "初，爽以宣王年德並高，恒父事之，不敢專行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "bab1bd6ca988e3e1f6e1fb73d8299c21b27e91c17750e275f092505c2824b408"}

{"id": "p_0da29402e3292e50", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 252, "text": "及晏等進用，咸共推戴，說爽以權重不宜委之於人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "f0ad0b658275323c5ba310e66312ec2fe082579ce6f12274381cbb072e6786e7"}

{"id": "p_0555dd23092920b2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 253, "text": "乃以晏、颺、謐爲尚書，晏典選舉，軌司隷校尉，勝河南尹，諸事希復由宣王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "4f4a66d0bfe59d93266c5ff4bca25692b38c2effcd15734916cd2a5f01e59900"}

{"id": "p_c80f996df5024a6d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 254, "text": "晏等專政，共分割洛陽、野王典農部桑田數百頃，及壞湯沐地以爲產業，承勢竊取官物，因緣求欲州郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "19a48aff27d55d37fd291ef6c1c9371d59fd8aaaa24cc55aa3b8d3ba4c210f94"}

{"id": "p_2a7b56de8256b827", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 255, "text": "晏等與廷尉盧毓素有不平，因毓吏微過，深文致毓法，使主者先收毓印綬，然後奏聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "416320f40d4f5d660a5f6c792ccdc6b2c35c10d5bad6fd790e6eeb08981a5608"}

{"id": "p_ff0e08c6420ef223", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 256, "text": "爽飲食車服擬於乘輿，尚方珍玩充牣其家，妻妾盈後庭，又私取先帝才人七八人，及將吏、師工、鼓吹、良家子女三十三人，皆以爲伎樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "6d5a4e9197ae39b8aab45e456221e0fa6843c3bf504588ff08e4bedec815518c"}

{"id": "p_08bd71fe9d043249", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 257, "text": "詐作詔書，發才人五十七人送鄴臺，使先帝倢伃教習爲伎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "a07f7603f617f5f8b18f137455d9853d6e800b2c7e741e60165557277220ee12"}

{"id": "p_6793ad1e73b307b1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 258, "text": "擅取太樂樂器、武庫禁兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "6ca84ff4d4b2693dafd4a547622edbed4d36a17b8430c7f09473d7cf6e3a7527"}

{"id": "p_e9bfba8f080cf442", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 259, "text": "作窟室，綺疏四周，數與晏等會其中，飲酒作樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "d94515d25c9f04fa5f5e627eb2938685a718e5400d5835b4650167b94953c7c6"}

{"id": "p_431ff4c9f231dd76", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 260, "text": "羲深以爲大憂，數諫止之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "8fe6240dd6b43cef9d5b4c84f6e6a37619becf06e5658fde34d4210a2043f3e1"}

{"id": "p_ab7ba8185e4c8d1b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 261, "text": "又著書三篇，陳驕淫盈溢之致禍敗，辭旨甚切，不敢斥爽，託戒諸弟以示爽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "e18459539c64d83b2070c9ccf31d04a215a91133585e88fd94da68bd721763ff"}

{"id": "p_8c950477d7320c89", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 262, "text": "爽知其爲己發也，甚不恱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "61b86f6b023f0ff123f65eca67c30f207af4787ed2ddef9e33316ef93f8eb6d6"}

{"id": "p_5b4e2ed35aea0061", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 263, "text": "羲或時以諫喻不納，涕泣而起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "0558e2eb4ec9acf0d7d6976538d0abdcaebf4567d5c1faa8e11eb3abb999460e"}

{"id": "p_d2396cb70e7a9e5f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 264, "text": "九年冬，李勝出爲荊州刺史，往詣宣王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "91559da6e41b99f47c09fb4fd7b51b5929bab26e6f8f2f009eadfc4cc7f0a6fa"}

{"id": "p_1062fed125c50776", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 265, "text": "宣王稱疾困篤，示以羸形。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "84f387ee4dbb4aa9c48d04d2f08a4250b0acd63810a568306fecb61f47b25599"}

{"id": "p_921c6fc5efa01bfd", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 266, "text": "十年正月，車駕朝高平陵，爽兄弟皆從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "cba913315cd01053399237e391930d3baabd1b910484bdce62567f799c082b8f"}

{"id": "p_74e02363ac487b0d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 267, "text": "宣王部勒兵馬，先據武庫，遂出屯洛水浮橋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "4b3bcbc0b09581149937a70f7aeb3f411d12cf1b0d42e1def1fb9cc0d5ccc8bc"}

{"id": "p_f1433420bfcee33a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 268, "text": "奏爽曰：「臣昔從遼東還，先帝詔陛下、秦王及臣升御牀，把臣臂，深以後事爲念。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "f375fb3ccfa9f744a2f996b7503f3810a0d681a69a342b92e716f1792dc8582b"}

{"id": "p_872f65a4f04cd8c7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 269, "text": "臣言『二祖亦屬臣以後事爲念，此自陛下所見，無所憂苦；萬一有不如意，臣當以死奉明詔』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "1c63492ff3f6a7d0be27d35ae8d2b4461cce8217718c8165444d05280df09b78"}

{"id": "p_18e387ece0f0be73", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 270, "text": "黃門令董箕等，才人侍疾者，皆所聞知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "9c980a12bd23ce2f1cc945ee86a4e77024b311901525f889e9d8876b7e953f6f"}

{"id": "p_99296e61079271dd", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 271, "text": "今大將軍爽背棄顧命，敗亂國典，內則僭擬，外專威權；破壞諸營，盡據禁兵，羣官要職，皆置所親；殿中宿衞，歷世舊人皆復斥出，欲置新人以樹私計；根據槃牙，縱恣日甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "b798f820c8c64a9c8ce33767b5c9dd1277f40d8b748da51a9e9c219bdae48c5e"}

{"id": "p_507f3cccc345e53f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 272, "text": "外旣如此，又以黃門張當爲都監，專共交關，看察至尊，候伺神器，離間二宮，傷害骨肉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "be9d6e7564a80d4ca115bb6b5d7bf379e850c83ceac9a39f1f49c001ad4f5e7d"}

{"id": "p_4291b95be5266fd6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 273, "text": "天下汹汹，人懷危懼，陛下但爲寄坐，豈得久安！", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "a5effe3035fb2ffc3f0ff6521f09f21a9154bd03cdfaae8426d88a58e788fe2e"}

{"id": "p_4c305828409fe0f4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 274, "text": "此非先帝詔陛下及臣升御牀之本意也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "4a9273a61396fa5024cac21541e45fe74bc686b49dfa8fe4ebf4f8db6e773b5b"}

{"id": "p_d4cab2a009cb2df2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 275, "text": "昔趙高極意，秦氏以滅；呂、霍早斷，漢祚永世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "23bf6fc57b2962a55331448f377b95c5c02354db6a5eff6afdca89f25ce28c6d"}

{"id": "p_25ae09db13cf9efc", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 276, "text": "此乃陛下之大鑒，臣受命之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "e594f26e8344c0925d6830b4d570f655b093d91e91cfcbee6aecd2171335a72f"}

{"id": "p_085a92074c0ec22a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 277, "text": "太尉臣濟、尚書令臣孚等，皆以爽爲有無君之心，兄弟不宜典兵宿衞，奏永寧宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "7e4d294dc0c70d7a2bc45165e497d71394e2a4bec03981a42d4d8bf58dc3d5d7"}

{"id": "p_52e798fdf8dcc1e6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 278, "text": "臣輒勑主者及黃門令罷爽、羲、訓吏兵，以侯就第，不得逗留以稽車駕；敢有稽留，便以軍法從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "785096baf2bf39e7fa91750531a88b04543f1454bed751711552306718d70ec4"}

{"id": "p_084d0a523b66ec9b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 279, "text": "臣輙力疾，將兵屯洛水浮橋，伺察非常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "e22852cb1f5bc8d862b292403221d907563fe366e4cdb22e0c26da7525e5ee20"}

{"id": "p_528d972651c4dd48", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 280, "text": "爽得宣王奏事，不通，迫窘不知所爲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "e43c89911f00504f4407be3a1d638868e516b7563d8eb5df9f9b945f4521bef4"}

{"id": "p_156a00c02af3c102", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 281, "text": "大司農沛國桓範聞兵起，不應太後召，矯詔開平昌門，拔取劒戟，略將門候，南奔爽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "ef8dd35fa7ca9258e0cf3a0446bd05ed3337425de9439ea80ddfce80266a488d"}

{"id": "p_4ab49713f4a829c6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 282, "text": "宣王知，曰：「範畫策，爽必不能用範計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "51b8e99be65b54996cd9977d53136a58f27d6f9a42f30b8b0500f47cd7e578a3"}

{"id": "p_5390be580b0a2ad5", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 283, "text": "」範說爽使車駕幸許昌，招外兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "dddf95eee5c379c13ffda1b226271867a1dabbc9d289fa17a01b8e105d666a84"}

{"id": "p_38035f39bb8da360", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 284, "text": "爽兄弟猶豫未決，範重謂羲曰：「當今日，卿門戶求貧賤復可得乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "8cef2a2267a7500c37e300f39ef6728e49188dce95b4376be03bc0c5ca00f0e8"}

{"id": "p_6b997f7bc1917892", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 285, "text": "且匹夫持質一人，尚欲望活，今卿與天子相隨，令於天下，誰敢不應者？", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "9d7b960fe01f8afb9ac2370a3a815b4daa90618d5b3330e5fd6f06ec7b24ef1d"}

{"id": "p_f6545c8db5aec24c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 286, "text": "侍中許允、尚書陳泰說爽，使早自歸罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "9eb294e5f7fc6fa998f6e0581c072d3a25f7a11a28fd0e2ad3dbf62c6c4ec79f"}

{"id": "p_459c3dcc73c3fa55", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 287, "text": "爽於是遣允、泰詣宣王，歸罪請死，乃通宣王奏事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "439ed8a021e0eea1cd325024b30513154d15ce99ae9752ed9e29e03ecbbd0993"}

{"id": "p_9d79b52421bff0c1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 288, "text": "初，張當私以所擇才人張、何等與爽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "7f4c38dc6b3221f4ba553f4e97ea1cf9f0d96da1d36efde95faa8b3b7637ff5c"}

{"id": "p_128c31c16233028a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 289, "text": "當陳爽與晏等陰謀反逆，並先習兵，須三月中欲發，於是收晏等下獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "00f4b3d239fbac3a40d1dc6842eac8ef56d5cdb22a4c242470b94354ff6cd807"}

{"id": "p_1a36d2032da7faa4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 290, "text": "會公卿朝臣廷議，以爲「春秋之義，『君親無將，將而必誅』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "9580e5bf35d80a3f068d5401d44d93222cb35ce45c860a271fa00c7f02eb766d"}

{"id": "p_1ae9950cd8ad2765", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 291, "text": "爽以支屬，世蒙殊寵，親受先帝握手遺詔，託以天下，而包藏禍心，蔑棄顧命，乃與晏、颺及當等謀圖神器，範黨同罪人，皆爲大逆不道」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "df5414fd96bbba73b2f2982381a44c3dfa75d996829141ebd8aa615e5d613121"}

{"id": "p_91365d64e8723c72", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 292, "text": "於是收爽、羲、訓、晏、颺、謐、軌、勝、範、當等，皆伏誅，夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "38ca93d0dd0f799b4972448ba8db5144db2bc2e8b292b3c3308b870bc44748f0"}

{"id": "p_d40b716affaf85ee", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 293, "text": "嘉平中，紹功臣世，封真族孫熙爲新昌亭侯，邑三百戶，以奉真後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "fbe0bdeb76f4b6cc2367fde02c2ea915a3e3ae77f87f6b3974b177216d1fb781"}

{"id": "p_0c8490e712bfdfaf", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 294, "text": "晏長於宮省，又尚公主，少以才秀知名，好老莊言，作《道德論》及諸文賦著述凡數十篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "486a302540cee24afea2a5491e98e80f0d05612ea2e0a057d6c09b1874909347"}

{"id": "p_039cac193a9e299e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 295, "text": "夏侯尚字伯仁，淵從子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "e5d43b140bad54b832c5df83346e1ff17e6b75a38bff8a5b3ae99d988cd53941"}

{"id": "p_502c7c7e16409cb7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 296, "text": "太祖定冀州，尚爲軍司馬，將騎從征伐，後爲五官將文學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "07810fd45002da72c8d469d36ea0be2ed0100c2f755c325ddc891cd382ef15a4"}

{"id": "p_39ed33968b1fc3e3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 297, "text": "代郡胡叛，遣鄢陵侯彰征討之，以尚參彰軍事，定代地，還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "991cf542faa5954a5ece52065feb98c3f573195732f1e6f9e6dc142640510854"}

{"id": "p_5ca616108b48b492", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 298, "text": "太祖崩於洛陽，尚持節，奉梓宮還鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "66c2b50362edafe3de2b538a219323d2ab804e96f128db19a16d19481bcc748e"}

{"id": "p_fbcc6fff2fcec213", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 299, "text": "并錄前功，封平陵亭侯，拜散騎常侍，遷中領軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "cfb9fecb208f94e2199c02ae1ee7cf7c894dc3a6462d9ddd7dbd03bb75768197"}

{"id": "p_eb77105f7638857a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 300, "text": "文帝踐阼，更封平陵鄉侯，遷征南將軍，領荊州刺史，假節都督南方諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "5bd4cf13fe67d7445c16006f290ca79f6473d1b0957200bbf74ce547d633f09d"}

{"id": "p_36f646bae11dd17c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 301, "text": "尚奏：「劉備別軍在上庸，山道險難，彼不我虞，若以奇兵潛行，出其不意，則獨克之勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "87ba115c62d4e17e2cf51c4825150dbbfac15db82ff29a8ee6b3038e3c8cafec"}

{"id": "p_283b98170762c66f", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 302, "text": "」遂勒諸軍擊破上庸，平三郡九縣，遷征南大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "b565d80e71f39c7820c172d7a9cff47bc92525f34dd4b6d57b41f7354bf347b3"}

{"id": "p_109e5074b9a68962", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 303, "text": "孫權雖稱藩，尚益脩攻討之備，權後果有貳心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 303}, "text_hash": "c77d9dcd879fe51000461b1e1f745b5aa59462d23b2861855abe199716d7ccc5"}

{"id": "p_eea0679900251ee7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 304, "text": "，車駕幸宛，使尚率諸軍與曹真共圍江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 304}, "text_hash": "4abd0b1be29038c4634a85c928c50d8f3c1b05519268a4f1211e6b8bba45bc8f"}

{"id": "p_f124687e9e1aa2f5", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 305, "text": "權將諸葛瑾與尚軍對江，瑾渡入江中渚，而分水軍於江中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 305}, "text_hash": "5ffc2b782366673da3944b289ab2d7656a7b06ae4853c506043daa60a3af57e4"}

{"id": "p_beea2c941184c957", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 306, "text": "尚夜多持油舩，將步騎萬餘人，於下流潛渡，攻瑾諸軍，夾江燒其舟舩，水陸並攻，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 306}, "text_hash": "88ee8d4f50342b134c14b35112d7bc3757865cd24b973f6ceb43e96c0a77e143"}

{"id": "p_e9f42dd90930f154", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 307, "text": "城未拔，會大疫，詔勑尚引諸軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 307}, "text_hash": "191230cd1dcbaaea884e6d1e2f5f8facad89e4f5bbfae9f561ca6f95c07822b7"}

{"id": "p_2fdf5d361f2cc88b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 308, "text": "益封六百戶，并前千九百戶，假鉞，進爲牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 308}, "text_hash": "81aadd53b7a65e0985a0775333163e30d2a577b30b08e4a07f5024fe417256c3"}

{"id": "p_c4a66913760a4c5c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 309, "text": "荊州殘荒，外接蠻夷，而與吳阻漢水爲境，舊民多居江南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 309}, "text_hash": "7c066e47593b3df559b12c4825c07ba9ef8ab84c17f366d8051f722553547065"}

{"id": "p_09cdfb96d0289745", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 310, "text": "尚自上庸通道，西行七百餘里，山民蠻夷多服從者，五六年間，降附數千家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 310}, "text_hash": "c906e56b120d7f4b5ebf1ad4992270c6a8c75ba0fd124ebcd139bb5539edaf70"}

{"id": "p_05d46ab015399665", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 311, "text": "尚有愛妾嬖幸，寵奪適室；適室，曹氏女也，故文帝遣人絞殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 311}, "text_hash": "418cf422c0cc7aa21ca48844c2306e0ac440ad4679268591f73f8d704ffe8e55"}

{"id": "p_60a7c7c6024dd958", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 312, "text": "尚悲感，發病怳惚，旣葬埋妾，不勝思見，復出視之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 312}, "text_hash": "7b4ffe43b49f61970718101a5c9ce34bc05d7f9bb2f1b8ea9bfff3527617e60b"}

{"id": "p_f05e7feb6e856321", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 313, "text": "文帝聞而恚之曰：「杜襲之輕薄尚，良有以也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 313}, "text_hash": "ae1b4c9f0e2087b828f5ea391de7a26bbe4540e3a7ee8e931a3271bd9ec7bb57"}

{"id": "p_4d3eedc3bef3cee8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 314, "text": "六年，尚疾篤，還京都，帝數臨幸，執手涕泣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 314}, "text_hash": "e969502d2afbe2f7ebed704ead963de4031c6bf4b090cfedf46cd1389d299b7d"}

{"id": "p_447f670d9207a7ac", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 315, "text": "又分尚戶三百，賜尚弟子奉爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 315}, "text_hash": "095afb870520082d9c5c26d8218db14ae65c7f7089f0657c30215d60b0eb5c45"}

{"id": "p_ad376483f6a3e98e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 316, "text": "少知名，弱冠爲散騎黃門侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 316}, "text_hash": "d814a08a39127c3b3bb091d719b4cf9da3670408a0dfb46c546ce621194ca0b3"}

{"id": "p_ccb34c22c735ce4a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 317, "text": "嘗進見，與皇后弟毛曾並坐，玄恥之，不恱形之於色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 317}, "text_hash": "dfb46ee4ea5c067105c5e87b2806a87fbe5dabfe7cf0c741fb3218e9dff040cb"}

{"id": "p_d382f9fda0b860f2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 318, "text": "明帝恨之，左遷爲羽林監。", "locator": {"ordinal": 318}, "text_hash": "c6b9e55787684e329aefe2c035caf324b9cda28850ed22f9260d96fab05a2e15"}

{"id": "p_a113a6e8c42f3485", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 319, "text": "太傅司馬宣王問以時事，玄議以爲：「夫官才用人，國之柄也，故銓衡專於臺閣，上之分也，孝行存乎閭巷，優劣任之鄉人，下之叙也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 319}, "text_hash": "da1b21c68e0c7b2bcb783dd04e249f27178c0d8fbc76f449a2fc1d9feb52cd3a"}

{"id": "p_08ee76468a3fd7bf", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 320, "text": "夫欲清教審選，在明其分叙，不使相涉而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 320}, "text_hash": "81bbf5dda320cc984ab59db255a0283884a9b83b97598758d049e5ca7544f2f3"}

{"id": "p_a87e30a1d59e21e7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 321, "text": "上過其分，則恐所由之不本，而干勢馳騖之路開；下踰其叙，則恐天爵之外通，而機權之門多矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 321}, "text_hash": "fdd012fec1ef68c866520bc8b54295e67efdec0c9ae04936d26ecfd422205489"}

{"id": "p_58e3dc38c9882cfa", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 322, "text": "夫天爵下通，是庶人議柄也；機權多門，是紛亂之原也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 322}, "text_hash": "36c4322a87d81a24bde8261aaf6059108e47a2673dc1d544e97893e41bac37e0"}

{"id": "p_d1143f1970f2c72b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 323, "text": "自州郡中正品度官才之來，有年載矣，緬緬紛紛，未聞整齊，豈非分叙參錯各失其要之所由哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 323}, "text_hash": "7057ac126b1baf3681709c0a0ededa126c639d1dca2f53cd786c17b905a6f42d"}

{"id": "p_acae10d21d786eaf", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 324, "text": "若令中正但考行倫輩，倫輩當行均，斯可官矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 324}, "text_hash": "5db16acf3a9b43354437a5a050604f2fce6e2202e0ade9500f99b7384e403bc9"}

{"id": "p_e83ba014df579cc6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 325, "text": "夫孝行著於家門，豈不忠恪於在官乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 325}, "text_hash": "b80eb5d6e7f22944dfbadc67cf8805a7f11957155bedf549b6d3da904e748881"}

{"id": "p_4b8a8234d476b730", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 326, "text": "仁恕稱於九族，豈不達於爲政乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 326}, "text_hash": "fc3543267165d5f0368833a26ada2badaafa7f9590b9ebb1192ada75d1f90109"}

{"id": "p_205c08842a3337b2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 327, "text": "義斷行於鄉黨，豈不堪於事任乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 327}, "text_hash": "44b2b0b3f21c053650b274d3682b0446071ebf95f23b385bd5029d69b808873e"}

{"id": "p_c1863cb0a2c93aa8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 328, "text": "三者之類，取於中正，雖不處其官名，斯任官可知矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 328}, "text_hash": "fc88694bf42eaaebff3b72361b43e6cfc668ca546980a63e9e6ec6bb19365286"}

{"id": "p_cce295859c3d8f03", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 329, "text": "行有大小，比有高下，則所任之流，亦渙然明別矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 329}, "text_hash": "f638d1fac20e94e7681b2605b03fc2ca3bb555404da8b298adb4ccb6a71ed83f"}

{"id": "p_d4a645e42f50ed39", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 330, "text": "奚必使中正干銓衡之機於下，而執機柄者有所委仗於上，上下交侵，以生紛錯哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 330}, "text_hash": "74679a22e587bb8096992502eed83e7c03aee0bba52e6f5547aafc3b6c53ff5a"}

{"id": "p_89247d29e5e6bc54", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 331, "text": "且臺閣臨下，考功校否，衆職之屬，各有官長，旦夕相考，莫究於此；閭閻之議，以意裁處，而使匠宰失位，衆人驅駭，欲風俗清靜，其可得乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 331}, "text_hash": "3df58623fc8f6f0f6a8e6ee32adea1c2c1766173ecb47915d9dccaa1a681d715"}

{"id": "p_84fa1429c530deb3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 332, "text": "所得至者，更在側近，孰不脩飾以要所求？", "locator": {"ordinal": 332}, "text_hash": "d36f8a37471e2b8363aa24ba9e1213208190740035f0f3b0f8187661de584f58"}

{"id": "p_0c0b133234c2fc3e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 333, "text": "所求有路，則脩己家門者，已不如自達於鄉黨矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 333}, "text_hash": "a02af43f0c65ed67fa1404eab84eaa63cb06d56d7c62a9f5fa00576e5d2fd5a3"}

{"id": "p_357106ac3ab041fb", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 334, "text": "自達鄉黨者，已不如自求之於州邦矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 334}, "text_hash": "fd5a86f5ac54d0569f049a947c0125b0861c0fbdad9f0c175be976d60ab0f972"}

{"id": "p_00a6779499c270ff", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 335, "text": "苟開之有路，而患其飾真離本，雖復嚴責中正，督以刑罰，猶無益也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 335}, "text_hash": "d994c70371f84cb05bb082546089b47a8b203b5f7db971dd25c61d3b84fc7594"}

{"id": "p_c396e10b0c79b6d1", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 336, "text": "豈若使各帥其分，官長則各以其屬能否獻之臺閣，臺閣則據官長能否之第，參以鄉閭德行之次，擬其倫比，勿使偏頗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 336}, "text_hash": "214874c68b598f1c1d96532af92435e63cc0b9cd0c1da92a83997d15fcc4fb8b"}

{"id": "p_c3ed216d16d65814", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 337, "text": "中正則唯考其行迹，別其高下，審定輩類，勿使升降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 337}, "text_hash": "5f969eee2297a617e8f7376417f145664785d64698e4cb6543110d619461ddf5"}

{"id": "p_ef9eb5eb1c90717c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 338, "text": "臺閣總之，如其所簡，或有參錯，則其責負自在有司。", "locator": {"ordinal": 338}, "text_hash": "887d3c032eae22d65280d52a5e0b9edc44439f7c2259c7bd4dcb8d560acb6d25"}

{"id": "p_eb9de55565feefb3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 339, "text": "官長所第，中正輩擬，比隨次率而用之，如其不稱，責負在外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 339}, "text_hash": "09890e4b564d5ce1f128a80db7494ab17a0374cbdd163d41a23717afd6acf38d"}

{"id": "p_e4db57555c1b1d4b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 340, "text": "然則內外相參，得失有所，互相形檢，孰能相飾？", "locator": {"ordinal": 340}, "text_hash": "c1cc7389d1bef46d4302d5de0ecc49d3b38762ef9c2a656b30746e8341ea0054"}

{"id": "p_e5173644ed79eb6d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 341, "text": "斯則人心定而事理得，庶可以靜風俗而審官才矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 341}, "text_hash": "61c0e18a3dffc845cbe795abc76df1c5c000339d18ebda2b622507755d763ad9"}

{"id": "p_d3a9451b0bbb3dc2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 342, "text": "又以爲：「古之建官，所以濟育羣生，統理民物也，故爲之君長以司牧之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 342}, "text_hash": "69776a7026427b952216e170eb78ee69b8884a8d904857735ad250b5dea9fdda"}

{"id": "p_ac86041cc0db7f67", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 343, "text": "司牧之主，欲一而專，一則官任定而上下安，專則職業脩而事不煩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 343}, "text_hash": "6d5f83e3ed25737a8320a50fba5fce47ee19a8347532c0a501b1943553a6d9ee"}

{"id": "p_1108ae382c79abfd", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 344, "text": "夫事簡業脩，上下相安而不治者，未之有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 344}, "text_hash": "254c83147d3e05fddadd42dce68c915cfb5466cc295cff3eda38a74476c818b5"}

{"id": "p_2a49472e5ca23408", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 345, "text": "先王建萬國，雖其詳未可得而究，然分彊畫界，各守土境，則非重累羈絆之體也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 345}, "text_hash": "76f111fa2379e03d17c910ad67bd280e9f929f53822ff67c0a7ff42aa329bce3"}

{"id": "p_1f0b7aa0085cefc7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 346, "text": "下考殷、周五等之叙，徒有小大貴賤之差，亦無君官臣民而有二統互相牽制者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 346}, "text_hash": "f632069cb510763154269e2adc4993eed072979f80b5d649d1614076d05fee62"}

{"id": "p_3f84522b3587b2f6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 347, "text": "夫官統不一，則職業不脩；職業不脩，則事何得而簡？", "locator": {"ordinal": 347}, "text_hash": "876fef4ec5477ad55d00cac33f0ee78c40834d1159d4a6b863e6f6550a58bfa6"}

{"id": "p_fbad6a6715e22d30", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 348, "text": "事之不簡，則民何得而靜？", "locator": {"ordinal": 348}, "text_hash": "dca53db9a8282e91633fb58221d904e549eef2790e97c6423be00a49d3c541b5"}

{"id": "p_f592690c5cf2b7be", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 349, "text": "民之不靜，則邪惡並興，而姦偽滋長矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 349}, "text_hash": "b472d95f2e218061b2788d2a49460381326b1b6ad239bc333042cde5f971d6cd"}

{"id": "p_26e43beaa2f1bcf6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 350, "text": "先王達其如此，故專其職司而一其統業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 350}, "text_hash": "238807f57581ddbb259abfeb21df7a6813538436ca326e434464d2f2eeb96d49"}

{"id": "p_e707dc3c9a9de6d6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 351, "text": "始自秦世，不師聖道，私以御職，姦以待下；懼宰官之不脩，立監牧以董之，畏督監之容曲，設司察以糾之；宰牧相累，監察相司，人懷異心，上下殊務。", "locator": {"ordinal": 351}, "text_hash": "81bdc32e60c80a2edc70e60e023dfca4cce87fc2b04b6f39a8f125a9aab916ba"}

{"id": "p_5d622c5efda24f70", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 352, "text": "魏室之隆，日不暇及，五等之典，雖難卒復，可粗立儀準以一治制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 352}, "text_hash": "6ec04917e5fa7c4bc151766e621465dfa758a890d610c36d01f37a2d6faccdf8"}

{"id": "p_a4db962496ce1640", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 353, "text": "今之長吏，皆君吏民，橫重以郡守，累以刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 353}, "text_hash": "f57456fed6134545e352d44a17de518b65001bdd45fd7ca016d223836e510a8c"}

{"id": "p_fdc7fa07d6708e65", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 354, "text": "若郡所攝，唯在大較，則與州同，無爲再重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 354}, "text_hash": "3191f8bc33709221bcf3954ab6376f499a001d2976e5da3e3fadb52c6814d4b8"}

{"id": "p_d57ec129bfc0bab4", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 355, "text": "宜省郡守，但任刺史；刺史職存，則監察不廢，郡吏萬數還親農業，以省煩費，豐財殖穀，一也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 355}, "text_hash": "cdff100f825c09b6bff1b1eb1fe9767ab8419b0b7b2375e3c4cd70cc535a66b8"}

{"id": "p_9f1568eaacd473f8", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 356, "text": "大縣之才，皆堪郡守，是非之訟，每生意異，順從則安，直己則爭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 356}, "text_hash": "f29604d2cbfc40e8981552e7649d2dd46fc249a497e071bc6ec0829e14374d5a"}

{"id": "p_4f3ce9a668a69319", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 357, "text": "夫和羹之美，在於合異，上下之益，在能相濟，順從乃安，此琴瑟一聲也，蕩而除之，則官省事簡，二也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 357}, "text_hash": "2235e8dc2642644d39b2ce3aa5e324dd9335dfc3cce00436d291848ddecf1cbd"}

{"id": "p_4c83eff62d46e6f3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 358, "text": "又幹郡之吏，職監諸縣，營護黨親，鄉邑舊故，如有不副，而因公掣頓，民之困弊，咎生於此，若皆并合，則亂原自塞，三也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 358}, "text_hash": "2d001afd9c39aefbf283e841ae2c5e816568a8f44bae4adcb82e00caef9753bc"}

{"id": "p_ea2ca26305701712", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 359, "text": "今承衰弊，民人彫落，賢才鮮少，任事者寡，郡縣良吏往往非一，郡受縣成，其劇在下，而吏之上選，郡當先足，此爲親民之吏，專得厎下，吏者民命，而常頑鄙，今如并之，吏多選清良者造職，大化宣流，民物獲寧，四也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 359}, "text_hash": "2bf5030a1d53560ddc96025aa2b6800f5db1dca3276c42ddd3a9317c10ff1f42"}

{"id": "p_a2841f723a4b34f2", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 360, "text": "制使萬戶之縣名之郡守，五千以上名之都尉，千戶以下令長如故，自長以上考課遷用，轉以能升，所牧亦增，此進才効功之叙也，若經制一定，則官才有次，治功齊明，五也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 360}, "text_hash": "47ed0c3a9048b76a4e1cd03304ff12652bb8e4d638b474dec412ac8485d720d2"}

{"id": "p_7e59e4c74d303a99", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 361, "text": "若省郡守，縣皆徑達，事不擁隔，官無留滯，三代之風雖未可必，簡一之化庶幾可致，便民省費在於此矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 361}, "text_hash": "dd1897c7b6e8be0f8bf822fe2d08184427fc7a576242800f4ed13f21bca3111d"}

{"id": "p_5d5bcd14b8d5f34e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 362, "text": "又以爲：「文質之更用，猶四時之迭興也，王者體天理物，必因弊而濟通之，時彌質則文之以禮，時泰侈則救之以質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 362}, "text_hash": "9393f6d819a256ed904e778bd35bdf0ece5a47e7014983f5dfc4383c92af99aa"}

{"id": "p_e419abd8dd8baa05", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 363, "text": "今承百王之末，秦漢餘流，世俗彌文，宜大改之以易民望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 363}, "text_hash": "d999ed7f3cf8667664791ec5aebc8874ab95cab009b450310565ade1b05baed3"}

{"id": "p_b6dab9a40688b9fb", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 364, "text": "今科制自公、列侯以下，位從大將軍以上，皆得服綾錦、羅綺、紈素、金銀飾鏤之物，自是以下，雜綵之服通於賤人，雖上下等級，各示有差，然朝臣之制已得侔至尊矣，玄黃之采已得通於下矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 364}, "text_hash": "14e72040345204bf665f3b072a8178c2d43598e164c2f64898422f67b34b9406"}

{"id": "p_a8d539356d918e71", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 365, "text": "欲使市不鬻華麗之色，商不通難得之貨，工不作雕刻之物，不可得也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 365}, "text_hash": "130c2946509a125e09074e3044cd2883a6a2b00b4bf2548adb73e3a174b80497"}

{"id": "p_2421922f08b8d54c", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 366, "text": "是故宜大理其本，準度古法，文質之宜，取其中則，以爲禮度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 366}, "text_hash": "723c650674fdb1422daeb2fcf6c23a81fc6f2f5a0df2a91f9e7fa39732201d31"}

{"id": "p_71efa5c31482f723", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 367, "text": "車輿服章，皆從質樸，禁除末俗華麗之事，使幹朝之家，有位之室，不復有錦綺之飾，無兼采之服、纖巧之物，自上以下至於樸素之差，示有等級而已，勿使過一二之覺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 367}, "text_hash": "38a282f8e9163dbc6fd7f14f5ed49805ebc777f1463bce3a894d85f0d34f1661"}

{"id": "p_f605b974ec0a0791", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 368, "text": "若夫功德之賜，上恩所特加，皆表之有司，然後服用之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 368}, "text_hash": "ae4c42b07aaa2cd8e2191c89d137a44db24d5654365b6a16367155c3041bceee"}

{"id": "p_8263aaeb2ae9c92e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 369, "text": "夫上之化下，猶風之靡草。", "locator": {"ordinal": 369}, "text_hash": "d4b3726f54b875e1b5ff49f209566f7cb27544f06f265afb72613aa4dc22ff3e"}

{"id": "p_bd48cd6802be92d9", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 370, "text": "樸素之教興於本朝，則彌侈之心自消於下矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 370}, "text_hash": "ae6d386e0394bb454d05a5925428405ae644610498d9cfccf058b3bfa7774192"}

{"id": "p_954906cbf8529d66", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 371, "text": "宣王報書曰：「審官擇人，除重官，改服制，皆大善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 371}, "text_hash": "c2d9d52ec3aface3fb4cca3f907d71d71e9420238b6eb085864736b8eee2669c"}

{"id": "p_b4c5c9f699aba09a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 372, "text": "禮鄉閭本行，朝廷考事，大指如所示。", "locator": {"ordinal": 372}, "text_hash": "fa0a924d7a7c7eb1214bf9940264341885735fccd34a9d232cf96fd28dbd8a35"}

{"id": "p_f55f87377ad61879", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 373, "text": "而中間一相承習，卒不能改。", "locator": {"ordinal": 373}, "text_hash": "20859e51d4eb5afa2716ce8c655aafe323d14c23e59a777875b22b36731369a1"}

{"id": "p_c7ec18cd6429497a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 374, "text": "秦時無刺史，但有郡守長吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 374}, "text_hash": "6b5f2cc90932e43a3cc8b0e7e386b3f70fc55e9b6fa1b0c15a646a24cab72a80"}

{"id": "p_05fbcd2e45ba5bcb", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 375, "text": "漢家雖有刺史，奉六條而已，故刺史稱傳車，其吏言從事，居無常治，吏不成臣，其後轉更爲官司耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 375}, "text_hash": "53c9293d3e344eefa35eefae1648d830bc941f20aa01daeacfb0e75a2f0ae9ed"}

{"id": "p_500fc7d0edccba45", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 376, "text": "昔賈誼亦患服制，漢文雖身服弋綈，猶不能使上下如意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 376}, "text_hash": "5143d257f6905e46cd378b038a5b999a9ce592d526d01934a035fa34ccf9ffeb"}

{"id": "p_6319e81851fa5b5e", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 377, "text": "恐此三事，當待賢能然後了耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 377}, "text_hash": "a0713543fbd9de3cc020228d43844a597613375b0f6cccaf8e556ee055cb8f85"}

{"id": "p_8c46e9b8d04a52f0", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 378, "text": "玄又書曰：「漢文雖身衣弋綈，而不革正法度，內外有僭擬之服，寵臣受無限之賜，由是觀之，似指立在身之名，非篤齊治制之意也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 378}, "text_hash": "444a096f982b66d925fbbc25707dd051bd1b38383617070193db0bdcdf8443a2"}

{"id": "p_8a051e1314594786", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 379, "text": "今公侯命世作宰，追蹤上古，將隆至治，抑末正本，若制定於上，則化行於衆矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 379}, "text_hash": "1b731a15737031175e389168c4966c139cd16ea7aea40a8ae531409062ebd97f"}

{"id": "p_f7a57549ede6a539", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 380, "text": "夫當宜改之時，留殷勤之心，令發之日，下之應也猶響尋聲耳，猶垂謙謙，曰『待賢能』，此伊周不正殷姬之典也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 380}, "text_hash": "9b958a5c8555935939558154333afdb3db131f1cb1fb14dc232226bf562a7433"}

{"id": "p_836ab3ffb64344a3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 381, "text": "頃之，爲征西將軍，假節都督雍、涼州諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 381}, "text_hash": "fcd4f06bc07339dfb9658f65e32010617ae55091aef8c9b0030329ac57b9a6d5"}

{"id": "p_e975ea0b1c98495b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 382, "text": "與曹爽共興駱穀之役，時人譏之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 382}, "text_hash": "a934979504a7aa79decdf6e4151da2a71f02aebed0cb1d436de563bbf2bb9874"}

{"id": "p_2099cbbfc0409f85", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 383, "text": "爽誅，徵玄爲大鴻臚，數年徙太常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 383}, "text_hash": "b15ca69868805de7c1053bfbd13b9453b755082be7528a337b5cc526bd31e0f8"}

{"id": "p_dc8d8f32d4361c4d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 384, "text": "中書令李豐雖宿爲大將軍司馬景王所親待，然私心在玄，遂結皇後父光祿大夫張緝，謀欲以玄輔政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 384}, "text_hash": "a27e560c0e52de0a11b6d0ea7439e5bf496cedae4064478b8b7e990c3b6db4ca"}

{"id": "p_817553057fbbdf96", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 385, "text": "豐旣內握權柄，子尚公主，又與緝俱馮翊人，故緝信之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 385}, "text_hash": "70d0c9aaf36772b11b206a62569300a397904de201889d34cdaae62697f17e65"}

{"id": "p_07a7aac167715bc6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 386, "text": "豐陰令弟兖州刺史翼求入朝，欲使將兵入，并力起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 386}, "text_hash": "23e71af8eb14c632bbfea169249b019b99aecc0bc2ba752a05a6c43e46089bfb"}

{"id": "p_c215449f72198be3", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 387, "text": "二月，當拜貴人，豐等欲因御臨軒，諸門有陛兵，誅大將軍，以玄代之，以緝爲驃騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 387}, "text_hash": "f56ffd5c2fcd10ef552fe1e0717ca3f1e250b715edb494c30cd2349c83a85ea5"}

{"id": "p_a0a16741dde12838", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 388, "text": "豐密語黃門監蘇鑠、永寧署令樂敦、宂從僕射劉賢等曰：「卿諸人居內多有不法，大將軍嚴毅，累以爲言，張當可以爲誡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 388}, "text_hash": "94c0612b4e16560bd7ddd8b5de8d0ba6d4145057e947e211962a6a1567a58b10"}

{"id": "p_064adbd2703ec6ac", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 389, "text": "大將軍微聞其謀，請豐相見，豐不知而往，即殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 389}, "text_hash": "b1203ab92e92d6154f7121d8796d8dd8453f35f0cf228dcf9664d5bc22f1d857"}

{"id": "p_495b217dfa482128", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 391, "text": "廷尉鍾毓奏：「豐等謀迫脅至尊，擅誅冢宰，大逆無道，請論如法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 391}, "text_hash": "d5073aede74fc8bb858c4ee45aec08c71dc5f77f3477f28ca88bd28cd26e9f11"}

{"id": "p_5db392eda013abb9", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 392, "text": "」於是會公卿朝臣廷尉議，咸以爲「豐等各受殊寵，典綜機密，緝承外戚椒房之尊，玄備世臣，並居列位，而苞藏禍心，構圖凶逆，交關閹豎，授以姦計，畏憚天威，不敢顯謀，乃欲要君脅上，肆其詐虐，謀誅良輔，擅相建立，將以傾覆京室，顛危社稷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 392}, "text_hash": "ddbdf5fdf1f6d4317dfb36a5c58d8d3c9ba031b7c73cb61c09564ea97203a1da"}

{"id": "p_522e4ce45c7b0981", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 393, "text": "毓所正皆如科律，報毓施行」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 393}, "text_hash": "c509a8e988a16cbab3affdb6e7f987ad5b0fe15f173f83ba507d085fe2f25733"}

{"id": "p_e0b8ed07bca5b5f5", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 394, "text": "詔書：「齊長公主，先帝遺愛，匄其三子死命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 394}, "text_hash": "cd1e0913b14821efafb8c9d98b0daf32c7d3798ace9bf66b25ce59d396aa178d"}

{"id": "p_e78d6b9c3f754da7", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 395, "text": "」於是豐、玄、緝、敦、賢等皆夷三族，其餘親屬徙樂浪郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 395}, "text_hash": "d0327221b17e6f06d7c6f61ad026c3f94137ab13fd0459b68d0c93d00a45173d"}

{"id": "p_db2f401cbfa19063", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 396, "text": "玄格量弘濟，臨斬東巿，顏色不變，舉動自若，時年四十六。", "locator": {"ordinal": 396}, "text_hash": "b1eec94fd2324f8047f66ba8aa83db1cf3e3c156e8f17c0040cc9b39527e761b"}

{"id": "p_3d59a72cd960237d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 397, "text": "正元中，紹功臣世，封尚從孫本爲昌陵亭侯，邑三百戶，以奉尚後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 397}, "text_hash": "1795c9c27e51e20fb9577a32f34bde6d13f542a996d88118a72bf9d6efe809aa"}

{"id": "p_5e8d0de3f4ca6dd6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 398, "text": "初，中領軍高陽許允與豐、玄親善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 398}, "text_hash": "d7dbd22874c82789f4ceafca112da575ff01152d0520b6a5c4801ac1574995a7"}

{"id": "p_ed0fe48be5ccfc1d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 399, "text": "先是有詐作尺一詔書，以玄爲大將軍，允爲太尉，共錄尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 399}, "text_hash": "9b545680bfe1c545554061f3af890b107e490057e7eb23d92fd557d080831ad0"}

{"id": "p_ea3bd225ff9327e6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 400, "text": "有何人天未明乘馬以詔版付允門吏，曰「有詔」，因便馳走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 400}, "text_hash": "06ba1a1559780bb6b149c1e64067c999fc3def7de20b6df7f5d44c44cff8c6d7"}

{"id": "p_06baf8d74485edad", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 401, "text": "允即投書燒之，不以開呈司馬景王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 401}, "text_hash": "246ad75507267f50be6810790965a3d383138a2625a1fc94305939626ca463c7"}

{"id": "p_4051e026c5af880d", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 402, "text": "後豐等事覺，徙允爲鎮北將軍，假節督河北諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 402}, "text_hash": "257728871842b451581828bad91f7384384b7084fe42b31d88795a82ca0067e5"}

{"id": "p_cc95ffa6a62ff00a", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 403, "text": "未發，以放散官物，收付廷尉，徙樂浪，道死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 403}, "text_hash": "9943ac1a99f199acd25f167a306d00c0bfdc6ad25de4576ca81370b69e7a59b1"}

{"id": "p_a0fe8991635a1f71", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 404, "text": "清河王經亦與允俱稱冀州名士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 404}, "text_hash": "699fc0f0ad68b259f56e51a340767a303073f7dd5586483965441bdf05e808dc"}

{"id": "p_132656d15f1535cd", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 405, "text": "甘露中爲尚書，坐高貴鄉公事誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 405}, "text_hash": "7b090ce01a7021c41e99876cd170ab53e299ab78148d0d8a5b06a6bf0423e7d0"}

{"id": "p_2016526fabb95572", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 406, "text": "始經爲郡守，經母謂經曰：「汝田家子，今仕至二千石，物太過不祥，可以止矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 406}, "text_hash": "90b49b1c743c8ea1be9c3af2bbbed868180fbfd9b62d312c882e94cb096b7b30"}

{"id": "p_8767cdf012cf5740", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 407, "text": "」經不能從，歷二州刺史，司隷校尉，終以致敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 407}, "text_hash": "c1f97b5bec5750478a1ec63a4066d8c33dc58371370bb5f2eae2fffab273adcd"}

{"id": "p_9ea6c56f4be97a56", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 408, "text": "允友人同郡崔贊，亦嘗以處世太盛戒允云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 408}, "text_hash": "d430b7ac79460be3de1b26d45b247dad660fe8e4675426929a3fd2c232393628"}

{"id": "p_265c3ee3b0613c2b", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 409, "text": "評曰：夏侯、曹氏，世爲婚姻，故惇、淵、仁、洪、休、尚、真等並以親舊肺腑，貴重於時，左右勳業，咸有効勞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 409}, "text_hash": "8f3235d33a0c9a195f8ce6188e5d155904b5ff1c68e79f63914d4c70ad1ff858"}

{"id": "p_75dbb34366e28072", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 410, "text": "爽德薄位尊，沈溺盈溢，此固大易所著，道家所忌也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 410}, "text_hash": "fb60c8423a87d9b29ce7e6482eb022ad144e191f740403bf2361f503b1e0c756"}

{"id": "p_07b926a7aeda4eb6", "source_id": "src_51e78653a9df5390", "ordinal": 411, "text": "玄以規格局度，世稱其名，然與曹爽中外繾綣；榮位如斯，曾未聞匡弼其非，援致良才。", "locator": {"ordinal": 411}, "text_hash": "801e9d63fed96c1989db516aa61ac4ec9d66d40e231d3c48a0498b1db8c657fa"}

{"id": "p_c982e7a6a845672b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_c35a70e8b3dba850", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 1, "text": "荀彧字文若，潁川潁陰人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "24f289853cdfc3f8ea72958a90ee2bf5e6ccc830a6cc0a8016a125b277f7a24c"}

{"id": "p_858b1a0637dbac04", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 2, "text": "祖父淑，字季和，朗陵令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "b0c3d07cd8db73cd7b4735915fca789a6cd7f19d6899ac640718a347062cf8e1"}

{"id": "p_ae9c72fe864aa9cc", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 3, "text": "當漢順、桓之間，知名當世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "b98cd1d20c3dc34228bb454b4f96cc1a694c26603e5d051ef05755c22da04e89"}

{"id": "p_b1751f9d64eeca11", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 4, "text": "彧年少時，南陽何顒異之，曰：「王佐-{才}-也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "6130d61586a7e89bd01fbde915a2f590ab68cde4ec8d171aab80cfffd08b9be2"}

{"id": "p_51b7acff217d717b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 5, "text": "除亢父令，遂棄官歸，謂父老曰：「潁川，四戰之地也，天下有變，常爲兵-{衝}-，宜亟去之，無久留。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "a3607a1cc22259e73070d708729923b56ea8845e6dbd9b78b8e413ae35fac5fd"}

{"id": "p_2d5f0f40d690a33c", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」鄕人多懷土猶豫，會冀州牧同郡韓馥遣騎迎之，莫有隨者，彧獨將宗族至冀州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "b48a1b62f51cfbba440e146c13eb2d13b00a6891308d329e05e7f83d0d133060"}

{"id": "p_cfb0684430af7d5f", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 7, "text": "而袁紹已奪馥位，待彧以上賔之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "dec5813bece56aea89131ea29280bca7c97ab1327ae852658072312cecba94ce"}

{"id": "p_78641041d2ddfb1d", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 8, "text": "彧弟諶及同郡辛評、郭圖，皆爲紹所任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "a8136454b7a4648631f96e1572fa4c9d0c6348319879c90960bca2c35e88ad69"}

{"id": "p_06b3b2ab3e3bac98", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 9, "text": "彧度紹終不能成大事，時太祖爲奮武將軍，在東郡，，彧去紹從太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "805c1e105bb527fc99f24f69d2bec59bb59dd59a389b05d36f737e9bff1575a9"}

{"id": "p_03cc0fe93e30ca9f", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 10, "text": "太祖大恱曰：「吾之子房也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "7d6970c6d6e0068064d97c408b47824391b0dbd38797cb3261021d95e595c308"}

{"id": "p_3d5f3599c6c12187", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」以爲司馬，時年二十九。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "5c6bd8f25d445b8f7fa47c823f1742de42f1daed190780ce2a06f6971e13db3c"}

{"id": "p_3373c80870f16c34", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 12, "text": "是時，董卓威陵天下，太祖以問彧，彧曰：「卓暴虐已甚，必以亂終，無能爲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "98d00ef15ca19017924284efde258ead9e31c38c93fdb8a4568c6da99d377421"}

{"id": "p_3d1954e0688eb204", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 13, "text": "」卓遣李傕等出關東，所過虜略，至潁川、陳留而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "1f6f862a024139f0b8039dc43baa72ea5f63711b24c4962c336201eb7c6b7ee5"}

{"id": "p_af17557739c24875", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 14, "text": "明年，太祖領兖州牧，-{後}-爲鎭東將軍，彧常以司馬從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "f1ce5b92c6ba7a9de522bbc93ff74b7c3d9db94e6812e64905ec6679928fe4b2"}

{"id": "p_7b4db058ebe5776d", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 15, "text": "，太祖-{征}-陶謙，任彧留事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "7f7de9ac41809ee1931ff57c8c9b4e65dd10608f9840946ca24fc43a5af2ec36"}

{"id": "p_41d5788a690e9d04", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 16, "text": "會張邈、陳宮以兖州反，潛迎呂布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "cc965879f4bdb3b28d2935da6c8a63c235ab083802098c3bb597ef6a9334ac7d"}

{"id": "p_41c982910cc14bbd", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 17, "text": "布旣至，邈乃使劉翊告彧曰：「呂將軍來助曹使君撃陶謙，宜亟供其軍食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "27f6c4f0ec9ecf2bf22cb945d1a1475524a176c4e25730ff5f63f25dd7e2f6bb"}

{"id": "p_738a8fd58b73d38f", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 18, "text": "彧知邈爲亂，即勒兵設備，馳召東郡太守夏侯惇，而兖州諸城皆應布矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "722bf4c91024e31351b3ce571ed0e6d952d94478867872b8b7983a861330b110"}

{"id": "p_0bdeb675e1e9802b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 19, "text": "時太祖悉軍攻謙，留守兵少，而督將大吏多與邈、宮通謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "42b8f10c2b4f47381d347efb7d252fc3d038c41dc0c5783a16253f480d138c52"}

{"id": "p_893b95e622e5cb57", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 20, "text": "惇至，其夜誅謀叛者數十人，衆乃定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "d3904eb665b436ab1c9bd242164eb6616903be65dc596df33a4b537b18f7488a"}

{"id": "p_2b6a7deecdf07b5a", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 21, "text": "豫州刺史郭貢帥衆數萬來至城下，或言與呂布同謀，衆甚懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "15b36c9ca5a00fa1581e772e7fd4b2217dd082d333334cffa1987aa450312a72"}

{"id": "p_dd53ab9c11ab93c5", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 22, "text": "惇等曰：「君，一州鎭也，往必危，不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "2b93ab84fb22ec8fbc67e241f42ff3cc608a8a3e7c754ef10f7a96ed50bb0f2d"}

{"id": "p_251426a659cfc093", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」彧曰：「貢與邈等，分非素結也，今來速，計必未定；及其未定説之，縱不爲用，可使中立，若先疑之，彼將怒而成計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "e8406a6f2e072f040671ec199937a739dc710f6533c2aa996772fb231901997d"}

{"id": "p_79d3158d7bc9e997", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」貢見彧無懼意，謂鄄城未易攻，遂引兵去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "83cc4f3d8f9e2aa91133d636bda0066dd1224fec14ded7284241efe8caa35dd1"}

{"id": "p_93f125955acf5e1d", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 25, "text": "又與程昱計，使説-{范}-、東阿，卒全三城，以待太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "e52799ace57820ca12c47cbfbf811955ad9e84d5802a2f9dc9cda92aa8de2b65"}

{"id": "p_45f0e398473152e4", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 26, "text": "太祖自徐州還撃布濮陽，布東走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "3ff59ef49bc36ee8689b41244d689caad04797f661992ec0a6d5b64b64b6aad4"}

{"id": "p_de3c6b372b3faa44", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 27, "text": "二年夏，太祖軍乘氏，大饑，人相食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "c53e841cb712571473385234fdf18caba58c9713b3b138d29e120b444d8bcf4c"}

{"id": "p_a985e5e4de203209", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 28, "text": "陶謙死，太祖欲遂取徐州，還乃定布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "c6996bcb5e9209b8592f925364b2e1511674de68d26d99f0fabdc6e470efb111"}

{"id": "p_e900c9fa0b9ad137", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 29, "text": "彧曰：「昔髙祖保關中，光武據河内，皆深根固本以-{制}-天下，進足以勝敵，退足以堅守，故雖有困敗而終濟大業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "e9272ec8c5af3089a64fab0be88ba2c3d1c7ce907d30a72df285db606ba27d55"}

{"id": "p_0e4fa4f726f12585", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 30, "text": "將軍本以兖州首事，平山東之難，百姓無不歸心恱服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "c0ecf78181335e478e3d304f737abc8def9cc000d0367c964a56265f9c5c4b82"}

{"id": "p_9bffb784d915cda3", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 31, "text": "且河、濟，天下之要地也，今雖殘壞，猶易以自保，是亦將軍之關中、河内也，不可以不先定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "e4ae21241ef7f0350dc90cca092ca23598a60dc8fb4b8d2c91b8ce850347ebfb"}

{"id": "p_90c05058cfd08216", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 32, "text": "今以破李封、薛蘭，若分兵東撃陳宮，宮必不敢西顧，以其閒勒兵收熟麥，約食畜-{穀}-，一舉而布可破也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "0dffdc69c78e017ebe3d3976dac74f3af14adbf4f8cb5814b2d4fddc4ac5e3e2"}

{"id": "p_35e5bbedd7dea814", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 33, "text": "破布，然-{後}-南結揚州，共討袁-{術}-，以臨淮、泗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "c0cc919b9ca8e86d1be14b69dc929202921bff5b116d5a165bba5803e5904527"}

{"id": "p_6e9dba5d2d6911d1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 34, "text": "若-{舍}-布而東，多留兵則不足用，少留兵則民皆保城，不得樵採。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "ed51d272fa3cd6728bc2e02ad0b7eb82376f4aeb8544ac876712989362a1b8a5"}

{"id": "p_779e0cb3c08cee08", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 35, "text": "布乘虚寇暴，民心益危，唯鄄城、-{范}-、衞可全，其-{餘}-非己之有，是無兖州也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "03cdd7bd4dfc281318c65f3be43b86a591986f27f61dcf5730220bdf0f5bd5ea"}

{"id": "p_1f896647fec363bf", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 36, "text": "若徐州不定，將軍當安所歸乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "b06163b7b46817debdbb91e666c8e632875307619302e305ffe8ca816a78696b"}

{"id": "p_eb4651c387ea0fea", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 37, "text": "且陶謙雖死，徐州未易亡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "d27593f260113d79e596cff25ae16c0f769d0af10604c1639e465a814bb76936"}
