{"id": "p_7c991d19140991cf", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 38, "text": "彼懲往年之敗，將懼而結親，相爲表-{裏}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "c035779679b81babfcc6b53c3e8b21e13a085ac870dead48cd0e96386baa0b74"}

{"id": "p_52c78c34bf37fa31", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 39, "text": "今東方皆以收麥，必堅壁淸野以待將軍，將軍攻之不拔，略之無獲，不出十日，則十萬之衆未戰而自困耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "dd461f1e95e8cc335c3c6c4bc3470d34ecc823f21c5abeec12a9b02fc264da47"}

{"id": "p_347b54049fe7343d", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 40, "text": "前討徐州，威罰實行，其子弟念父兄之恥，必人自爲守，無降心，就能破之，尚不可有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "b0958573285d116fe632337a492177ca4869aad0dd29f32f5a0e435de31f1136"}

{"id": "p_28483ac170a01ce4", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 41, "text": "夫事固有棄此取彼者，以大易小可也，以安易危可也，權一時之勢，不患本之不固可也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "f9b7fc3a9f04cbedc54fbf46f50589eecbe3a1fe3c76900b94cbdb782844d841"}

{"id": "p_d5977fbe62bfb800", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 42, "text": "今三者莫利，-{願}-將軍熟慮之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "6f5f4f33035123edeafd247632bd5b74bd50149834188bf698eb98ea11c9bdfe"}

{"id": "p_7195896452fe53ee", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 43, "text": "大收麥，-{復}-與布戰，分兵平諸縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "e58090f75518448204e7b4a49538851bc32e085caf7620e21b890c4e80fe06d6"}

{"id": "p_a2fb15b3454e3e43", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 44, "text": "太祖議奉迎都許，或以山東未平，韓暹、楊奉新將天子到洛陽，北連張楊，未可卒-{制}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "3fdf8857fa0d028cea233439039f9e46cff0a369ff77cff8e420ff0f9ca15133"}

{"id": "p_319d75a74529dd4b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 45, "text": "彧勸太祖曰：「昔晉文公納周襄王而諸侯景從，髙祖東伐爲義帝縞素而天下歸心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "2781f1ebce88b07ea8b35761caafd7cb2fe87efb1511c8cc3dd00a5880cbcc27"}

{"id": "p_be9b3298e1fd0b2b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 46, "text": "自天子播越，將軍首唱義兵，徒以山東擾亂，未能遠赴關右，然猶分遣將帥，蒙險通使，雖-{禦}-難-{于}-外，乃心無不在王室，是將軍匡天下之素-{志}-也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "bed44b3d71d50d850c3c5f07fdf7e9362a13ce4506407a33985209814a0327f6"}

{"id": "p_6eff4b92a5ca5d10", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 47, "text": "今車駕旋軫，東京榛蕪，義士有存本之思，百姓感舊而增哀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "8016d7e45eef884c107afc82b7b80710d58de9733bd432a71d028ac50e5e8e47"}

{"id": "p_53759df5b281b6c7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 48, "text": "誠因此時，奉主上以從民望，大順也；秉至公以服雄傑，大略也；扶弘義以致英俊，大德也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "4e13e230c48404767195da5523c07606e9c5996df1684c542b0f7c866c8fd472"}

{"id": "p_22dcf639341bebf0", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 49, "text": "天下雖有逆節，必不能爲累，明矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "2e3e9e9a3775ca49748736ac11013cde8837a5ef9baa768a883627c01aa09c40"}

{"id": "p_c305dcd4b8582dad", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 50, "text": "若不時定，四方生心，-{後}-雖慮之，無及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "7726257dcff984bd7911cb8dc2c6b9c0fa3ecebb48af7c35880c6f2f107af19e"}

{"id": "p_7dcbf0de25abbb84", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」太祖遂至洛陽，奉迎天子都許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "be3244bb7a3003be9dd55f3aa2dc8032977caff537ca53e5fe8e68277458558f"}

{"id": "p_9f54fcedf9428a1d", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 52, "text": "天子拜太祖大將軍，進彧爲漢侍中，守尚書令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "5965ed56ea95ea86c152beab5f52138ef4d1ed55cd218ced53745b43d74f85e5"}

{"id": "p_5eff220c2f561a34", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 53, "text": "常居中持重，太祖雖-{征}-伐在外，軍國事皆與彧籌焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "bd45693024d39773c0c7a905d79d69ce0708b24731ee16b2c3cb1010ee9f6d39"}

{"id": "p_f711b2b58e0cfb89", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 54, "text": "太祖問彧：「誰能代卿爲我謀者？", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "22a1344bf7865b2db1aebb2752d052ce1f54c7b98b424e3794419b792124a49c"}

{"id": "p_043beda8fd1758f1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」彧言「荀攸、-{鍾}-繇」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "9c32a1ba24081254b646d646436a4b30ef2b835e3f6fc589dedf2f850869b102"}

{"id": "p_f44441fcd0b606b0", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 56, "text": "先是，彧言策謀士，進戲-{志}--{才}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "8df7c85787ae17d84bc273e61a97fc4c71e47898d1bc1b9a2317a79c81f2f289"}

{"id": "p_80b31909fd694e66", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 57, "text": "-{志}--{才}-卒，又進郭嘉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "808c2c54898c66bbc7f4ecebb9637629d325c1d0c1b925ca5365d580db00d160"}

{"id": "p_4c7403cc2a16ec16", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 58, "text": "太祖以彧爲知人，諸所進達皆稱職，唯嚴象爲楊州，韋康爲涼州，-{後}-敗亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "0cf36686156ccc3c4fb0b7b6a2cd0e7ed27478249df452f75b11aa81daf5b6c2"}

{"id": "p_7882afa5552a3937", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 59, "text": "自太祖之迎天子也，袁紹内懷不服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "37624c235828aa4fb08256075185223482716c00da44727cf5cd1f8b35f2dead"}

{"id": "p_4b85650c1d42a124", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 60, "text": "紹旣并河朔，天下畏其彊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "93852b5cba62778707bd555e4a63db0936f745788eefd144a968b585f872c0a8"}

{"id": "p_80f99b0c94004d31", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 61, "text": "太祖方東憂呂布，南拒張繡，而繡敗太祖軍-{於}-宛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "61f04dae4de3d582b886f16c8ba6a3fdac11d49fc6378881998131a4ab641684"}

{"id": "p_3377400338fd79fc", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 62, "text": "紹益驕，與太祖書，其辭悖慢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "c796dbd1cb781208062b21a6da9d39214a5fca0e609530d06e1759f50268c492"}

{"id": "p_7c00486ba60e76e1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 63, "text": "太祖大怒，出入動靜變-{於}-常，衆皆謂以失利-{於}-張繡故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "cf8e627e3410b24cbe224a6842907eca20bb2b2e475de06e2b280b8c51cb3054"}

{"id": "p_975fd8287dddb4f6", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 64, "text": "-{鍾}-繇以問彧，彧曰：「公之聦明，必不追咎往事，殆有他慮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "44982ca4ff85ab053cf2c43ec505f75cda0e6427c3cb0fe16ed5f922aea39582"}

{"id": "p_15b5156036ca6033", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 65, "text": "」則見太祖問之，太祖乃以紹書示彧，曰：「今將討不義，而力不敵，何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "d14f1a9daa786238ec0151274428f1e3cd0e66dce6c1f02783ad407960f8ea02"}

{"id": "p_39c97d65acc91285", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 66, "text": "彧曰：「古之成敗者，誠有其-{才}-，雖弱必彊，苟非其人，雖彊易弱，劉、項之存亡，足以觀矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "70255c39c5cc2b96196a1d3f341ed74494f6c3b89fdbced17a8c24733ed823a0"}

{"id": "p_626c2506153ff53a", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 67, "text": "今與公爭天下者，唯袁紹爾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "34644dfe4ec80f0ecc464503b67e05b05317bff9663b75969c2a868804b2d70a"}

{"id": "p_3dcf7476c20175ee", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 68, "text": "紹貌外寬而内忌，任人而疑其心，公明達不拘，唯-{才}-所宜，此度勝也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "d2f059ea840e7a0e1d71c7c8317ae31e256cabead3f506c5217224063884d0a5"}

{"id": "p_b9ecf513bca2ced0", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 69, "text": "紹遲重少決，失在-{後}-機，公能斷大事，應變無方，此謀勝也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "e376fba4a1f9c47182f33a72cdd06af6a0203659f9332a59fa7a8e7ee352d8fb"}

{"id": "p_4d8c71fa74e9cc56", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 70, "text": "紹-{御}-軍寬緩，法令不立，士卒雖衆，其實難用，公法令旣明，賞罰必行，士卒雖寡，皆爭致死，此武勝也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "87e20b7ddab24e7e0c87ee20db599dc6d207fe8d568941cb6873273a9333bb46"}

{"id": "p_d3d7efb274a2ae1a", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 71, "text": "紹憑世資，從容飾智，以收名譽，故士之寡能好問者多歸之，公以至仁待人，推誠心不爲虚美，行己謹儉，而與有功者無所恡惜，故天下忠正效實之士-{咸}--{願}-爲用，此德勝也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "65219db5a99a23bf0c53ec0cfd4703a9b39475c7166a8a3cbffd72d8e12c0545"}

{"id": "p_f85c31b5d0408ac2", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 72, "text": "夫以四勝輔天子，扶義-{征}-伐，誰敢不從？", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "70305d82e71846b4ac44182d583b262a36e6063e85f520848da76427f7f4b396"}

{"id": "p_962cd09bb16180b1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 73, "text": "彧曰：「不先取呂布，河北亦未易圖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "8c4adc01e7cb98075964f8a978b97b6f20631feb2737c7d1f723df9791323dae"}

{"id": "p_bfbdc9eaa8cc5109", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 74, "text": "吾所惑者，又恐紹侵擾關中，亂羌、胡，南誘蜀漢，是我獨以兖、豫抗天下六分之五也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "ebc4938f815b4a4544f1914e02ac616717f7902e8a9eba5bc03614c1acfc89bc"}

{"id": "p_13c40ef2a116cc64", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 75, "text": "彧曰：「關中將帥以十數，莫能相一，唯韓遂、馬超最彊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "ccf9e785f2c45fd1515e3e14c302b5344cf66e768feaa7b77d6d47046755c96a"}

{"id": "p_720003c9673374e7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 76, "text": "彼見山東方爭，必各擁衆自保。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "3879bb3c7792fa1441e439179fe54f3204e2a5e32189685a4e25a5602a58846d"}

{"id": "p_e12b138cefd71f69", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 77, "text": "今若撫以恩德，遣使連和，相持雖不能久安，比公安定山東，足以不動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "65238c87f706b5b261d1e996d6e3ac8f5ea09bf9434dece87fc4be0c3db63bb3"}

{"id": "p_d0a8f29874a64585", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 78, "text": "-{鍾}-繇可屬以西事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "e5ca9d92825e593561f7419a7fdd82100eb5908aa83cab070d7e24014a9101fc"}

{"id": "p_619c8306d4afb6ea", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 79, "text": "三年，太祖旣破張繡，東禽呂布，定徐州，遂與袁紹相拒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "2a58ff508a5c4c927a70537ef9bf8cf77b22360a4e5d510dfd7664a2a628e49a"}

{"id": "p_fdff051a223f9a05", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 80, "text": "孔融謂彧曰：「紹地廣兵彊；田-{豐}-、許攸，智計之士也，爲之謀；審配、逢紀，盡忠之臣也，任其事；顏良、文-{醜}-，勇冠三軍，統其兵：殆難克乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "d240604f9f339feb491a739d856795dd4a11f470676984eaf109d7d4c82405db"}

{"id": "p_462d5cb4c9281344", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 81, "text": "彧曰：「紹兵雖多而法不整。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "31500e3f8bc84aec384b0cf49805a8f32412a61211d27e61df874007419bcaba"}

{"id": "p_eddf40cd7bc0e0e5", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 82, "text": "田-{豐}-剛而犯上，許攸貪而不治。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "215229e9eb835431e6e3c7aba341400c0fd947f239431cd41614fe9da34a8b5f"}

{"id": "p_3273abfbfb0aa4ec", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 83, "text": "審配專而無謀，逢紀果而自用，此二人留知-{後}-事，若攸家犯其法，必不能縱也，不縱，攸必爲變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "c7a8935babfb7c2234b19ccf66da5229a6da761e0abef86e63fffac1d317b1cc"}

{"id": "p_4ac17a5b1ff2e2f8", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 84, "text": "顏良、文-{醜}-，一夫之勇耳，可一戰而禽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "03d60f7a3a5a881d3c12ded59b1ebd8d14c24853ff9adf06d7e04624caa529c9"}

{"id": "p_14636044b87e3bd9", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 85, "text": "太祖軍糧方盡，書與彧，議欲還許以引紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "5c072f8a2d8f5b143a1656c6ec35e1ebc2d247ca9b49a1c0f57b411227342c34"}

{"id": "p_4c1e9816eaedea77", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 86, "text": "彧曰：「今軍食雖少，未若楚、漢在間也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "7dca58e1fd433ca68d7eec2476b64f20647975490215922167564dae15bfd397"}

{"id": "p_319c24495364645b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 87, "text": "是時劉、項莫肯先退，先退者勢屈也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "b008dd3fa203632dc709348994005ec8fee6e6d868d6e4f0be256d930a5fe0fc"}

{"id": "p_26b360c71e90b5a0", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 88, "text": "公以十分居一之衆，畫地而守之，扼其喉而不得進，已半年矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "45bde7929409f9a5cb8356cf4ce84db485d1ca19233148c9bfca65d173b04ca5"}

{"id": "p_daf10fc08c00e3f6", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 89, "text": "情見勢竭，必將有變，此用奇之時，不可失也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "66cf8443b2c40bc2a644437ad5202560ed4b2d41749dec5088f1c0568b560de6"}

{"id": "p_cabb622baf942908", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 90, "text": "遂以奇兵襲紹別屯，斬其將淳-{于}-瓊等，紹退走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "b8b8d8b26632cb047e7b0219996205c585a5b041e25b4a5045da2b9d0283945d"}

{"id": "p_1a53be07141e646d", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 91, "text": "審配以許攸家不法，收其妻子，攸怒叛紹；顏良、文-{醜}-臨陣授首；田-{豐}-以諫見誅：皆如彧所策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "e1e139f3bf19521adc6b82024d6f1b7b878307e659b6b375b29b4702fe653beb"}

{"id": "p_782985ac3e53a8e0", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 92, "text": "六年，太祖就-{穀}-東平之安民，糧少，不足與河北相支，欲因紹新破，以其間撃討劉表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "9709506c384c149019598da4aab2a05a3323426e6121365cd3f7c144d45ed405"}

{"id": "p_b849e24f47b0aa9f", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 93, "text": "彧曰：「今紹敗，其衆離心，宜乘其困，遂定之；而背兖、豫，遠師江、漢，若紹收其-{餘}-燼，承虚以出人-{後}-，則公事去矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "4f76609a65fdc5059f7608d2bf25778268c525e805e60a21593d7183a7cf8454"}

{"id": "p_79a5a8b78aafa032", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」太祖-{復}-次-{于}-河上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "73ae5e8f159d7d07f6443dbb5ed7e3f27441272369f32a7ed8b9c0dd989faeea"}

{"id": "p_ec1d83692d630561", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 95, "text": "太祖渡河，撃紹子譚、尚，而髙-{幹}-、郭援侵略河東，關右震動，-{鍾}-繇帥馬騰等撃破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "4ed43e4b7c605cb2e6e7cddc9e11a0562e9f3b6f879290c411b06bf17fd8eee0"}

{"id": "p_f1c8b850091a573b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 96, "text": "八年，太祖録彧前-{後}-功，表封彧爲萬歳亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "7bcb05879af17a4ab6ff4333c08495957db9662c9ffb51a367e172b36a75ce07"}

{"id": "p_77e41a14cad7a1a7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 97, "text": "九年，太祖拔鄴，領冀州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "2fc932751f982ba8b669e49d8ee8554eee748ee49f68cd0f56c87e78005677a1"}

{"id": "p_5cb3f22cbf899c87", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 98, "text": "或説太祖「宜-{復}-古置九州，則冀州所-{制}-者廣大，天下服矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "ad7c222e1cf871766cbde3ff09db13c94fc704137f4cc851c06f5a1964cc049b"}

{"id": "p_31c7b4b8e60c1813", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 99, "text": "」太祖將從之，彧言曰：「若是，則冀州當得河東、馮翊、扶風、西河、幽、并之地，所奪者衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "8dd0a5095ee98133219dacda565c69fc0fd1d82bf275c92dd3aeead5bdcdac87"}

{"id": "p_d272ce0b7251a239", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 100, "text": "前日公破袁尚，禽審配，海内震駭，必人人自恐不得保其土地，守其兵衆也；今使分屬冀州，將皆動心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "c16a9c13ed5b906f942d18f0072d4410dbbaf6b779801cde7404d849f1957730"}

{"id": "p_0a4a70c3d88e7dae", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 101, "text": "且人多説關右諸將以閉關之計；今聞此，以爲必以次見奪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "113c02fa51f3169147c3b81d5fa0510097e856a805501d8132c413dfc91effd7"}

{"id": "p_8c3101b4475d2f7e", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 102, "text": "一旦生變，雖有善守者，轉相脅爲非，則袁尚得寬其死，而袁譚懷貳，劉表遂保江、漢之閒，天下未易圖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "42dd7798a4b58e44c4219bbdb124470e58162f948f46ebd260318a2f37260433"}

{"id": "p_c4cde0894f236ad0", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 103, "text": "-{願}-公急引兵先定河北，然-{後}-脩-{復}-舊京，南臨荊州，責貢之不入，則天下-{咸}-知公意，人人自安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "511023a3c03311c90f02a29f7d1a986bebb745997f13f90fa685d81f3a6d8e1c"}

{"id": "p_61e2ca179d4b26f7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 104, "text": "天下大定，乃議古-{制}-，此社稷長久之利也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "f430e5ebe14c98700c18613125bdeae7efd8791ae40e9e1b655b3ab9088a465e"}

{"id": "p_54fd5187de3a6567", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 105, "text": "彧兄衍以監軍校尉守鄴，都督河北事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "6d464100f23cd4408445455228b51b6f5d1b31fb9b785b577bf5c10fe5373d75"}

{"id": "p_a81210ba43c7dd04", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 106, "text": "太祖之-{征}-袁尚也，髙-{幹}-密遣兵謀襲鄴，衍逆覺，盡誅之，以功封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "1b32a7630df64b60eac329841f2f2a29e6c26d7005b5107fd8eee47544d46751"}

{"id": "p_f6030478d0a8e8de", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 107, "text": "太祖以女妻彧長子惲，-{後}-稱安陽公主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "393ac7bccad0b5afc6dc1d4e805a1a429f63af01874639a693ac47065418716e"}

{"id": "p_952ba1134a5436b1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 108, "text": "彧及攸-{並}-貴重，皆謙冲節儉，祿賜散之宗族知舊，家無-{餘}-財。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "549ab68e2212ee8d1bca55bd58ca1e57577a78ee637a83c79719b8b040a0fd94"}

{"id": "p_5b4e5b70491754d1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 109, "text": "十二年，-{復}-增彧邑千戸，合二千戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "524b26a22d55ca3eea8a8de36750ace31ce281ed6688eeb10f96eaa501c6d811"}

{"id": "p_1f0593aefaff6a78", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 110, "text": "太祖將伐劉表，問彧策安出，彧曰：「今華夏已平，南土知困矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "4caad9c5c49d4478ce245713b90e7dbba4aa39acd66810235452fde630f8256c"}

{"id": "p_6702b80007122899", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 111, "text": "可顯出宛、-{葉}-而間行輕進，以掩其不意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "a6fab39cdd98ad55ab55da6c963128c7770b50cabd120b4d19e3967e7b48c016"}

{"id": "p_4538937e109996f3", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 112, "text": "會表病死，太祖直趨宛、-{葉}-如彧計，表子琮以州逆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "8e0f110bc2075f66f7e70f24b4b5a0bb9422307adf6874355722d74402a488a1"}

{"id": "p_0d267d71d5254d03", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 113, "text": "十七年，董昭等謂太祖宜進爵國公，九錫備物，以彰殊勳，密以諮彧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "2e3c367c4c8c1f29037c268cd3cac471c74f1d7dfe6f9f4ac26baef812239b66"}

{"id": "p_31b8bef4bdac27e2", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 114, "text": "彧以爲太祖本興義兵以匡朝-{寧}-國，秉忠貞之誠，守退讓之實；君子愛人以德，不宜如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "ec49189199782a6adbf0cf8f6525bb262aebfb3c0cfe770241209abe0398568f"}

{"id": "p_356058bf5c31dcde", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 115, "text": "會-{征}-孫權，表請彧勞軍-{于}-譙，因輒留彧，以侍中光祿大夫持節，參丞相軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "93840396f0213974ba3eb20fd7c3ef9714e1f9eb1f846cadc3609cfead7bf3c7"}

{"id": "p_f56ee00c99f7e48c", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 116, "text": "太祖軍至濡須，彧疾留壽春，以憂薨，時年五十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "9c147bb7d31a98799c52ece228ab7e7f67a7ffc5d5d3e51699660693c3594175"}

{"id": "p_2261898a5aeaf2f6", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 117, "text": "子惲，嗣侯，官至虎賁中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "bd1e68438e3681ce2babc5e051d65194d134e1e904ce5d345596d4de9542309b"}

{"id": "p_84de23c885ebf8b2", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 118, "text": "初，文帝與平原侯植-{並}-有擬論，文帝-{曲}-禮事彧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "555a73ae68fe5ec31c5b9aacb011e6f0a2e112c9aca12db0059790fa129485ea"}

{"id": "p_250a7d0c661a19b7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 119, "text": "及彧卒，惲又與植善，而與夏侯尚不穆，文帝深恨惲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "10b8b6736e45161f667cb4c604206c6fc9b9402a606f2abaa0dea6610bd4e557"}

{"id": "p_0ec8d5dba8fab681", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 120, "text": "惲早卒，子甝、霬，以外甥故猶寵待。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "a0452fe1d1eadfb7711185dcecca9d0f4fb150a8029d80ba3436274f1b1f8cb8"}

{"id": "p_d184ffdf5d0ba466", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 121, "text": "惲弟俁，-{御}-史中丞，俁弟詵，大將軍從事中郎，皆知名，早卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "4ddd0d7bcbbffcac91f6f43e2bd024375c2b929bd0bc4531715ed925e70991b0"}

{"id": "p_03d76af5320e31df", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 122, "text": "詵弟顗，-{咸}-熙中爲司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "a266f0bdcce1462221d8347f87209bd9b9c0e24ebc3dc43a157912a221741531"}

{"id": "p_e37613ad18dcc7c3", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 123, "text": "====惲子 甝====", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "17bf4c09a0c27f35fbe0ac600c7bfe4955b4d9c662f3276d106d847d7ae201af"}

{"id": "p_f04f2c79f573aed1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 124, "text": "惲子甝，嗣爲散騎常侍，進爵廣陽鄕侯，年三十薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "12ec95b257368895b40ddce41cf6b4108dd7fd40dd18b506054e6291bb855e8f"}

{"id": "p_d585086621c70468", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 125, "text": "====惲子 霬====", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "ed0eaefbf201a12226e2780e7a3ac40e5e7af9fe5a87431cc4e6ea53991eddf1"}

{"id": "p_0baf70a067bdf220", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 126, "text": "霬官至中領軍，薨，諡曰貞侯，追贈驃騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "7a65540ff3dbdc01637bcec8cc51b6a2ce777234913d62bc6d2e067862ba15e0"}

{"id": "p_2ef78c14a85e1176", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 127, "text": "霬妻，司馬景王、文王之妹也，二王皆與親善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "12ddda5ccb7545a8eefb4c63bb264a6ffd3a5427e5b3c79b063b2104dc207ca7"}

{"id": "p_77f3c36afbc17a07", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 128, "text": "-{咸}-熙中，開建五等，霬以著勳前朝，改封愷南頓子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "6272b4ac6985843433745333c8ba7901264131b2e6b9326cf7de1e2b11c24763"}

{"id": "p_ceb6e89d6fc176b3", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 129, "text": "及曇卒，故吏張權求守曇墓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "a9a7416b0914122970f1b6985371d315594770a14430685c8c2a7268834f4cb1"}

{"id": "p_eac0ada7b90c40e0", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 130, "text": "攸年十三，疑之，謂叔父衢曰：「此吏有非常之色，殆將有-{姦}-！", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "b9e3d2a5bb46db73ed5c6cd94d555b717eb665309aca81c2ff1cb16072bffb8a"}

{"id": "p_62bd61cbb0ae23fe", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 131, "text": "」衢寤，乃推問，果殺人亡命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "e9d1895ea58f3c42f753bfaf1336e09cf0d938c2da6f9dfa926fe0d2d0166f9a"}

{"id": "p_43ee198072c9b4c7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 132, "text": "何進秉政，-{徴}-海内名士攸等二十-{餘}-人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "9e930a9959f04a866e717074a66036f8627944f620c401cd56231eeaea9befbf"}

{"id": "p_6d54d09baf7d0f90", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 133, "text": "董卓之亂，關東兵起，卓徙都長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "47738b95999aa143e84a1884e625652ed4b80d08fa6d57487749aa23ceab2a87"}

{"id": "p_7993d54db0fddb9e", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 134, "text": "攸與議郎鄭泰、何顒、侍中-{种}-輯、越騎校尉伍瓊等謀曰：「董卓無道，甚-{於}-桀紂，天下皆怨之，雖資彊兵，實一匹夫耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "4558870a132e353c77b9b5015e38e1b4a842a029f8c42cf0b796cbbb670335e6"}

{"id": "p_30bc0834b23c2aaa", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 135, "text": "今直刺殺之以謝百姓，然-{後}-據殽、函，輔王命，以號令天下，此桓文之舉也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "9ea3f2fa6149bacc602ba7b6c92a773c0f8297112da8d3ddf3d724773913bbe9"}

{"id": "p_dae292150150a06f", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 136, "text": "」事垂就而覺，收顒、攸-{繫}-獄，顒憂懼自殺，攸言語飲食自若，會卓死得免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "52a2bc41bb3a98b7eb9f26c244b6cbf4691595670b5e7e29247de7bcb636a752"}

{"id": "p_7054a070c46750f7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 137, "text": "棄官歸，-{復}--{辟}-公府，舉髙第，遷任城相，不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "9ab7dc5a48e1218e7dfc14dd7b502220ea5518bf514196fc612218783e3d28f4"}

{"id": "p_17640ea476d3f846", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 138, "text": "攸以蜀漢險固，人民殷盛，乃求爲蜀郡太守，道絶不得至，駐荊州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "988a01480c6426548ba922ecc6506284bd7f28d83ce672007d07d826c464646f"}

{"id": "p_7101a4935c4c0532", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 139, "text": "太祖迎天子都許，遺攸書曰：「方今天下大亂，智士勞心之時也，而顧觀變蜀漢，不已久乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "087713c117da464e42cb88ea21e77337c844428403c50022fed14ee7c6c9c7d0"}

{"id": "p_3487d5fec04f57ad", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」-{於}-是-{徴}-攸爲汝南太守，入爲尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "c71ab440434b2f64a07b00aaadd31ff2a20645db2715bda289cd01cff1258963"}

{"id": "p_de1b2bee4e0629ee", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 141, "text": "太祖素聞攸名，與語大恱，謂荀彧，-{鍾}-繇曰：「公達，非常人也，吾得與之計事，天下當何憂哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "5e80c980ec7738c6c8d050a9cff9bfd7678e3554d3693901b57f0a4bc5b4b897"}

{"id": "p_ee958823a04aaa7c", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 142, "text": "攸言-{於}-太祖曰：「繡與劉表相恃爲彊，然繡以-{遊}-軍仰食-{於}-表，表不能供也，勢必離。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "8748b06c4a3d3e6e2160f976aea64edca58d6b79a398db8c2335885a892a8a6d"}

{"id": "p_ed486160fa83bcfc", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 143, "text": "不如緩軍以待之，可誘而致也；若急之，其勢必相救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "4662f92d2be4ce0fd1efe3d7b59fdb7c2a7e37372df8c35003e027017830324d"}

{"id": "p_9cdbc304ceb85116", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」太祖不從，遂進軍之穰，與戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "3553e07eb0ae08146343b1542792e4f97c4de565bf349c92c6e7459efff56403"}

{"id": "p_4161e30f2342d158", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 145, "text": "太祖謂攸曰：「不用君言至是。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "6acdd793078611c8d9b7de90def0c7013720586d8f5299862512c103395411f2"}

{"id": "p_a1b7e09d7092fcee", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」乃設奇兵-{復}-戰，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "2bbb8df8fbe4baa2f0180ad2b29d52f9472e0ab558b9087e65af53029910bda9"}

{"id": "p_3c46c1ed90bbc55a", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 147, "text": "是歳，太祖自宛-{征}-呂布，至下邳，布敗退固守，攻之不拔，連戰，士卒疲，太祖欲還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "3a7319d08d21d7022273baa32fe44d61dbdc510d881bbfa3f398c90b570df8c3"}

{"id": "p_0eaf0ab8095587c0", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 148, "text": "攸與郭嘉説曰：「呂布勇而無謀，今三戰皆北，其鋭氣衰矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "87d547385548d2269677b3efbc29237daef05020c976c388f28bab65a72a2687"}

{"id": "p_46729c4be17a8b70", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 149, "text": "三軍以將爲主，主衰則軍無奮意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "9dfe8c7d51cccb5c9b2ae8029d862a39eaf67e468520aeeb47335ce72f7dd23e"}

{"id": "p_db82a824bb91a558", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 150, "text": "夫陳宮有智而遲，今及布氣之未-{復}-，宮謀之未定，進急攻之，布可拔也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "4918aef5b44ca33b66c480bba1a1900d9dba6f063c3519b02892147ca79c2190"}

{"id": "p_06fbd76f9fecff61", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」乃引沂、泗灌城，城潰，生禽布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "275ab38139c95eaa1216a6ae8724cdefde3223287c781f475ccc58af02997356"}

{"id": "p_74078bbb9e665e74", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 152, "text": "-{後}-從救劉延-{於}-白馬，攸畫策斬顏良。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "8c7f65f2168e54db14e40102dbcba889afec4710fe41ea84580d4fccd6c5205a"}

{"id": "p_65269ff1dc3c474b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 153, "text": "太祖拔白馬還，遣輜重循河而西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "0d53fdea7f7db18c0618b72512611164612107d815603144e18c49100e528c74"}

{"id": "p_09d092f2b370927f", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 154, "text": "袁紹渡河追，卒與太祖遇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "9f452ba6dee249d5503ea5c952ece83e16e8f2826a4b6443b04a52293acccdaf"}

{"id": "p_ee132ca23b0dbb76", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 155, "text": "諸將皆恐，説太祖還保營，攸曰：「此所以禽敵，柰何去之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "9e5cdaf67c999d8d026490e0aed19e1bb0a7d4bd8a67fe96fe0b5dd5c4a13b55"}

{"id": "p_e1ec1aaf3365adce", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 156, "text": "遂以輜重餌賊，賊競奔之，陣亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "b43695c84dd7b75bc43632d4b3129eb037a5746080489c24824f008b8fded238"}

{"id": "p_85bebd1abba5d13b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 157, "text": "乃縱歩騎撃，大破之，斬其騎將文-{醜}-，太祖遂與紹相拒-{於}-官渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "189f5e73f4ba7e360d2faeadc3346dbe64c621c40c98bd84fb1d7287b94ef905"}

{"id": "p_f458e604d5062880", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 158, "text": "軍食方盡，攸言-{於}-太祖曰：「紹運車旦暮至，其將韓𦳣鋭而輕敵，撃可破也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "ece14516455be005613144f9f1fc16d447ce889d8a0f801b117d46faa2299002"}

{"id": "p_841dce94d6008b4c", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 159, "text": "」乃遣晃及史渙邀撃破走之，燒其輜重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "21c231e14966ae590391b55ec958c5b64b87407deb16ed243ff64d323361b9da"}

{"id": "p_6590301817b7eeb8", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 160, "text": "會許攸來降，言紹遣淳-{于}-瓊等將萬-{餘}-兵迎運糧，將驕卒惰，可要撃也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "81add39ef83fb9d00ad833fe980e7767b63898aae30e56502ffa7a5a78d781d2"}

{"id": "p_20352e18c0f2bd96", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 161, "text": "太祖自將攻破之，盡斬瓊等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "51935283b7d807281ffda0df8106df5b389b9f3d9c83a80c80c0606bff5a11cd"}

{"id": "p_916fc08c31ab81a1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 162, "text": "紹將張郃、髙覽燒攻櫓降，紹遂棄軍走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "d8a7863e25657415090793acffb6e3fb95870c7a8008a72b48a095ad0af3f4a9"}

{"id": "p_a9e8c5c7411e1bfe", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 163, "text": "郃之來，洪疑不敢受，攸謂洪曰：「郃計不用，怒而來，君何疑？", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "71c770715bc8c33244c8b10707e044dd56824ef5f2fa75746bab8f0fa0096e26"}

{"id": "p_59e3ee4fe5cb18ae", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 164, "text": "七年，從討袁譚、尚-{於}-黎陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "38d91776a867c8ab0aeea41381ec1f95cb0c8fd54cc06b3d816d4d0ba813b376"}

{"id": "p_b2b9d158150eeff2", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 165, "text": "明年，太祖方-{征}-劉表，譚、尚爭冀州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "0f3b9ab6f933b1360112677aec0b6745da5e09d37c45713f710f6eb038994539"}

{"id": "p_500575b438857816", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 166, "text": "譚遣辛毗乞降請救，太祖將許之，以問羣下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "a0b3a06aded69d8d77f2ede59ce2437177d9cefd853f557ec79c316a23711791"}

{"id": "p_0ac487a824dd9cbc", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 167, "text": "羣下多以爲表彊，宜先平之，譚、尚不足憂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "532d5a87edc97ca8e17a60589a3d5f996fa67b8b56e6aa96ab5578ea10ad97cf"}

{"id": "p_065f3ce5b4b337c5", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 168, "text": "攸曰：「天下方有事，而劉表坐保江、漢之閒，其無四方-{志}-可知矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "d3233fc9063380502ceebaf2f6ca49617d11d4974e385d32055dbcbf31bab007"}

{"id": "p_79f65d5d96d727b0", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 169, "text": "袁氏據四州之地，帶甲十萬，紹以寬厚得衆，借使二子和睦以守其成業，則天下之難未息也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "fff59f84872e8e40246a3a2f8ecc9be6ef7b424d40ffc4938da121c3010bce3e"}

{"id": "p_eafd2548b44ae46c", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 170, "text": "今兄弟遘惡，其勢不兩全。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "8b0ef4019586a08016dac151bdd1f8d351874df2a89f751535433378532afd10"}

{"id": "p_50570cd4cb1f5544", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 171, "text": "若有所并則力專，力專則難圖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "6384733fa8d7408ad018f499f6383750186b20dfd929b9ce15d7bf5131689817"}

{"id": "p_fc937fc82e812f0e", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 172, "text": "及其亂而取之，天下定矣，此時不可失也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "163e175a315836fefa3a3ea1c9039ed664d009a5ee2cfe6c82ed47fe1c883cb1"}

{"id": "p_ff3a069dfae3b073", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 173, "text": "」乃許譚和親，遂還撃破尚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "96c07ee12efd99302b43ceb3847c39835fd6212cbfa4bf5486a42527b4ffd2fa"}

{"id": "p_9b9e05e7c90a194d", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 174, "text": "其-{後}-譚叛，從斬譚-{於}-南皮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "d886a04cee7892fde9fbbdd04885a63d8fd19206a24f2f5de48f2dbd9001740f"}

{"id": "p_04ad390ddf2a8be6", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 175, "text": "冀州平，太祖表封攸曰：「軍師荀攸，自初佐臣，無-{征}-不從，前-{後}-克敵，皆攸之謀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "db8aa62108c326a58aa80f5921eba103a5b6c4448364edc7417f689c96b47360"}

{"id": "p_0afe605821792b07", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 176, "text": "」-{於}-是封陵樹亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "f8d4c98840f490db017779beaedebd95ee873de1a55ee82958675282445b3f35"}

{"id": "p_b2dd4f6b2c99f9a7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 177, "text": "十二年，下令大論功行封，太祖曰：「忠正密謀，撫-{寧}-内外，文若是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "d1e8eb50fa828f324d6984f778d3667ad9a41e774940dc2cb9091ca5e1db9b86"}

{"id": "p_9557c2caaab42018", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 178, "text": "」增邑四百，并前七百戸，轉爲中軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "b0e763996845dc1142adec1452adc3936fbd2c02c32dd31586d2ad800ae90fa1"}

{"id": "p_a7bb5ceb49ff3afa", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 179, "text": "攸深密有智防，自從太祖-{征}-伐，常謀謩帷幄，時人及子弟莫知其所言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "5c518f323b091348fa6000cb4c97fad2a824b10470948e1a4034a8bae583a0ec"}

{"id": "p_20dd79fb3e14e04b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 180, "text": "太祖毎稱曰：「公達外愚内智，外怯内勇，外弱内彊，不伐善，無施勞，智可及，愚不可及，雖顏子、寗武不能過也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "54d66823304bfa268f0691e39139508041c392153c43ff738c8dc64965def3f0"}

{"id": "p_402594d1089e97ae", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 181, "text": "」文帝在東宮，太祖謂曰：「荀公達，人之師表也，汝當盡禮敬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "d022cb9471c3bdd153585687c3c851b31a1e5bfab410be75b67c27a6958cf0ee"}

{"id": "p_c602869ade88c9f1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」攸曾病，世子問病，獨拜牀下，其見尊異如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "d2d1d7009368f01ae67776ce708bb6211ff67132e0a5cc72a1e2cf48cc5d61bd"}

{"id": "p_b6a5dd4b4a7267df", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 183, "text": "攸與-{鍾}-繇善，繇言：「我毎有所行，反覆思惟，自謂無以易；以咨公達，輒-{復}-過人意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "53cb92a2d16f5eec6aff67faf6740a4e0a518bb18bb5e9ff1e7e69911344dcd7"}

{"id": "p_50d8dc682eafe4c5", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 184, "text": "」公達前-{後}-凡畫奇策十二，唯繇知之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "315925007458bb46b9db73d41ea43a6a3ef4ce13ba93e82fce665bccbb17a72c"}

{"id": "p_7a4865b614511cd3", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 185, "text": "繇撰集未就，會薨，故世不得盡聞也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "c30c7ecb220ffc7e742f92ef69bc94a077e39e6cb4fd6450d3853f86b1fe47bc"}

{"id": "p_153e79159e449624", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 186, "text": "攸從-{征}-孫權，道薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "1e9bb2414b67c449f3053d9050d1d41c2d457b9db11cdbca8ebaf93632bb1fe6"}

{"id": "p_cff5a65f27d058dd", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 187, "text": "次子-{適}-嗣，無子，絶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "8441c1b8edeac939fd153877271e85e017633f657813706c55b5a15502639d70"}

{"id": "p_300a2b3636d3d786", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 188, "text": "黃初中，紹封攸孫彪爲陵樹亭侯，邑三百戸，-{後}-轉封丘陽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "bcfdf6c8595d3cc3adf0829a221f001c356d68678c69c805f2f788685f15f536"}

{"id": "p_b5b9f3e110bfc661", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 189, "text": "賈詡字文和，武威姑臧人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "9aeee3908678d1f98ce4db8bb1f0b3256ab278ccd683532829d07aabe4624c84"}

{"id": "p_30f1419b4cff6e56", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 190, "text": "少時人莫知，唯漢陽閻忠異之，謂詡有良、平之奇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "dd1115c7c159e4986df8507579371903fcd61162fa5aa679b7a9016782b52ddb"}

{"id": "p_745a5ad191f77c73", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 191, "text": "察孝廉爲郎，疾病去官，西還至汧，道遇叛氐，同行數十人皆爲所執。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "161982dd951e1f8e69c186555036b4bdf9265385a99001e46d28183fc4ff0027"}

{"id": "p_b46f016e842a8a91", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 192, "text": "詡曰：「我段公外孫也，汝別埋我，我家必厚贖之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "5bad28b87c9d4041b22b85dd319fbf82d427336c23c6c366c3e3269a5b964853"}

{"id": "p_5527d41dfeddf859", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 193, "text": "」時太尉段熲，昔久爲邊將，威震西土，故詡假以懼氐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "044cac245ad414132f6465ab4e987563dccaf91e3783c593b0f391d14e388deb"}

{"id": "p_1c7bed88dfe56449", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 194, "text": "氐果不敢害，與盟而送之，其-{餘}-悉死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "069c9718f6d6b835555359c03c947126a326b5b97f3b4f22f32cae9529572e23"}

{"id": "p_6c52cc9123e1f499", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 195, "text": "詡實非段甥，權以濟事，-{咸}-此類也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "7897cc9e205c0877e0f034d1cf9e412f5e9066f98b4d691a6033b4d64dc60e57"}

{"id": "p_e1a0bb8f57f3f4d8", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 196, "text": "董卓之入洛陽，詡以太尉掾爲平津都尉，遷討虜校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "e78d94ab80032220b03ffe2a8132d5bf48882952014f3d1032430765621cb8ea"}

{"id": "p_8db9019aff38e449", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 197, "text": "卓壻中郎將牛輔屯陝，詡在輔軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "5ff19c5decefc9d6eb49c8e5080f2faf3d87c4ac7c1497b25a01ad57100c89ed"}

{"id": "p_10569c87926ce367", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 198, "text": "卓敗，輔又死，衆恐懼，校尉李傕、郭汜、張濟等欲解散，間行歸鄕-{里}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "fe422da5d0354ec8f24dcbb44576b6b3298284babcc7389331c6a4a1081d44a4"}

{"id": "p_7375fddcf9938bf7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 199, "text": "詡曰：「聞長安中議欲盡誅涼州人，而諸君棄衆單行，即一亭長能束君矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "59ff4981155d9b65da3e49601ecb2e4220af916afb53fcad2b0445dd9b3f0eb6"}

{"id": "p_5e840601ffd34f10", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 200, "text": "不如率衆而西，所在收兵，以攻長安，爲董公報仇，幸而事濟，奉國家以-{征}-天下，若不濟，走未-{後}-也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "f6cc03b84efa8ed71d7fe7b0625489a8ecb32ee0c748843c60ccf46323566223"}

{"id": "p_198bfcfaf45fd8bc", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 201, "text": "-{後}-詡爲左馮翊，傕等欲以功侯之，詡曰：「此救命之計，何功之有！", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "758b77aabfc0f0f579dfe55f46d058dc71396abec4a472e1bd17f0d8c045c7e1"}

{"id": "p_9a0fba8c921ff4b8", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 202, "text": "又以爲尚書-{僕}-射，詡曰：「尚書-{僕}-射，官之師長，天下所望，詡名不素重，非所以服人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "1439f04f59fff022c1a5ad42d420e12fb6fe7cb92ee90baf3eeb91829cc995c0"}

{"id": "p_4cbb090299d37d32", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 203, "text": "縱詡昧-{於}-榮利，柰國朝何！", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "ceffeb82cf6671b93515b666fb1354af8ff2f872f58f5a93fc45244d5688b840"}

{"id": "p_a8d10fc00871465c", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 204, "text": "」乃更拜詡尚書，典選舉，多所匡濟，傕等親而憚之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "e446c110046c721c1a3de013bbe8c7d6fbceb452f05ae27d94db6a5b8c8cb881"}

{"id": "p_dd165809d9bd7843", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 205, "text": "會母喪去官，拜光祿大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "2372e04ee34f84a429bf6098857794254387d9a57b523b26d40a688d1f2fc5de"}

{"id": "p_20e0663848e69baa", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 206, "text": "傕、汜等-{鬬}-長安中，傕-{復}-請詡爲宣義將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "0eec96d1f312f3199d8ad161b4be0991201357cb1144acccdc539247cadf1d7e"}

{"id": "p_01da6633d0ff1c55", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 207, "text": "傕等和，出天子，祐護大臣，詡有力焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "90183420adba9151baeec15902f79196004779a2f0e87b924b0936a14c80a122"}

{"id": "p_1e582255b77d6101", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 208, "text": "是時將軍段煨屯華陰，與詡同郡，遂去傕-{託}-煨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "4cca7add342b2b10a940075fd03ffb2ce6596bde91e62220ad77065dd2ef3aa2"}

{"id": "p_22e6eae193626375", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 209, "text": "煨内恐其見奪，而外奉詡禮甚備，詡愈不自安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "5dd60b58f2ee66dc1e9123a23c0a94d247158aaa100e36df191f26c880cbdc9d"}

{"id": "p_c417fb7fde79cc20", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 210, "text": "張繡在南陽，詡陰結繡，繡遣人迎詡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "1ebf3d2f0a94387916f671b944e6a77fa19794ec49fa45838f249514f04139b2"}

{"id": "p_66aeec0d8454e718", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 211, "text": "詡將行，或謂詡曰：「煨待君厚矣，君安去之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "869a2d19528374b196705f533252ad4989b5faeaece69afa237b2490316454fd"}

{"id": "p_6bc92b2a6c3e0b16", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 212, "text": "」詡曰：「煨性多疑，有忌詡意，禮雖厚，不可恃，久將爲所圖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "3cfe1bc6008b08d0c492ac30ae81f342b32eaf4b1a32663035a94ef111f619b0"}

{"id": "p_ea6892dd8b17eb14", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 213, "text": "我去必喜，又望吾結大援-{於}-外，必厚吾妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "71b713070ba66869b3f49bfa8fd20530b26ea1054a465904a90685ac328c563c"}

{"id": "p_5163b67f462b05fe", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 214, "text": "繡無謀主，亦-{願}-得詡，則家與身必倶全矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "8286ad0f366b2e51307b54411eb4586c2d38c819ba0b82bd078e9642018eb3dc"}

{"id": "p_e603e4ec55c2b9ff", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 215, "text": "」詡遂往，繡執子孫禮，煨果善視其家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "aaee0474bbda9a569f28341505aaa986ff1f31f23405b219fcaa429dd00b9c93"}

{"id": "p_748467c4d2b1e779", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 216, "text": "太祖比-{征}-之，一朝引軍退，繡自追之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "fd60c0d06c1bee9231812abc5f10069607f9118d88bee63acf635c2f31e05efb"}

{"id": "p_0012001dc7e0e6a2", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 217, "text": "詡謂繡曰：「不可追也，追必敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "4453cef89c8f00e178c248a9b77a4e3edb9a49f18a4b1b20dadec124a9e38592"}

{"id": "p_6885624fbcef4cb8", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 218, "text": "」繡不從，進兵交戰，大敗而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "3cfb6171390054e71eb3808fab64f9e4d93580f43e9a61a56049268cdfd30e8b"}

{"id": "p_0610ece98ee02eb9", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 219, "text": "詡謂繡曰：「促更追之，更戰必勝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "2f7df5c233c03ba205820f31bc5299f1908cc0d9d95266ae7296072849463592"}

{"id": "p_80dd08e535860b57", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 220, "text": "」繡謝曰：「不用公言，以至-{於}-此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "9bb03735843e9b970bf4f26795fe00477cd890c6ad0441a80cf090f6ea287db3"}

{"id": "p_b9e7b2fef2ed81a8", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 221, "text": "今已敗，柰何-{復}-追？", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "d3178143f7b7d94a60b18b1eaa047890b4757e4f476e5d2abcd203a2be7389f3"}

{"id": "p_bbcdb04d5529b0ba", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 222, "text": "」詡曰：「兵勢有變，亟往必利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "1631f4087033d83e1631ba6e378bf32877c013ba54ca3927fff203d52b0cab5e"}

{"id": "p_1873b47bc7868174", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 223, "text": "」繡信之，遂收散卒赴追，大戰，果以勝還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "fec70f3a253a36c1d688a7f62cdedd1c3157b36498cdf7f4c7a97674ca4a98eb"}

{"id": "p_d05edcd4c1cad70d", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 224, "text": "問詡曰：「繡以精兵追退軍，而公曰必敗；退以敗卒撃勝兵，而公曰必剋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "5fadc097a6741a6b9eba6d99f8fe9adc011f682155b3fc012ee4b4e2927eb035"}

{"id": "p_ee15868c9499401e", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 225, "text": "悉如公言，何其反而皆驗也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "45141e1723ef084e285810ac8a9d014cc288142369e23bdee53ea173e4dcb798"}

{"id": "p_f5179c2c417b80f1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 226, "text": "將軍雖善用兵，非曹公敵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "444832e4b29935a216809adb836af71f27fda59f36f6a1ded551e90047fde30e"}

{"id": "p_325b617228fa2b60", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 227, "text": "軍雖新退，曹公必自斷-{後}-；追兵雖精，將旣不敵，彼士亦鋭，故知必敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "e61bfede8bd1fbfdcec71bb8dff9ab605793dffc4c9dc9a032accce4a0858a3b"}

{"id": "p_64c8f69d88634ecc", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 228, "text": "曹公攻將軍無失策，力未盡而退，必國内有故；已破將軍，必輕軍速進，縱留諸將斷-{後}-，諸將雖勇，亦非將軍敵，故雖用敗兵而戰必勝也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "0ee9c04dbfdb6bac376c20b22e8d9a25739e82f637a74d68a0f597ad1c20c55d"}

{"id": "p_97f91763585c417d", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 229, "text": "是-{後}-，太祖拒袁紹-{於}-官渡，紹遣人招繡，并與詡書結援。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "d5c1110358406dde65f4da9db12b6690af8d4ee1b30ed82c937bad3098ec8778"}

{"id": "p_2ea8b10c8270d302", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 230, "text": "繡欲許之，詡顯-{於}-繡坐上謂紹使曰：「歸謝袁本初，兄弟不能相容，而能容天下國士乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "981a01e1c18bdb0d97a5a417423c91ef910b08307eeb03c211fd32c9634589e7"}

{"id": "p_728911d8e94dfa41", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 231, "text": "」繡驚懼曰：「何至-{於}-此！", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "99e5e8d2248608974392839d9920f065f5b8bd7be74873fab90cdfed6b2829da"}

{"id": "p_1c40860a3422cc1a", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 232, "text": "」竊謂詡曰：「若此，當何歸？", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "a16076aaef45c19c3edfab94afcef5774fba666c033e267460a26deb4a42a955"}

{"id": "p_16ef1dc9a41b2e58", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 233, "text": "」繡曰：「袁彊曹弱，又與曹爲讎，從之如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "7a0d1207940cc65dc566c2ca77a9da43234b93da7a4005ff2f2d7c6de2a4563c"}

{"id": "p_07b126a9830bc1d6", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 234, "text": "」詡曰：「此乃所以宜從也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "57199a6b10601f9042c031690746944452381e89db6e98f33c54e0555ae726e9"}

{"id": "p_bc03350fcadb682e", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 235, "text": "夫曹公奉天子以令天下，其宜從一也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "6afab8ad7f07cb726c79b430d913f3d4010479da36a1775337efdfe9267e6ecd"}

{"id": "p_c50365840279769b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 236, "text": "紹彊盛，我以少衆從之，必不以我爲重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "f077a6ce29d84cccdfdbafae69c92ceeadbb61916e4523a73c20c2d61034b474"}

{"id": "p_ae3c1103ec198041", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 237, "text": "曹公衆弱，其得我必喜，其宜從二也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "2bd0ddc7f763f1344ef79a7a0d8babf51bf2cf687428bada7aa125d9436d4723"}

{"id": "p_1a0f388400bac03f", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 238, "text": "夫有霸王之-{志}-者，固將釋私怨，以明德-{於}-四海，其宜從三也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "a741febaf8d8a42acd5814171dd73d18ab12715ca35c1d52f9ca9d4c341daccc"}

{"id": "p_82985b4aa430c3f1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 239, "text": "太祖見之，喜，執詡手曰：「使我信重-{於}-天下者，子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "e35b5c316413f2fd568c5dc59600ac17c939b8fd41bb670c2df6f56a4667176b"}

{"id": "p_ae07015b502f10a8", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 240, "text": "」表詡爲執金吾，封都亭侯，遷冀州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "7c3b827dfab0ef41f74d0be89ce5986ed693a9a53c09400fd5a51ef388f84d3e"}

{"id": "p_dd2aec2eafd9934d", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 241, "text": "冀州未平，留參司空軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "17db7aff739354d58fe5584971ca53934a459782eed0727148ce1a84254f5d81"}

{"id": "p_918041e34940a6ee", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 242, "text": "袁紹圍太祖-{於}-官渡，太祖糧方盡，問詡計焉出，詡曰：「公明勝紹，勇勝紹，用人勝紹，決機勝紹，有此四勝而半年不定者，但顧萬全故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "1c662c17cf9a3782827a889cfd2e2b7a4efee0a9ca1686b0fc1336237b2a1151"}

{"id": "p_3b8aa22feaa7dc9b", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 243, "text": "」乃并兵出，圍撃紹三十-{餘}--{里}-營，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "b8211b25b5c8693464478a07f0703416b562302185e9dc62d5a5b401c2a7c393"}

{"id": "p_a0c3b928df346abe", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 244, "text": "太祖領冀州牧，徙詡爲太中大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "ec4db95e8cb316cebf86cb85d36c8eee8f6d7b743e8ca245d1bfb598da55c542"}

{"id": "p_7939df7df1e9cec5", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 245, "text": "，太祖破荊州，欲順江東下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "b21efed13fa4a7a437fe167c84b60fc330e205cda44faebff3eac0727de7175a"}

{"id": "p_13cf10fdaabfc5e7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 246, "text": "詡諫曰：「明公昔破袁氏，今收漢南，威名遠著，軍勢旣大；若乘舊楚之饒，以饗吏士，撫安百姓，使安土樂業，則可不勞衆而江東稽服矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "89567e176136bb0c2a8bc440b378023493dad85bd3b020428bdaa0d57bf65001"}

{"id": "p_9d7452e13cf0d051", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 247, "text": "太祖-{後}-與韓遂、馬超戰-{於}-渭南，超等索割地以和，并求任子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "4fb82c7bc1a83853eff206c4886b8d7d7abc780c16b26cf8f428b8d37c9bc412"}

{"id": "p_dd28c4747db40681", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 248, "text": "又問詡計策，詡曰：「離之而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "90892b449af1591e89c891d3566232bae251a4c91109b44ca71a628679d70ba1"}

{"id": "p_17904850b7dac071", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 249, "text": "是時，文帝爲五官將，而臨菑侯植-{才}-名方盛，各有黨與，有奪宗之議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "d90f431ca9f7b730b8f6e84a5e71f0eee72bcd954dc47c66365c6028960b891c"}

{"id": "p_6c8eadc479b352a2", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 250, "text": "文帝使人問詡自固之-{術}-，詡曰：「-{願}-將軍恢崇德度，躬素士之業，朝夕孜孜，不違子道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "820eaf5335c8beaa6759de2a781e96400c2bafc184f4083430f3de40ba04b565"}

{"id": "p_c28d3f372fe70fc7", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 251, "text": "太祖又嘗屛除左右問詡，詡嘿然不對。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "196ccd97b56a145669a444aed2f20cfa5114e9cbdc42808068fad66b748b0244"}

{"id": "p_9fadb8fb3764c685", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 252, "text": "太祖曰：「與卿言而不荅，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "b78585d7ba4d9bfd5b895f42433caa782f40497fd411c37c1e3cb8183fae3c2e"}

{"id": "p_6dd4d7824d7e5f19", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 253, "text": "」詡曰：「屬-{適}-有所思，故不即對耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "29a8a48fed72a07a284d97f69448b19cab4dbde785b7f12cbc42f77fc542121d"}

{"id": "p_b8385532aef41456", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 254, "text": "」詡曰：「思袁本初、劉景升父子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "691824fa75261246a4876eb1dae2b3536ebb82938e0a2843aadf483769648b4a"}

{"id": "p_421a1bf44fb27d68", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 255, "text": "」太祖大笑，-{於}-是太子遂定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "be627b4d4de35cd322209f150a0e95753db3012369f7d52d0f04e8fd591d176b"}

{"id": "p_67f13ddbc808693a", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 256, "text": "詡自以非太祖舊臣，而策謀深長，懼見猜疑，闔門自守，退無私交，男女嫁娶，不結髙門，天下之論智計者歸之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "ed11080d8a725589e9ecbddb018f319f73b874934b02a5c2cf3c5385ae15a969"}

{"id": "p_3618e0f3a2b1aed1", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 257, "text": "文帝即位，以詡爲太尉，進爵魏壽鄕侯，增邑三百，并前八百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "0524e31d48c3369f1744f951f61e56ed1456766862def3fc5564e0af306b2da1"}

{"id": "p_c5f98eeba9b8e8ef", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 258, "text": "又分邑二百，封小子訪爲列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "d7d09b5d31d519b301dc4797213914cab2f7f097c09851b91e7342c0dce25087"}

{"id": "p_f5dc755a2ac50372", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 259, "text": "帝問詡曰：「吾欲伐不從命以一天下，呉、蜀何先？", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "f54442e2d4c115f66aa46dc9cd6e66c98787a40329a2c61479c416cb87e1f1b9"}

{"id": "p_31adeb950b34a85f", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 260, "text": "」對曰：「攻取者先兵權，建本者尚德化。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "a97eda40cc6c345334e85a71787533aad62cef99d87e9faa7ad62e6ebfc189ae"}

{"id": "p_8a1a26ad79a562b8", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 261, "text": "陛下應期受禪，撫臨率土，若綏之以文德而俟其變，則平之不難矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "165bedbe4483f497be92f5a74d675ed08f7355d7061c69ce921c1fe34ef6fc4a"}

{"id": "p_32b77e3b1254b0c3", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 262, "text": "呉、蜀雖蕞爾小國，依岨山水，劉備有雄-{才}-，諸葛亮善治國，孫權識虚實，陸議見兵勢，據險守要，汎舟江湖，皆難卒謀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "a83f2bb2bb617f6a474dc5368ce845b11279c26a7bdcff2c1b3ebe4c7653e8c3"}

{"id": "p_1fbcc3ff85618409", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 263, "text": "用兵之道，先勝-{後}-戰，量敵論將，故舉無遺策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "c45eb32702caa7f06f23c569a35acb19001b3292673312a9ab119d5c482b2088"}

{"id": "p_333a349e122db92c", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 264, "text": "臣竊料羣臣，無備、權對，雖以天威臨之，未見萬全之勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "666199d7fe3ff56b98e1ec98cd71d482e79a46404f926f92c4d6d4c84452f7c3"}

{"id": "p_a5d88efd55134728", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 265, "text": "昔舜舞-{干}-戚而有苗服，臣以爲當今宜先文-{後}-武。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "0fade6bf38584b7886a03ddb9c948cd08fcd17da5717cb637d9ec1a019ea2025"}

{"id": "p_36f94e36f32f6ad5", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 266, "text": "-{後}-興江陵之役，士卒多死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "b193ea2fb1e85660f000a05e3899430b4843fb75363c7e7f3bf013a4db7c46bb"}

{"id": "p_70cecb3c2f069a12", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 267, "text": "詡年七十七，薨，諡曰肅侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "b9df485e691fbc55883a4c78f630a3c908376c4bd132c5a2715688df25575506"}

{"id": "p_b040aa602a6593ce", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 268, "text": "評曰：荀彧淸秀通雅，有王佐之風，然機-{鑒}-先識，未能充其-{志}-也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "9aa672e4ee6cb11098c0cde02fa5010a137500a2c14d7ca441cc9d4fded64f4d"}

{"id": "p_5f45e29e983d5def", "source_id": "src_2053a0a5c5eddc49", "ordinal": 269, "text": "荀攸、賈詡，庶乎筭無遺策，經達權變，其良、平之亞與！", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "9b2796ebfc2be5916c54882e5d4dd5a678c3c7e6217218dccf7946bbbbcb01cc"}

{"id": "p_db317f7b6ea2d625", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 0, "text": "袁渙字曜卿，陳郡扶樂人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "a97d213f7184c1145d21819284b67f5ef5956dd0de1d7867fd62c1a1eb25f7d3"}

{"id": "p_44d51699722d2df5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 1, "text": "當時諸公子多越法度，而渙清靜，舉動必以禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "6c17930c5e0645c9fab5dde1a95924f1291ca0314fb763ac5fc7d0425390b8c4"}

{"id": "p_aa93c6dea5f71d37", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 2, "text": "郡命為功曹，郡中姧吏皆自引去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "60cf6cc656c703fd18df9082d1581da4ae3d00619a1d226966eb0c1c94cbaaf8"}

{"id": "p_d42b96b71e5fa6cc", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 3, "text": "後辟公府，舉高第，遷侍御史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "fe816118bd2db58e511ef63ce0098d7bd5193175bd01f3cfb93e0a47a37188e3"}

{"id": "p_76237a1980b81d41", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 4, "text": "劉備之為豫州，舉渙茂才。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "98ad034789235ae584b9d2429a9db751cc81b69526b093dac2c11172a1fee9a1"}

{"id": "p_865ce104a5664900", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 5, "text": "後避地江、淮間，為袁術所命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "fae835ef9569cb43ec6a90d8c605a6fb6b20cd5a2431f9c01ec45a4495a4dc89"}

{"id": "p_155a47350986729f", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 6, "text": "術每有所咨訪，渙常正議，術不能抗，然敬之不敢不禮也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "0436fa512c52116084da7f99a99ba34b5231f7d617cc56e076f8cc200b4f4087"}

{"id": "p_4afa60f728a86403", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 7, "text": "頃之，呂布擊術於阜陵，渙往從之，遂復為布所拘留。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "5be7285023bbe17817a01c5f74164b09df252b888f8a5c86dae02da3defd0c6a"}

{"id": "p_cc220917ecbd4cfc", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 8, "text": "布初與劉備和親，後離隙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "f6a0011f0a01a5d12c685d8899865d39b026864151a5c64a44a5d94d3c4800da"}

{"id": "p_bc5cd218744c3fdb", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 9, "text": "布欲使渙作書詈辱備，渙不可，再三彊之，不許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "62d3056f601baf5f9aff15bda62e291c52de2f9f9021cbe1657a1a85cd3a04ab"}

{"id": "p_03dd8fddc60e390a", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 10, "text": "布大怒，以兵脅渙曰：「為之則生，不為則死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "3bdec51bccfe1706c882f0be043df40353b549cacfff96c04d7c0cbf0b490924"}

{"id": "p_629216f41e25f892", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」渙顏色不變，笑而應之曰：「渙聞唯德可以辱人，不聞以罵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "9d84930ded5f6b70dc43666da36aa2f64fc261b8b9dfcba8a8ba96ef9a5eff9c"}

{"id": "p_c3e04842f24ffa72", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 12, "text": "使彼固君子邪，且不恥將軍之言，彼誠小人邪，將復將軍之意，則辱在此不在於彼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "27a5b0de20ea722ba663b4b59f09f8b8434d5a299b9c9dfe4e336e628da2a816"}

{"id": "p_95aa13d50b844483", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 13, "text": "且渙他日之事劉將軍，猶今日之事將軍也，如一旦去此，復罵將軍，可乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "3671c69a586a221ec0f33baca33ed04fdbcfd20c495dc99679a1910a3bf1e089"}

{"id": "p_828ca71de5d3ce43", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 14, "text": "渙言曰：「夫兵者，凶器也，不得已而用之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "05ffe98133600fbd75a4778b9cfaae80f360f204eb109d3f8814f10384ee9da8"}

{"id": "p_dbcc9c51fa1593fc", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 15, "text": "鼓之以道德，征之以仁義，兼撫其民而除其害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "38b36e58973f83c29c72c8f8f82dd3379f56e61052382148978cfe5b8b5ec95c"}

{"id": "p_560cbaa64ce291b5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 16, "text": "夫然，故可與之死而可與之生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "c06a6e3856701c10ed45b1760cec31271307854720242be8b2ecdcf05ae14bea"}

{"id": "p_48a56ae067b689b3", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 17, "text": "自大亂以來十數年矣，民之欲安，甚於倒縣，然而暴亂未息者，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "9f25b1041cc1002897814d92349bd062955f45c32386c3c8d2581900e5136c07"}

{"id": "p_9971555fcb69cc98", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 18, "text": "渙聞明君善於救世，故世亂則齊之以義，時偽則鎮之以樸；世異事變，治國不同，不可不察也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "8f14ffb244a8bd66d81103cf7b42f0f4d124a97e9bf611d0770cbc614f7c967e"}

{"id": "p_06e0531117d4e0e9", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 19, "text": "夫制度損益，此古今之不必同者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "bd00222e79d611ff0832b407a691b86a9ca101f489b4028184ba3fe4e5247d23"}

{"id": "p_0ba550fd40ee0d08", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 20, "text": "若夫兼愛天下而反之於正，雖以武平亂而濟之以德，誠百王不易之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "f532c18cb196fe92b3108ebfaf02e9736cfa53f935c1a4c2cee854604da67141"}

{"id": "p_618a052f98bd6edf", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 21, "text": "公明哲超世，古之所以得其民者，公旣勤之矣，今之所以失其民者，公旣戒之矣，海內賴公，得免於危亡之禍，然而民未知義，其唯公所以訓之，則天下幸甚！", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "2789c25062e79dd6a55835d70c49d664eb76fe5b125156f6934297127393074c"}

{"id": "p_6b92f6141253e52a", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 22, "text": "是時新募民開屯田，民不樂，多逃亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "74c840b176d5b13b7a5a9f18524591d56108a10f74e26a9f5b52d4cbcd551c6e"}

{"id": "p_23a395a60d5a2591", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 23, "text": "渙白太祖曰：「夫民安土重遷，不可卒變，易以順行，難以逆動，宜順其意，樂之者乃取，不欲者勿彊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "49f2c5889e04374fd45825415a0c1fad99f6baf3da195e5e1015f4637b2d06ab"}

{"id": "p_4a49e26fb1fc6467", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 24, "text": "渙每勑諸縣：「務存鰥寡高年，表異孝子貞婦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "0fad0dd2740e8e5efe9d8bff27403da89205e0ca09698bcd6af8babcec80e395"}

{"id": "p_85e26b65d73dc58b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 25, "text": "常談曰『世治則禮詳，世亂則禮簡』，全在斟酌之間耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "1707e4a8e9422a9b740d98f2f9d1b09acf62d49c8a5ee0dcef665851c17e8ea5"}

{"id": "p_fb0b014df4168a2c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 26, "text": "方今雖擾攘，難以禮化，然在吾所以為之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "ff2e8c0ae2ca656be59ce597ac8a6330322b2a1df112bacf7d685f695668669d"}

{"id": "p_6185fa7efc5c25e5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」為政崇教訓，恕思而後行，外溫柔而內能斷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "bd433727341f5a283d73d1eb0e84b5a8f1b2573ecd8618597704b31b074102ab"}

{"id": "p_6de34c66f4bb7fda", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 28, "text": "後徵為諫議大夫、丞相軍祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "e36e24711de3433d0a9f1a8a200f8d578bb5048c38fb43fa73b6fbeab2a2fc5f"}

{"id": "p_950f22ef868e04e8", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 29, "text": "前後得賜甚多，皆散盡之，家無所儲，終不問產業，乏則取之於人，不為皦察之行，然時人服其清。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "e0a46db96724dc4111e224f3a212c92ec9a393fe3a0724fdcf3e1b2ede6a4b26"}

{"id": "p_444bb0b3943bccd0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 30, "text": "魏國初建，為郎中令，行御史大夫事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "df34cd15721634ca2d6c543ef3da99c6db627a1b686aaf6d85088ff6eb186270"}

{"id": "p_6690a7c86839f8a6", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 31, "text": "渙言於太祖曰：「今天下大難已除，文武並用，長久之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "d1f3c24c0e38d74a7b27d7006434c624ca396baa4708f30a173eac4c5e4e9c9f"}

{"id": "p_32f35396322ec920", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 32, "text": "以為可大收篇籍，明先聖之教，以易民視聽，使海內斐然向風，則遠人不服可以文德來之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "30f48cb1242c978997007472b99f69850b21ad80d94fa8773ce632c582dc51e6"}

{"id": "p_4bb0b51072f8350e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 33, "text": "時有傳劉備死者，羣臣皆賀；渙以甞為備舉吏，獨不賀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "619e5024a62a61b03331055bdd74d2947169872e40b14f9ea41fdd2f075a8e89"}

{"id": "p_e542f37c3102ba97", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 34, "text": "居官數年卒，太祖為之流涕，賜穀二千斛，一教「以太倉穀千斛賜郎中令之家」，一教「以垣下穀千斛與曜卿家」，外不解其意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "bd3d6dafccce0ecccd7fccb5a2d5baa56d1339f4a28d4fda40e02f72212cb7b2"}

{"id": "p_de1aebcf9c75b7c3", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 35, "text": "教曰：「以太倉穀者，官法也；以垣下穀者，親舊也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "8fe397be93aba6f4f01a9eda772ebda342de0d387b517cc6a11265f942f8f060"}

{"id": "p_5dbe847936f560ec", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 36, "text": "」又帝聞渙昔拒呂布之事，問渙從弟敏：「渙勇怯何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "7039cae35d9004710c5ac7ec98ffee241817f3d7425005c8db4d61ae51efbbf5"}

{"id": "p_07493d833c3dae18", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」敏對曰：「渙貌似和柔，然其臨大節，處危難，雖賁、育不過也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "86b85789dc93b077041defc739d1665290c68c88619383df052cbd0e1897ce64"}

{"id": "p_12bd39f57b083d16", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」渙子侃，亦清粹閑素，有父風，歷位郡守尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "64f3ddf53024fe0f7842981a6c10b20ef0eb3a977c5e2a851a1def5c2fb9620e"}

{"id": "p_b94275370d38a148", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 39, "text": "初，渙從弟霸，公恪有功幹，魏初為大司農，及同郡何夔並知名於時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "3893316658067945fe0e38e3128d47ebd210708daaa280ec93e98f7926145dd9"}

{"id": "p_abada489ef220c12", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 40, "text": "而霸子亮，夔子曾，與侃復齊聲友善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "0691518ce2d13b069ae68f21430cfe9d2878374eafbbdb8785e4b877daac1cff"}

{"id": "p_c9bad0dc483fb737", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 41, "text": "亮貞固有學行，疾何晏、鄧颺等，著論以譏切之，位至河南尹、尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "edd09bd5f61ae4932f612c4d45f348ba5f4b8ac3d25d590f171949c9b0b8b3fa"}

{"id": "p_8201defc088a944d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 42, "text": "徽弟敏，有武藝而好水功，官至河隄謁者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "ef588156758159dc636246174b272c60942b5b2a72b320286d6a2deeee566fa9"}

{"id": "p_9113e87214f755f1", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 43, "text": "張範，字公儀，河內脩武人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "b9aefd0b5f95e33b5e804fa7efc4ea4f63ea129f0b07ac7d743aabbe4033102b"}

{"id": "p_25fee94566f68932", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 44, "text": "太傅袁隗欲以女妻範，範辭不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "5b67d1be6aae2ece78f42985f36fdf1dbf5b084f964f5ef1dbf1c713484e79fe"}

{"id": "p_27f4e3f7ae2981aa", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 45, "text": "性恬靜樂道，忽於榮利，徵命無所就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "a56f6a3b0bcab278c47492537d2c6d3ddf5d1b8e4a604a32e630d592560f7a6d"}

{"id": "p_c384fb8f3760e0c2", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 46, "text": "弟承，字公先，亦知名，以方正徵，拜議郎，遷伊闕都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "bca82fb44bad37a2467e7b67b5c3801058ed2983afc4fbc854deaff3f0dafd48"}

{"id": "p_c5d19232cab4d2ec", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 47, "text": "董卓作亂，承欲合徒衆與天下共誅卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "bb2e89aa5a7cb916ce53e845f5ac0ce95dcee1362c82b426dd8452d6e81702fa"}

{"id": "p_357bf3ae291f306e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 48, "text": "承弟昭時為議郎，適從長安來，謂承曰：「今欲誅卓，衆寡不敵，且起一朝之謀，戰阡陌之民，士不素撫，兵不練習，難以成功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "09f1270993d50e744afe00fdca35dbfd6566703482f24eb1dd5a71a109f5fc88"}

{"id": "p_1eab0a414913f7c5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 49, "text": "卓阻兵而無義，固不能久；不若擇所歸附，待時而動，然後可以如志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "b1bad22548f1df269540378913a7a45c730a1eb9cd052a541e6512532f18963b"}

{"id": "p_2c841ddc0b4a00d0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」承然之，乃解印綬間行歸家，與範避地揚州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "aaf268453a21528f9c910bde37e29eefb49ed78ec12a2c27e2028a4f67295548"}

{"id": "p_8b108a42b0bcfc57", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 51, "text": "袁術備禮招請，範稱疾不往，術不彊屈也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "5e984747f1509f12f01c1050010c31b32e1fa656fa88aebeb3433d8ec0c378a3"}

{"id": "p_2d1a393ea54e892d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 52, "text": "遣承與相見，術問曰：「昔周室陵遲，則有桓、文之霸；秦失其政，漢接而用之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "c6fcf5b48e891805b806696b30ec79304b2d9d07777d24d6400098c814233953"}

{"id": "p_ee5876c60c1195f9", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 53, "text": "今孤以土地之廣，士民之衆，欲徼福齊桓，擬迹高祖，何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "a74dcd23f71b48482ef6a97d41cbeb273fb4382c62a855898978d39e70b4edd1"}

{"id": "p_fc4f3f015f8ffda8", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 54, "text": "」承對曰：「在德不在彊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "08908d259e69ca6d14857d1a2f30986aa6175e0da5b019d95c398237c360b593"}

{"id": "p_cbf2550b93635aae", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 55, "text": "夫能用德以同天下之欲，雖由匹夫之資，而興霸王之功，不足為難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "4bb3408e0517387e37b8e0fb617478ee752e3ec6db6bff50f7eb3a8fad538011"}

{"id": "p_6cbf34efcee0c01b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 56, "text": "若苟僭擬，干時而動，衆之所棄，誰能興之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "d8e311223b7053e03887da8ecd214fb45432021e445e2ca0f34c301945fc1c3d"}

{"id": "p_6bcabeb9b98bf26f", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 57, "text": "是時，太祖將征冀州，術復問曰：「今曹公欲以弊兵數千，敵十萬之衆，可謂不量力矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "9211ebbe03b340b24a6e3c9c79d148676d7045e0e8d9c8f0ed9a3800007a738c"}

{"id": "p_415a2c803cdf163c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」承乃曰：「漢德雖衰，天命未改，今曹公挾天子以令天下，雖敵百萬之衆可也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "3956ad6e9d64654cfdf0766c7238c6c5d381d536f11a9dd2db545300b814e295"}

{"id": "p_9e4ad529ddb6ed9e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 59, "text": "範以疾留彭城，遣承詣太祖，太祖表以為諫議大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "f23e649e57708ac1996aa5111ada4f88f401449a2504923c9ad340be4e41bb3b"}

{"id": "p_1a15e38e835125a5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 60, "text": "範子陵及承子戩為山東賊所得，範直詣賊請二子，賊以陵還範。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "4c926fd15d30f1e7083e6e99f70c0c2efa92866f45d2d95180ea3e374a929317"}

{"id": "p_e66ca978a4df298a", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 61, "text": "範謝曰：「諸君相還兒厚矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "63a82ccaf4559103a6e312dd978dae755656970779569e32af9a8caade820037"}

{"id": "p_4f707b91af4fcc7a", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 62, "text": "夫人情雖愛其子，然吾憐戩之小，請以陵易之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "b3609b1ec3f5fb31352afb773be1bc6bc079041fb914850e7e7a24093a6d1d8f"}

{"id": "p_7d90b0d21a10fc36", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 63, "text": "太祖自荊州還，範得見於陳，以為議郎，參丞相軍事，甚見敬重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "9aa8d0f819f5862b03aca95083be5e4bb82659d1e70d4b71d2acc2fba513a0b2"}

{"id": "p_e1bb1a132394220e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 64, "text": "太祖征伐，常令範及邴原留，與世子居守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "aea11eaf731d08e03baafb84c0ce303a9de90b0de0c1d0d66d9ca704a0cdfd06"}

{"id": "p_45582934507655aa", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 65, "text": "太祖謂文帝：「舉動必諮此二人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "d7fb01aea664e1f20894c62248982f2d92f9972554c53716a21b2a3ba94fb26b"}

{"id": "p_9b89948121d3edf0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 66, "text": "救恤窮乏，家無所餘，中外孤寡皆歸焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "34299a83c448e9897348997b9d04d0d6ea62b889bf75f68f486f2113ab4c0fed"}

{"id": "p_afa6f76f4a4ff931", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 67, "text": "贈遺無所逆，亦終不用，及去，皆以還之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "d8ed16a3ccd7852cc4797435a779a60e06410d79abd2e5e2d55584d6f46d4d11"}

{"id": "p_cf2fc5a8073ce89d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 68, "text": "魏國初建，承以丞相參軍祭酒領趙郡太守，政化大行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "3aad58e7c42cf332f6fc59c0dae3880f5cb936bee94e215be1ddc579dc062b47"}

{"id": "p_c40d5e4ed9d926e5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 69, "text": "太祖將西征，徵承參軍事，至長安，病卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "944c44d17a06a5837fc9915a4a0116a6bddc6d28801f0f904de868b63c10fd97"}

{"id": "p_df9320f3c90f6e40", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 70, "text": "涼茂字伯方，山陽昌邑人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "c242c50bd838f01b84ee3a5fe0e8a4422474655d7c37f26fe930cf3d2d0e4beb"}

{"id": "p_2649e0caa9902242", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 71, "text": "少好學，論議常據經典，以處是非。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "20d90d8ccb020c8fe3de5ad6f5015419779c070b8e9ccca72434bc3608839842"}

{"id": "p_ee602db02c0cf53d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 72, "text": "太祖辟為司空掾，舉高第，補侍御史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "9327edb0386bc330a2e56dbdde1391d0761b15da173e6a01cfa3e6aa69de1af5"}

{"id": "p_12f5bf2c19f23b54", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 73, "text": "時泰山多盜賊，以茂為泰山太守，旬月之閒，襁負而至者千餘家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "1767ad5839d1bd82e124502f58ef13f3c1afad29d98bd892287a739d1d80133a"}

{"id": "p_4296a90f57a902eb", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 74, "text": "公孫度在遼東，擅留茂，不遣之官，然茂終不為屈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "86fcf9c7dd5105225c84f68a66e1ebbb4eae820a5f43511115ee3e802679897e"}

{"id": "p_c738b86e64069971", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 75, "text": "度謂茂及諸將曰：「聞曹公遠征，鄴無守備，今吾欲以步卒三萬，騎萬匹，直指鄴，誰能禦之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "c81801cefe0cfd5d345ac91b65341cf82603386db8958e62c53db9c88af7e11b"}

{"id": "p_1d246a07f496bce7", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 76, "text": "」又顧謂茂曰：「於君意何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "b6e67bea087df6a232e79f34851fd4b56905f4bc39bbc010d59eeedb3b44c145"}

{"id": "p_b5aaa20cbd5bac04", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」茂荅曰：「比者海內大亂，社稷將傾，將軍擁十萬之衆，安坐而觀成敗，夫為人臣者，固若是邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "188148bc63f7c5ece25fb20c4e14acd63696a30a60719ce5172b936f21b32453"}

{"id": "p_01057b8d1d28e18a", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 78, "text": "曹公憂國家之危敗，愍百姓之苦毒，率義兵為天下誅殘賊，功高而德廣，可謂無二矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "36058c2ccbdb48cce7beff168aeb2f81a8c2c6304ba0e3e05e1792259d116fff"}

{"id": "p_eb44e79b13e6c358", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 79, "text": "以海內初定，民始安集，故未責將軍之罪耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "d80ef56c0548f9e1ec3a68f4499923f801de51d7a076ef87a8570923d6186a85"}

{"id": "p_1a0aea55372d3d14", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 80, "text": "而將軍乃欲稱兵西向，則存亡之效，不崇朝而決。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "10c40e75b911a398ef835eb075d48aba28d7adb1eb748ce51e161e85d9839d52"}

{"id": "p_bea095b132b25681", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 81, "text": "良久，度曰：「涼君言是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "4b43588a8f9da1bd8720ed6607e731f97eeef7dac43f767e022ff4c0632dd48a"}

{"id": "p_20d331d9eedffef8", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 82, "text": "」後徵遷為魏郡太守、甘陵相，所在有績。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "c5791161a3602b1e4b36d8162f7dc9909339fbb2473aaa802b0c4df81861d992"}

{"id": "p_384731c454b9e856", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 83, "text": "文帝為五官將，茂以選為長史，遷左軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "a9ca5ff66dbcdae37745641e90906b4d9160eb82721c1998c64dd0501931445c"}

{"id": "p_f7cecd4626d1ff63", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 84, "text": "魏國初建，遷尚書僕射，後為中尉奉常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "904e1db9fe0fa6e361abe2cee2d45870994404a82b972298da9d703cadd90c93"}

{"id": "p_8891a4db2ede77bf", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 85, "text": "文帝在東宮，茂復為太子太傅，甚見敬禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "b9b0d682661589b15df6de69b08077e41dd3c67315e3fca800a84af5bd731b2e"}

{"id": "p_d57dff637af19f8d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 86, "text": "國淵字子尼，樂安蓋人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "7910ed2824fe820aa2e1cd02f63d65f5d0687cfb6bcdba94e8252ab99b000372"}

{"id": "p_bd6f778077bdbd78", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 87, "text": "後與邴原、管寧等避亂遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "a99193d814c6c28a2b29595de9bf35591a88201ad23ce5773f69612dcf2846d9"}

{"id": "p_3b302f4253bd0b10", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 88, "text": "旣還舊土，太祖辟為司空掾屬，每於公朝論議，常直言正色，退無私焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "c2069ff0b26fb35b1a7506975a5e4fff6349a476fbfc75a8402df5a8a3d670aa"}

{"id": "p_f9b8d6604f81c0e1", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 89, "text": "太祖欲廣置屯田，使淵典其事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "ff261cc4dc69184bde957ccfefaaec6a35094d53798561ad5607359bcdf2e3ce"}

{"id": "p_319d9919136152a2", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 90, "text": "淵屢陳損益，相土處民，計民置吏，明功課之法，五年中倉廩豐實，百姓競勸樂業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "0dad5710b3f25278b6e46be47955d90d8b5622132ee9b7b8a4ef6501d2dcb6f3"}

{"id": "p_20473b0065c5187d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 91, "text": "太祖征關中，以淵為居府長史，統留事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "c2f947c3c260320dd293ddd8de9062e04b0665c1574f1ad9b8097c7e08a18b51"}

{"id": "p_1735810caecc1644", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 92, "text": "田銀、蘇伯反河閒，銀等旣破，後有餘黨，皆應伏法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "f19cfe9ac8b0d9ac7e6723aad961f1dbe0c3016b96f256faca9e5a5bde187547"}

{"id": "p_663f9a099068732a", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 93, "text": "淵以為非首惡，請不行刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "ffc22bb14cd437fd5ba3fde3e75f2206c4d787841bcb03705e66edc999585a32"}

{"id": "p_d736a563ac63bdee", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 94, "text": "太祖從之，賴淵得生者千餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "bb0dd563fd8e17cacba1a2033f1cec19731b7c72f29b0feb612741ebe7e524e3"}

{"id": "p_2f81dd8335f5e142", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 95, "text": "破賊文書，舊以一為十，及淵上首級，如其實數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "c0851eeed10b0cf18eb6fec1c3eeea3c45cdc33b39d721f13460330686b0330d"}

{"id": "p_54176898db9dc134", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 96, "text": "太祖問其故，淵曰：「夫征討外寇，多其斬獲之數者，欲以大武功，且示民聽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "ed06d2ae3cdc5158de4e02e8041ec46a1aa0d3e571a1c46da52715d9e3bab47a"}

{"id": "p_a5552d4a126c140c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 97, "text": "河閒在封域之內，銀等叛逆，雖克捷有功，淵竊恥之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "d46468694a1abe42b2be2e1280a54cef7572e447b4b2a4ff6a4cf492efa3c412"}

{"id": "p_cac5e84e0ba039f9", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」太祖大恱，遷魏郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "73b049f50745da11f9b60017f50a79398296c82a837f593738bba4f5e3801cb9"}

{"id": "p_5a932594153a65a0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 99, "text": "時有投書誹謗者，太祖疾之，欲必知其主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "849f8ebadafd04bda2da532569d7c18345f2f4f21d14ddcf0790980c4688ece4"}

{"id": "p_754e94cde38aa6da", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 100, "text": "淵請留其本書，而不宣露。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "53afed4bc0f501d5e65b2bf5e7a98c57f9d382423ca2a2bd190c0ebb1e31e939"}

{"id": "p_631bcd75358af716", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 101, "text": "其書多引二京賦，淵勑功曹曰：「此郡旣大，今在都輦，而少學問者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "3123b4defea90ddfde8777c92b980101eeacd2013827488eab561704c75d16c3"}

{"id": "p_400dbf04bd4b581f", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 102, "text": "其簡開解年少，欲遣就師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "c5acbca4a70c0af3566f14dbfb3fa252402eff329fdee1445bdc9cd3c9a698b3"}

{"id": "p_09add48a95c03b86", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 103, "text": "」功曹差三人，臨遣引見，訓以「所學未及，二京賦，博物之書也，世人忽略，少有其師，可求能讀者從受之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "0a86cf40e59c02ea622c1547e0f9888b005d9a354e41d7bc21a58e45fb671dcd"}

{"id": "p_5f14a4fb0b8d9e34", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 104, "text": "旬日得能讀者，遂往受業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "731fa66207f2240a757ce0e78a4af69d4527774a54ca200c6ba27f123a3c9bac"}

{"id": "p_605b48a758ba85fe", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 105, "text": "吏因請使作箋，比方其書，與投書人同手。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "852e056c4c5c8f1f616e5fd221d50c204738804d4c2434be8eac8e61ab4ce573"}

{"id": "p_f3e5b215abc25d05", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 106, "text": "居列卿位，布衣蔬食，祿賜散之舊故宗族，以恭儉自守，卒官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "6cf4b3610797be92b5ceaeb7794e842f10388ca0659a1870d0eb28064ce29845"}

{"id": "p_5d03a2b0c9436ebb", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 107, "text": "田疇字子泰，右北平無終人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "16276b1ae5268ac12e2d5ea03b24b261801c7c63ee5f1e47ef69ae947ce17ee5"}

{"id": "p_4b6124b77399558e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 108, "text": "，義兵起，董卓遷帝于長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "c6e74f85975414ba337cb4d5fb828f4f69a50f76571ef6cb77aac018eebfa85c"}

{"id": "p_e144ad8ac5c0c0c7", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 109, "text": "幽州牧劉虞歎曰：「賊臣作亂，朝廷播蕩，四海俄然，莫有固志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "01fe6ee883e8e52899dd64c07ba480e7e67010e6164b1c512561eaa215c9f0cc"}

{"id": "p_e248b6b6ca74c15b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 110, "text": "身備宗室遺老，不得自同於衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "c1d2b594115f80a919814215cf78b795732a5c2e8d1945aefa0346a21580b4f0"}

{"id": "p_7cd449ceb33aa4a9", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 111, "text": "今欲奉使展效臣節，安得不辱命之士乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "c0349ea5ca030ffb60ee98c957633ffb2964ec0779605864e5cbd5919e9f0277"}

{"id": "p_2bc99996617b94a0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 112, "text": "」衆議咸曰：「田疇雖年少，多稱其奇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "59c290a8af54e5869b2adf6d5b65d275a9e2512c36dbea0024e73c2f88665b1b"}

{"id": "p_2ca62daeb8315984", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 113, "text": "虞乃備禮請與相見，大恱之，遂署為從事，具其車騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "b440796c026436180c6b3e99e32210ed3ab318d42a983c51b92bbe2c8c044c56"}

{"id": "p_9175b8397212760c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 114, "text": "將行，疇曰：「今道路阻絕，寇虜縱橫，稱官奉使，為衆所指名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "0e63dd8045211ce3adc3bb9471675d2eeef7b07c83fde787736b9299a052a1f4"}
