{"id": "p_2e944dbdf3b7e0b2", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 115, "text": "願以私行，期於得達而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "9f3e30369ba0a8c3ef28b2a45712a5370d17baddfceffd4f53862f28be5cc8f6"}

{"id": "p_c4bc7509f193d2a4", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 116, "text": "疇乃歸，自選其家客與年少之勇壯慕從者二十騎俱往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "830f5ccaa19713f0d44ab8118917fdf5127fad65d2d619f90c2080df8b787434"}

{"id": "p_914d0c989e85ca5e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 117, "text": "旣取道，疇乃更上西關，出塞，傍北方，直趣朔方，循閒徑去，遂至長安致命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "cbf7019ebf9533eedbeb32e4d20fd312661db0e6f9c349d4ec5adf2399ede184"}

{"id": "p_c354a3a1eb5bcc59", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 118, "text": "疇以為天子方蒙塵未安，不可以荷佩榮寵，固辭不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "3f03f6b646c8db7dcd54c67bd41734e9b6aa435f13077ffd9871f927ee78eb43"}

{"id": "p_95409eac4f122f76", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 119, "text": "得報，馳還，未至，虞已為公孫瓚所害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "3551565f4b6159a4fefeabe94cdb78c8bb087720e659cedc2321cbefc144b36f"}

{"id": "p_a7f3475b42ac5179", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 120, "text": "疇至，謁祭虞墓，陳發章表，哭泣而去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "8cab00725190c23548ed512c297361a3d72ef4dadfea41c80e09bcd6d6f5211a"}

{"id": "p_245aef3ce6106dbe", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 121, "text": "瓚聞之大怒，購求獲疇，謂曰：「汝何自哭劉虞墓，而不送章報於我也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "19cb6f50a58d655fdc1bde3d7895d16c972e3d2a78b2e6b2add91fb8f4aad600"}

{"id": "p_efc4413b4047a4c6", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 122, "text": "」疇荅曰：「漢室衰穨，人懷異心，唯劉公不失忠節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "9d0d807d4990b80c78c94a7c8a51d4b4d7b81aec22aff6f264734c6770ea0933"}

{"id": "p_bab3155a58e74639", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 123, "text": "章報所言，於將軍未美，恐非所樂聞，故不進也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "68bb53257a7a48c0fb50d275c171db94c2bbe0181c62b28d6be2dd67e4ed3db3"}

{"id": "p_5505c1a3327d5268", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 124, "text": "且將軍方舉大事以求所欲，旣滅無罪之君，又讎守義之臣，誠行此事，則燕、趙之士將皆蹈東海而死耳，豈忍有從將軍者乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "b9dfc4e6e9dd316b5ab466012af3285cfab685df0e0e944122cb1f929ef8d471"}

{"id": "p_293f49635803411f", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 125, "text": "拘之軍下，禁其故人莫得與通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "e3f225bcd1445b0d40bbd73ec8bbd5445b5d70e7092b91a1a4270c6d0fb79506"}

{"id": "p_503efcfab3edf7f4", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 126, "text": "或說瓚曰：「田疇義士，君弗能禮，而又囚之，恐失衆心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "019c29b1aba5e14f11bfff9c8b0b2a7df19e524178dca0f3304bcd3c8a8ac288"}

{"id": "p_c1540a67e3e86667", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 127, "text": "疇得北歸，率舉宗族他附從數百人，埽地而盟曰：「君仇不報，吾不可以立於世！", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "db24e29bbf4b34ba9c00147ce74bce2fdd42b61152b351f33dbd8bdb70f41fe4"}

{"id": "p_d5e48b23037aa375", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 128, "text": "」遂入徐無山中，營深險平敞地而居，躬耕以養父母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "6bd60b98d8b3e4c45b9c4fdac22b6c8d48c0ec98ffd1b9185bac48e01cda9811"}

{"id": "p_9a6345a4ec5d5566", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 129, "text": "百姓歸之，數年閒至五千餘家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "ab4f6fae94e5b0e9763634e97805ea5792037c74514f13f88fb78b907b90c3b0"}

{"id": "p_a8da4058eacc269a", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 130, "text": "疇謂其父老曰：「諸君不以疇不肖，遠來相就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "96852d86529200d879cf92d37b2df0cbd135f71f030a4b108b5da4abadb5b0d4"}

{"id": "p_de87129fcf707e5c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 131, "text": "衆成都邑，而莫相統一，恐非久安之道，願推擇其賢長者以為之主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "1fd73dba9f5c554b15470bd074e8c47925e0650a846de59ab761e357fd71e837"}

{"id": "p_c2842b15d11547f1", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 132, "text": "疇曰：「今來在此，非苟安而已，將圖大事，復怨雪恥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "44933f5b65b743c0ffa91617efca5041af62837a0be524616467d988896780a1"}

{"id": "p_1f1636895e5207dd", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 133, "text": "竊恐未得其志，而輕薄之徒自相侵侮，偷快一時，無深計遠慮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "27a804c0fb9b083074efe158f6ef626bd68480c69a36d5e6bdac6abda5988058"}

{"id": "p_6f0cb98d8a39638b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 134, "text": "疇有愚計，願與諸君共施之，可乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "2eed4e31b7d60f78d4a372abe28c90292c23431ca997fdf0f7f41de85c6a090e"}

{"id": "p_d63da7c7a861eddd", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 135, "text": "」疇乃為約束相殺傷、犯盜、諍訟之法，法重者至死，其次抵罪，二十餘條。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "7fd32b878d48aed3e4966dba7514a464ff3e52b37f2b4c97eef3fe72c94e9e06"}

{"id": "p_bbb9d74cebf653fc", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 136, "text": "又制為婚姻嫁娶之禮，興舉學校講授之業，班行其衆，衆皆便之，至道不拾遺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "0c91144f61d330b3b8f05e9d20a229cb53e8c90d0265b850b69f2090d50b0413"}

{"id": "p_028a31ae506e4dfc", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 137, "text": "北邊翕然服其威信，烏丸、鮮卑並各遣譯使致貢遺，疇悉撫納，令不為寇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "e2d7ffa13790c0302c3fdb4291b416440de3d6ea3514450f081d5ff67d3f7498"}

{"id": "p_9816a737fa47f02b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 138, "text": "袁紹數遣使招命，又即授將軍印，因安輯所統，疇皆拒不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "2f6f55c1aad7d0493b64e70103fb26941cece6ae296a7b8c1990e381536caa37"}

{"id": "p_abdd5cacaa988d04", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 139, "text": "紹死，其子尚又辟焉，疇終不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "427d689f1cb045db85df17bf4ab3b8a4db32de16c0ed391c6a414b6ee03fee65"}

{"id": "p_33d2f4617be68ba0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 140, "text": "疇常忿烏丸昔多賊殺其郡冠蓋，有欲討之意而力未能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "1e4112e8b4c07387c97eef4d8c2d31d47b9d1682db5fa873fa4913c71108f092"}

{"id": "p_3d92173d39e7d3cf", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 141, "text": "，太祖北征烏丸，未至，先遣使辟疇，又命田預喻指。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "5a574cef3cb74ed37d011bc4b136438e60068482d96e240c38792a9fe7d2bee3"}

{"id": "p_4df383e82b25be91", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 142, "text": "門人謂曰：「昔袁公慕君，禮命五至，君義不屈；今曹公使一來而君若恐弗及者，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "799f22d4491f5751ff5e8db8e2f7640a89277d0b6f7c6ab78afb2e550f6cedb9"}

{"id": "p_3ec2d949b52bedf8", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 143, "text": "」疇笑而應之曰：「此非君所識也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "7026f509a992e4ab4790948a36d551f342f3c2f64f071ffbbeb8313abdbf66d3"}

{"id": "p_4690ef88b3105ee5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」遂隨使者到軍，署司空戶曹掾，引見諮議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "5bf41de2ff7e01e0944a3e2b0349e73ebf69c82f29f2e93d2111ae423df90647"}

{"id": "p_9df9aee80b3496f8", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 145, "text": "明日出令曰：「田子泰非吾所宜吏者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "7e0fb77a1820707d04f770fe15eb20c4ef67c53f4a4d961d9c4465c47b8d7d32"}

{"id": "p_c5f0c69e0ec262f4", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」即舉茂才，拜為蓨令，不之官，隨軍次無終。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "e84d2bea95b9c42ea755bfaf0df0cb406a9c9349f2aae73c018fa20f78a07c23"}

{"id": "p_afd7f397e53e9d2d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 147, "text": "時方夏水雨，而濵海洿下，濘滯不通，虜亦遮守蹊要，軍不得進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "9f98fcbfcd9fa8d9bb7ef3f93b160672690f8376a1c7a72fe1c14272ae335275"}

{"id": "p_e3d514c1b421d5f3", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 148, "text": "疇曰：「此道，秋夏每常有水，淺不通車馬，深不載舟船，為難久矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "d7ae2ed15e5699f45fe42ae191184ebf6506271dbef2b1f756bf4e4e270b65ca"}

{"id": "p_fe1b3cb4b4bc6a3c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 149, "text": "舊北平郡治在平岡，道出盧龍，達于柳城；自建武以來，陷壞斷絕，垂二百載，而尚有微徑可從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "aa96cff18591f6c88a21ac3ffbeb0c572d1ce229b8c9ea58a586b8802c3aee49"}

{"id": "p_9c9ebfb0bfbea54d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 150, "text": "今虜將以大軍當由無終，不得進而退，懈弛無備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "540b4aae845cbf82ad0b201a6d9f8c657a5fb038b910c664faf5c430d9ddd189"}

{"id": "p_b593da9313fd405b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 151, "text": "若嘿回軍，從盧龍口越白檀之險，出空虛之地，路近而便，掩其不備，蹋頓之首可不戰而禽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "decdaf1c4aead82434bb382147d8d52d8bd8b64f8b986b29cec007a0559dbd0c"}

{"id": "p_aeeb24522cbb1c36", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 152, "text": "」乃引軍還，而署大木表於水側路傍曰：「方今暑夏，道路不通，且俟秋冬，乃復進軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "bd1de0ee6b34952e248d6754bc5a4634412662d0a3b2c636c3151520a94d2afb"}

{"id": "p_0665b41920e7038b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 153, "text": "」虜候騎見之，誠以為大軍去也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "a5a2f69ea9f149798c481ef5b2597b1ffcc6afdeb25c91aa44d816445e8bf60c"}

{"id": "p_c9bc749f87cb437e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 154, "text": "太祖令疇將其衆為鄉導，上徐無山，出盧龍，歷平岡，登白狼堆，去柳城二百餘里，虜乃驚覺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "5d55b9b4234c0e01a1c9a365c1248bf74083db89e7a5dfcc93757ff8f01153c8"}

{"id": "p_1400596ee21a8ef1", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 155, "text": "單于身自臨陣，太祖與交戰，遂大斬獲，追奔逐北，至柳城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "abc6c1f1e51dbe7799d7bae0e772b371fd83d90667692bbefc095c3e14b972d6"}

{"id": "p_74aabe547f13f426", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 156, "text": "軍還入塞，論功行封，封疇亭侯，邑五百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "0e2ed896fec978e356895a760107d3fbe08eb6bdfa5a42b91cb08344a5f132de"}

{"id": "p_73dca30b8bc7fad1", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 157, "text": "疇自以始為居難，率衆循逃，志義不立，反以為利，非本意也，固讓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "99307721d4245c49bcc8ec92447b99ded875eba14e058d5902439144a9be22ab"}

{"id": "p_d95ce260a2b780c3", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 158, "text": "太祖知其至心，許而不奪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "7709b78bb783a8434beca6972dc56cbb29e78e74840da8b3348d579e2b764007"}

{"id": "p_dd1672b22db75130", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 159, "text": "遼東斬送袁尚首，令「三軍敢有哭之者斬」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "de1a036b887bafdcce51321fba1a580990b04d71134e8090870274ce9abb4eaf"}

{"id": "p_f5cbde2498450023", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 160, "text": "疇以甞為尚所辟，乃往弔祭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "178154f1bcc132d7b59b76799e3925452681ee5094c965809eb574b162c366e5"}

{"id": "p_99dface07081a7c3", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 161, "text": "疇盡將其家屬及宗人三百餘家居鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "524e7fdd949750c856aa2a3f7e72dacba66963632cd939dd2df33ffdaf079a79"}

{"id": "p_75e34613d5272d8e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 162, "text": "太祖賜疇車馬穀帛，皆散之宗族知舊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "0f854d7ceb66dd51c3047261c516eb8235f7f2d43db9f27da8ea1246aeb060d0"}

{"id": "p_35279c0ee1e870c0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 163, "text": "從征荊州還，太祖追念疇功殊美，恨前聽疇之讓，曰：「是成一人之志，而虧王法大制也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "f073dfd448bbfb194ef5b9a75ac6dd5086b03fa4f8a14f51949c1b9c41bc9e8c"}

{"id": "p_843a98ecbd763f96", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 164, "text": "太祖不聽，欲引拜之，至于數四，終不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "a3e214b42602cfb8849ca36c05746f43c4e741234099d5354c4e124da3308f84"}

{"id": "p_420dce6820d4d734", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 165, "text": "有司劾疇狷介違道，苟立小節，宜免官加刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "6d7289bc8293cad44f60bf21913387fc103bc423c65d1c1af4b592570ababd64"}

{"id": "p_889ea34cfdfce61e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 166, "text": "太祖重其事，依違者久之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "eb6e62adf828c202dbedc526ba7b277c88237785df9bb0a74bcf131c76cfd3da"}

{"id": "p_47e07cd0a217f03f", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 167, "text": "乃下世子及大臣博議，世子以疇同於子文辭祿，申胥逃賞，宜勿奪以優其節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "b332f55f017919b2fd6fdb9fd6a301721d1f435d42e397277a02e4d793f4cee5"}

{"id": "p_e4e2a0055bd53f24", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 168, "text": "尚書令荀彧、司隷校尉鍾繇亦以為可聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "23cc10fbd5f5b38e348aa087fcf63122034c522b59f1c6ecf4e84e03a956dba0"}

{"id": "p_75a3e7468e726756", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 169, "text": "疇素與夏侯惇善，太祖語惇曰：「且往以情喻之，自從君所言，無告吾意也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "90203df866b91aaf97c328346cd6e608b3094753bc518368b35bf5cc18d8fcfc"}

{"id": "p_b516cb69fa571ab0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 170, "text": "」惇就疇宿，如太祖所戒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "a4ad5a3fb71bcb01ce7a55ecb19e107eb0a0d58d7f17d99bada165717160f21a"}

{"id": "p_b34b21635ff653ca", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 171, "text": "惇臨去，乃拊疇背曰：「田君，主意殷勤，曾不能顧乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "f0a58d506245dc9b603bc05ea9ed1a4eb6972cb06300a3fb07365ddf82d7456c"}

{"id": "p_1b188e883863a0fa", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 172, "text": "」疇荅曰：「是何言之過也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "83ef085b7da619834b7b4a47924bb71b294f87803972eba5c53a5244fd1fded5"}

{"id": "p_484d0e6fbcc53821", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 173, "text": "疇，負義逃竄之人耳，蒙恩全活，為幸多矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "ad9db9e8bbdbb03666eda4ea04185280afab41016b3b491813126b80de224807"}

{"id": "p_13b18f5dc9969825", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 174, "text": "豈可賣盧龍之塞，以易賞祿哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "88bdded98ab190c533fc0575ca10cb4cff84eca7a683762b5abe06e3315e0194"}

{"id": "p_0b350a36c7c95352", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 175, "text": "縱國私疇，疇獨不愧於心乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "83ee063009c7a4b3a53f275821e282a37b160386a1fdf0cdcf6964726537d8ea"}

{"id": "p_19e7d5cd2f466cf4", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 176, "text": "將軍雅知疇者，猶復如此，若必不得已，請願效死刎首於前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "627f3f3da821666b3d84ed93a3021afbd82fd9d5b4efa5b8dc9706db55274011"}

{"id": "p_bf250c8512a538a5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 177, "text": "太祖喟然知不可屈，乃拜為議郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "6833433e72adb818dadbd7cf9497fa05e6eddc8a71c6971b3ee5ca88d321ef2f"}

{"id": "p_d90e0d8148524222", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 178, "text": "文帝踐阼，高疇德義，賜疇從孫續爵關內侯，以奉其嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "e6a9f3c10fcb18454a407bedc34ef26c0b8eb142a49898630587e35a5d37a993"}

{"id": "p_bdf94b1a5ca4ee87", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 179, "text": "王脩字叔治，北海營陵人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "e6aadb321b010b3aabaebc182ab3a11a9013361821af5bba135e5c0cc698df9e"}

{"id": "p_237ac57b2867a377", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 180, "text": "母以社日亡，來歲鄰里社，脩感念母，哀甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "b3ed904107c51db29e77a6908c27238d3e1fef92f0f18060536cc27ff4c56b92"}

{"id": "p_9893e31d96fcd033", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 181, "text": "年二十，游學南陽，止張奉舍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "43c755c584e332ccacb0aed1f47b801abc3cbb6373a37b8ef5a9c40ca7cf4922"}

{"id": "p_aed0d50e474bc104", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 182, "text": "奉舉家得疾病，無相視者，脩親隱恤之，病愈乃去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "e870199a13d02d24703685dcb92c2026ed97267936029909ecc33d2651e9a658"}

{"id": "p_77e7d4c917c0afb6", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 183, "text": "初平中，北海孔融召以為主簿，守高密令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "7b8d938233d2edb3903e74395f452b740b9a92d2c828332ae07e0a78bde7496c"}

{"id": "p_eb52b26f2d9dc7eb", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 184, "text": "高密孫氏素豪俠，人客數犯法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "97057b720b9f1ba1f5e2e3749e9433c78e1710c24c3280f86e53e2b19a28b73d"}

{"id": "p_7af1b3ddcb10e7ca", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 185, "text": "民有相劫者，賊入孫氏，吏不能執。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "34b1260b2fbc1c040ba73fd20369226daacdcc359b7a44260c20d5367fc1bf5f"}

{"id": "p_a12d1a095689aaa9", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 186, "text": "脩將吏民圍之，孫氏拒守，吏民畏憚不敢近。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "3ac901269b2038d2888b09ee72d23ab208f6c761a91009b67c7dfe3408fa5aae"}

{"id": "p_126e2bf28ab541af", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 187, "text": "脩令吏民：「敢有不攻者與同罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "a257fce7a7d83f5966e29b6822920bba20f96763523553248efd2d8320e9b35b"}

{"id": "p_4fd55831fd831fd4", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 188, "text": "舉孝廉，脩讓邴原，融不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "f0cf9e04f2624745f4e26830dc5fd06acef50612215e929abc3c1471a525519a"}

{"id": "p_ea51297dbc025a4e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 189, "text": "賊初發，融謂左右曰：「能冒難來，唯王脩耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "d7381ae2504bd421629595ab4a15363b57372c35d7b435dba6292a8c280d7c1a"}

{"id": "p_c3000e87cc44a29c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 190, "text": "時膠東多賊寇，復令脩守膠東令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "f00ed4f51cd59f10f9f362e0d4d23f9c45f710ccf67cdc6a9161f300c47738d9"}

{"id": "p_802e319253fff06c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 191, "text": "膠東人公沙盧宗彊，自為營塹，不肯應發調。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "af33b2bc09d771e67b1572c91bce2d1a33e8a549ba67cdcbfbdde0f82e51bd92"}

{"id": "p_2eb0b6f91fe5ad49", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 192, "text": "脩獨將數騎徑入其門，斬盧兄弟，公沙氏驚愕莫敢動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "88635585fda7816e60b5340f588b7f255a82fc6a474733bcbad7b039e3330563"}

{"id": "p_8ec4b296ee916385", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 193, "text": "脩撫慰其餘，由是寇少止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "0c914ea997403b37658b6ad7861ae63f1b9022614b61e3addfb232ec6cf1f525"}

{"id": "p_80251cde6b336374", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 194, "text": "融每有難，脩雖休歸在家，無不至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "ab0399061640309fdec871ae958dfc3cbb99f7738cc02723adb2ef4605022e05"}

{"id": "p_5c92ee75f87f7151", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 195, "text": "袁譚在青州，辟脩為治中從事，別駕劉獻數毀短脩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "07f24cb4d9202f5f3c984d7a912225fba7516c919294f08ec4cab575f00cfb59"}

{"id": "p_f2444bb11f71e43e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 196, "text": "後獻以事當死，脩理之，得免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "a6d15351e245d2b3c91f4f670819f7503497beaabc059d078296e8a9e1ce2f79"}

{"id": "p_61d8a85fd81e56a0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 197, "text": "袁紹又辟脩除即墨令，後復為譚別駕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "55389915da802b1ced6e8f9694b50839a63d921e86759caaa67d2e6fbc019d66"}

{"id": "p_84d2d42070205431", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 198, "text": "尚攻譚，譚軍敗，脩率吏民往救譚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "fb67e537eababbe31669a711d61519386e3cc54e882a9afd55f7d26554098f8b"}

{"id": "p_565502af8475f3e8", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 199, "text": "譚喜曰：「成吾軍者，王別駕也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "ca619f503b3df0191c0087553af6bca331815230264cad536c590c5eb483d513"}

{"id": "p_1b68b59d0b5f0837", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 200, "text": "」譚之敗，劉詢起兵漯陰，諸城皆應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "1726db388374c340d8eda957662562bb9fa94ef572e3dd76c5c569fdd592e862"}

{"id": "p_19d80442944f32fe", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 201, "text": "譚歎息曰：「今舉州背叛，豈孤之不德邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "2719ffe924a8652906b72d7708e9160022a1c7119c790d52396bacc231eac0c5"}

{"id": "p_209261bdb8d2f26b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 202, "text": "」脩曰：「東萊太守管統雖在海表，此人不反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "2ea733f9c124573324b4da9f486f35009fa7e118d63375f493fbbf7f028d4347"}

{"id": "p_b73bc35044326201", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 203, "text": "」後十餘日，統果棄其妻子來赴譚，妻子為賊所殺，譚更以統為樂安太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "4cf81fec9eae50406d2a33339c74edfe40e674744265e049f75753dc6a117dbe"}

{"id": "p_d80d2e93474b12e5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 204, "text": "譚復欲攻尚，脩諫曰：「兄弟還相攻擊，是敗亡之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "5367cdb02328bc4c8e3fee432f1e22a0dea5fee81d3bcfc903d8c3eb34eef008"}

{"id": "p_cd4e874d70d3e4a1", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 205, "text": "」脩曰：「夫兄弟者，左右手也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "16dbac948106a8042819c86f1fc1d4c56fc15bc6b58985554eca635f816aaf01"}

{"id": "p_45e73a487b7951ab", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 206, "text": "譬人將鬬而斷其右手，而曰『我必勝』，若是者可乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "f16b22a84597cd35003d1d777a8ce7174ef3a7c53ae66d62e7606b401c0f10e0"}

{"id": "p_2b1dd7d241900c15", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 207, "text": "夫棄兄弟而不親，天下其誰親之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "f14353e7ef35b395d86ef30df7072383c47b8a4052fd2d95bb3fa945ef0ecde8"}

{"id": "p_72f5cd7a833eee25", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 208, "text": "屬有讒人，固將交鬬其間，以求一朝之利，願明使君塞耳勿聽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "5df7f4fc94a08b8b8dff47b8cdd13ecc50c61bdc14dd7e4541eb9b2ebcda5ece"}

{"id": "p_de8f517edb345d2b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 209, "text": "若斬佞臣數人，復相親睦，以禦四方，可以橫行天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "c8f5e49815402dd885ad6142fd18125aff4434a4487884d5ce0006eedf88f9ce"}

{"id": "p_c287865c0518a1a4", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 210, "text": "」譚不聽，遂與尚相攻擊，請救於太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "b9c3188fccdc26cdedecf61e388d86cf436e917d1d09b49c4b57f6715f7e1190"}

{"id": "p_b5b33124fe395adb", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 211, "text": "脩時運糧在樂安，聞譚急，將所領兵及諸從事數十人往赴譚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "0db9bd220bdf9936e46eef16eaf729db014ebd804ff9a26427039b99649011d8"}

{"id": "p_e53b483ca70eec9c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 212, "text": "至高密，聞譚死，下馬號哭曰：「無君焉歸？", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "5625859e5006452b994bfd485503b354b65d27b94130d4e020590327fd5b36cc"}

{"id": "p_4e70fe54bcebe301", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 213, "text": "」遂詣太祖，乞收葬譚屍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "e27a294063ed9c6cae17ca03c541a52d48f5b16f7ef67074894c5eb68e98f221"}

{"id": "p_aab4eb01dc6ad452", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 214, "text": "太祖欲觀脩意，默然不應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "4bd0a814410151748c3a4cf3b0cb0b09aaa666ec2acf607e8ee926a44ab19b46"}

{"id": "p_b9ef82de663d558e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 215, "text": "脩復曰：「受袁氏厚恩，若得收歛譚屍，然後就戮，無所恨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "add50f26c5d81897f1a0eba1fcbbe932e7116160b42be0d2fb92cda82b47be71"}

{"id": "p_169dd0d01ff4e2cc", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 216, "text": "譚之破，諸城皆服，唯管統以樂安不從命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "eaba1d17c48fbbd472e5d737b904e37bd53cd14963725cb35920b300badee784"}

{"id": "p_1513ef3a2f2e206e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 217, "text": "太祖命脩取統首，脩以統亡國之忠臣，因解其縛，使詣太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "4ca6ed471dffd67b53b730dc45b2e9198dc458637f056f1a41a4b13ff929b392"}

{"id": "p_06aa9f2e672bb263", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 218, "text": "袁氏政寬，在職勢者多畜聚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "f03643eccd127042cd47c270688603d1e6c309c24dd3da74fd27b740d263f235"}

{"id": "p_bc1efad96b56d7de", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 219, "text": "太祖破鄴，籍沒審配等家財物貲以萬數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "091c04f333f1e13dc65ba8bec9f5788274e26f898e55f8f76025963ffd16f0a8"}

{"id": "p_6d57835d72fe4d72", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 220, "text": "及破南皮，閱脩家，穀不滿十斛，有書數百卷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "b8f07cbeffc09e1c017088d0520df98149490bd1c773791f11f172319e14b80a"}

{"id": "p_8552e78f95689ec3", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 221, "text": "太祖歎曰：「士不妄有名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "4cd391fde47436e858a26e3d821bead276edb361478c1fe07d3ab251cc4731e8"}

{"id": "p_cc853a2eb0b5994b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 222, "text": "」乃禮辟為司空掾，行司金中郎將，遷魏郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "ad6226e45ebca623160fd00419ec6e6b1e28ee1ed30f35bb4b33656907781ef6"}

{"id": "p_75c0ed78bdb642a2", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 223, "text": "為治，抑彊扶弱，明賞罰，百姓稱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "996ccafdc765d5318772459728c1ede1802bdcb7226306317838a85fe28ba741"}

{"id": "p_b5100513bf88fa20", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 224, "text": "魏國旣建，為大司農郎中令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "0774db5e0ccd3f35765b99f7d350d0e148d37c31d1f09bdb91b2ade740d69311"}

{"id": "p_554668659c28df21", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 225, "text": "太祖議行肉刑，脩以為時未可行，太祖採其議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "b5f8c59fc1109f388e00f714e5c8c761fe8081540c120bbd6f27e7d58fb40826"}

{"id": "p_1dd95122313e525f", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 226, "text": "其後嚴才反，與其徒屬數十人攻掖門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "c4ad6f5444aa8193ca87e2137063d30f5b01ded8c4aa9ce1e6177d645c2d7b1f"}

{"id": "p_ea6d7f135c2f91e1", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 227, "text": "脩聞變，召車馬未至，便將官屬步至宮門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "2593713df664e809d7d4e7b5e049d116888662d6c3980ea30bb459ee0feedd6b"}

{"id": "p_1b8c42a00521e363", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 228, "text": "太祖在銅爵臺望見之，曰：「彼來者必王叔治也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "5a1edaf6beb0dd3e3f7e81d9a7d1828485f7859ffb6e2d838e515089b56d8c49"}

{"id": "p_7894fcf9b2a366e0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 229, "text": "」相國鍾繇謂脩：「舊，京城有變，九卿各居其府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "492f862733b2b9a32edbceaccd50408c5e11d8f7bb074a1b50eb9647ba338ea9"}

{"id": "p_b321fe16c13c3a8d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 230, "text": "」脩曰：「食其祿，焉避其離？", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "f8d50a945ed96c677c3eda7f5da74ef0908fdc07014bf9f509016adb7ce67d84"}

{"id": "p_f605abe35799b0a4", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 231, "text": "子忠，官至東萊太守、散騎常侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "3e518e0bd8665dc80657b96167e410070e71feac8f12140f69a92f1e7bcdc56b"}

{"id": "p_ff6fd9c47d60d1c0", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 232, "text": "初，脩識高柔於弱冠，異王基於幼童，終皆遠至，世稱其知人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "43ab3f6bcb1783b9dbc371f05367ea160850135b307c0e8c25c8b15f585de69b"}

{"id": "p_b852bd1992084f43", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 233, "text": "邴原字根矩，北海朱虛人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "0eec96f6e6a5d39addeea647d38c64ba667c227fc6f23c25071058c7a5b52a23"}

{"id": "p_1551e549773468cd", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 234, "text": "少與管寧俱以操尚稱，州府辟命皆不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "708aff35e6199cdb60c8a4ce997853df03eaf1d0c92421b3dce58f9e36cdcdca"}

{"id": "p_1c74a178574f7026", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 235, "text": "黃巾起，原將家屬入海，住鬱洲山中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "7994c14f9f44740e635d2f0392fef0c05de336f2692b0b6dc06804c4e3f96ce4"}

{"id": "p_937cfe8127e1aa91", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 236, "text": "時孔融為北海相，舉原有道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "7b34068587efb73f6b936bbc70fb651578e7fef452faf97e6c8bc9df581107a5"}

{"id": "p_f315db4a1053c174", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 237, "text": "原以黃巾方盛，遂至遼東，與同郡劉政俱有勇略雄氣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "7d8b127c884a9b02dba7058a821e1ae67f11e08710129de9a3a125dcc66f596a"}

{"id": "p_3fd2d20625595166", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 238, "text": "遼東太守公孫度畏惡欲殺之，盡收捕其家，政得脫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "8f8eb42a03ec70adebc51515b04d729f8a9579b79c7d13a430f5e796b195389d"}

{"id": "p_224913035ba8d4a6", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 239, "text": "度告諸縣：「敢有藏政者與同罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "c42d8b7d72359049d01581babc8f2142bab0f5a627376febea399eb4a7f361a0"}

{"id": "p_d8fb6607c5da0f3f", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 240, "text": "原匿之月餘，時東萊太史慈當歸，原因以政付之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "9a5aeeca00b4e0f84794f3b4ef3fcec543826220bfdf6874f9431e29349399b9"}

{"id": "p_d734316cad79ae74", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 241, "text": "旣而謂度曰：「將軍前日欲殺劉政，以其為己害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "f9601a19436ec1ef2f5f2f97f1f986bb23b0333b084927abe871c12aa0f8f3dc"}

{"id": "p_296b727cf5d08dfc", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 242, "text": "今政已去，君之害豈不除哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "afe8c4c9019d86c07ac52641429223da99e54739ccb36b52d0446703f58749de"}

{"id": "p_eff18ef5795f1428", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 243, "text": "」原曰：「君之畏政者，以其有智也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "59b827e8f4430a88449498fd2928a3fdaa4ea87d68fc277b998427374ab7521f"}

{"id": "p_644b95be602cdbf7", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 244, "text": "今政已免，智將用矣，尚奚拘政之家？", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "69540ada5a89a351fe5a0804963f8fb212344f52c8e17d89d4c564df662c0798"}

{"id": "p_0d21004a0334c659", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 245, "text": "原又資送政家，皆得歸故郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "adb61724b5eea81d86d1d39996f6379598e3ace8b5d487a16f882b6e9eef60ee"}

{"id": "p_5ae20690c44a9d62", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 246, "text": "原在遼東，一年中往歸原居者數百家，游學之士，教授之聲，不絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "87a96fa815f70710189f780537bfc5d9e481977329b3b4a33edd36a2a72d194c"}

{"id": "p_3025ade75a42ff92", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 247, "text": "後得歸，太祖辟為司空掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "384b26f9f3f0095debbe6519bef91b338bc919db7627d4e32a7d8fafac6028bf"}

{"id": "p_49044547deff52ac", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 248, "text": "原女早亡，時太祖愛子倉舒亦沒，太祖欲求合葬，原辭曰：「合葬，非禮也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "03c229afdffdd03c92082ec0cb4961f98da4c9c3338bc04b711ae6f09c5a60df"}

{"id": "p_4f382dc4e7349412", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 249, "text": "原之所以自容於明公，公之所以待原者，以能守訓典而不易也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "7b2b60b42109cf5b55850458d2c10bcb72280da3e1ca85a3e73537924f4577be"}

{"id": "p_0bdcfdda864d86ea", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 250, "text": "若聽明公之命，則是凡庸也，明公焉以為哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "e3382fffdf45736cee901f8c4bb664b5fb4c006775b2637132e6e648da01f7fd"}

{"id": "p_07e2dedf4cac25c1", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 251, "text": "」太祖乃止，徙署丞相徵事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "47dee26935f83f063516f5ef0d2e31ca80dab0818097fd921f10379273c172c5"}

{"id": "p_ba25318d836a2b98", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 252, "text": "崔琰為東曹掾，記讓曰：「徵事邴原、議郎張範，皆秉德純懿，志行忠方，清靜足以厲俗，貞固足以幹事，所謂龍翰鳳翼，國之重寶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "b0651e2f43e75a752a11d026e44cfc8445a7ecc814bf48110265a39bf1c14823"}

{"id": "p_ffa053b0c8840335", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 253, "text": "」代涼茂為五官將長史，閉門自守，非公事不出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "87a7b3da0d77ba1fea873d0cc5c5cc809525294983353187d70ca669c7dd04ba"}

{"id": "p_6cf191fd372f6ef4", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 254, "text": "是後大鴻臚鉅鹿張泰、河南尹扶風龐辿以清賢稱，永寧太僕東郡張閣以簡質聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "b981443cbeb454249965d10048457a8d22d5b92fa60d7939b8377a9339678ef5"}

{"id": "p_3a9a088ac6475ab1", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 255, "text": "杜恕著家戒稱閣曰：「張子臺，視之似鄙樸人，然其心中不知天地間何者為美，何者為好，敦然似如與陰陽合德者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "c8e6d68f11a31432b47ab1e4ed51c2e62a061a9e9701d06b462dc7585ea80e9f"}

{"id": "p_e46fede8451b6d74", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 256, "text": "作人如此，自可不富貴，然而患禍當何從而來？", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "26d7ed8ed8db95ea1e9bd5aa03102da83a28cdacd95be8d317f0654350312339"}

{"id": "p_4e90a99dd26c865c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 257, "text": "世有高亮如子臺者，皆多力慕，體之不如也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "50bc6245393fc16408e22d89268f64ac9189b71c474d6340c4bfd8cb8ac1516d"}

{"id": "p_8e9e99131f68cd1d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 258, "text": "管寧字幼安，北海朱虛人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "25237414f8964dcfd97a116dfa813c0c7bd11e6d99f2b9f26bbfaab6074ff334"}

{"id": "p_ce4bf688207449f5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 259, "text": "年十六喪父，中表愍其孤貧，咸共贈賵，悉辭不受，稱財以送終。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "c1285f55c1bb990f086ef000ffb11e1decabdf95518a9286320b78931630364d"}

{"id": "p_a78fa948cf69c08d", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 260, "text": "與平原華歆、同縣邴原相友，俱游學於異國，並敬善陳仲弓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "cf9d9c76f36d0bd981f322ea95aa8c2275cf3107b7bbfb9178f15fc951a7fb95"}

{"id": "p_f639d7a2f7a82348", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 261, "text": "天下大亂，聞公孫度令行於海外，遂與原及平原王烈等至于遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "c4855f32ecbb2626d412aeae7ada400dc83210f9e732a077213767a5baf1a987"}

{"id": "p_9973ba9cf4d358fe", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 262, "text": "時避難者多居郡南，而寧居北，示無遷志，後漸來從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "3974e1c4006c6a0c718af0b4eda559e015efa5fc44a65c338ced1443d91f89e8"}

{"id": "p_6be60acac26ff099", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 263, "text": "太祖為司空，辟寧，度子康絕命不宣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "086461978192a1bee1b0d7e937c3d7e5c72d963f7a08119023154420fc8d4bd4"}

{"id": "p_7117b07f341f6400", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 264, "text": "王烈者，字彥方，於時名聞在原、寧之右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "78c36b40b752882ebbee52df7812a16a49057e0bf8ed757bdd5a32efe304264c"}

{"id": "p_e20e5019a002ba32", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 265, "text": "辭公孫度長史，商賈自穢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "2a8f1169abb20a4149dca15dcc8e75b5d2d2bdea04f70b9b900266fa6b63ccd2"}

{"id": "p_554c91159ab94671", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 266, "text": "太祖命為丞相掾，徵事，未至，卒於海表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "78c8be4ebf391dc4c0e7a541b543a86636171bd2aa7303e1524f64e19719ed6b"}

{"id": "p_45776bb3fcb4e954", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 267, "text": "中國少安，客人皆還，唯寧晏然若將終焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "4b1f850eeeb5c16785867284e1fcb5501859ed997edcf852fa0a40e3cbcee996"}

{"id": "p_406cf8d642737474", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 268, "text": "，詔公卿舉獨行君子，司徒華歆薦寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "1382fe7bf701dd3b2058aa1d942d2293ea43d3583e9dfa18ffb6d3a358707aad"}

{"id": "p_aad71680a64a8a93", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 269, "text": "文帝即位，徵寧，遂將家屬浮海還郡，公孫恭送之南郊，加贈服物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "6761c812955e105d966216c56873768753c245c8b4e35b9d01b9697e91b1b0ed"}

{"id": "p_fc578296b19c54b7", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 270, "text": "自寧之東也，度、康、恭前後所資遺，皆受而藏諸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "5d056e6813c04f474c469aac3b721b39cfffc7c5e3498d7d4bc065bec5578fc0"}

{"id": "p_9b3a85c96d897f70", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 271, "text": "詔以寧為太中大夫，固辭不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "170d41e98c4ff6e0d0c2e42f459055dce4d09f78a7690b164bc39dff7568053c"}

{"id": "p_5aa9a37ad6bf1640", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 272, "text": "明帝即位，太尉華歆遜位讓寧，遂下詔曰：「」又詔青州刺史曰：「」寧稱「草莽臣」上疏曰：「」", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "c0773c2ce3b6ed0c333705d225300668b5d05db9a759e5a19b7b3e42a152f135"}

{"id": "p_c58fa2647c2961a6", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 273, "text": "自黃初至于青龍，徵命相仍，常以八月賜牛酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "fd96542208d1c57f976e858cc2bec5c3536d6b81fd0204fb95694c5e23cab6a3"}

{"id": "p_233d67a7ffbf6f68", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 274, "text": "詔書問青州刺史程喜：「寧為守節高乎，審老疾尪頓邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "cf50bcd469c4804372474067ab9f4c8ec90f99ee4e2585afdcad4010546d7a8d"}

{"id": "p_5a1c8bdd660fa3ae", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 275, "text": "」喜上言：「寧有族人管貢為州吏，與寧鄰比，臣常使經營消息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "55e8299ab8d3fdf26416040494fd85687171a3a53173a55c7e8793ca9bc35f56"}

{"id": "p_fc38f5154849862e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 276, "text": "貢說：『寧常著皁帽、布襦袴、布裠，隨時單複，出入閨庭，能自任杖，不須扶持。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "e84aa4df13284025b3bb9a3e2e9c15b7e678aea40d6f8ea80109b3d18bd60e4b"}

{"id": "p_d8e406f92152a8a5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 277, "text": "四時祠祭，輙自力彊，改加衣服，著絮巾，故在遼東所有白布單衣，親薦饌饋，跪拜成禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "653e4ae2512a90bf07810ddf60b1f5e47f8fb1469160cf7ee14782160f8fe6ac"}

{"id": "p_c9414427f127644b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 278, "text": "寧少而喪母，不識形象，常特加觴，泫然流涕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "d6f7ad7851d310beae3aa5dea3d11249f4c1bf3ffcc5ebc4f58cb27d4e1bb23e"}

{"id": "p_e83aa1d8c8fc1f53", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 279, "text": "又居宅離水七八十步，夏時詣水中澡灑手足，闚於園圃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "4104383a96d2aef7e830117da12320a6a579bed43f1e3edb67b8f11ea454b7a3"}

{"id": "p_7a18f91f6b370587", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 280, "text": "』臣揆寧前後辭讓之意，獨自以生長潛逸，耆艾智衰，是以栖遲，每執謙退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "513dad533973ea152767922715c255783926867f5e74398018b7a6e6ef0bbebc"}

{"id": "p_09f2f73f223726f3", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 281, "text": "此寧志行所欲必全，不為守高。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "ec9ce60e85e32569a09d03aa1c5b24ee3cb5775704ebe6dd9d66812162075d98"}

{"id": "p_da8ff084a61d8402", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 282, "text": "，太僕陶丘一、永寧衞尉孟觀、侍中孫邕、中書侍郎王基薦寧曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "4b579e63de89cee8675cf9825b0357a4276a00d672c06526e1f85ba90cc398fb"}

{"id": "p_1e52bff7facd715e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 283, "text": "於是特具安車蒲輪，束帛加璧聘焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "65f802fe38a00cc236995d7f2922258036d5bc58bece7871ba80a66e4798e6ff"}

{"id": "p_c938848883041f8e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 284, "text": "初，寧妻先卒，知故勸更娶，寧曰：「每省曾子、王駿之言，意常嘉之，豈自遭之而違本心哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "8f81938ce9ee17c5f5107f0517a64ba396f80dc648b9b3dd53b1eda18dbf3dc1"}

{"id": "p_88849183eff52c90", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 285, "text": "時鉅鹿張臶，字子明，頴川胡昭，字孔明，亦養志不仕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "8d43ca190d26fdc963a2ac8a9f27390b6cb662a9aea41dfd3cb865fbe5ce6fc1"}

{"id": "p_9d7ab9e94e842588", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 286, "text": "臶少游太學，學兼內外，後歸鄉里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "333f61fe837bab4bc28a561de7fb0d0be2bcb67a57fca1fc85504b2bd6972073"}

{"id": "p_ab8a0d2d4dde55b4", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 287, "text": "袁紹前後辟命，不應，移居上黨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "a20fbd1172715b76e6fc59c0475194c2bc67150f8768dd057cfad7bce1734723"}

{"id": "p_ffd0d69848d51c5b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 288, "text": "并州牧高幹表除樂平令，不就，徙遁常山，門徒且數百人，遷居任縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "15048c3f5bccc0b7c6a92fdc82d5d26e2b3f49716edb4c2084ac784ff764010d"}

{"id": "p_06e4fefc1761f3c2", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 289, "text": "太和中，詔求隱學之士能消災復異者，郡累上臶，發遣，老病不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "37cec07c585d20a9c8c833d718f7a67eda96c2501cd632bd66016b948562fec3"}

{"id": "p_b9cc934b0ad921c2", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 290, "text": "廣平太守盧毓到官三日，綱紀白承前致版謁臶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "0e0edf2b49f201b384d4041e18e8e0f61e8debeb5b63eaf5952b889f2226a421"}

{"id": "p_13192945a43954cc", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 291, "text": "毓教曰：「張先生所謂上不事天子，下不友諸侯者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "c830a7396288096d0694995d9a3d8886cb1a94f34c3a94ae2bff61a9ff908744"}

{"id": "p_eac8755088d9d200", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 292, "text": "」但遣主簿奉書致羊酒之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "e72d369b330b1b96e8837d7a064c8d2501dc5aeb24d1b75f9566772e55cae6c2"}

{"id": "p_9c381c38e546652e", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 293, "text": "辛亥詔書：「」事班天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "fe7fc908d1404f50c7be1d5ed1ff533813b2b1691a5d69ac574c68c234047e7f"}

{"id": "p_554b1baab2d410f1", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 294, "text": "任令于綽連齎以問臶，臶密謂綽曰：「夫神以知來，不追已往，禎祥先見而後廢興從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "4f1b6bfcf905d6333f85701d884045ddd07c1c3c8cb8bd3b0bafb712fbf437ef"}

{"id": "p_8535dfe687c2010b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 295, "text": "漢已乆亡，魏已得之，何所追興徵祥乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "f7d184a97ca9d5bd89b12e3ff056f2c6699cbad7029bb85cc5875cdd5c92d92e"}

{"id": "p_c6be9afc3ae65fb3", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 296, "text": "此石，當今之變異而將來之禎瑞也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "cc7bfbd538af09fae5d0bfe13abf0ed4b2aadf01c50840764ec9675aa2cec4f2"}

{"id": "p_8a9c2fcece0746ad", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 297, "text": "」，戴鵀之鳥，巢臶門陰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "d2c17e3df2d7748ae6997273277d12dbdbb967951bf86444f059cb53ec90a269"}

{"id": "p_ef3dfaeab195a0f3", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 298, "text": "臶告門人曰：「夫戴鵀陽鳥，而巢門陰，此凶祥也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "3c05d814d30bdd3be3f63ca11f52e71eb7eb4b60d7f301edf383cdee2968ba8f"}

{"id": "p_25adae5bea971a80", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 299, "text": "」乃援琴歌詠，作詩二篇，旬日而卒，時年一百五歲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "626aeec6f1ac86ef219db61e63ac97304ce02e6008450db95afeaf2c75dff824"}

{"id": "p_3aaffe44d6cd9159", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 300, "text": "是歲，廣平太守王肅至官，教下縣曰：「前在京都，聞張子明，來至問之，會其已亡，致痛惜之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "73c7b3e8fab8a147dd365b6eb049dca4ed81c6e47feca5ff8b5ed9f800e1c56a"}

{"id": "p_585ae674ee1a4038", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 301, "text": "此君篤學隱居，不與時競，以道樂身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "6ad126b8113b2a01330e2727aecc82f549f94d86d61e52adcc6be13e2adc4908"}

{"id": "p_ba956d6b01aba146", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 302, "text": "昔絳縣老人屈在泥塗，趙孟升之，諸侯用睦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "d6d30427ba5f994f8cfba1124f975ae3819728fca9635aa6901f7a024cf37023"}

{"id": "p_5f51dd659217b06b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 303, "text": "愍其耄勤好道，而不蒙榮寵，書到，遣吏勞問其家，顯題門戶，務加殊異，以慰旣往，以勸將來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 303}, "text_hash": "11b56350b33d7a63a0b6b0391c06c01ec2941491d84c257edf742a10597a999c"}

{"id": "p_fd995f3d0f604439", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 304, "text": "胡昭始避地冀州，亦辭袁紹之命，遁還鄉里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 304}, "text_hash": "edf4a4375f04ab67209fca3a4991d6b39c14b5f738cb235a227e45082d919b6c"}

{"id": "p_418c012bbc71ee92", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 305, "text": "太祖為司空丞相，頻加禮辟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 305}, "text_hash": "de2fba83635f277c45a621b97ed5030ae7b22e087b84ddd828e53ce3b1850550"}

{"id": "p_2ec522d420619ae5", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 306, "text": "昭往應命，旣至，自陳一介野生，無軍國之用，歸誠求去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 306}, "text_hash": "8b3803c1fdccbe7d825f5e4e5a4bb8a111e6804958ff814c3122c6a3cbe160c2"}

{"id": "p_2df9961d038e615a", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 307, "text": "太祖曰：「人各有志，出處異趣，勉卒雅尚，義不相屈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 307}, "text_hash": "4fc93c2e253ba2b0e5960c3d38e5ff894127d76405a229a4ca2d54ce813ecc8b"}

{"id": "p_1d1b0d9495923d57", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 308, "text": "」昭乃轉居陸渾山中，躬耕樂道，以經籍自娛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 308}, "text_hash": "df39c7d0cf58acef6abdff0ac0e476416a9a9d3210b6e6b26f815698906733ff"}

{"id": "p_2294a5b3117ff1d4", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 309, "text": "，陸渾長張固被書調丁夫，當給漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 309}, "text_hash": "8e49dddff17fc8838d97ad9ce5f072323812df7339eee1dfb4d21683093966d9"}

{"id": "p_d59572cb1bc48b5a", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 310, "text": "百姓惡憚遠役，並懷擾擾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 310}, "text_hash": "c639d65de7efc1fa7d7de1068e2b6801d0dc608a8ffea8b93cf7f5d2f239e277"}

{"id": "p_286ed6559c162d31", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 311, "text": "民孫狼等因興兵殺縣主簿，作為叛亂，縣邑殘破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 311}, "text_hash": "c8dc2fe3bc3e7c0abafcbdcc5bdbbde48dbe97b40987b8febcfd869928a47119"}

{"id": "p_5ca235ad14462743", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 312, "text": "固率將十餘吏卒，依昭住止，招集遺民，安復社稷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 312}, "text_hash": "bfc85afc98699158daa43a7b775a814995180f4cfbda687b76a96b452d6380d3"}

{"id": "p_3bcd7e6ad8a80fdc", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 313, "text": "羽授印給兵，還為寇賊，到陸渾南長樂亭，自相約誓，言：「胡居士賢者也，一不得犯其部落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 313}, "text_hash": "3cf693f8e7cf2070abf2436f27d228c7a7df2fb4465d2b304d3940e103c29fe4"}

{"id": "p_6b9a832d407190fc", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 314, "text": "正始中，驃騎將軍趙儼、尚書黃休、郭彝、散騎常侍荀顗、鍾毓、太僕庾嶷、弘農太守何楨等遞薦昭曰：「天真高絜，老而彌篤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 314}, "text_hash": "a6eefc71fba1d047f3aec669b555604087bd8cba460383cbde138450b9827666"}

{"id": "p_c873d9dae4c55966", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 315, "text": "玄虛靜素，有夷、皓之節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 315}, "text_hash": "b5995215e6ab11d643761f3eb450d0fb4c580487a2729b1c8968a982766d7d6b"}

{"id": "p_35e3f7fdc83e779c", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 316, "text": "」至，公車特徵，會卒，年八十九。", "locator": {"ordinal": 316}, "text_hash": "ad89e5a32d532988c3a448d94cbb0fbdee82f1d9a2c982b38bb9346eea0baea5"}

{"id": "p_6a63feb39a3687a6", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 317, "text": "初，昭善史書，與鍾繇、邯鄲淳、衞覬、韋誕並有名，尺牘之迹，動見模楷焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 317}, "text_hash": "1e9af5425c8bee36dc507e19f22775fcd03452a11141391b365ad77f283b289c"}

{"id": "p_e38faf8970fc5b4b", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 318, "text": "評曰：袁渙、邴原、張範躬履清蹈，進退以道，蓋是貢禹、兩龔之匹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 318}, "text_hash": "3c65f6054a3dc147a1353c9a340de3978c56dbd06958196d38e21686812365e2"}

{"id": "p_be5e3cabc9317e04", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 319, "text": "張承名行亞範，可謂能弟矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 319}, "text_hash": "98aca9915f0ad47c893460c3946cef03b28c72e4bc128758c0b5b7af8184bedd"}

{"id": "p_23d52eecd00c4eca", "source_id": "src_ce35c99a5a2573cc", "ordinal": 320, "text": "田疇抗節，王脩忠貞，足以矯俗；管寧淵雅高尚，確然不拔；張臶、胡昭闔門守靜，不營當世：故并錄焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 320}, "text_hash": "653627bf4ab827d145e5546da5672e6fd5ae46493733fb2151f1215be584fa10"}

{"id": "p_9b2049eef0ed949e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 0, "text": "崔琰字季珪，清河東武城人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "1c7d51e279b2dd564bc554d43b5c4b74cee66f9223b43f11197b94e1e2bea16b"}

{"id": "p_e61445f0d623ec78", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 1, "text": "少樸訥，好擊劍，尚武事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "9a123c348262ccf98d0c55537e64aa6fab65fefa8bd824522a64924bd676b41f"}

{"id": "p_9672583b79015670", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 2, "text": "年二十三，鄉移爲正，始感激，讀《論語》、《韓詩》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "266d5e5addc14722fc1a27e39fb524c4516983b3356e7852872beaf2ec2af017"}

{"id": "p_51a3617fa97f03ef", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 3, "text": "至年二十九，乃结公孫方等就鄭玄受學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "567be183f14883e24ce2923441781bd63b6aa08c1ae2926c5c40713d6433716b"}

{"id": "p_18de9bb0fa740d71", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 4, "text": "學未期，徐州黄巾賊攻破北海，玄與門人到不其山避難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "138f03ea4a0e73f39a83ca85c5dd0f4dba34c75a430f2c06f2834781744d620f"}

{"id": "p_e68acf320a5b8bdb", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 5, "text": "時穀糴縣乏，玄罷謝諸生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "468ab13bdf8fc23f2a389c96f787fcfb62fbc3de536c5602462689cb5295391e"}

{"id": "p_146cfe9b4407df08", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 6, "text": "琰既受遣，而寇盗充斥，西道不通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "9816390a8c1d218a435705a9973c5dd751c2b6f4ffd7206006412cdae54a6138"}

{"id": "p_d2b8495dd518c7c0", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 7, "text": "於是周旋青、徐、兗、豫之郊，東下壽春，南望江、湖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "d86f5215c6230c1c07d01bcfb2bb6396e8d15b3071584318eeaffbdef8d9fe1b"}

{"id": "p_ee495d3df698e11f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 8, "text": "自去家四年乃歸，以琴書自娛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "4690fd21d7b5a595e5d6e19fcb8f41f295bbdbb2587b18e17309c6f824888cc1"}

{"id": "p_8edbeba8de8d55ca", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 9, "text": "時士卒横暴，掘發丘隴，琰諫曰：『昔孫卿有言：「士不素教，甲兵不利，雖湯武不能以戰勝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "61b1f256f409d33a6f597f8bedc78a06e6d1b1b5388581fe7f0b467f7db750f3"}

{"id": "p_c811b39b279dc495", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」今道路暴骨，民未見德，宜敕郡縣掩骼埋胔，示憯怛之愛，追文王之仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "98edc4bd90a15844b6d348d5ec826b632072f8b36c2a03bc407f218ca1c5c0ae"}

{"id": "p_aba2c8031536dd56", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 11, "text": "後紹治兵黎陽，次于延津，琰復諫曰：『天子在許，民望助順，不如守境述職，以寧區宇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "feee4bd447f61a77bfc528f40d1833bfeb7e4cf001db632511a3d52b510eb114"}

{"id": "p_d4960358b25e59f4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 12, "text": "及紹卒，二子交爭，爭欲得琰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "088e38861d037bb8e6bcc1f5c73f9402ef503afbd33d3b858aca47bbcd980aed"}

{"id": "p_15981bbce58feafb", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 13, "text": "琰稱疾固辭，由是獲罪，幽於囹圄，賴陰夔、陳琳营救得免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "04a3fa8758edba291f2c7da13fc4ea5483939ff7a2a315e43d3a5794b6dfaf80"}

{"id": "p_25f342c17c4a0ae4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 14, "text": "太祖破袁氏，領冀州牧，辟琰爲别駕從事，謂琰曰：『昨案户籍，可得三十萬眾，故爲大州也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "ea54af765e363d1f80a93cb879a73409fff7bdfd053534295b62fe6ef2fa83c9"}

{"id": "p_595ec58ad30f4ce1", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 15, "text": "』琰對曰：『今天下分崩，九州幅裂，二袁兄弟親尋干戈，冀方蒸庶暴骨原野。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "ebb29a66e9853efab67e3e11ea34a2cf3e2a62de316696596f9d52448034d2ce"}

{"id": "p_a8cb034f01d0eb86", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 16, "text": "未聞王師仁聲先路，存問風俗，救其塗炭，而校計甲兵，唯此爲先，斯豈鄙州士女所望於明公哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "989f2519ceb17737456f81a428ecbcba2dde9428f64e338d42671c72db299590"}

{"id": "p_4a8a79c0dd172ae3", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 17, "text": "太祖征並州，留琰傅文帝於鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "2ffac07b896a26165b1c6bfe5d25088e9d17bae618c66900b8d6583664e935f0"}

{"id": "p_feeb973476cbc9da", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 18, "text": "世子仍出田獵，變易服乘，志在驅逐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "a79cf57becc801b6b34993f29fed3bf98461aaa39e839f09482798bd63e10110"}

{"id": "p_431074b403ffbfb2", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 19, "text": "世子報曰：『昨奉嘉命，惠示雅數，欲使燔翳捐褶，翳已壞矣，褶亦去焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "1980cdaea682ac9eb9c7aed182fa67f10c6a84844bea3db505c2f6f59103c650"}

{"id": "p_226d9d7094d9d597", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 20, "text": "太祖爲丞相，琰復爲東西曹掾属徵事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "14c7ecc2fea7fb528d5f26ade392d48e0d9d6b116bb6e132623db2303e94b99a"}

{"id": "p_4c4ee3838eefd4a9", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 21, "text": "初授東曹時，教曰：『君有伯夷之風，史魚之直，貪夫慕名而清，壯士尚稱而厲，斯可以率時者已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "621802d6cb3223ef703edfacaad14be658320b82fa2fb98fbdce49584a0eec85"}

{"id": "p_1ac01ed7569da499", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 22, "text": "時未立太子，臨菑侯植有才而愛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "31ebcaa61404a6ed0a435669595dda1446a841c61f90f7d6b73fb26d8b4af94b"}

{"id": "p_853d7fae999c0cfa", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 23, "text": "太祖狐疑，以函令密訪於外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "a629162a3398911019658c37c05b54e3181838017d69f8e73c8ab54fd384e9ac"}

{"id": "p_d12c920a89046c97", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 24, "text": "唯琰露板答曰：『蓋聞春秋之義，立子以長，加五官將仁孝聰明，宜承正統。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "98273f566bea49848168a6d52091e35c08c506b83fe0591d025566028b0a156d"}

{"id": "p_a08dda49f8c7053e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 25, "text": "太祖貴其公亮，喟然歎息，遷中尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "bb24502cc6b1bf71d68054b83facdd7e0955e70d5d2d7d50259dadab5a166990"}

{"id": "p_dac45507b7a4aa76", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 26, "text": "琰聲姿高暢，眉目疏朗，鬚長四尺，甚有威重，朝士瞻望，而太祖亦敬憚焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "7a5af45c79e812cd1c1fed7ebf7a1b2c4792ff4f301f570a617b7c59a4ea0589"}

{"id": "p_0c7ace5504cf96ff", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 27, "text": "琰嘗薦鉅鹿楊訓，雖才好不足，而清貞守道，太祖即禮辟之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "91f970ed938146740e64f42df9dced6017f839d194d0569b5097c351d8e93a99"}

{"id": "p_9ea37140d868a6c2", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 28, "text": "後太祖爲魏王，訓發表稱贊功伐，襃述盛德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "d86bf89de8e33fadf15e2a032b2d1f437e01b3bc97c7b55a13bccaa53961818b"}

{"id": "p_8de887685694c9b6", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 29, "text": "時人或笑訓希世浮僞，謂琰爲失所舉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "003545bee9757c6aefee2e5021a2ecc2811e6754da8a3436bae595267424eb5c"}

{"id": "p_e985ceaecbeb24a3", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 30, "text": "琰從訓取表草視之，與訓書曰：『省表，事佳耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "eb19f0d7c8854531ac32950e246435e4c4e0e67cf5319c88d960dac177b963a7"}

{"id": "p_51881323a28c740a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 31, "text": "』琰本意譏論者好谴呵而不尋情理也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "3a29c5ceebbecd84ac455b6174190e58442daa4dff46e45c046009c73080ef1f"}

{"id": "p_5e1dc9a41ce6f890", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 32, "text": "有白琰此書傲世怨謗者，太祖怒曰：『谚言「生女耳」，「耳」非佳語。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "8027b056c48c903323d8e63924e25633376d321f81498c184a74ee4760dfb4e9"}

{"id": "p_e97d03236db0e57f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 33, "text": "「會當有變時」，意指不遜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "0a715b2b5195389e4dc2ca4ee5224e519d1d02dc99737680b62edffd8b0a22b8"}

{"id": "p_a1548f49844e868c", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 34, "text": "』於是罰琰爲徒隸，使人視之，辭色不撓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "3f2b82cab873612292c51f378098d26581f6d4813aa73e47f17c72969b536647"}

{"id": "p_3ec9251e94d7445a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 35, "text": "太祖令曰：『琰雖見刑，而通賓客，門若市人，對賓客虬鬚直視，若有所瞋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "ad73b71202add0a0db3ddc0f3a33ef625dba7120ba8d1a8339f1b2c88cabc495"}

{"id": "p_f2357822bf1c5ee9", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 36, "text": "始琰與司馬朗善，晉宣王方壯，琰謂朗曰：『子之弟，聰哲明允，剛斷英跱，殆非子之所及也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "b71960cb64fbcc8712265fd41868674005dddbf84d43c240edb2caa91d19d10e"}

{"id": "p_5f4a019df5caaf06", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 37, "text": "』朗以爲不然，而琰每秉此論。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "5f092dd69fbf23df5c940c61b795a93f2b8ef3947eaef1d44eb182229b605234"}

{"id": "p_2edab8c4fab8054f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 38, "text": "琰從弟林，少無名望，雖姻族猶多輕之，而琰常曰：『此所謂大器晚成者也，終必遠至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "6880b55b84f6518a447e75f60bc76a05a611b7f1af8e3e456cd88092f84f4f61"}

{"id": "p_adba936183957fba", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 39, "text": "』涿郡孫禮、盧毓始入軍府，琰又名之曰：『孫疏亮亢烈，剛簡能斷，盧清警明理，百鍊不消，皆公才也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "31b5fe8e2d280a50c0f0e1ba4043a54504337fb38c852c14e4dc14e6fe3e8ca8"}

{"id": "p_35e7c510e5063a09", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 40, "text": "』後林、禮、毓咸至鼎輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "f52a262a9eab2172653f9b0b91b572f9e614ab57ea657495d5273251f1a67d45"}

{"id": "p_4a278a65af6811ce", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 41, "text": "及琰友人公孫育、宋階早卒，琰撫其遺孤，恩若己子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "118aed5fc31e99d8ab14b6e5b3553a748c1545775f2628b0d55bef010bf08506"}

{"id": "p_30b479485a2ac8b4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 42, "text": "初，太祖性忌，有所不堪者，魯國孔融、南陽許攸、娄圭，皆以恃舊不虔見誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "e4bf5684312a972bd1f02cd9682b18e4f09f5311f862ba7c5c07ad7158fcae90"}

{"id": "p_0a192155e9bdc6bb", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 43, "text": "而琰最爲世所痛惜，至今冤之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "1355ff89305e852dff416835d41af21f98581eb125f7b0d3d2e3e78ef0dcdc2f"}

{"id": "p_4a9615b082dbabf9", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 44, "text": "毛玠字孝先，陳留平丘人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "9083bf572d2057e6d956604bc941e05699d1dc76633d592f48f5a769157f5954"}

{"id": "p_47fb907663681551", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 45, "text": "將避亂荆州，未至，聞劉表政令不明，遂往魯陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "de982df784379147ad71e03e8a9c8c62885baf80cb6e3da764d894d9b7ca2869"}

{"id": "p_64fcf3ddcd4d8eaa", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 46, "text": "太祖臨兗州，辟爲治中從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "54dbb16ca51c56e07a6661e12c37c119de7fc6f02e5a9ebbadec06c157db8510"}

{"id": "p_ccdb4b2424f39aae", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 47, "text": "玠語太祖曰：『今天下分崩，國主遷移，生民废業，饥馑流亡，公家無經歲之儲，百姓無安固之志，難以持久。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "ad5b46c3283a186d5ffe5bbb8a5232b0bc5a58f7c7e7bfe9b6bcba77e4874753"}

{"id": "p_567d9bc3157c537e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 48, "text": "今袁紹、劉表，雖士民眾强，皆無經遠之虑，未有树基建本者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "1eef0299d2d13e2f0267f2c3ba15704a9e63820cd1e998ac313539480c598ff2"}

{"id": "p_3003dccd9952cc8d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 49, "text": "夫兵義者勝，守位以财，宜奉天子以令不臣，脩耕植，畜軍资，如此則霸王之業可成也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "88320653b2d05c7b4246a23e1a19de13268fbf6e6ccf04f933b35612773c2c8c"}

{"id": "p_32ef6ece5db7de16", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 50, "text": "』太祖敬納其言，转幕府功曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "f2a0892fc8d9a7ccbfb450ba5e897b0ce0e2e3dbcefb7a16b0e3a8942a9cf9a8"}

{"id": "p_db20b4dfd57a51f9", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 51, "text": "太祖爲司空丞相，玠嘗爲東曹掾，與崔琰並典选舉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "331b641f5af54dee182106b3414f38a4f0d5a4ed8ce864fca71a1908c8eb087c"}

{"id": "p_335cb91554ca0587", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 52, "text": "其所舉用，皆清正之士，雖於時有盛名而行不由本者，終莫得进。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "f4195fe7187482b14f5fbcacf9baa3fedda502f7138c95f31a2baad454cbc133"}

{"id": "p_398033ff21b79785", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 53, "text": "务以儉率人，由是天下之士莫不以廉節自励，雖貴寵之臣，舆服不敢過度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "fb9638eaf8ba207d5981919e97c5462012982a899ac3d910e2720d3196ec7235"}

{"id": "p_5a38985908644c42", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 54, "text": "太祖歎曰：『用人如此，使天下人自治，吾復何爲哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "0c258a0c063085efd0a33db78a227b5bf35d9e70a7871754d95efdd226a7d6f8"}

{"id": "p_ca7eb27d0aeb5f2e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 55, "text": "』文帝爲五官將，親自诣玠，属所親眷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "c97a08a1ec7f880b70377db51a1985ed23f5907d28b6cdae5348bf92fdb24fae"}

{"id": "p_bff7d474e52d3122", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 56, "text": "玠答曰：『老臣以能守職，幸得免戾，今所说人非遷次，是以不敢奉命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "033255964ba67c5b3f534cb03af1d9ac2ea8774cce2e22b6af1d01258d053d52"}

{"id": "p_1c2216de001344f6", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 57, "text": "玠请谒不行，時人憚之，咸欲省東曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "d977e42799d8f06f4fd1806bb4a68fad13b6af85ac3bd40603ace20dece260b1"}

{"id": "p_4c20f78af74f068b", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 58, "text": "乃共白曰：『舊西曹爲上，東曹爲次，宜省東曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "44275079521686f49d4d84ff0a0ecd90c52581920253bb9a157994d5a1bb77b7"}

{"id": "p_257403c2b272f8b0", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 59, "text": "』太祖知其情，令曰：『日出於東，月盛於東，凡人言方，亦復先東，何以省東曹？", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "370250062ad2ddee76681bce192e5944cd345f62aa2db66c40976817b038e545"}

{"id": "p_a907cfaac0c93377", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 60, "text": "初，太祖平柳城，班所獲器物，特以素屏風素冯几賜玠，曰：『君有古人之風，故賜君古人之服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "e725c52cc3ed39deccb4ebfc59848c819314a6fc03463b8c0941d091faafe461"}

{"id": "p_e641cfc2dbc795d5", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 61, "text": "』玠居顯位，常布衣蔬食，撫育孤兄子甚篤，赏賜以振施贫族，家無所餘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "95f4fb98f2fb5dc43a5057b9ac695f36264e584f735e5b39fda8dcfc2aa83d1f"}

{"id": "p_00c56bc3057c4566", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 62, "text": "魏國初建，爲尚書僕射，復典选舉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "0f98cabe8b047a9d0fc87d1d9aa04c06d74aaa2b91ab49c5aa2242a64a883455"}

{"id": "p_e1d70b3d3003cb67", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 63, "text": "時太子未定，而臨菑侯植有寵，玠密諫曰：『近者袁紹以嫡庶不分，覆宗灭國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "f78c5538447be8db3c235322cbcbe92b8c98ebcf0e0f8b891329268be5bf057f"}

{"id": "p_a939339ece8cc1cd", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 64, "text": "』后羣僚會，玠起更衣，太祖目指曰：『此古所謂國之司直，我之周昌也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "81426b7ff0d15f3bd028d1c736e01867a33f6d237814f5ff2b0cdd68f46e0839"}

{"id": "p_862086335ecc3a2a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 65, "text": "后有白玠者：『出見黥面反者，其妻子没爲官奴婢，玠言曰「使天不雨者蓋此也」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "73e81d251ca90e7c0f63b77d0691c1fbc28f68409e0c3f06a49266f297bdab6e"}

{"id": "p_c25f16d25c133b54", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 66, "text": "太祖賜棺器钱帛，拜子机郎中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "5db9959c37689da427ebcfa38bd02967d49c0bf2307874034524e93ae4aeaf37"}

{"id": "p_054094afe4fcbbff", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 67, "text": "太祖爲司空，辟爲掾属，從西征馬超。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "750a8ce878c2e1e0e07fb5f934f7416c8a152a8923465988861f2004c93f030d"}

{"id": "p_139af3346c37596f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 68, "text": "時关中新服，未甚安，留奕爲丞相長史，镇撫西京，西京稱其威信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "ab871f413bb485c946c2ca808d8d56a6de14ce4429ccd69b00279977b2c7c560"}

{"id": "p_830f072d024eff79", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 69, "text": "转爲雍州刺史，復還爲東曹属。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "f85785bd9c4ddd2ad5c64fbd62aa522f35495b4438155ec50f32bada608ca342"}

{"id": "p_30ddc9ac3d5a6c81", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 70, "text": "丁儀等見寵於時，並害之，而奕終不爲动。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "9b68c9945b56ed2eb919a21ca0e54015e4cc5a6884eb2b7f0a8eebd54ee3dbea"}

{"id": "p_e5696bcd81feb0b4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 71, "text": "太祖征孫权，徙爲留府長史，謂奕曰：『君之忠亮，古人不過也，然微太严。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "393f3f7f6621d46d4f59fd832729c4aca7bcf5fb12f432505341126f21d1a96b"}

{"id": "p_937657c1ac17b094", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 72, "text": "昔西門豹佩韦以自缓，夫能以柔弱制剛强者，望之於君也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "b86526033bf79d822e875e0aa12f7a13b317a1bca52f289b79bd12fd7ef037e2"}

{"id": "p_b4bb45f6995ecc07", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 73, "text": "今使君統留事，孤無復還顧之忧也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "30c169361ab43ad17d2b8aca77cf3e99e2d2bac063075778f297082a0eeccb73"}

{"id": "p_b952293936852ab5", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 74, "text": "』魏國既建，爲尚書，復典选舉，遷尚書令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "77bba82e07c4c44fa8b0aa408bb85a44bf628cead64921768489782f8910ee96"}

{"id": "p_7d162ed9ce26204a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 75, "text": "太祖征漢中，魏讽等謀反，中尉楊俊左遷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "50d0ab0883763d452d203b7d84dfe6f4aa62903589e1645b31dc05e9e2e3f56d"}

{"id": "p_9f8cfea1d7b36308", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 76, "text": "太祖歎曰：『讽所以敢生亂心，以吾爪牙之臣無遏-{奸}-防謀者故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "d0f4b83f35f1ba835d3ddb5b0c41762704da93712e4c018ccde934aa3c0fadf0"}

{"id": "p_7fa8bba7d0c42ea6", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 77, "text": "安得如諸葛丰者，使代俊乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "0d8672ac32f4949ce16ec6b76378e7d199cdcac9e750133495d056294cb1e984"}

{"id": "p_ca24d5d0523745c5", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 78, "text": "』桓階曰：『徐奕其人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "2aa8995e8f8815aeb870ba382c35c390b99df3a8af8fa2e43cfd46262a712067"}

{"id": "p_565864e1db81385c", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 79, "text": "』太祖乃以奕爲中尉，手令曰：『昔楚有子玉，文公爲之侧席而坐；汲黯在朝，淮南爲之折謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "4b517d92353f1005aaf131192827975afde7bbd827bcfeece365a6660a949f3a"}

{"id": "p_e88e088d7e945226", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 80, "text": "詩稱「邦之司直」，君之謂與！", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "fefb4d1b5e04b74179e4861b1f8f3eb6019134b74bd15f44e8f21b0549dcdd30"}

{"id": "p_d634c4d33a97dcb6", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 81, "text": "』在職數月，疾篤乞退，拜諫議大夫，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "5ce123c317d093d92996d0b9a11666ce06ecc622926a1d9a2590889a25c17a29"}

{"id": "p_479a03ccd0d8b3da", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 82, "text": "何夔字叔龍，陳郡陽夏人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "109aa00784296d601284c3982bd63c876f2373d6a039651c447ecc58bf9e5076"}

{"id": "p_03ef561af745808c", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 83, "text": "曾祖父熙，漢安帝時官至车騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "d586abfbebe3bcba7aafb38ef6027bcb16aaa0cfbcbfe926618f5b675b07c294"}

{"id": "p_7aad679b995b8bfb", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 84, "text": "夔幼喪父，與母兄居，以孝友稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "1ab87150ad42931a0082e98d9401c6f275f184a3a64dbf9c6a5821b6788bee72"}

{"id": "p_bec786f84e106967", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 85, "text": "后袁术至壽春，辟之，夔不应，然遂爲术所留。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "8f9d7e0c0340ff0b3f8314dbf331ef2043e5f05e20799f406583d637710d42f7"}

{"id": "p_f4de7c2aef12d8b8", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 86, "text": "久之，术與桥蕤俱攻围蕲陽，蕲陽爲太祖固守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "f1e7f23276c25ce2402b12a146d95064d7ff1f912ca5c368dc9ea6fe9396a3ea"}

{"id": "p_d8ea044e8ec08137", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 87, "text": "术以夔彼郡人，欲胁令说蕲陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "86200c8de670889d47606920e3af74a8a695e61e8e0f5ecab7822882bd8a222d"}

{"id": "p_4732f1e27a89e740", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 88, "text": "夔謂术謀臣李業曰：『昔柳下惠聞伐國之謀而有忧色，曰「吾聞伐國不問仁人，斯言何爲至於我哉」！", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "c2bcda1f8f846fccde616497e7ae527485669022a74c0435ecfd7a52bddfa22f"}

{"id": "p_4121973b828f2c81", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 89, "text": "术知夔終不爲己用，乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "64cc70c702030b0ac1eecdac994eb03757c9cf1e99f3233348f8414611c96468"}

{"id": "p_48b02db33649a061", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 90, "text": "术從兄山陽太守遺母，夔從姑也，是以雖恨夔而不加害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "8b55a334dc7778f0d0670866074319aba9dc8c7d61044b6f79d17f4704133610"}

{"id": "p_4ffc219c1e6545d9", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 91, "text": "，夔將還鄉里，度术必急追，乃間行得免，明年到本郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "4bd01e8f452d2a50cc0be61bcfa1c17530673564ae6444661a07d6aea45fd5b5"}

{"id": "p_4b424a4f45321864", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 92, "text": "顷之，太祖辟爲司空掾属。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "ddc4039ed727a9a4af4c0f46096615922577683f91744b2b0e509720a3d00cd8"}

{"id": "p_73585ab97183b754", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 93, "text": "時有傳袁术軍亂者，太祖問夔曰；『君以爲信不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "ae49e0c3126b1a47ce82e71bec151bbee6b5e8f6400f37e48f14050802d81188"}

{"id": "p_604b0d68aded6551", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 94, "text": "』夔對曰：『天之所助者順，人之所助者信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "699b6915b80bfe07d3d7534732efa7b83ddef391319f9b0d75ad57f658a3874a"}

{"id": "p_1917de694cef6f53", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 95, "text": "术無信順之實，而望天人之助，此不可以得志於天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "b69cd17d0eef117e5d2975c85fd10f68c9904c70be45ddb498e785e0f34ef6f5"}

{"id": "p_94267b8b8953cc0d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 96, "text": "夫失道之主，親戚叛之，而况於左右乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "74f24d3364cb908b0e9dfbcf4785f5a1ff8861adb16a361000e803af911314cd"}

{"id": "p_2e7e654ff2c3ee8d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 97, "text": "』太祖曰；『爲國失賢則亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "f24393583315be1a9d831030db35a212d2a1082cb323152a7e0812d4b2e9e988"}

{"id": "p_f98f3860a76c5225", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 98, "text": "君不爲术所用；亂，不亦宜乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "dd5f0ab1183d7242016f93d7e96734e319a34e819adfe0058027c6cbf95eb4b3"}

{"id": "p_a26f7172c06c7388", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 99, "text": "』太祖性严，掾属公事，往往加杖；夔常畜毒药，誓死無辱，是以終不見及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "d6d2b952fb11f03bfa721001fec64846cef14891a42250bdee1d42b2fabb9e59"}

{"id": "p_1db8c7a92b6abe2f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 100, "text": "郡滨山海，黄巾未平，豪杰多背叛，袁谭就加以官位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "50cd1ac00378032dc572dd4c48af69cf4af52c200bd5ab52cd9bb0fabdc05cc0"}

{"id": "p_749796e69a90c55a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 101, "text": "長广縣人管承，徒眾三千餘家，爲寇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "c95a1b530ca817de847825ff15a8ad0918cff39dc1e38fcf6d1e0efce8c5058c"}

{"id": "p_394656dded0fd7c3", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 102, "text": "夔曰：『承等非生而樂亂也，习於亂，不能自還，未被德教，故不知反善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "7d4663348b95023f1b36238e1222b430bc500ea9c7e734cb03f8ae4d25abe034"}

{"id": "p_0cab76f6ad9e60a5", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 103, "text": "今兵迫之急，彼恐夷灭，必並力戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "16cf0e77ad275fe97a79bee91b923aea840476c622651725a7704f276ca1727c"}

{"id": "p_0a1277b7ac153552", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 104, "text": "攻之既未易拔，雖勝，必傷吏民，不如徐喻以恩德，使容自悔，可不煩兵而定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "f278bd78cd99e5b9cb57e5528b378a62bff8e1333bcc59040131b10736e2ede7"}

{"id": "p_a860f4bd5a49aea8", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 105, "text": "』乃遣郡丞黄珍往，爲陳成敗，承等皆请服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "81d262e818955b4bbed003b0bf66d408c5c184cff30d6b557396f3aec51bbca4"}

{"id": "p_1cb0ec194452fe6f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 106, "text": "夔遣吏成弘領校尉，長广縣丞等郊迎奉牛酒，诣郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "36312f97923b3bc834fb417237a99e8cfba084e51271e8b4b7c9f2c8bd546b58"}

{"id": "p_c4fab72b8e7f2fd3", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 107, "text": "矣平賊從钱，眾亦數千，夔率郡兵與張辽共讨定之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "a8be2a44126eed0d39cd92cb854b4e7a7f74dcc2ee79741b1ffcbc6939eca45d"}

{"id": "p_57fa444d35ca100d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 108, "text": "東牟人王营，眾三千餘家，胁昌陽縣爲亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "c6495e5fff0eae6c0f3dd80eb68066b0058a8517a27b6ede6d8624842e95713d"}

{"id": "p_d728deeb2b8b6851", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 109, "text": "夔遣吏王钦等，授以計略，使离散之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "edd119b4a3627ca280bd2ace58fe2598cddc5d583d5ef64486b5988c0f80b751"}

{"id": "p_7bdb1328bf1d4afc", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 110, "text": "是時太祖始制新科下州郡，又收租税綿絹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "0f03defdd986935283829a4e165146f9d8ea54b1ac5865477e6b8fc224091e86"}

{"id": "p_045da2a34f3101a8", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 111, "text": "夔以郡初立，近以師旅之後，不可卒绳以法，乃上言曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "f2044dc2df3fb7a0ea78028380bbbb0c64d7ebd9ab7f33d10340313302c6ed3e"}

{"id": "p_bf1827e928e886c4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 112, "text": "海賊郭祖寇暴樂安、濟南界，州郡苦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "27857404724f9d819a1c02437a3d3b16dfb35717b6b63dbd45c97e305adeae16"}

{"id": "p_0d86791f6d85a8a8", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 113, "text": "太祖以夔前在長广有威信，拜樂安太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "fa70df83c3221062bdc84197ec95972714416b52e9aeb07a45d753637699c284"}

{"id": "p_d4430368ea987373", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 114, "text": "文帝爲太子，以凉茂爲太傅，夔爲少傅；特命二傅與尚書東曹並选太子諸侯官属。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "6dce03e113c20fa9b9580d6cb9cc689423b1d668255bdd8d06a99faa15e51e5f"}

{"id": "p_c4683f540e28311b", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 115, "text": "每月朔，太傅入見太子，太子正法服而禮焉；他日無會儀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "c544b36e5a63d9ed9ffc98ec786c1d560d3a44ab1f976d1ddab187668ffa364a"}

{"id": "p_d035190c0fc0bc88", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 116, "text": "夔遷太僕，太子欲與辭，宿戒供，夔無往意；乃與書请之，夔以國有常制，遂不往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "bd600f290d6ac4c034431d4e7bb66f132602d0435d14a50c51d42d272d01d4d0"}

{"id": "p_b544323bbd0abab4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 117, "text": "然於節儉之世，最爲豪汰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "dd73de4f7e4f9635a23abfb4c20ba5b876cd4e4312380cd0cb9e0acd3e09e1d3"}

{"id": "p_8d241ec173c8ae89", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 118, "text": "文帝踐阼，封成陽亭侯，邑三百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "e023073e038289a78abe7184970428cf5604192b158d5ea190da50b95085bfe2"}

{"id": "p_56030dcb72c604c6", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 119, "text": "詔報曰：『蓋禮賢親舊，帝王之常务也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "a6bdef5be25289a729e43b06503e5b54d0e28d541ffc802757b7b6e42049f78a"}

{"id": "p_3f6eadefecfa9ef9", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 120, "text": "以親則君有輔弼之勛焉，以賢則君有醇固之茂焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "8cd5f915debe90c64426fe50777942d3de7f3b9eaaa089e8a4e6665dc9eb4c0d"}

{"id": "p_e6e7af63b3ead67f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 121, "text": "夫有陰德者必有陽報，今君疾雖未瘳，神明聽之矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "3a7379a442c2bff71644975ac579479615454adbe808e0d6d2b629fd9d582547"}

{"id": "p_75c88297a15709b4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 122, "text": "邢顒字子昂，河間鄚人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "8d1e580806e36ba4cbc42fdd7afee51e2a03d08eaf467bf23d5901a8b9dae381"}

{"id": "p_cfea90e833494838", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 123, "text": "舉孝廉，司徒辟，皆不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "5704b59acb81bacf42823519a3ca1468c21f80c7a7d9fb1babd076ed3c7b64eb"}

{"id": "p_5f090a00dee5774c", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 124, "text": "易姓字，適右北平，從田畴遊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "c26cee0647174d4e6898c9edec05f17cac2b7b5e83e59ab99eefa81535c6c9b9"}

{"id": "p_a87434770d32735b", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 125, "text": "顒謂畴曰：『黄巾起來二十餘年，海内鼎沸，百姓流离。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "644ffbab72c50c1371b6b2be6c2830ca1c6755575d0ec88ca4ab03a13793ed0d"}

{"id": "p_61939806861652a1", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 126, "text": "田畴曰：『邢顒，民之先觉也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "5e4ec35500d52c7ea4e968fa2a116d5fcab4edee0fc325c54dd552f71ef7f596"}

{"id": "p_493afee4b158c9dd", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 127, "text": "』乃見太祖，求爲鄉导以克柳城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "a2bdbd5c3071f242984ab4eac68ddc3845e1839a192148fe04b561341bc1c4be"}

{"id": "p_22d69c14df544959", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 128, "text": "太祖辟顒爲冀州從事，時人稱之曰：『德行堂堂邢子昂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "e28d83ccd570d9c54f13393bb1c502944d19e1ed26d1b50db3236cda62b05b4e"}

{"id": "p_3d1ed11a132446c6", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 129, "text": "』除广宗長，以故將喪棄官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "3c7bd703d35db51b6f6618482f664c06407a1f57af7b95c9cdeeb9853d9bb24c"}

{"id": "p_cf5c0ab5b21d75de", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 130, "text": "有司舉正，太祖曰：『顒篤於舊君，有一致之節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "0697d6415116afc97e5eaf24ea430a994fa5edb9f52a163529ec0c34b28f1f0c"}

{"id": "p_e22777ebe829d6d4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 131, "text": "更辟司空掾，除行唐令，劝民农桑，風化大行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "8aa46bb315a0cd8abc3575bb9df86b4ab5143b5d60f41babe00fcb87571aa80a"}

{"id": "p_09aab59e0a311b30", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 132, "text": "入爲丞相門下督，遷左冯翊，病，去官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "fe4e5d000bec3a8cf11bf550cce2a91f9c0b6366326e122338ac8cc5aa53abe2"}

{"id": "p_2609108399b15af4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 133, "text": "是時，太祖諸子高选官属，令曰：『侯家吏，宜得淵深法度如邢顒輩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "2178db06f02f27b8484005f0e49eeaee85b03ac62989f715908d2e7e14b6604e"}

{"id": "p_26bceab88d9bdeae", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 134, "text": "顒防闲以禮，無所屈撓，由是不合。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "d8b5698fe3181b73e3f45e63c93307ad3b0d82b786570dadc05a70e76955ab76"}

{"id": "p_f0c3f90df0e1ba46", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 135, "text": "庶子劉楨書諫植曰：『家丞邢顒，北土之彦，少秉高節，玄静澹泊，言少理多，真雅士也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "67462fc741455c9681fcec1e2a4ea9f71a468fa02054c9628bead9cbf3265121"}

{"id": "p_b7213e015aa088fb", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 136, "text": "楨誠不足同贯斯人，並列左右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "0524b242118679f7332dc3ded93d6e00b35a78548cc24fea7932a0ace9378c8b"}

{"id": "p_b0fa97bfbd0c9a7f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 137, "text": "而楨禮遇殊特，顒反疏簡，私惧觀者將謂君侯习近不肖，禮賢不足，采庶子之春華，忘家丞之秋實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "db91831ee57693b450730ae358db23910d5729fd975c27afa2dd2203d13136db"}

{"id": "p_f31c7e339e5d9210", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 138, "text": "爲上招謗，其罪不小，以此反侧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "194898d922f867fba1ac76f5476ece3807e2c3bc8c2be3ee4c9b892d4913038b"}

{"id": "p_c9eade57496b50b8", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 139, "text": "』后参丞相軍事，转東曹掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "99fbc099ae14343f45ce4ef558f7090fdc9ed707c40e16d28dcf178b194dfbcf"}

{"id": "p_1ebea92444622b65", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 140, "text": "初，太子未定，而臨菑侯植有寵，丁儀等並贊翼其美。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "e4248575cb93001e02ad2ca0ff42262a4a89b6c97a1d5e8622c1ae110b041339"}

{"id": "p_2b7069a23303fc50", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 141, "text": "太祖問顒，顒對曰：『以庶代宗，先世之戒也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "d4479c409005cf7684a4c1c16bc3604959c8b9982bb216e8af86877d089d3164"}

{"id": "p_43fbeb59b0d6bcf1", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 142, "text": "』太祖識其意，后遂以爲太子少傅，遷太傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "82482f65408155664a40ba50f2b5bf8b7656bc5bc15c03985fc1dfa031866b43"}

{"id": "p_e8d8156686c4a4fa", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 143, "text": "文帝踐阼，爲侍中尚書僕射，賜爵关内侯，出爲司隸校尉，徙太常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "e820f2ca75bd7aa34116360b764bf1f3b25a2a8a54ed59666e5d5f0b0abf53bb"}

{"id": "p_17eb1ddbc9f7875f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 144, "text": "鮑勛字叔業，泰山平陽人也，漢司隸校尉鮑宣九世孫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "1cd74459ab43c73698ec36e378413829ff1ab8d9543bddc959c0c96258d80a0a"}
