{"id": "p_50267e6b8eec0bfa", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 145, "text": "宣后嗣有從上党徙泰山者，遂家焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "a0251e6ba9379dd0ffb78b2a3ff45255e104041090bde0faab242c35b59c397e"}

{"id": "p_374516fbd5541ba6", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 146, "text": "勛父信，灵帝時爲騎都尉，大將軍何进遣東募兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "ba36f0e1ba43119cff39055d33cf6e160486cc452489761374e87ac297648924"}

{"id": "p_7d668a976cac97f5", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 147, "text": "后爲濟北相，协規太祖，身以遇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "fe2943ddb4221561367589bcc843ccca3b1559504843125dd386f91b26d99093"}

{"id": "p_3080bbd5a6e6b34e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 148, "text": "語在《董卓傳》、《武帝紀》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "ea5caffc289eee1fb9e7be1e985201e8dd037db8d34a42bfdbb4ff658352285c"}

{"id": "p_26bda81660138c76", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 149, "text": "，太祖追录信功，表封勛兄邵新都亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "1a63737026034407d81ecb31f0b8f1727ed01747533799c6d2f96df206923f8f"}

{"id": "p_f0ef84cabf54d0d5", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 150, "text": "二十二年，立太子，以勛爲中庶子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "f137a891b46aaa232e3807c8253951db72272e4236030da47815389d42e4951c"}

{"id": "p_20519f0be9462346", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 151, "text": "徙黄門侍郎，出爲魏郡西部都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "96904fd07e29f3b6ec711e03a16ddbc0132a1ac52483fab7ed9edd79aabc303f"}

{"id": "p_a2772eb4659d02ce", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 152, "text": "太子郭夫人弟爲曲周縣吏，斷盗官布，法应棄市。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "ed7f989b47993f5899f1caca222712a4aad8e218435c91eb9605663478b96393"}

{"id": "p_815156122e6c95c2", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 153, "text": "太祖時在谯，太子留鄴，數手書爲之请罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "36370972c5911a6e8ce58d0c2503fa364563d1e48847fa800a65db82c5048cae"}

{"id": "p_82e0905200436e13", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 154, "text": "勛前在東宫，守正不撓，太子固不能悦，及重此事，恚望滋甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "5c470cccc3456ae5a13608040b31c01034f8d0b829c1d0794ee64dd29d229900"}

{"id": "p_fe48c5d3a73260ba", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 155, "text": "會郡界休兵有失期者，密敕中尉奏免勛官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "e2dc8b1f5e0493a0867be12d3eca986db09ef39ffdd5c314776f7835ac5a8526"}

{"id": "p_39018d2b5114042d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 156, "text": "，太祖崩，太子即王位，勛以驸馬都尉兼侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "169ac80a361681b0f3f1619b80968d34a5bca0e24c0e98ce95c3716f94a9438a"}

{"id": "p_c78d1ecae247bd8f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 157, "text": "文帝受禅，勛每陳『今之所急，唯在軍农，寬惠百姓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "6e667e09063e391013d59deef0e835250a39b2d2b52591f0ca4f58fe33a880fe"}

{"id": "p_c963ff53e0e123c6", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 158, "text": "』文帝將出遊獵，勛停车上疏曰：『臣聞五帝三王，靡不明本立教，以孝治天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "f0bcf9187b4d5a5e9f2cc94d59cc6112d721019660d3c69d412f6acc11fa9585"}

{"id": "p_40287137d24f4930", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 159, "text": "陛下仁聖惻隱，有同古烈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "21956b9abf8e298e27494caf0140f60001bbcb26bf22c75228f4f21992a92747"}

{"id": "p_8c1d4cde7eb99b8e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 160, "text": "臣冀當继踪前代，令萬世可則也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "b1a9f0dee8241ab275db48c94b8863f538546e4e1d5e85e014ef480d5dd72dfb"}

{"id": "p_a64bcebe709b3a7d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 161, "text": "如何在諒闇之中，修馳骋之事乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "3077f82ef7f6ba40afddf56eb40cedf191c6f8c2a171a8f933481a0fd14c0d05"}

{"id": "p_b570216f82f71122", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 162, "text": "臣冒死以聞，唯陛下察焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "bc3a4e5bb948b98f216e078482d34677ff1d0d7c40ada00ee0bb61707aabea7f"}

{"id": "p_3104428baba7e871", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 163, "text": "』帝手毁其表而竞行獵，中道顿息，問侍臣曰：『獵之爲樂，何如八音也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "9a29f506a78cf9990525f732733fcd0e32dee552c894fe40e1d334b4a6123c14"}

{"id": "p_58613aea84507b4a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 164, "text": "』侍中劉晔對曰：『獵勝於樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "c3b73c30ffc7b79f1ac576193dfe9d2df59ed1802711e871eada45d6e3cd6e33"}

{"id": "p_56516995f287f8d3", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 165, "text": "』勛抗辭曰：『夫樂，上通神明，下和人理，隆治致化，萬邦咸乂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "7cb62c83f41dfae95bf80bba637ffad4898cbc8803b6ef67c527c12bb892e88b"}

{"id": "p_cb63e0523b6192dd", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 166, "text": "况獵，暴華蓋於原野，傷生育之至理，栉風沐雨，不以時隙哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "594c6be7ff8168b22323258df6f6ed1ecb4e26266f0b17158d6f9a894bdb8900"}

{"id": "p_81f7ff333f5cbd9f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 167, "text": "昔魯隱觀渔於棠，春秋譏之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "f8b6208e4c543315a445362c4ca21c397261d431ab8c25777499a8f75918a223"}

{"id": "p_c13830867900c6b4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 168, "text": "雖陛下以爲务，愚臣所不原也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "5ff80cbfa2f9a644604c21ca9d69af0b5bef6ef2c70cd1bae1a63f9ad6289f12"}

{"id": "p_b04b9b3ef1586824", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 169, "text": "』因奏：『劉晔佞谀不忠，阿順陛下過戏之言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "ddcc051e27dc58efccf822f1220e153a5360e253fbb0a665c38528fe1668caec"}

{"id": "p_43a805785524f6eb", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 170, "text": "昔梁丘据取媚於遄臺，晔之謂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "4387065e4c7892bbc81bb0cb61130e02fad02cb6e0471f7a50d2e97c7d64c863"}

{"id": "p_f238d4b5439c9549", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 171, "text": "』帝怒作色，罷還，即出勛爲右中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "d6858394fa5bf3182754b3a32eafebb7efca85905d9411543fecae00090a370f"}

{"id": "p_69d67be19888f17f", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 172, "text": "，尚書令陳羣、僕射司馬宣王並舉勛爲宫正，宫正即御史中丞也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "59f1ec52e4b0787324ee5c5e268f99365570c24be837cd34b4123fcdadee7fe3"}

{"id": "p_8303c3dfebf0c770", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 173, "text": "帝不得已而用之，百寮严憚，罔不肃然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "fb5e95a4fe49d07e5e74a51648b864ff0246cd96a0b00ddad531d58cb6437d62"}

{"id": "p_7ce9ae34f1fe4d27", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 174, "text": "六年秋，帝欲征吴，羣臣大議，勛面諫曰：『王師屡征而未有所克者，蓋以吴、蜀脣齿相依，凭阻山水，有難拔之勢故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "8e378b20a3fbdfe8c03dfea455e1afd9bab4f3ee221a776cd0e22e5e7f00db69"}

{"id": "p_b808cc529327d9f1", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 175, "text": "往年龍舟飘荡，隔在南岸，聖躬蹈危，臣下破胆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "a9e2e84b8539a29671832bceea9b9d5698d7084dc7e2cf91d3c3134d07715c27"}

{"id": "p_ff9361baa63273eb", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 176, "text": "此時宗庙几至倾覆，爲百世之戒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "4b637fb3d02366f257d1ba14ef9d60dc9ce42be7d8a60309da723933a2324404"}

{"id": "p_f6f9ec558bdda3c7", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 177, "text": "今又勞兵襲遠，日费千金，中國虚耗，令黠虏玩威，臣竊以爲不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "d86bfcd47884eda06561455ba755252e38f0aac558bff50df00de652bcbb6b51"}

{"id": "p_03b034d399387cd8", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 178, "text": "』帝益忿之，左遷勛爲治書執法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "6e3c5900952d2e3910ac6f166b5fe92cc16805fa388076d0109a6d18594ef226"}

{"id": "p_e3cf5a0a8c88e233", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 179, "text": "帝從壽春還，屯陳留郡界。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "935c5681d2e8dc6dc1a87abdd93c3deaed41753f69ca7eb3ea7bc320c1c230a9"}

{"id": "p_ea4479090c72fec0", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 180, "text": "時营垒未成，但立标埒，邕邪行不從正道，軍营令史劉曜欲推之，勛以堑垒未成，解止不舉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "59ff74c057a857c9dee111f1f4bd0a9c2a47c68d0b74368a606d8917d729f49a"}

{"id": "p_715822208f5c3381", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 181, "text": "大軍還洛陽，曜有罪，勛奏绌遣，而曜密表勛私解邕事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "2772217e0f2bb9e75278cce100bab7aed7d1a2490f95a4e8a0dbaca8ab6b1479"}

{"id": "p_556e5d600170972d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 182, "text": "詔曰：『勛指鹿作馬，收付廷尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "e55ad6fbd368c1bbec67c77be9693a3fa1383b29dc6a6ce2ee42bfd1b9dcbde3"}

{"id": "p_31dc76943cab0b48", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 183, "text": "』廷尉法議：『正刑五歲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "dcf32439baca709890c93b3bdd30979cd56d0eb5b4aeb27e318d591039aa27e1"}

{"id": "p_7cbb8299462cad0d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 184, "text": "』三官駮：『依律罰金二斤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "c004110008f5ad37c98ec91506b63ffbe936d017181b2a519c6705475729f4ba"}

{"id": "p_f9d502f8cf83dd26", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 185, "text": "』帝大怒曰：『勛無活分，而汝等敢纵之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "d4f9f5af1b9174e8614d2e4954b979ae753fbfa8174144b5e7c5ea0944e0434a"}

{"id": "p_383cff74bc7b6547", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 186, "text": "收三官已下付刺-{奸}-，當令十鼠同穴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "d74090a1393b95840fb97ee94109b74c956e6f1fdbed985d714464abe9e0d153"}

{"id": "p_63913ae751888a4c", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 187, "text": "』太尉锺繇、司徒華歆、镇軍大將軍陳羣、侍中辛毗、尚書卫臻、守廷尉高柔等並表『勛父信有功於太祖』，求请勛罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "562ce21c57d27b5809bed158306478e668597846a2f7a4bbf6fff2805b36d3a1"}

{"id": "p_3bfbaa06602e3a79", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 188, "text": "勛内行既脩，廉而能施，死之日，家無餘财。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "12a41bde48fab9251c1173fdafb9174b7226667e71d13b99fc02918544ee0d17"}

{"id": "p_c77513749caa1e74", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 189, "text": "后二旬，文帝亦崩，莫不爲勛歎恨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "6590f43bfa3b84658d9f9d4b3598ee3cd68977dc83940a3928572609f575cfcc"}

{"id": "p_508fd77a25b4ffe8", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 190, "text": "司馬芝字子華，河内温人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "10211cba3696192295e25f5e7781ea9e60341097d5402c51a2247d77e595424c"}

{"id": "p_a7d7d5ad04171f9e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 191, "text": "少爲書生，避亂荆州，於魯陽山遇賊，同行者皆棄老弱走，芝獨坐守老母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "c1a632639c5c1ceebe59c86c5a06ee6137929637e3bb3be2ddc0e5b772fd3599"}

{"id": "p_ae412017d7208d4a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 192, "text": "賊至，以刃臨芝，芝叩头曰：『母老，唯在諸君！", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "0bd03519369b0f3250e4de9fe75d5366bab92d92a96e3318a84d3eb579a06b30"}

{"id": "p_eec7ddf522ee5234", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 193, "text": "』賊曰：『此孝子也，殺之不義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "0b6aace10df087045592f208a74207ebf382dc10eaf76e72ed21d9d48c94b3ea"}

{"id": "p_da6f506ab77ee437", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 194, "text": "』遂得免害，以鹿车推載母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "7348b86539976d7583d32a4eef95d5a7b782f75715aecd7d2871b3bfafc7b71e"}

{"id": "p_c52d228c84a701ba", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 195, "text": "居南方十餘年，躬耕守節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "0bbd7c22fd48e75b1d121785d59d405336e036e731cc7ceb73ade7893f8c412c"}

{"id": "p_d6a9bc968f6af305", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 196, "text": "太祖平荆州，以芝爲菅長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "0a96a507bb527f12677675d2b4c9980168f6a4b78d14d2cfac69b3559c5672af"}

{"id": "p_b99e735ad0513511", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 197, "text": "郡主簿劉節，舊族豪侠，賓客千餘家，出爲盗賊，入亂吏治。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "68b2b4a3d84b9d4343be69d0678f6d4d2170b2c14aae7e7a96238426f90d4097"}

{"id": "p_79bd7c70464ccccf", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 198, "text": "顷之，芝差節客王同等爲兵，掾史据白：『節家前后未嘗给繇，若至時藏匿，必爲留负。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "91b6dfd6119d9f5076803601d174d2b54001c26b20de6109611990835fd3e77a"}

{"id": "p_0caa73e0f7241717", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 199, "text": "』芝不聽，與節書曰：『君爲大宗，加股肱郡，而賓客每不與役，既眾庶怨望，或流聲上聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "7ac1c93966ee7ffdbd661d944088adbe470f68470496cd3009c4f31b520f346b"}

{"id": "p_bcaa13499e6acf21", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 200, "text": "今（条）同等爲兵，幸時发遣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "9c3bb745d8119fc6d1f42f69df3e0cfa26ddbbabdd26447b9f1e9786b884a217"}

{"id": "p_7461575a8e3293f4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 201, "text": "』兵已集郡，而節藏同等，因令督郵以軍兴诡责縣，縣掾史穷困，乞代同行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "b0a9facb69ffe9718649f1874d61354a277b5a349d25e73856e105c438018c8d"}

{"id": "p_072e41fcf636e702", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 202, "text": "芝乃馳檄濟南，具陳節罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "dcb1d7ee2a4451d70dff2506db8edc048ba8d9726d1902d15dcd7390a681f9da"}

{"id": "p_97ec72fb8cd4431b", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 203, "text": "太守郝光素敬信芝，即以節代同行，青州號芝『以郡主簿爲兵』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "95af716dee6f8a52543a0769dcaffd5d3e8ca2eebf005d6e42013c407f556657"}

{"id": "p_93bd0a17a5c588a1", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 204, "text": "征虏將軍劉勛，貴寵骄豪，又芝故郡將，賓客子弟在界數犯法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "6d294cc128971cdcee03a6fc219c0e3e7a6e734597848bef30ed417a52106020"}

{"id": "p_e1e8b7d69c586901", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 205, "text": "勛與芝書，不著姓名，而多所属讬，芝不報其書，一皆如法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "a762642b9fd0d0948ac6fa9c3ed5d7acea7c1cb5dadc12f44ddd4d7043fb3cd5"}

{"id": "p_3df4f60146530abf", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 206, "text": "后勛以不轨誅，交关者皆獲罪，而芝以見稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "1f3b6099495f26e2ed4fa86bb1ad0b637e390403481b026bd946d1c68cafa66d"}

{"id": "p_ee53438ce71fd68d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 207, "text": "有盗官练置都厕上者，吏疑女工，收以付獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "1d42bb56e07e5e2c22109285828a48b5a18a05803d99080cdeadf656651d135b"}

{"id": "p_9e79cc76ff76be50", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 208, "text": "芝曰：『夫刑罪之失，失在苛暴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "ec8a7b8f3f1307783ae88ce558744ebef129dd22a815c083da95d691b77d54da"}

{"id": "p_0b7f868067e62fb4", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 209, "text": "今赃物先得而后讯其辭，若不勝掠，或至诬服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "3acaa9ab6c0fef69e9edbe8a6c2f1c80213b9304a0f77aab8980eac53ae51a35"}

{"id": "p_0e3d70fe77660d3e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 210, "text": "且簡而易從，大人之化也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "0828ad9cd0e4c49656e9283734ba4f18567ce50ed65b69a4cb7cc2383bf4a2ae"}

{"id": "p_b8d47c3c7085d97c", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 211, "text": "今宥所疑，以隆易從之義，不亦可乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "310f76998cd9422589204041c98900562fec7c99a796d1686cffd7a5a8d2a83b"}

{"id": "p_8444b8210d3ea466", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 212, "text": "历甘陵、沛、陽平太守，所在有绩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "0c22f583756a900ad74d42e25d8003e4ed3df40a20867b4bff555d98d91872ce"}

{"id": "p_11afd877ddb130c2", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 213, "text": "黄初中，入爲河南尹，抑强扶弱，私请不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "680bf7571a3a51ea5922e1bc8ee084e8e1e46be5ad882a22cf395d583e3b183c"}

{"id": "p_f872e3ab5d89e393", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 214, "text": "會内官欲以事讬芝，不敢发言，因芝妻伯父董昭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "b59bee8362e4e21026d97335272293c586a09116bf109239ffdd0a22653bc029"}

{"id": "p_98e17f917bc4fd37", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 215, "text": "芝爲教與羣下曰：『蓋君能設教，不能使吏必不犯也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "783e13fe42a40b354e1b159d7804e1408a3b336163edebe6a8dbef3eb36a38e9"}

{"id": "p_cff9b3651cad6a5e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 216, "text": "吏能犯教，而不能使君必不聞也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "6d61b5ce10c6ce2c404aba8fafd4ef657ba6639a5005cd3e6a604e8fbeec3234"}

{"id": "p_ba4aff9c0aa24538", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 217, "text": "夫設教而犯，君之劣也；犯教而聞，吏之祸也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "86c0f8eab0bd263edf2d0c0a098686df72c679052adfdf3fc7c604ef6abd73d8"}

{"id": "p_f4286118758177ae", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 218, "text": "君劣於上，吏祸於下，此政事所以不理也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "48b4024ffb42738e1869cc1c093001475f7e6a6a97da92c98081b5fcf4e7e2be"}

{"id": "p_18f5875bc0af4e21", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 219, "text": "門下循行嘗疑門幹盗簪，幹辭不符，曹執爲獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "6243530e75c10f0e250e90f4dd0f43ee6b0ecf756c2174a4a92a6ad983b80451"}

{"id": "p_363ab05b6a7649bd", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 220, "text": "芝教曰：『凡物有相似而難分者，自非离娄，鲜能不惑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "c4121852e10a66e3f2e10972aa9af085e58f6f637dae3f499eeb4efac3750d73"}

{"id": "p_c867d3984d62181a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 221, "text": "就其實然，循行何忍重惜一簪，輕傷同類乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "07b68dbee6118cebf43247919870fcf488b209c47d2985c1479f27b43db02755"}

{"id": "p_298951623c2cfb3b", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 222, "text": "顷之，特进曹洪乳母當，與臨汾公主侍者共事無涧神系獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "ca33a1085b900b020eef8ca6fbc7a7623704767a9e70898e2f9898354efd40c9"}

{"id": "p_ae32b643bc0f447d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 223, "text": "卞太后遣黄門诣府傳令，芝不通，輒敕洛陽獄考竟，而上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "9c0dba6972f23e0a4437b4d0032ad07740e0156b28135679070ce3d9bbfa5a87"}

{"id": "p_c472b9b82bfa445a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 224, "text": "帝手報曰：『省表，明卿至心，欲奉詔書，以权行事，是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "81ef91d2c6658a15e3c6a64509996e70b6d3d4e8612601ce6e8cd26c55e2138f"}

{"id": "p_4d54c66716841d41", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 225, "text": "此乃卿奉詔之意，何謝之有？", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "9d0b17b4d723115b8a6fa27f750daa83dabdc2b28fdc3c2a7053e770f9f19da7"}

{"id": "p_8e11a84bae3abc4a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 226, "text": "』芝居官十一年，數議科条所不便者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "74898172fb52506c6c2757d9d3e4ae060dc79a90aa5c36aa158166ec6b4fa2ca"}

{"id": "p_0e22e0f0bcb987e6", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 227, "text": "會諸王來朝，與京都人交通，坐免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "b21aaa1220362f3c5c406a09a0362a3dca2e1396e798f5e3f6f8cc2c1d238634"}

{"id": "p_c23db068e4ec1ebd", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 228, "text": "先是諸典农各部吏民，末作治生，以要利入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "7ab4d85db7c63749f2e57703c46697526952e3140551dca8f25aecfe011a6dea"}

{"id": "p_0040574ad2f0af93", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 229, "text": "每上官有所召問，常先見掾史，爲斷其意故，教其所以答塞之狀，皆如所度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "d701875452642490a624f27ddef86193956cc2b281a900720e71e94141a61718"}

{"id": "p_71644813f9a8c12e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 230, "text": "與賓客談論，有不可意，便面折其短，退無異言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "96307e8736c060d917e9fbe084ee4bbc8f1df25d9c6961c695f7ee6483a17ec2"}

{"id": "p_fb32785614b8fc2e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 231, "text": "卒於官，家無餘财，自魏迄今爲河南尹者莫及芝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "7692e49d51de693c590697825dfbb25b3484ad8a72442bae0efff2df7c837401"}

{"id": "p_4ce09dea26a2f736", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 232, "text": "芝亡，子岐嗣，從河南丞转廷尉正，遷陳留相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "2c79ff314213c0c657a206b2b2ab8a110395b9ae4660e4713d231d5ae55cfa86"}

{"id": "p_50c5aef220ab372d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 233, "text": "梁郡有系囚，多所连及，數歲不决。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "f5cdfccb5c814fb180ace91574eab9e3a4a68d303f84b0576de48502b8251367"}

{"id": "p_b7044a915667cb94", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 234, "text": "詔書徙獄于岐属縣，縣请豫治牢具。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "529833bf92e0d472f6c158d5418aed078224e85016fd3d15bbe9d87dd2a31318"}

{"id": "p_1b941bb54c54c37a", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 235, "text": "岐曰：『今囚有數十，既巧诈難符，且已倦楚毒，其情易見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "c297a614be910beb30f3f51fbe6dfa65b6851d4b0cdcda64d6377e837337c6af"}

{"id": "p_cae85fcce0bdd545", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 236, "text": "』及囚室，诘之，皆莫敢匿诈，一朝决竟，遂超爲廷尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "5b43f428c3e29547b3fe5ae60e48784586b6bd92f000bba3c8a9ec0ba852e7a0"}

{"id": "p_13da6997777b3d69", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 237, "text": "是時大將軍爽专权，尚書何晏、邓飏等爲之輔翼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "c23be6a70b1ec484f70dae95f1c9fe0429d474abd4ff87dcf7318bff79d90550"}

{"id": "p_c1ff872f253693c6", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 238, "text": "南陽圭泰嘗以言迕指，考系廷尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "96f2f96e625f56872f28b435477c73dee2caa9bdd5247d370cacdaedd2f2a538"}

{"id": "p_1417c53e312507f1", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 239, "text": "岐數飏曰：『夫枢机大臣，王室之佐，既不能輔化成德，齊美古人，而乃肆其私忿，枉論無辜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "193f695b4cd16cfe810ef3365694ac7b8f802252ee988750b004a94e9b2ed2ee"}

{"id": "p_f5c153c4d9a7542e", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 240, "text": "岐終恐久獲罪，以疾去官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "27cacd834d9017a35281b5a5d4e30561961a0cf10e46b70c7523f6199ab3badc"}

{"id": "p_aad2b667925d5bf1", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 241, "text": "居家未期而卒，年三十五。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "79838b4bbd29e39e60e55779bc9fe9e5b422aa886627979d700980887717e0ff"}

{"id": "p_e41f6102257fead8", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 242, "text": "评曰：徐奕、何夔、邢顒貴尚峻厲，爲世名人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "a6dbd3aadfff003ba2e1da7ccfc25dd98c01d0566ae03d8987e26b35a2b4c0d4"}

{"id": "p_c9737c2a33e0041d", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 243, "text": "毛玠清公素履，司馬芝忠亮不倾，庶乎不吐剛茹柔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "4e713dafcb4c7e2aee0c0af465f90b810dd70561b8bd4077af6c396c7c388514"}

{"id": "p_eb541472bc614e0b", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 244, "text": "崔琰高格最優，鮑勛秉正無亏，而皆不免其身，惜哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "5962966cb3fcc58947a3d9402b4e3fde426a06406a2ed6ae4829457389ece76e"}

{"id": "p_059c0108fa1abefb", "source_id": "src_0c206a912d4a1720", "ordinal": 245, "text": "大雅貴『既明且哲』，虞書尚『直而能温』，自非兼才，畴克備諸！", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "9da759f2e77fbcf1321be2fd597c43d116be10b05d95d8afc23dd93903af1f9b"}

{"id": "p_e4ee1e59962e3685", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_61ab6f946a599f07", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 1, "text": "鍾繇字元常，頴川長社人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "ea013927b564f42bda201d42a5a9c26dd8694e09fa449dd9c1d7dc903798eacf"}

{"id": "p_0cd8097fc8d1274d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 2, "text": "甞與族父瑜俱至洛陽，道遇相者，曰：「此童有貴相，然當厄於水，努力慎之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "6ed28ec3d0668dc9c4a57897e8738bddd155297c5d77ab7ff96679a0b153690f"}

{"id": "p_9bb93d75f5554237", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 3, "text": "」行未十里，度橋，馬驚，墯水幾死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "96475b06e6bf15af81955f10065d70d044495e2e9b1dbeb498c80781e3173838"}

{"id": "p_7ccc1497914ffb2e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 4, "text": "瑜以相者言中，益貴繇，而供給資費，使得專學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "8bc4efc5d403a3e68b49a41f9619454135cf957d77361daf9653e6a259b08559"}

{"id": "p_1cf0daf598b4f992", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 5, "text": "舉孝廉，除尚書郎、陽陵令，以疾去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "7480277289d6da4adbd1539a8a6afecd60da659aa16e282e36166e4510bb29d9"}

{"id": "p_61284a69a5903ebc", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 6, "text": "辟三府，爲廷尉正、黃門侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "30406028bcb3e9aae6f858e6dfaa222730ddfb2812b9a1013e53e13b5bd3e593"}

{"id": "p_7037219fbfd41d82", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 7, "text": "是時，漢帝在西京，李傕、郭汜等亂長安中，與關東斷絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "aa6e7529ef1b130b071300c3579a882482407c57f95ad1557a29a3d9c4388aa3"}

{"id": "p_db08d68b2828f6b5", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 8, "text": "太祖領兖州牧，始遣使上書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "616652aa64f4efc62da57687c810acc1b4c1bcbbc793704902de3a20286da32f"}

{"id": "p_ef2d8464f96b5fb0", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 9, "text": "傕、汜等以爲「關東欲自立天子，今曹操雖有使命，非其至實」，議留太祖使，拒絕其意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "5387f285d996a7ed0787c49021cc47d2f6db77c4654c2b5d3785ba9c7cda64ca"}

{"id": "p_adf9cd861b271394", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 10, "text": "繇說傕、汜等曰：「方今英雄並起，各矯命專制，唯曹兖州乃心王室，而逆其忠款，非所以副將來之望也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "30ad4c0e52ec2ec9138464b5f5b3915fb76783a61cba32f1e159afdd0e75a35f"}

{"id": "p_e32dd0c9f1a46ded", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」傕、汜等用繇言，厚加荅報，由是太祖使命遂得通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "446c34e831f15337e8210ecb8819f9536f0fe9ad500c04df1487310543fd2c54"}

{"id": "p_f4858d0da57ff9b5", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 12, "text": "太祖旣數聽荀彧之稱繇，又聞其說傕、汜，益虛心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "578d2c2d0899e28ba4deaea910176dd0d9fd668d3a070644586e2b917d985861"}

{"id": "p_c46ff8cc9e472b77", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 13, "text": "後傕脅天子，繇與尚書郎韓斌同策謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "d1976019653bf9d6d110224b270b458b04ca82a4c298b3e5af374477c58ab4f8"}

{"id": "p_02eda99852e50a98", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 14, "text": "天子得出長安，繇有力焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "5459fe1b1eb48fe2e635bc2d0efb3b0c84b1f783d282d65010629175161efd44"}

{"id": "p_023ac2aeb96c393b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 15, "text": "拜御史中丞，遷侍中尚書僕射，并錄前功封東武亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "795fdceb88fabed1c1d6f1b044e46a5bd0d31fb3ba9cd2d25a24c332a446205e"}

{"id": "p_4a47ca46d0fa1c3f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 16, "text": "時關中諸將馬騰、韓遂等，各擁彊兵相與爭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "62238f7a1b20fc75904ae64f9a19d7cad3fdef4fe4452229ff16fb65a90705ac"}

{"id": "p_2f2143325aa2893e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 17, "text": "太祖方有事山東，以關右爲憂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "5da931e680d54dd9af83e9b099ae1f161b2a5c058eb61e3df191046231c4d1c5"}

{"id": "p_5ddcb519cbd3af39", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 18, "text": "乃表繇以侍中守司隷校尉，持節督關中諸軍，委之以後事，特使不拘科制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "8de70f51a6e28901f916ee64de7ee46609651052fd7cffd63dcd882e12155ec3"}

{"id": "p_e4856380ee784053", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 19, "text": "繇至長安，移書騰、遂等，爲陳禍福，騰、遂各遣子入侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "81149a67904d9c55c120740c51be7ca6754a5dfee34c66a2de1965cb65bcbf8b"}

{"id": "p_8664c1e777ce7ef8", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 20, "text": "太祖在官渡，與袁紹相持，繇送馬二千餘匹給軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "0756e7bbfafb33454f6bf366592802f881137cea6dd695fc4b60d521222a8ca8"}

{"id": "p_d4874a4160468d32", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 21, "text": "太祖與繇書曰：「得所送馬，甚應其急。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "0195ae5d7bc295b4adccfd5a4a427ed2ee3197eb7a0e7cc89235c53dfc1c6011"}

{"id": "p_dd69edd32bdcf24b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 22, "text": "關右平定，朝廷無西顧之憂，足下之勳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "a5cb5df7669c7a676334a25e3e1c0f480edcdf9f4723e6335868373d92f5cc0c"}

{"id": "p_bc89ed7aef93bcab", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 23, "text": "昔蕭何鎮守關中，足食成軍，亦適當爾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "e1734a23a519f7112bc9793cc28344c31ed9860a20af5b6c4432893850b90841"}

{"id": "p_8bd4a47db2834947", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」其後匈奴單于作亂平陽，繇帥諸軍圍之，未拔；而袁尚所置河東太守郭援到河東，衆甚盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "b7e037aaa37df5f9f45f493d7ee13d2cd4dcd53878485c8d77c0e54639b962f0"}

{"id": "p_51581790392732d7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 25, "text": "諸將議欲釋之去，繇曰：「袁氏方彊，援之來，關中陰與之通，所以未悉叛者，顧吾威名故耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "6f0a883a96cc65abf5275433ee7b324729848e656c6610629e0309b352b66fa9"}

{"id": "p_a47a5b0a03c9d9f1", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 26, "text": "若棄而去，示之以弱，所在之民，誰非寇讎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "61e0f62c809e4bac8d543ed0825cfd97c7d17feaf4232885b1a25d5694164e04"}

{"id": "p_acdf2ead3f95d896", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 27, "text": "且援剛愎好勝，必易吾軍，若渡汾爲營，及其未濟擊之，可大克也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "93280739ffcaec89ad462fca9cb83b2db949a5f0524b83c478b6cfdb889fa1a3"}

{"id": "p_e92a68975aba158a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」張旣說馬騰會擊援，騰遣子超將精兵逆之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "90f97282f0a733d47741e1baecd469e131973cf10944f59ff4c02bc196b9b470"}

{"id": "p_9abe1ced2eaf50ac", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 29, "text": "援至，果輕渡汾，衆止之，不從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "14e27cec44cc89b8f2dddef2599f9a444ef4bd76925981f55734a55de4a43670"}

{"id": "p_4f091b5326590769", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 30, "text": "濟水未半，擊，大破之，斬援，降單于。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "d4fe65b41a7a8d0e8710402d1a3f1f0987081e11e1a9c7238c0641b60d98b666"}

{"id": "p_4a8851b4b6020eb1", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 31, "text": "其後河東衞固作亂，與張晟、張琰及高幹等並爲寇，繇又率諸將討破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "ca1bdef5c60035d159e89589d72e259d58f06ffd543be44f8876c7365f96e039"}

{"id": "p_d6f07c51101e2cdf", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 32, "text": "自天子西遷，洛陽人民單盡，繇徙關中民，又招納亡叛以充之，數年間民戶稍實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "2c5d25ef396455ef6c3c6933ee679cf52d97b15d58a31f50673b619db1ba098a"}

{"id": "p_4ddb4d04dfaf616a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 33, "text": "太祖征關中，得以爲資，表繇爲前軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "d5cfb515d662ae8e7348ad6d6cd369ac7f00fe6f1ee7b84f90f48f9190d58b93"}

{"id": "p_cabba1aac2525233", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 34, "text": "魏國初建，爲大理，遷相國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "678e1e66ebbc99bcb36110e499438dad434f0e98999437de87857590ccb66d8a"}

{"id": "p_6f4f24bc226b3eb3", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 35, "text": "文帝在東宮，賜繇五熟釜，爲之銘曰：「於赫有魏，作漢藩輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "fca0b269f1a3508b635f6dc6d4b4d7c5c5c29556f311b270a3e8b1d8cf320de9"}

{"id": "p_743d5adafd8c2b5e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 36, "text": "」數年，坐西曹掾魏諷謀反，策罷就第。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "760a9e0e1c04ac3920a83696f0d09cf98e306a43b6696f710e0c1a775dec7d30"}

{"id": "p_bc98db94344d38c7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 37, "text": "及踐阼，改爲廷尉，進封崇高鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "335c8aa375b11493d589ecfd3c9432bceaa4c31ee6e2092e12f1c99e0f0e759c"}

{"id": "p_4ddfb96f1547fff8", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 38, "text": "時司徒華歆、司空王朗，並先世名臣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "5c8775f9ea0036fa4dcf64828c6e1593e59fdb62174538b039d65648bbcb632f"}

{"id": "p_d90994537c1d18f0", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 39, "text": "文帝罷朝，謂左右曰：「此三公者，乃一代之偉人也，後世殆難繼矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "eb554e64376cc05aae9eb87014e9faf555865e59765587500eb1380bc7f7ddc8"}

{"id": "p_9621a92c0e26a409", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」明帝即位，進封定陵侯，增邑五百，并前千八百戶，遷太傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "f0cba66f337aa2eb18bb026e87ab1e027f61e8fba3936720cf72952c564cc09f"}

{"id": "p_145faad2ddabb869", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 41, "text": "時華歆亦以高年疾病，朝見皆使載輿車，虎賁舁上殿就坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "82a448e78ab4077b16301d3ad7b8ec2bf7a43533bef740163a19dd380227b2c4"}

{"id": "p_1d9797973b186157", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 42, "text": "是後三公有疾，遂以爲故事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "09b457269d9ce1361966c7ca341054e103cba04cb22ed280d31a195291c98861"}

{"id": "p_9dbf81cd415fb778", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 43, "text": "初，太祖下令，使平議死刑可宮割者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "f0217f7630e5ab737d98b1a6b2160d25fc642e2bd10b1ce872c17e6f7a40e551"}

{"id": "p_4e160acbff32d328", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 44, "text": "繇以爲「古之肉刑，更歷聖人，宜復施行，以代死刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "e626e2f30d77328fb6b3d42bda8aa4979c2648092c18624e0ac7e97633f361bb"}

{"id": "p_cde106d6e1cb959b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」議者以爲非恱民之道，遂寢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "166e1b4a4bbca1da2b82d637acf2cc033f1757956198c67e86247cc2478a0d33"}

{"id": "p_f3ca2b7dd7992e63", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 46, "text": "及文帝臨饗群臣，詔謂「大理欲復肉刑，此誠聖王之法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "fa98d68a274bbc08679a3cfb384f9599e0b6c4d4d546f6b343a4ea882bfdf66c"}

{"id": "p_6bbf94b35a06f354", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 47, "text": "」議未定，會有軍事，復寢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "53d467637b61b55bb74bcc77c9e00b5d13e3f6ee532e219a9a67bb3d777bf9f5"}

{"id": "p_9ae21f28ff3dbfd9", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 48, "text": "太和中，繇上疏曰：「大魏受命，繼蹤虞、夏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "0552a06ad4353e4034b101f6db6fbcd734b44e82fc84ab131d0e10b9f38a97d5"}

{"id": "p_dcfd5bb00845b01f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 49, "text": "先帝聖德，固天所縱，墳典之業，一以貫之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "29c05f5fdfc50455427ff3871e6dd7c1e24b2ff093c6ef8ffc272789f653db5c"}

{"id": "p_d90643725f74b976", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 50, "text": "是以繼世，仍發明詔，思復古刑，爲一代法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "b3db3628d5017364457ce7cdbbf4b8dc98044c7aeaa748225ddb6c9c5b703823"}

{"id": "p_dd0b76b1ec819b9e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 51, "text": "陛下遠追二祖遺意，惜斬趾可以禁惡，恨入死之無辜，使明習律令，與群臣共議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "01973cb890260d35fe051252c5eb018df00b79797fd741b153fd6858d303f96d"}

{"id": "p_1aa58598cde02088", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 52, "text": "出本當右趾而入大辟者，復行此刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "ace2f4111d73b59dc51e0a0aac3c7973a2be629f4a5350dbf90ccb0818d73ce9"}

{"id": "p_9d362dd009ce1dab", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 53, "text": "書云：『皇帝清問下民，鰥寡有辭于苗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "3ec6e53036f44d17086c73fc77591f2f543cf39150e41b2c90d805b9c0f67076"}

{"id": "p_d5eb56b9e504f712", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 54, "text": "』此言堯當除蚩尤、有苗之刑，先審問於下民之有辭者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "5367dfe8a2218234b0ba55d044d29e273614d5df49c888de9b8b5daac82b1c84"}

{"id": "p_a928557887500d23", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 55, "text": "若今蔽獄之時，訊問三槐、九棘、群吏、萬民，使如孝景之令，其當棄巿，欲斬右趾者許之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "57a4f398c9b7ba0a897a2b3d49440d5fe1e1320b64579b26f87ae0cba8183b6a"}

{"id": "p_38aca5daaa8e34ab", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 56, "text": "其黥、劓、左趾、宮刑者，自如孝文，易以髠、笞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "c539a0cfa19d9d03212b9ac14848655a793ecc48e2a99a1295ae522fa6e3684c"}

{"id": "p_abd1863a2b0df6dd", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 57, "text": "能有姦者，率年二十至四五十，雖斬其足，猶任生育。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "320fba5db10a4cb1ebe511daa65dfbdd3058569b44d51c5bc6f29f6e6a11f5b0"}

{"id": "p_0dc3a37e116d56a9", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 58, "text": "今天下人少於孝文之世，下計所全，歲三千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "d515e9aa1354d7d19338389ada25d3c14d7fe2aa31e6d57feca2746de6a61dd0"}

{"id": "p_fdb85ac061e47ae0", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 59, "text": "張蒼除肉刑，所殺歲以萬計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "f226341ee04f00bf3db4f5568210537c6c60bb2e26d6f1c0b9f22d01324c5441"}

{"id": "p_dc870cad7ae2e445", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 60, "text": "臣欲復肉刑，歲生三千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "e35c8fdf9242a7ce461e393d7279f8661fd7352499e7e57c875a2e893192ca76"}

{"id": "p_99876700d4fde6fa", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 61, "text": "子曰：『何事於仁，必也聖乎，堯、舜其猶病諸！", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "0d6c8d6d6936b71998102646fb10703d630a15f6081c0d9d0a4dcf0a2ff9ee07"}

{"id": "p_722ec0989a1423b0", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」書奏，詔曰：「太傅學優才高，留心政事，又於刑理深遠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "0d41ca186e4ff0ac1a91c29f932ae5f99fc95fc1a7a5e2088e900ec713d25143"}

{"id": "p_6a1192ed8c5c0e99", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 63, "text": "此大事，公卿羣寮善共平議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "e27ad847c09cdbee5477b5ed9bbe811fcba5b0acb0a5b2eeeb805d32ec514958"}

{"id": "p_94f1318d1615a254", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 64, "text": "」司徒王朗議，以爲「繇欲輕減大辟之條，以增益刖刑之數，此即起偃爲豎，化屍爲人矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "648c3b9548b6a1af53e543c86e15f13f14e709000b3c4d6d0b3d2498cde84f8e"}

{"id": "p_3d8739bd40cc1ce0", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 65, "text": "然臣之愚，猶有未合微異之意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "8049b2d13d29e81fea46fa59533fbd22dd419b0184f0621d7240f4518f116478"}

{"id": "p_f6dff99bf0b18bc7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 66, "text": "夫五刑之屬，著在科律，自有減死一等之法，不死即爲減。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "cc36db1d57ec9ff1a972a7873bf714ccac2df4c6e761d19c1491f768eae4b986"}

{"id": "p_8bc4308e25460b3c", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 67, "text": "施行已乆，不待遠假斧鑿於彼肉刑，然後有罪次也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "4c5d90c9a98ac57a987b710f4249611714c9ac8906a89deec98ad9c0111e2520"}

{"id": "p_613950a10cc628cc", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 68, "text": "前世仁者，不忍肉刑之慘酷，是以廢而不用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "17bbee5034652e0e945855d0d9e0f8d9e0a765d3c25b670053fc67011a5f943c"}

{"id": "p_48c39a74d13bdbf4", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 69, "text": "今復行之，恐所減之文未彰於萬民之目，而肉刑之問已宣於寇讎之耳，非所以來遠人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "a03aad385537e1be524572c73d6f4e033eab51417a8835c2c3676f900395a64a"}

{"id": "p_bc9a71068d4c8f16", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 70, "text": "今可按繇所欲輕之死罪，使減死之髠、刖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "bb68f73ae00f534d27b84cd69b583e72d9e2ddf4f30404f2659801aeda48c613"}

{"id": "p_3df3ccaedc058a6c", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 71, "text": "嫌其輕者，可倍其居作之歲數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "609172e9e488837b913fe6fa2a983dc275a577029eb6798280aef684fc3fa006"}

{"id": "p_1936d31cd4f43a54", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 72, "text": "內有以生易死不訾之恩，外無以刖易釱駭耳之聲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "0605bc9c871fc74472d29c960c6d60f5e7c53ad96978e503754f38f1c75b3a4d"}

{"id": "p_ab59d81d86d73262", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」議者百餘人，與朗同者多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "a48ffebb2bcf1072badec0f833ed8e0647c5ba195de9e60242ab6ed1e4916b18"}

{"id": "p_ebcdeb53c8b0f61a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 74, "text": "初，文帝分毓戶邑，封繇弟演及子劭、孫豫列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "9204304cae2f8ce5e83359512ac35821d942443b77bf46674963a3ed1aa51789"}

{"id": "p_bf43202669587930", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 75, "text": "年十四爲散騎侍郎，機捷談笑，有父風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "dadf7a6ba9644483d34195cf5c5a89a58bb70df958b61cf627f706b6417865ad"}

{"id": "p_4803959d744563aa", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 76, "text": "太和初，蜀相諸葛亮圍祁山，明帝欲西征，毓上疏曰：「夫策貴廟勝，功尚帷幄，不下殿堂之上，而決勝千里之外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "779a019a80363d76b64be8eecdb16616e79122166379a4b49607b7d75b638148"}

{"id": "p_249ecafe443cac58", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 77, "text": "車駕宜鎮守中土，以爲四方威勢之援。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "137e2e1f310a4055ae78af1cc442c06b90ac3fcccf6cda07ca86ce42c009c9be"}

{"id": "p_38625b0f1990cebc", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 78, "text": "今大軍西征，雖有百倍之威，於關中之費，所損非一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "d476cd353b3c6edfd15ed050ba19e2443a15e4af7fc440a1a61b3a46315de07c"}

{"id": "p_50fa2e1421408643", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 79, "text": "且盛暑行師，詩人所重，實非至尊動軔之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "862d9ae530e3cac1888c3abf83948f41f93088b9c9bb26d85f42c7aaaba2b2c5"}

{"id": "p_bf680639a470f938", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 80, "text": "時大興洛陽宮室，車駕便幸許昌，天下當朝正許昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "c7d0661626de3a678fdc8d49c292ff325a836c5934b7e037ed0448b55854268d"}

{"id": "p_b4f8237e0ce9a629", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 81, "text": "許昌偪狹，於城南以氊爲殿，備設魚龍曼延，民罷勞役。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "d04f6b42abc00fa3f76253b657d60e30c67e7096ffdfa2cbd802371a79d6a7f7"}

{"id": "p_119964016e81e2bf", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 82, "text": "毓諫，以爲「水旱不時，帑藏空虛，凡此之類，可須豐年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "cb2a05ec21ffa45f0b913d95497ba35eb28cd49e3a7ed44f1ac6fb882141c111"}

{"id": "p_f9cbbf67667267b7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 83, "text": "」又上「宜復關內開荒地，使民肆力於農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "5be322e1dc7b9157ef13eb8606d90d60d9c6c9234354639c8adef31f78c5066f"}

{"id": "p_44e4b9cd783f11b2", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 84, "text": "大將軍曹爽盛夏興軍伐蜀，蜀拒守，軍不得進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "18892ce8b6191bfb85b603b5276092267126b8f775d929eef9b3439406fff484"}

{"id": "p_93ebac414151abb9", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 85, "text": "爽方欲增兵，毓與書曰：「竊以爲廟勝之策，不臨矢石；王者之兵，有征無戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "0f53f1d437ecd1f5f531f6ae3eab9ab1a30b405bef452c4f9cb26ae52a771d8e"}

{"id": "p_55c31792090997c9", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 86, "text": "誠以干戚可以服有苗，退舍足以納原寇，不必縱吳漢於江關，騁韓信於井陘也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "5efe56ba8700a3732dc0b86baf0037fbffafdd8d09b88c9ba4b401e2d81ea5b4"}

{"id": "p_d81b2bf715754cfb", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 87, "text": "見可而進，知難而退，蓋自古之政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "f0d61479f92bc8e34ed8f7a4e5f015724679b5a7656918a4b1f613efdce2fef3"}

{"id": "p_73ef39ad94ac47a2", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 88, "text": "後以失爽意，徙侍中，出爲魏郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "020c82a35c7d7a48945725a13d7e4bf2f968455ef7ca07fe052c8ad0c0042161"}

{"id": "p_a810226518e08654", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 89, "text": "爽旣誅，入爲御史中丞、侍中廷尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "fe9d557041f7d065e217a2577be84b093a45b9e8cac3e71a39b6f4e0c887ed4d"}

{"id": "p_d67485e3a6cac516", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 90, "text": "聽君父已沒，臣子得爲理謗，及士爲侯，其妻不復配嫁，毓所創也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "23f783cad207bfdabcfcffb52b7c1a21507972bb0deedf8206ddcb76d17dde0b"}

{"id": "p_e6d5b4238547d361", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 91, "text": "正元中，毌丘儉、文欽反，毓持節至揚、豫州班行赦令，告諭士民，還爲尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "a6def0376a65e38c7c48d889a2cc0132c87d00be9e317c20a700ee829e6efe23"}

{"id": "p_7ecfb8af60e6943a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 92, "text": "諸葛誕反，大將軍司馬文王議自詣壽春討誕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "7bcd9c45992dc2f6657a63e0962612a93a5b5767ed8f7ce882a36429886f6ada"}

{"id": "p_67c41916f66110df", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 93, "text": "會吳大將孫壹率衆降，或以爲「吳新有釁，必不能復出軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "e10468e31e4e7dcba4bbe3ddc81e0e70921b526d02f15f75f432f8e0b20ca9db"}

{"id": "p_0c49d42f1b1f9907", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 94, "text": "毓以爲「夫論事料敵，當以己度人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "abdd0557f00dc11f5f61471fdf85f920788f3fd286bc369b240beb21491b301b"}

{"id": "p_894b8a0439307283", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 95, "text": "今誕舉淮南之地以與吳國，孫壹所率，口不至千，兵不過三百。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "4bdd6a093d09c4abc125a46f53a85c422e8b0f77674f7f45ac9a643a5ecd06c3"}

{"id": "p_e51c9a478e435d46", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 96, "text": "若壽春之圍未解，而吳國之內轉安，未可必其不出也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "6648bbbd235f38927cdb24cd30be16fb27c4eb8e78cb3d34e8fe5aba314a425b"}

{"id": "p_751dd4d90d44c6da", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 97, "text": "淮南旣平，爲青州刺史，加後將軍，遷都督徐州諸軍事，假節，又轉都督荊州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "222911ccdb28ec90c3e3039e12ee16456451863ffbbcf0a00e1dc42021fecce7"}

{"id": "p_8ec07ea5dcbb8132", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 98, "text": "薨，追贈車騎將軍，謚曰惠侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "bbafd6c5f4243ec7933535f45a9879307b93c3a3f6cbf89d4faa516a4cae4d1c"}

{"id": "p_dbbacb69c22fb0e1", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 99, "text": "華歆字子魚，平原高唐人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "b8687c544d62d5b3377f13122947958612fac8a0158a95ccc570785e3654b51a"}

{"id": "p_28179c7a9ec06753", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 100, "text": "高唐爲齊名都，衣冠無不游行市里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "9795cc1722c7fbdb01f39ef7f139938322b55414c62a5513e4079f8d30b7168c"}

{"id": "p_d26069145eba954b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 101, "text": "歆爲吏，休沐出府，則歸家闔門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "a78de9a205b61b2bb0fa89b185c95839ffee2f9d393cca715551bbb7665392eb"}

{"id": "p_6949100a39ed3f22", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 102, "text": "同郡陶丘洪亦知名，自以明見過歆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "2cfac498686933151c308fa867e64ece9ba1c5422d466b38c99a825ead80b7b4"}

{"id": "p_673ad871ffe65e23", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 103, "text": "芬陰呼歆、洪共定計，洪欲行，歆止之曰：「夫廢立大事，伊、霍之所難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "96efcb87c34527d17a9e24c5c0617876e138534ed8d518ed83050fc4fb3ac468"}

{"id": "p_ad134f7bc813a61a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 104, "text": "芬性踈而不武，此必無成，而禍將及族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "a1e4b97e2482e885b8009c81d8d66205a49a7ce29a04c5b01eff36a642c930f6"}

{"id": "p_834237cf75ac31aa", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 105, "text": "舉孝廉，除郎中，病，去官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "dc6be51082d49bffa92f8758d5b4140eaeb3adf45d6f59ab05fcdeae82da7246"}

{"id": "p_3628114ebe8f1540", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 106, "text": "靈帝崩，何進輔政，徵河南鄭泰、潁川荀攸及歆等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "75fc7b2ca8704634fb761cb811141cda6ab7567bbd1e451638b1ca4c2d55d7ee"}

{"id": "p_77373597d7f077d8", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 107, "text": "董卓遷天子長安，歆求出爲下邽令，病不行，遂從藍田至南陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "f2039373d7c0ade152b28f06d766f229085fa6c14bf3b2761577dcda33d494b2"}

{"id": "p_d66b69f5f29aa34b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 108, "text": "歆說術使進軍討卓，術不能用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "74b34cc3bad7836c9006350457af8568e0826b51ce38d5f718b09f1275b999e0"}

{"id": "p_011521e405fa31c7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 109, "text": "歆欲棄去，會天子使太傅馬日磾安集關東，日磾辟歆爲掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "09e471066c622344d63fbf4b9f76b0dd0078e3a267831723dfa0e99b126bc15f"}

{"id": "p_0c7ab3c9573287af", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 110, "text": "東至徐州，詔即拜歆豫章太守，以爲政清靜不煩，吏民感而愛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "6bbef4cec3882922e2c3465f026aae92cc9fb1f23ce2de7f7123104c17754296"}

{"id": "p_9d6fef1467b6758f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 111, "text": "孫策略地江東，歆知策善用兵，乃幅巾奉迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "92a38563d7499e8c5efbe5463cf6dba0d60ca812e695815821562de504ed4809"}

{"id": "p_ebcf68ceca84ded6", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 112, "text": "策以其長者，待以上賔之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "12eaf2b7c8dbf11b2da53f6dd96de7f76e14b6a6944e478e19d6dd6511e09ca3"}

{"id": "p_e6f67fd31ece4df7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 113, "text": "太祖在官渡，表天子徵歆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "a92044dd5726f46a3c7a59b5a9e3f6f434e9293b9737fce81654948de30eecc1"}

{"id": "p_49d466e717a021af", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 114, "text": "孫權欲不遣，歆謂權曰：「將軍奉王命，始交好曹公，分義未固，使僕得爲將軍效心，豈不有益乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "256818eef1170ce0efe0b620c2b1469d72c24b58220be2cc443e7469065bf04f"}

{"id": "p_63555e8996f8e18f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 115, "text": "今空留僕，是爲養無用之物，非將軍之良計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "5d76f62aa2506b6f564cad42feecf24297390747e6636e1c274e3c4801d76664"}

{"id": "p_dab672dc13c616a4", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 116, "text": "賔客舊人送之者千餘人，贈遺數百金。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "746e842675cbc627c23b9cc9be0517edddffe60d73e1a02c8b91ffc1a7321f86"}

{"id": "p_54db0d07fb5664cd", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 117, "text": "歆皆無所拒，密各題識，至臨去，悉聚諸物，謂諸賔客曰：「本無拒諸君之心，而所受遂多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "c30e41bd5e7b5c02be697c562bf5fc1885a0321f81ecd2300ec83717a112194b"}

{"id": "p_53c2a8b0617dab91", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 118, "text": "念單車遠行，將以懷璧爲罪，願賔客爲之計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "7e23808e4da7ad98c607cdd813dcd36e366a0d958a2e6729a552b32aaf854521"}

{"id": "p_ad418ca34e584ba6", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 119, "text": "」衆乃各留所贈，而服其德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "a89576e31a7e4391e34b0cfe1aa9332f416c30f8d6d01a3a2c4c838773d96ff7"}

{"id": "p_c1f342125bf20cbd", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 120, "text": "歆至，拜議郎，參司空軍事，入爲尚書，轉侍中，代荀彧爲尚書令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "1be73568520666da59ab515849bda6799e9e4c84b6a3196644ce9f9d54f8fa17"}

{"id": "p_362d9cb8047a55e9", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 121, "text": "太祖征孫權，表歆爲軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "70105bce477e0098c55f3b6fccf5844b2447d7c389c3b12ebc248bf381716c66"}

{"id": "p_584202b94dbbbde1", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 122, "text": "文帝即王位，拜相國，封安樂鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "c261e52c5d910212759802abb61618d972d657435867ccd79933c32dc86ea465"}

{"id": "p_753313a420d135ee", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 123, "text": "歆素清貧，祿賜以振施親戚故人，家無擔石之儲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "2d4a4d9f2c6be37ad0618fe7cc95a5d6f225f7b1b79e0f0724960aae4b1897fd"}

{"id": "p_3c5f07da4b5ae9be", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 124, "text": "公卿嘗並賜沒入生口，唯歆出而嫁之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "97d656dba4e514818bda41f7399693e2d2f0dab0567813fcb37289d117645018"}

{"id": "p_3d0a78d24bba26a4", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 125, "text": "帝歎息，下詔曰：「司徒，國之儁老，所與和陰陽理庶事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "bcab61f68373b7c5cdb3813043d022d832ac1e0fc996de5317fd732f15155ecd"}

{"id": "p_27f21972d7a528d8", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 126, "text": "今大官重膳，而司徒蔬食，甚無謂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "bc5a03b49826c586cb35db361291a380b9a2c4c97d2608b7bccfb41e7649de85"}

{"id": "p_397920832201c371", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」特賜御衣，及爲其妻子男女皆作衣服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "05ebe4fa0c7f00e18734e32857698b5eb183668ff5be4a8a4e9cc265b9a351c8"}

{"id": "p_2664b89633e91a83", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 128, "text": "三府議：「舉孝廉，本以德行，不復限以試經。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "cc5252937903ec11c7a6c7e502a8b416005058f0bace4571ec6f2b1ff0b10503"}

{"id": "p_61e5a0dfdfe97191", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 129, "text": "」歆以爲「喪亂以來，六籍墮廢，當務存立，以崇王道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "4f4901afc5aa191e7e610620c47f58605eb7cd33e9143eb88df2880db21a4c60"}

{"id": "p_d22e49d5440871d2", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 130, "text": "今聽孝廉不以經試，恐學業遂從此而廢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "eaadfbda535d803e18d0ba7e3d6abcde3e6b4b5420340233a6fe2473993b6384"}

{"id": "p_c86323a7b3e36a44", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 131, "text": "患於無其人，何患不得哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "5ab94ce4c1b2d4aee336f7812ad16b863795b04691c8fc4b4e2fa5c24e9bbc81"}

{"id": "p_3b6ab0dd5ea74252", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 132, "text": "黃初中，詔公卿舉獨行君子，歆舉管寧，帝以安車徵之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "d0e6bbfc311c473bbdbd9c8aa48c94852ceb0dc9408cd524c6b218da6c1106d7"}

{"id": "p_94f67346c6263097", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 133, "text": "明帝即位，進封博平侯，增邑五百戶，并前千三百戶，轉拜太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "bf6306f0dfc1319811448ed87a3d01de1731d1be94958e9f39c6a05aea98e126"}

{"id": "p_348ffc8fae1b043f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 134, "text": "臨當大會，乃遣散騎常侍繆襲奉詔喻指曰：「朕新莅庶事，一日萬機，懼聽斷之不明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "8e92e8719d8d62b1f7379cde6866d55c978f438d9b3d6d01df48d44a8722f3ce"}

{"id": "p_454a09b50e021aa3", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 135, "text": "賴有德之臣，左右朕躬，而君屢以疾辭位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "cae27bf14d416a0c9eef72b5c16e83b63b62e1319e843e1f1cdf0f24317344e0"}

{"id": "p_cfedf6551b15344a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 136, "text": "夫量主擇君，不居其朝，委榮棄祿，不究其位，古人固有之矣，顧以爲周公、伊尹則不然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "080f8e7ac18b82a81fe14dff7533c4010d0f50b097ac31004a8ac0756e08b952"}

{"id": "p_2974a4672076c078", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 137, "text": "絜身徇節，常人爲之，不望之於君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "19e63ca2d22486b2bcb78b06a90f0c658551ef5e25472e4679e84c3aea231b89"}

{"id": "p_31d1a3be64ee2d48", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 138, "text": "君其力疾就會，以惠予一人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "f2f6231b26354cf7ab780f8310ebf6081dd44ab54eaf075b0b7a34dcb70c4f63"}

{"id": "p_8785c21e93e0dbd6", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 139, "text": "將立席机莚，命百官緫己，以須君到，朕然後御坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "1894970fd29516fb1e6c74106579a8e0ae0e6715cf3403cb63bca939fb3e6ce3"}

{"id": "p_ff421d4dc13c0b10", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」又詔襲：「須歆必起，乃還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "bf0ce41893bef340eddfa0687d197f21f1f44e5680cf277f6ef8588df113bf14"}

{"id": "p_5d79417efc9de6aa", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 141, "text": "太和中，遣曹真從子午道伐蜀，車駕東幸許昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "6c0852e6eef3f708956747eb9fc5268f1d87ec8eb31cf9afe49ec025692d16a0"}

{"id": "p_c82001e3a9d610b7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 142, "text": "歆上疏曰：「兵亂以來，過踰二紀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "2fe6520f50d5c4d6f8ddebfd4e0a9c36478b3524be28c155336f1ee66a6cfdf8"}

{"id": "p_a621c876a18df77a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 143, "text": "大魏承天受命，陛下以聖德當成康之隆，宜弘一代之治，紹三王之迹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "c258e26c8995c704e015526873f443e1bbc28fe9bf38308af588cfbb99c3605b"}

{"id": "p_bda8a30327fcfb2b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 144, "text": "雖有二賊負險延命，苟聖化日躋，遠人懷德，將襁負而至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "b696a02839e456cd8399e606e330289407c81e41969fc9b508d225e19477fefb"}

{"id": "p_98784eaf4156ae48", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 145, "text": "夫兵不得已而用之，故戢而時動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "8e5a83440606f0ab85f30ca07b089c8dbbc245c24e792da59f7c4d0ac09cbc55"}

{"id": "p_00b0a5a96b697d5d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 146, "text": "臣誠願陛下先留心於治道，以征伐爲後事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "6592ae9da26903c85c72b72db919f27d9435abf6357d240202f4efcb7ba1b63d"}

{"id": "p_315dee0a52b8c8c5", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 147, "text": "且千里運糧，非用兵之利；越險深入，無獨克之功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "1be3c995b6dc50f51d45b43d5f37d705939b62248e36178ac102255f249ef26a"}

{"id": "p_9ea6fd946095ef38", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 148, "text": "如聞今年徵役，頗失農桑之業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "887b3e357599fbd0bfb43331f209a2902962d9c63f6026b00268fc4087d311bd"}

{"id": "p_ab467bdce604c55a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 149, "text": "爲國者以民爲基，民以衣食爲本。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "80b44666540e2b800ef49dffec21d946777b413748b745501d73c161917433da"}

{"id": "p_e5ade1edab321996", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 150, "text": "使中國無饑寒之患，百姓無離土之心，則天下幸甚，二賊之釁，可坐而待也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "0dbe2eda92ae93504425c5d82ee85439ab41ecb5f49276481eac065cacad11a6"}

{"id": "p_7c3a54a069832585", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 151, "text": "臣備位宰相，老病日篤，犬馬之命將盡，恐不復奉望鑾蓋，不敢不竭臣子之懷，唯陛下裁察！", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "50820dbf3e01762c682cb55719b461346453af04bcecf30ec1c99a0fc4150d10"}

{"id": "p_bcd979af95373bd1", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 152, "text": "」帝報曰：「君深慮國計，朕甚嘉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "e4759dfa7f1fd84a0b541a5247b0597e585d37d57889e3a8c25fcf46009313de"}

{"id": "p_e9401e2de35a54aa", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 153, "text": "賊憑恃山川，二祖勞於前世，猶不克平，朕豈敢自多，謂必滅之哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "0772cf4f3e296060c4b77e0cd9ce02cd1baf4e94ead14406e44f23693a8845ef"}

{"id": "p_daf4c15f2aeae98a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 154, "text": "諸將以爲不一探取，無由自弊，是以觀兵以闚其釁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "20dba9bc3b41c08b5251ff8b333a1009d4eec30eee982fff4c57315a7e9a09b2"}

{"id": "p_81b15056f0ce4eb8", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 155, "text": "若天時未至，周武還師，乃前事之鑒，朕敬不忘所戒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "a1266a7eb0389e6dd4e630cf2f1da4dabf0ae384383c9d95f97d0638cd56afdf"}

{"id": "p_668e884639b09d81", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 156, "text": "」時秋大雨，詔真引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "71bc200e28208b2878310bf6f2ca2d1ff4ba3801311d747fd3a84fd471ea1c32"}

{"id": "p_5eb760bdcbec6ebb", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 157, "text": "初，文帝分歆戶邑，封歆弟緝列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "bf8852c85d51a67748d86c56ba071979555a69c8fcc11f686efb40e345235689"}

{"id": "p_bec533f4c98e51a2", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 158, "text": "王朗字景興，東海郡人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "d4cc23d4a1f6462d5c41576abc0726f84c4f6e049af67ec861e0b36f426183a5"}

{"id": "p_8b5c1c0f001efcc8", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 159, "text": "以通經，拜郎中，除菑丘長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "a42fb5a51ee4b3a0732149da458adffca87582d448e41a2e40960dd94f17ec3d"}

{"id": "p_f5b8621a45a62c68", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 160, "text": "師太尉楊賜，賜薨，棄官行服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "2e9ac38ab8dacf092f75b5280e34626fdf038861e472ec2ce6037f7f75e46031"}

{"id": "p_17b1afdac5c791d0", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 161, "text": "時漢帝在長安，關東兵起，朗爲謙治中，與別駕趙昱等說謙曰：「春秋之義，求諸侯莫如勤王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "ccf6298e08213b498832427ae7c9a3662a3e32879c7a822ded2202ddb787b87c"}

{"id": "p_d02d99d724f74211", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 162, "text": "今天子越在西京，宜遣使奉承王命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "11ea78f9c404d13aa51bd6c4f578f34635223310817f00395d21b85ea4e65786"}

{"id": "p_c97e1400e6ebd3a5", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 163, "text": "天子嘉其意，拜謙安東將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "43554d939cbd84bf0893ac7c3c7291286bb4a37240a72d1efb5304d5da25f7bc"}

{"id": "p_17f6be1c44524ff1", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 164, "text": "以昱爲廣陵太守，朗會稽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "044af7457c5f18642f137b654d11dc080bb867d2c1334c9815e6d74051010d04"}

{"id": "p_701fb78b067dcb5e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 165, "text": "朗功曹虞翻以爲力不能拒，不如避之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "448c38e992a6134f3e834f9b6c5787bb05e9cd52d12eb2fd504b9274400cb70c"}

{"id": "p_7ec0477c11fcc717", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 166, "text": "朗自以身爲漢吏，宜保城邑，遂舉兵與策戰，敗績，浮海至東冶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "620cd8f75f7d0bad1f420095ad0671edf44ab54dc3da4b89741550bdb0856114"}

{"id": "p_4155f354d1878b34", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 167, "text": "策以朗儒雅，詰讓而不害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "06522eee7730b18180f9467f199a963cad5928ae84cd1132e878254c55d4c291"}

{"id": "p_85e91048dc264319", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 168, "text": "雖流移窮困，朝不謀夕，而收卹親舊，分多割少，行義甚著。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "093f376e9b2a73fc3c59b486bd6ccd66cf225f31d9d6400f2e99febff0d37ced"}

{"id": "p_fedbed8aa0ca931d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 169, "text": "太祖表徵之，朗自曲阿展轉江海，積年乃至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "3b7e068a7a99af40746b36894a447cebeee047b2c6a3c34ecd154317ab701909"}

{"id": "p_4ede7a3b0cbfa88a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 170, "text": "拜諫議大夫，參司空軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "a0cf6ca9255d2ba90d2ad87f253abf93c968d12412959c58dc246488598ce3aa"}

{"id": "p_5371917e55a77bce", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 171, "text": "魏國初建，以軍祭酒領魏郡太守，遷少府、奉常、大理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "d692142e46864b60df898b8ecb3999e8426c4979c3acd4e0e5d2fe18ef2d7009"}

{"id": "p_9ee5143f00421845", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 172, "text": "鍾繇明察當法，俱以治獄見稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "9001b2d0878baabe9c7750fa5ca284029b74d21103901c1d71cf435614f2ef43"}

{"id": "p_7d2f1d2618a3c3bd", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 173, "text": "文帝即王位，遷御史大夫，封安陵亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "67b9db80ff01773d7a245ef4ba60c183f4451d04d17627f9e85a494433361660"}

{"id": "p_d089406ed7c9198b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 174, "text": "上疏勸育民省刑曰：「兵起已來三十餘年，四海盪覆，萬國殄瘁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "1702f62fc867c2cc9bbdf1e4c3f4e48ee3f2ae2de2eb90e88ce60a193eeca386"}

{"id": "p_67642e14752357dc", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 175, "text": "賴先王芟除寇賊，扶育孤弱，遂令華夏復有綱紀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "b5c03c07b3540f92709badc6618150f72ce345fbd4b19dde7fba3bce7aa0e200"}

{"id": "p_935cc92596906f97", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 176, "text": "鳩集兆民，于茲魏土，使封鄙之內，雞鳴狗吠達於四境，蒸庶欣欣，喜遇升平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "8a2004bd6958425eaa55eedc50756d801c57d8eac60adbe15223a89a0b15d94a"}

{"id": "p_a474bb5321878d0a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 177, "text": "今遠方之寇未賔，兵戎之役未息，誠令復除足以懷遠人，良宰足以宣德澤，阡陌咸脩，四民殷熾，必復過於曩時而富於平日矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "8e1ac3fe3950308f2a683c1eed600c395dc7bfc498636eb5c510f2f767fd0bca"}

{"id": "p_8fe5dcaf4a65974f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 178, "text": "易稱勑法，書著祥刑，一人有慶，兆民賴之，慎法獄之謂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "669809880bb32b31c3a5f8584a84aa513cf32ca3faac8e773cb95d34dcd1ff52"}

{"id": "p_adeed075507395bc", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 179, "text": "昔曹相國以獄市爲寄，路溫舒疾治獄之吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "ff750b85cb0206966366913b6dee38b9d605891fecdae0106a8c68952f8d8af9"}

{"id": "p_40366c85bb70dc8d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 180, "text": "夫治獄者得其情，則無冤死之囚；丁壯者得盡地力，則無饑饉之民；窮老者得仰食倉廩，則無餧餓之殍；嫁娶以時，則男女無怨曠之恨；胎養必全，則孕者無自傷之哀；新生必復，則孩者無不育之累；壯而後役，則幼者無離家之思；二毛不戎，則老者無頓伏之患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "b4ff6999765a01ec747e24d6d4545b5c8de816d8218232e44742d506d8bb2bc3"}

{"id": "p_7b1b178942db3289", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 181, "text": "醫藥以療其疾，寬繇以樂其業，威罰以抑其彊，恩仁以濟其弱，振貸以贍其乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "0b09a9a1685961eaae92027b9b8e2fe383e59615ef5c07074c457b8689a56535"}

{"id": "p_c1b71c1684a23511", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 182, "text": "十年之後，旣笄者必盈巷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "c9e69f70905de092baab23c41180faac13d0fa631763757e5b1b5294baf20336"}

{"id": "p_3dc03590b4bf6a48", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 183, "text": "二十年之後，勝兵者必滿野矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "45dfaef03ec103ed4cb44a2089181e7136b9ec16ffced19ca9ce2c5232103c88"}

{"id": "p_632d40558a9ce0b8", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 184, "text": "及文帝踐阼，改爲司空，進封樂平鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "1d53a0520f110521c5d1a68cb1acf2fd50340b51eeceb249dd735cd4be9fca0a"}

{"id": "p_f3a54f3a86afd959", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 185, "text": "時帝頗出游獵，或昏夜還宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "e29201bcc42e7ed5b7795b027df0a8ca28358983c5f1dce946b322fc6856c34a"}

{"id": "p_c2eecb28ecb76573", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 186, "text": "朗上疏曰：「夫帝王之居，外則飾周衞，內則重禁門，將行則設兵而後出幄，稱警而後踐墀，張弧而後登輿，清道而後奉引，遮列而後轉轂，靜室而後息駕，皆所以顯至尊，務戒慎，垂法教也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "c586dfbddf957d5b59397ca14f8411aa98237d51d2a0b3dc36483990ea77686b"}

{"id": "p_be89292ecbf6c730", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 187, "text": "近日車駕出臨捕虎，日昃而行，及昏而反，違警蹕之常法，非萬乘之至慎也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "7e4db201c65cbf1540c8282ff93c1d01f3109e6e386aef542c1bc923f86169ab"}

{"id": "p_7c2928294820bdba", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 188, "text": "」帝報曰：「覽表，雖魏絳稱虞箴以諷晉悼，相如陳猛獸以戒漢武，未足以喻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "64f7ef16621661b223d43e8923994b43534172b288ba7255bf3a2e987bce093f"}

{"id": "p_e0c151a02daf9af2", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 189, "text": "方今二寇未殄，將帥遠征，故時入原野以習戎備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "2bab03266e6c236bc9fb25b08bc51363109cec5a302bbec876cdfce343316404"}

{"id": "p_9a77d68f622d8227", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 190, "text": "至於夜還之戒，已詔有司施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "363342b0e5dfdab7c9fbc1902611792b1792526f397a09dcde3a017abd652008"}

{"id": "p_719cafb861edf466", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 191, "text": "初，建安末，孫權始遣使稱藩，而與劉備交兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "75fa04d213ba6d9e3e19a4a622599bb0bb7aa6c2680217bd34f00fac144b3cc7"}

{"id": "p_2f259fedf7efa78e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 192, "text": "詔議「當興師與吳并取蜀不」？", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "71f239dc75f9da3f258d5cec20f581420ce1984a891e384b25a3097d0b9975fd"}

{"id": "p_eacae7927ca41980", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 193, "text": "朗議曰：「天子之軍，重於華、岱，誠宜坐曜天威，不動若山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "02085f408551d8c15903e51e16f425f4db59659ab1d8305c772db5cf50456bed"}

{"id": "p_f52201478ce03317", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 194, "text": "假使權親與蜀賊相持，搏戰曠日，智均力敵，兵不速決，當須軍興以成其勢者，然後宜選持重之將，承寇賊之要，相時而後動，擇地而後行，一舉可無餘事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "befb34e2306f349d15e40e282d7a4729624ece9978e67b5a4fd8757aa54469aa"}

{"id": "p_e10a4beb6a1d61f4", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 195, "text": "今權之師未動，則助吳之軍無爲先征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "b328662312e80ef09e11fbcbca95c53771a12458a64b823b7a98c71f7cc114f5"}

{"id": "p_f079c8a4bc1dd116", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 196, "text": "且雨水方盛，非行軍動衆之時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "6dfc8635daca22fedbaae20676b1f113f4461abb9e47c87c72665714fb5526b1"}

{"id": "p_4ad22a229bb58912", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 197, "text": "黃初中，鵜鶘集靈芝池，詔公卿舉獨行君子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "293cd41034b85cdfe6f69a00cc73453ed3298281af521c80cc8bf21f694a6e61"}

{"id": "p_8f2c9c8dea2d0a7d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 198, "text": "朗薦光祿大夫楊彪，且稱疾，讓位於彪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "886b9cd964d44c23cdb1e303a2c4e48eb514dcaf2c120caed14de7b43bb5150a"}

{"id": "p_ff7b94698e39bd6f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 199, "text": "帝乃爲彪置吏卒，位次三公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "4ec98207fe93d4f09c4db0837e977cb0a3e7e33d6a516b515b560aa81ba63b6c"}

{"id": "p_a47b55eef00d4093", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 200, "text": "詔曰：「朕求賢於君而未得，君乃翻然稱疾，非徒不得賢，更開失賢之路，增玉鉉之傾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "c692ca4d566c8f5426d8e0ce4f6960a3451a517c355288d4037a0dc7bd864121"}

{"id": "p_a00cfb4cbf87867a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 201, "text": "無乃居其室出其言不善，見違於君子乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "c614a80484ec7579ef325d32ac3e7c24418d0682cacdaa70eb05065d49185560"}

{"id": "p_a1870f1b4837783c", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 202, "text": "孫權欲遣子登入侍，不至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "b0450c2bba04e66507635c75c4d5f1059890a81cdb43da0706b7f63aaae662d1"}

{"id": "p_a46987627081d02d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 203, "text": "是時車駕徙許昌，大興屯田，欲舉軍東征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "6804e7a1ee46e6d19f831b933a3254eef007126e00475d98ead59f349cb8b4d5"}

{"id": "p_27a04382eb462a2c", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 204, "text": "朗上疏曰：「昔南越守善，嬰齊入侍，遂爲冢嗣，還君其國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "fbd9df5e53e168fb5027ea6f72fbe8dce5763c79909f551d38f5be3e9eddc1a2"}

{"id": "p_9704c068ab37f84d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 205, "text": "康居驕黠，情不副辭，都護奏議以爲宜遣侍子，以黜無禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "f6bd77f51891f89598f5936f43da000c2c7f20b26c0dc5508286e2c7f39b52fa"}

{"id": "p_d3ad6e7c94735611", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 206, "text": "且吳濞之禍，萌於子入，隗嚻之叛，亦不顧子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "2d0f020af3cbcca029982e99dfafa79cf79b871317324aa216e5d8a0eeb29795"}

{"id": "p_0f710c8b7524d401", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 207, "text": "往者聞權有遣子之言而未至，今六軍戒嚴，臣恐輿人未暢聖旨，當謂國家慍於登之逋留，是以爲之興師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "0c3129079a87fa42fcb9773caa0c90534a5d4202e232432d7ff8ee2bb3eb0577"}

{"id": "p_55a539aadcc871b8", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 208, "text": "設師行而登乃至，則爲所動者至大，所致者至細，猶未足以爲慶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "be0afe86daac516525de224e5f250d1230ea8f5626aeb756a71b75ca04857e36"}

{"id": "p_fe729bf897f0d58c", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 209, "text": "設其傲很，殊無入志，懼彼輿論之未暢者，並懷伊邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "2a5e51423c05b9768f84040e711580a219264def45052ae7d385fd5dfd647b19"}

{"id": "p_972124d1027decec", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 210, "text": "臣愚以爲宜勑別征諸將，各明奉禁令，以慎守所部。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "86335d49ce41ad6c1190c3613df1ede414d291629b3f398603e16d1cd67fb4e4"}

{"id": "p_0f12eb351a1ebc3a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 211, "text": "外曜烈威，內廣耕稼，使泊然若山，澹然若淵，勢不可動，計不可測。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "513d06962b01c684628495236582923ccc0a099b19052cf91348ab686d0615d8"}

{"id": "p_ce2dfb77f1881337", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 212, "text": "」是時，帝以成軍遂行，權子不至，車駕臨江而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "feec79858ef8ea72b538f4786b3c57bf2204c1ce60166a04b8cd1ac8ee52c1e3"}

{"id": "p_693c0fc6aaaedf50", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 213, "text": "明帝即位，進封蘭陵侯，增邑五百，并前千二百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "812f397f3b3c3c13f41f330c851127437ad0f69df7f73845cc97c72e55fdde44"}

{"id": "p_8d5abc60653e30e2", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 214, "text": "使至鄴省文昭皇后陵，見百姓或有不足。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "d4aadfb979caf72d70711bb3cdc8724619fbfed3182d5b19ad4b4949b239b2dc"}

{"id": "p_a33c54e709fbd16e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 215, "text": "是時方營脩宮室，朗上疏曰：「陛下即位已來，恩詔屢布，百姓萬民莫不欣欣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "d3201638ae52f311b5553472ddd6c00a659905fd240e82da598eefadc00a4975"}

{"id": "p_7b40d460e335800b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 216, "text": "臣頃奉使北行，往反道路，聞衆傜役，其可得蠲除省減者甚多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "6c974482a3a5f17a494caca1aeac3bc4f4de9552b7d9d1e82083d02fbd95b089"}

{"id": "p_b09bd0cf5c3386bf", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 217, "text": "願陛下重留日昃之聽，以計制寇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "6f31b099bf280ea16192d472e2002b8790928b95ab7649613f5feab7b0ffde0d"}

{"id": "p_b10b2d8bdc69de02", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 218, "text": "昔大禹將欲拯天下之大患，故乃先卑其宮室，儉其衣食，用能盡有九州，弼成五服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "05c27ef4b978200b295c1c263a4e3ced93b33b529b355ab9a1111745919247a9"}

{"id": "p_93b3c00f6049bf2b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 219, "text": "句踐欲廣其禦兒之疆，馘夫差於姑蘇，故亦約其身以及家，儉其家以施國，用能囊括五湖，席卷三江，取威中國，定霸華夏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "890c6ebe5e7b94c22252a05e184ca0e86cfaeca0d6cb5382c4fddabb1a3538ae"}

{"id": "p_29dedefaae5e0715", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 220, "text": "漢之文、景亦欲恢弘祖業，增崇洪緒，故能割意於百金之臺，昭儉於弋綈之服，內減太官而不受貢獻，外省傜賦而務農桑，用能號稱升平，幾致刑錯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "53ce4f5e7270138cb60cd06501c9666c34cb881788da013ad6f46cf4165a9d60"}

{"id": "p_d6615b9b36d9abbe", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 221, "text": "孝武之所以能奮其軍勢，拓其外境，誠因祖考畜積素足，故能遂成大功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "6aed6a1e10d386fdbb70bbc1b4bbbee9a980a1571f832efecf6b9eaebd69e04a"}

{"id": "p_977b7d9a432381d7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 222, "text": "霍去病，中才之將，猶以匈奴未滅，不治第宅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "ded7be6688ea87b86d9352f2a3265ccc52f1f1a744ba133cae5ce1a420b7b7b6"}

{"id": "p_974e465a4d14755f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 223, "text": "明卹遠者略近，事外者簡內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "d36eefe2cad6f791b9bf5f0ea5256c8c9d35287b20f3529ee9c005591707ba71"}

{"id": "p_e92fce1284e85059", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 224, "text": "自漢之初及其中興，皆於金革略寢之後，然後鳳闕猥閌，德陽並起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "1f3180efd6f4d6ecac3eecd461590c632c48e8c9114d018580b7696c518b501d"}

{"id": "p_87d6a34b0920174d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 225, "text": "今當建始之前足用列朝會，崇華之後足用序內官，華林、天淵足用展游宴，若且先成閶闔之象魏，使足用列遠人之朝貢者，脩城池，使足用絕踰越，成國險，其餘一切，且須豐年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "eeb11f5619dd7f03f1b8343f2f699632fbe3f88d2bb021514968d0fa9ccd2124"}

{"id": "p_e2a0d746b5158993", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 226, "text": "一以勤耕農爲務，習戎備爲事，則國無怨曠，戶口滋息，民充兵彊，而寇戎不賔，緝熙不足，未之有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "b9f68bc9076917d83968ad7031ce48a87d51f62e9200a2b517261cc1dd2a46cb"}

{"id": "p_2cf0c0eb241eab26", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 227, "text": "時屢失皇子，而後宮就館者少，朗上疏曰：「昔周文十五而有武王，遂享十子之祚，以廣諸姬之胤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "add54d5dc66add4e9be4991c72056cf9ca362848cd77c3fd4be26b7966181e25"}

{"id": "p_21db1415a0439ff0", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 228, "text": "武王旣老而生成王，成王是以鮮於兄弟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "bceb81a78f16e019988397dc7a8e09a145fb73a8814ff24c2a9abe9bb3f03a5f"}

{"id": "p_0992609ffd464b01", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 229, "text": "此二王者，各樹聖德，無以相過，比其子孫之祚，則不相如。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "4f72edddc61cf121c59cce26ba1de0bec83a5243cd03cf119066a6291cf68038"}

{"id": "p_6a44cc60e87fd025", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 230, "text": "蓋生育有早晚，所產有衆寡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "d3ab3ead6e64d25b8bec8949be7483bde7a1040c4afd994722ea55ce61598ac0"}

{"id": "p_0940b8c813e3eb6b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 231, "text": "陛下旣德祚兼彼二聖，春秋高於姬文育武之時矣，而子發未舉於椒蘭之奧房，藩王未繁於掖庭之衆室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "b90bedf559493a4e047211283677b9fb39cbbf2385ff5a01349781ea7932077b"}

{"id": "p_2f1c44c02b8ce277", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 232, "text": "以成王爲喻，雖未爲晚，取譬伯邑，則不爲夙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "744e3478deb6ec77028205cf3dc6e19d51206d6505d5b0eb04292b9aa78bce49"}

{"id": "p_0deeb6748b9bb5eb", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 233, "text": "周禮六宮內官百二十人，而諸經常說，咸以十二爲限，至於秦漢之末，或以千百爲數矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "d02bc055aee4b6bfc76dda6f090237e5a07d92e8e27ea69b48af70fdea841ab8"}

{"id": "p_2da8c45eb317ab00", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 234, "text": "然雖彌猥，而就時於吉館者或甚鮮，明『百斯男』之本，誠在於一意，不但在於務廣也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "50b4c050f130af9fcebb96f3a583273f8fd3fa7bd106ce679d5627bb462f855e"}

{"id": "p_b3dc8c5dd4f1b001", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 235, "text": "老臣慺慺，願國家同祚於軒轅之五五，而未及周文之二五，用爲伊邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "5e16d1c76d6206e9357baa22e030bd3507b3ad4120cbfa4b3d277f5a86f414e6"}

{"id": "p_21da3afe305af65a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 236, "text": "且少小常苦被褥泰溫，泰溫則不能便柔膚弱體，是以難可防護，而易用感慨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "bd92eaf730dbe612cbf2b5f7d6b381b66d9464d695d5202172c0bdd6808585a1"}

{"id": "p_6759ed86fb1a2741", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 237, "text": "若常令少小之縕袍，不至於甚厚，則必咸保金石之性，而比壽於南山矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "00805776515211c00d03d3fcfff8eae5576f924dd02006f035d508f117c2a89a"}

{"id": "p_bcf828de0d2caf3c", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 238, "text": "」帝報曰：「夫忠至者辭篤，愛重者言深。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "a124accb053e8e91fd61f9762630637fa33060a07036369c7f64cef56bcdb613"}

{"id": "p_5a19bfe8e301b275", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 239, "text": "君旣勞思慮，又手筆將順，三復德音，欣然無量。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "e3ce04f6544c52c7b4d44732545f79dad015b21974ea06a0ad2d6fe065ae3f85"}

{"id": "p_e676eac69bc392a6", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 240, "text": "朕繼嗣未立，以爲君憂，欽納至言，思聞良規。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "6685f2cc546a45cc7dde9ca5ff92848977906fcd31f681948aea2edf281e5183"}

{"id": "p_203116024902c760", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 241, "text": "」朗著易、春秋、孝經、周官傳，奏議論記，咸傳於世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "7fe0ecd73c396dbf0d1fcefa66eb57b3b4bf597b3656da17b5d04bff487556fc"}

{"id": "p_2dddde22510e0ed5", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 242, "text": "初，文帝分朗戶邑，封一子列侯，朗乞封兄子詳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "ae327402621cbc3b000ee7d07024ccf63517b9d6efaf9e581af22c833f50715d"}

{"id": "p_68e3ff65f888ea68", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 243, "text": "年十八，從宋忠讀太玄，而更爲之解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "3fa46586d18c20397900f0aea18c7136380de92d576003dad7b361cfdf555b14"}

{"id": "p_c6ea0ad7fde3470b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 244, "text": "黃初中，爲散騎黃門侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "0bf69d266c28d9cc93dc8c77522bf48ea92e33da415c90403225effd82034be0"}

{"id": "p_a60c452ebcd35de8", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 245, "text": "四年，大司馬曹真征蜀，肅上疏曰：「前志有之，『千里饋糧，士有饑色，樵蘇後爨，師不宿飽』，此謂平塗之行軍者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "d0c222e93cf44629250da14284b29e61736100f173b41c9e91d163095b25aa76"}

{"id": "p_131bf91f38f2ad05", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 246, "text": "又況於深入阻險，鑿路而前，則其爲勞必相百也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "b014a3e55672c51e314c896369729577f504ba1ac5199d8a414b2d4e4ec8723c"}

{"id": "p_bd940506b98c162f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 247, "text": "今又加之以霖雨，山坂峻滑，衆逼而不展，糧縣而難繼，實行軍者之大忌也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "95dd61f5e4fb859ae6293d9d93e026abfb732173911c840f84aebba094d7792d"}

{"id": "p_fe0f45f5f450b0b6", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 248, "text": "聞曹真發已踰月而行裁半谷，治道功夫，戰士悉作。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "003e01bda24c7345bdc998bfa7e0e4e89f5bbc0c7695014d9fbf949318ff5648"}
