{"id": "p_7262a3c83adf948c", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 249, "text": "是賊偏得以逸而待勞，乃兵家之所憚也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "e6aff923588b39f786f162a3ee9360fd8c460026480cfce5f3c3f959a6df87ee"}

{"id": "p_97165854ae209872", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 250, "text": "言之前代，則武王伐紂，出關而復還；論之近事，則武、文征權，臨江而不濟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "3584d50ee65c3458209646ed9eeff75aa5644d97522f9edbe9d11b2ea665cb30"}

{"id": "p_242e46e2853dd142", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 251, "text": "豈非所謂順天知時，通於權變者哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "b9961e2c0ae05fb115f0f989752cc4e458846a0faa5317b56a7aa5b392cb279e"}

{"id": "p_a0f9be48cf09564d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 252, "text": "兆民知聖上以水雨艱劇之故，休而息之，後日有釁，乘而用之，則所謂恱以犯難，民忘其死者矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "3f3e8fa76587ce0d3f96511990a3d64f02a13e532a6052834fc4e8a694bc1342"}

{"id": "p_c60fbbe5c5b39509", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 253, "text": "又上疏：「宜遵舊禮，爲大臣發哀，薦果宗廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "e387bd630589cc5850bb97bb2e6ff9923726730427d6b038a23bcab108729ccf"}

{"id": "p_8a6ce07ac689623f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 254, "text": "又上疏陳政本曰：「除無事之位，損不急之祿，止因食之費，并從容之官；使官必有職，職任其事，事必受祿，祿代其耕，乃往古之常式，當今之所宜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "b2253011fae3b5934fa43bce7d48020afb24026c3701780d21d7206634a6281a"}

{"id": "p_569b139f3b766a99", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 255, "text": "官寡而祿厚，則公家之費鮮，進仕之志勸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "aa0d4d4ed868450f468f2baf9f67bfa86a7d42a33d0b4c1620aede914b1a41eb"}

{"id": "p_27567367da1b8677", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 256, "text": "進仕之志勸，各展才力，莫相倚仗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "e9d52c9ce1a739a41bd24ae7d53565af61814a01a891c6d9b869f2e8a5ea7416"}

{"id": "p_42f68fee1569139f", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 257, "text": "敷奏以言，明試以功，能之與否，簡在帝心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "0a380ca3a405aee700139a51d2591e6ab2cb4aad4894ed5474e2a76ae53f5d1c"}

{"id": "p_b53d6796fd934f7e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 258, "text": "是以唐、虞之設官分職，申命公卿，各以其事，然後惟龍爲納言，猶今尚書也，以出內帝命而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "d121c5ee0a0c5a6853dfd718f7b323db3840653fc0560dd68d77f6642dd1bc20"}

{"id": "p_4fd375fc17e115ad", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 259, "text": "甘誓曰『六事之人』，明六卿亦典事者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "2fb4e96995af2f94962c3c75fe45597c8d03456c655c6c8c04492c5c068a00e3"}

{"id": "p_ead73c8835a59155", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 260, "text": "周官則備矣，五日視朝，公卿大夫並進，而司士辨其位焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "9430d2be1897ef0d9b846b90788366f8b614c49100e5c447f2eab396172d61f7"}

{"id": "p_622d3f95310aeef7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 261, "text": "其記曰：『坐而論道，謂之王公；作而行之，謂之士大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "c93c5c883c5330eb51f479ae06736bd5330eebabf842da96778093ec3a15f1cf"}

{"id": "p_f6a11e017ccbebdf", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 262, "text": "』及漢之初，依擬前代，公卿皆親以事升朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "3f85d0713688847921f17039eb3c3721d088baac7140df2575ff1f4c68fdb509"}

{"id": "p_cc2941853779a1fa", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 263, "text": "故高祖躬追反走之周昌，武帝遙可奉奏之汲黯，宣帝使公卿五日一朝，成帝始置尚書五人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "b3a20f756cb6c05ee0fd0352352ee4fb5c27db7b4171050d6f4bc6308bf9a208"}

{"id": "p_b21887dd944fe882", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 264, "text": "可復五日視朝之儀，使公卿尚書各以事進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "d7cc84c4f84fcb7e3badf671e203942ab88c732249829ccc236143898abae103"}

{"id": "p_405d3a622c9e50ab", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 265, "text": "廢禮復興，光宣聖緒，誠所謂名美而實厚者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "7d765b6bdcbf3f04caa12e6398db6614321be1ce326b0efb92237a51bf6a6506"}

{"id": "p_dede86d675dd9ff9", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 266, "text": "青龍中，山陽公薨，漢主也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "55fe573e8dbf98ccd03782f87e7dec857bccbb7e0cc7389e5caa87630aa3e740"}

{"id": "p_490f3fead63ab49b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 267, "text": "肅上疏曰：「昔唐禪虞，虞禪夏，皆終三年之喪，然後踐天子之尊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "aa7d1cdb3ce2a5b322be85ae9014b22e1e3124bd73d33975cc9809e563b12565"}

{"id": "p_861eb6d0c339e17c", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 268, "text": "是以帝號無虧，君禮猶存。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "0ba7c7e363e2772c2786a3aa6e681c26adebc43e12b7a56f54e4feb5013409a5"}

{"id": "p_498c9b579d7aabb7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 269, "text": "今山陽公承順天命，允荅民望，進禪大魏，退處賔位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "1d9d74e360a7ef27a235ec2d11d7d509b822e8f3f5564414c46fb03d7378cd81"}

{"id": "p_571198be71c50ff4", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 270, "text": "旣至其薨，櫬斂之制，輿徒之飾，皆同之於王者，是故遠近歸仁，以爲盛美。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "99dbcfff9b4c1c204fb025ad40ac2b177e914951636202d5cf8a0bb528823f74"}

{"id": "p_2d5c1325b4acb959", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 271, "text": "且漢緫帝皇之號，號曰皇帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "5dba52c43513efaa067211e32e5753c652c85c7397a640c134a9af5f2351ee30"}

{"id": "p_99b25a2b48750a99", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 272, "text": "有別稱帝，無別稱皇，則皇是其差輕者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "6ce36712ac5327e8f9d4da356147e2047176756205726e7cfe584ff3e1257450"}

{"id": "p_5cf0ff4e87789095", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 273, "text": "故當高祖之時，土無二王，其父見在而使稱皇，明非二王之嫌也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "4f2b1189d36be8b2d25bfef27232bd7728dd56c7f782875e0832520d86ce448a"}

{"id": "p_c997939ad47a0c01", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 274, "text": "況今以贈終，可使稱皇以配其謚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "02ac6b7b76ff6fc8352e1cfd78f4f60f6c16af69061e37903a26b709efa07b61"}

{"id": "p_b57e9a799160c2eb", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 275, "text": "」明帝不從使稱皇，乃追謚曰漢孝獻皇帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "2b83bd2a2033fa67bfb7e6dd50ddf3607503063eccaf216d4dfd968e63e55253"}

{"id": "p_f7823a6e623c857b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 276, "text": "後肅以常侍領祕書監，兼崇文觀祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "38f5835c1afdb8747d3ad27a35d89934bfdf1d95178a6e7a167e84e3c1668905"}

{"id": "p_2f20e0bee264d8e5", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 277, "text": "景初間，宮室盛興，民失農業，期信不敦，刑殺倉卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "0c931c8af642072631a09201fab4b979ed10cd896a23a3b1ba4bfa71ee41b682"}

{"id": "p_8f6d4fb42ff63978", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 278, "text": "肅以疏曰：「大魏承百王之極，生民無幾，干戈未戢，誠宜息民而惠之以安靜遐邇之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "78f39e05ca912e19063fad599e1443bd8f50adb43cd1df41eb192af5ca029006"}

{"id": "p_e3ad84de4756579a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 279, "text": "夫務畜積而息疲民，在於省傜役而勤稼穡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "e473f44c7c02c7e2e1ac2298353f46de8692c49edd1579005c426fad68df9d52"}

{"id": "p_0cd0dcd45e11e8d7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 280, "text": "今宮室未就，功業未訖，運漕調發，轉相供奉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "9a4d2fe5ef3c058b560754bf0890a0fd336076942ae8ab60c5e765ee228ffbbc"}

{"id": "p_99991fac729ad161", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 281, "text": "是以丁夫疲於力作，農者離其南畒，種穀者寡，食穀者衆，舊穀旣沒，新穀莫繼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "4a7c416e743dc6252245e5bd17651b1b10304898da3037d98f82392e4c23818e"}

{"id": "p_204c68d8b74acda5", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 282, "text": "斯則有國之大患，而非備豫之長策也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "69124e02c4d4c4d4bd0985c67dc54b03805629b302056086febc0b9ccb973ad3"}

{"id": "p_e49b30cf26821c26", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 283, "text": "今見作者三四萬人，九龍可以安聖體，其內足以列六宮，顯陽之殿，又向將畢，惟泰極已前，功夫尚大，方向盛寒，疾疢或作。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "d3e7ad8a9e6fb3c839e7d19325dded26a848577c5cdfe65f32a5ddff2f80b2e6"}

{"id": "p_8f3cb6d02a3a062e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 284, "text": "誠願陛下發德音，下明詔，深愍役夫之疲勞，厚矜兆民之不贍，取常食廩之士，非急要者之用，選其丁壯，擇留萬人，使一朞而更之，咸知息代有日，則莫不恱以即事，勞而不怨矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "ca53c54fdcec3b55103d10d469d938a2f6c9786bc664b271a5e85b9dd8fbcd18"}

{"id": "p_8caec9b41b6cb446", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 285, "text": "計一歲有三百六十萬夫，亦不爲少。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "84b7a43c663e1043edfbffb5cb917811759e2f6396abc8dc541dc0403203bc04"}

{"id": "p_1cbe5fdbf4e7b26b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 286, "text": "分遣其餘，使皆即農，無窮之計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "33d72a4a46205a5eb36eaaec45b608e4bad486ad7c3d62c14e606c56f5d47946"}

{"id": "p_94632fb534764ff3", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 287, "text": "倉有溢粟，民有餘力：以此興功，何功不立？", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "e0acc09509f447d7926f782496611b1a3511d541520238f180614bafe1deca2e"}

{"id": "p_726a859623fd7578", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 288, "text": "夫信之於民，國家大寶也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "577f26c7bb5221430af6891b6748dd77499673bc85a92af426ccc8e62283c724"}

{"id": "p_5ed8f63fd8d1cb03", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 289, "text": "仲尼曰：『自古皆有死，民非信不立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "4996622c7904ed8fec085238114ad95f52f16ada51d5917e2bc1c8ae5a965b2f"}

{"id": "p_dd6054774da15c11", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 290, "text": "』夫區區之晉國，微微之重耳，欲用其民，先示以信，是故原雖將降，顧信而歸，用能一戰而霸，于今見稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "8bb228b06e151def65a69a989f89e0a0eb5eec697f39030522ad613fa40a37ae"}

{"id": "p_738b335efc2a406d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 291, "text": "前車駕當幸洛陽，發民爲營，有司命以營成而罷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "17737de39219d95689a653e62b8adebbd096846faab19ad20a1046ed71ecc750"}

{"id": "p_a6bba87600728c8d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 292, "text": "旣成，又利其功力，不以時遣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "b1691d0ddb69c70e7ed84e6b6f085cd599e6c0c218578b33cd5a7d49c803b1c9"}

{"id": "p_531613f52bbc02f5", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 293, "text": "有司徒營其目前之利，不顧經國之體。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "75c4d57fcb9d84d68f3e8534bdb3fda2d56b7e26efe2dd09ce4f28f78c03e628"}

{"id": "p_7d304143d0c276c7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 294, "text": "臣愚以爲自今已後，儻復使民，宜明其令，使必如期。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "19f87f2b836efcae3364e6ab763243eef911c03a608a25bb8dbdc37cf777446b"}

{"id": "p_398ac3a666563645", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 295, "text": "若有事以次，寧復更發，無或失信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "040f558b1e7993dbff203c67c6b95b07e3c3ed9a5c4f9650f145064b5aeb220f"}

{"id": "p_51834297a3a7a49e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 296, "text": "凡陛下臨時之所行刑，皆有罪之吏，宜死之人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "941a75e4b2b9bb2876c0d9f44009275d43a7ab17327368c5be77f5788ae46cd4"}

{"id": "p_96b3c6790bd76144", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 297, "text": "故願陛下下之於吏而暴其罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "cce31373905b0ac5abb8cc43baff954906160bcff8b91fcc2536bf0749b05ebb"}

{"id": "p_3cc9519165fadb23", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 298, "text": "鈞其死也，無使汙于宮掖而爲遠近所疑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "569f26995007714f4f004b72a40b4b9735b059020cb100863f22674a414ad534"}

{"id": "p_aa57cc9f0145da33", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 299, "text": "且人命至重，難生易殺，氣絕而不續者也，是以聖賢重之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "3644df42c20c732a460ff254313798031d4e7b153b3be487bd12990ee852d86a"}

{"id": "p_d362989b1a840ef1", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 300, "text": "孟軻稱殺一無辜以取天下，仁者不爲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "d0d573e23e43013a6dcf73ef6a52e08016db5aa5e8b8be552ee6934b36061373"}

{"id": "p_d719142859576e49", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 301, "text": "漢時有犯蹕驚乘輿馬者，廷尉張釋之奏使罰金，文帝恠其輕，而釋之曰：『方其時，上使誅之則已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "c6c6aa979669425e24e7db1f670bc8a7c69da4bd03b6699056370fa4c9a83fe2"}

{"id": "p_1728d7288cd7ab52", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 302, "text": "廷尉，天下之平也，一傾之，天下用法皆爲輕重，民安所措其手足？", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "95b209a7a37d4d9efa90b94337d940b2fa8d38bf70e37a7add388d28d7f001e5"}

{"id": "p_5400821c348ef685", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 303, "text": "』臣以爲大失其義，非忠臣所宜陳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 303}, "text_hash": "32c4753b6c0f3307031e2cb0beab818f5c57649728723076adfd751929e37686"}

{"id": "p_dd1fd6a5541012fb", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 304, "text": "廷尉者，天子之吏也，猶不可以失平，而天子之身，反可以惑謬乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 304}, "text_hash": "888f47249be32420dc4f139b3adbe2f7ca9f037841189c2e54190ca2aad41b9c"}

{"id": "p_ecb6a274e24f1eb9", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 305, "text": "斯重於爲己，而輕於爲君，不忠之甚也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 305}, "text_hash": "f15356704aa48bdda0709c448173ef11bcd286b47864c26e331b250a3815f1de"}

{"id": "p_4f0fc7516726c1b7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 306, "text": "周公曰：『天子無戲言；言則史書之，工誦之，士稱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 306}, "text_hash": "67c6785bc4d4caddb4716fff39702975df28c6ab13811c87fbfc601d9aefa94c"}

{"id": "p_49bc68ca2636b053", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 307, "text": "』言猶不戲，而况行之乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 307}, "text_hash": "2dbf46da3290c77f2d39ddede9ebe0c612f2e6fd1dbf7e0d8db0b9baa6f683d2"}

{"id": "p_beb944f6a3d29309", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 308, "text": "故釋之之言不可不察，周公之戒不可不法也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 308}, "text_hash": "c5cf148208017956cd90416a862fa6af696f6e371e8fcdf4b2ce7091b890c806"}

{"id": "p_4276dab3cfecb10e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 309, "text": "」又陳「諸鳥獸無用之物，而有芻穀人徒之費，皆可蠲除。", "locator": {"ordinal": 309}, "text_hash": "30a63dee416d8a47b40e699ab18efd9a7d8a6945bc21d6a16a49b653d26c7566"}

{"id": "p_178da6513a400669", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 310, "text": "帝嘗問曰：「漢桓帝時，白馬令李雲上書言：『帝者，諦也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 310}, "text_hash": "ca8926ba8f5ba6065f94594c868236f96a5e27ec6039689e8995e22ed052f8f9"}

{"id": "p_8daa094aeee61ca6", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 311, "text": "」肅對曰：「但爲言失逆順之節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 311}, "text_hash": "e1606835527ed34ebc4aa3dd116e62f311d0e685c3cc5621d24187d66ed15c39"}

{"id": "p_2a58f2888cbab03e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 312, "text": "原其本意，皆欲盡心，念存補國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 312}, "text_hash": "237c02b8778f96e3e379b78f5a2b550d6c58a8068ae7c3b0f8aa9294ebce1a1d"}

{"id": "p_83bd1efb8cfa4795", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 313, "text": "且帝者之威，過於雷霆，殺一匹夫，無異螻蟻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 313}, "text_hash": "8c73fba012b4c79c988ef2926c355eaa34f6e99b95bbc2629962ead3a7ab4c37"}

{"id": "p_23384c29a7f1ad05", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 314, "text": "寬而宥之，可以示容受切言，廣德宇於天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 314}, "text_hash": "c2dd3721ce0e5e1a10b7458d18c31f0d6b97102120790b3a5be6dab8060a4b9f"}

{"id": "p_1b1c3b6b0e264762", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 315, "text": "故臣以爲殺之未必爲是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 315}, "text_hash": "cedf7546738f8cd1ab2d16dd71459fa3287f7c23590161c66570df8af49b9f4a"}

{"id": "p_b1da3170995214b6", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 316, "text": "」帝又問：「司馬遷以受刑之故，內懷隱切，著《史記》非貶孝武，令人切齒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 316}, "text_hash": "61c17492a7d7c2f3b7b5148d856ed5226abcdd5f419f9cdf0afea342841ed5d5"}

{"id": "p_7b098caa165aee1e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 317, "text": "」對曰：「司馬遷記事，不虛美，不隱惡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 317}, "text_hash": "5096b2c3816d5a07bbb693e634741aa2dcba8b452178db3567f12d859b755eda"}

{"id": "p_387146887a796b65", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 318, "text": "劉向、揚雄服其善叙事，有良史之才，謂之實錄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 318}, "text_hash": "49178417b63f4cd4a8d5ac8f41a10924c2b9603cdaeaf91648b3789974b96329"}

{"id": "p_a54d11f33724563b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 319, "text": "漢武帝聞其述《史記》，取孝景及己本紀覽之，於是大怒，削而投之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 319}, "text_hash": "486be640dfceb3cbd2182d7f6dc59ba4f42dcd5311bd1ca9df5fe618e216d826"}

{"id": "p_5c1422cf6230da77", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 320, "text": "後遭李陵事，遂下遷蠶室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 320}, "text_hash": "a52aca8c42934457c4fb2e3f60bbaa9be8308642aa693de1f7b61e155d450bb8"}

{"id": "p_7c2400f91f55612d", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 321, "text": "此爲隱切在孝武，而不在於史遷也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 321}, "text_hash": "be6913faef45e93b4cd69c9a0dd4c54277625fb59825b6db317cb996176271dd"}

{"id": "p_1deaa6890374921b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 322, "text": "時大將軍曹爽專權，任用何晏、鄧颺等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 322}, "text_hash": "4c657151e704a4c90a144af345db8fe4f4ce935cfc87d53fe9982566d57d7d1e"}

{"id": "p_1077895d7c8d7e43", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 323, "text": "肅與太尉蔣濟、司農桓範論及時政，肅正色曰：「此輩即弘恭、石顯之屬，復稱說邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 323}, "text_hash": "9e5b20840e7e42c2b9fe8dcec56b63a069de38ac7301c04bde27d2246229c45f"}

{"id": "p_a04dceab2092af19", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 324, "text": "」爽聞之，戒何晏等曰：「當共慎之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 324}, "text_hash": "ce428a73397f2ce0ef9169719276291b1d71e1e73be43e9b9f57758ec3b4944a"}

{"id": "p_9540e0963e81aad1", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 325, "text": "公卿已比諸君前世惡人矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 325}, "text_hash": "9f9f82ed168180eaed129cca4d7081bd83a89ec73fc9625b5872da340edfa6fb"}

{"id": "p_768e0e9d53023cf8", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 326, "text": "時有二魚長尺，集于武庫之屋，有司以爲吉祥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 326}, "text_hash": "29cec8d03e7c53c62ff4bfddf9fc25bbc0ef7cf9ba9c66fe84428f48f55dba2c"}

{"id": "p_0e14ad856e696ad7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 327, "text": "肅曰：「魚生於淵而亢於屋，介鱗之物失其所也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 327}, "text_hash": "53433902fb805005f0206bf1ccf0fdb5f79cac3ad92eaf03de4352cf5c664d20"}

{"id": "p_dfb3a177c32916c5", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 328, "text": "，持節兼太常，奉法駕，迎高貴鄉公于元城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 328}, "text_hash": "2a339cc8fcb9cd5ab86ec515aa10d4eb6e7eef019f6b37e02f37c4678209715c"}

{"id": "p_df9e708ecd494787", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 329, "text": "是歲，白氣經天，大將軍司馬景王問肅其故，肅荅曰：「此蚩尤之旗也，東南其有亂乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 329}, "text_hash": "e0be0a8bb3e16e6fb833d4cd14f7641c18a08898fe7b6839900045da327720e3"}

{"id": "p_b85eb4313a3330a7", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 330, "text": "君若脩己以安百姓，則天下樂安者歸德，唱亂者先亡矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 330}, "text_hash": "4972e15185218989f90f5e960b59a6690ae97d2ef9833731a339f0fa205e0618"}

{"id": "p_5aef9c19c7de2132", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 331, "text": "」明年春，鎮東將軍毌丘儉、揚州刺史文欽反，景王謂肅曰：「霍光感夏侯勝之言，始重儒學之士，良有以也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 331}, "text_hash": "4c6e575bb826561e0cec8dc3bd0344765d5dac2c25207686adacc376f88da992"}

{"id": "p_cfadaa2aed14a266", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 332, "text": "」肅曰：「昔關羽率荊州之衆，降于禁於漢濵，遂有北向爭天下之志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 332}, "text_hash": "e59886c282b2b4c14393cde4c9835f63c468925b434d15e956492a7b4bbd8687"}

{"id": "p_67ec6061a540066e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 333, "text": "後孫權襲取其將士家屬，羽士衆一旦瓦解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 333}, "text_hash": "60114a01d67c247649afbb65491ecb9df111885dd400bf5e3cc3d48f13e02cd8"}

{"id": "p_63b60df60c0bebaa", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 334, "text": "今淮南將士父母妻子皆在內州，但急往禦衞，使不得前，必有關羽土崩之勢矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 334}, "text_hash": "06cca8d3e8433a6971f657bf0b65980ade371fe481b650fcf01037869797bce1"}

{"id": "p_972f62001556df25", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 335, "text": "」景王從之，遂破儉、欽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 335}, "text_hash": "07f36d92fe546c0193c2bebbe4093100744fc19221f8cfb9158d64d9f212e783"}

{"id": "p_5e7816ae8a1d388b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 336, "text": "後遷中領軍，加散騎常侍，增邑三百，并前二千二百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 336}, "text_hash": "9b67d0ddd2f2be92fd36378e1fad7732f41dbe54e38376ca6144ed6529a2e875"}

{"id": "p_5c79d8da2fade9ec", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 337, "text": "咸熈中，開建五等，以肅著勳前朝，改封恂爲氶子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 337}, "text_hash": "a53fa39d7b7d1e13f8865c0bfc61adcdc08641b36a45613cd78c068102a7c48a"}

{"id": "p_9bdf0dec4d8dbb34", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 338, "text": "初，肅善賈、馬之學，而不好鄭氏，采會同異，爲《尚書》、《詩》、《論語》、三禮、《左氏解》，及撰定父朗所作易傳，皆列於學官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 338}, "text_hash": "d51361b4d43b79a8d36b4247531cfe7486d9d5baf8865a5f6614633595dd7378"}

{"id": "p_a7f9ad77d1de593e", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 339, "text": "其所論駮朝廷典制、郊祀、宗廟、喪紀、輕重，凡百餘篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 339}, "text_hash": "931e88b865e101853f06c5e145afa6efb270ecd22cf3a2663dcea88d9aafbab1"}

{"id": "p_de63db31c820c813", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 340, "text": "時樂安孫叔然，授學鄭玄之門，人稱東州大儒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 340}, "text_hash": "9184e722d471c0ed576cbe9c3a5dcdd97bf45f35f5ac45f8c96469eb2d0b4133"}

{"id": "p_dac4c55705837bfb", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 341, "text": "肅集聖證論以譏短玄，叔然駮而釋之，及作《周易》、《春秋例》，《毛詩》、《禮記》、《春秋》三傳、《國語》、《爾雅》諸注，又著書十餘篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 341}, "text_hash": "63afc595e8fdb9da67e2917f43f7b8c398cf0fb1ef0c9398fcfb85dc6ce3a2ea"}

{"id": "p_dead79d09757ed3a", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 342, "text": "自魏初徵士燉煌周生烈，明帝時大司農弘農董遇等，亦歷注經傳，頗傳於世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 342}, "text_hash": "e6ae61da2cb8fba1884bdefedb7334decff702f9b8310f28461d934b68acacf9"}

{"id": "p_5e488b27e2be013b", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 343, "text": "評曰：鍾繇開達理幹，華歆清純德素，王朗文博富贍，誠皆一時之俊偉也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 343}, "text_hash": "9ee226b6cb307eafdcd4a0d4ed14eca3f5728cd8c25c800c631743df445c1a82"}

{"id": "p_1356d4c7c063e896", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 344, "text": "魏氏初祚，肇登三司，盛矣夫！", "locator": {"ordinal": 344}, "text_hash": "b85ea11b909c99778d95629a76fb10d0ce792505bf976986e942c6f998b9000b"}

{"id": "p_c266a605fca3c9f2", "source_id": "src_e6f26fd0d5e5e763", "ordinal": 345, "text": "王肅亮直多聞，能析薪哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 345}, "text_hash": "f77514ea24d39cc480009299d21e04b6ad42440ea565f1960b8c47063e8d5d0a"}

{"id": "p_1723393d9b36f1ee", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 0, "text": "程昱字仲德，東郡東阿人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "b165e413261c8b24e7f97d9613de6de87b25d8b9e91638236f29ee6ea17a955b"}

{"id": "p_d9edf89e03723ae8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 1, "text": "黃巾起，縣丞王度反應之，燒倉庫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "73287f0d5a32a1efc646d84570be6a39d9ba407ec0201377a7a44bab0f73a53c"}

{"id": "p_9d495a7beddbe956", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 2, "text": "縣令逾城走，吏民負老幼東奔渠丘山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "e657a1c346d2af70496d1a295dca9e13988548480f97a166101cc67e1c37f1fc"}

{"id": "p_2505e32ea49cc6c4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 3, "text": "昱使人偵視度，度等得空城不能守，出城西五六里止屯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "f67849bdfbd535588bf67c20745bce54067159b859293b7b07e4983ba1464930"}

{"id": "p_45c144466bd990b7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 4, "text": "昱謂縣中大姓薛房等曰：「今度等得城郭不能居，其勢可知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "b195450c9165306b79642644ba52a9b7b4986caf46dc059478c539c83a996706"}

{"id": "p_3466fa6b248e5bc7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 5, "text": "此不過欲虜掠財物，非有堅甲利兵攻守之志也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "f6a8f711e3e6fa02233ddec468708edfe43332d5fce6807ca80f483f0568c855"}

{"id": "p_fbe2982099c84c09", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 6, "text": "且城高厚，多穀米，今若還求令，共堅守，度必不能久，攻可破也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "50afdb37c2e12d5009b56f491528eefa75afc1595bd9378f8f9edbb3586313a1"}

{"id": "p_7e6f80597c761cb5", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 7, "text": "吏民不肯從，曰：「賊在西，但有東耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "7d2498e43c540bcc17dcd5300a466e9561a92a8af3be376a9b0668037e8f4fb0"}

{"id": "p_38f6740f98ba64e8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」昱謂房等：「愚民不可計事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "cb547359a0125c14768fa71c4e56f45c61d57058e13095bcfd4e71d8579038ac"}

{"id": "p_97a0b0a83a8d7578", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」乃密遣數騎舉幡於東山上，令房等望見，大呼言「賊已至」，便下山趣城，吏民奔走隨之，求得縣令，遂共城守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "f7863df433bc18f63a772199579b6a299d37b095a2010870153aea42f696e715"}

{"id": "p_a73a3f7fdf55a353", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 10, "text": "度等來攻城，不能下，欲去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "c9b77212d3462e1f52329b047acbd7746b20e029cf8cb487215707dae64cc3e8"}

{"id": "p_429c60b661f856a2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 11, "text": "昱率吏民開城門急擊之，度等破走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "d8e98c94dbee7057a90377ff92263b534d22984ee656eec5128d66a73b9c24e1"}

{"id": "p_7549120e671285a6", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 12, "text": "初平中，兗州刺史劉岱辟昱，昱不應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "a7f97de403d33423b75faea45369eda12d674d274e645f4377a15fe50a592138"}

{"id": "p_4455fa5234252616", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 13, "text": "是時岱與袁紹、公孫瓚和親，紹令妻子居岱所，瓚亦遣從事范方將騎助岱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "e1158abbd7c7ca5de17e60e8d9f599cc6c3d77179515285c71bb3c84cd73ffeb"}

{"id": "p_fdcccdf10919ca3d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 14, "text": "瓚擊破紹軍，乃遣使語岱，令遣紹妻子，使與紹絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "3e0f40613eeb40ae13062f19184a74b6ee7b658f8b5dce9595f0190c9f488448"}

{"id": "p_0a65d9962de3b0a9", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 15, "text": "別敕范方：「若岱不遣紹家，將騎還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "c3e489037b9a18a6e057be54b440ca88bbafa92ab66f35bfca165ea7d00dae01"}

{"id": "p_bc10024bea33ef88", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 16, "text": "」岱議連日不決，別駕王彧白岱：「程昱有謀，能斷大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "2414b80bdd36f8fb187301a5d475d24406a3473d74ca56bce3fe075553c2ecb1"}

{"id": "p_30eddb5b8714bdb1", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 17, "text": "」岱乃召見昱，問計，昱曰：「若棄紹近援而求瓚遠助，此假人於越以救溺子之說也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "b6afa3eaad65b5f1699cf66b6dfa5cae37f25afe0112bc246569a008266e9dc1"}

{"id": "p_13df1c0c129ce2e3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 18, "text": "夫公孫瓚，非袁紹之敵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "9aab1ba5ec5c9e27fbf5fb3c408ebf16ca54f7ca224d25bf3c2d65519317dac2"}

{"id": "p_8b445790dafcc5df", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 19, "text": "今雖壞紹軍，然終為紹所禽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "48deb5c0a9e49e1c8861861f88a3e82ae6821195b16428bcfda1b1a7b8968cda"}

{"id": "p_3b17db5c502900f1", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 20, "text": "夫趣一朝之權而不慮遠計，將軍終敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "15f51a4d21b7809b6ae5c49a264ea56a146c5b2820fe5a846b26d0150c54e19d"}

{"id": "p_55ade17a55fedd63", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 21, "text": "范方將其騎歸，未至，瓚大為紹所破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "73e2f47b5d58a61a894e844c1ec9740bcd9ab80d51f89327cdab6356af416b03"}

{"id": "p_4fad0d9f6ae2dd40", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 22, "text": "岱表昱為騎都尉，昱辭以疾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "cf27677fa485f2bac35fd032ef40d6dd9bd53da775f9ee122d5bd22d1310d0af"}

{"id": "p_43721e3d0cd64e9a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 23, "text": "昱將行，其鄉人謂曰：「何前後之相背也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "42b04b570486708680481337a1978bb6cb4bac06dea9e7c49918a2c540fa3f91"}

{"id": "p_948b0f4090ff0956", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 24, "text": "太祖與語，說之，以昱守壽張令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "6cacffc34d1e40fb0c3f80a125c3ff2f453ac5577225d3afc1776c5e2ee0be43"}

{"id": "p_c1fc38c2f9c9cf7d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 25, "text": "太祖征徐州，使昱與荀彧留守鄄城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "7cc38e5d52e8ed6104cd6ac1e87aa20d483949ed5f0a0315e4bebb752550a52f"}

{"id": "p_372e632b372d1480", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 26, "text": "張邈等叛迎呂布，郡縣響應，唯鄄城、范、東阿不動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "cc327cd2ff580d52edaaea4cfcb7b0182778464a2f92f3c0a465d42e2a6675a9"}

{"id": "p_08f5e9dc46e2bf7d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 27, "text": "布軍降者，言陳宮欲自將兵取東阿，又使氾嶷取范，吏民皆恐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "2993cf10e6e3d982b75a2457a2bed4a8bddd813e65f175540aef3c46d918410e"}

{"id": "p_9000cefe0ecd4668", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 28, "text": "彧謂昱曰：「今兗州反，唯有此三城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "47cc8c71b68eabb2b207ee0d69c99926221522fc17999fe86dd7dafb7613719f"}

{"id": "p_293a3b5d043cbc10", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 29, "text": "宮等以重兵臨之，非有以深結其心，三城必動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "891ecac391696a0411428e9f72ac98579bbe2faa9e13136c32070d4c43057c39"}

{"id": "p_a3891a740f1acd90", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 30, "text": "君，民之望也，歸而說之，殆可！", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "0c86f0428272667eefa60ebb1ba73fe2f5047c98b9385cb4874274cba245ee59"}

{"id": "p_bc201d6a93d10893", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」昱乃歸，過范，說其令靳允曰：「聞呂布執君母弟妻子，孝子誠不可為心！", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "6b3f536d14c664205a39bfdc66e47ac395c3bcb174c18f9c444995727efddc2b"}

{"id": "p_16ca7ec32f207154", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 32, "text": "今天下大亂，英雄並起，必有命世，能息天下之亂者，此智者所詳擇也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "41ffeffbcd90fdf66981f90338c3ebd0ee496661f4c3208a95edc3e179290a7d"}

{"id": "p_263ff5147301008b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 33, "text": "陳宮叛迎呂布而百城皆應，似能有為，然以君觀之，布何如人哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "c243b375a8e0ed6c1f04818e66d5d864b95bbf2cfd2e6644f14ea3d0ff9ec784"}

{"id": "p_f803e03856ef7696", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 34, "text": "夫布，粗中少親，剛而無禮，匹夫之雄耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "656095ae44632631b54f3d104c78fe85ff6e8ed51b5b0bb974dba65e14197fb6"}

{"id": "p_f40c6c7da3d5c3bb", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 35, "text": "宮等以勢假合，不能相君也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "f1673cfd6a99a9d65c1f0101ba36d28e38336c3b759d4e6676923434d9269c67"}

{"id": "p_031da826180cb2a5", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 36, "text": "曹使君智略不世出，殆天所授！", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "d4b756db3332453578590c55671df7de649268cf0adeacc01f6acc619f48091f"}

{"id": "p_3643e8e885d21464", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 37, "text": "君必固范，我守東阿，則田單之功可立也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "2d77e6e03d7366284425aca989201c9fd2dfe908599685ccab46945edcd17f32"}

{"id": "p_86f8037adeb26fc1", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 38, "text": "孰與違忠從惡而母子俱亡乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "2f4d886a6ed8fb6d77a20f3007a65f5c2ebdb0e53ec983bb4a478249e0728a81"}

{"id": "p_a57979bbf49cadbd", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」允流涕曰：「不敢有二心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "c8147a38622d2607fff08ac2244cdbc86f8a897da71406a62cdaf0affabce7ef"}

{"id": "p_ecd49a41d3c450a4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」時氾嶷已在縣，允乃見嶷，伏兵刺殺之，歸勒兵守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "3d1fc2da21265ab9dbf743280edd763e0ac5fd8d7e712a660514228a8fedccfc"}

{"id": "p_941d5c94db13f5de", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 41, "text": "昱又遣別騎絕倉亭津，陳宮至，不得渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "9566264ca6e51897db8f6df602955e845b373eff7ef5fde5407012d855a142f2"}

{"id": "p_27319f6a40adecec", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 42, "text": "昱至東阿，東阿令棗祗已率厲吏民，拒城堅守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "5b488da0ace650da56221f193a919249bf43d67eef1dfef8c8bcae5ee5125644"}

{"id": "p_f84e71eef40f8358", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 43, "text": "又兗州從事薛悌與昱協謀，卒完三城，以待太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "cd42908c5eb264ec91e523aa7617a1a54dce6d94c20294765cfff3e2e8157e62"}

{"id": "p_c7b924cdc118b62a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 44, "text": "太祖還，執昱手曰：「微子之力，吾無所歸矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "20d7551f287ae7956b587b51251e291ecc1b4c624fa3b815d101ddb40eaabd2c"}

{"id": "p_602016c9f2f49ef5", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」乃表昱為東平相，屯范。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "9111ae0466167e92de062985d9733b83cdd9e5a27b1edfbf0c91db7d3dba6f99"}

{"id": "p_840aaef9646ae0e2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 46, "text": "太祖與呂布戰於濮陽，數不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "f54aac5d0ea95aa70d76179e8628daa3d124a810f9d9dd5b712a70f3adeca9ac"}

{"id": "p_d40644dba16e04b0", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 47, "text": "於是袁紹使人說太祖連和，欲使太祖遷家居鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "8b73615eec94d74eecf7c64eb39f10aca8a53dae25436a9fedb2b36837568dc8"}

{"id": "p_56b68dd3d7ab1a72", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 48, "text": "太祖新失兗州，軍食盡，將許之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "25dc796df3ef6d4922fcaaeec3518a7af4e52bce43cff533ae835a9ae3dab46a"}

{"id": "p_98b9a37c42aaea48", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 49, "text": "時昱使適還，引見，因言曰：「竊聞將軍欲遣家，與袁紹連和，誠有之乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "c5b183789611aea2aa5979823e4df43824cb0c9e2c5bbf0da8a5ef83472cdf90"}

{"id": "p_31b845cba7799641", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」昱曰：「意者將軍殆臨事而懼，不然何慮之不深也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "037dadbc7119771661d9b4f457a918746086f43a3327e8fe2616dbf02541bcbb"}

{"id": "p_8910cb8dddae186a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 51, "text": "夫袁紹據燕、趙之地，有並天下之心，而智不能濟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "a2c46f4f882c4ec5704da00df36f5f42961e8276cb2ae54b2c2ab5b4188d4c54"}

{"id": "p_b41908fc9da6f29d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 52, "text": "將軍以龍虎之威，可為韓、彭之事邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "cd55dee78a537b65e30ed2a42286aa136f9f9aa10aefa3afa1dad9a51dc77a99"}

{"id": "p_a72e9b72d850840a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 53, "text": "以將軍之神武，與文若、昱等，收而用之，霸王之業可成也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "a9abdae951a739645090a4fd9f9173f3c065be4c615bdf1782b594d843669f60"}

{"id": "p_9b685c494f03b048", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 54, "text": "兗州尚未安集，復以昱為東中郎將，領濟陰太守，都督兗州事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "3a5c4528dc5c5189267d853ef413b2f53015f5df42863a931777f50361f7c7c6"}

{"id": "p_a703cea7c631ae4e", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 55, "text": "昱說太祖殺備，太祖不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "62ff41d67017eb422adad765cdc7ac5630545a337040fc3ea337676b8af6da48"}

{"id": "p_1f77c1b367979ef8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 56, "text": "後又遣備至徐州要擊袁術，昱與郭嘉說太祖曰：「公前日不圖備，昱等誠不及也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "a2ffd8e76b6bb58df8ba7bbae6838855ef7104b76499c7fd63f7f6022c0fb766"}

{"id": "p_b5225706f1d3b145", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 57, "text": "會術病死，備至徐州，遂殺車冑，舉兵背太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "42c5d035cb5f8edae81d95af2e7b9a725c7c406378d2aaec78eefc28700b35f6"}

{"id": "p_3b62df0a88f62b09", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 58, "text": "時昱有七百兵守鄄城，太祖聞之，使人告昱，欲益二千兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "43eb7df8fdea13ea4bacb35c8341a439f64c8927fe73837abeb6f9f590fb1d2f"}

{"id": "p_e81a81991b063f85", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 59, "text": "昱不肯，曰：「袁紹擁十萬眾，自以所向無前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "26bd6f4a29807e309946f5f3538756fae4149eb827dad81e11f9855702f062d4"}

{"id": "p_8104c0e5944f5854", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 60, "text": "今見昱兵少，必輕易不來攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "79c2890da145dac77ec8dec75931da002b2cacebd746ac00df571daa8a75b6af"}

{"id": "p_3eabd2f1c212081f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 61, "text": "若益昱兵，過則不可不攻，攻之必克，徒兩損其勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "f07691f4a577548587bf89a38ac0aabcb8081d5c038e54a347e84f28f1b193c5"}

{"id": "p_18f046e0fed835c2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 62, "text": "太祖謂賈詡曰：「程昱之膽，過於賁、育。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "2bd88b50a789876aa0e0f78378bfa7d9e0662fef91d3138121276322787ff50f"}

{"id": "p_2afce5c8b67683fa", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」昱收山澤亡命，得精兵數千人，乃引軍與太祖會黎陽，討袁譚、袁尚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "8e0bda192bd921e80ee7e9740899dea124f33939124ba4aa8c7b06dc1a54ec00"}

{"id": "p_8bcc9322322fe524", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 64, "text": "譚、尚破走，拜昱奮武將軍，封安國亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "4f10f31da637e90d605f6ad3b65fe6b92682f3574900cc04c20e69efea7fcc42"}

{"id": "p_e25cf346445abe10", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 65, "text": "論者以為孫權必殺備，昱料之曰：「孫權新在位，未為海內所憚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "0c602144665ec7ef0c065baa2c13a1e07c50e8d7f0e61450fe3b61d1f844eebf"}

{"id": "p_565422fa2e967569", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 66, "text": "曹公無敵於天下，初舉荊州，威震江表，權雖有謀，不能獨當也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "722151f7e1f39ae47c3763fcdb7fa6799688a03bcdec50e7a0206648b8ccc339"}

{"id": "p_02492af71b3783b6", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 67, "text": "劉備有英名，關羽、張飛皆萬人敵也，權必資之以我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "67f1a9205356b3fafd5e54cd5cbf50199b6327f628d8251ad781a43b330b5030"}

{"id": "p_34517341a4b8afb3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 68, "text": "難解勢分，備資以成，又不可得而殺也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "fc5fcc86783e1ac440226d86728b7bb7bff8025ac1987ec49fe12b93996d8d71"}

{"id": "p_8fefdd019c5de67c", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」權果多與備兵，以太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "52ef5d10342917364158195bb2c213a140abe0491df555cb37230a81b967f03a"}

{"id": "p_0bc6b68d6d0557e1", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 70, "text": "是後中夏漸平，太祖拊昱背曰：「兗州之敗，不用君言，吾何以至此？", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "6f9fafdef51ea2977121c3efee4f79ae3b830124a37aba1e5ef95817bf94f459"}

{"id": "p_5506c042cfe457f2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」宗人奉牛酒大會，昱曰：「知足不辱，吾可以退矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "60b7cb256ca4a18d10a9566437a436f5076cb7ee69d5227c36e45b989706a505"}

{"id": "p_62be5e66f74198d5", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 72, "text": "」乃自表歸兵，闔門不出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "fd081a6cb5a23573e416784b2b53134070e1102deb43ef9dca57ed65104b409b"}

{"id": "p_0c73f5cc6565bc7b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 73, "text": "人有告昱謀反，太祖賜待益厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "2082f9299ce25e6967f91864401c17d0a22de8cca673e72005c5cb4552a2fc29"}

{"id": "p_4dba306b782291af", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 74, "text": "魏國既建，為衛尉，與中尉邢貞爭威儀，免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "b2d35dbda9a8f3146e83b8ca65426550b6bbb1a216ed043ef24a774993584287"}

{"id": "p_f40dbca8f880520f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 75, "text": "文帝踐阼，復為衛尉，進封安鄉侯，增邑三百戶，並前八百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "d9e1b5b948c4297cc7fbe4abbef4256df8dde671628f1e70a5f36bb360467d6f"}

{"id": "p_69ab20a45615ef43", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 76, "text": "方欲以為公，會薨，帝為流涕，追贈車騎將軍，諡曰肅侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "f16aa7a50b7fd73fecc235a05eb963cded0e64794428f4feee4ef91f9f8e7ce3"}

{"id": "p_c1f43204ce102ced", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 77, "text": "曉遷汝南太守，年四十餘薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "4e4ac887e68b25d0ec72dc80f77b86b7d1b5d5d59cccee57b7a5118439760c67"}

{"id": "p_04dbdcccf184598a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 78, "text": "郭嘉字奉孝，潁川陽翟人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "462b9283ace212aeb278935346f49a01f9b77a5ebb9d89eb67d4be7b2d607669"}

{"id": "p_f1c90a21dee19e05", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 79, "text": "初，北見袁紹，謂紹謀臣辛評、郭圖曰：「夫智者審於量主，故百舉百全而功名可立也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "0f81c96ef8517780534264ff6a0bb4b1ea0195b57ff9b4f294221ca10c47052b"}

{"id": "p_bb094753707b58a6", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 80, "text": "袁公徒欲效周公之下士，而未知用人之機。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "ca3566b48e3c0dfdc25f9e29eaa1f40d3ee5b068f02d0daf4c24791368d6978e"}

{"id": "p_c2cb972237dc9289", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 81, "text": "多端寡要，好謀無決，欲與共濟天下大難，定霸王之業，難矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "c5bf963add29ed8d29d83313852e80bcf5fc15f92e3651886dc8ac715ce0b115"}

{"id": "p_a63dc2808f9d05c7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 82, "text": "先是時，潁川戲志才，籌畫士也，太祖甚器之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "09f8a3cea3a8e90bda425e43247ede3e7b51d223c65a2c28688707d07648ad33"}

{"id": "p_af636c7df0cc0ab6", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 83, "text": "太祖與荀彧書曰：「自志才亡後，莫可與計事者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "fc6bfd72cec0f1af33ce530ebc5773d5a391f88683849d5c1ce121758db9b7e5"}

{"id": "p_05630d697b123817", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 84, "text": "汝、潁固多奇士，誰可以繼之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "f7491a85670d404c13f34c4df4ae72e495fa57f83986656d45ea91cdcbd4c242"}

{"id": "p_f5d4156bf8d4b94f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 85, "text": "太祖曰：「使孤成大業者，必此人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "9cae34af76c79ce8dee75f1c998d0586105fd4475f16e139559e7312a63c84c6"}

{"id": "p_31f282212acaa4c9", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 86, "text": "」嘉出，亦喜曰：「真吾主也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "36a1ab15c4a1b7e869194c79c5de15845019597c8e2630a79bc679c3cf522668"}

{"id": "p_78e11e361173f461", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 87, "text": "征呂布，三戰破之，布退固守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "68f382b3fdb22bdb596dc6163613cba3068e3df1122151c452caf448e5721c42"}

{"id": "p_429fa86ea0cf4386", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 88, "text": "時士卒疲倦，太祖欲引軍還，嘉說太祖急攻之，遂禽布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "fa5da56dc35b68f11540057f6a740670f0b13d036bb722691256689961790946"}

{"id": "p_2b72fdeb4fbdf43e", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 89, "text": "孫策轉鬪千里，盡有江東，聞太祖與袁紹相持於官渡，將渡江北襲許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "7155bb5deb9605e4a1a0d048cdb4452de9bbfb5ee07fe5151a59e1fde5ffbd84"}

{"id": "p_e8c98c3acdfb9563", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 90, "text": "眾聞皆懼，嘉料之曰：「策新並江東，所誅皆英豪雄傑，能得人死力者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "fcaaed8a165d05c2adb7b47bb5f49a7868f305f3b23638a5f55f4e6bd05da4a6"}

{"id": "p_8767f15713749d56", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 91, "text": "然策輕而無備，雖有百萬之眾，無異於獨行中原也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "87fe49fac45ca993559576115e82315291f1e4c932cb362bd3c5d8e0dc07e045"}

{"id": "p_c6c59e4d7a7385fa", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 92, "text": "若刺客伏起，一人之敵耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "eec6ecbc0bc010a56ddcf61693d1037d0befa6512759ea6e6a60aaf307b575aa"}

{"id": "p_74e23ad3a997e566", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 93, "text": "以吾觀之，必死於匹夫之手。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "cf12345d42e7a8eaee08605fbfc0b4926558ffe02aee8a3a6cd0173e73de67f4"}

{"id": "p_fc696a51215b5267", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」策臨江未濟，果為許貢客所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "852ada845c22290702a8d7795cb1469252dd922856a355bbb8a2cf59e90305a9"}

{"id": "p_1f256e472130ece3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 95, "text": "從破袁紹，紹死，又從討譚、尚於黎陽，連戰數克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "d210f0b842a6c72a0597eddf0cf50bd1189a6117fcf0a5564ae59da27f74fa9d"}

{"id": "p_22a99bcec0305ba7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 96, "text": "諸將欲乘勝遂攻之，嘉曰：「袁紹愛此二子，莫適立也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "ed5d73c7cfbb46df9990cc05b0cab304f289ecbaa96c5afcd2646016279e07d4"}

{"id": "p_35ca831e90a584bd", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 97, "text": "有郭圖、逢紀為之謀臣，必交鬥其間，還相離也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "1ddc5ffe2504371a84508f216ff81a67ea4548ecc3974246424a7230b44cd265"}

{"id": "p_6c38ccd287071b78", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 98, "text": "急之則相持，緩之而後爭心生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "8b23ce2915869b6c4124011575a2af84c6cd2647716c34b16f7ad395e91a7cfd"}

{"id": "p_5a503c1ad31eb82c", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 99, "text": "不如南向荊州若征劉表者，以待其變；變成而後擊之，可一舉定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "025c7adb81f12830c258fa24cb0783247e239d7431623c95fff96d2cb8703304"}

{"id": "p_b48742d0a860476b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 100, "text": "軍至西平，譚、尚果爭冀州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "c139d03d6acda90d422e7f0d5be7d9ed678ba43c9f7d1f84fe0ba2b9a2ff81d9"}

{"id": "p_14d5ca7041c96e2e", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 101, "text": "譚為尚軍所敗，走保平原，遣辛毗乞降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "d2025f26bedbd73b86c83ae4530fbceb9f1cf5af1b828639e4add61ca60388fa"}

{"id": "p_4786a421c0d876f1", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 102, "text": "又從攻譚於南皮，冀州平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "ad6d4a29a7d3e35c15c9bbf30018cc9eab8a4157de8893a7005d7bf434378d45"}

{"id": "p_de3afc7e978abdf8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 103, "text": "太祖將征袁尚及三郡烏丸，諸下多懼劉表使劉備襲許以討太祖，嘉曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "ad4cf4f72e5e7e8aa59d7da30ecd8364e1662f7e3ae506edda239311bb277c2e"}

{"id": "p_af5c140857136d25", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 104, "text": "至易，嘉言曰：「兵貴神速。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "0b64fd0226a76f089f01f0d43c201fe376d976fc5b59e927c8b67e930df65fb1"}

{"id": "p_b676ca2a4b50e166", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 105, "text": "今千里襲人，輜重多，難以趣利，且彼聞之，必為備；不如留輜重，輕兵兼道以出，掩其不意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "4db5156e3c02398ed4acae4efa046df162bc6c40c11b43abb51aec71a6713fab"}

{"id": "p_a1345675891fdf19", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」太祖乃密出盧龍塞，直指單于庭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "44b359e5dca6fa5e753aa8346497a4a66a1fd4215739b7765213866d6d3db107"}

{"id": "p_4a3de6da984cbf0e", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 107, "text": "虜卒聞太祖至，惶怖合戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "02d9e08f9ce9dd3bcd27d6cb169a3a47fcb1befc590e2d4850bc9f43f1864048"}

{"id": "p_207c5f5050e2b97f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 108, "text": "大破之，斬蹋頓及名王已下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "ce28bfdcf81d072d9e10a1adf74a71657be9d6443e7913a7527184e4e01287ba"}

{"id": "p_74568be7d5159593", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 109, "text": "嘉深通有算略，達於事情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "5fc036b95a87e0004dad2c5b6990f381ad84aa2ad15c47218a952264c384dc72"}

{"id": "p_bfd55f9f1b340553", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 110, "text": "太祖曰：「唯奉孝為能知孤意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "6c5a19c484243ec5b796b9842278e72d4de8d84d2855d15a17fe2e706786e5f8"}

{"id": "p_cecd0b84d5a18d04", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 111, "text": "」年三十八，自柳城還，疾篤，太祖問疾者交錯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "ec648076fc754744664a4a77c353a34975db76c9b46d68f4b8fd0fedc3525387"}

{"id": "p_8ff98b691ec0ef8a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 112, "text": "及薨，臨其喪，哀甚，謂荀攸等曰：「諸君年皆孤輩也，唯奉孝最少。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "56ea742cf7fa20b523eb2ae91f20acafc91dda08d8227e241d2648347a5eea43"}

{"id": "p_7f4c07375ac461ff", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 113, "text": "天下事竟，欲以後事屬之，而中年夭折，命也夫！", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "8f13b657cc91bf8a7ee4925a6da8cf8dbcc7982331fb690ff9a3c4d405381a8a"}

{"id": "p_0da9aac292b382a7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 114, "text": "」乃表曰：「軍祭酒郭嘉，自從征伐，十有一年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "22cea7cd537e8257c5150dfe7d807361b8b3c9945f9494373551eb1a4921030d"}

{"id": "p_ca0b78136bac6024", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 115, "text": "可增邑八百戶，並前千戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "ed87d9bf122c2d4a4ce698c487b93dd054a3c2a1b4fcc582d5f99ea08f6f74c3"}

{"id": "p_b44f315cc6042d0e", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 116, "text": "後太祖征荊州還，於巴丘遇疾疫，燒船，歎曰：「郭奉孝在，不使孤至此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "aceb37bb3b68b072a2edc71f7ea0be4fa9373d91beeabd6dec247a18835e436f"}

{"id": "p_b42a945508302c05", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 117, "text": "」初，陳群非嘉不治行檢，數廷訴嘉，嘉意自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "2d06975ec689f1ca41b92370c4c242dc5ee148f924b389827a960f413471435e"}

{"id": "p_56af6267a518f64a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 118, "text": "太祖愈益重之，然以群能持正，亦悅焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "40d0be8015a9cf1500e7a60861c2cdbc1e30537edf4c36489791e84961fd3e59"}

{"id": "p_a37e56cae6fd8854", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 119, "text": "董昭字公仁，濟陰定陶人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "d0faf32f548da834048df41be3d639eb5cd47d4e2e33e8955cfe6bbe67baee0b"}

{"id": "p_ff48d6f1c4d69020", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 120, "text": "舉孝廉，除癭陶長、柏人令，袁紹以為參軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "247174060fbb20cfc5d197bd22757d4e4247881b9f26c2af22a7840d047d9427"}

{"id": "p_f04d5f0b42d1df36", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 121, "text": "紹逆公孫瓚於界橋，鉅鹿太守李邵及郡冠蓋，以瓚兵強，皆欲屬瓚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "405d74ad7f448c2c3dc2618843a85e50a3086b40bdf8fb9d8def943ebf40cb0f"}

{"id": "p_891e36085eb9881a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 122, "text": "」對曰：「一人之微，不能消眾謀，欲誘致其心，唱與同議，及得其情，乃當權以制之耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "8a7b283d92694bc60616315939529ecf65c0e0bccf2b72ab35274ad2b8436003"}

{"id": "p_6d915c3455a856ff", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」時郡右姓孫伉等數十人專為謀主，驚動吏民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "a183f30a2c1d20abf200a4da6a30843f3e4414eae98e082ad613a639ebcf4fdc"}

{"id": "p_220971f35e37c35a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 124, "text": "昭至郡，偽作紹檄告郡云：「得賊羅候安平張吉辭，當攻鉅鹿，賊故孝廉孫伉等為應，檄到收行軍法，惡止其身，妻子勿坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "29468d6ae0da80f100204ae0cb7ed01b42ff71f6dfe4a14e6b9cdbf4ed2f609c"}

{"id": "p_2df2c315853322c5", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 125, "text": "」昭案檄告令，皆即斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "6461016bee40aa75d440cbb6b5e0b5600cf3ec906b8bfc0f4cf1b2161271faae"}

{"id": "p_9b54dcdf68dff272", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 126, "text": "一郡惶恐，乃以次安慰，遂皆平集。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "4a60b5de86e29c731ac08cae130b2ab8d04b7616fc1bdbad19fe804008b1bf4a"}

{"id": "p_f59be4b6cc27cf72", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 127, "text": "會魏郡太守栗攀為兵所害，紹以昭領魏郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "9d1722f94f5378eef3e8a1b586dd813b57b8123f7668959f6caac76164c34a04"}

{"id": "p_96a4a772ebf11c7c", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 128, "text": "時郡界大亂，賊以萬數，遣使往來，交易市買。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "19f68061e5c12cce0f5fca5ff9a264c388173dbe56c89e41c3111150bffcf27a"}

{"id": "p_6bc82baeace1ce23", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 129, "text": "昭厚待之，因用為間，乘虛掩討，輒大克破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "d29d8ad455389393df0d4732c3174ced65c205927fe6bd9f8702e8d4502462ed"}

{"id": "p_2c85618f158c0d3d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 130, "text": "邈與紹有隙，紹受讒將致罪於昭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "b72313e14d7a133b9095fc6ae5992d6087b73377bfc2a1c59dab55845d31a455"}

{"id": "p_6f93913c7d7ebc32", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 131, "text": "昭欲詣漢獻帝，至河內，為張楊所留。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "36c770b416b36843224b375a87ee7e216f1bb4f0c94e242d0e0a15344df4540e"}

{"id": "p_b70a9e9fe918facc", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 132, "text": "因楊上還印綬，拜騎都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "53088e0381fc4fddcbf955e5cbff4d5ec4acf3b35803bf169b2f25cc081caae6"}

{"id": "p_8f3fcdf8aec41da2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 133, "text": "時太祖領兗州，遣使詣楊，欲令假塗西至長安，楊不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "86e2573e94ecabb798f2223d3f224ad4e6db7b311e4ae67d28e9a311615146a9"}

{"id": "p_bdf67c2eae2c4e55", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 134, "text": "昭說楊曰：「袁、曹雖為一家，勢不久羣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "9e3b9632ad6ad08237be3fd509d187187f4b9da40d5f476be3220a13bc90ab08"}

{"id": "p_b8734e327c5f844b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 135, "text": "曹今雖弱，然實天下之英雄也，當故結之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "5b7f50c51b0597a708a12cb102999e00450ffb46b56c8f08034ac3111c42a4be"}

{"id": "p_514b5397490d79ec", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 136, "text": "況今有緣，宜通其上事，並表薦之；若事有成，永為深分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "77aceba37eceda43a335eabb1dc13df1b1be85075c4805b9ba63879be7bc7acc"}

{"id": "p_119e9c1291dffa94", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 137, "text": "」楊於是通太祖上事，表薦太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "4953001fe9078e47d617022977f11c08c5bf867703e6821bcdca22c1a7cdbf28"}

{"id": "p_d70fe1a24d7fbf0e", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 138, "text": "昭為太祖作書與長安諸將李傕、郭汜等，各隨輕重致殷勤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "7bc41bde5c00702f2970666b2208f9516a23eaa26923302b7b5b51723fd3b0d3"}

{"id": "p_5d879a91648389f3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 139, "text": "太祖遺楊犬馬金帛，遂與西方往來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "c0f4d2808e2dad85afd9802490d959665ad692db1b84de8b7366052da8af4d42"}

{"id": "p_ee739a363e4be54d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 140, "text": "天子在安邑，昭從河內往，詔拜議郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "88195556f3e67c7e8557588d6ae55d42ef1dffbf1b056272e6887a5fc43ac1ed"}

{"id": "p_a0144752c31d0ea7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 141, "text": "，太祖定黃巾於許，遣使詣河東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "9777592ab4b9890eb9ec7f8c25f3ff19708bda38af973191b86ea3418480e86a"}

{"id": "p_96269c9d21447b83", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 142, "text": "會天子還洛陽，韓暹、楊奉、董承及楊各違戾不和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "000388c9509c26c6841d92ab0b94c325311905a4e6632957b93c47a3ebda699d"}

{"id": "p_adb41b861118ece6", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 143, "text": "昭以奉兵馬最強而少黨援，作太祖書與奉曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "6fb67a9b664c75716692de5bc28480536fdf03fac0abcd0453ef9b00bb78d1e5"}

{"id": "p_ef026a1846e39273", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 144, "text": "奉得書喜悅，語諸將軍曰：「兗州諸軍近在許耳，有兵有糧，國家所當依仰也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "d2fb70a9c6b7c51df027e3beac5875b512812511dc60a70d2789c82c333dbb7f"}

{"id": "p_8a8e189339e473d8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 145, "text": "」遂共表太祖為鎮東將軍，襲父爵費亭侯；昭遷符節令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "37e52d15fb14c59ec56d8f0a9f9442eee41ca4ab626958fff512440cc3c11d57"}

{"id": "p_96bda5029a46fb9f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 146, "text": "太祖朝天子於洛陽，引昭並坐，問曰：「今孤來此，當施何計？", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "fa59e24fe7cc39e1e3f6bcfdf90be307c65049d81cb54159bb2707436a57e737"}

{"id": "p_aed0487d7d559813", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」昭曰：「將軍興義兵以誅暴亂，入朝天子，輔翼王室，此五伯之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "8f635a2915ecfefff7bcba2315e6f39b90eb22c215863da635dac6b0474606ed"}

{"id": "p_c0a2107ea1460f87", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 148, "text": "此下諸將，人殊意異，未必服從，今留匡弼，事勢不便，惟有移駕幸許耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "380aafe67e524ea9d9b78ec410aec6ae700fc04cda40d1c31a5fadab37fce0e8"}

{"id": "p_19f3079a64b13315", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 149, "text": "然朝廷播越，新還舊京，遠近跂望，冀一朝獲安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "f713a04b764e257560010fef21bae0e11b47fe976abf2dd60a1b7b17e10eea0e"}

{"id": "p_0efa844d7fd138e4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 150, "text": "夫行非常之事，乃有非常之功，原將軍算其多者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "af3cc304083b7caebedb265e90640a8999f9f7749432fe7b34f05285556c1e55"}

{"id": "p_06e95eb736c1c898", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」太祖曰：「此孤本志也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "a39cdc49fec2260d2b88aa166ce05c9107dd5cdd475260b483a552b83c404db1"}

{"id": "p_cf3af7c211c0caab", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 152, "text": "楊奉近在梁耳，聞其兵精，得無為孤累乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "0cac984ba58ccfb92a522bdccc00ec35bd0e609fe1a4cb12177bf6cbd0536adf"}

{"id": "p_1632a7e7d239a348", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 153, "text": "」昭曰：「奉少黨援，將獨委質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "e46fa8edb3da6f26140ecf9170e2dc5f932443b125d7e3fe1bb27c7b41f8a35a"}

{"id": "p_8c368781ea9e155f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 154, "text": "鎮東、費亭之事，皆奉所定，又聞書命申束，足以見信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "8cd45d172799e7b820a6e40d97b118b5a5c1fcb2b7a82e31785aa30bf2aab185"}

{"id": "p_0c44a52f7e09feec", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 155, "text": "宜時遣使厚遺答謝，以安其意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "23f5a0881507c4eb4ead3d2e03a308d260ef67e698941666be127910457a406f"}

{"id": "p_f8cf6f565a0b3aa1", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 156, "text": "說『京都無糧，欲車駕暫幸魯陽，魯陽近許，轉運稍易，可無縣乏之憂』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "4fad3af1249581a3e47a82699c6c8626ade6691dee09ee90da9fa3edb8b81550"}

{"id": "p_5142607db084d9f4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 157, "text": "奉為人勇而寡慮，必不見疑，比使往來，足以定計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "372b14a37cd0744f23ec3f41e89c9d2eff854e32ecaa739550f2ef965b8d45ef"}

{"id": "p_4ec36699293ce1f6", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 158, "text": "奉由是失望，與韓暹等到定陵鈔暴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "7d2fa1e8a7d90c6feaa67283fdb09388b82b8fc5e27564b723b1eec9572abda1"}

{"id": "p_efec8fd9dfee82b8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 159, "text": "太祖不應，密往攻其梁營，降誅即定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "c103073c07ca344daa0c20e7a2fa8d49b38d2aafb5ed6bcd38c710da74ddef77"}

{"id": "p_9427104df8bad909", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 160, "text": "時張楊為其將楊醜所殺，楊長史薛洪、河內太守繆尚城守待紹救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "a44a6cf08652070cb6fec61756658576733d075ddc314db5a172c7b82c50ad9b"}

{"id": "p_141da0d80a49b04d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 161, "text": "太祖令昭單身入城，告喻洪、尚等，即日舉眾降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "11d59d3a5d45229cdb8e54b1763359ea3bf9c3d96bc2a9f4e0b9e237f378efa9"}

{"id": "p_d23a7ffbeb8cb774", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 162, "text": "太祖令劉備拒袁術，昭曰：「備勇而志大，關羽、張飛為之羽翼，恐備之心未可得論也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "36e45a537ebe20579e1245c830d420612d8dff9a752ac62118e998ccc92d6a5b"}

{"id": "p_7ba3e4e76fb14cdd", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」太祖曰：「吾已許之矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "d949cce13498b2164c93372b5d94d8b6ee3e8a5c47b9b320ec67a9ff663e7b0b"}

{"id": "p_73d8e02597183fc2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 164, "text": "」備到下邳，殺徐州刺史車冑，反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "3d2a8a7e45216d4523a0d629bad8ef130d9926912df87d6a2386d9a3c8c88224"}

{"id": "p_9405e241abf38506", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 165, "text": "太祖自征備，徙昭為徐州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "128b626eed324e73cf10740b3c15e4da09a06b4cd57bef5b386f123cd754fdf6"}

{"id": "p_f577422550f89c8d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 166, "text": "袁紹遣將顏良攻東郡，又徙昭為魏郡太守，從討良。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "494cf99d4bc7d6b343d0f4f21b9da8c7428a30118f07bfb45194410147e2958b"}

{"id": "p_871ecb12ca6062aa", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 167, "text": "袁紹同族春卿為魏郡太守，在城中，其父元長在揚州，太祖遣人迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "e0bc5da4d74978bc8a4cbca1231b80a9e92db5772d977ba66d1ed025a457a507"}

{"id": "p_7c6d1aad6263c34b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 168, "text": "鄴既定，以昭為諫議大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "5ac6d78a0681c28e940b5337dcbd68d70e864bbb3345cc61b63e132b5178f3ea"}

{"id": "p_1727a96d7f4bfbf0", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 169, "text": "後袁尚依烏丸蹋頓，太祖將征之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "f332acf178cef5d58ddc5a2d536a6abd86f1d9bd8e7c630da485dbce12a83a8c"}

{"id": "p_c50ad7b485055034", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 170, "text": "患軍糧難致，鑿平虜、泉州二渠入海通運，昭所建也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "0de957a6741d7e17666de4d4bfdcf75e34348160e1d30a0991100de770811286"}

{"id": "p_d731a8a8bff2d9e5", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 171, "text": "太祖表封千秋亭侯，轉拜司空軍祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "c7e70da806c2ac4dcee8c7659ea65347d91d1b388376b5746881efb7c5145e80"}

{"id": "p_08846dd6cbcac6c1", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 172, "text": "後昭建議：「宜脩古建封五等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "978a479a8251f91c54753ef186e72454e6203c0b43cbbeb451ccf9db3a4909f6"}

{"id": "p_f26f77c0d6e27cd4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 173, "text": "」太祖曰：「建設五等者，聖人也，又非人臣所製，吾何以堪之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "54cc9cb760d9b17aea4638cadabccf57b6d53d02750a6cac3cb70a8b5962c413"}

{"id": "p_b3f873ffc838d393", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 174, "text": "後太祖遂受魏公、魏王之號，皆昭所創。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "c8359e2bc093a21415a956da9622a52de0914a04486ca29ed466d4bb57a78139"}

{"id": "p_f538b6d49cf7f76d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 175, "text": "及關羽圍曹仁於樊，孫權遣使辭以「遣兵西上，欲掩取羽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "6e1575b36c86c9e3ce261a89919fbdcad029749d3e6011350b3b3b54ac9a49c3"}

{"id": "p_b6cd663259b794ae", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 176, "text": "江陵、公安累重，羽失二城，必自奔走，樊軍之圍，不救自解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "80da6c263d2f60fe4b48f6a4199ca18ce243e08cd900f107f51fa21d4416cfb9"}

{"id": "p_5c6c896bbca0836f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 177, "text": "」太祖詰羣臣，羣臣咸言宜當密之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "ba66edb645e91638c74f4eddaa2674c1d400e34f9bfff154225be5ad1ba931be"}

{"id": "p_e328732e5871a36d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 178, "text": "昭曰：「軍事尚權，期於合宜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "7841c158679eb9aabc1a8fca220a44755d10248438285416f1a83793c9d3b99b"}

{"id": "p_cc09675ce3e374b3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 179, "text": "羽聞權上，若還自護，圍則速解，便獲其利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "926e89f9b5115fb1a175af2535ce7fe27ee5b7a26ac92f5733982d57bc13c636"}

{"id": "p_81b69fb5171d492b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 180, "text": "可使兩賊相對銜持，坐待其弊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "d2b9845da48cc94e630b10748186590cbf9efb2c671dbf6d67ee80da27dd72ec"}

{"id": "p_7e58b4e34c546309", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 181, "text": "秘而不露，使權得志，非計之上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "860bbb652189aa7305353c6064ecfce3c88d2fef90116870531be425e04045fe"}

{"id": "p_ae4f0bb8cc73ad1b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 182, "text": "又，圍中將吏不知有救，計糧怖懼，儻有他意，為難不小。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "e07668834c1eec8df08a78837566c7268d7b1a78d1c6b4878a6bd695113f9109"}

{"id": "p_9301702d19edaf90", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 183, "text": "且羽為人強梁，自恃二城守固，必不速退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "04e1072f5d683933cf035b530b6cc0fcbd615f02e2bd0fcdd849a25f81cab915"}

{"id": "p_16279a0a78ddcfd8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 184, "text": "」即敕救將徐晃以權書射著圍裡及羽屯中，圍裡聞之，志氣百倍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "51a8c0c984225875f7a22976013f0d3a1f1b0a4cbf7b7fe59158e7f2fc3902ad"}

{"id": "p_e1a6d66820cd4dfa", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 185, "text": "權軍至，得其二城，羽乃破敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "a4bd8c3724e1b0bae887f6cc3c741057a8a52341124e1147c502e54b0ee46053"}

{"id": "p_27e22b4946a972aa", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 186, "text": "文帝即王位，拜昭將作大匠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "b47e35c6b146b185c4c8e52083076c47cf2795426a10c14a977c988addf8f0a6"}

{"id": "p_a30720906b86bfeb", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 187, "text": "及踐阼，遷大鴻臚，進封右鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "71044333c635170581cad41e9ae14e6d3fc183e0b5ea534269702e060bb9c46e"}

{"id": "p_8fa14e9c3799b834", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 188, "text": "二年，分邑百戶，賜昭弟訪爵關內侯，徙昭為侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "f747f5f604a93c3bfde827aed614d45f42b80477689e8bdb701a6413e23b6452"}

{"id": "p_afd8fc09cefd7039", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 189, "text": "三年，征東大將軍曹休臨江在洞浦口，自表：「原將銳卒虎步江南，因敵取資，事必克捷；若其無臣，不須為念。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "ace613097dcaf39deadc98f00198731032786a6873d2466b6b99d9789c153b0e"}

{"id": "p_712552bcd06a5478", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 190, "text": "」帝恐休便渡江，驛馬詔止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "02d66c0c434e52f3cd9831f5b8944c247ffa083657225a1d9f474d87f267ba57"}

{"id": "p_935b8c02d2e2fe51", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 191, "text": "時昭侍側，因曰：「竊見陛下有憂色，獨以休濟江故乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "3c031fa5002dc0ccf2fb9695410f84421aa2411e146a1c5c8ed6a2b39ebcc22d"}

{"id": "p_ecb1eebc651ace0c", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 192, "text": "今者渡江，人情所難，就休有此志，勢不獨行，當須諸將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "ab76b365ce93ce1e55a92793e0de614ef351c2a2a5de7242a21927cf97ddfb75"}

{"id": "p_66d336ac8e20ea1f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 193, "text": "臧霸等既富且貴，無復他望，但欲終其天年，保守祿祚而已，何肯乘危自投死地，以求徼倖？", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "0181c29172e136f9f569692e856319a52cfd0d6079f441319aeca729400d1ef9"}

{"id": "p_93eca145c86fc555", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 194, "text": "臣恐陛下雖有敕渡之詔，猶必沉吟，未便從命也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "1d14300812572015c9e84a9977363032fb3904aa812d8ce0d2d3e4454be613f3"}

{"id": "p_446b890d1174974d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 195, "text": "」是後無幾，暴風吹賊船，悉詣休等營下，斬首獲生，賊遂迸散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "4ce654ec7ff1a01129f37400f462a0123e74e3c3c24c165553afde72b3e819a1"}

{"id": "p_add358ec46f4154e", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 196, "text": "大駕幸宛，征南大將軍夏侯尚等攻江陵，未拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "ec2a18981245141aca3b4dfc7f823073bc83ae27fb6630b9d6d02137b7511a66"}

{"id": "p_3f84140b573b2714", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 197, "text": "時江水淺狹，尚欲乘船將步騎入渚中安屯，作浮橋，南北往來，議者多以為城必可拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "f3e945c63da2199fe15ff4a8339344eaccbe1a2d6c3b303e124ed918aa044a9b"}

{"id": "p_b4077e25c9456760", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 198, "text": "帝悟昭言，即詔尚等促出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "4563158d9f36940db314644fb7a808d99c1f930f8bb5e3c1e1ddc246e55ea58f"}

{"id": "p_f059a4291eb59555", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 199, "text": "賊兩頭並前，官兵一道引去，不時得洩，將軍石建、高遷僅得自免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "ee70f9752497ddd6975c78526d941530098cde6d0fabfba3e59e5c106e53a951"}

{"id": "p_9e99c621e70ee4cf", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 200, "text": "帝曰：「君論此事，何其審也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "8ba42ca8c85a0379294cf5d421a0ac0cc1a0b9b6239cac49e6aea5419798f32d"}

{"id": "p_31ff3f2dc642ecbb", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 201, "text": "正使張、陳當之，何以復加。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "78bb197b8328ae8fdbc69f1c5d62c61c2fced90e652aa8492cf4ce2abb57a6fd"}

{"id": "p_6ec4540604f76539", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 202, "text": "」五年，徙封成都鄉侯，拜太常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "6af7ecb73a30010f0e5a264e39e23ebcd94c69f797632e43436b7181ff49e71a"}

{"id": "p_f0ee93fffe36f436", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 203, "text": "其年，徙光祿大夫、給事中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "c7f2b4ec384d528fcc6b6d199787df7fb6b960fe5b862e0f39ac2f074e5c50c2"}

{"id": "p_504bc1745afec618", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 204, "text": "從大駕東征，七年還，拜太僕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "ee55fec649b8d465d537f8f280a13f235b626ce3cb8f4cbdf7450eca9d794691"}

{"id": "p_afe12e6e7a2aeeef", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 205, "text": "明帝即位，進爵樂平侯，邑千戶，轉衛尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "0a2b4d8efbe696cf43e11adc915e27b7f5c47d9379a81a32239f1764f4b8b0db"}

{"id": "p_2fc48a48a8ca5087", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 206, "text": "分邑百戶，賜一子爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "6e31713d631e1530cfc1ecb37d25069fd1b3c5178da4f9769527ec8e464b9947"}

{"id": "p_8d9b3656331d3c48", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 207, "text": "，行司徒事，六年，拜真。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "e849bccb73a9b27f6ee713b685bfe877495d250bb854d6b1df1d66dfaff49cc0"}

{"id": "p_88dc8b437df649b2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 208, "text": "帝於是發切詔，斥免諸葛誕、鄧颺等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "ede77e3507fb4a0a61b2d3321843f24e7c91325c80e6dcdde04aeb8a525da02d"}

{"id": "p_46341e6c79e7d7eb", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 209, "text": "昭年八十一薨，諡曰定侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "6cb8e60d2ff97410f4b2d5e136847d0b38a635d71c5254988260c3ffaddc6eb0"}

{"id": "p_c943c23782211f43", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 210, "text": "劉曄字子揚，淮南成-{悳}-人，漢光武子阜陵王延後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "f85f5dc0363c9a1ff9b8e6faf333125fc2c8f7597e96b945e246202a4483516c"}

{"id": "p_c8de48285592d56f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 211, "text": "渙九歲，曄七歲，而母病困。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "94f28a81b9f1a6dadbb0219574ce468296b4173971e1f61106df515d9f0e0e61"}

{"id": "p_953705b10b5ddd1e", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 212, "text": "臨終，戒渙、曄以「普之侍人，有諂害之性。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "052cc387b6ac89d8d93a8c5e380c2714bf336eb14c6037982cac92bb910e0a4b"}

{"id": "p_fcf61d8e313856f4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 213, "text": "汝長大能除之，則吾無恨矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "18e3ea86f577a3697a5c797c192d1c038a14d2f0adbaddca7840a6700023573a"}

{"id": "p_d53480be619b2447", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 214, "text": "」曄年十三，謂兄渙曰：「亡母之言，可以行矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "ac2ec87b8e34c7f21fef811e0ed65525a2f3a5e66af6d20fb950fd71e479d473"}

{"id": "p_5f38a27e76e9a1b8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 215, "text": "」曄即入室殺侍者，徑出拜墓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "d2fb035bb17ce9212959502dcd7eae5d70638981d1b8a1e09f8af1485e183537"}

{"id": "p_08962370bfcf97a2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 216, "text": "曄還拜謝曰：「亡母顧命之言，敢受不請擅行之罰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "a471d4195f57df970377debe9359c019a84594e8ca6117ea1f07e2dfcf30262b"}

{"id": "p_6609fed4b9b1a5ab", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 217, "text": "汝南許劭名知人，避地揚州，稱曄有佐世之才。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "a12017f96131451bca012de788708cb7f1c40d9c408b9b6bae7c5f985973f1e9"}

{"id": "p_37ca536b993917f8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 218, "text": "揚士多輕俠狡桀，有鄭寶、張多、許乾之屬，各擁部曲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "b5d677f3f6c6a6a9a45bcb9f8f0cffe4b18321b40bd6deb4d76cf8968693e1c8"}

{"id": "p_c8680d1e61b558f5", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 219, "text": "寶最驍果，才力過人，一方所憚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "083374b6c4bfa8e4cc2e06e9d678cb95b34c32740cedbfacb442a7a9659c1201"}

{"id": "p_877235205d9799c4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 220, "text": "欲驅略百姓越赴江表，以曄高族名人，欲強逼曄使唱導此謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "74cd6c20565eb5b5da7cdffff59d0d1a7547b8ed9ba61264d26178331dc8eb26"}

{"id": "p_b47fb38c69b0dacc", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 221, "text": "曄時年二十餘，心內憂之，而未有緣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "a2abe3e0b0c0bce06e2139c6bbf28ce2f2d550049e44f8c9c74d292611c1f4a7"}

{"id": "p_40841a32ae4f6ecc", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 222, "text": "會太祖遣使詣州，有所案問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "ca1112de9c1a0ab7176f9f5a5ed4506e78fbef32904718e8c1068e2018c18874"}

{"id": "p_94f4dd0c3f641683", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 223, "text": "曄往見，為論事勢，要將與歸，駐止數日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "fdf58a35a96989e1c4bf289fd45e3cee6a68382204da568f957299729b9b5e6d"}

{"id": "p_08b6168f35fef374", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 224, "text": "寶果從數百人齎牛酒來候使，曄令家僮將其眾坐中門外，為設酒飯；與寶於內宴飲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "8e3636da544e25180ade7227bb6ea5831f77e55d6d1f3da000d8fba5000ef69d"}

{"id": "p_127927c497068ba3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 225, "text": "密勒健兒，令因行觴而斫寶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "d82ff7e7375f75b3ccd3a6c38ab763902f5292845d3a77f7f24537d707949b2f"}

{"id": "p_c7283a57eb718b34", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 226, "text": "寶性不甘酒，視候甚明，觴者不敢發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "2eff1060f016184b7aa78fda561784ed88e280e8d18b44f6d0cabfc8ac76e963"}

{"id": "p_b25fdd0f2a376751", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 227, "text": "曄因自引取佩刀斫殺寶，斬其首以令其軍，云：「曹公有令，敢有動者，與寶同罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "8dad92dac8cf343a37e0df7036559b37fcb16903f23050a2e14a52c453f2bd2a"}

{"id": "p_20bdfd5bf520afd1", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 228, "text": "營有督將精兵數千，懼其為亂，曄即乘寶馬，將家僮數人，詣寶營門，呼其渠帥，喻以禍福，皆叩頭開門內曄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "05865fd26061686581c9a3d5fdc9917483b7851b49f9211f141670b3d3ce4d86"}

{"id": "p_d0633665b2a92fb3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 229, "text": "曄撫慰安懷，咸悉悅服，推曄為主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "3d010351e493ef749c023ffac57767c7477d7a49d1a8c51befd056945b4b5729"}

{"id": "p_b32f52223602fb39", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 230, "text": "曄睹漢室漸微，己為支屬，不欲擁兵，遂委其部曲與廬江太守劉勛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "c18155854dc4eefa82d08cd8fb07915748e3ed28aaf4ccbb980cc5d273fc6f87"}

{"id": "p_cf2f6551a0d2b891", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 231, "text": "勳怪其故，曄曰：「寶無法制，其眾素以鈔略為利，僕宿無資，而整齊之，必懷怨難久，故相與耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "9875cc2322b35a1b9240e7117e34950fc355d231fb0b856f133fdd6c6ad37cab"}

{"id": "p_89eb7ffee5c8e9f3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 233, "text": "孫策惡之，遣使卑辭厚幣，以書說勳曰：「上繚宗民，數欺下國，忿之有年矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "2c3acb4135e31b541f45f3a09f7abcd9a44be247f6aedcf87326c06fb76568e4"}

{"id": "p_5344653bcf39d49d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 234, "text": "擊之，路不便，原因大國伐之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "a9b731d3c4f27ceb185beef3299906d9726f23237db7283398be607aa2e97784"}

{"id": "p_01303e84a9e4b9f9", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 235, "text": "上繚甚實，得之可以富國，請出兵為外援。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "c6d5c90e823c618e23943693e186640214240b3cbd9f7ced928964220f55af65"}

{"id": "p_946220daa581ffb7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 236, "text": "」勳信之，又得策珠寶、葛越，喜悅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "7d9298e5c31687d51b0fd921f410e7d7520593eb1b251e4861b0185e6850f4c9"}

{"id": "p_37efca57f7986454", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 237, "text": "勳問其故，對曰：「上繚雖小，城堅池深，攻難守易，不可旬日而舉，則兵疲於外，而國內虛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "c59cc9017f2a2ce3e8488be505022ee30617baa0dda84027eb6c309d32e6b6fe"}

{"id": "p_bea37fa6b93f36f4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 238, "text": "策乘虛而襲我，則後不能獨守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "217621893b11d21fa754e01bc07c8d0bafd5558f5c6e72ae8780a3e8cbff24d3"}

{"id": "p_1596a3734beb316b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 239, "text": "是將軍進屈於敵，退無所歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "cfdb5f61e6f5430ad947850a48411537c1741d6d0e41c10b979aa524b14b2540"}

{"id": "p_957aa9b892fe724b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 240, "text": "興兵伐上繚，策果襲其後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "fad95ee132c4fead33bb14c9b41fc67e7705fbe99d4479c6d2848d39a311285a"}

{"id": "p_4db161abdda6c6fa", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 241, "text": "太祖至壽春，時廬江界有山賊陳策，眾數萬人，臨險而守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "c1da9a4dcbcb849ad92c06cb00a692aef4d233bc9714259716272cddc8db81f8"}

{"id": "p_c61744ef28bac7b5", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 242, "text": "先時遣偏將致誅，莫能禽克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "75de7e472f530e5ca74d6edf0d6d9644b6c84f33e4b8832dbf8177473062b3e2"}

{"id": "p_71c5369880450d39", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 243, "text": "咸云：「山峻高而谿谷深隘，守易攻難；又無之不足為損，得之不足為益。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "2b52c608bfcd8cc778db557810ab037573553a780561d3f52e4e8ba2b91ccc4b"}

{"id": "p_ebeaed8005ad8298", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 244, "text": "」遂遣猛將在前，大軍在後，至則克策，如曄所度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "ee78ea83d22e4e5b9ee1087e78871462b4dd8321b22ec43e7d49e3177cbd0032"}

{"id": "p_f9b9e3becb53db64", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 245, "text": "太祖還，辟曄為司空倉曹掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "9c9a7c33b53b14dda4fc2ec30121e349427895a201777ee456fc3a4577f16f87"}

{"id": "p_b70c29c30d06251f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 246, "text": "太祖征張魯，轉曄為主簿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "e1867da0b6240b8a13266bfdfb4336bd06310a1a2181a5d85e1f301532170214"}

{"id": "p_f198e4cb281265a8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 247, "text": "既至漢中，山峻難登，軍食頗乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "b5e4fa56ac2e7e5deb12b4878d3580b21dfce1acea7383df349fc049b609f842"}

{"id": "p_3526ff509d074f48", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 248, "text": "太祖曰：「此妖妄之國耳，何能為有無？", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "9f33cb81639d4c21cd103e49fb577518e87d6ebd1d2c5d25ee98fe31f29a4b4b"}

{"id": "p_750db9319beb5a44", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 249, "text": "」便自引歸，令曄督後諸軍，使以次出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "fdab11be44cdd258d9f6cb3574a0a445a6d385baf1f9bf9880fa387335928936"}

{"id": "p_ee913b31406542c2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 250, "text": "曄策魯可克，加糧道不繼，雖出，軍猶不能皆全，馳白太祖：「不如致攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "3fb3cb7f1cb696353140fa76618c0f2538f5e0b8ca64937a35ca1c09eff446bb"}

{"id": "p_bc8821738d643589", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 251, "text": "」遂進兵，多出弩以射其營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "9b00ed1a2297250ae04bd4121c0e4804cbeb0e1938612a79588fbe1b685b5dba"}

{"id": "p_30e3017a10248661", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 252, "text": "曄自漢中還，為行軍長史，兼領軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "e7a2c12a760a525bd0f0ed4fd07c512cce88ee7336e3e3db4921f4055524b48d"}

{"id": "p_6a7ceac50e101fbd", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 253, "text": "延康元年，蜀將孟達率眾降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "275b78f97989087d8db6b954c15c5980766b82f1b405b3e8d57c6481e3dbdd74"}

{"id": "p_3e70b94eafec1976", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 254, "text": "達有容止才觀，文帝甚器愛之，使達為新城太守，加散騎常侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "1c7426677964b55e274e1918b18b2266af36b3539e898376fe507712e5088617"}

{"id": "p_38d070118021bafb", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 255, "text": "曄以為「達有苟得之心，而恃才好術，必不能感恩懷義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "25362a8d58eb0084706249c1a354ea7adc7e6de67a322d5ee2a226ce10011972"}
