{"id": "p_a0c0b3b00c8f3cba", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 256, "text": "新城與吳、蜀接連，若有變態，為國生患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "febda61291b93fa492e6e40f448fa4cc435b911cf87be8b16c72956eb8db263d"}

{"id": "p_8733a40c389fec71", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 257, "text": "」文帝竟不易，後達終於叛敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "4fc19063ba745eaf33368b9fa72761c25105f37787aecd81be600ecba3a274dd"}

{"id": "p_9e6e5527d7ffc4ca", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 258, "text": "，以曄為侍中，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "b9442878f7c3826b332dfb47a73caaafda1617ec9be08de9d800314971189440"}

{"id": "p_425f10f0ffeb7c69", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 259, "text": "詔問羣臣令料劉備當為關羽出報吳不。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "36dd7b17fe4f0ec525c1da944b42250881b51d636a4ad5737ba21b34112ac41d"}

{"id": "p_92cac47144d70a10", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 260, "text": "眾議咸云：「蜀，小國耳，名將唯羽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "ec4be67049d48bbf1347072a5a54088d7e65e71b23ca63d131012852c39c24fb"}

{"id": "p_9ddf358818d37c98", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 261, "text": "羽死軍破，國內憂懼，無緣復出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "927493c4cba38ca9e1c78fc4f1fbb0614d61a508b638a53ab78053962e82b704"}

{"id": "p_4be0fe81ee7abc41", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 262, "text": "」曄獨曰：「蜀雖狹弱，而備之謀欲以威武自強，勢必用眾以示其有餘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "addd3b9cb9a3d6042741a4ce30914e1cc321baaf5c0ee4e542378d7edbc48a39"}

{"id": "p_a3d164f66c9e3868", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 263, "text": "且關羽與備，義為君臣，恩猶父子；羽死不能為興軍報敵，於終始之分不足。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "9fecc978111f5311320c24f4976eef5a150e3899ecd7d838d0d3dce2ba623f43"}

{"id": "p_ce02f35586ce76b5", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 264, "text": "吳悉國應之，而遣使稱籓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "3d94bac17197bb7dc3f4337a652b6a558ab2db98fae0c7a9b2dc9c08230a5c79"}

{"id": "p_3db448fb7f99b8fe", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 265, "text": "朝臣皆賀，獨曄曰：「吳絕在江、漢之表，無內臣之心久矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "0527e0424dafea5f0e529c4abfa413b2125d3ee132c4a0f5659b7781dffb8009"}

{"id": "p_9f28d37207d78c92", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 266, "text": "陛下雖齊德有虞，然醜虜之性，未有所感。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "ac6be50ac0a6d8841445f189e3fc35e7ac281c69bc4f39f52428805c6422bef8"}

{"id": "p_e4777ab66b0f12a9", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 267, "text": "彼必外迫內困，然後發此使耳，可因其窮，襲而取之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "b5b69c2fd7e0bdc5a81caf388f871a14069a18444af8a17b761524f3dcdb842c"}

{"id": "p_b3f01938a0326b1b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 268, "text": "夫一日縱敵，數世之患，不可不察也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "05bd2960454bd197fc8b6d6c108d93c538f4980d1cfaed9dda30e3bc27605f58"}

{"id": "p_ebfe1d9c8ac8eb88", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 269, "text": "」備軍敗退，吳禮敬轉廢，帝欲興眾伐之，曄以為「彼新得志，上下齊心，而阻帶江湖，必難倉卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "6c13f3be66cbfdad1dbf3df415e038a6c2441d7706f1c67916c0268c8c60e525"}

{"id": "p_16c55fc26d3da3dd", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 270, "text": "五年，幸廣陵泗口，命荊、揚州諸軍並進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "bac293fe4fce83e07e8071f80b6d9b7daaf031fd8fa0e35e0dd521cf7ac12c87"}

{"id": "p_1eddf8feb65f32bf", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 271, "text": "會羣臣，問：「權當自來不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "07852e7c371e8966ae7aa758ae8d2d2bb62ada7e9cd719585735c34a98730f8d"}

{"id": "p_d0e6f09ae84f90af", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 272, "text": "」咸曰：「陛下親征，權恐怖，必舉國而應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "03c83b0aac5368771f6fdb6db1c736793b8b1b56b8f01808c002a72788584223"}

{"id": "p_580f0f0fa104a023", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 273, "text": "又不敢以大眾委之臣下，必自將而來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "dfd41ad5a157a2394ecf6274747d94b13d53ea2f6b94c578f74888ac6f7077ad"}

{"id": "p_2e31647b42f0a5fd", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 274, "text": "」曄曰：「彼謂陛下欲以萬乘之重牽己，而超越江湖者在於別將，必勒兵待事，未有進退也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "3c49d46004a7f175d7009c09ac0e5e41d011d8c28dda6f68400f84a9af0c35a2"}

{"id": "p_6e3f6d397ac9b31d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 275, "text": "」大駕停住積日，權果不至，帝乃旋師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "2b588fc1bae2b6716d791034f3f07df920e36abdd4c8fca6a19172498d70ca69"}

{"id": "p_020f347efc8bb12e", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 276, "text": "當念為吾滅二賊，不可但知其情而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "5430e4bb8a2b63bb6958cee70b45b349d9546487ad31b44fb1e07fc515048f91"}

{"id": "p_6567c33b21e5fbe3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 277, "text": "明帝即位，進爵東亭侯，邑三百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "cbce8a4defd51521bff106f2246880fe5389a3aec12085cbb76a852826371e33"}

{"id": "p_10b1a5ca538706e9", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 278, "text": "尚書衛臻與曄議同，事遂施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "e02ac018d63d21d515e4b56febc9f7d57320be44572042adcf7c4f0657f05fef"}

{"id": "p_e8686ea7aa3995ee", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 279, "text": "遼東太守公孫淵奪叔父位，擅自立，遣使表狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "56a401e316e298677a0d1ed1eecf620dcd14f61071664c4b57e0ef1fc717fac6"}

{"id": "p_adf214a0c5889d71", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 280, "text": "曄以為公孫氏漢時所用，遂世官相承，水則由海，陸則阻山，故胡夷絕遠難制，而世權日久。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "5589c43355e46be097e1b6e1bc5bc2fe14e0a4c47bda5864b5d33b0f1ba22927"}

{"id": "p_38af0db6e3ea0dc4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 281, "text": "若懷貳阻兵，然後致誅，於事為難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "1ab937146097e7459d6753af9a26e77537b9c6557c99d5cfc1ed9734e3418fb2"}

{"id": "p_c3d21fe07af4445c", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 282, "text": "不如因其新立，有黨有仇，先其不意，以兵臨之，開設賞募，可不勞師而定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "2eeaaa424edb3584da9a4b127c18bf6faec158fadd7e2706a1e3bd2e5e8e5811"}

{"id": "p_8edf8cbd581d0711", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 283, "text": "或問其故，曄答曰：「魏室即阼尚新，智者知命，俗或未咸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "c1850681a274bb3f3efeaf5d6efbb9f727792c60771eb75a5ecce50d38671b01"}

{"id": "p_081773e3109bc2c9", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 284, "text": "僕在漢為支葉，於魏備腹心，寡偶少徒，於宜未失也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "594e98536332c7896f00319a48e864679b85dbb309e3a38ec3003cf8ba21ab33"}

{"id": "p_4d1a42ecfe925624", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 285, "text": "有間，為大鴻臚，在位二年遜位，復為太中大夫，薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "850a1f20ab2e94862eb79315eb076ab1894d2e488acb1d1782ca7c0e244b02be"}

{"id": "p_6cc237169d44a8d0", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 286, "text": "少子陶，亦高才而薄行，官至平原太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "36b921e84188ae242c98b495db4852939cc0054a262a26180871eac8166f8c57"}

{"id": "p_db243e356c603dea", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 287, "text": "蔣濟字子通，楚國平阿人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "48e46a6bfc05cddf7e7f6622f5bff1890b37e350d799e0855f6b4d3780ce5823"}

{"id": "p_a60c703d3f48ede3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 288, "text": "時大軍征荊州，遇疾疫，唯遣將軍張喜單將千騎，過領汝南兵以解圍，頗复疾疫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "66cada0b0801f72c203fda802c7a122853dd75269ee02facff2816f9ba021685"}

{"id": "p_35aa4e1a11af0f32", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 289, "text": "濟乃密白刺史偽得喜書，雲步騎四萬已到雩婁，遣主簿迎喜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "d318854647035afbc6f8149e1bf456c9f282ae071a84933433169c5235bc391d"}

{"id": "p_28745123f11e1ce7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 290, "text": "三部使齎書語城中守將，一部得入城，二部為賊所得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "75d99e23db0304d3885092355e0aed18e2d56bb09a4aee70655915858c6ad9c3"}

{"id": "p_5c2f9281fca183b6", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 291, "text": "權信之，遽燒圍走，城用得全。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "48d2b0ca6f040eb0c8d5384ac204064596cd15f7eaec22056621a08020e12eee"}

{"id": "p_2e42ab1218f8c49a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 292, "text": "明年使於譙，太祖問濟曰：「昔孤與袁本初對官渡，徙燕、白馬民，民不得走，賊亦不敢鈔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "d5b055eb7f7bce6885f26e9c95ef7d7e32c7220919dda9e7186c2566cdbed632"}

{"id": "p_50ec6e75977952bb", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 293, "text": "」濟對曰：「是時兵弱賊強，不徙必失之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "0cd99ed221fd60766c9643831bce488f73296a6e616dea4f7850d1cb7a7ce4ac"}

{"id": "p_554074014325fcf7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 294, "text": "自破袁紹，北拔柳城，南向江、漢，荊州交臂，威震天下，民無他志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "0c1de165c4d318aaa858ff7834f481d6b6575a7969597cdc7f06da340aa0dade"}

{"id": "p_6a61e9b544f07ed4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 295, "text": "然百姓懷土，實不樂徙，懼必不安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "f369b2f193247a0e7e3acea252bf2e1afa92d82e243b6ff04053e6862fdf7982"}

{"id": "p_c9e9e4bb9e26f38f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 296, "text": "」太祖不從，而江、淮間十餘萬眾，皆驚走吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "3aa0716e1fc583d42baae13d0b6f994875413b436e9639130a532d798d558e88"}

{"id": "p_54d4b4781dc5949a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 297, "text": "後濟使詣鄴，太祖迎見大笑曰：「本但欲使避賊，乃更驅盡之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "e568f63138fcbf4d1b0daca9e5010fbad341532fd2b23dcd3ab1cc86f87e3c9a"}

{"id": "p_1e42cec857311c39", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 298, "text": "大軍南征還，以溫恢為揚州刺史，濟為別駕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "ca1450738a7cac7ecfeb264ba369f6e3f202f1baa1c056b23f18b01dc8e19254"}

{"id": "p_28ebf4ca18c4cdf0", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 299, "text": "令曰：「季子為臣，吳宜有君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "2be6bfac4e2252d85d7c15588db6bfddc710c6553d3bd244a6dd2ce6c183550e"}

{"id": "p_fb61c31ece29ebef", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 300, "text": "」民有誣告濟為謀叛主率者，太祖聞之，指前令與左將軍於禁、沛相封仁等曰：「蔣濟寧有此事！", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "78b848cb15c4b0b1a7a95a772edb66e83d3b48b312a652dda7c6dc2f88f65bf3"}

{"id": "p_1d241e0f358ec977", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 301, "text": "此必愚民樂亂，妄引之耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "4c01cf560e8e6f3578bc70e0c7d7c7a6350807d805fbee4af2b5576cf113d68e"}

{"id": "p_77ac7e8045bd0da4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 302, "text": "令曰：「舜舉皋陶，不仁者遠；臧否得中，望於賢屬矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "e442f48754755c2f7ee04343292cd91c47d423152c6a674ed5316c022a4a41a2"}

{"id": "p_591bd72b9a2298a7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 303, "text": "太祖以漢帝在許，近賊，欲徙都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 303}, "text_hash": "01eccc7ad4a00b340ba47ef7564c7e1be7f6e891c1ac2c42df48da3a8d133817"}

{"id": "p_430672ea31b221e7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 304, "text": "司馬宣王及濟說太祖曰：「於禁等為水所沒，非戰攻之失，於國家大計未足有損。", "locator": {"ordinal": 304}, "text_hash": "cbd43a64726d8c7cafc449835ac4a2c5cae1117ed90433a7569073f2d6198169"}

{"id": "p_f4b111a599f8266c", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 305, "text": "劉備、孫權，外親內疏，關羽得志，權必不原也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 305}, "text_hash": "cdd586898b0c6776129f8000e9630b708e96ef9d965a65afcdc963f567b1a87a"}

{"id": "p_8bda248da10cb89e", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 306, "text": "可遣人勸躡其後，許割江南以封權，則樊圍自解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 306}, "text_hash": "086a972104b8a24b592ee5d1d2b7304cbefe6054a8911d13dab69499c0c4497f"}

{"id": "p_9bbdd3a8c0f4690f", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 307, "text": "權聞之，即引兵西襲公安、江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 307}, "text_hash": "ae11302e6958d9a29a5c7f889559b4ca38bd2cdcea13be909669855770e40251"}

{"id": "p_7a1d455c6877a2cb", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 308, "text": "文帝即王位，轉為相國長史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 308}, "text_hash": "44fac34474e90cffc9ffd1f1b2368aa9f1086298fec1cd64bb05a135b050d857"}

{"id": "p_f75cb822b8d27213", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 309, "text": "濟請留，詔曰：「高祖歌曰『安得猛士守四方』！", "locator": {"ordinal": 309}, "text_hash": "e7988a84ca7a04ce1828cb8d7c534c87301540c2cc86e8c9de78ad45324f8215"}

{"id": "p_7fa1be56c62f2ff8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 310, "text": "天下未寧，要須良臣以鎮邊境。", "locator": {"ordinal": 310}, "text_hash": "2074047339b2332c7b961750241edff99c236f89b73eeecc44a613ac6521ba67"}

{"id": "p_4ebdd1740b2e4a7a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 311, "text": "如其無事，乃還鳴玉，未為後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 311}, "text_hash": "e8778eabbe2cc684c68ffee4d98366fb968d7fc18067fe209125a6cd3d5bf07d"}

{"id": "p_a0d2b9c8571acdcf", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 312, "text": "時有詔，詔征南將軍夏侯尚曰：「卿腹心重將，特當任使。", "locator": {"ordinal": 312}, "text_hash": "5679c8d78f6e04c74d1697ce7c6b93c1a1b0268d2e2462ac84fcc732ad20e761"}

{"id": "p_e4568cda18c9dfc4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 313, "text": "濟既至，帝問曰；「卿所聞見天下風教何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 313}, "text_hash": "95288834df5113e24d7dd9a044f1fd635af8ef1f9f6b9df3a4174d8faa6e1d8a"}

{"id": "p_c73f9df785c2b9dd", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 314, "text": "」濟對曰：「未有他善，但見亡國之語耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 314}, "text_hash": "73fc8585af4d1a69d013335a4efab54c91b5ee4bbfd94fd1ed243076a625a4e8"}

{"id": "p_7b8309adc68ace6b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 315, "text": "」帝忿然作色而問其故，濟具以答，因曰：「夫『作威作福』，書之明誡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 315}, "text_hash": "82a98ae3caa3416e334114fc7e4f7640a612ae31940b3609ae05e22dea536259"}

{"id": "p_f52ea0ffd56bca43", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 316, "text": "『天子無戲言』，古人所慎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 316}, "text_hash": "5118a9bf0b71eedb1e01d8c2f2eb5b90f28b27cc80f1b63f144b1a973bbc195c"}

{"id": "p_cfc1d4c91eac0cac", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 317, "text": "」於是帝意解，遣追取前詔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 317}, "text_hash": "ad8d0593b4e1d136beff692e6c3df3d246cd73d9935dd98d7e54fbe09b7bb182"}

{"id": "p_646d420a01cdb5a3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 318, "text": "，與大司馬曹仁征吳，濟別襲羨谿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 318}, "text_hash": "c870e11f3513bb44ecc3c982bb5797b19c9edcf75a088c7d8e498e2f558f595d"}

{"id": "p_e406a0cefe6fb006", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 319, "text": "仁欲攻濡須洲中，濟曰：「賊據西岸，列船上流，而兵入洲中，是為自內地獄，危亡之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 319}, "text_hash": "f6211c55a4698426c25a71ebaab21cd0b352339b5b181aabd905a7cb0df5ead4"}

{"id": "p_a9336631c6660f63", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 320, "text": "仁薨，復以濟為東中郎將，代領其兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 320}, "text_hash": "c90c648b56e14ee306d014c788da777df5627f87dfbf3a677e545ef01721180e"}

{"id": "p_1ad45e34b835087c", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 321, "text": "詔曰：「卿兼資文武，志節慷慨，常有超越江湖吞吳會之志，故复授將率之任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 321}, "text_hash": "0151789bf3904e93372cd91cce884436417e72e88d21d1b5bc868a5d8b171cb0"}

{"id": "p_40498c58d9f58c21", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 322, "text": "車駕幸廣陵，濟表水道難通，又上《三州論》以諷帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 322}, "text_hash": "d62cf472e77fbc799745fc94f12c495f3eed9db1f35a25577d5c0b8530716842"}

{"id": "p_3f3ac013a8ae3b41", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 323, "text": "帝不從，於是戰船數千皆滯不得行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 323}, "text_hash": "b1b02d1a69bc6c4ba4f5dff1b39eb6a0f9f9c02be7dc23ed84e9a1adb65284ce"}

{"id": "p_7551ba43b0a179a8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 324, "text": "議者欲就留兵屯田，濟以為東近湖，北臨淮，若水盛時，賊易為寇，不可安屯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 324}, "text_hash": "5922fe3112d6c52d4c4af4611365f66fde402409d537f7ec68756320aebe8550"}

{"id": "p_b22940b32a4c55d3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 325, "text": "還到精湖，水稍盡，盡留船付濟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 325}, "text_hash": "4fabf367b624aea949324eeb35cc6db04204823ec5fea5c2130947da5dbd6cd8"}

{"id": "p_ae7ab4f5de7faab1", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 326, "text": "船本歷適數百里中，濟更鑿地作四五道，蹴船令聚；豫作土豚遏斷湖水，皆引後船，一時開遏入淮中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 326}, "text_hash": "aae79dc7e2f6084c20f378d4ef4bce68d56edd53e10398db1dc16c861ac65208"}

{"id": "p_198030374f6ddc25", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 327, "text": "帝還洛陽，謂濟曰：「事不可不曉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 327}, "text_hash": "3ec60e247552e120681beeb6b452e96ac370440d3dd7aad9e4246e4646701832"}

{"id": "p_4530017386847b2a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 328, "text": "吾前決謂分半燒船於山陽池中，卿於後致之，略與吾俱至譙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 328}, "text_hash": "d4c9b92a2495dbc60138555ae27e2b0e13cf360e46ea470756cbd44307041cee"}

{"id": "p_250cc4fce27485ab", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 329, "text": "自今討賊計畫，善思論之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 329}, "text_hash": "ee75f7920ef54b90f9852c94f0e57b1b3f5f7016665c004bea41772f78602ddd"}

{"id": "p_e302e8622d6bc234", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 330, "text": "大司馬曹休帥軍向皖，濟表以為「深入虜地，與權精兵對，而硃然等在上流，乘休後，臣未見其利也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 330}, "text_hash": "5a0564b75d6bf9af0163df210fbbb25365a46320ca243c56c8e7edb3c64d2c55"}

{"id": "p_d0edd4767106c754", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 331, "text": "」軍至皖，吳出兵安陸，濟又上疏曰：「今賊示形於西，必欲並兵圖東，宜急詔諸軍往救之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 331}, "text_hash": "b78fe395d8b33ee54a4ebbeb8c35c1b273f7106727586ab16a640841b0f002dc"}

{"id": "p_f882be612b216987", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 332, "text": "」會休軍已敗，盡棄器仗輜重退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 332}, "text_hash": "a0a6f696a3ee4d13543ba3aa957827f251a3ffc8eefb2484377d0a36aa866a27"}

{"id": "p_cb8449a13ad96235", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 333, "text": "吳欲塞夾石，遇救兵至，是以官軍得不沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 333}, "text_hash": "f58a13e28fa36dadf3e8f5dd901c41b2949cbaa20cf1521df79851c951077902"}

{"id": "p_002c208ee50907be", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 334, "text": "時中書監、令號為專任，濟上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 334}, "text_hash": "7ad779e146e92951ead094e7a900bd32644f7b15dce8ffec590cee0af3cc4e47"}

{"id": "p_049df56ec18c3b02", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 335, "text": "詔曰：「夫骨鯁之臣，人主之所仗也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 335}, "text_hash": "e9505d9f56fbe1c1380747cca029c970d6bf887c814d2f31c12b2eb4d2efefff"}

{"id": "p_acab57a44a047534", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 336, "text": "濟才兼文武，服勤盡節，每軍國大事，輒有奏議，忠誠奮發，吾甚壯之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 336}, "text_hash": "23f36858ee345b664ed53237dfe269ebe2b28e1e96ca576f0b5d83496b6b04c5"}

{"id": "p_37d185da2d8e11a5", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 337, "text": "」就遷為護軍將軍，加散騎常侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 337}, "text_hash": "f5b5f091fa9428750b29475613e91bd129d637928e29e255869e3e7a392bd718"}

{"id": "p_3710595b16516536", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 338, "text": "景初中，外勤征役，內務宮室，怨曠者多，而年穀飢儉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 338}, "text_hash": "7c630da22830fb0a5e3c50f0f9d4e14c421477e75cc4e45e9a9deff575a5d9ed"}

{"id": "p_6b52f19c79936ff6", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 339, "text": "詔曰：「微護軍，吾弗聞斯言也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 339}, "text_hash": "f70fc37514e294086db104a56c9f4848e2ffc1032815f8b3236734a1eaf85d72"}

{"id": "p_92b75581f4ab4c5a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 340, "text": "齊王即位，徙為領軍將軍，進爵昌陵亭侯，遷太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 340}, "text_hash": "078116f833ab2f6d357da4d69e1b1040a4dae7ef91cabda34cc8c2f534bbe643"}

{"id": "p_994f67dd643bd7a7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 341, "text": "初，侍中高堂隆論郊祀事，以魏為舜後，推舜配天。", "locator": {"ordinal": 341}, "text_hash": "d3c99356649f9c0e46520ab19c51ad2288a23e38d2fe8bbc90f38dc8d0816266"}

{"id": "p_ffc1b9abefb61b88", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 342, "text": "濟以為舜本姓媯，其苗曰田，非曹之先，著文以追詰隆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 342}, "text_hash": "5ff1cbca50baff4972daa5d0769054608d35df4baa0e2153877feed6bdab8628"}

{"id": "p_c3eb3bdcdc92de3b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 343, "text": "是時，曹爽專政，丁謐、鄧颺等輕改法度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 343}, "text_hash": "056af96e6037704fc14931f7fe4f39d5e3d7d681738c5fae3deac6e5ce3343ef"}

{"id": "p_c6f75b5f5dd45fbe", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 344, "text": "會有日蝕變，詔羣臣問其得失，濟上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 344}, "text_hash": "f27c133f7ed4a57db01e8854bf6b3bf0854607d76e002d21cb6238aa7c985d8e"}

{"id": "p_74f8b7608b6580f1", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 345, "text": "以隨太傅司馬宣王屯洛水浮橋，誅曹爽等，進封都鄉侯，邑七百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 345}, "text_hash": "3fadc0cf68118f481b809184abfb5185173aeab94b84c9f1f139e54c09b63d77"}

{"id": "p_e6bbdb28468ecf21", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 346, "text": "濟上疏曰：「臣忝寵上司，而爽敢苞藏禍心，此臣之無任也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 346}, "text_hash": "065c7c97d8c46eb601cee167d7ca45d9bc67e3f2a28e14009b70f5f1537d3742"}

{"id": "p_804adc2164d247e4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 347, "text": "太傅奮獨斷之策，陛下明其忠節，罪人伏誅，社稷之福也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 347}, "text_hash": "856137de0880a499533a6f07969dffc398e4c2c018f846bd962a10aa433a213c"}

{"id": "p_1dedabd20a6b6edb", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 348, "text": "今論謀則臣不先知，語戰則非臣所率，而上失其制，下受其弊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 348}, "text_hash": "a7021d8d656d8be964fcd4c606cc7b9f55780df5794a51ce3fcdad39e7bb0a4f"}

{"id": "p_1f45c54dbf7f7176", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 349, "text": "臣備宰司，民所具瞻，誠恐冒賞之漸自此而興，推讓之風由此而廢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 349}, "text_hash": "beebdd8b289659d96f6c6a62845f02f87a25b675b58f92b703267490104dbe6f"}

{"id": "p_53d3ec8096de7daa", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 350, "text": "咸熙中，開建五等，以濟著勳前朝，改封凱為下蔡子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 350}, "text_hash": "25bdca0e21cd71bda35ced38a820c22bb60b3881444d35b5e5c7dfde96364578"}

{"id": "p_84116ab6a71c8a54", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 351, "text": "劉放字子棄，涿郡人，漢廣陽順王子西鄉侯宏後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 351}, "text_hash": "8b43d75a2236c8665fbf0de31a48ba0d5c9b595248409f30ab9fbcdce5478ede"}

{"id": "p_851c75c8aaaf16b6", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 352, "text": "遭世大亂，時漁陽王松據其土，放往依之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 352}, "text_hash": "ca68d671d8287c54e3d2fc2f5798efbde230991053ed7a1287cc75fcd069d029"}

{"id": "p_31ca10b90f722690", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 353, "text": "會太祖討袁譚於南皮，以書招松，松舉雍奴、泉州、安次以附之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 353}, "text_hash": "a3f65b9ce91140f2fa19dd3afa5e8f62a8264fa10d720d6c5df91220f97c0a84"}

{"id": "p_4c13f9d8337db38a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 354, "text": "放為松答太祖書，其文甚麗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 354}, "text_hash": "bc6f07f309abd7cde09b35b5d28582349014d392b6758232c26cabc9a4efdcb1"}

{"id": "p_bbda3ef5d1af23bd", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 355, "text": "太祖既善之，又聞其說，由是遂辟放。", "locator": {"ordinal": 355}, "text_hash": "c449d139b9a15b43be2c768771505e867118de549d372334e90bde8884f89ec9"}

{"id": "p_0719f7d2674e2f00", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 356, "text": "太祖大悅，謂放曰：「昔班彪依竇融而有河西之功，今一何相似也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 356}, "text_hash": "cd3ec026ce5ab2a3321ba5cdc9a65f4aeb56fc642842f0c6c4c7d78e3825cb1b"}

{"id": "p_f5d42cc882f7569d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 357, "text": "」乃以放參司空軍事，歷主簿記室，出為郃陽、祋祤、贊令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 357}, "text_hash": "3b7f2a905660f16e16e503e50d6ec1fc3bb41dec9612ceaa45605ab39d592886"}

{"id": "p_8cb80eb120a1252d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 358, "text": "魏國既建，與太原孫資俱為秘書郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 358}, "text_hash": "f1c2367b0d9bf4bf0ef13b9dee8fd4ec4efa401bfa0c3b6618cd6d23a9b8dcea"}

{"id": "p_b0597bea7d794871", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 359, "text": "先是，資亦歷縣令，參丞相軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 359}, "text_hash": "a9c11cf77d9ecc51b830b638f2c82232de9cce3152c78db96f9ef17b7be6491e"}

{"id": "p_44b28185c50f9925", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 360, "text": "文帝即位，放、資轉為左右丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 360}, "text_hash": "fa4222454ecc281b7c6dbc86e64a72739fb7dc9b7b8443180bd2834f120de321"}

{"id": "p_d74273d78df9468a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 361, "text": "黃初初，改秘書為中書，以放為監，資為令，各加給事中；放賜爵關內侯，資為關中侯，遂掌機密。", "locator": {"ordinal": 361}, "text_hash": "206e854fc2c9c78f13ae25d7c09ec47e54b2e3ec540f0d3755e62affff1e0b17"}

{"id": "p_430e3d909d0912e9", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 362, "text": "三年，放進爵魏壽亭侯，資關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 362}, "text_hash": "673de34b380712fb615c808224eb4ae7ee16d0a87bd90cbc19cd6ee641d04b78"}

{"id": "p_6082a69efd333766", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 363, "text": "明帝即位，尤見寵任，同加散騎常侍；進放爵西鄉侯，資樂陽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 363}, "text_hash": "774426a8803d19662d34d7bf0cfc4628595f66a73dfbd0608714cfd7a6745050"}

{"id": "p_c680eb022bd5fc8d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 364, "text": "太和末，吳遣將周賀浮海詣遼東，招誘公孫淵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 364}, "text_hash": "67aec914da1798fdfa590f12dac5dbd1f13c106aed5e52a14be3959d42baad60"}

{"id": "p_81792d30a92dc01c", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 365, "text": "帝欲邀討之，朝議多以為不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 365}, "text_hash": "7308dcfa4b53cd2c1f1825a74475e94ceced1615ec2493c21043b19e7201fde4"}

{"id": "p_2ef7321f20ac3167", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 366, "text": "惟資決行策，果大破之，進爵左鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 366}, "text_hash": "051b0de18f00e8d5c17231a6afbe364bf7d37fcb45c10d0063c7522f2171d75c"}

{"id": "p_0ba7e63d9248dc0b", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 367, "text": "放善為書檄，三祖詔命有所招喻，多放所為。", "locator": {"ordinal": 367}, "text_hash": "4e38098eec8672c28c867c7fe3262957e82ae3253420e4b9f36963e545c49ae1"}

{"id": "p_25c7ca4b0f5205dd", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 368, "text": "青龍初，孫權與諸葛亮連和，欲俱出為寇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 368}, "text_hash": "b538204bfa83a08706a3b57b5f63450f6c27e5b024ed5c3818321533309d88e9"}

{"id": "p_029eed5bc1477f0d", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 369, "text": "邊候得權書，放乃改易其辭，往往換其本文而傅合之，與征東將軍滿寵，若欲歸化，封以示亮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 369}, "text_hash": "e5369be77692e3151baf145cf583416e13a485888629f8436909a8ef17d82ee0"}

{"id": "p_ecdb888a8d2b2616", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 370, "text": "亮騰與吳大將步騭等，騭等以見權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 370}, "text_hash": "010d35c51ef50fed763bbdeeea6c1cef589c83fed2d9583507597e12a7521f6d"}

{"id": "p_d3ae356387fa24c8", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 371, "text": "是歲，俱加侍中、光祿大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 371}, "text_hash": "ac8f748619d1ec8351018def761d288cc509235e4345a4def081418cacc33d13"}

{"id": "p_507124b4a5de0e8a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 372, "text": "，遼東平定，以參謀之功，各進爵，封本縣，放方城侯，資中都侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 372}, "text_hash": "16a7df3167fa6b1101808a47b6d2c04c36d55f6b3b6045ca5486bcc60ee240e7"}

{"id": "p_d1b432b1ce890ffd", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 373, "text": "其年，帝寢疾，欲以燕王宇為大將軍，及領軍將軍夏侯獻、武衛將軍曹爽、屯騎校尉曹肇、驍騎將軍秦朗共輔政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 373}, "text_hash": "bdd12a82ebae73c10ab90914a6404d1215baaac139a0a89b0cc2ae8f5c45153b"}

{"id": "p_2c145ef4c7fe13e7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 374, "text": "帝引見放、資，入臥內，問曰：「燕王正爾為？", "locator": {"ordinal": 374}, "text_hash": "281a97c902b4da9d7acec13179294cb98bf1b5b5f6b122f99b5744565c0f4edf"}

{"id": "p_da13eddf6fda8ebe", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 375, "text": "」放、資對曰：「燕王實自知不堪大任故耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 375}, "text_hash": "76c5cabf8b0f60920ca5f508a34e67f082e5c245405ba9de1e29ec84b4292273"}

{"id": "p_8a01b386bd623d38", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 376, "text": "」帝曰：「曹爽可代宇不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 376}, "text_hash": "29c55537a6eba325e9f544f8b3ed107f3d2f47dfe9a20488f4b22b338f975178"}

{"id": "p_4e965e0a5bc9bca2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 377, "text": "又深陳宜速召太尉司馬宣王，以綱維皇室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 377}, "text_hash": "c0b11a3650648708195269a4adfada5c5b2605287c5ace89559035d40cc65301"}

{"id": "p_afbc3d68984fbf6a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 378, "text": "帝納其言，即以黃紙授放作詔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 378}, "text_hash": "47aef3ffc8a208925f0704816ff544aa2bfcf2114b22e7fc108634bde784fd87"}

{"id": "p_5822efa004e44891", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 379, "text": "放、資既出，帝意復變，詔止宣王勿使來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 379}, "text_hash": "951ae8c39d36d77a4c449dbbb7cacd7c28e7c04e5e7cac7712b7ab6908ac46b1"}

{"id": "p_240909844e8933f4", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 380, "text": "尋更見放、資曰：「我自召太尉，而曹肇等反使吾止之，幾敗吾事！", "locator": {"ordinal": 380}, "text_hash": "91f2a232461248ca6f695eb34111423c03aae5a5956191590197f69af24d1daa"}

{"id": "p_9400d284fc219f65", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 381, "text": "」命更為詔，帝獨召爽與放、資俱受詔命，遂免宇、獻、肇、朗官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 381}, "text_hash": "39cacabbc4ef42ffdf2c8a855021efdfc323f77c8918038622e4b9dcba2a1d4c"}

{"id": "p_4ed146b92d6df089", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 382, "text": "太尉亦至，登床受詔，然後帝崩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 382}, "text_hash": "6aa6453efbb04805ae9bbaca43d14ac9cbc7e738ee24a80ffcbc785aed3e8465"}

{"id": "p_8f0d8dbb2ec067d2", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 383, "text": "齊王即位，以放、資決定大謀，增邑三百，放並前千一百，資千戶；封愛子一人亭侯，次子騎都尉，餘子皆郎中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 383}, "text_hash": "0cfdecbdccc60216614020ad1712907dcca613002a97d219172ff9515d58822f"}

{"id": "p_0bbd0d7cd8c9c524", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 384, "text": "，更加放左光祿大夫，資右光祿大夫，金印紫綬，儀同三司。", "locator": {"ordinal": 384}, "text_hash": "185daa8ce3d5318cb2f1411bc397ecef8adbe7d21d769e007b809cc95a5c1e7f"}

{"id": "p_938f23a7b07b3585", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 385, "text": "六年，放轉驃騎，資衛將軍，領監、令如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 385}, "text_hash": "790ed46168a87a396b153482c56dccb08249b03d336602d34127c3a8bf06d4c3"}

{"id": "p_0d3aca0697ec9243", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 386, "text": "七年，复封子一人亭侯，各年老遜位，以列侯朝朔望，位特進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 386}, "text_hash": "7707b3039425564bbf83a75cdb09bb33383e0a157b33207b7fc5303e72555967"}

{"id": "p_f326fa63592d55c7", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 387, "text": "曹爽誅後，復以資為侍中，領中書令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 387}, "text_hash": "fcdc8849c3f033661c9afa681c4bb36bf03920ec1911b3ae1114a2f3b4e4ee15"}

{"id": "p_82658cfffda0dc7a", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 388, "text": "資复遜位歸第，就拜驃騎將軍，轉侍中，特進如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 388}, "text_hash": "313a0a14d99fcffb530df1a3e250858c86007d1555e72a1ac4aba51ccdcf45cf"}

{"id": "p_caf81fd22887bb10", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 389, "text": "放才計優資，而自脩不如也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 389}, "text_hash": "38f8680aff0e056af049045cccf829db4372b47966b2390b3ef2c2edb3799656"}

{"id": "p_47bc6b0c093fc457", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 390, "text": "放、資既善承順主上，又未嘗顯言得失，抑辛毗而助王思，以是獲譏於世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 390}, "text_hash": "4db0857121efcefb97e018924a03df9807e8a34b54683c7d2d5445acd238e250"}

{"id": "p_a6114f22ca08d362", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 391, "text": "然時因羣臣諫諍，扶贊其義，並時密陳損益，不專導諛言云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 391}, "text_hash": "d31a4b0e8b71cd7ee6f4bcb7ff4c984dda3576bdd185c3fb720f4c7429f765f8"}

{"id": "p_8dce65b47039706c", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 392, "text": "及咸熙中，開建五等，以放、資著勳前朝，改封正方城子，宏離石子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 392}, "text_hash": "21b378ce249e3a0229874a259d4bf714a85c116db91cb1ab156c88c73928a6a3"}

{"id": "p_bb37c79b4e7705f3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 393, "text": "評曰：程昱、郭嘉、董昭、劉曄、蔣濟才策謀略，世之奇士，雖清治德業，殊於荀攸，而籌畫所料，是其倫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 393}, "text_hash": "1df16557212b5aa896fb06cf63af653204af3b682cfe413bdd81d95ccd708401"}

{"id": "p_4aecff6dac4d95d3", "source_id": "src_d1655c127b1665a3", "ordinal": 394, "text": "劉放文翰，孫資勤慎，並管喉舌，權聞當時，雅亮非體，是故譏諛之聲，每過其實矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 394}, "text_hash": "190be0afdbb011507576b0d08727c12140f35389bf218e8dc9ce5359ccbe9554"}

{"id": "p_a061583c1635fcc3", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 0, "text": "劉馥字元穎，沛國相人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "855b740f591229e573214ba642bc9e7344ee6bd66a820cd9c01c940d5965b6e2"}

{"id": "p_5367c89c0cd80156", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 1, "text": "避亂揚州，建安初，說袁術將戚寄、秦翊，使率衆與俱詣太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "778698be2b0d0c8742cf657aa72f2271127b7a89cae79fae859113d664c8837d"}

{"id": "p_13daf7cfcf42912c", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 2, "text": "後孫策所置廬江太守李述攻殺揚州刺史嚴象，廬江梅乾、雷緒、陳蘭等聚衆數萬在江、淮間，郡縣殘破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "99ef54fc7e06b0b4a5eeb1cc937dc3f643da13b0261b7d6d6714a414ec99a82b"}

{"id": "p_af0e0e90bdbf0fa3", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 3, "text": "太祖方有袁紹之難，謂馥可任以東南之事，遂表為揚州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "54fe9997feda7ea09aae6234847d2cbfcc58f4882b3fc508645271cad2d6b383"}

{"id": "p_6bb037a4ca407dc9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 4, "text": "馥旣受命，單馬造合肥空城，建立州治，南懷緒等，皆安集之，貢獻相繼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "1392f39f7de786be78b289c58ceed83eac49f72d7d3d2c326195344c9e775713"}

{"id": "p_23bf7e9ca82b2495", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 5, "text": "數年中恩化大行，百姓樂其政，流民越江山而歸者以萬數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "4275d8bd068492bd5d1ff8c6e38054d3ea769e43c24f36e461dc28b82ef02826"}

{"id": "p_1cc4ae6f780e81f7", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 6, "text": "於是聚諸生，立學校，廣屯田，興治芍陂及茹陂、七門、吳塘諸堨以溉稻田，官民有畜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "dd1246ed92532d649fbbda01e8b8139a54f36544fd0dc7f89939ee0909dde854"}

{"id": "p_03a6e61df1457e3a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 7, "text": "又高為城壘，多積木石，編作草苫數千萬枚，益貯魚膏數千斛，為戰守備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "5ac926c93c6fbc87b1fa78ce2306dfd07d635856e8c38b5aa403beb50b8f5dae"}

{"id": "p_71a932e12d76a37f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 8, "text": "孫權率十萬衆攻圍合肥城百餘日，時天連雨，城欲崩，於是以苫蓑覆之，夜然脂照城外，視賊所作而為備，賊以破走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "d0f4bdd17b7f8860c249b68bd87380fed700d9ecd4fceaf6043423c0c6c1d04f"}

{"id": "p_96b88ca2941defe8", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 9, "text": "揚州士民益追思之，以為雖董安于之守晉陽，不能過也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "68eb31f54889d4fe5f9628892a7023143363f5a9493ba093591fce04d5513bf0"}

{"id": "p_faac946d5409bed2", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 10, "text": "馥子靖，黃初中從黃門侍郎遷廬江太守，詔曰：「卿父昔為彼州，今卿復據此郡，可謂克負荷者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "fe14d65bc6cbdfa1d895a50d5089d8aaf55342e08d462de558609a64026088e1"}

{"id": "p_0dd337199d1fd972", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」轉在河內，遷尚書，賜爵關內侯，出為河南尹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "1607f3f2c66aebdfca6582903bf002b11edec185883c8615157fae44d099b64b"}

{"id": "p_3bbdd6853c5031be", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 12, "text": "散騎常侍應璩書與靖曰：「入作納言，出臨京任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "522bd4a694f260d7d5817f02a7c4c6b566a8bb83e162d2a2cc05f5c64f44c773"}

{"id": "p_7ed48cb2787400c0", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 13, "text": "蠶麥有苫備之用，無雨濕之虞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "d4d71623eb110f9799fa0be1ebc0168908077b3ae284327b40cd4caee6adf269"}

{"id": "p_599d8c2b9c9cac09", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 14, "text": "加之以明擿幽微，重之以秉憲不撓；有司供承王命，百里垂拱仰辨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "91dc87ab7e057f36478eebffbfafdfdf0df20fd66140f0a231667c741e4585af"}

{"id": "p_1075fc842dad10f9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 15, "text": "雖昔趙、張、三王之治，未足以方也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "6f3d6ca12158412c1de160da28b09dba12b5017f5ad9e5bdc85e77a4532dbdfd"}

{"id": "p_bd3c9748aae38d11", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 16, "text": "初雖如碎密，終於百姓便之，有馥遺風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "ebfd66d5985b7e3057ecf670d962614a26dd92906f0b9a773d0c928a9d0ccae2"}

{"id": "p_9ef8b8269572e8ba", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 17, "text": "母喪去官，後為大司農衞尉，進封廣陸亭侯，邑三百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "f27215ffb55ca4f88b5c91fc0e03afae8ab4dbb12041ac9a459d33835bcec9b2"}

{"id": "p_77a12169670e34a2", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 18, "text": "上疏陳儒訓之本曰：「夫學者，治亂之軌儀，聖人之大教也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "8387b15b22faa67386a6a2218740a19e722d05edec1d79e946a4741747d4c883"}

{"id": "p_93a5ae44f89a2110", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 19, "text": "自黃初以來，崇立太學二十餘年，而寡有成者，蓋由愽士選輕，諸生避役，高門子弟，恥非其倫，故無學者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "d523fa652f17dbadc6ef48dfb1e8f897bd2c2ae86eca323364c9b447e9f50f10"}

{"id": "p_b528c7804a0929cf", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 20, "text": "雖有其名而無其人，雖設其教而無其功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "4f583c45b8a88417a89d7ce5e8f1cfd3fae6a7680c4aa640117fe8283cea7c2f"}

{"id": "p_78b292d5cb1df9e4", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 21, "text": "宜高選博士，取行為人表，經任人師者，掌教國子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "cfbce99b86b18d2d4f0767a3c39c1b7b5aec0c5096bf924f1a7170c1a82f79f7"}

{"id": "p_3c1432725666e8f2", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 22, "text": "依遵古法，使二千石以上子孫，年從十五，皆入太學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "10f9e20bd18356faed94717043d50c6c739861e16abc73bcc5e58b340cb4c367"}

{"id": "p_38ae9de28d340fc9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 23, "text": "明制黜陟榮辱之路；其經明行脩者，則進之以崇德；荒教廢業者，則退之以懲惡；舉善而教不能則勸，浮華交游，不禁自息矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "9900d361181f52be296e5fb128acfdb627a23de02164fa1a4e1db8370d07538f"}

{"id": "p_87eded9b3422692a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 24, "text": "闡弘大化，以綏未賔；六合承風，遠人來格。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "c7c2c0ffefb7cd4125b84cd6d7d634d3d47a15c0bfb073bafd33709a152d5e34"}

{"id": "p_15cbf8660fb48c1a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 25, "text": "此聖人之教，致治之本也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "0fd688944454356c3a778f7d6ae2dc3a0a3b97068742f63a7d062f8d0654aafd"}

{"id": "p_879289b9d34279e9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」後遷鎮北將軍，假節都督河北諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "8a0d5cf00c6ace1ce9c3eed3b7d4c7a7ff609c4f295a471ccaf78620af8f58aa"}

{"id": "p_082e2458b8711477", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 27, "text": "靖以為「經常之大法，莫善於守防，使民夷有別」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "9f4902dfc402548f166077a2ad19d7ac78ba5ad0a464adae7379d8b7978ff3a5"}

{"id": "p_bd6513b2e2bada0b", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 28, "text": "又脩廣戾陵渠大堨，水溉灌薊南北；三更種稻，邊民利之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "824209013372c3ee6d305ba097fdc2d21c10aeb1ebcc5c6553f188e494296b16"}

{"id": "p_9947413c02058abe", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 29, "text": "薨，追贈征北將軍，進封建成鄉侯，謚曰景侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "2c538076e4e5cc76a3d65c8a741ca099e23f8fa4e411ddf065d3a517d015114d"}

{"id": "p_05cc6578aed2c25e", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 30, "text": "司馬朗字伯達，河内溫人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "76f6b6de7077006b7a7cf7c80d6ff8af9e4c4817984475224d17edc1f0e7ded8"}

{"id": "p_0daf5a17315a6c24", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 31, "text": "九歲，人有道其父字者，朗曰：「慢人親者，不敬其親者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "6342fd198b07888c3b3872ee6a62e5e5e7b281e2a3a7edd7f39f12f85ca26650"}

{"id": "p_81341262adad5b5f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 32, "text": "十二，試經爲童子郎，監試者以其身體壮大，疑朗匿年，劾問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "7a80fb53d033f6a769f53c27dfb4a4dbdca1462e8bb224bc6bc32b0239262cee"}

{"id": "p_a1e49799a6d4cd1a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 33, "text": "朗曰：「朗之内外，累世長大，朗雖穉弱，無仰高之風，損年以求早成，非志所爲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "e7ced7c59e58e1ad257b38884aa1aec12badec96ab5df4ae33a3d3dbf7c880c7"}

{"id": "p_f88ccf9729a05085", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 34, "text": "後關東兵起，故冀州刺史李邵家居野王，近山險，欲徙居溫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "dcfa97f92157b52691f5ef1bcd69004789dab5215440cfcb4d47dc7f7f9e0867"}

{"id": "p_f1151bbb91b01317", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 35, "text": "朗謂邵曰：「脣齒之喻，豈唯虞、虢，溫與野王即是也；今去彼而居此，是爲避朝亡之期耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "6110730fd90de073a41cf6d3e9500dc77ff167758a2c8a9ed8aa261d9dd21386"}

{"id": "p_a3b6d310e68110d0", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 36, "text": "且君，國人之望也，今寇未至而先徙，帶山之縣必駭，是摇動民之心而開姦宄之原也，竊爲郡内憂之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "6934e39f15b6f7b1b0d8f7f0c83356cfd5dc9bb1338be3990289973fa5861bbf"}

{"id": "p_f29f1db1536c7dd0", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 37, "text": "邊山之民果亂，内徙，或爲寇鈔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "6dad168ceceec9a201ccb3e6a490a8ad6df53c30810789cad49af91ed84f196a"}

{"id": "p_d07fbe01a0f376d6", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 38, "text": "是時董卓遷天子都長安，卓因留洛陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "530fbecff78849de4dfc1de95de0b07590421ca13088d981c31e3d338836ff58"}

{"id": "p_e6d5a2bd57032713", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 39, "text": "朗父防爲治書御史，當徙西，以四方雲擾，乃遣朗將家屬還本縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "c91c68898c5176c40d44887a39a2fba08e18f4e30a5e5897083ed9a466c95eb8"}

{"id": "p_b7804b11da1e92d6", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 40, "text": "或有告朗欲逃亡者，執以詣卓，卓謂朗曰：「卿與吾亡兒同歲，幾大相負！", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "ac2f1e0a33bf4c0402cd972626be520ed7151c4648eb7e9320eb66aca311f277"}

{"id": "p_1ca917e4efd4d1b8", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 41, "text": "」朗因曰：「明公以高世之德，遭陽九之會，清除羣穢，廣舉賢士，此誠虚心垂慮，將興至治也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "ed6316d277b7e1c2d5518672a193cf7a6c109d6dab67a25262c741dcbb3c6347"}

{"id": "p_09aeb6e1b01da01a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 42, "text": "威德以隆，功業以著，而兵難日起，州郡鼎沸，郊境之内，民不安業，捐棄居產，流亡藏竄，雖四關設禁，重加刑戮，猶不絕息，此朗之所以於邑也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "0477bb2028b2b7752689cf7826de32183757b65a79fce0f2257eefc2e563f14d"}

{"id": "p_ff18299350f80831", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 43, "text": "願明公監觀往事，少加三思，即榮名並於日月，伊、周不足侔也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "5915514e87f30a63cff5e8494864aca8cb4e0557db167c3acee841f1cba34915"}

{"id": "p_e50f40c06a35d942", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 44, "text": "」卓曰：「吾亦悟之，卿言有意！", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "68a6d66a64ae9f87ec6ea4eb902f49fc20b5f62a1f73052ef51a7f47613b4d5b"}

{"id": "p_6c8f7924475eda00", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 45, "text": "朗知卓必亡，恐見留，即散財物以賂遺卓用事者，求歸鄉里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "74d07f6e05afffc599912adf8b69358996cffa76c4d341810e5ef8902c6559b0"}

{"id": "p_50456ad8525c136b", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 46, "text": "到謂父老曰；「董卓悖逆，爲天下所讎，此忠臣義士奮發之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "241e48a5e19c97c7703d103ded6a5c3d520b5f95bfea37958129968503974a69"}

{"id": "p_abb76d9a1ada42f1", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 47, "text": "郡與京都境壤相接，洛東有成皋，北界大河，天下興義兵者若未得進，其勢必停於此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "31fc1d056acfb2d65294acf08ad2852425b65fb22a58d8ee7c9dc363a1ea0c52"}

{"id": "p_307ec6dc9108efe5", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 48, "text": "此乃四分五裂戰爭之地，難以自安，不如及道路尚通，舉宗東到黎陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "8153a5218ccb4c9fea209b80b3475826eb60228d774d0e95bd85572ab8de380f"}

{"id": "p_d9b30b0860469eb8", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 49, "text": "黎陽有營兵，趙威孫鄉里舊婚，爲監營謁者，統兵馬，足以爲主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "ba8a7fb2ceb7400d766d35bb7bd8014b1027e65aa419cc15f776bf3f34875636"}

{"id": "p_ade974faebac86af", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 50, "text": "若後有變，徐復觀望未晚也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "b8226983c13b26d3a475efb38713e9139e47da8cfa1a2693200795e9cf536f8a"}

{"id": "p_f7baa1de8a99b18e", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」父老戀舊，莫有從者，惟同縣趙咨，將家屬俱與朗往焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "a28ececdad91aa2a2386a2e480dae5ba0a3119447d550fc0247d80567c869748"}

{"id": "p_2574d09c4f99d7c2", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 52, "text": "後數月，關東諸州郡起兵，眾數十萬，皆集滎陽及河内。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "742bf2a8324e9aaa8ca2cd8fec6f3bd4cbb9fae5cd88b580e88ea611b9c68384"}

{"id": "p_6cfd33f562240466", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 53, "text": "諸將不能相一，縱兵鈔略，民人死者且半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "2e5f17315f7a9f979b7b73f254b2e4c943ba8ac0512242267543d3b14e2149a9"}

{"id": "p_4309878fdda6e418", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 54, "text": "久之，關東兵散，太祖與呂布相持於濮陽，朗乃將家還溫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "fe86acb0784f3ba293c16f6fb56fa6951dfdf63f3f1198d87e658242a3acedc0"}

{"id": "p_4a80adc1c08ee0ab", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 55, "text": "時歲大饑，人相食，朗收恤宗族，教訓諸弟，不爲衰世解業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "17e405250f14a591d94f736ab443ef17a4f8d87051a991707a7a6a3ac1e0683b"}

{"id": "p_48c6140e157ffa33", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 56, "text": "年二十二，太祖辟爲司空掾屬，除成皋令，以病去，復爲堂陽長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "de9fd30f4fe24f3eb58e348e88672d22b02a9c4a1a0b6088a2ada69332382e6f"}

{"id": "p_bbe0fc67967441ec", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 57, "text": "其治務寬惠，不行鞭杖，而民不犯禁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "7670e92f9159127feda2d42e8c21df67077e7d0e848ba4823cb115a4879efe5e"}

{"id": "p_7c5e181b426743ae", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 58, "text": "先時，民有徙充都内者，後縣調當作船，徙民恐其不辦，乃相率私還助之，其見愛如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "2bafbe2c91ef81e15d5cc0f625609bf684293998b381e8eb6f22e12f114a1d0d"}

{"id": "p_d2cb68040120abc4", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 59, "text": "遷元城令，入爲丞相主簿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "a3db1a5e582e232de560eb15abd15471018769dd0dded257a73145ae3447a925"}

{"id": "p_63dc288c59a5cdb9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 60, "text": "朗以爲天下土崩之勢，由秦滅五等之制，而郡國無蒐狩習戰之備故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "bcb91c8aa30340b944f2ac0e021b9968ed43669d4aaf11d0c96f5548b72057bd"}

{"id": "p_1084e9aa4fd04fcf", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 61, "text": "今雖五等未可復行，可令州郡並置兵，外備四夷，内威不軌，於策爲長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "94e710d8dfbad7ff830e2d03076dc011c3f849c0d9cbb5967867635a5aa2c761"}

{"id": "p_5c77d893108e3b77", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 62, "text": "往者以民各有累世之業，難中奪之，是以至今。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "89681a9c7f47a8654a63adaebd924e765eee13e2ecb8fc8c07be41c1fb6eefdd"}

{"id": "p_a40b6cddbe98de2f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 63, "text": "今承大亂之後，民人分散，土業無主，皆爲公田，宜及此時復之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "daf02e63d83715e3a635c113d170b8598005bcf8d4ba618f244147c36eca2377"}

{"id": "p_6e7bb478d4740089", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 64, "text": "議雖未施行，然州郡领兵，朗本意也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "81a30b0aa3efd15f9e652418d7527228c9dd793206704796c130d945d2d52029"}

{"id": "p_a5365394a3e96a4b", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 65, "text": "遷兗州刺史，政化大行，百姓稱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "41603b8593a1155f427a1bf3eb3571710c21f85cab87b0ca5ab9d127cb5a4660"}

{"id": "p_6a4196c593bacb7d", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 66, "text": "雖在軍旅，常粗衣恶食，俭以率下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "179bb09b436b9576d49a5caadefa495c5044be1ce732ab4a6ba7ae524d0b248a"}

{"id": "p_050e964e0492ebf0", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 67, "text": "雅好人伦典籍，鄉人李觌等盛得名誉，朗常显贬下之；後觌等敗，時人服焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "82f4930ed40ea8ff2c0e12511afded5e3d6809212d45b1aa23c694f6da2dce54"}

{"id": "p_4777fd2376f66e50", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 68, "text": "锺繇、王粲著论云：「非圣人不能致太平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "2bb3e4b9ed55b15562c69700b1915c65d029b245147fd44922deb0ce41fee491"}

{"id": "p_871f4c5582b414ae", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」朗以爲「伊、颜之徒雖非圣人，使得數世相承，太平可致」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "65da46f814e15fc9e794061afb6b6ce829d0e7761a789c42a463fed83c536da9"}

{"id": "p_5a215699b2250e6a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 70, "text": "，與夏侯惇、臧霸等征吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "cab98d1f2386c7ed882f33b75e92b4a6410d38643d46b4e719a09ac6e8e52dd5"}

{"id": "p_b59790fe0af7cf22", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 71, "text": "到居巢，軍士大疫，朗躬巡视，致医药。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "19348e07bf77d31eb275fa2e2b32551c6f8a33ff2f82c4ccb4a6ec8c5697c64f"}

{"id": "p_316ac5a304185e16", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 72, "text": "遺命布衣幅巾，敛以時服，州人追思之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "2b8dc0dad39593a636d6f4b09221d14d069ed9b989171d1f2dd9613ecc04424f"}

{"id": "p_99203b99bb915cd2", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 73, "text": "明帝即位，封朗子遺昌武亭侯，邑百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "710c3b1deee64febb9eba9813c00e0bfaf28a2ef46766e2304bc1ceb6769b2c0"}

{"id": "p_a9fcf6b40c4087da", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 74, "text": "初朗所與俱徙趙咨，官至太常，爲世好士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "871d6757899635a84fb5bbb133dde905e96eff724f73fe850e52dfef9fce767d"}

{"id": "p_337f7d165d5f32a3", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 75, "text": "梁習字子虞，陳郡柘人也，爲郡纲纪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "fb557a2cc954e5f22c9aec5a69681611900f971d6ba1d95f0f39e7d2302f987a"}

{"id": "p_775100360aded980", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 76, "text": "太祖爲司空，辟召爲漳長，累轉乘氏、海西、下邳令，所在有治名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "b80ca9c196e2c75df84d479f8ac84cc37aea55c82c97763b65819c7ee3e9c6c5"}

{"id": "p_78566c9fe4cae90c", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 77, "text": "-{并}-土新附，習以别部司馬领并州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "dc3ef5d9e132a930ff95875e84a895df03edf7f1645a815f7e916451f19f82ea"}

{"id": "p_9059c52b5d703def", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 78, "text": "時承高幹荒亂之餘，胡狄在界，張雄跋扈，吏民亡叛，入其部落；兵家拥眾，作爲寇害，更相扇動，往往釭跱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "df816bac896b16fcd728ac5b8f42cda47ce6ad55c9edbd5bd81d6ee05ac7d242"}

{"id": "p_4e4416c5edb8617e", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 79, "text": "習到官，诱谕招纳，皆礼召其豪右，稍稍荐舉，使詣幕府；豪右已尽，乃次发諸丁强以爲義從；又因大軍出征，分请以爲勇力。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "2fc5e45670d2d27e228b1ae04fe93b4927e69c0633b3940fc91dac2f629bd236"}

{"id": "p_fc5dfa064a665f0a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 80, "text": "吏兵已去之後，稍移其家，前後送鄴，凡數萬口；其不從命者，興兵致讨，斩首千數，降附者萬计。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "13d6662f1204c8d81d9fa9c3c932a37bea1a690205d85448da45caea6a3f37c3"}

{"id": "p_6620fd0e9c5d5f0f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 81, "text": "单于恭顺，名王稽颡，部曲服事供职，同於编户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "c19ea8f1b039b0c962fba5779a228823a5d74cc7742801d1d54750d6179768a7"}

{"id": "p_309c317f842dfee1", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 82, "text": "邊境肅清，百姓布野，勤勸农桑，令行禁止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "015734e686e19058d9163624b8f14e43e390e98558c77337598b0d4318c2c61c"}

{"id": "p_773a0f0e0617929c", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 83, "text": "贡達名士，咸显於世，语在《常林傳》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "cbf452424b2b27394dedc48b9f1ef64647bb65dc81696330b0b1be50453b5296"}

{"id": "p_f12c329778c02804", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 84, "text": "太祖嘉之，赐爵關内侯，更拜爲真。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "a7fc1358256fc5997e72d6d26db4bcbd3c65cb751583b1e74d2e3f4b03c7a114"}

{"id": "p_804f278f0c355235", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 85, "text": "長老稱咏，以爲自所聞识，刺史未有及習者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "a14487caebf15b12fd7303fef65c6397c4fefa28a27a537df5829fccd41f5b65"}

{"id": "p_e7b4b299503f9a24", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 86, "text": "，州並屬冀州，更拜議郎、西部都督從事，統屬冀州，總故部曲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "caff63d26e4cfd7bfecca6354dfd9c32fbfd560697b58273b4385d1d442c04ba"}

{"id": "p_ec81580f4e79c313", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 87, "text": "又使於上黨取大材供鄴宫室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "808c3eefa8e0ef84bb539c82c9bb748ca446e64cad6fbe2a4d34613213c540a9"}

{"id": "p_c81c8348b84806a8", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 88, "text": "習表置屯田都尉二人，领客六百夫，於道次耕种菽粟，以给人牛之费。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "7c972fe62c0dc8bf3d14c14950cb1338b57efad7c7a26309a2bcfd97a95a69f3"}

{"id": "p_39a127ac521be2da", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 89, "text": "後单于入侍，西北無虞，習之绩也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "c46c29318b383a8257283386950df5bc564b0fa3041a526d57cae3c5a43b1d70"}

{"id": "p_b7db254c775a0ce0", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 90, "text": "文帝践阼，復置并州，復爲刺史，進封申門亭侯，邑百户；政治常爲天下最。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "2a54a302f8ae08111734a6d4c34f722956b33eff7f68530090d645c32278fddb"}

{"id": "p_80b898d0f21868aa", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 91, "text": "習在州二十餘年，而居處贫窮，無方面珍物，明帝異之，礼赐甚厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "4308a2892a44f01ac81d1576052ed7bc376913121a0a66514cd91b48ce6e8624"}

{"id": "p_0141c6ac252ae793", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 92, "text": "初，济阴王思與習俱爲西曹令史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "7676640aca70923bbd4f84a9508ca61b95b7cd945117eebb2c367545ad94f04f"}

{"id": "p_4863303d3e35cb06", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 93, "text": "思因直日白事，失太祖指。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "57fcb028839e564b78f5d926ece6dc7d53bb57817ea407924c922a8c62a7b8c0"}

{"id": "p_6d1a4373e8851f8a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 94, "text": "太祖大怒，教召主者，將加重辟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "d9794b04f9e43a70abb0dc5fe3dd52b048dd9fa14a0b7383f1a593a80fb18ad9"}

{"id": "p_ba1a9ac70ec49936", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 95, "text": "時思近出，習代往對，已被收執矣，思乃驰還，自陳己罪，罪应受死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "a9519e3b61a567f6f7d247f9691afa1b6fa3b8d95c46f65f62b7a16555639255"}

{"id": "p_65e1a7689ad855cf", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 96, "text": "太祖叹習之不言，思之识分，曰：「何意吾軍中有二義士乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "592786f47c5d370d1e42760c9eaba6d03e38e9bcf5c1e8dfe6bde663e75e27b1"}

{"id": "p_86371140a6eed7d3", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」後同時擢爲刺史，思领豫州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "04cdabe3beaf2553677dbdf838fce1a075bf221839893911e687924238f4a24c"}

{"id": "p_a267d2c09f21f978", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 98, "text": "思亦能吏，然苛碎無大體，官至九卿，封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "001faa767c07268e41a99e5fac3dc7ab215c5e7e521e8a2610e0732727b1729d"}

{"id": "p_d27d5beab53e3f38", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 99, "text": "張旣字德容，馮翊高陵人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "0c4442c3b57f94c091490e279e12b6def5400789190505a239292577abdcf66f"}

{"id": "p_96f81d32d7adf289", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 100, "text": "後歷右職，舉孝廉，不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "746888af32f2b4223ec3a32e3ea1ae709d9f66aca8c5f24568af2976ef814c89"}

{"id": "p_2e0e11b48e9fff02", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 101, "text": "太祖為司空，辟，未至，舉茂才，除新豐令，治為三輔第一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "ed43a4cff3bf9fffd215b90449c8a91beacf9471716d6a6ebf41a3ca6a94d3bd"}

{"id": "p_081acd78f09fb2b9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 102, "text": "袁尚拒太祖於黎陽，遣所置河東太守郭援、並州刺史高幹及匈奴單于取平陽，發使西與關中諸將合從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "12e4ee96699863c083614657e81e424cc7055a9c46aae0bb4214eb522ecc0e74"}

{"id": "p_9c830673dcde6a8e", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 103, "text": "司隷校尉鍾繇遣旣說將軍馬騰等，旣為言利害，騰等從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "7694f2e8d130b9666a34d600873b3138df76c67cbdb138abdf217be0a85adbcb"}

{"id": "p_e020e7aa321e4aa5", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 104, "text": "騰遣子超將兵萬餘人，與繇會擊幹、援，大破之，斬援首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "67be4bc9529008bedf5d229d694d1480acd8483c33e49a968bdaf479cf4272ec"}

{"id": "p_8eaf397c569d3f77", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 105, "text": "河內張晟衆萬餘人無所屬，冦崤、澠閒，河東衞固、弘農張琰各起兵以應之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "9247faf1ba71020335b2f6e9987bd9138160bb8588783e1bbddd8d5eeaa464b5"}

{"id": "p_08d41fac2908f42a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 106, "text": "太祖以旣為議郎，參繇軍事，使西徵諸將馬騰等，皆引兵會擊晟等，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "1721246d1d93d821b20604a30dea230c162ffa36159f16af65c0571fb0e7cec9"}

{"id": "p_4567d3ca8b53c084", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 107, "text": "太祖將征荊州，而騰等分據關中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "6d42e1c9a658ff60b0fbc9a54f219edc1a6ce9f30e9fd032ef7b410f58d2dbf2"}

{"id": "p_a5e0bbb2929b38ed", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 108, "text": "太祖復遣旣喻騰等，令釋部曲求還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "d396c4c1a43203ab88aa3dd0aac0b5642e26c694631a5eb5dc7fafd2d43e7771"}

{"id": "p_b063fc431d40b418", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 109, "text": "騰已許之而更猶豫，旣恐為變，乃移諸縣促儲偫，二千石郊迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "72f855b233758b4112c4d47b43dfafa64ea46f6c9370cc370961dde149ff9248"}

{"id": "p_756b45b592bd48c4", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 110, "text": "太祖表騰為衞尉，子超為將軍，統其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "8864e22136f6e47d8bf1e3d2c61b9ab8df69bafad1cbddd4c04e418c566ff291"}

{"id": "p_2c97e7f1a750eb32", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 111, "text": "後超反，旣從太祖破超於華陰，西定關右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "331a3e58fe05beaf02f8d003b6e516e3b953bf88c9ddf7b6269741e32886e325"}

{"id": "p_ef49ea506705c019", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 112, "text": "以旣為京兆尹，招懷流民，興復縣邑，百姓懷之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "bff3deb7382832aaadb2a1bd29ba3136630faebd5bcb4d0c91bfec79f21a48d3"}

{"id": "p_28f81290359640e8", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 113, "text": "魏國旣建，為尚書，出為雍州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "04397c3ea401cdd771c1a29da2ec6d8d4fd9054cb62da68077944e0365d06445"}

{"id": "p_1d759ce23a2f093e", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 114, "text": "太祖謂旣曰：「還君本州，可謂衣繡晝行矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "46a8946e883d0763114c33a7010319b1fe1430fb5bf83c24647f10d65b118fac"}

{"id": "p_15a22bf09903b666", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 115, "text": "」從征張魯，別從散關入討叛氐，收其麥以給軍食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "14e48dd7079faf7fd67438c984367ccb3bdcfbe92ea6203fc619e64fa4af3c9e"}

{"id": "p_5037691279589db9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 116, "text": "魯降，旣說太祖拔漢中民數萬戶以實長安及三輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "14809920c7955aa17bd99ef1c971cb556c051ff70a762df9fadd667ef3e97ac8"}

{"id": "p_eff1d9b0c3fa81ed", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 117, "text": "其後與曹洪破吳蘭於下辯，又與夏侯淵討宋建，別攻臨洮、狄道，平之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "f39f8a35bbf6b99753d511f411bc045ad082c00707886088f98ba56213ec0b5c"}

{"id": "p_bde31ea533c0e0bc", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 118, "text": "是時，太祖徙民以充河北，隴西、天水、南安民相恐動，擾擾不安，旣假三郡人為將吏者休課，使治屋宅，作水碓，民心遂安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "69888c1c2042a770b5de2f62e4694ad279c3af2a6e761ec2293e9751680132e8"}

{"id": "p_9810695f905ca6d6", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 119, "text": "太祖將拔漢中守，恐劉備北取武都氐以逼關中，問旣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "0e755ca4b84da6c7459b345503165055281d3a03e19cb5c53c8d565a42c61219"}

{"id": "p_b2592ccd2a206ebe", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 120, "text": "旣曰：「可勸使北出就穀以避賊，前至者厚其寵賞，則先者知利，後必慕之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "57cb74d5df331d9c95ccc72884a56a20771a9dba3136647629d7aef4df90a56f"}

{"id": "p_7dc6c5c6d111ea5c", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 121, "text": "」太祖從其策，乃自到漢中引出諸軍，令旣之武都，徙氐五萬餘落出居扶風、天水界。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "c3ece2c402abc2107d292a9f8629594780e2f31e81e93297bcca4a7d8a0dcb2e"}

{"id": "p_de1223e14e367f2f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 122, "text": "是時，武威顏雋、張掖和鸞、酒泉黃華、西平麴演等並舉郡反，自號將軍，更相攻擊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "7a74161e62cf67984178bf93677713e59b3792cb522358b3c87748e4d89b4c83"}

{"id": "p_3b2069e8013cca88", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 123, "text": "雋遣使送母及子詣太祖為質，求助。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "1c33dd9d00bb92b68c1053579463340287920b3a46c6e9c53fecc746cd6c90da"}

{"id": "p_fa9c1544879e9fad", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 124, "text": "太祖問旣，旣曰：「雋等外假國威，內生傲悖，計定勢足，後即反耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "385033d1042b22a1e2a9be4124c890657618e96465539d963685da4ed2dc3ce4"}

{"id": "p_cf2aaea0c2022762", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 125, "text": "今方事定蜀，且宜兩存而鬬之，猶卞莊子之刺虎，坐收其斃也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "2759d26c1f633554a9320bda40d4f86ecba3980a9ca04df676e3fac38f327a5b"}

{"id": "p_638e7f31d8663139", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 126, "text": "」歲餘，鸞遂殺雋，武威王祕又殺鸞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "b2c4cc9bd6e53f3bc26a37d02c1e60f5aa1a8507e76a8143aec6cfec6f97c2d9"}

{"id": "p_259b17206db57e12", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 127, "text": "是時不置涼州，自三輔拒西域，皆屬雍州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "1d41b53aa3c80616e671ae6338d205bfc4ce8e120d22f57b63254aa01057652a"}

{"id": "p_9d23a85a0a7f69c0", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 128, "text": "文帝即王位，初置涼州，以安定太守鄒岐為刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "86cc2fed1b22ace2e3e58a7d872ff0765010c7a87e1b35c01df99cc456587c59"}

{"id": "p_6f1e166a46b5e3be", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 129, "text": "張掖張進執郡守舉兵拒岐，黃華、麴演各逐故太守，舉兵以應之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "c4ed45f7fd8a07d78df7d16d9d418733207041c350771ec13d83c9cd3a11dad4"}

{"id": "p_290d7ea9559d67d3", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 130, "text": "旣進兵為護羌校尉蘇則聲勢，故則得以有功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "1da941d0566d926eb1a4321c4c254a547e20cbc69b9dc09e47ad3dac229f68e6"}

{"id": "p_daf71df73dd60f6c", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 131, "text": "涼州盧水胡伊健妓妾、治元多等反，河西大擾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "b28bbb97364385ebc37120d23d65ab1aa297a2bc80fdd235619bab155c80c539"}

{"id": "p_42cf6295f5e0937f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 132, "text": "帝憂之，曰：「非旣莫能安涼州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "466823a3e113eeac34aa50f85b2fe6e6e7de8b223fdf564448db56a1dff4d043"}

{"id": "p_4ab0ea45455cacf8", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 133, "text": "詔曰：「昔賈復請擊郾賊，光武笑曰：『執金吾擊郾，吾復何憂？", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "0ede873448886a67670ecbe5b02a5fefa8268bec6b32ea6daaca6b2953fd7453"}

{"id": "p_35fd1b3b0ef57744", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 134, "text": "』卿謀略過人，今則其時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "3315d98a0a02429d96f70f6d853283a27f404f0237c1f7bdaa9cdd87bb882013"}

{"id": "p_0ddb76737a84b24c", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 135, "text": "」遣護軍夏侯儒、將軍費曜等繼其後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "4882a89919c5c5be3486927d13dfccbddca3201242d569f987f2a43081e5bc62"}

{"id": "p_21c94c020925b5ec", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 136, "text": "旣至金城，欲渡河，諸將守以為「兵少道險，未可深入」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "520adaac850fb598bf5c79a5027b45477575077809388f59f7e6484259d1751f"}

{"id": "p_6bb68b386109c056", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 137, "text": "旣曰：「道雖險，非井陘之隘，夷狄烏合，無左車之計，今武威危急，赴之宜速。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "ec7d81906f232b647afc33eb2efd53ee95680c01e7e7c1689dc2c7693ffcd532"}

{"id": "p_daa1172e027aeaa9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 138, "text": "賊七千餘騎逆拒軍於鸇陰口，旣揚聲軍從鸇陰，乃潛由且次出至武威。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "e7815b07226f000ae5a4a2afb38b8f6365b112acd829b874b1e85006c38fa695"}

{"id": "p_bb392dcabdf28a1b", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 139, "text": "旣已據武威，曜乃至，儒等猶未達。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "4ff84137bb20e3bc8fb943cb635599af9ba339e787b43ece2cbe1c3b340aecd6"}

{"id": "p_8be9d16c6536be80", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 140, "text": "旣勞賜將士，欲進軍擊胡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "9f7dcbed9107d2e9714803977e472a38e21e124ccb4aa71868b01e7f8587f1ec"}

{"id": "p_d0a874a7326cd940", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 141, "text": "諸將皆曰：「士卒疲倦，虜衆氣銳，難與爭鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "73af05bb8e68529323c802fbe82084d2979ad28da8beec7e231e2008be51db4b"}

{"id": "p_8a5a3c500e2d1d0d", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 142, "text": "」旣曰：「今軍無見糧，當因敵為資。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "367d623ff480a86262312cd9f22c74ee867e14f4bc6e0ff61b67c7b034039333"}

{"id": "p_4be0a989666ed1b0", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 143, "text": "若虜見兵合，退依深山，追之則道險窮餓，兵還則出候寇鈔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "3254f0ea7a5ba34e95b1d02e7bfca83b91f138b1f515d12035d45a900cb60483"}

{"id": "p_fe13248e479038bb", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 144, "text": "如此，兵不得解，所謂『一日縱敵，患在數世』也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "f8fce85d1321b1fba2d738a410349f4ddd601b0d2af066e6a47962791e47cc83"}

{"id": "p_6f2fd7acaefb0395", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 145, "text": "胡騎數千，因大風欲放火燒營，將士皆恐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "5abe884425b1c1b9911b2f13ae9d21f833699e35b48d61f1232695d35d2b17c5"}

{"id": "p_6c22173bf03cf5d9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 146, "text": "旣夜藏精卒三千人為伏，使參軍成公英督千餘騎挑戰，勑使陽退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "04841cb3068824f85553da2185bb6b6829e6f2ec4a59d8ab8c732cc154ffe2e0"}

{"id": "p_1c0364875a008f0d", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 147, "text": "胡果爭奔之，因發伏截其後，首尾進擊，大破之，斬首獲生以萬數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "e33201653e863b128ea63e291e19c17bec764500873c0ce8a8e94a40e346d519"}

{"id": "p_a86e47cdb6c79535", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 148, "text": "帝甚恱，詔曰：「卿踰河歷險，以勞擊逸，以寡勝衆，功過南仲，勤踰吉甫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "32c6ca3051b7c75c2b7823c7f57135fc087fda0f94b6ffac99b86f219197a49d"}

{"id": "p_b39bf11309a83630", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 149, "text": "此勳非但破胡，乃永寧河右，使吾長無西顧之念矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "2c14c43f77d80515d83d566b55c9be6c3f07d489a06e51d09e2d8466dc235061"}

{"id": "p_27d46bad2f47649e", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」徙封西鄉侯，增邑二百，並前四百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "ac8023cc6d966754a3ab2f07087ff135df290928e0c593bb6dab1fdc02323a34"}

{"id": "p_b88415b3fa1ca718", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 151, "text": "酒泉蘇衡反，與羌豪鄰戴及丁令胡萬餘騎攻邊縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "f23d88d35bb1c9ff77beb178e94498f235f50db4ac0f4e262ecdf28c91531eac"}

{"id": "p_eecd9ce918a709f0", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 152, "text": "旣與夏侯儒擊破之，衡及鄰戴等皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "dcbeac174345a07b644d5d5382cf27ffbaab2f11fd28cb74f1f252f42e6b0fbd"}

{"id": "p_70bc3f1e68f2d53b", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 153, "text": "遂上疏請與儒治左城，築鄣塞，置烽候、邸閣以備胡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "d80f33c6d10aa0ed918bf65b107a896e0125d09894e2356cbaa6f788c8e11aaf"}

{"id": "p_643a31e5da0273d8", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 154, "text": "西羌恐，率衆二萬餘落降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "610a260b4e71d6a4a348a07874cfaba1794336640c19fbfc5cfb23bfedfe962e"}

{"id": "p_03679959c145ffe8", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 155, "text": "其後西平麴光等殺其郡守，諸將欲擊之，旣曰：「唯光等造反，郡人未必悉同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "bfc2f2310da535dedb53840c0920a2f8ad421e36d7a0051dab0b8116e22e691c"}

{"id": "p_dac20eb2768fd6c5", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 156, "text": "若便以軍臨之，吏民羌胡必謂國家不別是非，更使皆相持著，此為虎傅翼也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "f717fe3e8a96dd0ba1a6c08cc63c3ace1b44effdcca65de5e381b05569cec71c"}

{"id": "p_25c4349d68c32354", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 157, "text": "光等欲以羌胡為援，今先使羌胡鈔擊，重其賞募，所虜獲者皆以畀之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "d731a7a758af03d4daf54fe862b27b63dbd79ae6d99362264ae218728a53f878"}

{"id": "p_e698bb7c81fa6e06", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 158, "text": "外沮其勢，內離其交，必不戰而定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "7af35ad70e1fdac99684317aa626fbc60aa432eab9829a1e0a5023213705d87b"}

{"id": "p_2fbc4fdab95b4aa2", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 159, "text": "」乃檄告諭諸羌，為光等所詿誤者原之；能斬賊帥送首者當加封賞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "0374aaba54b12f1a82c3fde299193b84d1cbeef3032c69c59e083a10b17dbcb3"}

{"id": "p_eaefe2803a0378f6", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 160, "text": "於是光部黨斬送光首，其餘咸安堵如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "2ff5fd7192af6222bfc192c203d3d9915fd95ea3d972006ceeeec51081a4fd80"}

{"id": "p_210ef00fed377af7", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 161, "text": "旣臨二州十餘年，政惠著聞，其所禮辟扶風龐延、天水楊阜、安定胡遵、酒泉龐淯、燉煌張恭、周生烈等，終皆有名位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "bd5a3437dce54c8f323aea2590b635cbf71deedb21e57005a0e4186920523128"}

{"id": "p_b5ae170300999a2c", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 162, "text": "詔曰：「昔荀桓子立勳翟土，晉侯賞以千室之邑；馮異輸力漢朝，光武封其二子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "7b55b21b34c416e24ed1a97c87905cd20de84507e00c6da7abcca3710334ff7c"}

{"id": "p_9f841b106d6335fc", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 163, "text": "故涼州刺史張旣，能容民畜衆，使羣羌歸土，可謂國之良臣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "3d4d00f98a0fd4c60df42a3ae2581839d0c3a2ba56c1efa744c73e6d0fdd2c6f"}

{"id": "p_06492c4cb74ff9f0", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 164, "text": "不幸薨隕，朕甚愍之，其賜小子翁歸爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "507943df050911860406bd40e84c44cfaa128b272094a7eb44854763bb9feb57"}

{"id": "p_36b534a2af920b28", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 165, "text": "」明帝即位，追謚曰肅侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "1013e09ef3101e352792b489377fdbe086e8d9cc357ec838c30e1cdf16d9589a"}

{"id": "p_6d766a8bd18e9f2d", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 166, "text": "緝以中書郎稍遷東莞太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "4882ee1454e94e6286efed92f7184151cbe08c3fbc501ff6b445598ba4ff40bd"}

{"id": "p_2fe0ba46fc270f7b", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 167, "text": "嘉平中，女為皇后，徵拜光祿大夫，位特進，封妻向為安城鄉君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "e047fb1cd1d2e6470aeb9e5642cb534eca2410a0e31429089df1a3a99162b06e"}

{"id": "p_854ccb9f90048125", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 168, "text": "緝與中書令李豐同謀，誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "d38394de21319f890a97da5fceb826b8a8a1645fbe81f6e7d8f3a434fcd705cc"}

{"id": "p_84aa6dadbcd23c78", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 169, "text": "溫恢字曼基，太原祁人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "1fa8de8dc3b7637e82c0cf48a734d9dc91992875c79f3f1d8f3c29d7bf0ad61f"}

{"id": "p_cfbf18d84cc05ca5", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 170, "text": "恢年十五，送丧還歸鄉里，内足於財。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "c073d83e8e154e971ae720b2a84b8cdfdb102cf4c140e035ed0bc3b779e96da1"}

{"id": "p_8d110bd5f5a461ca", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 171, "text": "恢曰：「世方亂，安以富爲？", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "ed36fcec2bca167ad45fd2de8e0f4f770402229362c4a2e6d721f43c7871b545"}

{"id": "p_cdc92270949f8ab4", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 172, "text": "舉孝廉，爲廪丘長，鄢陵、廣川令，彭城、鲁相，所在見稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "0977675e8f68187815ab4cbf04f050dbfa35674637ee9ea4fe15707d5cbdbcf3"}

{"id": "p_12b26432c2ec5832", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 173, "text": "入爲丞相主簿，出爲扬州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "6419ac25bacc6971a99aac8705be48d3419648ade28e4e4c1065bcf93f94d3fe"}

{"id": "p_59dd8aca09efda39", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 174, "text": "太祖曰：「甚欲使卿在親近，顾以爲不如此州事大。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "eb15eda96ecc555e0e4609cd68eb73eaf9b8235bb20b40f3ce09122d5f26dfd5"}

{"id": "p_0969cb01f7cde437", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 175, "text": "』得無當得蒋济爲治中邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "c7f12769dbc6ebf720fe69d8a9f9c730a0aab67656532cc7e5a6ff2f2a359f69"}

{"id": "p_09097e790c49b3d4", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 176, "text": "」時济見爲丹杨太守，乃遣济還州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "eda108c79eab24beca90b8ea37da26931948322b6bd70668774d5ca9fd3d7d4c"}

{"id": "p_12acde72eac0f616", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 177, "text": "又语張辽、乐進等曰：「扬州刺史晓達軍事，動静與共咨議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "bb6354ae7e5e79aab613e8dad3450223863110eb64d007a5c20e6f505babf337"}

{"id": "p_f7ef188e448d8ce4", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 178, "text": "，孫权攻合肥，是時諸州皆屯戍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "eb8c2034568d254605be5a89668763740550361982024a2ab1b91a72b12500c3"}

{"id": "p_718fe39fc9f1066c", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 179, "text": "恢謂兗州刺史裴潜曰：「此間雖有贼，不足憂，而畏征南方有變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "10e9d090f1c96189045ee985c7f8ee7e23fc97544793386c2f78c1d57c32f7aa"}

{"id": "p_30bba8aebe40c3b1", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 180, "text": "今水生而子孝縣軍，無有远備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "7838c8d5ae0cf8a2a997126fdd0b1435c36e080a603c0219957670f0aafa4d6d"}

{"id": "p_76756caa644b2593", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 181, "text": "關羽骁锐，乘利而進，必將爲患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "95e22ec9654554559396218483cfeb18d025fbde339e7a5f749362887aba1aa6"}

{"id": "p_5461f06a3c3799ad", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 182, "text": "詔書召潜及豫州刺史呂贡等，潜等缓之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "702de078cf7f4d2884edc0d493511d1041a33d64cb7cf7c0eb29f78968278c5d"}

{"id": "p_de076e1d154f235f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 183, "text": "恢密语潜曰：「此必襄陽之急欲赴之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "d187a7299dd6e817dcde5b74602d0b60cbb94a65312aec5407c82e0a2e54907a"}

{"id": "p_c9058874a6db8c55", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 184, "text": "所以不爲急會者，不欲惊動远眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "b3ea1315a565d519a6f8a51135342dbceb2582c4acf79946977f4b3a771fac55"}

{"id": "p_49d8161c031e2a2e", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 185, "text": "一二日必有密書促卿進道，張辽等又將被召。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "0d818455d2d9c27222fb7d8e268d2ce29c18d1ec2ed81d17dd3800b2eeb5045f"}

{"id": "p_e8cc910e63e57571", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 186, "text": "辽等素知王意，後召前至，卿受其责矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "b75e64512c9fb915e57afd10db2dac2e7abe2407e6ecab36e506943a2bc9ae43"}

{"id": "p_7899bc8c113596c5", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 187, "text": "」潜受其言，置辎重，更爲轻装速发，果被促令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "23f12544b192d38c71fbea010c13054139e9cc2a80fc0fdac90d40908de74cc9"}

{"id": "p_3a043b2ebf0298c8", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 188, "text": "辽等寻各見召，如恢所策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "9784e6a105379a2ca9509f5b7e8c7ac22a1fd501891a1f8d7a0abf7f50bcd997"}

{"id": "p_b405d86d7ba5d094", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 189, "text": "文帝践阼，以恢爲侍中，出爲魏郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "a983d8039c45a6486e75d54c3fa19b422cc6c820c4246b47ffa5f310f57c6618"}

{"id": "p_c2dbaae2b75b2b3a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 190, "text": "數年，遷凉州刺史，持节领护羌校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "18ea552fc80252b5f26281a1923afe138630ed9cbc8ef0c213cbce38d641c1ab"}

{"id": "p_52f8f1343c9bb4cb", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 191, "text": "詔曰：「恢有柱石之質，服事先帝，功勤明著。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "2d4c0a39605c7ffc844b585216cecfc401d182561b2f02a6280d8cadb2b253c7"}

{"id": "p_8efd413773d63603", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 192, "text": "及爲朕執事，忠於王室，故授之以萬里之任，任之以一方之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "31c8e0d0f30c47801adb09c6ac3b501152b708047082116c1d648fffc476275a"}

{"id": "p_2f23c58ebe0d752f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 193, "text": "恢卒後，汝南孟建爲凉州刺史，有治名，官至征東將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "a129d4cf937879a960031f14ffe7d0c196d17fc9e76a75b9b31ee67b85125b4d"}

{"id": "p_80e8716ad5a7fb63", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 194, "text": "贾逵字梁道，河東襄陵人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "ea84ad2cf830562bc10d8483c77740e496edb9f3de2512d7d7ae9e18888d4e54"}

{"id": "p_f1dd996ab106beea", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 195, "text": "自爲兒童，戲弄常設部伍，祖父習異之，曰：「汝大必爲將率。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "0ab398fcf13851e8934ca017361ab02a360690ea2ed1b3bb595eed27e8ce189e"}

{"id": "p_e152a6c4e14806d6", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 196, "text": "郭援之攻河東，所經城邑皆下，逵堅守，援攻之不拔，乃召單于並軍急攻之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "2a3fc372a304a47a7c35f918de5b75b2c3b37f11d526be5d51623db2d400f4c6"}

{"id": "p_771721193938e088", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 197, "text": "城將潰，絳父老與援要，不害逵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "0dbaeeace248912fa09c51c4b0388ea7d6b36c70186acab4a4b3a8e8af95ed47"}

{"id": "p_ab9d2f26a21ef040", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 198, "text": "絳人既潰，援聞逵名，欲使爲將，以兵劫之，逵不動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "f1888ca5bfc7397038810992b96ce73ab0c3c1db82bef9bf9d93a28069a97ab7"}

{"id": "p_d4ad041f9684acf5", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 199, "text": "左右引逵使叩头，逵叱之曰：「安有國家長吏爲賊叩頭！", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "ffd8c6268ee20256d7a3329a28afdedd4107b089e32ad0f1de3cfa6bce98dd60"}

{"id": "p_1c8633f7e0ebf38c", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 200, "text": "絳吏民聞將殺逵，皆乘城呼曰：「負要殺我賢君，寧俱死耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "2665273add3db777af68a2e3d5ac9d3ca8d911f95742757fe5f347cbe751a04c"}

{"id": "p_f74e9b46bad21ded", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 201, "text": "」左右義逵，多爲請，遂得免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "512e650205ae22e47f4dc98c0639f6543b50a5ba2564bf6982dd5ac5aa556a05"}

{"id": "p_42369afc2831eaa3", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 202, "text": "初，逵过皮氏，曰：「爭地先据者胜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "72b9d52ac321b64e6036faa242c1e03be060e91a8609d9695c7000b9547125e4"}

{"id": "p_676bf516dc425be3", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 203, "text": "」及圍怎，知不免，乃使人間行送印绶歸郡，且曰「急据皮氏」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "82ff46c7ebdc073774ca8bd2c71bcc52e5b3cd514edb8102535f9fdb4b1d3d25"}

{"id": "p_a60a40e02fd09e02", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 204, "text": "逵恐其先得皮氏，乃以他计疑援谋人祝奥，援由是留七日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "9f614828121d3aa684366023ae93a1057502513d3b552c420f09572de2c4bd5a"}

{"id": "p_2c6e0bb8d1bf43a2", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 205, "text": "高幹之反，張琰將舉兵以应之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "fd6fe32c7661941a68f0651368483921afdb5e1f6fc678920c2c976da185c62e"}

{"id": "p_f1f544d0aed5e835", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 206, "text": "聞變起，欲還，恐見執，乃爲琰画计，如與同谋者，琰信之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "7acfcdd89717381d37f02cc194b92eb2687032c2835d8f06bbe1a491751bde5b"}

{"id": "p_ced6996986278bad", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 207, "text": "時縣寄治蠡城，城堑不固，逵從琰求兵脩城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "812b0f0ee86d0907b9eef71d380e500f7e43c788b3abfee08b840d189e1a695f"}

{"id": "p_e3cdb2cce695cd3a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 208, "text": "諸欲爲亂者皆不隐其谋，故逵得尽诛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "0c0089e353c6d86bad7ba6635492c992b97b0c28b5c930c6bfa2babbc0972c9a"}

{"id": "p_f7c10bebfd7b021c", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 209, "text": "琰敗，逵以丧祖父去官，司徒辟爲掾，以議郎参司隶軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "6ad5bd5153b1c01f719c60b98a1b7778c8cbfedbedc33ce415cf04cb6e39af2a"}

{"id": "p_0c81341c603367b2", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 210, "text": "太祖征馬超，至弘农，曰「此西道之要」，以逵领弘农太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "61dc921f775ffdb0b0b9c14a819dd509ed118ea97e60c53513b9292fc8986480"}
