{"id": "p_3fda3ca9031cdb6f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 211, "text": "召見计事，大悦之，謂左右曰：「使天下二千石悉如贾逵，吾何憂？", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "169225aa56e92cad0bca2364e3266686363202eda2f28fed8cfff36142a82433"}

{"id": "p_b90d84e8c13d9132", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 212, "text": "」其後发兵，逵疑屯田都尉藏亡民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "cbbb7aec12edd5ec51510397ec41127974352b2ea7122b0bc857e8c17a0f64bf"}

{"id": "p_8f105cc3450e6929", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 213, "text": "都尉自以不屬郡，言语不顺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "bf3167c36c379cf132fa42f74d3e701bd9d54e0dc320d5bf3893fd284db6a016"}

{"id": "p_80109aa7f5489ad4", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 214, "text": "逵怒，收之，數以罪，挝折脚，坐免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "202e78432eac1aea917d8dbb9c96ff95115765b65a396f11c850d81403a11b89"}

{"id": "p_84751a7a11c8f62b", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 215, "text": "然太祖心善逵，以爲丞相主簿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "8710185eb039a6264797382f40a23a7eabdfccdb27f965383f9750f38b8799f1"}

{"id": "p_e7a8f18d52454132", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 216, "text": "太祖征刘備，先遣逵至斜谷觀形勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "972551715b5f2e5c51b47f1e88a9f427ddf262456ffeedad289ae8a0834ee421"}

{"id": "p_c3b35d50ddee9475", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 217, "text": "道逢水衡，载囚人數十车，逵以軍事急，辄竟重者一人，皆放其餘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "1c29a40019aa0fce2763bef8f67173936958162ad9b9e0f62cf72361d4264f7f"}

{"id": "p_962a08ffa51930be", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 218, "text": "太祖善之，拜谏議大夫，與夏侯尚並掌軍计。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "094eee13e00d07de968317b3517e61aac3720d8884493300736e0fac46cfdb24"}

{"id": "p_1f9602c9c13d48e0", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 219, "text": "時鄢陵侯彰行越骑將軍，從長安来赴，問逵先王玺绶所在。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "e43bd64a5f18fd54ffa58b2dc36be134ed6af5d1246784a2cfc987d976791aec"}

{"id": "p_05e7eca1aa31e549", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 220, "text": "逵正色曰：「太子在鄴，國有储副。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "a8c114ca2fcc14fc550066503542beb5fedaf65de6e7d5da8962e3a0aaddb334"}

{"id": "p_e73c6ba43d050db6", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 221, "text": "先王玺绶，非君侯所宜問也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "faff549023917d2a77fde2eb408e1c75ce847a547c5d43eccf44a50b56a6c0bf"}

{"id": "p_e1efc39d2c21488a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 222, "text": "文帝即王位，以鄴縣户數萬在都下，多不法，乃以逵爲鄴令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "e44d343113aebcf7292e1d695a1a59c95a73577e651efdceced813642b1d97a5"}

{"id": "p_dfde040cecde79dd", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 223, "text": "大軍出征，復爲丞相主簿祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "beee8a8871609ba84bd8432c2b09d6dedbce1786553f57d0dec2bb048a463a85"}

{"id": "p_dfc8465dd7fd0796", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 224, "text": "逵尝坐人爲罪，王曰：「叔向猶十世宥之，况逵功德親在其身乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "1056d614c9f2cb0f81da82587eebee7d4fd1512e2dbe81283d8d8f0d9929a49f"}

{"id": "p_9945c3ceb3d45838", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 225, "text": "」從至黎陽，津渡者亂行，逵斩之，乃整。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "ab84c462e80068b6ba64d46b45a64a66abedde325c51a7bec889e53c0af255e2"}

{"id": "p_332e18815194439f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 226, "text": "是時天下初復，州郡多不摄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "b1d874ad8cc6a0cfe239a681ef63ab144969e1d1c7d1399dc3771ee7d5f6ee0b"}

{"id": "p_4579a451dde98f58", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 227, "text": "逵曰：「州本以御史出監諸郡，以六条詔書察長吏二千石已下，故其狀皆言严能鹰扬有督察之才，不言安静寬仁有恺悌之德也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "f825268f3b4d326a28d834a2e6874554bc2c1137d42969898462ee1009b6c38a"}

{"id": "p_ee6a8419fe092711", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 228, "text": "今長吏慢法，盗贼公行，州知而不纠，天下復何取正乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "1b0878a99bc6178185dddf7cb01aa01cd5d06fd9353fd4278110ae2d65275c1f"}

{"id": "p_d2ef798d5ea4582d", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 229, "text": "」兵曹從事受前刺史假，逵到官數月，乃還；考竟其二千石以下阿縱不如法者，皆舉奏免之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "86866b043d50a95cf6e20f35c9e7498690d183dc06311db8e7a59bcf35807dbe"}

{"id": "p_8fdb795c3c45a28a", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 230, "text": "」布告天下，當以豫州爲法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "1ec574f6bbcb100752e630bb8f9043676d04cff6d1a72066ebcb29a2506f91b6"}

{"id": "p_aaeb91cd4eba0085", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 231, "text": "州南與吳接，逵明斥候，缮甲兵，爲守戰之備，贼不敢犯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "406040bad430572f3e9af104aaf6189c7916860e933ce472e8141f148adce383"}

{"id": "p_853f5d9ed89f0dfe", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 232, "text": "外修軍旅，内治民事，遏鄢、汝，造新陂，又断山溜長谿水，造小弋陽陂，又通运渠二百餘里，所謂贾侯渠者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "84c89ea556154bed25189266b4e61ec86c718ef2eeb09b2049ba8da1ed3d6ea6"}

{"id": "p_286c361a3fcebcce", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 233, "text": "黄初中，與諸將並征吳，破呂范於洞浦，進封陽里亭侯，加建威將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "d37295e671634dd8ad5e55f79ca27c837faa1fb5d53420e6fc6ed5a1634c5538"}

{"id": "p_82b212d2aa49258b", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 234, "text": "明帝即位，增邑二百户，並前四百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "3395526468fa2d0f469e9a7dff535c77fd24c5014a1eff90ba9d35c08bc5058a"}

{"id": "p_d9c3162d000e15e9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 235, "text": "時孫权在東關，當豫州南，去江四百餘里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "dfc7617986c02763762ea38260139ce84325f83bae28da4b7c35e0cb1108f731"}

{"id": "p_b50d4ae00d1e086f", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 236, "text": "每出兵爲寇，辄西從江夏，東從庐江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "3c5c53fd0ab00afc122a0ddfe2065747f497799776fa257d36f491690a342924"}

{"id": "p_6aa688f42f287f00", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 237, "text": "是時州軍在项，汝南、弋陽諸郡，守境而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "49f7a8d397bb080ad674e92be6cfcbd742a9dcf9a2facbc1e3150733559ee0c8"}

{"id": "p_475cce25de0646b6", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 238, "text": "权無北方之虞，東西有急，並軍相救，故常少敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "93cc9fa0d212e826bfd2b424b3134dfbf7b5b81839430ee4ccbbacdfd0b50130"}

{"id": "p_7f45ddb4e577fb99", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 239, "text": "逵以爲宜開直道临江，若权自守，則二方無救；若二方無救，則東關可取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "5a991f6e92cfbc2604f84b09fb6677a7affba0486b81a7f39186d66afeeb2c29"}

{"id": "p_bbecf7e610c8f6f7", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 240, "text": "乃移屯潦口，陳攻取之计，帝善之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "3ef8b6e4b1e62fe3e7149589a68a2be85038e5566c8a08dcd9156aa2e8ef356b"}

{"id": "p_a8be53ebc193211b", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 241, "text": "，帝使逵督前將軍满宠、東莞太守胡質等四軍，從西陽直向東關，曹休從皖，司馬宣王從江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "27701ccb1ed29aaa74df4bd7721eaf733c5f3e98eb7bddee8b2f162bd21618b9"}

{"id": "p_c672ccb59b99a411", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 242, "text": "逵至五將山，休更表贼有请降者，求深入应之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "fdd693c8eacba97afd660c92c5e8383de45cece24299b59caf96189de748d078"}

{"id": "p_b4df917cfc1a0b61", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 243, "text": "詔宣王驻軍，逵東與休合進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "1f27beeb8e8da391fcdeeeef23ed03d9e2dab353ce38c3eebb7288dd19c9197f"}

{"id": "p_366ff5cb3dae4c94", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 244, "text": "逵度贼無東關之備，必並軍於皖；休深入與贼戰，必敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "a97e56deaf4a8ef86a080f466bd704fa5943a72290a2bb602cab9e69ada62a0b"}

{"id": "p_9d160eb1417c5a89", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 245, "text": "乃部署諸將，水陆並進，行二百里，得生贼，言休戰敗，权遣兵断夹石。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "30027213506a997b57208d4b97f19fa8fbacf5b67ca839c12f63d85a178213e8"}

{"id": "p_6479b5c8ea3b5138", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 246, "text": "諸將不知所出，或欲待後軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "5961554c89368d914a4988cbe02bf7fecb7500274a850e042c572a5bc96ebcf2"}

{"id": "p_c4084d1b0b645b03", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 247, "text": "逵曰：「休兵敗於外，路絕於内，進不能戰，退不得還，安危之機，不及終日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "e10bfd5ae96fd3a986f7b9b8e261e64e2e8f69d448745764dc65f9267f573963"}

{"id": "p_6ab45afaa6d56819", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 248, "text": "贼以軍無後继，故至此；今疾進，出其不意，此所謂先人以奪其心也，贼見吾兵必走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "194f2c5b897b0b671f3cf3a49c075273cce363007043cf9c5d63287196638243"}

{"id": "p_1dcb47e25bfd0166", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 249, "text": "若待後軍，贼已断險，兵雖多何益！", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "44608d65ab875e22d4e479dd58255b64b3c807d424416cd54135eefad6ea81ab"}

{"id": "p_5636431d2684b7f4", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 250, "text": "」乃兼道進軍，多設旗鼓爲疑兵，贼見逵軍，遂退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "43fcf0e1725effd94764d6a52bad955f4f8e1b42a51c2844769cb6712324b450"}

{"id": "p_76868169ac5690f5", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 251, "text": "逵据夹石，以兵粮给休，休軍乃振。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "af44647ceeb5f339c5d70d92f69767e3d5d4672d17d4546953116c0fee6c6545"}

{"id": "p_a2e6c127b36b4ab9", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 252, "text": "黄初中，文帝欲假逵节，休曰：「逵性刚，素侮易諸將，不可爲督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "498e1b2c5269c858174f93e4ad19955e8f321bc4917915de09257a235afc7470"}

{"id": "p_06fc4147288297f7", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 253, "text": "及夹石之敗，微逵，休軍幾無救也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "913ec6d0aa0942139a4979f07878fb4e64f69fd921d251132078a6d149b71824"}

{"id": "p_c7e99676d03846af", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 254, "text": "會病笃，謂左右曰：「受國厚恩，恨不斩孫权以下見先帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "b714d7789963215e22c843d1aeb1910380679987db660eb49d4c2706d36a4a98"}

{"id": "p_2d1963a23e620fb2", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 255, "text": "豫州吏民追思之，爲刻石立祠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "c4c5f6ed3de9ea7eae4e272c4050deeb9470814a32f96f500ce73a4d08b3e757"}

{"id": "p_b8df1f4f9ddfbe73", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 256, "text": "青龙中，帝東征，乘辇入逵祠，詔曰：「昨过项，見贾逵碑像，念之怆然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "45faac68a2481c3dc056e1d95c4710b7608c9886e153880fac184536531c992d"}

{"id": "p_8eae35e4070a03c4", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 257, "text": "古人有言，患名之不立，不患年之不長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "b987511c8dc7ed2e386b3e7c97d24280ed1198a6a0c0d7a575e8baff0fdb4b27"}

{"id": "p_a0b231f9b6c69bea", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 258, "text": "逵存有忠勋，没而見思，可謂死而不朽者矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "7ca06da18f09087724db202532b8c306eb8f135edad8ba045cd3d86a34b88403"}

{"id": "p_43862a14cc31bbe3", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 259, "text": "评曰：自漢季以来，刺史總統諸郡，賦政于外，非若曩時司察之而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "088cc3c86f539c16958a90881096efdb2902575c26d07fd65115503229498c43"}

{"id": "p_e6a1f510fd72ac20", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 260, "text": "太祖創基，迄終魏業，此皆其流稱誉有名實者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "051680414ad3a07eeb2f7f121c955c9348ff2e0fc2c2491a33013a0589371546"}

{"id": "p_469e0b8ceb3b21a5", "source_id": "src_ed2a5c2e7de42014", "ordinal": 261, "text": "咸精達事機，威恩兼著，故能肅齊萬里，見述於後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "c662cea3ff49321322a290b84ccd6d0cd2fb3d1c4037783a79d9fcbe8446ede8"}

{"id": "p_b7499e0bfaed6636", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 0, "text": "任峻字伯达，河南中牟人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "f6d6c7a716c78ade6370c95a7c9b5a9c9f2a0b1fdd6f2d0500d4c84d63bad4cc"}

{"id": "p_7d6043d332b11d7f", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 1, "text": "中牟令杨原愁恐，欲弃官走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "da7e8fb195af95fe49731594eeac96b34e5ec006d05cff525ff765b0a73f76a9"}

{"id": "p_5547b20c9f0b0ae7", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 2, "text": "峻说原曰：“董卓首乱，天下莫不侧目，然而未有先发者，非无其心也，势未敢耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "2dae12f70fa8d7c191c226cf8dfaeb15d90402470e505e0ff91caccdbf35df4a"}

{"id": "p_d0426ae256e1898f", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 3, "text": "明府若能唱之，必有和者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "2c93d069fea60d94bb7c4c84dfb6187dff9b0b1f7db1b83bb7c3b804ae795795"}

{"id": "p_30924e721f6103e8", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 4, "text": "”峻曰：“今关东有十餘县，能胜兵者不减万人，若权行河南尹事，总而用之，无不济矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "9ca1d4fd717df2d96e26a6c9ed5db5a61cfab529188c5dadfd30baa54e60e61f"}

{"id": "p_2c14153b734d6327", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 5, "text": "”原从其计，以峻为主簿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "ee1e321d8d0ffe81c1bc2c339e6bab3e78539cc14cbe4687e6e84d5b6bc785b0"}

{"id": "p_3536ab78c7a3b0c9", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 6, "text": "峻乃为原表行尹事，使诸县坚守，遂发兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "0e19ac6ef5478621d056bd9bb4db79e865ab5a4d5e3d01939bfbf4cc3723aff5"}

{"id": "p_58328c59e7d709ca", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 7, "text": "会太祖起关东，入中牟界，众不知所从，峻独与同郡张奋议，举郡以归太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "cdf734fb6a3ffe3e4e5ed2f436c9f0a767f56dbca665ffc12659a8bd003de1e7"}

{"id": "p_c17b7c1f1b27e04e", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 8, "text": "峻又别收宗族及宾客家兵数百人，原从太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "c0e2022e001838eb0d18ffafc63f054faa15000804a22ec23ac0aa00d264f6d0"}

{"id": "p_882f2ef1a329bc04", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 9, "text": "太祖大悦，表峻为骑都尉，妻以从妹，甚见亲信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "5c5d576801c469c849578e2f61421041bc6461e9e2c44bda7304afde7c583b7a"}

{"id": "p_ab2d59ea4e1b0945", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 10, "text": "太祖每征伐，峻常居守以给军。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "d5d5f41d5b50b1015920386d4b34852671b09fdce9c2878603803df5d2374b13"}

{"id": "p_f2aad763fcab9c68", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 11, "text": "是时岁饥旱，军食不足，羽林监颍川枣祗建置屯田，太祖以峻为典农中郎将，募百姓屯田於许下，得谷百万斛，郡国列置田官，数年中所在积粟，仓廪皆满。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "41f7659f74088d1b939a9dcb4212bc36643ad790bbc441fcd9e1c96e8fa21109"}

{"id": "p_80bad8a11b27299e", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 12, "text": "官渡之战，太祖使峻典军器粮运。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "2d5cf6b2a105642c8c6cf15fbb05190b856598ee7047dc761d6a4aaae30a74ac"}

{"id": "p_bb8a890457eca5a1", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 13, "text": "贼数寇钞绝粮道，乃使千乘为一部，十道方行，为複陈以营卫之，贼不敢近。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "1e2e67eb4153992ea5777a88a84ddec94370dfaf17fc9040fc42104292846490"}

{"id": "p_0e31465ac08d4947", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 14, "text": "军国之饶，起於枣祗而成於峻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "3aa5cf3c077376019d28fb64964020d920d314077292103ab6e70ee29dc6bdb3"}

{"id": "p_ba2dfe2ae7d97ba6", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 15, "text": "太祖以峻功高，乃表封为都亭侯，邑三百户，迁长水校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "8a8e7bd01e69ea1fb205c7dc271ad8a9b691de8f9eee74f3b854c6974b777666"}

{"id": "p_2986a5d24074a698", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 16, "text": "峻宽厚有度而见事理，每有所陈，太祖多善之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "176865f01fdb769b3ae8c4733a3fdf64d9fbd4c2bfe4487a3d35cb8da69ff100"}

{"id": "p_1906de50dfba4d70", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 17, "text": "於饥荒之际，收恤朋友孤遗，中外贫宗，周急继乏，信义见称。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "c0bbcb1f089fe9333ded703c6abcd2591dcce86a6ca8e1d419b0b8b4a040e418"}

{"id": "p_3e0426209c926f4b", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 18, "text": "文帝追录功臣，谥峻曰成侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "59bc95b8342950275aa205d71359e880a047f75253d7a72fda15bdfaf6490a98"}

{"id": "p_e708669773e7563b", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 19, "text": "苏则字文师，扶风武功人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "da609f3dbd7204c049eb0cac137acf619dc5b182be037fff97e7a33529c3a8ac"}

{"id": "p_f4e9de04d82bb2fe", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 20, "text": "少以学行闻，举孝廉茂才，辟公府，皆不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "f64a583112bc40b702a0c087b736b40fc418996bd77378dbf1e5a2d6084391ef"}

{"id": "p_629d93e1860894f2", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 21, "text": "起家为酒泉太守，转安定、武都，所在有威名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "980aab66b84bc328b2be331f0ec5425add36a0e93fb4bd6879bdc7a630743d16"}

{"id": "p_4231f66c282fe728", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 22, "text": "太祖征张鲁，过其郡，见则悦之，使为军导。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "aa75ae0991c62f24c2ca9ba9acd105d99f5f57578eb95d36e337065bd2d48b6f"}

{"id": "p_c90cf43b59d588e1", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 23, "text": "鲁破，则绥定下辩诸氐，通河西道，徙为金城太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "b5802ad95af3a799aba575c1a828b3cec2d46de4a80e73825fabc2a1b3f3a14d"}

{"id": "p_92b389f585ec5048", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 24, "text": "是时丧乱之后，吏民流散饥穷，户口损耗，则抚循之甚谨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "8f4dc472ff08fb13cffaf9bb9f7334c18c45cb9956c514060259a3b8a8a7dedb"}

{"id": "p_ab74ebfeac5fc3b7", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 25, "text": "外招怀羌胡，得其牛羊，以养贫老。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "f254efeac6011a821a22b60576462dc305a7921489ce498a9466943b7015b69b"}

{"id": "p_37e76ca3320963d0", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 26, "text": "与民分粮而食，旬月之间，流民皆归，得数千家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "0d91ee0ace1baf6ce9c2d1b780becbf50851532a8900624f280b9093d8c13520"}

{"id": "p_330cf39b5f669c09", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 27, "text": "乃明为禁令，有干犯者辄戮，其从教者必赏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "d88861626d759ae5fee2cf4a26a4cf4682122966d52ff0eac4279ae4c3217b3b"}

{"id": "p_b3ea83733b94bb83", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 28, "text": "亲自教民耕种，其岁大丰收，由是归附者日多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "df057a8bb4f8d77688028655130c40d18d79b568dc2c243f09c1d7bcf8fcb022"}

{"id": "p_d6dd371fc071104a", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 29, "text": "李越以陇西反，则率羌胡围越，越即请服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "7c30ac6d2e91ffcef38b7f105fb2662af40767283665c34c49c23bb81c21f22e"}

{"id": "p_070a8ab6a8fa2053", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 30, "text": "太祖崩，西平麹演叛，称护羌校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "0849d4442a697215558a189d910c6465e044b5520317d991e43fbcf0032dc017"}

{"id": "p_df21f79b91a97d96", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 31, "text": "文帝以其功，加则护羌校尉，赐爵关内侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "9a55713d50387d39955713260ec6400d7939cdf86a3d9ec37da820e78b371238"}

{"id": "p_322c8a95fd6b9166", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 32, "text": "后演复结旁郡为乱，张掖张进执太守杜通，酒泉黄华不受太守辛机，进、华皆自称太守以应之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "e8510e4745fb14a2d08c4b19cb60ba590ea305d68410d60a179f67d393024b52"}

{"id": "p_ede2ccb6f1ef45c1", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 33, "text": "又武威三种胡并寇钞，道路断绝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "1c10cf03413aca9ac2ebea2aecba2c859910a11df77ab23444229d698899aff5"}

{"id": "p_689dbc9c524e14aa", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 34, "text": "武威太守毌丘兴告急於则。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "e59b983bf91b6789fe19358cfe3b7e224a21f741deb8477b5b451b3f2342249f"}

{"id": "p_cd505060098077f7", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 35, "text": "时雍、凉诸豪皆驱略羌胡以从进等，郡人咸以为进不可当。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "19af0141718a833d04c1746cb200b959558693073eedb0da761283a4171cd162"}

{"id": "p_018f52c8a3d159d5", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 36, "text": "又将军郝昭、魏平先是各屯守金城，亦受诏不得西度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "b673718cd8c5150ed33ab1054d6273bf3b6f074d38d03ab7b4f008a6f76457ec"}

{"id": "p_e4f7148d76617a83", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 37, "text": "则乃见郡中大吏及昭等与羌豪帅谋曰：“今贼虽盛，然皆新合，或有胁从，未必同心；因衅击之，善恶必离，离而归我，我增而彼损矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "7af3c5cb12314bf2c00d2333d8f850cc124b0801c5f5b837b53e999f2425ba2f"}

{"id": "p_cad8401e2994cb6e", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 38, "text": "既获益众之实，且有倍气之势，率以进讨，破之必矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "fb909ae613b6651d577a15be08b38148d82a69d9fd63da2b98aec960df324049"}

{"id": "p_47e7178a2e672d88", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 39, "text": "若待大军，旷日持久，善人无归，必合於恶，善恶既合，势难卒离。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "0326239a9888e34cd34081b9608c9b213e5e8330f119c88e3b763ed004664c09"}

{"id": "p_830d73987522902a", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 40, "text": "虽有诏命，违而合权，专之可也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "807466905aa3771d44b0b53997bb33ee1e39283f1614846dbdd554e97d7994a9"}

{"id": "p_955827a73de2dc20", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 41, "text": "”於是昭等从之，乃发兵救武威，降其三种胡，与兴击进於张掖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "ea0b9980345b37142f92361c544676b3a3dfb8fcbd8d502351228193e2c5889f"}

{"id": "p_ee4189146d02bd67", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 42, "text": "演闻之，将步骑三千迎则，辞来助军，而实欲为变。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "20d21233728cc11254a5ba1389b77779d6bba8bd0290a82b61a764156875f74c"}

{"id": "p_567426faf0cddeb8", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 43, "text": "则诱与相见，因斩之，出以徇军，其党皆散走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "1350e4484cc5946633e504edb2ef5cf92bc1d7c67873e298634a01a581919772"}

{"id": "p_967695689df3bf5b", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 44, "text": "则遂与诸军围张掖，破之，斩进及其支党，众皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "194094b4924ed2fa450bd53f454b091f6f10eae9d10be2d21879b89d75c62500"}

{"id": "p_6fe7b0337d7d5532", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 45, "text": "演军败，华惧，出所执乞降，河西平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "b57f17224a707bbebaa8272797822488eec00a59db5cc0fec29afc71a442fe2a"}

{"id": "p_57cfbfbe3d147520", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 46, "text": "昭尝枕则膝卧，则推下之，曰：“苏则之膝，非佞人之枕也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "297b603173227d0be4386ece2eb471c31401a6775058d61e8753e7e5c034d862"}

{"id": "p_f4c710eda88ed15c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 47, "text": "”初，则及临菑侯植闻魏氏代汉，皆发服悲哭，文帝闻植如此，而不闻则也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "b56213fad1f186cfa594cb55b6cd6d31382be57c9779793d9f32c87545b61bc4"}

{"id": "p_558edf38c85e7e28", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 48, "text": "帝在洛阳，尝从容言曰：“吾应天而禅，而闻有哭者，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "5ce1acdaa100de739f49b2c414457e18e0b1a6a4ba83f7c046cce4a604c8852d"}

{"id": "p_794ddb6fb85536a6", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 49, "text": "”则谓为见问，须髯悉张，欲正论以对。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "f5a0009553aa4b089b9525311e043fa82f4614ad812866030c3aa3ddbb2b44dd"}

{"id": "p_8fe961c3d7025e72", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 50, "text": "侍中傅巽掐则曰：“不谓卿也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "fd8e1ea0ad82d30404c4dcea247ae930cea02696cbd9926b86736aafb804e333"}

{"id": "p_4893e6d174eee052", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 51, "text": "文帝问则曰：“前破酒泉、张掖，西域通使，敦煌献径寸大珠，可复求市益得不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "58ce7a2237fb52b748f17df31286c3d4062646112aae3a37c81b449519647e21"}

{"id": "p_c578e14cabdb9a65", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 52, "text": "”则对曰：“若陛下化洽中国，德流沙漠，即不求自至；求而得之，不足贵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "e1d0e976482c691078a936917d08632a3d50be8e1560bc667ef959c8582cbb4c"}

{"id": "p_ac8c56f8c51a7416", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 53, "text": "后则从行猎，槎桎拔，失鹿，帝大怒，踞胡床拔刀，悉收督吏，将斩之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "8946c58503e296407272846bbd582acae3bb0b4ba7d9b57c00045cae8b39fe55"}

{"id": "p_7db1ed70eed43ffe", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 54, "text": "则稽首曰：“臣闻古之圣王不以禽兽害人，今陛下方隆唐尧之化，而以猎戏多杀群吏，愚臣以为不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "df9633f86652888e0721cd78177536e466d2e73a829dfb9aa67f5bbc1653ebaf"}

{"id": "p_2fb5b839823e6cfd", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 55, "text": "未至，道病薨，谥曰刚侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "064e8ca56c3c231c5d875fcd8fda4e264ac11b2274633fd455d3bfe1db4a05a2"}

{"id": "p_ef29b2debc0059a5", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 56, "text": "杜畿字伯侯，京兆杜陵人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "7225dddc29c83dddc6dc0223b17dc7130305bcc4627e7c351f2fe6b4e7a8aea5"}

{"id": "p_98db7d31cf5192b1", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 57, "text": "少孤，继母苦之，以孝闻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "23f96ad58f43871d061904cfa17e0f4ffb243ec42aa39c02d20ffe21e2aef38f"}

{"id": "p_e2e2e79e1d451efc", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 58, "text": "年二十，为郡功曹，守郑县令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "9cd088041cb8656a45c0b3bb684876b0e7f1ab4f8d064f002e72a19d7e339e31"}

{"id": "p_bc2cb555648b0e27", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 59, "text": "县囚系数百人，畿亲临狱，裁其轻重，尽决遣之，虽未悉当，郡中奇其年少而有大意也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "e5b67b7c4e8d5be2ed6bbd76a86dec4a558236c98f8de4eeba4c399b1322ca49"}

{"id": "p_32cf0a84b59acf97", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 60, "text": "会天下乱，遂弃官客荆州，建安中乃还。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "faebd60d1f2cd2dbd84ba083898b07c5ee2c2c32e0d1c8886e75ab1043366577"}

{"id": "p_52d464d64f38b62e", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 61, "text": "荀彧进之太祖，太祖以畿为司空司直，迁护羌校尉，使持节，领西平太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "e727a33a63743fed629775aed7eb165658d6fd9a1163a4e0095fa4907017397f"}

{"id": "p_a8d469a5740738f5", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 62, "text": "太祖既定河北，而高幹举并州反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "4a87c8f6924e7be3addf445e301f3a39a452ea2e7c9593616e3c603735940cb2"}

{"id": "p_845d78bfab46cc9b", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 63, "text": "时河东太守王邑被徵，河东人卫固、范先外以请邑为名，而内实与幹通谋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "b6c691ca7c1c6ab85291b0b4de359ceb9f55425c66e3e8ada7059abe473777ed"}

{"id": "p_d95204e08b96d099", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 64, "text": "太祖谓荀彧曰：“关西诸将，恃险与马，征必为乱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "0d8f4bb97042a629da6c8ae5a5c38c56988f95d0d677ab9dde2c8d0797a72d59"}

{"id": "p_a928008702d51dfc", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 65, "text": "张晟寇殽、渑间，南通刘表，固等因之，吾恐其为害深。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "241b0104f1ca55d8d200b80711a17fca350b34b1bdf5bd11c5f151a5c7247386"}

{"id": "p_bf783f90160c1d2c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 66, "text": "河东被山带河，四邻多变，当今天下之要地也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "507765a58d0a89b4201fcf245c042071aeea70e505a35128dda912d221072431"}

{"id": "p_0bb2393428ad61e0", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 67, "text": "君为我举萧何、寇恂以镇之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "e716e9646475bb92ee5963c6f44013eebdb508d078302d3784d46e4240d85be0"}

{"id": "p_dc4badb68574f724", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 68, "text": "”於是追拜畿为河东太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "0594ffea754cdc19f59d0d3c60d5c9c554e7f8d364f66fcb556a093d990ca14d"}

{"id": "p_91e5bd509bde95d1", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 69, "text": "固等使兵数千人绝陕津，畿至不得渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "6977a1a350d89a25410a875d4f510952de23506674d9318954fde24693a1d154"}

{"id": "p_df757c10912441f6", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 70, "text": "太祖遣夏侯惇讨之，未至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "fb634cf12d2c207945f9e310d6cd7e7a6e393a4f990ac6e4e77fafe4c532cc56"}

{"id": "p_543f4de56a6c039a", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 71, "text": "”畿曰：“河东有三万户，非皆欲为乱也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "1c832f3844dc9443c476ae6554df1c6a201bdad43baf01d1c4a7d5f1b4c9758e"}

{"id": "p_d8a1c76391ed97e4", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 72, "text": "今兵迫之急，欲为善者无主，必惧而听於固。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "0d24e0a705772f0457e40723eeb6c04fb0f808ed74bdf521b69a27cf142a6fdb"}

{"id": "p_419f88f075662c70", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 73, "text": "讨之不胜，四邻应之，天下之变未息也；讨之而胜，是残一郡之民也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "ab0166ec266828fa8d9d891639601c83e7be51eef18eb98d99a410b8e4eb3eb4"}

{"id": "p_f0e7af65a28dc27d", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 74, "text": "且固等未显绝王命，外以请故君为名，必不害新君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "eaf2f784c2ad924168766b3da35fa94f092de621b0b0b5df80b076713d61e53c"}

{"id": "p_9eeed9d4382336b3", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 75, "text": "固为人多计而无断，必伪受吾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "9c5f8948d992606060be2bcc30cdd832675f9a6a1548db941ca3944347d7258f"}

{"id": "p_5c59c1640d32bd42", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 76, "text": "吾得居郡一月，以计縻之，足矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "90a052d077bd27f939f3319b8250e6612cdf006f1b1b189832d3ccbdfed0bdbd"}

{"id": "p_b169254c1c710414", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 77, "text": "且观畿去就，於门下斩杀主簿已下三十餘人，畿举动自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "1c62517606a27b2470d2e824680f376fff7ac0abafcbc604c8edf0a9b6a7d16f"}

{"id": "p_4a3b66eaa6614575", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 78, "text": "於是固曰：“杀之无损，徒有恶名；且制之在我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "c761cd28da95bc6d4fabf01b5b74b5d8edb748f6992a47d03dbb5a44b296adc1"}

{"id": "p_406eaed2531a5ba5", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 79, "text": "畿谓卫固、范先曰：“卫、范，河东之望也，吾仰成而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "5ac8549187711aca702f0bf0ff6f12f97aaff601ac3d508199e8cb2cdfe9a0c7"}

{"id": "p_a0191aa9a188cb99", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 80, "text": "然君臣有定义，成败同之，大事当共平议。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "e97c631998c1e5dcedf872149b1a7202423ea74b5674fd174b2f3305bfeb9e60"}

{"id": "p_731fbefa238e208f", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 81, "text": "”以固为都督，行丞事，领功曹；将校吏兵三千餘人，皆范先督之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "558bbcc3f115cb7f26275d8a80d7721942b914e73e69a18ecae685e45a77764e"}

{"id": "p_9978006bbeb13a61", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 82, "text": "固等喜，虽阳事畿，不以为意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "b010f7c0e91db1f1e4c6f42c4aa6d069a71a90fa1fc23c09e69fe9571f95959c"}

{"id": "p_8e7c5f6e2727d19a", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 83, "text": "固欲大发兵，畿患之，说固曰：“夫欲为非常之事，不可动众心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "c0c119050cf0bef29904714eb56ccec6d484dfcf579fd2d3d7c8fdfcacf4e121"}

{"id": "p_84a69ce8df37f7c8", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 84, "text": "今大发兵，众必扰，不如徐以赀募兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "e3740b3e92563ca786fec38c89e6291c5d5e2447bcd1b0f8ff9545d530732075"}

{"id": "p_59f153fd098b2091", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 85, "text": "”固以为然，从之，遂为赀调发，数十日乃定，诸将贪多应募而少遣兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "20bada644f1746b7a1d28c064d9b853bd317c9a2698f6d2099ad3a2247deced9"}

{"id": "p_d50fcdb71b27c17e", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 86, "text": "又入喻固等曰：“人情顾家，诸将掾吏，可分遣休息，急缓召之不难。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "37a20b684352e78189481cf4297eaef3a113cfb0daca2405c95e393bac985a8d"}

{"id": "p_943dda3dc796b2b9", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 87, "text": "”固等恶逆众心，又从之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "513985a313ca97179a9700dfd163610f3b04f621ebf3f9b8435d196a9ce0492a"}

{"id": "p_fe4360dac436d4fa", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 88, "text": "於是善人在外，阴为己援；恶人分散，各还其家，则众离矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "51ca8410669fe6528577485a5edac8b8cb99be307718163e67e5ef8885592885"}

{"id": "p_2311e6bd2f0148b0", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 89, "text": "会白骑攻东垣，高幹入濩泽，上党诸县杀长吏，弘农执郡守，固等密调兵未至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "bd9f8518b1ea66512a3a0ccf7fee1ba33c9586969f1ba3649c8b7e4c762f6d3d"}

{"id": "p_b78bb230878f5073", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 90, "text": "畿知诸县附己，因出，单将数十骑，赴张辟拒守，吏民多举城助畿者，比数十日，得四千餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "8bea5bf0745d9a49b06f5370a8385067dad4bfa52a984bee0f7a1928323e8c51"}

{"id": "p_94b444116216eba4", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 91, "text": "固等与幹、晟共攻畿，不下，略诸县，无所得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "7db86475fc9d1c5ab2913b8bfa884347ed0a3b2d3996c688c67f117a972cf1ca"}

{"id": "p_5eae5abf0304c9cc", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 92, "text": "会大兵至，幹、晟败，固等伏诛，其餘党与皆赦之，使复其居业。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "d5700db357391a0708e1f676fcc8b8bcf3d9a7797049a51bf09050d21772d432"}

{"id": "p_4ca073438c6c2109", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 93, "text": "是时天下郡县皆残破，河东最先定，少耗减。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "e64c1e2f406297a2a43f3bc486c91699e58ee3b15cab17b1ec4e22b39527c51b"}

{"id": "p_578946b7f0f66a4b", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 94, "text": "畿治之，崇宽惠，与民无为。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "a0ab9df566ccc395e294e9d341902ccd1cfe31505f93c72fe4bb95db1e864426"}

{"id": "p_764bdcbf28b7712c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 95, "text": "民尝辞讼，有相告者，畿亲见为陈大义，遣令归谛思之，若意有所不尽，更来诣府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "473226cb28d3a0d7aa07bc6530d38ec47ad56d5b2e4b869eda46aa896960369d"}

{"id": "p_f42887ac086ef5c6", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 96, "text": "乡邑父老自相责怒曰：“有君如此，奈何不从其教？", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "def53dd07a9faa6d834105dc0ca89e07c24b4f9ade637ff63e3be59f66c9d9ac"}

{"id": "p_4ad6f3b4c7610085", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 97, "text": "班下属县，举孝子、贞妇、顺孙，复其繇役，随时慰勉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "8e4f84f2afdea4ae3f7a8bb022b322984a35d8fbed1543d14106086a15aa31ed"}

{"id": "p_896a75cfb27d5cc9", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 98, "text": "渐课民畜牸牛、草马，下逮鸡豚犬豕，皆有章程。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "3c05f618a8d49b317b85e8b47bfc5998399835178dc604726a37e4e5917626b8"}

{"id": "p_3b6ad70707f394fb", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 99, "text": "畿乃曰：“民富矣，不可不教也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "4ab74be2fe88599c56f5d73469648c1d7f54c4ba5e52fbf59363653645e24e7f"}

{"id": "p_845942d574423182", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 100, "text": "”於是冬月修戎讲武，又开学宫，亲自执经教授，郡中化之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "2788fa08b3bb083b160333d800955a1f8c6975a7118a47a977aa796a09bd9765"}

{"id": "p_75cef50275958eb5", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 101, "text": "韩遂、马超之叛也，弘农、冯翊多举县邑以应之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "198eeef25d9f72d87a5264481489a3cde5850f6239d4a180aae23f81fe900095"}

{"id": "p_a2e33212ed766a63", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 102, "text": "河东虽与贼接，民无异心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "55bbc2c43a1958027c5055e19020f684ac8be698f59c839c8d2a172dda6fe879"}

{"id": "p_a724be14fa2ccd4f", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 103, "text": "太祖西征至蒲阪，与贼夹渭为军，军食一仰河东。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "2dcbb08f7de3354bc2e2f801ad8052728a7302a0bf3d531db29c87d5f452e84d"}

{"id": "p_2b6df81854cf2319", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 104, "text": "及贼破，餘畜二十餘万斛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "0ef08baf0979010f18ac05d34e5381d6109d299323e7400702a472b105cfebfc"}

{"id": "p_1c423c0a0f602360", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 105, "text": "太祖下令曰：“河东太守杜畿，孔子所谓‘禹，吾无间然矣’。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "37abc2a827b7bd062f01c0b5ad308b2f0e33e2b3bc54084ee823530562a06fa4"}

{"id": "p_696df2aea45922ee", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 106, "text": "”太祖征汉中，遣五千人运，运者自率勉曰：“人生有一死，不可负我府君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "a1a5d2412c34280c34e889b583f625cd4757399a58da49bed21aa4150104e1dc"}

{"id": "p_53ec52c8b28bb604", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 107, "text": "”终无一人逃亡，其得人心如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "a80a5419806d00f947ecd08c4552a450b6463cea299c14e99b25569946fb6986"}

{"id": "p_1fc6a744fa958202", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 108, "text": "事平，更有令曰：“昔萧何定关中，寇恂平河内，卿有其功，间将授卿以纳言之职；顾念河东吾股肱郡，充实之所，足以制天下，故且烦卿卧镇之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "e6d1e1b62a53c7b7f2532f87dd2db81f20ab7427885a2375289cf9cd97aba5f2"}

{"id": "p_ec3d6d47cf324e33", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 109, "text": "”畿在河东十六年，常为天下最。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "9fd554b9a9dab7c663a203bb2bc9e930c8e5718abfad2f751137745f2ca1eda2"}

{"id": "p_d70936f6c8eff92e", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 110, "text": "文帝即王位，赐爵关内侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "e238bcaccf6b5cc6db0ff3b40f185c2a50bb2d4c88deeaf2b9c9e162328819b3"}

{"id": "p_73a0ecc9ebc49e1f", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 111, "text": "帝征吴，以畿为尚书仆射，统留事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "1c11661e738822d4876769b2dbe9ff5483c88e08d80284b46620be34b8d4366c"}

{"id": "p_7ba351800fc5c779", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 112, "text": "其后帝幸许昌，畿复居守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "226ed72124524ace973806fe79513792393d0a3acae583598a382a0795a0bc5b"}

{"id": "p_f7d9f9ae10cbf977", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 113, "text": "受诏作御楼船，於陶河试船，遇风没。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "33849f06d872c6a564a247a1fc3b9da336ebb9f1c65539804bc44878065b69b5"}

{"id": "p_42a52b449f21eb0c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 114, "text": "诏曰：“昔冥勤其官而水死，稷勤百谷而山死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "6b9857a65da0d9996c33310aa9c6df8ccdd52c5744edd4b48bb5b943c05b7775"}

{"id": "p_298a567a5012c6af", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 115, "text": "故尚书仆射杜畿，於孟津试船，遂至覆没，忠之至也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "3a4a24590cacb28eed4f3f845f60f027ca4d0857181f92aae549fff9ecc0b31e"}

{"id": "p_74ef1394efbc25fb", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 116, "text": "恕字务伯，太和中为散骑黄门侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "3b74d60c0f3c4c43d9c9b6317290b11febacdc8da6c96878f8eee64d0a7c94a4"}

{"id": "p_8357892b01530ba4", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 117, "text": "恕推诚以质，不治饰，少无名誉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "fb1bd74d2f720f5abb40d36503b9877389c97a0cd6fffadf58615969809b9ab9"}

{"id": "p_8c7d44c6de5f479b", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 118, "text": "及在朝，不结交援，专心向公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "9742cc53739a55fe093d4b5f36b1707358e2aa267bdedc02827c01f928654419"}

{"id": "p_ec27b4555df29e8f", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 119, "text": "每政有得失，常引纲维以正言，於是侍中辛毗等器重之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "809ac8c88d82f033d0099d4ea38c3b4ef090b8fb571a8cc8367a5ecde026789e"}

{"id": "p_94b85772858baf24", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 120, "text": "时公卿以下大议损益，恕以为“古之刺史，奉宣六条，以清静为名，威风著称，今可勿令领兵，以专民事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "54f71c2b754a677b9ddca9ecdbe7b518d71317e36a6b3eb822628fe9d646909c"}

{"id": "p_cb9e89a442cab759", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 121, "text": "”俄而镇北将军吕昭又领冀州，乃上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "fde6ea8d5de43724a47eacd358458ef316b58ec89731c32dc9fc0b6574628131"}

{"id": "p_d9757f45d90c3bbc", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 122, "text": "时又大议考课之制，以考内外众官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "9bd46d230b8ec2c42cc362dad5dac94a5a26027f793cbce4c05d30e255c4aa33"}

{"id": "p_17d244310da80f41", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 123, "text": "恕以为用不尽其人，虽才且无益，所存非所务，所务非世要。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "2c1ba24514d00bc8553a34cb138346c9b4b3d7b96fc3bd0dc0a254c63fbcce25"}

{"id": "p_80d1c2a5fbba21b0", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 124, "text": "乐安廉昭以才能拔擢，颇好言事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "e4af535c24e45f72b81dab6233c1e27ee924a313559c1155d1907099cd8ece99"}

{"id": "p_d13119639463163d", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 125, "text": "恕在朝八年，其论议亢直，皆此类也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "fb118036757a4ab8e96bc01aec1b1b943195588fc844019bf93ad0c184b2b346"}

{"id": "p_8742fdf4efda7992", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 126, "text": "出为弘农太守，数岁转赵相，以疾去官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "3745f55c530e9fabc27ceed0fa609feb80f97ab39ec6c5e7c64f61088aef073a"}

{"id": "p_9066e62c4a22d1f8", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 127, "text": "起家为河东太守，岁餘，迁淮北都督护军，复以疾去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "869c1903f268c176c9339ca03d15307fa02cbe171895ab367e1af3737dcbff0a"}

{"id": "p_e4bacbfffcbe30fd", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 128, "text": "恕所在，务存大体而已，其树惠爱，益得百姓欢心，不及於畿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "edf242f63bfc1986434a3abc92bf2163a7c97085415a492df327817f2707c8a2"}

{"id": "p_00353bb39dc4c973", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 129, "text": "恕在朝廷，以不得当世之和，故屡在外任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "51976ffebdbc0634ee2946fb2ebbe324884a4889a7f72bc92be06078571f4260"}

{"id": "p_6a1b0207aab491e0", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 130, "text": "复出为幽州刺史，加建威将军，使持节，护乌丸校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "18c1265685766568b41ada89bc6c244f2c084813968bd9c77ff637ffae8df830"}

{"id": "p_35214bb704dacdaf", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 131, "text": "时征北将军程喜屯蓟，尚书袁侃等戒恕曰：“程申伯处先帝之世，倾田国让於青州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "3805152fb182eeeb3301144ad63c4ace3e2f406b034a9a72ea7c43740b54b4a8"}

{"id": "p_9f28c684ff8e0679", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 132, "text": "足下今俱杖节，使共屯一城，宜深有以待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "fd778a367fc07566b7154f55d1e43624946a5532d9f24680543ad52d894dc6bb"}

{"id": "p_2dd4710a457dd425", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 133, "text": "至官未期，有鲜卑大人兒，不由关塞，径将数十骑诣州，州斩所从来小子一人，无表言上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "c1bddd98ce9a2ecff7456a24083220037a692a52310a9a9ef79cb8e72eb46d24"}

{"id": "p_c9b5eeafdd39326a", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 134, "text": "喜於是劾奏恕，下廷尉，当死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "243b9241e16754bf0118a1df8ea3b98db114e47515670b0d07d354c0a2ed0212"}

{"id": "p_44493603587202f5", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 135, "text": "以父畿勤事水死，免为庶人，徙章武郡，是岁嘉平元年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "30f28ca103892f329b36c9dc6a9b0f83be360868f70612d8cb5fe105359a9407"}

{"id": "p_2182b6ce0b24760c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 136, "text": "恕倜傥任意，而思不防患，终致此败。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "850dac37b4ef65056ff08bed9d35a1b4de16cfdcbc3639f2ce2d6b86a0ec5664"}

{"id": "p_f7a464a232992a9c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 137, "text": "初，恕从赵郡还，陈留阮武亦从清河太守徵，俱自薄廷尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "5c9fc3fabaf477fdfe87504bd4b0371663e39cea462a96976a8efdbc55bf338b"}

{"id": "p_c8a2897526645192", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 138, "text": "谓恕曰：“相观才性可以由公道而持之不厉，器能可以处大官而求之不顺，才学可以述古今而志之不一，此所谓有其才而无其用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "9684167c6db180fac0cf6ee5361b50d0a140e08159f7d8d184da728dd40f03ca"}

{"id": "p_2fbfbf4e8d550d61", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 139, "text": "今向间暇，可试潜思，成一家言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "ca1b0007cf5f889ef333cdd6fc8c1fffdc25d2aaa3325a7c726c21d8d3831412"}

{"id": "p_a3ac1706a51227a5", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 140, "text": "”在章武，遂著体论八节。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "3d44c68bd1f04a2f26642c56dbddb9e4078808a2a9bd2053ab0d64c55c29f54b"}

{"id": "p_0b3b096917fa996e", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 141, "text": "又著兴性论一篇，盖兴於为己也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "1ddfb646807426f334d3df6d21f78865aa0d9e0a8daeab5c131ffd81d5215865"}

{"id": "p_a63022472c28d9d1", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 142, "text": "，河东乐详年九十餘，上书讼畿之遗绩，朝廷感焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "b59ae1a9a45a87a233bb53bf9d84b426ec293cc3a82ef703c5db7b4350ea1485"}

{"id": "p_856612f5c45e4e3d", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 143, "text": "诏封恕子预为丰乐亭侯，邑百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "a07124052735e3a27f04f0be7c95b31feb64903020fb708b287a8740a0595a52"}

{"id": "p_075577a0ad19f322", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 144, "text": "恕奏议论駮皆可观，掇其切世大事著于篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "3326219d81726f18f580b83540e4ed0aea3b0903a9c7b6d7a529ba57b27d7405"}

{"id": "p_f4965b328de192d3", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 145, "text": "郑浑字文公，河南开封人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "ea05d4ba1782c901a29023449a160bf2a547c76ebaa5933dff5fd9e895c359d3"}

{"id": "p_134bec092853760c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 146, "text": "高祖父众，众父兴，皆为名儒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "6ecaff868e15745702241e011912dd0ff337a251d585b92ab6cd4d564a54a297"}

{"id": "p_b55302866fadbd21", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 147, "text": "浑兄泰，与荀攸等谋诛董卓，为扬州刺史，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "7ebc751f682c2d0ae7338a1f83c8fd321bc7bb34bd60368c0d145e3c33f77723"}

{"id": "p_9833ae478b2d0667", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 148, "text": "浑将泰小子袤避难淮南，袁术宾礼甚厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "b588c28d2f5d352daeb93789de5cf3cad0353adac2f79b5f87b51a44353e82c5"}

{"id": "p_d18c4ead332a0ffe", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 149, "text": "时华歆为豫章太守，素与泰善，浑乃渡江投歆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "d18ee12a057ae76fbca3bc34e81780119dfb179dcf15df12e17447fe4939dda5"}

{"id": "p_25df9c2e3a013fe5", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 150, "text": "太祖闻其笃行，召为掾，复迁下蔡长、邵陵令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "a82425b6b2e9ff6487d56543bc932d6a72a0d38e828a585c9bc0ab8f7af3a22f"}

{"id": "p_da3c02dfa4b3165c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 151, "text": "天下未定，民皆剽轻，不念产殖；其生子无以相活，率皆不举。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "511434d8045a7d4f8afcd62d1a38fbd8d195450b592270a89e436eae61a9b6ab"}

{"id": "p_578e5fefa7d86e3d", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 152, "text": "浑所在夺其渔猎之具，课使耕桑，又兼开稻田，重去子之法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "a66d8906bf76c6f7a854bcc039e9528e656868978989940078f6e6ba007b7a4e"}

{"id": "p_3b7a70be343a7db2", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 153, "text": "民初畏罪，后稍丰给，无不举赡；所育男女，多以郑为字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "951422517c14966d07b94eeee6569b0f4b6b2034dc201704d288fd570fd12648"}

{"id": "p_aed648e717087a7f", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 154, "text": "辟为丞相掾属，迁左冯翊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "bf025d30822a1c27fe9b2d12b65492f156e959573065585e5fe5e0ce59cc7a96"}

{"id": "p_8ed7f92722d9611a", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 155, "text": "时梁兴等略吏民五千餘家为寇钞，诸县不能御，皆恐惧，寄治郡下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "be0c5040a3db204c464c3643b573a25d6b800143a64144d9a2ed9cc0fac2fed9"}

{"id": "p_963b20022fd6b0b4", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 156, "text": "议者悉以为当移就险，浑曰：“兴等破散，窜在山阻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "6e7f84e323b6fe0dd2fb9bb40511a15cb58410ac732f5b36d31b1a3c43fd18c7"}

{"id": "p_6aa577f364e69e0f", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 157, "text": "今当广开降路，宣喻恩信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "56ea839a15d8ca6b9581521873e7fdb3960d59eeb651e1a8b972eb0d77ea5f74"}

{"id": "p_5207de048086704a", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 158, "text": "”乃聚敛吏民，治城郭，为守御之备。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "23f9041fbf44999d06c0a1b026935095513877697b7f337f83b442347af5ffb9"}

{"id": "p_7df684a8673a1f59", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 159, "text": "遂发民逐贼，明赏罚，与要誓，其所得获，十以七赏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "d4756a36e0ae5b79c420274361b4d443066cdd1883af7016066671c289fbdd06"}

{"id": "p_fb28e83907337715", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 160, "text": "百姓大悦，皆原捕贼，多得妇女、财物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "fd3c86365c44ce95433cfe3ea5836cbf837559154eab430bbe2ecbb7dde57125"}

{"id": "p_f9377291f10fed8e", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 161, "text": "贼之失妻子者，皆还求降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "cf459eea7ea40da9896d23d8ee30f9653a35cd541ef6819c42295b42f6fe34eb"}

{"id": "p_e509b551af7324b0", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 162, "text": "浑责其得他妇女，然后还其妻子，於是转相寇盗，党与离散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "0fb42c9c99db31b08ce965de85fc7ad70e212197a8026ca7a57c6b8a50c4fe81"}

{"id": "p_580cf51aae5c0ea4", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 163, "text": "又遣吏民有恩信者，分布山谷告喻，出者相继，乃使诸县长吏各还本治以安集之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "ed9113c02d698c8acd807e651dbba03968d46bccebbaed568373a8496d57f960"}

{"id": "p_44356fd63dc2299f", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 164, "text": "太祖使夏侯渊就助郡击之，浑率吏民前登，斩兴及其支党。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "7f0954c171360704399db8b9db660bff4ab5a4523934e7d01e49c3e290355cb4"}

{"id": "p_fe7656fe12929e70", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 165, "text": "又贼靳富等，胁将夏阳长、邵陵令并其吏民入硙山，浑复讨击破富等，获二县长吏，将其所略还。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "3fca369874c060280c1ce1d2c958edb692463e528649958430ee4594c51742ac"}

{"id": "p_a6a0812816db38f2", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 166, "text": "及赵青龙者，杀左内史程休，浑闻，遣壮士就枭其首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "3a5c4707736e1dd2965952863f363ae0396a9a7eeaa0ae5b7ad6f4bb8089871e"}

{"id": "p_1088deacb1312382", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 167, "text": "前后归附四千餘家，由是山贼皆平，民安产业。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "f8e914e1a466dec6450a773212d516e43e9410d3996e38331f34f65e9307a413"}

{"id": "p_28232fc2e807bc61", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 168, "text": "太祖征汉中，以浑为京兆尹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "7dcf24b46661eb1d580377c54cb487ea2ca9811ee9f81ff3254019b96dd7d34a"}

{"id": "p_5acb5ad70a5d28d2", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 169, "text": "浑以百姓新集，为制移居之法，使兼複者与单轻者相伍，温信者与孤老为比，勤稼穑，明禁令，以发奸者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "c1cd42810783d19308bce338542c372b2247bd876c98ab6ff0bff97f76885e3b"}

{"id": "p_e1ebfb7a7d2f6a57", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 170, "text": "由是民安於农，而盗贼止息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "8807e555c1ad050cb31048a1d4e78f0a6145145ed71b6aef86441afba0483266"}

{"id": "p_7fd0d9c85d99a521", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 171, "text": "及大军入汉中，运转军粮为最。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "d3ad2bb1d797e23bfad5e075b92433fbb99648b9c0af750478ef2da8df73f898"}

{"id": "p_1607b0bf62d8211c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 172, "text": "又遣民田汉中，无逃亡者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "5f83301323935b8eee407a09aa72e6fdbb35c742770c726b718cfe02cab4ea55"}

{"id": "p_31e08e3b7b250e63", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 173, "text": "太祖益嘉之，复入为丞相掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "13117989d3f370cdb702fb27e36bb9deceb6b6f9a322dd4f96f20a0a4b61faf0"}

{"id": "p_453a9ae056335fcf", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 174, "text": "文帝即位，为侍御史，加驸马都尉，迁阳平、沛郡二太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "8f396d0865cd48ea5ea6e4735ef35a0d9c9139c028b8bc9b6bd9e398ef48f7b6"}

{"id": "p_4a0d43b393a44e04", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 175, "text": "郡界下湿，患水涝，百姓饥乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "e9c67146dfa52f37f398f950c62fed20bf4c4faafd61c864017c4ae2118ead13"}

{"id": "p_dc605c472946d4aa", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 176, "text": "浑於萧、相二县界，兴陂遏，开稻田。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "4e83e104113590d60e94d873cf1723873ecd30c9739082da8792c114d32b449d"}

{"id": "p_0962317de0d457d7", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 177, "text": "郡人皆以为不便，浑曰：“地势洿下，宜溉灌，终有鱼稻经久之利，此丰民之本也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "d77c69c101b19daf3c68434895dc6ee95de3c5e498c39f31f857cffba711a226"}

{"id": "p_a2bfc2bf466fa32b", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 178, "text": "”遂躬率吏民，兴立功夫，一冬间皆成。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "d343b3131e7d5818618bd1af0d2abca14cfccf76315df2c4283d961d895d7af6"}

{"id": "p_14efb1750b659418", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 179, "text": "比年大收，顷亩岁增，租入倍常，民赖其利，刻石颂之，号曰郑陂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "1a8c983484aacac31747c508afc82af9c228d5d874156c46ac45eaf63b15db21"}

{"id": "p_9088595b5164962b", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 180, "text": "转为山阳、魏郡太守，其治放此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "2b20c932ae2a5f778aeb2e1ca0b6168bb5b4b11e58d282148d55139e757f9ff0"}

{"id": "p_a812043046903838", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 181, "text": "又以郡下百姓，苦乏材木，乃课树榆为篱，并益树五果；榆皆成籓，五果丰实。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "26827f53ac62b1d1d1ac682e84b84fd810485caef7f31839c5c0b4ad4652ebc8"}

{"id": "p_4e5353f0a6856553", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 182, "text": "入魏郡界，村落齐整如一，民得财足用饶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "ee737c2e38579894163c95af6ef340719b1213f01c210d4dbc2829d30c9eff44"}

{"id": "p_d290921d86f85c6c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 183, "text": "明帝闻之，下诏称述，布告天下，迁将作大匠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "57e738dcc1c7eb1083a3415bf5b44839f44c9faba77ff0857d83351d536a9b7e"}

{"id": "p_5a99ba33d5e83a1c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 184, "text": "浑清素在公，妻子不免於饥寒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "829873b24cd021555f5c71c89f649968460ddd929eb1d9e2cecc8a56bda4cb6f"}

{"id": "p_37e44ec13cb70da9", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 185, "text": "建安中，太祖开募屯田於淮南，以慈为绥集都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "edf7d3ea5c5cae5998d475520fd8057864c5f048148e174b40a901aea3cac6dd"}

{"id": "p_1aed6d5c625ee2df", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 186, "text": "黄初末，为长安令，清约有方，吏民畏而爱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "672b15efff51a204e8dae0f770e8ff37f8e07f3f4ab091932ca19d78eda5ec32"}

{"id": "p_21b4446e54d138ca", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 187, "text": "郡在西陲，以丧乱隔绝，旷无太守二十岁，大姓雄张，遂以为俗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "b8637fa6f065ff06a961984598f779a1b64fc712db0f1a8cfe016ba7a5ed2795"}

{"id": "p_693342c721072ed1", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 188, "text": "前太守尹奉等，循故而已，无所匡革。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "902138c5e8ca646ba4db34af48cc83b9a5844d05531aca5589c154fb37f3c00f"}

{"id": "p_f701b2feafd21d9a", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 189, "text": "慈到，抑挫权右，抚恤贫羸，甚得其理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "d74a69a8a32aa2ce087168cff37d9d5307012ab271a043565670afb9baa0e0db"}

{"id": "p_d2050d48bc6a0667", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 190, "text": "旧大族田地有餘，而小民无立锥之土；慈皆随口割赋，稍稍使毕其本直。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "29c74aa6783dbec1f84fda985d1fe46138cde311987739058c879ef6b20a2b56"}

{"id": "p_85ede4a31dfb1554", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 191, "text": "先是属城狱讼众猥，县不能决，多集治下；慈躬往省阅，料简轻重，自非殊死，但鞭杖遣之，一岁决刑曾不满十人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "7dcc6e20f5c6514e735a2787fc8543056c09c968863b8cde1d5ba9df597b4b31"}

{"id": "p_8697dac684689372", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 192, "text": "又常日西域杂胡欲来贡献，而诸豪族多逆断绝；既与贸迁，欺诈侮易，多不得分明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "57adc21d271af528484b9d599dca3ac133d3266a1b2ada896bf60beaf7519ded"}

{"id": "p_40517e086abe46b7", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 193, "text": "欲诣洛者，为封过所，欲从郡还者，官为平取，辄以府见物与共交市，使吏民护送道路，由是民夷翕然称其德惠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "3f4910ea8fdc1a051b51ad3978febe8279f10e05917b0207034bf42d183c1d4d"}

{"id": "p_446deb78433762f4", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 194, "text": "数年卒官，吏民悲感如丧亲戚，图画其形，思其遗像。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "40a3711765190b2f6a53b537cf214f6a8de42aa3d471f3a6ff1db2bbd638e46b"}

{"id": "p_b29f73941134b051", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 195, "text": "及西域诸胡闻慈死，悉共会聚於戊己校尉及长吏治下发哀，或有以刀画面，以明血诚，又为立祠，遥共祠之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "d6d6678875aa80a698eacf52d3c3ae49d4bd8daf9cac12499a12eb3caabfe82c"}

{"id": "p_fb47eb8b3e346959", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 196, "text": "自太祖迄于咸熙，魏郡太守陈国吴瓘、清河太守乐安任燠、京兆太守济北颜斐、弘农太守太原令狐邵、济南相鲁国孔乂，或哀矜折狱，或推诚惠爱，或治身清白，或擿奸发伏，咸为良二千石。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "678dc2b3840b3dc93b55400d1a127cd759e4c2d317996aa07e8b577a7fed8cf0"}

{"id": "p_4fc08294a23ab7b4", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 197, "text": "评曰：任峻始兴义兵，以归太祖，辟土殖谷，仓庾盈溢，庸绩致矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "3503e3ed3488729f3aabbe7bd81dfba2b05f18bec01249d4c5f44f2ab8b936be"}

{"id": "p_1854798e2389851c", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 198, "text": "苏则威以平乱，既政事之良，又矫矫刚直，风烈足称。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "b3534da7ae715d7cb2c5d01ff4443dc378c351a51346d8bef472c46a2739bfa8"}

{"id": "p_4175d35dcc23c942", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 199, "text": "杜畿宽猛克济，惠以康民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "c37bb0b7075ca11d591f94ec56e64fe7936312e7c797cda23f88b0acccc3c7fb"}

{"id": "p_70f7e540c8a79b9b", "source_id": "src_98a24dfc2ad71e80", "ordinal": 200, "text": "恕屡陈时政，经论治体，盖有可观焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "e8ac659036a3b0cb79c0ed5acc6be47ab07ebc8863332f31d7c356f65ff60dfa"}

{"id": "p_a05905ddedca9381", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 0, "text": "==張遼== 張遼字文遠，雁門馬邑人也。本聶壹之-{後}-，以避怨變姓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "f60c5cd368905ac32475eeb99dc295337751ecdf795899bfc53baf13db30c6f6"}

{"id": "p_50b6495ef331f8b2", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 1, "text": "少爲郡吏。漢末，并州刺史丁原以遼武力過人，召爲從事，使將兵詣京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "6827a933dce5e8fd87107dd8f0e06678dd2c9a4fec0192909ad030b824eafe67"}

{"id": "p_162a7575bce477af", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 2, "text": "何進遣詣河北募兵，得千餘人。還，進敗，以兵屬董卓。卓敗，以兵屬呂布，遷騎都尉。布爲李傕所敗，從布東奔徐州，領魯相，時年二十八。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "cac366e7b7ba98e052835a5cd85cd8d1e094f6112265e5f0643bb5bbb77112ac"}

{"id": "p_cbd97c01b7d89f0d", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 3, "text": "太祖破呂布-{於}-下邳，遼將其衆降，拜中郎將，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "0ab3439d259ac8295b94589dcad6df53cd0d67b7d368aa58f3a1b98fe5bfbbec"}

{"id": "p_e670e8420a4a6422", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 4, "text": "數有戰功，遷裨將軍。袁紹破，別遣遼定魯國諸縣。與夏侯淵圍昌豨-{於}-東海，數月糧盡，議引軍還，遼謂淵曰：「數日已來，每行諸圍，豨輒屬目視遼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "a4d38de0fe51ecbbce8b18ace3124f2aa9edf584e1d8fc7d595ce2143aba900a"}

{"id": "p_d71343af42c0012d", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 5, "text": "又其射矢更稀，此必豨計猶豫，故不力戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "a531c9a08fb7fd5c9d482283fdef7168a0094666558f9a05abdaec4adf221ecc"}

{"id": "p_de249ab1714575d7", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 6, "text": "遼欲挑與語，儻可誘也？」乃使謂豨曰：「公有命，使遼傳之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "db6b6e74f513ee71d07bf758784080cab0d1e7a904440e6ec0aa9eee93dbfb78"}

{"id": "p_105f6db6a48446ee", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 7, "text": "」豨果下與遼語，遼爲説「太祖神武，方以德懷四方，先附者受大賞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "ba0bd1b4ce0bfd20fdc6f2ea43cc6bc5352a07679f249234dc9582c902159b64"}

{"id": "p_0f6e6c77347a9faf", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」豨乃許降。遼遂單身上三公山，入豨家，拜妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "6cae6e2f672ed477edec77fcbd2b815841c473507a194d840247a0d8ad7cccb7"}

{"id": "p_796d8d0d2a6062bb", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 9, "text": "豨歡喜，隨詣太祖。太祖遣豨還，責遼曰：「此非大將法也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "c5220cf709dba66e30ae34bcf4d8466bfb0cadd7c37c7b762808901e9bf12343"}

{"id": "p_abdc56bcf5ecff45", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」遼謝曰：「以明公威信著-{於}-四海，遼奉聖旨，豨必不敢害故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "9219fb4bee584d993d7468a91ebd842ea22b95dbc5d286faf8ca4c553f3c4052"}

{"id": "p_6fbcb291aabb5018", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」從討袁譚、袁尙-{於}-黎陽，有功，行中堅將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "0bf9147e1f63f3364cc6c2e9dffc32aa3496f23d56199876ca2929864a46968f"}

{"id": "p_507edb4feb5c0ae1", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 12, "text": "從攻尙-{於}-鄴，尙堅守不下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "224301a472800fd55b2ccd6cbecfcac860d194711f7bf4964b416e53489c7dea"}

{"id": "p_1c3f0869d3800a2d", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 13, "text": "太祖還許，使遼與樂進拔陰安，徙其民河南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "2b81ef5978a3ee9a78ed346e18656a8fc4f91dba230111a35d81621818f1d41e"}

{"id": "p_069a4acc85a1801a", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 14, "text": "復從攻鄴，鄴破，遼別徇趙國、常山，招降緣山諸賊及黑山孫輕等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "12e772ce70a82a4dfce6531d1c930769272fda8409924e00b7751d8c9113e72f"}

{"id": "p_de64887292839a65", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 15, "text": "從攻袁譚，譚破，別將徇海濱，破遼東賊柳毅等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "b02183849b9834d467e050483dc2ad3d8d130590d33cc153d66132589331c2c1"}

{"id": "p_d42d4a7ff31c754a", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 16, "text": "還鄴，太祖自出迎遼，引共載，以遼爲蕩寇將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "a7a83e5df88138103cca1a778f2188581e22687cf06f9310fd4158f2755fcdaa"}

{"id": "p_8a68bea016f6bf18", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 17, "text": "復別擊荆州，定江夏諸縣，還屯臨潁，封都亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "5c30e459c83898a45ea580fe1d66ea86c5e31a85459695a6cb265df25fb7cecf"}

{"id": "p_32c3422eaf134136", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 18, "text": "從-{征}-袁尙-{於}-柳城，卒與虜遇，遼勸太祖戰，氣甚奮，太祖壯之，自以所持麾授遼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "52c2d66bc0be7798dbc855601b397aef836a21c1b204a080e823b4b5c01450bb"}

{"id": "p_1d8280c77c94e137", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 19, "text": "遂擊，大破之，斬單-{于}-蹋頓。 時荆州未定，復遣遼屯長社。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "b8dc629d5222b8def0dd0cbaef939847584d71fbc5e2b806b25f8f71a70aa5a8"}

{"id": "p_eaac573fb8b835c9", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 20, "text": "臨發，軍中有謀反者，夜驚亂起火，一軍盡擾。遼謂左右曰：「勿動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "b6d30c5c6050b479847b56553eb9a971da45809805006f7db937cdd574771a52"}

{"id": "p_ad62446931a5edef", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 21, "text": "是不一營盡反，必有造變者，欲以動亂人耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "34128248dedf7afd328ae8b884c2eba2b45b5ab92ad58a821557a07faa348a5e"}

{"id": "p_1ebe7784bc12a0ac", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 22, "text": "」乃令軍中，其不反者安坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "497f46ceaee5e19ef7bd46da4eaf9616b99e789defc5beff0b957ed7d15977a3"}

{"id": "p_f94e6d1d7730d9d8", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 23, "text": "遼將親兵數十人，中陳而立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "9848040d3c3938e2a91835500b5dc0b28a196076bdca6c04f558bcf2058a9d16"}

{"id": "p_1ef31bc7c267f22c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 24, "text": "有頃定，即得首謀者殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "c8b279f734ca80080370c6bf1e2610aa744e7b8b72ebf32f366b68835db3f6e0"}

{"id": "p_92f1706de18140ea", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 25, "text": "陳蘭、梅成以氐六縣叛，太祖遣-{于}-禁、臧霸等討成，遼督張郃、牛蓋等討蘭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "0ccfe1b9fe441c552af4f82bd15f0f26ad41d3321465abf6d68b721a8ce041b0"}

{"id": "p_d36a3291b7b8cb2c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 26, "text": "成僞降禁，禁還。成遂將其衆就蘭，轉入灊山。灊中有天柱山，高峻二十餘-{里}-，道險狹，步徑裁通，蘭等壁其上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "84e47355ec82e5c1698fd35231a185cfb1104768708d355c12cf55338547e41c"}

{"id": "p_de95d9137deca6c7", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 27, "text": "遼欲進，諸將曰：「兵少道險，難用深入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "8904ecff853ad059831dfb32d8d7e3101b5da05541b1028ab43ca2613b82dc69"}

{"id": "p_2791ba2a2408d543", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」遼曰：「此所謂一與一，勇者得前耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "e776552d57039a79c56e43d99df63a8db2cc7b3e908b43756542b458b9efea1b"}

{"id": "p_e1a3bef241c1f7f2", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」遂進到山下安營，攻之，斬蘭成首，盡虜其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "732040b04eb3b49079397766b9fc43027bd81f8ba8848f22f0c13355c1804abb"}

{"id": "p_8fe4ecf8f8e2b984", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 30, "text": "太祖論諸將功，曰：「登天山，履峻險，以取蘭成，蕩寇功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "2e3b5052559c10cf5c90ecc53a4df6adfa4b920d0601b67e4928440e10c566e8"}

{"id": "p_b20148768b810b7c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」增邑，假節。 太祖旣-{征}-孫權還，使遼與樂進、李典等將七千餘人屯合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "1f7b9a3ebef97cc9e9d2acfc8606f4d4941a79a2eac88b77af1843f5d569377c"}

{"id": "p_57485de7fb6dcc41", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 32, "text": "太祖-{征}-張魯，教與護軍薛悌，署函邊曰「賊至乃發」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "61651d14b41c85eabcdbc58fb29110d48a5fcb6401e71d91ab240a3d86561337"}

{"id": "p_0bd3bf6e7a6d59ee", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 33, "text": "俄而權率十萬衆圍合肥，乃共發教，教曰：「若孫權至者，張李將軍出戰；樂將軍守護軍，勿得與戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "63d45a0a45903a14e69773b39c64a8fe3a76d3306f7c2c601ab4c0036b355ed9"}

{"id": "p_c6eba30b6c744f19", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 34, "text": "」諸將皆疑。遼曰：「公遠-{征}-在外，比救至，彼破我必矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "212f29023298a1b2a17d11cc6ed4dbdbd49dcdecea88268237c974b52e4c0d59"}

{"id": "p_43251249ed3216fc", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 35, "text": "是以教指及其未合逆擊之，折其盛勢，以安衆心，然-{後}-可守也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "1c70b3c3a75af41e18f231f8523752be158a5d10de3c613ef649becc030ddfaa"}

{"id": "p_4b69754a57dd2623", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 36, "text": "成敗之-{機}-，在此一戰，諸君何疑？", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "7dd5213617c3e20c18da63cac053ba8fda8fe0368ce7f0c8e3eeecbe9f732602"}

{"id": "p_8b07cf1f5e72e7ab", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」李典亦與遼同。-{於}-是遼夜募敢從之士，得八百人，椎牛饗將士，明日大戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "2e67019f45440eb077a1c67013e7f0994db574d17c2db11e89264671c0bce6d1"}

{"id": "p_747ad25c64b858aa", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 38, "text": "平旦，遼被甲持戟，先登陷陳，殺數十人，斬二將，大呼自名，-{衝}-壘入，至權麾下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "026efdbe8d111f8d2c939c5ce04258cd583e9f40eb3f8b5d35d31b57daa6b6dc"}

{"id": "p_0c0900f557202618", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 39, "text": "權大驚，衆不知所爲，走登高冢，以長戟自守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "3d59b5a90d6410a317349d3d3a6466e11bf9b0f287d0e772ebf6dc1187a20a79"}

{"id": "p_3636658d50f0d368", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 40, "text": "遼叱權下戰，權不敢動，望見遼所將衆少，乃聚圍遼數重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "f0b0d1bff666acc0a12f960a9968da86a46388e3639fd542c5702bb46694cf55"}

{"id": "p_218f8b4b35634beb", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 41, "text": "遼左右麾圍，直前急擊，圍開，遼將麾下數十人得出，餘衆號呼曰：「將軍棄我乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "c2fe4b0135c72249177dc20743bc1d7afd4fb1c83a8e2b8423a4a43c461fe63d"}

{"id": "p_ab8c35e1c2f96767", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 42, "text": "」遼復還突圍，拔出餘衆。權人馬皆披靡，無敢當者。自旦戰至日中，吳人奪氣，還修守備，衆心乃安，諸將-{咸}-服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "9b4c62d0ee0733e92113ca48ca498da76d2a997dcac0346d122ac0f5a8df1c28"}

{"id": "p_d042c45f062fa092", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 43, "text": "權守合肥十餘日，城不可拔，乃引退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "23893d3cd518a81cf68ebc2368c1cf2c8f22e77bb58bbf81fbf669dbe9b48afc"}

{"id": "p_c6d9627c37261259", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 44, "text": "遼率諸軍追擊，-{幾}-復獲權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "69a555324e881192fef833192de494b6affacdd97e90ece4990e4c94029880dc"}

{"id": "p_019eb1e41ef4853a", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 45, "text": "太祖大壯遼，拜-{征}-東將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "bc3daa12f9ffde12f95b3a67342794193f49b9df2db43f63ef527df530b16b19"}

{"id": "p_49ce4f4e4ef63987", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 46, "text": "，太祖復-{征}-孫權，到合肥，循行遼戰處，嘆息者良久。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "b9f653dfc3862f591e459b50d36d7aec376d2e2b0217ee29e901654327795085"}

{"id": "p_2b1aabe9d411f696", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 47, "text": "乃增遼兵，多留諸軍，徙屯居巢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "ddb266689bfad4986bff5259d014d1dd1f25fa81829f83ae0aa19b0ef80993ee"}

{"id": "p_0f3c71f159e0533b", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 48, "text": " 關羽圍曹仁-{於}-樊，會權稱籓，召遼及諸軍悉還救仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "7bf4fc39d04b563f13a51823dcf48a0a6aa43886945764b6bc9e8f58e94fd572"}

{"id": "p_0f524996e2b70661", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 49, "text": "遼未至，徐晃已破關羽，仁圍解。遼與太祖會摩陂。遼軍至，太祖乘輦出勞之，還屯陳郡。文帝即王位，轉前將軍。分封兄汎及一子列侯。孫權復叛，遣遼還屯合肥，進遼爵都鄕侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "d68069ee04ab1b12faecde332d30bd1cfc7654b5ca19716f40b659a197b56ae0"}

{"id": "p_0c723c8a7306801c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 50, "text": "給遼母輿車，及兵馬送遼家詣屯，敕遼母至，導從出迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "5f05f81cc0f39b2c0cdff8d8db0cd774eb827f26853ca15933b51c2af10c75fa"}

{"id": "p_9f12394d82d32677", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 51, "text": "所督諸軍將吏皆羅拜道側，觀者榮之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "aeb454a1530f6c8de99d5faf29d9139b1a6ac6192423098d067d5351d0c72d80"}

{"id": "p_cab8a15e2a899a50", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 52, "text": "文帝踐阼，封晉陽侯，增邑千戸，並前二千六百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "d4b15382872c6e56cbff899acbc194de928a3c56d2d5a6e78cec6bb8f8a282f5"}

{"id": "p_4e5d71fc440355ef", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 53, "text": "，遼朝洛陽宮，文帝引遼會建始殿，親問破吳意狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "0dcd3278d5fe56a76f4495c948057ef1e121ea67d34e8ea2e0f55212c8a67264"}

{"id": "p_1ec9585b67ce30cb", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 54, "text": "帝嘆息顧左右曰：「此亦古之召虎也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "1fb27cc429f22b5ec4df042e282bdb6b31c09f843ab7e21d5099966c2e913bd7"}

{"id": "p_b25b00e247dd8ad4", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」爲起第-{舍}-，又特爲遼母作殿，以遼所從破吳軍應募步卒，皆爲虎賁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "5144b60a6403668bd5abfa5c6ac76527deaf8f5ce54922f659dad8badacc4153"}

{"id": "p_9c5eb8ee4ead3824", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 56, "text": "孫權復稱籓。遼還屯雍丘，得疾。帝遣侍中劉曄將太醫視疾，虎賁問消息，道路相屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "7828fa07d6b3de4d6ef040aa82496e98a1d1ed9762c9f4cf0059fdd05746c423"}

{"id": "p_06b384c46cf4d042", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 57, "text": "疾未瘳，帝迎遼就行在所，車駕親臨，執其手，賜以-{御}-衣，太官日送-{御}-食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "afe03775f48525189b5b631bdd0b8ce77a8251d9f7dc79f62244395a68eda3c4"}

{"id": "p_38857ccdb957e2ba", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 58, "text": "疾小差，還屯。孫權復叛，帝遣遼乘舟，與曹休至海陵，臨江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "d1f50e1e9d7bd539c4fe636e7de0cf8bf20bde072782e74c5a1e041dcd02dd05"}

{"id": "p_5ea84ce690aed2a5", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 59, "text": "權甚憚焉，敕諸將：「張遼雖病，不可當也，愼之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "04a532f8f4cc81f5850c4c1a79d439b51391c1828d012fabac6b2abe5b9f24ab"}

{"id": "p_4f80470c163e0050", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 60, "text": "」是歳，遼與諸將破權將呂-{範}-。遼病篤，遂薨-{於}-江都。帝爲流涕，諡曰剛侯。子虎嗣。六年，帝追念遼典在合肥之功，詔曰：「合肥之役，遼典以步卒八百，破賊十萬，自古用兵，未之有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "00b314b51f70fd033b5e6c33e6cbd7b33b17ebf4ebc11095144885f6f3e4a548"}

{"id": "p_9635cde2768a1d72", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 61, "text": "使賊至今奪氣，可謂國之爪牙矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "2f4e635cd1210d7f381651cfe28a4bfd7e388b1fa7ff9f2f360869ccaaad8090"}

{"id": "p_eba733ef87cb85b4", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 62, "text": "其分遼典邑各百戸，賜一子爵關內侯。」虎爲偏將軍，薨。子統嗣。 ==樂進== 樂進字文謙，陽平衞國人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "40fa7fc558e490f6b0e9126456d5cb033ba94889a08ff9906f01f03c276712df"}

{"id": "p_a367e26e97c9ece9", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 63, "text": "容貌短小，以膽烈從太祖，爲帳下吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "6a0ca7db19ecab734db8043e2e09c9388539f78e86d8253faf14bdf5c364537b"}

{"id": "p_3ac82fd16a793843", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 64, "text": "遣還本郡募兵，得千餘人，還爲軍假司馬、陷陳都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "cce2a167006cdefd1bdb8939ee607b66b634f89ea91a776cdef3b22017018259"}

{"id": "p_d1a8cae3ec9e6872", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 65, "text": "從擊呂布-{於}-濮陽，張超-{於}-雍丘，橋曨-{於}-苦，皆先登有功，封廣昌亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "d2087c929bc728f69a24271af2979a042fbdc87461d6a322e3f2dbf6cfba59ec"}

{"id": "p_7e33304fee5cb455", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 66, "text": "從-{征}-張繡-{於}-安衆，圍呂布-{於}-下邳，破別將，擊眭固-{於}-射犬，攻劉備-{於}-沛，皆破之，拜討寇校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "5da96bb6a2348de336eb3b25f8fa5d032e1e560edf725bb695591261f4a369bf"}

{"id": "p_678117083df80e98", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 67, "text": "渡河攻獲嘉，還，從擊袁紹-{於}-官渡，力戰，斬紹將淳-{于}-瓊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "3bc700a01650f4c4285b81c9280b8430aa609d08497875bec8a8c1771d75adf3"}

{"id": "p_1e2b8fa102f97f1a", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 68, "text": "從擊譚尙-{於}-黎陽，斬其大將嚴敬，行-{遊}-擊將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "5cae45355959d0f60da026530e0d63b46f1ba2f68497717634b226e083d58acb"}

{"id": "p_b70c4f5ee0d33b67", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 69, "text": "別擊黃巾，破之，定樂安郡。從圍鄴，鄴定，從擊袁譚-{於}-南皮，先登，入譚東門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "e17ab0eaf96b197e76602d15393d46798c5761306920baeebb189e53fb3d39ce"}

{"id": "p_a85e5db6b84a0dd3", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 70, "text": "譚敗，別攻雍奴，破之。，太祖表漢帝，稱進及-{于}-禁、張遼曰：「武力旣弘，計略-{周}-備，質忠性一，守執節義，每臨戰攻，常爲督率，奮強突固，無堅不陷，自援枹鼓，手不知倦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "56c879e4eac322eedf53d285ba3ff91cba088155332d8ee9f1be67090f9042a4"}

{"id": "p_969a27e42db68e14", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 71, "text": "又遣別-{征}-，統-{御}-師旅，撫衆則和，奉令無犯，當敵-{制}-決，靡有遺失。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "4c2734bc0bff8c8f5c48a16979f593f1c739497f47e638b8ba0afb60af266e0f"}

{"id": "p_90bdf0a6917ee3ba", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 72, "text": "論功紀用，宜各顯寵。」-{於}-是禁爲虎威；進，折-{衝}-；遼，蕩寇將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "6a576d70d642d522a4b9df7c157901647d6c5678ce7992d83c755eeb55a89f31"}

{"id": "p_37907fd1adbedc7e", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 73, "text": " 進別-{征}-高-{幹}-，從北道入上黨，回出其-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "265018ef83512249e09bae55fc6a2aef8f573ff226802e0bb0f7361e326e5cfb"}

{"id": "p_00280a1dc8619158", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 74, "text": "-{幹}-等還守壺關，連戰斬首。-{幹}-堅守未下，會太祖自-{征}-之，乃拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "6ffd008cfcc356db3e5bbdd705de217b00db59691d0788a0363c4baef5a92553"}

{"id": "p_e1b7655bd823097f", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 75, "text": "太祖-{征}-管承，軍淳-{于}-，遣進與李典擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "e168662594e24eb047e337520c9d19f2ecf127420efb7945beb83869b24d82d4"}

{"id": "p_70a4773524fe9ad1", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 76, "text": "承破走，逃入海島，海濱平，荆州未服，遣屯陽翟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "19434cd72558b6fe68e30411bbf057c0a6cfd80274908e652f5bc6b298d7dfdc"}

{"id": "p_ff6777945053e19f", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 77, "text": "-{後}-從平荆州，留屯襄陽，擊關羽、蘇非等，皆走之，南郡諸郡山-{谷}-蠻夷詣進降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "99784eba865119afdff9ffc23be9370bdfb491aa6ca80279b3cbda3bfaf5072a"}

{"id": "p_81e63c9c31bf92cb", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 78, "text": "又討劉備臨沮長杜普、旌陽長梁大，皆大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "9d55db0d20b8d503a62080f57a5c6f1bb5bfb94c85988c519e2c970d3ac993cd"}

{"id": "p_0100ae9f19d369a9", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 79, "text": "-{後}-從-{征}-孫權，假進節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "f483df9377615fe1229cfa7a122f6aa95b19c2b59c2ed3472fdb0410e10579fe"}

{"id": "p_0b95eaa1de4acf71", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 80, "text": "太祖還，留進與張遼、李典屯合肥，增邑五百，並前凡千二百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "a91dbcfbd5f9f47a309f4fe8f4c46371bab8b86b65657f4c2849667af59759c4"}

{"id": "p_3a93b68fa7a3faed", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 81, "text": "以進數有功，分五百戸，封一子列侯；進遷右將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "c5dde9ceb3c213eaf03f70ac6d37d2b931086b1aa9d4a0094ee3eb2f71bcfc93"}

{"id": "p_f5009086b57415a9", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 82, "text": "薨，諡曰威侯。子綝嗣。綝果毅有父風，官至揚州刺史。諸葛誕反，掩襲殺綝，詔悼惜之，追贈衞尉，諡曰愍侯。子肇嗣。 ==于禁== -{于}-禁字文則，泰山鉅平人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "86b3254f253d04ac393802bfa2ad5b1f1152e9ec310d34e669ecdff7e9cfd864"}

{"id": "p_b6a767642312e079", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 83, "text": "黃巾起，鮑信招合徒衆，禁附從焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "12ecc953ea3eaa8032b7be17ac5e5077643d1b97ce26e86a0ede8d37e5a03388"}

{"id": "p_149cbc3c33d8a43b", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 84, "text": "及太祖領兗州，禁與其黨俱詣爲都伯，屬將軍王朗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "e0f728cc2c9993583b8ba208cbba70cf862e4a2bc2b9d486cf0ccfffd19a9b18"}

{"id": "p_5f6e92d82c3ca493", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 85, "text": "朗異之，薦禁-{才}-任大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "5f4cd02cd8b60b7c0bbde341ed67dcacbeb8362cbc81674305e3f5f064d8e871"}

{"id": "p_21a5751619e7cd45", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 86, "text": "太祖召見與語，拜軍司馬，使將兵詣徐州，攻廣威，拔之，拜陷陳都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "0b7ae197f18b7a85f7668e3bf7f0a4788ae4d6ea04bcdb83a792a783ffd68f96"}

{"id": "p_4491d9a43e46c460", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 87, "text": "從討呂布-{於}-濮陽，別破布二營-{於}-城南，又別將破高雅-{於}-須昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "b984b91812637d8e456a2295081cd61681900feda4b7997d4f004e0d06896536"}

{"id": "p_7070ca664be68157", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 88, "text": "從攻壽張、定陶、離狐，圍張超-{於}-雍丘，皆拔之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "f84eb67b14a5059b21c51c1048852666dacc2335a8ce65565e7080b7fc8366fa"}

{"id": "p_4bb19d2a10499277", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 89, "text": "從-{征}-黃巾劉-{辟}-、黃邵等，屯版梁，邵等夜襲太祖營，禁帥麾下擊破之，斬（辟、）邵等，盡降其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "049321ed9dde9685ad73b2384fa711dd0fbdbcce47b5b230db6988f149489289"}

{"id": "p_1c22d7b280cefd47", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 90, "text": "遷平虜校尉。從圍橋蕤-{於}-苦，斬蕤等四將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "2bc9b87827a5ebf9d69c3d703b4bdbd3f464a1ed294f8fd71c86cfd937a0868f"}

{"id": "p_ffa53d0f67d76930", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 91, "text": "從至宛，降張繡。繡復叛，太祖與戰不利，軍敗，還舞陰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "dad2eb0a33a003432fd3845f57a2d3dff7f151a29e77734051d4703685aa9c5d"}

{"id": "p_55e37089fccc3b74", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 92, "text": "是時軍亂，各間行求太祖，禁獨勒所將數百人，且戰且引，雖有死傷不相離。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "186e75dd55c4b38848445a4825c6e89585b300cee65f761156ea3e1b63cdc6e7"}

{"id": "p_87f0740220d0ba4d", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 93, "text": "虜追稍緩，禁徐整行隊，鳴鼓而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "4ea7cd418306ec748c52a6bfef5b01564d9d8c6e39be9138d113fce4402c35dc"}

{"id": "p_17d1e2991552f0f2", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 94, "text": "未至太祖所，道見十餘人被創裸走，禁問其故，曰：「爲靑州兵所劫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "b58df324765bc84399ceaf111faae7568adee0c090f2387a6b7760a5c94355ba"}

{"id": "p_5bf9ce0438276e45", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」初，黃巾降，號靑州兵，太祖寛之，故敢因緣爲略。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "94a5b3d540a2515a9894c62315ac3fff45640c590dc34928c1ecb5e6325b127c"}
