{"id": "p_2b8ef86f915f4e57", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 96, "text": "禁怒，令其衆曰：「靑州兵同屬曹公，而還爲賊乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "b8151fb004f9a845d6d061a04378b0853a9703075a413790d1453420185abea4"}

{"id": "p_d4b736730cdcb0c8", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」乃討之，數之以罪。靑州兵遽走詣太祖自訴。禁旣至，先立營壘，不時謁太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "fa8337b735f20f3c10bcb1be8cc3d8c5a1c77b48d935cdc6766fa3ce01787f33"}

{"id": "p_c4bab5f4a09e18bb", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 98, "text": "或謂禁：「靑州兵已訴君矣，宜促詣公辨之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "bb1deaf5c434af2ed372bbd9bbc5280d1b9d6657237e4531993f3484ace73166"}

{"id": "p_168f01165c384398", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 99, "text": "」禁曰：「今賊在-{後}-，追至無時，不先爲備，何以待敵？", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "f29b9b7ecb70fbc2287c4b0093f49f9175783e694733e022ca82f218a851779b"}

{"id": "p_299c2d36b26740e8", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 100, "text": "且公聰明，譖訴何緣！」徐鑿塹安營訖，乃入謁，具陳其狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "7f43370ce44007087ea28f9ce354f12f86332bbd85b3aea3b3aa6c1c75202330"}

{"id": "p_ea48fc8ae3a52546", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 101, "text": "太祖悅，謂禁曰：「淯水之難，吾其急也，將軍在亂能整，討暴堅壘，有不可動之節，雖古名將，何以加之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "fee3e58f08705877ebd800bced8aa1b3ba31fd45bd09b2344ae06385e98bbff1"}

{"id": "p_df09136a04cea285", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 102, "text": "」-{於}-是録禁前-{後}-功，封益壽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "ecbc9ed3f3173e97c3fc63ddf577d551083af8cd1f90c7470fce5ee27b382e6f"}

{"id": "p_4561ca7a072a526f", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 103, "text": "復從攻張繡-{於}-穰，禽呂布-{於}-下邳，別與史渙、曹仁攻眭固-{於}-射犬，破斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "05d886e8d69da3c37dddd5db95baead16877884ed5c4e1c827cdc1422ae93bb9"}

{"id": "p_5de48de4ee3e45ce", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 104, "text": " 太祖初-{征}-袁紹，紹兵盛，禁原爲先登。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "8b0431692e6ac66a85a946c46c66cf3c398e59b217dd383c7ee20cd62dfe27f9"}

{"id": "p_c28a51678973b497", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 105, "text": "太祖壯之，乃遣步卒二千人，使禁將，守延津以拒紹，太祖引軍還官渡。劉備以徐州叛，太祖東-{征}-之。紹攻禁，禁堅守，紹不能拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "059bd473c6d4bd092e146e916b6eb54ee60deb71e4bb31a87cfa2a21e8d92888"}

{"id": "p_ea43a9c5abc4339f", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 106, "text": "復與樂進等將步騎五千，擊紹別營，從延津西南緣河至汲、獲嘉二縣，焚燒保聚三十餘屯，斬首獲生各數千，降紹將何茂、王摩等二十餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "c163c9a562b045c4ff92c10409a8fee298699d90fa844d843412d2f62e56bb80"}

{"id": "p_08272404fbe1b341", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 107, "text": "太祖復使禁別將屯原武，擊紹別營-{於}-杜氏津，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "74e605b6875c3e977b0a2d4f936cecfbbc0f3edec5de127264a7d5d2595edc74"}

{"id": "p_82f8b002aa669e4f", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 108, "text": "遷裨將軍，-{後}-從還官渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "50738128904b63309721bcb795422793fa661cc0e0af2546739dd6696534699d"}

{"id": "p_f1cf34a2944ef8d8", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 109, "text": "太祖與紹連營，起土山相對。紹射營中，士卒多死傷，軍中懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "4b9ca55dd2002ccc8563888e9257e2a8be11868fde8da6754a9bd31157b26882"}

{"id": "p_d99b9d66cb55d5cd", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 110, "text": "禁督守土山，力戰，氣益奮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "577dd606ffd86d9cdf1ea2302907caf6c5e9f2838685b3238cce1de13aeab895"}

{"id": "p_d484f3949a2edef4", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 111, "text": "紹破，遷偏將軍。冀州平。昌豨復叛，遣禁-{征}-之。禁急進攻豨；豨與禁有舊，詣禁降。諸將皆以爲豨已降，當送詣太祖，禁曰：「諸君不知公常令乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "8088dc9781fee396062198625356a1895b8c9c98f262af2be5c9c1142c115435"}

{"id": "p_97b2dd71df628e2c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 112, "text": "圍而-{後}-降者不赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "dac36700224ead00a39b6d8219513908c330d573a3c83a3b75bc9a717397c834"}

{"id": "p_964ac1b5e42d7603", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 113, "text": "夫奉法行令，事上之節也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "02e69946816c194659d0ad1b46f526f111c841d972932b4b4fa17d17b9949d01"}

{"id": "p_d287f0f4cc2f8cc7", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 114, "text": "豨雖舊友，禁可失節乎！」自臨與豨決，隕涕而斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "51147a7e23927ef6884fb70b84eeb35db70e8e0d94e1065d9497de8e8b2b03f3"}

{"id": "p_431ea246203567f1", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 115, "text": "是時太祖軍淳-{于}-，聞而嘆曰：「豨降不詣吾而歸禁，豈非命耶！", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "09d79953a586277d4db4d841a787f239c358d15c0a36a0043014f77c89da672d"}

{"id": "p_787001d8c7ad467e", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 116, "text": "」益重禁。東海平，拜禁虎威將軍。-{後}-與臧霸等攻梅成，張遼、張郃等討陳蘭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "d5c96345f4cc11f62f5fedb1ccfc77b5b399b29996fa79d4e5db2ddea6d2a2b6"}

{"id": "p_bc24f3956cddb006", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 117, "text": "禁到，成舉衆三千餘人降。旣降復叛，其衆奔蘭。遼等與蘭相持，軍食少，禁運糧前-{後}-相屬，遼遂斬蘭成。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "900e709439aec382d116fd27167a9c102153f4c9479eb051f82b4fb1a2ebf8cf"}

{"id": "p_f8de1ba56d4e82ac", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 118, "text": "增邑二百戸，並前千二百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "b8a6f9308ff04331d3c4ca3ca9b9f95e0ea3b639d41d38a257e913a0b6f93dd0"}

{"id": "p_d26f85fb6dbb42ec", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 119, "text": "是時，禁與張遼、樂進、張郃、徐晃俱爲名將，太祖每-{征}-伐，-{咸}-遞行爲軍鋒，還爲-{後}-拒；而禁持軍嚴整，得賊財物，無所私入，由是賞賜特重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "59fe23677276210c7d3a430d1a90e2014f726cb3b211798a4f0fadb36987461a"}

{"id": "p_b1858a99328b7a6a", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 120, "text": "然以法-{御}-下，不甚得士衆心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "9be4f4cdb3aaf04cd5e05992d613174ac82ee762dc750d217fc8c473e140b998"}

{"id": "p_554e99a062294a1b", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 121, "text": "太祖常恨-{朱}-靈，欲奪其營。以禁有威重，遣禁將數十騎，賫令書，徑詣靈營奪其軍，靈及其部衆莫敢動；乃以靈爲禁部下督，衆皆震服，其見憚如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "00a2aebea0ff963c9fb08c74966e0306c63a4e8066e19f67d81ab893e82e52bd"}

{"id": "p_8658c4230e72cb9c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 122, "text": "遷左將軍，假節鉞，分邑五百戸，封一子列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "349ade79c6eff22ba69c7ea4c6c31659ecedbbd612955563408bc4cd38d711fa"}

{"id": "p_c019596fcc39a61c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 123, "text": " ，太祖在長安，使曹仁討關羽-{於}-樊，又遣禁助仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "f7ee28ddab3e441734535d2988429d9fa47b0fd41f6081034bfec5b073c0562a"}

{"id": "p_747851d1e9979299", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 124, "text": "秋，大霖雨，漢水溢，平地水數丈，禁等七軍皆沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "a85800abcf17734f16e7fdcec76eff15893e4160e83a68f13e7db486bca75c16"}

{"id": "p_f45f88fb02e71461", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 125, "text": "禁與諸將登高望水，無所回避，羽乘大船就攻禁等，禁遂降，惟龐德不屈節而死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "3c43a2d742a981cc8d9ad100b46fc94856f08f8c908858828881adba126b78c4"}

{"id": "p_9dfba01c58c6e11a", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 126, "text": "太祖聞之，哀嘆者久之，曰：「吾知禁三十年，何意臨危處難，反不如龐德邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "4449627602b84f49c1bb7ff449779ffbc5468913725c8fee4021f72ff7ef5803"}

{"id": "p_15faadb3f45f55d9", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」會孫權禽羽，獲其衆，禁復在吳。文帝踐阼，權稱籓，遣禁還。帝引見禁，-{鬚}--{髮}-皓白，形容憔悴，泣涕頓首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "befe1635f597e5496c381cfb3ca0154d4c130e9be09ad25a33bc3907f2c02710"}

{"id": "p_5298012e49b01bd2", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 128, "text": "帝慰諭以荀林父、孟明視故事，拜爲安遠將軍。欲遣使吳，先令北詣鄴謁高陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "4b718e6c5854d8bb8f8924a9be6148aba96545ecfe09535b9536def17536bbfe"}

{"id": "p_f577ee18d7bca0ff", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 129, "text": "帝使豫-{於}-陵屋畫關羽戰克、龐德憤怒、禁降服之狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "36ce7b5e8c9d41bebbbd4ead7d7bdae7990534559d87372cde9dfc302bd152c2"}

{"id": "p_88d3c1ae7de24b06", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 130, "text": "禁見，慚恚發病薨。子圭嗣，封益壽亭侯。諡禁曰厲侯。 ==張郃== 張郃字雋乂，河間鄚人也。漢末應募討黃巾，爲軍司馬，屬韓馥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "4669846d198b4adc367aa507ec4a0a53f9699509fc91aad4a4c3a1248751b993"}

{"id": "p_f8f1c5794d9d6b17", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 131, "text": "馥敗，以兵歸袁紹。紹以郃爲校尉，使拒公孫瓚。瓚破，郃功多，遷寧國中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "c0a304614fe50472ac3195dcf74e03859c056442e41b8ef2219e6dac900dbde0"}

{"id": "p_32f395f2f0531fe3", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 132, "text": "太祖與袁紹相拒-{於}-官渡，紹遣將淳-{于}-瓊等督運屯烏巢，太祖自將急擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "7ed71ec4bb184f68a51d83de94eb38d535fe2c72ba1700e29a8e3e041d77af3c"}

{"id": "p_0c2b0c9844142e64", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 133, "text": "郃説紹曰：「曹公兵精，往必破瓊等；瓊等破，則將軍事去矣，宜急引兵救之。」郭圖曰：「郃計非也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "102cb374ba4ed5d440dc9a888400201913c6b280e05d9c13615f770050c49b9d"}

{"id": "p_669bf206533dc621", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 134, "text": "不如攻其本營，勢必還，此爲不救而自解也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "6c7471925cc53bc25ad87413aa0b05d17026df1bb905d006d2001145ff67df9c"}

{"id": "p_d13d4c05df90d413", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 135, "text": "」郃曰：「曹公營固，攻之必不拔，若瓊等見禽，吾屬盡爲虜矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "903aa562163e5906b08110d71c737ebc92ab1b87e833839154f48a88d7495e78"}

{"id": "p_df077f688bbea169", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 136, "text": "」紹但遣輕騎救瓊，而以重兵攻太祖營，不能下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "dc35cfcc22cca30710be4e637414a0e4a6943e120a817e8562540d38c1fdf7a0"}

{"id": "p_dce38a131e63bcca", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 137, "text": "太祖果破瓊等，紹軍潰。圖慚，又更譖郃曰：「郃快軍敗，出言不遜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "c7e04a0ac4934d4f6bb74656f6b476521376a0fca502b65e3c74a654aabe0326"}

{"id": "p_8b24fca5ac53187d", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 138, "text": "」郃懼，乃歸太祖。 太祖得郃甚喜，謂曰：「昔子胥不早寤，自使身危，豈若微子去殷、韓信歸漢邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "563db000918d9d7420a446a8496379e3df50d84f50ef5144ebf790fade59b5a9"}

{"id": "p_5a478bd86ac5a50e", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 139, "text": "」拜郃偏將軍，封都亭侯。授以衆，從攻鄴，拔之。又從擊袁譚-{於}-渤海，別將軍圍雍奴，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "6ba079b7260a2b1786f8d88d55e1cdb223796663ba66ad20d0b2a3b02b8e61ce"}

{"id": "p_8f5e48312735d86c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 140, "text": "從討柳城，與張遼俱爲軍鋒，以功遷平狄將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "8df6cc5947c0af37d11b309c65ee32f7ef8936f9bd9305d13645449d7f6305fb"}

{"id": "p_301fbb6a3786e298", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 141, "text": "別-{征}-東萊，討管承，又與張遼討陳蘭、梅成等，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "fe1b1d4272c16e04dbecb8e93bac5a8f95500f2475e688d160144392d92f902a"}

{"id": "p_bbada44949aa5dd4", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 142, "text": "從破馬超、韓遂-{於}-渭南。圍安定，降楊秋。與夏侯淵討鄜賊梁興及武都氐。又破馬超，平宋建。太祖-{征}-張魯，先遣郃督諸軍討興和氐王竇茂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "41b92460a5c0cfe8facab0634dc49ab2770892ddc349dbcd30782cb976f4e363"}

{"id": "p_ad2410b1b5705cd6", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 143, "text": "太祖從散關入漢中，又先遣郃督步卒五千-{於}-前通路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "a07ad2d46466da556a680a2cbb8d9cf3e594e63519167ba6be210d85c3e61968"}

{"id": "p_f754b04c00c4d45c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 144, "text": "至陽平，魯降，太祖還，留郃與夏侯淵等守漢中，拒劉備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "28753ff4affe8bf7f36859c2824756ba9bb4491143cb2f024224a573bdb69ea5"}

{"id": "p_6ddeba987f411188", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 145, "text": "郃別督諸軍，降巴東、巴西二郡，徙其民-{於}-漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "af527df964a39bc9fbab13a9c99e06c0662bcdb83e59a8aedd459ec3d117efc5"}

{"id": "p_e08fe150f6c002a7", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 146, "text": "進軍宕渠，爲備將張飛所拒，引還南鄭。拜蕩寇將軍。劉備屯陽平，郃屯廣石。備以精卒萬餘，分爲十部，夜急攻郃。郃率親兵搏戰，備不能克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "c9674c665f0c6a2e663f6c34394ada8e3b23731f6c08d9d7000369092ecbb45f"}

{"id": "p_d3847863791e62c5", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 147, "text": "其-{後}-備-{於}-走馬-{谷}-燒都圍，淵救火，從他道與備相遇，交戰，短兵接刃。淵遂沒，郃還陽平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "2658a09754cb934ff12d82526c84ddd948d47bde8e4a0402d0fcda326d516998"}

{"id": "p_ee5f20573e81b0d6", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 148, "text": "當是時，新失元帥，恐爲備所乘，三軍皆失色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "cda1ae831872879625408276c34ea8bf4bf477be3fc5d5c90445b93922b4af24"}

{"id": "p_42ad09ee1544e840", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 149, "text": "淵司馬郭淮乃令衆曰：「張將軍，國家名將，劉備所憚；今日事急，非張將軍不能安也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "a5e39515c46d94fc6826d35144eda0c3e1784c442511ad0bab48d5d59d6b1ceb"}

{"id": "p_2371108ffba16bc4", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」遂推郃爲軍主。郃出，勒兵安陳，諸將皆受郃節度，衆心乃定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "595ff6fbe8d9dabaa2741b47f56b3ba3f81e46709b352c9ff92b44dfd1f13555"}

{"id": "p_1e7935fa06d2d9b8", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 151, "text": "太祖在長安，遣使假郃節。太祖遂自至漢中，劉備保高山不敢戰。太祖乃引出漢中諸軍，郃還屯陳倉。 文帝即王位，以郃爲左將軍，進爵都鄕侯。及踐阼，進封鄚侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "4345604181ecd7c96ee4e0aed894129feee38d5351e7bfe226c86f997d0a5efb"}

{"id": "p_6dcca225b0a98b20", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 152, "text": "詔郃與曹眞討安定盧水胡及東羌，召郃與眞並朝許宮，遣南與夏侯尙擊江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "69d1832176e18d945bfcc78088365a9fd88d93a5efb698b4a1b6da3c512e3dd2"}

{"id": "p_e790be042ae625fe", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 153, "text": "郃別督諸軍渡江，取洲上屯塢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "555fa8027fb338bca38e904144eb18eaa18921d914f53e1d8470f2bfa24d9df3"}

{"id": "p_5ec94e058a4a3dec", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 154, "text": "明帝即位，遣南屯荆州，與司馬宣王擊孫權別將劉阿等，追至祁口，交戰，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "46f05a2f71078d1cd4d507fc51c59de57a6a04c96726bf50ba28ea4ab85943c0"}

{"id": "p_25ae44a9057ae1fa", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 155, "text": "諸葛亮出祁山。加郃位特進，遣督諸軍，拒亮將馬謖-{於}-街亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "6ec2a006a5d909a7c7dda37c14f330c78724004ee6e4a6a8de0a0f5e13a6597d"}

{"id": "p_b034d909bf4c45ae", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 156, "text": "謖依阻南山，不下-{據}-城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "818bed67c3de73aaaf515e286298ea6f868cb00ad2e69e16909c4a4d13f472b2"}

{"id": "p_d8becd43003c269a", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 157, "text": "郃-{絶}-其汲道，擊，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "598010304b09484604d45439cd03e56e76d0a32c531cd53d70cf973f4e363123"}

{"id": "p_0af4d217bbaac5b8", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 158, "text": "南安、天水、安定郡反應亮，郃皆破平之。詔曰：「賊亮以巴蜀之衆，當虓虎之師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "f67ec025ee52ff177bfabadac748d022daefd63564cb3ae31a29c19a6d19a700"}

{"id": "p_8fb8e3b83429326b", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 159, "text": "將軍被堅執鋭，所向克定，朕甚嘉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "79c8f6a6c2f6852f88d94810cc3282e4174037d646e28819b4055f80baf60a36"}

{"id": "p_c3bf06d3daa2d7be", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 160, "text": "益邑千戸，並前四千三百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "b8bf166b133f7cb0a1a832fe68089843931414153e1bd2103406eb542d34f2a4"}

{"id": "p_adea6cbae45c2da3", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 161, "text": "」司馬宣王治水軍-{於}-荆州，欲順沔入江伐吳，詔郃督關中諸軍往受節度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "fed976eb9d5a775d65c0ffa11e3436feaf4d4f05db400ed0072a420e91bfb320"}

{"id": "p_0486c18860ce4986", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 162, "text": "至荆州，會冬水淺，大船不得行，乃還屯方城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "553261f095d221a5e56ae6cb2959f77edacf9c185535b140cc735c885e919c39"}

{"id": "p_5896699f7085b836", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 163, "text": "諸葛亮復出，急攻陳倉，帝驛馬召郃到京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "a6f1cf3a11ae03257b77dd55de1f7c49aa466d395bba86c03ef19ed410aae807"}

{"id": "p_51dcc25ebb9e1c3b", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 164, "text": "帝自幸河南城，置酒送郃，遣南北軍士三萬及分遣武衞、虎賁使衞郃，因問郃曰：「遲將軍到，亮得無已得陳倉乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "48d37af557c2d77e366fff734f02a2236ec57e401d86750f0ecede92d156b072"}

{"id": "p_cdaf2b709390e25e", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 165, "text": "」郃知亮縣軍無-{穀}-，不能久攻，對曰：「比臣未到，亮已走矣；屈指計亮糧不至十日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "a4f02b5fc9e1db34da619ff90bdf656dcca528eaebc8e3fc8e7240f03493a3fd"}

{"id": "p_cccd0423e36ed485", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」郃晨夜進至南鄭，亮退。詔郃還京都，拜-{征}-西車騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "260ae5175caa13c4505487dd199fbde24b1e662e797a20979c38880f899cf1c7"}

{"id": "p_9c72613f363d2df4", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 167, "text": " 郃識變數，善處營陳，料戰勢地形，無不如計，自諸葛亮皆憚之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "c7305b6751f2f41ed6609f3918fd1a00d2ab0c9fa0cc5b7ee75c0b58fab8c20e"}

{"id": "p_b3600b731a2d3b4b", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 168, "text": "郃雖武將而愛樂儒士，嘗薦同鄕卑湛經明行修，詔曰：「昔祭遵爲將，奏置五經大夫，居軍中，與諸生雅歌投壺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "47a7b948a3066ee33e9d96b77df8c474e9bccbd66dda375f7ff8285c56ac4fbe"}

{"id": "p_e05348fcb820026c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 169, "text": "今將軍外勒戎旅，內存國朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "c97b5fc5f0f3f54a32b60e79d01150bd1ac8551605e744c3584803665069d054"}

{"id": "p_479d6fe029df1c6e", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 170, "text": "朕嘉將軍之意，今擢湛爲博士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "8ae920b5715e4f6e40451b7dd499fa57315f95ac1df771683388dafc4028f4da"}

{"id": "p_701b4359ab99a3c0", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 171, "text": "」 諸葛亮復出祁山，詔郃督諸將西至略陽，亮還保祁山，郃追至木門，與亮軍交戰，飛矢中郃右膝，薨，諡曰壯侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "17a6bc2269e49599983c795731ce53fa9cf8c65d2e18f8176b31f8e45b76bcdf"}

{"id": "p_56b504354444569d", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 172, "text": "子雄嗣。郃前-{後}--{征}-伐有功，明帝分郃戸，封郃四子列侯。賜小子爵關內侯。 ==徐晃== 徐晃字公明，河東楊人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "af0f3f20d00fffe0a281f7de83c7ab9b06ffa69474e52200fa866bb9aa040b75"}

{"id": "p_0b39e1c4c8b6820c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 173, "text": "爲郡吏，從車騎將軍楊奉討賊有功，拜騎都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "455cf52850493934b4a6c12e1d9f3f8fded1143a6e54dc9763ce7860c7492e0a"}

{"id": "p_b0b7e95faaa3952a", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 174, "text": "李傕、郭汜之亂長安也，晃説奉，令與天子還洛陽，奉從其計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "32a7aab58ce2262ddcea42f1659e932466729ff3a7f3904d931e350279c7f796"}

{"id": "p_b75830ab5bd5d098", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 175, "text": "天子渡河至安邑，封晃都亭侯。及到洛陽，韓暹、董承日爭-{鬬}-，晃説奉令歸太祖；奉欲從之，-{後}-悔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "3bc9eb1a411497b8ec44221c182fb228bd4cf69439a44044064b3af52639b836"}

{"id": "p_1419f191d57f4d2a", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 176, "text": "太祖討奉-{於}-梁，晃遂歸太祖。 太祖授晃兵，使擊卷原武賊，破之，拜裨將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "7f0ab9ba601c3718425dc5003b6295852099fa8c263c61344012e0921d059eb1"}

{"id": "p_4546f6981b43b9d4", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 177, "text": "從-{征}-呂布，別降布將趙庶、李鄒等。與史渙斬眭固-{於}-河內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "aa262b6fe17ef62a78954a3e3574dfe3446c0766f65ad29ede7482df4f92bdfe"}

{"id": "p_e7338f64453e7d15", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 178, "text": "從破劉備，又從破顔良，拔白馬，進至延津，破文-{醜}-，拜偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "539369c961e2f811acf17d8ac60e8437522cce00b298f6165b7d94645de7589a"}

{"id": "p_dff235f967bf6779", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 179, "text": "與曹洪擊㶏強賊祝臂，破之，又與史渙擊袁紹運車-{於}-故市，功最多，封都亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "f915e0f1a23927a522ae2908f0edcc659f10e3605bb554d429e955bfa67aefe9"}

{"id": "p_d2474975ca1956b3", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 180, "text": "太祖旣圍鄴，破邯鄲，易陽令韓-{範}-僞以城降而拒守，太祖遣晃攻之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "af9278c45b8aae6012378064ba355bd7cc260896ff354bf47e481d026da08441"}

{"id": "p_4b9f1e4f38885418", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 181, "text": "晃至，飛矢城中，爲陳成敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "c761f62a80edf43ee5b3331e6781d9402dfdd9e2b8d7b68fe9cab364ea77b010"}

{"id": "p_ef8d0ab523f29ad9", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 182, "text": "-{範}-悔，晃輒降之。旣而言-{於}-太祖曰：「二袁未破，諸城未下者傾耳而聽，今日滅易陽，明日皆以死守，恐河北無定時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "e15e197af2aaa9fb4295bbab273f120380011082e9b7cc998950b3824b350661"}

{"id": "p_e256f051e65c454c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 183, "text": "原公降易陽以示諸城，則莫不望風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "b7e769c9604b2eff7894aded796ed3980253127678b5a86ed0693a3baeb1945d"}

{"id": "p_50f938098fd52749", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 184, "text": "」太祖善之。別討毛城，設伏兵掩擊，破三屯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "645b35a88f145cbc2511eafc37fd68e30f882a3a0dbb83dc89e309aef6a506cf"}

{"id": "p_4e5d1ffff225653c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 185, "text": "從破袁譚-{於}-南皮，討平原叛賊，克之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "a237ef8fce0cdadc1cee39d9c003c2a8b3b4eb3b9d7c489edaf2a4949b3ccbda"}

{"id": "p_3f6adee4188120ad", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 186, "text": "從-{征}-蹋頓，拜橫野將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "fd7e4d7e1ece31675fabd99e599602c6f7e6ff41b87441da752ba7811413599a"}

{"id": "p_69999d9d1f2dfab6", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 187, "text": "從-{征}-荆州，別屯樊，討中廬、臨沮、宜城賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "f0ffd4e906aab33bbfb749a6e2d840aa8d7b6072bc6897d6f93ccc3e8d0f8666"}

{"id": "p_edb3a099135e224c", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 188, "text": "又與滿寵討關羽-{於}-漢津，與曹仁擊周瑜-{於}-江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "c66b45fd3d3f9c0ae4128a88a195fae7bcec43abf533f3d555b07c3a04ca179f"}

{"id": "p_6a19c7e9f91f24ab", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 189, "text": "十五年，討太原反者，圍大陵，拔之，斬賊帥商曜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "1b21510161627766c0cce17caa28f4e07ce6bd78c4d7c84383baea1da521028b"}

{"id": "p_da2488f9e60a444e", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 190, "text": "韓遂、馬超等反關右，遣晃屯汾陰以撫河東，賜牛酒，令上先人墓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "5b725c6f6513ba656b603ec335aa4d44e50d244d36048d98331aa03e5e97b86a"}

{"id": "p_b8f11672493feee8", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 191, "text": "太祖至潼關，恐不得渡，召問晃。晃曰：「公盛兵-{於}-此，而賊不復別守蒲阪，知其無謀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "1dd6b7810b25324bb2b5cd8a3320dd04620787642fdef32157861a25cb425beb"}

{"id": "p_c1301a6fefe0a9b5", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 192, "text": "今假臣精兵渡蒲坂津，爲軍先置，以截其-{裏}-，賊可擒也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "bbc6c6ef76bf8ef03e45102d7c52785afab59a18d161263d2da23b8f5c2312d5"}

{"id": "p_b2d1c7f47604a2a8", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 193, "text": "」太祖曰：「善。」使晃以步騎四千人渡津。作塹柵未成，賊梁興夜將步騎五千餘人攻晃，晃擊走之，太祖軍得渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "3f2c35fa36adbc98948b69ac6fb96833a1e4b8ebf289087d3112ae5d47448d1f"}

{"id": "p_fe9f87bfc673b8e1", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 194, "text": "遂破超等，使晃與夏侯淵平隃麋、汧諸氐，與太祖會安定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "1871f3b5bb52651ea7cf070786ebfb9fca95474a7562a4c4870c76ada5dbe4b0"}

{"id": "p_2329e198932e01b9", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 195, "text": "太祖還鄴，使晃與夏侯淵平鄜、夏陽餘賊，斬梁興，降三千餘戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "874bebf05e4274d5a937c5e572fe7d71028a9f29815a37cc62425cb2551b9d5a"}

{"id": "p_e89bcd4e200c64bc", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 196, "text": "從-{征}-張魯。別遣晃討攻櫝、仇夷諸山氐，皆降之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "f0d5c8d32aebdbd22e3a54e754ff387946da783ba3b34630e9e239f1ae5772c7"}

{"id": "p_38dfc73aca337f73", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 197, "text": "遷平寇將軍。解將軍張順圍。擊賊陳福等三十餘屯，皆破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "091fc2383dfec1316ec235003429b81b515df342f44b789e6763fdac5a29b17e"}

{"id": "p_c0d087b4a341c191", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 198, "text": " 太祖還鄴，留晃與夏侯淵拒劉備-{於}-陽平。備遣陳式等十餘營-{絶}-馬鳴閣道，晃別-{征}-破之，賊自投山-{谷}-，多死者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "ca5c94f50cbb46be3b42a8e00ab607049b99def55bcdc0c18e1c2426363e48b3"}

{"id": "p_84f14f4a5c29c23d", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 199, "text": "太祖聞，甚喜，假晃節，令曰：「此閣道，漢中之險要咽喉也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "fbdc53b709953c7891bcdc7e29ea19a57e68658c43496057ad9e7ec15d99cb47"}

{"id": "p_33bbb6bb4a9cb719", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 200, "text": "劉備欲斷-{絶}-外內，以取漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "718c132aa237183d46fe59536f5b22bb648a0b723fc191d0c63184cd60a31e14"}

{"id": "p_db56f56ba8b434ec", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 201, "text": "將軍一舉，克奪賊計，善之善者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "98655f239508eb4c68177b03f834361a3190e917d610fd3111daf32133a1bd49"}

{"id": "p_6ff5a03793a6bc06", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 202, "text": "」太祖遂自至陽平，引出漢中諸軍。復遣晃助曹仁討關羽，屯宛。會漢水暴隘，-{于}-禁等沒。羽圍仁-{於}-樊，又圍將軍呂常-{於}-襄陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "d73654aeae70a7ae466a1c4ca5d5fe2cd4fd7fc357c539a68f73aa81a902fcc1"}

{"id": "p_3e148e86420d3769", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 203, "text": "晃所將多新卒，以羽難與爭鋒，遂前至陽陵陂屯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "6356990aef18c5be9996f83fa64717f1865ebbc47db870a2281768cf6d260fa1"}

{"id": "p_69ea5eb46c788ced", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 204, "text": "太祖復還，遣將軍徐商、呂建等詣晃，令曰：「須兵馬集至，乃俱前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "64653698b11bd4260cba3c392d78ab2b1d422e0a1b8ada391ca6542ea0e6be85"}

{"id": "p_eba164228fd6bb61", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 205, "text": "」賊屯偃城。晃到，詭道作都塹，示欲截其-{後}-，賊燒屯走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "82d5f9e1d6d27923ce6eb27463d7b1cef4005973564c3cb4e697e29a8b95353c"}

{"id": "p_6fc3583ced23bd38", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 206, "text": "晃得偃城，兩面連營，稍前，去賊圍三丈所。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "bf13beb57be0a2384e2d898439300b0322c34e2b5b3d65543b4dbcefebe80b80"}

{"id": "p_502298e564ea69ac", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 207, "text": "未攻，太祖前-{後}-遣殷署、-{朱}-蓋等凡十二營詣晃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "ddab801bc661c312fc4ae96060c15e06aa1eeee37a556d94e6f78e4c3f8ffc55"}

{"id": "p_e4e9a7fde04005dd", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 208, "text": "賊圍頭有屯，又別屯四冢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "d3ffc5da3af26834677989c78d499820fee564d3ad53b998f051aff594c92728"}

{"id": "p_5b9842ef8d20f9c2", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 209, "text": "晃揚聲當攻圍頭屯，而密攻四冢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "b9dc413882cc2904e3472c8f27c73ed91d845633cfa85f885ee15c6b92087ba9"}

{"id": "p_5b019b2849f02dfd", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 210, "text": "羽見四冢欲壞，自將步騎五千出戰，晃擊之，退走，遂追陷與俱入圍，破之，或自投沔水死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "ac10c296e689cfa3ce799948c0b94e472fe2a1ad5452bb78fef708a5ffd8217f"}

{"id": "p_3ce3dbc9948a3952", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 211, "text": "太祖令曰：「賊圍塹鹿角十重，將軍致戰全勝，遂陷賊圍，多斬首虜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "46d8d8223927e612a3b44af602e9e50b1e891d5949b7733dad61a32aa351a0af"}

{"id": "p_bc3a1cb325ee45a6", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 212, "text": "吾用兵三十餘年，及所聞古之善用兵者，未有長驅徑入敵圍者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "7bc76a2da14f6175eb723a7e469da357002f9a806fe26514945e67444a94d5e7"}

{"id": "p_497f8e570a5eb620", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 213, "text": "且樊、襄陽之在圍，過-{於}-莒、即墨，將軍之功，逾孫武、穰苴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "7445808e1ce4a68d8cfa21ac1170e291ed05bc7e417bd552b12c08663e223c2c"}

{"id": "p_db7c236e45122afe", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 214, "text": "」晃振旅還摩陂，太祖迎晃七-{里}-，置酒大會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "c5e2d739bd0f798b3f16c5f6a7de05a8c2e8151d7e8aff5fd532487494d1303a"}

{"id": "p_deaed272d8c41e7f", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 215, "text": "太祖舉-{巵}-酒勸晃，且勞之曰：「全樊、襄陽，將軍之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "8dc39f2a45d9fd6faa769a1e5354d9d2adb7a8f3275e01ab4dbaec2c06e9f6d9"}

{"id": "p_36be9b00f8eb4cfb", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 216, "text": "」時諸軍皆集，太祖案行諸營，士卒-{咸}-離陳觀，而晃軍營整齊，將士駐陳不動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "c770b7617bc31a1ddab1089f5e92e8d537b23d0009f4736982eceba9eb4df312"}

{"id": "p_bcc0cff8e250a611", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 217, "text": "太祖嘆曰：「徐將軍可謂有周亞夫之風矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "47f5c65df1cd4bf8bee3a28dadbacd596b22907e9950fcdd28bb7c55c61e335f"}

{"id": "p_2b97dd89cc491ad5", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 218, "text": "」 文帝即王位，以晃爲右將軍，進封逯鄕侯。及踐阼，進封楊侯。與夏侯尙討劉備-{於}-上庸，破之。以晃鎮陽平，徙封陽平侯。明帝即位，拒吳將諸葛瑾-{於}-襄陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "9f2c5c3157ff07b562451b0e1b67bd34ce9cb5ad6ab261f53953a578bf2fbffb"}

{"id": "p_86a63241b6657a1f", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 219, "text": "增邑二百，並前三千一百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "74b7e493e152f71a7877d2421cce9f76168651da2da3a39c86a6a8b52b7bb6b3"}

{"id": "p_cb056f35b515ec3f", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 220, "text": "病篤，遺令斂以時服。 性儉約畏愼，將軍常遠斥候，先爲不可勝，然-{後}-戰，追奔爭利，士不暇食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "2eba700e4b4ecc3569e6ba11b056ccd8913ccc3a36f937079f366e97f2acd327"}

{"id": "p_63eea5e30e4a1328", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 221, "text": "常嘆曰：「古人患不遭明君，今幸遇之，常以功自效，何用私譽爲！", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "689bd5076c466f434c85bbe37fd9c4e7bba870bccbe4fffdfd8a1a2fddc688ac"}

{"id": "p_828b0737d7e4d9b8", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 222, "text": "」終不廣交援。薨，諡曰壯侯。子蓋嗣。蓋薨，子霸嗣。明帝分晃戸，封晃子孫二人列侯。 ===-{朱}-靈===", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "c5e367716da59d870532b6497fb02a39f42912eac69112b6550d5c38306fe250"}

{"id": "p_ad4f4eed5ef7ca8b", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 223, "text": " 初，清河-{朱}-靈爲袁紹將。太祖之-{征}-陶謙，紹使靈督三營助太祖，戰有功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "421794d4b4bf5c3187eb4693fa34547e1c9673ad014badb2779efbddcf6231d5"}

{"id": "p_e7dc8d38dc7c7a68", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 224, "text": "紹所遣諸將各罷歸，靈曰：「靈觀人多矣，無若曹公者，此乃眞明主也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "7a5351073b54ed1a7e08351fdc3accf5604cd2639a5df3b0c2b6c6c4ebda7153"}

{"id": "p_d19c6df5ba229f2b", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 225, "text": "今已遇，復何之？」遂留不去。所將士卒慕之，皆隨靈留。靈-{後}-遂爲好將，名亞晃等，至-{後}-將軍，封高唐（亭）侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "a4218ea724fd0d30e12ec8bf133691677a8fb4fbdb670312e58850f02049b04b"}

{"id": "p_5b42a77154a3a3c9", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 226, "text": " ==【評】== 評曰：太祖建茲武功，而時之良將，五子爲先。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "2dd929faea680ece4f1a7594731873616eccae5abef6ccdcbddf5ad3bdac3714"}

{"id": "p_4068d4b740bbd030", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 227, "text": "-{于}-禁最號毅重，然弗克其終。張郃以巧變爲稱，樂進以驍果顯名，而鑑其行事，未副所聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "d9a2684de933782113eaa37f955f87e01afa5b1ae251dc9d0cd34e5e44e87426"}

{"id": "p_83ddc5987952322f", "source_id": "src_f895cb3a808d7ca7", "ordinal": 228, "text": "或注記有遺漏，未如張遼、徐晃之備詳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "bcfbaeadf52f7c0b284b736122fc13fc53b2a1cd2018320d93171b4907214dda"}

{"id": "p_3bd3f5c019cd69f8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 0, "text": "李典字曼成，山陽鉅野人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "050aca085bfe4c083671ce9bd5d13e9ed764c38f5db598effb43f45f73bcb295"}

{"id": "p_66d28edb22eede3d", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 1, "text": "典從父乾，有雄氣，合賓客數千家在乘氏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "a95d11992d0a0b5acbaf93050a66c0ae9177b5a8f4e8d0ab996f326b6a489f3a"}

{"id": "p_fbb16b2bad5c140f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 2, "text": "初平中，以眾隨太祖，破黃巾於壽張，又從擊袁術，徵徐州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "27c4ea976ad70469e29224169ed5df82995586327cb1b1b7d8bfe079bcf57560"}

{"id": "p_793b3900d061fa25", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 3, "text": "呂布之亂，太祖遣乾還乘氏，慰勞諸縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "407a2d506145b61a338665d97b08e78b5e5f4f834d2d29129a0df1e99371c3be"}

{"id": "p_812e4f28d71167e8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 4, "text": "布別駕薛蘭、治中李封招乾，欲俱叛，乾不聽，遂殺乾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "d6001f26e9f6b000996e196da41829e1883308fd77f90a2922e5875ae70b565f"}

{"id": "p_a4a943c03f733e0c", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 5, "text": "太祖使乾子整將乾兵，與諸將擊蘭、封。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "b2677850e16315841e7f30f13fe30acf6e429d7d5dddd8a35c66c86bc146e612"}

{"id": "p_c20f17b6093a9e7e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 6, "text": "蘭、封破，從平兗州諸縣有功，稍遷青州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "35bf10c176e6a9f97456580bc49426d1e3e4f5308f25d2370c9801b9d8c0df6d"}

{"id": "p_cb206c5dbbe8d9e8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 7, "text": "整卒，典徙潁陰令，為中郎將，將整軍，遷離狐太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "9b57654a59b4f19fbae1d759e5ea5c07cd8cd3fb753ba30527e99648979552d6"}

{"id": "p_e1e1686b0d3a0e8e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 8, "text": "時太祖與袁紹相拒官渡，典率宗族及部曲輸谷帛供軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "c7cd4ba2329d3fb612e15870dc189e898a8303dbf30db407d47f6af753aac610"}

{"id": "p_6bf13adc8fa40b16", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 9, "text": "紹破，以典為裨將軍，屯安民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "d91093717d8c39dff37a9550d0206052f1672c50f5786d153da1d150d383dd0d"}

{"id": "p_06db5ca5eab91f16", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 10, "text": "太祖擊譚、尚於黎陽，使典與程昱等以船運軍糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "2a7b1458a5aa443ef28cca07f906d413001374dfff1155a21b7bce369544494d"}

{"id": "p_574bb95d74f489e3", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 11, "text": "會尚遣魏郡太守高蕃將兵屯河上，絕水道，太祖敕典、昱：「若船不得過，下從陸道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "56417f786bf318357d5585b6c297fa64542f4c674b9c2e57b884a3fb964de49f"}

{"id": "p_bd224f892b122f96", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」典與諸將議曰：「蕃軍少甲而恃水，有懈怠之心，擊之必克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "cf0f26c6c42bd28e584116730f0ac49c6237d0fa9b241c2f54f0becea9280368"}

{"id": "p_fb3ceabf27652f72", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 13, "text": "軍不內御；苟利國家，專之可也，宜亟擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "d5b6aa234e52e2445d39c0a960ef7bd4ff7e1a2ba5b45a7a2203bf57447ea094"}

{"id": "p_3732edd996127c98", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 14, "text": "遂北渡河，攻蕃，破之，水道得通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "c51a10b9fb2130fb29d3a17f61938017df2acf5af0109c6d86c6b0a03569d8d1"}

{"id": "p_94ad0f7580e1c357", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 15, "text": "劉表使劉備北侵，至葉，太祖遣典從夏侯惇拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "7f14f47257b121784dde9e922804b72f9c77a435f1d6e089f84c5f5e98d154b8"}

{"id": "p_cb53e1f3abaed002", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 16, "text": "備一旦燒屯去，惇率諸軍追擊之，典曰：「賊無故退，疑必有伏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "e1bddc81cd4cc6eaf4872203b30fb838707268b12e6518a2d27d71ba1d84c51f"}

{"id": "p_9e35fd6a981df6f5", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 17, "text": "南道狹窄，草木深，不可追也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "b19d954ced1fa6c97931a69413a290cb4cf25ec6a12d5d4906238d2dc032e853"}

{"id": "p_7cc03e808fe99b90", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 18, "text": "」惇不聽，與於禁追之，典留守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "9ca9948b2c28c1285727307292c3908203b69b2d2117cb25e214f3118db65f84"}

{"id": "p_22f2eb91ea649522", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 19, "text": "惇等果入賊伏里，戰不利，典往救，備望見救至，乃散退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "de7eb3bdaea1a33072f336a77a26fc92ad62de834514f0c8be13457d18acdd14"}

{"id": "p_e923fdfb2c7d7463", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 20, "text": "從圍鄴，鄴定，與樂進圍高幹於壺關，擊管承於長廣，皆破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "f059e4cfa6fca2963dbed873db74ae9d8254171aad5d8e2219ed383176788f6f"}

{"id": "p_7b074990035405ac", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 21, "text": "典宗族部曲三千餘家，居乘氏，自請原徙詣魏郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "10c4a831d9293e19ff2d15fd94c29d939f16d1609567541ccfcf7f9a76da80aa"}

{"id": "p_ddc91e4630eddee3", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 22, "text": "太祖笑曰：「卿欲慕耿純邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "acf56b4fd51a87876844bda8e1f6f1bade337da36ca6821e4ea6dd3af6bd565e"}

{"id": "p_ed2ce497283503b3", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」典謝曰：「典駑怯功微，而爵寵過厚，誠宜舉宗陳力；加以征伐未息，宜實郊遂之內，以制四方，非慕純也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "05fe7ed623eacf3d8125e16024e081856ad208dabba3c746d91bb0f5ad31f0d2"}

{"id": "p_a66d50d30e838b1d", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」遂徙部曲宗族萬三千餘口居鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "29d34c8933cbebbf7a65efa35bf03c16499d0f3834408608d8e01210b007e63a"}

{"id": "p_ad888a502e532ba5", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 25, "text": "與張遼、樂進屯合肥，孫權率眾圍之，遼欲奉教出戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "2f8ffc12ffa5a66805cbc6cb1be90cfa4ce9722de39361f8c3945659a2732472"}

{"id": "p_17641e111187b4a3", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 26, "text": "進、典、遼皆素不睦，遼恐其不從，典慨然曰：「此國家大事，顧君計何如耳，吾可以私憾而忘公義乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "c5b9d1dc1dfa1dd63b76c679ebc766ec998a60737b254fd02a9d286431197f87"}

{"id": "p_917abbc27780fd76", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 27, "text": "典好學問，貴儒雅，不與諸將爭功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "447a455fb36b5b8700084b8d56e033932bde7f56435e12bab30bef5562bb717d"}

{"id": "p_61dbdd862a90c04c", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 28, "text": "敬賢士大夫，恂恂若不及，軍中稱其長者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "b476105d52dc69148040a9004bb24db9216e567888e218fe15ef39d1c47e4822"}

{"id": "p_434f9530f9ae83f7", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 29, "text": "文帝踐阼，追念合肥之功，增禎邑百戶，賜典一子爵關內侯，邑百戶；謚典曰愍侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "4d544d6d2e67d167f4051de00d83305240f0df62a4bb55328b640b48de0e786f"}

{"id": "p_cf49ce7114f5505b", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 30, "text": "李通字文達，江夏平春人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "8b3bf535958482533fe30764619252dfab30b9c0962b10f8e60e92ac1f596361"}

{"id": "p_41687d798120d340", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 31, "text": "與其郡人陳恭共起兵於朗陵，眾多歸之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "290b3d64b96c9bd045b3c98410f36669082ebcf4dedcf8b41b4dcc25f4a7fec3"}

{"id": "p_5a52fcc433b267a8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 32, "text": "時有周直者，眾二千餘家，與恭、通外和內違。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "18fa701f59f661b311a2b9dd596e03fb89a67c43a4d7cfee3c2f01532b5c5d41"}

{"id": "p_4c3515ad2c2d211b", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 33, "text": "通知恭無斷，乃獨定策，與直克會，酒酣殺直。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "faa43e2ef9e38bb2ccb8a2518b9f789e6659ba9294c4742b3c6d2e82e31f9957"}

{"id": "p_010a7860e2fca614", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 34, "text": "眾人大擾，通率恭誅其黨帥，盡並其營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "624dd3614924714b1d630f99ade7c4a024c4aeec30a3dd37b24e3d544c670f56"}

{"id": "p_c552745684a15792", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 35, "text": "後恭妻弟陳郃，殺恭而據其眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "e6ddf6c5b7c1d5724a8eb11917f86801b6bd88b52f2b7d0ae2e91c2edabb84d4"}

{"id": "p_5ca646c4feefc857", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 36, "text": "通攻破郃軍，斬郃首以祭恭墓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "6c1bc28693bebb89e37a455e02e269d2a203896d88920971d6d5d1c1fa078e79"}

{"id": "p_d461ee0f11a85f0f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 37, "text": "又生禽黃巾大帥吳霸而降其屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "f30074b814571c67d1603327b74f981c2cca9100b39691ad44d1936a274b6ea5"}

{"id": "p_19eaa6373cc69988", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 38, "text": "遭歲大飢，通傾家振施，與士分糟糠，皆爭為用，由是盜賊不敢犯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "ea13ea2e96322c7aec872daa1774ac805828d99be256127225859ec1961b4a54"}

{"id": "p_5a124eb1bb33685f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 39, "text": "建安初，通舉眾詣太祖於許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "5ec5c807d770cfc475a71a75341e8943fcd7a002aea82c0bf9632d999fd13d54"}

{"id": "p_c5ed6c012a4cb0c1", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 40, "text": "拜通振威中郎將，屯汝南西界。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "5a424538c6ac4f77375b5468c0b04280f6a485c55b113e63c2254b07ae4f595b"}

{"id": "p_0e16fd2a6e49b68e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 41, "text": "太祖討張繡，劉表遣兵以助繡，太祖軍不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "ced9b6aa6e3cbabf534962074f56b6d889698ef4711b3250824569899d80b897"}

{"id": "p_ab49e8cadfc9f595", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 42, "text": "通將兵夜詣太祖，太祖得以復戰，通為先登，大破繡軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "a415297aed746d73357d93331c087d7b0cdb45e230eac7a3329661d88f110f05"}

{"id": "p_217ca6d6d4bec8c1", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 43, "text": "分汝南二縣，以通為陽安都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "349eeaf129fc0428c10c3fa497422483e4b9e85647755e2f6527515124aea2ce"}

{"id": "p_fec6fd2fdf9eb8b6", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 44, "text": "通妻伯父犯法，朗陵長趙儼收治，致之大辟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "dd42921572650cf533cba7e05ebf3629d65164ac52821706fc75619c77805e40"}

{"id": "p_07b8d158cbff18fd", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 45, "text": "是時殺生之柄，決於牧守，通妻子號泣以請其命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "506bb24874977d9f6fb9fc4b437dc31bab2187ab25b75bb6ac7a646e91fc83c0"}

{"id": "p_47fcba6fbb5313ba", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 46, "text": "通曰：「方與曹公戮力，義不以私廢公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "3a0616567ba1c50be416500c11351545c12f5a3ea7019e281983a90d8a56cf2b"}

{"id": "p_de183cdb8518b1d8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 47, "text": "」嘉儼執憲不阿，與為親交。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "91b06fc968da5f56759e26ed76222b81d4cf3f989cf045f0fb682abe791e8c5b"}

{"id": "p_8ad2a355d63206ba", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 48, "text": "紹遣使拜通徵南將軍，劉表亦陰招之，通皆拒焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "e8309f3e96d69687ca00f984044e6aa6d9e34f213ec46537c37e24f937dce4c2"}

{"id": "p_97f085474c38f7fa", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 49, "text": "通親戚部曲流涕曰：「今孤危獨守，以失大援，亡可立而待也，不如亟從紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "14a5fdad98e83f85dababf9fa2cae70a7b6a1196167c84c2d5114cff45e50b94"}

{"id": "p_aab2948a404ff4b8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」通按劍以叱之曰：「曹公明哲，必定天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "107177992c21a9da65413e81a6e2dd96da249df8f4e00dd1808c66ff532650f2"}

{"id": "p_5fd398d0c80432c4", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 51, "text": "紹雖強盛，而任使無方，終為之虜耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "cfc709a857131de2766bc9e223ed38e161978b8ff297709af4438cf9dc95019b"}

{"id": "p_5a8833ac702865ae", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 52, "text": "」即斬紹使，送印綬詣太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "d79fd8eeb6c5894ca019a02ac5e3cc8a2652fcc15cfb55e39618f5ad4eac37b4"}

{"id": "p_b4e4d660c60b8004", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 53, "text": "又擊郡賊瞿恭、江宮、沈成等，皆破殘其眾，送其首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "f502507154c27a5ba375be7f39e48b86da7d2e2467250d69093f22e0e0110fca"}

{"id": "p_42e3a32a4c32cb00", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 54, "text": "改封都亭侯，拜汝南太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "124a1fe915ec406813d3f21e3449b9e057675b23a6c01c292deee2fd4f51c0e1"}

{"id": "p_731816d9c4f77b6e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 55, "text": "時賊張赤等五千餘家聚桃山，通攻破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "35c086d4362ba7ab7b4b4fb4c10ddd7793fb705061e559107e8d47b261256371"}

{"id": "p_7688ae72bf943db6", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 56, "text": "劉備與周瑜圍曹仁於江陵，別遣關羽絕北道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "7a185d4326d02851cf979076b2d97a6ca378113802554b1a05a1161b825f5a0c"}

{"id": "p_7a403603f607bf2f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 57, "text": "通率眾擊之，下馬拔鹿角入圍，且戰且前，以迎仁軍，勇冠諸將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "12ccc553e82eca545397efd3e6cbb3fcee822064631449a4f131bbdace980adc"}

{"id": "p_29f11e2f75981018", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 58, "text": "通道得病薨，時年四十二。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "98c8654e72881314f695b3efa13d15677c1ecd73808a1ee962a155754aa69a96"}

{"id": "p_f7fcd7f1e1532ca3", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 59, "text": "追增邑二百戶，並前四百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "6f31e7787ba0f2f18001c5f00963cc69335f1cbed39b2e2eb66b5a64cae854b2"}

{"id": "p_3af6a77dc596858a", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 60, "text": "詔曰：「昔袁紹之難，自許、蔡以南，人懷異心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "e362cd379a50846345523927150eacc415805d1e388654a1508fb37857f4449c"}

{"id": "p_dc4b05d83ec6a7a3", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 61, "text": "通秉義不顧，使攜貳率服，朕甚嘉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "b11189f3d05d0c32386491d742df140927e24683c44b200ab21f9654b93b7d2b"}

{"id": "p_16c174d15de8d803", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 62, "text": "不幸早薨，子基雖已襲爵，未足酬其庸勳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "f339ff0c4a1c216ddab7a2d907ee2b3c55a8be0f2415134ce5c9442b6d23c366"}

{"id": "p_c66304986b1bc07d", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 63, "text": "基兄緒，前屯樊城，又有功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "bc51e456f4f61dac18e9606d8710bfd9e647daacc164b1fe544ec38918844dc8"}

{"id": "p_0937d3ea78914336", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 64, "text": "世篤其勞，其以基為奉義中郎將，緒平虜中郎將，以寵異焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "f3b6b630bf7fab1f907784dae22bc42de44eced3e297b43bf81067e123d02e48"}

{"id": "p_c88376334b1ee79e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 65, "text": "臧霸字宣高，泰山華人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "3de1183e8cb08a0a52affcdaff13e4f7b4e90be2bdaf2e24319ea18f3f8ddd14"}

{"id": "p_a40090237428f79d", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 66, "text": "父戒，為縣獄掾，據法不聽太守欲所私殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "d48d9c3237ac7e7a299d0e8f1cfa712d281377544c2d291c83c3d0fec6665317"}

{"id": "p_4d0b12194d95936c", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 67, "text": "太守大怒，令收戒詣府，時送者百餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "185e7892b219d71ce855aea19f08e1a80fc5cafb1bd475213d60ddf2204d5c2c"}

{"id": "p_89ea43ecc74f48c4", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 68, "text": "霸年十八，將客數十人徑於費西山中要奪之，送者莫敢動，因與父俱亡命東海，由是以勇壯聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "15aa75e9d20e5edce92a0a20ac3c74c2479e4c6da8e5a5d2cef324f85f569ca4"}

{"id": "p_fbd274c9f8274f51", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 69, "text": "黃巾起，霸從陶謙擊破之，拜騎都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "d6a026886c5dc625d4cda1a8f64a0af1e14ebecda7760159fc8397f9c317b5ff"}

{"id": "p_8036bd1579de02fe", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 70, "text": "遂收兵於徐州，與孫觀、吳敦、尹禮等並聚眾，霸為帥，屯於開陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "f565089661ba608a69c9ddef0b55125c2feb854f9f799f6221114c958e5706f8"}

{"id": "p_4d62aa2cdb9e4799", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 71, "text": "太祖之討呂布也，霸等將兵助布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "cf91386816b167f0ae553c16d2196f34bc91c1c6480ea60b384126fcf58ab3dd"}

{"id": "p_6b250bd085b5d271", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 72, "text": "太祖募索得霸，見而悅之，使霸招吳敦、尹禮、孫觀、觀兄康等，皆詣太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "37c467391367f58b1a9e61529a014b7f5b164c58b4fc8613827ea423db7e94ed"}

{"id": "p_93e667eb7df2efbe", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 73, "text": "太祖以霸為琅邪相，敦利城、禮東莞、觀北海、康城陽太守，割青、徐二州，委之於霸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "9a6b03d332d449c03666ee31e465f2bfb4c439377850e525230914e6bf19acdb"}

{"id": "p_91cc158d64c1eb18", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 74, "text": "太祖之在兗州，以徐翕、毛暉為將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "45974034701e079bcc9cb02973b740597968840857fb72042f2c8addf5ea1480"}

{"id": "p_7f506961f854270c", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 75, "text": "後兗州定，翕、暉亡命投霸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "ec6cd8094257b97d261c3be0d573b6e0f345bec8d85062aaaa80b44c0f12d529"}

{"id": "p_f8396a01158757ea", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 76, "text": "太祖語劉備，令語霸送二人首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "ea5017932837d5ea96dd4c5eef2478057c6cdcdc7bd2d84416952e1e6fba186a"}

{"id": "p_887069ccc4f1e403", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 77, "text": "霸謂備曰：「霸所以能自立者，以不為此也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "748be5010d70dafaf70c0dfe26f68b3b5262c0a725d54d3e37b3e43ae6c319b6"}

{"id": "p_1037a401db5f3493", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 78, "text": "霸受公生全之恩，不敢違命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "7b1d3a8c9674e36da64ceba2d8efb4ea55b637cc28a8ed6e38b14ff96c67b312"}

{"id": "p_68e6948c919f8242", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 79, "text": "然王霸之君可以義告，原將軍為之辭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "25890ea974f8a09c0d4dc8acbae09518326484af6cae4f1c9d6a77fc94d78de3"}

{"id": "p_6892d1deab479751", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 80, "text": "」備以霸言白太祖，太祖嘆息，謂霸曰：「此古人之事而君能行之，孤之原也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "a2ba4a50bd6b2bff25f4680a65e59014199747c95c7cb778c97ccb85ab2fe39f"}

{"id": "p_065aa2df91392493", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 81, "text": "時太祖方與袁紹相拒，而霸數以精兵入青州，故太祖得專事紹，不以東方為念。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "8ad084b015f855c622a866bf15830aa7acc75ea87f13a39ad06e85074996ccce"}

{"id": "p_278816bb79e1db34", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 82, "text": "太祖破袁譚於南皮，霸等會賀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "0f4a94e068eacc90431bbaaf17d49f2a2696f129feee803f904fadb9ddb7672d"}

{"id": "p_4183c8cad1b42175", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 83, "text": "霸因求遣子弟及諸將父兄家屬詣鄴，太祖曰：「諸君忠孝，豈復在是！", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "799c9f4b6da868d5993a6ced0148fcc2dd889fe6df44c5c84713cd29fe9e0e66"}

{"id": "p_80576b477993bf90", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 84, "text": "昔蕭何遣子弟入侍，而高祖不拒，耿純焚室輿櫬以從，而光武不逆，吾將何以易之哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "687cfc849f382bb939a24df824af864a2e23dfd3f34f012cda26ce89483321e7"}

{"id": "p_e082ca15e03a4732", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 85, "text": "」東州擾攘，霸等執義徵暴，清定海岱，功莫大焉，皆封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "04bd602a1eed5bb0a2dcda9ca98cd4eca2dc5748848aec4395508475b7abed32"}

{"id": "p_54e01c35e2a8bc92", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 86, "text": "霸為都亭侯，加威虜將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "0eb0162c60951432e2c746c7d46bb619401c6f7034cc5158491e27d63197d93a"}

{"id": "p_2da65595b2ac19b8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 87, "text": "又與于禁討昌豨，與夏侯淵討黃巾餘賊徐和等，有功，遷徐州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "0da0b25c55e25ee98eb11d4ef2b35a65a16834b4fd40fc0723dd29b7c4d4070c"}

{"id": "p_f8384a083137aeea", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 88, "text": "沛國（公）武周為下邳令，霸敬異周，身詣令捨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "ea307f36f992eb942ef15f70bab3be0066bd9e92feb98059104e6ac331e3a7b9"}

{"id": "p_1b9d6bc2214b1825", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 89, "text": "部從事總詷不法，周得其罪，便收考竟，霸益以善周。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "cf16ddfba1c87428c55eca15e4b2706bbc12abc86be41553642f4eb0a17291a1"}

{"id": "p_0b4a0eaab7f57aab", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 90, "text": "從討孫權，先登，再入巢湖，攻居巢，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "09101cd3ae6f2b5cae62cbac8571b3217d93781fe892c92d96f2d8bcc34b25a1"}

{"id": "p_c8c51e688769e5a0", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 91, "text": "張遼之討陳蘭，霸別遣至皖，討吳將韓當，使權不得救蘭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "965b3277d0959e47a5bef682be0e9f096db41a3fdebd6c05114591288152bfff"}

{"id": "p_4c412864d5d5e1e5", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 92, "text": "當遣兵逆霸，霸與戰於逢龍，當復遣兵邀霸於夾石，與戰破之，還屯舒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "0fbe35560497c63fa804726ad3edb64b70220386e9575c84f865d37717cf9cc8"}

{"id": "p_617527b8a48ad225", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 93, "text": "權遣數萬人乘船屯舒口，分兵救蘭，聞霸軍在舒，遁還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "ca7f302a145e55e9e79b15dead3be3119447d339ad66754d4264c63df2992bc1"}

{"id": "p_a5117ada3659fce8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 94, "text": "霸夜追之，比明，行百餘里，邀賊前後擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "e2309eca069da960134b7a0490fa5639496e5a45e91ae6c905a4852aec35eb27"}

{"id": "p_d6d3579b734b04d4", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 95, "text": "賊窘急，不得上船，赴水者甚眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "5634e627ece31fe1301c7b292b0ac176169c1752394e3d76e693cbb8d6ef2829"}

{"id": "p_9df8471f2e8056d6", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 96, "text": "由是賊不得救蘭，遼遂破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "e2c512cd1765ef00830ac3c8eeda2e99a10df79e8120dbbcaffaa59c53527c47"}

{"id": "p_e9bf653ede5f5926", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 97, "text": "霸從討孫權於濡須口，與張遼為前鋒，行遇霖雨，大軍先及，水遂長，賊船稍進，將士皆不安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "878f85a733ea0f1d6953e55b734fb4abd8672a19e2cb38d685190d640e5239c2"}

{"id": "p_632df8653dc5677b", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 98, "text": "遼欲去，霸止之曰：「公明於利鈍，寧肯捐吾等邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "94c0bc55ac13346b15bced4d85c59bd9d8ec17adb7c62c15955e90aa13f6ed43"}

{"id": "p_a866877d31f6ca16", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 99, "text": "太祖善之，拜揚威將軍，假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "6e7ea2a48a6ae7c4ece259d69d8dcc65dd22359efcc09e529a1e6b5e3469750e"}

{"id": "p_15f6b99c8ba8f0e4", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 100, "text": "後權乞降，太祖還，留霸與夏侯惇等屯居巢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "eedfa2f9f5b1d1a8aabd4dacba59e64d2fb6e1105b679902709596d94e43bf5a"}

{"id": "p_cecd64a0f3dad239", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 101, "text": "文帝即王位，遷鎮東將軍，進爵武安鄉侯，都督青州諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "f1c3e3636ccde71e0791d85fdfe64e70f799859074e873d875df28ccf9587347"}

{"id": "p_b2a75acd4ab37509", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 102, "text": "及踐阼，進封開陽侯，徙封良成侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "241e26094b78690a2410dec093c64a8e9ce2284ce14892ad740c217ed10b4bb5"}

{"id": "p_d172aeff7f084cd6", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 103, "text": "與曹休討吳賊，破呂範於洞浦，徵為執金吾，位特進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "22b51849f5d96853c151344f054605322e0a7dd74ea7555224d16fac97208bda"}

{"id": "p_530764137f5ddef0", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 104, "text": "明帝即位，增邑五百，並前三千五百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "6acba6a74cc157679cda4803b096ed319bdb7c1e65565af091f4518a2c44051f"}

{"id": "p_52656bf90ea965a3", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 105, "text": "霸前後有功，封子三人列侯，賜一人爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "c7d08aee227ca9aaf44d380ee4f93e84a90e7c2dfb703a281c3d8531112f83f0"}

{"id": "p_019c83fbbce66f79", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 106, "text": "而孫觀亦至青州刺史，假節，從太祖討孫權，戰被創，薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "232d65c8f660735592ef92fd43d339bb65749b61474e3ee6bf7db9127f0e05b5"}

{"id": "p_661a70c8904777eb", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 107, "text": "文聘字仲業，南陽宛人也，為劉表大將，使御北方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "db435f0be69c6fadfb2b3120eb2f206800782f54a7ddc977c8c07ca26e98892c"}

{"id": "p_259a4781861fdfda", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 108, "text": "太祖徵荊州，琮舉州降，呼聘欲與俱，聘曰：「聘不能全州，當待罪而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "396be0c1e0aae554aaec3b7442d235a30c0612c0916911ec81c7be82d317502c"}

{"id": "p_87323719e894315c", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 109, "text": "」太祖濟漢，聘乃詣太祖，太祖問曰：「來何遲邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "842cbbc19d1e652c09cd83b5fb8b2a61d486d84e9543c2290bc49a77be165ef2"}

{"id": "p_1d8dcd4dc62492ae", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 110, "text": "」聘曰：「先日不能輔弼劉荊州以奉國家，荊州雖沒，常原據守漢川，保全土境，生不負於孤弱，死無愧於地下，而計不得已，以至於此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "96e0dbfd063530ee20bd008d396343115e99572e55f0f7ad107534d91835a6c7"}

{"id": "p_57fd6df7da70acda", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 111, "text": "太祖為之愴然曰：「仲業，卿真忠臣也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "cbeefbcfe1a3b2961d8c818e558e7bc9b5a0337a15b5ce5532a32d6bc36f0bf5"}

{"id": "p_15d4e3b6984cd61c", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 112, "text": "授聘兵，使與曹純追討劉備於長阪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "e386c58ae18e4f4b32a0aee501c7b7bc6af8d4b2a52b542a026ca8c8ba1183de"}

{"id": "p_ba35952c9eba4a38", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 113, "text": "太祖先定荊州，江夏與吳接，民心不安，乃以聘為江夏太守，使典北兵，委以邊事，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "6d54985a3d2e6e4958f79e51eda3dc1cb4680f95ad93d2fe08043b1edf8f5e17"}

{"id": "p_932c40af8052f1c7", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 114, "text": "與樂進討關羽於尋口，有功，進封延壽亭侯，加討逆將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "80017781939e6967f09d1a81eb0b1c5ada8a8981f26ad0fb34a9d4dd2ae13875"}

{"id": "p_2386c086679d45a2", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 115, "text": "又攻羽輜重於漢津，燒其船於荊城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "b8d4ec87dcd5491d68982f9580df238171e80b96cd19ac224e16c17d8e669e36"}

{"id": "p_e2d8b8b3b2b58061", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 116, "text": "文帝踐阼，進爵長安鄉侯，假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "e8d900150cba93856d12d9be5dc54a340ed6351b5ad2134ef6e2f4fcc93bd50c"}

{"id": "p_01bc1575508f0cd9", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 117, "text": "與夏侯尚圍江陵，使聘別屯沔口，止石梵，自當一隊，御賊有功，遷後將軍，封新野侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "42ddee676e37b1389f032e697ac744f5a9129df9bff1f1f58b45c60f86feb25c"}

{"id": "p_dc8bba348f2121e4", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 118, "text": "孫權以五萬眾自圍聘於石陽，甚急，聘堅守不動，權住二十餘日乃解去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "f2fc51a5c3c0826af07a184f25f75a857c39dc8a5874078a2987d9f9bc720a1a"}

{"id": "p_df3e678ee4e18281", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 119, "text": "增邑五百戶，並前千九百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "1b6c758dae989d18cc2733c3e16ba7259a7357120daa3f2baf8ba6fc2fc0d49d"}

{"id": "p_5c89fa19c50ed365", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 120, "text": "聘在江夏數十年，有威恩，名震敵國，賊不敢侵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "5d10a7828bd84588a879d3b9118525c53202d21f0271e829316b05f8802a6121"}

{"id": "p_3c578e69332324f6", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 121, "text": "分聘戶邑封聘子岱為列侯，又賜聘從子厚爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "2ae40f8e7575e2ad1902c7e6932be9c6f64a52e64eafba340182aff4533a30f6"}

{"id": "p_0f830e4c8a352c87", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 122, "text": "嘉平中，譙郡桓禺為江夏太守，清儉有威惠，名亞於聘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "22d475dd17d64b71ef24d9659a126e95766a6b61a126b9314a40a72cdcd2f808"}

{"id": "p_4160c1ce97fe5372", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 123, "text": "太祖在兗州，聞虔有膽策，以為從事，將家兵守湖陸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "d1b36289e134a490bbcf9eebeaa2de94b4c6f775b299d9e838dbbad842fd4d4f"}

{"id": "p_7c40d4192b46a713", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 124, "text": "〔襄賁〕校尉杜松部民炅母等作亂，與昌豨通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "3e6f5990f30a6982ca7dcfba92f37a8dfd82709fa3f26182c60e2f74a16fbef3"}

{"id": "p_e8ad388f5e66ee71", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 125, "text": "虔到，招誘炅母渠率及同惡數十人，賜酒食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "eac99c8ccf9ab18989facf8298e80e506a3610dbf5ac6d2155ff7ddc2126e58b"}

{"id": "p_a8ca489e880a9d85", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 126, "text": "簡壯士伏其側，虔察炅母等皆醉，使伏兵盡格殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "c467f962136a12e176dc3d8d6fe9ea282238a831354ecf1f196bcee79274bebf"}

{"id": "p_baf16ed650ef5f8b", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 127, "text": "郡接山海，世亂，聞民人多藏竄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "0dd0d82bce41b6916d22d79661900b67078565072cca0be5fc438cc355f3552b"}

{"id": "p_8767ea02f50d6ce6", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 128, "text": "袁紹所置中郎將郭祖、公孫犢等數十輩，保山為寇，百姓苦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "f0762d717fe3ed0ba7799fc84c5eaa8763169e1aa7d50a017c75ef860b8ee560"}

{"id": "p_37771085d3edf92a", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 129, "text": "虔將家兵到郡，開恩信，祖等黨屬皆降服，諸山中亡匿者盡出安土業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "0571965c5401df72361af9b9df2cd1f2b03c3d33fe5e4c4cd7f6650c464a0d2e"}

{"id": "p_db125e71086596b9", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 130, "text": "簡其強者補戰士，泰山由是遂有精兵，冠名州郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "2628e67925135f4ca705cdb6b9c0863750b1179faba754b11db6d46a68078e8e"}

{"id": "p_860162ee1214a8fa", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 131, "text": "濟南黃巾徐和等，所在劫長吏，攻城邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "34bb66524adf86e32e30ae8c7de9c2604cbf44992894d2a250d751acb9cbaa3e"}

{"id": "p_89b83f8f2ea9ec29", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 132, "text": "虔引兵與夏侯淵會擊之，前後數十戰，斬首獲生數千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "8dc0c4e9d1089a91463ba2253e450a5ad86986d78da21f38ea8d2440270eb8d0"}

{"id": "p_06bc63fc14e5ba8e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 133, "text": "太祖使督青州諸郡兵以討東萊群賊李條等，有功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "4ff90b34619a7beece204faba38dd18d85d6ee3c79423003d97dc0f74f1b4226"}

{"id": "p_5b006fba9b56c56b", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 134, "text": "太祖令曰：「夫有其志，必成其事，蓋烈士之所徇也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "0e613b1077993200a0bbd0882e6a534efea4a3fdf537e0bb6c33209e3ab1e8ad"}

{"id": "p_99cc10f7d45caf4e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 135, "text": "卿在郡以來，禽奸討暴，百姓獲安，躬蹈矢石，所徵輒克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "8edee3d18008bc2924ca8b2bc2bf70ee87bf9eaa468e7c6eee581f7887ee3957"}

{"id": "p_eed19eda5dca1ccc", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 136, "text": "昔寇恂立名於汝、潁，耿弇建策於青、兗，古今一也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "8c189e1a196f8b95dcf6e07c47c4f0d4d514661a788fa56e4d64bd847c2683d8"}

{"id": "p_a45935b857d0845a", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 137, "text": "」舉茂才，加騎都尉，典郡如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "13a43d6601c6ace3ad835230051b205c03e5456ab1a56e393d5ba4aa860f77ec"}

{"id": "p_a4bc458eefa84672", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 138, "text": "虔在泰山十數年，甚有威惠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "d2b3dbfc0366000dc3b4675b4b10f919a44005856053162a0b7b196992a71e7b"}

{"id": "p_2652c753c12fd3e8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 139, "text": "文帝即王位，加裨將軍，封益壽亭侯，遷徐州刺史，加威虜將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "9672ed63336845ff7c6c61ad12ee4e3a3a69da401ed289c60eddb761409b1a07"}

{"id": "p_c227ff2587597e2f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 140, "text": "請琅邪王祥為別駕，民事一以委之，世多其能任賢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "08583958f6856b9f1c2684ca6c35854a31bc9f3f2fbb1610e76d63235166a0ae"}

{"id": "p_8451f33cdd268463", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 141, "text": "明帝即位，徙封萬年亭侯，增邑二百，並前六百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "d25a0e160b67cf61a570dfc18749f61294c7161cbddba8f5a887678903c319c7"}

{"id": "p_9ee4a9538e4de7a7", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 142, "text": "許褚字仲康，譙國譙人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "4e1e65835bff155a2bb02d75cb3b44474d7916cce0775aa0da11e90eeb48ba42"}

{"id": "p_f02e7727dd752457", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 143, "text": "長八尺餘，腰大十圍，容貌雄毅，勇力絕人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "d2860698468aa26f89f3921de134df405356ce94a355493dc88a78e16a7e4528"}

{"id": "p_f2ded1879ef513cd", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 144, "text": "漢末，聚少年及宗族數千家，共堅壁以御寇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "3bbae0a02f2d0647db5cb95f2b3e589f8113b3d2d95407bc85fec95d214e7e61"}

{"id": "p_1603f336ed8eacf0", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 145, "text": "時汝南葛陂賊萬餘人攻褚壁，褚眾少不敵，力戰疲極。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "299379694ac8d94d2d7055e77e6d5197ee7eb0b6b8028d8cc20b271a58149199"}

{"id": "p_990cadad76ff6184", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 146, "text": "兵矢盡，乃令壁中男女，聚治石如杅鬥者置四隅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "9ae9883b032fa645444c935a57d7b4ef4386dd7c0ac2caa85e6333649f51c4bc"}

{"id": "p_0c0adfe863630779", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 147, "text": "褚飛石擲之，所值皆摧碎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "5990630785365dfd32c3b0a3f99cb08a1e881a20cd91ca4173a613a512d5a000"}

{"id": "p_98f61811104c5f11", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 148, "text": "糧乏，偽與賊和，以牛與賊易食，賊來取牛，牛輒奔還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "c3297f4946909d41df2d55d53bc8621a62b0754d5676f6f69ed16a834fb9245d"}

{"id": "p_9c21f91da10ee63e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 149, "text": "褚乃出陳前，一手逆曳牛尾，行百餘步。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "c4e96ee291c8d2887363dc567afc8c0377873cd19838839f7ee3fb5917b91d96"}

{"id": "p_14e0f10af42bbfb5", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 150, "text": "賊眾驚，遂不敢取牛而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "b57f9ed944b29fb026b64a73cf174f302b7d21e687bde5bb82baa7b6aa8899db"}

{"id": "p_4ddbf86d7c7562a9", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 151, "text": "由是淮、汝、陳、梁間，聞皆畏憚之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "9ec9df47de1e91f1b04a3fb340eb1a97aa232e2da6b01702c312794d2c39c235"}

{"id": "p_6318a74945c71376", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 152, "text": "太祖徇淮、汝，褚以眾歸太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "0a7893bba047c8216299ae00e697377eb4d32906056bf06d715733ae0f61ea3b"}

{"id": "p_afef5df9e8f7ec14", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 153, "text": "太祖見而壯之曰：「此吾樊噲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "9f6e219a076f4ae823236b681523689baa7de2a4dcebaab1fab3a6847a3ae32e"}

{"id": "p_5dc1b0a38fcc9f56", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」即日拜都尉，引入宿衛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "752428353f2740a07f4772b5892beef9b61cb5c11dbeb44d3e95591e43c0c027"}

{"id": "p_fe9e3e1559d72b63", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 155, "text": "諸從褚俠客，皆以為虎士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "67ccbfd5ca6a2b94fe94fe4c46b6ad22ec10548e006c733aab84b5fec76fa4a1"}

{"id": "p_df06ed7d4380f1c4", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 156, "text": "從徵張繡，先登，斬首萬計，遷校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "09eaddccf61484967ff745f64f483a76295cf9ec0b5d6169ae00addc55195829"}

{"id": "p_68654b18654b4b8a", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 157, "text": "時常從士徐他等謀為逆，以褚常侍左右，憚之不敢發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "05e639c025023ee3ea158b074fba0566552c3c949b7f2ab458706ccb57533ea8"}

{"id": "p_783c006e4e43a5d9", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 158, "text": "伺褚休下日，他等懷刀入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "07e6df77a686c0e9dd7fde5306f548241afea2705bfb74cd3078d8bff82ddeaa"}

{"id": "p_5338c83aefa0ba6e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 159, "text": "他等不知，入帳見褚，大驚愕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "879c0fe0897790fca79ae355ee7c3db59fad6564de7d38295dd795133649d8d7"}

{"id": "p_9892bcdedfb418f0", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 160, "text": "他色變，褚覺之，即擊殺他等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "d5e49eaadd12237e189f1bdefbcae6a9c867279dfec1b58aaf4299df45738ac5"}

{"id": "p_6d6754fd19d6fc76", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 161, "text": "太祖益親信之，出入同行，不離左右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "bd04a372312234f90803ec98c555a0beece7cf1ed73e196c936413f7af6ebab0"}

{"id": "p_6ddc904e91cb7aac", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 162, "text": "從圍鄴，力戰有功，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "04b4ba3004d9703ad12b2b69db99589ae41660d52d782a551a64a1340b7be236"}

{"id": "p_b57340df0e8e44d1", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 163, "text": "太祖將北渡，臨濟河，先渡兵，獨與褚及虎士百餘人留南岸斷後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "fcf097101611ddb4a3b52b7b42a851a92d9d917b5b4a79bcbf9e4a22bf724b26"}

{"id": "p_780641408c3509bd", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 164, "text": "超將步騎萬餘人，來奔太祖軍，矢下如雨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "eba83544153b0b4089a2ae633669eba9a3ec578b5ea2df8ca061fb2a3d1621f0"}

{"id": "p_61fdf82033f2d244", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 165, "text": "褚白太祖，賊來多，今兵渡已盡，宜去，乃扶太祖上船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "59ee91f37be0aef0773b989fdf878f741abe97e1265dfe358f6c727aea5b000b"}

{"id": "p_093d064e567a79c1", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 166, "text": "賊戰急，軍爭濟，船重欲沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "c23a95abe66f1b7f8263d275da81c219025077d986ccc373f3ffa4224bebe338"}

{"id": "p_5a7ddef8dabe8de8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 167, "text": "褚斬攀船者，左手舉馬鞍蔽太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "7e6a897a167f9378f3b58f729c282172b22bb6821d58130fcd3488250f43d46a"}

{"id": "p_46eba30e349ad156", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 168, "text": "船工為流矢所中死，褚右手並溯船，僅乃得渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "27376d043916d11712718731485ede871d18f5fb3607c2c80f9a9a67f5f98561"}

{"id": "p_9b6f7484dab68b4d", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 169, "text": "其後太祖與遂、超等單馬會語，左右皆不得從，唯將褚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "86908b4db1b93eb5a6c5d3449381254920bbf0910041a12daf67a871c86b0a0c"}

{"id": "p_c2c91db493c8e9cd", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 170, "text": "超負其力，陰欲前突太祖，素聞褚勇，疑從騎是褚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "e687b18998f8130388e0aae0b517b4256e337c34da8eb395b9da8f122c6a5407"}

{"id": "p_85034324acc0892e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 171, "text": "乃問太祖曰：「公有虎侯者安在？", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "c3b92f6e0f780817582da3e2ee381e1bdb6acd7f4320ba48202bf021f88d3c64"}

{"id": "p_0219e79f9cfa7ca0", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 172, "text": "」太祖顧指褚，褚瞋目盼之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "575eca47f58eaca1129e084c092ad79b46d1309c38cd8802b9e554da9cbc4aeb"}

{"id": "p_6c73ec1a0b3333d4", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 173, "text": "後數日會戰，大破超等，褚身斬首級，遷武衛中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "78b7eda46e68a211d3e201cb85ec9cc2a7c3e76d45e4be666f7621668c955991"}

{"id": "p_193648e6ee293d5c", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 174, "text": "軍中以褚力如虎而痴，故號曰虎痴；是以超問虎侯，至今天下稱焉，皆謂其姓名也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "93d986e22f0d53dacfc57888b4b98784a408e0778b2a7259a6564734f1151bfc"}

{"id": "p_e72e8840b1a10f3c", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 175, "text": "褚性謹慎奉法，質重少言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "42f9a2e2d2b905962e412982c051f3765d931b8fb1b11ba7ab75e56b5d663f52"}

{"id": "p_f716a0bdba805e84", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 176, "text": "曹仁自荊州來朝謁，太祖未出，入與褚相見於殿外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "8df7bd2daf2e569acaa4b513e2ccadaaf51a9bbc01584ea4bd3069097581318f"}

{"id": "p_372dc9c3ac8d9382", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 177, "text": "仁呼褚入便坐語，褚曰：「王將出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "4a9e4ac7edc843559461afb3681528a1e8a17f1c6f585b6caf608102c6a323cb"}

{"id": "p_11def79b38b98af0", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 178, "text": "或以責褚曰：「征南宗室重臣，降意呼君，君何故辭？", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "9bc62f99f337312ddc5521c0658d0e9f74068390174fa7440b31174b2138bf23"}

{"id": "p_68d02eb6a7049694", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 179, "text": "」褚曰：「彼雖親重，外籓也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "b3dc18c66ecd10cea54edd96535c30f06eb1ea32785657214cf2be96b87c91c4"}

{"id": "p_cfee0c0620c9b6c2", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 180, "text": "褚備內臣，眾談足矣，入室何私乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "44a2a27e17e1d66703fa758275568846476a2874d5903b75dee3c8a599bc6bf5"}

{"id": "p_9555703b669c97d7", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 181, "text": "」太祖聞，愈愛待之，遷中堅將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "f14dc9f396bb558af6441767239bff1abcc349345cb32e8d0717383be173de35"}

{"id": "p_7c4ce4da71d9f123", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 182, "text": "文帝踐阼，進封萬歲亭侯，遷武衛將軍，都督中軍宿衛禁兵，甚親近焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "8a0e1c9eba454221bda85aace3d13fdfa38d0243701cadd116a4827a1cefd503"}

{"id": "p_01d0e97942e3f614", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 183, "text": "初，褚所將為虎士者從征伐，太祖以為皆壯士也，同日拜為將，其後以功為將軍封侯者數十人，都尉、校尉百餘人，皆劍客也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "1b57fdb211739ebf624a0e8e53ca7f3e999db3fa4124b4dcec936289c0cf4855"}

{"id": "p_c467a3209b99e067", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 184, "text": "明帝即位，進牟鄉侯，邑七百戶，賜子爵一人關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "475e8f819ee7721f5034dfdd8c7c35ca00425443f4b562e8da21a2eb030960f1"}

{"id": "p_5b874da2ba6a5a05", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 185, "text": "褚兄定，亦以軍功（封）為振威將軍，都督徼道虎賁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "94a6ca0653fd75400cb7089ea78fe403f96267ef576a03a456bce9f60e6bf12d"}

{"id": "p_987b0c83cf042b49", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 186, "text": "太和中，帝思褚忠孝，下詔褒贊，復賜褚子孫二人爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "219d5f680a20398bf40ce208678a3114c40e7d06e6355a9989fbf5e2c04ce966"}

{"id": "p_2df4e202fe1a0ab8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 187, "text": "形貌魁梧，旅力過人，有志節任俠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "1e911fea544cd365e22e28324ef23a59599808c3ae8fddf2129bf63b08267ec2"}

{"id": "p_5692856b38421972", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 188, "text": "襄邑劉氏與睢陽李永為讎，韋為報之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "099c75f22788f00d3b25303db5a29513732a14ee2df88b7161e8c5f834bbb12c"}

{"id": "p_5243f8107535dac4", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 189, "text": "韋乘車載雞酒，偽為候者，門開，懷匕首入殺永，並殺其妻，徐出，取車上刀戟，步（出）。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "f08bed4db61d9c2bc72472f37a195851063e9e14bbd98f712771ece1413fa159"}

{"id": "p_b3383680f2668d64", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 190, "text": "行四五里，遇其伴，轉戰得脫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "b9116fe46d2d42ff88ce68660bef341fa3f60730eeced759c208bb7fd9ca8f3b"}

{"id": "p_d226475daef1284f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 191, "text": "初平中，張邈舉義兵，韋為士，屬司馬趙寵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "28cc188310507e40fad618e0f6300475472c3c72c92ce89ff6f1ac9130348c75"}

{"id": "p_0187dc3c73bdaa5a", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 192, "text": "牙門旗長大，人莫能勝，韋一手建之，寵異其才力。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "3dbe526f723e29a863811187bdb63842638ca6b3da78d98b4c0d91f1aac8e7d2"}

{"id": "p_96b77ace7c932ddf", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 193, "text": "後屬夏侯惇，數斬首有功，拜司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "4d9c0154efc41175f01a1d4d7d48babd195abee31034dc4b10fd61e4908f5db0"}

{"id": "p_56173959cfa105a3", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 194, "text": "布有別屯在濮陽西四五十里，太祖夜襲，比明破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "fe03e4d0eb7981fea704b9d99faaa7529dbfa8998222d49f4858adab8ef37ba8"}

{"id": "p_ea46b9718f55edec", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 195, "text": "未及還，會布救兵至，三面掉戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "2a796b1e1230aedc903abe4323da853b2e7f90dbc9555871eb1eab52ff8442d0"}

{"id": "p_5cc77971f92d89c5", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 196, "text": "時布身自搏戰，自旦至日昳數十合，相持急。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "15449c614201f7cf3a1fe5547321bdc915e5a16097305da9de0e9dc0a017e75a"}

{"id": "p_21eaabba8916d2b7", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 197, "text": "太祖募陷陳，韋先佔，將應募者數十人，皆重衣兩鎧，棄楯，但持長矛撩戟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "82d6c84c73eee7c7639c2b854c7fa1e51eae11f35250d69e5da4e1e42486b5e9"}

{"id": "p_de6622de63c81a41", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 198, "text": "時西面又急，韋進當之，賊弓弩亂發，矢至如雨，韋不視，謂等人曰：「虜來十步，乃白之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "d08eb6b47d2adce621683f164d5424081177f2feda382b9dd0f59d944d2d984e"}

{"id": "p_b6e1f83601ac68ff", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 199, "text": "」等人懼，疾言「虜至矣」！", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "2221a12dafbf43de3829ee279524047edc4cc20ec351256e5e5c5d47c4bd7a2f"}

{"id": "p_5904ba4922aaa7d2", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 200, "text": "韋手持十餘戟，大呼起，所抵無不應手倒者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "fb8ce9812cd936db5caca62f3543c68c474c61f9d3fafd2915ca8241185615ea"}

{"id": "p_3ec34411c702f073", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 201, "text": "拜韋都尉，引置左右，將親兵數百人，常繞大帳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "a53d05c38a99f614991b344cf736d12005c202e33f0ca33298c8d9c3522a3ff2"}

{"id": "p_096a5cb5e459dfc6", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 202, "text": "韋既壯武，其所將皆選卒，每戰鬥，常先登陷陳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "e35b021dd5174d1e75a367f174deada7b003d6405654f563eedeb23175810917"}

{"id": "p_9ddf75222861fb3e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 203, "text": "性忠至謹重，常晝立侍終日，夜宿帳左右，稀歸私寢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "131efae6e780110bef1e5fe8bfc2f01ffe59d353681426999c2d015025eda7d6"}

{"id": "p_e65d7e75bd50b5c6", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 204, "text": "好酒食，飲啖兼人，每賜食於前，大飲長歠，左右相屬，數人益乃供，太祖壯之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "8d640b279a3ef24d2e9783afa5d44b0b7fd5711b2e0c87ce9a85012743b3cbf6"}

{"id": "p_301e14ce6dcb15bc", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 205, "text": "韋好持大雙戟與長刀等，軍中為之語曰：「帳下壯士有典君，提一雙戟八十斤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "f18ad19741e08673056d2b45a1aa15ef4ecc62b8e1b82d84c44780675d8f2201"}

{"id": "p_be1ce84521621104", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 206, "text": "太祖-{征}-荊州，至宛，張繡迎降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "382aab6d45a06fd5a3236db5fa17f4baa2af9d0416545a80c3d2dc27f869c01c"}

{"id": "p_910cf933dd26328d", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 207, "text": "太祖甚悅，延繡及其將帥，置酒高會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "175cb23aa1d2322dc387da0ff9966bdeedda67bed074199b9c12a3654e6b2434"}

{"id": "p_4a408fd146e1a049", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 208, "text": "太祖行酒，韋持大斧立後，刃徑尺，太祖所至之前，韋輒舉斧目之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "62efff3a4f6a83dcd9d48640971dfba4464989c404d5d444972954b5fae27f99"}

{"id": "p_f619f7e0e1c3e49c", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 209, "text": "竟酒，繡及其將帥莫敢仰視。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "4bb8e503ef0ca20a94b977e790b062005548404e249e66ad8240fcd6d7cf0d8b"}

{"id": "p_d8aae71b4395f467", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 210, "text": "後十餘日，繡反，襲太祖營，太祖出戰不利，輕騎引去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "02f46b6d44809b87570370f2568b5f77be0002d72ef440cc7a6fdbefe309eb5f"}

{"id": "p_370584bd49a87726", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 211, "text": "時韋校尚有十餘人，皆殊死戰，無不一當十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "792582a7ec68c432a24e7f352f5f8aec76d32a74d543acae900c7b4eb6d9c391"}

{"id": "p_1b5e53cd801e9fc0", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 212, "text": "賊前後至稍多，韋以長戟左右擊之，一叉入，輒十餘矛摧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "b271d455854dbee74d2fee2a497c2c5d72544a035c651efc82ae58c0dc3cef2c"}
