{"id": "p_b0132ed080f0f42f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 213, "text": "韋被數十創，短兵接戰，賊前搏之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "2db0fa7a950944bcdec316c0a62e3943ba88914d81f4cc94b21d83ddab012ed0"}

{"id": "p_a64ddf15e1299841", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 214, "text": "韋雙挾兩賊擊殺之，餘賊不敢前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "ec0a3fdc07f02ed3a68653d417aa7ad85b21d4c85e378bb80cb44d763662ea27"}

{"id": "p_2364d6e227e6f152", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 215, "text": "韋復前突賊，殺數人，創重發，瞋目大罵而死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "7ec482fb70c0c105a6d3fe37f8b69a7483c8843a12f98de44497187f82827ddd"}

{"id": "p_c8bc858532fb46a1", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 216, "text": "賊乃敢前，取其頭，傳觀之，覆軍就視其軀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "ce07bf9ab67eec273bce1d8cc202e340badaa4e126dd2bf32bce2fd546cbf01c"}

{"id": "p_cfeffeb53a6b8a12", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 217, "text": "太祖退住舞陰，聞韋死，為流涕，募間取其喪，親自臨哭之，遣歸葬襄邑，拜子滿為郎中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "7a6afde55420dc8b75a43dca8626f3e5cf7048e800d9bd7ec4e2a3a760f9202f"}

{"id": "p_d324e146f36b8e4a", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 218, "text": "太祖思韋，拜滿為司馬，引自近。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "f3bac8ead378640c516f068db73a5c80fabe9a84166cf0bd36e5a9439f713d29"}

{"id": "p_35a01264f60bfafa", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 219, "text": "文帝即王位，以滿為都尉，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "6c6a2cd8e11c8f7791d68d6da2812d6cd5ead598bb1d11f2df9bdc7143e190a3"}

{"id": "p_4d91c464586cc2a7", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 220, "text": "龐德字令明，南安狟道人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "df4020111f7343552c4017a88d848f5f3a4d54eac7b86d0ed9f016241696a0fa"}

{"id": "p_975149db926e769d", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 221, "text": "初平中，從馬騰擊反羌叛氐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "a271a9b18e35ddecee308495e1d86dc9560fe0d6e82e690c5f68c85fe49702bf"}

{"id": "p_c2ded8de578dd1bf", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 222, "text": "建安中，太祖討袁譚、尚於黎陽，譚遣郭援、高幹等略取河東，太祖使鍾繇率關中諸將討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "3c6838430f4c4bec76642e59cbfcb122f88457dee5d9815202a67b976a974302"}

{"id": "p_fe7899af7195504e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 223, "text": "德隨騰子超拒援、幹於平陽，德為軍鋒，進攻援、幹，大破之，親斬援首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "ad6233d78770b82069746f902c8793e025e16c8cd65f11a8fed3f0cd750c1dbe"}

{"id": "p_e70558a183e4a86d", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 224, "text": "後張白騎叛於弘農，德復隨騰徵之，破白騎於兩殽間。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "c1aa6cbb464f160d8dffe51ec3a6911c8f3f40dda5f28633a313ae80300fa843"}

{"id": "p_985ad7a3d9333946", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 225, "text": "每戰，常陷陳卻敵，勇冠騰軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "d3df975ec6a254842e08a1bd78040c9108cc3eed9621ef44b615e7bba76986b2"}

{"id": "p_8ddee34bde59812f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 226, "text": "後騰徵為衛尉，德留屬超。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "298abb52f73a82921e081bb9a3acf2642d15dd44111ca14e69680f56106f9703"}

{"id": "p_d5577adc1c84bede", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 227, "text": "太祖破超於渭南，德隨超亡入漢陽，保冀城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "3e7855fa4b5a5e420d901e41abe0c91d4561f766003e525152dc91494b1a1c3a"}

{"id": "p_efaa573e75069ed8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 228, "text": "後復隨超奔漢中，從張魯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "a417c86e29175fae2d0e315cfd3f57336d30d50ca96f3fc5f119ed2927e6e6dc"}

{"id": "p_132d7a0b0d965556", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 229, "text": "太祖素聞其驍勇，拜立義將軍，封關門亭侯，邑三百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "97b6db4934cc04361a6f6f7fdd668dd620b8e9cbc6419ac495c7b6c787c763fb"}

{"id": "p_3398c1d3f5d48882", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 230, "text": "侯音、衛開等以宛叛，德將所領與曹仁共攻拔宛，斬音、開，遂南屯樊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "ea70e9bd387bdce053db4f755fc5d0ab65dd438ea3c324fe6ee9c3c02dbc5327"}

{"id": "p_12eacd9348955606", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 231, "text": "討關羽，樊下諸將以德兄在漢中，頗疑之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "372c8667f84fe58d8a443c49c31355e673e863212ca370b5e30a7e394ba4fed1"}

{"id": "p_b0235ac962146619", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 232, "text": "德常曰：「我受國恩，義在效死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "1556cdf0aadc21ea32b824525629311d496a54e9de0749e0798d09b262b6b12b"}

{"id": "p_4afb25ce99f6ae56", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 233, "text": "今年我不殺羽，羽當殺我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "9cae73e0f9f04391f7566ae67cf5060e50fa90398a685bc89af193dc2c39d00c"}

{"id": "p_08ccbe6f31aeace1", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 234, "text": "」後親與羽交戰，射羽中額。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "0615220882b82b5547d70ef95189c540f839db2418d00500c7f702d0f7f8151f"}

{"id": "p_3c263872a15f0e34", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 235, "text": "時德常乘白馬，羽軍謂之白馬將軍，皆憚之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "0175241fc61ad63b572ad46e574dc00bbe3d61277592e55ff6274b4381add516"}

{"id": "p_dce44093158cbf29", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 236, "text": "仁使德屯樊北十里，會天霖雨十餘日，漢水暴溢，樊下平地五六丈，德與諸將避水上堤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "36baef4f940c6652da0eeb4d16a000abc8f52b1a27eb60a4fb99ff5dd13e1af7"}

{"id": "p_13d8dc8f92b195d8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 237, "text": "羽乘船攻之，以大船四面射堤上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "af2151dae8cb9cb742c8c6371fe67f98ae3883f4834bd435bae285abf1c355a4"}

{"id": "p_7019857e1509d4dd", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 238, "text": "將軍董衡、部曲將董超等欲降，德皆收斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "cd29dcca4c74ea2f2b44c718933c6472387a65bc1cf06cfac8c680c93af2b301"}

{"id": "p_6083b8fd13fdc489", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 239, "text": "自平旦力戰至日過中，羽攻益急，矢盡，短兵接戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "83ea8dbeca5ea247692280a3b86599ec17d718ab102d484955148f29020c251b"}

{"id": "p_2f2dde3ecdbce556", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 240, "text": "德謂督將成何曰：「吾聞良將不怯死以苟免，烈士不毀節以求生，今日，我死日也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "3b05a73dfc370741b15889f46e511f288dff140cbf123fdd4698b25901c2b707"}

{"id": "p_3fb0d1f2ec9fa2d5", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 241, "text": "」戰益怒，氣愈壯，而水浸盛，吏士皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "55bf18abba531bdf19d65374fe61b77fcdf3c246d982c875b447f521bef29e1b"}

{"id": "p_a88b8edd3b1e8494", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 242, "text": "德與麾下將一人，五伯二人，彎弓傅矢，乘小船欲還仁營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "22d8258f9f4dee848cba3d15c9aa34d4b88af8f8838acaa8c649ea43b84db1fc"}

{"id": "p_ea9344a909d1a947", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 243, "text": "水盛船覆，失弓矢，獨抱船覆水中，為羽所得，立而不跪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "f9be7009a9395d7312ba9374d21bc2a27c15ae569c062ddde41becc9e4d52307"}

{"id": "p_94f8b7ad148a4789", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 244, "text": "羽謂曰：「卿兄在漢中，我欲以卿為將，不早降何為？", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "045d28c5c4611d1843552f39afc2ae53a083404a3e78a2d63d33918a68a042d7"}

{"id": "p_b80b67ac8b02313f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 245, "text": "」德罵羽曰：「竪子，何謂降也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "0063a85147a959c89ea10893df4881a925e50d4dcf1ebc058bad839c6fb73083"}

{"id": "p_1101058cfacb7fc2", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 246, "text": "魏王帶甲百萬，威振天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "a94e41bd6b378aa1d8204f2f8eb474eb1f50bab47eb30024a052b1869bb01378"}

{"id": "p_44af9e07d911c0d0", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 247, "text": "汝劉備庸才耳，豈能敵邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "a3ac2f1b5f54bfb260e252f558455c7f18171056a466231088ad161d6d16bf25"}

{"id": "p_63e39235e91e2393", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 248, "text": "我寧為國家鬼，不為賊將也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "026d75ce1a969badce8e745ad42af6a5bce36e3bc7a414f3b7f1ca864a8ac068"}

{"id": "p_34ccb1afcc1043a7", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 249, "text": "太祖聞而悲之，為之流涕，封其二子為列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "563d6bd3d7ff8bf26a27e5bb8c9d6b8b72307167e918d57a72096dbac159a6d8"}

{"id": "p_244ac5ebf429b437", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 250, "text": "文帝即王位，乃遣使就德墓賜謚，策曰：「昔先軫喪元，王蠋絕脰，隕身徇節，前代美之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "3e0076fef9b7e7a84d062273d0a877adc56c40eb8849e7026003d31c80873a76"}

{"id": "p_dca49d49bdfc470f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 251, "text": "惟侯式昭果毅，蹈難成名，聲溢當時，義高在昔，寡人愍焉，謚曰壯侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "d4dba56e4eaf6868d86e08e68f22c30392b8fad287c04ec150276b9a79a918a5"}

{"id": "p_0b6ede6d92f9b811", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 252, "text": "」又賜子會等四人爵關內侯，邑各百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "8c050e36e0ebf0697868abeed9c01af839d730e64bdbe4e2be32ae9583d9d0f6"}

{"id": "p_502e989bf45890d8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 253, "text": "會勇烈有父風，官至中尉將軍，封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "029632802b659110d23f18499acda0a7c43c58ac0677f87c69faed2b03f46f6a"}

{"id": "p_3b8816ea1ace463e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 254, "text": "龐淯字子異，酒泉表氏人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "8928cd7726a0ad24a040966f9b4513230f51e494cf1032bc07b90fcc5a53c900"}

{"id": "p_a550ad3acd971802", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 255, "text": "初以涼州從事守破羌長，會武威太守張猛反，殺刺史邯鄲商，猛令曰：「敢有臨商喪，死不赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "5fe85291fd1618d22f37d51cac42e7874809d415ac8379c05c0c795ca9e4f9a9"}

{"id": "p_3da2ee5ce7f7e539", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 256, "text": "」淯聞之，棄官，晝夜奔走，號哭喪所訖，詣猛門，衷匕首，欲因見以殺猛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "c495a85f376b14834626b4979119f19b7b5c15be4a7cfce751ab7d37bc0456ab"}

{"id": "p_29026d44ac1b266a", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 257, "text": "猛知其義士，敕遣不殺，由是以忠烈聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "cf15959618b1a87a5237e4365fa6994840e367e0569c29b451a99c58626d607e"}

{"id": "p_7fd821c15e830560", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 258, "text": "淯棄妻子，夜逾城出圍，告急於張掖、敦煌二郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "2f05d349b1fa873d3b027b180830017051c51796c923cfe97127a6fec26f7bd4"}

{"id": "p_0a359a190b8a2030", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 259, "text": "初疑未肯發兵，淯欲伏劍，二郡感其義，遂為興兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "4d3ecba48fd40b88e4dd7bd5693d6636db68b854eb856bcb33dac7ecdda9cefc"}

{"id": "p_396fc83e12b1e6b5", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 260, "text": "軍未至而郡城邑已陷，揖死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "0b7e3a52b1b66ff7e6839398f7a061d6ec0a0675c4cc1d507fefe961b45fcc7e"}

{"id": "p_3fde3194b3edeeec", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 261, "text": "淯乃收斂揖喪，送還本郡，行服三年乃還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "267f9984ad596e28c2cc92818995eb91c95091a0b4f9d7bfebe98ccf3d83d3c2"}

{"id": "p_294218195565132f", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 262, "text": "文帝踐阼，拜駙馬都尉，遷西海太守，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "ebf15dad851d38eb001a5c88977402b3ec89abc8418c2f7d44cd647c753f4857"}

{"id": "p_b6107dc4998f70eb", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 263, "text": "初，淯外祖父趙安為同縣李壽所殺，淯舅兄弟三人同時病死，壽家喜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "43bd0f6a1ab166c3d1ec413ff7020c451a8d17cd23b0ce4d0095ea5e99f07b0c"}

{"id": "p_6ca09c14861565b1", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 264, "text": "淯母娥自傷父讎不報，乃幃車袖劍，白日刺壽於都亭前，訖，徐詣縣，顏色不變，曰：「父讎己報，請受戮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "0f4eef8d95ebf50cf1658edfda509ec8e7507018ac1a1045f56f2d7f7bd24e10"}

{"id": "p_5d15255bb6ba2183", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 265, "text": "」祿福長尹嘉解印綬縱娥，娥不肯去，遂強載還家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "df04316c70f5c48000289c83bab1f3eab6ec81afaf566f6d787a7ba45b9ba548"}

{"id": "p_f3a686e1d5d07360", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 266, "text": "會赦得免，州郡嘆貴，刊石表閭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "3665fbc96be7723ef13f89dcf6870a38cde1c4e0590a8538deaec51d056421c0"}

{"id": "p_21bb89b5b92d7ca8", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 267, "text": "閻溫字伯儉，天水西城人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "445bd59a6fe95ed71ebe57598920fb67a745e5e9c1e8e6f2c540d846460e65ea"}

{"id": "p_185f87cb4110b65d", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 268, "text": "馬超走奔上邽，郡人任養等舉眾迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "9d848a53d3232dcc3cc08513d33118333d91aafed1ddd594cae7191a418690cb"}

{"id": "p_6dbb262c07186ac2", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 269, "text": "溫止之，不能禁，乃馳還州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "8674a5ccafa2a703300fa86476b56e1ba1b0e85d7cde25681c5cb5e1b3ab5a99"}

{"id": "p_57bf3cbb583cfba6", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 270, "text": "超復圍州所治冀城甚急，州乃遣溫密出，告急於夏侯淵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "b23f7d768674934ab451c7edd2fd7cb0c0a00b6d8cf864c938d4736fa25757fa"}

{"id": "p_c7d74fac285626bb", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 271, "text": "賊圍數重，溫夜從水中潛出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "4d8ee6b2fda7521719e0a432a445d79833deeaed43e9fead52893067e8597177"}

{"id": "p_d45a98ad0f1ddfd2", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 272, "text": "明日，賊見其跡，遣人追遮之，於顯親界得溫，執還詣超。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "ec950b5deb7c719515fdef2503e838060a6ff0356647343325d1e10feb7e6be1"}

{"id": "p_f606ec6f0746dda0", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 273, "text": "超解其縛，謂曰：「今成敗可見，足下為孤城請救而執於人手，義何所施？", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "3d95c40c134ff55501248ca475530feb2b1dfbbd8b2db012ad4f12d569f1fec1"}

{"id": "p_b4a0d24430ac085b", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 274, "text": "若從吾言，反謂城中，東方無救，此轉禍為福之計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "e0b1dbb33b5f53cae7bc7d072ca8fa496aa843357b7d3b8e14019c8e77e5530c"}

{"id": "p_97a31f1107ed485b", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 275, "text": "」溫偽許之，超乃載溫詣城下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "5247b332a9599e836f78c6235f65922aa331a6e0aad713d3de5ef9948a120f28"}

{"id": "p_c10640ef5b94df4b", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 276, "text": "溫向城大呼曰：「大軍不過三日至，勉之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "94f4ee90184b3a877189793435a02b12358ec100d3a3557e0ee382d132a3ba42"}

{"id": "p_f04b5bab62654cab", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 277, "text": "超怒數之曰：「足下不為命計邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "c13fbd2391cb2d78257c6c4c005a66b0e15cbaea2a4df5917088481365596b30"}

{"id": "p_09a2d720072cbb15", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 278, "text": "時超攻城久不下，故徐誘溫，冀其改意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "5fda088a00c4b7f1852356d1e0029b6e3815817889bd5e50276cab71f4cb3d74"}

{"id": "p_46ed7cd5c6cc9d94", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 279, "text": "復謂溫曰：「城中故人，有欲與吾同者不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "14e9bbaa8485f6536d1b5a10b87ef319af21742303ac014da5f0a76e3e9ee88c"}

{"id": "p_0c0af8aa9b1189b7", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 280, "text": "遂切責之，溫曰：「夫事君有死無貳，而卿乃欲令長者出不義之言，吾豈苟生者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "75985020e6eaa09fc8f67734a1559c4dad73e69e8f398f89fbcb42629df1d213"}

{"id": "p_a2d86ce9d9727565", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 281, "text": "先是，河右擾亂，隔絕不通，敦煌太守馬艾卒官，府又無丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "464ecddb2a133cf45ce132f7dc6d96e3a8ee6a119dc32e7883710ec638a0e718"}

{"id": "p_a29ed27461410f89", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 282, "text": "功曹張恭素有學行，郡人推行長史事，恩信甚著，乃遣子就東詣太祖，請太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "e44bb70dd4e1df9e85ec2498ad87ab58b1432df263bb21bb4c6816193c0da4a4"}

{"id": "p_2db19d128cbb8c2b", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 283, "text": "時酒泉黃華、張掖張進各據其郡，欲與恭（艾）並勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "d3f661c6c770a459ed5b702192d751e29e9b0b465ab46ae86fbfd298a56c2370"}

{"id": "p_898bdf0adc8a84ba", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 284, "text": "就至酒泉，為華所拘執，劫以白刃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "13a87277163b7b76e4d5085678165661494c981a6597b1afb08a214aa958d011"}

{"id": "p_3e3b8702bf63c6dd", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 285, "text": "就終不回，私與恭疏曰：「大人率厲敦煌，忠義顯然，豈以就在困危之中而替之哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "7cba60e37205854f97aff211c64191405103e67eff985b3be087fc0ee5e2cd29"}

{"id": "p_5bf7c999b883ca36", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 286, "text": "昔樂羊食子，李通覆家，經國之臣，寧懷妻孥邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "abd19589a5e6c7a972a9e5a2523ecd5a68337376f8e1e8390ffc75672ea90ca7"}

{"id": "p_4a21db1b92ac96a1", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 287, "text": "今大軍垂至，但當促兵以掎之耳；原不以下流之愛，使就有恨於黃壤也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "1ee13f1a597cc1447c0f81464ec6b0cd5bec27fff9ac8350586d28cb5fcf2350"}

{"id": "p_59cb4659329ab7cf", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 288, "text": "」恭即遣從弟華攻酒泉沙頭、-{乾}-齊二縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "e62cc99da5c6b3e99ba1bf15a8fc0adf99b903eed0b6841d80a787b9c897372c"}

{"id": "p_878a38b5dce8068d", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 289, "text": "恭又連兵尋繼華後，以為首尾之援。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "0322ecb95f4f4dd2eee0fb6ff34e504a61d95bab79347de7bb63d381f92028a1"}

{"id": "p_8495034880e75c1b", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 290, "text": "別遣鐵騎二百，迎吏官屬，東緣酒泉北塞，徑出張掖北河，逢迎太守尹奉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "593f4445c269c3c0b1c01a14a68b7dbec1662e91226d3f47bbcb183b33d94976"}

{"id": "p_8343356c37cc4a44", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 291, "text": "於是張進須黃華之助；華欲救進，西顧恭兵，恐急擊其後，遂詣金城太守蘇則降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "c9213fea51eb0dd0d6c11b65d045afda38948fafa4266bc8ff1b9b30f24ce707"}

{"id": "p_09dcbc4f5443e382", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 292, "text": "，下詔褒揚，賜恭爵關內侯，拜西域戊己校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "65503cb1fd4ce80a2e562ce8726aded8a5a6e03645da9ed5bcef834d81556ddf"}

{"id": "p_eb64123bf6beb900", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 293, "text": "數歲徵還，將授以侍臣之位，而以子就代焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "a0681e04edff358cbfbe42dcf1dff6d5cd58681e36152af04209274448d34215"}

{"id": "p_b861a4d1e1b7e54e", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 294, "text": "就後為金城太守，父子著稱於西州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "93a5279c94c7f90b16e066ab87ac0036fc196d03df7bd60c9454f0bfcfad0ec5"}

{"id": "p_4d335c88e894b439", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 295, "text": "評曰：李典貴尚儒雅，義忘私隙，美矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "9d9614125554573b09138c17be2fc568a35b3c550a06ea31452d5c1588b5287d"}

{"id": "p_840ab6b695af4da3", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 296, "text": "李通、臧霸、文聘、呂虔鎮衛州郡，並著威惠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "68b05756fea5454302280ed51d76391fb18c075faad3448bbf32d23c46da6458"}

{"id": "p_c75900c5d774bf22", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 297, "text": "許褚、典韋折衝左右，抑亦漢之樊噲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "b75bb0efe4d49248e057f92b55093a4cc30784c1490be648d7ce864d5551f810"}

{"id": "p_9650c3e9167d31cf", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 298, "text": "龐德授命叱敵，有周苛之節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "2bf409f0f2353763bcbded7c3b94a2ba206d06a905c1fa418cc89d350b94ec03"}

{"id": "p_4481b23634aa1660", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 299, "text": "龐淯不憚伏劍，而誠感鄰國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "dc9c92efd513b3de63a46a481eebbd1a1c725bdb6abc662b5d6637ca091ebaab"}

{"id": "p_bb3ef692aca99953", "source_id": "src_2395d786f555a79c", "ordinal": 300, "text": "閻溫向城大呼，齊解、路之烈焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "9b838b74b13931e4ba0b17c4b3961885847efc56e20b060d3477833e66ecb4d1"}

{"id": "p_5bef1967c417fe2e", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_cf50f11f4a7e570d", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 1, "text": "少善射御，膂力過人，手格猛獸，不避險阻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "da9241dbf0953f5323d753dcc18429b0e08ae595f80ac3c5604647722c54c649"}

{"id": "p_dea7b6d560007d02", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 2, "text": "數從-{征}-伐，志意慷慨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "ee4c27ea3bdad1ba29e90731b91dc151f7d8c57fc4c5895fe4555cf750659659"}

{"id": "p_68190b6aa217cf53", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 3, "text": "太祖嘗抑之曰：『汝不念讀書慕聖道，而好乘汗馬擊劍，此一夫之用，何足貴也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "9a436555dc305d2842b3b3a27cd955e780e25d514ff1fcfbbea6aac59b4869ce"}

{"id": "p_013cb1deb2547685", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 4, "text": "』課彰讀《詩》《書》，彰謂左右曰：『丈夫一為衛、霍，將十萬騎馳沙漠，驅戎狄，立功建號耳，何能作博士邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "1d14afc64200367179a80922fcb7428468de454cf5910778e45bf67149e9a322"}

{"id": "p_7ede49ba9ebda348", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 5, "text": "』太祖嘗問諸子所好，使各言其志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "a7ed8fc33926935010b67d1095eee3b500810d479f13a4d6efe268f91928b843"}

{"id": "p_1120ddd434e55ee7", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 6, "text": "』對曰：『被堅執銳，臨難不顧，為士卒先；賞必行，罰必信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "7d33072fcfa556f76265ea67e39e399d366cc646da41fe3ef9adcb6a93b0fac4"}

{"id": "p_63b9d5008d7c2341", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 7, "text": "二十三年，代郡烏丸反，以彰為北中郎將，行驍騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "66c4e2ca96a9a509b87ce3aa13d89500bbee68bd09331fd61e7aed2cee26d75b"}

{"id": "p_0274c1561cfeb259", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 8, "text": "臨發，太祖戒彰曰：『居家為父子，受事為君臣，動以王法從事，爾其戒之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "0e8163777f8932aa2c3d53485a43a0fa546043a4efa722f639a8bc11c8685245"}

{"id": "p_69d73f4e6ce0481d", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 9, "text": "』彰北-{征}-，入涿郡界，叛胡數千騎卒至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "24eb33041b9beafef4b4dfbd93ccedb6a3923bd0bff4c2908c64284368f27f56"}

{"id": "p_bf8c9ea9c00a227c", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 10, "text": "時兵馬未集，唯有步卒千人，騎數百匹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "93297108062b7f4c017f305fca97b4d2eb36cc00e665658ed51b0a94a6f42473"}

{"id": "p_1c76768c1f416e88", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 11, "text": "用田豫計，固守要隙，虜乃退散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "3784bc66097033a339e84831865addd9e80a411b980226523d08c5ae11a13e89"}

{"id": "p_ac1a334d2745f26d", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 12, "text": "彰追之，身自搏戰，射胡騎，應弦而倒者前後相屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "1e5acf7f1521e0933516c0b84fb7318b7363aac97432ac7bfd7a709b158bf18e"}

{"id": "p_30966fdbbc016d19", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 13, "text": "戰過半日，彰鎧中數箭，意氣益厲，乘勝逐北，至于桑乾，去代二百餘里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "8bb1b15cf2f16bb11090fd045389367ba279c207988ec2c8812818225d0f2bae"}

{"id": "p_09ca3c731e2517df", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 14, "text": "長史諸將皆以為新涉遠，士馬疲頓，又受節度，不得過代，不可深進，違令輕敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "3dec8f5a55420aff4c1adf2976258dece695d694e956f4565f84d2b5ba2f6889"}

{"id": "p_d92a338d688160b9", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 15, "text": "彰曰：『率師而行，唯利所在，何節度乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "734faaca852bfebbce81e52d38e06c3e75d2d5acfd17e6673ebb312c6e4e9e4e"}

{"id": "p_4ee93a114ae19000", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 16, "text": "』遂上馬，令軍中：『後出者斬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "1b0717e0ee1ca073a176792fe3f6ab6633dad047c1cb814414754f640202ae5d"}

{"id": "p_fda82d77204bc31b", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 17, "text": "』一日一夜與虜相及，擊，大破之，斬首獲生以千數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "563773f1d43729de3c79897ae2d1efd12b264aa9ddb3b1b9646620288c72bc93"}

{"id": "p_9d088ffdb5f4ddce", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 18, "text": "彰乃倍常科大賜將士，將士無不悅喜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "051f9297705ef11490431358dc6c9493ed75d83df05d3f3dec2e59d7d97da759"}

{"id": "p_cf51cc08f8985dc1", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 19, "text": "時鮮卑大人軻比能將數萬騎觀望彊弱，見彰力戰，所向皆破，乃請服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "729c4d9d4af7016c6157535f51158b0ea60b1c076e06fd3f8a5be75564da9342"}

{"id": "p_8f17c92938dd78ed", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 20, "text": "時太祖在長安，召彰詣行在所。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "d52fa90e4562435c26b4ceffbb60b04a3e931dc5fd23458a6638cba3e1c361e0"}

{"id": "p_d675f87a730271d7", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 21, "text": "彰自代過鄴，太子謂彰曰：『卿新有功，今西見上，宜勿自伐，應對常若不足者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "a1800db0b2e996d402ae36de07aac52f2db4b243763b098488ae07c9ba9bc7da"}

{"id": "p_0005aca5efc58088", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 22, "text": "』彰到，如太子言，歸功諸將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "45dd03d417fc9622f232596b3a933032c41e600eb7e0fa1c4023cea0f366e897"}

{"id": "p_5293fd29326565c5", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 23, "text": "太祖喜，持彰鬚曰：『黃鬚兒竟大奇也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "70f2d39e0cdd5f0a31f343c604af055bc4b6fd65e847d5fda26a0fb4bbef0d30"}

{"id": "p_b9cb9e42411588cb", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 24, "text": "太祖東還，以彰行越騎將軍，留長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "c5f0d42f2ccd33505245940f91edcd9766ec6cf50a0d8cd1ec66662be949c7e4"}

{"id": "p_932d8c38a55fc5fd", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 25, "text": "太祖至洛陽，得疾，驛召彰，未至，太祖崩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "7fb9e153171d04d567ada71a9070a9a79813ec1ced0a13ca5b39ca3f018624bc"}

{"id": "p_de98a06121342751", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 26, "text": "文帝即王位，彰與諸侯就國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "e2ff25ecbf127edcb9a191721328cae630c4fce6481e417d6ed8a746e6cec292"}

{"id": "p_fb50d2a5411cbc55", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 27, "text": "詔曰：『先王之道，庸勳親親，並建母弟，開國承家，故能藩屏大宗，禦侮厭難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "7353eea381b5944fd864fff857aed91ce0943cdab07192d1d5d06e3977363847"}

{"id": "p_149fc7d49ecd8385", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 28, "text": "彰前受命北伐，清定朔土，厥功茂焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "2380cb2d361049122a641ea60053862bcd71270e7c510d1ae429a20ba84f4850"}

{"id": "p_00b92d2cc8eb924a", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 29, "text": "四年，朝京都，疾薨於邸，謚曰威。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "409f2426796f5e8670a882b852750de4448c24cad68259f280ca23a81eca128c"}

{"id": "p_ec13fbfbf1025c80", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 30, "text": "至葬，賜鑾輅、龍旂，虎賁百人，如漢東平王故事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "a6a3e698aa2590818363c940dd2b5962745b8b16a2fa1d0e87c4bb08ae09070c"}

{"id": "p_0aad83008963a687", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 31, "text": "，復改封任城國，食五縣二千五百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "86ed332b30990e13d83ae49669bff91d9db82d16144fc8ca3139e2cbbd877bad"}

{"id": "p_c795d13a142649a5", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 32, "text": "，楷坐私遣官屬詣中尚方作禁物，削縣二千戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "ddb165f8431ed45385a9d70948bd2128732152b40c2cf39f3d4c365d2c0bcddb"}

{"id": "p_988c57c6318c4c97", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 33, "text": "正元、景元初，連增邑，凡四千四百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "7bc1553922b822cd2a556b9048e9ede71b11fdd8dcfaaef89f42c4e8a8155dd9"}

{"id": "p_4e358402767eba69", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 34, "text": "年十歲餘，誦讀《詩》《論》及辭賦數十萬言，善屬文。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "49b1720682f5919471da857bde5bec07a54544703689a314befe882aef16ae3b"}

{"id": "p_165537f9eb27b8fd", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 35, "text": "太祖嘗視其文，謂植曰：『汝倩人邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "31b614bf443f23adb4be3cfde219d27673c5d4460a88a022921cd95d2da28c2f"}

{"id": "p_9b7712d66f8e3cc1", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 36, "text": "』植跪曰：『言出為論，下筆成章，顧當面試，奈何倩人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "6ffd1c7635c082e2be9ee79fa0efaa9b2ed72e0ad157fc3ddb26f75b73cbc6ef"}

{"id": "p_0da900efd7f2b71e", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 37, "text": "』時鄴銅爵臺新成，太祖悉將諸子登臺，使各為賦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "0e096f78e5c0f1ce9d7a9b49131c91fc678983e348be44d2842c21e5c38d6354"}

{"id": "p_13c0a18a97f04bf5", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 38, "text": "植援筆立成，可觀，太祖甚異之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "99f6dd0d297ff1c55d8f3a0f8a1520f0f5fe7e4e3fd20b3b831702207feb30af"}

{"id": "p_29ae42e52b410486", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 39, "text": "每進見難問，應聲而對，特見寵愛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "5449ccd50d1b13f37f982a7616e84c85d7f4d01f4f581363436b8ba560ebde44"}

{"id": "p_af7aaef63b4cf12f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 40, "text": "太祖-{征}-孫權，使植留守鄴，戒之曰：『吾昔為頓邱令，年二十三。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "3e8d2093c6867c2f064aadfdba539295527da02797f1871b3bc1b00a7feae57d"}

{"id": "p_89f647addecc719c", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 41, "text": "今汝年亦二十三矣，可不勉與！", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "73595db03ffdfcae1a3a3ac1dc26bcfe64fb1c8e5ad9aebe1822f17ff54b04ca"}

{"id": "p_2c0cfb2dcbc9e4e9", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 42, "text": "』植既以才見異，而丁儀、丁廙、楊脩等為之羽翼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "2630186b70cc2c54849967979f83db084ba07892fe4e5981afeb92ebac50a6e0"}

{"id": "p_4566f323645026d0", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 43, "text": "太祖狐疑，幾為太子者數矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "3b9aa5865e86aeb05ea3766895d191772f259cf839451d3cef98d62f5afced3a"}

{"id": "p_47183f8143604d9b", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 44, "text": "而植任性而行，不自彫勵，飲酒不節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "35ca471bcf7fcb95e222a7098b106c53e4f3a5d5707fed1e7cdd055802f950a6"}

{"id": "p_c74783516b5a1f2d", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 45, "text": "文帝御之以術，矯情自飾，宮人左右，併為之說，故遂定為嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "698ad25852d8392107db74b5449ae7f7d118f4b8950e8155dbf9425804d249b7"}

{"id": "p_6aef49918deb7a66", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 46, "text": "二十二年，增置邑五千，並前萬戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "d0dade81d9daf693410bfecdba17870f7c45a975d2cedc8549953b64ebccf8e5"}

{"id": "p_e7d181511e7d8f3f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 47, "text": "植嘗乘車行馳道中，開司馬門出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "e4073c01af17513900ff33bd92a797ab0f61520941e96402ee9f3607c76c768d"}

{"id": "p_8f00a341ca8df2c2", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 48, "text": "由是重諸侯科禁，而植寵日衰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "61357e8d110f1d13338e3cb8254135cd2e6880fa71ce2c03064dda01ed52dbe9"}

{"id": "p_408f1595c2262438", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 49, "text": "《魏武故事》載令曰：『始者謂子建，兒中最可定大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "6503183d432cfff7eae8adad977893a2c831ca6fe2c89c02cef861b502f8267f"}

{"id": "p_7b453223576b5759", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 50, "text": "』又令曰：『自臨菑侯植私出，開司馬門至金門，令吾異目視此兒矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "32b885f887d81ee544a618d980870703f5726800fed707f2fbdd0db060a87d82"}

{"id": "p_a368a9d14e3346b3", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 51, "text": "』又令曰：『諸侯長史及帳下吏，知吾出輒將諸侯行意否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "6fbb7e2253d4c033ef07bddcc99e6bc6d87eb1f32404ec5202428023dde6aa7f"}

{"id": "p_0b8413c7a6998c84", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 52, "text": "從子建私開司馬門來，吾都不覆信諸侯也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "b287c089d100deefb259b781fe521d05e3db7df1bddc0d2956d53348e916b15b"}

{"id": "p_8e17a117863ee15a", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 53, "text": "恐吾適出，便復私出，故攝將行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "2b618ca344aafe009e0c1587b896d780457f8aae910ea0f8606298c999d8f757"}

{"id": "p_1c909f9dcc4bae47", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 54, "text": "不可恆使吾（爾）〔以〕誰為心腹也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "99210dae9e746f0dbcd90d92e10e43f7143e7e4ae8d8a6af651eec2b847600d9"}

{"id": "p_ddcf502013d1bb0e", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 55, "text": "』太祖既慮終始之變，以楊脩頗有才策，而又袁氏之甥也，於是以罪誅脩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "213b5a3fa7a9ecb48332ce400ec7ad09071de5cbc858dadce7568b41aead3043"}

{"id": "p_b8c756809514f9a3", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 56, "text": "《典略》曰：楊脩字德祖，太尉彪子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "fda872f2bccebbeea2680e9b8f45a4c407dc109e967c663ffaf2dbc1699adb01"}

{"id": "p_cb642344c3506aaf", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 57, "text": "建安中，舉孝廉，除郎中，丞相請署倉曹屬主簿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "5b7a9fc87964868d05b586caaf586d8237e540a68197464c04009d4154a0c829"}

{"id": "p_035e4e5c549bd821", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 58, "text": "是時，軍國多事，脩總知外內，事皆稱意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "9671a66f27729db96e21da4ea9971128b3a72465e3592823934af8cd296d1112"}

{"id": "p_72f58e39b1b6ac2f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 59, "text": "自魏太子已下，並爭與交好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "e06818e891d97374a025d41587f2945a38eeb7d8b7e59d3772dde0a9e36ebfb6"}

{"id": "p_b69d2ced3f2a6e43", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 60, "text": "又是時臨菑侯植以才捷愛幸，來意投脩，數與脩書，書曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "f86bd6fc7506d1c4fb1cf524aef1216ba5a5e19543908eff7cadb4e1541be272"}

{"id": "p_9f05fe480c0afae2", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 61, "text": "植後以驕縱見疏，而植故連綴脩不止，脩亦不敢自絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "ca8b1627c888f1e1297782de0ac50af990ddecd7d14a57e2d52dd4d0671f1352"}

{"id": "p_838ab8a4da90f107", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 62, "text": "至二十四年秋，公以脩前後漏泄言教，交關諸侯，乃收殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "11ae1ff26493b9d248d801cfdf0acd30882bffa236266e519fd47f88db9da748"}

{"id": "p_87318ad0813144c6", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 63, "text": "脩臨死，謂故人曰：『我固自以死之晚也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "bc609c354a32f236161f6c83573b4263d5064311018a2e8fc5080a4b5345c70a"}

{"id": "p_752458c9c86a7d68", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 64, "text": "脩死後百餘日而太祖薨，太子立，遂有天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "80ded2e2a526f1175b5116355863fffbaa56528e1de2a8dd043d68ece109021e"}

{"id": "p_8e78605f818348cb", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 65, "text": "初，脩以所得王髦劍奉太子，太子常服之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "59e8d74a4a36901c5a2b8201e0ef8de23bd53d071389214abb1235c932dec75a"}

{"id": "p_30366b41e617ec81", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 66, "text": "及即尊位，在洛陽，從容出宮，追思脩之過薄也，撫其劍，駐車顧左右曰：『此楊德祖昔所說王髦劍也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "77736efc6a1c52815db0bfcee960e7af8c0d6b1557e181e7136471bd5630ed3f"}

{"id": "p_48ebc1b0b22d92aa", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 67, "text": "◎摯虞《文章志》曰：劉季緒名脩，劉表子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "10af34c68e77b31b4ea0a42036c4802c138546712d4f2c47c28492d00dfaac7c"}

{"id": "p_5ad12b57d75e1970", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 68, "text": "◎臣松之案《呂氏春秋》曰：『人有臭者，其兄弟妻子皆莫能與居，其人自苦而居海上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "9dbba724bcb4aeb046fdc8afd73046b153c8e5e36b74abc5843b9e7ef200797d"}

{"id": "p_7a14abc45eb77ca3", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 69, "text": "海上人有悅其臭者，晝夜隨之而不能去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "6e80c32784ec0309f3e84aee8f69361a956a8014ac6bb692c02a63f3a2212b1f"}

{"id": "p_642f5c557eea25eb", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 70, "text": "』此植所云『逐臭之夫』也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "c77a5a47691150895b80ae283e00b7c7fba4c26c59f5c425b3cc9b6ec57eee6b"}

{"id": "p_d524bafcc0a437a1", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 71, "text": "田巴事出《魯連子》，亦見《皇覽》，文多故不載。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "20d5952e92c64f55b617c6c2cce9716fec5aa66e9a3daa4f1043e64479c425da"}

{"id": "p_0e3ec248f2bfe6e8", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 72, "text": "◎《世語》曰：脩年二十五，以名公子有才能，為太祖所器，與丁儀兄弟，皆欲以植為嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "7ed55024bc9d200f63bf12cada7d89423808abe53848362a62e866691c0057ed"}

{"id": "p_c9bbb21f1c54ad2a", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 73, "text": "太子患之，以車載廢簏，內朝歌長吳質與謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "26c554de3a5b088d5602fd0036d42cd5f8df075f49a85a70aadaf35c84e0a098"}

{"id": "p_56fa33a21376d4d4", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 74, "text": "太子懼，告質，質曰：『何患？", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "fe58aaccced306b41dcd78213aa1a5c7cacc0304e4ab061ea97b1dcddd6fed50"}

{"id": "p_1d4bbea8bf96626a", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 75, "text": "明日復以簏受絹車內以惑之，脩必復重白，重白必推，而無驗，則彼受罪矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "0bb22c42dbd035755c71ea60f09f19e5a48d9260f11261c014d1f224250e7b5e"}

{"id": "p_c1fcb657d40b2787", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 76, "text": "』世子從之，脩果白，而無人，太祖由是疑焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "b7e8a210ba0510b153f7fc57e667b4e380f0af31a4205be8a1175f4324070d53"}

{"id": "p_853aeb00a45025d1", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 77, "text": "脩與賈逵、王淩並為主簿，而為植所友。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "a96a6be984607fe44d2ee4397515c96e7e4609fddfc05f44e3f8a9ef0ee6e465"}

{"id": "p_2670e97f1e539747", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 78, "text": "每當就植，慮事有闕，忖度太祖意，豫作答教十餘條，敕門下，教出以次答。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "170f6e308a3777c38cdef5050f94231d2405af29bf53afd7054b907b9236f7a9"}

{"id": "p_ba4d141ade4ecb21", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 79, "text": "教裁出，答已入，太祖怪其捷，推問始泄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "7ed1b76ddb6e64067023ab6f0f200be243f8b60f9b796d534c604a017fa11e17"}

{"id": "p_a9b6553f81539a3c", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 80, "text": "太祖遣太子及植各出鄴城一門，密敕門不得出，以觀其所為。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "5f39ea53177d967bdc362a9f501001b207a9c3d1c1cb1b39b59cc02df369c8a8"}

{"id": "p_91e596ae00a2a522", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 81, "text": "脩先戒植：『若門不出侯，侯受王命，可斬守者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "94aed3849258bb8cc125b432ddc30186af6da878de7a95bb20f48234a1fe14a8"}

{"id": "p_57e42d31953c6c90", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 82, "text": "脩子囂，囂子準，皆知名於晉世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "d6c4cd57017618c1f9399497c0d9112a51530963d49ed932c8d9037c7d8a8c54"}

{"id": "p_136c9db9ff51014f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 83, "text": "囂，泰始初為典軍將軍，受心膂之任，早卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "9ba371aee33755cfce49e62f8958e2bdd63eaf237aff18a8529918028ef33fd8"}

{"id": "p_16395121d72d9552", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 84, "text": "準字始丘，惠帝末為冀州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "253729c8a955c8f40839e7bbda9bbe458fc52e6360ca53084ecd17366b690550"}

{"id": "p_caf50d0fe6a30691", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 85, "text": "◎荀綽《冀州記》曰：準見王綱不振，遂縱酒，不以官事為意，逍遙卒歲而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "7f6bdd6c6f8cf9a10ddc75e1dbb96873701af55892b75c8494618431aaa1fd64"}

{"id": "p_97f7aec5a34b252f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 86, "text": "成都王知準不治，猶以其為名士，惜而不責，召以為軍謀祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "74a443770d8da2ed63144b41082d24f541fae0bb7464361b2329d9d2895ab5fd"}

{"id": "p_504a01323c55c657", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 87, "text": "府散停家，關東諸侯議欲以準補三事，以示懷賢尚德之舉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "f835d1a7c07d83802fe9e8baea83cc58335482b2927e6299b0edb2a32641de73"}

{"id": "p_577c12ac91e28138", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 88, "text": "準子嶠字國彥，髦字士彥，並為後出之俊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "72d70dec666ca89af2dc3103df39184da59a0383ff93a8686f2a89415effae90"}

{"id": "p_fecb84a1b8b85529", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 89, "text": "準與裴頠、樂廣善，遣往見之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "055ffe447116b4f1b467df0a34a7014a1a27b982a8402be37d74521a453737bd"}

{"id": "p_4330c175966800c6", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 90, "text": "頠性弘方，愛嶠之有高韻，謂準曰：『嶠當及卿，然髦小減也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "3687cc735f3f6cb7e5ded3e4f825493fcc725ee87f3f11908335dd2ccdce6319"}

{"id": "p_6a2a7e326ffcefa6", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 91, "text": "』廣性清淳，愛髦之有神檢，謂準曰：『嶠自及卿，然髦尤精出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "22147bbdc48d601e98b44ec0483e8021d297ea7f154b64ab06f69b34d97046b5"}

{"id": "p_e1ebb33548a2d3dc", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 92, "text": "』準歎曰：『我二兒之優劣，乃裴、樂之優劣也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "32f050d371e0fcf4c088f6b1192d1ba29be319aff8b36bf054f14ece9bfdea82"}

{"id": "p_dc110c8b7728fa42", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 93, "text": "』評者以為嶠雖有高韻，而神檢不逮，廣言為得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "a5fc28a7deae830bb6d52c44b4437832e45251ac995bd2fcde920340129a2baa"}

{"id": "p_9f5edb7395d35285", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 94, "text": "』嶠弟俊，字惠彥，最清出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "40196f28a34151ec066d6c5bbac6824d9d1fa54ebce0c13b0486e472e6e33ae1"}

{"id": "p_2e71c0113035ebf2", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 95, "text": "二十四年，曹仁為關羽所圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "1456e89d4568ad2dc91be04d1fc1e6d2657603fa42f83444ca16e52554194228"}

{"id": "p_9974523614a03144", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 96, "text": "太祖以植為南中郎將，行-{征}-虜將軍，欲遣救仁，呼有所敕戒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "3566b8c45682784237772ab06331b1ca402969d471549587c8b3de82ba3002fa"}

{"id": "p_f51167eaacab2bb6", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 97, "text": "植醉不能受命，於是悔而罷之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "b3c2b6462062be8ea96bd41ff76fa8f1c5f04f35b459025ac54bd977c9854633"}

{"id": "p_b2512c90bf2d01af", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 98, "text": "文帝即王位，誅丁儀、丁廙并其男口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "0812bc8e29ae197ab8264f02e6cf8b8f1da5051f77f4130f86009bf73bbe25db"}

{"id": "p_97e94709bbfe02b4", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 99, "text": "，監國謁者灌均希指，奏『植醉酒悖慢，劫脅使者』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "0e2dadbfc090fbf61d988729b7461913fa74c2fca7b2a16a7ca058cca14c54ad"}

{"id": "p_e51fd26d3f9a8f39", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 100, "text": "有司請治罪，帝以太后故，貶爵安鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "82939fc087ff4d313b5b817c96bcb644a1b7ed034470cb16ef84b6f2f2d9204a"}

{"id": "p_6d49b61561829b5e", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 101, "text": "三年，立為鄄城王，邑二千五百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "81bf795066644dc431347de2d89bee7c98bb267716841a28b556341ff51cb6b7"}

{"id": "p_1795351f798b9447", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 102, "text": ":臣自抱釁歸藩，刻肌刻骨，追思罪戾，晝分而食，夜分而寢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "326dc2f3deb5badfab6858b373b64951e0accc107807073879e4da0c7d6c0fff"}

{"id": "p_1f3320d185cebb2a", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 103, "text": "誠以天罔不可重離，聖恩難可再恃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "1b108d13670c95e11604ec538c386dfef5c41ca303eb8f80ac5aa2b14974b27f"}

{"id": "p_669013910946a50f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 104, "text": "竊感相鼠之篇，無禮遄死之義，形影相弔，五情愧赧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "b57439305fcc7ef7922396ccc9fe1d858542fa293a61dd8121ab5fdb59163bba"}

{"id": "p_e0b5aae5cc2b50f2", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 105, "text": "以罪棄生，則違古賢『夕改』之勸，忍活苟全，則犯詩人『胡顏』之譏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "ade5b3444aa8e56b8b82a30132616256fdaf632f942d731de0b68ede65ab2dec"}

{"id": "p_7fdc060687dcbac6", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 106, "text": "伏惟陛下德象天地，恩隆父母，施暢春風，澤如時雨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "96888a7dd16286f1f7d9248c8255d94a8e21739e3d1e8331bb4e358189d9486a"}

{"id": "p_fc4be42e4a2f300f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 107, "text": "是以不別荊棘者，慶雲之惠也；七子均養者，屍鳩之仁也；舍罪責功者，明君之舉也；矜愚愛能者，慈父之恩也：是以愚臣徘徊於恩澤而不能自棄者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "1f44aa2479e96076aabd8fb555f7aa0299880556a90a3f8838bd450c7b2aec6a"}

{"id": "p_471c6ac10b298dc2", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 108, "text": "前奉詔書，臣等絕朝，心離志絕，自分黃耇無復執珪之望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "012ee35ce7bec4478480eb511896decb7ebc67d0ffc129ba616ea8c6da439fe3"}

{"id": "p_93ecb4f4b569ef48", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 109, "text": "不圖聖詔猥垂齒召，至止之日，馳心輦轂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "c3ddc0fcc4ee27f008254be24b2ba36986a83353a56271257fcbd98bb558ead1"}

{"id": "p_6311e1a9022a4b7f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 110, "text": "僻處西館，未奉闕廷，踴躍之懷，瞻望反仄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "c9bb5b6d5521015f6d1f175cbe973e710b6c4a06c7667d83f6eb6e65a9b00e7f"}

{"id": "p_cd2d6cdc4867a7c1", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 111, "text": "謹拜表獻詩二篇，其辭曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "b60f326890c1a6464e2281fbba0bbf99be4df6bd30f4f98d69f84c92a80ff596"}

{"id": "p_c8837221a32cf38c", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 112, "text": "::命彼掌徒 肅我-{征}-旅", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "3d331c6eb6cacca64040bf872adaa7960606f2be13436be9ddf28caeb674b285"}

{"id": "p_aaf7ad19548f4ddd", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 113, "text": "帝嘉其辭義，優詔答勉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "97be58e87a8c9bbb9fca15f7a448fc97d1897faccd9cbb3e29fc263308a3ae07"}

{"id": "p_6034e5b937359dc2", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 114, "text": "六年，帝東征，還過雍丘，幸植宮，增戶五百。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "12c9da7df6bc25f112c1146eaf7d62e5cd564b63b61464e0ca047e0f96e17075"}

{"id": "p_94e5e66018053692", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 115, "text": "植常自憤怨，抱利器而無所施，上疏求自試曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "0f10898f2683f3482a6b4d816c1641962808c0b50456579b8181eb7fedc62e00"}

{"id": "p_9577bc127e67464f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 116, "text": "五年，覆上疏求存問親戚，因致其意曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "52f79b35fb5dddff9523f3d84737b79a6b55b63d735cadf6b84bb53a70b1c529"}

{"id": "p_84fe20f6d560cd1f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 117, "text": "植覆上疏陳審舉之義，曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "d50ff020b641fd26021e4ca0e8c4f2ae54fdbb8363d0e786dec8b289053504da"}

{"id": "p_5bb4fcf3d9825044", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 118, "text": "其年冬，詔諸王朝六年正月。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "da119b22c878d80296a84939c2fb3fc3191d337b7436c05acc65e66e66d53e0e"}

{"id": "p_39b6044b49092bc6", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 119, "text": "其二月，以陳四縣封植為陳王，邑三千五百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "3fde5a42317ef1c2f6a2377c117f127c8cfeca85a2a5d3c27e59dfc9fc5003ee"}

{"id": "p_3fdd4c4d942aa29c", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 120, "text": "植每欲求別見獨談，論及時政，幸冀試用，終不能得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "1de7365d8eef9c5ee523d067e23bd7d3f15a3200382fe53f6baa3e4ffb0b9445"}

{"id": "p_3442c62bcb2e7bdd", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 121, "text": "時法制，待藩國既自峻迫，寮屬皆賈豎下才，兵人給其殘老，大數不過二百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "3213c93eea21d93b5b9b9fe27f8e1d5bf806755b3b9c589f4d6b15c514596b39"}

{"id": "p_74f4e3ec965f9219", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 122, "text": "又植以前過，事事復減半，十一年中而三徙都，常汲汲無歡，遂發疾薨，時年四十一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "d508fdddb8af1ee0168e5674114d60230734081fc26e8c4f36ba6174787e1b06"}

{"id": "p_6e1d7063bc6801ca", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 124, "text": "初，植登魚山，臨東阿，喟然有終焉之心，遂營為墓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "99c2d55be18264032ec5076509fb8d421f29a80cb557e3f03f7f023044228fa7"}

{"id": "p_de1aa52b78ef8438", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 125, "text": "景初中詔曰：『陳思王昔雖有過失，既克己慎行，以補前闕，且自少至終，篇籍不離於手，誠難能也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "034ac0a316dbbb04abd5749fca63442b7dbbe4bc97675745c783fa61d22a3785"}

{"id": "p_aa2b4310c5ae8a23", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 126, "text": "其收黃初中諸奏植罪狀，公卿已下議尚書、秘書、中書三府、大鴻臚者皆削除之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "61b7d728cf7b21f3119a8932b3b9d0d1b35cfdf84f6a71626ba6c1bb507fd97b"}

{"id": "p_b3976556262ddb7a", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 127, "text": "撰錄植前後所著賦頌詩銘雜論凡百餘篇，副藏內外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "7aa9267a7a04309b85b54db7c30e61d80db6985631068649fa2ae38ef3f881af"}

{"id": "p_a706c3aa805d0c8e", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 128, "text": "』志累增邑，並前九百九十戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "7d8b52624be84a0066e2f2f4ddc87db29bb6f68bdf8cc8df16459c9aba3a7c13"}

{"id": "p_cb9ff3a61ae8e248", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 129, "text": "，子哀王炳嗣，食邑二千五百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "fa3359de0936b49f56b517d8159478e3fcc31258a2dd0d7fd24e4d7ac60e38ee"}

{"id": "p_14c0c6a7f3898d7d", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 130, "text": "評曰：任城武藝壯猛，有將領之氣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "912834ce55859f24706f7221aa392028974c2e5cbd7bdb7eb310bff79984dc75"}

{"id": "p_ba6c86c27910384f", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 131, "text": "陳思文才富艷，足以自通後葉，然不能克讓遠防，終致攜隙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "b42f2611118c27f3bcb4e06a02bfe951f85a2d95e16108cc4b0769df8b8b75a1"}

{"id": "p_b14fcf8392edd893", "source_id": "src_e093b186de8e909c", "ordinal": 132, "text": "而齊亦未為得也』，其此之謂歟！", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "a88897755fc308920bb9100ee61beeab13a54b7501630e0cf624022b223a9f9d"}

{"id": "p_f8efbe3840fea22b", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_a6ab157a90b52188", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 1, "text": "武皇帝二十五男：卞皇-{后}-生文皇帝、任城威王彰、陳思王植、蕭懷王熊；劉夫人生-{豐}-愍王昂、相殤王鑠；環夫人生鄧哀王-{衝}-、彭城王-{據}-、燕王宇；杜夫人生沛穆王林、中山恭王衮；秦夫人生濟陽懷王玹、陳留恭王峻；尹夫人生-{范}-陽閔王矩；王昭儀生趙王-{幹}-；孫姬生臨邑殤公子上、楚王彪、剛殤公子勤；李姬生-{谷}-城殤公子乘、郿戴公子整、靈殤公子京；周姬生樊安公均；劉姬生廣宗殤公子棘；宋姬生東平靈王徽；趙姬生樂陵王茂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "a85f1f51ccdf7748f9e1ed24e675827f2d979838f32926ef3ac269025af0aa1a"}

{"id": "p_791b01ccc3d471b5", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 2, "text": "==-{豐}-愍王昂==", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "c71fdcb2fb71e623cf8c4d09284e176329c4626ecdedb9c64eaf0c32723c9736"}

{"id": "p_5c028d4072b786fd", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 3, "text": "-{豐}-愍王昂字子脩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "afcc7ba94842b496e55eda673fc506978e55949bea25588b88d98de9c7163679"}

{"id": "p_598c72cd88bfea10", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 4, "text": "隨太祖南-{征}-，爲張繡所害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "a66b0d31795e67241d99b5c0888e8a89d4cbba8ac5794527e0ced8ca88ab9174"}

{"id": "p_cb58061f424e258c", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 5, "text": "追封，諡曰-{豐}-悼公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "fb4f7718ccb7ac8cf067a650c5dbc494abd559d990bb427640a9aafa1405657c"}

{"id": "p_88efaebdc5ebb6cb", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 6, "text": "三年，以樊安公均子琬奉昂-{zh:後;zh-hant:後;zh-hans:后}-，封中都公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "bf5705e23fa882ed849500e47b33e4aca1f484271bd42efb05e65f34127fa22f"}

{"id": "p_893f0e0df255e13d", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 7, "text": "五年，追加昂號曰-{豐}-悼王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "d521e1c35b2ce17e7f956ffc165674654d5db5807e63637449a1740fc588f59d"}

{"id": "p_92fe2233eaac3163", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 8, "text": "，以琬襲昂爵爲-{豐}-王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "594b52b2b3f1257819262722ec0a01cf2fd0e9088c443cb8b4a7d6ae9453ff10"}

{"id": "p_ecbe807ba32452bc", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 9, "text": "正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前二千七百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "895634f111b407aa7750bc64f1979c1e4a53e4acb0e865518cdddf6bf1fd7145"}

{"id": "p_678e2c35a1f6cd75", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 10, "text": "相殤王鑠，早薨，追封諡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "8b65b0e536801007fbb59a065fef8d78ae30cf41053c23abf37d6c44220a2f84"}

{"id": "p_cf643c3725ca9100", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 11, "text": "二年，子懷王偃嗣，邑二千五百戸，四年薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "768cc3918ee70672ca874227425a0fc8b5ef0bdbf07d0898578173f62877853f"}

{"id": "p_61645886c8637a85", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 12, "text": "，以樂陵王茂子陽都鄕公竦繼鑠-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "bc31389418bcbc71c95427acbc7431011201fc1ced2179ab4e2a8e7230825a43"}

{"id": "p_6cd4c46e5391b63d", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 13, "text": "鄧哀王-{沖}-字倉舒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "774e828255a5408b3656eea7d3da7b981bebb77d40df0e41ddfaf4d879ed8dc1"}

{"id": "p_3777cfb77fe91675", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 14, "text": "少聰察岐嶷，生五六歳，智意所及，有若成人之智。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "2e92ec1acd98e8917af2a7bd7784815da6c7d3f9be14dfa367fb9ced3d36b8df"}

{"id": "p_e926385f26900537", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 15, "text": "時孫權曾致巨象，太祖欲知其斤重，訪之群下，-{咸}-莫能出其理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "b6f1c4d6b8337978fe5b2b1e5654a59f181e56db0cc5cb209ee2aabe018f85b6"}

{"id": "p_92eb794fa7c17876", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 16, "text": "-{沖}-曰：「置象大船之上，而刻其水痕所至，稱物以載之，則校可知矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "4b38c9315d54a4bdf27d339d773bde7ab6c7b7fbf38b06d02b7b3760526ecd11"}

{"id": "p_79e38acab84e4f5f", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 17, "text": "太祖馬鞍在庫，而爲鼠所齧，庫吏懼必死，議欲-{面}-縛首罪，猶懼不免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "8a636e505b7589e53a68e25544824661089093ad93ee47fc9416142d936549a5"}

{"id": "p_86afebcfeb789eb5", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 18, "text": "-{沖}-謂曰：「待三日中，然-{後}-自歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "d90df6f295efbf20153a8722b59b3038a81d8e6463e6da132b9ecf20b1fb0570"}

{"id": "p_e53480e613fc2cde", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」-{沖}--{於}-是以刀穿單衣，如鼠齧者，謬爲失意，貌有愁色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "50e648c9eb722c16bc2039d369a43621e966e542de85c1a398f7f9fd373a1055"}

{"id": "p_2262b575769be3dc", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 20, "text": "太祖問之，-{沖}-對曰：「世俗以爲鼠齧衣者，其主不吉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "7253c8c03a5d081acf965897be2258109dbe87085d65974cb358a429922b34ba"}

{"id": "p_4014c58fa3124664", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 21, "text": "」太祖曰：「此妄言耳，無所苦也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f3e9674dc7442eccf04475f029556162f0fe3a0bb3e97acebee8ff3b77087e9e"}

{"id": "p_d30f721089198822", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 22, "text": "」俄而庫吏以齧鞍聞，太祖笑曰：「兒衣在側，尙齧，況鞍縣柱乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "25fd4581835d783f6236326c7fbb9b32fa44a1a02df0a0426fdbcb9cec3bb554"}

{"id": "p_067029d2054532f7", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 23, "text": "-{沖}-仁愛識達，皆此類也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "6b094adcb25aa59e2d30d8736cf4cd49549096843cd4b4c1aed1448dc1d5dd32"}

{"id": "p_c89f1e940f9b79ed", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 24, "text": "凡應罪戮，而爲-{沖}-微所辨理，賴以濟宥者，前-{後}-數十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "44f4cddfe49682904d9d9d19763e4bfbc3577c1b0dddfc77055cde2c8d000b79"}

{"id": "p_d415e05b3da67c98", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 25, "text": "太祖數對群臣稱述，有欲傳-{後}-意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "2cb7371cbb895d8137d84ce3a9adb652f212b8013aabc5a1ccbc0523614bc759"}

{"id": "p_d105b916b88fa469", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 26, "text": "年十三，疾病，太祖親爲請命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "3460858618336962503464125097e4ea198cec1fd7ebc9af790a0ea6751fffe8"}

{"id": "p_476eaaa9c8fac9f0", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 27, "text": "文帝寛喩太祖，太祖曰：「此我之不幸，而汝曹之幸也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "1ec433199249e78c630001d3b35c79e6dae3e15d63cdb84ceadbfe3ad067322f"}

{"id": "p_0243f0d09638a898", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」言則流涕，爲聘甄氏亡女與合葬，贈騎都尉印綬，命宛侯-{據}-子琮奉-{沖}--{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "10834895493aec53d5db379362c6ec955780ec89c9b0e5709ec3c1140c6e32a5"}

{"id": "p_1c46db9e9f941fd4", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 29, "text": "，追贈諡-{沖}-曰鄧哀侯，又追加號爲公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "95bafc846f9126e4d66ca1559023f6ae157fddafd8deacadcd02aaa7bf9859aa"}

{"id": "p_18e65e051d4762a3", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 30, "text": "三年，進琮爵，徙封冠軍公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "979de5a9f893aefa19530268c651e2ae75897304580e4b832f42de98afb3a5ea"}

{"id": "p_1ce65fa86cacc33f", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 31, "text": "，加-{沖}-號曰鄧哀王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "668050cbe86f86cead44e709912d7ae904e4c3f189e72c1fbdca4e57bb825459"}

{"id": "p_3be617b0d50acb10", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 32, "text": "，琮坐-{於}-中尙方作禁物，削戸三百，貶爵爲都鄕侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "06a1b1778770b01b09b6a05a27e85c8fa5a6e8e19c80116117899061bf44ff69"}

{"id": "p_3ecaa033736c9376", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 33, "text": "三年，-{復}-爲己氏公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "392c59a287f29bc6e3766bd4077eb0d6dabb34c65c6325e471e7756209e8127d"}

{"id": "p_49ee7393d7203b59", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 34, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前千九百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "f7ce75878bf89dd0f073caafb4260fc16b315be65e9d60907c65af132011a553"}

{"id": "p_9d774c5507902d0f", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 35, "text": "彭城王-{據}-，封-{范}-陽侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "d358bf39aa0d150ff01a2895bedade4ccf987941cbace4fd02cd0c1088b28da9"}

{"id": "p_1ee07e8d1d12bd37", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 36, "text": "三年，爲章陵王，其年徙封義陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "bbd0e8eb2ea5b0b7091043f21417009975a6e1cea5a46b9ef412ea9271d42820"}

{"id": "p_5c6b09499ea7ae15", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 37, "text": "文帝以南方下濕，又以環太妃彭城人，徙封彭城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "e404f6558ba65ed0d2cf7d1e7b1a07904151f472869544770fc6ae7822125cd4"}

{"id": "p_02996f4a82fde7a1", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 38, "text": "五年，詔曰：「先王建國，隨時而-{制}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "c79717c73b247527f1aafd84b5ea9dcab306071d7ed820c935950e35dec5289d"}

{"id": "p_8e487da7ed2b3d04", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 39, "text": "漢祖增秦所置郡，至光武以天下損耗，幷省郡縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "d40ff4934c8f84876f8c3ba978a4e1b2d785ee1da54942a42752cb8fef7af759"}

{"id": "p_641317ce6d203b57", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」-{據}-改封定陶縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "3d85a20d09b3d53e82a0b8affd53497d985471fe15f8d6bbe474556b246a0848"}

{"id": "p_3c7526f296197f49", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 41, "text": "，改封諸王，皆以郡爲國，-{據}--{復}-封彭城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "ff2e720d6721d040d5e8f1fd23db2cee2fb0970a24a77c7aae1a835877796597"}

{"id": "p_e35dce12b1de4126", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 42, "text": "，-{據}-坐私遣人詣中尙方作禁物，削縣二千戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "4eb44fd132b831b1f9678a1c645b8ed97928c7bfd4b0411fc55238f21fceff01"}

{"id": "p_fb63900855d8a211", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 43, "text": "三年，-{復}-所削戸邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "8aeca028c6dd8d647320fe9119d3c3c41d2ad0648db54095cdcb94f44270acdf"}

{"id": "p_39fa21c3450b4c4f", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 44, "text": "正元、景元中累增邑，幷前四千六百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "dc80c635b811a298f03e6de3481cccbc6376ebda38760e6fa23ee01bde4c42c2"}

{"id": "p_bee93c8813096b40", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 45, "text": "明帝少與宇同止，常愛異之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "3b1267e813764b14038710bc85caccf8b113c5edd25b99ea1c4f8052724fc3d3"}

{"id": "p_792382878d21d232", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 46, "text": "二年夏，-{復}--{徴}-詣京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "0c948a6ef306d43ca5e17e0c21900b4457e8ee1d0e5fc07dc42668bcc374edc9"}

{"id": "p_1b55ff1ed53fa0ac", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 47, "text": "冬十二月，明帝疾篤，拜宇爲大將軍，屬以-{後}-事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "897ede432efdb99477b6fbf4bfc904c172dd39ddfbbf98b740a30eea86b4979d"}

{"id": "p_cddcb47b3ed17a11", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 48, "text": "受署四日，宇深固讓；帝意亦變，遂免宇官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "fc066318a2c9e242b714e70026a3f3e688b793c9fe0512b8c5b8fc1222850287"}

{"id": "p_d37e5b839b7dcdaf", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 49, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前五千五百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "e2c10017e6eb030e273d1803048d2d15908ec1c8d5fb5dcdca008547390bd42e"}

{"id": "p_c939d3549908ff5e", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 50, "text": "常道鄕公奐，宇之子，入繼大宗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "d818531a6b851056d0c1e8998e569e63f2590bb6f899d5dd7dc25df7f6441bc4"}

{"id": "p_7b48d239b5230d12", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 51, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前四千七百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "2870898e0ac0eca4edca0a0e1e1a6f8140d9908469444c6cacbbe533134541d0"}

{"id": "p_7d8a24b7c04822ba", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 52, "text": "少好學，年十-{餘}-歳能屬文。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "991ea98071bd3900196603ae532352af0a27a6853a9fd3741690dff49b0ab073"}

{"id": "p_751da6ffe30f3deb", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 53, "text": "毎讀書，文學左右常恐以精力爲病，數諫止之，然性所樂，不能廢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "259114c2c04fae67d6b755efc11b4dec736ba61522ce14b31a9892fd76106293"}

{"id": "p_6992c6f0b69d994f", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 54, "text": "二十二年，徙封東鄕侯，其年又改封贊侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "b3769dca71880698b0586d55ddc08f8da307364e28b8f749ece628b4b49746b3"}

{"id": "p_f0d141caf7755f59", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 55, "text": "，進爵爲公，官屬皆賀，衮曰：「夫生深宮之中，不知稼穡之艱難，多驕逸之失。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "727d8e13daf060ca0e7631250142734c956b76218beb160508a07b54ff279400"}

{"id": "p_d30a9802d81fab8d", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 56, "text": "諸賢旣慶其休，宜輔其闕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "fecab1f5c983eb3edaa0c62f3c47b091d0894568056ce547cb0f450808abf552"}

{"id": "p_c79ed4747571e44d", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 57, "text": "」毎兄弟-{遊}-娯，衮獨覃思經典。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "6fff6222ecbc2306e572b7e0926e63aeeb4932157e2f19bc90024ae98943bdc9"}

{"id": "p_c2ce2c8ec460f1c3", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 58, "text": "文學防輔相與言曰：「受詔察公舉錯，有過當奏，及有善，亦宜以聞，不可匿其美也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "fb4bf6ce266b645f7c4458459e002eb89c94c421c4be9c4bb069dcab73fa8d1d"}

{"id": "p_ece291337a2a8e2f", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 59, "text": "衮聞之，大驚懼，責讓文學曰：「脩身自守，常人之行耳，而諸君乃以上聞，是-{適}-所以增其負累也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "d04eb46869ea5e7bc89150c85bc07368745db90a3456fec9d14ae136e7f8c265"}

{"id": "p_7a436f7a40e8fe72", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 60, "text": "且如有善，何患不聞，而遽共如是，是非益我者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "c94caae779733a536775b18ea6a0b085512baa488c14b82dc37fd04dee0280a2"}

{"id": "p_1a5ce3e66bbf9ffe", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 61, "text": "其年，黃龍見鄴西漳水，衮上書贊頌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "583904bd2d9db7382191e893efc523ea86504f15d2652e8bcdcaf8feff9a5938"}

{"id": "p_b0391136a190d1cf", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 62, "text": "詔賜黃金十斤，詔曰：「昔唐叔歸禾，東平獻頌，斯皆骨肉贊美，以彰懿親。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "3d5d1f04aa623e0c965255d6e2fdfdff6130461ef70a9bdce8e6453f1914be9d"}

{"id": "p_6f9b22550c71cf23", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 63, "text": "王硏精墳典，耽味道眞，文雅煥炳，朕甚嘉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "47c11a296697aaa265c68e07eb67e0edee205663d184e8036e48fb34a694c14a"}

{"id": "p_811a62520e281d66", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 64, "text": "王其克愼明德，以終令聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "034ce88c3db2f82ce6dd6f4731f5c13e404100f63127be8d9f2540acf617e26d"}

{"id": "p_e522af97e147e6ec", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 65, "text": "就國，尙約儉，教敕妃妾紡績織紝，習爲家人之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "5a59689dc559cc9350f54ff217fac45e53260b8816ad516022d5c824199bf7f7"}

{"id": "p_f132ecdbcc221526", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 66, "text": "詔曰：「王素敬愼，邂逅至此，其以議親之典議之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "c2d8c2efa60d90b2a894667f28e72a6be799786c81bdf559ee03a16860e9e443"}

{"id": "p_d3bba1d0a084f0e3", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 67, "text": "帝嘉其意，二年，-{復}-所削縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "7f73ec40549efa4f57f58a9824c13c4df5a47ac3db0b135f42e260c1c59ecc26"}

{"id": "p_9ee2c6f1885baba8", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 68, "text": "三年秋，衮得疾病，詔遣太醫視疾，殿中、虎賁賫手詔、賜珍膳相屬，又遣太妃、沛王林幷就省疾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "3b1ab21d1558e04d133fdeb76c078ee5da5d68aba4f4e63cd9dfb4330d6eb9df"}

{"id": "p_5817c756e6bacfd3", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 69, "text": "衮疾困，敕令官屬曰：「吾寡德忝寵，大命將盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "79e0b92f553fa502610b9cbc1be7ce81c5a8c3ee39eb3c8e3b69bb30f6e958bf"}

{"id": "p_988894579085047b", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 70, "text": "吾旣好儉，而聖朝著終誥之-{制}-，爲天下法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "09f6dbc9b05e8a01d6ffaf9eb5d8203f66b400d250dc26c404636f0e141e1d25"}

{"id": "p_4fd98711d3af997b", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 71, "text": "吾氣絶之日，自殯及葬，務奉詔書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "d3fc7adece82715c02fc7bf1392eb5ff1d332dcaf56a22e3745fd108072eebb2"}

{"id": "p_8fb6dd96bb01d4ab", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 72, "text": "昔衞大夫蘧瑗葬濮陽，吾望其墓，常想其遺風，原-{託}-賢靈以弊-{發}-齒，營吾兆域，必往從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "20433268688fa258e00c9eb2465842b07e78cb7bd3b381998bcec6d998be4f01"}

{"id": "p_1042e790411d52ea", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」堂成，名之曰遂-{志}-之堂，輿疾往居之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "84de6257097b4eb4678c71f415fd5ab0df5f88818c62cb73ed39a2892f53eef1"}

{"id": "p_801b8efec9fa5780", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 74, "text": "又令世子曰：「汝幼少，未聞義方，早爲人君，但知樂，不知苦；不知苦，必將以驕奢爲失也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "9e06f39a946fd78368f84491bbbba3492c31f30c8a32040b31befd392b733b9f"}

{"id": "p_1abfac0c1c412e6b", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 75, "text": "雖非大臣，老者猶宜答拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "720da174aaac9ced881cd31ded0804d7954921d28bbfa76e41d2c2b09f9a080f"}

{"id": "p_8ffeba09191b70d8", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 76, "text": "事兄以敬，恤弟以慈；兄弟有不良之行，當造膝諫之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "972e44710c81f25f69d90d78f6eed9bac10dcd7df0f58cf5b107c1ae470d03ce"}

{"id": "p_45f37366e441774e", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 77, "text": "諫之不從，流涕喩之；喩之不改，乃白其母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "566b9e4b4cc25e1b21e3ff518b327f6c4738f4c6796289f263d8cf8805e10600"}

{"id": "p_d0196beef9fc7066", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 78, "text": "若猶不改，當以奏聞，幷辭國土。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "5cd56c99e9414ffd2953dbcae30d0c47017d9a2c4b2d7d1ae5403c4ab2acad0b"}

{"id": "p_57126f7eb6940596", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 79, "text": "與其守寵罹禍，不若貧賤全身也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "5482ff525ce20e491145156d284dc4bbe65a0727d24c1761125b3c7f1a2407cd"}

{"id": "p_c8da7b5e930384f8", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 80, "text": "此亦謂大罪惡耳，其微過細故，當掩覆之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "2f2056d99eab19a85acbf794ee81665996f2a9bb9851ad3d0ce430d6e325c044"}

{"id": "p_d206df94276614ff", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 81, "text": "嗟爾小子，愼脩乃身，奉聖朝以忠貞，事太妃以孝敬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "6425d4512d70b3c4d4cc0d7fddd0bebbec8467b8285b3f9796697290257d7050"}

{"id": "p_53f79efcef2e4435", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 82, "text": "閨闈之内，奉令-{於}-太妃；閫閾之外，受教-{於}-沛王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "1cc150ee7a321326796826f955e9d97ac2c63221ca0e9e911409aab77208f011"}

{"id": "p_2a885d872d2ab197", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 83, "text": "詔沛王林留訖葬，使大鴻臚持節典護喪事，宗正弔祭，贈賵甚厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "f9e512b56677b5db00ebcd1af8785fc655e0e49e2a6067d268073af424e887c5"}

{"id": "p_865fa4064cdaee72", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 84, "text": "凡所著文章二萬-{餘}-言，-{才}-不及陳思王而好與之侔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "2c8b0bc0797537a4cbaf6d2badea7887e903af82f24e2631af6bc2995bf02263"}

{"id": "p_09666ba56fd0cd48", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 85, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前三千四百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "2a7b02ebfe703d3a649ca6a8053289ccbb48946d494ff952c29aa556af34cab0"}

{"id": "p_58822c4b89378fe8", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 86, "text": "二十年，以沛王林子贊襲玹爵邑，早薨，無子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "e40677cca578f0aeb7f96d6e5e9ba8e23f40960e7036f656b3c636944fe60874"}

{"id": "p_36d1899dc9e07608", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 87, "text": "文帝-{復}-以贊弟壹紹玹-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "dec516c4411090d53ad2493f5b8f33addf7053ee7f629306e14bbf19c2e8edc9"}

{"id": "p_602e257faca4c4e7", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 88, "text": "六年，又進號曰懷王，追諡贊曰西鄕哀侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "0095622151a70ad92aae309d77c28a6c1ceca74569a7a0da87820639fa42848b"}

{"id": "p_e2e72ab9fbe68c81", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 89, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前千九百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "f7ce75878bf89dd0f073caafb4260fc16b315be65e9d60907c65af132011a553"}

{"id": "p_605ab0870ddce4ff", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 90, "text": "陳留恭王峻字子安，封郿侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "59a79d924403353b29a5f6c1f0fc7a1425500092364134f6686d9cd4d5d2e162"}

{"id": "p_0b01450230db04f9", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 91, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前四千七百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "2870898e0ac0eca4edca0a0e1e1a6f8140d9908469444c6cacbbe533134541d0"}

{"id": "p_a82f8eaf2e4bfccc", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 92, "text": "==-{范}-陽閔王矩==", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "ba5db03281900f993ad5e468ea25dd2832b669c5a349b13596750873093688df"}

{"id": "p_5108783b7be82f64", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 93, "text": "-{范}-陽閔王矩，早薨，無子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "079abdea40cfc9f87f6c47400ab0f6714ad779841683ef6c50d8068d1945b111"}

{"id": "p_277056ae07ef3bc6", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 94, "text": "，以樊安公均子敏奉矩-{後}-，封臨晉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "74018feb5ad3b6dab8b2230683dd95c0626a2225500872c41140f28fca6386e4"}

{"id": "p_c5d3d410eacb4541", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 95, "text": "追封諡矩爲-{范}-陽閔公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "e7369dbb6302d623fd14feec58cfdbc2d6faac5bfd40595a25809ca51001bed7"}

{"id": "p_4e5e1b1d7e055e49", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 96, "text": "五年，改封敏-{范}-陽王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "9eac6e1061e01a7874971baa15cd066229afe338f8801c387d6ac0cb56a6f6e5"}

{"id": "p_49fc1bb5a87ac693", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 97, "text": "七年，徙封句陽，，追進矩號曰-{范}-陽閔王，改封敏琅邪王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "564628375dda937bd33bca268e5f803793f1b8895cf210fdbbb597cf4856e2f9"}

{"id": "p_186d4d4dc71580b9", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 98, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前三千四百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "2a7b02ebfe703d3a649ca6a8053289ccbb48946d494ff952c29aa556af34cab0"}

{"id": "p_0d1a7414ae3c79b5", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 99, "text": "趙王-{幹}-，封髙平亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "1a1662ec61adaf7f8ac2ca289721db8145a8acd5fc596c6bb1e8f3a413d65353"}

{"id": "p_ab797ed9bf69e312", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 100, "text": "-{幹}-母有寵-{於}-太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "0b12bbcccd37628fbd2c4ab46f9fde8d8403a3516353c239a475f0575f10c7f7"}

{"id": "p_b7604ea863d7d4de", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 101, "text": "及文帝爲嗣，-{幹}-母有力。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "a104b7e8532e69270616eb60e47d0011c67a4fb186333f5e1c9672dfe97803a2"}

{"id": "p_7e2a6799deb6675b", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 102, "text": "文帝臨崩，有遺詔，是以明帝常加恩意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "dc5b8b60c390f059fa47cbc8c8a5bd37b591c5ac3f53d90c3df6d9b3b99cb45a"}

{"id": "p_664e2e9057e70e7a", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 103, "text": "，私通賓客，爲有司所奏，賜-{幹}-璽書誡誨之，曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "ad44986763889494d75b731a6bdc25eecff779e2eabf1a68683f211c07e200d6"}

{"id": "p_fefca674bb13234a", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 104, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前五千戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "9013d7f1cfeb28ce2e3dbd9e98526d469a4c089a5b159a6539da285f1679324b"}

{"id": "p_730558b979dececb", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 105, "text": "初，彪來朝，犯禁，〔靑龍〕元年，爲有司所奏，詔削縣三，戸千五百。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "97d76451448231ea3feb2a98af91c7a79b30867f0c5d35b12eb4bef92d3a2497"}

{"id": "p_e6e55824bd582253", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 106, "text": "二年，大赦，-{復}-所削縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "233e23b20e881c5d365d0b06665aec04e85deb15f043ef2007a20e97a555997d"}

{"id": "p_9ce8b7ecdb3c9169", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 107, "text": "，增戸五百，幷前三千戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "7954ffeeecfe56ee57f1b17127362389dd33acfccecc1c3f2f5680068f1f641e"}

{"id": "p_798e27a8be589dee", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 108, "text": "，兗州刺史令狐愚與太尉王凌謀迎彪都許昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "c79dc92a78840787e7bcf41875bd51720db01ac947161215184aa188e5deaf3c"}

{"id": "p_df07fd63b53f07f2", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 109, "text": "乃遣傅及侍-{御}-史就國案驗，收治諸相連及者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "1a261a215e5eafc421d40d21ad66a812e201bb7501447424368d7a54eb0a4461"}

{"id": "p_e862a94f0b791932", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 110, "text": "廷尉請-{徴}-彪治罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "ff86f54c77a7ab50080b2d9bba329080e02b24864fa217f396c5e4df247be0e2"}

{"id": "p_8b0abac555c1378d", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 111, "text": "-{於}-是依漢燕王旦故事，使兼廷尉大鴻臚持節賜彪璽書切責之，使自圖焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "d8faa816544eaa20139b050bf8b60db8852bff774ba9f796161499297f52a19f"}

{"id": "p_631ceaf1a4eab74c", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 112, "text": "妃及諸子皆免爲庶人，徙平原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "cd3804fbfbd8731d2ea019933400eb7d36252d6414f075880f35e4cf9b3f9037"}

{"id": "p_77ba0432d0befe3a", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 113, "text": "彪之官屬以下及監國謁者，坐知情無輔導之義，皆伏誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "1bf9f40d34bc43bcb1cd4167d5a4da0cbba1e5d666431763367281b1888b4ec0"}

{"id": "p_b8632fdfe4df6b51", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 114, "text": "詔曰：「故楚王彪，背國附-{姦}-，身死嗣替，雖自取之，猶哀矜焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "5845bb7ec178848406550663ed0f45af5965ff89ae39bc307edd23db7e4040e1"}

{"id": "p_c01b644f73b31d2d", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 115, "text": "夫含垢藏疾，親親之道也，其封彪世子嘉爲常山眞定王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "30f1e840096e4fae16acc54cf1c501a794361e4f7d41191c4dba0425de181deb"}

{"id": "p_363535385eac2c4a", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 116, "text": "」，增邑，幷前二千五百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "0ecc84a886bf64df98ab33f4a37b80e81d264bc6fbb72955ffc3037ca364192c"}

{"id": "p_0c08cc9bf31f5454", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 117, "text": "==-{谷}-城殤公子乘==", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "c71dfcfc8ad315f3b5225290dccb007380193c39c08145230f7a730984b2b801"}

{"id": "p_5fcc99062a2a7fb0", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 118, "text": "-{谷}-城殤公子乘，早薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "cee532ba285cfe4b2b3afbb45f2153bd43d5ac5a2c4c5be24ab8663b9cc93134"}

{"id": "p_e1a06fe8dde994b1", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 119, "text": "郿戴公子整，奉從叔父郎中紹-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "e0ddd58398d94fb391034606d006e70229e18b15c920b9e8be5ffd35192ee703"}

{"id": "p_a8eb53116c2a413a", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 120, "text": "以彭城王-{據}-子-{范}-奉整-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "eb902220f75abd43889deaa8d558a661850b75698c7927e896ec8628a68403ee"}

{"id": "p_132aca55bb804b55", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 121, "text": "四年，詔以-{範}-弟東安鄕公闡爲郿公，奉整-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "5baab9ce5e12045b40f4fa086e95135e41acf5c7b121d4a483062c28d447339b"}

{"id": "p_288786e3aa6612ce", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 122, "text": "正元、景元中、累增邑，幷前千八百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "0d5897dfc03b608a570febf47c01934613da73d84e95ff4d3c447366b9e39735"}

{"id": "p_3bf250f99c5aa4b2", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 123, "text": "樊安公均，奉叔父薊恭公彬-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "6709a1cc90a1ce722c83ecdd676d29a14102a047e7c87b030c66a541594a96be"}

{"id": "p_462f9c25e3c734de", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 124, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前千九百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "f7ce75878bf89dd0f073caafb4260fc16b315be65e9d60907c65af132011a553"}

{"id": "p_725a8deeb08c0e14", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 125, "text": "東平靈王徽，奉叔公朗陵哀侯玉-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "d61a91698de85d31834c6c1f664f0c9f2169db896fe0965bc8bc6a19c564ec3a"}

{"id": "p_84738ad5f4c35b39", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 126, "text": "，徽使官屬撾壽張縣吏，爲有司所奏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "de8e061855dfbc37fec5923c9be6a588f72e735d7a03202f3585e6ff5e964078"}

{"id": "p_d90d5b7a100e03f3", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 127, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前三千四百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "2a7b02ebfe703d3a649ca6a8053289ccbb48946d494ff952c29aa556af34cab0"}

{"id": "p_d8b6942bbd93991e", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 128, "text": "茂性泬佷，少無寵-{於}-太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "8f1d058ff07ccf479631894776af50fa5c7408ab89490a0878b53dbecd038db3"}

{"id": "p_ef874cea11cae061", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 129, "text": "，徙封聊城公，其年爲王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "db028f6973f012a63a813afbb3122a5d24754f145ecec1636c11163fe41ac498"}

{"id": "p_fd864ab5c445ad6e", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 130, "text": "六年，改封-{曲}-陽王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "0cd9f1d5cdd0485157e2dc2cfc74d406079776498fe4025dc23fe40dde3fb5c5"}

{"id": "p_7b73cbf9144da62a", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 131, "text": "，東平靈王薨，茂稱嗌痛，不肯-{發}-哀，居處出入自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "66a7c3ee24abf1115066be92d11cebd0fe23c7386c3a04204d932770de7a6642"}

{"id": "p_ba9fec35feee0750", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 132, "text": "有司奏除國土，詔削縣一，戸五百。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "b9e887a1499ec27e402f1edbd7b510521cef01ce675ab36c369f466f038a4ae8"}
