{"id": "p_9f5aadde0f415f51", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 133, "text": "五年，徙封樂陵，詔以茂租奉少，諸子多，-{復}-所削戸，又增戸七百。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "c9ed95c5c33b7ac8cb50817c85325764a6c4b369cf96f5dc4086ff14ce19f85c"}

{"id": "p_11e20d810ae1a763", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 134, "text": "嘉平、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前五千戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "a5efc86668667fabda7d32e8bea7f32ff439c47312f3a66947b2a2462a384f7a"}

{"id": "p_f16169a0f6d63243", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 135, "text": "文皇帝九男：甄氏皇-{后}-生明帝，李貴人生贊哀王協，潘淑媛生北海悼王蕤，朱淑媛生東武陽懷王-{鑑}-，仇昭儀生東海定王霖，徐姬生元城哀王禮，蘇姬生邯鄲懷王邕，張姬生淸河悼王貢，宋姬生廣平哀王儼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "cf10afbaddc0f1793b5714b8948f269729e28b6a66df1516954a18dfe5efdcad"}

{"id": "p_b52dff93b4fb53ff", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 136, "text": "，增戸五百，幷前三千戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "7954ffeeecfe56ee57f1b17127362389dd33acfccecc1c3f2f5680068f1f641e"}

{"id": "p_5029d605b6d17393", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 137, "text": "北海悼王蕤，，明帝卽位，立爲陽平縣王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "fe0345e6d582f3bd3923e22d3a5ea4af06c4c238e830a5986f12707038979b1a"}

{"id": "p_67d695ed4086d7ad", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 138, "text": "二年，以琅邪王子贊奉蕤-{後}-，封昌鄕公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "c57ef9d6c7d7ec0e9c3c19642c830579712066f9f1fd390f3bf3ab9314b02723"}

{"id": "p_13b22cdfa0d87129", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 139, "text": "正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前三千五百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "b7506db43f8f5d0bdf494af52281e04aed74700a47e2b595876a8743a378bd76"}

{"id": "p_d4bbb3beeaa028ba", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 140, "text": "==東武陽懷王-{鑑}-==", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "cb08dd8a6b757d2808f7a0f651028075083947e7ed725b2887039dfcdebd7575"}

{"id": "p_e1e3fae7c14d24fe", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 141, "text": "東武陽懷王-{鑑}-，立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "8f9a5bfa5837266113160489ae3de24e117a5e2685dfb8d5b2d26aac5de466bd"}

{"id": "p_31f061deb638c2da", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 142, "text": "東海定王霖，立爲河東王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "f5eac9297fc75222d2b38f83d496f455bfa60d0a60cc30f4e9d4fbc5b517f594"}

{"id": "p_9350a2333475605a", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 143, "text": "明帝卽位，以先帝遺意，愛寵霖異-{於}-諸國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "29cbbd1f9267346811973103940a3a57170a766111b7af299f52e8dbcfa5957b"}

{"id": "p_b4b7a06aa9fd04d7", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 144, "text": "而霖性粗暴，閨門之内，婢妾之間，多所殘害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "9bf6dd2855d82fe9d2fc61516c672f6d5b3540688002f03d6359a54dc3c20cfc"}

{"id": "p_267cc3d2ff97ec06", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 145, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前六千二百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "e30634dd54bb483e43e0b348f8d21b311aa54afc9816a3508f2587778da81f04"}

{"id": "p_3e867f40c561e320", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 146, "text": "髙貴鄕公髦，霖之子也，入繼大宗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "8d55b2257cb1d4198413f7a74d45dd12d1aa2177e16fe3d4f3732d267adc5f2d"}

{"id": "p_3fcb4221427c3d89", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 147, "text": "元城哀王禮，封秦公，以京兆郡爲國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "38883c85484621d6710c9cb6a0996f9b2fd626a6917f389ed77a4935e2acd0f4"}

{"id": "p_1e5a3b708ebfd102", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 148, "text": "五年，以任城王楷子悌嗣禮-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "8ddf99daf3162197492f14194ebc97d7fda242a61657b8fc69fec2e634251578"}

{"id": "p_4bd5f34c54d063ab", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 149, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前四千五百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "21c3ec047c32aedc0f2aeebe9ef6a470eed639aa646f55d6ce048e917f7f2e99"}

{"id": "p_00b5cea74dc8bdc0", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 150, "text": "邯鄲懷王邕，封淮南公，以九江郡爲國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "ec06bc2048772621be85b55824852e53749d90a742efdcee4162671a8505927b"}

{"id": "p_fc5722f132eadefb", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 151, "text": "五年，以任城王楷子温嗣邕-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "99d6fad0df3cade2f09da90d41c64e0e3e12873936de5645aabdfdb920656c6c"}

{"id": "p_c3815df4cd8dc648", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 152, "text": "景初、正元、景元中，累增邑，幷前四千四百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "a3a8453d23ac7298a26ad29b9f3640ddd0a6b434c36134270b7d188a4960dd9b"}

{"id": "p_09136b1f1c8605a2", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 153, "text": "評曰：魏氏王公，旣徒有國土之名，而無社稷之實，又禁防壅隔，同-{於}-囹圄；位號靡定，大小歳易；骨肉之恩乖，常棣之義廢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "2ab67b1c033d013e6655e50a28c45cb10b90600d94699efc9d39064911eccadf"}

{"id": "p_399a051111cb40c1", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 154, "text": "爲法之弊，一至-{於}-此乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "88e6006d495e14cd078c2cbd2a502aaa90f3597346d03499f92d4bba6d02047a"}

{"id": "p_71a3843d4c97bca1", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 155, "text": "《魏氏春秋》載宗室曹冏上書曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "b43dc596554af5675ad76a801b2a52755e3d51ce16aaeec68ac1ff95b2fd4165"}

{"id": "p_a2e324102537ab57", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 156, "text": "冏，中常侍兄叔興之-{後}-，少帝族祖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "3787293ff6eb7858a505c07773a6e66159e6eb60c0b87dc9949248c7383171c2"}

{"id": "p_34856ae325d2cea5", "source_id": "src_4c658113fbb182e6", "ordinal": 157, "text": "是時天子幼稚，冏冀以此論感悟曹爽，爽不能納。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "6e0e3fd0eadb24dd129e6bae8fd7a01b47c9cf8192c61a234c48069a2bac39b6"}

{"id": "p_d3683bda0d4f79d9", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_f0ca34dec5165375", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 1, "text": "王粲字仲宣，山陽高平人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "11635299f04ecab9329d22aedffb4ce16963aa3e4f3b2add353087c88da4ca6f"}

{"id": "p_4a38a256197cc140", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 2, "text": "曾祖父龔，祖父暢，皆爲漢三公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "c43ce09d73a36be9034fde59bf6b786c57bbeb845946dc7ff55bbe8aa9a8755c"}

{"id": "p_5c903926d516f59e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 3, "text": "父謙，爲大將軍何進長史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "19c608de4742cc3db8ab7dd56a977065ca7393efb7a38abec870b5eb15588a07"}

{"id": "p_b5a90ed7bc47bdd5", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 4, "text": "進以謙名公之冑，欲與爲婚，見其二子，使擇焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "211310c622dcab9a84b4298411d9fd44ee707caede0d2a332bb2acb76cf597bd"}

{"id": "p_a122e4fd0dfc0301", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 5, "text": "獻帝西遷，粲徙長安，左中郎將蔡邕見而奇之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "6173106bc232cddf587a757aaa3cf9861e2d4a176d325888282a64ff5b20b55a"}

{"id": "p_ee25f720e10b99a9", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 6, "text": "時邕才學顯著，貴重朝廷，常車騎填巷，賔客盈坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "f9d6f2437a99863091e84ee33025271faed2f95e69a7ee71857d106446858af9"}

{"id": "p_5e6096de85d264c2", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 7, "text": "粲至，年旣幼弱，容狀短小，一坐盡驚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "946788a56ee56fdb55fdd38e9a9a325cba703e6b8d860a00fe17d8f80a69d6f1"}

{"id": "p_2351345c9d4362bf", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 8, "text": "邕曰：「此王公孫也，有異才，吾不如也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "684fc74f85490504523c4f93a9d42575ebebdac1f3ccfdeeccd6eeffb537fb47"}

{"id": "p_ba1d53a366f54b71", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 9, "text": "吾家書籍文章，盡當與之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "bd8a43d1699da0e6c69e124ee0de3fde30e2e2613d0cc3a54ca16fa78ca07a8e"}

{"id": "p_73cbf57e26023f69", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」年十七，司徒辟，詔除黃門侍郎，以西京擾亂，皆不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "fc7300c7a43ec40a99247b999dec245893cfb3b919f008e142279382815519d6"}

{"id": "p_0ba8ce52479a321e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 11, "text": "表以粲貌寢而體弱通侻，不甚重也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "a1c86ca90a4778fe2e463ba93905b78b68c2092eef228faeae846910c7f5d4e8"}

{"id": "p_56039483627334cf", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 12, "text": "太祖辟爲丞相掾，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "11f677aa5bc8fe4d3d4208233a425dc0119440650a8675a0d3871da42534d72b"}

{"id": "p_360a2b2735b0c6b5", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 13, "text": "太祖置酒漢濵，粲奉觴賀曰：「方今袁紹起河北，杖大衆，志兼天下，然好賢而不能用，故奇士去之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "8b45631c532fb0b767b6dc95a0c13c249e6c60f0c003f1fd757ced0c9c9f0718"}

{"id": "p_755ede62d553be67", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 14, "text": "劉表雍容荊楚，坐觀時變，自以爲西伯可規。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "972e6776d02c44e89102ece9e351999b018e4c6d440346a9d047129bf530ff82"}

{"id": "p_b99e101feb4d7b56", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 15, "text": "士之避亂荊州者，皆海內之儁傑也；表不知所任，故國危而無輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "9efa9f817a1e1c3e3c57e83c4aa18ef256ca10a40b8bb5b78a3d69c3ae9c720c"}

{"id": "p_fde3a709d28d1584", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 16, "text": "明公定兾州之日，下車即繕其甲卒，收其豪傑而用之，以橫行天下；及平江、漢，引其賢儁而置之列位，使海內回心，望風而願治，文武並用，英雄畢力，此三王之舉也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "7cd9c4b25aecf399a2c83bfa8c1709c4539dd1061f5ca5152bcb0b81070e0382"}

{"id": "p_aba5c30cc2b23c62", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 17, "text": "時舊儀廢弛，興造制度，粲恒典之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "bba684f3477d858ffa3ad52c452601a3a9f5a2759784748e0b5164cc8f938239"}

{"id": "p_f8a4c3fb482de3aa", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 18, "text": "初，粲與人共行，讀道邊碑，人問曰：「卿能闇誦乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "895373b1e738f3f063533e374becd3de5c7aa19d6bd03932ceb83643d499c81c"}

{"id": "p_72fa6366fea773fa", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」因使背而誦之，不失一字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "104ea77a3bca0dba0869fae5ad342962b6e117f90f67a4f712ca7584c511a3fd"}

{"id": "p_af87af384df90461", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 20, "text": "觀人圍棊，局壞，粲爲覆之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "a930f8bdde9b59fac7429b952ded704de8063b987a14bb576d5630e9cff405b9"}

{"id": "p_0faa783c2c6e686d", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 21, "text": "棊者不信，以帊蓋局，使更以他局爲之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "ecf5a0dfb1c7df8213f0eca704cef42db94f7e914a536a5ead72ac6711eebef5"}

{"id": "p_4d04b18282484441", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 22, "text": "性善筭，作筭術，略盡其理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "86af3454aa04a01a301fbb4e1b6fc17320c07d75c23b416db61e4303f797ae8d"}

{"id": "p_266a3556c4add20f", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 23, "text": "善屬文，舉筆便成，無所改定，時人常以爲宿構；然正復精意覃思，亦不能加也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "f3c0ef1957389db4d4200a8f7359054cb7ea51f86fe4c55603777c494afab85d"}

{"id": "p_5dde990b5f4c6fe3", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 24, "text": "著詩、賦、論、議垂六十篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "10ec172985582b8df3b2c994070a6b29a97208d7be7d242743283a3ee30e4de2"}

{"id": "p_5351ddda48b72d6c", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 25, "text": "二十二年春，道病卒，時年四十一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "e29c82e9816462f04a2390d9743947c25d4fd592b814ed9f3fae704d153df049"}

{"id": "p_e757e14fce91a4f8", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 26, "text": "粲二子，爲魏諷所引，誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "64506e244346636969047eb8891073e16a465d2c77b94a0b6e1082b8c6e8ab1c"}

{"id": "p_eb5b787502ee7537", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 27, "text": "始文帝爲五官將，及平原侯植皆好文學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "fe977c1a7c052f23a928168d694bc042ff90c8d83fecc6382e3b53e7904539d5"}

{"id": "p_02c9520e3303779c", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 28, "text": "粲與北海徐-{幹}-字偉長、廣陵陳琳字孔璋、陳留阮瑀字元瑜、汝南應瑒字德璉、東平劉楨字公-{幹}-並見友善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "b877a185826899ee259fb4202d55523ed5109a3889d789f6c6d660be0e6f3ca4"}

{"id": "p_4df06a7d85ac42f0", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 29, "text": "===附 徐-{幹}-===", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "3d67ec187f708863d760cc3ab7dc64d306ce89d0a1263e21b47c8c1b75549fe3"}

{"id": "p_f284f3223fdb09ef", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 30, "text": "-{幹}-爲司空軍謀祭酒掾屬，五官將文學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "b4facf1da93bb63347dfa83d3a94ccfbeebd17cccd92e324402f078f0b712b7d"}

{"id": "p_e3e7840f3fc3ced3", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 31, "text": "進欲誅諸宦官，太后不聽，進乃召四方猛將，並使引兵向京城，欲以劫恐太后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "f9770afd463b80d1afb59149237b0ea4bffce2b6d721865c1cdef272c494548a"}

{"id": "p_bb17a8b92b47d7c4", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 32, "text": "琳諫進曰：「易稱『即鹿無虞』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "1009fd04de3c12a0bb4f316038acd21bbeeddccdf0eb54482951113525daf39b"}

{"id": "p_384e67d0b785fe33", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 33, "text": "夫微物尚不可欺以得志，況國之大事，其可以詐立乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "643285b6f21030041134b28d6c84d990b8411d011700584d97e38d91b68b0b42"}

{"id": "p_54de895b26f30cd5", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 34, "text": "今將軍總皇威，握兵要，龍驤虎步，高下在心；以此行事，無異於鼓洪爐以燎毛髮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "8be955b669ccca6b3f4df2524d736186152daca2c73e5638b05147e09506a474"}

{"id": "p_90027f1a11a9fab1", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 35, "text": "但當速發雷霆，行權立斷，違經合道，天人順之；而反釋其利器，更徵於他。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "4474b98222b3f383d9ea5fbc7561048e43bfd68bc300031d822cc92fa5750226"}

{"id": "p_3d8546a48866738c", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 36, "text": "大兵合聚，彊者爲雄，所謂倒持干戈，授人以柄；必不成功，祇爲亂階。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "fa690b622b0cbba33306f37ea51bbec829c405ccb8168e94f6918e61570273e6"}

{"id": "p_76bcc1372ea41f27", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」進不納其言，竟以取禍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "a3bc802f6e584606fb5220c51cbdf18c38ba0985b73ec003ce6bc817d6b896aa"}

{"id": "p_86ff51f8854e5ede", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 38, "text": "琳避難兾州，袁紹使典文章。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "25bd8571b859ec34820ea8b051bf8f58f689c507a2ca8327ec0fd7e3c73a06e4"}

{"id": "p_bed582aa23e978c1", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 39, "text": "太祖謂曰：「卿昔爲本初移書，但可罪狀孤而已，惡惡止其身，何乃上及父祖邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "901c1a6cee8c549f2f48c6e78f421fbfda9ffc55db5076c606d0727671362b79"}

{"id": "p_216ff0bf27a8fab0", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」琳謝罪，太祖愛其才而不咎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "607121de5ce3f1a63e24c55376c8a66f92c8da87be6743998b0750ff5bc685f4"}

{"id": "p_4cd384a3e10af684", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 41, "text": "建安中都護曹洪欲使掌書記，瑀終不爲屈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "1fe4e73732ce658bbd35e710deeae81473dec1182f4a3568e60c5bbac3c86fcd"}

{"id": "p_7a4f834d399c21e5", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 42, "text": "太祖並以琳、瑀爲司空軍謀祭酒，管記室，軍國書檄，多琳、瑀所作也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "2509df02da7eeef36fc4c82640afbf8fd24b852e5b67cfe9aa5cf32bd7ba54c8"}

{"id": "p_27341b28192c7071", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 43, "text": "琳徙門下督，瑀爲倉曹掾屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "c1c65bc83232d4255bae3fe69397a64b2e99e3c40640e13c6ccfc539b8b7bc92"}

{"id": "p_5a51dba492755357", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 44, "text": "===附 應瑒、劉楨===", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "ece379682cc346f82107a52b270ff2460b235dfb6242c8864e1e051e01a42d4a"}

{"id": "p_a7627b8d92b1890d", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 45, "text": "瑒、楨各被太祖辟，爲丞相掾屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "5854b3f36d5e381943677a42d76497e4d3fd60d9847b55b4799e034ceb597c2e"}

{"id": "p_2911f390c815652b", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 46, "text": "瑒轉爲平原侯庶子，後爲五官將文學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "4409d40ff6ee7d6be66fc1eb1d064c51982bfaab4d188241413bf3c52dbc53f5"}

{"id": "p_bcb175e6cb2a398d", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 47, "text": "楨以不敬被刑，刑竟署吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "d387e2dbc09a00fb3abf560bc4a4a908254a20bdaba2b3470fbc415c3200e554"}

{"id": "p_1edc1e5bd51dd2f6", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 48, "text": "-{幹}-、琳、瑒、楨二十二年卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "01498d8a7be7d7c07bbaf9a5c403ce8259be7efc392f1aacfe67ce3be5bfbf71"}

{"id": "p_539a932d98ae704e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 49, "text": "文帝書與元城令呉質曰：「昔年疾疫，親故多離其災，徐、陳、應、劉，一時俱逝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "927b97be58109ae8f73d919f1eac77b75768e915cb5e9ff9e98971a518e4db43"}

{"id": "p_43d7ad98bc0551e4", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 50, "text": "觀古今文人，類不護細行，鮮能以名節自立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "8a7545085f7faf6533d577ac74e184f0bce688a6e266cb813689cdcecb91bb17"}

{"id": "p_33244fb832572b06", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 51, "text": "而偉長獨懷文抱質，恬淡寡欲，有箕山之志，可謂彬彬君子矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "77130cc618f8bb18c0a2e308f037e79280c29a3fa0ead4a3ad4455d037b72c06"}

{"id": "p_97db96f9d23efbb8", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 52, "text": "著中論二十餘篇，辭義典雅，足傳于後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "4cd6c6d149a2b6148cf22ac12f339d3105ba21674b9018164643a32030486fda"}

{"id": "p_83028c2a74b598b0", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 53, "text": "德璉常斐然有述作意，其才學足以著書，美志不遂，良可痛惜！", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "3cbebd6fcb2d41257ef58a53a5ff09cdd961a3c5077be818ad4ecf84bb054c55"}

{"id": "p_26e0da27db74144b", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 54, "text": "孔璋章表殊健，微爲繁富。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "1ca78f7cbc6bd66b07003999f7e28fdb723d520d731fdf2aebad91aaf40da561"}

{"id": "p_e82b4baa790dd6f5", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 55, "text": "公-{幹}-有逸氣，但未遒耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "cddbfad01d8e206f8c9e5339863850b7f0778e351ed16362bf7a6011364e58df"}

{"id": "p_7b3411b3b7dd8a4d", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 56, "text": "元瑜書記翩翩，致足樂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "df7aa2a383179406d7baa0b1624ad95e317b70e15c178bc6c3b3764c474c69ed"}

{"id": "p_ce5e9ee8b07b9339", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 57, "text": "仲宣獨自善於辭賦，惜其體弱，不起其文；至於所善，古人無以遠過也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "cb36e9af0bf6baa237d23bc94b2270debb940f3be5e321b5c9583e604ae8d1ac"}

{"id": "p_9a661b542773a9f2", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 58, "text": "昔伯牙絶絃於鍾期，仲尼覆醢于子路，痛知音之難遇，傷門人之莫逮也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "3020e304c498e88dbab93969b8cef1f7935316cb14b3d0f0f7c078591b63bb9f"}

{"id": "p_955a110b0fef163e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 59, "text": "諸子但爲未及古人，自一時之儁也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "71e667b265e83b8c7ba272942977119d0f4956064bd52b8e97437e28dbaa65e2"}

{"id": "p_819a1791a74aab73", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 60, "text": "===附 邯鄲淳、繁欽、路粹、丁儀、丁廙、楊脩、荀緯===", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "aa24e737cdc3b61ca35e3d3b4d1f06613856a02fed0fd60234b7ef81a7ffa522"}

{"id": "p_101e5dc57c5f8515", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 61, "text": "自潁川邯鄲淳、繁欽、陳留路粹、沛國丁儀、丁廙、弘農楊脩、河內苟緯等，亦有文采，而不在此七人之例。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "543fc0a90bf67f44b7956875e0eed79843f4593f3d2548512c23d11a52edcf30"}

{"id": "p_818673182b9df47f", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 62, "text": "瑒弟璩，璩子貞，咸以文章顯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "248c05c2c2e1328f3bd983f63fa9a70a208c0567d63d44b68c12eb4eb9719c38"}

{"id": "p_f6429b88366b75a5", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 63, "text": "瑀子籍，才藻艷逸，而倜儻放蕩，行己寡欲，以莊周爲模則。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "d1f0d3baf35027f2757c70923480283fce7621d125eb5b6f8341440608177455"}

{"id": "p_17b5f0e588d5f59d", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 64, "text": "時又有譙郡嵇康，文辭壯麗，好言老、莊，而尚奇任俠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "34f0132819cdaa125d9848a8046e43f2c1b17e01ae023a42bcd781c1fece5867"}

{"id": "p_9c443568aaf3206e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 65, "text": "景初中，下邳桓威出自孤微，年十八而著渾輿經，依道以見意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "159d7e0622a0635fac1b14aea4a5aa6fc96847074aeb8233f69044773dbfd4ea"}

{"id": "p_321f7209625c71cb", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 66, "text": "從齊國門下書佐、司徒署吏，後爲安成令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "e7d4db57953e57e28e0c2c2ce336a6862b75a9365b51d847ab3b1aa325dc162d"}

{"id": "p_40087233f63d552c", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 67, "text": "呉質，濟陰人，以文才爲文帝所善，官至振威將軍，假節都督河北諸軍事，封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "47118f5ed486798136f94a5d260dc4776748c4e5025c7d3f1b94fd299d253d32"}

{"id": "p_76bd2b50c2a49b92", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 68, "text": "衞覬字伯儒，河東安邑人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "470ee43620b7ec79ace004f32b6d55c3cbb2e0e2e51236ea0e1f21efcf1a5757"}

{"id": "p_bb34903146dcca3c", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 69, "text": "太祖辟爲司空掾屬，除茂陵令、尚書郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "cb4f231265420743efbd971fda79560645673c2432296e2f02600517ddd9dfa9"}

{"id": "p_b9f8f2ee93dfd8c7", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 70, "text": "太祖征袁紹，而劉表爲紹援，關中諸將又中立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "376515164c2ef2f616c3c3c238709cf574a5a59062acfa450ce611683fffe855"}

{"id": "p_81bb1e631eb04f02", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 71, "text": "益州牧劉璋與表有隙，覬以治書侍御史使益州，令璋下兵以綴表軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "79380711d3ca481d69b63f2cf93455eca01db744987b5dc59dc27f4038cbb5b6"}

{"id": "p_a4aee37f0be75100", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 72, "text": "至長安，道路不通，覬不得進，遂留鎮關中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "7460525107131e350dc46623aa62ecca78f2f8da31b2b4db75511f88f690275b"}

{"id": "p_a5c361f15ebeb8af", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 73, "text": "時四方大有還民，關中諸將多引爲部曲，覬書與荀彧曰：「關中膏腴之地，頃遭荒亂，人民流入荊州者十萬餘家，聞本土安寧，皆企望思歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "28035f7b4c2c975b945fa5a71bb72edf270fe223246f92fb607066824cbc574e"}

{"id": "p_0964fe735c39c4da", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 74, "text": "而歸者無以自業，諸將各競招懷，以爲部曲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "dee64bf844c84475b21eeeed714b555b09866446ad37a39f761ff6ea40e94726"}

{"id": "p_700433c1ec7002a5", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 75, "text": "郡縣貧弱，不能與爭，兵家遂彊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "96793a76029ce599f209aa198ddd1f6b03f2968e60680bb1d3cccb81998d08d5"}

{"id": "p_3948536dcbdea639", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 76, "text": "夫鹽，國之大寶也，自亂來散放，宜如舊置使者監賣，以其直益巿犂牛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "54d909526cebc32f6d41ce1ea544a15a9c12e23c3d872fa035ccfdfbf213a692"}

{"id": "p_3b37e377b06864ba", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 77, "text": "又使司隷校尉留治關中以爲之主，則諸將日削，官民日盛，此彊本弱敵之利也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "c8de85ffb030dd93e025bc5b3d2babc867d7b1bbbfd62c432ea45f45ebf3666c"}

{"id": "p_f52e1cc031e047d9", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 78, "text": "太祖從之，始遣謁者僕射監鹽官，司隷校尉治弘農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "88c2a513c6cf50507adc4ee3e71ef76964547fc2bd78bdb7edcd9314955baa97"}

{"id": "p_3ec1ce995abb9b1f", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 79, "text": "關中服從，乃白召覬還，稍遷尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "95e1813564950df15c4dbb3abf5024222b95f9ab5f72e5c4feceef629467b711"}

{"id": "p_024ead94c870d989", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 80, "text": "魏國旣建，拜侍中，與王粲並典制度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "bd176d53d41260c0bac045597b69db0e70cabfc5b89dbcfb74b4bc829314dd36"}

{"id": "p_87caa247fbf945aa", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 81, "text": "頃之，還漢朝爲侍郎，勸贊禪代之義，爲文誥之詔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "71e2a0ad44f72aa63813786e12c476eaf322106bc9f6e3c1c0903df5916e7f36"}

{"id": "p_882615b981fe0735", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 82, "text": "文帝踐阼，復爲尚書，封陽吉亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "06411ef9fc1a096f0502f70c8b8aec3edb48f5c3327374429f412c3a9942d997"}

{"id": "p_58d0dbff8b47b0ad", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 83, "text": "明帝即位，進封閺鄕侯，三百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "9a460e7ae02a489d1cf3e1a69b4d1cc8ee4aa66bfaa1a1be8d255a7f458210ed"}

{"id": "p_ae7f37227672d1b2", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 84, "text": "覬奏曰：「九章之律，自古所傳，斷定刑罪，其意微妙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "6afc83afdecccecc1bbd5c0f10b41e4b1c7b0ae9b77e0025cc3f3b925baac29d"}

{"id": "p_f1bfd3c8667db3c4", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 85, "text": "刑法者，國家之所貴重，而私議之所輕賤；獄吏者，百姓之所縣命，而選用者之所卑下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "499e851bae4ed84bbfb9303d9929d014fff2e46d00f5aee5cc01c91c83e065db"}

{"id": "p_bb507be4ae777208", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 86, "text": "王政之弊，未必不由此也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "9d08761ec192b997dfbc6e4df1df18452775ebbbb0ce4274a8fbe392b19badc6"}

{"id": "p_52ec1dbcb0cdb51a", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 88, "text": "覬歷漢、魏，時獻忠言，率如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "5b48579c57ab2bb29966c77ed9479741df2ddc26ed17c9f21e8f83eeb315cdc9"}

{"id": "p_231de6dba121d22e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 89, "text": "受詔典著作，又爲魏官儀，凡所撰述數十篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "720347ca34409615b0484d734dd89f9bb9f682d77d5e8c738e971c054ea515d9"}

{"id": "p_4b95b5b4b6b78241", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 90, "text": "好古文、鳥篆、隷草，無所不善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "6b0dee3818af7c6a9518d2d2a0aebbcfbaf8fb5d6bd903748ca6d2aa717b4843"}

{"id": "p_d9d40b7d22f5f4f0", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 91, "text": "建安末，尚書右丞河南潘勗，黃初時，散騎常侍河內王象，亦與覬並以文章顯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "ab1830c578d74e75873e73fe81c8448dfb2833fcc4f185f450c1fe7f89ba1342"}

{"id": "p_5315859a4fce7fff", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 92, "text": "劉廙字恭嗣，南陽安衆人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "4149d05377c5e6603ddf542c7bcc6de45c42adb780adc69c83295ae54e460312"}

{"id": "p_daa2ac7cc21e6b96", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 93, "text": "年十歳，戲於講堂上，潁川司馬德操拊其頭曰：「孺子，孺子，『黃中通理』，寧自不知不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "de79af06da70d88f9eb9f22c3675fe9f1fef52e1e42080507385543c53dd6a02"}

{"id": "p_1a97436bf07095c2", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」廙兄望之，有名於世，荊州牧劉表辟爲從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "d1743cd5d622bb0fea0fadf22e095e39c4e474fdb1a047d59c187e77ea703659"}

{"id": "p_68e85e7eca75fda6", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 95, "text": "而其友二人，皆以讒毀，爲表所誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "5d521ed276b280aa39ef35aba639e9d60e2a2a95b2b56456327bc1d4cf664cfe"}

{"id": "p_427ef629e9a876b2", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 96, "text": "望之又以正諫不合，投傳告歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "d40fd9855f1144d1aafcee67e3d2eb99064c48d7ec1fe8481732ef47a2aee04b"}

{"id": "p_9e0e1877b276213b", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 97, "text": "廙謂望之曰：「趙殺鳴、犢，仲尼回輪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "b3baf80a78de34bb3c8831f2a8690aa6ac4563fb6dd78739b1761ee7e5f15bd1"}

{"id": "p_de6b520b3e5248c7", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 98, "text": "今兄旣不能法栁下惠和光同塵於內，則宜模范蠡遷化於外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "1eaf9ccc6ee4f0a122b9f5775d31da31bd93a7753daca8e70ee0431fba4bd81e"}

{"id": "p_73dd91be38070f8e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 99, "text": "坐而自絶於時，殆不可也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "70f792c721d327e3639b69d814801582ec73560da0c2ddc298df7082db8ed992"}

{"id": "p_35e18a3abd1ea29b", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 100, "text": "廙懼，奔揚州，遂歸太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "0e75b7b92c1858c667d1e8cd4d252f49312d9f251bcc3c5b07ee3b5860ee2a79"}

{"id": "p_815a01765d07e660", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 101, "text": "太祖辟爲丞相掾屬，轉五官將文學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "7ee815e59e56bea968adbdffcdce8578bef59dc17d5540e5aecb770938ac7488"}

{"id": "p_18808bf6a16ceacc", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 102, "text": "廙荅書曰：「初以尊卑有踰，禮之常分也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "e3da2438b4884ff826092907381b014633aa384a4d485e4c5f906960e8c7fec4"}

{"id": "p_8108201d3d081961", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 103, "text": "是以貪守區區之節，不敢脩草。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "e3102f02d2025c44ae715b2106d8f6baf70d039a8cb5f20aa48f59a19040d0ac"}

{"id": "p_8690964d7daa757e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 104, "text": "必如嚴命，誠知勞謙之素，不貴殊異若彼之高，而惇白屋如斯之好，苟使郭隗不輕於燕，九九不忽於齊，樂毅自至，霸業以隆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "d8e8a7c6d50631b68a2b34fe6d722cc391612eff257a4df5885f676f8640bc7e"}

{"id": "p_0c8d773c825ad000", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 105, "text": "虧匹夫之節，成巍巍之美，雖愚不敏，何敢以辭？", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "d1a7204cd6e23205b52c54b3fc82bf2e4b480d3185b52eb8aaa36a6d452bccad"}

{"id": "p_4cc645490cff89f3", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」魏國初建，爲黃門侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "2090d95c199325c89232877b93bbd3ad1fa82585222d279ebb657373468c8530"}

{"id": "p_21d45c7800ca5c4c", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 107, "text": "太祖在長安，欲親征蜀，廙上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "e20c7c142e3c0c4d354e2ec66c49b3fa56abe87b9480bc13d5a586e7f80c3692"}

{"id": "p_3d33755da5819afc", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 108, "text": "太祖遂進前而報廙曰：「非但君當知臣，臣亦當知君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "206a4417b0fa66b2f60d8ab9c3e15801ddfc50eb67e2f0212b3a818dbf08ad40"}

{"id": "p_791680affa7aa5fc", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 109, "text": "今欲使吾坐行西伯之德，恐非其人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "6dc1ecf5df55a8e72a0073f36556f6635bef9b67bc8862490c38841ed636ca92"}

{"id": "p_a283f9966da9fc0b", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 110, "text": "魏諷反，廙弟偉爲諷所引，當相坐誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "20286edd91effa78bc3ad38d11e660b57d38af4c4229e60c2b31cd21b1787291"}

{"id": "p_018f67f7c95e633b", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 111, "text": "太祖令曰：「叔向不坐弟虎，古之制也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "cf3a080c5175eae8529d388eb06f1f7190b387e269b091787ada7b13785bb563"}

{"id": "p_1f549df10ca79c93", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 112, "text": "」特原不問，徙署丞相倉曹屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "2e9bed61cb6e49b63adbbdc66cb3500048269a93d317a816721fcabb704aa1fd"}

{"id": "p_2072573b104d32cb", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 113, "text": "廙上疏謝曰：「臣罪應傾宗，禍應覆族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "bbc8f5058ea972d873c4011a767e3a111b2bba67dd48cfe0de32922544598e1c"}

{"id": "p_483b443f6d8868d1", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 114, "text": "遭乾坤之靈，值時來之運，揚湯止沸，使不燋爛；起煙於寒灰之上，生華於已枯之木。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "4c8205a2ca99cf46b9fc5d75d4de21015fd8f4e58ceac2614e3a9730cd5cea19"}

{"id": "p_b71f2c7ec92d7985", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 115, "text": "物不荅施於天地，子不謝生於父母，可以死效，難用筆陳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "b67f9d949e9a9bfc79df59a7976a9763badae6be58dded91e47a9058524086a8"}

{"id": "p_269b90f738553d3a", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 116, "text": "」廙著書數十篇，及與丁儀共論刑禮，皆傳於世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "5e4a66dbb4e31b474f28373c992be96491ee813f690ae2da1b7a1954717f9af1"}

{"id": "p_57d22f68712059eb", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 117, "text": "文帝即王位，爲侍中，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "d4e9e630ea89b23dabf0ec94847cd3b0d864c6020bc24e4e8fb7dfd9e610b880"}

{"id": "p_de4cb794d0288e60", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 118, "text": "劉劭字孔才，廣平邯鄲人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "26368479cecd8118388cb1100a0f02d844c3404755c0c2335acef0764f10ae5d"}

{"id": "p_eed2e06d19bdf538", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 119, "text": "太史上言：「正旦當日蝕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "1002e02b169ac8f46266880fecb250b99dead3d8ecb1b7a5747b42232865f4aa"}

{"id": "p_a8385e14723d1249", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 120, "text": "」劭時在尚書令荀彧所，坐者數十人，或云當廢朝，或云宜却會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "99d08bd01eb70297b7e10e248d5d2131fd06975793e09bc0dbb66846e1468d88"}

{"id": "p_a22950240419844e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 121, "text": "劭曰：「梓慎、裨竈，古之良史，猶占水火，錯失天時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "c3ac5fcfd8b3b8d80ee51f8357e76ceb299db41c5c12a5682cb2ecc58649ec16"}

{"id": "p_d95cf91ee9df9ae7", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 122, "text": "禮記曰諸侯旅見天子，及門不得終禮者四，日蝕在一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "9ba6242fbac8d18c1e41aecca4846cc8f18034213ea60000643ab1e5b03e2b98"}

{"id": "p_2ae6de3ce5012532", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 123, "text": "然則聖人垂制，不爲變異豫廢朝禮者，或災消異伏，或推術謬誤也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "e9b16340617dd217b24cbd7dc58c2feca88e99e2e4fda48bb0ec3293991195d6"}

{"id": "p_d76f598d2dd83b1a", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 124, "text": "御史大夫郗慮辟劭，會慮免，拜太子舍人，遷祕書郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "4b832fb7d9f89c7f97a566573338cd271adda60f1717816398a8a840349269c2"}

{"id": "p_85b21877d9d7347e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 125, "text": "黃初中，爲尚書郎、散騎侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "1d37dcd8cb8fbf9ccda025d13a081f168704b0e52c3f30cc4e7a9955e7d7375c"}

{"id": "p_e2fbbe8595dda48c", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 126, "text": "受詔集五經羣書，以類相從，作《皇覽》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "ee534f44942b872ab30b11aef79af6807f56d0fc9cfe7d3a73f4066c5200e0f7"}

{"id": "p_e11337ecaf3ecc13", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 127, "text": "明帝即位，出爲陳留太守，敦崇教化，百姓稱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "0d52aaf2ed5fd3e4c364976facbe3f08198747eaf5955e017736ffff9a95852a"}

{"id": "p_aaefe9e32b24c040", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 128, "text": "徵拜騎都尉，與議郎庾嶷、荀詵等定科令，作《新律》十八篇，著律略論。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "845efed3dfae5480d898147a2c513a8111ed9d80f7b6c14497d4851cab597f58"}

{"id": "p_24816552a59bb9af", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 129, "text": "時聞公孫淵受孫權燕王之號，議者欲留淵計吏，遣兵討之，劭以爲「昔袁尚兄弟歸淵父康，康斬送其首，是淵先世之効忠也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "872ff630684b51262e51a6b3c77757ccd724845117f384e618791aba1a33dec2"}

{"id": "p_2b016b874b98f033", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 130, "text": "古者要荒未服，脩德而不征，重勞民也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "4071fe9467f6bb391266a5b8fd5fd0671e6ddadb83f4131dddb5387da011fe65"}

{"id": "p_ed5bf09c00b9c8dc", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 131, "text": "」後淵果斬送權使張彌等首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "ae0bf7d85d1d6905e335d70bd6bb9da5b5512d0cb3012be3b93924f8130a7c1e"}

{"id": "p_a1224d9b5bef392f", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 132, "text": "劭嘗作趙都賦，明帝美之，詔劭作許都、洛都賦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "eea1b3712f37163dbc55787342fb7c8e8c6d5912501b3291b13ec9463cb83840"}

{"id": "p_4f5b102646b03d2e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 133, "text": "時外興軍旅，內營宮室，劭作二賦，皆諷諫焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "44a1d44cb22ea0652cc1749d29886308264ff5d5c8329e64a4d51d0bca315b13"}

{"id": "p_16de6828f791c097", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 134, "text": "青龍中，呉圍合肥，時東方吏士皆分休，征東將軍滿寵表請中軍兵，并召休將士，須集擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "501e094a4d582a199f8980953a9fba8df4d9f7666ab21d7be43fa0d513a703a3"}

{"id": "p_bb623bd18ff86795", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 135, "text": "劭議以爲「賊衆新至，心專氣銳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "24bc6e645876892d723e3baa359cb1e8c4967ddf1cc4f049ea1daf9ce550b4ce"}

{"id": "p_159eebc2bd343049", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 136, "text": "寵以少人自戰其地，若便進擊，不必能制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "be67b996240b64a186b6305b02d6074783b17be6d3362b974d224617ee24782e"}

{"id": "p_71928158ae48d065", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 137, "text": "以爲可先遣步兵五千，精騎三千，軍前發，揚聲進道，震曜形勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "1fb2f2bb281288b4c7c4c833ec42dcd14c8d9cef12944099f17fc1b33654956d"}

{"id": "p_d36a7aed878b8eee", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 138, "text": "騎到合肥，疏其行隊，多其旌鼔，曜兵城下，引出賊後，擬其歸路，要其糧道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "4b37e9e5dc083b62bdd5a2e7c86bc8e346cc82a08d8e770a046d34fe9b775642"}

{"id": "p_d745d52b60ee8dab", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 139, "text": "賊聞大軍來，騎斷其後，必震怖遁走，不戰自破賊矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "cbef777881e38e17a07a2865d6bafe13393eced7b327652ffae4d4181587d53f"}

{"id": "p_e21d680cc7d2a98c", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 140, "text": "散騎侍郎夏侯惠薦劭曰：「伏見常侍劉劭，深忠篤思，體周於數，凡所錯綜，源流弘遠，是以羣才大小，咸取所同而斟酌焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "bbbd2b60020a38736f29a568f30250dc16568763b4d951f506e0c9915959cce5"}

{"id": "p_2a444e0b5a713e43", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 141, "text": "故性實之士服其平和良正，清靜之人慕其玄虛退讓，文學之士嘉其推步詳密，法理之士明其分數精比，意思之士知其沈深篤固，文章之士愛其著論屬辭，制度之士貴其化略較要，策謀之士贊其明思通微，凡此諸論，皆取適己所長而舉其支流者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "34144d43f0eed4f73f2f22d63011e48a7552ea6888998dde87414f20dbb7ea35"}

{"id": "p_0f6e322bbe251971", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 142, "text": "臣數聽其清談，覽其篤論，漸漬歷年，服膺彌乆，實爲朝廷奇其器量。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "1ee13962a11981d1c03df635153c42205bad95b57c79d91898fce0becdec3c1b"}

{"id": "p_b8bc72e5ad90a873", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 143, "text": "以爲若此人者，宜輔翼機事，納謀幃幄，當與國道俱隆，非世俗所常有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "e6935f27bd33e183567d3ce159824e88180c51d75d36fb9c4b83235a5e74babc"}

{"id": "p_d1b7a989731c32b7", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 144, "text": "惟陛下垂優游之聽，使劭承清閑之歡，得自盡於前，則德音上通，煇燿日新矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "76a2ed660c1e1be2a56b7f3ee42494c221250040b7d5e77bd64124843a0413d7"}

{"id": "p_7912de9c3e01d63d", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 145, "text": "景初中，受詔作都官考課。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "c73dfe19c3c50b13920714ca51f8a8b8a0895f2ced13cbb122a46a41d0745268"}

{"id": "p_13461333d68c4053", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 146, "text": "劭上疏曰：「百官考課，王政之大較，然而歷代弗務，是以治典闕而未補，能否混而相蒙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "855478de39479ecd70c6a1473a72a2d337af793a4ef9ba5cdfb066fd162f1653"}

{"id": "p_9e448d589d86ebce", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 147, "text": "陛下以上聖之宏略，愍王綱之弛頹，神慮內鑒，明詔外發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "a637abb594e38fdc7f95d5e8e5f467a142f39709d7e18d067283fbc56728ee2e"}

{"id": "p_9f915b4bec91656f", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 148, "text": "臣奉恩曠然，得以啟矇，輒作《都官考課》七十二條，又作《説略》一篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "47d2fa20cddc188bfede2362520f22989877eac8045f959327e86fc108c3955c"}

{"id": "p_c9e1db90243553d2", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 149, "text": "臣學寡識淺，誠不足以宣暢聖旨，著定典制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "180c3b9920fee91f388fea4fd6123519a133c544c7c0a65a6942a346e042e0f7"}

{"id": "p_ce86b237d2db70fa", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」又以爲宜制禮作樂，以移風俗，著《樂論》十四篇，事成未上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "e777e3f723961e91c3ec1a164ad583bf41ad2ee0c03b7132ee60ea49525dca1a"}

{"id": "p_b2e1c674b37b4e75", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 151, "text": "凡所選述，《法論》、《人物志》之類百餘篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "1475fa76cdf0fa68095466343aa0c1de02ae4e23191c0a9359aafe3779f1cd03"}

{"id": "p_6c02f38a4a79cd90", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 152, "text": "劭同時東海繆襲亦有才學，多所述叙，官至尚書、光祿勳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "6ce04f4f87e9c3d6c9dcd9fff8d122c73ee0a57fac444fe2b97dc766960e3903"}

{"id": "p_7ed3451852aa9df5", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 153, "text": "襲友人山陽仲長統，漢末爲尚書郎，早卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "758f6b3d9016e76d16a504e932bc1463d08b16daaad4b08054fdbf1ecd88e5a8"}

{"id": "p_e8b3da0377ef6580", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 155, "text": "散騎常侍陳留蘇林、光祿大夫京兆韋誕、樂安太守譙國夏侯惠、陳郡太守任城孫該、郎中令河東杜摯等亦著文賦，頗傳於世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "eca29913f52e330223cee8430f1fff26818c1f31e37c2ebdc12bd18eed809ab3"}

{"id": "p_7fecc8652b7b3857", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 156, "text": "傅嘏字蘭石，北地泥陽人，傅介子之後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "66412b0d1a58ba0adb93f6d4c96b6835c282cf47d88bced7a946e8884dcb97b1"}

{"id": "p_2912237534e27ff2", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 157, "text": "伯父巽，黃初中爲侍中尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "03a87472a05aed2bb42626d21e50d1db2023fd210495ae8d8df9ffaf50c57717"}

{"id": "p_f5adf39fa130d8c1", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 158, "text": "嘏弱冠知名，司空陳羣辟爲掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "9fbabda00ff011c7059301f4d91bbe3d6bab61a9e7883a95bf8d24a9ac1bdf55"}

{"id": "p_4f290168eef3e43d", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 159, "text": "時散騎常侍劉劭作考課法，事下三府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "40a31e5965f62fb6a9ced972106c71448b830d68b562777cf007bc0abb8885dc"}

{"id": "p_c62082201123958f", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 160, "text": "嘏難劭論曰：「蓋聞帝制宏深，聖道奧遠，苟非其才，則道不虛行，神而明之，存乎其人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "1ed576d0cc736a87c4f00719a80a0850119ee096eda97c86acf475fc59f6c624"}

{"id": "p_b3bf9935889ac78d", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 161, "text": "曁乎王略虧頹而曠載罔綴，微言旣沒，六籍泯玷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "2baffb5029e05d05d8b9385a06f002e17d21073085432f1ceed01c1fdfdd122b"}

{"id": "p_b70afbfc2969e469", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 162, "text": "案劭考課論，雖欲尋前代黜陟之文，然其制度略以闕亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "d0a7ca2cea2c06192d348972b78f9e3f511f3c94c93429b059b1cda151add199"}

{"id": "p_2843bc71157a3652", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 163, "text": "禮之存者，惟有周典，外建侯伯，藩屏九服，內立列司，筦齊六職，土有恒貢，官有定則，百揆均在，四民殊業，故考績可理而黜陟易通也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "8a10388de487bff9015410ba35012f881ba7a15564984cc06aac6c337fb5d7a1"}

{"id": "p_6af3f1070cadc1e2", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 164, "text": "大魏繼百王之末，承秦、漢之烈，制度之流，靡所脩采。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "27947e70b57f8f2c57b35d296ca26190edf46652ffeed1f50c59ee67c86e17b8"}

{"id": "p_1045494c5347e200", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 165, "text": "自建安以來，至于青龍，神武撥亂，肇基皇祚，掃除凶逆，芟夷遺寇，旌旗卷舒，日不暇給。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "be6afab39dfa18c12219a0433771c0b314ac7970f7b1600aa60ebaec0ef23474"}

{"id": "p_a8f050cd6b00cde7", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 166, "text": "及經邦治戎，權法並用，百官羣司，軍國通任，隨時之宜，以應政機。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "c64add0fb7d3cda3128aefcc7e874de3977eeb0ef697a8080de78c117759bf78"}

{"id": "p_08cd78defd0f6ea5", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 167, "text": "以古施今，事雜義殊，難得而通也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "5cc530be0d9216ec697fbbad325135e540e83f71e8d40992975b617bc81af4c7"}

{"id": "p_475a23ae5a1d3137", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 168, "text": "所以然者，制宜經遠，或不切近，法應時務，不足垂後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "10789d1a41e012dfbaeceda72f027451545c7a478244a55148bbb1d74311e366"}

{"id": "p_f893d131b26e7f2e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 169, "text": "夫建官均職，清理民物，所以立本也；循名考實，糾勵成規，所以治末也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "2b9b59ce750ed9c4d4bc0f102ee0a11be6548a91e44d87f77c131b4298398333"}

{"id": "p_318c82fbd6a68867", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 170, "text": "本綱末舉而造制未呈，國略不崇而考課是先，懼不足以料賢愚之分，精幽明之理也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "96a12b7faa5e87d251ee42a23157972a9b7a4f8bb0b30240a5ea80de94dbdd31"}

{"id": "p_93ca2fbe88379c93", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 171, "text": "昔先王之擇才，必本行於州閭，講道於庠序，行具而謂之賢，道脩則謂之能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "877e197b3ac248cf2ce0016049b4384725768c72b58c5838c0aca4385237a571"}

{"id": "p_237f0403e184e21a", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 172, "text": "鄕老獻賢能于王，王拜受之，舉其賢者，出使長之，科其能者，入使治之，此先王收才之義也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "efd24784159d15b2d07b730e4cfe950eeeca491c4bce1846e402e6f46f0476a5"}

{"id": "p_36d97d2f15cffb93", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 173, "text": "方今九州之民，爰及京城，未有六鄕之舉，其選才之職，專任吏部。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "df62b57147b55f90f34bf0db772067e8846accb8e8e9cc4b8e443e3a19c24a02"}

{"id": "p_3fc1e132a67a1708", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 174, "text": "案品狀則實才未必當，任薄伐則德行未爲叙，如此則殿最之課，未盡人才。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "19f3e8d17a237c690d2850faf574b5f83637727b86db253434b9ae87c7ad0304"}

{"id": "p_645a24facabcaae7", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 175, "text": "述綜王度，敷贊國式，體深義廣，難得而詳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "5f90ff301b4d9580267053733f86b6afe295eed0ba2dc895336112d71f27c3d0"}

{"id": "p_446bc63513d04b9a", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 176, "text": "正始初，除尚書郎，遷黃門侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "07643c163665c5a5431d854178af03996a0b68a571476ea006bdbcdc30170973"}

{"id": "p_70dca198eda719f9", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 177, "text": "時曹爽秉政，何晏爲吏部尚書，嘏謂爽弟羲曰：「何平叔外靜而內銛巧，好利，不念務本。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "ea1f6a3c145f14c216568e4c36dc8e9538b8ccf38943c4ffebd9de3e33d8c88e"}

{"id": "p_dcc5228c483f7208", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 178, "text": "吾恐必先惑子兄弟，仁人將遠，而朝政廢矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "adfc4ee7205501657e5edd2a80624c4e6123190c84bb2593fb9bc5c121169bd8"}

{"id": "p_b35f5259eb9365d7", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 179, "text": "」晏等遂與嘏不平，因微事以免嘏官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "48ef538c0448994a649b5519560cce731c56af2ebd2206f5f3c9e4c5a2696f08"}

{"id": "p_b7bd123f74391923", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 180, "text": "太傅司馬宣王請爲從事中郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "ad4a88b3b16356395a43fee397b67cc6ded5c141397c61df932578ff6a0b47f3"}

{"id": "p_a7e2f0cc90755762", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 181, "text": "曹爽誅，爲河南尹，遷尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "b3183a3a1e8ad42111bd0ef7d826b5d15c5dc2ce37d8176c62415a732dc553e1"}

{"id": "p_8b37126cca004d6d", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 182, "text": "嘏常以爲「秦始罷侯置守，設官分職，不與古同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "873ef3a4294734c5ffb0a50339e97301de08b1acda57bdf4de3bbcd21c126646"}

{"id": "p_6d4704f72ccdf83e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 183, "text": "然儒生學士，咸欲錯綜以三代之禮，禮弘致遠，不應時務，事與制違，名實未附，故歷代而不至於治者，蓋由是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "00c7c51c808ac359dc118192f91cffe301939ffa56577ca301071e6d187551aa"}

{"id": "p_ac825e1fd0b953a3", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 184, "text": "欲大改定官制，依古正本，今遇帝室多難，未能革易」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "0a861fbb542cfde4e94a6d4a5d8b62af874f6b8a0f54829dc33de2ca194e96db"}

{"id": "p_129b4fc6c5daa858", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 185, "text": "時論者議欲自伐呉，三征獻策各不同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "3f3b914776586e001fdbf8a32c5a5a61b4eee939e65dc610a07bab6fd44a4e07"}

{"id": "p_54c05726b9d9e1ad", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 186, "text": "詔以訪嘏，嘏對曰：「昔夫差陵齊勝晉，威行中國，終禍姑蘇；齊閔兼土拓境，闢地千里，身蹈顛覆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "d33bf00789c0e4125c9a8b90e01fef94b3ef14ed96ea657fea0560174472c85d"}

{"id": "p_cdf982cc66744601", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 187, "text": "有始不必善終，古之明效也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "689c2548453b66d171d4a6ed6a635251c70ab069628444e33e64ab917b8ec857"}

{"id": "p_191ee3a07ab1254e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 188, "text": "孫權自破關羽并荊州之後，志盈欲滿，凶宄以極，是以宣文侯深建宏圖大舉之策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "7812c31b0fbfb0ad4aab4a4d89cc457cd62e0db1eb14618301a6b89e369f85a6"}

{"id": "p_0e01023015aa2a32", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 189, "text": "今權以死，託孤於諸葛恪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "079ad24f2e7d6d5fc72dd22e764e50506e64bb72e286ca32b0f5107c72d41096"}

{"id": "p_22e9843517ab6395", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 190, "text": "若矯權苛暴，蠲其虐政，民免酷烈，偷安新惠，外內齊慮，有同舟之懼，雖不能終自保完，猶足以延期挺命於深江之外矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "ac36fcb3566d4b061fc950a409d4cb3bb56c46fc9482f67c3dc744abad3fa5e9"}

{"id": "p_3769eb9f7a8e6272", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 191, "text": "而議者或欲汎舟徑濟，橫行江表；或欲四道並進，攻其城壘；或欲大佃疆埸，觀釁而動：誠皆取賊之常計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "0bdbea1c66228d3e6e9b68a5638b68395a3d4bb74bc676d43aec9a83e8c4ff53"}

{"id": "p_a07dc8171a1461cb", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 192, "text": "然自治兵以來，出入三載，非掩襲之軍也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "1e434c365afd9a37048ea67b68726cb5e45294a4fde0b94bde50eb18de30f7d3"}

{"id": "p_88aa8d90c71e86ce", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 193, "text": "賊之爲寇，幾六十年矣，君臣偽立，吉凶共患，又喪其元帥，上下憂危，設令列船津要，堅城據險，橫行之計，其殆難捷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "c579780feb61312189913f2de6e8a821a7029de41176b636c72510d2b0393bb9"}

{"id": "p_f562180168119f65", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 194, "text": "兵出民表，寇鈔不犯；坐食積穀，不煩運士；乘釁討襲，無遠勞費：此軍之急務也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "7c94f125e2e3b94a3b8769a686c61deda5519dc08c4d6e064de52b59ce3326a6"}

{"id": "p_783beb9afed56cac", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 195, "text": "昔樊噲願以十萬之衆，橫行匈奴，季布面折其短。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "63bcfddf22aecba1b2da19dc075499baa1831ed3ebdccb481a369899b396efd4"}

{"id": "p_17b19f279b75fab9", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 196, "text": "今欲越長江，涉虜庭，亦向時之喻也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "888a56c485f667b86889098922258910c2d842f9ecb5edfb670c1cd7defdfbbf"}

{"id": "p_5b6ca0b62faa7597", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 197, "text": "未若明法練士，錯計於全勝之地，振長策以禦敵之餘燼，斯必然之數也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "bc950a8523f66299b22c910181beaf014e44a844f99424047b7a0e55d5960428"}

{"id": "p_4141bf1d8272d017", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 198, "text": "後呉大將諸葛恪新破東關，乘勝揚聲欲向青、徐，朝廷將爲之備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "f6f44af7c0442291c2b13981e243d0117730d956bf195032c89f27739b709228"}

{"id": "p_724f6e7409e8bc94", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 199, "text": "嘏議以爲「淮海非賊輕行之路，又昔孫權遣兵入海，漂浪沈溺，略無孑遺，恪豈敢傾根竭本，寄命洪流，以徼乾沒乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "5cfff4319e41c7d04a2b6612d5b3afab5742b4ea4b15b4e3668c369d58abf5fe"}

{"id": "p_f9e4df07d52e0365", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 200, "text": "恪不過遣偏率小將素習水軍者，乘海泝淮，示動青、徐，恪自并兵來向淮南耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "77291212cf61912879ce2577ba15b6127f47b9c73bb08ca3452afdbb6f21fd20"}

{"id": "p_77de628d0d81bffa", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 201, "text": "」後恪果圖新城，不克而歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "ee7836435aee3b95e1423e0089c526465173206509b18e6c2d1f7b9bebe52137"}

{"id": "p_bc81687a076245f3", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 202, "text": "嘏常論才性同異，鍾會集而論之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "aed77165c9a2fbcab2523a158e027d4c8cc79e829f91489da2f7acd3afcb3c7b"}

{"id": "p_07af4bbe6ac95972", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 203, "text": "高貴鄕公即尊位，進封武鄕亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "b8c4c75b5a70aaec8401075d2727bd83778005c37f167ec1d941456dfc784e4f"}

{"id": "p_67ff04f9cc26a432", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 204, "text": "或以司馬景王不宜自行，可遣太尉孚往，惟嘏及王肅勸之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "65cc622a7efe2ee57cd00d45d1c414a4ba81f581a9c8ef4f74a9313ac92d34a8"}

{"id": "p_d79eaee0767619ec", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 205, "text": "及景王薨，嘏與司馬文王徑還洛陽，文王遂以輔政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "a81cbc87432e599644abc2f0b09a2f1477cc7cbf97c708ec6921a888390eea8d"}

{"id": "p_78c58189e3849fda", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 206, "text": "會由是有自矜色，嘏戒之曰：「子志大其量，而勳業難爲也，可不慎哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "0852c8f1848ce7af337f957cf753f880fbd55f09db74b6c25447f98cc88a986d"}

{"id": "p_9fce301ed47e5ec2", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 207, "text": "」嘏以功進封陽鄕侯，增邑六百戸，并前千二百戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "d51e5befceb26cd42b3ccd18b246c0fd1a57e15675da731f83f36f448024a5d1"}

{"id": "p_c3ccceac37fa358a", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 208, "text": "是歳薨，時年四十七，追贈太常，謚曰元侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "9d2ef35f828135ca6ade0704fcac801f039d321463ac51608d7f6fd15ae40a57"}

{"id": "p_a5d19c049ca5a837", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 209, "text": "咸熈中開建五等，以嘏著勳前朝，改封祗涇原子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "a83d73724ed6c220cc23f2c1c986288837de9b2fbbfd2492ea70877e04d1c37f"}

{"id": "p_3a578141b993e282", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 210, "text": "評曰：昔文帝、陳王以公子之尊，博好文采，同聲相應，才士並出，惟粲等六人最見名目。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "3fa84976888e2369125fd8b22c3548bcbe28657dc81709975fad588aba17ab38"}

{"id": "p_61771f3793338d5e", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 211, "text": "而粲特處常伯之官，興一代之制，然其沖虛德宇，未若徐-{幹}-之粹也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "7a4933bb79b34357d65c7369572d3d651dd58751194aaf2662648d9d9ab86534"}

{"id": "p_e389c308069a0116", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 212, "text": "衞覬亦以多識典故，相時王之式。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "5eb58b1f0485860a8ac2727517a621358f605e80b70261a55d9f2579bc22a29f"}

{"id": "p_80171fae5cb60671", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 213, "text": "劉劭該覽學籍，文質周洽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "8ccd827fe5624ed6b583dd263080f21aa2d86a0e95a0cc9cfd411c76ac47e639"}

{"id": "p_e76396a6b2a53018", "source_id": "src_1712d9536f4e709b", "ordinal": 214, "text": "劉廙以清鑒著，傅嘏用才達顯云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "d886726fbb87527f559d83f97bb46ebab2318b23379fd31fd1cfc500e7ff0794"}

{"id": "p_553e85e8f26b728d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_910776c6983381c6", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 1, "text": "桓階字伯緒，長沙臨湘人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "c1dcc4fded1b7a393b13eb2437ebbf7330e09915d5ca01ba6924696a0003d71b"}

{"id": "p_ec981bb24a6d7959", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 2, "text": "太守孫堅舉階孝廉，除尚書郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "39ae9bc109e17763835c9ad10c4b6bf1589ad817c2fb885eca68734122af823d"}

{"id": "p_a7c2616c44f311d1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 3, "text": "會堅擊劉表戰死，階冒難詣表乞堅喪，表義而與之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "99f8a2d1808a9f8adf0f7e74c572da43a306b9539bc0af98617781f420379085"}

{"id": "p_751fe7bd9ed1eb63", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 4, "text": "後太祖與袁紹相拒於官渡，表舉州以應紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "0426e028ad7bd82eeaafe631a45ffe4c9ee206a8f3e716bf21dee5d1e912c69e"}

{"id": "p_0d6ec7cfc64d3e0a", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 5, "text": "階說其太守張羡曰：「夫舉事而不本於義，未有不敗者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "6e6c479c0f6165a7e42ca5ac410c4b69b6088de5d32690b29ae4ac88bd51739b"}

{"id": "p_ca3a906f900d315d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 6, "text": "故齊桓率諸侯以尊周，晉文逐叔帶以納王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "5f1a4b2cae931b21944f6598845e9336cae7edc03aaf32e01dbe98c3a4e72560"}

{"id": "p_b464d6b2fd39630e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 7, "text": "今袁氏反此，而劉牧應之，取禍之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "999cbb1f0684e383564eeb1295d1186055d84efdd5c68966a0dd7b8bb6bd5b45"}

{"id": "p_2427ab8d2bae1028", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 8, "text": "明府必欲立功明義，全福遠禍，不宜與之同也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "d3c6f6cfb1e505505c0fbe3f96add7e64958cf335b4c00d6bb8e8f29a29128a8"}

{"id": "p_b060443e46c11636", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」羡曰：「然則何向而可？", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "92bdd04c08bc597029bd38b9effe047741c15ca82007ab0a4e80795c42ebb8e6"}

{"id": "p_63d355f199beb405", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」階曰：「曹公雖弱，仗義而起，救朝廷之危，奉王命而討有罪，孰敢不服？", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "96d5fc2bea5f6104b0d3c612759d1d8d9f92e2e5aaff20777319c582c33408bc"}

{"id": "p_54b4b9d290a9732f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 11, "text": "今若舉四郡保三江以待其來，而爲之内應，不亦可乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "b8b93d85bb98a225b0e38325953289fc8503bb603484c1585a30e4ef744e9b42"}

{"id": "p_fec1e1db18e43539", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」乃舉長沙及旁三郡以拒表，遣使詣太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "f599828c895aae4ace87f325304afc24451376b0cd23f4b10fc65ed12a0a89c9"}

{"id": "p_2ce94e3090a9396f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 13, "text": "會紹與太祖連戰，軍未得南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "90b8a72cbcf00fb12e283798548be020de76cc2b55b997d248f8c77590b52ca6"}

{"id": "p_88247b3edcdc918c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 14, "text": "久之，劉表辟爲從事祭酒，欲妻以妻妹蔡氏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "62a59a5b7a31e6d4aa843b0be07f604ff89b4ab80e7270b5d388f48252e2650d"}

{"id": "p_1ee044ddcbf492ad", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 15, "text": "階自陳已結婚，拒而不受，因辭疾告退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "c57cbaf97796d2d8b5562195bfeeb4253bdcfe19163a0b66bd3e0f0360e714bb"}

{"id": "p_3619accf18a0c321", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 16, "text": "太祖定荆州，聞其爲張羡謀也，異之，辟爲丞相掾主簿，遷趙郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "81b29e141acbc2ab1abb882acb5afe249fc2c515ed3f1b27a8a3bf511793a598"}

{"id": "p_37cfc515785e240c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 17, "text": "魏國初建，爲虎賁中郎將侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "dd69a55c6557cf79305b0801ddf3e1d26f05574df9f8cb275a65b7c14a39902d"}

{"id": "p_e92d5abbf0f8d346", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 18, "text": "時太子未定，而臨菑侯植有寵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "f2710aa1b0687cd957ab590ebbec42946289e79bde0e4cbce1ecfc0ed962fdf2"}

{"id": "p_90fdb1f76455b075", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 19, "text": "階數陳文帝德優齒長，宜爲儲副，公規密諫，前後懇至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "b28fe08012e2ff9f553bdc3818301c9658f0897df02d0f8503b0c4a517a609a6"}

{"id": "p_d289a9a4d49ef8db", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 20, "text": "又毛玠、徐奕以剛蹇少黨，而爲西曹掾丁儀所不善，儀屢言其短，賴階左右以自全保。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "6ef598ebe184bef350841eefc89b7da1ff8d054ad826d0b5acdf442adffbdbad"}

{"id": "p_48e147a818056b8f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 21, "text": "曹仁爲關羽所圍，太祖遣徐晃救之，不解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "eed62e5ada1dc51c9c649e68f3475cbf510236255c12f6926d5f36b3c7d9d7d0"}

{"id": "p_41b49b58537e5cb5", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 22, "text": "太祖欲自南征，以问羣下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "6c277cb23f2825897f4a997a331ad82a3e5e1fb5a9ace4bcc2829db50856f7ed"}

{"id": "p_1cb8fc4aab9f47e7", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 23, "text": "羣下皆謂：「王不亟行，今敗矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "004bc73058d9f12ab71d638170f20a496d751876c39c55c9d4044e97121f97f2"}

{"id": "p_0a93345974c88a69", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」階獨曰：「大王以仁等爲足以料事勢不也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "9a9ecac8323e1c889b5d20dad10f607eaafca3437f3f8813d9334ae9024bd019"}

{"id": "p_ada7e49db66e55d4", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 25, "text": "」曰：「吾恐虏众多，而晃等勢不便耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "7877ea2da23eed8480d54d06042f7cf1f7dbbb3c3117d5e5543545c422ceeb2c"}

{"id": "p_6559c80ba7a5fc77", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」階曰：「今仁等处重圍之中而守死无贰者，诚以大王遠爲之勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "7b775642234ee1df9a352aac57b6189e0464d24cd27c00015c5afaa716a92e88"}

{"id": "p_8a28228d0cfde865", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 27, "text": "夫居万死之地，必有死争之心；内怀死争，外有强救，大王案六軍以示餘力，何忧於敗而欲自往？", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "39d6c9389cfdfbe072df49e8aba2aca751c785231d72c1e2632162915af59ee8"}

{"id": "p_271d4557dba93cf8", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」太祖善其言，驻軍於摩陂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "0655a73175ee3c1974aaf7dccd558b231a7d1506b1083e6b48bdb1303fbc4cff"}

{"id": "p_94f0681aba80df55", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 29, "text": "文帝践阼，遷尚書令，封高鄉亭侯，加侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "a050f43ba59d3496f90aae74138de0d60eb037186b0454ba59b59cf3c1cb986b"}

{"id": "p_5eb504243be467bb", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 30, "text": "階疾病，帝自臨省，謂曰：「吾方讬六尺之孤，寄天下之命於卿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "4a046f89d5878d45e5dd55ce24a552b4a14aba66133925f4684f5ffe0863223a"}

{"id": "p_c3de8f9e18853559", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」徙封安乐鄉侯，邑六百户，又赐階三子爵關内侯，祐以嗣子不封，病卒，又追赠關内侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "9b37b40d22575174ee995e3838ec39054872a0ea3116df5537e890d954624b59"}

{"id": "p_a1c15bbe5bc722f1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 32, "text": "後階疾笃，遣使者即拜太常，薨，帝爲之流涕，谥曰贞侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "7bf75d90ab48e8e66657b142677354da00d0ec958cd061a19a80310d4c4ae89a"}

{"id": "p_914e6f5be7cef1c1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 33, "text": "以階弟纂爲散骑侍郎，赐爵關内侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "7dbd535b3f84d9c544e04db82a3e8211593fc302c687969ec2eba34a13f44e2f"}

{"id": "p_91124463c4a8ccf5", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 34, "text": "嘉尚升遷亭公主，會嘉平中，以乐安太守與吴戰於东關，軍敗，没，谥曰壮侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "f3af6c537f03b96ed30a5d592bb939f78f7d57f1553609b1c5a69ad3d2bec4a5"}

{"id": "p_e142aeb0af5b4810", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 35, "text": "陳羣字長文，颍川许昌（人）也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "487d7cbe8075f2f682e3c572b1d47b919b55516e26cd7df255300a97f859c7ee"}

{"id": "p_37cf41789641516c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 36, "text": "祖父寔，父纪，叔父谌，皆有盛名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "a47398ac72f6cdcb6613828aca19f522d6a25df4a8cb4921103c77da442e49d9"}

{"id": "p_4cc3dcddceb15ed3", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 37, "text": "羣爲兒時，寔常奇異之，謂宗人父老曰：「此兒必兴吾宗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "cf68a3b767f35bd9e5c607b126e5f50505ce26e5eb35431a0a3d1d782b814a91"}

{"id": "p_97bf08da08a50339", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」鲁國孔融高才倨傲，年在纪、羣之间，先與纪友，後與羣交，更爲纪拜，由是显名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "d56c7a223b01c8630b28ef226bb5e17d1e21f0c786cc08d6a0a8d9cf6826f139"}

{"id": "p_748b467dcbe3eec2", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 39, "text": "劉备臨豫州，辟羣爲别驾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "09e175e00a24d5db4b0711bac63890e32c6e23bf06cb4a37d480b6f6df035ceb"}

{"id": "p_104775b46eac2fd1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 40, "text": "時陶谦病死，徐州迎备，备欲往，羣說备曰：「袁术尚强，今东，必與之争。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "786225e59c18bb8418766df514051424398dfdb568f6553501e16b85381f65f5"}

{"id": "p_3e0d75ad5aa24391", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 41, "text": "吕布若袭將軍之後，將軍雖得徐州，事必无成。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "fa070a1afa72e792411416e069eb672d51d3a75fb393832dc60b724d09a845cb"}

{"id": "p_8324d4b0cd11ce34", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 42, "text": "布果袭下邳，遣兵助术，大破备軍，备恨不用羣言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "ad2f9c44e6b6c9c2cf6f90d821d90672997b9f6c1f09b6a0dc3cf9f93606dbdd"}

{"id": "p_5334b66c50b718c9", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 43, "text": "舉茂才，除柘令，不行，随纪避難徐州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "3b1829b8dc79914f123db26824529960a2a92b6fdf4873d0329e9306eb2a9cea"}

{"id": "p_2721e13809373c4c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 44, "text": "属吕布破，太祖辟羣爲司空西曹掾属。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "110ef58bafc6d1405ecd00dc9883d3bcecc02a2340c7e96713b633a993b149ad"}

{"id": "p_5af28f4f5d962d2d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 45, "text": "時有荐乐安王模、下邳周逵者，太祖辟之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "8ebec91190819056013c56f668c3a4a9b5fc9fb96bd1b3dd05b10aa195f8fb95"}

{"id": "p_c74c7492fc84a2e5", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 46, "text": "羣封還教，以爲模、逵秽德，终必敗，太祖不听。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "f04a4cdec609a75edcb69ca71ada3ba11d668b46119c9b1d1f62ca4ce65cbfa1"}

{"id": "p_6ad1288fa5c5aa8f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 47, "text": "後模、逵皆坐奸宄诛，太祖以谢羣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "eeaf502c51c2e2d617684ddf456ff57bd8ae8420aa685af68a6ff7e53cb88975"}

{"id": "p_cd1bff00c28294c5", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 48, "text": "羣荐广陵陳矫、丹阳戴乾，太祖皆用之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "617941e2266563c7bb4118904c73a9ce8c0436af4a86343ec9360ae93600c665"}

{"id": "p_f7e779df28ddc7ce", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 49, "text": "後吴人叛，乾忠義死難，矫遂爲名臣，世以羣爲知人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "bdcd077b5c7692f1183aa583011f4c168d5560312537adb517a0953d2eb2fa67"}

{"id": "p_dfe3ff5a18fd2748", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 50, "text": "除萧、赞、長平令，父卒去官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "2fdd04be5a000d4aaf7a36a6947cfbcf430c38da979311b75118c231d933a68f"}

{"id": "p_94453e58515058a1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 51, "text": "後以司徒掾舉高第，爲治書侍御史，转参丞相軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "6ea2cc5221fbaeeb3c570ba22226860bf7a73859beb743d96ddcc1e3d0dff972"}

{"id": "p_942b4f719acfb9a0", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 52, "text": "魏國既建，遷爲御史中丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "3381200292efb81ced435bc25222c5145cddb0cf663744b4e71e8a379b8be646"}

{"id": "p_863b0e5f05b8edcc", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 53, "text": "時太祖议复肉刑，令曰：「安得通理君子达於古今者，使平斯事乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "08417de245094606f52e1daabb10229475c9040d94e9352781b03171a9872f9a"}

{"id": "p_961cbe6570f6b6ea", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 54, "text": "昔陳鸿胪以爲死刑有可加於仁恩者，正謂此也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "4a13b2f835aee84628430711cc89f523861700f88f1f69b3f0ba860677687f13"}

{"id": "p_4c03072796ade771", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 55, "text": "御史中丞能申其父之论乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "14e154465d75abb46283254de56cd54fced4e623b1fe6965dd22b18c2afc79ab"}

{"id": "p_afdecb017349b062", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 56, "text": "時锺繇與羣议同，王朗及议者多以爲未可行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "5b33928718b3ef148c853f1ac717314443883ac0bee0be8ac71bc17d5aa0c42f"}

{"id": "p_33fda4dc988cc3ac", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 57, "text": "太祖深善繇、羣言，以軍事未罢，顾众议，故且寝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "c0bdee69cb6b0b09103942e5bd19cb218a323c89152026921830f9d3d3973112"}

{"id": "p_fa1a3b119a5924e9", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 59, "text": "在朝无適无莫，雅杖名義，不以非道假人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "fbcc9a4502fa9b4762deca1b8977b83506df195bda87b8b512215a1e5345a535"}

{"id": "p_3281225180bd5e98", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 60, "text": "文帝在东宫，深敬器焉，待以交友之礼，常叹曰：「自吾有回，门人日以亲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "6f05e2a5e29840170464c1b31658f99a6f583b4caa7583d08cec9a87917f45ff"}

{"id": "p_799d4f6ee9d23f4d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」及即王位，封羣昌武亭侯，徙爲尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "787bf44dc88409b0953cfca46ce62fdb78fd2457346773f842d907c032be6cc5"}

{"id": "p_efb6b354186b1e93", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 62, "text": "制九品官人之法，羣所建也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "c4134cca8b861b044448e7c58e576aaf5ef2d2ad8991923ec4b654baa39e7c43"}

{"id": "p_d0aff23a481da16a", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 63, "text": "及践阼，遷尚書仆射，加侍中，徙尚書令，进爵颖鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "3f979d92ed9419b774d22e0767456c7fca45055d97a5850021fca81dbed9888e"}

{"id": "p_1d76cf48499e70e2", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 64, "text": "帝征孫权，至广陵，使羣领中领軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "e24f7b6a8870a371dbd797ac7a28ca6cf750804656dc129a6807982d449f5bdc"}

{"id": "p_8836f60d1388092a", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 65, "text": "還许昌，以羣爲镇軍大將軍，领中护軍，录尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "ad4c1f8bfd8e5a99f4e6b4eb898ae8fa8030e7ed8bbe83c4deda93679790840e"}

{"id": "p_1aab53045c1e56c7", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 66, "text": "帝寝疾，羣與曹真、司马宣王等并受遺诏辅政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "5237bafcb692349b0c276034ebb43c716530320cfd880e5d636a1ca215ea6a67"}

{"id": "p_6282fe87d1a6f732", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 67, "text": "明帝即位，进封颍阴侯，增邑五百，并前千三百户，與征东大將軍曹休、中軍大將軍曹真、抚軍大將軍司马宣王并开府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "1bd676f20331677f786522f51798954939c0ade68d184703fa002235203b2e0e"}

{"id": "p_fb2b76b1b6bf3395", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 68, "text": "顷之，爲司空，故录尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "33a55dc898b91303dda2d3b1901de05902f5626ff892e9a090101380e31de97f"}

{"id": "p_54aaa1ad7db42b52", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 69, "text": "是時，帝初莅政，羣上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "59097b709d7276c08f4f5bb338ecf41afcf9f6df18c550c0623d928fac42f0bc"}

{"id": "p_15b3f6355e9d599c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 70, "text": "太和中，曹真表欲數道伐蜀，從斜谷入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "5a5bc857f12200a9fa49b500f28845b2c6751f79d1be82f206e4c36e6d4552b5"}

{"id": "p_b13f09f2a6fbebc5", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 71, "text": "羣以爲「太祖昔到阳平攻張鲁，多收豆麦以益軍粮，鲁未下而食犹乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "aa757cb4428afd19929867be1936f065e63f26629132f46c218057ae881db49f"}

{"id": "p_106a89f56306f0d0", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 72, "text": "今既无所因，且斜谷阻险，難以进退，转运必见钞截，多留兵守要，則损戰士，不可不熟虑也」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "a267f2335f55b6612090dfdb9071a86595786bdecafb70fa214a0b39d47ebc5c"}

{"id": "p_22cd2b3b0fdd365f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 73, "text": "羣又陳其不便，并言軍事用度之计。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "437e0b80e74c90b310eddd6b2ff79ed8abfadb5976fe53d7f50aa2141c45293d"}

{"id": "p_b3b83da075311b28", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 74, "text": "诏以羣议下真，真据之遂行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "8385abcd9bf68f5efd74486020ac8e28fdb691fac739a5e04447512da86f92fd"}

{"id": "p_363a650062b85304", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 75, "text": "會霖雨积日，羣又以爲宜诏真還，帝從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "67c0081007ba4c0b0727871606adf264cfffe502bdeb00c11df174e07d58eee9"}

{"id": "p_2576d67c4d6695ec", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 76, "text": "後皇女淑薨，追封谥平原懿公主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "596cb983c86eccd9dc1304d5d8bfef54196b89a3eca87b0c4b49910749a166be"}

{"id": "p_ffaec7d80aa12742", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 77, "text": "青龙中，营治宫室，百姓失农時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "868a3f24ac617615b19285cebe57cbe556ddb4b2f0ef898b9a6707aaf5a1c291"}

{"id": "p_a0ee3f4cf7aa9e18", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 78, "text": "帝答曰：「王者宫室，亦宜并立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "6ffca72e276629cb156aad1387327b7e655171df20c8bf3d45597545542ff4ca"}

{"id": "p_faeefbc8cf0b69b7", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 79, "text": "灭贼之後，但当罢守耳，岂可复兴役邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "48745cde5e23b66494c8ddf13310de8651817d3611e42e6b14eeec53a7c8c3c6"}

{"id": "p_5475245b45cddd0d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 80, "text": "是故君之职，萧何之大略也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "30ec40d0605fc08eab35b25f473dedf7f59de655cf389ba2799487d985f7e589"}

{"id": "p_f14c88487c57c2bc", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 81, "text": "初，太祖時，劉廙坐弟與魏讽謀反，当诛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "2fcf2e9b3c99ef21d33e103b45b8f2acb4ac09eb5c217c0d4f8a59e5739f9442"}

{"id": "p_231340f8ee35a492", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 82, "text": "羣言之太祖，太祖曰：「廙，名臣也，吾亦欲赦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "c4f8c557c7fe484600f5565b7cfa9efdba68a095d013d04f8cf80e5ee6ad2db1"}

{"id": "p_29e7b3f007312266", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 83, "text": "廙深德羣，羣曰：「夫议刑爲國，非爲私也；且自明主之意，吾何知焉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "07bfd27ec7d9e92589a620294d9045e1b372816f2c07962673da2ea3b3cdfae9"}

{"id": "p_6fc0eae54ed27721", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」其弘博不伐，皆此類也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "6ad6960ca879bcdb26fe8e6b6cda3aa83064c72587928338d1a490268b4cb83e"}

{"id": "p_db37bf7d80bdf556", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 85, "text": "帝追思羣功德，分羣户邑，封一子列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "de635780a394a76a4a9660746f56fb3327068fe39bdc12e291ef48ee45cb74d4"}

{"id": "p_8a3cdcb59dda28ae", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 86, "text": "正始中，徙游擊將軍，爲并州刺史，加振威將軍，使持节，护匈奴中郎將，怀柔夷民，甚有威惠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "94e85ec132ce94aec9f607f81649b2cdcfb6b1e616a7ec8ff6a792cacbd2d635"}

{"id": "p_7ef29a373d6f5dfc", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 87, "text": "京邑贵人多寄宝货，因泰市奴婢，泰皆挂之於壁，不发其封，及徵爲尚書，悉以還之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "077e689466cf4456cd594cc3e997e70b7bd4fa62c7fc2b2b1ec0cb88732240ae"}

{"id": "p_d637eeab8263c713", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 88, "text": "嘉平初，代郭淮爲雍州刺史，加奋威將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "afd3f587e392b0bff008d7a131c42a681480e9670510bcf0d0c47f222e965cea"}

{"id": "p_c473c12ce628a457", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 89, "text": "蜀大將軍姜维率众依麹山筑二城，使牙门將句安、李歆等守之，聚羌胡质任等寇偪諸郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "f1048f12e142a01853ea8d7880a5e7fd30aad86f8c7fe63368f416b05925d2b8"}

{"id": "p_a4217edc61af4cec", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 90, "text": "征西將軍郭淮與泰謀所以御之，泰曰：「麹城雖固，去蜀险遠，当须运粮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "f1d58e2a6ea38cc63c1d9dec63f47caef23c9e3fa5c9100f807fbe41b68a70af"}

{"id": "p_50df5b3b6ddbd6ec", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 91, "text": "羌夷患维劳役，必未肯附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "4c686916c765f9d9e250372dec5209b668836108f05017ee75875305e4c9504a"}

{"id": "p_ce7f42c61c6a5c4e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 92, "text": "今圍而取之，可不血刃而拔其城；雖其有救，山道阻险，非行兵之地也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "9adab60e5b736214560c1788a19cd01fae61f6919bb68f75ceec4f26393c4a6a"}

{"id": "p_bee141d3a4eab98e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 93, "text": "」淮從泰计，使泰率討蜀护軍徐质、南安太守邓艾等进兵圍之，断其运道及城外流水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "346e9dfd4542964de9ba68399748bbee7d33228d7173edc1f4a2492f8de6b53d"}

{"id": "p_372d43a9f2be7bb4", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 94, "text": "安等挑戰，不许，將士困窘，分粮聚雪以稽日月。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "b726dcafe49c57aac7982967d26813dd128f3b3fff89ba35174e0b3ae03e5280"}

{"id": "p_35b746e358e214f4", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 95, "text": "维果來救，出自牛头山，與泰相对。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "8d34abc59d46dd11df5414e1cbcd85050961f02576dd9b4010ae4cb5c82f3e0d"}

{"id": "p_386082b2fef9e6d4", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 96, "text": "泰曰：「兵法贵在不戰而屈人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "1bb7f8010fb42994ea13726504c120562c6e8b6803c19a599e21caecb43c86bb"}

{"id": "p_6bdbe8d17263c0aa", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 97, "text": "今绝牛头，维无反道，則我之禽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "7e58de8ca8c9af93dd042792821603b331ce9830d104caf69e42d451489bc161"}

{"id": "p_f2aa76dceba6c8a0", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」敕諸軍各堅垒勿與戰，遣使白淮，欲自南渡白水，循水而东，使淮趣牛头，截其還路，可并取维，不惟安等而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "694c1b41c09785836565b42e2d99e2b5cb72b60f6adbbab5ee3dd9b6624517cb"}

{"id": "p_a2122c1a52e4d8fc", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 99, "text": "淮善其策，进率諸軍軍洮水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "13956c7b1d919b09d06d8b7ae19fa8ccf0a3d5f36aa70304a7cfdf66d3f0797a"}

{"id": "p_4dd68b8c8bc4e3c4", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 100, "text": "维惧，遁走，安等孤县，遂皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "2c59363549f27cadd2d19797e317e69fae443cc7a8df94e4ee1b57f2430cf0f8"}

{"id": "p_8dde73f92b9c3327", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 101, "text": "淮薨，泰代爲征西將軍，假节都督雍、凉諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "76592053546d205e6de76be0a84135500981ab6987b43a545a62a35bbbdd7911"}

{"id": "p_1623e66a501f0989", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 102, "text": "後年，雍州刺史王经白泰，云姜维、夏侯霸欲三道向祁山、石营、金城，求进兵爲翅，使凉州軍至枹罕，討蜀护軍向祁山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "76f66846bf086ef76981cbf11fb56f0d8e0dcb4f1781904e73872fae0fefe02a"}

{"id": "p_e581888fb6d8e05c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 103, "text": "泰量贼勢终不能三道，且兵勢恶分，凉州未宜越境，报经：「审其定问，知所趣向，须东西勢合乃进。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "91fa8216c5c0972f2ca0f0c65b587ef43048cdc6184c47ba073a7422cc7b6283"}

{"id": "p_56239396f0a1a3ea", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 104, "text": "」時维等將數万人至枹罕，趣狄道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "eae9d49328c610047088996a52628481bed37122d008c7e84f4907c3249e2d93"}

{"id": "p_9709f47c64829331", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 105, "text": "泰敕经进屯狄道，须軍到，乃規取之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "bd6360643f7c5df0ac05c3615b83d0399595b7962c232099b109fd495d0d5386"}

{"id": "p_b8528f364dadb8c3", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 106, "text": "會经所统諸軍於故關與贼戰不利，经辄渡洮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "929d01fcfdc5540eeecbf53d39d09cdb4487ad6a820b9b418b662aadda3f6b2f"}

{"id": "p_38572d7412ace82e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 107, "text": "泰以经不堅据狄道，必有他变。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "a4047fef4e299906cd327a143ff5d42d3758e4eaef7c9ab58fdb840bce1e6114"}

{"id": "p_d5f87d6ab23eb2f8", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 108, "text": "并遣五营在前，泰率諸軍继之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "648d38e855f04a4cb72f6b5086aa6f52a34bcefa10f441516a8ee2e5a51655de"}

{"id": "p_8e44fe757e6bc073", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 109, "text": "经巳與维戰，大敗，以万餘人還保狄道城，餘皆奔散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "cbb7e690627440c127dd24a83394c234397205b0a2770e20941471432c3a0fe7"}

{"id": "p_9df0a32cfc3fe6d3", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 110, "text": "泰軍上邽，分兵守要，晨夜进前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "5a3c0049eb7b4e77fd48db938a50a6345a96959da8944fba9aaa99ca0c00a6b5"}

{"id": "p_258694e4629b2de0", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 111, "text": "邓艾、胡奋、王祕亦到，即與艾、祕等分爲三軍，进到陇西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "45baeb223b6118c75481f6ebe80ec311db53f950dee4bb4375f5266c6f403916"}

{"id": "p_86a13e6810b798ed", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 112, "text": "艾等以爲「王经精卒破衄於西，贼众大盛，乘胜之兵既不可当，而將軍以乌合之卒，继敗軍之後，將士失气，陇右倾荡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "f51392df21f5f4b24b1eb5ab3968e40e616a976ca0747dc7953208e48692af3e"}

{"id": "p_0fe5300a4a73385f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 113, "text": "古人有言：‘蝮蛇螫手，壮士解其腕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "0f60fc3119c8ac6d4f4e454cd826988ee3e73e1cbae8735eb093a524e6e2f9e6"}
