{"id": "p_2c1ccad7a1a0ba36", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 114, "text": "’孫子曰：‘兵有所不擊，地有所不守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "9bda50498aaeb2c2cf907f75e828a0f6e37c5739e0e4c2f119e31592d98b5225"}

{"id": "p_a3d79c9b001dc2d6", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 115, "text": "’盖小有所失而大有所全故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "d1abafcd704dbcf6d44753f108a8f09d58822708c3ca25b13cabce0d717d2b7a"}

{"id": "p_8dac064ed1fee929", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 116, "text": "今陇右之害，过於蝮蛇，狄道之地，非徒不守之謂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "9d528a2c37695566911b239136b6fe3de88667484d3ae323562a9cbb214d4408"}

{"id": "p_4e6db2dcfff0f1aa", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 117, "text": "不如割险自保，观衅待弊，然後进救，此计之得者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "56dd5fbcf08023ba9c2846df61d08a68ab14dbb353a00505314f312ce42374a6"}

{"id": "p_8bfd83fb03c18a02", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 118, "text": "遂进軍度高城岭，潜行，夜至狄道东南高山上，多舉烽火，鸣鼓角。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "81ce07a046485a29cb1f11f6b1ff49a8c5f170f23cdbe9f7a7d1d36d337a18f3"}

{"id": "p_9d7705b1d1317ecc", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 119, "text": "狄道城中將士见救者至，皆愤踊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "f6b61bc793822ec666b8b00efeb035e01bb64ef4447430ed22741ea119d29315"}

{"id": "p_423d6d6aa82e5347", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 120, "text": "维始謂官救兵当须众集乃发，而卒聞已至，謂有奇变宿謀，上下震惧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "7908c953f4d32da72a61f061ccf2e2f397f82cce0752b4466d72112927dfe6f7"}

{"id": "p_68b209d21ea210c1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 121, "text": "自軍之发陇西也，以山道深险，贼必设伏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "99aa5ec7bfcdea7181713b54ce2285a2f8f513b0a534f0ec40269b2406c68d67"}

{"id": "p_624d868dc20c832d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 122, "text": "泰诡從南道，维果三日施伏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "debe63be2d957e838a57e47e8d48622af9035b8dc50ac2e09a149edf5018b2f2"}

{"id": "p_35720dc9afde8694", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 123, "text": "维乃缘山突至，泰與交戰，维退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "ea77130883d3531da3f23a07178228b0821c0fabd96c6faa395f2f4af1748078"}

{"id": "p_ac0e6c8845b24f38", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 124, "text": "凉州軍從金城南至沃干阪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "7bf9e2b3de789007e88baba31040b4d072223bb5f0bc28f90e82b9a2d86903fd"}

{"id": "p_f3f0112d77aa807e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 125, "text": "泰與经共密期，当共向其還路，维等聞之，遂遁，城中將士得出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "7cda2676c319f4eabb9a96a48cdb13bc08e329ea3c1863115a6eba12a810e87c"}

{"id": "p_71cfb221a2bbb8a3", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 126, "text": "经叹曰：「粮不至旬，向不應机，舉城屠裂，覆喪一州矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "6310bc893f7180fb28f87b68fa6251549d757cac0699e8bf86feab63c7ebba67"}

{"id": "p_ad4f20cdc0148cea", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」泰慰劳將士，前後遣還，更差軍守，并治城垒，還屯上邽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "036d729074ae8abe6b954a07dc658a7b5bd9b13138bb12a8ed71b8869bd6aaf2"}

{"id": "p_0679e59273664790", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 128, "text": "初，泰聞经见圍，以州軍將士素皆一心，加得保城，非维所能卒倾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "67887d780a60cea368bcc343d486b420415fd62a5cef6f589c8843b19ad0eb51"}

{"id": "p_660d0d40cebd6169", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 129, "text": "众议以经奔北，城不足自固，维若断凉州之道，兼四郡民夷，据關、陇之险，敢能没经軍而屠陇右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "92ebff8a4ad064adaaed06fa9c7a221006f03b7a0862d0f4855b830bf6a11cd1"}

{"id": "p_a5897e2c1b917ec6", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 130, "text": "宜须大兵四集，乃致攻討。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "1578e501d7cb1f6cc0368425c700cba8dfa7df267a9a334742fdfff236ce722e"}

{"id": "p_ed8ce3a9ac1b6382", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 131, "text": "大將軍司马文王曰：「昔諸葛亮常有此志，卒亦不能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "617fa1ac54e36dd2363d332b38ac58062ffcc64620e412e7a6cd20b2dbee0649"}

{"id": "p_6f3bd2024533f50f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 132, "text": "且城非仓卒所拔，而粮少爲急，征西速救，得上策矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "357500f4f8d7ecf1d79f12839566a483724143c5f6eb28e8fe9f37783ae13e3b"}

{"id": "p_528cabf1089cb8a8", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 133, "text": "」泰每以一方有事，辄以虚声扰动天下，故希简白上事，驿書不过六百里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "72545cd342b01f2b0091fdb5ea783fed54d5ca0b11aefcf0f711da27f3940f60"}

{"id": "p_82a0e3e8b2235726", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 134, "text": "司马文王语荀顗曰：「玄伯沈勇能断，荷方伯之重，救將陷之城，而不求益兵，又希简上事，必能办贼故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "20a448069a6e28c39b39c22b7f2337a2a0718955ac3d74bcb75bf14794a7192c"}

{"id": "p_f67aa4d1efd952ed", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 135, "text": "後徵泰爲尚書右仆射，典選舉，加侍中光禄大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "9049d4c5963f7013f6b2ad21cad2a7adeef73aa47f6bcf7cd94b783d33c05ef5"}

{"id": "p_31be3626f9753890", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 136, "text": "以泰爲镇軍將軍，假节都督淮北諸軍事，诏徐州监軍已下受泰节度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "a4bdd001849bd0ae9538af870f4d389a110ed7caba8f62da762b0ff21ce11a2a"}

{"id": "p_6e15d45202f60923", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 137, "text": "峻退，軍還，转爲左仆射。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "8e2f464fc7c2de4175ab09f0eda87ddcabd67079cae957e624a0c3727092d2a2"}

{"id": "p_0612b1ffc975d1ed", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 138, "text": "諸葛诞作乱寿春，司马文王率六軍軍丘头，泰总署行台。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "cc052e2008a50ae9dabe2dd7ce22e89652c7dc43fef42ac97e220fd6e0abb493"}

{"id": "p_69ffb075537c3cc9", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 139, "text": "司马景王、文王皆與泰亲友，及沛國武陔亦與泰善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "65ab46c3b59f4dd1a3c31408d5d2689c6ed5de22fba55adfad96c66525a744f0"}

{"id": "p_ff43a59ef8126632", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 140, "text": "文王问陔曰：「玄伯何如其父司空也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "3f65608989735fab4e602b24d72fc05a2192c7cb2c4019e1a0b6996732ebdbf5"}

{"id": "p_7ad87ffb9c44625b", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 141, "text": "」陔曰：「通雅博暢，能以天下声教爲己任者，不如也；明统简至，立功立事，过之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "797f3797757542fcd483b2a13e7720b5c7ebc63a3146c4b16a42577c5e19ff83"}

{"id": "p_6be8c5a47d51367c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 142, "text": "」泰前後以功增邑二千六百户，赐子弟一人亭侯，二人關内侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "8d1c3d298255c539b3c315ffa23e693ea6f8f37bbebd33cdc10ea3934dc3e874"}

{"id": "p_21e61e935868ade7", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 143, "text": "咸熙中开建五等，以泰著勋前朝，改封温爲慎子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "3a3b775edef32584e7af0cde0c266989431713a3465c1dac2e670215256a9ce8"}

{"id": "p_4e4cdf10163f136c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 144, "text": "陳矫字季弼，广陵东阳人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "1c77f3d1b1208e433b95653e2113c01f8c27aa4e6e969f76008f6dd42da5d320"}

{"id": "p_94c826d563f811dc", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 145, "text": "避乱江东及东城，辭孫策、袁术之命，還本郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "571b4fcf90098e030fd4f99be7dce1489637ae7b501d1dbd16fe10a23e26e78f"}

{"id": "p_856414db7959cdfb", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 146, "text": "太守陳登请爲功曹，使矫詣许，謂曰：「许下论议，待吾不足；足下相爲观察，還以见诲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "56bad44735849aaa484cfee0c4e3bfb04bca9dd7ae02b192ebedf5248d095221"}

{"id": "p_1dbc577b6a3763a2", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」矫還曰：「聞遠近之论，颇謂明府骄而自矜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "fcf143e759d322bb0aa29f5f50e8fe236bc2b5a4085fec880a4da8a0b5f83a3f"}

{"id": "p_754c05c9922d2783", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」登曰：「夫闺门雍穆，有德有行，吾敬陳元方兄弟；渊清玉絜，有礼有法，吾敬华子鱼；清脩疾恶，有识有義，吾敬趙元达；博聞强记，奇逸卓荦，吾敬孔文舉；雄姿杰出，有王霸之略，吾敬劉玄德：所敬如此，何骄之有！", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "d34b0815f238e8336b9ddacc09adf87dd52c183eda41d4283213dfda827d2862"}

{"id": "p_689ac984221b92c0", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 149, "text": "」登雅意如此，而深敬友矫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "696233ae91b15b4319ae1662a3c1a13815fdc16544dfbe574146f79e9a4207d6"}

{"id": "p_65877d14890bcbf0", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 150, "text": "郡爲孫权所圍於匡奇，登令矫求救於太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "a054b6681615e600427a4f8a72c08e81b38ac8da017a08c69066fb1157de8da8"}

{"id": "p_47801b284c5587ad", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 151, "text": "矫說太祖曰：「鄙郡雖小，形便之國也，若蒙救援，使爲外籓，則吴人剉謀，徐方永安，武声遠震，仁爱滂流，未從之國，望风景附，崇德养威，此王业也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "89108d9a575870661710b2fe30e832a7edfd037b2d70eef5a12001513fb11c55"}

{"id": "p_905a2e0e27655425", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 152, "text": "矫辭曰：「本國倒县，本奔走告急，纵无申胥之效，敢忘弘演之義乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "f3da2c8cd59a5fbbe7cadff5729a2accaf006e71e8e8fd5e6f16b15a2dda94aa"}

{"id": "p_1d4d2ad394f19a3e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 153, "text": "吴軍既退，登多设间伏，勒兵追奔，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "60f1633430e0f2db4075870f488d0458b495703c5c2dabaa79322d8637b7871e"}

{"id": "p_bd5498e9c4a08f9d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 154, "text": "太祖辟矫爲司空掾属，除相令，征南長史，彭城、乐陵太守，魏郡西部都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "e4e9d06de994f0e63aae02b65bac23be496782d8664bcc9cd4d4017a774cd400"}

{"id": "p_c9d79ceeea55d602", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 155, "text": "曲周民父病，以牛祷，县結正弃市。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "1368d9491e86346b65f7cf43e73870c529bc08e5db33619da301d1d64e561f8a"}

{"id": "p_136408341d0a431d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 156, "text": "時系囚千數，至有历年，矫以爲周有三典之制，汉约三章之法，今惜轻重之理，而忽久系之患，可謂谬矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "0dc08e0a6fd3bf44b74db3421eb590865502d2cff8e855c475a9e493fbe8d496"}

{"id": "p_25c43c9f0060bed9", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 157, "text": "大軍东征，入爲丞相長史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "81217501863599420b4475b703cf4da6869aa9ed89eafbaeff16bdc5ad826355"}

{"id": "p_d551057574f0680b", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 158, "text": "軍還，复爲魏郡，转西曹属。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "838799b82157298e8d8dbc4c5a97ff9c0558874728a885ddee2669e723209a57"}

{"id": "p_2a1d974eb4dfe8f1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 159, "text": "行前未到鄴，太祖崩洛阳，羣臣拘常，以爲太子即位，当须诏命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "3335a36cbfb0ee771febe609f289061a494bb2bd3b6a4a1c9b9e0e273fed8061"}

{"id": "p_0cb73c309b438e23", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 160, "text": "矫曰：「王薨于外，天下惶惧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "49876d6cdbffd20cdca34459df74dfc5e6e3f5fece111744243a0e8a4a189ae9"}

{"id": "p_a34b19b5afe2661e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 161, "text": "太子宜割哀即位，以系遠近之望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "2a98067f7d373b81f60daee900c4c53cc2abdfa485cff82bc5eb77c14db77c98"}

{"id": "p_56b52b75e6215d19", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 162, "text": "且又爱子在侧，彼此生变，則社稷危矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "0bbc8588125ee9534778480ededa4d2c80ec4cd4f32e282bb51bd9ced6204f78"}

{"id": "p_cb991b1c5653c4a9", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」即具官备礼，一日皆办。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "aac6db4e27391f708ee96c39487da69da6e6f02570b583ff8b6b7dc6020f4539"}

{"id": "p_f8ebf94d4b2b2a15", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 164, "text": "明旦，以王後令，策太子即位，大赦荡然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "9745f5dc375cc932329146f30ff2ee8ec220372b349e4ece80bd271e301cd90b"}

{"id": "p_612dead7e1db1144", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 165, "text": "文帝曰：「陳季弼臨大节，明略过人，信一時之俊杰也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "207b34900f882ff881412788c89d59c7127c57ecee52e88ebdff04b8bb7602eb"}

{"id": "p_d8eb17b0539bc889", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」帝既践阼，转署吏部，封高陵亭侯，遷尚書令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "595f975203620474b1959c8661f58debf100f68e1d8b64e2f8e71c0e037e5640"}

{"id": "p_4ac5eb45479bdc2e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 167, "text": "明帝即位，进爵东鄉侯，邑六百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "791dbd7ac1818ccccec7dc67eb56be3bd7b3f124291a2733fd48b6359bdf6956"}

{"id": "p_d8a0e533cfe1fbde", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 168, "text": "车驾尝卒至尚書门，矫跪问帝曰：「陛下欲何之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "db9bc56728f93b3cd06cdde75b5dd97eefb7322e3f94e22a3f7495f46c5d37bd"}

{"id": "p_e64ab6a7a8c8372d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 169, "text": "」帝曰：「欲案行文書耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "f4aaec43a9cecbe784f2b955b03e1e3c0887ccaabab89f2c72844a41771de8df"}

{"id": "p_e86098ab98a31061", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 170, "text": "」矫曰：「此自臣职分，非陛下所宜臨也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "856b67ee6622e54742399d84c68f29e7f814e23127b1b423e0323817c5e14e05"}

{"id": "p_f7a2d85c410c67ef", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 171, "text": "若臣不称其职，則请就黜退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "58419fc379fbac1e6db4f1f261d8ea58c958eb1a87a2092d76f7a6326b09c56c"}

{"id": "p_e2603f12c6f4b1bd", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 172, "text": "加侍中光禄大夫，遷司徒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "e52971ba0cd2319bb771906cb35884b3c35b2071a4c1d67a37da8e1d0f4c2688"}

{"id": "p_4d2781e6cd7ae194", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 173, "text": "子本嗣，历位郡守、九卿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "70111ffdf0deb786f6999038f9f7f25d8ca256b051c3a58c7951883095c6224a"}

{"id": "p_c02fc0f9766ecce8", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 174, "text": "所在操纲领，舉大体，能使羣下自尽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "33fdc32c6ec49ae6418ce8d7eadd691e0e8d13dc7491b7fbfc160f186ca23de8"}

{"id": "p_1e3d1308ea62f8ec", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 175, "text": "有统御之才，不亲小事，不读法律而得廷尉之称，優於司马岐等，精练文理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "073e3cc5bf5e281bf078980c3c15a367f9a2a2d4816a1f55f34dd5b46e9c509e"}

{"id": "p_4ff8a1d7056e5e85", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 176, "text": "遷镇北將軍，假节都督河北諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "7723088f2ad7b2a7c7e2dfc9da196cd7f1960f6776aad4628ee1a4662dccdbba"}

{"id": "p_bc2482e1e1f26c72", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 177, "text": "本弟骞，咸熙中爲车骑將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "454cb1db89cdddcd7e1faadf8a5bf59d32383d9db22243bbc1090ebd074a50e7"}

{"id": "p_686049d337203a42", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 178, "text": "初，矫爲郡功曹，使过泰山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "89851aca966c4bb50eb405def28e6682f3706796a1811a6bb9e20054ec45a85b"}

{"id": "p_66f1e3655711fb8e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 179, "text": "泰山太守东郡薛悌異之，結爲亲友。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "0e92640bb803e91fadb4de3fbf558c85c9a2e7fdcc15d01ff1fb76b8f9cae7b2"}

{"id": "p_ce7bb40ccef24b96", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 180, "text": "戏謂矫曰：「以郡吏而交二千石，邻國君屈從陪臣游，不亦可乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "44569821d7e8f954a71280d908bb06fc120ba433db04ea91e44b182248a6dff1"}

{"id": "p_8a22ebdf5ae202fc", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 181, "text": "」悌後爲魏郡及尚書令，皆承代矫云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "d596eafb2dfaa87351a52cb846addaeabd30cd4e9443159e202b735b594b7b28"}

{"id": "p_c033909a163bb493", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 182, "text": "徐宣字宝堅，广陵海西人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "7fe29f1ab10c5bd3f8a81f5d575d7fff0fc5f278213769cf308930280bd6d196"}

{"id": "p_2bbca510f0c8b287", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 183, "text": "避乱江东，又辭孫策之命，還本郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "5948f30c1142ea567ccc887a9068949283bdb3484d11a4cafb78286ef5ff00d4"}

{"id": "p_8c67c22b6feb71c3", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 184, "text": "與陳矫并爲纲纪，二人齊名而私好不协，然俱见器於太守陳登，與登并心於太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "f993cf1ac7c499b92ac99f29b81e2cfb1611529d7450173b3ba64d8aae043f9d"}

{"id": "p_2079e54dfcc39fa9", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 185, "text": "海西、淮浦二县民作乱，都尉卫弥、令梁习夜奔宣家，密送免之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "a4342e544e3f408501174e0cde98de72469c1f7f7ac128395b158564babb8ef8"}

{"id": "p_3daeb8397fcb9b6f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 186, "text": "太祖遣督軍扈质來討贼，以兵少不进。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "6d573c95f4f0c91f859424829dc23f1c0d3c2a8c38b490b1ada0dfc2a1d4910c"}

{"id": "p_2efe66750c37d9fa", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 187, "text": "宣潜见责之，示以形勢，质乃进破贼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "77772dc051e217e61e649990e15c807bce16606bd39996bae17fbfe930a5572f"}

{"id": "p_0042102e9ac4a466", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 188, "text": "太祖辟爲司空掾属，除东缗、发干令，遷齊郡太守，入爲门下督，從到寿春。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "3154057b8201b387a59ff1d81c6caae082c0776edf414a90c68b67688e3331f7"}

{"id": "p_c741b629096c070b", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 189, "text": "會马超作乱，大軍西征，太祖见官属曰：「今当遠征，而此方未定，以爲後忧，宜得清公大德以镇统之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "a2eae79cf367d16b6af996f341c4ca12b23d96d7d36bbc6481815c9b7f325f36"}

{"id": "p_d051ec56c7b61b2e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 190, "text": "」乃以宣爲左护軍，留统諸軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "b65350f88e40ae0ee2bbe25b579d6800896620d6d36c71ec570bf454ca580351"}

{"id": "p_cb6ba4f285d4ffc0", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 191, "text": "還，爲丞相东曹掾，出爲魏郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "84fcd0077a71dccb078d128d933f4b93e6e848a8f206bcf6dcfdf16169d36631"}

{"id": "p_2ef701751d826aab", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 192, "text": "太祖崩洛阳，羣臣入殿中发哀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "9c125fbe666cb7fb58406650d4720508779452edfc26b51136126dc5145f188e"}

{"id": "p_aed3f4d9dc296b01", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 193, "text": "或言可易諸城守，用谯、沛人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "2389e8c58f185ceaa49357da695b4728f264e1f0f71e09f5219a84c2aec9addb"}

{"id": "p_dc622d4a86f23054", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 194, "text": "宣厉声曰：「今者遠近一统，人怀效节，何必谯、沛，而沮宿卫者心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "57da2c7baad66e036606f2e3f920187b347d041f45398a3eff8f33c5030d591b"}

{"id": "p_2e261450c1f7531e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 195, "text": "」文帝聞曰：「所謂社稷之臣也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "1a9af6cd1456016d2af7466677e5880d196dae7f81ca19794f525fc4613acf64"}

{"id": "p_e347890ea936f21d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 196, "text": "」帝既践阼，爲御史中丞，赐爵關内侯，徙城门校尉，旬月遷司隶校尉，转散骑常侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "f392817d8b6e18b298a1aff466327989a68d70444d621218c2768bfc95736d1e"}

{"id": "p_804939a6d6d61164", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 197, "text": "從至广陵，六軍乘舟，风浪暴起，帝船回倒，宣病在後，陵波而前，羣寮莫先至者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "1e1c1b9a493cafcd710d206e5832fbc173aa922cc4044f1895ca0c1d80885581"}

{"id": "p_4cf43b204f9d588f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 198, "text": "明帝即位，封津阳亭侯，邑二百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "6caa281029befc682086eb11217722428e9bdc47c15a00e8ae8fa9a3628a1177"}

{"id": "p_a0815c59fe1e1c7e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 199, "text": "帝遂以宣爲左仆射，後加侍中灌禄大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "f0209d022fae5dd6e202aea3c42ad0a96a3c5a79e9ad510167e5de95ceb2417b"}

{"id": "p_94cb8333a4e42e1a", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 200, "text": "诏曰：「吾省與仆射禾異？", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "2b7cf108109ed559fa059dc34a9c40ac440567daf877cacb17441d4e2d0f98ca"}

{"id": "p_e0d20b1cef19082c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 201, "text": "尚方令坐猥见考竟，宣上疏陳威刑大过，又諫作宫殿穷尽民力，帝皆手诏嘉納。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "d74f31be44e88fee418f457a1dd4a4bf8525888652213069388156ba4d225605"}

{"id": "p_5dc50b5d9d86b75b", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 202, "text": "宣曰：「七十有县车之礼，今已六十八，可以去矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "8bf21e1a7c4c7d9d29501f56e509bd7f370e5b7e0c2fb29e05e59e8a292f4189"}

{"id": "p_680fd44063291657", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 203, "text": "」乃固辭疾逊位，帝终不许。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "004f72d59b24bca10ea37326eb6d0bb0354457171d811c4ae31f556f01959c5c"}

{"id": "p_3111cfb44ba3cd5d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 204, "text": "薨，遺令布衣疏巾，敛以時服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "86beb144833f46ab77e4dc7e3cba4d6a4e38818a4de0bbabeb1d2f20cde06742"}

{"id": "p_50755f0126eced0f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 205, "text": "诏曰：「宣体履至实，直内方外，历在三朝，公亮正色，有讬孤寄命之节，可謂柱石臣也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "852eb09f5e19ba12c8e6dbe0cb88ee572c1ed13a3160e31f5fd868709a0af35b"}

{"id": "p_36f07fe00577a898", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 206, "text": "常欲倚以台辅，未及登之，惜乎大命不永！", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "e0206c296dc8178539dad269a09a42b5bd08764f03c05596262ed59c235cf922"}

{"id": "p_b2d3c1b31ea09fab", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 207, "text": "其追赠车骑將軍，葬如公礼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "01350b4bc2a5052346be52feff36cbda64c768fda484c0ea89715cd156b5b216"}

{"id": "p_c5355f683e16d2c6", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 208, "text": "卫臻字公振，陳留襄邑人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "c1e4175f1ee53870bca0db4b6695e01e6883ff4b6e714505409ffa3d7851b6ad"}

{"id": "p_4a92cafb26e45f51", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 209, "text": "父兹，有大节，不應三公之辟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "ecdeeee13e07234a742109c6e1bbc6cb442ac915691e578012c0a0e2d9eb052a"}

{"id": "p_daa5a3b2e0f55ca0", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 210, "text": "太祖之初至陳留，兹曰：「平天下者，必此人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "d7ffb633f01348486e3c8c3b3c90a7b3ba5031ec83b600bb3a4ae645e3599e67"}

{"id": "p_5275dc36da0e5338", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 211, "text": "」太祖亦異之，數詣兹议大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "24b7966dfd4d4cf8dc4ae2b9828805bad7690279271faaa5dee72275e9d5f239"}

{"id": "p_75dd638843b09db1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 212, "text": "從討董卓，戰于荥阳而卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "c42fd52450f59e0e1ab94cf2e0c06387f1b638c15784cfc1f2ce2da0523b2d7c"}

{"id": "p_a048283821ec1922", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 213, "text": "太祖每涉郡境，辄遣使祠焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "5512efc0b9d4482c5a7cebbcd6ca7541ed94770bc432ee7827df3c02d57f0f2f"}

{"id": "p_17d0d800f29a07d6", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 214, "text": "夏侯惇爲陳留太守，舉臻计吏，命妇出宴，臻以爲「末世之俗，非礼之正」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "2e6bec6dee315dedd58029146c31df00aea38c641046923abd1149a8ee27d784"}

{"id": "p_a78140659086b53f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 215, "text": "太祖令曰：「孤與卿君同共舉事，加钦令问。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "6ce9bb06a798361459050c8f62b39fbd899c6c1ed9357755502fcd334d578cd7"}

{"id": "p_0c110ef24c769d81", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 216, "text": "及得荀令君書，具亮忠诚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "289e6a4902655c9a62c3784c4d6e28698c323ee11ccb78cfb2c2c46b7939d8b5"}

{"id": "p_ae402601469b6682", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 217, "text": "」會奉诏命，聘贵人于魏，因表留臻参丞相軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "988f69e7bc5df5c045f8e189f1b44beb34cf1a5fbdb22fb145679cab532f8a27"}

{"id": "p_032c71773311b075", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 218, "text": "追录臻父旧勋，赐爵關内侯，转爲户曹掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "b6b5d02acc2cbb065fcc03d34fbe5f90fe6d5e724f91dca7d4a7bd37d2d3dbf8"}

{"id": "p_c5e08fc385d3f9c4", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 219, "text": "文帝即王位，爲散骑常侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "06c788be8a2224c8330c7f5235fcfaa5119191a7efa058aafc4a66f10447a09e"}

{"id": "p_58fa76ff9e0b826b", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 220, "text": "時羣臣并颂魏德，多抑损前朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "2d1e96664ad8d303794a147205b9cd623e167b650149d0a49096b5e95031d8e7"}

{"id": "p_52db955184f93535", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 221, "text": "臻獨明禅授之義，称扬汉美。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "d87eed42cd792c11a45e81e1d17e7eb8ba79aabc58c2be7a584c78db1a03fda9"}

{"id": "p_14e67fb5f74e7e8b", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 222, "text": "帝數目臻曰：「天下之珍，当與山阳共之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "efff4c2ab727281b81563fba4b7e2019f0fd5235d7e76b625f30f271f539e29f"}

{"id": "p_09c9882ac94a9c64", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 223, "text": "」遷尚書，转侍中吏部尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "89489f8d68ea771fd9da5bbdbaa30f66f50a799233b255b49f9de21234b071ae"}

{"id": "p_a8b56335099a375f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 224, "text": "帝幸广陵，行中领軍，從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "6a0aaa6a7af04298cc59746559bb38069d3421ac6841178b0ed6ae04f24b51af"}

{"id": "p_3185e90156b0d10d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 225, "text": "征軍大將軍曹休表得降贼辭，「孫权已在濡须口」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "a8885de99e5a27446bb8673a8070e0d4efda68018e69d17a90d7352bc9c803c4"}

{"id": "p_861743a12efc2778", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 226, "text": "臻曰：「权恃長江，未敢抗衡，此必畏怖伪辭耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "bcbaa9dca4df14f6a4a01f8feb465d6380df6608e302a649e1d7effd03f3e1df"}

{"id": "p_61f9dc3af4a6ec5c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 227, "text": "」考核降者，果守將诈所作也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "67b21de90140021356820005eb6dc705084a009c7242d443cad65d840e0699dc"}

{"id": "p_f082e22f95a93b07", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 228, "text": "明帝即位，进封康鄉侯，後转爲右仆射，典選舉，如前加侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "33b6192227382a2291af87a7b4d26eb5bc5d1ed2b81af8242ab13a71ddcdce66"}

{"id": "p_cdca0eb0ce9c9b10", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 229, "text": "中护軍蒋济遺臻書曰：「汉祖遇亡虏爲上將，周武拔渔父爲太师；布衣厮养，可登王公，何必守文，试而後用？", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "435ee44be2e3e4073535b7d80bd227929574b67e19b6bee78533df6890a66473"}

{"id": "p_3ffa8acde836c0b6", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 230, "text": "」臻答曰：「古人遺智慧而任度量，须考绩而加黜陟；今子同牧野於成、康，喻断蛇於文、景，好不经之舉，开拔奇之津，將使天下驰骋而起矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "26c1f549c418d938d9e4c8a99aa9ba0f2f8cf326b9516afe048993bda5708394"}

{"id": "p_c58dc503fed70d13", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 231, "text": "」諸葛亮寇天水，臻奏：「宜遣奇兵入散關，绝其粮道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "ff50ffeddfd844db8acbee21c8ba0520664197daa03d74ccc0511f22f8145290"}

{"id": "p_91bba568772700d7", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 232, "text": "」乃以臻爲征蜀將軍，假节督諸軍事，到長安，亮退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "ac3b935b7a2c14378fd579ee19b6cfd04ef4cca3e2b1463a68b3d7bfb9639ef9"}

{"id": "p_61982ec5b6a3a8ba", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 233, "text": "是時，帝方隆意於殿舍，臻數切諫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "f725052ca80401f69e28a0dedcc9f70eb405acf71d69f6211b070955a022843e"}

{"id": "p_035ccf5747334ab1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 234, "text": "及殿中监擅收兰台令史，臻奏案之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "84406e65614dc7ba2defba07b974a3a8ccfe2aad37d99e125ab0fb5e9a264d5c"}

{"id": "p_bce3c348c00ac9a4", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 235, "text": "诏曰：「殿舍不成，吾所留心，卿推之何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "0b7a04463e49b20862cdf574689ba4a2a7f60067085a3ae12a67ed0079938cbd"}

{"id": "p_ae7d72cdd419b184", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 236, "text": "」臻上疏曰：「古制侵官之法，非恶其勤事也，诚以所益者小，所堕者大也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "7f643be8c2ffa5049b425ce6fbce46eded66dcad521280b61a90919a90373b88"}

{"id": "p_6b47e6f7127fc552", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 237, "text": "臣每察校事，類皆如此，惧羣司將遂越职，以至陵迟矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "c67d96a579d3a0466bd8b1fad77f2f417821deb589ab87c020226dc048805017"}

{"id": "p_96f811ce743e5a6d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 238, "text": "」亮又出斜谷；征南上：「硃然等軍已过荆城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "6d4d4b95f37d0c61c283331f2391a31168eb60b745c4cf0943271308e181b98f"}

{"id": "p_0e1cbb564166ea01", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 239, "text": "」臻曰：「然，吴之骁將，必下從权，且爲勢以缀征南耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "3e03bc5b96501e28a239ace269ac15193e2a346c87cbf3cafda541e46ed01348"}

{"id": "p_556c994492f1ad19", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 240, "text": "」权果召然入居巢，进攻合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "c025b6d36bb8fd6ef2863b75f499eb540383f48a479df5b5afa47e1c782536bd"}

{"id": "p_c993fed42add0d6e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 241, "text": "帝欲自东征，臻曰：「权外示應亮，内实观望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "f7288674085403faa1827257095fbc49ab7f1d407f3d766612ef879768629f94"}

{"id": "p_a58d62ff6ed29f1f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 242, "text": "车驾可无亲征，以省六軍之费。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "f101b4eb5f61cf7f85b4ee8e785a5ec41554de573946e228ccac304e6b4d198c"}

{"id": "p_9eda1c2efde8e967", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 243, "text": "幽州刺史毌丘俭上疏曰：「陛下即位已來，未有可書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "a8e77afa9e971598db5de58af4fa0efb3c7b18cd76460f74c7d1837f0c1257b7"}

{"id": "p_fed27bcb75eb7071", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 244, "text": "吴、蜀恃险，未可卒平，聊可以此方无用之士克定辽东。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "c00098b1fbc3621dfd90bd73ab3425a89c9861652171a90a6b2f2359ad69317b"}

{"id": "p_46670db69542928c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 245, "text": "」臻曰：「俭所陳皆戰國细术，非王者之事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "0e0a1c15f81174900188498cf5f6a169c429bf1f483d2b17637f3f5c0dd55fd1"}

{"id": "p_3aa37e2cfcc3bfce", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 246, "text": "吴频岁称兵，寇乱边境，而犹案甲养士，未果寻致討者，诚以百姓疲劳故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "b786cf9b4d1e19d1f65da2b0691e1a456386e1c55c46d6a44c653221e3b38d63"}

{"id": "p_db563ae72185c3d8", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 247, "text": "且渊生長海表，相承三世，外抚戎夷，内脩戰射，而俭欲以偏軍長驱，朝至夕卷，知其妄矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "664e2d22486958e67df829354d6c5de738743cd72c74e516a9bc57c3dc14bb47"}

{"id": "p_5bcddf30acdafdfb", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 248, "text": "正始中，进爵長垣侯，邑千户，封一子列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "2e4b9fa8000cd3ef13f94a4098ef6c1d435afecabc9464226c3fdd2ad86e30e3"}

{"id": "p_c94d7b07b5c697cd", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 249, "text": "初，太祖久不立太子，而方奇贵臨菑侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "cc5826b4e75b3010f59149e0ba4c49330423dc9973d6f37ae47fbfaf6df77563"}

{"id": "p_042963fb434de875", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 250, "text": "丁儀等爲之羽翼，劝臻自結，臻以大義拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "0ee41c1de33e38f30be09cb53b7833b84e57cc524fae1238d11346416b9c4c34"}

{"id": "p_93669839c883994c", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 251, "text": "及文帝即位，东海王霖有寵，帝问臻：「平原侯何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "5e60e6783cce99157c514a4eacdca772fa80bb3c6fc09e0139716db7b8e58c51"}

{"id": "p_71292a2e39d76f94", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 252, "text": "曹爽辅政，使夏侯玄宣指，欲引臻入守尚書令，及爲弟求婚，皆不许。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "705ed65da86140d3710547d1084e4210f0b50c5172a0401ef0bd83d1e9c5843d"}

{"id": "p_afd0d04a06f10de5", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 253, "text": "诏曰：「昔干木偃息，義压强秦；留侯颐神，不忘楚事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "2f8275465e0f0b5910c3b345f303d081719e6ccbe39555d7c486cc66e2c75ce9"}

{"id": "p_d3a3a4ad7e91ec91", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 254, "text": "」赐宅一区，位特进，秩如三司。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "68d49d0d2cfa5239417599e9368b5f4fb8594adb35c322751340da9121743f41"}

{"id": "p_9b18a19e4445eb6e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 255, "text": "薨，追赠太尉，谥曰敬侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "00850841e4b01f99fd4f47b7f02f7fa554c18e2481c0c90824f5cb2762050e93"}

{"id": "p_eb400626fb49b7ec", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 256, "text": "子烈嗣，咸熙中爲光禄勋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "45004deac1b0ad9426cb6149b1921d4c97511c4d3a6fba00b9bb6114ec271a21"}

{"id": "p_7629b6c8c6d611f6", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 257, "text": "盧毓字子家，涿郡涿人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "4919c9d665e4091a9c59f3977eac697c31a8c14ae7cd3118806000424b916180"}

{"id": "p_ffc549a4882511c5", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 258, "text": "毓十岁而孤，遇本州乱，二兄死難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "f673c3bd037b0f98b4d03a10ad01201b8745d0aa09d0aef95a8f7bd11aa0ac1e"}

{"id": "p_077e2f78d375d81e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 259, "text": "当袁紹、公孫瓚交兵，幽冀饥荒，养寡嫂孤兄子，以学行见称。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "e289f98e0a0e613f4e9dc3881002727b8cebd7c99101df5582ce8416ae15f382"}

{"id": "p_1e4bc897e6781a45", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 260, "text": "文帝爲五官將，召毓署门下贼曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "9e0d06cad1d796f3f9ab2edd905e43dbca32e263d7e0c35cb947ef1da633a7d6"}

{"id": "p_c39a9b1768bba06d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 261, "text": "時天下草创，多逋逃，故重士亡法，罪及妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "8bc3c3326d1e15b3eb5c069a4490f9a78d9e4be30fef6b777e46b593da9ccc06"}

{"id": "p_e45a10cd12248177", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 262, "text": "亡士妻白等，始適夫家數日，未與夫相见，大理奏弃巿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "cb5b1dfb796577be3ae493ae22a081faff7e1360fa49f37de3adee735cae5a83"}

{"id": "p_5065efd45b4a03e7", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 263, "text": "又引经典有意，使孤叹息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "740cb3ee8eaa64d7e2f7c2d2db264ef06ff4c14949381a01f1c6784c9f28aca2"}

{"id": "p_d8be2ede15e35537", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 264, "text": "」由是爲丞相法曹议令史，转西曹议令史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "23b105170ccf5fceea53e5201d6cde9329b853fbaea37afa657cba142bbf1e1c"}

{"id": "p_5d533e61d031204e", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 265, "text": "文帝践阼，徙黄门侍郎，出爲济阴相，梁、谯二郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "ea1ca20ea5e663ffc9d30f0fb03091ece39a1c7bc1a21f78ae716f7e3e83aa22"}

{"id": "p_e2bc0f6cbe269ce1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 266, "text": "帝以谯旧鄉，故大徙民充之，以爲屯田。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "643403649ce24858765f324cab4c7155182c7e022d88f4bc3aab75971e337584"}

{"id": "p_ece9efa62841cc37", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 267, "text": "而谯土地墝瘠，百姓穷困，毓愍之，上表徙民於梁國就沃衍，失帝意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "5f24ae52a37c1a5568ed0cdf6a9a4e115e18fc21c3c1f5e3ff9aa336eed3da19"}

{"id": "p_7847ed543651e480", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 268, "text": "雖听毓所表，心犹恨之，遂左遷毓，使將徙民爲睢阳典农校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "04b58afc05096e3ceaecab5987d53ca7ed9e92021ee25ee57998be50fa6a7734"}

{"id": "p_a93dc22ece5d075d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 269, "text": "毓心在利民，躬自臨视，择居美田，百姓賴之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "fc646fd0dfd79085f6e88d93493c58baed83ba928d94ba612fb5dde39d2d3524"}

{"id": "p_54fdf3c4c59b3c71", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 270, "text": "遷安平、广平太守，所在有惠化。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "6b2e1a78e7e001581085dedbf83f947a12f8d8ded022ae14e66bfc61c697a07f"}

{"id": "p_9c67d9b24f7b934a", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 271, "text": "先是，散骑常侍劉劭受诏定律，未就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "bcad9799bc065890fddcce81f66aebc19fd6ab94607041c503d7d84f634d1267"}

{"id": "p_96abdeb76ea5f6a5", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 272, "text": "毓上论古今科律之意，以爲法宜一正，不宜有两端，使奸吏得容情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "b57cd1f0497f8e22a9bb077b9d5acfdb32e37417ea0674cbe125dfa0d38acceb"}

{"id": "p_b471add275cd2eac", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 273, "text": "及侍中高堂隆數以宫室事切諫，帝不悦，毓进曰：「臣聞君明則臣直，古之圣王恐不聞其过，故有敢諫之鼓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "e5c7957aba73a4a39497f74987602eb058e5dfac2586da1ee09e611e7ee9f966"}

{"id": "p_415b9bae01630966", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 274, "text": "近臣尽規，此乃臣等所以不及隆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "bd7b8a0c380e4ee8a08c62d41390229ba414597d88219dbc905e027f5636e2b4"}

{"id": "p_2aa42758a558d273", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 275, "text": "隆諸生，名爲狂直，陛下宜容之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "505115208b999858e62f51b9b694d0aab68f7735ec11a76dd0c0d250bcc9267a"}

{"id": "p_1cde69a8563bedc6", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 276, "text": "诏曰：「官人秩才，圣帝所難，必须良佐，进可替否。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "4e2f990f25bf1cdd1b7c5afaed9c6bffc8f5c12ca288f8a6e1b9d4a2c95f98f4"}

{"id": "p_c1282f5c352a8a59", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 277, "text": "侍中毓禀性贞固，心平体正，可謂明试有功，不懈于位者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "dec2e3b02f7fa3998b87992fb751046bddb60b93ddae73ef8b677a55dfec8978"}

{"id": "p_fd76b909aa5b690a", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 278, "text": "」使毓自選代，曰：「得如卿者乃可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "73c29988ed689772f32d3a379c2cc753951cce0e26958d9dffd765102bacc3a5"}

{"id": "p_657c584f1ae0b357", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 279, "text": "」毓舉常侍郑冲，帝曰：「文和，吾自知之，更舉吾所未聞者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "27148603e10bf6eec91887c72bb6c3df6d51992f6f38c8df8fb4c3686a18ad69"}

{"id": "p_9a8f1ade4ee491fa", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 280, "text": "」乃舉阮武、孫邕，帝於是用邕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "79cbf521b7e3b3ef1749e900e22eaa5486f41f79c1827acb81b536824b565d01"}

{"id": "p_15b5232338fc7f42", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 281, "text": "前此諸葛诞、邓飏等驰名誉，有四（窗）八达之诮，帝疾之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "b765b8afbfa2233f0debb21387dfd265825369540c616d125c3a8cbccb7a31ef"}

{"id": "p_683e0fde797ddfad", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 282, "text": "時舉中書郎，诏曰：「得其人與否，在卢生耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "12a0b702eee1bd039c51ff905e9fa9ba7a8c68184b8ce9b08610989cc4a22b11"}

{"id": "p_89b599bb92f53427", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 283, "text": "選舉莫取有名，名如画地作饼，不可啖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "a4851bc57abe7844023879844419c772c846722212037fcb4fecc0cbdab735b7"}

{"id": "p_255075aceb7857c5", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 284, "text": "帝納其言，即诏作考课法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "9d44ecfce892e0124a4f40a8b2478725d55d840945a3c3dc4b0ebb1d1a17ddb7"}

{"id": "p_0a6b971de46168e9", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 285, "text": "會司徒缺，毓舉处士管宁，帝不能用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "68c0169a74104f94f934dbb91a52e71f65119a25bfd2d87a3bdbf02a0c2fb471"}

{"id": "p_edd958da31169cee", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 286, "text": "更问其次，毓对曰：「敦笃至行，則太中大夫韩暨；亮直清方，則司隶校尉崔林；贞固纯粹，則太常常林。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "85d89df7f5532ee753455336816f6a67ed9c21b1a6f1dfd21c9b2f066ea380e6"}

{"id": "p_5dfe82c9f683dab4", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 287, "text": "毓於人及選舉，先舉性行，而後言才。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "10fa152c716e7bfa9e26c33f70fe23e3edf7152a5c0eed02dbd9bc8826169320"}

{"id": "p_ec2a2ce984ce9c0d", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 288, "text": "黄门李丰尝以问毓，毓曰：「才所以爲善也，故大才成大善，小才成小善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "dd96d1f836381fde2b346461b8d100425b06f3d207d19344a5c0c448924cb5a1"}

{"id": "p_04fe6a034a1ce35f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 289, "text": "今称之有才而不能爲善，是才不中器也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "32034d41b2f0bfb8e7d5eab3fb48531607e48d9031c29a214d3d2a7459224c83"}

{"id": "p_0ba31c80f738559f", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 290, "text": "時曹爽秉权，將树其黨，徙毓仆射，以侍中何晏代毓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "52fc975c248e3c8b0ed4cd31c15aa9c4d66bf1b036ecada5a9262f09de0996fd"}

{"id": "p_eef87ab41c10e3e1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 291, "text": "顷之，出毓爲廷尉，司隶毕轨又枉奏免官，众论多讼之，乃以毓爲光禄勋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "62d612f5e22a876b3751763d521fff36e713f04016d88ca1d7f9bfc30a63fc9f"}

{"id": "p_7ee402795e37ab54", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 292, "text": "爽等见收，太傅司马宣王使毓行司隶校尉，治其狱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "c5ec202dba860043ad7596f53f197c38c25d21ca91b1689933e78a611c6d9511"}

{"id": "p_feb3f7b011a4bd64", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 293, "text": "复爲吏部尚書，加奉车都尉，封高乐亭侯，转爲仆射，故典選舉，加光禄大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "a0d59029c09e5954ecc6b8108f54cd26986c35b3755ba5485836556db0aca58d"}

{"id": "p_4e1671af3d5511ce", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 294, "text": "高贵鄉公即位，进封大梁鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "98947e69f350cd198823e7ea247e0134f4e83061b720738382f992c944dca4bd"}

{"id": "p_f327f90fe2022e75", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 295, "text": "毌丘俭作乱，大將軍司马景王出征，毓纲纪後事，加侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "bf33f478606005b0cc1dfed11a01d86b3378f5d50183e37f24973f2326f33cbb"}

{"id": "p_86a0deb57392ae2b", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 296, "text": "遷爲司空，固推骠骑將軍王昶、光禄大夫王观、司隶校尉王祥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "09c70b18c72bbf5e6ff3f288ebae481559410eca92a997d3010bb156d681d5f0"}

{"id": "p_68bcc04a9fcbecdd", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 297, "text": "诏使使者即授印绶，进爵封容城侯，邑二千三百户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "e8c0a6eff615493bf7be801732d4c86a8e47136d9666e2774b37f17595acc97b"}

{"id": "p_35c697bafeac0d86", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 298, "text": "毓子钦、珽，咸熙中钦爲尚書，珽泰山太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "29a16b26bc66bde95d82b287014361e8cf331b3212301158151be84aca841bd4"}

{"id": "p_c823940d1ce594c1", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 299, "text": "评曰：桓階识睹成敗，才周当世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "62c30d23ad316b827f39a6613d26f7f39cb6a62a797d058ba0104aba51825e4d"}

{"id": "p_40eb98a42fd2df34", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 300, "text": "陳羣动仗名義，有清流雅望；泰弘济简至，允克堂构矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "daeaa87d3fa83abec67a3e699bdd23d4c380b2df3bf66f7c101e2479cd26669b"}

{"id": "p_b92407fc2d791e39", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 301, "text": "魏世事统台阁，重内轻外，故八座尚書，即古六卿之任也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "a7dc6d347a13fb72ab78b2f67708628d21e67a28b752675fc1970e424758267e"}

{"id": "p_3be252bc77d9d4ab", "source_id": "src_ab3038c907a85961", "ordinal": 302, "text": "陳、徐、卫、卢，久居斯位，矫、宣剛断骨鲠，臻、毓規鉴清理，咸不忝厥职云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "83ba3aa38865637424e1a2be9084843e32af3536c533e0b9724f8be22d982c1c"}

{"id": "p_2ddd646f9eb3e642", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_d1988b1a8fb5edca", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 1, "text": "和洽字陽士，汝南西平人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "f8de2cc36601d6e5041475a059aaab783506d5eda9e3907bd9cdc9c1b92fcec9"}

{"id": "p_0b1f57004a979595", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 2, "text": "舉孝廉，大將軍辟，皆不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "2d858427a8728833958d6d9a1ddf8ebba9c5404ffae4b1f0c6b39ec496b6ba91"}

{"id": "p_07799e080fc1bec0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 3, "text": "袁紹在冀州，遣使迎汝南士大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "83dc62c1bdb586b78ef98cc2ca7740d056c5f7ff10ebe38d8683846fca2ddc13"}

{"id": "p_13296bcbd3801190", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 4, "text": "洽獨以「冀州土平民彊，英桀所利，四戰之地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "a058de679d62576a918314e6ecc32b1b7b542f497aa780bf7d857f23fd49bbc7"}

{"id": "p_f6efb8e4a2b11b5a", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 5, "text": "本初乘資，雖能彊大，然雄豪方起，全未可必也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "824179deee8973d5111cc4bf80a399fc31a7055891ff8e07a16750a3d7c9d3d0"}

{"id": "p_777f6b7ef85c25b9", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 6, "text": "荊州劉表無他遠志，愛人樂士，土地險阻，山夷民弱，易依倚也」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "9aed3aa27f9a2583c369111ca899ff10d6c0791921cb221b425dcf2ade374ec8"}

{"id": "p_a7fc5eae930d949c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 7, "text": "遂與親舊俱南從表，表以上客待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "087b7c4bf3afe507f17b8a68ffe1fd3bf46c5763f2a644c838f2bd875a1cd8ee"}

{"id": "p_c04eb04c7424a5d2", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 8, "text": "洽曰：「所以不從本初，辟爭地也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "e66357bfaa71c217b389345546f8a75e52f7e019d7a397d88ec90e05f8f06048"}

{"id": "p_0d697dd70652cc9d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 9, "text": "昏世之主，不可黷近，久而阽危，必有讒慝閒其中者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "3dbc90f710be3a6319341ed6cfd4f16221d1148191c410c0b4bf28310308a33f"}

{"id": "p_c1622adb761f877c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 10, "text": "太祖定荊州，辟爲丞相掾屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "b9d901979a4a721a775154831d88b69d33d23c392f3248c37327ef781e7769cb"}

{"id": "p_da6646840fd40e32", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 11, "text": "時毛玠、崔琰並以忠清幹事，其選用先尚儉節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "27d4d0f69b5dc1641d7005a974f4a3d0ca419cd5a91f5860f8a7b751f9b6f334"}

{"id": "p_0ff7973c5115cf8b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 12, "text": "洽言曰：「天下大器，在位與人，不可以一節也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "0086e01eeed218521b8866b1df66636cec68d91825080ddafd1f5912bf66bdfa"}

{"id": "p_e2166ebfb61e2c23", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 13, "text": "儉素過中，自以處身則可，以此節格物，所失或多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "82e138d334a00aea1d813a7793186f25441b7b573237ddeeb9387fdd08a89adb"}

{"id": "p_d50567ec791e3c73", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 14, "text": "今朝廷之議，吏有著新衣、乘好車者，謂之不清；長吏過營，形容不飾，衣裘敝壞者，謂之廉潔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "07e5e98a1c7b036af8e9faa9f19cbaa014cb2f7642501260c690b6969fabbc92"}

{"id": "p_0305b9f6eab65bf6", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 15, "text": "至令士大夫故汙辱其衣，藏其輿服；朝府大吏，或自挈壺餐以入官寺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "74e5c50d29d02230e2f0f40c7e0218d4a0986718e5a0e1eded2896ce31bc3d39"}

{"id": "p_9a449d8d7303a8d4", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 16, "text": "夫立敎觀俗，貴處中庸，爲可繼也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "47db5761fbf5e4e87097f4b317ee2ade1bfd38b9d3136ac743772dcae8b0999c"}

{"id": "p_4e23d35a1a9db386", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 17, "text": "今崇一概難堪之行以檢殊塗，勉而爲之，必有疲瘁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "3a0a2db7798940eddc88fe8c09c0d1850e48078bb076c71a083c1ea57f306cd4"}

{"id": "p_c59b87cbd7c60566", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 18, "text": "古之大敎，務在通人情而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "da165f57bf88dfa616613c3180a4a2daa6de65060c7f63b5ce4269931e3fbd9a"}

{"id": "p_6b8eba9b3776887b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 19, "text": "凡激詭之行，則容隱僞矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "ef156f5b4929217cb92dbf8b2e1bfc2661fa176d6fe5eb77a9b1522ac0d782d6"}

{"id": "p_0f4daed34997d69d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 20, "text": "魏國既建，爲侍中，後有白毛玠謗毀太祖，太祖見近臣，怒甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "3b71c888f1db5083c471d69017785a5477155f22ad02cacc9a5f2080930e23ee"}

{"id": "p_519f3ac1036f61e4", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 21, "text": "洽陳玠素行有本，求案實其事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "6edcfd6e83c04945dd368ce56768711db32f988031bad37b183902d1bd465770"}

{"id": "p_558947685f8e62a5", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 22, "text": "罷朝，太祖令曰：「今言事者白玠不但謗吾也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "2d649d74952bdd4b7ea7cd278986ffa6b17ba55a69f8cdcb201ffa8196d760cb"}

{"id": "p_3378a1887a31fb2b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 23, "text": "此損君臣恩義，妄爲死友怨歎，殆不可忍也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "2d33f8e84aec360984af1112b2341e6c0ea312108f87c9a51c0516457bb03d9c"}

{"id": "p_5453d2c28a87a54f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 24, "text": "昔蕭、曹與高祖並起微賤，致功立勳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "5bfee388cd15390df05c3fb48d3edb14a02bd8b7fc3dcb384d619c447ea60215"}

{"id": "p_de49fbdb03df462d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 25, "text": "高祖每在屈笮，二相恭順，臣道益彰，所以祚及後世也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "1844c0276d5c1049f118cdf4587111ed1eb693c36e92b992a673baa54189c63c"}

{"id": "p_058d071e035a4cf9", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 26, "text": "和侍中比求實之，所以不聽，欲重參之耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "805e3df762090ff1decbd4832507a738fa607b2b1f0576d35b1e2bcd3363f02a"}

{"id": "p_be6d2b9405178d3d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」洽對曰：「如言事者言，玠罪過深重，非天地所覆載。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "1023812f4c08a661c0a241d554d458449a4d8dac1a78247070a39d99b35b2eb0"}

{"id": "p_4858a1b8bda2a0ed", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 28, "text": "臣非敢曲理玠以枉大倫也，以玠出羣吏之中，特見拔擢，顯在首職，歷年荷寵，剛直忠公，爲衆所憚，不宜有此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "daba49d43be791f351b18152d91842d908744d06b0f34573d76ed7c852f7556c"}

{"id": "p_db4268e5d01d7b33", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 29, "text": "然人情難保，要宜考覈，兩驗其實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "007b4c9835e99fc6027ab17b23cc990f596a386354388aec2f7dd0259025e263"}

{"id": "p_9732cb04b1ff6ee7", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 30, "text": "今聖恩垂含垢之仁，不忍致之于理，更使曲直之分不明，疑自近始。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "cbe882785ba47acc074ed9271a5b2f23aebe681ba127aac59a6875d844eb81f2"}

{"id": "p_8a8592795cadeab2", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」太祖曰：「所以不考，欲兩全玠及言事者耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "677ed69603a0bcfda6aabc09de22aa09a15841fc2b0dc60dc4a39906c2f35f6b"}

{"id": "p_96d3c71edc4abc99", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」洽對曰：「玠信有謗上之言，當肆之巿朝；若玠無此，言事者加誣大臣以誤主聽；二者不加檢覈，臣竊不安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "a63283924e5ad5d7dd557c973c02922a31c78426bf5cc5441f7a002cdb12074f"}

{"id": "p_d50b97199b11795f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」太祖曰：「方有軍事，安可受人言便考之邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "4af81a813a6be86c36f237794aeabc0cc34adc806765521a3f1ecd5e9d98637a"}

{"id": "p_34f8fd501c8c7147", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 34, "text": "狐射姑刺陽處父於朝，此爲君之誡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "81745dbed0aae471f04ecc9070b0bc216c437751898b16e94d30ff2937927df2"}

{"id": "p_71ccf2328451ed27", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 35, "text": "太祖克張魯，洽陳便宜以時拔軍徙民，可省置守之費。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "391ad2db33ac6c7eb1e7835bf5e6fa28e71ad2610741248240b71085a4db7e75"}

{"id": "p_0fa8ed146ba9512b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 36, "text": "太祖未納，其後竟徙民棄漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "d8ca204f3ddd8bd1d8f67d0256cc64e4d029536dca0602b75da86b73512b7668"}

{"id": "p_57efff962b28a9d0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 37, "text": "文帝踐阼，爲光祿勳，封安城亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "30266577282dec94c7f775c4fc62c8547044f1cd8a5f5cd20f52ab292403a60e"}

{"id": "p_61bb6edeab99e0fe", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 38, "text": "明帝即位，進封西陵鄉侯，邑二百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "6320517aa1edeecaa0343870a7db628641904a2c6a94e33878cb48aa96ac5d29"}

{"id": "p_3b58e6f742528183", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 39, "text": "太和中，散騎常侍高堂隆奏：「時風不至，而有休廢之氣，必有司不勤職事以失天常也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "c69fce6662116b0c49fa309a20e50c303abe4954f649d84c49c256e3145ecbf7"}

{"id": "p_cf57b58c2d10a945", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」詔書謙虛引咎，博諮異同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "eea8205d5bfe7550607ab3cd16b7a793410906cc6305a270716ccf3cec44b9f0"}

{"id": "p_3a9f80d1c61c4bf2", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 41, "text": "洽以爲「民稀耕少，浮食者多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "0286365108a7f8a367a03f730f50ae38c46ac44a56cab6779b8e570f67231b3a"}

{"id": "p_370a59ab91f893b9", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 42, "text": "國以民爲本，民以穀爲命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "8d6b1cec8ecdff45cb538d4133227e9b4c6380a5f8b16925c5ad6a070e38f379"}

{"id": "p_83c08a9d88d2c591", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 43, "text": "故費一時之農，則失育命之本。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "b1f5e03762ac8f146aac120bd0c8b56ff724769ad82784db7df88bf9ef2ccb84"}

{"id": "p_12776f2b19065551", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 44, "text": "是以先王務蠲煩費，以專耕農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "7b2afc6b0363ebdb4ca939e8bdf90b085f5b4d68c053851886685b0cdf9ddc73"}

{"id": "p_47fae3f2858deccc", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 45, "text": "自春夏以來，民窮於役，農業有廢，百姓囂然，時風不至，未必不由此也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "a4f7c1edde579f7df07cf9c034b6fd427d4fa11a94d162d8182518a689f8ba6b"}

{"id": "p_a6142607f5c89cb6", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 46, "text": "太祖建立洪業，奉師徒之費，供軍賞之用，吏士豐於資食，倉府衍於穀帛，由不飾無用之宮，絕浮華之費，方今之要，固在息省勞煩之役，損除他餘之務，以爲軍戎之儲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "3e5665625d78d824024dbad2adba8de0afed5d1eaf8896e7ebf29dbc031499d3"}

{"id": "p_2b8f967ddc518b5a", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 47, "text": "料賊虛實，蓄士養衆，算廟勝之策，明攻取之謀，詳詢衆庶以求厥中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "4ce27fe90f1dbb94e042fd02377ac34bcf5f4af06f66efd6b7f6e2d5561ecea5"}

{"id": "p_571df946910dfbd8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 48, "text": "若謀不素定，輕弱小敵，軍人數舉，舉而無庸，所謂『悅武無震』，古人之誡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "996f400d85d0d339c5870931e588a767d631059cedc7ffe3ffa420bdef96950f"}

{"id": "p_e95503a50110bd53", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 49, "text": "轉爲太常，清貧守約，至賣田宅以自給。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "55b59231415e1037f405ffadaf52920eacdae411219de1ec9abf8aca1f264b6b"}

{"id": "p_56883efe921f1eb1", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 50, "text": "弟，才爽開濟，官至廷尉、吏部尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "d1c17161fefd3a8f468488d0c37cdb3112966a12a257ce4fbe7e42135395a4e8"}

{"id": "p_65b34976b6b0a70c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 51, "text": "洽同郡許混者，許劭子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "270113baa034c71825013142c95e17e220b66ef43d7fd0e4eab4cb78363dbbe1"}

{"id": "p_f785f22c6e1aaf59", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 52, "text": "清醇有鑒識，明帝時爲尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "0bed0adde26e7f767e64e214d73ce2d93f175e18643bb8de0e60f9879f98f2eb"}

{"id": "p_666d1dae07047695", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 53, "text": "常林字伯槐，河內溫人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "5c6db7de3fb79cdcfd12f5bde57592327caeffa92045dfd53c3ba0e135c7b09e"}

{"id": "p_206bb8733fe155f0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 54, "text": "年七歲，有父黨造門，問林：「伯先在否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "9edccdca60df5b950136270baeb0e571f02f28473a347ea1d4cc31eafee4d4f6"}

{"id": "p_9acebff66e373865", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」林曰：「雖當下客，臨子字父，何拜之有？", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "764d7db6e1ea858145635278276da1bfb8f006be6e048746a0b88a505d3678a6"}

{"id": "p_13b32cc1b2f19127", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 56, "text": "太守王匡起兵討董卓，遣諸生於屬縣微伺吏民罪負，便收之，考責錢穀贖罪，稽遲則夷滅宗族，以崇威嚴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "cad6835690800471211de095d456546fb1902c4fce3f9e7944a2fa66c94a35ae"}

{"id": "p_3a29f18372fab509", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 57, "text": "林叔父撾客，爲諸生所白，匡怒收治。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "71f2e28aa00f10f1064a38cbb91e04036dfa2abc5474669f69a7451f7c2da9ed"}

{"id": "p_d03fc3854e13ee59", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 58, "text": "舉宗惶怖，不知所責多少，懼繫者不救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "d8d2d8d60f009346671f6488a9b37e4379d80aa628c7ca8e07a995d5bd1500aa"}

{"id": "p_925c6834fe0392c8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 59, "text": "林往見匡同縣胡母彪曰：「王府君以文武高才，臨吾鄙郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "cf12354b60020b11f5f6178640c27f8907881ca369395b65455318802f2f00cf"}

{"id": "p_1e2d8b3a06a1c434", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 60, "text": "鄙郡表裏山河，土廣民殷，又多賢能，惟所擇用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "397e268bf1e8041bb793e14f96ce1e219c6fca9a1365c8f939c9cbb61d13156f"}

{"id": "p_cbfbbcd1eea6fdbb", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 61, "text": "今主上幼沖，賊臣虎據，華夏震慄，雄才奮用之秋也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "86b98008aca8132a146fd9ae782b964e3b1fd54ff6c3d1e0c41691519c942d11"}

{"id": "p_333e631ac1fea501", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 62, "text": "若欲誅天下之賊，扶王室之微，智者望風，應之若響，克亂在和，何征不捷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "f2c146209c65e6722135423be8075af89c514d1b7ccb6255763a66092aeabd91"}

{"id": "p_9a928e0687f108c0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 63, "text": "苟無恩德，任失其人，覆亡將至，何暇匡翼朝廷，崇立功名乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "33ababa3bf6adb6673925712dc924cdfbbe7f08e14fde3e1ea6f8d3ea7837371"}

{"id": "p_0dd26eab5fa4f9bc", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 64, "text": "彪即書責匡，匡原林叔父。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "72c11acd08df47e18f3e0bd988240d7d479ac7f7d2d000037a2f1005627deb8c"}

{"id": "p_7011b22b472af92b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 65, "text": "林乃避地上黨，耕種山阿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "b69144486ebe46d445b5d369d7a32259987cfe5851881f55605a7458e1545482"}

{"id": "p_949766852f0852af", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 66, "text": "當時旱蝗，林獨豐收，盡呼比鄰，升斗分之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "ecffc02d4497dd95db9b538309de8628c36a20dcb936ab8c65af816004ccd488"}

{"id": "p_0d6264a8224a8b8b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 67, "text": "張楊利其婦女，貪其資貨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "68157739384cb6ace28f15b6785f33fe902e331e1c5a8362f886b27a1801ad0c"}

{"id": "p_6588dd30850b3b66", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 68, "text": "見圍六十餘日，卒全堡壁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "5554eb05fd4668b32ed57ddc69c3ed0e6b28f29e6efb3c8926e1af5c22be3828"}

{"id": "p_b248fc4c195ec139", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 69, "text": "幷州刺史高幹表爲騎都尉，林辭不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "2a0e98b17821a49ccef04d38acb3263e6a957b81e399c5afb5d3bea5045bbedc"}

{"id": "p_75e339d5334470b6", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 70, "text": "後刺史梁習薦州界名士林及楊俊、王淩、王象、荀緯，太祖皆以爲縣長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "092773adbd6d5fecce773371688a0bf69ae8fe2b01da982ec84152f4dd532234"}

{"id": "p_ab3901c66427411d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 71, "text": "林宰南和，治化有成，超遷博陵太守、幽州刺史，所在有績。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "c4441cb73cacbe594194ef56ccccad220b85b0d4a58f745aa2d214c356c0d0d3"}

{"id": "p_7ff636717338cc8d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 72, "text": "文帝爲五官將，林爲功曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "124ca381b7c60e2dde82ce4bdc89c11d5cfcdcaafcb7de1363108e40a76ee58b"}

{"id": "p_5ae9d68b60180ca2", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 73, "text": "太祖西征，田銀、蘇伯反，幽、冀扇動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "8030f795181e094ea96e74063f1222706abb651140b1fc0fd316cf0d52788771"}

{"id": "p_069b8237497b61c5", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 74, "text": "文帝欲親自討之，林曰：「昔忝博陵，又在幽州，賊之形勢，可料度也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "166ed079c3e710c565a499caad14d6be2fc64b33530b5871c02edfe086eaf966"}

{"id": "p_10e1b36813d131d4", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 75, "text": "北方吏民，樂安厭亂，服化已久，守善者多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "56dac5f17266119acf5b44323943b08cdf6d542ef039c0163098f8dc6e1a7106"}

{"id": "p_df06e87f4c020fd0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 76, "text": "銀、伯犬羊相聚，智小謀大，不能爲害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "3047e4b493d4d6e151352736af6f0ca49daa19e2f84a62e312e6fdb2435d6f34"}

{"id": "p_c1b742110f4018fb", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 77, "text": "方今大軍在遠，外有彊敵，將軍爲天下之鎮也，輕動遠舉，雖克不武。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "04ea04db5b7b2f62662b80bab6e52203a427b6835957d7b169bfd3ba86db22b3"}

{"id": "p_3391fd4917838590", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 78, "text": "」文帝從之，遣將往伐，應時克滅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "819a651d84512fcde2510635ab4b6ed972a1d612f2d5099925a5ca7dc858e693"}

{"id": "p_ae1dc72d270deb07", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 79, "text": "出爲平原太守、魏郡東部都尉，入爲丞相東曹屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "0b2b471dcf485f40c8ecf2342ad6de31afff88f9465486ae0c4a06de553d301d"}

{"id": "p_e3a63b92c8528b69", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 80, "text": "文帝踐阼，遷少府，封樂陽亭侯，轉大司農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "42802a9c7fb3c7cc1a4a925e4fa392965475f702090cb72739905aefcc77a2fd"}

{"id": "p_701faca060c78e2a", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 81, "text": "明帝即位，進封高陽鄉侯，徙光祿勳太常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "852e73a5b3443fc1829ab487b98cb341a3ffc38a8db66e7dc241e1f6135b89dc"}

{"id": "p_5f64ce934474d4d3", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 82, "text": "晉宣王以林鄉邑耆德，每爲之拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "c5d4e01a0ef64012fe5c2ffb8872b4423e3542f747e9fb13295b2235bdc40e5e"}

{"id": "p_e94969b53716158f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 83, "text": "或謂林曰：「司馬公貴重，君宜止之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "8f27b999793c289c0b5d3a464457e256649e1972c0595eb4b083b80ba47a1042"}

{"id": "p_9d2fd47bec72c20c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」林曰：「司馬公自欲敦長幼之敘，爲後生之法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "63b7cf7b482e89e74dadc21065b0c4044e8590171b71460b2519456b3de09668"}

{"id": "p_aa08723641edcbe4", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 85, "text": "貴非吾之所畏，拜非吾之所制也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "fc843b9d731b227e3c65597c1eb60862f795d4006d413d28a6c9024fb903b2ff"}

{"id": "p_f239732c39bc38c9", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 86, "text": "時論以林節操清峻，欲致之公輔，而林遂稱疾篤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "adb850810a673141845ecf220a0dcd4db2354d967c6fcfcaf9e4da99caee1b4e"}

{"id": "p_cd58d75c70ea396d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 87, "text": "年八十三，薨，追贈驃騎將軍，葬如公禮，諡曰貞侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "87bc440eaf0ccee63be4b9dcad5d80a91002fac696afcfa1285e129f53e6e97e"}

{"id": "p_f88dc785882a4872", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 88, "text": "子旹嗣，爲泰山太守，坐法誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "41599beab440d6109e7cb0e31334cd7110dd4ad493f50ab6cca55dfc82790a9b"}

{"id": "p_097de289978dce8e", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 89, "text": "楊俊字季才，河內獲嘉人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "7cb2373fc3537b22a8a305702f4af1b9e1687ab63ab28b7e0864f8279cf135a9"}

{"id": "p_09318ac0fb1a0d65", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 90, "text": "受學陳留邊讓，讓器異之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "57076e64991ac01bf25bb691d2f337eaa775a905dc1d1e08d8884cfe79490165"}

{"id": "p_a1bab4097e8db6a0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 91, "text": "俊以兵亂方起，而河內處四達之衢，必爲戰場，乃扶持老弱詣京、密山間，同行者百餘家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "471f5473e26ad5824a6a15eadc4c13218c0c4abe86ec03831021c93ca599d185"}

{"id": "p_357550cfadf8c2d0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 92, "text": "宗族知故爲人所略作奴僕者凡六家，俊皆傾財贖之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "14f00cf7d23b96afd37d025745ea6456331a0951e7403108a872af71ece9494b"}

{"id": "p_0b1d42caa326e40b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 93, "text": "司馬宣王年十六七，與俊相遇，俊曰：「此非常之人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "b3b0ea4dc9bb6d81a97ceed4af525dc7ad0966c0efd069f5b5119aec26d75073"}

{"id": "p_ed23556caa69bf26", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」又司馬朗早有聲名，其族兄芝，衆未之知，惟俊言曰：「芝雖夙望不及朗，實理但有優耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "48644f89c25df76ff4a84d74f0076fefce383f844c48a7f5ec576c888823f22f"}

{"id": "p_dc0b17c9dc816477", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 95, "text": "本郡王象，少孤特，爲人僕隸，年十七八，見使牧羊而私讀書，因被箠楚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "a4d2be278fcc20352df4d4d8427afedacda26273f0048e68b5be9adbf9ba7bfa"}

{"id": "p_b1bcaa46dc9da437", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 96, "text": "俊嘉其才質，即贖象著家，聘娶立屋，然後與別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "51c7aa97498409c6b3b1cfc98838b83c100c1fcc47e0df3725ec5604a29aad4a"}

{"id": "p_143d5472a1093baa", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 97, "text": "太祖除俊曲梁長，入爲丞相掾屬，舉茂才，安陵令，遷南陽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "af2f53978adc688d44cf16373d6ec113bb26984ebf6752116ee9a5b3fb51d6dd"}

{"id": "p_5154e049f91c4911", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 98, "text": "宣德敎，立學校，吏民稱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "930e146de14888ba2a0ce6fb1630a5fa2bd5d21858d81ea9092b6ca7d8e2e54b"}

{"id": "p_a4a876f1a60007b8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 99, "text": "太祖征漢中，魏諷反於鄴，俊自劾詣行在所。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "17db021e6cd5f314e94f5e7297a69ab35fd462fcb106546c53991264d2a9e985"}

{"id": "p_27ef58da1d189383", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 100, "text": "俊以身方罪免，牋辭太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "6682eba205af3844e087dc79d48b3ea1e37809b9981f2a6e0f0cca8a4564f197"}

{"id": "p_39933476ca0e9333", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 101, "text": "太子不悅，曰：「楊中尉便去，何太高遠邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "d14b00aa64514226cb34144fc96e89f4aaf7b756f605751ac67db644b567bb0e"}

{"id": "p_7c7f9be73d2a7b0f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 102, "text": "時王象爲散騎常侍，薦俊曰：「伏見南陽太守楊俊，秉純粹之茂質，履忠肅之弘量，體仁足以育物，篤實足以動衆，克長後進，惠訓不倦，外寬內直，仁而有斷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "8703e2ad70b39ea8fd414192ebf8abe46344e6a59bc32d90b0b58da483d864cd"}

{"id": "p_46e4ea6db6c60da2", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 103, "text": "自初彈冠，所歷垂化，再守南陽，恩德流著，殊鄰異黨，襁負而至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "7d7b2c117d86b2f5470934061de3ecfddc9e1a9513a99258dd8ba383f8a8e2e2"}

{"id": "p_fd1513c52e6498dc", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 104, "text": "今境守清靜，無所展其智能，宜還本朝，宣力輦轂，熙帝之載。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "811d4bc28779248d01b9b371c252df928f7ec9e04c68c625f18de25525a450f6"}

{"id": "p_1ca41b47b46e9e5b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 105, "text": "俊自少及長，以人倫自任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "2a3f2ad51b6805074f551c804e3ce9b097814a4cd74d1dec3dcc94afb540cf9c"}

{"id": "p_b88584adb1c8e358", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 106, "text": "同郡審固、陳留衛恂本皆出自兵伍，俊資拔獎致，咸作佳士；後固歷位郡守，恂禦史、縣令，其明鑒行義多此類也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "bd14735ca9eeb14e428012bbb51a014b245baac2a340ea9218267f217a8b92f6"}

{"id": "p_cea0732aebc77c0a", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 107, "text": "初，臨菑侯與俊善，太祖適嗣未定，密訪羣司。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "d3f285d4d43a94ea5d29ea57cd4de7339c8440bbf5ddac3f58986e4020df0688"}

{"id": "p_b204cf95e4aa033f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 108, "text": "俊雖並論文帝、臨菑才分所長，不適有所據當，然稱臨菑猶美，文帝常以恨之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "a8b88fbde351c45ad57233c3adb7bd6b2445372f8d593e6acc4a554c82fa8efa"}

{"id": "p_df668ecaa3988c66", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 109, "text": "，車駕至宛，以巿不豐樂，發怒收俊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "fb9908c1d380b3af042260972fda2eb8f93f639a62de392c6395bae4f356cd11"}

{"id": "p_d754d511cd3f99dc", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 110, "text": "尚書僕射司馬宣王、常侍王象、荀緯請俊，叩頭流血，帝不許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "b81a98cc7eb3183b581ec3a2aa92135a77d3477ff5147697894ee2c9433b388b"}

{"id": "p_c115eeabf51dafad", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 111, "text": "杜襲字子緒，潁川定陵人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "d888b055ec892bb40250d5cdab83a4750958db72df0b648eaa90e39b578805d4"}

{"id": "p_f18ba3c370aeebc8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 112, "text": "曾祖父安，祖父根，著名前世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "6a9a59b3e68ab8820a08430451785b9e9cb518c52cccd7ca5542fb680a71c299"}

{"id": "p_a76b97d66d6e37f5", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 113, "text": "襲避亂荊州，劉表待以賓禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "d5a3fecc6e965999606ba678dca2507e45abeec6188d311dad7f437596d460af"}

{"id": "p_20d68e473c170bbf", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 114, "text": "同郡繁欽數見奇於表，襲喻之曰：「吾所以與子俱來者，徒欲龍蟠幽藪，待時鳳翔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "8699bbcfab2e0b156b08db251f375a26cdc853ca580721070afa0b8392189504"}

{"id": "p_8b7005471e32a2e8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 115, "text": "豈謂劉牧當爲撥亂之主，而規長者委身哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "96c580575e184394b9795d60d731e369b7b6899c8b757e8a589217b08251cf17"}

{"id": "p_c66c185027fc6316", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 116, "text": "子若見能不已，非吾徒也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "1dd6833df6aefe84690c34f4204dfeb3b362e729f4239716a428d5d011b92804"}

{"id": "p_689893cce7851d4f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 117, "text": "」欽慨然曰：「請敬受命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "876fe859b434d8d9210b53b8f6dc2c40005dae1f77630cc0f8102181e1c292fc"}

{"id": "p_6b0e5d15d2137718", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 118, "text": "建安初，太祖迎天子都許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "4bf8978121edb31f4e21ede980033085b88c98bacfc9ed43bac23e439c2574a7"}

{"id": "p_ca0c6dd02a94f686", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 119, "text": "襲逃還鄉里，太祖以爲西鄂長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "de1e2c38d0a892e2aaea83975f83db7e7530041b30c2d48053feee2f30b7779a"}

{"id": "p_1cf75ca6fa72654f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 120, "text": "時長吏皆斂民保城郭，不得農業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "2a67d9554dff43549ec210436ee3ced0aee8dc0029e3832d17c7bc446b3cff76"}

{"id": "p_493b8f371a8c0ec8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 121, "text": "襲自知恩結於民，乃遣老弱各分散就田業，留丁彊備守，吏民歡悅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "92f8b040908abfd9160ba130593a3cec72096a255ed139c67495d9649eaee150"}

{"id": "p_4ade0687851adc19", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 122, "text": "會荊州出步騎萬人來攻城，襲乃悉召縣吏民任拒守者五十餘人，與之要誓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "8c702ee492651bfbdb948212774a7db46d7f8dc99d53624b9fdf186b0285509a"}

{"id": "p_9ae2f8559f46b56d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 123, "text": "其親戚在外欲自營護者，恣聽遣出；皆叩頭願致死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "945f6a7b9912cf5b5643937445837f5448f72f094e5a21ceef79c27ddf162d36"}

{"id": "p_3a57c088b22e02e1", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 124, "text": "於是身執矢石，率與戮力。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "b4fe4d36e095301a09dfdc878e6862cf2e94521c2bc8e3a2fb7f764467f89125"}

{"id": "p_5d7dc7b951657489", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 125, "text": "臨陳斬數百級，而襲衆死者三十餘人，其餘十八人盡被創，賊得入城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "f77dd651253901f6e946e3401128bc02b0c2f07ca27c8c4db9d85e6f60b72735"}

{"id": "p_a0e7fdab43ddfed6", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 126, "text": "襲帥傷痍吏民決圍得出，死喪略盡，而無反背者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "c3adb1b9241f79549226cd98689d95514217954d549a7fc2187f31c3aaa81411"}

{"id": "p_ed0bc8183cf7255a", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 127, "text": "遂收散民，徙至摩陂營，吏民慕而從之如歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "4eb67469c9e80c2f7c93f439beef5e87b81e6c73f451433275e85ad6205dbbb0"}

{"id": "p_592127b31fa10000", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 128, "text": "司隸鍾繇表拜議郎參軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "a4ef32628715b7f38dc9bd1ba573fcc99b75f13e8aa7f39da7e1e99f8d99ddc8"}

{"id": "p_95dae10990bdaa7b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 129, "text": "荀彧又薦襲，太祖以爲丞相軍祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "b9fcf09eed05cb6e7e1fbb54ea1e2c2c1df86c6fdc685a294d7830a3c2f20aec"}

{"id": "p_5b65571a9f589350", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 130, "text": "魏國既建，爲侍中，與王粲、和洽並用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "a2763a6c10071eb41ec8503986d844433760dadc70da0c0baa17d2aa169b8f9e"}

{"id": "p_475eded4af17bae8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 131, "text": "粲彊識博聞，故太祖游觀出入，多得驂乘，至其見敬不及洽、襲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "1f9c54ea445f0bf359a4e5282c19567a958a001c379383527f852a18e9530973"}

{"id": "p_3df85b4f1788510c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 132, "text": "粲性躁競，起坐曰：「不知公對杜襲道何等也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "210314fa1def23c817e486936b263d64cbd2e1efa531d55cf9577605ab45dc28"}

{"id": "p_2ce25a1e7f24d164", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 133, "text": "」洽笑答曰：「天下事豈有盡邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "d2b1d08d916117f6794264a21b99ce26b73714e47a47f6c61ee8c7471371b8ec"}

{"id": "p_2d08c1a80f645e6c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 134, "text": "卿晝侍可矣，悒悒於此，欲兼之乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "2faa94bad73bd72711fdad54d54b9b3ed7c21a650aad5e36d6203c7ec6b1616c"}

{"id": "p_ed6a83e8faba49ac", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 135, "text": "」後襲領丞相長史，隨太祖到漢中討張魯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "106cedc94ccd7f8e81f75200c51b1d7a1e7125ceb7e9adcf76ffd5cfc35afe40"}

{"id": "p_fdbc123b89015709", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 136, "text": "太祖還，拜襲駙馬都尉，留督漢中軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "381cc2c6a05fb1a6f05843e7e14c403a9255f859c57c5b67a1c603c311f656e9"}

{"id": "p_de1551c03dc4849e", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 137, "text": "綏懷開導，百姓自樂出徙洛、鄴者，八萬餘口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "8e88a47a232738dd2332ea7c3d7534a2a9c0fba29f0ce4accdbe5966a0c6b6de"}

{"id": "p_65eea9bf959f9490", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 138, "text": "夏侯淵爲劉備所沒，軍喪元帥，將士失色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "3f0b85140ef87a0c3da3ee1b0747397649d5c1ed29fb88793756735267decf1e"}

{"id": "p_a12126849b076ffb", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 139, "text": "襲與張郃、郭淮糾攝諸軍事，權宜以郃爲督，以一衆心，三軍遂定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "87207a0359ab27032166daf57a0bf359edcc7345383a71761a602191f648895c"}

{"id": "p_84d3abecbfcbfa5c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 140, "text": "太祖東還，當選留府長史，鎮守長安，主者所選多不當，太祖令曰：「釋騏驥而不乘，焉皇皇而更索？", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "304c3ab2f77e4a7d2c4a8e9e010bb8b03ea093f26c8d5db8f38f617d5316c691"}

{"id": "p_44ef22d3ff826d57", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 141, "text": "」遂以襲爲留府長史，駐關中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "5ed4ec907c0d2cfa5cffa7a3a88bd7a31fad9358e3dbb9ddae27e73d1da10271"}

{"id": "p_4ca241003d06a94f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 142, "text": "時將軍許攸擁部曲，不附太祖而有慢言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "a643b9bdaf4efb1dd057f926bffe876df9416673859f59bb4eaf855c3cb91590"}

{"id": "p_c749c602ddf728e1", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 143, "text": "羣臣多諫：「可招懷攸，共討彊敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "4e9a8ea45980b931e2f7ecf0bbb5670ba88b7c3d56fb49b197787f4d28a2a3a5"}

{"id": "p_d6d2830be46539cf", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」太祖橫刀於膝，作色不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "24ae6ffb8cfa72ed1a74aaa639a392874be84d1c65a762d9f67d64c8813a9ff8"}

{"id": "p_897191d6495662a8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 145, "text": "襲入欲諫，太祖逆謂之曰：「吾計以定，卿勿復言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "b1345a24b38d6eee566336d05befbd179786d2e75f9739afb8d82e7ce26d151c"}

{"id": "p_c7979d260f72fde0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」襲曰：「若殿下計是邪，臣方助殿下成之；若殿下計非邪，雖成宜改之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "b7fc94b460608a5cf8eb8dea8186a3b6c6f507ec90899d2c549d47979019ffc0"}

{"id": "p_e6f238cc2131ef47", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 147, "text": "殿下逆臣，令勿言之，何待下之不闡乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "1b373ecbf00b70119ec705f660c9d4e65f9803bdd8ef8cc954daee5701ecd900"}

{"id": "p_ff8b3042f6ec23e2", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」太祖曰：「許攸慢吾，如何可置乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "740383bf4f0e049b7738adbeea2525faf065aaa158441272b9dcff9b207c46e2"}

{"id": "p_e851e7f53fde3fa8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 149, "text": "」襲曰：「殿下謂許攸何如人邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "180e49bfa529a548c8c35f6c2006f5b8337886b5fcdc7bc1f160daa109cf8886"}

{"id": "p_89bde3c4e1e0dee3", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」襲曰：「夫惟賢知賢，惟聖知聖，凡人安能知非凡人邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "504927673d0ee526f7235476613ee07bd7c91d57f2fa48b46f7acaf06f16c1aa"}

{"id": "p_22aa8c8605322b63", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 151, "text": "方今豺狼當路而狐狸是先，人將謂殿下避彊攻弱，進不爲勇，退不爲仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "ae7064b78f9fb5fa878c5fad30c148055040a9ba6ae090c407af895edd72a385"}

{"id": "p_009c905486cd547e", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 152, "text": "臣聞千鈞之弩不爲鼷鼠發機，萬石之鍾不以莛撞起音，今區區之許攸，何足以勞神武哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "2a7db76823d69e87a3a40a5b60131439854a70dda4ea0fc652a42f2de483ed4d"}

{"id": "p_b4274be419ea4aae", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 153, "text": "時夏侯尚暱於太子，情好至密。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "d63b3438c86ac607fdd881c9d7c4ca2f5726d0c543a21edc86db331dd6068091"}

{"id": "p_5172a3cfbfd3032c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 154, "text": "襲謂尚非益友，不足殊待，以聞太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "8d23541245a337364923ab037849e3d53d1b521f8f0834a4430292ba0d0f65ef"}

{"id": "p_53266dd538924512", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 155, "text": "文帝初甚不悅，後乃追思。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "f25f4ff110323b455522c3d331e040ee22bb3f67a2f343c5962a1b16e9a47d13"}

{"id": "p_2f1fc997783d0308", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 156, "text": "文帝即王位，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "16d25328bc837b3c283f6e5246a3394c957b76ba3184c94cbc1ad2279b5136a3"}

{"id": "p_211bf6c3c3978ac7", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 157, "text": "及踐阼，爲督軍糧禦史，封武平亭侯，更爲督軍糧執法，入爲尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "9ee93082112b640ae65fafe45346fd91a975b508f586c4d8880a970f472d1ded"}

{"id": "p_a5f12565aaaca8b7", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 158, "text": "明帝即位，進封平陽鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "0eba4dba4c5388bba4fa19bd0cc5762b5340726174994290d312fffa12ff67e0"}

{"id": "p_7cbc57039c57183e", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 159, "text": "諸葛亮出秦川，大將軍曹真督諸軍拒亮，徙襲爲大將軍軍師，分邑百戶賜兄基爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "eb47bd23bea6081bd2ba558d37081aeda9355205b49e7691b10a104d55b83a15"}

{"id": "p_73aa02bfd8d665e6", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 160, "text": "真薨，司馬宣王代之，襲復爲軍師，增邑三百，幷前五百五十戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "fb6780e5efae2bc4751938c1c28c47c43f1293f5f3a04f59d394f74923398639"}

{"id": "p_2eda5e941e05ce1b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 161, "text": "薨，追贈少府，諡曰定侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "59d3fb5fce16fa405888d75a2583be48fd7556a97567cd27715a35f79ef72f80"}

{"id": "p_cda7e588db9df2cd", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 162, "text": "趙儼字伯然，潁川陽翟人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "cdeb4766ce9dcc2622026ba8df2419bb24a54c21539b7169ff4fa758820832cb"}
