{"id": "p_fde301a16d296ebd", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 163, "text": "避亂荊州，與杜襲、繁欽通財同計，合爲一家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "c4fc819273bd315827907d4e093b1d0b905d8d1243ac00eca753514a71385d02"}

{"id": "p_d717d5c10b4bf079", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 164, "text": "太祖始迎獻帝都許，儼謂欽曰：「曹鎮東應期命世，必能匡濟華夏，吾知歸矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "ecb75dd4cbec2870b2b98a813e330565c185e19752d8809212a437033b7958be"}

{"id": "p_3ad06a6844b6d464", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 165, "text": "」，年二十七，遂扶持老弱詣太祖，太祖以儼爲朗陵長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "455a9b2bc73913d39b7490cb02fc70a9a5ec7a90444e2b1a7666df289fdc8786"}

{"id": "p_d884a27c127ff633", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 166, "text": "儼取其尤甚者，收縛案驗，皆得死罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "2935d300305fa9b4beeac2383a42d037530780b16a789c26b174242b9724f51d"}

{"id": "p_a249430217afa362", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 167, "text": "儼既囚之，乃表府解放，自是威恩並著。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "b756a5636f864f69dad284176b19bc786318d52161c7b05031d464274d56da48"}

{"id": "p_68d4f94294b2c9cf", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 168, "text": "時袁紹舉兵南侵，遣使招誘豫州諸郡，諸郡多受其命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "9f23ea173af27792bb1095a7a39998b436bfb903218caa4c48ff339aaf26c545"}

{"id": "p_c50d118779f25a42", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 169, "text": "惟陽安郡不動，而都尉李通急錄戶調。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "d843432571819aabfbd69ea0acd2727c015db5a5b8956d9c5afb9b1dafcdc402"}

{"id": "p_c36e9852dbb74f9f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 170, "text": "儼見通曰：「方今天下未集，諸郡並叛，懷附者復收其綿絹，小人樂亂，能無遺恨！", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "7c55409340db8fa0f48fdd56e388d70bb1c506a536bea59f128ab17a763ae745"}

{"id": "p_f057ac6a4b479123", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 171, "text": "且遠近多虞，不可不詳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "b337b4ce6061ea891f9b3f8778cb3a4b967563f2a63890275a7dd323c465a6be"}

{"id": "p_e67b263df24a0767", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 172, "text": "」通曰：「紹與大將軍相持甚急，左右郡縣背叛乃爾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "af8e9d19a7bb6b4e884d0059b581b109c7016a77fdac016617f8fd8716a7199e"}

{"id": "p_eb89fee1de90deef", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 173, "text": "若綿絹不調送，觀聽者必謂我顧望，有所須待也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "4131b5cbdc0a8dd20b699cd5d18cc6551fd87747300531295d258b60a031cfde"}

{"id": "p_a90d7ce301c4f30f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 174, "text": "」儼曰：「誠亦如君慮；然當權其輕重，小緩調，當爲君釋此患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "e354b733fb3e226401efed4496ff73c1ff69c6f90f9592504d167e0eac99286f"}

{"id": "p_ab5fa1a40ed3bf02", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 175, "text": "」乃書與荀彧曰：「今陽安郡當送綿絹，道路艱阻，必致寇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "a075530297f164fd57ea4976e2035c5fcc906a5b11d2ecabfbc1e434d078b32a"}

{"id": "p_071c6e0eac05c8c7", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 176, "text": "百姓困窮，鄰城並叛，易用傾蕩，乃一方安危之機也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "a9025719d9242a5d533205e8b93202f265ecc128ffe514faddf10232a733e368"}

{"id": "p_c403f72b794538f8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 177, "text": "且此郡人執守忠節，在險不貳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "f97946803096cceddc107523154c46786acb8f895bad17e3dd90ecd53726c886"}

{"id": "p_721f6a344f627a53", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 178, "text": "以爲國家宜垂慰撫，所斂綿絹，皆俾還之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "675c9a089b09d64a1068dd93361e13fdc726b46ea22a46378ac5a36b9424b048"}

{"id": "p_55854d34b49b2470", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 179, "text": "」彧報曰：「輒白曹公，公文下郡，綿絹悉以還民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "37bf142811c390200a74636913d4ce9d525829ae32678ed1e36f111b82514cb8"}

{"id": "p_c6b4fadc209aa425", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 180, "text": "時于禁屯潁陰，樂進屯陽翟，張遼屯長社，諸將任氣，多共不協；使儼幷參三軍，每事訓喻，遂相親睦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "79c630d6b79109dfe8a96504fd7a102f9876716101417807bccf215017b81b2a"}

{"id": "p_1c074e589e623298", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 181, "text": "太祖征荊州，以儼領章陵太守，徙都督護軍，護于禁、張遼、張郃、朱靈、李典、路招、馮楷七軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "94acb0c2beef4f0994b5c171986e4beb89106dc54e931d4ed8ed141fb9dd232d"}

{"id": "p_7db0f6fac3d64324", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 182, "text": "復爲丞相主簿，遷扶風太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "dd60891388df9a4fe9818949cc487a7bb1c432a78d765007844e78dde98cfbfd"}

{"id": "p_0d0977fc83f9b47f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 183, "text": "太祖徙出故韓遂、馬超等兵五千餘人，使平難將軍殷署等督領，以儼爲關中護軍，盡統諸軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "f9a104771a91965f98a7d5466e7ee84f0882cbeb815c72b286c33d726b3b8901"}

{"id": "p_b631e06520f07eed", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 184, "text": "羌虜數來寇害，儼率署等追到新平，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "1416a6035882118ffeb74399e93811cfb5f006994ea9e7857056bd82a76679a9"}

{"id": "p_6bddb9b00267db15", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 185, "text": "屯田客呂並自稱將軍，聚黨據陳倉，儼復率署等攻之，賊即破滅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "cc51e20af1e52351e43e33e1a6de89181f21e5be2c81269176bd4cc53fceacb8"}

{"id": "p_39b23e185b7ff0b1", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 186, "text": "時被書差千二百兵往助漢中守，署督送之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "1fd46827b8891affcdde2cadcfb1741ff942be4a6e8299dfebb231bed62f50b5"}

{"id": "p_8dbcc945d8f70a4e", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 187, "text": "行者卒與室家別，皆有憂色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "8b0c41f9f1404cbdccc2ee3e9f25f6b8033298c5766738c924a8fee400259e2d"}

{"id": "p_3345cb3b2cbb4e69", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 188, "text": "署發後一日，儼慮其有變，乃自追至斜谷口，人人慰勞，又深戒署。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "b30044271a8569089b7c5a8f9de0d693f417a4fc810184710ceed9c8dc9cf408"}

{"id": "p_bae29558fd2aebd0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 189, "text": "署軍復前四十里，兵果叛亂，未知署吉凶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "2d5da498fa18363252c2b87d0653701cd3ea290c0afb5be423f0a3647e528850"}

{"id": "p_af35b507959e205d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 190, "text": "而儼自隨步騎百五十人，皆與叛者同部曲，或婚姻，得此問，各驚，被甲持兵，不復自安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "9621bc2cb013a7e834471b39270fc1b73ed10f935e9263d4ccd2c03e19d439f2"}

{"id": "p_68851c39875bd6cc", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 191, "text": "儼欲還，既等以爲「今本營黨已擾亂，一身赴之無益，可須定問」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "4b5f0ea5d996ac6503271ac4a2e9244661049337dbbbe87d9dc0c6d876f9f6a2"}

{"id": "p_403208d0f6d02f37", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 192, "text": "儼曰：「雖疑本營與叛者同謀，要當聞行者變，乃發之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "f08d66a23bbaf18591afe20571af9751198acc53d70d0c8bbcbd9c9c656eb407"}

{"id": "p_af16eb487dd49f9c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 193, "text": "又有欲善不能自定，宜及猶豫，促撫寧之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "464d1336e99e50324f9401b537bc1857b20c9461889af038885ed75cfbbf4d03"}

{"id": "p_af9eaf344f68068c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 194, "text": "且爲之元帥，既不能安輯，身受禍難，命也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "b9bcf424cde40bb49259e26a91fa31fabc6163c0e7942fd16822435ba67aebb2"}

{"id": "p_7be9579114c50442", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 195, "text": "行三十里止，放馬息，盡呼所從人，喻以成敗，慰勵懇切。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "35458cedf33021437ef14cdd29901c3714da9c2624f59a7ff2e3157d694167e9"}

{"id": "p_3fa116726913edb0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 196, "text": "皆慷慨曰：「死生當隨護軍，不敢有二。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "bf79dd49f23c77c6f4e2918650ab9f9b0b483d187e21eae868b0feab4fa07a7e"}

{"id": "p_dd79f212857f1ac8", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 197, "text": "」前到諸營，各召料簡諸姦結叛者八百餘人，散在原野，惟取其造謀魁率治之，餘一不問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "209ca9faa6c675d3d654762d9c8b304ae1a6c4d8723c806c648d4e8a76dd2d4f"}

{"id": "p_1389bc1030061def", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 198, "text": "郡縣所收送，皆放遣，乃即相率還降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "04bca2864718f89aa605bd55ce4c90ee752577a50f99f36e8ad28a8971005e83"}

{"id": "p_5627014d4dbaaac1", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 199, "text": "儼密白：「宜遣將詣大營，請舊兵鎮守關中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "20aa414cdf1e5a65632f9421ddb234ce329cf3e5a3a54e61609a8587903dfc63"}

{"id": "p_9ccb4702c50c0b40", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 200, "text": "」太祖遣將軍劉柱將二千人，當須到乃發遣，而事露，諸營大駭，不可安喻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "c27fc9f2279c0af4b1ce6c547da90470a81cbdc2505c5a84c336dce3245270be"}

{"id": "p_444773c430711750", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 201, "text": "儼謂諸將曰：「舊兵既少，東兵未到，是以諸營圖爲邪謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "f08f540ef7cc77618f0c7c7525fd3bd94adbbdd49b556d7c89e8e097b7cee3f0"}

{"id": "p_b6e3a49da1dfe291", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 202, "text": "」遂宣言當差留新兵之溫厚者千人鎮守關中，其餘悉遣東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "7cfcd872034bb4381cb53252af73bd72f6b7e4ac005d052b0d3346b91cc17bae"}

{"id": "p_ac3e552f49728c0c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 203, "text": "便見主者，內諸營兵名籍，案累重，立差別之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "37e1078193bc6aac5ecf6081b067526ccba0d5428c65142350c83af34ffcf5a4"}

{"id": "p_3bb31eb7b4ef5d34", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 204, "text": "其當去者亦不敢動，儼一日盡遣上道，因使所留千人，分布羅落之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "e802c55c49ff5bc2263cf5efd478a87b7bf9f262210c008fbc2b909e22868295"}

{"id": "p_7855aa7d6c9b6aac", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 205, "text": "東兵尋至，乃復脅喻，幷徙千人，令相及共東，凡所全致二萬餘口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "bd37d0e38836deeaec5f5806a723b9aed52174893ff00406ecff76d49f5f8e60"}

{"id": "p_d71db4476e0c2b2c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 206, "text": "關羽圍征南將軍曹仁於樊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "3ad42b62f741ca66cec79f42bd9417cc9ae108edd908818ff15a649412980103"}

{"id": "p_0b1985400e13152b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 207, "text": "儼以議郎參仁軍事南行，平寇將軍徐晃俱前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "11422f796929a2b09521181cfa31437280efaaf121dc4dfa093bef2ddd66649b"}

{"id": "p_bfc29a48f4e1c70a", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 208, "text": "既到，羽圍仁遂堅，餘救兵未到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "e5984f1b3944892290eb4634df9ed340157b9d9fb2647b430c940487a65f3e46"}

{"id": "p_56036e92b4206bff", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 209, "text": "晃所督不足解圍，而諸將呵責晃促救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "b06b638e93a5505852d7589c091126e9b933cc32a957fa4d82c41fc144be3322"}

{"id": "p_1baa5fcf872894c9", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 210, "text": "儼謂諸將曰：「今賊圍素固，水潦猶盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "210ea97e7785ee7b3f1408bbac93cb3c88a586d037cd706906b633c721a288a6"}

{"id": "p_8e421b9265ec4d26", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 211, "text": "我徒卒單少，而仁隔絕不得同力，此舉適所以弊內外耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "1f708b4dcf3d443f5449ab777cda31255cbef8415b5e5e057885a0fdcceae53e"}

{"id": "p_cc5eae1b544b1177", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 212, "text": "當今不若前軍偪圍，遣諜通仁，使知外救，以勵將士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "de08a830d696196ba7dadf7e0830f1e29d779ff4aa3e11009be86fd5950c7458"}

{"id": "p_c373319d5682f84b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 213, "text": "計北軍不過十日，尚足堅守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "3797705044e68f20aebee05df6ff9bfe931211d0b153c258c672da4a0baa08d1"}

{"id": "p_227662469365dc03", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 214, "text": "然後表裏俱發，破賊必矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "0bcb8813ed6d0070f4b3a5cea2b4e187fda4bf1713b360ef1a2bede22d088096"}

{"id": "p_90a25ac1021aa67f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 215, "text": "如有緩救之戮，余爲諸軍當之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "c13e216744d083a12dc85a20098db7018653bcb836a742dbee7c811984f19026"}

{"id": "p_b4479dd4939138a4", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 216, "text": "」諸將皆喜，便作地道，箭飛書與仁，消息數通，北軍亦至，幷勢大戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "b4e938832d3a731e796414f1446e7c188f3529d4b7da02ea47d8af6d69a9674e"}

{"id": "p_938aa437a449e7a0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 217, "text": "羽軍既退，舟船猶據沔水，襄陽隔絕不通，而孫權襲取羽輜重，羽聞之，即走南還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "2a5f6d3df8429cc231891b22b0fbd447b35b84beaf7b94cb6c657a7c803632a7"}

{"id": "p_578fccd2677c7e3e", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 218, "text": "仁會諸將議，咸曰：「今因羽危懼，必可追禽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "723ed4bd4473b486d20ac6ffcf2327c20161f2c61bae8ff70dca6c794a2f5d5d"}

{"id": "p_8ec4b7d03631227b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 219, "text": "」儼曰：「權邀羽連兵之難，欲掩制其後，顧羽還救，恐我承其兩疲，故順辭求效，乘釁因變，以觀利鈍耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "a4a7d032976048ba5b05ae512da99a06ac5dbbf0b576ff001b4e0418799ce4ef"}

{"id": "p_cbaae7318687e21c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 220, "text": "今羽已孤迸，更宜存之以爲權害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "7826602aea9abbc205b407919c26a43cf465943282234dbf153d3a82583dcba6"}

{"id": "p_6f495f552cff8308", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 221, "text": "若深入追北，權則改虞於彼，將生患於我矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "f5a73e78abba3f8340f6113e26a6f12c2cdc1f695a713d4b2ebbe3dae71295ec"}

{"id": "p_d46c888a14f90280", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 222, "text": "太祖聞羽走，恐諸將追之，果疾敕仁，如儼所策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "4a9023a7951719b296df454adb4fa0f31d6a9a3e66f0771db188d45a057104d6"}

{"id": "p_ca35ee97d3dce8cf", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 223, "text": "頃之，拜駙馬都尉，領河東太守，典農中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "9a86d76197ecdcd0e93ed5ab4056bb02eb58a0ba6cf7956f9d2a6b987dacde78"}

{"id": "p_e8b56f349702573d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 224, "text": "孫權寇邊，征東大將軍曹休統五州軍禦之，徵儼爲軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "41b759063aa4b5f20359b13f715e25dc1d8069576d86dbc7cc97c2a62eaf3512"}

{"id": "p_d00a95af7e25f4f2", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 225, "text": "權衆退，軍還，封宜土亭侯，轉爲度支中郎將，遷尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "14aba1812bb6305edf2710ff517c4a8fd1eaafde99f93550e3d27b057c00ebd8"}

{"id": "p_ba598efba44ceb0a", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 226, "text": "從征吳，到廣陵，復留爲征東軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "a1d905cec4510fe012f1e2ea92b817ddde9aedaf1f2ede9271502e56313ea2a9"}

{"id": "p_2eec14d7656e8353", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 227, "text": "明帝即位，進封都鄉侯，邑六百戶，監荊州諸軍事，假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "42dc0bc58b098cd1d10fb797f91fdcabfc9c7b33c7a8245961ea0c4e19d75398"}

{"id": "p_f171ebd9d24a2961", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 228, "text": "會疾，不行，復爲尚書，出監豫州諸軍事，轉大司馬軍師，入爲大司農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "d18d60e89fbb24901feb7373574d2e25d725c9cdf8016ea8f772b7d0d2212038"}

{"id": "p_7720d463a2ca5549", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 229, "text": "齊王即位，以儼監雍、涼諸軍事，假節，轉征蜀將軍，又遷征西將軍，都督雍、涼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "3b71b40871da57607425601fb725498c7e97be3151df5611deb7e5cb0f24fab1"}

{"id": "p_5ee8bcef788c0bea", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 230, "text": "，老疾求還，徵爲驃騎將軍，遷司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "9ad0cb1563029cf6adbdcc268bf503f39e4a62b4f6595bf888e150eb35ba8852"}

{"id": "p_1818380b2de4b98e", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 231, "text": "初，儼與同郡辛毗、陳羣、杜襲並知名，號曰「辛、陳、杜、趙」云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "e1f7adc2d9f856e820ecf44c957c56b07a0d4fe70a46646ee9009acdc2d6f14c"}

{"id": "p_d7cf8c1155adc102", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 232, "text": "裴潛字文行，河東聞喜人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "37081ed21fb5c5d493ae14440e098f6ea2257eed64885df758280978d6b9ff8d"}

{"id": "p_912fc0f6151fab64", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 233, "text": "避亂荊州，劉表待以賓禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "6680535dd903347605f9598991a2f1a0b5f6da7d6f1f9b28e51b7918c83309a2"}

{"id": "p_05ca5b4fb000ad63", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 234, "text": "潛私謂所親王粲、司馬芝曰：「劉牧非霸王之才，乃欲西伯自處，其敗無日矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "a469e61cc21de9d52eaa5f470b91b082a3a64c637772c5ceab3f692906463bc8"}

{"id": "p_7f727c5255edc40b", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 235, "text": "太祖定荊州，以潛參丞相軍事，出歷三縣令，入爲倉曹屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "8b9cb453b3aa507efd5a7c604fc3457ec3bc0b0d849fae0739bdbd14f82a01a6"}

{"id": "p_27b871e3b61769ee", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 236, "text": "太祖問潛曰：「卿前與劉備俱在荊州，卿以備才略何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "6d91a80f39799629197c3e4be80b7a39cfd2c4c050cab74756ba2e195092b32a"}

{"id": "p_bbd2297440a76b36", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 237, "text": "」潛曰：「使居中國，能亂人而不能爲治也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "339fa45951d7eb27b2c8dee0dac5b8464eb3d0d876628831bacad893645b18c3"}

{"id": "p_d1b09a73a81628f7", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 238, "text": "若乘閒守險，足以爲一方主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "3e17b2cedd4da053b40798bd9f45b9b332915aca52323acb73b3f556197f13f8"}

{"id": "p_edc868024d5098d6", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 239, "text": "時代郡大亂，以潛爲代郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "380ee836f2ee4ee493a66206ff6376b89269bcd56127019a6abbc0c0ae02440a"}

{"id": "p_8a5979bf75f30e05", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 240, "text": "烏丸王及其大人，凡三人，各自稱單于，專制郡事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "da8b3e231f3c9643be83cdf1837c1ed66e54b3562f91e60eb680445fbe3f9a70"}

{"id": "p_471ddc8b58fa3502", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 241, "text": "前太守莫能治正，太祖欲授潛精兵以鎮討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "8982c0fa135888699b25da24fe0a6f5ce8dee1f52e82eb472194cb4267ae05d8"}

{"id": "p_00f558d5774d7191", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 242, "text": "潛辭曰：「代郡戶口殷衆，士馬控弦，動有萬數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "f08f75060297fbdbd2749478ff59e042bca9ab60508e59799217327b321498a8"}

{"id": "p_6387d0bcc2b24406", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 243, "text": "單于自知放橫日久，內不自安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "e2a94e12ae2c3cb0843e2c05fcdcc51d83afc544270c3e20a53d53cd95862273"}

{"id": "p_07aa306375d94479", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 244, "text": "今多將兵往，必懼而拒境，少將則不見憚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "6fd1712d62ec0428291ff25c6ed57c13bd9ea1d66975fb18221e398292599d3a"}

{"id": "p_25e659e64dc434e0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 245, "text": "宜以計謀圖之，不可以兵威迫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "dc1afe700f3722d60a62a48b491a86f9f542b4fc82d7cb6aa0bdc3e8e938fbb9"}

{"id": "p_905afecf72b7fede", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 246, "text": "單于以下脫帽稽顙，悉還前後所掠婦女、器械、財物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "84fe0c88fe519c2dd7bb73a21938b1d1c49372c4af3627fe27a3f24fe6230e75"}

{"id": "p_98c2960a3cb32db9", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 247, "text": "潛案誅郡中大吏與單于爲表裏者郝溫、郭端等十餘人，北邊大震，百姓歸心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "854c7d801d4e760627c53b846b04139d3ba9d9da65060940d5408f6644f6fb46"}

{"id": "p_4535c9342fb24398", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 248, "text": "在代三年，還爲丞相理曹掾，太祖褒稱治代之功，潛曰：「潛於百姓雖寬，於諸胡爲峻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "c3e3f3424ee80c642f84d03230df2f44433b231100351dfd7d1268b5ed050736"}

{"id": "p_658f5b4304e9e664", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 249, "text": "今計者必以潛爲理過嚴，而事加寬惠；彼素驕恣，過寬必弛，既弛又將攝之以法，此訟爭所由生也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "c055191312b23cda215d8a3eeff5cf1a1256d74dcee2d000abeb4a94b43284a5"}

{"id": "p_77f64395564301a3", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 250, "text": "」於是太祖深悔還潛之速。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "f63388d6699ac3d2914a23fe5019c7f7f04c10e1663c3531e6eefbc22511c5c5"}

{"id": "p_e8e92eb769e1fb2d", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 251, "text": "後數十日，三單于反問至，乃遣鄢陵侯彰爲驍騎將軍征之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "bef476272bd49816965d0de4da396d3623a80fa923adbc9827d127edcde47ef0"}

{"id": "p_63da3574f19633b0", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 252, "text": "潛出爲沛國相，遷兗州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "9aa09444dbf96515b2f3e02edcd3edb88fdbcb1c32bf9814b1e486807bc748cc"}

{"id": "p_ebcbe0e480769a8c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 253, "text": "太祖次摩陂，歎其軍陳齊整，特加賞賜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "8067026151505afc59ae7feda8aaad2ab59f521b527b3cb6093c3ef811f44a2f"}

{"id": "p_cb7c95da5f6205ba", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 254, "text": "文帝踐阼，入爲散騎常侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "faa712c1119741bb8c1077343f215793fba5b004bf8e6170aa5eec9f8091ff6e"}

{"id": "p_28cbcb745ee29770", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 255, "text": "出爲魏郡、潁川典農中郎將，奏通貢舉，比之郡國，由是農官進仕路泰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "2a94a9c7d002f60a37a9d2edb42229adc05dd595a95b73584fa986b6f19fbda3"}

{"id": "p_5c95fe35da357111", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 256, "text": "遷荊州刺史，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "98ec4dd36be60e038c8f2d70d491e96f4747caa1495ff79072b3262def27c7b0"}

{"id": "p_cae14029dc0e2c08", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 257, "text": "出爲河南尹，轉太尉軍師、大司農，封清陽亭侯，邑二百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "2fe31cd960c5fd4ae35d1fdfbbc609b2164fe069a2cc119016269ce6762e3f51"}

{"id": "p_7fe48fc0d4afc76c", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 258, "text": "入爲尚書令，奏正分職，料簡名實，出事使斷官府者百五十餘條。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "697708ecea6442808a24679c76adcebcdccd7e0f225b1d9a01d68974bfe31541"}

{"id": "p_e40a4dde0eaecf95", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 259, "text": "薨，追贈太常，諡曰貞侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "bb72eddefc8828d4955736bc755f31c7bdba5bae0fa96006a1190b4f4c070bcc"}

{"id": "p_250c85989aac6b5e", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 260, "text": "遺令儉葬，墓中惟置一坐，瓦器數枚，其餘一無所設。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "2763614fcfac0656b021b44519c4f86448195c20dbd64d7dac9ba02758aba9cd"}

{"id": "p_e2bbd9c530775f5f", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 261, "text": "評曰：和洽清和幹理，常林素業純固，楊俊人倫行義，杜襲溫粹識統，趙儼剛毅有度，裴潛平恆貞幹，皆一世之美士也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "887b26ef70a92c6cc34d7d1d370fa07e63bbed09790cd44ba91ae6a32be8d9f7"}

{"id": "p_1ae53adb10eafdd4", "source_id": "src_57a5271c10f59e09", "ordinal": 262, "text": "至林能不繫心於三司，以大夫告老，美矣哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "771c7483fcd7ce8f8b1676c43fe34c56ea64f73d0b73ba9069f27b55f61f8109"}

{"id": "p_537b49c53a314a35", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_9357fd3ad0ab3384", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 1, "text": "韓曁字公至，南陽堵陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "c3011e84c1fcbab2637e6a8cb4499f39dcc97e28976ebe50f2e07df38ef602c8"}

{"id": "p_213be19a4ce9e6bd", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 2, "text": "同縣豪右陳茂，譖曁父兄，幾至大辟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "713f89aaca3c5b4fd76a43eea19b4881aaf8700fe9d8ae3493f40298552241d9"}

{"id": "p_4efc4713afa5ad2f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 3, "text": "曁陽不以為言，庸賃積資，陰結死士，遂追呼尋禽茂，以首祭父墓，由是顯名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "0926087b35f396a3c08508c9a9258f69f856c7b443968738d8d735daad15601d"}

{"id": "p_78126c3498e7a14c", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 4, "text": "舉孝廉，司空辟，皆不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "b2b524f74cc604797dbc8ffa1e35d457c19b77761c46d46a914db85d34b18dbf"}

{"id": "p_314327a80d2d0e06", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 5, "text": "乃變名姓，隱居避亂魯陽山中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "1037df0cc518ba4e997edf616942857da3a6b6a10b267397bf89220bfd434fa1"}

{"id": "p_2c35551b172c8752", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 6, "text": "曁散家財以供牛酒，請其渠帥，為陳安危。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "94e8a31d8c07b47a33e054cd507673a7b6aeecde56f0b575d4c6e63bc7d50508"}

{"id": "p_9dcef747b407388d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 7, "text": "避袁術命召，徙居山都之山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "236b14e837d0bd3c426efbd266c94a362230e856b538c0d92a0ea3f58c7c3fd7"}

{"id": "p_69dddc44d8b3c689", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 8, "text": "荊州牧劉表禮辟，遂遁逃，南居孱陵界，所在見敬愛，而表深恨之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "2d22c69329e1ad0082c14d7fc3a57a605880605cd8e8a28d51c9c3b56a737af8"}

{"id": "p_50783e20c6c34d75", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 9, "text": "太祖平荊州，辟為丞相士曹屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "4257c9554c852e7cf600bdbf7c3d0427883ce0771b8bafdf0a4dde67a8340a28"}

{"id": "p_6781336d7cf4aef4", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 10, "text": "後選樂陵太守，徙監冶謁者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "8ac1134fa9945fb5dc4e9ea3435f3e5ec77b43bf88c4159f92621540cf9ade90"}

{"id": "p_706234ff5f6860ac", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 11, "text": "舊時冶，作馬排，每一熟石用馬百匹；更作人排，又費功力；曁乃因長流為水排，計其利益，三倍於前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "01474e4cf20c3ed87d978a42c55f20e14890b38624e7dee5c219008b6f1b313a"}

{"id": "p_3c3208f31f2429a2", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 12, "text": "制書襃歎，就加司金都尉，班亞九卿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "5ef3dd3e4b932d27b4f286d6df7175e87700d36d78a92e1822fc2e7373001b5d"}

{"id": "p_b4516eb17d28aed1", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 13, "text": "，遷太常，進封南鄉亭侯，邑二百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "9c2ea54395151f8497f1039537b835f052c7e85241e351b84ade5512088a75bb"}

{"id": "p_bd73c6e8bb81480b", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 14, "text": "時新都洛陽，制度未備，而宗廟主祏皆在鄴都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "a20966b39a91c1c53532ace6129f472e098ca0125a00adceed246c62ad18c949"}

{"id": "p_b64df1377f56ea0f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 15, "text": "曁奏請迎鄴四廟神主，建立洛陽廟，四時蒸嘗，親奉粢盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "67fb491242ed73568c1047a1cd86728f2a815fd24db60478da8542d13ab631ca"}

{"id": "p_c206f5eb9e7ecc08", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 16, "text": "崇明正禮，廢去淫祀，多所匡正。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "cbee9f64506d734175c1bb72c9935072da513afe12df1e8e119c3d56668347f8"}

{"id": "p_58155573dcaf979f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 17, "text": "春，詔曰：「」夏四月薨，遺令歛以時服，葬為土藏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "85c2af1027cc48340c78ffc6946a1742acd0e98ca5dd3e437f8f3517ae354e86"}

{"id": "p_4ae08870c7d15c7f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 18, "text": "崔林字德儒，清河東武城人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "1c70bab9dc3e6a01e889712b6cb74d85c16251e57c5e2d400f79df756763c1d5"}

{"id": "p_d2a56e21d876616b", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 19, "text": "少時晚成，宗族莫知，惟從兄琰異之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "ca86ae081382f7ae06d65e12e993e37142bb020c463baea80233b9fc82be3a4f"}

{"id": "p_12256c1d98fd7f4f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 20, "text": "太祖定冀州，召除鄔長，貧無車馬，單步之官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "f8667c654bf51eaf2c083cb52c78b8f3df0a05987a8719afb8bae485ac123378"}

{"id": "p_36247905c531432b", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 21, "text": "太祖征壺關，問長吏德政最者，并州刺史張陟以林對，於是擢為冀州主簿，徙署別駕、丞相掾屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f62f964df4aca1cca7d689577e67aa1398c893e14df7b1e95410b59beb3266ec"}

{"id": "p_1a794b8aad3041a9", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 22, "text": "魏國旣建，稍遷御史中丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "a2f349bfd8ea364e55ee7ab7ae12aa3ee91a43c5b7dc88d6089dd361a6e37644"}

{"id": "p_2da5b5d00b3bd4e8", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 23, "text": "文帝踐阼，拜尚書，出為幽州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "9f09267cf96abe02a848da98483c11ed3ddb8f1b752487f783db77f29591b422"}

{"id": "p_fcdc27077aa46741", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 24, "text": "北中郎將吳質統河北軍事，涿郡太守王雄謂林別駕曰：「吳中郎將，上所親重，國之貴臣也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "47c086c39bcd2fa58b96fdc3cff194de11dbcbaa9f599a8015924f85b6ea30a4"}

{"id": "p_8c0e680e8c2e7306", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 25, "text": "杖節統事，州郡莫不奉牋致敬，而崔使君初不與相聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "1498c41e7e7f03b0d6b09614928c487b507d1f01b181ff20db0677da051807d0"}

{"id": "p_69d189ecba8951b5", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 26, "text": "若以邊塞不脩斬卿，使君寧能護卿邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "19c818515b0d686f4c05cf8357cd0cc7a597bcbccc1a89e79c8f673701ff30bc"}

{"id": "p_18b1b7f3c3041fe0", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」別駕具以白林，林曰：「刺史視去此州如脫屣，寧當相累邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "d9ee3659114f70867efbd9b40fc64ca75fa6e90d03106a723a750761356ba036"}

{"id": "p_c3fb0f3ff7384a35", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 28, "text": "此州與胡虜接，宜鎮之以靜，擾之則動其逆心，特為國家生北顧憂，以此為寄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "1263de0b1802712c78355e3d42f49bc614201fa7c29cb440073fbb1fe9b02f57"}

{"id": "p_b0d435fbd3d00704", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」在官一期，寇竊寢息；猶以不事上司，左遷河間太守，清論多為林怨也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "b6f054a355200091a92ec90b11cb48dabe1ee69a63af143810d923739fce5978"}

{"id": "p_f8d2e40a81a57e6d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 30, "text": "龜茲王遣侍子來朝，朝廷嘉其遠至，襃賞其王甚厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "f95cc88d68997de7b9eec45dc58398b4198a38d815b56f954df8de209f07ffe1"}

{"id": "p_902999802cf2e927", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 31, "text": "餘國各遣子來朝，閒使連屬，林恐所遣或非真的，權取疏屬賈胡，因通使命，利得印綬，而道路護送，所損滋多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "379067b876c0c570078f6720801294e4384a21e965ab153f4b6e69c6d6c428fa"}

{"id": "p_c1aa6b4d233fd44d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 32, "text": "勞所養之民，資無益之事，為夷狄所笑，此曩時之所患也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "702b7269384a62e235a769d258bbed515e833472c6e26f51509762ef973ec752"}

{"id": "p_c305f5561b263acb", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 33, "text": "乃移書燉煌喻指，并錄前世待遇諸國豐約故事，使有恒常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "d1b7bd97632b9d2dee1e3cf9a9dffade2cfecbcd51b698b934b5f344de2b468f"}

{"id": "p_edb365d8a7603ce8", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 34, "text": "明帝即位，賜爵關內侯，轉光祿勳、司隷校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "6e683e261d59b07b6155d43565cc46d5e5aa4f0304b7d12a934105ba29798f30"}

{"id": "p_99e6104a521fa263", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 35, "text": "林為政推誠，簡存大體，是以去後每輒見思。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "7a51259b4615d36927ee784256438360b22711e6279e9af2bd28f293b0432de4"}

{"id": "p_5ea6a2c93d35a0d2", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 36, "text": "散騎常侍劉劭作考課論，制下百僚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "52331cd2dfefb3f8a65c74025c8da7287daf2772d59dd199971b94faf3e75e83"}

{"id": "p_62e2aa61f272ccd9", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 37, "text": "林議曰：「案周官考課，其文備矣，自康王以下，遂以陵遲，此即考課之法存乎其人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "648353e50189eae3163ac7714a8cf7612b06fdea8f23026cc1859d1377ba11fd"}

{"id": "p_05b7088e3852921f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 38, "text": "及漢之季，其失豈在乎佐吏之職不密哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "3e78848a441185ce27471fdd887b124eec7f7cb9b3d330c89fe6799f829dcb2a"}

{"id": "p_3a42f2b074ed6d22", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 39, "text": "方今軍旅，或猥或卒，備之以科條，申之以內外，增減無常，固難一矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "f679af068188ca083195d1b6de2bc9ad5cd8b09a207c1fdfc4fceb624035ff7f"}

{"id": "p_aa96b3239ccd18cd", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 40, "text": "且萬目不張舉其綱，衆毛不整振其領。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "3f9e38d1fdd16c8d33e860df15477e3e0b730daa8e9489997e189d5b67ada18b"}

{"id": "p_32494c1a4230ca0d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 41, "text": "臯陶仕虞，伊尹臣殷，不仁者遠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "2f4f07d73441201bbf8d18df3d42f7625a263774aad724dabba2caed023163fc"}

{"id": "p_4a8ba2f9a425ee22", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 42, "text": "五帝三王未必如一，而各以治亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "d273949b545b3f7d96b16f7a551b0708b88c1e58b7ecd8176a18960b66c0c482"}

{"id": "p_417c0da059f9713a", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 43, "text": "易曰：『易簡，而天下之理得矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "307075bb2bdfda6da7d6b4f57f8696b0e89a675e33bcdefe65d3fb7be4f795da"}

{"id": "p_70951c3aa78f234e", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 44, "text": "』太祖隨宜設辟，以遺來今，不患不法古也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "d3258536ce1b3ba0da00d7aef83b0f427561d6cbbbef2177fc36d6cf053b9628"}

{"id": "p_da3db64f34d0511c", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 45, "text": "以為今之制度，不為疏闊，惟在守一勿失而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "63c0eb6692e90de745ce36e8ca788b198b37aa7da2c6052c1718ab9335a8c8c7"}

{"id": "p_b7042f3878f93ce8", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 46, "text": "若朝臣能任仲山甫之重，式是百辟，則孰敢不肅？", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "a567f2473be461e38b4dfa722d43fac6831a836fc56d3b6095e50dac5e88c2f0"}

{"id": "p_03da986a88f963a7", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 47, "text": "，司徒、司空並缺，散騎侍郎孟康薦林曰：「夫宰相者，天下之所瞻效，誠宜得秉忠履正本德杖義之士，足為海內所師表者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "2f1d464304d942db79d7762dae90b51aa809f8be6c89c4c0fb82bd9febab766b"}

{"id": "p_ce1b9d212c1440cc", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 48, "text": "竊見司隷校尉崔林，稟自然之正性，體高雅之弘量。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "65975449b5f6832ab81f523b8910eee712a2cbdc84bda4ad24d05f5290bf969c"}

{"id": "p_5837b595c94ae37b", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 49, "text": "論其所長以比古人，忠直不回則史魚之儔，清儉守約則季文之匹也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "264ff4bd1c5d76d15ef917a234a0287f3ee8527e90d71413f3db99a2ab0f79c5"}

{"id": "p_19c58c24e81409df", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 50, "text": "牧守州郡，所在而治，及為外司，萬里肅齊，誠台輔之妙器，衮職之良才也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "7ecddd3cb933cac3b8bbd06c9183cede944803b0bd3ff782b5848503360855b7"}

{"id": "p_a916faa29264fc5f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」後年遂為司空，封安陽亭侯，邑六百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "bcdba2db255047249ce835b97f7eddb4e40731844bfa6a4c146efbdf0105826f"}

{"id": "p_cd4b94e002112dbb", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 52, "text": "魯相上言：「漢舊立孔子廟，襃成侯歲時奉祠，辟雍行禮，必祭先師，王家出穀，春秋祭祀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "62eb738e79ff0c9c8ea14f496ad544b15c8c75e9cd23df2d1aba073d9ffb7bd1"}

{"id": "p_e6ad5f91c0a58f09", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 53, "text": "今宗聖侯奉嗣，未有命祭之禮，宜給牲牢，長吏奉祀，尊為貴神。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "72ee26d00421d515c6c520a2b9e676b9e5741aa24fa549c607b52b62fe83b470"}

{"id": "p_3aeba3b17daefc2d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 54, "text": "」制三府議，博士傅祗以春秋傳言立在祀典，則孔子是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "a3c07b1151656cfc64087b5975a7d448d14f0260665939a52f50bb4394f04829"}

{"id": "p_a6f4c21d03d3a21b", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 55, "text": "宗聖適足繼絕世，章盛德耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "7fefa63d5ed0b978278a4670396c61304c3e57db67c605b9063a6cd8caefa644"}

{"id": "p_a6f011a409926ffd", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 56, "text": "至於顯立言，崇明德，則宜如魯相所上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "e55029f82254baab762d079808b58cf5209ef6a085af7cc83e24c3ebc597f124"}

{"id": "p_299b0f63cb3dda38", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 57, "text": "明帝又分林邑，封一子列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "2a5e422dbe45a59e8051626efd7a32a9a07252998121d9d275a647074d37cb51"}

{"id": "p_674da03b64fba980", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 58, "text": "高柔字文惠，陳留圉人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "b60c5a7573863d1b9f1957c0f707df5ccfd5d2b2fef99c8c609be31776f4bc14"}

{"id": "p_6bc8c7e1641fbc6a", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 59, "text": "柔留鄉里，謂邑中曰：「今者英雄並起，陳留四戰之地也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "0e91d7ded3456ce001dedbd74a3ca96aca8b413217c2b362a3cde08b7c43f9db"}

{"id": "p_73ee3c8c9c710969", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 60, "text": "曹將軍雖據兖州，本有四方之圖，未得安坐守也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "29a6d479fc05948b77e138adcedb650af2f55cefae8ec87eb6877ea0d26a7d71"}

{"id": "p_2dc7c064581cef89", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 61, "text": "而張府君先得志於陳留，吾恐變乘間作也，欲與諸君避之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "d43844d771dc523ca5ad17516173a20e4344aa697f4e7c09ffcd68d77691e798"}

{"id": "p_42620e8def2dcf71", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」衆人皆以張邈與太祖善，柔又年少，不然其言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "f957194d00430e8d32be429f529b47117afa4f0e0fee1fb8f6d30aea330499bc"}

{"id": "p_71beb78c8b7c89f8", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 63, "text": "柔從兄幹，袁紹甥也，在河北呼柔，柔舉宗從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "15a77c00a4b13d8308e49d1b53eac7a7f59de46970c163560cd4137c8b200d81"}

{"id": "p_ef3fad625501f653", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 64, "text": "會靖卒於西州，時道路艱澁，兵寇縱橫，而柔冒艱險詣蜀迎喪，辛苦荼毒，無所不嘗，三年乃還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "6761e2ba2f93ce4d7b7e1b794345d1671b59a2969d1018b0996b4cb63c90e93c"}

{"id": "p_934232afaadb07de", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 65, "text": "太祖平袁氏，以柔為菅長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "c343a75c24c7be28cfa03c5bdfa39deaee323e58c71aa13f37075dc892948109"}

{"id": "p_be683836f3b28703", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 66, "text": "縣中素聞其名，姧吏數人皆自引去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "e43be7ada32ba5e0c65f3fde5353910240fdc9eb07c19ef01e7140d90fa1258b"}

{"id": "p_5bda4161f84eff62", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 67, "text": "柔教曰：「昔邴吉臨政，吏嘗有非，猶尚容之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "2930b7d4bc4313b18d8b72b4a82f947d151a944aa6d6cb1503291eec9de8d811"}

{"id": "p_c3031e51fbc9ae3a", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 68, "text": "況此諸吏，於吾未有失乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "31f95591a1bd75971fb86b17c7c5fe2ad221a9bd08ea62716db15b480d2f465a"}

{"id": "p_653ca62a0588ff27", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」咸還，皆自勵，咸為佳吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "d806769d97e2869e2c489b0c83629490c6212e914e3a2c49ac18168e0da79a30"}

{"id": "p_bc730740c8593d24", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 70, "text": "高幹旣降，頃之以并州叛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "08bce555812467a370c030792e191bba3a29302f8b1a17737ef5c023fbfb4d84"}

{"id": "p_3ba867598ebf3e20", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 71, "text": "柔自歸太祖，太祖欲因事誅之，以為刺姧令史；處法允當，獄無留滯，辟為丞相倉曹屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "57d5d4fc0687677952ee80dd146202eb025e09f5a8543598adfa8515a9133f63"}

{"id": "p_d474e1f8ae154ae7", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 72, "text": "太祖欲遣鍾繇等討張魯，柔諫，以為今猥遣大兵，西有韓遂、馬超，謂為己舉，將相扇動作逆，宜先招集三輔，三輔苟平，漢中可傳檄而定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "55de7f46b2de0f2a78651fdde1a745388fd179f55862159ea10b7915ebdf6dc4"}

{"id": "p_b27fdee0ae5a309c", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 73, "text": "轉拜丞相理曹掾，令曰：「夫治定之化，以禮為首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "184251dfff327a2eb0890359b25b7650cccf0265effbd518b8114a337e15b1ff"}

{"id": "p_df0915e71e309866", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 74, "text": "是以舜流四凶族，臯陶作士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "6c75a5246c22b2e48912fe996a395c158d439b6ab3d158355eab42dcd17ff5c2"}

{"id": "p_7235744e46e364bf", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 75, "text": "漢祖除秦苛法，蕭何定律。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "dcfbcbc97ec9d9a5ec18e023e311c001db38fb81a9af6e057547f393adbede9c"}

{"id": "p_aaf913b2641d6d86", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 76, "text": "掾清識平當，明于憲典，勉恤之哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "621992a0432e911dcde9c5cb6220353e1da6089ad872e29ed3f0b0f633ed1f8b"}

{"id": "p_854a5c5d6d027b04", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」鼓吹宋金等在合肥亡逃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "6c0a07a5caf573b2e62ae09eebdaf1678a5132a67e01bd2effee7935523b6fcb"}

{"id": "p_b2100b1acf91e71d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 78, "text": "舊法，軍征士亡，考竟其妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "57851572c5bc336a851aadc7c69be596db830495a55dc4566f54eaec0decb759"}

{"id": "p_82fd46723bb8dce2", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 79, "text": "太祖患猶不息，更重其刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "0a2a6c1d32e40ed24d6d3ffc569fe735fe2d46eff1c085f83d4fb347505e3d7e"}

{"id": "p_8cec3ee08f40a546", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 80, "text": "金有母妻及二弟皆給官，主者奏盡殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "8df0d0c34071dc23add5d9d4f211649471e54e74c5b40b1f916c17d6b283443c"}

{"id": "p_3e777c352248838e", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 81, "text": "柔啟曰：「士卒亡軍，誠在可疾，然竊聞其中時有悔者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "6909a887543b00127c43a97b9c60404a548531b9a8e16ab2bfe71998422acdb8"}

{"id": "p_cc50872d1c78ad75", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 82, "text": "愚謂乃宜貸其妻子，一可使賊中不信，二可使誘其還心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "18e18472e7e8854cb93882fefdac21516b0723a161e05d407b59b2b848e9fae0"}

{"id": "p_4cf5fa931392c170", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 83, "text": "正如前科，固已絕其意望，而猥復重之，柔恐自今在軍之士，見一人亡逃，誅將及己，亦且相隨而走，不可復得殺也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "de5a60fcd3aef4f46ffe90c9ecdc08cec80f493297002762822ff8956e17c8cc"}

{"id": "p_dded664a3d0b5170", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 84, "text": "此重刑非所以止亡，乃所以益走耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "7229fe97991549a14184cbcabd776246daf7ee06b12311a02d706bfe0f615df3"}

{"id": "p_0ec5c47974628652", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 85, "text": "」即止不殺金母、弟，蒙活者甚衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "cdbdadc735dcb1d2fa99b590e58d91d1ca2a188de8834be1e199868094a0ddfb"}

{"id": "p_28c5b1cdfcb4be2d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 86, "text": "遷為潁川太守，復還為法曹掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "79be7391c109aec53098dc0f60ab27a6028f89ccf8d2b468b9b2c9d9d7ce80b0"}

{"id": "p_8ce546ce473cc417", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 87, "text": "時置校事盧洪、趙達等，使察羣下，柔諫曰：「設官分職，各有所司。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "83fc5ca325094dc53c5094d71ad07fdea2c3a82eda9bd0e9becb371e4aa41d89"}

{"id": "p_2ce217e9d3b201f5", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 88, "text": "今置校事，旣非居上信下之旨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "3f58932e55dd75964a37560f70a7cc28246097715a1fb1416c7cda2ac45e80b9"}

{"id": "p_a3d3189e322d2841", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 89, "text": "又達等數以憎愛擅作威福，宜檢治之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "c38669174eadd7048e557a14faa75998fa3dcba2721dab47b414afda18794fc4"}

{"id": "p_c7624b4c3c18b0df", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 90, "text": "」太祖曰：「卿知達等，恐不如吾也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "2aab96b7a40a57003370e71576f21805aa47536ec217880b4afb727544ee67dd"}

{"id": "p_15732d1145c28759", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 91, "text": "要能刺舉而辨衆事，使賢人君子為之，則不能也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "93662c775b9c476fcefab2bb7cc2ac3136d76a024c216034b1419d625d15039d"}

{"id": "p_db4dabd0cc184a1e", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 92, "text": "昔叔孫通用羣盜，良有以也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "bc9e8920b3faa0ef30d896d200c4bdbeee88a22e253eb29ed40337d755492837"}

{"id": "p_56f87e74f679c3e2", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 93, "text": "」達等後姧利發，太祖殺之以謝於柔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "864c2eb85c4ad731a62c7ed15daa2776d4bee0758069fe8eaa73e215e4d8e431"}

{"id": "p_7b687042d120eb01", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 94, "text": "文帝踐阼，以柔為治書侍御史，賜爵關內侯，轉加治書執法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "ddaffb032bcb8c434846ef2dff6ee43252ccecffa015553a9ad39f13ef6df953"}

{"id": "p_b6935aed32319eec", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 95, "text": "民間數有誹謗妖言，帝疾之，有妖言輒殺，而賞告者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "aecbee0ccfba630974bcbfe42f5ad84238ee8f92ed3b3d776a2893c5752c0ba7"}

{"id": "p_ea2192d490d78955", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 96, "text": "柔上疏曰：「」帝不即從，而相誣告者滋甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "dce15200ba43a99d50d0ad0f10001a03f9d9f8288521e6b588e8a928bb12cf90"}

{"id": "p_6fd6deee56c7663f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 97, "text": "帝乃下詔：「敢以誹謗相告者，以所告者罪罪之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "87df4e7068ef0fa4d012a725a632e990b8f578ce08279eca29395683e184b2e2"}

{"id": "p_a0a11f595ed1240e", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 98, "text": "校事劉慈等，自黃初初數年之閒，舉吏民姧罪以萬數，柔皆請懲虛實；其餘小小挂法者，不過罰金。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "35dd40e1d490780669048cbc41528411e30e1307a7b61106ddfa44f41522c70e"}

{"id": "p_36a8b3acefa250ec", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 99, "text": "魏初，三公無事，又希與朝政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "cc6eaef789e38c1536f5bf6c2ee45731401bf6061aa442ae48df1e3b460c82e9"}

{"id": "p_933b551f728522a8", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 100, "text": "柔上疏曰：「」帝嘉納焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "07bdbcbfd7511bd09fe53cd756a3f6f6e38e7d2e4392a3d2b9fe08720cb81d9f"}

{"id": "p_fbc61e8b5c7b75d2", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 101, "text": "帝以宿嫌，欲枉法誅治書執法鮑勛，而柔固執不從詔命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "649dcc1e44dd7c7797904b31b0c1cb7a1096641024da25b39f56746d51c97960"}

{"id": "p_0115273249ca3fdc", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 102, "text": "帝怒甚，遂召柔詣臺；遣使者承指至廷尉考竟勛，勛死乃遣柔還寺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "a2bc24c74b9a0e9b2c13772030dba887c22574babaabb65424d6665a24e5a496"}

{"id": "p_53fb7810e811ea32", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 103, "text": "明帝即位，封柔延壽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "fd8cecbef258df5fca08a9c58cf6c0c8cbb309ab13d8254233d13b1ee64dab07"}

{"id": "p_c0e209e317393d3a", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 104, "text": "時博士執經，柔上疏曰：「」帝納之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "a0d052092e421a0c6b2e17fb5e137db8e729782c1bce64a73f0a18d7ec058290"}

{"id": "p_68b62b9613e33193", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 105, "text": "後大興殿舍，百姓勞役；廣采衆女，充盈後宮；後宮皇子連夭，繼嗣未育。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "cdf0e0afff5f881815d025a803710b57e8d7685b1fd412fe83ba8254ce1371b0"}

{"id": "p_a061f084514605cd", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 106, "text": "柔上疏曰：「」帝報曰：「知卿忠允，乃心王室，輒克昌言；他復以聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "8867503daf2b08ee237e0273e2b388c3528e922cee8ea95bf6d67defe7f644f7"}

{"id": "p_6f6503c9ed4959b1", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 107, "text": "宜陽典農劉龜竊於禁內射兎，其功曹張京詣校事言之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "528292956ba49b23b1579fd83bf61d9859fde14d053578fbc0f6aef0a2121048"}

{"id": "p_f003a42495a1f803", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 108, "text": "柔表請告者名，帝大怒曰：「劉龜當死，乃敢獵吾禁地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "e9507fb7eb700feed38b2f072f158e17394657f41784a0a4f63f8fdee937736a"}

{"id": "p_3b3872d0d54a20d3", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 109, "text": "送龜廷尉，廷尉便當考掠，何復請告者主名，吾豈妄收龜邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "8d685967170494fec9762177f16f6c0b89321a45d082e4b49af00e94df7d04ed"}

{"id": "p_278672de505e4268", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 110, "text": "」柔曰：「廷尉，天下之平也，安得以至尊喜怒而毀法乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "4e25ae1421b7ef002ec7008fbf8333d2d6fd74b5d1c21d70e812c49f65dc1c4e"}

{"id": "p_4df0cce5d269769d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 111, "text": "時制，吏遭大喪者，百日後皆給役。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "403e999e26dfaeb8b64c0d4416ed28303f73ae0769f0a7396eb414254007e22f"}

{"id": "p_5dfc7185d968439f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 112, "text": "有司徒吏解弘遭父喪，後有軍事，受勑當行，以疾病為辭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "d5c2c5f0d9b96d3c2617abc01d72e7182ba65df354a8c207430ca5a1746f8b29"}

{"id": "p_8675258f3bb3cef4", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 113, "text": "詔怒曰：「汝非曾、閔，何言毀邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "f5e83ce7dcc2258d36c58fe360f62eef44a48aedb834ed0e1a6dabe9ea62b102"}

{"id": "p_fbd3553aa1d6b053", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 114, "text": "柔見弘信甚羸劣，奏陳其事，宜加寬貸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "0b0e196f4774736622c1303bdb271f5901edda1bc018a6c3bd81654a6fe3a1c5"}

{"id": "p_0e24c3b524c22828", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 115, "text": "初，公孫淵兄晃，為叔父恭任內侍，先淵未反，數陳其變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "7153b504c53e2da5f98f54a7f42932c8be7171c530c8dd24c52089dc3c08e639"}

{"id": "p_1add5d5192cee841", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 116, "text": "及淵謀逆，帝不忍巿斬，欲就獄殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "46d20310a6b6adb4d6b3f3f5e3df27def72e3e7d0bc6e2fbd2017599b12e96d9"}

{"id": "p_256825583318350b", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 117, "text": "柔上疏曰：「」帝不聽，竟遣使齎金屑飲晃及其妻子，賜以棺、衣，殯歛於宅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "303f306d1a181d2bc2525ccd85c9b050708ac21cd3eba080a71f45918581a962"}

{"id": "p_00a36d58b43e4f38", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 118, "text": "是時，殺禁地鹿者身死，財產沒官，有能覺告者厚加賞賜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "5ca1e603d98d82f7c19602f820af9a2f00c9d5a08b61a404f427bbff227fe9f7"}

{"id": "p_acdf253e43c26a74", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 119, "text": "頃之，護軍營士竇禮近出不還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "be364dc63617cdcf15da029dabd4cee929b11217a754a4ad646906e04eed1f7e"}

{"id": "p_317692b1e5631694", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 120, "text": "營以為亡，表言逐捕，沒其妻盈及男女為官奴婢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "f8c5bcccdeb9888007e306002f9aa2c76052dbb5e3493199c99960123982d3f9"}

{"id": "p_d50e198406f25d8f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 121, "text": "盈連至州府，稱冤自訟，莫有省者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "864ed257cc4521bda9df55a39b31e704256668fe00aeaff09c7f98cb363e4451"}

{"id": "p_737e7e0c0dc738cf", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 122, "text": "柔問曰：「汝何以知夫不亡？", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "57cf907d6186c04e6b501ce47e63f21cf96f425feda549dac565af9c0accce85"}

{"id": "p_6e5d6505154d21f7", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」盈垂泣對曰：「夫少單特，養一老嫗為母，事甚恭謹，又哀兒女，撫視不離，非是輕狡不顧室家者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "aafc0d98aa50967c2eca7a6defe2aa430fc1ca84737843e97331cbb5a640a1c0"}

{"id": "p_2d07c916c0e81780", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 124, "text": "」柔重問曰：「汝夫不與人有怨讎乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "e5c94d27ce787128bcd3b83bbd46491c208899c41115b942fceceaabff8fe5d7"}

{"id": "p_3a4d5de62a63c933", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 125, "text": "」對曰：「夫良善，與人無讎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "01bcb63a58fd9401b24165051f6b941e81a7405ed3f16b3769bc2cf0f49e3423"}

{"id": "p_05f5cc9156e773fc", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 126, "text": "」又曰：「汝夫不與人交錢財乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "644801aa1a8102539dd5380895309643436e6cafc0e11865d517cf1296a6c5e0"}

{"id": "p_0e381909390cbdc4", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」對曰：「嘗出錢與同營士焦子文，求不得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "35fc979fbf6bafb071d5da76d40cc258a989f028d074501997efac890fa4bcf8"}

{"id": "p_95b8bd23418281a2", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 128, "text": "」時子文適坐小事繫獄，柔乃見子文，問所坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "79d497fac7771d8c1096422e51b110c858e3f0c297c260e1150b10539aef6c76"}

{"id": "p_fb1571368cbb96d4", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 129, "text": "言次，曰：「汝頗曾舉人錢不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "6945dba39f2d732a5f670b05cbd886790322ec4fd2b4400ceec91b01ee40369e"}

{"id": "p_17710055031da0dd", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 130, "text": "」子文曰：「自以單貧，初不敢舉人錢物也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "432ff11e40c67e2b382bfb2affa7909c3eb437ad7342ee626f28cd59da79ead7"}

{"id": "p_d9e8843975741f8f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 131, "text": "」柔察子文色動，遂曰：「汝昔舉竇禮錢，何言不邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "e57db5ec0e6cdce045d26aa841398a221e75317240cd94e1a4331cc178d718e5"}

{"id": "p_4b40e2e7df2f16ea", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」子文恠知事露，應對不次。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "58a1082a1ca44daafad421138a08da5c462ed25f3028f4989345ba7565a1c9ec"}

{"id": "p_56a83a3ee63fc104", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 133, "text": "柔曰：「汝已殺禮，便宜早服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "1fb6b1b8772bc53b16ce6a2c120826e5ac7983e4d52e0b730878db837fde64b3"}

{"id": "p_e916cc27c9b32e06", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 134, "text": "」子文於是叩頭，具首殺禮本末，埋藏處所。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "bd04671ac3771df5c22a8f24ce08d7cd53ca39deee8432d2a4f0684dfbe34972"}

{"id": "p_cc98aa5d0e6a5db0", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 135, "text": "柔便遣吏卒，承子文辭往掘禮，即得其屍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "3fa0d8de47acae3137286e2bfe1e18b4e6e219bf88cda81a4366b84c2a056baa"}

{"id": "p_40acca7dff7a2f6d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 136, "text": "在官二十三年，轉為太常，旬日遷司空，後徙司徒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "182cb3819db5e1b90b88a69f854363ec94437d4be9d550e6033bec2e50c49e3c"}

{"id": "p_f4372443a79799c0", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 137, "text": "太傅司馬宣王奏免曹爽，皇太后詔召柔假節行大將軍事，據爽營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "916624c1dd971fb2efb1c8f68a2d43af0467397f07f2828a2e2456d0a7a76ee1"}

{"id": "p_aa923abbb09c4ee0", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 138, "text": "太傅謂柔曰：「君為周勃矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "9fa2a99496b7c6707e72b4e7fac388631be9ff46c18dabf377290826201cebcf"}

{"id": "p_b9f29776cae3ca8e", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 139, "text": "高貴鄉公即位，進封安國侯，轉為太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "7511a1433ee0d9b142177e0069fb1861a6b8dfb3bf28e587a1ac122a73a67b0d"}

{"id": "p_d67401e5bd3af283", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 140, "text": "常道鄉公即位，增邑并前四千，前後封二子亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "b4f4ab7cdc6e8a3b139e6e0bd2d62d2ae79ee77563bcbdb3ede2bd1a84972033"}

{"id": "p_774a3f097d2735fd", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 141, "text": "咸熈中，開建五等，以柔等著勳前朝，改封渾昌陸子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "153d756214dcf8a1892b5c0a6da26f8b3c2c19c7ad4877967c16c66c04215c45"}

{"id": "p_d85d6d973624bfa9", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 142, "text": "孫禮字德達，涿郡容城人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "fb3323dc735df8e76344cde59687f4243212ac5a028c554f9473840fe305f013"}

{"id": "p_609e0250d9b52251", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 143, "text": "太祖平幽州，召為司空軍謀掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "7664b173a25e62c51c612e21fd4322ef97c005d51795be94cf7610996bb1800a"}

{"id": "p_bfde750242ae17e4", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 144, "text": "初喪亂時，禮與母相失，同郡馬台求得禮母，禮推家財盡以與台。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "bc94fc3a01ac3cd1194e30133ceb885851c4142d9390007520e315314031de70"}

{"id": "p_98cd18a84b9607ec", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 145, "text": "台後坐法當死，禮私導令踰獄自首，旣而曰：「臣無逃亡之義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "f4bd7755f07f73c5258164ba4ebbf513aa5f800b0fc3de36925574b91cbe7d6f"}

{"id": "p_92f9d4d87b05c992", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 146, "text": "恢嘉之，具白太祖，各減死一等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "28a7b82028759163a0da78b67112bde725bd1f244ab3ee488b636a296d2fdaf3"}

{"id": "p_c9e8a663d94f5e22", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 147, "text": "後除河間郡丞，稍遷熒陽都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "90401123c2b8da78d04ba703c7194c70c5145dd2367d6753dff118294a4a87e2"}

{"id": "p_b6cc3227f63c8cef", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 148, "text": "魯山中賊數百人，保固險阻，為民作害；乃徙禮為魯相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "6a4591219333e6a8731a9e9ccdc77481c8707cfe38fe6debc070e859a53ca778"}

{"id": "p_105d4e8ebe445449", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 149, "text": "禮至官，出俸穀，發吏民，募首級，招納降附，使還為閒，應時平泰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "75844c684eaa5bf39f1a2d6f82b8436331a6e2b828d62cd448e1e11293305875"}

{"id": "p_7bb12a64dd2bf28d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 150, "text": "歷山陽、平原、平昌、琅邪太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "4254af5745fefb739f2a88957ee089b1bbf3e66bdbeef8a4a070d991b44e1474"}

{"id": "p_97400e21f18e7c60", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 151, "text": "從大司馬曹休征吳於夾石，禮諫以為不可深入，不從而敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "27d833e29d123bf39865a44bbd1106eb42e045641c467637c24aba795e2d1ab6"}

{"id": "p_e734e4792cf7317b", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 152, "text": "明帝方脩宮室，而節氣不和，天下少穀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "26539d19f113b6a5dcd86083f44e1c08d6ee242fc3fed468d7c0b9abab3a8839"}

{"id": "p_891714ad710caaef", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 153, "text": "禮固爭，罷役，詔曰：「敬納讜言，促遣民作。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "9cf53e709bfe36cbb59aaa72c49b4f79f4066912dce5a44af07e3df2c0bb7ed8"}

{"id": "p_bcbe1204be220f57", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」時李惠監作，復奏留一月，有所成訖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "cb0329bb8948e60ad536f8d88460ce0a218baec2162c312c7c93e96943182412"}

{"id": "p_43c3f6990cc047e0", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 155, "text": "禮徑至作所，不復重奏，稱詔罷民，帝奇其意而不責也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "4e67bf6086383e3441d4184e2d731ab832eeac47519f24cb64e6d404c1acd646"}

{"id": "p_ab858ee40236de1d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 156, "text": "帝獵於大石山，虎趨乘輿，禮便投鞭下馬，欲奮劒斫虎，詔令禮上馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "cfdcae38a1f33c2641d92dc6ad28fe020529cbf0b792b179af0048d086a9a3cc"}

{"id": "p_4769844d9364a86f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 157, "text": "明帝臨崩之時，以曹爽為大將軍，宜得良佐，於牀下受遺詔，拜禮大將軍長史，加散騎常侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "9b24225a050712b5acee16922fb33efa4448be16ad4fe8bca59bbff52c5f43e2"}

{"id": "p_6512fb3db15f0db2", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 158, "text": "禮亮直不撓，爽弗便也，以為揚州刺史，加伏波將軍，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "cca9f3240b679025800484ce95293fd34ea60b48570d0bcd3fb1129f888ec1ff"}

{"id": "p_eec07570a0f60976", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 159, "text": "吳大將全琮帥數萬衆來侵寇，時州兵休使，在者無幾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "422ba3d25221c06dc783a9a53a2287b90dc694213b3a3a8bfc8d482964f589f8"}

{"id": "p_7534060375ee6c43", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 160, "text": "禮躬勒衞兵禦之，戰於芍陂，自旦及暮，將士死傷過半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "58a91df8f226ab2062cfb318d5a975199f84d6d7cffbee6c32be4951b193bbe0"}

{"id": "p_1cd31b9a2dcc3341", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 161, "text": "禮犯蹈白刃，馬被數創，手秉枹鼓，奮不顧身，賊衆乃退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "05584ccce35bf62a135954b1aa058e8c6a39e3d43e51f90ee51fa5dee712cdb1"}

{"id": "p_288dc410927f35b5", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 162, "text": "禮為死事者設祀哭臨，哀號發心，皆以絹付亡者家，無以入身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "38e652eeb3dfbec5fe06eaeffd6a19bc79657d27cfd35d3d6e9650df86d264fa"}

{"id": "p_0f5dddc72d599b8a", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 163, "text": "徵拜少府，出為荊州刺史，遷冀州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "1c39625479a5b4749b8e70082d08bd02c144c1b85aef34356e852a91d7494f33"}

{"id": "p_025097271e8c3ccb", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 164, "text": "太傅司馬宣王謂禮曰：「今清河、平原爭界八年，更二刺史，靡能決之；虞、芮待文王而了，宜善令分明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "cfeeb923d754137bd892f7a9f2384c17e195d23346446b9c6f7e2b27878304b1"}

{"id": "p_69a621d2d514ca12", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 165, "text": "」禮曰：「訟者據墟墓為驗，聽者以先老為正，而老者不可加以榎楚，又墟墓或遷就高敞，或徙避仇讎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "ca255e77b9426714fef84582f87525ee7129be4730a20cad5b35ef61b466ff72"}

{"id": "p_7ead1baddf012cee", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 166, "text": "如今所聞，雖臯陶猶將為難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "d6cc7f49af7dba0dea3abb449b26cf486fc57f0a6be12b1369618987fe2a61b3"}

{"id": "p_972a9548955048a2", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 167, "text": "若欲使必也無訟，當以烈祖初封平原時圖決之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "c311813d566e24a766a1bd3cdb0a8a32d0a35fc6d4020a90c9196f4edc4f6eb4"}

{"id": "p_0ac17b56dbdeac64", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 168, "text": "何必推古問故，以益辭訟？", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "10205fd0d9f7caa1be3240867c62598ec91e30f37da4a4434599b9f97ed7c1fe"}

{"id": "p_2781890c5a3b6bb7", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 169, "text": "昔成王以桐葉戲叔虞，周公便以封之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "4079f9185894907bbac01a705f2bdeb17fd7283d55352a78a906bae27171755d"}

{"id": "p_23a5d534171c7dab", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 170, "text": "今圖藏在天府，便可於坐上斷也，豈待到州乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "382e6131d9b09098428bdceb61a4e18d081260ad38692a6312a053731acd852c"}

{"id": "p_ec633cab47f30c8a", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 171, "text": "而曹爽信清河言，下書云：「圖不可用，當參異同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "368844d1cdb3b2c692cca740086119d005eae2c755684e5613482d5df46b6b6f"}

{"id": "p_8b234fcd69c8eb07", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 172, "text": "」禮上疏曰：「」輒束帶著履，駕車待放。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "a6f4bde7f49f5f15822fa44c522cc0051c8d9789d843246b602b6d60e10c35c8"}

{"id": "p_62c7a6a4b21c5df3", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 173, "text": "在家期年，衆人多以為言，除城門校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "1f2cefbb37670c6843617dee9e7b76970b650b77686a747cd694594f311ddcab"}

{"id": "p_24070bfb975ebcdf", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 174, "text": "時匈奴王劉靖部衆彊盛，而鮮卑數寇邊，乃以禮為并州刺史，加振武將軍，使持節，護匈奴中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "2a67769e26e38a9cbf652fdb65becef5f37eebbe43cb7966714e87596af20fa7"}

{"id": "p_2ddb95a953a50dc8", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 175, "text": "往見太傅司馬宣王，有忿色而無言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "87318cecd996735eb1f25c3a9e4a98c569aaa1db41249e0e682359cfebdd227e"}

{"id": "p_5751fb0dbbcad842", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 176, "text": "宣王曰：「卿得并州，少邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "6ab5d55a0594f1e9d85107839dcb9085526654c20ff394a717b8ccfff739de7a"}

{"id": "p_f966b155d207745b", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 177, "text": "」禮曰：「何明公言之乖細也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "6328abf9289bb21065a215500ad87d98560064154e6249d1fb4621374f1f27db"}

{"id": "p_415f33c9f8b5e486", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 178, "text": "禮雖不德，豈以官位往事為意邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "3b9fe123279b66f1a947a313afd4bb4785d6dfec38578720d307b97916155a7d"}

{"id": "p_2f152de04c5bc470", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 179, "text": "本謂明公齊蹤伊、呂，匡輔魏室，上報明帝之託，下建萬世之勳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "177cbc7e40bb3ffcdcb925f836844b0192a59b6f004ca2520fc7d2656730ea0e"}

{"id": "p_78a83c90f2ee542a", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 180, "text": "今社稷將危，天下兇兇，此禮之所以不恱也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "e3d2a8c57ba90e2472a4e618e5ad2ba3403384d9b834ecf11378aedbf912494a"}

{"id": "p_58b0ac1fe3277887", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 181, "text": "宣王曰：「且止，忍不可忍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "fd512dd6cf710d6780be07841e76b7670e8c467a62eb6e4e372655b72e7b110f"}

{"id": "p_670ecb1aee0473bb", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」爽誅後，入為司隷校尉，凡臨七郡五州，皆有威信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "51680765ca1e6ea3b126fcd8560ed54455e774ec8cf94a338139aa81aaa1de3c"}

{"id": "p_1842aa06c64befc0", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 183, "text": "遷司空，封大利亭侯，邑一百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "d09e13c938cfef9254f68e4187c47b818e5e9797a7a8ecbca7b68f994a77ef1f"}

{"id": "p_3288814f16656627", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 184, "text": "禮與盧毓同郡時輩，而情好不睦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "a81f9887672eb0c773b9d8d683557765392e9826641044b4de784f0fc26bf097"}

{"id": "p_b0fc77de638ccbaa", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 185, "text": "為人雖互有長短，然名位略齊云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "63457ff569440125a9aa2a5dcdd8968415cfd0adf3a8bfd385e7a123e9aaea18"}

{"id": "p_91669960e48a5145", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 186, "text": "王觀字偉臺，東郡廩丘人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "7c6639d5e21d23c3e7c2e3d34ad58c13911ab790f8932d23221fd00dc87463f3"}

{"id": "p_f790ea0be8991acc", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 187, "text": "少孤貧勵志，太祖召為丞相文學掾，出為高唐、陽泉、酇、任令，所在稱治。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "82717587f69035f25c9dc3f5ba0df2272c74651f8b8b7c124b18dda5d5973c0c"}

{"id": "p_34fb295e56751b33", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 188, "text": "文帝踐阼，入為尚書郎、廷尉監，出為南陽、涿郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "94bc0a00488ab920279e9b5783d8c0481ae8596f6620619dea67ffd901543028"}

{"id": "p_5d4a6743c99b4e38", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 189, "text": "涿北接鮮卑，數有寇盜，觀令邊民十家已上，屯居，築京候。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "c0c40c05be987e9515610f7d0307db2bfa512f0c5fa81fa4f60d03faed942ec6"}

{"id": "p_94e46be6da221826", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 190, "text": "時或有不願者，觀乃假遣朝吏，使歸助子弟，不與期會，但勑事訖各還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "44b58984b80ed1752fa60de553105b5cad7276670b9b2adbb15732cb5de2b02d"}

{"id": "p_60180504f8f87bd2", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 191, "text": "於是吏民相率不督自勸，旬日之中，一時俱成。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "6fa0067d89ad3803c364bff6d536eeb8668a4625d01854d0440bfd27f10173a8"}

{"id": "p_04dd12e7efd004d3", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 192, "text": "明帝即位，下詔書使郡縣條為劇、中、平者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "cacffd5caf1d538030b39e9881a0f5a9f1d12d88004b67a5ec56580a5d3f536d"}

{"id": "p_ccd6e718932e5709", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 193, "text": "主者欲言郡為中平，觀教曰：「此郡濵近外虜，數有寇害，云何不為劇邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "f5e1baa1fdc8ee3e4b4623324a529b994d3b58b58193ab323780db906dc9603d"}

{"id": "p_d4bcb636b0b82006", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 194, "text": "」主者曰：「若郡為外劇，恐於明府有任子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "55ca832f02f26dd5b339f568e080e052c395a332a01b3048935ae73bc8895b8a"}

{"id": "p_c5d30fe94d63a05a", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 195, "text": "」觀曰：「夫君者，所以為民也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "af591945add525a74b61fc5044b9000d22eb79f5558a0b74fa69007977a881da"}

{"id": "p_6163265e58b85f4f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 196, "text": "今郡在外劇，則於役條當有降差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "f2d77031c347ef031c7b7c3267957ee09dfb8ea2152f8f6f3ae7f34b7419e479"}

{"id": "p_9a5bad28e3ae929b", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 197, "text": "豈可為太守之私而負一郡之民乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "9176f88df1010df471e2c3626ca4632f412e5f735d56329218c9cf74ab603111"}

{"id": "p_12f910bdb9705aed", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 198, "text": "」遂言為外劇郡，後送任子詣鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "43e5862c0a3ccc38ce73c7dbce4e15844dc9aafab88e6f9fc7fbae2ddb0559fc"}

{"id": "p_2bf9083a5cfc81d2", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 199, "text": "觀治身清素，帥下以儉，僚屬承風，莫不自勵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "694d9ec072a405dc5d3c3c599f88c05e37fa2e14082cd1ed27243fb5ab7de74c"}

{"id": "p_a169487bfab6e108", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 200, "text": "明帝幸許昌，召觀為治書侍御史，典行臺獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "31c15f2e120b1c2d78d457f8d883b172f5f5636af7339f961c11c53f04638025"}

{"id": "p_857ace55bf8d4345", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 201, "text": "時多有倉卒喜怒，而觀不阿意順指。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "b107f868c6401ac0fae38c39f626f7177d1e6a7e315177b0b30d5875fd5ab332"}

{"id": "p_e627612c07dd1663", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 202, "text": "太尉司馬宣王請觀為從事中郎，遷為尚書，出為河南尹，徙少府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "4ce2b496463acc011bf2275a70e1e007a876971a5a2fa0871895c1d37d577ef8"}

{"id": "p_ff265bd4ceccd17a", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 203, "text": "大將軍曹爽使材官張達斫家屋材，及諸私用之物，觀聞知，皆錄奪以沒官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "d5b884e3065af9f62676185581d5ff054bc59c507b1d8a39210c1ca31ca2e010"}

{"id": "p_780df50a3426117d", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 204, "text": "少府統三尚方御府內藏玩弄之寶，爽等奢放，多有干求，憚觀守法，乃徙為太僕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "0fd653326570f2cfc7d2a2a00bed63ad307244bf7a4193cf8ecfec4a9f6fd4fe"}

{"id": "p_c55ff74dc5603a79", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 205, "text": "司馬宣王誅爽，使觀行中領軍，據爽弟羲營，賜爵關內侯，復為尚書，加駙馬都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "178eabd256c99e6d5dd7ee4223fb2a7b07633b55f5d66b84918cb54ad55837e5"}

{"id": "p_dc2e54b1156bb819", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 206, "text": "高貴鄉公即位，封中鄉亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "6b2270dbabc8f684dc5b940d6cc5b9be666072f97472af9cd1ee30796768d507"}

{"id": "p_eb08c30b75806b31", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 207, "text": "頃之，加光祿大夫，轉為右僕射。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "5cfc18324be067215e10fde78de708a00c519dc489840761741a2da4692085f9"}

{"id": "p_d35e154e20a39c57", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 208, "text": "常道鄉公即位，進封陽鄉侯，增邑千戶，并前二千五百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "cd754ce87816ed3fe7a59e9af33760b15bf185d6ed306370205e1c78d22b07a3"}

{"id": "p_ff201120801b3ccc", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 209, "text": "遷司空，固辭，不許，遣使即第拜授。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "a81a9323ad4fd5e93c804cbb575f1dfc43c58aaa9f29a30ffdd601a4d181606f"}

{"id": "p_2b5b3845fcd57b9e", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 210, "text": "就官數日，上送印綬，輒自輿歸里舍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "aa0c1c9868ed1f8ee6b6ffc6f90aefecfbe436923c75d54d9a83c81eb241bbf5"}

{"id": "p_8d5b767c51532ed3", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 211, "text": "薨于家，遺令藏足容棺，不設明器，不封不樹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "ad1bf424d8668211cd3ffefa6938e1d3ba206e36a69e38da63da906ce652182f"}

{"id": "p_8d2d30b6be7ef68f", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 212, "text": "咸熈中，開建五等，以觀著勳前朝，改封悝膠東子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "438dcbea59bc90e53011c724c141f0de2ac0eba4d22675c32e4513d965c94ac7"}

{"id": "p_c0d915d64db0eb2e", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 213, "text": "評曰：韓曁處以靜居行化，出以任職流稱；崔林簡樸知能；高柔明於法理；孫禮剛斷伉厲；王觀清勁貞白：咸克致公輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "c00640e04c703604787160ecaca5aaddb878c5b044b1ce4242c811c636ce966d"}

{"id": "p_1c3c815374ef857c", "source_id": "src_2abec7a17bdad966", "ordinal": 214, "text": "及曁年過八十，起家就列；柔保官二十年，元老終位：比之徐邈、常林，於茲為疚矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "87e7550422eaab6f5009401195076d9945359d580e3e52fb9a42252545436ff6"}

{"id": "p_04d85ed3fe4fcd52", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_16b152aa50d8e82a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 1, "text": "辛毗字佐治，潁川陽翟人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "c6c2f5135823509c3dbe97f3b553138c87cccc76e9bbff5dd6ea45bd44d4752c"}

{"id": "p_401afefbad2f8fb2", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 2, "text": "其先建武中，自隴西東遷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "310fec9d0779e7c73cd3a5f03c1ea6d8b3fa7063265e31af350560a9a11bd9ee"}

{"id": "p_82e301dfda8b29ce", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 3, "text": "太祖爲司空，辟毗，毗不得應命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "f81ad066a5d61924dce858a4b1ab0f384dfa27d089301b12faba521872d70ebf"}

{"id": "p_284844d8f6c59b5c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 4, "text": "及袁尚攻兄譚於平原，譚使毗詣太祖求和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "2fece4824e21b60e2831409ae25ae66f48a7de719c9f69f35d5a69501b77846e"}

{"id": "p_05c480938fc928c5", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 5, "text": "太祖將征荊州，次于西平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "3b7ce4c4ad144c93b9433a3bcdd237894dbec6b2ef0fb2f22e1d39cb087c0132"}

{"id": "p_b66d140e30c225bd", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 6, "text": "毗見太祖致譚意，太祖大恱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "bfa8471a8ade7b9cc776b0142e19cc9e20519b246bf8cbc176c1f9cabd7f9970"}

{"id": "p_f65e1326c38aa3ac", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 7, "text": "後數日，更欲先平荊州，使譚、尚自相弊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "26b7f73a9a2816bb2f9ef8e20f58dbcb73b4b03f5c594e51997f4e3ba60477e0"}

{"id": "p_7d6aaffd8db05d66", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 8, "text": "他日置酒，毗望太祖色，知有變，以語郭嘉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "8475d0861dfd146f30214723f08624c3300f043350c807a11c6734d2a6715105"}

{"id": "p_e05cc2ba1bbce468", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 9, "text": "嘉白太祖，太祖謂毗曰：「譚可信？", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "b985119c6ee03dce02081326fce1958484893f882f6ddc362740bae239668d25"}

{"id": "p_12dee568c88cdca1", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」毗對曰：「明公無問信與詐也，直當論其勢耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "c5c763cb39fed27825fc052bd039efba9bd5be792a7239295b70f0b557a00d2b"}

{"id": "p_7c0023b3f54e434b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 11, "text": "袁氏本兄弟相伐，非謂他人能閒其間，乃謂天下可定於己也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "06b08f9d9902663d0a79cd7cfc20897df7db65b467167c95af3215569a65f6f7"}

{"id": "p_7124283ef194a4b4", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 12, "text": "今一旦求救於明公，此可知也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "a5dea5046b7772ab713548708d94c6cf83043c55094a830d8dbb4bdcb08038a6"}

{"id": "p_26288a87c374ec2c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 13, "text": "顯甫見顯思困而不能取，此力竭也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "74ade297026b9e31c29a7bef8dc29fe44bfc6cd33b563d20c40329779114eb18"}

{"id": "p_2650979af45ed1be", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 14, "text": "兵革敗於外，謀臣誅於內，兄弟讒鬩，國分爲二；連年戰伐，而介冑生蟣蝨，加以旱蝗，饑饉並臻，國無囷倉，行無裹糧，天災應於上，人事困於下，民無愚智，皆知土崩瓦解，此乃天亡尚之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "9864870eaf6158a73cdfbee6a3651df3f13bb27a4f4a9a300c2b3fc4ba14deb0"}

{"id": "p_06be87ee70e120c4", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 15, "text": "兵法稱有石城湯池帶甲百萬而無粟者，不能守也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "937b9eb76079cd25e9bf765db6078c1ce789626f7d23a06104b3f674cc943679"}

{"id": "p_be96b322f0811887", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 16, "text": "今往攻鄴，尚不還救，即不能自守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "7711efd31fa3ca8f231c7e6dc75fb14cfc8354b13aa6104bbe2deb14f8c310f5"}

{"id": "p_741516459d3e0db7", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 17, "text": "以明公之威，應困窮之敵，擊疲弊之寇，無異迅風之振秋葉矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "37a4fb50694b505c434aa2fee9a6771c961422ec307df43ba89c037451dfb4f1"}

{"id": "p_f97bf720aed8efac", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 18, "text": "天以袁尚與明公，明公不取而伐荊州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "fce848bb3587b9ef704cafd63af76bc9d4ae11f97162e0210b3bdf700cea2629"}

{"id": "p_706ae25cd0d71edb", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 19, "text": "』方今二袁不務遠略而內相圖，可謂亂矣；居者無食，行者無糧，可謂亡矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "c185f36c90066a0a21fa8caa03433a218477555b07e5bec51b3b67d730553609"}

{"id": "p_9305b801691cce0d", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 20, "text": "朝不謀夕，民命靡繼，而不綏之，欲待他年；他年或登，又自知亡而改脩厥德，失所以用兵之要矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "0a20513e682c10bc37ba35668533045c18b0b31c8f3f612fe8107039fe37f04c"}

{"id": "p_418c59aa3a9d7b7f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 21, "text": "今因其請救而撫之，利莫大焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f6945d6953050564d2058a55b869048aebdfea8f2c268fbe8dc8ed5352240c1f"}

{"id": "p_94514e3d58ee411a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 22, "text": "且四方之寇，莫大於河北；河北平，則六軍盛而天下震。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "69661f0b211eafd7b358b0b8d4db41136e31b745969d17507bef7785619588c1"}

{"id": "p_005f8c1f572d3314", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 23, "text": "明年攻鄴，克之，表毗爲議郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "883e0e975fd142721294a4277717db1073b467671e1e4ee0baf975a1a8fe5d83"}

{"id": "p_62ed7f8029af1625", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 24, "text": "乆之，太祖遣都護曹洪平下辯，使毗與曹休參之，令曰：「昔高祖貪財好色，而良、平匡其過失。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "815ea3c6e4d6e48121f4b64ae1abf80549e20a306d893766ad611941053a196e"}

{"id": "p_4e8df96d4005a5b7", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 25, "text": "文帝踐阼，遷侍中，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "be129a854f04286e87f51dedc64b7c842869fe7954ab090c8e1fdc07e8096aa4"}

{"id": "p_27a8a7b67310a6d5", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 26, "text": "毗以魏氏遵舜、禹之統，應天順民；至於湯、武，以戰伐定天下，乃改正朔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "a23da44fb13d9ffe7e6604f63af5836b097d9bcc5dfd5539072438d19bf15608"}

{"id": "p_92ec696cfc536f3d", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 27, "text": "孔子曰「行夏之時」，左氏傳曰「夏數爲得天正」，何必期於相反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "4bbf04849b725c5ee6a3e5503f2c27fa4ccf8909cff08615ceefda417eb49a0a"}

{"id": "p_a8a72caabb31515f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 28, "text": "帝欲徙冀州士家十萬戶實河南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "de0258c0e0b8e14356cd1a05e9946c5ecad85ffe1e89ddc20339ad91de59a241"}

{"id": "p_70f33ec0ccbf34f3", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 29, "text": "時連蝗民饑，群司以爲不可，而帝意甚盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "e45db107dcd6e0445b3e87d498087274c6b07193d4b26b80349599b0bb3c6a5e"}

{"id": "p_a13f40a5296ecfd8", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 30, "text": "毗與朝臣俱求見，帝知其欲諫，作色以見之，皆莫敢言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "1639e28ff6ef8810aa8ad6a263decd0b1ed0528abd7dea70b11d4fd6c866095f"}

{"id": "p_a4db8f9144d50ec4", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 31, "text": "毗曰：「陛下欲徙士家，其計安出：」帝曰：「卿謂我徙之非邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "34a0c88b7e71cfc54f9d0ef3e8b4caf6921e25db9a06d96fdd5b63ebf1be199e"}

{"id": "p_80d8e81c08738767", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」帝曰：「吾不與卿共議也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "8db7976fa78863e773ca44178869d70cc7fac2cddafc8d659d62eb39dbfe109e"}

{"id": "p_a36028c0b6435f7d", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」毗曰：「陛下不以臣不肖，置之左右，廁之謀議之官，安得不與臣議邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "514c89fba8e638b124b83a92cd6407e762aeb831c64a759feb27034e5dab40d8"}

{"id": "p_3531570f3800648c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 34, "text": "臣所言非私，乃社稷之慮也，安得怒臣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "e489f1e4b6e5a9c64f540769173584e302091f5cb58ed5d4f4bf814cad1dd0e1"}

{"id": "p_3c56599192729f5a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 35, "text": "」帝不荅，起入內；毗隨而引其裾，帝遂奮衣不還，良乆乃出，曰：「佐治，卿持我何太急邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "541be22770a596d733c5e9ee7114af0cfab3f3cba3447e39af4eb555a53b1ce4"}

{"id": "p_7f44b42cca1620d7", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 36, "text": "」毗曰：「今徙，旣失民心，又無以食也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "af1a4f6f577c1dd28474dc440b78212ef89d1e6cd3d8f544aaa077e926843bb3"}
