{"id": "p_2412e7ce96e0eff7", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 37, "text": "嘗從帝射雉，帝曰：「射雉樂哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "fed96b3213373f04bb6deb2d1b9737785e50917cbd93ef8e6f1a93263a17b346"}

{"id": "p_fabcd2683b54243a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」毗曰：「於陛下甚樂，而於羣下甚苦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "da24c8560af8ff8c47cc583ff9263e891c7ad54dfea9fad7f19bd6104d2fcd27"}

{"id": "p_e409edc9a016c1e9", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」帝默然，後遂爲之稀出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "8bc26b94814251ff96696883e5c8ec93e8b020dc3aec98c36448175020485a22"}

{"id": "p_3bb4c0da61a64c1c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 40, "text": "上軍大將軍曹真征朱然于江陵，毗行軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "e6bcda3411f7aa1804cfb43bcebabd9929042b0e83404310e10f9bb92b6a0cb1"}

{"id": "p_dcea8478d877598f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 41, "text": "帝欲大興軍征吳，毗諫曰：「吳、楚之民，險而難禦，道隆後服，道洿先叛，自古患之，非徒今也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "192981ee76f932677ee4e964637ccc4189af67e7073785945d8d94ef818dc911"}

{"id": "p_63d8a8475b8a9efb", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 42, "text": "今陛下祚有海內，夫不賔者，其能乆乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "142869d7c22eb882478bdf194c7984971f3b1c25b8c136cc51dc9f47faf7df5a"}

{"id": "p_a1614da19804a72b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 43, "text": "昔尉佗稱帝，子陽僭號，歷年未幾，或臣或誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "0cbaba1bacbfc337d7c00bd9bb1959ce977d7497a31397a8c874d6d3955d35c1"}

{"id": "p_973b6899477ac9fd", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 44, "text": "何則，違逆之道不乆全，而大德無所不服也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "017d7a483cbbd4f7c8d62f7cc6df23909d167cd169ea962318cc9016bc92b3b5"}

{"id": "p_467c81b8479d2a35", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 45, "text": "方今天下新定，土廣民稀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "a77dc4c1a544764701928d0f8e986e63fafe14e179d44eb6b8aba78b217d0446"}

{"id": "p_6b0d223fac531b9d", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 46, "text": "夫廟筭而後出軍，猶臨事而懼，況今廟筭有闕而欲用之，臣誠未見其利也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "ca870ff0c81f4ea9a8de7778bf62b51732648433ea9b0ebb0e9d6e84f4935978"}

{"id": "p_991617023d3f807f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 47, "text": "先帝屢起銳師，臨江而旋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "b0c35198891cc322fb3c90a97fc56bcfa47a23187e4737c9d0647838590677fd"}

{"id": "p_b963e7452e9d2642", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 48, "text": "今六軍不增於故，而復循之，此未易也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "d5cfb55e5d836ca9562e7d9b0138a56a9bb1823a8d09cf4b2657f1a03118e3f1"}

{"id": "p_33f4215bf73a394e", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 49, "text": "今日之計，莫若脩范蠡之養民，法管仲之寄政，則充國之屯田，明仲尼之懷遠；十年之中，彊壯未老，童齓勝戰，兆民知義，將士思奮，然後用之，則役不再舉矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "c4d8b4cace0a1508ca036654aa91174baa036a22603fe505bd49aed6c1398679"}

{"id": "p_a7f7674d85c26296", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」帝曰：「如卿意，更當以虜遺子孫邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "5c09282b101a7c6dba612333e395b983fc5a086b745c6df9fd9be274fcf3cbb1"}

{"id": "p_a2f037944bfde8f0", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」毗對曰：「昔周文王以紂遺武王，惟知時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "7e7dd00110142d1fa75610e4ef7f414e8a8cb99f2611103b9e63916ac6143075"}

{"id": "p_4c83128b35c41ab2", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 52, "text": "明帝即位，進封潁鄉侯，邑三百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "8ac70eac941f98c4e77c39f96d539cbbf63063d1749660134990f3cfeb823a6d"}

{"id": "p_45cabd1ae574a127", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 53, "text": "時中書監劉放、令孫資見信於主，制斷時政，大臣莫不交好，而毗不與往來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "630ba7a2ed96a8f53fb764881ed2c1254efcca8d41fea56a634b4e91bd2e58b1"}

{"id": "p_f7c727e37a547fea", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 54, "text": "毗子敞諫曰：「今劉、孫用事，衆皆影附，大人宜小降意，和光同塵；不然必有謗言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "d4be1b8d5b98c0ff45d93fc6533f8eb5bf4fa35fb2329b63aefe6bc6ba63787a"}

{"id": "p_4fc95572de9a5542", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」毗正色曰：「主上雖未稱聦明，不爲闇劣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "f3f7548c44f42e9c7ec518deb3244fa95da6dc937b52b71bf01308e6dd140b6f"}

{"id": "p_c2578088a043539b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 56, "text": "就與劉、孫不平，不過令吾不作三公而已，何危害之有？", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "1fc3675af8c325bac077cbc0cc09d0837df95f59fc738c8ecba7962528658772"}

{"id": "p_c7f540928419d9a0", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 57, "text": "焉有大丈夫欲爲公而毀其高節者邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "6b2543ea64ce9a8302da73a3c6e98d9f646288692dafa1320bebab84c6c04a99"}

{"id": "p_96d5b23e500033fc", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」宂從僕射畢軌表言：「尚書僕射王思精勤舊吏，忠亮計略不如辛毗，毗宜代思。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "b469ca46d7ce9587f1e4abe0ad9820f40d15e793749b1cd652e1c6f61c6ab80c"}

{"id": "p_088b9cd092711d95", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 59, "text": "」帝以訪放、資，放、資對曰：「陛下用思者，誠欲取其効力，不貴虛名也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "22e6cc088a963be155efb66a2282f76e150bc18984696b18ee68f7d2b0de3776"}

{"id": "p_c6c0130846a97b08", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 60, "text": "毗實亮直，然性剛而專，聖慮所當深察也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "6806c342a6f0850be2d2e9ae6746e780d29267955ec4e7fad93762ac29d7c813"}

{"id": "p_bb038284a51fe27b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 61, "text": "帝方脩殿舍，百姓勞役，毗上疏曰：「竊聞諸葛亮講武治兵，而孫權巿馬遼東，量其意指，似欲相左右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "8b50d3ec9962dd71317d1714f9150d69cb9418d1f215fdccb2b38ec98642c720"}

{"id": "p_bcf6bd5a36547c3f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 62, "text": "備豫不虞，古之善政，而今者宮室大興，加連年穀麥不收。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "0fda368a6c80688a769b7c32790b2d1827c7e062ca3aba90e6e7e002997f2f96"}

{"id": "p_0ab2ac6b146a92b1", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 63, "text": "詩云：『民亦勞止，迄可小康，惠此中國，以綏四方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "415a7d7c9c868104276c3e692be5eab2a0092001ac220958f1924de48c658abb"}

{"id": "p_fe539c3129394a5f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 64, "text": "」帝報曰：「二虜未滅而治宮室，直諫者立名之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "c063bcbc64163e12366d32dcc23f93b564997cae796d53bab9bf3c39a9d16b96"}

{"id": "p_11da8edd8efde7c2", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 65, "text": "夫王者之都，當及民勞兼辦，使後世無所復增，是蕭何爲漢規摹之略也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "ef4f4ccf9aa0df56c743c59ebfd7c283b82e125842ba633c67a4356d762e37b0"}

{"id": "p_6f52ec5ad81e6c80", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 66, "text": "今卿爲魏重臣，亦宜解其大歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "1a59dcd36b6581521cadecee3722d02d1689095f05a4b9cf6f9ef6da0c696447"}

{"id": "p_0f5840bac46194b3", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 67, "text": "」帝又欲平北芒，令於其上作臺觀，則見孟津。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "fa4a431db56d7e305f1720965f1a7a3579b1fff742f3b1735ddd5526d305e599"}

{"id": "p_4e2a23e1f24e1415", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 68, "text": "毗諫曰：「天地之性，高高下下，今而反之，旣非其理；加以損費人功，民不堪役。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "a97c66b90905b0c1bde4fc5cdbeacc2159ff3f394696d06c4fe8ad9e4f2bfa4a"}

{"id": "p_bff9c8c0f3761a16", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 69, "text": "且若九河盈溢，洪水爲害，而丘陵皆夷，將何以禦之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "ef3f902a7b9a432286f00c59be539e15583c2f4c25354d0153570a39e8f214b0"}

{"id": "p_88a3638929bcf383", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 70, "text": "先是，大將軍司馬宣王數請與亮戰，明帝終不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "08934294c71e818b827a8fba4412ac5c714057a784389f9bacd1a4dcd72e1d38"}

{"id": "p_5edc1f7bdcaf4049", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 71, "text": "是歲恐不能禁，乃以毗爲大將軍軍師，使持節；六軍皆肅，準毗節度，莫敢犯違。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "e5f33906a48e2ff4f6879effcfade0a5d1fdf8d7eea3c3786572960bf0cac956"}

{"id": "p_ac7f9b698ec4f5ff", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 72, "text": "子敞嗣，咸熈中爲河內太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "fd81d8a43e9df0a29598002958105f25a928372b7e907ad21efee86e2b642756"}

{"id": "p_b87c2e491ae1a411", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 73, "text": "楊阜字義山，天水冀人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "9bf02d0c04fca91ce96bcb465bd48e87e9295dc00b271d5c6acf63340b3b6442"}

{"id": "p_7fb9189088efa774", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 74, "text": "以州從事爲牧韋端使詣許，拜安定長史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "5fab0b99860d40e3699e8e10bff0ffb1eb2a1b058f189a8daa640b8bb8758277"}

{"id": "p_0d44dee30aa6ebfb", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 75, "text": "阜還，關右諸將問袁、曹勝敗孰在，阜曰：「袁公寬而不斷，好謀而少決；不斷則無威，少決則失後事，今雖彊，終不能成大業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "39f80024abd8a877413a1de865e5a07e186a6847e3b1758dc2b353b9485294ec"}

{"id": "p_17ae31259ccc1796", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 76, "text": "曹公有雄才遠略，決機無疑，法一而兵精，能用度外之人，所任各盡其力，必能濟大事者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "b85a4885868ed184dd2d5dc46de1559cf0cd2d372f28f79500e4938b0f364837"}

{"id": "p_b0a2ced4e6821d4c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 77, "text": "而端徵爲太僕，其子康代爲刺史，辟阜爲別駕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "31d8b58a2497fef5ded4f5c1df617397184c8d746978d88e1b6fa47a7d349574"}

{"id": "p_7961e3834b1886b6", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 78, "text": "察孝廉，辟丞相府，州表留參軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "f87e1cc5151958f354f60234d3ba4d888d5c507fa45c87491961a7d899279a59"}

{"id": "p_f63067fa37621107", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 79, "text": "馬超之戰敗渭南也，走保諸戎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "09e329b56844bed92492bb4ffc099cdc2697185f7aceeba666f8101175f86864"}

{"id": "p_78b8e34bf72067e8", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 80, "text": "太祖追至安定，而蘇伯反河閒，將引軍東還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "119e88beca927cff1bdf78d92bd01f6dd467c37e7a22922a9f373377e9280ecc"}

{"id": "p_e3a92a84b22bfc26", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 81, "text": "阜時奉使，言於太祖曰：「超有信、布之勇，甚得羌、胡心，西州畏之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "1ac0dde5cb2104a14ad9f7a638c0dba2a6d5997665640a8abb5975568e7caafb"}

{"id": "p_b81749bac370b16f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 82, "text": "若大軍還，不嚴爲之備，隴上諸郡非國家之有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "c10e74e77d9d165e6b282eb0770b29cc7b61da29e3c7d9df2c3092c69764e79d"}

{"id": "p_b0e30610ad38b2b3", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 83, "text": "」太祖善之，而軍還倉卒，爲備不周。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "d0b404e414632aef3ff6b1eaad4e37e66730676e3426927f18de7c083c38843a"}

{"id": "p_74e8689f7fa1344c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 84, "text": "超率諸戎渠帥以擊隴上郡縣，隴上郡縣皆應之，惟冀城奉州郡以固守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "0bbed05b2e2807c7aa8b5d46d4f834d8fba5bc45fefbf85f81ea65055084f5e9"}

{"id": "p_3e4c8a56462ebd55", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 85, "text": "超盡兼隴右之衆，而張魯又遣大將楊昂以助之，凡萬餘人，攻城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "983d3f4575f83b23db9fe4cf177826def5e336c002a4c53bd7895b62b0ca86d4"}

{"id": "p_4c42b057e5fe3da2", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 86, "text": "阜率國士大夫及宗族子弟勝兵者千餘人，使從弟岳於城上作偃月營，與超接戰，自正月至八月拒守而救兵不至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "d45bf34f57b5bb04b3e043a20728c354f1e70573ea0ca0977716bea89c83c022"}

{"id": "p_784c3dd09146ef26", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 87, "text": "州遣別駕閻溫循水潛出求救，爲超所殺，於是刺史、太守失色，始有降超之計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "ef923b348ca443036682dfd5436a6e05ef551af021923563a4a753c5d826e741"}

{"id": "p_1587aac3ba4a36e8", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 88, "text": "阜流涕諫曰：「阜等率父兄子弟以義相勵，有死無二；田單之守，不固於此也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "9d5f6e3a11d7360673f186c15662dd89f797dae2109cdff627702ec3161f1301"}

{"id": "p_5b6e4f114c22cd75", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 89, "text": "棄垂成之功，陷不義之名，阜以死守之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "8df0d5389d17943b3a1da91c22deec9442c44b1b041a978c9998df5fc9482445"}

{"id": "p_4b0dfafc66870d1b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 90, "text": "刺史、太守卒遣人請和，開城門迎超。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "fb6c0c44138ef4a889d1b50a6f4eeb8c81539f3de393ddd9f31306a9979a84da"}

{"id": "p_1f4414ea25796938", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 91, "text": "超入，拘岳於冀，使楊昂殺刺史、太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "a03e54bf2dd8b9a664a755f9f0f6c686d036191cdac78e075522b65365ab54ca"}

{"id": "p_4a9714098989f262", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 92, "text": "阜內有報超之志，而未得其便。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "020a8324c7c60c77e17ecd073f559bc927a8a8d9e31552bc9cc8580a851dcfa6"}

{"id": "p_35d1d847e35d2f6f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 93, "text": "阜少長叙家，見叙母及叙，說前在冀中時事，歔欷悲甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "d474f118394848812aca3c9e3b0a486262e5e1c85e50dcde26c124cfa08b8f43"}

{"id": "p_bebd053f384f3a78", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」阜曰：「守城不能完，君亡不能死，亦何面目以視息於天下！", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "a5440728a7f434873705275cf4aeab023192595efbc22d6003915e09295f06ec"}

{"id": "p_122f3100f5a42b5e", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 95, "text": "馬超背父叛君，虐殺州將，豈獨阜之憂責，一州士大夫皆蒙其恥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "e846005f49acb8e8fcde478f7604c2536236da09cf82ad431968904106892487"}

{"id": "p_0d772abe67606b64", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 96, "text": "君擁兵專制而無討賊心，此趙盾所以書殺君也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "f2fb2167503e44931425d537f9283d3e9b72bf37d9ed97ee98d2df5ed3ee9635"}

{"id": "p_7077e76a681a61b8", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 97, "text": "超彊而無義，多釁易圖耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "34c8f9f06d63a77c703086d2a37e6c8ab4577970d9836b161771f5cf9c01ea5d"}

{"id": "p_123fd0003ae37392", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」叙母慨然，勑叙從阜計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "dc32e20f4c28756624d500aaa13fb15781bba267d1d4808ee890441764be6f0b"}

{"id": "p_b6fc51a64bb9395a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 99, "text": "計定，外與鄉人姜隱、趙昂、尹奉、姚瓊、孔信、武都人李俊、王靈結謀，定討超約，使從弟謨至冀語岳，并結安定梁寬、南安趙衢、龐恭等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "9cc0bc7a36f183afc84705c363bd066d0bebd47743b9cf39a75fa1e02c538cc5"}

{"id": "p_a750e7334ffe9b6e", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 100, "text": "約誓旣明，十七年九月，與叙起兵於鹵城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "7cb90595291d7af5f2862da5689cc1661ec0d4bf2c31887f6f5d693ce4fdb606"}

{"id": "p_30cf36740b1cedd1", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 101, "text": "而衢、寬等解岳，閉冀城門，討超妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "6b8c426a659c0287d5ef591263182a1a189851cbe88cf4d9ac55a6e2f0802170"}

{"id": "p_7277d679356cc4a9", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 102, "text": "叙母罵之曰：「汝背父之逆子，殺君之桀賊，天地豈乆容汝，而不早死，敢以面目視人乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "69ef7706270544dcbeb321a4087e35ac2d4408dccaca6293d6132c4c05801ad6"}

{"id": "p_1c6c45054be2c761", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 103, "text": "阜與超戰，身被五創，宗族昆弟死者七人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "42960a177bc21f857f68bcc1edfb6068e927d53bf9bd78c813166f9cd407ec06"}

{"id": "p_7b4b95c608942e93", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 104, "text": "隴右平定，太祖封討超之功，侯者十一人，賜阜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "6a58084b47149a17627ee2c987298b7ebbfa0e462a6b8906086bd88052dab6ba"}

{"id": "p_ebcaf6a2ad325b03", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 105, "text": "阜讓曰：「阜君存無扞難之功，君亡無死節之効，於義當絀，於法當誅；超又不死，無宜苟荷爵祿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "15d1362ade0eb3887c30e37d36857b8da888b9e30decaa1517e69d350170d189"}

{"id": "p_b335b186a44373fe", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」太祖報曰：「君與羣賢共建大功，西土之人以爲美談。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "2aecfb6e4defad27216c5e156938ea78d200cceae0d3e52ae096e64c28d52b0f"}

{"id": "p_2e7cdff603327061", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 107, "text": "子貢辭賞，仲尼謂之止善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "24f83a11474433315e9b476f5e4f92c8430f8633dfa544cc40fc070d51e3c16a"}

{"id": "p_a6df9f981612592b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 108, "text": "姜叙之母，勸叙早發，明智乃爾，雖楊敞之妻蓋不過此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "7ff764de748e29f5cdf5dc996f168f54111a6c5488941826137fa4805bb73ff0"}

{"id": "p_a39348f86a22c6c5", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 109, "text": "良史記錄，必不墜於地矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "33989e0939c9936bb661877fd311256790ad35d5c5ecf952f5c911e7866c1e9d"}

{"id": "p_688373deec910e2a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 110, "text": "太祖征漢中，以阜爲益州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "731afc5c1de2fb9e3f285f3be47f11d30f7e126a68b1ad251b2b02671446326a"}

{"id": "p_d59852623afb25c0", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 111, "text": "還，拜金城太守，未發，轉武都太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "52e767e0f4b6808f733f76a67f44d3daa084a1caf889389864fc9f8bc1c8225f"}

{"id": "p_d8e7ff522833ce5c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 112, "text": "郡濵蜀漢，阜請依龔遂故事，安之而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "728fb0db71d6af1a3e4339546a72a52d1c8430a417fbf9b8bea2ee5e2159ba8b"}

{"id": "p_1797883e732a1762", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 113, "text": "會劉備遣張飛、馬超等從沮道趣下辯，而氐雷定等七部萬餘落反應之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "22786ef4c19525ccd7f425025a0e14d980bfa1559605fa56e4860f96d90b597b"}

{"id": "p_655693ec6cf45aec", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 114, "text": "太祖遣都護曹洪禦超等，超等退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "62002a07c9fa25918f7e0de82f6e95ba1ac897f988c78fdaf3baf869e1fd834d"}

{"id": "p_2f7a97b6f6120c34", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 115, "text": "洪置酒大會，令女倡著羅縠之衣，蹋鼓，一坐皆笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "5b68e2d9a97847bc77ccb3fa422cb8f17cd7904fc505aace27332e304cf8d34d"}

{"id": "p_a646c50b19d6504b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 116, "text": "阜厲聲責洪曰：「男女之別，國之大節，何有於廣坐之中裸女人形體！", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "f1781351fcd123f5032a5aefee2d4224fbe0b4d059a0a67b096a0d6b245b01b4"}

{"id": "p_f7a77f3f15aaf0c0", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 117, "text": "雖桀、紂之亂，不甚於此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "c2a4d98a50cbcc240e258345b418f03275b6d9a62423556b42166bf05f828bb8"}

{"id": "p_6c4b01145a35319c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 118, "text": "洪立罷女樂，請阜還坐，肅然憚焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "cc183eceef494a8d4e1e1b5463b41cc90e2eace0abf22dc3151ee20def4fe57b"}

{"id": "p_683aea390ba60842", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 119, "text": "及劉備取漢中以逼下辯，太祖以武都孤遠，欲移之，恐吏民戀土。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "f397340d6e01c8638817b1fe746a554a9862a2eef7c38e23129a77337ecb16b6"}

{"id": "p_98221a77a8f10d3a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 120, "text": "阜威信素著，前後徙民、氐，使居京兆、扶風、天水界者萬餘戶，徙郡小槐里，百姓襁負而隨之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "67d9fb622cd45073aba436735a814237e3b105ca5b6f115936880b87f5402bbd"}

{"id": "p_3fb681a6b018501b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 121, "text": "爲政舉大綱而已，下不忍欺也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "66913144c98c541cc5ca5136eaef38320937e78d6a41993b6594d5e596b532c2"}

{"id": "p_72e24b0054023c93", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 122, "text": "文帝問侍中劉曄等：「武都太守何如人也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "baa8d27f604628b99c1a6913a9923612cb4966385b984d74008e264fc96207e7"}

{"id": "p_720c93069e2e2038", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 123, "text": "在郡十餘年，徵拜城門校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "eb623253d0f210c5d96bf7f19807c50db6ebbff6d6676fda6fdda73c050cf2e4"}

{"id": "p_ffaf786d870478cd", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 124, "text": "阜常見明帝著𧛕，被縹綾半裦袖，阜問帝曰：「此於禮何法服也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "572df83c69d8fd4c481df2fbe008c5223ea543a47e353f6485e8e9690572b6d5"}

{"id": "p_202744e2ca3a8ab7", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 125, "text": "」帝默然不荅，自是不法服不以見阜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "68b2bfdeaa2955de0489b0fcf68dec20f96df1b4fc931f02f928a0e09255e920"}

{"id": "p_09052bb601da2aa3", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 126, "text": "時初治宮室，發美女以充後庭，數出入弋獵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "b0563a5dd2243e5a63a69db52b2f3cdb7be7340ad24e70871d5cf29c1d52811a"}

{"id": "p_2a7eea4c7a40cd02", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 127, "text": "秋，大雨震電，多殺鳥雀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "cc0d6ae7c0eeaf4dd3349bfd7e5306b6b01b0ac6aad3848d1677c297258674d6"}

{"id": "p_cf878236d16e18a0", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 128, "text": "阜上疏曰：「臣聞明主在上，羣下盡辭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "93c6fbebb35ee98bf28ef3916a047d92e0dd49b70298937f91847d05763331b7"}

{"id": "p_efd0e53b74260167", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 129, "text": "堯、舜聖德，求非索諫；大禹勤功，務卑宮室；成湯遭旱，歸咎責己；周文刑於寡妻，以御家邦；漢文躬行節儉，身衣弋綈：此皆能昭令問，貽厥孫謀者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "569875baaf4d993462ce2c8cbbb2d0911ef1c78e1cc5794dd8ba01d9e81899f0"}

{"id": "p_133678130db4453d", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 130, "text": "伏惟陛下奉武皇帝開拓之大業，守文皇帝克終之元緒，誠宜思齊往古聖賢之善治，總觀季世放盪之惡政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "ad0a615755eab58c30ad3053585a60314d199cd481e26124a8eb6a299a78a70f"}

{"id": "p_62dbfdf820595feb", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 131, "text": "所謂善治者，務儉約、重民力也；所謂惡政者，從心恣欲，觸情而發也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "6dd8b6ae423f9343b075040fb0334a8640ed07371c3ce4e92c92102f7b3ec6cf"}

{"id": "p_03a8d6bf7733a4f8", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 132, "text": "惟陛下稽古世代之初所以明赫，及季世所以衰弱至于泯滅，近覽漢末之變，足以動心誡懼矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "8cd261b4dce9f2d051de44518b4b6630127c44a89a5626ffa647d0accc99e6fc"}

{"id": "p_edf7c534147e2c09", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 133, "text": "曩使桓、靈不廢高祖之法，文、景之恭儉，太祖雖有神武，於何所施其能邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "9dd42f1046c0ce88118c07bd04c803d8cb7d020c729205c6a8c5335cf399b227"}

{"id": "p_972d08dce299ed3f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 134, "text": "今吳、蜀未定，軍旅在外，願陛下動則三思，慮而後行，重慎出入，以往鑒來，言之若輕，成敗甚重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "c88b69dc23f8c9ab86a6764ec7a8ddc53507b90788d2d6bd684549faa6f8460c"}

{"id": "p_2b0d84643c523860", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 135, "text": "頃者天雨，又多卒暴雷電非常，至殺鳥雀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "9b169901549cd4430afdb5a0a30049617c2fdb838800cf829c99234dfd07f746"}

{"id": "p_5f37223bf95115a5", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 136, "text": "天地神明，以王者爲子也，政有不當，則見災譴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "caeb9402d88400e45fde7c1afdd7ddf902bf5cb3b506197080c3b0178ea62042"}

{"id": "p_14442b3d2d54b151", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 137, "text": "惟陛下慮患無形之外，慎萌纖微之初，法漢孝文出惠帝美人，令得自嫁；頃所調送小女，遠聞不令，宜爲後圖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "807c6dbeb73f0d4a20f2bfd90b7e2bcb08fe6d23a0118bbd1888ec08ff3f0e53"}

{"id": "p_da70f17c4f1f9db9", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 138, "text": "書曰：『九族旣睦，恊和萬國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "53f6fbb2ee445e4292309daf042065e0b116499260653e76fa80369ef6c22449"}

{"id": "p_b2a20e2d7c526754", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 139, "text": "』事思厥宜，以從中道，精心計謀，省息費用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "9f6360394faa0f892fe3f606f236c266bf5c8f1b20259ddc4b44f1e37ae6f32c"}

{"id": "p_2459b2c847332d6d", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 140, "text": "吳、蜀以定，爾乃上安下樂，九親熈熈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "aebdec9074e101dec129c2bf2edf73bf1da059b7a97155a186e9b0d6db12a36e"}

{"id": "p_e08abbe084df6d16", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 141, "text": "如此以往，祖考心歡，堯舜其猶病諸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "e995be44476d4fce0afd7a2c4d55c6bc684a277bb8d8685b12a1c0d3e76fcb87"}

{"id": "p_d544109fe19f2e20", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 142, "text": "今宜開大信於天下，以安衆庶，以示遠人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "5810079068591eab96ae59f89cae02ec618d6918780b8a0893346a6d878a6849"}

{"id": "p_3e9586c1a6a3cd44", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 143, "text": "」時雍丘王植怨於不齒，藩國至親，法禁峻密，故阜又陳九族之義焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "9b95c0c275283d7da5388502f21c26816be0fc897deff6388a35cf65b2a38091"}

{"id": "p_ec38da1d2937a9d6", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 144, "text": "詔報曰：「閒得密表，先陳往古明王聖主，以諷闇政，切至之辭，款誠篤實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "9ca42fa35f1b123f885f5a074610ccef13465d7db200c3aef2a4aa5a1441cb44"}

{"id": "p_4b7a5b50d029b841", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 145, "text": "退思補過，將順匡救，備至悉矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "b6cd5dad29ae2dadcc448291c2ff21ad1ae94ca5a0d15c253ba001444fe5f932"}

{"id": "p_cdac135100e3c847", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 146, "text": "是時大司馬曹真伐蜀，遇雨不進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "b496b3374330716fbcc58aee5e3737b5b86017c28518276bcc8724e0e4db841e"}

{"id": "p_46bbad8e32cb7c08", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 147, "text": "阜上疏曰：「昔文王有赤烏之符，而猶日仄不暇食；武王白魚入舟，君臣變色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "a399a7e73e463f331ac76f39e56d6c8192f6f807edd81f9e3b7cb3ffcb521e09"}

{"id": "p_75abd7a59962d887", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 148, "text": "而動得吉瑞，猶尚憂懼，況有災異而不戰竦者哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "8d4db22c281dfec6049293fa6f0e015215ecdc50a2307692445df9917fee03a0"}

{"id": "p_8adcc52108224190", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 149, "text": "今吳、蜀未平，而天屢降變，陛下宜深有以專精應荅，側席而坐，思示遠以德，綏邇以儉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "512585a2173288bfe29e1a3cd0c8c09f0de11fbacf08a5d85d1f80bd3a11eaf9"}

{"id": "p_7680234266ef7123", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 150, "text": "閒者諸軍始進，便有天雨之患，稽閡山險，以積日矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "8f8d2a9a28634eeb99a6616bff459a7e3230e2b785b3a9d7bf81c32214c61fe8"}

{"id": "p_3d058926884f8731", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 151, "text": "轉運之勞，擔負之苦，所費以多，若有不繼，必違本圖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "5a7435e5e0426ed14f063455f932ecf5e60375181c8fafdd16594dd47a5e2c07"}

{"id": "p_f15c87eb67a4051c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 152, "text": "傳曰：『見可而進，知難而退，軍之善政也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "5878061af90ceccf1167cfd172d84888a7c4b5ef1dcc3866a169efed691e82cc"}

{"id": "p_b24317da763075e9", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 153, "text": "』徒使六軍困於山谷之間，進無所略，退又不得，非主兵之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "9eaa45ad50bd2082205b370098ec4ec62d8536f3b9f909540f7bce85cbbbfa7d"}

{"id": "p_2241eba198cb0139", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 154, "text": "武王還師，殷卒以亡，知天期也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "dd2db75507b3b8a897f10c2c5015aa1c21f9e027a5e0273f1491f7537da9cbc1"}

{"id": "p_ff0a05a4ae4e67d7", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 155, "text": "今年凶民饑，宜發明詔損膳減服，技巧珍玩之物，皆可罷之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "6a20a83981f60f2b6fcf5932df27295fe6128738874ea9a74869740be59bc7a6"}

{"id": "p_99ec40a4d9cbdcc9", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 156, "text": "昔邵信臣爲少府於無事之世，而奏罷浮食；今者軍用不足，益宜節度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "3fd52128fefb6197bfe7f1cc6c2881f57994a997e02191e80a9f30681acceb74"}

{"id": "p_98341f8cd25c11ec", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 157, "text": "後詔大議政治之不便於民者，阜議以爲：「致治在於任賢，興國在於務農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "9ff43fc7b7d4a8e7b796c7da1e01a83516e7f60d870feafbb3fa63eb02b149f8"}

{"id": "p_ec411b8409e3b7ea", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 158, "text": "若舍賢而任所私，此忘治之甚者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "90bc5a4fb7fdf1a58dd472dff9d39e904050a9242e1f085de5d10cbefa57627c"}

{"id": "p_354a8dc2e05b9ff9", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 159, "text": "廣開宮館，高爲臺榭，以妨民務，此害農之甚者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "303fc8a0a0509d7bcaa6657d7197fb6e545087cc7554dd4fb22999ccde5c61d1"}

{"id": "p_f1dff039e291d522", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 160, "text": "百工不敦其器，而競作奇巧，以合上欲，此傷本之甚者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "845f7774aaffd62e54c46f48331bd417645f2bfa0896fa47232336e836da52a3"}

{"id": "p_54c08cb90255c7ee", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 161, "text": "孔子曰：『苛政甚於猛虎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "ab090410d55edf1d2451dfe68d9bdb44701b3d92c96310b5e9fbb31c47ed045b"}

{"id": "p_8ac1b5e37fb1f84f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 162, "text": "』今守功文俗之吏，爲政不通治體，苟好煩苛，此亂民之甚者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "b379a724cdac146243518e8804121dd09f6aaf46db2111d39cd21766337f63fd"}

{"id": "p_283875fba16dbd83", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 163, "text": "當今之急，宜去四甚，並詔公卿郡國，舉賢良方正敦樸之士而選用之，此亦求賢之一端也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "8cb577d40ebe6d1422edd8eea55ecbbd1e95a8db2326910cbca009c80e4f882c"}

{"id": "p_89b9cea9e58f2460", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 164, "text": "阜又上疏欲省宮人諸不見幸者，乃召御府吏問後宮人數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "44a2e84ff98dc2ff0b89e23b2bdf6c3b689412d4a535a5d5fa41a0530af557e3"}

{"id": "p_a0dcfc4e9be477b3", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 165, "text": "吏守舊令，對曰：「禁密，不得宣露。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "b2285324d592d091d472d0b95f87b065888ad807abcd7aeaa65a4b882b251735"}

{"id": "p_087e53e5e4125741", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」阜怒，杖吏一百，數之曰：「國家不與九卿爲密，反與小吏爲密乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "e37cb39f6b0e4c4682244082ee44fc83aae1baffa8a8a19b0fd4d9dc0ff00cc0"}

{"id": "p_73548c5335f4e0d0", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 167, "text": "帝愛女淑，未期而夭，帝痛之甚，追封平原公主，立廟洛陽，葬於南陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "90cab44e5fc611db9e8d93c7750b8f3d08166e0dbed72b63b47a06edd6a6c55f"}

{"id": "p_bcf182c5b2e9477d", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 168, "text": "將自臨送，阜上疏曰：「文皇帝、武宣皇后崩，陛下皆不送葬，所以重社稷、備不虞也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "33f7ca5e7e7d56076e20dd8c8e01a91bb6c3bef6283aba6a7c125123670a21d1"}

{"id": "p_9a61ba6a2bc9fe37", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 169, "text": "何至孩抱之赤子而可送葬也哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "1d37e718fa2dd49921979192578c0ee0851048465437373d3f7b48568de4ac50"}

{"id": "p_e90aa89be45f0306", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 170, "text": "帝旣新作許宮，又營洛陽宮殿觀閣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "f8784d0db1a3d8025747fce7e119e1521b382e530562da5a3aa6534e5630e6d9"}

{"id": "p_a38f0713d150d88b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 171, "text": "阜上疏曰：「堯尚茅茨而萬國安其居，禹卑宮室而天下樂其業；及至殷、周，或堂崇三尺，度以九筵耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "f1200d9ac9a713021e6ded6eb079d9c23ed86685779346556d6353c39388f641"}

{"id": "p_c76b7176b806fa2b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 172, "text": "古之聖帝明王，未有極宮室之高麗以彫弊百姓之財力者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "31e212c63bebf2a7f86c593a7320623785c433102e0a975ba2bcab33dd6f9c60"}

{"id": "p_abfe7484a47c7a41", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 173, "text": "桀作琁室、象廊，紂爲傾宮、鹿臺，以喪其社稷，楚靈以築章華而身受其禍；秦始皇作阿房而殃及其子，天下叛之，二世而滅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "4323d8a61887784d400ca73f774d9557fc048fdc29d0a49370930599c802e3f7"}

{"id": "p_10c90f8802b32e3b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 174, "text": "夫不度萬民之力，以從耳目之欲，未有不亡者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "1b4528f321437438a9f68efd67ad6ebfbcc0ef4f5104d81b84c82c7329dc4cb1"}

{"id": "p_ff697c24018ee6c4", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 175, "text": "陛下當以堯、舜、禹、湯、文、武爲法則，夏桀、殷紂、楚靈、秦皇爲深誡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "d9bcc0e0efb2f2061bd2f0d350ac1b00ffbf664af17d3c626df4f1dac6bf4a9c"}

{"id": "p_e536ae686bb00b5a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 176, "text": "慎守天位，以承祖考，巍巍大業，猶恐失之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "8b4de5c784ca99265a551af337a83d290a470827ad64adceaa522cb5d94f7aa8"}

{"id": "p_61fb327aca3de115", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 177, "text": "不夙夜敬止，允恭卹民，而乃自暇自逸，惟宮臺是侈是飾，必有顛覆危亡之禍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "d77021322cd0adfa3ecb493fa60620b9690696b767776514216c3230350c4ad6"}

{"id": "p_7842104eefb406e3", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 178, "text": "易曰：『豐其屋，蔀其家，闚其戶，閴其無人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "5f81fdf6312b2e93e9c5dfe481efbff2dee77fc3262910cec49b84a62de9b42d"}

{"id": "p_3ef0a3a7dad51f13", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 179, "text": "』王者以天下爲家，言豐屋之禍，至於家無人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "20becb905f34e41b6447dbcc9c30ceb4f66492526c29ce25d528b21f4b928df0"}

{"id": "p_2ee89ec70b24cf97", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 180, "text": "方今二虜合從，謀危宗廟，十萬之軍，東西奔赴，邊境無一日之娛；農夫廢業，民有饑色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "20b57beaebe587509c6551a8d2dc620dfe2298ea8e2673f524b5fc53209ffb16"}

{"id": "p_a1acee726fa1c1b1", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 181, "text": "陛下不以是爲憂，而營作宮室，無有已時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "0cacb3cd5c8d4ea15e0d2dbaa3f4a8ba8da306bff84dc770d5d7cc2873bc99a4"}

{"id": "p_0994db4a917100c6", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 182, "text": "使國亡而臣可以獨存，臣又不言也；君作元首，臣爲股肱，存亡一體，得失同之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "df0ee2cf6a288d47ef30d69566b72c806c2a870750f82c4331c0f2311be86b74"}

{"id": "p_5863a93302e5eb64", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 183, "text": "孝經曰：『天子有爭臣七人，雖無道不失其天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "c51b03ad224b85a2636cc5afb004f03d01d4772fd67905ad1ff443f529fd06ab"}

{"id": "p_902b3e91bafd6b94", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 184, "text": "』臣雖駑怯，敢忘爭臣之義？", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "066aecaf89a581cc63a21af42cab3d191ba4e313bdea2c2c6d6d90a965fc18ca"}

{"id": "p_61e5f928c48094f7", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 185, "text": "言不切至，不足以感寤陛下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "8b55f18f206d602a43ee2279a9b63a05a04ceb572e5aed477b2a25fe9af6007b"}

{"id": "p_76e8913e9a42fc02", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 186, "text": "陛下不察臣言，恐皇祖烈考之祚，將墜于地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "7f21aad0004f580abe2330e8a0a29ffda1f3c042707ed2cfeb73358a3d45d404"}

{"id": "p_57e89c749e9f20c2", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 187, "text": "使臣身死有補萬一，則死之日，猶生之年也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "b27d0692be5ffa337b701180a4583c6088f8f5d97327b3ac7908fa1af8ca15cf"}

{"id": "p_e4c2f81a4e8499f1", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 188, "text": "」奏御，天子感其忠言，手筆詔荅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "e742b58d88bf170fb6fa020e0aac511e5594b2715aa5d22dc7c630acc748aebf"}

{"id": "p_b20e1ee74ceb258e", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 189, "text": "每朝廷會議，阜常侃然以天下爲己任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "dd3512b6bfd0e08cc9fc5d345ea978292dc8f074b2d8cd3a23b0688badca228f"}

{"id": "p_4875942e5eee872c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 190, "text": "數諫爭，不聽，乃屢乞遜位，未許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "877b45ba37e985d53ca6d22f5208e97e11f442a49292f1c675e7aebc6ef6d73b"}

{"id": "p_ddea48c6998a2f2d", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 191, "text": "高堂隆字升平，泰山平陽人，魯高堂生後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "f0fb15b5d409d9f1733c1aa6a2e51f804197b06fa09d4c19c4f621d2ec8ff652"}

{"id": "p_8e42409b40e3f45d", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 192, "text": "少爲諸生，泰山太守薛悌命爲督郵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "32b094015d4a774c7f4e4c68e98c46c0a685e2b541e5e91ca8f058dce92ab0c9"}

{"id": "p_b09d9f6dcb6d864f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 193, "text": "郡督軍與悌爭論，名悌而呵之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "bbcd3ee5e817e3eac5390660b3f7d41073ab6449d1419bc7915301dfb740b693"}

{"id": "p_51fd4165591e3384", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 194, "text": "隆按劒叱督軍曰：「昔魯定見侮，仲尼歷階；趙彈秦箏，相如進缶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "365ca6c6e256cdf9058fd1f6b2649d1a39dfb33ac7444033bbeaceee3821a061"}

{"id": "p_f41535e57747a9e6", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 195, "text": "」督軍失色，悌驚起止之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "6c398e8d00f346cf04598d671c6a60b9862afb4857031d5b7604bc3ab0e1fee7"}

{"id": "p_008057707b2fab22", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 196, "text": "，太祖召爲丞相軍議掾，後爲歷城侯徽文學，轉爲相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "40fc8e2d96be8be0865eb685e0e90dd26bae48795c9c7216793bb1a2dbb7545b"}

{"id": "p_c46ae8c67e089b65", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 197, "text": "徽遭太祖喪，不哀，反游獵馳騁；隆以義正諫，甚得輔導之節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "836c1ba106282e3160a19780cb9977a09f5919cdb0744d812f332822b2411c10"}

{"id": "p_4b344651fb3f9352", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 198, "text": "黃初中，爲堂陽長，以選爲平原王傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "90d9039b18dfabb5c69d423ff32721fa99b7afac770b15b42a3da35f45af64bb"}

{"id": "p_36d1af2c98e6c950", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 199, "text": "以隆爲給事中、博士、駙馬都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "b2103e27301909713a856042a9ce94c3eed79890fd210b5bb5b00008ae150e51"}

{"id": "p_ca89c4bebf5db853", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 200, "text": "帝初踐阼，羣臣或以爲宜響會，隆曰：「唐、虞有遏密之哀，高宗有不言之思，是以至德雍熈，光于四海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "c0e9738f5722330e2012802e863e6c57dcdced11e126f7e5123396865286b1f4"}

{"id": "p_717163b5f8a49175", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 201, "text": "」以爲不宜爲會，帝敬納之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "e1ad3736a4bfccfc40ced68ad81706f1c0da6877764610befef5172a03d9ff8c"}

{"id": "p_508e0c22291d11b1", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 202, "text": "犢民酉牧，年七十餘，有至行，舉爲計曹掾；帝嘉之，特除郎中以顯焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "57d640ab391216507eeeb3609d1c32e654853f26d33da326357b9e36c6cf8277"}

{"id": "p_50c84d14fd6bcd44", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 203, "text": "徵隆爲散騎常侍，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "da21d2f5af601d3c98b146241291314de8d40793612fe6ee0c1a5a2bd4bf9e50"}

{"id": "p_729cc617776dc4c7", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 204, "text": "青龍中，大治殿舍，西取長安大鍾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "0fab6315420eede8e5f2b009c421161d321b4289c6161d5a5c7f3c623abe1bcf"}

{"id": "p_5332cbf69c4b6ea7", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 205, "text": "隆上疏曰：「昔周景王不儀刑文、武之明德，忽公旦之聖制，旣鑄大錢，又作大鍾，單穆公諫而弗聽，泠州鳩對而弗從，遂迷不反，周德以衰，良史記焉，以爲永鑒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "c645a007b73d8e95b9e132e090a3fdee1265650787e7cb8cd7fbb0f54092162a"}

{"id": "p_3d652087d3da3d0e", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 206, "text": "然今之小人，好說秦、漢之奢靡以盪聖心，求取亡國不度之器，勞役費損，以傷德政，非所以興禮樂之和，保神明之休也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "385c6136be41b089d3acc434fd95a3b1978beac4a0d66e3c765b4314605aadf5"}

{"id": "p_f6b0eecd1c54302f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 207, "text": "」是日，帝幸上方，隆與卞蘭從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "0f169ea17af5511073d3930f1abd554d90c5d1f0604da109bbe5b116918a2223"}

{"id": "p_38d72dd2a74ad887", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 208, "text": "帝以隆表授蘭，使難隆曰：「興衰在政，樂何爲也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "f385d25423e6f856a4ac139c672a689c02fbe0e894b22a4e02050c52fd0b9313"}

{"id": "p_96b4f6e95df32a2d", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 209, "text": "」隆曰：「夫禮樂者，爲治之大本也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "dacc06f6ac3a791368c79f3ba9f7c27b3ee99c3daa76a284e2c5e9d8ad06ff44"}

{"id": "p_8923375fb9e69639", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 210, "text": "故簫韶九成，鳳皇來儀，雷鼓六變，天神以降，政是以平，刑是以錯，和之至也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "5abda02e1c5453d65ca861973752232eb9c13aa14de82f7bd97c191522eefbe2"}

{"id": "p_64563f29208ac8a8", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 211, "text": "新聲發響，商辛以隕，大鍾旣鑄，周景以弊，存亡之機，恒由斯作，安在廢興之不階也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "89e82a438a3ca67f9ca02273bab9a225bf019d748464e1bd453e4edce23e275c"}

{"id": "p_3663e04f950e2815", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 212, "text": "君舉必書，古之道也，作而不法，何以示後？", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "c0028b732261cacc422f61a4fee36151ed09d6b72227088051bf5ae4a04e137a"}

{"id": "p_3832b38b48158b24", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 213, "text": "聖王樂聞其闕，故有箴規之道；忠臣願竭其節，故有匪躬之義也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "da210d1cdd72d4557fab5d7831834bca75136565b6d7f289992df83abc5e5166"}

{"id": "p_9db02bc60c186464", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 214, "text": "崇華殿災，詔問隆：「此何咎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "ba153795eafe613192f1a148a8b378ba0bf0f2a8b2b2ed896dd31edd11e74ac7"}

{"id": "p_643ec158f4163b54", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 215, "text": "詔問隆：「吾聞漢武帝時，栢梁災，而大起宮殿以厭之，其義云何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "316ed22898b4363215f1f8d1951f601e1f71e214eeb3943161403ecefa5baad1"}

{"id": "p_bb4d078f48d63842", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 216, "text": "帝遂復崇華殿，時郡國有九龍見，故改曰九龍殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "3c7ec881c12d006b05561548410182cf3f89ca3c88564ddcf6c079a2a40fece8"}

{"id": "p_2447b934ae47a063", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 217, "text": "陵霄闕始構，有鵲巢其上，帝以問隆，對曰：「詩云『惟鵲有巢，惟鳩居之』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "55808aa07665bab48eb536afa4729c787646ce288e4c525a2e2a3501c37e5962"}

{"id": "p_e6f90a4da36ba721", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 218, "text": "今興宮室，起陵霄闕，而鵲巢之，此宮室未成身不得居之象也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "c3fdcafe1a531303d884f6af07f7c434505a5703ccf77c8fc63f3161659b54a4"}

{"id": "p_31444490a724d123", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 219, "text": "天意若曰，宮室未成，將有他姓制御之，斯乃上天之戒也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "400a0dfdb2a38a2f9852a01cca42c1ba14f659c345d94eb2ec817fb074456231"}

{"id": "p_0f1717c85e8d95de", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 220, "text": "夫天道無親，惟與善人，不可不深防，不可不深慮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "aa68295821b6c6e2df7dcb86e3eefa65d8ffe5c420ebede6e917131b5105a7c1"}

{"id": "p_56a63ef06a4ad408", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 221, "text": "夏、商之季，皆繼體也，不欽承上天之明命，惟讒諂是從，廢德適欲，故其亡也忽焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "312681b0c59216e4eeb474ebca5081e95a4b40187f244be73adab73ba4384934"}

{"id": "p_cbc8dc5545805b68", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 222, "text": "太戊、武丁，覩災竦懼，祗承天戒，故其興也勃焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "a7c4d1659206707a0ba5504c6dd7bcb6babffe4a4e2ae2fd79085faec10c348e"}

{"id": "p_ac12df21df36b03f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 223, "text": "今若休罷百役，儉以足用，增崇德政，動遵帝則，除普天之所患，興兆民之所利，三王可四，五帝可六，豈惟殷宗轉禍爲福而已哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "1c872109562b3bcd7617bf750effc6052642e5cb09dca581cad0bf83ee5629b1"}

{"id": "p_b387fb612c962443", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 224, "text": "臣備腹心，苟可以繁祉聖躬，安存社稷，臣雖灰身破族，猶生之年也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "054618a9aff2da15bbaa3e720c92846fa88854a893b720404cc37dc4d38208a0"}

{"id": "p_6bec929835f18fd8", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 225, "text": "豈憚忤逆之災，而令陛下不聞至言乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "afe91babdc5ee9ec70b7e38af53d46f45145fcdef73cfd362d621ae45cfc5883"}

{"id": "p_b27822a57d628313", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 226, "text": "隆上疏曰：「凡帝王徙都立邑，皆先定天地社稷之位，敬恭以奉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "391b37c63ae57028c28266423d39b13747b7c54a622030c2f6d69b6747d4fd85"}

{"id": "p_5d18de0853ddd71a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 227, "text": "將營宮室，則宗廟爲先，廄庫爲次，居室爲後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "c5b5302c79d086f1125a6ec11f873633dca0457121682135a5177e9004845dd7"}

{"id": "p_83fa6ecbc86f7b1b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 228, "text": "今圜丘、方澤、南北郊、明堂、社稷，神位未定，宗廟之制又未如禮，而崇飾居室，士民失業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "9d9d1e45bf44092da200fbee38d18c072fe50ec449596c07dd08f797dcaf1462"}

{"id": "p_120dd0c9ee4c0015", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 229, "text": "外人咸云宮人之用，與興戎軍國之費，所盡略齊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "73122c5c2ea47aabd95883cff45f2c1c7beaf922760c96e7fffa2f1b78187426"}

{"id": "p_ebd31ea497d6111c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 230, "text": "書曰『天聦明自我民聦明，天明畏自我民明威』，輿人作頌，則嚮以五福，民怒吁嗟，則威以六極，言天之賞罰，隨民言，順民心也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "67f95b8a4b7547d620e10af9cca0021298d6b9b5f85a85227d10ac289f6a3d6a"}

{"id": "p_15a5a8b4e744a801", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 231, "text": "是以臨政務在安民爲先，然後稽古之化，格于上下，自古及今，未嘗不然也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "e136285d185a2dc2e1bbcfeead3665b41c9ce4e2c38f32a3a88ef12d301cc5be"}

{"id": "p_99d710749e6d85cd", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 232, "text": "夫采椽卑宮，唐、虞、大禹之所以垂皇風也；玉臺瓊室，夏癸、商辛之所以犯昊天也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "aa38f148add098c9a0d07cc8124e49c74f86e85041c84d1f135580a8f7afb0f1"}

{"id": "p_bf535343c818a6d9", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 233, "text": "今之宮室，實違禮度，乃更建立九龍，華飾過前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "f6cf6b5c625c18fe1894c4ef2ea9a89bef1f3c4f82298182bbfe60c9636fa409"}

{"id": "p_7d7a96f56e03517f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 234, "text": "天彗章灼，始起於房心，犯帝坐而干紫微，此乃皇天子愛陛下，是以發教戒之象，始卒皆於尊位，殷勤鄭重，欲必覺寤陛下；斯乃慈父懇切之訓，宜崇孝子祗聳之禮，以率先天下，以昭示後昆，不宜有忽，以重天怒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "08b9eb3725d696481ea96b5e3b07d25971d03c98ea93eed447c811c31cfd31c0"}

{"id": "p_2e65c38b077aafdf", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 235, "text": "隆上疏曰：「夫拓跡垂統，必俟聖明，輔世匡治，亦須良佐，用能庶績其凝而品物康乂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "92b24bf56b2587e495bcb35d7e02d2fc8b8f1660288f81e754372bc8e37d18ed"}

{"id": "p_61a5cedc5181d080", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 236, "text": "夫移風易俗，宣明道化，使四表同風，回首面內，德教光熈，九服慕義，固非俗吏之所能也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "ee0c1606db9bbc46fdf11400d117b1492dc73fc1d62d563cb424d07b0ac6a5ef"}

{"id": "p_13bf7a005c900edf", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 237, "text": "今有司務糾刑書，不本大道，是以刑用而不措，俗弊而不敦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "a47f4ac560dd95e6e505093ed20632cbded8df3bc074a48efc551e0bb3b34677"}

{"id": "p_7f5671a2343b144b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 238, "text": "宜崇禮樂，班叙明堂，脩三雍、大射、養老，營建郊廟，尊儒士，舉逸民，表章制度，改正朔，易服色，布愷悌，尚儉素，然後備禮封禪，歸功天地，使雅頌之聲盈于六合，緝熈之化混于後嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "1b6b88e971db06122e2457f29fc34c0f03c3440df70d52d4ea3549ec1edbd8d7"}

{"id": "p_f69614b75e86666c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 239, "text": "斯蓋至治之美事，不朽之貴業也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "7ed882829a94b40cf6caadf0bc49da35972467e630c5104ebf7cab9d1bdd2aa1"}

{"id": "p_f738bc4a6a5eb0b6", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 240, "text": "然九域之內，可揖讓而治，尚何憂哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "32bb2cb0877055206dbfd13298037b276a5847cabb064ba5861c60a9989da900"}

{"id": "p_1fc57e950ad7422a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 241, "text": "不正其本而救其末，譬猶棼絲，非政理也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "0fbf64459f892be3e60e539422c60bd49f2311b9465e9e7d3a0e4d289740e1de"}

{"id": "p_3744be6d52469e9f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 242, "text": "可命羣公卿士通儒，造具其事，以爲典式。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "9132ae1c5f7d8f66d2bf40246f2bf30944d604b541c630a2c178eeba19508920"}

{"id": "p_aeded27aeb70e40b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 243, "text": "」隆又以爲改正朔，易服色，殊徽號，異器械，自古帝王所以神明其政，變民耳目，故三春稱王，明三統也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "24f42f4890682188e354b059d47fdd81890f491bdc279807110d363b2d7b1bec"}

{"id": "p_074a958ff20388c9", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 244, "text": "於是敷演舊章，奏而改焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "52f68bc0a6ef652fc1b8a54f385a720a027b00b8ccf6c2f6cd0926895510403b"}

{"id": "p_57c571fc2619c66f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 245, "text": "帝從其議，改春三月爲孟夏四月，服色尚黃，犧牲用白，從地正也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "0c6f991e31c249322cc8ab323318a6a3391794ed016f84d8eabcec087c43d72d"}

{"id": "p_d304c67a00457a8a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 246, "text": "帝愈增崇宮殿，彫飾觀閣，鑿太行之石英，采穀城之文石，起景陽山於芳林之園，建昭陽殿於太極之北，鑄作黃龍鳳皇奇偉之獸，飾金墉、陵雲臺、陵霄闕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "17e7165dfc8f7033d0d029f5926b54b65276ece5918f13bcf84590f817a3e777"}

{"id": "p_5c18e5909ebf199c", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 247, "text": "百役繁興，作者萬數，公卿以下至于學生，莫不展力，帝乃躬自握土以率之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "a18c596a7113dbfd20fbd8c5669813e6b51ab5b3f0bdbfb97dd95a747a3e82c8"}

{"id": "p_152257be81745a6f", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 248, "text": "天作淫雨，冀州水出，漂沒民物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "4ffea1c739513af1f15836c9ad689372f3dc19946de6efb6438bf189db94c820"}

{"id": "p_897c87a4686410fe", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 249, "text": "書奏，帝覽焉，謂中書監、令曰：「觀隆此奏，使朕懼哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "462c80c6656b67f30590bd61b32a93ce4ef811e76e88c3bd9f797bfc915f3a55"}

{"id": "p_1b9326be584a5ca7", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 250, "text": "詔曰：「」隆卒，遺令薄葬，歛以時服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "b58f6312339a9aae9c1f50aff88a31fda96f362fb4f2ebafb96c4b1352aafb77"}

{"id": "p_89cc9badce492168", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 251, "text": "初，太和中，中護軍蔣濟上疏曰「宜遵古封禪」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "5586a06fda6ef05c490ffba3b207e9d7cf9fc94f2381784320f8126654cdb1a5"}

{"id": "p_8e6864e5137c8b3b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 252, "text": "詔曰：「」事寢歷歲，後遂議脩之，使隆撰其禮儀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "fb2c6e18181dc4e9ffba1bb1831700aeb80b2c53e7b49b929b88088cbe3957da"}

{"id": "p_1c236b855f82ebd0", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 253, "text": "帝聞隆沒，歎息曰：「天不欲成吾事，高堂生舍我亡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "531c01bfc3d1af8b36c6f6a4df5426a728dd41f60fd991b45d49328417e7ed08"}

{"id": "p_6394583f2c60794e", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 254, "text": "始，景初中，帝以蘇林、秦靜等並老，恐無能傳業者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "c08eacc22773a7ce4b925bff4cd672b9e340bcc5c521854ef382c719797b85d4"}

{"id": "p_ed8be859d3daf012", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 255, "text": "乃詔曰：「」數年，隆等皆卒，學者遂廢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "1226675371235d0926378ab795b3b6c9eb5e1560aad3df58729c1b4f29284663"}

{"id": "p_c3a292c6b84f5af5", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 256, "text": "初，任城棧潛，太祖世歷縣令，嘗督守鄴城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "415db1bbecf3147c7493a740bfed05e2c7ab6e94bae02920114c64e3db46edb3"}

{"id": "p_9b2c0bf091b962cc", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 257, "text": "時文帝爲太子，耽樂田獵，晨出夜還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "9b16d6aab7ce9f7704c52cb82b282a5563b9508f3d6f6b3cacd624b0033e23e2"}

{"id": "p_3490ce8f4d8f1aa6", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 258, "text": "潛諫曰：「王公設險以固其國，都城禁衞，用戒不虞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "a455668132403bdb5d8828bf2921551429d2d8d18829c567be95682e0cc6542b"}

{"id": "p_99aded33b74c1105", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 259, "text": "大雅云：『宗子維城，無俾城壞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "46d3b243863fed390220a8db50f38209b313064cd47cd0752dfa73fdd194a579"}

{"id": "p_b26be97b85b412cf", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 260, "text": "』又曰：『猶之未遠，是用大簡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "eb32577c66e94497de1357b88da633922984a3e38e2b67f7355189008ebbb0e6"}

{"id": "p_7140d23d555dde83", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 261, "text": "』若逸于遊田，晨出昏歸，以一日從禽之娛，而忘無垠之釁，愚竊惑之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "7dd0b379a1d5a90a343323525862256896956549d6237aab3eb208836cf524d8"}

{"id": "p_9ff2c9e20fb0588e", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 262, "text": "」太子不恱，然自後游出差簡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "81d9fdf3da526c1f1fa7ec96c9d7750e379a0bf960c2147221f3f19999174a6e"}

{"id": "p_ed4e00f89b9cee5a", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 263, "text": "黃初中，文帝將立郭貴嬪爲皇后，潛上疏諫，語在〈后妃傳〉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "69db2353de1bacc0d6922e9597e57097196ce85140fd1fc9015d0ce48e6ef2c9"}

{"id": "p_ae5ea2d5861c4e9b", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 264, "text": "明帝時，衆役並興，戚屬疏斥，潛上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "e72fbcf7d02de7202dc197f32060093ee7065bbdbcd4da1b379735e3ee6262fb"}

{"id": "p_1d310a0c3737b3fb", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 265, "text": "後爲燕中尉，辭疾不就，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "9df9f4e0dfbe27215e463a02719af90de11d67ee936246bdf5227c986f435b07"}

{"id": "p_2b80937447334320", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 266, "text": "評曰：辛毗、楊阜，剛亮公直，正諫匪躬，亞乎汲黯之高風焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "54ce4f55bf0aea25d09064d9f562b557d036b223c52dea267a0fec76ac3e5ee9"}

{"id": "p_c3678a792183c0d4", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 267, "text": "高堂隆學業脩明，志在匡君，因變陳戒，發於懇誠，忠矣哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "444d2bd965be4f4205772d9df45558aaca9782c47a0a9ab08e4adf3922e85d70"}

{"id": "p_bc4be41629ee9995", "source_id": "src_6c5f58321b1ec0ba", "ordinal": 268, "text": "及至必改正朔，俾魏祖虞，所謂意過其通者歟！", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "f912c021ffb204fc6b6cfc0832590bdfa6e7481c18d33b372f1af886cc3a5add"}

{"id": "p_9dc4212874472555", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_06a995c9ae6f1e56", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 1, "text": "滿寵字伯寧，山陽昌邑人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "2f31ed4c7b066d0a6f9022cd5a2c322efe3705d8eec2daa8d84a272d6ea107e1"}

{"id": "p_df650b4818f3237d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 2, "text": "時郡內李朔等各擁部曲，害于平民，太守使寵糾焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "41dd20106b1e9f7b8f304ca7edad97b046bfc2460818421df05477e77f175828"}

{"id": "p_57f9ec72e8d4caaa", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 3, "text": "縣人張苞爲郡督郵，貪穢受取，干亂吏政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "06d1ec8b3ba9d86d6e09ad5d65d7df4cf3930dd3b6bf894943659a3c3b3dfffb"}

{"id": "p_ef9e6ace702589c3", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 4, "text": "寵因其來在傳舍，率吏卒出收之，詰責所犯，即日考竟，遂棄官歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "62072e7ba7e40f0a7c1273b32175e6bd034c8fab6d6af1a994e1ee7302dd49b8"}

{"id": "p_89cf457c40082384", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 5, "text": "及爲大將軍，辟署西曹屬，爲許令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "1a4291db388697d4e0b46bcbf3424f49ec9e8a562f4a6472f2b514d209c24d22"}

{"id": "p_1cd444140ffd66e4", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 6, "text": "時曹洪宗室親貴，有賔客在界，數犯法，寵收治之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "f23308ff12b7a74736e13605bc7a3f81354186d01f5126a43af86dc41162f9ec"}

{"id": "p_f6844f2c58db9a9d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 7, "text": "洪白太祖，太祖召許主者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "0cd202864c4c675c1f6f0330bf6bfed074cd4d188b53114f142b8f034e8301e8"}

{"id": "p_48cf470dc10658d8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 8, "text": "太祖喜曰：「當事不當耳邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "803a93bef7862917680acf73a4075f870006cc9bef333994e1d2b94882c0efe0"}

{"id": "p_30dbcc7c5a7379ff", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」故太尉楊彪收付縣獄，尚書令荀彧、少府孔融等並屬寵：「但當受辭，勿加考掠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "a4d38e78d6197876bd6fc76046bbe9f082ef2c3d6d9fbbe69d658a1e5b381fb4"}

{"id": "p_c63a7db7d1980eef", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」寵一無所報，考訊如法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "4e9afdef35cd5592d913de79efbe6cda294b24869e8db755074fd52dd2324ed4"}

{"id": "p_d7e20fdd218e5d33", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 11, "text": "數日，求見太祖，言之曰：「楊彪考訊無他辭語。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "60052a92228b45352081aaf066a5241344a6acf078a68f2f3722e8c06de5c21d"}

{"id": "p_bc5556335fa11950", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 12, "text": "當殺者宜先彰其罪；此人有名海內，若罪不明，必大失民望，竊爲明公惜之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "3957c31f88d4f7e4b08a9492040ba9c9fa88a8ae1c878eeded87b9f34579a84b"}

{"id": "p_475d008dd3b1aa9f", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 13, "text": "初，彧、融聞考掠彪，皆怒，及因此得了，更善寵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "2d3bca0a68d5b0ee007c7133c690da88327464e317f12a47030fabdfa8100c38"}

{"id": "p_57846451fb756e9b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 14, "text": "時袁紹盛於河朔，而汝南紹之本郡，門生賔客布在諸縣，擁兵拒守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "d4479b2787bde31c5421b190d0892786902c33bae00536f9df3bd10848059fa0"}

{"id": "p_41ff2b15e9baf390", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 15, "text": "太祖憂之，以寵爲汝南太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "c68f0d45205055ade3ba76046309c19ed6ceddb51bcb642d9d399a62d2838c0d"}

{"id": "p_62568bab43490ed7", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 16, "text": "寵募其服從者五百人，率攻下二十餘壁，誘其未降渠帥，於坐上殺十餘人，一時皆平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "31892954735ff523958698826db4230c57dac986a0486c6b0d5623a172f62bfb"}

{"id": "p_6fffc7a2534a0b7b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 17, "text": "得戶二萬，兵二千人，令就田業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "7bc69162318ffc410f033f9a385a5549426b07ee327b18caa258d2fd4d5bcbe9"}

{"id": "p_1d28015d440d47b9", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 18, "text": "大軍還，留寵行奮威將軍，屯當陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "aa3c85464da68e0e38275f162334db2df8003cdeee6d605e0fcbf0e2af6387fe"}

{"id": "p_2a0cf418500ea9b4", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 19, "text": "孫權數擾東陲，復召寵還爲汝南太守，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "633e46503d6437ee6a76b75f1ea5cd9b82237e80af2851bf19f556ebe05b4c2c"}

{"id": "p_efc63e93b6aba0ac", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 20, "text": "關羽圍襄陽，寵助征南將軍曹仁屯樊城拒之，而左將軍于禁等軍以霖雨水長爲羽所沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "0962a7b7121c84ba2123a19bb2b2155743b1ae2b837fed490cb67b8bb5f999b4"}

{"id": "p_cc1c583e819193ce", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 21, "text": "羽急攻樊城，樊城得水，往往崩壞，衆皆失色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "b8ce36a1ccdcd95610037bd8b79851c3b902bc639cde20420ad88980e77d7621"}

{"id": "p_cfcfaea318d685d6", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 22, "text": "或謂仁曰：「今日之危，非力所支。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "cd1249cd7c9715849519cfea59f9ed49958c177089412ea4c0514b0d5d4df4c7"}

{"id": "p_0fec2e5c63808978", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 23, "text": "可及羽圍未合，乘輕船夜走，雖失城，尚可全身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "cef3b5578a1b600bcdceda9506e22ab56316be5c662ca42f8acd45c92f355238"}

{"id": "p_d86c2ae320392302", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」寵曰：「山水速疾，冀其不久。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "ca6b3cd5de93a1114eb39d5cfc7209694439440120c7ff6061ee4a3e9456fbf5"}

{"id": "p_3a14ffca986da111", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 25, "text": "聞羽遣別將已在郟下，自許以南，百姓擾擾，羽所以不敢遂進者，恐吾軍掎其後耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "9e304dc095f1d1925144d3654afa53902a85f4a0833d463fadcd8ad1ddf30c2f"}

{"id": "p_a398f9aad6df35ab", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 26, "text": "今若遁去，洪河以南，非復國家有也；君宜待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "e14059d7de5cc47d534cee4ada65689f20fbb35fc2b90faeec06b51ab9e8857b"}

{"id": "p_4755bf45a1050c7a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」寵乃沈白馬，與軍人盟誓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "f9b8aca6f800b754247be8e832471af8f81c9866fe705350d95659e53ab19d8e"}

{"id": "p_fdaaca5dcc0b48d6", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 28, "text": "會徐晃等救至，寵力戰有功，羽遂退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "b4b6eb1e315b133c60e80e9472f48c910717b5988caabe2b47a90486be8e6d9b"}

{"id": "p_b03735b8ee101d05", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 29, "text": "文帝即王位，遷揚武將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "3ee52dcd5dcec6197339ca8803d7d422205fe306888c8b7af855f932a8fb0cb4"}

{"id": "p_2cddcc77e8505c7d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 30, "text": "破吳於江陵有功，更拜伏波將軍，屯新野。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "0943da3f6bef63119ba2a765e59fde560dbeb43d31cbc9d96bb72f83a8116df0"}

{"id": "p_88a85ade779ae8cf", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 31, "text": "大軍南征，到精湖，寵帥諸軍在前，與賊隔水相對。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "81f0b0d43b987ed91d27d69e45a74527bda693fddb22e09c9b5e1de33a1c9406"}

{"id": "p_f82aa786ccf18b6e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 32, "text": "寵勑諸將曰：「今夕風甚猛，賊必來燒軍，宜爲其備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "0804ea26f351ef7b082c16feda9bd995bf8f87e4d2cd6169c95d45ef10b3407e"}

{"id": "p_ab3bf39bd23ab33a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 33, "text": "夜半，賊果遣十部伏夜來燒，寵掩擊破之，進封南鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "bd2348364e927d95a60bcd986ef558f28f50b4cd01b1dcebab7f75682c379b89"}

{"id": "p_bd4c594acebef012", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 34, "text": "三年春，降人稱吳大嚴，揚聲欲詣江北獵，孫權欲自出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "720fa5eb36c1ed5e985d4d3968fb38542dfab98b1add40e4c0dfc43403212d2c"}

{"id": "p_5338d09de61a7e12", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 35, "text": "寵度其必襲西陽而爲之備，權聞之，退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "805741c5d8f5f326a73721a21c654ad8862304c78e56e7667f42e45d37541289"}

{"id": "p_ad25211a302e2919", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 36, "text": "秋，使曹休從廬江南入合肥，令寵向夏口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "eb728559e9f6b27383b1b2751d7e6bd05ae1ec0649958c5412e0e34a216f0786"}

{"id": "p_dd1f867414f706a8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 37, "text": "寵上疏曰：「曹休雖明果而希用兵，今所從道，背湖旁江，易進難退，此兵之窪地也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "a5d19fde25809fe37d3e2933d908575d2603fc592496d69f325a4a1432cd8873"}

{"id": "p_84c7768ab3238a82", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 38, "text": "若入無彊口，宜深爲之備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "fd2b3801f5523611fa63fbfcd02caf41feb482ee9c3ef6e264d5aece9ab14661"}

{"id": "p_b2b2e7aa8f4eb4ba", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 39, "text": "賊果從無彊口斷夾石，要休還路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "581df36772b8dacb11b02ca36374272ea1d39b0874f94889b46663616c158a71"}

{"id": "p_58094d6314ea4583", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 40, "text": "會朱靈等從後來斷道，與賊相遇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "17835f34eea3267823cf7ec8ec3c5c661a2b463decc52f8c99e0e185c5c1cbdf"}

{"id": "p_73d87f78de137dd9", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 41, "text": "是歲休薨，寵以前將軍代都督揚州諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "b7d1f5e3b433235d6417c946c641b9cd9d4eb65ff4214a9da60ec257d1384c4d"}

{"id": "p_959bfa90ff63a577", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 42, "text": "汝南兵民戀慕，大小相率，奔隨道路，不可禁止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "00c686f3043c588f49d91ef95c4aae070f909d66a10bd2b7c7f79de6f20ff32c"}

{"id": "p_4c0adb345a4350b7", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 43, "text": "護軍表上，欲殺其爲首者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "b5a247dd40d6f2b31709e1c799e6261d2bb79c29a32d1fbe4d93033a2215f004"}

{"id": "p_222043a5e4a4d3d6", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 44, "text": "詔使寵將親兵千人自隨，其餘一無所問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "086952d233d541749daf7ea32b2751f6de1b4644655f73794ac732a28d3765a8"}

{"id": "p_e43c5943dcee6bbb", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 45, "text": "其冬，孫權揚聲欲至合肥，寵表召兖、豫諸軍，皆集。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "371f836f7a266ebf473ba6b431035f9af1650ff381ab235c39a4f9cccf27aec2"}

{"id": "p_73820b43bfdf6783", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 46, "text": "寵以爲今賊大舉而還，非本意也，此必欲僞退以罷吾兵，而倒還乘虛，掩不備也，表不罷兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "b3cd8897b1225e58f9a7e80158e40a508fd5ff0cd44abc4545b395b25f5e5870"}

{"id": "p_9923bcddd865aca1", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 47, "text": "後十餘日，權果更來，到合肥城，不克而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "4f720fb9f06fc22141d1395263eb7f391a220ef4fd5fc2b3e5d90d6e8de59da0"}

{"id": "p_a9842024e29e810c", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 48, "text": "其明年，吳將孫布遣人詣揚州求降，辭云：「道遠不能自致，乞兵見迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "a52c5df42d0abd74717cdd6d779aea8483515bd7d0292aa1eec280bfdbd46a90"}

{"id": "p_49726ffc7c6755e1", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 49, "text": "」刺史王淩騰布書，請兵馬迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "36f524712c72ae72ba692c11348d7728b31fc2cc280e91763d27d1f9683272c5"}

{"id": "p_890f801586190cf8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 50, "text": "寵以爲必詐，不與兵，而作報書曰：「知識邪正，欲避禍就順，去暴歸道，甚相嘉尚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "e0ca9ff4d8d87f50ac2dc4f612c816616832e834f88a10788672899a4c04e8ae"}

{"id": "p_172297c1cbc84d4e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 51, "text": "今欲遣兵相迎，然計兵少則不足相衞，多則事必遠聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "2f8467657080c61d148f82ad0b11181d1958b79c13fb8dc444a72a26bc38d960"}

{"id": "p_b21831ab9f7f6841", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 52, "text": "且先密計以成本志，臨時節度其宜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "ea718b5778b136d6221f9b34d13b41a43cb514615725543b207dd758adcb86fd"}

{"id": "p_85ac2a196d4de237", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 53, "text": "」寵會被書當入朝，勑留府長史：「若淩欲往迎，勿與兵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "1624173ec2404c42f9944276f7098543a700281443b2e55a77c53da7211d49bb"}

{"id": "p_452340972125a51f", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 54, "text": "」淩於後索兵不得，乃單遣一督將步騎七百人往迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "96182a6da105a4cc6131e5f8caafa8e3ca66f78e33ffa50abdc3fa7986c960a5"}

{"id": "p_f556b29a96dbd3d0", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 55, "text": "布夜掩擊，督將迸走，死傷過半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "cebc6e53d225c22dc2924edd85341efd678ff6a7875e068e1cb72294502463eb"}

{"id": "p_9e97eef63e3c342e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 56, "text": "初，寵與淩共事不平，淩支黨毀寵疲老悖謬，故明帝召之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "c591081ee1c1615f6ed805fb04ede1644c38c62f93d8a1c3282323122f6f72bc"}

{"id": "p_dae7f383e1ccdb6e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 57, "text": "旣至，體氣康彊，見而遣還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "b32f331b80b0ffb6bb2a6ae0ce79cb7b54c338f605d4022e017bf218eda5c7b0"}

{"id": "p_30ec0bec4985bea8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 58, "text": "寵屢表求留，詔報曰：「昔廉頗彊食，馬援據鞌，今君未老而自謂已老，何與廉、馬之相背邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "7de0db2d50bdda3f624a41be043727ce599c1b2b78f9a53e94d25fb77b4c1383"}

{"id": "p_d05d7a267f8824f9", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 59, "text": "」明年，吴將陸遜向廬江，論者以爲宜速赴之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "d4c29e4ed538f6fc038a410a65521c6916d05e58724ce2f387620ac87c6e04e6"}

{"id": "p_002fa75b8d091ad5", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 60, "text": "寵曰：「廬江雖小，將勁兵精，守則經時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "c0b87197f9fe7e2b627751b9c1e1f8ddcaf0ac961a10cb8f0bec32741fbe2196"}

{"id": "p_e183db47cc2dc5ec", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 61, "text": "又賊舍船二百里來，後尾空縣，尚欲誘致，今宜聽其遂進，但恐走不可及耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "bc504a098aab52fa93b8dd5c29703e58e5d673ab166ac81a632e51454ca676d2"}

{"id": "p_c87a6d7bee2e2964", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 62, "text": "，寵上疏曰：「合肥城南臨江湖，北遠壽春，賊攻圍之，得據水爲勢；官兵救之，當先破賊大輩，然後圍乃得解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "9184263c0ed6781319e508621be8226b901f1e0430a248fd3c28fd2af524a8bf"}

{"id": "p_9a18640d5d0347c7", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 63, "text": "賊往甚易，而兵往救之甚難，宜移城內之兵，其西三十里，有奇險可依，更立城以固守，此爲引賊平地而掎其歸路，於計爲便。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "d57912eaeb09d8a98788cad332eedb6cc295e647164b567be123e422aab9afb2"}

{"id": "p_1acbec8ee356a9a6", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 64, "text": "」護軍將軍蔣濟議，以爲：「旣示天下以弱，且望賊煙火而壞城，此爲未攻而自拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "46a677e0e33823803edc2525fb5142216fab87414db428844e598dda62cb44de"}

{"id": "p_ce44932ee44894f8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 65, "text": "一至於此，劫略無限，必以淮北爲守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "f73260d5588cae2f3fbeb2ad11edeace515aa1f4686cdffb4abf8f2f9a310760"}

{"id": "p_3e7040bfa6e3a818", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 66, "text": "寵重表曰：「孫子言，兵者，詭道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "b5c28792ea4333a78c8a3789be564fab0880a4f1955f9761046e3de10aa68753"}

{"id": "p_398af6b74fe72b5b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 67, "text": "故能而示之以弱不能，驕之以利，示之以懾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "779597ebfe9c7eb89cd1de38ca310ab9dcaf8aea30b384c590f02a1eabd197d5"}

{"id": "p_31381976ba82c590", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 68, "text": "今賊未至而移城却內，此所謂形而誘之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "e7beccc096cf1efd704317601fc414af08225a75d5f2780cd3fb9f39d82d19fc"}

{"id": "p_fb3eccf47c6a5cb2", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 69, "text": "引賊遠水，擇利而動，舉得於外，則福生於內矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "ed183101617a6e11d928ce6bf8187aef68f7a0d9da3bcf2b2d60834e48dbabdd"}

{"id": "p_bc59ffe62e89c2ac", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 70, "text": "」尚書趙咨以寵策爲長，詔遂報聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "4327e1df4c3c27d05d7123ff2601a0479b88bc5d56a39708f778065309b67945"}

{"id": "p_7bf285e505e9f7e3", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 71, "text": "其年，權自出，欲圍新城，以其遠水，積二十日不敢下舡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "447b9973739b5b3139c73f8a6777014b1ca7aadb581d3255651d33affd04959d"}

{"id": "p_fc3fa00f5a425f9e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 72, "text": "寵謂諸將曰：「權得吾移城，必於其衆中有自大之言，今大舉來欲要一切之功，雖不敢至，必當上岸耀兵以示有餘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "1b6e7833c1fd4aadc9e755f4fc8bab6aef8a4aeb1e46194ec32a0a61c3b2b328"}

{"id": "p_0d853582c911006c", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」乃潛遣步騎六千，伏肥城隱處以待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "ba8477b7ef59b7781119904cb64735c5a1af8471b86704b98df20f0be0aac344"}

{"id": "p_ec70ab98b22faf5a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 74, "text": "權果上岸耀兵，寵伏軍卒起擊之，斬首數百，或有赴水死者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "fb498489aeb78c5459fa5234f85df7933ad332485ca37a3b17fba1539d1abb47"}

{"id": "p_68960897f6f01552", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 75, "text": "明年，權自將號十萬，至合肥新城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "960f0ac9ccb1d295f9a565c88c291605468d97eb77a6943f3bd76973cdc9e548"}

{"id": "p_2b7d1ad1fd25c2a5", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 76, "text": "寵馳往赴，募壯士數十人，折松爲炬，灌以麻油，從上風放火，燒賊攻具，射殺權弟子孫泰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "4cd234d2b4038aa1c903e285066a07822d42f18f47e3ca26a663870cb781e4db"}

{"id": "p_58ddb24e47bc7d54", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 77, "text": "三年春，權遣兵數千家佃於江北。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "b5021a9f27a68981246f5b4c441bfaf370ce0a7b1f414a710d94f69baa311982"}

{"id": "p_72ff4f0180b3975e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 78, "text": "至八月，寵以爲田向收孰，男女布野，其屯衞兵去城遠者數百里，可掩擊也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "04005a90989007a3ef4e346d3ea97adeee06965bf9197e213904bbf022250d14"}

{"id": "p_4ead0d8f6819ddb6", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 79, "text": "遣長史督三軍循江東下，摧破諸屯，焚燒穀物而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "bf168961522e24a8831ac382fae108cb5cd79ad1fc4b38c79a7dfc391ba0fb82"}

{"id": "p_e98b5a0919b87b67", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 80, "text": "詔羙之，因以所獲盡爲將士賞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "d58285c5ceb7b56597e410aa67fb8b1c06c8e0b67e66feae98c8664f7edcbf5b"}

{"id": "p_0622c6acb5bc6895", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 81, "text": "，以寵年老徵還，遷爲太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "9c5c0079a21eaf863efe896c9f70258e4127abe1bde3c4ab9cce8300145eedca"}

{"id": "p_71a3b4eb2d62df50", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 82, "text": "詔曰：「君典兵在外，專心憂公，有行父、祭遵之風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "a48e077477600f24ae5c1eeb039c366ef78329aa25bb70c733a5b82f82f309e4"}

{"id": "p_efbe48c9f48138d0", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 83, "text": "賜田十頃，糓五百斛，錢二十萬，以明清忠儉約之節焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "05fab2277fa8335c90b291f3bfa691245a8f4867ca7f686615bd5402e514f368"}

{"id": "p_bcc1d3f8a8d94d6b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」寵前後增邑，凡九千六百戶，封子孫二人亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "f335a534743b969e88341fd155828e011e18ba11354a1eb98c71fc23a62c8ab1"}

{"id": "p_97ad77060bca401d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 85, "text": "偉以格度知名，官至衞尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "8b21cb2a1e9d2867ac6f7d6274558b181f73c3451d4fed05b062b6fc9b7bcca2"}

{"id": "p_3f2a13262978210f", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 86, "text": "田豫字國讓，漁陽雍奴人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "38c3ff6618088007aad7a4e7bdbfea47e0e988f1be03ec6027728add6e57b1aa"}

{"id": "p_c794714ce703621a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 87, "text": "劉備之奔公孫瓚也，豫時年少，自託於備，備甚奇之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "da19d8c8202afa48dc678c2007d0d6839c8358701cbc51f092632d889d2098ad"}

{"id": "p_eac19fb535aeef1a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 88, "text": "備爲豫州刺史，豫以母老求歸，備涕泣與別，曰：「恨不與君共成大事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "49c53844d7d8491199623eaa0f7bb6b24f7519cc4493638fbbdb23cc1a2e228e"}

{"id": "p_2df0ac6a52752b5e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 89, "text": "公孫瓚使豫守東州令，瓚將王門叛瓚，爲袁紹將萬餘人來攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "fbdb6381379500e9b421d96457362527aa96218033aea38ac798ac4f16b36b41"}

{"id": "p_7701890a123f0160", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 90, "text": "豫登城謂門曰：「卿爲公孫所厚而去，意有所不得已也；今還作賊，乃知卿亂人耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "7a8b20a4e041519890455cc7b55b861f59b2701f0571a8ca6121f7a21b71b338"}

{"id": "p_f76639c36619b525", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 91, "text": "夫挈瓶之智，守不假器，吾旣受之矣；何不急攻乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "16ba0a855962ff0d59a1dfc12f9f72ca8784b1511622daf6e22fcacc512c172b"}

{"id": "p_a4e43ec06d332fb1", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 92, "text": "瓚雖知豫有權謀而不能任也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "ca5c5354a0123844711130106cd557e3db3ea0f91f518e7aa80f8a9836f16a7e"}

{"id": "p_e24bea9d27247ea1", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 93, "text": "瓚敗而鮮于輔爲國人所推，行太守事，素善豫，以爲長史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "b32c469524cf9b2154b0243b4b6634dc1a68e6c197b1b0d9a13b75f9f8592468"}

{"id": "p_220598f8818d3218", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 94, "text": "時雄傑並起，輔莫知所從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "ff08d729087766b7f28e232a12fae8abab8e61148d632f3ce4692928c57b3e56"}

{"id": "p_348fb345086e94e1", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 95, "text": "豫謂輔曰：「終能定天下者，必曹氏也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "b76b7eaaf81bb21f3ceae3ed0509f8c68c9472d9dd38caeb412c9632ea510a66"}

{"id": "p_cdcf59d33289ea54", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 96, "text": "太祖召豫爲丞相軍謀掾，除頴陰、朗陵令，遷弋陽太守，所在有治。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "96a4d19e5b6b25652886dd51a9feba2c378fd9e0d4079661cdbc88f9a44cd08c"}

{"id": "p_5c324e6301edbfc2", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 97, "text": "鄢陵侯彰征代郡，以豫爲相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "173a2ae00e9ea2fac0f14f26c845b3aa2498c4bba9166a200b0863442a7d1bff"}

{"id": "p_dc42fbe25d37cd20", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 98, "text": "軍次易北，虜伏騎擊之，軍人擾亂，莫知所爲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "b100c97fc0ac00bdd602384c60c7964dc8558ff8d2379c3c95948615b79dcb4c"}

{"id": "p_1d07adc52de85154", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 99, "text": "豫因地形，回車結圜陣，弓弩持滿於內，疑兵塞其隙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "7376785e202493602843cb0d2c1c0142f3cdf00116bc8a6aa6e41de80ba9c769"}

{"id": "p_81d66d7b1e9402c0", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 100, "text": "追擊，大破之，遂前平代，皆豫策也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "583ccc08000b0bbf96d6dd3824b9af9260b0592ea12fa5a8a96d7c59f65fb441"}

{"id": "p_6e709cfbd3fda63d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 101, "text": "先時，郡人侯音反，衆數千人在山中爲群盜，大爲郡患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "d47e03dee228fcb43b25e8c84b5c1585622b4e1cf0693d506b8e140b585e1451"}

{"id": "p_09f90b6ab77156d7", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 102, "text": "前太守收其黨與五百餘人，表奏皆當死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "778b8f7cab5f9e558c51e407293868de204f531cb1e3520b820ef5c721477c1b"}

{"id": "p_0a75047ed79b5d14", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 103, "text": "豫悉見諸繫囚，慰喻，開其自新之路，一時破械遣之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "e164779aedeaad92d49f36c6f041d19e237ac5837132195c6aa1ab1f6ac7c2f9"}

{"id": "p_97045695f37835bd", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 104, "text": "諸囚皆叩頭，願自效，即相告語，群賊一朝解散，郡內清靜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "3150de6c40db1b8a8ee4dd7067cedc9a2cb6ad26660ce94a41e4683f38e9d1d5"}

{"id": "p_e3434812ef7bc98c", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 105, "text": "文帝初，北狄彊盛，侵擾邊塞，乃使豫持節護烏丸校尉，牽招、解儁并護鮮卑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "3d0bd339176f8915b77af99faa5122ab4315b1ec498a3eaa431d967d11994b77"}

{"id": "p_052a685f41ec8f22", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 106, "text": "自高柳以東，濊貊以西，鮮卑數十部，比能、彌加、素利割地統御，各有分界；乃共誓要，皆不得以馬與中國市。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "7f9db3eb4c1ced23c547f3142d5a48fd959f41aa8d7b58ff2bd75f9394a24d94"}

{"id": "p_ed5f6a6b6a2fb3da", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 107, "text": "豫以戎狄爲一，非中國之利，乃先搆離之，使自爲讎敵，互相攻伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "0818993d88a5860a830b11fcc790c67094d123101eb90f855866b4e2c3b59d70"}

{"id": "p_26ddeaedca65cfe8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 108, "text": "素利違盟，出馬千匹與官，爲比能所攻，求救於豫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "be80ded5ae5694445dc27a9115ff0776e1690d6d29f179e715a4059ae136b50d"}

{"id": "p_faf38bde7679789b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 109, "text": "豫恐遂相兼并，爲害滋深，宜救善討惡，示信衆狄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "aeb6577a29f18eeac6b8cd6783fea78a925e79bf88919c0a389b4183980f1046"}

{"id": "p_4ba9c909caf72796", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 110, "text": "單將銳卒，深入虜庭，胡人衆多，鈔軍前後，斷截歸路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "dc51047917564467264a0e0763bd976396ce3795b3df63b8ad37ce837c565d24"}

{"id": "p_c85e1b28afa67779", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 111, "text": "豫乃進軍，去虜十餘里結屯營，多聚牛馬糞然之，從他道引去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "7d86a32943c6e42f36777a5d6e5468ee325ae866022ef5e9884d7f8ef3fca609"}

{"id": "p_bba0c96e241eecb1", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 112, "text": "胡見煙火不絕，以爲尚在，去，行數十里乃知之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "3f72d86adee3b1f780724e00628be33b3b41bf5196a2f422969c38ba7564caad"}

{"id": "p_796026a2040f5bb0", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 113, "text": "追豫到馬城，圍之十重，豫密嚴，使司馬建旌旗，鳴鼓吹，將步騎從南門出，胡人皆屬目往赴之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "98bf0b9a3fe429750427d8b567554a993a93a924eebd011568e01dad9fa5ed20"}

{"id": "p_1659c28728f8ee7d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 114, "text": "豫將精銳自北門出，鼓譟而起，兩頭俱發，出虜不意，虜衆散亂，皆棄弓馬步走，追討二十餘里，僵尸蔽地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "df82fd701d28d0177d471f8f3ff4c9e4b5c89dc912081cb6f0fd8f3702f0b4f5"}

{"id": "p_082238af94bdc85c", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 115, "text": "又烏丸王骨進桀黠不恭，豫因出塞案行，單將麾下百餘騎入進部。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "94b198f6722cab37a23a3e9c61b998924aeaf028724c1c777ff1f1c67ba44c1b"}
