{"id": "p_03da7c2491029202", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 116, "text": "進逆拜，遂使左右斬進，顯其罪惡以令衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "7b2ec992b70edbd6db46a9077bd61749feb4eafbb8485ff177412d30064a7693"}

{"id": "p_e5240955987a2ee2", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 117, "text": "衆皆怖慴不敢動，便以進弟代進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "b3862d1b8f2d54e63495b0f3a9ede161a3661c9a788a688ec4f98129b49a66a5"}

{"id": "p_96f16392eb418fa8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 118, "text": "自是胡人破膽，威震沙漠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "bc0fb7edd2693a9326cda27f209d8e060faa5e5d45b52007511651c74a8d0b9f"}

{"id": "p_2ec22864833283c6", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 119, "text": "山賊高艾，衆數千人，寇鈔，爲幽、冀害，豫誘使鮮卑素利部斬艾，傳首京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "e460a8930f88380201a46122db4df689e36743f5e05bb2198a800a9c965981a9"}

{"id": "p_cb54db0816ab79d9", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 120, "text": "爲校尉九年，其御夷狄，恒摧抑兼并，乖散彊猾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "256352f8c6d91c2b6d7055796ae543afd01ff7b4942bc4371e210a0d9d93db2d"}

{"id": "p_1a9f22c0779e5517", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 121, "text": "凡逋亡姦宄，爲胡作計不利官者，豫皆構刺攪離，使凶邪之謀不遂，聚居之類不安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "58c718d3fbce82681ea0a4d4f29437bd6673cc2f7313c3d8fe5e0ddcd6b352e1"}

{"id": "p_c105c14dd5a34af4", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 122, "text": "事業未究，而幽州刺史王雄支黨欲令雄領烏丸校尉，毀豫亂邊，爲國生事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "0be5d5e7be3a7604e11f24d3cc74b0f8ecddfd05abbd6ddd569f77466a636c8c"}

{"id": "p_569b66bc684e57b7", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 123, "text": "遂轉豫爲汝南太守，加殄夷將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "ceded108b00a4e687f59985c0f0964226db50037fce39b23dadf0aab1fcb07df"}

{"id": "p_2aad847a2ac855b4", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 124, "text": "太和末，公孫淵以遼東叛，帝欲征之而難其人，中領軍楊曁舉豫應選。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "d577cfbd3a3f0a15a6d03b958e0cc47dd0f702e67f92a5f2ad34b7c2286c93db"}

{"id": "p_dc5dd0388b26e2dd", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 125, "text": "乃使豫以本官督青州諸軍，假節，往討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "5cf4432f70995758ae824706696d047ee47f9ff9c6365c50537df3d69f28bfb3"}

{"id": "p_6cd863c1018ab410", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 126, "text": "會吳賊遣使與淵相結，帝以賊衆多，又以渡海，詔豫使罷軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "1d3737021d3691a90588a6fcb74a1d74fe3d19d2922de7b76d6b657cb628fa57"}

{"id": "p_1e236d56dfe49fad", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 127, "text": "豫度賊船垂還，歲晚風急，必畏漂浪，東隨無岸，當赴成山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "0fb0cca6f883378796d839d30aa7d131c36a700a55606ad4f1b671c44c32ad18"}

{"id": "p_9fc9509daa93a5af", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 128, "text": "成山無藏船之處，輙便循海，案行地形，及諸山島，徼截險要，列兵屯守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "a44e54b974b666e7cfd4e7f9bee5aa464dc60ab22b508b8d378831065732e5d4"}

{"id": "p_47741244a5e2b6c3", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 129, "text": "賊還，果遇惡風，船皆觸山沈沒，波蕩著岸，無所蒙竄，盡虜其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "8ed4381c7b91dfdce22a5d024b2272e14d3f4e226e8d44c862a7513b545e7dec"}

{"id": "p_f8f80addbe180876", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 130, "text": "初，諸將皆笑於空地待賊，及賊破，競欲與謀，求入海鉤取浪舡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "21a989ce4db870e120ca2007e9a6f2486e02cf21b086148508f198b3bfaa8863"}

{"id": "p_067452b0d641488d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 131, "text": "初，豫以太守督青州，青州刺史程喜內懷不服，軍事之際，多相違錯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "afce3dd8c4967000e463f61780840ed2ccd2865a465b36bd555098242b3153c3"}

{"id": "p_dade607712da64b4", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 132, "text": "喜知帝寶愛明珠，乃密上：「豫雖有戰功而禁令寬弛，所得器仗珠金甚多，放散皆不納官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "905e5e2f5507f4a8177e925f88ab92cb876e1558435d2c4a374af24bb4ed2c92"}

{"id": "p_14812fcb8c677663", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 133, "text": "後孫權號十萬衆攻新城，征東將軍滿寵欲率諸軍救之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "d55efcad79027fdcbbb2087963896f3b7bf8a87722a07b71eda4201e9716ff8d"}

{"id": "p_b9c04211e508156e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 134, "text": "豫曰：「賊悉衆大舉，非徒投射小利，欲質新城以致大軍耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "52c68d0b358f4ab0511c40d9f619e49365b4797bc06657ac2b99b6581b7dde67"}

{"id": "p_764a2995311cf9c2", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 135, "text": "宜聽使攻城，挫其銳氣，不當與爭鋒也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "c2bf0e496caa60cb0cc140ff9ea064feacf6913ea57f01503aefcb05257f9c7d"}

{"id": "p_f3f65356f6cf4285", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 136, "text": "城不可拔，衆必罷怠；罷怠然後擊之，可大克也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "d27749203a075488ab8bd0d25415e4c73d603753730d8da71b1f4448340f6824"}

{"id": "p_9760703a0b628bb0", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 137, "text": "若賊見計，必不攻城，勢將自走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "0bf0baf4a430eba4c66918850f910c2dadb66836695e761e5cc8bd4242489c46"}

{"id": "p_05fe54f8b56c060e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 138, "text": "又大軍相向，當使難知，不當使自畫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "b60687bce2406b81fc401713ca4bd126cde41f870786b9f65d224eae826aa156"}

{"id": "p_62b6b5218bdec304", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 139, "text": "後吳復來寇，豫往拒之，賊即退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "53cb0b7cab431ad1113fb8ad308000b62091d180aec3e11c41a491f2a16f9a1a"}

{"id": "p_7464b55677f32623", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 140, "text": "諸軍夜驚，云：「賊復來！", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "a869002352c83a5964014194f304c9ba9d11e8f9cdf1df498a79e6b488abc141"}

{"id": "p_60e345d6423908c8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 141, "text": "」豫卧不起，令衆「敢動者斬」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "9cc303df4564c62283c05b02bbb45dbc2c69b3a956915fff7fac51f80ea84f60"}

{"id": "p_4712a191e9b4f0b1", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 142, "text": "景初末，增邑三百，并前五百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "404f4da97e2bf2b82abec931fc8f42dc76b0595e72cf6882836a63c018c6c1ed"}

{"id": "p_83a9a940754bc83d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 143, "text": "正始初，遷使持節護匈奴中郎將，加振威將軍，領并州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "cc4222601e1cca66e295e9ea643b2f872d394b1ba59f18e32b2c0dcb98e9e377"}

{"id": "p_8ed08dbb6ae5893c", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 144, "text": "外胡聞其威名，相率來獻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "0afc3129f48e5a571116db3afac47d60e53aaf65a6c5f514e7794a1971ed50ef"}

{"id": "p_9acfdac308007c52", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 145, "text": "屢乞遜位，太傅司馬宣王以爲豫克壯，書喻未聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "74a3b9aa56b7e294f71161e3472b9c7555c0a4b352b90ad03de55f7107e3efdb"}

{"id": "p_f12bc6795135de25", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 146, "text": "豫書荅曰：「年過七十而以居位，譬猶鍾鳴漏盡而夜行不休，是罪人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "b62dca4578ebf83cce4ec095efc5d0cc9d828e3e197f1b27c11f6a6d114a9f94"}

{"id": "p_5b539727b7ed13b2", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 147, "text": "豫清儉約素，賞賜皆散之將士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "cd41aa610598d007edfba50be5372d56a6629a28df01698c4dceefc6efdc3284"}

{"id": "p_8670407facc83686", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 148, "text": "每胡、狄私遺，悉簿藏官，不入家；家常貧匱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "5ae5676598547824dcf40d0bef54ada55c5bafa7359e2ff9e058d3afee872d33"}

{"id": "p_c83ea4ac36fe1a2e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 149, "text": "，下詔襃揚，賜其家錢糓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "587a28b307f43e25cd26ad651f619e77c67b6bf5c784554ce2bd0316e8cf6390"}

{"id": "p_41013416c454a4b6", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 150, "text": "牽招字子經，安平觀津人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "7bb91190624fc644182e82e455e2463ca03fe67148583d586a640ac470483f40"}

{"id": "p_9bc16d96f15ec0c9", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 151, "text": "年十餘歲，詣同縣樂隱受學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "6e71c013877816ac3682cb3537f467216dc08884014fba5073bced1cba0ef848"}

{"id": "p_d0faaa062fe20ed2", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 152, "text": "後隱爲車騎將軍何苗長史，招隨卒業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "6ce4d492ff722d7285e11600613a88f9c6b5e7777b7f893693528f6789f3c44f"}

{"id": "p_d9b36ff6339f098c", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 153, "text": "值京都亂，苗、隱見害，招俱與隱門生史路等觸蹈鋒刃，共殯斂隱屍，送喪還歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "55bd2a7a51600b97a77cea23e3b638fa3a9ffb911e0e17bb7b8a57f93cbeb3bd"}

{"id": "p_a5a6775a1fdf14d3", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 154, "text": "道遇寇鈔，路等皆悉散走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "87d56c810d92598f110d2636dd11e9abbb4e5c590833733447f348a440eee0fb"}

{"id": "p_ca155f76d5ef313a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 155, "text": "賊欲斫棺取釘，招垂淚請赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "9986b3b404751c6fc23cf0467c8daf17fd947d65b3bc201156cc1edc1482a855"}

{"id": "p_b45f7d6145708923", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 156, "text": "冀州牧袁紹辟爲督軍從事，兼領烏丸突騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "84152f13d20f2198bcbd7127b5ea677db10747965c7fc2dbb4de6738b6d9ba93"}

{"id": "p_76284fd6a99fab61", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 157, "text": "紹舍人犯令，招先斬乃白，紹奇其意而不見罪也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "8b45a9b7df5b2d7747634181679458fa11275e6506029d18eef33cf1cfca2696"}

{"id": "p_f7183ac09c3a8e93", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 158, "text": "尚遣招至上黨，督致軍糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "00e45373acde939a64e06538c33ed781fb9a3b1ea705a3c228edb23ba77920e7"}

{"id": "p_b04cb785ab336602", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 159, "text": "時尚外兄高幹爲并州刺史，招以并州左有恒山之險，右有大河之固，帶甲五萬，北阻彊胡，勸幹迎尚，并力觀變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "e1bbcc80c0d0e367c8022b5d4655adf74663d0889dc135a4d5becc327cb12051"}

{"id": "p_85804d19b0e37871", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 160, "text": "招聞之，間行而去，道隔不得追尚，遂東詣太祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "f4649491b7f62776c24fee14f8e22b9261d861888ba15685ac12b65650ba4a36"}

{"id": "p_311889ce7ed93a54", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 161, "text": "太祖將討袁譚，而柳城烏丸欲出騎助譚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "203add66eccc03e78309ea6383f8d86d5c34b662d803ad4c39cce766bc9f5bd7"}

{"id": "p_efb28b21a727aa85", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 162, "text": "太祖以招嘗領烏丸，遣詣柳城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "5e03afa3a937e9cdb686c2a480b8c37f8c2ad4cd805dc18b9217fff24f933fe5"}

{"id": "p_81b1e20ed924bf01", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 163, "text": "到，值峭王嚴，以五千騎當遣詣譚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "2d8e5146ccdfb7e4b897ed0f950d78d335ed1a47cbf9abf7646ead7581a66c50"}

{"id": "p_f8f4d453841abfef", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 164, "text": "又遼東太守公孫康自稱平州牧，遣使韓忠齎單于印綬往假峭王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "846bfcb4efdc5d551769f170e2696469b1061725f901e86792581c31842b8d8d"}

{"id": "p_6c76a69d2396d975", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 165, "text": "峭王大會群長，忠亦在坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "e922b83b131caf8c82b06e24a50627873ee74957b2e8cf46963159cfb3d4239a"}

{"id": "p_1f8e11b40bf50a5e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 166, "text": "峭王問招：「昔袁公言受天子之命，假我爲單于；今曹公復言當更白天子，假我真單于；遼東復持印綬來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "be6842eb6ad28b399988754ad21eac19cbd69e1fad8a0945cc7fb6d27f5fc5e9"}

{"id": "p_2a982aae9e73a933", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 167, "text": "」招荅曰：「昔袁公承制，得有所拜假；中間違錯，天子命曹公代之，言當白天子，更假真單于，是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "09877f1055103d72806b0e09bb0f6b134ed909c4302d5c79464a46876aaedc93"}

{"id": "p_00c8f1ebc971b121", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 168, "text": "遼東下郡，何得擅稱拜假也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "02995dcdd55ab84358d9a97f2ba5a3c76fd7a884fe56a0451e57da2dcba9b778"}

{"id": "p_c4a6fd8b1c7e47a9", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 169, "text": "」忠曰：「我遼東在滄海之東，擁兵百萬，又有扶餘、濊貊之用；當今之勢，彊者爲右，曹操獨何得爲是也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "587ebe8ff3b559de435ca3b58615be15ecdcc61a1e50270fca5b283a18c696cc"}

{"id": "p_ff7186e74dd7e81c", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 170, "text": "」招呵忠曰：「曹公允恭明哲，翼戴天子，伐叛柔服，寧靜四海，汝君臣頑嚚，今恃險遠，背違王命，欲擅拜假，侮弄神器，方當屠戮，何敢慢易咎毀大人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "1c162fc4c9801e7c02321806a3b50221e3a48f9e645ef2b855b520344d08838c"}

{"id": "p_d44a21ba4e501e16", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 171, "text": "」便捉忠頭頓築，拔刀欲斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "aa37274222f9ea0e69cb8fc718be6dec61ee6d7ca185860e3dc4f05389bb85f7"}

{"id": "p_5a391dd37fc3982b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 172, "text": "峭王驚怖，徒跣抱招，以救請忠，左右失色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "e6132c664408a467efa0b68f284a032f15dcbf788acd6251175163d097008569"}

{"id": "p_1bb70fdbedfdb262", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 173, "text": "招乃還坐，爲峭王等說成敗之效，禍福所歸，皆下席跪伏，敬受勑教，便辭遼東之使，罷所嚴騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "cdd2c09bed2d1378eae001d3f7a935b35e3b5903400ef136feb0b9261fa13aeb"}

{"id": "p_ff3f96029b004175", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 174, "text": "太祖滅譚於南皮，署招軍謀掾，從討烏丸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "e9911f40b2828d518d31a9a0ea4f0c365f08881b369f18ad5b14ca7ed8b6a973"}

{"id": "p_40b6b43b9140ba99", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 175, "text": "還鄴，遼東送袁尚首，縣在馬市，招覩之悲感，設祭頭下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "d2dbb9e8f03563f1a6199653c47f6e2e24f757f7ec438cc2756132b57c11d030"}

{"id": "p_6fc0a272076a8d6f", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 176, "text": "從平漢中，太祖還，留招爲中護軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "916cdca9292a510366efc1c60fc1cf431b68e2fbc22658dc54b324f472fcb2da"}

{"id": "p_710ded2118ae67d7", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 177, "text": "事罷，還鄴，拜平虜校尉，將兵督青、徐州郡諸軍事，擊東萊賊，斬其渠率，東土寧靜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "6307b8a21f2b9b8da462c80ddec18166c756285d11e666b89f76429c4940c0ce"}

{"id": "p_166a56d43aa045d5", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 178, "text": "文帝踐阼，拜招使持節護鮮卑校尉，屯昌平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "13caeeb6fe0a505e255987e2c3d1db5454a8daaf3805940a4250efd0b2b8fc9c"}

{"id": "p_6c92c9e47ba105fc", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 179, "text": "是時，邊民流散山澤，又亡叛在鮮卑中者，處有千數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "1dd28f7039e853fc8418a056e66b3d687775daea9789f3621997aeb76a63697b"}

{"id": "p_35c455e3a68c43aa", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 180, "text": "建義中郎將公孫集等率將部曲，咸各歸命；使還本郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "1a8b6d4aa22e12bc82c05debcaf857eb5f6522da9fb203e20ae3315b661e6303"}

{"id": "p_7110c60498609e99", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 181, "text": "又懷來鮮卑素利、彌加等十餘萬落，皆令款塞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "704d5a5d4ccfe1ffc6555e9f3b9088d766f5ea271458d456244253fd434cc5fc"}

{"id": "p_8866317c24d46338", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 182, "text": "大軍欲征吳，召招還，至，值軍罷，拜右中郎將，出爲鴈門太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "885b6ae60485da67c260f012b74af93e64e344b83cb3b3bc934144d1e7687694"}

{"id": "p_fc30d723d6d732ec", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 183, "text": "郡在邊陲，雖有候望之備，而寇鈔不斷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "a6e0da99ac0cc5538b301ce76b226cc99e7f18580180de75c761cb4a4470bff0"}

{"id": "p_b7c5216ee97dc202", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 184, "text": "招旣教民戰陣，又表復烏丸五百餘家租調，使備鞌馬，遠遣偵候。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "0b3301b2f7a7e49bdbd1ed480d951fda425fafedca577d7896c01cab7f88d40c"}

{"id": "p_28bca0eef77da037", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 185, "text": "虜每犯塞，勒兵逆擊，來輙摧破，於是吏民膽氣日銳，荒野無虞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "632ea65269a1c72b3f6f21d928aab26ced07813b21bc8b4c72bae559c8c82104"}

{"id": "p_02867f79119ddf0e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 186, "text": "又構閒離散，使虜更相猜疑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "ee5cbda932119ca0a13d707883cd238f31a4c7d07606a3237e73191f6496d3d1"}

{"id": "p_bebf7b1e292ccf3d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 187, "text": "鮮卑大人步度根、泄歸泥等與軻比能爲隙，將部落三萬餘家詣郡附塞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "e7ca81968e2d03e6b588c39c7c4814c82c6039bf7c23016b74931b845e2b76d4"}

{"id": "p_b07ed4041776270f", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 188, "text": "勑令還擊比能，殺比能弟苴羅侯，及叛烏丸歸義侯王同、王寄等，大結怨讎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "21da6f1646696a2aab188fdd050fc48d1953e22c6052d2a423b577ccfaa26526"}

{"id": "p_1348d87c34f5a1f3", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 189, "text": "是以招自出，率將歸泥等討比能於雲中故郡，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "f322ebc6cd52c9a6aed04236ce9447d43aad1b3ca9ed745cff755a49d8459f05"}

{"id": "p_0383e546435c7065", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 190, "text": "招通河西鮮卑附頭等十餘萬家，繕治陘北故上館城，置屯戍以鎮內外，夷虜大小莫不歸心，諸亡叛雖親戚不敢藏匿，咸悉收送。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "b5cfe467e49a9e0c38591ddcb53e9011918653f85e3f011f082076fdaf24e4f4"}

{"id": "p_613261024dce7ec8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 191, "text": "於是野居晏閉，寇賊靜息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "0973a9001b33b6f2805b061f14d33dee184a0fb853b141f27459a7d87b6daf22"}

{"id": "p_c45fa13a37673e67", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 192, "text": "招乃簡選有才識者，詣太學受業，還相授教，數年中庠序大興。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "b68d1917ade0f6772a10cbf169aa949341c5c76cb463ed75eb29210df24f32f4"}

{"id": "p_87660c01693ca516", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 193, "text": "郡所治廣武，井水鹹苦，民皆擔輦遠汲流水，往返七里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "e278119188eec0364b9c3c8f7b10557f901e0b57d1ec4a234676bfec3fea2994"}

{"id": "p_8f51cd11f9ee9b8e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 194, "text": "招準望地勢，因山陵之宜，鑿原開渠，注水城內，民賴其益。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "361b95c2de26cc95ff1c89ee457b755b3a37bec87321c1f4c3f320ed8caafc67"}

{"id": "p_2834a2400b5b6691", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 195, "text": "，護烏丸校尉田豫出塞，爲軻比能所圍於故馬邑城，移招求救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "b7b0ed09426d95af3020072bcac556d3fe5656e3b45145d7b1912f3c95e2d52c"}

{"id": "p_3a79b709e5c9edd4", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 196, "text": "招即整勒兵馬，欲赴救豫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "2bee1f8dd32dcdacd2f6b3e85cf0f9b64779bff255a8f7d9bdbf3013f04a3f92"}

{"id": "p_d684041bac3a5eab", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 197, "text": "并州以常憲禁招，招以爲節將見圍，不可拘於吏議，自表輙行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "4cba8a1171838e2053696e6db9ebdae53540a845c901f82f3d2a8c1e5001cfc8"}

{"id": "p_19100d1d6f285db9", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 198, "text": "又並馳布羽檄，稱陳形勢，云當西北掩取虜家，然後東行，會誅虜身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "3ae7476c63be18e4856d4a057143386978eeaba242ee16c2b8cd2e6246869f19"}

{"id": "p_0e44c80d799e355d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 199, "text": "又遺一通於虜蹊要，虜即恐怖，種類離散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "04cdc5d67967485a4c19f7bb6a151b4672c2b839b4a72b8634b01e00d78be8e3"}

{"id": "p_9d867e1d846fe353", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 200, "text": "比能復大合騎來，到故平州塞北。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "c2fab00a5039e85cd39406ba9899c4be5c8e4ac6ca8cba0db9849e530c878c33"}

{"id": "p_80300374898b6fd3", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 201, "text": "招以蜀虜諸葛亮數出，而比能狡猾，能相交通，表爲防備，議者以爲縣遠，未之信也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "2a2ec8e63868889e66303ddef035c59f481beec9f66bd96e7977c63c2f67e3de"}

{"id": "p_0fd622a0a8a316f7", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 202, "text": "會亮時在祁山，果遣使連結比能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "ca63be69ef67eb30891f16b8518435fe38355f00c8d900757c3b9e805fce478b"}

{"id": "p_e9d34d301758d31a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 203, "text": "比能至故北地石城，與相首尾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "735e31dc3bc331bbd03e532ba80dcc5034168f276b836d92ea7d65342eb1d656"}

{"id": "p_81bd8a1f38a3602f", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 204, "text": "帝乃詔招，使從便宜討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "24bfb372acd1673250c7c584d88dd24be643a3592a9e582811d5d4489460f97c"}

{"id": "p_c768a1cd2b0bb7f2", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 205, "text": "時比能已還漠南，招與刺史畢軌議曰：「胡虜遷徙無常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "176b76f7d5775f9c063d4d0195ab01ba7d845d0fd91666b1326d10c0756daf9d"}

{"id": "p_25aec3ae31efc8f4", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 206, "text": "若勞師遠追，則遲速不相及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "7e2fba4aa74a7c7d2384013db0648c412ab897b2a5a16c5599956185797f90af"}

{"id": "p_ee41c0a4c270c197", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 207, "text": "若欲潛襲，則山溪艱險，資糧轉運，難以密辦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "6792c586eb64d98afa7b453b33befaa362666a81b2146e137ddd1a7cfa9df55e"}

{"id": "p_93a6f5f9354391a0", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 208, "text": "可使守新興、鴈門二牙門，出屯陘北，外以鎮撫，內令兵田，儲畜資糧，秋冬馬肥，州郡兵合，乘釁征討，計必全克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "e72dd9b5aec409e435902e9f2df1a5b9f88aca64107985143b34523cfe55537d"}

{"id": "p_172eec6fd1ebef9d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 209, "text": "招在郡十二年，威風遠振。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "5908ce0bd3c70e607f8d57125ed7dfdc1971dfe349e0d1f541122463bf5a9e2a"}

{"id": "p_eb32b1207c095389", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 210, "text": "其治邊之稱，次於田豫，百姓追思之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "294dcab46ce58b21d672752447589b908ef535d70d6a037cc8e60edfb0ec21d5"}

{"id": "p_1aa0927689a54ea8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 211, "text": "而漁陽傅容在鴈門有名績，繼招後，在遼東又有事功云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "e46129aea77ffe3101773fae281de4e55fce2726558474dbc428edd73b88f7c2"}

{"id": "p_3868bb0f767d3a40", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 212, "text": "次子弘，亦猛毅有招風，以隴西太守隨鄧艾伐蜀有功，咸熈中爲振威護軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "1b2acc49b9ebecf95376222d6c3c1736195e8aa1463828f5da73a08e42e4e547"}

{"id": "p_86042d62d2f54bb0", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 213, "text": "嘉與晉司徒李胤同母，早卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "964f2030a421ed01e3e02ec512818b013cf8382a641736c7640b6a5d5ee66583"}

{"id": "p_d14470e74690043f", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 214, "text": "郭淮字伯濟，太原陽曲人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "afad1b01f9786893fb0f862dc1fad67da8fc7e840928058934c0b773b765e308"}

{"id": "p_8a76f57f8656888b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 215, "text": "建安中舉孝廉，除平原府丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "af52583e848beaa1c89174f2f809fe0c4048cb5455d49f2e8ee3498f0dc5506c"}

{"id": "p_b2d419814f02e91f", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 216, "text": "文帝爲五官將，召淮署爲門下賊曹，轉爲丞相兵曹議令史，從征漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "7161e50d7731356722d7246a74e4c1dab5e7555722b788542b7a10bd9f9cc5d8"}

{"id": "p_036373b5dcfe9317", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 217, "text": "太祖還，留征西將軍夏侯淵拒劉備，以淮爲淵司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "61c2e0c9a73034f5bf675b3db4a0c8fc54aedeead368d2e1782b7a7922ec6921"}

{"id": "p_08f6639fd80b1242", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 218, "text": "淵與備戰，淮時有疾不出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "b1f407d616360205bfefd27ba508939bc2308945762e30584a8ef3a348ec767d"}

{"id": "p_2ba7ce563f97c2a9", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 219, "text": "淵遇害，軍中擾擾，淮收散卒，推盪寇將軍張郃爲軍主，諸營乃定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "ccaf97afbd2413af8bb9ec64de711e755232ad7bcbba717cc845ea3e4d01e11e"}

{"id": "p_1e399de6741eb390", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 220, "text": "其明日，備欲渡漢水來攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "8cc01b9518f734b67c4dce08da0efa95ca8ee4e6e7fe80df80e47f4cd0805515"}

{"id": "p_4a042ba2441e85dc", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 221, "text": "諸將議衆寡不敵，備便乘勝，欲依水爲陣以拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "d7d05c0d71e5054845312676ea9b5f3cc635e18cdea094593b7a077e0ce5ed72"}

{"id": "p_c4e22e0b052f68f7", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 222, "text": "淮曰：「此示弱而不足挫敵，非筭也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "63bc7ddea2c182aa935fd5907e39f0d652c0c76cfbc42e17df84a870b05eca45"}

{"id": "p_0939c2782b8ab9de", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 223, "text": "不如遠水爲陣，引而致之，半濟而後擊，備可破也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "7fc3e804c1123c59c1d5ee1004854d8c95a80b6476370daa6d1bee2547a02e73"}

{"id": "p_b4383d37b4d5a95e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 224, "text": "」旣陣，備疑不渡，淮遂堅守，示無還心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "d8af8bc88f0555f5ea6576cdd3d9762134d5108e4fe749a2c9f4d91f610ffdda"}

{"id": "p_38ecae930d582e45", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 225, "text": "以狀聞，太祖善之，假郃節，復以淮爲司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "bf16003ffab92595fd2e5af0a76ad88c945f46e8fce10fa96d6ac6d235840822"}

{"id": "p_87d21aa0b709d511", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 226, "text": "文帝即王位，賜爵關內侯，轉爲鎮西長史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "a8766ae5d62a92e9664442dc36eb798783b60af1e2007d7585dc064dd4a15559"}

{"id": "p_bcab006264762a53", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 227, "text": "又行征羌護軍，護左將軍張郃、冠軍將軍楊秋討山賊鄭甘、盧水叛胡，皆破平之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "ccf9d3645910514578cf8b2889d1b75f70e88825fc6bf14639e7adc6882b9548"}

{"id": "p_ef739e3c25b13c9b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 228, "text": "，奉使賀文帝踐阼，而道路得疾，故計遠近爲稽留。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "0e46c2cfd85576c36f2e2e9d971a8bd0bcd637259b98830b4275712c06728f18"}

{"id": "p_6c63b8a0fb49ad0a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 229, "text": "及群臣歡會，帝正色責之曰：「昔禹會諸侯於塗山，防風後至，便行大戮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "a2f1d9c94a2c94b9514dcc9ccdc555b691510ca1c880850d4d9e575535ca97ed"}

{"id": "p_fa3f88dfee6bbd70", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 230, "text": "今溥天同慶而卿最留遲，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "4fe7237d16f72f4539100338558dcfd4b738357f882bf832412ee68683857c03"}

{"id": "p_aed84996e3d5d07b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 231, "text": "」淮對曰：「臣聞五帝先教導民以德，夏后政衰，始用刑辟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "cb1a01988695a861383e88013b63c324d9ba35603417052d958888a6821a1b79"}

{"id": "p_4a9a0c938e26cc72", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 232, "text": "今臣遭唐虞之世，是以自知免於防風之誅也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "09061297a6b4c7b623b187d4b29562d373d86e2acb10bcaf9a57aa68ab419afc"}

{"id": "p_7a035c542706cad3", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 233, "text": "」帝恱之，擢領雍州刺史，封射陽亭侯，五年爲真。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "559dadd659b474eb9516bfc93d57abfe3163c9ef0c892071069b7963e857f190"}

{"id": "p_459074a9b3c0ce0e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 234, "text": "安定羗大帥辟蹏反，討破降之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "eba1f7db19bfe485f4df5bfbf0f42684f51787db557f484772ebf3710c6b8ff9"}

{"id": "p_c44d6cf9efa2533b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 235, "text": "每羌、胡來降，淮輙先使人推問其親理，男女多少，年歲長幼；及見，一二知其款曲，訊問周至，咸稱神明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "4670acff32a921691685681ff5c93e85822e62fb282e3d323a0fc18641916f18"}

{"id": "p_db7b4a9d51d06f81", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 236, "text": "，蜀相諸葛亮出祁山，遣將軍馬謖至街亭，高詳屯列柳城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "fe909f0e7272386cc73009fd7b2bdec1e58e8fdadec0f7d02be04100d5cb8469"}

{"id": "p_13c1be88347f2fad", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 237, "text": "張郃擊謖，淮攻詳營，皆破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "f6b68fa25c5e55cad2a5283995c1d7de9a3f008bb1a86ad388474849d7dfbea3"}

{"id": "p_222b07b31e3a06fd", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 238, "text": "又破隴西名羌唐蹏於枹罕，加建威將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "a3e3551e835a7fd5703c7bf0ab051dfbe59ebce0100f53be0a5d35d53cee98da"}

{"id": "p_a79c1fd0e746893b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 239, "text": "是時，隴右無穀，議欲關中大運，淮以威恩撫循羌、胡，家使出穀，平其輸調，軍食用足，轉揚武將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "d1e66099f0a0b1a542b7882176e576053563f89f73963851473402acd34cd7d2"}

{"id": "p_2405f7ca42f68a77", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 240, "text": "青龍二年，諸葛亮出斜谷，並田于蘭坑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "a30a257f0bbe4f648999c3b0611e604ce142ebd8b41d8fc6fde7faad0e77f4f0"}

{"id": "p_88df5d5b1c93ff08", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 241, "text": "是時司馬宣王屯渭南；淮策亮必爭北原，宜先據之，議者多謂不然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "e938059564dd4c527b4d754e43e45cf5a19fc8015d6b425734d42ad031cad609"}

{"id": "p_d5f7f9c0fdaa53b4", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 242, "text": "淮曰：「若亮跨渭登原，連兵北山，隔絕隴道，搖盪民、夷，此非國之利也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "bc3675f9d68e2a67efd746dcc7c68799166f8163c9939624d063e52cfe97acbe"}

{"id": "p_e777c9ddd4e73b4b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 243, "text": "」宣王善之，淮遂屯北原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "a6303772c50156a9e5dbbbe311c67db36b88a64790823fc2de9dec889755f899"}

{"id": "p_5d9cceb2d92340d5", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 244, "text": "塹壘未成，蜀兵大至，淮逆擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "557915c3b17ac7d1cd2b905e247fb807cb4c87960e628d9fdbcae8986ea30871"}

{"id": "p_6c7240d1a95a85fc", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 245, "text": "後數日，亮盛兵西行，諸將皆謂欲攻西圍，淮獨以爲此見形於西，欲使官兵重應之，必攻陽遂耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "7da792cce9fde1eb47886e9c8aca8334121d2691a7861823fa2305a44f95f9a1"}

{"id": "p_1090897d1817bdbd", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 246, "text": "其夜果攻陽遂，有備不得上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "c5c90df85b7c6ba14f4bdac0c76ccf014ecf662d065b8b92663b6f8acd0dfb3e"}

{"id": "p_2b779d306f3f3150", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 247, "text": "淮遂進軍，追至彊中，維退，遂討羌迷當等，案撫柔氐三千餘落，拔徙以實關中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "cec8d2e62f8239570014c9a3890fee3caa58464a239dc7b4b9a767af5c81dda9"}

{"id": "p_7988c6b14f358233", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 248, "text": "涼州休屠胡梁元碧等，率種落二千餘家附雍州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "b3530f9a5ccfb3c55ea3edc6c93cd1645f0084fc327065379c60c705b0b04c76"}

{"id": "p_e2af86ad58676dce", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 249, "text": "淮奏請使居安定之高平，爲民保鄣，其後因置西川都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "f7c9d4fca443fdd7f399a79f2c81af7ce9879b61a66f3a6b476360edc3a60f32"}

{"id": "p_2149470415b2ab49", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 250, "text": "五年，夏侯玄伐蜀，淮督諸軍爲前鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "19dd6d987c0970615d7fe3ff258f317c8c2fd0b14eb0862ec44afba2363b78eb"}

{"id": "p_ab117f4decc29e12", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 251, "text": "淮度勢不利，輙拔軍出，故不大敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "83b3429b6800253d3712d98357bf24bc5b20a0f29a8dae804d4b22489ea77a6a"}

{"id": "p_5364995918ae7183", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 252, "text": "八年，隴西、南安、金城、西平諸羌餓何、燒戈、伐同、蛾遮塞等相結叛亂，攻圍城邑，南招蜀兵，涼州名胡治無戴復叛應之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "9e35c6980c9298cba3a8486b32f72818d1b04ed18684123105cc9ffc5639aea3"}

{"id": "p_db8ac80c31cd21fe", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 253, "text": "討蜀護軍夏侯霸督諸軍屯爲翅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "57e26e4a57125f4fff707714bd21c37894a68e72aa95fd9a11666f4525f402fe"}

{"id": "p_97751791eff7443a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 254, "text": "淮軍始到狄道，議者僉謂宜先討定枹罕，內平惡羌，外折賊謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "193a76a21bda7a38f324410a7b65e2339702bd2a3b3ba29173428c5fb571e123"}

{"id": "p_a698483573fc8223", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 255, "text": "淮策維必來攻霸，遂入渢中，轉南迎霸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "810eb0e34d8c344f7ec8f46a54ce3018c6a8a103104d92b449ef6ad190deab26"}

{"id": "p_6f5c2182515725b8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 256, "text": "維果攻爲翅，會淮軍適至，維遁退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "f381dadca4aa7b695b14720b8cb13ac46367f4a559f0e2722be92e48e79cf0b8"}

{"id": "p_23e3cc96d925866a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 257, "text": "進討叛羌，斬餓何、燒戈，降服者萬餘落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "a513697cbd0d578fa78284874b73c9e2bb5856dd24ef3695d16fc920c48dc023"}

{"id": "p_9377c20fc94d24ab", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 258, "text": "九年，遮塞等屯河關、白土故城，據河拒軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "167b26a371813745c51dfa5f939a95edcdc1c8a5aaeb43e488560d8956484542"}

{"id": "p_d4cdbb4fc98ab41d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 259, "text": "淮見形上流，密於下渡兵據白土城，擊，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "783f07c2644078d0b8ebd2dc5d7e3061a592d92e5356a69f0583f9954b41c16b"}

{"id": "p_4cd1e8de52f5e837", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 260, "text": "治無戴圍武威，家屬留在西海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "cd5adabcb576f7171e2b6249e567d464de2ed88356c6073ce507eda9efe99389"}

{"id": "p_20f5698279028f4c", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 261, "text": "淮進軍趨西海，欲掩取其累重，會無戴折還，與戰於龍夷之北，破走之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "0131e548f2b3d6224f4971bb66f89df56e9d6721bc603d76491d3f1fc2f870b9"}

{"id": "p_3b2d8abbb58a5ad9", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 262, "text": "令居惡虜在石頭山之西，當大道止，斷絕王使。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "862adfd405d23f622ac0fc8c497b5dfac088a35c70d51c1152734cf7a7ff05ae"}

{"id": "p_fcaa285f50f24453", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 263, "text": "姜維出石營，從彊川，乃西迎治無戴，留陰平太守廖化於成重山築城，斂破羌保質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "8dfdba89afa6e2a6c8e29fa1ec7e4b1785e4cf565de28c8b357c9c7810b4341e"}

{"id": "p_bcb35aae8b6198a3", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 264, "text": "諸將以維衆西接彊胡，化以據險，分軍兩持，兵勢轉弱，進不制維，退不拔化，非計也，不如合而俱西，及胡、蜀未接，絕其內外，此伐交之兵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "fadfe6e7349ffa763f291b5776283c1303a897d784f3f7e8ef8142a0b52ed2e1"}

{"id": "p_2a8030f8bf99e9e8", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 265, "text": "淮曰：「今往取化，出賊不意，維必狼顧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "bca702a140bfb24a61c4182ba60a8a16a52ca0399ab5354a167ccd6632aed03e"}

{"id": "p_2140be27a168b67e", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 266, "text": "比維自致，足以定化，且使維疲於奔命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "302a7e3497c07fc91d9623750b66302d51a3649c7f0f794e760dbf9d393b3030"}

{"id": "p_6ba45f7c8640d8a5", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 267, "text": "兵不遠西，而胡交自離，此一舉而兩全之策也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "8530130fa25e560e3789a488f3f3413a0a95658e12ef2b34b06f0c9609a571cb"}

{"id": "p_862a537714349c60", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 268, "text": "」乃別遣夏侯霸等追維於沓中，淮自率諸軍就攻化等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "4e7b802bcd81c03cbee5c314638d4a01e5de61a9cc41a70d845f27b9226c6eed"}

{"id": "p_8557b348a29d8079", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 269, "text": "維果馳還救化，皆如淮計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "04a9acc1afe8ec1a50fc64c25f96f03008bcad9ffb0c068d76a3b5528cca4538"}

{"id": "p_5e33ed5c33da317d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 270, "text": "，遷征西將軍，都督雍、涼諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "3a480527aa95fa39c026815b5a6ef9907e48ddd8a1b7923686759e6864f0c6b4"}

{"id": "p_889d4296b5a172ae", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 271, "text": "是歲，與雍州刺史陳泰恊策，降蜀牙門將句安等於翅上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "d43ffe0439cb9bc0a82a783d6d664710ec9fa4134657b5c7de2478ff3dfed788"}

{"id": "p_ff2b6349cb29be21", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 272, "text": "二年，詔曰：「昔漢川之役，幾至傾覆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "d2f45e077baf0879803866009882f6eb1e724b6b8da115acb7f6cf88f9114d29"}

{"id": "p_ca885bdd6e47b7ac", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 273, "text": "在關右三十餘年，外征寇虜，內綏民夷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "9b4b897fc8a5108aefaceadd76705b43660ecc909e4156c0d04303026042163c"}

{"id": "p_6ffb3449c67a22d4", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 274, "text": "比歲以來，摧破廖化，禽虜句安，功績顯著，朕甚嘉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "9edd15c71aea38f989fe1afb93090bdac4ca8ee44023bb20dc1a5e044e4290cb"}

{"id": "p_1f6a4879c5f5e21f", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 275, "text": "今以淮爲車騎將軍、儀同三司，持節、都督如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "584d5bcb1553ccb4725d04960ea38fba3787313181e02a99a918f845b54556c3"}

{"id": "p_0fb9d02b8c9ac0d1", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 276, "text": "」進封陽曲侯，邑凡二千七百八十戶，分三百戶，封一子亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "04ff41030cb5802adb8966fd7f1772b3ebcb3dc9fb1d6f0a2411d67d327dc97f"}

{"id": "p_e81b1da354f59d81", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 277, "text": "薨，追贈大將軍，謚曰貞侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "6f23b7cef730411f0322ce449806cf741a4936f0ed2fa1154c17b898bae4fcd1"}

{"id": "p_89fdda213d20a62d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 278, "text": "咸熈中，開建五等，以淮著勳前朝，改封汾陽子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "a21d6746daa16468bb05b1b2b8fa676efc40c9f729e31fb8fffd8c872da15bf5"}

{"id": "p_8b875754a4efcb5d", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 279, "text": "評曰：滿寵立志剛毅，勇而有謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "570dcdba1d15032cfbf4383b6d48156f00d002c706b2e11352ac6737363d172f"}

{"id": "p_d158f156304a4cdd", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 280, "text": "田豫居身清白，規畧明練。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "6f42c4873bd47481c4e527468fb6d6bacaa3bcce67fc77d4fe29f367d9eb4ee7"}

{"id": "p_8896a661a886edf3", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 281, "text": "牽招秉義壯烈，威績顯著。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "aab3eb0349c2a85678bb72ea14bc0bf3d41179aa5292fe6e01687091dd0472f6"}

{"id": "p_c611193eac3fc66a", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 282, "text": "郭淮方策精詳，垂問秦、雍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "6ff73308ddccfdad35c3f40ff1415411dc9fed28a090677c37ee1fa2f9ac16bb"}

{"id": "p_b16e59d695e0756b", "source_id": "src_c9ae62e2b7a0db82", "ordinal": 283, "text": "而豫位止小州，招終於郡守，未盡其用也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "e47fac8ad4c7f0fde57d43f7522e10a80d23ec9d88f06b81d42bc1923cec7981"}

{"id": "p_aa73727fe443f654", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_b5fee1d28938a6c1", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 1, "text": "徐邈字景山，燕國薊人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "b4dab70fd56c8719e4bf93542cfae9ca952ca822995a28d0cad0909db487a11a"}

{"id": "p_f82e505b5657fb13", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 2, "text": "太祖平河朔，召爲丞相軍謀掾，試守奉高令，入爲東曹議令史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "02d43f42066a0ae1eda7c974f762a4f61427cb664f1c4ff8860de7e3f077c261"}

{"id": "p_7853855469a8eaa3", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 3, "text": "時科禁酒，而邈私飲至於沈醉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "6eb81e8f2ef9677e75ba0634a51349c9ab567139e13853fc994f859f9019f1b0"}

{"id": "p_9b3b4bd177eadf14", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 4, "text": "校事趙達問以曹事，邈曰：「中聖人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "1ef8f7fcba960530071d7af1617bef34f6c9fcc527c6f0548004215bbc5a09fe"}

{"id": "p_a058e86e54254cce", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 5, "text": "」達白之太祖，太祖甚怒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "e9780aafb966fd37178db1d5fd40fe43f289bb559a2e3da64e03318287941c28"}

{"id": "p_ccf5566b63359440", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 6, "text": "度遼將軍鮮于輔進曰：「平日醉客謂酒清者爲聖人，濁者爲賢人，邈性脩慎，偶醉言耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "053255ce2515b55802589a790375137b2d4e6b812d7bd654169d719dd7c50ee8"}

{"id": "p_1352349daac64293", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 7, "text": "後領隴西太守，轉爲南安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "e56e78ef936255fe8669dc92ecc23257a3f27b60943bf6ca4b5d251e7716c817"}

{"id": "p_03d1f23e0d46296c", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 8, "text": "文帝踐阼，歷譙相，平陽、安平太守，潁川典農中郎將，所在著稱，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "4e1c197e63b28c37fe7dde99b462e0d3a58d19773a8d4375432c82c18e9ef9f5"}

{"id": "p_8583f8b746541638", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 9, "text": "車駕幸許昌，問邈曰：「頗復中聖人不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "95f86d794f173497692d6dd55df62424f817241615e0865d80d1a2ed1137dd82"}

{"id": "p_08a7b9833244ea62", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」邈對曰：「昔子反斃於穀陽，御叔罰於飲酒，臣嗜同二子，不能自懲，時復中之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "7c087d15aa4747bbf7ccb9ac711922ec2498a346c70c80c77ad583b183042a9b"}

{"id": "p_0184bafafda8ea12", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 11, "text": "然宿瘤以醜見傳，而臣以醉見識。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "74f887599886b2d9a627914279d94bc7cdf04f1a3dedc26ba8aec249e7e80b69"}

{"id": "p_021748cd026ddd8c", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」帝大笑，顧左右曰：「名不虛立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "22872d35b331f63d819d089bebe8b95003e062346da9022e05249b3b37b55e3a"}

{"id": "p_f0a63a6a4b5a9300", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 13, "text": "明帝以涼州絕遠，南接蜀寇，以邈爲涼州刺史，使持節領護羌校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "644ddcd81e571e2992f6a6479f319468ee5e3ea5aefc9f5e882dcb5e1cfdfe33"}

{"id": "p_ed84282daceeda83", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 14, "text": "至，值諸葛亮出祁山，隴右三郡反，邈輙遣參軍及金城太守等擊南安賊，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "cc1db335f3fd46f5a105a70d7a3f58d262aa3221a79d3046d8a86755d10474be"}

{"id": "p_dda4db81cf0d1b4b", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 15, "text": "河右少雨，常苦乏糓，邈上脩武威、酒泉鹽池以收虜糓，又廣開水田，募貧民佃之，家家豐足，倉庫盈溢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "856464ac978832649fbddca244b39074fc1512a66c806da9f62b424200d09887"}

{"id": "p_713361b7a3b4d7cc", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 16, "text": "乃支度州界軍用之餘，以市金帛犬馬，通供中國之費。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "3c099e79b475b87a71ecd9d45e821c5eb278dd1c5bfe9a5cf23968baf32cc6e7"}

{"id": "p_b5600e5a27a25b29", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 17, "text": "以漸收斂民間私杖，藏之府庫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "e2129e4a742317acfd59dc3db332c72ef708df665662ead58f34c5a92796c5d0"}

{"id": "p_f40ba7587ec0062f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 18, "text": "然後率以仁義，立學明訓，禁厚葬，斷淫祀，進善黜惡，風化大行，百姓歸心焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "35d0ff603c48a479b4649df8ba33c72ed9fa57c4d683564eaef981a7b77dddbb"}

{"id": "p_0647b4acf22029a9", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 19, "text": "西域流通，荒戎入貢，皆邈勳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "738fa7d58a66f6c9a91806b3dc22a0ba291c57a8f37d38fb3d77da9c7852b4ec"}

{"id": "p_266c1c051262d79c", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 20, "text": "討叛羌柯吾有功，封都亭侯，邑三百戶，加建威將車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "4f304cfd6952c7fbff18d3921dded1d84df9b29a6da7779405055ff39a2a653f"}

{"id": "p_86316d0e7f4bec77", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 21, "text": "邈與羌、胡從事，不問小過；若犯大罪，先告部帥，使知，應死者乃斬以徇，是以信服畏威。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f193514c00300f3ff1fd246125be08a86d0ab744d624bd5d06c96896cf8ba92b"}

{"id": "p_38beba3cc66020a3", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 22, "text": "賞賜皆散與將士，無入家者，妻子衣食不充；天子聞而嘉之，隨時供給其家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "67c555ea6f9d3389e6315713b367aca7487af1f792795263f22792a0392046c1"}

{"id": "p_f74ffd81217facf2", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 23, "text": "遷爲司隷校尉，百僚敬憚之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "8d36be87761d5b5fd6a0f03cfae8ce61c976d765adc1b69a335615c4bccb8cd0"}

{"id": "p_8cf144e476c41377", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 24, "text": "後爲光祿大夫，數歲即拜司空，邈歎曰：「三公論道之官，無其人則缺，豈可以老病忝之哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "a4d44004cc2305abf0a8726e17c945b05a409af47ed802fefeeaab786362c4af"}

{"id": "p_45ae291bd5f237b1", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 25, "text": "，年七十八，以大夫薨于家，用公禮葬，謚曰穆侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "1359ab5464db78999de56b356b8b87651289b8f778f201c0682d5256ae3d247b"}

{"id": "p_acddffb43be12d8f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 26, "text": "六年，朝廷追思清節之士，詔曰：「夫顯賢表德，聖王所重；舉善而教，仲尼所美。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "eb23cd3f627c67a501cf08c648204152c82370c9e178e7b01d46c48984d0604d"}

{"id": "p_31c545bddd33559f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 27, "text": "故司空徐邈、征東將軍胡質、衞尉田豫皆服職前朝，歷事四世，出統戎馬，入贊庶政，忠清在公，憂國忘私，不營產業，身沒之後，家無餘財，朕甚嘉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "45badfb5b44f460df0540544aa73a747f871413c3354720af71a475d8bd80aab"}

{"id": "p_52c789ce84f5a518", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 28, "text": "其賜邈等家糓二千斛，錢三十萬，布告天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "6d0e26e10def1d56bc1c3c11e4473a54ae11360421023b3b530c11409f433a0a"}

{"id": "p_dd71f4ffed531e83", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 29, "text": "邈同郡韓觀曼遊，有鑒識器幹，與邈齊名，而在孫禮、盧毓先，爲豫州刺史，甚有治功，卒官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "962c650e39578b5ace0c06e99135a09f9699de1be732946d94797b32faf4d020"}

{"id": "p_501190e799d6347b", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 30, "text": "盧欽著書，稱邈曰：「徐公志高行絜，才博氣猛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "fd84d8a3587d522d6a14975bc6876d4a77a0e5b7fd2b6645dee6d0484706f2d8"}

{"id": "p_15bc9941b60ac09e", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 31, "text": "其施之也，高而不狷，絜而不介，博而守約，猛而能寬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "020795f03a876f424e37052a5e6771200c2b8dceadf5505e91d8971a4fb75677"}

{"id": "p_598e6a0ea4d6778a", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 32, "text": "聖人以清爲難，而徐公之所易也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "aedc66e4525322184c26ae2d3266c4ce57aaa82275b5822811621d94e3536ca2"}

{"id": "p_5e800817fac01dec", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」或問欽：「徐公當武帝之時，人以爲通，自在涼州及還京師，人以爲介，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "e55e8cdc0ebeba6a2b58df95b8e87055d551a8859b21596477221853cb8e494e"}

{"id": "p_24144afe18f49475", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 34, "text": "」欽荅曰：「往者毛孝先、崔季珪等用事，貴清素之士，于時皆變易車服以求名高，而徐公不改其常，故人以爲通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "af0ca0271201ea23a2b08ff4a3a8c51ff070c6e32963de3584a2bd2ec5e55caa"}

{"id": "p_5d86e30ef9f5950e", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 35, "text": "比來天下奢靡，轉相倣效，而徐公雅尚自若，不與俗同，故前日之通，乃今日之介也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "1572297e5618e7a195ee1f8c7782c1b112b26e1765570ceba3ca82bcdf43f297"}

{"id": "p_3c2fc34fa05b745c", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 36, "text": "是世人之無常，而徐公之有常也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "785a585512f8cd91bf42b2b2f6d68ae0edac5288de521c665770137a494f00ef"}

{"id": "p_0714aa092cc0f7c4", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 37, "text": "胡質字文德，楚國壽春人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "753ae7cc954d82b32d68e30bef36e91d5f4f8140a79bdba54a2328c5243817f2"}

{"id": "p_705abfb9be374472", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 38, "text": "少與蔣濟、朱績俱知名於江、淮間，仕州郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "f29bbba678d8ba8c14a9130d8b11f78b44043979334327fb3f160be5b5bd6356"}

{"id": "p_5c732b3c107ceaaf", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 39, "text": "太祖問曰：「胡通達，長者也，寧有子孫不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "3445cf1f262a0659b5e4785b5561347bad3bbb771020c13cd4e8e3d014d421af"}

{"id": "p_b17f187c4589770f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」濟曰：「有子曰質，規模大略不及於父，至於精良綜事過之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "ae6a7b8825072a7ac15befbfcc2fc9b8ca6e4e585426635f4c9426d74f5a6e63"}

{"id": "p_d73dade03675182a", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 41, "text": "縣民郭政通於從妹，殺其夫程他，郡吏馮諒繫獄爲證。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "6a24306107e8a5d66c96ef5060abd7bc3ca6e61e33744109e54a32a102826a50"}

{"id": "p_eadbe13cdcc54420", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 42, "text": "政與妹皆耐掠隱抵，諒不勝痛，自誣，當反其罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "1963c928e1c56be862ef1a941b4d4b2083850039f7568c33275edc90c5c81491"}

{"id": "p_6621a8a9266a2136", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 43, "text": "質至官，察其情色，更詳其事，檢驗具服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "746ee8e4cac45e26e89fbe18a0c9ceb8a510ef63dec0f64bc9d37d01f402e75b"}

{"id": "p_87cd7f0b6fdac49a", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 44, "text": "入爲丞相東曹議令史，州請爲治中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "8298887d894f6f9657b3b429de4ebcdc71681ce973a2d5afc6ae67a98142516c"}

{"id": "p_cef50cbb1afecbc5", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 45, "text": "將軍張遼與其護軍武周有隙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "7f15e27f5344788c665deaf607facfb7b543e89b870cc272798c410077765179"}

{"id": "p_e41423bb86448f1c", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 46, "text": "遼見刺史溫恢求請質，質辭以疾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "1688b6d7d0a85f14ff2b77eb7c3e7dc871f77cf0e2b47eea9cf98d2146271e39"}

{"id": "p_736cc071ac3e8ec0", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 47, "text": "遼出謂質曰：「僕委意於君，何以相辜如此？", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "60f8dd9aae9b4f2f461db35959e66b4278faf2d97d62a4a3c2a1c44f04fe3eaf"}

{"id": "p_24eeb9815ad52c4b", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 48, "text": "」質曰：「古人之交也，取多知其不貪，奔北知其不怯，聞流言而不信，故可終也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "4b83ddf3fc2bb2aeea0312fb96d02f6e23e4f577018f102e5b33adc87e1eaea7"}

{"id": "p_a0cd80d75dc881ab", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 49, "text": "武伯南身爲雅士，往者將軍稱之不容於口，今以睚眦之恨，乃成嫌隙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "8f5ebc266facb412e0f16cf374a8256b95578859f9f360bbfea34d54bdc7d92d"}

{"id": "p_b0b9da6b5f0c5eb2", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 50, "text": "黃初中，徙吏部郎，爲常山太守，遷任東莞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "a98c4a5f5115338b4227ee6a0577d51013d4d6751d4bb42292a3efabd59af0ed"}

{"id": "p_eb5a72e2b4dbe912", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 51, "text": "士盧顯爲人所殺，質曰：「此士無讎而有少妻，所以死乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "cd772287865f2cb4d40f48cadc794b232b3bba931b67fb92df4227d5b10dbdcf"}

{"id": "p_cfb4afa4f7650244", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 52, "text": "」悉見其比居年少，書吏李若見問而色動，遂窮詰情狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "02ad5644165dcc180b8f264f20d6905722a18e82e79a08411fd9bd75a91a672f"}

{"id": "p_df640eac43354705", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 53, "text": "每軍功賞賜，皆散之於衆，無入家者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "f84c5d269c3b87b92fce53dc33572274c9b0daa2b8bb05417dbf7fdb207170e9"}

{"id": "p_88565e4116fbf11d", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 54, "text": "在郡九年，吏民便安，將士用命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "81773d106fcc6349fc25aa44d0fbddee8c707ff4579685fbea7d9c0329669098"}

{"id": "p_b7ebe542a579a9fb", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 55, "text": "遷荊州刺史，加振威將軍，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "592d5d8bb8808038dd912c9ccf06a2385c86ef656556a0b5fe2d578455187c39"}

{"id": "p_903d21874788781e", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 56, "text": "吳大將朱然圍樊城，質輕軍赴之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "5e825d783d98c06c872533d5e9d82ec400cf9c2ae9e3d4d6d5077b92e3b638fb"}

{"id": "p_317c15a6bb0f41dd", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 57, "text": "議者皆以爲賊盛不可迫，質曰：「樊城卑下，兵少，故當進軍爲之外援；不然，危矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "65679307c43e47d05dc27b2409aa0541a1ac97357cc9a67333c99cf5854fe1d5"}

{"id": "p_f6f6c568614e0760", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」遂勒兵臨圍，城中乃安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "d83a2cd3e5255058ef9769e05f46f0cce526be983f2b6cb19847505ab1f18cb4"}

{"id": "p_7d2f6a9f29aa0a8b", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 59, "text": "遷征東將軍，假節都督青、徐諸軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "8368e09aa8bcf6a8b3b2e708fd15bfda2a2982cc6791d2444029c9f681442c90"}

{"id": "p_dd97995abbaf5293", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 60, "text": "廣農積糓，有兼年之儲，置東征臺，且佃且守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "f387f03532eef18b12571ffbb03d21ab0a7b26d142cf0e3e5bdfbabd86c43f1d"}

{"id": "p_ceeabad249b22b21", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 61, "text": "又通渠諸郡，利舟楫，嚴設備以待敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "44220366fd7f49e50f9615f52d2ad6ef940f90491be43f1bb47e56ddd5960dc4"}

{"id": "p_133b771d58851b16", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 62, "text": "性沈實內察，不以其節檢物，所在見思。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "76091c5964e3efa6f03c121c669fda632661c3bb91515a2f0d84c0822327121f"}

{"id": "p_afdebf3c9b297a82", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 63, "text": "薨，家無餘財，惟有賜衣書篋而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "72974c7542a0f3b6a6938e65e5ef890ddea00c601a3d7df30b17d275368b4ece"}

{"id": "p_abd18289cf5bc4e6", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 64, "text": "軍師以聞，追進封陽陵亭侯，邑百戶，謚曰貞侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "71c2c920e9faeb68cec5168987c9a5e1ff8e9d83f48ba6cbb81814663f42281d"}

{"id": "p_da882156d3be0872", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 65, "text": "六年，詔書褒述質清行，賜其家錢糓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "e72c25c6a614205e2e0a24e397554e59665ef26ca1a69195d09304c6efb1f589"}

{"id": "p_e0387fab913153c3", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 66, "text": "威，咸熈中官至徐州刺史，有殊績，歷三郡守，所在有名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "2b1363785bf8d84f11d762feecd68cd956394747f5d7fe9aaefc8ea3e9e2bc99"}

{"id": "p_fe707cc46ca8ebb1", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 67, "text": "王昶字文舒，太原晉陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "16e27fdf4b9a8fb6ec8b4c21a6ed8f3e611206896d555b193bfa417b24a59c10"}

{"id": "p_ee997a5f9e181c80", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 68, "text": "文帝在東宮，昶爲太子文學，遷中庶子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "a2d205f5c203db20d830126fba1f6731b651e9e668f1d0820edaea34123f49d8"}

{"id": "p_9d8734a8e9daeb16", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 69, "text": "文帝踐阼，徙散騎侍郎，爲洛陽典農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "bda21b595b306dbd8b0e998d01678c8465d097847b3ba8968813722bd5fe0856"}

{"id": "p_cba96e84468b99c2", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 70, "text": "時都畿樹木成林，昶斫開荒萊，勤勸百姓，墾田特多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "f1179ade3a8d6466e57283e3ef03eb8391c23975f71900c3ac098b79c220f1f0"}

{"id": "p_59cb72d12d531c55", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 71, "text": "明帝即位，加揚烈將軍，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "757bab9e0b1c93a82c2901a562aaf4ad0bc516f425a56a69d885a780b0052299"}

{"id": "p_8b5a04d6488ca928", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 72, "text": "昶雖在外任，心存朝廷，以爲魏承秦、漢之弊，法制苛碎，不大釐改國典以準先王之風，而望治化復興，不可得也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "062646ad64e9126bf21d77722b8ede2d89a03e185e5e6e6e15e8740328847f4d"}

{"id": "p_c960043ac2ba6367", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 73, "text": "乃著治論，略依古制而合於時務者二十餘篇，又著兵書十餘篇，言奇正之用，青龍中奏之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "ea563d369c0d12466c620d9ab9eac34f94c59c6bf0456dadb3d3097c3dfc06f5"}

{"id": "p_41df0df11a313eb3", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 74, "text": "其爲兄子及子作名字，皆依謙實，以見其意，故兄子默字處靜，沈字處道，其子渾字玄冲，深字道冲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "46f62330ccd81f90bce16c2a3043b7e3e7d08e92cb7fe5ed62c7575905f7143c"}

{"id": "p_b03715d2f776eebb", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 75, "text": "，詔「欲得有才智文章，謀慮淵深，料遠若近，視昧而察，籌不虛運，策弗徒發，端一小心，清脩密靜，乹乹不解，志尚在公者，無限年齒，勿拘貴賤，卿校已上各舉一人」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "a56d080bef7fbe3ad22b4abcd79f4c3163b910b52c3b3c659456e8db8f9e566c"}

{"id": "p_35c35cd970df5e32", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 76, "text": "正始中，轉在徐州，封武觀亭侯，遷征南將軍，假節都督荊、豫諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "1a6eb44f2d8b752ef97337dfb7c5fc4cd46b75f5af46da7a3b1fbd06dd85cdbd"}

{"id": "p_375e1b448579b8e7", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 77, "text": "昶以爲國有常衆，戰無常勝；地有常險，守無常勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "71f22606902ce9bdc679faab714674c3748c071232bdd6a64c10627901b5a9ad"}

{"id": "p_5680f56bca6b8efa", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 78, "text": "今屯宛，去襄陽三百餘里，諸軍散屯，船在宣池，有急不足相赴，乃表徙治新野，習水軍於二州，廣農墾殖，倉糓盈積。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "ac535c34cb547911817f01145c6cc4c98fe567a5e83654828f422ede2d235e40"}

{"id": "p_acf229e0337cf821", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 79, "text": "嘉平初，太傅司馬宣王旣誅曹爽，乃奏愽問大臣得失。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "c805a87051d8a78d6cc28486a7a3e5eeb05dd8b7c4391a609dd09a98fdb2be9f"}

{"id": "p_6e48f6779c029d36", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 80, "text": "昶陳治略五事：「其一，欲崇道篤學，抑絕浮華，使國子入太學而脩庠序；其二，欲用考試，考試猶準繩也，未有舍準繩而意正曲直，廢黜陟而空論能否也；其三，欲令居官者乆於其職，有治績則就增位賜爵；其四，欲約官實祿，勵以廉恥，不使與百姓爭利；其五，欲絕侈靡，務崇節儉，令衣服有章，上下有叙，儲糓畜帛，反民於樸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "3185326c772bf179f1424f99cc42263b478101e48cd700284fb0a6e3eee5d191"}

{"id": "p_a4aed79636f71e06", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 81, "text": "因使撰百官考課事，昶以爲唐虞雖有黜陟之文，而考課之法不垂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "0b3b159f5c1ae6cc3156d1ba38b07158049a9c9286f4ff29632ce458157e0d1f"}

{"id": "p_81eb7a2f96daaf3b", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 82, "text": "周制冢宰之職，大計群吏之治而誅賞，又無校比之制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "c9c1951913a583979f3f1b4a54e762ad855eb96c9bbf32eebc628c19808364a3"}

{"id": "p_040755b7fd34f11e", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 83, "text": "由此言之，聖主明於任賢，略舉黜陟之體，以委達官之長，而總其統紀，故能否可得而知也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "b92aa5bcf5726e95feb398fed3af1394e1f0c702385c25651461d0e3376d4e94"}

{"id": "p_032c42e63b87a9f7", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 84, "text": "二年，昶奏：「孫權流放良臣，適庶分爭，可乘釁而制吳、蜀；白帝、夷陵之間，黔、巫、秭歸、房陵皆在江北，民夷與新城郡接，可襲取也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "e0de710170ed55117df6f26b01335585def8f3e33bf4e75fa8a39a7dc1f015e1"}

{"id": "p_dfb01c05fdff2915", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 85, "text": "」乃遣新城太守州泰襲巫、秭歸、房陵，荊州刺史王基詣夷陵，昶詣江陵，兩岸引竹絙爲橋，渡水擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "d6983d170624c93334556ad0b86dd476814c8e593590d9eb923d25bf51ee2431"}

{"id": "p_46b3d21d61ea08d8", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 86, "text": "賊奔南岸，鑿七道並來攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "dd9d88b09639afe4894cba7ffc5d18005298878edc7f6337faf7303b76f6b343"}

{"id": "p_5b96baf715fe2282", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 87, "text": "於是昶使積弩同時俱發，賊大將施績夜遁入江陵城，追斬數百級。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "116df8a45a910618c6ec8a4f0bb143ca0bd612fc7b4193b39f1a178e32a6d8c3"}

{"id": "p_9a7bf60b6b594861", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 88, "text": "昶欲引致平地與合戰，乃先遣五軍案大道發還，使賊望見以喜之，以所獲鎧馬甲首，馳環城以怒之，設伏兵以待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "c6449f88eb26a93b9e8c59b4764e89fecce9a507c1f89742b540b1d5657d9fb2"}

{"id": "p_156478795741e485", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 89, "text": "績遁走，斬其將鍾離茂、許旻，收其甲首旗鼓珍寶器仗，振旅而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "966f6dffa519aab558bb92e70986d83fd3ab8e732a847e1e038430f1d9d59087"}

{"id": "p_e40cf5d271bb1d4d", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 90, "text": "於是遷昶征南大將軍、儀同三司，進封京陵侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "0443c6e1264059ceb578ef811fdac8ebb16a8aa8bd577c33b16da69f7b533cbf"}

{"id": "p_909fd31cece9b333", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 91, "text": "毌丘儉、文欽作亂，引兵拒儉、欽有功，封二子亭侯、關內侯，進位驃騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "e4d29bb54efb315dceac5db326c1c068c8b539e533edd405388ea245a9f9ad83"}

{"id": "p_29161c5432bd2a12", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 92, "text": "諸葛誕反，昶據夾石以逼江陵，持施績、全熈使不得東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "a5539a280613b38c309edb97cef9323b052c8c1c22595ae9c30d49dc837d0ac3"}

{"id": "p_7b70a50e2b783c91", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 93, "text": "誕旣誅，詔曰：「昔孫臏佐趙，直湊大梁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "4dff31b16d08462f32db4caaf55856191ad729c667da5f0adca561e1664020d7"}

{"id": "p_fedf430e5f4a936d", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 94, "text": "西兵驟進，亦所以成東征之勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "aca0a142d85b0aa93869c468642532cc7ba543bb2bf603d16d330672c7c36229"}

{"id": "p_637e2f6487828b4b", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」增邑千戶，并前四千七百戶，遷司空，持節、都督如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "a48b720abe1027d36d77a135ef6eb7f95c0a95c43c90baf235ac133daf0c627b"}

{"id": "p_e26faa85fcd97cb0", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 96, "text": "子渾嗣，咸熈中爲越騎校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "1d4b055e5cfc3a251b5ff67874304b73d09ab9ab49edcb8b9fd0b59fe31b2bda"}

{"id": "p_fc706987568fc742", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 97, "text": "王基字伯輿，東萊曲城人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "c880e3b98f99b6d91f125206042472e017af11474b586c8b2d08a1b8cd2ea36d"}

{"id": "p_ec4fe93ccac2d58e", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 98, "text": "翁撫養甚篤，基亦以孝稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "a8385e4a15fd94e54eaae5c2eb7ca2d7935047ecb6e02327afcfda360ef6be36"}

{"id": "p_f0bebfa58cdc5bec", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 99, "text": "年十七，郡召爲吏，非其好也，遂去，入琅邪界游學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "2dfb9a307a6ad0a8fd02c7e21fd49ececc7032ffe01a61d5ad9814fa99ad85ac"}

{"id": "p_84d45e90dc139e7c", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 100, "text": "黃初中，察孝廉，除郎中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "2745d9a859d3510c1502c12ee5b19d726ed9225cec8d057f3034d74daccf4c3a"}

{"id": "p_95fe84455666ad02", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 101, "text": "是時青土初定，刺史王凌特表請基爲別駕，後召爲秘書郎，凌復請還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "ef827eae064a0799c89386120a43ff8a29703af3ca7df7301bd1a4f7fa6299e1"}

{"id": "p_b2279aef25042cc7", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 102, "text": "頃之，司徒王朗辟基，淩不遣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "9d35cf1cab6ecdf692385b335899ff1e5abcd838a72cc4816845227baf5b3552"}

{"id": "p_5a755d5b28755b2f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 103, "text": "朗書劾州曰：「凡家臣之良，則升于公輔，公臣之良，則入于王職，是故古者侯伯有貢士之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "468f5851aec013c541bf112ed52a99121c6ad0a1da7670427f950664cc4e4b32"}

{"id": "p_41aa12dc4d9f0b45", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 104, "text": "今州取宿衞之臣，留秘閣之吏，所希聞也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "d81edc16e561178b30e7014c2cf6bc71e174630d657b4171cd3bfb85a9cf9040"}

{"id": "p_e1a4bdefef3d3137", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 105, "text": "淩流稱青土，蓋亦由基恊和之輔也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "23fa4008e1f1f0c20165591094c11ef97527020f314277a05369fe4e5f372577"}

{"id": "p_9660b5968376a330", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 106, "text": "大將軍司馬宣王辟基，未至，擢爲中書侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "7b8534ce51176d15d345fa25611ec8e60998fc0a43b162bb853d8bf17e3afb49"}

{"id": "p_b40c5acfab425a45", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 107, "text": "明帝盛脩宮室，百姓勞瘁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "5c53b24533db44f462df5772682a692bce22ba57c238504906bd946f74701cdb"}

{"id": "p_8ca33b2c7fb18c69", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 108, "text": "基上疏曰：「臣聞古人以水喻民，曰『水所以載舟，亦所以覆舟』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "3e6c498aee2f3d6d876c15f98a4c80cf7aa47a7cb888a81e56cf554b5fa7ed76"}

{"id": "p_93fef595f800adf6", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 109, "text": "故在民上者，不可以不戒懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "ba245522be3f17b0049e65cd9cfaa813499c1760a43bfa9e179777684279a22b"}

{"id": "p_ffe275fa12302316", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 110, "text": "夫民逸則慮易，苦則思難，是以先王居之以約儉，俾不至於生患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "bae7095741634a8077b443e1b90927c0675c32a4977c1888a2158eca40662694"}

{"id": "p_9eb5a623dc6030c4", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 111, "text": "昔顏淵云東野子之御，馬力盡矣而求進不已，是以知其將敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "a8ff39137806d85ec99be0a65b2a51944fa3fd753017b2de8ed8c96a2515b096"}

{"id": "p_7a6ed1ee527cea5c", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 112, "text": "今事役勞苦，男女離曠，願陛下深察東野之弊，留意舟水之喻，息奔駟於未盡，節力役於未困。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "98cd27e944cc072165607009fd33dabed425f4f06cf7d240ac23da469afa7ce7"}

{"id": "p_6f5d5c929623db00", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 113, "text": "昔漢有天下，至孝文時唯有同姓諸侯，而賈誼憂之曰：『置火積薪之下而寢其上，因謂之安也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "9f08640e9ad86f4b215cf2bfbe58fce036daa538aa1ecc5cd9f4035a546a4890"}

{"id": "p_cbaf8129432798f1", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 114, "text": "』今寇賊未殄，猛將擁兵，檢之則無以應敵，乆之則難以遺後，當盛明之世，不務以除患，若子孫不競，社稷之憂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "20ee32a090634de4da78732e129dc1ad2764aaa537bd915bb4b2b7fec1ccd71c"}

{"id": "p_ea0df8afe6970b55", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 115, "text": "使賈誼復起，必深切於曩時矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "f906053b8e067616b75977041ffccafa55ed506558169229145021ad74277cc8"}

{"id": "p_1778f9127bd4424f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 116, "text": "散騎常侍王肅著諸經傳解及論定朝儀，改易鄭玄舊說，而基據持玄義，常與抗衡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "9f9676fa065c6e06f38b11ece03ea25f5f9167deb185e801c690f276760d4e27"}

{"id": "p_a315f5919e4551e1", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 117, "text": "大將軍曹爽請爲從事中郎，出爲安豐太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "ec44cc4307d3ef8e7c585f43f9b1710d309c83efeac9e48e138cc0116d354a0c"}

{"id": "p_e41c34636bac5c65", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 118, "text": "郡接吳寇，爲政清嚴有威惠，明設防備，敵不敢犯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "2f5a18656ba70873569972adb89f353e723a1c160d312472e2e6b71fe1e48f39"}

{"id": "p_32bb911cb710e4db", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 119, "text": "吳嘗大發衆集建業，揚聲欲入攻揚州，刺史諸葛誕使基策之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "2f5dc8d179709ddc763483d9f58d5f322cc8e00649703efe8b239eec0974cfb5"}

{"id": "p_ce7617d706dd7089", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 120, "text": "基曰：「昔孫權再至合肥，一至江夏，其後全琮出廬江，朱然寇襄陽，皆無功而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "0fc3a79e71dc16eb5be9767fb232b94afcb22d729dbbdf183134a0f5389e80b8"}

{"id": "p_cd7c081e0eb0b401", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 121, "text": "今陸遜等已死，而權年老，內無賢嗣，中無謀主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "480980621ffd49261b43baad706aa909cecc475432b9f4b2fa705c65f525b711"}

{"id": "p_8c4ee73518dae455", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 122, "text": "權自出則懼內釁卒起，癕疽發潰；遣將則舊將已盡，新將未信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "daf6eaafc70080f7e5a6e92e2808bdba260a3c1f6d54e6ca8424a4a78c25cc8a"}

{"id": "p_e2332061cf034948", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 123, "text": "此不過欲補定支黨，還自保護耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "26faf3c92fe15c0b4ee36ee23dcf8889575b17897162b70b481a0ac22b645580"}

{"id": "p_0d386333098b244e", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 124, "text": "時曹爽專柄，風化陵遲，基著《時要論》以切世事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "18f052a4de4005599a5ee7f3915594520810d52b23348b32e6d1d46ace3e2e70"}

{"id": "p_7d596bebae87a08c", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 125, "text": "以疾徵還，起家爲河南尹，未拜，爽伏誅，基甞爲爽官屬，隨例罷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "e1060d560128924ccbc900dd68862e298a96e9e630c02c8e9ef7994cb621c900"}

{"id": "p_2a8992ecc3e97a09", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 126, "text": "其年爲尚書，出爲荊州刺史，加揚烈將軍，隨征南王昶擊吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "cfcc8beb6145bc510b6ebee73bf372c272a6abec3dbfae4b3ab0813a3713b145"}

{"id": "p_f2c6b9aad672ab14", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 127, "text": "基別襲步恊於夷陵，恊閉門自守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "edea73b2af69e26d0734290d7fdef9cd2b7cdae31064f6e09250e606cfd37ffa"}

{"id": "p_25552f8fefac65c8", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 128, "text": "基示以攻形，而實分兵取雄父邸閣，收米三十餘萬斛，虜安北將軍譚正，納降數千口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "e6c23727a8ca42dee540a7aafaf2f199c969e5bd914b86fe5d205e5219c02ae4"}

{"id": "p_b63297dc0ba4edb6", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 129, "text": "於是移其降民，置夷陵縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "f2e4bf452cd31949a93cc91e3b603ac85cabd179022f425e41bca9f9aa00908a"}

{"id": "p_8d766ef34ff58e2f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 130, "text": "基又表城上昶，徙江夏治之，以偪夏口，由是賊不敢輕越江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "744410f9abc47d55bee19bcca6a8b3da15217e816f52fe96b3a555d898a18df3"}

{"id": "p_c574a9f936773e2f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 131, "text": "明制度，整軍農，兼脩學校，南方稱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "ab104b3cb9ecb6b39d35d16ab7037ec4ff23544a832b0cb26b4bd190fbe6b28a"}

{"id": "p_1e698de64f2e38e9", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 132, "text": "時朝廷議欲伐吳，詔基量進趣之宜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "b2c65ebdca03294df43578bf6819ab8fdb195093c1adff5c66c5bc8600f5bead"}

{"id": "p_ee0501c26c7ab7a9", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 133, "text": "基對曰：「夫兵動而無功，則威名折於外，財用窮於內，故必全而後用也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "723c1b982378fbbaeb2147abe77f366bbcee06f136ab38c1a2e38c77624bce6f"}

{"id": "p_0111ff3bf795ce93", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 134, "text": "若不資通川聚糧水戰之備，則雖積兵江內，無必渡之勢矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "0628615d646031719273ff4917029a12f3fbdd51a25b33864f4b99f48fee3aca"}

{"id": "p_dbddc7b7ea08ee47", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 135, "text": "今江陵有沮、漳二水，溉灌膏腴之田以千數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "6a0c0f9d5a3a329ca820d405cf0b5fc3b918340797b1f88ee414e87d89fddc15"}

{"id": "p_c2f36cc58f111d24", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 136, "text": "若水陸並農，以實軍資，然後引兵詣江陵、夷陵，分據夏口，順沮、漳，資水浮糓而下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "41482576cfa26586002fcc4aeb7d8cbe1c1a900b37bdd7de2291bfd9a974138e"}

{"id": "p_74735530d88b2341", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 137, "text": "賊知官兵有經乆之勢，則拒天誅者意沮，而向王化者益固。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "103e2a14aadc4aaa1f5a6f902de8075c6bd0c1cbc9bf83799f291dea1b3ac1bf"}

{"id": "p_c54240c91c328a4b", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 138, "text": "然後率合蠻夷以攻其內，精卒勁兵以討其外，則夏口以上必拔，而江外之郡不守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "4e1f9a0754c2f713f5bd8b179e2d67270d3b5a1d99cb620deef61b81102fe314"}

{"id": "p_5d665e4cc6f77cdd", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 139, "text": "如此，吳、蜀之交絕，交絕而吳禽矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "08b9798400d251ca807b502b1f64471480a6a91d71b721385009fc5727e59825"}

{"id": "p_55e3d079993ea781", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 140, "text": "不然，兵出之利，未可必矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "82b0cf598db634f840687e9baeb6c3af00af0b629813eba354b04ce8d31552c9"}

{"id": "p_7b1ab56d4bbbffbd", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 141, "text": "司馬景王新統政，基書戒之曰：「天下至廣，萬機至猥，誠不可不矜矜業業，坐而待旦也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "93649257680d633dda4dfee663e6eb584df13394ff92fd7f13e346897cc5159d"}

{"id": "p_c2a1b0f7d3f9ef26", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 142, "text": "夫志正則衆邪不生，心靜則衆事不躁，思慮審定則教令不煩，親用忠良則遠近恊服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "4954f6b936bddbe4fdc15a913f3961ffb145deb62f9c5a44978da39c1f91fb34"}

{"id": "p_119ce6894fa1e4d6", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 143, "text": "故知和遠在身，定衆在心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "1c87c53ce0afc60ccd64d73c8897d988c096b6c974535b3f55869d95fb393aed"}

{"id": "p_d8036162fb739819", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 144, "text": "許允、傅嘏、袁侃、崔贊皆一時正士，有直質而無流心，可與同政事者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "dc04a775425860722bf6e7ba5e674fa97de38e2cf10cb35ddbc731389bb69902"}

{"id": "p_963591ee3e27b080", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 145, "text": "高貴鄉公即尊位，進封常樂亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "e8ab4a2587abde6bbde9c6a659b039aa1c16177941874ec8e74df5bb32b9acba"}

{"id": "p_ed074356756b9224", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 146, "text": "毌丘儉、文欽作亂，以基爲行監軍、假節，統許昌軍，適與景王會於許昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "a2a3a5b1189b2ac1ad88cd586ced928e69e118ed805f438e0fad9506ac114872"}

{"id": "p_c09df6b6006eaf68", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 147, "text": "景王曰：「君籌儉等何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "8a65176d8c0b6878b370646dbbfee1c4b7acdb9a74b2f5a4513e2f44ebb71580"}

{"id": "p_e13582cf07a42bc1", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」基曰：「淮南之逆，非吏民思亂也，儉等誑脅迫懼，畏目下之戮，是以尚群聚耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "6d3ba480c6121611955db3ad04f6df5918ce7ed3c01197b5448c238930de765f"}

{"id": "p_d1a7a75d4b5fc8e7", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 149, "text": "若大兵臨偪，必土崩瓦解，儉、欽之首，不終朝而縣於軍門矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "cabe4e314edaea63289fc1c42e12a3aec837cb381d1a56ddc25b761ce7374317"}

{"id": "p_69923a8da77e8851", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 150, "text": "議者咸以儉、欽慓悍，難與爭鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "462fab1862d664baf9b4b07708ba6b21155f180a077c42661e2bdd1772674281"}

{"id": "p_f490bcca8e0a9fae", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 151, "text": "基以爲：「儉等舉軍足以深入，而乆不進者，是其詐僞已露，衆心疑沮也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "516673c2f0118ce70c8b562184812078277c086083518a9a30da2ffa0065aea3"}

{"id": "p_7444b6970401dbf4", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 152, "text": "今不張示威形以副民望，而停軍高壘，有似畏懦，非用兵之勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "2f2c53559b655896686f41bbe55c5e8cca523b71ab6c3d87a9f4036d9b16f4f9"}

{"id": "p_25a0baacd9f43e15", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 153, "text": "若或虜略民人，又州郡兵家爲賊所得者，更懷離心；儉等所迫脅者，自顧罪重，不敢復還，此爲錯兵無用之地，而成姦宄之源。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "404e7fbbbd291949843e77db10b43e54c493e17550d91ecb6535374bffe51666"}

{"id": "p_b8612620aaf1c88d", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 154, "text": "吳寇因之，則淮南非國家之有，譙、沛、汝、豫危而不安，此計之大失也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "a03132f3e667b0ff4be1d5388aed7c8cd3eff6b2dc9246577ee602d282dbb926"}

{"id": "p_33c4e58942b78cbd", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 155, "text": "軍宜速進據南頓，南頓有大邸閣，計足軍人四十日糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "2da78ce9fd55d621e9cae487abfd321272abf85d555b7faba7da345490fc23ba"}

{"id": "p_253f154ca2a31b49", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 156, "text": "保堅城，因積穀，先人有奪人之心，此平賊之要也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "097245acabaeb659ac3e6fc1488220c67419beb935c7b6ec629136bec6d6484f"}

{"id": "p_07ea6cdec641b169", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 157, "text": "」基屢請，乃聽進據㶏水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "c76ce5d5e18ff7c70193aeda6f2646b426e317625bae492678b967eb38d6639d"}

{"id": "p_157cbd2eca244b1e", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 158, "text": "旣至，復言曰：「兵聞拙速，未覩工遟之乆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "64b420c6531b47f65af4d6d36e1572b39acdb2722d4f5076d911cb889dc5f022"}

{"id": "p_238e73f857456e74", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 159, "text": "方今外有彊寇，內有叛臣，若不時決，則事之深淺未可測也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "d9623a3c3e46c98db09626e89a779f6760b848ee210c0a6c6f73fc24efedc59b"}

{"id": "p_a97eee91a196922a", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 160, "text": "將軍持重是也，停軍不進非也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "4df330a2fd5a25e0c54b40d30ccc036f575b3a33d55f8198ddbf31106910a4de"}

{"id": "p_7aa3eaf65379f676", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 161, "text": "持重非不行之謂也，進而不可犯耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "08f598507dec7413ccb9a0dbe72f19cb3d855862d98517b0ee5d3993eb9a50f7"}

{"id": "p_ae66de0cf1c3c113", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 162, "text": "今據堅城，保壁壘，以積實資虜，縣運軍糧，甚非計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "5b4de8c73c6588eecd962bcb595bafdbd4397a95244f85e4e7179ff878d42c97"}

{"id": "p_0d1e0a23c13a903b", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」景王欲須諸軍集到，猶尚未許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "e40a8a41b6b33a1a27c5af5a9b408132b4ec70de2759dc1f341ed0221537ed02"}

{"id": "p_27b5df3577c904d1", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 164, "text": "基曰：「將在軍，君令有所不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "ee91f44f7c93a21402ac20e6cef2ce57453cce400e4452c9d5f7c2cafe79dbe6"}

{"id": "p_0772a0af30ba00db", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 165, "text": "彼得則利，我得亦利，是謂爭城，南頓是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "4e0daddd8b6aa0db39ccc642b5f1c2b56378f337b1c80e940068971a37b434f5"}

{"id": "p_e53185e359976d1a", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」遂輙進據南頓，儉等從項亦爭欲往，發十餘里，聞基先到，復還保項。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "2797c601a7b7a9bbb1d5fd591eef4d533d9b706b180c6a8dc4284801225cc0bb"}

{"id": "p_d6c422671c286f39", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 167, "text": "時兖州刺史鄧艾屯樂嘉，儉使文欽將兵襲艾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "b08a64fda34ab7e05b795282f5024f27e1ccef1305dfb6765bc54d951c53c665"}

{"id": "p_f56e1a3fb4c3ac53", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 168, "text": "基知其勢分，進兵偪項，儉衆遂敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "f49af3f4c80089b7c8d1e515d8a48cbce89361d4f0f45779f1f51271cf8cfa59"}

{"id": "p_260dd55e5f8697b8", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 169, "text": "欽等已平，遷鎮南將軍，都督豫州諸軍事，領豫州刺史，進封安樂鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "4cb37a2957a855f472805f23705f68e5fa3b81275253f74fbc7ba4208d41ff5b"}

{"id": "p_7ae5f5d2d864b0cd", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 170, "text": "上疏求分戶二百，賜叔父子喬爵關內侯，以報叔父拊育之德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "65d67c70d8e8421e0c1d53b907be77f279c17ec9462080716ce023bd65068928"}

{"id": "p_f8d6dbd8879b032d", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 171, "text": "諸葛誕反，基以本官行鎮東將軍，都督揚、豫諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "a6e635f49784d9f5fa3cebfed38d313f91223bf40b7560b5b44c7dd010ea9832"}

{"id": "p_9edc9b1a97cd2685", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 172, "text": "時大軍在項，以賊兵精，詔基斂軍堅壘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "34bfc041783ade763edf56975f3d2d5e333f5bcacf9ac0e1c8588308fe4b4332"}

{"id": "p_6b15d681206505e7", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 173, "text": "會吳遣朱異來救誕，軍於安城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "212558909ceb95f024333b289ebc87f0c274afcd566ebc8afddad77a0a0263c7"}

{"id": "p_275f689f077d404c", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 174, "text": "基又被詔引諸軍轉據北山，基謂諸將曰：「今圍壘轉固，兵馬向集，但當精修守備以待越逸，而更移兵守險，使得放縱，雖有智者不能善後矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "46b850e18e26b66b444e939e579c51e92921b00a6139216ad0dd201400cf8cd6"}

{"id": "p_5af99a71ad3b5893", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 175, "text": "」遂守便宜上疏曰：「今與賊家對敵，當不動如山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "45db396e93f98e00b8b2171557029899e8b50948e3cd530a4eb69920da902c2e"}

{"id": "p_3811ca5fa147e7f1", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 176, "text": "若遷移依險，人心搖蕩，於勢大損。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "f8e3ae272d92b3b9bf9f11e7d666dbc166e434df19b429323e7369cc4917be2f"}

{"id": "p_c9a93841125ee38f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 177, "text": "諸軍並據深溝高壘，衆心皆定，不可傾動，此御兵之要也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "c5582763ffd802035f3ea6e84bd64fbab32787a615384aa2a6b6ddffbc0a0cbe"}

{"id": "p_073e08e833a8dfee", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 178, "text": "大將軍司馬文王進屯丘頭，分部圍守，各有所統。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "ca507b21e6fa719693a0c121531585be69914f962e862483553f3b85d17c2751"}

{"id": "p_49acbf10f5375cfa", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 179, "text": "基督城東城南二十六軍，文王勑軍吏入鎮南部界，一不得有所遣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "784abd7422e642e17a4c5824af595c8aef8f9efbb6b8f0d6b7baf382f5da338d"}
