{"id": "p_1d0bed4a67b51db5", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 180, "text": "城中食盡，晝夜攻壘，基輙拒擊，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "925d1dd2f08dc574e503a172305a1d1dd10beef550938618261245f78ab885fe"}

{"id": "p_bb2a245b388080e7", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 181, "text": "壽春旣拔，文王與基書曰：「初議者云云，求移者甚衆，時未臨履，亦謂宜然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "8310086bf4e8689699972d055ca7b2c475bc7bf2c06cc785affc805c6486159f"}

{"id": "p_69c207a67569d219", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 182, "text": "將軍深筭利害，獨秉固志，上違詔命，下拒衆議，終至制敵禽賊，雖古人所述，不是過也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "ed39c6bf0a6d5d88dd93db2ab2c7f969e5566e3442a307e25d33a430db585c6e"}

{"id": "p_ea1b4adce568e08f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 183, "text": "」文王欲遣諸將輕兵深入，招迎唐咨等子弟，因釁有蕩覆吳之勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "a92a442f532a833748c7a64c73fcfa1f897e7da53a2d9256e19331cc19033fa7"}

{"id": "p_29311d6222c5bc94", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 184, "text": "基諫曰：「昔諸葛恪乘東關之勝，竭江表之兵，以圍新城，城旣不拔，而衆死者大半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "46749e7d75f2548df18f0277214d1038593745a1e3a3aaec44f22528946b83f8"}

{"id": "p_4b8d6968eeacf7fe", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 185, "text": "姜維因洮上之利，輕兵深入，糧餉不繼，軍覆上邽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "398e39559f466528d4bd95f54ab29efb79d0e4532d126e624a9d856f072496f3"}

{"id": "p_77cdfce135411bbe", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 186, "text": "夫大捷之後，上下輕敵，輕敵則慮難不深。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "8f137bf2ad91146216f430dac8806e28ce0642f5c60edb8e19bb7901b1484fbd"}

{"id": "p_09595ec3b64a52c2", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 187, "text": "今賊新敗於外，又內患未弭，是其脩備設慮之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "a032c7781ff735696247b3091f95027c8de243ecbdbb48aa85686034b41c2b93"}

{"id": "p_2f8ef6874f10b8d9", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 188, "text": "且兵出踰年，人有歸志，今俘馘十萬，罪人斯得，自歷代征伐，未有全兵獨克如今之盛者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "5aaade462105c3fd6e1fd025e1f71f0042c264e1d897180faaa3944c9aa1de2d"}

{"id": "p_311e02a8588240a0", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 189, "text": "武皇帝克袁紹於官渡，自以所獲已多，不復追奔，懼挫威也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "d9a21a3ce8e80e9e94a935aa22bc1e2e156959651db663247c5fed321747533a"}

{"id": "p_c8c1817e377a91d7", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 190, "text": "以淮南初定，轉基爲征東將軍，都督揚州諸軍事，進封東武侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "e5c4be3ea0f7d7db17cccad9c3640108008b8db9820cd8f1d8ef41783f0bbaaa"}

{"id": "p_0a13e3e8b4d369f8", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 191, "text": "基上疏固讓，歸功參佐，由是長史司馬等七人皆侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "2de1aec71a4fbe78167bc3f9e043fdc215ca15898bd9fe15d5c269f12d5f1f99"}

{"id": "p_c49875c8b2e4d40d", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 192, "text": "是歲，基母卒，詔祕其凶問，迎基父豹喪合葬洛陽，追贈豹北海太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "954fbfd9a58ca85e6d18c8ca8bd2e3e21b904e4758b2051510b34519437c1360"}

{"id": "p_5a54b5b7552579f0", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 193, "text": "甘露四年，轉爲征南將軍，都督荊州諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "20f64f21e828853e0fac30883c6b0cf10d3d6f6e056979736b9ff24401db4dad"}

{"id": "p_14b584dfd27f4deb", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 194, "text": "常道鄉公即尊位，增邑千戶，并前五千七百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "fc98ae0e3274256d96a58f37922e2e12ce95efd2678ec3bd3a5e47578be8b3f4"}

{"id": "p_96d5779ef02fa816", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 195, "text": "前後封子二人亭侯、關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "2e81f8dff972fbd620f6f20cdab09276ecf2b255d9055e3bd6af3761652355b2"}

{"id": "p_8ce314fea2d66c35", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 196, "text": "，襄陽太守表吳賊鄧由等欲來歸化，基被詔，當因此震蕩江表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "ee32f9b10296582dba3a5addbd29ac49f3f3093f8078b260de74f3593e2e1606"}

{"id": "p_33785cb7159ca8d3", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 197, "text": "且曰：「嘉平以來，累有內難，當今之務，在於鎮安社稷，綏寧百姓，未宜動衆以求外利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "036d8e3eda647efc00f74d2a11ba080cad1aba745f0881e9571100fc6974cdac"}

{"id": "p_07ce003e742b4180", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 198, "text": "」文王報書曰：「凡處事者，多曲相從順，鮮能確然共盡理實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "6fbfea3a7c6e2f3e4739bce24de5e6383827d51c2038bae0d4e4a51028df0219"}

{"id": "p_e924c64677748f9e", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 199, "text": "誠感忠愛，每見規示，輙敬依來指。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "f1e15c4b216b009d0373db73874b8bf0d43dcdeba26276f3c979dda03da7a38a"}

{"id": "p_a1f77043852ccdca", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 200, "text": "是歲基薨，追贈司空，謚曰景侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "610eed21344595357537eff2af468f1896eacea4d345fc3db42da81567f25ae0"}

{"id": "p_43c19fdf255b7524", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 201, "text": "咸熈中，開建五等，以基著勳前朝，改封基孫廙，而以東武餘邑賜一子爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "4e5aef5ff6a957420338a3572e4efc3e6bb63597b37126a240032eef4ce69e29"}

{"id": "p_ac9d81015c04b79c", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 202, "text": "晉室踐阼，下詔曰：「故司空王基旣著德立勳，又治身清素，不營產業，乆在重任，家無私積，可謂身沒行顯，足用勵俗者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "c8eb2946d20a1ecd10db642271ee2e97c2e784375a89becf33b7e2acb39bf8a7"}

{"id": "p_70b78547e2ff296f", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 203, "text": "評曰：徐邈清尚弘通，胡質素業貞粹，王昶開濟識度，王基學行堅白，皆掌統方任，垂稱著績。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "333a30ea24c0ffc7ce4bae8aaaf0ef4e787922f4c065be9709cb1780c170b1c2"}

{"id": "p_1f1ca960142b7c5b", "source_id": "src_78da344c7ebf66a7", "ordinal": 204, "text": "可謂國之良臣，時之彥士矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "5fe9bf6b23be70ef2c81cf516b2e71712e20254556d95ac547d176dcce0ae2ca"}

{"id": "p_1bdc4d92e4094388", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_41b2929d6eae3ac0", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 1, "text": "王凌字彥雲，太原祁人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "1ad64139964a48e46aa860ba3291db224c4baa1494085476abfd7af546f635fa"}

{"id": "p_98dfac6cee27a430", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 2, "text": "叔父允，為漢司徒，誅董卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "cca5fb687e029dea5ad1825b0247a38595de05646960c08c4b792be8e8a879d4"}

{"id": "p_75f672741e91d85c", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 3, "text": "卓將李傕、郭汜等為卓報仇，入長安，殺允，盡害其家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "5d18aa07737bc15e363b62621da01c2952b9d484b587eb57663da5abd1528dfb"}

{"id": "p_dd7cbc514fb289eb", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 4, "text": "凌及兄晨，時年皆少，逾城得脫，亡命歸鄉里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "1e31ab04d88f2a390a27a29c886e531bb14ac68b44e5fa1342164673daf97d6f"}

{"id": "p_ec8f12e98bdda1b1", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 5, "text": "凌舉孝廉，為發干長，稍遷至中山太守，所在有治，太祖辟為丞相掾屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "c74df1f78535345ae566e601fba2b0ffb4bf3419690f4d4770415390cda49084"}

{"id": "p_2affbd0e6a11b6a1", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 6, "text": "文帝踐阼，拜散騎常侍，出為兗州刺史，與張遼等至廣陵討孫權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "0aeee30786cedbcd687ad652f7c78715b0c263d8d18abe10509f3c88eb896792"}

{"id": "p_6b030f5637b8ace0", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 7, "text": "臨江，夜大風，吳將呂範等船漂至北岸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "95ce51ebd28982b6a3fcc7b998848e823c5a5f497f6b84acf32d4fd57d596b69"}

{"id": "p_afb5446d86a2482d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 8, "text": "凌與諸將逆擊，捕斬首虜，獲舟船，有功，封宜城亭侯，加建武將軍，轉在青州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "ed3d885db4cade36b4b3f4512be12648b6563fe825fe05efd6fff42d98fde262"}

{"id": "p_23439203258ab44a", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 9, "text": "是時海濱乘喪亂之後，法度未整。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "266669442bf658cb365e89893eb823a388430a0d3b0db25e046c431112ced12c"}

{"id": "p_067566acae65c081", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 10, "text": "凌布政施教，賞善罰惡，甚有綱紀，百姓稱之，不容於口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "c5672d8c0e68bca3e3afe4e5e2d7485479e8f9b408f387f9f44a464fa2ada33c"}

{"id": "p_3e7732e806694a04", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 11, "text": "後從曹休征吳，與賊遇於夾石，休軍失利，凌力戰決圍，休得免難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "a28457b0d899e776417b7ec4a7be9e25245e7d88efa6ebfdacada67327f8f658"}

{"id": "p_5a17ea6a8c6dda95", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 12, "text": "仍徙為揚、豫州刺史，咸得軍民之歡心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "c2814d10d30cff5f32ca5008b61a2b9b9c9b430e90d01e4f8a54966e7c5a7d7c"}

{"id": "p_20a106882412fe76", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 13, "text": "始至豫州，旌先賢之後，求未顯之士，各有條教，意義甚美。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "0f29820971016f529c453ea9e07f2b395567b53b1374b048f0c1967be459c277"}

{"id": "p_688c80d0cde9be40", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 14, "text": "初，凌與司馬朗、賈逵友善，及臨兗、豫，繼其名跡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "e11b5c9ae0ab6b8cf567e1e09a7a2e902ff0e69361a3af399e160d3df08192e1"}

{"id": "p_e0a561ba5c3d9971", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 15, "text": "正始初，為征東將軍，假節都督揚州諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "1cdf2f4283d91ce3f1d85e57b07f2921b2bf0a812c7fb748208eb7e9d9d98bc3"}

{"id": "p_1d0d4abc119b8ce9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 16, "text": "二年，吳大將全琮數万眾寇芍陂，凌率諸軍逆討，與賊爭塘，力戰連日，賊退走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "7ffa994c0b2bc61bd76c9fb4feeb62f2cec6beca8ca88e7ef9eca45467859d20"}

{"id": "p_b568a89511fda002", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 17, "text": "進封南鄉侯，邑千三百五十戶，遷車騎將軍、儀同三司。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "d08c26ed6caa7a89950c5f46d915e822bd295a1aefb048167881080176e128f7"}

{"id": "p_10e055a7c3fd1a4c", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 18, "text": "是時，凌外甥令狐愚以才能為兗州刺史，屯平阿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "f8a67aaae4497a7f6aacaee12645470f94da06a5a616c13cafcac9e4abe85c74"}

{"id": "p_f09c7e6381ce664c", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 19, "text": "舅甥並典兵，專淮南之重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "d3d6b2b033a0dfacb00f29760588931954ebf5cfbf753c56d5c0b08be2d10af5"}

{"id": "p_168fc4218783015a", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 20, "text": "司馬宣王既誅曹爽，進凌為太尉，假節鉞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "2c18ad6de0d27f1d8b755a550b873f490763ee2c34e1590bc50135f2747a1fa7"}

{"id": "p_8e0458152f9ee621", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 21, "text": "凌、愚密協計，謂齊王不任天位，楚王彪長而才，欲迎立彪都許昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f723512a538554e83af982844ed2414921996d17f66797fb2087e2fc232ba52c"}

{"id": "p_9adb8d5cb3e7a287", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 22, "text": "九月，愚遣將張式至白馬，與彪相問往來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "6637d9ae93f9a5adf41b05e96368fd4a6324bb6823a87c466eb7067242c1d988"}

{"id": "p_e55866448aabf8df", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 23, "text": "凌又遣舍人勞精詣洛陽，語子廣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "661e80abf426dbd4fcc0228f24991a46c892759c2048171ec2ff6b8f68825229"}

{"id": "p_1beb59eb9e611d82", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 24, "text": "廣言：「廢立大事，勿為禍先。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "fd4bbc4c1fb608f62483c9f9d71885a51147e63a5968915f09bbde687f59bfd0"}

{"id": "p_fa1f7fff61e755b2", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 25, "text": "」其十一月，愚復遣式詣彪，未還，會愚病死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "033edf8db5c988be5b4e06340349ae8d58a1599c487b17defe5c233cb5a45a6b"}

{"id": "p_a6ff1f1d1da445ba", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 26, "text": "二年，熒惑守南斗，凌謂：「斗中有星，當有暴貴者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "012cc5251702c507bb9393c8ccb4da59151a31d0e9dfc9ed3ea70b75f482f2fd"}

{"id": "p_1a5c1edced741e65", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 27, "text": "凌欲因此發，大嚴諸軍，表求討賊；詔報不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "6b35ee442a1e65f5cc3b993edfc287da74d63144042609f0730af39d54a5118b"}

{"id": "p_ebc5393637b8df11", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 28, "text": "凌陰謀滋甚，遣將軍楊弘以廢立事告兗州刺史黃華，華、弘連名以白太傅司馬宣王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "5973fd24a443fb465e4e889005679fefd651574b859efeedb72c86908c22b9a8"}

{"id": "p_eda573c9dadcb81b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 29, "text": "宣王將中軍乘水道討凌，先下赦赦凌罪，又將尚書廣東，使為書喻凌，大軍掩至百尺逼凌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "a7e805d2a418b7ad0d6e6feca523fe3a09fc07d1989ed8314540ab1cecd38c92"}

{"id": "p_c57ec2c86a1a8375", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 30, "text": "凌自知勢窮，乃乘船單出迎宣王，遣掾王彧謝罪，送印綬、節鉞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "ff8acca72831df7fd303bd4fcccc2a7a0fc6ac9d220019ff5987ce1c1cdfe327"}

{"id": "p_4be478f35ee2d452", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 31, "text": "宣王承詔遣主簿解縛反服，見凌，慰勞之，還印綬、節鉞，遣步騎六百人送還京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "7cf505df687a678999a56d4bb0fb5f0ce56d36e3270e64cd95468ed6fed7ecdd"}

{"id": "p_a8ef5c76926285a5", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 32, "text": "張式等皆自首，乃窮治其事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "b94d6ee5443fe5b114decc50ee2b9b8d6ae929c243cca3b5d63d90aa6f46fa7a"}

{"id": "p_490f2e713cc72ebc", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 33, "text": "彪賜死，諸相連者悉夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "0b4631048a2d7a0e5c448f478086a8a55063cbfd9667d50b846a40f57b46d180"}

{"id": "p_ab5c21cb814b3031", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 34, "text": "朝議咸以為春秋之義，齊崔杼、鄭歸生皆加追戮，陳屍斫棺，載在方策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "f8d698cb41bb0db20d62ff4db031d26d10f78adb9e73fcefc2ec9bae27ffc758"}

{"id": "p_0a6fbd5ab558e98b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 35, "text": "乃發凌、愚塚，剖棺，暴屍於所近市三日，燒其印綬、朝服，親土埋之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "1f1b2b85f8dc9c109c2779f00288cd744c8d4e8dfed1dddc4f71ab35cf8afb18"}

{"id": "p_a5a0a26a6d5d0f57", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 36, "text": "廣有志尚學行，死時年四十餘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "f7840540244754d72acc413c6ea0f0aeb1bed25c3b442932c7e6aa097971f7cf"}

{"id": "p_5ed065dc857a09bc", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 37, "text": "毌丘儉字仲恭，河東聞喜人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "3673a312d2245053e53566b6743e6d470ae143612e3f9f0ab00e108b0f193c45"}

{"id": "p_0c8592c1ac60bf62", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 38, "text": "父興，黃初中為武威太守，伐叛柔服，開通河右，名次金城太守蘇則。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "fca57c71b3eb218c0a95675715e189de6fb035823fafd15093333444b972beef"}

{"id": "p_73a0fe583cb2f8b3", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 39, "text": "討賊張進及討叛胡有功，封高陽鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "546c801323dfd62fe2effeb7b6c71eb4b84a79810ee90908b3e16705009d5865"}

{"id": "p_3b7cc7ba53ddc80f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 40, "text": "儉襲父爵，為平原侯文學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "06e10883151771ff8917fb98cf42c3afa9751f7e8338ede99aa05df8d780f44b"}

{"id": "p_8bb86eb4051bb4ec", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 41, "text": "明帝即位，為尚書郎，遷羽林監。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "9441dd42c5540b6b60468913e3caf7feab2ae432b56dcd1bc49a6a5de22d598a"}

{"id": "p_f908a12892cd8086", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 42, "text": "時取農民以治宮室，儉上疏曰：「臣愚以為天下所急除者二賊，所急務者衣食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "d6661e560ed46e3a9cccf18f850dae89473262c88ac132ff3fdfa1f8a735bee4"}

{"id": "p_affb651e742078d8", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 43, "text": "誠使二賊不滅，士民飢凍，雖崇美宮室，猶無益也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "2483d40752554a33d3ce0d5c0961cb98b14ab4a7f5dbb1f5093e286f5ad4d2ed"}

{"id": "p_4529b3cc1cd56513", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 44, "text": "青龍中，帝圖討遼東，以儉有幹策，徙為幽州刺史，加度遼將軍，使持節，護烏丸校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "7a5623d1ef5088231d6ca27098a5f4a57a8a464ef52c16b6788d6e7c4233225d"}

{"id": "p_68c6452a2b0a4003", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 45, "text": "率幽州諸軍至襄平，屯遼隧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "d8fc508568c572ba03d62d1572d9430416d20551be9390786f028ecbe0288c7b"}

{"id": "p_ca8351f4c2a0d287", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 46, "text": "右北平烏丸單于寇婁敦、遼西烏丸都督率眾王護留等，昔隨袁尚奔遼東者，率眾五千餘人降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "0289b135e00926e4c24ad59083a80b38aa3a44a57084a63ee799ee8c79c28002"}

{"id": "p_7f87f19df19703c6", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 47, "text": "寇婁敦遣弟阿羅槃等詣闕朝貢，封其渠率二十餘人為侯、王，賜輿馬繒採各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "329d2deeb8625b26ae9f030ba815e1645db8fcdf175a34cea4a0c5cd492d6618"}

{"id": "p_24dffa65bf74d494", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 48, "text": "公孫淵逆與儉戰，不利，引還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "9d568739575efc5f6fd05004cdd5b7f6afdd174a4afe68d3df83e5caf0fa85bc"}

{"id": "p_c801d007e6c6c7d6", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 49, "text": "明年，帝遣太尉司馬宣王統中軍及儉等眾數万討淵，定遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "8d8c19b597bb2eb138226650c0a5faaf84225c5ae6ce60f6dd97939ce785204e"}

{"id": "p_0082f3f7c50f80e0", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 50, "text": "儉以功進封安邑侯，食邑三千九百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "591c90cca09f4b12bca2b5a98377310c861261ff32284f9c47247cd2116dd5a5"}

{"id": "p_691d97166e91ff8c", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 51, "text": "正始中，儉以高句驪數侵叛，督諸軍步騎萬人出玄菟，從諸道討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "a6baf531ad4465efc171518a7e626bdefcffa395dcfff5c4b2703e436f862b54"}

{"id": "p_d6c649986dbd3ead", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 52, "text": "句驪王宮將步騎二萬人，進軍沸流水上，大戰梁口，宮連破走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "7168c8993c032e465bd76e80a6710c3bb1ee2292c870e1a934c3e630a593d948"}

{"id": "p_1aab7b4aee89a897", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 53, "text": "儉遂束馬縣車，以登丸都，屠句驪所都，斬獲首虜以千數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "ad6c568dc191f4bfc136489e931714c3f1336e3826cd04317c04c663b14c4a7a"}

{"id": "p_175ffc10a05c0d65", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 54, "text": "句驪沛者名得來，數諫宮，宮不從其言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "0f541230ee1c127938c4c3fde6720ed31d417847c6ef3884d7cd9b872315adc4"}

{"id": "p_1b670839edfaa6b3", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 55, "text": "得來歎曰：「立見此地將生蓬蒿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "67d1d3bb491686559de0d290c9b5708aea40645d565aeaa7bb3d85a9ec54b315"}

{"id": "p_480d40ad7d68831b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 56, "text": "」遂不食而死，舉國賢之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "0b74daf415e9364d17d36979017c637a6acf039e23bef54c05211e813d0f8f11"}

{"id": "p_62e85e042442f755", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 57, "text": "儉令諸軍不壞其墓，不伐其樹，得其妻子，皆放遣之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "12e68e11e486e7bdb96d3ac6b89ccbe07f7a52eec91accf4aef4c01b35519ec8"}

{"id": "p_5f924622deb4a1bc", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 58, "text": "六年，复征之，宮遂奔買溝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "47da70231de0d221d37b92484d814c3045b41815731eaa13b000125c92ece181"}

{"id": "p_7a2ed5431ba235ac", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 59, "text": "儉遣玄菟太守王頎追之，過沃沮千有餘里，至肅慎氏南界，刻石紀功，刊丸都之山，銘不耐之城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "e8627d0f4aeaf4dcc1cb0163bd8f04050ca8b0d85f2050ed61f6cad895ad5cbe"}

{"id": "p_b52d8f0d1ab99c90", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 60, "text": "諸所誅納八千餘口，論功受賞，侯者百餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "71f307d31c194a614024cc1eb4dfe89da6897b3bee6260cdda1e6559eeb76324"}

{"id": "p_9a64185350f26b6b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 61, "text": "遷左將軍，假節監豫州諸軍事，領豫州刺史，轉為鎮南將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "3522f694a38ff1d55a668ccead9f9bdca6fcfa5e56da2bcd86cba2ade8fb506a"}

{"id": "p_4ae6906639b7c8b6", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 62, "text": "諸葛誕戰於東關，不利，乃令誕、儉對換。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "2ae20c5c2654d7e4a1703da4bfcb016e397fc0957babd80d970daf8474021389"}

{"id": "p_fcf7101c49594cb4", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 63, "text": "吳太傅諸葛恪圍合肥新城，儉與文欽御之，太尉司馬孚督中軍東解圍，恪退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "2ec1831b8ec02c461518b9ea3960e75d6ac1b6a31a31459af93883c160e5c7ed"}

{"id": "p_cae2b4390fcd6084", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 64, "text": "初，儉與夏侯玄、李豐等厚善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "24eae14577f08fd72f3f1da3b0da281d66fca232a052c9c4ff9db274f0bee09b"}

{"id": "p_1c5687a5a56e4a9f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 65, "text": "揚州刺史前將軍文欽，曹爽之邑人也，驍果粗猛，數有戰功，好增虜獲，以徼寵賞，多不見許，怨恨日甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "acba56bcf72109ded4ec51d0beab395c54755e1a88c848b8c09dcdf035888a2a"}

{"id": "p_b6c28b095f6507f6", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 66, "text": "儉以計厚待欽，情好歡洽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "23b6c0a67086a7dd71910564d32986bdb91bad7ddd61ee0878df9730c01e385a"}

{"id": "p_628f4b915297305f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 67, "text": "正月，有彗星數十丈，西北竟天，起於吳、楚之分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "ba588d4597ca243a33f2f851eb5b333774c7d10fda3f36da866835a75bbcce52"}

{"id": "p_4e1d96494522f07a", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 68, "text": "遂矯太后詔，罪狀大將軍司馬景王，移諸郡國，舉兵反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "90cdde8035053b7ada5587b9638c38aad3592983231d50c97fcde32131f45aef"}

{"id": "p_e9a84290418cf1bc", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 69, "text": "迫脅淮南將守諸別屯者，及吏民大小，皆入壽春城，為壇於城西，歃血稱兵為盟，分老弱守城，儉、欽自將五六萬眾渡淮，西至項。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "de4df95585716b010969a745a9fd8e859945f2e2bcc27585ad3e7cf292490a10"}

{"id": "p_55cfb2596a537a1c", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 70, "text": "大將軍統中外軍討之，別使諸葛誕督豫州諸軍從安風津擬壽春，征東將軍胡遵督青、徐諸軍出於譙、宋之間，絕其歸路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "8e3b1c1427ceaeb3708493bf6abf0004e025d35b7afdf1cf6ea0e7f0e60b4431"}

{"id": "p_3dad24411601488e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 71, "text": "大將軍屯汝陽，使監軍王基督前鋒諸軍據南頓以待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "9954a1855e6b64497c756d7f0f1568582fe794ae777fe9b0a4b0c6afe0d8b161"}

{"id": "p_4c811ddf87658dde", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 72, "text": "儉、欽進不得鬥，退恐壽春見襲，不得歸，計窮不知所為。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "8ff6a3db6d366e789b0421e4ff3db96846d682a1699a47ca42f671b072e6d886"}

{"id": "p_1f29c273d90b9bdb", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 73, "text": "淮南將士，家皆在北，眾心沮散，降者相屬，惟淮南新附農民為之用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "b75f0634241655ca5acb4ab2fd64c7596db4ee6b634ca046d75f1c270ec9798a"}

{"id": "p_ece397812d14b676", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 74, "text": "大將軍遣兗州刺史鄧艾督泰山諸軍萬餘人至樂嘉，示弱以誘之，大將軍尋自洙至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "11827e26308d226326e9f354fcfb98958118d83932ff3f8d434cebab268a8d33"}

{"id": "p_134d59532b79e331", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 75, "text": "欽不知，果夜來欲襲艾等，會明，見大軍兵馬盛，乃引還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "5d61aa6be33f94b5f26e5ac122fa487feae0aa5703803e585bd989131b6c854a"}

{"id": "p_e37b018031aaffa9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 76, "text": "大將軍縱驍騎追擊，大破之，欽遁走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "bbb298bbcb63196f4f2d82815258b6a68edd32fd7cb6912acdaf5e28cc0cf0bb"}

{"id": "p_9b98465375e88f68", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 77, "text": "是日，儉聞欽戰敗，恐懼夜走，眾潰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "9900071afcdc3c6f1d656bd8cb299a6dc34ff36c705a6aface0bba7bd4a8cdd8"}

{"id": "p_2c09943eae24976c", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 78, "text": "比至慎縣，左右人兵稍棄儉去，儉獨與小弟秀及孫重藏水邊草中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "bfeeca92ccab0cdd156f4af8a69261cfe4ded5957ba745fa6464cec13c174e95"}

{"id": "p_160c87c14624c52e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 79, "text": "安風津都尉部民張屬就射殺儉，傳首京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "5d1f50090807607c9de91bc674c3f8c195a1418026e219c8c50c28c2caadbf18"}

{"id": "p_e944e660892840dc", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 80, "text": "將士諸為儉、欽所迫脅者，悉歸降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "124f8a62fdae1d8692565acfacf85fc755627ae736b93f583ba93fc240306373"}

{"id": "p_5b18bf4efe14ed62", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 81, "text": "儉子甸為治書侍御史，先時知儉謀將發，私出將家屬逃走新安靈山上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "6da8b124be630dd8017261181111da9ba0d30e523e13f88fee291750ede68424"}

{"id": "p_6167f10bea06bebc", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 82, "text": "欽亡入吳，吳以欽為都護、假節、鎮北大將軍、幽州牧、譙侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "9134e6abb6b5094f3ebac3369c2f722e7f8f5e96c5a5c526290aff738bff23c8"}

{"id": "p_1dd38de61227268c", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 83, "text": "諸葛誕字公休，琅邪陽都人，諸葛豐後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "32163198091f0b5bbbc3523953d1ccafaa59eb96741e921271ad75f8ea292cc4"}

{"id": "p_1d4162b3fbf67855", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 84, "text": "初以尚書郎為滎陽令，入為吏部郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "f9aeaf3af13b59f0095541534a54d0745b4b41088a942ed291f78950cb4ab6f3"}

{"id": "p_ce912d5528a759d5", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 85, "text": "人有所屬託，輒顯其言而承用之，後有當否，則公議其得失以為褒貶，自是群僚莫不慎其所舉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "0ad734f8f515846b889b6813b917fc8379ccedf8fb5a67153e6a728dd51d7ea2"}

{"id": "p_0041bec7061420ca", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 86, "text": "累遷御史中丞尚書，與夏侯玄、鄧颺等相善，收名朝廷，京都翕然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "1c127b4c5c05173f52eb1d55373293c7c05f423933387a8fa3b3ce48113291ff"}

{"id": "p_3bccbb1b8b395458", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 87, "text": "言事者以誕、颺等脩浮華，合虛譽，漸不可長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "9edd5989fdd4da817e6d584b43dc7b3ffe38c681924d1827d3b204690b43d951"}

{"id": "p_312af794a316ecfd", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 88, "text": "會帝崩，正始初，玄等並在職。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "62f8814c4b776ab85ee417a2fe2379775ac1a9476782d30ea6e97fcf72bee642"}

{"id": "p_ee576d21af36512f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 89, "text": "復以誕為御史中丞尚書，出為揚州刺史，加昭武將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "f7a8cc89d6e34fc2480458a8dddef22556946686aa438f8d97aed00765f43d49"}

{"id": "p_9ba6642ee1aaa0c7", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 90, "text": "王凌之陰謀也，太傅司馬宣王潛軍東伐，以誕為鎮東將軍、假節都督揚州諸軍事，封山陽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "f4bdc03ce078ecf511d9747a0f04d07b9fa396a7fc3b4183cebc35b1e347721b"}

{"id": "p_19418e2f82c3255e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 91, "text": "諸葛恪興東關，遣誕督諸軍討之，與戰，不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "1400972aad8467ec4d924965051170d87df4490f0ec8de688fa23bd9d341d7e8"}

{"id": "p_8d0b90fe58f36866", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 92, "text": "後毌丘儉、文欽反，遣使詣誕，招呼豫州士民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "b819e3f46e24b0b7216184d662796190699d7ad16f1d1b2b84832fc3a73b0110"}

{"id": "p_5c58cbca82b0e73b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 93, "text": "誕斬其使，露布天下，令知儉、欽凶逆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "84f144388c2a8c467d4f369a7c4d49d2bdd153745e5e0e01da15bfa1761659a5"}

{"id": "p_61cb559f84ee4754", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 94, "text": "大將軍司馬景王東征，使誕督豫州諸軍，渡安風津向壽春。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "6574d2e9640c4333885f9415bfaa9b9aae760e27f5068edc5905f0f114cf26ab"}

{"id": "p_9472149c3daa2493", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 95, "text": "儉、欽之破也，誕先至壽春。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "1f918cec53edb2b77d1a118a61d6282a68ec5f68070d61fc5d9b027a82f34179"}

{"id": "p_77f3bbe3c2b725c6", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 96, "text": "壽春中十餘萬口，聞儉、欽敗，恐誅，悉破城門出，流迸山澤，或散走入吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "74f2bb71ceddf3528e2cb8a53ec09eb6d25f1f0989110b611aa00cd0ebbb333c"}

{"id": "p_5f30ea79fea44c17", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 97, "text": "以誕久在淮南，乃復以為鎮東大將軍、儀同三司、都督揚州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "35c32355c0fa2fd667b8ff65194c939a232dab5014e92b4dfbb9cae333f2d1fb"}

{"id": "p_b9c335721470e767", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 98, "text": "吳大將孫峻、呂據、留贊等聞淮南亂，會文欽往，乃帥眾將欽徑至壽春；時誕諸軍已至，城不可攻，乃走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "768293d28500947ef5c29cd61b52c0603c385d87bf21cb410e75c6cd6f816712"}

{"id": "p_0382b4a0fe4aff06", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 99, "text": "誕遣將軍蔣班追擊之，斬贊，傳首，收其印節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "0e2b2e945b223048e3457446d6844a770d376840088e53d3a813e460759e988c"}

{"id": "p_3f337eebb96772db", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 100, "text": "進封高平侯，邑三千五百戶，轉為征東大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "3ed99730fca1bc18c2125dabecc671e474f846e5126fd20da66f5e28c4e1b11e"}

{"id": "p_2dad7bd2d873b0df", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 101, "text": "誕既與玄、颺等至親，又王凌、毌丘儉累見夷滅，懼不自安，傾帑藏振施以結眾心，厚養親附及揚州輕俠者數千人為死士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "e85b09e508b5acc6bc4d4ef7f79909dfb34e650a4fe25cc9491dcf8751fcbeda"}

{"id": "p_8d0203030d630ef3", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 102, "text": "冬，吳賊欲向徐堨，計誕所督兵馬足以待之，而復請十萬眾守壽春，又求臨淮築城以備寇，內欲保有淮南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "9f4a7db54810420a91cfe5e4e16a88b28d655d207b631127a1368416103107de"}

{"id": "p_f830fc06d1f4b99a", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 103, "text": "朝廷微知誕有自疑心，以誕舊臣，欲入度之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "8bdf333effb845225070f121b90584934eeff43b99efa66e1b5cf73c0a22b4e9"}

{"id": "p_80936805e6f42d3e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 104, "text": "召會諸將，自出攻揚州刺史樂綝，殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "3bd3ee36fd407afad4ac2c236b6a597863c0bbf82de5c477a63da0967847ac30"}

{"id": "p_153142f2bcef8467", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 105, "text": "斂淮南及淮北郡縣屯田口十餘萬官兵，揚州新附勝兵者四五萬人，聚谷足一年食，閉城自守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "9383cd8835255af94529e483941cddfb92a32691d431aee58d8e83955ce42699"}

{"id": "p_c612103c08b97462", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 106, "text": "遣長史吳綱將小子靚至吳請救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "b48eb3f2b027ba2156a5117282c6899203b27e3c4e027e5da202ef17d2b5c338"}

{"id": "p_1bfa72b2f8abe846", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 107, "text": "吳人大喜，遣將全懌、全端、唐咨、王祚等，率三萬眾，密與文欽俱來應誕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "37705d4fffa28e036e2ca1d9296d224caf17b03b86f8c13d34f7b8ae5a83f074"}

{"id": "p_167a6f1b1182839d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 108, "text": "以誕為左都護、假節、大司徒、驃騎將軍、青州牧、壽春侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "4efc3d8b1ad058d12ea390cfe51bd622a2849e14157c5e7363d3303452fa014d"}

{"id": "p_b9f3bdbf86e7a6e1", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 109, "text": "是時鎮南將軍王基始至，督諸軍圍壽春，未合。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "2509641a0df22c85b89fcb0edb126666002640fa633aa666987d7c3d098f9749"}

{"id": "p_174cde84dd3e03a4", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 110, "text": "咨、欽等從城東北，因山乘險，得將其眾突入城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "5792a55637015b05584efb764056192b63196485c0f3e4c1e6e0fbaa134dcb74"}

{"id": "p_02334a51d52a64b7", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 111, "text": "大將軍司馬文王督中外諸軍二十六萬眾，臨淮討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "24f6996b04f046ca166085e093cf515fab141100244dc15d5cb0415c9a746601"}

{"id": "p_c28d774ec01ef668", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 112, "text": "使基及安東將軍陳騫等四面合圍，表裡再重，塹壘甚峻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "3a549beb353decaf799c354f415712d5489f1f35425f2d7edcd30ec3f081c9b9"}

{"id": "p_ba4049e47ffe8915", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 113, "text": "又使監軍石苞、兗州刺史州泰等，簡銳卒為遊軍，備外寇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "d5fba12bd92cb8da84bdf3a0ef39bfd056c1dbf01f5352962af4d1e0b082b096"}

{"id": "p_04d7b4dbf6b10f96", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 114, "text": "欽等數出犯圍，逆擊走之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "25e24790fb2628e29194ce944476c3bcfe5cf8e16f3d5ecaf0cad976954efd6b"}

{"id": "p_21f49ab4546ef0fe", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 115, "text": "吳將朱異再以大眾來迎誕等，渡黎漿水，泰等逆與戰，每摧其鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "c678db0f6fce3c52a1c307a91f9090ed4beeda5879df681ad674dabee6bdb17d"}

{"id": "p_72d0e81c398a3245", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 116, "text": "孫綝以異戰不進，怒而殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "e9d42cb05358208301656ddfa73fa1a486eb0756d34ec8018e1de9035b5cc76b"}

{"id": "p_b6cf87924b68177d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 117, "text": "城中食轉少，外救不至，眾無所恃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "fd487f2bd8252429f2e6c5c37c395d878a6dbbc8d7d25461f957bd10860886ba"}

{"id": "p_641a45eb5c49ddc9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 118, "text": "將軍蔣班、焦彝，皆誕爪牙計事者也，棄誕，逾城自歸大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "ae159e898d79c86d68a3214d5b0b7bef0032b1a9d34551d0400239d64a9f43b9"}

{"id": "p_414ea371625d045b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 119, "text": "大將軍乃使反間，以奇變說全懌等，懌等率眾數千人開門來出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "b590fc7a4296b27a3a75ac6d579cb9c0d5a8354ebdea025f836564332fb86667"}

{"id": "p_69245d8fcc63f7d1", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 120, "text": "三年正月，誕、欽、咨等大為攻具，晝夜五六日攻南圍，欲決圍而出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "d1a58a56bddcd7e5636eddc056e83084ad888c5bbc2af72190a2e4d0265269dd"}

{"id": "p_631568a4a506c0b4", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 121, "text": "圍上諸軍，臨高以發石車火箭逆燒破其攻具，弩矢及石雨下，死傷者蔽地，血流盈塹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "a7ff86c1b0ff80b97bf9d9df7dadcd16a5ea5762644603806fb2787280a85cbc"}

{"id": "p_46f7385a222edcfd", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 122, "text": "復還入城，城內食轉竭，降出者數万口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "90200783ba9adc46a75f4af8841c3bd063f987bbb217c049362c18abb99928ce"}

{"id": "p_b1b1d22505cd9ec9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 123, "text": "欽欲盡出北方人，省食，與吳人堅守，誕不聽，由是爭恨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "d92ebbafd2bbd04e23d47451ad680da6b180ed6bc37850e9d3b71bac1fc7e269"}

{"id": "p_15af777e8a5e8d90", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 124, "text": "欽素與誕有隙，徒以計合，事急愈相疑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "eb3d453d073117d5214dd4a7d837d757372ba21dc3c8c57ca1ff7aa276b55f80"}

{"id": "p_ad2a68ab259ca323", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 125, "text": "欽子鴦及虎將兵在小城中，聞欽死，勒兵馳赴之，眾不為用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "3a8d5c3c571411a74af1baa78495be97d119729b37651cbaa9828b3b8dfe2b79"}

{"id": "p_8f4c685186fdc783", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 126, "text": "鴦、虎單走，逾城出，自歸大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "2ba11d96b1a38f507fceed2a64682efde5bdc76243e6a2baa5343ecd61a2b18f"}

{"id": "p_d3ac91b58d06343d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 127, "text": "軍吏請誅之，大將軍令曰：「欽之罪不容誅，其子固應當戮，然鴦、虎以窮歸命，且城未拔，殺之是堅其心也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "64f6fad37f1e9ead2a6636db3b2139b2ab2daf0e4fc7cdf31c01432ba3e9b853"}

{"id": "p_5a06a0ea889606b8", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 128, "text": "」乃赦鴦、虎，使將兵數百騎馳巡城，呼語城內云：「文欽之子猶不見殺，其餘何懼？", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "8d87288e1cc4164ec809bb33dd06b041d65f1061a49195e1e75c781acaa73224"}

{"id": "p_975f6564a0be64e9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 129, "text": "」表鴦、虎為將軍，各賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "9ff492d8f46588f6b176ecb07f42057e39d521121abdbc914010e2e3086d4086"}

{"id": "p_12126c86a873bca7", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 130, "text": "城內喜且擾，又日飢困，誕、咨等智力窮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "f058790e1658816dc0139f5f6d6860698f511e60fe6398e82e2b56d9858687b7"}

{"id": "p_3978a2bda0621fbd", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 131, "text": "大將軍乃自臨圍，四面進兵，同時鼓譟登城，城內無敢動者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "b823e5c97f32bab55a902a879078de5d1165396ba08999e904e7741af5527047"}

{"id": "p_5f950fa80617cef2", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 132, "text": "誕窘急，單乘馬，將其麾下突小城門出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "cdb7dc7b4aaa738496621f57939466988fba367da739908a272852f8af652489"}

{"id": "p_7837a159d00210ea", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 133, "text": "大將軍司馬胡奮部兵逆擊，斬誕，傳首，夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "c65cdc85d2e3e4c1246e917baf03f09d40c4a4233486ba1a5f1401d6f4a9617e"}

{"id": "p_6483c4e0a02ce23d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 134, "text": "誕麾下數百人，坐不降見斬，皆曰：「為諸葛公死，不恨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "eae7dccc9f0cdf9fdab42cb300f044a372a2e0866f1ef483d70ffe50b849ff00"}

{"id": "p_943d490e61fb0ae9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 135, "text": "唐咨、王祚及諸裨將皆面縛降，吳兵萬眾，器仗軍實山積。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "bd65e1c20ed9dada22e278a1f4e209fd29146db9f1d0d914518bdb64b38dc0a7"}

{"id": "p_958ed8397fa517d2", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 136, "text": "初圍壽春，議者多欲急攻之，大將軍以為：「城固而眾多，攻之必力屈，若有外寇，表裡受敵，此危道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "782c92ca551137078095434e697d82c53ec08e76e16409dbd12e3e23f4036a3b"}

{"id": "p_4c2c40b27e8919f7", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 137, "text": "今三叛相聚於孤城之中，天其或者將使同就戮，吾當以全策縻之，可坐而制也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "74b364fd2c7aa617340940b850bad6b57e7cf40e64fe8f085482858f20d216fe"}

{"id": "p_f360725b8f376f86", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 138, "text": "」誕以二年五月反，三年二月破滅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "d02bde3cd5c70ed45be093893c09817d618d5fdba1d0f2dad5cbd6d8c7eaa5ab"}

{"id": "p_0ac59cb317a45dc2", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 139, "text": "六軍按甲，深溝高壘，而誕自困，竟不煩攻而克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "792d6f3d191ac77df8ee2894f4d173f9e543afa7d5b40f4a599ec1ca5690f31a"}

{"id": "p_c59fe23d9b1c7a63", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 140, "text": "及破壽春，議者又以為淮南仍為叛逆，吳兵室家在江南，不可縱，宜悉坑之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "f568bb7a3428b93a81860d3f5d86f06c1f50a9c9766544ea57c5a3ecf33bf982"}

{"id": "p_06d84392e0076bed", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 141, "text": "大將軍以為古之用兵，全國為上，戮其元惡而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "bd604035e205982499552957422f4b2e96a501d39947b51d2f605ec96adc88ca"}

{"id": "p_707d2dc80a0bd8a3", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 142, "text": "吳兵就得亡還，適可以示中國之弘耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "e3b11ffe6e659c97c8f4bdc09ec46cfb5815ad9932f9879c0b97f89ce9e3dd35"}

{"id": "p_c303ba79b524d431", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 143, "text": "一無所殺，分佈三河近郡以安處之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "015a263d9f539a79466cc30bc072edb85210544024167daba35c2d96eba06083"}

{"id": "p_808fab4d1e04bbae", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 144, "text": "黃初中，利城郡反，殺太守徐箕，推咨為主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "70a279f58926aaec34f28e17c3a2434ddec90e4a0bb2b487f842043e4d2a35db"}

{"id": "p_3dcf542e372cb345", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 145, "text": "文帝遣諸軍討破之，咨走入海，遂亡至吳，官至左將軍，封侯、持節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "f9e05a232456c752b4329f4f254d6204cdb6777d61467f6061ea1ce5f02f5271"}

{"id": "p_738c74b760c79d64", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 146, "text": "誕、欽屠戮，咨亦生禽，三叛皆獲，天下快焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "2cd8fc5474034f2bc3b6c23589366d7da8400c2205e9df7905ae0d1efe1fcb37"}

{"id": "p_5d2f58f485efd7d3", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 147, "text": "拜咨安遠將軍，其餘裨將咸假號位，吳眾悅服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "b4fee0d2a37cdcbf1c787d340f5dbb859363ce83b82414de7cfff6240e39708a"}

{"id": "p_0fba03624954dd18", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 148, "text": "其淮南將吏士民諸為誕所脅略者，惟誅其首逆，餘皆赦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "fd21798d891f40ec083707ccd5537ec49403f7e6c1abaf14e9cbc426ff0037a9"}

{"id": "p_83469d037655ab64", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 149, "text": "聽鴦、虎收斂欽喪，給其車牛，致葬舊墓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "be97693f373139dede5f3246d42f4cae9ccf6f23d8b992df2a4a5c9cfa46f4de"}

{"id": "p_7adabdb759f0721f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 150, "text": "鄧艾字士載，義陽棘陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "03d4eba33bbf3b2597fb0eaad2f0f9b5e572ba1eab9f9a2962a3942da64b0f7f"}

{"id": "p_ca2957cff99b5fac", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 151, "text": "少孤，太祖破荊州，徙汝南，為農民養犢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "9b2907c9fde6325cd419ea020417483ca3f0fb6d6af1beaec6530942a8b32080"}

{"id": "p_09697e598c808f9f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 152, "text": "年十二，隨母至潁川，讀故太丘長陳寔碑文，言「文為世範，行為士則」，艾遂自名範，字士則。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "759a9a42ef33c65db4a552f10e52682ae0aa315f39bad3071e5e7fcd11acaf6a"}

{"id": "p_4283a4c0d8a1d7a5", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 153, "text": "後宗族有與同者，故改焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "1ff6d671bb858a62d594e24352170a13304bd60816bf437f03b45546a744ae62"}

{"id": "p_87ceab6edd21b964", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 154, "text": "為都尉學士，以口吃，不得作幹佐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "b7b6784b462f017ec3c2e695c70105c55435cf5aba0439b86190fdd6a7ea0951"}

{"id": "p_0ad8d44315cb662a", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 155, "text": "同郡吏父憐其家貧，資給甚厚，艾初不稱謝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "65b077e9eb6a29b2f1f57212115c5b19a75462189ecb3437f7b7374d872bed24"}

{"id": "p_32684305b56a0ee7", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 156, "text": "每見高山大澤，輒規度指畫軍營處所，時人多笑焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "28ae169867b05b065526d4c898eed4424afaff8757d1b3a6cab1645022646cc5"}

{"id": "p_f7c5efff7d09c481", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 157, "text": "後為典農綱紀，上計吏，因使見太尉司馬宣王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "858268cc327d51e1541702c928de36da65d59b11fb42e3dfc05973998fbd42a1"}

{"id": "p_a69390d09718e864", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 158, "text": "宣王奇之，辟之為掾，遷尚書郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "6e5dcb9bd9a659cfe60bf87e707c4233a7505465fedc1f63c387f56a6c5065ff"}

{"id": "p_2811484a1579b6f5", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 159, "text": "時欲廣田畜谷，為滅賊資，使艾行陳、項已東至壽春。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "07f07dc80820161cd3e6473c8b1720068b9e6937404a5ac70498651badeab501"}

{"id": "p_b511534062dc875f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 160, "text": "艾以為「田良水少，不足以盡地利，宜開河渠，可以引水澆溉，大積軍糧，又通運漕之道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "c3fb724d6f7dc21e0a9526927f985edcf0d91d34b17d17b73af28e7b9b8af819"}

{"id": "p_48b4e70ffbf58bb5", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 161, "text": "又以為「昔破黃巾，因為屯田，積穀於許都以制四方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "cda462de58ff4ee0302023dd1026cd15a20c84fab5df23c603804bddd0c85945"}

{"id": "p_f1a8b4f1993c0092", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 162, "text": "今三隅已定，事在淮南，每大軍征舉，運兵過半，功費巨億，以為大役。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "b3698b173eb9c08d0ae357cc5bf1385f758afc8ec3fff1f075f23fd604e8bb86"}

{"id": "p_6c5d1ec398fdf2f7", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 163, "text": "陳、蔡之間，土下田良，可省許昌左右諸稻田，並水東下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "2126d18499eb4eec0f4bce31c28750cfecbc81311ca5abca8e882c8af1e2157a"}

{"id": "p_adefb35863183769", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 164, "text": "令淮北屯二萬人，淮南三萬人，十二分休，常有四萬人，且田且守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "e514f0c9d475f01222d26fa001c85f46627288355e655c4859a9f5385ce4c19b"}

{"id": "p_cc25a4fc424f6d98", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 165, "text": "水豐常收三倍於西，計除眾費，歲完五百萬斛以為軍資。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "bb8319777bc08f2c04dc6917416a8fa46507cf1e03e7270beb34f3842c70b9dd"}

{"id": "p_d364976f4d430af5", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 166, "text": "六七年間，可積三千萬斛於淮上，此則十萬之眾五年食也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "fca962ef7bfcb91ad832d3efbdcfaa04029486eac247a4381bf86050b7143c50"}

{"id": "p_8ab04f65dd5fcfbf", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 167, "text": "以此乘吳，無往而不克矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "5b62515a708e70d6e0e97d173412042889fd2a43394f200b6cb35a25bd3b7243"}

{"id": "p_8e8549aa01b50d3b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 168, "text": "，乃開廣漕渠，每東南有事，大軍興眾，汎舟而下，達於江、淮，資食有儲而無水害，艾所建也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "f0ab1e68ccadbbbe8963d2b361ee7a11657e16994b00ded42aef3753da413c31"}

{"id": "p_ace237547db4fc57", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 169, "text": "出參征西軍事，遷南安太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "490ad2911e031765363303c3f3b54976eede415a94ebc97468e7b1fcdf71d8f7"}

{"id": "p_725c86f6a34cf2b0", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 170, "text": "，與征西將軍郭淮拒蜀偏將軍姜維。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "24106be14093a41303a049eb1ada88252344232b0e1c569b89297eb2cab332c5"}

{"id": "p_f2fe37f8880023ff", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 171, "text": "艾曰：「賊去未遠，或能復還，宜分諸軍以備不虞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "63f39746287919860839221a89c379e39c7e02b9267eeefc9eb036517ddbad44"}

{"id": "p_487def2ea8c13016", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 172, "text": "三日，維遣廖化自白水南向艾結營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "2dd95e45207d6245124701bd1da37b3bfad9d951a456df310a47a91ccdcd80d7"}

{"id": "p_1b007a201c33579d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 173, "text": "艾謂諸將曰：「維今卒還，吾軍人少，法當來渡而不作橋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "5f21dcad6ec98aa37c0085a5e7ca3bb0ebfed78c2fb82f07b1dc536f26f51c78"}

{"id": "p_920990de3861d1b8", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 174, "text": "此維使化持吾，令不得還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "0ec38f8b4434ce6cce9ca2232141ec8e08a3a6eb8e65728f296575e28a31636c"}

{"id": "p_fbd06753740b4c2b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 175, "text": "」洮城在水北，去艾屯六十里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "a71abc3818b1900294c8e98a93ab749022759296f4c964e28e64e96501c5b16d"}

{"id": "p_c7e368bdd133ff91", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 176, "text": "艾即夜潛軍徑到，維果來渡，而艾先至據城，得以不敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "8ebc4c26d0c4dc560a36daadbad18e5e17268fafba6ab4e2ca5db3fe1f0bcbb1"}

{"id": "p_5f7f5eed430e8e99", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 177, "text": "賜爵關內侯，加討寇將軍，後遷城陽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "c9e08d788797ed746bdfb25a8d1b96912d676eeb84f3ea8c7ee55de76e790bda"}

{"id": "p_92054e6d190b4e7b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 178, "text": "是時并州右賢王劉豹並為一部，艾上言曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "a2b01f178b85673432dbf360b50125bfb5ef0b5c47573254944f6a92aa86cca8"}

{"id": "p_23fd8fb6c760a791", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 179, "text": "又陳：“羌胡與民同處者，宜以漸出之，使居民表崇廉恥之教，塞姦宄之路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "ed1d8df90c01ea693ee70f29f0820d3528443158997364c60fcb6284b12adc27"}

{"id": "p_e69112e8d3492f8b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 180, "text": "”大將軍司馬景王新輔政，多納用焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "49bbffdbf507001d3a0cb5713d06798331db660bfd56386580d5048d239b6644"}

{"id": "p_150f11b076d3ac09", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 181, "text": "遷汝南太守，至則尋求昔所厚己吏父，久已死，遣吏祭之，重遺其母，舉其子與計吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "9240e83e3d74e3d5657e2ee2dc23ccab072557fe4f24f3c19b037a0c1d7c9c49"}

{"id": "p_8b11627ccdb37b74", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 182, "text": "艾所在，荒野開闢，軍民並豐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "e05f20a5be16c4bcc084efc22442f8fdadc63b1b2527c843d2f4f6ea79b2701f"}

{"id": "p_499204f4a85ff53d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 183, "text": "諸葛恪圍合肥新城，不克，退歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "cfdd8128dec1e01e370e10f6dcec587cdb2e64db5b3bff6e742d0c8bc5a6a11c"}

{"id": "p_11a79d4f7a0b765d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 184, "text": "艾言景王曰：「孫權已沒，大臣未附，吳名宗大族，皆有部曲，阻兵仗勢，足以建命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "eab87dc92633955033da492de9c9ef23acff9dee5bad529ba7092bb15bc253fd"}

{"id": "p_8409cf2e160695ee", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 185, "text": "恪新秉國政，而內無其主，不念撫恤上下以立根基，競於外事，虐用其民，悉國之眾，頓於堅城，死者萬數，載禍而歸，此恪獲罪之日也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "d953f7d5be1ca3aceedd20fb3dfa5596242b5e18f96f0577bf9a7165d62eba53"}

{"id": "p_d407d59164e6fd53", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 186, "text": "昔子胥、吳起、商鞅、樂毅皆見任時君，主沒而敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "c51853efe3398b1baf2602e7a5e7d7afc3d6399a4ed5adeaa156a1de56341268"}

{"id": "p_37af2d0a97f8e4ec", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 187, "text": "況恪才非四賢，而不慮大患，其亡可待也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "05e0b915f4f2bedee501c92cc2d2ef44ca03618e7931759b7889e31ecb48a082"}

{"id": "p_c480a4c8506312c7", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 188, "text": "遷兗州刺史，加振威將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "ebc5c0ec5bb24cecba8cc04510248d0679577082d0c1eee65335d8afffe6a881"}

{"id": "p_45c5ccfc9a8c992e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 189, "text": "上言曰：「國之所急，惟農與戰，國富則兵強，兵強則戰勝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "e9b7c7ec761d208727db91981148761054dfa3b2c0a3dc81a13f0fb005d8ff89"}

{"id": "p_4d898a00975e5aa1", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 190, "text": "孔子曰『足食足兵』，食在兵前也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "7bf65d13622a39fb539f9a31dafae852d58908f4435d212ec4966e1090c15419"}

{"id": "p_2d96367b03cc23d4", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 191, "text": "上無設爵之勸，則下無財畜之功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "9bc2a39ed4f398e3eb25146a387cb816afc8c4d1f80eaed171c9f389f7d4e27b"}

{"id": "p_553648ae1b2cf76a", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 192, "text": "今使考績之賞，在於積粟富民，則交遊之路絕，浮華之原塞矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "f0150e4a10209927d07535d9ac1afec8406ca993aa759cd6c7dd3f74ea20d3cf"}

{"id": "p_43c05ec441c3cf88", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 193, "text": "高貴鄉公即尊位，進封方城亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "977736651f7d3f19742c4e00952de3807e6d6e62e41c383040caa60291c6ceaa"}

{"id": "p_3b428935cf79e9df", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 194, "text": "毌丘儉作亂，遣健步齎書，欲疑惑大眾，艾斬之，兼道進軍，先趣樂嘉城，作浮橋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "f0203b2ed22309c42e3723e07d41ba65c4dcb937cfa50c8ec17e0bdbe96405ba"}

{"id": "p_7ac09cd787c093d0", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 195, "text": "文欽以後大軍破敗於城下，艾追之至丘頭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "f4fe908e7479bf870051285aa81546214fdcc54724d463e0208a7917c1fc481f"}

{"id": "p_df7ea30ab3b03161", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 196, "text": "吳大將軍孫峻等號十萬眾，將渡江，鎮東將軍諸葛誕遣艾據肥陽，艾以與賊勢相遠，非要害之地，輒移屯附亭，遣泰山太守諸葛緒等於黎漿拒戰，遂走之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "e12365e3fe140804ed86a5928e23c1ff74b6adbe7cbf47a3d2a7bfa6f0a4bba4"}

{"id": "p_276392d6e43c0a51", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 197, "text": "以破欽等功，進封方城鄉侯，行安西將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "90d90afee0b3d7f2d2a884cd3ad506559a8227d22ea4e12468a42813d27b553a"}

{"id": "p_ae8f1b4b995917db", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 198, "text": "解雍州刺史王經圍於狄道，姜維退駐鍾提，乃以艾為安西將軍，假節、領護東羌校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "5cc53fbbc143143a236bfc2485ab926c34ea6801b7c912278f5e76a0b8cd2f09"}

{"id": "p_516fb22322377d9f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 199, "text": "議者多以為維力已竭，未能更出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "bfe5eed18bc283b0198cae20c904477a6757bc628f0439a189887d83b42d0d01"}

{"id": "p_1f20b290a99b9098", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 200, "text": "頃之，維果向祁山，聞艾已有備，乃回從董亭趣南安，艾據武城山以相持。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "b2fafbcf179b9ffaf34a06be17ddc2f8b58048d27e7d399854a4b725f997f944"}

{"id": "p_248af16ac250d917", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 201, "text": "維與艾爭險，不克，其夜，渡渭東行，緣山趣上邽，艾與戰於段谷，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "4e35ce0d307c985fb8286b0e49a64aa591168058411a775afd1ff83ca1577634"}

{"id": "p_4cf846e5e1b4fb97", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 202, "text": "詔曰：「逆賊姜維連年狡黠，民夷騷動，西土不寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "d0b88b423bed4fd88194ea769e5349c13db5c4da61bda7c5ab338e846a77231d"}

{"id": "p_31138549f5f4516d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 203, "text": "艾籌畫有方，忠勇奮發，斬將十數，馘首千計；國威震於巴、蜀，武聲揚於江、岷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "ce9a22fc9b6444cf2d102e9732672776b892399def17e2e1eff073938a0b3808"}

{"id": "p_d6718752ab699908", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 204, "text": "今以艾為鎮西將軍、都督隴右諸軍事，進封鄧侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "15e3c6033a5a068363103ec24e4b96747a333b1f2b9e5f09145eaef6f93c5e5a"}

{"id": "p_8ed5d1413e32232f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 205, "text": "」二年，拒姜維於長城，維退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "6382b7bc391da85ed5d0d536958b0a9a0482c034fab86e8e3717afde5232adab"}

{"id": "p_99d7a212daaeffa3", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 206, "text": "遷征西將軍，前後增邑凡六千六百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "6b5be1533fdad14f1ad80e3a5d2d1e5dfccd424721c5cc708f7e4bf28295fb88"}

{"id": "p_de121931fc0733d9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 207, "text": "，又破維於侯和，維卻保沓中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "30d3206b02761b433d906cf1f0d762609712c62a8ae4e01e0132f4f9984b7979"}

{"id": "p_1f086696816e24a9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 208, "text": "四年秋，詔諸軍征蜀，大將軍司馬文王皆指授節度，使艾與維相綴連；雍州刺史諸葛緒要維，令不得歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "e3234bc4d69b2a89f784be21faf10efa4e0a4aae2cf7eba9ff0646e61311f274"}

{"id": "p_22a60078263ad5dd", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 209, "text": "艾遣天水太守王頎等直攻維營，隴西太守牽弘等邀其前，金城太守楊欣等詣甘松。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "a3c17812a107d5a70f9fe7a4131e0c43bd1bbba3ef865dfb9fc6baafc03908ac"}

{"id": "p_6ec437e64e0371e7", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 210, "text": "維聞鍾會諸軍已入漢中，引退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "b6f140297cee77b2b4b7e2660224424b9b20e9a60a480fe88dcf15e86d3efc72"}

{"id": "p_cd19da0d80584217", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 211, "text": "欣等追躡於強川口，大戰，維敗走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "e8edd47ca723879562f5db1efdb1850c0b0111b0833cc274b448ddafd81ec1e6"}

{"id": "p_5ab539405903af7f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 212, "text": "聞雍州已塞道屯橋頭，從孔函谷入北道，欲出雍州後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "775d01751e9dbe77be4489c121603067330bd568814be2dd41d2bb983901e412"}

{"id": "p_baa4dbe97253bcc0", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 213, "text": "諸葛緒聞之，卻還三十里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "1bb5930ab14c50c8887a02afcb5938e49addb545768deae573b3a6060d801a78"}

{"id": "p_0f1e8371a957b22b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 214, "text": "維入北道三十餘里，聞緒軍卻，尋還，從橋頭過，緒趣截維，較一日不及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "0226a3515fd99adcef0614846862d630f7a6fc214a03f97f7f4fe01be74c797e"}

{"id": "p_1ab639f7f51d3104", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 215, "text": "艾上言：「今賊摧折，宜遂乘之，從陰平由邪徑經漢德陽亭趣涪，出劍閣西百里，去成都三百餘里，奇兵衝其腹心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "6fc58a0b07973f2280e94e30b0518ff2bc881ec5a8327cb516ea03f207273504"}

{"id": "p_c8d0c1b3b228266e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 216, "text": "劍閣之守必還赴涪，則會方軌而進；劍閣之軍不還，則應涪之兵寡矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "66dccdfccee80dbfaabd5618d59fc5ca8f9411c9ecacb1bd78bdcae5b8310b55"}

{"id": "p_d6c677f79822a75b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 217, "text": "軍誌有之曰：『攻其無備，出其不意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "2ef4f1a8120e9095a20418763afa803abe521da33798a8dea05fbb5fffd2fe38"}

{"id": "p_5fc2cec23181e034", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 218, "text": "』今掩其空虛，破之必矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "21d835ab74b10e5310c309ab2fc0dfebdcfc602ae049db03f3665ba0ba3c78dc"}

{"id": "p_cc60230372f6650f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 219, "text": "冬十月，艾自陰平道行無人之地七百餘里，鑿山通道，造作橋閣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "cc247e61f4e8300db0e681318b4d4f2cbc0bb13994efc3e0601058205cb287ef"}

{"id": "p_4301c438bb383a99", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 220, "text": "山高谷深，至為艱險，又糧運將匱，頻於危殆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "8f582ca18fc9936caed37c1ee453e044db7eb9bc3ef8f7f864710f32528279f8"}

{"id": "p_371891f78d2c79f3", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 221, "text": "將士皆攀木緣崖，魚貫而進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "720f0477b2a2c9e35bb6730912ce5d0a1c106f4864f494cdaa375ca5975eaeea"}

{"id": "p_77669313f029b9b9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 222, "text": "先登至江由，蜀守將馬邈降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "1c0ddfe873042d899a4cd0ae42c8b8bef8364739179aa5401b7c92b8f905aeb4"}

{"id": "p_65f1fa1ef8b5934f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 223, "text": "蜀衛將軍諸葛瞻自涪還綿竹，列陳待艾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "efc533ee4eabfcfaf80dfa508a224b9bc003eca25e62b1ce410b9dab64eae362"}

{"id": "p_c28931fb4ad33383", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 224, "text": "艾遣子惠唐亭侯忠等出其右，司馬師纂等出其左。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "210848677fdc32ab017b750dc9e1acdacf47fc140d1383b275f66a872fbaecd3"}

{"id": "p_3d037e1fe4558271", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 225, "text": "忠、纂戰不利，並退還，曰：「賊未可擊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "85caa2af6d7e4d7e14ef38882f342f794f85cfa7b47732614507cf7a0f553666"}

{"id": "p_a9c748bfe6d1c7c9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 226, "text": "」艾怒曰：「存亡之分，在此一舉，何不可之有？", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "13df8d618c829d3173b0370dfd894e9fa544b8a7d2866789c426f0de1489b02d"}

{"id": "p_15b46d6d518e0a6d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 227, "text": "」乃叱忠、纂等，將斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "19707492daa1a876bb1ec7da65dcffb2fb268b4347a972c56e00f056661ebb50"}

{"id": "p_26cdddec88ed3bfb", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 228, "text": "忠、纂馳還更戰，大破之，斬瞻及尚書張遵等首，進軍到雒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "5f31e0134f34e4f4abdd1620437df16b70c8b9dbc07823fe6aa1d21db617f132"}

{"id": "p_d378293d5d4d6855", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 229, "text": "劉禪遣使奉皇帝璽綬，為箋詣艾請降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "31505d3c85a83dcd3591f2aa1506943e8ca11488579bf94c3a3be4ec7781285b"}

{"id": "p_fb8f8575305f153e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 230, "text": "艾至成都，禪率太子諸王及群臣六十餘人面縛輿櫬詣軍門，艾執節解縛焚櫬，受而宥之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "2c398443eeb7f9355d85166bce1d950aede346d392bd2a68d45e49be44974e34"}

{"id": "p_c25fa3560110c7d4", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 231, "text": "檢禦將士，無所虜略，綏納降附，使復舊業，蜀人稱焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "9e802720887392c5616e3723bb911a5a69277d7e160a3a71a6ff114f4812b41c"}

{"id": "p_79f2a76c2eeadade", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 232, "text": "輒依鄧禹故事，承制拜禪行驃騎將軍，太子奉車、諸王駙馬都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "7839eef1f10898a8595a4faf0770931819544b44b71e2643ea85c8ef4a79a22a"}

{"id": "p_682d73f91e8a4791", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 233, "text": "蜀群司各隨高下拜為王官，或領艾官屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "90a1f03823a461947f1429b1746bae4e448b58f854f57498d685f42647e13ce5"}

{"id": "p_b02dd1ffced5a5c3", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 234, "text": "以師纂領益州刺史，隴西太守牽弘等領蜀中諸郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "30b7ba7f7f454930ed5e13f5470866d3ea6c3e88ab3cbea9e3c3c60b1b4a1659"}

{"id": "p_03db8d90ddfc0a50", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 235, "text": "使於綿竹築臺以為京觀，用彰戰功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "d5c8333a2a0d51b9fd1610f39203e99a3c427897cc49eacd2dcd7cf723ab7478"}

{"id": "p_d4f49019e21816b8", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 236, "text": "士卒死事者，皆與蜀兵同共埋藏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "2f6ff93c3eabe95e23848fc014e444d0abd93677246a3c097b99c71831e76ea7"}

{"id": "p_44a752967893024e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 237, "text": "艾深自矜伐，謂蜀士大夫曰：「諸君賴遭某，故得有今日耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "45cfe75befeaa650d6dd16129753c22055f256a0c734d6cc73a584e0fcf9c15d"}

{"id": "p_482f72fe05faecd8", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 238, "text": "若遇吳漢之徒，已殄滅矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "02886ab8f33b15be75a2602563f05ab5bbe6884a19df03aa63e377ab4862c8c2"}

{"id": "p_81d2f968b0fa9592", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 239, "text": "」又曰：「姜維自一時雄兒也，與某相值，故窮耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "fc08a624537eb6b9b84b16d54d0d459ecfe2968e8e5079e9af839598f62cda34"}

{"id": "p_532f689a3500ff16", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 240, "text": "十二月，詔曰：「艾曜威奮武，深入虜庭，斬將搴旗，梟其鯨鯢，使僭號之主，稽首系頸，歷世逋誅，一朝而平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "ad0950e0d126c5205b4769b22f4094c171ee8ec4c4ad529c10d9e1ba8373698b"}

{"id": "p_25b4eb9996b5ce49", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 241, "text": "兵不逾時，戰不終日，雲徹席捲，盪定巴蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "2445408fcdb27f4277767c07dd5112cd30be9f039fe79e1eee2c114d3f018436"}

{"id": "p_0cb96bea27b1ed4e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 242, "text": "雖白起破強楚，韓信克勁趙，吳漢禽子陽，亞夫滅七國，計功論美，不足比勳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "53483629e5b3558d53bb350bca6bbc28f6e5ac9e6e4a2d179bac60d6f4426654"}

{"id": "p_3cb789f4bd173352", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 243, "text": "其以艾為太尉，增邑二萬戶，封子二人亭侯，各食邑千戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "9ef1ec5492921bd492e6368589a5e73bc01c84e26bedc897cb80c1fd8de6a63b"}

{"id": "p_f6f2e1a2377cc6eb", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 244, "text": "文王使監軍衛瓘喻艾：「事當須報，不宜輒行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "9ad015f2d325cc8e51dcf83d77fdb64af282a80a8430b104dc8c6814a4b4978d"}

{"id": "p_4c41d57dd1f016f2", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 245, "text": "」艾重言曰：「銜命征行，奉指授之策，元惡既服；至於承制拜假，以安初附，謂合權宜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "708278dd06dfbef807f463f0729b058ab6630600fcbd7f40b55123ee9f4c8497"}

{"id": "p_1643fb94e31c7052", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 246, "text": "今蜀舉眾歸命，地盡南海，東接吳會，宜早鎮定若待國命，往復道途，延引日月。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "fea6be454e4cb9613fbc10c7dfe828f80e3ae4d0326c74208dd1811596b20b78"}

{"id": "p_29104abe743ed6e1", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 247, "text": "春秋之義，大夫出疆，有可以安社稷，利國家，專之可也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "2e3f8b90198c4092a567f15aede11cf8d4dd925c05a3e9ef20860c574e0f1c62"}

{"id": "p_accb07ae78dc2f58", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 248, "text": "今吳未賓；勢與蜀連，不可拘常以失事機。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "8d6494d9f84ccb808f11547720147f0c27ddec24df64c874a199f58bc9a98671"}

{"id": "p_38914c4f6cc12ecc", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 249, "text": "兵法，進不求名，退不避罪，艾雖無古人之節，終不自嫌以損於國也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "96b0f86567abbb219199d2d59ee6c085268acee3467240822d5d36bedb01a106"}

{"id": "p_329a14fb32a146bc", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 250, "text": "」鍾會、胡烈、師纂等皆白艾所作悖逆，變釁以結。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "c3c7a9dc326335eeb2e1df3dd39df3bb6c15658caa72ecd4befc9596289a6600"}

{"id": "p_1827d5d67657fbab", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 251, "text": "艾父子既囚，鍾會至成都，先送艾，然後作亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "fe55c52079e02a2c8459da657d61f693b8aba8cedefa7b2211cf61b6e73dfd03"}

{"id": "p_b948453c79c83c09", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 252, "text": "會已死，艾本營將士追出艾檻車，迎還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "a8db1847dc24cf335ed1d4c438bc6d2db361618be30e84bcaca45cf55b852c99"}

{"id": "p_b2ccdabec7f5c6f8", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 253, "text": "瓘遣田續等討艾，遇於綿竹西，斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "0218da793d2f0fd055920ed2b4deb9b48fce46790bf3c635b980f9b8b10b0776"}

{"id": "p_5cfed7737acea71e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 254, "text": "子忠與艾俱死，餘子在洛陽者悉誅，徙艾妻子及孫於西域。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "b5da03ed2f5644907d2830961796163a09e88d75c9190a961d846871e119ee5f"}

{"id": "p_2c58a9b2097f193b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 255, "text": "初，艾當伐蜀，夢坐山上而有流水，以問殄虜護軍爰邵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "19ea58e1e057d38ef110e8fecfba8abc689e2ecef66548b0e597086cca291c5d"}

{"id": "p_0e2ec458e3033aca", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 256, "text": "邵曰：「按易卦，山上有水曰蹇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "9767626db14556b316431aee7c88822936cc9fc437ab4e597eee69b97cff2776"}

{"id": "p_2ccb6829841f6d34", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 257, "text": "蹇繇曰：『蹇利西南，不利東北。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "9facba0cf499b274b496ef21abfab4bcb44019dd96e1634b4e8227e77d205fb7"}

{"id": "p_11942b160ae18db5", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 258, "text": "』孔子曰：『蹇利西南，往有功也；不利東北，其道窮也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "fba39d8f2f8c57f73f88c485b3790613202a560ba3aa918ec935c607d1fc296e"}

{"id": "p_40004d7a3a3e036f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 259, "text": "，晉室踐阼，詔曰：「昔太尉王凌謀廢齊王，而王竟不足以守位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "6140d9d08a6b5d9e7f6835dfc1609f13e0e2ad015a528b093c3955ebeb455d83"}

{"id": "p_7e5014c7eecf3a3a", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 260, "text": "征西將軍鄧艾，矜功失節，實應大辟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "cd9e17a6c89849d5515a612e90caff0397039d3990eab6c5c8776ceccd6d9470"}

{"id": "p_6a0a7764a294d9cf", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 261, "text": "然被書之日，罷遣人眾，束手受罪，比於求生遂為惡者，誠復不同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "2381739eb0e49e539665b4502c2b03f5114b987ce798371bf376e8a215deac84"}

{"id": "p_b3182d49b79783b3", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 262, "text": "今大赦得還，若無子孫者聽使立後，令祭祀不絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "9fbf949ea84486599cffa3708bdf0a594c842d5a00fd69a46585a53cd77e4334"}

{"id": "p_76d1318c94cafbdb", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 263, "text": "」三年，議郎段灼上疏理艾曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "e14fc9dc034cd1167ad8360bf1db35dfa56352257602667e2442a8dc785361d5"}

{"id": "p_b8d0701465166038", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 264, "text": "九年，詔曰：「艾有功勳，受罪不逃刑，而子孫為民隸，朕常愍之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "11da2c023295415922f6187294729bded15a7b6e4c361986bb95a08c0b480893"}

{"id": "p_914d4a478e4a17f9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 265, "text": "艾在西時，修治障塞，築起城塢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "aadc578bf4587265868babc7fa2eca1f77cc77b5986e18c98442b63b18165f24"}

{"id": "p_d021855c25f66d5f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 266, "text": "泰始中，羌虜大叛，頻殺刺史，涼州道斷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "a7b61fbb25efe6d5b54e3112f1a4c1a66fc2ee367f0953c09a60ba513c2eba42"}

{"id": "p_630898b5100851ab", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 267, "text": "吏民安全者，皆保艾所築塢焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "ce45703a6fdeac0777722469248571b715bf06a989d7dc2d7e603dd3ebacb27c"}

{"id": "p_d2a0231a32272ebf", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 268, "text": "艾州里時輩南陽州泰，亦好立功業，善用兵，官至征虜將軍、假節都督江南諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "2d423e0c8e713a093551af861a3b55c4b3b6ce72cefcb540fb6cf664cf9f250c"}

{"id": "p_697e92bb1416aa06", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 269, "text": "薨，追贈衛將軍，諡曰壯侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "a730aff06a9a901ecba976dbb990a3c907c70c7a3bd095556298173d89994643"}

{"id": "p_1897972e23f32fec", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 270, "text": "鍾會字士季，潁川長社人，太傅繇小子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "9f945d470126913a92f68433fe63ad1a83aa3f403f533a722230911f704cd0c4"}

{"id": "p_6ad4a72fbe9ea5c0", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 271, "text": "中護軍蔣濟著論，謂「觀其眸子，足以知人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "aa5a2446db3d5b1d6c54c4e659a0cb511e3ee446fb75e9a5bda9b3f03cfa4a6c"}

{"id": "p_ee4ed7e440f5f484", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 272, "text": "」會年五歲，繇遣見濟，濟甚異之，曰：「非常人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "1bc99570640498a1e7537a8ebe3ac3fb5409db8c357e80ab1ce2af7fa15c16ae"}

{"id": "p_8c38d694318b7418", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 273, "text": "」及壯，有才數技藝，而博學精練名理，以夜續晝，由是獲聲譽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "e494a5878efa76d723d08c9d7873305dfb5e4e3555d426e8b47c670ad018e083"}

{"id": "p_34111c7ae51d08cb", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 274, "text": "正始中，以為秘書郎，遷尚書中書侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "fd3889b954ef1382cf4199390699e63e88e336b1e59be0011fc7214836ab8fe9"}

{"id": "p_1c71ca50fd68bb5f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 275, "text": "高貴鄉公即尊位，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "c9d27cae51d032ca56deb7673c7bcaaea3bb1bae29c9549728fbc5fd8f6e9768"}

{"id": "p_66d1b4dc88a85def", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 276, "text": "毌丘儉作亂，大將軍司馬景王東征，會從，典知密事，衛將軍司馬文王為大軍後繼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "e90cccaf52c54412de62f054c7c861fb9d275ce64c4ffd9c9eacae9bbd5f73c9"}

{"id": "p_a1500557875b60ed", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 277, "text": "景王薨於許昌，文王總統六軍，會謀謨帷幄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "f214f9be96050de4361b23ece4d7e1c413acf60d963760ff6027ac0fa39212ca"}

{"id": "p_85aa3c670739e96f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 278, "text": "時中詔敕尚書傅嘏，以東南新定，權留衛將軍屯許昌為內外之援，令嘏率諸軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "5f0a5c40610db559d35d7bb09cb4de2cb50843fd6934592a4a00e04f50ef9499"}

{"id": "p_34f41d1e6eb5041f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 279, "text": "會與嘏謀，使嘏表上，輒與衛將軍俱發，還到雒水南屯住。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "03d59303170ed2994a886a632161f10075c71e5ce4a5491ba22e4d6d1c7bdb4c"}

{"id": "p_9169ea0166014f4e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 280, "text": "於是朝廷拜文王為大將軍、輔政，會遷黃門侍郎，封東武亭侯，邑三百戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "ea8a4a8e5e07bfee961b733c2d7927361f4e1c99543543546c241c255f3ae403"}

{"id": "p_742ca65c63b87ea7", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 281, "text": "，徵諸葛誕為司空，時會喪寧在家，策誕必不從命，馳白文王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "372eac83212ae1369b72a763da11eab84440e4868abf8d5f670ccc7251177d93"}

{"id": "p_c829b8ac343653ce", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 282, "text": "文王以事已施行，不復追改。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "42f51f8b06117b3d55ebe779134bf856f33987b0b918d222a551da3624091f15"}

{"id": "p_5bc0fcbab3b241f9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 283, "text": "及誕反，車駕住項，文王至壽春，會復從行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "d5f0e89f993ad05e22245552145ab50d1e38e137d446fb598310c144ec3c313c"}

{"id": "p_479f701e81244c65", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 284, "text": "初，吳大將全琮，孫權之婚親重臣也，琮子懌、孫靜、從子端、翩、緝等，皆將兵來救誕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "72e1b176ffe76f40cb3fdb0aa3e442ac9ae7299f900661dc69cd318411a8f6b6"}

{"id": "p_afa2d5d7f5e62455", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 285, "text": "懌兄子輝、儀留建業，與其家內爭訟，攜其母，將部曲數十家渡江，自歸文王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "7dc9d5c212c7f81ee592edd6b01cddc2ff2f8706deff42177c4b568b0c921320"}

{"id": "p_ef99f2971b0dd283", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 286, "text": "會建策，密為輝、儀作書，使輝、儀所親信齎入城告懌等，說吳中怒懌等不能拔壽春，欲盡誅諸將家，故逃來歸命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "bdf22ee10e74aa140f446b7c723ae6e87d26faa5249acd9bab8c7215db65ea25"}

{"id": "p_01ef8798df6f4ecd", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 287, "text": "懌等恐懼，遂將所領開東城門出降，皆蒙封寵，城中由是乖離。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "ddfdd97edb256b62dd2ca1832d6385e8c9c494533b1eb931ea4a1181da0025d7"}

{"id": "p_a427b2ccbad7c6a8", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 288, "text": "壽春之破，會謀居多，親待日隆，時人謂之子房。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "5d705b05e1579cfb3bb89f140dc3ce01547bc2f5790bcdd6c33d27e6b38b1a57"}

{"id": "p_98ac1195bb020298", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 289, "text": "軍還，遷為太僕，固辭不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "b5cee57a1f5e6c0f0de3ff7de3c6c14d8722fb3f70d950076ccd0cd306ca525b"}

{"id": "p_92769a3ddf4da5e2", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 290, "text": "以中郎在大將軍府管記室事，為腹心之任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "f5fa98be9018279d18d87836962cd658c354f70c24645308ce01fe5ce438d26a"}

{"id": "p_0a67bd26faa24740", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 291, "text": "以討諸葛誕功，進爵陳侯，屢讓不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "c65626b1591a0eed6eaf98fd16283f41a71138c315575feb7e9e3fa1bcdce90c"}

{"id": "p_94ca7dfdfd3d8a73", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 292, "text": "詔曰：「會典綜軍事，參同計策，料敵制勝，有謀謨之勳，而推寵固讓，辭指款實，前後累重，志不可奪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "e10ac73d642263539758f7fcc7b61d89b197a0829348a3371b314ae1b68082b0"}

{"id": "p_407fca5bad6e2f65", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 293, "text": "夫成功不處，古人所重，其聽會所執，以成其美。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "c9bb0540e53a9f7d41a30e619fe4e6f657c13add289ea99584bdf20f51ca410e"}

{"id": "p_3221c1571f20151e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 294, "text": "雖在外司，時政損益，當世與奪，無不綜典。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "a1a563e9d25542b6fb9409717f4e034e3f014cb4bb4253c4da9396eac64603b2"}

{"id": "p_6db91e7f3cf343cc", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 295, "text": "文王以蜀大將姜維屢擾邊陲，料蜀國小民疲，資力單竭，欲大舉圖蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "7bbcadb15d3cf9c664027a5a94d1df2c1d5a45be9879bc2260221a4f50120a78"}

{"id": "p_39e57a6e54162971", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 296, "text": "惟會亦以為蜀可取，豫共籌度地形，考論事勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "6e09a30c3594b92374b682f669e9f0c62e6ee660a186d870441992bb275832c3"}

{"id": "p_49453a5cdf6371b6", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 297, "text": "冬，以會為鎮西將軍、假節都督關中諸軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "f2beff7761b5f01efb7d7b55b676f9b692e99f91c511aece973b78c861553575"}

{"id": "p_818043217c4b2496", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 298, "text": "文王敕青、徐、兗、豫、荊、揚諸州，並使作船，又令唐咨作浮海大船，外為將伐吳者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "c1d170ea2150e725f10fa413fa132561893b446bf8d3ca5fbea88e1a4a6b12ef"}

{"id": "p_7e3d94b545adbdbe", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 299, "text": "四年秋，乃下詔使鄧艾、諸葛緒各統諸軍三萬餘人，艾趣甘松、沓中連綴維，緒趣武街、橋頭絕維歸路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "fde8400f94ec9ec6a064da354ddf881370cc99b3d31900bcb54c63abb49cc4e3"}

{"id": "p_8af2455323355c9e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 300, "text": "會統十餘萬眾，分從斜谷、駱谷入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "8eb3da77d85792bbc25ed3a5b8e027818cca9c835a16a8395e3a0817a97baaa4"}

{"id": "p_059feba822237f96", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 301, "text": "先命牙門將許儀在前治道，會在後行，而橋穿，馬足陷，於是斬儀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "61c4ca94a4f9ae8bf61b71a9284a9c3d776985462ad877b2a447cb3a1c0ec0bf"}

{"id": "p_428f4e3ad4997f50", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 302, "text": "儀者，許褚之子，有功王室，猶不原貸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "03de3182a2a31ed75423af16ece0d81cd695575b4f88b73b369eec43332961ce"}

{"id": "p_c972673737722d27", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 303, "text": "蜀令諸圍皆不得戰，退還漢、樂二城守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 303}, "text_hash": "8fa5e2d92e20309d0fec797c93eba742f76f07df888deee1e4bee33512b22cf2"}

{"id": "p_15a96bf508a17827", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 304, "text": "魏興太守劉欽趣子午谷，諸軍數道平行，至漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 304}, "text_hash": "84e18efa872dfecbcc1f51fbd89a97cd4b8b68131e601182ea7436f1736e30f7"}

{"id": "p_a31703d417347dab", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 305, "text": "蜀監軍王含守樂城，護軍蔣斌守漢城，兵各五千。", "locator": {"ordinal": 305}, "text_hash": "9020daf1f9ce09ad424c89dd1b9b2f23c2c066cbd619ffedbbcee890344c6e6b"}

{"id": "p_1bb144d2d3c4d53c", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 306, "text": "會使護軍荀愷、前將軍李輔各統萬人，愷圍漢城，輔圍樂城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 306}, "text_hash": "9ed58c13ce634cceee5d67fecf8d28de41a2c93e3fd405148c714db14f2948e7"}

{"id": "p_ff6ccff59d83bc60", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 307, "text": "會徑過，西出陽安口，遣人祭諸葛亮之墓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 307}, "text_hash": "5552bc20208417a88dc764b627a4acd4cfa267e8562eaa94e209328e951f2efe"}

{"id": "p_3f99fea4b9a4b7b3", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 308, "text": "使護軍胡烈等行前，攻破關城，得庫藏積穀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 308}, "text_hash": "87fa2f3d905af2fafd1b6245d3a764dd561bf5e550d07fbb4c7b9d05abca9f23"}

{"id": "p_4873e0f0079cf0a2", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 309, "text": "姜維自沓中還，至陰平，合集士眾，欲赴關城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 309}, "text_hash": "62405d403c88d0141309dc378e53651e61d8fd880a6105d86d3655f7b0ed69ed"}

{"id": "p_95994d071b9df51b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 310, "text": "未到，聞其已破，退趣白水，與蜀將張翼、廖化等合守劍閣拒會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 310}, "text_hash": "8fd8e340f5568747be13e163750fa636defd3e7cf582c39bfea4b80ae4964183"}

{"id": "p_371894d3dcf0f2e8", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 311, "text": "鄧艾追姜維到陰平，簡選精銳，欲從漢德陽入江由、左儋道詣綿竹，趣成都，與諸葛緒共行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 311}, "text_hash": "ecab37cfb8f381a394c5d748f0aa7ce1a86c3979b1364cea8a8e492d47a19ba8"}

{"id": "p_b68e8331914a9415", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 312, "text": "緒以本受節度邀姜維，西行非本詔，遂進軍前向白水，與會合。", "locator": {"ordinal": 312}, "text_hash": "ab437c6c417a4a755cddd8224c15bf92378d8d22e9ae8897e81de6264970a1ac"}

{"id": "p_05c8ca546f1385f7", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 313, "text": "會遣將軍田章等從劍閣西，徑出江由。", "locator": {"ordinal": 313}, "text_hash": "a5f0f3dff4a6dfc597e3235c49bbfda27bfcce2a03a8668710fbebe4d30249aa"}

{"id": "p_e34508b9e0cf109f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 314, "text": "未至百里，章先破蜀伏兵三校，艾使章先登。", "locator": {"ordinal": 314}, "text_hash": "5a6db8583f52512dc240b73a0db620ac9f8360672cb2d52203f3bb0cd1a37352"}

{"id": "p_21798c4d4b114166", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 315, "text": "會與緒軍向劍閣，會欲專軍勢，密白緒畏懦不進，檻車徵還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 315}, "text_hash": "c1cc2532e638d3ab1353bbb2bace6d90b4e16d47956bfbdcd4f65921a847228f"}

{"id": "p_3557c0fb5908eb81", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 316, "text": "軍悉屬會，進攻劍閣，不克，引退，蜀軍保險拒守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 316}, "text_hash": "2174f4e5966270c3354ccb91d4b8409341c434469fe6c1dd0fe6f2274493727c"}

{"id": "p_d327ba4c82f7e93a", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 317, "text": "艾遂至綿竹，大戰，斬諸葛瞻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 317}, "text_hash": "e6a2e504e9b15873da9d5e777db11b499232f89ef1844443c229da892f66cb9a"}

{"id": "p_6d0c48ec1711f1aa", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 318, "text": "維等聞瞻巳破，率其眾東入於巴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 318}, "text_hash": "08ca856f1bd1928eac4615b2a7610a8570cf619a39978983c822a080657b6506"}

{"id": "p_5650963ed3b2b596", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 319, "text": "會乃進軍至涪，遣胡烈、田續、龐會等追維。", "locator": {"ordinal": 319}, "text_hash": "33a3f882ff04cd29dca22a0f7ff9d1a65e3440440334415a0eef88b0a0ba20a1"}

{"id": "p_4caa1ff4b7f7e57d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 320, "text": "艾進軍向成都，劉禪詣艾降，遣使敕維等令降於會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 320}, "text_hash": "cb2d64b76881930f3265c60c2ba8611d8fb3ae46c1548969408c44eb696131ca"}

{"id": "p_cf6446eb84cce8bb", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 321, "text": "維至廣漢郪縣，令兵悉放器仗，送節傳於胡烈，便從東道詣會降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 321}, "text_hash": "68fad8c5dceef31f3fb2668c9e6b99db7a16a1bebced1caa328b197ee3bc45d9"}

{"id": "p_8b94980ada91796e", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 322, "text": "會於是禁檢士眾不得鈔略，虛己誘納，以接蜀之群司，與維情好歡甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 322}, "text_hash": "fa8f6f9473ea183f3f91659b34ab3977b82526e47197555252ee4cdfcdb43628"}
