{"id": "p_ddc232d03609b960", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 323, "text": "十二月詔曰：「會所向摧弊，前無強敵，緘制眾城，罔羅迸逸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 323}, "text_hash": "c17018ecb717d400bd051a70233d28b11ebe88e113c324414e4220032365b4ee"}

{"id": "p_039e32f9947aca6b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 324, "text": "蜀之豪帥，面縛歸命，謀無遺策，舉無廢功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 324}, "text_hash": "54abc80d1b462f732e6092d35084fe96c77e80cad573f598934611ad6222fa63"}

{"id": "p_82a7232875dbbb84", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 325, "text": "凡所降誅，動以萬計，全勝獨克，有征無戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 325}, "text_hash": "b95a1b7d1a1a135878d3bc737f89e0aab6793c6ccbb4c87602db75c5e760db66"}

{"id": "p_933508f083dd0166", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 326, "text": "其以會為司徒，進封縣侯，增邑萬戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 326}, "text_hash": "d7c22c479f5779a12a0f8e91d3f5ec0f56078a309e4b30d1d5943bc2aa334bf8"}

{"id": "p_f8630aed7f919b42", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 327, "text": "封子二人亭侯，邑各千戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 327}, "text_hash": "53665fedbf525b4d3d55ef7830152b00489fb7a6b96b31883a4811edb92f3cd3"}

{"id": "p_95813d65462206e0", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 328, "text": "會內有異志，因鄧艾承制專事，密白艾有反狀，於是詔書檻車徵艾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 328}, "text_hash": "90022864ebbb350c009f1eca8e7ebedf0754fac4cd3340859648e64d6f340524"}

{"id": "p_11b94e87f3e297d4", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 329, "text": "司馬文王懼艾或不從命，敕會並進軍成都，監軍衛瓘在會前行，以文王手筆令宣喻艾軍，艾軍皆釋仗，遂收艾入檻車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 329}, "text_hash": "2c27f673abd1b3ca586aea42dc7a33299d607643663c98e305b052258ff54030"}

{"id": "p_8e9446124b15c52d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 330, "text": "會所憚惟艾，艾既禽而會尋至，獨統大眾，威震西土。", "locator": {"ordinal": 330}, "text_hash": "9cbf1cf85c6d4d94868bcc04df115d36250f68e9eacdb41e3f47ee597bd847e9"}

{"id": "p_1f1b1bd1e7190381", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 331, "text": "自謂功名蓋世，不可復為人下，加猛將銳卒皆在己手，遂謀反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 331}, "text_hash": "27ebafa03e4103d27c5e765218f9ebb805462c3ba53fd9f3bcb6e8cf26026f47"}

{"id": "p_f588e2bb33935805", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 332, "text": "欲使姜維等皆將蜀兵出斜谷，會自將大眾隨其後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 332}, "text_hash": "1f64e63b428c173910cab165eb0bfdd9a5aaf48d553845677e3698a3b0fbbf40"}

{"id": "p_0e836f9ee1cc7f9b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 333, "text": "既至長安，令騎士從陸道，步兵從水道順流浮渭入河，以為五日可到孟津，與騎會洛陽，一旦天下可定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 333}, "text_hash": "28a176442a653596b7dff54572cbec4ec12652a411dbcceeb1cda748c2a3ec26"}

{"id": "p_3d4e44633c187fd4", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 334, "text": "會得文王書云：「恐鄧艾或不就徵，今遣中護軍賈充將步騎萬人徑入斜谷，屯樂城，吾自將十萬屯長安，相見在近。", "locator": {"ordinal": 334}, "text_hash": "4d762aa8f92fef8ba37d13ee5da370a066c0edc9a7344951458343ccd60d9f2a"}

{"id": "p_23322f6e0a68db9a", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 335, "text": "」會得書，驚呼所親語之曰：「但取鄧艾，相國知我能獨辦之；今來大重，必覺我異矣，便當速發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 335}, "text_hash": "0f2222812717b732bbe1a5742cb5274c338f6ba0f1cab211e7cab7db9f23fc79"}

{"id": "p_16312f8873c2c4ba", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 336, "text": "事成，可得天下；不成，退保蜀漢，不失作劉備也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 336}, "text_hash": "60b02de27cccfe1646249e838bd02edfe774188eee7e8ed258242bb38b2572c3"}

{"id": "p_d59ebd63924381ed", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 337, "text": "我自淮南以來，畫無遣策，四海所共知也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 337}, "text_hash": "fcaa9a60d093eea81477f4c4be51eb0b882daed2d8e0ce05592de5046ecebcbb"}

{"id": "p_3107cf06e30d0dd6", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 338, "text": "」會以五年正月十五日至，其明日，悉請護軍、郡守、牙門騎督以上及蜀之故官，為太后發喪於蜀朝堂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 338}, "text_hash": "dca4ebf662105d03496a557413ba14c15b3998119ff33ab7ba9bb7f5066b9f51"}

{"id": "p_419f3ed5e91a5e74", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 339, "text": "矯太后遺詔，使會起兵廢文王，皆班示坐上人，使下議訖，書版署置，更使所親信代領諸軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 339}, "text_hash": "dedda6431e9c1845851bb9e01cf04a198c255daf3316a3d3d6dda1bd101e24f3"}

{"id": "p_d72c7efd5d102bf9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 340, "text": "所請群官，悉閉著益州諸曹屋中，城門宮門皆閉，嚴兵圍守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 340}, "text_hash": "5d6aabe9cce85a65295075efea8e83a81970df779780d4b82d876e4695ffdc30"}

{"id": "p_dc9a93868a20dc42", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 341, "text": "會帳下督丘建本屬胡烈，烈薦之文王，會請以自隨，任愛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 341}, "text_hash": "a776e851a6a1251f59e93918ad977ed591f49e2e780c2a6b2cb2f7ddf5c20b74"}

{"id": "p_ccdd6e3fe1bce1e1", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 342, "text": "建愍烈獨坐，啟會，使聽內一親兵出取飲食，諸牙門隨例各內一人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 342}, "text_hash": "c97f618b9599f8662508b7dcb5e98ea401736ccde22e51951098c706583183cd"}

{"id": "p_b7f468a7cfa751c9", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 343, "text": "烈紿語親兵及疏與其子曰：「丘建密說消息，會已作大坑，白棓數千，欲悉呼外兵入，人賜白㡊，拜為散將，以次棓殺坑中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 343}, "text_hash": "6148694bc0d5d4678b7a6b3d5f0c7303ea4f8c44b6f50e28929c45ec18ed4fbd"}

{"id": "p_3e8a3733e24abfc0", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 344, "text": "」諸牙門親兵亦咸說此語，一夜傳相告，皆遍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 344}, "text_hash": "c1a6f19e65ce8dc8459e51033e08736f5c9350daf321e2fa32615548cf69af13"}

{"id": "p_b611907fc8aaf691", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 345, "text": "或謂會：「可盡殺牙門騎督以上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 345}, "text_hash": "c5f29a482169e37529713f964b74d8762c26bcb3b714b831832e469cee77510d"}

{"id": "p_bd0766bfcc289d21", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 346, "text": "十八日日中，烈軍兵與烈兒雷鼓出門，諸軍兵不期皆鼓譟出，曾無督促之者，而爭先赴城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 346}, "text_hash": "7d55c01e38c6d5d24f8f09726e233b1a59f189a6ed1882936a9420dac5f4c3e1"}

{"id": "p_ccef515bafb50536", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 347, "text": "時方給與姜維鎧杖，白外有匈匈聲，似失火，有頃，白兵走向城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 347}, "text_hash": "e53ecf9b72cbf8a29a3bace63ddd755325c2542c7200578482b77e8d51a36758"}

{"id": "p_d255546dd7e11c64", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 348, "text": "會驚，謂維曰：「兵來似欲作惡，當云何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 348}, "text_hash": "8cb3fa9c5ee467e0bc3072738a4da7f69d51dd620338f25c6b1613f35409a6ab"}

{"id": "p_215914c43eafb77f", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 349, "text": "」會遣兵悉殺所閉諸牙門郡守，內人共舉機以柱門，兵斫門，不能破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 349}, "text_hash": "159439fe92e3544e8c0a8b3fe9415bf521eb0871743b3acb9059a11e7ea5b3fd"}

{"id": "p_b43c112ec5ab1ffa", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 350, "text": "斯須，門外倚梯登城，或燒城屋，蟻附亂進，矢下如雨，牙門、郡守各緣屋出，與其卒兵相得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 350}, "text_hash": "3e77e21fabbebe14d0bef3af5912d4f20b2da2a0f66cadb1c72d43951d454e02"}

{"id": "p_3bb83bcf85068d98", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 351, "text": "姜維率會左右戰，手殺五六人，眾既格斬維，爭赴殺會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 351}, "text_hash": "73e624c31d00cb853d8f6a760996266f13307d582917d1700eeb21fa848bd300"}

{"id": "p_fe32a0ba974ca3a0", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 352, "text": "會時年四十，將士死者數百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 352}, "text_hash": "daea5dccb338b0a5d6a889c24e2ddeba65b9fa8f78d376d49327a74354174657"}

{"id": "p_288b3595b5dab1cd", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 353, "text": "初，艾為太尉，會為司徒，皆持節、都督諸軍如故，咸未受命而斃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 353}, "text_hash": "bb9263d6ffacf1330d993773fbd22f07f6f021a666b011fd4eeefc78ca10f2a8"}

{"id": "p_214978f4a4182c27", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 354, "text": "會兄毓，以四年冬薨，會竟未知問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 354}, "text_hash": "80e860ced3790751d300df0a182c79c916fa9a40541c0f9e0dca25c305b76569"}

{"id": "p_5e8147bf2f91079b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 355, "text": "會兄子邕，隨會與俱死，會所養兄子毅及峻、辿等下獄，當伏誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 355}, "text_hash": "b5cd294da4b7feb02b3975594e319f1597f9df195d793d129199e50290433e8e"}

{"id": "p_e468d73e27a4ad99", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 356, "text": "司馬文王表天子下詔曰：「峻等祖父繇，三祖之世，極位臺司，佐命立勳，饗食廟庭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 356}, "text_hash": "b21bb9bbe8d6135bb7843f7e4581b6c9ebe448f73875147d991ae6689cc67c87"}

{"id": "p_7e00d7309dba9f78", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 357, "text": "父毓，歷職內外，幹事有績。", "locator": {"ordinal": 357}, "text_hash": "dad60b6aa2266db546e5868b6ed0703dce2264ca575d74cbb521673815b9177a"}

{"id": "p_b3318372a1603ce1", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 358, "text": "昔楚思子文之治，不滅斗氏之祀；晉錄成宣之忠，用存趙氏之後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 358}, "text_hash": "246f931287323abd7325a04b731b98ab2f80eee32c6177cbec8c0d09aa4fa307"}

{"id": "p_ea554021e11fce80", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 359, "text": "以會、邕之罪，而絕繇、毓之類，吾有愍然！", "locator": {"ordinal": 359}, "text_hash": "6a7a6d2a88544417e4b184d88c1093101d337460664e0a2780e8f9035fc19aeb"}

{"id": "p_3f3a85dd159d9f0a", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 360, "text": "峻、辿兄弟特原，有官爵者如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 360}, "text_hash": "1bec5625913d8ad968a3da8337930f58614c7a0fbf7cb85cd82cbc74567eba74"}

{"id": "p_fcbd50ba8c9aba2b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 361, "text": "」或曰，毓曾密啟司馬文王，言會挾術難保，不可專任，故宥峻等云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 361}, "text_hash": "f9a11722149fd02f1bd72077affee182de38b0189955fb941a4b76d800b4f3a3"}

{"id": "p_ecae79f02e6fc922", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 362, "text": "初，文王欲遣會伐蜀，西曹屬邵悌求見曰：「今遣鍾會率十餘萬眾伐蜀，愚謂會單身無重任，不若使餘人行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 362}, "text_hash": "e838bef7af3bedd2e1253a595aa99991987f4b4a79585a95bb6032b2130ee472"}

{"id": "p_eb07d54ec93e31c8", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 363, "text": "及會白鄧艾不軌，文王將西，悌復曰：「鍾會所統，五六倍於鄧艾，但可敕會取艾，不足自行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 363}, "text_hash": "412bb231cd203ef91a44d126f92495589a19e8cab5c0bb5ffcb86dd5bc4df978"}

{"id": "p_213ab2d268450d30", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 364, "text": "」文王曰：「卿忘前時所言邪，而更雲可不須行乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 364}, "text_hash": "5bb5266d1b09a4f5fc3109770e7c861181694b60538d922d3555845734e45dea"}

{"id": "p_4484148c770054e8", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 365, "text": "我要自當以信義待人，但人不負我，我豈可先人生心哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 365}, "text_hash": "e5057d5b9b83c1e7510802437f44f9c79239dade9e7cb4315e8e7d8b2efa5d66"}

{"id": "p_fb89ea807c3439c6", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 366, "text": "近日賈護軍問我，言：『頗疑鍾會不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 366}, "text_hash": "962abc045b732f65560c2cabbfeda4b3cd971243d7bc4df52c9170c008d221f5"}

{"id": "p_8ec67fd33985877d", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 367, "text": "』我答言：『如今遣卿行，寧可復疑卿邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 367}, "text_hash": "a34c34c5569f00c120e8bfc81aec7c845678168954528c9562c94393911cbf3b"}

{"id": "p_a231d58ce856158b", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 368, "text": "」軍至長安，會果已死，咸如所策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 368}, "text_hash": "11b75d949512e48793ca27ef3e45c85690b8cedd3733b7755e29941e145451c3"}

{"id": "p_c61a07d7c3e71621", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 369, "text": "會嘗論易無互體、才性同異。", "locator": {"ordinal": 369}, "text_hash": "a8660403e566e3dda653103bad6b36cfcdc35702e1b9907d4f08929ca055aafd"}

{"id": "p_8d13ab612f23bbe4", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 370, "text": "及會死後，於會家得書二十篇，名曰《道論》，而實刑名家也，其文似會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 370}, "text_hash": "bb40bfd54ae61ae1ac3206a6e670bd3a2b122d32b8373ac687b29f684331c443"}

{"id": "p_0ac9b609353b1649", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 371, "text": "初，會弱冠與山陽王弼竝知名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 371}, "text_hash": "57ca62832c898a839806c4650c6d3bd832e95bec125c22e36acb3af23fe1ab75"}

{"id": "p_9dbad0744d121af5", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 372, "text": "弼好論儒道，辭才逸辯，注《易》及《老子》，為尚書郎，年二十餘卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 372}, "text_hash": "bd10c5df80021c4c6e163225995ec5a38912da7c760987269f1a9550d6804c06"}

{"id": "p_dd0f0fc8ffc358e4", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 373, "text": "評曰：王凌風節格尚，毌丘儉才識拔幹，諸葛誕嚴毅威重，鍾會精練策數，咸以顯名，致茲榮任，而皆心大志迂，不慮禍難，變如發機，宗族塗地，豈不謬惑邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 373}, "text_hash": "e4988124d246707fb8f8e60f0d73648ad79208e6c88b3a9425a773541c5406c5"}

{"id": "p_02c472bb100e6033", "source_id": "src_80541d569e2cc6b6", "ordinal": 374, "text": "鄧艾矯然強壯，立功立事，然闇於防患，咎敗旋至，豈遠知乎諸葛恪而不能近自見，此蓋古人所謂目論者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 374}, "text_hash": "2f6542fb09bb254fe91f1dd77b7c93b383ebe29bad58c95d0b4eee80f717ac7d"}

{"id": "p_27d17080b1e3666b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_bcf3f7fd2dddb449", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 1, "text": "華佗字元化，沛國譙人也，一名旉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "ca8f2f9ef1eb599ccd2c282e98ebbf2f5f503ad1ffe4132408781d069933f336"}

{"id": "p_f6adb45425858317", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 2, "text": "沛相陳珪舉孝廉，太尉黃琬辟，皆不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "b56197f53bce2cb7af1f8c73ab5259af15fcdfea6a7b2e1c443e2136e70c3afb"}

{"id": "p_2b3869eecb611b7a", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 3, "text": "曉養性之術，時人以為年且百歲而貌有壯容。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "330beaea3cce16071cebc2e69afdb91650555144c5a6633ff6ee0526cc5f8bb4"}

{"id": "p_a436b951297b3fda", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 4, "text": "又精方藥，其療疾，合湯不過數種，心解分劑，不復稱量，煮熟便飲，語其節度，捨去輒愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "02632773cb4a2fb7cfaccb8fa710a9f424c6d3f4f8737bca401a15000f6c60b9"}

{"id": "p_e377bd13e0b100e8", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 5, "text": "若當灸，不過一兩處，每處不過七八壯，病亦應除。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "986920ac2f6671acb0ede84c15baba745decc582a941c8019442c6cea5069e08"}

{"id": "p_7cd3155909192cb4", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 6, "text": "若當針，亦不過一兩處，下針言「當引某許，若至，語人」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "dafe7144133dac3d300972ac2e7888056cdf6b7f3418b800a28bd5bbf6e202e1"}

{"id": "p_551ea9f3585430b5", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 7, "text": "病者言「巳到」，應便拔針，病亦行差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "8ef20e1bb2bbb6ac18ef0320bb5b9bc71d0ed41973a20adb6756a530fe9a55f5"}

{"id": "p_9124a50485bd8b28", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 8, "text": "若病結積在內，針藥所不能及，當須刳割者，便飲其麻沸散，須臾便如醉死無所知，因破取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "f5e0369d759aed1a79d14492c2a609e51aac354bca30f7a5d18ad29a3abaf110"}

{"id": "p_59ab116ac12c80f7", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 9, "text": "病若在腸中，便斷腸湔洗，縫腹膏摩，四五日差，不痛，人亦不自寤，一月之間，即平復矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "279385ee5d5ff233be4c8257231c69f9bd8fe44088286bb094ae893be397c4e9"}

{"id": "p_b73f85fb5e17ef74", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 10, "text": "故甘陵相夫人有娠六月，腹痛不安，佗視脈，曰：「胎巳死矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "5df65bdd2a0f9053ef7e89b3490ff86c82b1b92a7e1231fbbdaf10b5be5b10f1"}

{"id": "p_066b1e9ad11dd187", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」使人手摸知所在，在左則男，在右則女。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "c396173999b63d4e98bf185f86a498d695cda0c97108bb080094e4f858a90be0"}

{"id": "p_22397f57f0d4f38e", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 12, "text": "人云「在左」，於是為湯下之，果下男形，即愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "7820db3a35aede493ea0e74b016068b6b7f038fe6381e071003fd44d21a5c3c7"}

{"id": "p_cc25818576f055c4", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 13, "text": "縣吏尹世苦四支煩，口中乾，不欲聞人聲，小便不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "c8b29dff4068bbec3d25c63e120344b0303b62c09c63cc0ed4ac7eb06b2ee971"}

{"id": "p_177c71e200dc926c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 14, "text": "佗曰：「試作熱食，得汗則愈；不汗，後三日死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "aa7a37bb5624243825267afa6d1ac759cc84af8d2b4108f11ff3ac4e38aef4e1"}

{"id": "p_9fd1e8fbbf547d31", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」即作熱食而不汗出，佗曰：「藏氣已絕於內，當啼泣而絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "0cd6f8baf94912fc1a4fe725e63a172772680041c0c4b96eb719d55b6b00bdde"}

{"id": "p_d9c3291bee025089", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 16, "text": "府吏兒尋、李延共止，俱頭痛身熱，所苦正同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "c9ace7dab3bf87dc50bcdb712c97468e757462de6e03f02c6ef025e0cddf3979"}

{"id": "p_6ed8e3609901e644", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 17, "text": "佗曰：「尋當下之，延當發汗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "d4080e2fba986b57f0daf3edc5b1d41ca12f3a0de5c0f557f2f64c32c8ed0a25"}

{"id": "p_9b7e2beafc565f1b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 18, "text": "」或難其異，佗曰：「尋外實，延內實，故治之宜殊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "9ac5adec68baf2f2c01f3c63bf919c794e858b646b3157c8be7a1fde073621d9"}

{"id": "p_010851d8c8aa48b3", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 19, "text": "鹽瀆嚴昕與數人共候佗，適至，佗謂昕曰：「君身中佳否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "0f0d819ebd43fdc4399495bb400accb4e0afaf7cf9272b2281acd37087f0a2b5"}

{"id": "p_ddbf7cf588dbd9af", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 20, "text": "」佗曰：「君有急病見於面，莫多飲酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "01c8f1e7751a290569d8ee2673a42483d9d23a100cb46f497d563fe6291a7ac0"}

{"id": "p_9dd281c357632b34", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 21, "text": "」坐畢歸，行數里，昕卒頭眩墮車，人扶將還，載歸家，中宿死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "091be5fb77e38ae9c4ab59509d634f0c0365988d3582216309da5f58c2f6efb5"}

{"id": "p_518ec1c27d4dc8af", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 22, "text": "故督郵頓子獻得病已差，詣佗視脈，曰：「尚虛，未得復，勿為勞事，御內即死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "652d95b5c03a9becc154f767523e29a789779d38818d76173784284072b8814e"}

{"id": "p_2e1ef7925a140fc1", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」其妻聞其病除，從百餘里來省之，止宿交接，中間三日發病，一如佗言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "9befb7c9b92147ca4b0b943bcd5d53ce2a584833184043cf487242ec735132ea"}

{"id": "p_4000f024cd42cf14", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 24, "text": "督郵徐毅得病，佗往省之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "dd624425439d40bb8cf18be1f0d7674b2a58d13444d8b670971ba3208eceb264"}

{"id": "p_26f2599ccad2d8cf", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 25, "text": "毅謂佗曰：「昨使醫曹吏劉租針胃管訖，便苦欬嗽，欲臥不安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "f768674001b0165b2b13ae1c675e81930cbbc638cfa3e2e1d89450e0bed7ab5a"}

{"id": "p_623420ecd0f8de0c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」佗曰：「刺不得胃管，誤中肝也，食當日減，五日不救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "f7aca4379923d1bd2151ffc9793c816e2886843b97dd3fbf1dd224eab984ea96"}

{"id": "p_ed57fb7a541893a6", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 27, "text": "東陽陳叔山小男二歲得疾，下利常先啼，日以羸困。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "872cbe4e382f1b5e01bb4cd1a1f135ebd0c0ad5bd78dab26e7f09ce1b6286010"}

{"id": "p_291539dcfd628107", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 28, "text": "問佗，佗曰：「其母懷軀，陽氣內養，乳中虛冷，兒得母寒，故令不時愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "a972a0f0f7d63de42ecd6edba18bab2c756906befe9cfdcef1f0c985c162ef17"}

{"id": "p_222e7c7033177822", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」佗與四物女宛丸，十日即除。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "621ac67669b521d107c151db40e8320724848de52317eb6d872ecbd127f4ddb4"}

{"id": "p_1b7d144aed001648", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 30, "text": "彭城夫人夜之廁，蠆螫其手，呻呼無賴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "149726e53a227e6ddf5d569e0803c676dbad412782966d422793aa46b9c314dd"}

{"id": "p_29e7474e76f85567", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 31, "text": "佗令溫湯近熱，漬手其中，卒可得寐，但旁人數為易湯，湯令暖之，其旦即愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "f66e93402c80f4821e3faca50117b8f14e40b5401a8a1e80e38afbb65e552724"}

{"id": "p_8f060a14bb438df7", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 32, "text": "軍吏梅平得病，除名還家，家居廣陵，未至二百里，止親人舍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "ae0abf739d0324783ff9f3f3c6be6d07f76b2105a995133b0c33ecd9c93d71ae"}

{"id": "p_6cc575058f0584fb", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 33, "text": "有頃，佗偶至主人許，主人令佗視平，佗謂平曰：「君早見我，可不至此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "b9577e8816c1bf72f42b5843a88e7c74e286dc4f3ef2b9e13f69af5f8d126ca4"}

{"id": "p_d67be6c642051893", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 34, "text": "今疾已結，促去可得與家相見，五日卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "a5d278ca6b6bae04a490e52d31649a2b33edd994d35f2f22fdf94b46bd8e5673"}

{"id": "p_f161a74501c6c080", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 35, "text": "佗行道，見一人病咽塞，嗜食而不得下，家人車載欲往就醫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "541b829a3c6fcd41e5abfc250dee37063cb982bd6de201280806436cb60b5b31"}

{"id": "p_dc70f4764d90e1d7", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 36, "text": "佗聞其呻吟，駐車往視，語之曰：「向來道邊有賣餅家蒜齏大酢，從取三升飲之，病自當去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "688451451e8e048f0adba74cd23eb285eb9ebc3e4d9d5de988acc7499696daf9"}

{"id": "p_abb39d090788f5c4", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」即如佗言，立吐蛇一枚，縣車邊，欲造佗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "f3eedcfb48ef386f528b19b8ec8361d0c7ec3abb83b27df8d45c32a95cc8a335"}

{"id": "p_197b37b31ff5f36a", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 38, "text": "佗尚未還，小兒戲門前，逆見，自相謂曰：「似逢我公，車邊病是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "2d66128cee61b416a54b54d6f255bdb4660949b77855d19af6b75b6bccf5f6e1"}

{"id": "p_cade4f3afbc4a318", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」疾者前入坐，見佗北壁縣此蛇輩約以十數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "097251074bd658853968364658551fe35c264cbdcf148f5fcba01fa6db52e4bc"}

{"id": "p_4055cb64d07be452", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 40, "text": "又有一郡守病，佗以為其人盛怒則差，乃多受其貨而不加治，無何棄去，留書罵之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "9a9177a6416e1c9ec2e3e834fa4ba856573b2eb534ab9cf5f29ae472fd6906be"}

{"id": "p_8456fcac62f43326", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 41, "text": "郡守果大怒，令人追捉殺佗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "13a1e816d9ee0bbd3538a1c23552980ba61e112190028d044495343597d59945"}

{"id": "p_01337f9d8888ddcf", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 42, "text": "守瞋恚既甚，吐黑血數升而愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "312b7b3a216012fc3c7c11bfec24d8a1cdcaceb5b7aac05e0aae547881e1ce4f"}

{"id": "p_5ac8d327478786c5", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 43, "text": "又有一士大夫不快，佗云：「君病深，當破腹取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "7b00fa9aa85af2fc62cd064c608b1229b4fcc6d402c38d264e1fdbec78e7aabc"}

{"id": "p_735acfdc84014888", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 44, "text": "然君壽亦不過十年，病不能殺君，忍病十歲，壽俱當盡，不足故自刳裂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "9a886935c9432f260248b6631c7a5d6a871b39566a110b7dd8d588fe4c3a77af"}

{"id": "p_edd17973ec215e04", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」士大夫不耐痛癢，必欲除之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "428b059f995a1713c8034a8f1294995651a1ccb1155f499edeec8c69edb7c2fb"}

{"id": "p_d15fbfa0ffba7d82", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 46, "text": "佗遂下手，所患尋差，十年竟死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "dc0b462b11d849f54773c7ebc5c442aece094eeb9cfad02f9bf6256c418b90a7"}

{"id": "p_497f60c27049f6b3", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 47, "text": "廣陵太守陳登得病，胸中煩懣，面赤不食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "47c7d1d19cd7b5707152ad91159c2e5e8d7e2b6d0a92077a20aaaa61841ac29a"}

{"id": "p_c8585900c1fc8b5e", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 48, "text": "佗脈之曰：「府君胃中有蟲數升，欲成內疽，食腥物所為也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "30cf78dd6084843cfab29d06efa793281cf342e9fcada6ed05393741d85dc38b"}

{"id": "p_a2447e28d40f505d", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 49, "text": "」即作湯二升，先服一升，斯須盡服之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "b523e82de9c4779f1385b0491b2724fa5dffc66308de3acac4cc51369e2db453"}

{"id": "p_3c3fea258dc08d2b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 50, "text": "食頃，吐出三升許蟲，赤頭皆動，半身是生魚膾也，所苦便愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "95e3e89745dcfd26ec78a378b6cb3c93f5f49262cad8bae141ffadbfe74c3abd"}

{"id": "p_f7e3cc03b9faf35f", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 51, "text": "佗曰：「此病後三期當發，遇良醫乃可濟救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "1132954c9ff7c1592703acab9aa5bb7397d6de0e2523eb73725c407d00a65522"}

{"id": "p_ebd22b1fe1f2e871", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 52, "text": "」依期果發動，時佗不在，如言而死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "fc55faf84c7fede9a1d2e1605a53be0887db106b2c6b37ef4dffa8134c489490"}

{"id": "p_f306e01c84fa1ce1", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 53, "text": "太祖聞而召佗，佗常在左右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "0a5938d874ad383b4108543bb0b65978cc416d1a48e4e4214cd8915d21d2fe7d"}

{"id": "p_ae6e51f3a6be4b18", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 54, "text": "太祖苦頭風，每發，心亂目眩，佗針鬲，隨手而差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "26c1738ffc578850cbdbc1f47dfaaa45e218aeed0461821f1dd4ec8c8df479a5"}

{"id": "p_2f2049ee6114cb2d", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 55, "text": "李將軍妻病甚，呼佗視脈，曰：「傷娠而胎不去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "576ee0d1c7a13fe6b112ad542a05962519d8cb2dbc5b04f5a266a9569fb8c316"}

{"id": "p_477a5498b58998b1", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 56, "text": "」將軍言：「聞實傷娠，胎已去矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "59a87d32deb9535fcff1778621049a4f96e37c514f4cb4197e2db99d319dc368"}

{"id": "p_2e437355605c6167", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 57, "text": "」佗曰：「案脈，胎未去也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "a8b7d9c9fbd826e95439214e1eb02d0d84f992e80533da5b01ad1eee6c15fc6a"}

{"id": "p_2908b62c26b53283", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 58, "text": "百餘日復動，更呼佗，佗曰：「此脈故事有胎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "7fe6d24c11b34d6ec57a5d94e85ae2c4fbb9cc01b0b695589846d1364e8afc9f"}

{"id": "p_aeaa31c11ea2d552", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 59, "text": "前當生兩兒，一兒先出，血出甚多，後兒不及生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "b0aaa6055dc23f8f29fc769baaca72e79bd41ad34ea9962b6a417a080cd4819d"}

{"id": "p_83ba91040955906c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 60, "text": "母不自覺，旁人亦不寤，不復迎，遂不得生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "491d4f7ed244bb9cdcfb396975d2e5b4f0a494be51e0bd5c2bf99396a4780b87"}

{"id": "p_7f92a96034651b1c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 61, "text": "胎死，血脈不復歸，必燥著母脊，故使多脊痛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "344222cfb616905613972adda0d3a4916a488518667af97d7b568e6624ced435"}

{"id": "p_1ac0bd1d4ec63ce8", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 62, "text": "今當與湯，並針一處，此死胎必出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "1ba022b891ec84f2cdf563adb5c46e90616ca35b2ee60f207db3bb3e30a6198a"}

{"id": "p_fc69721d94f49eb2", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」湯針既加，婦痛急如欲生者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "39cd89b544a9698c31715b9b9ef34214b083f3cdae53c5f21384afab2d0852c1"}

{"id": "p_5b4a08d35775eeb0", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 64, "text": "佗曰：「此死胎久枯，不能自出，宜使人探之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "eafb1ffcd4daa5527133e5f8de85ec9828c2e741aede3b7a6125c4a85583fe81"}

{"id": "p_31a8d96afba35197", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 65, "text": "」果得一死男，手足完具，色黑，長可尺所。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "12342db74e611acbe2efa5da244fef53d8d4eded8f51b7843585f073655fbda9"}

{"id": "p_9a86382db9aa8276", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 66, "text": "然本作士人，以醫見業，意常自悔，後太祖親理，得病篤重，使佗專視。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "20ae759117b939025e133c5d837c597d6ae0ad7d16018d257f9f468309624b58"}

{"id": "p_ea565f1c465c22e6", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 67, "text": "佗曰：「此近難濟，恆事攻治，可延歲月。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "1aadeac720fd384495c7bda4d1f7d0a7ba0339bb5439ce3316d99731784869ff"}

{"id": "p_a2581f4e710bfe98", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 68, "text": "」佗久遠家思歸，因曰：「當得家書，方欲暫還耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "56b65675be2ce559a4425517eff9313b93d130772af7edb0c776b5513ac7ec1e"}

{"id": "p_1b4b545174eba8cd", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」到家，辭以妻病，數乞期不反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "2707c4ab9860b12483f07675c5d433a5d4883c9a5074b12708611dd128d30cdb"}

{"id": "p_c756bc2886239b62", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 70, "text": "太祖累書呼，又敕郡縣發遣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "e129e7646e767bc634c7df196f1c0ea13994b3c18225ae28cace56e63119a47b"}

{"id": "p_b432785adb771e52", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 71, "text": "佗恃能厭食事，猶不上道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "665eb78468be8e0463b7699d8ddb4e54bed6aafe9168676b16c7dd77766a575c"}

{"id": "p_2f87daea01d2b508", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 72, "text": "若妻信病，賜小豆四十斛，寬假限日；若其虛詐，便收送之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "2cea78306c4412c5ad67eba15940b2851979ff1a05b6cdd65a31e013fa8b696e"}

{"id": "p_24bdf55058c07eac", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 73, "text": "於是傳付許獄，考驗首服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "69cbc38cfa9b297f358994a7a15a6cc203170ea441d2091766de348cddd4c297"}

{"id": "p_c846226b714bee2b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 74, "text": "荀彧請曰：「佗術實工，人命所縣，宜含宥之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "6b12639f45894fbfc3e26c8732a7c6efb08da583286f5ff2988c27994be26a18"}

{"id": "p_82006c96e7d323c5", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」太祖曰：「不憂，天下當無此鼠輩耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "f0ae28a575ee20df9c22d283a2b3c6a3bfc62cd5bd61a21a77915a571dafcdd5"}

{"id": "p_c3e54926902faafb", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 76, "text": "佗臨死，出一卷書與獄吏，曰：「此可以活人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "754814266f37047b0b2d7941def8663022ac94fb08e1ae1f99c09da19974c3c0"}

{"id": "p_302b8de51d8da232", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」吏畏法不受，佗亦不強，索火燒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "7ba7e34140efce8b97d9b051401f4474b9b6d27164dc2cbafbd005a565d82fce"}

{"id": "p_994153d0d3d34725", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 78, "text": "小人養吾病，欲以自重，然吾不殺此子，亦終當不為我斷此根原耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "cda05a2358eaa20fc265cd7517adfb9bb1bd5da1d8cca688a3663953ee581310"}

{"id": "p_aab5f44ba193c94a", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 79, "text": "」及後愛子倉舒病困，太祖歎曰：「吾悔殺華佗，令此兒強死也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "ae43d9c3a169e92d64130057b5040fd71aa5f881fbf3681032ef5519cffb050d"}

{"id": "p_0fee51c3e66d7f9d", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 80, "text": "初，軍吏李成苦欬嗽，晝夜不寤，時吐膿血，以問佗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "ca46cb6a29aa8dd5b6d31cd92b6ce17e5e3bae170e2917e6f240fd56d8466e7c"}

{"id": "p_c5db6bcbb8c3ccc5", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 81, "text": "佗言：「君病腸臃，欬之所吐，非從肺來也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "ecd338180907449a02e04cb444f8bbc8f37e3adcac826ad276001c12fb140e57"}

{"id": "p_e418d75f1e9f3814", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 82, "text": "與君散兩錢，當吐二升餘膿血訖，快自養，一月可小起，好自將愛，一年便健。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "acb9e07c9ae2e242d454bddf05655bf63d1c2e80dcd97793ab6dc2754ad78f35"}

{"id": "p_eb2a884b45a4dd48", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 83, "text": "十八歲當一小發，服此散，亦行復差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "76d229b72b41cb431d0248244d3aebf7b7e754df00ceca91f9c4dde9b7f36ef2"}

{"id": "p_4cd1f8bc8ec5ac3b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」復與兩錢散，成得藥去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "36619dc4f02b9c3f44c9091c88796e3512eaf4f02cf9a660de38bf555cf4a944"}

{"id": "p_472add9a302ab63b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 85, "text": "五六歲，親中人有病如成者，謂成曰：「卿今強健，我欲死，何忍無急去藥，以待不祥？", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "8a267791753bfa0b892dc286f28842294dcc146bf0e49435b7bdf4d0a442a479"}

{"id": "p_3dd5bf02064ce11c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 86, "text": "先持貸我，我差，為卿從華佗更索。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "7736cf16703d433dc96ddcca81841f58eb0dc1a3a81fc946d0b078093a47b82c"}

{"id": "p_bcddec39af94c61e", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 87, "text": "已故到譙，適值佗見收，怱怱不忍從求。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "656a16a38af8db428066d88a25d537242799bd23d91538c3c70906dc1ffc413d"}

{"id": "p_a3295097f01ea26c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 88, "text": "後十八歲，成病竟發，無藥可服，以至於死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "f03e1b318dd8048930bd237373df9787ad5e32f93dbf14fc44d6fc9c68e59e7f"}

{"id": "p_46d3aad45e575caf", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 89, "text": "廣陵吳普、彭城樊阿皆從佗學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "c66d7d7c1fb65f1aa23e08b756e29f37fbf503c259b851e06565741fbf37c768"}

{"id": "p_d7b99cfb0f0027bc", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 90, "text": "佗語普曰：「人體欲得勞動，但不當使極爾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "e6159ba02a309329185dc3fd6e375d8a33ccc1fe770f7d3e217ae0d6756d327c"}

{"id": "p_4b4a213af4393ff3", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 91, "text": "動搖則谷氣得消，血脈流通，病不得生，譬猶戶樞不朽是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "bef64fa1a5c194d4caa488f6c1353307b8a7b5bdbb0d912ed06047049332d844"}

{"id": "p_251599892ba076f7", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 92, "text": "是以古之仙者為導引之事，熊頸鴟顧，引輓腰體，動諸關節，以求難老。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "cbd24012e996c00df597c5b5fb2f4f058e296d003bd8ef487a36d814faa06910"}

{"id": "p_a6adb6eea685a04e", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 93, "text": "吾有一術，名五禽之戲，一曰虎，二曰鹿，三曰熊，四曰猿，五曰鳥，亦以除疾，並利蹄足，以當導引。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "76e3e9f7bccd8c5dc9ce7b4f73bd40e3b5ce7e6b3cd33f51f14a37fcd318a547"}

{"id": "p_df94b5cc5a545b6a", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 94, "text": "體中不快，起作一禽之戲，沾濡汗出，因上著粉，身體輕便，腹中欲食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "c657f6d26bae289181501d81de51d2dfc45e0a6fa739070a0b1021ea5d80e7e7"}

{"id": "p_574da701460a95ed", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」普施行之，年九十餘，耳目聰明，齒牙完堅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "98f412473f58d3554785dafaaf0ca672a9300286d017c512aa2122df67e16d4c"}

{"id": "p_748e4a9816d48041", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 96, "text": "凡醫咸言背及胸藏之間不可妄針，針之不過四分，而阿針背入一二寸，巨闕胸藏針下五六寸，而病輒皆瘳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "6d32d0952cea3055fa4a08801aeae7d356d154550b51ec2bf1016cfee085c13a"}

{"id": "p_584698afc6d05d57", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 97, "text": "阿從佗求可服食益於人者，佗授以漆葉青黏散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "e2c6c3311a0207616daabde15c7956a652af3cf2637b2495cf40ee1d72a8368c"}

{"id": "p_9e52af5cba687c4b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 98, "text": "漆葉屑一升，青黏屑十四兩，以是為率，言久服去三蟲，利五藏，輕體，使人頭不白。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "81475d55bb961bf8db17b62ae25d2ff2ee02879789aeb234f9daa8ed960e9c77"}

{"id": "p_c79a3f56cd32f783", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 99, "text": "漆葉處所而有，青黏生於豐、沛、彭城及朝歌云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "1f0aea1c8ba31b941517ca1ed95d1a9fbfe2975079275b2caeac77b3be258cc1"}

{"id": "p_cdcfb4eb4a08713c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 100, "text": "以知音為雅樂郎，，疾去官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "72ed616fada83cdf66b8183fc7ad42f73ea97585fba4d62fc804be265abc3a5d"}

{"id": "p_04eecf898ae2d2f9", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 101, "text": "州郡司徒禮辟，以世亂奔荊州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "ab2bba02da7f13cd6adf3c194acdc1165e2afd525ca9b7942e6cc1bd9fbcd17b"}

{"id": "p_2a15315e3aa7414e", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 102, "text": "荊州牧劉表令與孟曜為漢主合雅樂，樂備，表欲庭觀之，夔諫曰：「今將軍號（不）為天子合樂，而庭作之，無乃不可乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "975dfb01dc0c6d14e8cf0ed53f6df764e1fab362704f966c1328f95c01a5950d"}

{"id": "p_f39e0c47a3916e56", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 103, "text": "後表子琮降太祖，太祖以夔為軍謀祭酒，參太樂事，因令創製雅樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "bf9a05bbe025fb91ec2730790af403b740e4438991de5973e34e2c95140ec53f"}

{"id": "p_624e601c182ca741", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 104, "text": "夔善鐘律，聰思過人，絲竹八音，靡所不能，惟歌舞非所長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "52295f892ae58f6c58e10afa6e175db9ef2207ea4951fa3ef10ceb9c3ae72df0"}

{"id": "p_db3d5dd679ae6271", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 105, "text": "時散郎鄧靜、尹齊善詠雅樂，歌師尹胡能歌宗廟郊祀之曲，舞師馮肅、服養曉知先代諸舞，夔總統研精，遠考諸經，近採故事，教習講肄，備作樂器，紹复先代古樂，皆自夔始也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "78c920ee5c344e6d1f3e7632680f0e51d6a8dc61b4962b561b88e1e84bd67e54"}

{"id": "p_2f3d99db7bf17767", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 106, "text": "黃初中，為太樂令、協律都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "b3befe45c1930187330bee263aaa52df3c681460ef8832cada82b33b39a0403b"}

{"id": "p_e67aabe71ad62c9b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 107, "text": "漢鑄鐘工柴玉巧有意思，形器之中，多所造作，亦為時貴人見知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "7a40289138499a033a045ed2e789a16f8b30cc260c8d54f0ccd3daf7ea9bc578"}

{"id": "p_0d96f60c09247cbd", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 108, "text": "夔令玉鑄銅鐘，其聲均清濁多不如法，數毀改作。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "221c69d500d37f99f88511cd47808a79907e1b940af4125b49316935edb3e93a"}

{"id": "p_4a152d05225e63a3", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 109, "text": "玉甚厭之，謂夔清濁任意，頗拒捍夔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "f57b633ec75efee944395db0c304ee69cefddd40735ac135960c270cd7a05640"}

{"id": "p_e9f16c5e3226b1bd", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 110, "text": "夔、玉更相白於太祖，太祖取所鑄鐘，雜錯更試，然知夔為精而玉之妄也，於是罪玉及諸子，皆為養馬士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "8a2bd000a70d8d04beaddad2d9d22171a0789d2e3ee62a962c25d5a6acb1dc07"}

{"id": "p_bdbebdf8011ae7b6", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 111, "text": "文帝愛待玉，又嘗令夔與（左原）〔左〕等於賓客之中吹笙鼓琴，夔有難色，由是帝意不悅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "bbfa9280bee56bc5806c5bb9c2be046fb76b570f98c4af036e38225e20573564"}

{"id": "p_fdddec4dadf02e57", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 112, "text": "後因他事系夔，使（原）等就學，夔自謂所習者雅，仕宦有本，意猶不滿，遂黜免以卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "94e07ecc4ab600346a0e2ac6490aac00eb651a4e449f24d00a81a95e8caf1231"}

{"id": "p_a3bfddd4716faea3", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 113, "text": "弟子河南邵登、張泰、桑馥，各至太樂丞，下邳陳頏司律中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "0986a1ea778ed960c91895ca6459254190a2c5871401920c3a973b838e834fde"}

{"id": "p_d3c64a4f3b243836", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 114, "text": "自左延年等雖妙於音，咸善鄭聲，其好古存正莫及夔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "1b90e6cf9dd3ac62dae358133b6fe7047771d1f430074028908f932eed8ceed9"}

{"id": "p_5f8c151c2c0836a9", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 115, "text": "善相術，於閭巷之間，效驗非一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "b2647bade1805dece1ec14a5482c0b89c82aa40ef9beff6a33bebe7339f4403a"}

{"id": "p_fde6632a59379658", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 116, "text": "太祖為魏公，聞之，召為郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "d9f67896b3a3d5257c7daae0f47b903f5ca472237da65e8d5463494fc5d23a71"}

{"id": "p_6ebc21b891b4fdf7", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 117, "text": "文帝為五官將，坐上會客三十餘人，文帝問己年壽，又令遍相眾賓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "948d7c575587c3c0b9eb2276201f10eca9a9a732f40a5210b4cef3b1158219e5"}

{"id": "p_6ae6cf5ec34337a1", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 118, "text": "建平曰：「將軍當壽八十，至四十時當有小厄，願謹護之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "4c7686b4bcda729c6434eba25b5d9698ad9dc1b8a3e0cf249a2355d644a8b148"}

{"id": "p_eafb662d147137cf", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 119, "text": "」謂夏侯威曰：「君四十九位為州牧，而當有厄，厄若得過，可年至七十，致位公輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "d01ee7a8895698fa4156a41418d32ba25352bfd90fd750b436bef5083cb413de"}

{"id": "p_3fd6784b1f86a3d8", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 120, "text": "」謂應璩曰：「君六十二位為常伯，而當有厄，先此一年，當獨見一白狗，而旁人不見也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "77f57b1b5d6273920a674a56ff6d264c0307d76884458bdb548e88be2ece0d24"}

{"id": "p_1bb53fc74e8c17dc", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 121, "text": "」謂曹彪曰：「君據藩國，至五十七當厄於兵，宜善防之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "ca01455bbdc3bddf67d81a43f1393a643681b3351b6b188b5948f6f9599045c8"}

{"id": "p_0dc3f6e41894c908", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 122, "text": "初，潁川荀攸、鍾繇相與親善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "52e28e5b2d504ea6ac5359671d5c9f38c917107379e17d05b053bfd0b7fe8c4d"}

{"id": "p_0d7f3c843796b622", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 123, "text": "繇經紀其門戶，欲嫁其妾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "cec0deb0a9c4f5b1986b059197478123a1f55224e4f2bbd0b9c36f63a29c3bb1"}

{"id": "p_fa5a2d6965fb0f3f", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 124, "text": "與人書曰：「吾與公達曾共使朱建平相，建平曰：『荀君雖少，然當以後事付鍾君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "7e2da62200f17a5ba8e319123fe809dffc48c5c2d101a365d70bb20904dbd5de"}

{"id": "p_49a9a800b8b7905c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 125, "text": "』吾時啁之曰：『惟當嫁卿阿騖耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "37209b5e75c6ecb0169af3407a43bffcfd3ff8cc894ece87b14740f34c9fbccf"}

{"id": "p_bb446ac72dead4d6", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 126, "text": "』何意此子竟早隕沒，戲言遂驗乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "ee064e0ccdae88b008a873e3fbbd5a7c95aab53d6a912514a2da8d35a93f0495"}

{"id": "p_368f0e11505c3174", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 127, "text": "追思建平之妙，雖唐舉、許負何以復加也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "4d5b66c429ea5b5806a7395ebc7b10facd1b71bc9c4be70332c712670fd650d1"}

{"id": "p_86983bb100e699b2", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 128, "text": "文帝，年四十，病困，謂左右曰：「建平所言八十，謂晝夜也，吾其決矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "34152ae5e4ad25f01bc4629b3f5ccd93ee6fbdbb09b8ead14a707569db245618"}

{"id": "p_e398fd331b5a569b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 129, "text": "夏侯威為兗州刺史，年四十九，十二月上旬得疾，念建平之言，自分必死，豫作遺令及送喪之備，咸使素辦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "5bf6833cb163f15562c7a82a02b31d794fc142181b71308bef2aeca8e05a6df5"}

{"id": "p_f333c5f0c70be7ec", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 130, "text": "三十日日昃，請紀綱大吏設酒，曰：「吾所苦漸平，明日雞鳴，年便五十，建平之戒，眞必過矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "242c0c8bc50e91c134697f5164715aa59bfdcf0ead7ee3c24e6739c49594036a"}

{"id": "p_c3d1347e413f224c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 131, "text": "」威罷客之後，合瞑疾動，夜半遂卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "99685ed633d0a0cb196d632abec59b05e39b2ae2800333c400688f2bda952aed"}

{"id": "p_9fa106dafa45a8ee", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 132, "text": "璩六十一為侍中，直省內，欻見白狗，問之眾人，悉無見者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "306cf537e730585d6ff694ab2750be47cf1f7e387dfff5d38c86f0cad541e8ec"}

{"id": "p_88e9958ee14ec1c9", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 133, "text": "於是數聚會，並急遊觀田裡，飲宴自娛，過期一年，六十三卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "1d3dfe2fc8838144ec62e2b3f3b369fe865de48b8a391e69801831cccc618cb1"}

{"id": "p_b4b287a67ec0961c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 134, "text": "曹彪封楚王，年五十七，坐與王淩通謀，賜死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "53ff456ff6d191cf370ab0d05e6db57239f72ff9fcf15e8b01be72a5c168855e"}

{"id": "p_a234df85c2d8ee02", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 135, "text": "凡說此輩，無不如言，不能具詳，故粗記數事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "a2495ad52e5aaa5abbbba4ec8b650bc895517b6f5f346c13ec1cc770bd6f5708"}

{"id": "p_7e4128ca2648959a", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 136, "text": "惟相司空王昶、征北將軍程喜、中領軍王肅有蹉跌云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "8e0f0f2521538b36176fe8a330b46a05f98ae369b5aecffa6849826abe0af58c"}

{"id": "p_b0242338f34ca449", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 137, "text": "肅年六十二，疾篤，眾醫並以為不愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "452c3cc4b4806854d790c193c19760d60742bfd4572e7f7adf38b4b0a199a52d"}

{"id": "p_34250c8d8d9e92a9", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 138, "text": "肅夫人問以遺言，肅云：「建平相我踰七十，位至三公，今皆未也，將何慮乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "c7b315e6308fda1b8eef3a1f01496fe4124a6efd7b97cb225bdf469bd5b54961"}

{"id": "p_0fd39f39e4f2bd88", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 139, "text": "文帝將出，取馬外入，建平道遇之，語曰：「此馬之相，今日死矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "44a13757f07cc8b2ee80120ab33bee37a698a48d0966726a047945b596033301"}

{"id": "p_44a1dd516539fbb1", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」帝將乘馬，馬惡衣香，驚囓文帝膝，帝大怒，即便殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "76119a76d4d17aa67518d643b8d24a09fc7f2caf2b869378ed2bdf13567bdb31"}

{"id": "p_7746119fd8973876", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 141, "text": "太守楊沛夢人曰：「八月一日曹公當至，必與君杖，飲以藥酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "c0fe5122089a9869b1ab1e7d9b11d7f613bebc78cf6b6fba1c4c3b193d4718ca"}

{"id": "p_ca89a1ab0324a4d8", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 142, "text": "是時黃巾賊起，宣對曰：「夫杖起弱者，藥治人病，八月一日，賊必除滅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "a90d1744f1060c6bf0c546b2824f975b0cbebe70b1893b24a5b1eb687f339eb8"}

{"id": "p_7b81a59d4b59294a", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 143, "text": "後東平劉楨夢蛇生四足，穴居門中，使宣占之，宣曰：「此為國夢，非君家之事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "06bb6cf1570c728730eeed6812e987bafd7424e9bc34ff0e51e4b813bfb50131"}

{"id": "p_cad8250c4690a0fa", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」頃之，女賊鄭、姜遂俱夷討，以蛇女子之祥，足非蛇之所宜故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "eabaa968744483ad388725de646a2efa6a76879c6c70e4c81adfb35cc005ba08"}

{"id": "p_c1ba2a794680d643", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 145, "text": "文帝問宣曰：「吾夢殿屋兩瓦墮地，化為雙鴛鴦，此何謂也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "0be5b762e2dfffdfb61f3a53b99aefa3cf274427dd9683c9b2a30f1e0f669c83"}

{"id": "p_9e4e997835f5220a", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」宣對曰：「後宮當有暴死者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "3d546171503d467d9de369978d2cb8218dc13f595ef9aee73b34806b8e06c52f"}

{"id": "p_fe16f049f0f99f82", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」宣對曰：「夫夢者意耳，苟以形言，便佔吉凶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "e6c30eed533dce73d1b77c8088fa4843b1813d9269db48dcd33dc87baa22fc35"}

{"id": "p_c5c973dd80256352", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」言未畢，而黃門令奏宮人相殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "fd2cfb5e65fec8e31a17a6c8705f5306b41a3fc3d46e04282ea03df40d23f9a7"}

{"id": "p_7ae38fecaa8f0d30", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 149, "text": "無幾，帝復問曰：「我昨夜夢青氣自地屬天。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "23efebbee4ca58f75642f5f6330198a6ef3f2c7861f3d7d435f026b2b094fb3f"}

{"id": "p_65ca9c2a8e9e25be", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」宣對曰：「天下當有貴女子冤死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "7c51b3d5efe8b65a68104db69683e8abe3b4f37f3e0ce0707309987030a39c2f"}

{"id": "p_a1637b30bcb2350b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」是時，帝已遣使賜甄後璽書，聞宣言而悔之，遣人追使者不及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "efee9473cbf4bd3bec9121b71fe037bb7163ec013c0499f70e5eb62d83bc2dfc"}

{"id": "p_ec1b22e6aeb0a1e1", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 152, "text": "帝復問曰：「吾夢摩錢文，欲令滅而更愈明，此何謂邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "c3b528d9dc97827eaf11e98412cb2b44f1308b0e41afbf5bb186377b8797449b"}

{"id": "p_c64bac61fb1d4c93", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 153, "text": "帝重問之，宣對曰：「此自陛下家事，雖意欲爾而太后不聽，是以文欲滅而明耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "c614a9090b5486cd1b30248fcbc2f7626088855d889fc2ede87b4126f89c7f00"}

{"id": "p_3387cbc96825ebe2", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」時帝欲治弟植之罪，偪於太后，但加貶爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "8b6bbe9b702a5eacd9230d99a2a533d8491b8a32948783f78f0cd348cd6b2438"}

{"id": "p_026bb812a8e297d5", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 155, "text": "嘗有問宣曰：「吾昨夜夢見芻狗，其占何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "37ec2e8631eb169e69ac12cac5379a08ebc67d1d3c28d223e0714242a0dc915e"}

{"id": "p_5e9714e9943defe0", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 156, "text": "」宣答曰：「君欲得美食耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "966587a713f4eafbd99f9c616cdbf51149fe9afc9285575df3aafde9febae5b2"}

{"id": "p_c8b31cfba5756366", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 157, "text": "」有頃，出行，果遇豐膳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "6649704ba56369990a7dcdf9dcd37d5155a6307f9bf2856563f5aed59a7435a5"}

{"id": "p_fb7624df391b4541", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 158, "text": "後又問宣曰：「昨夜復夢見芻狗，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "dcd8996b447c54ac2ed3c5ed2896dad308283251fcd187e1387f5332a9534f4f"}

{"id": "p_76e66e82994fb360", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 159, "text": "」宣曰：「君欲墮車折腳，宜戒慎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "6a005e72044f2f1bcb519005a338af21ff07ef21d3fc5cbafe0e4e7998f57ea6"}

{"id": "p_bbfcf91cdf957bf9", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 160, "text": "後又問宣：「昨夜復夢見芻狗，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "83e092e76ed3189844182953c5167a4b6214decad5139ae86cddbd02187ef7be"}

{"id": "p_5371f226941b44a8", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 161, "text": "」宣曰：「君家失火，當善護之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "a4a6471e19493d0cbcfb729fd30ecab8252f05e03cb166c6c43801b24ea261ff"}

{"id": "p_edd6a5735bb0e74c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 162, "text": "語宣曰：「前後三時，皆不夢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "2e46d9a8a71715ca9c8de33ff3af91b5c3e397751767f942cd1193e973c4facb"}

{"id": "p_3e3c6b34ec43fcf1", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」宣對曰：「此神靈動君使言，故與眞夢無異也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "495a6e5afab64fa6d32060cc00a1243e682dca79ae17d98a4744b136b2f50ca5"}

{"id": "p_1e2043cbe000c022", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 164, "text": "」又問宣曰：「三夢芻狗而其占不同，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "c52aa26056fc28115a4ca1f4d89f58de23841cc6b624ed743d924a26970dcde2"}

{"id": "p_974695a5eaca6bb9", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 165, "text": "」宣曰：「芻狗者，祭神之物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "1a75267c5fc8950237a8d6a6d7ddaf82d30f6d5969eb704144702176ff83d181"}

{"id": "p_822c9fe9764b96e6", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 166, "text": "祭祀既訖，則芻狗為車所轢，故中夢當墮車折腳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "4c7987cd6bbbfb5094b59813ca5b88f214a26a41ecbe5b8bb7fa771c26ba6bb4"}

{"id": "p_e8ea2d6a27ee3070", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 167, "text": "芻狗既車轢之後，必載以為樵，故後夢憂失火也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "d04f751e93df79539a34abc3e989da48cf99a2a809bea52fbce413d3f0e1ec86"}

{"id": "p_88699e9abdf02b75", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 168, "text": "十中八九，世以比建平之相矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "f2edfe9eb25bf97dba113fd3c3a3b13175c1cc26005477f316aa01bb74daeb13"}

{"id": "p_a9f681617daff18f", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 169, "text": "容貌粗醜，無威儀而嗜酒，飲食言戲，不擇非類，故人多愛之而不敬也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "12996705bda9eb1d480294e2e36e6dd936e151435aab782ee5ef2ae86de95f45"}

{"id": "p_120c0f9a5f0f7d87", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 170, "text": "父為利漕，利漕民郭恩兄弟三人，皆得躄疾，使輅筮其所由。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "01f3c0180dfce13dde647fd5044bbf009354d80c00089865321e42dfd70d3bc7"}

{"id": "p_60b6f6d841ecaf9d", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 171, "text": "輅曰：「卦中有君本墓，墓中有女鬼，非君伯母，當叔母也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "8448c547279a5832847f4addf88e663e0ca80cc396c27e574e73e5f02761b4dc"}

{"id": "p_ced4f4a97f45b522", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 172, "text": "昔飢荒之世，當有利其數升米者，排著井中，嘖嘖有聲，推一大石，下破其頭，孤魂冤痛，自訴於天。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "dc5ba67a5048ba3cba129b2e22ef0e7f106efea36f2a2ee7e0fbcdae0fc4d3f5"}

{"id": "p_63718d4e5aaa4932", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 173, "text": "廣平劉奉林婦病困，已買棺器。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "1eff0f10337c30b06315a35167776678bc660521505009e8592b838471c8e0f7"}

{"id": "p_ce75d8ac1bb0c703", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 174, "text": "時正月也，使輅佔，曰：「命在八月辛卯日日中之時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "643ab09f855e29f57d902c6482f6c9836364dd4c50b4d5eb3725bb36bdb2ceaa"}

{"id": "p_43362ab55b850649", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 175, "text": "」林謂必不然，而婦漸差，至秋發動，一如輅言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "d2a68e0d95c4f53074ce10d91bf3c98264437b4ae8bb3de8aee66449f7689956"}

{"id": "p_e18eaa7556979e69", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 176, "text": "輅往見安平太守王基，基令作卦，輅曰：「當有賤婦人，生一男兒，墮地便走入灶中死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "cb300379d6120c88c4404d97165c669723ca69aa0c37d3b75e60680d68132f4f"}

{"id": "p_ad564ed7e8f607ab", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 177, "text": "又床上當有一大蛇銜筆，小大共視，須臾去之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "8fac7f404a07b5a1927d855e70b66bb266490787f245a1f367b361d3caf97600"}

{"id": "p_8b97df715529a4f6", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 178, "text": "又烏來入室中，與燕共鬥，燕死，烏去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "ca3814902e70e6c4802f0bc412718811886e2d4a0600a2875c7056796a47b3c9"}

{"id": "p_a97c94f568e8d62d", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 179, "text": "輅曰：「直客舍久遠，魑魅魍魎為怪耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "c13134611d4d25e173552a62c0a1b77af3bad90cf59215f1510c0dc48556daf7"}

{"id": "p_bc2efabcc16e1b8c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 180, "text": "兒生便走，非能自走，直宋無忌之妖將其入灶也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "8c0439f18a68e8fb3f583a258a4f016d17e1f84035e743cf04230e476c3cdc15"}

{"id": "p_a37d5a134efb3673", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 181, "text": "今卦中見象而不見其凶，知非妖咎之徵，自無所憂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "d673a80ae0c21acb7d621f824b00dd3585b11ef4758eeabac653b7845be6908c"}

{"id": "p_10b4a75902ca0a17", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 182, "text": "時信都令家婦女驚恐，更互疾病，使輅筮之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "251df5a8187a8bc65cf2db3a6ac3059a12f8f8c7ff32db4c2968225012ea5f9d"}

{"id": "p_4fea67894013b38e", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 183, "text": "輅曰：「君北堂西頭，有兩死男子，一男持矛，一男持弓箭，頭在壁內，腳在壁外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "294a702969b8d4efa58726b1b5621fafc567c0ce844e6028ab84665255314921"}

{"id": "p_24f63fabea8d8ae3", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 184, "text": "持矛者主刺頭，故頭重痛不得舉也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "10576e472f5438c107642333c311d7576c5bc5e74618b7545d83fd65cc91261e"}

{"id": "p_456376508828a6e4", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 185, "text": "持弓箭者主射肫腹，故心中縣痛不得飲食也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "35ecfeb7b27dbc730316d673912d2c7407eb31070ebdafcda60003dd6512aaeb"}

{"id": "p_e9e8e089c0c41c71", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 186, "text": "晝則浮游，夜來病人，故使驚恐也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "a863f9fcd90dc6f7592b10f547b4a41febc754110933101be5f4cbe46e2b5f3c"}

{"id": "p_5f676d51304e40b6", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 187, "text": "」於是掘徙骸骨，家中皆愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "3eace253207c3134cc29202ec06a82af2d8f0fb984d9f6d0f2a7e87207e911f7"}

{"id": "p_d2a583637b0e1d84", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 188, "text": "清河王經去官還家，輅與相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "66a0208aa8387b80946e558104f19152869279f5c35f0c83818073d9278e205f"}

{"id": "p_05e5231c4eb5fc6b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 189, "text": "經曰：「近有一怪，大不喜之，欲煩作卦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "f034d7a89eb69a7569b89f23074773b7337c0024dfcbad795f6ca9ecea283e15"}

{"id": "p_9b8d4c316f192b67", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 190, "text": "」卦成，輅曰：「爻吉，不為怪也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "adb336528c45e59034d0a4da2754528d376ecff8e57f0041a0c560a951ef1451"}

{"id": "p_28755c1df2656263", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 191, "text": "君夜在堂戶前，有一流光如燕爵者，入君懷中，殷殷有聲，內神不安，解衣彷徉，招呼婦人，覓索餘光。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "044a10746bcd4d5c3f73273b0365135bb756833305ab79471ceb18ad9fa5c405"}

{"id": "p_9f1b3e9b5b238bfc", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 192, "text": "」經大笑曰：「實如君言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "c39759a540ad6c7c44d1af74ff183ab8ba5a0c58d5ed32717ff8d77fd2219c04"}

{"id": "p_67c9aa36dd9ad2ae", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 193, "text": "」輅曰：「吉，遷官之徵也，其應行至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "bafee0b56e27d012758218afc071cf83aa569a343bcbdc48705d8981ae59a190"}

{"id": "p_5061f16759832b71", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 194, "text": "輅又至郭恩家，有飛鳩來在梁頭，鳴甚悲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "e003ac3bbbae1d34b6fcabfd22e2bc1be28f0ad37e33f3fb2fdad56ffe4aded7"}

{"id": "p_7e6051281474ae15", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 195, "text": "輅曰：「當有老公從東方來，攜豚一頭，酒一壺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "357431666cea244195d26627a5ca84a298120eb1cc7001041b80be31300b48c3"}

{"id": "p_b4a02b849d4b4497", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 196, "text": "恩使客節酒、戒肉、慎火，而射雞作食，箭從樹間激中數歲女子手，流血驚怖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "852fdcb8269129e48ca7d02d9af4b622b00d1f66bdb2b593ba4bb38090058c2a"}

{"id": "p_9cebac46ad9529f4", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 197, "text": "輅至安德令劉長仁家，有鳴鵲來在閤屋上，其聲甚急。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "8cfa69e19a187da4670d3001052ba942737cd819f646ac7e8e2fadd3aebff3f2"}

{"id": "p_1a09261f735043a4", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 198, "text": "輅曰：「鵲言東北有婦昨殺夫，牽引西家人夫離婁，候不過日在虞淵之際，告者至矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "0da21da3b7158f98e5c89cc060e549229d78763949051f3ce063329f670e23b9"}

{"id": "p_31940795de2e969f", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 199, "text": "」到時，果有東北同伍民來告，鄰婦手殺其夫，詐言西家人與夫有嫌，來殺我婿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "e4a51086ed23036a21e0ab93b55e3c7572528a6de41b703d0350c9c61e90e03a"}

{"id": "p_d96ee79d10bb8bf4", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 200, "text": "輅至列人典農王弘直許，有飄風高三尺餘，從申上來，在庭中幢幢迴轉，息以復起，良久乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "ba5618ae7f66ade963abb08881a2965732ff23d8d4b14f175dcc1e9fab92b03b"}

{"id": "p_aafd0f92eb331b7a", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 201, "text": "直以問輅，輅曰：「東方當有馬吏至，恐父哭子，如何！", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "69b30649c0fca47803ad37135b2d6a6d707fb16f7efbf84f85fcdb3ea79f66d8"}

{"id": "p_ba0d0bdeb8308a31", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 202, "text": "」明日膠東吏到，直子果亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "a7d6099f6485c54c9b6228c58b8facd2951ab31054da8d2a11797c3fac2d8f5d"}

{"id": "p_8cabb38291f12744", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 203, "text": "直問其故，輅曰：「其日乙卯，則長子之候也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "9139a5ad5f9104b018fc1f027bf82431cd8038c8f0c8346fa6fa683d8616c502"}

{"id": "p_cd2f96c133440065", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 204, "text": "木落於申，鬥建申，申破寅，死喪之候也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "a646d1132b036fea536d02757a57b4ef8efc4c89c479074e77ac454f640e2703"}

{"id": "p_baf6ec19b0bb0efe", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 205, "text": "日加午而風發，則馬之候也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "af0b4bf37313973fe30ce4d035fb4874f33fde58d05003b21e54810af5af0060"}

{"id": "p_4b5ba74a0ecb9186", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 206, "text": "申未為虎，虎為大人，則父之候也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "69cf214bc963c82d56b9106880d32c769981768726fd8ec86f3087564f77a756"}

{"id": "p_1edacfb5d1bfbeae", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 207, "text": "」有雄雉飛來，登直內鈴柱頭，直大以不安，令輅作卦，輅曰：「到五月必遷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "f4d4f992cbe12d9e2e6e10ae66695a8b72ed3d966bae1215d550cde9fff4ca00"}

{"id": "p_c7bf8ba2348cfe5d", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 208, "text": "」時三月也，至期，直果為勃海太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "ae913494eec20068332ab5e4c2f12c16a238553b275579d99dc7923fc8d73539"}

{"id": "p_ad5b6534dabded0d", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 209, "text": "館陶令諸葛原遷新興太守，輅往祖餞之，賓客並會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "061f452e1ea0b7c1c9b053a2a76e689727c85aef2a43a14b821c551fc40c0dc1"}

{"id": "p_a5fd6deeb4972f82", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 210, "text": "原自起取燕卵、蜂窠、蜘蛛著器中，使射覆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "521929a9a40e9f1b9cad801a6d8312b436fe9ab9eb043c1fdb994c5567e552de"}

{"id": "p_4099fd2500b439d7", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 211, "text": "卦成，輅曰：「第一物，含氣須變，依乎宇堂，雄雌以形，翅翼舒張，此燕卵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "7b6f5bd59c765218fa558ce3482c88150cf83568f629624c2f25f8d0a3816bb0"}

{"id": "p_36ef1b2cfac55237", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 212, "text": "第二物，家室倒縣，門戶眾多，藏精育毒，得秋乃化，此蜂窠也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "4d46976fd5452f92fca7310ed3119d2cda4462d5ebce6941586fc143154477c7"}

{"id": "p_9df62937b94d43e9", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 213, "text": "第三物，觳觫長足，吐絲成羅，尋網求食，利在昬夜，此蜘蛛也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "9805f017e590b44da8bdc4a3dc931eb43ad1a06668a0989c9535f34faa8312a7"}

{"id": "p_1053946f4cc842a2", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 214, "text": "輅族兄孝國，居在斥丘，輅往從之，與二客會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "b125832b22eee8b8bac336118e57522d6a7fd7670d4d4f85e8b6413a48563300"}

{"id": "p_7a590719eab3f05f", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 215, "text": "客去後，輅謂孝國曰：「此二人天庭及口耳之間同有凶氣，異變俱起，雙魂無宅，流魂於海，骨歸於家，少許時當並死也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "17464522ab2deb6b004d1ed2c966613a76e592ffbc14b92ab42ab008a7a4191f"}

{"id": "p_8de4e64be16f6334", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 216, "text": "」復數十日，二人飲酒醉，夜共載車，牛驚下道入漳河中，皆即溺死也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "a1d3874d11a6e2cda1d89dba1395925f3f481e68bcec288a5396cdb8ea941d1e"}

{"id": "p_e20812d9095f5417", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 217, "text": "當此之時，輅之鄰裡，外戶不閉，無相偷竊者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "bc8df2c238a5414f27cf8073fea6d9939dfd418be8304d4c1a31b788e5d14131"}

{"id": "p_0d1cd6ecab12635e", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 218, "text": "清河太守華表，召輅為文學掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "be4555cfb972ce60b1aa409eaa97f6301adcc91f9c06a895c4fda84d4da13de3"}

{"id": "p_3038342b44d4bb53", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 219, "text": "安平趙孔曜薦輅於冀州刺史裴徽曰：「輅雅性寬大，與世無忌，仰觀天文則同妙甘公、石申，俯覽周易則齊思季主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "795ed74704a77203af5d485f0956d9890622ab8818646e186b94ebc4108707d8"}

{"id": "p_99236b77760f6d6c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 220, "text": "今明使君方垂神幽藪，留精九皋，輅宜蒙陰和之應，得及羽儀之時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "b3ab209a18858df939628d99f8dd16b1471c823cfd63125aff39f72584d0e103"}

{"id": "p_4c34b4d11e77090b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 221, "text": "」徽於是辟為文學從事，引與相見，大善友之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "43e567a65159e45118477f878c47053ee75faa4b724476a79950b81decfad086"}

{"id": "p_d8d2617d085b9b72", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 222, "text": "初應州召，與弟季儒共載，至武城西，自卦吉凶，語儒云：「當在故城中見三貍，爾者乃顯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "51373d07028613ae679bc70dababa4168da34ba456bf17de4cbeb35ada741c99"}

{"id": "p_9bb46d9631e0f91b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 223, "text": "」前到河西故城角，正見三貍共踞城側，兄弟並喜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "f44711f450f782313e64998653f15c2105f3bf499e7a9d61d02f490ff39a4969"}

{"id": "p_143e6a7d034c6ca8", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 224, "text": "十二月二十八日，吏部尚書何晏請之，鄧颺在晏許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "1da61145c414c3c0e859cf9a1250dd126b90ce884035757916c5a5abeddaa9ec"}

{"id": "p_6e2e1db5ca45da82", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 225, "text": "晏謂輅曰：「聞君著爻神妙，試為作一卦，知位當至三公不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "a34ca328793674e956a0918c2388b7bad2d3bfd54768924cee472ab21e2c55f6"}

{"id": "p_0fce4334c0c94765", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 226, "text": "」又問：「連夢見青蠅數十頭，來在鼻上，驅之不肯去，有何意故？", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "65d3a4ccf13cfd25335667ac9bb8c4298385b1d5f8d88faf7a76c077046522c3"}

{"id": "p_d4197600f254c043", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 227, "text": "」輅曰：「夫飛鴞，天下賤鳥，及其在林食椹，則懷我好音，況輅心非草木，敢不盡忠？", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "46d67b69585d2cf5c91b8806d9772473aac2f601c7b08bcac649e7e0dfab80d0"}

{"id": "p_0a0d0e837357ff41", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 228, "text": "昔元、凱之弼重華，宣惠慈和，周公之翼成王，坐而待旦，故能流光六合，萬國咸寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "b843f8112c0386b31684026cf6ca63590a1e38ff81f6d404eed37c6a47404168"}

{"id": "p_045bdffdeafe60ac", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 229, "text": "今君侯位重山岳，勢若雷電，而懷德者鮮，畏威者眾，殆非小心翼翼多福之仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "743e852e1e7acf62827366ba6a9eaa873591e5fae95d40773826f9c43876018c"}

{"id": "p_3daa5fcedc50e587", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 230, "text": "又鼻者艮，此天中之山，高而不危，所以長守貴也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "0f896554d4f0d8b6a2f90ae1611995df266a127332b87dedcf0610cd33c8b765"}

{"id": "p_2cf9c343bb01652c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 231, "text": "位峻者顛，輕豪者亡，不可不思害盈之數，盛衰之期。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "b0e044939971d4cad5e1d085755e12b91209fe071a0a6e0c1697d08286fa4c2f"}

{"id": "p_5a74ff9736b66743", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 232, "text": "是故山在地中曰謙，雷在天上曰壯；謙則裒多益寡，壯則非禮不履。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "034afb5870971e51ef32d5cdd121a831dfd110c9266d37b341d01e832f350b87"}

{"id": "p_7ec4ee8c27223c5b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 233, "text": "未有損己而不光大，行非而不傷敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "2cbdd7e393c44437e900b58b1b6b3a40a421ac4721ed9bffeee9f94a9ffd0ed9"}

{"id": "p_79e6ae5a206c8973", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 234, "text": "原君侯上追文王六爻之旨，下思尼父彖象之義，然後三公可決，青蠅可驅也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "2cf40d72b0c1909cf0c7784b9aaafdba2eb2748a62c3855ed8ec5e97283fc941"}

{"id": "p_c14b19e8a2d2f3ce", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 235, "text": "」颺曰：「此老生之常譚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "788e40cee22bf47cb99b85c69aab87afc1ea765fdb8cbcfe0c0c4b257a4dd183"}

{"id": "p_08be2e58214e42c9", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 236, "text": "」輅答曰：「夫老生者見不生，常譚者見不譚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "121ff90b24705631249ed06fbc10581fbabb7f45d47b3a166415d4d2ea82e2ae"}

{"id": "p_364ca88d386ee782", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 237, "text": "」晏曰：「過歲更當相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "193b07af6a670a07176015740e39624070015a024b6c04a35573678e0a838b47"}

{"id": "p_cb049bbf63ef5e65", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 238, "text": "」輅還邑舍，具以此言語舅氏，舅氏責輅言太切至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "9b47ff595756789a4a77a3823ffeff69a9c4ea69a7e45ff6d88a18d29e787546"}

{"id": "p_c05f27875d1a6e5e", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 239, "text": "輅曰：「與死人語，何所畏邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "d1763d911828e6968a0858c9187719c7f34c79161a8601f12db06c10edba1a75"}

{"id": "p_ccaa3739b4d174c6", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 240, "text": "歲朝，西北大風，塵埃蔽天，十餘日，聞晏、颺皆誅，然後舅氏乃服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "cfb4fc63106e4bea61bc9f524673b0077454c1800648f2a934db2ae28d9cdabc"}

{"id": "p_8df4ba0a3f2863a1", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 241, "text": "始輅過魏郡太守鍾毓，共論易義，輅因言「卜可知君生死之日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "c12e76462bd42fcf9704b3b050a9c188d78ad8c8f92d589aa5ef296f16e0a975"}

{"id": "p_1855a4a11c531951", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 242, "text": "」毓使筮其生日月，如言無蹉跌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "a070de43827e60c8b55f07b1bd059d86a6152e1b686f17f701a7811330a04bb2"}

{"id": "p_1707b02d24930663", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 243, "text": "毓大愕然，曰：「君可畏也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "f7b488f0e0630d3912815096f6ec98ac40e9b14e01178f944eae4159640f141f"}

{"id": "p_03b4a40af18e59e7", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 244, "text": "毓問輅：「天下當太平否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "9c0d323c207ee19957c570ce6e0900e8f101082790a869bf95e3eb40a73c8229"}

{"id": "p_02d14592dd8ef72b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 245, "text": "」輅曰：「方今四九天飛，利見大人，神武升建，王道文明，何憂不平？", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "d06f6f85ad27681ffef3e34d4ca6892d3b713141c417c82c6c567608bd2aa06b"}

{"id": "p_fc2fd1457651cafa", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 246, "text": "」毓未解輅言，無幾，曹爽等誅，乃覺寤云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "8b0487abf55e2af2d23dcd2fb7924fa4d293f98256381b01182c980c15d86e48"}

{"id": "p_fb5c302320192e69", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 247, "text": "平原太守劉邠取印囊及山雞毛著器中，使筮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "16713d1a30c160b7974ed3eac99fa36717fcb5d4088078a8c9e552f3e8331eae"}

{"id": "p_1168c91df9867d61", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 248, "text": "輅曰：「內方外圓，五色成文，含寶守信，出則有章，此印囊也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "795ed37fee3ef927d53cd61556bf423636da7894532c67b8551a463ffd8feba5"}

{"id": "p_eef14ddb6f9aed58", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 249, "text": "高岳岩岩，有鳥硃身，羽翼玄黃，鳴不失晨，此山雞毛也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "0fb4c70446d69a4a9db4b538f34cc902883505d595870bddd1f9fc47789af454"}

{"id": "p_c7972fccafa436ac", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 250, "text": "」邠曰：「此郡官舍，連有變怪，使人恐怖，其理何由？", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "1f467b46463154be387fc8920225135c236a00b6664baa227aba7dc2bf334242"}

{"id": "p_3789de5f0434d10c", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 251, "text": "」輅曰：「或因漢末之亂，兵馬擾攘，軍屍流血，汙染丘山，故因昬夕，多有怪形也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "25c02517e3cd1b4560f0fe8bed51d02b93d2ee917b7a9017ed6c5f4f1c03f683"}

{"id": "p_09f805836959e947", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 252, "text": "明府道德高妙，自天祐之，原安百祿，以光休寵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "97392fd79e34606f7fd5059c399a6b1769540c3e9832177d3f256d4ad634448a"}

{"id": "p_d166dba083c1d0e5", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 253, "text": "清河令徐季龍使人行獵，令輅筮其所得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "43ecf862a0763d6edfbda3349dd6bc808a3e616189c9fd908ae3def12053fd74"}

{"id": "p_77603da059783d02", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 254, "text": "輅曰：「當獲小獸，复非食禽，雖有爪牙，微而不強，雖有文章，蔚而不明，非虎非雉，其名曰狸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "ac23d47e85b94e19f8a6c9c4062091b6ee7e02cdcd224babaab32b24d6f797b1"}

{"id": "p_4629a10375643e89", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 255, "text": "季龍取十三種物，著大篋中，使輅射。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "f58e2957c6304eaa4fe55fba7d38f06e9ab57a93cdb48eeee1b039066753fead"}

{"id": "p_b61ff3fbb7649ca8", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 256, "text": "云：「器中藉藉有十三種物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "9a461d8a14f6d8fb16d38a0da70a539f44812bac973dec6a65fdd0aa0bdae7b1"}

{"id": "p_e7a6ef3fd68df1fe", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 257, "text": "」先說雞子，後道蠶蛹，遂一一名之，惟以梳為枇耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "6a73d5b11efe7c3b23291a5f3164c9b0d46211b86eb9c208d9c87e1f3abb5739"}

{"id": "p_7ec7d56038b647ec", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 258, "text": "輅隨軍西行，過毌丘儉墓下，倚樹哀吟，精神不樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "2f0737794d3e2caf253b29b1f1fb90353bfdddb161235ffe551e60d438b1e657"}

{"id": "p_6a2ccc13ec25a90a", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 259, "text": "人問其故，輅曰：「林木雖茂，無形可久；碑誄雖美，無後可守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "8e5fb1b66032c23a74b65ee262f12ac5a762cd94a33c46dee138af9fe16e4df8"}

{"id": "p_9fcb83e229b98829", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 260, "text": "玄武藏頭，蒼龍無足，白虎銜屍，硃雀悲哭，四危以備，法當滅族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "08673f92949f2bf785139c5c9f49275ba0f9357ba5217d62cb9b8d121fc21606"}

{"id": "p_5ac5dcaecbcbb04b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 261, "text": "時天旱，倪問輅雨期，輅曰：「今夕當雨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "92c566e8d907e2a199ee64ac7a871cce4f8a83476ba90ff241890c07c7c17a77"}

{"id": "p_e5ee47cc78bb111b", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 262, "text": "」是日暘燥，晝無形似，府丞及令在坐，咸謂不然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "3a0fb667c59dfe7a8d7972253bed6f10e5ae6aadc4d99b424762dc1b152f6277"}

{"id": "p_e1e3b05fcc0426f1", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 263, "text": "到鼓一中，星月皆沒，風雲並起，竟成快雨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "1fdf0ccebd7702ec9b024fc9f38299a6132d4414aa947a50a45cbecfa4838cd1"}

{"id": "p_1cce3b49068fa6b1", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 264, "text": "於是倪盛脩主人禮，共為歡樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "2d21e8a231d7bc90d65cb831b1c9966176647261162e7649a5d62d319ffaf391"}

{"id": "p_a0901e9dc9d7b90d", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 265, "text": "，弟辰謂輅曰：「大將軍待君意厚，冀當富貴乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "faa7d9fe4c10cb4aadde6a193ae2161263c6e7bbdf973afc832d0b5ff72db6ca"}

{"id": "p_23c87634f8ecdce4", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 266, "text": "」輅長歎曰：「吾自知有分直耳，然天與我才明，不與我年壽，恐四十七八間，不見女嫁兒娶婦也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "120b797a4fc9b86fa7f1328ea33c39ea5bf3828733ebc50a1af11419d4f106ca"}

{"id": "p_69f3c4248212b0b8", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 267, "text": "若得免此，欲作洛陽令，可使路不拾遣，枹鼓不鳴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "cb09d1c20328c36c4a557d4892615ea3bac9532446c880a57175628fdf2e1e6a"}

{"id": "p_a1eb3b19cebf7669", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 268, "text": "但恐至太山治鬼，不得治生人，如何！", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "d80158bc68fc4751eb0903c789f6aecb479f1fde024fd2b18d79f13cb50bfc7b"}

{"id": "p_baa74f0bec664f63", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 269, "text": "」辰問其故，輅曰：「吾額上無生骨，眼中無守精，鼻無梁柱，腳無天根，背無三甲，腹無三壬，此皆不壽之驗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "986d472e602da2643d6b67977cd78a68c17290b183e8f5d214b35404b3ba6c2b"}

{"id": "p_6d51f27c45a9d729", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 270, "text": "又吾本命在寅，加月食夜生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "3c32e7a3a62cb4f30ab5e9f194440e9c3ea74480f277851ecef44e2b849d7bc9"}

{"id": "p_e4429360ec7d71df", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 271, "text": "天有常數，不可得諱，但人不知耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "0f6aa252a5f1a40db93b14d228cdce6a327edb067ac85450785bfd821832a611"}

{"id": "p_b85897996a7be156", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 272, "text": "吾前後相當死者過百人，略無錯也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "7bab2412825e056e7dc102e8333a74855b3fb8d4edcb6e29c525cc4e036d1c25"}

{"id": "p_fde7199888f89fee", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 273, "text": "評曰：華佗之醫診，杜夔之聲樂，朱建平之相術，周宣之相夢，管輅之術筮，誠皆玄妙之殊巧，非常之絕技矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "6e3b96b96370830f2b476e3ade126abbaa58286f97a466d6d207b38411daf420"}

{"id": "p_61d9a4d12a298b85", "source_id": "src_be1eda3a2ac6ac94", "ordinal": 274, "text": "昔史遷著扁鵲、倉公、日者之傳，所以廣異聞而表奇事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "a2805a4e3697c252e4639e6cfd2920385c3455cfeccaddec76109c1c3c3f1fbc"}

{"id": "p_f2974fa0b0bb2fe0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 0, "text": "== 【烏丸鮮卑】 ==", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "8a781c1f90b03d37ec23bd15c26b4a902cf84536016588fef7db602a67242e01"}

{"id": "p_013b34d756a4698f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 1, "text": "《書》載「蠻夷猾夏」，《詩》稱「玁狁孔熾」，久矣其爲中國患也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "ec933fd1ef22d150fc172c8465e9cb8f1b8b782864578e079fff321ec8ccd060"}

{"id": "p_a5214b6aa6c3e27c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 2, "text": "秦、漢以來，匈奴久爲邊害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "61125a9fd75f5090d935ae45b30f49895f9e2424bc9a941c4e3710eba2843953"}

{"id": "p_1af6a29b5191ea38", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 3, "text": "孝武雖外事四夷，東平兩越、朝鮮，西討貳師、大宛，開邛苲、夜郎之道，然皆在荒服之外，不能爲中國輕重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "368012bf73281941112f1d2f54e68f650294a60b9fb48bfa03596e02ae7626a2"}

{"id": "p_5323c87108b59bea", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 4, "text": "而匈奴最逼於諸夏，胡騎南侵則三邊受敵，是以屢遣衛、霍之將，深入北伐，窮追單于，奪其饒衍之地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "940487e3ae53db87ab0ed19028d093ee1a1cf15cfd2dcda55fbd5dfa89166f0d"}

{"id": "p_bc967c7a2e586556", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 5, "text": "後遂保塞稱籓，世以衰弱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "5970aaf2433a75f44dad6634312b3df5303bf1b5c72209e8748f1c8b18224174"}

{"id": "p_1bc297c8f1bd834e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 6, "text": "建安中，呼廚泉南單于入朝，遂留內侍，使右賢王撫其國，而匈奴折節，過於漢舊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "373946bb0fbf01a56ddb8fcb97ae67c574691f43a9b10df91f83d08aecffd8a3"}

{"id": "p_f09976744577e04c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 7, "text": "然烏丸、鮮卑稍更強盛，亦因漢末之亂，中國多事，不遑外討，故得擅漠南之地，寇暴城邑，殺略人民，北邊仍受其困。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "65268a2db5b16e1fe487cd1aa87c35b6558fcca3d16eaf6a5c55ee08a41428aa"}

{"id": "p_abff5491cdf267d5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 8, "text": "會袁紹兼河北，乃撫有三郡烏丸，寵其名王而收其精騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "c022f1af498cc610e1a81a975f40761e62e7fc71841af68509c343b2258b3f8d"}

{"id": "p_bad5dd5320ad860b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 9, "text": "蹋頓又驍武，邊長老皆比之冒頓，恃其阻遠，敢受亡命，以雄百蠻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "9fa66e8d57bb1adf7f600a6958c83d0f15db0094df56fccb97257235cdd078bb"}

{"id": "p_3ad65c918a4af1a4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 10, "text": "太祖潛師北伐，出其不意，一戰而定之，夷狄懾服，威振朔土。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "2982ed72a61967a12ba24fe01f7c35639444e6ac959b184b6e77c26d43b7a0e8"}

{"id": "p_687f5be7d4d28ee1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 11, "text": "遂引烏丸之衆服從征討，而邊民得用安息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "29002b25a62db2350fa9082557496a8127870f3640362c37f592ee1dc3e8ec71"}

{"id": "p_691d932b666b3459", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 12, "text": "後鮮卑大人軻比能復製禦群狄，盡收匈奴故地，自雲中、五原以東抵遼水，皆爲鮮卑庭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "9be8d3eb865d4f461ac15738f60d4d013d7b1870ed7d4af11fa917b08a372492"}

{"id": "p_128eb8705d1c80e9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 13, "text": "數犯塞寇邊，幽、并苦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "6fe9e593f7f33c5821b38a4e1becb985b06d338ad08bfd3384e4589a3b24e629"}

{"id": "p_02b9e622695ef09c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 14, "text": "田豫有馬城之圍，畢軌有陘北之敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "551be89b3dffbc95d1c17097f3106207499c453d08a4a8843c666f0a4c4cfbe7"}

{"id": "p_a15ce036be30581a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 15, "text": "青龍中，帝乃聽王雄，遣劍客刺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "c228fd37dbdb85eb8ef8fed142a458d19de5439194aa5f44414b464137e02166"}

{"id": "p_0a4c58755548ef81", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 16, "text": "然後種落離散，互相侵伐，強者遠遁，弱者請服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "6cd8b8701cb93741859ccd4ea5d219e4986d8ec7d936bc66ad63461320102e9f"}

{"id": "p_d85dde9b40d8dcd2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 17, "text": "由是邊陲差安，漠南少事，雖時頗鈔盜，不能復相扇動矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "28ba0d4db6f1c861975cc00a756658847806ac79aa93a709c56dec850b1a810c"}

{"id": "p_c64d0082e83b7f9c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 18, "text": "烏丸、鮮卑即古所謂東胡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "d6dd8172977dc271f89547fbb32e8acb92212d94b04eb2eeb7c20f8e17652fa8"}

{"id": "p_f36c93cf32b3d654", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 19, "text": "其習俗、前事，撰《漢記》者已錄而載之矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "84eaa5b267379e9ffe7648df20353eea95da8e1e81ef2111824f678e39d77c18"}

{"id": "p_3a5f9bc6bccb3ec4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 20, "text": "故但舉漢末魏初以來，以備四夷之變-{云}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "bcf5949503cbc87a43433a36efa65cae09f7a25b2c4cff598db1123316ab0ca6"}
