{"id": "p_e505929e3543806d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 21, "text": "《魏書》曰：烏丸者，東胡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "0ef6363fe66c89d7c6e5dc027f1a44cc6df35cdea7b3a409c1a216bbe8967522"}

{"id": "p_08e3a2b6443d2607", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 22, "text": "漢初，匈奴冒頓滅其國，餘類保烏丸山，因以爲號焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "2bcebb68c63482f2aa10c1f29e64794744df8132416ab3d2bfe4053fbf5ff9d9"}

{"id": "p_81b24a811ebea5dd", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 23, "text": "俗善騎射，隨水草放牧，居無常處，以穹廬爲宅，皆東向。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "e5690a8727180a5a11f35f128fece9ece47c61e6eb75d4fdf2fd04104d14b1e5"}

{"id": "p_4b9b583381255370", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 24, "text": "日弋獵禽獸，食肉飲酪，以毛毳爲衣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "750cd9ea416200444dabcb0cc9cb65e481ce1ce6d5ac06eb0925df97deb84d83"}

{"id": "p_46fe7dbff4bcccbb", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 25, "text": "貴少賤老，其性悍驁，怒則殺父兄，而終不害其母，以母有族類，父兄以己爲種，無復報者故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "41e7b03c106b5e7b0b9b938c85e8e2611d02bff8021b879ab90530604b063b19"}

{"id": "p_05403f8873f44254", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 26, "text": "常推募勇健能理決鬥訟相侵犯者爲大人，邑落各有小帥，不世繼也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "29b7261e81ca4803b7504babcc2ae477337cf497797059c21df08a91d18e2f22"}

{"id": "p_88472dff4c2543c1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 27, "text": "數百千落自爲一部，大人有所召呼，刻木爲信，邑落傳行，無文字，而部衆莫敢違犯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "3375d3681082d31cfda8a680bcb80ac7fedd3adf8c43d3c78d9c1dcdbfe0f63b"}

{"id": "p_395b3dc8a9a7f814", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 28, "text": "氏姓無常，以大人健者名字爲姓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "7e635a592341cf761951941732c2a40a85484d54e9b517585efc309c12ad0cf4"}

{"id": "p_7c206ef68c79f7ee", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 29, "text": "大人已下，各自畜牧治產，不相徭役。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "852f65ea63f0fc047e5b33d9f2e7ec0b6c68ae949fde832ebcc587525f617bdb"}

{"id": "p_498d5d01982f9597", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 30, "text": "其嫁娶皆先私通，略將女去，或半歲百日，然後遣媒人送馬牛羊以爲聘娶之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "fb973b26ee287e3878863b42925be538ae0602f417c9d995e2fe86a78b9e9697"}

{"id": "p_2c9b1a151e1ecdba", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 31, "text": "婿隨妻歸，見妻家無尊卑，旦起皆拜，而不自拜其父母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "e1f1b4dda2daaa8c27b09bfa81408e0c2d1516499b64e9c1e2ac5dfb43bd1540"}

{"id": "p_784fc44dbf2fe545", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 32, "text": "爲妻家僕役二年，妻家乃厚遣送女，居處財物，一出妻家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "6cc913f0e70f1c0aa155169fd56b0be9631c7a847f8c67ee81076e87c9994989"}

{"id": "p_af5228b9d0ce27ee", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 33, "text": "故其俗從婦人計，至戰鬥時，乃自決之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "b7ab1bee3f84a3d7b7bbbdc28ed9f25bc8b968916ddb874c2157d46501d006b3"}

{"id": "p_135058f15b091f2b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 34, "text": "父子男女，相對蹲踞，悉髡頭以爲輕便。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "46b39bf08d3fd72a5eac050e19ea914f2c472d30de3abfb59e0df323aa89ed32"}

{"id": "p_8794e13f0a39ad2b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 35, "text": "婦人至嫁時乃養發，分爲髻，著句決，飾以金碧，猶中國有冠步搖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "cfc9f4f6fd0ec4efedb814f8688076b88d03a2cb6f3d4908878143d1c0d45496"}

{"id": "p_be28f1f36e5ca0e2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 36, "text": "父兄死，妻後母執嫂；若無執嫂者，則己子以親之次妻伯叔焉，死則歸其故夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "eca67a0085ef9e3e73e7322f26f779f7b6f294f8ccca59b7d0af0ef82b43e444"}

{"id": "p_2bbe71e105cc8f6d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 37, "text": "俗識鳥獸孕乳，時以四節，耕種常用布穀鳴爲候。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "0fb8054ad6f4c3d42c03dee6b1f376107c58764a1875cd26a1180dbfe751c220"}

{"id": "p_a8cfd3e2605ed8f5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 38, "text": "地宜青穄、東牆，東牆似蓬草，實如葵子，至十月熟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "6c2de5f2ec507cab9754739d4a26accd46a478058b45edaeeecfca172ed092ac"}

{"id": "p_5a0d538913b5687e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 39, "text": "能作白酒，而不知作麹蘖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "e596e3a61a4efa331f6c6bf9024bcd35377e97ec734f0d885a82cdfc6b9860b6"}

{"id": "p_e5b85999c74419ba", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 40, "text": "大人能作弓矢鞍勒，鍛金鐵爲兵器，能刺韋作文繡，織縷氈毼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "844e6555498fa4ed335d0e0414969432f23bd029e50ec8dbc16e1216b45c1df6"}

{"id": "p_896ad1c1f465c4e0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 41, "text": "有病，知以艾灸，或燒石自熨，燒地臥上，或隨痛病處，以刀決脈出血，及祝天地山川之神，無針藥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "22907099dc951f4909d384033e87a94accc6b5d59c529e080dc8aa02242fcbc4"}

{"id": "p_ed80db167ef67213", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 42, "text": "貴兵死，斂屍有棺，始死則哭，葬則歌舞相送。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "03aade9d3c7013b2c688647d9452c338a42c0e94fff120ecca3199d98f8d57bf"}

{"id": "p_2a50cf5b825fb671", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 43, "text": "肥養犬，以采繩嬰牽，並取亡者所乘馬、衣物、生時服飾，皆燒以送之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "ee0599b4e3c64fd98ae53bddaae7f97b982d147faac0fa709bc9076b95f45bff"}

{"id": "p_c9a979edcce15fd8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 44, "text": "特屬累犬，使護死者神靈歸乎赤山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "e06d0a02ec581595f739702cd6fa2a001c58512d6cc50a103f54051ba88c3f4c"}

{"id": "p_27ca7a0644478299", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 45, "text": "赤山在遼東西北數千里，如中國人以死之魂神歸泰山也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "345f23f20dd34b68eca6082261f47f5aefb4690c8f45aee5aeced88094ae944b"}

{"id": "p_458e3673d7da5459", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 46, "text": "至葬日，夜聚親舊員坐，牽犬馬曆位，或歌哭者，擲肉與之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "4e6d88202a3358d279473070c91371b5681cf30dffad1e6dfaba6d2aed77815d"}

{"id": "p_5df381dd636ddd20", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 47, "text": "使二人口頌咒文，使死者魂神徑至，歷險阻，勿令橫鬼遮護，達其赤山，然後殺犬馬衣物燒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "d987fcb6673efb3700b2968328a64ec1ad18e4d8f27a7934a069ca4a43cfdd9f"}

{"id": "p_13d0fb7835fe8db4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 48, "text": "敬鬼神，祠天地日月星辰山川，及先大人有健名者，亦同祠以牛羊，祠畢皆燒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "e524e10d0856c11143d4a761cb8a0335f53363689993acb9202b02c2c3b85144"}

{"id": "p_50d0b7b1ee9dd813", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 49, "text": "其約法，違大人言死，盜不止死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "475253c3b407b7a981bcd1191f66847d45974ccd241802cbe6b0c847806412bf"}

{"id": "p_6ec28978c765b51f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 50, "text": "其相殘殺，令都落自相報，相報不止，詣大人平之，有罪者出其牛羊以贖死命，乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "b747590cb73cd73bb4e0a27653504de9854d13cc3f1eb1cfdd3f82ff28e443d2"}

{"id": "p_9dc3067d70288476", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 51, "text": "其亡叛爲大人所捕者，諸邑落不肯受，皆逐使至雍狂地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "8e935d61c4b7712c5212ccd4af7ea764c47398c470b900215bb439bc9255d0e9"}

{"id": "p_40013f9a5ef4a07f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 52, "text": "地無山，有沙漠、流水、草木，多蝮蛇，在丁令之西南，烏孫之東北，以窮困之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "51983bab7d73e50703fe6acf42d4a43088132229a467eae7a8da9cf2d344c28b"}

{"id": "p_a4a7737df7fddf6d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 53, "text": "自其先爲匈奴所破之後，人衆孤弱，爲匈奴臣服，常歲輸牛馬羊，過時不具，輒虜其妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "70d0e599a82848c3c2a8368869605822b0174410f99841049dede557e873ff00"}

{"id": "p_0aff8dc1046c5796", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 54, "text": "至匈奴壹衍鞮單于時，烏丸轉強，發掘匈奴單于塚，將以報冒頓所破之恥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "6ac98cc741ec3d9ee62f807e9167ef2b6e61ac09d7443a6e493921cb79f57c2e"}

{"id": "p_63b77153d033fefc", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 55, "text": "壹衍鞮單于大怒，發二萬騎以擊烏丸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "ee072143ff8b80d3f1770504dff421ba6e49f42ec0f7480998bcd2caa7573d2c"}

{"id": "p_d643f0e304aad9aa", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 56, "text": "大將軍霍光聞之，遣度遼將軍范明友將三萬騎出遼東追擊匈奴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "35e946e49fcd8be6969b20109045b8bb2c070871472eed4b8f2b7ac5a648251b"}

{"id": "p_a04257ca2dcda6fa", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 57, "text": "比明友兵至，匈奴已引去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "849a821cf5bc6840f8b3497831ca3dd80efc16a5651df582225ec37878122957"}

{"id": "p_dd46e0ed18aff92e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 58, "text": "烏丸新被匈奴兵，乘其衰弊，遂進擊烏丸，斬首六千餘級，獲三王首還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "e4acbc76ed0a869ea94d04f3bb3e4c9d2ddfba1e1d79543fbca8dfb3f6d6e2b5"}

{"id": "p_67383a5a1cf00418", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 59, "text": "後數復犯塞，明友輒征破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "00a660cf6df063487b052e75244eeeb3cb9651bfd2ebf18ba3c2cbb4e7c4b3a8"}

{"id": "p_85ed4d0f1a586771", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 60, "text": "至王莽末，並與匈奴爲寇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "87a607c1140c1aba342763c111e93d36a160efa5db5f776e6c493a78c70e04b6"}

{"id": "p_f336596b17946977", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 61, "text": "光武定天下，遣伏波將軍馬援將三千騎，從五原關出塞征之，無利，而殺馬千餘匹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "610c2cb582f8b48de00a89ea7a1c243241994869f0296eb06ab1836dff21ec3b"}

{"id": "p_dce021f9e2fb5043", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 62, "text": "烏丸遂盛，鈔擊匈奴，匈奴轉徙千里，漠南地空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "9fa1842ae50b8013efa9a08385784f1b9a1cd082a76f82cd88619f741301589b"}

{"id": "p_4420028b4463b137", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 63, "text": "，烏丸大人郝旦等九千餘人率衆詣闕，封其渠帥爲侯王者八十餘人，使居塞內，布列遼東屬國、遼西、右北平、漁陽、廣陽、上穀、代郡、雁門、太原、朔方諸郡界，招來種人，給其衣食，置校尉以領護之，遂爲漢偵備，擊匈奴、鮮卑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "2b3cec74d8e40187f246ca2c785bdb0559a345ef92e4a9dc991532b7d6545472"}

{"id": "p_1f144bd92d6d189e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 64, "text": "至永平中，漁陽烏丸大人欽志賁帥種人叛，鮮卑還爲寇害，遼東太守祭肜募殺志賁，遂破其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "5b6f063006b9577d7ca38e9da26acc49ac5fda3ac59ae3ad6f61d92dd41bcf88"}

{"id": "p_dd335d97bfbed3e4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 65, "text": "至安帝時，漁陽、右北平、雁門烏丸率衆王無何等復與鮮卑、匈奴合，鈔略代郡、上穀、涿郡、五原，乃以大司農何熙行車騎將軍，左右羽林五營士，發緣邊七郡黎陽營兵合二萬人擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "acce42a110052790d034972e488c0d453ebd2fc85ac95fa30f59e83bf30d5cbe"}

{"id": "p_852004e3f22c728b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 66, "text": "匈奴降，鮮卑、烏丸各還塞外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "4f9f483aa192d79e12bf35e3b93e5b1ab5ac2423e7a8782ed3c32cd761c28a3a"}

{"id": "p_37e6fd3c680782ed", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 67, "text": "是後，烏丸稍復親附，拜其大人戎末廆爲都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "9590b8ae572c09b03c3cfddc00bbc4c4de207f5f4ad386a93d5bef01e670edc0"}

{"id": "p_dff1056d1cb3441d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 68, "text": "至順帝時，戎末廆率將王侯咄歸、去延等從烏丸校尉耿曄出塞擊鮮卑有功，還皆拜爲率衆王，賜束帛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "bd090466480c45710f871aebc7eb9d51dae034fca7fce2b8a4e7ce8cc5111386"}

{"id": "p_1bb35e8e75299e07", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 69, "text": "漢末，遼西烏丸大人丘力居，衆五千餘落，上谷烏丸大人難樓，衆九千餘落，各稱王，而遼東屬國烏丸大人蘇僕延，衆千餘落，自稱峭王，右北平烏丸大人烏延，衆八百餘落，自稱汗魯王，皆有計策勇健。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "b23157c4a4dd79af609cde35e1fd929e6574d6003b44f53132c1acc72484446b"}

{"id": "p_56978b4edeb6fb53", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 70, "text": "中山太守張純叛入丘力居衆中，自號彌天安定王，爲三郡烏丸元帥，寇略青、徐、幽、冀四州，殺略吏民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "c74a8bfa1ac842e5149fe431e59b24ea6b2b297eca50f29226dae874a7b040f0"}

{"id": "p_c57e1c5d3ac7eac1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 71, "text": "靈帝末，以劉虞爲州牧，募胡斬純首，北州乃定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "6c618eddb7410870bc33787067cc098a19635987aa86b722faa0c7cb1980accc"}

{"id": "p_0ef4df5adaed541c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 72, "text": "後丘力居死，子樓班年小，從子蹋頓有武略，代立，總攝三王部，衆皆從其教令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "71e19a885c49b5722a4253951b4a82e7f12a6b2ad302a870976af1c914e75840"}

{"id": "p_3e44272316bebb86", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 73, "text": "袁紹與公孫瓚連戰不決，蹋頓遣使詣紹求和親，助紹擊瓚，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "d4fe0b856a8e7aae09523446171b68fc7104df9273bbee5aaa17b6ccd442c1ed"}

{"id": "p_26ac0101b142aa58", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 74, "text": "紹矯制賜蹋頓、峭王、汗魯王印綬，皆以爲單于。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "ef6f2c244bd5a3f6f17e2746cfb7e3755dd1670a282ee3157724d29fd96f78f3"}

{"id": "p_3f9dda1e3245b7da", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 75, "text": "《英雄記》曰：紹遣使即拜烏丸三王爲單于，皆安車、華蓋、羽旄、黃屋、左纛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "efc4cc0d41f5ffc37b18470bd970806c154c8b3d55a73b62105f07c350d1951b"}

{"id": "p_be853304ad7c7ddc", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 76, "text": "版文曰：「使持節大將軍督幽、青、並領冀州牧阮鄉侯紹，承制詔遼東屬國率衆王頒下、烏丸遼西率衆王蹋頓、右北平率衆王汗盧維：乃祖慕義遷善，款塞內附，北捍玁狁，東拒濊貊，世守北陲，爲百姓保障，雖時侵犯王略，命將徂征厥罪，率不旋時，悔愆變改，方之外夷，最又聰惠者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "2080af3a591d66dff0ea48557ed0dafd1485b354917212b1d9206a7df7372211"}

{"id": "p_438cf3605069ff71", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 77, "text": "始有千夫長、百夫長以相統領，用能悉乃心，克有勳力於國家，稍受王侯之命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "d91b1ec08a346b0c92fc0efe80a677166aaaa15aa1b13db7375eab3d40a900ef"}

{"id": "p_a3c82b44fbcbe365", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 78, "text": "自我王室多故，公孫瓚作難，殘夷厥土之君，以侮天慢主，是以四海之內，並執干戈以衛社稷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "c420bc3f1d9264f6a3da2990e448b756fb8b6cd993e53fa99b456b37187ef25b"}

{"id": "p_2e958574265e8b5d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 79, "text": "三王奮氣裔土，忿奸憂國，控弦與漢兵爲表裏，誠甚忠孝，朝所嘉焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "32d6250049c8a83d12cd84ca6a09e68216019ed8238126d2dacdc2b7f04dc5c5"}

{"id": "p_45e771cc6a9d59b1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 80, "text": "然而虎兕長蛇，相隨塞路，王官爵命，否而無聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "a85278abf639b5ff229a22fadbe57d6e3e503101db1af2723d12047312851abf"}

{"id": "p_e696460c7f1434b7", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 81, "text": "今遣行謁者楊林，齎單于璽綬車服，以對爾勞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "b6f14fe4e28033d2fddf0612fba2e288a7c41b4546e1ea1183f2b4b0b2f2a81a"}

{"id": "p_1b65d92533ded9ca", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 82, "text": "其各綏靜部落，教以謹慎，無使作凶作慝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "9a3947ae5cb3805e2aa29787bf524b4ac03d1a2e3ced0b9acd3b519a0220cdb5"}

{"id": "p_fe5127616f8d52a7", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 83, "text": "世復爾祀位，長爲百蠻長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "3db211a20f0a997c9001c924d5117e6bf29882b55338663479c979f5f20e2e31"}

{"id": "p_daaa2b7ffa65adf7", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 84, "text": "厥有咎有不臧者，泯於爾祿，而喪於乃庸，可不勉乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "63fdf7624881ff732ebfd5582eb683040c5b47353452c83784dabc1231cf8745"}

{"id": "p_477e118f81153417", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 85, "text": "烏桓單于都護部衆，左右單于受其節度，他如故事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "7e8e2ccc552ea305686bd246ef0fc978a980ab4e8caa15a4b4b8fd01f77e0afe"}

{"id": "p_55b6574ecc94e336", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 86, "text": "後樓班大，峭王率其部衆奉樓班爲單于，蹋頓爲王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "1363ed99a23b80155cb7980d18ce04501f3d2a7c9660cd488405aa610a1fe80a"}

{"id": "p_7e3d390c4c265887", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 87, "text": "廣陽閻柔，少沒烏丸、鮮卑中，爲其種所歸信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "34ac7ec65172a02db932d967c85fe7757e21e35430fe9f573331eb14531b2a75"}

{"id": "p_33594113450f7885", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 88, "text": "柔乃因鮮卑衆，殺烏丸校尉邢舉代之，紹因寵慰以安北邊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "9c622f4cd3333ff48c7339292157685aec50529ea4c6554970db7a7439bee1e7"}

{"id": "p_726c338dcf91ee7d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 89, "text": "後袁尚敗奔蹋頓，憑其勢，復圖冀州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "91182951d4d5cd315706762adfaaf0ab57dff2599410e70e53a4c4240797d9ed"}

{"id": "p_8936d4cd76553dc1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 90, "text": "會太祖平河北，柔帥鮮卑、烏丸歸附，遂因以柔爲校尉，猶持漢使節，治廣甯如舊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "6d22d34c27365fd6f7460485794a110c77bdd3cc0576b54e33a7013f3e6a0153"}

{"id": "p_31216dd720d25142", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 91, "text": "，太祖自征蹋頓於柳城，潛軍詭道，未至百餘-{里}-，虜乃覺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "e399a64867ba4c15bdc0cffd95ce06624b2437343e91706487aaff2e5d2ed27b"}

{"id": "p_a31476c4b0d1085e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 92, "text": "尚與蹋頓將衆逆戰於凡城，兵馬甚盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "f310ec44304470833e166387eb25a67710a57e10e1612333207f44f893b3771f"}

{"id": "p_d2b1f5de9e42a7fc", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 93, "text": "太祖登高望虜陳，（柳）軍未進，觀其小動，乃擊破其衆，臨陳斬蹋頓首，死者被野。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "ce954d4e16b063b4c8fdd52b685d0e9240933f11a45e7c6ed8b5e605cf8f485e"}

{"id": "p_87674e84b98a7861", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 94, "text": "速附丸、樓班、烏延等走遼東，遼東悉斬，傳送其首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "7778d3ee1e1a67ba53b22d9d8b0505f3a808ace412014fbebce457edf0dab969"}

{"id": "p_fe485f45a8053a2f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 95, "text": "及幽州、并州柔所統烏丸萬餘落，悉徙其族居中國，帥從其侯王大人種衆與征伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "f29215a519bcd9888e215b7c83c164c6b205b427ce941156ecfd6e90da3466b4"}

{"id": "p_1465d71449776a72", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 96, "text": "由是三郡烏丸爲天下名騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "58e90aac3021aeab388d859adec66e2ce03b1632a3c7b4ed068eed0400646b33"}

{"id": "p_7476bd2075fd2b10", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 97, "text": "《魏略》曰：秋，遣幽州刺史毌丘儉率衆軍討遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "c4fb4289ec33890f6fbc6ffa2db6589568b5aa3bce3533bc813c7e8c85926c5f"}

{"id": "p_784ce25cd5716d9d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 98, "text": "右北平烏丸單于寇婁敦、遼西烏丸都督率衆王護留葉，昔隨袁尚奔遼西，聞儉軍至，率衆五千餘人降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "3b6b9cbafff8678baf48b44e9f0c230486dd4661ced0491175ffcd022bf168b4"}

{"id": "p_c74a381b8a921c9f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 99, "text": "寇婁敦遣弟（阿羅獎）阿羅槃等詣闕朝貢，封其渠帥三十餘爲王，賜輿馬繒采各有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "80a807a74ada40259529c6c1ab5f86ad0aae4064e6940e37f92409be3b40caab"}

{"id": "p_900ef71ebf0bc19b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 100, "text": "鮮卑步度根旣立，衆稍衰弱，中兄扶羅韓亦別擁衆數萬爲大人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "e5d03f5b412f63bd2f0c2efffcadabf5044e87b211858d2e5d2de964d2d69c30"}

{"id": "p_de3f3d2fd4613005", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 101, "text": "建安中，太祖定幽州，步度根與軻比能等因烏丸校尉閻柔上貢獻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "0deaa8395c51a43601412e40873f13810c31ed24a740e52720b697539dc4b74e"}

{"id": "p_14c8eeed5b3b1156", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 102, "text": "後代郡烏丸能臣氐等叛，求屬扶羅韓，扶羅韓將萬餘騎迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "474a98d42146dfc4b1464ffe6e7f01d6459b8d66aababcbfdab10bd3f08df061"}

{"id": "p_f250396db1ea846c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 103, "text": "到桑乾，氏等議，以爲扶羅韓部威禁寬緩，恐不見濟，更遣人呼軻比能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "5d879d480e162462e92d20f4f41f4634a2b7d4c09ab0f91a13ab05eb158ab66e"}

{"id": "p_bed2230bdabc38cd", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 104, "text": "比能即將萬餘騎到，當共盟誓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "059c30c8949a737acf4101c83ba2064b12a1c4221606794bfda9039bc97e198d"}

{"id": "p_13edbec624d39ed1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 105, "text": "比能便於會上殺扶羅韓，扶羅韓子泄歸泥及部衆悉屬比能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "6dc5e3cce3ae2b812539143d1b632fe1d87ba3b295f8cc0af7f17f6b995ef65e"}

{"id": "p_920643ef88fdaa10", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 106, "text": "比能自以殺歸泥父，特又善遇之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "510ee7f6702a8d99d7159c9fbe79b739a1752894681f8e39647b71cc70d07050"}

{"id": "p_d0d08e663ea9c275", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 107, "text": "文帝踐阼，田豫爲烏丸校尉，持節并護鮮卑，屯昌平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "7be6db72da9bd78a0fbd5f7a694750ec489e605dc0759815f55a3d378da283d6"}

{"id": "p_f00476d3c205f1d4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 108, "text": "步度根遣使獻馬，帝拜爲王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "d888633452f7e83057eceb0171fc6142178000ce6661601fa8d7c0455a8f0ddd"}

{"id": "p_6a7b81a04be47ba5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 109, "text": "後數與軻比能更相攻擊，步度根部衆稍寡弱，將其衆萬餘落保太原、鴈門郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "f0796b2ae8e0deb7aa32810c017632e64d529e5fd08ce31bd1a520bdc4d9d47f"}

{"id": "p_6689ff88adec81f4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 110, "text": "步度根乃使人招呼泄歸泥曰：「汝父爲比能所殺，不念報仇，反屬怨家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "f39ff4cf7dc4a6a69f998f933ede11bcb0f4981b89d61be7f02e0442f0f9f8e3"}

{"id": "p_a03a8db1e7cc4987", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 111, "text": "今雖厚待汝，是欲殺汝計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "3bb5939af11b65cde83092d7d29ab48751753627dea930d08b7c8a5b4d2a1a28"}

{"id": "p_c8539d2d501632f3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 112, "text": "不如還我，我與汝是骨肉至親，豈與仇等？", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "359309095af20363345e251139406478ecf8e164a94a3f413b7256cbc8ed7038"}

{"id": "p_ee14e73dd17a3953", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」由是歸泥將其部落逃歸步度根，比能追之弗及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "58c703bd5bd198f6297c10bba32c816cc50a0cb3bb0f6b1ba6d9f14041848e3d"}

{"id": "p_8a32912debf64831", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 114, "text": "至，步度根詣闕貢獻，厚加賞賜，是後一心守邊，不爲寇害，而軻比能衆遂彊盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "d1f9cf1c3bf3f5fa5d562b71619cd38ef0f4fa19e37946140cc00e61fbda5d7f"}

{"id": "p_fa06b3550f4c0c1b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 115, "text": "明帝即位，務欲綏和戎狄，以息征伐，羈縻兩部而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "f95db93468daccb6a21638aa31b7b5287c01fae69924368d7d910a1a5417e9fb"}

{"id": "p_41c04176be7cd7ef", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 116, "text": "至，比能誘步度根深結和親，於是步度根將泄歸泥及部衆悉保比能，寇鈔并州，殺略吏民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "cb459c37a9e3d1bfc97af2347098ed7a7262f7b743a8cfcae1c1ba93d87b75d5"}

{"id": "p_212f18edf7985650", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 117, "text": "帝遣驍騎將軍秦朗征之，歸泥叛比能，將其部衆降，拜歸義王，賜幢麾、曲蓋、鼓吹，居并州如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "362b20298cec260fb44d0195da944f32ce970186b38f866f3c9584e68a925482"}

{"id": "p_de023676f992771c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 118, "text": "軻比能本小種鮮卑，以勇健，斷法平端，不貪財物，衆推以爲大人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "425335a9065c99f96cb9dc70b4ad4f37c0ece4497eeed95d182dd3b90e5fa712"}

{"id": "p_8110474c387b9fb2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 119, "text": "部落近塞，自袁紹據河北，中國人多亡叛歸之，教作兵器鎧楯，頗學文字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "7f65fa853715bbd800bb6f9d2c3a4b26066057a17dee983b46048c661775b825"}

{"id": "p_99d231b150b73e70", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 120, "text": "故其勒御部衆，擬則中國，出入弋獵，建立旌麾，以鼓節爲進退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "299117dd5b1be06da0618e711d81d50eff95790f6ad668608980809a2c08cef7"}

{"id": "p_663af49d13eba975", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 121, "text": "太祖西征關中，田銀反河間，比能將三千餘騎隨柔擊破銀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "33da87548e25e8c74b648928764e1b364bd69762415276f66ce67afc2da045ff"}

{"id": "p_5f95cd9649ce4b68", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 122, "text": "後代郡烏丸反，比能復助爲寇害，太祖以鄢陵侯彰爲驍騎將軍，北征，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "8e330c92a7cf5eec30e2d31df931967c5d07e9dbafc693b70075327326ac4d35"}

{"id": "p_565a1b3989cc693a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 123, "text": "比能走出塞，後復通貢獻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "3bbb4a33b9fbf5e68c24be91d25e9bd8f7d2dc94688cddb5eccbbe6ddf454ecb"}

{"id": "p_016047241af63f9a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 124, "text": "延康初，比能遣使獻馬，文帝亦立比能爲附義王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "72710174a3f4fe96a095d10b5fa6c4c29b20dde804b418f2550c6cdfc101b193"}

{"id": "p_8115bf755b9e4794", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 125, "text": "，比能出諸魏人在鮮卑者五百餘家，還居代郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "06804b14c4f99e1d05557ca8b56156647b312343a6d17bb9246ed46457f8919b"}

{"id": "p_07bae51ac77f2f2f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 126, "text": "明年，比能帥部落大人小子代郡烏丸脩武盧等三千餘騎，驅牛馬七萬餘口交市，遣魏人千餘家居上谷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "a207e12410a042ffbad146ae5b475454db794c01a4629999cb06ccc3752871f2"}

{"id": "p_9ed63fb962742aa5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 127, "text": "後與東部鮮卑大人素利及步度根三部爭鬪，更相攻擊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "9b31d5911cc767fb61db5af414dca99bde6fb6e8a9b826bb6b28d5cc4932b5ce"}

{"id": "p_c083773e873da6c1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 128, "text": "五年，比能復擊素利，豫帥輕騎徑進掎其後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "56d1f6aad9534e07dca00a10ed4b38f342efc9b75f654fc98393485bcfa2911c"}

{"id": "p_99b157cd862b5584", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 129, "text": "比能使別小帥瑣奴拒豫，豫進討，破走之，由是懷貳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "f6ee5e873823b3982d12b87c158a573451454df91a895c5037829d8ad83556ff"}

{"id": "p_e01dd4da782df6ac", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 130, "text": "乃與輔國將軍鮮于輔書曰：「夷狄不識文字，故校尉閻柔保我於天子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "015c0ba68067b9db4baff9f4c400556bec78040c464d01acb141ed70504ead1c"}

{"id": "p_a636819f2261ed05", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 131, "text": "我與素利爲讎，往年攻擊之，而田校尉助素利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "f1296a1969d7b917dc6e891b8c62082460e81dd9a52eb07f0dead1cb5b671bcd"}

{"id": "p_e1f9ae40d8c65b67", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 132, "text": "我臨陣使瑣奴往，聞使君來，即便引軍退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "af1b79d366ac449bfa20d1dfa98f372e08de38befede6201ce0d080db997e49f"}

{"id": "p_c584c4304d8804cd", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 133, "text": "步度根數數鈔盜，又殺我弟，而誣我以鈔盜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "fedc28a42bccc8757955ef536f492376c886f611d8e234e50e5f85272e5c6cd9"}

{"id": "p_9a1aef4510059c24", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 134, "text": "我夷狄雖不知禮義，兄弟子孫受天子印綬，牛馬尚知美水草，況我有人心邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "c7626f0600df99264c658be855a2299299b2ed013b7dda635fa5ef05c5cdcd74"}

{"id": "p_6f7476f2ecf83062", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 135, "text": "」輔得書以聞帝，帝復使豫招納安慰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "9283cfa9a32aebd55fcd45b538fd54a299393446639e9d057f25f83af07068db"}

{"id": "p_7de8eb928b4d2bf8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 136, "text": "比能衆遂彊盛，控弦十餘萬騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "630dd92959c62049f1a7b80d80103a09a3aa18843889b954906cce8a1f3fa036"}

{"id": "p_3be21204888179ef", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 137, "text": "每鈔畧得財物，均平分付，一決目前，終無所私，故得衆死力，餘部大人皆敬憚之，然猶未能及檀石槐也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "e4d92baab4014c4aa34b2c6d6f8e0369aec640569b7a28830b113a6f9978ae2b"}

{"id": "p_dd287ecda15f0118", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 138, "text": "，豫遣譯夏舍詣比能女壻鬱築鞬部，舍爲鞬所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "329ad449bec07f94cbc1b095dd6d682104ba4305cacb649269401b1b3cbdfa72"}

{"id": "p_1e03240a819da645", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 139, "text": "其秋，豫將西部鮮卑蒲頭、泄歸泥出塞討鬱築鞬，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "6bc319dd2b4ad6d4a208d9493ec42934ee4c07321ba59bcb6a1e8427dc19282e"}

{"id": "p_8c192877f575ef77", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 140, "text": "還至馬城，比能自將三萬騎圍豫七日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "621749a50d46dbfddb953456b49d637fe6023adfae4a9d8c9f6529ef52377055"}

{"id": "p_b4c0f4d9310d5492", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 141, "text": "上谷太守閻志，柔之弟也，素爲鮮卑所信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "fee585bc0cb3417866a4c917bf882a08aa811b2465dfc760409dc20c69a39680"}

{"id": "p_b1cbc62278411968", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 142, "text": "後幽州刺史王雄并領校尉，撫以恩信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "08c4318889e1f89d25fcfe0b55f81f1d2c1b010669a0f529e3232e84ba1732d5"}

{"id": "p_f87dc89d8e41e9d3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 143, "text": "比能數款塞，詣州奉貢獻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "a1406cc300a2ce2ab8848d1537eddff625efc7bf896d3f0c55be1f89611123e1"}

{"id": "p_02f540557139e413", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 144, "text": "至，比能誘納步度根，使叛并州，與結和親，自勒萬騎迎其累重於陘北。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "aa48471c00566d5f0cca330ca11df14c8830b2f07f61a0ebc27f68db1e14f1e0"}

{"id": "p_25aefa4c92e37843", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 145, "text": "并州刺史畢軌遣將軍蘇尚、董弼等擊之，比能遣子將騎與尚等會戰於樓煩，臨陣害尚、弼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "be0b21f5047ae7eb0f285f6bd4df7749e7f5e2fb362c9d7317646144bcd9cc4b"}

{"id": "p_d65c30b0b1b76390", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 146, "text": "至三年中，雄遣勇士韓龍刺殺比能，更立其弟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "8608b68af9f8b75cef9614f538f8c4f7061c1f22bc758bfefbf3d0af3b1e5c40"}

{"id": "p_f756501b0bdc1e4e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 147, "text": "素利、彌加、厥機皆爲大人，在遼西、右北平、漁陽塞外，道遠初不爲邊患，然其種衆多於比能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "ce166b87357c5f9a42c50fc3b2fc5045c236d3556ec05b44b18e7c794fea5a7e"}

{"id": "p_ae1f5ab79ec211e7", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 148, "text": "建安中，因閻柔上貢獻，通市，太祖皆表寵以爲王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "982578448c2fd2f6680433ec24d9e9f912ff9263a73a7e113d85cf8d4c6ae937"}

{"id": "p_400dd58dd585e134", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 149, "text": "厥機死，又立其子沙末汗爲親漢王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "55b3e1345fffba05e5e5c8f21e49cad5c5e20b5de1e83f50fbf06780f6b78a46"}

{"id": "p_f986738ea80a2642", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 150, "text": "文帝立素利、彌加爲歸義王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "bec0220fe19c39f9bb0a838b59f69c428f05d67f74418167bbffc81e3eaf6466"}

{"id": "p_df21c4ee0bd20974", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 151, "text": "子小，以弟成律歸爲王，代攝其衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "63f025a9c4427389b057e180c1b2f4c6e0b939197d41a318596c412c32e4a9d0"}

{"id": "p_b5b06bfcb8aa975c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 152, "text": "《書》稱「東漸於海，西被於流沙」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "30dffa78d32346c83f7492563e30a98612023601256cf12b3c7a79925ecb20c0"}

{"id": "p_a447d329630c2eb1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 153, "text": "其九服之制，可得而言也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "0d22cf0e98d15bf6a486aec54436911bd9c677704c5b25009228badff5ef05dd"}

{"id": "p_f15d3e0dea21e859", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 154, "text": "然荒域之外，重譯而至，非足跡車軌所及，未有知其國俗殊方者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "2835d8832b1964f79443da80c7d262f6bd481d0f9f5a03e1f78e4d9063550219"}

{"id": "p_55667f4eec6c394c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 155, "text": "自虞暨周，西戎有白環之獻，東夷有肅慎之貢，皆曠世而至，其遐遠也如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "9bbb1aa2dffc2f7391283aad29ab42a670c9cb6de22bae215fe7b8c21006b65d"}

{"id": "p_dc382544638b04fa", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 156, "text": "及漢氏遣張騫使西域，窮河源，經歷諸國，遂置都護以總領之，然後西域之事具存，故史官得詳載焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "60e5d9761a843316702308410e8fc09b06738183b69a15eec1f04dfa01978e1e"}

{"id": "p_7823a7ed7e921c0d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 157, "text": "魏興，西域雖不能盡至，其大國龜茲、于寘、康居、烏孫、疏勒、月氏、鄯善、車師之屬，無歲不奉朝貢，略如漢氏故事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "a66dd54faa1854c1cf3c117cb98f30119939f96f591d2381bc0c759d74d129cd"}

{"id": "p_d530565fa6e421d3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 158, "text": "而公孫淵仍父祖三世有遼東，天子爲其絕域，委以海外之事，遂隔斷東夷，不得通於諸夏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "e1440fd73bcd86fcd7c32f081d738c502110c3eb25fb13716b1788f283187e4a"}

{"id": "p_1e351853160a6a02", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 159, "text": "景初中，大興師旅，誅淵，又潛軍浮海，收樂浪、帶方之郡，而後海表謐然，東夷屈服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "ca69b19c4d4ce8590daae234f8767ae00bc5a3126256fb9a99a8be3b9a35417f"}

{"id": "p_c5b79bef890172b4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 160, "text": "其後高句麗背叛，又遣偏師致討，窮追極遠，逾烏丸、骨都，過沃沮，踐肅慎之庭，東臨大海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "eddcb2097245da0ae76c41554dc73726877ae56c70aefbc4e8a050ea47b24297"}

{"id": "p_fa941a04c88bd642", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 161, "text": "長老說有異面之人，近日之所出，遂周觀諸國，采其法俗，小大區別，各有名號，可得詳紀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "987ef3e8d7891b0a0cb5ad96cad1f5ebace83511df4969cf87a073c671a12629"}

{"id": "p_9eec3f3cc091aa49", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 162, "text": "雖夷狄之邦，而俎豆之象存。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "61b218dc179cf70c59079cba3947ad4adeda5218ee5d1f6d09e90dd094e088fb"}

{"id": "p_1b249efd69be2852", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 163, "text": "中國失禮，求之四夷，猶信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "95100b2c5d5dc4a6e0f02fff046db0e3ec78f3edb4b7aad8112a3927bb0eaabd"}

{"id": "p_11045ce2672dcf49", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 164, "text": "故撰次其國，列其同異，以接前史之所未備焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "ab4a0bb3aaee14e19674e5c5c08830aa28b559c631f8a31a6c51cc3f20dd84f2"}

{"id": "p_f23d17d3a305205a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 165, "text": "夫餘在長城之北，去玄菟千里，南與高句麗，東與挹婁，西與鮮卑接，北有弱水，方可二千里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "00f09b89db291b4118ed963277ded75f8cbfd34f7301b32be9e60d0ca8fa29c6"}

{"id": "p_688afa9f576acd1b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 166, "text": "戶八萬，其民土著，有宮室、倉庫、牢獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "f165a0002c38dec0d7d498e44082d35e8726ff8aa30a5f117859bf8cd9808b3a"}

{"id": "p_1f7657d005cce090", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 167, "text": "多山陵、廣澤，於東夷之域最平敞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "515fadfb7ce367710bb6512bd3715cd99a84adb6a000051ee59a4734a7b3aecd"}

{"id": "p_2a62f5d96970e5e8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 168, "text": "其人粗大，性強勇謹厚，不寇鈔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "fb23df5f0376550c4f75a980ac6a785076c48638a527bbec174c7c7b5cde5a17"}

{"id": "p_78d9b92815a5b8b2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 169, "text": "國有君王，皆以六畜名官，有馬加、牛加、豬加、狗加、大使、大使者、使者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "632e721c8b323803b28a75e20952b2bb2db38982d8cb0a0370403ef307948cc6"}

{"id": "p_9913637a9bff8233", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 170, "text": "邑落有豪民，名下戶皆爲奴僕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "710806b5fad68e65c910d25844aad441e45ae8c7d07a47fe87b118f119a59929"}

{"id": "p_9a31e48599d62f91", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 171, "text": "諸加別主四-{A|出}-，道大者主數千家，小者數百家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "87147af14b7e2a86e2a8afb6393461bbabce45a574918c606db72adabdf12e49"}

{"id": "p_a86f49b203cd5962", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 172, "text": "食飲皆用俎豆，會同、拜爵、洗爵，揖讓升降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "1fb22bc97b849f2d7b2e550f165573ec749f201b81b6c07ab071822cd4220ccb"}

{"id": "p_b6f01914b22991d5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 173, "text": "以殷正月祭天，國中大會，連日飲食歌舞，名曰迎鼓，於是時斷刑獄，解囚徒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "3b61c16685e735c279f664cd6225a53a9c54514ea908aed5321489f22585a3f7"}

{"id": "p_d63f093d371d5a41", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 174, "text": "在國衣尚白，白布大袂，袍、袴，履革鞜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "b7773bebc1b16379446f9a318c7ed6a4ce57ae49b807dbb58e1417fc6e1f624a"}

{"id": "p_89003cbfbac4cb75", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 175, "text": "出國則尚繒繡錦罽，大人加狐狸、狖白、黑貂之裘，以金銀飾帽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "dec92c937aeb400730f415ab4bd22559aa6af1f70f0c1647bdfc35a26463ff46"}

{"id": "p_ee4753968ddde45a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 176, "text": "譯人傳辭，皆跪，手據地竊語。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "9aae043113de139de2e3634e711fd57850596a66d91f807a95cfdef327899c4c"}

{"id": "p_9ff6dc2be37e246d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 177, "text": "用刑嚴急，殺人者死，沒其家人爲奴婢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "e4ec0d90b46f794e7f0e134fddc0be04cbe5d53f4a6f98090453ec1b73874c27"}

{"id": "p_5ca705900c15c170", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 178, "text": "男女淫，婦人妒，皆殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "26957195894c9b0225b8e8d851d921a06b49deb45d3e5c7a509d7abcbfea71ce"}

{"id": "p_bd0aedf37d26fdef", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 179, "text": "尤憎妒，已殺，屍之國南山上，至腐爛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "ffc29f889fbdc68f6c4c639f3e0b93c20d8d2e986c3fe53bae935225845cfd5d"}

{"id": "p_e3132aee31d063c5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 180, "text": "女家欲得，輸牛馬乃與之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "a3c4a0b5a698eb58d68d07a3394693a4f0e4077e6a05bb31fbcbb7794d4927de"}

{"id": "p_fd4287df1b84d7dd", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 181, "text": "其國善養牲，出名馬、赤玉、貂狖、美珠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "9c47419512c5a3fb87458ef039ecfa4adff3e7c1d3ae25ef0953378a649dedd2"}

{"id": "p_438ec800836d53b6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 182, "text": "以弓矢刀矛爲兵，家家自有鎧仗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "48375e673423a27c98e28579b446fcc430715aa77ed70cfeea151561c910ab71"}

{"id": "p_00bc17916ff9584c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 183, "text": "行道晝夜無老幼皆歌，通日聲不絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "742f1b423c1261208a9182d78faf78f505b6380dd6744d398bc36a2ce8df2203"}

{"id": "p_74bdbd64d835dcf1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 184, "text": "有軍事亦祭天，殺牛觀蹄以占吉凶，蹄解者爲凶，合者爲吉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "6ad50f38ef05f2b24fc9b7ed0ac3a7a3a94335d5cae2ec190805943eecbaf5c6"}

{"id": "p_27b4b713e2e93f1b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 185, "text": "有敵，諸加自戰，下戶俱擔糧飲食之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "b4fb0f993d2660a48a27a8fd08af44f07871ef8b77050a43c2d306eb39e40c4a"}

{"id": "p_06b91096ea795d7a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 186, "text": "《魏略》曰：其俗停喪五月，以久爲榮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "18818f29bd3d1f062eec9c9da2c798b9b9dbe4e1caae1feff42dba2188f86130"}

{"id": "p_de70f55eb35e65b6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 187, "text": "喪主不欲速而他人強之，常諍引以此爲節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "d81458a8a9ae6fad228f3540e40476b4fa4644e8b6759f79cdf13418f6d9b7ab"}

{"id": "p_da9edfd4854d830e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 188, "text": "其居喪，男女皆純白，婦人著布面衣，去環珮，大體與中國相仿佛也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "c654db996f2ef12dae1295646262b220692fc51554a091c3fc691a6065281287"}

{"id": "p_929f33fbe80a1164", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 189, "text": "漢末，公孫度雄張海東，威服外夷，夫餘王尉仇台更屬遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "decb75fb27d8bcd476e1ead15f10a5970811b45a9d06166542e4fd97d7e6fa19"}

{"id": "p_3896046bbca647c7", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 190, "text": "時句麗、鮮卑強，度以夫餘在二虜之間，妻以宗女。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "4b0e5f951eef34a79912836bcdbe22e3b7c623f2fb38f4bc7e6aa88e3b50e1db"}

{"id": "p_1048767413b3c62e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 191, "text": "牛加兄子名位居，爲大使，輕財善施，國人附之，歲歲遣使詣京都貢獻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "9447a734e9523b29955892f7101a933f60d2be1311ea8d2608cfefca27d420f3"}

{"id": "p_45794f281cd2a8a5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 192, "text": "正始中，幽州刺史毌丘儉討句麗，遣玄菟太守王頎詣夫餘，位居遣大加郊迎，供軍糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "5a97b7e6f3419da05983c1f0ee11f3fb66aaf72ec777cc6bdecec6aa133a2e01"}

{"id": "p_b14dd6f5e08663df", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 193, "text": "季父牛加有二心，位居殺季父父子，籍沒財物，遣使簿斂送官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "a7fba54550adc5943bf2ff307638fb6e186ecb0eb385596f7480e61adf84b7d2"}

{"id": "p_ca2a13510e224f86", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 194, "text": "舊夫餘俗，水旱不調，五穀不熟，輒歸咎於王，或言當易，或言當殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "f8503dd37406dd1da237d8ce6d9cc24b051d148139acc06cdb2c504f3f76163f"}

{"id": "p_5e87f7ad1f51b879", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 195, "text": "麻餘死，其子依慮年六歲，立以爲王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "e76c53c0833d221af80cca2ade4034c1ed450555716277120c7a99dddc57dfa4"}

{"id": "p_bf165338b5c8b405", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 196, "text": "漢時，夫餘王葬用玉匣，常豫以付玄菟郡，王死則迎取以葬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "45d8a86a448d3865dd5d8d9ccde70c4bd83432270d7a71c0922f4012efa3ff3a"}

{"id": "p_71f123b1dff455e6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 197, "text": "公孫淵伏誅，玄菟庫猶有玉匣一具。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "ee98f27cc95c0bcfb6bad2d8875006492fafdc40bd303ce2cbe6e05ada5d3ba9"}

{"id": "p_aecce4774f1754db", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 198, "text": "今夫餘庫有玉璧、珪、瓚數代之物，傳世以爲寶，耆老言先代之所賜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "83353c0ae74a4f8a9c15942e723aac9903ae4d880ab8836b931fe6db4b5fd96c"}

{"id": "p_63c1f4f1ad874721", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 199, "text": "其印文言「濊王之印」，國有故城名濊城，蓋本濊貊之地，而夫餘王其中，自謂「亡人」，抑有（似）也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "bea9988c496331747bfe242ecdfe213683b8535e5f534f4b89e07e36417ac37b"}

{"id": "p_6c5ce4bd8ebdfd1f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 200, "text": "《魏略》曰：舊志又言，昔北方有高離之國者，其王者侍婢有身，王欲殺之，婢-{云}-：「有氣如雞子來下，我故有身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "b7c83ff36d75f16542da9f9f358fddde374f882a75b728d565f0c3a8b5bbcb6d"}

{"id": "p_7cdb0275b87b14cd", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 201, "text": "」後生子，王捐之於溷中，豬以喙噓之，徙至馬閑，馬以氣噓之，不死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "fec8d517096e83551ea65426fbb3d41a3b63aacdcd40c1e910a72587fec25401"}

{"id": "p_6ba124c19eaeb1db", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 202, "text": "王疑以爲天子也，乃令其母收畜之，名曰東明，常令牧馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "334e6f8129cf0e7f6a83b5c8450e5661b22b392ece4b11f78886bf9ff3f56be0"}

{"id": "p_6b4bbe38876e4fc1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 203, "text": "東明善射，王恐奪其國也，欲殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "f383e1bff37a833ddc1f751a20c8e687d40f7fb3f151f824edfed88fd74f5466"}

{"id": "p_3198818d1b17e4e5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 204, "text": "東明走，南至施掩水，以弓擊水，魚鱉浮爲橋，東明得度，魚鱉乃解散，追兵不得渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "5ebffed92ec46b92b9f0903e3c87aeaea6bb8b9ff8db247da9f0759a2fc9194e"}

{"id": "p_b149813dae54a4ad", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 205, "text": "高句麗在遼東之東千里，南與朝鮮、濊貊，東與沃沮，北與夫餘接。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "541bbac113b9b491f4506f56c7ce2c065b155b1b36fc6948a3d9c94991370e64"}

{"id": "p_121d41ae9c4add9a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 206, "text": "都於丸都之下，方可二千里，戶三萬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "653338a11823cff8e13c913f36c5a4b5b8a8ee6238ff3b626b2130e61b95433c"}

{"id": "p_15b27565b0bcc491", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 207, "text": "無良田，雖力佃作，不足以實口腹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "baac3501713477782a122ccc592fc5c0a8aa50a58fe90b4f8f5cdd92320fa2fd"}

{"id": "p_417fcf1fae64f237", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 208, "text": "其俗節食，好治宮室，於所居之左右立大屋，祭鬼神，又祀靈星、社稷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "5b3301e1ab9461f598c83589b2e8c9fb5f09df0de460e87936272a42df089fb7"}

{"id": "p_7a8f61eac3e54509", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 209, "text": "其國有王，其官有相加、對盧、沛者、古雛加、主簿、優台丞、使者、皁衣先人，尊卑各有等級。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "896d23a88efc5af44c80e44c9b1b44b873cb65c223ddc41c5e8e2835e11e533c"}

{"id": "p_f6cae0931d4e5844", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 210, "text": "東夷舊語以爲夫餘別種，言語諸事，多與夫餘同，其性氣衣服有異。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "609890d89a9536134b7084d40308b45fd1c396aa81b747ad89759c185117dc23"}

{"id": "p_9325b4bc5549cff3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 211, "text": "本有五族，有涓奴部、絕奴部、順奴部、灌奴部、桂婁部。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "b3d4a514b5b10f3e614ca6d2850d012f96055d32b07c54bf79871547cccb7944"}

{"id": "p_f04a4e866f0c4ad9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 212, "text": "本涓奴部爲王，稍微弱，今桂婁部代之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "a1e1d6f9c6422bcf0d09496be32c60979fdf7eecf85b57c550d334fe139fba27"}

{"id": "p_09bccb07641b50a7", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 213, "text": "漢時賜鼓吹技人，常從玄菟郡受朝服衣幘，高句麗令主其名籍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "65a2c0f5bdc1d8b567fccbd07445135f86b70238d7395b52213e3dd9f8738908"}

{"id": "p_c78293ce95fd8155", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 214, "text": "後稍驕恣，不復詣郡，於東界築小城，置朝服衣幘其中，歲時來取之，今胡猶名此城爲幘溝漊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "568729783985c97aa62656d48d8c11f0e5694d7422e5e6f3e2ba6a67e957e4bb"}

{"id": "p_03fbc4af97240d5c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 215, "text": "其置官，有對盧則不置沛者，有沛者則不置對盧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "b26798f5604d766be85a71ca4a0d3ac8d4c4a8aa47beecc1fc9c3d2cfbbd7154"}

{"id": "p_1594a0d0df8b8764", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 216, "text": "王之宗族，其大加皆稱古雛加。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "11f8d85f91b2a6e7f0bfbac9742d58da2a5b5cd45074a54e1201d5e87901ca68"}

{"id": "p_fb24500c73d92bfa", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 217, "text": "涓奴部本國主，今雖不爲王，適統大人，得稱古雛加，亦得立宗廟，祠靈星、社稷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "4e0ea3aabaea194f4d382b2fff38a6afc2f27fec50dc2b3b0bd32f880bfdfc4c"}

{"id": "p_6f17d1259ddd6f80", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 218, "text": "絕奴部世與王婚，加古雛之號。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "b94a5e2fd9ac2755001e8a8d8288bb180f2e3d4bbb442ae9fd42aae24a4d4654"}

{"id": "p_374f26255db52c04", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 219, "text": "諸大加亦自置使者、皁衣先人，名皆達於王，如卿大夫之家臣，會同坐起，不得與王家使者、皁衣先人同列。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "3d64bc5b39c96a7a2fa2528b17a7ddb0c47be90e6e0fc1797128c11780d2a38c"}

{"id": "p_68423e7836c923a3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 220, "text": "其國中大家不佃作，坐食者萬餘口，下戶遠擔米糧魚鹽供給之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "ba11c3b5b3092aa686f26d3df54d6223df1067337ccc9c5fbb08b2a38c10b40f"}

{"id": "p_321630a1d69dcd96", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 221, "text": "其民喜歌舞，國中邑落，暮夜男女群聚，相就歌戲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "c8ed89823a76b4e64ab8e5fa8d4bee598d50b1d26a0ad9f7a212f098e7f7ef17"}

{"id": "p_08db3cd56d60e889", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 222, "text": "無大倉庫，家家自有小倉，名之爲桴京。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "36fb60ad80af86cfeda047e9db6df02aaaff2ab6b519bcfe73bfbb181ab0231f"}

{"id": "p_f9292662c550fa80", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 223, "text": "跪拜申一腳，與夫餘異，行步皆走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "16e16f8b61e6b847ecddf9c7e55c1226d2da2738329c17373ad30c92bdf601c9"}

{"id": "p_7a9762e7e0b04e58", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 224, "text": "以十月祭天，國中大會，名曰東盟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "b8578d147b671bccdb16d27b862314c8292727accf7104cf7c1a25a26c164d9f"}

{"id": "p_4380665dd322cb67", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 225, "text": "其公會，衣服皆錦繡金銀以自飾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "7c870ddd9276a8fea90bc4cbd638163c23cedda51ff1f3fccc96e8e21c03d07d"}

{"id": "p_6c29c7557aa3d4b0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 226, "text": "大加主簿頭著幘，如幘而無餘，其小加著折風，形如弁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "111cfa15e42f7ee5ae5891cfe18d0f6d44945f2b2d1e118eb7bced93bda71211"}

{"id": "p_45f6f48ae23f7175", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 227, "text": "其國東有大穴，名隧穴，十月國中大會，迎隧神還于國東上祭之，置木隧於神坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "86093b044b335cf3c8cfdac356047b89842b8458dbab9b2548782deefbac7800"}

{"id": "p_ecc443399f6e75ce", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 228, "text": "無牢獄，有罪諸加評議，便殺之，沒入妻子爲奴婢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "57c08d9f1fc0a1fbfc39d223475d29ca405885f52cfd8c9d7b0367cd04c67ecf"}

{"id": "p_764c88cfb9da441e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 229, "text": "其俗作婚姻，言語已定，女家作小屋於大屋後，名婿屋，婿暮至女家戶外，自名跪拜，乞得就女宿，如是者再三，女父母乃聽使就小屋中宿，傍頓錢帛，至生子已長大，乃將婦歸家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "5e3c7d3946863784c19d287893429e3f81524bae1fc7b3f6747f86b2b4b47e77"}

{"id": "p_b36d957186fb5c8a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 230, "text": "男女已嫁娶，便稍作送終之衣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "2d85266658a126f460e6f8d003520b9194b0c11a65d7ec7b28b5755610ede3b5"}

{"id": "p_c4d53220b6f18571", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 231, "text": "厚葬，金銀財幣，盡於送死，積石爲封，列種松柏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "a1cfb229672840cc1bbb4b92c5ce442088509ee9c2414b456f38fa4868e60c4b"}

{"id": "p_7433707e74d7febf", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 232, "text": "國人有氣力，習戰鬥，沃沮、東濊皆屬焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "3b6b086ae1c09243af9fd719f1d040d60d7cf99799a698838921881d10711a8b"}

{"id": "p_f221f4320df702f8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 233, "text": "句麗作國，依大水而居，西安平縣北有小水，南流入海，句麗別種依小水作國，因名之爲小水貊，出好弓，所謂貊弓是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "21b7f22756baa4fc69ff1b3fc172421e6170088e1b910d70274a5ba702886704"}

{"id": "p_5fedce238cdfca06", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 234, "text": "王莽初發高句麗兵以伐胡，不欲行，強迫遣之，皆亡出塞爲寇盜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "efbd606e77af8b0821f4e766979fa98ccdebf1ba95bac404722da68d1f0f4bd9"}

{"id": "p_3050d84e3579d4c9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 235, "text": "遼西大尹田譚追擊之，爲所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "1a0041d2c5f07afbf774635e60688e470288de48a2edaadd0e04ee3ffddf0efc"}

{"id": "p_80e73cc356c6c603", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 236, "text": "州郡縣歸咎于句麗侯騊，嚴尤奏言：「貊人犯法，罪不起於騊，且宜安慰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "c38b3385bf7288178cd6599fecf4cfc4ff117efb469ddce40d73a068e3b68b93"}

{"id": "p_713f972389fed656", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 237, "text": "今猥被之大罪，恐其遂反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "6971482e94af828448f228b8c4f6985f88d2699a52ac25cec6bcbd879900d81c"}

{"id": "p_17aa33c3c39cd79b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 238, "text": "尤誘期句麗侯騊至而斬之，傳送其首詣長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "a9bf7326d77433d5234b90738532209ac3154567582457756c31451ebcae1713"}

{"id": "p_7987235b8820d246", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 239, "text": "莽大悅，佈告天下，更名高句麗爲下句麗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "84393678a37bdb34ed489669b6a9994acc737f1b5cfe9881270a22ed30bf154b"}

{"id": "p_fa32e13136070022", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 240, "text": "當此時爲侯國，漢光武帝八年，高句麗王遣使朝貢，始見稱王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "a9b959f2ee2ef2bd23880f1aed1ebc6be1e69948c7659838d53443a5960da63a"}

{"id": "p_26d8712af8f40f06", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 241, "text": "至殤、安之間，句麗王宮數寇遼東，更屬玄菟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "d00e26fc6963324ed396e3a97f6b93adb4d6730b5acfe8887f64ae469f22d14b"}

{"id": "p_900b3f277bef731c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 242, "text": "遼東太守蔡風、玄菟太守姚光以宮爲二郡害，興師伐之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "f548851b5e0160c5aa512d192143197eeca59af8232dd983beecd6dbc19ffd8b"}

{"id": "p_4bf38b020e57facd", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 243, "text": "宮密遣軍攻玄菟，焚燒候城，入遼隧，殺吏民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "5e922757597c70ac02e7c0f6b268478e5ac3e8560bcb7e7f787284d84be99e9a"}

{"id": "p_ff9c48c7f20f7468", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 244, "text": "後宮復犯遼東，蔡風輕將吏士追討之，軍敗沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "c9423b68e88c72ecf1a7ac1f616b186c347c918f0856b7c0393ab1f1173113cc"}

{"id": "p_1c3aacbcac62e65c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 245, "text": "順、桓之間，復犯遼東，寇新安、居鄉，又攻西安平，於道上殺帶方令，略得樂浪太守妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "dce393605f9995cb8afa4adebb704cba3f80886dcd2e335efacee1bc2ab7676d"}

{"id": "p_c53315e6b0ab0a2a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 246, "text": "靈帝，玄菟太守耿臨討之，斬首虜數百級，伯固降，屬遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "484eda426c754fba9a28a049ef960439fd77cde64b26dc29937156bf1316e141"}

{"id": "p_a5f78264b9fce41b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 247, "text": "〔熹〕平中，伯固乞屬玄菟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "6cff23b8ce51a7bd71f35359fb40bd2f82f2c97a7693c2ba4df761ae7cb01f6f"}

{"id": "p_1beb7e1a5156226f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 248, "text": "公孫度之雄海東也，伯固遣大加優居、主簿然人等助度擊富山賊，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "a682ff3307e72b8b31aedd684336cf14f66341fa319aa815a8a0a7ee259fa2c5"}

{"id": "p_515e326198bde321", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 249, "text": "伯固死，有二子，長子拔奇，小子伊夷模。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "63219315ba703f26a73f172e29bfa6c01ea6d19533a299a94df27f3667d6b68d"}

{"id": "p_903c189be01d1c73", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 250, "text": "拔奇不肖，國人便共立伊夷模爲王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "b29e3f22365327a65490e6ac2276ab1f017b0dced7908157a989d1893a32e22b"}

{"id": "p_4b6175e5eb0e5bac", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 251, "text": "自伯固時，數寇遼東，又受亡胡五百餘家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "bf91136a397a5456c46738bcf04be0553e1c5756ed152addf25545f2c2c96933"}

{"id": "p_ff85fb2b58bff299", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 252, "text": "建安中，公孫康出軍擊之，破其國，焚燒邑落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "de0755c659311f842bc150aee3ccf0815bd6f64eb68773cb77ccf06d25e855d8"}

{"id": "p_45a4e0692d5ef843", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 253, "text": "拔奇怨爲兄而不得立，與涓奴加各將下戶三萬餘口詣康降，還住沸流水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "6c74b047cd83f9d6f9729c97db0172eb6f019c32478410410cce9f022c57b04c"}

{"id": "p_17bc3905bf52de30", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 254, "text": "降胡亦叛伊夷模，伊夷模更作新國，今日所在是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "b34628a65768f56e741d81291f2795725da2d85465de81a11277d70ca42ccfe7"}

{"id": "p_ddea55ec2d0f23f4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 255, "text": "拔奇遂往遼東，有子留句麗國，今古雛加駮位居是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "d04e5693ed936b1028b05b27ed736067796971b298b343ec8c0d14f1ba029e4a"}

{"id": "p_b597d3bac710b186", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 256, "text": "其後復擊玄菟，玄菟與遼東合擊，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "724f4237d402f53d91ecf48c534f9687abfa282d7e37bb339f59f9cb2e8a23e9"}

{"id": "p_90f113baa0517d85", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 257, "text": "伊夷模無子，淫灌奴部，生子名位宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "2eb1c1797f108349adf5e5b34979ef474ef4afe12d2bb328f230cc8175d7a3c9"}

{"id": "p_9a5199303a9909d8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 258, "text": "伊夷模死，立以爲王，今句麗王宮是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "0d086304861fb969e8ac83600e5ef0194a8e4c4a510807d189869cc6ab07bf1e"}

{"id": "p_aa879eeaaec323df", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 259, "text": "其曾祖名宮，生能開目視，其國人惡之，及長大，果凶虐，數寇鈔，國見殘破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "7b5bfb702a21f1021ffa0a373ba68c390c21294495ae72e63f618f1de0568aa4"}

{"id": "p_13f3257458a060d8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 260, "text": "今王生墮地，亦能開目視人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "5af290d75733c22aa24ac01f806f448ebe84a9f3e28009ff69b1cac34948be81"}

{"id": "p_ae7290d47ec6d6f8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 261, "text": "句麗呼相似爲位，似其祖，故名之爲位宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "74855a1640e412612c4434d0f0949658a9ca2ad522c0d3962b1369ef7bac5e14"}

{"id": "p_d75bd86ff3a33024", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 262, "text": "位宮有力勇，便鞍馬，善獵射。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "68b7d2638e63f1a6e32ddb737dd659296c9430bbce7ecf9ab897a19defee88bd"}

{"id": "p_1fd08a7e67e45dd2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 263, "text": "，太尉司馬宣王率衆討公孫淵，宮遣主簿大加將數千人助軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "e7346e212078c923da10eadb31a6039055b7aa0269c67740dae9e3063cb71415"}

{"id": "p_3e6381a05f0edc83", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 264, "text": "，宮寇西安平，其五年，爲幽州刺吏毌丘儉所破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "0b0eef76295e6991fc5a3f0b2635d76014e5e1597cf9ee935d9e4fa6110027f3"}

{"id": "p_c9cf52e6ee5c4651", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 265, "text": "東沃沮在高句麗蓋馬大山之東，濱大海而居。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "66d08b0100c3e0139c77475c37f1810cd52f0bd86afbe5981f0204c04f999a68"}

{"id": "p_4789deccad00f59e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 266, "text": "其地形東北狹，西南長，可千里，北與挹婁、夫餘，南與濊貊接。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "2da6dc0b5dea9d4a30c07a2ef70cc2926d2d870200312c5f4ee33834d1da1a69"}

{"id": "p_5cd2abc53c06a0fb", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 267, "text": "戶五千，無大君王，世世邑落，各有長帥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "ce74e2ce766e5b61974fd1bdf036b1139d25550a5706fb10342c55e448e56fca"}

{"id": "p_e7e89f7bf480d9d5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 268, "text": "其言語與句麗大同，時時小異。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "b6e476a73cb4ed4e62b4ea59d44921716ad08d0d5852f7175db196716779c966"}

{"id": "p_4bfd3d673810372a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 269, "text": "漢初，燕亡人衛滿王朝鮮，時沃沮皆屬焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "7ccb002d467d9374ca4f7f5dc3f2c9274f268b5fa126bbd32e1b374263203abd"}

{"id": "p_aaa07947aa7ce09d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 270, "text": "漢武帝，伐朝鮮，殺滿孫右渠，分其地爲四郡，以沃沮城爲玄菟郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "6e75cb01190f0858c6c7cdc63297fac793204b22809e1709ffda3d53f1d15ae3"}

{"id": "p_71abc54baf9f723d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 271, "text": "後爲夷貊所侵，徙郡句麗西北，今所謂玄菟故府是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "09177f878ccf78a35e036a4e40e2a3905bfb809b46fac9ab73494d8e2dd258fe"}

{"id": "p_0ec773cb37948be9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 272, "text": "漢以土地廣遠，在單單大領之東，分置東部都尉，治不耐城，別主領東七縣，時沃沮亦皆爲縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "4eb5fa2b662f6b30d2eebdfb0d62eb82c92dd8f0c9d819051c442a63cb129090"}

{"id": "p_922dcbc9e8b380dd", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 273, "text": "漢（光）武六年，省邊郡，都尉由此罷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "8e7e518b8fdffbe4d1adadb2b7a8694f115c666a7b05ffdaefff9fd560e16a3a"}

{"id": "p_5c988ed84aebb1b1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 274, "text": "其後皆以其縣中渠帥爲縣侯，不耐、華麗、沃沮諸縣皆爲侯國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "95d69117f42eead58cf7b3f4e762f6f38da98e7b13e01c28b041565218107dc2"}

{"id": "p_93596bbc33b87189", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 275, "text": "夷狄更相攻伐，唯不耐濊侯至今猶置功曹、主簿諸曹，皆濊民作之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "312f52da5d392925f7363ffbd2517995f7a237eca7c46a504678d527ef485482"}

{"id": "p_7bb128e10bae5fc5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 276, "text": "沃沮諸邑落渠帥，皆自稱三老，則故縣國之制也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "b40a61acaf3e917313aeaa761120c14a7205dd4690b31bddb07c7021432048de"}

{"id": "p_0ea27c133b61be55", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 277, "text": "國小，迫於大國之間，遂臣屬句麗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "3a13f8fb49d31fe753f4af0d4b30322caf95d3c75f31f8392677e52b8c51a50f"}

{"id": "p_6d3bb2b49c407b56", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 278, "text": "句麗復置其中大人爲使者，使相主領，又使大加統責其租稅，貊布、魚、鹽、海中食物，千里擔負致之，又送其美女以爲婢妾，遇之如奴僕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "00ae3da3de956743aba877f420adf3a7e0fd164a711f1c3f168e7d7d9d5e799c"}

{"id": "p_f5d34efe321ead77", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 279, "text": "其土地肥美，背山向海，宜五穀，善田種。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "8e4ca5cb079e033d3b4be572d2bfdd9c75084e68c4c24c8797582e568cbe3035"}

{"id": "p_5e5f33bb97d11146", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 280, "text": "人性質直強勇，少牛馬，便持矛步戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "f35f07b43c34f6243accf857140bbfcdfcc9eadc1bd6c23ce7a174f4ff388a6f"}

{"id": "p_7859ac074c883393", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 281, "text": "食飲居處，衣服禮節，有似句麗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "9a0cda10489b18578d08baa2eb5206a6fb1fb271ecd50d895862ee8df9e53c7f"}

{"id": "p_d744f7621bc17c02", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 282, "text": "《魏略》曰：其嫁娶之法，女年十歲，已相設許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "7302d161edfa10d37a6aa0c559ff2bd31e9d93ce956d9bb17669ca8786c361ae"}

{"id": "p_772b7d0ccd483253", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 283, "text": "女家責錢，錢畢，乃復還婿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "d50ea537994ce54a75695c64d5c3a475caebad9767e081a6eb3969bc1d8a0428"}

{"id": "p_0bc6f8f344c46f9d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 284, "text": "其葬作大木槨，長十餘丈，開一頭作戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "029ee512baedde7004c700a246198c6e7de10315a265dc3a22cdf3afca418398"}

{"id": "p_38686e5228649303", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 285, "text": "新死者皆假埋之，才使覆形，皮肉盡，乃取骨置槨中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "36731f8a28a7456e7599ea2f42a3786191d4522f5523cdf43ef1caedd65acdf2"}

{"id": "p_3fe178a6fdd6d073", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 286, "text": "舉家皆共一槨，刻木如生形，隨死者爲數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "f2df6a5dadd420fbd3e3902161c66d88c02179be4201046b6ab4896f686bca2d"}

{"id": "p_b476b821daa0cdea", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 287, "text": "又有瓦䥶，置米其中，編縣之於槨戶邊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "feb35871f66d1cdaa61c1d0e82b52442cffb744d1d22167b381f6dde36990c9c"}

{"id": "p_765c1ae13febf776", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 288, "text": "毌丘儉討句麗，句麗王宮奔沃沮，遂進師擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "80ca2cf5f66ae68970a46afc87b74f67b345e21b26f899dfcb6e04bffc83744d"}

{"id": "p_da57a9b94faff644", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 289, "text": "沃沮邑落皆破之，斬獲首虜三千餘級，宮奔北沃沮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "b41097dd50d0cc49b1a8c6bc72ec4fe9a541c6cb223b358bfbf79e60a3ed4b94"}

{"id": "p_388ea9a26413ece5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 290, "text": "北沃沮一名置溝婁，去南沃沮八百餘-{里}-，其俗南北皆同，與挹婁接。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "5679bedbe6cc562621b1dbdda645e259a3c654323576e8c63ad2bb1c69927fc3"}

{"id": "p_9f0496318e5483d9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 291, "text": "挹婁喜乘船寇鈔，北沃沮畏之，夏月恆在山岩深穴中爲守備，冬月冰凍，船道不通，乃下居村落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "a228417c882a03838c75fc705ef7e356427f34f6dbe6df5935607a791477951c"}

{"id": "p_c79b3f11b9919049", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 292, "text": "王頎別遣追討宮，盡其東界。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "bf230465c9417a05378b889d4ad310be162bf5383e8e43963a2eaf71c3531950"}

{"id": "p_2ba4fe2bca93556f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 293, "text": "問其耆老「海東復有人不」？", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "835b0f2ea168d6c6cbdd9cea2fc0185618bebfac48ea013867732b37a1c7abbd"}

{"id": "p_5d2775cdb635dcdc", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 294, "text": "耆老言國人嘗乘船捕魚，遭風見吹數十日，東得一島，上有人，言語不相曉，其俗常以七月取童女沈海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "d004c6b6bec9b9175f98bcf1e716865f978d755d5fdfd08c07472f5244260af2"}

{"id": "p_56fd4d9c18c95bef", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 295, "text": "又言有一國亦在海中，純女無男。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "e88cc4390b98b2a78662d56a365a4c81044017c6582338abc633e0728b737b6b"}

{"id": "p_917aaf3530014fd5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 296, "text": "又說得一布衣，從海中浮出，其身如中（國）人衣，其兩袖長三丈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "93859ac64134a5cabfd86c1315078d24e2e1a1f2f3fbe9c6a7f60c3efbbf974c"}

{"id": "p_c54e5a05ac9c8741", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 297, "text": "又得一破船，隨波出在海岸邊，有一人項中復有面，生得之，與語不相通，不食而死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "a4d0e3f3f519d7a55ff08f045acf76e58d3cbc142efd6af7f4b2ee31ce6052c5"}

{"id": "p_d455982311a19961", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 298, "text": "挹婁在夫餘東北千餘-{里}-，濱大海，南與北沃沮接，未知其北所極。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "4649eb894a5b69b1bbf181e5b3f3abfefb99016b7c86bbf3e37fa8e22d93e18c"}

{"id": "p_58e7fe45d81ead24", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 299, "text": "其人形似夫餘，言語不與夫餘、句麗同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "5a616b88a9e1b9603d94aff6354fcfa12b2a2a841e8569762179277f0e29617c"}

{"id": "p_1601dbb1841717a5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 300, "text": "無大君長，邑落各有大人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "a3b32dd4396dca813ca1f5e48d922b1da18b28eab6a16e7301fe428abdd0d61c"}

{"id": "p_78c485a3adf9e7c3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 301, "text": "處山林之間，常穴居，大家深九梯，以多爲好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "97791608b839357ee01a667b0a270abb7e7682956643a5533da100b829a2aef5"}

{"id": "p_da13f98e003cf578", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 302, "text": "其俗好養豬，食其肉，衣其皮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "af67f3446cee3a84a1deed50ddc02ccbfdc89877517007f85d49fa4d5fa2836f"}

{"id": "p_dbba3dd130f6ddf2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 303, "text": "冬以豬膏塗身，厚數分，以禦風寒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 303}, "text_hash": "91601b4f0ac88ec7e4a9fd95fb222e848a0ec947e689427ed3b98b7a18ad0e37"}

{"id": "p_dabed7ebca098d0e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 304, "text": "夏則裸袒，以尺布隱其前後，以蔽形體。", "locator": {"ordinal": 304}, "text_hash": "3a8c468242537a86879443ef267aeb187c57695e5abedc25abaa8e906ec2b307"}

{"id": "p_a29e92cd9fa18201", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 305, "text": "其人不絜，作溷在中央，人圍其表居。", "locator": {"ordinal": 305}, "text_hash": "bf22eef8374ef1460cc09ec8caf91dbc01255200d67ed06c851bad819744c3df"}

{"id": "p_a0134a278375ff39", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 306, "text": "其弓長四尺，力如弩，矢用楛，長尺八寸，青石爲鏃，古之肅慎氏之國也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 306}, "text_hash": "f0683f9d353bcaaa0d9f6b5bb4c2a07999583b5265ec6fdeb9b58d4f1864c416"}

{"id": "p_497dbb311ed44b7f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 307, "text": "出赤玉，好貂，今所謂挹婁貂是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 307}, "text_hash": "71680a1ead595c84cca8ee00eddfe368f4ea13e853a4e5abde7a8df53a674c81"}

{"id": "p_f36a5eb51e41875b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 308, "text": "自漢已來，臣屬夫餘，夫餘責其租賦重，以黃初中叛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 308}, "text_hash": "ee6f946a2d48e63902fc8f45ac4f3c4838d9cd17685f61b87aca7ed178bedb38"}

{"id": "p_51c783b6b0b4dacb", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 309, "text": "夫餘數伐之，其人衆雖少，所在山險，鄰國人畏其弓矢，卒不能服也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 309}, "text_hash": "0e3fdb3b175e5c1b8f6d8dfe898313e02e2cb5776330a3465185d600ab144256"}

{"id": "p_3d7dfc1e19af311f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 310, "text": "其國便乘船寇盜，鄰國患之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 310}, "text_hash": "caafac452c3bd8bb2872a6f2e896e9fc4bea73b76a76a18d58b99a6bfd09f257"}

{"id": "p_e23009062173fcdf", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 311, "text": "東夷飲食類皆用俎豆，唯挹婁不，法俗最無綱紀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 311}, "text_hash": "fe63995f4308aee129e2824c3e236622b1b8d1724675aca437a85092b03f3cfd"}

{"id": "p_063f00f507e6688e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 312, "text": "濊南與辰韓，北與高句麗、沃沮接，東窮大海，今朝鮮之東皆其地也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 312}, "text_hash": "2b0fc86ee13f073706445da4da124893b4e866fa3fee2adc208798e518765d85"}

{"id": "p_5b7d4690d386476d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 313, "text": "昔箕子既適朝鮮，作八條之教以教之，無門戶之閉而民不爲盜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 313}, "text_hash": "70847d6a18a5e289c18f2845cc2d771ebae634dac1d42c401ab5003bcea0bba9"}

{"id": "p_6898cda6fef485d9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 314, "text": "其後四十餘世，朝鮮侯（淮）僭號稱王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 314}, "text_hash": "1d06f5538ea385c942ffc3ba3a9891c6cac0aee30e4127753fbedce35955c73e"}

{"id": "p_e90539084c4fbcc5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 315, "text": "陳勝等起，天下叛秦，燕、齊、趙民避地朝鮮數萬口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 315}, "text_hash": "83cf5994ce4fdf2165403069e66ba39615ef2df42fee9b6195e1d27eba13bacd"}

{"id": "p_a3d9ca2bc2017c29", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 316, "text": "燕人衛滿，魋結夷服，復來王之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 316}, "text_hash": "59e888ddaa6846f70909c789c50e9cb6b7407d9458460b0216c10c79fd9004af"}

{"id": "p_03b394acd797dba4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 317, "text": "漢武帝伐滅朝鮮，分其地爲四郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 317}, "text_hash": "c2b70ff7160b4a04909a1427d4337e5a57667fe0e8cdb6ad1d1fa5b34441385a"}

{"id": "p_7e211772a656b007", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 318, "text": "無大君長，自漢已來，其官有侯邑君、三老，統主下戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 318}, "text_hash": "5c61766d3d835d9433f918cdb828e3421db653c25e98d4782cc2e16c44c082fc"}

{"id": "p_b7fa96b77a7e2801", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 319, "text": "其耆老舊自謂與句麗同種。", "locator": {"ordinal": 319}, "text_hash": "7fbdd1c686fb86f4b273f808299bb13fe7741f5cf3c6972a433ab9ffb1214f4b"}

{"id": "p_286172487aeb3c6e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 320, "text": "其人性願愨，少嗜欲，有廉恥，不請（句麗）匄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 320}, "text_hash": "150b0170e78a7cc61ed0dde7b42edc4bb76d83cbadfd1bdcbfb379635d327d9a"}

{"id": "p_5fbc5f7d51507efe", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 321, "text": "言語法俗大抵與句麗同，衣服有異。", "locator": {"ordinal": 321}, "text_hash": "95fe5f828cc2d19208c5015c66823bb9f4358c57e1b3045a84602ba95ecbb7bf"}

{"id": "p_ea513eb180c6c732", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 322, "text": "男女衣皆著曲領，男子擊銀花廣數寸以爲飾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 322}, "text_hash": "27f6c75a8f7b2ae461090b7841e0a7be3365314c1507ff8045afe9ce4fb69e6a"}

{"id": "p_999df3daf0ae4e15", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 323, "text": "自單單大山領以西屬樂浪，自領以東七縣，都尉主之，皆以濊爲民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 323}, "text_hash": "3c4bb32d8eacb34eb103d066f098792b343f27e5497b4e29fffd6feed2ecedca"}

{"id": "p_f58215aefe75cd4f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 324, "text": "後省都尉，封其渠帥爲侯，今不耐濊皆其種也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 324}, "text_hash": "5df8cdb6cdc6e433f240bc36b977b7d882eaa0ed6c717a977f3e557ab3649723"}

{"id": "p_5158b7abf9e2d8e6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 325, "text": "其俗重山川，山川各有部分，不得妄相涉入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 325}, "text_hash": "7b0b13edd30342f4328e200c4efa6fad2f17e8350cb35ee0a640297aeda8075f"}

{"id": "p_21ba954ab7965f90", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 326, "text": "多忌諱，疾病死亡輒損棄舊宅，更作新居。", "locator": {"ordinal": 326}, "text_hash": "8995642231a5de29eaae371f8f3c35a671837d5b64a56c1a358b505f3b31d220"}

{"id": "p_d4198b7adcd040c5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 327, "text": "曉候星宿，豫知年歲豐約。", "locator": {"ordinal": 327}, "text_hash": "fa0cd4ca240cb964aba4202af1857790e2f93d2e48f88a8a2f84e3e6ba157558"}

{"id": "p_187e7cf4e928fde1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 328, "text": "常用十月節祭天，晝夜飲酒歌舞，名之爲舞天，又祭虎以爲神。", "locator": {"ordinal": 328}, "text_hash": "780c3203664e31cfbe1fb4152c3991a08207a6d028ebfcffe244fe3bd973f79b"}

{"id": "p_aa41d1e8235ce2ec", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 329, "text": "其邑落相侵犯，輒相罰責生口牛馬，名之爲責禍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 329}, "text_hash": "d6b4d9b64cc37fcc051bfb038ffd92f5921356da8974014b8386b9758fdc2d3b"}

{"id": "p_0df68ff523cba285", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 330, "text": "作矛長三丈，或數人共持之，能步戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 330}, "text_hash": "583cb25fa4f281e6d0c5fe9f31c96d6cf78cff158939f79f492d3260be875413"}

{"id": "p_739f7fb899f595d8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 331, "text": "其海出班魚皮，土地饒文豹，又出果下馬，漢桓時獻之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 331}, "text_hash": "6a049a39884bd87b4baa76c507c364cce9f32edb4a563b69a4521e0651df2bc8"}

{"id": "p_13b16b61859eeb69", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 332, "text": "，樂浪太守劉茂、帶方太守弓遵以領東濊屬句麗，興師伐之，不耐侯等舉邑降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 332}, "text_hash": "dfc978a6e16aff89f8fbbd6fbab9126c4d64f8b13e51a3e644b67ab46f347ffd"}

{"id": "p_7d67499aea83ac22", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 333, "text": "其八年，詣闕朝貢，詔更拜不耐濊王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 333}, "text_hash": "20223c513e5b87f6ce41b73b3da7b8960335e7cab9ecfc78739b83ed8fc13a00"}

{"id": "p_40bdf5131431758e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 334, "text": "居處雜在民間，四時詣郡朝謁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 334}, "text_hash": "7bd151df8d1d3187a13f7d351b7314db60f7dc01c4f6647bd16ed09d46b3c01d"}

{"id": "p_e14b4d30b7e22e6b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 335, "text": "二郡有軍征賦調，供給役使，遇之如民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 335}, "text_hash": "2eaa32110808fdcf38765fc455117f12da620bca4cc51d98ea2b4191f9c76fa0"}

{"id": "p_ef40922e4332dcd5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 336, "text": "韓在帶方之南，東西以海爲限，南與倭接，方可四千里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 336}, "text_hash": "2cd72a38532a4a54fb3bb94ec5327049d64afb7f087fc4b6be1d8c56f2723393"}

{"id": "p_ba738954a88e2cf6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 337, "text": "有三種，一曰馬韓，二曰辰韓，三曰弁韓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 337}, "text_hash": "6e0c906b7bb506f217ed4c0668e6893e952a4bdd47ba4b21a583a7cb6683eda6"}

{"id": "p_15df88067b74ede2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 338, "text": "其民土著，種植，知蠶桑，作綿布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 338}, "text_hash": "5b558070ed2b7033087297ab420d19349cff3ae79b3200cbe65482a288553c77"}

{"id": "p_bff4de3142460363", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 339, "text": "各有長帥，大者自名爲臣智，其次爲邑借，散在山海間，無城郭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 339}, "text_hash": "36f2097968d5628e2502ec5661fbfe22e0fc477c805fbdf0c8183de0ceadbdef"}

{"id": "p_acbe34fa6c84576c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 340, "text": "有爰襄國、牟水國、桑外國、小石索國、大石索國、優休牟涿國、臣濆沽國、伯濟國、速盧不斯國、日華國、古誕者國、古離國、怒藍國、月支國、咨離牟盧國、素謂乾國、古爰國、莫盧國、卑離國、占離卑國、臣釁國、支侵國、狗盧國、卑彌國、監奚卑離國、古蒲國、致利鞠國、冉路國、兒林國、駟盧國、內卑離國、感奚國、萬盧國、辟卑離國、臼斯烏旦國、一離國、不彌國、支半國、狗素國、捷盧國、牟盧卑離國、臣蘇塗國、莫盧國、古臘國、臨素半國、臣雲新國、如來卑離國、楚山塗卑離國、一難國、狗奚國、不雲國、不斯濆邪國、爰池國、乾馬國、楚離國，凡五十餘國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 340}, "text_hash": "88417a841574df494130621633283288df406e332974267d329bc168889d6e28"}

{"id": "p_5af40eb2177861e3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 341, "text": "大國萬餘家，小國數千家，總十餘萬戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 341}, "text_hash": "bba4973310089a41cb20a0f8f9bd1f989bd6960543eb2758ba75fa9c11cbf9ad"}

{"id": "p_8192318eb3224b62", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 342, "text": "臣雲遣支報，安邪踧支濆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 342}, "text_hash": "c0b0d30705fbcd4aff973f493e6bee01692e8365d43655892b8bf868a7ef00ba"}

{"id": "p_a5ac5a374acb57fe", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 343, "text": "臣離兒不例，狗邪秦支廉之號。", "locator": {"ordinal": 343}, "text_hash": "bc18c61860adbadc8fa6b5a8c47b898e4eb13be346480dd678bab9c722f63c48"}

{"id": "p_96abe76fdb6f757c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 344, "text": "其官有魏率善、邑君、歸義侯、中郎將、都尉、伯長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 344}, "text_hash": "6ed130bae7f64d0c6f607047e4d3b7287d03381d16b2c4b409a75219593e60b9"}

{"id": "p_add5c4caac55095b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 345, "text": "侯准既僭號稱王，爲燕亡人衛滿所攻奪，《魏略》曰：昔箕子之後朝鮮侯，見周衰，燕自尊爲王，欲東略地，朝鮮侯亦自稱爲王，欲興兵逆擊燕以尊周室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 345}, "text_hash": "5e54af1a8738cbb8173458566bcf9d4786df8543bc22216f7f7530ca5b4c4314"}

{"id": "p_8de8b2ba14df4603", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 346, "text": "使禮西說燕，燕止之，不攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 346}, "text_hash": "6232cffdbbc33ecde59afa933f54a36f34d69e542ecee4919c959808929b3ec7"}

{"id": "p_880134ffd7717996", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 347, "text": "後子孫稍驕虐，燕乃遣將秦開攻其西方，取地二千餘-{里}-，至滿番汗爲界，朝鮮遂弱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 347}, "text_hash": "62a72722f8fa7c0b12df1e2873a9f7482bffb4cca278982a9193c9b81372e0fd"}

{"id": "p_ea9c56c3ebc0b5e5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 348, "text": "及秦並天下，使蒙恬築長城，到遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 348}, "text_hash": "7a70676f2c2ce8ac56638bbe4c3965e11a100c85886b043f1029b9fd8fe36e84"}

{"id": "p_fd88b59a6374e6f6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 349, "text": "時朝鮮王否立，畏秦襲之，略服屬秦，不肯朝會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 349}, "text_hash": "b40af7fdc48c7130d459a8e85317f7e7970100f4a4c29775af750137b2076dcc"}

{"id": "p_6afc3fb93f671f4d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 350, "text": "二十餘年而陳、項起，天下亂，燕、齊、趙民愁苦，稍稍亡往准，准乃置之於西方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 350}, "text_hash": "1774ddb88dc3448a63b3c504ee654687a488801f8849b6f7d508baac48bbd160"}

{"id": "p_9f1c302004baafc4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 351, "text": "及漢以盧綰爲燕王，朝鮮與燕界於浿水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 351}, "text_hash": "e4086e75256f03ca36d36de2d4732c5579eddf9546c1556ab7b737e11209412e"}

{"id": "p_17b0940462b0af48", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 352, "text": "及綰反，入匈奴，燕人衛滿亡命，爲胡服，東度浿水，詣准降，說准求居西界，（故）中國亡命爲朝鮮籓屏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 352}, "text_hash": "75b101391ebbb718685ec31daa6fee3fbfea4cebd0c9afb0afcb5b6ec5349e65"}

{"id": "p_6673d88e315fb7d0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 353, "text": "准信寵之，拜爲博士，賜以圭，封之百里，令守西邊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 353}, "text_hash": "1d6f1d966d7fe8f71c749612dc85faed8052f624f5c8858815dc8ef4f314cd88"}

{"id": "p_44e5c8b381190f31", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 354, "text": "滿誘亡黨，衆稍多，乃詐遣人告准，言漢兵十道至，求入宿衛，遂還攻准。", "locator": {"ordinal": 354}, "text_hash": "b06abdfddd837e1b76bf740f5ebbd6bff5ba7a47ea1b2d86ba995ea7981a92d9"}

{"id": "p_563f29df4bd0b551", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 355, "text": "將其左右宮人走入海，居韓地，自號韓王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 355}, "text_hash": "99b5778b0959d3bd5af7efc036435b38120b89c63892a256fccb834351be6467"}

{"id": "p_6e1b4658cbaf1157", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 356, "text": "其後絕滅，今韓人猶有奉其祭祀者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 356}, "text_hash": "f2385ff26b32653b42f0aaf3c66d685f20d6ef2bb838635864b6ee0d0e029f07"}

{"id": "p_3fc8c0e330682825", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 357, "text": "漢時屬樂浪郡，四時朝謁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 357}, "text_hash": "0e9765c2a9a1cd442f30226279cd907a2b796a70e0d4ffcd8b6a6f4aa81f5230"}

{"id": "p_4c2c06602754fa24", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 358, "text": "《魏略》曰：初，右渠未破時，朝鮮相曆谿卿以諫右渠不用，東之辰國，時民隨出居者二千餘戶，亦與朝鮮貢蕃不相往來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 358}, "text_hash": "1d00946d98eaa4d06f43a2572a06048a9348596f666005225940b8cba050b1e3"}

{"id": "p_1617b8f7b7d01268", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 359, "text": "至王莽地皇時，廉斯鑡爲辰韓右渠帥，聞樂浪土地美，人民饒樂，亡欲來降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 359}, "text_hash": "f9d500cc2704f706a74a832ff4ecd11ea0700e4b101c01e59dc18f830fd699ad"}

{"id": "p_c6c9028759a9eadb", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 360, "text": "出其邑落，見田中驅雀男子一人，其語非韓人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 360}, "text_hash": "92ec4d3a4a3a9169cfcefe449f52724174468e2e0b75c018dd6ff543b461d2b2"}

{"id": "p_3e9f14b79e80751b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 361, "text": "問之，男子曰：「我等漢人，名戶來，我等輩千五百人伐材木，爲韓所擊得，皆斷髮爲奴，積三年矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 361}, "text_hash": "0a889f6034d9c420ab74202b1ccbdf88f5527e0fefa16de6ce0102e3002acb95"}

{"id": "p_d6b3a0b8db7b3086", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 362, "text": "」鑡曰：「我當降漢樂浪，汝欲去不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 362}, "text_hash": "afc47c08a55ee8bff3499e24e79c36a75bbef514569327b539d203377cd048a5"}

{"id": "p_4aef3e4a3734c71e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 363, "text": "」（辰）鑡因將戶來（來）出詣含資縣，縣言郡，郡即以鑡爲譯，從芩中乘大船入辰韓，逆取戶來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 363}, "text_hash": "c359711af5e8d75cdc61a3f5b02edb264680052852311f1f0bd976df9d9395af"}

{"id": "p_1e29510e8a81b774", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 364, "text": "降伴輩尚得千人，其五百人已死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 364}, "text_hash": "5a573c8dac98c9d3596fc1fbc913f618613bcafe2332dfe26971a3817eb0e343"}

{"id": "p_54da7e9f65907c4a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 365, "text": "鑡時曉謂辰韓：「汝還五百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 365}, "text_hash": "67819969738423e393779a5ee06fd4fbb832bcf9ffa28fa50d5e5f4c882e8ced"}
