{"id": "p_4081a77d736ac62f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 366, "text": "若不者，樂浪當遣萬兵乘船來擊汝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 366}, "text_hash": "f0b2a9425caf289132d5bbf0bd9f94d5ddeb0971467b3cd1081f498f9f576804"}

{"id": "p_80661546374cf591", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 367, "text": "」辰韓曰：「五百人已死，我當出贖直耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 367}, "text_hash": "d62cafda9d2a50ac6fc71ae287fbcea7d1d30ef9643483320c319ce3c43a32c9"}

{"id": "p_dba4e706e2a15af1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 368, "text": "」乃出辰韓萬五千人，弁韓布萬五千匹，鑡收取直還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 368}, "text_hash": "44c351fd5a0601334df632a517e8eef388ccd7965f51eb1d62cea407daae9b48"}

{"id": "p_3822de3412238142", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 369, "text": "郡表鑡功義，賜冠幘、田宅，子孫數世，至安帝時，故受復除。", "locator": {"ordinal": 369}, "text_hash": "d02a74dfebcbdc35f2275ebfc7212e8d2fbf196337db3317b02f58ab623084b3"}

{"id": "p_320b024d2fb95f4b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 370, "text": "桓、靈之末，韓濊強盛，郡縣不能制，民多流入韓國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 370}, "text_hash": "19d101e4277aaf7085663690da0bb04f3c5a867c4c33296ed509863516689395"}

{"id": "p_d684c609cd487a52", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 371, "text": "建安中，公孫康分屯有縣以南荒地爲帶方郡，遣公孫模、張敞等收集遺民，興兵伐韓濊，舊民稍出，是後倭韓遂屬帶方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 371}, "text_hash": "66da345d25f1cb764f5e73e2f3dbcb4c4ab5fb3944d0f827b44b2fb57b7e35e7"}

{"id": "p_7d0e8db8efd36816", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 372, "text": "景初中，明帝密遣帶方太守劉昕、樂浪太守鮮于嗣越海定二郡，諸韓國臣智加賜邑君印綬，其次與邑長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 372}, "text_hash": "8b8746c64c04b8734245379dd8472bb4ae0a76ac037afa70f350fa4fafff2011"}

{"id": "p_c0e5a277053bfdbf", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 373, "text": "其俗好衣幘，下戶詣郡朝謁，皆假衣幘，自服印綬衣幘千有餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 373}, "text_hash": "5381cc64d6b411a327096fa733e8204e02c7acf88433f903825aa819caae3a88"}

{"id": "p_3d279e0cada9ef0d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 374, "text": "部從事吳林以樂浪本統韓國，分割辰韓八國以與樂浪，吏譯轉有異同，臣智激韓忿，攻帶方郡崎離營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 374}, "text_hash": "2583efd57e2b0b9fb7ecd76e5ade780cdf0d76f3052551020e4f24ad02f2011e"}

{"id": "p_a11648118c0dfbe0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 375, "text": "時太守弓遵、樂浪太守劉茂興兵伐之，遵戰死，二郡遂滅韓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 375}, "text_hash": "5ad202205f992d94927cf2d4149977b971b3e19197cbfd195884a924049f1dfa"}

{"id": "p_65c574c9cdef0354", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 376, "text": "其俗少綱紀，國邑雖有主帥，邑落雜居，不能善相制禦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 376}, "text_hash": "c656b8dc92ba63ee25f810952670f9d4de4e35b2e4d1a40a6413b2235b7ee72f"}

{"id": "p_3c8b6f6480392a6b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 377, "text": "居處作草屋土室，形如塚，其戶在上，舉家共在中，無長幼男女之別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 377}, "text_hash": "0cb4d2b7359fb4cfc45fa0fb86c2d0f7365c04851423e6c0f49311d9b7a759f5"}

{"id": "p_9056033f902eddfb", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 378, "text": "其葬有槨無棺，不知乘牛馬，牛馬盡於送死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 378}, "text_hash": "37bd7caac92507f294b69a04f65d4c795eac2071a5d8ae79fcb2952fe4b15413"}

{"id": "p_b07f0f221bbd45b2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 379, "text": "以瓔珠爲財寶，或以綴衣爲飾，或以縣頸垂耳，不以金銀錦繡爲珍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 379}, "text_hash": "9408d3f258c9a21efeddc01fdc73ee894b743e94b22c7860814d5f9560338745"}

{"id": "p_0eb4be111e788a44", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 380, "text": "其人性強勇，魁頭露紒，如炅兵，衣布袍，足履革蹻蹋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 380}, "text_hash": "ae779857c15869613b38701eecdb882aea680601139f7b28f996f4f22ff65457"}

{"id": "p_b151336fecdcc073", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 381, "text": "其國中有所爲及官家使築城郭，諸年少勇健者，皆鑿脊皮，以大繩貫之，又以丈許木鍤之，通日嚾呼作力，不以爲痛，既以勸作，且以爲健。", "locator": {"ordinal": 381}, "text_hash": "c239226f70cf7ffa036d0b532f778f32f2b5d019b6ec4746f580fa29f25806ca"}

{"id": "p_739eff231dcb39d6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 382, "text": "常以五月下種訖，祭鬼神，群聚歌舞，飲酒晝夜無休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 382}, "text_hash": "60be81d30af374713df14450b5c68567201fe91b83b8759930ac4192425f21f1"}

{"id": "p_2ed7fb4f3d6ea019", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 383, "text": "其舞，數十人俱起相隨，踏地低昂，手足相應，節奏有似鐸舞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 383}, "text_hash": "05d78ba984576b44e8c7c0f340d312885373d0a3bdef985f604e5309ae100ce9"}

{"id": "p_d089f9ea1b66e04e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 384, "text": "信鬼神，國邑各立一人主祭天神，名之天君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 384}, "text_hash": "75579c8c03a51cd2b701e884b66fbd5260ea953b36fd2bd1ad9ab88032f9ee89"}

{"id": "p_9fcd0af0d3cd09ad", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 385, "text": "立大木，縣鈴鼓，事鬼神。", "locator": {"ordinal": 385}, "text_hash": "d3438d2377ffdd74b4d124ff20508ec9d9636ed33081ed12b6feb5ee52e7708e"}

{"id": "p_d5961adf0e997a66", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 386, "text": "諸亡逃至其中，皆不還之，好作賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 386}, "text_hash": "113b24349f1cbcefde832fccac01fe69754551f3bc1829399891f99b39dfe561"}

{"id": "p_6090bdd2ae301fd1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 387, "text": "其立蘇塗之義，有似浮屠，而所行善惡有異。", "locator": {"ordinal": 387}, "text_hash": "8206e4c3fb2327621b93cb3a5858c2932414ef42b77406e9b859c45ea24f7471"}

{"id": "p_0dd4e383d3d89fa7", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 388, "text": "其北方近郡諸國差曉禮俗，其遠處直如囚徒奴婢相聚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 388}, "text_hash": "0866dc9a62e0f59b10f413dfcbe36cfb795b899a5b143b39e3593ebe6ed8ee78"}

{"id": "p_7346589c622de41e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 389, "text": "又出細尾雞，其尾皆長五尺餘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 389}, "text_hash": "fc0f5505418aca341f4496980c0d4473f8effb4cbbd1d45df17f4f9623817232"}

{"id": "p_12a0e3adb63c5c1a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 390, "text": "又有州胡在馬韓之西海中大島上，其人差短小，言語不與韓同，皆髡頭如鮮卑，但衣韋，好養牛及豬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 390}, "text_hash": "5c892dfba1c5414a82370c8abe603e4d3b57539469a08a01b5567e2afdda29d2"}

{"id": "p_05285b749245b616", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 391, "text": "其衣有上無下，略如裸勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 391}, "text_hash": "52de508d8e7358067ffdceea1a74260154293d9579ce80afec77f7d715ee7a0e"}

{"id": "p_8de23a290a8f884e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 392, "text": "辰韓在馬韓之東，其耆老傳世，自言古之亡人避秦役來適韓國，馬韓割其東界地與之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 392}, "text_hash": "2fd928178d0ac6628bfb682a85f6b5851bacc0a61fb0a81f0e14c2b25cce16c8"}

{"id": "p_bcb04dcb983da546", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 393, "text": "其言語不與馬韓同，名國爲邦，弓爲弧，賊爲寇，行酒爲行觴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 393}, "text_hash": "9814d8108511cbcd7eed1ba0138f2816d3707cd60fc683a8fe271874c0994f69"}

{"id": "p_150b25e5f631016d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 394, "text": "相呼皆爲徒，有似秦人，非但燕、齊之名物也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 394}, "text_hash": "67ed05e35901456d6a4080776e8ec2193832ab63ad8056363c71e8fcb6cdf651"}

{"id": "p_76fb3724945f194c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 395, "text": "名樂浪人爲阿殘；東方人名我爲阿，謂樂浪人本其殘餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 395}, "text_hash": "b13c7755de45530a0dc7a4aca1323b6fdf5e02c8accfa53a1a4ea9a2590e9f3c"}

{"id": "p_f9f0dcc7b70ff763", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 396, "text": "始有六國，稍分爲十二國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 396}, "text_hash": "c7bfcf3fdae6dbdf422523221648abe42211c23894ad8c873dedd2695f01f121"}

{"id": "p_c141216f41154d0b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 397, "text": "弁辰亦十二國，又有諸小別邑，各有渠帥，大者名臣智，其次有險側，次有樊濊，次有殺奚，次有邑借。", "locator": {"ordinal": 397}, "text_hash": "ea7705eff9987423667b1c2b1a69ffe6d4e5f124da226520076c9fa1b5d784ee"}

{"id": "p_269b40202e89b55c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 398, "text": "有已柢國、不斯國、弁辰彌離彌凍國、弁辰接塗國、勤耆國、難彌離彌凍國、弁辰古資彌凍國、弁辰古淳是國、冉奚國、弁辰半路國、弁樂奴國、軍彌國、弁辰彌烏邪馬國、如湛國、弁辰甘路國、戶路國、州鮮國（馬延國）、弁辰狗邪國、弁辰走漕馬國、弁辰安邪國、弁辰瀆盧國、斯盧國、優由國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 398}, "text_hash": "9147bfe49a64f95cde04c58e3006d7eb7cc81cba1e642b8ebbf5a00345f055a7"}

{"id": "p_a638a1a03827801f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 399, "text": "弁、辰韓合二十四國，大國四五千家，小國六七百家，總四五萬戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 399}, "text_hash": "ab47e98c595ed245cf421dd9e9373465583c4a77c7c6a25f9d7607abe69b3bac"}

{"id": "p_fc483e7e2c0aa81d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 400, "text": "辰王常用馬韓人作之，世世相繼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 400}, "text_hash": "f6be53c0bb96359382464bae6640711759176436d1d66d530676fa45b9918e2f"}

{"id": "p_df36950271dba625", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 401, "text": "土地肥美，宜種五穀及稻，曉蠶桑，作縑布，乘駕牛馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 401}, "text_hash": "a264d2ec2948d05235faf64d5be63b8a2e697c3e092597e677fc26536e71ce65"}

{"id": "p_e042d1f09043211b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 402, "text": "以大鳥羽送死，其意欲使死者飛揚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 402}, "text_hash": "bf477b0fbd054c55b51bbbaf9567a66a38c69687287f44d728d83695b9f13bd3"}

{"id": "p_cd8796a0dee21c7e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 403, "text": "《魏略》曰：其國作屋，橫累木爲之，有似牢獄也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 403}, "text_hash": "0a5a8a9f4fa40b6eacec2be18a0a2a8ff6b5c7a963a03e1f8d4394bb14d47883"}

{"id": "p_ff4d260573a9d812", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 404, "text": "國出鐵，韓、濊、倭皆從取之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 404}, "text_hash": "696ca06b1c49a2a3ed389d0dfa43f4927a88cf41ae56e6f4a254550f9c55b48d"}

{"id": "p_78b1f79de692874b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 405, "text": "諸巿買皆用鐵，如中國用錢，又以供給二郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 405}, "text_hash": "77c06e970df140dcbe6246d58666743c00d8582be123d8b0168cb5a1a26185da"}

{"id": "p_c35ffc996bd8b277", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 406, "text": "有瑟，其形似築，彈之亦有音曲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 406}, "text_hash": "737d9048704476e389591b6d93627c1e964829197d4d67beee94edf3dea2bad8"}

{"id": "p_39a348c3ad0b6476", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 407, "text": "兒生，便以石厭其頭，欲其褊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 407}, "text_hash": "7cf63d07965320d890bcc83dce7eea0fcd94fb9f7c21a7e6bc9968b452f17373"}

{"id": "p_8bf46c3892086c20", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 408, "text": "其俗，行者相逢，皆住讓路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 408}, "text_hash": "ebcb6c553e1a993128eb444b739e28268e078f3e8c62b2a64c66210804efeaf1"}

{"id": "p_527c9860c5ee4e57", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 409, "text": "弁辰與辰韓雜居，亦有城郭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 409}, "text_hash": "385502df8d161d177d47fbbbf44168d2e624470d93fdc9aca28eb546efa4bae7"}

{"id": "p_0bed256ead6a79f4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 410, "text": "言語法俗相似，祠祭鬼神有異，施灶皆在戶西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 410}, "text_hash": "cee7847d4e82e87123a71fa8e9c21759956e3375b44bee185337664a27afe129"}

{"id": "p_a863db0cee1353cf", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 411, "text": "十二國亦有王，其人形皆大。", "locator": {"ordinal": 411}, "text_hash": "47c44d6c0fd05a3cb0ad42e7b82b648b6ce45b96aba83b65e695668b14c0e2d7"}

{"id": "p_6c2caa499c7a350a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 412, "text": "在東南大海之中，依山島爲國邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 412}, "text_hash": "6a7a9298ec285bcbb8bac203415ff233e7c030d402dccf3a4d421271a576508a"}

{"id": "p_2aa0df5e8dd09349", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 413, "text": "舊百餘國，漢時有朝見者，今使譯所通三十國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 413}, "text_hash": "5d4e9a92f8f039fa0a4cd1701a8bc737746fda89cea81c15400ffd67fd1dd4a0"}

{"id": "p_813af854d906ca75", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 414, "text": "從郡至倭，循海岸水行，歷，乍南乍東，到其北岸，七千餘里，", "locator": {"ordinal": 414}, "text_hash": "7e1a869eea58af094b2c676a5769df0de03400e5d985285ff077191312a8c087"}

{"id": "p_4639fcc34b0d4304", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 415, "text": "所居絶島，方可四百餘里，土地山險，多深林，道路如禽鹿徑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 415}, "text_hash": "95fc1b83a1df679bbbf009e32ca2a91a7f99364b6beb728e3de8e2c3a1d232fd"}

{"id": "p_a99758ff302b7295", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 416, "text": "有千餘戶，無良田，食海物自活，乘船南北市糴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 416}, "text_hash": "1665be0037527f13314416164ad6012d5518f86d92b4a998cb268108cd461340"}

{"id": "p_f3c36715b9deef92", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 417, "text": "又南渡一海千餘里，名曰瀚海，至，官亦曰，副曰，方可三百里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 417}, "text_hash": "8cb0c9a7d7811bd67626be79e3fb551efd160e7f08178fb254e50e1367e58a0e"}

{"id": "p_fe1c5a14ea49b215", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 418, "text": "多竹木叢林，有三千許家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 418}, "text_hash": "c552ea388287d91df8e40690b308cbcd2226d6cb56907a0e3ed2991585f5ff78"}

{"id": "p_ab3c23f3bf4b9a8a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 419, "text": "差有田地，耕田猶不足食，亦南北市糴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 419}, "text_hash": "652fa40ba42b78b65c9544172535bdc86a49c3d258879a63d7afd980e40b668e"}

{"id": "p_4f72c2e1ba25dfb8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 420, "text": "又渡一海，千餘里至，有四千餘戶，濵山海居，草木茂盛，行不見前人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 420}, "text_hash": "cf55ce8ce67674edc59a6bc9b13cb90b5cf6f27048e2e669d8da4a0376e951c9"}

{"id": "p_599b9035d122ef1f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 421, "text": "好捕魚鰒，水無深淺，皆沉没取之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 421}, "text_hash": "92f55da7ed34668b4ca50d0a7906ae83fef58a16f719857e2feae3c05cfb81de"}

{"id": "p_64bdccc0175b4156", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 422, "text": "東南陸行五百里，到，官曰，副曰、。", "locator": {"ordinal": 422}, "text_hash": "d4b80514fa0c5bda58b8b87273c73d49abf7710a28b6741e09b1878239a3a245"}

{"id": "p_284e99b1dfa18c0c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 423, "text": "有千餘户，世有王，皆統屬女王國，郡使往來常所駐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 423}, "text_hash": "eb28c3e0f3ff9636bdb68ff5c8a3af3625610be5c5fed62550ea07830d93f157"}

{"id": "p_e9eef90ca82e8b07", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 424, "text": "東南至百里，官曰，副曰，有二萬餘户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 424}, "text_hash": "c9eb6d4693492632138afd0d88177c4f5a609dc6225996e69eef0d3beed08ac7"}

{"id": "p_cee9beade480b9f0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 425, "text": "東行至百里，官曰，副曰，有千餘家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 425}, "text_hash": "50153b2a4bfe9a8b1d8140df2f42aea796d585c441844c5a19f4d616264c76c7"}

{"id": "p_c1ee309c5c46e74e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 426, "text": "南至，水行二十日，官曰，副曰，可五萬餘户。", "locator": {"ordinal": 426}, "text_hash": "f993c3d7db7e7aa9273bd4651c78d308f65fda46b69cde5374d33908de94949e"}

{"id": "p_8b4403053f0fed21", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 427, "text": "南至，女王之所都，水行十日，陸行一月。", "locator": {"ordinal": 427}, "text_hash": "af2a725d08b96b841574d3777081ddcffeb5ae61b6afd66db4e4e99f8b94649c"}

{"id": "p_095c175c93587dd9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 428, "text": "官有，次曰，次曰，次曰，可七萬餘戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 428}, "text_hash": "e2a58e6eae53fcc2f04b7122c531dd54bbd4465777f63642d14605e8a0504cd0"}

{"id": "p_72d59afb85bebcff", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 429, "text": "自女王國以北，其戶數道里可得略載，其餘旁國遠絕，不可得詳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 429}, "text_hash": "0b5936e31d3d0f729fb98be5a153165ef6a0831ba33b34dcb3949456478cd8fe"}

{"id": "p_44bbc24c64d0f536", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 430, "text": "次有，次有，次有，此女王境界所盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 430}, "text_hash": "d76f6a6f3000c7fcd30e7462ebf30bcb8fe5f55e58b9d4d7382c9d8e76d851b3"}

{"id": "p_c3db65bb36305cae", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 431, "text": "其南有，男子爲王，其官有，不屬女王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 431}, "text_hash": "f7cc13c9a8a32c4dd5ee47189a18399848f5473fa4f3a5122e7bc40931f664c4"}

{"id": "p_4fb8173f95aeb7aa", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 432, "text": "自郡至女王國，萬二千餘里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 432}, "text_hash": "452188b1345b1b26f989714031ba2b8040d827fd5986cfcdd6402378cc4cf915"}

{"id": "p_35b89785ec23d328", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 433, "text": "自古以來，其使詣中國，皆自稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 433}, "text_hash": "1cc869088008a359cfeeee023d6b8e4e41e5b57e2bb52e35c12096dab91c0fd9"}

{"id": "p_96e91c1e8aad0c3b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 434, "text": "夏后之子，封於，斷髮文身，以避蛟龍之害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 434}, "text_hash": "717af5f3f3fcc5256bc2f057b91a0bb057ace0db2125bac0f9a7747a700b7f69"}

{"id": "p_020c6937bad15430", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 435, "text": "今倭水人好沈没捕魚蛤，文身亦以厭大魚水禽，後稍以爲飾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 435}, "text_hash": "fdb8261934744b0192c62cab0178bc1539a9d47c05825880c8d0e5d7c280d554"}

{"id": "p_6c78b24ff733fa72", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 436, "text": "諸國文身各異，或左或右，或大或小，尊卑有差。", "locator": {"ordinal": 436}, "text_hash": "2ee34c8c8574996de6eb4b60193fbbf1434444909ec683964be47470733b2de0"}

{"id": "p_21ae5a9373b4a6d9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 437, "text": "其風俗不淫，男子皆露紒，以木緜招頭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 437}, "text_hash": "65bbc7f329ecd104f07434050f0ab8724c91f86501602aae04f495e07de50add"}

{"id": "p_ca5b7f2088b81c1a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 438, "text": "其衣横幅，但結束相連，略無縫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 438}, "text_hash": "981868a82c1902b7f9e68763c8bf57af08fdcbdc5162016fd8c4cbf7144aabd8"}

{"id": "p_464b4dd5c5c56253", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 439, "text": "婦人被髮屈紒，作衣如單被，穿其中央，貫頭衣之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 439}, "text_hash": "ba422d2b7ecce2460c98fee6ac0a1d962b86186af4f2808f28f6914c16c2e239"}

{"id": "p_e9b5563ef389ca03", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 440, "text": "種禾稻、紵麻，蠶桑、緝績，出細紵、縑緜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 440}, "text_hash": "57019f3f971886b2296b8194d6f880b231571b7ecd19ca1f4e67c9061346df22"}

{"id": "p_dd075001fbd7d0ae", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 441, "text": "其地無牛、馬、虎、豹、羊、鵲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 441}, "text_hash": "0c33b187e86cdad51fb55881f0e3ab4c5a2803ea65a86abaed1374ecac3f099e"}

{"id": "p_6c3bf64c3385edb8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 442, "text": "木弓短下長上，竹箭或鐵鏃或骨鏃，所有無與、同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 442}, "text_hash": "17da9949c6a669f5dfb1ed13bfb85268c52df9235db84dc6933d136ea717d627"}

{"id": "p_749890cee7605b02", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 443, "text": "倭地温暖，冬夏食生菜，皆徒跣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 443}, "text_hash": "8d63d4b0ac1dca1a9b4f6bcdb4bb1779604d4478f7c163dc65f820387e595648"}

{"id": "p_ed5dba9bc7033411", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 444, "text": "有屋室，父母兄弟卧息異處，以朱丹塗其身體，如中國用粉也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 444}, "text_hash": "62a7add2ac088bb136df04a2205af44ad3af2c7410831e1cb4e35703f58ac7a8"}

{"id": "p_8f44bf5cc38d0516", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 445, "text": "其死，有棺無槨，封土作冢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 445}, "text_hash": "508ca3129ca1c838e15537a67d59a49054d33fc37c083b3413464cdc86aec01c"}

{"id": "p_745d084a5166bbe4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 446, "text": "始死，停喪十餘日，當時不食肉，喪主哭泣，他人就歌舞飲酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 446}, "text_hash": "3e44e0fc3e0ec25b043d3723cbb1ab208681f1d8eb307ce66ae38cc6121149db"}

{"id": "p_a5d349a817ada8f2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 447, "text": "已葬，舉家詣水中澡浴，以如練沐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 447}, "text_hash": "2618da0f064c06cb5c04a0d2ed52c34f784e9db77e71280120559d06ceffda57"}

{"id": "p_815430de7a5cbfb3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 448, "text": "其行來渡海詣中國，恒使一人，不梳頭，不去蟣蝨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 448}, "text_hash": "629926ea89ab94eabd4063ed60fb4b92f77b367c47739ee80722fb96c8f38566"}

{"id": "p_d44c24ee40b833ef", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 449, "text": "衣服垢汚，不食肉，不近婦人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 449}, "text_hash": "a8362dc6b5979f565f5283063bc003d3cf7db542986098721ee53fa533cd7ba1"}

{"id": "p_6b8f8e9230e3bb07", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 450, "text": "如喪人，名之爲「持衰」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 450}, "text_hash": "32621b9e1b3c19b60f137e5d1f280a7e20982c42fb5964111ec98766348d17cf"}

{"id": "p_d8f4a5cbb50340e8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 451, "text": "若行者吉善，共顧其生口、財物；若有疾病，遭暴害，便欲殺之，謂其持衰不謹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 451}, "text_hash": "4f2b5f591ef048e358740ea4c65c751eb6aec9f226d15192218048d5878361ac"}

{"id": "p_8d0801f176405256", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 452, "text": "出真珠、靑玉，其山有丹，", "locator": {"ordinal": 452}, "text_hash": "e85aee6da96cb5f191e72424901847cc4807ead3db285adc4058a71a7ac0075b"}

{"id": "p_856d16013d2f35b7", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 453, "text": "其木有柟、杼、豫樟、楺櫪、投橿、烏號、楓香，", "locator": {"ordinal": 453}, "text_hash": "82b4619558f4d53f18b8821241aa7eff77f71809c391d74e9da61415fa80ef43"}

{"id": "p_28210614560a535f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 454, "text": "有薑、橘、椒、蘘荷，不知以爲滋味。", "locator": {"ordinal": 454}, "text_hash": "222b33f5ce15c0098f8283f34d0007fbf2650c97a3a6b5e8d0505a13b2d13d54"}

{"id": "p_d9bb87c1d0910fd8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 455, "text": "其俗舉事行來，有所云爲，輙灼骨而卜，以占吉凶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 455}, "text_hash": "16dbae0d155e4070616bc3f31983b420eb5ebc45ba699c083687529b685bbe10"}

{"id": "p_8fdbe8b40c757e73", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 456, "text": "先告所卜，其辭如令龜法，視火坼占兆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 456}, "text_hash": "e8bd726411de450232613d67b1c37464adb45ed4971fe3bf9bae1d32a8092eee"}

{"id": "p_71a7a41367d2aeaf", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 457, "text": "其會同坐起，父子男女無别，人性嗜酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 457}, "text_hash": "db1af9624f609d9a847a489279ecf4ebd03824baeba4adb5826ef30b5a0b8da5"}

{"id": "p_b110c7be246a2578", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 458, "text": "見大人所敬，但搏手以當跪拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 458}, "text_hash": "1a9bc18c5ca81082901d4646b4d62149cd6f7ca0ab121621b37c08b4ab185cc3"}

{"id": "p_15921768e6730875", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 459, "text": "其人壽考，或百年，或八、九十年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 459}, "text_hash": "a5e2102517f86841f7f6ee9df4948568fc9e0cf2e428430994ccabb290a255d4"}

{"id": "p_436b586ea19b9208", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 460, "text": "其俗，國大人皆四五婦，下户或二三婦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 460}, "text_hash": "d35d20f8235c7b3be869214c0ef5b34cbf491e03e2572ee169923ce72a062ab8"}

{"id": "p_343e1a1145198b72", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 461, "text": "其犯法，輕者没其妻子，重者滅其門户", "locator": {"ordinal": 461}, "text_hash": "585d8116ea57cf8b51ff131db1386c571d10703fbaa5db321e0897582f92d093"}

{"id": "p_df3516df9841d6f9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 462, "text": "及宗族尊卑，各有差序，足相臣服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 462}, "text_hash": "85d9fa572d5770e923436d1d146fee53971525ba61633b0aa1463e3f332b20d6"}

{"id": "p_21077ac23d75e656", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 463, "text": "有邸閣，國國有市，交易有無，使大倭監之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 463}, "text_hash": "20d1c417afef5c097330769c8015226140f23d04f8681d270686309bef11d762"}

{"id": "p_73c4948614dec42a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 464, "text": "自女王國以北，特置一大率，檢察諸國，諸國畏憚之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 464}, "text_hash": "72c72741d5d62a9cf18f5876f53badf4fe5e3a28227f3877184b245bb3cc880a"}

{"id": "p_43966da5960bbb33", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 465, "text": "及郡使，皆臨津搜露，傳送文書、賜遺之物詣女王，不得差錯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 465}, "text_hash": "e7b9ebc5868181c7d435c7b3348bfb53781b7b3ff4ce299b07a89442a364bb85"}

{"id": "p_9ddf1a59a0c8f671", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 466, "text": "下户與大人相逢道路，逡巡入草。", "locator": {"ordinal": 466}, "text_hash": "e01f10ab3eb2fc54fb763f88b25314c4707bbd1f13ce5423cd4777408355337b"}

{"id": "p_ea8eecb4f63ac0cf", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 467, "text": "傳辭說事，或蹲或跪，兩手據地，爲之恭敬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 467}, "text_hash": "2b52d50a7f77f33ed2de70630d876ba6d947626632a6ad79b65e014c3d5c1f48"}

{"id": "p_2dd3ab6e4dcaa99b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 468, "text": "對應聲曰「噫」，比如「然」「諾」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 468}, "text_hash": "049958a261fca02cdf735898a1e41a56231cafbe2145e579ced3d84cd3016467"}

{"id": "p_7bede0a6e6e9654e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 469, "text": "其國本亦以男子爲王，住七八十年，倭國亂，相攻伐歷年，", "locator": {"ordinal": 469}, "text_hash": "030c20b467526e11837cc728e780236c397989a367e1be82e56ed864f5de5cf4"}

{"id": "p_b2101c961f91b083", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 470, "text": "乃共立一女子爲王，名曰，事鬼道，能惑衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 470}, "text_hash": "b6c0c55f093bc7277b7ce85dfa1667954aeb7598f69ae4a438896481752b85ff"}

{"id": "p_d908927864fdeb25", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 471, "text": "年已長大，無夫壻，有男弟佐治國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 471}, "text_hash": "70b30185424a313a89ef6a3b06f73f9f0c90a6bd8c7fb96b48ba2627ee736a71"}

{"id": "p_e64ea049bd4864a8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 472, "text": "以婢千人自侍，唯有男子一人給飲食，傳辭出入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 472}, "text_hash": "eb53880a76025728807dce3aad5f80dc23563d90107c8b09a304d4a784d28a10"}

{"id": "p_6f35d73e66e2094e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 473, "text": "居處宫室樓觀，城栅嚴設，常有人持兵守衛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 473}, "text_hash": "3664b8b4f1ad9aeb7cc032e247a0326d2d03933bcef1d9a3cdf8ce206513ea78"}

{"id": "p_8a9d4d819d0431fc", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 474, "text": "女王國東渡海千餘里，復有國，皆倭種。", "locator": {"ordinal": 474}, "text_hash": "75715b19174187edcf037312cfdf39ddc428be0b5ac2260fe00df76323c823fb"}

{"id": "p_d89237018379ca12", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 475, "text": "又有在其南，人長三四尺，去女王四千餘里，", "locator": {"ordinal": 475}, "text_hash": "e15da96a435af4bde5c9ccdcc8dc8f0021428502489ff261199db4917b9eeb06"}

{"id": "p_2e63400aa2183389", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 476, "text": "又有、，復在其東南，船行一年可至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 476}, "text_hash": "4941247e996f799c0b6bc3954f3ae0a1e055daa19a68c4ee432d45d0dd81663f"}

{"id": "p_53d4c955a68436c6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 477, "text": "參問倭地，絕在海中洲島之上，或絕或連，周旋可五千餘里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 477}, "text_hash": "dd9c5996e59ec8aea2f1fac1b9683178f137972340a790eabb090e1081e6a69c"}

{"id": "p_2dfa6e8f28ac6282", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 478, "text": "景初二年六月，倭女王遣大夫等詣郡，", "locator": {"ordinal": 478}, "text_hash": "bc5a79527721fdaeeffdb4129f702061d32f9868c75346377842a8104eafbf00"}

{"id": "p_b1393e726ef1eb21", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 479, "text": "求詣天子朝獻，太守遣吏將送詣京都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 479}, "text_hash": "f60c39d5da7fd86a1ab927e3d783e8f1987a0ea6870d9f8a468a20c0ae0f1f94"}

{"id": "p_8cf884b08f237cde", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 480, "text": "其年十二月，詔書報倭女王曰:", "locator": {"ordinal": 480}, "text_hash": "5f6f1aa880b3f4549f51d05891bcda99923de5094358ff08fb1f51396c9026e8"}

{"id": "p_f2ab6209948d26c5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 481, "text": "太守遣使送汝大夫、次使，", "locator": {"ordinal": 481}, "text_hash": "53f08ecc7deafbce74349dacd479d1f50b19001b379637920f13b5896147e848"}

{"id": "p_bced58bffe50e623", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 482, "text": "奉汝所獻男生口四人，女生口六人，二匹二丈，以到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 482}, "text_hash": "2a7e58e1adb96f8eacf4d0a448b702e8bd95efc8063989f80d341c3d4e6b2fad"}

{"id": "p_0d808ad0bb79d88a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 483, "text": "汝所在踰遠，乃遣使貢獻，是汝之忠孝，我甚哀汝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 483}, "text_hash": "d4802989a1eb1adf92926c2123f90ab253cf97df4fbd39d38c3bbd7d31f7f2a5"}

{"id": "p_96fe6e5b06269f06", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 484, "text": "今以汝爲親魏倭王，假金印紫綬，裝封付太守，假授汝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 484}, "text_hash": "8adc4af4d4e0d996efde6ba07d4d9ce0235465cf2fa3cba2ff234590a5f42292"}

{"id": "p_96f57439d76dec75", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 485, "text": "汝來使、涉遠，道路勤勞，", "locator": {"ordinal": 485}, "text_hash": "76766718ff334d1471eb32ef6be12224f53402ba7303c77b205902f4d31fbc5a"}

{"id": "p_ae220aee653e5090", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 486, "text": "假銀印靑綬，引見勞賜遣還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 486}, "text_hash": "589311adb3655c2383e32f6f88dfb2f76ecd7b87604d92fb49ce504355107281"}

{"id": "p_688524b3b565ac51", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 487, "text": "五十匹，五十匹，答汝所獻貢直。", "locator": {"ordinal": 487}, "text_hash": "287ded788983bd0f62fd0ef5936bdd8922cd8ae4c914b8af8b662079f90ccbc8"}

{"id": "p_d25d3becec1082c6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 488, "text": "又特賜汝三匹，五張，五十匹，", "locator": {"ordinal": 488}, "text_hash": "244fbe1a592bd096afe6fddffa532c6d1033553f51ace95c5c32e7d13c3f0aa8"}

{"id": "p_014bd8a71adb4b48", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 489, "text": "金八兩，五尺刀二口，銅鏡百枚，", "locator": {"ordinal": 489}, "text_hash": "4c5717f36683f8107555cfa1f30468d9287884ab9d25b69a3bcb22bbcae61a6c"}

{"id": "p_dd3584e24dd15c20", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 490, "text": "真珠、鉛丹各五十斤，皆裝封付、還到録受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 490}, "text_hash": "b80cdc4f5b4a5cedbd2aa42e58fdb110be3fea3bb3f06cdbb7500f467ca552ce"}

{"id": "p_6b64a5af0dad1a0a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 491, "text": "悉可以示汝國中人，使知國家哀汝，故鄭重賜汝好物也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 491}, "text_hash": "3ef4cceda6ccbed002c7abbaeb9c6d2c14b3eca65e6437e1661403b8339d8c58"}

{"id": "p_dd8bb619cb4fd66f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 492, "text": "正始元年，太守遣等奉詔書印綬詣倭國，", "locator": {"ordinal": 492}, "text_hash": "7f09f7b542d621c4359dfc20e0959f6bef372f1da3850a883017d668b2ccec68"}

{"id": "p_1338a8af289672eb", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 493, "text": "拜假倭王，並齎詔賜金帛、錦罽、刀鏡、采物，", "locator": {"ordinal": 493}, "text_hash": "5bfbe095870d6ee5fb872ba043492809dd2a9d436ea1c407b4c4aabcb30c5818"}

{"id": "p_680e959913d0f0f9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 494, "text": "其四年，倭王復遣使大夫、等八人，", "locator": {"ordinal": 494}, "text_hash": "6a95ebfc0056ec47fa488dcdc6634a662989817939e7044bd89e04508fa1f4e1"}

{"id": "p_02ec31b23f56a69f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 495, "text": "上獻生口、倭錦、絳靑縑、緜衣、帛布、丹木、𤝔、短弓矢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 495}, "text_hash": "c61422d5aa273c499919edd1ac4626c456afe02738fe07ab9aae6aac7b373563"}

{"id": "p_b8c0140997544116", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 496, "text": "其六年，詔賜倭黄幢，付郡假授。", "locator": {"ordinal": 496}, "text_hash": "65a57f1362da4a02ae5fb77550d76b692aba19b29218be219d870efc87e3df1c"}

{"id": "p_7b7b1f7fa5b6bfe7", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 497, "text": "遣倭、等詣郡，說相攻擊狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 497}, "text_hash": "dce5a916545138d1cd162f640a68323c24f0c766a60e709e61db2a7379d98885"}

{"id": "p_a8d4cf71dcb228c0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 498, "text": "遣等，因齎詔書、黄幢，拜假爲檄告諭之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 498}, "text_hash": "eee5a0ffc8781facb94efbc11905121efb09bfedfe03343d7c1f8994bac6ab52"}

{"id": "p_29b0b1c6ecd93113", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 499, "text": "以死，大作冢，徑百餘步，徇葬者奴婢百餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 499}, "text_hash": "abe88217d611f2079f135b18672591e3a20cb687f98a228c867d0b9f34dcf18e"}

{"id": "p_6b100391a6f62301", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 500, "text": "更立男王，國中不服，更相誅殺，當時殺千餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 500}, "text_hash": "78cbfeed24d850ae27b53a08018befe8f3f58bb65d23cb0900659cf809829185"}

{"id": "p_73e5f92e66329037", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 501, "text": "復立宗女，年十三爲王，國中遂定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 501}, "text_hash": "64ddd889ef2b8ac079b9772da3fa70defdc29b06a62224f098e899c2e454f47b"}

{"id": "p_bf8882fffa7c8f95", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 502, "text": "遣倭大夫率善中郎將等二十人送等還，", "locator": {"ordinal": 502}, "text_hash": "d1ed4c1ae891cf9a9d8cefdf063a98a13475220b44b67f617fde2ce449a77a80"}

{"id": "p_52ed4f54038ebb99", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 503, "text": "因詣臺，獻上男女生口三十人，", "locator": {"ordinal": 503}, "text_hash": "a7ff8eabe9fc817ebb7a64cf8b82297c4cedcf1df2c8f5a0f6b4a916131ee339"}

{"id": "p_b5098960b5a95bcc", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 504, "text": "貢白珠五千孔、靑大句珠二枚、異文雜錦二十匹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 504}, "text_hash": "48f73987d4c1f60f3f1faa3d12d05f6413d692e95456fbc731c1db56d45c4090"}

{"id": "p_987427a4fc8c6f32", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 505, "text": "《魏略西戎傳》曰：氐人有王，所從來久矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 505}, "text_hash": "f3cc56de44ca5135aeadeecc10ba612978c1c9533ff0fe626198093a23789e49"}

{"id": "p_11a8b99f8e854a1c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 506, "text": "自漢開益州，置武都郡，排其種人，分竄山谷間，或在福祿，或在汧、隴左右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 506}, "text_hash": "8143a0ade48cb943fae2c1f2040ff9ff150815e854c97f496e8ff6ef8086c417"}

{"id": "p_262020ee646bcc48", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 507, "text": "其種非一，稱槃瓠之後，或號青氐，或號白氐，或號蚺氐，此蓋蟲之類而處中國，人即其服色而名之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 507}, "text_hash": "8db5d500a85e85a39f4b32768f31ab163461d02eecc8a3dec4614e786a49fceb"}

{"id": "p_e6774379bc481eed", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 508, "text": "其自相號曰盍稚，各有王侯，多受中國封拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 508}, "text_hash": "2f10c900f8af45f178e2fd93bf72d3f7d6b01ee0b874644f0dfcc039dd1b544b"}

{"id": "p_1a80c8515759e8cf", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 509, "text": "近去建安中，興國氐王阿貴、白項氐王千萬各有部落萬餘，至十六年，從馬超爲亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 509}, "text_hash": "9d25e29bec38ed83b3ed8534682b37354e40d6886efaebc8c9bd4ea0dfc19abb"}

{"id": "p_f62350cc474b4922", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 510, "text": "超破之後，阿貴爲夏侯淵所攻滅，千萬西南入蜀，其部落不能去，皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 510}, "text_hash": "8799180bedea8e6fe903ba9435defefa0a7e825c3feadcc110bc249e87369107"}

{"id": "p_398e01bf76053cba", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 511, "text": "國家分徙其前後兩端者，置扶風、美陽，今之安夷、撫夷二部護軍所典是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 511}, "text_hash": "05c7915ed19772319dabfaebab09b004c6fdb061dff1141af22dcf402367e404"}

{"id": "p_7d49385850955c3d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 512, "text": "其（太）守善，分留天水、南安界，今之廣魏郡所守是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 512}, "text_hash": "96ead3dd60d03aa85014a16d68364dbe65581ba702706d56256639df6c55d2ae"}

{"id": "p_bf4b19049e25134a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 513, "text": "其俗，語不與中國同，及羌雜胡同，各自有姓，姓如中國之姓矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 513}, "text_hash": "d3755657b4d326933373de25cac6a55537bb3690b1d7c8e0e6ad5257905db57c"}

{"id": "p_7f463a3ae5dcd7d2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 514, "text": "俗能織布，善田種，畜養豕牛馬驢騾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 514}, "text_hash": "c42389899fc43440d4cb498f8618e64ef2eb19d67c929511880c0e32ac116202"}

{"id": "p_38ba8d7fdb1d511c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 515, "text": "其婦人嫁時著衽露，其緣飾之制有似羌，衽露有似中國袍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 515}, "text_hash": "be86fcd1bac084a7c0266c1f92b8072c7ad8155c1ac9b44d97b61a92b49af7a0"}

{"id": "p_4a53b353d4433837", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 516, "text": "多知中國語，由與中國錯居故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 516}, "text_hash": "71c6cc6eee3f7e60f201770d91db9cff970cccfde07164267ade0debbb8749a8"}

{"id": "p_3f9e495bc07e5550", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 517, "text": "其自還種落間，則自氐語。", "locator": {"ordinal": 517}, "text_hash": "15e8066765629e0c7ab2c237dddf70975d849366ecdc54b93bcd17c52e5c487a"}

{"id": "p_462e5963d77e45bf", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 518, "text": "其嫁娶有似於羌，此蓋乃昔所謂西戎在於街、冀、豲道者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 518}, "text_hash": "278f1a0a18d3523412156a69db9fa8450411a7b610132f3a2fb66ef06a193613"}

{"id": "p_9b11b1e691c1bb23", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 519, "text": "今雖都統於郡國，然故自有王侯在其虛落間。", "locator": {"ordinal": 519}, "text_hash": "94a57dfe0a18d8d98f9bfe525b4c78cb16dd1535627768a101cd57b4c918db6e"}

{"id": "p_ef30f760e2ec94f7", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 520, "text": "又故武都地陰平街左右，亦有萬餘落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 520}, "text_hash": "830b84a83100c84a7014c4644d60ecac9225838b893a0a88d9b18c2cd96794b7"}

{"id": "p_d4bbef83373066d2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 521, "text": "貲虜，本匈奴也，匈奴名奴婢爲貲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 521}, "text_hash": "d0655cd5c958cf44876d0e1a0842e8097255b3e4e36b91748cae672d95407a0a"}

{"id": "p_263b9057ca2e6a58", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 522, "text": "始建武時，匈奴衰，分去其奴婢，亡匿在金城、武威、酒泉北黑水、西河東西，畜牧逐水草，鈔盜涼州，部落稍多，有數萬，不與東部鮮卑同也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 522}, "text_hash": "ad31933cc354cbaa8a938b75f02f5eaf7a2801e5b5b56b1436feb68a67a4eb56"}

{"id": "p_b96a383714ffed8e", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 523, "text": "其種非一，有大胡，有丁令，或頗有羌雜處，由本亡奴婢故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 523}, "text_hash": "d78d7f4366b7b8c9918aca6364f30166ff40c079052757b5a74186177a64694a"}

{"id": "p_5310e12ef8b26528", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 524, "text": "當漢、魏之際，其大人有檀柘，死後，其枝大人南近在廣魏、令居界，有禿瑰來數反，爲涼州所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 524}, "text_hash": "9db7c8642ccde393ef9effff6c6fac3c2d6a2d716f26fe6f78a210edf7424af4"}

{"id": "p_993142bf4559621b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 525, "text": "今有劭提，或降來，或遁去，常爲西州道路患也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 525}, "text_hash": "0806514f5e1a164ac9660fe0e4acd24a01b2017dab5eb2169e6df57cd6114973"}

{"id": "p_ee6b1dc9bf871d69", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 526, "text": "敦煌西域之南山中，從婼羌西至蔥領數千里，有月氏餘種蔥茈羌、白馬、黃牛羌，各有酋豪，北與諸國接，不知其道-{里}-廣狹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 526}, "text_hash": "7aabcf01248b5fda242826d11c36152c0d3166d5d1855ae9e6d9cda6d00a9952"}

{"id": "p_293ab15604a545a6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 527, "text": "傳聞黃牛羌各有種類，孕身六月生，南與白馬羌鄰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 527}, "text_hash": "eb0ff7b19381acbb293b30a0ee08953246ffe83d3abe55e850389dc643ac759a"}

{"id": "p_2df824f571c54a00", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 528, "text": "西域諸國，漢初開其道，時有三十六，後分爲五十餘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 528}, "text_hash": "e4c11be7e0f43c97feecd67db5684144f25da929aaa28a710a5648a96894e568"}

{"id": "p_c3c294903df050c5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 529, "text": "從建武以來，更相吞滅，於今有二十道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 529}, "text_hash": "7469e071926d8fd56d98bc8aa90a7491d06223f4ce7e8d0ff797366b5484ae59"}

{"id": "p_b65782f48833906b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 530, "text": "從敦煌玉門關入西域，前有二道，今有三道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 530}, "text_hash": "8bce9e6d146c8791ffdbcdf037b5a32e07ff507856c32cca82b053b4ea4ab3a6"}

{"id": "p_cdb7a1e17a7b2d89", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 531, "text": "從玉門關西出，經婼羌轉西，越蔥領，經縣度，入大月氏，爲南道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 531}, "text_hash": "255affaef530e604813bee8ace08f3894877e70bb4ec2dfbd343209cb04b90f0"}

{"id": "p_f03627e6fa332a1f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 532, "text": "從玉門關西出，發都護井，回三隴沙北頭，經居盧倉，從沙西井轉西北，過龍堆，到故樓蘭，轉西詣龜茲，至蔥領，爲中道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 532}, "text_hash": "42826641604a9b5aba8ab86df227c8e10f54fa4085f63ea32949b11d1e1604f4"}

{"id": "p_453891a6788f33a8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 533, "text": "從玉門關西北出，經橫坑，辟三隴沙及龍堆，出五船北，到車師界戊己校尉所治高昌，轉西與中道合龜茲，爲新道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 533}, "text_hash": "7d32c5b948a1d965e8a6f41ef17e6b6a61f30fcc6216dcd1c9b057a6a4dcdced"}

{"id": "p_083ba30ed45e8cb3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 534, "text": "凡西域所出，有前史已具詳，今故略說。", "locator": {"ordinal": 534}, "text_hash": "9f1c30fc6d4b3e85f8f24ef07c31746e2781d208c74832dd5a05859267e453fe"}

{"id": "p_ac800875ee0609df", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 535, "text": "南道西行，且志國、小宛國、精絕國、樓蘭國皆並屬鄯善也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 535}, "text_hash": "b366777d7214c04fa3a3309f5abfa22453e07cabc8ab01dd4d6c90534bcd5605"}

{"id": "p_818868da7289efa4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 536, "text": "戎盧國、扞彌國、渠勒國、〔皮山國〕皆並屬於寘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 536}, "text_hash": "de48926f7329d7429508118eebbe0b574c1073459e902c92d67399f82fb90aa6"}

{"id": "p_872d9002dce8225b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 537, "text": "罽賓國、大夏國、高附國、天竺國皆並屬大月氏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 537}, "text_hash": "e754e3e393226297937118aca24dd0799541291e2a6a7bbb3e7ac597105826ba"}

{"id": "p_c6b963465af9d1b3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 538, "text": "臨兒國，浮屠經-{云}-其國王生浮屠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 538}, "text_hash": "cc0921b70e61de13935d08f5675c97dbd430f950aed9b6fe7cc57d135f6de068"}

{"id": "p_b9d8d0c701d697e0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 539, "text": "父曰屑頭邪，母-{云}-莫邪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 539}, "text_hash": "26930b375c2974feadb597628f1f2dd52cfeed7bea145d5fcd98d3518f83c20d"}

{"id": "p_73148191ec4a1d08", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 540, "text": "浮屠身服色黃，髮青如青絲，乳青毛，蛉赤如銅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 540}, "text_hash": "376c959a29e825e21fd7660c003a44bd0d3027d9ce8b8a95eeea4d1ca1c125c0"}

{"id": "p_30d8a6ed147af9ea", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 541, "text": "始莫邪夢白象而孕，及生，從母左脅出，生而有結，墮地能行七步。", "locator": {"ordinal": 541}, "text_hash": "70692e2948cba74d65fdf3d22e4582577fb5f2733b0c1b0ba10ac8375ff1c296"}

{"id": "p_32d4e53870a747c0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 542, "text": "昔漢哀帝，博士弟子景盧受大月氏王使伊存口受浮屠經曰復立者其人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 542}, "text_hash": "e3d3cfa1b9c6af69639a78a9e16f2ddf2aed3271b0d059fd781146c55ba09c00"}

{"id": "p_76c169ce5b9310d4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 543, "text": "浮屠所載臨蒲塞、桑門、伯聞、疏問、白疏間、比丘、晨門，皆弟子號也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 543}, "text_hash": "b3036e7f0ad775ed0411aae6b87dbb4cc7bd09a4f3cbfff943594c6f465f5e7f"}

{"id": "p_6d3ca4b332bbdb9c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 544, "text": "浮屠所載與中國老子經相出入，蓋以爲老子西出關，過西域之天竺、教胡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 544}, "text_hash": "be5e9671d97c098f3a34cae86a7de23d9c676460f35e0eee33c004f0208e9d36"}

{"id": "p_1d7cca12a2f4f9ec", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 545, "text": "浮屠屬弟子別號，合有二十九，不能詳載，故略之如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 545}, "text_hash": "dd77dd60b2a1f4873dde551bb9f64dbacfd8b9eb4a047e5b3fb4ebcf825cfab2"}

{"id": "p_00a07a8d6d47ef41", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 546, "text": "車離國一名禮惟特，一名沛隸王，在天竺東南三千餘-{里}-，其地卑濕暑熱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 546}, "text_hash": "2e98353f1abe5c06de5ae62e7ba8282effac329db49f2c192a09ae0ce491db4b"}

{"id": "p_9a1cf23f7e235c25", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 547, "text": "其王治沙奇城，有別城數十，人民怯弱，月氏、天竺擊服之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 547}, "text_hash": "b232f20d0fef6ea54ef86dbecfe1af484ebafc477158ac096300fc75b509f231"}

{"id": "p_a207de902c9b5fc3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 548, "text": "其地東西南北數千里，人民男女皆長一丈八尺，乘象、橐扆以戰，今月氏役稅之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 548}, "text_hash": "05bb8ba2b6db5b47146f09bff9035e59a663efcaa43b8c4d909dc3068d64c400"}

{"id": "p_3f9a9fce637668bf", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 549, "text": "盤越國一名漢越王，在天竺東南數千里，與益部相近，其人小與中國人等，蜀人賈似至焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 549}, "text_hash": "f57cb067e15d8387a4b4777d586c273a315794aa547bb41e336448bae4f7a8e7"}

{"id": "p_f6fa355e2911d078", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 550, "text": "中道西行尉梨國、危須國、山王國皆並屬焉耆，姑墨國、溫宿國、尉頭國皆並屬龜茲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 550}, "text_hash": "ff418c37120aa40ce4f573032e092a67cd2da05a067a2c07448230527a3531a0"}

{"id": "p_ebf748785d91d334", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 551, "text": "楨中國、莎車國、竭石國、渠沙國、西夜國、依耐國、滿犁國、億若國、榆令國、損毒國、休脩國、琴國皆並屬疏勒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 551}, "text_hash": "4b96e3f3b8018eb4f4cfda4a0affa3ff63276d3c931ad7e3f99b4647825c2462"}

{"id": "p_67f12f950fd68e19", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 552, "text": "自是以西，大宛、安息、條支、烏弋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 552}, "text_hash": "f669e9a8ef0d4b49dc2699e2bdc7e4529358c4f94c390214e09874fed0671210"}

{"id": "p_dfc47cfcba3f93ab", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 553, "text": "烏弋一名排特，此四國次在西，本國也，無增損。", "locator": {"ordinal": 553}, "text_hash": "aff74ad1e0221963fb000e7700f0476cee67591ed8d6cab8bd100e82b6bc40d1"}

{"id": "p_a6e9e2616c3f9562", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 554, "text": "前世謬以爲條支在大秦西，今其實在東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 554}, "text_hash": "f3e540577340b7ec270a19d5f7b093362269cbeb3b6b5fafc55672dc992989a2"}

{"id": "p_e43f9c8f0256b7c3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 555, "text": "前世又謬以爲強於安息，今更役屬之，號爲安息西界。", "locator": {"ordinal": 555}, "text_hash": "a73b7f664c8a1ca834037c4ac6cd3f7b0253adea8750125eecf51a3a2f4f5e2f"}

{"id": "p_f1dd8465fac39f9d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 556, "text": "前世又謬以爲弱水在條支西，今弱水在大秦西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 556}, "text_hash": "cb8787fdeb7c984b26b0899cd3f5526b0b4837cdd46c501417a6b9f654bd65c6"}

{"id": "p_4a3bbaef21e92f40", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 557, "text": "前世又謬以爲從條支西行二百餘日，近日所入，今從大秦西近日所入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 557}, "text_hash": "c90bca356ebcf90fe8e403c115fcac709ddb3f17868fedd6f2b8622858fea231"}

{"id": "p_987c8cabd61a0b56", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 558, "text": "大秦國一號犁靬，在安息、條支西大海之西，從安息界安穀城乘船，直截海西，遇風利二月到，風遲或一歲，無風或三歲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 558}, "text_hash": "12ae6f953588f710103f43a9e73569c5f7c97b57008f948c99db73ed68b5d583"}

{"id": "p_5a6a81eae96ae60d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 559, "text": "其國在海西，故俗謂之海西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 559}, "text_hash": "cf2f8876910894d62b3884b9667054914a6187a541a05c5ada65a9dd1d9017b5"}

{"id": "p_23d452f0fe32a040", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 560, "text": "有河出其國，西又有大海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 560}, "text_hash": "70eaa31bc337e484da954e21594287203e68162fd5b29a9c83db0d8de96a1496"}

{"id": "p_39c093be9edd59a0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 561, "text": "海西有遲散城，從國下直北至烏丹城，西南又渡一河，乘船一日乃過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 561}, "text_hash": "c659518b37379ce90c97623d3cca3be7ddbff1ac0c10d5aa202606ff30f28e19"}

{"id": "p_8012024e31e7e62c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 562, "text": "西南又渡一河，一日乃過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 562}, "text_hash": "3ed372f66ba25adb87a0ace2d9d3a0a4c1ec000903de0321362b6470572ee714"}

{"id": "p_6b176c57975f482d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 563, "text": "凡有大都三，卻從安穀城陸道直北行之海北，復直西行之海西，復直南行經之烏遲散城，渡一河，乘船一日乃過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 563}, "text_hash": "49d72f6db41cdc0c0c4dcfd8c5bc249dbea3b15ec4b5558e6118115e5c8d0522"}

{"id": "p_4aca0647a15fcd31", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 564, "text": "周回繞海，凡當渡大海六日乃到其國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 564}, "text_hash": "14d2fb491123880bcc1c3f3a555e8646240808fa0852d962041cecfd1ce0dff4"}

{"id": "p_61473b3d9706749f", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 565, "text": "國有小城邑合四百餘，東西南北數千里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 565}, "text_hash": "16ada410839270b2312fca6c7d6637deca639d371b00dea9cdf56d66b992984a"}

{"id": "p_b20ae660f9db9a45", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 566, "text": "其王治濱側河海，以石爲城郭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 566}, "text_hash": "3563870c208aeeb1a6dadd942996ccfaddf596ed089e62e49a310ab65119dd25"}

{"id": "p_405dad8b20404712", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 567, "text": "其土地有松、柏、槐、梓、竹、葦、楊柳、梧桐、百草。", "locator": {"ordinal": 567}, "text_hash": "1af2298fb1a801ea9e67090813dc3700603aeb91e2776b4e492afb589e657150"}

{"id": "p_05e7e2a2fb1bec85", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 568, "text": "民俗，田種五穀，畜乘有馬、騾、驢、駱駝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 568}, "text_hash": "735d127017c3317df78f5b52cbdffe1012671073bd957b03e6e554ef49f76dff"}

{"id": "p_e989bbebe450edb3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 569, "text": "俗多奇幻，口中出火，自縛自解，跳十二丸巧妙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 569}, "text_hash": "0d9c32ac4ffd8a61ee4d22dd2149e96cd748c1445dfb61a44e913992320dca5e"}

{"id": "p_4a6363d59b92364b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 570, "text": "其國無常主，國中有災異，輒更立賢人以爲王，而生放其故王，王亦不敢怨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 570}, "text_hash": "4e3f78e1d3167580ec25d01673a758d108296910c3db7eb8aebd7936978071aa"}

{"id": "p_2a492d46153c1cd9", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 571, "text": "其俗人長大平正，似中國人而胡服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 571}, "text_hash": "4aee2e3343f9b1b74322fd231e682bf7a53f664693f6595c422f7117717300bc"}

{"id": "p_8fd9a7b2c3c5c554", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 572, "text": "自-{云}-本中國一別也，常欲通使於中國，而安息圖其利，不能得過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 572}, "text_hash": "7883ee99fe5b6fec07e022f35f7e1d95ddffa622d91cadb95c1f578e05b7eab7"}

{"id": "p_3e7c724b2c16f888", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 573, "text": "其制度，公私宮室爲重屋，旌旗擊鼓，白蓋小車，郵驛亭置如中國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 573}, "text_hash": "ab5a37c3c14d13a78309a251a76fcd416338300105e660671c47bcef18a8c542"}

{"id": "p_824b07030908a64c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 574, "text": "從安息繞海北到其國，人民相屬，十-{里}-一亭，三十-{里}-一置，終無盜賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 574}, "text_hash": "920cb4f7aeaa7cd9c1fd484446cae8148934e097dc4b8482e340a3cc6292a96c"}

{"id": "p_4965997e4818fc55", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 575, "text": "但有猛虎、獅子爲害，行道不群則不得過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 575}, "text_hash": "8a0b5b3cd108e2f43ce1bd5bbbdae9a35f3ac665d1b8ecca5bd04ba9ab818dd8"}

{"id": "p_3d3760d2b19ba224", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 576, "text": "其國置小王數十，其王所治城周回百餘-{里}-，有官曹文書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 576}, "text_hash": "ef646b1c3359350faf87570e4ba1846ac40ae73b5fcc3bc276cce28683c31dd1"}

{"id": "p_f2b99f284efd54b6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 577, "text": "王有五宮，一宮間相去十-{里}-，其王平旦之一宮聽事，至日暮一宿，明日復至一宮，五日一周。", "locator": {"ordinal": 577}, "text_hash": "dbf8a1306e477fe739e7c539738b386aa822d27423bed7d27aa52e0e6aeeb874"}

{"id": "p_0251201a228efa62", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 578, "text": "置三十六將，每議事，一將不至則不議也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 578}, "text_hash": "a8eec797598c9d4453e1a68f5fd4d0474bdf86a5c9994f5154e4cb32759d05d2"}

{"id": "p_77b7aaedc2effdcf", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 579, "text": "王出行，常使從人持一韋囊自隨，有白言者，受其辭投囊中，還宮乃省爲決理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 579}, "text_hash": "c51e63bd637f2cadf801468cce9579e779e153cfd14a8bdcf9a357c053636a05"}

{"id": "p_bfdb82de485831d2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 580, "text": "其別枝封小國，曰澤散王，曰驢分王，曰且蘭王，曰賢督王，曰汜復王，曰于羅王，其餘小王國甚多，不能一一詳之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 580}, "text_hash": "149f1fe9ea9b69d99bdafda348d6486806e5da2f92e464f87289f499402d78d5"}

{"id": "p_e2e6374e39b8bdfb", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 581, "text": "作金銀錢，金錢一當銀錢十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 581}, "text_hash": "c4de86d4277523afa851617919c9828d554f8ff3262caec9e4f32b95a8ffc3c6"}

{"id": "p_4be5a2b84d04a586", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 582, "text": "有織成細布，言用水羊毳，名曰海西布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 582}, "text_hash": "a1e1ac0ff59531a4992c539ca3b1acb18d412b35558b441f3b6fd24ec2174014"}

{"id": "p_34a4590cda0bfb8d", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 583, "text": "此國六畜皆出水，或-{云}-非獨用羊毛也，亦用木皮或野繭絲作，織成氍毹、毾㲪、罽帳之屬皆好，其色又鮮于海東諸國所作也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 583}, "text_hash": "adb7bed2dace05f13fbcae1736f5ace865324c975ee221d5ebdac49c6d2beca2"}

{"id": "p_1315cf982edb6521", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 584, "text": "又常利得中國絲，解以爲胡綾，故數與安息諸國交市於海中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 584}, "text_hash": "be631bd202d8b8d186f5880d5697c0c00e9660d453cdf8f829c88e4ddb9a6763"}

{"id": "p_963f2cb7a4232758", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 585, "text": "海水苦不可食，故往來者希到其國中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 585}, "text_hash": "698a3a63ed289e96e652071df4c261690e91fd0e5873ba2752e56479b96c84c4"}

{"id": "p_8035c18cd79976a3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 586, "text": "山出九色次玉石，一曰青，二曰赤，三曰黃，四曰白，五曰黑，六曰綠，七曰紫，八曰紅，九曰紺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 586}, "text_hash": "c2ffa628a9f6885bc9ab6124d6ee6bf2df4032a8d4a1d2171bc19cbdf78767ee"}

{"id": "p_98e959a84f207de4", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 587, "text": "今伊吾山中有九色石，即其類。", "locator": {"ordinal": 587}, "text_hash": "274f2ca75897e602648ddb1a139908d871e6e5cb1fcb376a46e89e7637618342"}

{"id": "p_22e032ff4af73b15", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 588, "text": "時，疏勒王臣槃獻海西青石、金帶各一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 588}, "text_hash": "d2349dcb94300fcf6564abc36063acb7a244bc8c57a4e0114de44cdf18cb885a"}

{"id": "p_86e4ac0beaee39d8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 589, "text": "又今西域舊圖-{云}-罽賓、條支諸國出琦石，即次玉石也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 589}, "text_hash": "21524e2762edffc1ad9929f3d74908d7e3566ffd1c0a7c19b8eca8a34e7fd270"}

{"id": "p_4d175e0aa5dd138a", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 590, "text": "大秦多金、銀、銅、鐵、鉛、錫、神龜、白馬、硃髦、駭雞犀、玳瑁、玄熊、赤螭、辟毒鼠、大貝、車渠、瑪瑙、南金、翠爵、羽翮、象牙、符采玉、明月珠、夜光珠、真白珠、虎珀、珊瑚、赤白黑綠黃青紺縹紅紫十種流離、璆琳、琅玕、水精、玫瑰、雄黃、雌黃、碧、五色玉、黃白黑綠紫紅絳紺金黃縹留黃十種氍毹、五色毾㲪、五色九色首下毾㲪、金縷繡、雜色綾、金塗布、緋持布、發陸布、緋持渠布、火浣布、阿羅得布、巴則布、度代布、溫宿布、五色桃布、絳地金織帳、五色鬥帳、一微木、二蘇合、狄提、迷迷、兜納、白附子、薰陸、郁金、芸膠、薰草木十二種香。", "locator": {"ordinal": 590}, "text_hash": "19057ce04e248b7e18c2af27a36a633de80b3a84511adf95dfa486ee764d2db9"}

{"id": "p_1f258e92f37d8d53", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 591, "text": "大秦道既從海北陸通，又循海而南，與交趾七郡外夷比，又有水道通益州、永昌、故永昌出異物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 591}, "text_hash": "da8c08b4aac78384fd417d84e7424d0e3baef721480ce736b5a1fc79742d7ce7"}

{"id": "p_3b33991b156d008c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 592, "text": "前世但論有水道，不知有陸道，今其略如此，其民人戶數不能備詳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 592}, "text_hash": "04d80ab410be247a9dc436ac09814bd32008f1d7ee08550dea5762c127d018bf"}

{"id": "p_c3edb05158247b58", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 593, "text": "自蔥領西，此國最大，置諸小王甚多，故錄其屬大者矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 593}, "text_hash": "2dbdd99d3a86e65b5861d1ed105edeb0525a94e35f7fbd8c04810809f4d4ab43"}

{"id": "p_e30bafa679764e1b", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 594, "text": "澤散王屬大秦，其治在海中央，北至驢分，水行半歲，風疾時一月到，最與安息安穀城相近，西南詣大秦都不知-{里}-數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 594}, "text_hash": "8022caca6a9a7acee0807c3f5602594f33bb8385b75169c713702e5222f9fdf6"}

{"id": "p_caec7d2d6c86e6ea", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 595, "text": "驢分王屬大秦，其治去大秦都二千里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 595}, "text_hash": "cb5574420d33b595e47c8e667eb65580ebe28438adccb989be627ff9b0b6b6c4"}

{"id": "p_f1e66dd921d4e7ae", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 596, "text": "從驢分城西之大秦渡海，飛橋長二百三十-{里}-，渡海道西南行，繞海直西行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 596}, "text_hash": "f9273b77ff919f3c3a2bc559d72a3a54066640deaf2bed5116d7b997dab3b1cd"}

{"id": "p_eca3ed80496a2c30", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 597, "text": "從思陶國直南渡河，乃直西行之且蘭三千里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 597}, "text_hash": "6e881da2fc5f77378f13e55ca26578d980f920bc3c93b4a55667d1c274f5ff2d"}

{"id": "p_a75eb48fb27d609c", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 598, "text": "道出河南，乃西行，從且蘭復直西行之汜復國六百里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 598}, "text_hash": "9fed3ae8b8a876dec9cdb2252d9fbb34310b0e99797932138a0c030f647947ab"}

{"id": "p_9504fb3986a488a0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 599, "text": "南道會汜復，乃西南之賢督國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 599}, "text_hash": "60d395458bc7da765741c770ae3bcbb4e6572ad8e6b81e54881f5e96a64cf456"}

{"id": "p_36a0fbdae5390777", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 600, "text": "且蘭、汜復直南，乃有積石，積石南乃有大海，出珊瑚，真珠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 600}, "text_hash": "8114e70cf9677c98fc83808c6ada83dc87a18735120b1a97a21ee6dc151d4465"}

{"id": "p_3feffbc7bf262764", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 601, "text": "且蘭、汜復、斯賓阿蠻北有一山，東西行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 601}, "text_hash": "058457c58014262bfd70df64acaae1351fa94064925ae755983ab45979be2208"}

{"id": "p_bc8b76084a2e36e3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 602, "text": "大秦、海西東各有一山，皆南北行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 602}, "text_hash": "1dfbf5a29d631b4da7e9dfabdb832b078130910dbc843b4ec34e2327131e4737"}

{"id": "p_6cba6f9c30951446", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 603, "text": "賢督王屬大秦，其治東北去汜復六百里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 603}, "text_hash": "28485e006b162255d11b4d1aaa84278af3557aa5db4fadfb58b98efa97a57be8"}

{"id": "p_7695ff07763a9214", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 604, "text": "汜復王屬大秦，其治東北去于羅三百四十-{里}-渡海也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 604}, "text_hash": "95884ecf0a9ffe3ae739d16691ad204216a83c97b89cf3a88ad74936ee88df0a"}

{"id": "p_7aed50854ee02937", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 605, "text": "于羅屬大秦，其治在汜復東北，渡河，從于羅東北又渡河，斯羅東北又渡河。", "locator": {"ordinal": 605}, "text_hash": "ed11e152900e1bd87daee542e510b8d9b4e34a3694f84da81566ec20d6f75bde"}

{"id": "p_d5b356b9c417d3d0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 606, "text": "斯羅國屬安息，與大秦接也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 606}, "text_hash": "c939587b52a2ce0acaacc1c38a2b4687ec88c5ac53a65371a534b0fc76b3389d"}

{"id": "p_939120b788ec33dd", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 607, "text": "大秦西有海水，海水西有河水，河水西南北行有大山，西有赤水，赤水西有白王山，白玉山有西王母，西王母西有脩流沙，流沙西有大夏國、堅沙國、屬繇國、月氏國、四國西有黑水，所傳聞西之極矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 607}, "text_hash": "90b1f91a50b32b2342e3f981193272e6145d82bdcf1e1ecb2deed32e288a39c6"}

{"id": "p_b65b318ac8e7e464", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 608, "text": "北新道西行，至東且彌國、西且彌國、單桓國、畢陸國、蒲陸國、烏貪國，皆並屬車師後部王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 608}, "text_hash": "5c18d1a47abfc5721365ba87be89e209e2bb9670d03b9ece64ad18ccdb019450"}

{"id": "p_5748cff3273ea2bb", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 609, "text": "王治于賴城，魏賜其王壹多雜守魏侍中，號大都尉，受魏王印。", "locator": {"ordinal": 609}, "text_hash": "cbb7408a7775b9a84fde5c49e69eb2f4d99ab82a47ecb53019ac650f558c83f0"}

{"id": "p_8a3b1ac51c1354fc", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 610, "text": "轉西北則烏孫、康居，本國無增損也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 610}, "text_hash": "3e50527bc9b5f227f532fe5effa60cfe3009fa43cb45cb8f8c14d08768202bb0"}

{"id": "p_43e5c7e2d278a0ae", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 611, "text": "北烏伊別國在康居北，又有柳國，又有岩國，又有奄蔡國一名阿蘭，皆與康居同俗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 611}, "text_hash": "60efa726af0bfe99ad0465336dc36ab866e0e2dce06de33874a0d9a34b16b504"}

{"id": "p_edf4de7aee069be6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 612, "text": "其國多名貂，畜牧逐水草，臨大澤，故時羈屬康居，今不屬也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 612}, "text_hash": "5d27e5009440f66795a33fc0f38a56a8afde0b7d9bfe893cebe614c3df175e8a"}

{"id": "p_863eaa3d9d824b17", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 613, "text": "呼得國在蔥嶺北，烏孫西北，康居東北，勝兵萬餘人，隨畜牧，出好馬，有貂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 613}, "text_hash": "6d51b68ec3e77738cb64064c5ada86ae141f6320bf7a4fdf963a24f1b14878c2"}

{"id": "p_51c104cb0b906db0", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 614, "text": "堅昆國在康居西北，勝兵三萬人，隨畜牧，亦多貂，有好馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 614}, "text_hash": "4aec0fcb2fd7b14420abf1ac04be794ebca5f4832d5269280594f2b8855fabc0"}

{"id": "p_ce0f0870818959b5", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 615, "text": "丁令國在康居北，勝兵六萬人，隨畜牧，出名鼠皮，白昆子、青昆子皮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 615}, "text_hash": "db7dbd56dec40aa68fd90ff5622e41513cd1e7f501296e8ba1ed9dbe1dcd0de4"}

{"id": "p_79c8502a85b44ffc", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 616, "text": "此上三國，堅昆中央，俱去匈奴單于庭安習水七千里，南去車師六國五千里，西南去康居界三千里，西去康居王治八千里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 616}, "text_hash": "b86f8c58f0f1b08708de805b2381e051f18c3f1479f60111488d91060d9b5f6d"}

{"id": "p_107e1a0ae2f6fdf2", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 617, "text": "或以爲此丁令即匈奴北丁令也，而北丁令在烏孫西，似其種別也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 617}, "text_hash": "59335ca2d9eb07e372e3ff77024c4f3f09fe63af229c92b9172dab109f91aaa7"}

{"id": "p_36d8f5aeb50a7bbb", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 618, "text": "又匈奴北有渾窳國，有屈射國，有丁令國，有隔昆國，有新梨國，明北海之南自復有丁令，非此烏孫之西丁令也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 618}, "text_hash": "2baff1d2911ff3385ff03d82e01647d735cf4ede1122c99eab86dcf33b6315a8"}

{"id": "p_1d473c7d4475d254", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 619, "text": "烏孫長老言北丁令有馬脛國，其人音聲似雁騖，從膝以上身頭，人也，膝以下生毛，馬脛馬蹄，不騎馬而走疾馬，其爲人勇健敢戰也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 619}, "text_hash": "d836eaa6c746d0420e0f983919f159cf9cf2c350c645578cc506d834698b646d"}

{"id": "p_3eb447bedd4639e1", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 620, "text": "短人國在康居西北，男女皆長三尺，人衆甚多，去奄蔡諸國甚遠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 620}, "text_hash": "332fe91a50eaa96c213e10f2b0ef18214c6ef69cd87eb28536a465ecfcf9e819"}

{"id": "p_8f97e780b4ee7f19", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 621, "text": "康居長老傳聞常有商度此國，去康居可萬餘-{里}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 621}, "text_hash": "e0bd2a680751d2e643687ff78fc28a29b8f07bc78d20f0c9b55b4c57aee04612"}

{"id": "p_c1e7b0f2f59d82dc", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 622, "text": "評曰：《史》《漢》著朝鮮、兩越，東京撰錄西羌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 622}, "text_hash": "bfe52545c25ae77666a09741753b173381f598bb04a6840d2c899932be67e0e7"}

{"id": "p_d37a1fade0a493f6", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 623, "text": "魏世匈奴遂衰，更有烏丸、鮮卑，爰及東夷，使譯時通，記述隨事，豈常也哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 623}, "text_hash": "5b2239a43227c770ced98ef3dcd77cee89e3df3d12d1bb929c50ac238bb08f97"}

{"id": "p_b32ed49335231ed8", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 624, "text": "Category:印尼‎", "locator": {"ordinal": 624}, "text_hash": "6ddba20f74be0976fcbbcaa2bfe0ffa5c0746cdcc5bad9d3f6b7128bae8c2098"}

{"id": "p_d05d2b94c01a41e3", "source_id": "src_4aa52a1c9a125d30", "ordinal": 625, "text": "Category:印度‎", "locator": {"ordinal": 625}, "text_hash": "3dabd4792149550b83192d77f74c646e7813093dc2d08cd2a67dad8619f67b01"}

{"id": "p_1c51c6dd096a4ad0", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_6542e64eb3a8ed33", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 1, "text": "劉焉字君郎，江夏竟陵人也，漢魯恭王之後裔，章帝元和中徙封竟陵，支庶家焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "e2457eadaf47b80c15bde87a6a0ae18ad75a7959f445135ff4eabd2cbcc1d48e"}

{"id": "p_c3d76cc58aef8dec", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 2, "text": "焉少仕州郡，以宗室拜中郎，後以師祝公喪去官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "d22cd5a83079b224ea8567cc22a8435d42661492299f1afed5786f5f6e120211"}

{"id": "p_d1492c6f0a009a02", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 3, "text": "居陽城山，積學教授，舉賢良方正，闢司徒府，歷雒陽令、冀州刺史、南陽太守、宗正、太常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "1a48ce545ddaba410f323859660e59916a96393f3ea79d1293574f208399ee8e"}

{"id": "p_c2bebc79194a9d6b", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 4, "text": "焉睹靈帝政治衰缺，王室多故，乃建議言：「刺史、太守，貨賂為官，割剝百姓，以致離叛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "aed88f6809ac5d477dc947a6157cbe2031df73fb2b1073c5f59d7171fb1d7262"}

{"id": "p_9361e1a6cf20da79", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 5, "text": "可選清名重臣以為牧伯，鎮安方夏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "77d7d414b52f36d7ad7833951669f06fb8bcf6ac3324eb2ec12d7bf9df2f55aa"}

{"id": "p_3ea202d8a550dda0", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」焉內求交阯牧，欲避世難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "a776618f6f69f90200a614cd547f618f5fac7af210ea061a372dfbdc90454404"}

{"id": "p_28c19a722c9f5b7c", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 7, "text": "議未即行，侍中廣漢董扶私謂焉曰：「京師將亂，益州分野有天子氣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "c1781078769289f4800ec3cb2fc0b4b4217f085fd7db3c17fb47a20faef7424e"}

{"id": "p_67937282d90726e1", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」焉聞扶言，意更在益州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "56fd853b82bcbbf67b28e59f663c561b4d5edfcce17fb4ffc58962071ff1e2a4"}

{"id": "p_bc678b4efeba91ec", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 9, "text": "會益州刺史郤儉賦斂煩擾，謠言遠聞，而并州殺刺史張壹，涼州殺刺史耿鄙，焉謀得施。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "8b8505381801f1cc0dde62bff90fc0b7962614e563feb48a41db7ec521c3f564"}

{"id": "p_3a420c4e3659bb65", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 10, "text": "出為監軍使者，領益州牧，封陽城侯，當收儉治罪；扶亦求為蜀郡西部屬國都尉，及太倉令（會）巴西趙韙去官，俱隨焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "de7dc470ac9d423de7054c77f843243e55e3f386f1d2bbc8a5918a10be127b0a"}

{"id": "p_d0dcdabe89f16517", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 11, "text": "是時〔益〕州逆賊馬相、趙祗等於綿竹縣自號黃巾，合聚疲役之民，一二日中得數千人，先殺綿竹令李升，吏民翕集，合萬餘人，便前破雒縣，攻益州殺儉，又到蜀郡、犍為，旬月之間，破壞三郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "65d47bedd514f094b8e383a9a2686a60449812eb4301103b21db70b1f07644e3"}

{"id": "p_933453060e893877", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 12, "text": "州從事賈龍（素）領兵數百人在犍為東界，攝斂吏民，得千馀人，攻相等，數日破走，州界清靜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "e7be0bedf86450d03d941c7c8f91d6da1157d8cf928666261f59eaa063d88b85"}

{"id": "p_6c2f09504288d910", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 13, "text": "焉徙治綿竹，撫納離叛，務行寬惠，陰圖異計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "2098bd796877d0d071183a09e4b91348b828c7180f91a144d52de46d013e17e3"}

{"id": "p_5377f0f080a1eeb5", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 14, "text": "張魯母始以鬼道，又有少容，常往來焉家，故焉遣魯為督義司馬，住漢中，斷絕谷閣，殺害漢使。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "f26240abeecd49088d8f32949c90e65caf58956a00f990ea66f13b0850d53a5b"}

{"id": "p_a5e583b543a20bc7", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 15, "text": "焉上書言米賊斷道，不得複通，又託他事殺州中豪強王咸、李權等十馀人，以立威刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "156c93c3a0a1641a9a89db9450b09535461b46c3a7f6600b2f84d4029e069668"}

{"id": "p_77ec38d9e2b0a266", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 16, "text": "犍為太守任岐及賈龍由此反攻焉，焉擊殺岐、龍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "9920f98f706e030df7d5f77b47a611c90b6c3d3e6e0c10b7e6b18a154f303f7f"}

{"id": "p_23c14ee68a1f5a61", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 17, "text": "焉意漸盛，造作乘輿車具千馀乘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "1de15536b18eada95e14514d421c2ca56dc04bf2d73135bb957ba70c39d67845"}

{"id": "p_beb4b8c2eec2d80e", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 18, "text": "荊州牧劉表表上焉有似子夏在西河疑聖人之論。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "1a254d9e893824dd2515ddbc184af4575ef3137c11f8699c6ae1815663e02b2c"}

{"id": "p_a2a45cbf7227b059", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 19, "text": "時焉子範為左中郎將，誕治書御史，璋為奉車都尉，皆從獻帝在長安，惟（小）子別部司馬瑁素隨焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "ba11835360f9da5c20e982794785d4ac134824c12c4e728ede3b72390bec5afc"}

{"id": "p_edbcad4c6dd8bd12", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 20, "text": "獻帝使璋曉諭焉，焉留璋不遣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "442918285051a9dd55224b3fe8e1690df5e524a476ef7dced3dbe08e46b37565"}

{"id": "p_291fbea0126ce071", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 21, "text": "時征西將軍馬騰屯郿而反，焉及範與騰通謀，引兵襲長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f01ffedfba96ef22429f0ebfc66cb4af470d37caffe16cd977ba0d13d0bcacfe"}

{"id": "p_86009b3a02b47db0", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 22, "text": "範謀洩，奔槐里，騰敗，退還涼州，範應時見殺，於是收誕行刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "00f13ee9c3fe68336eee9d86d8392d8e8315e2225ae2684d48f93f23937e760a"}

{"id": "p_026a9474af0e8d89", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 23, "text": "議郎河南龐羲與焉通家，乃募將焉諸孫入蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "c4d6ecb6955339933dc8ab66555f30fb209f6426024749aabfe60e6fa4a74bcb"}

{"id": "p_8f663a1c29e06135", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 24, "text": "時焉被天火燒城，車具蕩盡，延及民家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "4abeadcea500a7e311e4a81319a752f5d1ef5564582a8d89835b6f2428843f05"}

{"id": "p_4386aabfc7e7c08c", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 25, "text": "焉徙治成都，既痛其子，又感祅災，，癰疽發背而卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "07ce214ebdc20640b3f2cd95870e8e44bb9001cb926400e2cedc35b29d0ee41b"}

{"id": "p_23ce664ff011a111", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 26, "text": "州大吏趙韙等貪璋溫仁，共上璋為益州刺史，詔書因以為監軍使者，領益州牧，以韙為征東中郎將，率眾擊劉表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "c2dbd80661e6315d47cde438ba23d37bfa7d8be081d1dbd101930d410b982572"}

{"id": "p_bede30f005c2610a", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 27, "text": "璋字季玉，既襲焉位，而張魯稍驕恣，不承順璋，璋殺魯母及弟，遂為讎敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "3e8ba6013c10d1104d948f69796b13dfd961b78063a2a4688bae95b232bb309a"}

{"id": "p_427b6f2f1a95773c", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 28, "text": "璋累遣龐羲等攻魯，〔數為〕所破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "c7ad5db7b588f65eff4673d962f04b134db3c578fb8e9b2ea6f3c0ca3d08d7ae"}

{"id": "p_17f026a4723b7882", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 29, "text": "魯部曲多在巴西，故以羲為巴西太守，領兵禦魯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "afc99a33dc3cf2675dc0fe6ccfd653729542994a8df388fe1841162533680819"}

{"id": "p_785652e9186c368c", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 30, "text": "後羲與璋情好攜隙，趙韙稱兵內向，眾散見殺，皆由璋明斷少而外言入故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "e8834379a473588ae8e1334f997af6fddb28389cb38225f22ba0be6bcb5716dc"}

{"id": "p_d20ccdb3d46a8e01", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 31, "text": "璋聞曹公徵荊州，已定漢中，遣河內陰溥致敬於曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "74054ebf9d9cedb4b63bcbdb101f1d2c9a70085519fe6b3b6fa797c45dcf0c4e"}

{"id": "p_9450936fa4da1ffb", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 32, "text": "加璋振威將軍，兄瑁平寇將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "c32989d8355d8f9f7908cf1744ebd55f13a74103a0bc1c98337761498435bd4e"}

{"id": "p_2cae8251e1a715fe", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 33, "text": "璋復遣別駕從事蜀郡張肅送叟兵三百人並雜御物於曹公，曹公拜肅為廣漢太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "b466f710bf4d1c24ea880f033c21dee78ed84266de0a8bc9db65d92ad7ef488f"}

{"id": "p_5360b3ab06aa722f", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 34, "text": "璋復遣別駕張松詣曹公，曹公時已定荊州，走先主，不復存錄松，松以此怨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "feed72669cbeda82cc137e9265a1e6f00b359ee1a175a672d49a27386165f343"}

{"id": "p_7735460ac0c4049f", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 35, "text": "會曹公軍不利於赤壁，兼以疫死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "73293d0c7bd178b840048e35699323cbcb4d9654f228985c4f9a66054b1d4955"}

{"id": "p_53ffd3b1cb0d43c2", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 36, "text": "松還，疵毀曹公，勸璋自絕，因說璋曰：「劉豫州，使君之肺腑，可與交通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "92273505b696a3a3c567625cedf1c5272b36d2e162ce974da7da153db166697e"}

{"id": "p_8349412cd1ba78d8", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」璋皆然之，遣法正連好先主，尋又令正及孟達送兵數千助先主守禦，正遂還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "18cbc6135c07e36bdefa4a7afd18d04f66d196f62ee4db0fe553a0ce547ef48d"}

{"id": "p_f2c4c5a2666eb905", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 38, "text": "後松復說璋曰：「今州中諸將龐羲、李異等皆恃功驕豪，欲有外意，不得豫州，則敵攻其外，民攻其內，必敗之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "b9de00c5c7317b62ac6b78a05802918f8cd4876002a92e17a0d5cc6cb21589a0"}

{"id": "p_2398884f768d24ae", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」璋又從之，遣法正請先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "38cc83a62ffe22afc5d031069cc2bd16eeb1fdc5dd021a3e5f34381156b68d81"}

{"id": "p_831498a876e64a5c", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 40, "text": "璋主簿黃權陳其利害，從事廣漢王累自倒縣於州門以諫，璋一無所納，敕在所供奉先主，先主入境如歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "4bdf1d584403b01d6593c668ab65142c4fe6461203d25ff76d1f642f63eb9107"}

{"id": "p_6db540fa946f5a9a", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 41, "text": "先主至江州北，由墊江水詣涪，去成都三百六十里，是歲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "5ee77bc8493b497520a33a7d72101e4e1d8dbd4033a9e1f371604ce339e57c9e"}

{"id": "p_7410e8d40aae0b6d", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 42, "text": "璋率步騎三萬馀人，車乘帳幔，精光曜日，往就與會；先主所將將士，更相之適，歡飲百馀日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "5bc6c9456de09039f4e8f598fb1fde92709bfe28c7dcad2ae168c9fd8952af00"}

{"id": "p_cf6e3d223fe8517b", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 43, "text": "璋資給先主，使討張魯，然後分別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "dba7ee95412ebe85c35e9912a3987f6d162289b47024c8b99e8eec8e31586f76"}

{"id": "p_d54f4a7253b6474e", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 44, "text": "明年，先主至葭萌，還兵南向，所在皆克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "b05023686845e703f69d8e41e8bdccf356da8a659e4047ab10e79fe594de9429"}

{"id": "p_c27e054f900f98e7", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 45, "text": "十九年，進圍成都數十日，城中尚有精兵三萬人，谷帛支一年，吏民咸欲死戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "c19f53b9ad44564bb18082d28006adbea4fb172d270c200f1fff3301ca77fcc0"}

{"id": "p_86800e688c7272b1", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 46, "text": "璋言：「父子在州二十馀年，無恩德以加百姓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "b88c1c37dc54885634031428f915f61e4c2622ea235938f522e652463609641e"}

{"id": "p_be8cfe735e37b83e", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 47, "text": "百姓攻戰三年，肌膏草野者，以璋故也，何心能安！", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "4eefd867f0f01a323f0c3240e65ce606903b6a9dab0d054cffeffe9b7bea6df8"}

{"id": "p_0c15d0d26cbb4c5c", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 48, "text": "」遂開城出降，群下莫不流涕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "6cafe02cf50a78c5530d5795a845569f4f3d8ac9ae5084ddd521cc40f4232d13"}

{"id": "p_b3b6dbb19de39243", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 49, "text": "先主遷璋於南郡公安，盡歸其財物及故佩振威將軍印綬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "7d07f8ed42ae0dee1e073c7f114a98fbed6e0511a5b326feb308491729900ef6"}

{"id": "p_01f0679d19406e66", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 50, "text": "孫權殺關羽，取荊州，以璋為益州牧，駐秭歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "d3a261153412407bb8822a4f0da4803bbf7457b90001e57babc979bb9c945ef1"}

{"id": "p_4fc3c0b5ed0e4d99", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 51, "text": "璋卒，南中豪率雍闓據益郡反，附於吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "56f3e31dd0ae5fe519028875e19f09cc83f5774941f0380a731608b03df5f96f"}

{"id": "p_12e73eaf03b818ab", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 52, "text": "權復以璋子闡為益州刺史，處交、益界首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "26677a2bdaf6312a697db1d332eb30b45cfe5900404da34a76634593161f10a5"}

{"id": "p_a180757ea1dc6682", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 53, "text": "丞相諸葛亮平南土，闡還吳，為御史中丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "5aaf842deb2d836d8d6704d05e0d52c9780cf3832649f4d83042309cf576ce95"}

{"id": "p_ff7b030bd2b6650e", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 54, "text": "初，璋長子循妻，龐羲女也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "6ed510ad23684a3547ef6ee6815109398692d95169ef89770112c21358331e51"}

{"id": "p_2376fb30b1124299", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 55, "text": "先主定蜀，羲為左將軍司馬，璋時從羲啟留循，先主以為奉車中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "b50867cd6468415aa97ebc79a678c3835337cf91f2ac74c1bd53f77d3c45ce18"}

{"id": "p_bdb3d346ddb2540a", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 56, "text": "是以璋二子之後，分在吳、蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "e45a7a1c9f80a1e359571bca817e490e1b932b2c182f3d7399386b530d7f1407"}

{"id": "p_3747d4d86962cf6a", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 57, "text": "評曰：昔魏豹聞許負之言則納薄姬於室，劉歆見圖讖之文則名字改易，終於不免其身，而慶鍾二主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "850ed2c72f56a6ba1bc708c4c8c9f5551cd0a6691977022bbe3385d14914ae77"}

{"id": "p_7b91ac59b2729f15", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 58, "text": "此則神明不可虛要，天命不可妄冀，必然之驗也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "6e3b723c80089c6a46d05edbadcc2c6cf35cce7d207e64d488352b6e5711862d"}

{"id": "p_93acfa80f9490ed1", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 59, "text": "而劉焉聞董扶之辭則心存益土，聽相者之言則求婚吳氏，遽造輿服，圖竊神器，其惑甚矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "859d7bb8745e2e605a701ea1104d4864e92fcf27f924ca088c683f21ee01a38e"}

{"id": "p_04d76fe70bee6ea4", "source_id": "src_3b0068044bc7c40a", "ordinal": 60, "text": "璋才非人雄，而據土亂世，負乘致寇，自然之理，其見奪取，非不幸也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "33e57f1765b395bb5b94a3ac1ca67d1e8d0047e7ef6da09c6fa08a56cbfa3b49"}

{"id": "p_d6db934b376d3353", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_a4e2ab619cfcfa7e", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 1, "text": "先主姓劉，諱備，字玄德，涿郡涿縣人，漢景帝子中山靖王勝之後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "b36dce641e1fe82276f051e3178ed8282d4aeeb2b25e3ec8cc7b0ea18a60d7cc"}

{"id": "p_6f81056034c5065d", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 2, "text": "勝子貞，封涿縣陸城亭侯，坐酎金失侯，因家焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "100b2cd1b55359270edbbbe322dc18539f2c45489339cda1f1ec5df0b2e8e730"}

{"id": "p_a10af9f5a8bed780", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 3, "text": "先主祖雄，父弘，世仕州郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "d4e7da7437d088316e5baf49fd275f6ef6568d3337cd1ed42e3ea54a575a2efb"}

{"id": "p_eb0f9983c4129ed0", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 4, "text": "雄舉孝廉，官至東郡范令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "bc0513b9027b0e40d955af64176bb40cd969a322b19ef1e41949817af7a71e82"}

{"id": "p_7f410843d13c7da2", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 5, "text": "先主少孤，與母販履織蓆為業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "5ccaf69336c51d8da18885906a82d612f5aba355fa864213d540b471da557015"}

{"id": "p_e41fb32b17b98430", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 6, "text": "舍東南角籬上有桑樹生高五丈餘，遙望見童童如小車蓋，往來者皆怪此樹非凡，或謂當出貴人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "6e1715a448bf6bf07a52f938e0195db4493513da3b6ec6944982f65fad5bf505"}

{"id": "p_097fbaeb4cdc59e6", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 7, "text": "先主少時，與宗中諸小兒於樹下戲，言：「吾必當乘此羽葆蓋車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "a70190e9adafb27c18d1e9b11c315867cc445f795219acfab51d0b7ea49ebf7e"}

{"id": "p_c35177bb9dc3e745", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」叔父子敬謂曰：「汝勿妄語，滅吾門也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "2ee91bc38fc32dadab95cbcc7982874587664eb72fd8e7bed680e9d8f5d56641"}

{"id": "p_be0d3871f334be7e", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」年十五，母使行學，與同宗劉德然、遼西公孫瓚俱事故九江太守同郡盧植。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "36f253bee828db105f7b079af179595fcd129ae979a86bb7d3699236ff7ed8e0"}

{"id": "p_9f91abd42ee1bad0", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 10, "text": "德然父元起常資給先主，與德然等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "d7174342cb66e0543b4048236e9f863ebb18cd0abe0efe1047d4227613dda76d"}

{"id": "p_44809507621239ab", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 11, "text": "元起妻曰：「各自一家，何能常爾邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "a8bdc9d69ecf93ef4cf467c928e2081dbe306051abe366bd1de478c6ec1b8ec9"}

{"id": "p_55ea2783b6cc0519", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」起曰：「吾宗中有此兒，非常人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "1423aae4594531e873bb70d78a15619d10eaf78f6afddf049123a476f122018e"}

{"id": "p_bbc473c8b002a40b", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 13, "text": "先主不甚樂讀書，喜狗馬、音樂、美衣服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "451b8d88b920629dda14ec3a7ccf3408f456b94fa506ed4389be1d4cb8260ef8"}

{"id": "p_c06ebf6400a51442", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 14, "text": "身長七尺五寸，垂手下膝，顧自見其耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "efbc30f352d6cda53fb74510e027db7a258b4e292945dfe3b41d727792b67029"}

{"id": "p_39d92a5677feb3ad", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 15, "text": "少語言，善下人，喜怒不形於色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "ec6e56040460fa8fa1dd3bc8673959cc55f73956bdcd93a32f111bbf2e3d2fe1"}

{"id": "p_e3fba89848302d40", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 16, "text": "好交結豪俠，年少爭附之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "f439864b454581bf134a6bb7d2ebfc223f8763201dac4557a7d9205806eee1eb"}

{"id": "p_51a6cbb68630a1e1", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 17, "text": "中山大商張世平、蘇雙等貲累千金，販馬周旋於涿郡，見而異之，乃多與之金財。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "fab0412396f7d9d78f905d20a11887ce1c58710905b571c47c6b25b952b4b0e3"}

{"id": "p_83f98fe9bcd975c5", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 18, "text": "靈帝末，黃巾起，州郡各舉義兵，先主率其屬從校尉鄒靖討黃巾賊有功，除安喜尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "6f0fe37e796229323698aa6d98904e6dd1d1a41423edef42e858020e17f23ec3"}

{"id": "p_44530d50e6552f2e", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 19, "text": "督郵以公事到縣，先主求謁，不通，直入縛督郵，杖二百，解綬繫其頸着馬枊，棄官亡命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "750bcd6ca8caf0e2a68a6673a7c8d3aa8c30f8ed7f240ff4e64013dc7e444a13"}

{"id": "p_356a6ea2554315a6", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 20, "text": "頃之，大將軍何進遣都尉毌丘毅詣丹楊募兵，先主與俱行，至下邳遇賊，力戰有功，除為下密丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "c12c61d97839dfe7cf3c0c185c3318f5f9078dd24d1c84bfb22d57937ed296a8"}

{"id": "p_0941c47a9b3b5183", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 21, "text": "為賊所破，往奔中郎將公孫瓚，瓚表為別部司馬，使與青州刺史田楷以拒冀州牧袁紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "c6e5d2f4cc5d38f42f17edde943e33f5703f9be81a7b898679c776ca01f6d4e3"}

{"id": "p_dae6c91f2f3fa664", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 22, "text": "數有戰功，試守平原令，後領平原相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "04ffe1afb4252319964523dff861da528f42889de82cf6414ef4cc7e4b17d06b"}

{"id": "p_871bed15b2070a37", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 23, "text": "郡民劉平素輕先主，恥為之下，使客刺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "dadfa3b08436636558dba63f7cc964f134c61176ed6ae6d54bac755f8bf4c1f4"}

{"id": "p_f39fc6a2a1870c92", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 24, "text": "袁紹攻公孫瓚，先主與田楷東屯齊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "39530148393c3e89fc88f6d94a098005a5e9b1ed7812cbe5635e6b6673ddfd1a"}
