{"id": "p_4778e54eb4debbad", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 25, "text": "曹公征徐州，徐州牧陶謙遣使告急於田楷，楷與先主俱救之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "792af10e8899f37183698c634521ba8270863d71b77e32c6820a7ea48164f38a"}

{"id": "p_ee8995286d4e1c22", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 26, "text": "時先主自有兵千餘人及幽州烏丸雜胡騎，又略得饑民數千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "74244f80afbbc78289391dae75651432cb959899656c5b1b9551719d1e22be74"}

{"id": "p_78ba76fc9e922c83", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 27, "text": "既到，謙以丹楊兵四千益先主，先主遂去楷歸謙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "b1238dc79ffe60afce07a7b659dae168f4199610fe5a740478d76fda18e741e6"}

{"id": "p_3c92a62d10114a3b", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 28, "text": "謙表先主為豫州刺史，屯小沛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "7e412ccd8ab986e55c53bf948b5ef92bdcd2e02af232b4d7b2458ecffc904bf0"}

{"id": "p_2de09bc05b123bf7", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 29, "text": "謙病篤，謂別駕麋竺曰：「非劉備不能安此州也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "3bad65d052ca880b443b0595ea13efada5daddafdaad40592bd202c9a69c93c4"}

{"id": "p_72b0852cddcc29b2", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 30, "text": "」謙死，竺率州人迎先主，先主未敢當。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "3bffeeda3a3004d3cd2dbab7e9c211df6e2b8fef5613e8e10a51cfafc0a0fb79"}

{"id": "p_2c9d20b59ad4ff02", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 31, "text": "下邳陳登謂先主曰：「今漢室陵遲，海內傾覆，立功立事，在於今日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "f1cf024b6f29e556564ac7aa7e4ea8f39b8120d231d3ebd4846373088c01c79a"}

{"id": "p_81c2bc25cbb25c0f", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 32, "text": "彼州殷富，戶口百萬，欲屈使君撫臨州事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "92ed9c8825c52a676a128509279c6b48eb8318acb3d61ff018d923250e981131"}

{"id": "p_eb70c586a715156d", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」先主曰：「袁公路近在壽春，此君四世五公，海內所歸，君可以州與之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "dfa2fe34ae6e17bb807955c5d70dcfeb2dc7211220d907a02bf6f6cbab1fd8d7"}

{"id": "p_a28ae5f13b171842", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 34, "text": "」登曰：「公路驕豪，非治亂之主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "f1e1a4b345f4b5b0ed6e4213a541a1a1b10828644b51724d5ff470895945874f"}

{"id": "p_937a3322ccd595a7", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 35, "text": "今欲為使君合步騎十萬，上可以匡主濟民，成五霸之業，下可以割地守境，書功於竹帛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "c65873206c2a788e276a5aad2186d5b9a766cc7846d0387d8bf5fe8f7a44359b"}

{"id": "p_3deafc4f00d333f5", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 36, "text": "若使君不見聽許，登亦未敢聽使君也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "5ccd6e1dacbe8aa8df5c517b53ac4f93e2ed08a5ece75b154af2e48ea507b527"}

{"id": "p_6cf3a5d128d3851e", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」北海相孔融謂先主曰：「袁公路豈憂國忘家者邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "13b22a36225e4ea3620792eb6adc97351d3144b0867d3afc324be3fb3326b9c6"}

{"id": "p_6a7d51f1e922a84a", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 38, "text": "今日之事，百姓與能，天與不取，悔不可追。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "e2fd2e95331217139cf8d163416c83f4317883ae693fdfebae61e5218318d7e5"}

{"id": "p_bd23e4a35137bfec", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 39, "text": "袁術來攻先主，先主拒之於盱眙、淮陰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "287a3b1e45ed67ab994b2defdd98565dd9f96adfb921aca83f75b0729170d64a"}

{"id": "p_a656440188315614", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 40, "text": "曹公表先主為鎮東將軍，封宜城亭侯，是歲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "83ef6106ddfd619fc7a72c407421b12ba6a1cc651230206a3a64f2739ef8d48d"}

{"id": "p_203a3f44b86e3b73", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 41, "text": "先主與術相持經月，呂布乘虛襲下邳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "34f44d026039a7e4b2764aed4c1aabdae777d7d25bf9ecd252b9fc8e6dbf8f91"}

{"id": "p_161d7888bf0a5587", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 42, "text": "下邳守將曹豹反，閒迎布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "590e44dbcc38425bcc7a8451a4f47b2fffab1453fb5edeae766228a9cb48d459"}

{"id": "p_5323430e73754a9a", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 43, "text": "布虜先主妻子，先主轉軍海西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "047b30f89c9ec594070b87f79d416944a0237c90ea772f850d80ddbfd865e541"}

{"id": "p_807225d22b0c0032", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 44, "text": "楊奉、韓暹寇徐、揚閒，先主邀擊，盡斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "34f396d5f91a9ff407d4ca818bb1abdae32d3b2d53b9a72d79c8c6a22fff6401"}

{"id": "p_3324484c195b8dcf", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 45, "text": "先主求和於呂布，布還其妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "9e9b1e525a21a229e64d6732d27737a26ee7d63209f3d4354f79a30fdb2d4c9e"}

{"id": "p_c67056cbb88a8f6a", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 46, "text": "先主還小沛，復合兵得萬餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "da48a13a90153bef82478be81eccbc5c2dde1e16f6fbf25147919efc2ea3a5aa"}

{"id": "p_e45cab18aa960abf", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 47, "text": "呂布惡之，自出兵攻先主，先主敗走歸曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "bd94ed39b84b4b00351e456bf21f028f33b98e3719f816bd165b6f744209b46a"}

{"id": "p_e7ccf83d917911fb", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 48, "text": "曹公厚遇之，以為豫州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "307b9c396d5cd8cc6c1e9492c36e60573b260937ba5bbaec32b68a7ec7a55159"}

{"id": "p_a2dc16c595b091ad", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 49, "text": "將至沛收散卒，給其軍糧，益與兵使東擊布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "39a74ce44fc4065b03d062642faf1b6c1a6bf79a208b96abe33058b105291b02"}

{"id": "p_10c70f73dfb1dcb0", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 50, "text": "布遣高順攻之，曹公遣夏侯惇往，不能救，為順所敗，復虜先主妻子送布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "4665ac7a5e76d433e3d7db3aa7d477a8892b6cfa134510d514a3749a417ed2b7"}

{"id": "p_3f9e5f60849d3c59", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 51, "text": "曹公自出東征，助先主圍布於下邳，生禽布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "8f2605f5c3ceee0b9bf18bfe2e45b7ed60af78c39011b26841a780222d1fdde0"}

{"id": "p_53acd6d4e23d1fd6", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 52, "text": "先主復得妻子，從曹公還許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "a28ea8bbc50348d2b34f83ce13acb92853bbc8d8cba39bc604ad49fadf3892e4"}

{"id": "p_f0bd1e781dc07837", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 53, "text": "表先主為左將軍，禮之愈重，出則同輿，坐則同席。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "ca2433e71dc1f55c8fddca7c9ca508fd61a7a75b69ef8f398797291e4ab6bad2"}

{"id": "p_3b8c619ed8b6098c", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 54, "text": "袁術欲經徐州北就袁紹，曹公遣先主督朱靈、路招要擊術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "95e905448933137b5b9e89de65b2d17f1a44045a3618221d707de39f9a7c9992"}

{"id": "p_386c18cf121f1f34", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 55, "text": "先主未出時，獻帝舅車騎將軍董承辭受帝衣帶中密詔，當誅曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "42d620daf3ad5ceede989d2360988cc9377b3e0f007d436f25cfb704bca088e8"}

{"id": "p_d36a9f03b6c2f048", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 56, "text": "是時曹公從容謂先主曰：「今天下英雄，唯使君與操耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "6ffac8b702bb88849a012590f95dbe24437c35645129001eac478bae53ea73f7"}

{"id": "p_b2a25328c90c2856", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 57, "text": "遂與承及長水校尉种輯、將軍吳子蘭、王子服等同謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "709a137181d8a03b6b3d967495a022fee86cea686ad7e18dfdf201f9c38c09d4"}

{"id": "p_5a258259b08677a3", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 58, "text": "靈等還，先主乃殺徐州刺史車冑，留關羽守下邳，而身還小沛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "c49f563bde6ae7ca470df42b4e0c34d31c333acb671fc34a7a67dd92101c142f"}

{"id": "p_54e42670f10ee000", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 59, "text": "東海昌霸反，郡縣多叛曹公為先主，眾數萬人，遣孫-{乾}-與袁紹連和，曹公遣劉岱、王忠擊之，不克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "e7f86c15bd346962c9927bbed8227267c9bbf21416c268f83779bb4b25e6138d"}

{"id": "p_173a69abdef63b93", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 60, "text": "五年，曹公東征先主，先主敗績。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "2a696ac798e72b8c7940ea3cfa7d26de6485d763696e04ae62ede94b9a28cddd"}

{"id": "p_e3c871e4b8b647e4", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 61, "text": "曹公盡收其眾，虜先主妻子，並禽關羽以歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "d34ccd4abb62804c4251be14c6a3147e6da8fa06a84a6dda6a28e0af231bbdc3"}

{"id": "p_c9650d91a3f3344e", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 62, "text": "青州刺史袁譚，先主故茂才也，將步騎迎先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "c6d798d55526d4751c985068115620d31ac36bef8e1e5570e1aa0a703c6d7e1e"}

{"id": "p_22b55467d437d5e9", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 63, "text": "先主隨譚到平原，譚馳使白紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "bcde315e9bc295d4a9b14e01b94767337ea4f7198af1f71627bcb5e753d7ffb1"}

{"id": "p_440d655dacd20e1c", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 64, "text": "紹遣將道路奉迎，身去鄴二百里，與先主相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "6cbca00f06de7329bf79649ea69e15e9ed191af87fffe7beb34f6b27f0f3547c"}

{"id": "p_8e2915b34e92e1ed", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 65, "text": "駐月餘日，所失亡士卒稍稍來集。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "851d027009e50d5be407e81ace7cb0452a0dc77d10a2970fde4d14da63067f55"}

{"id": "p_b0398aff7f5fd328", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 66, "text": "曹公與袁紹相拒於官渡，汝南黃巾劉辟等叛曹公應紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "05a093c3aeeea0d927f357f43a52047fc2bae6661c59ed10ce0d92f9e0d31de5"}

{"id": "p_955c769ff6287c1e", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 67, "text": "紹遣先主將兵與辟等略許下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "5aa113629f2028de902b6392ece5b02c38ad882bc6b3c6daf79d0437a2abd7d8"}

{"id": "p_0fc63a22a8622428", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 68, "text": "曹公遣曹仁將兵擊先主，先主還紹軍，陰欲離紹，乃說紹南連荊州牧劉表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "fb03aa64ebeff11cd46e51e386a85e407cf2594bf213535811baece4c82fab36"}

{"id": "p_4f2e68efef5f180d", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 69, "text": "紹遣先主將本兵復至汝南，與賊龔都等合，眾數千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "249dc59056c1b72527ac2501d2109da898e976f1905a9d3544875c60cd40a87d"}

{"id": "p_125b9a96fa26df3f", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 70, "text": "曹公遣蔡陽擊之，為先主所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "d59d03d7ff8a03df8e60e3a9a380504ca66f262a677953b4326c0cb031195ea7"}

{"id": "p_7140744473d0feb5", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 71, "text": "曹公既破紹，自南擊先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "36d491c352f13986ddce64cc72aa05d2926811642dc53c805e0c216ecace3bf8"}

{"id": "p_034a3b45b600d25f", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 72, "text": "先主遣麋竺、孫-{乾}-與劉表相聞，表自郊迎，以上賓禮待之，益其兵，使屯新野。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "367981cf78a47a213b159786b7b4b703100cce8067ccaeb80478f3558a8acf84"}

{"id": "p_cd1f5197329dc9f5", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 73, "text": "荊州豪傑歸先主者日益多，表疑其心，陰禦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "017537ecf3de500d5295153c44d4c80e79095a778734e60e00edad4aa6c2c05c"}

{"id": "p_dcf71b7f3fcd88a2", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 74, "text": "使拒夏侯惇、-{于}-禁等於博望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "dce10fa860855e099f94ab1d95e044d66494cf528616e97e82de120b68bcb549"}

{"id": "p_e95eb02289419f4b", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 75, "text": "久之，先主設伏兵，一旦自燒屯偽遁，惇等追之，為伏兵所破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "1dbf04abf4dc208e7c16a0aae6985e1245f00892db14c5374f7b5e80a78bdcae"}

{"id": "p_ad82cbf6615aaa5f", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 76, "text": "十二年，曹公北征烏丸，先主說表襲許，表不能用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "1cf0fbe7594276e88c57cfd1c8c374f07b9ea56b0eb16a01aa215e519180a6f5"}

{"id": "p_25e3c7cbdc5ce92d", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 77, "text": "曹公南征表，會表卒，子琮代立，遣使請降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "6be0e66c2d35f691cfd994f63e47cfd097867698af1b0bc9fc273c1a1edc8abb"}

{"id": "p_adb9d0b1e0501ca3", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 78, "text": "先主屯樊，不知曹公卒至，至宛乃聞之，遂將其眾去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "7f37e6912ffa401036b49ef771581ad351b90463d30a48c51cec70f69b3bcf63"}

{"id": "p_7d3434ccc9e7a788", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 79, "text": "過襄陽，諸葛亮說先主攻琮，荊州可有。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "83ea316ce364efca3114f4fdbc54a4aab8e0c725285f0a647dba4c38ea7d7b15"}

{"id": "p_b757e7c1eb23f499", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 80, "text": "」 乃駐馬呼琮，琮懼不能起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "652cffe8b1d694d4b30059a47e11b4dd268ca4cf1e111e5fc1c3a902e0b33e10"}

{"id": "p_aa03356614d7ee01", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 81, "text": "琮左右及荊州人多歸先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "b64b81ede8c8c2d2e3b685d363405ddecaf4880e2fc3113565ef5eb983e12e9f"}

{"id": "p_6c3395c10d93a034", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 82, "text": "比到當陽，眾十餘萬，輜重數千兩，日行十餘里，別遣關羽乘船數百艘，使會江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "b04172b1b2739e281e03de59addb265aa66890c2a57c35179ea68ec41b2297c3"}

{"id": "p_f3088c7ac58ad87d", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 83, "text": "或謂先主曰：「宜速行保江陵，今雖擁大眾，被甲者少，若曹公兵至，何以拒之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "7de5b39d8a06e134959118c33845aa0ed25577566925bd2aab3bf9c1e7c1a9ce"}

{"id": "p_46727459a63f2a07", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」先主曰：「夫濟大事必以人為本，今人歸吾，吾何忍棄去！", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "2c47ce85724cddc77c253df7373253373d61f53f49b6ac80e393b8b9a61b6dfb"}

{"id": "p_935af31b3d20ff75", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 85, "text": "曹公以江陵有軍實，恐先主據之，乃釋輜重，輕軍到襄陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "01db1f9ce8eccda6330d8353b92c08d9e47aaf6ac72a1b644019a6bcd5775ae5"}

{"id": "p_a5921c5fa4a243e0", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 86, "text": "聞先主已過，曹公將精騎五千急追之，一日一夜行三百餘里，及於當陽之長坂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "230255e0157314e9b0880ecc99a488f3bb2ef7c7cfd7d354ee0d6a626e305917"}

{"id": "p_443491a09f37f2d7", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 87, "text": "先主棄妻子，與諸葛亮、張飛、趙雲等數十騎走，曹公大獲其人眾輜重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "55ef08fff042dd09a1d4d065966776cce235f1943bfb2ea918c1bfea1f3043b0"}

{"id": "p_1874ccd20210d54b", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 88, "text": "先主斜趨漢津，適與羽船會，得濟沔，遇表長子江夏太守琦眾萬餘人，與俱到夏口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "b2c36fee6448dabece5aa6d55e500965efcc1c2de901296b68c7056f6f2628cb"}

{"id": "p_59ebfd2b0480c612", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 89, "text": "先主遣諸葛亮自結於孫權，權遣周瑜、程普等水軍數萬，與先主并力，與曹公戰於赤壁，大破之，焚其舟船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "4e8ce450a3351f0eeae3b42a0ce69a49e6ea3c9ccff479989cbbbcb1d67b310f"}

{"id": "p_80dc21649abb969b", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 90, "text": "先主與吳軍水陸並進，追到南郡，時又疾疫，北軍多死，曹公引歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "179e7b8993ae48c929dc7941fe4f8940f57e6547a3adff031726f23f824e8a7d"}

{"id": "p_79579bb1bb7cc545", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 91, "text": "先主表琦為荊州刺史，又南征四郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "3e4b2d2c310439d4591f79a4ab733affeef934d71ab0d4b257a993cf54fd5d6e"}

{"id": "p_17aa9423d6459869", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 92, "text": "武陵太守金旋、長沙太守韓玄、桂陽太守趙範、零陵太守劉度皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "23504300fdecb3b2a70b3680bad52333d06d809740254b41ade6f0982f6d057b"}

{"id": "p_e349446c835ba59a", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 93, "text": "廬江雷緒率部曲數萬口稽顙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "5759f77513769cdfa817ff62fb1dc0c554596ba9b5ee1ab142e6946f3356bd32"}

{"id": "p_6105038e73279d1e", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 94, "text": "琦病死，羣下推先主為荊州牧，治公安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "a71244ac78a5beb45a57b45a6e850da21662e76cf259e22d2ea58a4ea6d526df"}

{"id": "p_6e0fe19ce882d847", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 95, "text": "先主至京見權，綢繆恩紀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "032344245770f57996bd8833dc03309367f272d37a91e015ccccbdf9ee73329a"}

{"id": "p_277e8c712572d7b8", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 96, "text": "權遣使-{云}-欲共取蜀，或以為宜報聽許，吳終不能越荊有蜀，蜀地可為己有。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "05fc69b41ddcb84c2b6c4d0c14df807bfb60de0ad3f2601f859467b3ef7348e2"}

{"id": "p_364e31cdaaa1093d", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 97, "text": "荊州主簿殷觀進曰：「若為吳先驅，進未能克蜀，退為吳所乘，即事去矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "6bbea0689048963c739c1eb049f3013561228515d24c24985bc5c445df070a03"}

{"id": "p_5e4587d69831b9c1", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 98, "text": "今但可然贊其伐蜀，而自說新據諸郡，未可興動，吳必不敢越我而獨取蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "7dbcb70c9bcfce8b529ee1a584fcaaf80fe1bf253463c33c4ed6289186830856"}

{"id": "p_79995ad867f901ca", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 99, "text": "如此進退之計，可以收吳、蜀之利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "fd64577e57a1abfdec8bc90d1cfc219917fad59b951d68e9aca8bf1a13e295a0"}

{"id": "p_5fe49d33878e37e2", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 100, "text": "十六年，益州牧劉璋遙聞曹公將遣鍾繇等向漢中討張魯，內懷恐懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "f200710aa418d7d27a77fcf1737797a178f078edf5ed9cd1c8367811d1c518d2"}

{"id": "p_13c8ff2b32399a3f", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 101, "text": "別駕從事蜀郡張松說璋曰：「曹公兵強無敵於天下，若因張魯之資以取蜀土，誰能御之者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "4dbe24224f97546d1514f9df184997387b9c26bd588da6436a4ff120c9fee04a"}

{"id": "p_5b6bcdf4df6b21f5", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 102, "text": "」璋曰：「吾固憂之而未有計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "d31f3b05c04c7f5d2a913183613e4a744f0afffb9bdec70f2181e866e7addca6"}

{"id": "p_e091eebd23a8eefb", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 103, "text": "」松曰：「劉豫州，使君之宗室而曹公之深讎也，善用兵，若使之討魯，魯必破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "7f16057d21e39e8c6c2cb15a9edb9ea917814014d677f8dcc48af9775ffa2dcf"}

{"id": "p_a824ea8c1c3fc123", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 104, "text": "魯破，則益州強，曹公雖來，無能為也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "4d18c2bc8029b238c629ae9a2a88f9222cba2cccaec3483399b5cb2f661065d0"}

{"id": "p_87a4271c400cb0c8", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 105, "text": "」璋然之，遣法正將四千人迎先主，前後賂遺以巨億計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "882df5fd11671fa2c4d1f57233ba6db72e769ef2848538b8197247d60049d420"}

{"id": "p_1f2b6316aca3ef95", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 106, "text": "先主留諸葛亮、關羽等據荊州，將步卒數万人入益州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "f8cc9c81e76afe5e85956463cf95af538863e00cd7f689e4f743dba79458ab4d"}

{"id": "p_0b7985dc0b472af4", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 107, "text": "至涪，璋自出迎，相見甚歡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "b414307bc15193a0b3d2628517391a191aebc08b0950d85fa20cea4382224bd7"}

{"id": "p_9f7d218ca07c81c6", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 108, "text": "張松令法正白先主，及謀臣龐統進說，便可於會所襲璋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "37301bcdeea5c69db71571f2702a0d04f6d8ee99499a4825928a04f63dd4a84b"}

{"id": "p_a546933bd6abd6a0", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 109, "text": "先主曰：「此大事也，不可倉卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "080e17a0eab18daa054cd4ff5b9384898566451de33aa66480ec8f63dd878e37"}

{"id": "p_fa377d24d45ea583", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 110, "text": "」璋推先主行大司馬，領司隸校尉；先主亦推璋行鎮西大將軍，領益州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "874a115e7fd942da4313eda733e34f2fd8cb9079fd70d0074d50c00be4bccdea"}

{"id": "p_7cd8f605437108e7", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 112, "text": "先主並軍三萬餘人，車甲器械資貨甚盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "259d59d37ab4ba19939208aa151dd29743e5a0c4e23f077c43e60d71b0203065"}

{"id": "p_db7f4e8469c5f439", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 113, "text": "先主北到葭萌，未即討魯，厚樹恩德，以收眾心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "960f9ac319801f4a9c49589652f933255842c10365ad1b513b4febbd7c86bd1f"}

{"id": "p_dbd5fea9905d0e04", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 114, "text": "明年，曹公徵孫權，權呼先主自救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "0d97a947c95d2620b74570b83bc4fd719b50bdbac864e9c8ed2f289e9b4c1e0d"}

{"id": "p_b89a1b1ba76eccbb", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 115, "text": "先主遣使告璋曰：「曹公徵吳，吳憂危急。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "fadd7a43fd6a197b69ec01d339bed18a5e5bbe0657e9a7d6359c0007e9626b7b"}

{"id": "p_c5baf579076ce4bb", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 116, "text": "孫氏與孤本為脣齒，又樂進在青泥與關羽相拒，今不往救羽，進必大克，轉侵州界，其憂有甚於魯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "20cdb0fd81a0f899b50af9310c6ae270575211013b88419ef603401a8f1ea8eb"}

{"id": "p_e8177396978de6b5", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 117, "text": "」乃從璋求萬兵及資（寶），欲以東行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "df55a09abc3bb737d008a4ba28d8928f9ac44c317e564cca7ca29585d41b1dba"}

{"id": "p_6d3199dc6b5efd23", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 118, "text": "璋但許兵四千，其餘皆給半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "59e567ce2610e336a7efca50ab0853314e76fa61c51df948152ecb95fb3be2de"}

{"id": "p_c478bd40ebe25885", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 119, "text": "張松書與先主及法正曰：「今大事垂可立，如何釋此去乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "b3d94e79efd90157d70b438de29e2cae6d4b7e65b5bc7fd993a264863b93e5ca"}

{"id": "p_79cee175fa42ab47", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 120, "text": "」松兄廣漢太守肅，懼禍逮己，白璋發其謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "b86ca17feda1c800d19c3d0cac506b3cd606cb4377e7b0f19a8a344a91866724"}

{"id": "p_8342e95140b3e6ec", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 121, "text": "於是璋收斬松，嫌隙始構矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "ef6db677cd45202c3bb73146cc5254681ae11ffa39bda0fdc5f290eb2fbb77a2"}

{"id": "p_7a6a848279aab910", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 122, "text": "璋敕關戍諸將文書勿複關通先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "6247dc668c39695066614bf9889500e0e923e445035b615ba8e0da97c51c140d"}

{"id": "p_9ca050b83931e0d4", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 123, "text": "先主大怒，召璋白水軍督楊懷，責以無禮，斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "a068f6444d791d4aac0e0ed5658db66aa21c86b267a37585edc1bbc506f47542"}

{"id": "p_3e19847a01afcf9e", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 124, "text": "乃使黃忠、卓膺勒兵向璋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "e21a3a016ccfc4d6da964e81759d42e790635c9bb1ddf0f5e69ca7da93212932"}

{"id": "p_2e55bccb57d9f0d8", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 125, "text": "先主徑至關中，質諸將並士卒妻子，引兵與忠、膺等進到涪，據其城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "8f8530b47e9675b35d7d0dd0044b60b1e23febd297b9d005b5fdd8f9ba665daa"}

{"id": "p_0faee18956072c14", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 126, "text": "璋遣劉璝、冷苞、張任、鄧賢等拒先主於涪，皆破敗，退保綿竹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "20cab08917124fd5ef7d4f4a6b0086e7347699b7394059fcff56dc4b12cae858"}

{"id": "p_4fc4f56b761b0971", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 127, "text": "璋復遣李嚴督綿竹諸軍，嚴率眾降先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "c01e4211e18420999d0c6ffca99b71dbd6c3bfa8c3ebbe244229a296781a28bb"}

{"id": "p_f86e456fec56bdad", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 128, "text": "先主軍益強，分遣諸將平下屬縣，諸葛亮、張飛、趙雲等將兵溯流定白帝、江州、江陽，惟關羽留鎮荊州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "79bb8980707f0c62e4d0f3bfa95ea8ea5c1f1d055b7a3ef8036481e50d01ecf3"}

{"id": "p_7dae949c085e2617", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 129, "text": "先主進軍圍雒；時璋子循守城，被攻且一年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "bc40c82b05ca23d2b22ce89583e62f6505ba8652325fe3f78da2077bee8b5b99"}

{"id": "p_edf4791be4ef4161", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 130, "text": "十九年夏，雒城破，進圍成都數十日，璋出降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "e4abbd606b30bb03c83aa9b5ac1b0d31ef4119984aafc87cee706ee16f443bab"}

{"id": "p_e969455e7b518003", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 131, "text": "蜀中殷盛豐樂，先主置酒大饗士卒，取蜀城中金銀分賜將士，還其穀帛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "401d394bd1584c112e23f3b5d57b5099be1387943e1eeca046b0aa3ccd476e38"}

{"id": "p_16e6f6277c1abbdc", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 132, "text": "先主复領益州牧，諸葛亮為股肱，法正為謀主，關羽、張飛、馬超為爪牙，許靖、麋竺、簡雍為賓友。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "044388e5f3a743278c1d10dec84fd9278f30e24e2997512407e8388010891c38"}

{"id": "p_0133ea726c0808c6", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 133, "text": "及董和、黃權、李嚴等本璋之所授用也，吳壹、費觀等又璋之婚親也，彭羕又璋之所排擯也，劉巴者宿昔之所忌恨也，皆處之顯任，盡其器能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "e94f32cd5d603f958a3d1e3f79d09b4e3c4f57f7b17e45912eb2d11096a8aa62"}

{"id": "p_84e9b2636d3a0227", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 134, "text": "二十年，孫權以先主已得益州，使使報欲得荊州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "713aea855f1201addd71a6e2f2fbaf563d7885672a4bcb801c000d9797fa6491"}

{"id": "p_a30767653d219ed9", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 135, "text": "先主言：「須得涼州，當以荊州相與。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "870b72909735165b0c5d5426b7988fcd332ac5ab06ec6f5eb64b6ba7a2e1841d"}

{"id": "p_99166530b8a43e7d", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 136, "text": "」權忿之，乃遣呂蒙襲奪長沙、零陵、桂陽三郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "137d3368c97f161994353c5543797c6b127312c7cb6dfc3c171546e9e259621c"}

{"id": "p_9610246609d3d595", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 137, "text": "先主引兵五萬下公安，令關羽入益陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "cb552e003a88c64aa8c1fc15df9032301492b4bf40b7f3e63a2e944865c007bb"}

{"id": "p_46a226d4f48ed928", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 138, "text": "是歲，曹公定漢中，張魯遁走巴西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "3df7cd2ea2a61329c6f3ae631e38b70e4cd01e9222fecb57d0264bb424051ae1"}

{"id": "p_618ada1c04084b41", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 139, "text": "先主聞之，與權連和，分荊州、江夏、長沙、桂陽東屬，南郡、零陵、武陵西屬，引軍還江州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "a09bc91fee091a994899d77fbe1a2f7da3e3b42cc2372cce826891e9167467ce"}

{"id": "p_b8d578c84d8828b3", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 140, "text": "遣黃權將兵迎張魯，張魯已降曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "f5874d1af1da46ad1f1cc693c9f20da7d2b7ea5d76b9de8fd68829706de3e948"}

{"id": "p_0b3e3d48af4aadd1", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 141, "text": "曹公使夏侯淵、張郃屯漢中，數數犯暴巴界。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "027a5efbc3c0962c477ae0f143d112f8c09d59a7814993bbf8765b558e9e93c4"}

{"id": "p_548d86241675a28a", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 142, "text": "先主令張飛進兵宕渠，與郃等戰於瓦口，破郃等，收兵還南鄭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "03266d22a9a6aa32699814f7c0b0412d4c4ec18f429b6ac1b62f5f5fc53204b5"}

{"id": "p_8772698a1be938ef", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 143, "text": "二十三年，先主率諸將進兵漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "04d3b08432f948b02748b91845b50e568b7e0c5796d657904e3c5c9c75c15818"}

{"id": "p_1ecd9556dc435455", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 144, "text": "分遣將軍吳蘭、雷銅等入武都，皆為曹公軍所沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "56443f68161439e783d8051d2fe447bc8489b385d8169c98d1a9962a97fc1719"}

{"id": "p_3875786a1006ba61", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 145, "text": "先主次於陽平關，與淵、郃等相拒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "ad48f5b58ec45ef54fd77a74f2d5876e7780201687981ca43af4f0f4f48d63c0"}

{"id": "p_7dbaa45102c3820f", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 146, "text": "二十四年春，自陽平南渡沔水，緣山稍前，於定軍山勢作營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "8a1f9882268040fa8604b16a3048b1af5622d4bcecb3f35595e7d22cfff7b7f5"}

{"id": "p_e39acfc7777a952d", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 147, "text": "先主命黃忠乘高鼓譟攻之，大破淵軍，斬淵及曹公所署益州刺史趙顒等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "9b581a9d59b5da12e611145197b036f4356d065433972735ec6f63553df46ae3"}

{"id": "p_ab799926f7ab4ee8", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 148, "text": "先主遙策之曰：「曹公雖來，無能為也，我必有漢川矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "393a0a0d92b84ad1b053ea374df94771e214c3df338a715611012d3bed95b228"}

{"id": "p_86dc6b36ae7ff638", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 149, "text": "」及曹公至，先主斂眾拒險，終不交鋒，積月不拔，亡者日多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "7ec719416e38bf9f6455cbd9394363a11a839b0fb761a9eba1179640780d45ef"}

{"id": "p_46426fc279bee47a", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 150, "text": "夏，曹公果引軍還，先主遂有漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "2dbac7166d9cdbe8a152e9050473a09e0441ff434b293428264578b9d3653e91"}

{"id": "p_63a947b277a60949", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 151, "text": "遣劉封、孟達、李平等攻申耽於上庸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "a00cf367b03e1e3431fb0284e2bde4fa5431024f759ed04e006a481bd7949909"}

{"id": "p_dbb39689c2160f64", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 152, "text": "秋，群下上先主為漢中王，表於漢帝曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "298d1a0c23f12def6a1fcf1bb49f8da04282d42fb4d127c1406698860afee39b"}

{"id": "p_8e8ebfccbf293a50", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 153, "text": "遂於沔陽設壇場，陳兵列眾，群臣陪位，讀奏訖，禦王冠於先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "7a937df3b4bdab282671655d4fc36cd2ad68c976b1038df730908037ba46895f"}

{"id": "p_9afe36e5b5d68f79", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 154, "text": "時關羽攻曹公將曹仁，禽于禁於樊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "5b366909be381cd08393d9070b892ee87736fe99b514f165573e410cf1b6edcf"}

{"id": "p_5477cae411356e87", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 155, "text": "俄而孫權襲殺羽，取荊州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "9eafce72eb46ec4275834497538b6e84f252d593400fec9a8d1b59b10a952a06"}

{"id": "p_112f629511fdbb3f", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 156, "text": "二十五年，魏文帝稱尊號，改年曰黃初。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "d156bbd3cfe675e1aa065cb59c85d78d875d714a4de1b851f740662308227757"}

{"id": "p_82191e2ecec595a4", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 157, "text": "或傳聞漢帝見害，先主乃發喪制服，追諡曰孝愍皇帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "550529bd012027cd3ad715f2bed9c0ef1dddea1fe9fdce1b708b8be0032dc25c"}

{"id": "p_4a858601e853714a", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 158, "text": "是後在所並言眾瑞，日月相屬，故議郎陽泉侯劉豹、青衣侯向舉、偏將軍張裔、黃權、大司馬屬殷純、益州別駕從事趙莋、治中從事楊洪、從事祭酒何宗、議曹從事杜瓊、勸學從事張爽、尹默、譙周等上言：", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "395b7b7f0192e32e452a2d52761439b04f47f4af9e834231fae1a019b42145ce"}

{"id": "p_f1b813468e69fbac", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 159, "text": "太傅許靖、安漢將軍糜竺、軍師將軍諸葛亮、太常賴恭、光祿勳〔黃柱〕、少府王謀等上言：", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "590fa2b9b0ff70efb7048ab746edefabb3c0fbc0f26d8833904b91210dd246a5"}

{"id": "p_ee38d78ede28bb72", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 160, "text": "即皇帝位於成都武擔之南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "216628bc0f648d1fdbffede41a62d7e5a7be9e6cab6e14c5e13a7a107e5d56e3"}

{"id": "p_992cb41e2ac62a9b", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 161, "text": "以諸葛亮為丞相，許靖為司徒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "abf466f1194c2aef153b9092584662ea8490f1dc49ed57c7dc471ef23fc3b7d4"}

{"id": "p_4866cc8c2fee2a13", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 162, "text": "置百官，立宗廟，祫祭高皇帝以下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "504519047fe2df8dc65823b3f1be9752a5463f8896e38f17e7d14e522dad0f41"}

{"id": "p_4d82acb6b4954a00", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 163, "text": "五月，立皇后吳氏，子禪為皇太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "86cb80aa8e8bcfb9b56b59f272d17dce40b77363f6a6253d4c70059a6a05feca"}

{"id": "p_f383079929743b54", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 164, "text": "六月，以子永為魯王，理為梁王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "1b4a5a9a76b18fc3964fbf7d301e3d6bd22b725574f8fcdd5faf3e097f60fe62"}

{"id": "p_5e02b418980c84ec", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 165, "text": "車騎將軍張飛為其左右所害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "30d781f8b437dfcb03ff812957d9b698dea9136b70e011135de749bd630697b4"}

{"id": "p_3f4ace37f5f62320", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 166, "text": "初，先主忿孫權之襲關羽，將東征，秋七月，遂帥諸軍伐吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "cb71dadef7286fa6b03d5f72a224ff3bf533a96c2bf0da272b4bab1f68c1d939"}

{"id": "p_50513786a343452a", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 167, "text": "孫權遣書請和，先主盛怒不許，吳將陸議、李異、劉阿等屯巫、秭歸；將軍吳班、馮習自巫攻破異等，軍次秭歸，武陵五谿蠻夷遣使請兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "22e1315705ee86dd962f7f92e55837692be6dd5be4e4486704012aa836b416ab"}

{"id": "p_8253a66beb5f00c4", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 168, "text": "二年春正月，先主軍還秭歸，將軍吳班、陳式水軍屯夷陵，夾江東西岸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "e416364d83bd13a2eba8a63fea5f2ba4d6d9b0099fa10a83c9a5c5165726c81b"}

{"id": "p_daee553e7d06efa7", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 169, "text": "二月，先主自秭歸率諸將進軍，緣山截嶺，於夷道猇亭駐營，自佷山通武陵，遣侍中馬良安慰五谿蠻夷，咸相率響應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "407ef5da53fa43281575de860f0148165c906bff1568fe76bd7ae18f29f67fe1"}

{"id": "p_ff6966d21d54b790", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 170, "text": "鎮北將軍黃權督江北諸軍，與吳軍相拒於夷陵道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "2ee833befe499d446d98ea043b6067721a45fac78c5ebc4b65bc5c797bbd1395"}

{"id": "p_96f28945fc6e7f23", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 171, "text": "夏六月，黃氣見自秭歸十餘里中，廣數十丈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "35de2c857f774f94a9fd97106bc9ee2c36674321cc6277cdb186898d0eb07281"}

{"id": "p_222dbd49ef23fd24", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 172, "text": "後十餘日，陸議大破先主軍於猇亭，將軍馮習、張南等皆沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "0424bb591617a44f308b40ddcabfe6d73bd952738670f615c9feeb7b9d7ea887"}

{"id": "p_ce5613e16d45b83d", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 173, "text": "先主自猇亭還秭歸，收合離散兵，遂棄船舫，由步道還魚复，改魚复縣曰永安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "2856852ee3a7c59bd96dd8ed977fed0424ddd327f8e6b8e7e5ad329261ed6ed5"}

{"id": "p_4f592a2a1c96836f", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 174, "text": "吳遣將軍李異、劉阿等踵躡先主軍，屯駐南山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "23bbd7936409ed4b52cf5d8e211f3384ac23e0127b5f106aac18f083ec4570a8"}

{"id": "p_1a4e9b7d28ef5048", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 175, "text": "冬十月，詔丞相亮營南北郊於成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "c00a60ea4f9c3be3a992071d9528ca82d9a612d05d5c885cbb7f4dfc143a41df"}

{"id": "p_6f540eaa80813192", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 176, "text": "孫權聞先主住白帝，甚懼，遣使請和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "5af139c30378fd6fe41b6a46bc5ad88c183b92b4f076a84a315c23214cf79814"}

{"id": "p_e9b5661056b03de1", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 177, "text": "先主許之，遣太中大夫宗瑋報命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "98535808a1155e3321bd3c1c44f663d500e367f9d39c2a6f16e9cc5fc1b423ce"}

{"id": "p_0e19da7330613aac", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 178, "text": "冬十二月，漢嘉太守黃元聞先主疾不豫，舉兵拒守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "ae3af9f7d722f620ed71a6de6f00b04937fb300377ee2d2424e47d4fb9914082"}

{"id": "p_c7ae286382649fdf", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 179, "text": "三年春二月，丞相亮自成都到永安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "366910f5ee9c02c3e34e69c20494600b256e71a53b634c7feb72c3ed48f613a2"}

{"id": "p_e9164d1cb9be09d9", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 180, "text": "三月，黃元進兵攻臨邛縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "9a058676d406f6430e2bdf9d98537e62fb800b89485052466aef7a05b63f29b5"}

{"id": "p_19aa9710ba3c8fc9", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 181, "text": "遣將軍陳曶討元，元軍敗，順流下江，為其親兵所縛，生致成都，斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "5312f419a54ca5c2243c2e811ef8883d1a136f20e9ee4fc5251bf32260cf04f5"}

{"id": "p_c98c20f6bc4f13e9", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 182, "text": "先主病篤，託孤於丞相亮，尚書令李嚴為副。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "99650933f0c74a6b7f65cb63ce96912d34e9438d94cf9a61cd7c62e1d9893053"}

{"id": "p_94a2b58a40a5f425", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 183, "text": "夏四月癸巳，先主殂於永安宮，時年六十三。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "2c612205b92066330d92dab3b37da8d1ace682bcc8d13bd3179166e9af6ea938"}

{"id": "p_5cff9292c0ee9d61", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 184, "text": "五月，梓宮自永安還成都，諡曰昭烈皇帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "37f1eb98d997633524156d3c3fc0451731eadf574e37b1d64b90826cacfba974"}

{"id": "p_7e28bd001e59c665", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 185, "text": "評曰：先主之弘毅寬厚，知人待士，蓋有高祖之風，英雄之器焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "9c197f0cbb346df1949691b4287fd05dc4798f0e93ccb51553cd80872e82916b"}

{"id": "p_bdd2a13305ad604a", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 186, "text": "及其舉國託孤於諸葛亮，而心神無貳，誠君臣之至公，古今之盛軌也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "9e3d20308d4117b049a239d1e6ef993e180ad4ec0c4ef9de69f1b9f9b6320a23"}

{"id": "p_a23c6918d4305bb3", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 187, "text": "機權幹略，不逮魏武，是以基宇亦狹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "83e8e9f69793b04df492999d68ed3069b1226bd916b60694e7f26b5e6efdb63d"}

{"id": "p_701951f9c5bd57a5", "source_id": "src_9e8bc1439a686931", "ordinal": 188, "text": "然折而不撓，終不為下者，抑揆彼之量必不容己，非唯競利，且以避害云爾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "032552fb71cdde60cc8393c48e6dabb135812008a18465361a27929ea452522e"}

{"id": "p_551068ef3cdc1885", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_fe4b69e06fa54ded", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 1, "text": "後主諱禪，字公嗣，先主子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "d04ba28976953a2ff82016c78794bbb0c94382ccc082a9a54220effc0d9b9338"}

{"id": "p_f6f18bdb98ac6a39", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 2, "text": "，先主為漢中王，立為王太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "ad58634f74f3235d75ff4a68fbb8e48b598405dc5545ece52d6392ca0c8818fa"}

{"id": "p_1809300cf2020997", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 3, "text": "及即尊號，冊曰：「惟五月辛巳，皇帝若曰：太子禪，朕遭漢運艱難，賊臣篡盜，社稷無主，格人群正，以天明命，朕繼大統。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "dcd8c4911f3afc1f8ad52f76e2e9c18497c63cbe8b1188169a00b03f65237bf1"}

{"id": "p_7d3aedc2a250e253", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 4, "text": "今以禪為皇太子，以承宗廟，祗肅社稷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "9be8a2d9e5042e5039e92f2336e34199d24244914ce00ff046e715ddd7d74e9a"}

{"id": "p_bd014d880ca452f2", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 5, "text": "使使持節丞相亮授印綬，敬聽師傅，行一物而三善皆得焉，可不勉與！", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "fb169e0c770d48e46c27cb7e6372a0f78941505202667bcbaa75f2a4f2b97ce8"}

{"id": "p_8331196c1302704a", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」三年夏四月，先主殂於永安宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "fec63f54bdfd9bde23810a166a5776a14514733e9b01e5610cfc93da3461e524"}

{"id": "p_4a9dc4d8e204684e", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 7, "text": "五月，後主襲位於成都，時年十七，尊皇后曰皇太后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "ed338325986707e32c4a8f15a99e4b941523d9ec3e2e848f0cb17c0de95fd68a"}

{"id": "p_be722ca317a148d1", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 8, "text": "夏，臧柯太守朱褒擁郡反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "c299b568672e222747332f2e37314464f7e6256d43e171afbe1de04014e522df"}

{"id": "p_1017a8847e687685", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 9, "text": "先是，益州郡有大姓雍闓反，流太守張裔於吳，據郡不賓，越巂夷王高定亦背叛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "9c5000962e3d7b375e5a7d81274c269e9dc4aff79f2b4c2bf1dfd170c94b8e2f"}

{"id": "p_4cf21f359f4ef236", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 10, "text": "遣尚書（郎）鄧芝固好於吳，吳王孫權與蜀和親使聘，是歲通好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "c1c4bcad6ce96c7ea9960324ffc824a273174b45d9ba98492c850bc4ef908c0e"}

{"id": "p_0ed6dd0d8f36701e", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 11, "text": "二年春，務農殖穀，閉關息民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "eed7b71c8a90e5d02cb47b804cf76419d82ea3c8a483ec17b233f5875907397b"}

{"id": "p_715b4eac5e375b33", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 12, "text": "三年春三月，丞相亮南征四郡，四郡皆平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "73157a0c3dc884539cda21e37b299a6e96c71c1c5b025598656b32a5fbfc1a10"}

{"id": "p_3edd22b8eae83395", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 13, "text": "改益州郡為建寧郡，分建寧、永昌郡為雲南郡，又分建寧、臧柯為興古郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "6ae8787f65e3d396f4d6b63a40a7789d176c3e5bf70567bcca1495e63f33b005"}

{"id": "p_33d6c3fc7633aa2d", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 14, "text": "四年春，都護李嚴自永安還住江州，築大城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "3751d92a06d8b228838ef8d9399e74fcb7269c03ab43c88b95872da605e6a3a2"}

{"id": "p_dff74ce7685347d6", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 15, "text": "五年春，丞相亮出屯漢中，營沔北陽平石馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "1310353cd2d790523c5edadb3ef1e71d24897a6740f684991f356eedf59f3d5f"}

{"id": "p_03e469f9ee2fc5c1", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 16, "text": "六年春，亮出攻祁山，不克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "38ca7f9a9e9379e62122b7e1e30af83c1fde9016ac6456250315b87c6d5f5528"}

{"id": "p_86c559176d5ba786", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 17, "text": "冬，復出散關，圍陳倉，糧盡退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "5b53a125c2e9e1e4d0c1e2d4a47779e9cc7aef486ee393bc53a02d847d7062ad"}

{"id": "p_581d9d8016a638e1", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 18, "text": "魏將王雙率軍追亮，亮與戰，破之，斬雙，還漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "9af0612b2aca7251906887162c8e8d75ac8f4e079c34a4764c092d5a918524d2"}

{"id": "p_29cbdea9830349b3", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 19, "text": "七年春，亮遣陳式攻武都、陰平，遂克定二郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "113c9ca427c16b99a3f193a57606169571e00419bcc8f1743259a2a52dc2a488"}

{"id": "p_6ee564f2c3563688", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 20, "text": "冬，亮徙從府營於南山下原上，築漢、樂二城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "2da4133e5368eee487beebca3a5004e5c6050ecd282519f3cdd71e593ecc7278"}

{"id": "p_ebdb0d39f1263ec8", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 21, "text": "是歲，孫權稱帝，與蜀約盟，共交分天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "0e2ec8155736d06930402bc7a9451117c5f33ec925eac32e93f140a68427f9bf"}

{"id": "p_e548f0ef6086adfb", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 22, "text": "八年秋，魏使司馬懿由西城，張郃由子午，曹真由斜谷，欲攻漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "1e0446dc227f348402ea9e2963742387d0649cedd301eedd0f18e68dc9a6da5b"}

{"id": "p_1c3456b471e45fd1", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 23, "text": "丞相亮待之於城固、赤坂，大雨道絕，真等皆還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "799df3cb3f471a815368f44bfbacaa9949fb6008ccbf33718ff357046765e59a"}

{"id": "p_3281751c2e52661f", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 24, "text": "是歲，魏延破魏雍州剌史郭淮於陽溪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "ee33538692bdb2333ea48e172ee40598d26b34b2cf5031543866a9d56c2f9bbd"}

{"id": "p_62382887ccf384ab", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 25, "text": "徙魯王永為甘陵王，梁王理為安平王，皆以魯、梁在吳分界故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "588b1f5cb1db77bc0f6802191d427feff5498ac1b7ed3653777d0261a3150707"}

{"id": "p_3831db764b196943", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 26, "text": "九年春二月，亮復出軍圍祁山，始以木牛運。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "b86237024dbb4e7c052195da26de54812d914f6647b4f715059fcbe126c74946"}

{"id": "p_356c8e6428c79a3f", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 27, "text": "夏六月，亮糧盡退軍，郃追至青封，與亮交戰，被箭死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "28493b0db2b78c2ded5ebeb0a3a0a779fb65075a64265ab563c9923c8c09c260"}

{"id": "p_12949c9048422fe5", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 28, "text": "秋八月，都護李嚴廢徙梓潼郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "1620ec6f38a5512152af7e5151f94264f3c14d34b9ad42b8926306aec80260f2"}

{"id": "p_ae00bb4312aa6279", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 29, "text": "十年，亮休士勸農於黃沙，作流馬木牛畢，教兵講武。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "554721e4c49eb81cdc6297ae5f48c1546288f2c61d280e98cc6a8e220528aa0c"}

{"id": "p_18f14af82f5653d5", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 30, "text": "十一年冬，亮使諸軍運米，集於斜谷口，治斜谷邸閣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "66120d402bb80372ef6f8a195feb1c01565ee8b6fa098c0602b48c5365bda102"}

{"id": "p_4e147fe0651f7bcc", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 31, "text": "是歲，南夷劉冑反，將軍馬忠破平之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "5396ea68ad8e9093bb3f3c224ce2e74d9ab280234ea1ff7e8288f5180ef1c704"}

{"id": "p_48c31748e6b987af", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 32, "text": "十二年春二月，亮由斜谷出，始以流馬運。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "920839cbacff0e808bd74af27f7fed313749946697968c7da56454625ba6b630"}

{"id": "p_79534ef89d5a54e6", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 33, "text": "征西大將軍魏延與丞相長史楊儀爭權不和，舉兵相攻，延敗走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "d1c332662f7691f1b9de56e3058dc564337252130e5f1937130530b2cd395ed8"}

{"id": "p_6deadd7d1b122d1f", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 34, "text": "斬延首，儀率諸軍還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "5bb009aaecd29f469f158c80aa97c1a43021d4ee346e1ac169d0163959451a5b"}

{"id": "p_1326542965aba6b4", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 35, "text": "以左將軍吳壹為車騎將軍，假節督漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "88b765a5f053a608d060f489dfb19076c398c37ec95e92792d532b34321ccd4e"}

{"id": "p_7debbe52ede15841", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 36, "text": "以丞相留府長史蔣琬為尚書令，總統國事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "1e4a4c1252bff4f56033af604bf338840ca7550e50c95fc2a335ca952394d058"}

{"id": "p_aec118c6f43d6a49", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 37, "text": "十三年春正月，中軍師楊儀廢徙漢嘉郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "476aaf6de6397f9cb4140b14b5789b59eb60a3d35a7e03f88b290e9754f67785"}

{"id": "p_161fc72ecd0e0af5", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 38, "text": "夏四月，進蔣琬位為大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "d84af2d5a57225530098187b528bb6c9626f226a5dc900108b7071fc1a53e22b"}

{"id": "p_cc98bd74beefb280", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 39, "text": "十四年夏四月，後主至湔，登觀坂，看汶水之流，旬日還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "46e6aa15bc59c2d5a9a73ede61a4c364089171f301869526052585cb5484e880"}

{"id": "p_88b89ef4d8af0475", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 40, "text": "徙武都氐王苻健及氐民四百餘戶於成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "5e2c9f423eae2cacc4f19c40f0513e924796da87c0c2ce55d8e8d66f36638903"}

{"id": "p_088600bc6c72f6b7", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 41, "text": "十五年夏六月，皇后張氏薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "9839dbe00b78798da693e916b717ba6e28b18f0e8fcbbe9869c6e3c19e1762f7"}

{"id": "p_797d5eea1da0b3b9", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 42, "text": "立子睿為太子，子瑤為安定王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "276ce0cfa109b20b4e6c68ec386b9aef589a56d73b79635cee45070b30d4cdfc"}

{"id": "p_3188f319d585d502", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 43, "text": "冬十一月，大將軍蔣琬出屯漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "c9a15f4cd655d693c9858ba61b5b3f8e0b40110a4ee1a2982bd3552f2bfa285d"}

{"id": "p_ca93724d8f54cc32", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 44, "text": "二年春三月，進蔣琬位為大司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "a3b062213a8c10e14c1feddb972ea3355dc429193ed7737c81ff701722f91448"}

{"id": "p_e1867f68bffd8391", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 45, "text": "三年春，使越巂太守張嶷平定越巂郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "311da16dba7c0332dc3ca57d339b1bf3922cbd2844a425d3bea5d503fc25d5e8"}

{"id": "p_91598c967c792fca", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 46, "text": "四年冬十月，尚書令費禕至漢中，與蔣琬咨論事計，歲盡還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "f1b5f5c7e99b89723d335e880aef84f8ce39ea6d834aa238842d268eef8db68e"}

{"id": "p_e2e55cc4fe9252f5", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 47, "text": "五年春正月，監軍姜維督偏軍，自漢中還屯涪縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "446fd7009b978ceff4441cbecece85969c93011b02fcc93d3840fbb2088434c9"}

{"id": "p_a14b426848c04b88", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 48, "text": "六年冬十月，大司馬蔣琬自還漢中，住涪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "2f9fe06a8e38019f87ada6adcd52a0a6daf7e9d81537f48b4fdf82d5fcbc865b"}

{"id": "p_dc87006c11e19634", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 49, "text": "七年閏月，魏大將軍曹爽、夏侯玄等向漢中，鎮北大將軍王平拒興勢圍，大將軍費禕督諸軍往赴救，魏軍退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "43c9c89bc62b1b1bf12e8818fbdc600577c58c01e61e4531760faacaf5d6754b"}

{"id": "p_fb290bedfa822faa", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 50, "text": "十二月，大將軍費禕至漢中，行圍守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "15479ee568848c16f569d34d233e2f9bc1c0e1e27886900a947b63ccc05e0a03"}

{"id": "p_91fd8b7254b8d057", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 51, "text": "九年夏六月，費禕還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "e26247067e9664af58d07cc345625a187bd99a902b04657d33138edc1d0f3a78"}

{"id": "p_b493d611934e617b", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 52, "text": "冬十一月，大司馬蔣琬卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "c0d8c613914fa90d114a394cd8c04dbe0046387b5a963d47df6b4791407434c8"}

{"id": "p_c6e9855b08165209", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 53, "text": "十年，涼州胡王白虎文、治無戴等率眾降，衛將軍姜維迎逆安撫，居之於繁縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "cc1944c65b6a63596601411d2f4640d792889439a4de264425fa66ce5f308e54"}

{"id": "p_2fe18b2e6d4eee8a", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 54, "text": "是歲，汶山平康夷反，維往討，破平之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "517422e4fee39de4ecf945b6b22e41efbc5d0b579ec8dc9724994303137f19bf"}

{"id": "p_edb9ae44ba956fa7", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 55, "text": "十一年夏五月，大將軍費禕出屯漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "b53745b23d6a43706c81da8418ffd05f4e8dbb73563493287fcd9aca6e735465"}

{"id": "p_dd497751b3365d9f", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 56, "text": "秋，涪陵屬國民夷反，車騎將軍鄧芝往討，皆破平之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "92f8a61bd5a8fb897ad7367b278a9e0c1f5b3229354033bf85115b2d25501e2e"}

{"id": "p_50165ea3b43973cb", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 57, "text": "十二年春正月，魏誅大將軍曹爽等，右將軍夏侯霸來降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "11d78165ad3b7b2cd07274abbb2ab00f8d89f57eaa8041e84e050641960d7881"}

{"id": "p_405bb15d59c35d8e", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 58, "text": "秋，衛將軍姜維出攻雍州，不克而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "caffee10998713aef8bacba6e7a8afb2de13b5183642880e5c74dfcf32ceae04"}

{"id": "p_5db6f7c25105680f", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 59, "text": "十三年，姜維復出西平，不克而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "c3e065eb79a835f258451fc7cfeacee57216f337a89519e4d6d6948624739d17"}

{"id": "p_6ac986210e88b5ce", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 60, "text": "十四年夏，大將軍費禕還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "6d68db0dd1742537c348cf9284a20e5b1630965c8dfe7b37374ee240ad37b92c"}

{"id": "p_aca2c6a5366274b9", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 61, "text": "十六年春正月，大將軍費禕為魏降人郭循所殺於漢壽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "6b4b6ca4d150e947848841e05805bd53e788befb654da9d25c5155801f74ae50"}

{"id": "p_d4df9bacaf8a7dc9", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 62, "text": "夏四月，衛將軍姜維復率眾圍南安，不克而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "826a57ab2863abe2f57bf23df99bf0f64dcc0de2e934008fb7edf0af76dffa20"}

{"id": "p_0884fa2d496b74c8", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 63, "text": "十七年春正月，姜維還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "00cc3fd641f8f484808c9130cbf110da38626b7140e4298a1929c95771fbeb02"}

{"id": "p_a42b7e5452e7f045", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 64, "text": "夏六月，維復率眾出隴西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "f1a1ca9a408d40ae415dc27fcfe23c46a685b0889db6a12a954ba3fddf9897e1"}

{"id": "p_68a6b8be75c37ddc", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 65, "text": "冬，拔狄道、（河間）[河關]、臨洮三縣民，居於綿竹、繁縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "f2c81e6b60739318fe20a161920c6f1a3742f1ef99b70e6909b9a517e4f3ff59"}

{"id": "p_00c18c98e02fa3fe", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 66, "text": "夏，復率諸軍出狄道，與魏雍州剌史王經戰於洮西，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "c655553f2b3ed9140d29746c190cfd9d0b7ff879473ad4bc0d08c56cb4bebb05"}

{"id": "p_947d77f54781101c", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 67, "text": "經退保狄道城，維卻住鍾題。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "4e8de2b4f73cf793887ff3ea9b3e9b7c95aef8535f7c36a0ec27d902fe8d5f9e"}

{"id": "p_35755455acabfbbd", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 68, "text": "十九年春，進姜維位為大將軍，督戎馬，與鎮西將軍胡濟期會上邽，濟失誓不至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "4fbf1d7c5de3fe806106de1af8288df04773e10fb9e8eab7ab784f19ee992b29"}

{"id": "p_73db2fac565c3372", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 69, "text": "秋八月，維為魏大將軍鄧艾所破於上邽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "e3b5fc3c4068113a85439fe4d7227b2a19a7aab18aa4ba9a7f059c894036b11a"}

{"id": "p_984a9750634248f2", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 70, "text": "二十年，聞魏大將軍諸葛誕據壽春以叛，姜維復率眾出駱谷，至芒水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "26f57d88fc23bffdb47f8fd3167a7c4e7aabbd3650d0a96c5261745c61e0bf27"}

{"id": "p_e6e8986603933462", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 71, "text": "史官言景星見，於是大赦，改年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "45de35334247109b4ed6ca71264a16fda9e4d11c91b97ab0eda278bb9ae46760"}

{"id": "p_63175f0f7bf682b3", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 72, "text": "吳大將軍孫琳廢其主亮，立琅邪王休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "707067f2007b82fffa817a5bd63deef59d976a24fb912de5fa2e7ef9043d5eca"}

{"id": "p_5e4991e98d995bec", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 73, "text": "二年夏六月，立子諶為北地王，恂為新興王，虔為上黨王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "adcdf012bfc0e9f5c69868a600c529579ddaa9026790cff0f7504a5c44e43438"}

{"id": "p_78d5893c26a2dd2f", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 74, "text": "三年秋九月，追諡故將軍關羽、張飛、馬超、龐統、黃忠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "eacebb0dd83de776a6ca594f9d5c0a77004843d08321651289d0b759c22e0355"}

{"id": "p_44ee8547e29a87fc", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 75, "text": "四年春三月，追諡故將軍趙雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "05160b6563c95c143a73ad3247376d5e290a5d97e50bf220cae55a714deefe20"}

{"id": "p_101e3d57f36e5255", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 76, "text": "五年春正月，西河王琮卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "ee37dec9b34651b2ce5735a5a47be8b521ccd7c6a27945b0769f2daca8cfaa35"}

{"id": "p_776e82a4cd772d07", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 77, "text": "是歲，姜維復率眾出侯和，為鄧艾所破，還住沓中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "4c2d216ce17a084a1131696865fa984bdd5dde93e2b2b32b12612f800caa4cb1"}

{"id": "p_d2f393b05aa33526", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 78, "text": "六年夏，魏大興徒從眾，命征西將軍鄧艾、鎮西將軍鍾會、雍州剌史諸葛緒數道並攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "e99477488e33a9f042b4e760cee87ed859be38dd1e8a517a8dc2c651cd22c0db"}

{"id": "p_ed6820e37dc80c7d", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 79, "text": "於是遣左右車騎將軍張翼、廖化、輔國大將軍董厥等拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "f31413a08986d569c1df4cdd42bf257fd8bf2dcbd8ce997285787742bad8409c"}

{"id": "p_1aa4f4b71013183f", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 80, "text": "冬，鄧艾破衛將軍諸葛瞻於綿竹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "d38efc2af87760ad83cdc21a7c48b16daa3fb20ddd576968971a77d4f80b19fd"}

{"id": "p_cba371d087c26957", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 81, "text": "用光祿大夫譙周策，降於艾，奉書曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "9035459068f0e52a5c98878066f5058604a573314b8139cd67ef22e260ef013c"}

{"id": "p_0410e12157323437", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 82, "text": "是日，北地王諶傷國之亡，先殺妻子，次以自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "6ee57d1044a5bc6240ed41c3eecdb28c7b121d95fa7b69a86d94a3031c2796f4"}

{"id": "p_1b81cbf27c29d356", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 83, "text": "艾得書，大喜，即報書，遣紹良先還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "4afac4beabf84cccca95091f012c624f19d1c9626406cc9f7fcadc137c2e912a"}

{"id": "p_45ebc9026bd3ed8e", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 84, "text": "艾至城北，後主興櫬自縛，詣軍壘門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "80a9d80db3cb97eddfb795a2080070e8298204af90aeb490261a0aaa5f87bb2b"}

{"id": "p_e9bb7ed158369c97", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 85, "text": "因承製拜後主為驃騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "d4083f8c9f7e3f3ff1c6dfe910cf6c88ffe7c2034b63bc83e65cca43d37b3656"}

{"id": "p_b7a03194bc8061cc", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 86, "text": "諸圍守悉被後主敕，然後降下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "cd4e20d0dc7a73d9329b370cae042579f2f6dfe940a8d9218f3d4954d4e27a4a"}

{"id": "p_2d8fce9edf97e403", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 87, "text": "艾使後主止其故宮，身往造焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "55198efaa5a2c490b158d42b5db659eccb21c0113a7a78747894fc9814ee366b"}

{"id": "p_b6658a099020440c", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 88, "text": "資嚴未發，明年春正月，艾見收。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "0d6b769cc552887810029243cf0a49f789f02e7a5d3e3f935590f80f13267da3"}

{"id": "p_138011371693aad8", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 89, "text": "會既死，蜀中軍眾鈔略，死喪狼籍，數日乃安集。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "43070f7ceee68b36ea33b56490281a6d1defe50217a9960158f85ba76445407b"}

{"id": "p_e4f7e4267a71917a", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 90, "text": "後主舉家東遷，既至洛陽，策命之曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "19e6b500fbaa4dcd48496f733aa21c14d55306b1bbc8ed4c9be1e502c4cd9dd0"}

{"id": "p_9ee001bb0058ffbc", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 91, "text": ": 惟三月丁亥，皇帝臨軒，使太常嘉命劉禪為安樂縣公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "5781fc4a769f399d10b437553e79ffed53400b3fc715582557d293cfe31fdf10"}

{"id": "p_90196a179379dde4", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 92, "text": "蓋統天載物，以咸寧為大，光宅天下，以時雍為盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "b65fb3da463227bfb4d8504c9a92bcad84f0223a8087224778f911d691684a69"}

{"id": "p_7b389b26584244bb", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 93, "text": "故孕育群生者，君人之道也，乃順承天者，坤元之義也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "7747c4b1af93acacaa6f68d67541a4ecdf12220e39b1ea0caa232e258cb75c9d"}

{"id": "p_241fed42e1012102", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 94, "text": "上下交暢，然後萬物協和，庶類獲乿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "bb84aa27bfbe69139e124bc040ff576fe8f0a8213aac6e789d13e9e57d539487"}

{"id": "p_f0c961e8a255a699", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 95, "text": "乃者漢氏失統，六合震擾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "9b644e5e6698ce665b905035c0bc245690ec0f0d750fba8261cb2e247ef5af6b"}

{"id": "p_aa0cc4ab06c37c75", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 96, "text": "我太祖承運龍興，弘濟八極，是用應天順民，撫有區夏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "ec000325745d1dbe2fa1c42274ab8f3bde8ecdbf37331067c7a3e2310b258ff2"}

{"id": "p_48db56212bd0b6a0", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 97, "text": "於時乃考因群傑虎爭，九服不靜，乘間阻遠，保據庸蜀，遂使西隅殊封，方外壅隔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "cb6d0f8e7fd87cbfebf570fe24240367af7c324bf51dac5bbeb6a6d036631156"}

{"id": "p_15b5a53b25f119df", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 98, "text": ": 自是以來，干戈不戢，元元之民，不得保安其性，幾將五紀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "99c1cf4c12d500af7cb7c22abff4ec23fb3c3d08c2e4ebf493623080d365160d"}

{"id": "p_0db8a51e9a7e1435", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 99, "text": "朕永惟祖考遺志，思在綏緝四海，率土同軌，故爰整六師，耀威梁、益。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "bd6f3800d25ab7126b4c767382ec7d08b99bbb0be9a3d6b3ce760cee4917988d"}

{"id": "p_96d8be6092c311fb", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 100, "text": "公恢崇德度，深秉大正，不憚屈身委質，以愛民全國為貴，降心回慮，應機豹變，覆信思順，以享左右無疆之休，豈不遠歟！", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "94c61b44c335fb6abc75746e30d72bd56ebe8a41f891a6f01f6cd703ba0500aa"}

{"id": "p_8fe970bb845d366c", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 101, "text": "朕嘉與君公長饗顯祿，用考咨前訓，開國胙土，率遵舊典，錫茲玄牡，苴以白茅，永為魏藩輔，往欽哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "f990c6d988e42855cefb1acba5df456d2c4ea24ea18af216b37037f3e783bd77"}

{"id": "p_0dddecc8033eec3e", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 102, "text": "公其只服朕命，克廣德心，以終乃顯烈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "52a81dec039cff98c2e4840894a336a3ff9c578869cbeb578b93f59c5b9ce7a6"}

{"id": "p_5dd313105ccfd5c6", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 103, "text": "食邑萬戶，賜絹萬匹，奴婢百人，他物稱是。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "49f3e6ee15fbf2d53a92b74f7a9f5e447e3d1adc8f59ea608bff0d8b42402e45"}

{"id": "p_cb69d67f9ba897a0", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 104, "text": "子孫為三都尉封侯者五十餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "3f5aabf42f90410c392516a0ae4829a552e1be683c94c0593404e22713676756"}

{"id": "p_c8207ad247abce21", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 105, "text": "尚書令樊建、侍中張紹、光祿大夫譙周、秘書令卻正、殿中督張通並封列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "892f91764e41b943784403fcc1f074ebe434f2427d79f6b1a30ab2f4ed419981"}

{"id": "p_f6f0b41994a1e381", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 106, "text": ":評曰：後主任賢相則為循理之君，惑閹堅則為昏暗之後，傳曰『素絲無常，唯所染之』，信矣哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "16dad23ca6dd62ebd1e5a22f0452c3e97c1b42b2e2e527198599ad6b4a732fa1"}

{"id": "p_e2fbaf6cdc41d58e", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 107, "text": "禮，國君繼體，逾年改元，而章武之三年，則革稱建興，考之古義，體理為違。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "7dc467a8c57af70a6c91b8e609c66de3c0b7e6ae711b95ba3cde99f44f0743eb"}

{"id": "p_a43cc9d521be4aac", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 108, "text": "又國不置史，注記無官，是以行事多遺，災異靡書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "3b26a1460482af85cdcba105c7e2f55e49765643914eb650b1f60e9e75ccc916"}

{"id": "p_73395f10d0fd5394", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 109, "text": "諸葛亮雖達於為政，凡此之類，猶有未周焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "0ba81e004cba41f1490d06b05af53577d5a00430f8e9d7821efc9cb309734290"}

{"id": "p_75aaa42e5cbaf164", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 110, "text": "然經載十二而年名不易，軍旅屢興而赦不妄下，不亦卓乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "d0a574b133588221cc05f3f61f8064abb352f37007f45c80e2681a0de6f3da1d"}

{"id": "p_8dc2269452b5c4c3", "source_id": "src_aad55ef47efe0680", "ordinal": 111, "text": "自亮沒後，茲制漸虧，優劣著矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "4bc45ff19259fd8166fc6512560cd421f4c3522ea930efc8002d5c9dc29b1a93"}

{"id": "p_21ab126e313fc747", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_5ecf19a91b18195e", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 1, "text": "先主臨豫州，住小沛，納以為妾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "026c0987ced0e7998f52cc2d9ffd8f664e540b633b51c252ffc35d0bfc646445"}

{"id": "p_85ef3aa38a3e122e", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 2, "text": "先主數喪嫡室，常攝內事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "63ea72128a7798ac59b81e50a7e50f8b004654d50dc7e920ff44e00b50720ca6"}

{"id": "p_e3ad9c8984061e5b", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 3, "text": "值曹公軍至，追及先主於當陽長阪，於時困偪，棄-{后}-及後主，賴趙雲保護，得免於難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "4f74f0d98f6e3f94a5e30adb65a6bfd011de4f0a61f7449abf40e0a3a6e2b2ba"}

{"id": "p_ce990de46f64525d", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 4, "text": "，追諡皇思夫人，遷葬於蜀，未至而先主殂隕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "8ce46e87582b25f5de7e8f77ff96f9523cbc27aa9a01267b798fd50563753887"}

{"id": "p_6b07ac61b982e20e", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 5, "text": "兄吳壹，少孤，壹父素與劉焉有舊，是以舉家隨焉入蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "843d26f1d2e7dd5039b9edcd70c3c80cad5d60a03617f5e18bdde48b1d7b1ae0"}

{"id": "p_ca69c9478e480a54", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 6, "text": "焉有異志，而聞善相者相-{后}-當大貴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "1a23ef6aaa7f6729b7e767ced5afc522633b2d12549ab2c02412633f0e707847"}

{"id": "p_f5953c8b84b29ac1", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 7, "text": "焉時將子瑁自隨，遂為瑁納-{后}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "4af53da5152c73ce517e0326f9d4a36adf9397fdf26564b29d3cf75cbe576ea6"}

{"id": "p_fe652ac28a0ddffb", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 8, "text": "先主既定益州，而孫夫人還吳，群下勸先主聘-{后}-，先主疑與瑁同族，法正進曰：「論其親疏，何與晉文之於子圉乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "386eb35d0c6b7ac6a86979dbc929413dbb5a1ab4833f796b9defe1c79d616428"}

{"id": "p_b4552745c2b0359d", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」於是納-{后}-為夫人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "0a6654fd56d0b1d8cdc89c91ad18b9f5b4a77baf9bc346dac68a3b6d805e3287"}

{"id": "p_99801d10f9569303", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 10, "text": "夏五月，策曰：「朕承天命，奉至尊，臨萬國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "80a14e7ba6f6740867e25568deaba7787f7b112ff79e4d08dc513d59ff2f51ac"}

{"id": "p_34666ac10b1c11a3", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 11, "text": "今以-{后}-為皇后，遣使持節丞相亮授璽綬，承宗廟，母天下，皇后其敬之哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "deca22f4cb36a51c1869b363180d01d13cb4e23d42b9e10250747d1604f7eaf0"}

{"id": "p_b8fe55c8bf43a29d", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」五月，後主即位，尊-{后}-為皇太后，稱長樂宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "f2677a11864fed3ecaa41b3270aae0e8183ef5b93e0c3d5337407adcbf4db543"}

{"id": "p_272324e84c95f570", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 14, "text": "，-{后}-薨，合葬惠陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "b3625e05695ec10a76bf2dd5b8b273f9bf8ec7668cd5b909c63dca602094e6e0"}

{"id": "p_35b45e45849e78fb", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 15, "text": "後主敬哀皇后，車騎將軍張飛長女也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "2c6ea5847a40ff6fbfee77d6af0110b42c5943d82588f350ce677cb6977b3b0c"}

{"id": "p_eee9aa0121f9cca5", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 16, "text": "後主張皇后，前-{后}-敬哀之妹也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "08e894c6465e8040e7d764655e151de5a5305782bc0c29a08983cbd070524030"}

{"id": "p_7388485d6996c271", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 17, "text": "春正月，策曰：「朕統承大業，君臨天下，奉郊廟社稷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "455c6f9db96bd3249d5f97da347615bd5a45797841dce55cc96dc126d3c283ef"}

{"id": "p_11a1fde384ed7c02", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 18, "text": "今以貴人為皇后，使行丞相事左將軍向朗持節授璽綬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "4b9d3b279bcc82769d025c0f5fed26edcf6474f4bb5ec61ed407aa4b07288957"}

{"id": "p_507e6d97bd8cdb18", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 19, "text": "勉脩中饋，恪肅禋祀，皇后其敬之哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "d61e3d614bd0126c55de39fbdef6bcf4a0daa1d40703629fa7c1e9067dffa3c4"}

{"id": "p_4fcbfa1d7c4fd16d", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 20, "text": "劉永字公壽，先主子，後主庶弟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "a729dc302706502ccc4c487182daa74a7a182b3475a4369393f2603aedae2fd1"}

{"id": "p_60d37164e3d6fe08", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 21, "text": "六月，使司徒靖立永為魯王，策曰：「小子永，受茲青土。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "8663066e5473f26aab7d61b0f419fecdc78ec9f807eba6f5bc3a2bd59b318ec6"}

{"id": "p_17af1ad7654f17e9", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 22, "text": "朕承天序，繼統大業，遵脩稽古，建爾國家，封於東土，奄有龜蒙，世為籓輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "c971eca266a4ce8c8041d60ad71c3eaf3754db4f3287912c879feb6a5e58ba0c"}

{"id": "p_52e80ef20f98f8db", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 23, "text": "惟彼魯邦，一變適道，風化存焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "5b7450afaadaf7db34d3d795100b597fd7f06714951bd699b04f99b40b0b5052"}

{"id": "p_5056dbc4981dc6d1", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 24, "text": "王其秉心率禮，綏爾士民，是饗是宜，其戒之哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "6dc57ecbbec1249e2c4cf8d69d807069e77092d282eb1900cff9d481214376ac"}

{"id": "p_7eed9e76c5e3e495", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 25, "text": "初，永憎宦人黃皓，皓既信任用事，譖構永於後主，後主稍疏外永，至不得朝見者十餘年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "4b7c6ff6573636554357d58a4873264fe0de79ee31b44f1dc9eebd9f42731bc9"}

{"id": "p_8ac912e67d0e7998", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 26, "text": "，永東遷洛陽，拜奉車都尉，封為鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "96bfff7c85c8d2d9aa319cd9f22300d7207e96e540028a192150e90c9e773738"}

{"id": "p_35d52036a398f759", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 27, "text": "劉理字奉孝，亦後主庶弟也，與永異母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "b3ea2444473b6f21514667e8b2b0c596ae1c822ae1220eaef13a96b92e1b3332"}

{"id": "p_29621eb57fee255e", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 28, "text": "六月，使司徒靖立理為梁王，策曰：「小子理，朕統承漢序，祗順天命，遵脩典秩，建爾於東，為漢籓輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "83b470ca5df173d8ff69c9ed8c062c20842d1fa5da27c496a46478250193c597"}

{"id": "p_87181ad0bbf9cc02", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 29, "text": "惟彼梁土，畿甸之邦，民狎教化，易導以禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "d3b2ea97fa2ed9c17fb5bf32b2d35116d8c12acbd8372743b482f450efbdfdb1"}

{"id": "p_9b3b357b5f389503", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 30, "text": "往悉乃心，懷保黎庶，以永爾國，王其敬之哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "ca773cbc2ebdd2009c97aac2547e5e86f7571854c357dcde84454269e8768d83"}

{"id": "p_1c4f86387bd7f9fa", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 31, "text": "詔曰：「安平王，先帝所命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "be4bc47f7af3f1c478b20cad29ea0c5623b85727e4b5fd4f8da2a93335a65b16"}

{"id": "p_86e6de128288ffed", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 32, "text": "三世早夭，國嗣頹絕，朕用傷悼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "a9972938422e05f6fe3cc823e79aedc8fd556e96a47802c0f39bd4ba6333b8a2"}

{"id": "p_f247a22d2af38a93", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」輯，理子也，，東遷洛陽，拜奉車都尉，封鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "b300f6a19057c6c50968cf41d83e225c6f90447a046098af7caa076ea00db3b1"}

{"id": "p_69b8b33e2d89f2fb", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 34, "text": "母王貴人，本敬哀張皇后侍人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "d95a191c3589743eca371a91776df36798507435311eb38a1cd2e2f38c1c4d2b"}

{"id": "p_0e7cacaeb6b3b7a3", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 35, "text": "正月策曰：「在昔帝王，繼體立嗣，副貳國統，古今常道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "380dff8785138a5241bf868894aef13f8286e99fda170f47a0778d33c9d1825e"}

{"id": "p_7cfcabf06a2b3618", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 36, "text": "今以璿為皇太子，昭顯祖宗之威，命使行丞相事左將軍朗持節授印緩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "dba502b04589362310536961a1ccc743f5dbfdb8fb12ae1192c2c40073db3b03"}

{"id": "p_1d83b04d5aa9d090", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 37, "text": "其勉脩茂質，祗恪道義，諮詢典禮，敬友師傅，斟酌眾善，翼成爾德，可不務脩以自勗哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "c538c8f71f58b5eb289c44879ae3503a5e2593f24bbea3a5016696d2c0ee911a"}

{"id": "p_1e5256d691afee75", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 38, "text": "正月，鍾會作亂於成都，璿為亂兵所害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "c279059f265af770c182509cc23dc4f8c5e423fb7ec27da22639373fabd28211"}

{"id": "p_1fb70fd386084979", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 39, "text": "評曰：《易》稱有夫婦然後有父子，夫人倫之始，恩紀之隆，莫尚於此矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "9da2a6ca2da3f0a8133b2675673db1ac3eb90eb09c52ccaccc4e061a38dc8141"}

{"id": "p_566810987a348389", "source_id": "src_033e5925db32e682", "ordinal": 40, "text": "是故紀錄，以究一國之體焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "a4af8fc46d1d6973bbf9d23f86788543a0e13cbd2466333b44f451c7f01d6c82"}

{"id": "p_e7c2477357483772", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_187206d20df20968", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 1, "text": "諸葛亮字孔明，琅邪陽都人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "5dbc19a5012ff1bb7cf206da66f6fa3a2989c3deb395678f1894189dda4cc4d0"}

{"id": "p_ef0638dbaac3d7b2", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 2, "text": "父圭，字君貢，漢末為太山郡丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "5aa5dcfa865c863058d9d7facb8eed4bf50ec3923cd56846f785628748756738"}

{"id": "p_61fb3d5b8ad6738f", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 3, "text": "亮早孤，從父玄為袁術所署豫章太守，玄將亮及亮弟均之官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "76188e19fca94e64bd0bca42d254ef99e39b6e0f6d015f10f8951be57e86938a"}

{"id": "p_619e4afcdf58adb5", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 4, "text": "玄素與荊州牧劉表有舊，往依之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "049d85612433335fb43bebb3d3489070564e458ae8f7de511845d7f473d3c53c"}

{"id": "p_078708b2a5dfd438", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 5, "text": "玄卒，亮躬畊隴畝，好為《梁父吟》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "6196dd80ec5d5bcaf9ff49fe52e7046588fdb8b26aa679b1a92225faeaed5f44"}

{"id": "p_f08551921a827cd1", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 6, "text": "身長八尺，每自比於管仲、樂毅，時人莫之許也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "090204f5cf6936c50baa99ade973e90b562fc2de5058d863001c93641029661b"}

{"id": "p_7f2c438c085eba27", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 7, "text": "惟博陵崔州平、潁川徐庶元直與亮友善，謂為信然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "4ea4cb06cf21bc63a74040178a3b81d7b518c26351024d1d6dd97bfbedbf73f8"}

{"id": "p_2bfdc41b55464e88", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 8, "text": "徐庶見先主，先主器之，謂先主曰：「諸葛孔明者，臥龍也，將軍豈願見之乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "2dc92d9573a16b5a48fd4da87f4f3a31ccb8ae09a746de9fdb6458b8c7a5df22"}

{"id": "p_fbdc80a1a7ffc336", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」庶曰：「此人可就見，不可屈致也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "54d2c9304005e1f783e312fd4fc172f70728a40ca9a223f06bb85c4e70987c72"}

{"id": "p_e81fa4d767046d74", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」由是先主遂詣亮，凡三往，乃見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "702286620b491377a466ccf5f6ea70cf018eaa9cb17deeaf11d3804b34c9fb45"}

{"id": "p_82d8c04f0155fac2", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 11, "text": "因屏人曰：「漢室傾頹，姦臣竊命，主上蒙塵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "5d4e0d8c0240d1f9fcbbe1481b7422d8ff8ddcc99c69490964781aea378af13a"}

{"id": "p_528f06f90d7f44d0", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 12, "text": "孤不度德量力，欲信大義於天下，而智術淺短，遂用猖（獗）〔蹶〕，至于今日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "6df7b4d8de8acc84148bb601658009a5b7921c083314804a6e38832ff73a7956"}

{"id": "p_8203b0e65080403a", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 13, "text": "然志猶未已，君謂計將安出？", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "1189a12f064e961a44dbb474cc7a6dda45c163cf106e389b437298bcf0bf431f"}

{"id": "p_d4dc24355f352d12", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」亮答曰：「自董卓已來，豪傑并起，跨州連郡者不可勝數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "ea33eec7090d3ae6e5b17365ec318cdc345ccaad16ea9c19512e1bdac3e788e1"}

{"id": "p_537fca67c73b448e", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 15, "text": "曹操比於袁紹，則名微而眾寡，然操遂能克紹，以弱為強者，非惟天時，抑亦人謀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "f53dd9f0f4d43594637958445cc7f02bf8826d212001ff0840650ca1015f6b2b"}

{"id": "p_40c2bcda7a455f40", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 16, "text": "今操已擁百萬之眾，挾天子而令諸侯，此誠不可與爭鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "269b6431f2ddc8ba03265fef40badacc953adaf9aa055287f3861be5e66fdb1b"}

{"id": "p_459690379f44d51f", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 17, "text": "孫權據有江東，已歷三世，國險而民附，賢能為之用，此可以為援而不可圖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "945b51c377bb8b0cb2f53e27a131017e8e621fe20a5726a7a53f480efa139284"}

{"id": "p_b9f1e367c5ba5983", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 18, "text": "荊州北據漢、沔，利盡南海，東連吳會，西通巴、蜀，此用武之國，而其主不能守，此殆天所以資將軍，將軍豈有意乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "ecc126784d6c4f1cc332fc678228c9fd34dd6fe79074492efa846f7eb6699ad1"}

{"id": "p_dd364f10ce98de85", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 19, "text": "益州險塞，沃野千里，天府之土，高祖因之以成帝業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "1104d676d7aee728bb5b1fa20dd407209e0042d90c7f6a950234ce8cadcd1b30"}

{"id": "p_182408c56b635478", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 20, "text": "劉璋闇弱，張魯在北，民殷國富而不知存恤，智能之士思得明君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "6b251d1e80505404bc45755726f635b64a885d034248da543e54a315c02ef458"}

{"id": "p_52961de280b7d52f", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 21, "text": "將軍既帝室之冑，信義著於四海，總攬英雄，思賢如渴，若跨有荊、益，保其巖阻，西和諸戎，南撫夷越，外結好孫權，內修政理；天下有變，則命一上將將荊州之軍以向宛、洛，將軍身率益州之眾出於秦川，百姓孰敢不簞食壺漿以迎將軍者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "e38228c4e26dae365a984bf28d93d6e9731bc95a5b6e665fe0e6849914a4b9f3"}

{"id": "p_92a36c718b8ad09f", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 22, "text": "誠如是，則霸業可成，漢室可興矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "33f59f3daef35f466e6ebae1f29e897f4bbed0077843cda34fe8d0a56a78b9fb"}

{"id": "p_c3ff894c0d7741f6", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 23, "text": "關羽、張飛等不悅，先主解之曰：「孤之有孔明，猶魚之有水也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "9d5604299414882cf5c20d693a0a20e5dcb346872976d9fc6fdfe1a56198f965"}

{"id": "p_052b716b08eeddc1", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 24, "text": "表受後妻之言，愛少子琮，不悅於琦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "d967844a49b9daac3df46abf37a47ec6d00b83c7f9f1f3e82a7ef7da9dced480"}

{"id": "p_493310db2329332f", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 25, "text": "琦每欲與亮謀自安之術，亮輒拒塞，未與處畫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "0418eace16f900f9a11253113a4ebd409766665f370ddc1141be1d69a21ba692"}

{"id": "p_d46da646305d330e", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 26, "text": "琦乃將亮游觀後園，共上高樓，飲宴之間，令人去梯，因謂亮曰：「今日上不至天，下不至地，言出子口，入於吾耳，可以言不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "226965db3ed0c68f0578a1805e62e5ff27c803b8b449d7dc9722466f56f197ba"}

{"id": "p_c36a4f12722ef560", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」亮答曰：「君不見申生在內而危，重耳在外而安乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "d026dc24e80a0a4b7ac91960f573125b9bdd94a3618c36540c07be86a7332996"}

{"id": "p_9dbfdd35a6173fbf", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 28, "text": "會黃祖死，得出，遂為江夏太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "d8ce07a1387d23c0eb8082a1f7e1a6c8d3eeda20f19d62570d7952fb11762bb4"}

{"id": "p_0c73a448b37e92c0", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 29, "text": "俄而表卒，琮聞曹公來征，遣使請降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "6f57d77b688a0059c38c6532a580f6b4403f199bd1fd7d900044fc46ae5b8542"}

{"id": "p_302cc3aa5cad7508", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 30, "text": "先主在樊聞之，率其眾南行，亮與徐庶并從，為曹公所追破，獲庶母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "c99793b2ac12221a5c3d7672660c6a75d2673887a82c2a64347f8cd981a73c60"}

{"id": "p_a205c7b5eb7d66cd", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 31, "text": "庶辭先主而指其心曰：「本欲與將軍共圖王霸之業者，以此方寸之地也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "9a5ddd1479958c38891aca742e8e67620df4ad0d53c9fcf8d9d813f2d6f9b54a"}

{"id": "p_5f2030698f9e8f36", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 32, "text": "今已失老母，方寸亂矣，無益於事，請從此別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "8d14351b8eb3f4a5bc8ce6af1885222b4a448df6f7c3854cac2b0de2cc3b9150"}

{"id": "p_41f687ec790346f0", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 33, "text": "先主至於夏口，亮曰：「事急矣，請奉命求救於孫將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "0d1ef26920c5aab5370d814cb51ee14fdbf672619b0616a4068136c5248a1f56"}

{"id": "p_4f76a1d96d283bb8", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 34, "text": "」時權擁軍在柴桑，觀望成敗，亮說權曰：「海內大亂，將軍起兵據有江東，劉豫州亦收眾漢南，與曹操并爭天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "58ca4d01b539f01d4828b9206632e69873176e6840e9d830c068b64820deb677"}

{"id": "p_91ae0a158baf199f", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 35, "text": "今操芟夷大難，略已平矣，遂破荊州，威震四海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "8567d5f30d91c39d622cc28b6d637e638f3e653675181f40af9c7662bdf39331"}

{"id": "p_492cc707883ae075", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 36, "text": "英雄無所用武，故豫州遁逃至此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "8188bce7467ea14fd832f57ae836d1d545cbe86783c01e866e3a8a58ea7bca83"}
