{"id": "p_55ae02460a0e35cf", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 37, "text": "將軍量力而處之：若能以吳、越之眾與中國抗衡，不如早與之絕﹔若不能當，何不案兵束甲，北面而事之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "74da8ff003a7a67894537e98714d9da7119ab7bd3126edc2e1017105a961c511"}

{"id": "p_05d2ff5a0a872802", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 38, "text": "今將軍外託服從之名，而內懷猶豫之計，事急而不斷，禍至無日矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "ee52e772b7b5ca4315fcfba7ef3d37192b0cb8aa8d24c8da4a41cfac82bf2306"}

{"id": "p_6c0a5239398836de", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」權曰：「苟如君言，劉豫州何不遂事之乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "1b9966889991d9bf1841ad01557371ae5ab7271ff6ea5a4d72730d755dd2c604"}

{"id": "p_fde5713bf1167c57", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」亮曰：「田橫，齊之壯士耳，猶守義不辱，況劉豫州王室之冑，英才蓋世，眾士仰慕，若水之歸海，若事之不濟，此乃天也，安能復為之下乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "ea625800e6d3138d904996ffffe7256349ffb28397d1cecfb777c4051ba16b14"}

{"id": "p_e5ad289381096713", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 41, "text": "」權勃然曰：「吾不能舉全吳之地，十萬之眾，受制於人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "25c489e637d1cde0dc5ff21a5c25cafacfe43684fe0636afaa089a07256ab50a"}

{"id": "p_129dcd06af22f17c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 42, "text": "非劉豫州莫可以當曹操者，然豫州新敗之後，安能抗此難乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "741b9ce1ca16af0a790fc84a022b44a7cfd5c047688fccae14fc774957bbdf24"}

{"id": "p_e6bc271ee2acbf74", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 43, "text": "」亮曰：「豫州軍雖敗於長阪，今戰士還者及關羽水軍精甲萬人，劉琦合江夏戰士亦不下萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "8ef6e5c5033c126f8b0bd7ad8b0dd0d76e7d377b37c5c7202b60926635656cbf"}

{"id": "p_f846c6ebd4d82439", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 44, "text": "曹操之眾，遠來疲弊，聞追豫州，輕騎一日一夜行三百餘里，此所謂『彊弩之末，勢不能穿魯縞』者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "d4032e186a0fdd46d567c0d99c728767710f9684965fb4eafddc9c294fa3dc7d"}

{"id": "p_db6c56e381ea33b5", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 45, "text": "故兵法忌之，曰『必蹶上將軍』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "1170f705240c496e64501de6f795a76cec12b356ace15b453dfea97fa607eecd"}

{"id": "p_fea51111b660fdc7", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 46, "text": "且北方之人，不習水戰﹔又荊州之民附操者，逼兵勢耳，非心服也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "b103d67fd4f4d7d1677fde47e4fbe675caceedb5a71c33089aafcbaf2a678098"}

{"id": "p_1c588848a71fbcff", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 47, "text": "今將軍誠能命猛將統兵數萬，與豫州協規同力，破操軍必矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "9cc8d55d382cf40f560b32046297312360b266e86a852538fe0f5c82f119d2b5"}

{"id": "p_ee803c42c939b167", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 48, "text": "操軍破，必北還，如此則荊、吳之勢彊，鼎足之形成矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "ab9324e1026a1b13af4fd990508521e35978e2f8c1270daa78cb5033d6ed5731"}

{"id": "p_89b1761b29a07ddb", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 49, "text": "」權大悅，即遣周瑜、程普、魯肅等水軍三萬，隨亮詣先主，并力拒曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "793fe46ea9041cc37f5d0274a412203536c970ad734b872c0862e02e1c4c44b0"}

{"id": "p_a9281d94962c66fd", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 50, "text": "曹公敗於赤壁，引軍歸鄴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "845880c6bdbdad20007099fa418103bf073689a14f61f74f2657bf9bc558b2e4"}

{"id": "p_3af54653b80e55ed", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 51, "text": "先主遂收江南，以亮為軍師中郎將，使督零陵、桂陽、長沙三郡，調其賦稅，以充軍實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "5918ba3ec73c7c4739e6ce77086cdf669535b37c8e65faeebbbb893b1fd6ce31"}

{"id": "p_6785c9a0a31fdd75", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 52, "text": "，益州牧劉璋遣法正迎先主，使擊張魯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "b02aec83d3c9189d303c888632f106a14259004451298afb2f379be4576610bf"}

{"id": "p_73ec2932187a0920", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 53, "text": "先主自葭萌還攻璋，亮與張飛、趙雲等率眾泝江，分定郡縣，與先主共圍成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "f4860af4fb4d44a12ec0a4c7421f71ef9690d1a0b242ceb058657ab301fe49be"}

{"id": "p_dae5765b2bd2b9d0", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 54, "text": "成都平，以亮為軍師將軍，署左將軍府事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "4c991e0cbaaa32b929cd3616e6f17538c10d7aec0cfc60deb90ebb7cce7947b9"}

{"id": "p_437f1b7c49d48cae", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 55, "text": "先主外出，亮常鎮守成都，足食足兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "33f4e41370dc5c25ebce2450dbfcf4fa23ca4ca607f5998faba65758da031d84"}

{"id": "p_d9ba5f699bd687ef", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 56, "text": "二十六年，群下勸先主稱尊號，先主未許，亮說曰：「昔吳漢、耿弇等初勸世祖即帝位，世祖辭讓，前後數四，耿純進言曰：『天下英雄喁喁，冀有所望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "6e0b86e778e4593cea51a39ae858a5e50fbe3c53efca823d8635bcaa2677b15f"}

{"id": "p_dccea8387c10989c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 57, "text": "如不從議者，士大夫各歸求主，無為從公也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "1bb5f223ad9ab50827562d9f42646ec3e3f4efa2764355e3fa38115bc292b4a3"}

{"id": "p_2f05926f376dbe5a", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 58, "text": "』世祖感純言深至，遂然諾之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "c29d2601cc1d0b767adebb7f7082f8293f6f9da8b4c2a74469e6df27a60b0282"}

{"id": "p_9134843fd15068bd", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 59, "text": "今曹氏篡漢，天下無主，大王劉氏苗族，紹世而起，今即帝位，乃其宜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "53637c6350179f285f4ecc6b2d3f6018f238e1b9638267e6dbec2643c730ced8"}

{"id": "p_c388d21bb88070f9", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 60, "text": "士大夫隨大王久勤苦者，亦欲望尺寸之功如純言耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "ad666ccdcf668e10b3d20f08f0d32bb3897fa75868c838d984e183280b75693c"}

{"id": "p_65b489ad8ab5b0ba", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」先主於是即帝位，策亮為丞相曰：「朕遭家不造，奉承大統，兢兢業業，不敢康寧，思靖百姓，懼未能綏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "0155370bfd8602aaba27407ae65883c24681fd9138dca0e60f9b75d751644f7a"}

{"id": "p_865b026aa9e7ca4c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 62, "text": "丞相亮其悉朕意，無怠輔朕之闕，助宣重光，以照明天下，君其勖哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "a7bd7ba8ea285ddd950db3af171f96ec01cc35f992425e50e40e1827c2dbd893"}

{"id": "p_d3c548605028e92c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」亮以丞相錄尚書事，假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "11feebba4d14397bde7b3d12c5194f9ce1fec51a7e320bd8b40a0173f4dfddb2"}

{"id": "p_8335e9f20872d2f8", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 64, "text": "春，先主於永安病篤，召亮於成都，屬以後事，謂亮曰：「君才十倍曹丕，必能安國，終定大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "f0d3095a43916691a01af55d183c5b6fa5e11cc9cd9425e73a7221cc54877f83"}

{"id": "p_863f7008c13bbacb", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 65, "text": "若嗣子可輔，輔之；如其不才，君可自取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "776474fb11274427071eada18c4276404f788ff632f82a2e5458796fb2c8bbad"}

{"id": "p_2b945c53ceba4271", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 66, "text": "」亮涕泣曰：「臣敢竭股肱之力，效忠貞之節，繼之以死！", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "f6006d31aef56e2ebcf77ca3555d5335b8a610364f41bd7cd4399e2752da44f6"}

{"id": "p_6b7148912247332d", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 67, "text": "」先主又為詔敕後主曰：「汝與丞相從事，事之如父。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "e6fcd510903d07360422452719a18adb2ada00c10f43c71c55e793bbb458e560"}

{"id": "p_420f1ccd132cd7ab", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 68, "text": "，封亮武鄉侯，開府治事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "31168cd847ca94351b95418bd1ae52fbca86353f0d16a3ac5f402f53f855525a"}

{"id": "p_8cd2ad8337f63599", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 69, "text": "南中諸郡，并皆叛亂，亮以新遭大喪，故未便加兵，且遣使聘吳，因結和親，遂為與國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "052de898312801e0691acc7c3288e4b6f1a39f1055ed8477651536fe8780d111"}

{"id": "p_896975c4debe46df", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 70, "text": "三年春，亮率眾南征，其秋悉平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "c292476dc45c87db65dcb3d69c8c4f9de9c5441427c31ffce0f7b1c7506a5af7"}

{"id": "p_249dd78216b28fba", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 71, "text": "軍資所出，國以富饒，乃治戎講武，以俟大舉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "c85418f09e5e22e64cd3e05289b7788bf209c6514ed76d397fcd8e6450708c1d"}

{"id": "p_69b12c66f47e6590", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 72, "text": "五年，率諸軍北駐漢中，臨發，上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "33125e6a7c3d5af06935364469335b7f4db36f2d60e175e757f59aabf205b823"}

{"id": "p_4fbd056e3e41bb93", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 73, "text": "先帝創業未半而中道崩殂，今天下三分，益州疲弊，此誠危急存亡之秋也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "99db7d2e44ffa62684ed6b8683d092357defdf3ef103f6fbe4fdb68e85c882b8"}

{"id": "p_0d8bc520f2fd7a9c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 74, "text": "然侍衛之臣不懈於內，忠志之士忘身於外者，蓋追先帝之殊遇，欲報之於陛下也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "8c95801322d937b70f43b7a44c0d045632ebce6efd95213bd5dfb28058faec9e"}

{"id": "p_dc3479654db2f3d3", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 75, "text": "誠宜開張聖聽，以光先帝遺德，恢弘志士之氣，不宜妄自菲薄，引喻失義，以塞忠諫之路也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "a813b4b20ed15e120684df67ba5d9120d8734590951b61d6f63f91c25e93d7dd"}

{"id": "p_581a430002520dd1", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 76, "text": "宮中府中俱為一體，陟罰臧否，不宜異同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "a3d927f5438911ef2d053f09d40a6db2e1231e9948d0b509ff05daae56b55053"}

{"id": "p_63a8171cd169c9f1", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 77, "text": "若有作奸犯科及為忠善者，宜付有司論其刑賞，以昭陛下平明之理，不宜偏私，使內外異法也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "fc7ac27ae1c2ddd9307904ec9d24ad0180437031bf657f47132eacd1b08db0c8"}

{"id": "p_3c373e711bbd0989", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 78, "text": "侍中、侍郎郭攸之、費禕、董允等，此皆良實，志慮忠純，是以先帝簡拔以遺陛下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "5249c988d989fbb774b0a736391d9afe7f116149c77ad06dc879930b061d8a9b"}

{"id": "p_1a079848f5ce9836", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 79, "text": "愚以為宮中之事，事無大小，悉以咨之，然後施行，必能裨補闕漏，有所廣益。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "f2037dfe72cdcfec1931b4608dbe851a68ab95dd29d8b62450f463b7f31bb7d0"}

{"id": "p_a36be227be27d836", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 80, "text": "將軍向寵，性行淑均，曉暢軍事，試用於昔日，先帝稱之曰能，是以眾議舉寵為督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "2299c99192d4fee9658952aee6a67b3f05463b4c63074bf1ee7ad446b7d5447e"}

{"id": "p_064eb766dc4d878b", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 81, "text": "愚以為營中之事，事無大小，悉以咨之，必能使行陣和睦，優劣得所。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "944380748c3ef06760356a5684ddd1f3422287bc147d6f01bdb7f21453f57afd"}

{"id": "p_e24bb7ca62fd59d6", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 82, "text": "親賢臣，遠小人，此先漢所以興隆也﹔親小人，遠賢臣，此後漢所以傾頹也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "e67852b56318bddc903216b240ad66ac807a8751009d5d9fe17562c3cc4b3470"}

{"id": "p_a8a4e924f5da7dad", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 83, "text": "先帝在時，每與臣論此事，未嘗不嘆息痛恨於桓、靈也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "47d59ea27cb51f13b9d32920c29595f8f09d37ba63bc5170d8974c873358066a"}

{"id": "p_e30b64e1a3f18561", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 84, "text": "侍中、尚書、長史、參軍，此悉貞良死節之臣，願陛下親之信之，則漢室之隆，可計日而待也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "a0331e8ba3ea82221d16623af92457f4f07d2d1536d9b0808f24a4597206bfa0"}

{"id": "p_5c68f80ddb272193", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 85, "text": "臣本布衣，躬耕於南陽，苟全性命於亂世，不求聞達於諸侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "bc517c1f3c5e82577488e92513abff566e418c442a2963d1c0900e5c9449b589"}

{"id": "p_b29ce85f49c3c0f8", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 86, "text": "先帝不以臣卑鄙，猥自枉屈，三顧臣於草廬之中，諮臣以當世之事，由是感激，遂許先帝以驅馳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "5b0552e892dce315b9134c9d925c1dc5fc35f58001f6624e28149dd8c9e2cc83"}

{"id": "p_27f9c0282b22c0b3", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 87, "text": "後值傾覆，受任於敗軍之際，奉命於危難之間，爾來二十有一年矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "df7a62118cd40243036bda8d3693455f18310a5073e55b4e08bdde18f404048a"}

{"id": "p_f74413836e8f9b90", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 88, "text": "先帝知臣謹慎，故臨崩寄臣以大事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "2abc92a00436a3467124a1d53cc2cef2a3ac1f9ac880c7c6e3f35912b9212bd7"}

{"id": "p_260dd902a9c757ed", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 89, "text": "受命以來，夙夜憂歎，恐託付不效，以傷先帝之明，故五月渡瀘，深入不毛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "3067f32acb9871626ca18cb59ef8ce0ae343f399732d15af92da48a7d4cbd240"}

{"id": "p_11cc67306a79825e", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 90, "text": "今南方已定，兵甲已足，當獎率三軍，北定中原，庶竭駑鈍，攘除姦凶，興復漢室，還于舊都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "090e01bc2b63da0ef9a1d91aa3ec81b9ae77c0c45402e9c2046c89a8a1c7d0c2"}

{"id": "p_859c99d31b6733c7", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 91, "text": "此臣所以報先帝，而忠陛下之職分也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "ba80e1a58125ed2e2ca4c98fa7225345621aa0add8cea17d0678e4c874422a3f"}

{"id": "p_119354b4cd6ad151", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 92, "text": "至於斟酌損益，進盡忠言，則攸之、禕、允之任也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "9dac67399c93af438ca2da7d18d0c8afa09bbea83ed2e54c8f959023b7aaf146"}

{"id": "p_392d39015d08992c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 93, "text": "願陛下託臣以討賊興復之效﹔不效，則治臣之罪，以告先帝之靈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "0f30300378d36f6e762ce818b770f7da9ddf5ecab84de2e49617b95265ebf55e"}

{"id": "p_252f7ec427e1ea94", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 94, "text": "[若無興德之言，則]責攸之、禕、允等之慢，以彰其咎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "2e607a7e5f9f855c5d4187af94c806ef09ca89a264844899e0fd1303d35efe1f"}

{"id": "p_cfd2f56ce3be6818", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 95, "text": "陛下亦宜自謀，以諮諏善道，察納雅言，深追先帝遺詔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "ec270326ff3e59f9a61f78d4fbeddbda99849977df727e053498c86c8946b3fa"}

{"id": "p_15ae39298fcbd79e", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 96, "text": "臣不勝受恩感激，今當遠離，臨表涕零，不知所言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "2dc3fe9270367a65682f947aa8bd6bffad0cd411e9d10163f0469de5cf8d148e"}

{"id": "p_e193907e36f3a2cc", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 97, "text": "六年春，揚聲由斜谷道取眉，使趙雲、鄧芝為疑軍，據箕谷，魏大將軍曹真舉眾拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "7a32fedbdda75c88e59c73532345027266bada8a13162e8ac5714a88d5b92f24"}

{"id": "p_871d8052618f8bea", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 98, "text": "亮身率諸軍攻祁山，戎陳整齊，賞罰肅而號令明，南安、天水、安定三郡叛魏應亮，關中響震。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "0219789aabadb2c50f8af4c753d10e3ab097ed12c71b94d8daa9af8476d3f287"}

{"id": "p_2da270cd07433ec7", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 99, "text": "魏明帝西鎮長安，命張郃拒亮，亮使馬謖督諸軍在前，與郃戰于街亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "cb9b7eb9c74f884b986e9de9a16ff3484aafb03ecd656ad48c9c664d6acf7be1"}

{"id": "p_b19014af084d5b86", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 100, "text": "謖違亮節度，舉動失宜，大為張郃所破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "8f74938e7d6e78e53fbf7e84f65ee3ce828a59985bcf7f3f9766dfbd9eb8cdba"}

{"id": "p_8c37865f7d9889ad", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 101, "text": "亮拔西縣千余家，還于漢中，戮謖以謝眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "3b647f22bd99631e67ac05b2cd570f6e4c24866ef85cba6feabb5d68e37116e6"}

{"id": "p_f5c542e532ac882c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 102, "text": "上疏曰：「臣以弱才，叨竊非據，親秉旄鉞以厲三軍，不能訓章明法，臨事而懼，至有街亭違命之闕，箕谷不戒之失，咎皆在臣授任無方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "bf2bbedab09b98159dbd91fb03c44fc8ca1d91ee6ead84a8d535f1ce01649f23"}

{"id": "p_8c12f709eca89e01", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 103, "text": "臣明不知人，恤事多闇，《春秋》責帥，臣職是當。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "8abfba45a98411282591d5af99757e5cdce588a84f7575a0d83bbb6f311059b1"}

{"id": "p_d7e9bff19d9e3148", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 104, "text": "」於是以亮為右將軍，行丞相事，所總統如前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "bad310b9f2e6ce984275424b24048dbaf5fda6d9f0c3f277a7e72d6145849454"}

{"id": "p_8323da550a4311bb", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 105, "text": "冬，亮復出散關，圍陳倉，曹真拒之，亮糧盡而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "58f17f89c4f1df9051b053471032300a3ef31a176732038c06bf6342dc37d63f"}

{"id": "p_44e132120b690399", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 106, "text": "魏將軍王雙率騎追亮，亮與戰，破之，斬雙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "dbfa24553dde8946e3b942971f5c6adf5df5e2e2f536af4b8cb9f13a831c0126"}

{"id": "p_f1ec4f4e26f1f3ee", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 107, "text": "七年，亮遣陳式攻武都、陰平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "366b5e987189f5f96141c807c1c954e29ef9db012b94475f79cc7813ebd62e6f"}

{"id": "p_49262f90a736c023", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 108, "text": "魏雍州剌史郭淮率眾欲擊式，亮自出至建威，淮退還，遂平二郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "00c2b891186b5cfddec68f7430d5c2259815fbffed7508946f33ca89270a7f5a"}

{"id": "p_d7e9f4dbdcecf5f3", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 109, "text": "詔策亮曰：「街亭之役，咎由馬謖，而君引愆，深自貶抑，重違君意，聽順所守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "15a82a6acb83fe1ddde89f57c40314f266e1f81d16cb16f21041c0af763d1404"}

{"id": "p_8c24703f7d8a696a", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 110, "text": "前年耀師，馘斬王雙﹔今歲爰征，郭淮遁走﹔降集氐、羌，興復二郡，威鎮凶暴，功勳顯然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "2ec23c85eb87a8302b0697ea606df7ebf66a4602de8200cf1b67adeefa354224"}

{"id": "p_05928392756d1ba9", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 111, "text": "方今天下騷擾，元惡未梟，君受大任，幹國之重，而久自挹損，非所以光揚洪烈矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "8bdc964168a510eecf9eaeadd37d3cfcddf4e11ee6f52b5c431562819daf1749"}

{"id": "p_d348681747f2cbe2", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 112, "text": "九年，亮復出祁山，以木牛運，糧盡退軍，與魏將張郃交戰，射殺郃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "292a215142254383ecccf123b80fe8ea4a6588fdc505590ccd7d612c2c3fc597"}

{"id": "p_721c3356f376b197", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 113, "text": "十二年春，亮悉大眾由斜谷出，以流馬運，據武功五丈原，與司馬宣王對於渭南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "6fb04b0fcd8218cb2d5ff0f4339671df0411f6e2cdeba0ec80e349c6e6d5a2cb"}

{"id": "p_017094a551ad0093", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 114, "text": "亮每患糧不繼，使己志不申，是以分兵屯田，為久駐之基。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "dd30f33c492dcff05398a3a0e48d1f797a1d5cfe961deae5375abc24eee69e41"}

{"id": "p_72fdcad426690ecb", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 115, "text": "耕者雜於渭濱居民之間，而百姓安堵，軍無私焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "a7a66565b32bf4896c9a107cb5ef412777d199189ab1afc48b0ba16a93393c8b"}

{"id": "p_f23368fa56dd62b5", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 116, "text": "其年八月，亮疾病，卒于軍，時年五十四。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "9a2f3b06eb2c372c97bfdc4196ce2f0035edf9c1b2f7ab8c64da40f5531e51c3"}

{"id": "p_683f5e41744b3a2b", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 117, "text": "及軍退，宣王案行其營壘處所，曰：「天下奇才也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "c574e4cba564d63f1b92aa15e3ddd641ac027383dd7ed100b7a75941ba78efa6"}

{"id": "p_48da4bbb79ab56b3", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 118, "text": "亮遺命葬漢中定軍山，因山為墳，塚足容棺，斂以時服，不須器物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "e862f904461a0d8e7ca8acb00d8619455d931f0bccef5a472dabae4c96aa0131"}

{"id": "p_1e27dec8d779a75d", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 119, "text": "惟君體資文武，明叡篤誠，受遺託孤，匡輔朕躬，繼絕興微，志存靖亂﹔爰整六師，無歲不征，神武赫然，威震八荒，將建殊功於季漢，參伊、周之巨勳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "d7a44b6bce1ce294f4da7ca0cf7aadc7280f9bc9255ddd7801c347a00545ef2b"}

{"id": "p_bb1d10cc0bc8662c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 120, "text": "如何不弔，事臨垂克，遘疾隕喪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "7861fd6f0eed1bfee3a16fd63c59132f33b995e73e476803c04322c60399ea32"}

{"id": "p_d0d38583becc2f49", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 121, "text": "夫崇德序功，紀行命謚，所以光昭將來，刊載不朽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "aa2c09623ee3768c71bf24606837401aab6da5093bf6cf537a4e0f45bd90ef8b"}

{"id": "p_0f05ad9c315f0ee4", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 122, "text": "令使使持節左中郎將杜瓊，贈君丞相武鄉侯印綬，謚君為忠武侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "f2a976da0dd957b4299afeaf670f5a3f6e9974b075c080cff3dfa094010aafa3"}

{"id": "p_284711ac229f8f24", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 123, "text": "初，亮自表後主曰：「成都有桑八百株，薄田十五頃，子弟衣食，自有餘饒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "0a9742f281b2e681316bfc30be8e64d2e97c4b931a673ce6c072f26469e070e3"}

{"id": "p_a6d9b588f157aa39", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 124, "text": "至於臣在外任，無別調度，隨身衣食，悉仰於官，不別治生，以長尺寸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "10098af4318a687491ba9c4df34962d49517d46a54903c2fdf2bae6595c31a23"}

{"id": "p_6cb5ef8111339f46", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 125, "text": "若臣死之日，不使內有餘帛，外有贏財，以負陛下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "ff8b9c5da2fb62727feea58f96196fb3961c794abece19424a90d2e39b69963d"}

{"id": "p_c5073115b2610516", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 126, "text": "亮性長於巧思，損益連弩，木牛流馬，皆出其意﹔推演兵法，作八陣圖，咸得其要云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "1b68d5640e960c54c901af05f112d0440c1ccb573f04bf6a3417f2a8759cf3e0"}

{"id": "p_e5e532ca9b1c04c7", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 127, "text": "亮言教書奏多可觀，別為一集。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "3bd7651f52e4a2d9b9d162b38a8b05ae04e3da291f14514cf25fdc7afcd4b8db"}

{"id": "p_ae900c99266757c4", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 128, "text": "秋，魏鎮西將軍鐘會征蜀，至漢川，祭亮之廟，令軍士不得於亮墓所左右芻牧樵採。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "1ba7d504e6b22c1ece83e360af232780fb7c33e1cc581008302fb57efa090e54"}

{"id": "p_9bf7c6d8f01cee45", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 129, "text": "開府作牧第一 權制第二 南征第三", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "fa87947103934903ee969c6b74ccd612a5a0280eb660bce3916c970488de7170"}

{"id": "p_90a1eab44265e4e5", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 130, "text": "北出第四 計算第五 訓厲第六", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "3efee26e7f52ae60f9c77aadbd25652557d4fe59f90d165dfe63b99d4c57381f"}

{"id": "p_f133f4d37255cbb0", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 131, "text": "綜覈上第七 綜覈下第八 雜言上第九", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "a423daeae5616cd67f80b0d7124df856c1b63792314d60d01926193fc3a055d0"}

{"id": "p_6bdfe7320646248d", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 132, "text": "雜言第十 貴和第十一 兵要第十二", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "821fac7c77ae99cfa046e523de65e2c40b3e22816625a4b0175803840c372303"}

{"id": "p_004768933671740c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 133, "text": "傳運第十三 與孫權書第十四 與諸葛謹書第十五", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "fe0b129d2cefce873e6ed3b701df4059e316a105b1a5f46efb6c55a10967c668"}

{"id": "p_ef73489cff882250", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 134, "text": "與孟達書第十六 廢李平第十七 法檢上第十八", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "339ffa248ae22315e026ee2f72e64f9239d60f3ad5af7fed5b4d3ad86577927e"}

{"id": "p_f3395bd36f891fe7", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 135, "text": "法檢下第十九 科令上第二十 科令下第二十一", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "e999353fa76319f5b411d3cf3029f244ab96d67de7a7b191f8916966dafa2dae"}

{"id": "p_9cd1b53bd45a23d0", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 136, "text": "軍令上第二十二 軍令中第二十三 軍令下第二十四", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "02d417a505aaacb4e9dcb4f3c1637352c1c603c6f38b3b1110024b0f22377143"}

{"id": "p_aec985f38c353398", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 137, "text": "右二十四篇，凡十萬四千一百一十二字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "0b9ad8eafbc8fc367267a6c6161a12e31773d552a410b01925485ab3a86c8108"}

{"id": "p_545c9957f6dc1c5c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 138, "text": "臣壽等言：臣前在著作郎，侍中領中書監濟北侯臣荀勖、中書令關內侯臣和嶠奏：使臣定故蜀丞相諸葛亮故事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "f68beaa071b200f24f4f9ec75504b673d6217bea374efea7d6380dcb17389057"}

{"id": "p_d194dd33a871f270", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 139, "text": "亮毗佐危國，負阻不賓，然猶存錄其言，恥善有遺，誠是大晉光明至德，澤被無疆，自古以來，未有之倫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "7bec03f87ea646cfe400fc8cd8190c101273309452cba0ba9344d62db05ce3f6"}

{"id": "p_1dddddbde39d38d0", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 140, "text": "輒刪除複重，隨類相從，凡為二十四篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "f1c309113ec4dabb2fc729c843e8e3d7024cb6aa0c38f147fa6478da7bae4219"}

{"id": "p_1671f9acfde1ce29", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 141, "text": "亮少有逸眾之才，英霸之器，身長八尺，容貌甚偉，時人異焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "4d8a6f3057e3c7540c80fbc4f3a8e5cb14fdd17633c616fbeb870e13f6db9115"}

{"id": "p_f26ee65ac852d9ed", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 142, "text": "造漢末亂，隨叔父玄避難荊州，躬耕于野，不求聞達。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "354837da4a348fc169758899956b474c84beb96a6618dd6a12b68d9916c3a3f7"}

{"id": "p_e5582b892f9ed895", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 143, "text": "時左將軍劉備以亮有殊量，乃三顧亮於草廬之中﹔亮深謂備雄姿傑出，遂解帶寫誠，厚相結納。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "3643f976dc78c645d5ca60658526ef0f4954f424784166733c53cf94d681ede9"}

{"id": "p_8b4ebe292369bf9f", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 144, "text": "及魏武帝南征荊州，劉琮舉州委質，而備失勢眾寡，無立錐之地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "29103738b33f688441013ab768674e9f3f95adaccbfde0280e94fe4b1c1ce732"}

{"id": "p_251a6fcd00cbfa56", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 145, "text": "亮時年二十七，乃建奇策，身使孫權，求援吳會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "d047868938783e6c0c1917023e60a5ac43c4f14f38ca24bac0eafb72d763bc6b"}

{"id": "p_2906b7598e83bada", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 146, "text": "權既宿服仰備，又觀亮奇雅，甚敬重之，即遣兵三萬以助備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "d3e3d8cdef75f9face679e2f3605aa22dc446e96b606497bbb2b8b69d05b48e0"}

{"id": "p_fc72d6f20529b145", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 147, "text": "備得用與武帝交戰，大破其軍，乘勝克捷，江南悉平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "733049992408601e9ad877d64c7e90fcdd072e1d34b686c4e7e500defde189cd"}

{"id": "p_90c20d961d0d9a2e", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 148, "text": "益州既定，以亮為軍師將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "9cf8a0aca527349a1e45b84dbe8192b17fafc49859a3a8988a4832acdbb802ef"}

{"id": "p_805e0f5eef941c7b", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 149, "text": "備稱尊號，拜亮為丞相，錄尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "c6cf80ec60eb99448881ac56f0c86e2f5ff748501e510182a6510391dfeeb698"}

{"id": "p_b3440a27e833a287", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 150, "text": "及備殂沒，嗣子幼弱，事無巨細，亮皆專之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "39b69da574824e2662dd78ef59a9b624735282e4d3009b332abdf93c6f51bb4c"}

{"id": "p_99886071e2e53b9d", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 151, "text": "於是外連東吳，內平南越，立法施度，整理戎旅，工械技巧，物究其極，科教嚴明，賞罰必信，無惡不懲，無善不顯，至於吏不容奸，人懷自厲，道不拾遺，彊不侵弱，風化肅然也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "cb95f5507c8bceb0d21c4cf3a70730281ba4b4f2da57783de77702592e472516"}

{"id": "p_a2309a91463d3d6a", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 152, "text": "當此之時，亮之素志，進欲龍驤虎視，包括四海，退欲跨陵邊疆，震蕩宇內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "9f479cbe604f2d66e3aae143063515ad77b2d6b670cba88d29fff672919914e9"}

{"id": "p_5de5c6e37e32b323", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 153, "text": "又自以為無身之日，則未有能蹈涉中原、抗衡上國者，是以用兵不戢，屢耀其武。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "6acdb0edc629489a28aa4d8c4f31518278703ccc5daca189fec5a65ad00b531b"}

{"id": "p_a20093e31b945dd7", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 154, "text": "然亮才，於治戎為長，奇謀為短，理民之干，優於將略。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "5ce459df3c4a57727850391f9bdc48e5bc28693de00f7a8132e400cbcb312dbf"}

{"id": "p_0b9f52064c485bd9", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 155, "text": "而所與對敵，或值人傑，加眾寡不侔，攻守異體，故雖連年動眾，未能有克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "799fba7590579cf3cdecad8906ce62e2bb96ef38337ab6ba2f539da93bb96f5a"}

{"id": "p_ff4c017a46e32100", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 156, "text": "昔蕭何荐韓信，管仲舉王子城父，皆忖己之長，未能兼有故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "258cdc1de95c12c918d4b344a091ff66c639355721da3a2610e44dc20aed2f83"}

{"id": "p_499d19e87d106e07", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 157, "text": "亮之器能政理，抑亦管、蕭之亞匹也，而時之名將無城父、韓信，故使功業陵遲，大義不及邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "a076a83a48e3f3808360b8ad873327bcd106b31ab30c511b091975f4069c3647"}

{"id": "p_142688d9b2713db9", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 158, "text": "蓋天命有歸，不可以智力爭也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "c0f326dc75f9db4809c4bbfcd5e66dad54c7230371c9050630959818b58e7981"}

{"id": "p_13e9bb14774a9e80", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 159, "text": "青龍二年春，亮帥眾出武功，分兵屯田，為久駐之基。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "bfabc88e87e1d7b9131aeb682fd25e64b49a7ac2607a9b4e62b9a6d329acb85f"}

{"id": "p_567c07fcb072c387", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 160, "text": "其秋病卒，黎庶追思，以為口實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "6b89a0be699bc91264c23ca4d3dcb0e4115f566528d9eaf3ae34afb3de0747eb"}

{"id": "p_33dfc0d4e56d990e", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 161, "text": "至今梁、益之民，咨述亮者，言猶在耳，雖甘棠之詠召公，鄭人之歌子產，無以遠譬也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "4b0506edddd8f9dc038369a38e5222b5ad6062908b801345d67edc8b3a9fbb40"}

{"id": "p_72a9a9e0c272e552", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 162, "text": "孟軻有云：「以逸道使民，雖勞不怨﹔以生道殺人，雖死不忿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "5372896cf314aae3a02aaa4bf852a83789d1efc809a67ce37e5f821b9cce4212"}

{"id": "p_6e98e53886a11b33", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 163, "text": "論者或怪亮文彩不艷，而過於丁寧周至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "2efc7ae7b5ef96f469d0d0c63155feb0d72b6704320d9dcc8061292ce1e5d0c6"}

{"id": "p_5e16228983b77d90", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 164, "text": "臣愚以為咎繇大賢也，周公聖人也，考之尚書，咎繇之謨略而雅，周公之誥煩而悉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "469a124b6ccd9cbda1781824e1305cad8d2be9898363c3635756850e919e3e7d"}

{"id": "p_b2d7816c0334c4ab", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 165, "text": "咎繇與舜、禹共談，周公與群下矢誓故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "592ffb99c3aace33c311a9d972e15dd4a841b5a746cd10bb2d4c88b11cfa1026"}

{"id": "p_6957aca037e37d3d", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 166, "text": "亮所與言，盡眾人凡士，故其文指不得及遠也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "bb38513cd09c0e3adf5be0965114f4b6b96830fd20ddf223c62a9e3f5d2375a7"}

{"id": "p_8ceb75d6d577bc68", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 167, "text": "然其聲教遺言，皆經事綜物，公誠之心，形於文墨，足以知其人之意理，而有補於當世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "1a1de86d6ca033f3036e7da13783a56bd1df43b3efe085cb7ca94adcc306931b"}

{"id": "p_91fb0f8a4fd121cb", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 168, "text": "伏惟陛下邁蹤古聖，蕩然無忌，故雖敵國誹謗之言，咸肆其辭而無所革諱，所以明大通之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "0caa5887ccb88e26770b5c0b3361f23662210bd0ae2dc40e9eaaff7236f316a6"}

{"id": "p_2c50be2e84c6d6d4", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 169, "text": "臣壽誠惶誠恐，頓首頓首，死罪死罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "8594ea87b5b138b33ceade73a019dc47861743bb3c5ef29ff98c7eccc491d5be"}

{"id": "p_671577f6d8280dfa", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 170, "text": "泰始十年二月一日癸巳，平陽侯相臣陳壽上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "d437febe810b6b8f45446ee00dc5545705e0b25c3da9ee3d92726fe007cc01df"}

{"id": "p_7561113dc105f248", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 171, "text": "喬字伯松，亮兄瑾之第二子也，本字仲慎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "7ebc603821202d36707c79539fb99b339a5a895ee5f4cd62cf04e311786e1a6f"}

{"id": "p_10d68c1ce9669c0c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 172, "text": "與兄元遜俱有名於時，論者以為喬才不及兄，而性業過之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "c71c833eaab6762bbd09d015b54e28ba92be51ac7799d406f1c311757d28a41f"}

{"id": "p_8e4bfcb9b52b10b8", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 173, "text": "初，亮未有子，求喬為嗣，瑾啟孫權遣喬來西，亮以喬為己適子，故易其字焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "7a43c17f8b3cd65f3dcb3d2779ec1a849007fc84dab628a53aae8eddbabb25d9"}

{"id": "p_49ce57c047cb4f54", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 174, "text": "拜為駙馬都尉，隨亮至漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "8632bb2cf61b2036a9b63ef75c83bd3f36887902166137decd4ddbed9a3657a8"}

{"id": "p_bd936aa568346d42", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 175, "text": "年二十五，建興（元）[六]年卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "e28102ed0e0e2c9aec2808c3b9c2102f9970aa3551d3f38f79655b9ab71953e3"}

{"id": "p_3dad2bc3fa88ee2a", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 176, "text": "子攀，官至行護軍翊武將軍，亦早卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "94f14e1f4b35ca0162b4df55ec04889a040a7867e0da7dc1d9ac340007908893"}

{"id": "p_3606bd09d60ba76a", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 177, "text": "諸葛恪見誅於吳，子孫皆盡，而亮自有冑裔，故攀还復為瑾後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "ecc7c83e73d02088a0de877cbf6e6a4347e561688283a48aa2c0fbd197319288"}

{"id": "p_04c872e532e5544c", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 178, "text": "，亮出武功，與瑾書曰：「瞻今已八歲，聰慧可愛，嫌其早成，恐不為重器耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "86bfcd0de085030fd29b40439b73751b0e0c0daa64e9daf913cdccb69c9fb97e"}

{"id": "p_cb104e156c6e16a7", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 179, "text": "」年十七，尚公主，拜騎都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "7782b47675e04ad16a04885be485f65e4d98e6fe245c3cc4f6f7d282f8582728"}

{"id": "p_3674a8b0a927b46d", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 180, "text": "其明年為羽林中郎將，屢遷射聲校尉、侍中、尚書僕射，加軍師將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "890ec50b92c5b431d686a9d64e3b41023e03aae7c1867039990a176816410473"}

{"id": "p_aa321264cba18fc9", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 181, "text": "瞻工書畫，強識念，蜀人追思亮，咸愛其才敏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "b2cea5f4f2860c7fcefbecab562b8209c441808830cd1dbb6eccacdccec9adaf"}

{"id": "p_b2ae585a42c4f745", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 182, "text": "每朝廷有一善政佳事，雖非瞻所建倡，百姓皆傳相告曰：「葛侯之所為也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "d6f1b397262d34ea6b82cd188035c7ee320ac37f8c1a280ce47956cefbdde3c8"}

{"id": "p_c417145b66036bfc", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 183, "text": "」是以美聲溢譽，有過其實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "0a47b2a030ef622b73eb10ac84dc89f7a0773c839fa60659c117821432a5f1cf"}

{"id": "p_8d85d890e3fb7df2", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 184, "text": "，為行都護衛將軍，與輔國大將軍南鄉侯董厥并平尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "eea9a0559b3df0366b54289e848473cb93da596dab37606f99586e669c7ac76c"}

{"id": "p_2a6caf927fe294ba", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 185, "text": "六年冬，魏征西將軍鄧艾伐蜀，自陰平由景谷道旁入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "dc9ddf13230142398460d75ae9484373966141a1cee214be76cd55c4f5606026"}

{"id": "p_af5f68af2a328e44", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 186, "text": "瞻督諸軍至涪停住，前鋒破，退還，住綿竹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "cde536972a84a65bb9b023e599d35c6cc61497dbf6b69a490df8f48314ba857a"}

{"id": "p_3a3ed1488db9f66d", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 187, "text": "艾遣書誘瞻曰：「若降者，必表為琅邪王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "e296bb898eb1366af0fa4e391930e24e10802f85c8d0b38ca763ef8aa6c59c74"}

{"id": "p_72c46ec0f4e1d0d5", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 188, "text": "遂戰，大敗，臨陣死，時年三十七。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "85d317dc4ea260070865e61b1185d79585bb9ba952d16cb8086d32f3941b646e"}

{"id": "p_de38f4feffe6be5e", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 189, "text": "眾皆離散，艾長驅至成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "92ed8051344eef1ce215e826c0a7db7fd6c8937396dc0d05726d1bde7bdea6f3"}

{"id": "p_61c30f998929e36b", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 190, "text": "次子京及攀子顯等，內移河東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "17da12b33f3082f3c9cce2a1bebf72bf0b5bf23996185cb91eac382a402eb1e8"}

{"id": "p_0404918f83fdcc6e", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 191, "text": "董厥者，丞相亮時為府令史，亮稱之曰：「董令史，良士也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "5460b4e08eb343d4ed6559d126b2a2bc39472158aeb0760a1c1d76195a497dec"}

{"id": "p_acedf9d2734c26a8", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 192, "text": "亮卒後，稍遷至尚書仆射，代陳祗為尚書令，遷大將軍，平台事，而義陽樊建代焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "52cbb2275b58d36b63d4aaa42e361c0b3593c70dd6cff14a82c27d82e3386e28"}

{"id": "p_2e38481719d00e11", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 193, "text": "延熙(二)十四年，以校尉使吳，值孫權病篤，不自見建。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "164920cb03883fede4d76a1b1a4c18917d43f22be3b7d9192d527b52ffe515a9"}

{"id": "p_320e2265de0edec8", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 194, "text": "權問諸葛恪曰：「樊建何如宗預也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "031eacd403078620ec127026568531eac1455338f14817bafa500ee13a4c7aa8"}

{"id": "p_53cb022284f467bd", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 195, "text": "」恪對曰：「才識不及預，而雅性過之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "c799a7074f015bdf2bde181bd6ef805144dca322998815d453b83f5602ef5fe5"}

{"id": "p_9e763ecb21263cab", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 196, "text": "自瞻、厥、建統事，姜維常徵伐在外，宦人黃皓竊弄機柄，咸共將護，無能匡矯，然建特不與皓好往來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "366e2d0967186ec7fd20464f38404a749ac156a026ce06426ffc36582c5b56ea"}

{"id": "p_7d0f7129fb301e33", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 197, "text": "蜀破之明年春，厥、建俱詣京都，同為相國參軍，其秋并兼散騎常侍，使蜀使慰勞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "59c6e84e3334a2cc2ff95ffee13f8acf13f4861d2d25ee15572d803e5b654bf6"}

{"id": "p_587b1e6f8ace7ad3", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 198, "text": "評曰：諸葛亮之為相國也，撫百姓，示儀軌，約官職，從權制，開誠心，布公道﹔盡忠益時者雖讎必賞，犯法怠慢者雖親必罰，服罪輸情者雖重必釋，游辭巧飾者雖輕必戮﹔善無微而不賞，惡無纖而不貶﹔庶事精練，物理其本，循名責實，虛偽不齒﹔終於邦域之內，咸畏而愛之，刑政雖峻而無怨者，以其用心平而勸戒明也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "e6c8c214aa20e4793d3baa06dde2e26579070858116ee6d168dd77feb4983202"}

{"id": "p_e8954d72cd22009b", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 199, "text": "可謂識治之良才，管、蕭之亞匹矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "1cf75c89e0274e2b6ae4a72161fd1687a53114bd748cdc21c8246df119a4a209"}

{"id": "p_173e64c2545a44f8", "source_id": "src_fbebc49524c95139", "ordinal": 200, "text": "然連年動眾，未能成功，蓋應變將略，非其所長歟！", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "a84a20596af965778c16271322be54ccfe2561e4475013facb367bd5cb7a6991"}

{"id": "p_44c847801e2461e5", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_a6de6342f0f7d6bc", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 1, "text": "關羽字雲長，本字長生，河東解人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "b85728a10eb5a1836037190f27969933f64fab73caedc2623d28412b98cde149"}

{"id": "p_ecb9dd700ffd8e26", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 2, "text": "先主於鄉里合徒眾，而羽與張飛為之禦侮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "be2233d7ccd424d647c2b677b2d893378322dbb10e194e337c9ff7fa248c872c"}

{"id": "p_5fc10c8f64be3ab3", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 3, "text": "先主為平原相，以羽、飛為別部司馬，分統部曲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "f8a209a1a71e5468bf4c2b0a62b980d34f604faf388f35f3e0b081b1aa8f26af"}

{"id": "p_6ad101a1e2c5e821", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 4, "text": "先主與二人寢則同床，恩若兄弟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "17791f829ef1f0436943a15311801bc79425dafe073f1aaee1fadda14548ca86"}

{"id": "p_5ff8dd89c0340c8b", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 5, "text": "而稠人廣坐，侍立終日，隨先主周旋，不避艱險。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "3bea085ceb26e4127d3d5bef46a01184acbbdf755aa842e543afd92bcd922978"}

{"id": "p_12e2e6796eca591c", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 6, "text": "先主之襲殺徐州刺史車胄，使羽守下邳城，行太守事，而身還小沛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "05a7a3e64cc2b6a25e36ffaf4925f4748126c829a2e26c7a85ce81048d23e94c"}

{"id": "p_e3f748fbf6fe879f", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 7, "text": "，曹公東征，先主奔袁紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "819fca1cddb6ea1c39c94aef1f0aa079103c9f91392ba82f7593eba24d9419a7"}

{"id": "p_2b3812fcb59ea217", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 8, "text": "曹公禽羽以歸，拜為偏將軍，禮之甚厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "5dcc8615be99a71c9ff98384792688cc06b8bb4fdc13be3e00ff2a43820e8175"}

{"id": "p_8a6353e90e3592a0", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 9, "text": "紹遣大將軍顏良攻東郡太守劉延於白馬，曹公使張遼及羽為先鋒擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "fbd8c2d2283005af8db4f714001b7b06b72cb3a0196047962604f4e3f459743b"}

{"id": "p_79ddc427af4d0d44", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 10, "text": "羽望見良麾蓋，策馬刺良於萬眾之中，斬其首還，紹諸將莫能當者，遂解白馬圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "8050f98a4dbfd6911afad1162a2637708f24889b804b0829bc8d0b72a6645834"}

{"id": "p_79e0912c376b2b2b", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 11, "text": "曹公即表封羽為漢壽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "47bfcde11e1b50fa3fcc37a7a763e61b1c2cce0b2e13f3f3f404c3141e4da130"}

{"id": "p_eca1fbca19bfdbb6", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 12, "text": "初，曹公壯羽為人，而察其心神無久留之意，謂張遼曰：「卿試以情問之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "4c787e3a5d2ea7dbeb3826f38d09afd01de0b76e6134b81cf180dd2a97297e84"}

{"id": "p_eb90d31ee24f2cbd", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 13, "text": "」既而遼以問羽，羽歎曰：「吾極知曹公待我厚，然吾受劉將軍厚恩，誓以共死，不可背之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "f464b7684d5e4f84d4ed085cd443c12d8e8b879f1792ae8d4124640598e896bf"}

{"id": "p_cad5b182a2c7cd5c", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 14, "text": "吾終不留，吾要當立效以報曹公乃去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "0d04b6d9420a82b053fd3915559fdc917d2369983560750adf95b1d01f4b4a7a"}

{"id": "p_b044efa94021a280", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」遼以羽言報曹公，曹公義之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "482f0cbc02f843fda07c39191d211d136ed8eec271adba7d306abeb9b76cd133"}

{"id": "p_13c5b4ee3fc94673", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 16, "text": "及羽殺顏良，曹公知其必去，重加賞賜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "c72bbe55592c470e5f792b47d41e9121f0630610966280a565d6ee452edc9d8a"}

{"id": "p_de5261aeabe34d21", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 17, "text": "羽盡封其所賜，拜書告辭，而奔先主於袁軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "b7039886c69502095aa193edc6fb15102a87628cf3d8e42afa5374e18664a295"}

{"id": "p_4cb6e17752fae7d1", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 18, "text": "左右欲追之，曹公曰：「彼各為其主，勿追也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "cc670fc47b818b0031d013e1dd965dd46e9cdca674db74b8c7b7dea1bec64e3f"}

{"id": "p_217d8d2ebfca6905", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 19, "text": "表卒，曹公定荊州，先主自樊將南渡江，別遣羽乘船數百艘會江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "80ab9056310543fe39559316c257c422ff24eaf28a333c80843f1e712ca4bc68"}

{"id": "p_542ffee8d212fc11", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 20, "text": "曹公追至當陽長阪，先主斜趣漢津，適與羽船相值，共至夏口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "88b069d04282de1ef74d70cb461bb758926599077a763a22572ec66b09fb528e"}

{"id": "p_9d2f7b99c3ca2926", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 21, "text": "孫權遣兵佐先主拒曹公，曹公引軍退歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "4714a5c8b1332c653577af480cb9188d1674452d21d2b3c4be9ea72107a7511e"}

{"id": "p_863ed8d358d9ac3a", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 22, "text": "先主收江南諸郡，乃封拜元勳，以羽為襄陽太守、蕩寇將軍，駐江北。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "169c03ae004faa0aec1af69c1e287b149c0d39c0964c3414b407a8bbdd964369"}

{"id": "p_e03304f1c027297e", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 23, "text": "先主西定益州，拜羽董督荊州事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "5b39c6d22b6ee63dc8f92d9acfc81ba6ad090fdd9b4423f2acbd740b55b16220"}

{"id": "p_c3e8590e32b33450", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 24, "text": "羽聞馬超來降，舊非故人，羽書與諸葛亮，問超人才可誰比類。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "910bea02532324a9e2d6904e6f1d82e8a31e2b23ad492d69396113d2a3c0fda9"}

{"id": "p_10b439928d555ef9", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 25, "text": "亮知羽護前，乃答之曰：「孟起兼資文武，雄烈過人，一世之傑，黥、彭之徒，當與益德並驅爭先，猶未及髯之絕倫逸群也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "4851605f95f85a291e84ce7d3329f591100ca3e0e3a576aebf7ef27d7e64de3d"}

{"id": "p_fd896b0c405b19df", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」羽美-{鬚}-髯，故亮謂之髯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "d6755bc5197a7e17cce926e7c3eebfa671aa0029996b6ccf16aa0466784eb985"}

{"id": "p_8b5838e336e80122", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 27, "text": "羽嘗為流矢所中，貫其左臂，後創雖愈，每至陰雨，骨常疼痛，醫曰：「矢鏃有毒，毒入於骨，當破臂作創，刮骨去毒，然後此患乃除耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "b8bd5bf05700b46be4816a801655531f08f9cbd569bcd79078744ff32a674eea"}

{"id": "p_fb34518aa6345e1f", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 28, "text": "時羽適請諸將飲食相對，臂血流離，盈於盤器，而羽割炙引酒，言笑自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "ea16eddaecf66169b0efc45ad7f77191d8966bb4c8a405dac6f3ad02d0a8828c"}

{"id": "p_d0155edcb424a962", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 29, "text": "二十四年，先主為漢中王，拜羽為前將軍，假節鉞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "bc205a9beae9ce0f75a8cfae4dd103402713d65b3979c95f48033950faf3bb1b"}

{"id": "p_21613e6bcd033182", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 30, "text": "是歲，羽率眾攻曹仁於樊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "ef9d6d804c810f757f793432146d5d34fd4860afce319d8bb536ba92b9865bf4"}

{"id": "p_ba305d96ac768d8d", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 31, "text": "秋，大霖雨，漢水汎溢，禁所督七軍皆沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "caf0439080a822b11fe533d3314eb7ac7f46c062ceafba31dafdac0eae465479"}

{"id": "p_6b7f2df0de5e8d43", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 32, "text": "禁降羽，羽又斬將軍龐德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "70f0aa5ee873a06d9ea27b601f79124dd07951acd356a029616a11130f81b330"}

{"id": "p_d5272c6f752d3c6a", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 33, "text": "梁、郟、陸渾群盜或遙受羽印號，為之支黨，羽威震華夏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "240717de3b1bc8252b44243a113f9498138ff97fc4b1345e81419a716747818f"}

{"id": "p_fec60865b73e127e", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 34, "text": "曹公議徙許都以避其銳，司馬宣王、蔣濟以為關羽得志，孫權必不原也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "0ae57220c74de745daccbb581d6500cc7250864d3bb33164c4ef61f250347752"}

{"id": "p_b8e8666affa7d269", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 35, "text": "可遣人勸權躡其後，許割江南以封權，則樊圍自解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "03e53c9df40646122178b0bf03b4d7355afb9aa99132ef9def05b2aa8908bbf9"}

{"id": "p_f6ae815bb9e3984b", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 36, "text": "先是，權遣使為子索羽女，羽罵辱其使，不許婚，權大怒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "b7c3a3471fc705f98ffaa944d2914371d0fec44040bb1011a74e1f6c1852db63"}

{"id": "p_9a0d780d1e754a72", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 37, "text": "又南郡太守麋芳在江陵，將軍士仁屯公安，素皆嫌羽輕己。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "d1ef22ff66f1ae64986fef76f3db690383fae5c1d6829bcf24f3d333ec311778"}

{"id": "p_02923761a3db994e", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 38, "text": "羽之出軍，芳、仁供給軍資，不悉相救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "27c44e656abca386ebf45ef20f762688adecadd45596865216773822107684e2"}

{"id": "p_e97a7ab7dd1a6fb3", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 39, "text": "羽言「還當治之」，芳、仁咸懷懼不安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "e5bb20122b47f03ec77bc37830c4e26844e9da1fd283e97cd49afa7c5907f34d"}

{"id": "p_fb303a190873311b", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 40, "text": "於是權陰誘芳、仁，芳、仁使人迎權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "0f29814d0ce63092d19f5da418e4cc467cc33c23d0ae9a6af4e54ba0989ec5d6"}

{"id": "p_9e407f4efa3845fe", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 41, "text": "而曹公遣徐晃救曹仁，羽不能克，引軍退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "32e5ae06a38d131d4a8a59c5515ff55b9700603e2393bc6665782d1e1a94ac87"}

{"id": "p_5970d3156b8e0c49", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 42, "text": "權已據江陵，盡虜羽士眾妻子，羽軍遂散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "9f300eafc348c201f968d3ea571f9b173ac75d1a46c493a06d9b123ecc2a216e"}

{"id": "p_7fa3fa9a925a4fcf", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 43, "text": "權遣將逆擊羽，斬羽及子平於臨沮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "c75125f1026387de7bfbe9b971a628f41b130939ed6746d6f1bdd66b94aa3668"}

{"id": "p_b3167d85ed1ee8b6", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 44, "text": "興字安國，少有令問，丞相諸葛亮深器異之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "fa4b15a54839d6ff45c8861217a1d4a8757be7ffedafee0cc2f834f10ba5d652"}

{"id": "p_fc91f804be4a2bef", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 45, "text": "弱冠為侍中、中監軍，數歲卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "fd8b04302ec54494146eb9665ef17442482a5c4b8f7c1fb6cc135ca2cdd0b59d"}

{"id": "p_a236c553a7e980d3", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 46, "text": "子統嗣，尚公主，官至虎賁中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "2a75934db5a1d3695be88fcc228ae6731cf5b3e65c50a211088d6759298242ee"}

{"id": "p_3de9c07412e3eaba", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 47, "text": "卒，無子，以興庶子彝續封。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "00011ab39ae15eaa1af0b7b01e2855361c52d4c0749be4468fb653e8f406a143"}

{"id": "p_2573ce8570bb44a7", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 48, "text": "張飛字益德，涿郡人也，少與關羽俱事先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "b29e77e24951414e0e97a9d609d71d656f818442c87195ebddee5e9700a6c166"}

{"id": "p_b15063e9b90e184d", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 49, "text": "先主從曹公破呂布，隨還計，曹公拜飛為中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "ff9415686e8d001a7c1bed75d29875100861c5bec477f798545246b8cb4add3f"}

{"id": "p_74fc86675e007290", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 50, "text": "先主背曹公依袁紹、劉表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "d506c801af4039ca2895b8635069d732c4a73d1619df610ec8d7b0091dc47caf"}

{"id": "p_53003dba36602957", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 51, "text": "表卒，曹公入荊州，先主奔江南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "a1d82e178e72043b5bd2c2a518f4d173838d1f8f7b1e72b83cf81d15db4e673a"}

{"id": "p_6ea41d8cb2e5fac5", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 52, "text": "曹公追之，一日一夜，及於當陽之長阪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "1c84d70fec7018d13d5397c31929b561417fcd6f957622196b777f253dd1a12b"}

{"id": "p_e89a491516761a86", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 53, "text": "先主聞曹公卒至，棄妻子走，使飛將二十騎拒後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "925c80f983fc1df8d1839603b64a9cdc712343698b0703ae7eb1c49836646eff"}

{"id": "p_4249edd9185ac811", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 54, "text": "飛據水斷橋，瞋目橫矛曰：「身是張益德也，可來共決死！", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "e7575ff3499807f661a068bf015ff8f497dae7a773ed5535e2610ad300e5882a"}

{"id": "p_1091f1100388a412", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」敵皆無敢近者，故遂得免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "69d28fc2faf47bcf60304fe0999c3ef3c7550527845399798599488023588dfd"}

{"id": "p_edefe92fd279cff8", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 56, "text": "先主既定江南，以飛為宜都太守、征虜將軍，封新亭侯，後轉在南郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "b7a8612e926d0e540be146c8a82b1894523b85f221f84cb7491764b21ee1f863"}

{"id": "p_656c18a3b72e8e5d", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 57, "text": "先主入益州，還攻劉璋，飛與諸葛亮等溯流而上，分定郡縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "26eec109b2520de7129ac871b28a0cc45c1314830c18678a4c3f13b94ba7f1a7"}

{"id": "p_e1a7642b39b21d54", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 58, "text": "至江州，破璋將巴郡太守嚴顏，生獲顏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "2f66951778a873fe6d25437975885fa2fd44e1a4fd415943675dec8b9d1ff161"}

{"id": "p_b52898a1be8e27e8", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 59, "text": "飛呵顏曰：「大軍至，何以不降而敢拒戰？", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "76eb5f7324678e854f59b40aaf6ace237ec2acc95410d8e8ed1bf8c817c55a7c"}

{"id": "p_2407f71dfdda5bb7", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 60, "text": "」顏答曰：「卿等無狀，侵奪我州，我州但有斷頭將軍，無有降將軍也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "17d92ebe8281d79d0c2d3a44773a1ca5bd799bc03e52d1b41e90018be1a23ee4"}

{"id": "p_41edb0fbf7b3d3c6", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」飛怒，令左右牽去斫頭，顏色不變，曰：「斫頭便斫頭，何為怒邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "ec9e72e96d9ba8a1bc15504170154ec4ec3d99f41fa896007a9c4368c7f94152"}

{"id": "p_17ca4b007f15bb91", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」飛壯而釋之，引為賓客。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "a7e49a20781c4de3da0b6a77371417a1fdbc2d720976096d086ceb9604184684"}

{"id": "p_866caf474c8998f2", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 63, "text": "飛所過戰克，與先主會於成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "6ccf831bb3f405b7108be321b78f10c15f713666c6119a26adf68e02f0219258"}

{"id": "p_012e24fd32acc0fb", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 64, "text": "益州既平，賜諸葛亮、法正、飛及關羽金各五百斤，銀千斤，錢五千萬，錦千匹，其餘頒賜各有差，以飛領巴西太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "09039cf9d0dfe9dede4cd1b0aae9639a08fd6b4b9fa87ce06d6535ba4c75f77d"}

{"id": "p_706b42945cef194e", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 65, "text": "曹公破張魯，留夏侯淵、張郃守漢川。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "747ba567ac5ff1c042ae74c9e4ca8b5f4f0c3990e8aebad765da5c0a6827228b"}

{"id": "p_04b0afa392d0f2a9", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 66, "text": "郃別督諸軍下巴西，欲徙其民於漢中，進軍宕渠、蒙頭、蕩石，與飛相拒五十餘日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "47417ec0d132250f871eec4499700d196fef9341049ac8a6b985ce9a62cff1dc"}

{"id": "p_1d63b791cace2602", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 67, "text": "飛率精卒萬餘人，從他道邀郃軍交戰，山道迮狹，前後不得相救，飛遂破郃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "68eb8cca6a56b4aaaa27d1eadc26f6c695a0e25ac6f8006ece656922e16a08de"}

{"id": "p_d3aea2e23f215837", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 68, "text": "郃棄馬緣山，獨與麾下十餘人從間道退，引軍還南鄭，巴土獲安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "ebad1f020789b34a34b526a70d4abf42199dfdcf8bbcb350ce0270778c33c7de"}

{"id": "p_b8e7bea173ed32e1", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 69, "text": "先主為漢中王，拜飛為右將軍、假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "93cb8184b69784742dcc33d863a15179599f366b9190ad8a0bfda83d83b18943"}

{"id": "p_15d0f09cb47a735b", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 70, "text": "，遷車騎將軍，領司隸校尉，進封西鄉侯，策曰：「朕承天序，嗣奉洪業，除殘靖亂，未燭厥理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "5e21620609661d98b45033b3edcc26dac9874dac9539da1198b105c0f7fe537e"}

{"id": "p_51b002cb8d3f1480", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 71, "text": "今寇虜作害，民被荼毒，思漢之士，延頸鶴望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "954bbae0f2e965547cf94ff3127c47faf74becca2cfd43b6674f41bdc8ddce9c"}

{"id": "p_9ce63f753f072477", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 72, "text": "朕用怛然，坐不安席，食不甘味，整軍誥誓，將行天罰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "d5460c3ae64f51518ff48ef0b4f537c937258353978b2069e77357082425d54b"}

{"id": "p_13d69d231ccb3a24", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 73, "text": "以君忠毅，侔蹤召、虎，名宣遐邇，故特顯命，高墉進爵，兼司於京。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "293a791904e9fc770909de96cf29e5b07cfe897809e89b7d8211230e2f09e77e"}

{"id": "p_b2d26210367f47ef", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 74, "text": "其誕將天威，柔服以德，伐叛以刑，稱朕意焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "74c721d9da136a4375bd3d9b631313a7422d6bd3d62e30560e87578a94890415"}

{"id": "p_7f62668eded301bc", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 75, "text": "詩不-{云}-乎，『匪疚匪棘，王國來極。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "046330bc38ea58925cc00ab316a83a7fbd9c1a97883c73c88cfc3336404eabe7"}

{"id": "p_1b24aad4678eb3f0", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 76, "text": "初，飛雄壯威猛，亞於關羽，魏謀臣程昱等咸稱羽、飛萬人之敵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "2d9a87bcebae93db8627f6d8b5d7197029eee6409e0616a639da3862b897af0a"}

{"id": "p_98020c8cb5362eee", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 77, "text": "羽善待卒伍而驕於士大夫，飛愛敬君子而不恤小人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "f80d504c9ea6bc0e0c78d77103f6cc0f1cd52a8d73ab33c36aca5df6308f14a3"}

{"id": "p_37356d4ead465cfa", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 78, "text": "先主常戒之曰：「卿刑殺既過差，又日鞭撾健兒，而令在左右，此取禍之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "27ff1fd190cefafe02526ec4c92fe17ce99c60106d00bc717430a1d724497612"}

{"id": "p_3cecd04053836999", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 79, "text": "先主伐吳，飛當率兵萬人，自閬中會江州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "3b862720273f1aeb47e5bd2d648e79d0771885e3fd290b8ad03d88e3ea9afbaa"}

{"id": "p_d004e7421b111301", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 80, "text": "臨發，其帳下將張達、范彊殺飛，持其首，順流而奔孫權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "d9619ea7ae920c593341d7c2213f13a1533f9448fdea35888936511e50deb635"}

{"id": "p_ba65ded1ef07906e", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 81, "text": "飛營都督表報先主，先主聞飛都督之有表也，曰：「噫！", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "bb4f25dd00dd9b4eff2d13be40be0d21629e9243546ad08c936de2f976ca3ba8"}

{"id": "p_551153a84d3bca3f", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 82, "text": "次子紹嗣，官至侍中尙書僕射。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "9a7af2820c527330a348fc8b433d0de15483ee9cea33314030ce98d68e0a4c21"}

{"id": "p_d3b8574a79de4ab0", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 83, "text": "苞子遵爲尙書，隨諸葛瞻於緜竹，與鄧艾戰，死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "9208ed1d9970add0187bf89692327b9f6f7f3699498d5d714c18ca8dbaf9bd37"}

{"id": "p_3921a229a786d599", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 84, "text": "馬超字孟起，右扶風茂陵人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "cc182c8b06b1581fa1f13ddcf76e1cc6833493402c2b5aab1995252a7327cadc"}

{"id": "p_9e98f28864d6ed27", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 85, "text": "父騰，靈帝末與邊章、韓遂等俱起事於西州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "4943d57bb235f0eb216d1a29113e2704f8ef29159cfa7ecb26975aa1d76d189e"}

{"id": "p_f656cb337092c62d", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 86, "text": "漢朝以遂為鎮西將軍，遣還金城，騰為征西將軍，遣屯郿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "411c4a37db80c1047a8ce900a345fe17da5621945e371c335114729cb3c2441a"}

{"id": "p_b02b2924abd148e8", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 87, "text": "後騰襲長安，敗走，退還涼州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "88899fb8b6b0a2bb882b466c60966f0aef6771b5e54d801fa5abaee9e2276ae0"}

{"id": "p_c7c65f86c563e5e3", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 88, "text": "司隸校尉鍾繇鎮關中，移書遂、騰，為陳禍福。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "5faeb3610895bb51e517129d1db39c614e296108a0285b18b7c0dbde3d0bd8d9"}

{"id": "p_9e72c326589688f0", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 89, "text": "騰遣超隨繇討郭援、高幹於平陽，超將龐德親斬援首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "b499bce00c999028e1e1c4a83db0de7b73731d33b1fd2166b78d4852ed4125d9"}

{"id": "p_4773c58e3894a86b", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 90, "text": "後騰與韓遂不和，求還京畿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "4400c592a39459b12fae2be8140f1a1ab9517028be6e7f68b1714e3ce7481e7f"}

{"id": "p_08dff70289c0f63f", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 91, "text": "於是徵為衛尉，以超為偏將軍，封都亭侯，領騰部曲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "7ae1a3929320f70d87a92667f019da4974e78b6747502a3ecd9e55e17cc2b8cc"}

{"id": "p_41929b4a5385e162", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 92, "text": "超既統眾，遂與韓遂合從，及楊秋、李堪、成宜等相結，進軍至潼關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "207d9ecf98068584a915fd690619091d7f9175bb9fb3db82d3b45a29971b04d8"}

{"id": "p_2285da5049b60fdd", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 93, "text": "曹公與遂、超單馬會語，超負其多力，陰欲突前捉曹公，曹公左右將許褚瞋目盻之，超乃不敢動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "8cfeb6cef59fad327662109bed25382549a5a62ace651b3a97e557ec9ca1c37f"}

{"id": "p_ebaa176b70227f9a", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 94, "text": "曹公用賈詡謀，離間超、遂，更相猜疑，軍以大敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "b0ca1945b2a3ed212348ccd42244ff729415dc9023778c916fee75de2d0c0f7c"}

{"id": "p_c228e4f9f21fd269", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 95, "text": "超走保諸戎，曹公追至安定，會北方有事，引軍東還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "313351154c26a2a6495d6fd21f1b762aa69f3ecdd1c70442bef97d55c83dfb39"}

{"id": "p_309093ecfea1b91e", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 96, "text": "楊阜說曹公曰：「超有信、布之勇，甚得羌、胡心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "91e3a719fa336d6de333d7c80da39667c5965baf5389c4efb6b527b7b3237fd3"}

{"id": "p_2e0c7269907f8094", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 97, "text": "若大軍還，不嚴為其備，隴上諸郡非國家之有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "ca06e7df44df417f1156fa3361fb86cce4a235c11afcb2734bf9c4854579c4ce"}

{"id": "p_6191711eb02fad5b", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」超果率諸戎以擊隴上郡縣，隴上郡縣皆應之，殺涼州刺史韋康，據冀城，有其眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "2e149f5f1fdb6c77ad70e47664219b1f20e1983c8f8469ba92af8f2e753207eb"}

{"id": "p_3f5568c487c09158", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 99, "text": "超自稱征西將軍，領并州牧，督涼州軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "21beb47a6750cf82f788fce261d9c087d67e09d8c9b8391cc3b70422f1519e6c"}

{"id": "p_339d5d2e5dce9a4f", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 100, "text": "康故吏民楊阜、姜敘、梁寬、趙衢等，合謀擊超。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "f5d92ce0d929c1a04947b0fb65774519a22a2c7de0ab9bdb3899f2b0dee4adfa"}

{"id": "p_d877078c98907157", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 101, "text": "阜、敘起於鹵城，超出攻之，不能下；寬、衢閉冀城門，超不得入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "aa581bf3b76cb4494315302ac4ec9af7ed1f0f7539bb850d8a2adebe70058d20"}

{"id": "p_36917ba67e6f56a4", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 102, "text": "進退狼狽，乃奔漢中依張魯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "923358093942d528c9f4b863c58689a1f65c3f4b257d28fe96184062a7b71cec"}

{"id": "p_a785aa1507f739f1", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 103, "text": "魯不足與計事，內懷於邑，聞先主圍劉璋於成都，密書請降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "5e37ffd561116866938388adb26ae3d64b6584205369a77c9a6f6f11f6cf5099"}

{"id": "p_03ac1212e7ecc1e3", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 104, "text": "先主遣人迎超，超將兵徑到城下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "8e8da4fd40e0fc46074d01d9b63231ad9bc45908adad10d3a5ef9b93af4eb924"}

{"id": "p_9dbfb30135b31191", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 105, "text": "城中震怖，璋即稽首，以超為平西將軍，督臨沮，因為前都亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "fc8451098f764f6bf745305bee38f73ce16ffa3d7759f08b908a9b58b621b1ee"}

{"id": "p_adfc3f0997ad4c38", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 106, "text": "先主為漢中王，拜超為左將軍，假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "713eba74e74e72aca88ffb5da9f1774875c57e21af848e55c10449590140a81e"}

{"id": "p_b190cba58337f494", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 107, "text": "，遷驃騎將軍，領涼州牧，進封斄鄉侯，策曰：「朕以不德，獲繼至尊，奉承宗廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "7fa5d7b2984d6d8923ead0cf2fcc7bb7f5ce48cd70116b07121f1d2103a8eb0e"}

{"id": "p_80f340f5261fceb5", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 108, "text": "曹操父子，世載其罪，朕用慘怛，疢如疾首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "cabdb950613b1d54d5210d5b71cb460fbe1f47eaa15afa4e3f3b9a797015d603"}

{"id": "p_c8b275b7da3b421d", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 109, "text": "海內怨憤，歸正反本，暨於氐、羌率服，獯鬻慕義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "bd1f6626e07dc08795aa6b68eb1795d2ded4a0f99e40eeeb09d454b49c2c0b44"}

{"id": "p_3a40f51b0fecc7d9", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 110, "text": "以君信著北土，威武並昭，是以委任授君，抗颺虓虎，兼董萬里，求民之瘼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "37adfe4f0df19d3b7abd91cc7e0f71867c80140d0bbe5bb7cc6767238900ed1c"}

{"id": "p_f1f9028ab1d07196", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 111, "text": "其明宣朝化，懷保遠邇，肅慎賞罰，以篤漢祜，以對於天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "1192a7f94ac67e99100844922762a39434b98e876c2a6af7312c24c313fad07f"}

{"id": "p_397284ddb694e9a0", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 112, "text": "臨沒上疏曰：「臣門宗二百餘口，為孟德所誅略盡，惟有從弟岱，當為微宗血食之繼，深讬陛下，餘無複言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "d95be3f5eb5ceeea480fdfe672862892be5765d120885671910abf12687506c3"}

{"id": "p_1e1dae071c40454e", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」追諡超曰威侯，子承嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "37a044c61651a91803e7739b343b4c33596a7cd9f86fd471281413808e3de299"}

{"id": "p_5d21879185614e8e", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 114, "text": "岱位至平北將軍，進爵陳倉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "7bfa3f481e400c0b6bc3cd46b278dfb35b0a12971607235c9a770e6b75777210"}

{"id": "p_29997a129729c6d7", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 115, "text": "荊州牧劉表以為中郎將，與表從子磐共守長沙攸縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "759767d15db91091722907f0692e6fbe5da2469b4f69e7d332fe7ec74a08601b"}

{"id": "p_bbe62ede6e3a457f", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 116, "text": "及曹公克荊州，假行裨將軍，仍就故任，統屬長沙守韓玄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "f11416e27441a98a8e9b8490d192f51fe0bb45c8e5eac347113e5f70fea3a8f3"}

{"id": "p_e62f02f7340d10b6", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 117, "text": "先主南定諸郡，忠遂委質，隨從入蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "a1ee0d7c002f5f167ec4944bf6250636f01833b53242d05b676425a027a18a9e"}

{"id": "p_1420222da5ea76ba", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 118, "text": "自葭萌受任，還攻劉璋，忠常先登陷陣，勇毅冠三軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "b8c5aef8262d935aa06929e03a3a190462c7a16976bff21366a2872a9c648cad"}

{"id": "p_b5c4946721b68412", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 119, "text": "益州既定，拜為討虜將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "678766bd6dc53dadd404c57b8ac12e88598d1d06176e0b31ab25eaa6c0c0b0ac"}

{"id": "p_fa3f89f53a40eed5", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 120, "text": "，於漢中定軍山擊夏侯淵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "a834c2eb2a06af9396b7e43b0061fe1e210517af3ce9b6512f4c86a0520b40cb"}

{"id": "p_5b2b9b7534213a0b", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 121, "text": "淵眾甚精，忠推鋒必進，勸率士卒，金鼓振天，歡聲動谷，一戰斬淵，淵軍大敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "c2adc8371ce8117fef0f134973c3ca22d7b26b7af6781d48e546b6ba3f42b8c9"}

{"id": "p_ae00c19069589536", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 122, "text": "是歲，先主為漢中王，欲用忠為後將軍，諸葛亮說先主曰：「忠之名望，素非關、馬之倫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "9d445d176e87a4d8c5662e0e644f772090c910c74c2c0eb86b385b63ac76955e"}

{"id": "p_08d5367c1f0a6b69", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 123, "text": "馬、張在近，親見其功，尚可喻指；關遙聞之，恐必不悅，得無不可乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "a966f36e31962f2993ec9ba168c42cebb34eb41fed837ce116308a6e53056a68"}

{"id": "p_68effbe7d3e451c4", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 124, "text": "」先主曰：「吾自當解之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "87c4acb8dc7885df7be74ab051e696f582104108d623d24c10eb5f205bc7d517"}

{"id": "p_60f14bb656e4b6bd", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 125, "text": "」遂與羽等齊位，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "e83c11eb3c53cf6fa191f7dce0c36d3ab9940088d4cf5eb06dc20afb5dd7882c"}

{"id": "p_d0edb2f593589c1c", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 126, "text": "趙雲字子龍，常山真定人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "455bca8977f25df48d891221d8a9ae18558c0d20d4fba8dc08825facd31b4935"}

{"id": "p_a1cb2a2cfd28be48", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 127, "text": "本屬公孫瓚，瓚遣先主為田楷拒袁紹，雲遂隨從，為先主主騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "a416d239221d8a3f9e9484b0a1cfe478dfc297a70e6ef8a9f01001864c738092"}

{"id": "p_dc3eb1b0273089cb", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 128, "text": "及先主為曹公所追於當陽長阪，棄妻子南走，雲身抱弱子，即後主也，保護甘夫人，即後主母也，皆得免難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "3e11637a3f3cd067a6a078bff2c8acc2aea124d08417dcd9f4f46cc61eddb903"}

{"id": "p_3394fbf304340563", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 129, "text": "先主自葭萌還攻劉璋，召諸葛亮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "cff0446d7405b8d35139907aafddb1b056ec78c57d9c2ff3c42d72073388b952"}

{"id": "p_ee6f7060cdfb0f3a", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 130, "text": "亮率雲與張飛等俱溯江西上，平定郡縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "a5dc59a7518f56c5adec2630c5aecda7879bea81fc9025561b8ef2b27c3d0139"}

{"id": "p_769f3e9de57dbbdd", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 131, "text": "至江州，分遣雲從外水上江陽，與亮會於成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "3701a10ccf3a083d5b77fb81b3443f4c9d4b769ec637cd47d5e10d2c6c34026b"}

{"id": "p_ca02f0cbd01cc896", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 132, "text": "成都既定，以雲為翊軍將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "a3ef6c500a05ba39d1b3abf3cfd8e88ccfec96b9dff55d5c09eedcfa86977075"}

{"id": "p_b374a902ecb95478", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 133, "text": "，為中護軍、-{征}-南將軍，封永昌亭侯，遷鎮東將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "27dc408aa8c70e3307ff4048e35af479e498a27f183f93229c255296b312ea3d"}

{"id": "p_9db65a12a0724c51", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 134, "text": "明年，亮出軍，揚聲由斜谷道，曹真遣大眾當之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "1a263060b3a8324e56b0ea8caeac4b73201e49731cb269710a0181a714a1d8f8"}

{"id": "p_aea4a4c21b264ac5", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 135, "text": "亮令雲與鄧芝往拒，而身攻祁山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "4571afdc65388a7efb39af081c676285c167b657a4af233d094aa7663ac8ed84"}

{"id": "p_bafc0a54b098349d", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 136, "text": "雲、芝兵弱敵強，失利於箕谷，然斂眾固守，不至大敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "facd6808b6700b3c615e158670d0d0ac5d583e5a84908049dc444760b1ffbc0c"}

{"id": "p_bd08f905e3f2c6f8", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 137, "text": "初，先主時，惟法正見諡；後主時，諸葛亮功德蓋世，蔣琬、費禕荷國之重，亦見諡；陳祗寵待，特加殊獎，夏侯霸遠來歸國，故複得諡；於是關羽、張飛、馬超、龐統、黃忠及雲乃追諡，時論以為榮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "cb189d8aac98900eee01539d3dac7c01c62fa7f6d5cc5b4f79e8898f2f650801"}

{"id": "p_6bfe700a74c61fda", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 138, "text": "雲子統嗣，官至虎賁中郎，督行領軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "4ab538676f883a10c6c783e1c7bdde9d318575e5089b35ebf556bf35bcb866a8"}

{"id": "p_37478b52fb0d866e", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 139, "text": "次子廣，牙門將，隨姜維遝中，臨陳戰死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "a58d437a9438dc171a0dd1285085dc7efaa660bc0262c4256bcc607ebcb21cb2"}

{"id": "p_48566e6f1e3b65f7", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 140, "text": "評曰：關羽、張飛皆稱萬人之敵，為世虎臣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "40b00d1d7a3550ca96ec6f9d8f7c4e9271e3799d5fa7935756f87241440fea2d"}

{"id": "p_6134ac91b16468b2", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 141, "text": "羽報效曹公，飛義釋嚴顏，並有國士之風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "1802a51e5e6725167b47f15f2b9ad7b79474da1381e8b49c3fed0b3e6afa055b"}

{"id": "p_91314298e1091790", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 142, "text": "然羽剛而自矜，飛暴而無恩，以短取敗，理數之常也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "25136c9004fb1183e05c76de787917b84163e3724ee5bb0b0884e1315914f430"}

{"id": "p_b9c6c2f1e9bfb9d9", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 143, "text": "馬超阻戎負勇，以覆其族，惜哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "a33c25736043e81061fcab0c885fbd776a39d1cd251cfd5f41b21933595bf728"}

{"id": "p_a8b86acb5328903a", "source_id": "src_2ea883a54927d7ea", "ordinal": 144, "text": "黃忠、趙雲強摯壯猛，並作爪牙，其灌、滕之徒歟？", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "f5ba5e312df7a2934b09b7d91250d461cacbdb7b46ced8aee493a893af3e0382"}

{"id": "p_4ee2d8ab5dd24406", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_282bbe3434bc9de9", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 1, "text": "潁川司馬徽清雅有知人鑒，統弱冠往見徽，徽採桑於樹上，坐統在樹下，共語自晝至夜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "887f5708ad0ce8a31125b2ec4a40becd6878b82b7c219dbbe9283d32ea212a61"}

{"id": "p_9de934fdad481b4a", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 2, "text": "徽甚異之，稱統當南州士之冠冕，由是漸顯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "4e5063ee050a5272d289a249196c3397df3466ab05b6445fbae3dfce28932a47"}

{"id": "p_282e05e650a55cb4", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 3, "text": "每所稱述，多過其才，時人怪而問之，統答曰：「當今天下大亂，雅道陵遲，善人少而惡人多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "286c88ca3e54ff2a7cb29988f607d5d5bea634d6fb352f9e35dab2cfdbc87995"}

{"id": "p_4311859d64801dba", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 4, "text": "方欲興風俗，長道業，不美其譚即聲名不足慕企，不足慕企而為善者少矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "98fdf658efb3dd1ba49986cfd88adc83672607ee2acf16320896615f708ef277"}

{"id": "p_513db99291ff0731", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 5, "text": "今拔十失五，猶得其半，而可以崇邁世教，使有志者自勵，不亦可乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "011f3276a40062f6157d742d58059c7edf0dbd9381f431ed3be81cd72a7f78a5"}

{"id": "p_d9454f364ce16395", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」吳將周瑜助先主取荊州，因領南郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "fb776fc0665ebcb6630446816666ac4a2f3fc3bfb2a5d835fc3d53e4dd52a017"}

{"id": "p_f82e7f9a1e40812d", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 7, "text": "瑜卒，統送喪至吳，吳人多聞其名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "7e91299605ee75787389b8c05d60d68aaf12ca0735e57968e55ce5116aaff310"}

{"id": "p_82ba3937da1d95e2", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 8, "text": "及當西還，並會昌門，陸勣、顧劭、全琮皆往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "c9e07df0eaa890c693dda5353da47e36ebf202d8a8f26f7dc9da4948a5464c89"}

{"id": "p_d6119a3780c2481c", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 9, "text": "統曰：「陸子可謂駑馬有逸足之力，顧子可謂駑牛能負重致遠也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "6355e07f273dfbe7332e4989b008370bd1b7d6597b8316b41ea569569d285a0c"}

{"id": "p_4c6bc00327d92d54", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」謂全琮曰：「卿好施慕名，有似汝南樊子昭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "b49d1c0f664cc4ed0e8001cab892a722ed536c95b35e42e7b1aaedfa405861be"}

{"id": "p_15a5b10eb486396d", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 11, "text": "雖智力不多，亦一時之佳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "cf0d36d2b533dfae875bc2122011da654237ebda957bd34fb3af7f4585ea95c5"}

{"id": "p_8981442af8fb226f", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」績、劭謂統曰：「使天下太平，當與卿共料四海之士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "d105d3432b6b045b78db4573dcab1d7af01f6fb269b36781f45e33556736f181"}

{"id": "p_2a74d773f2a8e4dd", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 13, "text": "先主領荊州，統以從事守耒陽令，在縣不治，免官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "fb0a9953fefd53e89b231eefbaa55d3e7b25d0f1dac95d5b1bfa8a9b29151f79"}

{"id": "p_3bf5286b5c6c74dc", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 14, "text": "吳將魯肅遺先主書曰：「龐士元非百里才也，使處治中、別駕之任，始當展其驥足耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "bea433081eacb9cd59f7eeb621aff00109d64a6ff2783ae0969d3393e287fc19"}

{"id": "p_fa4e56080bf09d2a", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」諸葛亮亦言之於先主，先主見與善譚，大器之，以為治中從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "583c5006dc7bccc255bac73511810b37680fd6187b5b7135a71f35c2d97f5d6f"}

{"id": "p_54e565c09f0efcc4", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 16, "text": "親待亞於諸葛亮，遂與亮併為軍師中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "242ae54b7fc6b3452da9abbc5e7915c8fe3df0a588574c118dcb22337014896f"}

{"id": "p_74970f2ae0cc80b5", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 17, "text": "益州牧劉璋與先主會涪，統進策曰：「今因此會，便可執之，則將軍無用兵之勞而坐定一州也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "3518fc75bca1d370f1fbbf9480a985346bca4c39aaa6bb79610223dfab143215"}

{"id": "p_1d46e07f5545bac9", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 18, "text": "」先主曰：「初入他國，恩信未著，此不可也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "634642ab43c29abd6765e398aef07cbe25bab1edac0c2919b883b692ef2d364f"}

{"id": "p_c5cfffc5b3e4c421", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」璋既還成都，先主當為璋北征漢中，統復說曰：「陰選精兵，晝夜兼道，徑襲成都；璋既不武，又素無預備，大軍卒至，一舉便定，此上計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "b1f9b2f2b1b534353a54f8b9ea2a03b889e668942637ce7a5345258edf256059"}

{"id": "p_c0d889bb5ce24d0a", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 20, "text": "楊懷、高沛，璋之名將，各仗強兵，據守關頭，聞數有箋諫璋，使發遣將軍還荊州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "ea5cbe7e3003a8920a7e0564e3865b68ca97818296a98dce00d6988860a75ba3"}

{"id": "p_3e2c2b79f1791180", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 21, "text": "將軍未至，遣與相聞，說荊州有急，欲還救之，並使裝束，外作歸形；此二子既服將軍英名，又喜將軍之去，計必乘輕騎來見，將軍因此執之，進取其兵，乃向成都，此中計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "7fdf643ae89fe078a8053e0a301ca1b9c72c6cc7d0c4e8d67f75396ab4609267"}

{"id": "p_781f6c6e2607f020", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 22, "text": "退還白帝，連引荊州，徐還圖之，此下計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "320c21094bea9098ce71ec5f1b69df9dc7db8c93debdbd14af4870ac9222bf94"}

{"id": "p_4df382fc95c12a18", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 23, "text": "若沈吟不去，將致大困，不可久矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "20d03bb1b650da76a152683489c56dd40adeaa42c6407231834e662e8b47a75e"}

{"id": "p_38072e4fa82ef7ae", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」先主然其中計，即斬懷、沛，還向成都，所過輒克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "f25ceebbdf6068381b7a812d368e3da96c27ee0581b8fd1646e212b99ac214b3"}

{"id": "p_59f51a92eeb5900e", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 25, "text": "於涪大會，置酒作樂，謂統曰：「今日之會，可謂樂矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "4641b30a360cba05aab177cc28a80bb2cd1b5ea1d134df3967c249285466697d"}

{"id": "p_c99f80c0b4a5940a", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」統曰：「伐人之國而以為歡，非仁者之兵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "7e5ce756c0966e67e7af41ebb5a7088f4604d4d0261d9e141be370931388820d"}

{"id": "p_c15314ed0f9443a6", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」先主醉，怒曰：「武王伐紂，前歌后舞，非仁者邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "c60eba3da5256deffedf5c63ac28433a8600dbfcc4de8db999fcdd9c2168b57c"}

{"id": "p_3a9b16d319bf707d", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 28, "text": "統復故位，初不顧謝，飲食自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "8af665b70554316d9a9937d42dec6e3e004fb8b29d2ac97898beb25074f605a0"}

{"id": "p_6b1c70e7cb03c644", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 29, "text": "先主謂曰：「向者之論，阿誰為失？", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "fd5fa3640cbccb3efce40bd4736586456667b1ee7dad88108ad8d00e7d56fe50"}

{"id": "p_a8af3e29d61f52fb", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 30, "text": "進圍雒縣，統率眾攻城，為流矢所中，卒，時年三十六。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "33d6f5a82493f774ab4d32e8b0736c4bc66b9333b6611a17292670b88fdfc772"}

{"id": "p_5453a7fafa78f1c8", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 31, "text": "拜統父議郎，遷諫議大夫，諸葛亮親為之拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "b8014b519f98d463753ca599e2d263bd0e89928ac8ea54ac7540914416ec9589"}

{"id": "p_a6c41971ce2b8eb7", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 32, "text": "追賜統爵關內侯，諡曰靖侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "d541fd9b74fb7108f4817adb6a16513a2b8cc41b35e5927d314966ea7c1d719b"}

{"id": "p_4cf87267d84ac5de", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 33, "text": "統子宏，字巨師，剛簡有臧否，輕傲尚書令陳袛，為袛所抑，卒於涪陵太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "c371a43961adc6b9ec01fabddeb49ae6c7d3546bec6b201d46b60f866cc72d61"}

{"id": "p_50e84099a9dbf415", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 34, "text": "統弟林，以荊州治中從事參鎮北將軍黃權征吳，值軍敗，隨權入魏，魏封列侯，至鉅鹿太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "fa8a4f67f61796dd7fff865ba5347164b7d2cab55cf15cfda420f29180b0c815"}

{"id": "p_c930dcb5435260bc", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 35, "text": "法正字孝直，（右）扶風郿人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "c90bd75956c0e38917e9312702b770fb07c478be0041df660d4a4e513c768b09"}

{"id": "p_fc699163c051a795", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 36, "text": "建安初，天下饑荒，正與同郡孟達俱入蜀依劉璋，久之為新都令，後召署軍議校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "1d85986db5967744d0f14ee98185f6a04ae6dd3325e134e83f6d6a819e192783"}

{"id": "p_ce4dc7434563634a", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 37, "text": "既不任用，又為其州邑俱僑客者所謗無行，志意不得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "c533b21ae27992841bcf12019a0d570330d56a487a92b4555fb6d50738c98114"}
