{"id": "p_bbf9c8071599270f", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 38, "text": "益州別駕張松與正相善，忖璋不足與有為，常竊嘆息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "c837d5d49af7c0101ad35291de0459acd1132e90c754329e517fe7dc2c26de37"}

{"id": "p_7cf6dd6bf7b0faa5", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 39, "text": "松於荊州見曹公還，勸璋絕曹公而自結先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "9510fd85253e9b842147a6aa2fabded7be63446b121400677400fc21bcf9a77a"}

{"id": "p_ed99ec55ccf8c1ef", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」松乃舉正，正辭讓，不得已而往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "adef3e28a661e4f750cd556f0974ec2825075606955a8f2be0b750ae96890360"}

{"id": "p_f518943cf0f5b04c", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 41, "text": "正既還，為松稱說先主有雄略，密謀協規，原共戴奉，而未有緣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "7aa61320c6d3df6daa0a917acfbe8e91967745054b48d8944f7769f6cc3159de"}

{"id": "p_3f433732034ec635", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 42, "text": "後因璋聞曹公欲遣將征張魯之有懼心也，松遂說璋宜迎先主，使之討魯，復令正銜命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "be03c615b5609d58b36316aeb6ce137b4e105dbf96e333b96ec98ca14aee3e64"}

{"id": "p_e62499043ed384c1", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 43, "text": "正既宣旨，陰獻策於先主曰：「以明將軍之英才，乘劉牧之懦弱；張松，州之股肱，以響應於內；然後資益州之殷富，馮天府之險阻，以此成業，猶反掌也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "2c869e54b28af52dd315e08eed02693cbb91170b76c7b52f779437956599cce3"}

{"id": "p_1f6da88eb80fea99", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 44, "text": "」先主然之，溯江而西，與璋會涪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "92b5b884bc67f96bed188790e4e64eb370e680f525073c5f82f05218c169aba3"}

{"id": "p_3379e31251b30e4a", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 45, "text": "鄭度說璋曰：「左將軍縣軍襲我，兵不滿萬，士眾未附，野谷是資，軍無輜重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "fcfcdfc3893ce7f5694eeffaa0fa7d245678f1a1c2ba2d83f41893dd7c13f9fa"}

{"id": "p_539783193a869654", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 46, "text": "其計莫若盡驅巴西、梓潼民內涪水以西，其倉廩野谷，一皆燒除，高壘深溝，靜以待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "bbb586c80a058107b6a64b3c74ef0d1b5d431de6667bef6a3bb41bd444e6640e"}

{"id": "p_d2200d649c1cdb8f", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 47, "text": "彼至，請戰，勿許，久無所資，不過百日，必將自走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "85e09c051d67d3f6dbb6af182b93d5f5964ed66428b4193d5fc5870d73d17525"}

{"id": "p_1c98f134e53fc940", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 48, "text": "」先主聞而惡之，以問正。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "b51148d8df506db7bdc1acc77555aee996d38a80d2661eb52e8e61ab563331d6"}

{"id": "p_37f7adf6875b30d7", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 49, "text": "正曰：「終不能用，無可憂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "f2712278a5b1a406d139180f8e5218f73adfee481549c5aff8012eaa3796583d"}

{"id": "p_0a51cee4dd043960", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」璋果如正言，謂其群下曰：「吾聞拒敵以安民，未聞動民以避敵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "a710b14307f577e76c4f56999bf9d11dd8f4aedbf5de15c8674375264c3b7bc9"}

{"id": "p_f067b1ea3cadfb68", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 51, "text": "及軍圍雒城，正箋與璋曰：「正受性無術，盟好違損，懼左右不明本末，必並歸咎，蒙恥沒身，辱及執事，是以損身於外，不敢反命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "06a83410d2d0424cb92a8de587ffde69e86414e99737893625156fc314ebe7b0"}

{"id": "p_bd767f6f94111093", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 52, "text": "恐聖聽穢惡其聲，故中間不有箋敬，顧念宿遇，瞻望悢々。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "8613cfd6974790a60feea53295ce792540eb07dff9785d1d52fc973157092b20"}

{"id": "p_d1da7787f4be3d74", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 53, "text": "然惟前後披露腹心，自從始初以至於終，實不藏情，有所不盡，但愚闇策薄，精誠不感，以致於此耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "c182ec48d1e690280b4cf0c9876651dcc4d87f04c578f22719d463f6386b0638"}

{"id": "p_ce4281c69b8f1f14", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 54, "text": "今國事已危，禍害在速，雖捐放於外，言足憎尤，猶貪極所懷，以盡餘忠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "2850f0f86b023f565c1c478a824e182a73a5c679e9018116abb55008a565f5f8"}

{"id": "p_51409fa90ca2d603", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 55, "text": "明將軍本心，正之所知也，實為區區不欲失左將軍之意，而卒至於是者，左右不達英雄從事之道，謂可違信黷誓，而以意氣相致，日月相遷，趨求順耳悅目，隨阿遂指，不圖遠慮為國深計故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "f72ae7740159a6077cdfeb9d1234747409cf6ffa4b9ac96ae335727193ea1f2c"}

{"id": "p_a90658a5a992da4d", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 56, "text": "事變既成，又不量強弱之勢，以為左將軍縣遠之眾，糧谷無儲，欲得以多擊少，曠日相持。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "941248620275195bc674020aef5d20c44010e14f08fa8696f9b6060b776f8731"}

{"id": "p_d3719da8f08ed015", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 57, "text": "而從關至此，所歷輒破，離宮別屯，日自零落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "13e75deb29db0e88960d1aff518eb82d93f21238fecd71e3dfd15a813395bfa4"}

{"id": "p_2202d33f7eff08fc", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 58, "text": "雒下雖有萬兵，皆壞陳之卒，破軍之將，若欲爭一旦之戰，則兵將勢力，實不相當。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "359354771c35cec1058de171a4c248464b9952519fd3d012f6c515df1c723ebd"}

{"id": "p_83d1c6bf05c1022c", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 59, "text": "各欲遠期計糧者，今此營守已固，谷米已積，而明將軍土地日削，百姓日困，敵對遂多，所供遠曠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "ce17d28c657bb569bc588a14849b17b908f31a0d415ff7ad36092fac812d09bb"}

{"id": "p_0cd051e70a6b8b0c", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 60, "text": "愚意計之，謂必先竭，將不復以持久也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "f8714d5701537cd636525fa1f654657d28ccc54f991a6f25191668b376b4c6af"}

{"id": "p_25d860c4db40092b", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 61, "text": "空爾相守，猶不相堪，今張益德數萬之眾，已定巴東，入犍為界，分平資中、德陽，三邈道侵，將何以御之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "67e2b42a4b4163f60ae5138c6201acdbdaf09f36c7a922636a0c1ee2dcab94b7"}

{"id": "p_20500ff47fe0586b", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 62, "text": "本為明將軍計者，必謂此軍縣遠無糧，饋運不及，兵少無繼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "3a07190186fa506774b242a6e102cd83d7bf04a0c6d20ec4e2ec30edc5403b6b"}

{"id": "p_779dfb84829d223d", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 63, "text": "今荊州道通，眾數十倍，加孫車騎遣弟及李異、甘寧等為其後繼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "f5604225a9094e8d9b2adb86bebda678ff1eca43552760f3202026d165e02804"}

{"id": "p_a88bac7cc009e87d", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 64, "text": "若爭客主之勢，以土地相勝者，今此全有巴東，廣漢、犍為，過半已定，巴西一郡，復非明將軍之有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "b90c802907eb923c88eaab99866ef69119c7752b6d222c02578b4f9358dc61d7"}

{"id": "p_33bb76e6cd1a6d96", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 65, "text": "計益州所仰惟蜀，蜀亦破壞；三分亡二，吏民疲睏，思為亂者十戶而八；若敵遠則百姓不能堪役，敵近則一旦易主矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "22b798e00a473ee9b903485d5f360e81fe992968db96f6729427c0561fdddb2d"}

{"id": "p_4f42cc51696645d1", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 66, "text": "又魚復與關頭實為益州福禍之門，今二門悉開，堅城皆下，諸軍並破，兵將俱盡，而敵家數道併進，已入心腹，坐守都、雒，存亡之勢，昭然可見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "ac99e66872967d36a9a9914055e1695926dfc5284ce4d04d3b826ab0559b8250"}

{"id": "p_cb150eda8429ead2", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 67, "text": "斯乃大略，其外較耳，其餘屈曲，難以辭極也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "a48648e5ca77c8e5891a10ba5002c89ea0b8fa1074b76887a397af01ea36d3b8"}

{"id": "p_255c4b3d88285aa1", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 68, "text": "以正下愚，猶知此事不可覆成，況明將軍左右明智用謀之士，豈當不見此數哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "15dfbbe0a8a51b345253614458ff5a42c69d2e3c56e4dacfea3b4f3ee5796533"}

{"id": "p_d42be263f12f9d40", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 69, "text": "旦夕偷幸，求容取媚，不慮遠圖，莫肯盡心獻良計耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "b5927c9dacab23a05acd1a4725fa1cf1e0805d9b85c25a7fbb6537d09bab8a7b"}

{"id": "p_218e66c6d8c9c568", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 70, "text": "若事窮勢迫，將各索生，求濟門戶，展轉反覆，與今計異，不為明將軍盡死難也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "10300f67532e82b36cc4d2de8ca63ce590e3da4966ee8266fe7e1e1e2e9877ad"}

{"id": "p_6465cf74509b743b", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 71, "text": "正雖獲不忠之謗，然心自謂不負聖德，顧惟分義，實竊痛心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "7efa968091baffa764cfb75619362ecdb4ff0f2276b547dc937e1cedf676f20a"}

{"id": "p_84d91f875d3fbe28", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 72, "text": "左將軍從本舉來，舊心依依，實無薄意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "4584c0ebbbdd010e7a7d620653022944b7fe6dfa6f2bfbe5a5c78996a43f6a67"}

{"id": "p_569f5e3cabc37a1f", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 73, "text": "愚以為可圖變化，以保尊門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "634cc9e0c8015d7246dd0596ec58046faeaba5cf86c4bc028ac573dfbf18962a"}

{"id": "p_4c07bfffff19ea8a", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 74, "text": "」十九年，進圍成都，璋蜀郡太守許靖將逾城降，事覺，不果。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "9ecaebe3b6ccee2ce24300490e44ab022599d2396fdb3bd8857416d3e5164485"}

{"id": "p_66f4a592bfece5e1", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 75, "text": "璋以危亡在近，故不誅靖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "aa82911db3ef3ce66ed2c7aa968d15ec8d5510413a47185d0ec758b54335ce6b"}

{"id": "p_f2e94e32e06db9d9", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 76, "text": "璋既稽服，先主以此薄靖不用也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "8982e489cf0bebe5e5367079d7ef9bce837232cdf099eac68371cbffcd081b4c"}

{"id": "p_24d5a58ba63aceec", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 77, "text": "正說曰：「天下有獲虛譽而無其實者，許靖是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "759a1e6166e641669ad302b6dd837fecc4ad16f22f4f794afa1363fc978778af"}

{"id": "p_58f397351c73af80", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 78, "text": "然今主公始創大業，天下之人不可戶說，靖之浮稱，播流四海，若其不禮，天下之人以是謂主公為賤賢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "38330741eb1300c1d0349c91339b1dff8abd42b837e4118f2feac5b0bf8dd316"}

{"id": "p_bcab393d99821243", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 79, "text": "宜加敬重，以眩遠近，追昔燕王之待郭隗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "8f511e90fd4b648541faa3c51742c5f0006fa97291d650b3069bf075ab1a4429"}

{"id": "p_7a677351465fca89", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 80, "text": "以正為蜀郡太守、揚武將軍，外統都畿，內為謀主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "2c0a997f82f90428ea16aaed8b601e5abab7eaa0ab0cc6de09aac09a119d9387"}

{"id": "p_d3b92befe461956d", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 81, "text": "一餐之德，睚眥之怨，無不報復，擅殺毀傷己者數人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "de4d3a2832db172c48509d443feef79c99f149cd5090bbaf3099875acf75e108"}

{"id": "p_4aeb2d305b954541", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 82, "text": "或謂諸葛亮曰：「法正於蜀郡太縱橫，將軍宜啟主公，抑其威福。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "5776d7db6a929e95e3b7b7c313bc93514d92185b60f6fe5e35570a15cc67b781"}

{"id": "p_a136a0456df0fc67", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 83, "text": "」亮答曰：「主公之在公安也，北畏曹公之強，東憚孫權之逼，近則懼孫夫人生變於肘腋之下；當斯之時，進退狼跋，法孝直為之輔翼，令翻然翱翔，不可復制，如何禁止法正使不得行其意邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "4f81804ba43cebd59e8e574ff0097d67c23b8e119fad409833cc7e9d41b269a9"}

{"id": "p_93bca3c70f41641c", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」初，孫權以妹妻先主，妹才捷剛猛，有諸兄之風，侍婢百餘人，皆親執刀侍立，先主每入，衷心常凜凜；亮又知先主雅愛信正，故言如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "47eebe357f540d9aad5682c6fba96fc4fd89fd71d2a52470a0072a2b9df20d01"}

{"id": "p_355fbdb22e9b842e", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 85, "text": "二十二年，正說先主曰：「曹操一舉而降張魯，定漢中，不因此勢以圖巴、蜀，而留夏侯淵、張郃屯守，身遽北還，此非其智不逮而力不足也，必將內有憂偪故耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "08028075b50ed2939bdc041f894a2a3cb5da713dde334a21650e9923d1876678"}

{"id": "p_45264c30237f1095", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 86, "text": "今策淵、郃才略，不勝國之將帥，舉眾往討，則必可克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "4281f1e5ae64ced56006e54fa2cdb5cce83ffc7fa6820eaf8c021860a7072ba7"}

{"id": "p_39ba84e305e2a6f5", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 87, "text": "之克〔克之〕之日，廣農積谷，觀釁伺隙，上可以傾覆寇敵，尊獎王室，中可以蠶食雍、涼，廣拓境土，下可以固守要害，為持久之計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "a8054255fe9c17d02cf1479c66a3cd48a7e97e796bd043f87ad84056c38e0d5c"}

{"id": "p_9186ab9668c38d88", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 88, "text": "此蓋天以與我，時不可失也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "a5411c95b52551f44651711c02f344bbc7937b9691c76f55200330b5594f2e04"}

{"id": "p_5fe139315e324b2e", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 89, "text": "」先主善其策，乃率諸將進兵漢中，正亦從行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "29ce06ccf8a9cbc7d788408c0be148f8eea67110bfb5b435a8e99be2c0833a92"}

{"id": "p_46fab7321190b078", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 90, "text": "二十四年，先主自陽平南渡沔水，緣山稍前，於定軍、興勢作營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "d21a3f193cbfbb070e09a9122eb35b1a6328fb576006e4af8b6658af958235c1"}

{"id": "p_2d5ad04b3dedc196", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 91, "text": "」先主命黃忠乘高鼓譟攻之，大破淵軍，淵等授首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "18abeb9526cd83725669606fe09d22d25fca635ac7acc2de2a328613130a4edd"}

{"id": "p_8a58940391f48a5e", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 92, "text": "曹公西征，聞正之策，曰：「吾故知玄德不辦有此，必為人所教也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "e4ea03682c01c2d476f099db7bff162e381b7f1599c3e584bc87a49a69619679"}

{"id": "p_c331145d284795b5", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 93, "text": "先主立為漢中王，以正為尚書令、護軍將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "353964e8fc54ae6c22356808258177ea4f3a50e7e2528c5686164619ecf646b0"}

{"id": "p_73693529d1badc12", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 94, "text": "賜子邈爵關內侯，官至奉車都尉、漢陽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "63369880245027e41f0eb67096f541ab3dde9298b399c5ca92aad78fce252bcb"}

{"id": "p_77823d19c8ecdc53", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 95, "text": "諸葛亮與正，雖好尚不同，以公義相取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "0dd537f3a753a4b3e48611d4a4812232b7c3a38455f6f8e354f4081e61828164"}

{"id": "p_6b19322b04671405", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 96, "text": "先主既即尊號，將東征孫權以復關羽之恥，群臣多諫，一不從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "682d098445f4a25582b800a3fae61d0d506043de3e7214f4c4b97b17e3865f2e"}

{"id": "p_5da8799322dd0048", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 97, "text": "亮嘆曰：「法孝直若在，則能制主上，令不東行；就復東行，必不傾危矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "5cb293fa668372ec5b658ddacf9cd829c71e991c0bd1f22f0c72332a7a58dec5"}

{"id": "p_203d7977d241a011", "source_id": "src_f7ccae560a70d8fe", "ordinal": 98, "text": "評曰：龐統雅好人流，經學思謀，于時荊﹑楚謂之高俊．法正著見成敗，有奇畫策算，然不以德素稱也．儗之魏臣，統其荀彧之仲叔，正其程﹑郭之儔儷邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "d89af98ae5e62d287d9a6baa23e7b7f94d45750f6863ad75d4bad1180c72d1ea"}

{"id": "p_ced1fee01e5ac30a", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_de956fac90c66f2d", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 1, "text": "許靖字文休，汝南平輿人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "fbfbc90e81f2102e89f85d1baa0840ec3ded1ce2305fc84262728dac8b717cf8"}

{"id": "p_4ce4ae76d8e1c1d0", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 2, "text": "少與從弟劭俱知名，並有人倫臧否之稱，而私情不協。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "105ea1620e2946e50015068d6f2263cb87b2cf8f587983008e0aae80fc54995e"}

{"id": "p_af3a569353ded38e", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 3, "text": "劭為郡功曹，排擯靖不得齒敘，以馬磨自給。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "fd7062a431e99a858e8d61d61aba06a6a54403cd8f175e9f563aa6bb7195097a"}

{"id": "p_2036fcac1a6b945d", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 4, "text": "颍川劉翊為汝南太守，乃舉靖計吏，察孝廉，除尚書郎，典選舉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "7109d86d20d152caf419479bd700a9ececd19ece91e7f3b98f05b5c0d3ba7ced"}

{"id": "p_1ce23a2bd91a905f", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 5, "text": "靈帝崩，董卓秉政，以漢陽周毖為吏部尚書，與靖共謀議，進退天下之士，沙汰穢濁，顯拔幽滯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "2e76c1911a5d6cdb3928027ee113ffd2817c8e4c362ddfa5c5927a0050e360e1"}

{"id": "p_d5157b3c547590b4", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 6, "text": "進用颍川荀爽、韓融、陳紀等為公、卿、郡守，拜尚書韓馥為冀州牧，侍中劉岱為兗州剌史，颍川張咨為南陽太守，陳留孔伷為豫州剌史，東郡張邈為陳留太守，而遷靖巴郡太守，不就，補御史中丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "96584bb0780c1ce456d6f267d47bf19f05be09f0597ce6ecde5ca382db84bb7e"}

{"id": "p_214993f9f3d474f2", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 7, "text": "馥等到官，各舉兵還向京都，欲以誅卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "6baed2c154d52135ab4acc3d2752398ad5fb399326e773d7a9fedfc14aee4043"}

{"id": "p_2bc2ac8b0524ff94", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 8, "text": "卓怒毖曰︰「諸君言當拔用善士，卓從諸君計，不欲違天下人心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "d77103c3f3d9f7c3ecaa34b9aa377b61cbba62915b9f19d43ac9db449bf94253"}

{"id": "p_b2541a5bc83c6a76", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 9, "text": "而諸君所用人，至官之日，還來相圖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "36bf88872eec1e2e4473479d539788f6a7dd09bed4543be7f8255e6a1a61c509"}

{"id": "p_d11551dcdd0323c7", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 10, "text": "靖從兄陳相玚，又與伷合規，靖懼誅，奔伷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "de1f41bfc4bd92dae1a906c46d0a50e949612038799f780b82b05d5d8736ba98"}

{"id": "p_df4c73bb1bd3cc63", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 11, "text": "祎死，吳郡都尉許貢、會稽太守王朗素與靖有舊，故往保焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "38d89b687ea040bec14df2b024f4fee2ee7c2b91e31ddfe280a87aac56d2b57c"}

{"id": "p_84d94b20af36c5e0", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 12, "text": "靖收恤親裡，經紀振贍，出于仁濃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "098003ee8692e487e84563a78e0209beeefc0209b25b8820359b8aaf88c4395a"}

{"id": "p_6fedb517ea751640", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 13, "text": "孫策東渡江，皆走交州以避其難，靖身坐崖邊，先載附從，疏親悉發，乃從后去，當時見者莫不嘆息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "e831abd192df2d42e1b67707607ce0412a0f7b7e1b5bf6a2b446b8d29bad51cc"}

{"id": "p_d5d313c76d8001cc", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 14, "text": "既至交阯，交阯太守士燮濃加敬待。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "85bd90a0699e596c3e58fd6f8e5a7fb302e9e54d7780f706e65c44fee0697091"}

{"id": "p_ebe7b9aac09a3615", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 15, "text": "陳國袁徽以寄寓交州，徽與尚書令荀彧書曰︰「許文休英才偉士，智略足以計事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "c1b66902c996ceb656481af39202df9b1e8f8393744c4d691093f846b442fec0"}

{"id": "p_f84e298dcacca1ef", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 16, "text": "自流宕已來，與群士相隨，每有患急，常先人后已，與九族中外同其飢寒流。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "48c2c90b369c7b654f435d22757a24ef86eddbe8d427e9d774b55fd30b1c3637"}

{"id": "p_eda327cc680758af", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 17, "text": "其紀綱同類，仁恕惻隱，皆有效事，不能複一二陳之耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "b529e443719e2bf6f9c8d8dd4c4b11e04a2d769a17b980caa4689996f9a000cb"}

{"id": "p_2a7d4e58a563c2c7", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 18, "text": "」巨鹿張翔銜王命使交部，乘勢募靖，欲與誓要，靖拒而不許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "c4bb839726f8319c5b02aed80b2ca86955251ea036716ca308f504ddc8da9d58"}

{"id": "p_b5c7f2c2e0210a08", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 19, "text": "翔恨靖之不自納，搜索靖所寄書疏，盡投之于水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "7d72d3c37bafc719427d977349afc29161cdc43aab9177551d459ddecad2e67a"}

{"id": "p_e344761f4426b97c", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 20, "text": "後劉璋遂使使招靖，靖來入蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "119e3dd13d4166394fb42e9dea35045bd2b66c60016001279b9c7ffd4fc1b246"}

{"id": "p_5dba883706ff666b", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 21, "text": "璋以靖為巴郡、廣漢太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "e87844de1e2d95607b325cb016e835d2956ad7950e562bc86ce89265b9e786b3"}

{"id": "p_5853b7e963bba051", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 22, "text": "南陽宋仲子于荊州與蜀郡太守王商書曰︰「文休倜儻瑰瑋，有當世之具，足下當以為指南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "7c2977f6826ab80f4b021ccf4eaf6248d0cd54fc0c80528cf66586f41e9b38c6"}

{"id": "p_78dd09237895881e", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 23, "text": "十九年，先主克蜀，以靖為左將軍長史，先主為漢中王，靖為太傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "d48adf5b3e10ba7b50ec60d363c53861b6dc642dee30a6141dbd9a50a0f67868"}

{"id": "p_033b39b1702ffff0", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 24, "text": "及即尊號，策靖曰︰「聯獲奉洪業，君臨萬國，夙宵惶惶，懼不能綏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "befe090c14656d33b93251fd132fa2bf7db982f7c3da2d5e3cd369dd59e229da"}

{"id": "p_4e6a7da40780aacf", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 25, "text": "百姓不親，五品不遜，汝作司徒，其敬敷五教，在寬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "5666e6a32af23591da9deb27e54bfc934488434ef62704fd0d012ca3bfee69e5"}

{"id": "p_37900c0d0edb882e", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 26, "text": "君其勖哉﹗秉德無怠，稱聯意焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "27fb1ddd6785ea82673c5d35dc6c117ff07f5251e9a48abb09078075a98fb849"}

{"id": "p_308347cf7470e8d4", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 27, "text": "靖雖年逾七十，愛樂人物，誘納后進，清談不倦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "6012cae864242bbc582203fa8b6db2597cc07974533274eecd896bc62d38a1e0"}

{"id": "p_cc24643e9905b321", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 28, "text": "始靖兄事颍川陳紀，與陳郡袁渙、平原華歆、東海王朗等親善，歆、朗及紀子群，魏初為公輔大臣，咸與靖書，申陳舊好，情義款至，文多故不載。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "f07e18f2a1c978eab0f2e707d1afbe131050c2db2017591edaf66e9f7416a44b"}

{"id": "p_6ecf36e2f7d6883f", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 29, "text": "麋竺字子仲，東海朐人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "437d6f66695ac65c24b3f356ca54eafab1640d581171271dc3e11b85916e2145"}

{"id": "p_0d0e0f62d1547cd8", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 30, "text": "祖世貨殖，僮客萬人，貲產鉅億。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "309c3b0cea926d74d65c7e5b514db5fbf7ce3b822f1fefc433b543dae0c39b4a"}

{"id": "p_11e96056e82bc233", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 31, "text": "后徐州牧陶謙辟為別駕從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "b95977ee89759abbed3a2881eb12ad0da767366ffb016379c72be405b3c7ca04"}

{"id": "p_d5708c2b762460e9", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 32, "text": "謙卒，竺奉謙遺命，迎先主于小沛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "2f0ff996a1dcbcc25ce73744d55f977d6f87b9813613526a2253bf96add12e6e"}

{"id": "p_2d46a7a663ce742a", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 33, "text": "，呂布乘先主之出拒袁術，襲下邳，虜先主妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "9292375db3ca998e9dd1ca1fc7930eb88b9cb60f0d592f8b400f07bfa13d9da8"}

{"id": "p_2e2097d09447bff4", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 34, "text": "先主轉軍廣陵海西，竺于是進妹于先主為夫人，奴客二千，金銀貨幣以助軍資，于時困匱，賴此複振。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "4fdd4c43eda13ed3e8f8ed9275983bff31f7196325d56aa31c3916530ba19d3b"}

{"id": "p_ce168a3625aedb38", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 35, "text": "后曹公表竺領嬴郡太守，竺弟芳為彭城相，皆去官，隨先主周旋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "027e14f6565cff682469056915d5ad6a2a5f28ee130c952a0f794e2f32b7a26b"}

{"id": "p_6ae1b1a8a2d05f87", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 36, "text": "先主將適荊州，遣竺先與劉表相聞，以竺為左將軍從事中郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "2fe910c922afe9f95aed370067dc6a7f9183b49fef12bf8bb9c81243d5526feb"}

{"id": "p_269664fb7dbf38a8", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 37, "text": "益州既平，拜為安漢將軍，班在軍師將軍之右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "8222f9548dfadfaaa01c736162367bc7a2b1c4166277d25eae17250eae750576"}

{"id": "p_e45fa460dfa17e5e", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 38, "text": "竺雍容敦雅，而干翮非所長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "9a3bc0755c28135b366cd964ba73351d7a010f1116690cfd6a169323ea1ed8d6"}

{"id": "p_0d2168ce32de8e11", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 39, "text": "是以待之以上賓之禮，未嘗有所統御。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "b99a9485d8ce14a54757a52654c3584a18e8c04910a61f2d3f95f2037fce0a12"}

{"id": "p_9989d8ee42afec17", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 40, "text": "芳為南郡太守，與關羽共事，而私好攜貳，叛迎孫權，羽因覆敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "eee7cd075bbe47dd400116dfcaca53c6edc9419931af9b5b867c9fc9ca58d1a6"}

{"id": "p_c6583da565c1884e", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 41, "text": "竺面縛請罪，先主慰諭以兄弟罪不相及，崇待如初。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "9f0648eb7377ce2ffd4f0054b25af243730ebb288c084af5dced8aa113919d91"}

{"id": "p_31ea823f1e0c1ca9", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 42, "text": "自竺至照，皆便弓馬，善射御-{云}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "66f48b5c9dc8bc3fde938a7cfc76a71e11c77fce3990c194254c2444702e6dc3"}

{"id": "p_eb2b628905d8ac80", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 43, "text": "孫-{乾}-字公佑，北海人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "953cba90b3299a1553288c1642cfbace57380fa0a0764152819f01f1564ec98a"}

{"id": "p_14b7fc20098d00d5", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 44, "text": "先主領徐州，辟為從事，后隨從周旋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "6c5dbff0fc841a9d16ed73757b15ffdb83ca9ae5d05585db9dcfee484f678813"}

{"id": "p_52212b5a38c4fbff", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 45, "text": "先主之背曹公，遣-{乾}-自結袁紹，將適荊州，-{乾}-又與麋竺俱使劉表，皆如意指。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "223b7c05dd045f86d13ab7f92bf9d1598d2877d07eb72274736c59232b9ae102"}

{"id": "p_2ff27226515d4645", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 46, "text": "后表與袁尚書，說其兄弟分爭之變，曰︰「每與劉左將軍、孫公佑共論此事，未嘗不痛心入骨，相為悲傷也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "3cf1c388505b9c4eab99c04935af199df1e29a1d22e34a8da94eb8fda5bac9bd"}

{"id": "p_3573dd9538ab5855", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 47, "text": "先主定益州，-{乾}-自從事中郎為秉忠將軍，見禮次麋竺，與簡雍同等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "44363537f54acb94b1f01edaa3683d65c993af1562452d32f607ea3236689ed3"}

{"id": "p_8317c489ffe28c48", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 48, "text": "少與先主有舊，隨從周旋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "4a861feddd00796793b02c0f5e2d1bbaf53ba935214491af2cf13b73afea9853"}

{"id": "p_768f069ef0d2d14c", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 49, "text": "先主至荊州，雍與麋竺、孫乾同爲從事中郎，常爲談客，往來使命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "7f21a3e23da1adaa3309b80318a1d00d44aa73ce3c4df95595cfe5746abff74d"}

{"id": "p_d0424c5882461bcb", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 50, "text": "先主入益州，劉璋見雍，甚愛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "48d227e5cfc517688195354f9672f3ce3d9f0eef76ec00fea0b2710d315f667b"}

{"id": "p_9dae24f3eecaa64a", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 51, "text": "後先主圍成都，遣雍往說璋，璋遂與雍同輿而載，出城歸命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "822d25104b1011559a6e5d9a00c07a8242b0592ae53823bb5f5693da63d2754f"}

{"id": "p_5016f4ae68c8188d", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 52, "text": "優游風儀，性簡傲跌宕，在先主坐席，猶箕踞傾倚，威儀不肅，自縱適；諸葛亮已下則獨擅一榻，項枕卧語，無所爲屈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "592baf4e127ba400651d4860ab063ded4155ae35f3d54b73b3cbded61b4937d3"}

{"id": "p_6c3ed454b25b1b87", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 53, "text": "吏於人家索得釀具，論者欲令與作酒者同罰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "0284020add757e3005182be7d492da1a6577a0da5a02ba7be9e38a0e1627fec1"}

{"id": "p_1902be400799ce71", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 54, "text": "雍與先主游觀，見一男女行道，謂先主曰：「彼人欲行淫，何以不縛？", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "4a656ccd930d04d7b5731ea2415ecc6f5e3b10c224529af665d0eaa22073492d"}

{"id": "p_c97d63fcf683e636", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」先主曰：「卿何以知之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "c54ca8aaa1daa9728c08c2e92abdaec29da99b258f3516adc81dae7e49f84046"}

{"id": "p_64f04179f3d4f2f4", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 56, "text": "」雍對曰：「彼有其具，與欲釀者同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "75314eb2dd68a0b56ca95e33bf2c0425c4a9edce541f67f55772232c3940c6fd"}

{"id": "p_65c3bdb2785aa2c2", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 58, "text": "先主之在荊州，籍常往來自托。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "263a7fe531b1292233da0472ed993e4a9488325a75c0635fef126550120ac331"}

{"id": "p_042ef67de06c33b6", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 59, "text": "表卒，遂隨先主南渡江，從入益州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "f70e824abd186416f10eae7df17478bb5d78ec792228dffa97f250ebebc660e6"}

{"id": "p_588dc67716f143d6", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 60, "text": "益州既定，以籍為左將軍從事中郎，見待亞于簡雍、孫乾等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "456bdeb73f0380e2f64c58710b05178f45784d708cb1d57cf3a02476f55258d0"}

{"id": "p_24b5b9cd9e45b887", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 61, "text": "遣東使于吳，孫權聞其才辨，欲逆折以辭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "29d5dfbae16c77752ce5b9c5945286e5cadc1eca350e41c551fa64e6571fa10b"}

{"id": "p_8f0096d7c54f7d31", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 62, "text": "籍適入拜，權曰︰「勞事無道之君乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "5632e3b8396702ce04df215a14573a2f147415e01bb81fd9a2ac8ae9d765bb76"}

{"id": "p_4752e542cb024d6b", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」籍即對曰︰「一拜一起，未足為勞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "94d272962ef03c0acd115d2cb1534714f45a2d6a248c081fa95a737f2d71f064"}

{"id": "p_5e382586881a2b56", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 64, "text": "」籍之機捷，類皆如此，權甚異之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "e34f4dbb29c5f8225f9f31e6c8592e6d7aa3bc1a767f923e08a75c26f8e0af24"}

{"id": "p_0c442b2e744c06de", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 65, "text": "后遷昭文將軍，與諸葛亮、法正、劉巴、李嚴共造《蜀科》；《蜀科》之製，由此五人焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "b99d153a3783051881e35bd4259ddffca34cde9f22b2a8374e457e928c288dc5"}

{"id": "p_d3c7a7c90a8b41c7", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 66, "text": "秦宓字子敕，廣漢綿竹人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "d3048675fc78fd03aecb25c6e763fb8cc66348da8ced63e25c1e1ce86aeafc51"}

{"id": "p_18341e0bbf0e8484", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 67, "text": "少有才學，州郡辟命，輒稱疾不往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "5b41259e17d4a250648fd3ad88dab0379f3b2afb8d527d2fb576f3cac888a3b8"}

{"id": "p_56736c8a5c7f01f2", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 68, "text": "奏記州牧劉焉，荐儒士任定祖曰︰", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "a35f6fb022d9859f487ca321a5a41e4ec6e31054525461ceb8c685baafab1e0d"}

{"id": "p_cfab0903e67341d6", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 69, "text": "劉璋時，宓同郡王商為治中從事，與宓書曰︰「貧賤困苦，亦何時可以終身﹗卞和炫玉以耀世，宜一來，與州尊相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "5ecfcc49b7f7ac91f237f234507291d2adac3e73c5c793b7899a66f6da6f81b3"}

{"id": "p_dee8e36ed42570c7", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 70, "text": "先是，李權從宓借《戰國策》，宓曰︰「戰國從橫，用之何為？", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "7d872e363d6c94357dc06f658a9875ca661f0239c07e6f8884d6ad86feb5fe52"}

{"id": "p_b4ccdf64ddd8b184", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」權曰︰「仲尼、嚴平，會聚眾書，以成《春秋》、《指歸》之文，故海以合流為大，君子以博識為弘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "cd13c829e4b234e50285d44e5e5e475410455a0a16b92728589c6dcafacfe769"}

{"id": "p_563dbddef5e474d8", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 72, "text": "或謂宓曰︰「足下欲自比于巢、許、四皓，何故揚文藻見瑰穎乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "07b6149aeac3b6e83548a6b0b8f6491668a604b0803801c4b86e827c2635e47f"}

{"id": "p_72f08e0496494579", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」宓答曰︰「仆文不能盡言，言不能盡意，何文藻之有揚乎﹗昔孔子三見哀公，言成七卷，事蓋有不可嘿嘿也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "c2343f38fbbb30d3ffe77937dc90827964d9f4aa51ff1ebb600e6fb943cfe35a"}

{"id": "p_7da4e4bb81836dfb", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 74, "text": "接輿行且歌，論家以光篇；漁父詠滄浪，賢者以耀章。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "851fea43081455cea0b71a03383a526f69c4a913d29ba6b96de4767a5589001d"}

{"id": "p_ba7a6133665e7f3a", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 75, "text": "此二人者，非有欲于時者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "831fe408952e91a98a668868bdc08b51237e0f6128bef24a33861408f3e732da"}

{"id": "p_0064fb8ff24f05e3", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 76, "text": "夫虎生而文??，鳳生而五色，豈以五采自飾畫哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "bdec7814914516d6a6ed2709fc754e9536e8be0daf1d76525509f1baffda0585"}

{"id": "p_51ca742f613a096e", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 77, "text": "蓋《河》、《洛》由文興，六經由文起，君子懿文德，采藻其何傷﹗以仆之愚，猶恥革子成之誤，況賢于己者乎﹗」", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "8f6f2a7b585cb557b6e9dd93e82f9bcc5b80dd569a96e71215d53ec3ce7e788e"}

{"id": "p_440fe7810df658ad", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 78, "text": "先主既定益州，廣漢太守夏侯纂請宓為師友祭酒，領五官掾，稱曰仲父。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "d074921b5b6d688ea20f7898fd74f2c22d32955002bb3fd4ff1dfc2038b75da9"}

{"id": "p_51e802bc08bafe99", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 79, "text": "宓稱疾，臥在第舍，纂將功曹古朴，主簿王普，廚膳即宓第宴談，宓臥如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "77448da616f122902d4a36e8b690c220ff414b863ce055a964bafd93bcd70fd7"}

{"id": "p_c36b6e729d56eef0", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 80, "text": "纂問朴曰︰「至於貴州養生之具，實絕餘州矣，不知士人何如餘州也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "569c974dc7e9a3ea6dd99fd07ac412a459bd8f45cd222a194444ba5e9ac25175"}

{"id": "p_fb1e8b4e90c2bdad", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 81, "text": "」朴對曰︰「乃自先漢以來，其爵位者或不如餘州耳，至於著作為世師式，不負于餘州也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "313dbcec597f04a46f1c96a6900543182a1edf9aa5802b68facdd83039ea9f19"}

{"id": "p_174972ca3abf464b", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 82, "text": "嚴君平見黃、老作《指歸》，揚雄見《易》作《太言》，見《論語》作《法言》，司馬相如主武帝製封禪之文，于今天下所共聞也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "dcd8a85ff9d2539dcb6634a87f23246b127adc5340a6e20997c2fca1509df027"}

{"id": "p_924c932923f3a2ae", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 83, "text": "先主既稱尊號，將東征吳，宓陳天時必無其利，坐下獄幽閉，然後貸出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "797e2a1bba73dbb74241cf75ffbb3e1b246413fbeea487e848b8acee54c57436"}

{"id": "p_0365db20e39b9cc1", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 84, "text": "，丞相亮領益州牧，選宓迎為別駕，尋拜左中郎將、長水校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "d7660ffccbe79be367456a0e3ffe72c38d2163992f01cc7eb0280389f8a0b039"}

{"id": "p_8cca0ad3662ab2e6", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 85, "text": "吳遣使張溫來聘，百官皆往餞焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "a671621d6183465059ea544554863a729107e9cbc813e952c25074cabbb4a0d9"}

{"id": "p_51f7ce522791c7de", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 86, "text": "眾人皆集而宓未往，亮累遣使促之，溫曰︰「彼何人也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "770a1251ee2f511c9ca8cbccb18b2cc158a7d60e1ad06aced57a429f8c3a1206"}

{"id": "p_dd869b285ce11f6d", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 87, "text": "」及至，溫問曰︰「君學乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "234a3e8ce023bd024f7beeba12ce0849f0f1579d5d23b7e674001d0b5931316b"}

{"id": "p_652ab164a2b94e3d", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 88, "text": "」宓曰︰「五尺童子皆學，何必小人﹗」溫複問曰︰「天有頭乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "ef97abe5db00c907f801daa0861e73cde95280f25746f060c90532aa26bed076"}

{"id": "p_2ef9880dcf0534e9", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 89, "text": "」宓曰︰「天處高而聽卑，《詩》-{云}-︰『鶴鳴于九皋，聲聞于天。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "068a75173ba86b2a948abd8f92af829d3ecb8d885880c28571ad7a811ba49198"}

{"id": "p_c923f62ac9803da7", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 90, "text": "《詩》-{云}-︰『天步艱難，之子不猶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "83329bb713437ee8ae48e8549587d862714dcaf89e489ebe71e82022ec2d1987"}

{"id": "p_76e91192797cdba8", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 91, "text": "」答曰︰「天子姓劉，故以此知之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "771976e5b408cdcc5d20f3f70d8e45661ad41eb0d2d86e856d9b1718ee10fae1"}

{"id": "p_d4fae84812126417", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 92, "text": "」宓曰︰「雖生于東而沒于西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "8893e7edd689787b808aea07ebbdc74f8ed2fb767b08a7c38fb29f7605343250"}

{"id": "p_a9eef1254f48d7fd", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 93, "text": "」答問如響，應聲而出，于是溫大敬服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "2f2f7b7aa6d39b110f317801b1057eadff436cf6285cb6d0e83082bb75e94c6e"}

{"id": "p_6a7c9450490bdd05", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 94, "text": "初宓見帝系之文，五帝皆同一族，宓辨其不然之本。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "42d46614054a7243bb069ead1b6b543ac39b031aef8cb0e3bbef3c389458b700"}

{"id": "p_399ca8a4610b30af", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 95, "text": "又論皇帝王霸（養）[豢]龍之說，甚有道理，譙允南少時數往咨訪，紀錄其言于《春秋然否論》，文多故不載。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "b1e67fbbb58a1d4180b014ebfabe322c472d9b90216cc5cdf8c0b5b04dbbd15e"}

{"id": "p_6fd330574fce0c19", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 96, "text": "評曰︰許靖夙有名節，既以篤濃為稱，又以人物為意，雖行事舉動，未悉允當，蔣濟以為「大較廊廟器」也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "7433fd69cd700ec6001ea4f0e7f883aa99097275790081e0b859bb72c71d731b"}

{"id": "p_54b9b284d2f445f2", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 97, "text": "麋竺、孫乾、簡雍、伊藉，皆雍容風議，見禮于世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "bc3c8e3374363bb52565d36d348223dd6dcebf2cb620fa063154f86bfbef57f2"}

{"id": "p_adf432f449ee8cb5", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 98, "text": "秦宓始慕肥遁之高，而無若愚之實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "3a7c1d9a275358c23cdd4e6839d99c1b7c427a34a0841f1b95be4fcee95b972e"}

{"id": "p_74ea2d0d40e94b84", "source_id": "src_260570fbbc633583", "ordinal": 99, "text": "然專對有余，文藻壯美，可謂一時之才士矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "f8b8e65a9fac794260cb96eb14cf98e9b8d5283626998351e9f40cdc3cfe2b80"}

{"id": "p_2c8d47dd3c2673f0", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_b467673d2d6bfca9", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 1, "text": "董和字幼宰，南郡枝江人也，其先本巴郡江州人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "7c00b06b3a047ec0a11bf311b179e7092d3b3c4d80cc9f94966e5e2b20c2e7b8"}

{"id": "p_52699a1e7002cfee", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 2, "text": "漢末，和率宗族西遷，益州牧劉璋以為牛鞞、江原長、成都令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "d6ce2935d7367cfea66bc982fb9674e31a696d0e1064050cf9f991357bfad00e"}

{"id": "p_40c2c42b8c062338", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 3, "text": "蜀土富實，時俗奢侈，貨殖之家，侯服玉食，婚姻葬送，傾家竭產。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "250ca74539baddcb3eab7e65b31c2ab41d925dac4a1c4d1b4b478fa0e459d5e5"}

{"id": "p_79612c5da2c8c8d9", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 4, "text": "和躬率以儉，惡衣蔬食，防遏逾僭，為之軌制，所在皆移風變善，畏而不犯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "a8e9c10e7144b15638bf3f5a47a364ec7cfd4b5800c50b6f6d353271668e024d"}

{"id": "p_56cac68a4d2e4b80", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 5, "text": "然縣界豪強憚和嚴法，說璋轉和為巴東屬國都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "7dd28f0fdfe0119ddbdd31607be649820601bee541e8a8b07880432c618e6b39"}

{"id": "p_956f3d223c8a69f1", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 6, "text": "吏民老弱相攜乞留和者數千人，璋聽留二年，還遷益州太守，其清約如前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "3ff6c5ebc6dfa9a1d8dfe614eb6b85b50402c01e11a95d1b2ee23791a6f71337"}

{"id": "p_536094b1acd2c52f", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 7, "text": "與蠻夷從事，務推誠心，南土愛而信之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "5354009513f7a01c925dedfe12453f7d6f9161eeea356a1cf0c0eb2d2eae28c6"}

{"id": "p_0b0dd82c8567e9f3", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 8, "text": "先主定蜀，徵和為掌軍中郎將，與軍師將軍諸葛亮並署左將軍大司馬府事，獻可替否，共為歡交。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "efe7af219d5c58fb0065ec304b98015363104737f4d18a7d191a0552e87bc260"}

{"id": "p_7a0fa55da2036f30", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 9, "text": "自和居官食祿，外牧殊域，內幹機衡，二十馀年，死之日家無儋石之財。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "0e71da983384c03dccc1d79218ade15415c738c89cc182122239a0aeb4792de5"}

{"id": "p_e873f61039270744", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 10, "text": "亮後為丞相，教與群下曰：「夫參署者，集眾思廣忠益也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "2b2abbc6cca22f6f92679e54978cb0cb0d37cb66053947927cb13039d4490fdb"}

{"id": "p_efb4841f4283b49b", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 11, "text": "若遠小嫌，難相違覆，曠闕損矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "175c90071f4418abb17042f8dd71fab6224aa4c09b72dfd6a8be54730f9d8c28"}

{"id": "p_d9fce01037a363c9", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 12, "text": "違覆而得中，猶棄弊蹻而獲珠玉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "c01eda324072964e3bfd434266c14e95c135c42876cd2eea83cf2b77d8c4b1b1"}

{"id": "p_aeeaa1f0fde37a27", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 13, "text": "然人心苦不能盡，惟徐元直處茲不惑，又董幼宰參署七年，事有不至，至於十反，來相啟告。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "397ef1235bfca5810f9bd39054e5d879c2468a34f5377a0359d0c72a6033b13a"}

{"id": "p_cff0d03474801299", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 14, "text": "苟能慕元直之十一，幼宰之殷勤，有忠於國，則亮可少過矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "4062b2216c5ac21c064069abf368b38c225dcca7f57b832ac5aa3dd46132df53"}

{"id": "p_ada713038a210197", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」又曰：「昔初交州平，屢聞得失，後交元直，勤見啟誨，前參事於幼宰，每言則盡，後從事於偉度，數有諫止；雖姿性鄙暗，不能悉納，然與此四子終始好合，亦足以明其不疑於直言也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "4b7b66ba78880f78c2b66b5737e7d92cb7e124fe03b31a401e151657e4a837bf"}

{"id": "p_5d8f69f8a6ccbdb2", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 16, "text": "劉巴字子初，零陵烝陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "853753051d2c41feebdde62006a781b8bae542f3db8acd4f4b883f7ecf41696d"}

{"id": "p_c7d447064e832f52", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 17, "text": "少知名，荊州牧劉表連闢，及舉茂才，皆不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "2308f7a1db787bbbd5ad7a0662576dad08d6355f1680c0a581d38b2daaa7f500"}

{"id": "p_0bcf792ccd0c7b2d", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 18, "text": "先主奔江南，荊、楚群士從之如雲，而巴北詣曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "d7ba386d0071c71ffe4b688018437be4c5e7823ad9af571c04b2ad6081a94c6f"}

{"id": "p_af91386bb4579302", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 19, "text": "曹公闢為掾，使招納長沙、零陵、桂陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "dbbea063e9908fb04b95339a1a3882d3314406dbd10a9e84313fe2b8c8d3e3bb"}

{"id": "p_2e6a249cc237c602", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 20, "text": "會先主略有三郡，巴不得反使，遂遠適交阯，先主深以為恨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "b00e5dddda1f4a400de440923bdfec35c8ea6921a0c6a69ce739fc95fe1ababe"}

{"id": "p_851902dc1f32ee17", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 21, "text": "俄而先主定益州，巴辭謝罪負，先主不責。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "b48c90c9d303f730c7a0af797b4362c6eb9e28ecb3f9b383267d7a0400412aba"}

{"id": "p_eedcba6366085351", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 22, "text": "而諸葛孔明數稱薦之，先主闢為左將軍西曹掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "868d4c3938d69e6cbb4b1da832ce08e4a83b2581311c0a34e123b077430409f8"}

{"id": "p_bcb41ceed199de12", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 23, "text": "，先主為漢中王，巴為尚書，後代法正為尚書令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "794452ac095de04ac74e69a2140e8894f69a12a0d0d7c379b69cd794151a9570"}

{"id": "p_38958f956d15c80b", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 24, "text": "躬履清儉，不治產業，又自以歸附非素，懼見猜嫌，恭默守靜，退無私交，非公事不言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "ba81eb658d93b81d8d855bcc910caf546261927ec64a21ed459deafd31fdd253"}

{"id": "p_511b9dc548e7e2f6", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 25, "text": "先主稱尊號，昭告於皇天上帝后土神祇，凡諸文誥策命，皆巴所作也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "d9c2358787ea7e997b19afdb1ae488aa414c7d62d8143c29910b1ec8ae73cd1a"}

{"id": "p_b3d23f3727d52445", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 26, "text": "卒後，魏尚書僕射陳群與丞相諸葛亮書，問巴消息，稱曰劉君子初，甚敬重焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "7b31d9775b2e7123ef0087fbebc23d803ad05cd36d8d324f0a73fa12f58593c8"}

{"id": "p_1f3f291f1195f994", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 27, "text": "馬良字季常，襄陽宜城人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "7c60e84512be788a7f3264f7ecc2ffc4f135ff85b80f3314dd93329140062e00"}

{"id": "p_00edd9b45823337b", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 28, "text": "兄弟五人，並有才名，鄉里為之諺曰：「馬氏五常，白眉最良。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "970944339b45c0681319a099030658e84a8baf206d786652b82e58cb5fc2ed34"}

{"id": "p_4db1e992bf154ff9", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」良眉中有白毛，故以稱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "62fc3a705830a41941c258c7340ae4ed860bfb2bfa22a21fc667b06b6fee1eb8"}

{"id": "p_d0ede42f3eb1a74d", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 30, "text": "及先主入蜀，諸葛亮亦從後往，良留荊州，與亮書曰：「聞雒城已拔，此天祚也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "d591ef1861ab19001f71de40696522b0dfbbec3d5bc008b9212cac3108793886"}

{"id": "p_8463ab11c9dd0aab", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 31, "text": "尊兄應期贊世，配業光國，魄兆見矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "f639d73fdfdab3e98baf286de2405735c26300403844fe439210321755482c83"}

{"id": "p_9646dbb11a25fcab", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 32, "text": "夫變用雅慮，審貴垂明，於以簡才，宜適其時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "5ef611318bf4b586f82f26792a8be55c0361f922765ed4c7618f8e6d503e841b"}

{"id": "p_088368431dea9036", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 33, "text": "若乃和光悅遠，邁德天壤，使時閒於聽，世服於道，齊高妙之音，正鄭、衛之聲，並利於事，無相奪倫，此乃管弦之至，牙、曠之調也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "e7c2b1c35735b1b13cd4cc0fcdcb790a815e8916a6724a63aa20924f5361128b"}

{"id": "p_3546bf01a81dd03c", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 34, "text": "後遣使吳，良謂亮曰：「今銜國命，協穆二家，幸為良介於孫將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "88177f17362ffc62fa691bad0008a54d15e93ad9dcaa3e909c8f0f02fa21f83f"}

{"id": "p_5502db08436896dc", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 35, "text": "」良即為草曰：「寡君遣掾馬良通聘繼好，以紹昆吾、豕韋之勳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "02b1afa15c748c0bb283b41c3954f9a8978d7c51181e9646c8795dbb46c42623"}

{"id": "p_8e5e843894b42018", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 36, "text": "其人吉士，荊楚之令，鮮于造次之華，而有克終之美，原降心存納，以慰將命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "3db9c122fcdd778022fab8e6964aedf23780f30ee0b0613a15c8955edcd44ac1"}

{"id": "p_9246a889e70eeee2", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 37, "text": "先主稱尊號，以良為侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "a77cca7c0bacc6a8ab13b2e954a983288d95ed34c9de590cdef268bd2e9b06ff"}

{"id": "p_9d573b746010164a", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 38, "text": "及東征吳，遣良入武陵招納五溪蠻夷，蠻夷渠帥皆受印號，咸如意指。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "b0514a22c35994daeb6366fee1117f090a0153fa9e762c610394100d9c4928c4"}

{"id": "p_0f627d93002ca847", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 39, "text": "會先主敗績於夷陵，良亦遇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "f0a412118318654c2ce0aa9496be9d2152b78b99105450c77057e58e6f230a6c"}

{"id": "p_48ce921e125fb0aa", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 40, "text": "良弟謖，字幼常，以荊州從事隨先主入蜀，除綿竹成都令、越雋太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "6d0238d944495e064c5d59cf4ea277ca036fb3ff8068ea63a7bb5df3352d1335"}

{"id": "p_ff18fe244493e2c2", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 41, "text": "才器過人，好論軍計，丞相諸葛亮深加器異。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "288768fa6982f75066c789d3b5eabac8bd743da399d168f92e85ecaba6119ae0"}

{"id": "p_ed64d5df0bd62f8c", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 42, "text": "先主臨薨謂亮曰：「馬謖言過其實，不可大用，君其察之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "ab307f44cc59f8efad4c7d095ddf63c6916ddd3e29b96b7476a55c9b956787bf"}

{"id": "p_958a7d5ef4f9aacd", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 43, "text": "」亮猶謂不然，以謖為參軍，每引見談論，自晝達夜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "f0027267d2807196df715ea32438dea54616597f5a0eb87d78732d5a8889593d"}

{"id": "p_89ffd44759b28d97", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 44, "text": "，亮出軍向祁山，時有宿將魏延、吳壹等，論者皆言以為宜令為先鋒，而亮違眾拔謖，統大眾在前，與魏將張郃戰於街亭，為郃所破，士卒離散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "bf06678bf95afebd37fb134c1f700976af840fe86f8842823665ee3699b8c9e8"}

{"id": "p_9fd55ae2fda2b37c", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 45, "text": "亮進無所據，退軍還漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "7dc6c1de6e1915680b68f015517b781019ddfa7d5423714ceecf9211c7fee567"}

{"id": "p_fafe4482b109dd38", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 46, "text": "謖下獄物故，亮為之流涕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "2ebd22e3145339c3001f4012f5d4e37cf88cd5979b15ccb7f1403a3fca29813a"}

{"id": "p_f97505559b092e27", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 47, "text": "良死時年三十六，謖年三十九。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "f97ba5b0c72d2b9512a061b778038d5a788c032d9c4c6bcf7dd9fce4cfca7cb8"}

{"id": "p_cbfc31ad7b5ca915", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 48, "text": "先主領荊州牧，闢為從事，部諸郡，隨先主入蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "bf50cbeae30f2b054418590d22fcc2bc99e086d87c3e96f5dd327cb5924cdec5"}

{"id": "p_b33e40378255c9e2", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 49, "text": "蜀既定，為蜀郡北部都尉，因易郡名，為汶山太守，轉在犍為。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "0045e39f5c526c4c2acd4436b21679c9e951503920cc55c8bc0929f7f5d9b1aa"}

{"id": "p_1004003114453ae5", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 50, "text": "，入拜尚書，遷尚書令，奉命使吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "fb49e41e2a507164d2ab77e151faccbfcd628d44d2bc9df9e814c00fd11294e5"}

{"id": "p_aca3e44e36401cd1", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 51, "text": "七年，孫權稱尊號，以震為衛尉，賀權踐阼，諸葛亮與兄瑾書曰：「孝起忠純之性，老而益篤，及其贊述東西，歡樂和合，有可貴者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "7736f25185ce73212cf15e47d63fff031d05ff9fdc02437dae85f91a7edd9694"}

{"id": "p_6f5f548eb85a64ad", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 52, "text": "震到武昌，孫權與震升壇歃盟，交分天下：以徐、豫、幽、青屬吳，並、涼、冀、兗屬蜀，其司州之土，以函谷關為界。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "ea8ef0e954094b16c113c90eb2895dcaf677589d200675d7ed47acb1fdb2b7ae"}

{"id": "p_d51d99101997da93", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 53, "text": "九年，都護李平坐誣罔廢；諸葛亮與長史蔣琬、侍中董允書曰：「孝起前臨至吳，為吾說正方腹中有鱗甲，鄉黨以為不可近。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "11f4a6e837d789d07f6fc2ac4269106d9410a652395b324f0c16ed14a9895d49"}

{"id": "p_c0089960a1390803", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 54, "text": "吾以為鱗甲者但不當犯之耳，不圖復有蘇、張之事出於不意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "daaec0ffe5a08f78da74d5420461dccb5f10614f45bc0e5cfadae62e565e5688"}

{"id": "p_c479e7b002f14141", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 55, "text": "董允字休昭，掌軍中郎將和之子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "2ee28d8aafe42a57a716a29ad2c75bffc795904ae14904600ed740f47f8f3e98"}

{"id": "p_2f6e377027d3fefc", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 56, "text": "先主立太子，允以選為捨人，徙洗馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "08cfeff16658a609f2a32f51ba83db2216fdbcf60e43e72e7ae658d7b5a413a7"}

{"id": "p_df2a5e9f03de61f2", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 57, "text": "丞相亮將北征，住漢中，慮後主富於春秋，硃紫難別，以允秉心公亮，欲任以宮省之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "f249423dfc057e0c091565d80e4b8aee41232bd361fb1a09afd50e97a3cd5597"}

{"id": "p_097b18150b00b9b6", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 58, "text": "上疏曰：「侍中郭攸之、費禕、侍郎董允等，先帝簡拔以遺陛下，至於斟酌規益，進盡忠言，則其任也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "5c1befd77a4ee9c487931c785fa8f05a8c9f7fbc86905cf374d22b52a96ee57a"}

{"id": "p_dcf6ad87078ce938", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 59, "text": "愚以為宮中之事，事無大小，悉以諮之，必能裨補闕漏，有所廣益。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "086e53a3a5afeb646266e4b65b24cc23b9a40a3de12a4392479826c512ee767e"}

{"id": "p_b0a2949182135e7e", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 60, "text": "若無興德之言，則戮允等以彰其慢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "73f9d7ebd39d644d1bdf976ae570a18bab488cfc1006c07f9e6bd2ad0cdbf720"}

{"id": "p_1957bd560d3a9630", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」亮尋請禕為參軍，允遷為侍中，領虎賁中郎將，統宿衛親兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "8bcf747f2acd555989b2c44ae99187687bb2ad96f2ee9c09e3fd39b684f98ead"}

{"id": "p_837f056fec0497e2", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 62, "text": "攸之性素和順，備員而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "58131406a1b85ae4c4a7692d332c021ea4f9d529039724f0344d928f7fe7c07b"}

{"id": "p_a561153fd98b7867", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 63, "text": "允處事為防制，甚盡匡救之理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "a7bc5ae2d0103aa85f0f2b7c71654ec5ed9c9a1848278a586476447350ccd015"}

{"id": "p_4a9589e8cfd5b65b", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 64, "text": "後主常欲採擇以充后宮，允以為古者天子后妃之數不過十二，今嬪嬙已具，不宜增益，終執不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "c7382ab5108da461c7e33e2a120bfee60e819e16f5a0dc3baab95d68986206ef"}

{"id": "p_926c1065d6692806", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 65, "text": "尚書令蔣琬領益州刺史，上疏以讓費禕及允，又表「允內侍歷年，翼贊王室，宜賜爵土以褒勳勞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "c597581f4d27afdadb2890080065aa91da8a2fda4b8c78fb9d04325ff30df1fa"}

{"id": "p_0a6d4abfd2853609", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 66, "text": "後主漸長大，愛宦人黃皓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "9178247494aa5ac2d58145cc867e0c183d95ae9e9f298cf563cb5fbca20ff38c"}

{"id": "p_f82a85bd5ce75a48", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 67, "text": "允常上則正色匡主，下則數責於皓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "dbf6ee012a0fbad25b042f5e9efdffa22a43336ee85a9b8813bf39911e3444f3"}

{"id": "p_37ddc90bbe955cd6", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 68, "text": "終允之世，皓位不過黃門丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "4073e31deea64ada64b4bc7faf3d1c652e1cec49bd9d4150b5f5387a1057ea75"}

{"id": "p_00d56cbbf0fb3b4e", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 69, "text": "允嘗與尚書令費禕、中典軍胡濟等共期遊宴，嚴駕已辦，而郎中襄陽董恢詣允脩敬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "4e39df89815fecb6656dcfd2fcc5a7b9d2f476d820bf3089f3e9bcde4048067e"}

{"id": "p_802444928722589f", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 70, "text": "恢年少官微，見允停出，逡巡求去，允不許，曰：「本所以出者，欲與同好遊談也，今君已自屈，方展闊積，捨此之談，就彼之宴，非所謂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "a4b78cbe5765855a32b4ec6eb86e3c4b59d1b7c4f571e00c9bde24d458f208c9"}

{"id": "p_cafd4d18e3ef7c68", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」乃命解驂，禕等罷駕不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "4c52a0912644cf4ecdb30ed252ece42e35a8331c1900a5d633cb2294b6485418"}

{"id": "p_3b2230098f272863", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 72, "text": "七年，以侍中守尚書令，為大將軍費禕副貳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "4f4ffebd316826dc44be73472dd3e64eb8596dbed255d76c1c4f4de862453157"}

{"id": "p_0596c163c7383f89", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 73, "text": "陳祗代允為侍中，與黃皓互相表裡，皓始預政事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "b4da6884c5711845fca5d21ef4f21aff85a6a1c1c9870c12a1a8a3eb7b7e5fdc"}

{"id": "p_e5e11a350ba67400", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 74, "text": "祗死後，皓從黃門令為中常侍、奉車都尉，操弄威柄，終至覆國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "074d832ed34ba64f30c8250c02bd82bd7ab145ad7b3e318ed4a3e2fa5f7f1b86"}

{"id": "p_6385a8b9d519bf6f", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 75, "text": "及鄧艾至蜀，聞皓奸險，收閉，將殺之，而皓厚賂艾左右，得免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "84233d81b3919478bb94e040af1bee648eeb9bf955d9dd015c6cee497a1a22c3"}

{"id": "p_477090332695b373", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 76, "text": "祗字奉宗，汝南人，許靖兄之外孫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "317aec105d111a2a9e78dd95ab230c45a47ef776445ba952e1b4dad30846b32f"}

{"id": "p_37247d090b21c355", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 77, "text": "弱冠知名，稍遷至選曹郎，矜厲有威容。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "d66843fcd9731929f561386a2392aa1514807ccde760dda9c915bab2570e1864"}

{"id": "p_3f5fb3c8791089d1", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 78, "text": "多技藝，挾數術，費禕甚異之，故超繼允內侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "155789a0b684ef0533e4920d0be256d70c5bad89b4ba9690cc6543826bf1290d"}

{"id": "p_f7ef100081f813e3", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 79, "text": "呂乂卒，祗又以侍中守尚書令，加鎮軍將軍，大將軍姜維雖班在祗上，常率眾在外，希親朝政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "26db12fe037f473cbff24c17e9cf6fbbd1b206fbc11f93398662b4f3758152f8"}

{"id": "p_a869610545f74403", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 80, "text": "祗上承主指，下接閹豎，深見信愛，權重於維。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "f8f183a4b2716f61a58bac01b07aa8f20864bf84ee23dc43131231698e6e3f58"}

{"id": "p_232060029857ac79", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 81, "text": "卒，後主痛惜，發言流涕，乃下詔曰：「祗統職一紀，柔嘉惟則，幹肅有章，和義利物，庶績允明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "94bc519d51f1f939e7fcfc0cec2b39037449cd225f174fe51f2c31a0e72be9b9"}

{"id": "p_e535c131f7ab7375", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 82, "text": "夫存有令問，則亡加美諡，諡曰忠侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "9acadb107a95feec9f881bd18965810e5b8c3172fb664fd0e16ff9b61030c87c"}

{"id": "p_665d27074d2d272f", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 83, "text": "」賜子粲爵關內侯，拔次子裕為黃門侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "e95a2a54a4a95e882ce4f6f5e7ecb958cec60ffd718280618c12e5a4fce9c249"}

{"id": "p_57472f6884ace879", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 84, "text": "自祗之有寵，後主追怨允日深，謂為自輕，由祗媚茲一人，皓構間浸潤故耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "92976474668a79f6218f6a52d43d0a2f7afeaa9045033c32516004e86a9e6001"}

{"id": "p_52816579b4564d9b", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 85, "text": "父常，送故將（軍）劉焉入蜀，值王路隔塞，遂不得還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "3963fb98306ff278233613d3cd05b87781260346b65e3e9c5e748b0ed094fc09"}

{"id": "p_0273ab526b20796e", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 86, "text": "初，先主定益州，置鹽府校尉，較鹽鐵之利，後校尉王連請乂及南陽杜祺、南鄉劉幹等並為典曹都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "36e00b51d57fd64dce9d078df6479be3a83c50dbc987bdc7bf5bdb9276b36c54"}

{"id": "p_a4edebb95aa3c691", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 87, "text": "乂遷新都、綿竹令，乃心隱卹，百姓稱之，為一州諸城之首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "f79c2874c072e4c4d68bbaf8a001302c718af1fe7a4c4e086d8c9eb0227df7fe"}

{"id": "p_d0672a2e8fa13a65", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 88, "text": "丞相諸葛亮連年出軍，調發諸郡，多不相救，乂募取兵五千人詣亮，慰喻檢制，無逃竄者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "4c6fc7e3b8c4be08438b5fca49f1b255f40be709b666062dc8526520a9e716f1"}

{"id": "p_66bd8a01e4403bf2", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 89, "text": "徙為漢中太守，兼領督農，供繼軍糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "2c8811f09b88f8e1b0ca01802c2e8ac0c45739871385bdf677748205128a74e4"}

{"id": "p_e465e37353504292", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 90, "text": "亮卒，累遷廣漢、蜀郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "bf2ad7548c8cb2d8e34555978d262c2e8ff00171b2756b4f28518b6a6786c7b8"}

{"id": "p_79d753276a475662", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 91, "text": "蜀郡一都之會，戶口眾多，又亮卒之後，士伍亡命，更相重冒，姦巧非一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "81914015bd9ee6825811ea7c19e968f57c6d042e4c3f299018ceed82406b098e"}

{"id": "p_09540c5192943d46", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 92, "text": "乂到官，為之防禁，開喻勸導，數年之中，漏脫自出者萬馀口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "923be41b3f6b55b66ce7100d6acd1e6bdf68bca0ec1b75511ea0b001895554a5"}

{"id": "p_1e679acb5ac44529", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 93, "text": "後入為尚書，代董允為尚書令，眾事無留，門無停賓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "1b8e5d2e602e041e2f4418458315ac3474f5f6dba9140a1713f29018a96394e3"}

{"id": "p_819eb8bf4ad8f700", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 94, "text": "乂歷職內外，治身儉約，謙靖少言，為政簡而不煩，號為清能；然持法刻深，好用文俗吏，故居大官，名聲損於郡縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "4eecf539bc1be49eb8f62c8e2a3217422825fada733c05e052b6b2bf0a7a8f04"}

{"id": "p_21c2b58cdc80d1ca", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 95, "text": "雅清厲有文才，著格論十五篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "606b6ea94318d79d5a8930159839bf8f1dae5ffbd6eaad19da9475d3dbeff528"}

{"id": "p_10d40bc255166e6b", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 96, "text": "杜祺歷郡守監軍大將軍司馬，劉幹官至巴西太守，皆與乂親善，亦有當時之稱，而儉素守法，不及於乂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "81e708f1593dfe7ea712a8fe3b737c31a92f5aaf6be4e0f2ccb1cf6c12dde70d"}

{"id": "p_7cf07f2e5fd65835", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 97, "text": "評曰：董和蹈羔羊之素，劉巴履清尚之節，馬良貞實，稱為令士，陳震忠恪，老而益篤，董允匡主，義形於色，皆蜀臣之良矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "afd977bdce9b122685fb1decbfeb7c084290c556825dae53035dd37b30426e53"}

{"id": "p_d9f12113155e9e86", "source_id": "src_41c47ed2e7780d4c", "ordinal": 98, "text": "呂乂臨郡則垂稱，處朝則被損，亦黃、薛之流亞矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "082be59b4cf3a2b5601e79eeb3ba0c2ae3ac9406eaf9dd80a62e514f1d7c9ef8"}

{"id": "p_ffdca3cc05ed6067", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 0, "text": "==劉封== 劉封者，本羅侯寇氏之子，長沙劉氏之甥也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "e54b238358dd3ff1b1793fa7169f43dcd447c83e71b68755ccdad2ecfec3a7a3"}

{"id": "p_cb19e1b860629140", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 1, "text": "先主至荊州，以未有繼嗣，養封為子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "8cd2b6cef232a4decce1f2bf530da2fb3c117aca5f1afdef954d0eabb9b22dee"}

{"id": "p_8904dca87638f29b", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 2, "text": "及先主入蜀，自葭萌還攻劉璋，時封年二十馀，有武藝，氣力過人，將兵俱與諸葛亮、張飛等溯流西上，所在戰克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "e91456f7f8656b0e5a2391423f1dd713a195827b819b9e36ecfac48ede022ef8"}

{"id": "p_2c651752b9d1d90e", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 3, "text": "益州既定，以封為副軍中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "4eea26af14bc6a7a850f4c65e306101ffc59340d821d9965de8d821051da58a5"}

{"id": "p_cce5837066cb4ca9", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 4, "text": " 初，劉璋遣扶風孟達副法正，各將兵二千人，使迎先主，先主因令達並領其眾，留屯江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "c19859c4c3ac4b7395363481bd827e1557ba4ad381d824c97e003db3bd715fea"}

{"id": "p_6c351b2410ea8c9d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 5, "text": "蜀平後，以達為宜都太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "e0f4dd188c58e973c7071580a37798b47c120b3cbeba94022592835a31236bc8"}

{"id": "p_649b5b720c80f077", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 6, "text": "，命達從秭歸北攻房陵，房陵太守蒯祺為達兵所害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "85a405c833b97f889e4cd2f58c00748c6afd0fea36d11cfd7dfa883761bbc7de"}

{"id": "p_14cf98164474992e", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 7, "text": "達將進攻上庸，先主陰恐達難獨任，乃遣封自漢中乘沔水下統達軍，與達會上庸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "b2e305d2438757cfb676835e4b3afc9cc466dee021d153474a848b2d30960386"}

{"id": "p_da9520df3c0092b2", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 8, "text": "上庸太守申耽舉眾降，遣妻子及宗族詣成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "c0c0087acce9711e172dc9ceb3676980539b1672db0567eb650d60563c35c3f5"}

{"id": "p_43fe834799f411e3", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 9, "text": "先主加耽征北將軍，領上庸太守員鄉侯如故，以耽弟儀為建信將軍、西城太守，遷封為副軍將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "0daf7f306b14cfe7e0f8dbe05574b0c815f759634f0137137fd6713197ce1bf8"}

{"id": "p_03d2aa071220c75b", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 10, "text": "自關羽圍樊城、襄陽，連呼封、達，令發兵自助。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "e6d9d279fab65956fde4f8c0f737ebb5478e23ca0daad29619ddfedd59df57c9"}

{"id": "p_957f3216e0643381", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 11, "text": "封、達辭以山郡初附，未可動搖，不承羽命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "dedf0b114b01073bfcc0238d34115b317addc3ed1533d431f9ba73c1f60b19c1"}

{"id": "p_e677076651a4bead", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 12, "text": "會羽覆敗，先主恨之。又封與達忿爭不和，封尋奪達鼓吹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "0ddf281d5cc5e78e065a8236bb1c8deda7de0f9c3c0dad55b7ed1afb9d8570f4"}

{"id": "p_8cd8847c93536975", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 13, "text": "達既懼罪，又忿恚封，遂表辭先主，率所領降魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "fe2253c88dbc18ad440b1ace9b03eb1529b704470053fa562f973d6670b6ade4"}

{"id": "p_4aba5af290183799", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 14, "text": " 魏文帝善達之姿才容觀，以為散騎常侍、建武將軍，封平陽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "936cf1cb6f132fedbd1ef7966037584228c0d60cdfa8a978c270cc0a42806ca0"}

{"id": "p_82442300b8537f0c", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 15, "text": "合房陵、上庸、西城三郡〔為新城郡，以〕達領新城太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "83514f4bdbdac4be67599bdf2fefbfd9c77f627ecee0b3c44f97899c11c2ebf7"}

{"id": "p_d95becbc605ad584", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 16, "text": "遣征南將軍夏侯尚、右將軍徐晃與達共襲封。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "0970ec3b3a9f3a5edd4e8b2035cc84c0b8418713e771dd3ebd2c37291571a1c8"}

{"id": "p_4d96bc28719f445f", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 17, "text": "達與封書曰： 封不從達言。 申儀叛封，封破走還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "9829daa7ba960508d9024c27ee23e1a548bb29c7d9d3fd00e65909f1b0b2747b"}

{"id": "p_5aa49ae0b19c95e1", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 18, "text": "申耽降魏，魏假耽懷集將軍，徙居南陽，儀魏興太守，封（真鄉侯）〔員鄉侯〕，屯洵口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "c8983f97f498d572155e2e7dc98cb1f8d48d0eefbe4081c4c14b1b13ceaf9f76"}

{"id": "p_1c70be86ee943c2a", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 19, "text": " 封既至，先主責封之侵陵達，又不救羽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "26a63fba98a77af3740ea69d2acca00687b404af065f4f673ab59a2f11d4c20c"}

{"id": "p_210fc12094c309a5", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 20, "text": "諸葛亮慮封剛猛，易世之後終難制御，勸先主因此除之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "92803b3f21fa882d1dd26758d299ebea251cc377664f8243cb024cd48e433f5d"}

{"id": "p_2309699c263c7560", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 21, "text": "於是賜封死，使自裁。封歎曰：「恨不用孟子度之言！", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "152e865ffd9137b8047268344413edfa8698209c824560a98ca9945723fdb29b"}

{"id": "p_c113bcfb3c45cfc9", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 22, "text": "」先主為之流涕。 ===孟達=== 達本字子敬，避先主叔父敬，改之。 ==彭羕== 彭羕字永年，廣漢人。身長八尺，容貌甚偉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "ea3a91fa01ff79340b5a653f514f2e833d295719513b83ad438430ee71e1cfbe"}

{"id": "p_9a357e48a7f933ca", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 23, "text": "姿性驕傲，多所輕忽，惟敬同郡秦子敕，薦之於太守許靖曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "a3492acc7932964989755d7edd42144440c7a09bce94aef7713a1a8a481259e5"}

{"id": "p_2344cef979365c7c", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 24, "text": " 羕仕州，不過書佐，後又為眾人所謗毀於州牧劉璋，璋髡鉗羕為徒隸。會先主入蜀，溯流北行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "906b5cf39c39766b52e3345efed3bf6d3582f2db73eed510111b7f161a6af72f"}

{"id": "p_99932ed8a41eb25d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 25, "text": "羕欲納說先主，乃往見龐統。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "130008cefef177ae0e7c96e172ca648e2d109996058e0496f7ef6b529beda9fc"}

{"id": "p_5a8e0dcef71e57e5", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 26, "text": "統與羕非故人，又適有賓客，羕徑上統床臥，謂統曰：「須客罷當與卿善談。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "f770fe93016a3f061db3f26ea8748fa819a94e7971cf22293186fd51be78c401"}

{"id": "p_18bb6b704583e6bd", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」統客既罷，往就羕坐，羕又先責統食，然後共語，因留信宿，至於經日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "e3858e6fdd0a284010938ed763edf144abfe66ba7fe976c5f404d197f0607e4c"}

{"id": "p_dbe25ac3f4e3ec16", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 28, "text": "統大善之，而法正宿自知羕，遂並致之先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "22b54d9a7e2036df17167eeeb869a690304bf3dc6609af67e320f1ce7f7b31c6"}

{"id": "p_12a8aadae4c10eaf", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 29, "text": "先主亦以為奇，數令羕宣傳軍事，指授諸將，奉使稱意，識遇日加。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "7fa4ad6452eafcf4668724c8fdc84810e77edddb60320de7c059ef5d032cea2b"}

{"id": "p_66e7c1352738457f", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 30, "text": "成都既定，先主領益州牧，拔羕為治中從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "edea06097822b2f0ecc010a8f710609829e58f9646cf9034b4eb4cee5d2118c1"}

{"id": "p_c83c6c38c8853b3f", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 31, "text": "羕起徒步，一朝處州人之上，形色囂然，自矜得遇滋甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "d5844830f6b209e58a80d70ef32d1a0e89ac0dd3690cd59d95381a36911eff24"}

{"id": "p_7e1228d031f30963", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 32, "text": "諸葛亮雖外接待羕，而內不能善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "768ec69b5be462f84a2d889478a57630916291fe67ad4b16f971f433117f486c"}

{"id": "p_5de4d9518b82128f", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 33, "text": "屢密言先主，羕心大誌廣，難可保安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "bf4b2604ba42a006fa68c5c00aff4913565d1c822ee12c36409772b515bbae04"}

{"id": "p_eede8d008f44ebd9", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 34, "text": "先主既敬信亮，加察羕行事，意以稍疏，左遷羕為江陽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "4f2d92b7107e1ebcc30ab354eefddd11109942c315327a1af422321f87b7db6e"}

{"id": "p_f760898dcbc35d67", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 35, "text": " 羕聞當遠出，私情不悅，往詣馬超。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "9ac1d2d813f49fed3d535c2a48b23403acd8119c2c1268bc13329e0c18effb63"}

{"id": "p_3c0541bc3e01a478", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 36, "text": "超問羕曰：「卿才具秀拔，主公相待至重，謂卿當與孔明、孝直諸人齊足並驅，寧當外授小郡，失人本望乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "ea102c3b78db2e592b64808ceb6604b83e36cb8028bd63b796b429080f547fc0"}

{"id": "p_207ab18fdcb4f549", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」羕曰：「老革荒悖，可複道邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "0118c207031e47bd8f808b63e233fc63340e44584f7fb285f5efdc925a1174ac"}

{"id": "p_bab83621955c302e", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」又謂超曰：「卿為其外，我為其內，天下不足定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "41186da80697e87a83fb4fd35d930ee70a5f5f01bb4e6e39589ba98498655b48"}

{"id": "p_6effbe9b76e4f7c8", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」超羈旅歸國，常懷危懼，聞羕言大驚，默然不答。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "2aa471f186996adfff9f07ea6dd9cb10894632a44fd5f21a509fc453916e0f41"}

{"id": "p_aef21922d57abf05", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 40, "text": "羕退，具表羕辭，於是收羕付有司。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "e9d59737122e12feb91b5694ec97e5af8e42d4850866f2d44b29b5a0d609b795"}

{"id": "p_78edd0ee9760c099", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 41, "text": " 羕於獄中與諸葛亮書曰： 羕竟誅死，時年三十七。 ==廖立== 廖立字公淵，武陵臨沅人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "0df8f36fe5683248b15ff808539f793acf8f0ae6b2b12123e8a0f4365eb03ab3"}

{"id": "p_a5be0618018032a7", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 42, "text": "先主領荊州牧，闢為從事，年未三十，擢為長沙太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "163f5d9d4efc97f9668bc7ccd2efe7e380f0b8c2f67220fe35c9113741fb029c"}

{"id": "p_1228844a784ae776", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 43, "text": "先主入蜀，諸葛亮鎮荊土，孫權遣使通好於亮，因問士人皆誰相經緯者，亮答曰：「龐統、廖立，楚之良才，當贊興世業者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "acc963519492c1b8ec9b4dc79a7ca803109fe68223c186fa1948c14904be4c03"}

{"id": "p_a0fd42d3a5d03f79", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 44, "text": "」，權遣呂蒙奄襲南三郡，立脫身走，自歸先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "e634cf079d0a5b05b7f850768549254168510d1b03cc84c0dd9e055286cc0690"}

{"id": "p_e7b1505a2d1f437c", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 45, "text": "先主素識待之，不深責也，以為巴郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "aaf561939b53ba97c3671b3fd5d8b1dc0be42bf77f8fd67473e4fa6b52befd2b"}

{"id": "p_93459577a90c1093", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 46, "text": "二十四年，先主為漢中王，徵立為侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "6d2fa9d610ad10176522ad51153f7097f75afe2ca87dc4f87b3c25ac244ac1d3"}

{"id": "p_a514c2bc38bbf663", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 47, "text": "後主襲位，徙長水校尉。 立本意，自謂才名宜為諸葛亮之貳，而更遊散在李嚴等下，常懷怏怏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "cf22ffee445ed77cd0186e25247fe928c103e485193760515348e895910b3ada"}

{"id": "p_00340fd4954f04c1", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 48, "text": "後丞相掾〔李邵〕、蔣琬至，立計曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "b13043230e5385277e6decab374ab70bd9d3c00f149ff8495d85123fdca565f8"}

{"id": "p_43963f62246b9a18", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 49, "text": " （郃）、琬具白其言於諸葛亮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "4ea932c89535bb28e86bfdcfe6aec4ce4c91971af1ee7980baa130e7f3d5f7d1"}

{"id": "p_8e84c9025d779f15", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 50, "text": "亮表立曰：「長水校尉廖立，坐自貴大，臧否群士，公言國家不任賢達而任俗吏，又言萬人率者皆小子也；誹謗先帝，疵毀眾臣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "246ef8ef238ee826774987ad6a0f3af86fecee0a144c063c301566d9aabcbe70"}

{"id": "p_200c0e5a45049829", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 51, "text": "人有言國家兵眾簡練，部伍分明者，立舉頭視屋，憤吒作色曰：『何足言！", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "39935976beecf7ee12a94008eff18b17fc4e2d10f721d6f9bacc6a19eaef3ba7"}

{"id": "p_bed1052b99c71b1f", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 52, "text": "』凡如是者不可勝數。羊之亂群，猶能為害，況立託在大位，中人以下識真偽邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "038849b217d018711e805c668d5f646da4561ad13fe74d06c5f0a882ea7f5781"}

{"id": "p_be7ec17cde891563", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 53, "text": "」於是廢立為民，徙汶山郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "b4c8b880f07c922536e01f2834b311df78ec38b86342d212e82b80a7057e5ddc"}

{"id": "p_4271161ba73fb469", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 54, "text": "立躬率妻子耕殖自守，聞諸葛亮卒，垂泣歎曰：「吾終為左衽矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "8135a20378be28c78fe0d085924716cbda7e25d8a79472dd16380cb40b326ef8"}

{"id": "p_8caab7c9d2bf72fd", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」後監軍姜維率偏軍經汶山、詣立，稱立意氣不衰，言論自若。立遂終徙所。妻子還蜀。 ==李嚴== 李嚴字正方，南陽人也。少為郡職吏，以才幹稱。荊州牧劉表使歷諸郡縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "b1f64b139a63f5a06059f6cebb591234977a2f799231418a2017cf2394a0b8c1"}

{"id": "p_c84e39283606bb38", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 56, "text": "曹公入荊州時，嚴宰秭歸，遂西詣蜀，劉璋以為成都令，復有能名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "3e8fee97e87943f680997e6ab8f48e771ce5635a05d43f1b68661c6a074f8afd"}

{"id": "p_273342a3dd69e6d7", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 57, "text": "，署嚴為護軍，拒先主於綿竹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "c3d74961856b4c213c6c17413d222f4e778cd811b3a43d5ffdeeec96fced28e0"}

{"id": "p_71d02c8a4ba7e218", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 58, "text": "嚴率眾降先主，先主拜嚴裨將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "279b7fa53dde0c203cfa2c1d98f1f207ce33e8944c8263dfc4a320e3b21bba82"}

{"id": "p_69c033309759e05e", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 59, "text": "成都既定，為犍為太守、興業將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "f990e4feaa19136ea5cd190855fdb7327a2bb92e7406602496c84b1681b07186"}

{"id": "p_991c62b4e970799d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 60, "text": "二十三年，盜賊馬秦、高勝等起事於郪，合聚部伍數万人，到資中縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "b2f136c5f83e35bafaccbb5d5eedffd66d1ed9ba07af5fe476cec6d0ca941d30"}

{"id": "p_29dc8ff87ae2a580", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 61, "text": "時先主在漢中，嚴不更發兵，但率將郡士五千人討之，斬秦、勝等首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "0cc4dfe7d5372a66350c86c4f71ba154eac55bc2a3adb549150df2893bb8c00e"}

{"id": "p_bc50afbfe6ea9a67", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 62, "text": "枝黨星散，悉复民籍。又越巂夷率高定遣軍圍新道縣，嚴馳往赴救，賊皆破走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "e246b3706caa1a4ef8760027a401fef54582f8cc535b109e130a760057cfceb8"}

{"id": "p_15fa6227ce939b89", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 63, "text": "加輔漢將軍，領郡如故。 ，先主徵嚴詣永安宮，拜尚書令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "8d4817b590e851cb354ee540d1a63c61f9436c9bb7aad3b6d1a3e47afb38ab82"}

{"id": "p_ced6c6ad1671902d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 64, "text": "三年，先主疾病，嚴與諸葛亮並受遺詔輔少主；以嚴為中都護，統內外軍事，留鎮永安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "e4f8e1bbd2d9a5ba595cafc0c120111a3164994dfeaf4338c75fdda0ffc9afb7"}

{"id": "p_cc0c70cbc0e6162d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 65, "text": "建興元年，封都鄉侯，假節，加光祿勳。四年，轉為前將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "af5954438d41b0e549225bb7fdece15e9889467e751f281053c47f39af8f24cb"}

{"id": "p_2d1923bcda67a4ee", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 66, "text": "以諸葛亮欲出軍漢中，嚴當知後事，移屯江州，留護軍陳到駐永安，皆統屬嚴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "515f908c3502437d370cd28ef5cda00185ad5cf55e7011ceacf988072aabef60"}

{"id": "p_f930bc4854c46172", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 67, "text": "嚴與孟達書曰：「吾與孔明俱受寄託，憂深責重，思得良伴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "fa122619dc0fbf732ed49112410f86181f8973d0471ceaaba62b0a435eb700ba"}

{"id": "p_aca3ed2176fdfd00", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 68, "text": "」亮亦與達書曰：「部分如流，趨舍罔滯，正方性也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "17022743ee9f41e055cd027589239074d85f7d66279dc58a2eb4f01016f0aeda"}

{"id": "p_a957923ca0fb03fd", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」其見貴重如此。 八年，遷驃騎將軍。以曹真欲三道向漢川，亮命嚴將二萬人赴漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "38110b64be786d42adab7f24ea32f113a62c7cbad3da297205b38f0893ae6c17"}

{"id": "p_7bf3cf930e832093", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 70, "text": "亮表嚴子豐為江州都督督軍，典嚴後事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "44f6e5ffef5d7346249fe40fbacf69915ac814b9681b4edefb76f42ada6e69df"}

{"id": "p_93f2dff3fb828109", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 71, "text": "亮以明年當出軍，命嚴以中都護署府事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "a9ba7c43c76d12a2dd78b8001dc3aa0bf594104f2d0c45028dfe5723204abfc1"}

{"id": "p_b976d5e8f8667416", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 72, "text": "嚴改名為平。 九年春，亮軍祁山，平催督運事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "44f1568625ec496aa0db841f13e6bf59d46334a4324fc2ddc3ba1a4508cf69cd"}

{"id": "p_17d212a79b9d4de4", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 73, "text": "秋夏之際，值天霖雨，運糧不繼，平遣參軍狐忠、督軍成籓喻指，呼亮來還；亮承以退軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "dc5a90f0cf1e1fa1ffa8badd2a7215ceed06b3c81f96348057f898018386257c"}

{"id": "p_2fd7d848d7c07cda", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 74, "text": "平聞軍退，乃更陽驚，說「軍糧饒足，何以便歸」！", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "3444462b94fb2928efc51914c83e7accdac64aff0c4b95919da94ca392770c10"}

{"id": "p_f54dfa48a4fe8423", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 75, "text": "欲以解己不辦之責，顯亮不進之愆也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "6df3cbd2bc0cf38972c6c58f28f11ef058385028535e51d5a730b757ebb1af31"}

{"id": "p_21e2bcbf40aa0c3a", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 76, "text": "又表後主，說「軍偽退，欲以誘賊與戰」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "2f0c2faa51177b5d9a4aa63b1aeac30ae3991ab86958069ff9403dd4fb83a565"}

{"id": "p_e6220e599046ccb8", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 77, "text": "亮具出其前後手筆書疏本末，平違錯章灼。平辭窮情竭，首謝罪負。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "969c0a916d5251336787eeac6c7f5eaced47cd5d56181a44cc9987fa78ee712b"}

{"id": "p_dbb72f3dfae88a9d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 78, "text": "於是亮表平曰：「自先帝崩後，平所在治家，尚為小惠，安身求名，無憂國之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "4b5ccc9170ef997329fd4d48e1ed60ab9d74a63828825b431bc4546195d15e72"}

{"id": "p_ec00cac035a3dd1b", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 79, "text": "臣當北出，欲得平兵以鎮漢中，平窮難縱橫，無有來意，而求以五郡為巴州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "ae490f79da4267e4b125c926680cb63b6bb12728e41b3201914e7b6e4f467813"}

{"id": "p_262113736413d81d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 80, "text": "去年臣欲西征，欲令平主督漢中，平說司馬懿等開府闢召。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "df7fe5ac4b71ffad13b42ebb6312cc7a5164290745f31fa1681130668ebc9353"}

{"id": "p_e2f29b6286afc9a7", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 81, "text": "臣知平鄙情，欲因行之際偪臣取利也，是以表平子豐督主江州，隆崇其遇，以取一時之務。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "5b3843760898b5f7b3bbaf3a69efecf51d301efdddea1a7622a312935c30f60b"}

{"id": "p_c27d8c6dc3a4d5f7", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 82, "text": "平至之日，都委諸事，群臣上下皆怪臣待平之厚也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "aa59ba3420069fe0e9de8360b6a7c63947a800763f330a0d6f26ed2a381ae313"}

{"id": "p_8d968f776c503363", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 83, "text": "正以大事未定，漢室傾危，伐平之短，莫若褒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "9f970474b984aa5c015007bf51522b4f92d136d8f54462d13e7f9a4bc1024b85"}

{"id": "p_0abca45bd9cc1fac", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 84, "text": "然謂平情在於榮利而已，不意平心顛倒乃爾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "43301536982e1aa4b4cd577efb178731c5e3c99dc77c4d75f631bde208ab8461"}

{"id": "p_d26c96d3fc23ee36", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 85, "text": "若事稽留，將致禍敗，是臣不敏，言多增咎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "20dbaff9d473b5c2275409758c5f743b704082a92601d6388c3ff94abcfd6641"}
