{"id": "p_1949fdb1d1e355b7", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 86, "text": "」乃廢平為民，徙梓潼郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "b3109abb6d10461923e6509d8b710696aca3f815df4a991790bbc2fd311fdf2f"}

{"id": "p_9f49458c41c233c5", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 87, "text": " 十二年，平聞亮卒，發病死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "631134021971a5484ca1ff8f6f23471302bc86d6c576d1acbc56872f42765061"}

{"id": "p_5241d7e275cad7f7", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 88, "text": "平常冀亮當自補复，策後人不能，故以激憤也。 豐官至硃提太守。 ==劉琰== 劉琰字威碩，魯國人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "9d150a3301f4cc47406ae257d6f767e19ffde9a6c1c22d5769fac415d140b31f"}

{"id": "p_57c6aa54085da85a", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 89, "text": "先主在豫州，闢為從事，以其宗姓，有風流，善談論，厚親待之，遂隨從周旋，常為賓客。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "a9e63a56c82e15d4428dab7edeab1c8ee0dac31bb23fc98b4b356f4368907a2d"}

{"id": "p_883dd42e947a084e", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 90, "text": "先主定益州，以琰為固陵太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "c944c2c217ade05052a96e7469b9ff7b2134f848db1dbce7ca29676c5d226921"}

{"id": "p_678b0eb22266e3b4", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 91, "text": "後主立，封都鄉侯，班位每亞李嚴，為衛尉中軍師後將軍，遷車騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "3a6b9fec99be037e85490470b6d023654ad37a1943114c9b515b0a5b2a941244"}

{"id": "p_d637378ee7530c30", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 92, "text": "然不豫國政，但領兵千馀，隨丞相亮諷議而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "5425bfe48ca58eb8ad005fd4b6ca56c785cfeeabe738fd3fc73f7a64bc1e51c5"}

{"id": "p_7d135d0264c65904", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 93, "text": "車服飲食，號為侈靡，侍婢數十，皆能為聲樂，又悉教誦讀魯靈光殿賦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "e66400e354de3db82842ebf7d8f3d211381cf6581f35440cab7c6ea82c309774"}

{"id": "p_a206164b96218103", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 94, "text": "，與前軍師魏延不和，言語虛誕，亮責讓之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "c83176ceb0cafb264f0266b00c85d31e4cfb1f802283c5f0796d52fc1ab020bb"}

{"id": "p_ed47f129fa0be2f7", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 95, "text": "琰與亮箋謝曰：「琰禀性空虛，本薄操行，加有酒荒之病，自先帝以來，紛紜之論，殆將傾覆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "2a09bfa5253617c51581868de1eba18c97be6d41657a4c0ea860d3fb3463e84f"}

{"id": "p_b4d6276c809693eb", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 96, "text": "頗蒙明公本其一心在國，原其身中穢垢，扶持全濟，致其祿位，以至今日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "703f0012a59670b9b53e4e25dcd00e651714fdabbacc2f9b037ea7578a05e84e"}

{"id": "p_56c9ec2962e5d1e0", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 97, "text": "間者迷醉，言有違錯，慈恩含忍，不致之於理，使得全完，保育性命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "698bbafe6d0790214898261d623d019abc7b7e8a9e83afc1fe720ed02bba25e4"}

{"id": "p_8407b088a3827268", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 98, "text": "雖必克己責躬，改過投死，以誓神靈；無所用命，則靡寄顏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "67fa97fcb0efb16614c66f716b7bffacde1b6554a43434db4f8ff23f559c62e0"}

{"id": "p_2e0c71f1f96b6e99", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 99, "text": "」於是亮遣琰還成都，官位如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "03389b20123358164c8cc9ca63a4670f853fc7f7d068fcdc179cbe19cd91065d"}

{"id": "p_f6856e297eb7515c", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 100, "text": " 琰失志慌惚。十二年正月，琰妻胡氏入賀太后，太后令特留胡氏，經月乃出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "32f0feaafdb9c54976acdb08d1238cecd93ada8322725a3b1efb05b51c46b571"}

{"id": "p_d136b4549f2bb13b", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 101, "text": "胡氏有美色，琰疑其與後主有私，呼（卒）五百撾胡，至於以履搏面，而後棄遣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "a93e21b5d9e21c5b05e4d7f6856dad8ac6d876205763244e7f1872ee97bf2713"}

{"id": "p_d9b8a8279444b926", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 102, "text": "胡具以告言琰，琰坐下獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "faf2e1435d72db72a244ba0abe64991efdba0a8de0c3098bd23421474a80bc30"}

{"id": "p_a476f3eadf653d88", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 103, "text": "有司議曰：「卒非撾妻之人，面非受履之地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "55d7e50134e8b5878ab768be920d5fac5676749b975b1f71a3c77420d2374df2"}

{"id": "p_37ae6e79f74d482f", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 104, "text": "」琰竟棄市。自是大臣妻母朝慶遂絕。 ==魏延== 魏延字文長，義陽人也。以部曲隨先主入蜀，數有戰功，遷牙門將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "a814c8b8c50b4bbd4304af96ed803600473321bcbc7e066921fe47ef53db5afa"}

{"id": "p_43597515dc2a41de", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 105, "text": "先主爲漢中王，遷治成都，當得重將以鎮漢川，眾論以爲必在張飛，飛亦以心自許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "56a83245d5996f767db42dffeba3a078ce51768be515b61f9612c8ac540242b9"}

{"id": "p_ad775bd2995af6fa", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 106, "text": "先主乃拔延爲督漢中鎮遠將軍，領漢中太守，一軍盡驚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "234b72b7d442e083126977e31e1a571787858b1f2122a2a4ec71818aeeb0c00d"}

{"id": "p_269d2d66614d8f3a", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 107, "text": "先主大會群臣，問延曰：「今委卿以重任，卿居之欲-{云}-何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "fcc548d01e0fd4568dfa305fb83bf32783719954a3a4ea0cb8f7ebdc4ec0c39e"}

{"id": "p_8cd7d10bbbe985bd", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 108, "text": "」延對曰：「若曹操舉天下而來，請爲大王拒之；偏將十萬之眾至，請爲大王吞之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "244007ee753db291c4ac973663d16de58adf91b544d0eba6a9d93ad832369178"}

{"id": "p_0c38dca4e6dc4113", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 109, "text": "」先主稱善，眾-{咸}-壯其言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "c7e7e589c4be75a848f5bb68657563acfbf678d2b6c211bb1689fb7cbbbb5144"}

{"id": "p_f25b5122c7e40f62", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 110, "text": "先主踐尊號，進拜鎮北將軍。，封都亭侯。五年，諸葛亮駐漢中，更以延爲督前部，領丞相司馬、涼州刺史，八年，使延西入羌中，魏-{後}-將軍費瑤、雍州刺史郭淮與延戰-{於}-陽-{谿}-，延大破淮等，遷爲前軍師、-{征}-西大將軍，假節，進封南鄭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "6b405ffd07b6ce24cf7dafab3d19873f74f591e5fff3459c36373c501090cf14"}

{"id": "p_d0a6fb89346e5694", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 111, "text": " 延每隨亮出，輒欲請兵萬人，與亮異道會於潼關，如韓信故事，亮-{制}-而不許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "56f4c3bc65bb7f1502742a4f557d539877e6d3b1c2a8a97f0b912ab86a7e06e3"}

{"id": "p_f8546be5263a3481", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 112, "text": "延常謂亮爲怯，嘆恨己-{才}-用之不盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "8ad61e03a6a8a7dc4104599359d918c1b41233da154629d06e90661f04910762"}

{"id": "p_38761455f78bd95b", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 113, "text": " 延既善養士卒，勇猛過人，又性矜高，當時皆避下之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "efbfe3616126f06152c09bd7feb6a2ed4ee6e3ab4fd38afdb268b66b5d36e4fa"}

{"id": "p_e6ba38285cd7dd8f", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 114, "text": "唯楊儀不假借延，延以爲至忿，有如水火。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "ef364031a08b3fbcc1eb511b4604e3a5ca7b47215fb121a204a68d2e56359e81"}

{"id": "p_dcf0a90a41d48988", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 115, "text": "十二年，亮出北-{谷}-口，延爲前鋒。出亮營十-{里}-，延夢頭上生角，以問-{占}-夢趙直，直詐延曰：「夫麒麟有角而不用，此不戰而賊欲自破之像也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "0675f3ecc5cb9db233b6d7aad521c2889c60afe073c6f1e0e8ce29421e518de2"}

{"id": "p_056a7c38cc9a1fcd", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 116, "text": "」退而告人曰： 「角之爲字，刀下用也；頭上用刀，其-{凶}-甚矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "b85c1d986b7eddf792e29ba4beb8ba360aaba69d702cac53487d465655435394"}

{"id": "p_6618c053148f37d7", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 117, "text": "」 秋，亮病困，密與長史楊儀、司馬費禕、護軍-{姜}-維等作身歿之後退軍節度，令延斷-{後}-，-{姜}-維次之；若延或不從命，軍便自發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "eeb59aacea814407f6d2178371b8539cae90bb0812a4fc09d1bcb2872ae63c4a"}

{"id": "p_13dc20a940ade891", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 118, "text": "亮適卒，秘不發喪，儀令禕往揣延意指。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "8e86a2c964946890d59e5c3c180c8111a509fb92d42ff0ffeab00adcdc40dff2"}

{"id": "p_16919e976e633dcb", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 119, "text": "延曰：「丞相雖亡，吾自見在。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "bf7f21c6636d600e15fa8bbae915b73fca10ea3a439326db39caa5599faed4e4"}

{"id": "p_aacc6bd997f09abb", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 120, "text": "府親官屬便可將喪還葬，吾自當率諸軍擊賊，-{云}-何以一人死廢天下之事邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "2f7ea18be706109a2267a279bfb97510945765707848325d9a51b051cb53c549"}

{"id": "p_e215eac0a9491dda", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 121, "text": "且魏延何人，當爲楊儀所部勒，作斷-{後}-將乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "de6685cdcdf877a2b82e1be218831a5d44cfbf315885aa1f2103fa4b27db1da0"}

{"id": "p_f0419c10c29f9b23", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 122, "text": "」因與禕共作行留部分，令禕手書與己連名，告下諸將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "6106b120f89eb22f987151f2e8b5934156c70acaf6c477e36fb9abb96027ff14"}

{"id": "p_04386dd1d6f5a8e3", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 123, "text": "禕紿延曰：「當爲君還解楊長史，長史文吏，稀更軍事，必不違命也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "d745466b8023930b9f05a30addc90c10ffd133851ef406aeedf35c0d333e5b9e"}

{"id": "p_bab33bb69f7ba397", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 124, "text": "」禕出門馳馬而去，延尋悔，追之已不及矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "f9d536eb8cf089b00115ea7139110a3d54cda96ce9449f80f3c35f731440d2a5"}

{"id": "p_68856dfef6c9ace9", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 125, "text": "延遣人覘儀等，遂使欲案亮成規，諸營相次引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "bd04d8a750ec5909edbb059c84427a9689da515c7786df4f64efeb9b18cabbb0"}

{"id": "p_73154aeacfa36e11", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 126, "text": "延大怒，（才）儀未發，率所領徑先南歸，所過燒絶閣道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "d052ce19a472898d55ef4ecc935a8cfbcc00049f28fb19d54451ec8521692c7b"}

{"id": "p_80b3a30beeaf9eeb", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 127, "text": "延、儀各相表叛逆，一日之中，羽檄交至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "2e821669cada5b6a2df02250d82cbdbf9ba26a9f441ba32e4036fd2081ee1e12"}

{"id": "p_81a227feb9f9609b", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 128, "text": "-{後}-主以問侍中董允、留府長史蔣琬，琬、允-{咸}-保儀疑延。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "d759c0c33e0fc3ba910a0592424980b6e8b991c0cd9a5b1d4649ceeb802eb877"}

{"id": "p_ec9044ca4eef9554", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 129, "text": "儀等槎山通道，晝夜兼行，亦繼延-{後}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "fa4a25beb799f2fd4bd5effaf62a187f44cd52139be5299a89d0a90dd50904e9"}

{"id": "p_5e70478b8ff88d16", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 130, "text": "延先至，據南-{谷}-口，遣兵逆擊儀等，儀等令何平在前-{禦}-延。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "8b46beac7bb7859853e733ae806dd5634eeaf02662521de02514d3de3e43e00e"}

{"id": "p_20c70cd235392d9a", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 131, "text": "平叱延先登曰：「公亡，身尚未寒，汝輩何敢乃爾！", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "091eabc7977d14798db93ca2e82e90821ccb813a1d8a80197b27adcd503d3f34"}

{"id": "p_8840c521ee51b2f3", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」延士眾知曲在延，莫爲用命，軍皆散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "838d493825b69b15a9bb6ae2018f58ed8d906ba06f7e0f853b1f2be4b6a2e3d1"}

{"id": "p_0f45bb3147bfe15d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 133, "text": "延獨與其子數人逃亡，奔漢中。儀遣馬岱追斬之，致首-{於}-儀，儀起自踏之，曰：「庸奴！", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "357da058645027bdff8d1487500563f4b8b7e6f666d1c734ca38342beb3b6704"}

{"id": "p_30b1cd8ce11e5a6b", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 134, "text": "復能作惡不？」遂夷延三族。初，蔣琬率宿衞諸營赴難北行，行數十-{里}-，延死問至，乃旋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "2d9f11a804c0cd3358057a8bb05174bdb4457d422f71052aa38eb1eb632172af"}

{"id": "p_88eff8f30ad22771", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 135, "text": "原延意不北降魏而南還者，但欲除殺儀等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "2896879e0bcd3d2121f47adf7aa45f9222ba229d673dba95a79627a95e3f1bf1"}

{"id": "p_42f75dd20266ca7c", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 136, "text": "平日諸將素不同，冀時論必當以代亮。本指如此。不便背叛。 ==楊儀== 楊儀字威公，襄陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "e27119ba79ae4a2b5c036cd22e3bb8ee54ea1d4fc299f1df69e3b7ee5cfb2f46"}

{"id": "p_b21acab0bbc07f7b", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 137, "text": "建安中，為荊州刺史傅群主簿，背群而詣襄陽太守關羽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "90a7db85ce69897a7f1f588aae0bead20e7294d640222a653fb06629dd602534"}

{"id": "p_d69420b8f7703a58", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 138, "text": "羽命為功曹，遣奉使西詣先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "e1378de8e1b835eab26e9e300ee00cf2ae21511734c8cff8816402e7130cc78d"}

{"id": "p_9681561690b68aa8", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 139, "text": "先主與語論軍國計策，政治得失，大悅之，因闢為左將軍兵曹掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "7f164ca594225fbefc97a793a54098187817dd29dc2d40db2bee0d51811d27a7"}

{"id": "p_48b8e1eeafb070e0", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 140, "text": "及先主為漢中王，拔儀為尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "a1270265fc8c1204d27219f11e97762949125616eba3a94124a2d66fb27ef2c3"}

{"id": "p_eab0ee7fd7ca56da", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 141, "text": "先主稱尊號，東征吳，儀與尚書令劉巴不睦，左遷遙署弘農太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "b69c768a073e56362a6331d0b62a564d754bb2d4e4f3663ec8f551bf45037fb5"}

{"id": "p_eccecb14aed545d1", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 142, "text": "，丞相亮以為參軍，署府事，將南行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "9408a9f83fac1315aa5430f2cced523e9d4201021fe486dea627b25334eca824"}

{"id": "p_d46cb23672598e9c", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 143, "text": "五年，隨亮漢中。八年，遷長史，加綏軍將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "e89e603ad5181e11b2ed0fbcdd903a23963766a9491ee950a0a5fa19afa96651"}

{"id": "p_26b38cd0d1d17b0c", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 144, "text": "亮數出軍，儀常規畫分部，籌度糧穀，不稽思慮，斯須便了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "b9e2925a2ca14bd1da83fb1c7a55be564d71294076cffd5f8b280fde5d49d292"}

{"id": "p_3326bad7b5173dc8", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 145, "text": "軍戎節度，取辦於儀。亮深惜儀之才幹，憑魏延之驍勇，常恨二人之不平，不忍有所偏廢也。十二年，隨亮出屯谷口。亮卒於敵場。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "ca40489e3b3ec88d7cfd06356376414a146f193ace7fa0768d21f360f2395c3f"}

{"id": "p_db7dedc6dfedb8b5", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 146, "text": "儀既領軍還，又誅討延，自以為功勳至大，宜當代亮秉政，呼都尉趙正以周易筮之，卦得家人，默然不悅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "874f0c8b296531925983f83cfba9b5b5e2e2b2067f38ac88aeeb415041356e73"}

{"id": "p_0c189fd9e5e37b19", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 147, "text": "而亮平生密指，以儀性狷狹，意在蔣琬，琬遂為尚書令、益州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "83a7dc955804f7b12e4abb2d32a349ab210e63119b6a893512ba66ced8352111"}

{"id": "p_92930a5e053774f0", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 148, "text": "儀至，拜為中軍師，無所統領，從容而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "157f49887ab88a7d640e35b4ac8a7ca4cf260d9a863435032dde384d59c2536e"}

{"id": "p_910ce93bc0ddffa3", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 149, "text": " 初，儀為先主尚書，琬為尚書郎，後雖俱為丞相參軍長史，儀每從行，當其勞劇，自惟年宦先琬，才能逾之，於是怨憤形於聲色，嘆吒之音發於五內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "21b0777aa79f1defb8e8085e03b03c150ded16256f181d6918796f0f499ee248"}

{"id": "p_a975381dc38a108d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 150, "text": "時人畏其言語不節，莫敢從也，惟後軍師費禕往慰省之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "e8430092003c025e16482fdb7f8b5e5978e0a2d8acbb675adee12d364aac7366"}

{"id": "p_a0f7f42ddbaa2c88", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 151, "text": "儀對禕恨望，前後云云，又語禕曰：「往者丞相亡沒之際，吾若舉軍以就魏氏，處世寧當落度如此邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "155c2a0cb75341fe7a6ea91490f79f1b5330fd0a17f970496a45df70261982c8"}

{"id": "p_78b2eec5b3040a91", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 152, "text": "令人追悔不可複及。」禕密表其言。十三年，廢儀為民，徙漢嘉郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "4029607640fac2239ba3d4081b8334985b62b159d23248bf93ecd3a40d8be839"}

{"id": "p_3601caced3fc1f5d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 153, "text": "儀至徙所，复上書誹謗，辭指激切，遂下郡收儀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "10cd295a9f85b57bb32aa92a10bf0a532050a1c5b31e36a4025a348e88aa6100"}

{"id": "p_6d15d1ef374eadb8", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 154, "text": "儀自殺，其妻子還蜀。 ==【評】== 評曰：劉封處嫌疑之地，而思防不足以自衛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "361e9eab927b482cab58f763bf9040be9016b44ca99ccb11f0062a4b8ff05add"}

{"id": "p_68b7ad2bedf8166d", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 155, "text": "彭羕、廖立以才拔進，李嚴以幹局達，魏延以勇略任，楊儀以當官顯，劉琰舊仕，並咸貴重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "81422505127b6005c8c355ef36cebeaf825d7fda712f9f2013d92ce8ec195aa9"}

{"id": "p_d3845456dbd01b8f", "source_id": "src_131b7a6c87908bf1", "ordinal": 156, "text": "覽其舉措，跡其規矩，招禍取咎，無不自己也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "fb1dc272b30c4bc478215e4430b21c6a4bae684f94feef35cf89397e4e5c209a"}

{"id": "p_a135e0fbc0ce20ed", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_135deda176a22695", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 1, "text": "霍峻字仲邈，南郡枝江人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "c58e306ca097c444df2bec613c947f1e1319690ae4f2891982f0937ebdd46d5e"}

{"id": "p_8bc4cdec65f6ce0d", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 2, "text": "兄篤於鄉里合部曲數百人，篤卒，荊州牧劉表令峻攝其眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "3c147a82306ffc8a2acd715cf5c0a0d3e85ad31de04356e9c40c5a2c1d5a9da5"}

{"id": "p_b5c92459440d2e32", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 3, "text": "表卒，峻率眾歸先主，先主以峻為中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "24fd16012937fbeaa43304adf26c688a7bbd49699d1423b14efc4c35eb567a80"}

{"id": "p_9a1f49fb214a6497", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 4, "text": "先主自葭萌南還襲劉璋，留峻守葭萌城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "19c48eb050067c7d791aef582f5159ca58ad569e35a69b6be5cafa5f0f485642"}

{"id": "p_6faf6ee9b2d91740", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 5, "text": "張魯遣將楊帛誘峻，求共守城，峻曰：「小人頭可得，城不可得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "5cdb2643d34b33f142ae8b118a5157714c33459b6c8cdef7e2edc650e6c2d7bc"}

{"id": "p_9cd4aa3b8f99fe6a", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 6, "text": "後璋將扶禁、向存等帥萬餘人由閬水上，攻圍攻峻，且一年，不能下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "94942a64ffa2a52eca535ced42f8d3039dacaa026faaf42d227becb827ed0662"}

{"id": "p_7e7b691b4172fd10", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 7, "text": "峻城中兵才數百人，伺其怠隙，選精銳出擊，大破之，即斬存首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "b7280243d30b2822121d456f9d95a08c2e329599d8ada8153820d9537df69c39"}

{"id": "p_a48bc092342fccfb", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 8, "text": "先主定蜀，嘉峻之功，乃分廣漢為梓潼郡，以峻為梓潼太守、裨將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "1459add7e553ae9e5a8b84bdeba749e3a3e6a0ea81b22d91211a0e29cbac7875"}

{"id": "p_60f3974c8b5ca817", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 9, "text": "在官三年，年四十卒，還葬成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "54cc72cadbfa07f23ebed1619862945e8b084b512f832d47e1177e09878fcc04"}

{"id": "p_01c8f5359980f3b4", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 10, "text": "先主甚悼惜，乃詔諸葛亮曰：「峻既佳士，加有功於國，欲行爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "5d629f0e95d8e6d3a1c08b59e55b3aee6247f615965d198326a0ba15c9df47af"}

{"id": "p_02aeba8621d1f97c", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」遂親率群僚臨會弔祭，因留宿墓上，當時榮之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "f35f67f1c68db5f94f7a83cbffa496604c683408f97534d88e00a91ed5ccc4f8"}

{"id": "p_78354c860483fa45", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 12, "text": "子弋，字紹先，先主末年為太子舍人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "dc1d99e929fc063ed892e5a3dad9e97342cf76d52e4a98dbfeb68dc7a4d7afcf"}

{"id": "p_74956e066ba2985d", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 13, "text": "丞相諸葛亮北駐漢中，請為記室，使與子喬共周旋游處。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "a6af90210cd937ebc80962d5bd3f7602c59ad4b2728e8faa14303e0411cc8a1f"}

{"id": "p_8759226c9d8579b7", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 14, "text": "後主立太子璿，以弋為中庶子，璿好騎射，出入無度，弋援引古義，盡言規諫，甚得切磋之體。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "92fca456db89d812c11f94de5b0a4ee5ca6a3161510e9ad19c220796dbb8e0d3"}

{"id": "p_5ae57bbfaccdf25a", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 15, "text": "後為參軍庲降屯副貳都督，又轉護軍，統事如前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "5b0d00749bc241638e52d6ac0f2087f96bdf5e8a1291e72eda10de96984238ce"}

{"id": "p_22b4d43718946439", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 16, "text": "時永昌郡夷獠恃險不賓，數為寇害，乃以弋領永昌太守，率偏軍討之，遂斬其豪帥，破壞邑落，郡界寧靜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "5a8cb4aaa5aa1672531d715231af37ad56131cbb7b3d74701893bcab0787c357"}

{"id": "p_a72ca0d50ec98ef4", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 17, "text": "遷監軍、翊軍將軍，領建寧太守，還統南郡事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "b92ab4dfaffb48d9ea88ca7498b852719b5f77c854884634f5a6f6feea34855e"}

{"id": "p_f092bd4ece2720a3", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 18, "text": "是歲，蜀並於魏，弋與巴東領軍襄陽羅憲各保全一方，舉以內附，咸因仍前任，寵待有加。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "7cfdd715da6278b60706da371249eff54b745d9faf2e5a558d47c1c5deb764d0"}

{"id": "p_c9398d2c9af9d651", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 19, "text": "先主起事葭萌，進軍來南，連閉城不降，先主義之，不強逼也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "5f165c71b6db63a8ba3db4025c5a23c960ce8eb4c845b2eb59463047de6b24ca"}

{"id": "p_15dcf3b4799d60c8", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 20, "text": "及成都既平，以連為什邡令，轉在廣都，所居有績。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "09aaa2d9fd73ab57c3d5acfcbb8805d5d84dc386dfe63ec502da5361d3dc659d"}

{"id": "p_f22034e131917369", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 21, "text": "遷司鹽校尉，較鹽鐵之利，利入甚多，有裨國用，於是簡取良才以為官屬，若呂乂、杜祺、劉干，終皆至大官，自連所拔也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f45dd7ef4729fee69386ec5e797841e3b6611593541035a90dab8e32ec1e75ec"}

{"id": "p_a7b5b0e4822bb97a", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 22, "text": "遷蜀郡太守、興業將軍，領鹽府如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "ea2285a68dc50d9e1b69ff08c7991f9cebf9ab3f7b30cf9978e696cf186965c5"}

{"id": "p_9c724c75e81eaaee", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 23, "text": "建興元年，拜屯騎校尉，領丞相長史，封平陽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "315cae6eceee13db34bd47b29d49396c2a612374bcd2342ae27095a082d9c6d1"}

{"id": "p_ce971b7ba4d7dd7e", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 24, "text": "時南方諸郡不賓，諸葛亮將自征之，連諫以為「此不毛之地，疫癘之鄉，不宜以一國之望，冒險而行」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "ba424642725a6757808095a42625f5582594b4ce39debdfbd614279d68873911"}

{"id": "p_e1734745b9ca72d5", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 25, "text": "亮慮諸將才不及己，意欲必往而連言輒懇至，故停留者久之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "559e948253fdd6b89528e791fc7e219ea1ef8831c468c10e068a78ef81279ff2"}

{"id": "p_aaa54c072b50f293", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 26, "text": "向朗字巨達，襄陽宜城人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "2252686c3eb5f77387da1fc751bdcc56575eda259887b73a3bc73fbbf87e97c8"}

{"id": "p_677fa9015926aae7", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 27, "text": "先主定江南，使朗督秭歸、夷道、巫（山）、夷陵四縣軍民事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "f4febc00a444be7ff2ded00fa1e5e8cc2a9b8fadf39585a56e20fe5dc4747702"}

{"id": "p_6b86966403fd7d87", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 28, "text": "蜀既平，以朗為巴西太守，頃之轉任，又徙房陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "c193330d7fa4091a8a3f97ad454a615533ae1eaa264225f9f66ea6841da307db"}

{"id": "p_a0cdd6d1da013154", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 29, "text": "后主践阼，为步兵校尉，代王连领丞相长史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "1ef29dc9c48763cb5ecd0bd8c8302ed27d6fd9a4a9a8f38e53f55e8f11425a6f"}

{"id": "p_fe4130639701a7c0", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 30, "text": "丞相亮南征，朗留统后事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "0af57b42f2aa50c2d62f2e0208c7d0b88d594ed753b21256c906a6559099cbfa"}

{"id": "p_36e79dc12a792e72", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 31, "text": "朗素與馬謖善，謖逃亡，朗知情不舉，亮恨之，免官還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "1e1d9f4c7c0bc957b3ade2508fc7393ad77f0ea81e037912d4b8affa64e3d760"}

{"id": "p_89a79f503fecf93e", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 32, "text": "數年，為光祿勳，亮卒後徒左將軍，追論舊功，封顯明亭侯，位特進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "88f5f118c51cd66d2fa7bd51812b19547eb14344cedfe2e98ab40d7aef1a81ab"}

{"id": "p_da6967c7aff0a5aa", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 33, "text": "初，朗少時雖涉獵文學，然不治素檢，以吏能稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "90e918f3f69627b3d1d7db76d9ebcffe580df4c81e592abbb1739654f990beb2"}

{"id": "p_bab0490c18403237", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 34, "text": "自去長史，優遊無事垂三十年，乃更潛心典籍，孜孜不倦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "76acb9a0981c429f73cd694267e9c0807471f28a8c1b2716c6d88122a13ffd54"}

{"id": "p_02297b57382baf1c", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 35, "text": "年逾八十，猶手自校書，刊定謬誤，積聚篇卷，於時最多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "2b5f964c1cd9aabb29e43a3ca3d34d83b8649070de82fb0282852526e9fd1728"}

{"id": "p_81cf3adffd75c1d6", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 36, "text": "開門接賓，誘納後進，但講論古義，不干時事，以是見稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "a43efc6f10a5d3ff17587c904c95be99426d0a615b897c68a223b425d1ac2015"}

{"id": "p_55647ac15f04eaac", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 37, "text": "上自執政，下及童冠，皆敬重焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "ff96ccbd417ea28f5231394eb6d0126dd58fd9762be53bd0cb8be3d9380ab86b"}

{"id": "p_53e2f917d16e8398", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 38, "text": "子條嗣，景耀中為御史中丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "de21cf5e5e03d93928f3db89991751fd04ce4da9e8300002dd0ab3cc197ea4c2"}

{"id": "p_2954ebdf1c31240f", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 39, "text": "朗兄子寵，先主時為牙門將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "42d835c4d20f85910db28c934d6ed02c532869e4c2fc9c9be945458c2232dac2"}

{"id": "p_bfbf6e4970bdf256", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 40, "text": "封都亭侯，後為中部督，典宿衛兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "a435523f6c40c18256344161992f2d8ba30c7d9982011a09b5f5d30b1b39afa7"}

{"id": "p_7805f71e365b3923", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 41, "text": "諸葛亮當北行，表與後主曰：「將軍向寵，性行淑均，曉暢軍事，試用於昔，先帝稱之曰能，是以眾論舉寵為督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "12a97a61295a4bc79bdd035e38e083342e42246450d2ca1ecfeffaac08efb785"}

{"id": "p_e4d443b05711b2bc", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 42, "text": "愚以為營中之事，悉以咨之，必能使行陳和睦，優劣得所也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "8d60d9e1701aa81a980e4ef4bc3b4484ad65d7cf65a6c6d6ed640ede6e094674"}

{"id": "p_778805e7d2b094f5", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 43, "text": "寵弟充，歷射聲校尉、尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "f0275a644370f89f7ae42219bd221aec5ef5f0f187108092710f08a10ec7c093"}

{"id": "p_ee460f2d30a50564", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 44, "text": "張裔字君嗣，蜀郡成都人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "96bfdace1f34daf8bab063aff08d4555f8e622fef8e075fc2e4168141e571c4a"}

{"id": "p_6559f8f3b8ef1a23", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 45, "text": "治《公羊春秋》，博涉《史》、《漢》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "d2d0a897da2e439d204a5da0ede4462d524f8d0a847e1c7b5629a29e8decdf34"}

{"id": "p_4642a4ebc456aa4f", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 46, "text": "汝南許文休入蜀，謂裔干裡敏捷，是中夏鍾元常之倫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "cbddfdde9b0313c8671f950815c4b2626202c4d991b632954d35ee08d0b4a35d"}

{"id": "p_c41e3462a9e10a82", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 47, "text": "劉璋時，舉孝廉，為魚復長，還州署從事，領帳下司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "093a047710b80aa099d28a63890a03a2d70417d9f73424492fa3776e57816397"}

{"id": "p_001dff79f0b52b4d", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 48, "text": "張飛自荊州由墊江入，璋授裔兵，拒張飛於德陽陌下，軍敗，還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "7dec6f398ff468a9d68f2d2fa13265e0271e5c5ab8f77d4d027a77a571dee614"}

{"id": "p_42328d4a101388b7", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 49, "text": "為璋奉使詣先主，先主許以禮其君而安其人也，裔還，城門乃開。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "2d997ba3cd5c86fb84ad181e7540b2650b31d6f2d6bc0e69a709c7270e81a20f"}

{"id": "p_1399a04485d5227d", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 50, "text": "先主以裔巴郡太守，還為司金中郎將，典作農戰之器。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "5b4e28da0385f84854aefd60c99940be4b1e4048a760e0c1df6344439b9a3ab7"}

{"id": "p_4bc9df3ec5fbbd76", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 51, "text": "先是，益州郡殺太守正昂，耆率雍闓恩信著於南土，使命周旋，遠通孫權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "229d95e630286d90c0b0eb0369e73a37f6b199d4dfee07a5734c128927a2fa61"}

{"id": "p_232c9161b9f9eb57", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 52, "text": "乃以裔為益州太守，逕往至郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "4c0a8beb469355bba8d5a2fb280690892c9b5d7d40ca94698682dad72fe52867"}

{"id": "p_35c5e6cf4c91ae3d", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 53, "text": "闓遂趑趄不賓，假鬼教曰：「張府君如瓠壺，外雖澤而內實粗，不足殺，令縛與吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "bb32ed214234b1a6c1177de6c54d6f27f9207e2ef9e980717be7c089adc41baf"}

{"id": "p_91a8ffe501431bc3", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 54, "text": "會先主薨，諸葛亮遣鄧芝使吳，亮令芝言次可從權請裔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "7182de17336a200f687e82cfefcfe616cd8971a7f81c8de245bfe02260b6f9ce"}

{"id": "p_bcbfec166c6a137b", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 55, "text": "裔自至吳數年，流徒伏匿，權未之知也，故許芝遣裔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "2e304c88c7a778eb964cd503f041efebfb5937051971c25c2f5740c51335691a"}

{"id": "p_9e3b7c5eee92090b", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 56, "text": "問裔曰：「蜀卓氏寡女，亡奔司馬相如，貴土風俗何以乃爾乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "9620532fad2a4559fafa08783f9b56c7bb1b11c34797c3223b305d416e82b415"}

{"id": "p_af46c3bd849d5c85", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 57, "text": "」裔對曰：「愚以為卓氏之寡女，猶賢於買臣之妻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "beae4d21f118e45e288ac30edd1b23c78f4dcbefd35d6898ea9a8eb1161d0833"}

{"id": "p_6432332c10581a30", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」權又謂裔曰：「君還，必用事西朝，終不作田父子閭裡也，將何以報我？", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "1aaafd04695bd5c9b281072652ea5808a9014467ce857d4b61a72054af55f92d"}

{"id": "p_bc51d8dfa6423e89", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 59, "text": "」裔對曰：「裔負罪而歸，將委命有司。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "7763f6a398fc49e1fc23f10d5c6a13ba9e879edb97130906dc7047d6a02f7f4e"}

{"id": "p_7cd48aa92bd0a554", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 60, "text": "若蒙僥倖得全首領，五十八已前父母之年也，自此已後大王之賜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "8e4e3c80ea1177001ab375a0a58a277eea4b1a7aa8d46950a9cc5ac9948a5a1a"}

{"id": "p_277e9b0e5af7c8f4", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」權言笑歡悅，有器裔之色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "f6ebb79651eb680e7c96c1a739414f325df61e077c12ab91a8a0ec297286608c"}

{"id": "p_ef31091673b440a5", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 62, "text": "裔出閣，深悔不能陽愚，即便就船，倍道兼行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "b8f3ea01e9f746a79533ad4d333cf9266f978bcb37bb79c7414fcdd00c64463a"}

{"id": "p_d35bd23585117525", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 63, "text": "權果追之，裔已入永安界數十里，追者不能及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "825f61418385b60bffe111dfade25051789ad48703b095b0b2c8af73e139aaec"}

{"id": "p_7f7f1076a487e37c", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 64, "text": "既至蜀，丞相亮以為參軍，署府事，又領益州治中從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "4d35a56e3a28c47528c4e90f19e2abe541ffe0f932297b84c51b184dbebbad50"}

{"id": "p_ec55a2784fc16317", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 65, "text": "亮出駐漢中，裔以射聲校尉領留府長史，常稱曰：「公賞不遺遠，罰不阿近，爵不可以無功取，刑不可以貴勢免，此賢愚之所以僉忘其身者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "76c00500bccfd9aabc0c51e9fe20cc357d36ab232e4bdcf7dfba4a897f139444"}

{"id": "p_2287c9dc4f63b666", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 66, "text": "」其明年，北詣亮諮事，送者數百，車乘盈路，裔還書與所親曰：「近者涉道，晝夜接客，不得寧息，人自敬丞相長史，男子張君嗣附之，疲倦欲死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "1888da379b7c0f95fcdc7c5213c1bcb4a611d1bb56efd8b9799e47a37f47d28e"}

{"id": "p_fcf9c036b4d4632b", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 67, "text": "」其談啁流速，皆此類也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "c1955156e91a433bdb0d2a557db834713a1aa3335c0ac0c1cb0024e5cc15c59e"}

{"id": "p_877455f92172c9e7", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 68, "text": "少與犍為楊恭友善，恭早死，遺孤未數歲，裔迎留，與分屋而居，事恭母如母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "fec49de11c860aed986c8b81af40227769161aaecdfb4bb59921edf75f2668ea"}

{"id": "p_3a8fc61c085f00e6", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 69, "text": "恭之子息長大，為之娶婦，買田宅產業，使立門戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "6b6fd8f0ed1c303d9a398b53d6d6c691cb4bfafcfcf05f4eab74efb4059849bb"}

{"id": "p_4630bbdd0cccef4b", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 70, "text": "撫恤故舊，振贍衰宗，行義甚至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "0618993f2616481754b2a5e897db838ee04830042676ef9fc0a34f29c1ced8e4"}

{"id": "p_21c08dab457cedcd", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 71, "text": "加輔漢將軍，領長史如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "d4a71e90d75f4241df3b443e987f1611503de822dab9356710aa2a5606653087"}

{"id": "p_415f8709a0db1459", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 72, "text": "子毣嗣，歷三郡守、監軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "0d08be8ffca9deff124fd6281fb55295e6378526a1287acc6f704d148ae49cd1"}

{"id": "p_f27253c8dd3710e1", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 73, "text": "楊洪字季休，犍為武陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "c85b6d8d99f584165404f50cd2538cc6482966c5d62e415b92a37e0703536122"}

{"id": "p_85c238913667f080", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 74, "text": "先主定蜀，太守李嚴命為功曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "5672031e228e2e9146e04a91809fb52d455622ac8c0516c822e10bdbe173d7f1"}

{"id": "p_ae0d62e168d691cf", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 75, "text": "嚴欲徒郡治捨，洪固諫不聽，遂辭功曹，請退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "b181441b13061a7a0c7e22d2fecf0190b85d0780cb8f8b2dcc33c284436b46a9"}

{"id": "p_9fa599d4d166b842", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 76, "text": "嚴（欲）薦洪於州，為（蜀部從事）[部蜀從事]。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "093d57eea0f3b9ebbf00c6d260f642382499af81266f520224c603db4cfe6783"}

{"id": "p_2d39fbd2a2d40da7", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 77, "text": "先主爭漢中，急書發兵，軍師將軍諸葛亮以問洪，洪曰：「漢中則益州咽喉，存亡之機會，若無漢中則無蜀矣，此家門之禍也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "1bf6ca883a0d5bc9b0a3f7a31cfaba2d20c95966c978a6399952fffe379e4c12"}

{"id": "p_26333d342081156e", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 78, "text": "方今之事，男子當戰，女子當運，發兵何疑？", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "4df51bb8b37a93304370b50349fe23d5392085d04b7d99071b947d9f94ae2433"}

{"id": "p_df28b006d8dfbc87", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 79, "text": "」時蜀郡太守法正從先主北行，亮於是表洪領蜀郡太守，眾事皆辦，遂使即真。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "521367224e5b88ac2bd1bbc9ae55a3d5c6984ea0c87e14c1775c55a75dc7ab3c"}

{"id": "p_4283e63950de57b4", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 80, "text": "頃之，轉為益州治中從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "25b9c71b7b1d10c07f17d1c5979bdef544676608a530247060d220f11d5f0ffd"}

{"id": "p_25f59be6f28c184c", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 81, "text": "先主既稱尊號，征吳不克，還住永安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "6b9c45bf2662da0991fc2d56b1ca200e2fa9e1b68020776500886dca6107a292"}

{"id": "p_b53d90f5e8bee2ad", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 82, "text": "漢嘉太守黃元素為諸葛亮所不善，聞先主疾病，懼有後患，舉郡反，燒臨邛城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "970bd9974be6152d8e481a4c48f3067412f23566e0c1e11728a690afa233e040"}

{"id": "p_1e575f988c7f963f", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 83, "text": "時亮東行省疾，成都單虛，是以元益無所憚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "dba534d14ce294c5b029ae4898c68e7e55db934304ce2d31c8b60fd7536a6249"}

{"id": "p_fa0db5945eb37b4e", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 84, "text": "洪即啟太子，遣其親兵，使將軍陳曶、鄭綽討元。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "01ffebd7bc5b367eee3f497f8f780eeab23346d00d80af5b3805e490f145f411"}

{"id": "p_7941659d8c567015", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 85, "text": "眾議以為元若不能圍成都，當由越囗據南中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "2f45f4bcd2c9967bd5fc137e5e7522a113879ca879ffbe07c5f35be2c2ff0957"}

{"id": "p_bc1159a08ef15175", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 86, "text": "洪曰：「元素信凶暴，無他恩信，何能辦此？", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "47e7fec5d0054a5f0e85c1703e8d5f853f8374f769f9cc13fc892f8d36760710"}

{"id": "p_ae715a9a5b86a28a", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 87, "text": "不過乘水東下，冀主上平安，面縛歸死；如其有異，奔吳求活耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "0c670d33b04513d869185c5082b8cf96f8b8b47b0ff3069ce513417ec4e306ab"}

{"id": "p_707882c508f8b776", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 88, "text": "敕曶、綽但於南安峽口遮即便得矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "8ee903170335065b6ffe887f0c32f8fb9f30daa1cab2b96fe185950f1c4ddad4"}

{"id": "p_d1005f1f883a2e2c", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 89, "text": "」曶、綽承洪言，果生獲元。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "deec0d61da3821dd438b665b4b20b59480fa8c7fbaa263b7567a0de6d8dfb98d"}

{"id": "p_ed6d95142d65ae4e", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 90, "text": "洪賜爵關內侯，復為蜀郡太守、忠節將軍，後為越騎校尉，領郡如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "a0956e14d66b531fa68b99976e8add1146cf9ca7710686451ffc77cb47ab3406"}

{"id": "p_c345c94832011344", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 91, "text": "五年，丞相亮北住漢中，欲用張裔為留府長史，問洪何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "bf6e4644c77c2959c4cd6d499fe3aea476ab3477dde2e104d6103e944d259149"}

{"id": "p_4f20d1e78add4292", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 92, "text": "洪對曰：「裔天姿明察，長於治劇，才誠堪之，然性不公平，恐不可專任，不如留向朗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "e33e3ea12e3ae0e70e7062ca79c8ea7750ef7f7c4967ea83486300a7854751a9"}

{"id": "p_ac7e269d848a0ad9", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 93, "text": "朗情偽差少，裔隨從目下，效其器能，於事兩善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "f542f911cc2783a72d16eba6de6e194ed9ce48df8f1d73eb420c66801e38fbfb"}

{"id": "p_66b6d13f1c9e41d2", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 94, "text": "裔流放在吳，洪臨裔郡，裔子郁給郡吏，微過受罰，不特原假。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "32c7e3c6247bdab66b9de926e55326ddca8a9f3a390c295cc11bacbe6843f9ea"}

{"id": "p_94671943bf47cf4e", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 95, "text": "裔後還聞之，深以為恨，與洪情好有損。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "200e26c4c6e4ba8f9e6bd1bc72b888cfa64768c5ee4301100a3ef5e4fd7551a9"}

{"id": "p_8e1a04d46316463e", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 96, "text": "及洪見亮出，至裔許，具說所言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "41fc209d7f8610995a8d584f755da65fc818cb6fd7438caa4a2c209e38ce2a5b"}

{"id": "p_f32bfc06f7db44c4", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 97, "text": "裔答洪曰：「公留我了矣，明府不能止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "ffcf6ae70de039536d584c08f6edb5bf5c34ece7fa89653d925b7616508d48ba"}

{"id": "p_bfdee397ba78bf7d", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」時人或疑洪意自欲作長史，或疑洪知裔自嫌，不願裔處要職，典後事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "832dd7623d38301e177e592016ed10a6a5fb916e73ad4c258cab7592b86aeb9e"}

{"id": "p_f20f0748c8c0cdba", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 99, "text": "後裔與司鹽校尉岑述不和，至於忿恨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "8ccd7f9bc5900b0b33f97bb36f734904bd8c4da30dd6ffe41e674bc6681ed4cf"}

{"id": "p_45797564edae5251", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 100, "text": "亮與裔書曰：「君昔在[陌]下，營壞，吾之用心，食不知味；後流洪迸南海，相為悲歎，寢不安席；及其來還，委付大任，同獎王室，自以為與君古之石交也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "b2b6e5151f5b0092a0bd5179963ba53a7f30b6cdc973a4e987c422fe4fd8addf"}

{"id": "p_dc77ff5b055c01c6", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 101, "text": "石交之道，舉仇以相益，割骨肉以相明，猶不相謝也，況吾但委意於元儉，而君不能忍邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "bffc09159858d7eb45733d3ba410388ac7a130e23142762084aa455f0b3888f3"}

{"id": "p_0ea34722b287f6e2", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 102, "text": "洪少不好學問，而忠清款亮，憂公如家，事繼母至孝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "0656d71efd566d950ca1bc5c7a62abbea1eb4d7817d471061532943f3e6ec03d"}

{"id": "p_b89a5ae157c1921a", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 103, "text": "始洪為李嚴功曹，嚴未（至）[去]犍為而洪已為蜀郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "9ceae6676f47f4acd8dfb17f71866097a2ee99326794f24e520d76f8cfc55305"}

{"id": "p_01e8861af4d9512a", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 104, "text": "洪迎門下書佐何祗，有才策功干，舉郡吏，數年為廣漢太守，時洪亦尚在蜀郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "aee6c11b394e99bd8f6592748fe14bf4897fc79b0e99b35e23fcfdb5b64402a4"}

{"id": "p_ac32af3773a6dce6", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 105, "text": "是以西土咸服諸葛亮能盡時人之器用也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "2d5a308b19165e9f4135a08f45886eba6375ab7b561186a15cb92bfce06bb721"}

{"id": "p_2000485b1718afa6", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 106, "text": "費詩字公舉，犍為南安人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "c2175100f8e199ed8115acd514832ab87896689c6626683ea931e51541c7c0f6"}

{"id": "p_54039eca85ae7d77", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 107, "text": "劉璋時為綿竹令，先主攻綿竹時，詩先舉城降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "c960a1ab1d3beafa05e65df4796f6915c36c10c64766495e3b118c1596713547"}

{"id": "p_e78377c02b7712d2", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 108, "text": "成都既定，先主領益州牧，以詩為督軍從事，出為牂牁太守，還為州前部司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "79d64e0a1f16fea1da291f6dc08ee2917104e7effa266aa274c11424cd0c9223"}

{"id": "p_7d34c1f69c34dde1", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 109, "text": "先主為漢中王，遣詩拜關羽為前將軍，羽聞黃忠為後將軍，（羽）怒曰：「大丈夫終不與老兵同列！", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "a15a03b9358300abe7206aa4a53031885fb7ff242f92133ba56868fcb14c9f50"}

{"id": "p_996262175f5bcb53", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 110, "text": "詩謂羽曰：「夫立王業者，所用非一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "2a5a3bff94caad90f6ed225a39b5fefab220099409f52a24f0220435d31feb7c"}

{"id": "p_013b37e7409571e1", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 111, "text": "昔蕭、曹與高祖少小親舊，而陳、韓亡命後主，論其班列，韓最居上，未聞蕭、曹以此為怨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "968e8dd82203fc5a5d383e3cdc6ec3c5f8676ff8460d40579253e5966c88b9d3"}

{"id": "p_dc7519c74c63c7df", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 112, "text": "今（漢王）[漢中王]以一時之功隆崇於漢升，然意之輕重，寧當與君侯齊乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "e139cc6846e8cc331713e6148646aeae5b3f4c7aa9216d3fe01f943076cd6489"}

{"id": "p_37123af76cbace64", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 113, "text": "且王與君侯臂猶一體，同休等戚，禍福共之，愚為君侯不宜計官號之高下、爵祿之多少為意也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "bca605f9cdd80dd95258f942b7f9866da5aec49d400560baef0f02c37273aa1a"}

{"id": "p_effe880c01654fea", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 114, "text": "僕一介之使，銜命之人，君侯不受拜，如是便還，但相為惜此舉動，恐有後悔耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "9cc1f74565a6468a5ba4c6069f6b173356d7432147d72109aee51600049a0fdc"}

{"id": "p_dc4ce0c809882ef8", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 115, "text": "後群臣議欲推漢中王稱尊號，詩上疏曰：「殿下以曹操父子逼主篡位，故乃羈旅萬里，糾合士眾，將以討賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "454ad11feea5bee9ddcbb6207325cfdf1b57634b72789d132bfe8c808d5730fe"}

{"id": "p_e799ddca29624d2d", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 116, "text": "今天敵未克，而先主自立，恐人心疑惑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "0511aecc61f105b92ae1c85566061f1beae87d27c71364aa27e518350d54d7b1"}

{"id": "p_78e4fa02a136a095", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 117, "text": "昔高祖與楚約，先破秦者王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "3b392026e33213d7c6167693290785c1223851f6cf84e08d5eabe5e1e6f627bc"}

{"id": "p_830274c44a912281", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 118, "text": "及屠咸陽，獲子嬰，猶懷推讓，況今殿下未出門庭，便欲自立邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "4e5c6d66e18376e289cccbf1b21b5265ebbeafb799d7320a8bc12e903d9d1eba"}

{"id": "p_a9292de458d8470a", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 119, "text": "」由是忤指，左遷部永昌從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "bd610772e424f994d169ac6bbccc4447e70df2f3533e3fbc02e946c69028907a"}

{"id": "p_b2b516f7b187ee30", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 120, "text": "，隨諸葛亮南行，歸至漢陽縣，降人李鴻來詣亮，亮見鴻，時蔣琬與詩在坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "1b926da89fbd0e4c0b477cfac746a46b40ed913c5000a8bdab1e2ed73b84dcc2"}

{"id": "p_a5e289214d89f23b", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 121, "text": "鴻曰：「聞過孟達許，適見王沖從南來，言往者達之去就，明公切齒，欲誅達妻子，賴先主不聽言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "12e72ef9fbd5b77a9d804bec05f9485bb59fffec796baea52e5846ba9577e787"}

{"id": "p_997d2f1db60a5a71", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 122, "text": "達曰：『諸葛亮見顧有本末，終不爾也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "bf8f7716c91bac9705f0012a0a67318c2a6db9bd5d7a4eeecde5ef1e6be71961"}

{"id": "p_921837daeabf704f", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 123, "text": "』盡不信沖言，委仰明公，無復已已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "f507f1c50713b6fe62d59f04309ead2fd1634f4f969cb6ea4ae1c7ddeee885d5"}

{"id": "p_0a233ac5312d40a0", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 124, "text": "」亮謂琬、詩曰：「還都當有書與子度相聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "2c5e0c030090527f98406fc45fcff0b375fb40321fffccc0de70d343e3d80c0e"}

{"id": "p_d6f1fc4fa4f2b363", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 125, "text": "」詩進曰：「孟達小子，昔事振威不忠，後又背叛先主，反覆之人，何足與書邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "40f1e08c88ab8b117197e3778ce6575d0e67cc25320ccbd8f6596b39a987323e"}

{"id": "p_34bab8a9cf488c1e", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 126, "text": "亮欲誘達以為外援，竟與達書曰：「往年南征，歲（未及）[末及]還，適與李鴻會於漢陽，承知消息，慨然永歎，以存足下平素之志，豈徒空托名榮，貴為乘離乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "4c585b38fafe7e1acf77fca676f62402dd0f38393de056496e674df3e6b6f10b"}

{"id": "p_50a0bc4f4ab77375", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 127, "text": "嗚呼孟子，斯實劉封侵陵足下，以傷先主待士之義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "652e3be2cb67188bb16646d1fd35b9ba9ee451b0cc1aa1071c59fd315f2a3e42"}

{"id": "p_65fa489cdee328c6", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 128, "text": "又鴻道王沖造作虛語，云足下量度吾心，不受沖說。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "4b256138d169d4f00919dc68d8b990f21797697d6e7044363d46e506fcd38c57"}

{"id": "p_f65f39bbb9794182", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 129, "text": "尋表明之言，追平生之好，依依東望，故遣有書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "40252a5d35f386fffe1de6ee477b38de2df8a23c01e22a654cef3d3e9ffbda08"}

{"id": "p_5d8296b49c8f7160", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 130, "text": "」達得亮書，數相交通，辭欲叛魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "7a5fcd5894389aae602f21892cb18d80ed9263eb94775cfd429746facf3da220"}

{"id": "p_6300987778e45224", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 131, "text": "魏遣司馬宣王征之，即斬滅達。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "d91b4eff1ec6118ba87697bd91155f24938ada8e57d5aef954e733c17131f4bc"}

{"id": "p_05b3b9769cfeb27e", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 132, "text": "亮亦以達無款誠之心，故不救助也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "4b3d5a3b40b581f5eaedd953ffb82bf1a13177b2bba7764a08eb9ea4dcf9056f"}

{"id": "p_29e149e6bc8a5a69", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 133, "text": "蔣琬秉政，以詩為諫議大夫，卒於家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "1d591ad28b3ed75f7065b9a680ef7396d13267a6f4a00d3604a42942c58b9584"}

{"id": "p_fc3bc2b16ae4b6b5", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 134, "text": "為牙門將，統屬江州李嚴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "d9fba899afd66b511c37276ca26f4d176a974fcaf0c63a25bc26ad05f1de56cd"}

{"id": "p_e7403220c94abfd6", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 135, "text": "評曰：霍峻孤城不傾，王連固節不移，向朗好學不倦，張裔肤敏應極，楊洪乃心忠公，費詩率意而言，皆有可紀焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "dcaa1e60faeb80db7c058c6a9a157962d17628ef63bf098c515f9b3b6898e079"}

{"id": "p_5a9de0aca20de4ae", "source_id": "src_dbc442dfb3a20b05", "ordinal": 136, "text": "以先主之廣濟，諸葛之準繩，詩吐直言，猶用凌遲，况庸後乎哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "64671a850018def64720d3a1794d7df8c95213e8cfb3f6fffdef2ab97fa17625"}

{"id": "p_fdb57cce67875169", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 0, "text": "杜微字國輔，梓潼涪人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "abcd41cfcd5ad0e4e92b2ea38fd78f4cbed19fd5752c786a1cdf25d77a604676"}

{"id": "p_789b7b4238f55875", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 1, "text": "劉障辟為從事，以疾去官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "bbb312dc95652be3ae151498af12d66e032e7ddd885a9715617946da7be12fda"}

{"id": "p_58b821bb3fc3f20b", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 2, "text": "及先主定蜀，微常稱聾，閉門不出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "7fb280dde6eead3b1b4f04397b8b09771f1890c9e7e21e2f63753891e3efbb5d"}

{"id": "p_1c3297330be580b3", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 3, "text": "選迎皆妙簡舊德，以秦宓為別駕，五梁為功曹，微為主簿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "c30a099d7d21e7efa79293dee611e3fd1a1825f0c9129d9878d8b47d5f475c18"}

{"id": "p_60ca18a11c7bc821", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 4, "text": "既致，亮引見微，微自陳謝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "043665841fdbda9197caca2d178be98ee546ecefbd88e2f01a11400f190f4660"}

{"id": "p_4b468dc5421df7a7", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 5, "text": "亮以微不聞人語，於坐上與書曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "0b9b79ab4bd54cb0d0615e48b3d52fadb03110bc58a3053a615d8442a841b81b"}

{"id": "p_d6dbbb024cf865e0", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 6, "text": "微自乞老病求歸，亮又與書答曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "33780dea62ac96b44ba697afdbc44441f0472d1317437e42fc12a1f45d6b19fb"}

{"id": "p_c59bba055873b2f6", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 7, "text": "其敬微如此，拜為諫議大夫，以從其志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "83413504d097dbd00568a9bb726359b7c7a5e49fee5b8b7cd877d5714ef6cd2d"}

{"id": "p_62d969fdabb6fea9", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 8, "text": "五梁者，字德山，犍為南安人也，以儒學節操稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "92f014bfe7a95425ce192a25939b5bc6680202241a004725f69e598beca0fabe"}

{"id": "p_9c0f723a40116d59", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 9, "text": "從議郎遷諫義大夫、五官中朗將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "7f2f8bedad2f5811ac367071b88e82d425a55ef08e1d39d404927fea6b390e86"}

{"id": "p_bae7817bab258594", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 10, "text": "周羣字仲直，巴西閬中人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "b0f071b2a5e8317e0a9a3b9a12f890d4c332259ea559ae9b7f2c2436aecfe4c6"}

{"id": "p_c7d7b5785ce39a33", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 11, "text": "父舒，字叔布，少學術於廣漢楊厚，名亞董扶、任安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "12ed0dad79a221a4740d4cc459d0c69fb28aed430e146cbe22ce39dbf388bc2e"}

{"id": "p_2e14b47b34358d08", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 12, "text": "時人有問：「《春秋讖》曰『代漢者當塗高』，此何謂也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "47f0d4b58f93037e1f92bdaab31b2912a27260f4244c254737e31e76c29802cf"}

{"id": "p_03368d00331e6bd8", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 13, "text": "」舒曰：「當塗高者，魏也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "d0b7685237384a5f588911bf0e8607e7e03eab075efaa31ccb7f2d3ed48b6f68"}

{"id": "p_3799e99e2834e5d6", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」鄉黨學者私傳其語，羣少受學於舒，專心候業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "ffa0e4f7afae5adb23f96978c103450674c0c054a8a99466339013c39fbad806"}

{"id": "p_126ff99ce1cda7ad", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 15, "text": "於庭中做小樓，家富多奴，常令奴更直於樓上視天災，才見一氣，即白羣，羣自上樓觀之，不避晨夜，故凡有氣候，無不見之者，是以所言多中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "dbfba3eee83361b307315273124b3c45371c7acd840689b3d5612a4d13439eb3"}

{"id": "p_5ee05d7be667eea7", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 16, "text": "州牧劉璋辟以為師友從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "43074cf94faf9d9b58c7aa3d769c9d4a29c864b7567fa4308da3685914166e77"}

{"id": "p_756c29ec8657abfd", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 17, "text": "先主欲曹公爭漢中，問羣，羣對曰：「當得其地，不得其民也，若出偏軍，必不利，當戒慎之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "249b343248cc865948fcfc6b4904bd95126d5bd91ce8951758823038830fb15a"}

{"id": "p_33c126f3365c00e0", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 18, "text": "」時州後部司馬蜀郡張裕亦曉佔候，而天才過羣，諫先主曰：「不可爭漢中，軍必不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "b26295189fac69e2ce15e9d7d841e422155ae0a53140c42be3a1e8845dc7e7bb"}

{"id": "p_f707633eebcb1b50", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」先主竟不用裕言，果得地而不得民也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "3afcf7e994778300b385a04de5da9f1d562318ed0a375d645abb2ad9de2de916"}

{"id": "p_87bb14be7d85f98c", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 20, "text": "遣將軍吳蘭、雷銅等入武都，皆沒不還，悉如羣言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "a874b717cf15f57efd75cda16b8e91852f2c377791332c4cc307eccaf6f60422"}

{"id": "p_6dba0642e05f3f5b", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 21, "text": "裕又私語人曰：「歲在庚子，天下當易代，劉氏祚盡矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "50ba098be79888b56502744ed7c428c15fe7984e2e50673d86a34b4f1648c5ee"}

{"id": "p_754cb13559b04b40", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 22, "text": "主公得益州，九年之後，寅卯之間當失之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "9cf52818e5e28954d5ff8a166f466ab7dc9945440322014c8922c1a88164df41"}

{"id": "p_20633eb54e599584", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 23, "text": "初，先主與劉璋會涪，時裕為璋從事，侍坐，其人饒須，先主嘲之曰：「昔吾居涿縣，特多毛姓，東西南北皆諸毛也，涿令稱曰『諸毛繞涿居乎』！", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "d767b041363f081fc850b9e57f73a923011b276d0d86031c4e10c6413dc8de66"}

{"id": "p_866ab3bd0acf7f70", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」裕即答曰：「昔有作上黨潞長，遷為涿令者，去官還家，時人與書，欲署潞則失涿，欲署涿則失潞，乃署曰：『潞涿君』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "ca86a575dc7b4bb38d6dab463495feb7f18ce730dbde025f32681398547b1023"}

{"id": "p_5f7c3a732e59c97c", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 25, "text": "先主無須，故裕以此及之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "ea36cfd96332734e7e5d2b11ee27a725c34019ce993c9e49f0571b4723cb54a1"}

{"id": "p_c807f683cf935550", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 26, "text": "先主常銜莫不遜，加忿其漏言，乃顯裕諫爭漢中不驗，下獄，將誅之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "b9de4407a13b6368dcb5bcfabf8c34ea983080dde5e5fb9549e444c49521a8d7"}

{"id": "p_63a8a376e656e5e7", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 27, "text": "諸葛亮表請其罪，先主答曰：「勞蘭生門，不得不鋤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "8c504938d6183f1c7b18864001a48af44b5b7348248bb0a212563fbf3ce8e286"}

{"id": "p_e95d0060a88c4f68", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 28, "text": "後魏氏之立，先主之薨，皆如裕所刻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "ed8c3d85dfcf673736a387b6e876df713394fd827f5b5639e6d0bd9416c49e95"}

{"id": "p_9d8bbaee93b7b09d", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 29, "text": "又曉相術，每舉鏡視面，自知刑死，未常不撲之於地也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "e2c49a56411e8f6337b64996cad5bfcc60892ae0261d01f4dbbc16a588fe80c1"}

{"id": "p_2890f00ddea85262", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 30, "text": "杜瓊字伯瑜，蜀郡成都人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "9b827169ad7a42bd4bf818f4871dea140943eba3588929d5ebd899e170dc2de0"}

{"id": "p_d4b0a277f5cb2497", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 31, "text": "少受學於任安，精究安術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "7bcc511a54e4527c73bd2ca071c6ab723333dacdc444bd65d5dee36cde96cb30"}

{"id": "p_2acd0396e5271e26", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 32, "text": "劉璋時辟為從事，先主定益州，領牧，以瓊為議曹從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "268c69aa0740f14568acb147cb5d6ea4af34eaba2f4675beeca9b6f0006b7996"}

{"id": "p_8d336be60461a011", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 33, "text": "後主踐阼，拜諫議大夫，遷左中郎將、大鴻臚、太常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "7e694bd1662d289b169a8bb9c7275ec3e0535e6e205430fb2b0f1585f31fc3a8"}

{"id": "p_8951308a1f8f152b", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 34, "text": "為人靜默少言，闔門自守，不與世事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "92170ef8a149fce23cf538e8dbdddfcdc159e81e0ce58b0293cad03c4fd58339"}

{"id": "p_4fb1c8e4f894ef7e", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 35, "text": "雖學業入深，初不視天文有所論說。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "ce67842d44d20d4e1ee803ff4d614ab9ae62fdd37a1caaf64205e9ba2ead8761"}

{"id": "p_aacf05f586f12eca", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 36, "text": "後近通儒譙周常問其意，瓊答曰：「欲明此術甚難，須當身視，識其形色，不可信人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "e486f615e12451276e6f84be93b9000b9a5c9b2b8ebdf8e474d6757d7338c6ad"}

{"id": "p_f921ff73ffdeddc3", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 37, "text": "晨夜苦劇，然後知之，復憂漏洩，不如不知，是以不復視也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "9c96eb7c6ca230cdd135afffdb385fb9c3363d03076b3ab8cc0f80069d1bf660"}

{"id": "p_2d59d7428d81df42", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」周因問曰：「昔周徵君以為當塗高者魏也，其義何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "8cde48bf40fc2953315ece2ebfbb4f9ff9f3ecd950fc00ee8ea0deac1f61b107"}

{"id": "p_d04e132f944c22fe", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」瓊答曰：「魏，闕名也，當塗而高，聖人取類而言耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "edb696376e80e8ba1d1acbef966fbf3f4cc2f8ee7a19e7e5d2b62b4809f65439"}

{"id": "p_ef55633c68de8fe7", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」又問周曰：「寧復有所怪邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "226de67326fcad114cb85c465ca02b8814594545efcef18af32d769ab8ffa599"}

{"id": "p_8916cdcf38a42968", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 41, "text": "」瓊又曰：「古者名官職不言曹，始自漢已來，名官盡言曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "e23c422bf230697d19f665908cb216c8076c2363f4f335713a88a2f9aaa6fba5"}

{"id": "p_6898e9d07707eb4b", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 42, "text": "吏言屬曹，卒言侍曹，此殆天意也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "93f273af6b65b2a1d2f594982dd6247b7f718a5e8c94a0f05175e3b6b89fc25e"}

{"id": "p_542237e469b5ce09", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 43, "text": "著《韓詩章句》十餘萬言，不教諸子，內學無傳業者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "a6db30ab011535f99fff59825f3e055a3ab530ff34e32b7a264d58e1b77340e7"}

{"id": "p_63fea1fbd09b76fe", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 44, "text": "周緣瓊言，乃觸類而長之曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "7c2ff49c7059061cebb7363d6a72bb88572144f770a0e1e6d4155830a323d9be"}

{"id": "p_3f7a605e9cd0f4f0", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 45, "text": "後宦人黃皓弄權於內，，宮中大樹無故自折，周深憂之，無所與言，乃書柱曰：「眾而大，期之會，具而授，若何復？", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "8969761c6863ccd59f4053a0c35b6de0c2fdc9e7fd45cc9887c557bfb16375e9"}

{"id": "p_1764317c9b596c5a", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 46, "text": "」言曹者眾也，魏者大也，眾而大，天下其當會也，具而授，如何復有立者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "695c922a030a7cd41d97dadd810681d76b2564fbbf3dcaa7112854424f70c956"}

{"id": "p_a4156dec3889c3ef", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 47, "text": "周曰：「此雖己所推尋，然有所因，由杜君之辭而廣之耳，殊無神思獨至之異也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "bd817bc8dad7642ad3599ddda56edb1991c5274fc4f8410845e091afe4032c9a"}

{"id": "p_485c5d76fee41495", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 48, "text": "師事劉熙，善鄭氏學，治《易》、《尚書》、《三禮》、《毛詩》、《論語》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "74df103e7c772e4735af1f2e7b07087528911b38b653471ec09ef6e689d07ebf"}

{"id": "p_bba729836e887264", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 49, "text": "建安中，與許靖等俱自交州入蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "aaf6d3e4a5a8062d8618915ffcb7c15c4c4ef9c071a5f88284ec66b9fab05405"}

{"id": "p_c885628b9e68e271", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 50, "text": "時又有魏郡胡潛，字公興，不知其所以在益土。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "bc0669b03bf1562cb297e4ad7b0456dac6a7a1f3306e75abeadcf8ae307c5bfc"}

{"id": "p_e22b39f069ed2018", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 51, "text": "潛雖學不沾洽，然卓犖強識，祖宗制度之儀，喪紀五服之數，皆指掌畫地，舉手可採。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "91930d22ad47e17c42745bb3e0b0c659baeb1a5e30dc3766858530d1060d5a71"}

{"id": "p_f83279abe50408a5", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 52, "text": "先主定蜀，承喪亂歷紀，學業衰廢，乃鳩合典籍，沙汰眾學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "756cfa5121f3ad6f2575e1305ff3472b24b7ba00c30bc89d179d397494bff02b"}

{"id": "p_27981c71dee8dd16", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 53, "text": "慈、潛並為學士，與孟光、來敏等典掌舊文。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "c4b426a56312d88eebed0378ce0e0e760fdecf0ab16e5341763c89e37828aee9"}

{"id": "p_003c5778ff4ee613", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 54, "text": "值庶事草創，動多疑議，慈、潛更相剋伐，謗讟忿急，形於聲色；書籍有無，不相通借，時尋楚撻，以相震攇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "218f956389a3d2e593d50da2af7ab968c2bad04b514232880a76046a36210ae6"}

{"id": "p_70f0fab5398b67f1", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 55, "text": "先主愍其若斯，羣僚大會，使倡家假為二子之容，效其訟鬩之狀，酒酣樂作，以為嬉戲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "3cbe146a2db5cbd6ef473fb710ab489d738780837bf6edf9d25d3187c9e1e137"}

{"id": "p_994068455fdb22a1", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 56, "text": "初以辭義相難，終以刀杖相屈，用感切之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "c57d2b505d4231906d7d97a4eb0c6c1bf5587b4f842f673edb0cd6f81355a372"}

{"id": "p_1934ef82d69d787f", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 57, "text": "潛先沒，慈後主世稍遷至大長秋，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "374f02c215ee164d87ee17445d878aa39b81337658e48d0ab9faeab924a8455a"}

{"id": "p_bbaa846c330ffb39", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 58, "text": "孟光字孝裕，河南洛陽人，漢太尉孟鬱之族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "a41c392c7314b7a5767b40ee91c0782ba46a03b7c4240680636022c5e990d9ba"}

{"id": "p_d7ef249d942b2474", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 59, "text": "獻帝遷都長安，遂逃人蜀，劉焉父子待以客禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "050a41369c9556398d5a4d01eb56561f84550a2a0230dbd6692d941b1d2c9afa"}

{"id": "p_470b85c8030be5d4", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 60, "text": "博物識古，無書不覽，尤銳意三史，長於漢家舊典。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "fc1a5425d6411cf0c0aa026bcd9e43267e815d6773a1909cfea66981d891cc04"}

{"id": "p_2f76a2bdf1401dd4", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 61, "text": "好《公羊春秋》而譏呵《左氏》，每與來敏爭此二義，光常譊譊讙咋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "bd011a74240e6b3119e47095103a19384835fce4e2100df1ad44f3f219902884"}

{"id": "p_08199cad70a7aa73", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 62, "text": "先主定益州，拜為儀郎，與許慈等並掌制度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "84dde6a8d80be20f460ffc357d91c2fb6f89356705c2c29af6fe0a433ba0e0bf"}

{"id": "p_a14552d539a38a0f", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 63, "text": "後主踐阼，為符節令、屯騎校尉、長樂少府，遷大司農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "cf16f5a020da80758679e6996e90a617a5f243043a71e38d1aabeda7db8f8247"}

{"id": "p_402f49f9a2d8e3f0", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 64, "text": "秋，大赦，光於眾中責大將軍費禕曰：「夫赦者，偏枯之物，非明世所宜有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "ae5a38dc922a54ca685ec046e2d0f97a51177fc60e6b917b083333c2543e4386"}

{"id": "p_e204f044f85db9b3", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 65, "text": "衰弊窮極，必不得已，然後乃可權而行之耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "3d827549975bce5fdd0674c3d05ae4562ba9877e98912b7bf574f23294fa4984"}

{"id": "p_05f1286e1a4fb0a0", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 66, "text": "今主上仁賢，百僚稱職，有何旦夕之危，倒懸之急，而數施非常之恩，以惠姦宄之惡乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "052a9b56d6e4493cc0ee65235a5a02768a6c679eecf73adf146efff8dd84fccb"}

{"id": "p_3b3112275c4c3560", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 67, "text": "又鷹隼始擊，而更原宥有罪，上犯天時，下違人理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "b1a4b51e22d73633d42a6aab704fe8bdf59d15e7693b7c4475c3ef7640da359f"}

{"id": "p_31ab873f6fc1534a", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 68, "text": "老夫耄朽，不達治體，窮謂其法難以經久，豈具瞻之高美，所望於明德哉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "a31eeaf82d79fbc2df7c19265faed9fe287e3b2ff6c99c255b9665e7a39fdf13"}

{"id": "p_f24331ead617ba48", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 69, "text": "光之指摘痛癢，多如是類。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "279deb43a1274e79fec68996cd822abbd050da09aff60eb60550836ec559bf79"}

{"id": "p_de386acd41ee886a", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 70, "text": "故執政重臣，心不能悅，爵位不登，每直言無所迴避，為代所嫌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "b06e65c33a2047f7d0285ae54e55b1a702ec39e5b8acd4124a6504ffca908e8f"}

{"id": "p_245732eec1379563", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 71, "text": "太常廣漢鐔承、光祿勛河東裴儁等，年資皆在光後，而登據上列，處光之右，蓋以此也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "2df9a935ddf4d0de78b2508936a67abbc62593eca23195e0e5f901f53350e0d7"}

{"id": "p_3dfea585dda5d917", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 72, "text": "後進文士秘書郎郤正數從光諮訪，光問正太子所習讀性並其性情好尚，正答曰：「奉親虔恭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "ab14ac4090c2330aa5e8c860e93314d1753143f523648532feecfbed2efb5b61"}

{"id": "p_528d1443433949cc", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 73, "text": "夙夜匪懈，有古世子之風；接待羣僚，舉動出於仁恕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "68d8549a425c282e8b4dbe5a60c706c32b6a570289a4fe089deed9007bb49204"}

{"id": "p_f1aedb00d19a1267", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 74, "text": "」光曰：「如君所道，皆家戶所有耳；吾今所問，欲知其權略智調何如也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "ad0ff2c1ae33c8eacbf837e74d1317caa2d04cda488d33b7e2d3fe50f7aecb49"}

{"id": "p_2eef931b79cc6bda", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」正曰：「世子之道，在於承志竭歡，既不得妄有所施為，且智調藏於胸懷，權略應時而發，此之有無，焉可豫設也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "980fbf97a37616cd88ac2a8920b7d841f5f763dd1dcb9432d4008012ebe7f256"}

{"id": "p_8dbf97f2626d347e", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 76, "text": "」光解正慎宜，不為放談，乃曰：「吾好直言，無所迴避，每彈射利病，為世人所譏嫌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "072a4cee363061942429b8f946eea9b38d6fdfc5dcb14e75e0ea02d76aa9fb64"}

{"id": "p_286c63da56dd9683", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 77, "text": "疑省君意亦不甚好吾言，然語有次。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "39f6c3867bfd6475baaf99613b365fb6994d8ce604b5191668250f09c690b59c"}

{"id": "p_1096443bc4d6942a", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 78, "text": "今天下未定，智意為先，智意雖有自然，然不可力強致也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "636884fd7df1d7601baa95e8b2d079800f19ed7eba3d1e0ddc3ab054e3e0742c"}

{"id": "p_203e24c9f9a76834", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 79, "text": "此儲君讀書，寧當效吾等竭力博識以待訪問，如博士探策講試以求爵位邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "d54fec5992385c344d2c19600878fb97aa9e8a224ab61fd031f38bb98f666f0f"}

{"id": "p_2efbfb2d98c55f69", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 80, "text": "後光坐事免官，年九十餘，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "3d434f89c752dd07752fd97903898b9b286ca7d25e58c490b61378f99c1dc394"}

{"id": "p_b29c6a3ff7568a91", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 81, "text": "來敏字敬達，義陽新野人，來歙之後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "ddfc5d56533f8bbc3d0ba6cb44a2633a53f4b5d5134608386a6bad9ebd1ee266"}

{"id": "p_59bf00d5d01748cb", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 82, "text": "漢末大亂，敏隨姊夫奔荊州，姊夫黃琬是劉璋祖母之侄，故璋遣迎琬妻，敏遂俱與姊入蜀，常為璋賓客。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "e7e8ce3277119722fefa9afe634362f2dfd55e0776393ebc2a71015638a723ff"}

{"id": "p_0d79319cd90611fd", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 83, "text": "涉獵書籍，善《左氏春秋》，尤精於《倉》、《雅》訓詁，好是正文字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "c2f87eebaf833ca3ce476ace6fa0a1cfaaa8f74c3777140dca2009787fe27e93"}

{"id": "p_bd4417d522945f6b", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 84, "text": "先主定益州，署敏典學校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "5ca797e6ffe79b90a40668e9ba356d0b1f2fcb6662fd5bdfaa668b9719e40269"}

{"id": "p_368dc906417cb688", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 85, "text": "後主踐阼，為虎賁中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "0a401ad7f778289fcfdf1e4c4e5a94db57e41340726cc4ebf2371cdfc801226b"}

{"id": "p_b82044e9ca0d18e4", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 86, "text": "丞相亮住漢中，請為軍祭酒、輔軍將軍，坐事去職。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "74779b0431a9124d1f38b53a30d04d9bf84736ea2bbb63f815522b933f3e64d3"}

{"id": "p_6124974044224dff", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 87, "text": "亮卒後，還成都為大長秋，又免，後累遷為光祿大夫，復坐過黜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "bf664eb4b5312f8d0a021db0fb906c8ce4c96afe46f8d54275713dfab1db4a2b"}

{"id": "p_91599dc175e6736e", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 88, "text": "前後數貶削，皆以語言不節，舉動違常也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "e4963b9c09f0195a57739bb25c7bb6287eeb62dbf2a88188240f315af2e9f575"}

{"id": "p_89fc5d6708e4496a", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 89, "text": "時孟光亦以樞機不慎，議論干時，然猶愈於敏，俱以耆宿學士見禮於世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "ed38308bceac6dcbd014610a14c2c17aecab158f06fadd8a9564e246cc2be62b"}

{"id": "p_64ba55dd65dc8cb3", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 90, "text": "而敏荊楚名族，東宮舊臣，特加優待，是故廢而復起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "19e09b731103a8a1e4e285e487e8199844979a9b81715446024fbdd16f04b1b2"}

{"id": "p_ea192323003e6b59", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 91, "text": "後以敏為執慎將軍，欲令以官重自警戒也，年九十七，景耀中卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "4a0e4a36978c98c66958164fe27db77e43072dafc5d24ddd53780aa481c66fae"}

{"id": "p_3bf196d8dd9fefd9", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 92, "text": "子忠，亦博覽經學，有敏風，與尚書向充等並能協贊大將軍姜維。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "fa584cc056a0eb383d2cbd301cc23db012d7a3ebbf4811bd46fa9ee2ba282d96"}

{"id": "p_539aba9978be4279", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 93, "text": "尹默字思潛，梓潼涪人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "a6fc87c5c1b61755e168ff649cede98e98fa0d714d24846649b6cb9682e33576"}

{"id": "p_e696562a4e5bf376", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 94, "text": "益部多貴今文而不祟章句，默知其不博。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "714547ffe67dd39b780584ac7ac75ad52e91a6ea1b8afa810a0d2b439231f8ce"}

{"id": "p_35ae455fb6e5a991", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 95, "text": "乃遠遊荊州，從司馬德操、宋仲子等受古學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "5302ce4607e4c7ae6033d937a1d3320e1648f5bb3186f1c0b34c7587ae153ae4"}

{"id": "p_77c4ef11f251cf35", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 96, "text": "皆通諸經史，又專精於《左氏春秋》，自劉歆條例，鄭眾、賈逵父子、陳元、方服虔注說，咸略誦述，不復按本。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "ea161e4d43d4d9a9e84c468eec38062b51c27599266a706669485c88d90f0310"}

{"id": "p_028752513bdf5cc4", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 97, "text": "先主定益州，領牧，以為勸學從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "6d09b2f470c5cfe42a9abddb6d0811dd0ba1c4240f96b0dd4610ad7154510652"}

{"id": "p_1a94941021492635", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 98, "text": "及立太子，以默為僕，射以《左氏傳》授後主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "893fdd87baeed74be561e96b8a6257ea3d97da46ea6d45ff1a2f6223f60f5a22"}

{"id": "p_d7fb49dfbb95b650", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 99, "text": "丞相亮住漢中，請為軍祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "511321388893d624582c4e58c393c06125c457ba839e8f4c515e741da12e3593"}

{"id": "p_cd8baba4abf09fbe", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 100, "text": "亮卒，還成都，拜大中大夫，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "97972d3815378e24f5380ec3aeb4391d85ec696838ad2aa29dabd62897317f66"}

{"id": "p_8a6bb42c2b7c9828", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 101, "text": "李譔字欽仲，梓潼涪人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "8ffa75cf424bfd5be4c11dc762072617414d2caf06093ca418aabaad56640d90"}

{"id": "p_002e0b0878e7deb5", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 102, "text": "父仁，字德賢，與同縣尹默懼遊荊州，從司馬徽、宋忠等學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "4d8bf05401f7f0fa7a85d9aa9e8e6077feb8b608b52e6f40448c1be54ccdc8e0"}

{"id": "p_a9a7a0af33e70b4d", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 103, "text": "譔具傳其業，又默講論義理，五經、諸子，無不該覽，加博好技藝，算術、卜數，醫藥、弓弩、機械之巧，皆致思焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "71b95fc8efadc4f6cd9bb3b73d12267b1553b64a95b0294500d2883bbf319283"}

{"id": "p_39e5901e032d1be9", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 104, "text": "，後主立太子，以譔為庶子，遷為僕射，轉中散大夫、右中郎將，猶侍太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "444739b49245ded7ac2d0d2030a6a19b71d9fa01634ae6307a55cf9b1c9957e8"}

{"id": "p_e08514cc46226138", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 105, "text": "然體輕脫，好戲啁，故世不能重也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "ea6f33840cc7c2cac29856e423fc943d30b4f984872d4d90155292fccf1a87e6"}

{"id": "p_b24f575189351a3d", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 106, "text": "著古文《易》、《尚書》、《毛詩》、《三禮》、《左氏傳》、《太玄指歸》，皆依準賈、馬，異於鄭玄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "236806c9134eddadee76d6915860ec9d3f9719e68c59242da43d5d9051571c4e"}

{"id": "p_9c730e6a323accd4", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 107, "text": "與王氏殊隔，初不見其所述，而意歸多同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "76a71cb7369083433a0d623f5a08e0b8862fab6686f24220369f0f8aef664b7b"}

{"id": "p_16c55e489f4ccd48", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 108, "text": "時又有漢中陳術，字申伯，亦博學多聞，著《釋部》七篇、《益部耆舊傳》及《志》，位歷三郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "3520c7d9bc4b9580d8641bcda57dd73a31eec2c03e0c2f7294c23233e0fce963"}

{"id": "p_73b115d40d0307f3", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 109, "text": "譙周字允南，巴西西充國人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "86c55fe1b88cf1a096718f5e7bd222c542f62e3018daebfd50da6e3cf16932c7"}

{"id": "p_6cc1a58be0b06c66", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 110, "text": "父𡸫，字榮始，治《尚書》，兼通諸經及圖緯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "58484c26ebd7d8e0ad8cd3b91a20d887cbc4f85a5ca171e9e0f97841d38b2d20"}

{"id": "p_65fa16c3dfc37533", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 111, "text": "州郡辟請，皆不應，州就假師友從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "e9d98b49e7ec9471e4c5f6a56844b254331f94096df0a9d323c9346b466605a4"}

{"id": "p_6771cc11d132887e", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 112, "text": "既長，耽古篤學，家貧未嘗問產業，誦讀典籍，欣然獨笑，以忘寢食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "722f8b1179f3d062601c5f3ce2810cd40632a7305833d50fa41acd774306ac6e"}

{"id": "p_0685de50c3aa0ddb", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 113, "text": "研精《六經》，尤善書札，頗曉天文，而不以留意；諸子文章非心所存，不悉遍視也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "7ba7b7d6686bf26a1f9f18ef08674b4c9d1fd2f13376daa24854f8da5827ef54"}

{"id": "p_ba0f934b54272dff", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 114, "text": "身長八尺，體貌素樸，性推誠不飾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "ef9ef94b1dbcd4c7ba6ed70d86765e1aebc4b39ee788ee1f4c918c66a72a75e7"}

{"id": "p_5f0e42e3dfe83626", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 115, "text": "無造次辯論之才，然潛識內敏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "d04845d247af0dbaa5d3581156360086614d41c406bf43b216a72600c46b8114"}

{"id": "p_08022aa2d0e0bc83", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 116, "text": "建興中，丞相亮領益州牧，命周為勸學從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "5b6e581f3783be988801cbc0319cba178b10983891e2278b9e451e45944cd9a2"}

{"id": "p_896671b659983e4c", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 117, "text": "亮卒於敵庭，周在家聞問，即便奔赴，尋有詔書禁斷，惟周以速行得達。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "a2fe94a5fec740c767abeab5787c1e36fe3f0144c9848606b9641811c8f66525"}

{"id": "p_aa7fc5f86f3e1ca7", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 118, "text": "大將軍蔣琬領刺史，徙為典學從事，總州之學者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "77cf18bcc250d6dc2f13f810e6093b787256e38af4948c6f7ad8b477c521ac8b"}

{"id": "p_4df4628cdcf106b5", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 119, "text": "後主立太子，以周為僕，轉家令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "954dcf6bc83ae00199562ffceca962ceff538e0fcea52eb7cc0191cfdfcdcaad"}

{"id": "p_c717adcb3f65bc3c", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 120, "text": "時後主頗出遊觀，增廣聲樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "12b58b3f5dcda4dcbb4a6bb7578fb231c8cc1655b6c366e3e3e0c862e0392caa"}

{"id": "p_2b247547706c0545", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 121, "text": "徙為中散大夫，猶侍太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "4846e79c5f56c702d2f7064ee98f3756abaf8b0801ca292a937370d5d937cfac"}

{"id": "p_04fc2c606f55a831", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 122, "text": "於時軍旅數出，百姓凋瘁，周與尚書令陳祗論其利害，退而書之，謂之《仇國論》，其辭曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "456e49a0256e395f35a28d4c487079774ad66449ddaef377f17dbebf8fc61d50"}

{"id": "p_31258197e7a72760", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 123, "text": "後遷光祿大夫，位亞九列。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "7e9ca9a3b745b61f11f8255952b2bf9a4ff039789fe2dc7a17765b22a1032e5a"}

{"id": "p_b4f300a97028ffaf", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 124, "text": "周雖不與政事，以儒行見禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "def2c68ac346623f92feeb28db2defa9793d67f97cee274c43587f435523791c"}

{"id": "p_a70cf20c2fcc388f", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 125, "text": "時訪大議，輒據經以對，而後生好事者亦諮問所疑焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "78d81805b2069e8c3efed352d636438602686ef5ced306d9c7ac599a33756acd"}

{"id": "p_d2959e73b96084b0", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 126, "text": "冬，魏大將軍鄧艾克江由，長驅而前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "9af1ca7428e7bf54493c83fe32157939272d9ea91f496027a70771b2fd63b8f9"}

{"id": "p_fcce097b3de0ca6c", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 127, "text": "而蜀本謂敵不便至，不作城守調度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "9df8c19e8fa4ce0fd1ca1eb70be17e0d40bd08b0c1462585cfc7e56024e943c2"}

{"id": "p_dc9e7950482e86b6", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 128, "text": "及聞艾已人陰平，百姓擾擾，皆進山野，不可禁制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "6720af33e9a4a44fe5fd9220189c5695a45fd7a245dc50ea31b769c821eff072"}

{"id": "p_7d26c8e55ad8e8c2", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 129, "text": "後主使臣羣會議，計無所出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "9835ac083b93ba4c89b0e05cf29f0bbf534534ac2279ddf209b3126567ffcf4c"}

{"id": "p_25ee2fddf7170fe6", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 130, "text": "或以為蜀之與吳，本為和國，宜可奔吳；或以為南中七郡，阻險鬥絕，易以自守，宜可奔南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "b80109d9b142b5c1289a69b38b6d666aec32ecf281c27cd1a12d11b3b835957b"}

{"id": "p_6a896b08b6bdcd75", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 131, "text": "羣臣或難周曰：「今艾以不遠，恐不受降，如之何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "deadbc8052797b71fb11f7270e3722daa3a694aa5d1ee223d67e34bbb592eb0c"}

{"id": "p_54178adb7bb695da", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」周曰：「方今東吳未賓，事勢不得不受之，受之後，不得不禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "e95c3681b9fb0e1c545497c76bd3d94c7ffb0a380d3a23e67d86723e64063f68"}

{"id": "p_2846e7ad238fb57a", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 133, "text": "若陛下降魏，魏不裂土以封陛下者，周請身詣京都，以古義爭之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "740ce778f2f1b4f529a6f5c2b1a92084e4a831eab71c26794a00f846fa1cd048"}

{"id": "p_c4b0b0a33af42338", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 134, "text": "後主猶疑於入南，周上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "6bc1d2b995fec2df36410f674941c0875c5fcae523f6243da2d333240df2f4ef"}

{"id": "p_7912ce5e15d108cf", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 135, "text": "劉氏無虞，一邦蒙賴，周之謀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "708a283cf3d4e54866004fcb7f4c0914c8de09dac320b9d61025b756911e6ece"}

{"id": "p_fe9265d2bba7e52a", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 136, "text": "時晉文王為魏相國，以周有全國之功，封陽城亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "614cbe33459e1cd97e5e9a0a247774297123dd684ecf410e5399ab31531ebb17"}

{"id": "p_741759059c94d21f", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 137, "text": "又下書辟周，周發至漢中，困疾不進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "b8f2d2833f71bc83875293d65e9d4aa343348e782a87a732a3be872a5754b9d1"}

{"id": "p_e966382397d9234a", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 138, "text": "夏，巴郡文立從洛陽還蜀，過見周。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "1017aa365bb5152964cbccaa388a71f454d79d4e580893c1152a299acce5f9eb"}
