{"id": "p_7966d145792c52c6", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 139, "text": "周語次，因書版示立曰：「典午忽兮，月酉沒兮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "255ed9578c7d67f1040c9b56d3690d77c9ecf42e93ddb4aa8b96c42e3d8b1db3"}

{"id": "p_6fd971454e53de9e", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」典午者謂司馬也，月酉者謂八月也，至八月而文王果崩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "3f64a7455324c3cb45a7b7cb6bbabeea30d180c725da733fde635786ccdcd06d"}

{"id": "p_0e0262235dd6edae", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 141, "text": "晉室踐阼，累下詔所在發遣周。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "2381928c049005ce7977c387569af4f3549ca78c42d2e8aae33682cdb3864e7d"}

{"id": "p_e85b4cb000525acd", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 142, "text": "以疾不起，就拜騎都尉，周乃自陳無功而封，求還爵土，皆不聽許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "bf9c6212e5059364e41ae0a39903685efa14de37bf9dd22e7d1672f745ebbe2f"}

{"id": "p_ffdd4b08a0ff1ccd", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 143, "text": "五年，予常為本郡中正，清定事訖，求休還家，往與周別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "5cf89fcb1ff550c6c5b28e3814c18395d2e603fdad243e15aa4f971124b29320"}

{"id": "p_c1b8eb8c66fa9096", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 144, "text": "周語予曰：「昔孔子七十二、劉向、楊雄七十一而沒，今吾年過七十，庶慕孔子遺風，可與劉、楊同軌，恐不出後歲，必便長逝，不復相見矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "12bdb5f3329b6064385665ef56f08233a8b81f9b24f034bb6e859a2fa4f6c7d2"}

{"id": "p_c8794653a86a49fa", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 145, "text": "」疑周以術知之，假而此言也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "6160ccedc71d8cb3ae67689523ac785d0aa138e23a75115c1b10278342779601"}

{"id": "p_108b2cc5ea0f933b", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 146, "text": "六年秋，為散騎常侍，疾篤不拜，至冬卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "3d87397dac03b09dc102cb14f66aee67c4a19c33699d974c282f4e924e79e32e"}

{"id": "p_1c58aabde4611b57", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 147, "text": "凡所著述，擇定《法訓》、《五經論》、《古史考》書之屬百餘篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "760a865f122e5713fa10fd3a2483d0af5744d88fda4784a10f3ceb4fbb52b88c"}

{"id": "p_b25a71d28834b90d", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 148, "text": "周三子，熙、賢、同，少子同頗好周業，亦以忠篤質素為行，舉孝廉，除錫令、東宮洗馬，召不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "e19a72424596cef49f04b621ae08a95982741d17458530ad6a3d939b5b6a811c"}

{"id": "p_a997e2871588543f", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 149, "text": "郤正字令先，河南偃師人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "ff5c37f96c670ab314690a5d47749ca243c415d1f6d15cd250588cc4d58156b8"}

{"id": "p_02bface8adaafe6c", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 150, "text": "祖父儉，靈帝末為益州刺史，為盜賊所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "cd0131260d21224fa86fd5f550024db45dd5e99fc98b3b091d6600bcf033d6f4"}

{"id": "p_fc55b8aab1da9d7b", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 151, "text": "會天下大亂，故正父揖因留蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "0c6480c4f5708b02693403ba7db9257a3f056b51c9c00eaf6ae4fb9a317fdb23"}

{"id": "p_27e2d6d1f7307460", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 152, "text": "揖為將軍孟達都督，隨達降魏，為中書令史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "fbd27858f68e999cc0ac0fcfab29474536bf86cab80d7bd0883084c87502db18"}

{"id": "p_94d3ca584db3de00", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 153, "text": "少以父死母嫁，單煢雙立，而安貧好學，博覽墳籍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "7eb1f8d3fbe8cfa75bd234941abbee591af95e38385b095ade80541503f93865"}

{"id": "p_a92d69f6bc8afd51", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 154, "text": "弱冠能屬文，入為秘書吏，轉為令史，遷郎，至令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "e0e11fc2ada4a90c60d087a8ddc3201531fc1bbb23ad600e4ce530cda22c192e"}

{"id": "p_d5a35bc13e208720", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 155, "text": "性淡於榮利，而尤耽意文章，自司馬、王、揚、班、傅、張、蔡之儔遺文篇賦，及當世美書善論，益部有者，則鑽鑿推求，略皆寓目。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "e3b168b34c6789c9aef037dfada90ca4c8f46ce2a1d652b1b8a5fc1ba878a322"}

{"id": "p_378139ff0c6960eb", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 156, "text": "自在內職，與宦人黃皓比屋周旋，經三十年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "00d66af92fc172a6432cc76de5aabd5755ec873580f0226eadb2d8c8985926a5"}

{"id": "p_98d62075a290cb92", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 157, "text": "皓從微至貴，操弄威權，正既不為皓所愛，亦不為皓所憎，是以官不過六百石，而免於憂患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "500946a94cb127e897f2c7e2db559ae9f562765a4b43f75ddcb947d0e7b8071b"}

{"id": "p_fb2a539c58996d9d", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 158, "text": "依則先儒，假文見意，號曰：《釋譏》，其文繼於崔駰《達旨》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "8f9880d3441ee8cc99620afe9bfe1b14952c60dd287fc51b623581984134b82e"}

{"id": "p_b97f66675f92a26a", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 159, "text": "，後主從譙周之計，遣使請降於鄧艾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "969edbe142daab850c51270c605dbc1c66740a157a8beb283e5343af84e1fff4"}

{"id": "p_b94fbd441b40409b", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 160, "text": "明年正月，鐘會作亂成都，後主東遷洛陽，時擾攘倉卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "add08211008ed987c2fe89a09142e10c0bf1e583c8e8b39bdbb08e55fb91ef29"}

{"id": "p_7ddfcbec99d38a72", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 161, "text": "蜀之大臣無冀從者，惟正及殿中督汝南張通，捨妻子單身隨侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "0a8aeb280b264b9592030e0de0f5adf44942fa68f8d8d763e79db427f382e588"}

{"id": "p_32dcc911030b9a60", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 162, "text": "後主賴正相導宜適，舉動無闕，乃慨然歎息，恨知正之晚，時論嘉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "25f5b8d17d539d6f88a0225b5ce213c3bdc05d9dbb6cc85bee4f5dbb7666b573"}

{"id": "p_6025a10db57e2157", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 163, "text": "泰始中，除安陽令，遷巴西太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "b5d50dc6263c7336b4d57ed4fbed7491f27c8d8ddcaad677a999cef81e6f645f"}

{"id": "p_667484b090b4575e", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 164, "text": "詔曰：「正昔在成都，顛沛守義，不違忠節，及見受用，盡心幹事，有治理之績，其以正為巴西太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "3f0e93b80b58a60fa2a6d5a7ea8f9b1017d55edf8cd793b09ed8754508b3e2ad"}

{"id": "p_96711f0f24030c7f", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 165, "text": "凡所著述詩論賦之屬，垂百篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "5567827f4d72ec26d074b3a41124659b1df4f4c1593faa91eacbf0d5ca4f679f"}

{"id": "p_20bbdec6662fbf88", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 166, "text": "評曰：杜微脩身隱靜，不役當世，庶幾夷、皓之槩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "c056387cd4be936beb64b17647531a99c27ee63f1ff4e640ceef21411b6a09dd"}

{"id": "p_d440dc70e4ae25c4", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 167, "text": "周羣佔天有徵，杜瓊沈默慎密，諸生之純也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "ca85247f35d0e2edf67c19a6bcb1b004ecf40f6b6f6f0d1a9dcc50ae721936e3"}

{"id": "p_2fc2ef9ffd98b627", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 168, "text": "許、孟、來、李，博涉多聞，尹默精於左氏，雖不以德業為稱，信皆一時之學士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "9ee363efcdee7f2a94aab56193094ace88a6e28a64a641dc4d219bdd2235468d"}

{"id": "p_a0721ff48777f87d", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 169, "text": "譙周詞理淵通，為世碩儒，有董、揚之規，郤正文辭燦爛，有張、蔡之風，加其行止，君子有取焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "d9d8e5b84c062f3e199542f036f450ad56ca341b7ec9e9fb495e3b848c71a6e2"}

{"id": "p_ffd796e2d6bd9503", "source_id": "src_268b01b3c5c53618", "ordinal": 170, "text": "二子處晉事少，在蜀事多，故著於篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "ea12bd4bae6aaaee8b88be93d6be32caa04b7ae582790b5fa7df4286c3b91b66"}

{"id": "p_505a3f6620d66772", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_b486d0ea8e9cadd3", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 1, "text": "黃權，字公衡，巴西閬中人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "e6bedcff70b151ed7777b692aca1193c71f7b71c3a3ccf22c3e58e467216adaf"}

{"id": "p_74942170bf9cf5ee", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 2, "text": "少為郡吏，州牧劉璋召為主簿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "3f0365dc70fb5d50511c5f65fb2db8c65e3b838f84a4847745bcb7f03699af1f"}

{"id": "p_9af1fc25090a3e09", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 3, "text": "時別駕張松建議，宜迎先主，使伐張魯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "6813f161490d4b54870daf7482014d3e5525d94074a661864862869c46f41f9f"}

{"id": "p_7dbb3671a1321c42", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 4, "text": "權諫曰：「左將軍有驍名，今請到，欲以部曲遇之，則不滿其心，欲以賓客禮待，則一國不容二君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "09d56c4ddc690daaaa99d782a5ed652eeffc1c482496b1a924d87a22e30a6dc5"}

{"id": "p_830f8a5cd941d49b", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 5, "text": "若容有泰山之安，則主有累卵之危。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "f990da4206a22a445d92fb61c291501b05b286c9baa39d1bb09c0597120e269e"}

{"id": "p_2bd1504e8cec9952", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」璋不聽，竟遣使迎先生，出權為廣漢長，及先主襲取益州，將帥分下郡縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "14fa2d74566b2cce9e59104eb774ade9d37e015da49817faedf7193e9bba500c"}

{"id": "p_5c827627e0cbde0e", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 7, "text": "郡縣風景附，權閉城堅守，須劉璋稽服，乃詣降先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "6ce0244516bf996098a2e2135297987c7a796becc2f10b3512e7d1b13fc1a50f"}

{"id": "p_818d846d46abd172", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 8, "text": "及曹公破張魯，魯走入巴中，權進曰：「若失漢中，則三巴不振，此為割蜀之股臂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "0e03a2dbd48bf6094c7715882316a0eecbc00df19fc64379e76d28c648e8860d"}

{"id": "p_6b539d56c2f86a52", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」於是先主以權為護軍，率諸將迎魯，魯已還南鄭，北降曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "d3c1283c4a2174eb8212517673f4c7e3403e0fab4f31d15deac894ade5a30949"}

{"id": "p_620e252756d0f7ba", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 10, "text": "然卒破杜濩、樸胡，殺夏候淵，據漢中，皆權本謀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "565aa088e8c1f01dfcf8bf28d807c19d7a2ceb902656c056863df9e8d2ad7db2"}

{"id": "p_eb8885a9d8e1185c", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 11, "text": "先主為漢中王，猶領益州牧，以權為治中從事，及稱尊號，將東伐吳，權諫曰：「吳人悍戰，又水軍順流，進易退難，臣請為先驅以當寇，陛下宜為後鎮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "2d09c7a73fd7503f1e7102df2d33e460668cf36572a0a3646dd3a5057acd6705"}

{"id": "p_fe5da02fd9a11799", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」先主不從，以權為鎮北將軍，督江北軍以防魏師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "6f240d7bc96bb252f7fd642e98fa2a29fe2af18fedf1c861617e3fc3fad0c95a"}

{"id": "p_47ce2a43e09c1d53", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 13, "text": "及吳將軍陸議乘流斷圍，南軍敗績，先主引退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "e9c36c69b8f9250b4b4241b233b4e799a10182f5cbbbff9f514f1dc8dbf933ae"}

{"id": "p_a2afe410d20403bd", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 14, "text": "而道隔絕，權不得還，故率將所領降於魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "2111c194b7bd6a4ab94468b2635a4dc549eb50fb5e1ad7214d2b3f1be8ce5ec1"}

{"id": "p_6dd92ec02daa9f81", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 15, "text": "先主曰：「孤負黃權，權不負孤也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "fd27f4e184c1764d266872853cf5d0e0d723334e35f6e130f6625933ec4c3546"}

{"id": "p_ff37cab5f0651e6f", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 16, "text": "魏文帝謂權曰：「君捨逆效順，欲追從陳、韓邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "b7c3250a0c284198f0689084c5ed77f848286e280f7f0200b6e703bc1368393f"}

{"id": "p_928b271997ec17bf", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 17, "text": "」權對曰：「臣過受劉主殊遇，降吳不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "3765ad1da8f7850005bb9934857623989928b861e1e0af493ab475d37b055364"}

{"id": "p_b5c9adeb39f6196c", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 18, "text": "且敗軍之將，免死為幸，何古人之可慕也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "6219740aac39bd41a9870c7735841fb95f73f2d87510020675b2952259e3eabc"}

{"id": "p_860699fa6a1beed2", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」文帝善之，拜為鎮南將軍，封育陽候，加侍中，使之陪乘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "1bdddd6f6061e11e639fca511653bf4671069d23eba486adc26e733fab653ad6"}

{"id": "p_10bb6238735c3a34", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 20, "text": "蜀降人或云誅權妻子，權知其虛言，未便發喪，後得審問，果如所言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "3328467677052ad53373a669848378dca366e60a27935417503620f773301834"}

{"id": "p_9ca3d91fe4099131", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 21, "text": "及先主薨問至，魏群臣咸賀而權獨否。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "3a9cf6309511a60bc1f0d6719b257c1b3b82f9a751b50e8057d4d989bbb0e61f"}

{"id": "p_915695d2297e49e2", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 22, "text": "文帝察權有局量，欲試驚之，遣左右詔權，末至之間，累催相屬，馬使奔馳，交錯於道，官屬侍從莫不辟魄，而權舉止顏色自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "5bd079c0cf2407e596df557611e5a1078308fc9ecd47833d41efae3d5a45c138"}

{"id": "p_fbec991cfc0a298e", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 23, "text": "後領益州刺史，徙佔河南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "ee66171c6c7808109dbb272e7394fae695696232c4b38b4fa33f2c3aa53151b1"}

{"id": "p_d78b4b0ca5694e7e", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 24, "text": "大將軍司馬宣王深器之，問權曰：「蜀中有卿輩幾人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "f49a631fcac921b3e39e539259da1d245a8185413ca526f2512f3c100223df45"}

{"id": "p_e37fbe0d8559dcf5", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 25, "text": "」權笑而答曰：「不圖明公見顧之重也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "15a624c0f29d77fc92502a6497789a2f3eb3e3d045740f6f847f3330c8dc465b"}

{"id": "p_bebde1b13ba2b201", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」宣王與諸葛亮書曰：「黃公衡，快士也，每坐起歎述足下，不去口實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "1795bc78898ba89f4f55250d36984f35fd6745605cb9188339b03b61b70ebbdc"}

{"id": "p_9a9dba451c6b91ad", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」，蜀，權遷車騎將軍、儀同三司。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "a53ac9ddf8e032ad0f184ec1265fff0fb838d895e112966d10b5d2c41a9f1b2c"}

{"id": "p_31ba271b92de002b", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 28, "text": "權留蜀子祟，為尚書郎，隨衛將軍諸葛瞻拒鄧艾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "31ab30eff201cb5e5318e5d784cd43bae8dc29a339d84b2dce5961c3ca74414d"}

{"id": "p_3c925d17d2df8a05", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 29, "text": "到涪縣，瞻盤桓未近，祟屢勸瞻宜速行據險，無令敵得入平地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "82432a125ca94954d2c55d5c9d65d446cec5b1dbdc53ab4dac2ec9f6a3d97396"}

{"id": "p_5e2a5ddcc096b68f", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 30, "text": "瞻猶與未納，祟至於流涕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "ca0b63a9317c2c0f0ced6ff8d522db6f428924f4c09dad855860ae4734f92449"}

{"id": "p_497838bdea1cc3d8", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 31, "text": "會艾長驅而前，瞻卻戰綿竹，祟帥厲軍士，期於必死，臨陣見殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "02656ff1cd71511dd19bc8847781c0210ca89a90a8656b2165a8a32614706ffb"}

{"id": "p_36acf8405b2874a2", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 32, "text": "李恢字德昂，建寧俞元人也，仕郡督郵，姑夫爨習為建伶令，有違犯之事，恢坐習免官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "1b45449a38f7c9e2e7a7b3c953a3e43a7ce6fb47adadddc08fb07c5d72a744be"}

{"id": "p_ded0855ed15059e9", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 33, "text": "太守董和以習方土大姓，寢而不許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "24f3ca940ed934d2a27e57c90d5c05e60aa4f7f37bd5a299942ec5a169143bba"}

{"id": "p_a216c971ff6a8c93", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 34, "text": "後貢恢於州，涉道末至，聞先主自葭萌還攻劉璋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "19e9790eeace6537a73b1aae25e04b059075906076d884a5fe30de3ac6418f54"}

{"id": "p_e93633c975c27249", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 35, "text": "恢知璋之必敗，先主必成也，乃託名郡使，北詣先主，遇於綿竹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "196aeb5472bf749435232948893baf64d71f262ef0f9155dafdc6e63f9a45b51"}

{"id": "p_35dce4ae2351e592", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 36, "text": "先主嘉之，從至洛城，遣恢至漢中交好馬超，超遂從命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "05af2b7cccaf03508ec863a9d4c749a38805ce2fd1c679a3caed56a6300520dc"}

{"id": "p_bfa9d7dfab6e1193", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 37, "text": "成都既定，先主領益州牧，以恢為功曹書佐、主簿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "877eeefc8b986ee927905138c5b6cc46827a2495cacb2fc5379f886f7026d696"}

{"id": "p_992438b49d03a612", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 38, "text": "後為亡虜所誣，引恢謀反，有司執送。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "2531d7c52ddcfadff0dd24c2b77b3dd412ecd1ddde46baddcd2086093da93051"}

{"id": "p_39ae609380bc3fd4", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 39, "text": "先主明其不然，更遷恢為別駕從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "041bad06f58acc942a2a638354099b7cae9e10d7838ab39d408c51c489ed8d17"}

{"id": "p_a916a41cf9653774", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 40, "text": "，庲降都督鄧方卒，先主問恢：「誰可代者？", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "07b64ae33626ebc406da34d82b024f0ce2b8773568a00c3a4ec753d5fecdc5e1"}

{"id": "p_6f82aad939101131", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 41, "text": "」恢對曰：「人之才能，各有長短，故孔子曰『其使人也器之』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "9a8fa8255cc6c00d1db44d2df1e206f40a5d7c66b5fe99f39d491444293c3e53"}

{"id": "p_7b71646f61e0071a", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 42, "text": "且夫明主在上，則臣下盡情，是以先零之役，趙充國曰『莫若老臣』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "dcbd274f9bbc2c4b446fe02bb45c132980efbd3369551598c29292d50f6dbfaa"}

{"id": "p_53df5c70e44adc27", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 43, "text": "臣竊不自量，惟陛下察之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "5857c991802cc990a9d63c8ac345bf4986cccef4279f408db5a99b9d6d80293b"}

{"id": "p_5fdac6dc425ce400", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 44, "text": "」先主笑曰：「孤之本意，亦已在卿矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "7977db844714e7ffc194ab551e38c76570ec3aebeca6817c2473dd82385229b3"}

{"id": "p_3e24c51badb1087b", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」遂以恢為庲降都督，使持節領交州刺史，住平夷縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "1f2540539257d2cd9397087f260c13c0b07b7091d00dce1c4de788044c2f7a02"}

{"id": "p_2523412ef4ff0e25", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 46, "text": "先主薨，高定恣睢於越巂，雍闓跋扈於建寧，朱褒反叛於牂牁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "c3936d716d140456c73f2f395af5ac37332e39a3801783107aa459806779dec1"}

{"id": "p_826f43acba632dd9", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 47, "text": "丞相亮南征，先由越俊，而恢案道向建寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "8134121c4aad1b2b3272db58498a6c635195e114d469d5984587230596b94737"}

{"id": "p_bb13ffc60b12de15", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 48, "text": "諸縣大相糾合，圍恢軍於昆明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "11b73b5e25529034a12582e09b46f21be188c24836b23df93f97d22235cdd243"}

{"id": "p_ac887e930c8025b7", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 49, "text": "時恢眾少敵倍，又未得亮聲息，繪謂南人曰：「官軍糧盡，欲規退還，吾中間久斥鄉里，乃今得旋，不能復北，欲還與汝等同計謀，故以誠相告。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "ccc13a6960bfb182b39bce598445da0c507cd3ee681e8dcb19b9d76a4102e9f2"}

{"id": "p_a25ee8aacc1cbae6", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」南人信之，故圍守怠緩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "9c8b45cfbe66d54a81ef0f78bdbccf2072178cc86958f5896b380838fb132d3f"}

{"id": "p_6bf9eda7c357e6d4", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 51, "text": "於是恢出擊，大破之，追奔逐北，南至槃江，東接牂牁，與亮聲勢相連。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "ed670f3d653f1ab9027953d96eaf029764e279afa3d83f1576c98160f4a84eca"}

{"id": "p_933368b1768737fd", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 52, "text": "封漢興亭侯，加安漢將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "216f88d91bf6679631bd039954d4c076a067330576d6f7758957cbbdcedc0541"}

{"id": "p_a8d13d75bb572a69", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 53, "text": "後軍還，南夷復叛，殺害守將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "9fbeb7decf4c1245df6c0f4f4db00dbba69bb0060fc083b14b29bcc5d7533420"}

{"id": "p_61cc839b44940032", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 54, "text": "恢身往撲討，鋤盡惡類，徙其豪帥於成都，賦出叟、濮耕牛戰馬金銀犀革，充繼軍資，於時費用不乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "ba179f0698dea4e97a68cf711c5b301bc0de6999de0212806fa319927b7da86c"}

{"id": "p_f46207d182e2caed", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 55, "text": "，以交州屬吳，解恢刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "c0f6477fa28de36b091246ba2f641abe2385fb86205dae57dee47a348909a95b"}

{"id": "p_3342e88d2fc80653", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 56, "text": "更領建寧太守，以還居本郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "c6654e350139cbcdf5da65cb5d022445228dafd70757b5bef9ec89b8736dd6e2"}

{"id": "p_f0613f09a5799ecd", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 57, "text": "子遺嗣，恢弟子球，羽林右部督，隨諸葛瞻拒鄧艾，臨陣授命，死於綿竹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "2d61ee20035abec44451ca3d52b41e81b8258cda3f0e211c96b33618266ee86d"}

{"id": "p_b93a68168572e503", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 58, "text": "呂凱字季平，永昌不韋人也，仕郡五官掾、功曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "9005e09d92ce1f38fd84e37e02be0174cabb0360756a03a1f8b0c0b28d11e410"}

{"id": "p_0ca592a8d7cf1b2f", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 59, "text": "時雍闓等聞先主薨於永安，驕黠滋甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "f3d065996600a2ba29389c4dee1d8fb313ecf3502edda66b48ad5e041787d692"}

{"id": "p_ffb37c0177e80fb0", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 60, "text": "都護李嚴與闓書六紙，解喻利害，闓但答一紙曰：「蓋聞天無二日，土無二王，今天下鼎立，正朔有三，是以遠人惶惑，不知所歸也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "cc00cf7848ff2d13c56703d3b5402bc8c460d1cae1388aa1c3bc1c982a0c0453"}

{"id": "p_ed28805d6961dddb", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 61, "text": "闓又降於吳，吳遙署凱為永昌太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "08240a288383a0d5554a528b624e7db589928968aef924e5ab801132cc5c4bbc"}

{"id": "p_8817881d24689c52", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 62, "text": "永昌既在益州郡之西，道路壅塞，與蜀隔絕，而郡太守改易。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "74867a7044a2c61ab7574b849d60272ba444b55b5660f928a6a9a9ac9f449024"}

{"id": "p_7b2ad1370510360a", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 63, "text": "凱與府丞蜀郡王伉帥厲吏民，閉境拒闓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "20bcbf270571b3354f053f98164109ef1ed08791e84c0eaa7ca5659a7e55cb3d"}

{"id": "p_9cf2941c72a09877", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 64, "text": "闓數移檄永昌，稱說云云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "577ff9ac67a54e44b25e7e8ac5573ed9638a6d4b0c4182c9c5d6392cabc41ca1"}

{"id": "p_b447f9917674076d", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 65, "text": "凱威恩內著，為郡中所信，故能全其節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "cc51ac371a09f8d1cc474d5ca1ce9e12155a47ca2587c980b4a25ac8a40d0bd2"}

{"id": "p_7c9daec9db7fa292", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 66, "text": "及丞相亮南征討闓，既發在道，而闓已為高定部曲所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "a56e2b4d25dcdb17ace54789a763c098f105ba50a5feec4b0c1bb1066293921b"}

{"id": "p_e67654fb9d5561d4", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 67, "text": "亮至南，上表曰：「永昌郡吏呂凱、府丞王伉等，執忠絕域，十有餘年，雍闓、高定逼其東北，而凱等守義不與交通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "a753520ffc7ac360b75793ce62d804c7b6c74a86461ac86caf884d759c9dc41a"}

{"id": "p_29b0d6026f010c05", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 68, "text": "臣不意永昌風俗敦直乃爾！", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "4383ef843e6205d17d875ba98732b63860af08a058c59e18410196e94975ffb2"}

{"id": "p_9915189288676324", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」以凱為雲南太守，封陽遷亭侯，會為叛夷所害，子祥嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "b75c1fe7709f826f46ed4828fbe51ec9954e4733c5e6109cc6f68dc98a7e73b1"}

{"id": "p_5752bbaca9120209", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 70, "text": "而王伉亦封亭侯，為永昌太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "345a95e8917b982cf7dcd28ba42650a7fe7e89a4ab0098b18ed0f00257891090"}

{"id": "p_2b0c0be3056d00fc", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 71, "text": "馬忠字德信，巴西閬中人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "c0e92e642bb71e310d62080eb3a86015ab94eaf194d51df3b730c26b376f31c3"}

{"id": "p_872e3e94c2d4eba5", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 72, "text": "少養外家，姓狐，名篤，後乃復姓，改名忠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "0365ccea18a06efbc75575ae71258da16a6cdada1331b69b9fa7f34ebee408ef"}

{"id": "p_bd1dd8e197b4cf90", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 73, "text": "為郡吏，建安末舉孝廉，除漢昌長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "0a028bdcbf686144d21430154afd9aedd86c9733679ec94f645d8231698efdb7"}

{"id": "p_d757bab5eb05b276", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 74, "text": "先主東征，敗績猇亭，巴西太守閻芝發諸縣兵五千人以補遣闕，遣忠送往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "85ea060277feca693f444af7e515d4e02c233f923a10c21d3292bfdcc9efe54c"}

{"id": "p_079d2f71327b5093", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 75, "text": "先主已還永安，見忠與語，謂尚書令劉巴曰：「雖亡黃權，復得狐篤，此為世不乏賢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "c310a8541115b545de4aec3abed8b497a714c09d4ccb792efb7878bc09352bb8"}

{"id": "p_897471e01db40f75", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 76, "text": "」，丞相亮開府，以忠為下督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "87e086f8df313dd9d3e1a7937292aaf6122c3e42ba949a3e8bb3db0bdf9d4f84"}

{"id": "p_ba1c9c32c1990449", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 77, "text": "三年，亮入南，拜忠牂牁太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "d10ec34a01bd47305d4a57885e063e209cb3760ec08eca153603f1683231e226"}

{"id": "p_856e2c4dc74b17c8", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 78, "text": "叛亂之後，忠撫育卹理，甚有威惠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "462f7241e8579706fc7e726ce31daaf7a136ac779b9ac20cdfee57f7720e6853"}

{"id": "p_239ef07ffb288896", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 79, "text": "八年，召為丞相參軍，副長史蔣琬署留府事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "ae216bde6ba44f4cf839f91d60bb4fd6a829905710d86fee8b0a7bd80c601a8f"}

{"id": "p_71096d3ac0f7e385", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 80, "text": "明年，亮出祁山，忠詣亮所，經營戌事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "7ad259f0d2c9d71d764985179d0d8ae24bcde46431003077b465746395c748e3"}

{"id": "p_ee455927d72a04cf", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 81, "text": "軍還，督將軍張嶷等討汶山郡叛羌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "52b7060bccb8ba43fa4031f365cdf3c7e21b63863d3be11a5a47133f828d6792"}

{"id": "p_6818065db18dc0a0", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 82, "text": "十一年，南夷豪帥劉冑反，擾亂諸郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "a69776f09c50849344f2e2a1389084244672e9bd27ce25b8ab757f43aafc293d"}

{"id": "p_0ff8aaeb3d09488e", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 83, "text": "徵庲降都督張冀還，以忠代冀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "07e4e640953a19e61155a7f639f56948733fd58403ae1f080241d10c5ccf6ce9"}

{"id": "p_ca44d80a4ae1179b", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 84, "text": "加忠監軍、奮威將軍，封博陽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "ed32eacd7e956b8f9fc9ea0e7cee9743711dbfc0a8e1189e8dcbe2d91ff10c0c"}

{"id": "p_b4da8a598befb7c3", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 85, "text": "初，建寧郡殺太守正昂，縛太守張裔於吳，故都督常駐平夷縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "fab2c96fe20d56f36806d1290cd19e653e08a0ec5cc8c01d36c1a29b2b5024ba"}

{"id": "p_f854bba08efcee52", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 86, "text": "至忠，乃移治味縣，處民夷之間。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "5798ecf1edd262cd2da1864de2006a9397b06dc91fd1568fe956a55f76225741"}

{"id": "p_690797127514c2d1", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 87, "text": "又越嶲郡亦久失土地，忠率將太守張嶷開复舊郡，由此就加安南將軍，進封彭鄉亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "9c03b11f738af00979a99e1687b80e5c559b62a9956f9dcea86a7ae7888bad56"}

{"id": "p_c72e06cde71b103d", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 88, "text": "還朝，因至漢中，見大司馬蔣琬，宣傳詔旨，加拜鎮南大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "f41d13e4b6e05ab1f0eabf13fb090d4e1c3d702addc6d7115b72c682e733aa4e"}

{"id": "p_10ba782fa3c827a9", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 89, "text": "七年春，大將軍費韋北禦魏敵，留忠成都，平尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "d035ba89760b6754a7b3c244ab264e380119b44ccd691f01a623df7d06603e6f"}

{"id": "p_7a9b2beb264e76f2", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 90, "text": "忠為人寬濟有度量，但恢啁大笑，忿怒不形於色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "a74c9be138d8506e3b18293407b8f536b6331717b6a57852429e1c188d03fa2b"}

{"id": "p_e3480556d67fec9c", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 91, "text": "然處事能斷，威思並立，是以蠻夷畏而愛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "64a639300c497312f034335e2b9c45a31ea4b325e9f27080c436118412ed218f"}

{"id": "p_cdb3807295ac9b09", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 92, "text": "及卒，莫不自致喪庭，流涕盡哀，為之立廟祀，迄今猶在。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "0259a0433916a0f118c1f781b913d21ab78052f17d5deaf149382e001218b1ca"}

{"id": "p_ad305bbee48a5914", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 93, "text": "張表，時名士，清望逾忠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "ffc32d4d7195eb716101dd9d6b8bf07276a2f710d7399248cbb4c73105ff0139"}

{"id": "p_2f9dfbc8f2b24e4d", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 94, "text": "閻宇宿有功幹，於事精勤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "f7983b36de83dec3b7ae593746f3c0e360fbefebf9b00d0053fe99a0630d1b79"}

{"id": "p_6c229f9774311a77", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 95, "text": "繼踵在忠後，其威風稱績，皆不及忠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "99f410ff72df99e3c57cfbdbba3a07dcf3e9831827a253ca6f2014d2595bb196"}

{"id": "p_95d663312cc380c4", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 96, "text": "王平字子均，巴西宕渠人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "22f9a5188f06b6954b862d3a9c12444b1dcc3bc0770e28106dc99d376c6601d6"}

{"id": "p_0de0e75df0231837", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 97, "text": "隨杜濩、樸胡詣洛陽，假校尉，從曹公征漢中，因降先主，拜牙門將、裨將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "071c36fd89d3e32942a8c6c8bc1864c567a9c6a798e3f79b12ab9e40ab710642"}

{"id": "p_f6b1333ce2ed573e", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 98, "text": "謖捨水上山，舉措煩擾，平連規諫謖，謖不能用，大敗於街亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "5efa130a530bddb6c1a395eb2ee37673822678c889cdb5d698ec92dde928c999"}

{"id": "p_3c9b7154e648cdee", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 99, "text": "眾盡星散，惟平所領千人鳴鼓自持，魏將張郃疑其伏兵，不往逼也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "6d3c973d719b423b5db5a91aed5066fe3142d8548680432cf1671496edffeb49"}

{"id": "p_56c1a0963b681a85", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 100, "text": "於是平徐徐收合諸營遺迸，率將士而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "aa2796068cd81b5229df186d61273cec8867a9786f097bbe1d72ecd32d45fb27"}

{"id": "p_b52ef6d940ae3f6b", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 101, "text": "丞相亮既誅馬謖及將軍張休、李盛，奪將軍黃襲等兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "ac98804b898359310e94c37ceb9e43efc4bc8db0eb19bba286bf04bfbbee4dd8"}

{"id": "p_7af5385ae22980b8", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 102, "text": "平特見崇顯，加拜參軍，統五部兼當營事，進位討寇將軍，封亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "496c35834845942045a673756cf985c19204feeff80649d3970f2cf0a5ee2a42"}

{"id": "p_34fbd3ab449717a3", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 103, "text": "九年，亮圍祁山，平別守南圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "8eea67aaddf8e7d5e4153482c23c7d10d9f0e5b1589af64607e9ccabdd872f50"}

{"id": "p_7dbf914a0de6b4d6", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 104, "text": "魏大將軍司馬宣王攻亮，張郃攻平，平堅守不動，郃不能克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "e6dca7b3d980f773245950558fc05245bccdc3521d703a2819ea4a43286e239c"}

{"id": "p_8be4b46a6a5129c7", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 105, "text": "十二年，亮卒於武功，軍退還，魏延作亂，一戰而敗，平之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "b0b3433b774a57707d8c17f69cf9f4bdfe651011b5f36dcd7baa6f1eeaf85ac5"}

{"id": "p_63461f542822eaa3", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 106, "text": "遷後典軍、安漢將軍，副車騎將軍吳壹住漢中，又領軍漢中太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "dffc2fa04a075c9cc125a7b7c1b39cd33c46f588881113412a241b5cce6b9417"}

{"id": "p_4fcf86cae9d51590", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 107, "text": "十五年，進封安漢侯，代壹督漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "503c96a8006ff42c359de1b0ef85ea3130ed2c575e44619a2512b0f649b7d381"}

{"id": "p_696aeef6f32ab7f6", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 108, "text": "，大將軍蔣琬住沔陽，平更為前護軍，署琬府事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "0e305a0a90122bba6ac5429846c9d4322e72461ddc7ff603ce0995eaeae67388"}

{"id": "p_4211b2b33adf9b5d", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 109, "text": "六年，琬還住涪，拜平前監軍、鎮北大將軍，統漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "490e85e4590ece7706f79274c013f32396a367dffa7dfc06bcff536f77baf5b8"}

{"id": "p_3f4b19a6c9aa682f", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 110, "text": "七年春，魏大將軍曹爽率步騎十餘萬向漢川，前鋒已在駱谷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "b513e8fd1f592a4b02e3b6ee1cbf1654e1ea2a28d0bd6bca562601ce2073bed0"}

{"id": "p_efee1bf43707e146", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 111, "text": "時漢中守兵不滿三萬，諸將大驚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "3d2feb2a06bad39f179e3105595bc2c6d0c7417d58b4e8574eef30a2ec5cb80d"}

{"id": "p_d583b53a7148fbbe", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 112, "text": "或曰：「今力不足以拒敵，聽當固守漢、樂二城，遇賊令入，比爾間，涪軍足得救關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "e07e3f5221251cfd4580773dbd8d16e28f789c2bc81f28c56238eb9bbbf834ad"}

{"id": "p_8da9b5ba43725049", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 113, "text": "今宜先遣劉護軍、杜參軍據興勢，平為後拒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "5e3189d64a806cd9189ce8ce33d86d500dcb985b98eb73dd667fb4d7def72226"}

{"id": "p_f018e4464a2501b2", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 114, "text": "若賊分向黃金，平率千人下自臨之，比爾間，涪軍行至，此計之上也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "b3e9ac799d4658340328d715bf02986e444a06dd2f7bd8f05c575b7691619b9d"}

{"id": "p_5358adc1c82704ed", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 115, "text": "」惟護軍劉敏與平意同，即便施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "4b97dc10b3a320a9fe8b631182077541bee4e15588d26a3606afc5b3a0412ec8"}

{"id": "p_adb462dad87e3133", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 116, "text": "涪諸軍及費禕自成都相繼而至，魏軍退還，如平本策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "d007a508fbb004b0586a716a9b6d9e377682ab532b92408a664528ea3ff301d6"}

{"id": "p_861f0487de02acc8", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 117, "text": "是時，鄧芝在東，馬忠在南，平在北境，咸著名跡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "900dea5937a0dfac9847b6cc39a0abc367f01b2a096bdd8117b02c1d10cc29c4"}

{"id": "p_0103672ad2b94b3b", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 118, "text": "平生長戎旅，手不能書，其所識不過十字，而口授作書，皆有意理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "86740344713576814677e4dfe8bd5d1b02a39fd12d81da25c5b4e0f9fc6490e6"}

{"id": "p_90042c0d2ddb82f1", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 119, "text": "使人讀《史》、《漢》諸紀傳，聽之，備知其大義，往往論說不失其指。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "deb42a1f6d5484f340485e74a39826d1a61c377e1bd403a5dae242ed87c228f3"}

{"id": "p_bebe5711d7645c1f", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 120, "text": "遵履法度，言不戲諺，從朝至夕，端坐徹日，懷無武將之體。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "db60a542c274ce886c3935c99814d75b2e39686127817a3cd1e9cfc2ecdf4532"}

{"id": "p_98cba7e97b330ca4", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 121, "text": "然性狹侵疑，為人自輕，以此為損焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "53ce1812976f7d486f860db593a3ae6d358e98bf7f0f04545829ff6c7e85b70c"}

{"id": "p_16f26c03240637da", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 122, "text": "初，平同郡漢昌句忠勇寬厚，數有戰功，功名爵位亞平，官至左將軍，封宕渠侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "3cc7a3d9f95bcd06475bc4f37893280a6725d71333204ff3326d9506d60ff9ca"}

{"id": "p_9ce44ce86f96bec3", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 123, "text": "張嶷字伯岐，巴郡南充國人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "c823e4b2b474173797aa1d86b635cc8a4583b899597f5e0b922b372f87c9a975"}

{"id": "p_d2d5c93f76471a0e", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 124, "text": "先主定蜀之際，山寇攻縣，縣長捐家逃亡，嶷冒白刃，攜負夫人，夫人得免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "a785fec5d123bf096788593eaef57889a5251cbb5dd0c53c9d0ef0406612ef29"}

{"id": "p_9ce85d9821a7f6bc", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 125, "text": "時郡內士人龔祿、姚冑位二千石，當世有聲名，皆與嶷友善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "c4c55976a8a422048782df37a2ef9cfa3d609658678195d9f26dfd16c29149e1"}

{"id": "p_b79dd874077d4279", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 126, "text": "，丞相亮北住漢中，廣漢綿竹山賊張慕等鈔盜軍資，劫略吏民，嶷以都尉將兵討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "358fdd671b3e8dfa14e5a2ef07c59968f7ec1b749b9aaa20dfe4bc3a75f56a7d"}

{"id": "p_fda6d717ddc4acd0", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 127, "text": "酒酣，嶷身率左右，因斬慕等五十餘級，渠帥悉珍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "fcb5a70ace37c73bd4949d58ba6248183a5b5fbdf39f5210b59e053953623f32"}

{"id": "p_738c70713ee02c44", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 128, "text": "後得疾病困篤，家素貧匱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "fc92910ebee34d8627d0e1ec08bdd8543836953c3daa530c76cfe0a26fe3deca"}

{"id": "p_08eb9374014e774d", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 129, "text": "廣漢太守蜀郡何祗，名為通厚，嶷宿與疏闊，乃自輿詣祗，託以治疾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "4d89609ef82d73dd7a11e1c277f22e013812bf352f7f0419a64b52e32e516814"}

{"id": "p_c5c3b0c369246f3d", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 130, "text": "拜為牙門將，屬馬忠，北討汶山叛羌，南平四郡蠻夷，輒有籌畫戰克之功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "a7bd1e14082e3403e6858dd6ffd801067782e19453d40d3658c8a62be99e3bde"}

{"id": "p_c10d6c78debc79df", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 131, "text": "十四年，武都氐王苻健請降，遣將軍張尉往迎，過期不到，大將軍蔣琬深以為念。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "5cc503470ab56729c079b63fc8e2c7fb28873f4735114f2d6ff340d2cb63f37a"}

{"id": "p_a8d4692a8cc74694", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 132, "text": "嶷平之曰：「苻健求附款至，必無他變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "0c5cb0dec4d54f3c7f318045e1086ebeae7ab06f9d95b7e74c4ef2b0296a01e0"}

{"id": "p_1ae5886931af74ef", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 133, "text": "素聞健弟狡黠，又夷狄不能同功，將有乖離，是以稽留耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "9d6368d1b9155da6c90918fc44229596ee224fbc531a2b0d7e00678d570f5df2"}

{"id": "p_2ff8274261644c60", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 134, "text": "」數日，問至，健弟果將四百戶就魏，獨健來從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "600d642a433d95135151cfb5353d7daa8da6a87f006d7e85c63516b6b417597d"}

{"id": "p_c626d7bd2f374c60", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 135, "text": "初，越巂郡自丞相亮討高定之後，叟夷數反，殺太守龔祿、焦璜，是後太守不敢之郡，只住安定縣，去郡八百餘里，其郡徒有名而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "66ffe3e4b10bcd25316494057aaea1613f2fe82e3d34e0d66cbd9a2fc358e628"}

{"id": "p_8c245faf51962a26", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 136, "text": "時論欲復舊郡，除嶷為越巂太守，嶷將所領往之郡，誘以恩情，蠻夷皆服，頗來降附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "30152bb2ed56a90a54f15a239f73812fe17599de977d78cef81b72940c4a65f4"}

{"id": "p_0e20dc8c2799aaa3", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 137, "text": "北徼捉馬最驍勁，不承節度，嶷乃往討，生縛其帥魏狼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "a8191d914bf0ebd6653415de851327a2326e3371f82bb57a331926a843b71186"}

{"id": "p_c2c265d73f97ee3f", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 138, "text": "又解縱告喻，使招懷餘類。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "92a63eb94e263a157e7d4156a62fd89e5b0a87d4b418b241dd30ccfff754328c"}

{"id": "p_de4a7c3c49d0e271", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 139, "text": "表拜狼為邑侯，種落三千餘戶皆安土供職。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "2a09259e389fc9cc3118a99257ff054dfe28d0590af4cd3af2b2525d7570abb7"}

{"id": "p_54040216ac9d7540", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 140, "text": "蘇祁邑君冬逢、逢弟魄渠等，已降復反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "7558bfa8ef3bcebcf8bdf80720de32a7257cd8539a6f174257eae31d0773871d"}

{"id": "p_85bc2b866efdb701", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 141, "text": "逢妻，旄牛王女，嶷以計原之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "11b52ad1347079a2c1342ae9a404fb53822b41ce24ef9348815aac580e99e31c"}

{"id": "p_44e81149114a957b", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 142, "text": "渠剛猛捷悍，為諸種深所畏憚，遣所親二人詐降嶷，實取消息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "234b1643ef792773baf3be697f7d6d4ad4e3735e70ea8ce7b03f68bc86ea5a06"}

{"id": "p_0d1b055535d48fbb", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 143, "text": "嶷覺之，許以重賞，使為反間，二人遂合謀殺渠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "bf96b6243f7ac7974a1e7901c206a3dd40c168e7931d61f16e2b8241245ac9c0"}

{"id": "p_0bef7722a159d75e", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 144, "text": "又斯都耆帥李求承昔手殺龔祿，嶷求募捕得，數其宿惡而誅之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "cce3f80be2bb88e80d6c880830cc928da349e5b2e6b2c82e3bda33d5854a5a68"}

{"id": "p_f5e21767e79c331b", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 145, "text": "始嶷以郡郛宇頹壞，更築小塢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "d05c55f89ca549ca0495875bee8c6cf5205acc0670608b4a18b861c9d118df86"}

{"id": "p_d79cda50de983f7e", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 146, "text": "在官三年，徙還故郡，繕治城郭，夷種男女莫不致力。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "9dbe6ed8f3a74d79fc40ecb15f531ff35cb3832cfa6786b92f150bd81e792c76"}

{"id": "p_eb98d73cf2fb5964", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 147, "text": "定莋、台登、卑水三縣去郡三百餘里，舊出鹽鐵及漆，而夷徼久自固食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "5c59b9d45bb23c0fadee56e9a4074a66706b6d02d4655ab481d90f331aa34542"}

{"id": "p_92fabb270cecefd2", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 148, "text": "嶷率所領奪取，署長吏焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "fc694c5f94125e43a3e42a02a6d8de9b1cdf11bd435b7972eb219229c4bab3b8"}

{"id": "p_9a20c8a34c065f49", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 149, "text": "嶷之到定莋，定莋率豪狼岑，盤木王舅，甚為蠻夷所信任，忿嶷自侵，不自來詣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "0e7ea13cbc72c415ed662c1c3aaea616ff7d96a3847f940975be39d00ec739e6"}

{"id": "p_5a8ced0051e20617", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 150, "text": "嶷使壯士數十直往收致，撻而殺之，持屍還種，厚加賞賜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "7603cf9f6bd802e22a4e54f4ed395e3084fafdc2e8cd15eca82d408c76ab782b"}

{"id": "p_ade00fab8210dc52", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 151, "text": "喻以狼岑之惡，且曰：「無得妄動，動即殄矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "cade3ce83925037f63e80b9894e1c9a43baca56e516d7eb600fa22bd46c4cba2"}

{"id": "p_66a08336505a8464", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 152, "text": "漢嘉郡界旄牛夷種類四千餘戶，其率狼路，欲為姑婿冬逢報怨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "ac4cbf6015d2c1adfe67882fb03c9be759ab3ee83338bc9988ab12c177cfdd4f"}

{"id": "p_e2c264b16e49c07e", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 153, "text": "遣叔父離將，逢眾相度形勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "4d990a078e39c042339b941697e96e266fceb217313d140f2cb5fd10a892f542"}

{"id": "p_5fb82cc5da21eab1", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 154, "text": "嶷逆遣親近繼牛酒勞賜，又令離姊逆逢妻宣暢意旨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "5a67937e795a583fd25d4434df2d198cac06e3ad70b8b91d7fbb39511e674a1d"}

{"id": "p_fc69f17d6c35c706", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 155, "text": "離既受賜，並見其姊，姊弟歡悅，悉率所領將詣嶷，嶷厚加賞待，遣還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "0612e07c82e4113c71491d56cc640bd67c1ba1412c230c24e761a120b3d2a25b"}

{"id": "p_a1197c65b6cdbec4", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 156, "text": "郡有舊道，經旄牛中至成都，既平且近。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "fb953cfa6c0550d1b9713a962945b480d7e49eb1875c6e0b63196e114eddfb56"}

{"id": "p_1a622fc0f0d72bf7", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 157, "text": "自旄牛絕道，已百餘年，更由安上，既險且遠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "2de8e822451491448f3707971ae3aa8e7e9332edf50226396b14822bfdd1e083"}

{"id": "p_5295319e2880c439", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 158, "text": "疑遣左右資貨幣賜路，重令路姑喻意，路乃率兄弟妻子悉詣疑，疑與盟誓，開通舊道，千里肅清，復古亭繹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "8d8b51fd88d34924354a04c3f01d0ded2e07326629e207f1d7d6563a2d9ef24e"}

{"id": "p_d3d1dc7f22b2c76c", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 159, "text": "奏封路為旋牛毗王，遣使將路朝貢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "7f75bd4682b69b9ce17d747c0fb755b3db8e1368a65328bf3a0c3ab2a7bd0bd8"}

{"id": "p_acadafdb0b05387b", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 160, "text": "後主於是加疑撫戎將軍，領郡如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "94bfe35577cc3f33b589093f00ae1a657c038548f6818b65be992808c18b035e"}

{"id": "p_292baa97436001ee", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 161, "text": "嶷初見費禕為大將軍，恣性泛愛，待信新附不過，嶷書戒之曰：「昔岑彭率師，來歙杖節，咸見害於刺客，今明將軍位尊權重，宜鑒前事，少以為警。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "a557a0e995411c7fac758bc557cdabb4d6a4f96f39951a0a0f68b23c9e31264c"}

{"id": "p_4fe363ddef9d5477", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 162, "text": "」後禕果為魏降人郭脩所害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "e07ae97a66840a99e7252d9ae9f97a95bcdb1bb00744b1d8a1b2472a390f7bcd"}

{"id": "p_90ac1bdd53456f3b", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 163, "text": "吳太傅諸葛恪以初破魏軍，大興兵眾以圖攻取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "3b8dfd597eb6681970c96343d889ad92271bafb6427a83d3aa54109f014d46f6"}

{"id": "p_6bf53a890b0a75fc", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 164, "text": "侍中諸葛瞻，丞相亮之子，恪從弟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "48ea1ccdfb6c2901c21e3541a974d6ed929a79554fdc9b41b9cd89b7e019b5b6"}

{"id": "p_8fdad98f373d57e6", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 165, "text": "夷民戀慕，扶轂泣涕，過旄牛邑，邑君襁負來迎，及追尋至蜀郡界，其督相率隨嶷朝貢者百餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "29e9f50eae16d72eec88dabffb1cf62d247398fc3ef04262806bc51a61e82aa6"}

{"id": "p_66da64a90f0bbbba", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 166, "text": "嶷至，拜蕩寇將軍，慷慨壯烈，士人咸多貴之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "9cdd474b7d4262867ad289f2095b03e999a827eb46dd6e1823334f1246b8f499"}

{"id": "p_6cd6224d676daade", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 167, "text": "然放蕩少禮，人亦以此譏焉，是歲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "6e2bbb70cfbba47ab8f717451d78d07e5b018a967451ce6618e2ae80c1b38ec7"}

{"id": "p_b92515554069b431", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 168, "text": "魏狄道長李簡密書請降，衛將軍姜維率嶷等因簡之資以出隴西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "faa3534baa16ce11646b069a96ddf48fb64724820e518f1edcf600a38636ed7b"}

{"id": "p_11b3441120d5de9e", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 169, "text": "既到狄道，簡悉率城中吏民出迎軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "02e2d915656d662f4c6a6610d129f1930e8996b16482fba3e3674ca8f73d5254"}

{"id": "p_d3dc5fc7e1306beb", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 170, "text": "軍前與魏將徐質交鋒，嶷臨陣隕身，然其所殺傷亦過倍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "45a03a415d0598765e4fce18698d4b80e7acdf82007790793b3f906dbddcde1d"}

{"id": "p_88aecc26c43eb074", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 171, "text": "既亡，封長子瑛西鄉侯，次子護雄襲爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "930145f106ed2e0a5cf92063c2f70bd7c2a37ea30697e31edfe8a86958293567"}

{"id": "p_8182c6a7c6f24d23", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 172, "text": "南土越崔巂民夷聞嶷死，無不悲泣，為嶷立廟，四時水旱輒祀之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "3232d1d0d4b93a66b3d279d2e481b9271e07816a229b6210e5b465285b4b220a"}

{"id": "p_6409032695925c43", "source_id": "src_28ed8b1971e88b32", "ordinal": 173, "text": "評曰：黃權弘雅思量，李恢公亮志業，呂凱守節不回，馬忠擾而能毅，王平忠勇而嚴整，張嶷識斷明果，咸以所長，顯名發跡，遇其時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "8cda85d0341382319c73914ad48c1d389ec3d06e09c0bb34327b78ab5f838173"}

{"id": "p_d68f2ed9dea8001d", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_bed8308f90bf6bd1", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 1, "text": "蔣琬字公琰，零陵湘鄉人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "b5b2ca855bc8798ca5344ab7e698f924720523af2f1501708abf8ef0971ac3e9"}

{"id": "p_210bc5dd004bf152", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 2, "text": "弱冠與外弟泉陵劉敏俱知名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "e3e45f8ccb4bc572ec31d0568c319248b69e722c0a89554cccaf006966f7cd1d"}

{"id": "p_c6178df318b1f8eb", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 3, "text": "琬以州書佐隨先主入蜀，除廣都長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "c5a840defbc58760a47b1fefa0938bbb68d7333da9038ebe5e445d67c54b9d1f"}

{"id": "p_a237f849feef6e77", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 4, "text": "先主嘗因遊觀奄至廣都，見琬眾事不理，時又沉醉，先主大怒，將加罪戮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "3f8045396a08ac232b0de4a9eb00f385cf189ed04c924f57592c608298821c6e"}

{"id": "p_4d067aa51a427cef", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 5, "text": "軍師將軍諸葛亮請曰：「蔣琬，社稷之器，非百里之才也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "4e36db50c8481e46b7cf2715317f9b0fb93b98c6d40e99b331bc2c2f1bdd8d40"}

{"id": "p_52dd6ebd98e315bc", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 6, "text": "其為政以安民為本，不以修飾為先，願主公重加察之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "6e249fd9fdb4669642681d87ac49abd949eece0ff38e7b61df0d8cb156afd6b3"}

{"id": "p_dc968bd221053e8c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 7, "text": "」先主雅敬亮，乃不加罪，倉卒但免官而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "f09e7e09785a479708212fe12a1619055af2ecf6b244cfa26ec010c920826849"}

{"id": "p_23b4e4dcd0a86655", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 8, "text": "琬見推之後，夜夢有一牛頭在門前，流血滂沱，意甚惡之，呼問占夢趙直。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "fe4e64cd528fc50c1952b395ccf8385b87ab0be75fb70b6889b5ba8313b0e7c4"}

{"id": "p_bc82903ab1e54395", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 9, "text": "直曰：「夫見血者，事分明也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "f5590e547e7f52aa563d668ca51bf0b33a6a0dd1e957c87bc9922551a99edd49"}

{"id": "p_de8605565419d1bd", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 10, "text": "牛角及鼻，『公』字之象，君位必當至公，大吉之征也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "8f45d4297b5a3db6125e88f9a38dd5c16b72df82b5eda4f7987d9393a769e2b2"}

{"id": "p_42b3e4dafe56c00e", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 11, "text": "先主為漢中王，琬人為尚書郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "257f4dcc4b8f1590326e98b00dc8a78a93535971554ff766286186d588235ee6"}

{"id": "p_c67de161268d50b6", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 12, "text": "，丞相亮開府，辟琬為東曹掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "910cd564a17756c6b106a5b6f6e196d9d97a340d7f3ab21932da588ce1f10dd3"}

{"id": "p_ac3f2a84f500185a", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 13, "text": "舉茂才，琬固讓劉邕、陰化、龐延、廖淳，亮教答曰：「思惟背親捨德，以殄百姓，眾人既不隱於心，實又使遠近不解其義，是以君宜顯其功舉，以明此選之清重也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "985533e6a3a1aad70bfd492bc353acc6646a7bcd74f4eefc384eb4110a9d0430"}

{"id": "p_aad88bca30b3c98c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 14, "text": "五年，亮住漢中，琬與長史張裔統留府事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "a583ade096eae8542c35a1b9f64f496f10a69dce4c6fc24cee2fa2fb2384e2c3"}

{"id": "p_0dd33cb73e284740", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 15, "text": "八年，代裔為長史，加撫軍將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "f230f420b2174ee6cf77283922bc76b036fb951ee159d85964977a26b8da7b94"}

{"id": "p_c9a5af2107408006", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 16, "text": "亮數外出，琬常足食足兵以相供給。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "0aad9ed3d10b6a177e6cd27f3136c1832df28802591629bec406484a4687a84e"}

{"id": "p_afb596c73a48afcd", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 17, "text": "亮每言：「公琰托志忠雅，當與吾共贊王業者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "f6c4f481fd8011b84237d57746fe0029989caa9218791666b14f46be9d5154c8"}

{"id": "p_70633c5ea03e6424", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 18, "text": "」密表後主曰：「臣若不幸，後事宜以付琬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "02a3009adf35db01eb1b144cb95a0786add4dfd7d267e89954968a48af8646c7"}

{"id": "p_41a3ea103be9bf2c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 19, "text": "亮卒，以琬為尚書令，俄而加行都護、假節、領益州刺史、遷大將軍、錄尚書事、封安陽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "c3973e59171095378321cc08715f1f91b5cb59a12e792e9b11b5b72b18bbc1c7"}

{"id": "p_49064b53833e071b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 20, "text": "琬出類拔萃，處群僚之右，既無戚容，又無喜色，神守舉止，有如平日，由是眾望漸服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "7905b5df9f40e349c77ef75b45edd382c1d8b9ed96b09f2816a6fbb1d558bdc5"}

{"id": "p_c240beba21518f30", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 21, "text": "延熙元年，詔琬曰：「寇難未弭，曹睿驕凶，遼東三郡勞其暴虐，遂相糾結，與之離隔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "76abee265b7f238c285437c78973e82db0a8115c8bfc50ec6cd6cf599b523087"}

{"id": "p_dfa52d159dddb86f", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 22, "text": "囊秦之亡，勝、廣首難，今有此變，斯乃天時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "45518c1146064ba94b3dfbbfce978b409b454b93349d5d600420bb882b751a79"}

{"id": "p_797af97ce03aa62e", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 23, "text": "君其治嚴，總帥諸軍屯任漢中，須吳舉動，東西掎角，以乘其畔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "1404b6606c9c3ef4d25cd6b48bc64909abfeeae34b7593336032e57d6da83336"}

{"id": "p_2aef549a2e8e0eb2", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」又命琬開府，明年就加為大司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "4f9d0a4c89f386cd56f57c4222323f13fb189e1db28b2487df3796dc4fcdc1a2"}

{"id": "p_6acf1bf041f7fa59", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 25, "text": "東曹掾楊戲索性簡略，琬與言論，時不應答。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "becc3521947f9dfd837484b968622650aa41611e211b4126097e53b106c088f5"}

{"id": "p_dd0ddc8437ecd8ac", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 26, "text": "或欲構戲於琬，曰：「公與戲語而不見應，戲之慢上，不亦甚乎!」琬曰：「人心不同，各如其面；面從後言，古人之所誡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "552bce2174c5dacee89ddd5757c72a6a064267973814b0f6a6c8a8428c8af18f"}

{"id": "p_b8c29df3bbf9eed8", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 27, "text": "戲欲贊吾是耶，則非其本心，欲反吾言，則顯吾之非，是以默然，是戲之快也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "239fd6fcba688aab692312751c090d2fd9165eb7540abd8bb2624ba8ba831af0"}

{"id": "p_df5271a1cebebbc5", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」又督農楊敏曾毀琬，曰：「作事憒憒；誠非及前人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "cd635805ca2ef713c7098acbfe14d8f78cc6ae34a8e3eb4565eeb6bc8a196164"}

{"id": "p_a87ff3e6b417f216", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」或以白琬，主者請推治敏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "2b9a8617059aa3531be90e538198ed573e545948953ce0db054ef7538f985008"}

{"id": "p_e4c31eaea8a7bc86", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 30, "text": "琬曰：「吾實不如前人，無可推也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "27730dd807d0b0fd271359a30270c318a32092e10ba519b11ab5bfa253cf4a4c"}

{"id": "p_2e93f2db5c939ec1", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」主者重據聽不推，則乞問其憒憒之狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "cff9e541ec2f967ace3c46bf62f71c91f25102caa8e234b4869201277304541f"}

{"id": "p_7be4b2104bf5fc35", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 32, "text": "琬曰：「苟其不如，則事不當理，事不當理，則憒憒矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "e4be7681e73e1dd890af9d7113b5e5bd6e13e18b8dd31dc8384755a777c2ab0d"}

{"id": "p_2feffac8faa11b90", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 33, "text": "復何問邪?」後敏坐事繫獄，眾人猶懼其必死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "bfaf3b12441361763f884d8e9d548a03499e81cec846e588084b8cddecbf7d5b"}

{"id": "p_5ecf8780802a14dd", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 34, "text": "琬以為昔諸葛亮數窺秦川，道險運艱，競不能克，不若乘水東下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "02276a5be3f303ac1bd8dac10d342fe37b08edf868ff0d82d88b2cda77ed4b35"}

{"id": "p_092ba095eacea64e", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 35, "text": "乃多作舟船，欲由漢、沔襲魏興、上庸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "c4e7af002af3751acc0738be9b39c3e166e7be1284a9d603019f224a1d9a8227"}

{"id": "p_fe3b8edc1d369fff", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 36, "text": "而眾論鹹謂如不克捷，還路甚難，非長策也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "25e85448457e63e46c96d5f82cf422e8a8035c5c51f1ed38be5634bc9130965a"}

{"id": "p_bc0f53e6a5e22564", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 37, "text": "於是遣尚書令費禕、中監軍姜維等喻指。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "8cce76087b48dc423189be03f0910afff809d0dd8296497311e2793092929c07"}

{"id": "p_7767408d137456f1", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 38, "text": "疾轉增劇，至九年卒，謚曰恭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "8842a2322f74feaaa477b286b30f514812c368e04b0e0f4a35848a4bfd057083"}

{"id": "p_11905702ff9eb418", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 39, "text": "子斌嗣，為綏武將軍、漢城護軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "62c62fa26c5a6e2353cc47b51079e7224024436a27259eb30489537941b1419b"}

{"id": "p_2cf34e2759b2fe9b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 40, "text": "魏大將軍鐘會至漢城，與斌書曰：「巴蜀賢智文武之士多矣，至於足下、諸葛思遠，譬諸草木，吾氣類也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "507bbb084ecd8be33db7b429a3793ec0444dc66d502db897e1d45c5cc79c9b50"}

{"id": "p_24542fd3e0de816c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 41, "text": "西到，欲奉瞻尊大君公侯墓，當灑掃墳塋，奉祠致敬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "b13a0aacd79182ce7fc1f6b3ba993dae725d4c68f4a258d21f87bbf2123d5f1d"}

{"id": "p_286a361387fa0965", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 42, "text": "」斌答書曰：「知惟臭味意眷之隆，雅托通流，未拒來謂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "1c6603bdc732cff881a7a6170bd558852f7f4ff329b0a7562f2d9500b1a2bc29"}

{"id": "p_8b941da5f2918831", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 43, "text": "亡考昔遭疾疢，亡於涪縣，卜-{云}-其吉，遂安厝之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "75afbb95645b9e525044683d59f090d3677a073deaeb4a7c63a03c2e2ffc508c"}

{"id": "p_7099ebe2e3e6a478", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 44, "text": "知君西邁，乃欲屈駕修敬墳墓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "b3dc3c41a8a9f55902cb3c7cc1cc2ce481f1ae7ca7c7b415c21de927c15f7e16"}

{"id": "p_e1fdbc9c2d08ad30", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 45, "text": "視予猶父，顏子之仁也，聞命感愴，以增情思。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "130f234108b7f6e93fb92dc0cae598a8dfcd804162d719013103e1bc57b5817e"}

{"id": "p_5d88b5b853eb54f0", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 46, "text": "」會得斌書報，嘉歎意義，及至涪如其書-{云}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "a00937664ba0cd6831576057c66b23cb3ed19c024372d7d9d012f5e95a0f6aab"}

{"id": "p_d0135684918b6ff7", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 47, "text": "後主既降鄧艾，斌詣會於涪，待以交友之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "566edccfe11dbb4af1a01b975d96a6811a7ed532107464ae3f214c97feb6f1a1"}

{"id": "p_909b8309664a4222", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 48, "text": "隨會至成都，為亂兵所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "aad60c68f29645a6b8563e655bdd21ad30c39f55bfbb60502c7ae9146bbfba61"}

{"id": "p_4fa336c6396eb19a", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 49, "text": "會亦愛其才學，與斌同時死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "30212584d17db6868676afb93bdba44efff60655646e2a92d79fcf3cfb9b0c5e"}

{"id": "p_e8ca43320c49ea3f", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 50, "text": "劉敏，左護軍、揚威將軍，與鎮北大將軍王平懼鎮漢巾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "7f99252a26a9f8449d40710c6eedfa63babefb449faed5d963cad7e1f42e77cc"}

{"id": "p_d8b8bd583627af82", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 51, "text": "魏遣大將軍曹爽襲蜀時，時議者或謂但可守城，不出拒敵，必自引退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "7a44c92ff11ed1ba87eee6f190e63eb81b13ba72347d9644dff9147b16b48712"}

{"id": "p_2628f833368a3468", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 52, "text": "敏以為男女布野，農穀棲畝，若聽敵人，則大事去矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "38f6f9d0d89ef02e606008cbbe5f153fd8280e5b9f9806c85a4e3a128070138e"}

{"id": "p_fc20728df024c2d5", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 53, "text": "遂帥所領與平據興勢，多張旗幟，彌亙百餘里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "3ebc3a37609c280ada81a4682263fe1be0cd24d9ee3638258ab4a6aa27c319e3"}

{"id": "p_52373439b2ff4e5c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 54, "text": "會大將軍費禕從成都至，魏軍即退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "337deda3fb4dacaca4193cdd708c47219b76a73931915e1d85c7e8a772e34dfd"}

{"id": "p_af5c3c5e459a663b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 55, "text": "費禕字文偉，江夏鄳人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "7c5661da28f3aeb1c08181122519ba34ccf2f6529a03c571720af87a77fcee7f"}

{"id": "p_68a7eb45c8e63da4", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 56, "text": "伯仁姑，益州牧劉璋之母也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "65daddc9b782084977088fa91db076b17027d8d76f65f90f0a246f4fa13b415f"}

{"id": "p_86c483f190113298", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 57, "text": "璋遣使迎仁，仁將禕遊學入蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "fa7e7a59be30acf71aaa57023fa1220ac4b30cd839b39c63e6894a7845d4dd45"}

{"id": "p_43c00cd2379bc598", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 58, "text": "會先主定蜀，禕遂留益土，與汝南許叔龍、南郡董允齊名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "43450a000e31328603d0975822cad71fa2d19eb44761eebd89b92fa0773f5e85"}

{"id": "p_043481bba3d66a81", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 59, "text": "時許靖喪子，允與禕欲共會其葬所。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "6aa71b94453c6ff972c7e6ae4c0b8d5d529d4b86ef86ae3c5415dfaa405f78a4"}

{"id": "p_08e628577a471c5d", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 60, "text": "允白父和請車，和遣開後鹿車給之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "e6315aef7673398b53cde2acc786d62b8763bc8dcc3c51537241d6c016f1a2e2"}

{"id": "p_08944fcdfa09321c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 61, "text": "允有難載之色．禕便從前先上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "46674be23c16e599bb7d095ac24df0acff52b3b8cf91774ca5fa5830cf8c459d"}

{"id": "p_7cef6c15c0367fd4", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 62, "text": "及於喪所，諸葛亮及諸貴人悉集，車乘甚鮮，允猶神色未泰，而禕晏然自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "fe4dc510b04aa39e5507d52420ae9c5fc7f0006d1146d892ba042dece1ec2b5a"}

{"id": "p_8d80f47cd916b603", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 63, "text": "持車人還，和問之，知其如此，乃謂允曰：「吾常疑汝於文偉優劣未別也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "a0b8edb4b445ba33297f3d34bcf709ccccb311697c42ec2eabfd09d2a6539a0c"}

{"id": "p_77198099f461f19c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 64, "text": "先主立太子，禕與允為舍人，遷庶子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "07e991bfa5c39752b293f55f0a946d906bb95c26ead9965bda220e4164df20f1"}

{"id": "p_47e99fa67e1d75d9", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 65, "text": "丞相亮南征還，群僚於數十里逢迎，年位多在禕右，而亮特命禕同載，由是眾人莫不易觀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "b7dac80a7c7b56e29d49c6f7cf0bdb16727a8edcc2a32514b43a05f4b379ef74"}

{"id": "p_9cbc1266b1fab1c0", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 66, "text": "亮以初從南歸，以禕為昭信校尉使吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "0b8f08b5400c568d1547303273fc233fd1b5e83331f4dfe12eb8ecf722a9e357"}

{"id": "p_59a1b33b323b8d8b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 67, "text": "孫權性既滑稽，嘲啁無方，諸葛恪、羊衜等才博果辯，論難鋒至，禕辭順義篤，據理以答，終不能屈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "926cbb5e34b7213aaafd42d242879383c328f439ba1e25ac9883b7a705084008"}

{"id": "p_9950a649f03f8fa1", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 68, "text": "權甚器之，謂禕曰：「君天下淑德，必當股肱蜀朝，恐不能數來也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "b5a43a75cd0252c7f410ef1edd65d5bb8653e95a2cf5cca75c216ff185026b5a"}

{"id": "p_ee2c39d3cbdca2d3", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 69, "text": "亮住北住漢中，請禕為參軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "318314c0d22590c138434d8ef78e531c7ff8c58ae2c4d399e5467c0c7e024b7e"}

{"id": "p_7adfa81697734a52", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 70, "text": "，轉為中護軍，後又為司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "3719bb946b4a20fe91da03e9b00ed6d69dfbe790fe0b9f3a3b84cf09d35205bf"}

{"id": "p_737623f84261a192", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 71, "text": "值軍師魏延與長史楊儀相憎惡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "a9dc45d017d7d5ce707727d6d95e4ae35123838d3c7ad9ad394e9121cbd99163"}

{"id": "p_2d4ee3a22e7bbf2f", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 72, "text": "每至並坐爭論，延或舉刀擬儀，儀泣涕橫集。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "693c70431fdb5b487bcaaf0b346aed82de25ad4f898e96065a1069b7c4173e67"}

{"id": "p_76b84b38ad4a2743", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 73, "text": "禕常入其坐間，諫喻分別，終亮之世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "fedb5ae4c9c07184aa1c2093acf7287ac096a6810ec4d8dea9fa3c05f9bee2e7"}

{"id": "p_10926eb0c3fc3ea9", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 74, "text": "各盡延、儀之用者，禕匡救之力也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "857cbe4b6da943465c2550839c89f963d7dbf7102a4f55beae81fffd874d7182"}

{"id": "p_9143472500c871db", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 75, "text": "琬自漢中還涪，禕遷大將軍，錄尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "dbb2da97cc46190738bdf36760695b461a5366a6bd36d1b97a1b4996dfb2185f"}

{"id": "p_3b14783f47cf8d74", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 76, "text": "，魏軍次於興勢，假禕節，率眾往御之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "818cb00f4eaa3738bdf453d60f122037444ee781548a45fe51a7da338c42d647"}

{"id": "p_90a4b7cd1994ed6b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 77, "text": "光祿大夫來敏至禕許別，求共圍棋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "39fde9b7f3a06082ef7048a677c2b0cc8712e9fe5a1f75431d860708acb8ad54"}

{"id": "p_0f8be1abd8e60962", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 78, "text": "於時羽檄交馳，人馬擐甲，嚴駕已訖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "4b50671b8a7ec8306b7e9498c528d1ec8a441b9e9cf2a8df629666d218809c6d"}

{"id": "p_2a93578185b726ba", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 79, "text": "禕與敏留意對戲，色無厭倦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "aaf39aa4c22f2fb9b1548aab9bae5449852ae00ce2500ea47207f685e9f5f160"}

{"id": "p_53e010988e591a2d", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 80, "text": "敏曰：「向聊觀試君耳!君信可人，必能辦賊者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "d675236a1632551da8f0292a60aa51fb49f2c45eb8db61804e4d7ceef7d21fa0"}

{"id": "p_07559d7e4040a671", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 81, "text": "」禕至，敵遂退，封成鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "6798907ae7c9b758072cf68900eafa7155dd0fd51bb2afaae321d4a7f5f8ae57"}

{"id": "p_ab13525c915c80e2", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 82, "text": "琬固讓州職，禕復領益州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "4f01c2241c504401d7b7c3ae7e3c38e8c0c7997f100016c867eca26c62119b0e"}

{"id": "p_bcb2060ba990083b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 83, "text": "十一年，出住漢中，自琬及禕，雖自身在外，慶賞刑威，皆遙先咨斷然，後乃行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "80956692f3c1ec9a58afc87ced4e1a5230f41001052e6fb6998eaf0bd9d9fe3c"}

{"id": "p_026d38bfa241fa39", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 84, "text": "後十四年夏，還成都，成都望氣者-{云}-都邑無宰相位，故冬復比屯漢壽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "5b44c9cb77b0f923614eabbec2ba11762bfb38bb7b746f6e886de67b7a07ffa0"}

{"id": "p_8f0513404dea06c5", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 85, "text": "十六年歲首大會，魏降人郭循在坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "272415a948580eced79cef51bfff529ad264491d3b746fa8e3ba2eb672d037d9"}

{"id": "p_690cd849e9411f47", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 86, "text": "禕歡飲沉醉，為循手刃所害，謚曰敬侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "02f0db521045db2419b047a7cef01610289a721c54d92ffd93efe5c563303a5c"}

{"id": "p_90eb9723b883ae1b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 87, "text": "子承嗣，為黃門侍郎，承弟恭，尚公主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "42a2bdf16c75cc5c33acf771a516ce31cadeb40ced36b6d748c14e533445b698"}

{"id": "p_dfa48c0d2d0d7755", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 88, "text": "姜維，字伯約，天水冀人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "2a16c644b9e74e5170847bbbd5693755109494531d63db26ec9fe95f9900c635"}

{"id": "p_009009bbfb01c517", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 89, "text": "少孤，與母居，好鄭氏學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "76f57385b0dc62a59b8b8e4773f8ce2ffeab5c4950fbf06ec0656e9ddf576d66"}

{"id": "p_68a4af69a3ee7003", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 90, "text": "仕郡上計掾，州闢為從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "e9ef5a6a76db5b5dda57e715390dcee1798878d973ac5fce2071f641fbe7b9e2"}

{"id": "p_9ab3f28068f7789c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 91, "text": "以父冏昔為郡功曹，值羌、戎叛亂，身衛郡將，沒於戰場，賜維官中郎，參本郡軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "79b9df2143e1fecbac9d78e9a1eb3641ef7319f9a34a954667ff319aa60dd94d"}

{"id": "p_3c6719b43362d120", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 92, "text": "，丞相諸葛亮軍向祁山，時天水太守適出案行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "af9b2695d4435d1fac62bc936b9289b46c4d67f76b4cfc96293b4fee3dd59143"}

{"id": "p_f4b18bb724bffd0e", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 93, "text": "維及功曹梁緒、主簿尹賞、主記梁虔等從行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "0c51ea332bca13a27ded2b03a482a12d259cbe542c374ea43d48b6b51c91433a"}

{"id": "p_0eafdb173c0d2f28", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 94, "text": "太守聞蜀軍垂至而諸縣響應，疑維等皆有異心，於是夜亡保上邽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "06115591bda411da478d44cfa5d4e9becb69fe9e03237c5ea3adbdc3b1f0e202"}

{"id": "p_b955b69496170617", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 95, "text": "維等覺太守去，追遲，至城門，城門已閉，不納。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "088aa0fdd3d09e29d2f7064ee61b12aa8b233ea48dc41bc6551ac35a7367c7ea"}

{"id": "p_e89d562dfa66c65b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 96, "text": "維等相率還冀，冀亦不入維。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "0f48cbfe29bf1e2b3a5cb15f2ac90fb40d913e3d90b4212fce10d25b446e99dc"}

{"id": "p_fdc186692789cd8f", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 97, "text": "亮拔將西縣千餘家及維等還，故維遂與母相失。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "436dc54a619899a9b72dc90b8241e284094f8ce513cf4e91fdfa5162e8061d07"}

{"id": "p_f0c102c79a2f0e72", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 98, "text": "亮辟維為倉曹掾，加奉義將軍，封當陽亭侯，時年二十七。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "c8e113fc1df4dc3d1a80b093b1c2818ffb88e82d15399d6bdd1c5965308e32bb"}

{"id": "p_7a1fab3b1e36ccf3", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 99, "text": "亮與留府長史張裔、參軍蔣琬書曰：「姜伯約忠勤時事，思慮精密，考其所有，永南、季常諸人不如也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "8a93a32fe21e67065400ccbde9d3d5fae19867d43982d07ad22b10cf76bf2f87"}

{"id": "p_8090a3d3a248bd3d", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 100, "text": "」又曰：「須先教中虎步兵五六千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "2f2c11981e3e22b6bf28947526e3a1db42c4e3881296019723d46c03e1187b84"}

{"id": "p_1d717a6936ea3273", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 101, "text": "姜伯約甚敏於軍事，既有膽義，深解兵意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "263fd45705292e43364e777b1b68a6b3a0d3869947ef99d5bf6359cf72f49525"}

{"id": "p_677467f6ab897410", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 102, "text": "此人心存漢室而才兼於人，畢教軍事，當遣詣宮，覲見主上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "10c41dd7b0344de7efa2e5a9ca8059dcf72a05301daa901475df44f5b8558eb9"}

{"id": "p_220519a3484707ac", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 103, "text": "」後遷中監軍、征西將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "c922208aa93fc5a77b63b27f3010ae09d05f572311c3d356499e47b0feb73f1c"}

{"id": "p_eb3fe8ef9af626a7", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 104, "text": "十二年，亮卒，維還成都，為右監軍、輔漢將軍，統諸軍，進封平襄侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "58723054e2f1aefbdd5cc5d63e7cb696c275bf30f51326c4ae923360fa980b3d"}

{"id": "p_a639d425d0661f94", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 105, "text": "延熙元年，隨大將軍蔣琬住漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "6af4ed8443c690fba2a3fa57425e348b09196be4e7da1b5ed0e648a784a95656"}

{"id": "p_de5d0544c9332c33", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 106, "text": "以維為司馬，數率偏軍西入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "2d0ea754df859932f43a7da32fdce5c4a1a4ab3728836c465a99f827da517eaf"}

{"id": "p_79c1cdef7b730f0d", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 107, "text": "六年，遷鎮西大將軍，領涼州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "b357ca287abf610d531c70f229e0fc2e1f7d6bca692011dd4bd0a6489a1deee7"}

{"id": "p_4cc9ef0c9dae246a", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 108, "text": "十年，遷衛將軍，與大將軍費禕共錄尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "d2d7438859c54ce3d750cacc37f1747cb15c502b1c3d4d2cc7e796c32065fd4a"}

{"id": "p_4d2d2ae727712f69", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 109, "text": "是歲，漢山平康夷反，維率眾討定之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "9d1b76859bd532f2e5c661841e2cacd75cfcd56de5569b0dd2ce0cb3998e9375"}

{"id": "p_9b5707b1959f7a4f", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 110, "text": "又出隴西、南安、金城界，與魏大將軍郭淮、夏侯霸等戰於洮西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "d943e6bcf130dccd0d2bbbce343ae9847019bc16dae84f3d640a89c6dbaacc71"}

{"id": "p_0004b340b4056425", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 111, "text": "胡王治無戴等舉部落降，維將還安處之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "53bfc86b32ec1356860eb90a922cec89b1f4dc06628c03bd27bc3ed164294b25"}

{"id": "p_fe2dbb6f1281bc21", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 112, "text": "十二年，假維節復出西平，不克而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "1712fe1c2306464698f5fd179096d15a8177a049e930c73e89bf94acd538e38e"}

{"id": "p_43e83a1d4453b955", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 113, "text": "維自以練西方風俗，兼負其才武，欲誘諸羌、胡以為羽翼，謂自隴以西可斷而有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "77d41a41a09fa71b22d92adcf870b3d9e5f445c0904fa33e9610a9b17bd7eb7d"}

{"id": "p_b20303ef38bb067e", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 114, "text": "每欲興軍大舉，費禕常裁製不從，與其兵不過萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "121cd47ac164c73f395389875c48b96cedf1aece49589ec38a86fe2dca3ccbe2"}

{"id": "p_3eaf944aa546fcd0", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 115, "text": "夏，維率數萬人出石營，經董亭，圍南安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "b6f6fcebc95ab43cd0c4add8a6adbccce5655c729eb6ab1c9b70ce7600880639"}

{"id": "p_abe3b6635d0e3054", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 116, "text": "魏雍州刺史陳泰解圍至洛門，維糧盡退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "d48feec0d00d89ae2767bccbea5415c8629541070d85f135a4e9e26eec859586"}

{"id": "p_fdb329b807ddc6ce", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 117, "text": "復出隴西，守狄道長李簡舉城降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "ad885fa20d1ec0c4f12a242778b7dd0d1bf4eb77f046bf16cc96ff26e81eec74"}

{"id": "p_95b913ac2942ec12", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 118, "text": "進圍襄武，與魏將徐質交鋒，斬首破敵，魏軍敗退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "730bfd690a48fca0ed430e55473d27487e466ff137542ebb01bb2df6a91adba3"}

{"id": "p_02c46aa58065fd4f", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 119, "text": "維乘勝多所降下，拔河間狄道、臨洮三縣民還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "a9500cd604c75b85e1ff7d66bb7ec94d682e370af15835940ebc22976e30ce21"}

{"id": "p_3506554dcfe9a732", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 120, "text": "後十八年，復與車騎將軍夏侯霸等俱出狄道，大破魏雍州刺史王經於洮西，經眾死者數萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "40db11204bb7a6d236595253389c269b08c8bf076a63ff29647552c8fa19e60e"}

{"id": "p_f6fe9329eec21f40", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 121, "text": "魏徵西將軍陳泰進兵解圍，維卻住鐘題。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "2ebb13728e6157b4ea4ebf4519f5d102382e7d151939fbeb642fe50f44ee3baa"}

{"id": "p_a604cb429ee5cdf4", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 122, "text": "十九年春，就遷維為大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "e73943812220320695ff4364195b1d4065c95e1f52991e7187b233fbddaba6d0"}

{"id": "p_568039c26c168af1", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 123, "text": "更整勒戎馬，與鎮西大將軍胡濟期會上邽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "2568ff0732ed527694340e22492b1ccc02489d7fc77e1ce8812c31a27b653ed3"}

{"id": "p_f7305d977275b243", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 124, "text": "濟失誓不至，故維為魏大將鄧艾所破於段谷，星散流離，死者甚眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "150c0d62d592e921dc84b0f9e722c9fe3422acbe55d1a0d51b452215b564b629"}

{"id": "p_d47212747f5a4a34", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 125, "text": "眾庶由是怨讟，而隴以西亦騷動不寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "dfec989cc261b4ecd610cbda93c0e79f561811abd24264cfd4f0ef4c827868cc"}

{"id": "p_4fede78c2cd65a6e", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 126, "text": "二十年，魏徵東大將軍諸葛誕反於淮南，分關中兵東下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "e491ba3e27d8b8bd563a5160f54b8ae39d6eadaaf3de930d88a0df9addb11673"}

{"id": "p_aa4446d788233fb6", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 127, "text": "維欲乘虛向秦川，復率數萬人出駱谷，逕至沈嶺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "bff243038a649620729b9739fadd08b33492d90465a831b7249b6e62aa637661"}

{"id": "p_ea45c52f3671698a", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 128, "text": "時長城積穀甚多而守兵乃少，聞維方到眾皆惶懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "e8135f976775233777b6358ecadf1a14be2f2e5f5260a82fc2ea014eb7caeedf"}

{"id": "p_48fd72fbf17d042b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 129, "text": "魏大將軍司馬望拒之，鄧艾亦自隴右，皆軍於長城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "f1c0791ba7320bc093d27630cbed31e68116fbad24fabcd90304f4f41896b554"}

{"id": "p_09d8bec233ec2566", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 130, "text": "維前住芒水，皆倚山為營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "c4cbc3d591414c930d4644fb29930dd190aec93e67ffe8274a019b54e5818377"}

{"id": "p_56a4d67924af2cfc", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 131, "text": "望、艾傍渭堅圍，維數下挑戰，望、艾不應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "9cc01779d89ee3f9ed1d1242463a69ec3ac22138bbfb7b96e76d764c762c81dc"}

{"id": "p_505dd2bdc0ca8900", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 132, "text": "，維聞誕破敗，乃還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "fcee493a782a6e82815dd3071931b242aaa4e8b587b62dcc2b1c66aa3ef5c140"}

{"id": "p_241a66dff017ad50", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 133, "text": "初，先主留魏延鎮漢中，皆實兵諸圍以御外敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "ab9abd1db96b7b8dd368dec0a5ad26200befd93d65883cd9ab457461115b2c42"}

{"id": "p_6a8ed5a52043fe7e", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 134, "text": "及興勢之役，王平捍拒曹爽，皆承此制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "c71f256a3ef9c36614bcc4f0b2cc652800fb479f4cc3ad6d06b40f8a1a662959"}

{"id": "p_70fd7cff727cb903", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 135, "text": "維建議，以為錯守諸圍，雖合《周易》「重門」之義，然適可禦敵，不獲大利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "e6fc9bb65cfee9642c35fed4fd9459c873b3a16e4b39eda8c2df2f4d1f2b10ab"}

{"id": "p_5c702a1c1224490c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 136, "text": "不若使聞敵至，諸圍皆斂兵聚谷，退就漢、樂二城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "b0afdfd14f85f3396909fb4c874c2a0b8c5ae279b872b431f354ab2a484edc6f"}

{"id": "p_a67e5fa1b93b9e55", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 137, "text": "使敵不得入平，臣重關鎮守以捍之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "4835563a3acd890912766af78f8ec9f62b43d6a67a722d099d1ec163156afe55"}

{"id": "p_5c747831a0a49230", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 138, "text": "有事之日，令遊軍並進以伺其虛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "4c2f21ecccf26aa3516f0c80732beda49d556b3596efeb6b6dbb613ea126735f"}

{"id": "p_110000d257cd9142", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 139, "text": "敵攻關不克，野無散谷，千里縣糧，自然疲乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "69f21bf06cdd61500b3e7fb0c6f038404f444239705038cab7ca5b0b35c1ffa4"}

{"id": "p_9bced89cc34d40bf", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 140, "text": "引退之日，然後諸城並出，與遊軍並力搏之，此殄敵之術也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "f1a880c81a646ef259881f7215da1ba93afd4a048b3201e0415f14e39288e929"}

{"id": "p_e59379c3890ebacd", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 141, "text": "於是令督漢中胡濟卻住漢壽，監軍王含守樂城，護軍蔣斌守漢城，又於西安、建威、武衛、石門、武城、建昌、臨遠皆立圍守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "de3be7c9437af81e6a151a3a0c0b17924ed14c7939007c342700d3025d7fc371"}

{"id": "p_766e2a1ef4156ec5", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 142, "text": "五年，維率眾出漢、侯和，為鄧艾所破，還住沓中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "a3a222296a50ffb333454ad58ed4869f51d98feb048f9b119ac24002651ef292"}

{"id": "p_fe7c44c688e17b4b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 143, "text": "維本羈旅托國，累年攻戰，功績不立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "2cf50b78acb5cb834a53ac974f3bed0b0e3352097eb3225b7899b3582c837519"}

{"id": "p_9f990b25ea357afb", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 144, "text": "而宦官黃皓等弄權於內，右大將軍閻宇與皓協比，而皓陰欲廢維樹宇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "cfb3a8b8f69a0b1db7c678e9a868a643a6d00dcf24407c302533636775c8e5d4"}
