{"id": "p_77249191c196754e", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 145, "text": "維亦疑之，故自危懼，不復還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "4d18c6bde14ccdf83bd89d0fae564eb2c6056766a61e65aba5574b1ec265129e"}

{"id": "p_2eccdd0d5882243c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 146, "text": "六年，維表後主：「聞鐘會治兵關中，欲規進取，宜並遣張翼、廖化詣督堵軍分護陽安關口、陰平橋頭，以防未然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "8b6617fc558fee575029d0798338335f733ddb9bab1404f57a369d4ddc6ba902"}

{"id": "p_23663b8df3b5efaf", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」皓徵信鬼巫，謂敌終不自致。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "5e0219edb8e7c1a819d1765a2b4d4d7f66b813fa44fb2511fdd7ccdb372d2e5a"}

{"id": "p_e98e7109376d1db4", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 148, "text": "啟後主寢其事，而群臣不知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "ed78e7856e1e54e687a36d30e3fb193443acb553ce6ed0fe62d44c48fe986fd5"}

{"id": "p_9f74fd721527e057", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 149, "text": "及鐘會將向駱谷，鄧艾將入沓中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "1acbe952cdd9ccdfd0aaa2f5cd722fc4293afae189bbcfbbd98a0a0b89bf62fa"}

{"id": "p_b48dfb00b1fb1a17", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 150, "text": "然後乃遣右車騎廖化詣沓中為維援，左車騎張翼、輔國大將軍董厥等詣陽安關口以為諸圍外助。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "c59ddcf50250dea997b6ca5fd94a2eb0d90246bd3c7418ac0681e0b2132afcff"}

{"id": "p_ade4df6d9e7cc699", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 151, "text": "比至陰平，聞魏將諸葛緒向建威，故住待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "098521560e9b045ae7fe2d16b72036433f5d74d683f713301d041b2cd53cf348"}

{"id": "p_13821d99bc634001", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 152, "text": "月餘，維為鄧艾所摧，還住陰平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "f924017b5c24c62b69f4f832a316699aac159fc5323428fde6475a185cd1fd49"}

{"id": "p_24e26f3c5083257d", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 153, "text": "鐘會攻圍漢、樂二城，遣別將進攻關口，蔣舒開城出降，傅僉格鬥而死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "54a149ac37db9c2fdf637face5c34fe1c97b0a98dea4bed9b734b5a78a5f5180"}

{"id": "p_86047c4bb56cadd7", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 154, "text": "聞關口已下，長驅而前，翼、厥甫至漢壽，維、化亦捨陰平而退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "b11a1c259ead65d303702c33143015ab44d516d3c1578dbd9947c5029a3bb9c1"}

{"id": "p_c1b80e296fdea695", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 155, "text": "適與翼、厥合，皆退保劍閣以拒會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "0bcfa2e2b59535dc2ccd6bc1db8e298db7f54befd41d315239e77673f021c92c"}

{"id": "p_e909b00d468e696d", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 156, "text": "會與維書曰：「公侯以文武之德，懷邁世之略，功濟巴、漢、聲暢華夏，遠近莫不歸名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "1451de1d1b5ce450f19b9398ec52e77dc4719507f81d197ddeaed13ba5b17588"}

{"id": "p_cfafc5ebd8a1f6ea", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 157, "text": "每惟疇昔，嘗同大化，吳札、鄭喬，能喻斯好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "60e44a8af3e9bcb67808b76c0d844eabed67534296478a5005a8423e79de6093"}

{"id": "p_cf83b84dd5e294f1", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 158, "text": "會不能克，糧運縣遠，將議還歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "7852bc79933aaebf173d7fed32acbbfa04cde963aa98b0c93a2a92eb81677952"}

{"id": "p_0e0dd58343ecc230", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 159, "text": "而鄧艾自陰平由景谷道傍入，遂破諸葛瞻於綿竹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "42ce2191010b9357008fe2de1b177b2469e44b8e7905a2532416b8882aec1690"}

{"id": "p_adbf716ae7328a93", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 160, "text": "後主請降於艾，艾前據成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "4ad7aee53bf176beb016adbb275718e99c351613211e1ffc187d7629671ac266"}

{"id": "p_7c7b3c644d23e0cf", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 161, "text": "維等初聞瞻破，或聞後主欲固守成都，或聞欲東入吳，或聞欲南入建寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "6350dfb91896870d4b1f6611a755d055d1759a9471b0dd6c700c7e81c88f0c64"}

{"id": "p_ae19e6bf3705f6a5", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 162, "text": "於是引軍由廣漢、郪道以審虛實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "d181d5c453df1e51589585c18ccbcbe7aac0961536293511e55c0b254f609e2c"}

{"id": "p_2e27acd9875d5337", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 163, "text": "尋被後主敕令乃投戈放甲，詣會於涪軍前，將士鹹怒，拔刀斫石。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "da36e1533f19d09dd2589e07721889b62cf53c08c92d9ec59472ce26d8768284"}

{"id": "p_5250d52d63dc33cd", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 164, "text": "會厚待維等，皆權還其印號節蓋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "d26409cb513f59abc623aba70ea4273c48067c1d33a4e00a5235b0c484f465a7"}

{"id": "p_3fb725e85585aa40", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 165, "text": "會與維出則同輿，坐則同席，謂長史杜預曰：「以伯約比中土名士，公休、太初不能勝也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "e2a9cff08c34fe893bd648a54b4f69c72dd17cbfde74345bd17a99974e4601c6"}

{"id": "p_b205760ee2a8e672", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」《世語》曰：時蜀官屬皆天下英俊，無出維右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "27b693ca3ad10088a41aacc96224a2c1818d423873b4e9eace1cc886cf70aa9d"}

{"id": "p_52249770d05221c1", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 167, "text": "}}會既構鄧艾，艾檻車征，因將維等詣成都，自稱益州牧以叛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "0e9a81797d112c69e5a81a0e999c4f43079ba1a62da5c4a17af9799558645c33"}

{"id": "p_b1a9643e90c6905c", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 168, "text": "欲授維兵五萬人，使為前驅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "171ec3df6d4f097d5598d96bdfe8b9ce87bdc8076518626cb555f47ae9df49f5"}

{"id": "p_60ee53ffce917a4b", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 169, "text": "魏將士憤發，殺會及維，維妻子皆伏誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "87e5457e1b02b8771ad81433419cc2bec6aa7455eaf7bda5b613a2edb6a5a1f8"}

{"id": "p_0c8aee91761510a1", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 170, "text": "郤正著論論維曰：「姜伯約據上將之重，處群臣之右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "b857588ec041de7390d19cb79997dc4a222d085645be71a8a863cedd2b4515a6"}

{"id": "p_3d1165fe84d5bdbd", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 171, "text": "宅舍弊薄，資財無餘，側室無妾媵之褻，後庭無聲樂之娛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "0828c64d2a70212f0ef4902bed3c8bed058d59636813b3a7a8686c4fdfb00df1"}

{"id": "p_50c15311daacb886", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 172, "text": "衣服取供，輿馬取備，飲食節制，不奢不約，官給費用，隨手消盡；察其所以然者，非以激貪厲濁，抑情自割也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "b956aa475500f15fdbc15c1abf047fc88540eb27547238c4d35795c89085da66"}

{"id": "p_2426d7479f165135", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 173, "text": "直謂如是為足，不在多求。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "138562d945693d401b089f420d5194400523751d7cee1eea864e573f5abaebaa"}

{"id": "p_12e860f6f47bba2e", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 174, "text": "凡人之談，常譽成毀敗，扶高抑下，鹹以姜維投厝無所，身死宗滅，以是貶削，不復料擿，異乎《春秋》褒貶之義矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "b1b2070ad29f959d03f6683ee339085d566b3a02283d0aa27e116a3c66d9d3af"}

{"id": "p_28d8f15aea97bfa1", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 175, "text": "如姜維之樂學不倦，清素節約，自一時之儀表也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "6c62b21f3542ef852907c3c485dbd5fc98b7c9143b0f6aefc169d7f1d97bffd8"}

{"id": "p_deb907abf912f582", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 176, "text": "」維昔所俱至蜀，梁緒官至大鴻臚，尹賞執金吾，梁虔大長秋，皆先蜀亡沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "3d5b5faad1f34759976e469c80cadda92e3e89ebeb59460281db2cf67f6cac44"}

{"id": "p_ef6f32e3c8941394", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 177, "text": "評曰：蔣琬方整有威重，費禕寬濟而博愛，咸承諸葛之成規，因循而不革，是以邊境無虞，邦家和一，然猶未盡治小之宜，居靜之理也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "7b214d66c2beebb3582b9f97649da2c7bedaf3d2717ff4e8099f8080f5577113"}

{"id": "p_bcac33803d1a5963", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 178, "text": "姜維粗有文武，志立功名，而玩眾黷旅，明斷不周，終致隕斃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "a3f75b1c19f55fc110879befc02b577c9d87b336c3cfb8311561d33a97b4865b"}

{"id": "p_ead95ffb9204b77e", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 179, "text": "老子有云：「治大國者猶烹小鮮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "6b27087f94412432e4e7c2df496588d5aba94aa3110b92fe72eff62ca3cb1d12"}

{"id": "p_8a09521663dc38d0", "source_id": "src_3606155c35fc19fd", "ordinal": 180, "text": "」況於區區蕞爾，而可屢擾乎哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "8596b5dd59658ec90f386b9b5cb67b111383e61faa5dbebbd0978a6c74aa114a"}

{"id": "p_94ac09c14d8e5e91", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_8bdfb9a60e9ea61f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 1, "text": "鄧芝字伯苗，義陽新野人，漢司徒禹之後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "3d4aa446af4c18b7895525da581549882600d54ff14f5d9202369e23b5a9726f"}

{"id": "p_41904ad876aaa545", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 2, "text": "時益州從事張裕善相，芝往從之，裕謂芝曰：「君年過七十，位至大將軍，封侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "5c1a96e7a634ab47aaba87c7d7af678856431a83529eac7d73fb6e4f47f4317e"}

{"id": "p_8d4d22ec0d6010e3", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 3, "text": "」芝聞巴西太守龐羲好士，往依焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "74e54e6a5924db7d7d8d479cec2ef334f36134892cc29781e4c7fd9e4b7306e8"}

{"id": "p_104f1598c7fffe9c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 4, "text": "先主定益州，芝為郫邸閣督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "7623546b4a18213675b74f32f2370be0c698b3d76446446d4f9390c2396d5be1"}

{"id": "p_f2ded155ec0c8f22", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 5, "text": "先主出至郫，與語，大奇之，擢為郫令，遷廣漢太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "7c029dd2b816bb10291bc9572001e3b7b25e011968954309717270fe578fb875"}

{"id": "p_9e8bb7046924a6ac", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 6, "text": "所在清嚴有治績，入為尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "cf0e99a7fc5e2dda99dfad57844e9bacc03a1266fad3d5a5ae8232b5e5d0ef58"}

{"id": "p_66e1b264f9f36717", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 7, "text": "先是，吳王孫權請和，先主累遣宋瑋、費禕等與相報答。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "faa8c2571907a1335bdc8ad60274ef5a9476b4419d41760d98ac2dac4efbe5fc"}

{"id": "p_c7601400db28d8f3", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 8, "text": "丞相諸葛亮深慮權聞先主殂隕，恐有異計，未知所如。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "ffed8df2573de41209f4fa81b787f69b5d53c4dc29c25c4d088c37adf74421a0"}

{"id": "p_1745f0afb860b9e8", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 9, "text": "芝見亮曰：「今主上幼弱，初在位，宜遣大使重申吳好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "43cd553829aae3cef078f5aaa6b95a24d56f999f22803bd2887f7dc2b3664822"}

{"id": "p_b702c9b7c42203bb", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」亮答之曰：「吾思之久矣，未得其人耳，今日始得之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "7283a3c4901395a34b80d55552160322f829ddc1b742b1ace0950e64052871fb"}

{"id": "p_72728eb4665266f7", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 11, "text": "權果狐疑，不時見芝，芝乃自表請見權曰：「臣今來亦欲為吳，非但為蜀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "91d316f9010378ff3b3e3c872cd436aaa4585a91a092142e4c6ce74549ae52cc"}

{"id": "p_c46300eb7cf7ed6b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」權乃見之，語芝曰：「孤誠原與蜀和親，然恐蜀主幼弱，國小勢偪，為魏所乘，不自保全，以此猶豫耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "f043f66bfe8aeb86fc76d7c5e6e0ee81d8f1d773cd606ed674ffbff25ab079b3"}

{"id": "p_e14bbbc92a0f88f1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 13, "text": "」芝對曰：「吳、蜀二國四州之地，大王命世之英，諸葛亮亦一時之傑也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "5febfcd7abe0b842147f61ee4d179a68eae89171349df46063723d3e52dfc8e4"}

{"id": "p_a82a27e113f8d1e9", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 14, "text": "蜀有重險之固，吳有三江之阻，合此二長，共為脣齒，進可並兼天下，退可鼎足而立，此理之自然也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "c72ccecf45e8f41fc6937f4df9520380b278f024e29f92d40ed95951c536eb3b"}

{"id": "p_3d773778f872d764", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 15, "text": "大王今若委質於魏，魏必上望大王之入朝，下求太子之內侍，若不從命，則奉辭伐叛，蜀必順流見可而進，如此，江南之地非複大王之有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "5850f2227e46887ffc81e66e451ff833b5719956841cf9e0347fe2a95bfc61c3"}

{"id": "p_e5b9c5254306a336", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 16, "text": "」權默然良久曰：「君言是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "78416c28b21128eae34ac4dd1447cd56ea8c54250f32f1c4028e803cf4ec669f"}

{"id": "p_3aeb2448b80ecde4", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 17, "text": "」遂自絕魏，與蜀連和，遣張溫報聘於蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "022224162fda8b3f0c6e2d9891dbdef26fcf04758730516c06214d0708519391"}

{"id": "p_167bafd491466b64", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 18, "text": "蜀復令芝重往，權謂芝曰：「若天下太平，二主分治，不亦樂乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "8c2f225ceae2c2e1c773c6b7bae1f74eec2c9c474524baafbbb4f671172f0ce7"}

{"id": "p_ff396a557590c12e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」芝對曰：「夫天無二日，土無二王，如並魏之後，大王未深識天命者也，君各茂其德，臣各盡其忠，將提枹鼓，則戰爭方始耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "d16cb58807a8955211881ad2d355fe2674dcc8f3302c57d1f25c054c196a8aa4"}

{"id": "p_ed89384b9d13746d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 20, "text": "」權大笑曰：「君之誠款，乃當爾邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "379703aeca35e6245cd00138d7e62217cbeeb63ebfca0fab320129f5eefc0314"}

{"id": "p_7da45bc214133797", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 21, "text": "」權與亮書曰：「丁厷掞張，陰化不盡；和合二國，唯有鄧芝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "ed735cdf7ec505afdb9d161e00ae8ffb1f810c4e76fc170f8b2df4321999180d"}

{"id": "p_ab7a9147585c1c43", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 22, "text": "」及亮北住漢中，以芝為中監軍、揚武將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "66a8090d2af6011972148a81e63b324dab46fb468abc8b98d43b9a2b9e68fd6d"}

{"id": "p_34484f4acd2d9cfc", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 23, "text": "亮卒，遷前軍師前將軍，領袞州刺史，封陽武亭侯，頃之為督江州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "0d49094459668758bdfc5a2e0922e090a76a5b89b1e8d9dabf945ab9a597a48f"}

{"id": "p_248a89db80f757b1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 24, "text": "權數與芝相聞，饋遺優渥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "94101589980afa167c2f05d5b9493aa441483a513cc717d574cf0f90518e8c24"}

{"id": "p_092835018334376d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 25, "text": "，就遷為車騎將軍，後假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "faa5b315e502a02322bc4e026291977ee4b7e41a873cd10298bd8c013f031850"}

{"id": "p_d1438d07d79af3e8", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 26, "text": "十一年，涪陵國人殺都尉反叛，芝率軍征討，即梟其渠帥，百姓安堵，十四年卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "8d32d2169c76cde3478d073c4d71b0e4e06a4d6b789249c3923e96b2bb187d32"}

{"id": "p_100418d634b574f7", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 27, "text": "芝為（大）將軍二十餘年，賞罰明斷，善卹卒伍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "9fd3d13d8232eeda037971e8d869345939a6172e161a7cace8d7d79afa7b2b70"}

{"id": "p_9af9af1993002476", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 28, "text": "身之衣食資仰於官，不苟素儉，然終不治私產，妻子不免飢寒，死之日家無餘財。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "c96489d3d6610d12dfb68314011156087be98c43b21630b461b354ca9306a7d2"}

{"id": "p_14c0560756e6be63", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 29, "text": "性剛簡，不飾意氣，不得士類之和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "e34b7ed57dd2ae23d69a8697b2d32a011fe5166f4295c1234215e8a2357e10ad"}

{"id": "p_d0fbed2b0f0def7e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 30, "text": "於時人少所敬貴，唯器異姜維雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "dd0817d0ef105dd755de4d3b2e76a0af6430fe219a7dbd85435f24468b4d1641"}

{"id": "p_2fed6944e3f22a13", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 31, "text": "子良，襲爵，景耀中為尚書左選郎，晉朝廣漢太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "3d8a85676e0707b42f6b898483f4eaf814a4b54bd563e5f1adb59654e6809aad"}

{"id": "p_e9faa90bf6d1109e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 32, "text": "張翼字伯恭，犍為武陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "3978d3c23ade14dcb0684efea474413cd50562692e790e4331a0bfedf312fed4"}

{"id": "p_3832f6b6e0b9f89c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 33, "text": "高祖父司空浩，曾祖父廣陵太守綱，皆有名跡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "64a60b0edb18f6e17e3bdb140b342f8c9599581f3bb4d42e681c7f9450e94860"}

{"id": "p_2a5b3b055e34564e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 34, "text": "先主定益州，領牧，翼為書佐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "b93d2eeb1c393cba4939e846376021166056054ddc1fd71acc6f6e4162bf7880"}

{"id": "p_ac1bf371c57185f9", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 35, "text": "建安末，舉孝廉，為江陽長，徙涪陵令，遷梓潼太守，累遷至廣漢、蜀郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "00e71b699ba2e0c4f1c96315076e154c24b0c2282d8d1053a02d800122881389"}

{"id": "p_022b319f3fbbca7e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 36, "text": "，為庲降都督、綏南中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "9a05efe13c2c60270a28643ec1438fa23728cebdf32250975e2a71e3e2a5d72b"}

{"id": "p_d73d14d6c7094c4c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 37, "text": "翼性持法嚴，不得殊俗之歡心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "5769bfc7d96734af324178185abece22b8c4606076a38614adca86f0fb72336f"}

{"id": "p_ee0e508c630eb8c4", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 38, "text": "耆率劉冑背叛作亂，翼舉兵討冑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "ae320bcad72a8284449aa5003fc842496a02352b38d2c86c50046084f6174721"}

{"id": "p_08f16b351dafc62b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 39, "text": "冑未破，會被徵當還，群下咸以為宜便馳騎即罪，翼曰：「不然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "88e8fbc54fbfb1fb2eadd8f26a95217fe26932e6fc1b521ec90aa10147eaa95d"}

{"id": "p_5e340a2937605031", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 40, "text": "吾以蠻夷蠢動，不稱職故還耳，然代人未至，吾方臨戰場，當運糧積穀，為滅賊之資，豈可以黜退之故而廢公家之務乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "2d55bd052abb1a5cacca82bffa04266dc669008bfaca68527ef9736efe64b39b"}

{"id": "p_916509d09ae843aa", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 41, "text": "」於是統攝不懈，代到乃發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "8751e5821c25b73e387e9a075af402aa22afc36b74cc783f74898292118af11b"}

{"id": "p_5e2313894f8b4980", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 42, "text": "馬忠因其成基以破殄冑，丞相亮聞而善之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "da47dc5e9779eae3045bde2d4dbca028a897cbd907033bb03f9a2b1a41a776d6"}

{"id": "p_a53d9cfbdb664898", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 43, "text": "亮出武功，以翼為前軍都督，領扶風太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "8e38a3c68fa42125b434d779189a67b85fe14a9998f9323643aaa91ed4cc025b"}

{"id": "p_2a6d2901dbb6b061", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 44, "text": "亮卒，拜前領軍，追論討劉冑功，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "99f08f610ecfb3424eb0cdf5cb3c25454eae5b20d825658fff008406100544dc"}

{"id": "p_d7319c5a928ea42b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 45, "text": "，入為尚書，稍遷督建威，假節，進封都亭侯，征西大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "9812e540faea293ad52ed2bf561d72659f3054e624303eebe713b2e45d13b1a6"}

{"id": "p_c50b34c74c3a4522", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 46, "text": "十八年，與衛將軍姜維俱還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "94ebda9bb2742f495c05bcbe4b4e765e997c7b0cb448b492c8206117c235395f"}

{"id": "p_ba4bbe9d51e9c52d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 47, "text": "維議復出軍，唯翼廷爭，以為國小民勞，不宜黷武。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "0d108a49e3cbdf37f111d32047c3b14f529ec897ec1562ccd5b10591529e1fb5"}

{"id": "p_6701a46b845d0e15", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 48, "text": "維不聽，將翼等行，進翼位鎮南大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "58f19d64089fdd6d11bcdbf520cfa36e9ca74596948b8dea8376271d740670fa"}

{"id": "p_c57cae5aa25310f3", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 49, "text": "維至狄道，大破魏雍州刺史王經，經眾死於洮水者以萬計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "580c956bae1e18ed154b5034aaf57b4697226dafe6f16e7ef42719fb158ed601"}

{"id": "p_ae78e18b43b37c6d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 50, "text": "翼曰：「可止矣，不宜復進，進或毀此大功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "175c78cc1dbb1f4d18f52ef916685f320c7cddf7185b877515fc30c9b24d434d"}

{"id": "p_6e94bf3b663d8f4a", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」維竟圍經於狄道，城不能克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "4b5a77109e26f88f4aa676c747090eb7043ed620979559718a6827b72386eaf8"}

{"id": "p_c4fde9512c87347c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 52, "text": "自翼建異論，維心與翼不善，然常牽率同行，翼亦不得已而往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "fb9eb9be808d871e5fa1a439e4fe4e023939f8627feb50718c03b349d0bcf4d3"}

{"id": "p_31383640b7123233", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 53, "text": "，遷左車騎將軍，領冀州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "77c4b17a67ebb0bfbfcef01a8bfc8c95fad47166899fd514f5c36e2b31604c7c"}

{"id": "p_a64cfb4abd826ff3", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 54, "text": "六年，與維咸在劍閣，共詣降鍾會於涪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "0bb015c007f6d5e6619b45a1b54d25babbd7321b64e1ee740b3e91af26284014"}

{"id": "p_d6cbd525ebc3d271", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 55, "text": "明年正月，隨會至成都，為亂兵所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "6f85336167c38dbf94aa23534004da90fe26222c2da83de0b25c254434a3729e"}

{"id": "p_8a740468f85cbd95", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 56, "text": "宗預字德艷，南陽安眾人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "c471b5684dc2e08411cd71b5b13e3ab31fb6b3ac477b29512fc35495a5564e92"}

{"id": "p_1673c0b1eeef3e87", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 57, "text": "建興初，丞相亮以為主簿，遷參軍右中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "e37ffbb420eeb8c3137b56dcdd26468741e6e7a3cca81a172906cc95b0e81a74"}

{"id": "p_c030c20d34f15e38", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 58, "text": "及亮卒，吳慮魏或承衰取蜀，增巴丘守兵萬人，一欲以為救援，二欲以事分割也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "8f20c98e1a04c918e790070b4e6e0d0754a283777c5b6f1510b00bea4164064d"}

{"id": "p_ec43966106bdf7fb", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 59, "text": "蜀聞之，亦益永安之守，以防非常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "aba7063a88572f0ead037541175c0a980621d94526e4ebbedf893fa38f01d1f1"}

{"id": "p_cf6d6115261bb6b5", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 60, "text": "預將命使吳，孫權問預曰：「東之與西，譬猶一家，而聞西更增白帝之守，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "3268ec8225d8c17006bb3fd786ad9915d927a0fb153012853ba09c56b4037458"}

{"id": "p_14b235408e1df0c4", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」預對曰：「臣以為東益巴丘之戍，西增白帝之守，皆事勢宜然，俱不足以相問也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "b7a2326472f83bbb6837d6a4fdb74c73e507161108db06ad174388117cd424da"}

{"id": "p_de5ee5a343af2de3", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」權大笑，嘉其抗直，甚愛待之，見敬亞於鄧芝、費禕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "217d047fadecfd3b9df930d32c862c36e74897d38821f2e4e74639dfa47d6c29"}

{"id": "p_88cc2bb492d6572d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 63, "text": "時車騎將軍鄧芝自江州還，來朝，謂預曰：「禮，六十不服戎，而卿甫受兵，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "d73da3dd9b77d7f5cb6965bbf9df29a7be7ae0d8f330c30f6c0973913e8af985"}

{"id": "p_92a4f86328e8f878", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 64, "text": "」預答曰：「卿七十不還兵，我六十何為不受邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "bad9296f9665be7775836ceb96e68b3d7eee674762e9131e6aa559fc665eaa65"}

{"id": "p_82f3e77d882a1e44", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 65, "text": "」芝性驕傲，自大將軍費禕等皆避下之，而預獨不為屈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "452510b4d6624eb6fc020d7a6abeb42557e75fbf5895c3308ffc342aa4719a7c"}

{"id": "p_b95b33de8a6cde7c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 66, "text": "預復東聘吳，孫權捉預手，涕泣而別曰：「君每銜命結二國之好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "09fcdd504328588a5f1fb53e8a1b7ca8e1722ea4983010557264e2825c973c9f"}

{"id": "p_2da75f61eaa4f210", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 67, "text": "今君年長，孤亦衰老，恐不復相見！", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "e1a3b6ab2666fb9ef377131b9f52bf3d9e0ba91ae1e9be74f1d0a9004c31b172"}

{"id": "p_66aa9750998a3de4", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 68, "text": "」遺預大珠一斛， 乃還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "f9a8ae63463050e4d618aaf774ac396d0b1ff51c217d7f7e84df8ea56bd6b1bb"}

{"id": "p_04e826b3fa243d13", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 69, "text": "遷後將軍，督永安，就拜征西大將軍，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "d41a348c27b3dac6afe049d7c457f0894acbda8008686a833238845548460c24"}

{"id": "p_2793a3abe8f46186", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 70, "text": "後為鎮軍大將軍，領兗州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "c4930a649f3519d0d1b647340ee6ee2dbafde72f64a46012a3b49e048a2a4442"}

{"id": "p_03b23d79252ffaba", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 71, "text": "時都護諸葛瞻初統朝事，廖化過預，欲與預共詣瞻許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "e063724a2b054900e4eaffdd571da3d9cb15a3261ce892a53a921701fe1de6a3"}

{"id": "p_b62a565de1121bbf", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 72, "text": "預曰：「吾等年逾七十，所竊已過，但少一死耳，何求於年少輩而屑屑造門邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "ca5b30a424f8bed6a29286241373e2438c03c4c014e342f83e9ac2f6005b0adf"}

{"id": "p_ecc0589ed5cf9dc5", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 73, "text": "廖化字元儉，本名淳，襄陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "635c52fabe24ed45c51de74b6ea8cb720a706e9037ebab3fe407a69c5ae9688c"}

{"id": "p_79e91539262a5fe0", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 74, "text": "為前將軍關羽主簿，羽敗，屬吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "bb59e566c034731d96cce2daeb915d514592abeb5a89fc8a27a66f3809a6feae"}

{"id": "p_ff1c9d1d042c3da6", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 75, "text": "思歸先主，乃詐死，時人謂為信然，因攜持老母晝夜西行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "126d0516d3eadcf68c2864d724a29c7e1ebef47e468946e1716432b7a6bb501e"}

{"id": "p_9a88154aecda2f74", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 76, "text": "先主大悅，以化為宜都太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "245b1e28bda9bbf12f50014499bf7b62bb3014e6ca432a504930d00075976b72"}

{"id": "p_afdb78884ce3da94", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 77, "text": "先主薨，為丞相參軍，後為督廣武，稍遷至右車騎將軍，假節，領并州刺史，封中鄉侯，以果烈稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "022d8493f4c29388cfeafdd44662b4577d6423d156bfcbd0adf1e0f4030000ea"}

{"id": "p_345ef671e8c93e38", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 78, "text": "官位與張翼齊，而在宗預之右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "c9c4998727940367276ec20f5f1919102f0b39898daa396e854fdaa3a722a329"}

{"id": "p_b070f910b7f1af26", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 79, "text": "春，化、預俱內徙洛陽，道病卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "112a094f3e99ec2be3085d25ae28537455a6cb82b1070b58c7f337115d1f684a"}

{"id": "p_bf615ffa80c7d749", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 80, "text": "楊戲字文然，犍為武陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "ca14ea035dc0ec5738efd6ef48fd1b204342108df660d61befeb5a59173228fe"}

{"id": "p_8148a4937b05ecf1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 81, "text": "少與巴西程祁公弘、巴郡楊汰季儒、蜀郡張表伯達並知名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "4b3237aa6a64394b7e668be2f8f8179f510a6ce9a5831a9a671bee0fca6df897"}

{"id": "p_9714a9c5c3448788", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 82, "text": "戲每推祁以為冠首，丞相亮深識之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "9ecc8d264ecbcc95ac2be47d18d60f4edba7d74bfa98330edbe42975185fd755"}

{"id": "p_3ed428b48a78e29a", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 83, "text": "戲年二十餘，從州書佐為督軍從事，職典刑獄，論法決疑，號為平當，府闢為屬主簿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "8f3d3173d60e0af31b53c17601f333b7ed7f7a551f7d05c51962947ddaa7cea0"}

{"id": "p_c6a13f19476e9c6c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 84, "text": "亮卒，為尚書右選部郎，刺史蔣琬請為治中從事史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "db857de7814a3045cb206273334b7973a70a63526f5129932484c2861a6b241c"}

{"id": "p_7359b823589a19dd", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 85, "text": "琬以大將軍開府，又闢為東曹掾，遷南中郎參軍，副貳庲降都督，領建寧太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "63a81da317e4e5821f6b632048d89d2ded848426178968ea0317d41c870639fb"}

{"id": "p_b9fda88599972800", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 86, "text": "以疾徵還成都，拜護軍監軍，出領梓潼太守，入為射聲校尉，所在清約不煩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "8b0ddffe5b5ba182018e80e0e9fb173da22b0513b5eb79edddf889f1c426749e"}

{"id": "p_a41b511fe1305d4c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 87, "text": "，隨大將軍姜維出軍至芒水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "b0a3d07eacd8ebacf93337826f970cddce05fd001314d538085e135dcc7d05f7"}

{"id": "p_976261dd0800e9bc", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 88, "text": "戲素心不服維，酒後言笑，每有傲弄之辭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "dd705e2806fe7eaadea5364714287c4f2d52cfcdfb706e9791d4383208c895e5"}

{"id": "p_54b374deaea5ca66", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 89, "text": "維外寬內忌，意不能堪，軍還，有司承旨奏戲，免為庶人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "81e61cd831fcf723559c3815dd39c8804a2255ebff006d07847f87b1c81ae76a"}

{"id": "p_fef3144c69e610dc", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 90, "text": "戲性雖簡惰省略，未嘗以甘言加人，過情接物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "dc39f183135daa1a71b083628c39926041a4364384313468ef26d74021c4b52b"}

{"id": "p_5c9fb86b0bf10458", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 91, "text": "與巴西韓儼、黎韜童幼相親厚，後儼痼疾廢頓，韜無行見捐，戲經紀振卹，恩好如初。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "30b1ff54a3a67af7e42c9ed78d03cc53dcb0ee69311a453e161e412d5b0e91a4"}

{"id": "p_26e755f4e6fddfe7", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 92, "text": "又時人謂譙周無當世才，少歸敬者，唯戲重之，嘗稱曰：「吾等後世，終自不如此長兒也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "5879d6a84a1d61b5d7672898c17d659c9e0c4ebba9708838aaa6efe78c46efdc"}

{"id": "p_2e7b468e576bc1fd", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 93, "text": "張表有威儀風觀，始名位與戲齊，後至尚書，督庲降後將軍，先戲沒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "52de74ed7cab7d80fb0f62f80e059f27444df5903aae0d602f1c4b86f60b59c9"}

{"id": "p_d34ba9c65500a51c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 94, "text": "戲以著《季漢輔臣贊》，其所頌述，今多載於蜀書，是以記之於左。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "0882b95e5df7a146d96020a0dcc56d0855bfd4df2bbe0952578192d4139e6663"}

{"id": "p_02425b4ef500c5d6", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 95, "text": "自此之後卒者，則不追諡，故或有應見稱紀而不在乎篇者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "4072ab34296d2ce9cf6e5a2d56129203023b5f9859e52f1054d97df3523bb1f1"}

{"id": "p_8e2c8e101619a5c2", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 96, "text": "其戲之所贊而今不作傳者，餘皆注疏本末於其辭下，可以觕知其彷彿云爾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "f825a06eef2a6b94eeb2be91bc2e140509d5439753ffc389b12f381c03bea7e5"}

{"id": "p_52804becc8d1dff1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 97, "text": "昔文王歌德，武王歌興，夫命世之主，樹身行道，非唯一時，亦由開基植緒，光於來世者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "69a42d0222e2f956da2174c1ba2c09edf5b2459fdcfbd90f845d5a5df255d4e7"}

{"id": "p_e07672e1e2436157", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 98, "text": "自我中漢之末，王綱棄柄，雄豪並起，役殷難結，生人塗地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "7cfecc78cc8806d1f40498ad7afdeff305264c692c268b1f5e73569792a7e28e"}

{"id": "p_02c7766167ef5a9b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 99, "text": "於是世主感而慮之，初自燕、代則仁聲洽著，行自齊、魯則英風播流，寄業荊、郢則臣主歸心，顧援吳、越則賢愚賴風，奮威巴、蜀則萬里肅震，厲師庸、漢則元寇斂跡，故能承高祖之始兆，复皇漢之宗祀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "e06a7e2558ef9f1902fc1ffb54c006dafcc2543f01de1dcbd39f2adae217068f"}

{"id": "p_b51c1dd5ade6a85d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 100, "text": "然而姦兇懟險，天徵未加，猶孟津之翔師，复須戰於鳴條也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "f816c4e423460e69d80360e73bc0c04ade25f7c34af0ccec61623808624b20d7"}

{"id": "p_bd738f07f33f5b13", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 101, "text": "雖攝歸一統，萬國合從者，當時俊乂扶攜翼戴，明德之所懷致也，蓋濟濟有可觀焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "e2b57db8bfb16c7820eb88af7f0720d01f9579a108f632a0678e86608115a2cc"}

{"id": "p_303e7b19a4ad9797", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 102, "text": "遂乃並述休風，動於後聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "1047c4e124a17328b545221dfcbbb946ece0d3fa762b186f32b97f6c2e6d95f3"}

{"id": "p_4810b34708139b05", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 103, "text": ": 皇帝遺植，爰滋八方，", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "77393054dc07c586282d77efb0e9443cb6a43d4a9e63e27a70cfdb86b14fc19b"}

{"id": "p_d7ac13c0b5c97028", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 104, "text": ": 別自中山，靈精是鍾，", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "84625c9e701863945e37537121cebd7274862a316bc7d5daf3ee40919271276d"}

{"id": "p_dacd5749e161242f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 105, "text": ": 順期挺生，傑起龍驤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "b7a6ac2113e45383dc9a12729a738241f7a71780238aa5bc571cb3559a92982f"}

{"id": "p_bb55f0d057841759", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 106, "text": ": 始於燕代，伯豫君荊，", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "d4bfbf01ae623297c9ef3394025da6d7ce3060744ef482154d870700f486c591"}

{"id": "p_a206ae676e9af04c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 107, "text": ": 吳越憑賴，望風請盟，", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "f1a3673ef8cdce90f1d4067a74d8c4aa1cbe13442bc40c1e3bf23c969698e885"}

{"id": "p_46de0412f2a993f1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 108, "text": ": 挾巴跨蜀，庸漢以並。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "a1146d009f5693486179894acbd33b3d361a5b1acb93d54d513312dab7793ac8"}

{"id": "p_4a917a8eada482cf", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 109, "text": ": 乾坤复秩，宗祀惟寧，", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "855e6eac4c2cc1968edcdadd9d06d0f8bcda1d4fb2ce0f0e8dd8dc5c60f69d41"}

{"id": "p_7cea51f3cbca2b8a", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 110, "text": ": 躡基履跡，播德芳聲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "6589f71f5b62406fcdb7c42f6de7aa68e9525eb1eece06f9fcd777e5a3c184b8"}

{"id": "p_08f80a64f8953bd9", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 111, "text": ": 華夏思美，西伯其音，", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "75eeec773b62efd0496495febae7cf6a7dc3428e4bb2739d362f02d9ef3d6106"}

{"id": "p_5c3a6d7f1db1fd10", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 112, "text": ": 開慶來世，歷載攸興。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "325dd242f6d69289f3b22cd90efccaf99ff5b1b003f4f84ea248d541fe3e4858"}

{"id": "p_e8e96f8b987d0522", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 113, "text": ": 忠武英高，獻策江濱，", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "bd678424cfd509d4918b5e8fde7e6aded1c27ee128d05ab779273ef8adacaff6"}

{"id": "p_e1b559320ff58512", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 114, "text": ": 攀吳連蜀，權我世真。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "ca22da0ca68a1ceb8eab9e9cc9b99fae4a7bbb45fbeaea5487db6f859349634f"}

{"id": "p_f40b7b9970f2670f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 115, "text": ": 受遺阿衡，整武齊文，", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "9afc5401049c7be2b317089e33735a5b8c7330af8643057e029530102439b9d3"}

{"id": "p_6a19a16207159f8f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 116, "text": ": 敷陳德教，理物移風，", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "1c1d7c0976a9f76bf7ca390cf3bf6382cf5a9627f934215d8c004e32daa00415"}

{"id": "p_5b3020c4de1742a6", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 117, "text": ": 賢愚競心，僉忘其身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "795a093468c567eb006fa18db96ae80ca6c5b7a2fea2d07ecb409f13dd89a0c6"}

{"id": "p_2011c6045698704c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 118, "text": ": 誕靜邦內，四裔以綏，", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "1bd7f2a05ffca59f7064a79cf402c086a67a5723fdb9d9f35cf958dee8c8917a"}

{"id": "p_03d38f2f2d1405c6", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 119, "text": ": 屢臨敵庭，實耀其威，", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "93eeaddcf23b59a91ebc0ab832f458e68df1b4a4ef9378d75ceb3b483e2da507"}

{"id": "p_0e8d9370defcca8e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 120, "text": ": 研精大國，恨於未夷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "ff67592c484d628ce95ab9756a4ac974f5240cc5a9af6ba1f6fc5df17bea0afd"}

{"id": "p_1690ddeabc06a949", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 121, "text": ": 司徒清風，是諮是臧，", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "886f84a04847ee59e3c4ef9697c5084b53357ba04cb5da8b2a686a4a5737fa60"}

{"id": "p_6c8d3d7189ec82fe", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 122, "text": ": 識愛人倫，孔音鏘鏘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "acc7fab8822951e6b09ddd8066aae053eb0116123e8ce4fcc86426c3f2bffdf3"}

{"id": "p_8c578d56046b093c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 123, "text": ": 關張赳赳，出身匡世，", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "3034bbf5f656d4b2ecb6bc9e188f2683f0ae92300a50b7a44eb6651c20b18b61"}

{"id": "p_38f0bcd352f09ea1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 124, "text": ": 扶翼攜上，雄壯虎烈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "e087408576ebf0beb3885c5e8c5fd7a2c190b4882951599a12817b44c7bfbdf0"}

{"id": "p_e326bc5d82fda7a2", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 125, "text": ": 籓屏左右，翻飛電發，", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "1f94af97f77c20cc77277993a0cd0c7327745c28eaa766ac858435ceaaed28a7"}

{"id": "p_58bf7ebfed03cde1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 126, "text": ": 濟於艱難，贊主洪業，", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "e39be89b813258b0ede45445aaff993a522c663c398cdeb686c9c5cdbd9542c1"}

{"id": "p_b08e9688a2e835ca", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 127, "text": ": 侔跡韓耿，齊聲雙德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "992304b5a304e151ffef4203137b2ccde68ce8e33633ce8ea12dc2c26696fcf4"}

{"id": "p_2f0a0d58866770eb", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 128, "text": ": 交待無禮，並致姦慝，", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "9947e7b16286b62f3bdf3aca95058a445683ea2d61d91d5e9e95c6606a77074a"}

{"id": "p_fbd182d028bccbf8", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 129, "text": ": 悼惟輕慮，隕身匡國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "8ed254a7cd92b1880c607854e72e3c38ecf4ec23f5e3088b6fd90a3441ff251b"}

{"id": "p_fd99d6a2e3205d78", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 130, "text": ": 驃騎奮起，連橫合從，", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "9706a048bfa761ba1698e2079d146a61cb17f60955f45dc134ddec7e4c3e8ad9"}

{"id": "p_d09d27c1827a94c6", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 131, "text": ": 首事三秦，保據河潼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "0841379a2b6c90d255cc9bd6d2c14a34b8ba01351ed33513a5a491a923290f2b"}

{"id": "p_ae22e6fa8543b998", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 132, "text": ": 宗計於朝，或異或同，", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "097f67e5ea1b5821b4fc31150faa6c047d8196c0fb0ecf86fbcc48f7fdf5abcc"}

{"id": "p_1da532d4e2becabc", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 133, "text": ": 敵以乘釁，家破軍亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "50965de8a69ea488bffb195041494dcd11d290f780624e529361cc8fb23deed3"}

{"id": "p_8dd992472dca5190", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 134, "text": ": 乖道反德，託鳳攀龍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "b988b7b8f537b2f93ac6a7868369c62f129657463da4a8ff35a118eac9cac995"}

{"id": "p_fb33c97bf3f68a54", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 135, "text": ": 翼侯良謀，料世興衰，", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "da1b4e842362bc0b091e3609a42ce38a9d2f1e6c6b7303b5fbd96359b1f76b9b"}

{"id": "p_55795cf1d601dd7c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 136, "text": ": 委質於主，是訓是諮，", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "51872223ad1a57d6b777dae37105c37f584ed3d0df303be41ce865dc4733a193"}

{"id": "p_3ceb10e16e5ea7b9", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 137, "text": ": 暫思經算，睹事知機。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "854c9869428dd775f69ee0e5d398400abd977e8f9bcf78fc24df9d8375b901aa"}

{"id": "p_367287e7c3b785ca", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 138, "text": ": 軍師美至，雅氣曄曄，", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "d4050c25b04bf5b194cc42c87367b3379b223ea835dbd3783753f49f928777a3"}

{"id": "p_8b51ab52d3d3defd", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 139, "text": ": 致命明主，忠情發臆，", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "85199a0e17e7e1fa750b568ba37c90bc01586a81ecd5c1885806beae9d8d0d3b"}

{"id": "p_4565ac58d70a636d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 140, "text": ": 惟此義宗，亡身報德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "a662fc132c1c6c42a3dd3892743a8ad494bc4d7622d539b66e9af4f4a82402c6"}

{"id": "p_aecaabbcf3161ba7", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 141, "text": ": 將軍敦壯，摧峰登難，", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "39a6bd4ac7573a41ff6649bfcde7251ef1ccc50c782c667f312e335bfbf412b7"}

{"id": "p_0c889019e829ca8d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 142, "text": ": 立功立事，於時之幹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "9b358b66bef30b92dac39c40cf1d6037a6d26f5ea1248cb28ae7133ca07ee1ae"}

{"id": "p_8fe3d8f5848705af", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 143, "text": ": 掌軍清節，亢然恆常，", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "68e29636cbb5b46abf94aaf39904bab79e65fccfbcbff8c77614d5ff786feece"}

{"id": "p_e72e67f6713c18bb", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 144, "text": ": 讜言惟司，民思其綱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "0460b1dff2b3528081959a41c2846a6c39b4847b5d4ab878b2cf977fd97817ac"}

{"id": "p_00ebc5cd304c90f0", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 145, "text": ": 安遠強志，允休允烈，", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "129d7774b2443716325aa58dd2af915366f69a09e37e2576eff9b68d732ef1d5"}

{"id": "p_2b5937adb4ce8aba", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 146, "text": ": 輕財果壯，當難不惑，", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "6904236b082266eca7bb915733af4061cf4e79e679dcd7de7d9d4901aea6c79e"}

{"id": "p_ab0b2d02153eadd1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 147, "text": ": 以少禦多，殊方保業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "888f8b5c0f8a9e33aa01cc31a351acb20642401ccd70ab7b7ece28ae694931c1"}

{"id": "p_b62de469c4432a29", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 148, "text": "蜀既定，為犍為屬國都尉，因易郡名，為硃提太守，選為安遠將軍、庲降都督，住南昌縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "0247a038c9f58f2570cc5860d2d917510d20895d437321a737ec4bd63803b577"}

{"id": "p_fee721e795349141", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 149, "text": ": 揚威才幹，欷歔文武，", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "96f4c204eb48bed5db80ad469f8db8882f7f67a34e840e429ac5b8414fab2d02"}

{"id": "p_722a0756a52b3916", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 150, "text": ": 當官理任，衎衎辯舉，", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "898469faaa0d6ea7d0dbc39e68aa29628bbc798f35e20052fc05fca7acd55795"}

{"id": "p_03f598d1ead3f61b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 151, "text": ": 圖殖財施，有義有敘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "bb0600b181369a96d121353d336adf4a5662550921955452f8e1ca8fda5ade7f"}

{"id": "p_49937d9f13c4ac89", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 152, "text": "劉璋母，觀之族姑，璋又以女妻觀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "d5e6392f4813705a173b88b45e1839caab6fb8998fa3ab1cdd301d2bb1efc9d1"}

{"id": "p_eddddaa3d073b9bc", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 153, "text": "觀參李嚴軍，拒先主於綿竹，與嚴俱降，先主既定益州，拜為裨將軍，後為巴郡太守、江州都督，封都亭侯，加振威將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "40de2b57e294ea18a258c7c9581755be81dc6344f79f06bf071d7b2524f5e462"}

{"id": "p_bfa3091c20cb660c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 154, "text": "都護李嚴性自矜高，護軍輔匡等年位與嚴相次，而嚴不與親褻；觀年少嚴二十餘歲，而與嚴通狎如時輩雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "5f32993cdf922bd88220c65ada1f913bbe89ef276e02cfb35fbe0b635d5f4f24"}

{"id": "p_aec1444502788b16", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 155, "text": ": 屯騎主舊，固節不移，", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "52e656722bcf375f1b7e479dfa676e44c782fe43b7fc2c65a988a291d02c0652"}

{"id": "p_6f897063ff316f13", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 156, "text": ": 既就初命，盡心世規，", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "8d1da065fae71c73d07647e642ffb351efea51642a3acdaea4dcb8257c5f7131"}

{"id": "p_f36d3f59cceca261", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 157, "text": ": 軍資所恃，是辨是裨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "692834382b49f5ae82b38e97d500bffae19a7700d8fae195ad14b9b2ff6adfbf"}

{"id": "p_9e8b18409897a437", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 158, "text": ": 尚書清尚，敕行整身，", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "7a8f8373dc4de9baaa4ce4c2c116d1df1db1ee05017c854e43efb27cb34e76d8"}

{"id": "p_ac9a379f43198b6b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 159, "text": ": 抗志存義，味覽典文，", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "da2855ee326577fdcdf170f8d32ad1b575b46fbde44ab827e3cd8d29cd1014f7"}

{"id": "p_8fab2423c1759fc9", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 160, "text": ": 倚其高風，好侔古人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "84ef8fe314353e60e51371d74c5532cbdfc1a7d03a92a9cf3bb2412fd8a2850a"}

{"id": "p_63d33736fcfde554", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 161, "text": ": 安漢雍容，或婚或賓，", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "b57a4f4b90d9e0bbdd0138f84ffc57b5d3b269b8b06de68c99e2b7d3fd81c3f2"}

{"id": "p_813f51ea09f79c47", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 162, "text": ": 見禮當時，是謂循臣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "b5ea261c2f0fff85df534187beee05f5eb63b6e10f8a43bece41bf31072eaa35"}

{"id": "p_2ff5c50357a77dc5", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 163, "text": ": 少府修慎，鴻臚明真，", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "87fa3ae057101bbc2a3e3fdcdc841e477e2400fd58fc978b14c39b999620d0e0"}

{"id": "p_6bfa022a3d9957d9", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 164, "text": ": 諫議隱行，儒林天文。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "3152e076433447a8967086ea2e0b989e2407753fc66fd726160017768653221d"}

{"id": "p_ed0dd97f2de6700b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 165, "text": ": 宣班大化，或首或林。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "3f6e0f28828564152756537a483ec84284050660089c21a146f14be438bb3034"}

{"id": "p_70447dbadd704788", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 166, "text": "──贊王元泰、何彥英、杜輔國、周仲直", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "dc451b2b43ce327708845e58c8071f953278527a4e514c9cd431ba9b089a3e35"}

{"id": "p_85db83ab6e1527b2", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 167, "text": "劉璋時，為巴郡太守，還為州治中從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "58317440b83db8bded705fe971fd88554d4d8807d34635be7ab2cb370187aa2e"}

{"id": "p_6c039b1db11ae771", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 168, "text": "先主定益州，領牧，以為別駕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "68dfdc2e8f431314bf2c40192e485ea52a8529a893c44b5561620cdb8cf2e52a"}

{"id": "p_243e31813c344177", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 169, "text": "先主為漢中王，用荊楚宿士零陵賴恭為太常，南陽黃柱為光祿勳，謀為少府；建興初，賜爵關內侯，後代賴恭為太常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "3a63a416b494817bf238d31daf5bdabe37218fd527eb77fc39805a45d14c81cd"}

{"id": "p_34a50a8e474ca685", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 170, "text": "恭、柱、謀皆失其行事，故不為傳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "c9305e80f103a1ecd9b60db1d605f10a5c8942ba124e85ed35e20c94f89e3c5e"}

{"id": "p_211b5151c432b729", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 171, "text": "恭子厷，為丞相西曹令史，隨諸葛亮於漢中，早夭，亮甚惜之，與留府長史參軍張裔、蔣琬書曰：「令史失賴厷，掾屬喪楊顒，為朝中損益多矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "dd0c4cb63857947e6cf986a5db7f09bceaa1fc4cb89bb4b5480b0dbfe45f9692"}

{"id": "p_fccfe92d24bcda32", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 172, "text": "後大將軍蔣琬問張休曰：「漢嘉前輩有王元泰，今誰繼者？", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "e7ff6f41ca513cdb5f9f49688f36072639173383d5c168ef31ae918ce342b37c"}

{"id": "p_cf3970b6bb0645a4", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 173, "text": "」休對曰：「至於元泰，州里無繼，況鄙郡乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "d92584dbaaeef9dc53ff5835667c78f525aa96408a46fb83c0c44ed3fb6aa99a"}

{"id": "p_ab8811daea5ad6cf", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 174, "text": "何彥英名宗，蜀郡郫人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "76776e5ba0b3bff6095d4c97094a7e3673ff936b9e5c13ba57b4149730b6a1d0"}

{"id": "p_d018bfc111d25ffe", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 175, "text": "事廣漢任安學，精究安術，與杜瓊同師而名問過之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "0820c57d0e6b9e594d39cc6d9c531fa0648ee22d8ba630b5e341fbb00670d673"}

{"id": "p_97525a46d877b7ed", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 176, "text": "先主定益州，領牧，闢為從事祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "66976a36da87f9cb143600c7f3a65f6a927a33c593bf74412e55ffa797608e29"}

{"id": "p_0181568f8de8b99b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 177, "text": "後援引圖、讖，勸先主即尊號。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "6364676353fdc6786bf6bcddf06630ee36d881ff5e9a001d9096efcbe44e7f22"}

{"id": "p_c4ad924e9374434d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 178, "text": "滑稽談笑，有淳于髡、東方朔之風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "0d216e5932d89f274d3a2a4c4c1285e0171e7786c898a805cd5566d4b666a32c"}

{"id": "p_0baf5663fbf8cf31", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 179, "text": ": 車騎高勁，惟其汎愛，", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "2997a00474677bab0d583a8b00e61ba859809085a906a9cfeb5e20cff809b8e1"}

{"id": "p_2b1a052071bb473b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 180, "text": ": 以弱制強，不陷危墜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "86e122c18997655e9328668d33e2eab7845770ae0e5f68943cd7a5ddc79323c2"}

{"id": "p_7ffd5186f1d2758d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 181, "text": "劉璋時，為中郎將，將兵拒先主於涪，詣降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "5b607d7bf4513123653f703feb00ec4c176654842c0a6f0e5fbbb11c1efeb2d7"}

{"id": "p_97dc9a730a1fc727", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 182, "text": "先主定益州，以壹為護軍討逆將軍，納壹妹為夫人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "753eb99813f28e98a9b2599c41db49f150eba1fc17dea34eb59de86edaa6d82b"}

{"id": "p_7870e5ca8db11210", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 183, "text": "，與魏延入南安界，破魏將費瑤，徙亭侯，進封高陽鄉侯，遷左將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "9c7eb8bc128cecbe7cf244b3fe847fbd9402db95b55cbaac30c32586e387012e"}

{"id": "p_013d698c7ff8a947", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 184, "text": "十二年，丞相亮卒，以壹督漢中，車騎將軍，假節，領雍州刺史，進封濟陽侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "b27496347952fe49a587a9077f28e605273dacdb579613ebdd7d7539e4dddfbb"}

{"id": "p_8306e66e014ff040", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 185, "text": "壹族弟班，字元雄，大將軍何進官屬吳匡之子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "c810cb7dc3cd23e1ab68aefd909e5ad6ac5172944c7024085f62c2aa62a7fd76"}

{"id": "p_918f3b378d0f5940", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 186, "text": "以豪俠稱，官位常與壹相亞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "b0e00035b3400f6348e1db22113697a5ad8db46314e15b0c397509097aac2408"}

{"id": "p_956c7df17e6bba44", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 187, "text": "後主世，稍遷至驃騎將軍，假節，封綿竹侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "def3914a9b3f13e08aa933b7c9bd006ffa0afbd17d20fd79e40b4d86e2cc906d"}

{"id": "p_e93d75cf81714a3b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 188, "text": ": 安漢宰南，奮擊舊鄉，", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "e5633c08108d3e25862143c396adaf77faab61ff1824c486116d8c7e53cbf7f7"}

{"id": "p_9a85a7abd61801d5", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 189, "text": ": 翦除蕪穢，惟刑以張，", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "4453bb7c4dd9ef2353128cfa9f20b9f539fa671c0ec02e7b91899e0e23401896"}

{"id": "p_125cb43b8b26ccb4", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 190, "text": ": 廣遷蠻濮，國用用強。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "4a456e5c41da653ccb40b06f4681deae64e97fd756f3d72e3bb066fa050e5b59"}

{"id": "p_9a98ec3da85333f3", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 191, "text": ": 輔漢惟聰，既機且惠，", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "38adc48c8eb1a92aff1194743ceb463d46dc4fb4c1c11d85dcf3a550bc9309b0"}

{"id": "p_52b38e712554c859", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 192, "text": ": 因言遠思，切問近對，", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "81ce95307728725c579e8f032f7abfb01dfb929d8d4aec6674f07baed7b51fbb"}

{"id": "p_293cb0f1238f1e86", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 193, "text": ": 贊時休美，和我業世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "3820260db1838a7065a522dc7e1b8d55c7755bbf80b1286e1425e6828c855920"}

{"id": "p_58edb253f9a0f0a1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 194, "text": ": 鎮北敏思，籌畫有方，", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "78de6865820e2562361dca739883de686d088061e0430a906f3f5cc8c5077ad7"}

{"id": "p_758fae546a7a1bd4", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 195, "text": ": 導師禳穢，遂事成章。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "756a9ac81339c1465914d32356594b29b1b0d9a91568a5328f2d559e9dcc9045"}

{"id": "p_92067955435352a3", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 196, "text": ": 偏任東隅，末命不祥，", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "9f50ad91f26de34b5cc95741f9b194b056ec0ac0fd9e5d68aedaf8d49a56c5bc"}

{"id": "p_1e565c79daec477f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 197, "text": ": 哀悲本志，放流殊疆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "60fb3a6d94ff61998a6aa5d56d71569648fd56c65c7bcd909249d125fc2e3d2b"}

{"id": "p_0b4eb54f88c9ae9f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 198, "text": ": 越騎惟忠，厲志自祗，", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "f4951b2410a68f54c8aafe4acfdd364fe35d5d67ff9d08da50960171a9700abb"}

{"id": "p_e30853b990ef7355", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 199, "text": ": 職於內外，念公忘私。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "bf86cc8af0e49294cce82b7558610a90e0b6a665bbd00343f3baf4ff2351ff05"}

{"id": "p_0f98c81b06c1be2a", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 200, "text": ": 征南厚重，征西忠克，", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "0e537f38c768408d9a53b069edbe009fe72d7bd63c9f15d98dc4a1b4b79edc11"}

{"id": "p_a77e7404d25ef739", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 201, "text": ": 統時選士，猛將之烈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "8c24b96f9775cf869878a1c2bff663cabb0312da57a3c86f1cb4c3dfa3b71bf6"}

{"id": "p_1d02f9fe1e64aaf2", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 202, "text": "自豫州隨先主，名位常亞趙雲，俱以忠勇稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "8bf981e19cc793e6b2fe4942aa28f5c1ff275ae8d175103d2b11dde1b0ddc640"}

{"id": "p_7a8c07289314361f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 203, "text": "建興初，官至永安都督、征西將軍，封亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "ee70c0a6af77108ae57f9042e18e7bdd5f2afd22c64bb2dbadee063bfc3c75bc"}

{"id": "p_31b6d0f4656dc9ce", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 204, "text": ": 鎮南粗強，監軍尚篤，", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "42bc802142f5ea24ae1551acb7137abb0fd47a7f4008caf1f566ee4dda86839c"}

{"id": "p_1e5aca3ca58efe63", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 205, "text": ": 並豫戎任，任自封裔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "8f34eaac05d6971e525774bd350e3b8a67bdf61cfa420438024adef42b9379bb"}

{"id": "p_0f2522bbecaebcdb", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 206, "text": "建興中，徙鎮南，為右將軍，封中鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "d3fab44f3628cc6a09883674d67522a205f06f19377498dc08840470f915b5d9"}

{"id": "p_f8593b666cee6c13", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 207, "text": "建興中，稍遷至監軍後將軍，賜爵關內侯，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "61ec673205364e014e22cb92861e533e05ae455cf2f0a0298c71940c0ff4f2ba"}

{"id": "p_f7f4957722bcb644", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 208, "text": "少子武，有文，與樊建齊名，官亦至尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "cde5aea9ca8efff2c1a2d1116dadf871350cbfdc85eeb74b90b709b3aa2ebfd9"}

{"id": "p_cfc44f9b862f6143", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 209, "text": ": 司農性才，敷述允章，", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "0ad8c4339c5815593880180e75356e397ee1708e1ca7f428f695c02280ea9967"}

{"id": "p_56b95936836fc46b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 210, "text": ": 藻麗辭理，斐斐有光。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "e3986eb5e68d171c8f7598845cd18cb3a35f3671a2a357b5f0a63d401692e29c"}

{"id": "p_01aa1577811bca08", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 211, "text": ": 正方受遺，豫聞後綱，", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "f1e8fade6ae07af345dfa7be939602236c7f36ee67c1b92022e0f0edc6e2d4ff"}

{"id": "p_8c1998eb9cb87f9e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 212, "text": ": 不陳不僉，造此異端，", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "6900a4b1ff65132941ac38929814ef74f7846ce0c7f99ce171802a9723c37fe6"}

{"id": "p_f170feeb02971249", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 213, "text": ": 斥逐當時，任業以喪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "f5c786f8d215ff6085d656e4b60d6a1fc353c284383f92895014c849fadc252c"}

{"id": "p_1b3060402287f809", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 214, "text": ": 文長剛粗，臨難受命，", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "04ed8bdeb186485541b7fcc633bda8d12d94fb5ecf5faa1152a57293e643a597"}

{"id": "p_6d195478094faf5c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 215, "text": ": 折衝外禦，鎮保國境。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "e90d15f56fd4f57ef203878f9f386afa05e978c95c49430fdc5cb55f0d5bc295"}

{"id": "p_ecee5e457b3ba13c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 216, "text": ": 不協不和，忘節言亂，", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "44f784ca465bf355bb9d01f3110aac3efc19b6c8e570a34930cd4cda92ebca41"}

{"id": "p_763023923acbe293", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 217, "text": ": 疾終惜始，實惟厥性。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "d7cdd7380fdead20eb4913e1a09852b3621af680e0063157e15d73c0fd76ec03"}

{"id": "p_ae299271b9fe8ca3", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 218, "text": ": 威公狷狹，取異眾人；", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "d977cb12180651718cbb1426c53b9b3bcb66ec24afea52c1ef1f7c08d68a68ad"}

{"id": "p_52277fe9965d9908", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 219, "text": ": 閒則及理，逼則傷侵，", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "f2315fe02efffd04badbcba73a790ff414ef19e6bce272ff86bc95cdeacb9459"}

{"id": "p_1d0ae836c0048406", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 220, "text": ": 舍順入兇，大易之雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "7769be8e4f23f02bdde62cf09236185e50a1794f6777f1b7e6d0b29ba337dd3c"}

{"id": "p_ddc154484d0b765b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 221, "text": ": 季常良實，文經勤類，", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "ae281e7b354f2a6156cae7ce34feec30b88d2282f5d56a7c0a0c410994c391e7"}

{"id": "p_44e5d4556d3df5d6", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 222, "text": ": 士元言規，處仁聞計，", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "2792d2d766c580fbb08dd7ff04e7e0ff8ba053f465c8a85291cf18c6b83e8977"}

{"id": "p_7be8981533d51043", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 223, "text": ": 孔休文祥，或才或臧，", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "e365ad5102c1e0ca841a0ed29e561dddef23081dd4d97e5577923c26a63ecb75"}

{"id": "p_2dac891eb3932125", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 224, "text": ": 播播述志，楚之蘭芳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "781e56e506223a47b9dc57d166dc4b207f2aa0d191fd1f6309e8b4489ae4bc97"}

{"id": "p_5f81c384c1914e41", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 225, "text": "──贊馬季常、衛文經、韓士元、張處仁、殷孔休、習文祥", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "19a682e204a7dfb9d4797e0ee5e27203eb526b8c7337805557fed23dea81ec61"}

{"id": "p_688bcd602360ee8a", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 226, "text": "文經、士元，皆失其名實、行事、郡縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "72129b36fbd77063c827b96cf3c008b7b71986ecaa9a914cc87faa582cb4fe46"}

{"id": "p_df752294ee5cd177", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 227, "text": "以荊州從事隨先主入蜀，南次至雒，以為廣漢太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "6d93d1d975084495ba3cb055539753d05a01917cc6f7c29b1785527cfc0cc147"}

{"id": "p_9b070e7933b21b59", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 228, "text": "存素不服龐統，統中矢卒，先主發言嘉嘆，存曰：「統雖盡忠可惜，然違大雅之義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "37c1cba2f759991abe74a18a681a9260817983707d3d013ed6b7844301c8c328"}

{"id": "p_2e390d8ed6e38085", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 229, "text": "」先主怒曰：「統殺身成仁，更為非也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "93cb87d214dbd2adab97fa23dd76f9b43011f8799250be02fa508f19b4752c78"}

{"id": "p_dae5ef8e8dc3f875", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 230, "text": "孔休名觀，為荊州主簿別駕從事，見《先主傳》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "ecdae828aa57c25f48a4ee1ef9cc938248659c0fafcee2971e202a4291666a51"}

{"id": "p_23081248224b3c9b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 231, "text": "隨先主入蜀，歷雒、郫令，（南）廣漢太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "1e3965f33e99b8ac682f7c46155822542db56e4fd86df12068731a0da0d8f315"}

{"id": "p_d85846477b030e7a", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 232, "text": ": 國山休風，永南耽思；", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "907e11b578bcad7b1e3e2da212080f119c8028d80a7d6e8e13db104d815328d8"}

{"id": "p_789ceb819010da51", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 233, "text": ": 盛衡、承伯，言藏言時；", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "23690795c03f4871daf8db7b0703583b020309fec8a767761e474f1dfda53d11"}

{"id": "p_3b2d1f08e044b9fe", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 234, "text": ": 孫德果銳，偉南篤常；", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "21f03a02a3b88ccf2ff701dd17764630f8eb79431e54399f4ae3c23c81d2a116"}

{"id": "p_a6922886bb8269ae", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 235, "text": ": 德緒、義強，志壯氣剛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "4de36695e91abf9eeaf65e14fa18cdc61f932f60ea21ef7667657779c9444816"}

{"id": "p_88cce8e4ee1737da", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 236, "text": ": 濟濟脩志，蜀之芬香。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "1032b0b06e1fa604ae7189cb658ae7804f3122bf1cc9012e13b9d9a232babe98"}

{"id": "p_6cd963f1ab745067", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 237, "text": "──贊王國山、李永南、馬盛衡、馬承伯、李孫德、李偉南，龔德緒、王義強", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "44f6fa0929ac36102057ae895e407eed9c26ccb5269276bb1fed4aff0c010ce1"}

{"id": "p_17ce8b4bc48b964c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 238, "text": "先主定蜀後，為綿竹令，還為荊州議曹從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "c1a032da41269b7881d8bfa4b5b69e7cb56b68fa4b4b30c842a7a4c6c3c0c92e"}

{"id": "p_4bf1cde89a6c134e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 239, "text": "隨先主徵吳，軍敗於秭歸，遇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "a9ca822840deb6a71b9a90e1c66e22bfa80beef6a413d4b234d389221b587cec"}

{"id": "p_7b7dd031ae78b02f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 240, "text": "子祐，有父風，官至尚書右選郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "e4d9dcaa4d2f94ce4432f80b96b6ce15a7873f7562711ddfdae503ba565341e1"}

{"id": "p_5be69fc50a69cb6d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 241, "text": "先主定蜀後，為州書佐部從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "ce52a0ae2b8857c3b1c9eb2e83cc1c90e8eba12aca69e7e21d457988efd19ba0"}

{"id": "p_35645e8f1217c435", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 242, "text": "亮南征，留邵為治中從事，是歲卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "dc021cd4a85c2cc68d2250b01f7258f24e6a9e246716de1184b3b626c0761c0c"}

{"id": "p_666be26bbea42167", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 243, "text": "盛衡名勳，承伯名齊，皆巴西閬中人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "b7f3c19354f15449a823471141a60ff1082ee4302cce68998697b354e836d945"}

{"id": "p_7626420bbc0d90c6", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 244, "text": "勳，劉璋時為州書佐，先主定蜀，闢為左將軍屬，後轉州別駕從事，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "56e456ca87c70e8a4937e3cc10497df784e418d77dea521165183c9106d96b60"}

{"id": "p_c937cce60abd0a47", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 245, "text": "建興中，從事丞相掾，遷廣漢太守，復為（飛）參軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "18eba1a3c14dc0c7a3d02aa54d8538a149e0381656f15a616213a90c2bb5fcb8"}

{"id": "p_7beb220336483a40", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 246, "text": "勳、齊皆以才幹自顯見；歸信於州黨，不如姚伷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "4cf9f4133e602b16ab2a4c1ddac9b11fcd6ca0824dc089b0ae449d2dee87e070"}

{"id": "p_a667c3aedd544cee", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 247, "text": "先主定益州後，為功曹書佐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "a0a0c104a4284397762fb9bad2def3d3a85f4394512d1d406a1c19f6949f752e"}

{"id": "p_c1e8d8f97b5b2d6f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 248, "text": "丞相亮北駐漢中，闢為掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "f331cbf0945e56b6c1b8e76fc7b5c835e77f11f8eff37b406984626e61bf88bc"}

{"id": "p_c0a24d680f50acc3", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 249, "text": "並進文武之士，亮稱曰：「忠益者莫大於進人，進人者各務其所尚；今姚掾並存剛柔，以廣文武之用，可謂博雅矣，原諸掾各希此事，以屬其望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "ca281a6197e81a5a8cd0410f352682133270d41baff92edbfd1fe6ee1c62ead8"}

{"id": "p_514af89342cf70e0", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 250, "text": "先主定益州後，為書佐、西充國長、成都令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "b650de07ed37b14de70507dbc1451bb0d13aceb7d1c480097cd223d676b7ec6a"}

{"id": "p_3f4755d6d0014095", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 251, "text": "，徙巴西太守，為江州督、楊威將軍，入為尚書僕射，封平陽亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "05b03b34a78d46a29dd6f4394feea15971a5604ce2d5c09decf16124b7d23598"}

{"id": "p_87f93ce19ab27455", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 252, "text": "延熙初，大將軍蔣琬出征漢中，福以前監軍領司馬，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "0a62483bf2d04da9dbba6ae0c14154148069566f5b3c3a9fe604940c97041eba"}

{"id": "p_4d5ca1847028be10", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 253, "text": "郡功曹，舉孝廉，臨邛令，入為別駕從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "8f7f66188cab29b91e75d41763102ae3ea0065ac043f98d7746adcc42947ba82"}

{"id": "p_db9d11a18222e1bb", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 254, "text": "隨先主東征吳，卒於永安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "c2b3ba415490d8aa8154bf2667cf5724c565b3f24b77a660214e445c5098b23f"}

{"id": "p_4ddd73c1d6065ec1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 255, "text": "德緒名祿，巴西安漢人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "2e8004812251433cf0d23f49db69f52e27f1bef1753ae3760bf2974aac7ce8e2"}

{"id": "p_c03f7da48f196ca7", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 256, "text": "先主定益州，為郡從事牙門將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "ea07b9e6812367994f1038767462d6add993b68f0bb7463822f34a5c8a98f70c"}

{"id": "p_8dc1b0df6e2f338a", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 257, "text": "，為越巂太守，隨丞相亮南征，為蠻夷所害，時年三十一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "fd82136b7aff7c7817911e11fabf8a2dd4e1132a4ca592ca23d185ede5137fac"}

{"id": "p_4f7f18f5b9c2769f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 258, "text": "義強名士，廣漢郪人，國山從兄也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "dfd35c0611b19ecc2dd340722f045f9ecbd74f48acccf9657df6df81712fb913"}

{"id": "p_1a5c4521f0b90ef8", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 259, "text": "從先主入蜀後，舉孝廉，為符節長，遷牙門將，出為宕渠太守，徙在犍為。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "7abfed00629d3820d21aefe2d6f9381cc31b660389d6555e3204d30b05a54158"}

{"id": "p_15ea0be314ef4c63", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 260, "text": "會丞相亮南征，轉為益州太守，將南行，為蠻夷所害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "7793ac6fdc09257e85d61e94081ebf5be622d43fdd163cfa907bb1457c3b7a49"}

{"id": "p_020dd8028994f9bb", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 261, "text": ": 休元輕寇，損時致害，", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "38708bc4e6487b23f5898888bd93fa489bd703b58787c761db1abc08900f8f11"}

{"id": "p_f526bc3ce8b68c72", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 262, "text": ": 文進奮身，同此顛沛，", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "e5cd4a54218d59b6c86805ad7f24c5e124ee0a9f9edfcd7289e8115aed112f94"}

{"id": "p_cd72279b4a7a2ad4", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 263, "text": ": 患生一人，至於弘大。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "2dc2089223c16b95e826216c8a1d0a426fdc6a95d941d015633ca81c7f8f4270"}

{"id": "p_f9ea9043fb1350b8", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 264, "text": "先主東征吳，習為領軍，統諸軍，大敗於猇亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "db62e364ded476b04d692fa1321f68f5a814c908c620f3fc4389540f2130b3a2"}

{"id": "p_09dd175246ecbcb9", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 265, "text": "文進名南，亦自荊州隨先主入蜀，領兵從先主徵吳，與習俱死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "3f97a27e7f480fe339c4806910871074078e2599d08f6c390bea8bda24cea7c3"}

{"id": "p_d911eec9c01d2c20", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 266, "text": "時又有義陽傅肜，先主退軍，斷後拒戰，兵人死盡，吳將語肜令降，肜罵曰：「吳狗！", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "d929d7ec3ab8373e196cac824649430379a5cfc707c0c2c00645b358bb246d9f"}

{"id": "p_e5d2ba4d28e7ae89", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 267, "text": "拜子僉為左中郎，後為關中都督，，又臨危授命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "e08fcf8efecb1f1a9c5409b5a4acd7419e680f919989db96c3268ad05f1eeb3d"}

{"id": "p_241a96931c34fa5e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 268, "text": ": 江陽剛烈，立節明君，", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "811d954f4be3fb221b2557ff5f11fb9e9e9ab9322375e107558ae839f234983e"}

{"id": "p_00873cf81370cc3e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 269, "text": ": 兵合遇寇，不屈其身，", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "62fbacb54c9181d8555fa421fcc4372ae22a2324d50246b712b87e5bf48e7933"}

{"id": "p_821302f2774c5493", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 270, "text": ": 單夫只役，隕命於軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "57125d742e0f2880d830b6b9af97ca5e6e0a2a1fb57dbf086b1cd003af636341"}

{"id": "p_be8c0db6e3514577", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 271, "text": "季然名畿，巴西閬中人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "410c1b5718046a3e69e8ef948e1d0c0f566fd037d02ecb2d8b1c8e4f43d9a2da"}

{"id": "p_32510cfe21f1b732", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 272, "text": "縣有賨人，種類剛猛，昔高祖以定關中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "8282ddff48f440dacdc4007a5bb914fbde0c2ec21df53ca97056bda9554d231a"}

{"id": "p_bf0e04f783a48f0a", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 273, "text": "巴西太守龐羲以天下擾亂，郡宜有武衛，頗招合部曲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "c74275fb081dfd187d21eed4ebd41de0924a3406e564e46c0f9ca0c3c2363436"}

{"id": "p_ed54c16429b75da8", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 274, "text": "有讒於璋，說羲欲叛者，璋陰疑之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "f7796ca10cdc1764196630f265749d85f063169ec832fa8c9eb6b845ac306cff"}

{"id": "p_7b356c9f49bb47ed", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 275, "text": "羲聞，甚懼，將謀自守，遣畿子鬱宣旨，索兵自助。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "78fa99228f2c35d647cb43df3b66e70f4f956bf5675a7b0210cbf93e0018e803"}

{"id": "p_c9383bbdcf08f1f9", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 276, "text": "畿報曰：「郡合部曲，本不為叛，雖有交構，要在盡誠；若必以懼，遂懷異志，非畿之所聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "c33d40396500aface2af1392e7e5189739afca36b9e87d6602825619d0dbcfb1"}

{"id": "p_07aa8aa10542629e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 277, "text": "」並敕鬱曰：「我受州恩，當為州牧盡節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "f59d2c0f413b182fb98d743547f37b56d6b8f3e565d3f067b4fb18b1732bf4ce"}

{"id": "p_e3e053cd1a321b4f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 278, "text": "汝為郡吏，當為太守效力，不得以吾故有異志也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "c046d0286c747daa54200d2ddc056cf1ff23a312cdfdbcc53efa1304f20d330a"}

{"id": "p_6b633b60f6594f91", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 279, "text": "」羲使人告畿曰：「爾子在郡，不從太守，家將及禍！", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "bf9698da0f7faa26e36a6d366f8dc70b9514d9fb09c61abaf70ef52e6b65b0e4"}

{"id": "p_0765cbb24b57c213", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 280, "text": "」畿曰：「昔樂羊為將，飲子之羹，非父子無恩，大義然也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "2d9f6c602b93f93cc510439d67117517a448f195df91db807d788777ee9c2bfa"}

{"id": "p_b6fb7fa93d5e64b1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 281, "text": "」羲知畿必不為己，厚陳謝於璋以致無咎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "b4ce8bf2b2e87f66adc8a2630c52ef4d6a64a746912f5010b04d0a571258453e"}

{"id": "p_dc441e90c5b59022", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 282, "text": "先主領益州牧，闢為從事祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "ca03b92e02e2e8d831951694eec0f393808df77d463ab1a2a36773e1ad52d6a3"}

{"id": "p_616ca84cfaefbc2d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 283, "text": "後隨先主徵吳，遇大軍敗績，溯江而還，或告之曰：「後追已至，解船輕去，乃可以免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "67b1f7298eed38ceaf40d70c05348914d12d75f96f6d27b52e7f531c30e7bd3e"}

{"id": "p_b8bffc72e988f31c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 284, "text": "」畿曰：「吾在軍，未曾為敵走，況從天子而見危哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "2ca84b3b2d772e16049786ab3d452cee9b044fde177bd3f079eff4e7d25621ec"}

{"id": "p_5d066d84c7c49eef", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 285, "text": "」追人遂及畿船，畿身執戟戰，敵船有覆者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "e82cc5963dc3c9977d5bbc7f7a919afb0ba1ae4932bf66ca6a09e1923ffcb01f"}

{"id": "p_caaaa2189799b6f0", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 286, "text": ": 公弘後生，卓爾奇精，", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "554a0a08e9fa7b616cfc32c712520e9d19ad8ce2e6d98aae28703e7a7f53bbcd"}

{"id": "p_f8e6b1201b928621", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 287, "text": ": 夭命二十，悼恨未呈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "9847ff0d399bd5c9d6ce960c643bfcc8a46bb243a6996c0a34fea15aa0ce73e0"}

{"id": "p_c7a5c31177bf6a5c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 288, "text": "公弘，名祁，季然之子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "df6cf61d442d381598952f5f182bc50dd07497cb03b9aadfcb62434cc0c44c8a"}

{"id": "p_0c80debabc80257c", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 289, "text": ": 古之奔臣，禮有來偪，", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "46b4b6e009d22aac952b1069b37ee65663b3fc403d9f83bf8cf26231879e2b12"}

{"id": "p_301681c465fa471f", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 290, "text": ": 怨興司官，不顧大德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "f71ec15d8d27d513431f9cd932efb66ece4f0d0b66ac958ce1e49cd5dcb7e305"}

{"id": "p_a80128d91b64c6b8", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 291, "text": ": 靡有匡救，倍成奔北，", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "6ff7f9a0fd5b853f5f88f0c650d4fd9ed60d06ec23d79d6d19c57716d26363d5"}

{"id": "p_3bd9015b61fe108d", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 292, "text": ": 自絕於人，作笑二國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "18409a954d671b7cb033f4f539dbcb84804d6064f9b8a586e7bf216b855524ac"}

{"id": "p_fe4db6d70a50254e", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 293, "text": "──贊糜芳、士仁、郝普、潘濬", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "e3c95a03472d4059de457179f3d749b8fd87be059284ae1e10701d19785d4b4c"}

{"id": "p_2cb34be68958f7f9", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 294, "text": "糜芳字子方，東海人也，為南郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "80beebc0b5597784d74fa954345a4f4c6b2cfea024918fe3ecfb31bff586c376"}

{"id": "p_36e40bb2bb08ee52", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 295, "text": "士仁字君義，廣陽人也，為將軍，住公安，統屬關羽；與羽有隙，叛迎孫權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "8776a2f056c3b7755e3eee2e4163c4a5aec08adae6a5733ff0ef7a397bd33e23"}

{"id": "p_fcaf56323751ba31", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 296, "text": "先主自荊州入蜀，以普為零陵太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "c871f3e9b46cab178499a96c92c9a5e579fdbd012f5add28892a4f36634b22e5"}

{"id": "p_5feaf4467b35991b", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 297, "text": "為吳將呂蒙所譎，開城詣蒙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "e033fa352a8b4900ca04b1abaf8b6928881c66d29c7d3b8d870298e54088a8d1"}

{"id": "p_6aa72dbbacf79665", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 298, "text": "先主入蜀，以為荊州治中，典留州事，亦與關羽不穆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "dc63371f17483eda2d7a68358776dc513a758b14f5c000c436062154d3cd4dd7"}

{"id": "p_e84c3c5ca7e0ead1", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 299, "text": "普至廷尉，濬至太常，封侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "975236053064476b706de1ed24747f53e9571603ad27610c20bbe9963ce67700"}

{"id": "p_6ef71e1f694c72aa", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 300, "text": "評曰：鄧芝堅貞簡亮，臨官忘家，張翼亢姜維之銳，宗預禦孫權之嚴，咸有可稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "96a68797d0a0d3a6398b10c798b5a04d45487c36214277db03162bfc7a6ca911"}

{"id": "p_e083d58cbabc73aa", "source_id": "src_cf63e8ac344f6db5", "ordinal": 301, "text": "楊戲商略，意在不群，然智度有短，殆罹世難雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "72cead8bdaad41f2082d34188eff701d7df56a39cd72e89790815a92c61f2198"}

{"id": "p_83d203e5a38be605", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_23ffe97c68e15498", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 1, "text": " == 孫堅 == 孫堅字文-{臺}-，呉郡富春人，蓋孫武之-{後}-也。 少爲縣吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "f223fbd659a7fcaf2233541df799e8403e3a81dba070fcaa3d662e8bd1b80178"}

{"id": "p_7bf53dd559741a15", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 2, "text": "年十七，與父共載船至錢唐，會海賊胡玉等從匏-{里}-上掠取賈人財物，方-{於}-岸上分之，行旅皆住，船不敢進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "ed969e0848b5f4187095694d94ea536973327fd0d8275e1d88d3b20d60958ba9"}

{"id": "p_fc77a2f1bd9e7026", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 3, "text": "堅謂父曰：「此賊可擊，請討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "6b61f0fe0348d42829e28910a3cb7e088265af0bd10e6165e951333ce0d63427"}

{"id": "p_f46a0e6f52296db9", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 4, "text": "」父曰：「非爾所圖也。」堅行操刀上岸，以手東西指麾，若分部人兵以羅遮賊狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "af359f6b3ee1ca751110bb79a22a4daa6cae32dc4d408341ba0b32bc00b81529"}

{"id": "p_d94d446b8ac45222", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 5, "text": "賊望見，以爲官兵捕之，-{卽}-委財物散走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "c3e9db1df2609e0d05a09b559efeb557df493e8b63872abc3145950928d59c18"}

{"id": "p_d965fc10e1025783", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 6, "text": "堅追，斬得一級以還。父大驚。由是顯聞，府召署假尉。會稽妖賊許昌起-{於}-句章，自稱陽明皇帝，與其子韶扇動諸縣，衆以萬數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "50be7a8ca188d445f29ae08a5b9fc44b6d8234f2ee476e61bdfbdfbd8c2c6013"}

{"id": "p_87b1dbb50a0b486e", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 7, "text": "堅以郡司馬募召精勇，得千餘人，與州郡合討破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "c20f87fe71fbc06b5d466cc00784a212befe93a84ff0bf7eaddbd99ce843a1a1"}

{"id": "p_1ba45621530b5840", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 8, "text": "是歳，也。刺史臧旻列上功狀，詔書除堅鹽瀆丞，數歳徙盱眙丞，又徙下邳丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "634d557c7cca7bec897adc1f4cd03f02a27d89faa66f1325e0b6f567a03ba052"}

{"id": "p_f1917bdb6257a7c0", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 9, "text": " ，黃巾賊師張角起-{於}-魏郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "a4d14cd7e3d2531360b0828271e780bc2b2f3cc315770e83ae09ea7641f10aa7"}

{"id": "p_87691765245fa302", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 10, "text": "-{託}-有神靈，遣八使以善道教化天下，而潛相連結，自稱黃天泰平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "0c579ea4160031c7ebda711dbab8c2c6bce80be74fb60e1c06b211a5f7c6fe82"}

{"id": "p_9da1d80606230230", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 11, "text": "三月甲子，三十六（萬）一旦俱發，天下響應，燔燒郡縣，殺害長吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "5b07c066b85ec945473f62ad68662f61035a9ad2d0f771d8f5f2684ae03f5dbe"}

{"id": "p_b2d00429bb24bc93", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 12, "text": "漢朝遣車騎將軍皇甫-{崧}-、中郎將朱儁將兵討擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "3c179bf81406ffb1c71736183212293719b59d888dd04622c651e1692633c0e4"}

{"id": "p_2efd25d4a1017e33", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 13, "text": "儁表請堅爲佐軍司馬，鄕-{里}-少年隨在下邳者皆願從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "f3b00b68bd38c861e16447e4260d79bdcd2a9e7e8145c214afb6b58838e9927d"}

{"id": "p_3973a9be58d289c8", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 14, "text": "堅又募諸商旅及淮泗精兵，合千許人，與儁-{並}-力奮擊，所向無前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "2227774485ff272a9df9fa387b43ae4ed503ebd7ef4a88f8d485d3f90d1195a1"}

{"id": "p_2c4b9040c37215e0", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 15, "text": "汝穎賊困迫，走保宛城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "68c6e4b909673b642a080a46b27d4a1de123cfd6b912794bff4ef277eca4b9e5"}

{"id": "p_c8651e23a382f7d4", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 16, "text": "堅身當一面，登城先入，衆乃蟻附，遂大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "aa6743e3d2ac4c96d77e21b67d92c709f731b14b5786810360bbda02fb934695"}
