{"id": "p_629b6c8eaa988f83", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 17, "text": "儁具以狀聞上，拜堅別部司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "4a34658657f251b4686d4c80582d0b2870240798f05ea026154b30aaff5a6e55"}

{"id": "p_3982c25d65c389f3", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 18, "text": " 邊章、韓遂作亂-{涼}-州，中郎將董卓拒討無功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "3ea09e5cb1c8c5d45e5634e689b405aaf69443b371a8ce45aaddaa290ff383bf"}

{"id": "p_edd86867fd5e9fb7", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 19, "text": "，遣司空張溫行車騎將軍，西討章等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "143c124b7c550523413e347d50cc2b0e2fe9b3d7cb5c8cc1dd44c82df18176b2"}

{"id": "p_718e73d82a936b16", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 20, "text": "溫表請堅與參軍事，屯長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "815f645463674d99651911a7187cbd5104bc3a127dcf72f3a5b69d32a4a41cbc"}

{"id": "p_d2bad96bf3fd17ad", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 21, "text": "溫以詔書召卓，卓良久乃詣溫。溫責讓卓，卓應對不順。堅時在坐，前耳語謂溫曰：「卓不怖罪而鴟張大語，宜以召不時至，陳軍法斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "6a306261f9f685aabe0e7c155520cf452ea5f6e4f2029723cd6a2384948a0797"}

{"id": "p_37583bff8dd7bfaa", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 22, "text": "」溫曰：「卓素著威名-{於}-隴蜀之間，今日殺之，西行無依。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "fc9853765f6f182658e269c990ec3a20aca07098e5f4a0045f5a145fadbc0161"}

{"id": "p_fdd715655ca46031", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」堅曰：「明公親率王兵，威震天下，何賴-{於}-卓？", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "7d8b07fa2ca09d9a715dc6460e83d9955614360c1767ed10996907269cae76b4"}

{"id": "p_44901b3ab366ebff", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 24, "text": "觀卓所言，不假明公，輕上無禮，一罪也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "5e91655c92fda7d42a82b5cfaf3ed0e4bba65b0aacea8be07918293e9c44f878"}

{"id": "p_1d959772a11f61bc", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 25, "text": "章遂跋扈經年，當以時進討，而卓-{云}-未可，沮軍疑衆，二罪也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "e20574af59197b39e2712f068ea2de408eec0f2e8baae9c3555e49fdbb454aa8"}

{"id": "p_cffbdee47479d71b", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 26, "text": "卓受任無功，應召稽留，而軒昂自高，三罪也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "caf49e272ca787336fc2cc1d07a15aa2dfb1896435e739cb630888137aadd9d9"}

{"id": "p_07aab64c0ceea605", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 27, "text": "古之名將，仗鉞臨衆，未有不斷斬以示威者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "348c37d0bf3dee883d2e996dc20fcf70f6c56e985bea8129f260093a5f760b83"}

{"id": "p_f24a62d47155ae4b", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 28, "text": "是以穰苴斬莊賈，魏絳戮楊-{干}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "4bc2ec2768d37c9c1f5e1a5f33bfb584c9e7ed6ada7e16042354ca9084f8ad14"}

{"id": "p_258f9964855be9d4", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 29, "text": "今明公垂意-{於}-卓，不-{卽}-加誅，虧損威刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "c7d948a5ad4fdd95369bb6214ab81830c9dd16ed2c573f52d578a0800b08771b"}

{"id": "p_4f49cd610bb9017c", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 30, "text": "-{於}-是在矣。」溫不忍發舉，乃曰：「君且還，卓將疑人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "8411facf691316fb27f0c6d7c7d2334143d01f6eed502e05647e9dded2da1023"}

{"id": "p_8586e17c39d25ae1", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」堅因起出。章遂聞大兵向至，黨衆離散，皆乞降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "dc5ff9f4e69f12c8630ad9bf28a6d74f806f5cacc12626784c3b93c42ab8cd17"}

{"id": "p_3f9a3a6fc8de1943", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 32, "text": "軍還，議者以軍未臨敵，不斷功賞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "c932bcc502a79149b4d3fd238723bc551b120eb2df5a6b496956ade6d4b389c3"}

{"id": "p_ea71208d945809ba", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 33, "text": "然聞堅數卓三罪，勸溫斬之，無不歎息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "fd272ac5fc17d0f483a802d03d73a49ebfbaf4f9d284bae9c9da4fe25a646066"}

{"id": "p_b8c1803ce98e5295", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 34, "text": "拜堅議郎。時長沙賊區星自稱將軍，衆萬餘人攻圍城邑，乃以堅爲長沙太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "bfac48500f7cb200994f99bcafe0d339fceb835e402d428b068f4266075484d2"}

{"id": "p_3c363e56448097c4", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 35, "text": "到郡親率將士，施設方略，旬月之間，克破星等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "a182b94f33e86fb2f2fa98716ac25ac5e3179ed36e95a6c0f1825b4fdb7fe957"}

{"id": "p_573aebd8a900c108", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 36, "text": "周朝、郭石亦帥徒衆起-{於}-零桂，與星相應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "fdaecb156a7bbf649adbd2a70d70e336c0f3569f5701ca39539f0d36b96cc360"}

{"id": "p_3538131bf8e1eccf", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 37, "text": "遂越境尋討，三郡肅然。漢朝録前-{後}-功，封堅爲烏程侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "f6a7e5f0fbbfcbebc8e51540c7f5af88c9dc90d6cd9dfe9aff1c207628c0417d"}

{"id": "p_ee78e1b86e551fc5", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 38, "text": " 靈帝崩，卓擅朝政，橫恣京城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "4088522981bcc0674569c13f3d27b3df7c80c8a5edcf08cc9756ada34228e9e4"}

{"id": "p_1237b579e96361f6", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 39, "text": "諸州郡並興義兵，欲以討卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "61da17e3aa3abc1b760e66bdbca3087d90d414273013bc1d48252184db494c1b"}

{"id": "p_12d96b979b726abe", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 40, "text": "堅亦舉兵。荊州刺史王睿素遇堅無禮，堅過殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "bb33f25cd3ea5423ee5b22498e115527834304952a6c4ed40be9eaa86c2e25b4"}

{"id": "p_c9f375a0fd4ee7ef", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 41, "text": "比至南陽，衆數萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "a0ba9f3940a00139215ac4734fd83229a06bf97aa85eed87e3666149384189eb"}

{"id": "p_6874be4f1363dc9f", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 42, "text": "南陽太守張咨聞軍至，晏然自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "a3799e7703102baa79fe629fe8010047efebbdef0f0a41854802cfefebc79fa2"}

{"id": "p_3d447baa491ae838", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 43, "text": "堅以牛酒禮咨，咨明日亦答詣堅。酒酣，長沙主簿入白堅：「前移南陽，而道路不治，軍資不具，請收主簿推問意故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "ff7bb00054297218962db97f4e3fbc7d674808188b5c82f66de1bce5b0330ec3"}

{"id": "p_aa44436a39b1f4e6", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 44, "text": "」咨大懼欲去，兵陳四周不得出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "4b307c72e2632f5880b8a470f45e1a4ae4652c205d7a0afc383201979fdc97ee"}

{"id": "p_8dd1ed9e95d0ad56", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 45, "text": "有頃，主簿復入白堅：「南陽太守稽停義兵，使賊不時討，請收出案軍法從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "0119c3cac0a6c0552a774a6a6abade56154c5760ce67f550eb03ca4d749e9b41"}

{"id": "p_9d8122583a1c16e9", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 46, "text": "」便牽咨-{於}-軍門斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "f6b1d4fe4248d46f6ca22ecc1572dde0e4e2a9b93edfe5d2632bfe51f68db46f"}

{"id": "p_b96b98f6573f7644", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 47, "text": "郡中震-{慄}-，無求不獲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "6a95f6d7ae643616fa3e23125406d09c9359aa54fa4c1e93187f13b9a9e50bbc"}

{"id": "p_9a736d131627e6b2", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 48, "text": " 前到魯陽，與袁-{術}-相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "96924726e8d742fab0d9267ac9c86c0167609ddca29b3cc38fa479dbdbf00dd4"}

{"id": "p_3bd7d1f656e19c82", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 49, "text": "-{術}-表堅行破虜將軍，領豫州刺史。遂治兵-{於}-魯陽城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "fd5a46a69c34eb1fa3abc3eae71489c996174e7f999cf1b8c239953b927b7314"}

{"id": "p_0c26b5bd8d01ff6c", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 50, "text": "當進軍討卓，遣長史公仇稱將兵從事還州督促軍糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "7b39c3e4c2ace67d65c7f79512cb0cda5e7f06a7f99822b9a87197bbdf571c1a"}

{"id": "p_f9358d1572a94ec4", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 51, "text": "施帳幔-{於}-城東門外，祖道送稱，官屬-{並}-會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "c2b39dc8bc0dcef6cd5863fdf6dda6f707bcb8c77298ecfc3f05c2d60b37d2b0"}

{"id": "p_b50a7e50a8a0bcc2", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 52, "text": "卓遣歩騎數萬人逆堅，輕騎數十先到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "5a874c8c3695ab45e24da3ccc9737e71610841dac1cf57be22ec3005a3af981d"}

{"id": "p_bbae7619f83264c9", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 53, "text": "堅方行酒談笑，敕部曲整頓行陳，無得妄動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "7cf6a362c19e5ed6f8ad14b2bc2df65b6eefaa868eae216d2b45db04e3f62108"}

{"id": "p_8a312bd0407700ca", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 54, "text": "-{後}-騎漸益，堅徐罷坐，導引入城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "b308d312caa9a623b48ef0d45a84b94b5da9ac2056676cf5145e5c9d3dff4b66"}

{"id": "p_6b18391e42743534", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 55, "text": "乃謂左右曰：「向堅所以不-{卽}-起者，恐兵相蹈藉，諸君不得入耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "cdc3e855a7dadb7518c23259b7ba4b1d821d01780190064adf6477da493012d2"}

{"id": "p_1828c3d829d863e0", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 56, "text": "」卓兵見堅士衆甚整，不敢攻城，乃引還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "2290465cfa672a37da8bd0dabd8c866f7c112c7839688acacbe455e6de5c50e4"}

{"id": "p_a4a4ccd6c9e97842", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 57, "text": "堅移屯梁東，大爲卓軍所攻，堅與數十騎潰圍而出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "d42772201fabd41aff0ae5834d5ef0b01ee37b476fcae90fa7ca13d4359a2489"}

{"id": "p_5e818969c6324fe1", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 58, "text": "堅常著赤罽幘，乃脫幘令親近將祖茂著之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "60426ac26351e53b892d056d176b02c77f4bf63db2f197688e00ab13995a6163"}

{"id": "p_3b17da2fb06efed6", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 59, "text": "卓騎爭逐茂，故堅從間道得免。茂困迫，下馬，以幘冠塚閒燒柱，因伏草中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "8a0a69000b53c5891c286a94b8321f41c80b42a6a5f052383aa6f8b081c02060"}

{"id": "p_ac702f2656bdc7e3", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 60, "text": "卓騎望見，圍繞數重，定近覺是柱，乃去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "18f45accf8c69fb2ceb14d58a247cd2d702cb39b727960fec92cbe11f0cea4e9"}

{"id": "p_a0dfa51058d9bf61", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 61, "text": "堅復相收兵，合戰-{於}-陽人，大破卓軍，梟其都督華雄等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "bf709a8b08ef8e0807c9070e812af061a4651d723279b07bc6f89686e98a7b98"}

{"id": "p_c33c9b1af86bad0e", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 62, "text": "是時，或間堅-{於}--{術}-，-{術}-懷疑，不運軍糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "dcb4349443a47d059e81586a3e5b5aa81fd61625d8bcba5a3ee1425c5d7a30e2"}

{"id": "p_5be07c9fdb6a1abc", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 63, "text": "陽人去魯陽百餘-{里}-，堅夜馳見-{術}-，畫地計校，曰：「所以出身不顧，上爲國家討賊，下慰將軍家門之私仇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "991fe935aa29a44d5973a76b79e5e2633f5eccf9a46d795c91108966e45cdb73"}

{"id": "p_b649a899e8af96c5", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 64, "text": "堅與卓非有骨肉之怨也，而將軍受譖潤之言，還相嫌疑！", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "3487cadde931c9f14f587e0aa2f68d44fb3ce41c17c22dd9ff0bc2e86a6119ee"}

{"id": "p_118c7c6825a22359", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 65, "text": "」-{術}-踧踖，-{卽}-調發軍糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "f8bb32def1d9c0a0fbd95fc7febca26e80524d0ecab9988a0a9edfef8c7b8f62"}

{"id": "p_124182bd1a7f8d0d", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 66, "text": "堅還屯。卓憚堅猛壯，乃遣將軍李傕等來求和親。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "f04bf81ee0d9c8c0493f671aaa2e539ec6cd1e7638498bd715bc289b5027dfb9"}

{"id": "p_daff18e4e09281e0", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 67, "text": "令堅列疏子弟任刺史、郡守者，許表用之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "3765ff2fea97fa4cc3a56cbc053ed91990d37a144f98a005e4017825b0389f58"}

{"id": "p_c5db1a3261ab6de8", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 68, "text": "堅曰：「卓逆天無道，蕩覆王室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "5a414132061c906ca73458d92e0402792e942c49e68019ad5d4ee43bf6ce6143"}

{"id": "p_d88386ec353b534d", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 69, "text": "今不夷汝三族，懸示四海，則吾死不瞑目。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "c83fabf50098c9f708167189391d6e703a4f893cac3ce6d96f7f863e9b1ca7c4"}

{"id": "p_fb1ba69ff8df44db", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 70, "text": "豈將與乃和親邪？」復進軍大-{谷}-。拒雒九十-{里}-。卓尋徙都西入關，焚燒雒邑。 堅乃前入至雒，修諸陵，平塞卓所發掘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "a83df826c6438f7b2b615383bc832e5f99ea33b932e3152baa2d2c7300dac358"}

{"id": "p_064ac13dbdf823fe", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 71, "text": "訖，引軍還，住魯陽。 ，-{術}-使堅-{征}-荊州，擊劉表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "56fb4574fcf0e3a02e9982911bf9b7c8fcfef52bfcfe1c56d7695b97830a7f78"}

{"id": "p_77b49a683b03a563", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 72, "text": "表遣黃祖逆-{於}-樊鄧之間。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "399eb96213b2b4f13d180610b2562d8032a3d9580b2cbef369e75273b1a1b4fd"}

{"id": "p_5912209d22380aa9", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 73, "text": "堅擊破之，追渡漢水，遂圍襄陽，單馬行峴山，爲祖軍士所射殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "23b8979c64a4aee649fb9f9fd5e2df70bbf4b8e4c19aef673ece84b1be1564c5"}

{"id": "p_18c894d633cc6d3c", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 74, "text": "兄子賁，帥將士衆就-{術}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "f91bce4004f0fde90a73a5a585b64770c143aee0a550294b1b5c8795495ae8fe"}

{"id": "p_594d25e52e864108", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 75, "text": "-{術}-復表賁爲豫州刺史。 堅四子：策、權、翊、匡。權旣稱尊號，諡堅曰武烈皇帝。 == 孫策 == 策字伯符。堅初興義兵，策將母徙居舒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "b0b796c84dc3d06d096a0f4f6ff3b368bfa4752281f57c40441e6dc42948ca4b"}

{"id": "p_c3e8a5b84261ac3f", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 76, "text": "與周瑜相友，收合士大夫，江淮間人-{咸}-向之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "bf430de215ff4651de71794203563d77a4c6e15988082361a314a9409c2482b8"}

{"id": "p_4947027cb12bd936", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 77, "text": "堅薨，還葬曲阿。已乃渡江居江都。 徐州牧陶謙深忌策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "ae46b2869389ef8fccf629eb99afb7057e363c04ef7bdc445cedccbc0cee8a9b"}

{"id": "p_391b3a14a060c43b", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 78, "text": "策舅呉景，時爲丹楊太守，策乃載母徙曲阿，與呂-{範}-，孫河俱就景。因緣召募得數百人。，從袁-{術}-。-{術}-甚奇之，以堅部曲還策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "d7dbb2c2a5cc5157db04a1d61b7a506c803c111180e2e170db6b1e35bd965240"}

{"id": "p_ca7eb014b47165e3", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 79, "text": "太傅馬日磾杖節安集關東，在壽春以禮-{辟}-策，表拜懷義校尉，-{術}-大將喬蕤、張勳皆傾心敬焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "bb834a4276fe6855ccb9cbd81c297fde97e6aa260cb06cf6501e972f019f1b01"}

{"id": "p_b0aae747a7831096", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 80, "text": "-{術}-常歎曰：「使-{術}-有子如孫郎，死復何恨！", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "2bbdaa43710a0eda38b4ecf1a9858ff2b0152073ad2b2d7f804c8c895f72966b"}

{"id": "p_85cb0468f5506612", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 81, "text": "」策騎士有罪，逃入-{術}-營，隱-{於}-內廄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "f14cbccce7fca40bb8bd558e0dbb871120751de22f2e800d7d98f0c98672e9a5"}

{"id": "p_edf0faa306259d03", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 82, "text": "策指使人就斬之，訖，詣-{術}-謝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "94d2048b37e801c371e8d290ca2ff329375456c1c7d8be4f059923a6555bffb7"}

{"id": "p_523bf68dfcee2608", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 83, "text": "-{術}-曰：「兵人好叛，當共疾之，何爲謝也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "15bee532d7aefd839fcbf930bbbb6811c1dc6f7c58300af4ddf87cd23df0fc02"}

{"id": "p_671c7f567955d7ce", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」由是軍中益畏憚之。-{術}-初許策爲九江太守，已而更用丹楊陳紀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "3a9be917c9e39b3bfb1bdea8a13059e5198ff59cf8bc45cb823628a7fa4d28b9"}

{"id": "p_e9629bd62c59cad8", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 85, "text": "-{後}--{術}-欲攻徐州，從廬江太守陸康求米三萬斛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "a64d89d7bad731480c3250383c9e5e7db63dd0a0950feae5e25bdc9e37651b28"}

{"id": "p_b9ff7ba3d05b29ac", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 86, "text": "康不與，-{術}-大怒。策昔曾詣康，康不見，使主簿接之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "2c319a998ee63d73625def99ef7eaa6e2ef7b70c913d65f5b7a681a189f2294f"}

{"id": "p_20cebc65cf701ddc", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 87, "text": "策常銜恨。-{術}-遣策攻康，謂曰：「前錯用陳紀，每恨本意不遂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "3860f9765323b2ba83539e3f35cb0c615aae6f27904af839388f1c00075be11a"}

{"id": "p_3e90cb4dd446aa5c", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 88, "text": "今若得康，廬江眞卿有也。」策攻康，拔之。-{術}-復用其故吏劉勳爲太守，策益失望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "8f6afd0477c978360b1e3fca4ea5e47bf103f98bfc7ef8c0a1534ef308238f74"}

{"id": "p_59b11dec38086574", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 89, "text": " 先是，劉繇爲揚州刺史，州舊治壽春。壽春，-{術}-已據之，繇乃渡江治曲阿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "1405d9fd4030f32d55578e217ee037ee9902f517dab6f76aaf0afc83882b6d97"}

{"id": "p_76be94c11a61f21d", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 90, "text": "時呉景尙在丹楊，策從兄賁又爲丹揚都尉，繇至，皆迫逐之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "5a7a3db8149cf3c06756c7dcd45d6119bf7c7202fb0bf45041f58ce19a45c753"}

{"id": "p_e5918ea48b35884c", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 91, "text": "景、賁退-{舍}-歷陽。繇遣樊能、-{于}-麋東屯橫江津，張英屯當利口，以距-{術}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "ec2fafdfaf522c451be3f666ede1cf3e644411b934a5bb6ddc2e861fb9dbbb45"}

{"id": "p_2fc9d616f579a58e", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 92, "text": "-{術}-自用故吏琅邪惠衢爲揚州刺史，更以景爲督軍中郎將，與賁共將兵擊英等，連年不克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "6d64c0e6a8c64d7db80c5eda28ff60ef76ac2c4a9ea7927e340461b40397bf15"}

{"id": "p_af58a8158b1be790", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 93, "text": "策乃説-{術}-，乞助景等平定江東。-{術}-表策爲折-{衝}-校尉，行殄寇將軍，兵財千餘，騎數十匹，賓客-{願}-從者數百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "3830ebd289f283ad856a024642246522b5f85b98f60f82af2c0d2cfa5f607581"}

{"id": "p_90750790a52fa7cc", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 94, "text": "比至歷陽，衆五六千。策母先自曲阿徙-{於}-歷陽，策又徙母阜陵，渡江轉-{鬥}-，所向皆破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "ebf94f34d5109615f3e2a184248d4d12fec4664b7dfad7f09b753eebcfe27923"}

{"id": "p_b2c099661ce66095", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 95, "text": "莫敢當其鋒，而軍令整肅，百姓懷之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "99850e7afb114f4322a7de160be7bb0b62f85de80ef15ef134b1ec89d2874140"}

{"id": "p_3e18ba97919e4ac7", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 96, "text": " 策爲人，美姿顔，好笑語，性闊達-{聽}-受，善-{於}-用人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "26ebfd217ccde77cec38dd4cba646d57d391578832691d69c0e8d70a1ac1f65e"}

{"id": "p_1a2fd7475096e063", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 97, "text": "是以士民見者，莫不盡心，樂爲致死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "155828d3cbf7956e60e07cc0055ab602f3b5d77dd1f108a9d513cfc8103aa52f"}

{"id": "p_7667976485dcb697", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 98, "text": "劉繇棄軍遁逃，諸郡守皆捐城郭奔走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "604f1be52cb96d71fb72587cde1400a17073c542a2e07c13d4b12a9a690b543e"}

{"id": "p_057c343d4628afb1", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 99, "text": "呉人嚴白虎等衆各萬餘人，處處屯聚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "9b0cc3724c2af1edd867d030e1fff126ed15aa56be676933d1f8aac3f1e75c6f"}

{"id": "p_a207893e3868671f", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 100, "text": "呉景等欲先擊破虎等，乃至會稽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "61cb416c1279e65a313f86f6d93207d585ada67557e91ce27f7dfb1cecb5c027"}

{"id": "p_e0564eda94987995", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 101, "text": "策曰：「虎等群盜，非有大-{志}-，此成禽耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "f821fd23ed7382b450d3856369aa2b4818c23c78c2ffb78f1ff044ca5c3d3a93"}

{"id": "p_de82092acd7e57a8", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 102, "text": "」遂引兵渡浙江，-{據}-會稽，屠東冶，乃攻破虎等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "be14e2e7a3d0b56df87ca6ff6bbd64f13e5636058f0ac04a6f48783ef65e6a44"}

{"id": "p_16850fd488f349e8", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 103, "text": "盡更置長吏，策自領會稽太守，復以呉景爲丹楊太守，以孫賁爲豫章太守，分豫章爲廬陵郡，以賁弟輔爲廬陵太守，丹揚朱治爲呉郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "a467b150d0803114303d9f472beca7fd155d13cc83ea34bb679922bccd3c1e63"}

{"id": "p_852c338e2abcdcd1", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 104, "text": "彭城張昭、廣陵張紘、秦-{松}-、陳端等，爲謀主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "38aeb56bef92f53d52731b6190d74a1c2af2212ce1586e54299f2f6b5bb1b5ae"}

{"id": "p_d072d4363296883f", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 105, "text": " 時袁-{術}-僭號，策以書責而絶之。 曹公表策爲討逆將軍，封爲呉侯。 -{後}--{術}-死，長史楊弘、大將張勳等將其衆欲就策，廬江太守劉勳要擊，悉虜之，收其珍寶以歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "17369b3b621cff4eaecccd6649a1a034d960f4baa33d749961032e97779fa2cd"}

{"id": "p_c8fda1bf44da6655", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 106, "text": "策聞之，僞與勳好盟。勳新得-{術}-衆，時豫章上繚宗民萬餘家在江東。策勸勳攻取之。勳旣行，策輕軍晨夜襲拔廬江，勳衆盡降，勳獨與麾下數百人自歸曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "e7f8e7395374b64d6668f5571da49b51e9f3fad7561e925ebd4652bb15bc5d41"}

{"id": "p_1380ff011c04f87e", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 107, "text": "是時袁紹方強，而策-{併}-江東，曹公力未能逞，且欲撫之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "01dabca2bc8ab62d8c295254b68fe006682a792095807a0a0a4302404be6f94b"}

{"id": "p_ad398834abb91f1d", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 108, "text": "乃以弟女配策小弟匡，又爲子彰取賁女，皆禮-{辟}-策弟權、翊，又命揚州刺史嚴象舉權茂-{才}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "fea690955ba1bd2c17fcab3c2f8f3899144ca5c493e520ab5489c70e0d636ad5"}

{"id": "p_b186fe7d6d223ca9", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 109, "text": " ，曹公與袁紹相拒-{於}-官渡，策陰欲襲許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "101c57cc725c26d1c165e6c2dbc7f6200efa753c7cffbeb9569cbb02467dbd89"}

{"id": "p_9af725bc08bd6186", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 110, "text": "迎漢帝，密治兵，部署諸將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "16b08394caab266424d00acdbece7b2470036b5497700a0fb66642fb2d375214"}

{"id": "p_c4e9d1a5be231a6a", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 111, "text": "未發，會爲故呉郡太守許貢客所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "5d96e707515f081836b30ccac2d4a348cfeaf606344142133f3205f037084572"}

{"id": "p_0c9a77f512e783f0", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 112, "text": " 先是，策殺貢，貢小子與客亡匿江邊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "d89c10cb867e217822d81cf75a765c7204b33c7db5425cb7137eefafb029afb4"}

{"id": "p_1f35fe69fd91e60f", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 113, "text": "策單騎出，卒與客遇，客擊傷策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "2ba941d5e275ba85111c40b99b01f707672d5443b3182dd22b07bd0a90e67759"}

{"id": "p_194ce05ca5608b2f", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 114, "text": "創甚，請張昭等謂曰：「中國方亂，夫以呉越之衆，三江之固，足以觀成敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "a77b0697fb90b34971b0d9c5af5efc8c22ef7b537d13e227b370a530ea41744a"}

{"id": "p_4f64f3462e18f219", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 115, "text": "公等善相吾弟！」呼權佩以印綬，謂曰：「舉江東之衆，決-{機}--{於}-兩陳之間，與天下爭衡，卿不如我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "b52dc4fe2ff43577185ac6f5281f48e5c4f651eca475b199bb88be0a01c6ac4d"}

{"id": "p_c315404603cd070d", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 116, "text": "舉賢任能，各盡其心，以保江東，我不如卿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "88f811d0508e584027ec278e174706506c077b08584af77b738664088d98f823"}

{"id": "p_34edf8d0474bc6e3", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 117, "text": "」至夜卒，時年二十六。 權稱尊號，追諡策曰長沙桓王，封子紹爲呉侯，-{後}-改封上虞侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "7142750c5c2931c6ff958c7b612377b541f890c2e007178c7e0c0e9b170bac3d"}

{"id": "p_78341c8adab4e28b", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 118, "text": "紹卒，子奉嗣。孫皓時，訛言謂奉當立，誅死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "1b571613b579c60d36e92a93e73f303ab4ee753696a8327647f83be2f057b851"}

{"id": "p_81eb80696c4024b7", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 119, "text": " == 【評】 == 評曰：「孫堅勇摯剛毅，孤微發跡，導溫戮卓，山陵杜塞，有忠壯之烈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "f5e9ae407923b3fe189d55c64ab1e2557c6cf7018fd0f1c53d392c74f3fef4df"}

{"id": "p_c09bf9cd642d4d54", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 120, "text": "策英氣傑濟，猛鋭冠世，覽奇取異，-{志}-陵中夏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "920875ca5f36c943c4a3f89ef097af6e0c06fb7cb7a3c8869cfae7b64364d70d"}

{"id": "p_781366222c1e3cd9", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 121, "text": "然皆輕佻果躁，隕身致敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "dbb72337edfc65d007e11974fa54b481ceccddad2eb62cf00f1964b97844ef11"}

{"id": "p_b4a38796e85e245f", "source_id": "src_89a199d35db6aed2", "ordinal": 122, "text": "且割據江東，策之基兆也。而權尊祟未至，子止侯爵，-{於}-義儉矣。」 46", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "cf8def0cbb1f8d8eec1f1eebbaee594f92a72be7078784ab7537bb077f3b4568"}

{"id": "p_e5f9271b35b8bb1f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 1, "text": "兄策旣定諸郡，時權年十五，以爲陽羨長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "4fc1bd55637fc2938cde9fde86c2444f72cd6a8bf66b03e440e80cdebb07d673"}

{"id": "p_839f926757fa0825", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 2, "text": "郡察孝廉，州舉茂才，行奉義校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "55174afb44fef5bea2e621509d50852b9df50acda6cac804df51bfd94fd94be8"}

{"id": "p_cab9e99e31ba1ff2", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 3, "text": "漢以策遠修職貢，遣使者劉琬加錫命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "2cbb3f18d49407870f4ebd0723ee1d2f4c92e58869312746a57b49850d4144ce"}

{"id": "p_f69bf98bde1a1f75", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 4, "text": "琬語人曰：「吾觀孫氏兄弟雖各才秀明達，然皆祿祚不終。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "4d9244d9b625e6d45be4a9f672cede59a5eac991408c94da1193b9002a44dfe8"}

{"id": "p_c38a37d0926f7c22", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 5, "text": "惟中弟孝廉，形貌奇偉，骨體不恆，有大貴之表，年又最壽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "ddf8860e58fe68ece2417cb5face90a83d079b075ff7f9383186d6e8eb0b5342"}

{"id": "p_1051032b23b9f57a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 6, "text": "，從策-{征}-廬江太守劉勳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "ab5ea0d9b2aca12273fd657767efcf06d1d897c8861a30b22a46eaa745fb0a4d"}

{"id": "p_05c952f1eb0cf4fc", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 7, "text": "策薨，以事授權，權哭未及息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "848c497d617628e71a1941c675c9648bf938beb4668a05d7a70d35bcdd158dda"}

{"id": "p_769853a866a1c286", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 8, "text": "策長史張昭謂權曰：「孝廉，此寧哭時邪?且周公立法而伯禽不師，非欲違父，時不得行也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "0aaf69de3872920144c7c1b6e83a347a0b0881dcef743f6a6ba2aa9a46a0375c"}

{"id": "p_f8efe5dc2d462dd1", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 9, "text": "況今奸宄競逐，豺狼滿道，乃欲哀親戚，顧禮制，是猶開門而揖盜，未可以爲仁也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "16cefa3b927504a1b351b61c5d96759391ab10ffb22222ddc6e559c3925bb994"}

{"id": "p_e25c53b3730c69f8", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」乃改易權服，扶令上馬，使出巡軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "e163c87c392c4aec1ecd8d62da82313b81fc0e2809db8bbe8fa0f9bc0c72af0d"}

{"id": "p_c3704f84bfc0ab89", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 11, "text": "是時，惟有會稽、吳郡、丹楊、豫章、廬陵，然深險之地猶未盡從，而天下英豪布在州郡，賓旅寄寓之士以安危去就爲意，未有君臣之固。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "3a10dc35f7c49b90790dda387d74fc80905b7255ad140f1a33ff22f71af04525"}

{"id": "p_91fb6d096bce0e38", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 12, "text": "張昭、周瑜等謂權可與共成大業，故委心而服事焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "365a5f5f56799f7329025cee68e8f9f6a6e54ff2d84021f511a91961143a6964"}

{"id": "p_eed116190cafab80", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 13, "text": "曹公表權爲討虜將軍，領會稽太守，屯吳，使丞之郡行文書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "c1e984f9dc0a2f43c8097d98e7f1e209b6206d2288cac4f2d1af9fd72b7d8bd1"}

{"id": "p_c8df93f5bb12ac7e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 14, "text": "待張昭以師傅之禮，而周瑜、程普、呂範等爲將率。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "cb7bf8ec07c5b9e7894ff38d7afa1b82131032eecd0d435bc6d7a5322c85159b"}

{"id": "p_cefccc45ef38798e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 15, "text": "招延俊秀，聘求名士，魯肅、諸葛瑾等始爲賓客。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "701c9471633147477be805d4163d882380cd55431b20a657ac4d5aa7c3ce11dc"}

{"id": "p_954cb0e6f87d93e6", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 16, "text": "分部諸將，鎮撫山越，討不從命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "d3b293273004f1f8eec8425c3016d8b91f1e42aa8a8389d10c1789964c94e04e"}

{"id": "p_38beb6bcf8207c95", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 17, "text": "八年，權西伐黃祖，破其舟軍，惟城未克，而山寇復動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "1667a68de8a2f45ecab476a1dcd6aa949898288f0e5f37dee8e24a68b404f2a8"}

{"id": "p_1bafe69beb038273", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 18, "text": "還過豫章，使呂範平鄱陽，（會稽）程普討樂安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "c2c8ba1a1460d378c06e7bb9cf9ae864c4d36a4ee901e437ade1ddbf8b91ca06"}

{"id": "p_72cba70f7d998616", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 19, "text": "太史慈領海昏，韓當、周泰、呂蒙等爲劇縣令長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "1ebdeda1dd4492ca9d02500a8986167b9ebb90f096b4d51578c279a24e98c5d4"}

{"id": "p_9d8f036fd455e4e7", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 20, "text": "九年，權弟丹楊太守翊爲左右所害，以從兄瑜代翊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "c5cdd6baf46002882f59a19ed6f488476ce429b01ac7a1fcc38d284197faf545"}

{"id": "p_57a69c315bad36eb", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 21, "text": "十年，權使賀齊討上饒，分爲建平縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "387567a66c289fd72174d1fed8a92d21c2df066db17b963d2b0ea7427b4b9230"}

{"id": "p_40baf01cf843aa67", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 23, "text": "十三年春，權復-{征}-黃祖，祖先遣舟兵拒軍，都尉呂蒙破其前鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "52b4c20f5f132f607b7bc1fd463b44a3f706741734337260880f32fc1d9d439a"}

{"id": "p_2b7c5d80b37d5fa3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 24, "text": "而淩統、董襲等盡銳攻之，遂屠其城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "c75a5b6f7d4d8ebe14d1c8a1989101f55dd94e34195645501f6e972dc01c1afa"}

{"id": "p_bfdde3101faca382", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 25, "text": "祖挺身亡走，騎士馮則追梟其首，虜其男女數萬口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "3629b53eb3870d06f80737adb542126a7a326f71096f4df94653a66c114af4ca"}

{"id": "p_7884be3e1171039e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 26, "text": "是歳，使賀齊討黟、歙，分歙爲始新、新定、犂陽、休陽縣，以六縣爲新都郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "a80e5f3df7551f8d68fdc7ab4a59a0bd21be5bbb9330cc03260d603ddb2715eb"}

{"id": "p_59ba019ab2ff5e81", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 27, "text": "荊州牧劉表死，魯肅乞奉命弔表二子，且以觀變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "0c6caf5891e3680393f45c27722d42cf236991210d3237cfe0d207c08714d8aa"}

{"id": "p_03bcade3a1618d00", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 28, "text": "肅未到，而曹公已臨其境，表子琮舉眾以降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "395209ee5c55d7fe15404a7a585bef18721af9f61a813147e4c69b7854521767"}

{"id": "p_fe11d5829fbf3aa9", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 29, "text": "劉備欲南濟江，肅與相見，因傳權旨，爲陳成敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "012a3c01d849a0b6287235fe1861defc42e2d5450e73053b60322d9850dedc4e"}

{"id": "p_6f07f5320b8b37ac", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 30, "text": "備進住夏口，使諸葛亮詣權，權遣周瑜、程普等行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "ebda5fb0eb36c3a047ad125bbca0bee5e652826f8bb74e9217c6aaf65c512337"}

{"id": "p_3355c4d46f3af62f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 31, "text": "是時曹公新得表眾，形勢甚盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "6e013c20e5803c85a4665a68e90ff208444456badbf2a5c3882376d7e5c52383"}

{"id": "p_db0e29ab6e487a6b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 32, "text": "諸議者皆望風畏懼，多勸權迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "e5e2bd0df4417f3312f6fee3001f8c5f7deb1093106c293ebd76482e393bee0d"}

{"id": "p_5a7d95ec17fc071f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 33, "text": "惟瑜、肅執拒之儀，意與權同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "b34ab9f03f9ceca55a8ca850d9522a72b57d76500a58962309e8af93160e22cd"}

{"id": "p_9bf265fa7f2e1c16", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 34, "text": "瑜、普爲左右督，各領萬人，與備俱進，遇於赤壁，大破曹公軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "a2f3f97e3e0e704561de57860226466795f1a3fc61ae2524b30fd5d8c6c3e11f"}

{"id": "p_48313ec1f2b56099", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 35, "text": "公燒其餘船引退，士卒饑疫，死者大半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "2bb922f770e42172000aa3b1ccda4ecf26780877dc64c3a30e6e6423a073da82"}

{"id": "p_d9afae4954fdd557", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 36, "text": "曹公遂北還，留曹仁、徐晃於江陵，使樂進守襄陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "c13a2667b11b5bebbb3f54205c8229d3a22bb665e15d11cb1488797cad0fb188"}

{"id": "p_5a8db0d3405f049e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 37, "text": "時甘寧在夷陵，爲仁黨所圍，用呂蒙計，留淩統以拒仁，以其半救寧，軍以勝反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "9db13d07adccb6d73905c656aaa99653d62915e8e9438f4aabbfa6fc4fb4a151"}

{"id": "p_2c4a46170b7181ef", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 38, "text": "權自率眾圍合肥，使張昭攻九江之當塗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "df8c379d74bea582884bc98a10f7d4e160b132e11efdf1dcd9b72b3c65cfb6e3"}

{"id": "p_3b2a0ba628e60585", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 39, "text": "昭兵不利，權攻城逾月不能下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "33ea20a9befcb3af9e04c2dbdfe7b0ca30299a8a380dc63f5c046dd37fb157cf"}

{"id": "p_29ca557a9132348f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 40, "text": "曹公自荊州還，遣張喜將騎赴合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "79e1e5415198cdd9bc0a5dbe1b12c3d06d9d909ef8e7b294ce202c6ea6bb874b"}

{"id": "p_7fd02da0798d6dd6", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 41, "text": "十四年，瑜、仁相守歳餘，所殺傷甚眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "ca287afc134b079ecd6acd7b484679ed3dfec3f28242d1e53bd7518abb94ec0f"}

{"id": "p_b968b815384257dc", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 42, "text": "劉備表權行車騎將軍，領徐州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "03cb4a5a64223908c9a9003bdfea31ca1a829c3b94d94a3041d7498d1ce247d2"}

{"id": "p_3335751fce1b781b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 43, "text": "十五年，分豫章爲鄱陽郡；分長沙爲漢昌郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "3442935c684f208a4ca70f8f1b13b1b74e82453fb2378039cfbc1b24fc75be30"}

{"id": "p_b3ec6fb86f7ff5cc", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 44, "text": "明年，城石頭，改秣陵爲建業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "f9b93595daeb7fa2ba64c6ed94eda307bd9cf46cd15f2bb15319b584a9ce81c4"}

{"id": "p_48f6ec89f7323f6d", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 45, "text": "聞曹公將來侵，作濡須塢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "60b10c37ba96d34c4a7ab41c0b440435ca322afacd37b801f7b2d08590590070"}

{"id": "p_8763bb1748021cb9", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 46, "text": "十八年正月，曹公攻濡須，權與相拒月餘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "62fbd9b9d05b1c75dfa8d13f67d20a65b4f2a743b309a760db5229827990b999"}

{"id": "p_0ace64ca636bb15c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 47, "text": "曹公望權軍，歎其齊肅，乃退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "924bb5680878235c6ebc37bcdc2087a0a4a3f7056192b635d256487cdec229f9"}

{"id": "p_ee153ca8215e4665", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 48, "text": "初，曹公恐江濱郡縣爲權所略，-{徵}-令內移。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "7702b0b564330f3b85eeca0e9694bec1af7a23ddd4549557cb4f5c8481cbb25f"}

{"id": "p_4e0b3a4a99ec28e5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 49, "text": "民轉相驚，自廬江、九江、蘄春、廣陵戸十餘萬皆東渡江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "bbd90b579ae0b754809c910e2f57bcac2a5fca6072f7f34c1320fab931d4fd9e"}

{"id": "p_97395bc587581ff3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 50, "text": "江西遂虛，合肥以南惟有皖城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "a8379bbbf9a1fdcc329a95c301a30a60ea989b015a2e6e34cf393a6e851ce084"}

{"id": "p_d22e212f7a29fcf2", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 52, "text": "獲廬江太守-{朱}-光及參軍董和，男女數萬口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "9130fbcf650a733ff49e47900c047b1aac0ba00dbd29db895da853319bf71705"}

{"id": "p_2b91c2616451a789", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 53, "text": "權以備已得益州，令諸葛瑾從求荊州諸郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "5741428afdf732ca2e9ab0a9be75bccebf517520e2092b09d9ff85003b6e8dbc"}

{"id": "p_d3292f94bdc7130c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 54, "text": "備不許，曰：「吾方圖涼州，涼州定，乃盡以荊州與吳耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "29736c17897616d4efeb8d725ae2400427acee504ac9660e478dad7938a59cf0"}

{"id": "p_a5ab04d12ce219da", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」權曰：「此假而不反，而欲以虛辭引歳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "250102561d631f3b0d9a0ab7c2a2085111db6bee56cf4239d2790fa19b4ca565"}

{"id": "p_6b40acbd902838df", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 56, "text": "」遂置南三郡長吏，關羽盡逐之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "673d9f8bbd176d89cc4b5c2033d8d22ff34dd5c438624d34895edfea101a9598"}

{"id": "p_b21dd886d59e1bc2", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 57, "text": "權大怒，乃遣呂蒙督鮮於丹、徐忠、孫規等兵二萬取長沙、零陵、桂陽三郡；使魯肅以萬人屯巴丘以御關羽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "70ed100ebb233ec76970d5b2a1de6fbc95a0981ebfa56466f6a6cd27d2c12a2e"}

{"id": "p_e03dfeaabb185395", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 58, "text": "蒙到，二郡皆服，惟零陵太守郝普未下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "1c2b5a7346e4ded43f602131a1cf0cdfcc201aa23ecd88993503d7b98de722de"}

{"id": "p_8230a57856bcf250", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 59, "text": "會備到公安，使關羽將三萬兵至益陽，權乃召蒙等使還助肅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "fe9483d04aa5ad224da87798fb97ce548561ebf4dc08dcf21ea6d72dc2a35059"}

{"id": "p_356c6e420fccfab5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 60, "text": "蒙使人誘普，普降，盡得三郡將守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "12a31d08637b570c76a2e24b4443382eb8c8131cdea63e5bf6b97bb4161491ea"}

{"id": "p_6e7e050fa46012e7", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 61, "text": "因引軍還，與孫皎、潘璋並魯肅兵並進，拒羽於益陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "08cea8f34b08ce5a6502188df235ba63e39f317555247c7a87e0fa8fe4b23fe9"}

{"id": "p_4b6cc6542681a528", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 62, "text": "未戰，會曹公入漢中，備懼失益州，使使求和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "3d990d95e4546150a36230039e83c0eda7e338804720c8aecd317212546f1159"}

{"id": "p_2d9ce2a3e2872230", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 63, "text": "權令諸葛瑾報，更尋盟好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "0109cd922adf0bdcf72fd1f12e8525306101b683b376914d6e46ba08c80c51ea"}

{"id": "p_50080141bff6330f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 64, "text": "遂分荊州、長沙、江夏、桂陽以東屬權，南郡、零陵、武陵以西屬備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "e5218b579d75f1fb8c0acdeab04cf0649b79f9b44fac5047e6fa0cd53a8d2820"}

{"id": "p_4a075ffb11bacddb", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 65, "text": "權反自陸口，遂-{征}-合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "ec29754e122f0b27de7df0ae707ab6498e42194166bd60197b8710f25e92c5b0"}

{"id": "p_eae9d8f867aa5c87", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 66, "text": "兵皆就路，權與淩統、甘寧等在津北爲魏將張遼所襲，統等以死扞權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "94ad8d115b7ba6d6a0ce74fd5907fd509c19b0691993a26886ca60f0a4136037"}

{"id": "p_356bf908b7b7c355", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 67, "text": "二十一年冬，曹公次於居巢，遂攻濡須。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "0d4d0d4227642f68cea2cf1979d9bb24480976e16289c471a50a97a94a14f3ea"}

{"id": "p_93af9ab84e73cc7a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 68, "text": "二十二年春，權令都尉徐詳詣曹公請降，公報使修好，誓重結婚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "af0357309ba636c221d99cce2603d996483bc101cd2d3763014dbf4b783f1f28"}

{"id": "p_c5483de369b5975f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 69, "text": "二十三年十月，權將如吳，親乘馬射虎於庱亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "e16aa8ed8df46467faba107aff6af9d0ec603fcdce2c197c7006c33f8782b01e"}

{"id": "p_d383389c4b031364", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 70, "text": "馬爲虎所傷，權投以雙戟，虎卻廢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "887902dbf24c36121f49dbcefc69338e6bb457cf44f9cb1e895764e52fbc3545"}

{"id": "p_9614aa2eda7e83ac", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 71, "text": "二十四年，關羽圍曹仁於襄陽，曹公遣左將軍于禁救之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "a3b3401bba92323614f564d2e5a463d71ee84c2e1fe5ff19ab7b03306416ee8b"}

{"id": "p_63f1188a8fad4caf", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 72, "text": "會漢水暴起，羽以舟兵盡生虜禁等步騎三萬送江陵，惟城未拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "bc9daa3e2446d824fd8b6b8643450d6afa43834d075a6ab92a906bad15d46522"}

{"id": "p_2b46398ded1ad20b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 73, "text": "權內憚羽，外欲以爲己功，箋與曹公，乞以討羽自效。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "35548efea848b771a5f18e75a52f905bd30209ee17aada422f0b825a8e874a9b"}

{"id": "p_00287fddee39cbb4", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 74, "text": "曹公且欲使羽與權相持以鬬之，驛傳權書，使曹仁以弩射示羽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "e78179a81677604152954dee5cac8d8261aa1d84a06c818767dadae73514ce7b"}

{"id": "p_f108b2ec6be2fd53", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 75, "text": "閏月，權-{征}-羽，先遣呂蒙襲公安，獲將軍士仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "f963acbae14abf7d726ec66194d912a2e77e99b23bdce302a0de99896378927c"}

{"id": "p_d07faed214bed877", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 76, "text": "蒙到南郡，南郡太守糜芳以城降，蒙據江陵，撫其老弱，釋於禁之囚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "0e854413bd0520ad672d2955e4a8da4eafd683eb64238c016e58605db6786ed0"}

{"id": "p_1a2eecc3b408ff2c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 77, "text": "陸遜別取宜都，獲秭歸、枝江、夷道，還屯夷陵，守峽口以備蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "ea5cf4b42c9f159ccff1accd46782cb938fe4fb902c58f75c0e64e3c34689bfd"}

{"id": "p_75d991c2591bdfd5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 78, "text": "羽偽降，立幡旗爲像人於城上，因遁走，兵皆解散，尚十餘騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "7619b18ea49e28af713f3f9ccdc5e88ddb9e9b98fc436eea021cb25a10c25fb4"}

{"id": "p_57254954dfacd3b6", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 79, "text": "權先使-{朱}-然、潘璋斷其徑路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "f85fa20d642c693c3854ed102e647c063a643b299abb63a19e205e9a81c3b382"}

{"id": "p_3ee66b543bdd5894", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 80, "text": "十二月，璋司馬馬忠獲羽及其子平、都督趙累等於章鄉，遂定荊州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "81447a1dd23191540275304bb7952da0080d4115bde69dac67a7cd23ed8c829d"}

{"id": "p_223b91f83e9cd29e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 81, "text": "是歳大疫，盡除荊州民租稅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "23dbb9397dbd9d6e023c2cc05cf62089974324c6eafaf55a20472dc28e170528"}

{"id": "p_b824d280b82cbd6c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 82, "text": "曹公表權爲驃騎將軍，假節領荊州牧，封南昌侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "7c5a8022292374fcf30d08fb85aa2caf7bddc830a970175ec324d0dbad5e4020"}

{"id": "p_d671a1d49e5bc2ce", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 83, "text": "及令王惇市馬，又遣-{朱}-光等歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "bdd02a29df13f50a47db9e4d5d95a51268e2d06da0cb3c90ec0a5c4fb1c37d60"}

{"id": "p_5d2531fac6d651fe", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 84, "text": "二十五年春正月，曹公薨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "6fc3a6dc79fe826e97ab784b6874a08fd1e78f6b86e3cdc0ef3913b1a6d6fe7b"}

{"id": "p_0dafa60e6053547b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 85, "text": "太子丕代爲丞相魏王，改年爲延康。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "8773a07d4916d9c52b4f94a088896a1fbfab626368983c3cd22a15ec1526a144"}

{"id": "p_3129f5d346863193", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 86, "text": "秋，魏將梅敷使張儉求見撫納。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "d48dd8e1353b0ba00fa2b987369b0a10a3185c24ecea2eba12e84b4387ab8ed6"}

{"id": "p_06d2d19f7fe839a1", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 87, "text": "南陽陰、酇築陽、山都、中廬五縣民五千家來附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "e434f003131fde689429b8c85f1f3dfe7eb1e64bab9245e273b691af539aa126"}

{"id": "p_7c4b4462593bb1f2", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 88, "text": "冬，魏嗣王稱尊號，改元爲黃初。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "3298ac24c5ffc4ac682f519cf22ad025a4118f23019fc9d048fc5d492d27cb89"}

{"id": "p_da650f8caa393659", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 89, "text": "二年四月，劉備稱帝於蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "6898f93c3fb97e40cd732055d8f289643ffda762fee9d0081589e75cea5aa022"}

{"id": "p_db6b69a9928d5d0c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 90, "text": "權自公安都鄂，改名武昌，以武昌、下雉、尋陽、陽新、柴桑、沙羨六縣爲武昌郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "0f637507ca61a7a4f445b46f24f34a488998d038f371b393df88dbf1fac711e8"}

{"id": "p_045574d5219b3484", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 91, "text": "八月，城武昌，下令諸將曰：「夫存不忘亡，安必慮危，古之善教。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "c73b829e737696215523e6268bb5a5b8487ecc12c317105a53003aadfe7f6d87"}

{"id": "p_49776c53088a2947", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 92, "text": "昔雋不疑漢之名臣，於安平之世刀劍不離於身，蓋君子之於武備，不可以已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "170befaa1bf1a619d966d5a8482aa49158f6e0d1f792a85da94e6a941a9e8fde"}

{"id": "p_d1d4dad76174b6be", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 93, "text": "況今處身疆畔，豺狼交接，而可輕忽不思變難哉?頃聞諸將出入，各尚謙約，不從人兵，甚非備慮愛身之謂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "170349af2bcf11787101c3f555e999a7002f7244c84f9d802eb9102de7b67439"}

{"id": "p_70b1d267de913b4e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 94, "text": "夫保己遺名，以安君親，孰與危辱?宜深警戒，務祟其大，副孤意焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "1b01dde6c57b3f0ebdd848d5157cb3730d7909b71dee041494ac05894fe9a831"}

{"id": "p_36d97599a6cb5aad", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」自魏文帝踐阼，權使命稱藩，及遣-{于}-禁等還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "3a5601d3d532e1c3e6c2bda7d032d1dd18576cf070a0939ce376a0a45edc240d"}

{"id": "p_eecef3a475888a35", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 96, "text": "「蓋聖王之法，以德設爵，以功制祿；勞大者祿厚，德盛者禮豐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "9eeebc20a439f167be72759baa452efeb71e9637795802a32c4a345eee69c4f4"}

{"id": "p_1754169827d21b95", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 97, "text": "故叔旦有夾輔之勳，太公有鷹揚之功，並啟土宇，並受備物，所以表章元功，殊異賢哲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "ca04307e7bd1b9a18be09c62dcc19af8d98499b7ff527eec42dca0f35a3de742"}

{"id": "p_c9108a9ef9ad805b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 98, "text": "近漢髙祖受命之初，分裂膏腴以王八姓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "077ade7d15f1f81c21e32df35a13cd40283de6edf0313c99c443f52230297e51"}

{"id": "p_29142e40b81af49c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 99, "text": "斯則前世之懿事，-{后}-王之元龜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "08b70fce7f5738ee52c9d11b02da46d980a8e0ff5061b9032a93e438ac4456b1"}

{"id": "p_faea0cef7d5d32f3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 100, "text": "朕以不德，承運革命，君臨萬國，秉統天機。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "cbac72477cea6e530f1e663875fed46f3a2e259750e8377f9ffe82b441e437d7"}

{"id": "p_809a82fe9d3720e9", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 101, "text": "惟君天資忠亮，命世作佐，深睹歷數，達見廢興。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "9f9bdbc7daf90e23f4311087abcda691777ded5989558a23a649fb47fd7d0bbc"}

{"id": "p_172923b32584a27c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 102, "text": "望風影附，抗疏稱藩，兼納纖絺南方之貢，普遣諸將來還本朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "e38ba18dc89cd6e1ed7e010e2152da583272bc0b75d246b1d6c9259c21a586d4"}

{"id": "p_86d60879492c1614", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 103, "text": "忠肅內發，款誠外昭，信著金石，義蓋山河。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "7a9229be4ce9be81a16d7049cb57abd4076454fefd5efdb789496e3f9103bec6"}

{"id": "p_44cbd4e5a4f97a5b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 104, "text": "今封君爲吳王，使使持節太常髙平侯貞，授君璽綬策書、金虎符第一至第五、左竹使符第一至第十，以大將軍使持節督交州，領荊州牧事，錫君靑土，苴以白茅，對揚朕命，以尹東夏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "78fb2eb50fe54fd33632ce0c70fc5883359c6f01007310ef09028a29fe968e48"}

{"id": "p_bb1031971e221aab", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 105, "text": "其上故驃騎將軍南昌侯印綬符策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "13d30d97a851c29b1b3fd983a525b68b82fe03e4e9fb68af76158c316c4e66b0"}

{"id": "p_193c8956263b760d", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 106, "text": "今又加君九錫，其敬聽後命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "03ebae167278e7f8fa217477471be7f8453902600e670d0be4673c1a14e8ccf6"}

{"id": "p_a28b935fbfc0b02f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 107, "text": "以君綏安東南，綱紀江外，民夷安業，無或攜貳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "74e09176ddf82668dc664d76c609e2381e8f50ffb5d5a081287b90c88b08a820"}

{"id": "p_b84f1219773839d7", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 108, "text": "是用錫尹大輅、戎輅各一，玄牡二駟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "1e3f6195dc7b332539d2fedb9897a5e58b0487bf779daf2cb874a9ed623661bd"}

{"id": "p_eaf7bf6c8852413f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 109, "text": "君務財勸農，倉庫盈積，是用錫君袞冕之服，赤舄副焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "907c2be0082b2261c6d287fdf1585a8ccf443413d169384a45543561ea9e19aa"}

{"id": "p_519bad2b38061b87", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 110, "text": "君化民以德，禮教興行，是用錫君軒縣之樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "3bf06969aa652a3735a8a4c0cbe0a4f19f23cb4c7a497081be019e9b71dcb2f4"}

{"id": "p_27142403af4932f3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 111, "text": "君宣導休風，懷柔百越，是用錫君-{朱}-戸以居。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "84373ef794f63a866893765b85bf046f19adf14a8476d0ec81aae1ce2af5a872"}

{"id": "p_56ec9a1c64111d23", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 112, "text": "君運其才謀，官方任賢，是用錫君納陛以登。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "843214698cb9e423c428473f1a0b71d3a35eeff4a06bd64954c7c7fa84ea53b2"}

{"id": "p_04062a963338b64a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 113, "text": "君忠勇並奮，清除姦慝，是用錫君虎賁之士百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "636bb9f31464f40bfd61a8446166162bad3cc01891de416024a657361288af60"}

{"id": "p_263eee0c8dd4bb40", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 114, "text": "君振威陵邁，宣力荊南，梟滅兇醜，罪人斯得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "caf2daa3928a534515e9b94b8083877f96780f4b94ad00632a9ad6584b1b2782"}

{"id": "p_8dc312c9dbd0483c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 115, "text": "是用錫君鈇鉞各一，君文和於內，武信於外，是用錫君彤弓一、彤矢百、玈弓十、玈矢千。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "290c0e4f99df233ec9054ffdd27be5bc958b304ff6fff442705f3c239a4217cb"}

{"id": "p_d82070c6a10f3e5a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 116, "text": "君以忠肅爲基，恭儉爲德，是用錫君秬鬯一卣，圭瓚副焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "7d4fc6f716cab07191951901b4ae057764dc1b66dc820a40f380e9df4fa84be4"}

{"id": "p_b3052eeb6fc460f9", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 117, "text": "欽哉!敬敷訓典，以服朕命，以勖相我國家，永終爾顯烈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "3a06a65f80fbd0399ac8ac8fb24b51fa1d6901d8c83d274896a0aef3eea078f4"}

{"id": "p_ba8a85c2dde88920", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 118, "text": "是歳，劉備師軍來伐，至巫山、秭歸，使使誘導武陵蠻夷，假與印傳，許之封賞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "04d266bcce74ed537f2aa71c585956d18c6b989d3bfa5254df90b77e0683db46"}

{"id": "p_cc0b9f4b1c2b29ea", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 119, "text": "於是諸縣及五谿民皆反爲蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "e2b9659fd4358d64dd9a8661774cbcaea4452ab95b8cb9ff56429b04146756bc"}

{"id": "p_0f4a31bff1361db9", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 120, "text": "權以陸遜爲督，督-{朱}-然、潘璋等以拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "20ef5f51f8c8f5db27c7abbdeb387ab47ac7994526bc70f7146acc9f7801e8c0"}

{"id": "p_3e3064facc7ed9ce", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 121, "text": "魏帝問曰：「吳王何等主也?」咨對曰：「聰明仁智，雄略之主也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "395a24fae657b6c5adf7210a2c34d9537c1f2535d88dc036f2fd1e5692511d24"}

{"id": "p_d81c7a3bd1f2754b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 122, "text": "」帝問其狀，咨曰：「納魯肅於凡品，是其聰也；拔呂蒙於行陳，是其明也；獲於禁而不害，是其仁也；取荊州而兵不血刃，是其智也；據三州虎視於天下，是其雄也；屈身於陛下，是其略也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "d72aee53a1be1f9e131d1b5b42ae3624811cccc8e9fbda3989d2603c0aff0f7f"}

{"id": "p_9cc502b0334efbc5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」帝欲封權子登，權以登年幼，上書辭封，重遣西曹掾沈珩陳謝，並獻方物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "5be5905281c0cc5c6473561b2b7d386ec1b8770da7a231ccc63bbf45716b6945"}

{"id": "p_99ea6818f1bd01f4", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 124, "text": "春正月，陸遜部將軍宋謙等攻蜀五屯，皆破之，斬其將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "57731864e6820f603a1499969141143e7fa190801ddd92db6d3af2dc6e6f5a2c"}

{"id": "p_8e5eb201dc790b77", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 125, "text": "蜀軍分據險地，前後五十餘營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "77a1b85af825cbc05b6763245a4947f58b962348389804e2114b8dadc0b12a56"}

{"id": "p_85df2aa7f7df39c4", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 126, "text": "遜隨輕重以兵應拒，自正月至閏月，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "c849625f24775436a02a2d1c8b28b1b5a3926e496736f5bdf36393c35e9628c4"}

{"id": "p_f50dd7b4eed7e2b3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 127, "text": "臨陳所斬及投兵降首數萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "5a186aee06ce5784cb50aa49c4315e33787dd6893c26ed76d71aa7c86a3f8508"}

{"id": "p_60276670ab7be6d5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 128, "text": "初權外託事魏，而誠心不款。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "ab462c4c7bbc021c2468ec7032308a9ddacf46bf972a7055cb587d2f839c6299"}

{"id": "p_d4f27fa8279a3eac", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 129, "text": "魏欲遣待中辛毗、尚書桓階往與盟誓，並-{征}-任子，權辭讓不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "116701770f0c3e4a0afc3bad6b62220f5066a00ee17e923d29ba125de638438b"}

{"id": "p_f26ddfa013ec5e97", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 130, "text": "秋九月，魏乃命曹休、張遼、臧霸出洞口，曹仁出濡須，曹眞、夏侯尚、張郃、徐晃圍南郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "617674d9c849c8b7b58448ef6f449f590efe01b35b047a3523a2387f70a2ba9c"}

{"id": "p_11c0f29ad74ba002", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 131, "text": "權遣呂範等督五軍，以舟軍拒休等，諸葛瑾、潘璋、楊粲救南郡，-{朱}-桓以濡須督拒仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "ea3138c975e10d93151a42d06c34c61defa1b4bd5bb2fd3aa23b9ca336b10c71"}

{"id": "p_880184be971a11eb", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 132, "text": "時揚、越蠻夷多未平集，內難未弭，故權卑辭上書，求自改厲，「若罪在難除，必不見置，當奉還土地民人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "e01dd0c4cb6b9d77fb8d5be7a9f1a0b0150fe56f8e85949d0a1bb336f3327507"}

{"id": "p_a6695fedf84fbae5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 133, "text": "文帝報曰：「君生於擾攘之際，本有從橫之志，降身奉國，以享茲祚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "8a6adb6fe59e7eb4ff2414c705ca0c0717df621609210040f4f4fc121b837c1c"}

{"id": "p_a7ce772fa8f52e71", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 134, "text": "自君策名已來，貢獻盈路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "495bfa6d3913ac102270804735c9ec6de45cd5cceef2a8486e2284a31c9f0452"}

{"id": "p_f3fa5099640b7ddb", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 135, "text": "朕之與君，大義已定，豈樂勞師遠臨江漢？", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "a6e969c6ed538c0f7458c86d531e0276e072162e2fc871a5d566e900bafa6cef"}

{"id": "p_403fa0ba436154e5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 136, "text": "廊廟之議，王者所不得專；三公上君過失，皆有本末、朕以不明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "a04f441de647e6382e1dce90a95baa2c78d2e75c48f9284b73cdc9c8a2a21907"}

{"id": "p_12648a4c5bda154e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 137, "text": "雖有曾母投杼之疑，猶冀言者不信，以爲國福。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "a0d20bb48039e1bb95318dc825d06493c49302242a6569bed9f97bb4dd2cdcc0"}

{"id": "p_a0e727a53f251a15", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 138, "text": "故先遣使者犒勞，又遣尚書、侍中踐修前言，以定任子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "af7c1dd8219f3307a2f68061c5db86bfd5222d5620dad86f075551d07be4c424"}

{"id": "p_4fecd2c1535493f8", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 139, "text": "君遂設辭，不欲使進，議者怪之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "1f68320dadeb9d8eeb62b2719fff1d5e91ffb3a4a1b90b2db444fe8b78c33b0c"}

{"id": "p_a4a27670e6da139f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 140, "text": "又前都尉浩周勸君遣子，乃實朝臣交謀，以此卜君，君果有辭，外引隗囂遣子不終，內喩竇融守忠而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "3df3e8aaa85d16a0612665754c2a813ca0b8c7944d740b979e19cfcbca155f77"}

{"id": "p_8bc2a4fc3ba00de7", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 141, "text": "浩周之還，口陳指麾，益令議者發明眾嫌，終始之本，無所據杖，故遂俛仰從群臣議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "1284b5dc6e0d6d0550c382fb82102344e5b324111b818285aea62c5e59045f6c"}

{"id": "p_29590789fe096631", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 142, "text": "今省上事，款誠深至，心用慨然，淒愴動容。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "02882e05820f36a7dfca10e12740f261b8e6bd648ffe3d628af98c83d499bd57"}

{"id": "p_385fbfe37bb8acc4", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 143, "text": "即日下詔，敕諸軍但深溝髙壘，不得妄進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "fd7d929bc95eacb7bc0293120c73bac52329d8f130f595358da0eb0b964b2d98"}

{"id": "p_1478812ef50e9a9f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 144, "text": "若君必效忠節，以解疑議，登身朝到，夕召兵還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "2f5fb0b46697a62b7247c75edabb9413c846644734f3b5064f1e79345f0f8b5f"}

{"id": "p_3ee80f9d77d630b6", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 145, "text": "呂範等兵溺死者數千，餘軍還江南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "0c3e05b4c41eb614820301aafcc57112a7c388da736d38d2a3b5936b1a9ed016"}

{"id": "p_99870319791c8656", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 146, "text": "曹休使臧霸以輕船五百、敢死萬人襲攻徐陵，燒攻城車，殺略數千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "d68c8d8fca2ab788c611f307a025699da3d5b517bda779697f0d0d1482ea406a"}

{"id": "p_e3774f148ae7f4c7", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 147, "text": "將軍全琮、徐盛追斬魏將尹盧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "82ce93af3d3cea10e8d164c5f3ef80efbd0ecb20950a0058dd3ab29e25478706"}

{"id": "p_0c92f423a4614ef1", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 148, "text": "十二月，權使太中大夫鄭泉聘劉備於白帝，始復通也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "1588c133f2c19e6564ecb7a0f68745bbda765e6b4d98eaa5781649d01dfcbccb"}

{"id": "p_cea47df20195be21", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 149, "text": "然猶與魏文帝相往來，至後年乃絶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "821c44c224df443a20745f48ac74051adec342216fce0d9c525500809d59c9a7"}

{"id": "p_08dd46af4bec1ded", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 150, "text": "二年春正月，曹眞分軍據江陵中州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "52c0d0d25945a44fa05691b6b84527113f4fe2ec8c34f0afbad0013d351689e3"}

{"id": "p_cda8b46746de75b3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 151, "text": "三月，曹仁遣將軍常彫等，以兵五千，乘油船，晨渡濡須中州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "9fd158b5331b9893e9a9404c66c212c694e32e5fa8b6931e19419a3d62612175"}

{"id": "p_c4b55e8605b8cdd2", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 152, "text": "仁子泰因引軍急攻-{朱}-桓，桓兵拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "8603cfde8a8e59d96cf2eb6b1ae02e10570c3dbe85c05a8d6f5bafdc42cf4a03"}

{"id": "p_7b9c6a1e839246be", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 153, "text": "夏四月，權群臣勸即尊號，權不許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "710f1e639f0abf8773c25f66f6caec9c02eacc81c4a591126627cf9d5cb05fcf"}

{"id": "p_a7617b0505e7c46a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 154, "text": "先是戲口守將晉宗殺將王直，以眾叛如魏，魏以爲蘄春太守，數犯邊境。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "9a6f2d7ecf644ea821b364eca94bb4395ce190d294f50ef9ad5d3f3050cfbee5"}

{"id": "p_ce5d6d45b98e8a58", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 155, "text": "六月，權令將軍賀齊、糜芳、劉邵等襲蘄春，邵等生虜宗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "a31b93075ad81db91195726910a80638a1fa6e639ab4645fc92e559530b2a2c8"}

{"id": "p_56e34196b2a23b9c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 156, "text": "冬十一月，蜀使中郎將鄧芝來聘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "87bce5f467f38b75e53252d8cf09c5000169c688d7522c893985d4d90e986e5e"}

{"id": "p_bd7438fc0195ce49", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 157, "text": "三年夏，遣輔義中郎將張溫聘於蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "e4910df666dd2edd21ba0d69aaefa99aa4db8db8e92dbff06fc6cc51471535c8"}

{"id": "p_325f53a60f4f9fa6", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 158, "text": "九月，魏文帝出廣陵，望大江，曰「彼有人焉，未可圖也」，乃還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "43eda14a274a0f011563bd61fa04b7f717f941bb9992ee031b6d3cc59b68eec9"}

{"id": "p_b01184a1e853dcea", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 159, "text": "四年夏五月，丞相孫邵卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "5a2df80be7000c9ac04022b53e58e591a24288af343d9dd3c67d1fdadafd231b"}

{"id": "p_659515700d471678", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 160, "text": "六月，以太常顧雍爲丞相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "f00f4ded0789f36f003feb7b95b07c495643bc2104e4aa99dc5e46ba223a04ec"}

{"id": "p_501efeed95fc59e9", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 161, "text": "冬十二月，鄱陽賊彭綺自稱將軍，攻沒諸縣，眾數萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "bef838de472011465d85174bebb72e6094e4bea23a476dedbe1eeaa7d43fb1e9"}

{"id": "p_c52a0818795a0210", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 162, "text": "五年春，令曰：「軍興日久，民離農畔，父子夫婦，不聽相卹，孤甚愍之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "c170bbde2d1b0a4445ca04a30f6ffa759c84aef5c0002204b9736500b2b60fb5"}

{"id": "p_75851c1a3816f037", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 163, "text": "今北虜縮竄，方外無事，其下州郡，有以寬息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "1a40a98947f37045f44d03141f83f5673a6ff9d6aed1fc4b7ffa7c3df9a516ac"}

{"id": "p_8b42c1a5b925de0f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 164, "text": "」是時，陸遜以所在少谷，表令諸將增廣農畝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "cf195c0ac4d8b5a50c822b7fd409e4fb27123f58dc515ac470790b3be256537a"}

{"id": "p_bdfc933ee442c2f1", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 165, "text": "今孤父子親自受田，車中八牛以爲四耦，雖未及古人，亦欲與眾均等其勞也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "9dab8e6371843831cef2db9294ccf3967b293119a90074dca4c0a924159be6cd"}

{"id": "p_a5fbacf0625ccbaa", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」秋七月，權聞魏文帝崩，-{征}-江夏，圍石陽，不克而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "f3a5b4478c639d3d22cac26f9c4ad55911dd258732469772a74984e96cc97e41"}

{"id": "p_3e5d4956dd5719e8", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 167, "text": "分三郡惡地十縣置東安郡，以全琮爲太守，平討山越。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "70258b36051c255ca0677b4429d29ac5ed6c288338ce8d077678dde8e45836ec"}

{"id": "p_820b98bbd8902c01", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 168, "text": "冬十月，陸遜陳便宜，勸以施德緩刑，寬賦息調。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "3f904c463a03ddec094c16e6b7afc8c52d78b8b8fa6a6f178d4b6381149bb2eb"}

{"id": "p_7f433afda8fc6e9c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 170, "text": "於是令有司盡寫科條，使郎中褚逢齎以就遜及諸葛瑾，意所不安，令損益之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "83f0db79ab7fa1188af02f5658daa3f5d399763befc650154428700d96588dcd"}

{"id": "p_a734be748af3ae98", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 171, "text": "六年春正月，諸將獲彭綺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "52d86a265ba1ec61fb452d408273af2b4c7a0732dba8ec49a79c18e1eee48c0d"}

{"id": "p_2c136a8db82afbe4", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 172, "text": "閏月，韓當子綜以其眾降魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "e230124228920d0e56f2619a53f6ab910ae30676bba25d1ca6242223f4fdf7a9"}

{"id": "p_6438e5f8692f08fc", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 173, "text": "七年三月，封子慮爲建昌侯，罷東安郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "a03411ccbd086ba2ff90f848ff4f77f018f3b20a330159d5e4fcf174237fdc60"}

{"id": "p_17f3ae7a43f3492f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 174, "text": "夏五月，鄱陽太守周魴偽叛，誘魏將曹休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "e023c9145fbc19494d17d5083974c248265d18e0cdc0dc84ac4c27c7f06e2384"}

{"id": "p_c736187a557b91dc", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 175, "text": "秋八月，權至皖口，使將軍陸遜督諸將大破休於石亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "5bac200eb6e0b29686452b2ef2553aa7138c19ac4789cc18eafd2a856796d098"}

{"id": "p_a7f4361c42c4a9e0", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 176, "text": "春，公卿百司皆勸權正尊號。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "8545baede75dce86cf00471623984c68cc84f7c1aba892b40991ddaf30a9fd2a"}

{"id": "p_5b992130db75adb0", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 177, "text": "夏四月，夏口、武昌並言黃龍、鳳凰見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "1477114c9e3d5acc41ee539452c60833987c7d1d8948c27f74df3813b8bb7599"}

{"id": "p_dca030469e1739c5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 178, "text": "改年，追尊父破虜將軍堅爲武烈皇帝，母吳氏爲武烈皇-{后}-，兄討逆將軍策爲長沙桓王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "18ce37c55a163111d17e3470fad7f03ae60f65cb3a3e64478db2fb5852193f57"}

{"id": "p_3176e832d28fbb50", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 179, "text": "初，興平中，吳中童謠曰：「黃金車，班蘭耳，闓昌門，出天子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "97c900d88477a6f01b5c87a2cc1f74d646c266cbcaa3e18fcd61ded8b98a266c"}

{"id": "p_e9fb4efb221efa93", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 180, "text": "」五月，使校尉張剛、管篤之遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "79d9b24baa7b51cb4199a4b8e1f738c5045cc5d5f5f4238ff59d055a17dcece5"}

{"id": "p_20b800d679767b0b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 181, "text": "六月，蜀遣衞尉陳震慶權踐位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "851643901f35c573850e7761fb14108bdab16084b739cb72931de3cafe3cfdb8"}

{"id": "p_888845c50cdd48fa", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 182, "text": "權乃參分天下，豫、靑、徐、幽屬吳，兗，冀，-{并}-，涼屬蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "632e4a812dc882d8ef3c8a4690dedbb2bee55c8c2aee9b0a9c5bc6e9342e902b"}

{"id": "p_7387fb28c3f0c38b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 183, "text": "其司州之土，以函谷關爲界，造爲盟曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "728066f616de002e92cefb5762b38a5df54250400001eeeb74c5dc99037d6b73"}

{"id": "p_9492372212d30316", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 184, "text": "秋九月，權遷都建業，因固府不改館，-{徵}-上大將軍陸遜輔太子登，掌武昌留事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "de573a747057d8027e77aa47a1452f0862221109e2ed84d5b8b9d286cb195e17"}

{"id": "p_a4a818cd1054f4a2", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 185, "text": "二年春正月，魏作合肥新城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "3c3ec9a60bebdfaffce3926e6c187f5d5c613134edfa64fa1c423b5436eae7a9"}

{"id": "p_b9dce8fcf194c828", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 187, "text": "遣將軍衞溫、諸葛直將甲士萬人，浮海求夷洲及亶洲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "897fb3308db91d258cc6df249a21a1daa0d515281f44c0b21d58c47f79873110"}

{"id": "p_fd0b221fda19dd78", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 188, "text": "亶洲在海中，長老傳言：秦始皇帝遣方士徐福將童男童女數千人入海，求蓬萊神山及仙藥，止此洲不還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "a56843ce820c27212c418f32bf703c74698cc650d966d821efb73b9543735728"}

{"id": "p_ce66af0af259a524", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 189, "text": "世相承有數萬家，其上人民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "1243b3e284afea4b8e0d62d13e5ad6b9bb921c0b8ddcaecc3931ca94280ca11c"}

{"id": "p_92d128950bcb5745", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 190, "text": "時有至會稽貨布，會稽東縣人海行，亦有遭風流移至亶洲者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "e56ab1f597e9fcf6dc18c55852ebb8afcfe2855f5cb47131aaade97e316309ae"}

{"id": "p_eb17d6bb0fa8fbfa", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 191, "text": "所在絶遠，卒不可得至，但得夷洲數千人還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "a605ae347900e54a9a28eca9f53823591a093322d10ec90f7c264c7b1f2b05fb"}

{"id": "p_f46569d786c98e0e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 192, "text": "三年春二月，遣太常潘濬率眾五萬，討武陵蠻夷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "079a520d0bb46ef3cfd888324020e5610afae5a04bd0d8440d1cad3bbf0bb64b"}

{"id": "p_b3deefa65b35d269", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 193, "text": "衞溫、諸葛直皆以違詔無功，下獄誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "f3bf6257cc23ddc98e33342f7e0ae4073d1c4a1f8eded0960b67d53a862c19ec"}

{"id": "p_a9011af7f42b2ec2", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 194, "text": "由拳野稻自生，改爲禾興縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "33ee7c7d52f046c40333aec42132951f2703004b01ca150267ca7fffdf3ebc1b"}

{"id": "p_8e6ced9c4e5f5f8b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 195, "text": "中郎將孫布詐降以誘魏將王淩，淩以軍迎布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "d5f48feaa26df5452edbf0b5d5dd3d8d32e8bd15ca6b1d3561dc20d5da4b0bf8"}

{"id": "p_28f0e0a5d5c19898", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 196, "text": "冬十月，權以大兵潛伏於阜陵俟之，淩覺而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "22fad957c1a3c3f00483e7680e531b002f4828445436cea55e0bca8ac6a8719a"}

{"id": "p_afdf55f0c8e4f7b2", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 197, "text": "十二月丁卯，大赦，改明元年也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "2712ffbc21322b09d79acb53551ad5dc9a3001fa93347b405109fd6e9f44db88"}

{"id": "p_ae447754b828f48b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 198, "text": "三月，遣將軍周賀、校尉裴潛乘海之遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "d84cd3ab57b08704f0712def5b4b9394137a2b706243683579841d120f5fafcc"}

{"id": "p_6f454f550c287c38", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 199, "text": "秋九月，魏將田豫要擊，斬賀於成山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "4ff7feb6f72aec09207717f3bd06afab577496ab113a44d9c80e9cd936390231"}

{"id": "p_83cef8291e81ccf0", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 200, "text": "冬十月，魏遼東太守公孫淵遣校尉宿舒、郎中令孫綜稱藩於權，並獻貂馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "08d6b308159dda0b679c6abd3ede32776d06e18973ab3b6f0617793d009fd9b1"}

{"id": "p_aeb14fbb2b2bc707", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 201, "text": "二年春正月，詔曰：「朕以不德，肇受元命，夙夜兢兢，不遑假寢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "c9f296efc7acda8dd3696ae803b68dd2c9626238afc0c57c2f2b5b8cdd987d31"}

{"id": "p_286d5b0ed18dd724", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 202, "text": "思平世難，救濟黎庶，上答神祗，下慰民望；是以眷眷，勤求俊傑，將與戮力，共定海內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "e87ddb576ca8506fcc334cbe5a048ee18d2fb4868bd8e9dbbd45805c8887d472"}

{"id": "p_2082739dcf737de3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 203, "text": "今使持節督幽州領靑州牧遼東太守燕王，久脅賊虜，隔在一方，雖乃心於國，其路靡緣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "7476e1471f394cf0abf1c477e245ab2d0eb1eada8f65db318bd62572c55e117e"}

{"id": "p_743e72aa6eda2a9a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 204, "text": "遠遣二使，款誠顯露，章表殷勤，朕之得此，何喜如之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "d6f35d60f906202869b51b3b56ff76dd79648b7ef9b0998366e2a31ac784ee5a"}

{"id": "p_662c71041c69456b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 205, "text": "雖湯遇伊尹，周獲呂望，世祖未定而得河右，方之今日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "39cad9dc8f3e6a6da43756676ef9d4f9e65d27d69342bb3b8ccbf5847c915384"}

{"id": "p_61d9d880b1dfa6dc", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 206, "text": "『一人有慶，兆民賴之』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "aa124c28fbfd98a0a4b319014af367ae297ba0b44d4827bc98ac8fb882319d5f"}

{"id": "p_a84bb1e378ef2d94", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 207, "text": "其大赦天下，與之更始，其明下州郡，-{咸}-使聞知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "4354011129a7da6920c3d61985d61a1b85351cb949b1c5e054688d1985be3f91"}

{"id": "p_a526b3e4c0b7108e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 208, "text": "特下燕國，奉宣詔恩，今普天率土備聞斯慶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "f7e65353d2a80871278116755c8fab87c4fcd6b91b27fc5f264a5a866620729f"}

{"id": "p_6fe81af8fcf0b143", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 209, "text": "」三月，遣舒、綜還，使太常張彌、執金吾許晏、將軍賀達等將兵萬人，金寶珍貨，九錫備物，乘海授淵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "b450082bd452aea6a6e8df91d2b7c98c1f0d2fc34accdebbdeaea39dd207362b"}

{"id": "p_b20f9a8b2abd5ab1", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 210, "text": "舉朝大臣，自丞相雍已下皆諫，以爲淵未可信，而寵待太厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "0eb703a925fb0318197d3d7ff52eb34fe5cc286c25a24a7fe8ba8bf43a29b259"}

{"id": "p_32a58923b93d6f2f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 211, "text": "但可遣吏兵數百護送舒、綜，權終不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "dbe0b8427c63b3ff5145cfcfd99def6f97e2857a13cb7d361965a0e9cf3e822c"}

{"id": "p_d2ada1b6eeea8d94", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 212, "text": "淵果斬彌等，送其首於魏，沒其兵資。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "560c6b54a67ee6a9ab02fbef78582f09fb91933b49a7a5f3384d9369cffe7d85"}

{"id": "p_986cb9ce0d1ddcef", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 213, "text": "權大怒，欲自-{征}-淵，尚書僕射薛綜等切諫乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "61a12806f8bd491366b55336f7826655df2ea114e28d84c1bd11d7704849b8f1"}

{"id": "p_5164d6ed6caf5b36", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 214, "text": "是歳，權嚮合肥新城，遣將軍全瓊-{征}-六安，皆不克還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "c5c6d07fbf4992db955979c0bfcbde951a59c4d7034ed99e6f8ed24d42702f18"}

{"id": "p_09d3a44fabb6509b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 215, "text": "三年春正月，詔曰：「兵久不輟，民困於役，歳或不登。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "bd16ccfeb507aed270d71b59254d476691467ac895dfb0dfcaf5fc1c74ebf091"}

{"id": "p_4cb1367fdd9cd608", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 216, "text": "」夏五月，權遣陸遜、諸葛瑾等屯江夏、沔口，孫韶、張承等嚮廣陵、淮陽，權率大眾圍合肥新城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "adbf3a17052d37fd57f093bb3f7be5c56bde241b28d30eae72613890e0ad58ac"}

{"id": "p_90fa1ee269fdfa11", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 217, "text": "是時蜀相諸葛亮出武功，權謂魏明帝不能遠出，而帝遣兵助司馬宣王拒亮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "f44013bbe6bcf121eebeb677323a955dbbff24a89d73e6581e6a6194775ce609"}

{"id": "p_8a7255d1c72dface", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 218, "text": "未至壽春，權退還，孫韶亦罷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "05e2b5a545ea8822001c8efda9fa6b43e78d205dc4de6decd5dd348cf22dc16d"}

{"id": "p_da33d667612f39a5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 219, "text": "秋八月，以諸葛恪爲丹楊太守，討山越。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "b49fae9e11c9551b5a701480a648788304d1ac30cdc4e20347e8be8e1119a072"}

{"id": "p_82d10051e517846f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 220, "text": "冬十一月，太常潘濬平武陵蠻夷，事畢，還武昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "98f8c788181dbe9c465107727e71130f19896dc11ef396494042d188a8adb9d8"}

{"id": "p_e70ada2a8420fa23", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 221, "text": "詔復曲阿爲雲陽，丹徒爲武進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "57428f9aa99e3709080aaa7eb59d35ffd0e10016d6af1f6a7833aded18188b5b"}

{"id": "p_54ef33991d472adc", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 222, "text": "廬陵賊李桓、羅厲等爲亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "15435ce8ae3fda1114c62f38d1e8ca2029cc89a77802213c01c38690dc5555ab"}

{"id": "p_96f954a8886320f6", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 223, "text": "魏使以馬求易珠璣、翡翠、瑇瑁，權曰：「此皆孤所不用，而可得馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "a7d3fa00d41b078ffd58b7b684da6de79219ab1bfc868475e27684ec97417bbf"}

{"id": "p_a7419041ddabcac7", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 224, "text": "五年春，鑄大錢，一當五百。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "d21c7e3cd0bcb51bd41dc0c1f1e24a941c1caf1c6bdc44cfb44dc4a051bc0031"}

{"id": "p_346b34f1b7584e0a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 225, "text": "詔使吏民輸銅，計銅畀直。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "acf2fb0daba83ebb0f87951b649946bd242a5a132ccc47a82916038d279ace6f"}

{"id": "p_1289ea199181bd40", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 226, "text": "二月，武昌言甘露降於禮賓殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "d1f93ab520a91d12313be7fe4a7dde7465f24e9c6d170b10c542b6dd9f54d2b0"}

{"id": "p_40dbd529184a956c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 227, "text": "中郎將吾粲獲李桓，將軍唐咨獲羅厲等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "4790501091461a789a813f79a810fda8f9f6e69ad704834a6d3f29ac3fb28eca"}

{"id": "p_cc9cdf98b023fa71", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 228, "text": "顧譚議，以爲「奔喪立科，輕則不足以禁孝子之情，重則本非應死之罪，雖嚴刑益設，違奪必少。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "6c49db1eeb07404cf509ef4c2c64849c7014aa64ec711b181e9db64ae030f902"}

{"id": "p_a6a78b8eacc6aaa3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 229, "text": "若偶有犯者，加其刑則恩所不忍，有減則法廢不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "b16eb1637d2893d868ad9d7a8b8ce96460a3109b0807d1fcdd96b9b457b10914"}

{"id": "p_c06b5fbc5fbc3e01", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 230, "text": "愚以爲長吏在遠，苟不告語，勢不得知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "f0546b768c78e65259b233b18b8494219bfd9ebe5fd2ae078760135fd84087c8"}

{"id": "p_72c5209b3f319599", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 231, "text": "比選代之間，若有傳者，必加大辟，則長吏無廢職之負，孝子無犯重之刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "997e129e206319eb09bcc9c9dde52c50fd38c38d214489c07b555dba92523a46"}

{"id": "p_f988491fe0209c98", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 232, "text": "」將軍胡綜議，以爲「喪紀之禮，雖有典制，苟無其時，所不得行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "4d44a5041378448ac5020a8f04a5d898f8fb384382c54ac9916deae26c844f67"}

{"id": "p_4e358346daa6d231", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 233, "text": "方今戎事軍國異容，而長吏遭喪，知有科禁，公敢干突，苟念聞憂不奔之恥，不計爲臣犯禁之罪，此由科防本輕所致。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "55d46d430f90939558db0d99f80ac62d208e023a99179d6d8cff3c46fae52f98"}

{"id": "p_0f53d060ebb00c1b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 234, "text": "忠節在國，孝道立家，出身爲臣，焉得兼之?故爲忠臣不得爲孝子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "d7dbdfdb3a597e0abd939e020a625e77936b5b12ce9128e490772cbf89c5faae"}

{"id": "p_155808c8c6765a68", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 235, "text": "以殺止殺，行之一人，其後必絶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "31bc49b3ce5f29ae7edf3af3619d285701ccab2adf66eed3d781785d76918757"}

{"id": "p_1dff73c5d6bd7bb8", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 236, "text": "其後吳令孟宗喪母奔赴，已而自拘於武昌以聽刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "6ac129c3e496c76554f3d41d9a9de9cbc74eebae2a4e04d1814cc6bac1c7133a"}

{"id": "p_e0b3691e0a770f4e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 237, "text": "陸遜陳其素行，因爲之請，權乃減宗一等，後不得以爲比，因此遂絶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "246ad97962f7ad86c90a714814329e6a57b3b212338b4024854854a4347e3981"}

{"id": "p_77d1a114ca8f6a98", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 238, "text": "二月，陸遜討彭旦等，其年，皆破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "b50e6c97d44f85d2e7b4be759158613f7cb4b50cacd077f4c3348cc584aac18b"}

{"id": "p_25c6065238637227", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 239, "text": "冬十月，遣衞將軍全琮襲六安，不克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "8cd7445f0cd10562a77e252de7ff24e05ca0db1641ffeecd585189a3631b54b9"}

{"id": "p_491b08e571b935ce", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 240, "text": "諸葛恪平山越事畢，北屯廬江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "22d2da2f4dabc2718bf5d196bc79c86dea92f515b19dc0382b65226c8c9cca90"}

{"id": "p_ac0b8781db46ccdb", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 241, "text": "夏，呂岱討盧陵賊，畢，還陸口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "4a3a071815bb42c70859dab079e3f5e751a60f101b05a8fbc8ed7d3c48e288f5"}

{"id": "p_bc38b3553ec16cf3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 242, "text": "有司奏言麒麟者太平之應，宜改年號。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "174eda5ade169b8c22d1bdda19b63d16635d50ea6786e06a9eda6388a9b98c12"}

{"id": "p_12977444480f040a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 243, "text": "詔曰：「間者赤烏集於殿前，朕所親見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "d18d0321e63df0b1c9fe82586e8936849bdb3c3fa5d573707dc6029c50806aec"}

{"id": "p_f2f177809bcf6800", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 244, "text": "若神靈以爲嘉祥者，改年宜以赤烏爲元。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "b37109f340014d64421d563fd640a23ba741b79acad4f60b16d4c726e8052c47"}

{"id": "p_7d81c288ad0b33f3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 245, "text": "」群臣奏曰：「昔武王伐紂，有赤烏之祥，君臣觀之，遂有天下，聖人書策載述最詳者，以爲近事旣嘉，親見又明也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "98632a36e8afeed4e5e1fce6ab7a7d09e3286f8583ba2fc03242b21e21e8d9db"}

{"id": "p_783466c2ca7fba7a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 246, "text": "步夫人卒，追贈皇-{后}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "4b9129bc638cb81294b3e1328dfb8a393a9b096d0adf4e131ecaa0acae27c9e7"}

{"id": "p_0cdf344151aa45dc", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 247, "text": "初，權信任校事呂壹，壹性苛慘，用法深刻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "95177b7cc4640181d12e6f89969ef74292d89f4bbf97bf66864351d904373226"}
