{"id": "p_910bc6754794156f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 248, "text": "太子登數諫，權不納，大臣由是莫敢言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "d447478aed9724e043be08622c5e1421ab57f5ee9da1ab3e69e368ff9097b022"}

{"id": "p_b6819968f9c3b9d4", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 249, "text": "後壹姦罪發露伏誅，權引咎責躬，乃使中書郎袁禮告謝諸大將，因問時事所當損益。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "23dc6c5df75e286861fefdc0634698ce03dc26ad98e8c9cdadd0dc97e32d2984"}

{"id": "p_a5175e8d609e594d", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 250, "text": "禮還，復有詔責數諸葛瑾、步騭、朱然，呂岱等曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "e90dcb653483d0af1b05dbcf2bc95a78ad860bd1f1eaaf22e90fd8336498f1d9"}

{"id": "p_89ddd706bc1fb797", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 251, "text": "二年春三月，遣使者羊衜、鄭冑、將軍孫怡之遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "1794eaf2bff154b078579a9abbd13c2f2f4580f692359e42426772a33130947c"}

{"id": "p_f000fb77d6428938", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 252, "text": "擊魏守將張持、髙慮等，虜得男女。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "598789a97cf5f7e1b2ab1fde8c1fcb4b955aec8e53c9ceb5b685ba05f21bfe07"}

{"id": "p_edf9882d092ab71f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 253, "text": "冬十月，將軍蔣秘南討夷賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "05cc70805673cf98fac3364358204b48f9ab925ace5ba614d67602f0a3ca4987"}

{"id": "p_3c42baa259590625", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 254, "text": "秘所領都督廖式殺臨賀太守嚴綱等，自稱平南將軍，與弟潛共攻零陵、桂陽，及搖動交州蒼梧、鬱林諸都，眾數萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "51a3ed1a3ae82d43e56f56276adf21f2907fb7ad9530d6a11cb80af816c31336"}

{"id": "p_2c26cba66510b288", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 255, "text": "遣將軍呂岱、唐咨討之，歳餘皆破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "2feb30182d5d1cf0afb4a3216b3ce760e7529fdf6d8fa06bcb266f751d8406b5"}

{"id": "p_0548cff9c95e68ec", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 256, "text": "三年春正月，詔曰：「蓋君非民不立，民非谷不生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "91458c6173eeabe9581ea6131b7e4ce9afd5fa83293646e1456192593f48d025"}

{"id": "p_33454374a2098db5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 257, "text": "民多-{徵}-役，歳又水旱，年谷有損，而吏或不良，侵奪民時，以致饑困。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "4b1c911a12abf14a9f10663f03921ed4e6d4b9d82741b671ec4168c90850aef4"}

{"id": "p_aea7b6b2659ea8d6", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 258, "text": "自今以來，督軍郡守，其謹察非法，當農桑時，以役事擾民者，舉正以聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "5061b2bf1b7fc83dba962964df6fc5947ef93fac25dbdaa1fe325a2c63a3b9ef"}

{"id": "p_c5558a38a0565a36", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 259, "text": "」夏四月，大赦，詔諸郡縣治城郭，起譙樓，穿塹發渠，以備盜賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "d216337248a004a4eba737e454ef969dc37e61ddf77515b96bd1a1aefdd65cce"}

{"id": "p_3828b323c080f8b4", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 260, "text": "冬十一月，民饑，詔開倉廩以賑貧窮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "e4cf805e2f5cceca07e4f9718a1dafe59bae912d327e1e4d230679179995aec0"}

{"id": "p_7595e7cab9a5de14", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 261, "text": "四年春正月，大雪平地深三尺，鳥獸死者大半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "2adb5c42e006991357e5738693104c78f48f797cfacbf71ebc031709f1d21f51"}

{"id": "p_68d308cf3e8748c0", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 262, "text": "夏四月，遣衞將軍全琮略淮南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "fe6668ad3037b633af7f4b75a3aed27cb00e8cb817fad34b0684cb4aed11004e"}

{"id": "p_0e3028c2cc7166e6", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 263, "text": "決芍陂，燒安城邸閣，收其人民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "644b7ec6561030d8ce361b3c6345b5573bbc9a0d621985c86d6cb7ef350fb5ff"}

{"id": "p_819a4b2186ff9f6c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 264, "text": "琮與魏將王淩戰於芍陂，中即將秦晃等十餘人戰死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "6f6ffb202a807f0d2fa81ef9eb6b5570d6d7c2ba015d49ea6b68cbbf1d277ecb"}

{"id": "p_8dffc830c1b94fb3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 265, "text": "車騎將軍-{朱}-然圍樊，大將軍諸葛瑾取柤中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "cbd227770886ea6790e9310dadc4f92860dcef268659383e9dafee0ba5ee7a52"}

{"id": "p_cd0c3528d862b60b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 266, "text": "是月，魏太傅司馬宣王救樊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "c96f4bb54868b6de99481e387a64f7e3043330e5ec1a11afb593402c958489ec"}

{"id": "p_ebe2b8bbe452c079", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 267, "text": "五年春正月，立子和爲太子，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "680fca0e8ed5a05ce6f53b4decf02e66f8a93f46b2b724d8ce960428bdbcf4e6"}

{"id": "p_099eb2319fdea5e5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 268, "text": "百官奏立皇-{后}-及四王，詔曰：「今天下未定，民物勞瘁，且有功者或未錄，饑寒者尚未恤，猥割土壤以豐子弟，祟爵位以寵妃妾，孤甚不取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "5def8c6b5a63f0253d174218682853527a98d60a4c97c8472f5de5370e7560de"}

{"id": "p_d76bbd53f5f53d3b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 269, "text": "」三月，海鹽縣言黃龍見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "5f99c6ca67a9133da677dfa2eed5734967c77dc757513b0f4d91fb2b50f81517"}

{"id": "p_472ded186bff502d", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 270, "text": "夏四月，禁進獻御，減太官膳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "f1ad7306c1942a86e90a7f1b3748ffe675ff6340c677eb17f4150fdb21797668"}

{"id": "p_37422b3798f493e7", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 271, "text": "秋七月，遣將軍聶友、校尉陸凱以兵三萬討珠崖、儋耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "08049d82933e9a684ca21ab01d470b3336ca2df008d39e67970aa728815a5f09"}

{"id": "p_962db10b02b0022f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 272, "text": "是歳，大疫，有司又奏立-{后}-及諸王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "78fa37267598ea71d41b4f8ab5cfd3530d6c318cab79bbaafff1d835b5ca1e95"}

{"id": "p_574e2d8bcfa537f7", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 273, "text": "六年春正月，新都言白虎見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "af70c48b8208c8f8643974752edb30b4c43e86122b0015dd1d4e5cfaa320fdda"}

{"id": "p_bf8a2670ffff1acf", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 274, "text": "諸葛恪-{征}-六安，破魏將謝順營，收其民人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "d1470c42c605a5a76ae9bc82f6c3303a3a110588f2bad919e751847d9926ae5a"}

{"id": "p_c45a3593ef7dca9a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 275, "text": "十二月，扶南王-{范}-旃遣使獻樂人及方物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "043806ea8badd91c26c6113f8c7537c3b512eeb60e54381f8e292ef8f75bfa05"}

{"id": "p_e61a1854aa4c7628", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 276, "text": "是歳，司馬宣王率軍入舒，諸葛恪自皖遷於柴桑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "7e90bd99d957f758cca5b59cf8606b3e0168788d4e8380cf957e5e586a358746"}

{"id": "p_854006beb2e5f2c7", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 277, "text": "七年春正月，以上大將軍陸遜爲丞相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "c787a2c1411e6e478ea54cd5df5af0cc5e1efae452b49e604a0f30b091e06c77"}

{"id": "p_2b5179ab911e1376", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 278, "text": "是歳，步騭、-{朱}-然等各上疏-{云}-：「自蜀還者，-{咸}-言欲背盟與魏交通，多作舟船，繕治城郭，又蔣琬守漢中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "29121466d7998c70894335bdfa7414215b7c1ff4bd996a5854bfa5f03dfdd0f1"}

{"id": "p_7a4541eae2a08a16", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 279, "text": "聞司馬懿南向，不出兵乘虛以掎角之，反委漢中，還近成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "99adb6a47bbf843fca91223aa0b8ed5039b9debec3b6246bcb5e0fc616995578"}

{"id": "p_151dd89feb61cecf", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 280, "text": "事已彰灼，無所復疑，宜爲之備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "416b493535b60b8df20c06a36de83537f4111d6fbf8beb750d8d590101ecf38a"}

{"id": "p_15a0a32d63c5257d", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 281, "text": "」權揆其不然，曰：「吾待蜀不薄，聘享盟誓，無所負之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "775fb12661f97ea3dfab44a3662a3142d79cad763dd06551417e4bc5448d04ec"}

{"id": "p_7ee52371f39fb630", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 282, "text": "何以致此?又司馬懿前來入舒，旬日便退，蜀在萬裏，何知緩急而便出兵乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "f32d8da798ad98e216f4b285f99106d67a2a8932f93c66024cf9a992865e46b8"}

{"id": "p_3998a0d0ebc37628", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 283, "text": "昔魏欲入漢川，此間始嚴，亦未舉動，會聞魏還而止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "dec32b6d26f6455330506f98d319321e71b3f830739a04c8c15d672a8435f96a"}

{"id": "p_ec80ebe3a7d24b60", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 284, "text": "蜀寧可復以此有疑邪?又人家治國，舟船城郭，何得不護?今此間治軍，寧復欲以御蜀邪?人言苦不可信，朕爲諸君破家保之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "06a622632074e912069ee0d172a78954120b23cf0234089ca7f168c9ae42ce7e"}

{"id": "p_15cc3e30ebe2b839", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 285, "text": "」蜀競自無謀，如權所籌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "754b5d003c9707efae5042b8a1f57f03ff65673dc40b0d60ac57298cfb4eff34"}

{"id": "p_252849e1ab04b067", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 286, "text": "八年春二月，丞相陸遜卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "ff94ea6743a21e7899c807d2969308cd6328ffce7b670cff83776efaf16f2d23"}

{"id": "p_480bf4283abb22c2", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 287, "text": "夏，雷霆犯宮門柱，又擊南津大橋楹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "d2dced9542a51d3811eb6cc646e0dadff61f19356fdcb386e5285d86f92fd349"}

{"id": "p_2ed6e2fcd038d0fa", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 288, "text": "茶陵縣鴻水溢出，流漂居民二百餘家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "b4fd36221e6cc55c60d3585197696c15e709203764b223c0a26d11af757e0eb9"}

{"id": "p_098623bbf589827e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 289, "text": "秋七月，將軍馬茂等圖逆，夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "c111bd302db5b131ab57e7d62cc46aca22b83fe1719a21413a8922ae49bf5c47"}

{"id": "p_9c4c2c37c0fa6e2a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 290, "text": "遣校尉陳勳將屯田及作士三萬人鑿句容中道，自小其至雲陽西城，通會市，作邸閣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "602f22462d9f0516f271bdaf0d8055c9a08ef458998516900169226eb6df9ecd"}

{"id": "p_4122abe82e50cc62", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 291, "text": "九年春二月，車騎將軍-{朱}-然-{征}-魏柤中，斬獲千餘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "32673b1a2b07fe3cd1602198d45538c796d51140f4c99369b0ac6c3f47c35c0f"}

{"id": "p_d8d5dd68dee9d4b1", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 292, "text": "秋九月，以驃騎步騭爲丞相，車騎-{朱}-然爲左大司馬，衞將軍全琮爲右大司馬，鎮南呂岱爲上大將軍，威北將軍諸葛恪爲大將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "5e91066ec877755c1f29874b85acb1a18c0d31d61c70d85dd3737a1fc95a265d"}

{"id": "p_e299cd1b592db79f", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 293, "text": "十年春正月，右大司馬全琮卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "b382a1447bf68a77cf453a0cf0e28acbc2df5679d1215e6152ca3fd267268d75"}

{"id": "p_b394af67541daa19", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 294, "text": "三月，改作太初宮，諸將及州郡皆義作。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "a6e426329afca127fd818e5a9f2edfbb79ad2c5c266757cf602f0dcedf973b14"}

{"id": "p_a9a5533038e868ff", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 295, "text": "十一年春正月，-{朱}-然城江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "69d2980b6e46c8dffaa618ebd74f1f84997608e916836dc8d09c5389aed771b5"}

{"id": "p_8fd032014d011430", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 296, "text": "夏四月，雨雹，雲陽言黃龍見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "d8cc4bcec57017a5ae8c568068e2c5dfd0aa8a3808c31c63b58171162c25ec70"}

{"id": "p_cac61b98e8fdbee3", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 297, "text": "詔曰：「古者聖王積行累善，修身行道，以有天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "791b3fe2580c30fd6ebafedbbc02df36dedc72c2c866d056f1110a12c992506c"}

{"id": "p_ffbffee7b952b3c6", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 298, "text": "故符瑞應之，所以表德也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "3eda529f79aab26cd470be804028092d6bab0bc991cba6272a3011f00162ea31"}

{"id": "p_20e7c948ecebd1d0", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 299, "text": "朕以不明，何以臻茲?《尚書》雲『雖休勿休』，公卿百司，其勉修所職，以匡不逮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "95280c4843211d8bfe79809ad21974276e868bc9acc00211102b0c324038f574"}

{"id": "p_79861272e9cab21b", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 300, "text": "十二年春三月，左大司馬-{朱}-然卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "f547483bfbec2e1b3a0d0749fe737982d63f75cff55ea9cb8b4f7100bce8b392"}

{"id": "p_9184d24c449248ae", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 301, "text": "四月，有兩烏銜鵲墮東館。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "6f730b58f70518ddca18414d57905cb1b2bdfb9a4d02852c1e54409a350bb1f6"}

{"id": "p_8c5f448ade67c3b2", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 302, "text": "丙寅，驃騎將軍-{朱}-據領丞相，燎鵲以祭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "f95db27cba11f7ec4800007e511182ec2b3e8d0ba4bbaf8b56e98a1559b2703d"}

{"id": "p_ebb66726956e3b41", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 303, "text": "十三年夏五月，日至，熒惑入南斗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 303}, "text_hash": "8736413114d7d3d7e430410b8cc4f012c71a7592d4cf8f2e99c1bb07f9a91399"}

{"id": "p_de66da72a4a31cf0", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 304, "text": "秋七月，犯魁第二星而東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 304}, "text_hash": "a578c1d51e27b080e63ab8425d1873c335fd08a4533b2e9631a64cc7db819e18"}

{"id": "p_d1392a20b724c7a8", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 306, "text": "冬十月，魏將文欽偽叛以誘-{朱}-異，權遣呂據就異以迎欽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 306}, "text_hash": "8b4961944c35a166fbc0827f79c178b56ae223c90580e3b15ecb8f11abc20f6c"}

{"id": "p_8467a7dec09e54e5", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 307, "text": "遣軍十萬，作堂邑塗塘以淹北道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 307}, "text_hash": "2f2c8ec533cb2548eea83cf1413551e388c9d773f7814b7560b28c80420e816d"}

{"id": "p_de76b16d3cce4a77", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 308, "text": "十二月，魏大將軍王昶圍南郡，荊州刺史王基攻西陵，遣將軍戴烈、陸凱往拒之，皆引還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 308}, "text_hash": "c3eea9732688d2b5d0ce15d1db6a4376df3208be8fe3caa8ec6e47050b8e27bd"}

{"id": "p_7953d391f65de442", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 310, "text": "夏五月，立皇-{后}-潘氏，大赦，改年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 310}, "text_hash": "fffca241ba529cb5316bf487d5fc8fc353dcf1ddf2ca2dc15272ce37175fd5e3"}

{"id": "p_9396e521e3f2d9ab", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 311, "text": "初臨海羅陽縣有神，自稱王表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 311}, "text_hash": "6a3540b62cadc1a4e0077fc7ddec6a5f152fe94a797dadb637cc7049f8726d8d"}

{"id": "p_799f1e43707c778a", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 312, "text": "周旋民間，語言飲食，與人無異，然不見其形。", "locator": {"ordinal": 312}, "text_hash": "aaacf1620dcdd6cda074903922bb72a46e4605347c724dbec041c64d68cae1fe"}

{"id": "p_7fd2d9304b67f052", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 313, "text": "是月，遣中書郎李祟齎輔國將軍羅陽王印綬迎表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 313}, "text_hash": "d5e35a886672d1d5827fcec0b34e820b7a177b03f412b7a6c9267f98d6083884"}

{"id": "p_fcf9926cec782e24", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 314, "text": "表隨崇俱出，與祟及所在郡守令長談論，祟等無以易。", "locator": {"ordinal": 314}, "text_hash": "bd931a7cfc6ec9af25973a2966115d9948843fc39df8baf03c7a4cf78a97c489"}

{"id": "p_a0df21baa789c0bc", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 315, "text": "所歷山川，輒遣婢與其神相聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 315}, "text_hash": "75d8801d73ab572c5c3f5206873fd27edb45947807c75954da3b40d2e1f98408"}

{"id": "p_7309cae40610140e", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 316, "text": "秋七月，祟與表至，權於蒼龍門外爲立第舍，數使近臣齎酒食往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 316}, "text_hash": "43d876d1abdfbc162af66e990616f420288c761de63a0e7163011cb7decc1e71"}

{"id": "p_1568fa4d4a879719", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 317, "text": "表說水旱小事，往往有驗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 317}, "text_hash": "75fe40f8edcd9e04b5c124d3c8a431d35dcc3de7aad455eece1247f6632ef022"}

{"id": "p_b6d5801d6724fe8c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 318, "text": "江海湧溢，平地深八尺，吳髙陵-{松}-柏斯拔，郡城南門飛落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 318}, "text_hash": "3d694a6fd3c1740a0da2669138317f63814c4df06e2f01c8616f28f964b72ef8"}

{"id": "p_6fc511e5c04f8ae9", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 319, "text": "十二月，驛-{徵}-大將軍恪，拜爲太子太傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 319}, "text_hash": "fe5541bd9397f9feca9f0ad013e3012c749687d9761e7d323cd0ccccf00bf729"}

{"id": "p_d98544303c2c7e75", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 320, "text": "詔省徭役，減-{徵}-賦，除民所患苦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 320}, "text_hash": "01d92fef5387e07052f20ee05cbd9cda2a4efeaee4265985c4aa86d927fafcc3"}

{"id": "p_f2ee19b94e846283", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 321, "text": "二年春正月，立故太子和爲南陽王，居長沙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 321}, "text_hash": "3aa70e9fdf4253e37e5e8ef4c5d3e718951bf88a1c40ec430a00c8621f669743"}

{"id": "p_c8ea440d7447ec93", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 322, "text": "二月，大赦，改元爲神鳳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 322}, "text_hash": "1d8011abfae736c43735cf8ffdca6101051d465d05fc7e0956b554f09c217a96"}

{"id": "p_020309a314a4a17c", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 323, "text": "諸將吏數詣王表請福，表亡去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 323}, "text_hash": "d82ab8f8bc02b65cc9102507600d5602f968e5e1185c27b79df99996c3ddca33"}

{"id": "p_0817287095a63536", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 324, "text": "夏四月，權薨，時年七十一，謚曰大皇帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 324}, "text_hash": "4a5244257ec61065893d7d5527fddb56877338cce7f2eafbb780ef0ed11ab410"}

{"id": "p_83ea347ecea58078", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 325, "text": "評曰：「孫權屈身忍辱，任才尚計，有勾踐之奇，英人之傑矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 325}, "text_hash": "1a8f759a33a2f05a4e826551b32bd4b8e9efd1d3ea0197b79232d6d8dfec5971"}

{"id": "p_5fbd3e5cbc2e8d73", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 326, "text": "故能自擅江表，成鼎峙之業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 326}, "text_hash": "faecb481d8a206f6f5f48f096a0b5c220cc6c243567f7a027266ce5fd28f6045"}

{"id": "p_c858bd55c0406eda", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 327, "text": "然性多嫌忌，果於殺戮，暨臻末年，彌以滋甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 327}, "text_hash": "c81f13823a8a25e3c41b906a75c5caef352b7b3e7809f4077fb71edbaee72e28"}

{"id": "p_869188cde964c382", "source_id": "src_90248089724a23e1", "ordinal": 328, "text": "至於讒說殄行，胤嗣廢斃，豈所謂賜厥孫謀以燕冀於者哉?其後葉陵遲，遂致覆國，未必不由此也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 328}, "text_hash": "c871645858ccbbd7481091ea80b6cf28f111666d77b8e252dec932ebd5ba6a36"}

{"id": "p_573be1f34bcff94a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_ae3d832a311492c1", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 1, "text": "權春秋高，而亮最少，故尤留意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "3cbe11e3d0cbdb6b08318a07509596882fe9ff570ac9ba05f7b8a830a6ba2560"}

{"id": "p_86e01fd0ffdc0d84", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 2, "text": "姊全公主嘗譖太子和子母，心不自安，因倚權意，欲豫自結，數稱述全尚女，勸爲亮納。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "eb097aa6bb4c87463dfbc6d1f64dcf52d25e9f2a5362a44822482f2e16d5f8f4"}

{"id": "p_d823bb5cb5f3939f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 3, "text": "，和廢，權遂立亮爲太子，以全氏爲妃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "875f20c0b096ffc537227fbed8ea757f6614a0376ec6d765a95b28e7cd736a60"}

{"id": "p_98851c3af3e8727e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 4, "text": "冬，權寢疾，徵大將軍諸葛恪爲太子太傅，會稽太守滕胤爲太常，並受詔輔太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "cb68ac9e94ee243295337957bd5e1f517b1227483f7b057cbcf8c5b4358db866"}

{"id": "p_3e86c642906b2b16", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 5, "text": "明年四月，權薨，太子即尊號，大赦，改。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "47f596941f33f15824f016ccee13f71a34e17206d1498f751fd123c4ce2c2c12"}

{"id": "p_a066371669c9430c", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 6, "text": "閏月，以恪爲帝太傅，胤爲衞將軍領尚書事，上大將軍呂岱爲大司馬，諸文武在位皆進爵班賞，宂官加等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "ea6421828ad28c50cb52a8345e56f2456eed7a4e0a743af6ed3af3fb78b3324a"}

{"id": "p_27db46e56fc2734d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 7, "text": "冬十月，太傅恪率軍遏巢湖，城東興，使將軍全端守西城，都尉留略守東城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "fa315270a90086dd4d1c03650f3d27c18fe533b5d29eb9a94dccc34ad29ba673"}

{"id": "p_aece4c377a0e13c7", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 8, "text": "十二月朔丙申，大風雷電，魏使將軍諸葛誕、胡遵等步騎七萬圍東興，將軍王昶攻南郡，毌丘儉向武昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "73f7f42d8562bf17f79b4f678d06b037e251044a1b9356f1b0ff2862d4ff0081"}

{"id": "p_63763cba8e08ab6c", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 9, "text": "戊午，兵及東興，交戰，大破魏軍，殺將軍韓綜、桓嘉等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "c3322668dc2a8f6f3907cc201bdedf21a1a14df301450cdf65a383d48c6052e8"}

{"id": "p_514060918c3ceedd", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 10, "text": "是月，雷雨，天災武昌端門；改作端門，又災內殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "53b329963dc1588d3e6cd1943a0978ce35a99105b11198505aa4e1e6fd59e7fc"}

{"id": "p_43c7d2d63c4864ef", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 11, "text": "二年春正月丙寅，立皇后全氏，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "5f5cac455b32ef1c6227ccfd46b313602f21d003f2ba17b4dae81f1843f96520"}

{"id": "p_724aec294bbe6a9f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 12, "text": "二月，軍還自東興，大行封賞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "4727a176ec8cb784f0ed4c2eb615a5c108586961ac3d0fd14b68205e023e4474"}

{"id": "p_02d9c52e44f3e37e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 13, "text": "夏四月，圍新城，大疫，兵卒死者大半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "dc9e5ef3cbf33e06d03efa72680d8d8bf17d3e6dfb85c7770599039e2484fb1b"}

{"id": "p_93cdc2cedbef396c", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 14, "text": "武衞將軍孫峻伏兵殺恪於殿堂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "8cbe8704531d3aceaf5ddccb558a37a4f07d6bacd029f06127bd0c3441680723"}

{"id": "p_38581b334e377304", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 15, "text": "十一月，有大鳥五見于春申，明年改元。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "a78fcf56b487f1ff336edd5a1c8ab221cafb3bde953011bf43f12ee0a3314038"}

{"id": "p_d850f2d7b8ebcad5", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 16, "text": "秋，吳侯英謀殺峻，覺，英自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "86498bcd38fe5ce902238ce720f5bc243865074c24714947343ac101257d22ff"}

{"id": "p_cc2caf7eebd1c638", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 17, "text": "冬十一月，星茀于斗、牛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "7d894f7f0835f811e890c5c1b7663cadb3fcdd77c9ee333ed700ab2aec5ecf5f"}

{"id": "p_acf8bbf7375f4465", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 18, "text": "二年春正月，魏鎮東將軍毌丘儉、前將軍文欽以淮南之衆西入，戰于樂嘉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "8b7aa503d3b5d9ae0abf584c99caa7052ab6d4e348d91c2c15c22a1c7d750aa2"}

{"id": "p_fa54af3145efcffa", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 19, "text": "閏月壬辰，峻及驃騎將軍呂據、左將軍留贊率兵襲壽春，軍及東興，聞欽等敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "d97fc53f3c1ca57a95693aabbb082bc1b7ee2bd815e69d39a3395e6475adc839"}

{"id": "p_8f2a432a66e49920", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 20, "text": "壬寅，兵進于橐臯，欽詣峻降，淮南餘衆數萬口來奔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "48d5d1edc2387c98add63ab388df0989bbbced516f802efc0503046c2bfe11d8"}

{"id": "p_af80f937e642bffe", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 21, "text": "魏諸葛誕入壽春，峻引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "73131dcc86ecda8c1773715902bb915827e686c2504638611375cfeafdafd410"}

{"id": "p_b3ed40d3dee4bb97", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 22, "text": "二月，及魏將軍曹珍遇于高亭，交戰，珍敗績。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "8646c5686e82b32424f837f2ec0cbabad45bf5d76a830a6f96f77c356d6713fd"}

{"id": "p_7471330ffb225f58", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 23, "text": "留贊爲誕別將蔣班所敗於菰陂，贊及將軍孫楞、蔣脩等皆遇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "67b723c00165ee16d57ab93ea4fd4e75a4e741fbde5448606dc8073d979bd0f5"}

{"id": "p_af19b9c75f23a865", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 24, "text": "三月，使鎮南將軍朱異襲安豐，不克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "81aa9400249ecb4b66241168c34f57a3d95c4ef4f59a4ea272232a48fa12b646"}

{"id": "p_c225cf6db3616bec", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 25, "text": "秋七月，將軍孫儀、張怡、林恂等謀殺峻，發覺，儀自殺，恂等伏辜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "c5bef6e3a73be88229c671fa3acb44aa7f68823b5a2013371f22f5411cc13e92"}

{"id": "p_ec48bb21f8ec7779", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 26, "text": "使衞尉馮朝城廣陵，拜將軍吳穰爲廣陵太守，留略爲東海太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "50bc244ec8f3b6d9be7cc7b01fef6fe1fd0ee8854b8b5277c15e7aeb9b11d4cd"}

{"id": "p_47b73893bdff2fa3", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 27, "text": "以馮朝爲監軍使者，督徐州諸軍事，民饑，軍士怨畔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "ab704f5fa127b8e05e0b7840f81b22b839edfc176b1fcbf621eb6faf277ce1b4"}

{"id": "p_ea5739e338b28f22", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 28, "text": "峻用征北大將軍文欽計，將征魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "b3d3521d40b79934370c6f19900207cdf7484660c29b46a1b5502ca3b3f3acd9"}

{"id": "p_bd1c092a6ce66e71", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 29, "text": "八月，先遣欽及驃騎呂據、車騎劉纂、鎮南朱異、前將軍唐咨軍自江都入淮、泗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "453d43a987bad971b1bf2e5d41615a21fc6a1fa97558d501fac25425c764b475"}

{"id": "p_1e87b079b4f9dc7e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 30, "text": "九月丁亥，峻卒，以從弟偏將軍綝爲侍中、武衞將軍，領中外諸軍事，召還據等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "4638393f7767c0bb2a12d3a013acd2e674c63d8470819dbabc74b34a32c37e05"}

{"id": "p_9d206816f7015eab", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 31, "text": "據、欽、咨等表薦衞將軍滕胤爲丞相，綝不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "c262a3de8bb4c93b86698e09b4c274c8126c956ba40f82490fe44bfce369800c"}

{"id": "p_5671d1ce2a1e6d4d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 32, "text": "癸卯，更以胤爲大司馬，代呂岱駐武昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "86bbcdc1d13c8987f05c9b7affb55aa13e8b4254b5d75c2f52f1039e2ce0c009"}

{"id": "p_98e6918e488e2358", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 33, "text": "綝遣使以詔書告喻欽、咨等，使取據。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "419b5901494ce2222027741379977aae79727b29dd9ffb18efd2f3b8c94c1c6d"}

{"id": "p_1291101b2586efe4", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 34, "text": "冬十月丁未，遣孫憲及丁奉、施寬等以舟兵逆據於江都，遣將軍劉丞督步騎攻胤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "11f34a5e0aeb35674569796d098fdedfb12b78036cd7b0e727190c59fa15773b"}

{"id": "p_98bcb0d098ad0a01", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 35, "text": "十一月，以綝爲大將軍、假節，封永康侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "eb34aa482ba35f684a0cb3b5955ca5e0e85de4f03383faa97a4d7e2df69b6485"}

{"id": "p_b37e9f2a3e18eb02", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 36, "text": "孫憲與將軍王惇謀殺綝，事覺，綝殺惇，迫憲令自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "443db20a7fab38a9ec7bbf310af25a9898fc59427350653a1a5be56626c54f4e"}

{"id": "p_a70ce5f4ed1b4aad", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 37, "text": "十二月，使五官中郎將刁玄告亂于蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "e988c370c38658cbbb19548a954c8c0f070ccf8abec78dea31786943d0c370df"}

{"id": "p_9e63403cfd911029", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 38, "text": "二年春二月甲寅，大雨，震電。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "565c9ec15ebee1afa93ccba7c9a060415bbf6f7c409cd9c233806c2a38e9324d"}

{"id": "p_1d859346d0770a01", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 39, "text": "以長沙東部爲湘東郡，西部爲衡陽郡，會稽東部爲臨海郡，豫章東部爲臨川郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "cbcce2e772f8c7b4ce43354189e7ac7eb25cc1d4bf35f453bca97fab687ec1a3"}

{"id": "p_7fa902d73acfe965", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 40, "text": "夏四月，亮臨正殿，大赦，始親政事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "80fa9f90e235f237b31786024eacc2fe3c990c49acda90a033c02391db81501b"}

{"id": "p_baf608ea218af50d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 41, "text": "綝所表奏，多見難問，又科兵子弟年十八已下十五已上，得三千餘人，選大將子弟年少有勇力者爲之將帥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "04a2cee28cff404a30bbce24447d9385b89e9beed4634b41d086b191d476e0e2"}

{"id": "p_7ec0b8bd95634753", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 42, "text": "亮曰：「吾立此軍，欲與之俱長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "687d550261ff57196827befb7833eadb6bccfb87f3aed68724b0944ee78bce2f"}

{"id": "p_a7d0dce927c4e814", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 43, "text": "五月，魏征東大將軍諸葛誕以淮南之衆保壽春城，遣將軍朱成稱臣上疏，又遣子靚、長史吳綱諸牙門子弟爲質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "add43335a706254872e0f97e03da9e65fa2cfd4ed446b5157f2b2751afc0a4c6"}

{"id": "p_afe1dbcf2783f716", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 44, "text": "六月，使文欽、唐咨、全端等步騎三萬救誕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "4e6a91a5efcd228a63e3e701b76db66de1a310d3fd6e8b1f3595d620aacb3b12"}

{"id": "p_335f14a429a42872", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 45, "text": "朱異自虎林率衆襲夏口，夏口督孫壹奔魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "3bd3fb95affa15a0594aecf08b8dbca7f9b2e567e7c70224e1261e48b0817463"}

{"id": "p_449ecb4c60204e7e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 46, "text": "秋七月，綝率衆救壽春，次于鑊里，朱異至自夏口，綝使異爲前部督，與丁奉等將介士五萬解圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "91eaf03ca6b164b5adf6f9b8c3f554c4d8e2d416fa8c8092b45ded0eaec53311"}

{"id": "p_55aa4eccadec5162", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 47, "text": "八月，會稽南部反，殺都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "5ba73bc5ea3128362ddcede2dd82a3b466fc242bb2880f2a249175775d78dd17"}

{"id": "p_68c03188f830b8a8", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 48, "text": "鄱陽、新都民爲亂，廷尉丁密、步兵校尉鄭胄、將軍鍾離牧率軍討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "c3a98706dd6d981811487191e901dd559b3d0e743e75d188b5832c295cc2444f"}

{"id": "p_254abf58d7686897", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 49, "text": "朱異以軍士乏食引還，綝大怒，九月朔己巳，殺異於鑊里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "f37f4af64289afb2d176b74e05671889ca231b726afe5defc7e0e777d75b9684"}

{"id": "p_5c38c0054ca4d2f6", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 50, "text": "十一月，全緒子禕、儀以其母奔魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "92421dc18aa452f2cc43c473654b25bc5c56c858715009abc95f24b7c5297637"}

{"id": "p_6b13e77ed2cbf342", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 51, "text": "十二月，全端、懌等自壽春城詣司馬文王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "b07d99bbe7d97c14b31060c531dcb7925c65bc40be49f7e4bb5554b5c497d192"}

{"id": "p_08c52f69987633c7", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 52, "text": "三年春正月，諸葛誕殺文欽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "1d47052f38b587f5be59a2557d3d2eabaed8dc710d936fb8838ba0eae90328a0"}

{"id": "p_c79de90c32f4cc25", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 53, "text": "三月，司馬文王克壽春，誕及左右戰死，將吏已下皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "e9da0704ba8e4a3c2f6a92d426c0b300d3d5fe0f0761613e4ae352329d2217a1"}

{"id": "p_70941ab522eba10f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 54, "text": "秋七月，封故齊王奮爲章安侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "4dca36ffe6341d509ea7fe6e39ca6705fee159ae6ebeb2241563ad598764cd10"}

{"id": "p_5ef0254e335eb756", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 55, "text": "自八月沈陰不雨四十餘日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "7a6ea8897981e9508633e68f2483da62a372b8f5b8c1fb5f4235930034edb952"}

{"id": "p_07ef514e0be478d4", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 56, "text": "亮以綝專恣，與太常全尚，將軍劉丞謀誅綝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "6641f3b5d97c0d9f46472afc627477540e89c30e867b2d8f7eb8a0923e59e8a4"}

{"id": "p_9a47cf3377248f68", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 57, "text": "九月戊午，綝以兵取尚，遣弟恩攻殺丞於蒼龍門外，召大臣會宮門，黜亮爲會稽王，時年十六。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "8a8afe47ddc1cc482106a2b5237e1b85e4faec23f60545070e751f97e26803bd"}

{"id": "p_7d585eaedb78d24e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 58, "text": "年十三，從中書郎射慈、郎中盛冲受學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "f0dbb81c8585150f4968f3453f99e6cef6d6c6bc1e8bf78f83cea0bdba7ba3b6"}

{"id": "p_551e99e9f229dd06", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 59, "text": "正月，封琅邪王，居虎林。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "a1348a3543d2b17c404181c39f9eacf98fea143fe4a78cd424b8611f22b70533"}

{"id": "p_6f95e3984509fb35", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 60, "text": "四月，權薨，休弟亮承統，諸葛恪秉政，不欲諸王在濵江兵馬之地，徙休於丹楊郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "74fe5d90bebde4a7b6535e6540ef8d6c228e7547d81d4188ee8a3a0b8892be05"}

{"id": "p_856da52ec6a6df7a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 61, "text": "太守李衡數以事侵休，休上書乞徙他郡，詔徙會稽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "93a5cbaff491051ea3a4bfbf66c6fed252929e2e334ca92f0ab1deed98acbbea"}

{"id": "p_96131288ed42bfeb", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 62, "text": "居數歲，夢乘龍上天，顧不見尾，覺而異之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "59f524745a000865d614460d4ce0531d7c1c00c0a29425879d31e30442c3d58d"}

{"id": "p_acf806488ffc93d1", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 63, "text": "孫亮廢，己未，孫綝使宗正孫楷與中書郎董朝迎休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "5a9824fa2ed16455992374bbb8bfc8ef62d70286995b2b80e54ac388d7bca1cb"}

{"id": "p_53359df6cfbd915d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 64, "text": "休初聞問，意疑，楷、朝具述綝等所以奉迎本意，留一日二夜，遂發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "18d8cf27cc961eb9022712562638fc5e10c4cabc6a46b69880e66daca8b518f6"}

{"id": "p_ad98de9b63c30d1d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 65, "text": "十月戊寅，行至曲阿，有老公干休叩頭曰：「事乆變生，天下喁喁，願陛下速行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "9d8351a745fa8040efc7b89d027f0438a673a8f21a3c0f694e4766e0e878ac0a"}

{"id": "p_5737a9abce9c4b18", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 66, "text": "」休善之，是日進及布塞亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "a68730258cfecb8bc12b8728dd15781832ad7e2fc99a1f28264293ef4da1b5d4"}

{"id": "p_34f69eabcc8fcfa7", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 67, "text": "武衞將軍恩行丞相事，率百僚以乘輿法駕迎於永昌亭，築宮，以武帳爲便殿，設御座。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "80fd8660a8bb627160765cb01c993908b3a7cc69ddfa7cdfece0a83fed6dd032"}

{"id": "p_9b817ea9ad6e3ecb", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 68, "text": "己卯，休至，望便殿止住，使孫楷先見恩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "87ff0f512f70f3c97ce06e642220139cc60d0ee8ff7eeb4f9adf0588ba0be63c"}

{"id": "p_012741bf2f352f15", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 69, "text": "楷還，休乘輦進，羣臣再拜稱臣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "7901420a7cb19683d4d151896eb7f7fefb6100148656a512d789ceedb992b2a9"}

{"id": "p_8fa9a3ce1dab2ebc", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 70, "text": "休升便殿，謙不即御坐，止東廂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "da471d7ad9b99008ddabd5841e39f9ac25b18a8f0a485b88c75df10f02f8572f"}

{"id": "p_343c2a9dfb82315c", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 71, "text": "戶曹尚書前即階下讚奏，丞相奉璽符。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "3a1d1e772aa65880e7cc4394f199751472a8916affdb643195f8e9b312db0b0b"}

{"id": "p_c47693ac5edf2e08", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 72, "text": "休曰：「將相諸侯咸推寡人，寡人敢不承受璽符。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "f20a7e3d04d59a31b879760f662cbe2cd3334c1df50c07fd11a35660bbd2f91c"}

{"id": "p_832e73484bc08c2c", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」羣臣以次奉引，休就乘輿，百官陪位，綝以兵千人迎於半野，拜于道側，休下車荅拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "707aab7a749ef27844bbd74eebf7c12ab9aa639cbfe72ee1e69ef5da054f74cd"}

{"id": "p_5d22fd3e0d4a14bb", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 74, "text": "即日，御正殿，大赦，改元。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "56f11ac04c7e8fb3745bddda7391e86e381fe8c01daa5588952362f6cd7474f5"}

{"id": "p_fc9f79b8dd507386", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 75, "text": "冬十月壬午，詔曰：「」又詔曰：「」己丑，封孫皓爲烏程侯，皓弟德錢唐侯，謙永安侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "8e8b5dcaef1069d20dbdd3fa2eece73fd4cef9575511f27efdccfdf1df5f2217"}

{"id": "p_5e5420c9ab235463", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 76, "text": "十一月甲午，風四轉五復，蒙霧連日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "defd58c7743199c723e60809947850fcb783f4f206c59999cb318fa38f412c31"}

{"id": "p_99be9b1755168ea3", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 77, "text": "綝一門五侯皆典禁兵，權傾人主，有所陳述，敬而不違，於是益恣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "da981bd58605cee4533e3cd7e9a70ee1a4fd6e405345a7255aadacca1f17beec"}

{"id": "p_bee48f1c220ef315", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 78, "text": "丙申，詔曰：「」戊戌，詔曰：「」壬子，詔曰：「」又曰：「」頃之，休聞綝逆謀，陰與張布圖計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "d839838b6006e6a56c03574378889203e5be43f51e6e722e6f00ea7d01456465"}

{"id": "p_8670b3a28cf98107", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 79, "text": "十二月戊辰臘，百僚朝賀，公卿升殿，詔武士縛綝，即日伏誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "6d2f16f816576babb29ff4bdcc1e3053d7e3c21480eae214e48f680a99689bca"}

{"id": "p_8ed0bcf57e3fccda", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 80, "text": "己巳，詔以左將軍張布討姦臣，加布爲中軍督，封布弟惇爲都亭侯，給兵三百人，惇弟恂爲校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "cd1fb95ee44072b0795450ed80e3988a06806a63faf2a2dc6c8ed52cda6096ca"}

{"id": "p_d371eb3bb2526411", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 81, "text": "三月，備九卿官，詔曰：「」", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "b1b234989f23ca2c695f92f63e03eaaac75f8b1bc6c8c8b8d85e900776d07330"}

{"id": "p_d982e8b47cd2e16a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 82, "text": "三年春三月，西陵言赤烏見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "75e1ab6ab7915f75232bb3dfc7452d048e9639bbcb07dccb3b1696a363d9a020"}

{"id": "p_01f2e68dab284d63", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 83, "text": "秋，用都尉嚴密議，作浦里塘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "3f5a22cb6fed32f5738c9a789acb795e1b40cc2227219e261aedc1fdcdbae095"}

{"id": "p_f38015a25c6477d8", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 84, "text": "會稽郡謠言王亮當還爲天子，而亮宮人告亮使巫禱祠，有惡言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "e61644010e214638beb77213f82cbed9e36404598c0cd00e1327ec0e5bb4b56c"}

{"id": "p_de665d6954fae527", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 85, "text": "有司以聞，黜爲候官侯，遣之國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "c6281ede6e4a0d1dff65ac93e244b6286d7b07c70af301a5364f78623d805689"}

{"id": "p_4b72a807eb1ce905", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 86, "text": "以會稽南部爲建安郡，分宜都置建平郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "9523640a0de0037551a1c4e6d457328e3a6e511be2686c9299542d9c2e7a744d"}

{"id": "p_b6aa2475df4297fe", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 87, "text": "四年夏五月，大雨，水泉涌溢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "4cbea75465475cf52468245dd2d65371313c145030897f3baf50abca07b2d0aa"}

{"id": "p_8e81c0d4e5bf1935", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 88, "text": "秋八月，遣光祿大夫周弈、石偉巡行風俗，察將吏清濁，民所疾苦，爲黜陟之詔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "05762001316b73c5903fd285c2423e1f4f0734ce483606507e2435fadf652099"}

{"id": "p_45c9e0e2789704bb", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 89, "text": "是歲，安吳民陳焦死，埋之，六日更生，穿土中出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "1ff5f724c1237bc0c4fe713a21a351cdfd754fdb902af36e84297380b8b2d30a"}

{"id": "p_ed6568b03753247d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 90, "text": "五年春二月，白虎門北樓災。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "13057fd86c843a4054addb02258c278b9b6461d1734c980aa6b0b869cd02d628"}

{"id": "p_9c4dccf403f612ea", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 91, "text": "八月壬午，大雨震電，水泉涌溢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "b8dcdc5d756258d00199f1261a06b6d1664ce66e4695101d92fda5acdca906d6"}

{"id": "p_8d06e1858ee0b3d3", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 92, "text": "戊子，立子爲太子，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "f425b0a0d5064eb3062d022d35ebc7a266d837a36fb7fbd16b6253f058c89bd4"}

{"id": "p_7acd57ac17b2a09e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 93, "text": "冬十月，以衞將軍濮陽興爲丞相，廷尉丁密、光祿勳孟宗爲左右御史大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "2c20e04dcc4dd0009176edd9b42835eeeec00b7997e971a40afdbe6dba34c35c"}

{"id": "p_07d2b59d1a32b3e1", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 94, "text": "休以丞相興及左將軍張布有舊恩，委之以事，布典宮省，興關軍國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "f39e43d843867e5aa79ef746532cc8223e4084a9105d2553343c089b3436dc56"}

{"id": "p_885793c085f47cac", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 95, "text": "休銳意於典籍，欲畢覽百家之言，尤好射雉，春夏之間常晨出夜還，唯此時舍書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "e5a326fb7ac5c06669d92d23f4a1265a95e9fff4ecd22c8c15cce0a3da912a8e"}

{"id": "p_ef501cb5d57c19e3", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 96, "text": "休欲與愽士祭酒韋曜、博士盛沖講論道藝，曜、沖素皆切直，布恐入侍，發其陰失，令己不得專，因妄飾說以拒遏之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "8282323fa59f8ddcac56aa1e440cbe6e91da04ff78f7882eedca9128d8a8a053"}

{"id": "p_428828b37ec8039e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 97, "text": "休荅曰：「孤之涉學，羣書略徧，所見不少也；其明君闇王，姦臣賊子，古今賢愚成敗之事，無不覽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "c3dd61c1429b4d14fdb6e6c781087e04bab6d9aceafb724e2f5c9ae9b04b82dd"}

{"id": "p_5d8ac7e98ffd1740", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 98, "text": "今曜等入，但欲與論講書耳，不爲從曜等始更受學也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "972f053f83ce5152b7fa5e1ccaadb38a63289617ea9ca6ef5e3de48fa5f401dc"}

{"id": "p_00e0fc3bf608d67a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 99, "text": "君特當以曜等恐道臣下姦變之事，以此不欲令入耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "046ea7ddfa61c0bdf331270e8f4b80da76cfe2218e0baa4fd38400f429c5b14f"}

{"id": "p_02eff3aaf0dbca6e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 100, "text": "如此之事，孤已自備之，不須曜等然後乃解也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "f0af0b467d6ecefd4699fc23988b933aec558a0f152f4c4398c53ecdbf084aa8"}

{"id": "p_5ce0b97e7b921031", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 101, "text": "此都無所損，君意特有所忌故耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "0634faecb75589d6a0098c1aba45829c20f0062335fe1ee59a5255c1260f71b3"}

{"id": "p_bf10b47f360234b4", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 102, "text": "」布得詔陳謝，重自序述，又言懼妨政事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "825b5da06fcae76b215af81161dc58141977c1363eb5299e362852fbbfb88513"}

{"id": "p_b2c43059ec9945af", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 103, "text": "休荅曰：「書籍之事，患人不好，好之無傷也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "2d598828034abeb0b0293ba9e1c054fa6316ca9f3dc727e2d41d5cb50f28dea4"}

{"id": "p_04f12bb06b160440", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 104, "text": "此無所爲非，而君以爲不宜，是以孤有所及耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "86b618d402097bf5fc57f82ff8ccabd64f1db792c4d7ccf8c5299ea2e4534fc1"}

{"id": "p_a61ea70dc1217dec", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 105, "text": "王務學業，其流各異，不相妨也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "d1ea306dc546f157cd1f7e8f3b705fcc8bee88d8019491fc42c5fdf4ce78393f"}

{"id": "p_f57aae9f0dcf8e8f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 106, "text": "不圖君今日在事，更行此於孤也，良所不取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "1cf2f8a02a0c964eb1690f396e650c7087139d26ae2c709c2789a457654afcfb"}

{"id": "p_ae1dbe467131ccfb", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 107, "text": "」布拜表叩頭，休荅曰：「聊相開悟耳，何至叩頭乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "8dfe7c06de41ac4344f412b4c803364fa8f5a50f84e7a60dcdb3722845cff303"}

{"id": "p_172dfd979840d510", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 108, "text": "往者所以相感，今日之巍巍也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "c3ddab692d1737b3298a316d2ba7599c321862a1e552e1bede15deca92f1c31a"}

{"id": "p_b6594996d642a46f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 109, "text": "詩云：『靡不有初，鮮克有終。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "0d06da7fd1cfa03dc6162671d1e623c7be4e1751fb915e310304002402b77491"}

{"id": "p_4041372a5cff646f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 110, "text": "」初休爲王時，布爲左右將督，素見信愛，及至踐阼，厚加寵待，專擅國勢，多行無禮，自嫌瑕短，懼曜、沖言之，故尤患忌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "0d9aa51266937b9308408be888276af6b66edb8c9aab615acbe0016261adbb2a"}

{"id": "p_fd81941a69891372", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 111, "text": "休雖解此旨，心不能恱，更恐其疑懼，竟如布意，廢其講業，不復使沖等入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "5e1a2d15b8024e67dbb42607200a8feef8471458b36d10870865a792a35954cf"}

{"id": "p_9dd757375103a4e0", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 112, "text": "是歲使察戰到交阯調孔爵、大豬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "25798815f2550a957b2a2620f38427eba5e1a055b752337d341a4d099ad2ceba"}

{"id": "p_0c8cdfd2c04f5fce", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 113, "text": "六年夏四月，泉陵言黃龍見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "4e81abe823947e4daf9e8357aaadbfed48c8255bc44d49e42796e5220ee42eaf"}

{"id": "p_cc895bfe2d17776d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 114, "text": "五月，交阯郡吏呂興等反，殺太守孫諝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "e0a50b812a127b689fc5d067ae435c59dd2edf4f7eccf63daaafb6479fdb8ef6"}

{"id": "p_c0b689569e65d11f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 115, "text": "諝先是科郡上手工千餘人送建業，而察戰至，恐復見取，故興等因此扇動兵民，招誘諸夷也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "0747b752e6313451ed5e983ee0221c6f807fbdf6a2befb7d505087eab7600020"}

{"id": "p_6f624ebca62e8954", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 116, "text": "冬十月，蜀以魏見伐來告。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "596e7cc8489c724c23a34ecdff040c0c806cf96044ce39f5ecbbe200933ee0e6"}

{"id": "p_12e4103a6249b6a1", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 117, "text": "癸未，建業石頭小城火，燒西南百八十丈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "75176f61d3c149f8c4e484fbd7496d9fa981db8abc6b05518093e49fe9731379"}

{"id": "p_646a4dc928e50bb0", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 118, "text": "甲申，使大將軍丁奉督諸軍向魏壽春，將軍留平別詣施績於南郡，議兵所向，將軍丁封、孫異如沔中，皆救蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "b926f8eff36919e38f0feda0aa703dd2f0ef8591bd81eb26614513c17cf67c4c"}

{"id": "p_97024d00b3976528", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 119, "text": "蜀主劉禪降魏問至，然後罷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "91fd41ae0e5d9d5a14974f99d1174de061a4e987b9a294003b6cfdb9c2f69ce2"}

{"id": "p_985556237a77a42e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 120, "text": "呂興旣殺孫諝，使使如魏，請太守及兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "edd32680a41553d8e4340809542dfeff8d9c6b8b87bca113b42548cc7d36106d"}

{"id": "p_9fed84a571dff31f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 121, "text": "丞相興建取屯田萬人以爲兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "0edd7be51c0403530772092b97b0807dd05fabc811b05ae4cc040f90f9e14121"}

{"id": "p_24883c37c9479e5c", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 122, "text": "二月，鎮軍陸抗、撫軍步恊、征西將軍留平、建平太守盛曼，率衆圍蜀巴東守將羅憲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "fb6bf4e39085780613c84615f10900278f57af3bcf1c72399a9e258a4753e765"}

{"id": "p_42cb2d51df60f6f7", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 123, "text": "夏四月，魏將新附督王稚浮海入句章，略長吏賞林及男女二百餘口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "ec7ed607ba2fcb19a2e888fbd59e7b3071b9d80f82da36eadb51f9cf8afc3018"}

{"id": "p_94354b3c878caad6", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 124, "text": "將軍孫越徼得一船，獲三十人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "d2bb11ce4e58d6c18f6a4a65259d207c3c8f2234e077c1fe44b52722e4893d56"}

{"id": "p_95aafa7580f8b59d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 125, "text": "秋七月，海賊破海鹽，殺司鹽校尉駱秀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "6ee5763d2675eb8f4b594d375382b1ab6f5f94f32fe30800eb924addb38827e3"}

{"id": "p_435870de9a62091f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 126, "text": "豫章民張節等爲亂，衆萬餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "1478f0e139bf4a671fd1c3c56421a0fa6902b285b639327527e97e4cac974809"}

{"id": "p_c41f9ae2b0151ed6", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 127, "text": "魏使將軍胡烈步騎二萬侵西陵，以救羅憲，陸抗等引軍退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "3bc603ce089fb4faaab5a6338d1b89f0e69e515974ff0ceb5a6720d4b582555c"}

{"id": "p_23ae7a1ac67f6192", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 128, "text": "癸未，休薨，時年三十，謚曰景皇帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "90e9477743b70c763f92d1219dc17c7cefe2730e32b008554c68801fa93a566c"}

{"id": "p_957fef6f624c6828", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 129, "text": "孫皓字元宗，權孫，和子也，一名彭祖，字皓宗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "b9991974463a44c3598c78840df83239a5dc0b68efa4e9111c618add9873a67a"}

{"id": "p_3546837a1ef3ac6b", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 130, "text": "孫休立，封皓爲烏程侯，遣就國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "0ee296f7a0b0b76cd5ab38c2b09085e247c353bf82d7a38e7b75d8779a83469b"}

{"id": "p_471292c09c7d3edf", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 131, "text": "西湖民景養相皓當大貴，皓陰喜而不敢泄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "5d530785a6280830a3ffbeeff742ac1e0800602831d76f0871ed88816729391f"}

{"id": "p_fbab935635e20a83", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 132, "text": "休薨，是時蜀初亡，而交阯攜叛，國內震懼，貪得長君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "61d799d8985bd7a18442a65e4cbf6524faecc6fa52279ceb3b4385678677c575"}

{"id": "p_528bee076daf5621", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 133, "text": "左典軍萬彧昔爲烏程令，與皓相善，稱皓才識明斷，是長沙桓王之疇也，又加之好學，奉遵法度，屢言之於丞相濮陽興、左將軍張布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "cfadc39a087e1900710847ae81efedd8778b0d7056f28118bf9ffedc1a6b6534"}

{"id": "p_869b8e04c9abb7a3", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 134, "text": "興、布說休妃太后朱，欲以皓爲嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "c5e84c4f5596f8c1caa3d010516743204f07073f25cc1e3d9df3bf4435f55962"}

{"id": "p_c33a7567552f798b", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 135, "text": "朱曰：「我寡婦人，安知社稷之慮，苟吳國無損，宗廟有賴可矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "e5f76f284de85ae58a2b045b59c457c15ca0a00e7fe0af677123a8c63c510f19"}

{"id": "p_6e9b5e63a25084ae", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 136, "text": "」於是遂迎立皓，時年二十三。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "2a136c3f94d8772501f44b2df49afe6aadbc803ac194bba619d07632b7a47db8"}

{"id": "p_45c3cc512e48262f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 137, "text": "八月，以上大將軍施績、大將軍丁奉爲左右大司馬，張布爲驃騎將軍，加侍中，諸增位班賞，一皆如舊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "323d02efb886617a1bea7b9e0d947c3d2fa471c9b4a23c5283b374d6d4822367"}

{"id": "p_e7046d8de360d43a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 138, "text": "九月，貶太后爲景皇后，追謚父和曰文皇帝，尊母何爲太后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "b8212b025784b7c3e02429af0910b693e4568ca099b677f1462561534e7debb8"}

{"id": "p_5d3994edf545fd4e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 139, "text": "十月，封休太子爲豫章王，次子汝南王，次子梁王，次子陳王，立皇后滕氏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "41e1a63c9dedb00548f304d51d270bfa523c5c2f32e7a6c32c6249e3be9bdab4"}

{"id": "p_79853573ffdad0f9", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 140, "text": "皓旣得志，麤暴驕盈，多忌諱，好酒色，大小失望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "3105263dd3e49383be36fa023344840112f6d83304c9f803c33bb4456f8b2413"}

{"id": "p_d6dc073f357b0ba8", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 141, "text": "或以譖皓，十一月，誅興、布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "9015e263ac435c2248f57cc60fd4fb597c997d2269ce89629317428935118233"}

{"id": "p_52367ff967f70a90", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 142, "text": "封后父滕牧爲高密侯，舅何洪等三人皆列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "05eed004af978d1723b90f241a84ddb26f60f61fdbeeae3d33839479044b123d"}

{"id": "p_060a01af311280b7", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 143, "text": "是歲，魏置交阯太守之郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "05eb97b985898daba3cf06147fa395d669f1d82a99ec5583f18a075e805e273c"}

{"id": "p_6092f4c2febf05a5", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 144, "text": "晉文帝爲魏相國，遣昔吳壽春城降將徐紹、孫彧銜命齎書，陳事勢利害，以申喻皓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "87a517465badfb02ef7e76a864c9af2fbe9b5f6aa44d4df02025bad94dc64829"}

{"id": "p_1ced11adffe03b21", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 145, "text": "三月，皓遣使隨紹、彧報書曰：「知以高世之才，處宰輔之任，漸導之功，勤亦至矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "a41e77dd56baa0b8e9a32ab3a31efca977afb242b6277a8e5b6c34a3e43ed532"}

{"id": "p_1df7b29807f55ee3", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 146, "text": "孤以不德，階承統緒，思與賢良共濟世道，而以壅隔未有所緣，嘉意允著，深用依依。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "356390b6aecad307a20c2a76bb5505c9cdb2a7ac993170b205d4e30140ddcd0c"}

{"id": "p_4ae0e83483120e08", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 147, "text": "今遣光祿大夫紀陟、五官中郎將弘璆宣明至懷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "239bb0640559742fdcbd4cf14e1df2ed6f9190de9889ed7cbdf0b22611f6e052"}

{"id": "p_cd5e59f60b4a3d19", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」紹行到濡須，召還殺之，徙其家屬建安，始有白紹稱美中國者故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "e3e9923788bd0b8014c3ffc0db73a51024cec16393b7d03a7df4fd28a13c78f5"}

{"id": "p_d15c8f5f2728d25d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 149, "text": "夏四月，蔣陵言甘露降，於是改年大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "d0d8cc35f012f355a2c2bc1a1ebf24bacc42f19dfc05650259efd2a16fd7e54a"}

{"id": "p_80ef8a641a7655ae", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 150, "text": "秋七月，皓逼殺景后朱氏，亡不在正殿，於苑中小屋治喪，衆知其非疾病，莫不痛切。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "10e1a672f190278c8ac64b0543f22ab9f3a0376ed9059f94da811204f90eed5d"}

{"id": "p_852647cd85c44c6b", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 151, "text": "又送休四子於吳小城，尋復追殺大者二人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "1ef9c7bb892223d65d1df7ae33d8194cf3ea60433a6dc40ff63b76baa34e4100"}

{"id": "p_e59d5483fee09ac1", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 152, "text": "九月，從西陵督步闡表，徙都武昌，御史大夫丁固、右將軍諸葛靚鎮建業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "5d8ad137c60096af29404b571edec2d6d7aa15b762b197129acf7ab1351be57e"}

{"id": "p_52e3321abdabcca1", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 153, "text": "陟、璆至洛，遇晉文帝崩，十一月，乃遣還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "1b42ee09e83141c445deb35c4cc320785144309ad36bac791e05849df4a0a5bd"}

{"id": "p_85cae40d79db96b3", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 154, "text": "以零陵南部爲始安郡，桂陽南部爲始興郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "035df4021441311807d534d8f849c5d7dc008440d02355e50ce2b9f472da3993"}

{"id": "p_d7aa87c25c875862", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 155, "text": "正月，遣大鴻臚張儼、五官中郎將丁忠弔祭晉文帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "471f8ff729f7049fca066650995d74be2353000c448f40cb47dddc71354841a5"}

{"id": "p_c00168f29f880c9e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 156, "text": "忠說皓曰：「北方守戰之具不設，弋陽可襲而取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "1481e17e8125286b1e3b37f39c370bb4cddaed704f5e6954aece5ad645a630a1"}

{"id": "p_43416186b29cf527", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 157, "text": "」皓訪羣臣，鎮西大將軍陸凱曰：「夫兵不得已而用之耳，且三國鼎立已來，更相侵伐，無歲寧居。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "b60fee37202d5bd6b012aef0ad91c488ce4854e60a69b59f139f8f11a95c8dc5"}

{"id": "p_f85e5560cbe4cf56", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 158, "text": "今彊敵新并巴蜀，有兼土之實，而遣使求親，欲息兵役，不可謂其求援於我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "3d4b49a27523ce0c01f4734ee0d75a9f8f55cd6ab4ca0e0942e3ee4bf44f3457"}

{"id": "p_6e60ba0902c39b64", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 159, "text": "今敵形勢方彊，而欲徼幸求勝，未見其利也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "2270d12acfbd1db38d622484a0221bb2d8dde6a136eb3764fdf7d918e1d13940"}

{"id": "p_34cf7b680c9c357d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 160, "text": "」車騎將軍劉纂曰：「天生五才，誰能去兵？", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "042a665ae8c5e7dedb667bca5bb655d3eaae005e18ed5e180b5f2860577978d5"}

{"id": "p_29eeb5ec94955b65", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 161, "text": "」皓陰納纂言，且以蜀新平，故不行，然遂自絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "d6593960523df4a3638a3230f65c257cad47f336e9e02f5e1d338991985a3db3"}

{"id": "p_5f9f5f375ea5ed5a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 162, "text": "八月，所在言得大鼎，於是改年，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "461ff521f2115db17527b1b52743cd9581f70b4079d99755ee7e63d74bbca5b4"}

{"id": "p_c88b9888eb07d988", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 163, "text": "以陸凱爲左丞相，常侍萬彧爲右丞相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "45d1ec38f46314649d0f79cf1af4781dc3b56d806992859b316ac0dcdbdac6eb"}

{"id": "p_1cf288cee559622c", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 164, "text": "冬十月，永安山賊施但等聚衆數千人，劫皓庶弟永安侯謙出烏程，取孫和陵上鼓吹曲蓋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "1cc054d7d2f834ba22043d9668401da3dee433f0e4cbec002337b8cc7048813c"}

{"id": "p_2ae0ba6af7bd9165", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 165, "text": "丁固、諸葛靚逆之於牛屯，大戰，但等敗走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "b985a6a95fd42af640c823c1fa0585233d2b63e230177027546892c39146d4e2"}

{"id": "p_49405eb1447184d2", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 166, "text": "分會稽爲東陽郡，分吳、丹楊爲吳興郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "3df63459814143842fa4f92cbed746801f6499d281d3209d0c1b9669c7162c08"}

{"id": "p_7c09c823894fd186", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 167, "text": "十二月，皓還都建業，衞將軍滕牧留鎮武昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "4a77ae71778ad42d79aec486f3a5ad880399b1e8dd0b5ec47096d1a9e28e6983"}

{"id": "p_f50377bb7554b195", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 168, "text": "夏六月，起顯明宮，冬十二月，皓移居之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "6cf9c9be4586eb8d94f2849dece1f196fb3217b1348b3230c7bbe549205c14a4"}

{"id": "p_09560a3894342b0a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 169, "text": "是歲，分豫章、廬陵、長沙爲安成郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "65bddd495f5d7b7fbf9be2c765969298b9b58c65e266079e01cf5171de6f5455"}

{"id": "p_efe02859e4c4d966", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 170, "text": "三年春二月，以左右御史大夫丁固、孟仁爲司徒、司空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "eab85a6a9cbb8e03614cb538b97d5737248f7512f0f279459f30dc9a7286e111"}

{"id": "p_ae1a7713d155dd87", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 171, "text": "秋九月，皓出東關，丁奉至合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "671a63369cbd7d086dd3bb645595c6ef4ca3924ce2b5da5162f74b729fecc633"}

{"id": "p_1f4434169f760f6a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 172, "text": "是歲，遣交州刺史劉俊、前部督脩則等入擊交阯，爲晉將毛炅等所破，皆死，兵散還合浦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "3eda4c9d801819ad3e13ec2ef1b884152f08a2ff8097430e9c0867f060dd513f"}

{"id": "p_8221d63e1bc33792", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 173, "text": "春正月，立子瑾爲太子，及淮陽、東平王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "7f93020778ceb5eabc49f0e86de6a73094451fb284b50a088a9cd187a710198a"}

{"id": "p_4f1ddaf902daf4e4", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 174, "text": "遣監軍虞汜、威南將軍薛珝、蒼梧太守陶璜由荊州，監軍李勗、督軍徐存從建安海道，皆就合浦擊交阯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "5fc6a30915d55517ffe39e241a5db7d81eff63fc7ddd79f1d971f4abd9ec2e33"}

{"id": "p_00081c21193ac0c7", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 175, "text": "李勗以建安道不通利，殺導將馮斐，引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "a2af3bd8612a1abfb8f0c9f78ca55ba7106d9fbc1ed7ac516c6d0bcb1e65fee2"}

{"id": "p_2311e175207b834d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 176, "text": "三月，天火燒萬餘家，死者七百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "ce2b01da3115dace087648f91c98c9ced93025196a4c9118020252ffcda06404"}

{"id": "p_3a3a1923efbccfce", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 177, "text": "夏四月，左大司馬施績卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "637d9c5ef013752945f9a14665f5f58112e399e940d39f54ad77060da3c6eba4"}

{"id": "p_6f292307aca657f1", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 178, "text": "殿中列將何定曰：「少府李勗枉殺馮斐，擅徹軍退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "0dd70618370f9e480df27288a1511809f04bb740fa5b8fd2f9556f11c7c037d6"}

{"id": "p_4e8c7010106c986d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 179, "text": "秋九月，何定將兵五千人上夏口獵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "bb3daddf218682a3a9432d0b7d067c3dfc1b663f211e9881f7f3ac071031701f"}

{"id": "p_85e477fab66c1f39", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 180, "text": "三年春正月晦，皓舉大衆出華里，皓母及妃妾皆行，東觀令華覈等固爭，乃還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "726c2d24b4fd95bc53c2275f0d51736e228709097a7c1aeb8bad94c6fa271d5e"}

{"id": "p_b55bf7e1f43bd5b6", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 181, "text": "是歲，汜、璜破交阯，禽殺晉所置守將，九真、日南皆還屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "704be766819b81d488b1f8bea50ee5001a20855da80149a9934b94044c14253d"}

{"id": "p_16189c0a2d5f5d95", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 182, "text": "右大司馬丁奉、司空孟仁卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "2ea1ecacc4bd528453740316183cb6837af969c9a9f9ba034c1e7050fa3ada55"}

{"id": "p_49cf083aaebe1afd", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 183, "text": "西苑言鳳皇集，改明年元。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "69fbfaafcfbc06f2d1acebecb0e7a7a39e76df7ac07a29716ef701071558027c"}

{"id": "p_daa318e849b24504", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 184, "text": "遣樂鄉都督陸抗圍取闡，闡衆悉降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "7f27a6be133b09b688abd021ae384e24f73653b9de559873af06ed51311b69b5"}

{"id": "p_cd8ba37089dedb16", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 185, "text": "闡及同計數十人皆夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "b5e0183354c968e96be9e62397ef6420d4714d6c81deda9ef326e17a62c579a0"}

{"id": "p_0c698320c4313bf0", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 186, "text": "是歲右丞相萬彧被譴憂死，徙其子弟於廬陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "811982a440a62d6324b6ab4bd3af3b4f9a91ca12f1fa0e73b9ae0f114bfc9d6b"}

{"id": "p_cd84f1fa34c93320", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 187, "text": "皓以其惡似張布，追改定名爲布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "debdd0be715243f141ead02fd9463c5ac34e6722e9ade1ab1db2e53d78ddb3d3"}

{"id": "p_13719f9be2edb970", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 188, "text": "二年春三月，以陸抗爲大司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "bb0dc131955bd37626a0d785eaef849cd4254ad7f9ba7987d9ded5ad4de486db"}

{"id": "p_156e0448b76757b2", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 189, "text": "秋九月，改封淮陽爲魯，東平爲齊，又封陳留、章陵等九王，凡十一王，王給三千兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "b3675c5a1e3deed5dca87a37f5e33c43155c4cf1849a5e40fa948c9b9c6f5221"}

{"id": "p_54c242b8a7fbd850", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 190, "text": "皓愛妾或使人至市劫奪百姓財物，司市中郎將陳聲，素皓幸臣也，恃皓寵遇，繩之以法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "e0e065f042d130de1c045bb628cbdf9b1cb4068aeab51cdda137dff796690037"}

{"id": "p_ebec43f1e6b25b3c", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 191, "text": "妾以愬皓，皓大怒，假他事燒鋸斷聲頭，投其身於四望之下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "c244894ce44a6e759855d60f4cfb91799d931765146b56e4f5c12674c2bfa238"}

{"id": "p_20569fdceeeafb1a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 192, "text": "三年，會稽妖言章安侯奮當爲天子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "513c7ba1a399ae574b9563e6e3bd384fe46cc37a2adf92a9913f7eb76bd28420"}

{"id": "p_7c26874d8d5bd5ea", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 193, "text": "臨海太守奚熙與會稽太守郭誕書，非論國政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "e866c80e90deea4be223506f3d3d986a76b3b3633c82412270c372c0605a7bc7"}

{"id": "p_6ae5cf062888301f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 194, "text": "誕但白熙書，不白妖言，送付建安作船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "d07d04e650692ced68ce72895be64327f283c05ae7af9340475344f00cc29849"}

{"id": "p_82922b855feb975d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 195, "text": "遣三郡督何植收熙，熙發兵自衞，斷絕海道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "690ca24ecd8183bf5e5b7968ed5e6ec47029cbcb9320c4e3fb6566366968bf7d"}

{"id": "p_6a7d27342875ee50", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 196, "text": "熙部曲殺熙，送首建業，夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "ea14dca6864bb9f7c1eaf1a9db85672fe3b5de913c31d6142dc8c85bbd4777bb"}

{"id": "p_df037924eff13840", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 197, "text": "秋七月，遣使者二十五人分至州郡，科出亡叛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "e63c53cf525774052ca8bbb12a3140e1931cd25988fee86996768dd50641338e"}

{"id": "p_513285cdea82f904", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 198, "text": "，吳郡言掘地得銀，長一尺，廣三分，刻上有年月字，於是大赦，改年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "85b9721f5d943ecdd02c434cc0706cef3ba7dcbec9e67d82cf8df5b2755a5fb0"}

{"id": "p_ca5ed7fb11dbdced", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 199, "text": "，吳郡言臨平湖自漢末草穢壅塞，今更開通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "5bc305d509f941474a7a99523052d1c55a2b60c58ad8cdca7186af823695b6d7"}

{"id": "p_d4c858f78fed3e94", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 200, "text": "長老相傳，此湖塞，天下亂，此湖開，天下平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "a148ef1ade9b0442306846341887d320f46897e2ce285f93549922400c5515d6"}

{"id": "p_a383cd97e3eab3a3", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 201, "text": "又於湖邊得石函，中有小石，青白色，長四寸，廣二寸餘，刻上作皇帝字，於是改年，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "11b7706e345d5fd572cef4e3e2039273de587a792b3eabcf1daa7354dd671584"}

{"id": "p_37bb5b2dc1f365c3", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 202, "text": "會稽太守車浚、湘東太守張詠不出筭緡，就在所斬之，徇首諸郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "0198259a41e0cff06808583821a0d5f75747fc923083654ca67dff996327dd4a"}

{"id": "p_bdb52cad4de37e6b", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 203, "text": "秋八月，京下督孫楷降晉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "0f4d2993dd90d5893d6518937e04fea9f02b184240c9937d2f4d41db349d0e75"}

{"id": "p_298c50ec5e65035d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 204, "text": "鄱陽言歷陽山石文理成字，凡二十，云「楚九州渚，吳九州都，揚州士，作天子，四世治，太平始」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "b7337d75144a626823a9ee80c7d1a095441445a449c2ed8227141d874437a7e5"}

{"id": "p_3699fd6328daa61b", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 205, "text": "又吳興陽羨山有空石，長十餘丈，名曰石室，在所表爲大瑞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "b95d702cfe7d4301ed5363c266ce8048ff54264bd740df16a0ce6d348b5135d8"}

{"id": "p_b1971ac4b9bc3cd7", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 206, "text": "乃遣兼司徒董朝、兼太常周處至陽羨縣，封襌國山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "9e1d31c951b8318055773ece944b8cb26e4fdd82a59b8967b2e5099793751522"}

{"id": "p_741ef09b7c5458a1", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 207, "text": "明年改元，大赦，以恊石文。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "1b357f1724212f0e47d8dcc91ad2844392993fb3d99436494e61e1c057abed39"}

{"id": "p_502bd5e6ba38d31f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 208, "text": "夏，夏口督孫慎出江夏、汝南，燒略居民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "2ace95300eb2b4c0bced9238ee9666110765e1e923113187d57b2ce2c9271805"}

{"id": "p_6d444bc255669fb8", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 209, "text": "初，騶子張俶多所譖白，累遷爲司直中郎將，封侯，甚見寵愛，是歲姦情發聞，伏誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "fd887698cfce73c02ff3ba47b7402e4497007206b4e18e03d36e20eadcea63e1"}

{"id": "p_bfe70674b19e39ff", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 210, "text": "二年秋七月，立成紀、宣威等十一王，王給三千兵，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "7fb6a49d899c024281489feac098765758a4e47d4d045f00353e53e1ad53de63"}

{"id": "p_1a75b3ee9a0911ec", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 211, "text": "馬本合浦太守脩允部曲督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "d7986163c192c786fe084cdb9ba74bc5fe74e85aba48ab39d76c7a9baede7eb5"}

{"id": "p_3be37594480ac3a0", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 212, "text": "允轉桂林太守，疾病，住廣州，先遣馬將五百兵至郡安撫諸夷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "378aa7abf4a19efd4d9586ab6e6e60d4e047860e99c1f4ea5480907cd497c6f4"}

{"id": "p_f59752524bfb195b", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 213, "text": "允死，兵當分給，馬等累世舊軍，不樂離別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "5ab3369398a26a4b3ed488fe7d8f176b0291f11a633cd547a7eb629b6fd3dff0"}

{"id": "p_a1260cb3263bd6f4", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 214, "text": "皓時又科實廣州戶口，馬與部曲將何典、王族、吳述、殷興等因此恐動兵民，合聚人衆，攻殺廣州督虞授。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "dcc85f350edc22a316f29da62ba1409061f5cee173e860bbc2b3593d03c3db47"}

{"id": "p_cbd24155f02e39e0", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 215, "text": "馬自號都督交廣二州諸軍事、安南將軍，興廣州刺史，述南海太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "bd3a5297313904f0e0d00643dd1898ccff815f1fab43e7ad6cc5e5a89b9c2a32"}

{"id": "p_c457bc7f9a51ee6e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 216, "text": "八月，以軍師張悌爲丞相，牛渚都督何植爲司徒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "188814fbec489ee822dc6db679b85e46f44f3f08d509156c8fa197736ae5d273"}

{"id": "p_b66dd9a41cf7974d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 217, "text": "執金吾滕循爲司空，未拜，轉鎮南將軍，假節領廣州牧，率萬人從東道討馬，與族遇於始興，未得前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "f72500a4a2f445aa1a99407e5f9cdfebf0d1f60b421a3877efcfdb3644365283"}

{"id": "p_9a3b00391a72f0ab", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 218, "text": "馬殺南海太守劉略，逐廣州刺史徐旗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "b33c41f8a8fcde1dee439c55cecf73c802e2bdce51365fb72b3d9dcc3f510076"}

{"id": "p_c51e4c3a25a5f939", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 219, "text": "皓又遣徐陵督陶濬將七千人從西道，命交州牧陶璜部伍所領及合浦、鬱林諸郡兵，當與東西軍共擊馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "798b0de48c31548dca077c051c87f37750adcb7b126cd68baa7ac24ae051f40d"}

{"id": "p_83d2663b63c7a486", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 220, "text": "有鬼目菜生工人黃耇家，依緣棗樹，長丈餘，莖廣四寸，厚三分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "6e66075f2927df0163acd8e3a212757406948ad1214d8cde335bd39281ffa64a"}

{"id": "p_f9f5de9f5c12069e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 221, "text": "又有買菜生工人吳平家，高四尺，厚三分，如枇杷形，上廣尺八寸，下莖廣五寸，兩邊生葉綠色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "d90aa6a35cc809f469e8b7d16e9973417408374f0bfe57434bb7a9a901ad3ba6"}

{"id": "p_1dee2f511428816a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 222, "text": "東觀案圖，名鬼目作芝草，買菜作平慮草，遂以耇爲侍芝郎，平爲平慮郎，皆銀印青綬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "9d6dafb2f534cc1637d286ebb6a7429848f97bc2034a43bde219260880a3b62c"}

{"id": "p_25021c5f7463e1b5", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 223, "text": "冬，晉命鎮東大將軍司馬伷向涂中，安東將軍王渾、揚州刺史周浚向牛渚，建威將軍王戎向武昌，平南將軍胡奮向夏口，鎮南將軍杜預向江陵，龍驤將軍王濬、廣武將軍唐彬浮江東下，太尉賈充爲大都督，量宜處要，盡軍勢之中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "42e671a3800d13f9ab02ecb3d9644e21049a0853674b767e402663970ea4d81a"}

{"id": "p_1847fcc66219cd50", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 224, "text": "陶濬至武昌，聞北軍大出，停駐不前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "1c428171e865db96882f529238ee26340b32736961c7550b28cfdbc288d060a6"}

{"id": "p_7bbaf189e0e14c60", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 225, "text": "初，皓每宴會羣臣，無不咸令沈醉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "303c2164feebc94dbddaaf48f7c3477c8534de42776e6566b8ff800587349eb3"}

{"id": "p_b12aa1e75ee38919", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 226, "text": "置黃門郎十人，特不與酒，侍立終日，爲司過之吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "06a96b852145b0bf6c4ddf91f4daecbf0b8acf39f458f7ed6fef361937a2d2fb"}

{"id": "p_b9d0f5a84d73379f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 227, "text": "宴罷之後，各奏其闕失，迕視之咎，謬言之愆，罔有不舉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "f549e2aab04c3a1ef603aa17a7569f5c6d50c97fe7d07151eae8be0035f43e53"}

{"id": "p_ade0ae1616b7bf80", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 228, "text": "大者即加威刑，小者輒以爲罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "2456b8f1d6b4b8a4b953c8ea7b289017a6767621229681cade49ff191bc63e64"}

{"id": "p_5b321404f13a9278", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 229, "text": "又激水入宮，宮人有不合意者，輒殺流之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "225328645a8f586968710b85e955ac81ce3fd07b0c6bba342aa516c49a9f148b"}

{"id": "p_a1747715764f72c5", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 230, "text": "或剥人之面，或鑿人之眼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "ca78f09e3322c2d0de295d3a4f728e1f689c80cad7d7ead1c70de92884d5e01b"}

{"id": "p_e414878e5aac9a89", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 231, "text": "岑昬險諛貴幸，致位九列，好興功役，衆所患苦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "9cd6dcc1a4a3753d3b040e4cf139deb664bb8985f0a5875d97e20316b054b903"}

{"id": "p_88d36ace28767a8d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 232, "text": "是以上下離心，莫爲皓盡力，蓋積惡已極，不復堪命故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "d28b5bf941669eec747a58ffc99d7084f4c874670241287fbe133202daf9de46"}

{"id": "p_4d6ea85d9b58401c", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 233, "text": "四年春，立中山、代等十一王，大赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "a6f5962c98dc055bb84a1f4cfbbf73e5ae7d34b32a7176fb00339057a05b717f"}

{"id": "p_9a0eb88fda96f679", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 234, "text": "濬、彬所至，則土崩瓦解，靡有禦者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "1c3435f47c471397b5636de80ec19d68530b04d17c4b57f1e048146588c09b02"}

{"id": "p_a928f82bcc8932ee", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 235, "text": "預又斬江陵督伍延，渾復斬丞相張悌、丹楊太守沈瑩等，所在戰克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "eba4ddd951d7e09716ad66745854f75303a0982d552a48401070875200aafd42"}

{"id": "p_af998b651998cd0f", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 236, "text": "三月丙寅，殿中親近數百人叩頭請皓殺岑昏，皓惶憒從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "fe46be2a5452d038cce0b1da280146089a18510cd20c8ac88dfaf8e80d2afa69"}

{"id": "p_238b0bd848612ada", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 237, "text": "戊辰，陶濬從武昌還，即引見，問水軍消息，對曰：「蜀船皆小，今得二萬兵，乘大船戰，自足擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "95b9668400207e355488a6a9cd8931e6b5fede77eff2964f3c609828f499cc19"}

{"id": "p_4d65aa88b73cd3f7", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 238, "text": "明日當發，其夜衆悉逃走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "98cfd09535656c07373c8430e36a09cd67f8257a1976ef93fc1d104b0706613a"}

{"id": "p_faa358758fc5a152", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 239, "text": "而王濬順流將至，司馬伷、王渾皆臨近境。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "3be26b3d5a3af6570ab426338a5b60ff5994f86e0b4ef0498fff491d1d38347d"}

{"id": "p_006543f3b348ddfd", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 240, "text": "皓用光祿勳薛瑩、中書令胡沖等計，分遣使奉書於濬、伷、渾曰：「昔漢室失統，九州分裂，先人因時，略有江南，遂分阻山川，與魏乖隔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "fc4c838385fbec11fcd9a853b6a56f297bd5486cd31326b3cddab915b025df2d"}

{"id": "p_7e19c7abb46ad575", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 241, "text": "至於今者，猥煩六軍，衡蓋路次，遠臨江渚，舉國震惶，假息漏刻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "5054c2729e10f4a222f2ba68a3f3a710ad198a9104a571a32e8b03a231d43c8f"}

{"id": "p_1aea5437ab8bd016", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 242, "text": "敢緣天朝含弘光大，謹遣私署太常張夔等奉所佩印綬，委質請命，惟垂信納，以濟元元。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "8d7287a110266c3cf4bf0fbf763bf681c35660cd72fe7d9e8d2d9282a5d9f692"}

{"id": "p_bf5952908412e91a", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 243, "text": "壬申，王濬最先到，於是受皓之降，解縛焚櫬，延請相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "53a6c26c9b383dd59ba60e4bfdd190416b3aaf385f3f1dd61bb8a5863074c7e3"}

{"id": "p_0f53c83ccfbe1624", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 244, "text": "伷以皓致印綬於己，遣使送皓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "7498cf238bbde2a15e7aa2f41fff5bb56a6e3058746e3120f5332410f957de31"}

{"id": "p_229cb2d339f5af5c", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 245, "text": "皓舉家西遷，以五月丁亥集于京邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "419795c8f523da2a06bdf002d12d70b2e8c2360c1d8a48ac6c63817d7bc9f0d1"}

{"id": "p_b28457d0749eab4d", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 246, "text": "四月甲申，詔曰：「」皓太子瑾拜中郎，諸子爲王者，拜郎中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "fa033f648abff7c829769290586c567dcdd42d7e93189fa00a1f491b3afb0dee"}

{"id": "p_cf0f9d6e4c53e165", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 247, "text": "評曰：孫亮童孺而無賢輔，其替位不終，必然之勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "b3a30fb3d3c34248607c926862f2de07e9025a337423d88aadfe078cfbe4a93f"}

{"id": "p_cdb501306ab107f4", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 248, "text": "休以舊愛宿恩，任用興、布，不能拔進良才，改絃易張，雖志善好學，何益救亂乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "08db1060f9fa832bba457734606ca8fd37fbee071817c08471021b6672522c5f"}

{"id": "p_08e099a580feb763", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 249, "text": "又使旣廢之亮不得其死，友于之義薄矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "36d0787fe57ad4f5997d3c49e1dab6f8e5c8891e7b1b9582e56dddd95eb9a609"}

{"id": "p_df8cfd7df064ef39", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 250, "text": "皓之淫刑所濫，隕斃流黜者，蓋不可勝數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "01057f8ec9f8241fc47077753690e39e414df6004c5e1392ed9f3b8770e2f5d8"}

{"id": "p_d76a7b7d1f2e3eaa", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 251, "text": "是以羣下人人惴恐，皆日日以兾，朝不謀夕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "c7109f59575e10ffa99435dcbe2bd92d73306e4353a3970d0041169827193913"}

{"id": "p_ae9c1004ea7a595e", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 252, "text": "其熒惑、巫祝，交致祥瑞，以爲至急。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "bf5c07b3da095bcbfd29eb4f68b9ed9e5dad5800683890e29cb8faa71fe15eee"}

{"id": "p_9e7ad9570ea890ab", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 253, "text": "昔舜、禹躬稼，至聖之德，猶或矢誓衆臣，予違女弼，或拜昌言，常若不及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "adc08faca59a60daf83f69c1b5750b536673193a20cb0d89a46f1444dbb69aad"}

{"id": "p_63ac68a566a42ea5", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 254, "text": "況皓凶頑，肆行殘暴，忠諫者誅，讒諛者進，虐用其民，窮淫極侈，宜腰首分離，以謝百姓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "8836de0980338e8d5ac8a2fa86733431a7a557ead8175a88e1f00b71a25e63a5"}

{"id": "p_5a7461d1f8914189", "source_id": "src_baa2dacc57d45375", "ordinal": 255, "text": "旣蒙不死之詔，復加歸命之寵，豈非曠蕩之恩，過厚之澤也哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "5cf9bf18401e452fe977fccdaec0290c4127d82ef96d7672156e568f27eb1b6e"}

{"id": "p_d46be1967b5946f2", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 0, "text": "劉繇，字正禮，東萊牟平人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "237ec8d5171bec54a627e46ff738b302ee109ffdc25863d8f317257556c2dfe4"}

{"id": "p_01029aca87026db3", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 1, "text": "齊孝王少子封牟平侯，子孫家焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "e6936a3fb286518a332fc7b7d209cbd8a9a1e0cc1d7a43cb7bef35fe8397ccda"}

{"id": "p_9695b81443c4034b", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 2, "text": "繇兄岱，字公山，歷位侍中，兗州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "2d03f815bf4a3f27c91a960e7897bfc186f1122ef1e6f7d1cea56263c55332ae"}

{"id": "p_1e9d14457f2b0657", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 3, "text": "繇年十九，從父韙為賊所劫質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "77914868ba09ee7d27ef96659a2a81e5e571647ce967130069262575df027240"}

{"id": "p_8f8f5a288d113813", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 4, "text": "舉孝廉，為郎中，除下邑長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "f43ebe8c34b02c697da586b296255a21465b708733b3e283d50aabbf8db91931"}

{"id": "p_7fb123c227a97372", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 5, "text": "時郡守以貴戚托之，遂棄官去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "c73cdd0745e07a129a12bc66e1be37d4e64ba74922ac9c05d0cff26ce7eb2316"}

{"id": "p_64f857875696c7be", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 6, "text": "州辟部濟南，濟南相中常侍子，貪穢不循，繇奏免之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "6a5ccf4108394e90daa37bafd54cec1e2189841851420f2c625afa028c52cc1a"}

{"id": "p_1ce960a7831fc2c1", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 7, "text": "平原陶丘洪薦繇，欲令舉茂才。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "298e9fc12ddfd92d29e1088e198a541a3a44bdacf6b8f1c68c7ec3b4a675137a"}

{"id": "p_0f5e66fd19a3a2c3", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」洪曰：「若明使君用公山於前，擢正禮於後，所謂御二龍於長塗，騁騏驥於千里，不亦可乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "5a01ddab6efab402490fbd538dc5ccdf288b27c8df301f4f2ea0a09c1fb6415c"}

{"id": "p_88df93c855d00a56", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」會辟司空掾，除侍御史，不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "05a349f70b46bf92e3eefa2439124511e5314694a9fb340927832784f828de17"}

{"id": "p_c81c37de4f7cca0c", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 10, "text": "避亂淮浦，詔書以為揚州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "bfb87db76abd6040ec469eed2d24ac984ca3e7ec3914573b694d4720fbe68a9b"}

{"id": "p_191425d17593bb01", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 11, "text": "時袁術在淮南，繇畏憚，不敢之州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "57d49fe18609d25d072d9c83befd28f8cf312c888aa51ab2bcf17172ad989c12"}

{"id": "p_16002d9676a3f92b", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 12, "text": "欲南渡江，吳景，孫賁迎置曲阿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "b4dcb182b3677c6a9266f924e1b49d603ab622f67fef9ea82c33432929eaaf4b"}

{"id": "p_8a1487b39c0ca902", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 13, "text": "術圖為僭逆，攻沒諸郡縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "ef462112d4a01764027af941b1d1fc6d671c0366eb5ad40e4a58fe01a77c3bf6"}

{"id": "p_ff75d752c2202eed", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 14, "text": "繇遣樊能、張英屯江邊以拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "82d5521c772ffd5c1fde796d98f407cc19757888b9740aa461294cd0edc1e343"}
