{"id": "p_29971c8baf88b7ba", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 15, "text": "以景、賁術所授用，乃迫逐使去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "0c9a70671656e2fda7b87a0b280be7f5bbfec8b13e3dbdc9dba0f6caca1866ad"}

{"id": "p_1b3cff64bf0cd8b0", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 16, "text": "於是術乃自置揚州刺史，與景、賁並力攻英、能等，歲余不下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "2127b194409a6f75780779d536c3b263cdfeb152b61faf6465f89a9e10fdc8c7"}

{"id": "p_6134ee85ee152d31", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 17, "text": "漢命加繇為牧，振武將軍，眾數萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "7159a0e99a1ec5c59412a75e28f9c60e7e2b1f87fe60c85f4932f9bff1439245"}

{"id": "p_06fc245862940d8c", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 18, "text": "繇奔丹徒，遂泝江南保豫章，駐彭澤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "fe246404068cac3bc37169ebdb3d0ce93fe9352369c8ca63a48cf4f1ccd1a62e"}

{"id": "p_6d9e4e44a1259c39", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 19, "text": "繇進討融，為融所破，更復招合屬縣，攻破融，融敗走入山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "08c01f4b964b0e460057414ec2341e83aab946194e1748db7d0a07df939e65f5"}

{"id": "p_51d32b60f76ebb15", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 20, "text": "初聚眾數百，往依徐州牧陶謙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "f152ef1ab3f019027360c2cf9199ddca72195712b58ff765e62eb8532632a48b"}

{"id": "p_35072807f71d2cc7", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 21, "text": "謙使督廣陵、彭城運漕，遂放縱擅殺，坐斷三郡委輸以自入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "8ba9ad69e47e799bb436895c6c81eb3c9bc2736eb4173ccf7f9eb258cb8ba2e1"}

{"id": "p_71c684a4a9359808", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 22, "text": "乃大起浮圖祠，以銅為人，黃金塗身，衣以錦采，垂銅槃九重，下為重樓閣道，可容三千餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "893bc05cdebfddeba8125835bd6b133a6ab6dd36845aa1c20c0039d3550df7ae"}

{"id": "p_4b78590d035d6281", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 23, "text": "悉課讀佛經，令界內及旁郡人有好佛者聽受道，復其他役以招致之，由此遠近前後至者五千餘人戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "acdeefc628f4f3616e1066cd26a5c0e31330e4965f0e8b72434d80b4bb171035"}

{"id": "p_620c1ce9286653f8", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 24, "text": "每浴佛，多設酒飯，布席於路，經數十里，民人來觀及就食且萬人，費以巨億計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "9c117d0018035de91a6560a3d3b72373cebe22283f211fcb6e7ad0f7b0efa6da"}

{"id": "p_1e03868ff35a3ee7", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 25, "text": "曹公攻陶謙，徐土騷動，融將男女數萬口，馬三千匹，走廣陵，廣陵太守趙昱待以賓禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "e9637f41c56511116ed48946d68190819b431aab89a94357c60342f6c8022829"}

{"id": "p_78bf5fee81f5c38a", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 26, "text": "先是，彭城相薛禮為陶謙所逼，屯秣陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "0fa2941300b19cdce74991af1a03f887977b0f873fd1f296e9ea71537d445a8d"}

{"id": "p_5662b1f344b16a86", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 27, "text": "融利廣陵之眾，因酒酣殺昱，放兵大略，因載而去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "d76dfd63dca4e85baa880cd712274a95c51c154c0cb54668b36fb00ad286a4ba"}

{"id": "p_e7ac2496ca9df8a2", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 28, "text": "後策西伐江夏，還過豫章，收載繇喪，善遇其家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "99276ca3094d7ac30ba7b676d67d825a6d4ecfc7ccfa50713238afdd5c655532"}

{"id": "p_c4e765b5c496a750", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 29, "text": "王朗遺策書曰：\"劉正禮昔初臨州，未能自達，實賴尊門為之先後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "eaab389945b8eadd751d9d511f7b0a5b81f2205def03f6501ebf0ec4dcda735f"}

{"id": "p_df947f34c507e85b", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 30, "text": "用能濟江成治，有所處定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "ef01ad8b93f902479054703aae14bba581a99637d7440575ddb4f1f78ed09521"}

{"id": "p_628e4a8a8cbfbd78", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 31, "text": "踐境之禮，感分結意，情在終始。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "391d4cf751158a06bc9250d6004dd188ad5aa23534d3ac72fdbb0c28e7cd94ff"}

{"id": "p_652ad01b754f451a", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 32, "text": "後以袁氏之嫌，稍更乖刺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "f84847c5665bb4aa794aa23f0ce0b430290b8c5b19745ae2bda2994790f283ed"}

{"id": "p_687de1fffe871822", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 33, "text": "更以同盟，還為仇敵，原其本心，實非所樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "00346f1e68456c9705ab64606436adf2911620df92187f7ced512d7738c2a567"}

{"id": "p_871f8989c11862e9", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 34, "text": "康寧之後，常願渝平更成，復踐宿好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "2eb96e1c280d50d5ce19b27c08fbfcc4b34336c2a2a8169e1c3b9bcb769bb2a7"}

{"id": "p_ab8753a1cb3f671d", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 35, "text": "一爾分離，款意不昭，奄然殂隕，可為傷恨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "f2ece2c9eead3f454971ae751dc7cfcd851b86fe5623f83f7c678b58534a735e"}

{"id": "p_0183ba316998dfbb", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 36, "text": "知敦以厲薄，德以報怨，收骨育孤，哀亡愍存，捐既往之猜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "fc656f82de9e6ecf2409cd7842f5ba23cb36e341afa46e0932074ac95a684186"}

{"id": "p_8215e75860ab3700", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 37, "text": "保六尺之托，誠深恩重分，美名厚實也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "e7d9108edea24ab85716b6f773a08f48b0fd816ee67555bcbfa73fd5776cb6da"}

{"id": "p_72a674b70a060eaf", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 38, "text": "昔魯人雖有齊怨，不廢喪紀，《春秋》善之，謂之得禮，誠良史之所宜借，鄉校之所歎聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "f7b6b1a1c070674fe44b15cf675332431c51252c585cd145ec9a833bb1f7c562"}

{"id": "p_1b2aed9e3b664da5", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 39, "text": "正禮元子，致有志操，想必有以殊異。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "19bb59a4f9d26dfb957e8276b7bdf1e24e0518d6ff6217e03e43d598b682d1d7"}

{"id": "p_e1b43c13bb45b001", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 40, "text": "威盛刑行，施之以恩，不亦優哉!\"", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "343e5f7ce8393b4745ec305bdad19407863c4768aef69810615023daf762bd2f"}

{"id": "p_c5187ead37ed8a0c", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 41, "text": "年十四，居繇喪盡禮，故吏饋餉，皆無所受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "421286f11bc72535d69b19faf53381bae154969bbbd7e2c721b034f4dfc96099"}

{"id": "p_bc19e2faddcedf95", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 42, "text": "權為驃騎將軍，辟東曹掾，拜輔義校尉、建忠中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "1ffcc36dc33d032fe398d27fdc571a96bf442e0bdfd23e4ae57941fad9ff1605"}

{"id": "p_87db3d7227218f6e", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 43, "text": "權嘗宴飲，騎都尉虞翻醉酒犯忤，權欲殺之，威怒甚盛，由基諫爭，翻以得免。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "665ebfba16a4a6737b25ea555795294c496dbb4f0a67836de70504a54854cebd"}

{"id": "p_df26e941c6e30609", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 44, "text": "權大暑時，嘗於船中宴飲，於船樓上值雷雨，權以蓋自覆，又命覆基，餘人不得也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "7abc4e560f7277dc9d70c20f96813c7d199baad95d7ed3d3bef1e81925ac3f9a"}

{"id": "p_2d4b770299ba2386", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 45, "text": "權稱尊號，改為光祿勳，分平尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "2066ac68f11a5041be048aeb02cb3b7b214ee3352a2a4a6a211e83f0baa5c650"}

{"id": "p_30ba7af8de758461", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 46, "text": "後權為子霸納基女，賜第一區。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "dc9300b4138d60a0a240db6fcc13d9184a5f82a734ae7bb5939bdb7f3bf6d09c"}

{"id": "p_c4a1e4b27a7357af", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 47, "text": "基二弟，鑠、尚，皆騎都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "bff6fece4b0a3a619755f19c76aeab715d9342d44467372a6f87059e09912a4e"}

{"id": "p_b04c1cd7ba6f02ce", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 48, "text": "太史慈字子義，東萊黃人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "81eb20207f6bd9d2998da6d5fe511d7ce8ea718713bdd429e88ecef4edca9b79"}

{"id": "p_6a4ed4db5f8e8501", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 49, "text": "會郡與州有隙，曲直未分，以先聞者為善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "b2bddec40ba2af1b4f613ffbcce8e4680db78343ffe0350ba947ccf6dacdc752"}

{"id": "p_cfceabd3e0a5a417", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 50, "text": "時州章已去，郡守恐後之，求可使者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "92f40b3d0964af18144e1e4d60bb24eabd286ed16edb09358ca84410138400cb"}

{"id": "p_78c0c9b5ed27add6", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 51, "text": "慈年二十一，以選行，晨夜取道，到洛陽，詣公車門，見州吏始欲求通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "e9ba0c4170f1fd666dbb9967cb3a000a3d347ffac11d8af12f9c1fbd2059836e"}

{"id": "p_4d279c484c5731a7", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 52, "text": "」慈曰：「章題署得無誤邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "c20e566c8180563feebf2d90d764185b30da6c831a2671442f0e39920324be91"}

{"id": "p_b357a11f332afb2c", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 53, "text": "」吏殊不知其東萊人也，因為取章。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "fe303047823fee674d7b85db9a3787b3e67ab43be86299ce45f7ee647b869058"}

{"id": "p_1e3b5ccdb5b548cd", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 54, "text": "吏踴躍大呼，言「人壞我章」！", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "a2d6a3bbed397a30be5bd2fa8109248cafd35ea772f8965a485bda6c38c51250"}

{"id": "p_e4af4909fe49f67e", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 55, "text": "慈將至車閒，與語曰：「向使君不以章相與，吾亦無因得敗之，是為吉凶禍福等耳，吾不獨受此罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "f35b5c367a2d207941abccda7c689ea3712b349f95869ab6c504e489eba1a9bd"}

{"id": "p_9682860dd6c59545", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 56, "text": "豈若默然俱出去，可以存易亡，無事俱就刑辟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "5d7b3efc5481abfe3c46335c7a77a66a60e0a380f670d615ee0edf2a7266214f"}

{"id": "p_06515db0d5255ad6", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 57, "text": "」吏言：「君為郡敗吾章，已得如意，欲復亡為？", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "461168d1849e0691b1d034b675d06adc021668b274280a02ba270e5190058b4d"}

{"id": "p_bdbdac9708dd30d8", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」慈答曰：「初受郡遣，但來視章通與未耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "3d96a93e29a1b97bc96754ddf4770987d1745f89867bcc5654b8226dde1c26e5"}

{"id": "p_ed9ea30a8b0f077a", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 59, "text": "今還，亦恐以此見譴怒，故俱欲去爾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "bff94fb27af50ba3bce248c1c61d56beca8dc63da07827b9dfee5894ea85ebcc"}

{"id": "p_a704f94c4018d460", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 60, "text": "慈既與出城，因遁還通郡章。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "68f75aa24653bffc2c48f2c50dfea1b139032fa963aa86f3b1fc2cc0649dcf55"}

{"id": "p_fd2f01ae4951c071", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 61, "text": "州家聞之，更遣吏通章，有司以格章之故不復見理，州受其短。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "76139a135fab1e630a92caec7b148477eaa6468cdb1f2e2b4279611fc65b9c80"}

{"id": "p_52fd2661e545c957", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 62, "text": "由是知名，而為州家所疾，恐受其禍，乃避之遼東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "a89babeaf8a2fbefa87373a785d70c2c0d6f25e92192738b25372c22c939d1df"}

{"id": "p_b658010789be1fd6", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 63, "text": "北海相孔融聞而奇之，數遣人訊問其母，并致餉遺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "8cced1fd565c3748bbd60d86e2af4612ceb17c0c3cd1d4c1591cc4862d19bb96"}

{"id": "p_9519618fa369bec0", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 64, "text": "時融以黃巾寇暴，出屯都昌，為賊管亥所圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "a2003838f6e8db2df5be471b52e858c231740004d308f03b16b0566c84752548"}

{"id": "p_93067bc665331c70", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 65, "text": "慈從遼東還，母謂慈曰：「汝與孔北海未嘗相見，至汝行後，贍恤殷勤，過於故舊，今為賊所圍，汝宜赴之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "e0da7990b094cb754e9646b377ca47cb2d07fa7472d623fae79e1caed0634485"}

{"id": "p_05f2f52749c97292", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 66, "text": "」慈留三日，單步徑至都昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "8180ff3d1d699ad421eca70922e6318f17a8f5dd1ef104fdabce667cde9f6414"}

{"id": "p_9dbd105a97ddebfc", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 67, "text": "時圍尚未密，夜伺閒隙，得入見融，因求兵出斫賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "9e451c1b89eed560ca569bd000f6ea19da5ff066dd3d8835c614ee15243d66fc"}

{"id": "p_14068c8e954d9096", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 68, "text": "融欲告急平原相劉備，城中人無由得出，慈自請求行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "d4fe60bd9602af5bfb1cfa73a35de9cfe1732b8b31831ec94d9e9a84032372d2"}

{"id": "p_7a43281200f44ed9", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 69, "text": "融曰：「今賊圍甚密，眾人皆言不可，卿意雖壯，無乃實難乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "50bc25144bdc4ecfd267ebab0ae66e4046fc45f910fd9414093666a8563013c2"}

{"id": "p_b3d188d33bb1ad5e", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 70, "text": "」慈對曰：「昔府君傾意於老母，老母感遇，遣慈赴府君之急，固以慈有可取，而來必有益也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "52fd1553af5212c3ecfc396ae07f48911afd87a2c4d8ee567235bdcdc430086d"}

{"id": "p_9114dcbbe2264ddf", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 71, "text": "今眾人言不可，慈亦言不可，豈府君愛顧之義，老母遣慈之意邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "63a44b02e2706f19cd59f5e4edbd79e4d2c8a724e15097449ee63269b95308f6"}

{"id": "p_f6a59f1ac080fe1d", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 72, "text": "於是嚴行蓐食，須明，便帶鞬攝弓上馬，將兩騎自隨，各作一的持之，開門直出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "7e9fac18561966175d6cb935df6fc92a03ac485f5235caeecdc28de532d962c0"}

{"id": "p_3c41110b59a204e8", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 73, "text": "外圍下左右人並驚駭，兵馬互出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "af02041d99f4a3708605e585cdeaf296e5a07bebcddfa454772e9d919f2d2c89"}

{"id": "p_3fdad7ee9045ece4", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 74, "text": "慈引馬至城下塹內，植所持的各一，出射之，射之畢，徑入門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "24fa79c08c963710e23c416562444e5efe15186bc5b61510857d44211fa086da"}

{"id": "p_efa30ae3ccb9aaf1", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 75, "text": "明晨復如此，圍下人或起或臥，慈復植的，射之畢，復入門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "fa401d31fbb36f69099d89ef2103f9411ad3f694aa644134b5a47f3cb8b30c56"}

{"id": "p_51698c2cb5a1db93", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 76, "text": "明晨復出如此，無復起者，於是下鞭馬直突圍中馳去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "4c32569a8c8a023ebf377913f5dfadaf0af2cc5780e50a76c66e09a6ac929807"}

{"id": "p_6decb10bb4557376", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 77, "text": "比賊覺知，慈行已過，又射殺數人，皆應弦而倒，故無敢追者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "648dae1153fb74c05aeff64441ded1fb682c6eaa005ea5bef33e6efb29f21919"}

{"id": "p_ceb31af832156be3", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 78, "text": "遂到平原，說備曰：「慈，東萊之鄙人也，與孔北海親非骨肉，比非鄉黨，特以名志相好，有分災共患之義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "8f9aef077702e81fc05d482ded84e68970720c5346226f4b423b2d56a60dd9e3"}

{"id": "p_90b45f0d7db4e847", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 79, "text": "今管亥暴亂，北海被圍，孤窮無援，危在旦夕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "fef5e57882cecd1d7c6e16293bb81fb233e6b5acd670b0aebef87d97eb3aec06"}

{"id": "p_4a0a6343f29e6c33", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 80, "text": "以君有仁義之名，能救人之急，故北海區區，延頸恃仰，使慈冒白刃，突重圍，從萬死之中自託於君，惟君所以存之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "0a76bfdd6c8e17f9bb9ac0e3bd2365c33a35411d9e8b88dac7a8b3906b924edc"}

{"id": "p_14c2da42ed83d105", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 81, "text": "」備斂容答曰：「孔北海知世間有劉備邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "4a6eb39b14984b44023710938e1d14fbd333c80eda9795d6ce68a15481e96ebf"}

{"id": "p_acdf49bc3d2d27fa", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 82, "text": "融既得濟，益奇貴慈，曰：「卿吾之少友也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "4a5e0c98667eb33201a074fb99413ded78e6bf1053ed2f33384478ffb87dab17"}

{"id": "p_cfa1de3f6ae4af15", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 83, "text": "」事畢，還啟其母，母曰：「我喜汝有以報孔北海也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "a7f5d661f8d9576b40359a7c6c0612e00cbfe9ae9f59318f40d14b58bd6f07c2"}

{"id": "p_fc24ee5f378d8a88", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 84, "text": "揚州刺史劉繇與慈同郡，慈自遼東還，未與相見，暫渡江到曲阿見繇，未去，會孫策至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "89af8bb563947492ad075055a7007bbed548bb61c4c0a1094a07a1e5acf50cf6"}

{"id": "p_62203d9eb3d1ec86", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 85, "text": "或勸繇可以慈為大將軍，繇曰：「我若用子義，許子將不當笑我邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "7fa10bb72a07226406b7a426470afee7ba7b4d50b8a763b1e0f69dcbf0d829cc"}

{"id": "p_ac8668d51a0f9a4f", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 86, "text": "策從騎十三，皆韓當、宋謙、黃蓋輩也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "9509d7e200381fd547a837fca52b197b0621e495970d832d85e39c26dad38042"}

{"id": "p_b53038dd861e59ee", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 87, "text": "策刺慈馬，而攬得慈項上手戟，慈亦得策兜鍪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "8c8d0dc9ce3f9e0ac9776094d27417fdcdd6c2ec71562610ad1489be42531ffb"}

{"id": "p_968584b6ec515b63", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 88, "text": "會兩家兵騎並各來赴，於是解散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "2cbb6621e12e73581638bc9606e22f5905667e554066f966ac4f2cda0dc164c7"}

{"id": "p_5ff546039c602429", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 89, "text": "慈當與繇俱奔豫章，而遁於蕪湖，亡入山中，稱丹楊太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "26c9c600bff3508392a46aaaedacdaeffe203430a6ce085436456f4664973c3c"}

{"id": "p_e36d2c4e3ce6bfe9", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 90, "text": "是時，策已平定宣城以東，惟涇以西六縣未服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "04fedc7c8c3e87adf6d31213fd97e288d1925fb14e3676bb0629114cdd125ea7"}

{"id": "p_a1ce9ab648efd390", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 91, "text": "慈因進住涇縣，立屯府，大為山越所附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "2ead177c09e7f3e43cc5008708dc3e00ac1522aa882bba3b656dc11dd36b1212"}

{"id": "p_f18e6fdfa53a2e75", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 92, "text": "策即解縛，捉其手曰：「寧識神亭時邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "5b160cf3976b7ac9eb216b1bd5590b501e7361a409dc619a935e78b0f6709def"}

{"id": "p_6a3e2f163977aafa", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 93, "text": "」策大笑曰：「今日之事，當與卿共之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "58bbed432ba2f79a96047fd2ce1df14fa72490933174a28d2dcfc0de047b4ad9"}

{"id": "p_0cd5eb909770d5d4", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」即署門下督，還吳授兵，拜折衝中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "025a75e52071af494a69116352d06f406a9165f6ee14d2b2f5b33b6c5ab1aa91"}

{"id": "p_51ee34301f061b76", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 95, "text": "後劉繇亡於豫章，士眾萬餘人未有所附，策命慈往撫安焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "dccf8cada198e52d1aad78c6cea6d912fd646c73671a3fa373d3287cf3dea39b"}

{"id": "p_023ea298856196c4", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 96, "text": "左右皆曰：「慈必北去不還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "269cb3120c1c6e941e8c61e11450fa69da20496d8071bf51c8510535fca6e17a"}

{"id": "p_9f4fbf596a748694", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」策曰：「子義捨我，當復與誰？", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "2ff2582be109c9e9e9da49f52bec8529cba26c6188bb368e037a15f08ab45649"}

{"id": "p_40d6fef86cbe89a8", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」餞送昌門，把腕別曰：「何時能還？", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "cbe675f745d7e99775a2409566eeeb9493b7d37422b380723017dbc460ad4224"}

{"id": "p_fa488d98636d589d", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 99, "text": "劉表從子磐，驍勇，數為寇於艾、西安諸縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "8699a087cec021ceec635e26b77ef107aa4f237f265cfa23793f8b25252e4def"}

{"id": "p_dd8c8e27c271b5a6", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 100, "text": "策於是分海昏、建昌左右六縣，以慈為建昌都尉，治海昏，并督諸將拒磐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "850eb039db639073ceb61610ab64c2bf2d9c17a98509ebe215e74e51d6030786"}

{"id": "p_48d5d6652c4e9e03", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 101, "text": "慈長七尺七寸，美鬚髯，猿臂善射，弦不虛發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "6831b9d3289f55feb407bc984565659d70b04e328b6588df2f549963cdbd964e"}

{"id": "p_68a7e667a2ed30ee", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 102, "text": "嘗從策討麻保賊，賊於屯裏緣樓上行詈，以手持樓棼，慈引弓射之，矢貫手著棼，圍外萬人莫不稱善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "dca59c73201486e699baccd2a9df7c7f504d646738364c47bb683c974f564fd7"}

{"id": "p_cb0c88a96a01a4d0", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 103, "text": "曹公聞其名，遺慈書，以篋封之，發省無所道，而但貯當歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "2dbf56b879321cc6840d48eff23552c9467c175ff047b546adbffbc2d70003a0"}

{"id": "p_7490ca8eb6a3ac07", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 104, "text": "孫權統事，以慈能制磐，遂委南方之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "e1fed73f855ef116e316dd6b82dff72d4d5a9107eb1723e78cc9753548ff9a04"}

{"id": "p_69696921eda91947", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 105, "text": "士燮字威彥，蒼梧廣信人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "1026d7e761d0926fe43258970e5dacd60e05aff1c3514d0af8b5b05a3ae8d112"}

{"id": "p_88ff705096c26305", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 106, "text": "其先本魯國汶陽人，至王莽之亂，避地交州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "24e0e901cf6fef9d5318c49622973bbe537c3d39c0e2cb3dec089b1ac07f81da"}

{"id": "p_62ec33545608fe86", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 107, "text": "六世至燮父賜，桓帝時為日南太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "7479fe1682f1132daeac302fbd316ab5ce39fee41b2153f0f5511095ba8cf086"}

{"id": "p_5c255ce737bdccda", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 108, "text": "燮少游學京師，事潁川劉子奇，治左氏春秋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "b26e56ff441342157c6d8af244673169cafc68f74a25005b4707e6e94d233566"}

{"id": "p_b47ec3e9b31752a5", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 109, "text": "察孝廉，補尚書郎，公事免官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "5bd3cd9b4ab960d9a20f7d35c0dfa8d793fe5d159dfc733d2284fa49cfda6b05"}

{"id": "p_ad094b936610e09b", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 110, "text": "父賜喪闋後，舉茂才，除巫令，遷交阯太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "5ef85207157da88da97b6482a66839c3f408d79e19a88b2b73e7d54af0a7e23a"}

{"id": "p_14b3e71bcc87448a", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 111, "text": "刺史丁宮徵還京都，壹侍送勤恪，宮感之，臨別謂曰：「刺史若待罪三事，當相辟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "f045082f900ba4b3c56e859d5914dfe703a3a6ac19e48488a7775e6ac00a582f"}

{"id": "p_c40aac7c6e375e7e", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 112, "text": "比至，宮已免，黃琬代為司徒，甚禮遇壹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "487aa7f8684c6e48d6dfa2ff44e6e9e9dd482cd05cccaf5ef6d0531a52724f1e"}

{"id": "p_1c3eaf80eab4f117", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 113, "text": "交州刺史朱符為夷賊所殺，州郡擾亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "7b8fd38c7b260b6c7defa69173d1c1143b77280782280853d4621113c20ec41e"}

{"id": "p_14463405cd6fa612", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 114, "text": "燮乃表壹領合浦太守，次弟徐聞令䵋領九真太守，䵋弟武，領南海太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "cd61757ebb31b2a1567f07b4e7b41236449b0a4e09e90c45a013554e505b60ba"}

{"id": "p_e6f3487f91343b47", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 115, "text": "燮體器寬厚，謙虛下士，中國士人往依避難者以百數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "a11d1fc36c5adae27bd60246f9a7a87023a252bf095f9766a1cc9f651cea48e0"}

{"id": "p_bedc087f0ac8af74", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 116, "text": "陳國袁徽與尚書令荀彧書曰：「交阯士府君既學問優博，又達於從政，處大亂之中，保全一郡，二十餘年疆埸無事，民不失業，羇旅之徒，皆蒙其慶，雖竇融保河西，曷以加之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "02f3152c59382459262a5ae307958e4dae3398ca3f8a972a0212e0593659697d"}

{"id": "p_0333c932618dd937", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 117, "text": "官事小闋，輒玩習書傳，春秋左氏傳尤簡練精微，吾數以咨問傳中諸疑，皆有師說，意思甚密。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "74c85cc01d8f069d59518f2b14180ad885a9290e7c359b423e59e5eb43ee67f1"}

{"id": "p_b500f16149228e53", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 118, "text": "又尚書兼通古今，大義詳備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "142a7fb326437547c6874a94e227602c877e5a1e9ae8383cdc356bfc38fecb09"}

{"id": "p_a2d153a1b4861a18", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 119, "text": "聞京師古今之學，是非忿爭，今欲條左氏、尚書長義上之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "af6f077e89eaf3e36e7293844ffe4ad1fe441eaa73ac84eaa5cae79cb22c749c"}

{"id": "p_c6a3364a9142f8a6", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 120, "text": "燮兄弟並為列郡，雄長一州，偏在萬里，威尊無上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "4dba6fbb29f5a56eea719bc69b6f703ba500909e8bd50ef31ba2284f87e975cf"}

{"id": "p_3c812dcbb08a03ab", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 121, "text": "出入鳴鍾磬，備具威儀，笳簫鼓吹，車騎滿道，胡人夾轂焚燒香者常有數十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "3a71317a069a750202ac1e0122b9f714039e39edd55b1aa2b234215435ad30f8"}

{"id": "p_a903e300029241b2", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 122, "text": "妻妾乘輜軿，子弟從兵騎，當時貴重，震服百蠻，尉他不足踰也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "a0d09573895a686a3ed8422d28b996369fa00ee109d754ebf80bbeb606b198dc"}

{"id": "p_7b7f30b86b761954", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 123, "text": "朱符死後，漢遣張津為交州刺史，津後又為其將區景所殺，而荊州牧劉表遣零陵賴恭代津。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "a6aee6e22224e88967f096ef36c94214558e6887414ebb164989cc0f8ab9c6d3"}

{"id": "p_8e0d1082999a376b", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 124, "text": "是時蒼梧太守史璜死，表又遣吳巨代之，與恭俱至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "99d081093eff1b902112a693f2b3926f8b8f8c4817301b3ee7a66b922bb3016a"}

{"id": "p_15fb5cc9f7d16d47", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 125, "text": "漢聞張津死，賜燮璽書曰：「交州絕域，南帶江海，上恩不宣，下義壅隔，知逆賊劉表又遣賴恭闚看南土，今以燮為綏南中郎將，董督七郡，領交阯太守如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "0092e6d18013e38335d1dc3bcf19013b9b9044081be28a7e5872bb0b677a0603"}

{"id": "p_1f349ec0b813db9c", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 126, "text": "」後燮遣吏張旻奉貢詣京都，是時天下喪亂，道路斷絕，而燮不廢貢職，特復下詔拜安遠將軍，封龍度亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "2369a23a81d7ce18f76711823c7405d9dc32c7494ff56b23b240f978baf57148"}

{"id": "p_ea614208e90f2353", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 127, "text": "後巨與恭相失，舉兵逐恭，恭走還零陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "17fc940d02b7918d4f993e0560523aede17ffd2a0067dcefa88e6b8a7260f5b9"}

{"id": "p_b8e408135196a3dc", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 128, "text": "，孫權遣步騭為交州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "7022d8ad9afa8e3c51bceb391a7577a75df10a5266c3992445d540ba217bb744"}

{"id": "p_cbc4ff69633a3393", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 129, "text": "騭到，燮率兄弟奉承節度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "bdcf4abd647007dbc144bdd5972868d5cf5caa30ecafd72ae4097712eb4253c5"}

{"id": "p_dc8af1b217231cbd", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 130, "text": "建安末年，燮遣子廞入質，權以為武昌太守，燮、壹諸子在南者，皆拜中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "fd54ee688c922c2e4d4f6d69b3d8f91e1a8d368f7bb5ff4ad8f1518fe4e3002a"}

{"id": "p_ffd7cd8a840f325f", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 131, "text": "燮又誘導益州豪姓雍闓等，率郡人民使遙東附，權益嘉之，遷衛將軍，封龍編侯，弟壹偏將軍，都鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "4f7352f6d8e8fe5d3b3718e88eeb42fb96e5e5a72b85bd1572543a6a7f5fb066"}

{"id": "p_93f211a0c547d1d2", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 132, "text": "燮每遣使詣權，致雜香細葛，輒以千數，明珠、大貝、流離、翡翠、玳瑁、犀、象之珍，奇物異果，蕉、邪、龍眼之屬，無歲不至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "a9e2c7b702592f57e636235876717b40d67363bee40164e9dc8929c6aab2d772"}

{"id": "p_dd2084496161752c", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 133, "text": "權輒為書，厚加寵賜，以答慰之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "09a796a39cfc6af7162d3de84edd53e9a872cef3521bb3099277924c0fbcda58"}

{"id": "p_6bea239b986fe16a", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 134, "text": "燮在郡四十餘歲，，年九十卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "906707bc870e1ab4211cc6668c09b920cc1a60e6e81e8cb10724ab17b94328f1"}

{"id": "p_b1da2c8c5f68ed5d", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 135, "text": "權以交阯縣遠，乃分合浦以北為廣州，呂岱為刺史；交阯以南為交州，戴良為刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "23569a6bf36dbef5a1217e960eece3d8e6af49d5053917d444ca402c4de62e92"}

{"id": "p_eea44f07351f3baa", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 136, "text": "又遣陳時代燮為交阯太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "c2953374e0520bdecacc35670c727b71f975bab752ed4de5e4c74965e4d643ec"}

{"id": "p_95bb96eb9473115e", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 137, "text": "岱留南海，良與時俱前行到合浦，而燮子徽自署交阯太守，發宗兵拒良。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "5809af63c127ebb607c3bb1b087e2dc1adac4471ee414475522cadf2a7f320b3"}

{"id": "p_b468497be0170a28", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 138, "text": "交阯桓鄰，燮舉吏也，叩頭諫徽使迎良，徽怒，笞殺鄰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "4ad1fb59a2cd8ca72ee4901daf74cb7eeed146f2d5b2710287e783390f4096e8"}

{"id": "p_b040be2e2d29fec6", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 139, "text": "鄰兄治子發又合宗兵擊徽，徽閉門城守，治等攻之數月不能下，乃約和親，各罷兵還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "0aeb580cf5f0e9589a04390c46e549d7993a5a38ec5083f49348773ac162cc52"}

{"id": "p_031fb8a1c84d7ac1", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 140, "text": "而呂岱被詔誅徽，自廣州將兵晝夜馳入，過合浦，與良俱前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "3d87567a3830f2faad788ef49fecf019bb001c55d4a83ee6a81d929fda545f95"}

{"id": "p_186342aa8dfffed4", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 141, "text": "壹子中郎將匡與岱有舊，岱署匡師友從事，先移書交阯，告喻禍福，又遣匡見徽，說令服罪，雖失郡守，保無他憂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "e3c7560b373722064e19a882690d8f4de9a406226b5ba1eb0b9949d782cfb4d0"}

{"id": "p_5acc85da56afba81", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 142, "text": "岱尋匡後至，徽兄祗，弟幹、頌等六人肉袒奉迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "57512d0a377ba4189b5dd851359b2364d7599e3cf074d2971e54aea59db3d1fb"}

{"id": "p_e26d50e3e879f25a", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 143, "text": "明旦早施帳幔，請徽兄弟以次入，賓客滿坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "5457be62ff7554b7c3c6bbfa5dc1f3ddee46c0fa8473f75efbce75a2330a829b"}

{"id": "p_7b46a7871dd75033", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 144, "text": "岱起，擁節讀詔書，數徵罪過，左右因反縛以出，即皆伏誅，傳首詣武昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "fae1ccb59a02269ab29b4ddc7362138dfcf5fadbf0503e6c2f60b2ef46366e8b"}

{"id": "p_2520eb9daee72cab", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 145, "text": "壹、䵋、匡後出，權原其罪，及燮質子廞，皆免為庶人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "2b5f1100f23c43a8a65ca324b15322fd59278b8f29fb3d76982c1c78ee0431ee"}

{"id": "p_7b62c551298dda7e", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 146, "text": "廞病卒，無子，妻寡居，詔在所月給俸米，賜錢四十萬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "8fdcf105bbc91c3161d6c89ff3d3bacfbed12780a2762e197c4bc5e2919f37e0"}

{"id": "p_383cd55d2c1fa701", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 147, "text": "評曰：劉繇藻厲名行，好尚臧否。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "87af3199ec87bb1427b57f9d0d6399b0994d6e6a79cd8c34daccbeeefd222e4f"}

{"id": "p_e1694e3c94bff515", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 148, "text": "至於擾攘之時，據萬里之士，非其長也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "ca0f646a00f2eefd20e4b55259e56329d8c759c0f42f405a008931c28ab6d5d5"}

{"id": "p_60fc1efa8f4811f4", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 149, "text": "太史慈信義篤烈，有古人之分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "a319919d71593972a2a71a2f158302cc572e1e4935c686d73c1aff060be305f7"}

{"id": "p_7f7f5fc581372b5c", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 150, "text": "士燮作守南越，優遊終世，至子不慎，自貽兇咎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "5e00ddb6716d6bdf2838e327498278360807cccbdcefbd5acd8959a6cfda3925"}

{"id": "p_2906b68df05ddb82", "source_id": "src_38904e1bcaeb6623", "ordinal": 151, "text": "蓋庸才玩富貴而恃阻險，使之然也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "21703194778c960cd5523c3c31a0b39018e9fe5396233e473f59a8a06471bfae"}

{"id": "p_a8090f078845d158", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_1ecad2723ce88682", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 1, "text": "孫破虜吳夫人，吳主權母也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "fb2aedb6135b5f5efc3f12cb2b050f332af8c0182f3f5cd14249920527fdbc31"}

{"id": "p_28cd7b487067f865", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 2, "text": "本吳人，徙錢唐，早失父母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "8c9881532187fdd5ecaafc4eb331d8808296ec8fc48dbd29b9382fa4ed743f06"}

{"id": "p_278c678aea081f6b", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 3, "text": "吳氏親戚嫌堅輕狡，將拒焉，堅甚以慚恨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "c56546fff70242f64e61d8a316ea05b118347486dfa6fe77802b1f17a9193c7f"}

{"id": "p_75b6696c2b2d8475", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 4, "text": "夫人謂親戚曰：「何愛一女以取禍乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "3365967fafbe7c5f1b30b738e8329cff0266050134fdf4e9699ddc1ceb7c808b"}

{"id": "p_a91c2fe4d4decde4", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 5, "text": "」於是遂許為婚，生四男一女。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "80aac172e8068d868b92867d3ed23e9f6895f35ae5540fd55c96b658751f2b3b"}

{"id": "p_6a29c3c1c731901b", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 6, "text": "景常隨堅征伐有功，拜騎都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "d12f66b3ca1c46fd64312fab106906f1a552c63e01bf2ef47b8ff9e127df7795"}

{"id": "p_b1fbb7896e866e00", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 7, "text": "袁術上景領丹楊太守，討故太守周昕，遂據其郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "b2825d10d0c72d6ea1fa9bca5a4201b3178b13d0abe9e85677a70e509e2474ce"}

{"id": "p_2c636d7c68c50481", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 8, "text": "孫策與孫河、呂範依景，合眾共討涇縣山賊祖郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "dc2c37974b7f2a00f7cce40eeb3c81bf806bddf33dc7ffb0dc18165ef8ae6d22"}

{"id": "p_585694066d99a072", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 9, "text": "會為劉繇所迫，景復北依術，術以為督軍中郎將，與孫賁共討樊能、於麋於橫江，又擊笮融、薛禮於秣陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "e65f3f09c05cc81e5b26019771037c6c60cacc0272e51abf9c9e554f432a709a"}

{"id": "p_98ee73bc89093eed", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 10, "text": "時策被創牛渚，降賊復反，景攻討，盡禽之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "262bc61350dc057075fc8d42959ee2ba8216566c34c68638e8d4be5626ceb0be"}

{"id": "p_21f949c9624ca3c0", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 11, "text": "從討劉繇，繇奔豫章，策遣景、賁到壽春報術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "e7bc2e91c25a481accf1c76fd0ce71cc819383a377e827bd6be1c422618d590a"}

{"id": "p_e6eb6769f87bbf34", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 12, "text": "術方與劉備爭徐州，以景為為廣陵太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "1a8cedf7b0f146bc781c31916b5532877fadcf7e7baa221b00e8a53ebca3bc5f"}

{"id": "p_61a949b673aa57b6", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 13, "text": "策以書喻術，術不納，便絕江津，不與通，使人告景。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "7988818322b4c036802f6da2f7ad66a68010360c33f363f9aea6d0198ec50287"}

{"id": "p_04aa2800829b4d46", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 14, "text": "景即委郡東歸，策復以景為丹揚太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "01f683ed9c20b107451dc0c7b2370fdc91626374b782930fff5c6ad366a48a4b"}

{"id": "p_926d4a0f4a75f6e7", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 15, "text": "漢遣議郎王誧銜命南行，表景為揚武將軍，領郡如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "8e57600f91588108d2d2d5c0366ab61d0cafb07009e5c4ea3d247ccc6726e3c9"}

{"id": "p_014f5dabb07d7bb2", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 16, "text": "及權少年統業，夫人助治軍國，甚有補益。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "b8b50da3363eebf2a1191a7eefaba141e794feba78781d7c46563e60d00efe68"}

{"id": "p_3afe0470f785df36", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 17, "text": "，臨薨，引見張昭等，屬以後事，合葬高陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "00600451c74dec020f33540ed9309f6913429ddb9f2ce26a304f59a0db43683b"}

{"id": "p_6b3b6d048d91ca84", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 18, "text": "八年，景卒宮，子奮授兵為將，封新亭侯，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "fc0f2061b6bdaffea59f2940f7364820a1ab9f041ccf121dfd45dbf829e39ef8"}

{"id": "p_41a179f700d81e2e", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 19, "text": "子安嗣，安坐黨魯王霸死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "ddc70668b8f214ee0179cfbcedfddff23a0cdd9c3776595279580f8b9cad8217"}

{"id": "p_033ac385f23cc4ea", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 20, "text": "奮弟祺嗣，封都亭侯，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "ea51c3628b824b9892832d16fedae8aa9ae5113557e3a3ce6a59e2a8ba295b6d"}

{"id": "p_5094f5d97cc5a331", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 21, "text": "纂妻即滕胤女也，胤被誅，竝遇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "09645049fb45702507deb93cb5d6045a284b14fd1dea3eaf276e23825f8a9bc4"}

{"id": "p_ba4293d75b280b63", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 22, "text": "吳主權謝夫人，會稽山陰人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "9ff79de8e78131b2619c19d625256403946a836d42ce926606e2abade5854f7b"}

{"id": "p_d3432a4413bf8239", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 23, "text": "權母吳，為權聘以為妃，愛幸有寵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "d8f0ee4c16b52b6e08fd4353f37470e078357318447105965b6951875bc86de1"}

{"id": "p_6b529f13c6e124eb", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 24, "text": "後權納姑孫徐氏，欲令謝下之，謝不肯，由是失志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "d1cfc99cd48a4eafffd92ef279b0d972fa508b16aee5de92befb14681956431b"}

{"id": "p_3ae73156f946b623", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 25, "text": "後十餘年，弟承拜五官郎中，稍遷長沙東部都尉、武陵太守，撰《後漢書》百餘卷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "3e36b540e8105edb8ae34adf5e11f55cd4d3704ba791e07c6a42e30b2f0ae235"}

{"id": "p_86e02ef4b83c0979", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 26, "text": "吳主權徐夫人，吳郡富春人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "468ee7d85d8197fbd7fbb8b4aebcfe8890e20848c2d4b2286826541e6f58ab08"}

{"id": "p_fe215d79e384ee87", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 27, "text": "祖父真，與權父堅相親，堅以妹妻真，生琨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "51193896c7d563a039b60c11a81f57cd30fe610187ba058f71615438297dee62"}

{"id": "p_4e04ec2b659e7670", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 28, "text": "琨少仕州郡，漢末擾亂，去吏，隨堅征伐有功，拜偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "e1d62efd808ff40cf35be21bb6a60627df6112f354a70f45f01f9baf72c17526"}

{"id": "p_74b8911018223ef6", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 29, "text": "堅薨，隨孫策討樊能、於糜等於橫江，擊張英於當利口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "54e8f2ca9a0bd5c134156843913d2e6303bb929f58da5180579d48579e9936e9"}

{"id": "p_0df167ef09744ecd", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 30, "text": "琨母時在軍中，謂琨曰：「恐州家多發水軍來逆人，則不利矣，如何可駐邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "7c0ed63cfb85a01c5043aa34d1fe562d9be6c3351584c8df999db71ddc82c200"}

{"id": "p_ea2708ca0557cf03", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 31, "text": "宜伐蘆葦以為泭，佐船渡軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "796335ea234800f809d37d82cf845d41312f1ffbfc625e8cb38aedc80f8467a8"}

{"id": "p_7a1e40f32f6ed347", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 32, "text": "眾悉俱濟，遂破英，擊走笮融、劉繇，事業克定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "2dfb0694856b002bad4eede7c020624b8b6e5b14719069be864f3d6f9c012b44"}

{"id": "p_7344802aa4ebf1d6", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 33, "text": "策表琨領丹楊太守，會吳景委廣陵來東，復為丹楊守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "f7316621b18bf9ddb60608970e99d76757b362bf2331800051627c8c69df514b"}

{"id": "p_1bae75348c841977", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 34, "text": "琨以督軍中郎將領兵，從破廬江太守李術，封廣德侯，遷平虜將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "ad8e046318b4f131d99d6483bba4eeba0f92e0acd297db21401509970c4e2fb2"}

{"id": "p_00969cb77c0c2ef9", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 35, "text": "琨生夫人，初適同郡陸尚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "bcc45ba86b35b2528d5b6dee797a08a742fcc9d219b48953925e77ee51f5eed7"}

{"id": "p_5c832f47f592faeb", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 36, "text": "尚卒，極為討虜將軍在吳，聘以為妃，使母養子登。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "cea219a0ade2e95f326526dd8700ebd6da4cd49f3c65a34ab814a1b3106a394f"}

{"id": "p_239b5ae1f5097cf5", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 37, "text": "後權遷移，以夫人妒忌，廢處吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "d64190e599c7fadfc535aaf6394244d087d2870589a621749e00b57c19aba1af"}

{"id": "p_082a43edda7612c9", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 38, "text": "積十餘年，權為吳王及即尊號，登為太子，群臣請立夫人為-{后}-，權意在步氏，卒不許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "c551a39e7ea3b1f25d2aa700b1523bd66bc1005737e5ed9c7d07b9f53e4590eb"}

{"id": "p_adfded2608bb53d7", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 39, "text": "兄矯，嗣父琨侯，討平山越，拜偏將軍，先夫人卒，無子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "7a6ce26c1849192b861e0a4cf17fa361baa7c2c84c7d3b0c32c9f7f551956623"}

{"id": "p_349ca49ba9786a5f", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 40, "text": "弟祚襲封，亦以戰功至（於）蕪湖督、平魏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "b9404b50d2c2f44312d1a5a5344695ab4c14371fd760378140cbd1e163df096c"}

{"id": "p_48a77fd51db77360", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 41, "text": "吳主權步夫人，臨淮淮陰人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "d777c33221ade575460219e39e99ef1ce124f4792ce1964541f51a275f764457"}

{"id": "p_dde7a891121a37a0", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 42, "text": "漢末，其母攜將徙廬江，廬江為孫策所破，皆東渡江，以美麗得幸於權，寵冠後庭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "eab76f01165eba30c98425112f85ec2c8038549cbd1129337824c4e6cf3f744f"}

{"id": "p_8b6d9ba5cb00708c", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 43, "text": "生二女，長曰魯班，字大虎，前配周瑜子循，後配全琮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "81b213fa0c56d5dfc9c5e363aff04a6d21b3f9f7cd5ddb2ee4238b59e2fbaf12"}

{"id": "p_a2b74be24f4a3c31", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 44, "text": "少曰魯育，字小虎，前配朱據，後配劉纂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "40c5fba3702711d3533b2eee51226734867b60567f52c90ec22f28f9be10589d"}

{"id": "p_5fc982b1070459b8", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 45, "text": "夫人性不妒忌，多所推近，故久見愛待。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "d1e7fdefa5a5cac8f4a7862869cb378f12f92a9bb437124f5f12360087641ccc"}

{"id": "p_b7613547a0cf1e57", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 46, "text": "權為王及帝，意欲以為-{后}-，而群臣議在徐氏，權依違者十餘年，然宮內皆稱皇-{后}-，親戚上疏稱中宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "ab8d6a96fec562ec318bbc8410fa32fafaa0a6f076fcd2ea950afde783667374"}

{"id": "p_c3573abd5c665075", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 47, "text": "及薨，臣下緣權指，請追正名號，乃贈印綬，策命曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "6e0d550506cf3ac2cb9d1e2e0348886d31f4293f27e5ce12c0484f29c6074e78"}

{"id": "p_e14de698975ad0d9", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 48, "text": "吳主權王夫人，琅邪人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "7581aa014c61572a947a9e9fafbdf02f82ff06c9dab11c603cb86083a4e48294"}

{"id": "p_92574eb3487f2b28", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 49, "text": "夫人以選入宮，黃武中得幸，生（孫）和，寵次步氏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "bf9e71dac8d9a7cd029603493bb961f312248a8850ec09d657d97173cbcfe0ec"}

{"id": "p_c7bda46e374dab71", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 50, "text": "步氏薨後，和立為太子，權將立夫人為-{后}-，而全公主素憎夫人，稍稍譖毀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "f4a1e4fd40b2000ffe91cc08be204ef5f57507ba21d02c4ace23cebfd98977e7"}

{"id": "p_c5b997e88c2fdc39", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 51, "text": "言有喜色，由是權深責怒，以憂死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "b08ccda6aeab98c59a820d309336e6b7f90dedf2cb56f430fa52fb3796898573"}

{"id": "p_89678e97ddeaf0bc", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 52, "text": "和子皓立，追尊夫人曰大懿皇后，封三弟皆列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "c0d67515bfce1456c29cb53b07ff50e26e29bcc716ceec8a41c2774e289e8403"}

{"id": "p_99f1558d99f6dbd5", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 53, "text": "吳主權王夫人，南陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "27d1aa1c21e2334fbcd920373c223f68a0683eb261a228b011a2a212109bbe31"}

{"id": "p_112904c278b6817f", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 54, "text": "以選人宮，嘉禾中得幸，生（孫）休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "66d9d1d8b9b182e749f8ccd6ea7a58670804d6a3505c2d3bb093c6cbe71c8d82"}

{"id": "p_b6c2288f0a50b88d", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 55, "text": "及和為太子，和母貴重，諸姬有寵者，皆出居外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "ec76061e31294f6b25bb6a003ba73831be1d9e91c418e1de6c220336f1304611"}

{"id": "p_854f08a4fb16ffae", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 56, "text": "夫人出公安，卒，因葬焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "c650036b58fc507f68288661554c93941f732ae508429a30938d169c364c989f"}

{"id": "p_5fe602be121465f9", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 57, "text": "休即位，遣使追尊曰敬懷皇-{后}-，改葬敬陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "f8be6b9cf4a8f2d70e66d9032b5177d26b9eb76b15f88b287bfbbbf3ce9c40a1"}

{"id": "p_b77475316a49f4a7", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 58, "text": "王氏無後，封同母弟文雍為亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "f226596ae7d17459bd535aa96978d98d8980f6d132ebef2f1d4694ce0c25da22"}

{"id": "p_da26203f9c2a93c5", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 59, "text": "吳主權潘夫人，會稽句章人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "05c5b34d6c331148e7951396f89bd095879a3202641959e2cf2c2f0818248696"}

{"id": "p_1fcbd2e791da2125", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 60, "text": "夫人與姊俱輸織室，權見而異之，召充後宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "d6280abc88d9281dbb51cba20a43cb1c3e97f24a165775cd69f72a4e70eafdb1"}

{"id": "p_46e1b2a9b1586753", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 61, "text": "得幸有娠，夢有以龍頭授己者，己以蔽膝受之，遂生（孫）亮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "173d9da5a3816554c63640c1cb1913ba267bc1d2285b38da4e8fb50b2ed3cc63"}

{"id": "p_b582d9f4731ac4e0", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 62, "text": "，亮立為太子，請出嫁夫人之姊，權聽許之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "b55d30501402fc4bf0c71420c32a24165154f71567ce1df40f9bfbcf32b44142"}

{"id": "p_b1b1c4d6a5af0bb2", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 63, "text": "明年，立夫人為皇-{后}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "0a1384bc6f1cbb1da57365920a2267a76008d950abbc0d0f70f25b60b50ed43d"}

{"id": "p_a1ae6d650db5a81f", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 64, "text": "性險妒容媚，自始至卒，譖害袁夫人等甚眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "17bd22cef45f578f6ab6feb1ab0c3d640db3411c36381782c2e2eea62dc831cb"}

{"id": "p_b5e2235bb04f0b14", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 65, "text": "權不豫，夫人使問中書令孫弘呂-{后}-專制故事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "e62e259dc0b43ea96b87e0eb31ac469d8ee8ea3266f3a03bd91d535a65a43c23"}

{"id": "p_304309485107f68a", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 66, "text": "侍疾疲勞，因以羸疾，諸宮人伺其昏臥，共縊殺之，託言中惡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "7f75e854dd9184ca2f5e1f5d52f6347c83e3c3da30ea2eae6eda321ee2667517"}

{"id": "p_8b01e5740153de66", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 67, "text": "孫亮即位，以夫人姊婿譚紹為騎都尉，授兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "0994be4f4b7a6bfb8b091270af2bd045542af58a9c4d10fe0a677eb6b01b5b26"}

{"id": "p_efb1543d9aba6d93", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 68, "text": "亮廢，紹與家屬送本部廬陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "035882605b9032ae09b8233e645a5d6fd4729e57346b3250822ce6f26e110e5d"}

{"id": "p_076e5a451ff437e3", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 69, "text": "（尚）從祖母公主愛之，每進見輒與俱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "810611fe738075f70582b13ec618106278f2a52b3c1f05511d4debd0c98dd911"}

{"id": "p_2bc58bbf873d5a8d", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 70, "text": "及潘夫人母子有寵，全主自以與孫和母有隙，乃勸權為潘氏男亮納夫人，亮遂為嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "f50d13df5c940487a9a1964e2668f35c13a6fd02a0b75390dd2d837ba70478ae"}

{"id": "p_846500dab41bf604", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 71, "text": "夫人立為皇后，以尚為城門校尉，封都亭侯，代滕胤為太常、衛將軍，進封永平侯，錄尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "f0a229317f75a24d37b49fb4d418a33deafa85b5b064a5aa914f01cd35cc3402"}

{"id": "p_f4ccef44afd624a6", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 72, "text": "時全氏侯有五人，並典兵馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "e554185c07d33c3e1cef114709803191a7f5c8d067a9a38285a04ba2c5357db2"}

{"id": "p_dc6d5939365ef952", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 73, "text": "其餘為侍郎、騎都尉，宿衛左右，自吳興，外戚貴盛莫及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "c876b566bc730f7239e6f9d0243787fa46102ce6cfbefee4f271efc994516ebe"}

{"id": "p_ff4d5b52b7602a47", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 74, "text": "及魏大將諸葛誕以壽春來附，而全懌、全端、全禕、全儀等並因此際降魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "588c67f04b20c42257f72ab2db3e7ec5a8a1fea00fdc158a2f274b7351c2f7d5"}

{"id": "p_5325e3178cc16f74", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 75, "text": "全熙謀洩見殺，由是諸全衰弱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "55c1bbfed16c4770126f4c8616483ad88bc264b3cc9fa85fc961cd151f9cd2b2"}

{"id": "p_2c016a58914b1211", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 76, "text": "會孫綝廢亮為會稽王，後又黜為候官侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "86b01488fb945581c17c653cdb7b7e4e04880ef16e67acf89cbc5d0fcc443e70"}

{"id": "p_1989d3a298390b16", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 77, "text": "夫人隨之國，居候官，尚將家屬徙零陵，追見殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "9c9c20e420f4bffe500803165db88ffd2952d2043499adc6600ca9aab4071beb"}

{"id": "p_dac0d63884ba1659", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 78, "text": "孫休朱夫人，朱據女，休姊公主所生也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "68dab9df79c8850ed3d08a14af1b113c32f29517c6c59dfc111a3914ff3298e5"}

{"id": "p_4b8c59250eaad10f", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 79, "text": "赤烏末，權為休納以為妃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "5dfb89a9d6f51438be4f2a02da4121e9ab496a8b2bd02002122258c04e1acf20"}

{"id": "p_2d4a48b4a9523d7f", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 80, "text": "建興中，孫峻專政，公族皆患之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "1654bbccb3a0c0fd27511d147b4d95735dc27146ddc6ec9bb1a0f7c781799f9b"}

{"id": "p_c50947f72b4c80cc", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 81, "text": "初，孫和為太子時，全主譖害王夫人，欲廢太子，立魯王，朱主不聽，由是有隙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "b0cdb7aae2d5d77ea2e608f9d752ed27f2a05e91338b4d9bd12a754c04b18be5"}

{"id": "p_3ac0f5c55dafb0a0", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 82, "text": "五鳳中，孫儀謀殺峻，事覺被誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "881f41dbd67ad789ec329ad249e3f7ab157eb85ea3535256658faa96428f8f21"}

{"id": "p_3a3963679724164c", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 83, "text": "全主因言朱主與儀同謀，峻枉殺朱主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "e0dd2bbfa8e6864a702f9f95a12f01eb637e4c38731a385b1eb8fbc1f0dc8701"}

{"id": "p_1116c7e603363668", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 84, "text": "休懼，遣夫人還建業，執手泣別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "5d01c2a8084ee44bbc2df7bca6be6fc3ee9f60b002fd06b71b43168927cdb345"}

{"id": "p_51070ce9e5068149", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 85, "text": "太平中，孫亮知朱主為全主所害，問朱主死意？", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "7017c02ce8193cc3b46a36792dd7d24afcc60fcf4bcfafe43b86f0d79895c136"}

{"id": "p_d70ec88425d3c55b", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 86, "text": "全主懼曰：「我實不知，皆據二子熊、損所白。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "ea204b3aa95836328f49ebfc578e95aae843395a8158672cd5d504355a33c703"}

{"id": "p_f503831bfdc31fb9", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 87, "text": "損妻是峻妹也，孫綝益忌亮，遂廢亮，立休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "5164d0eec840f43a82b801da09e345a0e1df1f2186b6a72adfab3e43f4907639"}

{"id": "p_3ca7103fb249d275", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 88, "text": "休卒，群臣尊夫人為皇太后，孫皓即位月餘，貶為景皇后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "a6f45f3355487597f57298bbcd56ffe90de91ac8ae6e813383d41d691860ac87"}

{"id": "p_0ddcfbe7c790a689", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 89, "text": "七月，見逼薨，合葬定陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "344166040cdccafa458f9385639840f02cbe951cb6a6e58f2a0e8f10478892ac"}

{"id": "p_e73d2220da09d657", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 90, "text": "孫和何姬，丹楊句容人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "80f8ea6367be4e61aa3bfafc450bd5fe0a6af035d9463df8f91a00d99d56685b"}

{"id": "p_d39575aebc7fd644", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 91, "text": "孫權嘗遊幸諸營，而姬觀於道中，權望見異之，命宦者召入，以賜子和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "593c2ae3b3d7f386082aaa6733b50e5668ba1681d606c67ed272f5a2fbd5891f"}

{"id": "p_e187c6aacf6c3e99", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 92, "text": "太子和既廢，後為南陽王，居長沙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "b134754459ea8d35d7f66297489dd47ed8c3b93d11035b58a1f3177979f17254"}

{"id": "p_b8ca0b11cb42f27c", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 93, "text": "峻素媚事全主，全主與和母有隙，遂勸峻徙和居新都，遣使賜死，嫡妃張氏亦自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "2076258f3bdd736b022859854651ad69b8652534666bfa1129226bbdf59a2f4b"}

{"id": "p_b2f820aa48a20aa1", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 94, "text": "何姬曰：「若皆從死，誰當養孤？", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "953ef23f0508234f540bc6ac1c4798e94a1f0b67f37afcb35b259e1293a69f21"}

{"id": "p_e10f776987e7655b", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 95, "text": "皓即位，尊和為昭獻皇帝，何姬為昭獻皇-{后}-，稱昇平宮，月餘，進為皇太后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "90382635ee4691030b1d51909d02696703c266aafe2f90676ae69f6b075bf583"}

{"id": "p_576d6caa2ae06536", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 96, "text": "封弟洪永平侯，蔣溧陽侯，植宣城侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "aef925f6efa190721612bb43fb6ecb69dbc4da24d5f87dbd4f34a8edb87d6e68"}

{"id": "p_8589ba9f25c39a47", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 97, "text": "洪卒，子邈嗣，為武陵監軍，為晉所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "f680a31a2c09758cf680cb1bee9a3261cd292bffd9aace4c9da79a83a3bce4f9"}

{"id": "p_312699f068c27cf7", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 98, "text": "吳末昏亂，何氏驕僭，子弟橫放，百姓患之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "ac383d6d1795dd509453227d880126f496ad3d699dcc4ade5544c9d98cec1bbf"}

{"id": "p_6a415cc40e3ec88c", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 99, "text": "故民訛言「皓久死，立者何氏子」云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "c7e16d817a19bad17c5dc41bee213c5944c0c6e9654f61b48d1ac53a7fd4a4ad"}

{"id": "p_6a39bf1e94d59192", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 100, "text": "孫皓滕夫人，故太常胤之族女也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "94325a5ad542f71e13aa4efff0d043e0b1cff5128aba4f4cc911d79f2f3d9657"}

{"id": "p_b2f619556591d456", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 101, "text": "胤夷滅，夫人父牧，以疏遠徙邊郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "c196f4f91a544f5194a7f8089b5ab55a3df7f197b5af82bc612998ae28001f3c"}

{"id": "p_9c00bdab0acc5a23", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 102, "text": "孫休即位，大赦，得還，以牧為五官中郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "98da2e733aa1495913032a80cfbdd79d746fe563c757e4ecfe3c4a9b0635c660"}

{"id": "p_3fc081ac85f5aced", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 103, "text": "皓既封烏程侯，聘牧女為妃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "84ba44e6f576c2f3681e40a17537c3141997f21c774cd37c19b4ff9aff7e6ffa"}

{"id": "p_68f185391a962f55", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 104, "text": "皓即位，立為皇后，封牧高密侯，拜衛將軍，錄尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "3f2eeff7a0cd1598291e50a84996d4132ce19f05b48ca63d8bdb7bb40f0f647f"}

{"id": "p_c143c6c08c49c8b3", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 105, "text": "後朝士以牧尊戚，頗推令諫爭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "0aff05a7b6fe78d905699a825c8dd860255dc298d1bc9d24b62af74b041008f9"}

{"id": "p_a910364b0317f656", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 106, "text": "而夫人寵漸衰，皓滋不悅，皓母何恆左右之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "098aaa2d6865332a926b38d44544a52711977519a0daa0f0aaad930f550bd910"}

{"id": "p_be2f0b123a797295", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 107, "text": "又太史言，於運歷，-{后}-不可易，皓信巫覡，故得不廢，常供養昇平宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "219dcb9dfb271f1ccdcb2df6a8b70f9cf0125fc97a46e8a4c3f20de45b8d17fa"}

{"id": "p_1d0998629a7430d0", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 108, "text": "牧見遣居蒼梧郡，雖爵位不奪，其實裔也，遂道路憂死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "3652de65768011510addd9abd2b76c4124a6b69c71546d7a83ade7c983912266"}

{"id": "p_cbafec97c7603c8c", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 109, "text": "長秋官僚，備員而已，受朝賀表疏如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "e35d549e85e3f9fbdc3ecf263a728dfd4065079c188b9ebaade5642940bc4097"}

{"id": "p_51e1bb93331c6b19", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 110, "text": "而皓內諸寵姬，佩皇-{后}-璽紱者多矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "74bcf01399bc522e9ef40bfc62ca8cfb3e50ac521be0d55cd9098a3da5fe1b6e"}

{"id": "p_d25d228926fe3ffd", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 111, "text": "評曰：《易》稱「正家而天下定」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "5de6df62e484577ccbb5ab6b3df788137099b4971a912e2a8ef3a03c389feca0"}

{"id": "p_18f2cc7cab631dd9", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 112, "text": "《詩》云：「刑於寡妻，至於兄弟，以御於家邦」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "fc02d3458f260718bd9ee0e2cda6930b2f65fe9dab1f49ccd0ab9df7c1636ce4"}

{"id": "p_611eb8f2a752cbcd", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 113, "text": "遠觀齊桓，近察孫權，皆有識士之明，傑人之志，而嫡庶不分，閨庭錯亂，遺笑古今，殃流後嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "e6ceb30f326c3d0069d3617c3b84c7fc5b97f5cec34552b5bf9a33a743611470"}

{"id": "p_beffbdeb99e14644", "source_id": "src_f0c4da13da81c074", "ordinal": 114, "text": "由是論之，惟以道義為心、平一為主者，然後克免斯累邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "10ffe2bde8d2f09e2e69e54ae598b945c6257fe4c9409a29805313804bb765b0"}

{"id": "p_25a4ec057914c50a", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_b2d351deafdd1821", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 1, "text": "堅始舉事，靜糾合鄉曲及宗室五六百人以為保障，眾咸附焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "371d0bfe1edfa6b2fd40b708bda62c7f24fbcc6cb835feb4c6f1f3cf9e43decc"}

{"id": "p_996926a51c6c5412", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 2, "text": "進攻會稽，遣人請靜，靜將家屬與策會於錢唐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "e9ab1ad15271730e988f3db93e8f7152220834cc171b69f01c84522f77f2b126"}

{"id": "p_ca69e17c5d3fe428", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 3, "text": "是時太守王朗拒策於固陵，策數渡水戰，不能克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "704770689cee4fa48382d7c0bff96ad2d7a6c6ce6424a917d4249de9a94001c9"}

{"id": "p_6d2632379d003bf5", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 4, "text": "靜說策曰：「朗負阻城守，難可卒拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "8e6f23fc33e98dac976a9be09a327aa126fedd387bbdc97429c8aaaf47d0deec"}

{"id": "p_4215e056932d5f00", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 5, "text": "查瀆南去此數十里，而道之要徑也，宜從彼據其內，所謂攻其無備、出其不意者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "e191ff388d1f00a70c4f3f5bc79b1163b62c56a8add555c0c2c14f356fd4c0f2"}

{"id": "p_aaf669a49d1711cf", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 6, "text": "吾當自帥眾為軍前隊，破之必矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "e90e65d07c95bf405e6f3569150a294756a6cbdf33ca77250f0bfb6a2e431268"}

{"id": "p_f6c95221440b69e9", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 7, "text": "」乃詐令軍中曰：「頃連雨水濁，兵飲之多腹痛，令促具罌缶數百口澄水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "df8881711aa1d2181ea0c6d39fd33a10a247149ff2a450d60d434c6f73c8f25d"}

{"id": "p_73f446da4ee55a2d", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」至昏暮，羅以然火誑朗，便分軍夜投查瀆道，襲高遷屯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "3ccbe88efc02d7822f1def24427e8cb346c8763031d5706aaa055a56d40f7646"}

{"id": "p_dddce886ddfdc968", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 9, "text": "遣故丹楊太守周昕等帥兵前戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "b3b4bbc7daf0e2cd6a5076869492241ee3dad3a0905c1e1c2a3f26346c4ee1e6"}

{"id": "p_ba40e9656760852d", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 10, "text": "策破昕等，斬之，遂定會稽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "055f1e84e105984b4795c6854e1d955165cfd0879b7da3d177834ef6c261bfb5"}

{"id": "p_8f708d256973b83d", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 11, "text": "表拜靜為奮武校尉，欲授之重任，靜戀墳墓宗族，不樂出仕，求留鎮守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "1bff8d4c77c65a23a980ab468e87d84abc8e0223e1fc7e69f9a2a59ad1f760a2"}

{"id": "p_ded5d6617b9057d2", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 12, "text": "權統事，就遷昭義中郎將，終於家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "44f11781fd57865d4c43ccc7db791ec7dfacb26c0e878385dd39ffe0743952b5"}

{"id": "p_e720b20486e76306", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 13, "text": "有五子，-{暠}-、瑜、皎、奐、謙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "bb7bdbbde1ddcb0a2a3d370a95d0a46f1d0b37c72ff1ea0f7ae55ec5a49f7e19"}

{"id": "p_3c5c8d991831f27d", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 14, "text": "-{暠}-三子：綽、超、恭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "cba7d0a4f5365f6f8c7d12199e01a9b741e8218cfac801349b8c1ff00dba66f0"}

{"id": "p_68a2f43b0eefa9f5", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 15, "text": "瑜字仲異，以恭義校尉始領兵眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "bd279689a75500810f7c194dba3e41ea5e7ecd662273623dda1f2422f20f548c"}

{"id": "p_1dc74a2076304633", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 16, "text": "是時賓客諸將多江西人，瑜虛心綏撫，得其歡心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "d9f961d552a593e00519b7549c7b48b3b4120ce3d0f93896ffbd98b141b8e348"}

{"id": "p_3553807bba22a52a", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 17, "text": "，領丹楊太守，為眾所附，至萬餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "bdc69948e0d04513642d0258b8909fafdcaa97dfab7df64c684c40f984c6c6b8"}

{"id": "p_fa3b5886f5d80b09", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 18, "text": "十一年，與周瑜共討麻、保二屯，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "4c7bb87bda184b44b395551a2d02c9f1157358f99c18a8e3d7107232a0ead194"}

{"id": "p_7dec38b283601f21", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 19, "text": "後從權拒曹公於濡須，權欲交戰，瑜說權持重，權不從，軍果無功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "c2a9dea6bf5156587ae894e5b17485a68f2c79866bb38f90ea963467dd24607a"}

{"id": "p_e8bf7f78cddb1606", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 20, "text": "遷奮威將軍，領郡如故，自溧陽徙屯牛渚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "7cc60aefb891605188929a366b67811ae32aff9b08b7215fc950137342c3d32b"}

{"id": "p_3bbb11de9e805544", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 21, "text": "瑜以永安人饒助為襄安長，無錫人顏連為居巢長，使招納廬江二郡，各得降附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "eb3657f475432fdcbe67c014d68bf79719f7c93a7355bbb698bbf2b1d14ca953"}

{"id": "p_53b75975ec6ba9d0", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 22, "text": "濟陰人馬普篤學好古，瑜厚禮之，使二府將吏子弟數百人就受業，遂立學官，臨饗講肄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "8199db11ef2f800c4091cb77e533df1547d3dad5627da1dbea9fed0f9f49716c"}

{"id": "p_c5e3fef2d89838e6", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 23, "text": "是時諸將皆以軍務為事，而瑜好樂墳典，雖在戎旅，誦聲不絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "0ab6bdcffd44d290173cc2702909ea73832b2f2a0dad28c7f8a1f2454a5c4c51"}

{"id": "p_226bc11e678553c3", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 24, "text": "瑜五子：彌、熙、耀、曼、紘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "a8b3560ca26e82d629006dfec3231864004b23c62345ef87a5067fe27885bcd1"}

{"id": "p_58d4a7c140d8b38d", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 25, "text": "孫皎字叔朗，始拜護軍校尉，領眾二千餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "3502f1e28677bc84c0026885202060dd38c7957682d12bd3bfa65a49f2f47b36"}

{"id": "p_2f3af9ac7f78ccd0", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 26, "text": "是時曹公數出濡須，皎每赴拒，號為精銳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "b4132323f22997e3cdc06766c3c1bb2b5ecbbc254dc0061370662a36c765f2c6"}

{"id": "p_2f602c0720410885", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 27, "text": "遷都護征虜將軍，代程普督夏口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "212c04493f57470db4a5e9b0b398cc6d4e7b4f5030a67b8f2b1aa17811fb407e"}

{"id": "p_79c00c850210797a", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 28, "text": "黃蓋及兄瑜卒，又並其軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "a9c42dd28e2e672dce955f173dc7677b99b1e09692787067b3b37938b29e151e"}

{"id": "p_61efdf59e2959f93", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 29, "text": "賜沙羨、雲杜、南新市、竟陵為奉邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "5580d81f096662d57ea4e45111c7910b655d09038b5d4251d4791662bbc2e38f"}

{"id": "p_5066fab8507c1d18", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 30, "text": "輕財能施，善於交結，與諸葛瑾至厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "9b21c66844c1508b05de869b150787e18e1e0928155363ac7569b69c7512019e"}

{"id": "p_89a228f352fd079a", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 31, "text": "委廬江劉靖以得失，江夏李允以眾事，廣陵吳碩、河南張梁以軍旅，而傾心親待，莫不自盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "66d193a321aea867284ad6779b992aacdc21de9e210030771549c1b2f416b0a0"}

{"id": "p_f38eea80b1a6654f", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 32, "text": "皎嘗遣兵候獲魏邊將吏美女以進皎，皎更其衣服送還之，下令曰：「今所誅者曹氏，其百姓何罪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "80ead1a2d2fbbb807c5fb65cd5396528730615c8ebf434c5fbc118269eccb470"}

{"id": "p_9c21ae599ef1899b", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 33, "text": "自今以往，不得擊其老弱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "96a88f0aaca88bbf621388342630e8a700e448245893c54ae7a8de4d1cfed6bd"}

{"id": "p_f7b13c8a8497c350", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 34, "text": "嘗以小故與甘寧忿爭，或以諫寧，寧曰：「臣子一例，征虜雖公子，何可專行侮人邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "bfe5d40a723fbe0136c309a436bbcdf6a0b77c758231463d5b20dde340b04a8f"}

{"id": "p_1f071321b86613b9", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 35, "text": "吾值明主，但當輸效力命，以報所天，誠不能隨俗屈典矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "edbdb08c7fbf6332d6c22a23e48c8a19ede77ea486898a31feaa15019c362b94"}

{"id": "p_51ede6647931db38", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 36, "text": "皎得書，上疏陳謝，遂與寧結厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "11a3ce9352bb53b402eccd28f39cf020a7381c6218cbeef1d2a560d9e085fea1"}

{"id": "p_588f0b525b3d8f3b", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 37, "text": "後呂蒙當襲南郡，權欲令皎與蒙為左右部大督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "57347905ab9dd7d1baca2dd95270d8dbc8c2ffb4117a974c3d86e48df9d3525a"}

{"id": "p_6f390de08fe704f7", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 38, "text": "蒙說權曰：「若至尊以征虜能，宜用之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "d7b43a30126f01c838d1a84493726fbe78e046396a37ecc33149c1172f2148ea"}

{"id": "p_29f6015e1b0cdbc2", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 39, "text": "昔周瑜、程普為左右部督，共攻匯陵，雖事決於瑜，普自恃久將，且俱是督，遂共不睦，幾敗國事，此目前之戒也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "969393fc46599fd930ea1bc03e7ea4d11b8eff44cd198e5b0282cdc124e58f46"}

{"id": "p_52d8581e0c8283a6", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」權寤，謝蒙曰：「以卿為大督，命皎為後繼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "21a264693129795a0026e40eda211cb59bbabb16bac90723127358df1f73c269"}

{"id": "p_3c5d16641f8d66a5", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 41, "text": "」禽關羽，定荊州，皖有力焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "8723a0f167f362445a7306ca28ea19f458db397cdd614e9ffd3799997961d6c4"}

{"id": "p_588aab87f00c3047", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 42, "text": "權追錄其功，封子胤為丹楊侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "fa89280f2b8fce7f176464fc37bf37408a489246f5dcfdbf9a4916e3f5d8d524"}

{"id": "p_72d75ce2fd8b08d9", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 43, "text": "弟咨、彌、儀，皆將軍，封侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "f6d424290c97d6e6993c6e4525226ce08ed2a612faba2bf59760d101f654d704"}

{"id": "p_d1a7c33edd99811d", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 44, "text": "咨為滕胤所殺，儀為孫峻所害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "fe28a1a503369b990274156769c8e4945d7e314f58adfe621917b072e216d456"}

{"id": "p_a913a7313ab80126", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 45, "text": "兄皎既卒，代統其眾，以揚武中郎將領江夏太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "76c5f089bad19a10aec1b46211171338d8c34b3e48ce8891414277a4a78219ec"}

{"id": "p_ba0110348374efe4", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 46, "text": "在事一年，遵皎舊跡，禮劉靖、李允、吳碩、張梁及江夏閭舉等，並納其善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "6986fbd03b9173e4fe4b5c5b45ff7b2b193397edca40fab6a28522129c20540f"}

{"id": "p_9d1dc509e84c50f4", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 47, "text": "奐訥於造次而敏於當宮，軍民稱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "8937fabb4ecbc88843f768a38005a5c4452cf176a07351298f43ff7d6d13751c"}

{"id": "p_59a90501f71c12cd", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 48, "text": "，權攻石陽，奐以地主，使所部將軍鮮于丹帥五千人先斷淮道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "343407b5855bef32a14aac7d1abd1d1f1c7a0533a33307b2478689036e5f9946"}

{"id": "p_173ea35a92f94911", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 49, "text": "自帥吳碩、張梁五千人為軍前鋒，降高城，得三將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "b27bcff43a828a95614a4d9c8bdcc2f0777ffae4f4a25c947e44599c04593ae7"}

{"id": "p_b313fd05931c43ca", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 50, "text": "大軍引還，權詔使在前住，駕過其軍，見奐軍陳整齊，權歎曰：「初吾憂其遲鈍，今治軍，諸將少能及者，吾無憂矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "f78e35b40b38e90c9924b7abafcb98a30140e91953bacb08c94ab10a03a2b7cd"}

{"id": "p_30bf6942a28cf220", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」拜揚威將軍，封沙羨侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "aa4ccb1a2940faf7af4d406c63f760ded777cbe43142c83fad2440d076d5f560"}

{"id": "p_a132bea0f3e19cce", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 52, "text": "吳碩、張梁皆裨將軍，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "95796b404acccc01201e02d457da52c154071f14627f40def1b716fd096fe8c3"}

{"id": "p_570ec9d3eae31394", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 53, "text": "奐亦愛樂儒生，覆命部曲子弟就業，後仕進朝廷者數十人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "3ec2eea3c1c8ae76325f4614dd1ede5ae0ad69f4192a751102a3a755c4741ca3"}

{"id": "p_6a0a18c12c71b20c", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 54, "text": "子承嗣，以昭武中郎將代統兵，領郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "c02b5d8374973203723d2deb08f25fe099b53b1af277f97f0d4fa8cdfceda8d8"}

{"id": "p_0ae6a91975beedbb", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 55, "text": "卒，無子，封承庶弟壹奉奐後，襲業為將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "054ffd34cf0d7ea6f3158a73c6e840f0687be7e047f37c71ea85f09e8e3600fc"}

{"id": "p_1a58f9140bcfa846", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 56, "text": "孫峻之誅諸葛恪也，壹與全熙、施績攻恪弟公安督融，融自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "0e1261ef23d2fec892a9a95e67947f8f5543951eecc7262db5eef779766e1758"}

{"id": "p_41a025f6edf651eb", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 57, "text": "壹從鎮南遷鎮軍，假節督夏口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "c71e0d40bbddd93c62f494c99194ed164c67da31093c0f6fef591d767b8c99e9"}

{"id": "p_8c64db6c941e2555", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 58, "text": "及孫綝誅滕胤、呂據，據、胤皆壹皆之妹夫也，壹弟封又知胤、據謀，自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "110007b7486ca50c5c0d618ea66acbff9647bceba9342c793d78d7261674b74e"}

{"id": "p_26c2d1103e421d93", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 59, "text": "異至武昌，壹知其攻己，率部曲千餘口過將胤妻奔魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "b3c199769c9e2bb0fb34a6efa099ad676bd8019800864391227d3252426697f8"}

{"id": "p_67bf83591aaa874c", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 60, "text": "魏以壹為車騎將軍、儀同三司，封吳侯，以故主芳貴人邢氏妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "767e071c4c761b5958e46d679a0f6c56c38d043fa88237900207e42ee1bcd68a"}

{"id": "p_059007554dbae16c", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 61, "text": "邢美色妒忌，下不堪命，遂共殺壹及邢氏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "7d53cdc3323419008fd1b92e623f97529327e39040eff060795310216de949fe"}

{"id": "p_ca1f23e3fabe3694", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 62, "text": "孫賁字伯陽；父羌字聖〔臺〕，堅同產兄也，賁早失二親，弟輔嬰孩，賁自贍育，友愛甚篤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "7fa5d223fb954e134f798da72753e5e9380ac44389591d4a0ef026515a5a243b"}

{"id": "p_978f81a96df67d05", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 63, "text": "堅於長沙舉義兵，賁去吏從征伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "590d16ccb049eede8ce24b4064d47e79ef90f70e255b4c1834efeea9fb8c388f"}

{"id": "p_f809f3ebb08207cc", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 64, "text": "堅薨，賁攝帥餘眾，扶送靈柩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "9211fcfdcc06942ceef68f826b5e814b8e991cf14e03e0bdc2fa223a0d6229dc"}

{"id": "p_f9a4cfd7c2987fe5", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 65, "text": "後袁術徙壽春，賁又依之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "b8e2f3fdcdc5a683c8d8af80a9d4775eef98f852005dcd3b6098fde36b13c6f2"}

{"id": "p_478d4f054a8b20a1", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 66, "text": "術從兄紹用會稽周昂為九江太守，紹與術不協，術遣賁攻破昂於陰陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "b487383b2c1798ea9b1d74fc134aa0be04d8f1568672d38159cce9fb9f38628d"}

{"id": "p_e9830465d14b2438", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 67, "text": "術表賁領豫州刺史，轉丹楊都尉，行征虜將軍，討平山越。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "b840d9a45ade5589adadac998fc4d25b070af126cabafe24c3b0122bce36c719"}

{"id": "p_9b56ade2e6ded4f0", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 68, "text": "為楊州刺史劉繇所迫逐，因將士眾還住歷陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "147c19f64ee619f50f8d9cf0f8eecd6a8be82edd28a6e012cebf97ad7f438f16"}

{"id": "p_b4e39f4896649fe3", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 69, "text": "頃之，術復使賁與吳景共擊樊能、張英等，未能拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "e3fdd1fbb85b3284903191180cee1d9e60415e2c6f51c777e4832810474d3a7c"}

{"id": "p_5f77b4b99cb5694b", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 70, "text": "及策東渡，助賁、景破英、能等，遂進擊劉繇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "fba62dc04cdfa437bf280068ef93b32ba6d087fcbece836cbafd7ff4e63c8a51"}

{"id": "p_1ebc45e206a0964c", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 71, "text": "策遣賁、景還壽春報術，值術僭號，署置百官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "9eb20644e27583e4ebe98ec325ed8317fdc1ca6970322e8f9197b9912b3a9cb8"}

{"id": "p_bd6164308064c5eb", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 72, "text": "時策已平吳、會二郡，賁與策征廬江太守劉勳、江夏太守黃祖，軍旋，聞繇病死，過定豫章，上賁領太守，後封都亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "903f07457c74ab4d382999f7c0762f9a12c801c3e4dd557f5c160603da4c173a"}

{"id": "p_41e1acbe90ed3bad", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 73, "text": "，使者劉隱奉詔拜賁為征虜將軍，領郡如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "51ee1d13021db1e90a556a8ccc45aaac74d723aaa72d28e9da2e2120ce40c3bb"}

{"id": "p_d190d0f48b5db82b", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 74, "text": "鄰年九歲，代領豫章，近封都鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "4832d972529a47c185c2995dc94cfe6829c3857997557288b1caff1dffc9b44d"}

{"id": "p_1a7ea42bc6de4f2c", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 75, "text": "在郡垂二十年，討平叛賊，功績修理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "314d534d200316fdd98544807c604f8d598913978b2df132d796b0c057e6ba05"}

{"id": "p_c3a67613b1551f16", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 76, "text": "時太常潘浚掌荊州事，重安長陳留舒燮有罪下獄，浚嘗失燮，欲置之於法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "80ce73c362a5d962f7006625ac55663ebf0990199bedee0d38fcf3147c747b7d"}

{"id": "p_3399d7e057de6613", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 77, "text": "論者多為有言，浚猶不釋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "bd342fe1cb469b6c730094beda2a220d3c00431c7ea20dcf6d2f2eb9015473aa"}

{"id": "p_73376f274d501148", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 78, "text": "鄰謂浚曰：\"舒伯膺兄弟爭死，海內義之，以為美談，仲膺又奉國舊意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "900a663e0734af4529e6422e66685459c304a0a43048a4ce7999d5bb48d1f7b4"}

{"id": "p_83890ebb1d5d6683", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 79, "text": "今君殺其子弟，若天下一統，青蓋北巡，中州士人必問仲膺繼嗣，答者雲潘承明殺燮，於事何如?\"浚意即解，燮用得濟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "efcf7ecc3973ce17160f85e283f3bc5d75fbfb41b2f726be148a0976e4ab7572"}

{"id": "p_62a7d1a56972c443", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 80, "text": "鄰遷夏口沔中督、威遠將軍，所居任職。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "b4380b40d4db6e8fe26fce95c9efe3476a306245deb5120dc08cd9d89314a11c"}

{"id": "p_b8644c1e0ef104f4", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 81, "text": "苗弟旅及叔父安、熙、績，皆歷列位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "e690002c6e8b9041a0db6ccefbca1791fa61b18f59f3bc951ddc8202d4657d5b"}

{"id": "p_cf21f852ce7e5532", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 82, "text": "孫輔字國儀，賁弟也，以揚武校尉佐孫策平三郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "fca646d68a020500ec02dbcaa3c88ba0c0e2aecba5a095185b6ea39fad181a8d"}

{"id": "p_1573e3af620344d4", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 83, "text": "策討丹楊七縣，使輔西屯歷陽以拒袁術，並招誘余民，鳩合遺散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "e4acc6bad5d8e4097ed11e45777015bd52edc771238b02ec4ce3f91fec3c1722"}

{"id": "p_9d545db265907a00", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 84, "text": "又從策討陵陽，生得祖郎等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "aada51ce2686e1c69ad42c098787c7c4f470903aaf016d35da51351d704d0b6e"}

{"id": "p_ef7be458246964ce", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 85, "text": "策西襲廬江太守劉勳，輔隨從，身先士卒，有功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "47208e31255310bebc09530a602da0f789fd2ff815a26a0f9810d7e59853b89c"}

{"id": "p_78dab722b7113e07", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 86, "text": "策立輔為廬陵太守，撫定屬城，分置長吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "67348e6c0ef3b1f75689064cb836f6443e1a024b3e536425d49dcb6d1c831116"}

{"id": "p_25a57078d56d1f5b", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 87, "text": "遷平南將軍，假節領交州刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "6eddd674edaaf044f2ff5b8213b3c55a8c38382cec22430a4c6ba7102657d8c9"}

{"id": "p_cab9572831116d8f", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 88, "text": "遣使與曹公相聞，事覺，權幽系之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "5edc8db27a2bef4053547e7657d071d0b0f0975375a4be58570fd4dcd09e3ecc"}

{"id": "p_ef3757975e087c2c", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 89, "text": "子興、昭、偉、昕，皆歷列位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "ae62636df6b0508896484ad8eb799bf9dee6e24909c2e7970d53158d1fc87e2b"}

{"id": "p_7d62559233ebee1c", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 90, "text": "孫翊字叔弼，權弟也，驍悍果烈，有兄策風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "93ab3023bef90b0f2f0f0f06197ea22164c316a2b114d1b3a64d38a77036d7ab"}

{"id": "p_43fbe2027fce18f1", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 91, "text": "太守朱治舉孝廉，司空辟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "fa071a875eabfea9bd7c66f377a8ec997e1c968a3b3b2bd8f3074df08bf0a97c"}

{"id": "p_afa9216c73fbcb34", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 92, "text": "，以偏將軍領丹楊太守，時年二十。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "19199e9bc16c7b7a5f7a696bd4a33801d07273c5c0c46ddda71815b964481702"}

{"id": "p_0f5a78d7e0cb4a66", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 93, "text": "後卒為左右邊鴻所殺，鴻亦即誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "6bf89d253b50a7eb3b47420782593c9752ecb37e784bba9c1c8c4ef81ae82b63"}

{"id": "p_c3764141c443a27c", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 94, "text": "子松為射聲校尉、都鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "2dc0281113cd7ee63dc3641da2e39096ff58fdb6bb63d750879a3cdd19c752ee"}

{"id": "p_241ba989a949600a", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 95, "text": "蜀丞相諸葛亮與兄瑾書曰：“既受東朝厚遇，依依於子弟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "e645fbd2a1c16cb4610bb7dc99be0fb4e2a835afa9d1413cb7e95b7db8efdc8a"}

{"id": "p_97fcdf65149b3f67", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 96, "text": "見其所與亮器物，感用流涕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "6dc283f9bccb27f30407793e71ee25afd62c62f4c14dfc11f1880e1bd178e0ce"}

{"id": "p_6a78b86fdf2fd1e4", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 97, "text": "”其悼松如此，由亮養子喬咨述故雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "5e858eaadac6b8bd60b7e2711031347917b8500ac1b09e288aa1921b6f0c10f0"}

{"id": "p_cee9e7c6ddda2dcf", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 98, "text": "舉孝廉茂才，未試用，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "e1aa28d2e6cc4a6ea11e11cd7926df471d0bcdf923d2b4863ecacb5c12e0e4c0"}

{"id": "p_c9ec4dafd436bbaa", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 99, "text": "子泰，曹氏之甥也，為長水校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "2510ae31b7e85ceb0ec81131bf19e6fd894074d4dac2279fb2fe8752c366f58a"}

{"id": "p_2d4fd577d44049ab", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 100, "text": "，從權圍新城，中流矢死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "3d33fa0f87e4d2ea6c81ba2639fb0206ea39c9724a4ce1c6a2c9a79e31cea687"}
