{"id": "p_bcb5b5de03a59ef8", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 101, "text": "泰子秀為前將軍、夏口督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "bd48e04effd50bfb4b9bf4c4acea1da8f6a06d9492c7f6d4dc2b6a1214e13a22"}

{"id": "p_c0e40260b2fb61e6", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 102, "text": "秀公室至親，握兵在外，皓意不能平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "9fa158ae8bbd0100830dfb5c3d92fb872595d74ee8e8c79c91aeaa9c555ea654"}

{"id": "p_29bd34ae11cfa802", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 103, "text": "，皓遣何定將五千人至夏口獵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "63d65abbc562b18a5caf88bf9b149c323d534b32a436307e0a9a15e7c2711a9d"}

{"id": "p_e6f9a0aff9ea9813", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 104, "text": "先是，民間歛言秀當見圖，而定遠獵，秀遂驚，夜將妻子親兵數百人奔晉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "7e3f8fe5f289cad7704526b613d882cb66d06f7d65d6f0528dd5507c669800fa"}

{"id": "p_8e9ff07997e783b3", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 105, "text": "晉以秀為驃騎將軍、儀同三司，封會稽公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "643a906ca5ce94ffc0707227cfd94fc1c6f9219fd04a28f62893b73ec4ec9e3b"}

{"id": "p_a820b31d01058f18", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 106, "text": "伯父河，字伯海，本姓俞氏，亦吳人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "fddda88c2d0490582f1e9a47fb3c20920b1dc56a2b965a32834405c2fdead565"}

{"id": "p_2b637e37fca907fc", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 107, "text": "孫策愛之，賜姓為孫，列之屬籍，後為將軍，屯京城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "6e46c8a2ba84475ad386b7c555bb00bb2ce338ba9c6cc273626945dc445cc3a7"}

{"id": "p_cdf1429cf86bd213", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 108, "text": "初，孫權殺吳郡太守盛憲，憲故孝廉媯覽、戴員亡匿山中，孫翊為丹楊，皆禮致之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "88967861cca864dbdc0df739350fe6262892d03af88dfd56b5d35364c0ebc564"}

{"id": "p_8ebd816ca46b6131", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 109, "text": "覽為大都督督兵，員為郡丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "2a39ff967f5b2d17cc33f2a5cead9506b7c3aa9efd22bc86f115ea2269b62140"}

{"id": "p_dda9a44b8e4c5368", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 110, "text": "及翊遇害，河馳赴宛陵，責怒覽、員，以不能全權，令使奸變得施。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "c3510b295e8daea7c2c6f039b1fe0a0a21b5169ac9a73ba1762d7c696d12bb79"}

{"id": "p_be77ec4deff26c0d", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 111, "text": "二人議曰：\"伯海與將軍疏遠，而責我乃耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "3f75b3d26ae0f3ee25b243030b999e95fe5d1e20a18902df927b607fdccd541c"}

{"id": "p_cf0306b6bb857f34", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 112, "text": "\"遂殺河，使人北迎揚州刺史劉馥，令住歷陽，以丹陽應之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "7d0b418176d4a032c843dde43b8acfcd813bd0f8e57542797d924e5b4a80992c"}

{"id": "p_d08db65285b3c136", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 113, "text": "會翊帳下徐元、孫高、傅嬰等殺覽、員。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "e0e2cfd04f5eebe433014fcd4e8b25c7e191ced27ec820defda249c969acb423"}

{"id": "p_23d9567047910a14", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 114, "text": "韶年十七，收河餘眾，繕治京城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "650015fc9894cc8c18e941604987b78ac49c53645839cbd886f3de3ef9ca9d9f"}

{"id": "p_9fd4eb5330b84dbb", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 115, "text": "權聞亂，從椒丘還，過定丹楊，引軍歸吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "5a257c2d0ef54bf89fb60ffb3398acd1f69f63609339c3203f42a10a7ece3762"}

{"id": "p_ce807eb907cae934", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 116, "text": "夜至京城下營，試攻驚之，兵皆乘城傳檄備警，歡聲動地，頗射外人，權使曉喻乃止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "7e88afd4a8719812ffff8a59736c028e398fbd73066eba6bbd6c2c371d26430a"}

{"id": "p_b4702433c5557d54", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 117, "text": "即拜承烈校尉，統河部曲，食曲阿、丹徒二縣，自置長吏，一如河舊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "cadb267d6fad72d8546e7ae80340f9b3892f43468eda353cf51afd5733d10bdd"}

{"id": "p_2e654779ddd041bf", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 118, "text": "權為吳王，遷揚威將軍，封建德侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "44d652669f17bae536dd1e8d1c5f07903c6d3ef5eb1c1d028d40596c770fb392"}

{"id": "p_490a5e33c3d6a939", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 119, "text": "韶為邊將數十年，善養士卒，得其死力。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "fadc2efbc88174094a21f4b4d414a74ca997bc9cbb466a678bc7e5a3b88f2063"}

{"id": "p_0907c352d463d7bd", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 120, "text": "常以警疆場遠斥候為務，先知動靜而為之備，故鮮有負敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "488c4c0025ad6279194b12137a727e9dab9bf4fa45f58d37e6cbcd23b8aa032e"}

{"id": "p_2b40bce9a7c5eacb", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 121, "text": "青、徐、汝、沛頗來歸附，淮南濱江屯候皆徹兵遠徙，徐、泗、江、淮之地，不居者各數百里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "a3328ffe432706663763094cf42c41a26e0da4a4d8cf5b063b6bc12462fa2a53"}

{"id": "p_c819a61c808040ea", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 122, "text": "自權西征，還都武昌，韶不進見者十餘年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "b8b60ba3aadfd0c86800a574642c2cb2c3420f9942dd38b911f5e9439c32d48e"}

{"id": "p_596723477fd276ca", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 123, "text": "權問青、徐諸屯要害，遠近人馬眾寡，魏將帥姓名，盡具識之，有問鹹對。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "1aee1521bfb61984d65b160d07a8e6e0cee1c59971005150c8c039e45f34f1aa"}

{"id": "p_c1858812cf985da5", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 124, "text": "權歡悅曰：\"吾久不見公禮，不圖進益乃爾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "ebcdfda4e7516821625aaaad12790479736e8e6218d3d13cd9d4c65379c70a37"}

{"id": "p_59f897f1625d8aa9", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 125, "text": "子越嗣，至右將軍，越兄楷武衛大將軍、臨成侯，代越為京下督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "3679100d02b3f329af277647244de279256a7ce907a10edce2abba8470aa8064"}

{"id": "p_fee11dfb9cfe9f29", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 126, "text": "楷弟異至領軍將軍，奕宗正卿，恢武陵太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "c9257a2f456b026ee9334d54726bd43ad1cd2d10e71e1dca085c1fb34fbf6dd8"}

{"id": "p_4a0cdc1fa5a5cac8", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 127, "text": "，征楷為宮下鎮驃騎將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "eab62f742dde1dbbd16c62968b8630b437125257ff60e23a34c156afe79e2c91"}

{"id": "p_55366d159893f506", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 128, "text": "初永安賊施但等劫皓弟謙，襲建業，或白楷二端不即赴討者，皓數遣詰楷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "62237cafad115ed48acf39c331c24066366bccae65ec0f9864c4a40342caa19f"}

{"id": "p_ee2afd0a75a6a295", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 129, "text": "楷常惶怖，而卒被召，遂將妻子親兵數百人歸晉，晉以為車騎將軍，封丹楊侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "8c90a981ed23e87ed8f54a5601ae6f70de54b889652d08f8e7e9be5fab270842"}

{"id": "p_c69a65e5d529e9cf", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 130, "text": "年二十五，拜安東中郎將，與陸遜共拒劉備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "a332cf36f9045b8dee06eeddb6d750e2cba271a006829cd146d5795a5955a811"}

{"id": "p_180632dc6fe70a68", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 131, "text": "備軍眾甚盛，彌山盈谷，桓投力奮命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "05372be39c6d5f0feed25f19d57af087e7dc571e10cd05428c87be8cffb4d392"}

{"id": "p_222f4e3e22beb2a3", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 132, "text": "桓斬上（兜）（夔）道，截其徑要。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "e1d19f00b1ff9afc8b5276a67b2280a00e83e2594747f4a391c81c55089ee692"}

{"id": "p_17be82e2414d1a6c", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 133, "text": "備逾山越險，僅乃得免，忿恚歎曰：“吾昔初至京城，桓尚小兒，而今迫孤乃至此也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "4ee0f93ee03ae071ceb6d77d67d05c70879239a790cb5c092d201e360e184894"}

{"id": "p_9a975b79c73124a0", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 134, "text": "”桓以功拜建武將軍，封丹徒侯，下督牛港，作橫江塢，會卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "bcbc566300311189aae13c5fd505778e84f0a228af220ad94daeb7f5191ce9c6"}

{"id": "p_08d297f44f8c6533", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 135, "text": "評曰：夫親親恩義，古今之常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "4dda0584b8a1056fb5515cb895995062ff8c0657d90d3ec3bc1b9ab9a0aab92d"}

{"id": "p_012bba0a532ea40e", "source_id": "src_d031fc1c9d32785f", "ordinal": 136, "text": "況此諸孫，或贊興初基，或鎮據邊陲，克堪厥任，不忝其榮者乎!故詳著雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "6c0db3ef8b91b9f759b9fd569114c91657b51ee416ba17c01dc15fc317e15010"}

{"id": "p_12aa0a2cdc890e3f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 0, "text": "少好學，善隸書，從白侯子安受《左氏春秋》，博覽眾書，與琅邪趙昱、東海王朗俱發名友善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "84cb1d0b87aebebada7ae30952eb7d9dddd794da17d72304024b04caf515d926"}

{"id": "p_936a12275018e85e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 1, "text": "與朗共論舊君諱事，州裡才士陳琳等皆稱善之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "8d67d158394270813bb3618f288008e8ec3e5f740dcfdd9ea50e93aaa4bb4eed"}

{"id": "p_2add522d31e1c51a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 2, "text": "刺史陶謙舉茂才，不應，謙以爲輕己，遂見拘執。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "55b6ec614b625acbcbaedca9afc96cb03d5542dbf9514d4fd4e97a0fc71753a1"}

{"id": "p_1ce4844f4b3ca997", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 3, "text": "漢末大亂，徐方士民多避難揚土，昭皆南渡江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "6acf040637148c44d7c75012cc1024cda0746649ca069a1f70e3867846e5a2c5"}

{"id": "p_dd6d8a6dbc6b635d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 4, "text": "孫策創業，命昭爲長史、撫軍中郎將，升堂拜母，如比肩之舊，文武之事，一以委昭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "678889a42649120dd50319a63dd8320b751c3f1ce6720de41399f496a3ce4a6c"}

{"id": "p_b37f4889d0704283", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 5, "text": "昭每得北方士大夫書疏，專歸美於昭，昭欲嘿而不宣則懼有私，宣之則恐非宜，進退不安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "5848aa16b8739999c8e56e0a93077cad7390a3e68ae7f2f431ddd75dfbba06b7"}

{"id": "p_1acdfc26a59f3ac3", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 6, "text": "策聞之，歡笑曰：\"昔管仲相齊，一則仲父，二則仲父，而桓公爲霸者宗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "092bc698528dfcaadd38d4a1b5a8c0f7d4d74b01954d9b11235f19ca38ee9adc"}

{"id": "p_811be14135a3cc94", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 7, "text": "今子布賢，我能用之，其功名獨不在我乎!\"，", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "73a8bfa44c942e40b6b9fdaad784e4d397f1d4dc84225fc58d0925c69e47b215"}

{"id": "p_e6a4eda685973a65", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 8, "text": "策臨亡，以弟權托昭，昭率群僚立而輔之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "1731ca34e1eb876983d7a6958a5e41d1288c8b1e44017d7c6a7c90f2e8a58822"}

{"id": "p_66858622c6bc8f10", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 9, "text": "上表漢室，下移屬城，中外將校，各令奉職，權悲感未視事，昭謂權曰：\"夫爲人後者，貴能負荷先軌，克昌堂構，以成勳業也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "13741f0768766be2c8686f6b0f5378fafed532628668f7e714240f4230c17ba8"}

{"id": "p_cc0f25bbfb338373", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 10, "text": "方今天下鼎沸，群盜滿山，孝廉何得寢伏哀戚，肆匹夫之情哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "4c8cecbd509b7205f3cc4511002cb7aa903a1ffce83c53d123cbda743fb33619"}

{"id": "p_96774d5aac02b84e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 11, "text": "\"乃身自扶權上馬，陳兵而出，然後眾心知有所歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "2516bcc6f82596fef541569dd8178772d6e5fde19a44a7719fe37cbebf1b5b7b"}

{"id": "p_5dc7c53241fadf8e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 12, "text": "昭復爲權長史，授任如前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "fcecc9a70479dfbec7ff85e1ca0ea8469fdfd054128d3c947c6c684073c360d9"}

{"id": "p_cf7ece0dea8e8c3b", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 13, "text": "後劉備表權行車騎將軍，昭爲軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "dba0d38557e943bd74b37bbda61550436853ad2044e3a83527a54316d571843f"}

{"id": "p_0ff9a1906b91be69", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 14, "text": "權每田獵，常乘馬射虎，虎常突前攀持馬鞍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "ca166a2f6a9f32a52bf70d184446f70c1f1fe312f5f2e883ebfd95dec82ac293"}

{"id": "p_9c0dad59f328082e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 15, "text": "昭變色而前曰：\"將軍何有當爾?夫爲人君者，謂能駕御英雄，驅使群賢，豈謂馳逐於原野，校勇於猛獸者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "a43d6fa25e8b4c7377ce759c44445ea4edcf43745f2159b79415be23a79162bb"}

{"id": "p_9b14befd921eb957", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 16, "text": "如有一旦之患，奈天下笑何?\"權謝昭曰：\"年少慮事不遠，以此慚君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "c0976de870de3e935ac36d5aa122ba3aad2fbc4f4a21f4b7f286f9d08327ec0e"}

{"id": "p_84389b16ec2cdab2", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 17, "text": "\"然猶不能已，乃作射虎車，爲方目，間不置蓋，一人爲御，自於中射之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "dfafb3c07d7e77301d40dc5996fc6d1eb16158d849624eddbc32466fea8e4a10"}

{"id": "p_983413c17cab9b18", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 18, "text": "時有逸群之獸，輒復犯車，而權每手擊以爲樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "dd41a0a8482831010fa61006c6d4314f81797296fa2433705b764c32ff556f00"}

{"id": "p_8978a93faf361cf3", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 19, "text": "魏黃初二年，遣使者邢貞拜權爲呉王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "31019a9a068657d3b368a1f3ef530d3b61fcbd2b1e11252845b24cc312e2c202"}

{"id": "p_f6beaabff36c2343", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 20, "text": "昭謂貞曰：\"夫禮無不敬，故法無不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "5fc3eaafeb69a1f3ba24bb4327f76b9c55573e7ad0dda6dec40522cb283c7606"}

{"id": "p_5944cba250734767", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 21, "text": "而君敢自尊大，豈以江南寡弱，無方寸之刃故乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "0b5d474c89a7a4e0c31dea6ebdd3fabf234d02b56541743e835c448da3a95cc1"}

{"id": "p_0a50961c540aab69", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 22, "text": "拜昭爲綏遠將軍，封由拳侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "3061a7998f3dd749fff580cd0ad53f11b6471109abe3cd535ddea15adc294921"}

{"id": "p_933382851377a1dd", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 23, "text": "權於武昌，臨釣台，飲酒大醉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "c347c826b4e32189fb1c3b26e17c7a288f096c568736629035feef4342f2ad31"}

{"id": "p_6786e9558acd22b0", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 24, "text": "權使人以水灑群臣曰：\"今日酣飲，惟醉墮台中，乃當止耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "c1abb84f7913ddef75c9fcf01d47b17bda05ac160fd60a52e8996a050c4a8d8a"}

{"id": "p_6e1d4740dc230e20", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 25, "text": "\"昭正色不言，出外車中坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "763520705fb695cdf0d5c65ea82ba217f045719132eec275a3d4ecaba5cbf2a4"}

{"id": "p_1d46c5aa197474ce", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 26, "text": "權遣人呼昭還，謂曰：\"爲共作樂耳，公何爲怒乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "f2b41a978f412dc6aef2dcf6987d5c173bb3b6afbc0f83c84159fb2e2817045d"}

{"id": "p_a3be18e66179a3ac", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 27, "text": "\"昭對曰：\"昔紂爲糟丘酒池長夜之飲，當時亦以爲樂，不以爲惡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "9fa25a53109a6de2dcde856d81600f548c964e468936051849e53b2cba57cd34"}

{"id": "p_11f8dd9d4241eb6a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 28, "text": "初，權當置丞相，眾議歸昭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "398946cf412c0a2dab49d8780e925a7d9394b5a8b0e845e224da026c75e61534"}

{"id": "p_dd25d3128ad0717d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 29, "text": "權曰：\"方今多事，職統者責重，非所以優之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "dcc049fc5ec4648f7ee2ac5d58e5851843d044216d85e1b51ffea456581da4ed"}

{"id": "p_e87f5c13829da7ff", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 30, "text": "\"後孫邵卒，百寮復舉昭，權曰：\"孤豈爲子布有愛乎?領丞相事煩，而此公性剛，所言不從，怨咎將興，非所以益之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "84e691555f54dbb5a6d61c1e0e855ec487865fa032c8f086dae70fbca18414ab"}

{"id": "p_a3f72239f4a8c3df", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 31, "text": "權既稱尊號，昭以老病，上還官位及所統領。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "52680c7110307654a36b4c3fdee4f1ba6b15a85e8882c28cf6caa7c4bf71f999"}

{"id": "p_e7645e67f9c128b1", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 32, "text": "更拜輔呉將軍，班亞三司，改封婁侯，食邑萬戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "7924082bccb2afaeacfcc2ef9ae4e0c7ad9e34d9d01b97a07a910d5c62ec318f"}

{"id": "p_6c660f0376b3f0f1", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 33, "text": "在裡宅無事，乃著《春秋左氏傳》解及《論語》注。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "8ea7751037894228fef5839af08488e2e53416e766cec40c122fab199520de12"}

{"id": "p_3aecbac064ff8202", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 34, "text": "權嘗問衞尉嚴畯：\"寧念小時所暗書不？", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "57fc76f1f568f22e2677ea470e0c1ff70320e37a88881299c4f62e6f7a958d62"}

{"id": "p_0fd714da95fe8261", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 35, "text": "\"畯因誦《孝經》\"仲尼居\"。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "79fe28f06717f5d5d1301d03b186a2a5fe0be0a1d380c06843171e6e4091a2ef"}

{"id": "p_97839a1379c78025", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 36, "text": "昭曰：\"嚴畯鄙生，臣請爲陛下誦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "ce1499306ae4e8b07248a3069846f0c9373e40bf24ca8fbdea339408ad38d3ee"}

{"id": "p_25a25fbd875e8ca3", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 37, "text": "\"乃誦\"君子之事上\"，鹹以昭爲知所誦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "5b6350826e2921e0debbdcfa481805c9b206fdb7de5677fbb6d87f9f1f1ae0c6"}

{"id": "p_c21e3319b2d8f7f1", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 38, "text": "昭每朝見，辭氣壯厲，義形於色，曾以直言逆旨，中不進見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "f6d4fd620a692c217530b8a3c148f0bce446deda912f5988e4a1c505747ae454"}

{"id": "p_c9493eeaad998ad0", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 39, "text": "後蜀使來，稱蜀德美，而群臣莫拒，權歎曰：\"使張公在坐，彼不折則廢，安復自誇乎?\"明日，遣中使勞問，因請見昭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "fceb4c59abcbeed8d0aba8bb9dd749dee70c302565f6bab88833c1927959bb85"}

{"id": "p_95602c4ddb89236b", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 40, "text": "昭坐定，仰曰：\"昔太后、桓王不以老臣屬陛下，而以陛下屬老臣，是以思盡臣節，以報厚恩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "d3f5e4035c70a28677845d6791db40d1ba4e936c50a8a9c63e228455dc2914a1"}

{"id": "p_b454fc843983f2ee", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 41, "text": "使泯沒之後，有可稱述，而意慮淺短，違逆盛旨，自分幽淪，長棄溝壑，不圖復蒙引見，得奉帷幄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "d984db6bfbb69e6ce3fd0ca4ff4a91d4689ac98bb962e97f98f4488252c3e280"}

{"id": "p_0dbc38f18de89d53", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 42, "text": "然臣愚心所以事國，志在忠益，畢命而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "a4b58b4a44abb91998606cc59204e4b1cf6e09689ceb05806497b97cca63303e"}

{"id": "p_222a827b01b23830", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 43, "text": "若乃變心易慮，以偷榮取容，此臣所不能也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "4dac0a3cc5d57089d96f3dcda1f0c8181da8c4e85220269ae52b88ed0cc4690e"}

{"id": "p_c63db058aa728ed6", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 44, "text": "權以公孫淵稱藩，遣張彌、許晏至遼東拜淵爲燕王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "f720258573685a71ca5bb3f9b69b49a7476234ea8d66b3e915f58513efcec8ad"}

{"id": "p_4123b6d4abeb36aa", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 45, "text": "昭諫曰：\"淵背魏懼討，遠來求援，非本志也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "d196e5cee1bcb48780069160da0ce87e4881f7e1451fc8c6d2a89b595cbb9ae0"}

{"id": "p_7f76c338b2c5258e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 46, "text": "若淵改圖，欲自明於魏，兩使不反，不亦取笑於天下乎?\"權與相反覆，昭意彌切。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "c0fbd9ccc18282c9b6f9a9631c1d58fe05c05a3d1b5e891f06e61e4cdc2546ba"}

{"id": "p_bd7df3638632dd95", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 47, "text": "權不能堪，案刀而怒曰：\"呉國士人入宮則拜孤，出宮則拜君，孤之敬君，亦爲至矣，而數於眾中折孤，孤嘗恐失計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "771997171dca269faaef8154cff063f1de191c3ac19671541f78c2a027e97e83"}

{"id": "p_feab8b0e1faa2048", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 48, "text": "\"昭熟視權曰：\"臣雖知言不用，每竭愚忠者，誠以太后臨崩，呼老臣於床下，遺詔顧命之言故在耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "72cbb87cbf4fdd27660180e5122af2b7d1bfc36f5a984040f56ca472083e5898"}

{"id": "p_aadfaf539830a9a3", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 49, "text": "昭忿言之不用，稱疾不朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "d38254ffe26dbc20d456c0770fc4c315f9f8684d93ab418938e09c34a181f7da"}

{"id": "p_529ecefe2e6fd6fb", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 50, "text": "權恨之，土塞其門，昭又於內以土封之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "b99e0febae0ea87de42b9656f1aeb880203b6f000891eb8dc38e2d71e470f241"}

{"id": "p_f5c34c54b0fc95e5", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 51, "text": "權數慰謝昭，昭固不起，權因出過其門呼昭，昭辭疾篤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "977fdf446151beeff49dd3039089ffdf1a75b7e65daa33aaa569714553301765"}

{"id": "p_0d756291a10cd98a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 52, "text": "權燒其門，欲以恐之，昭更閉門戸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "5ac3428f733de05c7f0caa995a6972fdeefc0c84779e4b1d0b1def1114221c0f"}

{"id": "p_2c81fdcd4f5c6152", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 53, "text": "權使人滅火，住門良久，昭諸子共扶昭起，權載以還宮，深自克責。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "2a3e105a9d62238335fb81dde1e44c36046d02db776a80f69755463df5b46a56"}

{"id": "p_aeb1b99597c9cd28", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 54, "text": "昭容貌矜嚴，有威風，權常曰：\"孤與張公言，不敢妄也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "d54bbd7e543972ae8a596f0d4990d34b4a8f2bc5984ee136f69bb071fa3e5790"}

{"id": "p_1d548c54f47a33fa", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 55, "text": "遺令幅巾素棺，斂以時服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "6b290a887632b8f456aa7ddc3413b7c70ce307ec792d3489d7e4dc3b1024219b"}

{"id": "p_2c85c4327d1de28a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 56, "text": "長子承已自封侯，少子休襲爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "201c70fa6c0a4889a28404a6069873218b60b16f98a53a901802cf8045f67b7c"}

{"id": "p_147471afd3cbf21d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 57, "text": "昭弟子奮年二十，造作攻城大攻車，爲歩騭所薦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "163ef4aef7a1e766b13ee7453f1056186fc6f0a3d7e32af530b262c802132ff2"}

{"id": "p_aeba3d2432085cfd", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 58, "text": "昭不願曰：\"妝年尚少，何爲自委於軍旅乎?\"奮對曰：\"昔童汪死難，子奇治阿，奮實不才耳，於年不爲少也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "100bc58375f47da83fdd21d674c1514c418d2bbabe554d46a4919462318ac41c"}

{"id": "p_19a4d3684463ed10", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 59, "text": "\"遂領兵爲將軍，連有功效，至（平州）都督，封樂鄕亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "b836ab339d5f40419add89c71078aaacd3d5e554b4a91b474992dc49a28cfc4f"}

{"id": "p_6f2d84289947e7c8", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 60, "text": "承字仲嗣，少以才學知名，與諸葛瑾、歩騭、嚴畯相友善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "606f5276ead29cf7fbe511b9292deeedb1954500a1c822cf9416ca5f146dc5b1"}

{"id": "p_8a232a6313f93571", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 61, "text": "權爲驃騎將軍，辟西曹掾，出爲長沙西部都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "40031b84b0ab14f6f933b3f53ce2f65e0409d415f3f29e98f127c49f0d321d9e"}

{"id": "p_18437a12d983b3ae", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 62, "text": "討平山寇，得精兵萬五千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "0843dca60acfc8573cbed04b480392c6d4b86af80fb7a89f8f515661f5865de6"}

{"id": "p_a271f2e94cf315b1", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 63, "text": "後爲濡須都督、奮威將軍，封都鄕侯，領部曲五千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "f60a50d9181fa221939e893c64af868ee312f894c866b30e99536d32489cb044"}

{"id": "p_e4bc892056a5de13", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 64, "text": "承爲人壯毅忠讜，能甄識人物，拔彭城蔡款、南陽謝景於孤微童幼，後並爲國士，款至衞尉，景豫章太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "89c4f319a8e732518d786c7e3be08e74b9b7c2869c3f4fca0daa3b3c2514845f"}

{"id": "p_367162134140dd97", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 65, "text": "又諸葛恪年少時，眾人奇其英才。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "3f33787dc5460fc1bc08345eedaea3cd5af9b4d4de5d2625cfdcae9afbc75c60"}

{"id": "p_ae57568fd39a075a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 66, "text": "承言終敗諸葛氏者，元遜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "a9514b986e7df24a07df5207cc7b04da34416fe6b1ec43c559b5914b14f4c549"}

{"id": "p_e95c3667f1628022", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 67, "text": "勤於長進，篤於物類，凡在庶幾之流，無不造門，年六十七，卒，謚曰定侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "a01808da077b5af3eb9645b0c426ed74f19e664cabdf96898c681971ee0bd2ee"}

{"id": "p_e79286b1dbeb1874", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 68, "text": "初，承喪妻，昭欲爲索諸葛瑾女，承以相與有好，難之，權聞而勸焉，遂爲婿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "77b04db75f9387cc54e4f53a347047854872b46159c3f645ccf71cdd25a55799"}

{"id": "p_549827e7fabeaa9d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 69, "text": "權數令和修敬於承，執子婿之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "c3542dc41926894ff96e17cbe504ef470718710a888ece9cf8c4d84a4054f692"}

{"id": "p_3b448c6818236697", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 70, "text": "休字叔嗣，弱冠與諸葛恪、顧譚等俱爲太子登僚友，以《漢書》授登。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "216996851d4ae1f7a8e2f5dead1c1d6529e30840c351045adc1e7f6e42ba323c"}

{"id": "p_e7433d63c895fe7f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 71, "text": "權常遊獵，迨幕乃歸，休上疏諫戒，權大善之，以示於昭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "f441583a02be9691745da2d18bf8be47712ec04dba55c31624f505ad312ed216"}

{"id": "p_6e94e2cabc6bf04d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 72, "text": "及登卒後，爲侍中，拜羽林都督，平三典軍事，遷揚武將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "8b12f54c78cef901bcaba867ac3a8111c3a5f2dd124e72eeb17eec39c5f50573"}

{"id": "p_04d495fb872038ec", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 73, "text": "爲魯王霸友黨所譖，與顧譚、承俱以芍陂論功事，休、承與典軍陳恂通情，詐增其伐，並徙交州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "34f360d5d5d31740d714d99d8192c090a3be82bc8db04d3e393d120f67e0d8f5"}

{"id": "p_b92b7216c73bbfe3", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 74, "text": "中書令孫弘佞偽險詖，休素所忿，弘因是譖訴，下詔書賜休死，時年四十一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "46fdd5747a969adfde65f4b424a779b4d26474220428b48f50158824d5943c1e"}

{"id": "p_d2e1d249d70b55c5", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 75, "text": "顧雍字元歎，呉郡呉人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "88f452bbc4bc28c08303b68297ed27e18972f363b4047152b7515ae1405111b5"}

{"id": "p_fd8f5976b836a728", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 76, "text": "蔡伯喈從朔方還，嘗避怨於呉，雍從學琴書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "93746e4327caaedc1d8c2929938b9cea06e9727e91dc5ed3f54384502640d662"}

{"id": "p_e236d2266c077a3c", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 77, "text": "州郡表薦，弱冠爲合肥長，後轉在婁、曲阿、上虞，皆有治跡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "653f308e494badc884c4d2cffccdca43dfb24cf0ed7b0cfe6d11c59b99ca1ce1"}

{"id": "p_f4f1d5d3bc77e0b4", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 78, "text": "孫權領會稽太守，不之郡，以雍爲丞，行太守事，討除寇賊，郡界寧靜，吏民歸服，數年，入爲左司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "51a4bcdc335ef4e522533a344a115c199f189f5f70ca5d022e377f698995d0ea"}

{"id": "p_98acb32d9a645f56", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 79, "text": "權爲呉王，累遷大理、奉常，領尚書令，封陽遂鄕侯，拜侯還寺，而家人不知，後聞乃驚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "10af113d05f94708f3a45ed36b195dcb1bdeb5e59f497dcd90418a2216f2e795"}

{"id": "p_2be83da6f130bb75", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 80, "text": "既至，權臨賀之，親拜其母於庭，公卿大臣畢會，後太子又往慶焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "f55c12c05c70c8c5ea775c397ed2a8c230b9ac38885fa3704a394ddd47a54a91"}

{"id": "p_50c48caff06b5a87", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 81, "text": "雍爲人不飲酒，寡言語，舉動時當。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "e110b92a0a91add030411ce50952987c3bc8d3d4ada8e6ff65bea64ea186c44b"}

{"id": "p_e61187f1b929ba07", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 82, "text": "權嘗歎曰：「顧君不言，言必有中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "b12d3b273ab815f1ecc5d5fc9dfbf92ad6274e6d336b4549e42b49e32aae5ecd"}

{"id": "p_116c1eb80cd15c5b", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 83, "text": "」至飲宴歡樂之際，左右恐有酒失而雍必見之，是以不敢肆情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "04029b0c846c12d9a79ba0365c03bf3b0ff38059b9ddb6610c372c13bb5b4711"}

{"id": "p_7aa6192fc6b9909e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 84, "text": "權亦曰：「顧公在坐，使人不樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "acf198c327cf4cec91384833f31585498104121fe97653b15b161f901f7307cc"}

{"id": "p_ab3a0a07e64c5b50", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 85, "text": "進封醴陵侯，代孫邵爲丞相，平尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "4f140baef1d7b9e1320d3670d8fbcb26183d2c95c23e820014d586c1a7c75e91"}

{"id": "p_e30d94f63b971a61", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 86, "text": "其所選用文武將吏各隨能所任，心無適莫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "84c09bb41ceb0f8cd6c18a268a5b95a263714b93a580ab580048e6f1ee180696"}

{"id": "p_7ed20ac2f795d403", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 87, "text": "時訪逮民間，及政職所宜，輒密以聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "5f27b1b1261d843311c0ae3f3892a364a5203debf98b735f16852b7592303945"}

{"id": "p_12370a94ce6a11d4", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 88, "text": "若見納用，則歸之於上，不用，終不宣洩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "9b0a7266c33426c04d154d49513c0a29a7f2566142abff12011f82fc35ef7fa2"}

{"id": "p_0571e08cd76e28df", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 89, "text": "權以此重之，然於公朝有所陳及，辭色雖順而所執者正。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "a508021ea361f804f92f61ec0114bf859f45378fc1ab9ff7d4d1fb4dbace8e21"}

{"id": "p_44a654d9f5f822c6", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 90, "text": "權嘗咨問得失，張昭因陳聽采聞，頗以法令太稠，刑罰微重，宜有所蠲損。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "e456ba4087f8fd48dea20ca759747078902501f433fcaad1f2cf25057b9755e5"}

{"id": "p_aa4393d30f535f05", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 91, "text": "權默然，顧問雍曰：「君以爲何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "1e29f824ea524bdeb9c0f150508eef82faeb20629df03ec4d00700d386ea5a56"}

{"id": "p_a92f0f1d252220ce", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 92, "text": "」雍對曰：「臣之所聞，亦如昭所陳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "d3dcc04464f19d27f5897c08e6b8cad6a15b1e8a61540c76997edfd864e77453"}

{"id": "p_d8b88b4267d43f31", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 93, "text": "久之，呂壹、秦博爲中書，典校諸官府及州郡文書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "403fc1d448b368f77edc588af96af9a51058b4f6ea6fd5916689ff25b2c075be"}

{"id": "p_0f9acd2b786c61b2", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 94, "text": "壹等因此漸作威福，遂造作榷酤障管之利，舉罪糾奸，纖介必聞，重以深案丑誣，毀短大臣，排陷無辜，雍等皆見舉白，用被譴讓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "dab8028b67adcc7f409a8f01586d60e41acd02a6ca5d44b02c03b37a7c99a064"}

{"id": "p_0a1187dbf41ef2d3", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 95, "text": "後壹奸罪發露，收系延尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "77392bfe0e1a8b8e777671c28d22de84bbb8cf4e5e322994de404812b4e0b4c0"}

{"id": "p_b7fa358eccc8bba9", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 96, "text": "壹以囚見，雍和顏色，問其辭狀，臨出，又謂壹曰：「君意得無慾有所道？", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "b08690187dead42db47eb1512ff87268d1ced2ed2f3f323086fc7244dd8d1c25"}

{"id": "p_fcaeeb46aa80f2bb", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 97, "text": "時尚書郎懷敘面詈辱壹，雍責敘曰：「官有正法，何至於此？", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "1ceab3e902774eb174746e0d71392b087e3baf05f8da60d2067348e69a518f2d"}

{"id": "p_ce2322f7f3d85fa1", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 98, "text": "雍爲相十九年，年七十六，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "80215f38c3992c8390cd4693a5e6d8d661b458abbd415c77521939fba636c88e"}

{"id": "p_3b14c8b266716bb7", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 99, "text": "初疾微時，權令醫趙泉視之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "3896acc38548e6e358ebb691a8b6b044e80290c5397d5e353088cb7e2cfb50a6"}

{"id": "p_0ab951b4d03ba148", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 100, "text": "雍聞，悲曰：「泉善別生死，吾必不起，故上欲及吾目見濟拜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "a7c903320334ec749c1d1453785a01e640f0ab6c02c2419a11012de3848a88e9"}

{"id": "p_928cb09432e5d41d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 101, "text": "」權素服臨吊，謚曰肅侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "2e399b83a55f67001b33f627f104421e04348ab1bbcd29bba6dc2b165b3f09b9"}

{"id": "p_b0d3c3f36c2c4d0f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 102, "text": "長子邵早卒，次子裕有篤疾，少子濟嗣，無後，絶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "1dddb616e61a6d488a41d4b1d5896b609963192e16f41054cea944af5d1a1edc"}

{"id": "p_05495a94e6db682a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 103, "text": "，詔曰：「故丞相雍，至德忠賢，輔國以禮，而侯統廢絶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "30e07cf4c0fd713f0ebc703e6c56159828ef9e5c990b52c5475236194ac77b85"}

{"id": "p_793af94e3def3d0a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 104, "text": "其以雍次子裕襲爵爲醴陵候，以明著舊勳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "906593ee74213828412d64ba0b02d8c39899d42c7eb6042d78b8ebb672229749"}

{"id": "p_ff1a5dc20e73776d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 105, "text": "邵字孝則，博覽書傳，好樂人倫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "021851a4415994ad59c936003bcdb54df85cf5d91d811f5fb1ffd1747128a8f8"}

{"id": "p_e3cbdea6c41fde4a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 106, "text": "少與舅陸績齊名，而陸遜、張敦、卜靜等皆亞焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "a8715580efab5a2f810499e96b7a3afb23970af790163c43638ab13b06acf792"}

{"id": "p_4ec3c5a77e35eda4", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 107, "text": "自州郡庶幾及四方人士，往來相見，或言議而去，或結厚而別，風聲流聞，遠近稱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "8133788fca32cf381524a78a6c7924131521736eec32aba45f6c7679e5f73cb1"}

{"id": "p_4575eaf1cad228d7", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 108, "text": "年二十七，起家爲豫章太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "f1fa6f241ad31e3a1ae223dd6e12c3c9b3e495e36e8381ba7fbbf8f12d258d0d"}

{"id": "p_0774812a88f067fe", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 109, "text": "小吏資質佳者，輒令就學，擇其先進，擢置右職，舉善以教，風化大行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "8c35bf395e31478f74f5ddb8ba94a4b6d4cd19611ecc776fdf8d3f17afb3351a"}

{"id": "p_c81c40d099f5b804", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 110, "text": "初，錢唐丁諝出於役伍，陽羨張秉生於庶民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "851ec0ec3eae69eb4ad80e34e9332831293e0e9c7bf744d3c45011ce2a4f2892"}

{"id": "p_dcd775cedf186b36", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 111, "text": "烏程呉粲、雲陽殷禮起乎微賤，邵皆拔而友之，爲立聲譽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "13020f304b866e4e28ba6f6858277ccc940df879a8a20e4f286abd6af8f1c3e2"}

{"id": "p_a5693611f46539ac", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 112, "text": "秉遭大喪，親爲制服結絰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "e913680b7e5fdfc5a5f07346a76907cc7b48af859280de86a3b0a4784374981c"}

{"id": "p_98864ea9afa3e17d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 113, "text": "邵當之豫章，發在近路，值秉疾病，時送者百數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "0195fd877ffa99ef7590822d48687421d52833c62d88f53ea0bdc23bb357a4a2"}

{"id": "p_070057ae83f4ee05", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 114, "text": "邵辭賓客曰：\"張仲節有疾，苦不能來別，恨不見之，暫還與訣，諸君少時相待。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "c9935fb1eef953fe1e07be5d66226d86e93afe5c62d5057c04380a76e1897b57"}

{"id": "p_95be3bdb5f90b41d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 115, "text": "\"其留心下士，惟善所在，皆此類也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "c11886f8b534bd23d38a531d5133a9c05d0d95bdbc21b3f5dfbee5249db6aa72"}

{"id": "p_19e3e3682f00e91a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 116, "text": "諝至典軍中郎，秉雲陽太守，禮零陵太守，粲太子少傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "d0999fb7dbaec44004aba05af756a1ac4be102e4133dc46a92afcb8f969d722e"}

{"id": "p_dcc18b71c11d57b5", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 117, "text": "在郡五年，卒官，子譚、承雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "5a2989cd5b1143d2331ecd71b80b33fd7f02c1d79a7295c16a2ff9018d681b0c"}

{"id": "p_1016a7e267cc684a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 118, "text": "====邵子 譚====", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "c42ffea537414388db109add51022d0ff68cb26d3e5952ae6ce22a467d179826"}

{"id": "p_b91e27a8bf95773c", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 119, "text": "譚字子默，弱冠與諸葛恪等爲太子四友，從中庶子轉輔正都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "6e2277a6a4b1c06d0743a540ef7c5947ccffd5f8046f08086b5c390901832623"}

{"id": "p_596c28d050a25f6c", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 120, "text": "每省簿書，未嘗下籌，徒屈指心計，盡發疑謬，下吏以此服之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "5c7646343178249b3b13a9a8254e621e50ed535923502fa0ccb53b08265561c3"}

{"id": "p_df5be7da2ad06175", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 121, "text": "薛綜爲選曹尚書，固讓譚曰：「譚心精體密，貫道達微，才照人物，德允眾望，誠非愚臣所可越先。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "15b8c10f4198bc898b25f5beca86b2e3e398a471486e5def83bae6acd4429501"}

{"id": "p_7facb46a48e14411", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 122, "text": "祖父雍卒數月，拜太常，代雍平尚書事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "2f8f2fde8dd8197ef5437791c38a89cd028c553e3f2535ce27aacb53cfdea9aa"}

{"id": "p_39575a63e507eb9e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 123, "text": "是時魯王霸有盛寵，與太子和齊衡，譚上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "c6e62825804cc9113b460b091e5bb2eeb5361d9823bb50189948b7f67000e1bc"}

{"id": "p_30129da838ffc0d0", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 124, "text": "時長公主婿衞將軍全琮子寄爲霸賓客，寄素傾邪，譚所不納。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "68a625134db9ea2cb35467841c91ff621e5eb45923c71bdb5a920411ab103e63"}

{"id": "p_8f0f117025b56fc8", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 125, "text": "先是，譚弟承與張休俱北-{征}-壽春，全琮時爲大都督，與魏將王淩戰於芍陂，軍不利，魏兵乘勝陷沒五營將（秦兒），軍，休、承奮擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "d7002c1aa2689ffbbe1beccd7c0130ccd4cbaa016fb3cf433144276b54efa10a"}

{"id": "p_fce7e55b6d02a721", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 126, "text": "時琮群子緒、端亦並爲將，因敵既住，乃進擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "82e5ff3bf44a7d1565bc8e6aee5b7adf8da1f32052145201b0a925491acbdc09"}

{"id": "p_6dfb1645b605d9f7", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 127, "text": "以爲功駐敵之功大，退敵之功小。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "81325d8cab3cb06e521dab30e45fbd4fa8900f6d57b76350ac8c546a045afed4"}

{"id": "p_ed1dd9341b6034cc", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 128, "text": "休、承並爲雜號將軍，緒、端偏裨而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "43d7ec371dffec3e7fa1e21a8f3cbd83f2c37fba0cb57ae98dc3a41f2939df8b"}

{"id": "p_3d0c422e8da0fb66", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 129, "text": "譚坐徙交州，幽而發憤，著《新言》仁十篇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "5cedd8758a1adcbe5e4208bfc1c4cd316a20a8d176eb05ef0281e9b629aae44f"}

{"id": "p_73f64a4ab3a064a4", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 130, "text": "其《知難篇》蓋以自悼傷也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "45306858da9714a73c3b7e671344a68998671ab6ab922254820028fb044d770f"}

{"id": "p_775a1b8fad14e7ff", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 131, "text": "見流二年，年四十二，卒於交阯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "b1f42669b01940a679947fe5981a8a36a572f1413def7f286e2874a664ca8448"}

{"id": "p_1cf334610f6204bc", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 132, "text": "====邵子 承====", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "dc70375dd8aa35bd65f74aec3703b457d11a7668cbfccdf35837a232bcd2b18f"}

{"id": "p_54945a7a15d8bed2", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 133, "text": "承字子直，嘉禾中與舅陸瑁俱以禮-{征}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "aa11efaf386f35d46ba5e72a6e5ef27110bf19b59ee5f6c34bcfc7995f957c39"}

{"id": "p_d36dc7ed5ae4d164", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 134, "text": "權賜丞相雍書曰：「貴孫子直，令問休休，至與相見，過於所聞，爲君嘉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "e29b5ed60d9a9f7b2414c750d711e0188a310508e2e68754602d134c1778efa6"}

{"id": "p_f8e55afa77e68d3f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 135, "text": "後爲呉郡西部都尉，與諸葛恪等共平山越，別得精兵八千人，還屯軍章阬，拜昭義中郎將，入爲侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "316851a4aed066e4832a8efba04f943ce05cfd5797b3051928635411fad0fb6e"}

{"id": "p_663ec08e32be8432", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 136, "text": "芍陂之役，拜奮威將軍，出領京下督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "b3619e0861812e75fe5b2faf6e6b5e3b260dd86d5b2bf424685d0b90bf020692"}

{"id": "p_fc1ed38d20712af6", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 137, "text": "數年，與兄譚，張休等懼徙交州，年三十七卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "0f58f3d8162287cd9eaa3f3fb31ac385a6f6d6e66b0e7ec6097f638e23e4b99e"}

{"id": "p_c997b111a35da9e0", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 138, "text": "諸葛瑾字子瑜，琅邪陽都人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "48bce9ebbf52de1fe70011820becfa76f9fc4d8e0ab5364751a6cb4e84c655d0"}

{"id": "p_ff11af258d1bfcc0", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 139, "text": "值孫策卒，孫權姊婿曲阿弘咨見而異之，薦之於權，與魯肅等並見賓待。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "f5d276846bd7653fc422a6aba6114d0078cf36104a9c6d3efe21eaa2d5aadd27"}

{"id": "p_26f8b41807598631", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 140, "text": "，權遣瑾使蜀通好劉備，與其弟亮俱公會相見，退無私面。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "548f31e5927061392e3e2ccb96d24adfe12f4571c9745d6e12ed4da0fb47c227"}

{"id": "p_9698728de5ee9d76", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 141, "text": "與權談説諫喻，未嘗切愕，微見風彩，粗陳指歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "c210acd2e86cdb93d25f31494c3d47cdb33f0c45b12215276d46d2798c33570a"}

{"id": "p_cd56d606293f8009", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 142, "text": "如有未合，則捨而及他，徐復托事造端，以物類相求，於是權意往往而釋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "4df81a13769e75d0c540952f761bda6a4a6789b954caaf0e00313fa47cde58db"}

{"id": "p_a7e9f112d1c456df", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 143, "text": "呉郡太守朱治，權舉將也，權曾有以望之，而素加敬，難自詰讓，忿忿不解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "4f7b7116d3609ed4e957b8dcf45d99dfb74bc193dc642308506afdc2dbe817b7"}

{"id": "p_ab7ff9c9cd7b61fc", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 144, "text": "瑾揣知其故，而不敢顯陳，乃乞以意私自問，遂於權前爲書，泛論物理，因以己心遙往忖度之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "43e72bd03c9f52bbbb0eff741e6f9f202261b59e705773447d4ab513d1e4ea84"}

{"id": "p_c0e29a567d85b376", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 145, "text": "畢，以呈權，權喜，笑曰：「孤意解矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "a2e4b91826d379964c43dfbadcf753c7d97267c736a2f12b34a9c44d68301109"}

{"id": "p_ee32012e3acb83a6", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 146, "text": "顏氏之德，使人加親，豈謂此耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "65ae45c0aca1d781eba9b8e40ed8e373b17a69327fcc7292dbe88e9540ceef93"}

{"id": "p_b7a8417893b579cb", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」權又怪校尉殷模，罪至不測。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "4f97e1194fffff5aea7d010d8da8a1dbfde64075bde6c5476129b9252cf73a97"}

{"id": "p_1b1c457724795b8e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 148, "text": "群下多爲之言，權怒益甚，與相反覆，推瑾默然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "704939dbd8937559eb423a13773700f3e6c18d881450619f30892bec3aa18c8a"}

{"id": "p_42e1b81a96ca5d5f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 149, "text": "」瑾避席曰：\"瑾與殷模等遭本州傾覆，生類殄盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "a0ce551d5ff088f9d38e4446c68817eb47fc86574641a5581ca702627f45129f"}

{"id": "p_958e196c74871d63", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 150, "text": "棄墳墓，攜老弱，披草萊，歸聖化，在流隸之中，蒙生成之福，不能躬相督厲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "322663cbe6c46906d9b76353de93d4d1201f88f5ee84517e54366bd96e957edf"}

{"id": "p_9b967857da779123", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 151, "text": "陳答萬一，至令模孤負恩惠，自陷罪戾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "d2924545ae23d769a5f919b5d3ba72b9f30bb76154876a400de464d08f43140d"}

{"id": "p_5be1a40d03157299", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 152, "text": "臣謝過不暇，誠不敢有言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "a8913646c27495635b2c3e0da5444c4b91d7fcb9b1f1b2f308f4d29288366d1c"}

{"id": "p_2652e02f9dbd7486", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 153, "text": "\"權聞之愴然，乃曰：\"特爲君赦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "3d78e59c0410bc4fe75f32956972ab971f890c84f631c70b47bb2755f8e99aa0"}

{"id": "p_428b86b008b60d3e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 154, "text": "後從討關羽，封宣城侯，以綏南將軍代呂蒙領南郡太守，住公安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "9aeb6bc444001c9dd92d6660c7a7c638ac341cd976a2450f553fe2516f62aeda"}

{"id": "p_88fae4a9b8c9664a", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 155, "text": "劉備東伐呉，呉王求和，瑾與備箋曰：\"奄聞旗鼓來至白帝，或恐議臣以呉王侵取此州，危害關羽，怨深禍大，不宜答和，此用心於小，末留意於大者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "5d457b0fbb8dbe9f15afae26f6a9819f187f9fc5767d0c57ff7be70c2eb9b3d5"}

{"id": "p_9158524f0cf61761", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 156, "text": "試爲陛下論其輕重，及其大小。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "f9e303c4623eea451e25ccc1f84caaf9d766240120828704135a7bd2d016cbb6"}

{"id": "p_6d8084de81c087bf", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 157, "text": "陛下若抑威損忿，暫省瑾言者，計可立決，不復咨之於群後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "a6bfd468ce7891e2efce5a1d50bab513112ee6d7ca168f2e103dc73850f3bd12"}

{"id": "p_1d72a727078c97b7", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 158, "text": "陛下以關羽之親何如先帝?荊州大小孰與海內？", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "e19981b2a0211b43d6786f310d4fffa39c91adb0ec26db52539541966f0a12df"}

{"id": "p_0fc3bddf8dac2c2f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 159, "text": "\"時或言瑾別遣親人與備相聞，權曰：\"孤與子瑜有死生不易之誓，子瑜之不負孤，猶孤之不負子瑜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "c0559753c9e858376f441a56656106c07e7190361f3def88bc25531f3768fcf9"}

{"id": "p_44653cb095394053", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 160, "text": "\"，遷左將軍，督公安，假節，封宛陵侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "bce98a432060cdb4dd689f7e064b2b84c59df0277c8c65205246d66888e5fa36"}

{"id": "p_8ee04c8b9d02d347", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 161, "text": "虞翻以狂直流徙，惟瑾屢爲之説。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "067e828877b48e5131b5024030bc03a8b2f6b00c796aaff91751298552106937"}

{"id": "p_9bc053bd8dfd3825", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 162, "text": "翻與所親書曰：「諸葛敦仁，則天活物，比蒙清論，有以保分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "e85a55dce0072ffab85baab79d933d450e766a5838ff330884044318c8c650c2"}

{"id": "p_741ac98a83803034", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 163, "text": "惡積罪深，見忌殷重，雖有祁老之救，德無羊舌，解釋難冀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "9ede9da5ecd3ef8678ca8aa4908da7f97b9b8c312b8c6e3d0d66bf8ce740b3a2"}

{"id": "p_8ba55280cb2cb010", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 164, "text": "瑾爲人有容貌思度，於時服其弘雅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "3119e932e015eb18fee85945dff0a4610c58d09e256ceadcf16c89b9b068454b"}

{"id": "p_b15d03e1d095f7db", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 165, "text": "又別咨瑾曰：\"近得伯言表，以爲曹丕已死，毒亂之民，當望旌瓦解，而更靜然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "4da65ebff06775bb06b338bb92cf269bb10e981b8786380d546c9527698add63"}

{"id": "p_2d7ed49b6d70dbff", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 166, "text": "聞皆選用忠良，寬刑罰，布恩惠，薄賦省役，以悅民心，其患更深於操時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "77352341d9bf66897f2de13b4baccb531b852358c859670139c191e0dd569089"}

{"id": "p_2bea860256f3bde4", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 167, "text": "操之所行，其惟殺伐小爲過差，及離間人骨肉，以爲酷耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "f78c69085cbc8d7632e40251da5356a0bac6c6bcbf4cc7ef909e855c9a3af09b"}

{"id": "p_f7cc121cadad6c6e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 168, "text": "今睿之不如丕，猶丕不如操也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "b92f863352d6c773b1d3f02c438b1126196709764f124e9c4b8d0055655a30a7"}

{"id": "p_de71f4baa52e849f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 169, "text": "其所以務祟小惠，必以其父新死，自度衰微，恐困苦之民一朝崩沮，故強屈曲以求民心，欲以自安住耳，寧是興隆之漸邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "2f3b0249412aaea476fd8308c50441015ffbccc2dcf3d67bdb51a06dfe783b86"}

{"id": "p_88fb504de42f64a3", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 170, "text": "聞任陳長文、曹子丹輩，或文人諸生，或宗室戚臣，寧能御雄才虎將以制天下乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "3392a9f39d2501a984edb10427083a21caa9bdc60cdb32990d5aa92de55c73ca"}

{"id": "p_26546da7dec8a442", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 171, "text": "夫威柄不專，則其事乖錯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "6af68bd832d6a3cd3ee896ea7520e95f35425e3465aec225254a9a6dbaf04078"}

{"id": "p_f94ea94c533d4465", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 172, "text": "如昔張耳、陳餘，非不敦睦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "b16250359a23f6136c39a4750ae5483d01f071afa3d2f3fb8dacbef72826c7dc"}

{"id": "p_f96a946576d4141e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 173, "text": "至於秉勢，自還相賊，乃事理使然也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "1ace4dca724f0b66c0313405f6253fec18062c52e3221d8d0667f651e03f5028"}

{"id": "p_c6e69d9170e3c242", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 174, "text": "又長文之徒，昔所以能善守者，以操笮其頭，畏操威嚴，故竭心盡意，不敢爲非耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "9a8eb2a96ea20b1a1a4d72e2f11c8a5b4b233eae726841a87c434a605dc9c2c2"}

{"id": "p_051cd55dd045caf9", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 175, "text": "逮丕繼業，年已長大，承操之後，以恩情加之，用能感義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "ad48d5c78e5eb8ecba00c95b467a58ecc04e5c1f84669a6f1f16bf712debd901"}

{"id": "p_243b3d29966ba3d3", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 176, "text": "今睿幼弱，隨人東西，此曹等輩，必當因此弄巧行態，阿黨比周，各助所附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "92e76aedb58792267d26ac1a68b525852df58ed6bfffc56706ed160a0c7ec2a5"}

{"id": "p_b86f1b0e690e848e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 177, "text": "如此之日，奸讒並起，更相陷懟，轉成嫌貳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "069eeef2b96d40ed768934d50d4a4fa76781848f6af884a48cbf374bfea887b2"}

{"id": "p_8cfa04030a254df9", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 178, "text": "一爾已往，群下爭利，主幼不御。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "55753c2c90724be953584d31aa94d8e6c4bbb00a101f09704de5d8bab5a69c7c"}

{"id": "p_cf483209eda169e1", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 179, "text": "所以知其然者，自古至今，安有四五人把持刑柄，而不離刺轉相蹄嚙者也!強當陵弱，弱當求援，此亂亡之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "71e5c3a6406ae0d9b9f8d4de443ce04be7ee7b8cc774a8439cbefd66687f27b2"}

{"id": "p_a48af32598fe7323", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 180, "text": "子瑜，卿但側耳聽之，伯言常長於計校，恐此一事小短也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "088332054b73237d213a48010f1ca2a92149c9f9c1780e97f268293bd6d0d8d1"}

{"id": "p_cce7bcc83e4f50a0", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 181, "text": "權稱尊號，拜大將軍、左都護，領豫州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "78792f33ca0f6dc8661521de4fb406ca89f7a5989174d9fb2f69fc54e4f71165"}

{"id": "p_06b469c64123d5d1", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 182, "text": "及呂壹誅，權又有詔切磋瑾等，語在〈權傳〉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "1648c09d5690ff5a46c0c5b1d6d1b62c867e80bb3f6475732a6f70b48b0aad71"}

{"id": "p_31d03fea63860d82", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 183, "text": "瑾輒因事以答，辭順理正。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "1d1a65ab555d2786236bb6b56c20b8127b1dc2fe7814a27335d07168a16fff2a"}

{"id": "p_d9c4a5888784a14c", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 184, "text": "瑾子恪，名盛當世，權深器異之；然瑾常嫌之，謂非保家之子，每以憂戚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "4e03042996b32162c0988c9bcdc7d935a7396e9a60c5519ae1c7e6df9570f741"}

{"id": "p_b36edd94505ad0ba", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 185, "text": "，年六十八卒，遣命令素棺斂以時服，事從省約。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "80bec1453225aa7433cd9132f50638321b984f3fd1935d003b1597e03e84171c"}

{"id": "p_6faaa2ea6f8e150b", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 186, "text": "恪已自封侯，故弟融襲爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "9e61507282aa110bb92fd6860359943765f3b4eb116bc55e000832c5e4439bbd"}

{"id": "p_e27bc8db17e6993c", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 187, "text": "攝兵業駐公安，部曲吏士親附之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "bb7fcc3398a1396aee8f15bd63970f88dd2f6166d4f59aa15357a4d822bbdce2"}

{"id": "p_99bf9fe532ffc802", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 188, "text": "疆外無事，秋冬則射獵講武，春夏則延賓高會，休吏假卒，或不遠千-{里}-而造焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "9279b8ba88173639402b3a6930b2e00e4df0a47962b99c87ad341f04b04ba62d"}

{"id": "p_8dfb663c526b2813", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 189, "text": "每會輒歷問賓客，各言其能，乃合榻促席，量敵選對，或有博弈，或有摴蒱，投壺弓彈，部別類分，於是甘果繼進，清酒徐行，融周流觀覽，終日不倦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "303fd9d28eda8e166698a4fcd860ba8bdbe8cef57bafed1c3e74e14ce81c2a95"}

{"id": "p_62d35477fde771cc", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 190, "text": "融父兄質素，雖在軍旅，身無采飾；而融錦罽文繡，獨爲奢綺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "557d0de58bb52124fcf3a495c4239641c27da33d78fe90a99b262b5520296008"}

{"id": "p_c461b9514b6a7be4", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 191, "text": "後恪-{征}-淮南，假融節，令引軍入沔，以擊西兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "a727ef3e2f3a675735fe1c55c55babbd96cf34dd27980218b1db77f8fa882174"}

{"id": "p_ab6ec293f96dec00", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 192, "text": "恪既誅，遺無難督施寬就將軍施績、孫壹、全熙等取融。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "1cc4a7e8d282e4f86573d6eb5da8a81ec3750f26713e82d4cb5afc1bf74479a6"}

{"id": "p_7d0f7ddcd2d3391e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 193, "text": "融卒聞兵士至，惶懼猶豫，不能決計，兵到圍城，飲藥而死，三子皆伏誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "8098a24f3e88e7c10b6e1685c82396734d49369edfb5abc47a1c06d9811e28fd"}

{"id": "p_5753fd78446538ab", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 194, "text": "歩騭字子山，臨淮淮陰人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "cc0dc3a7451914ad284596c2762782180fd165f9216c2dfa05a15cab58374a2a"}

{"id": "p_bbd3a96e8639c795", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 195, "text": "世亂，避難江東，單身窮困。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "ee34c8559a9b2ec7805700fed476b1c7de63e5a6fab89ffaf0fd8eb5ee08b6f9"}

{"id": "p_3772b7954ef42587", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 196, "text": "與廣陵衞旌同年相善，俱以種瓜自給，晝勤四體，夜誦經傳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "82db2480a8ec90de70bb3b1233b81df065280f466c0a7a5818588853f4449cef"}

{"id": "p_968e2fb92376e931", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 197, "text": "會稽焦-{征}-羌，郡之豪族，人客放縱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "8917eff25a951a59f5f837261072bdee353bf845c653dabbeedff93f21a95033"}

{"id": "p_9a980c994aba6219", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 198, "text": "騭與旌求食其地，懼爲所侵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "4d2bb163b8267a90ab72510803d0ed5d0e72a2fb7b9b940375c6d17f6ecae938"}

{"id": "p_49106a52a9db1ca4", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 199, "text": "乃共修刺奉瓜，以獻-{征}-羌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "c66f6bf022dcd3bb4c9b5c786093dcad69218d76415b02685f34b85c5d1a155d"}

{"id": "p_d47e87b35cc21937", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 200, "text": "-{征}-羌方在內臥，駐之移時，旌欲委去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "7b9c64d831e1e6a9ace909039c6b7447ee378bc382837c8bb05e859270389691"}

{"id": "p_f408db69e7110e6f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 201, "text": "騭止之曰：「本所以來，畏其強也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "589faa83f46adbfd6cdcdb307b71cc9fa5a3b2a50318aed50754bb39b4612eb9"}

{"id": "p_3cbee9e594298a4f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 202, "text": "而今捨去，欲以爲高，只結怨耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "2def7b9fe20fa60cf71fefff215ad27bf0adc1fd6d5b6d237ad59656cec849ad"}

{"id": "p_d0c31a1d7fde86db", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 203, "text": "」良久，-{征}-羌開牖見之，身隱-{几}-坐帳中，設席致地，坐騭、旌於牖外，旌愈恥之，騭辭色自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "cd5f57e02ab9243c20267d71257c978f47dae1a2aa2abe7c43e9ba8850b59e62"}

{"id": "p_1a844c3491c76f87", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 204, "text": "-{征}-羌作食，身享大案，殽膳重沓，以小盤飯與騭、旌，惟菜茹而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "7f79611e255268dc39b2702cf9862c99b6299f87bc446f0d7c15a211772608d5"}

{"id": "p_386fdd5776edca0d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 205, "text": "旌不能食，騭極飯致飽乃辭出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "49e6990ff730b3d595de39f87906973785386d230a1f68484f1fee42c28594bf"}

{"id": "p_940a3b9212524c84", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 206, "text": "」騭曰：「吾等貧賤，是以主人以貧賤遇之，固其宜也，當何所恥？", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "aad78e59ce2080559435a2e306fd3616664a29421f6dd7d9ad055f3523226a91"}

{"id": "p_09ee617109644523", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 207, "text": "孫權爲討虜將軍，召騭爲主記。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "a625127eaafefa3f379210971d0871ce345b5605f7f6bae04b92448609d94a17"}

{"id": "p_aa78503cb19120f7", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 208, "text": "除海鹽長，還辟車騎將軍東曹掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "df1e57bcb321996cfdb2a714b40d50585905a055a2e27f3389f3cb6029209455"}

{"id": "p_420016409f70ee98", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 209, "text": "歳中，徙交州刺史、立武中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "c8dd8fb2723dedeccefeb1aeb6f74506b17117156b2050db48e3dd0639b9ac2b"}

{"id": "p_c4e8a155c822c9ec", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 210, "text": "領武射吏千人，便道南行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "00127551ab1bf7807756ba8cc6c06a4d875622a06d034c33c25db09de94c255b"}

{"id": "p_30557f1d73477ffe", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 211, "text": "明年，追拜使持節、-{征}-南中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "bb41744afee13f8107227a068297fb612c178048e5f4da1e4ede1e2a014c9048"}

{"id": "p_7ef0227118cb7660", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 212, "text": "劉表所置蒼梧太守呉巨陰懷異心，外附內違。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "f16923148d46a9e0a56d2a90d401c47e15579964b0406050c7f52718a0012c6e"}

{"id": "p_e5fb7a0de7a4e899", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 213, "text": "騭降意懷誘，請與相見，因斬徇之，威聲大震。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "681bbe34aa91151a5d5d593b09d0beb69e79b7a5a75e6839acb74fbef28dac73"}

{"id": "p_49abca16bf2b2923", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 214, "text": "士燮兄弟，相率供命，南土之賓，自此始也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "de6f2a4ad0a7851f272dd1e616b6182da51bc2e9d1785d1779ed2a0b7b93f00e"}

{"id": "p_0fbcc07d28bfe5c5", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 215, "text": "益州大姓雍闓等殺蜀所署太守正昂，與燮相聞，求欲內附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "dbb6ca257db1ec21e830f223b4ce4a824015204ebf8ed8028eb592bb23a609a5"}

{"id": "p_5e39cfd9071559dc", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 216, "text": "騭因承製遣使宣恩撫納，由是加拜平戎將軍，封廣信侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "06c1e39a6a9deb0165c58084541bac7c1edc75dbbb3236ea183a61fbd04e92fd"}

{"id": "p_d15884cc0bb0e125", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 217, "text": "，權遣呂岱代騭，騭將交州義士萬人出長沙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "161da40a02a82a656572c14e809d22bd3dae6c47e2c0a39e350089ef4b915158"}

{"id": "p_1d3a038b8540cfcb", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 218, "text": "會劉備東下，武陵蠻夷蠢動，權遂命騭上益陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "b9ef6f1ab7ff6ece6080ac3cee02bc452911076d2560cb6157709a74c1f8591b"}

{"id": "p_58c5063139fb54ff", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 219, "text": "備既敗績，而零、桂諸郡猶相驚擾，處處阻兵，騭周旋-{征}-討，皆平之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "7c2db07c6b319703c6416957cb9dfb93381a65427a507d15bc4c3037abee8c5e"}

{"id": "p_5de4e6c4b60f5f16", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 220, "text": "，遷右將軍、左護軍，改封臨湘侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "857ba619fa9b253b93e81f05434207532e1eb63aca9dbe01ea99f50ccb629fab"}

{"id": "p_a23cef8fd8d96c65", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 221, "text": "權稱尊號，拜驃騎將軍，領冀州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "179649deaaa6ad407eb2d3f8460f9c0664a852bb68832ebb42c5bee7d852b860"}

{"id": "p_53dc977e320fa810", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 222, "text": "代陸遜撫二境，頃以冀州在蜀分，解牧職。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "144badd16ced127eecbc3454596a3978c4763403d741e52a09125fbf7fc5244e"}

{"id": "p_05c7641b6045c5c8", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 223, "text": "時權太子登駐武昌，愛人好善，與騭書曰：「夫賢人君子，所以興隆大化，佐理時務者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "bbe16cb0612887a80a8049ed1f8d395b675fc5e29314cbbadd6d6146e968fb86"}

{"id": "p_4dff2240060b5f71", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 224, "text": "受性暗蔽，不達道數，雖實區區欲盡心於明德，歸分於君子，至於遠近士人，先後之宜，猶或緬焉，未之能詳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "74191ba741d2794a997c750a311834c722bbebdec5be3fca5d0d35ac637605cf"}

{"id": "p_0044dbf443217e61", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 225, "text": "《傳》曰：『愛之能勿勞乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "192a1c56bd9a560ae1a2a52988809bf7f04c6646e2d7a9f9a2ba7d2e158fecb0"}

{"id": "p_7ef0ed1558f7bf4e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 226, "text": "』斯其義也，豈非所望於君子哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "9eb1cb9f329244f24327347f11793bc1481df246f9a56c20ed909ea0fb436417"}

{"id": "p_478b02fba04b2156", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 227, "text": "」騭於是條於時事業在荊州界者，諸葛瑾、陸遜、朱然、程普、潘浚，斐玄、夏侯承，衞旌，李肅、周條、石干十一人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "230189aa1296dbac8273929ba3cf117c5a4a7e9a0190aa99e5df45b871ac47b9"}

{"id": "p_37c86a59e09d69dd", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 228, "text": "甄別行狀，因上疏獎勸曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "32bd18e9d3e0f18afd7812c0c199b5df5700e95d4707c0ac338e24962035ea5d"}

{"id": "p_36190267247c13a0", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 229, "text": "後中書呂壹典校文書，多所糾舉，騭上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "99fb286f32f409e367ddf681cdf374fe8524f2d13ec6c766a0f838efc0bb5a06"}

{"id": "p_9713422a91cb7bf3", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 230, "text": "騭前後薦達屈滯，救解患難，書數十上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "4c800a77707f27315ad5675d7a25e6f7a6fbdc05fbfc9e49945b03191c538997"}

{"id": "p_0f34b4007050034f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 231, "text": "權雖不能悉納，然時采其言，多蒙濟賴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "d581514a78ff6044e9ac9800a2322174d1ae24fe7b3e17e38d12f6928afad7e8"}

{"id": "p_0086ba2fb3076941", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 232, "text": "，代陸遜爲丞相，猶誨育門生，手不釋書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "41a511c8358f320b39f392aff58dfabccab6b8bc848890efb6886849ce0554f1"}

{"id": "p_5e675118170b5097", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 233, "text": "然門內妻妾服飾奢綺，頗以此見譏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "196f1e4398a2d8db62ec77429c86c89f1d05ae565e5e9fe215a71f90b8aaae24"}

{"id": "p_824bcbddae485f81", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 234, "text": "在西陵二十年，鄰敵敬其威信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "a44f1cdff9cc9401e53f20a0df7a4aaa7fc95fee5e457cd92c1ba4bcd2e2c172"}

{"id": "p_3dcdcea84d1a3e8b", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 235, "text": "性寬弘得眾，喜怒不形於聲色，而外內肅然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "9ff8197499f1e54dfe54b0be4639c464c09dec62fb815f2f3f79980f162cba84"}

{"id": "p_032ca3320a938411", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 236, "text": "十（一）年卒，子協嗣，統騭所領，加撫軍將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "35ed87354b6921ce380f2d9ba05f8a4c87664fb739b0b019b229da8a49e90ba3"}

{"id": "p_22072a2df19bd716", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 237, "text": "協弟闡，繼業爲西陵督，加昭武將軍，封西亭侯，，召爲繞帳督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "5aa140d5c89e578ec1c17d2b7c6b18f03369196d7198e81f1dfed2e55c3d0fab"}

{"id": "p_f995292cd77ed07f", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 238, "text": "闡累世在西陵，卒被-{征}-命，自以失職，又懼有讒禍，於是據城降晉，遣璣與弟璿詣洛陽爲任，晉以闡爲都督西陵諸軍事、衞將軍、儀同三司，加侍中，假節領交州牧，封宜都公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "56e16acabe015a10f5bb8d20d7a35552d8ddca3514210e40efd0c60e5e8738e6"}

{"id": "p_020773fbe48ec779", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 239, "text": "璣監江陵諸軍事、左將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "f5c4fcd3b7f23a9bdad387477c0ea83601bc608c6f2369ef5f7e38b670395a0e"}

{"id": "p_1afaac057e12bc7d", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 240, "text": "加散騎常侍，領廬陵太守，改封江陵侯；璿給事中、宣威將軍，封都鄕侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "0e12edeb9ab4cdd9519444719a0404bd96e3fe8b44763f02f8be0d58dba15648"}

{"id": "p_79b781769f291916", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 241, "text": "命車騎將軍羊祜、荊州刺吏楊肇往赴救闡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "f07994761fdb4222ef3868173dcc055f721ac2b6dcfbcef7b061692cc56b6c77"}

{"id": "p_4667f2d8f10b44b7", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 242, "text": "孫皓使陸抗西行，祜等遁退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "689574fed3b28d1e420b9e42f9738f2386d4b18b7844c938400c8bbcc16bdfe1"}

{"id": "p_6c62381f815f40d4", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 243, "text": "抗陷城，闡等，歩氏泯滅，惟璿紹祀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "fb7a31fb675c384060de36f94a54ae12c30be035ddaa60da9d66fb5b61c25dfe"}

{"id": "p_dae5a20029a75a45", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 244, "text": "穎川周昭著書稱歩騭及嚴畯等曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "7e63a38f445dc9b8847b8ca3514906546bf88f1500bb08bac1a4730d61a8d828"}

{"id": "p_cbccc23768f8e184", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 245, "text": "周昭者字恭遠，與韋曜、薛瑩、華覈並述《呉書》，後爲中書郎，坐事下獄，覈表救之，孫休不聽，遂伏法-{云}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "5d9f5c1cfdd65d79998f538672234a368939c60eb7950a8e6dfedd40e171c966"}

{"id": "p_0f29cc82aaee30ae", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 246, "text": "評曰：張昭受遺輔佐，功勳克舉，忠謇方直，動不爲己。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "4e5507a4a222450529a2ca10200a00fe148cd4fe98602eba3c83eebb5983eebe"}

{"id": "p_d18c692aba6e800c", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 247, "text": "而以嚴見憚，以高見外，既不處宰相，又不登師保，從容閭巷，養老而已，以此明權之不及策也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "f67dbbf68204904037b085c8ee357a5753bdbf4caf67f66c260296df99b8d0c1"}

{"id": "p_be90555b3519844c", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 248, "text": "顧雍依杖素業，而將之智局，故能究極榮位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "face2a136890ca711452bf14cfb64e299b6be949c3337141768555a22e3fc482"}

{"id": "p_963b307d83f7eb13", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 249, "text": "諸葛瑾、歩騭並以德度規檢見器當世，張承，顧邵虛心長者，好尚人物，周昭之論，稱之甚美，故詳錄焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "f693489cc70e558328d3064b7feb3f6d4a8ada217f3a9e94bd5c238afceab98d"}

{"id": "p_fd3323a51ccb1c5e", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 250, "text": "譚獻納在公，有忠貞之節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "850ac6c992254820db1e88a68726dea593537483dc9ca3db2b375c1b48bde553"}

{"id": "p_66ec1a38e2e86a39", "source_id": "src_3eed952e7a888b92", "ordinal": 251, "text": "愛惡相攻，流播南裔，哀哉!", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "eca370d81213fe9a2cd5195aa0aefb30904fb8394a840a60ad45b5fb58726d06"}

{"id": "p_db4104c22dcbcebb", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_9b647fc9406a7d2a", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 1, "text": "少遊學京都，還本郡，舉茂才，公府辟，皆不就，避難江東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "309241fa066cd7fe0d2c80641fb78ac047057e3cae1724db6626cbad444f3211"}

{"id": "p_3f1028f788af19ff", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 2, "text": "表為正議校尉，從討丹揚，策身臨行陳，紘諫曰：「夫主將乃籌謨之所自出，三軍之所繫命也，不宜輕脫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "996a5b23eae4e4d65ad3d7ce7c2345f1be075093b20d39b9b0a1b4dfa7039676"}

{"id": "p_e492237b44b2d487", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 3, "text": "自敵小寇，願麾下重天授之姿，副四海之望，無令國內上下危懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "2fd2114481e23f33f52164963bee11cb2d7a32bd0a1434a603e55d686bb027a8"}

{"id": "p_77cd809b6b9a81fa", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 4, "text": "，策遣紘奉章至許宮，留為侍御史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "01cf337d85973ca82a3f0e3fa573072e01bbdcff325677343522030e85b77b0c"}

{"id": "p_28a021932e1688a7", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 5, "text": "曹公聞策薨，欲因喪伐吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "aa11acbfe41d62a10afa3b2adc5e0fe52f1410d70dc91628c5a98db8cfb0148a"}

{"id": "p_fdac1ea2600a3378", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 6, "text": "既非古義，若其不克，成仇棄好，不如因而厚之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "63262e91dd79c7a000aee6a094a226b959e807aafcf8a7357a7f35916b185c41"}

{"id": "p_a8466339bdce2e22", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 7, "text": "曹公從其言，即表權為討虜將軍，領會稽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "15effaccdc8d75332d8cd4656bd0ed40c14352edd89b47ac45f7132fd9ccec0e"}

{"id": "p_bcd5e4856a1d89cd", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 8, "text": "曹公欲令紘輔權內附，出紘為會稽東部都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "be55cffde3010890ea7dfe6e181ddebcc21488ba04b2655fb6eab8598fc6bd49"}

{"id": "p_b0a15e05d553b47d", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 9, "text": "後權以紘為長史，從徵合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "8d571498df502cd0bd8efe9c94b42432ce051b4916f5abbd5926cf8de5516e34"}

{"id": "p_768eb5b357667f03", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 10, "text": "權率輕騎將往突敵，紘諫曰：「夫兵者凶器，戰者危事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "bf45fb0dac7b38a58c5c9daf8aa84711c722f2474b692968a89de7bbe6436a2d"}

{"id": "p_9b6aa95b3ba4dd41", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 11, "text": "今麾下恃盛壯之氣，忽強暴之虜，三軍之眾，莫不寒心，雖斬將搴旗，威震敵場，此乃偏將之任，非主將之宜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "a9906ccdd38fcdcc5fa536dd9306a1576a2918e0886a0cad4ea8e19d8d9d7e22"}

{"id": "p_8b90564a7dd5ec7d", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 12, "text": "願抑賁、育之勇，懷霸王之計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "93093fa1842d1502a11eef4cc09e398146dbfb0cdfb855178a30796545f1ee8e"}

{"id": "p_decbcf6db97ca3f9", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 13, "text": "既還，明年將復出軍，紘又諫曰：「自古帝王受命之君，雖有皇靈佐於上，文德播於下，亦賴武功以昭其勳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "a138405a5d2b9e0ed843a46077d6018897ad6f9ec9bcfa84e4f36dfee6c18233"}

{"id": "p_0ab6f596fb3be0c3", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 14, "text": "然而貴於時動，乃後為威耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "2529fb7f146a2eadc602a2ce8a3856d5dee930c206b525301ed05a53a99dffbc"}

{"id": "p_8556e3dbb4bce713", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 15, "text": "今麾下值四百之厄，有扶危之功，宜且隱息師徒，廣開播殖，任賢使能，務祟寬惠，順天命以行誅，可不勞而定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "23c0bba0b9e58574914750d282edd6aaf35d9e0fb5db754585d0356d1ff12ae7"}

{"id": "p_a5674bafd461cd77", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 16, "text": "紘建計宜出都秣陵，權從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "fdb5c0273000596c13efc9618bc446884e94a9560687a5ffe2f5f06db70a1a25"}

{"id": "p_1ebdd094a7475690", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 17, "text": "臨困，授子靖留箋曰：「自古有國有家者，咸欲修德政以比隆盛世，至於其治，多不馨香。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "41663e01bcd8646a13390c9576adc49e2de4bb92582a31413c5a250a6197489f"}

{"id": "p_9697e52471e05efb", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 18, "text": "非無忠臣賢佐暗於治體也，由主不勝其情，弗能用耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "3a8f4014e412843871a554ea772108285ffa43a5667ba74fd64ce5fce8510e5a"}

{"id": "p_872388e28d865cf4", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 19, "text": "夫人情憚難而趨易，好同而惡異，與治道相反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "10d47178c61f7ca1a0ecde9f60b9e349061bf95c7785faef8f47d42d1daf0b71"}

{"id": "p_1410e8d9e61ae8b8", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 20, "text": "《傳》曰：『從善如登，從惡如崩』，言善之難也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "3f4132bd770625589ab401115a2b8e598f1b677dc22c1767b76a42652f592054"}

{"id": "p_53f9b36c49440110", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 21, "text": "人君承奕世之基，據自然之勢，操八柄之威，甘易同之歡，無假取於人；而忠臣挾難近之術，吐逆耳之言，其不合也，不亦宜乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "310053f8da2a9dc840349845b147b7845c88d25743713210a857a537977c1337"}

{"id": "p_d0c12a9240ac6eb4", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 22, "text": "（雖）則有釁，巧辯緣間，眩於小忠，戀於恩愛，賢愚雜錯，長幼失敘，其所由來，情亂之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "376d7ae2f7fb6573d6723f5c75600b23bbc05d760d9d521f2c4fb4f61f2e06ee"}

{"id": "p_268ea6b4551bb476", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 23, "text": "故明君悟之，求賢如饑渴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "9059737d25e3b44330038e0d146e155f0fd02e366851308fe5926a3c36fe8b7e"}

{"id": "p_633e8667d583bdb1", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 24, "text": "受諫而不厭，抑情損欲，以義割恩，上無偏謬之授，下無冀之望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "fb6ebb57979844efc25f016bc4e110555bbde0f145d2b8715b32c3d818bf24b9"}

{"id": "p_6e2aed9e78626fcd", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 25, "text": "宜加三思，含垢藏疾，以成仁覆之大。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "43c7101a4983cac8556e95dfb0167138f94223a09692a69f53728b4e040c568c"}

{"id": "p_a24d77698f8a2186", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 26, "text": "子玄，官至南郡太守、尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "327ab9cc8663397b029a7028215d083809293563f807ba6458e39b8584589fed"}

{"id": "p_9db210cd5f8c3a66", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 27, "text": "玄子尚，孫皓時為侍郎，以言語辯捷見知，擢為侍中、中書令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "c7f7f311b0881d9e2391728f4ecb4e23efa2a22083d459348ad3b47c97ca06a5"}

{"id": "p_6e5b5e873f396d53", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 28, "text": "皓使尚鼓琴，尚對曰：「素不能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "29407c46fc6ce15cdccb6986e58b61592f03236f91c29c23d441cd304e02adc9"}

{"id": "p_130d6be4fee1dccb", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 29, "text": "後宴言次說琴之精妙，尚因道「晉平公使師曠作清角，曠言吾君德薄，不足以聽之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "609b6916f94f0e2a50de9c1f14b6dcf73c0aea2dbcd7a2b4c630a20bef7366cb"}

{"id": "p_7dfad8723f386e51", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 30, "text": "」皓意謂尚以斯喻己，不悅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "21e00165ecb86c0be87083ca0c0f3bc076c9c7f207c58e4a9342a4a42019ab67"}

{"id": "p_f123b51d329a208d", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 31, "text": "後積他事下獄，皆追此為詰，送建安作船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "bc953bc2776967836e1ac65688862276bb2f9dc06d0faf7e85f19ea6d7073b69"}

{"id": "p_01f50b3114514d6d", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 32, "text": "初，紘同郡秦松字文表，陳端字子正，並與紘見待於孫策，參與謀謨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "4a963547e204ef8ce69d61be039f2b0bc17d83b1d0ed7dea7add76f7da5f6d35"}

{"id": "p_0466cd34202c5e05", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 33, "text": "少耽學，善《詩》《書》、三《禮》，又好《說文》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "a66a8b039b86e33880d829b1a8df99f5d42dc10267feb50ff1926fac7e24d691"}

{"id": "p_b13f623338627075", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 34, "text": "避亂江東，與諸葛瑾、步騭齊名友善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "3770a9f2189dff3bfd2f254d227d36ae90bb2e4f4f3214c200307fbafa468cf6"}

{"id": "p_75cd9ede4956f009", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 35, "text": "性質直純厚，其於人物，忠告善道，志存補益。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "083b7f41a5f886022b7f3b635db776cc3763a1100a6dd0c44f86f460441030ae"}

{"id": "p_0726c35980ec1a93", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 36, "text": "張昭進之於孫權，權以為騎都尉、從事中郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "55f0f0de9af51dd8bab8d3411f5eadf3f5e1f4698be76048774364592112afe1"}

{"id": "p_34279d7195cc76b2", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 37, "text": "及橫江將軍魯肅卒，權以畯代肅，督兵萬人，鎮據陸口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "9313aa365c1bb80932bedff00d01924ebd36691bf5ab0702637e0e59f1aacf73"}

{"id": "p_cbb48b1786aef06b", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 38, "text": "畯前後固辭：「樸素書生，不閒軍事，非才而據，咎悔必至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "602637baee28bde6a75aeb0f58acac3177f3f04c8b3dd01112202b8af4b8cda1"}

{"id": "p_2d278199c8d8e88b", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」發言慷慨，至於流涕，權乃聽焉，世嘉其能以實讓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "502e6de1c37b8cc1109c4e72875c2c3a4be2188c6d9af17b72971590045943b0"}

{"id": "p_3c06761eefe1e312", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 40, "text": "權為吳王，及稱尊號，畯嘗為衛尉，使至蜀，蜀相諸葛亮深善之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "663e4e2f23450b2026ecf867c95d40c1296fb8bfee644c9289f85f5875ec77da"}

{"id": "p_abe3dcb77f124ce2", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 41, "text": "不畜祿賜，皆散之親戚知故，家常不充。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "c621de9c0ac164594d99c16f3debcde71dd21c2dc5a35f892cb1cde780eb7c16"}

{"id": "p_4f2afbc2596f6458", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 42, "text": "廣陵劉穎與畯有舊，穎精學家巷，權聞徵之，以疾不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "6d6113e41a212226c227f0b9b7c92397bd7ffebb184e13805b8d5112630dab8d"}

{"id": "p_e8eafc73acaec86a", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 43, "text": "其弟略為零陵太守，卒官，穎往赴喪，權知其詐病，急驛收錄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "e067ba102683c41e315a5c9185eca909051925c2b1ea969aeebc079fba071d7e"}

{"id": "p_36514b70ba765974", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 44, "text": "久之，以畯為尚書令，後卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "0aeda518502351bf87fd9697c19114ca6d1a2e999fb3cef02d2421c447e9d7a4"}

{"id": "p_ca4f54d4d5f65b97", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 45, "text": "畯著《孝經傳》《潮水論》，又與裴玄、張承論管仲、季路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "3e78f9338f1d121ac08a21086f8f74760a0a73a963dfcd28ef9f115cd49b5eed"}

{"id": "p_c0ba5dbdd2629c3a", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 46, "text": "玄字彥黃，下邳人也，亦有學行，官至太中大夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "f9cff4a9643b1150e490db85cead28f91f3af877ff6830d8c6cf25281693d18a"}

{"id": "p_57fefdf7d2de45c9", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 47, "text": "問子欽齊桓、晉文、夷、惠四人優劣，欽答所見，與玄相反覆，各有文理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "6d8c556e4fe4674fe0c894df0a8ca509ed1905974b9f03c721b2b1006bdb6232"}

{"id": "p_3d7ddada499e551a", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 48, "text": "欽與太子登遊處，登稱其翰採。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "37069de9676bdfcbce5147a4e1ac1fd8e8a8db02df289eec28ca4b32bbee39c0"}

{"id": "p_8e5ba15eedb1c5be", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 49, "text": "程秉字德樞，汝南南頓人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "90349cb52e21dc1001a396885e639dc84251dc81ca56aefbe3bd7ad5bb479233"}

{"id": "p_0956a12cc0cba625", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 50, "text": "逮事鄭玄，後避亂交州，與劉熙考論大義，遂博通五經。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "c696aea7eedb4a21873245c5c75fe5fa00b831362eb293e342c0789dcd973331"}

{"id": "p_3f117ba0abc90f21", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 51, "text": "權聞其名儒，以禮徵，秉既到，拜太子太傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "f44e79a757e8292a675b99871736ee75b78858a95b51d0d711735c3278bf7257"}

{"id": "p_65af4a455a8eb6bd", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 52, "text": "黃武四年，權為太子登娉周瑜女，秉守太常，迎妃於吳，權親幸秉船，深見優禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "e4562f2fc14e8f313ec7b00bed90151152c8fe7b0efb882f7992004236411d1f"}

{"id": "p_81914370df073662", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 53, "text": "既還，秉從容進說登曰：「婚姻人倫之始，王教之基，是以聖王重之，所以率先眾庶，風化天下，故《詩》美《關睢》，以為稱首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "8e88c82abe86e4711d14c958681df505c747e1afb87cfa81c468aef7fb346380"}

{"id": "p_e9441f0b730b56f2", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 54, "text": "願太子尊禮教於閨房，存《周南》之所詠，則道化隆於上，頌聲作於下矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "b5e156aa38220fa2de6faf1d81fafe0357e54a57668b61f0e6bd6d77c01293f0"}

{"id": "p_72a06b4b5faee57c", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」登笑曰：「將順其美，匡救其惡，誠所賴於傅君也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "55a838ee36936f62b134377d803a9c17b267eaa5c953f4e1171fe78a6a2227d2"}

{"id": "p_e4e5663cc58992e0", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 56, "text": "著《周易摘》《尚書駁》《論語弼》，凡三萬餘言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "06e8ef79f86ce909801b0977784bac28d1b427a3290f1f1fccb9a07c272c4e16"}

{"id": "p_f2ef1fd039ed7952", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 57, "text": "秉為傅時，率更令河南徵崇亦篤學立行云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "715c36eb689c14f67c5639384ec4cefb8af68b34e065c6c788940d206574770f"}

{"id": "p_e1b69887091f6572", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 58, "text": "闞澤字德潤，會稽山陰人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "3e44709cba3961a1a77e278408adb38afcfcc351686a2c2379bbbc32903af5ac"}

{"id": "p_288ef82d250053d3", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 59, "text": "家世農夫，至澤好學，居貧無資，常為人傭書，以供紙筆，所寫既畢，誦讀亦遍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "11dd8c47a130e61851f9fc9c6cc3ed2750a205b417d47a33a8b3f682b5e201d0"}

{"id": "p_a474164cc9556eef", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 60, "text": "追師論講，究覽群籍，兼通歷數，由是顯名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "f04886a0d690427b348867385dfa28763943aaf03d8631d61fc342eb05455ad5"}
