{"id": "p_53798cccb2ccc798", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 61, "text": "察孝廉，除錢唐長，遷郴令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "fe80f46b600fa19912cc5366b5c22ac5028f650492f7d8fa0b71d7d49439f7ba"}

{"id": "p_f86115e51b7425fe", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 62, "text": "孫權為驃騎將軍，辟補西曹掾；及稱尊號，以澤為尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "08aa40ffd8cae82645a08b07b5283dd221d28da9356fc544bc69ccb99113c02e"}

{"id": "p_b9e6d3683bb5ee67", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 63, "text": "嘉禾中，為中書令，加待中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "ef64dcee1792c107f77b7306adec7327abe1f6459ab6e355073c26c1fbee517d"}

{"id": "p_a2e89b29fea445bb", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 64, "text": "，拜太子太傅，領中書如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "44ea7540dea06441376e15d798399e8374144766849a49452736e6b162c4aa04"}

{"id": "p_8cfaab0a79780530", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 65, "text": "澤以經傳文多，難得盡用，乃斟酌諸家，刊約《禮》文及諸注說以授二宮，為制行出入及見賓儀，又著《乾象歷注》以正時日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "0a20d8dac3f7ca4211de0072261c5f07322f02c38f33cd51f49c813ee80b9f96"}

{"id": "p_2ee456a0ccd05b96", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 66, "text": "每朝廷大議，經典所疑，輒諮訪之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "bd42186852bb42065b9e2810938584492292dfd8538f1c66408b07f1f3be3eec"}

{"id": "p_beb64153a40e6c9b", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 67, "text": "性謙恭篤慎，宮府小吏，呼召對問，皆為抗禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "113e6508c4f1e40f9165ebb81508562013528e94fccf4488189a131bae711543"}

{"id": "p_f2da9142fef2a852", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 68, "text": "人有非短，口未嘗及，容貌似不足者，然所聞少窮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "385de08a857b68539f7e188b66c706def861cdd41229d370c9b222f39619be81"}

{"id": "p_7a983a9febb3ecc1", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 69, "text": "權常問：「書傳篇賦，何者為美？", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "47d33cc9d34a35d848fce35f6c6e0c33402e732d5c878dd122bb208e9b35bdbe"}

{"id": "p_dd0a5c9f47419f75", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 70, "text": "」釋欲諷喻以明治亂，因對賈誼《過秦論》最善，權覽讀焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "0285ca7c012ff28c02055f7e265469cf037ad6ce1dc19a3f715f29957ffc2df1"}

{"id": "p_bec10757eb02c154", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 71, "text": "初，以呂壹姦罪發聞，有司窮治，奏以大辟，或以為宜加焚裂，用彰元惡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "0441015b388bd23a3d1226c133c47a67906c319eee0d57a129ce23ab6cb9f921"}

{"id": "p_afb56227c0889bb4", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 72, "text": "權以訪澤，澤曰：「盛明之世，不宜復有此刑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "a1bb9aa3d004e426ccad9696f7a8c8c9d55c840b3beaa2874fe4ecc6cc2fc5bb"}

{"id": "p_cf9bb8d4775739fc", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 73, "text": "又諸官司有所患疾，欲增重科防，以檢禦臣下，澤每曰：「宜依禮、律」，其和而有正，皆此類也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "9ca62113abb81637746cd712048d56dfc75a7498a3d2538a14ad18d23b32f00e"}

{"id": "p_3cfdbb8f24a9478f", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 74, "text": "六年冬卒，權痛惜感悼，食不進者數日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "6367fa2cb7776814d0027845334edfcbca1d118df6f58d68681283fd39e8d518"}

{"id": "p_deaed8d0d72b2519", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 75, "text": "澤州裡先輩丹楊唐固亦修身積學，稱為儒者，著《國語》《公羊》《轂梁傳》注，講授常數十人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "623aba826fdd4eb1c5e8951bcf1bc18e97802d751517959a1dcaf98b9ddcc99f"}

{"id": "p_7acfd23680012cbd", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 76, "text": "權為吳王，拜固儀郎，自陸遜、張溫、駱統等皆拜之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "c05bac6f6417673305ab9b4261d8167c54b35acb4514b0f50ec7e01432bd8f95"}

{"id": "p_c04253b1549d11ca", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 77, "text": "薛綜字敬文，沛郡竹邑人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "ccdebd2c704bb62715186c7f152082f345849af0f642221e93b17e66bb39d58d"}

{"id": "p_6b69d9f23d880556", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 78, "text": "少依族人避地交州，從劉熙學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "8c20281d47f61a386ce7c463011916bcfe96a2596dfb49f95b5a27de1b52f549"}

{"id": "p_2eb3f9afd0b21525", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 79, "text": "士燮既附孫權，召綜為五官中郎（將），除合浦、交阯太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "4c575da710c0d06f8b0428a75cf699aaf57219e371fdea85b6df4f9bc0f55cfe"}

{"id": "p_513294d5cffa8891", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 80, "text": "時交土始開，刺史呂岱率師討伐，綜與俱行，越海南征，及到九真。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "4b494050eabc0a6022bcddb323aa6e412585363636f27f517914aa85c36316ab"}

{"id": "p_0b7978c5dd634a67", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 81, "text": "西使張奉於權前列尚書闞澤姓名以嘲澤，澤不能答。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "8e364c0a1338aa4b019f6255014d987ae19f4ab21c1caeb6f3a4a464b9c974dd"}

{"id": "p_d4d3494610989e4a", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 82, "text": "綜下行酒，因勸酒曰：「蜀者何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "d6e461716a9d5fc6b6609bd077fd70224fd3396dcd78bb8636147e78d2403720"}

{"id": "p_55c62c3ab33a3b3c", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 83, "text": "有犬為獨，無犬為蜀，橫目苟身，蟲入其腹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "0b1772d6feb98398068ce14bdb476d3c2e417bf0c4e34d6dd3f116639f7d8570"}

{"id": "p_f9056e3c9972ff6e", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」奉曰：「不當復列君吳邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "474444591e3ad6cc284a3b6bc021ee35247c42e8651c2efd4ff0eb390bd9537d"}

{"id": "p_ab2239627cc2df1c", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 85, "text": "」綜應聲曰：「無口為天，有口為-{吴}-，君臨萬邦，天子之都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "b1bca5730164c385eb336180607852e687de1c9b9c265435e31c0ffb1b6a8237"}

{"id": "p_fc83381d7cc45699", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 86, "text": "」於是眾坐喜笑，而奉無以對。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "539c278a178f79cf28c052801c2c0f81321aaf5924676506b945a77e1e3f19c6"}

{"id": "p_3c89b2dbe62a460e", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 87, "text": "呂岱從交州召出，綜懼繼岱者非其人，上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "2ddad5f9102fbdb1ef118b820b1e4edb522598bef3b07904f9f057f356fcff48"}

{"id": "p_b2e33af86214167a", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 88, "text": "，建昌侯慮為鎮軍大將軍，屯半州，以綜為長史，外掌眾事，內授書籍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "6d32919e767f234a873db329a5f7eb9b78408784b0001cfefe3a64bd52f05b96"}

{"id": "p_2e8b7ff9a7a556b5", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 89, "text": "慮卒，入守賊曹尚書，遷尚書僕射。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "3821811b49397329ebe72a7feb8b3ae31b6ac6c112673b7f4098c7b4059d063c"}

{"id": "p_788eca3d2bfc8d6a", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 90, "text": "時公孫淵降而復叛，權盛怒，欲自親征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "d9ed75a0608bbc264fcb78f022438f7c69ccef00cbb231df28d8f4aaf015bd41"}

{"id": "p_5280cb6f4532ec4e", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 91, "text": "正月乙未，權敕綜祝祖不得用常文，綜承詔，卒造文義，信辭粲爛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "755f44c1b7ee53361269432afbe0bb7e4a76e604835f28e0e44247b5bde3ad05"}

{"id": "p_39d9bacc0ff9d6ec", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 92, "text": "」綜復再祝，辭令皆新，眾咸稱善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "51086c46bc45a5e512efa586a7f37643b88285d9f46aa94a4e2834f451248366"}

{"id": "p_354ef2d054ce2f53", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 93, "text": "五年，為太子少傅，領選職如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "5fe52efe2d10fb6272d3a3943efcf1b01335affbc24acd884a9f03bcd47f723d"}

{"id": "p_36510058a7f21f2a", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 94, "text": "凡所著詩賦難論數萬言，名曰《私載》，又定《五宗圖述》《二京解》，皆傳於世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "a24b1b1719aefd3a10bce29a960dddae75b01d02b7c12006bcfd432f845f719d"}

{"id": "p_27d502a7b29db270", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 95, "text": "子珝，官至威南將軍，徵交阯還，道病死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "6ce31729a0f35be11f3ff0cc4641bf147a405ab3b9fba1122a4382adfa4b80c9"}

{"id": "p_38331acc0de146e4", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 96, "text": "珝弟瑩，字道言，初為秘府中書郎，孫休即位，為散騎中常侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "d506080331b356ef927712d75e61292f4e578474e67c44223d6a13176c5e08b0"}

{"id": "p_7ec60451b7a2386b", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 97, "text": "孫皓初，為左執法，遷選曹尚書，及立太子，又領少傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "eaa5ca64c4429c2cd39ee3366c07e9844ec7f44ba9bb7f42f237e17c01fc7c36"}

{"id": "p_a1523ef9562a9590", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 98, "text": "，皓追歎瑩父綜遺文，且命瑩繼作。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "633953ceda391f2fafadd4c47a7eaa5f0453ccd9009f468e1904aa69c2182617"}

{"id": "p_b5216ae0f49700ba", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 99, "text": "是歲，何定建議鑿聖谿以通江淮，皓令瑩督萬人往，遂以多盤石難施功，罷還，出為武昌左部督，後定被誅，皓追聖谿事，下瑩獄，徙廣州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "10ae5ec9c5395484ed8085732aa24cc606e791a5489683d39fcba0a76a37cae1"}

{"id": "p_2596e4128bbd3591", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 100, "text": "頃之，選曹尚書同郡繆禕以執意不移，為群小所疾，左遷衡陽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "b931b58b20ee0d81a6514cc998e6818b6aab224ddbd231dcd796c1c5f550586f"}

{"id": "p_ae0123919c33bbcc", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 101, "text": "既拜，又追以職事見詰責，拜表陳謝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "6fd6cd26d01bd7714cd10375cf3d2f8b18f47851a6313bc5770da2caf7ae301e"}

{"id": "p_5f2d780ea740d117", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 102, "text": "因過詣瑩，復為人所白，雲禕不懼罪，多將賓客會聚瑩許，乃收禕下獄，徙桂陽，瑩還廣州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "4d58e1102714b522a8e9711242587711abdef71e7a3eeb6be64ad0180daec2a1"}

{"id": "p_7e181e644b60b491", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 103, "text": "是時法政多謬，舉措煩苛，瑩每上便宜，陳緩刑簡役，以濟育百姓，事或施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "2b8215cf8cff6451ea0ba9326e14db92e29f740055ed7af01e65965fcfe4f35e"}

{"id": "p_3c57ce0df1e46fa0", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 104, "text": "，督軍征皓，皓奉書司馬由、王渾、王濬請降，其文，瑩所造也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "6c685f876fb0081e8ff669c51b82ed682ed1418a2e646fa76a17f98a50b49530"}

{"id": "p_66c469c334048353", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 105, "text": "瑩既至洛陽，特先見敘，為散騎常侍，答問處當，皆有條理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "ea9b231cb1fc88462b0437cbfaeee9eb8b9c65f7f8d1600d4e5ef0e2dcb8f792"}

{"id": "p_00e4fce17ecdd6c7", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 106, "text": "著書八篇，名曰《新議》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "3afc9079673f5a18c0440621a4e8a119fa7f258eaa5cfda6836df3b20f7da18a"}

{"id": "p_db38ac5030e9fb76", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 107, "text": "評曰：張紘文理意正，為世令器，孫策待之亞於張昭，誠有以也，嚴、程、闞生，一時儒林也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "36d402e4e2861de3d169da51463f578766566e26b3705732412aa41d651cdd7a"}

{"id": "p_ae7e5b84d327527f", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 108, "text": "至畯辭榮濟舊，不亦長者乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "1581d4cafe24d90424c03a121ff0545fa92f9a885a0d41c64d3ebed6aa7e58dd"}

{"id": "p_e8898f787dc68fe3", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 109, "text": "薛綜學識規納，為吳良臣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "b0b28c024a2f92530c6848b3e76e9b5295aaef4ef4c0b3903bcb46a0ad1edcb1"}

{"id": "p_6a2c3792a5c47dd0", "source_id": "src_acca52d1c455da03", "ordinal": 110, "text": "及瑩纂蹈，允有先風，然於暴酷之朝，屢登顯列，君子殆諸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "3991268fa4e5d20f1bdbf6c9dfa59a4e7d1621959a9ff60d7653f3e271c42963"}

{"id": "p_2d9b098e9bb9663d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_70d70710c7906c4a", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 1, "text": "周瑜字公瑾，廬江舒人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "1fd2a76ae5d5829eff156a538e4163b0b270f07797e03267a5147649b7bcb94a"}

{"id": "p_c641aa12b63425df", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 2, "text": "從祖父景，景子忠，皆為漢太尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "ebbeab0b061a66abf05cefc5836971df5cbe6a1e362744558b3eafd40e3200ff"}

{"id": "p_2e98298dcc3f1518", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 3, "text": "初，孫堅與義兵討董卓，徙家於舒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "7707af860fd5fc76ec5f15ef397c7dbb2671d09bc83fa08842a47802f9b329e6"}

{"id": "p_03b5eb4483d64cf8", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 4, "text": "堅子策與瑜同年，獨相友善，瑜推道南大宅以舍策，升堂拜母，有無通共。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "6404fa4591c3982089c870d7f1aa600c4a831ba8398391f50baddba14bc9b3e6"}

{"id": "p_2a69a6aeace5e0aa", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 5, "text": "瑜從父尚為丹楊太守，瑜往省之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "302efbb1d47b6aff06d9979a0b740edd2ee337390a182393306136ab2e600db7"}

{"id": "p_91ca1bb34eb949c5", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 6, "text": "會策將東渡，到歷陽，馳書報瑜，瑜將兵迎策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "225a56543c2978988d1f6300d72d8ac6299969a7d71e08d6e9b88ead51bd3998"}

{"id": "p_7a883703b977f00b", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 7, "text": "」遂從攻橫江、當利，皆拔之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "6762c12c4f13051d9382d0fcfeb580aed6d657fd662d2039d8e3d1d7d9ee251c"}

{"id": "p_00b1d31ac25ea621", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 8, "text": "乃渡江擊秣陵，破笮融、薛禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "2c8a5abb59fdefcdb8d805f99d73c4a107414c2259c1f056abd4621cd7fb3a45"}

{"id": "p_92922280bf73f666", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 9, "text": "轉下湖孰、江乘，進入曲阿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "6c45c099c6fcddf28def6e9c3015fc394dee04c52c937670b4eec92f019dde5c"}

{"id": "p_80c0afb5760b8fb4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 10, "text": "劉繇奔走，而策之眾已數萬矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "53102a73a3c9c6905703e12828e29490b7db5f01ba775947f2a77d1e26fdfb11"}

{"id": "p_da4debc6c7e76212", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 11, "text": "因謂瑜曰：「吾以此眾取吳會平山越已足。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "661cdf3c95f316dbcb20ca50aa2358f9bd91bcdf2b6026136f45adff9543336f"}

{"id": "p_d5e0f3a1971f0c01", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 12, "text": "頃之，袁術遣從弟胤代尚為太守，而瑜與尚俱還壽春。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "4061e512a17a349b8ca205d0cad610d448d8e80487d9112567336f28bee34c24"}

{"id": "p_f746450f4740c595", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 13, "text": "術欲以瑜為將，瑜觀術終無所成，故求為居巢長，欲假塗東歸，術聽之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "018db33e529c2ff4698195b957e85b0291cdcf241b736c483f816ff387f06a28"}

{"id": "p_fb52955dab264e89", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 14, "text": "策親自迎瑜，授建威中郎將，即與兵二千人，騎五十匹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "06715e58022095abbdd8a06284a76c91f5f8f13232306a215b7b2940dbc91122"}

{"id": "p_d88f47fb411d6c62", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 15, "text": "瑜時年二十四，吳中皆呼為周郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "761215f93e75f8ee2281d7a3ccbdccdf85e82d0620987ce0aabc72b8db505dd3"}

{"id": "p_e55e7e936c2460e2", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 16, "text": "以瑜恩信著於廬江，出備牛渚，後領春谷長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "9191f62ab7855a27275c8a46a0e737a9177d0423d6887964ff03fadb88cfb9ad"}

{"id": "p_b28a9583fcb4287e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 17, "text": "頃之，策欲取荊州，以瑜為中護軍，領導江夏太守，從攻皖，拔之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "5c153693812b40b34285d43dcb82ff1d608ede761bfd9c56979d95d9e1d205c4"}

{"id": "p_b69f6f28e2ec4bf8", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 18, "text": "時得橋公兩女，皆國色也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "fe06f3b5252390671d85a48b1704d3ac6aa395c8276e657f8b71d37bfcefeec3"}

{"id": "p_9ba9b218423e75e6", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 19, "text": "復近尋陽，破劉勳，討江夏，還定豫章、廬陵，留鎮巴丘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "55c3b429004ec18086da34b6b5717875141ac80b6f688bc7845ea52e6a3c0a58"}

{"id": "p_333bef502a77514a", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 20, "text": "瑜將兵赴喪，遂留吳，以中護軍與長史張昭共掌眾事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "6294e4ab010924f2e8c2b3ea36ee0c84718b45a946c528eadb9eaa746e90aa14"}

{"id": "p_ba38b9485b25bafb", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 21, "text": "十一年，督孫瑜等討麻、保二屯，梟其渠帥，囚俘萬餘口，還備（官亭）。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "0d776478393379f844d628bfdf15f0198b5f381620df87ad495f65e714073c02"}

{"id": "p_67f5ae9340b0f561", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 22, "text": "江夏太守黃祖遣將鄧龍將兵數千人入柴桑，瑜追討擊，生虜龍送吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "3b49746724d54116ecd9581b76cbe1e71ca8c78e62215b106364089bd7884927"}

{"id": "p_ec270b203ad842f9", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 23, "text": "十三年春，權討江夏，瑜為前部大督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "4856366cb5daba94a4bc829976f86b18886f8dd4e70e0505ca097e5f6c56a8db"}

{"id": "p_fc99a01ff0f9541f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 24, "text": "其年九月，曹公入荊州，劉琮舉眾降，曹公得其水軍，船步兵數十萬，將士聞之皆恐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "6409c062994a9cc78cb47e974921e7ef0caa96ae763cea19fea02ff24f4a13e3"}

{"id": "p_890f495561ac322a", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 25, "text": "議者咸曰：「曹公豺虎也，然託名漢相，挾天子以征四方，動以朝廷為辭，今日拒之，事更不順，且將軍大勢可以拒操者，長江也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "0aa82d0d67beac13c16209b4c13071f4618d04e99391f7ad46b5e9997ba691dc"}

{"id": "p_2a1559c48618b953", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 26, "text": "劉表治水軍，蒙沖鬥艦，乃以千數，操悉浮以沿江，兼有步兵，水陸俱下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "ce51bc408a9fd2cc698f40f7d1c818bac4650f590716fb90089d83c1d21a7188"}

{"id": "p_db3890ad3a7de73f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 27, "text": "此為長江之險，已與我共之矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "9aaa69fa64f52b124ff2451d4eb15de11c4448979f440fe6d60813b51b932e1f"}

{"id": "p_748a7d1fe6fd47cc", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 28, "text": "權曰：「老賊欲廢漢自立久矣，陡忌二袁、呂布、劉表與孤耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "4bf3ee1ca7fbd7719f15e64dab1f1835fda0cc4595264c8f467da266dd652e41"}

{"id": "p_17b01cc01f802f4d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 29, "text": "今數雄已滅，惟孤尚存，孤與老賊，勢不兩立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "d50622c540ecee52734a661c2ed63841d502741181af7ddf775ddb28ab09531c"}

{"id": "p_f28642dcc92f77f2", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 30, "text": "君言當擊，甚與孤合，此天以君授孤也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "f593aeef2eaaec4598903d8b296165c5bcc74178a66632621897b30f742aa8f1"}

{"id": "p_1dbdf8dc89d0aa94", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 31, "text": "時劉備為曹公所破，欲引南渡江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "4c42075cb765f5458e8779eab4a68cd3db758913a0492ab19f5e964ca5f89451"}

{"id": "p_67aa69906719ae07", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 32, "text": "與魯肅遇於當陽，遂共圖計，因進住夏口，遣諸葛亮詣權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "dee11de09830f5c56ab5eae5d0cdefa38c4ba235591a9e866da15317c3e8f324"}

{"id": "p_8e76c0139914e7f0", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 33, "text": "權遂遣瑜及程普等與備並力逆曹公，遇於赤壁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "eb67db34d5d15dd98c99d2dd90baf82c4c7ccd08dc1e29d137d090e7f669f3e8"}

{"id": "p_004b02fd7a5d63ee", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 34, "text": "時曹公軍眾已有疾病，初一交戰，公軍敗退，引次江北。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "2d41057929b4168b6e027f6d1e6f9c40092783c1f631e6a282c02689f4b073c6"}

{"id": "p_1ee0440217979610", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 35, "text": "瑜部將黃蓋曰：「今寇眾我寡，難與持久。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "f9a9f5b26abab68b439b064d180384e3a495cca1c687c9beedea4ccef25fae07"}

{"id": "p_1d39ab0651ee2fba", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 36, "text": "然觀操軍船艦，首尾相接，可燒而走也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "746f0bf8bc30811e5107653c3bc26f42814b3209d8356469f90d5551d90dacfc"}

{"id": "p_8e84e5a71a1b080b", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」乃取蒙沖鬥艦數十艘，實以薪草，膏油灌其中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "15e928308184bac69a8331da015861b7df023a8784f38f23e84fe168bb28de54"}

{"id": "p_147e2742b976a3b1", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 38, "text": "裹以帷幕，上建牙旗，先書報曹公，欺以欲降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "5243ebbcbb0404091e0c04164b6fb331594eefe10d669722243488e13d064b50"}

{"id": "p_8cec9a7be143fbb2", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 39, "text": "又豫備走舸，各系大船後，因引次俱前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "2d4c69e00ed2312847c9da52f609607a8e4aa2cff7aefed9afedd8cc29f64466"}

{"id": "p_d2e309862196f9f1", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 40, "text": "曹公軍吏士皆延頸觀望，指言蓋降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "62bc94a3fa97bfbb5fbb269e6e62adf4c1d8675b6aac7d1fbaec59468f54aaba"}

{"id": "p_8e087b16fd6cbfc4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 41, "text": "時風盛猛，悉延燒岸上營落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "2af61d32be990684951c669bfce9bbe9481b9411eddbd7e031690fc116ed5ddf"}

{"id": "p_14e2ee67dbaedd11", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 42, "text": "煙炎張天，人馬燒溺死者甚眾，軍遂敗退，還保南郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "7e6acc8c029f5076cfe2ccecd32f3075b4b7c3addc566a128b39e1d6ac3fb1e6"}

{"id": "p_4f76a4b2435d8611", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 43, "text": "瑜與程普又進南郡，與仁相對，各隔大江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "9e9e1f906061e28b71b4fd2b20f5f83bb115d9b518aed7f27f2611a80ecf7059"}

{"id": "p_63ee8f723ced85fd", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 44, "text": "兵未交鋒，瑜即遣甘寧前據夷陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "512797093306227bc238e087ce83b8b3caf4035cb7bfe5edab89da6d6d6ded75"}

{"id": "p_30281315ae08998d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 45, "text": "瑜用呂蒙計，留淩統以守其後，身與蒙上救寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "a4e87198b92fbf91f6e99679cdb3d35203a7f2d841e740ebe29ef58596bbdea7"}

{"id": "p_1de536c8d1defde6", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 46, "text": "寧圍既解，乃渡屯北岸，剋期大戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "d31dad809856889763513e852b000fe490548e68d93b59ec9c9ef9cfeba3288e"}

{"id": "p_cb43428d6ee0d500", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 47, "text": "瑜親跨馬擽陳，會流矢中右脅，瘡甚，便還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "c84679155bb84524a8037d20bcaa6f4f497d96f0356c08da25f3d63179937323"}

{"id": "p_54266fca1e8b4ce2", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 48, "text": "後仁聞瑜臥未起，勒兵就陳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "90f5619c37d1f812ece4b8a6ae12c0f1af560c4efe3c0bf84ea1c3988314e9ec"}

{"id": "p_2247ab595e384208", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 49, "text": "瑜乃自興，案行軍營，激揚吏士，仁由是遂退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "91e5f84487c777303ff1bf609d74d8db88642501297977d7872849230c04a803"}

{"id": "p_793314329c67a4c1", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 50, "text": "權拜瑜偏將軍，領南郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "94befec54cb398b1033d0cc332085dd8c50e7bfd9907f0697a3147cfa80a424f"}

{"id": "p_e565e71cfe042ba9", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 51, "text": "以下雋、漢昌、劉陽、州陵為奉邑，屯據江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "49e86cd7f00635f3e6bd5a06170d27aeb7c261ec1f88ab4e6738a1787fc6769a"}

{"id": "p_5a7a760869a88a52", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 52, "text": "劉備以左將軍領荊州牧，治公安，備詣京見權，瑜上疏曰：「劉備以梟雄之姿，而有關羽、張飛熊虎之將，必非久屈為人用者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "0abe96f17c15fb7bae97e94b512da65ef9b6ff9edf2b8bc9d776d533e576e1d5"}

{"id": "p_77da5c785cfcf9b4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 53, "text": "愚謂大計宜徙備置吳，盛為築宮室，多其美女玩好，以娛其耳目，分此二人，各置一方，使如瑜者得挾與攻戰，大事可定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "988607db0d37447bf5b3a1f9facda98a3cdcf0bb281a7622e699669398b97887"}

{"id": "p_eff6933a6246f72d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 54, "text": "今猥割土地以資業之，聚此三人，俱在疆場，恐蛟龍得雲雨，終非池中物也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "198cea2a3cc711afb344fec66953ed80a8984faedd1ee71716830c070a720f6f"}

{"id": "p_a166d6e38b26a80d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」權以曹公在北方，當廣攬英雄，又恐備難卒制，故不納。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "4371d7d48aea6120d757a6d03634567d4e91b86ee4bf366f48927d69832030f6"}

{"id": "p_f68ad46089285edf", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 56, "text": "外有張魯寇侵，瑜乃詣京見權曰：「今曹操新折衄，方憂在腹心，未能與將軍連兵相事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "c7d15d08d8b3d785a0b16d8863c53f0aac451d868f3e51091d4394c830a621ea"}

{"id": "p_a2ea964b9da0d069", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 57, "text": "乞與奮威俱進取蜀，得蜀而並張魯，因留奮威固守其地，好與馬超結援。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "8a5e2ce14b0ed214c4a642a5f09337f635b12e256c81e7efd1b9f2f97f2ff23b"}

{"id": "p_de78ae08629b79a9", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 58, "text": "瑜還與將軍據襄陽以蹙操，北方可圖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "6ac669b27b7d47acec213fdf6e7637396418509e1037d0382fd4113437641d1b"}

{"id": "p_600de1e2c0095c39", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 59, "text": "瑜還江陵為行裝，而道於巴丘病卒，時年三十六。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "01c968861d2bab2093eb102961f8c05bb2795a6975cac80b2586b867915cc2c0"}

{"id": "p_3c11424dbf078ae1", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 60, "text": "喪當還吳，又迎之蕪湖，眾事費度，一為供給。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "5774a8cdef820ad025d5148b7254115a1699e87d71abee722f5007ce134c157a"}

{"id": "p_687b1002e0002460", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 61, "text": "後著令曰：「故將軍周瑜、程普，其有人客，皆不得問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "b9dd92027767782b0c06e22a9db94ee7b2406783361a6865018a226476f59990"}

{"id": "p_89ca90bfd6bf8b1d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 62, "text": "初瑜見友於策，太妃又使權以兄奉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "9867d0d47e6f605817ec6f1eea975afd3cb4f6b5269fa9b087bcbdba7b77d39d"}

{"id": "p_2689eb91fbaa355d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 63, "text": "是時權位為將軍，諸將賓客為禮尚簡，而瑜獨先盡敬，便執臣節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "e88f762663a1e2b178c2a693945b929eae0a0e0f88153b08b371da9cbdb80a30"}

{"id": "p_392852b75709db81", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 64, "text": "性度恢廓，大率為得人，惟與程普不睦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "9279274bfc154f619816d4032328c389ba6d79a03771114685c2286fbdacf602"}

{"id": "p_8cb0c04bce1de1f8", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 65, "text": "瑜必知之，知之必顧，故時人謠曰：「曲有誤，周郎顧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "b3ed5b188e98ad09cfaf3c764aac86d61b19db53add8d110f71d7843d3828822"}

{"id": "p_8949880f3cd3552c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 66, "text": "瑜兩男一女，女配太子登。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "be0466a73dc21edd8effb46c5a3f9e7ee8c7853cd70df9dfd3b05b941320fc40"}

{"id": "p_0f1edab7e51cad0b", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 67, "text": "男循尚公主，拜騎都尉，有瑜風，早卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "934fa32314338b2903c1bd6f038e547ba169eb1e0333bd3f658541ea2c5ed3e2"}

{"id": "p_d57a6e71b416db5c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 68, "text": "妻以宗女，授兵千人，屯公安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "1ea352d294cc43dd54e25da4a81ae6e71f2c2598487653e156e3dedd184ef040"}

{"id": "p_1e27e2a0986c02a5", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 69, "text": "，封都鄉侯，後以罪徙廬陵郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "bd3680ebcc018c90c2335aa85e7bc0c6711e33150147f9868928672d3cea38f9"}

{"id": "p_0430643eedad3384", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 70, "text": "，諸葛瑾、步騭連名上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "0bf8936c36b2f0c96ba60cd9a03c2f10f48af646fe8c611beb916f8dd561562e"}

{"id": "p_23cc11b0de137265", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 71, "text": "權答曰：「腹心舊勳，與孤協事，公瑾有之，誠所不忘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "7f0a52e42adfcb8fb7e9ea244062c14ac49ea55d8ff4c58c4c7dfb5051768bd9"}

{"id": "p_df6cc25ce45a7ba1", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 72, "text": "昔胤年少，初無功勞，橫受精兵，爵以侯將，蓋念公瑾以及於胤也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "afed872b32d774a0a1f1fdb9010f22b1be940110ce72523b130b73897efb8cc2"}

{"id": "p_566bc84168d2770c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 73, "text": "而胤恃此，酗淫自恣，前後告喻，曾無悛改。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "4feaaa594bec2a48591ec2c98f7b4cc42ab79ca00c2f92d6737ad7275ea742b2"}

{"id": "p_cec6ac6ec3dc0c2c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 74, "text": "孤於公瑾，義猶二君，樂胤成就，豈有已哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "ebdc55bdcfb5cffd56a8dc69e43e467464f54fa3eb70a6ddb625e195fb73dfe6"}

{"id": "p_9c98150de6810d4f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 75, "text": "迫胤罪惡，未宜便還，且欲苦之，使自知耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "808c9c628e3a0448ed63c50a8cbea22d8aed12c16d5cbf54917ffe6d4a5088b7"}

{"id": "p_fbe4095d4da50efb", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 76, "text": "今二君勤勤援引漢高河山之誓，孤用恧然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "b54cabf91b6ddb3b0f4c4c456f50978fddadd8b24af4e532cd36711b1bdf6236"}

{"id": "p_b511b7b65e9037f4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 77, "text": "雖德非其疇，猶欲庶幾，事亦如爾，故未順旨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "d0110249ccb8fa8b17f5d3434fdad43c144da7c6827f82b01afee17bfdae7df5"}

{"id": "p_eb63f219f510c456", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 78, "text": "以公瑾之子，而二君在中間，苟使能改，亦何患乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "cb9936c8ad0cd55a24e41b1fc8d1ac3f73fc9463481cc5389b08510d5b7ccb01"}

{"id": "p_4c0193b70f2ed1d1", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 79, "text": "」瑾、騭表比上，朱然及全琮亦俱陳乞，權乃許之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "cd86bca95c4d01e0958a24c718ba17cae931ae701dd8183a8a8654c185320e26"}

{"id": "p_07a3a2c16d9834b4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 80, "text": "瑜兄子峻，亦以瑜元功為偏將軍，領吏士千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "f3045bb5488dc0226fa145c87e5f0484c8d09c2ee78de3f95433ad0b6231d3f8"}

{"id": "p_c39146124bbca82f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 81, "text": "峻卒，全琮表峻子護為將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "b16acfe19f187530c8040e8d20fb310022657a5a4524f06d308848c4e9a78258"}

{"id": "p_8f43de7150f5a4d5", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 82, "text": "權曰：「昔走曹操，拓有荊州，皆是公瑾，常不忘之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "1b6637858d90157a5469b044d796cc39723535c28cc34ffedb34672cfd1d48eb"}

{"id": "p_88288bc8dcf90261", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 83, "text": "初聞峻亡，仍欲用護，聞護性行危險，用之適為作禍，故便止之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "4420cd5316eb0a24ae5096c06c37afc1fcaac0aa5086980b7d85a2de47d365d6"}

{"id": "p_9294c95def1d23ed", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 84, "text": "魯肅字子敬，臨淮東城人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "9f7235df57fdeaa6e7e57fbcac419b2de223ea8827c21378445aa243e5c96b12"}

{"id": "p_a712f2688f4ea46c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 85, "text": "家富於財，性好施與，爾時天下已亂，肅不治家事，大散財貨，摽賣田地，以賑窮弊結士為務，甚得鄉邑歡心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "3a2c81b93d802bef7a0f0fd7977f20a90278cdcdec1e926d964bbc21a936ab0e"}

{"id": "p_bdc83e81a2e91180", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 86, "text": "周瑜為居巢長，將數百人故過候肅，並求資糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "8ce4327749c2aeed59a0e5e332b6153b30b58e6609a3dbb711566ac1ecfe4c6f"}

{"id": "p_c6ac372d0ff6e62e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 87, "text": "肅家有兩囷米，各三千斛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "c170603e87ad6066a0638735d370ee644d9c6bbdf7f9dfacbb215862787bc6df"}

{"id": "p_a80a294a41a39272", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 88, "text": "肅乃指一囷與周瑜，瑜益知其奇也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "7d8eb63556ccf4b355963b9588336e6046a680a77f3b4062f3a731a3f7476ef0"}

{"id": "p_249d7beed789d78f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 89, "text": "遂相親結，定僑、札之分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "949b53f8d7ccdd4da28a17fb3ac92335192dc8ef46328c2abf6070eab2f9b246"}

{"id": "p_7276ff3273bc602f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 90, "text": "袁術聞其名，就署東城長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "5ae8bd5848dc21be0e5eac1a9c3e8b34ec9791def810156d504734d7495170f8"}

{"id": "p_2e10cbf02657dba3", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 91, "text": "肅見術無綱紀，不足與立事，乃攜老弱將輕俠少年百餘人，南到居巢就瑜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "14d832bbe6647c6d1d9e5dc7b9dd9deb08262070d81393b72c0948ac01e1bd13"}

{"id": "p_12ba9a3252c308a3", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 92, "text": "瑜之東渡，因與同行，留家曲阿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "34eb609d5bd37e7f0e32af64143540b0a35440ce24730db7c4a2294fa825ec92"}

{"id": "p_d93aa82ce0478879", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 93, "text": "劉子揚與肅友善，遺肅書，曰：「方今天下豪傑並起，吾子姿才，尤宜今日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "1269b676e2157a643912fae62812b95eba83fa54454a24d47ed51365ad6f1f69"}

{"id": "p_32f06d9e48c6138c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 94, "text": "急還迎老母，無事滯於東城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "d69d7e217cc61a9c4dd4bf58606527abe9737c77bebdd01d419ecb49ce71d65d"}

{"id": "p_132582fd50bbd436", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 95, "text": "近鄭寶者，今在巢湖，擁眾萬餘，處地肥饒，廬江間人多依就之，況吾徒乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "8fd08570053dbc6df3a8fe0540577e153a9485b3a337470a62fe42a9f204788d"}

{"id": "p_44f9b6eb3af9a8e4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 96, "text": "觀其形勢，又可博集，時不可失，足下速之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "dbbc4d0e2cfe29a27bc09e6fc71089ae93cb4c9af99a9a05c38d9bb1fcb4f3c5"}

{"id": "p_b54069d7621e6ca0", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 97, "text": "會瑜已徙肅母到吳，肅具以狀語瑜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "56ad4761c12fd3c8f36444c97eb423a761caf556f277e95c5f9ccfe4646e5176"}

{"id": "p_c0cd0832c27e7843", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 98, "text": "時孫策已薨，權尚住吳，瑜謂肅曰：「昔馬援答光武云『當今之世，非但君擇臣，臣亦擇君』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "88ea334a631df25ece3b691932f755a028dd2a15c22d53d1d85b4a4cc088f4cb"}

{"id": "p_d6bf0e24ddbf087a", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 99, "text": "今主人親賢貴士，納奇錄異，且吾聞先哲秘論，承運代劉氏者，必興於東南，推步事勢，當其歷數，終構帝基，以協天符，是烈士攀龍附鳳馳騖之秋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "645888c48774d7ab83f314b5064025d3b3eef702590aeb24a1b47229a836beb2"}

{"id": "p_db01884d061de9d8", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 100, "text": "吾方達此，足下不須以子揚之言介意也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "13ddeef12bb2d392f2b4192904efa577bd5ac169f87c0c9806e84dd22563d3a7"}

{"id": "p_945c2851e39d008e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 101, "text": "瑜因薦肅才宜佐時，當廣求其比，以成功業，不可令去也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "6a35d0b4d4ed43c1919ebc59db0d7eccd944b9277d94701ea6155749742642ff"}

{"id": "p_9f9380dad13ab101", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 102, "text": "眾賓罷退，肅亦辭出，乃獨引肅還，合榻對飲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "4db6ab1f89cf433c9809c05d3794031a83f8b0f2fd47ee80fb3b96e24725f0d9"}

{"id": "p_7ce14429f6d93f12", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 103, "text": "因密議曰：「今漢室傾危，四方雲擾，孤承父兄餘業，思有桓文之功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "064d535960244d87c9bc0d69c668a589e89ce5b455123d242b9c5085b04bfff4"}

{"id": "p_686bfb3c767ec2b7", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 104, "text": "」肅對曰：「昔高帝區區欲尊事義帝而不獲者，以項羽為害也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "f99bfdcdcfcba59e2f875db7e751531eff625ca0677de38607bbf0847c026f77"}

{"id": "p_26569fe0c5dc9841", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 105, "text": "今之曹操，猶昔項羽，將軍何由得為桓文乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "81d19befe504b1dd1fc5cf116b97f22804a6bb1504fee6c81b0df07be9fade33"}

{"id": "p_e7b367daeb39ffef", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 106, "text": "肅竊料之，漢室不可復興，曹操不可卒除。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "04f295a4896923bbbbfe87f76ed667f2343e4b9305a2d86c90cbbcc4cc470593"}

{"id": "p_2a5bfce351fa1609", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 107, "text": "為將軍計，惟有鼎足江東，以觀天下之釁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "ccab0d644e589ff2bafeb6ea4a957a60b84cb3ac18ba3ed7e58298e9afc0d6fa"}

{"id": "p_0e91a253e3fae60e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 108, "text": "因其多務，剿除黃祖，進伐劉表，竟長江所極，據而有之，然後建號帝王以圖天下，此高帝之業也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "3a08a7afee8ac6174d569659231a6ee650643cd89eab03251e7e07ad2c019b29"}

{"id": "p_7adb7118d4ddaf03", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 109, "text": "」權曰：「今盡力方冀以輔漢耳，此言非所及也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "257549a1318bfeadee8b422e8cc6c356c1617e6005ac0e2b8382a1b4b15f80d8"}

{"id": "p_cbf1fdf9b28cd2e2", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 110, "text": "」張昭非肅謙下不足，頗訾毀之，云肅年少粗疏，未可用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "b41af7dc1c5ca0c87d8df6a7f86fc634973d6d53d4cb68838dd44e48d763dbb9"}

{"id": "p_d5026697920cb659", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 111, "text": "極不以介意，益貴重之，賜肅母衣服幃帳，居處雜物，富擬其舊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "e7677c3dd90cd45a5d42db8eda4b6038e391009032f50b58567d8e85ffccd4e9"}

{"id": "p_f96c404a8db470c7", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 112, "text": "劉表死，肅進說曰：「夫荊楚與國鄰接，水流順北，外帶江漢，內阻山陵，有金城之固，沃野萬里，士民殷富，若據而有之，此帝王之資也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "fc2ca073663a4d84bc54aa40a49fbdbad6cc2a34e11e2841aa26ddf2fd48803a"}

{"id": "p_3484e4eb94f322aa", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 113, "text": "今表新亡，二子素不輯睦，軍中諸將，各有彼此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "1383e54865dbd769ea96549de10454c7796c240d9a484e0886f82ff0be15cd3f"}

{"id": "p_89526416f1c9af5e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 114, "text": "加劉備天下梟雄，與操有隙，寄寓於表，表惡其能而不能用也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "f600fa2f540f2925b25ce3f1194f278f01bf8bb290ce98c7c52cfec04e4eef7d"}

{"id": "p_fa7b85290de7a8df", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 115, "text": "若備與彼協心，上下齊同，則宜撫安，與結盟好：如有離違，宜別圖之，以濟大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "f92e2fd62c980e50aac31aff789bbc5cc3bdb457a2286afdbf1009aee9216757"}

{"id": "p_8c6e78b3b25092f4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 116, "text": "肅請得奉命吊表二子，並慰勞其軍中用事者，及說備使撫表眾，同心一意，共治曹操，備必喜而從命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "cf1e3e0aa10cc3a501545f4e8f05821063f14bd9c537e44402d49d6f23256671"}

{"id": "p_0a94aff3aa22955b", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 117, "text": "到夏口，聞曹公已向荊州，晨夜兼道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "4ef372d207d9e1befb3131d10e94bb12cc409044cbded20b5afdd3f4155f1429"}

{"id": "p_128247ac5ed736f5", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 118, "text": "比至南郡，而表子琮已降曹公，備惶遽奔走，欲南渡江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "70eedcd322e408c48e53bdd4074c01463fa57543550c7250a93c2b4c66045e61"}

{"id": "p_36f73cf9581be8da", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 119, "text": "肅徑迎之，到當陽長阪，與備會，宣騰權旨，及陳江東強固，勸備與權並力。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "36d55f195806c48fc79209ed6d6467f07c0c44bfe4e1b23442a6d4ff7fd60680"}

{"id": "p_6ff5ada64b646e8d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 120, "text": "肅謂亮曰「我子瑜友也」，即共定交。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "fb9c00b8b579cb08539e6fec8bb94f5ef1b5d6a4b4f6bac2c4edb5ce1c7908c2"}

{"id": "p_1ae6a048c3741738", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 121, "text": "備遂到夏口，遣亮使權，肅亦反命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "71b932fc7831dcbec8108d4d6c429b84c9e49260cbf174d739118970d997105a"}

{"id": "p_57f9448760eadef7", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 122, "text": "會權得曹公欲東之問，與諸將議，皆勸權迎之，而肅獨不言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "f4bfc641d35f5720472b0f6ba7a8fc473372567a067b8a86be0fc0c8ae37a6f1"}

{"id": "p_2398c24232fc9824", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 123, "text": "權起更衣，肅追於宇下，權知其意，執肅手曰：「卿欲何言？", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "449d1ebbedfe5c55d9861068734335bbe071f26bfd1b07a226f2e37bf5f54a22"}

{"id": "p_b5a14cf3c199eedd", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 124, "text": "」肅對曰：「向察眾人之議，專欲誤將軍，不足與圖大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "3eefc5e23029a137158a51049bd067aaa095daa03461d0be589ab72807081707"}

{"id": "p_000521d7a296f15b", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 125, "text": "今肅可迎操耳，如將軍，不可也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "e3fa66a576781ef7e61012bd13750e0823221bdb393d7aa22472d1b41a09ccd2"}

{"id": "p_6fa8c403dd83ad1a", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 126, "text": "今肅迎操，操當以肅還付鄉黨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "1f1fb79ec0ec309e42da33f3572f7163fd0b768d39dec1e8b555b0ce18d5a4e4"}

{"id": "p_8d7da2771f0a5f35", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 127, "text": "品其名位，猶不失下曹從事，乘犢車、從吏卒、交遊士林、累官故不失州郡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "8ef34bcd526d37ff34e7a32a8d9c3677ecaa08f474292ee11f38403be6acd246"}

{"id": "p_2750ee0708ec9a79", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 128, "text": "願早定大計，莫用眾人之議也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "6fca2634cc81989357edf237a6b4948a33b07f82ac2feddc8d1c616d58ad94b4"}

{"id": "p_1d9c2a417d20176c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 129, "text": "」權歎息曰：「此諸人持議，甚失孤望；今卿廓開大計，正與孤同，此天以卿賜我也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "d3c099021dbea57df1b4eb9c2b707e88e2d82fc51719fd08250366379cbaf0a2"}

{"id": "p_baa4c752b8d344ee", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 130, "text": "」時周瑜受使至鄱陽，肅勸追召瑜還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "28407b50e043296ab03ec37ed8e349990a301d53a9d87a50606e1eb81c9948d3"}

{"id": "p_8c393a291519f8ac", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 131, "text": "遂任瑜以行事，以肅為贊軍校尉，助畫方略。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "fa6e423be58636838aaeca2d1812d18f339d3b77d508c8418d8c8e575752d2c3"}

{"id": "p_8b2f985bce14f2df", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 132, "text": "曹公破走，肅即先還，權大請諸將迎肅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "3d571224825dcf70b6062a1c2501768813d9f3b1e16c580170c343ad47f324eb"}

{"id": "p_e227f50d682fc92f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 133, "text": "肅將入閣拜，權起禮之，因謂曰：「子敬，孤持鞍下馬相迎，足以顯卿未？", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "814deb738dbcd2310cf56734e3c780a3779f8b17463f3dfc88abb0c3a2dbf26b"}

{"id": "p_7545ffaba9c34261", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 134, "text": "就坐，徐舉鞭言曰：「願至尊威德加乎四海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "85338168905a455ebc9f8773f20fa1813d208a243d33ac749efb888966b7f8f1"}

{"id": "p_5163296e32acd3a7", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 135, "text": "總括九州，克成帝業，更以安車軟輪徵肅，始當顯耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "79551e8c68727311a8220cfa9c524c49eca5509cd987e9c3413e27b2c1bff40b"}

{"id": "p_6db001de7e5c0b01", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 136, "text": "後備詣京見權，求都督荊州，惟肅勸權借之，共拒曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "9dacf85b2fb4755b951eb0c5a358e93294f00df744bac98b690a7851a9e36e1f"}

{"id": "p_f21187ea42b87532", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 137, "text": "曹公聞權以土地業備，方作書，落筆於地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "f33064b17bdd435cf7461faa10a6341cf4f0f9d4edeb58ab6a389ee2ca5c5ae3"}

{"id": "p_589dc5239c1ea0e5", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 138, "text": "周瑜病困，上疏曰：「當今天下，方有事役，是瑜乃心夙夜所憂，願至尊先慮未然，然後康樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "505f0dc122e552321cb11884e7dcc9a92515b623fe6419c2e2d97cb2eca46ae3"}

{"id": "p_8e9907239d34ed85", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 139, "text": "今既與曹操為敵，劉備近在公安，邊境密邇，百姓未附，宜得良將以鎮撫之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "3fd5da5882149cf619a62b1dfde1206679099ea2cdf9bf86e9b9eae00a180291"}

{"id": "p_4f5c6c711de42cef", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 140, "text": "魯肅智略足任，乞以代瑜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "0c4efe5d40d039059c3c822a26cfa7d830e7394e283715834007057c3c50b004"}

{"id": "p_a23cdca1c0c3201d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 141, "text": "」即拜肅奮武校尉，代瑜領兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "de50a12e938366afe234b7ae733f702591462610667a7d314d0ed4a5f2580a89"}

{"id": "p_e92b29bb6732fcef", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 142, "text": "肅初住江陵，後下屯陸口，威恩大行，眾增萬餘人，拜漢昌太守、偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "9a5508306553c67c8709ea91840f57940262829d7934990e576ebe98ed9a079c"}

{"id": "p_013eebccb81762ea", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 143, "text": "十九年，從權破皖城，轉橫江將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "027fd2dda1545a449732cce2add0a9aa0bec4fca14bf2844cb9c830b6511ad51"}

{"id": "p_29950e22205d9377", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 144, "text": "先是，益州牧劉璋綱維頹弛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "867262efbfd43affe328afb9ab7a7ad0e60f1d4bfbe011c036355a78f53eeb1d"}

{"id": "p_17b6afbd4107c165", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 145, "text": "周瑜、甘寧並勸權取蜀，權以諮備，備內欲自規。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "089988ff78aeccc24c630835ceaf37688b6e8029bb98d9e7b55f6021826fb76c"}

{"id": "p_a6966b3ffdf269d6", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 146, "text": "仍偽報曰：「備與璋托為宗室，冀憑英靈，以匡漢朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "1a97e5e80c5032f50551cb1e2fe0bce4ffa9c8011084b472fa12b556080375b8"}

{"id": "p_a932b26646f34bab", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 147, "text": "今璋得罪左右，備獨竦懼，非所敢聞，願加寬貸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "149b310a407d6b93df6c5f6ce54808fdf6c6c6c5eaf6ecd7d7ae1f8d8046f25f"}

{"id": "p_dcdf81f881972c5d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 148, "text": "若不獲請，備當放發歸於山林。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "1090a50ebc7096cf6788f3a9bc926e07405961ef5a3b46cc6584b5e04ac1b3ff"}

{"id": "p_96db5157657dfa0e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 149, "text": "」後備西圖璋，留關羽守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "2afcdfb9ad76c85072cfdcad96501f37c99d398de509c779f7f835ab039ed6cb"}

{"id": "p_c6d74f0ee4a0f616", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」及羽與肅鄰界，數生狐疑，疆場紛錯，肅常以歡好撫之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "8598cb5b1aee870679ddbe6f72c3623e8e4d3874f1b5a2bfdbb3ef5dab9dac02"}

{"id": "p_0f1cb3a434f00a4d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 151, "text": "備既定益州，權求長沙、零、桂，備不承旨，權遣呂蒙率眾近取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "7dd67111978ae6902186ef34577feb68181203c6ffb3dd5c9d0e8c5d363ec386"}

{"id": "p_01e6117b884863ee", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 152, "text": "備聞，自還公安，遣羽爭三郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "22b673a38169060763351969b238967bacb9d25a3ef7789d8353c4b14285eab7"}

{"id": "p_add75de13a080110", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 153, "text": "肅邀羽相見，各駐兵馬百步上，但諸將軍單刀俱會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "db8693ce6de95f0648af120a8996f897a878f74d1474b911ec64831b05dfe7e0"}

{"id": "p_88129d2fbcc12290", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 154, "text": "肅因責數羽曰：「國家區區本以土地借卿家者，卿家軍敗遠來，無以為資故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "183e3e79ed44016a7798b5eeede9e24189ab4aba025140a2641fd6054503a7e8"}

{"id": "p_606301202afdf06e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 155, "text": "今已得益州，既無奉還之意，但求三郡，又不從命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "09d5c4e20695ce504ef96185db79945b10f3d0aaa63fb0703ff222c529251320"}

{"id": "p_88551ca8f749080d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 156, "text": "」語未究竟，坐有一人曰：「夫土地者，惟德所在耳，何常之有！", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "29997379048f729e1576f4e8b0915b12f603407158915697f419dbd22895bb4e"}

{"id": "p_f7d8857628647930", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 157, "text": "」肅厲聲呵之，辭色甚切。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "cfd1c571a47ca18716f7307fb363705ffaeed4d62028d18063b0653badff7cb2"}

{"id": "p_93cf2eb819fc8ad2", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 158, "text": "羽操刀起謂曰：「此自國家事，是人何知！", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "87849f6972f98f4b4552231c8c953ae78fa0a82339b9ba76a7961be02379cc29"}

{"id": "p_2435c17f8a479000", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 159, "text": "備遂割湘水為界，於是罷軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "22de3a423ee8e73d71cdcc5ad210c20dddacd05871f9a63e8f7aca22fba0536c"}

{"id": "p_1df1d613506c080d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 160, "text": "權稱尊號，臨壇，願謂公卿曰：「昔魯子敬嘗道此，可謂明於事勢矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "bf51df74082e5ddad4d0977054e07f6b6a3f2cbfda4c86cc8a3010ead6ab8b77"}

{"id": "p_58db68c362aadfc5", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 161, "text": "」肅遣腹子淑既壯，濡須督張承謂終當到至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "33c4a851cedaecc27a2cbb289ed58528aca4ce2e1fc02458ab453becdaa4974a"}

{"id": "p_83a1fe872f22cb39", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 162, "text": "永安中，為昭武將軍、都亭侯、武昌督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "6a8edfd2916f5d9b0891fa958926e0dac0ebd60995054ccf62ec33ae855b3598"}

{"id": "p_76569495c0fca0f1", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 163, "text": "建衡中，假節，遷夏口督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "3fec7851c09f4b2c4d60bb4c0127e54d92014adbfd19bce3178987624b041683"}

{"id": "p_d2b2483dc481bf5b", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 164, "text": "呂蒙字子明，汝南富陂人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "d274d61f4bb4bb60b980d89e9ca96c0371f5b42c9169e77a1e3612ee12dc31cc"}

{"id": "p_4c8e08eb76fa7451", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 165, "text": "蒙年十五六，竊隨當擊賊，當顧見大驚，呵叱不能禁止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "2a4be7e07d84f18a0ac0ec260231a3539e34a7ef0563e3fd433d7aead37532d9"}

{"id": "p_e29ce20c08c060a0", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 166, "text": "歸以告蒙母，母恚欲罰之，蒙曰：「貧賤難可居，脫誤有功，富貴可致。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "58a877d7284a47a95d23b5a5b440ef578ba50c7d9f64dbedf271fb86f2392e81"}

{"id": "p_793cd2d986ade753", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 167, "text": "時當職吏以蒙年小輕之，曰：「彼堅子何能為？", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "58eb8bad3062bf26c56b1cfbb4843f6d019736edc8ae10cba19f470c73acc8a2"}

{"id": "p_e7a21001f47c4885", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 168, "text": "」他日與蒙會，又蚩辱之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "d9c54bc497cfd22be27a2388a7f3496cea45181ed8e6f2e939e3b89cdf45e37b"}

{"id": "p_1c9fc3e34b57c134", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 169, "text": "蒙大怒，引刀殺吏，出走，逃邑子鄭長家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "75b9d027379c63ad11009beea45e68f01badb3c5ada444aa20a93df36535318d"}

{"id": "p_21c3170f320360ce", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 170, "text": "出因校尉袁雄自首，承間為言，策召見奇之，引置左右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "5079403befdf5969236dcbd55bf85bc253ef31056999f94a1a27d9d8e6c849e9"}

{"id": "p_b8c5ccb75c89c867", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 171, "text": "數歲，鄧當死，張昭薦蒙代當，拜別部司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "46f0d92f8a5f92095952f84f18875cbbe120e2865594c371bb186cd31b0c497c"}

{"id": "p_b85934ab14708c51", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 172, "text": "權統事，料諸小將兵少而用薄者，欲併合之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "a1fbc4319b7cd25d2345427dbf0943962e6297625c526eef061c3f3294f093fb"}

{"id": "p_7fc622d3ec67f1bb", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 173, "text": "蒙陰賒貰，為兵作絳衣行滕，及簡日，陳列赫然，兵人練習，權見之大悅，增其兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "702f68221d7c8e1e32c92ab86371bf9940197b45a9f1b0d49415232b8b220123"}

{"id": "p_e70514e17e0167e8", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 174, "text": "從討丹楊，所向有功，拜平北都尉，領廣德長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "7bb8bfce294fbcd9fcb74e1e3d30e2a557ead2ea7327f335c21aaffbb98c21c3"}

{"id": "p_7c8bbc0a868ab0af", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 175, "text": "從徵黃祖，祖令都督陳就逆以水軍出戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "a7a4cfae88ca092fd005f228eb34e273afe380e7ad3b1a2e90a972a87c3b5cf1"}

{"id": "p_a8ac5d44aedee484", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 176, "text": "蒙勒前鋒，親梟就首，將士乘勝，進攻其城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "7011678127d45d5e93088c709603072276a179495b97bc2f7614fe2dfd02157c"}

{"id": "p_08bdc80ae0c2408a", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 177, "text": "祖聞就死，委城走，兵追禽之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "ec66a6a2187d9ab505164e3314cc3757179c220d732b135fe89581e0f171c73d"}

{"id": "p_6991f63ca7956345", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 178, "text": "權曰：「事之克，由陳就先獲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "d5ab2f69affb9245c85e150ac069809e6e1f13795b73c8733159a1a71aee90d4"}

{"id": "p_1f6f584e4cfc7195", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 179, "text": "」以蒙為橫野中郎將，賜錢千萬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "8297d19213a06675a55c111d896d5adaf8f2ec85662762766c23b65d077fa583"}

{"id": "p_836677d2e707bc3e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 180, "text": "是歲，又與周瑜、程普等西破曹公於烏林，圍曹仁於南郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "feabb9ee75960e58b36d198c4c69c3202eca3bcc62dce5f060fa146592f8c8e5"}

{"id": "p_49e15fdf578296d2", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 181, "text": "益州將襲肅舉軍來附，瑜表以肅兵益蒙，蒙盛稱肅有膽用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "6ed6e1b5dd7e2a0a1c98cdebd44271c59f5fb99bb107dd11fd71ef041e1c60d6"}

{"id": "p_7e2c008919f78d34", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 182, "text": "且慕化遠來，於義宜益不宜奪也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "7efe1665fc28a8f7680550b17144710b5e262b557a4940e280b72c0ab9de2650"}

{"id": "p_57d5df3f50cb50eb", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 183, "text": "瑜使甘寧前據夷陵，曹仁分眾圍寧，寧困急，使使請救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "ac3168ee129f1bb3bf244bc9cd49d80c394aa697150985d7f9d1a0099aa8aebc"}

{"id": "p_09b2296d74110a13", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 184, "text": "諸將以兵少不足分，蒙謂瑜、普曰：「留凌公績，蒙與君行，解圍釋急，勢亦不久，蒙保公績能十日守也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "ddc72be4468579b635529a00bbffefa92ec320c56b1ea4e34d7263a98c1a7bea"}

{"id": "p_f01a6589662a3811", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 185, "text": "」又說瑜分遣三百人柴斷險道，賊走可得其馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "bab01768815c92a2c8ffee0bafd0827a571aa6c15d132486641a1ad896c32ca2"}

{"id": "p_10bc8ab2998e698d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 186, "text": "軍到夷陵，即日交戰，所殺過半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "70e0c412f739d2eda6d7cf7964610397c1a83ecb27818c4a3b291489674f5176"}

{"id": "p_129fe0b24cac2599", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 187, "text": "敵夜遁去，行遇柴道，騎皆捨馬步走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "f42dd8695caf3e81c672294408538b405802ec3dfaa5013c6228afe85830ebd9"}

{"id": "p_ea008ff4f6d8d6aa", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 188, "text": "兵追蹙擊，獲馬三百匹，方船載還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "df6d1aebfe5c729ad6aa0522a44b5c2052392db4d255f94dc9b26a350539774c"}

{"id": "p_90c6a1c6e3d005fe", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 189, "text": "於是將士形勢自倍，乃渡江立屯，與相攻擊，曹仁退走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "5d4dfa1eda0c24bc369acd660e913fec462e5675013b42b04202fde2e1653009"}

{"id": "p_7015a410217a2f3d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 190, "text": "還，拜偏將軍，領尋陽令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "598df6b8f462998ec01eaf192e596ec10bcb82cbd3332ddeb7a78e33f2479a19"}

{"id": "p_b105b201d49b261a", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 191, "text": "魯肅代周瑜，當之陸口，過蒙屯下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "455f69f3e5b2742fa810cbbbb7436dad91d5ec10768056f3e0ae6a5142ee3bb5"}

{"id": "p_7e057b2e96c2cb6b", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 192, "text": "肅意尚輕蒙，或說肅曰：「呂將軍功名日顯，不可以故意待也，君宜顧之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "f36ff640a7d8c2bd156d2b3c9543bc14e44a55e13d6fddafebc5278969f68297"}

{"id": "p_40192903dda0a737", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 193, "text": "酒酣，蒙問肅曰：「君受重任，與關羽為鄰，將何計畧以備不虞？", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "fbc131a7983bed439b2e3bd96763891680c172b943ce1d8d29961112d0bbf388"}

{"id": "p_ccc099231a5713df", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 194, "text": "」肅造次應曰：「臨時施宜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "fccb4c94905b74a3a7f551e0f035dbdea096a8280c1ff00bac921da9a567e62d"}

{"id": "p_58400529d03f44d2", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 195, "text": "」蒙曰：「今東西雖為一家，而關羽實熊虎也，計安可不豫定？", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "7c0d8e860dc02e9fd4d341d68a24973873bd1eab76d9ae2a339476f6d08763b5"}

{"id": "p_023f2d3845d66df3", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 196, "text": "肅於是越席就之，拊其背曰：「呂子明，吾不知卿才畧所及乃至於此也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "0c26a68fc3c5e8e69226088ed323dc8a82de464800dcd16c72cd13dd0afbe41b"}

{"id": "p_527b22583eb85546", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 197, "text": "時蒙與成當、宋定、徐顧屯次比近，三將死，子弟幼弱，權悉以兵並蒙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "cb93bd4458082041a24dd0500ff42fa69fecd5a687558b2bf13312c7e0a5dd04"}

{"id": "p_de09be964f3ef83e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 198, "text": "蒙固辭，陳啟顧等皆勤勞國事，子弟雖小，不可廢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "7fb5b55822ae465e84127343d834181ef6d870e5ed436b597531a16b981714a7"}

{"id": "p_9e6919f91da94cd6", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 199, "text": "蒙於是又為擇師，使輔導之，其操心率如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "f1d40ecb93cfbd63000d99827f5216c13953da160d70b47b80dba50054bfd95b"}

{"id": "p_ce0b4d5e49e8239f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 200, "text": "魏使廬江謝奇為蘄春典農，屯皖田鄉，數為邊寇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "30dede61fa22a7ba79de815bc51441d522d7cf9acc842c8b00e809e38d35f33e"}

{"id": "p_96b6b46938cff4ac", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 201, "text": "蒙使人誘之，不從，則伺隙襲擊，奇遂縮退，其部伍孫子才、宋豪等，皆攜負老弱，詣蒙降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "f390b29924aab7755742aa10507c577c500dc3e503ce6034c324acf134c03313"}

{"id": "p_fe2455b75a06534d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 202, "text": "後從權拒曹公於濡須，數近奇計，又勸權夾水口立塢，所以備禦甚精，曹公不能下而退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "aaa3eecd449f232e5958019af26ab6a215d03370e35a8e17e2b249d5b6a43a1f"}

{"id": "p_358dec95fe4f052c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 203, "text": "曹公遣朱光為廬江太守，屯皖，大開稻田，又令間人招誘鄱陽賊帥，使作內應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "ac89a481793a3db2d1da0b9b863acb5efc83b7ed59968ad81aa5128d7c4dfae6"}

{"id": "p_ff21383e01b0a25e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 204, "text": "蒙曰：「皖田肥美，若一收孰，彼眾必增，如是數歲，操態見矣，宜早除之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "34d5c8329ee2fdf1da5d828ead5eb29f22d2b509c4fb6462023a597b973d3243"}

{"id": "p_74dae14eaa2295af", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 205, "text": "於是權親征皖，引見諸將，問以計策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "608ff2cd997dd59f2015291237e8be49d4d91fb1fae18d2cf86b19643b349e00"}

{"id": "p_95742ac0cd30d13c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 206, "text": "蒙乃薦甘寧為升城督，督攻在前，蒙以精銳繼之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "55a6bf49e8dac006283097aba2a32db5988585c55ab3250b0b71452d386f77cd"}

{"id": "p_98732516b2d47932", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 207, "text": "侵晨進攻，蒙手執枹鼓，士卒皆騰踴自升，食時破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "b1d41363856fa5e810e7e0669616c88c246aeb24b89c68790fb33cdc362598a6"}

{"id": "p_6ab816c4f71140af", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 208, "text": "既而張遼至夾石，聞城已拔，乃退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "40fa8ed882be293b61af4577b616ee85f112141276a8a50f2a01e5c16bbf1796"}

{"id": "p_9689d7732bf8f022", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 209, "text": "權嘉其功，即拜廬江太守，所得人馬皆分與之，別賜尋陽屯田六百戶，官屬三十人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "bec7f8afd252fa0d5c83b534791abf52953465b0f778a297ea069d809651fef2"}

{"id": "p_4ed9b57b45912db4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 210, "text": "蒙還尋陽，未期而盧陵賊起，諸將討擊不能禽，權曰：「鷙鳥累百，不如一鶚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "e3b3f23b0212a5f88017e2bd535fd37900aedc228cc36012025afe39e85e17c8"}

{"id": "p_6ae1f9b8d021f50c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 211, "text": "蒙至，誅其首惡，餘皆釋放，復為平民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "e94334e9098289a7106ebee27ff5c13146dba42168c4e1b1fd608dc06b6f5a8b"}

{"id": "p_28d6c6eae898a1b0", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 212, "text": "是時劉備令關羽鎮守，專有荊士，權命蒙西取長沙、零、桂三郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "f4ac122e96f705423e3465dd8893ee87b20acee45f761aad8eeec03cc7fbcafe"}

{"id": "p_a5538a2656474345", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 213, "text": "蒙移書二郡，望風歸服，惟零陵太守郝普城守不降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "e21704010fb68f6297e42bb6d9d8392beeccf99d696905e9dde9ca144f6815e0"}

{"id": "p_eecc3617e2fa03f4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 214, "text": "而備自蜀親至公安，遣羽爭三郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "99a0f3cc056603d7d49d3233cf519025ffd42d8d5a99bb4d347b50863ca5850c"}

{"id": "p_4bcebf9bdbd0e421", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 215, "text": "權時住陸口，使魯肅萬人屯益陽拒羽，而飛書召蒙，使捨零陵，急還助肅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "ff7598aa54213f4b1fb4d3ee021b17319e31e123185548646fd6a1f6e67551ab"}

{"id": "p_14257f2e8e7c46e1", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 216, "text": "初，蒙既定長沙，當之零陵，過酃，載南陽鄧玄之，玄之者郝普之舊也，欲令誘普。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "9f73302cb0245237da19a192cb7fcbaf13273b35a700957e1c6fc6567afb8eef"}

{"id": "p_bb315261f7f0ea3f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 217, "text": "夜召諸將，授以方畧，晨當攻城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "aa59cddc100d2648505ec8fc314faa54dc30cd08ae1955ec06cc2e4f4aacddc7"}

{"id": "p_5081e8172ac642f8", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 218, "text": "玄之見普，具宣蒙意，普懼而聽之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "3858d1041211763ec5b4bd39e7909044d0527fc3568891505a37420566b304c4"}

{"id": "p_503a21f47ee1b722", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 219, "text": "玄之先出報蒙：「普尋後當至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "72488dfe5c0570a50b3d1ab29e86ae6e703f02e863aac59b3a8ce98a6823ec64"}

{"id": "p_5fc674e1caf8c82e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 220, "text": "」蒙豫敕四將，各選百人，普出，便入守城門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "f9f9e335e954afb7d2e23a91d8582b1a71bb17aa8f1f7cd6e83113f4356f79e0"}

{"id": "p_3d8c5369f53adb07", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 221, "text": "須臾普出，蒙迎執其手，與俱下船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "74f93b352017e4a38d9a0d08aede97b75c133e5a66ba0c3671222cf3b937b88c"}

{"id": "p_11b5914858253544", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 222, "text": "普見書，知備在公安，而羽在益陽，慚恨入地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "e61cc5fc79d70f80ed2efd01d978da33b775a0152fa4fa29de1c1943a3179220"}

{"id": "p_6c847ffddffd49e1", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 223, "text": "蒙留（孫河），委以後事，即日引軍赴益陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "1bf04ff1f9d5b5302e9d77bef19e2ebce7e8afe5864857b2dd55d06614d518f1"}

{"id": "p_d13d994bff1971dc", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 224, "text": "師還，遂徵合肥，既撤兵，為張遼等所襲，蒙與淩統以死扦衛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "649d9c923102d652f48fbd3bff8f4be1fc9e7b684fc0401c033cf89c21ee9631"}

{"id": "p_263a488af2edcdb4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 225, "text": "後曹公又大出濡須，權以蒙為督，據前所立塢，置強弩萬張於其上，以拒曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "f419c6c61906b1a70d4d5969327097d30385f7d86fbc54a336449248c2031d15"}

{"id": "p_c166fe640236518d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 226, "text": "曹公前鋒屯未就，蒙攻破之，曹公引退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "b0d05bb0b90e27bca6a17108bb95859144ec0c68b0c72933000fc6ec369e1933"}

{"id": "p_ffa8c147466c045c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 227, "text": "魯肅卒，蒙西屯陸口，肅軍人馬萬餘盡以屬蒙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "ea797a20d90aa1f7ef011943139dd3e905488d5b65810334c0859453ff1b0059"}

{"id": "p_a430a152ad1bcb02", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 228, "text": "又拜漢昌太守，食下雋、劉陽、漢昌、州陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "ea7f9444c95650bff800491253ac99eb8447b8a6bb3bb0530aa5802de51e7178"}

{"id": "p_063e960d883a0f6b", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 229, "text": "與關羽分土接境，知羽驍雄，有並兼心，且居國上流，其勢難久。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "7afec422dc8289132054a8cb9ab3c23ef04553cd4f78f01c9fd415b4d68c908a"}

{"id": "p_a840442b32f9894c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 230, "text": "初，魯肅等以為曹公尚存，禍難始構，宜相輔協，與之同仇，不可失也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "6bb6b3f8959c7e55f0a6607264d6c7adcc0b82b5dedde92178445aab8ae0aa84"}

{"id": "p_ca5b831d73640ded", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 231, "text": "蒙乃密陳計策曰：「今令徵虜守南郡，潘璋住白帝，蔣欽將遊兵萬人循江上下，應敵所在，蒙為國家前據襄陽，如此，何憂於操，何賴於羽？", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "9a152ceb7bcb17a53fa0ac0449d0dceb7cffbce69335a39915fd19af7d058cab"}

{"id": "p_3aed4caf6f2409a0", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 232, "text": "且羽君臣，矜其詐力，所在反覆，不可以腹心待也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "b09d833a6f690989c8f681728f9e73fc17ab3de91f166ea6f71865dd01b7b021"}

{"id": "p_005972c694c65574", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 233, "text": "今羽所以未便東向者，以至尊聖明，蒙等尚存也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "8034b425decd2d982d890de0a2e26aee79060137c1ecba5410093368c63732c9"}

{"id": "p_7c8cc9fc99b150be", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 234, "text": "今不於強壯時圖之，一日僵僕，欲復陳力，其可得邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "c6866589bbc8a4d164c03015c80876cc121caa51f2c75ec2896325af8a4785fc"}

{"id": "p_289806c546017efe", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 235, "text": "」權深納其策，又聊復與論取徐州意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "1287e225ee4fa14c868b33f171b2af964fcbd1209b759033c347dcf062f160bc"}

{"id": "p_c19828b45fd4fc36", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 236, "text": "蒙對曰：「今操遠在河北，新破諸袁，撫集幽、冀，未暇東顧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "b3d17abd10a09a9a05b593418050bc7f472af134b8f64dd53bd205cc9aaf897f"}

{"id": "p_bea021997a6da908", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 237, "text": "徐土守兵，聞不足言，往自可克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "89220570f4cbdbca04049af41042b75333b5cb9c1b0e4203211c07f9e7d1aaf9"}

{"id": "p_12e8dfc60bd4028f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 238, "text": "然地勢陸通，驍騎所聘，至尊今日得徐州，操後旬必來爭，雖以七八萬人守之，猶當懷憂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "f15f4458d5cc6d57cf1769f6abcf6a7e4ae28137cf448eeaa0ccb54444c64565"}

{"id": "p_34199356f87fe7f9", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 239, "text": "不如取羽，全據長江，形勢益張。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "baec0b1bc5d4853bd236d6faa66390f73052decedf6ed7589da250d3ad020522"}

{"id": "p_8228d21e5c68ef9c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 240, "text": "及蒙代肅，初至陸口，外倍修恩厚，與羽結好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "9ae6e7051e936a22d661ef553c4d7b91f8bc392b8f79f5d97421ea9efdeed67c"}

{"id": "p_22047f46d3c10ce6", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 241, "text": "後羽討樊，留兵將備公安、南郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "f9017f0204bde57148adaf326824ec6e7a568375bfe62a3938953a0d9decc263"}

{"id": "p_95893918bf3c3309", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 242, "text": "蒙上疏曰：「羽討樊而多留備兵，必恐蒙圖其後故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "83c8d9c264b300279ecb84b276db5ba55e82624d1aeb6e83157755cf4cfa4374"}

{"id": "p_d1b1df22fa05db53", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 243, "text": "蒙常有病，乞分士眾還建業，以治疾為名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "3398380f5753c729284bd9b4066bcab6bf675eafa30eddbf76410829b6fb6599"}

{"id": "p_579e7c8fbf6c9c91", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 244, "text": "羽聞之，必撤備兵，盡赴襄陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "e00c3c2b08f56456a5bbb47ab574fcfff3c9a9297e54fda0d0454f99e1825284"}

{"id": "p_f218bc6e3f79a33c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 245, "text": "大軍浮江，晝夜馳上，襲其空虛，則南郡可下，而羽可擒也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "059208ad632509e6675b891bbec7f0ef4d2759f04eb710ec0950e8c79a7ba696"}

{"id": "p_5ba004781284b61b", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 246, "text": "」遂稱病篤，權乃露檄召蒙還，陰與圖計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "c3a4fc0883682768b7f6e29c0c8424863cd2c71cf18ae5712a53cf4cba7b540b"}

{"id": "p_e38e509d76c46f89", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 247, "text": "羽果信之，稍撤兵以赴樊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "78e63bb2adb5f491166d4eab4648e4917cd66f8848089d1763ff1f0def2f33d1"}

{"id": "p_bcc5541cec3cb997", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 248, "text": "魏使于禁救樊，羽盡擒禁等，人馬數萬，託以糧乏，擅取湘關米。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "6ae2795f40354c1b58eacd1d4092c30618b95e74c8d6a1295ee35a58825c4d27"}

{"id": "p_2fe650ba87301ac3", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 249, "text": "蒙至尋陽，盡伏其精兵𦩷𦪇中，使白衣搖櫓，作商賈人服，晝夜兼行，至羽所置江邊屯候，盡收縛之，是故羽不聞知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "b0de0f67624869d832e584e13c25dd77a27bd0bdddaff11bd49c76e9d46a38a0"}

{"id": "p_122d484d1b33f7da", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 250, "text": "遂到南郡，士仁、麋芳皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "5a2c52cdd9d8aefd0bca9b6c096e0aa21f3a0899d378c4268b927f1684b31f7a"}

{"id": "p_10844f39c315c4a4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 251, "text": "蒙入據城，盡得羽及將士家屬，皆撫慰，約令軍中不得乾歷人家，有所求取。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "52bff1bed059b9ebbc5be7b40af9bd5bc2033ff88da26ed07c791ca7bae6f0b6"}

{"id": "p_eaf277c6f17c59e8", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 252, "text": "蒙麾下士，是汝南人，取民家一笠，以覆官鎧，官鎧雖公，蒙猶以為犯軍令，不可以鄉里故而廢法，遂垂涕斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "cbbc509c5833216b2477d274e117832ce6975fc6e7f79abeacea7448337c0e1a"}

{"id": "p_4eeac5361142e83f", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 253, "text": "於是軍中震慄，道不拾遺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "d855804b0f9062eec159f25ba825785222e6ef6b94f6c66e020cdaef3a1b7c69"}

{"id": "p_e172a11b78af518c", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 254, "text": "蒙旦暮使親近存卹耆老，問所不足，疾病者給醫藥，饑寒者賜衣糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "357fbd2f89276d4ca064498a950eeaae06dfd5592ddd21734dc4c3ffe5a1c4be"}

{"id": "p_b6b817e6ac91a9e4", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 255, "text": "羽府藏財寶，皆封閉以待權至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "3a54b62ed6c79810b1cf97096eb7b53eb002f6d54640dbadf746bfc21fe31bc8"}

{"id": "p_2a426f29c726ba32", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 256, "text": "羽還，在道路，數使人與蒙相聞，蒙輒厚遇其使，周遊城中，家家致問，或手書示信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "36c98a87f5304b404f6705e8d8ddaaf12c06c63df8cf479a0f1e07fddf527db9"}

{"id": "p_d32eb0ce4388314e", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 257, "text": "羽人還，私相參訊，咸知家門無恙，見待過於平時，故羽吏士無鬬心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "9d8f03293b9ec8ed1cb327bb70f56a8757cf34f32cf508743bbfbf400973b6cf"}

{"id": "p_94a2e450e9611ffc", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 258, "text": "會權尋至，羽自知孤窮，乃走麥城，西至漳鄉，眾皆委羽而降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "0d7ad495b42f33e3d86562e91a07fdf7519f21bea97337d2637344d8663fe838"}

{"id": "p_eee7e3a27b524024", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 259, "text": "權使朱然、潘璋斷其徑路，即父子俱獲，荊州遂定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "e2fb662fd4901e1c56b97673004d533726acc686864ade1fa35e1f1068dacd9a"}

{"id": "p_19fceb7d081b47bd", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 260, "text": "以蒙為南郡太守，封孱陵候，賜錢一億，黃金五百斤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "1d688932c6c4f6dad57482388193de243432fed66edfd94f1f64a775eef0c973"}

{"id": "p_098cc61fa1a55c29", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 261, "text": "會蒙疾發，權時在公安，迎置內殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "4035157b2df897bc7ebc00b3d77e0f9da67087ce2a4a8f5d4f8c1bdd01d69c71"}

{"id": "p_3f37414045fee0d2", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 262, "text": "所以治護者萬方，募封內有能愈蒙疾者，賜千金。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "4da5f458272f5bc4e52f8ce93d60d0eb46aca3b9d0e8bcb0c21a967d4b28120f"}

{"id": "p_03ccceddb4831f52", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 263, "text": "時有針加，權為之慘戚，欲數見其顏色，又恐勞動，常穿壁瞻之，見小能下食則喜，顧左右言笑，不然則咄唶，夜不能寐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "24d2d90236119b1d0cee90a2970e3bdad3560931683ade55105b140582cd4fcb"}

{"id": "p_f5644c64671439d7", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 264, "text": "病中瘳，為下赦令，群臣畢賀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "c51e287d5f64378f5b2607e606b8fd932b3a1ae99f8c250559688f19a8d821ef"}

{"id": "p_0123dd19f2081d69", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 265, "text": "後更增篤，權自臨視，命道士於星辰下為之請命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "2959ee56d360a1be1fb786ed57525f1815b772baf06cf21beadb498cb465e062"}

{"id": "p_535f358621d2d309", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 266, "text": "蒙未死時，所得金寶諸賜盡付府藏，敕主者命絕之日皆上還，喪事務約。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "8a5ffb41ca64a204f67948fe87e3ae0fa3db79d6ac0c59015022c12f7114ec25"}

{"id": "p_f8b9a4ccec2cda12", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 267, "text": "蒙少不修書傳，每陳大事，常口占為箋疏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "59fcfdbb60695534796d52eaeefd9e2f5cb6b844db85dfd083f7706c6215e69a"}

{"id": "p_57577cb984d93abe", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 268, "text": "常以部曲事為江夏太守蔡遺所白，蒙無恨意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "54c7ab5373085b1c6e12953d2db5ca426fdc4f22d6a53dea7e99d1bd66c816d6"}

{"id": "p_72a185e7d727edeb", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 269, "text": "及豫章太守顧邵卒，權問所用，蒙因薦遺奉職佳吏，權笑曰：「君欲為祁奚耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "d1190ad4b50332e75eecb2a28cb48f804407d19b35a3787fd6a176f92a9c296d"}

{"id": "p_4cc310edcd509221", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 270, "text": "甘寧粗暴好殺，既常失蒙意，又時違權令，權怒之，蒙輒陳請：「天下未定，鬥將如寧難得，宜容忍之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "13ea6eb351917147febb0aae4e41fb99b626ee3f5f8a7f10818cfe0e32779bd6"}

{"id": "p_fc83752a298a877d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 271, "text": "蒙子霸襲爵，與守塚三百家，復田五十頃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "d172103e065832bd891346cf0b96372c7594be6c5a8af8238059f8b20440dff1"}

{"id": "p_40c1321e047ff570", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 272, "text": "孫權與陸遜論周瑜、魯肅及蒙曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "9da47e5438c4849338d7776b25e88d2c821a2af721ec61bdbca00e1c9aac741d"}

{"id": "p_c814ab79bbe751b7", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 273, "text": "評曰：曹公乘漢相之資，挾天子而掃群桀，新蕩荊城，仗威東夏，於時議者莫不疑貳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "d53ed53490247143853e24bec9be0617f05373a5b7b1740cea95e9be9393114b"}

{"id": "p_d6dba51e95e0cd81", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 274, "text": "周瑜、魯肅建獨斷之明出眾人之表，實奇才也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "13cc3b22ce910885b16ec53b56b6c3be6805ec6496d515f4d27129abfb82944b"}

{"id": "p_1cd9ec71809ef592", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 275, "text": "呂蒙勇而有謀，斷識軍計，譎郝普，禽關羽，最其妙者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "87f19b5a4e10d0b6c20f6a6a690d0bfad42c9667d773cb252a20083490dd60ad"}

{"id": "p_8e228e7c8f6ded24", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 276, "text": "初雖輕果妄殺，終於克己，有國士之量，豈徒武將而已乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "f11e8cc19fbefba8669ce02e1e3ab7ff1a012cd48f5b67da2512d2165a638767"}

{"id": "p_86c48760760aa17d", "source_id": "src_dbcf027d30cd527e", "ordinal": 277, "text": "孫權之論，優劣允當，故載錄焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "b9f442cc1fcca2419fe41397bce4cff482c2e31909507cab6e2d422106ac8e59"}

{"id": "p_ee34f8b18dcc7fc1", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_ab52b3cca20b23c0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 1, "text": "程普字德謀，右北平土垠人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "43173a47ba7b74909aba84c8b831f45b95962294916ecb0475d1c26c888ffdf2"}

{"id": "p_69994c220bb09da6", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 2, "text": "初爲州郡吏，有容貌計略，善於應對。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "744db10a376fccc5dad02679177cf44bfd8c2b1971b596cdf807fed3052bffc9"}

{"id": "p_a03c11764ddd7a96", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 3, "text": "從孫堅征伐，討黃巾於宛、鄧，破董卓於陽人，攻城野戰，身被創夷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "06bea490849ca2266ebea4ba39e50f9d91ecfbd28b08379b8ca653d86dfd3136"}

{"id": "p_bb42dd66b7128121", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 4, "text": "堅薨，復隨孫策在淮南，從攻廬江，拔之，還俱東渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "9689b55346249ddbfea2975642edd252fa699cac9049e847b9a8c2648022ec34"}

{"id": "p_938aa4f18ce8afa0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 5, "text": "策到橫江、當利，破張英、于麋等，轉下秣陵、湖熟、句容、曲阿，普皆有功，增兵二千，騎五十匹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "1ca10519e125fdd970260f74ab35a4d080c078e95f453414ee55ccd5044bbbef"}

{"id": "p_84e7f84ae1db6264", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 6, "text": "進破烏程、石木、波門、陵傳、餘杭，普功爲多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "265f78cc914ef2e7512def05856106e8dfbaf2a3b05b9db502d654e14e0fd94d"}

{"id": "p_05047c2481cb1f21", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 7, "text": "策入會稽，以普爲吳郡都尉，治錢唐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "48ccd700b1a7ace139d4e6e46ad4398d1bec2f2564a1c211f7790a51966bd697"}

{"id": "p_b74008f6c46c434a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 8, "text": "復討宣城、涇、安吳、陵陽、春穀諸賊，皆破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "a0897beb37cc6cbeaadbb393a22839a4af549513a92c03e25e983ac09f369f54"}

{"id": "p_b862f0ec0cf67cb3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 9, "text": "策甞攻祖郎，大爲所圍，普與一騎共蔽扞策，驅馬疾呼，以矛突賊，賊披，策因隨出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "5edbad7927df0229b995f36b8df352ccfa61edc5fcb90bd80a849e703496fc91"}

{"id": "p_8f7ba5bced39c041", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 10, "text": "後拜盪寇中郎將，領零陵太守，從討劉勳於尋陽，進攻黃祖於沙羨，還鎮石城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "3d25f5ab336e75c8f62a17855c70aef61f13fafce5ffcde55875e40534ebf6f5"}

{"id": "p_097f633e52a19b27", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 11, "text": "策薨，與張昭等共輔孫權，遂周旋三郡，平討不服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "98ea5e1c04530383fdba218620d627df5f237aa941046865a0b0416b8c2cd32f"}

{"id": "p_88dc00a5e431a5cf", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 12, "text": "又從征江夏，還過豫章，別討樂安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "743d7875c7de5455ab5df1e957c50cb61d4cd1776bf670754d7b383799759822"}

{"id": "p_3843a11074e24aef", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 13, "text": "樂安平定，代太史慈備海昏，與周瑜爲左右督，破曹公於烏林，又進攻南郡，走曹仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "57005e37f265bcfe7aa287b88e86979e6a85ddec76a13f416bbc8e6e8d29d218"}

{"id": "p_642e00950c1e6f22", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 14, "text": "拜裨將軍，領江夏太守，治沙羨，食四縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "e63425b09e4550a8669da623f5c61d0e40b9b5493a724bb28f16ffac9d3b7d18"}

{"id": "p_76dfd1fbf300afe9", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 15, "text": "先出諸將，普最年長，時人皆呼程公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "b180451f185a6963d5a3f37244d42b5688dde6f17d061b90a029151523b0adfb"}

{"id": "p_a97456cb1543600d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 16, "text": "權分荊州與劉備，普復還領江夏，遷盪寇將軍，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "ed63a2d53ed344a1d8c705cb6e581cb4b7f0d5bee19ba7127dd5c321310334f0"}

{"id": "p_c32c8888931b894f", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 17, "text": "權稱尊號，追論普功，封子咨爲亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "cfc75d1951e8dfefcff00d05870e040b863e60423880178b1dab25b27b438f9b"}

{"id": "p_c2c27105515a8308", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 18, "text": "黃蓋字公覆，零陵泉陵人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "b9a54aef2c689c725a9b05a652cf24de718bcfb6675593093b2a3c8973ce3ae4"}

{"id": "p_6677b094b7d3d693", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 19, "text": "初爲郡吏，察孝廉，辟公府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "2ab7def8baf2a2d9bfa23b9424d170409504bd74f1c09d860db309079034509b"}

{"id": "p_708206638825cd39", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 20, "text": "堅南破山賊，北走董卓，拜蓋別部司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "4f2dbb6b3eb0d39ccd34d99249c400a0c060f4a12eb7405df1e64d87440667d3"}

{"id": "p_53f143c6b455d6b4", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 21, "text": "堅薨，蓋隨策及權，擐甲周旋，蹈刃屠城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "40a6da618a96dcc1f30d0a402b8a390898369209d2361130a5640da8539dfc07"}

{"id": "p_7a835c0056215223", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 22, "text": "諸山越不賔，有寇難之縣，輙用蓋爲守長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "38aaad734a15a92d6fa79bfe69e3db675f32cdc15c948a93b180edcce700f980"}
