{"id": "p_5e614998a4970a6b", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 23, "text": "石城縣吏，特難檢御，蓋乃署兩掾，分主諸曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "ffff6d3eb8ba666c5dc3518a661e60228e38e85b46626a067ff3c5f27a6dc94f"}

{"id": "p_282b352a7b472602", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 24, "text": "教曰：「令長不德，徒以武功爲官，不以文吏爲稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "88cd4fd0f730e074c6899c3029e0a5e519028641b07d98e920c6d947c6237bd4"}

{"id": "p_cb8987030c6cc228", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 25, "text": "今賊寇未平，有軍旅之務，一以文書委付兩掾，當檢攝諸曹，糾擿謬誤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "e6d24d4cce96e20202274edeeb4d5bea5cbadb8c77596cb7c97af7f982904567"}

{"id": "p_225980187b369d77", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 26, "text": "兩掾所署，事入諾出，若有姦欺，終不加以鞭杖，宜各盡心，無爲衆先。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "d0b9b6b3841cda62337aa31b844ab736ea142d386bfe351dbed38deca8141d44"}

{"id": "p_a87593d2c20f6c0f", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」初皆怖威，夙夜恭職；久之，吏以蓋不視文書，漸容人事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "f8d6472c72b7367ba6044d604abcdb46e05e05b4f4b50b5bf487aeb3c13ab205"}

{"id": "p_072a63e09f727f16", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 28, "text": "蓋亦嫌外懈怠，時有所省，各得兩掾不奉法數事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "8d9a75a1a3e1aa0584f36b2754a973eb3b958a2ca10a46affd1f5bccc86f10e6"}

{"id": "p_72b8704587ef241f", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 29, "text": "乃悉請諸掾吏，賜酒食，因出事詰問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "15882437c108005d2b975f59f386a2d8cc63e03dff3387e85b98eb3f1d95b471"}

{"id": "p_bd11ba2b1b441b9c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 30, "text": "蓋曰：「前已相勑，終不以鞭杖相加，非相欺也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "4e547fd5bfa3b30e43c645f2e702952a6efc90ebc6960589f794e152dafbf5da"}

{"id": "p_7ba718d472384901", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 31, "text": "遷丹楊都尉，抑彊扶弱，山越懷附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "65c6ce829b131a6049d691e9554fd1e470558ea1ea49f6ffe6206d961078ebaa"}

{"id": "p_a33a621bed0ecb6d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 32, "text": "蓋姿貌嚴毅，善於養衆，每所征討，士卒皆爭爲先。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "87505c74fb1f4125cbbf07b5af9775a46922d4fcee28e5f2e51d997a1d79fc5c"}

{"id": "p_429b083a637770c3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 33, "text": "建安中，隨周瑜拒曹公於赤壁，建策火攻，語在〈瑜傳〉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "f1e54076bde6eb19a51f403e9e0b6724e691c01ba9fa75966da09f4fdd0a8684"}

{"id": "p_013159c387f0db9e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 34, "text": "武陵蠻夷反亂，攻守城邑，乃以蓋領太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "0a9ff79aca4da1bb0c7af0965ebea2866691ce0d2dc6e77f306f7e64765b9557"}

{"id": "p_4f3078002ddea107", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 35, "text": "時郡兵才五百人，自以不敵，因開城門，賊半入，乃擊之，斬首數百，餘皆奔走，盡歸邑落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "78145125422b6e0b92e6d1fdfa607ed2fd265c1b3d9a54878384567f1126d776"}

{"id": "p_b8c877adb55b790b", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 36, "text": "自春訖夏，寇亂盡平，諸幽邃巴、醴、由、誕邑侯君長，皆改操易節，奉禮請見，郡境遂清。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "ce9d951cefe4fc94a32482d6a5140ea57f8c6fe335ab36ded3358c5924242e90"}

{"id": "p_5c8f039af8613b84", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 37, "text": "後長沙益陽縣爲山賊所攻，蓋又平討。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "991d90b23763152556a62b7e212df653ed9ecf85f3b34ab321857b45f0edf8a6"}

{"id": "p_def7ded54ff58733", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 38, "text": "蓋當官決斷，事無留滯，國人思之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "4de954e1bd4905c55b513caca505ea95da1409afe87a4326aa6f13ab1965cb99"}

{"id": "p_1d63f541c26ba5e7", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 39, "text": "及權踐阼，追論其功，賜子柄爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "ec61fffe5188700b9bd703ec37caf5a106c1838e5aea3bc10b91e5adfca785ae"}

{"id": "p_ae104def088692be", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 40, "text": "韓當字義公，遼西令支人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "f99bff20b69a1366e3c3dc02f18cc3a9219ffd1f89faf4245699f59c2a896252"}

{"id": "p_d3d1f772b52ac907", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 41, "text": "以便弓馬，有膂力，幸於孫堅，從征伐周旋，數犯危難，陷敵擒虜，爲別部司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "b49978a6cb31c7262828be0a0c6475f60b24acf5a8500465b31ee24573a74a2b"}

{"id": "p_746396c543b3b724", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 42, "text": "及孫策東渡，從討三郡，遷先登校尉，授兵二千，騎五十匹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "b9b3469c455df9df2eb17c26b923bd67bdd37f841a03f1de9d4a45c585f7832a"}

{"id": "p_98d4c49a3e5496cc", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 43, "text": "從征劉勳，破黃祖，還討鄱陽，領樂安長，山越畏服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "738935ab93ce4d2abd879b4459432e0e476d5bc33bcacbcc2262056b0d6a0d6f"}

{"id": "p_06bfcd92df7bfaeb", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 44, "text": "後以中郎將與周瑜等拒破曹公，又與呂蒙襲取南郡，遷偏將軍，領永昌太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "65002fb20bb9d49fcc71f1f1de4f652a2d834d8978d7fd1f0c31b091b738c945"}

{"id": "p_42840c610c935dce", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 45, "text": "宜都之役，與陸遜、朱然等共攻蜀軍於涿鄉，大破之，徙威烈將軍，封都亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "baa0f50a30fb058fd3596cd3324efb38d07ee4e1e67c9af36c7330326a31d3ba"}

{"id": "p_c437a745a3d5bb09", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 46, "text": "在外爲帥，厲將士同心固守，又敬望督司，奉遵法令，權善之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "06c188a7ec7aeef8b1a6e11f48a31843a02eb7caaf64472df23574de6861ff59"}

{"id": "p_8e14bd87dc32d78d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 47, "text": "，封石城侯，遷昭武將軍，領冠軍太守，後又加都督之號。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "20893930182928236ae16e39bc351bb947775733d431c7dff9b70657537f6999"}

{"id": "p_72762c9dd2e6d3fb", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 48, "text": "將敢死及解煩兵萬人，討丹楊賊，破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "1b3b43429e926034534d522efee871c9be00e140398f79d9f782e237696e42d3"}

{"id": "p_74bec3fd65d6dd10", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 49, "text": "其年，權征石陽，以綜有憂，使守武昌，而綜淫亂不軌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "3a420b56fa18dbe51cf53b734ec02c2705fb6daaa31c097d4db790861e62ff1c"}

{"id": "p_3f6fa78d67de6953", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 50, "text": "權雖以父故不問，綜內懷懼，載父喪，將母家屬部曲男女數千人奔魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "a345a94913b348341dc18d808a302e6edbc6d2aed67800c937dd5ed97be371de"}

{"id": "p_2a55284b85851442", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 51, "text": "數犯邊境，殺害人民，權常切齒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "b3767e417a086e4c4461b122874d6c0e4851844609579d1f7832ff82e1c834ea"}

{"id": "p_ef1b7a8b59d6c5e5", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 52, "text": "東興之役，綜爲前鋒，軍敗身死，諸葛恪斬送其首，以白權廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "630149a3d11d1c4edf8e006ca90cfbbda8a89a84229f0d105a04df1b6507399d"}

{"id": "p_435f97f4782e0c5f", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 53, "text": "蔣欽字公弈，九江壽春人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "1e7423aafabe1f165e108f0c1dc879db6e90e89934f1f3969ccb2338bc1139c0"}

{"id": "p_95153f578941dff1", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 54, "text": "孫策之襲袁術，欽隨從給事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "a769cc1e66a652708b41e441ed28b9d883fd7ce1d26f46b255a717a56987237e"}

{"id": "p_d7ad4aee8960df70", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 55, "text": "及策東渡，拜別部司馬，授兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "9803886f97deffd4972a213c47aaa19a3d015a6c65316657f0a53826036c2de0"}

{"id": "p_46575a1db828a035", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 56, "text": "與策周旋，平定三郡，又從定豫章。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "3d66d000c786478894c8bbd73be073962b4a2e6c0e2cf698bea4dfce35fab036"}

{"id": "p_c91e3d5ed5bf8b4b", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 57, "text": "調授葛陽尉，歷三縣長，討平盜賊，遷西部都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "3bcd897665a7c7d36350800e67b6c31194a27fb6e524f368d3f2e9096fe04142"}

{"id": "p_ecc4ceccaba5176e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 58, "text": "會稽冶賊呂合、秦狼等爲亂，欽將兵討擊，遂禽合、狼，五縣平定，徙討越中郎將，以涇拘、昭陽爲奉邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "ec4ae5236fb42f7d8e24f1043b32b5adb4180f17137a3abbcf0b21b0ffb23f39"}

{"id": "p_cbdec605445f785a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 59, "text": "賀齊討黝賊，欽督萬兵，與齊并力，黝賊平定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "2e4f765e51b5420b344a9706cc034462ed66570d0c75f20d323e5271e2b3df0f"}

{"id": "p_872fbb7b93231fed", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 60, "text": "從征合肥，魏將張遼襲權於津北，欽力戰有功，遷盪寇將軍，領濡須督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "6c818af31afffdea4f19ad7759afb5452519f8fb6eff670b0d5112c674dc09d3"}

{"id": "p_ad2fbd57ac725a3a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 61, "text": "後召還都，拜津右護軍，典領辭訟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "ae92032cbb3814a78694d5d94923981fd35ea4fdc156970dc33c58fa6ec5d9a7"}

{"id": "p_a4a11c1aec241119", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 62, "text": "權甞入其堂內，母踈帳縹被，妻妾布裙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "fd0f506e840c6abb9dd1bd4b7f521f9643b824e0990be022ddc81523af414cb8"}

{"id": "p_eccb96a166f2a291", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 63, "text": "權歎其在貴守約，即勑御府爲母作錦被，改易帷帳，妻妾衣服悉皆錦繡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "49fc7807747544bddba05fd45cec8015318ce30f3032418711efd693df9f683d"}

{"id": "p_c53ddeff1d071d9e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 64, "text": "初，欽屯宣城，甞討豫章賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "b5023cb14c1bdcda728510a938f2131f3fe9cf484b14bc8502322680171e59f3"}

{"id": "p_571abf642e09a3d9", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 65, "text": "蕪湖令徐盛收欽屯吏，表斬之，權以欽在遠不許，盛由是自嫌於欽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "f6a141aed5241007b430e4f7796c65c93b5f4c55c02f3095d501389520a91232"}

{"id": "p_a28cff7f14608797", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 66, "text": "曹公出濡須，欽與呂蒙持諸軍節度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "e3a8eb090e83a4e513cdd91ede522f76bcff08cc1d718f498d38445158a8d2c3"}

{"id": "p_f2795c0571bd649d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 67, "text": "盛常畏欽因事害己，而欽每稱其善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "5a461c959e80d78b1144c10633e62291f2a6cae2f58069473d54e720fa94790f"}

{"id": "p_7c0ce148aa7af03b", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 68, "text": "權討關羽，欽督水軍入沔，還，道病卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "e962c86e5e15bbb41681d89793c57bad93ba57d19477d0578be862b79e22732a"}

{"id": "p_f8ca35488ff1857e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 69, "text": "權素服舉哀，以蕪湖民二百戶、田二百頃，給欽妻子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "32df24cdae2ab1e7b3baccbb06e8dfe58647c9cc7c98fe673883b49ea46394a5"}

{"id": "p_0d0b3bc6323acbff", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 70, "text": "子壹封宣城侯，領兵拒劉備有功，還赴南郡，與魏交戰，臨陣卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "ce41e2d0342228085a85ccff95feb460d5462eb26c19f30d980880633e7f41f1"}

{"id": "p_8c2ef3f3ef6571a2", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 71, "text": "壹無子，弟休領兵，後有罪失業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "7b1e9dd96b3ef4205bdb7139edfc01f70006678f42a40e778f231baa2ed8e6d0"}

{"id": "p_d73daa719a56ed0a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 72, "text": "周泰字幼平，九江下蔡人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "f4f20d117aafb57d89ecbf694c2bb872492dc4e4f60454dd4d2ac06c1a942ab1"}

{"id": "p_3da05b8dd0fe7f56", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 73, "text": "與蔣欽隨孫策爲左右，服事恭敬，數戰有功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "7444d1dee0970b87337442d9bccf6f616d48fb34d0a046072f538fed7c922467"}

{"id": "p_d37b00448ca1b705", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 74, "text": "策入會稽，署別部司馬，授兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "4790ac939e7f397824865f439442abb37e500f5d1f685602ed84e56d4f56b6e9"}

{"id": "p_916ceded0343ecc6", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 75, "text": "策討六縣山賊，權住宣城，使士自衞，不能千人，意尚忽略，不治圍落，而山賊數千人卒至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "f33ac9cf440b26c6c5b763e44806aa4cac476642297079328ce64159c7c771b1"}

{"id": "p_f9fe5191aad30f39", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 76, "text": "權始得上馬，而賊鋒刃已交於左右，或斫中馬鞌，衆莫能自定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "272566238351e2caad1dd2a43e523a12d1ce3b161884c2c048a30dad2d1e4d37"}

{"id": "p_c7ec87c1d428cda9", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 77, "text": "惟泰奮激，投身衞權，膽氣倍人，左右由泰並能就戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "e9c100a2c1245824a27ce961e3a817f00e28ea694c675568014549035d967915"}

{"id": "p_51302618f3a00195", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 78, "text": "賊旣解散，身被十二創，良乆乃蘇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "ebfddd6d1fb147c141051cebf5be1fe85c9cefa04a06e36f61c4199fa1cf345e"}

{"id": "p_5736633cc15f9bf1", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 79, "text": "後從攻皖，及討江夏，還過豫章，復補宜春長，所在皆食其征賦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "1d9b85567df94064d17a458538b990de3f0bbcae6c4800a429c6197d9439e8b5"}

{"id": "p_4f5cd880dc063f31", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 80, "text": "後與周瑜、程普拒曹公於赤壁，攻曹仁於南郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "40ef713456e12a41b9b054a50a4ce6ba0dbf162f229e943c34a75ab5de8d2f7d"}

{"id": "p_068cf3439a6d7ae3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 81, "text": "曹公出濡須，泰復赴擊，曹公退，留督濡須，拜平虜將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "34722bcc62d510a55668e6d4656b70af8c05de8c4d7ff369ab4c117ddbb91ff9"}

{"id": "p_30604f3968524b3e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 82, "text": "時朱然、徐盛等皆在所部，並不伏也，權特爲案行至濡須鄔，因會諸將，大爲酣樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "4274ef2235d5d5ec97e144073aa3098ae57442392299d9f82d9f6bd583d61ef3"}

{"id": "p_5bad7168b2539f7c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 83, "text": "權自行酒到泰前，命泰解衣，權手自指其創痕，問以所起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "88b3deb39e35bd0f953ceacce45f3a38e85ad43215fc79e002b24bd9b1b10dfd"}

{"id": "p_80925329b8ef272c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 84, "text": "泰輒記昔戰鬬處以對，畢，使復服，歡讌極夜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "9c417c6c554c0f05ad0928306af5f1200a31f1c28cf0038c51c6884d0e9eabbc"}

{"id": "p_c10d1e3529340b08", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 85, "text": "其明日，遣使者授以御蓋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "a8b6c9a1d04df002e64e8de7be254d16e69d89fb9cb8b7031562872afbe08f8f"}

{"id": "p_4ac26c3946960d56", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 86, "text": "後權破關羽，欲進圖蜀，拜泰漢中太守、奮威將軍，封陵陽侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "50bcc02fd5da6e43f8da5843051f30f56213d6ab6ed4be1bea8efdc1291a6ba8"}

{"id": "p_e1d4655b706a7833", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 87, "text": "曹仁出濡須，戰有功，又從攻破曹休，進位裨將軍，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "4e978a091ecf7ddfc2fdc7b4089ef748c12812cbb0b817fbf2e624409b4af375"}

{"id": "p_3f4f2ce85ae61696", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 88, "text": "陳武字子烈，廬江松滋人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "678a618027a6028d2817ec0a577665479e5c057a05b62f32b77de766f786d7ab"}

{"id": "p_9480763623785e14", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 89, "text": "孫策在壽春，武往脩謁，時年十八，長七尺七寸，因從渡江，征討有功，拜別部司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "f66e7d01079ea3bc1ef5ee0640a98777f2344d9486be36f2ef696e81adef1bd6"}

{"id": "p_e6d6dc57ef5863b5", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 90, "text": "策破劉勳，多得廬江人，料其精銳，乃以武爲督，所向無前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "6168e84d6b8e0069438a235b5c6a6962cdbadd81585db81a729bfb0c145ba8cf"}

{"id": "p_2e09cecebd1a6ea3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 91, "text": "仁厚好施，鄉里遠方客多依託之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "2cf0feb42a5cea640fb46733cc3c93852024d5cac55866ea314b2f3b77a02e9f"}

{"id": "p_78e32892632b056b", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 92, "text": "尤爲權所親愛，數至其家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "7c9c15e62dd74322a7d7f0578f816276a3f5f7443839c0e7ed99a27776890c0a"}

{"id": "p_fb5606c3135cd7b9", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 93, "text": "子脩有武風，年十九，權召見獎厲，拜別部司馬，授兵五百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "da7cb922ebaada5b0e00d28c1620d85240d4c4a3defa72da47f691a6b4ec5ce0"}

{"id": "p_ee995c78e323a64a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 94, "text": "時諸新兵多有逃叛，而脩撫循得意，不失一人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "64c2fc7e83103e3a25012a3d96573d41c1046e2fbdae7e9ba69d5ab03486f7f4"}

{"id": "p_a5fecd6db4b78312", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 95, "text": "建安末，追錄功臣後，封脩都亭侯，爲解煩督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "c5ef7e2a59dd217c25e4deb6936e4025c7faeb007ec418447773d687575295c3"}

{"id": "p_b276c360f607579d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 96, "text": "弟表，字文奧，武庶子也，少知名，與諸葛恪、顧譚、張休等並侍東宮，皆共親友。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "ed9bd07205c8a7daf51e84a70df35d21f4bd549d6f0d025c0a662e26b4ee166b"}

{"id": "p_1a5a36f27859cf6c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 97, "text": "尚書曁豔亦與表善，後豔遇罪，時人咸自營護，信厚言薄，表獨不然，士以此重之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "f98d3c800ac2d0685b0333f29a9f69ba6a336bc548925547c82c4534a526acfb"}

{"id": "p_859e9148ee5350de", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 98, "text": "徙太子中庶子，拜翼正都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "6c9afa67002e0816dffeb0a0adf8804ceaa755d9931d81e21cdc86641c6beca1"}

{"id": "p_79eeeac5a279110f", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 99, "text": "兄脩亡後，表母不肯事脩母，表謂其母曰：「兄不幸早亡，表統家事，當奉嫡母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "8d078398e99313fec4f1a5b43032a20f7eefcc31ba2180aacb46e44ee5b84bed"}

{"id": "p_beb91143da5b617d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 100, "text": "母若能爲表屈情，承順嫡母者，是至願也；若母不能，直當出別居耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "e1f39b9d85fd7bfb59fe5d219b36d8c8d63810fdd4d56a2f7dae8adabbd7ce97"}

{"id": "p_14f701e1aa0cda9a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 101, "text": "表以父死敵場，求用爲將，領兵五百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "34ec459ad78ace805946046548346277f04e227e9f5db1126e591b035524f0ef"}

{"id": "p_7d43e6ad11aecd95", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 102, "text": "表欲得戰士之力，傾意接待，士皆愛附，樂爲用命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "d14ddfa9f5c544fce1065d6708a03ce3355a71a5584d7e76b5d76d31835b82ea"}

{"id": "p_fb7da3757c66b342", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 103, "text": "時有盜官物者，疑無難士施明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "eb7a9d3cf1c85814830d0bd14215b7a314fdc431893cc8225c547fc54dafe3c2"}

{"id": "p_191bb407f2aadf2c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 104, "text": "明素壯悍，收考極毒，惟死無辭，廷尉以聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "10f5e5da0dd6c88c04a9bb125033f825a0ab7e8272de1a5bf0a5f479ab8dbc92"}

{"id": "p_96cd74f46d8ddf02", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 105, "text": "權以表能得健兒之心，詔以明付表，使自以意求其情實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "8f88bcbc0e9e3503f92cedbfb6f99bad19a7309377770a0f3c09540cc68d82b3"}

{"id": "p_904df2c7e7803a32", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 106, "text": "表便破械沐浴，易其衣服，厚設酒食，歡以誘之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "6c381eabf2dbd37f35c905d60c84d956a01d98a4f2519df08c6a95141cc6081e"}

{"id": "p_03e622ee350bdfe8", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 107, "text": "權奇之，欲全其名，特爲赦明，誅戮其黨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "63feb5746debfa03f87b16e534c8164617db17be7a5a5edbe73eee840e4014a7"}

{"id": "p_bc875c5805e90ad2", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 108, "text": "遷表爲無難右部督，封都亭侯，以繼舊爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "bfed9337ad64847ef36e98733ee7183a1baba39afd4f2070d0c8e4d4975adebf"}

{"id": "p_4d398c51a7f293d0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 109, "text": "表皆陳讓，乞以傳脩子延，權不許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "52976e94f1eef6f77202f4837f44ef807806cda85fa0054369bbf682a8bce399"}

{"id": "p_07c120d0608647c7", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 110, "text": "，諸葛恪領丹楊太守，討平山越，以表領新安都尉，與恪參勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "f6bec5e24fb676f9042add14f2f1d92ddb5e81293f2ec236b76546147a5827c0"}

{"id": "p_91f90fc45ee0b133", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 111, "text": "初，表所受賜復人得二百家，在會稽新安縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "b61f289a9ea58d93e29d930923c536e28829c6783d197e158c73630fd8a6fa16"}

{"id": "p_d9c24f2e81b67e62", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 112, "text": "表簡視其人，皆堪好兵，乃上疏陳讓，乞以還官，充足精銳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "8b354360cf852734de73415d0b926205754c76a580daedde4aaf8eb40d4baab7"}

{"id": "p_6797559ce5a25083", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 113, "text": "詔曰：「先將軍有功於國，國家以此報之，卿何得辭焉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "28afafbad48208f36e3c208372222aec5569325309234dd4f8e4d77a56e384ed"}

{"id": "p_304c136bc44e50c2", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 114, "text": "」表乃稱曰：「今除國賊，報父之仇，以人爲本。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "dbea3d8d8f9f1098364a5778242320352b3a7c0bbe9288e7cc552fa3c7f13ad3"}

{"id": "p_d40a230ffab99dd0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 115, "text": "空枉此勁銳以爲僮僕，非表志也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "148a10d3d86cfffcc4cff2cbddb98960f36d37c0311c0f3615f3f5578f70638f"}

{"id": "p_f1621ef717e08224", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 116, "text": "下郡縣，料正戶羸民以補其處。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "f6ecaa36278551058ad7b4d197398ef2258946b687decd511a733990e2be273c"}

{"id": "p_5f401ccb17c9f944", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 117, "text": "表在官三年，廣開降納，得兵萬餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "b18d0da697ea059be62fa1fc34873c3c61975a25c03e47c8d522a7a38b06a65a"}

{"id": "p_6bbac7bb8f8d203c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 118, "text": "事捷當出，會鄱陽民吳遽等爲亂，攻沒城郭，屬縣搖動，表便越界赴討，遽以破敗，遂降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "a1ff168574e7deeadf97e38b72e99ecc14cf51c10f9ae4d9b52eae0d5aca92b0"}

{"id": "p_499db07baa1e48d2", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 119, "text": "陸遜拜表偏將軍，進封都鄉侯，北屯章阬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "950719450d24f9a8e7f9c45fa92cd3cdcfd97f853b996562e46f948d2d2289d2"}

{"id": "p_e604e57a1478e434", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 120, "text": "家財盡於養士，死之日，妻子露立，太子登爲起屋宅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "b753ed321051a60d5fa751785347560ad9ccde872515024d100392d1dcbf3952"}

{"id": "p_ed35c36f3c75875b", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 121, "text": "子敖年十七，拜別部司馬，授兵四百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "bc5467c2a7223ac03740a6647ad6c77fdc6cc42cb19b8df36fff60f1e4469afb"}

{"id": "p_ca1c3549d6fc4807", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 122, "text": "敖卒，脩子延復爲司馬代敖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "a4c4e111dcd767bacee6b304a3479874b325652da4a161e45085415850f81adf"}

{"id": "p_7ce8a4d999cc080c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 123, "text": "始施明感表，自變行爲善，遂成健將，致位將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "48d044bcb13f51fc1d57a9e0486763a538ab1ea0ba3dcfc7839136cdd5284fec"}

{"id": "p_f8f0a684be419c5c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 124, "text": "董襲字元代，會稽餘姚人，長八尺，武力過人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "f53f2f55cbc9cbe2d3770bca315ebaf54cf08f484809482b70a91ce679227c56"}

{"id": "p_22dc177c8e7118d6", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 125, "text": "孫策入郡，襲迎於高遷亭，策見而偉之，到署門下賊曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "e806bfde893bad4231f40bd80630be9cf5153141f60ab352891b972d40d958e6"}

{"id": "p_b005788b971dfead", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 126, "text": "時山陰宿賊黃龍羅、周勃聚黨數千人，策自出討，襲身斬羅、勃首，還拜別部司馬，授兵數千，遷揚武都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "e2ea1b0c06eae291a7ccbe464b0e24bb912103729585777813af8d45f46e81a7"}

{"id": "p_2d673d69c12a843a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 127, "text": "從策攻皖，又討劉勳於尋陽，伐黃祖於江夏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "6ccf2de88dfe8417881e5b026da7849c65589f256ffa51f84c07d6fe8c87c1a9"}

{"id": "p_6dac0cb4ecbf00e0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 128, "text": "策薨，權年少，初統事，太妃憂之，引見張昭及襲等，問江東可保安不，襲對曰：「江東地勢有山川之固，而討逆明府恩德在民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "181d79a2baf4dc74c7d7919c6e8e3713e20f32c71f0b54d13a3e760f227d91c0"}

{"id": "p_25a8fa7e5cb17ad0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 129, "text": "討虜承基，大小用命，張昭秉衆事，襲等爲爪牙，此地利人和之時也，萬無所憂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "5e480dd461d29c6d1dac61ab2301c8e31bbd9f18be23112abd936f74f249f14f"}

{"id": "p_4ac0ce933aa2261d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 130, "text": "鄱陽賊彭虎等衆數萬人，襲與凌統、步隲、蔣欽各別分討。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "33ee9a1a5bfa0cb8e7e34a0940c69d7966f1b5a581569ebd3f5fcc11bb2b8d40"}

{"id": "p_834f5e369809db99", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 131, "text": "襲所向輒破，虎等望見旌旗，便散走，旬日盡平，拜威越校尉，遷偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "289c85c194b138c5bb6a5bd43c97724c891764ed085da38456b826a2f3ff3ec0"}

{"id": "p_6c7d3f3c794353c9", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 132, "text": "祖橫兩蒙衝挾守沔口，以栟閭大紲繫石爲矴，上有千人，以弩交射，飛矢雨下，軍不得前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "e95e989e5e138b3f818590181c0318c234b942310d2e266f60d1f4fb993f5ec4"}

{"id": "p_7cf24b889275e3d6", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 133, "text": "襲與凌統俱爲前部，各將敢死百人，人被兩鎧，乘大舸船，突入蒙衝裏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "9ab7b2e059df32df10b1d109ec3ab0c3f81ba7c61fd91920113f2245f6eef029"}

{"id": "p_9629faab58092c84", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 134, "text": "襲身以刀斷兩紲，蒙衝乃橫流，大兵遂進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "23bc3bf5a8d3ccfc1b25dc3ba00a9548ed3784115eded6ae6e53f16273ca0e63"}

{"id": "p_fdff28892e2d09be", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 135, "text": "明日大會，權舉觴屬襲曰：「今日之會，斷紲之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "f842f5da4f04fd27d60f1a650db1518aa581718498064fd33de327b3a46043b5"}

{"id": "p_51853c462eb79b64", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 136, "text": "曹公出濡須，襲從權赴之，使襲督五樓船住濡須口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "ff1981bc16db2af1a45f369d09561c27046fc24ce4286e46235c21767ee61d35"}

{"id": "p_06e018df4fad793d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 137, "text": "夜卒暴風，五樓船傾覆，左右散走舸，乞使襲出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "6860df74c49e643c0a92bd96e11d7e0c10cc38645145d59afaa38512e86153a8"}

{"id": "p_117a0a32c7e10172", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 138, "text": "襲怒曰：「受將軍任，在此備賊，何等委去也，敢復言此者斬！", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "7ce3a187ac8b674d2b8506b28fcc610e672ffe9b634fb3100b5657b0cfc44cf3"}

{"id": "p_0351d84976de2ca3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 139, "text": "甘寧字興霸，巴郡臨江人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "9810310912c8bcf184ecea22c0c0a4f8e8501ac9a9bb087ee5ae7206f8b9d3d0"}

{"id": "p_00924e677aee54d8", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 140, "text": "少有氣力，好游俠，招合輕薄少年，爲之渠帥；羣聚相隨，挾持弓弩，負毦帶鈴，民聞鈴聲，即知是寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "2c663a9b7dfd0bde9ce27349e7b0a71962ee9debe54554dd1d992817e26ffcce"}

{"id": "p_89dde825827b74b8", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 141, "text": "人與相逢，及屬城長吏，接待隆厚者乃與交歡；不爾，即放所將奪其資貨，於長吏界中有所賊害，作其發負，至二十餘年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "42b2855ec3adb428e7688fb8e1600678ff07af7712923544e3948794e94167b3"}

{"id": "p_a442dedc6c7d27f1", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 142, "text": "止不攻劫，頗讀諸子，乃往依劉表，因居南陽，不見進用，後轉託黃祖，祖又以凡人畜之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "ac086e78e3df44f0147069d2ee82239f21ddec421dc02a62f399a458d7f48351"}

{"id": "p_5ac2b37573812aa9", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 143, "text": "周瑜、呂蒙皆共薦達，孫權加異，同於舊臣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "d052a1278ccbc3b8bee42da333854b3c15909ec59f768bb9c56d1ac5be525a09"}

{"id": "p_543223d7ef038846", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 144, "text": "寧陳計曰：「今漢祚日微，曹操彌憍，終爲篡盜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "4f7fc96db42bf541070e460be6c307bd073a111f164112847fb49360b3618b80"}

{"id": "p_d3ed438860a0543e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 145, "text": "山陵形便，江川流通，誠是國之西勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "86161cd2b5a8c8e7500c2d95e2396d1e43ddeb3282ea717fadf26ab1e8d3f60a"}

{"id": "p_0d382834a803d441", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 146, "text": "寧已觀劉表，慮旣不遠，兒子又劣，非能承業傳基者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "2887f9e02ea3f9741ce1a880115b86af44aa2401bd5a2bfa56db607b073d7e30"}

{"id": "p_df4bb2cb6753a4bd", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 147, "text": "至尊當早規之，不可後操圖之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "a148f4f26d8b336ad8abb35d5a264aa483efa70931773bab464cf754a7ee0187"}

{"id": "p_2b4db40161551e46", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 148, "text": "祖今年老，昏耄已甚，財穀並乏，左右欺弄，務於貨利，侵求吏士，吏士心怨，舟船戰具頓廢不脩，怠於耕農，軍無法伍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "79d9c05652c76468dd5c72c23edcd4ea5db11b36cac1db59bd04c73691f7f88b"}

{"id": "p_b8d42c1b84f74156", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 149, "text": "一破祖軍，鼓行而西，西據楚關，大勢彌廣，即可漸規巴蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "aef198a32fafac9d649d79169ffc729267c5e1ea44596dee20502a69b93fd6cf"}

{"id": "p_e32c32931ee6132c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 150, "text": "張昭時在坐，難曰：「吳下業業，若軍果行，恐必致亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "3c719554ec8e7701e11983187812e827a7a0063a8de9a30ea6138d7c403df346"}

{"id": "p_1cd1b664c90dfdf8", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」寧謂昭曰：「國家以蕭何之任付君，君居守而憂亂，奚以希慕古人乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "fd394b9aacf797f2453726e49787d51bd67c74a865b74a66adc0134499a9660c"}

{"id": "p_776f449da170c65d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 152, "text": "」權舉酒屬寧曰：「興霸，今年行討，如此酒矣，決以付卿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "79f88463e9bf1c216fc20559a6d4e05046638e1fc4a43b22c858a25967900223"}

{"id": "p_c9785ee53ae2e5a2", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 153, "text": "卿但當勉建方略，令必克祖，則卿之功，何嫌張長史之言乎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "f47b54732d5e1e8bca23937dc038dc30031ef75414a98fea2dc2c69a1078882b"}

{"id": "p_bb4dc82f56c39c11", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」權遂西，果禽祖，盡獲其士衆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "e776d8edb62bad7f5532a03cd04a24a1a49635d3b4d001752f2fc6be30317a4f"}

{"id": "p_8b76c9d602fb0c37", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 155, "text": "後隨周瑜拒破曹公於烏林。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "5c49545f4efdd930de46fb655d18d8407bd3471776e1d89198c2a82282c6fc0e"}

{"id": "p_dda5d2b1352b57af", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 156, "text": "攻曹仁於南郡，未拔，寧建計先徑進取夷陵，往即得其城，因入守之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "d202c41e165841604239c4f560953e3831c5c334a28695acd9ac28c87aab2e14"}

{"id": "p_37bea27082b51495", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 157, "text": "時手下有數百兵，并所新得，僅滿千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "81a201242e1d3f3c07a6c98f76f743c491f1982f1d0d13301de0c26348081903"}

{"id": "p_47a4c693d2158b5f", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 158, "text": "寧受攻累日，敵設高樓，雨射城中，士衆皆懼，惟寧談笑自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "2f6fb6072416255c2297ff396c92c725e0a54219d2cf2087be396b18339f64fb"}

{"id": "p_32b33d57a128381c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 159, "text": "遣使報瑜，瑜用呂蒙計，帥諸將解圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "a9cf58873a24b47ce7e1db4b25abad61336437f7a704823803574acb242a78ab"}

{"id": "p_9bc67ebdc95755de", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 160, "text": "後隨魯肅鎮益陽，拒關羽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "5539108107333eacc72adb2c17da69d06109974130c15c28599eb646275a1848"}

{"id": "p_51d549069b143e14", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 161, "text": "羽號有三萬人，自擇選銳士五千人，投縣上流十餘里淺瀨，云欲夜涉渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "059aa09cd2bdbf25bd165680b7adf11ea305588447e47efad355dce8839aed2b"}

{"id": "p_5f331d5516b934e4", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 162, "text": "寧時有三百兵，乃曰：「可復以五百人益吾，吾往對之，保羽聞吾欬唾，不敢涉水，涉水即是吾禽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "c5ee42764db70973146effc9e363db1f997cc3b789bfcc25e48d57ec3e8ac093"}

{"id": "p_4076a4358d6c221a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」肅便選千兵益寧，寧乃夜往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "90aa956bc6a1201bba5b34b447abce83ba53a3caacbf94ea1449419701366b99"}

{"id": "p_a4c780d0fbba8801", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 164, "text": "羽聞之，住不渡，而結柴營，今遂名此處爲關羽瀨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "c1ad6640e0495ef367e1727a2bf7ead3de118f3fea1d34360d41b396094273cf"}

{"id": "p_b06b440d720c5f2a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 165, "text": "權嘉寧功，拜西陵太守，領陽新、下雉兩縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "a5780a6a7a9b11d72e228ffe0eda1279f5a4cdf235f42d3f91980a9ff1b217ad"}

{"id": "p_0e4f59070b1e59d0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 166, "text": "寧手持練，身緣城，爲吏士先，卒破獲朱光。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "3cf9e38e4f554f5479bd9fab757521593c1dd3c36f52a5dcf8e51662140123ee"}

{"id": "p_8e329bcc67ce0106", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 167, "text": "後曹公出濡須，寧爲前部督，受勑出斫敵前營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "6e5a9bf1b42fc77f0aee40bcefc9ff833bd2562e212e50a59893f87270e693fd"}

{"id": "p_ac15cf1397431234", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 168, "text": "權特賜米酒衆殽，寧乃料賜手下百餘人食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "bbe9e57e7c0fbe6c7b6ccd03ade629f26e350ab5ff4ba9fa5064fd8b674c9e91"}

{"id": "p_2b32bfb3e37952e0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 169, "text": "食畢，寧先以銀盌酌酒，自飲兩盌，乃酌與其都督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "a3279388cd22ebf465d019f296ef485898d52754ee11a997a00e6f1283e4f068"}

{"id": "p_3e80a6f5d6561fd5", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 170, "text": "寧引白削置膝上，呵謂之曰：「卿見知於至尊，孰與甘寧？", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "08718ab643a1f74d9bb59a17e90ecada08aec4c9e2238f881b80b1b3dba92643"}

{"id": "p_5fe38b1573e8bdd2", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 171, "text": "甘寧尚不惜死，卿何以獨惜死乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "bb0af37bc09109e746dec2cc3acea9243b8c21e3029d25d79a5b6fdfac08f375"}

{"id": "p_8b0e1b4c12ffd92d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 172, "text": "」都督見寧色厲，即起拜待酒次，通酌兵各一銀盌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "df0110263ba8530dae4a98ebc717a927084110fc968f2366508b7bf25f6c2c28"}

{"id": "p_b05e6089e3832c17", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 173, "text": "寧雖麤猛好殺，然開爽有計略，輕財敬士，能厚養健兒，健兒亦樂爲用命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "ea8e3c0341567fd5b71521ea03e3868899b4f8c802f4cd014b477cc467febd92"}

{"id": "p_4a16d6db0c41ad28", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 174, "text": "，從攻合肥，會疫疾，軍旅皆已引出，唯車下虎士千餘人，并呂蒙、蔣欽、凌統及寧，從權逍遙津北。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "2e65c3f852b29088f32b28bc0b231b8d73e26534b26f512b8dc85341b892b68c"}

{"id": "p_ede138aeaa7b57a3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 175, "text": "張遼覘望知之，即將步騎奄至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "6fada681471f5d7b2352eb3dd7764e701a9204b281ba198a5f4019d94dd71707"}

{"id": "p_35832e662febe0fc", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 176, "text": "寧引弓射敵，與統等死戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "ee052c367478dde2e1a7086ef006984eec382f91276a91f2f020ea359fa9fda8"}

{"id": "p_afffff4f560ddc65", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 177, "text": "寧厲聲問鼓吹何以不作，壯氣毅然，權尤嘉之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "c6589a998a10ffe0b6f5a87dd74f3cb781d51ecdd87c9b9957bd099c34879b80"}

{"id": "p_3b762b9717c9a7a6", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 178, "text": "寧厨下兒曾有過，走投呂蒙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "7aa8cfeb707945ba09f2864f9e2827f86e8aa166ff19d34bb86ed1023d6f4556"}

{"id": "p_c31e6e9fdab4ec1a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 179, "text": "後寧齎禮禮蒙母，臨當與升堂，乃出厨下兒還寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "e4dccfa95b26c0162e252528e0e13174846f46a94fbbf250bb3f9902126a9a1e"}

{"id": "p_9e634d12f425aa80", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 180, "text": "斯須還船，縛置桑樹，自挽弓射殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "d8cb826acbf836946b537fa8872f45bf7d4da259f66430ad6a13bab58611ed27"}

{"id": "p_3f3a49f7b8447b73", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 181, "text": "畢，勑船人更增舸纜，解衣卧船中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "90edea240097c9c48e2514d0159503e7441568a6fdb9a3eb726225f9a434300e"}

{"id": "p_25bcebf503b060b2", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 182, "text": "蒙大怒，擊鼓會兵，欲就船攻寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "f615138fb6926f03c16ccca5ad813fd79d4758a3fc4f7c258f86aba8bcb2f3b5"}

{"id": "p_71c1a4bcc2937679", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 183, "text": "蒙母徒跣出諫蒙曰：「至尊待汝如骨肉，屬汝以大事，何有以私怒而欲攻殺甘寧？", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "5c1c7880024a3e52e22dcc45fcce53ac5887b4f88e2cc79a5a6862c6b3cc673e"}

{"id": "p_5fa06dd754a725d0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 184, "text": "寧死之日，縱至尊不問，汝是爲臣下非法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "69dbdc299a0e58ebf13d40ae6c77980e1993f307e683f7f1d5757b7229e43902"}

{"id": "p_0139e52041debb34", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 185, "text": "」蒙素至孝，聞母言，即豁然意釋，自至寧舩，笑呼之曰：「興霸，老母待卿食，急上！", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "22577e360742378b9d060a5f4e3bec6511c3cfe566bd7a0e3652003d7e208f3e"}

{"id": "p_cc6a2a2bb31ac0c6", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 186, "text": "」寧涕泣歔欷曰：「負卿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "4e72c6893dca3b2cfc1c9b7cfa2c14fe974aaed8ffd4668bb2e7587ea9cda412"}

{"id": "p_aac2d172d1e92931", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 187, "text": "」與蒙俱還見母，歡宴竟日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "536912fd449e55f550b48a4ee2e9ce390178385f0af0b602c3196b592b67ed87"}

{"id": "p_b4a349038b20cf6f", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 188, "text": "子瓌，以罪徙會稽，無幾死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "f470b971abc253d7dc2bda6b3b5aa54ecb3ceb3e09731db86aec5608e7cd65fe"}

{"id": "p_09ca50b47b375f93", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 189, "text": "凌統字公績，吳郡餘杭人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "a3ad5dfe976eb40139e7f5b08c97b50bdfc1386e4b28bb4d179c62c46c9c6bc3"}

{"id": "p_b269599b1c2f9cb8", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 190, "text": "父操，輕俠有膽氣，孫策初興，每從征伐，常冠軍履鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "c92cc6bef578f2587db7a0698575c5e04ef4662cd12e47cb879844edadbb2591"}

{"id": "p_37946ade3e95a42f", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 191, "text": "守永平長，平治山越，姦猾斂手，遷破賊校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "bafb5872e1ff8267acee18e239f693aded766060ddc4ae1a62b864b49451c848"}

{"id": "p_738868e0099e9340", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 192, "text": "入夏口，先登，破其前鋒，輕舟獨進，中流矢死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "18891ec2aa54736bd62d58a84c7b201ad83fb16fef4e45dab6cd77ba26d3baea"}

{"id": "p_094ecda3683f5258", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 193, "text": "統年十五，左右多稱述者，權亦以操死國事，拜統別部司馬，行破賊都尉，使攝父兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "f58abd2cb2d43ae7dfba89c2d983ac1326a6552bf98c5f43c523fabb65a858df"}

{"id": "p_5d1145140cfd52ee", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 194, "text": "後從擊山賊，權破保屯先還，餘麻屯萬人，統與督張異等留攻圍之，克日當攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "2634dc9c22296426d3af52c1ec1ff5a08962ef643646296df2e708d63780765e"}

{"id": "p_ebfc625c03644ace", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 195, "text": "先期，統與督陳勤會飲酒，勤剛勇任氣，因督祭酒，陵轢一坐，舉罰不以其道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "1dfcdd2a6f5a816af0611dbe7eefcce508b75f36d2180ff067b17cd29b91af3d"}

{"id": "p_967878aacf2a61fb", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 196, "text": "統疾其侮慢，面折不爲用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "25cdd559035ddb755d6d5ff8343aed0be713af4b00d2d3c5abfd91e92e6044dd"}

{"id": "p_82b810ddb772a0da", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 197, "text": "勤怒詈統，及其父操，統流涕不荅，衆因罷出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "22be8d918dc3e76e79bd9a6bade30068878f5c41c4f1065286c899f0511eb93d"}

{"id": "p_cf69e88146205819", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 198, "text": "勤乘酒凶悖，又於道路辱統。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "202c3f8fb4034625cb552aec518e9961bd3b17e585e31cab51c44fc286ab4b53"}

{"id": "p_06e3c452b7fefeaa", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 199, "text": "統不忍，引刀斫勤，數日乃死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "813e4e886a89fa142a589ffde77d4831e32d4c787048095674ce5d2e0be03a4b"}

{"id": "p_f769c3369e3169df", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 200, "text": "及當攻屯，統曰：「非死無以謝罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "ac6f675ea353e305f8cde93bbf08adbd6ab4bff3bfad786f3f9f5c89f61d80bf"}

{"id": "p_c36e1fd468776a24", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 201, "text": "」乃率厲士卒，身當矢石，所次一面，應時披壞，諸將乘勝，遂大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "0309720d075bf9cb9b91b1d0e36899b0b0bace27d42d039fbe8178cd59995dd5"}

{"id": "p_e2947ac74caaf67a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 202, "text": "權壯其果毅，使得以功贖罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "0ba8f27f0ee367b96689e3f6e91a0a0c86ff82d9767042358510759777c51694"}

{"id": "p_92de42856ba1eb20", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 203, "text": "後權復征江夏，統爲前鋒，與所厚健兒數十人共乘一船，常去大兵數十里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "8bb27047411126dd8e74d651bf2f02bb3e82e539fbf944da913ccfed3c3305a4"}

{"id": "p_3f10d82d238058e0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 204, "text": "行入右江，斬黃祖將張碩，盡獲船人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "33476044b3b83ca33b2b44ac750e2e5e698d9a46499445714ce714504a6d07ea"}

{"id": "p_b1a33e0308136f39", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 205, "text": "還以白權，引軍兼道，水陸並集。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "fccfafd8a4a246a0062824eaceb3584da7da00389d4ced59101eaa8be4c68393"}

{"id": "p_4ca5aaa004c32aba", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 206, "text": "時呂蒙敗其水軍，而統先搏其城，於是大獲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "9f261e3e80cf5d878ada611659bbad110f2b219d841ec85ec5a0f3a126bf4156"}

{"id": "p_2e93ad8b8fdb8c46", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 207, "text": "權以統爲承烈都尉，與周瑜等拒破曹公於烏林，遂攻曹仁，遷爲校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "9ed78b9c17924ce3c10e594b9efae86a1cc0b665b625c9fd970f6730afa41f8f"}

{"id": "p_7928f93776798837", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 208, "text": "雖在軍旅，親賢接士，輕財重義，有國士之風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "dc9d818c216427435e797e7134f7717f9bbe0885cd9543638aff1d9f9bfd3528"}

{"id": "p_0ac8e1fcf059f9e8", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 209, "text": "又從破皖，拜盪寇中郎將，領沛相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "d31c458eeade1c141f6302f08ce0465dd26a1cbe7a98cfa659cddacd26d8c9ae"}

{"id": "p_84fb537917deb49c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 210, "text": "與呂蒙等西取三郡，反自益陽，從往合肥，爲右部督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "e6fa35b2250118ba81c06d3f8fd2fc0cba6b30b441431dc767a6e8789aa78a98"}

{"id": "p_88b553e6d372c933", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 211, "text": "時權徹軍，前部已發，魏將張遼等奄至津北。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "060a547d722f222816ca5874312450d02121dcd18b4126790c03beda00e88953"}

{"id": "p_7dbaff7451774147", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 212, "text": "權使追還前兵，兵去已遠，勢不相及，統率親近三百人陷圍，扶扞權出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "0151ce3546814b7d585daa6f864c380ed91de1c6da746a2ecf5586626825e6c3"}

{"id": "p_7ef262dc607f2125", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 213, "text": "敵已毀橋，橋之屬者兩版，權策馬驅馳，統復還戰，左右盡死，身亦被創，所殺數十人，度權已免，乃還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "dbe7fd1491f0ffc84aaeba5e1d4d24f7d1310f36b97f00ac9a7e60c745ff06fa"}

{"id": "p_945c65b6cd4ca812", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 214, "text": "統痛親近無反者，悲不自勝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "2621e852543997cfea3062efddba83f01008fafd2a3465436af1a6b88829970f"}

{"id": "p_2c677b12060d45fe", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 215, "text": "權引袂拭之，謂曰：「公績，亡者已矣，苟使卿在，何患無人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "b7a182b58c7f37e548cb1896285e3550a222610fd0aefcadb356a438a8d657a5"}

{"id": "p_afeb5786fcaf3eb6", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 216, "text": "時有薦同郡盛暹於權者，以爲梗槩大節有過於統，權曰：「且令如統足矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "47d2f5ffe55393e3907d6e3e494ba03842775b9048385846a37fa6b2fa57a3fd"}

{"id": "p_771bdeddae5baf4e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 217, "text": "」後召暹夜至，時統已卧，聞之，攝衣出門，執其手以入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "f75f6340a7c45685c599f0ef4c33e182481f8f8a36c537772c98f8f25b9a213a"}

{"id": "p_50c970627b9bb44a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 218, "text": "統以山中人尚多壯悍，可以威恩誘也，權令東占且討之，命勑屬城，凡統所求，皆先給後聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "ddf3dd547ee483c77c96432d6414d596da95e97122ad2dad3a68db87db5fb7da"}

{"id": "p_1ea3953887047502", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 219, "text": "得精兵萬餘人，過本縣，步入寺門，見長吏懷三版，恭敬盡禮，親舊故人，恩意益隆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "4479d094a4281d7b48de896f023f81f121b71a80e2c1ce5f8184dd83b459bdee"}

{"id": "p_c34700369ad1aab4", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 220, "text": "事畢當出，會病卒，時年四十九。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "9c93f15358b028b4d521c21692e502443efd96ff41eee62886b3c4a9b70258f4"}

{"id": "p_b39f2e0ffb1dba2d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 221, "text": "權聞之，拊牀起坐，哀不能自止，數日減膳，言及流涕，使張承爲作銘誄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "df5b22a90357f04417dfc535cfe3d8b06f1496d88023e376364f6449d6d029c3"}

{"id": "p_4816aaf0f93d4636", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 222, "text": "二子烈、封，年各數歲，權內養於宮，愛待與諸子同，賔客進見，呼示之曰：「此吾虎子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "d397343299df28a24a9fc750beb7f139882d8218c01f6281c0758c09153c54af"}

{"id": "p_38616c236a558106", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 223, "text": "」及八九歲，令葛光教之讀書，十日一令乘馬，追錄統功，封烈亭侯，還其故兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "be90d5e1dd2e1693f5bbdb1fbdd89c2cb08ecc749fa1676aa27bf887b1341153"}

{"id": "p_c5160a4f92c890c3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 224, "text": "後烈有罪免，封復襲爵領兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "746102fbf1d9dc4a0ce68120ab0d0a9b4e1bc4f417820545ed3ec3c4a6268de7"}

{"id": "p_0a2da3d1954e8a63", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 225, "text": "徐盛字文嚮，琅邪莒人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "91ddc91f8ed53519955ec9a3ca64f6e2bf7a731f12cd0ab9223978349d2b014f"}

{"id": "p_e82272acc313cff7", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 226, "text": "遭亂，客居吳，以勇氣聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "aaac9c440ba626ea5e0fa3740e74d137ae0ea9b6c0fb1a481b6c96102ec893ae"}

{"id": "p_22f2dfabb4e385f6", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 227, "text": "孫權統事，以爲別部司馬，授兵五百人，守柴桑長，拒黃祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "fc5e18cdbebc637d3593130247794793af89df49ef7ac926579f90ba0348d5fe"}

{"id": "p_fd7cd3d5a1739f86", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 228, "text": "祖子射，甞率數千人下攻盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "1bcc54c6aa4e21c7283e946f6817876b6ad817f6de3445823401df00a6d3ae4d"}

{"id": "p_82dc5c512f52ce15", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 229, "text": "盛時吏士不滿二百，與相拒擊，傷射吏士千餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "5ed14c9738ad1fb91bb34d7e2349487733455aea1b99fc48fe903a743ae0c9d4"}

{"id": "p_aa220ba2cf95858d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 230, "text": "復討臨城南阿山賊有功，徙中郎將，督校兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "bfe0f9115fe9fe24ce3cc9c828c6293e652b74e6847c6a3fdf867dbef69c62b9"}

{"id": "p_1f0fa0ba32461312", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 231, "text": "魏甞大出橫江，盛與諸將俱赴討。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "cd4e685360ab97b44df8b423ca05791f7e0758780c74fc7d36a79a3141e56194"}

{"id": "p_db63b3d1241dcb24", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 232, "text": "時乘蒙衝，遇迅風，船落敵岸下，諸將恐懼，未有出者，盛獨將兵，上突斫敵，敵披退走，有所傷殺，風止便還，權大壯之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "1bf8be886326ce789b27c4ff4ece17ffe0e4151c2609d2d538aa6dbe2111fb64"}

{"id": "p_1f8fc31ccfdd20f5", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 233, "text": "及權爲魏稱藩，魏使邢貞拜權爲吳王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "8bf1500d073e0bd836add2b12f2be9e09fe7ebe36480c782c16e6ed1e359e64d"}

{"id": "p_505759f76fc0fd00", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 234, "text": "權出都亭候貞，貞有驕色，張昭旣怒，而盛忿憤，顧謂同列曰：「盛等不能奮身出命，爲國家并許洛，吞巴蜀，而令吾君與貞盟，不亦辱乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "2ef1d54e004515bae68cd359e9f8d41131beba68ac4a98ad7354e5c547b28e22"}

{"id": "p_e50133b23e91a1e3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 235, "text": "貞聞之，謂其旅曰：「江東將相如此，非乆下人者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "f0d280c5e73e1f5b288f0eef7c809008c5f63e73c8e9a3bc6327cedb263027f5"}

{"id": "p_e399620005bac6c2", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 236, "text": "後遷建武將軍，封都亭侯，領廬江太守，賜臨城縣爲奉邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "a8fd3749e5f9bbf76d50b4bbaca687e3a0ab82f4b258104a168f3c836aa2665b"}

{"id": "p_13930d208e894bd2", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 237, "text": "劉備次西陵，盛攻取諸屯，所向有功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "f731c782af5ee599ac301c1761a8718f87dcd43541c71802dbdc82687d7994d2"}

{"id": "p_6f355f39433ec857", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 238, "text": "曹休出洞口，盛與呂範、全琮渡江拒守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "4281396cfaadb1c92cadb8ca8efe4a37730ac620fb7dbc166d9e90019e286d6f"}

{"id": "p_ebc4484d1311637e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 239, "text": "遭大風，船人多喪，盛收餘兵，與休夾江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "475a03a5d57d8f05f51cf953b16d7d93a8dcbe62818c68c081389f0983f3db2e"}

{"id": "p_b3e483b74cb82b6c", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 240, "text": "休使兵將就船攻盛，盛以少禦多，敵不能克，各引軍退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "77730b63244a96ef8f4bf7da7bbb944288b63e29246cc2f0c2525f8a8ac630a5"}

{"id": "p_20d0b9fead091945", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 241, "text": "後魏文帝大出，有渡江之志，盛建計從建業築圍，作薄落，圍上設假樓，江中浮船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "089f2515e80a6114aabc31da9538fd8c06908d96806a4003b59fa536c08b9100"}

{"id": "p_e8b0d0c693c38efa", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 242, "text": "諸將以爲無益，盛不聽，固立之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "f985c03939605625b9fa5f6745ec64742d1af85f74c98d96d5e51c67b5c69251"}

{"id": "p_9cd8bdcf7ecfbd9a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 243, "text": "文帝到廣陵，望圍愕然，彌漫數百里，而江水盛長，便引軍退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "639881081a4f21e072d283906b2ac1890b9eff3f6b4247515b38050306a79e7c"}

{"id": "p_73e7d323e3500cc4", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 244, "text": "潘璋字文珪，東郡發干人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "76f98b280d43d02412d8b153881d2138f198faf1c2d29fffd9eeb50a2b04fc6b"}

{"id": "p_8688dda71c9e18e1", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 245, "text": "孫權爲陽羨長，始往隨權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "d7d1a2ec010c226a5fa3f0b0ef4f8d3795573f51159cd869cf79215d899dfc46"}

{"id": "p_1c40dead9c172d41", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 246, "text": "性博蕩嗜酒，居貧，好賒酤，債家至門，輒言後豪富相還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "81200f8ea2ec2d2937174f0019312361bedee6f18d61f7f5c2a95bad2ec57653"}

{"id": "p_d4cf95936605e06e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 247, "text": "權奇愛之，因使召募，得百餘人，遂以爲將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 247}, "text_hash": "45782e7118d7bd567aea9eee9c372a26a081e82ccd4cda125cfc4b9c918b8dbe"}

{"id": "p_6ddebdd86dfe31c9", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 248, "text": "討山賊有功，署別部司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 248}, "text_hash": "47fe8c625c87c3b884e1be858ad80e40a5533125ad88cee633dda84fb78ec812"}

{"id": "p_ec4c0beef8959020", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 249, "text": "後爲吳大巿刺姧，盜賊斷絕，由是知名，遷豫章西安長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 249}, "text_hash": "14d371d73a2e3577cf60ef25003a5f1b52b522d730d2fc5a83640886ed72c37f"}

{"id": "p_3d91b7d4bfe96761", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 250, "text": "劉表在荊州，民數被寇，自璋在事，寇不入境。", "locator": {"ordinal": 250}, "text_hash": "743291474bcb2fad1c3683197bae06602634af16802efabe92c607b3ea406cdb"}

{"id": "p_7807322284e2f937", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 251, "text": "比縣建昌起爲賊亂，轉領建昌，加武猛校尉，討治惡民，旬月盡平，召合遺散，得八百人，將還建業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 251}, "text_hash": "c197da6f89a07d0b4488c6c4da59b40b787a3f3697a49eb03e2a02816060ba52"}

{"id": "p_54bf529331ae2fba", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 252, "text": "合肥之役，張遼奄至，諸將不備，陳武鬬死，宋謙、徐盛皆披走，璋身次在後，便馳進，橫馬斬謙、盛兵走者二人，兵皆還戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 252}, "text_hash": "4fccc8a09701c608b544b267840c12ad16aff5cb8cfdbc5a5a353a844bb7cbc0"}

{"id": "p_72c553eb33683fb4", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 253, "text": "權甚壯之，拜偏將軍，遂領百校，屯半州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 253}, "text_hash": "821a1f8a3b430f91243c95be8b20e7ef2bfa8f610a76c56756ec794c01d1e21f"}

{"id": "p_e5c6533abfd31dde", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 254, "text": "權征關羽，璋與朱然斷羽走道，到臨沮，住夾石。", "locator": {"ordinal": 254}, "text_hash": "32ab815aec8bfb38411bd58d6a2a2fc1f10553b8aca03e73f1a8bdd52528a8e6"}

{"id": "p_76097ad6c6c916f1", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 255, "text": "璋部下司馬馬忠禽羽，并羽子平、都督趙累等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 255}, "text_hash": "60def722b6d7bb00ab310fb1c98019e3d07d2b5f85283408207b8d5407d1ee78"}

{"id": "p_ba63e58abec1c51e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 256, "text": "權即分宜都巫、秭歸二縣爲固陵郡，拜璋爲太守、振威將軍，封溧陽侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 256}, "text_hash": "cb6ec4589f0801e041c2e569c10c974b75bedfd54e208fab181a976a6bd9d382"}

{"id": "p_b26b853c759d0cd3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 257, "text": "劉備出夷陵，璋與陸遜并力拒之，璋部下斬備護軍馮習等，所殺傷甚衆，拜平北將軍、襄陽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 257}, "text_hash": "88f598c1431f5f423f504876be381f4ca3caf221abab4646e774296b6f2bb60a"}

{"id": "p_eb620419d939d7ee", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 258, "text": "魏將夏侯尚等圍南郡，分前部三萬人作浮橋，渡百里洲上，諸葛瑾、楊粲並會兵赴救，未知所出，而魏兵日渡不絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 258}, "text_hash": "ef0099b37103437c076d2bd3193154fcc29b67f583b920a1890f7e44b5eacfef"}

{"id": "p_b07996f6dff304b6", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 259, "text": "璋曰：「魏勢始盛，江水又淺，未可與戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 259}, "text_hash": "5bb549e8c6c6fab3ba081bc72f7a00fd7a3bb5304b1b358b7ff6a04321619290"}

{"id": "p_f89da6bd92d2059e", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 260, "text": "」便將所領，到魏上流五十里，伐葦數百萬束，縛作大筏，欲順流放火，燒敗浮橋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 260}, "text_hash": "28e5903e7759e13d1e81fabbdabb7c15cd7a76a8ebdbfba7ae7f7bb0d99be98e"}

{"id": "p_a808a3a7f444c3c2", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 261, "text": "作筏適畢，伺水長當下，尚便引退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 261}, "text_hash": "a7a1761026a148f54cf843a08149f0cd91172d19011b7c6f0008cf3ec1daae4b"}

{"id": "p_cae24ede9704c641", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 262, "text": "璋爲人麤猛，禁令肅然，好立功業，所領兵馬不過數千，而其所在常如萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 262}, "text_hash": "a74b42adce481755d562b34c27bb8fb4e05175420810fd97c91c4b7923db6371"}

{"id": "p_f9fc3a4b0ccde82b", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 263, "text": "征伐止頓，便立軍巿，他軍所無，皆仰取足。", "locator": {"ordinal": 263}, "text_hash": "1989521e701c7b9106c00e5e9197fbe146744fc868c4bf878f3569185921ea5a"}

{"id": "p_19ed1cfb11049fa0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 264, "text": "然性奢泰，末年彌甚，服物僭擬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 264}, "text_hash": "c5556ed151fee34ff49bc54a6476de3d10a1c94ac5e5364945a9962f7ec08886"}

{"id": "p_ba1ec4aa16b01b49", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 265, "text": "吏兵富者，或殺取其財物，數不奉法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 265}, "text_hash": "c5febcee6ef76b4360375a281ee52937b81efa6c9557e323d0ed0c309612d13a"}

{"id": "p_5c6eaecd3389bbad", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 266, "text": "監司舉奏，權惜其功而輒原不問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 266}, "text_hash": "5ee2ef3c438b56d64794d89b37aa906d9546de481517c81a2b39f79af4bba862"}

{"id": "p_73f1afbce8f35ece", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 267, "text": "璋妻居建業，賜田宅，復客五十家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 267}, "text_hash": "c8ef2d9022f6f20ad86b7c115fadc059c9408d0972394589ff1251384081e9b3"}

{"id": "p_fbde4b6f019a6741", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 268, "text": "丁奉字承淵，廬江安豐人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 268}, "text_hash": "4dca2b6c5077ae579c94a1b139f533bce3cd42b22c61886c209628d5869019af"}

{"id": "p_4b884668e3a360b3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 269, "text": "少以驍勇爲小將，屬甘寧、陸遜、潘璋等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 269}, "text_hash": "a4745901180e381c323d686e5071e2e312c746463242c41d113e1a8fad656107"}

{"id": "p_dd720bc780c2ccf6", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 270, "text": "孫亮即位，爲冠軍將軍，封都亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 270}, "text_hash": "7f8d4c5623e2c169067ef6f0f695d89f1cf83fd25a05528d1142cf7cd333b303"}

{"id": "p_f18271d06fa55268", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 271, "text": "魏遣諸葛誕、胡遵等攻東興，諸葛恪率軍拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 271}, "text_hash": "6e0149ab11acebeffd5caf79ef985c12be0e8520569f9e130612747c2e3c5528"}

{"id": "p_dd4289621484188f", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 272, "text": "諸將皆曰：「敵聞太傅自來，上岸必遁走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 272}, "text_hash": "268c37e27b8e7dd9203110b4a69d9a98eda702f509f4cb5f5fbb084c4be04d21"}

{"id": "p_9aacbd8bdcfde5dd", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 273, "text": "彼動其境內，悉許、洛兵大舉而來，必有成規，豈虛還哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 273}, "text_hash": "2a465d308eb6010122353e787a6ccd2846110f73df3e70b751c0504fb89c28d0"}

{"id": "p_16cee5b36ef815df", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 274, "text": "無恃敵之不至，恃吾有以勝之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 274}, "text_hash": "7ff6929d1f00d33d7fcb3ea03b41b58d02290de0b90f6c04cab8d59201f20d9c"}

{"id": "p_eeba2c8acb9575cd", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 275, "text": "」及恪上岸，奉與將軍唐咨、呂據、留贊等，俱從山西上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 275}, "text_hash": "9c9876c1c63b291506f3f13758b0501a6189b6da40183026e88c5d69507407d5"}

{"id": "p_52c4e58e815198fa", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 276, "text": "奉曰：「今諸軍行遲，若敵據便地，則難與爭鋒矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 276}, "text_hash": "ff8b3fa77e2fbdc8d127556dea059842dc733f5f18e81d2bd2d2b9ce3a3ef788"}

{"id": "p_0d588d984b4fa3ed", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 277, "text": "」乃辟諸軍使下道，帥麾下三千人徑進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 277}, "text_hash": "aeee767dfac4788baf5632ba5110bd3fdd436bbc6ef12689a24ef6141bb3e8fb"}

{"id": "p_02b3990d1fee4f94", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 278, "text": "時北風，奉舉帆二日至，遂據徐塘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 278}, "text_hash": "31337f9280635a5d1bfece8f0fddc19a6f8fbc36694d952633cfb6947909f01b"}

{"id": "p_aafd01aafcf4080a", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 279, "text": "天寒雪，敵諸將置酒高會，奉見其前部兵少，相謂曰：「取封侯爵賞，正在今日！", "locator": {"ordinal": 279}, "text_hash": "f18713a85fe7330a13b9325ea7fa5033223b5314b0596efc412d8f9be19813cf"}

{"id": "p_a2eb395261cf1c6b", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 280, "text": "」乃使兵解鎧著冑，持短兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 280}, "text_hash": "61d876e3cddc9609005071adef106d1467391444c690c4bb4135d408e133110f"}

{"id": "p_f02f299f15754788", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 281, "text": "敵人從而笑焉，不爲設備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 281}, "text_hash": "11ecfd70a6d4a5cbbbf1ec4a6369c8e4402778ec141d7585040006e93fffc120"}

{"id": "p_71fa84736a4e9160", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 282, "text": "奉縱兵斫之，大破敵前屯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 282}, "text_hash": "5246febe03132233f5e23eaf170853abe9a6374e4c526da8fcb43c3473d1398e"}

{"id": "p_d9761d2d037b12c3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 283, "text": "遷滅寇將軍，進封都鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 283}, "text_hash": "6e0dfe4e0c2520582afce10d59f0e48ac9be548829b3679e14e65cfcc2712e5e"}

{"id": "p_0e09824102201f7d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 284, "text": "魏將文欽來降，以奉爲虎威將軍，從孫峻至壽春迎之，與敵追軍戰於高亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 284}, "text_hash": "f88c71babd231d6cddec02e1e72a56d7905d100b8105091cd5927aa10586e3f1"}

{"id": "p_f2a798f7d28703d1", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 285, "text": "奉跨馬持矛，突入其陣中，斬首數百，獲其軍器。", "locator": {"ordinal": 285}, "text_hash": "8ba35266949100531eedc33015dbecad0dd052a091b4066514dcc4cab33b30eb"}

{"id": "p_f15e35909fa93d34", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 286, "text": "，魏大將軍諸葛誕據壽春來降，魏人圍之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 286}, "text_hash": "a98d85bfb60e9d0393ba267e7eb6d928fc903a1969adb4cf7f8b2936002f68c7"}

{"id": "p_285bafdb259053fa", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 287, "text": "遣朱異、唐咨等往救，復使奉與黎斐解圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 287}, "text_hash": "cf862bf7de6dcb9e827bfe98507066fe90eee65d0927467c77491d88e6662571"}

{"id": "p_2c2003f0a401f9aa", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 288, "text": "奉爲先登，屯於黎漿，力戰有功，拜左將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 288}, "text_hash": "e5b7a0ed3b0d6379f9b415fed8f7ad52e3b3737cc6cbd363d107339f39c69238"}

{"id": "p_0d799bf18ce70422", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 289, "text": "孫休即位，與張布謀，欲誅孫綝，布曰：「丁奉雖不能吏書，而計略過人，能斷大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 289}, "text_hash": "9e341403cb6970b8dbad5146444843b3ff8d5e0275f3992e8c7dae76acf3a7da"}

{"id": "p_e35d6f7c8df4cabd", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 290, "text": "」休召奉告曰：「綝秉國威，將行不軌，欲與將軍誅之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 290}, "text_hash": "d17b603041d3dcb9af8b7ed87cc564f708e889b9d3f221d42e60f3e60d554663"}

{"id": "p_0eba5a1b3c451ab0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 291, "text": "」奉曰：「丞相兄弟友黨甚盛，恐人心不同，不可卒制，可因臘會，有陛下兵以誅之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 291}, "text_hash": "f2346a013a980015fd3564f0f2e0fca81018760988f8754b5be4ca3a7fe3f454"}

{"id": "p_366decb85ac01261", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 292, "text": "」休納其計，因會請綝，奉與張布目左右斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 292}, "text_hash": "f2526caacea5d42a5ea9970b9c66cfc07379eaad39c07a3c0d1b3ab34cc31344"}

{"id": "p_6ad4638d21f63bc3", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 293, "text": "六年，魏伐蜀，奉率諸軍向壽春，爲救蜀之勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 293}, "text_hash": "d7c27859691cc13f45a3b2ab73b97dd490e66ff9684574acfe899ea5655cebb8"}

{"id": "p_2a800e0038d73d5d", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 294, "text": "休薨，奉與丞相濮陽興等從萬彧之言，共迎立孫皓，遷右大司馬左軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 294}, "text_hash": "5029c471c9044dfb3be2d4f9e70063fdf7a362ae28f649c87d4a9d7b822a5e0e"}

{"id": "p_883dd965c772eb28", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 295, "text": "，皓命奉與諸葛靚攻合肥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 295}, "text_hash": "3f1e824fab453f194476ee3e81665d357cf31f8458799c0d4e983745cd10fcf1"}

{"id": "p_35f9da15a909e609", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 296, "text": "奉與晉大將石苞書，搆而間之，苞以徵還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 296}, "text_hash": "34a6e367e39b9b949b97ab6a292f9d1b66a80fe638c8db62a6fb5c824224150e"}

{"id": "p_ad7ac717f4742b76", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 297, "text": "，奉復帥衆治徐塘，因攻晉穀陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 297}, "text_hash": "30056063928866a82bbafb6027a69e3e67d095c1908aaae165b945907bf86171"}

{"id": "p_dc27d7c5ee41aab0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 298, "text": "穀陽民知之，引去，奉無所獲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 298}, "text_hash": "4f764fc27b84fb8cba3ee0aaa0d53734a9c5cfb79137559f3718aa5579808951"}

{"id": "p_ddd382cf86ca9c02", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 299, "text": "奉貴而有功，漸以驕矜，或有毀之者，皓追以前出軍事，徙奉家於臨川。", "locator": {"ordinal": 299}, "text_hash": "b2a875bfe298f6bec2a002b944f2a41bbff1ea1d8b78f6139aa173afb44f9586"}

{"id": "p_7a7c1b31f31b3e41", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 300, "text": "奉弟封，官至後將軍，先奉死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 300}, "text_hash": "7a5bdc691e5572931e921a334cd456b6d734af1aa9d12528fac7846c0adade21"}

{"id": "p_6aa5268a78b64d41", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 301, "text": "評曰：凡此諸將，皆江表之虎臣，孫氏之所厚待也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 301}, "text_hash": "60c35a7e8101dcafbcf2fcc1262191ca6fc95f2dd74350e46ad6ac23431432cf"}

{"id": "p_8580b98e5977bac0", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 302, "text": "以潘璋之不脩，權能忘過記功，其保據東南，宜哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 302}, "text_hash": "8af624424325c53d7352a82a26eb098587b150cd55b7cfee0b51b8cdf73aa97f"}

{"id": "p_625e9a58f65e6b06", "source_id": "src_598f4bd991d53b99", "ordinal": 303, "text": "陳表將家支庶，而與胄子名人比翼齊衡，拔萃出類，不亦美乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 303}, "text_hash": "3b07eecc96b01ffef0801fbc0ffa27abe790658de46ed01c148b4542f46b9a10"}

{"id": "p_8ff00e30242defac", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_31196a9d5dd8e4f8", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 1, "text": "朱治字君理，丹楊故鄣人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "347f272a3666783456416bca760783ea5c712ce02f22edd6ff385f52161b12ea"}

{"id": "p_49f74671ba0b54e0", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 2, "text": "初為縣吏，後察孝廉，州辟從事，隨孫堅征伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "a5714659c9fcf691fe349bc1ec3fe6bc8d6d88b90bf5fc5c522e59ccc33b7b15"}

{"id": "p_7921d828235f319a", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 3, "text": "從討長沙、零、桂等三郡賊周朝、蘇馬等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "aa812db3025afbe3f20b0cc4780b38d0b399b7c6de72aa42d31fa478b3b76852"}

{"id": "p_e51e2298bd458777", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 4, "text": "從破董卓於陽人，入洛陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "3e3b11fa8c23e0ed33fa9b2df20ef9bef79525b8378dd31f503d9e4bad96c5d0"}

{"id": "p_ffd7aa6532dfd227", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 5, "text": "表治行督軍校尉，特將步騎，東助徐州牧陶謙討黃巾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "7a04cfc9ff61d313a79c77e3a2f08680a8e47babbed7f6f009bcbf30a4a0ee3c"}

{"id": "p_1ac2925cd2119dca", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 6, "text": "會堅薨，治扶冀策，依就袁術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "2c6532fcb9dcf6a33b7333eaf5cc28af5d442ec9219bd014b4c831667c6efc7a"}

{"id": "p_37d5decc6d033abd", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 7, "text": "後知術政德不立，乃勸策還平江東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "3a8bc80f8a50ecd92af2a1eb4b775256bcf9ba250448926f7e339e4d6c7adfbf"}

{"id": "p_fbb425dcb2c88c68", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 8, "text": "時太傅馬日碑在壽春，辟治為掾，遷吳郡都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "cd8ad608b5bfd8b4e6bdb1cc50de921a60b5e449661c6b1edeef6ebe20f09213"}

{"id": "p_275dbd8e7977cb18", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 9, "text": "是時吳景已在丹楊，而策為術攻廬江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "3298644718583f8069462ccad8511c4662bb1ea2934c71579c4103e21e40730a"}

{"id": "p_6108951abf1db135", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 10, "text": "於是劉繇恐為袁、孫所並，遂構嫌隙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "6a6ea94e5c88897d2c3ede19da1e0d4175f27636d93a60ce2bc826d5d55a9ad6"}

{"id": "p_5cef5bab939b544e", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 11, "text": "而策家門盡在州下，治乃使人於曲阿迎太妃及權兄弟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "003c13b3aa3880ec77870321d5dd96a4c497c6f8b615930b709ff7b050cb6148"}

{"id": "p_93eb33a574eef60f", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 12, "text": "所以供奉輔護，甚有恩紀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "88e47ec334ec4764a8cd54474f9d8139091cfd8337d769ecbe13fcd3fa95d830"}

{"id": "p_b8ef23b6da30fcd0", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 13, "text": "治從錢唐欲進到吳，吳郡太守許貢拒之於由拳，治與戰，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "314650171bd2d205f87402629924809f675c9d7fcc25e356770aba2f7be231e4"}

{"id": "p_e93d6117f2c78c6d", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 14, "text": "貢南就山賊嚴自虎，治遂入郡，領太守事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "4ea7976c3a7ee47d224c02bf5f2cfdeaf033a969c961fc1fe5af5a4fd1a56178"}

{"id": "p_767fb805e5958c29", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 15, "text": "後策薨，治與張昭等共尊奉權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "394099efebd31708e15d1c1685e4553003ce3ed2b6eeb8ae9f60449cb2e7e7f1"}

{"id": "p_1fa3845348ae1c59", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 16, "text": "，權表治為〔吳郡〕太守，行扶義將軍，割婁、由拳、無錫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "c192d8a5c71faa6dde5a1501dc91171d1425234666dae50364e6cbf95bfa6066"}

{"id": "p_ce821c0bdf18e71e", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 17, "text": "征討夷越，佐定東南，禽截黃巾餘類陳敗、萬秉等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "a01ba77e9c3982dee520960cd7d7831059cb3fc6937a360be7b9a87350faa6c5"}

{"id": "p_32c61f8c43ef041e", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 18, "text": "二年，拜安國將軍，金印紫綬，徙封故鄣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "e4501fa0d510c5e36050adf4288debd9640b0c9c32e25f4b4e9e900be776c643"}

{"id": "p_b901d9eee6255272", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 19, "text": "權歷位上將，及為吳王，治每進見，權常親迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "9a0bf4e9c408394606b9bc8a9c25c0b78aaf32eeff40389326db85737711140c"}

{"id": "p_02b7a6a4de32f73a", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 20, "text": "執版交拜，饗宴贈賜，恩敬特隆，至從行吏，皆得奉贄私覿，其見異如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "b2c7fc29857fea783dc8d4d69194b116f39ee8613a2d6b769667d6344103e5d7"}

{"id": "p_e8758b46874d4205", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 21, "text": "初，權弟翊，性峭急，喜怒快意，治數責數，諭以道義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "b438bd7a5483ffe4e2b3d7ad5ee49f838f372ff896c91c496505ead40a63cc7c"}

{"id": "p_f776117e29955619", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 22, "text": "權從兄豫章太守賁，女為曹公子婦，及曹公破荊州，威震南土，賁畏懼，欲遣子入質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "c96a97dc1ed963f8837f7ceeb7e33dc61d38b45d991aa8c3f60ac300e4d82e1b"}

{"id": "p_5fd8433e9a567c3f", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 23, "text": "治聞之，求往見賁，為陳安危，賁由此遂止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "0dcd0209b4da182fb54c25f5c937230963524e8aa3ee1753fc2493bef4ff4191"}

{"id": "p_b3fdeec04053a37c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 24, "text": "性儉約，雖在富貴，車服惟供事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "731cf7ff537ab4dc5d8b3c0244cfb4f6b6baa22cd42c1b99fc802b2fe4c9eafe"}

{"id": "p_990ecbc405248e12", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 25, "text": "權優異之，自令督軍御史典屬城文書，治領四縣租稅而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "94696e8eccef87569f6a797781046e9950aaabaa8b6cc367f37b9b5d59677eab"}

{"id": "p_867f2e9f2d4ba479", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 26, "text": "然公族子弟及吳四姓多出仕郡，郡吏常以千數，治率數年一遣詣王府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "ea9abc7247b7a527839edea3509b3e1e3602ab778c1a0e8e64704567d0c7bd58"}

{"id": "p_7bf54c2c51c32452", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 27, "text": "所遣數百人，每歲時貢獻御，權答報過厚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "ac1fe30727f38246b06a79499735122bb5589757c604ec7babb2a7d95f4d1bce"}

{"id": "p_4be5a5cb86fee5cb", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 28, "text": "是時丹楊深地，頗有奸叛，亦以年向老，思戀土風，自表屯故鄣，鎮扶山越。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "08998259e2054a017852bc9794fd24f4a4b5f213161b3e3a11a705ee62a78086"}

{"id": "p_698104426c3f2f34", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 29, "text": "諸父老故人，莫不詣門，治皆引進，與共飲宴，鄉黨以為榮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "006259c974c63a7fc9ffdb51ec907b2ceac87e4c9c3a92640affe588da1854d5"}

{"id": "p_14b5b7c09034dbcf", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 30, "text": "卒，在郡三十一年，年六十九。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "9779d6ea5cbad0f0f643d191a3ba554fcd6340ae98c4482164fb93c2b1f7112d"}

{"id": "p_2f07ef2f58c2d8df", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 31, "text": "子才，素為校尉領兵，既嗣父爵，遷偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "c56a24ca34992a0153eef206799be9b1b90e4aecad2ab766f1a115541a561c18"}

{"id": "p_33389f3f02496ddf", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 32, "text": "才弟紀，權以策女妻之，亦以校尉領兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "1dc6bee9cd9334212db0a0ccc38d0a6e75fecae0fe87a2bdb436240553118504"}

{"id": "p_f1d2bf2cb2d1a906", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 33, "text": "才子琬，襲爵為將，至鎮西將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "670111f55ebe8719b338c4a35dfc699e1316c85d7d18889b2fa3156b16b4e336"}

{"id": "p_ec43f62b6d1564f9", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 34, "text": "=== 治甥 然 ===", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "ef8735fd840fbde1a3460770370905335e04316c5c39b1fdee19d8f5552f0a72"}

{"id": "p_b35004f3823b00bb", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 35, "text": "朱然字義封，治姊子也，本姓施氏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "ba75bd6cd15b92442bb361255bc3378ca0d0ad4512696436d1f48f7fdd0ce776"}

{"id": "p_b47be555b25266d3", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 36, "text": "初治未有子，然年十三，乃啟策乞以為嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "416fdfb4bf3f67b0d10b02f7c3a15a9b83351b32720507164f8ff417fa925260"}

{"id": "p_6714d76f5be6213a", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 37, "text": "策命丹楊郡以羊酒召然，然到吳，策優以禮賀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "6e4b625349b6b62c6df3e48d248e4e162da6405157ad71381d458bd75bc9221d"}

{"id": "p_73719439b3215e38", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 38, "text": "然嘗與權同學書，結恩愛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "de528d2df529de83b8e2f6aeecd54c740c84d79c2d4d0a114a80760b04b1a874"}

{"id": "p_ea10de4568d12c1c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 39, "text": "至權統事，以然為餘姚長，時年十九。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "43fb784462ae3431006e36f2b9b3ba94b9e12ba4314e3d0b6e47e16e66e153d1"}

{"id": "p_0ceb3371f7ce0aeb", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 40, "text": "後遷山陰令，加折沖校尉，督五縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "47f7346ae706e44cfbb4baf127cd06d62d3336f50cd1f2f7263cbc50d53f48de"}

{"id": "p_bfad5142840f056c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 41, "text": "權奇其能，分丹楊為臨川郡，然為太守，授兵二千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "a9ff62a2dc46fbbf5adc11f39018c9e0fec7dfaa87b0ad53f0d21b67b820f52c"}

{"id": "p_8d3d1763ebffa567", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 42, "text": "會山賊盛起，然平討，旬月而定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "60eb9c87da18b73103a984a69d7f0c9835f1518f60fdef479f3262d3ec8b9d2b"}

{"id": "p_b012a6bfdd5a9611", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 43, "text": "曹公出濡須，然備大塢及三關屯，拜偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "37535f1f6f9a1df3681057fd93afc515812b46a947d4c589a04c33837cc40541"}

{"id": "p_d33cc744fcc433dc", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 44, "text": "，從討關羽，別與潘璋到臨沮禽羽，遷昭武將軍，封西安鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "c785bf1d2fc3cc04fc70f6bcb5f2d3183100cb10f5f98bffce06c20269f009b5"}

{"id": "p_6511bd53c6c733a8", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 45, "text": "權問曰：「卿如不起，誰可代者?」蒙對曰：「朱然膽守有餘，愚以為可任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "4e92c2db9e0a3ce868b018d64f58518c054f4b201445f61abed04da045beb26a"}

{"id": "p_aac691de85b18cbe", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 46, "text": "」蒙卒，權假然節，鎮江陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "ae0c1d5f48e4a24a47b113988aa8675d234305101f538c5f28c025df2a0b7128"}

{"id": "p_468055b7b236fe34", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 47, "text": "黃武元年，劉備舉兵攻宜都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "077cabd59ca31386f910f679025d53942a1aa846035f38d375e48a4d20f29e81"}

{"id": "p_2e233ae302f2a7c1", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 48, "text": "然督五千人與陸遜並力拒備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "7c9f185f657d1a33b4246c9294e69f12eb524e374d923dd83e05373fbe536161"}

{"id": "p_04e064959a8eb971", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 49, "text": "然別攻破備前鋒，斷其後道，備遂破走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "7afcc283e841e7fc1868e2cfbdca4d155079810afb523a9b630d8e3ffbc576ad"}

{"id": "p_269f2392b1d1e518", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 50, "text": "魏遣曹真、夏侯尚、張郃等攻江陵，魏文帝自住宛，為其勢援，連屯圍城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "42dcb2bb702293fdf729abe97f1e7fbe1e308080956a01914caa06c0c3a3fcda"}

{"id": "p_2c40adc01877ecf9", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 51, "text": "權遣將軍孫盛督萬人備州上，立圍塢，為然外救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "a01b120663c063672121a679f2eeeb66f0e87508dbe440aaabf04619b8c1db7c"}

{"id": "p_bc526143b8a5769c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 52, "text": "郃渡兵攻盛，盛不能拒，即時欲退，郃據州上圍守，然中外斷絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "109700f540af2cca1bbec3f94ebc3bb0fa7f80e062805d65a3e9afe7d7e6affc"}

{"id": "p_6ef94c507bd81439", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 53, "text": "權遣潘璋、楊粲等解而圍不解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "d1d284c9236f0c55da9136ca0c1a3ab98e43f7a1251bcaa124f2c6326404b5ac"}

{"id": "p_b4b25e01e183171b", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 54, "text": "時然城中兵多腫病，堪戰者裁五千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "2aec8bd33bb4331a01b1cd5d2fa24f1ac90b3457e53ad0359ffff0c2e0d570e1"}

{"id": "p_a4cf8aa6ea4a1dad", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 55, "text": "真等起土山，鑿地道，立樓櫓臨城，弓矢雨注，將士皆失色，然晏如而無恐意，方厲吏士，伺間隙攻破兩屯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "af9b763b385d80f185eb43cd520f257069e37c319ed7bf35b9048ec357c7a947"}

{"id": "p_621ea372dcaec1d2", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 56, "text": "魏攻圍然凡六月日，未退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "e625c7970509d75f66858a40d6f8db0e7ac5d996190cf87e728e587ee2868ee2"}

{"id": "p_ca79cf92c785f226", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 57, "text": "江陵令姚泰領兵備城北門，見外兵盛，城中人少，谷食慾盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "4702c975f6ea91a62a4026b82207b86e6795abcbed6b475dc3311409c3cb01c3"}

{"id": "p_fb37ffbddea16e35", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 58, "text": "尚等不能克，乃徹攻退還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "bab70b3a1c54e463a92f3bc8a69d87f51c4fa9e17bc2fa698a988f15d5d67c88"}

{"id": "p_05b8f121ddf00687", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 59, "text": "由是然名震於敵國，改封當陽侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "a8b622b1f2e59fdf87d39f6d616fad2288eca7f90bb241297838f7b82c997116"}

{"id": "p_2f57edfd610e12b0", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 60, "text": "六年，權自率眾攻石陽，及至旋師，潘璋斷後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "4eca44f75983047f78299b592af37d4a4dc783df0345bce56b40762c34536ccf"}

{"id": "p_01250ecd30c7a211", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 61, "text": "夜出錯亂，敵追擊璋，璋不能禁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "76a17ff5a7782ce0a1fa998c6993b3b0981827d9ef92665027fbe5e300651468"}

{"id": "p_d8e97f314de62b0e", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 62, "text": "然即還住拒敵，使前船得引極遠，徐乃後發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "65e429757c06e7063a39f4be776f00403faed3f6b1ffb78fcc835f983613d36b"}

{"id": "p_fa61bc8e006aa70f", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 63, "text": "，拜車騎將軍、右護軍、領兗州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "183b020b07991b68084afe48a6ea6a9afbf553202e58b51b7c1ec0d4114a0f6c"}

{"id": "p_50e6300cd359e0ac", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 64, "text": "頃之，以兗州在蜀分，解牧職。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "fd355ef074a8430d45642b78ba453ebd0a83f7932f46fc99f3ff0bd0987e3a72"}

{"id": "p_873ba37733c537d3", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 65, "text": "，權與蜀剋期大舉，權自向新城，然與全琮備受斧鉞，為左右督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "00509adfbb35dca27c7e95d9ac23c43f632285faf211308b91e8b93632686f67"}

{"id": "p_92af088b9b6dbe13", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 66, "text": "會吏士疾病，故未攻而退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "a7d958f6938147ef6ae38621e50a87cca17dbc86c0e27c8dd9f27b207cec1f6d"}

{"id": "p_20ebb7fb0b30137c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 67, "text": "，征柤中，魏將蒲忠、胡質各將數千人，忠要遮險隘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "a5fb22a74445fd14920e64be247df412d53e23251b1605c173939bab32367d3e"}

{"id": "p_3737a53dee645cdd", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 68, "text": "時然所督兵將先四出，聞問不暇收合，便將帳下見兵八百人逆掩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "5b4521b2977d5c07a3ea4efd662c0c3d8ac5393759db82d7e9993a10e50dcd9f"}

{"id": "p_ba5c069920b27653", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 69, "text": "九年，復征柤中，魏將李興等聞然深入，率步騎六千斷然後道，然夜出逆之，軍以勝反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "4a722135c455636a854161f3aef3a87c7358642e90b954420dbb0612fe99e454"}
