{"id": "p_5ebbd646b2f2e0a5", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 70, "text": "先是，歸義馬茂懷奸，覺誅，權深忿之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "2fb9e75d475b9dd13b462b6d702f3f6e8bb7711884b262a393ff575176053535"}

{"id": "p_8788d0479505ac3d", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 71, "text": "然臨行上疏曰：「馬茂小子，敢負恩養。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "ea9fb4878fdc1dd1ca48e218ffb38962f2a556d742018d007bfff33dfa7255d4"}

{"id": "p_332eb469cfe2ea1a", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 72, "text": "臣今奉天威，事蒙克捷，欲令所獲，震耀遠近，方舟塞江，使足可觀，以解上下之忿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "9b7b888a082928d08863bb152096d4d9fa30ccd48596fbc9700576fec41cdcc1"}

{"id": "p_7d08f4dab4e422ad", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 73, "text": "惟陛下識臣先言，責臣後效。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "395824ca0b8fb7ee2d904cd25c29fce2fdfe61ed501d8be0e8243214456a8cbd"}

{"id": "p_e80ab1d47a00e76a", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 74, "text": "然既獻捷，群臣上賀，權乃舉酒作樂，而出然表曰：「此家前初有表，孤以為難必，今果如其言，可謂明於見事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "30af58873ab6e0f96761bc5ba4bcaf25270f63989cf6b07373183878ed43555e"}

{"id": "p_06a4be70142807c2", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」遣使拜然為左大司馬、右軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "84fd1bd6d5fcba782cc2ee3ee5c4d89daad32dc635dc99fffd7cae1323b5aafb"}

{"id": "p_1625e20e46e3b0c1", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 76, "text": "然長不盈七尺，氣候分明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "fd38b1544e2e203754cc92677e8b1f00bdfd2ad5f5bddcee4cf3457b0dd22961"}

{"id": "p_5f330d2dcc77bf3c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 77, "text": "內行修潔，其所文采，惟施軍器，餘皆質素。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "e5eb00b80748694712159c78135f48defa7ec0a512184fb64891a2bd75a1360f"}

{"id": "p_99d87fca63e969cf", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 78, "text": "終日欽欽，常在戰場，臨急膽定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "04c51a6aa37a42a45c34ff5cf5f27fb883098edb20ef7b0e3a7c2c5d643fda25"}

{"id": "p_72397ccbbfe46cfc", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 79, "text": "雖世無事，每朝夕嚴鼓，兵在營者，咸行裝就隊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "35b929528f72cb99f9882d3bbd8e5b6e3cbeab353922278a40dee1128f49a659"}

{"id": "p_53d31130051baa6f", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 80, "text": "以此玩敵，使不知所備，故出輒有功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "9efe42139a0e6c6d83cd9915e08ebc286350e2a3ae9456c43b46c408f1275e25"}

{"id": "p_6de7f186ba7dbb68", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 81, "text": "諸葛瑾子融，步騭子協，雖各襲任，權特復使然總為大督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "5fc39e830408b8f1123a5d4b312c1b1910aba8fd7b1d965b788923af65133ab4"}

{"id": "p_99509d5144b5ec3f", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 82, "text": "又陸遜亦本，功臣名將存者惟然，莫與比隆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "8052471e973ae55b1a78bb73cdf7bf0fc56ac461f896365a04d4d42c824238ed"}

{"id": "p_87e284eeef3e02a5", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 83, "text": "寢疾二年，後漸增篤，權晝為減膳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "a3bfb0c96bede2c77463310f0d9a4f430281491738033aac420c740f44bdedd7"}

{"id": "p_cdc3c35d0faa785b", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 84, "text": "夜為不寐，中使醫藥口食之物，相望於道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "91e79a8378671713b5d83897668988c74742a6c3c34b77a5e132cf5874973962"}

{"id": "p_3df64680c020c507", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 85, "text": "然每遣使表疾病消息，權輒召見，口自問訊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "287778373576243c00db5de412cb075499c3a4bba54c097d9fc961ce8120dc08"}

{"id": "p_b8e5df090b86d5e9", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 86, "text": "自創業功臣疾病，權意之所鐘，呂蒙、淩統最重，然其次矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "c35608ba323cf7dc8a313ebba9c1f437f1e3425b9b95a8a730b0aa6cc528cf84"}

{"id": "p_612767ea2469abaa", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 87, "text": "年六十八，卒，權素服舉哀，為之感慟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "2e86259d13a3ee6bf5025f69883cb6d69944cd4ad15d0bc032282d242b5bc6eb"}

{"id": "p_b6552f4a23bbf487", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 88, "text": "績字公緒，以父任為郎，後拜建忠都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "f6c325cf69497c2ac3c32b38639ea057cafcddbb5c9f28987395e7a256ba0383"}

{"id": "p_ed0c88dfe27ec1b1", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 89, "text": "叔父才卒，績領其兵，隨太常潘浚討五溪，以膽力稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "3dbe4da167bcd06711196197f0cbccd2f71e9d960c8ed305dbf532c11df44d57"}

{"id": "p_c2c2804a392bd800", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 90, "text": "遷偏將軍營下督，領盜賊事，持法不傾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "3aa8b6fbe605c83ea00f63d6f485a23be5ba899be255cd40d027c465c17d1718"}

{"id": "p_7d30116fad8f9e36", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 91, "text": "魯王霸注意交績，嘗至其廨，就之坐，欲與結好，績下地住立，辭而不當。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "980939bb60b3ba248d1eefcc4300363c50a75dc063f88e395e70834011cca513"}

{"id": "p_90e5e26bce420842", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 92, "text": "績襲業，拜平魏將軍，樂鄉督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "544894dfd8bce29b2be811da6c655610cd5b419998cccb317c381898c5875e52"}

{"id": "p_86dd1f850fb5b96b", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 93, "text": "明年，魏徵南將軍王昶率眾攻江陵城，不克而退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "81869332667743ea168dc700c90c4fdd87aa31f7b0dbe9831b027d4012cfd9db"}

{"id": "p_1f3929852da6ffdd", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 94, "text": "績與奮威將軍諸葛融書曰：「昶遠來疲睏，馬無所食，力屈而走，此天助也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "17634f014f63941f0cb42a38197534947835deaf4512e9dec4b53e66351ce377"}

{"id": "p_0ec7150bd9b804b4", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 95, "text": "今追之力少，可引兵相繼，吾欲破之於前，足下乘之於後，豈一人之功哉，宜同斷金之義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "7d2a868b43d83588be6963b3f8a7ad5548073959dc26c08702ebb981d67e7f4e"}

{"id": "p_ef9b781719a23e41", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 96, "text": "績便引兵及昶於紀南，紀南去城三十里，績先戰勝而融不進，績後失利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "36bcf523f17ad6119cbd2cd00fa9d4c1a24b37541dcf0b06a4c232f511f33c3b"}

{"id": "p_376f455872de5006", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 97, "text": "權深嘉績，盛責怒融，融兄大將軍恪貴重，故融得不廢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "8c15b3dd559323e39fec33f31db0b0a4c6286dc393b42511756e7197265556e9"}

{"id": "p_3e3964bcc4b270e5", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 98, "text": "初績與恪、融不平，及此事變，為隙益甚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "6e24c37905a75aa4aa8ce17399ea00ce23fd6565f3e313fb7aae3de37224b674"}

{"id": "p_484c2bd31141be21", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 99, "text": "二年春，恪向新城，要績並力，而留置半州，使融兼其任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "ed17265252ca4beec62a0c3f16fda4601a59f69f3403c069a5321fbc635b8cab"}

{"id": "p_6d6118cdbe3f5cde", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 100, "text": "冬，恪、融被害，績復還樂鄉，假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "4c8da9eac124ecc13be16d231321dca97734e8e586881848ef330162efc9f514"}

{"id": "p_312dcb92333c295f", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 101, "text": "孫綝秉政，大臣疑貳，績恐吳必擾亂，而中國乘釁，乃密書結蜀，使為並兼之慮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "825c80a5fbee4821b474734fe591e1e6111b74e6d4b42ea6d61500552f7414b3"}

{"id": "p_507eb68ddeaf43c8", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 102, "text": "蜀遣右將軍閻宇將兵五千，增白帝守，以須績之後命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "ecde2b01b1ef6d48c925ca2b9f2f58602341dec0a647f8c8ef323469f9f06c5c"}

{"id": "p_ba384554e1afbb12", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 103, "text": "永安初，遷上大將軍、都護督，自巴丘上迄西陵，，就拜左大司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "884af6adde552b9ac30610076473c644ed579ccc45c7ecfc3c4bb373abc5ce91"}

{"id": "p_fbc93ff4d93ad072", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 104, "text": "初，然為治行喪竟，乞復本姓，權不許，績以五鳳中表還為施氏，卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "01169138c1f7958df847a74b520c62809e68291882db6ccf69af46856719b6c4"}

{"id": "p_2f6d89b388e2feb9", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 105, "text": "呂範字子衡，汝南細陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "a68918a0d8eab383a49e2a54073938960dedd1c22a23bc00f42a812c26007236"}

{"id": "p_384bc879f6706a17", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 106, "text": "邑人劉氏，家富女美，範求之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "f0e61af754a5a3213873b29cad62bfaf841224bb561b464d7a97306a8e8a99c8"}

{"id": "p_03cbb272bebc0c34", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 107, "text": "女母嫌，欲勿與，劉氏曰：「觀呂子衡，寧當久貧者邪?」遂與之婚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "918f274f931d076e331c9e07b79cf5ad1f8fb26d3d8a23ef268bca7436438210"}

{"id": "p_fcb34eb736abb100", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 108, "text": "後避亂壽春，孫策見而異之，範遂自委暱，將私客百人歸策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "d6020e0c0e0fcbe1193d46b1db2014cacbb3e4e867768ac8bd302bd9684da9ca"}

{"id": "p_f61fea73dc0b7f0b", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 109, "text": "時太妃在江都，策遣範迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "0afc20ca9631b9e8c06b485e63e7c51c0235f85cafa865fa8b327f7c06100535"}

{"id": "p_a3a41548752f8465", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 110, "text": "徐州牧陶謙謂範為袁氏覘候，諷縣掠考範，範親客健兒篡取以歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "36e646be729cf09eb3cd72dd0cba211991403bf386fc14758b9701623c1c05bd"}

{"id": "p_b852dfd808afb21d", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 111, "text": "時唯範與孫河常從策，跨涉辛苦，危難不避，策亦親戚待之，每與升堂飲宴於太妃前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "3a3558156eaa5350836daa4e73a6e0e1c7ccb79401e96f5aac468cbf450a8199"}

{"id": "p_1e87de45ad051ca9", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 112, "text": "後從策攻破廬江，還俱東渡，到橫江、當利，破長英、於麋，下小丹楊、湖孰，領湖孰相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "effefb8df968faede00416080e8175bd153366875e0d38635156b983b19ae4b4"}

{"id": "p_1d3f5be20aa39be1", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 113, "text": "策定秣陵、曲阿，收笮融，劉繇餘眾，增範兵二千，騎五十匹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "e1617d5cb9a1ee47fb0913cd2f9eb68590f9f32d3519bda2e7b9db3c0096ba4d"}

{"id": "p_c9628c0eb8e8d188", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 114, "text": "後領宛陵令，討破丹楊賊，還吳，遷都督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "4e10215da16c1d6779d2b0aff903ee6ea279e82a8b1a4b2a286a2acba531ff0c"}

{"id": "p_79c8fc58bdb032ff", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 115, "text": "是時下邳陳瑀自號吳都太守，住海西，與強族嚴白虎交通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "f62fa6ac927b3b69c9547e2b194a40db837e6d657c6ec5a67cb2269c3d450ba6"}

{"id": "p_714bb60d8abb07da", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 116, "text": "策自將討虎，別遣範與徐逸攻瑀於海西，梟其大將陳牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "b127d803ca182ead938a5797a183cfe87fad8136ca941661d86e62f8cb1e82c5"}

{"id": "p_88f6dccb9302990c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 117, "text": "又從攻祖郎於陵陽，太史慈於勇裡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "26f75e475506440db6e50be058541a08ca263f56c47e93681a880706dd403ba2"}

{"id": "p_ce269f79b7400da2", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 118, "text": "七縣平定，拜征虜中郎將，征江夏，還平鄱陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "5dce4b68b98fb415e534d996a810f8c8e2585f2ab79cf9bbd9177911cfa9b73f"}

{"id": "p_b143640ed506988f", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 119, "text": "後權復征江夏，範與張昭留守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "508e0a325178250ddb86158b0feafb23ba8d391501c8298e09dca2b31cb64110"}

{"id": "p_6b7fdd7cc4b7222c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 120, "text": "曹公至赤壁，與周瑜等俱拒破之，拜裨將軍，領彭澤太守，以彭澤、柴桑、歷陽為奉邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "5d47efe1209d316d18d2f37c2ac8fe1ff43b3a8a7669b957b9fa712f69dcb7b6"}

{"id": "p_9f98d5c3fd9e1995", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 121, "text": "劉備詣京見權，範密請留備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "d948fcdb4205f93f87c7880d7927fede79e84a9d689364b6a1bedac5629ed11a"}

{"id": "p_8b34c1a60031ae92", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 122, "text": "謂曰：「昔早從卿言，無此勞也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "3ca973f60597e017abdd1088f8e419a5cff437051369b4d9b4ece7217e5e0a69"}

{"id": "p_b3c9ce8cb10fc60c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 123, "text": "今當上取之，卿為我守建業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "c6acf6379a85ddc15ddda82c93b9f258e088bce499eae8cdaf3a6a41dfe1c7bd"}

{"id": "p_fb1d9638f0564024", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 124, "text": "」權破羽還，都武昌，拜範建威將軍，封宛陵候，領丹楊太守，治建業，督扶州以下至海，轉以溧陽、懷安、寧國為奉邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "a46c059de401d1e371a33227183e86f9329b19cb7f7ad1db9c43b2c6584caa13"}

{"id": "p_e145d8b17cccb600", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 125, "text": "曹休、張遼，臧霸等來伐，範督徐盛、全琮、孫韶等，以舟師拒休等於洞口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "d31e67ae40e99ecb5bb80abc723d9de7888fd6111a69b942b94c14e53e704c83"}

{"id": "p_bc0eff46236f501e", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 126, "text": "遷前將軍，假節，改封南昌候。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "eae039b20c2ee8e5d9551247ea7de71b2249d9ec74a952e68e749d9ad37a2020"}

{"id": "p_e9229403c4a5c59c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 127, "text": "時遭大風，船人覆溺，死者數千，還軍，拜揚州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "bfc6a4126df364d5c4024f011b29b6592d27708fb49facd3a1f521ad33ad5c34"}

{"id": "p_d6cf6ffba3938689", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 128, "text": "性好威儀，州民如陸遜、全琮及貴公子，皆修敬虔肅，不敢輕脫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "4aff84c4c06f4159897d153a3c710a4f64339e45b6a0d29d958218a93a28491b"}

{"id": "p_075d50012e32205a", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 129, "text": "其居處服飾，於時奢靡，然勤事奉法，故權悅其忠，不怪其侈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "05b1105e167a1959509886fb897aa2343cdc6ab732a089878b6a73d22bd48ee0"}

{"id": "p_dadb301692fcca5a", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 130, "text": "初策使範曲主財計，權時年少，私從有求，範必關白，不敢專許，當時以此見望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "11b8d48bf6829014914186d348c3ac7a8d9aa532591d559f804b3811ca70d2bb"}

{"id": "p_d75f1972053df6cd", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 131, "text": "權守陽羨長，有所私用，策或料覆，功曹周谷輒為傅著薄書，使無譴問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "27dfdfbe01acc5ba6ae5ba4e725ea746ccd5c32914337a5a6fed84f018666b65"}

{"id": "p_e6d97a45f19d0250", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 132, "text": "權臨時悅之，及後統事，以範忠誠，厚見信任，以谷能欺更簿書，不用也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "7350b142e83218a9b2e38fa2d7f87d38971477963a1713cdd27d8f6f479c06c5"}

{"id": "p_e4ece984b6d79315", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 133, "text": "，範遷大司馬，印綬未下，疾卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "10182db3626fb2c7182aae6302d65772c988793a8fc8bb0e520d0ed335bea9ea"}

{"id": "p_17f637154eb72f3c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 134, "text": "權素服舉哀，遣使者追贈印綬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "c3566518f2a692ecd9f290ac8d2c627017c6786c82081a87683a28ef570ad1bf"}

{"id": "p_d82f0a06f99d4d49", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 135, "text": "及還都建業，權過範墓呼曰：「子衡！", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "838c37523d90444db965e52e8bbdddb5308da6c4108f323a9621df1d1dddacba"}

{"id": "p_4123853e72643efd", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 136, "text": "以父任為郎，後範寢疾，拜副軍校尉，佐領軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "6cb02583fa571c98fabce8462a2c00978734359d92ff3e3baaf300002047a2f5"}

{"id": "p_c56354cb21243636", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 137, "text": "數討山賊，諸深惡劇地，所擊皆破、隨太常潘浚討五溪，復有功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "7a97d7e35c7e0afa63ad7edbe0985bf0ce1cd1fe2fbff3dface9ecc3e6f79f9b"}

{"id": "p_c084d54103c48619", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 138, "text": "朱然攻樊，據與朱異破城外圍，還拜偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "aad71fc46b03eb119211041e3af855a9ed28849a1590b327363feff8abc39fcf"}

{"id": "p_a23a233e254acd19", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 139, "text": "入補馬閒右部督，遷越騎校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "f3d1d2596638fe0865fb4db0c0ee0d3b18723e31a07f46df77df1b7596f193cf"}

{"id": "p_87e64ead142936de", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 140, "text": "，大風，江水溢流，漸淹城門，權使視水，獨見據使人取大船以備害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "b371ec3ca5dfaad3999a2ec915cd263a1c884ff9e4ed739e26be205b4906a390"}

{"id": "p_7a8d605b102e5b5c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 141, "text": "權寢疾，以據為太子右部督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "3e0f96b6d90aed32dacdcb44af245943986c6477615ed41c798f1c254b1a0a6b"}

{"id": "p_5a739587c809d26f", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 142, "text": "明年，孫峻殺諸葛恪，遷據為驃騎將軍，平西宮事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "de2831edccab7f7c2eb70b048a26ae842ef7c733cf4ff61f6d6581623ddff488"}

{"id": "p_365eaa7a806a6d3d", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 143, "text": "，假節，與峻等襲壽春，還遇魏將曹珍，破之於高亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "b33b104581d96f2638e41d612408881bfa821f80b48e82eaa0eab876cbb1197d"}

{"id": "p_0552e89dd5174f96", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 144, "text": "，帥師侵魏，未及淮，聞孫峻死，以從弟綝自代，據大怒，引軍還，欲廢綝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "356739d099fab4f68e163a0e5d92564ac693f04f0baa5483334de5e6868066e3"}

{"id": "p_04ec64e4bbd0a083", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 145, "text": "綝聞之，使中書奉詔，詔文欽、劉纂，唐咨等使取據，又遣從兄慮以都下兵逆據於江都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "f45fe7a9fc5cb654c38699a82c693584984ad375e4c559e10853ce12488944f5"}

{"id": "p_fa321e6ca17d0185", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 146, "text": "左右勸據降魏，據曰：「恥為叛臣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "b3b00c8a9090806a022b8ae5e4623574b487a5805813d27f77bc5d14ef911cc8"}

{"id": "p_7687d6329d86ebff", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 147, "text": "朱桓字休穆，吳郡吳人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "6c45a421edf2b104d88bb27a0f92f211423e8e07e97a27458c44fe3f47aff363"}

{"id": "p_8d3d7f009355fdbc", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 148, "text": "孫權為將軍，桓給事幕府，除餘姚長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "2a1b63ca13681830bab3c58d6f5439b6d70df2d27297cc0fb423146fb8f73cc9"}

{"id": "p_dce7c2be691e15b7", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 149, "text": "往遇疫癘，谷食荒貴，桓分部良吏，隱親醫藥，餐粥相繼，士民感戴之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "83c5c8421531dbeef846c35198af22c045b6d87b6584e2746d22ecf7c81a2815"}

{"id": "p_c1657a81100e02ea", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 150, "text": "遷蕩寇校尉，授兵二千人，使部伍吳、會二郡，鳩合遺散，期年之間，得萬餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "6a8940beefe5f1f9e4aa64e2340eb78d0a8c60224d5c1c48dee1e8626bf06e0d"}

{"id": "p_dead306c6efc1bc5", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 151, "text": "後丹楊、鄱陽山賊蜂起，攻沒城郭，殺略長吏，處處屯聚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "3468e8167f0af26881c653ce440f72b7ba792fc819d0dfede31b50ddfc9a4ec4"}

{"id": "p_dbfc9b45fd103675", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 152, "text": "桓督領諸將，周旋赴討，應皆平定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "c175e8712b067a09b9b0221bbc13101c93fc78d55273b17fff1230d3ca394b31"}

{"id": "p_318716c983642d49", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 153, "text": "稍遷裨將軍，封新城亭候。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "48b2b3bfc37d180287cea169a729cc28c2398af84eab204e16eaa22c1c293033"}

{"id": "p_965ea0f978bf94db", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 154, "text": "，魏使大司馬曹仁步騎數萬向濡須，仁欲以兵襲取州上，偽先揚聲欲東攻羨溪；桓分兵將赴羨溪，既發，卒得仁進軍拒濡須七十里問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "c7ea0f6bd747a9da121b93d98041188d2ede4697b529a45d6d0a7cfcb1efceb7"}

{"id": "p_f2907ab90b1e91f6", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 155, "text": "桓遣使追還羨溪兵，兵未到而仁奄至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "e9b82df666a16cd102a5f1b7a0b655c6002eb4e504d27dde8189452e54a22a61"}

{"id": "p_6f2e4025f219f097", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 156, "text": "時桓手下及所部兵，在者五千人，諸將業業，各有懼心，桓喻之曰：「凡兩軍交對，勝負在將，不在眾寡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "7a819c87252b26360241dc6a23a0c940b0370c067e622ec4b52f9e5d6cc397e9"}

{"id": "p_d31a099250114ab0", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 157, "text": "諸君聞曹仁用兵行師，孰與桓邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "0c78f3daf4fffdcc8be6daadf97c0a61ed6e69919ed7bbf8bbdf32d0ab84bf46"}

{"id": "p_c8e894779a57794b", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 158, "text": "兵法所以稱客倍而主人半者，謂俱在平原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "52630c790611520b06fb13b9d289003c04fd741221d164a2a9db7d398c5debfb"}

{"id": "p_9963a57a3a013888", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 159, "text": "無城池之守，又謂士眾勇怯齊等故耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "aa61a10346c6131e3cda9619fe8263ae80baa56965b2786aebb086da7f7f2417"}

{"id": "p_71fc8dc7064edde7", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 160, "text": "今人既非智勇，加其士卒甚怯，又千里步涉，人馬罷困，桓與諸軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "38b945e7380c58b678566e894ba1d09baf4f4bf5cf80fa8993bae05a123ef163"}

{"id": "p_a477bbbe5bdc0dd7", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 161, "text": "共據高城，南臨大江，北背山陵，以逸待勞，為主制客，此百戰百勝之勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "d56314e1bc8fe768ecc81a7660ef4f54eddf2d229d5108b857adeb3b48b382a7"}

{"id": "p_7e3aeb7410c09e37", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 162, "text": "雖曹丕自來，尚不足憂，況仁等邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "aae04126dcbc66d4e19094ef33e714751a4083623bff42ccc35a30ab48708376"}

{"id": "p_92374260bd39d733", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」桓因偃旗鼓，外示虛弱，以誘致仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "a3fb0ac95bb4d06f3d37bbba05778bf9e9db2c94a710a30b7bbbf4072698881d"}

{"id": "p_152665223b87ada5", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 164, "text": "仁果遣其子泰攻濡須城，分遣將軍常雕督諸葛虔、王雙等，乘油船別襲中洲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "c87e1adf6bc454f5e5fb57e7597fbdfc804867f88362941728698c3030090c93"}

{"id": "p_b0f3b13be642521e", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 165, "text": "中洲者，部曲妻子所在也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "718acc24add84bfaa395c360c55535d2b3c5b649d67555a132201faba47f3866"}

{"id": "p_619fb82d778a513c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 166, "text": "仁自將萬人留橐皋，復為泰等後拒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "33bcf6c75faef3d4404d087981db8239f4242aeae0f0aabe0cadd3991428efa6"}

{"id": "p_a8cae579faef064e", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 167, "text": "桓部兵將攻取油船，或別擊雕等，桓等身自拒泰，燒營而退，遂梟雕，生虜雙，送武昌，臨陳斬溺死者千餘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "53c7be99951c1ee7e56b8acef3da23f50d3f655582a05e1007007fd03080a10f"}

{"id": "p_3a5c604106a73e5f", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 168, "text": "權嘉桓功，封嘉興侯，遷奮武將軍，領彭城相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "8b28d410f8ecc1ccccf58079c83189d787d1485f86454feb001e395eca1a91b1"}

{"id": "p_210a336c30e6c177", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 169, "text": "，鄱陽太守周魴譎誘魏大司馬曹休，休將步騎十萬至皖城以迎魴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "bbe262bbeef8a3d5f6f35b65c5306cfce0b80d847406004c866bdff08349d23a"}

{"id": "p_799fdd5bd2ef34c3", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 170, "text": "時陸遜為元帥，全琮與桓為左右督，各督三萬人擊休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "9d80e2154a326389613fffb6477183c66af045413e6fd1ff6587fd2ae06de098"}

{"id": "p_ee18883ca9210c86", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 171, "text": "休知見欺，當引軍還，自負眾盛，邀於一戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "d65ed6d18be9d8b78ca44aed4058ae214833d0f929289e743fba08227b7c5542"}

{"id": "p_81fc418705564c0a", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 172, "text": "桓進計曰：「休本以親戚見任，非智勇名將也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "eff3a69460baf58aae27d3cd66e5e1ec208da040e7f9458cb523b6e6e0efda7e"}

{"id": "p_4b5ee0359242b748", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 173, "text": "走當由夾石、掛車，此兩道皆險阨，若以萬兵柴路，則彼眾可盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "3d841d7c4f7f0cbb083d3b1ee917d8a628722397159b21d9f356f85db6c19cc0"}

{"id": "p_2f30661ea17490d7", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 174, "text": "而休可生虜，臣請將所部以斷之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "6fbe497b686fd5c0e64f985cf6eb6e156b32bc53d23fade0c1b38a06edaae949"}

{"id": "p_fa1bc30336bc6902", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 175, "text": "若蒙天威，得以休自效，便可乘勝長驅，近取壽春，割有淮面，以規許、洛，此萬世一時，不可失也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "7d92487cd9d348d26bf16ca1df72fb2809575b3762fa5f1ffab58221e2f6858e"}

{"id": "p_3ac0fe132644168d", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 176, "text": "」權先與陸遜議，遜以為不可，故計不施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "6ebc22be5dfdc0157362cb10d9d345c7d57b3c7ee16f03f5d52eefda19f6a443"}

{"id": "p_2c8fd6ddbc41f89d", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 177, "text": "，拜桓前將軍，領青州牧，假節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "8c1634687e1d67377ff12ce4981d3d4e733a0484c0264376bc19c190edbb2295"}

{"id": "p_4e5adb476cd1243d", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 178, "text": "，魏廬江主簿呂習請大兵自迎，欲開門為應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "ee40957a652b7561df24fd72c731384f9d7cca9c9ca5c2bab487ffa9424ccfc5"}

{"id": "p_f2173bc7f36ad3ca", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 179, "text": "桓與衛將軍全琮俱以師迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "c886eebec714ce1049ca1e6911865fd5830dc521e893f670daf6796230211f2c"}

{"id": "p_cfd04cea0331b0f0", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 180, "text": "城外有溪水，去城一里所，廣三十餘丈，深者八九尺，淺者半之，諸軍勒兵渡去，桓自斷後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "01eae545c3e463674e10fdf8020df093bc9e1be48a76b0eacb59850045235ad6"}

{"id": "p_860d54655b773fc0", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 181, "text": "時廬江太守李膺整嚴兵騎，欲須諸軍半渡，因迫擊之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "a2dc34517f0ae92e6c38d01b49e5d8251bf2e0551ccad18665c19def87c2c06c"}

{"id": "p_ef3a741f7d37b9b9", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 182, "text": "及見桓節蓋在後，卒不敢出，其見憚如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "fb444f836edffcc0ad8b184f1d9e91d853b62b4fdb247cbbeb87fdee4c3656a4"}

{"id": "p_bc9cab3b905ebfcb", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 183, "text": "是時全琮為督，權又令偏將軍胡綜宣傳詔命，參與軍事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "d2e75ff7457c65c4c9501febe325d42cba70e86420fa824e85330bc7394cf781"}

{"id": "p_505189eef368b50f", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 184, "text": "琮以軍出無獲，議欲部分諸將，有所掩襲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "a4008ec5ade87d24826babcd11e351f2fbc9cb3889e0ddade7ef5a6250877a13"}

{"id": "p_29d1d29e3e448915", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 185, "text": "桓素氣高，恥見部伍，乃往見琮，問行意，感激發怒，與琮校計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "5c1f27519a90ac1bcb1a03fe639730131a616a74e70c609dd7e1f1b21033ed26"}

{"id": "p_bedcb7b6ae8a223c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 186, "text": "琮欲自解，因曰：「上自令胡綜為督，綜意以為宜爾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "7c81d42ca581c15dd4b6bba0c1963d405eecdb3050d54de953eb277cc4803cac"}

{"id": "p_d5a0d5d7eff88ea5", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 187, "text": "」桓愈恚恨，還乃使人呼綜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "7b339c4d7a27ede6c9f8d60392f98b52debe7f70f8fd46a049c8a44d6b2cb7bc"}

{"id": "p_46076d60e16bcc62", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 188, "text": "綜至軍門，桓出迎之，顧謂左右曰：「我縱手，汝等各自去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "c26defd0142cb672d63235eb99e6a86c3fe2ae5317b092fe01c566ae90822fc6"}

{"id": "p_809ee599f0fea130", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 189, "text": "」有一人旁出，語綜使還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "e2fef8e079f3614a260179c3923020d1389175cde918b298d8eb4b70b6b4ba39"}

{"id": "p_5706decd1b908a73", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 190, "text": "桓出，不見綜，知左右所為，因斫殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "b7d2b6130a22ea31e5ba98cd9769eda1e9b2e31c745582b3fe710928e92d59d9"}

{"id": "p_18b06471e9481286", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 191, "text": "桓佐軍進諫，刺殺佐軍，遂托狂發，詣建業治病。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "e6f0f3a746057eb2d0932bcbf69e72df204aed87ffeaed2298e2338f826b8c86"}

{"id": "p_077ce74aec5da083", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 192, "text": "使子異攝領部曲，令醫視護，數月復遣還中洲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "9d5a3b65469b48ad48d1d659eab8aee9bdcebb62b8e2d7630de0850b5db4644c"}

{"id": "p_173f7b8d2b6b2109", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 193, "text": "權自出祖送，謂曰：「今寇虜尚存，王塗未一，孤當與君共定天下，欲令督五萬人專當一面，以圖進取，想君疾未復發也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "91ec8d0664d5e63a79f018d46705cc39948cbe4e85b3f9ccf66f84bea7b11c45"}

{"id": "p_830ab61ba76acbb5", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 194, "text": "」桓曰：「天授陛下聖姿，當君臨四海，猥重任臣，以除奸逆，臣疾當自愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "36d01112565808dbe0537757641623d3a11e4642d1579932200ecceb5a67505b"}

{"id": "p_b9e6f4517519b654", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 195, "text": "桓性護前，恥為人下，每臨敵交戰，節度不得自由，輒嗔恚憤激。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "a48c038f91ed09f35f7a46b440935216ba0c94c449eb46408a69873354fad42d"}

{"id": "p_64b93e28c3c53ee4", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 196, "text": "與人一面，數十年不忘，部曲萬口，妻子盡識之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "007746f3d71d90708379c1841cb89f2ecadb946930934808b461271341b496ca"}

{"id": "p_c322d535a04a1703", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 197, "text": "愛養吏士，贍護六親，俸祿產業，皆與共分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "c426001c4fbbf5ce06c4a5d0486f73cb284624354c9a41e0ed9ef5834026f83a"}

{"id": "p_f248c1093dfebdd7", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 198, "text": "又家無餘財，權賜鹽五千斛以周喪事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "70d700060031fbbb460c7c47fee0b6c1f9f301cc94b49305aa23683d644a1737"}

{"id": "p_28c20786ec577dba", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 199, "text": "異字季文，以父任除郎，後拜騎都尉，代桓領兵，，隨朱然攻魏樊城，建計破其外圍，還拜偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "552f09a0310ed741a92dce5dc0e8172ab6c77240f70fd2f1518a4b32d302e5ad"}

{"id": "p_fa9c42d5abc08803", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 200, "text": "魏廬江太守文欽營住六安，多設屯寨，置諸道要，以招誘亡叛，為邊寇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "1bf6073c9d01f2946edcfff058ca8e64914df636d72ba3e2d7d0e938574b83ad"}

{"id": "p_3151102b6e84cd8b", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 201, "text": "異乃身率其手下二千人，掩破欽七屯，斬首數百，遷揚武將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "8689d641d463ec013d0abb11de4a9d914d73a4e5fdbccbf67a4f22a75a615c9f"}

{"id": "p_dc24ad81e667e322", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 202, "text": "權謂異從父驃騎將軍據曰：「本知季文膽定，見之復過所聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "2ac878a7f469a2c8533563ab37d79650250e2a8bf3c9212155ecc5d4eceb42b0"}

{"id": "p_dc9d9acc87d39af3", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 203, "text": "」十三年，文欽詐降，密書與異，欲令自迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "c7ea21285727aadd3225d8060046a8f61b4424ffbbd84fa685591f29cb02d19f"}

{"id": "p_491d92bfb08cdbe6", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 204, "text": "異表呈欽書，因陳其偽，不可便迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "90bc3a04185cc014337ee1ffcf632dee3cec6ff83b7debc5487112b6bef7dfb2"}

{"id": "p_e73b77dc9ae8f89d", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 205, "text": "權詔曰：「方今北土未一，欽云欲歸命，宜且迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "a27e9df56800f69b09958f9e6440fb3efb58fd3cce01f10f47ec69d841fc8f6c"}

{"id": "p_c5f78323c1121638", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 206, "text": "若嫌其有譎者，但當設計網以羅之，盛重兵以防之耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "6465d073217369a6649464d455e608ea88506a386d0a4f4a783a15c731cdd60a"}

{"id": "p_0a1bd7d1202041db", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 207, "text": "」乃遣呂據督二萬人，與異並力，至北界，欽果不降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "9f987021a1a4a6e438e3ee2c8766c95d66d6a5232b78706e2c456c8ab00cd489"}

{"id": "p_bdd9e8ef940aa21c", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 208, "text": "是歲魏遣胡遵、譜葛誕等出東興，異督水軍攻浮梁，壞之，魏軍大破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "9ffb7fc86425656fdde6960f264cd2e95b71adbb90215299234487e9b0568879"}

{"id": "p_954d2c0d5c1ad7d3", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 209, "text": "，假節，為大都督，救壽春圍，不解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "e2a0d1fc5e8f22bae1eea675298ed8c01e85df246187e29bf67e6828e4674815"}

{"id": "p_de618682c417615d", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 210, "text": "評曰：朱治、呂範以舊臣任用，朱然、朱桓以勇烈著聞，呂據、朱異、施績咸有將領之才，克紹堂構。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "5e9006b342c5fd2a3e6fdf63f3c4c07313f5ba19a67441d0ced6cbbec2750c35"}

{"id": "p_3d875b7c6d44c25e", "source_id": "src_3c33f3e976c7d8ed", "ordinal": 211, "text": "若範、桓之越隘，得以吉終，至於據、異無此之尤而反罹殃者，所遇之時殊也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "7f35a5dca95421779be51b0d1e293ba269a81298b7f6de8334a985f5e776a586"}

{"id": "p_c6bff9a3aa6eb537", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_076d0402b973caf7", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 1, "text": "虞翻字仲翔，會稽餘姚人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "5015a220ce0ba484323d9e62e2f910e9228a64b15c3c602ae6e80fa604d57c13"}

{"id": "p_a0b12b56f70fa0c4", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 2, "text": "孫策征會稽，翻時遭父喪，衰絰詣府門，朗欲就之，翻乃脫衰入見，勸朗避策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "2b98e9ec86b1d48842861aacab9359c100c415b744fc93109983b3e59cb93707"}

{"id": "p_32856699a34c0dc1", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 3, "text": "翻追隨營護，到東部候官，候官長閉城不受，翻往說之，然後見納。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "45c5e4d84ed14c2b8a51504adba2e2907ee75281bc85885ede6a87ba7b901485"}

{"id": "p_fab39429a3daf0e2", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 4, "text": "朗謂翻曰：\"卿有老母，可以還矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "9d4f4dc46af89298ccb7f847d299cc9b94b4a09a8af696fcf49845f63400a817"}

{"id": "p_65c5243124d42d66", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 5, "text": "\"翻既歸，策覆命為功曹，待以交友之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "2b868a71334dd58045f755f528ebb2eb65a27d9cfc093ec8b91520c08f5ca141"}

{"id": "p_ff288cb601b61c6e", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 6, "text": "策好馳騁遊獵，翻諫曰：\"明府用烏集之眾，驅散附之士，皆得其死力，雖漢高帝不及也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "fd1b8ee3237e8389f6e45be7558b65b703d949d3757a760106bf9c198964c4e0"}

{"id": "p_d6ca7c0afa8cd851", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 7, "text": "至於輕出微行，從官不暇嚴，吏卒常苦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "98a42d21ae171af035a5025dff076cd8e531abed023167732deba93b5e0ef821"}

{"id": "p_d9d5bcff2af130c6", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 8, "text": "夫君人者不重則不威，故曰龍魚服，困於豫且，白蛇自放，劉季害之，願少留意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "bf4686fc476b3d1fbd56c80fa0a04b05e20cdb89b2a8a2f5142a2b729ac6cc28"}

{"id": "p_2257c50e1f7671ce", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 9, "text": "\"策曰：\"君言是也，然時有所思，端坐悒悒，有裨諶草創之計，是以行耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "15902e82a9d1134ff6130eafc20465c3d4cc69accf69f1cda85108a8a6675364"}

{"id": "p_43c10ed1e4708cd9", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 10, "text": "策薨，諸長吏並欲出赴喪，翻曰：\"恐鄰縣山民或有奸變，遠委城郭，必致不虞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "57dfb06e683ea56154bacd3eea072ec3f4ea21a375856424862b893c3eb76a73"}

{"id": "p_1f305d6be462cfd0", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 11, "text": "後翻州舉茂才，漢召為侍御使，曹公為司空辟，皆不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "c66276f62ae81fc1506bbf796639f190cb31def2d09915308e8444587a9cab2b"}

{"id": "p_70ad2dbd04770263", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 12, "text": "翻與少府孔融書，並示以所著《易注》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "642e346725720734c48395a92994f904066602c679984009f85ce77f32cc0f2b"}

{"id": "p_163a52d030786773", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 13, "text": "融答書曰：\"聞延陵之理樂，睹吾子之治《易》，乃知東南之美者，非徒會稽之竹箭也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "522c6692ee5e5ba3bb3e026962ceb6b48cd061d08c52d2f019557ce3018f8853"}

{"id": "p_92a823773545079e", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 14, "text": "又觀象雲物，察應寒溫，原其禍福，與神合契，可謂探賾窮通者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "1183cbb5ce1c183d5ef6b1028bf03faf802a7a5b2b799c65ff9048d6dc5beeef"}

{"id": "p_7ed631cd363f6e9b", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 15, "text": "\"會稽東部都尉張紘又與融書曰：\"虞仲翔前頗為論者所侵，美寶為質，雕摩益光，不足以損。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "56efcab5441b80a7141e2c51668288fbe40cf1839acbbec8bce9ad047daee5ca"}

{"id": "p_9469adb086670d7e", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 16, "text": "翻數犯顏諫爭，權不能悅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "ca4ad36a2246eebc3880791788eebe79e60302bc4beada48f71dcb471bc52a3f"}

{"id": "p_de1eaf9e1bd0e103", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 17, "text": "又性不協俗，多見謗毀，坐徙丹楊涇縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "6e5cf38208ea778e24a1e89251d991736e10fd27791cc57c53da13dee73e3713"}

{"id": "p_5db030739a6bdb4d", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 18, "text": "呂蒙圖取關羽，稱疾還建業，以翻兼知醫術，請以自隨，亦欲因此令翻得釋也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "2452a6a8297d7e68a0afbd7f284606d78680c9457c3bf631bcc653b4a013ec1c"}

{"id": "p_bdcf57feed1f1733", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 19, "text": "後蒙舉軍西上，南郡太守麋芳開城出降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "89c4b2ff49f17dc18b08db1c846edc516b1f8a3ba9e667de32684c4510eb2791"}

{"id": "p_e03c0ab58622548b", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 20, "text": "翻渭蒙曰：“今區區一心者麋將軍也，城中之人豈可盡信，何不急入城持其管答乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "8d4174055431f036c9def1c3b11254c25a002c415472c148998912847753bee6"}

{"id": "p_c1d8390e7e264524", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 21, "text": "時城中有伏計，賴翻謀不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "87860887e351d6298aa042de83828c472820eafe086ac5292dcbf653d025fd08"}

{"id": "p_ee4a5114145e0881", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 22, "text": "關羽既敗，權使翻筮之，得兌下坎上，節，五爻變之臨，翻曰：\"不出二日，必當斷頭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "2c08cf452e16d457457168d9e86e3bb4fa712bdc045e5df279c657ddfa7ed142"}

{"id": "p_5130cf49d005da74", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 23, "text": "權曰：\"卿不及伏羲，可與東方朔為比矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "20888f2a91230a6759a9e6cbc98600c473c5ba8b31d64f09fb69adc22d6c0d9b"}

{"id": "p_3f52efa56922d77f", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 24, "text": "魏將-{于}-禁為羽所獲，繫在城中，權至釋之，請與相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "79d5f8e3bdf1d5ae3f1084c0872249f87b43d1f702e5e5f3de56c66cbac31740"}

{"id": "p_a42a53224e3180c3", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 25, "text": "他日，權乘馬出，引禁並行，翻呵禁曰：\"爾降虜，何敢與吾君齊馬首乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "cf0da0faf4fa05a7da60d7251fbb3ddefbf4f5d12e1ddff86fe907b70e5643f7"}

{"id": "p_aa62cbc3abea7951", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 26, "text": "\"欲抗鞭擊禁，權呵止之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "56fa683bf2e533aba521ad94f067e7161b1e786e690353907d1c49f3ef4029f8"}

{"id": "p_e5a20b08cbe866d2", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 27, "text": "後權於樓船會群臣飲，禁聞樂流涕，翻又曰：“汝欲以偽求免邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "341276e4f478a590b19fc97e2900baf150a6ddcfa0d758b32cb0b6ea9b624978"}

{"id": "p_8bc2cfa05203f3cc", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 28, "text": "自起行酒，翻伏地陽醉，不持。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "12cd286b75bc023e4696381be4380216330d6e868a97a5711984b58995cd0043"}

{"id": "p_30de25981bf11823", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 29, "text": "權於是大怒，手劍欲擊之，侍坐者莫不惶遽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "6caed6a8d32ed7db985e265c232c51612f7b97b5cd2b78391acd5cbccbd12b66"}

{"id": "p_4221115162f92618", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 30, "text": "惟大司農劉基起抱權諫曰：\"大王以三爵之後殺善士，雖翻有罪，天下孰知之?且大王以能容賢畜眾，故海內望風，今一朝棄之，可乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "71abe8803fced5977895d413c46e42111a83ee569101328fafb3d0c613b96b6f"}

{"id": "p_a11d2fa177376b50", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 31, "text": "\"權曰：\"曹孟德尚殺孔文舉，孤於虞翻何有哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "b8e09c6a7bc03ca17a54b031e4b563af4fd7a69beb6ecfc2c89ec6094b0fb1d5"}

{"id": "p_8af2cb07dea57d98", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 32, "text": "\"基曰：\"孟德輕害士人，天下非之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "1ce086c28f8c840b4e087c6997b3290daa40b16d84c1d540ecac5522727dc707"}

{"id": "p_defa04509e37f7b5", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 33, "text": "大王躬行德義，欲與堯、舜比隆，何得自喻於彼乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "4536adc833e2e84af44ab16c1efebc721974c30d5c5559be39f1dba40e64f288"}

{"id": "p_8ba600adbec430ff", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 34, "text": "權因敕左右，自今酒後言殺，皆不得殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "54e5e382aa6c4cb7d2d3500d3432d41fff53b58cab86a0a62f19018bdf466ea9"}

{"id": "p_a7b5be61253f5c06", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 35, "text": "翻常乘船行，與麋芳相逢，芳船上人多欲令翻自避，先驅曰：“避將軍船！", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "5be32709f62a0f2f3f2d17964a68bac3f22bf6aabb64b72ac267a1051ba34ca2"}

{"id": "p_f83311c2720129e4", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 36, "text": "”翻厲聲曰：\"失忠與信，何以事君？", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "6ab3b97223f6b4aed99c5286731cb0ed4f3028a0f23ae3966454e39834f6b5a4"}

{"id": "p_14922f5e67725e56", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 37, "text": "傾人二城，而稱將軍，可乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "46a97f196a11f08fa148ae166e54c35cd8135be9d542b4c3b3b250dfcc3cda01"}

{"id": "p_e1a84eef0e92a29e", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 38, "text": "後翻乘車行，又經芳營勞，吏閉門，車不得過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "f0a99bd4f09541926ad05c5e4305696e82ed103c66cca9309e77f44b72741b74"}

{"id": "p_f831ff60623b26a4", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 39, "text": "權與張昭論及神仙，翻指昭曰：\"彼皆死人，而語神仙，世豈有仙人也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "8254c4a3b82995405da06b795e89a2dd900c94364d5e5e892e7fc5384cf73cfc"}

{"id": "p_09fe265c751dbd39", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 40, "text": "\"權積怒非一，遂徙翻交州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "1f1aec3d054209eecd3b66c0cc21c9cd0abdcf7137840ab38fdd1f3bf37058dc"}

{"id": "p_7a46337cdf9c7a6b", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 41, "text": "雖處罪放，而講學不倦，門徒常數百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "071ac4977541fe3f821c57b7cce65852303d1f3724852bde6881caf05a64afc8"}

{"id": "p_93b8efe734a2fd59", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 42, "text": "又為《老子》《論語》《國語》訓注，皆傳於世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "663fbb8a90b1114096ea08544f7a72379ffb78605388f81f0c19bf2ac0cc9899"}

{"id": "p_e4f63b4781083e2d", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 43, "text": "初，山陰丁覽，太末徐陵，或在縣吏之中，或眾所未識，翻一見之，便與友善，終鹹顯名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "aa31c6621684206e15a3a4e4d543adf21427495a8a41b45f433414832e994447"}

{"id": "p_e8e5a4dac9e08ce6", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 44, "text": "第四子汜最知名，永安初，從選曹朗為散騎中常侍，後為監軍使者，討扶嚴，病卒，汜弟忠，宜都太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "7c3aaf54f5e54d0dabac0b3463fefd1046bd99b1baf5c6dbe1b24c20032b6ff2"}

{"id": "p_f8529a50b622c806", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 45, "text": "累遷廷尉，湘東、河間太守；昺，廷尉尚書，濟陰太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "01c39b562cd5bca52e47eda9aa8e3eabba388577d01af90ce5c48710f8dd9524"}

{"id": "p_274dd35262b0c9a6", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 46, "text": "陸績字公紀，吳郡吳人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "1c31e03a2195f94a04fca56aea31fb4f0d96962206f54d7dfd20ce5455114fed"}

{"id": "p_2475e4c706af5bda", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 47, "text": "績年六歲，於九江見袁術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "a33e9a177b7e5579d2e23147152df2f7a9b25160144ddc3f415f705bfa61df08"}

{"id": "p_6cc0272051944014", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 48, "text": "術出橘，績懷三枚，去，拜辭墮地，術謂曰：“陸郎作賓客而懷橘乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "482c6f464b18a65a9dcf80a066cf0e47a6be312d58e7d87653e53b2d9aed59a1"}

{"id": "p_02382c2d8c1d0430", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 49, "text": "”績跪答曰：\"欲歸遺母。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "119d1b6c6e6044b6ed00835adc1eb539481efaa04fbbd27a8de4cee158924a1b"}

{"id": "p_a404a2ffdac783d9", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 50, "text": "孫策在吳，張昭、張紘、秦松為上賓，共論四海未泰，須當用武治而平之，績年少末坐，遙大聲言曰：\"昔管夷吾相齊桓公，九合諸候，一匡天下，不用兵車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "2e87373ce320b54941f86e29960f9b91da1999f324f36380beaeabdad5ca8598"}

{"id": "p_859163799ae9c7b8", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 51, "text": "孔子曰：'遠人不服，則修文德以來之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "8abf84e4b95fd27d704a0b30068007888c3758d1b11a488eb348f3e7fb56cff2"}

{"id": "p_ba04fa8b3979bf82", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 52, "text": "'今論者不務道德懷取之術，而惟尚武，績雖童蒙，竊所未安也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "8d22766c6417c47036053bb13b502f858f04ee54a2ab18ad1443fc0341c74f4f"}

{"id": "p_794582404c732433", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 53, "text": "績容貌雄壯，博學多識，星歷算數無不該覽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "f40183393e87fe9c2e43e67ba9bac6e410db0aefbfb5219d2bc03077b46e2944"}

{"id": "p_f56614135aec793c", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 54, "text": "虞翻舊齒名盛，龐統荊州令士，年亦差長，皆與績友善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "c41b592841788d1f3dad4e948ab1dff7293034e7116ed7a30a6f9b84b431dd06"}

{"id": "p_663d56cc040c9435", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 55, "text": "孫權統事，闢為奏曹掾，以直道見憚，出為鬱林太守，加偏將軍，給兵二千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "ba3f5efe3447458766de6e1f793c93c98afac38573ccdcdef2e56130348a7ddd"}

{"id": "p_78b0a2c71e59758d", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 56, "text": "績既有躄疾，又意在儒雅，非其志也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "0cd58bffe72fb4fbd91027501d336f724e4118c358db891cb73df548f13f9492"}

{"id": "p_1f12b1af428b1a70", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 57, "text": "雖有軍事，著述不廢，作《渾天圖》，注《易》釋《玄》，皆傳於世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "4071f8ad472beb161f1986b718c7d26809071ca11865522bcb2a6302d0e17f00"}

{"id": "p_d63f0c796ed69e53", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 58, "text": "豫自知亡日，乃為辭曰：\"有漢志士吳郡陸績，幼敦《詩》、《書》，長玩《禮》、《易》受命南征，遘疾遇厄，遭命不幸，嗚呼悲隔！", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "ac441ae57042c52398f840a509fd3b73f56764095afb868a98f3cd191b674558"}

{"id": "p_798a07e15469dc73", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 59, "text": "\"又曰：\"從今已去，六十年之外，車同軌，書同文，恨不及見也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "433415a72f594e29cd6fe3652f54b17984b5c5cd498ff5585a6313a5a86ef2e8"}

{"id": "p_480f7e6a302ccd4f", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 60, "text": "長子宏，會稽南部都尉，次子睿，長水校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "0a02928b689933da91e1337b79bb2bd9d894c6920c763e0756f78ea79e46889d"}

{"id": "p_dd035994fea58c78", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 61, "text": "張溫字惠恕，吳郡吳人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "b204274e1a584626f0c48319a5bc2f042cbe8c280347b39d568204d72e62f5fd"}

{"id": "p_ce1986f9974ad834", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 62, "text": "父允，以輕財重士，名顯州郡，為孫權東曹掾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "be686425cec5770571c34e957c9b3478308bc74912b9836a9478a3f328f5de34"}

{"id": "p_9aa9a2321f8ffe00", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 63, "text": "權聞之，以問公卿曰：“溫當今與誰為比？", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "6287024f0dfa0992396f91ca85563d1055a2a0ee48a16853d679d79d9c1829ac"}

{"id": "p_7c1212c06295e382", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 64, "text": "”大（司）農劉基曰：\"可與全琮為輩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "f88a97cf142e66455afc30453aa99e7909c22acf494d319e93cba7ad6d00fece"}

{"id": "p_7af7b129e12f33a3", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 65, "text": "\"太常顧雍曰：\"基未詳其為人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "fe2740d6d0d3d8fa8694c84a1bd64c9675974d545f20a4628d4b6b568f4e430f"}

{"id": "p_eff3202bc8ebae4b", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 66, "text": "\"權曰：\"如是，張允不死也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "887b01bd6a033062b3d1c39675664133ec82e10461bcf479ce49258848c99f83"}

{"id": "p_9315fb26f74363ab", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 67, "text": "\"征到延見，文辭占對，觀者傾竦，權改容加禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "6de81798cd59bd92c0363162a471ea1bbef19e020b25eb0c1f01f831e45f4159"}

{"id": "p_eb4a96b65d801a9b", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 68, "text": "罷出，張昭執其手曰：\"老夫托意，君宜明之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "1353a59f6afa8511c653152592918412f59684e51f17edf0f173c8724fedea8c"}

{"id": "p_965989e330e8dab7", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 69, "text": "\"拜議郎、選曹尚書，徙太子太傅，甚見信重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "880ff2146a73a8d684a23f18c458741d822a03fcd312c6685ac2c9f3bcf4bc1a"}

{"id": "p_52aba7fb424c2e35", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 70, "text": "時年三十二，以輔義中郎將使蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "9ef8879ac579993b4b0f3be391ee12e0f6f4c9a8eba22794da75bf39878e1148"}

{"id": "p_1ec699f6de5a863c", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 71, "text": "權謂溫曰：\"卿不宜遠出，恐諸葛孔明不知吾所以與曹氏通意，（以）故屈卿行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "b037712b9ea744ec15ea57036871f63dfa92e443f8dd6576e925549a3a6e31d4"}

{"id": "p_12c3d6ab1e05d029", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 72, "text": "若山越都除，便欲大構於蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "7a943225414813e7455f95906b6f92bddf30b8649b4777900af31de61c9f190a"}

{"id": "p_4b48718ff978cdbc", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 73, "text": "行人之義，受命不受辭也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "04fdf47433b7544bfe0dadfa5f8648da6561288e93c17e282269d552305e8903"}

{"id": "p_bea622b2a863c364", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 74, "text": "\"溫對曰：\"臣入無腹心之規，出無專對之用，懼無張老延譽之功，又無子產陳事之效。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "80c467187cabe8837eb34119261c3c5c9d32824e7dc1e3b268c2373e5380cbfd"}

{"id": "p_1c3ef45319676ca5", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 75, "text": "然諸葛亮達見計數，必知神慮屈申之宜，加受朝廷天覆之惠，推亮之心，必無疑貳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "28c6a042da42991ee360d39d827a3e60af63d690d2cd520c8d709ef5a98607d3"}

{"id": "p_71740e57c419ec14", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 76, "text": "還，頃之，使入豫章部伍出兵，事業未究。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "db06381febdb2ab621fdb6e9def3830c04833536f0983a1c1dfa7fe10d2d5a5d"}

{"id": "p_21e0baf4f719d792", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 77, "text": "權既陰銜溫稱美蜀政，又嫌其聲名大盛，眾庶炫惑，恐終不為己用，思有以中傷之，會暨艷事起，遂因此發舉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "16ac28607aeca73bf1f35edc49b12b74521c38c81ec4c69b0c616dd00c2fe6d2"}

{"id": "p_4aa8ab5b77c037b0", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 78, "text": "艷字子休，亦吳郡人也，溫引致之，以為選曹郎，至尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "cc9fedfddd01d8be41d7927eee8208d3518639a64fda06f11d2832b39bb78d17"}

{"id": "p_aa831a0b0682f959", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 79, "text": "艷性狷厲，好為清議，見時郎署混濁淆雜，多非其人，欲臧否區別，賢愚異貫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "581b55b76831026b950ff38810f7d09bb0a664e15554de49c0f33b549317d837"}

{"id": "p_301e67db46d1a793", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 80, "text": "彈射百僚，核選三署，率皆貶高就下，降損數等，其守故者十未能一，其居位貪鄙，志節污卑者，皆以為軍吏，置營府以處之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "d76dc489bc868352b0e5da043eb61333f9d2cb46a74507ffa00b140e28022d57"}

{"id": "p_0fcc0544fddc5a0a", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 81, "text": "而怨憤之聲積，浸潤之譖行矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "b6bd44448aba44346ace4b3cd858c10c298c159b0f97e3e60a4c8cd7c7a1a97a"}

{"id": "p_879c5af636cfe33c", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 82, "text": "競言艷及選曹郎徐彪，專用私情，愛憎不由公理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "b6f9f26931186088ce29ef60a88683aa2bf4f4ac240168fd49f1073bf9aa0a1a"}

{"id": "p_e47382d36dc1c4ba", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 83, "text": "溫宿與艷、彪同意，數交書疏，聞問往還，即罪溫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "f2be11486a585379e4a2f1284f71cff6941429ee0d4a35882d7c031c23e62803"}

{"id": "p_ae54c6c967f85341", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 84, "text": "二弟祗、白，亦有才名，與溫俱廢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "9befe187e1a94f24102648046eea1155012cd4f8846fd8eb146cfaf6b9f3f1af"}

{"id": "p_67e271a8840e3ad5", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 85, "text": "駱統字公緒，會稽烏傷人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "f0bebb8614d3797e3eea41336454e8337ce626d1de413ab71fce58eacacc1200"}

{"id": "p_dcc526cd682a6bb1", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 86, "text": "統母改適，為華歆小妻，統時八歲，遂與親客歸會稽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "69c8b080ba8eaabae10450aa1a1c5067cf5b60787c3baf6b6cf4747ba160f621"}

{"id": "p_3bba87dc7cd61b0d", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 87, "text": "其母送之，拜辭上車，面而不顧，其母泣涕於後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "7b9dbc32573ce02811ceafe3f06273f2436ab95349afeb42baff4a75915c202e"}

{"id": "p_d50b8a6124f8c40d", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 88, "text": "」統曰：「不欲增母思，故不顧耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "26d5da57c89eb3be1fa2ebc5bda66cf224d9d54dc7a9f5a5e5c886450465c618"}

{"id": "p_a7ae7d6fd0de23c8", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 89, "text": "時饑荒，鄉里及遠方客多有困乏，統為之飲食衰少。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "3199b963576ce35ee4e5b736f5a3631200037d901c2e64433804dbf9cda47233"}

{"id": "p_3feb46d274039df8", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 90, "text": "其姊仁愛有行，寡歸無子，見統甚哀之，數問其故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "fc8eba8db4135a3dc7c07a8687d6ceb21839ac036106b33233516b8084a574e0"}

{"id": "p_66eb3bfb5dd3c4af", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 91, "text": "統曰：「士大夫糟糠不足，我何心獨飽!」姊曰：「誠如是，何不告我，而自苦若此？", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "e246b0872ca52a42dedbf4361041b0c52fd55386959a0fa9b0f0dcc4fffad80e"}

{"id": "p_b13618d00ef9c196", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 92, "text": "」乃自以私粟與統，又以告母，母亦賢之，遂使分施，由是顯名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "ffca7aa579ba2fe085ac9b1bee65f87ca248011735b4fa3e1d998e83346f3bc4"}

{"id": "p_76c4a84954d6a0d0", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 93, "text": "孫權以將軍領會稽太守，統年二十，試為烏程相，民戶過萬，咸歎其惠理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "673c7e53dba648851fe59b4707ce0e83e4737072d1d32a25b9c29c07797eb768"}

{"id": "p_31c407ca328e1686", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 94, "text": "權嘉之，召為功曹，行騎都尉，妻以從兄輔女。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "a6ca893db09b1c02184ae1bb0cb62899093e49d614281001a0742be872f09afe"}

{"id": "p_c5dc1968a58b8c55", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 95, "text": "統志在補察，苟所聞見，夕不待旦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "21cdd2fb41eaf8db23cb452b4904e6e3972325232e9849eadde6ee80232aa334"}

{"id": "p_119f48fec618122e", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 96, "text": "常勸權以尊賢接士，勤求損益，饗賜之日，可人人別進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "109cfc6730ba76cf4c3d47678299a74814e84013e9ef54a245c3d6ff1ba1d5ea"}

{"id": "p_0401cc5525b85a5c", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 97, "text": "問其燥溼，加以密意，誘諭使言，察其志趣，令皆感恩戴義，懷欲報之心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "02429cb7ce7a5b72912651c2d4e4e40386b709c36d263b5408099fa5a4d0653e"}

{"id": "p_b0716dbd3cd203e1", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 98, "text": "出為建忠中郎將，領武射吏三千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "32ca3275a8d06729090845ef2fad420cd3ec72313125c9f062aa97ed3e36aa8f"}

{"id": "p_14627fe10e078ef9", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 99, "text": "是時徵役繁數，重以疫癘，民戶損耗，統上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "6626fac6e61caf1a5be89924981e495f0bacaf98ef154e6a249a02eb3a0e4f82"}

{"id": "p_eb9be1f20a9ba40f", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 100, "text": "以隨陸遜破蜀軍於宜都，遷偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "7650f7451ad9ba0c5a1a8e3b279ed315873035fac07074a78c539e017015b69f"}

{"id": "p_3f0d655bebba8ded", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 101, "text": "黃武初，曹仁攻濡須，使別將常雕等襲中洲，統與嚴圭共拒破之，封新陽亭侯，後為濡須督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "bd1dff4d70dd6b72030d8d35c07cc71bdf16a439f8b1cf3bb2f78ef6070e6878"}

{"id": "p_0cb7f8adc05c6625", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 102, "text": "數陳便宜，前後書數十上，所言皆善，文多故不悉載。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "0facb55229342ef42f07aae44b88d2a524b762fc7ad1224db577114f701335e4"}

{"id": "p_bc22d09c860274dd", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 103, "text": "尤以占募在民閒長惡敗俗，生離叛之心，急宜絕置，權與相反覆，終遂行之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "b428d8d9e720054ac05b8e1221391c061978667404b6ad1680119f4ad19baa1f"}

{"id": "p_9cf58f420df416ca", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 104, "text": "陸瑁字子璋，丞相遜弟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "48f1db441c739ceb6f6cca84a8eaacf6058c956a5be50dcdb296884a7e915b1f"}

{"id": "p_a9733332a56183b3", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 105, "text": "陳國陳融、陳留濮陽逸、沛郡蔣纂、廣陵袁迪等，皆單貧有志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "1060ca376039cb42ab71a7ee4ed27af7e34e808ab5693a247955bbeb19e80f2a"}

{"id": "p_9e7f6d833200f723", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 106, "text": "就瑁游處，瑁割少分甘，與同豐約。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "773b54600bf3826177d3ef7200e15c6000bb8746de464852e42a71cd498eb8a2"}

{"id": "p_bcb4c6f6d3d4cfb7", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 107, "text": "及同郡徐原，爰居會稽，素不相識，臨死遺書，托以孤弱，瑁為起立墳墓，收導其子，又瑁從父績早亡，二男一女，皆數歲以還，瑁迎攝養，至長乃別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "75db129b9dddbcc17c94cd449f9a0e9cdbd9dece46b003fc8ebf2236556a0512"}

{"id": "p_dfcf28d3fe5dddd8", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 108, "text": "時尚書暨艷盛明臧否，差斷三署。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "d13367039bc45f16f0c9942f2fc27a1717b152549e54d8d258262e9c6fa80652"}

{"id": "p_ab7dbb9b89de90b8", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 109, "text": "頗揚人暗昧之失，以顯其謫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "ccd9df9c90b1307bfe07b0eb868581545faacf9d5f5c1c0c11317bc534efba3b"}

{"id": "p_55f591640761e3b4", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 110, "text": "瑁與書曰：\"夫聖人嘉善矜愚，忘過記功，以成美化。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "25ec421286021b07ec8099240ad533ea794a3aa84c00decb230c299abe4676b0"}

{"id": "p_4ed7388a79305fae", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 111, "text": "加今王業始建，將一大統，此乃漢高棄瑕錄用之時也，若令善惡異流，貴汝穎月旦之評，誠可以厲俗明教，然恐未易行也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "bc882ed8acc90de889143b6522aff2d87b68d8846d95ecef2f851ec303aae759"}

{"id": "p_1d799ab0254c5c29", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 112, "text": "宜遠模仲尼之泛愛，中則郭泰之弘濟，近有益於大道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "af9c97c65084b3380226166c301a347af94071fde421b3ebf3b0d13dd4667f41"}

{"id": "p_95aa39d3c8966f36", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 113, "text": "，公車征瑁，拜議郎、選曹尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "ac1c652e9b7451b273e2c762a3a5fb1ceeaf313af10f73d4bda0449ee1fd5997"}

{"id": "p_d3036f25466097de", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 114, "text": "孫權忿公孫淵之巧詐反覆，欲親征之，瑁上疏諫曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "ba54cf8251dfa2eed1c8b25312d2ea6233fd8e5788b30b260dab00fd5de1a66a"}

{"id": "p_7dc27dc548fd1ffe", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 115, "text": "權再覽瑁書，嘉其詞理端切，遂不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "f7e660fda40bc40845ef6ce7dcd47aef6e5c6cb6642c33a46552554dbf891f76"}

{"id": "p_5a8398b7ad0d75d3", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 116, "text": "初，瑁同郡聞人敏見待國邑，優於宗脩，惟瑁以為不然，後果如其言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "7ef332be23f443a475c0952af9840c42f3e422a1c6072de3d4d33e985120c79a"}

{"id": "p_64b2f0c7e62191dd", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 117, "text": "子喜亦涉文籍，好人倫，孫皓時為選曹尚書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "7c58b5b1d9a9a5c86429c252dce2f9e14d114737e55f4a1777f468081b30cdb5"}

{"id": "p_92a905bdddadd1e0", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 118, "text": "吾粲字孔休，吳郡烏程人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "18f6c5eb6bf1d1a02d9b520cd0d0990f765090c0108e104587a45fde256a4d2f"}

{"id": "p_dccaea76949a54ce", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 119, "text": "孫河為縣長，粲為小吏，河深奇之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "8ce068da61cba323ca4a12228accc112418f4c50951c0c66c934a9c6478330b1"}

{"id": "p_f150e50cc54b5fe9", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 120, "text": "河後為將軍，得自選長吏，表粲為曲阿丞，遷為長史，治有名跡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "a19b42b2749f9913bdb0606765e4a7e6024b8b4c876124990468c4e4298da743"}

{"id": "p_97f47d23273a7147", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 121, "text": "雖起孤微，與同郡陸遜、卜靜等比肩齊聲矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "89df3af53be0411602c1d800e3e0eb494e0331b7c87cc81cd1341d1d3c5623bf"}

{"id": "p_51d6875c3ede74b3", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 122, "text": "孫權為車騎將軍，召為主簿，出為山陰令，還為參軍校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "3b47f668245bcd666c30c26a8e43f452367e3e84fc46a5d18b53018ff3ea93f8"}

{"id": "p_0761c41f26a9df43", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 123, "text": "，與呂范、賀齊等俱以舟師拒魏將曹休於洞口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "a23f3ef10fdecf96f52b0f9ce02faab93a66900e784587ef4174bc9f0a55876d"}

{"id": "p_68a3e955d77d7e88", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 124, "text": "值天大風，諸船綆紲斷絕，漂沒著岸，為魏軍所獲，或覆沒沉溺，其大船尚存者，水中生人皆攀緣號呼，他吏士恐船傾沒，皆以戈矛撞擊不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "a6938f326cf110b6a7c2b113331134016de6d8a0ff04f8591e0170838f6249a1"}

{"id": "p_c72ac178e8aa1c79", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 125, "text": "粲與黃淵獨令船人以承取之，左右以為船重必敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "d12547ebf7e73226a6041612d9fbaa4c92b9371d459f861530bd5bd6748c434e"}

{"id": "p_d4e2d3b6d3092619", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 126, "text": "粲曰：\"船敗，當俱死耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "76ad5a776f585dbeaf74f421fa9d5ccf0ab2a499c9406f7f09ad8f8546fe03d8"}

{"id": "p_376fdc9e20e67b84", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 127, "text": "還，遷會稽太守，召處士謝譚為功曹，譚以疾不詣，粲教曰：\"夫應龍以屈伸為神，鳳皇以嘉鳴為貴，何必陷形於天外，潛鱗於重淵者哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "5977a96ba8fb3c42eb1a50d5101a0785ed51bdc499338cb19b3213050a750022"}

{"id": "p_6e1680a1db99bc68", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 128, "text": "\"粲募合人眾，拜昭義中郎將，與呂岱討平山越，入為屯騎校尉、少府，遷太子太傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "d1c137f3d0fb4aa64c0a5da0cae44ea206ba6dbaa18682c3de57b7faad497bea"}

{"id": "p_9fa70ba3a3a64be3", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 129, "text": "遭二宮之變，抗言執正，明嫡庶之分，欲使魯王霸出駐夏口，遣楊竺不得令在都邑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "d97010a5ab48ec7897b4b8f380ed3cb0e9ff0ea37f50b9bff378b6f260c35995"}

{"id": "p_36a0acc0d0eef9c6", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 130, "text": "又數以消息語陸遜，遜時駐武昌，連表諫爭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "59f69909e6e7492dbba1f478344ab4548819e8cddfd0b1f8a78f9dfbefd89470"}

{"id": "p_c01b09a679dc7690", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 131, "text": "由此為霸、竺等所譖害，下獄誅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "5cdbeb953bec0f1aeaebadf534af39bd48c052499192caffbc677b71a17a4f56"}

{"id": "p_74797bdb05ff7a5d", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 132, "text": "朱據字子范，吳都吳人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "31cd2a77d4900502712b9a2bc52a05ec685fd469d67351cfd808e54ab42b938f"}

{"id": "p_9cdb9e4ccd81eda8", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 133, "text": "黃武初，征拜五官郎中，補侍御史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "c9efaae560ed936061317b26a2fb8105028a22e56d3244b6753f79cb4967b439"}

{"id": "p_a93ee75fed1bc997", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 134, "text": "是時選曹尚書暨艷，疾貪污在位，欲沙汰之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "b4a74f2daecbf853103728887f9d166a887934e48e2eeb74b18c3f923e1c4fbf"}

{"id": "p_7d501f35d461e581", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 135, "text": "據以為天下未定，宜以功覆過，棄瑕取用，舉清厲濁，足以沮勸，若一時貶黜，懼有後咎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "f977c6431129aae86cee834464a38852fb48eb2b809e8ac12108a1d719f3cbcb"}

{"id": "p_6954aa49241b8ceb", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 136, "text": "權咨嗟將率，發憤歎息，追思呂蒙、張溫，以為據才兼文武，可以繼之，自是拜建義校尉，領兵屯湖孰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "88dc39c4a6dc487e41a02afd45dfae557b413013ada19fb0ea5bc18e58154063"}

{"id": "p_eddf3be04e7eb44c", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 137, "text": "，權遷都建業，征據尚公主，拜左將軍，封雲陽侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "b2244f5774aebaafd99782347ad0c53347c2525b54f0c587e3f939750451e4e5"}

{"id": "p_9bbaf9708fef0f9d", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 138, "text": "謙虛接士，輕財好施，祿賜雖豐而常不足用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "a104d881aae88a1215bb76acb4ff0788cf9ade8ce3c219b5a17262c9219d399f"}

{"id": "p_d1aa665a68f9d188", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 139, "text": "嘉禾中，始鑄大錢，一當五百。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "edd6c391140b320b282c5cc02e7bc04fcba3856dd96790dde6d468769c4b55a5"}

{"id": "p_b1a74eaa89c947be", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 140, "text": "後據部曲應受三萬緡，工王遂詐而受之，典校呂壹疑據實取，考問主者，死於杖下，據哀其無辜，厚棺斂之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "a858cc84d880d68e40f5ba9b594eb04ce2f0ea44bc3a5a05160eae7fc1127aa1"}

{"id": "p_1e8e7a01202fa78f", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 141, "text": "壹又表據吏為據隱，故厚其殯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "2787b74036a599d81616c4662a19f100b32f44bbba2390b9f5e439b3ae166c38"}

{"id": "p_d278098f6bf67f19", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 142, "text": "權數責問據，據無以自明，藉草待罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "996ad027c00a845b31ca60f8cf0814850c1b38db069c8b160f424d148e6a112b"}

{"id": "p_09087a0d478dc0ac", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 143, "text": "數月，典軍吏劉助覺，言王遂所取，權大感寤，曰：“朱據見枉，況吏民乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "59e22e8feb22739490052f23507c122cded298a5b6994bb170d6a398dd1e1ed2"}

{"id": "p_a0d963e9d667966b", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 144, "text": "”乃窮治壹罪，賞助百萬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "23be07a0549be5f5a8ab051c1b558c4915945ede96de6c333be1e4cad77ec1c8"}

{"id": "p_50ddeef6380f4b7d", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 145, "text": "遭二宮構爭，據擁護太子，言則懇至，義形於色，守之以死，遂左遷新都郡丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "9f25ea749cd95150672de744ee45352350edb5e2f1005ea6045cdce406f30dec"}

{"id": "p_f76091a7f7e3d882", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 146, "text": "未到，中書令孫弘譖潤據，因權寢疾，弘為詔書追賜死，時年五十七。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "62676b014596240dfe649eb07e6a7f8a3298468b975c8532a360f096885511db"}

{"id": "p_775f760e2c7d47f2", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 147, "text": "孫亮時，二子熊、損各復領兵，為全公主所謂，皆死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "9e5178f8cd7d864d00cdc39434fcbe1df313a29afadee5f0cb350f2da625cd28"}

{"id": "p_7c267005877a3941", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 148, "text": "永安中，迫錄前功，以熊子宣襲爵雲陽侯，尚公主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "ba02b5da89e82d8e1d37555a2dce01bb6f0b834d4c982fdc309efcbbe05a37c5"}

{"id": "p_c922dce607dae102", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 149, "text": "評曰：虞翻古之狂直，因難免乎末世，然權不能容，非曠宇也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "d0a99b4f24f54564812e55cddf3b39c7fad937dbf539219141cd9dd28e61668d"}

{"id": "p_09cd084d48c77810", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 150, "text": "陸績之於揚《玄》，是仲尼之左丘明，老聘之嚴周矣；以瑚璉之器，而作守南越，不亦賊夫人歟！", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "29e4bdcf31376bc4bdbaa92003607d603f1c35ad752cebd43005d85a433a293a"}

{"id": "p_614cf873258c4785", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 151, "text": "張溫才藻俊茂，而智防未備，用致艱患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "18b6fcd965e5a1fce0ac81eafdbd8ac7b24c966f075e6c05d2d4ac45b6bf5858"}

{"id": "p_62210f45b9b0a9ca", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 152, "text": "駱統抗明大義，辭切理至，值權方閉不開。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "28e4f30ea7b45e7d050cd9ece1730faf0484dc59eba4f6e5ba6a64573559c39d"}

{"id": "p_30dcb6a75788963c", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 153, "text": "陸瑁篤義規諫，君子有稱焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "c5008ee953cb2200d327f182197cd177f3d1a0000d3f91f5aca4c56e68920832"}

{"id": "p_113e847c81ab3e3b", "source_id": "src_76ba243507db21b0", "ordinal": 154, "text": "吾粲、朱據遭罹屯蹇，以正喪身，悲夫！", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "de0d7d98862e2f114f474c9a34b208ce7f5391ee0e60a1a5933b6c5d2f5bb263"}

{"id": "p_1fafed5367c75f45", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_c7158953c29f2c7a", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 1, "text": "陸遜字伯言，吳郡吳人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "d724e0c8afc8e471f3161eba2e533bd411e99ddd16dfa0e0805dc94edb72570e"}

{"id": "p_679652a53adeeccb", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 2, "text": "遜少孤，隨從祖廬江太守康在官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "99cbd0d9add7979fc171bf0d4608dba861cff7d55497ca40b77f9bd6447892ae"}

{"id": "p_abce67e498a3374e", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 3, "text": "袁術與康有隙，將攻康，康遣遜及親戚還吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "263a016cc923e1fac251916be8e843f35745a083de7a0f8f768306ac2a1bacfd"}

{"id": "p_b560f35ab7b9982b", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 4, "text": "遜年長於康子績數歲，為之綱紀門戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "c83d9cab44d8ded6abbf1069647ea2eabd6dc77a3213bad8f2477a21b0c39f68"}

{"id": "p_ed867d405d157232", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 5, "text": "孫權為將軍，遜年二十一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "b6e3ce993b5aa80dbd95889e6e41a270b0b015961be857b8d0a3cd5131a08ea1"}

{"id": "p_7b4dac7cfdeb7f4f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 6, "text": "始仕幕府，歷東西曹令史，出為海昌屯田都尉，並領縣事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "ab6bb4bccee460b00b9d28fec087ab35e7dbee9540f7d984d9a879c201f63e22"}

{"id": "p_1412ff0ed6cecc6d", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 7, "text": "縣連年亢旱，遜開倉谷以振貧民，勸督農桑，百姓蒙賴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "c59d113777ef5bc1ac3f7efbc63daa7d64b87797ed6f1dbedae3963d76e89f72"}

{"id": "p_b42f9ed918f95d9c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 8, "text": "時吳、會稽、丹楊多有伏匿，遜陳便宜，乞與幕焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "15da62001f6866f268edd3c1481b12217407cc9f57b632c8639c08b8aedb0062"}

{"id": "p_ed6477dbc0515f5e", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 9, "text": "會稽山賊大帥潘臨，舊為所在毒害，歷年不禽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "fc2e4a41dd161e69097b433f05d621285b861bbabc2efdb05a03f78247fd7b71"}

{"id": "p_9c5b2dc0b07c4554", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 10, "text": "遜以手下召兵，討治深險，所向皆服，部曲已有二千餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "a6937c3e2fbd159608e789ea5371d01cdc066178180537287980ea30b7a297ce"}

{"id": "p_5a5f53d714fa8fbe", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 11, "text": "鄱陽賊帥尤突作亂，復往討之，拜定威校尉，軍屯利浦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "4e2f864913faf976d31998c080d051a329ed88c00b076ea85603ced3c46a6ee4"}

{"id": "p_9aea73e637830697", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 12, "text": "權以兄策女配遜，數訪世務。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "50892294242fdd218e5012e684cd631e2e4e8a1918c17c3d0d6a950169adaf09"}

{"id": "p_35b25424cd0b6732", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 13, "text": "遜建議曰：「方今英雄棋跱，豺狼規望，克敵寧亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "c19ad7c11e5f50035f688a9ac9528981dd94b2f48a16e948652b524247088af1"}

{"id": "p_e065355406a91ae3", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 14, "text": "非眾不濟，而山寇舊惡，依阻深地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "e29f24c9f93eb48e6a7fbecf7bb23a059e903eb98f9be40a3f615b207a9e5881"}

{"id": "p_042f9f66d0817a70", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 15, "text": "夫腹心未平，難以圖遠，可大部伍，取其精銳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "b8896fec3feabb758abfd8646e2dfcb2d513168e3a318871c7a6ac886997a222"}

{"id": "p_6bbc471aa4c56da6", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 16, "text": "」權納其策，以為帳下右部督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "8a9012e82f587115995d81c422f4748f1d9097372d32bafe4e269cd542a55272"}

{"id": "p_b7708dbbd7811df8", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 17, "text": "會丹楊賊帥費棧受曹公印綬，扇動山越，為作內應，權遣遜討棧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "78e25c5aba97f2d3b8597e8bc0cb27882242ba668a6835e39ea8f5b84f7cb13e"}

{"id": "p_1d6d94dd2c51b102", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 18, "text": "棧支黨多而往兵少，遜乃益施牙幢，分佈鼓角，夜潛山谷間，鼓噪而前，應時破散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "bae7276ca66c7571d7aa8afde180569b42cb4f9f5bd4df3d32f467d7fcc5261b"}

{"id": "p_2519439f708000c6", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 19, "text": "遂部伍東三郡，強者為兵，羸者補戶，得精卒數萬人，宿惡蕩除，所過肅清，還屯蕪湖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "11209c8de13609e6b238eee42774d794af24504626d3c1b2769e07b892329a29"}

{"id": "p_2440a06cc0bbe250", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 20, "text": "會稽太守淳於式表遜枉取民人，愁擾所在。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "22d651fdb1e8d3caa2e32cd541e0e0314df2ae98c5f902cf62d9a5aa8746b02b"}

{"id": "p_02bd423db36fce6c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 21, "text": "遜後詣都，言次，稱式佳吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f1c306c08252ee4f4501586c30001cd0c074c83692a3d3f932be2f99924b163c"}

{"id": "p_777b0b2c4f699bcb", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 22, "text": "權曰：「式白君而君薦之，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "834d926858f2dab6fe0d47825aae85c4f752ac6bada0edad86be4ccf958c3db8"}

{"id": "p_c71c85db4ab3d187", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」遜對曰：「式意欲養民，是以白遜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "d2f5c9c47470c63461ea014ed9a5ea2fc3c5cd3a4bec8ac5e6e0e76e9859a7de"}

{"id": "p_ffd350fc53d43ffc", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 24, "text": "若遜復毀式以亂聖聽，不可長也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "9415e91b9b089605848fadab32da478e5955fd07f02c019684fdfce715b96758"}

{"id": "p_580c91aa956f540d", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 25, "text": "」權曰：「此誠長者之事，顧人不能為耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "ce9485367b4669df7f25d60a31e3bb983f549c6051725a9226b42e2b93355b22"}

{"id": "p_c9fc0c9039936d27", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」呂蒙稱疾詣建業，遜往見之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "88c220724e4a27cab9d3281c436b161ea8d1cba1518490f7e614f1f3405c39e2"}

{"id": "p_b7ca494c7da04834", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 27, "text": "謂曰：「關羽接境，如何遠下，後不當可憂也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "d946756beed71833b770b189fa44d97746370de38c8272aeded580c98e33a47f"}

{"id": "p_ad72c5c2970ee22f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」蒙曰：「誠如來言，然我病篤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "d376db0aba5fe6b0337bb4676d68b7469baa4d6278fc3b0fd369ccd9470b4fd8"}

{"id": "p_d092c624531da8b3", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」遜曰：「羽矜其驍氣，陵轢於人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "396a5002a461f8090140bdd6bc7b917b755e6f98a432a13b0bb604789ab5b808"}

{"id": "p_a76c662713e8a6e9", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 30, "text": "始有大功，意驕志逸，但務北進，未嫌於我，有相聞病，必益無備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "98b01cc38745e10df73725328f086bbc11c3f3f121e68773f92ec7a9804aa7d5"}

{"id": "p_631b57fbbcd3685e", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」蒙曰：「羽素勇猛，既難為敵，且已據荊州，恩信大行，兼始有功，膽勢益盛，未易圖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "1004d1aeba8e4c6ddb9fdeada045c914aa99586e4c11bbeef6886a102d5e6ffa"}

{"id": "p_8f4654ddb49b1019", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」蒙至都，權問：「誰可代卿者？", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "6291b312689bf690359d116245a33a9c727fda7c58c0922c3310ae5ebaedf608"}

{"id": "p_bed2498c5c4f4a4f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」蒙對曰：「陸遜意思深長，才堪負重，觀其規慮，終可大任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "5b0aa2084453b725ea58db8650431e168876c23285a8f994eb40a24a096844d1"}

{"id": "p_0e9917c12c129048", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 34, "text": "而未有遠名，非羽所忌，無復是過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "f2ea29fd52f9683f063ab55559a8e204c0d414fd8e6468b2d2f45a45bfafafd2"}

{"id": "p_acba3612b23a5748", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 35, "text": "若用之，當令外自韜隱，內察形便，然後可克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "1df07b2d571108aac589d495bc1b35b393ac1f73f7855971f984726c0fcad30e"}

{"id": "p_29ce9268e6fe068b", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 36, "text": "」權乃召遜，拜偏將軍右部督代蒙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "3a1b72bffe4d964410841576fe2e98bc613055cee0120417f403322dd1ea244a"}

{"id": "p_9b11ed028a4da77c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 37, "text": "遜至陸口，書與羽曰：「前承觀釁而動，以律行師，小舉大克，一何巍巍!敵國敗績，利在同盟，聞慶拊節，想遂席捲，共獎王綱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "0a3ddacb5c69b2869e56e8594b76a9548f807d3b7726164ee50edff0d6a2e3b6"}

{"id": "p_1bfabc846313b958", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 38, "text": "近以不敏，受任來西，延慕光塵，思廩良規。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "8d7121684afd8b1f7f3db9a2ceb980ae7de4d33ad5a366802f81f6696b96240e"}

{"id": "p_c621edccb690edc4", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 39, "text": "羽覽遜書，有謙下自托之意，意大安，無復所嫌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "5ad2b5ee149cfbfa95b33ded3e2c9904532f75bb0ccb780d3df4caf0c32f60f4"}

{"id": "p_8951c7cbbc3f97c5", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 40, "text": "遜具啟形狀，陳其可禽之要。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "144d954a39367c668d574fe425cbea5e9b00ca0757710fd3b6fd5186c62b1b8f"}

{"id": "p_c72c719581618190", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 41, "text": "權乃潛軍而上，使遜與呂蒙為前部，至即克公安、南郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "ccc56fc4a1fad7b79525eee2b348ae632bcf45f86a4715a5532875b2b908bc9f"}

{"id": "p_91d6d3ef5dca7e61", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 42, "text": "遜徑進，領宜都太守，拜撫邊將軍，封華亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "39ca86462345688c5a7fcccd50dbe6ecc6523577b61a9fcc8be922fec2d37537"}

{"id": "p_3b8bf54143f2f891", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 43, "text": "備宜都太守樊友委郡走，諸城長吏及蠻夷君長皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "60a30353efa243476d2aaaeac420a7ef0ad9610401dbffafcc81eabf101bc814"}

{"id": "p_59bc3f44c281ddc7", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 44, "text": "遜請金銀銅印，以假授初附。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "034bf8b5620e34122a43075c267c6798a880070a9bb270b1562a6c2b985c1d3e"}

{"id": "p_032405f25189b1d2", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 45, "text": "遜遣將軍李異、謝旌等將三千人，攻蜀將詹晏、陳鳳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "2c9ee02b54ef91c10bb49209465c3964d7c0f715f83dcb7e4387e97248e5770b"}

{"id": "p_594ef512e642bf95", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 46, "text": "異將水軍，旌將步兵，斷色險要，即破晏等，生降得鳳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "872b5d96f8ebc3b35f78b365e6791c27abdaeb8654c91fbd9c025d4713f838a4"}

{"id": "p_e127acf8f37ea519", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 47, "text": "又攻房陵太守鄧輔、南鄉太守郭睦，大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "0757b0bb76268fcab3d230e9b420e9899e9f05150ee55e063b4ade51e3beec7d"}

{"id": "p_aa8d2cbc2e5c9a6f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 48, "text": "秭歸大姓文布、鄧凱等合夷兵數千人，首尾西方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "e432622d28081e189d40d2f9a0b0d3257885e9e8ef3f9195102b3bc319aecf95"}

{"id": "p_78e33b544184e99a", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 49, "text": "遜令人誘之，布帥眾還降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "beac97980af6d6e90dc493ab308dcea7996a082088cc63cd1a957dbce2d4d630"}

{"id": "p_327430f2218c772f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 50, "text": "前後斬獲招納，凡數萬計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "759f64aa2afad2439088cce49b2d837e70c20e0ec33480be7f40a85e039cbb99"}

{"id": "p_22173982d6b2064f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 51, "text": "權以遜為右護軍、鎮西將軍，進封婁侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "1dfedecf4d442426655754d175cb8e7dd5d1e04e4b6d7e02c25ce41099180290"}
