{"id": "p_b8923c0cd80a04d7", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 52, "text": "時荊州士人新還，仕進或未得所，遜上疏曰：「昔漢高受命，招延英異，光武中興，群俊畢至，苟可以熙隆道教者，未必遠近。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "d8291ff06479a546420d47386d702afab285a9f261e583d109c8fd867e9ff41a"}

{"id": "p_e460da593140637a", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 53, "text": "今荊州始定，人物未達，臣愚慺慺，乞普加覆載抽拔之恩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "64350fc18c5048133fe4d9b3f11a06c890c74b1f33a9aade4aa3457ca966ff3f"}

{"id": "p_0b0092a2c483a431", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 54, "text": "令並獲自進，然後四海延頸，思歸大化。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "ddac7903b8c8e3f45de51ce3105492220fdd84c4963903ee7e06a4fd01d10d19"}

{"id": "p_daab72e1494f85aa", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 55, "text": "，劉備率大眾來向西界，權命遜為大都督、假節，督朱然、潘璋、宋謙、韓當、徐盛、鮮于丹、孫桓等五萬人拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "507cc5514ab5e7f6b83dc3f3509003a66fb15716ad79b204d64932be0b5f9a39"}

{"id": "p_2a63e0a3d1466a83", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 56, "text": "備從巫峽、建平連圍至夷陵界，立數十屯，以金錦爵賞誘動諸夷，使將軍馮習為大督，張南為前部，輔匡，趙融、廖淳、傅肜等各為別督，先遣吳班將數千人於平地立營，欲以挑戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "70a4561af59492677151391da8b55eeec5ee7a6d50e631e10902a47f9ef5a2fd"}

{"id": "p_c6a5ad92ef5b207f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 57, "text": "諸將皆欲擊之，遜曰：「此必有譎，且觀之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "116dc8a609916bc335946ce21013d82763293c806570505f596017f846f158f9"}

{"id": "p_d1373b437716c45b", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」備知其計不可，乃引伏兵八千，從谷中出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "1e13ccf0d7b70d80760b3e559c7e23a483426415dbc886e7ff4ef153f0e2089e"}

{"id": "p_1d5d52ebe79ffba9", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 59, "text": "遜曰：「所以不聽諸君擊班者，揣之必有巧故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "1b0dd06363aaf115bf94618c4d6ca848a368da8427a0d97b50c367ed5387faa7"}

{"id": "p_9a36cabf9269a286", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 60, "text": "諸將並曰：「攻備當在初，今乃令人五六百里，相銜持經七八月，其諸要害皆以固守，擊之必無利矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "a65b1dd5fea1d527b9bff95f36dd8df46b0c5ded05341d2555a5d0c519904a74"}

{"id": "p_bc38902cbae01924", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」遜曰：「備是猾虜，更嘗事多，其軍始集，思慮精專，未可干也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "051d13d84f3c892e6a26b5baa1776d3b18f7d26c69c63809a13c1437816e7b66"}

{"id": "p_9d53ea5a8e3c7205", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 62, "text": "今住己久，不得我便，兵疲意沮，計不復生，掎角此寇，正在今日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "88e8689218223f4a905ac9d02162d81ccdebb6cb00684ad63064d23cf354b505"}

{"id": "p_41e7d5c07e3c96da", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」遜曰：「吾已曉破之之術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "3757f3218d292d3a3c3664feb686e63944875e04eaf8c63f352559f276791182"}

{"id": "p_8924cbf1b99c6be3", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 64, "text": "」乃敕各持一把茅，以火攻拔之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "cc9ff14456eb05fbc177c96477833b8468d33d129d8b9ea4ef1e51e615ccf141"}

{"id": "p_b209dbe52ae8aee6", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 65, "text": "一爾勢成，通率諸軍同時俱攻，斬張南、馮習及胡王沙靡柯等首，破其四十餘營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "1a914ff7606464b5c9a3eefd9f1d3eac3652719ec0017c2b0adc5b8508ea7305"}

{"id": "p_9ef05a80c63ab6b7", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 66, "text": "備將杜路、劉寧等窮逼請降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "3eec9b097bd39f109f6ccb714336b086b3d7b86ccc816252708b40842245bd54"}

{"id": "p_16d00aeef67e02d5", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 67, "text": "遜督促諸軍四面蹙之，土崩瓦解，死者萬數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "8886ccddf5244e4aab4e8ff9e420d9e5f5bf474f01197493fa631cb10983fe6f"}

{"id": "p_8ab3da2feb985503", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 68, "text": "備因夜遁，驛人自擔燒鐃鎧斷後，僅得入白帝城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "a516f73830e3af96ee4f886ca2d60028b55a2128b9b9213fd3cfecc543e453d7"}

{"id": "p_2323fc527abd3dfe", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 69, "text": "其舟船器械，水步軍資，一時略盡，屍骸漂流，塞江而下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "2ac0edbf9471cdf4f56dadee01cdee8c4a6ddd022a5f63167c9d017e1af1d2a1"}

{"id": "p_b8857a66d62b0b4b", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 70, "text": "備大慚恚，曰：「吾乃為遜所折辱，豈非天邪!」", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "c6b5ea3aacda689e6353f5bd4f0d8dd778807915c156901979ed1d13159e2b71"}

{"id": "p_c505b9188b7e9af5", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 71, "text": "初，孫桓別討備前鋒於夷道，為備所圍，求救於遜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "1edcf5a878fb1b1297224e0ea07fec6045e7edacc1568364a4c19d57e78ca68d"}

{"id": "p_493ae04dae78a97c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 72, "text": "」諸將曰：「孫安東公族，見圍已困，奈何不救？", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "906b80fedded7d3ade5bd62e92f9e8a1d4901476faf1475e73b6cd3184fdc593"}

{"id": "p_cdb7c9d4101a12ae", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」遜曰：「安東得士眾心，城牢糧足，無可憂也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "047ba5a2ffc0c0e8aa36a6310fc693db3fb1ac2bd9f35f7556236d68a19604de"}

{"id": "p_1b3004dafd7eef50", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 74, "text": "待吾計展，欲不救安東，安東自解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "5eebdafa70802c8df3a50063df048d5281eefefce8fc89729bb5be3e57eda8b8"}

{"id": "p_96a5682a005e9fc2", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」及方略大施，備果奔潰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "e58a228760e6c16844c6a5b3b1e487a0e658020632ac240173505c1b35233963"}

{"id": "p_39dc740233765739", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 76, "text": "桓後見遜曰：「前實怨不見救，定至今日，乃知調度自有方耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "198080bf5d839ec513b0cf021ff5fe85668f47c906bbffb1086f0004bce00223"}

{"id": "p_ae683628cd52bef5", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」當御備時，諸將軍或是孫策時舊將，或公室貴戚，各自矜恃，不相聽從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "44ddf499a1fdb45672e7f819fce95ff111ef57dd121fd3f8674dea803363c934"}

{"id": "p_cf543ac6acb0e839", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 78, "text": "及至破備，計多出遜，諸將乃服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "7867f4b86f5771fd3c39c9d0e46c5a046b274d7d224263173b1805950c8c65b3"}

{"id": "p_8d94d1c26eaa13b4", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 79, "text": "權聞之，曰：「君何以初不啟諸將違節度者邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "5b846c106cfc11cc66b4a42f87c0934a497dc7124bffb48725cc0f2e09831458"}

{"id": "p_081e62c91d78bc58", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 80, "text": "」遜對曰：「受恩深重，任過其才。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "b74f9933e0738a2c7ee223c2e7527b60e0615bdd53e7c7400fe24512cdec7776"}

{"id": "p_5166327a3c712854", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 81, "text": "又此諸將或任腹心，或堪爪牙，或是功臣，皆國家所當與共克定大事者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "9407d91f077e03bf1cdf7c1823e1fbaf5534f1f39e1afb38118c967face75af6"}

{"id": "p_932d080e16db27d5", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 82, "text": "臣雖駑懦，竊慕相如、寇恂相下之義，以濟國事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "aaeccf806a544d4293e682ed37badade9ceea4c7ad3e6b25ee23c518b03ab82d"}

{"id": "p_909f664957000d69", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 83, "text": "」權大笑稱善，加拜遜輔國將軍，領荊州牧，即改封江陵候。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "963714d89219dffd1c8de4139610e81f0bda671aa99f3e0e8b2d356beee1efa3"}

{"id": "p_9af09555fc8ae419", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 84, "text": "又備既住白帝，徐盛、潘璋、宋謙等各競表言備必可禽，乞復攻之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "df90f803f1d5b8e3bb69310f3ac641cfeecc58f04fc1ba1ae37e2c1f8fa4643b"}

{"id": "p_42512f37c7249b79", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 85, "text": "權以問遜，遜與朱然、駱統以為「曹丕大合士眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "caaa52546f64774738a3e2c1f3f7ad9354f8d47c9384348983288a09e95219e1"}

{"id": "p_b24e6a6c1074409c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 86, "text": "外托助國討備，內實有奸心，謹決計輒還」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "66c9fa73126c4dd33743736edf08f8a074ba5cdbef151736914c61f5eb04d593"}

{"id": "p_6fcc1d7b49adaa9e", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 87, "text": "無幾，魏軍果出，三方受敵也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "7c646260a5cd8ed345f9ed63a327a5f92cafa1ddb819a9398c99ea1b1bad97c0"}

{"id": "p_30ed40e9e5ee2e2d", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 88, "text": "備尋病亡，子禪襲位，諸葛亮秉政，與權連和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "c882ef20efa37fa08bde31291bc4628c1caf0676baedb2f1fbf084fde5afc8b6"}

{"id": "p_5242cfc6e83d5877", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 89, "text": "時事所宜，權輒令遜語亮，並刻權印，以置遜所。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "eeacde57a308c2996bad409342c0438708f1ebb50d01ca84182ab5512bc2e23e"}

{"id": "p_26c95a71caed67e4", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 90, "text": "權每與禪、亮書，常過示遜，輕重可否，有所不安，便令改定，以印封行之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "a92f631686f9e0932d938e5c506b9fdf09a3b12b4ff1eb035485dc6692ba0d71"}

{"id": "p_801447dbc4ff5f8c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 91, "text": "七年，權使鄱陽太守周魴譎魏大司馬曹休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "cfbc855f266ac3c1f2909e4749de0cc95fbfb165a55421d34939eaae2c1cf215"}

{"id": "p_ff48661b69292ca7", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 92, "text": "休果舉眾入皖，乃召遜假黃鉞，為大都督，逆休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "f359dba196976785c982bd18c83b0c7a77c98f35006bce2da3640caf5c0e40d5"}

{"id": "p_241ccc9bf85f5f7a", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 93, "text": "休既覺知，恥見欺誘，自恃兵馬精多，遂交戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "3d8fb6434989ca184a846698a6d4f39aaa1ef6747a5244da33cde2c99aa1829f"}

{"id": "p_07854f8b4ed0dd3b", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 94, "text": "遜自為中部，令朱桓、全琮為左右冀，三道俱近，果沖休伏兵，因驅走之，追亡逐北，逕至夾石，斬獲萬餘，牛馬騾驢車乘萬輛，軍資器械略盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "c32a001943ea299caae40f6f86622528c20388c57d2d3e73bceb3eed308c6949"}

{"id": "p_c8d992ed6e770e46", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 95, "text": "諸軍振旅過武昌，權令左右以御蓋覆遜，入出殿門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "baac97ec2ae3f0405243c61db98b281ead0d05b19fd07b8123b45deb92a63615"}

{"id": "p_20490805a6b4867e", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 96, "text": "凡所賜遜，皆御物上珍，於時莫與為比。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "5f2803fe88d2b1609cffb28b4dd2d50100e7b4f41723c20a5f9adcb174635fab"}

{"id": "p_490c02393c0bbc5e", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 97, "text": "是歲，權東巡建業，留太子，皇子及尚書九官，征遜輔太子，並掌荊州及豫章三郡事，董督軍國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "d81f96627de775df0d59cfaf72fd0a9da9060754afbf7c8a06903eb3eb01593e"}

{"id": "p_fd5f999070835b67", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 98, "text": "時建昌侯慮於堂前作斗鴨欄，頗施小巧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "231c235a794f06c2587ee434e14d58946cfe1e24bcfe001a4f3304995106f8b8"}

{"id": "p_4d363eb49e71abe4", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 99, "text": "遜正色曰：「君候宜勤覽經典以自新益，用此何為？", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "5e7de5a97cca7dedf62bb9abc90416300d7d85460a7ff07eebc53af60e934597"}

{"id": "p_50aaf31d1317c170", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 100, "text": "射聲校尉松於公子中最親，戲兵不整，遜對之髡其職吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "27304a60f39ab4cf40e7b391148032acd9990ecc0134ef6e25b34bdb05c8fb70"}

{"id": "p_eb43c1461a9b6bc5", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 101, "text": "南陽謝景善劉廙先刑後禮之論，遜呵景曰：「禮之長於刑久矣，廙以細辯而詭先聖之教，皆非也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "49a95a21661f4e97aef6d53689bfe30490a4f8ac587f7bf42a27fb7887039d53"}

{"id": "p_433ff8c8d54fda31", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 102, "text": "君今侍東宮，宜遵仁義以彰德音，若彼之談，不須講也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "65d88abdfdc79615507495b8aba7ef86784a08c1b52899e8a60fc546ff218ce2"}

{"id": "p_ce798e840af1ff7e", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 103, "text": "」遜雖身在外，乃心於國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "cff355db3b5ae7bfa911d465de2777791a3307ee5fef314223b66dbfd83a9d92"}

{"id": "p_6f988f0122356d88", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 104, "text": "權欲遣偏師取夷州及朱崖，皆以咨遜，遜上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "d29ba5c37477695a659779d24f0966a33804238ea3b246682d6b6d5378be3f26"}

{"id": "p_0e2160aebab07149", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 105, "text": "及公孫淵背盟，權欲往征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "01801199c5ac2e2b4bd17fc19ae5d241d1b46ba81ace4d61b844fe1c8f41631a"}

{"id": "p_398cda0b36567426", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 106, "text": "遜遣親人韓扁賚表奉報，還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "07378d937f130be13dc26b77ad65572b4031a36f504eb1e0fbd90bc72cc38895"}

{"id": "p_74524e113099f908", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 107, "text": "書與遜云：「大駕已旋，賊得韓扁，具知吾闊狹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "918756e38568f6d067e674281704d67c6aa00fceba233d0bff9ceef9460241c7"}

{"id": "p_da7c8034c77b4c0e", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 108, "text": "」遜未答，方催人種葑豆，與諸將欒棋射戲如常。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "cf9e6da4246b965291a219e7a9c096f84f6705740e97770eb8d0154c4d737349"}

{"id": "p_4910e8bf0c233d22", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 109, "text": "瑾曰：「伯言多智略，其當有以。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "afa120c0808ab80a0234b0a68a5e9110b1877cbffd4b36e55e6f79ef56d29942"}

{"id": "p_6235c9463bf288c1", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 110, "text": "」自來見遜，遜曰：「賊知大駕以旋，無所復戚，得專力於吾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "531fbe3fa6a814d4a65d40e3b59525ec0e068ed1eee41b006394c37b2e837c17"}

{"id": "p_ecd35bb6a1e5d735", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 111, "text": "又已守要害之處，兵將意動，且當自定以安之，施設變術，然後出耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "2f34079a989afe35580ccaf230eb4798e1d3ddb05be574dab162f2863995213a"}

{"id": "p_f7eaf3d20e27177c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 112, "text": "今便示退，賊當謂吾怖，仍來相蹙，必敗之勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "2ef42ab3ffd253f651352dcffe153b7d079af890b74288fae5c2a782901eba9c"}

{"id": "p_025c26a73e1146e4", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」乃密與瑾立計，令瑾督舟船，遜悉上兵馬，以向襄陽城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "a50c794384d1e84f95f5820dbb682a77742ec27a6ea5a7cf7e9b10a7530b4b8b"}

{"id": "p_a1e67783009fd95d", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 114, "text": "瑾便引船出，遜徐整部伍，張拓聲勢，步趨船，敵不敢干。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "0582f1e5f5d1e3da84cbda4a5f04beddbd291478d0e533c5ee3778172908f9c9"}

{"id": "p_d73183715ec253dd", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 115, "text": "軍到白圍，託言住獵，潛遣將軍周峻、張梁等擊江夏新市、安陸、石陽，石陽市盛，峻等奄至，人皆捐物入城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "e4d4aa585eb40085ba90ae0d175e649920b4fcdfdc06f03fa86ba16743dc5dbb"}

{"id": "p_779cde009ec6510a", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 116, "text": "城門噎不得關，敵乃自斫殺己民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "f8dba78b7906023756334e25436383d4148b1bae5f874f35ecc2b89ab6366183"}

{"id": "p_7562a78f7a094bfb", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 117, "text": "其所生得，皆加營護，不令兵士千擾侵侮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "be6804e8ff62db3dd8fc2129434e1ee52d537f1c5cdbd67a39e9803303975269"}

{"id": "p_c2c8f883bb17ee45", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 118, "text": "若亡其妻子者，即給衣糧，厚加慰勞，發遺令還，或有感慕相攜而歸者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "32bf3570cb6ddb149105f8ca9d57a239d815bf9103a0d4d6185f0144276aba7f"}

{"id": "p_04623be41c45ef6f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 119, "text": "鄰境懷之，江夏功曹趙濯、弋陽備將裴生及夷王梅頤等，並帥支黨來附遜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "06fa170ac5c310e7d62955ce5d8977e24e8670c08d1851b8c390a526b2d3f877"}

{"id": "p_8633bc338ca59188", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 120, "text": "又魏江夏太守逮式兼領兵馬，頗作邊害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "3e9a3fcf6603be5ab77125051265f4f86697298afbc49c5fc2af680a37d42710"}

{"id": "p_ff0e2b16854094bd", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 121, "text": "而與北舊將文聘子休宿不協。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "245bf5865cdb968531ae60c05b5ead440986aa9b4c408c356185267eea219ebf"}

{"id": "p_b7b486288b0653f2", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 122, "text": "即假作答式書云：「得報懇惻，知與休久結嫌隙，勢不兩存，欲來歸附，輒以密呈來書表聞，撰眾相迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "ca1f8147b0303d2845e7ed5ff45154b53ac1e88d4981e04501e70e17a2611c3d"}

{"id": "p_14105e712445c70e", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」以書置界上，式兵得書以見式，式惶懼，遂自送妻子還洛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "5a11b04f6a6b2d04f2fe572877d986b01a6bbb61cc882413ebb66f476f808015"}

{"id": "p_fec13be91246bab4", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 124, "text": "由是史士不復親附，遂以免罷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "7831314807481896c9cd71f903c33542473783296fc9be104e8acdb073e79cb0"}

{"id": "p_dfdcde9bef81ebfa", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 125, "text": "六年，中郎將周祗乞於鄱陽召募，事下問遜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "bb28048589c0bbfcd36bcd7a1344a32a5afab2e5c42a4212adf6f7be1f2b98c5"}

{"id": "p_ad49b96a0a873983", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 126, "text": "遜以為此郡民易動難安，不可與召。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "cf218217ecfb9f33e8d16d5e98af17fc360c46bd6cee4f890ef7a8934c5fb715"}

{"id": "p_dfceb1bc7cf0b3b0", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 127, "text": "而祗固陳取之，郡民吳遽等果作賊殺祗，攻沒諸縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "0d9aa9d54ba20dbc10124f84e0c84c7833c3e9709ea31eb9f5bd53d3b623352c"}

{"id": "p_33feafdd88a45400", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 128, "text": "豫章、廬陵宿惡民並應遽為寇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "e1a05818d138ff1437fe5f14a43636e4b1b45a88b84bb40455408d83b7060950"}

{"id": "p_a958fb78c33e28b3", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 129, "text": "遜自聞，輒討即破，遽等相率降，遜料得精兵八千餘人，三郡平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "60fd4c6efcfff6968569789339044cbd4af07d645bf3e3357eab1eac385ef195"}

{"id": "p_900b24fca648b858", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 130, "text": "時中書典校呂壹，竊弄權柄，擅作威福。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "235fb92db2402c3e2f588261d6aafb3ecea6868a73f78ba78e81ea6643563326"}

{"id": "p_ee348c4bf540890c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 131, "text": "遜與太常潘浚同心憂之，言至流涕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "5db247397606be8b2cf1d16b96e1ddfd49c6a5cff7a8e4454d343c268d3b7f26"}

{"id": "p_9189670528811374", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 132, "text": "後權誅壹，深以自責，語在《權傳》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "67b907a7b607926144d868091575d6438a4d2983ff2348039f090dbaf7eecad0"}

{"id": "p_8f87123687d74f7d", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 133, "text": "時謝淵、謝厷等各陳便宜，欲興利改作，以事下遜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "6e792a603d11940ce44be5a0ebc960c2e8e3b4eaca4825a6e14e48603e20b703"}

{"id": "p_073aca48b830d782", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 134, "text": "先是，二宮並闕，中外職司，多遣子弟給侍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "e1ae50bd42e6810a71c2fdea50734a11cffab7eab6ed1674877c144b5d6a0d84"}

{"id": "p_a3c647ae2cfe694d", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 135, "text": "全琮報遜，遜以為“子弟苟有才，不憂不用，不宜私出以要榮利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "3995e26c80074f2482b6ff533394bb7a81ef9f92ab2a90273a921d6253e3ddac"}

{"id": "p_b7fe2a6d8bb5133b", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 136, "text": "且聞二宮勢敵，必有彼此，此古人之厚忌也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "df34396f3d6ee5be1177ae7abe0ecc5e98fa83259cb28115820892ef94c42adc"}

{"id": "p_dfe0adcf54450317", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 137, "text": "”琮子寄，果阿附魯王，輕為交構。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "c3ba904da82c07eca54160da492113ff8757302747160e50423ca7c9a36a0287"}

{"id": "p_6f1ec8745f1105ef", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 138, "text": "遜書與琮曰：「卿不師日磾，而宿留阿寄，終為足下門戶致禍矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "e9d1ef702c82da6b63c810d362a191d9b643d9815531adc94dbc7c6008d59ced"}

{"id": "p_9b2595978b77d5d7", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 139, "text": "及太子有不安之儀，遜上疏陳：「太子正統，宜有磐石之固，魯王藩臣，當使寵秩有差，彼此得所，上下獲安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "65d1c1066a51ec176d9262f25038ec2cd5392b99dfea8ae34ecb0ed4eb501ad0"}

{"id": "p_0de65b77983f8e19", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」書三四上，及求詣都，欲口論適庶之分，以匡得失。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "deb1ead4d39e746f042bfdf778e804bec599213819e74f142da93dbe04e6ecd3"}

{"id": "p_5dfb1f773c65cdb0", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 141, "text": "既不聽許，而遜外生顧譚、顧承、姚信，工以親附太子，枉見流徙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "a54e884c2bd33c020591cf147e5eb42db9cad455aba0d936d32ca2cf8fb1d61b"}

{"id": "p_ac94a3f7478f283a", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 142, "text": "太子太傅吾粲坐數與遜交書，下獄死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "8e7473fd1b3d23c751d7d2d70a329d5411bc5dd33a4bafb1e65fb5ce8853aa6b"}

{"id": "p_45784fadf0777bd7", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 143, "text": "權累遣中使責讓遜，遜憤恚致卒，時年六十三。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "320f17b8c99c924461f69f597e16388be1afd97a00e196f55eefcaf8f4556bec"}

{"id": "p_6b4361f43322b6f9", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 144, "text": "初，暨艷造營府之論，遜諫戒之，以為必禍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "dbb683c11bd73851aeb3e3e60e1a04eccebabfc4e990a30772c87cd45cf13ea4"}

{"id": "p_d43c0de7f9d1f264", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 145, "text": "又謂諸葛恪曰：「在我前者，吾必奉之同升；在我下者，則扶持之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "08be5aa7a8ab53e6798cb34bd5db5dc1d3ac602717d50731323d3a433267b872"}

{"id": "p_f4543e5fda5896cd", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 146, "text": "今觀君氣陵其上，意蔑乎下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "24349af8f85895460c5831e23185ac67074f0dd8425c2f16e13f47b130f268c0"}

{"id": "p_d601c66abce10d83", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」又廣陵楊竺少獲聲名，而遜謂之終敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "863250bc22c9b84584acd095f2842ed240cb6934e678cf292a226d8cdbefd404"}

{"id": "p_a140fa1e1c1c7f47", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 148, "text": "長子延早夭，次子抗襲爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "fd8e32091e584418d6b55f29b1249bbfd5bd5e9aac8acf9736a114a4137e2d84"}

{"id": "p_a3ecd37f2ae7f9e3", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 149, "text": "遜卒時，年二十，拜建武校尉，領遜眾五千人，送葬東還，詣都謝恩，孫權以楊竺所白遜二十事問抗，禁絕賓客，中使臨詰，抗無所顧問，事事條答，權意漸解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "4b3fd9b141bf39e5e05114f810fd2449498f6eede02ef01d0ab2dea23ec09b75"}

{"id": "p_3457de9b5ecf4bf5", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 150, "text": "，遷立節中郎將，與諸葛恪換屯柴桑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "c5f24a3f0b859ad6577bed4f56325847e5cff1e9664cf17ca7c5d230c6921483"}

{"id": "p_7c9346ad9d5bda18", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 151, "text": "抗臨去，皆更繕完城圍，葺其牆屋，居廬桑果，不得妄敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "14c23c0efd01141e957575bc51711d99c16c8005ebc1a5dc92f0cf2dc6c14020"}

{"id": "p_fbfb2f9615aa07e0", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 152, "text": "而恪柴桑故屯，頗有毀壞，深以為慚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "910ae8113c789614dd5a9c42d6c985c39767d19d0addfd96e2bb5da60fb93b44"}

{"id": "p_12677a5e91c9d1d0", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 153, "text": "權涕泣與別，謂曰：「吾前聽用讒言，與汝父大義不篤，以此負汝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "80177a302f0812b2d7d8939a7d6e40de3171c890d0a4c8ee67eca8b64e669e7f"}

{"id": "p_53012604dd32b115", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 154, "text": "前後所問，一焚滅之，莫令人見也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "2d5a64103aa9e8f6d9b1b84e8d15f87e62f28f2f61f9e040b3c0e4e7bb6b90a4"}

{"id": "p_fa6065f106ad61f8", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 155, "text": "」建興元年，拜奮威將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "f3c47964d606b813da8c34647bf1adfb2eef67da2b4689577fa7b13142cf3cfd"}

{"id": "p_3a533234404cfd35", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 156, "text": "，魏將諸葛誕舉壽春降，拜抗為柴桑督，赴壽春，破魏牙門將偏將軍，遷征北將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "49c171bbeb6a7f064652e7437df1396279f0524ddc98b7971bc89e9fd3c2cdb0"}

{"id": "p_e3ed74c5d85a9a2d", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 157, "text": "，拜鎮軍將軍，都督西陵，自關羽至白帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "8f572b9f488844982dec9a088fc1ad577024c980ad38b0e08535b6317b40aa31"}

{"id": "p_ea0ee5835f948f8b", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 158, "text": "孫皓即位，加鎮軍大將軍，領益州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "d1cb0fe05c9972305ec15565ca170494b4834aaca1b78ef99c8d1cfcae3e03ee"}

{"id": "p_cbd221b0fc6d281f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 159, "text": "，左大司馬施績卒，拜抗都督信陵、西陵、夷道、樂鄉、公安諸軍事，治樂鄉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "2f9ae0973fa49808ce97a7d3cf05bc56ff0314deb1b118e7d1042214a3c35dc9"}

{"id": "p_c3b9ae398682eed3", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 160, "text": "抗聞都下政令多闕，憂深慮遠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "279e8275307cce93a86b675c96a572430ffa5094de1efbebd7ac78216caee4ca"}

{"id": "p_23f5b3604d7ff26c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 161, "text": "，西陵督步闡據城以叛，遣使降晉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "1c17c3af8addf58bcb3470a5a55c9ffa07f6361e0390e8a3c2a45ddc4908e98c"}

{"id": "p_3aec020366fcb9d5", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 162, "text": "抗聞之，日部分諸軍，令將軍左奕、吾彥、蔡貢等徑赴西陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "4ce4f1b9d65458660f33bab9ad26652abbf18834d7189f9beaa239487f208783"}

{"id": "p_850be46d3b6cbb5f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 163, "text": "敕軍營更築嚴圍，自赤谿至故市，內以圍闡，外以禦寇，晝夜催切，如敵以至，眾甚苦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "5763aa99b28761dc9f7388288f9fb5b5ddf8f4ea3a6be90493d7547cc8f05d06"}

{"id": "p_84a647ab067c52bc", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 164, "text": "諸將咸諫曰：「今及三軍之銳，亟以攻闡，比晉救至，闡必可拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "f94135fe942ee25a7eee49682392680433ca4753bcb16e96eaedf7166e560f29"}

{"id": "p_279c5dc62d2030e7", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 165, "text": "何事於圍，而以弊士民之力乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "088a4ff1cbea8c6cba282de4b82eba7b742655dcf8d9d549a63faa8bf04fc4a6"}

{"id": "p_31f9af937e293335", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」抗曰：「此城處勢既固，糧谷又足，且所繕修備御之具，皆抗所宿規。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "cffe3676f62d0eace32b89cf087dda0a775bbbc2d26a8b802578d2d615c61f3c"}

{"id": "p_125d1662a4b47ab8", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 167, "text": "今反身攻之，既非可卒克，且北救必至，至而無備，表裡受難，何以御之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "91e54a0e8e4c0b6fc084854a820aea5e8e628acc6a9a37504327e8a9eed5f2e8"}

{"id": "p_acfaaec5a4bb890f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 168, "text": "」諸將咸欲攻闡，抗每不許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "ff11e14890f6db54f83ee2ea0d6a6cd88474a5de9320b0fea0d9ed47791ae569"}

{"id": "p_254b2aedfbf0e44f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 169, "text": "宜都太守雷譚言至懇切，抗欲服眾，聽令一攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "84beda9165a3b73ca7177935fedd67a3f61f60b598828e05f308c7ff909ea5c6"}

{"id": "p_314d72c233d835e0", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 170, "text": "晉車騎將軍羊祜率師向江陵，諸將咸以抗不宜上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "0d7bdf0fe7d355a1f0b60c2ba3057d29444f593672f44da4944cbbbe6da5e511"}

{"id": "p_48797830eedb5d99", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 171, "text": "抗曰：「江陵城固兵足，無所憂患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "4f08541d828c7184d730c20789401b95d70e9c1c807fbb2012440478eb85169a"}

{"id": "p_cecd811979649769", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 172, "text": "假令敵沒江陵，必不能守，所損者小。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "343cb19682327376772de072f7e2fae25d25f659e692abb054344a51d372b2df"}

{"id": "p_120cd8bca22622d7", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 173, "text": "如使西陵槃結，則南山群夷皆當擾動，則所憂慮，難可而竟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "66703cd5be88bef35a4d5d477ed2987c268aab6648cc105b3584e2534db477ca"}

{"id": "p_40021d46c76baa7c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 174, "text": "吾寧棄江陵而赴西陵，況江陵牢固乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "d85d81385746680684f2bb08971b63299b3eac06d7b2640b4fe06c85faa183f3"}

{"id": "p_5e4e70cedb3bbd7d", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 175, "text": "」初，江陵平衍，道路通利，抗敕江陵督張咸作大堰遏水，漸漬平中，以絕寇叛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "18ec75a3e41e897cd14afe576eb61ae9209a95a4d1dcb7fd993d4a6061b14eaa"}

{"id": "p_1fb4211d28403237", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 176, "text": "祜欲因所遏水，浮船運糧，揚聲將破堰以通步軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "bc39b1d5b8f3ac09aacf5b8ab255bfed2d2a3b56c9e16bdfeb77e8348e4d8ddf"}

{"id": "p_29975ce0ca8de695", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 177, "text": "聞堰敗，乃改船以車運，大費損功力。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "9b97677676c75775ed9043cc12bff47c4bc769f959c8030d78cd7d0c4978de12"}

{"id": "p_045bcb35d52a2d4b", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 178, "text": "晉巴東監軍徐胤率水軍詣建平，荊州刺史楊肇至西陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "68228aaa6b6ae83f68412a9f1e60d8420b4a3eb6af28c1883092bc1cf97203a0"}

{"id": "p_bdc7c4f68f49b5f6", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 179, "text": "抗令張咸固守其城；公安督孫遵巡南岸御祜；水軍督留慮、鎮西將軍朱琬拒胤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "6c69bd1a1582117974afc9820323974cdf0e5cafab947fe6b28a19d738a7cc41"}

{"id": "p_bed0e24a99c2e2ea", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 180, "text": "將軍朱喬、營都督俞贊亡詣肇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "a4c0402a6503a60b6e762a101a0c1bc2db36811ed78dbe073e0cf00c2ee59cfc"}

{"id": "p_80dbda29f387839a", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 181, "text": "抗曰：「贊軍中舊吏，知吾虛實者，吾常慮夷兵素不簡練，若敵攻圍，必先此處。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "fb10d89c0a5930d7c03579eee803733b6245db0190403d48d8d7526c999506d2"}

{"id": "p_b81c96b156b7fd8b", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」即夜易夷民，皆以舊將充之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "db8baf70986ef266f16d01d8014261e260ac46f36993d0073dd9060c82b98478"}

{"id": "p_1ab7de6a7d13de52", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 183, "text": "明日，肇果攻故夷兵處，抗命旋軍擊之，矢石雨下，肇眾傷死者相屬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "2ea62ac502c5d3eb6ed3097f0699aa2c8a71abe4aa793faf1de658e95a27607f"}

{"id": "p_c85f8aa0dc16681d", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 184, "text": "抗欲追之，而慮闡畜力項領，伺視間隙，兵不足分，於是但鳴鼓戒眾，若將追者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "7fb588050ba2632643efae9cf0f4367627f4f4c154c9257fead0f3367c32078e"}

{"id": "p_eb897438fdc26ca4", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 185, "text": "肇眾兇懼，悉解甲挺走，抗使輕兵躡之，肇大破敗，祜等皆引軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "93b66cdc4931ca932b9ec530f7d4d74bddce9071f7c5cb45605f7868e15a83d4"}

{"id": "p_923a498b49772709", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 186, "text": "抗遂陷西陵城，誅夷闡族及其大將吏，自此以下，所請赦者數萬口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "65893daa00f0ee55e262ee23eeba218ea033a50cfc11339d7fdf4a3cc6719e25"}

{"id": "p_60dd912be121f2be", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 187, "text": "修治城圍，東還樂鄉，貌無矜色，謙沖如常，故得將士歡心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "95e70cbea2ef8c8113784af7a114161a01c31c36baa3b42beeada0aa6dd611ca"}

{"id": "p_63ce45bfb1f255fb", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 188, "text": "聞武昌左部督薛瑩征下獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "892d5c027bf7e4f120e0022b94b41a612b666c64b7826ca51e5d7b22bac0a7f9"}

{"id": "p_fe792dfdcb7fd6ad", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 189, "text": "二年春，就拜大司馬、荊州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "9292e2f5d56811ccc9d4aea3d5f0527666f987d4c4ed6d98e90b9ae46aaf7f18"}

{"id": "p_9b4a44296e167c6c", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 190, "text": "晏及弟景、玄、機、雲、分領抗兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "6ab8831945ebddd809ac50785bc1661789a5d60b5f491b66cbee5f07aa94273a"}

{"id": "p_4c648147df4c7fdd", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 191, "text": "，晉軍伐吳，龍驤將軍王浚順流東下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "bed0aff7856b8108a1a5d6f9dad4be8bf8c903f769eb022c021bc7e0b7702b4c"}

{"id": "p_0c9db6125ef4abf2", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 192, "text": "景字士仁，以尚公主拜騎都尉，封毗陵侯，既領抗兵，拜偏將軍、中夏督，澡身好學，著書數十篇也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "3c04f6975765cd26d30ae095a926fa07c6537ff32b35ca1e18fd9f806c552e6c"}

{"id": "p_1dff8a0bc6811f4d", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 193, "text": "二月壬戌，晏為王浚別軍所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "71a71dd68cef370a6ebdbf31c7c4bd8617b116fe4cf37a96b3ffa7f658ef700a"}

{"id": "p_e1517573184f37b1", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 194, "text": "癸亥，景亦遇害，時年三十一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "fb1945a5ae241ce7871d0a1744205e20e98d908a8fc389e00067ed27e393c44a"}

{"id": "p_bb6d4bcd344e0374", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 195, "text": "景妻，孫皓適妹，與景俱張承外孫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "a7fe2fc4ca9fbdf4968c077a1196a85f9969baef714a957c0419584fbe2481b8"}

{"id": "p_f01c23acf24a1d8f", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 196, "text": "評曰：「劉備天下稱雄，一世所憚，陸遜春秋方壯，威名未著，摧而克之，罔不如志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "7e3e63dfeb305e085ded8eae3b9ebcd0e327fed7878b70f05146e7aed3e3bd24"}

{"id": "p_e397543ec76a2221", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 197, "text": "予既奇遜之謀略，又歎權之識才，所以濟大事也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "0d191c1364ef11b3481f62475834d4342cd83f89175709c51736d56b47d5d4ef"}

{"id": "p_42fc059c603016fb", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 198, "text": "及遜忠誠懇至，憂國亡身，庶幾社稷之臣矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "e9b4c1e209338b518ea840690923ff48b90648b790442db621fbc883b4ed488f"}

{"id": "p_5b40cd68cebdf4c1", "source_id": "src_2ef71ae4ed7e8347", "ordinal": 199, "text": "抗貞亮籌干，咸有父風，奕世載美，具體而微，可謂克構者哉!」", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "4f0fc9ea0021c83f8bc0d9d1dce332c2e1dcbe773c2483127654a95f895d5fba"}

{"id": "p_5824c4be7298e2a0", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_96f643a4052c5fe8", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 1, "text": "魏，以權爲吳王，拜登東中郎將，封萬戶侯，登辭疾不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "8ad38978d616845d67148511cde51f094d4516c7c00fabf187b4aeb64a9f0681"}

{"id": "p_751e5f7a8a3832a4", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 2, "text": "是歲，立登爲太子，選置師傅，銓簡秀士，以爲賔友，於是諸葛恪、張休、顧譚、陳表等以選入，侍講詩書，出從騎射。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "f7cf5f940aceaf8c0b25a9d3b7a1ca5361d90ca7a2c6bc291b77c0aa93a955fe"}

{"id": "p_122e161b20ae39ed", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 3, "text": "權欲登讀《漢書》，習知近代之事，以張昭有師法，重煩勞之，乃令休從昭受讀，還以授登。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "e6ef245ac70cda1f3bcab24d424ed4c02de398cabba97c3b0a2d66dd070d1e18"}

{"id": "p_31c7bb8a8773e16f", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 4, "text": "登待接寮屬，略用布衣之禮，與恪、休、譚等或同輿而載，或共帳而寐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "a6e7fefd32a5f6c911b653cb1f09cad4ca7214c9bad2033496b5b918b0ce6e51"}

{"id": "p_ff0b764ab2097c11", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 5, "text": "太傅張溫言於權曰：「夫中庶子官最親密，切問近對，宜用儁德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "fed8d2e42a27f2aabd29d0a24613ed8bec38cc41373f23806a077d5c7ac33cec"}

{"id": "p_1e58339a162ca24f", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」於是乃用表等爲中庶子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "d614a5048e130ec6e280be2676803044cd8ad6b29ad540ab8979e5792eb7fa32"}

{"id": "p_6455e7d785151a1f", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 7, "text": "後又以庶子禮拘，復令整巾侍坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "00816de0a275599c16bba89305ea2cd3b6e36ad041ca7a93bceba16b0fe8d473"}

{"id": "p_6afe4e25317f1862", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 8, "text": "，權稱尊號，登爲皇太子，以恪爲左輔，休右弼，譚爲輔正，表爲翼正都尉，是爲四友，而謝景、范慎、刁玄、羊衜等皆爲賔客，於是東宮號爲多士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "04cc1aeb6ca1b1a339bbc8cf0d9ea65fcb206857e81ddbf6bed56c6aa866df37"}

{"id": "p_533114096d5a8a3f", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 9, "text": "權遷都建業，徵上大將軍陸遜輔登鎮武昌，領宮府留事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "aff52b87bdf835a7f1a923af91df9c2aaf1268dc225299e404ca5aac88a357ea"}

{"id": "p_878bfb63e8488ba2", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 10, "text": "登或射獵，當由徑道，常遠避良田，不踐苗稼，至所頓息，又擇空閑之地，其不欲煩民如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "2dbb5ec27ad2dc2c98f7c7cc2815b00939162679f0d9cd8aa14cfe5afa670232"}

{"id": "p_bdd73d4aef8827b8", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 11, "text": "嘗乘馬出，有彈丸過，左右求之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "24be6595cef22c565934833122286bbc4370310302e429fe8b31ff25e4f2d2eb"}

{"id": "p_86804a534cfc3d05", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 12, "text": "有一人操彈佩丸，咸以爲是，辭對不服，從者欲捶之，登不聽，使求過丸，比之非類，乃見釋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "df078fa5da86bf335ce2fc68a18940ed98663d99623eb7baab7c09ee67297927"}

{"id": "p_f09df06da213546f", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 13, "text": "又失盛水金馬盂，覺得其主，左右所爲，不忍致罰，呼責數之，長遣歸家，勑親近勿言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "518927e862f96531c350c1340f5c84c36d2ee0fb4c83d76636ae9d5c69e4b2fc"}

{"id": "p_6f77f606698bfa7f", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 14, "text": "後弟慮卒，權爲之降損，登晝夜兼行，到賴鄉，自聞，即時召見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "41e41e4effd6f784ab00847d1ae76ba94c43289bdeaf5a212026fb676ee77929"}

{"id": "p_8a6a889a1b212946", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 15, "text": "見權悲泣，因諫曰：「慮寢疾不起，此乃命也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "5668bfb34231cdd83c342be7471a9cc2837daae61932f2a163d75ee526f33562"}

{"id": "p_058ab4876bffbafd", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 16, "text": "方今朔土未一，四海喁喁，天戴陛下，而以下流之念，減損大官殽饌，過於禮制，臣竊憂惶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "0420067bb636de9beef67c46876724046325b0bdd04d2657da414c1568c36ce7"}

{"id": "p_86df8235bea75236", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 17, "text": "住十餘日，欲遣西還，深自陳乞，以乆離定省，子道有闕，又陳陸遜忠勤，無所顧憂，權遂留焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "b30474341be89ded97c520c797faf3fa7673c4aee3d652abbeeb555561c7c6f1"}

{"id": "p_110ea87a9c8542a7", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 18, "text": "，權征新城，使登居守，總知留事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "7f41956571702004a9a35ef0aa9193291921be1005fdd8873b942a12dcb6d85e"}

{"id": "p_29a3525dc2e31ab0", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 19, "text": "時年穀不豐，頗有盜賊，乃表定科令，所以防禦，甚得止姦之要。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "7b55371a5468980b9b7ce7c7436dd99f4bf730e7929fc6ffbae7f98b2504b859"}

{"id": "p_994d785784349c94", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 20, "text": "初，登所生庶賤，徐夫人少有母養之恩，後徐氏以妬廢處吳，而步夫人最寵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "f6b242c819ad3f76562414dc5589b7553e445c36fcd616cdfff42e583e2ca7d2"}

{"id": "p_a456abca309854e9", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 21, "text": "步氏有賜，登不敢辭，拜受而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "b623c0abed573176f714cb6b19ef2182bb91404cc57d21ffd5324359067927d8"}

{"id": "p_e6f60f12cf7b9f85", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 22, "text": "徐氏使至，所賜衣服，必沐浴服之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "dce49189720fd85fd7f2da8c00f7db8379913bcbc531132922b30961c484d16d"}

{"id": "p_865ae495e86c153c", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 23, "text": "登將拜太子，辭曰：「本立而道生，欲立太子，宜先立-{后}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "d1e3b772a6d803a39b4660f38b6826e1f2500327461960f50e8eec4cefabe701"}

{"id": "p_b2fc87824a877bdf", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 24, "text": "立凡二十一年，年三十三卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "444d1e71515f2682acb7f61cb4eb652f6356dc85b981c4bf3089b369a93ed54e"}

{"id": "p_7de783ff1c49263f", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 25, "text": "臨終，上疏曰：「」旣絕而後書聞，權益以摧感，言則隕涕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "18cf2101330bb9e66bc96db02a5e150c7cc83f0f5b1a12484651fb2de037c20b"}

{"id": "p_67170d4fec7be829", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 26, "text": "謝景時爲豫章太守，不勝哀情，棄官奔赴，拜表自劾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "63a26cdaf8c27c23f51304a504f63ac5defb151449648634297d985ee25f79ba"}

{"id": "p_a548cc1be293e766", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 27, "text": "權曰：「君與太子從事，異於他吏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "f1662be5b30e76d3c903f38faf53d64bdc8f8bc17ad70cd1c629c12cfc69882f"}

{"id": "p_d91c688138b3f187", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」使中使慰勞，聽復本職，發遣還郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "a243efe95593c4639958edd1707477a4f0f34dcc668a3d1089c45718d94a9de4"}

{"id": "p_98b03b1b2cc60e20", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 29, "text": "子璠、希，皆早卒，次子英，封吳侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "6c98093814641def814e3bf124a8f898702953d1e7e68a50a71a0b37e80d58d8"}

{"id": "p_a902a87c3ce326d8", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 30, "text": "，英以大將軍孫峻擅權，謀誅峻，事覺自殺，國除。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "8b960e86de048af11dd2f9e68589ad7b3f9d34b04be72176bd07346d690422ba"}

{"id": "p_77ab37ae8cd395ce", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 31, "text": "謝景者字叔發，南陽宛人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "6feb6062890cb7aa18f90e9604c556a90eea3d45bdc065df96bff2d78a78f3f1"}

{"id": "p_aebda8b572a0ea59", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 32, "text": "在郡有治迹，吏民稱之，以爲前有顧劭，其次即景。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "0feb3fc184f0282d1c0c564ea424b40971eab303667048d61703e2369c46db97"}

{"id": "p_00699a3b9efbebf9", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 33, "text": "少敏惠有才藝，權器愛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "e201c54a05e8c209d79b2fce4f753ba63def8509219c93dcb193451a100fc1ca"}

{"id": "p_659518ab3b002a24", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 34, "text": "後二年，丞相雍等奏慮性聦體達，所尚日新，比方近漢，宜進爵稱王，權未許。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "b8305306a19220e10a83c78ea749eca20adf06d86827d65f5347f2534ce63a6c"}

{"id": "p_7fee115370a0661f", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 35, "text": "乆之，尚書僕射存上疏曰：「」權乃許之，於是假節開府，治半州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "2df6bdf453356431fc9ea22e53f608cb15bf0b4758fd22c17e58efd5c9f1a4fe"}

{"id": "p_2669e88925e037e4", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 36, "text": "慮以皇子之尊，富於春秋，遠近嫌其不能留意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "95a7f36a1805a960e7373f01949cc20be51386e844fa1b8cf3eee27123cbd54d"}

{"id": "p_80b98d4019c2077d", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 37, "text": "及至臨事，遵奉法度，敬納師友，過於衆望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "897180a5550979a32375c5be989bd1834689cccd58cee7d44c4d38aef34171c5"}

{"id": "p_554ae48bf521c2d7", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 38, "text": "少以母王有寵見愛，年十四，爲置宮衞，使中書令闞澤教以書藝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "7df35c13fb2fb106720ae1055f7b67344bcf16adcf2cdcc829c43951109e185c"}

{"id": "p_38d24e72167a298b", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 39, "text": "闞澤爲太傅，薛綜爲少傅，而蔡穎、張純、封俌、嚴維等皆從容侍從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "4dd46e868701c2f3d7db65da9ccd6d1939af75e544ddb9cf9fbeda5f38b5ac4d"}

{"id": "p_8c63815f8f07dbae", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 40, "text": "是時有司頗以條書問事，和以爲姦妄之人，將因事錯意，以生禍心，不可長也，表宜絕之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "f6cc79d5847edcad5a777b5cf069937c6a8a3cea9c2766a06d8bc1b4be385a08"}

{"id": "p_52a2be8ad8081fcc", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 41, "text": "又都督劉寶白庶子丁晏，晏亦白寶，和謂晏曰：「文武在事，當能幾人，因隙構簿，圖相危害，豈有福哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "7ee34096a4324840862f8aed27c5a59162858cbd03513a0ed213776a6903625f"}

{"id": "p_f4a9312570e8a750", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 42, "text": "常言當世士人宜講脩術學，校習射御，以周世務，而但交游博弈以妨事業，非進取之謂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "a0105f8681ee755130836056f8c29f92f01e24919f4ebbd4b167c3fff439a1f9"}

{"id": "p_7097a60be759134d", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 43, "text": "後羣寮侍宴，言及博弈，以爲妨事費日而無益於用，勞精損思而終無所成，非所以進德脩業，積累功緒者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "99719593300b63d47292c54161a6f377bfe326095d264157a60571936df875dc"}

{"id": "p_8e450588b942ee81", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 44, "text": "且志士愛日惜力，君子慕其大者，高山景行，恥非其次。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "b47b93e5d2f590a3aa1008e65abc9a19b22d21e434443febc3d01361e2acf140"}

{"id": "p_3fe9e751396d92ca", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 45, "text": "夫以天地長乆，而人居其間，有白駒過隙之喻，年齒一暮，榮華不再。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "e58926784e3c68505b50e6244677173429da41f587bde78cd5e59bd0f055aff0"}

{"id": "p_2ac612850368e7bb", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 46, "text": "凡所患者，在於人情所不能絕，誠能絕無益之欲以奉德義之塗，棄不急之務以脩功業之基，其於名行，豈不善哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "0db7c9b2f7a9c3ddac85715c7bf7ac5b75c7feeb7951ed64ed25c92f8c2b6c71"}

{"id": "p_35959b80c792cb81", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 47, "text": "夫人情猶不能無嬉娛，嬉娛之好，亦在於飲宴琴書射御之間，何必博弈，然後爲歡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "b2793683818c000d7a1cb09e47d6b2a875b6b71bd8be33bdc76cc1ce8bf8c22c"}

{"id": "p_6230a42ba9786777", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 48, "text": "乃命侍坐者八人，各著論以矯之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "cb719e97d531901857cb8e051cf90ee13093a9e9eb0d4f73e24fc2b9c1656da4"}

{"id": "p_e1d3ebac3c0f5d7d", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 49, "text": "於是中庶子韋曜退而論奏，和以示賔客。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "3b6857d2c0422d2b0efbc726363bcaccb685c77ce9a46d995df5b5e9229b5a1a"}

{"id": "p_095e1c42c11241a4", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 50, "text": "時蔡穎好弈，直事在署者頗斆焉，故以此諷之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "e41c2eebcfd09871d8ecbfe3af5263839af537e51077eb0c0d900aaa6dbfa54d"}

{"id": "p_8e4379e8b08cf97e", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 51, "text": "是後王夫人與全公主有隙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "8090c8ce81dc0f94e3cce8e95fe821d177db676782bc577bdadec6a7833e8c4d"}

{"id": "p_787acf7357403a05", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 52, "text": "權嘗寢疾，和祠祭於廟，和妃叔父張休居近廟，邀和過所居。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "7842a692092878b50f80daa0c327195dc906ed79c22740b829f3a9c59980e87c"}

{"id": "p_01a21151421461e4", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 53, "text": "全公主使人覘視，因言太子不在廟中，專就妃家計議；又言王夫人見上寢疾，有喜色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "eef5f8e8ca4c043ed27acca5258806f142bd703243e07b82b4813f9febf69bce"}

{"id": "p_ce64207b9253c51c", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 54, "text": "權由是發怒，夫人憂死，而和寵稍損，懼於廢黜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "ec6658cc5c17fdb338e7bc92ef65d81de0570c967f435c49d327b808d2c49b67"}

{"id": "p_d9b2533409df6b80", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 55, "text": "魯王霸覬覦滋甚，陸遜、吾粲、顧譚等數陳適庶之義，理不可奪，全寄、楊笁爲魯王霸支黨，譖愬日興。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "920f2365fab1f3c5a27f7cafc34caf5f438b01e2a91e626ae6df6fa4dc4510f6"}

{"id": "p_c2a5322bc4350f84", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 56, "text": "權沈吟者歷年，後遂幽閉和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "395bbb4c374756a0f9079f10e0bb3f443cd7a96a97feb4a11db8d9a9c569c558"}

{"id": "p_637796f7c70b0c9a", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 57, "text": "於是驃騎將軍朱據、尚書僕射屈晃率諸將吏泥頭自縛，連日詣闕請和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "26ec4d657e27296f5d38f477594cc624f9620c64a1224f162b9e8187186f6e59"}

{"id": "p_e5dbf29d0c6fb389", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 58, "text": "權登白爵觀見，甚惡之，勑據、晃等無事忩忩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "5443ebd4691cc15287fc66f73b2ea008cd69b798b6cfb9e2f0cffdd7325f880d"}

{"id": "p_035241ef982c5801", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 59, "text": "權欲廢和立亮，無難督陳正、五營督陳象上書，稱引晉獻公殺申生，立奚齊，晉國擾亂，又據、晃固諫不止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "7e8ebe91493bf46af1eff8e067eb7cd18335fd22dcd0657caa5a3db32e0beff1"}

{"id": "p_3cf808dde1ac6e3a", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 60, "text": "權大怒，族誅正、象，據、晃牽入殿，杖一百，竟徙和於故鄣，羣司坐諫誅放者十數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "be10d8092191177c020830d472c54abe2c779ad340b2d2ffb0a9e72b33d17ec8"}

{"id": "p_6172ebc976a8b4cf", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 61, "text": "正月，封和爲南陽王，遣之長沙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "1286249d492f0cf9b19a5e2cabd58d91a9a19a496f0466d2c10f2348f5481407"}

{"id": "p_ef3a60cb4eed5072", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 62, "text": "四月，權薨，諸葛恪秉政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "48206279b70cd6f056d3af39c0604cd4f665f0d099cda75fdd41a46c3f0fc8e2"}

{"id": "p_211dd9ed70a0ae8b", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 63, "text": "妃使黃門陳遷之建業上疏中宮，并致問於恪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "14c0d324fd36fe7d3a70af73d1d70d14e7acbfe824998eaba91ac501b4b40a22"}

{"id": "p_eecbe3978ca863c1", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 64, "text": "臨去，恪謂遷曰：「爲我達妃，期當使勝他人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "85bb56fe9e3ab37ab38c7402b7a104f52815e3c82cc2b70ceec9badf6af5770e"}

{"id": "p_96f3abe52a0c6474", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 65, "text": "又恪有徙都意，使治武昌宮，民間或言欲迎和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "c7a014de9539cfc9421dbfa481e058170de0bf623eb51bc987c740a1aa770fab"}

{"id": "p_7232fbda5aa691d2", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 66, "text": "及恪被誅，孫峻因此奪和璽綬，徙新都，又遣使者賜死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "1f9358bd0af5eacf0e7c88267d1a07d6879accf3f79854b8c6675b0c4b86dacb"}

{"id": "p_cfb1214bef181a24", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 67, "text": "和與妃張辭別，張曰：「吉凶當相隨，終不獨生活也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "a59c6ca20543461d8edcdad5f0dee23c933ee6bc2b91cfb218e5174f59ab846f"}

{"id": "p_0e2092a1dc8a4e2a", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 68, "text": "孫休立，封和子皓爲烏程侯，自新都之本國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "89e5d04de1c16eac5874e2a463152a22df9c69cbf14a5479287958fcb9c34c38"}

{"id": "p_a456a885a45b7699", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 69, "text": "休薨，皓即阼，其年追謚父和曰文皇帝，改葬明陵，置園邑二百家，令、丞奉守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "7370617425f24636ce886a48d1eb4373d3233164ae24d86f2f3e463c10a5f46c"}

{"id": "p_d49ec35ea7590532", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 70, "text": "後年正月，又分吳郡、丹楊九縣爲吳興郡，治烏程，置太守，四時奉祠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "5ab703b64c56b3deb1e286e2215a57ab5ec93fd6f2cc3a39ee9dcfcd7520dbbd"}

{"id": "p_4ffa42cbb456b151", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 71, "text": "七月，使守大匠薛珝營立寢堂，號曰清廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "9bc880cfb04774a8683a44412059e7a256ba6377f3b9de746acb2cdd937ca8d7"}

{"id": "p_61f66b964d155328", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 72, "text": "十二月，遣守丞相孟仁、太常姚信等備官寮中軍步騎二千人，以靈輿法駕，東迎神於明陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "ff0a039e477e7724e6b6375eb41032ea77a76c29f92755903ea414713e1f768c"}

{"id": "p_41ea5f01f3939af9", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 73, "text": "靈輿當至，使丞相陸凱奉三牲祭於近郊，皓於金城外露宿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "1de68bc21894ca3d3c9d95b3e1d608c99bf45fd2e4947b570f84671260ec6352"}

{"id": "p_3bd0539770d41006", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 74, "text": "其翌日，拜廟薦祭，歔欷悲感。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "36a673739a4ba527447314580bcd3adf008a327febf51363631e35e18c7df475"}

{"id": "p_19debb715efbe076", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 75, "text": "比七日三祭，倡技晝夜娛樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "8bad39c0ed08ef870a0124232fa8ae6199dcde21afc47b9681854cfcb77fabb2"}

{"id": "p_c08585dfe89ec3d0", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 76, "text": "有司奏言「祭不欲數，數則黷，宜以禮斷情」，然後止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "94edea33688f0911c2d84fb48a405edb2f6891e6be1e6a3013fab2309c76ea41"}

{"id": "p_86bcbee7e6b4974d", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 77, "text": "霸爲魯王，寵愛崇特，與和無殊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "17164ddfe07a165f3bdd0f3297ee51292793036c8c487cb7057b0c259c603dd9"}

{"id": "p_3fc2decc7222421e", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 78, "text": "頃之，和、霸不穆之聲聞於權耳，權禁斷往來，假以精學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "03788e483c84dd686d5b8c4fb8509cf0cff2785caf0cea727ea5ef53e8091d0c"}

{"id": "p_bf31a97dfbc3f5fc", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 79, "text": "督軍使者羊衜上疏曰：「」", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "9f19b25413ecd2c44cdcf4e23553a0a4a86d898ed4e8fdf4527865b6f7b60f1a"}

{"id": "p_6d08073aea0957f9", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 80, "text": "時全寄、吳安、孫奇、楊笁等陰共附霸，圖危太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "9f5a63e78580e68d5bea2c3593a11f8d182935faece43b9013b4e7c91aca9b2f"}

{"id": "p_9682b3cc5399ae68", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 81, "text": "譖毀旣行，太子以敗，霸亦賜死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "47e06fa5db0c7f248213262d34c419a575806f37cdc00403a08372e2be62f77b"}

{"id": "p_7582ff52ec6dad4a", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 82, "text": "流笁屍于江，兄穆以數諫戒笁，得免大辟，猶徙南州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "1ecc09d7ee696f4bf5f2a684f60e06034318d6ef11d55369a800603fdcedd9c0"}

{"id": "p_b8102de98bf897b3", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 83, "text": "霸賜死後，又誅寄、安、奇等，咸以黨霸搆和故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "a39420e8c36c81f519009715d0966c39c610ae223ea8feac333640ea360b569f"}

{"id": "p_8f27986fb412de0e", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 84, "text": "五鳳中，封基爲吳侯，壹宛陵侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "9e82dc8e7a353425a04b29f61ddad4e29c94b57fff468731ebbca0252c01f2cf"}

{"id": "p_075a60000e1c00c7", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 85, "text": "基侍孫亮在內，，盜乘御馬，收付獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "f2153ebcceec55b5108fd0d380d6a761ef96f7f3e2d1ab589f222527f04ec0fb"}

{"id": "p_4aa50d87fcc0555b", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 86, "text": "亮問侍中刁玄曰：「盜乘御馬罪云何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "cdb3844685de024f8313dc6781624271c202537dd1b071c3b53808ebff2a6a43"}

{"id": "p_9fdf7c1883c3d96f", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 87, "text": "然魯王早終，惟陛下哀原之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "07ef6673c87005fad273564bfcb2b5c78f78d866c16a9d07507804f8dae02442"}

{"id": "p_7b8eea947561c4a6", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 88, "text": "」亮曰：「法者，天下所共，何得阿以親親故邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "d484c00e85c63244f04fb95e89dfc289c0aa1f182869e3189a5183ef4481cf69"}

{"id": "p_529597bf1a2e1abd", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 89, "text": "當思惟可以釋此者，柰何以情相迫乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "4efd789fde4e42756cef7115840f570ea1816efd849574f724ff11477f7aa8cf"}

{"id": "p_084d65dbbd541720", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 90, "text": "」玄曰：「舊赦有大小，或天下，亦有千里、五百里赦，隨意所及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "d1f4459599223c6b7ee1449a372ae85056802753f82540fa5bff20680efbe92c"}

{"id": "p_4c8f203395fc6b7e", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 91, "text": "」亮曰：「解人不當爾邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "42dceaf2a415aca9941d012c7b7727663bb5c9b6c627b948c41efef69dbf55f9"}

{"id": "p_777f66de533ad821", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 92, "text": "孫皓即位，追和、霸舊隙，削基、壹爵土，與祖母謝姬俱徙會稽烏傷縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "4667dad0dd38ca842de344def78e1d90f3b462d0f3d8059d004d5d077bae0812"}

{"id": "p_7077bbf8b0e72e5f", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 93, "text": "孫奮字子揚，霸弟也，母曰仲姬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "54e3249282ccdccd4e7ac42c489d63efe1a30fe524023c3d6ecec38eca6fed25"}

{"id": "p_9ae8c669b7483b81", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 94, "text": "權薨，太傅諸葛恪不欲諸王處江濵兵馬之地，徙奮於豫章。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "c161f88c1b941a883622edb335e9476d027dd7675c6204ac3bd211ab7fa58c9e"}

{"id": "p_0f3327eea3b3807b", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 95, "text": "奮怒，不從命，又數越法度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "4a20cb1cfb5e698062d10ad86c68ed747a322637bf0ebba55d882e63f30efba2"}

{"id": "p_764bd6d394d7dc14", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 96, "text": "奮得牋懼，遂移南昌，游獵彌甚，官屬不堪命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "353abe4d815f0645934af09c76d37c0f1804fc68148f451e71ad04f2de013e20"}

{"id": "p_e119250c10a35033", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 97, "text": "及恪誅，奮下住蕪湖，欲至建業觀變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "8051b18ebf357f9208dcc43acc8a4b56b5e891d4bddd3d38e3cf4b8fa32f192d"}

{"id": "p_816447ed02bbb380", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 98, "text": "傅相謝慈等諫奮，奮殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "84159a2732a7900011f6bf788c978192520a4fe838c7d32dfa295c32f0d74bf9"}

{"id": "p_126549de21a8d300", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 99, "text": "皓哀念過甚，朝夕哭臨，數月不出，由是民間或謂皓死，訛言奮與上虞侯奉當有立者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "31fb2829f4da4b1c5ab9e1f260819d733e8c46913b5ccec794a4e9e8152111e3"}

{"id": "p_05955d59e61ce512", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 100, "text": "奮母仲姬墓在豫章，豫章太守張俊疑其或然，掃除墳塋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "cf84266af753823c184ab2459ab74cb8c5e33a4ac2bdd2e10e92a6cd762718a1"}

{"id": "p_3d08620d99408067", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 101, "text": "皓聞之，車裂俊，夷三族，誅奮及其五子，國除。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "d9cdb9955fef4021c44efb0ffe0c976a55e0e8839bfb8af4995385cc03ec4bcc"}

{"id": "p_fb9eaf77481e4fcf", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 102, "text": "評曰：孫登居心所存，足爲茂美之德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "d3ea471fe685bf2dbb6d06f19a38c5f57e264d2b555771c2f116977616b11069"}

{"id": "p_f411253d1f0e4523", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 103, "text": "慮、和並有好善之姿，規自砥礪，或短命早終，或不得其死，哀哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "02e7b31b1d6cfdf410b802c8bd2a280b494e065a575a1cd4cf2febb7a0616311"}

{"id": "p_a9c88fc745598d3a", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 104, "text": "霸以庶干適，奮不遵軌度，固取危亡之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "8ab53f17f81e895bc83f4da2e2f2b20eecad4633b0917eba54e9e814fcb89222"}

{"id": "p_5b57ce3e9ea224c5", "source_id": "src_ab68ed414415530a", "ordinal": 105, "text": "然奮之誅夷，橫遇飛禍矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "b8f69e37a9b1081109636116360e05f9583e28d5715e5f0dde94e1b6022687a7"}

{"id": "p_d9c9fc2d3a7dbb4b", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_1a24ab8117c48c8e", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 1, "text": "賀齊字公苗，會稽山陰人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "e138a7a9f3db9edc5a38c07517592df417cfeb9d6bf0526df46a2492b24314c3"}

{"id": "p_d0c9f8785fed0a29", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 2, "text": "縣吏斯從輕俠為奸，齊欲治之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "51f772d454cda62952603e859f4087321ffef837ea185e6de0c27f9650883437"}

{"id": "p_71247974da0f882b", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 3, "text": "主簿諫曰：“從，縣大族，山越所附，今日治之，明日寇至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "9910af1ec16464d5332a744a303de95f2053cbf1957df1d025069ad039c13382"}

{"id": "p_cf9a8d86001ff4a4", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 4, "text": "從族黨遂相糾合，眾千餘人，舉兵攻縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "8b2c9c6cf1ecdb77f8cfdbad7d86b54e3ae75af194ff9bc7805f4085fe399027"}

{"id": "p_dc9c7b70e6221a68", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 5, "text": "齊率吏民，開城門突擊，大破之，威震山越。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "472a788fc2b438feff9233062731a432ca37e763748387c3412ee68969cf28e3"}

{"id": "p_4bd4b00b1f68b884", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 6, "text": "後太末、豐浦民反，轉守太末長，誅惡養善，期用盡平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "07ccc6f6a0649e95b85a782e769072a922ff88cf985cb2b03da133edb6bbe5de"}

{"id": "p_2e15a1c27f1211ef", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 7, "text": "時王朗奔東冶，侯官長商升為朗起兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "2bab2daf49343bf9d956b6577bd30e38d51af0a9c779e7b43fd543356a56f92e"}

{"id": "p_ed36718fd0fff99c", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 8, "text": "策遣永寧長韓晏領南部都尉，將兵討升，以齊為永寧長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "5ccd2835ccbdd2125a3e0430b24e73ddc0c25cc7f179d4818fffae8cdf178ca8"}

{"id": "p_23f79bf54673b660", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 9, "text": "晏為升所敗，齊又代晏領都尉事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "363c3486c4fb9479f5dcdbd712cd9b1ca73d09199a45629b0cbf6b299eb654f6"}

{"id": "p_4060c9b27f04e923", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 10, "text": "齊因告喻，為陳禍福，升遂送上印綬，出捨求降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "5759bce333ad4838500d632c467de602f1c9214795aef4aa45f8df53c7159e49"}

{"id": "p_cd32ad81eb84d3c1", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 11, "text": "賊帥張雅、詹強等不願升降，反共殺升，雅稱無上將軍，強稱會稽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "6ff328e56b2c0784df947ea1ba7a85981a885dcc117df795fc126da07d6a3ed8"}

{"id": "p_3224d8ae7b18f55e", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 12, "text": "賊盛兵少，未足以討，齊住軍息兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "c6725afe7eba255b8ef89aa8e086b031d7ceac9444c87fca9a02e666dd851e60"}

{"id": "p_b24713ea61516534", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 13, "text": "雅與女婿何雄爭勢兩乖，齊令越人因事交構。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "3b4603acc5812c9fbf12a3a0cb99a2d00736fdf3f55ffa437946b8fd4333e16f"}

{"id": "p_de2a4a2298f900d7", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 14, "text": "齊乃進討，一戰大破雅，強黨震懼，率眾出降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "ea826d6ff023ed84fa86ed855f5760a723e3c6cdd80ceea47a03641bf7b73a9e"}

{"id": "p_e13492ce457e4de2", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 15, "text": "而建安、漢興、南平復亂，齊進兵建安，立都尉府，是歲八年也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "db131640d796aa7192590c0f26b42d1a43d5cd516cf0fc4caa38c1059bdcf0df"}

{"id": "p_531add484db0fbd1", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 16, "text": "郡發屬縣五千兵，各使本縣長將之，皆受齊節度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "9c12459960007a206636c3a8ed9a506c2e89b970f694b74a57c33b9a341369d0"}

{"id": "p_efe73bb216056c08", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 17, "text": "賊洪明、洪進、苑御、吳免、華當等五人，率各萬戶，連屯漢興，吳五六千戶別屯大潭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "0ccfa89f43872572f8529334e0a7817d942b676e292b0c19b8d3cd148fbb3efe"}

{"id": "p_4aff1e3090ed3c2a", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 18, "text": "鄒臨六千戶別屯蓋竹，大潭同出餘汗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "a7b6fd5be1c30da435ed14aacdcfd4328498eb4cc2d7b5c412645b35ac8bd928"}

{"id": "p_255c80f38437144d", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 19, "text": "齊以為賊眾兵少，深入無繼，恐為所斷，令松陽長丁蕃留備余汗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "594083840e734320192bf09f552b1e179b89f71daaeb33dc45d009f02a370a70"}

{"id": "p_0dad94dfd0f7a84b", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 20, "text": "蕃本與齊鄰城，恥見部伍，辭不肯留。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "f4babd6e946252e415a61cf4d5c0d1d17fdc02510519f48ec704401d8f51b5d8"}

{"id": "p_c6a68f23401f5747", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 21, "text": "齊乃斬蕃，於是軍中震慄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "3c0df72b581c0fbb0eb575b8f4d66b99f5a994243ed90c78a981bd987fa77f3d"}

{"id": "p_7331a7aa31f78389", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 22, "text": "遂分兵留備，進討明等，連大破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "cff104efa3a1cb43fa68c0673785056a064458dc2290aebb1c6a74b9bcf266c3"}

{"id": "p_0b1b0878591ade24", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 23, "text": "臨陳斬明，其免、當、進、御皆降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "6a51242698b23a81fdefeae9be86fcbbe2c5f08e99e4756d9b25d7a00c07cc65"}

{"id": "p_c92dbe988991e07f", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 24, "text": "轉擊蓋竹，軍向大潭，三將又降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "3a1a78f9549f67109e7427ccdfa409179fe1874d5dc1c3e58a12adc46a9ebe6d"}

{"id": "p_2ed89997e8c80c11", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 25, "text": "凡討治斬首六千級，名帥盡擒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "bc859ab8168e4f85ac1e6cc1d890f74cb9b25e09dc7c443d48123d48a3cefb37"}

{"id": "p_818d27aa9f4961c4", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 26, "text": "復立縣邑，料出兵萬人，拜為平東校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "533edab00e9dc0b9ca0e8608f3ea85c654b50d389c1aee2ecc52f61aead9b8a8"}

{"id": "p_579022d047bbeb49", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 27, "text": "十年，轉討上饒，分以為建平縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "a28c59ab0f3f818a814b309333be6ffa2f3657c04bb0ab10e808464547037b30"}

{"id": "p_98b3d1411401943c", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 28, "text": "十三年，遷威武中郎將，討丹陽黟、歙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "41381bfc4fc9c14168bb09988742fc2ca0b3f96d7ddcafde8125ca3c4fc76270"}

{"id": "p_4e48aeee913a4c7d", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 29, "text": "時武強、葉鄉、東陽、豐浦四鄉先降，齊表言以葉鄉為始新縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "0932cf7c881f7d022a184e39d48c225653151040f852e3abf3d0dca77cbbe9b6"}

{"id": "p_b6746485726279df", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 30, "text": "而歙賊帥金奇萬戶屯安勒山，毛甘萬戶屯烏聊山，黟帥陳僕，祖山等二萬戶屯林歷山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "5f54f2d2f60703e4225fa4ad6b02c6611e6394161824dfe3a18a869ea24bc399"}

{"id": "p_c4dbbf3277015ac9", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 31, "text": "林歷山四面壁立，高數十丈，逕路危狹，不容刀楯，賊臨高下石，不可得攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "055d827c25952c12f7081e26102e37b5dd2a121e6191270085f036450a7beada"}

{"id": "p_e433732563da4176", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 32, "text": "齊身出周行，觀視形便，陰募輕捷士，為作鐵弋，密於隱險賊所不備處，以戈拓斬山為緣道，夜令潛上，乃多縣布以援下人，得上百數人，四面流布，俱鳴鼓角，齊勒兵待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "a322a7fc43b423b6fc75ec90a00574bb25039fe393cc2d3985f3965e1e7b29d7"}

{"id": "p_3d621b59f842ccbc", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 33, "text": "賊夜聞鼓聲四合，謂大軍悉已得上，驚懼惑亂，不知所為，守路備險者，皆走還依眾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "2eeb6e4fe1ed0da373a283c0f1169ee8c58f2c334579cdca25086cc884bec119"}

{"id": "p_3fdb4a105c7c0579", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 34, "text": "大軍因是得上，大破僕等，其餘皆降，凡斬首七千。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "938a5c4b4ff52eb203986a88b507d6f3f32fb29f7fc3931130048528b3c3da1f"}

{"id": "p_a54ae9c01da570a4", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 35, "text": "齊復表分歙為新定；黎陽、休陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "ce567070bae082b3849b139dfc9d81260c7d2d6e70d1540ad5fdedf7e282bbe1"}

{"id": "p_2f48efc665b554e1", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 36, "text": "權遂割為新都郡，齊為太守，立府於始新，加偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "fdb1ccd4d4067e20dc58fc75c0967c1eb22dbaa00d4440aff1e10c9e802a2a49"}

{"id": "p_6103b39e7f3a0157", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 37, "text": "十六年，吳郡餘杭民郎稚合宗起賊，復數千人，齊出討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "d3c82b85541ec7c1c6daa1673ba203af02ccc15313b8712a3168732d639bb46c"}

{"id": "p_d049e68a144c8586", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 38, "text": "即復破稚，表言分餘杭為臨水縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "c217640a5a06460c31b10e7181cb6d3fa54d1a58c8243031fd4da16d6132ba68"}

{"id": "p_18fbc0cd5a8b945e", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 39, "text": "被命詣所在，及當還郡，權出祖道，作樂舞象。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "ba5bab00894c2f840c0cd86dc75e78adfb96d13f1ae90c826cdef0c986d88ac5"}

{"id": "p_70a26042171d0a30", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 40, "text": "賜齊軿車駿馬，罷坐住駕，使齊就車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "c8bce84e62466759e8dbd791bcbfb72c5cfa7dc3b563f1d7a271d74f572c90f0"}

{"id": "p_c8a20b23c1cb0289", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 41, "text": "齊辭不敢，權使左右扶齊上車，令導吏卒兵騎，如在郡儀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "522a2db98bea389ac8c065af2e8eb67249732869e13cb385c8a8ddf26a9ad967"}

{"id": "p_3ae5b64e94d2d929", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 42, "text": "權望之笑曰：\"人當努力，非積行累勤，此不可得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "013451a0a577276a1601ce905fe00f19300dbc486e372e4b81336282a7a42500"}

{"id": "p_47496ac8a28c0f53", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 43, "text": "十八年，豫章東部民彭材、李玉、王海等起為賊亂，眾萬餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "733b3b4948b7d4c0d1139d359dbb1751bd20f60c720614765d4f137b50ac946e"}

{"id": "p_fa75aeb4ca779229", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 44, "text": "齊討平之，誅其首惡，餘皆降服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "4981af4ac2dfb1d47cf6765e67c37cc42e9fc6fb54c362e1f7e246a6c4dbbdee"}

{"id": "p_6b9f2fcab0307de8", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 45, "text": "揀其精健為兵，次為縣戶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "14dbfd2a20dda85143446b5e6bda0c1914b925c16d347d602a11328ea04d36f0"}

{"id": "p_c7d54a7ff01b7b8a", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 46, "text": "時城中出戰，徐盛被創失矛，齊引兵拒擊，得盛所失。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "33e475762abc72c86e00e10dbf5658a719b1237e02210c1b0d6147b157b168b0"}

{"id": "p_c5d773e713252da8", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 47, "text": "二十一年，鄱陽民尤突受曹公印綬，化民為賊，陵陽、始安、涇縣皆與突相應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "64eb61230e0cd2c1beab91df48441d2df47ee1bfba1d4c69f6cb5599d7a84fd7"}

{"id": "p_fcd5c34caa8892a4", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 48, "text": "齊與陸遜討破突，斬首數千，餘黨震服，丹楊三縣皆降，料得精兵八千人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "da8f769e5852d4a1dbe2fb58fce2a7365221ea163b6f067f73cc0d128cd1bcf3"}

{"id": "p_db78419be813adfd", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 49, "text": "拜安東將軍，封山陰侯，出鎮江上，督扶州以上至皖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "f3beffe67629c670445313c1dd08d269cc819bb151af139ea1e4f828165a7555"}

{"id": "p_b999edac59024198", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 50, "text": "齊以道遠後至，因住新市為拒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "e3974905dd7e13c8e806d2c555836a3cfd1bb6b0764fa8423c4b669418668d3a"}

{"id": "p_43277c86cf4ccbd1", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 51, "text": "會洞口諸軍遭風流溺，所亡中分，將士失色，賴齊未濟，偏軍獨全，諸將倚以為勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "d0d61cb2dba3f67695f13d0a88afff1bd370bf1f968ad13d1e2db62fa4614c08"}

{"id": "p_d95283805b378553", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 52, "text": "齊性奢綺，尤好軍事，兵甲器械極為精好，所乘船雕刻丹鏤，青蓋絳襜，干櫓戈矛，葩爪文畫，弓弩矢箭，咸取上材，蒙衝鬥艦之屬，望之若山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "1738940a425e747e3f664033aeb994267ef5132cac4a1d3d385a8e52a6c01ea7"}

{"id": "p_7b60d0ed77c1d091", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 53, "text": "遷後將軍，假節領徐州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "46d106fc8162de7e686be4b30acf34907fb9657c3641995f86d9b8ea23500f6d"}

{"id": "p_69a6fc9e8623a000", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 54, "text": "初，晉宗為戲口將，以眾叛如魏，還為蘄春太守，圖襲安樂，取其保質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "c792082ff0f424a6dc9fcddfc5c1cf99bd024fe8c5f6ee0cadb2ab065f1f5d84"}

{"id": "p_473e1beb9fb7b265", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 55, "text": "權以為恥忿，因軍初罷，六月盛夏、出其不意，詔齊督麋芳、鮮于丹等襲蘄春，遂生虜宗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "e59b56321e035ecaf4d443a82ce8c01dfff5ec0138124b59c2b853433ca87c4c"}

{"id": "p_13199f2341ea97e1", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 56, "text": "後四年卒，子達及弟景皆有令名，為佳將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "70b2982ffd26430f0ebf68af83940c0b31eea7016a120709978c2d9bbcf94d28"}

{"id": "p_8e6021a40231e3c6", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 57, "text": "全琮字子璜，吳郡錢唐人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "7aa97b7dae99eca8fb032307e97f901fa63f999603faeb3ef6973bfd114260d5"}

{"id": "p_f1953423ae5b1715", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 58, "text": "補尚書郎右丞，董卓之亂，棄官歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "e5e79275ae8bc9f678c06721788d929b8897ec6583cdae29d017b7cb499e995f"}

{"id": "p_d93bb50f86e1a8e9", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 59, "text": "州辟別駕從事，詔書就拜會稽東部都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "39470a9488059534bafd09a78651c35956d871adc3e649125e01c82ea99e9529"}

{"id": "p_dfa4421861bf19bf", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 60, "text": "孫策到吳，柔舉兵先附，策表柔為丹楊都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "2e017b38d11c2721b3247ae87ee56e55bf47970a1ea6c7515c10e1a7703ce94e"}

{"id": "p_3ad965a39e5c42ec", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 61, "text": "孫權為車騎將軍，以柔為長史，徙桂陽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "08ccea5eb32805089f0fda8a918658f6b759740d369f94dd10c79ac0cbc16c81"}

{"id": "p_78c3826f222fa9fa", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 62, "text": "柔嘗使琮齎米數千斛到吳，有所市易。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "e0b4d2568bf041854c9408cf81c0cfb811370390f971e8038a88b37d46dd826b"}

{"id": "p_f22aa438824c0770", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 63, "text": "琮至，皆散用，空船而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "f055e746fe4e33532ca577905522788af5cdcb181fdb6d083d6dfbe03b9d9b23"}

{"id": "p_f4a9331da165b219", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 64, "text": "柔大怒，琮頓首曰：“愚以所市非急，而士大夫方有倒縣之患，故便振贍，不及啟報。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "d2d78ed7b291d9eb102cc657980c9e2ce471f58cb2b5d5d4d3507f6105bf2b65"}

{"id": "p_af5290e3a7b8033c", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 65, "text": "是時中州士人避亂而南，依琮居者以百數，琮傾家給濟，與共有無，遂顯名遠近。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "f543f7104073d92d07a370bf77c50b1803e4bf70a48d5b3314327dfb622ab454"}

{"id": "p_6c96b554c79425e3", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 66, "text": "後權以為奮威校尉，授兵數千人，使討山越。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "a0730933d6da8a6e3a14cfbc82b69706d1bc7024496bbca5d1e206985ffd2673"}

{"id": "p_ba20baa2d3a35c37", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 67, "text": "因開募召，得精兵萬餘人，出屯牛渚，稍遷偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "2069ed13a45302378d1de37b9a9e36a7f25082e11f6d3a8fd40dfe4b5158fc40"}

{"id": "p_d5606c06ca295d9b", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 68, "text": "，劉備將關羽圍樊、襄陽，琮上疏陳羽可討之計，權時已與呂蒙陰議襲之，恐事洩，故寢琮表不答。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "0ca539843cf01d5950ba5d25bb075c4b74e818231dbdcff7f70a897750be3dba"}

{"id": "p_e722416012ac6cd4", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 69, "text": "顧謂琮曰：“君前陳此，孤雖不相答，今日之捷，抑亦君之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "9ef820239dae69ac44bf9a8bf5abb95aa7bf5e3aba2cf3be4dc7e0d8e4788e30"}

{"id": "p_0107dad20da0ae52", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 70, "text": "，魏以舟軍大出洞口，權使呂範督諸將拒之，軍營相望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "f4d06169436a217e04ab70b44b8f8727af7611c6a88f698e977f826586b52e63"}

{"id": "p_a3e2c07ee55e80fd", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 71, "text": "敵數以輕船抄擊，琮常帶甲仗兵，伺候不休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "7490776024f814bbeb074aa64795368bf39d7cf0b32e9d382c1ed8ab92b72e73"}

{"id": "p_391f7ab4a6e73408", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 72, "text": "頃之，敵數千人出江中，琮擊破之，梟其將軍尹盧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "1b34d58bc39fcacee375687bb2ec0a731a5cc65d0f5e906041b0094165f52dee"}

{"id": "p_2efb7688e4c6e5a4", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 73, "text": "遷琮綏南將軍，進封錢唐侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "2050ab28028dd0aa98d3e430530abd9975a87d9c92e4272b2d13f4a176bcf8f2"}

{"id": "p_665fa9e586f02e97", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 74, "text": "七年，權到皖，使琮與輔國將軍陸遜擊曹休，破之於石亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "27551d1c3d3f0ac21a068c70b767fe190c560e24b1463189c5ce15e95f8c7bca"}

{"id": "p_766c7e909774a6fe", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 75, "text": "是時丹楊、吳、會山民復為寇賊，攻沒屬縣，權分三郡險地為東安郡，琮領太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "4c9d6bba71e8f443f07f80e9127d0cadcb23bfd4bf191c9f9baf406c75b9f42c"}

{"id": "p_7c860e9ef0c50d7c", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 76, "text": "招誘降附，數年中，得萬餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "e2de76a720257c61cd193ac600e85fe546490a0d7ac8ef7f5b84c511c4caa05a"}

{"id": "p_87fc8b001fae9916", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 77, "text": "權召琮還牛渚，罷東安郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "891dc56533903670183b85dd4779a85ce17efccffc213e53e8b9232b8bbb7c2d"}

{"id": "p_afb0c24fa0dcfcf0", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 78, "text": "，遷衛將軍、左護軍、徐州牧，尚公主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "e415f4d870fd8654a5454ddb77d1aebf27ed0994e70f0e2a378827603668071f"}

{"id": "p_e8a1279abf913e28", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 79, "text": "，督步騎五萬征六安，六安民皆散走，諸將欲分兵捕之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "25b14883e14d5ffd56107c55c424f205f66cb7f672588b480ea007eab4d2d2d5"}

{"id": "p_a6f46e232df6c117", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 80, "text": "琮曰：“夫乘危僥倖，舉不百全者，非國家大體也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "a4c534e83529d31377f3223093c8c807e7e3d1b319e2f0fa70a637eec4dc7822"}

{"id": "p_7343089378f2a98f", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 81, "text": "今分兵捕民，得失相半，豈可謂全哉?縱有所獲，猶不足以弱敵而副國望也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "e33b34e0490dd7358f5ba535c9caef78e5c1d5976422304e028a5f050c9cfdc7"}

{"id": "p_2866903665f39157", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 82, "text": "如或邂逅，虧損非小，與其獲罪，琮寧以身受之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "dd709c8ad7873c03f195275755b04d17862c3d10c238a1fc294ff822ecd61d86"}

{"id": "p_73fd8861cbed8585", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 83, "text": "為人恭順，善於承顏納規，言辭未嘗切迕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "f3b934c8a5a7761090779a6d2b96ea6f6c756696867320d083b0e57930c49a1f"}

{"id": "p_4a27fe80194b2ef6", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 84, "text": "初，權將圍珠崖及夷州，皆先問琮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "62f340c33ce7c1e29961b0f82c2b86dd0932f403bb75cc91f70ca3adfc8ebe22"}

{"id": "p_754e8508a5809886", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 85, "text": "琮曰：“以聖朝之威，何向而不克?然殊方異域，隔絕障海，水土氣毒，自古有之，兵入民出，必生疾病，轉相污染，往者懼不能反，所獲何可多致？", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "df41cd8a61f169d86a8feb49e46e7fb6fa50ddd3b6c48f44eb3dfe3bb3434de5"}

{"id": "p_a63f66fcf866654b", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 86, "text": "猥虧江岸之兵，以冀萬一之利，愚臣猶所不安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "3e69eba68d2c284221fb8a178adb94028f632a362478ef643c383d33d53224e8"}

{"id": "p_0d47899b852c701a", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 87, "text": "軍行經歲，士眾疾疫死者十有八九，權深悔之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "4780bd1f94b607d9365b41efa06817546bccaa0ad1328866ab7dfbe919a3b5a1"}

{"id": "p_a3b79ce3a3028bf3", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 88, "text": "後言次及之，琮對曰：\"當是時，群臣有不諫者，臣以為不忠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "96914b253742efc0b6ef5c2a9b4c94810d355a13dd7cb0d7f62495f5c7d71295"}

{"id": "p_202bf50da9267f32", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 89, "text": "琮既親重，宗族子弟並蒙寵貴，賜累千金，然猶謙虛接士，貌無驕色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "6bcb3c6e48a91ad54989571f655cfa8fab2964374f23e3c5af0ee16886f24c17"}

{"id": "p_429905e7f72fe7ba", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 90, "text": "後襲業領兵，救諸葛誕於壽春，出城先降，魏以為平東將軍，封臨湘侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "31ac20b0f1af9344cbe14a1f22ac236524886c4966181e097c524a4af5ed56af"}

{"id": "p_e95524c73ecbb7c8", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 91, "text": "懌兄子禕、儀、靜等亦降魏，皆歷郡守列侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "28176e5d03a2ecb0dc642c88fa2a7e49ea6c7aa5dcd3f0ea8ccfd010b78b19b6"}

{"id": "p_6764e3a6d9368c25", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 92, "text": "呂岱字定公，廣陵海陵人也，為郡縣吏，避亂南渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "3de54b3c975e45b1110ba38fa95aff5692dc0564c48f817777f5165aaa3123cc"}

{"id": "p_4ea6d2290cdb2617", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 93, "text": "孫權統事，岱詣幕府，出守吳丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "6774bf67ebd9ef0497d3dc5e56884d8066137e1b7186fbf2c5668b151e7bc45f"}

{"id": "p_870999e299525be6", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 94, "text": "權親斷諸縣倉庫及囚系，長丞皆見，岱處法應問，甚稱權意，召署錄事，出補余姚長，召募精健，得千餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "c61ae388f64dc383345f052d9e2e339930bacdda6eeec7cb36c176f456893ce8"}

{"id": "p_d84a91ef208ba201", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 95, "text": "會稽東冶五縣賊呂合、秦狼等為亂，權以岱為督軍校尉，與將軍蔣欽等將兵討之，遂擒合、狼，五縣平定，拜昭信中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "30245d5cba35fe85ef32d0f1a8fa6fc05c007909b156f2781c0cecf8416d7b54"}
