{"id": "p_5ccb9110dac0ae11", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 96, "text": "，督孫茂等十將從取長沙三郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "5eacaf9a55f47b7118566f3402675ced5dc788f5d19a2d3aa6e10a82b9b402c6"}

{"id": "p_2ce6263cdff049ff", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 97, "text": "又安成、攸、永新、茶陵四縣吏共入陰山城，合眾拒岱，岱攻圍，即降，三郡克定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "0592c001cb1c4db7d8d4b7adce7e3103db9a4e36c99c823b5a8f6b67b85fdef2"}

{"id": "p_6c56c5ddcbfe18aa", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 98, "text": "安成長吳碭及中郎將袁龍等首尾關羽，復為反亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "531204b3dca2057b11d9297ab7ea3f2986c0977fe13d4f2c84ff161117f3f25b"}

{"id": "p_90da67e2e3032d74", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 99, "text": "權遣橫江將軍魯肅攻攸，碭得突走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "11f54cd3a57243baec2564105e0cc6c92932e00aff5352371d8d1e7637f6a3f5"}

{"id": "p_4138106b3c561136", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 100, "text": "到州，高涼賊帥錢博乞降，岱因承製，以博為高涼西部都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "3567fb50802cfbc99a70ce780a5d674e379df9657689bdbe75bb807cd5341c31"}

{"id": "p_ebe1e0b1f7ee8995", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 101, "text": "又鬱林夷賊攻圍郡縣，岱討破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "54c2b9e24725058232f937a888c89b4733a79131e0566e7070d82b1fad86e0c9"}

{"id": "p_e1348c21c21df5a6", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 102, "text": "是時桂陽、湞陽賊王金合眾於南海界上，首亂為害，權又詔岱討之，生縛金，傳送詣都，斬首獲生凡萬餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "91ee3f1caaf0c6d4cda608e2ce11fcdd4393a33d2593b8b2973ca1ce7e7b62ce"}

{"id": "p_1107fed41fafca46", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 103, "text": "遷安南將軍，假節，封都鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "a275c23358aa53b99862f3327e9bf203f2f5cfca5ffe0aadc630d96d0c27f7bf"}

{"id": "p_d98ac7d8a08b229b", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 104, "text": "交阯太守士燮卒，權以燮子徽為安遠將軍，領九真太守，以校尉陳時代燮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "872683a97194a0e8355746a80bb0bb54126b349265295496a5919f9ead75b14c"}

{"id": "p_95592b90e3aaf545", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 105, "text": "岱表分海南三郡為交州，以將軍戴良為刺史，海東四郡為廣州，岱自為刺史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "2cdf29919d7ccc20451144d8a385c2efa8255e8004f38084c3dd6d7114e1fb5b"}

{"id": "p_9b4a90f0ed2fc004", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 106, "text": "遣良與時南入，而徽不承命，舉兵戍海口以拒良等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "23292cc342c75d25a8efec32dd3a1c104cb9fcdfdb9845ee8e9cfaa5c2eddba2"}

{"id": "p_5196f256c1e6fd43", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 107, "text": "岱於是上疏請討徽罪，督兵三千人晨夜浮海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "004a3bd540e28bc01276372f8089496b3bff1ba85b53fdfbbd3779e71bed6cb4"}

{"id": "p_d8f40f3b3a7e3299", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 108, "text": "或謂岱曰：\"徽藉累世之恩，為一州所附，未易輕也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "fef62ebea591308f0d71e5415fb621f0c2cb53afca8ec32a9f5b28c3e3e04467"}

{"id": "p_0709221df09069e5", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 109, "text": "\"岱曰：\"今徽雖懷逆計，未虞吾之卒至，若我潛軍輕舉，掩其無備，破之必也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "7d77a7dcb2fa12066be052a63156557d28c1515a93fb175c792a33b8e34037ee"}

{"id": "p_f261d2db01544232", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 110, "text": "稽留不速，使得生心，嬰城固守，七郡百蠻，雲合響應，雖有智者，誰能圖之?\"遂行，過合浦，與良俱進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "a2fe2c53eed2cf384a405aed62d755f2f669d7852b00d5d41b5e88efa2102a1d"}

{"id": "p_6e919e7cf3d6b55f", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 111, "text": "徽聞岱至，果大震怖，不知所出，即率兄弟六人肉袒迎岱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "3ee68ee90141cd9b06b7032c8f161d0bc00708ba0f44c998e166484d75832361"}

{"id": "p_926537af26b5fe25", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 112, "text": "岱皆斬送其首，徽大將甘醴，桓治等率吏民攻岱，岱奮擊大破之，進封番禺侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "84850d293a972d71d3c86e9685b43262a91578bc9145559a35d7be6cd6cd3687"}

{"id": "p_fb91b76cbac1369d", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 113, "text": "於是除廣州，復為交州如故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "58e24976eb030f9ebd25526322faec10f8e93622bbaec4e8601bb23cbb3f6746"}

{"id": "p_412de4fa75a55cb2", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 114, "text": "岱既定交州，復進討九真，斬獲以萬數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "3a033b65911950e4f54c3ef3eb436533f2c823a773cb4a76e7160bb20b084d41"}

{"id": "p_aaae04ef3aa98790", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 115, "text": "又遣從事南宣國化，暨徼外扶南、林邑、堂明諸王，各遣使奉貢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "35fdf000bb894df922ed5df97954e3d39c0607aaffa17e4f915d06534f0fa30b"}

{"id": "p_dc4a5c65df4c5b6e", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 116, "text": "權嘉其功，進拜鎮南將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "684815af69badcd9f79e731d60b109b4954548b75562abffab6c3805137f3eec"}

{"id": "p_191c9e2ed29e35da", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 117, "text": "，以南土清定，召岱還屯長沙漚口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "05f196a2c6590f3b67b9e8e03e7ce5397b4af99165d3fbde5adddc5b1847d17a"}

{"id": "p_1b914adf9a0b47a5", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 118, "text": "會武陵蠻夷蠢動，岱與太常潘浚共討定之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "b4cb4fa70ea78e4992bfdbc44af43f218eaecfa6395a19ccaab42448ba6a88c4"}

{"id": "p_0af6c483e3f5cae2", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 119, "text": "，權令岱領潘璋士眾，屯陸口，後徙蒲圻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "c9a5151cedf5745c672947a09c8fc97407efeb9c26c83fb16e5c9308f729db32"}

{"id": "p_245808f96a9387a8", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 120, "text": "四年，廬陵賊李桓、路合、會稽東冶賊隨春、南海賊羅厲等一時並起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "00869707aa883f09fd07df171463bf05a7ff0a528db48b355d2f43d5b2882377"}

{"id": "p_4a61632d7a8979ca", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 121, "text": "權復詔岱督劉纂、唐咨等分部討擊，春即時首降，岱拜春偏將軍，使領其眾，遂為列將，桓、厲等皆見斬獲，傳首詣都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "c3cd39d5ac675b9823fd4f572cb40734080b0760485e44c23edb7a0b28a49307"}

{"id": "p_b5458685eddcc0d8", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 122, "text": "權詔岱曰：“厲負險作亂，自致梟首；桓兇狡反覆，已降復叛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "b85a595136a69fcbbfcb64f20ee7dbc190e1aacf9966aa4089a29dd7f551b5a3"}

{"id": "p_c2e7d23adaaa13fb", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 123, "text": "前後討伐，歷年不禽，非君規略，誰能梟之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "02abd983becc51bb64117c3c81bda2988c966608b9b353ef8a1fd11b75de9a9d"}

{"id": "p_c4756a0d447f048c", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 124, "text": "元惡既除，大小震懾，其餘細類，掃地族矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "4260541f8fab9fba8ec2ddb351055e325f55d78379bd4af63f5236c665976e91"}

{"id": "p_29a0559e5d07d504", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 125, "text": "自今巳去，國家永無南顧之虞，三郡晏然，無怵惕之驚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "8ac2e90144fb87f29ff801e912c739b33c20c55f64be92c2ec64f9316491669d"}

{"id": "p_7d1b793f1e3e75e0", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 126, "text": "又得惡民以供賦役，重用歎息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "f6245f82d75fe1411ca38a8cd8981f602bb8f21b6c8273d3f077e51ad972d602"}

{"id": "p_77a00092e7da774c", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 127, "text": "賞不逾月，國之常典，制度所宜，君其裁之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "d6fa5c986a6a328941d7e28582f8cab66a2f32a48d403aadf64ee9b9f817897c"}

{"id": "p_5353e3971aaec211", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 128, "text": "潘濬卒，岱代浚領荊州文書，與陸遜井在武昌，故督蒲圻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "0cc35cb65c3d62571a076bcc75774e2f603ce9b3fa9345abf37b311bbfc3948b"}

{"id": "p_a7bb0e2352778099", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 129, "text": "攻圍城邑，零陵、蒼梧、鬱林諸郡騷擾，岱自表輒行，星夜兼路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "4d94cf947813b7a6e916f5d68a3e63845d32693645ffae5c1ff2c595439a7bbb"}

{"id": "p_e2c9f8206f5bb3e5", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 130, "text": "權遣使追拜岱交州牧，及遣諸將唐咨等駱驛相繼，攻討一年破之，斬式及遣諸所偽署臨賀太守費楊等，並其支黨，郡縣悉平，復還武昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "eb3cae0030d7062ceb22129a9dfa7b7541ce7966f11d06fd403b0b9ddacc88e3"}

{"id": "p_c2d0a89aaad2d7c5", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 131, "text": "時年已八十，然體素精勤，躬親王事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "408942f24eb0db56bc0a6c4add2fc0b1a4f83c627c8b177cc8857b5b16ec1c1e"}

{"id": "p_5201931273f46bec", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 132, "text": "及陸遜卒，諸葛恪代遜，權乃分武昌為兩部，岱督右部，自武昌上至蒲圻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "103b3ea8fb637399f7ffd0d119eec4bc8b5cf2337583a00d1718ab557ba29850"}

{"id": "p_8390b0291832d987", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 133, "text": "遷上大將軍，拜子凱副軍校尉，監兵蒲圻，孫亮即位，拜大司馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "e740f7719db06569c5e32c15f42348a55413834022dfbea528004658a7aa7c77"}

{"id": "p_5b1f10e2971f0b2b", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 134, "text": "初在交州，歷年不餉家，妻子饑乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "17e8eb20be3d0cf1486cc45e6420fb2f5499bae8d78dc75690bb87ef4bc493ef"}

{"id": "p_d849f7340ac85546", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 135, "text": "權聞之歎息，以讓群臣曰：“呂岱出身萬里，為國勤事，家門內困，而孤不早知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "beaac269fe9e1b31cddda9dcd56a7091564083fc8dbba89a59dee6de3b37f9e3"}

{"id": "p_8f56391acab0f6c1", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 136, "text": "”於是加賜錢米布絹，歲有常限。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "53b6e8617365925ab83450bac15c7b2333538558d33154c30be0d89ef5048f94"}

{"id": "p_0eda5ba514aa3ac4", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 137, "text": "始，岱親近吳郡徐原，慷慨有才志，岱知其可成，賜巾褠，與共言論，後遂薦拔，官至侍御史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "ce74ff6faae13c795ff759f193dc8d43939d07334294cc8d93874d384721686f"}

{"id": "p_ef3f06d2f7b4625f", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 138, "text": "原性忠壯，好直言，岱時有得失，原輒諫諍，又公論之，人或以告岱，岱歎曰：\"是我所以貴德淵者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "17269ba4c171da29ac80f8a72b73a938b4ef78eebe3feaae619b915b59818222"}

{"id": "p_d23bd678ff594b6e", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 139, "text": "曰：“德淵，呂岱之益友，今不幸，岱復於何聞過？", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "a2e5e06f144cb881082808cd7faf0bac1cd8f54340712e3cefd60b4259014d7f"}

{"id": "p_539a4a4f6aa5ead1", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 140, "text": "遣令殯以素棺，疏巾布褠，葬送之制，務從儉約，凱皆奉行之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "e0648b4851d1c271cd2ad6b547f890794775ea15575a7a84c4065f6d65ea49a9"}

{"id": "p_66dd45f017582e6f", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 141, "text": "周魴字子魚，吳郡陽羨人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "a23aa42a4b59291183415923866d0f34b91e8bd90632d59d3400e0e3dbb4b51a"}

{"id": "p_c06b2f6f9073c6e9", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 142, "text": "少好學，舉孝廉，為寧國長，轉在懷安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "e633d4678e19e22cd4a99c95f094857b0137ae20a544dce5140ee7a9c75874ae"}

{"id": "p_65706647b71cdaea", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 143, "text": "錢唐大帥彭式等蟻聚為寇，以魴為錢唐侯相，旬月之間，斬式首及其支黨，遷丹楊西部都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "389dfe860f8e8451a80a852445da95d8b5bd4cba31f3f66fc4109ed71d0af7df"}

{"id": "p_203c75b76a4b698e", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 144, "text": "鄱陽大帥彭綺作亂，攻沒屬城，乃以魴為鄱陽太守，與胡綜戮力攻討，遂生禽綺，送詣武昌，加昭義校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "7551fcc0f9ba29aee9ae9a9003855c2e2d24d24689bbc5cb68a9c91690d8c682"}

{"id": "p_8daf9296c2b0789f", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 145, "text": "被命密求山中舊族名帥為北敵所聞知者，令譎挑魏大司馬揚州牧曹休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "8c8ae7f90a002ad203064ace29563189f2dd1722a727fd1cb5923134aaf61c90"}

{"id": "p_d279baf1d20d3646", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 146, "text": "魴答，恐民帥小丑不足仗任，事或漏洩，不能致休，乞遣親人賫箋七條以誘休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "44e57fbed36d5d358a16a7381c22062dfb63ecf29c95acb59b744a5e82b6fb28"}

{"id": "p_7de3b4c0db547ef1", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 147, "text": "休果信魴，帥步騎十萬，輜重滿道，逕來入皖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "2b3ea910c7cb561e6203fb507ea36c78a0cb9dc8122780c68765083ab40bf065"}

{"id": "p_dd9dab274a26abd1", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 148, "text": "魴亦合眾，隨陸遜橫截休，休幅裂瓦解，斬獲萬計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "5121a96e6ed6dbedb6666442049b6c926c22628389294476b25d83d5aaa7c9fb"}

{"id": "p_0700c4ac3dd50a67", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 149, "text": "魴初建密計時，頻有郎官奉詔詰問諸事，魴乃詣部郡門下，因下發謝，故休聞之，不復疑慮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "66cb62d89ba661760f7c367878ca8d2f22b545e9d8218d444bce4a5fc6a5d7c6"}

{"id": "p_3817c983b120c3fb", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 150, "text": "事捷軍旋，權大會諸將歡宴，酒酣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "5300e1c0969ea28e296288c335da7c72a888917607f5b5a98a02ecbc372a07cc"}

{"id": "p_4db8fec77ddb0b97", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 151, "text": "謂魴曰：“君下發載義，成孤大事，君之功名，當書之竹帛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "a2550a6129a73b274e627da2ae778925ae8c845675198d223a1f9f5ca3318db4"}

{"id": "p_9b6a0425750f4e46", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 152, "text": "”加裨將軍，賜爵關內侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "d5f88652255f0e202fe5e5a1a980eb6f17eb0dc003459be035f372b21d1a4c0e"}

{"id": "p_58374c99f36a9e42", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 153, "text": "賊帥董嗣負阻劫鈔，豫章、臨川並受其害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "820e4b82330ead10805e1f3c87cc198dfafa338fbc6624da21df53b97a38945d"}

{"id": "p_da39e9c33d764bbc", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 154, "text": "吾粲、唐咨嘗以三千兵攻守，連月不能拔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "50053abbb8a977f8ca65abe84c5c1c3a39207159b15e2236d03211995d259850"}

{"id": "p_fc397ea9848c538e", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 155, "text": "魴表乞罷兵，得以便宜從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "50087b231f1fa7ef364a6ea7fb5a6da00c5315d390514d6b3f8fab5a37e32784"}

{"id": "p_2fa6fb9f4add23a9", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 156, "text": "魴遣間諜，授以方策，誘狙殺嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "ea2b15eefcdc0ab04b2af3f56954fb2705574fb5d4a34f12056fac412846df9c"}

{"id": "p_83aa4917cd8c2b13", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 157, "text": "嗣弟怖懼，詣武昌降於陸遜，乞出平地，自改為善，由是數郡無復憂惕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "ab63a350f3066744834c4ba2bb900fc7559b05582c7f6a5968cbbc1beeaa265a"}

{"id": "p_62f2717f20cef45a", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 158, "text": "魴在郡十三年卒，賞善罰惡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "d99371412b39f6b9bafa3c88a2a5353be1fa349e0c5db9c126c76862bb440294"}

{"id": "p_8acfde58cf408fe4", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 159, "text": "子處，亦有文武材干，天紀中為東觀今、無難督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "e7a21e3fa5b60af47cbfb479c277eb94e45a4e67de7452112c22b12394b48bee"}

{"id": "p_affafe3b4a98e03e", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 160, "text": "鍾離牧字子幹，會稽山陰人，漢魯相意七世孫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "e4af734304ae4f9093a722d1a56ed6cf0303541a30cf8fb0c6880e7551f4ecd5"}

{"id": "p_93ec76893bf35e3f", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 161, "text": "少爰居永興，躬自墾田，種稻二十餘畝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "8bfdd1cd6dafe39838579286217c57a46145753412ba15d7f16ebb3c917db4c5"}

{"id": "p_1170b945197a7562", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 162, "text": "牧曰：“本以田荒，故墾之耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "9dcb308715d95652392935f90b5a7978cba02af4f9dff98daade9f5e21b67aff"}

{"id": "p_da71951eccb21ac0", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 163, "text": "縣長聞之，召民繋獄，欲繩以法，牧為之請。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "a8a7e7a289595eb55cead0fa54ef3edcb49d2008457bc28b91d47ceec6d71f23"}

{"id": "p_215e228e2921034f", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 164, "text": "長曰：“君慕承宮，自行義事，僕為民主，當以法率下，何得寢公憲而從君邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "0df2ce1492e3ebe771b5660cc4ee827336e2666718372ea722c27d1508af1e8e"}

{"id": "p_1b33e4fb06294fe3", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 165, "text": "”牧曰：“此是郡界，緣君意顧，故來蹔住。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "868785a411e2390af891bb5dc51127fd938351752455519a68f6e51a4db49ff0"}

{"id": "p_5447b4875f08ef4e", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 166, "text": "今以少稻而殺此民，何心復留？", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "454e5ee9da9a49fbeaaf6dcdc231d466b69faba07193b0af5afdd026d9467f94"}

{"id": "p_f2a95e2f42c97795", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 167, "text": "”遂出裝，還山陰，長自往止之，為釋繋民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "48c3fdff246972d0b34a6f8eb8e3f8e85d1bb897ae646bcfc3b6c8a6c7dcbec0"}

{"id": "p_783438600e760c10", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 168, "text": "民慚懼，率妻子舂所取稻得六十斛米，送還牧，牧閉門不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "24fcfa1f69d56bafccae5c651b87df158c10ac8667211fe2f3b36330d784b813"}

{"id": "p_1b706bfbb9161e43", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 169, "text": "，從郎中補太子輔義都尉，遷南海太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "678f4c37d38eaa491ab2367c1845d315d2f0722e4e70e57fc4a0f0ab0daa89c1"}

{"id": "p_22a27d70b1c02761", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 170, "text": "還為丞相長史，轉司直，遷中書令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "758a1d47dc212d56536597ac67f3c9b698bcc9bffd004085263549996d4226ac"}

{"id": "p_341a40f857de48ed", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 171, "text": "會建安、鄱陽、新都三郡山民作亂，出牧為監軍使者，討平之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "215e2a8a55e56114c7ffd3d3070fcb005b877edbbba4a9c42b0a79ab906163d9"}

{"id": "p_d6bb93881eac6d56", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 172, "text": "賊帥黃亂、常俱籌出其部伍，以充兵役。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "fd3835fb1297dedb012a437c51186e499a74e16f75d5c51e0555b6c55e4426eb"}

{"id": "p_0228bc07f0d3f124", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 173, "text": "，蜀併於魏，武陵五谿夷與蜀接界。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "dbbe1fe3145bd02fb3069a151dd337346d838637974bd56df802b3d872d4ac46"}

{"id": "p_8d4bd6170b016bcd", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 174, "text": "時論懼叛亂，乃以牧為平魏將軍，領武陵太守，往之郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "382546bc8007e152e3b14b7e3fc19120582c1bac2dbe780f618414691548cc58"}

{"id": "p_44e7da15522761dd", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 175, "text": "魏遣漢葭縣長郭純試守武陵太守，率涪陵民入蜀遷陵界，屯於赤沙，誘致諸夷邑君，或起應純，又進攻酉陽縣，郡中震懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "63d54b92d330285080f91e5be4b1ecd00d1a889e5499f4461b4d6075c6b632ef"}

{"id": "p_09ff9a6db5a89568", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 176, "text": "牧問朝吏曰：「西蜀傾覆，邊境見侵，何以禦之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "4d1e57d2b88d2e406c9fdc0f1cca4c710b1500f3fabd5956ab3aca661386ee34"}

{"id": "p_25655f5c5d1c8337", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 177, "text": "」皆對曰：「今二縣山險，諸夷阻兵，不可以軍驚擾，驚擾則諸夷盤結。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "6f37da35ec53f8365622081c519cbdb0443c50629bca26796f7694c4e762c256"}

{"id": "p_a408777432ce359f", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 178, "text": "宜以漸安，可遣恩信吏宣教慰勞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "b3a7b9331f86dbd4ce7e5c272d3ae388586d5992f3367598ebf4d9c0b2aed885"}

{"id": "p_1e2790b4f3980475", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 179, "text": "外境內侵，誑誘人民，當及其根柢未深而撲取之，此救火貴速之勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "1e5363881f29c1f17ed5adb13ed2c6dc3bcd6c9b034f6dc1ba385b8d3979fae8"}

{"id": "p_0c5040a057e75ab2", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 180, "text": "」敕外趣嚴，掾史沮儀者便行軍法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "e760b2e60594cb4d6dac4557bd18e454199f97d65d40f7f3a9cedb8a9573a438"}

{"id": "p_b2884c1f4eae8ebf", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 181, "text": "撫夷將軍高尚說牧曰：「昔潘太常督兵五萬，然後以討五谿夷耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "f422fd91f66e0e000dd651b3f26120153e8ef18a0a2b3cc94509f328329f7c74"}

{"id": "p_b435dcf668dd03b4", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 182, "text": "是時劉氏連和，諸夷率化，今既無往日之援，而郭純已據遷陵，而明府以三千兵深入，尚未見其利也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "8b41bcf8ffe730001e93272191c60794c946d1005d37f39a7ca076f730f59b87"}

{"id": "p_fc16a06b397550a8", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 183, "text": "」牧曰：「非常之事，何得循舊？", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "ee962b2c0ea2acb9a23325c1ac2411d86cb2e4f7e66e444cd54e0ef2b828bbe2"}

{"id": "p_168a0ae81c6ad725", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 184, "text": "」即率所領，晨夜進道，緣山險行，垂二千里，從塞上，斬惡民懷異心者魁帥百餘人及其支黨凡於余級，純等散，五谿平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "384a4fed730d5cd86557d4497d37592a119bd656cc9d77a5960424e726006a83"}

{"id": "p_7caf71dde814a3e6", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 185, "text": "遷公安督、揚武將軍，封都鄉侯，徙濡須督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "2ab5ee9156c0d6359c102bf4e093c534360f8348e650b6cd3138aba2b67f0d69"}

{"id": "p_633466a763717140", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 186, "text": "復以前將軍假節，領武陵太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "d3cf1383ed31ce393890ce441f62ee65d1097e0f503da8740b54a0849e159e8f"}

{"id": "p_44843a0ea119d96a", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 187, "text": "評曰：山越好為叛亂，難安易動，是以孫權不遑外御，卑詞魏氏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "dd0bf95df3873f2b7d85ddbf0aa8ead26c7b3c0abe64cf929a20637556f98cf6"}

{"id": "p_35aed2de26c67bcc", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 188, "text": "凡此諸臣，皆克寧內難，綏靜邦域者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "284675829e24231b204858ed789c3e0ca73ee754ef9b389db0e049a1f55c7f43"}

{"id": "p_858b6b5ebd06bfc1", "source_id": "src_bcbc2580e3bf982f", "ordinal": 189, "text": "呂岱清恪在公；周魴譎略多奇；鐘離牧蹈長者之規；全琮有當世之才，貴重於時，然不檢姦子，獲譏毀名云。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "05b80266ebfa2689a3937382f21f1ea5708e587a4495762cbdaab98c28c3c85b"}

{"id": "p_d538c3b0a7c70ffa", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_b2f0a99737b2d16e", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 1, "text": "潘濬字承明，武陵漢壽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "e7ad3de2f42b55bcbed37bc0920e9f7a0ca68dcfe56b93800c0fef4831c716dd"}

{"id": "p_19c3c950c0416588", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 2, "text": "年未三十，荊州牧劉表辟為部江夏從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "867e9094869277bd5580b7f2074d5dbdbc850ac77ba269b421cfbc2a95f02397"}

{"id": "p_d834c6902a78ce33", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 3, "text": "時沙羨長贓穢不脩，濬按殺之，一郡震竦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "11218160d38bdf34f057131948e9622aae263aeba147035438fe80648f407565"}

{"id": "p_09d7a9b074362627", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 4, "text": "劉備領荊州，以濬為治中從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "594eb488554e642c8457da7e386ef79590cb87567f00b3c585b5db415f244137"}

{"id": "p_44d41eaad8b7466b", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 5, "text": "孫權殺關羽，并荊土，拜濬輔軍中郎將，授以兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "e2322106afaa7d63039b3d9a3e8b1560327f81c0d090195a562368e220a53782"}

{"id": "p_fd4f0df81ce39834", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 6, "text": "遷奮威將軍，封常遷亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "f4072013c9b331b3b932141400040e917dfd3511f6e8dbd702cae93a0a8f1afc"}

{"id": "p_5b1f5d0d033ae888", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 7, "text": "五谿蠻夷叛亂盤結，權假濬節，督諸軍討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "0f8a828ed6932d0ad6ef0f6426d144353e85aecee88f917708fba2daa9dc7a56"}

{"id": "p_56392e5e4404a6f4", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 8, "text": "信賞必行，法不可干，斬首獲生，蓋以萬數，自是羣蠻衰弱，一方寧靜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "dfded28fa4d570ae33422746730e1c44f53d48c23e1b2fd9850e9f25b1dcff24"}

{"id": "p_e268726b583fec2a", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 9, "text": "先是，濬與陸遜俱駐武昌，共掌留事，還復故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "7023edec4c6d7f8a6ce89cdf119bd0b9e63574e21b57f1b6d1a821d575ad09b5"}

{"id": "p_4aff9a25112370bc", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 10, "text": "時校事呂壹操弄威柄，奏按丞相顧雍、左將軍朱據等，皆見禁止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "74a9c70c3912fffff44101914e7cf2c4af00a8e5590a61a9b8147e1cc84ecd47"}

{"id": "p_51377d0b37c3ea47", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 11, "text": "黃門侍郎謝厷語次問壹：「顧公事何如?」壹答：「不能佳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "c1d37bad73e187e1be1315b2e1dbbbb44083c95332f6314b301e3a545067f459"}

{"id": "p_8e3ced95ab3628cd", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」厷又問：「若此公免退，誰當代之?」壹未答厷，厷曰：「得無潘太常得之乎?」壹良久曰：「君語近之也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "324a177f34c36f0a9921f788f1293ca91ca86a2f0f5f21f0f958cb53678e6293"}

{"id": "p_2f4305f2a8714cab", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 13, "text": "」厷謂曰：「潘太常常切齒於君，但道遠無因耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "5957ccb2ef8c69e65374013e83b3f742146307a4152bdadbd75d4aef8de8ce2c"}

{"id": "p_357bfe9d053a5640", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 14, "text": "今日代顧公，恐明日便擊君矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "ae8c5eb1cf730d705cf26ec6b227a9720e83d7e596484a782af5c737613eddd6"}

{"id": "p_7c3970248363b1b5", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 15, "text": "濬求朝，詣建業，欲盡辭極諫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "d33b6b3d6003187bd2298eded1dfd6e44b55fede70f272ed9a2c1754b6f40d92"}

{"id": "p_3392601d0d2c795b", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 16, "text": "至，聞太子登已數言之而不見從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "2dcae773c9cf546ab267dd7b88b8d8f9b2b04e4e5a47f6b044a3b07008c1a1c4"}

{"id": "p_239f75e37aea46f2", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 17, "text": "濬乃大請百寮，欲因會手刃殺壹，以身當之，為國除患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "6fce2ce9b7fc8b5f1314ac8f13b29a3dedf84b63e927f78192710862975d27d4"}

{"id": "p_b449bff888089bf4", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 18, "text": "濬每進見，無不陳壹之姦險也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "e5c33e55fbc0694ac029909cce86001c29bda1a28072b6e3a42ca25c6ced9b4d"}

{"id": "p_e66492a0b8328949", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 19, "text": "由此壹寵漸衰，後遂誅戮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "17814321608229dddcf8a5f2bc3b68c7f58f07298c50f4faf0f87c6cd930d9af"}

{"id": "p_e6d27f4f7cd5d142", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 20, "text": "權引咎責躬，因誚讓大臣，語在《權傳》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "91b64248815d110b4c1b4296f096a5497a4f6175325fbda034b6b3506c690285"}

{"id": "p_c754f2278d76e725", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 21, "text": "陸凱字敬風，吳郡吳人，丞相遜族子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "4ee7aae9be329b997ad717a114edecff87ac0abc6daaddb07beab158f840636d"}

{"id": "p_b37915d9ce92f106", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 22, "text": "黃武初為永興、諸暨長，所在有治跡，拜建武都尉，領兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "86a8163f0be31ce3fabcbf9807a435e9bb533585a53048f2736d4ae6e83ce628"}

{"id": "p_2d281ee38689ccf9", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 23, "text": "好《太玄》，論演其意，以筮輒驗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "ef8ee9b3fcbcec5a3ce2d9691be35885fd31a8c6b4385643646bf09a793c0e5e"}

{"id": "p_16844b92075158f9", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 24, "text": "赤烏中，除儋耳太守，討朱崖，斬獲有功，遷為建武校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "6b11ceca771df072654a6646a3bf85ee44ed055a03e6d1a1fd87acdb8d428c68"}

{"id": "p_6d77b2b284a002f2", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 25, "text": "斬毖克捷，拜巴丘督、偏將軍，封都鄉侯，轉為武昌右部督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "2ec7ffc4a72701922065e8bafdd1654e4826da33d604bb0b19a135d589691ef8"}

{"id": "p_b3d111c6294cd8f1", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 26, "text": "與諸將共赴壽春；還，累遷蕩魏、綏遠將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "edfe8b89f1804cb573be89cd4d4846c1fe755eee36e62f77d7a8b9b17fcaaa64"}

{"id": "p_7dc80541a8dccda1", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 27, "text": "孫休即位，拜征北將軍，假節領豫州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "c98aac0d0b50ca89b88fe397d4df869dfc86716144b7b36549d0743afcf64ea8"}

{"id": "p_657a73fe71de3f24", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 28, "text": "孫皓立，遷鎮西大將軍，都督巴丘，領荊州牧，進封嘉興侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "c766d459b0696f8c73f16ef49d0f0cc1aa47ef6b7b0d69353c6ebc2039917c28"}

{"id": "p_123d6cb1630ea4aa", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 29, "text": "孫皓與晉平，使者丁忠自北還，說皓弋陽可襲，凱諫止，語在《皓傳》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "a3039cc9cb67fd3133368e595a60b1d78ca9cba37d4c1967f5cd5dd121affec7"}

{"id": "p_81090d963d95e7cc", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 30, "text": "皚性不好人視己，郡臣侍見，精莫敢進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "f88645d6e6f79ead34659fe92e199266011a1a9072cffd275967289e49eaee14"}

{"id": "p_e75ca1157342a85b", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 31, "text": "凱說皓曰：“夫君臣無不相識之道，若率有不虞，不知所赴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "f82fb31449de27c55d0cbd3586e5885d960867e02a47258e10663fd43bcf65e0"}

{"id": "p_7adc9d10a2772be3", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 32, "text": "皓時徒都武昌，揚土百姓溯流供給，以為患苦，又政事多謬，黎無窮匱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "f2480afdff85fdc9d34e488ea7563078aac4aceb2fefa9fbdca31f8042b79ca9"}

{"id": "p_3fd6c85b17bf4312", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 33, "text": "時殿上列將何定佞巧便辟，貴幸任事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "8c4f97885e921119b76da2a8359d7175cb353d987cf4a304fa05b32790f1585a"}

{"id": "p_de9a698c24964a28", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 34, "text": "凱面責定曰：“卿見前後事主不忠，傾亂國政，寧有得以壽終者邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "1c0fd8bb74fa461f746152fb2b3a13278a17e5c2704bc354013a224595490205"}

{"id": "p_fc4fd0eca51ff196", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 35, "text": "何以專為佞邪，穢塵天聽？", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "e6983e6b0cfcf375838ae638c1e5f29d8cc1c883cd65c08b089d7b8b753ccd12"}

{"id": "p_4bff69273b5c31ef", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 36, "text": "不然，方見卿有不測之禍矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "4c82ad61046f4c55165fd2ebfed690f4f177827719912c01400ae2c14eabe644"}

{"id": "p_f495ab387d0923d6", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 37, "text": "”定大恨凱，思中傷之，凱終不以為意，乃心公家，義形於色，表疏皆指事不飾，忠懇內發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "3dc3505bd53d0a26bb62c712411a462af4c04478afe35a15d80f97a96e0a5f31"}

{"id": "p_69b5b26c1e194303", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 38, "text": "皓遣中書令董朝問所欲言，凱陳：“何定不可任用，宣授外任，不宜委以國事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "89afe38b02e7b20bf4c1f4e80355fce0ff16ac9f8d0b0a94bfc683cff4d76de7"}

{"id": "p_990b9d76ef3f8e0e", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 39, "text": "奚熙小吏，建起浦裡田，欲復嚴密故跡，亦不可聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "2c3d94724b91e33b5a54b5dd78799ab77a7bf44360c6836e217282a499ce1e3b"}

{"id": "p_dfe686f4f303ebea", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 40, "text": "姚信、樓玄、賀劭、張悌、郭逴、薛瑩、滕脩及族弟喜，抗，或清白忠勤，或姿才卓茂，皆社稷之楨干，國家之良輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "e96d6e97047469dca91e1b5de8582c81dc8563b287b2a1afd04cb0e6ccceeb90"}

{"id": "p_45a91c82b759ebc6", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 41, "text": "願陛下重留神思，訪以時務，各盡其忠，拾遺萬一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "cf952f231bf1ca3e11e1efbb6912fb7aae0edffa2e4f33fa303828e421f302d2"}

{"id": "p_272495b8ce559956", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 42, "text": "初為黃門侍郎，出領部曲，拜偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "d2880d08dc47b7725f1390d8f83b813d0d63a2567c7176019790d8eaeec04e20"}

{"id": "p_a9adbfbfab34d1c0", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 43, "text": "凱亡後，入為太子中庶子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "3bbeec28daef505b454e5c36a28086d5c860893caf1af150c351025b98f94e07"}

{"id": "p_ed6a350e4a07be0d", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 44, "text": "右國史華-{覈}-表薦禕曰：\"禕體質方剛，器干強固，董率之才，魯肅不過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "7120ef47452eea1eba297bd4df507e86bc267565dc4501bb8b697138cff8dc80"}

{"id": "p_2cec26c089ee842d", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 45, "text": "及被召當下，逕還赴都，道由武昌，曾不回顧，器械軍資，一無所取，在戎果毅，臨財有節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "fb1b4ebf9730bd4c000c49ff2aeb55f783929e7b42e41438cc670afa10fdce70"}

{"id": "p_abe28470cfbff5bf", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 46, "text": "夫夏口，賊之沖要，直選名將以鎮戍之，臣竊思惟，莫善於禕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "3580b3fbb326cf9c0291160f98708fe9e74ef95b125197008a58c462c4524d2b"}

{"id": "p_40a2e6c951ca5799", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 47, "text": "初，皓常銜凱數犯顏忤旨，加何定譖構非-，既以重臣，難繩以法，又陸抗時為大將在疆場，故以計容忍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "5eebe25e7f06e35272979e2399398a592f137d09bad4e35bdcd524fc94ab6362"}

{"id": "p_a57ee70a562df8a3", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 48, "text": "抗卒後，竟徙凱家於建安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "191ce09230b8a2f5c943fee5c0c4c77ea97f9cd389bf0cd0cafbe3e729c2d2d3"}

{"id": "p_0cd699d055b8448b", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 49, "text": "或曰十二月，凱與大司馬丁奉、御史大夫丁固謀，因皓謁廟，欲廢皓立孫休子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "ddd865b03933b5a4f2540bdf678694b01d1ab1da2a057401bee01e9a478fdcc2"}

{"id": "p_6db2267dff56f20b", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 50, "text": "時左將軍留平領兵先驅，故密語平，平拒而不許，誓以不洩，是以所圖不果。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "4f19c9734b41dd28f7c9292d57409fcb867f723eea5ce6b81e54e4e6768bf38a"}

{"id": "p_a6c83eafe838122b", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 51, "text": "太史郎陳苗奏皓久陰不雨，風氣回逆，將有陰謀，皓深警懼雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "538bcc0b3a0317154106ab187f91c294721a245654dfffd6b4596cf026441752"}

{"id": "p_7baf94af232ad282", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 52, "text": "予連從荊、揚來者得凱所諫皓二十事，博問吳人，多雲不聞凱有此表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "02e9f0487f3ccedcad2aff156e754e21d960799a1f0a145b32b5abbd1da146ec"}

{"id": "p_a7a9dd6fa67bd8c7", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 53, "text": "又按其文殊甚切直，恐非皓之所能容忍也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "2a01363727444c8ccaabd75d6b9d91bb443629f77ab9d3a0dd1746d005b2f6d1"}

{"id": "p_2c025473575a1c60", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 54, "text": "或以為凱藏之篋笥，未敢宣行，病困，皓遣董朝省問欲言，因以付之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "291e704c5bc4e24f6439c6b61da05f7453d663d2d9214d7abf74e959bf65bd89"}

{"id": "p_52486f20edc70d8a", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 55, "text": "虛實難明，故不著於篇，然愛其指擿皓事，足為後戒，故抄列於《凱傳》左雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "1199b21dd03ed581d4032bac5b5c5434debb6163e007dbeb5e3d17c93eda8d85"}

{"id": "p_3e1ca60a3a2eb297", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 56, "text": "皓遣親近趙欽口詔報凱前表曰：“孤動必遵先帝，有何不平？", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "69aa592f46897497ed9529e1e2349372c621b1259e205950895680d0584a3c04"}

{"id": "p_14f47ff7a31c73fa", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 57, "text": "又建業宮不利，故避之，而西宮室宇摧朽，須謀移都，何以不可徙乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "d817a147d5b6fc0ae3d52cd25ccf1eb246b7f688877a0df7dee1d480fa85d3c8"}

{"id": "p_613d2b9d71090f13", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 58, "text": "始為御史、尚書選曹郎，太子和聞其名，待以殊禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "9a09640f1fa0176a5fe4f144742cc95b7d850ac172f294457b144075c0661904"}

{"id": "p_e9555e8b6b460bf8", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 59, "text": "會全寄、楊竺等阿附魯王霸，與和分爭，陰相譖構，胤坐收下獄，楚毒備至，終無他辭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "fa8fae9a0165ef771646a5dc612273f1075b3797cf6dc1bdf3c173e031704ed7"}

{"id": "p_20dcef37593efe94", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 60, "text": "，交阯九真夷賊攻沒城邑，交部騷動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "6de276d0259863c00a77126ebb5f891de34164b0e642173a674c67d7e62b9f9c"}

{"id": "p_915ef68bbf9e3fe6", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 61, "text": "以胤為交州刺史、安南校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "90ea02002c5e1f785738a85a778930538abc3adee4256ab68415a54bb66e9795"}

{"id": "p_26e6afb40f1813d4", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 62, "text": "胤入南界，喻以恩信，務祟招納，高涼渠帥黃吳等支黨三千餘家皆出降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "2b7884ae597de217d7e4dd813dff4a1fd1c593814514a7cddf5cbc636eef60eb"}

{"id": "p_bb5dab2492a9ef35", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 63, "text": "引軍而南，重宣至誠，遺以財幣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "184a05ae34bdbcf70ca2a9a2193353eb2d4a2ebce9b4bdf62b924404cb9557e9"}

{"id": "p_ac00cbef7566ab5d", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 64, "text": "賊帥百餘人，民五萬餘家，深幽不羈，莫不稽顙，交域清泰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "662b59afe9a3e2f4edd83d6e5568a61e9295bfb8b520f29d2bbbfa1622f44c99"}

{"id": "p_dfa8cd0e8f52e194", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 65, "text": "復討蒼梧建陵賊，破之，前後出兵八千餘人，以充軍用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "8a57b6665cde377408fa62bd48c2c28cda567cc2f3f9d6d3b6f812b415394a26"}

{"id": "p_a56459e64aeb3bec", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 66, "text": "，徵為西陵督，封都亭侯，後轉左虎林。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "83219168c3756a347d843c7e0b07ed242fc43dd97561028988ceee231f7e6463"}

{"id": "p_ee4f29f2fbb4c2a5", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 67, "text": "中書丞華-{覈}-表薦胤曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "a4cc9bde2e637692f0f4ec6c96d9d8711fd81ada6ae403249f3cb4df99dd896a"}

{"id": "p_1ea7332226c30fbc", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 68, "text": "，召還建業，復將軍、候。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "f71a56f7150153e3ae829abd06a145a33c62562376c417cd1d9c3ae7de2e9b71"}

{"id": "p_650f83c56198e7cd", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 69, "text": "評曰：潘浚公清害斷，陸凱忠壯質直，皆節概梗梗，有大丈夫格業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "d8b0dd3059789569142264676a9ea1515c2447a3d7bd22dd9991370afc2890c7"}

{"id": "p_89eb1de391daffce", "source_id": "src_3e4d5d22a79c67e4", "ordinal": 70, "text": "胤身潔事濟，著稱南土，可謂良牧矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "b656dc73dd67ccb12c77676da3e8ca76c9902c94416a48ec8e4b52555de85d7d"}

{"id": "p_8d4dbe4148dd1986", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_c0f40ee775caec82", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 1, "text": "是儀字子羽，北海營陵人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "f31c05183d8f5cbf70064769dd79f7e115bb2cc8f13abeedfd95e2ff8a44763d"}

{"id": "p_62113e30d0010f63", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 2, "text": "本姓氏，初為縣吏，後仕郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "adceb6d25c0bff3346c19c68e826e9fa192ca6528bd733828376ddea57cc22c2"}

{"id": "p_627b42c53528299f", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 3, "text": "郡相孔融嘲儀，言\"氏\"字\"民\"無上，可改為\"是\"，乃遂改焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "eff5ef5e54528b5eac52f7abf5abd1ec349d5525ced8e6c33ca30b2e39a48217"}

{"id": "p_5ffbc4c56ca30cae", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 4, "text": "孫權承攝大業，優文征儀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "a2f9777ef4d16d30ff086a1959a115d0532587d981bd0e54193e7e117023c02a"}

{"id": "p_aee7fc3d3a277b6b", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 5, "text": "到見親任，專典機密，拜騎都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "01ef40e06632e0b7306a23eff7f7cd28ad4011ff414e420d6ceb3c5eb2a056b1"}

{"id": "p_4527a75d6d3be03a", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 6, "text": "呂蒙圖襲關羽，權以問儀，儀善其計，勸權聽之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "7a15addb5b78e58204c6e6a834f8b5b6e33e2e9a63727e4f3854ed24acea9acf"}

{"id": "p_3c2bd347eb695081", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 7, "text": "儀陳謝，權令曰：\"孤雖非趙簡子，卿安得不自屈為周捨邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "4f13d12d02e362be8d3d8ce32244f9aa263c2f1dd9e56a2ca6d0c1843078c325"}

{"id": "p_9fb37092f487f6cc", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 8, "text": "\"既定荊州，都武昌，拜裨將軍，後封都亭侯，守侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "8a5c530684f9c5f9b1d1316103cde6404dfe194a245643883433323556ce19d0"}

{"id": "p_ac425187b6cbc859", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 9, "text": "欲復授兵，儀自以非材，固辭不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "7388b01b71d5dbbaf3038650dbc12ee8d4095ce25fb58e4a7624bde6be8b8e68"}

{"id": "p_97875839ce47123a", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 10, "text": "黃武中，遣儀之皖就將軍劉邵，欲誘致曹休。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "1725f2da53479721a4b0ffa87040a235c0f43028c925f096ab848293ada12cd5"}

{"id": "p_690ad3f10fd4ea9f", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 11, "text": "休到，大破之，遷偏將軍，入闕省尚書事，外總平諸官，兼領辭訟，又令都諸公於書學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "6c62fe85e1c812c4afec9ba822bcb08e9db19e8278bdc4a936ca67c58bba6754"}

{"id": "p_9708c88aa5f882e3", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 12, "text": "大駕東遷，太子登留鎮武昌，使儀輔太子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "7a057d77f768a3be55819bc389bbf23d2ac5e22a0a38e283913adcc93587a2b9"}

{"id": "p_21a52b2e63d3c71b", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 13, "text": "太子敬之，事先咨詢，然後施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "ca38079b9eb4d3d77618289d6f28e80810e0e75b9ffa52a2279105cf812fa5ee"}

{"id": "p_d12c74d0f7a2f03d", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 14, "text": "後從太子還建業，復拜侍中、中執法，平諸官事、領辭訟如舊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "0c166074a5d7f9b4c38f7ff52ceef1d7744e2d2fb161874136b801194f617f0b"}

{"id": "p_365f8ccf2cf4693e", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 15, "text": "典校郎呂壹誣白故江夏太守刁嘉謗仙國政，權怒，收嘉繫獄，悉驗問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "e20342d119a16ec72ca013c311a78e9c3b44b1272733a0ea9b1daf8234d62c48"}

{"id": "p_68bb2151dbcdd36c", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 16, "text": "時同坐人皆怖畏壹，並言聞之，儀獨雲無聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "12e72f195890bb58e2cdd687d5d2c77fe824046ebc54d1ed13b38c5e75168539"}

{"id": "p_0bff377f570bad07", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 17, "text": "於是見窮詰累日，詔旨轉厲，群臣為之屏息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "d47eac7755c17b1e1d4471f14daa62740fef652e3007b6fd3d65f4001f52887f"}

{"id": "p_b799ce9a5aa419a4", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 18, "text": "儀對曰：\"今刀鋸已在臣頸，臣何敢為嘉隱諱，自取夷滅，為不忠之鬼!顧以聞知當有本末。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "67883824608097a7a7fdcc3d59fe3461df9a2115faa435ed5778c7f45bd02e02"}

{"id": "p_8ce07b5e9c1e83a2", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 19, "text": "蜀相諸葛亮卒，權垂心西州，遣儀使蜀申固盟好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "a96cb92cc15e91cec3a5e0147a6388da8d04e21131bce79f92792bc79e3f5b82"}

{"id": "p_66e0b190257aa7fc", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 20, "text": "奉使稱意，後拜尚書僕射。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "087d8020e339668618294a15cdd5e0b46a4175d11300e36a40fce1aafc34ac26"}

{"id": "p_fe40f844c8d6d5f8", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 21, "text": "南、魯二宮初立，儀以本職領魯王傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "63fb6a2eb7ce001c47d0c0f8f1b1ff4cca063ab0f87e928d3f13a59bf4d52190"}

{"id": "p_7f4513fcf8c5723f", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 22, "text": "儀嫌二宮相近切，乃上疏曰：\"臣竊以魯王天挺懿德，兼資文武，當今之宜，宜鎮四方，為國藩輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "aaf5c23b5b4ca511074bd1a44f128aede304c0606a803ecc71177143340c43b9"}

{"id": "p_9f5e55eee41fdf01", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 23, "text": "宣揚德美，廣耀威靈，乃國家之良規，海內所瞻望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "f9259a970ee16766aaed0ee67d1d09c133ef9c496c444dab83662aefc2f35488"}

{"id": "p_105d24205f63dabc", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 24, "text": "但臣言辭鄙野，不能究盡其意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "14cef3d6d66b7e6aec5edc22418926b1dd3f17c2725c5e041743d6887dd28927"}

{"id": "p_06d811df5ddb57f5", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 25, "text": "愚以二宮宜有降殺，正上下之序，明教化之本。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "f7766623df7e300b435796a4db621fd4594af872505b975ac35cc80fcd72e3a7"}

{"id": "p_fe2a7676905d8eeb", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 26, "text": "為傅盡忠，動輒規諫；事上勤，與人恭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "35b7f7c94957bf4fec5b2fd1a5356311bee03b654047120aa62798c925f6dd22"}

{"id": "p_bcb6367a1544a2a0", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 27, "text": "不治產業，不受施惠，為屋舍財足自容。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "3981ab2ca72d0c4e3cc04954e1f7c225c8c4e8d5a1bc02d0737cc5ccf6c7e256"}

{"id": "p_b5a4e3151960c1fe", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 28, "text": "鄰家有起大宅者，權出望見，問起大室者誰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "e08782e272a7f3e77252adbc83727e845550fa92afca9e86ede69586e1b17c5d"}

{"id": "p_87f0c80eeea58551", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 29, "text": "左右對曰：\"似是儀家也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "98fdfc69b78e52ed18bc79bc7f817aee4ab1684bc474b2d1367df933fa510727"}

{"id": "p_d8df684c9be5616e", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 30, "text": "\"權曰：\"儀儉，必非也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "746290def38300e077c55cfb960ce0b7f25b5ce32a53da9b9f7e1075d7b17176"}

{"id": "p_b83cb7ca28e67adf", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 31, "text": "服不精細，食不重膳，拯贍貧困，家無儲畜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "6f01a38ae6eecb19d88e96775bd06bfd9dfb0a4cecb3b53715b8469b4341f693"}

{"id": "p_3913aca139c36802", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 32, "text": "權聞之，幸儀捨，求視蔬飯，親嘗之，對之歎息，即增俸賜，益田宅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "78aecd17813a6aaeb6df74b002690034612a41dc469612733440cb5fee098d34"}

{"id": "p_151e7d11cdbcbd0e", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 33, "text": "時時有所進達，未嘗盲人之短。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "9a7d9c47eea9b469bd1cc02eaf820c004814efb56f3efde0ff0334c42b0b97b5"}

{"id": "p_28c3e60cb80d9f99", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 34, "text": "權常責儀以不言事，無是所非，儀對曰：\"聖主在上，臣下守職，懼於不稱，實不敢以愚管之畜，上干天聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "af0b33b3a3bc5eeacc647ef3d747dfa40b3483a2d2cd7b8c435e60b1cc48a19b"}

{"id": "p_3232a2c375297712", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 35, "text": "\"事國數十年，未嘗有過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "ba37f34f29087e86319c0526d85d2dd504ac14ed1d3ae81eaf098d5745bca7a1"}

{"id": "p_9dcdcbd7d3cfc264", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 36, "text": "呂壹歷白將相大臣，或一人以罪聞者數四，獨無以白儀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "04801edc5dbeac2f1ad5555d111935a0d59aa35ec7e199e40c15b7c193b82f38"}

{"id": "p_efc949df43a0d2bc", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 37, "text": "權歎曰：\"使人盡如是儀，當安用科法為?\"", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "c1f19b8abbcb5c070af8a6a6a81f3f2be4e2ff7a71c1d84db090d0cbfad4e281"}

{"id": "p_4763ee853aefc414", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 38, "text": "及寢疾，遺令素棺，斂以時服，務從省約，年八十一卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "02a55d4c9d34f92e1377e9c871706ea9a9e400e7e537777cdc3e07160ed24aa4"}

{"id": "p_6bbca143d517110f", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 39, "text": "孫策領會稽太守，綜年十四，為門下循行，留吳與孫權共讀書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "6660e0903271d448c687dbf0feee2accca9d26749bdd82b236da5fa44d338a2c"}

{"id": "p_09386f3a5329d284", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 40, "text": "策薨，權為討虜將軍，以綜為金曹從事，從討黃祖，拜鄂長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "76cd6812430008ae904c5fb97754ae6c6c2670d39cd105538cc032a66f316cdd"}

{"id": "p_bfd9a1978401ea6c", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 41, "text": "權為將軍，都京，召綜還，為書部。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "89a0dee4b3a21350eb4a108bef6087ace1e0a216b69340b997f382ae25d1df8a"}

{"id": "p_b4605a610ea862cc", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 42, "text": "與是儀、徐詳俱典軍國密事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "f85dca84bb26549d2cde473f68f5ee14e28f300b11bfc3c627146a746faef6a4"}

{"id": "p_b8771d1fde546c44", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 43, "text": "劉備下白帝，權以見兵少，使綜料諸縣，得六千人，立解煩兩部，詳領左部、綜領右部督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "80dceaeb87e2f77686e42ce18f105f7588445fac625d4f41d27920309b71e9f1"}

{"id": "p_1b4bb74c64418958", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 44, "text": "吳將晉宗叛歸魏，魏以宗為蘄春太守，去江數百里，數為寇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "178664c6296a2bf29aae6041cd3848feb3e505836f147bab836ef80f0506ea55"}

{"id": "p_0b67e346bdc1b615", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 45, "text": "權使綜與賀齊輕行掩襲，生虜得宗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "fd931436d69382cf0f11654a7d185cab1111d39174bd1299c3a9fd3b374f11c2"}

{"id": "p_927ce92ca92c5d43", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 46, "text": "魏拜權為吳王，封綜、儀、詳皆為亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "72f23f3509f521e151301f72967261c2545dd31ea50727a043037cc2e3b33304"}

{"id": "p_08f7c481d4e3fbd4", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 47, "text": "夏，黃龍見舉口，於是權稱尊號，因瑞改元。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "3b99f704ee8ec8d8fab7a0500bb0da24af584532bfeac9c4fa400b41456f1fb1"}

{"id": "p_bc08cfb869c18c18", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 48, "text": "又作黃龍大牙，常在中軍，諸軍進退，視其所向，命綜作賊曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "f1d0997ebd5276b29801a3a2ff62a1f4f66bf1e7a766a84f9796b420850775df"}

{"id": "p_0658c65c62747fb2", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 49, "text": "蜀聞權踐阼，遣使重申前好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "76c27dadabb048d054ea175d972e679eed087809da44c323976e8e93b9605923"}

{"id": "p_54ea3b84d62b4374", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 50, "text": "綜為盟文，文義甚美，語在《權傳》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "4e50e3213312ab0f54f7598d007965b55cabcb45fd6db3e7b92f3f74ea5c8a14"}

{"id": "p_ff909aea66f8a7ab", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 51, "text": "權下都建業，詳、綜並為侍中，進封鄉侯，兼左、右領軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "5a61b0270a2f99b3405b4349a559f98a52d54d9b73c2b33f1089fc0d3435138a"}

{"id": "p_a0664ac6a056c00c", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 52, "text": "時魏降人或雲魏都督河北振威將軍吳質頗見猜疑，綜乃偽質為作降文三條：", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "7ba87bd8a8c768afeeb7816a4aca061ef3a02d66014f6804675bb009d7b3423a"}

{"id": "p_fc70d1297462725b", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 53, "text": "此文既流行，而質已人為侍中矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "211cee0b0f98b4d463e8dfe2c928c3284f2bbfc6a6631970906ca745d1b50733"}

{"id": "p_ab503165ab6376ac", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 54, "text": "上書曰：“臣聞紂為無道，微子先出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "194e4266ec6fa1b7139c23d3e3e7b2a3e1c526cc99569ed90e03fdec693e4fb9"}

{"id": "p_096a1ee5af2edf3b", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 55, "text": "臣年二十二，委棄封域，歸命有道，賴蒙天靈，得自全致。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "23d9cea5be216eb573a43794ed1776a0c80f21418449a3172022a6b39b7dad6f"}

{"id": "p_f493fc9d0e15065b", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 56, "text": "臣至北有日，而主者同之降人，未見精別，使臣徽言妙旨，不得上達。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "4c07fce3440bca67fed4ab91c1a3bb0417765c9e490cd2264ff0f0d867f71848"}

{"id": "p_08e34d44c814b8b0", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 57, "text": "蕃謝答問，及陳時務，甚有辭觀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "31500d040407fa70e300bcaaec5fd97f32b159ac6b0008390559633e341404d0"}

{"id": "p_7c407713c4b335c7", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 58, "text": "綜對曰：\"蕃上書，大語有似東方朔，巧捷詭辯有似彌衡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "bce37c9aa7db9fb01aec099dab5d732cc5c3896e6aea006dab4d0817b6bdd0a5"}

{"id": "p_ee2e131390ddbf8b", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 59, "text": "綜對曰：\"未可以治民，且試以都輦小職。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "be31b122f10d821245c30bfddb1434f2042c777f174c6d18f403c2f5fefb0ed8"}

{"id": "p_4f2d5059b8df2758", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 60, "text": "\"權以蕃盛論刑獄，用為廷尉監。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "3aedc953f29819a3f4dd537f24ae9d34c88a39233b9ad10e86d0e2c901eb90a6"}

{"id": "p_0cd48156a2287d99", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 61, "text": "左將軍朱據、廷尉郝普稱蕃有王佐之才，普尤與之親善，常怨歎其屈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "6f7c6ed039f682c486bb733c15ddbf926ba15f7c9e857aa3fecd5a6439ebe7f3"}

{"id": "p_e4cdb243fdef740a", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 62, "text": "後蕃謀叛，事覺伏誅，普見責自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "3136fa14a9e39ba955fb181a3ecfe4cf44b0b350da9cad645a4517263aa2527e"}

{"id": "p_2fceb53ad3856620", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 63, "text": "拜綜偏將軍，兼左執法，領辭訟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "e5e5e1f4165a1ba6ff61414a859fb0d18bc0e9993834b91647c7d2b1c925e5c5"}

{"id": "p_6f792ee4245ba015", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 64, "text": "遼東之事，輔吳將軍張昭以諫權言辭切至，權亦大怒，其和協彼此，使之無隙，綜有力焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "61784fc5f15045cf647de4a1d7ed98cc154a56bded9dbb842bf039a1aa282ad5"}

{"id": "p_d5ac43ea24fe8ebd", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 65, "text": "性嗜酒，酒後歡呼極意，或推引杯觴，搏擊左右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "2f88a0ffc93f3e879c9a7cb7dd1458c76b0708fd8911f8730429dae162f8f1a2"}

{"id": "p_dce7e03e3fbf6876", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 66, "text": "凡自權統事，諸文誥策命，鄰國書符，略皆綜之所造也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "df6c53bcf1d8798732afc5f2a7c5777c92ee49ee27103ec1358d750f14fb19cf"}

{"id": "p_44baac775fe3694b", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 67, "text": "初以內外多事，特立科，長吏遭喪，皆不得去，而數有犯者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "6b0393451f4e757132d73a274404eedbdb3a980dc7a58a7d5dc6a0334ded86ee"}

{"id": "p_236a80b28d944f8a", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 68, "text": "綜議以為宜定科文，示以大辟，行之一人，其後必絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "d9e6bb2effd6960ac4ade397585ceae81fd1c9986698c24b115574a24c40618e"}

{"id": "p_e3324ecc1d638548", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 69, "text": "遂用綜言，由是奔喪乃斷，", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "c0bbb99b40f30a17870113e310caa3cc74ffb3c34d897e9c4adedd96635ae337"}

{"id": "p_0915149e5f3cd46f", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 70, "text": "沖平和有文干，天紀中為中書令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "c97e53e026151f8d65ce2f44a8d2e3e75ee5cfe63d55ec85279d651eab82a639"}

{"id": "p_60c430cca633061d", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 71, "text": "徐詳者字子明，吳郡烏程人也，先綜死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "9f9f74ac2100634be6f8c1e4839ff6d7505379c32f4ec6e38de283c8c9e3f778"}

{"id": "p_5fd94ebc048e596f", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 72, "text": "評曰：是儀、徐詳、胡綜，皆孫權之時干興事業者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "90543ea2929f1b658cdd73a9da9066c8467af5e321d922ee5ebfb23f038cf8d4"}

{"id": "p_29081d867a14bc6b", "source_id": "src_a1fe387d87643550", "ordinal": 73, "text": "儀清恪貞素，詳數通使命，綜文采才用，各見信任，譬之廣夏，其榱椽之佐乎!", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "2200d36f41783a0bf7d4ad353ea8dac5e66d8f467691eef63e76a20e002a4bb4"}

{"id": "p_f3b8e85d6dc771ef", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_05d3cf48152eca58", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 1, "text": "吳範字文則，會稽上虞人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "6db049a0c0608c6d153899465ebcff2ee9914a57435b95b62596be7e8f9b22bb"}

{"id": "p_fe769985c5dcc035", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 2, "text": "以治曆數知風氣聞於郡中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "b43b2e2b7720bd51a4c0b8a53da814dd6b8946d1cbfa24c51092fd7921590692"}

{"id": "p_b4d0f047c228147d", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 3, "text": "舉有道，詣京都，世亂不行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "7c21d5674e0804ec266c5a6d82f1e94ddc054e1ad87d148125d9f6b848f60c49"}

{"id": "p_ce6128a81ad559c0", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 4, "text": "會孫權起於東南，範委身服事，每有災祥，輒推數言狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "dddb1aa8d9cd3173fc2ed4ff7cff783a1c8f02e178b176f08ff55223033fbd61"}

{"id": "p_87e0630a48d54814", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 5, "text": "範曰：「今茲少利，不如明年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "5b810081c2897060eacebea0bdd986617fa4e0c15654e027ed033b4019abe3df"}

{"id": "p_b84536b157d45e3c", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 6, "text": "明年戊子，荊州劉表亦身死國亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "61074c3590bcb4ba7eebed51df96ed38ec1457e29cc1944b1dd4fc90ade89bc3"}

{"id": "p_19e77b4e274142ce", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 7, "text": "明年，軍出，行及尋陽，範見風氣，因詣船賀，催兵急行，至即破祖，祖得夜亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "c18da66b5d29b4261ef14d3eb8f356f5c3f65cbe1959f22371d9ffd98e932a3a"}

{"id": "p_f96d021b37ed0a6c", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 8, "text": "權恐失之，範曰：「未遠，必生禽祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "4129ce0f995d10b2b672366da6ee5174552c5750660ddc8df971a942efa72c3b"}

{"id": "p_150d8ebbe02f6caf", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 9, "text": "及壬辰歲，範又白言：「歲在甲午，劉備當得益州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "fa3df1eb09bb2d8aecdf8a1131895816036846e163cf777edf774a70b1e76f9d"}

{"id": "p_fc3f54e2940fe0c5", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」後呂岱從蜀還，遇之白帝，說備部衆離落，死亡且半，事必不克。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "09ea204b1ca0fbe682300eae46d23826a6c5f49518f02c22e1ccd04553a17354"}

{"id": "p_1d2fd09041ce7902", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 11, "text": "權以難範，範曰：「臣所言者天道也，而岱所見者人事耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "c2019e4caa15c0c95eb4c4bab1e8f15c368021eaebc3230462290cb1890d0b05"}

{"id": "p_222ea960cff980a2", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 12, "text": "權與呂蒙謀襲關羽，議之近臣，多曰不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "ef065abee7b9895154d28acd5aa5eb8cbee94f52dd5799db91ef8a481f3bd49b"}

{"id": "p_e33892ec3aadd955", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 13, "text": "權以問範，範曰：「得之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "9e72296109531b73c6b1abfb39d3d193a0e0f301cbfedd395d29e179c34acb6b"}

{"id": "p_78c33fb7426154d4", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」後羽在麥城，使使請降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "4636f3f4d80e5a34c1eee5dcf6c9b3ea44264f549e208346f3037cf62c8c545e"}

{"id": "p_d7bd7d00b23f9c99", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」範曰：「彼有走氣，言降詐耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "c1afa297013c0a86aad8af6f36e19cdfa60779d85834a1603981b840c3ff716a"}

{"id": "p_0f84e3d758aa05dd", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 16, "text": "」權使潘璋邀其徑路，覘候者還，白羽已去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "ff763f4db13830ceb047794972faa299bace7ea8d45b5e942a9b4b107c2d3730"}

{"id": "p_18b49eba157093c2", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 17, "text": "」問其期，曰：「明日日中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "372237afcb76f376956c8d09eda95b3e7734e6301e2b4b0303cf8ae7ae8aa853"}

{"id": "p_c021af4bd4321a1e", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 18, "text": "及中不至，權問其故，範曰：「時尚未正中也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "4d1c32ad6597a42b4b4fa8956063990997a794722c6258c517052a76f5f86111"}

{"id": "p_0a1806ef55da3cd9", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」頃之，有風動帷，範拊手曰：「羽至矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "c9658bd9cc9388adae03a2e83461e902281c9c1ddf8b3931c6f8b03f7b4a2294"}

{"id": "p_e6fda6cd182315e9", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 20, "text": "」須臾，外稱萬歲，傳言得羽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "a1160d7afee04b6352a8470da5f2420e4412ebc7ea6f36638e21832272742f32"}

{"id": "p_f6038422ba8f2993", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 21, "text": "後權與魏爲好，範曰：「以風氣言之，彼以貌來，其實有謀，宜爲之備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "650cd840b9feb808652a7ebef68f1c5d1a6439b7e022ae60d1a9f7532838a4eb"}

{"id": "p_08b0d67c07674bc9", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 22, "text": "」劉備盛兵西陵，範曰：「後當和親。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "0a55dd3138da9f91d2068ab2211e9c1fc2aa89f5fdce3eb9a1a9cb2c0491146a"}

{"id": "p_362f58c2a5d74e69", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 23, "text": "權以範爲騎都尉，領太史令，數從訪問，欲知其決。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "cdbd7b70bfa9f6b1d653d274296cdb31e4f4809d1f612bf346ea2d9ac9371df5"}

{"id": "p_e9931d2a2982e9e0", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 24, "text": "範祕惜其術，不以至要語權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "8dd65e790b365bfa68a6556e7c9e8f6c1e9e2e95cd87dbc064d3b1e6117499c8"}

{"id": "p_a6c8d3ce818a8884", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 25, "text": "初，權爲將軍時，範嘗白言江南有王氣，亥子之間有大福慶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "0fc30e65b6a1c5f1c0987992df2a8cf07fef58171136318835f8be57a618889f"}

{"id": "p_7a2eef3d4bd93692", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 26, "text": "權曰：「若終如言，以君爲侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "76292a2c735141f2004deadfa7c977663a49b269842f8bedf71afaa3eca94ce5"}

{"id": "p_ba902419e45dc4b1", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」及立爲吳王，範時侍宴，曰：「昔在吳中，嘗言此事，大王識之邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "8e9c12324bf7ffb8ac7db5eb49e6c33ee1cf98f2ae02423b1c47bc470ce407d7"}

{"id": "p_de7dc502590fff7b", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」因呼左右，以侯綬帶範。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "29d971bfc797880251dbd40b0859f4fe3600428035110c1b53a84e1eee5668e7"}

{"id": "p_85bac28ae6034476", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 29, "text": "範知權欲以厭當前言，輒手推不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "d28429b607d4998efa32435349cb07be1c60bec9ca4a675c951198513679cfc4"}

{"id": "p_32e8b7c504d10ac3", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 30, "text": "及後論功行封，以範爲都亭侯，詔臨當出，權恚其愛道於己也，削除其名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "bbd0a16149b34140f72c3f610bccd492a8dd1e879282ce1bd024df00caccc669"}

{"id": "p_4a0f55dedbcca4b1", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 31, "text": "範爲人剛直，頗好自稱，然與親故交接有終始。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "cb7349bf75a2aa54ef04df3129612aab7d7a264e7b23f7b4d4af3688a727fbef"}

{"id": "p_d87f79eb4d765fa9", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 32, "text": "滕嘗有罪，權責怒甚嚴，敢有諫者死，範謂滕曰：「與汝偕死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "65ee73a457b32e8278f5507fc6f9e9fcbe3d6d3d929d9d126cf730b9f999d8f5"}

{"id": "p_852aa86568393e52", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」滕曰：「死而無益，何用死爲？", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "2252686939b7b2e433d4eb05dca1d5cc5060a13a8d1bd4eb5d0d9186e3af6dc1"}

{"id": "p_6941ec58d740ad5a", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 34, "text": "」範曰：「安能慮此坐觀汝邪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "9f8b010cca8d2ff369ef149c7a6f1fa090d80c4b4d9bdf3cac5a2a18de1933bc"}

{"id": "p_32a87448a6c139c4", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 35, "text": "」乃髡頭自縛詣門下，使鈴下以聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "0ce0f9d61e1a87296f58635a11024d4126dc390508dd166377579f45dc58a362"}

{"id": "p_ba4354fc5c772cf8", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 36, "text": "鈴下不敢，曰：「必死，不敢白。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "3243e94d7d44a73368f0e8daadb2c2b405944fa6d0f7aaff7d98403152dfaf7f"}

{"id": "p_e46202e5b8078ff3", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」曰：「使汝爲吳範死，子以屬我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "61c631dc5b21c818a97ea15ad620a4ba93fbb0a40297a811a619127310e30421"}

{"id": "p_ababe3befbb57831", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 38, "text": "言未卒，權大怒，欲便投以戟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "0d3411a69a8097ab926fc3edec1a0d37797fd2f2f5e3fb83acfa0c5d32d98c9a"}

{"id": "p_a54dab9a096175f6", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 39, "text": "逡巡走出，範因突入，叩頭流血，言與涕並。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "b570ec0b9129306b5fffdf8d2bafdfdc86a3241b1717ff4777807df3647cf8e0"}

{"id": "p_c9db16ba5be078bf", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 40, "text": "滕見範謝曰：「父母能生長我，不能免我於死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "4bc13fff024150d9bd1bec45b784990c923b5e15a59781e43ec80c1f6be14260"}

{"id": "p_4c2332b3f8bbe909", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 41, "text": "丈夫相知，如汝足矣，何用多爲！", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "d608a0620c26af35faeee529dbeceaed88619892a34aa3a1da5f25e6779d5aec"}

{"id": "p_e3454726404d31a2", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 42, "text": "長子先死，少子尚幼，於是業絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "9c9615ce23cd5b9fbaa59e34d9e8ca5a4bd81b1c92d848bb74a3134911d596f5"}

{"id": "p_f5c5ae080094f865", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 43, "text": "權追思之，募三州有能舉知術數如吳範、趙達者，封千戶侯，卒無所得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "488dc172745c4d8a23f28af808cf05548cd2394f8fccb61fb1a80026c17df7fc"}

{"id": "p_be2e85bb7d83794e", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 44, "text": "遭亂避地，客游廬陵，事孫輔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "6f58166b2feb7febbb77234cea0d0d458082a04d3853149917e4e857c28494e8"}

{"id": "p_9d815432b92144bc", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 45, "text": "以明天官達占數顯於南土。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "91b6ba73aa4eb0db439dacd226a675a706a3732b4e0b932531e2d533c7116975"}

{"id": "p_f436098e23e1846d", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 46, "text": "每有水旱寇賊，皆先時處期，無不中者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "effc4d8ae02515c284e333c32ba1aafa0850a550ebb023bc92de3ee9f294b235"}

{"id": "p_4e3cc1412dc8a450", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 47, "text": "輔異焉，以爲軍師，軍中咸敬事之，號曰神明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "e00900493493f7b4e86c73fce30d0f78c06d28eda1399aa476cf036c3dde0d0e"}

{"id": "p_589e6c496627a1d5", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 48, "text": "建安中，孫權在豫章，時有星變，以問惇，惇曰：「災在丹楊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "9f1a7e50ab0528e5db3f7f221ffc9713dc98bd2dd4454a3aa7d8387d5f0bd9d2"}

{"id": "p_fe540961797acffa", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 49, "text": "」曰：「客勝主人，到某日當得問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "3a39bd6d7b108c70d9083204ffa8700e5a413194588752039fefa9f1613c385f"}

{"id": "p_c43770337bb3e47d", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」是時邊鴻作亂，卒如惇言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "2335506e853c8ca4873bfdb557751d84f20e4d0209c5c9fad491dd78ab195a45"}

{"id": "p_58a84b157965a6b3", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 51, "text": "惇於諸術皆善，尤明太乙，皆能推演其事，窮盡要妙，著書百餘篇，名儒刁玄稱以爲奇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "254a86657b4d3738ce2504c17df445cb182368691acc1446579a52e4ebe7b6c4"}

{"id": "p_ddde85c6838e1883", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 52, "text": "惇亦寶愛其術，不以告人，故世莫得而明也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "ccf00ddc707971d9c80d2fc74d8712f188f6d95b003ddc662e89695379d95d58"}

{"id": "p_28dd348cb07c2fef", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 53, "text": "少從漢侍中單甫受學，用思精密。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "0f68bdc0c4bfd466eef57854ede4244aa8d9c16154536db0692463c240f90d82"}

{"id": "p_3b11688b061676a1", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 54, "text": "謂東南有王者氣，可以避難，故脫身渡江。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "fe3c6f7dc3b0d3e5e0c1ada89d7761d489d7ff4286bc83fb3803b7cf76e5d4ed"}

{"id": "p_d682465246553b2c", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 55, "text": "治九宮一算之術，究其微旨，是以能應機立成。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "9ae410d07b4dada720a37a9a1f52bbfd0c553b0508148c752a59822b4f638eb7"}

{"id": "p_ab0e35431365215e", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 56, "text": "對問若神，至計飛蝗，射隱伏，無不中效。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "4e3ef1646a578ab44e587a5b67cd77b1fdbd5587a6e5ca7d4659b8e31d985d05"}

{"id": "p_a0479d6a38ace8ad", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 57, "text": "或難達曰：「飛者固不可校，誰知其然，此殆妄耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "e23b302bc98cc7b7a73a8a060c4af96e8b046e7aaa6a555fceee22241df891b3"}

{"id": "p_226bce079a37170c", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」達使其人取小豆數斗，播之席上，立處其數，驗覆果信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "796ac917cc91cebbc636ac96f768cfce414b21293ada5e36b678228deb468f8e"}

{"id": "p_d27bcbb9b717f465", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 59, "text": "嘗過知故，知故爲之具食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "87f3c06b56b4bb0cc8483504d6838f54b4d6cbcef1a569928615e0223b38b061"}

{"id": "p_f70157cda6ace96f", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 60, "text": "食畢，謂曰：「倉卒乏酒，又無嘉肴，無以敘意，如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "ce592d0fce3987cd08061ee508a69306500ab71d4284c8628ba7a71a73777679"}

{"id": "p_257326f69029a441", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」達因取盤中隻箸，再三從橫之，乃言：「卿東壁下有美酒一斛，又有鹿肉三斤，何以辭無？", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "277b292e4e4cfa0632d350d264d6c6c16707e6be3e22bd92ad69c979c12fc7fe"}

{"id": "p_fb959caa376d9dff", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」時坐有他賓，內得主人情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "3bba18da4c116f39ac8e257c8aefed6b85b50826331ae97c80427d09468a008f"}

{"id": "p_765c67be8919cb75", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 63, "text": "主人慚曰：「以卿善射有無，欲相試耳，竟效如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "036d57738a231e510f49118bb47e3f094139b542aab9469df942a921fa091aca"}

{"id": "p_3c2a9f729bbdbe74", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 64, "text": "又有書簡上作千萬數，著空倉中封之，令達算之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "7850bc4643d21dcc6a5d788d8e747ddebc11dc4e357b62de4539736026878f6b"}

{"id": "p_004eb100fd55c1eb", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 65, "text": "達處如數，云：「但有名無實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "eeaf128046116821de469ebaa6abecb2c2d1a831bf5d7496f3c3261444e41d38"}

{"id": "p_333caf545c5bed4c", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 66, "text": "達寶惜其術，自闞澤、殷禮皆名儒善士，親屈節就學，達祕而不告，太史丞公孫滕少師事達，勤苦累年，達許敎之者有年數矣，臨當喻語而輒復止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "d7b1772d7ed6c0807bca07e5de1ebf97c5884e1296a7274695a469f5fe4ab848"}

{"id": "p_3ad514b73955ba17", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 67, "text": "滕他日齎酒具，候顏色，拜跪而請。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "38add20a6505262395130f8e932c2db42e7e33ded42ea5df7f914c09e0f27749"}

{"id": "p_638088f6a4a955e5", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 68, "text": "達曰：「吾先人得此術，欲圖爲帝王師，至仕來三世，不過太史郎，誠不欲復傳之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "888f4fa7c1d3f8628776e3a7685a279e635254213311615fad5150ae1f9ee3ee"}

{"id": "p_dacc7d5d185430c9", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 69, "text": "且此術微妙，頭乘尾除，一算之法，父子不相語。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "2903ab4ac9bf283d3c20f6fbca4665c90d9214ec647252336e9ee11ebe9547de"}

{"id": "p_adf3e60b95918f95", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 70, "text": "然以子篤好不倦，今真以相授矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "9ab08811058ab2ec339d6f32432e6c9f7aef39d43d3c8ddd2d4757643260564d"}

{"id": "p_6450240e41310bd9", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」飲酒數行，達起取素書兩眷，大如手指，達曰：「當寫讀此，則自解也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "4cf43573127e95c3fdf6d4b5b9801e9dd40a3336c4005617f4eeeb561b6a2c9e"}

{"id": "p_41683680489b9be6", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 72, "text": "今欲思論一過，數日當以相與。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "3f715b3ec9f055ba2489e91793b4c5f66c763a6f39e1c8f2ad2e7c7e53214f9a"}

{"id": "p_1f3a402dd2b2f095", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」滕如期往，至乃陽求索書，驚言失之，云：「女婿昨來，必是渠所竊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "affe44532cb8d29bc1c4c3be607db42eb1774819b1a7d8f334c26bb48bc79d7d"}

{"id": "p_074ccd443d385940", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 74, "text": "初，孫權行師征伐，每令達有所推步，皆如其言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "05703a02ed0b961bd8ad04faf23aa9e19f6f06fd7ecdd24861d2dcf98074e005"}

{"id": "p_8de6e1108384c5a1", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 75, "text": "權問其法，達終不語，由此見薄，祿位不至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "9359423a61f02b56606ff3ab8faa611b4f1bfd14c719a52dd1a0b4da8353eb8b"}

{"id": "p_654f1c4d6f2b6232", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 76, "text": "達常笑謂諸星氣風術者曰：「當迴算帷幕，不出戶牖以知天道，而反晝夜暴露以望氣祥，不亦難乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "986b575076fc9eeface46038220f91f0889caeaf791c4a999163b143fffd3920"}

{"id": "p_8fbb9f2bd70d8a38", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」閒居無爲，引算自校，乃歎曰：「吾算訖盡某年月日，其終矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "72482e88dc138d84c2823d72b1c5dd4d6570e30010da107d91663d1f332b7650"}

{"id": "p_9b25cdd43b99110e", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 78, "text": "」達妻數見達效，聞而哭泣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "0f5d8a09117fe16023360418888a80fe039b5413ee516e2f37a69c4ec6f482a8"}

{"id": "p_e080d8e98a770eab", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 79, "text": "達欲弭妻意，乃更步算，言：「向者謬誤耳，尚未也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "0478d30f328d88324624b09232b79911616ebaef73ff089fa55742e8c7b3b5f7"}

{"id": "p_41a6339a003d19d7", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 80, "text": "權聞達有書，求之不得，乃錄問其女，及發棺無所得，法術絕焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "c76d7b472881f9573a47fc01cd9c20d58a4444820f7f44c60e665b019ddf8749"}

{"id": "p_e9e707e0d7df4f03", "source_id": "src_7b2c4fcbe1da2525", "ordinal": 81, "text": "評曰：三子各於其術精矣，其用思妙矣，然君子等役心神，宜於大者遠者，是以有識之士，舍彼而取此也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "50ae4da68f8d5fe1a25ac3daf2c675f251ad3d7542597e0980607ecdb1c598f4"}

{"id": "p_87b79b137ec274a9", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 0, "text": "__FORCETOC__", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "7459b308e7a6049601d0566acb8568e6e10b19d8628313ecb6ec3a4938159b35"}

{"id": "p_e06163cb4ebd6daa", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 1, "text": "諸葛恪字元遜，瑾長子也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "7bd54f71e6fa73b42a3fbbdc384fea105a9e280a293a0a86fd19f5dd3543fe48"}

{"id": "p_103a375eaff39518", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 2, "text": "弱冠拜騎都尉，與顧譚、張休等侍太子登講論道藝，並為賓友。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "7f90185c23ddc2106a2aa7341186fc47f0ee50c64ae5a78043e51fd065205030"}

{"id": "p_d776f995684493a1", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 3, "text": "孫權大會群臣，使人牽一驢入，長檢其面，題曰諸葛子瑜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "7f08c84f57fee2845d19622a6b5e018072fc9bb6db83cd9bc0fd4f57a0041236"}

{"id": "p_9dad4572f7c06c0b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 4, "text": "恪跪曰：「乞請竺益兩字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "d78242b7292c9c24c68339d4f3f84509bdf6702401a092747045bffa1b506f2b"}

{"id": "p_dc4c2b0897fb510f", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 5, "text": "他日復見，權問恪曰：「卿父與叔父孰賢？", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "28938d4c82dd7ae9e4644d6704454981a03204b4ee7d3fbcbee162d615b154a1"}

{"id": "p_6280d9508fe1cb28", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 6, "text": "對曰：「臣父知所事，叔父不知，以是為優。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "f3cf729174f0a56fa70888394ffca1b5c86a3b6fae5638ebc0cf51495abc6131"}

{"id": "p_516286507fe67291", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 7, "text": "命恪行酒，至張昭前，昭先有酒色，不肯飲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "bcf2121df7e43f003a64e3a79814cebf9060157754d4f2b071af7d999ee9c1f6"}

{"id": "p_f6edb4fc40deb113", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」權曰：「卿其能令張公辭屈，乃當飲之耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "ba68910cd3e22fcf084712ebdaf4a8d1de0552a80edd62e36dbe1505107dfbf6"}

{"id": "p_94a14dd0297af80c", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」恪難昭曰：「昔師尚父九十，秉旄仗鉞，猶未告老也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "3f2ffd799a41d2dd3f6806d764d1c72bca2a8f550f416608ce0c707fa7e3d48d"}

{"id": "p_25bae0e40a0cc0f2", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 10, "text": "今軍旅之事，將軍在後，酒食之事，將軍在先，何謂不養老也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "4e9735de92a11a29d049378a5092491ec3d2321539d6f22b05f3fc255c34cf3d"}

{"id": "p_6b762e4d71422d02", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 11, "text": "後蜀好，群臣並會，權謂使曰：「此諸葛恪雅使至騎乘，還告丞相，為致好馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "95759b34638aa9ddfd14065b8bcc80ce27f31fd6b89443a582e77f63d4350473"}

{"id": "p_26de6029a6135120", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」恪因下謝，權曰：「馬未至面謝何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "c23e88e7081290bd4cc146b70ffc6615e8fae25a06877f91c570d66de07055ed"}

{"id": "p_993096b93e7ca94b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 13, "text": "」恪對曰：「夫蜀者陛下之外廄，今有恩詔，馬必至也，安敢不謝？", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "3e20f450d2afcae83b809781f0306cc98a82d08ab78f46a961c81a85067eb33e"}

{"id": "p_f940367d2370475b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 14, "text": "權甚異之，欲試以事，令守節度。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "325dfc85379a406142175e95cf14dd41143edb8af3c634ef2eaead1ed33a7328"}

{"id": "p_efdd6b9c6a73e5f4", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 15, "text": "節度掌軍糧谷，文書繁猥，非其好也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "a9438fd72ec4d0c0f58540cb4847eb8b94a5dc2b694a4f73db71a7d51152a8d1"}

{"id": "p_0807e2c4318d4af8", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 16, "text": "恪以丹楊山險，民多果勁，雖前發兵，徒得外縣平民而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "2524849b2ca6f13b2f9bf9abf194513e764646a52e61977a813e65491329b7f2"}

{"id": "p_67db73f9422fe21d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 17, "text": "其餘深遠，莫能禽盡，屢自求乞為官出之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "fb9f08df4dbea55d28ef32c0f804d150bb42897381e0b49c340dc4d1005f5387"}

{"id": "p_dd19e4f6d2173f77", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 18, "text": "眾議咸以「丹楊地勢險阻，與吳郡、會稽、新都、鄱陽四郡鄰接，周旋數千里，山谷萬重，其幽邃民人，未嘗人城邑，對長吏，皆仗兵野逸，白首於林莽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "1b10131e02aac8892ef9ea34249d0439f42bb6435f1860c0500252ed12e5bf59"}

{"id": "p_c8065c8ef4ddcdde", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 19, "text": "俗好武習戰，高尚氣力，其升山赴險，抵突叢棘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "3d0faf0a03a73a6ee5d81b236156abfd8e6add42c362a827645e06a6fa5a9c98"}

{"id": "p_925ae5565a61f242", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 20, "text": "若魚之走淵，猿狖之騰木也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "1b86f8333d8f64031f62bfcf6bf31713d6e1228b9da1a6be12b6ceea68af8648"}

{"id": "p_5b5f0b73615b3cd7", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 21, "text": "時觀間隙，出為寇盜，每致兵征伐，尋其窟藏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "b99397f5751cbbe57a6d3cc2030026b4b29ac5e8def5f029e8915dc45a4a86b3"}

{"id": "p_c736368eab4dde5f", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 22, "text": "其戰則蜂至，敗則鳥竄，自前世以來，不能羈也」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "3f915d15f0a03e3eb70a36209e365942796a89d6293ddd411e94afccf2366317"}

{"id": "p_83fcf8e70b88da62", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 23, "text": "恪父瑾聞之，亦以事終不逮，歎曰：「恪不大興吾家，將大赤吾族也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "530465cbe6344c9ba728cc11f34f89122270281d0739af740b6c31d0f91aa768"}

{"id": "p_d71fb96f88318ce9", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 24, "text": "權拜恪撫越將軍，領丹楊太守，授棨戟武騎三百。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "1546e469e2bbd5b33431a54beea0299c830a8a8ee378c96bdcd0a15b0126b725"}

{"id": "p_8ecb29dc06940fac", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 25, "text": "拜畢，命恪備威儀，作鼓吹，導引歸家，時年三十二。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "1880c788e7a9b4f59493735d40daf5bec2c2f9904e949358489eb5f0c437a5c6"}

{"id": "p_80b47c8e39250961", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 26, "text": "恪到府，乃移書四部屬城長空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "ff8f5b796cc578b2aa1a3b9bf4ce3a34976fce3e65fcd3b3a0814528097d92f3"}

{"id": "p_20a2958d66045f0d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 27, "text": "令各保其疆界，明立部伍，其從化平民，悉令屯居。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "a943a08923575358e9dccb89f96d042a63fd74d1cb040fe7c47b9a94f0437fc9"}

{"id": "p_4fc58ee31bd2cef9", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 28, "text": "乃分內諸將，羅兵幽阻，但繕藩籬，不與交鋒，候其穀稼將熟，輒縱兵芟刈，使無遺種。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "653e3d3a1bd70c0187f0a0fb95a48f33e60fa9d65aedb4003989dec52552dd8a"}

{"id": "p_c8f918afc47c9200", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 29, "text": "舊谷既盡，新田不收，平民屯居，略無所入，於是山民饑窮，漸出降首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "6cb2cacb0ba31a3ec6eb12e6a8fce5cb5febe6e1a4a23c114cc653efa730bb42"}

{"id": "p_933dfd2665cec6b2", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 30, "text": "恪乃復敕下曰：「山民去惡從化，皆當撫慰，徙出外縣，不得嫌疑，有所執拘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "d914dde854474795956edb31e935beac8bb251342cecbb2074181c088b9746f1"}
