{"id": "p_6c64a2d1d1ae0539", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」臼陽長胡伉得降民周遺，遺舊惡民，困迫暫出，內圖叛逆，伉縛送言府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "7044ed0fb624313d375f077bb29f964a75ccb3197d7433901220109e9335f018"}

{"id": "p_7cea5300f08a1e59", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 32, "text": "恪以伉違教，遂斬以徇，以狀表上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "2cfcced8ee953f9d83e4d7c543bbd19f660f85bac750d78f46866cac8babfc48"}

{"id": "p_13511e25525f74ec", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 33, "text": "民聞伉坐執人被戮，知官惟欲出之而已，於是老幼相攜而出，歲期，人數皆如本規。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "b6414e29f0516e1611481a755b5adb5fe7518fbac7d56340c35e2e84dc40de21"}

{"id": "p_501b9a96f5a39be4", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 34, "text": "恪自領萬人，餘分給諸將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "83a054e2e77494962ae9f8517c4f8bb281ba67f56b10e3e1cfb4cf6cce5807f2"}

{"id": "p_7e3e555e04ead462", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 35, "text": "權嘉其功，遣尚書僕射薛綜勞軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "a767203e24b4454547baec55681896ee44d3bd9c9b34fe97d2bdc470a3cd13a3"}

{"id": "p_c33b146fc64057be", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 36, "text": "拜恪威北將軍，封都鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "4f6a69c238b4dabad4d556801e95a2a8d671385a655db81d5376fc8a9f4070c1"}

{"id": "p_2d3478132bf4fc79", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 37, "text": "恪乞率眾佃廬江皖口，因輕兵襲舒，掩得其民而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "c2c1daa8c2f34ada4bd551d698d2e2427ff1e0bbac18bb6e177e64b1e91dd4de"}

{"id": "p_bde963397f916955", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 38, "text": "復遠遣斥候，觀相徑要，欲圖壽春，權以為不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "7398ba755ae70c61ec183a8d1510c34e654f914eb07f8c2cf72ee049d967f2be"}

{"id": "p_63d9318fc0a82074", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 39, "text": "赤烏中，魏司馬宣王謀欲攻恪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "0d59fdea93e6ab16e5cbae7fc8ee1a314dca9dbc225691f0b4793624e0b31723"}

{"id": "p_83de8fdc4bf62019", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 40, "text": "權方發兵應之，望氣者以為不利，於是徒恪屯於柴桑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "ffa077bedc55350ad5532466cafa3678b2cf48c14913895bbc58cb1a94613876"}

{"id": "p_27173350da9722b2", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 41, "text": "恪知遜以此嫌己，故遂廣其理而贊其旨也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "eecc8369d8c7d44b1dd8d43069699c29b8e6b1a3e76a6256719fdc2401452bc5"}

{"id": "p_612bea9226eefdd5", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 42, "text": "會遜卒，恪遷大將軍，假節，駐武昌，代遜領荊州事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "4d0764f9f580b62156e836d3874196a52c8b3d3eb473f6d309bc9bec08161900"}

{"id": "p_bccec02755de9b27", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 43, "text": "久之，權不豫，而太子少，乃徵恪以大將軍領太子太傅，中書令孫弘領少傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "14e5d426451b0b0d5afb0cb96b161b47e263dd5ecdbaa8b35c874eefa428bb38"}

{"id": "p_2c3136d12a0117e1", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 44, "text": "權疾困，召恪、弘及太常滕胤、將軍呂據、侍中孫峻，屬以後事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "ad0b9000f0f0d9afd7f416263c820c006eb8abf2e29f6a9a42126600cc948688"}

{"id": "p_5ecf196ee3fa2ba9", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 45, "text": "弘素與恪不平，懼為恪所治，秘權死問，欲矯詔除恪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "4cb23d1805c40a77b0a9d01608eab9186ae78398ef5bc1c0fb93bb8321d6b53e"}

{"id": "p_61142cc2e55b9672", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 46, "text": "峻以告恪，恪請弘諮事，於坐中誅之，乃發喪制服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "31ea1f89747ca732c288af6d0f8d0d0a6a53df48f23b34a28440a96e58d46019"}

{"id": "p_644b46d3272b9e68", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 47, "text": "於是罷視聽，息校官，原逋責，除關稅，事崇恩澤，眾莫不悅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "e61ee483098d66371cbf45b8167035c62c4cb5e9937b53724166c0a047354295"}

{"id": "p_c2bc9388046f092e", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 48, "text": "恪每出入，百姓延頸思見其狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "b0807d4659320a039c1f6eb496e242759b4fa3aa22308f568e52597967a65de2"}

{"id": "p_b4121c94d6369385", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 49, "text": "後徵淮南，敗，以內船，由是廢不復修。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "401944ad7583333b363a565764dec7284592a802b4d685ad7b1e2fcbefcc7423"}

{"id": "p_7a95c49daf595e10", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 50, "text": "恪以十月會眾於東興，更作大堤，左右結山俠築兩城，各留千人，使全端、留略守之，引軍而還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "abdda701e3dbb4db11b8cce7939a0523c125129a3f5481c2eead09c30ae07c86"}

{"id": "p_2c7b7452fcb75e75", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 51, "text": "魏以吳軍入其疆土，恥於受侮，命大將胡遵、諸葛誕等率眾七萬，欲攻圍兩塢，圖壞堤遏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "380644ff76cf8fedca428942cda3366d778a4367e5f27c26bbfb72b551825054"}

{"id": "p_f86fdc3ccc2a5923", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 52, "text": "遵等敕其諸軍作浮橋度，陳於堤上，分兵攻兩城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "d301095c9ac52f30500e72b4d6ec254f049744bdf45b33e9b2a135aba5c1d07d"}

{"id": "p_9d4d352fa9446ef7", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 53, "text": "恪遣將軍留贊、呂據、唐諮、丁奉為前部。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "f58390a4ecdc1d0f2b1042f7cd807bc7cc2d58397cfb75895dcd40de40054e89"}

{"id": "p_d741f0962ca67d06", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 54, "text": "時天寒雪，魏諸將會飲，見贊等兵少，而解置鎧甲，不持矛戟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "14769d94376981462cf420a5b351de1c572b9237882d941e6e24a7c12fcfc148"}

{"id": "p_e2db139ca3cabd57", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 55, "text": "但兜鍪刀楯，夥身緣遏，大笑之，不即嚴兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "35fdf6f2a73659bd080a00dc19e5dadc5f4ebd258a7e81171e83f77f90ebedfc"}

{"id": "p_35af2b71da69b6a8", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 56, "text": "魏軍驚擾散走，爭渡浮橋，橋壞絕，自投於水，更相蹈藉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "808aab53c3722ef6ccc7b8d060bc4057bc253ac0ea6d189bad20c56c25cfdec8"}

{"id": "p_1e2c06b75ba70876", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 57, "text": "樂安太守桓嘉等同時並沒，死者數萬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "e4b31e52ad48fdee591a60765eda8b1eb38a81c6713c255ee40988a23cd6b6e5"}

{"id": "p_064c3b27c9216f8c", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 58, "text": "故叛將韓綜為魏前軍督，亦斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "c9c9b87bd8464c4e09c55eba846ef0c73a4428e7888667b2378604d0f0b2be0c"}

{"id": "p_dc1da4d3d8909d42", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 59, "text": "獲車乘牛馬驢騾各數千，資器山積，振旅而歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "4da7ecc9463ac853dcf1a5ef0f691f2bfa878dca4e72aa0914b20775774c6dba"}

{"id": "p_c3930a5b0dece10d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 60, "text": "進封恪陽都侯，加荊揚州牧，督中外諸軍事，賜金一百斤，馬二百匹，繒佈各萬匹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "f0fbc2546c8b1c95d489b153a1d51b17bf47138eb0a61b8f65c3d7e411fe202a"}

{"id": "p_23ece0eaf137d2c8", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 61, "text": "恪遂有輕敵之心，以十二月戰克，明年春，復欲出軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "d5a986e2f90eb531dd517e2b92f14385d3ee9e65bbfa171cbc1a13e50c4d9388"}

{"id": "p_4b7f3c1ef8a68a3d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 62, "text": "諸大臣以為數出罷勞，同辭諫恪，恪不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "910601c4b42c6a238c9632c3aeb5918b753c38f36bff624d0a960ff31358854e"}

{"id": "p_06da8551e5dca0af", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 63, "text": "中散大夫蔣延或以固爭，扶出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "2b817e6181d6f6a01570397fdb5c793f74de7328597da56eef27fa0095345f34"}

{"id": "p_92b75ea54ae85b81", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 64, "text": "眾皆以恪此論欲必為之辭，然莫敢復難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "18bb7902bfca5cb50c610126e8edc872f100eb1a417442f22805829b6986372a"}

{"id": "p_02273e85142b28ac", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 65, "text": "書諫恪曰：「大行皇帝本有遏東關之計，計未施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "c30fe763099f2bc8eb7dac61b0886f2e2073a0b4191cadb15e81d2fe624b97a4"}

{"id": "p_719fb5f40febedd3", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 66, "text": "今公輔贊大業，成先帝之志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "b211e683e45220106ceb9069db6e44c7a49a87f3dbd6db49e4a4862e318cf196"}

{"id": "p_4030be75aeb82f75", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 67, "text": "寇遠自送，將士憑賴威德，出身用命，一旦有非常之功，豈非宗廟神靈社稷之福邪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "5246cb19e52cfa349ef6a8473bdc0dd75e3147d081f1a7d7cb10f8f50a5a3f1a"}

{"id": "p_56644a20736d5175", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 68, "text": "宜且案兵養銳，觀釁而動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "621439460e784e3a4b75893ce4d1bff250b2f5657264fd94467b8c2c952e842d"}

{"id": "p_39ec9902a1bf750b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 69, "text": "今乘此勢欲復大出，天時未可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "b5add345ca74eaa1a27f3a95bd4f2fcb47531a4b7e9078af813566faa5d701e1"}

{"id": "p_4cda3c4ece552583", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 70, "text": "而苟任盛意，私心以為不安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "e738ddd9e23de2a5b789d8b5eb7b8c7371fcb58e8442c96d90a7a2a9fb54084b"}

{"id": "p_1ac6614366734240", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」恪題論後，為書答友曰：「足下雖有自然之理，然未見大數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "36310d64106072eda8dd5cf74d2501cd60435fd4afa13dd780cfdae4e5342d9d"}

{"id": "p_186c56af8e408403", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 72, "text": "」於是違眾出軍，大發州郡二十萬眾，百姓騷動，始失人心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "5acd349aef7b52d3507bdd272bc6f09f8d3734756bbf626c3d144d24f2684e97"}

{"id": "p_6b1b05c4cdc46281", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 73, "text": "恪意欲曜威淮南，驅略民人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "f9ff3adb4d7002d605179429dd52376a2db12f002ea830e5fd76272e41963f50"}

{"id": "p_7282c3197d254e6d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 74, "text": "而諸將或難之曰：「今引軍深入，疆場之民，必相率遠遁，恐兵勞而功少，不如止圍新城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "e75b218c8d4ed6634eb6a46221baae6e185937e31ea70602215b02a6595d08b3"}

{"id": "p_0acec0a14bbd5814", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 75, "text": "新城困，救必至，至而圖之，乃可大獲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "5812ec512208104ef0b741f14b4ed6d43be2e58fbbeb012cb253805c6984cd82"}

{"id": "p_38351348a344393b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 76, "text": "」恪從其計，回軍還圍新城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "a89f233e0591d17067fe38fe43f1206d286d71f7a4052ae23323b4dfd7d33f40"}

{"id": "p_44c8bcb0c485c527", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 77, "text": "士卒疲勞，因暑飲水，洩下、流腫，病者大半，死傷塗地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "9d8be77bf73258f04f5df1c4980d848feec03ddb6cb61ae02f5c9b3efdd7e599"}

{"id": "p_83859c21ddb2bb0a", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 78, "text": "諸營吏日白病者多，恪以為作，欲斬之，自是莫敢言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "87e323cdbf8fdf8d28f2550d7a54141c858d9f4a1a780532cc30c47807f6f225"}

{"id": "p_867f8f3708b8c37b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 79, "text": "恪內惟失計，而恥城不下，忿形於色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "0ae970b434afd277b329bfc5602a52c1bec0f128e7cfd311c5c2edd1988836f9"}

{"id": "p_2132bb6d76836481", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 80, "text": "將軍朱異有所是非，恪怒，立奪其兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "292956cb12a4548747cdf40c56132bc1f5cd8b35098cc6f6cec3c59a0d6bd508"}

{"id": "p_61c720e6a05d3487", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 81, "text": "都尉蔡林數陳軍計，恪不能用，策馬奔魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "88a2a231685b7206b19c2dbb7b13f2d0b4b62eab214a26d0fab87f0ac6104349"}

{"id": "p_81cec3997e022655", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 82, "text": "魏知戰士罷病，乃進救兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "cf99ff042ef2c9471de3fce1486e35c57212bc0250690b10380b747544c0155e"}

{"id": "p_2c421b0e80274780", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 83, "text": "士卒傷病，流曳道路，或頓僕坑壑，或見略獲，存記忿痛，大小呼嗟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "5f564a8446c151dd9770a93cd06e6388e25bdfaaa8f439a8998cd285d59f4969"}

{"id": "p_3583055bdce92069", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 84, "text": "出住江渚一月，圖起田於潯陽，詔召相銜，徐乃旋師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "eaacf75e8903dd8eb6f217576ec49bf26ad353767320ed1187fe3695b41e4923"}

{"id": "p_97342389ed8f095c", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 85, "text": "由此眾庶失望，而怨黷興矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "49d8523351984aa6066330a4cb91a7408c72cb1b6f7fa5e0015d42aee56a581b"}

{"id": "p_760b78d956276f38", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 86, "text": "秋八月軍還，陳兵導從，歸入府館。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "0fe751e346ba538dd85dbf4bdd7194fb1b5b28508bded03e8358172f22f47adb"}

{"id": "p_dec7c1066340737d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 87, "text": "即召中書令孫嘿，厲聲謂曰：「卿等何敢妄數作詔？", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "8a89fcf3e62ab121a208c990722472caa4bb64b58f12a0cbc86fbe080104b476"}

{"id": "p_c751dd2933044e0d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 88, "text": "」嘿惶懼辭出，因病還家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "5dc3906e98980b6a2db04eb9a1077f39c40167b9d6cdd0f1724d754f503277e6"}

{"id": "p_59b6f1a412eefce0", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 89, "text": "恪徵行之後，曹所奏署令長職司，一罷更選，愈治威嚴，多所罪責，當進見者無不竦息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "288c5ad03ad9c32a0d4d1f5075754e293a1e056f200a4771e2fb56c6c75944de"}

{"id": "p_79fe77f2dc4fa56a", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 90, "text": "孫峻因民之多怨，眾之所嫌，構恪欲為變，與亮謀，置酒請恪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "931ac7dd14d03695a7a3cf8a4e8d9dca467a41b713bde32abef6c16de76bd5eb"}

{"id": "p_c8bd1ba6bc88ef32", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 91, "text": "恪將見之夜，精爽擾動，通夕不寐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "feb14e52fafa489b4d0649e44b6660597a11d7144b5635a9773f0d71b8a8ac8b"}

{"id": "p_b0a072183158caf1", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 92, "text": "明將盥漱，聞水腥臭，侍者授衣，衣服亦臭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "a97222d5918235fa9aad9e4a2f660af812975ae7bc9d6d911cd8dc8feda507ee"}

{"id": "p_28c6b61532a61660", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 93, "text": "恪怪其故，易衣易水，其臭如初，意惆悵不悅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "0e28902871efd2d99f388e6ca4998fc4f03fdf170a91b6f20f7da3f340d70e9f"}

{"id": "p_e96ed56e395c9535", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 94, "text": "嚴畢趨出，太銜引其衣，恪曰：「犬不欲我行乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "f56301d4db02f45c00cc1f188640ce3caa80742efabedf48aabfc86c6f45915f"}

{"id": "p_b8c3f7eda5b7c2c0", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」還坐，頃刻乃復起，犬又銜其衣，恪令從者逐犬，遂升車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "e7700b5be85f1d33c39e28b52a53520945b577dd56f0173a124063b769830c6b"}

{"id": "p_4a168e955648552b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 96, "text": "初，恪將徵淮南，有孝子著縗衣入其閣中，從者白之，令外詰問，孝子曰：「不自覺入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "773f5afd1f2a7644f8f15b10b06c5cc1027f756f9f5b3fa7536463fef457ca8c"}

{"id": "p_1eaee6cbf2675ed5", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」時中外守備，亦悉不見，眾皆異之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "6d09a8c5de0bc2afa2d50757a30e8cdb1611fff1c08e670f88f87d123984cbad"}

{"id": "p_1d42611f620128fd", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 98, "text": "出行之後，所坐廳事屋棟中折。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "06f6427f5be60c624adaae7c098c3c930ecd8e13d51e756693578b70476485a1"}

{"id": "p_b53e3c48e625dee7", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 99, "text": "自新城出住東興，有白虹見其船，還拜蔣陵，白虹復繞其車。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "3253db4c89a3258f0936f9d6ae7312ca42b089498e4ca2d8a56691a0a0c4d867"}

{"id": "p_9517449bb8f4ad13", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 100, "text": "及將見，駐車宮門，峻已伏兵於帷中，恐恪不時入，事洩，自出見恪曰：「使君若尊體不安，自可須後，峻當具白主上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "a132a5590cf93dbc6d8419cdf157b7edb4a48c1333e7caa81f68e654a0bbf194"}

{"id": "p_2505eb0b5f2af498", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 101, "text": "」散騎常侍張約、朱恩等密書與恪曰：「今日張設非常，疑有他故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "f8eaf89095710e5059b3f91c45183ffbc9b3c3dde14f09bebad8ecc556a16138"}

{"id": "p_4fa35cfbaee89752", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 102, "text": "未出路門，逢太常滕胤，恪曰：「卒腹痛，不任人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "0dcb4aafc9b3b57d33e487eb5b1e2c0efde68f91b851f5067bb7754a8a72e2c1"}

{"id": "p_c20d6faa74aaae81", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 103, "text": "」胤不知峻陰計，謂恪曰：「君自行旋未見，今上酒請君，君已至門，宜當力進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "5ff517dd16f726990028e2ebb2fcb9dc7c0c29980d4c9afda1e19110b1472129"}

{"id": "p_2583916787d316f7", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 104, "text": "」恪躊躇而還，劍履上殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "3160c109b7a30acf0e416ba9a3b8a31f45052bd24d3baf206062a433bb5b1a92"}

{"id": "p_c860ccd9cde90a53", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 105, "text": "設酒，恪疑未飲，峻因曰：「使君病未善平，當有常服藥酒，自可取之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "edfaab770407bc3f3fe6428abd890283a0a7fa9f269b08617f7ebfc7bc67da4a"}

{"id": "p_b959ecf17eb5c374", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」恪意乃安，別飲所齎酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "37682bbf7ada69f3243bffe0dd2b1f8a8b29dfc614b8e82e818a3fe6ac8515d0"}

{"id": "p_a05676c92e3d642b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 107, "text": "酒數行，亮還內，峻起如廁，解長衣，著短服，出曰：「有詔收諸葛恪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "846a23829358c7396797ebcb27f1d74c6a6b1b2428a57043f61fd7a05d0d92c7"}

{"id": "p_b227308e8e712e03", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 108, "text": "」恪驚起，拔劍未得，而峻刀交下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "fe7d54d29d17ef174c0092f6712625ae568ed311ac617397d4b1e523bab59c1d"}

{"id": "p_9a5a460467daf57e", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 109, "text": "張約從旁斫峻，裁傷左手，峻應手斫約斷右臂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "21c565ff58ebe002d5ff4c0af024348b75ed83636108fec183aed30a93ce9c3e"}

{"id": "p_11bbda3693869b77", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 110, "text": "武衛之士皆趨上殿，峻云：「所取者恪也，今已死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "728122fab896416a1b871498ad2a8200c25ebb2509a2d73b17e10ba5491ad440"}

{"id": "p_60c536a7c2b348ca", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 111, "text": "」悉令復刃，乃除地更飲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "c0a2dcea7c7eb7dacc0a7fbcc2212e9e27e88a46bafa26520dbcb7177dc2c38c"}

{"id": "p_c9cbf903de5daf07", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 112, "text": "先是，童謠曰：「諸葛恪，蘆葦單衣蔑鉤落，於何相求成子閣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "2daad4413a230cc506c29a7de96299eb4bffde2b6b4ce35e73841effae7611f8"}

{"id": "p_c9785bfd69579ee9", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」成子閣者，反語石子岡也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "84196bc9d6a4b6606a551855c72a2e0a009a1d7b5d04f956f1d79dd791c89de9"}

{"id": "p_27c595bf9ac9b56d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 114, "text": "建業面有長陵，名曰石子岡，葬者依焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "5de1c31fd64b155fcaac3344d476d1c5a6893555d067ae8c311853d682010024"}

{"id": "p_fe86057708a8ae9e", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 115, "text": "鉤落者，校飾革帶，世謂之鉤絡帶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "5c318200acf0d32be61c03fd7a556b77c341227c5ad6875bbe730a0e0bf84e0d"}

{"id": "p_e0b32d28f46cb028", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 116, "text": "恪果以葦席裹其身而篾束其腰，投之於此岡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "1fbcedf9fb28aabb32a285d163ecf2fa43ee9efede455b56ff3466ca54054f90"}

{"id": "p_284e50fd7c6545d8", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 117, "text": "恪長子綽，騎都尉，以交關魯王事，權遣付恪，令更教誨，恪鴆殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "bb885803bdec7bdabb70ea0bdbf5fa9fd4ef4312f2617963e3a7dd81b86e7810"}

{"id": "p_05e86c11f5c6a693", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 118, "text": "峻遣騎督承追斬竦於白都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "ed3af65dda66a86402fd6e17479dda9bc21c7d7ba93445473720002702c735a1"}

{"id": "p_16f31ec3d3e81245", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 119, "text": "建得渡江，欲北走魏，行數千里，為追兵所逮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "1b499f07fff08975a5e8fba503ea9d838d0d192e399abc9a2188db560bf54416"}

{"id": "p_31775b1f0bfb3a45", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 120, "text": "恪外甥都鄉侯張震及常侍朱恩等，皆夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "1441359fd1969ab047a6f24f2138785bfd1d95e92af7efab75276d5f6a952cdb"}

{"id": "p_5b0b827a73287c30", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 121, "text": "初，竦數諫恪，恪不從，常憂懼禍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "fed7fe4f3583cc0ac7410160171c2a35fd7c2c31b4f5bfa8b24d29c1f2f410a1"}

{"id": "p_72cf418405b3f441", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 122, "text": "及亡，臨淮臧均表乞收葬恪曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "fc9c909f9339f5e96881a45f22738895524b353ee2415e413c1668e7a7a9f112"}

{"id": "p_6c461fe28e0127da", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 123, "text": "於是亮、峻聽恪故吏斂葬，遂求之於石子岡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "8336f83204e2f134a6b7239d3e573cef486c252b531d4d8d126b6343072cfdde"}

{"id": "p_9ea6b4352b546764", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 124, "text": "始恪退軍還，聶友知其將敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "e1507279d5d333be44991e40c8297ead6a03c88ba74008b3ca5fcba7ab83a7e0"}

{"id": "p_92f462fedfb1d813", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 125, "text": "書與滕胤曰：「當人強盛，河山可拔，一朝羸縮，人情萬端，言之悲歎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "381a38a49080f1f36743f8849bcd05a6bfc5717bf8227eeef48026d7a18672a4"}

{"id": "p_26e3baa2a8375bdf", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 126, "text": "」恪誅後，孫峻忌友，欲以為鬱林太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "753e572be32c22cd6ebb3ebc24050fb3acb00878d30bf037ca2801278f8d4ca3"}

{"id": "p_334d18b4e612473f", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 127, "text": "滕胤字承嗣，北海劇人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "aa0047f9325c386b0aae4b68d40281a486ddb736855b9f090c26d9634825b31c"}

{"id": "p_a7f2485ff9cb37fb", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 128, "text": "伯父耽，父冑，與劉繇州裡通家。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "4d0de64281d061e3d4411d392275e343b43269506eb622cb274d9e603c875751"}

{"id": "p_4437567382a1cdbe", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 129, "text": "孫權為車騎將軍，拜耽右司馬，以寬厚稱，早卒，無嗣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "e4c7d5270cfbf1b99d88e10bb6cc35ead0410bed7c1013278ac66fe518bfd2a6"}

{"id": "p_d60f64bebe1213b1", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 130, "text": "冑善屬文，權待以賓禮，軍國書疏，常令損益潤色之，亦不幸短命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "8fe560473608763510ed844b421b49f720e8212f2a7dc5f6d4a8a11a6e074aa8"}

{"id": "p_0fd4b52c82735f86", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 131, "text": "權為吳王，迫錄舊恩，封胤都亭侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "02ada48c1fa74ece638f0cdf06b954b4215314ed26035ff4d10ae6ffe85435f9"}

{"id": "p_356b1c1396c669ba", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 132, "text": "年三十，起家為丹楊太守，徙吳郡、會稽，所在見稱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "e904a5a23a2fa9e69f7fd3115cea12662c5a2cb98c8525deec6633285b09a218"}

{"id": "p_b4107a48634f39aa", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 133, "text": "，權寢疾，詣都，留為太常；與諾葛恪等俱受遺詔輔政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "9717b37df714202d5ba59dbae499ab0baac2d6fd2e684940b07d939dc09cfc58"}

{"id": "p_bd81508b38594559", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 134, "text": "胤諫恪曰：「君以喪代之際，受伊、霍之託，入安本朝，出摧強敵，名聲振於海內，天下莫不震動，萬姓之心，冀得蒙君而息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "ebe24a325ecb16d7be56943aabcf93cbfcbaa105a5a4c2c4b2be6b8c39feff18"}

{"id": "p_971c50dddf62b094", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 135, "text": "今猥以勞役之後，興師出征，民疲力屈，遠主有備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "fbe3f93f0ba5cafc1937448ceb71b7c2c5b814d385f82cbeccdb15460f4f0a75"}

{"id": "p_05da3e33f7066452", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 136, "text": "若攻城不克，野略無獲，是喪前勞而招後責也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "b934014c2e4d29cd238bf54aa21bc6360ba02c33f36bcc50e353acd506a003de"}

{"id": "p_951fdef71b04aab6", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 137, "text": "不如案甲息師，觀隙而動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "a7cfc57de4c9861c4365d96d5cae896db71777e27b4e55aadeb24c3836ca7b8b"}

{"id": "p_27ef0668cc6ca98d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 138, "text": "且兵者大事，事以眾濟，眾苟不悅，君獨安之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "8b479c42aa2030a9a600079ad25017e1e477323076c36a7b588f3d2d3a057d88"}

{"id": "p_2ae6e15240bd2e8c", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 139, "text": "」恪曰：「諸雲不可者，皆不見計算，懷居苟安者也，而子復以為然，吾何望焉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "6171f011518d04a7ebe98718e5281e25104527c731909332b4decb3e9c526966"}

{"id": "p_ef3415d6b3408fb4", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 140, "text": "夫以曹勞暗劣，而政在私門，彼之臣民，固有離心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "8d04cd9302666f65c35493fc37d9acdd86db616811ba192b87d143236cb69aa6"}

{"id": "p_feac33734f99db0a", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 141, "text": "今吾因國家之資，借戰勝之威，則何往而不克哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "0531b6dc38dfad7ea78ff1bb5e0788c0a32dcb96c7ff23019ba09751f3f97cc1"}

{"id": "p_f51f9ed71728bb78", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 142, "text": "」以胤為都下督，掌統留事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "dd6134a858c3c30d6e131b5a7f90bea07a09f9c748e31a2e0a72fd143e06e0be"}

{"id": "p_5951be9bf6b76f85", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 143, "text": "胤白日接賓客，夜省文書，或通曉不寐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "c14ac16f87159a27cef196af5185313ab304d3a8b11bf60cf37ebfaa73baa442"}

{"id": "p_a9446d757e25f696", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 144, "text": "孫峻字子遠，孫堅弟靜之曾孫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "c4112f4560423d8b9a6436d15fcd430fa60629909e67df43e2fe69b2421ae190"}

{"id": "p_0703b5315b936d8c", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 145, "text": "靜生-{暠}-，-{暠}-生恭，為散騎侍郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "66047b3db804377fb1adcb6bb9ef0e4188fd8e096f7861cffdb5088d1d6b0d6d"}

{"id": "p_bde58d5fbb00b6e1", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 146, "text": "孫權末，徙武衛都尉，為侍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "d3a37825d5bef4a54c009110d735de2a361f6895ccc2fe32cefbbf9423d6bbf5"}

{"id": "p_688305e2d4ec6eda", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 147, "text": "權臨薨，受遺輔政，領武衛將軍，故典宿衛，封都鄉侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "73760c16493c0b67883f531112da35464b970bde4dab0f765cd4c6faf70d160d"}

{"id": "p_489b99a172152324", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 148, "text": "既誅諸葛恪，遷丞相大將軍，督中外諸軍事、假節，進封富春侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "3646abe91bbae1d3296521cfd169037354a254391148f55815124645592eb2f2"}

{"id": "p_239aa7042359d945", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 149, "text": "峻曰：「鯀、禹罪不相及，滕侯何為？", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "c339b97b7bd9a1b033553a10d6103bb71f042fb9b43ec3ac760a62d9984e926c"}

{"id": "p_c90e1b801856b117", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」峻、胤雖內不沾洽，而外相包容，進胤爵高密侯，共事如前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "53b9eea3c8f1900d95523ee1091507e583fa4e5be57dec3f16d1319dca4f6a3d"}

{"id": "p_1a7bfd3b29e473a5", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 151, "text": "峻素無重名，驕矜險害，多所刑殺，百姓囂然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "0ab78650f1079fc27757f2f911273321fe078003235a24ef5b30a5f9388c4d32"}

{"id": "p_afb451c6b789b0c1", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 152, "text": "又姦亂宮人，與公主魯班私通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "728fde88b14a9a298922183bf10217d5b8c7edde2b97b892100f4ce1fb01c4aa"}

{"id": "p_feb2b9803558d16c", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 153, "text": "，吳侯英謀殺峻，英事洩死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "39246aaa837faf066ae1e40f1650ee670ef4998fc2cc4ac01910d069bc62470d"}

{"id": "p_d0f53d30de3bcfeb", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 154, "text": "二年，魏毋丘儉、文欽以眾叛，與魏人戰於樂嘉，峻帥驃騎將軍呂據、左將軍留贊襲壽春，會欽敗降，軍還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "3f100fb3558bd4933660e1899f0590f2b6013f928a5e26870e21666fb77a1e9e"}

{"id": "p_58491c281ce791ae", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 155, "text": "是歲，蜀使來聘，將軍孫儀、孫邵綝恂等欲因會殺峻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "3dc339d280960340b275405bcc84a46d8cb0ef6312a160cf5e92334efa7b47aa"}

{"id": "p_9eb20669e6cd163f", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 156, "text": "事洩，儀等自殺，死者數十入，並及公主魯育。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "9406fe87004fabb48eea7f02c6b6584959444955bdc7029e16725c57e0565a8f"}

{"id": "p_037cc93f49318010", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 157, "text": "峻欲城廣陵，朝臣知其不可城，而畏之莫敢言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "143a6a7436c0af83364133f9979b45afe4d5e9009a37b4ac7e7570cd5ff02ed4"}

{"id": "p_f2c42ccd802131f8", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 158, "text": "唯滕胤諫止，不從，而功竟不就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "dbb7fe46fcba9e70f67a06785c3e409fbdd5f2a49e3cb34879c0c99d1d9057fd"}

{"id": "p_5882d1399d310280", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 159, "text": "其明年，文欽說峻徵魏，峻使欽與呂據、車騎劉纂、鎮南朱異、前將軍唐諮自江都人淮、泗，以圖青、徐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "e2eb621a6f982580023bc5d4b70d26103855c99dca10ee3424b2a363f3a24b18"}

{"id": "p_1245eb990d7e25b3", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 160, "text": "峻與胤至石頭，因餞之，領從者百許人入據營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "64b1de84590c1111273ef8cdb09934363ae3e58cf5c05269f0c4f5fd239c7819"}

{"id": "p_6b9605ebd752bfdb", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 161, "text": "據禦軍齊整，峻惡之，稱心痛去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "fca2c034dcd5e924ba616404bbcc872357f5b30517866727261849ba3c19d9ed"}

{"id": "p_5cb091b6411b045b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 162, "text": "遂夢為諸葛恪所擊，恐懼發病死，時年三十八，以後事付綝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "53fcf6d20d6cc701e8d7bc50ba52e0e190204ed4fc5978758f106b723bd8b6b2"}

{"id": "p_18a96f67f06197f6", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 163, "text": "綝始為偏將軍，及峻死，為待中武衛將軍，領中外諸軍事，代知朝政。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "a49bef5d5eb7a32bfa1b52acc102595e96b9a0c872dd988ed05973d10707ebdb"}

{"id": "p_4c57c8d8aed2af93", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 164, "text": "呂據聞之大恐，與諸督將連名，共表薦滕胤為丞相，綝以胤為大司馬，代呂岱駐武昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "a379be29f43cb4e28e18a5855db439fe5f40557132a1e03bfff22b2b2c371d2b"}

{"id": "p_2418cf8b30920311", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 165, "text": "據引兵還，使人報胤，欲共廢綝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "9829c4e98749c21c72f2c0daba14c146ab71a316ec2d96ba56cf9435a499974a"}

{"id": "p_01fb557a0c259011", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 166, "text": "綝聞之，遣從兄慮將兵逆據於江都，使中使敕文欽、劉纂、唐諮等合眾擊據，遣侍中左將軍華融、中書丞丁晏告胤取據，並喻胤宜速去意，胤自以禍及，因留融、晏，勒兵自衛，召典軍揚崇、將軍孫諮，告以綝為亂，迫融等使有書難綝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "57b5b9828b63f86bf39bdfcc8687f89c104a0a9e4cd7835278c0c96a99c158b5"}

{"id": "p_d669513bf479b70d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 167, "text": "綝不聽，表言胤反，許將軍劉丞以封爵，使率兵騎急攻圍胤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "f870b5375ec81136a5ebe64a791037a02b32f9223e5ae0060acbc8e284982876"}

{"id": "p_d976868d5373748e", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 168, "text": "或勸胤引兵至蒼龍門，「將士見公出，必皆委綝就公」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "2319b8cadd053773f12547fcafb741deb04c6ad7cfc0b4176f18d3418a81ee4b"}

{"id": "p_c2c2c0c98f9aefde", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 169, "text": "又難舉兵向富，乃約令部曲，說呂侯以在近道，故皆為胤盡死，無離散者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "275295eb5310383aeddaf8850a2b370cd9eac29a98fb98c592808d50b5cde489"}

{"id": "p_4f52a6669b5cc91d", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 170, "text": "綝兵大會，遂殺及將士數十人，夷胤三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "f9170c3e6ce8db3a91f0d58fed50ec6455452fe3b8641e45c7981412b41bf223"}

{"id": "p_6c72df3f7c9f194f", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 171, "text": "綝遷大將軍，假節，封永寧侯，負貴倨傲，多行無禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "023b73741b2a485f272858cd0e80b03900440f1a7a92cdb08f60dd0444a874c1"}

{"id": "p_250bc5313ce82a98", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 172, "text": "初，峻從弟慮與諸葛恪之謀，峻厚之，至右將軍、無難督，授節蓋，平九官事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "0a29261897835629813a043f64be5e649232fdc9994dbbf5e41201829d7599a9"}

{"id": "p_ed151d69bb230108", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 173, "text": "綝遇慮薄於峻時，慮怒，與將軍王惇謀殺綝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "1085da5c7ee60fd56bfc524c5a375f7a1cec0ddda0ba1bdec222b01ab95793ad"}

{"id": "p_85bb1905aecde236", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 174, "text": "魏大將軍諸葛誕舉壽春叛，保城請降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "21c005e9a10de36be462d84abba5968ec0fd0d110263715fd89a00b651cbe1c2"}

{"id": "p_521396f6fb5eb2ea", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 175, "text": "吳遣文欽、唐諮、全端、全懌等三萬人救之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "46fdbbc25671acd33c1023c62b10f4dd71d7e650d46751b611313bd12fe3c39a"}

{"id": "p_ba589fa58f4381d0", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 176, "text": "魏悉中外軍二十餘萬增誕之圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "a919447d99bd6710e7176a5b23603dc60d4fc6bbb2b624c699f7a8378d064e9c"}

{"id": "p_6f964efd7e7cdb74", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 177, "text": "朱異帥三萬人屯安豐城，為文欽勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "7a312dbb025dd1604155929006810e1ccd7cac7daa14cd10ff784e0c93e7bcf9"}

{"id": "p_a4114e05bb5ef883", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 178, "text": "魏兗州刺史州泰據異於陽淵，異敗退，為泰所追，死傷二干人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "3912dd4ad2c3c85ed750fb0b1e7c85b3ab9162a7709ef0e3e6570a839955aee2"}

{"id": "p_9f538b166115675c", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 179, "text": "林於是大發率出屯鑊裡，復遣異率將軍丁奉、黎斐等五萬人攻魏，留輜重於都陸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "1e1812c92390a362385082653c35dc3f66fe818c27693a25a649ec5b1ee0651f"}

{"id": "p_f9b8724834bf882c", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 180, "text": "異屯黎漿，遣將軍任度、張震等慕勇敢六千人，於屯西六里為浮橋夜渡，築偃月壘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "e1bc851425d1cc64208ecb4bfb706edcce4241ed6d7ecaf767ed90500e23c378"}

{"id": "p_1fef00bb7c6c5446", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 181, "text": "為魏監軍石苞及州泰所破，軍卻退就高。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "6f7197f1804178907b8085c583cfd048b683f063fc31152cf0b3a83bd51495b7"}

{"id": "p_54185f8c7fccb4b5", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 182, "text": "苞、泰攻異，異敗歸，而魏太山太守胡烈以奇兵五千詭道襲都陸，盡焚異資糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "d5751a2bd73d916983034811e2ddf67308c0a707b1d583f3f1e83f3ccc3df699"}

{"id": "p_ce3d2eb199454d37", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 183, "text": "綝授兵三萬人使異死戰，異不從，綝斬之於鑊裡，而遣弟恩救。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "183930ca2d576b7070951767409acc7e99a35daf26db70b7a0231163b7148ed0"}

{"id": "p_46d03d57c05f1788", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 184, "text": "綝既不能拔出誕，而喪敗士眾，自戮名將，莫不怨之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "b2598e89240746c860a2825fc137ae95a867c6cd058b6c351acd1d20fa3bf169"}

{"id": "p_9b74ae640a903548", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 185, "text": "綝以孫亮始親政事，多所難問，甚懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "69fa51fd6a15608c34893f42fe5f8adc5c65e519d9002b798fe62a3d9d38073a"}

{"id": "p_a0084b687c5a1386", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 186, "text": "築室幹朱雀橋南，使弟威遠將軍據入蒼龍宿衛，弟武衛將軍恩、偏將軍幹、長水校尉闓分屯諸營，欲以專朝自固。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "e34346c5c185c1257a1ddbc3a748c3cd438a537d34270cd67f5e644bf7921cff"}

{"id": "p_d98f79c53561bc92", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 187, "text": "亮內嫌綝，乃推魯育見殺本末，責怒虎林督朱熊、熊弟外部督朱損不匡正孫峻，乃令丁奉殺熊於虎林，殺損於建業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "a99448e39a3a19358fb274c0cb243f5f9a8ef046baf6fe6d1aeb1a49235671ad"}

{"id": "p_6406efe637e2e5b0", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 188, "text": "綝入諫不從，亮遂與公主魯班、太常全尚、將軍劉承議誅綝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "aaf7119d5f62d117ccea065090f302eee52bc15c04cc4dfcb053be3e4da3a9b9"}

{"id": "p_dcacbbd41f37d76f", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 189, "text": "亮妃，綝從姊女也，以其謀告綝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "6d42d1c128c5996cf901d72b1dcbbea0687fe02ea0d26dae9e9f8db2c127a44a"}

{"id": "p_e19ca09d4f3606a8", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 190, "text": "綝率眾夜襲全尚，遣弟恩殺劉承於蒼龍門外，遂圍宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "49e9e26cec851b296ff40b4b7ad805d9472af4d39b14290534cbd757d2d1df3a"}

{"id": "p_939c5111ecfb240a", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 191, "text": "使光祿勳盂宗告廟廢亮，召群司儀曰：「少帝荒病昏亂，不可以處大位，承宗廟，以告先帝廢之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "29dbf862520a68e57d75d6fe90ae3f3f2b2cad14d50f8e7f68c0495e9faf45f2"}

{"id": "p_d53a563edbb5c810", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 192, "text": "諸君若有不同者，下異議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "9a3e4e07d96cd1c73068d2911c3682000fb8b9cf5e19142922dadd6b63386da4"}

{"id": "p_3ad6e737626d5339", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 193, "text": "」綝遣中書郎李祟奪亮璽綬，以亮罪狀班告遠近。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "dc48fe4450244f24b47bf7582e54d2f5d6c7d7895e88344a363b43a90ad97294"}

{"id": "p_bfbb41203bd88153", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 194, "text": "尚書桓彝不肯署名，綝怒殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "aecae5aa2ea00a499d0d48c933c6e32f4aae2fab0644553390a5fb178a68bdd6"}

{"id": "p_a70b6458eebbf75b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 195, "text": "典軍施正勸綝徵立琅邪王休，綝從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "5aa07c31cdd639d5097d68e82dee908fe021794b9df5be2adfb40a304120495e"}

{"id": "p_cc494019dc6d2cab", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 196, "text": "綝遣將軍孫耽送亮之國，徙尚於零陵，遷公主於豫章。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "5cce488f1525fa4c58f4ef6bf00d4d022fd261759a072d79cfd3ea00e54c4680"}

{"id": "p_0fb5a1cf7da402dd", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 197, "text": "綝意彌溢，侮慢民神，遂燒大橋頭伍子胥廟，又壞浮屠祠，斬道人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "70355920ebade6deb28d1edee4884dc04b4560d4490fb95317156fdfb9c81f5f"}

{"id": "p_7f03391874113f86", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 198, "text": "詣闕上書曰：「臣伏自省，才非干國，因緣肺腑，位極人臣，傷錦敗駕，罪負彰露，尋愆惟闕，夙夜憂懼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "fde65c72b7b79d33179414e9cfdfcec872d40256499a047a3c5e5744a1075cb7"}

{"id": "p_6ae6cf647bd3155e", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 199, "text": "臣聞天命棐諶，必就有德，是以幽、厲失度，閡宣中興，陛下聖德，纂承大統，宜得良輔；以協雍熙，雖堯之盛，猶求稷契之佐；以協明聖之德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "2d70ca190c8787a1bc85e4d0b42ce8b6711863b14a441eae3b28a0bd23009312"}

{"id": "p_8287241f7bdb694c", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 200, "text": "古人有言：『陳力就列，不能者止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "785105b8fe530499b661a392e546d8b21e7d80a731eb5be93f06dd1faed57c1e"}

{"id": "p_ed773df06a420782", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 201, "text": "』臣雖自展竭，無益庶政，謹上印綬節鉞，退還田裡，以避賢路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "65ef74599b71e897d1b2a854bf552dae32fc77b50f4ff7292d5dfa5dc35d2396"}

{"id": "p_2627817c5fba9dce", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 202, "text": "又下詔曰：「朕以不德，守藩於外，值茲際會，群公卿士，暨於朕躬，以奉宗廟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "36b306e67e912abcd426f6e383ffb664894762b88a46c7147f8a94a8bff65d6b"}

{"id": "p_2328cc71c17306a6", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 203, "text": "大將軍忠計內發，扶危定傾，安康社稷，功勳赫然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "02fbc19c7725cdd161b04b13d9c26afa3599a451f354dccb0f722fc72c0e7ace"}

{"id": "p_a7c1ba9335c0df56", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 204, "text": "昔漢孝宣踐阼，霍光尊顯，褒德賞功，古今之通義也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "6b33b241f0ea22f1d29ec3106e0acfec463c9f9d79db8224632262ab7cc2298b"}

{"id": "p_a8d3725b01b61fe8", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 205, "text": "其以大將軍為丞相、荊州牧，食五縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "c30ce13a29283610b5700a6ef5def4261ff66a4b7463d5b030a4172ae0f1a4f4"}

{"id": "p_2b4bb4b95073a8e8", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 206, "text": "」恩為禦史大夫、衛將軍，據右將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "491b5a533a5ae265f83d369a006e3119b2932ace62716647084c41bfa220ce9b"}

{"id": "p_762007c06bfd3b1a", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 207, "text": "綝一門五侯，皆典禁兵，權傾人主，自吳國朝臣未嘗有也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "3ccc4142ec3662bb1fc51101f762d128a99d9feda7abface5ea0dbac2d752f64"}

{"id": "p_02472e27a82622a0", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 208, "text": "綝奉牛酒詣休，休不受，齎詣左將軍張布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "836c39fbfee82ba404194227e5f4133d4670f394b9242ce2e674b148e7f81746"}

{"id": "p_df364dc1b5567b97", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 209, "text": "酒酣，出怨言曰：「徹廢少主時，多勸吾自為之者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "e5c2f95fc2a68ae64ad2270fa8e9246a2ca845a53f207a2793da5d334e79a6dd"}

{"id": "p_9b243b3b6b072e7f", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 210, "text": "帝非我不立，今上禮見拒，是與凡臣無異，當復改圖耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "e3b2f6eda14050f5e8ad2f5b3cd241f38870c71648f06090b50ddd5f0519bcf6"}

{"id": "p_4ad108a1216ee77b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 211, "text": "鞏其有變，數加賞賜，又復加恩侍中，與綝分省文書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "55e8594e04169341afef1e7fbf1f77b1049ff636a960536dbe5240d13e597254"}

{"id": "p_ee18a7e7ddabad88", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 212, "text": "或有告綝懷怨侮上欲圖反者，休執以付綝，綝殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "baad4f076198fbf34e59b045d764edc15ec1943d5fa912cbb89a2e60fd4395cc"}

{"id": "p_7e6a19b619a991ba", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 213, "text": "由是愈懼，因孟宗求出屯武昌，休許焉，盡敕所督中營精兵萬餘人，皆令裝載，所取武庫兵器，咸令給與。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "112ce3ae97e844d66b78862a4a833e5aa2b3a94641f207a5759e97678ceaee30"}

{"id": "p_32df48d3b3427cb4", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 214, "text": "將軍魏邈說休曰「綝居外必有變」，武衛士施朔又告「綝欲反有徵」休密問張布，布與丁奉謀於會殺綝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "92a087e6684f67be7d21bc4ea031ac2043161aaa70cc42a6b8a7af528c4e95b9"}

{"id": "p_f0ad40f33fce5710", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 215, "text": "十二月丁卯，建業中謠言明會有變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "8f84ae4d1eca84bcd0874117caeef6cd57fa57cb7842654565eb265d7a34f3eb"}

{"id": "p_54a78ee06d10d5e9", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 216, "text": "夜大風發木揚沙，綝益恐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "61e68ecca15da73e5725f826cde63186cf6d3146611e9a5cf2faf6f382c0722f"}

{"id": "p_076f3c7ff50afcbd", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 217, "text": "綝不得已，將人，眾止焉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "86ed0856ac34dd5d7fb1d351340c2060fb3d673ab11bf275893aa8d41fc500a3"}

{"id": "p_b684920c123b4053", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 218, "text": "綝曰：「國家屢有命，不可辭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "66c5cabb704fd9963cd7d7c6ff9c11584fcac34995e919c42317a316d2bfd871"}

{"id": "p_1d5a0fcff2b97a7b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 219, "text": "可豫整兵，令府內起火，因是可得速還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "4b3434b5e6f2c4a8c747d8639385af8ecd1f4e20194346ceb2fbc75d90570951"}

{"id": "p_8997b8ec0c7e8fd6", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 220, "text": "」遂入，尋而火起，綝求出，休曰：「外兵自多，不足煩丞相也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "f6f189d76975d05ae1e10872a9c348bcd4ed65c942f4cee9d4d9d7b99601274f"}

{"id": "p_1b5328fecf0f941c", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 221, "text": "」綝起離席，奉、布目左右縛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "35e8086e9a7149a9a8103771a3b9ebe6a2158ee55a17f864e73c6f33049e4585"}

{"id": "p_3517a117440d33be", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 222, "text": "」休曰：「卿何以不徙滕胤、呂據？", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "2e77d6efac34eaffb2cd30ee05c357347aa0ff1d9131507ea829749d421d9145"}

{"id": "p_7248e196ef94ee9a", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 223, "text": "」綝復曰：「願沒為官奴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "e621ced0c897702b41370c54c1b64087d183588ed417a58382e5ff981a127194"}

{"id": "p_657c63caf71a2017", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 224, "text": "」休曰：「何不以胤、據為奴乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "dccc07eab7853fc64c36a066cb5c25094b7cf4b48c7ed9c5e3b90c903a4f0de3"}

{"id": "p_9d79f725da0dde95", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 225, "text": "以綝首令其眾曰：「諸與綝同謀皆赦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "5ddcec9407182b932ed88fc757222c865e6df3046a644ac73178d7eef4e1e67f"}

{"id": "p_07c96dbe3850c97b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 226, "text": "發孫峻棺，取其印綬，綝其木而埋之，以殺魯育等故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "3a5926e103ef030268bccbb0f025627863a3b4937aa129bc19073b57f2ce76c5"}

{"id": "p_a05821c280096743", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 227, "text": "休耽與峻、綝同族，特除其屬籍，稱之曰故峻、故綝-{云}-。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "cc863a9e6a07561216a4ae17f8e0fce66e1b67f9e14433ee11766272347308b4"}

{"id": "p_0a8980d4099e3809", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 228, "text": "休又下詔曰：「諸葛恪、滕胤、呂據蓋以無罪為峻、綝兄弟所見殘害，可為痛心，促皆改葬，各為祭奠。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "80c75808d5e465c1bcfc3e765fd0eac924a3f257a622cc19e08d9881590dadb7"}

{"id": "p_1c4a22e7fcda6997", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 229, "text": "其罹恪等事見遠徙者，一切召還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "45907d6a4c23ba1c98655986ffbeb37dbb2a3a612a9e834d873037e0d27a933a"}

{"id": "p_0006d2ebbff44fca", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 230, "text": "濮陽興字子元，陳留人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "2d29aad2674245924530574d0085dd42fd7630b300b69d0bcd8579d24cc0b9b9"}

{"id": "p_470ec257488279f0", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 231, "text": "父逸，漢末避亂江東，官至長沙太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "ab761533f5d0acae9b4e06305c63b6cbf8f4551bd877db22a356ad0bf0bf1338"}

{"id": "p_5e9cd2c0d9d1ee0f", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 232, "text": "興少有士名，孫權時除上虞令，稍遷至尚書左曹，以五官中郎將使蜀，還為會稽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "6d8e7e76a6a29e4d091ac43026263a4744405ab62ec93195b3dfe6c41da806bd"}

{"id": "p_b754886c8cb1a680", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 233, "text": "時琅邪王休居會稽，興深與相結。", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "ae9ebe90142703b4dfc176eec429770774e53359dedd36ad9f362ec882f7cb27"}

{"id": "p_b6d4c85eb7f91bbf", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 234, "text": "及休即位，徵興為太常衛將軍、平軍國事，封外黃侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "68f67e616c88750d7abd307d34b4e56d18b121ffa29cc0897cc7bcbd5a8ba3a9"}

{"id": "p_176ecb5bb4650409", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 235, "text": "，都尉嚴密建丹楊湖田，作浦裡塘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 235}, "text_hash": "daf4e5a8a2b37001c0a4cab46bb0e8e2bad285dfdaac4af270b33a2d88d7cbaf"}

{"id": "p_b3b5a79649d33d6a", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 236, "text": "詔百官會議，咸以為用功多而田不保成，唯興以為可成。", "locator": {"ordinal": 236}, "text_hash": "58de500454c9a2eb0164043ef99670182a1d0b9ae3dcca634527f9a3bf795acd"}

{"id": "p_293236a2acc4dcdf", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 237, "text": "遂會諸兵民就作，功傭之費不可勝數，士卒死亡，或自賊殺，百姓大怨之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 237}, "text_hash": "87433bc09b95a9658713bda1ed9c95a828d0aadf9e5f78c82447cff7d60cf9e1"}

{"id": "p_f8728738421bdd9b", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 238, "text": "興遷為丞相，與休寵臣左將軍張共布相表裡，邦內失望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 238}, "text_hash": "ebaac645efa61f658d9c9a05f4b28f6ca1982998fedd48b1b9aaf8d177a5c84d"}

{"id": "p_687251ac880b06cc", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 239, "text": "左典軍萬彧素與烏程侯孫皓善，乃勸興、布，於是興、布廢休適子而迎立皓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 239}, "text_hash": "278e147a57cb1adb74e6e00c594c021ade314f6457b6f1a4b8d843b27898224e"}

{"id": "p_ce6220acdb7ec0b3", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 240, "text": "皓既踐阼，加興侍中，領青州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 240}, "text_hash": "55b060c41800c5546e9fbb7fe58d9105963652a085c0c5411b2912af1a918c79"}

{"id": "p_ea46e5525b06e7ce", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 241, "text": "十一朔入朝，皓因收興、布，徙廣州，道追殺之，夷三族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 241}, "text_hash": "46bd4a7b3a9a739f770a34fb12454b0a240e4ee95287c6c8d9e148f946008e2e"}

{"id": "p_4fef374771110fe8", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 242, "text": "評曰：諸葛恪才氣幹略，邦人所稱，然驕且吝，周公無觀，況在於恪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 242}, "text_hash": "3287eabfa5b6285222f36b97bff744a7a549d767955fddfd697252f6fb9f6b3e"}

{"id": "p_dcd4a2410738b64f", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 243, "text": "若躬行所與陸遜及弟融之書，則悔吝不至，何尤禍之有哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 243}, "text_hash": "69049e24075a30501ba0621f04952606c51bc76a4687d72c30a50cf0ee3c1cb8"}

{"id": "p_5e0419cf71e1df43", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 244, "text": "滕胤厲修士操，遵蹈規矩，而孫峻之時猶保其貴，必危之理也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 244}, "text_hash": "f19402145d23cad6e79057ab7ceaf368f15495e60e92aedc3844ccd6b12eb691"}

{"id": "p_c02e32475e6547fd", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 245, "text": "峻、綝兇豎盈溢，固無足論者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 245}, "text_hash": "968c3241573b05befac3cfac94bf501ac9f3c8fea19f9bf0d7a88cea0a4c1ef1"}

{"id": "p_6b90dacf46ed2398", "source_id": "src_65d2dde4fbd460ba", "ordinal": 246, "text": "濮陽興身居宰輔，慮不經國，協張布之邪，納萬彧之說，誅夷其宣矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 246}, "text_hash": "4a5629092337d91691796dadd714cbf960d3a5813234ac8057e3f264e89987e1"}

{"id": "p_a5683269c35853af", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 0, "text": "孫休即位，與賀邵、薛瑩、虞汜俱為散騎中常侍，皆加駙馬都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "a5507fa3bad0cb5b863b6fee51a42803a8a202c9af3460f6b3438bc9b84c84af"}

{"id": "p_827ba57fd30b3545", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 1, "text": "遣使至蜀，蜀人稱焉，還為夏口監軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "872eaa229b0732070593c790b29030eef26293659f07d04431bd5c1cdbf6f4bc"}

{"id": "p_073dad0f622d950e", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 2, "text": "復入為常侍，與萬彧同官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "12ea3378a4f3fd8bc288ab2c0745c3fd7684a4ccc3a11041394012e3a1142b4b"}

{"id": "p_b3e10e1a199879b4", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 3, "text": "彧與皓有舊，俗士挾侵，謂蕃自輕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "20fb34936f8e4ce3f221528cc250b3905d96aeea9b7bee337c1e0105bc300bd5"}

{"id": "p_51211592ecc3d935", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 4, "text": "又中書丞陳聲，皓之嬖臣，數譖毀蕃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "b4f9eaa603f3e9347d719e24b9fb8a218c9aca3c4c52ecc877da2924a22c7558"}

{"id": "p_93152e8ee4a9d910", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 5, "text": "蕃體氣高亮，不能承顏順指；時或迕意，積以見責。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "6eac70049248fe7052b69bc9f34166aa54ac8749f212b796e2b78bdf8c224e6a"}

{"id": "p_63e13247a811a6ab", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 6, "text": "，丁忠使晉還，皓大會群臣，蕃沉醉頓伏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "e588e250dc6805fcc248903efac6ceca4be4de0c1b9ff92482b9822c58627145"}

{"id": "p_37f5f6aa6c3011d4", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 7, "text": "蕃性有威嚴，行止自若，皓大怒，呵左右於殿下斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "030e9bd922d669d59599d3bdfa8ab25373acdb3a26fd4e0466357fb94ad79d3d"}

{"id": "p_42641e6817538196", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 8, "text": "衛將軍滕牧、征西將軍留平請，不能得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "1b2740f896ac0cb41a2153433f0d2327d425bc9e465121bf7e584d876c7dbc2d"}

{"id": "p_63da37c7bf06bf9e", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 9, "text": "丞相陸凱上疏曰：「常侍王蕃黃中通理，知天知物，處朝忠蹇，斯社稷之重鎮，大吳之龍逢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "b5fb8f81e8be1ab328afe93ae2f902ae4f8e4710110692ebd14cef7bfe5c5e11"}

{"id": "p_a5bc7730d857dc8c", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 10, "text": "昔事景皇，納言左右，景皇欽嘉，歎為異倫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "5d5f7643bb72af100e9ec3d84ab4d5e70148b6b1a0517270cbd894aba3bd9d9c"}

{"id": "p_4ab8552cfcd947c4", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 11, "text": "而陛下忿其苦辭，惡其直對，梟之殿堂，屍骸暴棄，邦內傷心，有識悲悼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "2ad4a5f00e3a1d68ef7b2e761f79c0075b8cd069e9a83a156b102c97aed876ef"}

{"id": "p_1afa6c03ec1d7628", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 12, "text": "蕃死時年三十九，皓徙蕃家屬廣州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "f80c718bf15d2a27cf470ad91f5a82cca8281e0694e54a937eddb2592e7b7a85"}

{"id": "p_e581c357109a107b", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 13, "text": "二弟著、延皆作佳器，郭馬起事，不為馬用，見害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "3271ec7096d03efd887dff9612e19ae721f1b4c26b0d9601183e820c0f1b9dbf"}

{"id": "p_ab5329f0e50044c9", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 14, "text": "樓玄字承先，沛郡蘄人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "dc4d84be6c48dd1ddb91b0386f0b0aa093cfd9517a5a75be56e58b7fdd85aa06"}

{"id": "p_f0fcd2fd16a1b57d", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 15, "text": "孫皓即位，與王蕃、郭逴、萬彧俱為散騎中常侍，出為會稽太守，入為大司農。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "1abb16fcb54a0b546ac0a742918c9da6e869c766a5e1fe68fbd2521d6de544d3"}

{"id": "p_c3a9d3594f550020", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 16, "text": "舊禁中主者自用親近人作之，彧陳親密近職宜用好人，皓因敕有司，求忠清之士，以應其選，遂用玄為宮下鎮禁中候，主殿中事，玄從九卿持刀侍衛，正身率眾，奉法而行，應對切直，數迕皓意，漸見責怒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "0de5053f0daebccd6617565a869ad47393e196160acf2fdbe3cd75accbb44a8d"}

{"id": "p_dbfcb60eb24c1e45", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 17, "text": "後人誣白玄與賀邵相逢，駐共耳語大笑，謗訕政事，遂被詔詰責，送付廣州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "271989bb82a875060c7be3f5bc5bd7f0477b826bca263b2bda8f005b78fba9a7"}

{"id": "p_12c85198c0047da5", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 18, "text": "皓話玄名聲，復徙玄及子據，付交阯將張奕，使以戰自效，陰別敕奕令殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "b272c0b9fda0ca922d8bf97f31ebdb9d6d8dccefb8cdeee4da9040e1bda5d607"}

{"id": "p_2e84995f293c19dd", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 19, "text": "玄一身隨亦討賊，持刀步涉，見亦輒拜，亦未忍殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "5d1811d2d3bd3096aac8f3e6697aeec2c92239f03bddc51f88bb68e75d55367c"}

{"id": "p_d414aadcff790bdc", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 20, "text": "會亦暴卒，玄殯斂亦，於器中見敕書，還便自殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "4bbf57be441ea49bf45def04ef24ed9f3a19c79fd6bd32eb831495d4f9428284"}

{"id": "p_cd888c2044e3efdd", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 21, "text": "賀邵字興伯，會稽山陰人也，孫休即位，從中郎為散騎中常侍，出為吳郡太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f12d4b4ee3b7011fe7dbf596f88bf86762558b45c21b7198c4ce0b504c080f3a"}

{"id": "p_c170dfa9164b8809", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 22, "text": "孫皓時，入為左典軍，遷中書令，領太子太傅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "03c1f9490a93c87eb51dd479b9e0d2ede4999471839b3f1c4a5245ab4b6c806b"}

{"id": "p_1d0c22f71179cdfe", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 23, "text": "乃共譖邵與樓玄謗毀國事，俱被詰責。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "a42dbeda4acd0b3e139f2b83ef3613e1b90b79fc6baf0ac1d8a0a3c1f3c4bccf"}

{"id": "p_fb07e2fe64d0fb4a", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 24, "text": "後邵中惡風，口不能言，去職數月，皓疑其托疾，收付酒藏，掠考千所，邵卒無一語，竟見殺害，家屬徙臨海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "1f499ddad39f8ffde2637fa4867ef5ff1a921625063da1fb2cf79b7696519ba0"}

{"id": "p_5d50daba20480bd8", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 25, "text": "並下詔誅玄子孫，是歲也，邵年四十九。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "a3556ccbcedb77c93ac4e15d5a08b2fc6befe920c3791b26ed519497380b8479"}

{"id": "p_4297ca219193a829", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 26, "text": "韋曜字弘嗣，吳郡雲陽人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "37f21bdd10a0d4948422fd19820bb2dca3b1371fa16e70a593674ed7fe64844f"}

{"id": "p_2f3f085420c534da", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 27, "text": "少好學，能屬文，從丞相掾除西安令，還為尚書郎，遷太子中庶子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "9c92f9d88f6d8698dc857d8a897130be19e0b03bb8a97846a13959b28b6cec59"}

{"id": "p_6485b5d3470f8dbd", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 28, "text": "時蔡穎亦在東宮，性好博奕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "c0cfb096bb1a22528dfd43a6914042f520855a4c7fdcc7edcdcbfca6c1a84cd1"}

{"id": "p_53256461c51839e0", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 29, "text": "太子和以為無益，命曜論之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "95a7f111a4c16e63a55bd3a03f2e350746f7bf73ff1ace9781a26711b85bd8fb"}

{"id": "p_bd639259fb7dff08", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 30, "text": "孫亮即位，諸葛恪輔政，表曜為太史令，撰《吳書》，華核、薛瑩等皆與參同，孫休踐阼，為中書郎、博士祭酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "d99e50e309569bfa34077f02932804cee4e114bb3d13382eb59d8c75773f5aec"}

{"id": "p_119665dd0d30dd1c", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 31, "text": "命曜依劉向故事，校定眾書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "96f8f6bffc0547e426d679b49bddd0af366c42962bae470ca72f2c82504f6b4b"}

{"id": "p_618becb922f3e44f", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 32, "text": "又欲延曜侍講，而左將軍張布近習寵幸，事行多玷，憚曜侍講儒士，又性精確，懼以古今警戒休意，固爭不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "cfac153333a584de37c1f7e2bb44b927f6170f5303aacf536c97af74d00079db"}

{"id": "p_c8314929ec68e87c", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 33, "text": "休深恨布，語在《休傳》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "a54f8bb2dd434f124045cbb203051c5bc51f04c4561afeb1cda17e34938b37a9"}

{"id": "p_4d594ea8006895e0", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 34, "text": "孫皓即位，封高陵亭侯，遷中書僕射，職省，為侍中，常領左國史。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "d0d56b4ee1eca199e3b81263dc95919e69297667df5cd23faf585d79c95704c8"}

{"id": "p_49a4af36e70393e5", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 35, "text": "皓以問曜，曜答曰：“此人家筐篋中物耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "a895fd4b96e979f62d4ef2798b4520a40e5bc4c02f38e18d59c032fdd49b7831"}

{"id": "p_95678742c7bc4941", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 36, "text": "”又皓欲為父和作紀，曜執以和不登帝位，宜名為傳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "9cdf116798e38867b096d68ce37dab73e363a28c84cb72d719d65827df25cd46"}

{"id": "p_c028376c78c96834", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 37, "text": "曜益憂懼，自陳衰老，求去侍、史二官，乞欲成所造書，以從業別有所付，皓終不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "f9dd46b2142b947a25b4b8b563904dc24d3d9f85fc559a162e726f6903969240"}

{"id": "p_b43871bdf63729f8", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 38, "text": "時有疾病，醫藥監護，持之愈急。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "32e9f52238e1d47cf8141bad5985f71e675e38fc3d20295f1ecd5ad5d219711d"}

{"id": "p_c5b008af15447afa", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 39, "text": "皓每饗宴，無不竟日，坐席無能否率以七升為限，雖不悉入口，皆澆灌取盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "f9709f19889f2272edf7483985c3259ccbedf0c95178e6805986f09f2456ebb5"}

{"id": "p_d5a5890b882f1a4e", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 40, "text": "曜素飲酒不過二升，初見禮異時，常為裁減，或密賜茶荈以當酒，至於寵衰，更見逼強，輒以為罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "02b2482f92479af68e1ace69f5d1fb0dd75cdb2fbfe1c8495dca5abfdeb3b2a2"}

{"id": "p_a56b6990db34960a", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 41, "text": "又於酒後使侍臣難折公卿，以嘲弄侵克發摘私短以為歡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "8d6c39efba95252c66737a333ac5df0401afde215ef62986725485f7e75c3511"}

{"id": "p_c147809cc9d5eaf2", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 42, "text": "時有衍過，或誤犯皓諱，輒見收縛，至於誅戮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "8a3518fd7dd456fa8eb7360ddcb29eeaa1facf189e3943854b5134d1add610d9"}

{"id": "p_ba1ebbdf29d826a7", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 43, "text": "曜以為外相毀傷，內長尤恨，使不濟濟，非佳事也，故但示難問經義言論而已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "3c50a5859ddd2ad00e03cb0b6c857b015eae5daecfbb1ca6238b9c251a0d7847"}

{"id": "p_861d8d85c923b8fe", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 44, "text": "皓以為不承用詔命，意不忠盡，遂積前後嫌忿，收曜付獄，是歲也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "7a21a51341f31aa5278bac7b1cc905024069c9ccbae533e92a1a4dcc21222e94"}

{"id": "p_d0deee2f8d598f97", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 45, "text": "曜冀以此求免，而皓更怪其書之垢故，又以詰曜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "473137eac54cc26d19151e5946d58d21f4fe78e676189e6ce0fb9d457212317a"}

{"id": "p_a141943154cde4da", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 46, "text": "曜對曰：“囚撰此書，實欲表上，懼有誤謬，數數省讀，不覺點污。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "1ddbe44293b4b5699808e77d4619ba4832d024ef714953f434007b8e143e2504"}

{"id": "p_f8dc5d60a484d276", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 47, "text": "被問寒戰，形氣吶吃，謹追辭叩頭五百下，兩手自搏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "c173fbb998acc62f8440544916d5f83e298229990985ee58f843d39d93d5d4c8"}

{"id": "p_e9db0eb97f2fa832", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 48, "text": "皓不許，遂誅曜，徙百家零陵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "158de3839012c70caaae1fecced36b7cf078b42873b503f3054f766714736e3f"}

{"id": "p_4adf775c9690e808", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 49, "text": "華覈字永先，吳郡武進人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "cac96e43aea6c3fa7752485636b24f2299681f7a2aa31d07358ee6a011a72248"}

{"id": "p_73da6e2cbc5e8fa8", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 50, "text": "始為上虞尉、曲農都尉，以文學入為秘府郎，遷中書丞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "c254d798393ec6c0fdd5b484e14b7c2f26a3492b0690138c23b2ed83a652a913"}

{"id": "p_f0f6083c7a5d17cd", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 51, "text": "蜀為魏所並，核詣宮門發表曰：“間聞賊眾蟻聚向西境，西境艱險，謂當無虞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "f14e0b49f2dd2aa1a057118963305bea09f36d3378cec55ed3de0581ad9e7902"}

{"id": "p_b292711f78cd6caf", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 52, "text": "定聞陸抗表至，成都不守，臣主播越，社稷傾覆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "a90c844fde698e76970f808f70b5975d84844f776d7e4dd7ae84c33a8f68a125"}

{"id": "p_0226305fe12c5870", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 53, "text": "昔衛為翟所滅而桓公存之，今道里長遠，不可救振，失委附之土，棄貢獻之國，臣以草芥，竊懷不寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "560bd3fefa1c27d50390922a977dc5a1a1d409b060dc8e10862f67f25d35042d"}

{"id": "p_3aaea8043ef6aa68", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 54, "text": "陛下聖仁，恩澤遠撫，卒聞如此，必垂哀悼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "3be6e9be83e35ce8b2b6239f372ddfce278b8ee2f81e2364806af6e4808b4488"}

{"id": "p_3d1ca9a03d6487e9", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 55, "text": "臣不勝忡悵之情，謹拜表以聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "0a98af00b72906c1dc26e20263a81b3f93c857f1d853d214c0261fa1b70c59a3"}

{"id": "p_1c49d4a8a7d1ac8f", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 56, "text": "，皓更營新宮，制度弘廣，飾以珠玉，所費甚多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "ede133108bab0070853843f0aca4632fc5ee406e5baa01ba20e223493dc6224e"}

{"id": "p_43b8cdfaa232bcab", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 57, "text": "是時盛夏興工，農守並廢，核上疏諫曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "e4c46627f3bd2234b5008129694d96deb5b39e63c362b2366c2f5d70ae1860b2"}

{"id": "p_877f647710f80295", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 58, "text": "後遷東觀令，領右國吏，核上疏辭讓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "bc7b4ad3e7b19e39343d86818ca6f02c3b008f4d0cbf096a32ee9b9549fb2cf3"}

{"id": "p_ac26b72f18247ac3", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 59, "text": "皓答曰：“得表，以東觀儒林之府，當講校文藝，處定疑難，漢時皆名學碩儒乃任其職，乞更選英賢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "66b57f1c3cc9f37a500242b4920b7d97323c33ebd3172b4cd960a893afa3c4cd"}

{"id": "p_bc52210ed21cb9d5", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 60, "text": "聞之，以卿研精墳典，博覽多聞，可謂悅禮樂敦詩書者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "b3103ac56224d83ca7bb3c35fcdbfeea0119e0c80272a80ea4293e0bfa6e3a5e"}

{"id": "p_4fffccccf744faf9", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 61, "text": "當飛翰騁藻，光贊時事，以越揚、班、張、蔡之疇，怪乃謙光，厚自菲薄，宜勉備所職，以邁先賢，勿復紛紛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "b924280a2222bfde7cbe33cbbdc5edf184178ad3fb033985fda65d5d37f550de"}

{"id": "p_46151fe89001aa90", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 62, "text": "時倉廩無儲，世俗滋侈，核上疏曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "072675b7f7337e920547c2e7d22de5944a516478b52b60f20c6bc208ddd88d97"}

{"id": "p_9f247dabdda9e661", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 63, "text": "皓以核年老，敕令草表，核不敢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "2c03daf5a8b131717571b6e3d49d22d0085a80efaa241077495a689e012011fd"}

{"id": "p_6852bc2f229ad815", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 64, "text": "核前後陳便宜，及貢薦良能，解釋罪過，書百餘上，皆有補益，文多不悉載。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "88c0e7f3af918c5c2c380c2fccee638ec5efade63d398723ca632ba9249d4c9d"}

{"id": "p_d48a1615b9a7d7ec", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 65, "text": "曜、核所論事章疏，咸傳於世也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "0fdc3bd1b07695993e8e3d20458ae87a32f9169c97c61305fbc6a5a0201bc0f6"}

{"id": "p_4de5ac2fdb047a8a", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 66, "text": "評曰：薛瑩稱「王蕃器量綽異，弘博多通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "e955aaae940dd0f19250eebb650d4b9e9efdbc1fecb2422967383b637c004abe"}

{"id": "p_6634f9563f2d547f", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 67, "text": "樓玄清白節操，才理條暢；賀邵厲志高潔，機理清要。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "c1ce5d4378773d897a8a65e5e45743f7c6be1c44c08979284159f58f0cd760e4"}

{"id": "p_7b4e5b6a52db7d86", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 68, "text": "韋曜篤學好古，博見群籍，有記述之才。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "d96b9cbf568a6a6bb4fe98cb84b76a94f35f4beb67990e56b9b1abf35fad7844"}

{"id": "p_5429ed496673587a", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」胡沖以為「玄、邵、蕃一時清妙，略無優劣，必不得已，玄宜在先，邵當次之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "c4fc8c78fc5979ec85ebcdf714a134adc98ac238b137bd343f5f46a8186fd75d"}

{"id": "p_76c92ece6baa5994", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 70, "text": "華覈文賦之才，有過於曜，而典誥不及也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "b77a00d7e9ea4ebb517c58ee84baddf3a2f63e333bf5095be32b0c73699c7c59"}

{"id": "p_8d237040c632b683", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」予觀覈數獻良規，期於自盡，庶幾忠臣矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "12a98cf24e9b20c65b7b8e77623214c2b897cd3958f38e47c757a9dff5d7e6d5"}

{"id": "p_80c8349c4d6ccf99", "source_id": "src_bc53344938646106", "ordinal": 72, "text": "然此數子，處無妄之世而有名位，強死其理，得免為幸耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "3e7e291129969f75f154cf79d992c0f68f3db9addf729f54b677388efe8e49c9"}

{"id": "p_04d48027e10ae198", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 0, "text": "::滾滾長江東逝水，浪花淘盡英雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "28bc10df5492da6c3d6b4fc8b8060ece88496997fe2693c5585926bdcd244187"}

{"id": "p_4c9b75df9c85d4fe", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 1, "text": "::是非成敗轉頭空：青山依舊在，幾度夕陽紅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "94298587c994f9b0fc7475ac77da6db7dfbb5f0c1770ed649b9b1afb101c5ccf"}

{"id": "p_883011bff90b6cbe", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 2, "text": "::白髮漁樵江渚上，慣看秋月春風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "a1800d7c7cc6ab5951331bdf517c47601588963b6980494a0863bbd90df87f3a"}

{"id": "p_8cca65bbab8c284e", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 3, "text": "::一壺濁酒喜相逢：古今多少事，都付笑談中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "4a7de7fb7ca354304f5a6d1e6aadf249b1b48cc7ede6a2644fe6829f33bd605c"}

{"id": "p_ccb399d64ea3b354", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 4, "text": "話說天下大勢，分久必合，合久必分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "f4c1f34c4fb2cc1f39c4769473983b1cb6658ea738b871aa7cc8fc265012e5ee"}

{"id": "p_c97a9f78977209fd", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 5, "text": "周末七國分爭，併入於秦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "e17a4bd8beec7597505e14ae14c992ff79831964ac2b332b326160dba0c9fbcd"}

{"id": "p_fa770e5883e3e791", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 6, "text": "及秦滅之後，楚、漢分爭，又併入於漢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "e5fbe148bf7e8cb16a0caae6d2adef73d485596bf9547ff3b79f3e4c9277291d"}

{"id": "p_35f0a742b5e6934e", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 7, "text": "漢朝自高祖斬白蛇而起義，一統天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "899862d95e0f1e7ab18b71ca5948ea36a38275dc3a6913447f64dd6fa8143107"}

{"id": "p_3c2ab1d1e2e1137b", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 8, "text": "後來光武中興，傳至獻帝，遂分為三國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "ffeb2c3fbb7850a45d25d883798a8ce39210f52b74e78c58b64cd67cc5f9c4a6"}

{"id": "p_d97e9c3ace892f72", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 9, "text": "推其致亂之由，殆始於桓、靈二帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "bda1bb28de2ca7c37bf71fb568039b0c805a00bc1f5d5f025b1c348ab2476349"}

{"id": "p_25843990513478df", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 10, "text": "桓帝禁錮善類，崇信宦官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "0fe9aaaf43be52901a1db33e3dd39889a90188d761d165ec556c5ec6beb5f438"}

{"id": "p_139c3baef75d2fa1", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 11, "text": "及桓帝崩，靈帝即位，大將軍竇武、太傅陳蕃，共相輔佐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "1690b65e5171d72fb4e826f08254b5144b69e3077b6069e0a878aadc6f55e6dc"}

{"id": "p_bfe2f04e53c7c4ce", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 12, "text": "時有宦官曹節等弄權，竇武、陳蕃謀誅之，作事不密，反為所害，中涓自此愈橫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "6e539e5217677fccfed0f5879f07bb51d98b8bf7afd284da4b2261c921da9cfb"}

{"id": "p_87f09132170ad7b8", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 13, "text": "方陞座，殿角狂風驟起，只見一條大青蛇，從梁上飛將下來，蟠於椅上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "36676bb56e57bdd3f08d8b0159e8ed22fb5a05c9ea91342592e3a72fb5106184"}

{"id": "p_c7b6a2c380bf6a8b", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 14, "text": "帝驚倒，左右急救入宮，百官俱奔避。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "9e40704d6b9ed97dc3f89b0bf1ca686000e81bb395290b547be5260303a5a5ea"}

{"id": "p_fdb49661cf1dfab4", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 15, "text": "忽然大雷大雨，加以冰雹，落到半夜方止，壞卻房屋無數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "3c5e703a59310e9395d21beda457c89a08377c1e7fa064c1752d23632505355e"}

{"id": "p_be478499e33697dc", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 16, "text": "建寧四年二月，洛陽地震；又海水泛濫，沿海居民，盡被大浪捲入海中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "dab510e44636a05f5ad225e6aea0040287f1b290bcbb61af252441724268052d"}

{"id": "p_561ad12e51f597d7", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 17, "text": "六月朔，黑氣十餘丈，飛入溫德殿中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "0a3bed2a32809f161bbd8c683bee51aa0175a9852cbc9b5f76a8e99c0c076536"}

{"id": "p_01585b436663aed8", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 18, "text": "秋七月，有虹現於玉堂，五原山岸，盡皆崩裂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "2ebe7147201a94e11f836fa0ea30a7a3e8285c32d65d9fc4e2e173388dcdcb5c"}

{"id": "p_7cbeef5ccc3f4ae5", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 19, "text": "帝下詔問群臣以災異之由，議郎蔡邕上疏，以為霓墮雞化，乃婦寺干政之所致，言頗切直。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "07dd7bdf35b1711e6bff37213e4a9c3bcebc53e203189a9e76439510268cf122"}

{"id": "p_2d99fa51771f994e", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 20, "text": "曹節在後竊視，悉宣告左右，遂以他事陷邕於罪，放歸田里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "df530e76db3e9378d48680b0232357e12da185e427efc1915db170283d63f2ff"}

{"id": "p_fa1d6d16f1d7eb4f", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 21, "text": "後張讓、趙忠、封諝、段圭、曹節、侯覽、蹇碩、程曠、夏惲、郭勝十人朋比為奸，號為「十常侍」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "f8c6f2fb1da547eb6c3c976563f4e4c0226a55c0c0cba562b28bf2bd33a4f834"}

{"id": "p_6f064c41d641d8d1", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 22, "text": "帝尊信張讓，呼為「阿父」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "b6f685539290a9221194e90e58305ee43ef93477d93180a6e33c5aa77569b79d"}

{"id": "p_b7fd708342224614", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 23, "text": "朝政日非，以致天下人心思亂，盜賊蜂起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "d196760e1c0af7c09dc01a1181325950e665d656a558c9a681d30c84332711ca"}

{"id": "p_f85088cf0828ed78", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 24, "text": "時鉅鹿郡有兄弟三人：一名張角，一名張寶，一名張梁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "32397372a14867f88421e7a9375cacd20975a93c33cb9798f3582abf4daa546d"}

{"id": "p_8580bbbc99e54186", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 25, "text": "那張角本是個不第秀才，因入山採藥，遇一老人，碧眼童顏，手執藜杖，喚角至一洞中，以天書三卷授之，曰：「此名太平要術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "2a371c2561a826cce057c8dc8806c1fd5a4df0c5cea46c42962960db0c3118a9"}

{"id": "p_8e44fa940ea9754c", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 26, "text": "汝得之，當代天宣化，普救世人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "9c963f45b6a7a3f2b1a8430e722002505659811e5422b7e16af5b42d56a2f12d"}

{"id": "p_651a9652840357f5", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 27, "text": "老人曰：「吾乃南華老仙也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "0ce8bcc1b7cca14abba4960747596167868f87192c4a79914111f4613678ac8a"}

{"id": "p_339ca521df4848f6", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 28, "text": "角得此書，曉夜功習，能呼風喚雨，號為「太平道人」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "b3dc8ebead30f48c58a3e0441014f2a1d22d8cbf6b4d56d06e4af000fc8a291b"}

{"id": "p_052d0b388fba8418", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 29, "text": "中平元年正月內，疫氣流行，張角散施符水，為人治病，自稱「大賢良師」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "fc23b4639320a8d7e35fca7a9465bdc547e489bf464c97e3f3c197c690230b27"}

{"id": "p_66b4689248b238df", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 30, "text": "角有徒弟五百餘人，雲游四方，皆能書符念咒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "bbfd88492e49046c9c9564763cd465a76548690a2e8c0016ce10a975726069f8"}

{"id": "p_85ed5118012dc17c", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 31, "text": "次後徒眾日多，角乃立三十六方，大方萬餘人，小方六七千，各立渠帥，稱為將軍；訛言：「蒼天已死，黃天當立；歲在甲子，天下大吉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "8c36429ab69fe677f805ead977d4782dc274c1db086d8916533a5fe1168e387c"}

{"id": "p_71692af11ffb9265", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」令人各以白土，書「甲子」二字於家中大門上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "e058b04aa1af56f00799cae8a3f59f219094c96490d13575beb4d945322951b3"}

{"id": "p_98fac4b8b29cb486", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 33, "text": "青、幽、徐、冀、荊、揚、兗、豫八州之人，家家侍奉大賢良師張角名字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "b9f037e1aac9b07899e9e15808749a355a0c48ce860c5335e8facf4d01c7f464"}

{"id": "p_bd4196d45ffe261d", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 34, "text": "角遣其黨馬元義，暗齎金帛，結交中涓封胥，以為內應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "d1f44805bcb2b3ee791be4292f632485421e0deced78168aa843013490864353"}

{"id": "p_071367b2544da4fb", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 35, "text": "角與二弟商議曰：「至難得者，民心也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "e0a18c3117b4cafbad1b361fc961ac80ce6db33becbc14493a0e6aa8ade77d54"}

{"id": "p_9f6389f6d0e8cd45", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 36, "text": "今民心已順，若不乘勢取天下，誠為可惜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "2ac9b798834019b2ca49b7dfd1ebfd4731646f8f78556af972f9af649099d2a3"}

{"id": "p_84b06ec31801444a", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」遂一面私造黃旗，約期舉事；一面使弟子唐周，持書報封諝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "8338235c6edf796a1746718ee01ef3c79b6d8b122c3307fef2ed0dd4c9a89b2b"}

{"id": "p_0e0bb38b840a7c31", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 38, "text": "帝召大將軍何進調兵擒馬元義，斬之；次收封諝等一干人下獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "b2bc9a7ed5df1f9f49d3906be60f630c6c005bd9321559b8a37cebf990215d40"}

{"id": "p_beb108f44edbfcb3", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 39, "text": "張角聞知事露，星夜舉兵，自稱「天公將軍」，張寶稱「地公將軍」，張梁稱「人公將軍」；申言於眾曰：「今漢運將終，大聖人出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "b9dc17af636bdc5a7184765909f0c8d8fe3c6d6a40e7da7fd3ae3a07aa3147e8"}

{"id": "p_7de1469d2b4c3b85", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 40, "text": "汝等皆宜順天從正，以樂太平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "b8d27e8a0ca7ed70d2b5f16dbc4a5e2cd2d58cdacd23942d688791ba471f71a5"}

{"id": "p_f8d2e3ee7be93ea7", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 41, "text": "」四方百姓，裹黃巾從張角反者四五十萬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "236dafcbac08d109bbc543842dbff115a7debc1f01ec896bc6f3e698353f1b22"}

{"id": "p_26a760acae67f6c1", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 42, "text": "賊勢浩大，官軍望風而靡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "e92b21f5d0e78b3ecb34543bfa3d841b7e0193e639f79e7e193e6c1a967814fa"}

{"id": "p_be7499ec25fa9464", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 43, "text": "何進奏帝火速降詔，令各處備禦，討賊立功；一面遣中郎將盧植、皇甫嵩、朱雋，各引精兵，分三路討之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "797990168f2dae31cdf99f801a2600723ebb1a887775645114404888570e716c"}

{"id": "p_97918b8f2e0fbd59", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 44, "text": "且說張角一軍，前犯幽州界分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "5b0d48409e80cbffdb021af1251c6204a6e8b93ab5748e99739db9d1a3ab6fb9"}

{"id": "p_35a0a41a8079fd2a", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 45, "text": "幽州太守劉焉，乃江夏竟陵人氏，漢魯恭王之後也；當時聞得賊兵將至，召校尉鄒靖計議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "16ed5f9176ea2c2d4ac4ee886f699f617b91fddc55eb8c1a5e47378e7afc1c87"}

{"id": "p_26fc377ec0a76483", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 46, "text": "靖曰：「賊兵眾，我兵寡，明公宜作速招軍應敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "098981bc774dcb1d896c425af62ef6a061b9118af977ccc58ae8039186f3a8e7"}

{"id": "p_41bc8bd1f9c99082", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 47, "text": "」劉焉然其說，隨即出榜招募義兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "ff1b4932bcfa0d1e197ac32c02088d4946fd39c2efd8396b706adfcdf14bf558"}

{"id": "p_cb60a9cf8f65420c", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 48, "text": "榜文行到涿縣，引出涿縣中一個英雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "cd2696e8c32b3b299aab1163dbcb3969c0ecd9287d896b31956175826be876d4"}

{"id": "p_c9274412538e13f6", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 49, "text": "那人不甚好讀書；性寬和，寡言語，喜怒不言於色；素有大志，專好結交天下豪傑；生得身長七尺五寸，兩耳垂肩，雙手過膝，目能自顧其耳，面如冠玉，唇如塗脂；中山靖王劉勝之後，漢景帝閣下玄孫：姓劉，名備，字玄德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "aaabaf6d86328f9fc81c352d088c4dc9b1bc4eb9549f47bc981c8974ffaee73d"}

{"id": "p_435d0b2474a08a61", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 50, "text": "昔劉勝之子劉貞，漢武時封涿鹿亭侯，後坐酌金失侯，因此遺這一支在涿縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "289055880cda57d8cfa25809da3cc64ad3fe239b5a16ef9955eb94f52667b804"}

{"id": "p_e8c7cbd9c3d2129e", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 51, "text": "弘曾舉孝廉，亦嘗作吏，早喪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "85a3e5dee096ddf71178652769521c0a664f328406e10de186945f5dcb8007b3"}

{"id": "p_6302de07ac02a269", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 52, "text": "玄德孤幼，事母至孝；家貧，販屨織席為業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "24a8b1b7fc87e2d1302efb5b673036f547c9c14d1bb0666aabe91695f6c02a78"}

{"id": "p_51d0c32dc9000a6f", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 53, "text": "其家之東南，有一大桑樹，高五丈餘，遙望之，童童如車蓋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "cc48aaa5dfc9f6b8c9a3a7745753c0768945a4fc081988b251e639e35b61f92a"}

{"id": "p_d58e2ff8bea81a89", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 54, "text": "相者云：「此家必出貴人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "507860c417c2cd26c5ca3bc36e7abc743e8ec70f6165a8464b47fc41dbc18803"}

{"id": "p_d91278946fe27763", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」玄德幼時，與鄉中小兒戲於樹下，曰：「我為天子，當乘此車蓋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "c340fabdc2fc1757f88c256e7c11b311c5f53d30424694dac7059dd09bd9aa9b"}

{"id": "p_0792c650eb88d2d4", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 56, "text": "」叔父劉元起奇其言，曰：「此兒非常人也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "acfec4d5c764aa6bbc07e1a6ccc67f7cc245a577c40e59c3e99a5f970444c511"}

{"id": "p_dc0cd1e2df044fbc", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 57, "text": "」因見玄德家貧，常資給之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "d13f42f5cea269f47b97bf36ee7cc7795be4c1bd3ba0c6befa7ef63c25328d3c"}

{"id": "p_c4a737216eebf83d", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 58, "text": "年十五歲，母使游學，嘗師事鄭玄、盧植，與公孫瓚等為友。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "aa6d5b7d70b9f047123a943e6c8524300bfafd3f21c02fab0956293427632adb"}

{"id": "p_6c90830ecdce4394", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 59, "text": "及劉焉發榜招軍時，玄德年已二十八歲矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "921e42dc88e60e4a0495f31f8145dcb3ec66d676f12124a3431394e31b15a0fd"}

{"id": "p_e4819ac521fd1888", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 60, "text": "當日見了榜文，慨然長嘆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "3004ec6a178d0b6438d991bb481ad4f0b45abdbc4a855eec9139bf0fbc352e9b"}
