{"id": "p_9bbe2965871f110d", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 61, "text": "隨後一人厲聲言曰：「大丈夫不與國家出力，何故長嘆？", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "a795e37400cadc9c6742630224297b5d5f4aaa8ac20008b35d99e0a7e5a2199e"}

{"id": "p_799375bb25485ee8", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」玄德回視其人：身長八尺，豹頭環眼，燕頷虎鬚，聲若巨雷，勢如奔馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "0c901ef449817bd2cb2b7d982a2ee4f22a67642c056a11d2eba44260401a3502"}

{"id": "p_a701dca30fc77fd4", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 63, "text": "玄德見他形貌異常，問其姓名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "95017380af61384ae1a9575174319c322621edb609d7459427738489036cb882"}

{"id": "p_ef6b477a196cc984", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 64, "text": "其人曰：「某姓張，名飛，字翼德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "51f472d9b30a78cd2b8382e57d0fa783af440aa018dbc047bcbd3a9c6f72fdc7"}

{"id": "p_a7aff14e9c56d7b7", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 65, "text": "世居涿郡，頗有莊田，賣酒屠豬，專好結交天下豪傑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "46d50c3620c7c459f0a770f884757d43f157e391f98ed70b072f05cd4be41fae"}

{"id": "p_74cf18acadab2292", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 66, "text": "適纔見公看榜而嘆，故此相問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "5eae9fdaedb142c65ca6e6a4c3a8130cc230174fbe5c063cb280410098615a7a"}

{"id": "p_f8d6f35f621707c7", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 67, "text": "」玄德曰：「我本漢室宗親，姓劉，名備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "ec0364564b2d507da44f6ad7401a1fb1ee38e9fbfb07a6e7261a4f6d0fdd4d52"}

{"id": "p_30f065129edfc8e1", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 68, "text": "今聞黃巾倡亂，有志欲破賊安民；恨力不能，故長嘆耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "ecce400966335c9b037f489240a26a918ba50a740477866acfa914594fb5fa61"}

{"id": "p_c577e571da221e85", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」飛曰：「吾頗有資財，當招募鄉勇，與公同舉大事，如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "ad5808201f75c28b24ce0f1f66ef3bc09c213f672a4d84ceb3176e0b7f07be1e"}

{"id": "p_f64a74c32a770112", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 70, "text": "」玄德甚喜，遂與同入村店中飲酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "2f76af58d355bfcaa3619842bbab56a8ab56dec07e5ba44d25794475406287a4"}

{"id": "p_a42511dec9aa0a93", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 71, "text": "正飲間，見一大漢，推著一輛車子，到店門首歇了；入店坐下，便喚酒保：「快斟酒來吃，我待趕入城去投軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "dd6638d80e199622192fe802d95e69fa36e598b8772bf09021db5adaf21c0b71"}

{"id": "p_c56530360a264d9d", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 72, "text": "」玄德看其人：身長九尺，髯長二尺；面如重棗，唇如塗脂；丹鳳眼，臥蠶眉：相貌堂堂，威風凜凜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "a79b153c0b8f423f7c7c297275cb20deec9f6cdd9ed1079ff81d37ec4cc54b4c"}

{"id": "p_694991fafb35aac1", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 73, "text": "玄德就邀他同坐，叩其姓名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "c9a166b7fa45a2f12d6b814b8325eb347e7e42d32a5df1da666dc68d1df734c5"}

{"id": "p_4e35b498812ac776", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 74, "text": "其人曰：「吾姓關，名羽，字長生，後改雲長，河東解良人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "23c8fcaf1cc662d1f6f66a06486ca3ad07548e55bfef3796cacf946e6edfe94e"}

{"id": "p_e59e0192e7a0ef24", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 75, "text": "因本處勢豪，倚勢凌人，被吾殺了；逃難江湖，五六年矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "3ba1e690bd6ea7376d7314d161176b449de61a0752bfde1869b8c8462ab20393"}

{"id": "p_e37e0a5dbf5c0e0a", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 76, "text": "今聞此處招軍破賊，特來應募。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "3b668f84db2b6ee98421faeb402af409c2f336bf734d70d6b6e1464976f4338a"}

{"id": "p_9aa9f4c15f751589", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 77, "text": "同到張飛莊上，共議大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "aa72d975934d8e5fc5957e4969b90f5be1665b84a4bafb6910804251c6acd438"}

{"id": "p_0bae78c23a385eac", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 78, "text": "飛曰：「吾莊後有一桃園，花開正盛；明日當於園中祭告天地，我三人結為兄弟，協力同心，然後可圖大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "ef7251c914baef0ac28a3a51c2c73af49c187824da3080f67ca1a5e8edc1a110"}

{"id": "p_28d42bcd028b76f1", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 79, "text": "」玄德、雲長齊聲應曰：「如此甚好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "d9c4e4b0e1b025082344b8d83275ac56e24f142fb75e765ab1ddc9cb0b5fea9b"}

{"id": "p_cca46c950fb15c77", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 80, "text": "」次日，於桃園中，備下烏牛白馬祭禮等項，三人焚香再拜而說誓曰：「念劉備、關羽、張飛，雖然異姓，既結為兄弟，則同心協力，救困扶危；上報國家，下安黎庶；不求同年同月同日生，只願同年同月同日死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "ac12b7885d98d855a43e6fa60543f812353574fc2768e04da7a885bb8080e555"}

{"id": "p_901c252f5afecfcf", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 81, "text": "」誓畢，拜玄德為兄，關羽次之，張飛為弟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "30ae8775a823149c615559b4c83f8735eb317cfc3eb1627ad10ec31bd52524b7"}

{"id": "p_b59b3648ff8c9092", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 82, "text": "祭罷天地，復宰牛設酒，聚鄉中勇士，得三百餘人，就桃園中痛飲一醉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "4eef399d23b7fdbdd4ffcdf7b9dc22831af2bb9b2b3c6c0bcef762f8c44fce03"}

{"id": "p_2cbd6e1cbc971422", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 83, "text": "來日收拾軍器，但恨無馬匹可乘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "64623f2cf7f6ab32bc69bf3431deddb1841004fa6d8e138b7684b41b38243347"}

{"id": "p_0a24ea686b7c8ac6", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 84, "text": "正思慮間，人報有兩個客人，引一夥伴儅，趕一群馬，投莊上來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "c5f1d56cc8c2f3e7d9082110faffd0c2e85b50a6b7585241cc7b5db407cf096e"}

{"id": "p_9568906eb8c4a241", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 85, "text": "原來二客乃中山大商：一名張世平，一名蘇雙，每年往北販馬，近因寇發而回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "c337ce3249f413b1c0b9c3ba81237e34558c1ea87abd10e762110246e7e5e81e"}

{"id": "p_ede674fb0fd19a3a", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 86, "text": "玄德請二人到莊，置酒管待，訴說欲討賊安民之意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "5cf52a0c815cd0e067572df55137983f56869cdf48140beebc1886158023fb03"}

{"id": "p_7d35d2b924ad6265", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 87, "text": "二客大喜，願將良馬五十匹相送；又贈金銀五百兩，鑌鐵一千斤，以資器用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "4c0d09a72dec27ce90379798bda0aebeb4b166fdd229252a420c162f9228353d"}

{"id": "p_ab773894d4696ab4", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 88, "text": "玄德謝別二客，便命良匠打造雙股劍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "417a9397ed04920c04cadf721e5ec3c1060b0ba5d6ca787a6703551e77f714c2"}

{"id": "p_4620473e822f5ac8", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 89, "text": "雲長造青龍偃月刀，又名「冷艷鋸」，重八十二斤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "4f4daa2914812ea681ada7bc79ac9856279ba0b77744d1436cb642ed80008eff"}

{"id": "p_9551d481a3175c88", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 90, "text": "共聚鄉勇五百餘人，來見鄒靖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "f129ca0f45e51956acb86f361db9b8d1d9d399f75cf73696290c4e047a2681a3"}

{"id": "p_2e4d48a2acb576d8", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 91, "text": "玄德說起宗派，劉焉大喜，遂認玄德為侄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "40ae9712faa40092b3b1e9a6ce1f6827907595abc92009f2cc5e26ac89df6c70"}

{"id": "p_c1896cc6d8c7aa11", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 92, "text": "不數日，人報黃巾賊將程遠志統兵五萬來犯涿郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "aec3214f25f0ff9e2563ee49160c0bb17166cba78374b79280c63d47e06020ec"}

{"id": "p_6337ac692d639ab4", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 93, "text": "劉焉令鄒靖引玄德等三人，統兵五百，前去破敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "415bf425f72cd3f014fba00c6701e73ff81df1907d184206fcf327d41e942cad"}

{"id": "p_324f944a367dd9f0", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 94, "text": "玄德等欣然領軍前進，直至大興山下，與賊相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "6c16002d66907b12461d4314c63e88421b430a02567e5702502c5cb85783aff6"}

{"id": "p_8a257a40220d8be6", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 95, "text": "賊眾皆披髮，以黃巾抹額。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "5a39aed538bdaa3201695ebc48e47474090ae510969930a4162e6b678d1cd004"}

{"id": "p_2b2782224534c7ef", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 96, "text": "當下兩軍相對，玄德出馬，左有雲長，右有翼德，揚鞭大罵：「反國逆賊，何不早降！", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "7452179cefa7da5099e64a87644f1e90a7c4ba4e1e213ab50c7508787b4009f2"}

{"id": "p_48a5929b47e07e57", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」程遠志大怒，遣副將鄧茂出戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "e475e0b352c865fd521513951abf5802ccfb50b03712e021520a18ca2c85eb00"}

{"id": "p_c50a7980b18abced", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 98, "text": "張飛挺丈八蛇矛直出，手起處，刺中鄧茂心窩，翻身落馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "8ef1d200b71712532a9a198919c1cb7c51abd154b4dd5f72a9488471f2a43b7c"}

{"id": "p_be997d9405b36ab8", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 99, "text": "程遠志見折了鄧茂，拍馬舞刀，直取張飛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "a4066ba0015acc469950ccd7afbc142817376bb908f78a98f98e756c674c147b"}

{"id": "p_d76900b09c2c049d", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 100, "text": "雲長舞動大刀，縱馬飛迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "8be9a62d339b7406adede06e58240afba34521e5842c3914b2d982b2b8659066"}

{"id": "p_854c058e827395c0", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 101, "text": "程遠志見了，早吃一驚，措手不及，被雲長刀起處，揮為兩段。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "56b753e057ceb49ceaee7e869e705db8dae07637976d06fcbc6de18fb677faaf"}

{"id": "p_306dba67cee9d385", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 102, "text": "::英雄露穎在今朝，一試矛兮一試刀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "cc8d41f3188e284fc246744dbedb6a7cd5cb1238eef93760409b59d8c94c74b9"}

{"id": "p_8061ba130bfa56a4", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 103, "text": "::初出便將威力展，三分好把姓名標。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "620e256be6ae6e84fb2b065c49fd6db5f471d87357866bd976f73bcfc772d88a"}

{"id": "p_bdd1563b4c779612", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 104, "text": "眾賊見程遠志被斬，皆倒戈而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "591245f0f46338cad786022117e81d9b48b9f380fac6fb740344685180d1df97"}

{"id": "p_5b6ba5b56536cf93", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 105, "text": "玄德揮軍追趕，投降者不計其數，大勝而回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "a8d9a089c6159e6fb26539f603b7d1aa4abfe6b5b38e638fc75d3b02393337f9"}

{"id": "p_0835f9f3fc92806d", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 106, "text": "劉焉親自迎接，賞勞軍士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "ee15cf4e4f9a55e45d25481ed1a8c91a12a39fe6749df52a69daf0327eb3bea2"}

{"id": "p_5109357a493acfd3", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 107, "text": "次日，接得青州太守龔景牒文，言黃巾賊圍城將陷，乞賜救援。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "16c306ae4cbb3127c393d13f254ab687bfe97296355b23ca267b50fbd27ceaaf"}

{"id": "p_63c35b1257808f81", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 108, "text": "」劉焉令鄒靖將兵五千，同玄德、關、張，投青州來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "c64effae06c4cdaede868c182565e6b8e1d64c380b7af6bc2c9b1ac3e23e9012"}

{"id": "p_e18cab851f2e7acb", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 109, "text": "賊眾見救兵至，分兵混戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "47b3ba9dbd7646b8d899004472f6ad7c9f7b7d445ae6eb37cd70216c944d5b5e"}

{"id": "p_fd4a92776143946f", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 110, "text": "玄德兵寡不勝，退三十里下寨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "b56dafade662c2def08043d606f077de901ababd93f1703653874df3c9238c10"}

{"id": "p_20edf4ac575cb5a2", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 111, "text": "玄德謂關、張曰：「賊眾我寡；必出奇兵，方可取勝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "bde1bdd3fe7f1f74bcb0fcd51938400e637880c4883657762fe84caa8b18d9f5"}

{"id": "p_6351450105e8d9b2", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 112, "text": "」乃分關公引一千軍伏山左，張飛引一千軍伏山右，鳴金為號，齊出接應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "e3d2ccea22240b8794f181d6e02db4a0394ce339c6c1977f80508696bed817a2"}

{"id": "p_d6e6c94339a3111c", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 113, "text": "次日，玄德與鄒靖引軍鼓噪而進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "e69a70012f130370987f6c643916fc9702e1223c7cc31b48c324afbf03ca95fd"}

{"id": "p_ecd21ee7db94f9eb", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 114, "text": "賊眾迎戰，玄德引軍便退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "7f8ccef1287801009b774a4ffb85aa4e93ad3c364b5f6a474ea57d695c021a3d"}

{"id": "p_ac42f3d65933380c", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 115, "text": "賊眾乘勢追趕，方過山嶺，玄德軍中一齊鳴金，左右兩軍齊出，玄德麾軍回身復殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "da072ac46b6caa4efc841345f6b9e4409f5f4cb6d48ef02ad4bd99ca6e23afc5"}

{"id": "p_0aaca4b90b2e5601", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 116, "text": "直趕至青州城下，太守龔景亦率民兵出城助戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "3e2dee7038106fe63ef402d7dddb5cd99f95f893b7b745c38c05e893c5aa4372"}

{"id": "p_79a336ccfaf3dae8", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 117, "text": "賊勢大敗，剿戮極多，遂解青州之圍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "60087aab320a73bb6707833434e9b15610eefcbe1973d0810e8dc35f97d748e2"}

{"id": "p_4c32b28cfead0863", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 118, "text": "::運籌決算有神功，二虎還須遜一龍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "4195d31e1feb54373b860685017f5f90bc9a804a844727704c5a8a5e3ab00460"}

{"id": "p_e447da0b8ed27c37", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 119, "text": "::初出便能垂偉績，自應分鼎在孤窮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "d1303821c177b5d3db7ea38d00427d9e1b4d7bc88bcd557b293fd63deaa7f929"}

{"id": "p_f003d396e3fbb019", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 120, "text": "玄德曰：「近聞中郎將盧植與賊首張角戰於廣宗，備昔曾師事盧植，欲往助之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "9683894c416d573d2648d8dcd8cd8901d22865d15efc9f87e76cb91785be29e2"}

{"id": "p_a36efe8bbf80e3e9", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 121, "text": "」於是鄒靖引軍自回，玄德與關、張引本部五百人投廣宗來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "4192f1f5bf41bd184255865aa07da1ff07f1518d4528a57513c4152183c03f03"}

{"id": "p_ddc761f3107ce911", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 122, "text": "至盧植軍中，入帳施禮，具道來意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "0952d78150aecaf1cc0aec6de06e5444bf1072a698b14be714530f21650eb3c0"}

{"id": "p_20de53d3c36dfa3c", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 123, "text": "盧植大喜，留在帳前聽調。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "7ba786828c7a7f4b4358e138b2d8acf4b204fc5868217e9c6cc30f29e28d4a03"}

{"id": "p_6ba577cd8eeb3c9c", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 124, "text": "時張角賊眾十五萬，植兵五萬，相拒於廣宗，未見勝負。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "61a5546f783e1b88e2b50e413efcb639faa6f59f23482d601fb0ef9258c6ac56"}

{"id": "p_0ae950e9c231a074", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 125, "text": "植謂玄德曰：「我今圍賊在此，賊弟張梁、張寶在潁川，與皇甫嵩、朱雋對壘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "a87354ed3b52defc561438f678fb1aab65a2222a8d7674af92a03785068d0bb2"}

{"id": "p_03630870b5906520", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 126, "text": "汝可引本部人馬，我更助汝一千官軍，前去潁川打探消息，約期剿捕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "cd436769ed21226a5be286be39303a9893b9d46fb29a5fa9fec047371f7ca181"}

{"id": "p_cac6c7f380e689ea", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」玄德領命，引軍星夜投潁川來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "de159595d6bbd3bae4cc2e63d8aa874e52388d0518725870e2c730d996cee294"}

{"id": "p_a4029c1a330dd8ed", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 128, "text": "時皇甫嵩、朱儁領軍拒賊，賊戰不利，退入長社，依草結營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "31a13965d6250702ee9b07dc93ff901f8a2a79607276d2057f83a71b599b9150"}

{"id": "p_d0074ddd263af61d", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 129, "text": "嵩與儁計曰：「賊依草結營，當用火攻之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "a8472e25b441cb55e60c31bfdf2c1d185c9a5e16e080dfc8ff487c256a4103d4"}

{"id": "p_b305c93e8fd693eb", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 130, "text": "」遂令軍士，每人束草一把，暗地埋伏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "f9ed2ab68174cac76fb4eb0e717ebc5d5ab75b53a185edb4ac148c051d88cd1d"}

{"id": "p_182735630cdf008f", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 131, "text": "二更以後，一齊縱火，嵩與儁各引兵攻擊賊寨，火焰張天，賊眾驚慌，馬不及鞍，人不及甲，四散奔走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "03ebcba4e05f60c444c68722d86236b6fc72f05186b1d112ca199bad1fd494a9"}

{"id": "p_3796a688daddbd87", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 132, "text": "殺到天明，張梁、張寶引敗殘軍士，奪路而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "9fc36e3a6f03491531db95c3c1475170e9532664afe317d09687c639de0f0849"}

{"id": "p_ed818ceb0661352b", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 133, "text": "忽見一彪軍馬，盡打紅旗，當頭來到，截住去路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "82954a4e0fc1fd1f8ae2e48520647e91fa0f1bc965a3101827f4277024208701"}

{"id": "p_c5e65e2f16af2f52", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 134, "text": "為首閃出一將：身長七尺，細眼長髯；官拜騎都尉；沛國譙郡人也，姓曹，名操，字孟德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "6d88da82fd8846593f7b06b673d00329abe17134e6a23e973a1333b14b317b6f"}

{"id": "p_e37123d4915d7804", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 135, "text": "操父曹嵩，本姓夏侯氏；因為中常侍曹騰之養子，故冒姓曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "e047a81f93486ea13a39bdaf51d9cecc5467e6c8df237afa92481df4290e3c7e"}

{"id": "p_ef436dccb6e55ab2", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 136, "text": "曹嵩生操，小字阿瞞，一名吉利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "a2d8018691f0131861cd6863e4a6f51f673bd6d6feaa859c83c3368fddf8a1ea"}

{"id": "p_21f0986c0986cdda", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 137, "text": "操幼時，好游獵，喜歌舞；有權謀，多機變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "cba2d065c6f18af5eadf43503ee4f292a1f4b41e6cbcbd44a39aa7c38c0689c9"}

{"id": "p_3cb56cf38032b6e8", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 138, "text": "操有叔父，見操游蕩無度，嘗怒之，言於曹嵩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "25ac3686dd8e4bade9ab8ae9e679563daa04f2f30ce4aeeeeef04959f4990b44"}

{"id": "p_fc5442748db1a7ca", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 139, "text": "操忽心生一計：見叔父來，詐倒於地，作中風之狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "9e024a3c09a7aa46cac3d57fac375297e5e6abf19efeeb0694be8d6b8b56287e"}

{"id": "p_f2b61cc2ffc2ed2b", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 140, "text": "叔父驚告嵩，嵩急視之，操故無恙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "6b427a0b7d937def0920f1c5689f70f0b6d60b314e1881d76532669c4fec538b"}

{"id": "p_b3f3b753e6a658dd", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 141, "text": "嵩曰：「叔言汝中風，今已愈乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "23322952b2c98c0c3b297492302fdb7dcc68ab8dfc0da32971e3156a4795f4d7"}

{"id": "p_7f9d29895c932e56", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 142, "text": "」操曰：「兒自來無此病；因失愛於叔父，故見罔耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "2212e5145045b778d8f69c33b3f24abf2036cb86eeeee69ce1bc22f7783851d4"}

{"id": "p_7e940feef1d568c6", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 143, "text": "後叔父但言操過，嵩並不聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "7a84d8331ed18fb827c111c56823e791e3360e56f5945564a80f1716d34d864f"}

{"id": "p_94ffad360627a26a", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 144, "text": "時人有橋玄者，謂操曰：「天下將亂，非命世之才不能濟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "c551cb0d3463fcacc84c8b478395ad25301fffc4e04563ff4c55082cfd4f5afc"}

{"id": "p_e8ae5c0cb4b25ec7", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 145, "text": "」南陽何颙見操，言：「漢室將亡，安天下者，必此人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "6b9cd2d0ced210c06c8346cd80f15186bd4d4312431cc69d631eaa4fcf0c4d38"}

{"id": "p_20682773a4f260a4", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」汝南許劭，有知人之名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "cd956d1db6e11224e339bf085cd5e0358c4822e5b45954bd50c8852486517ddd"}

{"id": "p_01365bc8bec53fcf", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 147, "text": "操往見之，問曰：「我何如人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "804c913efe1c576fef05aa6c80bb0b3380b6f57caacb7c20f46c6fdb27e19192"}

{"id": "p_b116bdc598e97a63", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 148, "text": "又問，劭曰：「子治世之能臣，亂世之奸雄也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "339e87760f72dc64803d90147d6282497b987951e633263c7b23ab1acb427616"}

{"id": "p_b891a43b5150fbed", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 149, "text": "年二十，舉孝廉，為郎，除洛陽北都尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "76b29972ffb2dde18e465b6b8943b79cd15ca013cca9aaeca70dcb618c5f1e90"}

{"id": "p_38b5dd2dee220bdb", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 150, "text": "初到任，即設五色棒十餘條於縣之四門，有犯禁者，不避富豪，皆責之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "3fd8261cc504b75e80211657ece1f17894354088f102fe09fcea3c3de4a954de"}

{"id": "p_be0645fff1a31faf", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 151, "text": "中常侍蹇碩之叔，提刀夜行，操巡夜拿住，就棒責之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "0b9dea9822f1a24caf4de2fcf29108b4be85ef2bada7d42e24fbc9e31077fd70"}

{"id": "p_00202347042c105a", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 152, "text": "由是，內外莫敢犯者，威名頗震。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "67fdff601dfcdbdcc984b2cf1fc6e84ee29b329d7c47f038097f692280c7b4fb"}

{"id": "p_6e3dacae75675d36", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 153, "text": "因黃巾起，拜為騎都尉，引馬步軍五千，前來潁川助戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "e3c1352dea3a87f9fbb1942470e5d95c8798024a457046217f8141d97b08f472"}

{"id": "p_a7c0daf48d4c1c83", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 154, "text": "正值張梁、張寶敗走，曹操攔住，大殺一陣，斬首萬餘級，奪得旗旌、金鼓、馬匹極多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "0d2abd0c4d0a96407e3b969e7ee3e1e7b28e05876390d95d6c2b934ee70585d0"}

{"id": "p_cb226586f7e2a489", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 155, "text": "操見過皇甫嵩、朱儁，隨即引兵追襲張梁、張寶去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "dd22d6ad43db556e525cc69dabf3436d0863f8dbdd2778e72138a33b35da28ef"}

{"id": "p_7c5d9e79a6ffa644", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 156, "text": "卻說玄德引關、張來潁川，聽得喊殺之聲，又望見火光燭天，急引兵來時，賊已敗散。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "e39ffbdba06f4c970edac817073ecff2a6d4545664a617c9b9eb064220147025"}

{"id": "p_18f29cbc12b181fc", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 157, "text": "玄德見皇甫嵩、朱儁，具道盧植之意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "4f6b8a101e6564c81f37c64ba1fde2fab6afc1319bdd0b35b367a0e9ec12896f"}

{"id": "p_1bceb2807de04ff8", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 158, "text": "嵩曰：「張梁、張寶勢窮力乏，必投廣宗去依張角。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "66346742ab81cccbcebf9b2f08af1eda6d7746281fd93d3340d75c716bafd908"}

{"id": "p_39f2bd4e66c17b68", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 159, "text": "」玄德領命，遂引兵復回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "1de7f62a9e001ba1ae262f15aecdbe4da09fe0807ee9258cb5dd27ab14fccafd"}

{"id": "p_308dc289282ecb34", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 160, "text": "到得半路，只見一簇軍馬，護送一輛檻車；車中之囚，乃盧植也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "49a97985fcfb2294f7202642c6c76a6b77ca1fe5b2f37dd51f26aa6dcd063e41"}

{"id": "p_e4335a9d6dab9c78", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 161, "text": "玄德大驚，滾鞍下馬，問其緣故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "943fc52c8b956813960fb9456946796969880c4f4cd505a8a93b97e6b6781b1c"}

{"id": "p_9852a114b89ba0b5", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 162, "text": "植曰：「我圍張角，將次可破；因角用妖術，未能即勝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "12509711071364721c54a9aed0a32d786603115e6c0589885762f4d5883e8b1b"}

{"id": "p_072ed589b9f013fb", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 163, "text": "朝廷差黃門左豐前來體探，問我索取賄賂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "c245eafa9b04ba3b362e54f6c45f43d98be1db1900a38aacab7049f7a0793199"}

{"id": "p_d676c30eb512eb6a", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 164, "text": "我答曰：『軍糧尚缺，安有餘錢奉承天使？", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "c1a095d7d9dab62805f38da43855edd7ceb17a109e0790bd37eb8093c6f6ad2f"}

{"id": "p_98ab553f28300705", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 165, "text": "』左豐挾恨，回奏朝廷，說我高壘不戰，惰慢軍心；因此朝廷震怒，遣中郎將董卓來代將我兵，取我回京問罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "c0dc8d256dbfa4af97c805d8c1294b4a397c3586e063e340ce927ba421ba633c"}

{"id": "p_cb32426edc748d68", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」張飛聽罷，大怒，要斬護送軍人，以救盧植。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "23eb1f9cf544923bd78cfe52370ac0a87eeb3e76fb0ff981f01077955e74a2a9"}

{"id": "p_3ce82063e05ab590", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 167, "text": "玄德急止之曰：「朝廷自有公論，汝豈可造次？", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "901df5b29fbe6320f75572aa5ef28e606c597026588e4bed7f89c99dece312bb"}

{"id": "p_4e31985fb713f8db", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 168, "text": "關公曰：「盧中郎已被逮，別人領兵，我等去無所依，不如且回涿郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "6ca659ed978307f26ce71d6ce675322b3a4a27c06ddac2e54c7c881800e0b9c7"}

{"id": "p_6495339b79f94a78", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 169, "text": "」玄德從其言，遂引軍北行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "a9f3e9e9bdcfe4356944cecb7a62eb241a82c39d4fe2a7c0a77c8fdc5a66c08a"}

{"id": "p_06974cad6ce6224c", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 170, "text": "行無二日，忽聞山後喊聲大震。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "5b292b1b6eda3b8132ce917a1541dbdf3b5dcb11119992939fab390713d913d6"}

{"id": "p_725c24378e7cd928", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 171, "text": "玄德引關、張縱馬上高岡望之，見漢軍大敗，後面漫山塞野，黃巾蓋地而來，旗上大書「天公將軍」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "39cc63f808f638456cf27ab273ef1f045febb4cbf1ddd703ed83a31836164bd3"}

{"id": "p_70bc3515fa2ef1ea", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 172, "text": "張角正殺敗董卓，乘勢趕來，忽遇三人衝殺，角軍大亂，敗走五十餘里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "b30e2fa4ccafe136148d8934c92b70edcd04e4f31434bb4925402d659a988344"}

{"id": "p_0acaf9e76bba8acd", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 173, "text": "玄德出，張飛大怒曰：「我等親赴血戰，救了這廝，他卻如此無禮！", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "ffa20b41354f9d13e7eab171f9476f047b2af46d114caa31be24ee93bf5b3bf2"}

{"id": "p_efb4bbfb125ee4ee", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 174, "text": "」便要提刀入帳來殺董卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "4cb10542a1004a9ca7a9c22a1fc562fcde43f8ac664fc3e11312d430cde4140c"}

{"id": "p_e32a9158c4f6fa79", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 175, "text": "::人情勢利古猶今，誰識英雄是白身？", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "45abfe5f535606868d550c3a9355d20a246ac6d45c220e195ffc0aa7974caf5d"}

{"id": "p_92a34a7636953c47", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 176, "text": "::安得快人如翼德，盡誅世上負心人！", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "2b520fa56c433004cdcaeb34b974d2bf529367d83aa82cafc3829ea199f0c143"}

{"id": "p_53b63c1f65ab573c", "source_id": "src_41fda515e06fee8a", "ordinal": 177, "text": "畢竟董卓性命如何，且聽下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "e07f88b37b86c79fa8f24e09b43045db8373958ce79365fc5ebff5bd2c563704"}

{"id": "p_c1305a4b2d6a8bf0", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說陳宮正欲下手殺曹操，忽轉念曰：「我為國家跟他到此，殺之不義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "13192b146cd40a0bfe9dd5e16f79f571f587eec4f57d14ff90627a12e0a3d4da"}

{"id": "p_4d4f470e971785d4", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 1, "text": "」插劍上馬，不等天明，自投東郡去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "c9a4214ca162ba3675dc140ecc0b3cebe18c5c3346fd4b2a6bf69cd83f719919"}

{"id": "p_8345a99180cecb0e", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 2, "text": "操覺，不見陳宮，尋思：「此人見我說了這兩句，疑我不仁，棄我而去；吾當急行，不可久留。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "d78f63cd5fd813d10da73e0b621f8377a150b0c2a4a821701ba304528694844d"}

{"id": "p_453515e6c80800d0", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 3, "text": "」遂連夜到陳留，尋見父親，備說前事；欲散家資，招募義兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "01c9c20331aec3e63ec17391c4e9c6939b387a14624ced3daf4db81674c0e514"}

{"id": "p_56c412cb5dece914", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 4, "text": "此間有孝廉衛弘，疏財仗義，其家巨富；若得相助，事可圖矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "861be6e2159832ae374759539c6ffa09b5ed6178463efc81eee42384c0d42469"}

{"id": "p_54bff62aa881248b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 5, "text": "操置酒張筵，拜請衛弘到家，告曰：「今漢室無主，董卓專權，欺君害民，天下切齒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "6c41d8fdddc160b55655d14f4c25cfd4cfb08397a8ae0beae56ec4fd3f0e143c"}

{"id": "p_7e61d0e8cda5fef7", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 6, "text": "操欲力扶社稷，恨力不足。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "39833b36c9e41425ba326aaeb85dd107a929dc683a25f51ea298db7da189a648"}

{"id": "p_e901aa2c28b081c3", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 7, "text": "公乃忠義之士，敢求相助。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "2337d235bf2db8fa980ae0ca518281d692b018f0ba41f3b73d4e8c7beb69c5ec"}

{"id": "p_2cc7fe60854eb0ac", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」衛弘曰：「吾有是心久矣，恨未遇英雄耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "5a96d5fdbc1e0343c4c4979c142d387e654dc7a1904e0d5f59d521bc3223a846"}

{"id": "p_d586be8d361e74be", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 9, "text": "既孟德有大志，願將家資相助。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "13ba45159a36fe95ee8e9c6abf8824182e9ecd4911b71ecc46e35821b3f83289"}

{"id": "p_4a6b7e1c0862fbbd", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」操大喜；於是先發矯詔，馳報各道，然後招集義兵，豎起招兵白旗一面，上書「忠義」二字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "a6f4b373f53c92e65b7198b815f1ddaa7ef8bea61531c7f54e662772ca9d79e6"}

{"id": "p_e2f3b96401908afa", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 11, "text": "不數日間，應募之士，如雨駢集。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "3ca909bd47cd59cde3f1cc3b766d9b7f7363908e2189354cf5b94a3e25059a3d"}

{"id": "p_9a9bd2868073ccc3", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 12, "text": "一日，有一個陽平衛國人，姓樂，名進，字文謙，來投曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "97713a3ef5255e9699b1ca9e1c18c23a94dc4054f3bccc75b4ddfa4530828399"}

{"id": "p_1463d5b3a35cba8c", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 13, "text": "又有一個山陽鉅鹿人，姓李，名典，字曼成，也來投曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "56a7e4023e5f72f514a27f1a0f6782845b59bf0f818f01bb06056cbbc9705c3d"}

{"id": "p_0e52b992d9a50a16", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 14, "text": "又有沛國譙人，夏侯惇，字元讓，乃夏侯嬰之後；自小習鎗棒；年十四從師學武，有人辱罵其師，惇殺之，逃於外方；聞知曹操起兵，與其族弟夏侯淵兩個，各引壯士千人來會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "00640f07e1870ba3fc705718ad80a2cf8abb42599d827a7b69262299429ae5ef"}

{"id": "p_b531f661d01aa8d6", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 15, "text": "此二人本操之弟兄：操父曹嵩原是夏侯氏之子，過房與曹家，因此是同族。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "18239a9f8edc955b680ee18c0e1b493ef1185bfdf8621d9efdfde7ce7c93049b"}

{"id": "p_e2212b3210a8a87a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 16, "text": "不數日，曹氏兄弟曹仁，曹洪，各引兵千餘來助。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "737e2e2006eca3606cd8e969e702d91568ca294d1accf5874506167220ee7d19"}

{"id": "p_2f91d096c9fe6066", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 17, "text": "曹仁字子孝，曹洪字子廉；二人兵馬嫺熟，武藝精通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "ddf09d04da8dc4143db86498de525c7d427c1a5d94596920690823f896d6e46c"}

{"id": "p_ba95d11462417f0b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 18, "text": "操大喜，於村中調諫軍馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "226f9d3c83f5931fbb7fee78c587d8aab9a356ecc8e7a85dfb2e251125892e08"}

{"id": "p_9f0d4ee8cc1c8d53", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 19, "text": "衛弘盡出家財，置辦衣甲旗旛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "f030be5a8ce152ea48904b2626a8250db55264892b36f4c2c831bda742217bab"}

{"id": "p_ee02808b8e7bb595", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 20, "text": "時袁紹得操矯詔，乃聚麾下文武，引兵三萬，離渤海來與曹操會盟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "644cf49f35587ac646472e9f924c3a860ad22c75c4fc4434362bf18894d35b2e"}

{"id": "p_10254860b59f57ee", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 21, "text": "::操等謹以大義布告天下：董卓欺天罔地，滅國弒君；穢亂宮禁，殘害生靈；狼戾不仁，罪惡充積！", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "b5e41f57f6cba82288aea54fd1f3db02353d9215bb562c1b8c9c40fdeaeefc62"}

{"id": "p_f1e1b611ddd41253", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 22, "text": "今奉天子密詔，大集義兵，誓欲掃清華夏，剿戮群凶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "b2a00e8f6e626bc263152253bc4ba051c3b889c9f0b2eb84aa64860a4706a42b"}

{"id": "p_f2b0b347510e6b21", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 23, "text": "望興義師，共洩公憤；扶持王室，拯救黎民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "48b9c5d089780ad785baaa9c07ba023b9b16a6078964564f2051ba22d55bb9bb"}

{"id": "p_ec19175af8e9b635", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 24, "text": "操發檄文去後，各鎮諸侯，皆起兵相應：", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "10a1082d459cfc7ab9540283fc31a7cc97bb717d1db6967c0866c4c3ca39e8f4"}

{"id": "p_aa6e47997b31ccda", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 25, "text": ":第一鎮，後將軍南陽太守袁術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "1e74232f051e61e8a09392753963ad8e470d965e89d605339233884d0f899830"}

{"id": "p_b126f8e3c4c0b4ab", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 26, "text": ":第二鎮，冀州刺史韓馥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "9d79c452f09f34d1243d7e9624e2810a39e210debc26f56ab9ee3128ae1d05f5"}

{"id": "p_612312c0414b695c", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 27, "text": ":第三鎮，豫州刺史孔伷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "9474007c0ee812072c777d44e570865f7e9ee9c837727dc853cc7534c21a2040"}

{"id": "p_e1e729228e37d9b8", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 28, "text": ":第四鎮，兗州刺史劉岱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "8f0061e5a9585793ca0afe2d76e8d9c031d4cc50c753a1a88e25579fb70e16b0"}

{"id": "p_420d74eacb0f0765", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 29, "text": ":第五鎮，河內太守王匡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "1367e02fb53c72dac1c4c26ed4081072e43e7fc54b5ec5ea70e5e0f3236b10ae"}

{"id": "p_38af90daddebc305", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 30, "text": ":第六鎮，陳留太守張邈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "06720709fa2ec0180a3d15582da1c2a1019f593ea38852030c9d89d803ec4dea"}

{"id": "p_166c24a7b09b1c5f", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 31, "text": ":第七鎮，東郡太守喬瑁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "4d5d24d26882aeea2521be06a92f71a97433b5385b26dcb8a06d545722dac59f"}

{"id": "p_8842fe3592f8a1a6", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 32, "text": ":第八鎮，山陽太守袁遺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "9c5bf4b58ce488d5cef7d242f7679a1949abbe996f1b0be90e65bbfca139cfab"}

{"id": "p_17a3a6758e425129", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 33, "text": ":第十鎮，北海太守孔融。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "24a2079f0577e62e5438672ae75515dc76c903ecffb7ea7aab13ae8983f03d55"}

{"id": "p_0d875cac9110e93c", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 34, "text": ":第十一鎮，廣陵太守張超。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "d6bf108b0c294c245b52d9fee1432f152e1fffdd4c1c821c373c662a5502c762"}

{"id": "p_c54214abc3fb2b41", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 35, "text": ":第十二鎮，徐州刺史陶謙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "d1eb821ca86c6356051b099e61e8d3b753f66197b5e45703c4da42ec8f6d9b7a"}

{"id": "p_447e41a49bdd4f96", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 36, "text": ":第十三鎮，西涼太守馬騰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "3e1ad920d95f03328372887470c5b42bcabf520eb6d0d5dead4e67fa51da398d"}

{"id": "p_b05925fdb5fbe500", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 37, "text": ":第十四鎮，北平太守公孫瓚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "6724bacbfaf49f520dd39d52c74ee9b8053a9efd526b1b5484c178b7d1ee903d"}

{"id": "p_7bb475b489d145b5", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 38, "text": ":第十五鎮，上黨太守張楊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "0bf6644340cd26d3e0cafc08ed81b49fcb8548941ac78506403e4cd0bb04328e"}

{"id": "p_29ff9262b10f60fa", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 39, "text": ":第十六鎮，烏程侯長沙太守孫堅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "9352f46c9783d7599ee5c208a6dcff6dd594330f2cd1e04a48b0b28632abbdbc"}

{"id": "p_1ad4ce7f92f38af6", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 40, "text": ":第十七鎮，祁鄉侯渤海太守袁紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "527cbe9d7ad5f30c8a5fecb60129084d6fafa8af57ccc4afaa7472da95d75875"}

{"id": "p_fc9518abc690d3fa", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 41, "text": "諸路軍馬，多少不等，有三萬者，有一二萬者，各領文官武將，投洛陽來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "f13ca84a1addcb84bfc09f7a08692a6de272352637cca79f8608ccbc8c83bf20"}

{"id": "p_80e433b77f257f30", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 42, "text": "且說北平太守公孫瓚，統領精兵一萬五千，路經德州平原縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "d65baca0d69181513f56300c68d4b841695227cb259bc8f6d15568399a6a3be0"}

{"id": "p_e8c800be939f961a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 43, "text": "正行之間，遙見桑樹叢中，一面黃旗，數騎來迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "1c03643f71d7efce22275dcfe1fa3b9c7c365790ba91a135395eb72ad96b89f1"}

{"id": "p_af9d91aa3ba63b98", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 44, "text": "瓚問曰：「賢弟何故在此？", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "4b53677eb8809b912dc5a511e4d3e813fd60d5a3fd957ee29dd89cb812dd8e9e"}

{"id": "p_d737892335cf25ff", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」玄德曰：「舊日蒙兄保備為平原縣令，今聞大軍過此，特來奉候，就請兄長入城歇馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "d9434139f1aa564f89f088cb603a05dcdd45d3b9611210b5cb1a825cf20a33cc"}

{"id": "p_1d10b987b19e237f", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 46, "text": "」瓚指關、張而問曰：「此何人也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "820e4cde59c34a73009c6b044ed3412fde1f273f546c4b3ce76a71df3ee28f21"}

{"id": "p_2afd487876cdb307", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 47, "text": "」玄德曰：「此關羽，張飛，備結義兄弟也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "72853982e2a20a3a8ad44bd045c6199b31a51895ad6bc51b1e91d7a31c4ef653"}

{"id": "p_54abff48dfe4ed54", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 48, "text": "」瓚曰：「乃同破黃巾者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "c3f25bc043bcfc88221d04dc6359a23444e103375f5d9910ce6584059e37c55d"}

{"id": "p_abb0fad3bf6a30ed", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 49, "text": "」玄德曰：「皆此二人之力。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "08a3831ef544d1610a6bf7d6309b7664d3275de9e716706f81d2257ee83b4b35"}

{"id": "p_ec66e9ce7b86927b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」玄德答曰：「關羽為馬弓手，張飛為步弓手。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "eb291eadbcc8913b7819adcdd690d7a041e7e0722dd1af93dba1591c267e38c0"}

{"id": "p_1b6faf78281d9b20", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」瓚歎曰：「如此可謂埋沒英雄！", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "2687a23153705743c449afe71076d77582ca0e23410ecd8736f18e73a7fc21d6"}

{"id": "p_56ff154080c66fcb", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 52, "text": "今董卓作亂，天下諸侯，共往誅之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "2ba55bf31980cd9363c5fabeab4fdf87c9302da81ca18e7cb79ed1cbc282ef91"}

{"id": "p_f53daf9501a66427", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 53, "text": "賢弟可棄此卑官，一同討賊，力扶漢室，若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "0b995443b95ce2987864c5e37d742d4812197e93a94d2535e46386782e12994d"}

{"id": "p_7123581771009835", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 54, "text": "」張飛曰：「當時若容我殺了此賊，免有今日之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "94e0966889c7e04c6be30cd679babd20a1e8db88f9d1ac11fba4b2f4b9db11ec"}

{"id": "p_c98fc6e44ff693db", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」雲長曰：「事已至此，即當收拾前去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "465c5cb4edd33a235b20c90bf56af7928e7950308d952224be57e09813415712"}

{"id": "p_b82b52c56a9d9012", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 56, "text": "玄德、關、張引數騎跟公孫瓚來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "4343ef63b4104aff7a70156b9e7b6e7369b16339de436809fc9fbe2e4286be18"}

{"id": "p_914eda41354b44fd", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 57, "text": "眾諸侯亦陸續皆至，各自安營下寨，連接二百餘里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "4fd96af19bc9c02ad3a14e0b64be5b5c01a4b48ea695aec23c8336b855e1ab6d"}

{"id": "p_47667d7341021237", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 58, "text": "操乃宰牛殺馬，大會諸侯，商議進兵之策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "c1ae3d6549afcb1e296a9f5f99de119c1ff89d63006a69a04867eda9f0b82b54"}

{"id": "p_82096a436cc0c1d7", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 59, "text": "太守王匡曰：「今奉大義，必立盟主；眾聽約束，然後進兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "ea1ca2fd9b3e9a8730d4f24d31c754e3d2bcbbfde0e02ae85309fdba72552d2f"}

{"id": "p_fff7f0a74352ed6b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 60, "text": "」操曰：「袁本初四世三公，門多故吏，漢朝名相之裔，可為盟主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "b6ea64d3c3abf4cd434a940d7fa0c28b841e33a98af7dba799428335690d2cf1"}

{"id": "p_1e09c63e77465810", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 61, "text": "次日築臺三層，遍列五方旗幟，上建白旄黃鉞，兵符將印，請紹登壇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "94542edb668c9dbb84c95f67a64713909c849404ca8a161a8a3a6d2f97535dbe"}

{"id": "p_3fa959bbebdd6c5c", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 62, "text": "紹整衣佩劍，慨然而上，焚香再拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "1f8ec2144ad6bccde44afcd2e9f96a292377af3727ab018c1f471094992d2e12"}

{"id": "p_f832726af64af935", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 63, "text": "::漢室不幸，皇綱失統。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "040fb2d89a8abfc1ae2839a5480555b8f8b8c8a18573736ea57d8cfc100ac4cc"}

{"id": "p_4a0c3ee76efd8217", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 64, "text": "賊臣董卓，乘釁縱害，禍加至尊，虐流百姓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "91175e9e74bf44b5a70eb8a4624d9ef24927d31f94f13190054cd10ff7a3918d"}

{"id": "p_5e04c8ca58542a69", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 65, "text": "紹等懼社稷淪喪，糾合義兵，並赴國難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "893d39e513268f2ff052e081c75c8619c8a2750d0801278c7b8bde45b5f527a9"}

{"id": "p_da4dafb370b41fd6", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 66, "text": "凡我同盟，齊心戮力，以致臣節，必無二志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "d9ac1f221d3e44fe02e6cd95da1ef4d4be2389c98d1ccea81b767220b34aeaba"}

{"id": "p_329d99fef1b7a991", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 67, "text": "有渝此盟，俾墜其命，無克遺育。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "199639b5ec794f2980faab50f3ee5cb66ad7e7532ff2a5df14a6739752327e32"}

{"id": "p_f614256b95a2c6ba", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 68, "text": "皇天后土，祖宗明靈，實皆鑒之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "04ac9ce9427cae38d23fdcd23733339f20aee06c78e3d0a5803f780b6a5f7fbc"}

{"id": "p_1a5f819bbec93aa1", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 69, "text": "眾因其辭氣慷慨，皆涕泗橫流。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "ae9d547719de823a6c8e465ac73c7ca6d868f888f552c62894e6b84d4a6210e9"}

{"id": "p_76dc9716b7c4238b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 70, "text": "眾扶紹升帳而坐，兩行依爵位年齒分列坐定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "0982a78d6108e2eb9950f3ea6af815719b938039bb75c1993243a82d7ee596b9"}

{"id": "p_01e5d400ab38dfa7", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 71, "text": "操行酒數巡，言曰：「今日既立盟主，各聽調遣，同扶國家，勿以強弱計較。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "a51b2c0335c4dbcddb5306a2bf9795d636a3e77b52af193324b1c199328819c5"}

{"id": "p_e630dfe2e13b170f", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 72, "text": "」袁紹曰：「紹雖不才，既承公等推為盟主，有功必賞，有罪必罰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "9c72cd308c61d94e72b6fb29dc476cc8b843b7fb8460982f74766b9b0b67f0f8"}

{"id": "p_c71859f86cb30d6d", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 73, "text": "國有常刑，軍有紀律；各宜遵守，勿得違犯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "ff922131f1696800cdabb0e50fa2895ee18590289d661d4dd54a96a9e6822a67"}

{"id": "p_3ca6c795d2074475", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 74, "text": "」紹曰：「吾弟袁術總督糧草，應付諸營，無使有缺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "18508d8531ca48f375144c520dbb86e6a93808926fa070b8ab397655c5da6ce9"}

{"id": "p_ec25c8aecf902e62", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 75, "text": "更須一人為先鋒，直抵汜水關挑戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "e11e3f1e586a52de5feceae0a12e37e9cd16efb1ddaa59694671def3749c6533"}

{"id": "p_70296facd3a87cd3", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 76, "text": "」長沙太守孫堅出曰：「堅願為前部。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "897ce3501e5afac136f73eb2dd14abc34cbec1ade0da36b9f8809db904e6c858"}

{"id": "p_03c0494fde5d1cf8", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」紹曰：「文臺勇烈，可當此任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "20fb6b7121b07c5c041e5b482856d6985b36e62047530c9fe90e87d7bdd6a197"}

{"id": "p_917a7393df9c207e", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 78, "text": "」堅遂引本部人馬殺奔汜水關來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "409a88d67e51cd5cc12b754949465f9b5bd5bf98165d27aad0cc83cd3903a136"}

{"id": "p_80a6acc893d44503", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 79, "text": "守關將士，差流星馬往洛陽丞相府告急。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "4f64d766090f3045b03bb6edd55c0866c48a6f7db3ae4fab2ada2d3c543d8dc8"}

{"id": "p_148d1a25e91e5849", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 80, "text": "董卓自專大權之後，每日飲宴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "102b7742f52ae5cdf78a768b7e5eaee2e94c2c9a845e9ffc71ccf7de6a6a47f9"}

{"id": "p_4c7e0874f2d616ba", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 81, "text": "李儒接得告急文書，逕來稟卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "2512b7a134796c63448f725b590f92071e91472b72fb80a42cb3876272805fbf"}

{"id": "p_abdfbd0004fbbaff", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 82, "text": "溫侯呂布挺身出曰：「父親勿慮：關外諸侯，布視之如草芥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "32a00391260c689e5e445bb320a7ea9369643adfc5bb63f3e611b8df3d5132c9"}

{"id": "p_b7ce802a831b4786", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 83, "text": "願提虎狼之師，盡斬其首，懸於都門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "45382991e7900c202e8658c4e3b2ebd02716907f1ee67f6a7faffe2fa73c504e"}

{"id": "p_2c58d097b06ad487", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」卓大喜曰：「吾有奉先，高枕無憂矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "896de06e66a5381d359a3391ad7532028b9417dedf0978e8d40a34d6c7899748"}

{"id": "p_ecefa3569d8e5506", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 85, "text": "」言未絕，呂布背後一人高聲出曰：「『割雞焉用牛刀？", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "8f4820941d0d5e799439d359be5ef616d5db00d316458af948fed92d6832acd6"}

{"id": "p_494969c27229eecd", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 86, "text": "吾斬眾諸侯首級，如探囊取物耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "5915b3f8d1944fd1a054dca187ab9694ee526f1d6cf3815bc953af08e842262b"}

{"id": "p_ef701d4ae8757e80", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 87, "text": "」卓視之，其人身長九尺，虎體狼腰，豹頭猿臂：關西人也；姓華，名雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "0378fd5bb7876f2abf5bfc91271e0e4b973d000a0dc29b0df4da66c1d388ddd3"}

{"id": "p_566290d5454f16b3", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 88, "text": "卓聞言大喜，加為驍騎校尉，撥馬步軍五萬，同李肅，胡軫，趙岑星夜赴關迎敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "b8e9c07a20cb2530e1d4d739502274b7a7413af281178f316c442156fb4ea426"}

{"id": "p_ed379d0aee1cf2eb", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 89, "text": "眾諸侯內有濟北相鮑信，尋思孫堅既為前部，怕他奪了頭功，暗撥其弟鮑忠，先將馬步軍三千，逕抄小路，直到關下搦戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "ca54166c6529bda304103479ca7a603425309fb23c8c9826b22d056610006a58"}

{"id": "p_8166ffd7f7d8d276", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 90, "text": "華雄引鐵騎五百，飛下關來，大喝：「賊將休走！", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "68b23443041ab9ad989ced1d3319dd8e12cbe0b331e30cf75bbe0e15398e74b0"}

{"id": "p_db93eaa2f191a5cd", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 91, "text": "」鮑忠急待退，被華雄手起刀落，斬於馬下，生擒將校極多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "da42bdf57e580e9540dd618fcab4e2d93b1d876f955e25ed8317d467753a1bf6"}

{"id": "p_b7687af16446d42b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 92, "text": "華雄遣人將鮑忠首級來相府報捷，卓加雄為都督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "0da3b03cee1f29294b8dc11eda2ccc2efaeb2a8527bab5a3a12f0bcb7ceaf998"}

{"id": "p_ddb2e7fae62d1dc0", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 93, "text": "卻說孫堅引四將直至關前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "eaaa4ad3b884b7dbba1d9312f047dfe4921a5de2e70eb8ccb569a170500d64fb"}

{"id": "p_29d98f68f054e487", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 94, "text": "那四將：第一個，右北平土垠人：姓程，名普，字德謀，使一條鐵脊蛇矛；第二個，姓黃，名蓋，字公覆，零陵人也，使鐵鞭：第三個，姓韓，名當，字義公，遼西令支人也，使一口大刀；第四個，姓祖，名茂，字大榮，吳郡富春人也，使雙刀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "a94de360f6a1ab9f5c02853092e6788f6a3a7cd32d570f3fa14311ea974189a7"}

{"id": "p_51e621dd6a6d51bf", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 95, "text": "孫堅披爛銀鎧，裏赤幘，橫古錠刀，騎花鬃馬，指關上而罵曰：「助惡匹夫，何不早降！", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "2e0471d3bd2af15d10a65afa8b2da11efe1527401f2b2ce23daa851c28edab8a"}

{"id": "p_53d910cc52ca6de8", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 96, "text": "華雄副將胡軫引兵五千出關迎戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "c1605e37419897234d1af3235433bed92b9e1c5487bbf0e863be3a026c6e42fa"}

{"id": "p_511ad0d070bb2bf1", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 97, "text": "程普飛馬挺矛，直取胡軫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "b692e2d26a9f746438972c5451b90d408f58d68fd44b52feb1d7864f44e55658"}

{"id": "p_06f26d5a3beeac14", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 98, "text": "鬥不數合，程普刺中胡軫咽喉，死於馬下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "f07c790ece652538220b87e40d66f6e3d8dffa488dcee35e80983f2e82a74121"}

{"id": "p_56d011ed1deb8281", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 99, "text": "堅揮軍直殺至關前，關上矢石如雨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "b9d78e9728c120a2f82a71dc24c945726a46302e94ef3fefdc0c5756a3a14da5"}

{"id": "p_50326e03175ab9c0", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 100, "text": "孫堅引兵回至梁東屯住，使人於袁紹處報捷，就於袁術處催糧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "d3e577406a818b7e9e97c0ead3bd98526070c6730e82123b9045d47e93897c87"}

{"id": "p_e8597fd66d6ff215", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 101, "text": "或說術曰：「孫堅乃江東猛虎；若打破洛陽，殺了董卓，正是除狼而得虎也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "ec6c30582ed711c30f1da44097b3f3e912e013338812ff20e29a63dad6b01f9a"}

{"id": "p_bdb73d68ef14955a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 102, "text": "孫堅軍缺食，軍中自亂，細作報上關來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "0d07ff0718c18dc8ec0a50972134535636e93c83674705aaaaf70f1f91be39ce"}

{"id": "p_59f106b4d045c31a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 103, "text": "李肅為華雄謀曰：「今夜我引一軍從小路下關，襲孫堅寨後，將軍揮其前寨，堅可擒矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "5e65b1a35d14bb54dee07493c2e163024a61ec71b3ca8b6f4216db670a1e134f"}

{"id": "p_d307ec2bf400b2df", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 104, "text": "雄從之，傳令軍士飽餐，乘夜下關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "ba9f7f581954ba66515cece79e50d863dd9759dda9799cef6e35f738c30b58a6"}

{"id": "p_47b0445a2597f024", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 105, "text": "到堅寨時，已是半夜，鼓譟直進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "216b6ad8ecf5f9108636cc780da372bf94f6af83114c52686c55a81bdbb5625a"}

{"id": "p_fa29f3f49648629c", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 106, "text": "堅慌忙披掛上馬，正遇華雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "e55cfaf38e9866a7b8f78cf3d5197bd407c5d14b44ebf2909353b7b795e39119"}

{"id": "p_2f2c6593614d0b85", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 107, "text": "兩馬相交，鬥不數合，後面李肅軍到，令軍士放起火來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "53a24f71d1f56f63362404224d2b5c3b3f0f65b1c50d846385a0f4a7ee6648b8"}

{"id": "p_c15aafb146732ba2", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 108, "text": "眾將各自混戰，止有祖茂跟定孫堅，突圍而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "7ae9ae0370cf71d2871afb696497cbfe1d958afed4cc978fa44327c93c83c6c2"}

{"id": "p_8e447e3dcf524f64", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 109, "text": "堅取箭，連放兩箭，皆被華雄躲過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "00cdea4566e6218ab0e1562af8cd8e2f726416f8d6c92ab6629ecf615904dddd"}

{"id": "p_e1e604cc030f7e80", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 110, "text": "再放第三箭時，因用力太猛，拽折了鵲畫弓，只得棄弓縱馬而奔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "9ed5a19dfa7053696e5561a2a8823e546d4bb666416aa1e66b20d9d3874ee174"}

{"id": "p_e7215cb469bf0e70", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 111, "text": "祖茂曰：「主公頭上赤幘射目，為賊所識認。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "83aefebeb7633eae88a81d9095a17364d954555939e60b1d56aa105c5d500238"}

{"id": "p_d80ef4b77e80da78", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 112, "text": "」堅就脫幘換茂盔，分兩路而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "9663c0d47fdc72a4f5ffb6018b80f53ee1ef76a7f464b2688f7ff270925af444"}

{"id": "p_7bed7907bec89fff", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 113, "text": "雄軍只望赤幘者追趕，堅乃從小路得脫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "4c79db91027e488af38f9947a1887567692c986b23c9d1306d0ad2e7019aac88"}

{"id": "p_27b95dcc156b10a3", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 114, "text": "祖茂被華雄追急，將赤幘挂於人家燒不盡的庭柱上，卻入樹林潛躲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "ab22b9be9dc7086bf94e2b5fb3bc99ba4330d6b113d76efdc9d6a6a40318948f"}

{"id": "p_10a15ceb094ce98c", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 115, "text": "華雄軍於下遙月見赤幘，四面圍定，不敢近前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "b357bc4c56f0a3ea5f7fa65617ec0575babfe134204d7905eab39be9f4d5ae8b"}

{"id": "p_3b122bbeb72ac615", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 116, "text": "用箭射之，方知是計，遂向前取了赤幘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "3f51fac7d406337cbbc2bd165e067642f37deba31975712ef774f94310701014"}

{"id": "p_1f3b3b383018e58b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 117, "text": "祖茂於林後殺出，揮雙刀欲劈華雄；雄大喝一聲，將祖茂一刀砍於馬下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "6091d03e6a3c694b3737ac554230a08a825527a376abbf7957c0c57d78f78cfc"}

{"id": "p_046c07a42dcbbfe2", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 118, "text": "殺至天明，雄方引兵上關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "f6936ce32c224bdf4af54bb8b2a8d47b696cfb04e6acf68d7f9221290dde8030"}

{"id": "p_fe693d586dc477f1", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 119, "text": "程普，黃蓋，韓當都來尋見孫堅，再收拾軍馬屯紮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "7c1209b366a84df3dff390bf13aa98e10379a1a71a743147cfdbfc7d83cf9aed"}

{"id": "p_b2c404dfb91a9b6b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 120, "text": "堅為折了祖茂，傷感不已，星夜遣人報知袁紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "88740754958f7741359391b58eb3d83171a3ad3f85b30821b2c97e8b4f87522f"}

{"id": "p_ed236ea785e9956b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 121, "text": "紹大驚曰：「不想孫文臺敗於華雄之手！", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "4d5724defe1c41c00e0dfb6b006295f55fa2daf8544eac5280c4b77155f197d6"}

{"id": "p_004f963b62b5e406", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 122, "text": "眾人都到，只有公孫瓚後至，紹請入帳列坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "9f3ed1d4c29988d8ce56648efbe286f5129aae2cb110eb0a5ee51023f6fef861"}

{"id": "p_ecbc652a0005b0a6", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 123, "text": "紹曰：「前日鮑將軍之弟不遵調遣，擅自進兵，殺身喪命，折了許多軍士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "8c7d730e2c83cfcbc67aac3d4d9276de71e42353d4578b828bd2c4fc5118fcb6"}

{"id": "p_29c0290f31cef86f", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 124, "text": "今者孫文臺又敗於華雄：挫動銳氣，為之奈何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "4ec873515a3fd63855e1909605552b58d54244d89d6746b896cd008dadc987f6"}

{"id": "p_c85e6faf283aefe7", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 125, "text": "紹舉目遍視，見公孫瓚背後立著三人，容貌異常，都在那裏冷笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "a7330c51c8a1433fc1a25af7eb9302eb264556a989ec78b71238c2824306ba04"}

{"id": "p_3a4dcf083232f666", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 126, "text": "紹問曰：「公孫太守背後何人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "46bbea78a5ed58153ee7d3e2c3d7bd87ab7f9dc380619a6339456737225dceff"}

{"id": "p_38581b6305557554", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」瓚呼玄德出曰：「此吾自幼同舍兄弟，平原令劉備是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "232cd2e91a1801478fa0dcd50b6bb6adb51c748ca2e5440ec661680a26875279"}

{"id": "p_1c5dcae3717b4cd2", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 128, "text": "」曹操曰：「莫非破黃巾劉玄德乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "87e96ec8a6d4932dc110e550f55f428c681af402f318ae1ccc52999b2841c884"}

{"id": "p_ac1903c8d95b1a30", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 129, "text": "瓚將玄德功勞，並其出身，細說一遍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "5d7c9ca34ab984ba36ed16f20bc2684d68ed720e60f0f525ea05d2c2631ce57e"}

{"id": "p_e9e354db64d9d14a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 130, "text": "紹曰：「既是漢室宗派，取坐來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "8be5f0efe8ea9d05fc4da9d641597f9f27491557a4c157cc51a555b92adedc7f"}

{"id": "p_d4e8f84a312a42e1", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 131, "text": "紹曰：「吾非敬汝名爵，吾敬汝是帝室之冑耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "bb539346915bba2f711c7e80867c25ccf60cbcad6992038bf940dd8aff360292"}

{"id": "p_7088b7c47c323ec4", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」玄德乃坐於末位，關、張叉手侍立於後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "2e51de3c65b22ac44872ad6ebf932383cda4e2ba27e76a909595ee42382c5528"}

{"id": "p_83e551f723ad2f01", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 133, "text": "忽探子來報：「華雄引鐵騎下關，用長竿挑著孫太守赤幘，來寨前大罵搦戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "513997d3b5381d33bacd3997a9f0d7169987bc90c4967a6cb7b7bceca07dee5e"}

{"id": "p_bf9110b2822f75e7", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 134, "text": "」袁術背後轉出驍將俞涉曰：「小將願往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "713f0cf2b94608c6c4becc10d1b1a953bae65d7b43d8e444ea8602aeaeae8d9b"}

{"id": "p_fa175282c9b2a001", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 135, "text": "即時報來：「俞涉與華雄戰不三合，被華雄斬了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "5d4a5cdd8bbaf30981142bc02e73266fe5fd1ca513cb3fe8fac2bc52856d6fcd"}

{"id": "p_e15982530d6dcf0a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 136, "text": "太守韓馥曰：「吾有上將潘鳳，可斬華雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "64b11c263896a5b0e198f21d4d92d084783d69cb620f94138a0564a6c1ed8593"}

{"id": "p_f72e8a5d3573999c", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 137, "text": "去不多時，飛馬來報：「潘鳳又被華雄斬了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "ffffaa8a9bc1dc958b0e63b966df6b23080f397a5845f5f2dbc8aff3aa62ba81"}

{"id": "p_af97163e025482b9", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 138, "text": "紹曰：「可惜吾上將顏良、文醜未至！", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "ac0680d779e0e51e339e823de370122a80106c785e8a0616eee0585cc136e6c9"}

{"id": "p_8a0a4784c65aa337", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 139, "text": "」言未畢，階下一人大呼出曰：「小將願往斬華雄頭，獻於帳下！", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "70e1d8b82f60c4a0ab3b476aeda6d0365b579d613738976f7e52b722e0858659"}

{"id": "p_e2ca39fbe0a34414", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」眾視之，見其人身長九尺，髯長二尺；丹鳳眼，臥蠶眉；面如重棗，聲如巨鐘；立於帳前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "9e42a011cc7baa24fb9fedfee30dfb866b9f1487839c68716b6cd4049b46ebd1"}

{"id": "p_e794e35f4b67aef3", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 141, "text": "公孫瓚曰：「此劉玄德之弟關羽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "5bb36de51bd3713f867a2c7312b274283a1b68f610adf8993eb6a48cfb64dbab"}

{"id": "p_36d43df128ec37b9", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 142, "text": "瓚曰：「跟隨劉玄德充馬弓手。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "aebed1cbd35fbd5d355b6ead7f9ae3a0663b8d72532de30eb20a68796e651058"}

{"id": "p_d0052c6063e39e2d", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 143, "text": "」帳上袁術大喝曰：「汝欺吾眾諸侯無大將耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "2d9181bdb280cfd15be87fcac0e2bf62bbc06ed3edc51d28c14da407344bc182"}

{"id": "p_d05ada33415536fd", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」曹操急止之曰：「公路息怒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "10fdfb2aade27eb5ae6698bf673353f95071134476d212fd4b2e4ae6982d7da3"}

{"id": "p_9d0b946513ad7828", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 145, "text": "此人既出大言，必有勇略；試教出馬，如其不勝，責之未遲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "ea47de8c83b5779a22fbe5d8369f1e9f734acd2ad44a59db6f7c22fe52c89e27"}

{"id": "p_8bcb010d3c75d728", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」袁紹曰：「使一弓手出戰，必被華雄所笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "09b6fb287750dd2dab4936bbe383d12c277312c03f5267cd68e6666c1ab7b7f2"}

{"id": "p_3d35ce6b17a94f59", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」操曰：「此人儀表不俗，華雄安知他是弓手？", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "e79194ba09df2450d95d86146215d1bba98eacb2ce6cbb7324b443e04b3109ab"}

{"id": "p_2e7044d5d78e9ad9", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」關公曰：「如不勝，請斬某頭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "6372ca12077f43203b170120791fd8c9d7ddf984388186455e531f61769254b7"}

{"id": "p_133b94e315e93f3a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 149, "text": "操教釃熱酒一盃，與關公飲了上馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "b26779b157d661189eddbb512fdac75d4925b9bdced6f68ac1f41ec200e0797a"}

{"id": "p_3ece3c27ca66dd87", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 150, "text": "關公曰：「酒且斟下，某去便來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "100e440b646b685bc1ece4881bba456f84a81e3e76a6f77bce6263f17d664c65"}

{"id": "p_c1c9a1fe4bb0be5a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 151, "text": "眾諸侯聽得關外鼓聲大振，喊聲大舉，如天摧地塌，岳撼山崩，眾皆失驚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "873416453ef2f7c56c2de4e14acd051254395e979096e8ca6e587c4ca9475987"}

{"id": "p_a240588668ecc43c", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 152, "text": "正欲探聽，鸞鈴響處，馬到中軍，雲長提華雄之頭，擲於地上，其酒當溫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "055281f38105c9f510fde173c98ac75f8be837624f1fbea1f826770e5043a3b0"}

{"id": "p_d28f60c8080bcb99", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 153, "text": "::威鎮乾坤第一功，轅門畫鼓響鼕鼕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "2a2948b3f7e7fb2eac3867a299bed579b30bf9a4016eff5b3ac6242de422bfe4"}

{"id": "p_0ebe59db56ccb712", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 154, "text": "::雲長停盞施英勇，酒當溫時斬華雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "f27d32471126958fd251e6883fd8649a1f6a5367adcfe2c4c4f36a82e8c4993e"}

{"id": "p_85de1f799c9e9297", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 155, "text": "只見玄德背後轉出張飛，高聲大叫：「俺哥哥斬了華雄，不就這裏殺入關去，活拏董卓，更待何時！", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "c07f70a9b7849e34a666e98b4d18c0a5b40a8cc7e3ed1315c51c834abca7989e"}

{"id": "p_1cd498202754b88f", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 156, "text": "」袁術大怒，喝曰：「俺大臣尚自謙讓，量一縣令手下小卒，安敢在此耀武揚威！", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "7790d1f47e467b4a7371a66d0f865dd2a300b0e2ee8e59d13c8ba88a528f1b52"}

{"id": "p_729b7b8daea6c9db", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 157, "text": "」曹操曰：「得功者賞，何計貴賤乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "8eb05d5e3ef96357cbc922444430efd3b651ddadb2c5cfc93c87ecbc30211db4"}

{"id": "p_3c9525ec61f3aeda", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 158, "text": "」袁術曰：「既然公等只重一縣令，我當告退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "f3db1cc69387e470510c06d198ac109d9676b1c5b428c7935e025ea27df56a2d"}

{"id": "p_9e46e1be6420a489", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 159, "text": "」操曰：「豈可因一言而誤大事耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "9e38049600949a560be08999bfe657f3bcdc610e0c4f176377ed604d9f6af71b"}

{"id": "p_13bd37fc0c616a24", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 160, "text": "」命公孫瓚且帶玄德、關、張回寨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "72773aa0972d814a13d0676206ca0f3192b0d45f046a9f79892dd714319519fb"}

{"id": "p_5d17f02e9aee9dca", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 161, "text": "曹操暗使人齎牛酒撫慰三人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "a10f25f485c69f26ee7aada96882c5b61eae2450c8a42da5d71f75b65bfce52b"}

{"id": "p_91ad0d92d7f12f3d", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 162, "text": "卻說華雄手下敗軍，報上關來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "6a3056447389263c36b8daa616831fbd043c0c61cc05a5099723dda7d47ba2b8"}

{"id": "p_7d12549e4110805a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 163, "text": "李肅慌忙寫告急文書，申聞董卓。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "455366cbf34481e96800c22b5702a64576aa5e9696045ed3947a09e0f3f7740b"}

{"id": "p_5b8a70eff7fd2d1a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 164, "text": "卓急聚李儒、呂布等商議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "abb59a57dfa092d23083ffb4406f289d51118eb942cfa135597fa394b044b8ff"}

{"id": "p_abf95a1b09b3596e", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 165, "text": "儒曰：「今失了上將華雄，賊勢浩大。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "03c489040754a7fe928fcd480e870f63df567747736d5549c9dacc3ac650e923"}

{"id": "p_95ae18e52282e1b0", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 166, "text": "袁紹為盟主，紹叔袁隗，現為太傅；倘或裏應外合，深為不便，可先除之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "6222d9f024343fcde6b2d864c2862f350814f5b15e07eb89201387e5ad7ff06b"}

{"id": "p_a559cc79c5ba1fee", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 167, "text": "請丞相親領大軍，分撥剿捕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "e9aba82271d0995223de61758da7cd5a62bddaf5347ddeb296c63ce8a89b27f5"}

{"id": "p_8557f83f91bcb377", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 168, "text": "」卓然其說，喚李傕，郭汜，領兵五百，圍住太傅袁隗家，不分老幼，盡皆誅絕，先將袁隗首級去關前號令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "190b2248287a6be3b9f875fa13352e5ef26b9b8949b94858026824ae405a6451"}

{"id": "p_a4f9659c307549eb", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 169, "text": "卓遂起兵二十萬，分為兩路而來：一路先令李傕，郭汜，引兵五萬，把住汜水關，不要廝殺；卓自將十五萬，同李儒，呂布，樊稠，張濟，等守虎牢關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "1eaba686c49500aa9155bbe6b34e4b3068070f962045cf27a2307c800200eaef"}

{"id": "p_c7760ab3a1ca1ce1", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 170, "text": "軍馬到關，卓令呂布領三萬大軍，去關前紮住大寨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "bfaed1f0ff9c0122a688db4e78c3880fac4b1e76f0d5f30563d5c18479c6a6c1"}

{"id": "p_9eeddb3fc4840d39", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 171, "text": "流星馬探聽得，報入袁紹大寨裏來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "5361eaa3658766fe407d6adb0f5fb74c0eb6857ceca4c379d419e26604228229"}

{"id": "p_9af34d47d9749c2b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 172, "text": "操曰：「董卓屯兵虎牢，截俺諸侯中路，今可勒兵一半迎敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "f74214fd97e9ca3d973c9a5bc8fd19262515634457dca975a49203dd45b8bc70"}

{"id": "p_3c5c5b7fa3c51f9e", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 173, "text": "」紹乃分王匡，喬瑁，鮑信，袁遺，孔融，張楊，陶謙，公孫瓚，八路諸侯，往虎牢關迎敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "b27d3b9276f847befefdaa648783b848fe82916a129befab22a237b62d17d7aa"}

{"id": "p_882591f0d3ee1ed6", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 174, "text": "河內太守王匡，引兵先到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "d83132309b76c2a79f7c765f1eb060af1f98189aca0b756255ad512c5115c325"}

{"id": "p_4f8bb232d7b5c2fb", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 175, "text": "呂布帶鐵騎三千，飛奔來迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "6cbe577fa3d8a6756c87103859ef1bd13826f8f2fcc7d921366fad5fa483bdd2"}

{"id": "p_cd6c2ff961a673aa", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 176, "text": "王匡將軍馬列成陣勢，勒馬門旗下看時，見呂布出陣：頭戴三叉束髮紫金冠，體挂西川紅錦百花袍，身披獸面吞頭連環鎧，腰繫勒甲玲瓏獅蠻帶；弓箭隨身，手持畫戟；坐下嘶風赤兔馬；果然是人中呂布，馬中赤兔！", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "fb11c8eee0fb37395264e5046fa45867243d935e526c33769eec3ae8c58172ac"}

{"id": "p_0ecf3a45b9743247", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 177, "text": "王匡回頭問曰：「誰敢出戰？", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "a349387c9a630084db993799e567b6a1934c9e83e0d621e0b532e3544c9edf20"}

{"id": "p_7bbd8bc4181ef89d", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 178, "text": "」後面一將，縱馬挺鎗而出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "66c808823cf250b6090ee591f5a21894ac256946ef13b2720bf9a0498e1be5ab"}

{"id": "p_c9c8551ac2d1e746", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 179, "text": "匡視之，乃河內名將方悅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "79aef64f3ed8efa8ee8f5e5ada7fa771659db3bb6cfddd22e26e59fb458b0f1d"}

{"id": "p_cca8e7ed97af8cae", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 180, "text": "兩馬相交，無五合，被呂布一戟刺於馬下，挺戟直衝過來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "bcafdf1b8131818a27599ea06858983f32742e9a15e10718672bc42c447799aa"}

{"id": "p_6321af41bf299a21", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 181, "text": "布東西衝殺，如入無人之境。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "5ae09d5f3844f50464042d458c15b2b6af3879a80ad03e7856708815ab922c0e"}

{"id": "p_e4b12864078f9963", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 182, "text": "幸得喬瑁、袁遺兩軍皆至，來救王匡，呂布方退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "5f225e2522114aec24847e60809779000aa0091cb4986288c333b7f620fda2b0"}

{"id": "p_2c19025d3580be24", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 183, "text": "三路諸侯，各折了些人馬，退三十里下寨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "3c83152234357014df3a7a461703c02e2ebab49ed938d9fb4f474f163287bdd3"}

{"id": "p_39c5caa1512d465f", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 184, "text": "隨後五路軍馬都至，一處商議，言呂布英雄，無人可敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "75ef9064d7ec59ce31f60379dd71d6827f70c4415851a4d7ee358bd166aec8f3"}

{"id": "p_79472e053fded32f", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 185, "text": "正慮間，小校報來：「呂布搦戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "c92522ef74ce80713d25fee60274b584429bcbef8692abacfba92e70e9657797"}

{"id": "p_2b10bfe1e99fa736", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 186, "text": "」八路諸侯，一齊上馬，軍分八隊，布在高岡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "20285f72f33f5af6ebd45984780a01781563233fff92ffd5a49ea2b652a38afb"}

{"id": "p_11e7250a7410b39c", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 187, "text": "遙望呂布一簇軍馬，繡旗招颭，先來衝陣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "7778cc486a2694f0cc345cf2743566c36d9f58af020f1513fb7a1d5252258d51"}

{"id": "p_24b9c71eaab1218e", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 188, "text": "上黨太守張楊部將穆順，出馬挺鎗迎戰，被呂布手起一戟，刺於馬下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "ccbee08dcb8504114814226bb8ee620753ba16fc66878cc29c196b93c35ed9a0"}

{"id": "p_b64b69deb0ac9172", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 189, "text": "北海太守孔融部將武安國，使鐵鎚飛馬而出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "83cf302d062c880c02641df732caa948435affb0a974b17afa4e0256c7ed2425"}

{"id": "p_62def4307d478196", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 190, "text": "戰到十餘合，一戟砍斷安國手腕，棄鎚於地而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "c275ee5327cfb535fcdcb4d662f1d5be2516ffa2196fd4c9f752ad725a1127aa"}

{"id": "p_a35e63a35e524463", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 191, "text": "八路軍兵齊出，救了武安國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "cc6a64d74a6fa5a9fb5ffd25fc81f026c75d80a33a7b36721293bfa498aef1e9"}

{"id": "p_16c5cfeab7a00c64", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 192, "text": "曹操曰：「呂布英勇無敵，可會十八路諸侯，共議良策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "c7911ad6f0b408835ce5044df683fdee14bf21bd3e2b99ff0a2c8297359e8127"}

{"id": "p_0fe4ff8fc0c92aa8", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 193, "text": "若擒了呂布，董卓易誅耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "1db8bdc01bdad6d407d1719d7bda05623a1d4210f2fd59d4d1859f3f85f22b4c"}

{"id": "p_64582bff6cf21b93", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 194, "text": "正議間，呂布復引兵搦戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "ffe2116a749e8a16f10894d0a61204f2f9923dbc3c8cb3e61633b61169b62024"}

{"id": "p_d0f74c801a533f02", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 195, "text": "那馬日行千里，飛走如風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "2c63b0c848f7311e4d4e712992f717710c0a8598b4fefe328114125fe631b00e"}

{"id": "p_eadaa49b3d296542", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 196, "text": "看看趕上，布舉畫戟望瓚後心便刺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "cd36dcdb5c97d0f586051d19122d9e96f9e6f9de6fc0631dd0b50c74a188c642"}

{"id": "p_99db88002263f498", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 197, "text": "旁邊一將，圓睜環眼，倒豎虎鬚，挺丈八蛇矛，飛馬大叫：「三姓家奴休走！", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "5c088484337f2b0e23dc547bfe3ee3cf714b2b98c2feb16d18a7d5cfed2ccb0b"}

{"id": "p_12d3ee5e52f53a66", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 198, "text": "呂布見了，棄了公孫瓚，便戰張飛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "0f112d12f58f8fc7da7b66052151c231ac4ad3f14435e3b72d37b5baf192cdbb"}

{"id": "p_be82c23c4a218ed3", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 199, "text": "連鬥五十餘合，不分勝負。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "dd5581d09a5186e7dfb9b4e8bf2b0ed073b5cff6d265fa313f302d392cfaf803"}

{"id": "p_60c76714e551b38d", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 200, "text": "雲長見了，把馬一拍，舞八十二斤青龍偃月刀，來夾攻呂布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "a1b59d498ac857468568e584740e5c4ff073c9951029b09e306716c449f94a8a"}

{"id": "p_37c5e878ba41fb36", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 201, "text": "戰到三十合，戰不倒呂布。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "9fd1a4931c332f3eca1c6da6190c9359794a8afb6869db594e867e6d772d4159"}

{"id": "p_541a9d068e2fa264", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 202, "text": "劉玄德掣雙股劍，驟黃鬃馬，刺斜裏也來助戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "29bb815cbbdea0cad44c0e5eed15a54a821846102c9fae296f53910355df9db0"}

{"id": "p_60c9c81f52eed149", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 203, "text": "這三個圍住呂布，轉燈兒般廝殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "3adf0dd1517810a31f9ddd5cbd0b7c9027147383ca520667df4e9e6e5c34ab0b"}

{"id": "p_c1ea11c6c8983a24", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 204, "text": "呂布架隔遮攔不定，看著玄德面上，虛刺一戟，玄德急閃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "5bf6baa222d5ae7becc0c08acf5142ad0d1dbbfc2092a19cb174dc93cdb63db8"}

{"id": "p_56598b911516ebf4", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 205, "text": "呂布蕩開陣角，倒拖畫戟，飛馬便回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "b100c76c0d8cca509c7eb2d451cb848eab7d434bb59715a2f51a6b4424f517e9"}

{"id": "p_3a2abc4510da690d", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 206, "text": "三個那裏肯捨，拍馬趕來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "bb69940b0677b65199319ca8a552547675cebf46755a807fd780be45789def39"}

{"id": "p_b34ec08a6825b360", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 207, "text": "八路軍兵，喊聲大震，一齊掩殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "5d002d6421182f420c6a75b1b5e7b6bfb4da995ca1ed86d425179cc10d90a823"}

{"id": "p_0d1c6577189f3288", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 208, "text": "呂布軍馬，望關上奔走；玄德、關、張隨後趕來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "e01e834c7039f3b5728a07543f0c2a351a78a2565cb654016c127c63ce82b421"}

{"id": "p_68cdb7460ff3703a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 209, "text": "古人曾有篇言語，單道著玄德、關、張三戰呂布：", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "7642a8ca5e9bead16da04c1eaf3a5bd36c7e5da97f990ce89d10862c2582daac"}

{"id": "p_c8d64a845377f521", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 210, "text": "::漢朝天數當桓靈，炎炎紅日將西傾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "785d981c1f5e87e15c40c980770b150d2e0e1423a049ae94f6147242fb23dc0d"}

{"id": "p_3f3934f054fe6c80", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 211, "text": "::奸臣董卓廢少帝，劉協懦弱魂夢驚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "94e4d9f640b90902ed4c61c876de2d7074f1aaf004b3c61f0b6696902683a31b"}

{"id": "p_528306b331e2351d", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 212, "text": "::曹操傳檄告天下，諸侯奮怒皆興兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "174fa79307f792ec5c6cd203807250a4b906e63b43814fb830ded63e85606b17"}

{"id": "p_4e1d9068dc5cbc57", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 213, "text": "::議立袁紹作盟主，誓扶王室定太平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "f772afa8ce6b51a43a8f24b812e858690fd9b3276c1579bce1a958d4adf0b2c5"}

{"id": "p_fe99a8888b6e3930", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 214, "text": "::溫侯呂布世無比，雄才四海誇英偉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "1eb1a9132739d22d0e5e07af25548e82f14d64bb3d8bed59d590cf0bb1c7164d"}

{"id": "p_6959e4d8d6a34f85", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 215, "text": "::護軀銀鎧砌龍鱗，束髮金冠簪雉尾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "e649a15d6e9548fe7b9f7c4fcee31d0a20da524a44d7ab3f9d51b0c81cb1217f"}

{"id": "p_4bef0c6bd247a95f", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 216, "text": "::參差寶帶獸平吞，錯落錦袍飛鳳起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "1f221420eccc52680288a13c106ee0e896da12f19d9a889278aaecdc80dc7839"}

{"id": "p_33117f528f2ab62a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 217, "text": "::龍駒跳踏起天風，畫戟熒煌射秋水。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "9c4574372d38480f4a8e1677cd635ff59ca8f31edd61e2639b51af75025107e1"}

{"id": "p_56a148e5a882796d", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 218, "text": "::踴出燕人張翼德，手持蛇矛丈八鎗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "68bb222ae0803c9e426fc7f984522f34648f29026c6a5db8ee6b221f37c96e9c"}

{"id": "p_0de689335322988b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 219, "text": "::虎鬚倒豎翻金線，環眼圓睜起電光。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "ef22e369a61027355d485ff85260ef5ecbfd577216a908618e2c4db0251f4307"}

{"id": "p_82219a57a49e80f5", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 220, "text": "::酣戰未能分勝敗，陣前惱起關雲長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "3e7b64a9b0cd51d4feb9756080a61b57475b6f6bdef344342c0c8a066b72d21f"}

{"id": "p_d6e4134a8627713d", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 221, "text": "::青龍寶刀燦霜雪，鸚鵡戰袍飛蛺蝶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "d5fbc579122ef5c89a07547e6b60e856c3db7c4baf772cf267476b938a1865f7"}

{"id": "p_39a01ebe3bef8e40", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 222, "text": "::馬蹄到處鬼神嚎，目前一怒應流血。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "727f6987387fb5711407c20aa56db3552728ed8c3fd99b83a3718e9d0dd50d10"}

{"id": "p_1837169c45fd405b", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 223, "text": "::梟雄玄德掣雙鋒，抖擻天威施勇烈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "09fdbcad54a52aa1282dc810e8288628a4a21282c3ad1f0e43ff5fae71ac4b48"}

{"id": "p_b9760e7d39f870bf", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 224, "text": "::三人圍繞戰多時，遮攔架隔無休歇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "572228cd55bd023893c23ae81beeaf4b7ae504838a41b796f15577c6b33d5820"}

{"id": "p_47063436aa1ef4e4", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 225, "text": "::喊聲震動天地翻，殺氣迷漫牛斗寒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "980dacb71f1bc776c692bbcdead1b3a4d39183f2239d626bad984eafed63cbcb"}

{"id": "p_a491732a5ea24ef4", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 226, "text": "::呂布力窮尋走路，遙望山塞拍馬還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "2b281c52a586bf5ed978aa5a70201dd09c60b668c037dce22ed877511a54fdb4"}

{"id": "p_0b243d235db0d7c7", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 227, "text": "::倒拖畫桿方天戟，亂散銷金五彩旛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "25b3eb00d2330d1c87cc228b943daa6c5c510a488e0080d3f79e4bf97639c213"}

{"id": "p_647ab8fadda0aa69", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 228, "text": "::頓斷絨縧走赤兔，翻身飛上虎牢關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "e401e7ac75eee820d8bda926d021adc4bcc553fc3ed105bf91cbcad5f74bec0f"}

{"id": "p_2aa1b6fb3c2497fc", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 229, "text": "三人直趕呂布到關下，看見關上西風飄動青羅傘蓋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "e3d97f8cc949a921746b1cc848a5bf61fe9553192f2e58b3125d57780d331375"}

{"id": "p_b612add9a85cd635", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 230, "text": "不如先拿董賊，便是斬草除根！", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "3540d77fedf29972cb894d4246ec762b53e38357e7325c8f29ec5249753ced73"}

{"id": "p_3a807ccc384d95ba", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 231, "text": "::擒賊定須擒賊首，奇功端的待奇人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 231}, "text_hash": "7f802da09f7563541b650d534d123fa88efa12dc8cc513318c3d7fb2806f300c"}

{"id": "p_20b53f5dcfd907e6", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 232, "text": "未知勝負如何，且聽下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 232}, "text_hash": "6c49dc27ff749a7c1b50c239279a5134dda3c5b675b95d1abbdd94cce52784a4"}

{"id": "p_be9397ca5016717a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 233, "text": "en:Romance of the Three Kingdoms/Chapter 5", "locator": {"ordinal": 233}, "text_hash": "4eecdc8140f1e9d4264c0c25a0f1ed8f2129439d2706d4e085c86f20a659fca2"}

{"id": "p_6b350641274a812a", "source_id": "src_d1eb367ab10c107e", "ordinal": 234, "text": "vi:Tam quốc diễn nghĩa/Hồi 5", "locator": {"ordinal": 234}, "text_hash": "b3be585f18a34e30a3c29b44b995aa50f81c549b67c828109509a62f534ed871"}

{"id": "p_6d748997911c1d94", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說董承等問馬騰曰：「公卻用何人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "a670934c95b936e600abd2fd1b23f5d2a95f08c64dce02a17730bdcef1b4be45"}
