{"id": "p_6956b1ad6948bd82", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 1, "text": "」馬騰曰：「見有豫州牧劉玄德在此，何不求之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "bc515ec9738c3184a7d49ccaa1c0ebb1b91ff7ad7b594dda805d2c40ba64abb0"}

{"id": "p_be42aeaa98da945c", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 2, "text": "」承曰：「此人雖係皇叔，今正依附曹操，安肯行此事耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "a16cbea430e3f2a37eb07fc0fa869d7b37448dc4761b46b00fe6e36f16903049"}

{"id": "p_a3954b6e1ab99324", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 3, "text": "」騰曰：「吾觀前日圍場之中，曹操迎受眾賀之時，雲長在玄德背後，挺刀欲殺操，玄德以目視之而止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "2e4f8779d47dbcd5a2950ed2907cdf5247d59f448aaf28a3d95502ba1b2efcb9"}

{"id": "p_8bdb02ddddf889a4", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 4, "text": "玄德非不欲圖操，恨操爪牙多，恐力不及耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "3a9d8b74377a4212a27fc80e0902011603f5dea355679a2da072b5933cec8937"}

{"id": "p_d76319727566b4a0", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 5, "text": "」吳碩曰：「此事不宜太速，當從容商議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "2476a7456a40790fab916e327359f25815097fbc668d9b88a4c64f69b345b805"}

{"id": "p_0cf0caff5a24f580", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 6, "text": "次日黑夜裏，董承懷詔，逕往玄德館中來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "50e33c5b05ca31b6ac77549abee54e0043f567fa5ab39f2be798a079f6264aa4"}

{"id": "p_4bb6982d796170be", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 7, "text": "門吏入報，玄德迎出，請入小閣坐定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "e7bb839d812023bbec9741fb75d9e0aaeb04add268199645f17f756be7c2756b"}

{"id": "p_4f8602634323d320", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 8, "text": "玄德曰：「國舅夤夜至此，必有事故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "28af9551e8963761a7e676c5a6accebfc79c8b10389a9a997b4b25f7d0466798"}

{"id": "p_883003c0623fb88c", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」承曰：「白日乘馬相訪，恐操見疑，故黑夜相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "05b6e2e2caf0e56f9f6d6dc8092ceb47f390da57413bf7b265edf7677a67b2c4"}

{"id": "p_3cf1300b096cc6f1", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 10, "text": "承曰：「前日圍場之中，雲長欲殺曹操，將軍動目搖頭而退之，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "af29dd90ee48a1a9c555d103a64757a15af08b423f0638d91a876f8d6eaef5bc"}

{"id": "p_8b517e82cbf644d6", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」玄德失驚曰：「公何以知之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "2ff90b4b9d9dcb751a1ddb6974726b2c9079af64c21910c158a71fba8c66c865"}

{"id": "p_2f30d9f3165a66b7", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」承曰：「人皆不見，某獨見之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "ee186ac0c9e399391bdb85e18dc00c48124ed415c9efaaa81b6e43af3a62b1a3"}

{"id": "p_17769e7753dde5ee", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 13, "text": "玄德不能隱諱，遂曰：「舍弟見操僭越，故不覺發怒耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "ec372697fabd57648e63412ede49267bf8755cf28dbb6303ca4c7b2cd01e6486"}

{"id": "p_a9aa186c5f52c7de", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」承掩面而哭曰：「朝廷臣子，若盡如雲長，何憂不太平哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "c9aae10dc49f683028b1046e1abcef1cab61da8ef824a6ef08024a1da26e0667"}

{"id": "p_4e560232f3b4fc11", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」玄德恐是曹操使他來試探，乃佯言曰：「曹丞相治國，為何憂不太平？", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "6348484494b03e4bf42a7d36371db1b8b81a073d19a663b4094e693714d47ecc"}

{"id": "p_0f39b92b0eebed25", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 16, "text": "」承變色而起曰：「公乃漢朝皇叔，故剖肝瀝膽以相告，公何詐也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "27033b4a8ed9d740241908e1dfc946813aad2f5221bda80956043bc40931028e"}

{"id": "p_4f63322b302f5668", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 17, "text": "」玄德曰：「恐國舅有詐，故相試耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "d3876836cf2db745bbfe3a46826a2afbdf60607d0a1cd45538f62c60bffd9429"}

{"id": "p_32fac6ca948ea5e6", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 18, "text": "於是董承取衣帶詔令觀之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "57116547cd6a3b0dc494dcc06248ee08e8b1256f13f99238dfbcff024a035861"}

{"id": "p_6f5d6743d64416ed", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 19, "text": "又將義狀出示，上止有六位：一，車騎將軍董承；二，工部侍郎王子服；三，長水校尉种輯；四，議郎吳碩；五，昭信將軍吳子蘭；六，西涼太守馬騰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "43707df2492a2c637ad33696ea4245119e78e73760ddda24edae0aad74b5ada1"}

{"id": "p_fa0706a4b995ee3f", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 20, "text": "玄德曰：「公既奉詔討賊，備敢不效犬馬之勞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "2588726604ad66f9b7a387fa0c910b8c06c14b814c3ee41a3f4419dd3b4a4229"}

{"id": "p_3dd70229323d9f79", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 21, "text": "玄德亦書「左將軍劉備」，押了字，付承收訖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "01b056b355417595f1990cd8f3b05a9ab0cfbecee1ada745cfbd56773c660feb"}

{"id": "p_5cdeab64655df3d3", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 22, "text": "承曰：「尚容再請三人，共聚十義，以圖國賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "cee6cf298dbe930ae8a67cf1dd179e0c35f023df137f21b6d09d7a32e022cf29"}

{"id": "p_2d4bc02c91461f06", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」玄德曰：「切宜緩緩而行，不可輕洩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "77f0b75c43b2aad09723c7d456f3974a2bb386ad96598e16424b66e0c329d512"}

{"id": "p_61c7bc5f9daf44d2", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 24, "text": "玄德也防曹操謀害，就下處後園種菜，親自澆灌，以為韜晦之計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "1da5bf454baebcfd90ef60e8507e8d35e2bca08e9649992a720453ec68607778"}

{"id": "p_18cb8d1af9717473", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 25, "text": "關、張曰：「兄不留心天下大事，而學小人之事，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "eee95d72028579347706c68231bc484482745d1ada080a7e851015cc519e3243"}

{"id": "p_4ccc8fce4440ba09", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」玄德曰：「此非二弟所知之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "75b3c3c488ee1517b2b7fb7abbb1ad6b96a90dc8a70bf2a5f186ca80ada662b4"}

{"id": "p_1e28ed3e9fbe6494", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 27, "text": "一日，關、張不在，玄德正在後園澆菜，許褚、張遼引數十人入園中曰：「丞相有命，請使君便行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "320b445fcabebcd52e0fe2b75fcfa5422ffc0c390c883383e898ddd79c51c03f"}

{"id": "p_34711da611d30709", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」玄德驚問曰：「有甚緊事？", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "64d4ada35a132f05ae93ac1826e573324183c6c1470a127994aa5547bb3f185a"}

{"id": "p_697846dff1763438", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」玄德只得隨二人入府見操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "d70f375a5c6c439c19ba374e366e4e0f99d3603b7319637f51a03f7bda49bfc2"}

{"id": "p_cffc4e41b6e78992", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 30, "text": "操笑曰：「在家做得好大事！", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "99515d51559662011bbae97195c43f66152a344b30e105ef74216adc0114a9b5"}

{"id": "p_70cf3c445a177017", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 31, "text": "操執玄德手，直至後園曰：「玄德學圃不易。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "8846aa76f2a4e3e80fa73229f2d4880122dea16736239c94047f35b687b92482"}

{"id": "p_102d76e22b544f62", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」玄德方纔放心，答曰：「無事消遣耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "b7184533578c9bc2d5a1df1e6c977acf95cd3376ca8f436cea42cb26dc6e3c5e"}

{"id": "p_e1ce5eef960d0b3b", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」操曰：「適見枝頭梅子青青，忽感去年征張繡時，道上缺水，將士皆渴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "052bada7feb85100ad8953b0978d460dc0aa40bc3deb9096e6e4ddeb609c0b27"}

{"id": "p_dc72ebc2bb2eaf38", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 34, "text": "吾心生一計，以鞭虛指曰：『前面有梅林。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "45228e5391f92cb8f13bfa75b0aeb97499b5b92d060d1b077fe2da868fd98ff0"}

{"id": "p_c83243ad82180e28", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 35, "text": "』軍士聞之，口皆生唾，由是不渴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "ecdcb7c9b1aeaaf4e12d9e69c780da31df5fa989c99300a1e235d3cc6cef5bca"}

{"id": "p_2a948fe756aea437", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 36, "text": "又值煮酒正熟，故邀使君小亭一會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "dc3992595a60d9510dae4f0abb6f9bb4d79968cd17d838a6f1d284e0646f6f63"}

{"id": "p_451734c143796a65", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」玄德心神方定，隨至小亭，已設樽俎：盤置青梅，一樽煮酒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "9cecf3218eb300e788f3405c9eccd42964999b2f788c092e6b1ddf8443240d9c"}

{"id": "p_d3ad26a10e1a0a7e", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 38, "text": "酒至半酣，忽陰雲漠漠，驟雨將至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "733db173ad1333b1272278ce7e938832901c54d6b7a96bfec786049fd0bb7a22"}

{"id": "p_c56510ef61c61ea3", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 39, "text": "從人遙指天外龍挂，操與玄德憑欄觀之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "a93c4db5bfe3debead7d612c69a83c7e6a9e8bd94277823bb9f07406ce4695e0"}

{"id": "p_3642d57be23b3bd3", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 40, "text": "操日：「使君知龍之變化否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "04324b2d6bcef0e8a73447ef69deaf333b1af7cc203580de332232f796a73607"}

{"id": "p_29bd30bf03b17127", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 41, "text": "」操曰：「龍能大能小，能升能隱；大則興雲吐霧，小則隱介藏形；升則飛騰於宇宙之間，隱則潛伏於波濤之內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "c7bf8b692c3d35b4157872425a4d8d3aac8006692076cda85e2800d2ad9cebe0"}

{"id": "p_e7b622080fedd5b6", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 42, "text": "方今春深，龍乘時變化，猶人得志而縱橫四海。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "584715b8dec859a9986819de28c94619cc88bdf5b913532e9b3da2d3f886dc1d"}

{"id": "p_2377a5ac6c0cc57e", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 43, "text": "龍之為物，可比世之英雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "5f7b1883e362f3b818c04691211ccead0383a40c426d7de491ecedb230a2fff4"}

{"id": "p_4a3ad912b362703e", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 44, "text": "玄德久歷四方，必知當世英雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "cd2604bd1a6ad859ced675e2341229a61865e161bb5ae38d129e2928c395dedb"}

{"id": "p_1de36b1bfe474ea1", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 45, "text": "玄德曰：「備肉眼安識英雄？", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "d58f5d21900317624bcaf52045d9c38b77178ef24f1e84ce5ffb2973a16cab42"}

{"id": "p_34c17a0cdd579d9a", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 46, "text": "」玄德曰：「備叨恩庇，得仕於朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "af5e4fb1a78d39201dd185e58277cc1e60dca83c73c46027ecf67a7fc5c5bcef"}

{"id": "p_829ddc17347cd1b2", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 47, "text": "」操曰：「既不識其面，亦聞其名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "1535d91ba1505d889dced679b2902a30bf019a6071257d0987d995389829df48"}

{"id": "p_c08ff4bedba11301", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 48, "text": "」玄德曰：「淮南袁術，兵糧足備，可謂英雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "2df811fa2eba30627183e347df0ebd681bf8b0069685130c28af7dcf85468d66"}

{"id": "p_d9d0708d850ca837", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 49, "text": "」操笑曰：「塚中枯骨，吾早晚必擒之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "efeafa4de03a8a7974193e21a3dd7666d0e5144a64a60df585f5e27a90577bac"}

{"id": "p_979acdc275835ada", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」玄德曰：「河北袁紹，四世三公，門多故吏；今虎踞冀州之地，部下能事者極多，可謂英雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "cd9cfa036d69483f98b659ac61a8026e4c6b9bb98fff2c7dc68d3788a20ad443"}

{"id": "p_723411d995b8338b", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」操笑曰：「袁紹色厲膽薄，好謀無斷；幹大事而惜身，見小利而忘命，非英雄也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "e702d190abe7bb80b733fbdfd200ad2c4927406aaebeb5e0d3febc631f7d4fcf"}

{"id": "p_01dd4e16121c81ee", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 52, "text": "」玄德曰：「有一人名稱八駿，威鎮九州：劉景升可為英雄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "d7d62ed3b1cf1d054149cacadb6c477389b6053252bb12c33724ab762d6b253d"}

{"id": "p_48274fb189681a4a", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 53, "text": "」操曰：「劉表虛名無實，非英雄也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "182b033ebb437889c0fcef676f8c7b042bef5dc5240d1f15f42fc2a803e5ccb8"}

{"id": "p_8652c13cc378c164", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 54, "text": "」玄德曰：「有一人血氣方剛，江東領袖：孫伯符乃英雄也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "100cbc9b3a6dc0f4d32471c2c990da448925ace40409f2e4119a6f3f299b8833"}

{"id": "p_890b26f83b5b3e94", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」操曰：「孫策藉父之名，非英雄也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "6c98a337cfefadb5fda04f8222e602068de3b063f665721f0207416904ecdb8a"}

{"id": "p_73d70e2ee61911f9", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 56, "text": "」玄德曰：「益州劉季玉，可為英雄乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "9f5fd70f950fde1bc8831057b9f13703b3aff0d4e3e3ec5102461315b835b42d"}

{"id": "p_116aa0635b5745ee", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 57, "text": "」操曰：「劉璋雖係宗室，乃守戶之犬耳，何足為英雄！", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "0af09f249cdda585d535ea8b0440d9d98218fe39550ab7c1c77672a8cb772e0f"}

{"id": "p_35e38d4b44d45788", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」玄德曰：「如張繡、張魯、韓遂等輩皆何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "0ed7c193d5410b28c6f51e4a579442b4d39cef4bee0f0c9dbdbdc3379130e361"}

{"id": "p_7ab418506b818373", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 59, "text": "」操鼓掌大笑曰：「此等碌碌小人，何足挂齒！", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "a1ef4d9658c359490406b0911b5cf76ba884efaedddb916f45647b244a7e6161"}

{"id": "p_85e2373086280bae", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 60, "text": "」玄德曰：「舍此之外，備實不知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "2761514605e65bdbfea124e93dcc2d525d72168f250e57deda7f2563869f4714"}

{"id": "p_d47659867e6ec182", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」操曰：「夫英雄者，胸懷大志，腹有良謀；有包藏宇宙之機，吞吐天地之志者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "7dd6ab2d18f5596ed7d41c2e08ca8c7599e856a3f1295e93ef93c35ce4e81486"}

{"id": "p_bab5391d8c542678", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」操以手指玄德，後自指曰：「今天下英雄，惟使君與操耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "be5189c98f0c362c63e41c10534be8efff98fc5ee7b7acedd4e084283c3e9a23"}

{"id": "p_e1de7a5e229554e3", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 63, "text": "玄德聞言，吃了一驚，手中所執匙箸，不覺落於地下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "7eaa73f2a8cf9452047791ebbfb922a26e70805d251cf7ebfd0e04b411b2fa4a"}

{"id": "p_6070e1fd48065f0f", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 64, "text": "時正值天雨將至，雷聲大作。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "b4a45dc150d8bcfd59d28b12cd4ddc71351f4864010a5b42f2ec2e91e5363b9f"}

{"id": "p_b67dd6796470b44a", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 65, "text": "玄德乃從容俯首拾箸曰：「一震之威，乃至於此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "18c84104a7dcca90382d21238a441f97e2519148363a9ec0a501252e74c69e58"}

{"id": "p_a422206a1ef445b9", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 66, "text": "」操笑曰：「丈夫亦畏雷乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "c558a51dafa336c463ffc3f7700dfef72ab3e288dca809187ec4ab54fe76c1a5"}

{"id": "p_4aba3a2ad8ccac3c", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 67, "text": "」玄德曰：「聖人迅雷風烈必變，安得不畏？", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "948059c4104e10a852db3b9e14a722f6deaa9016d60ad43fb844827d3d00ede0"}

{"id": "p_e3613fe137c30397", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 68, "text": "」將聞言失箸緣故，輕輕掩飾過了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "3419139a06d1456804aeb9db02b6492d0db6f3a6b8ddc073e7921cd96b55429b"}

{"id": "p_1112abc0571cad69", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 69, "text": "::勉從虎穴暫趨身，說破英雄驚殺人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "f1f9d59879111b4bad346a10de894804e95209376bd1309b4cc88033ffb72f4f"}

{"id": "p_1590f1116a1ecdaa", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 70, "text": "::巧借聞雷來掩飾，隨機應變信如神。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "d852c458810276643e184b52d56bc5d5f84db69e0ca458f3943975517401e231"}

{"id": "p_77c467b33bcd6afe", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 71, "text": "天雨方住，見兩個人撞入後園，手提寶劍，突至亭前，左右攔擋不住。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "9324046cb9015a7b6c5dfff452b583ec54ed0aef57ec9c09929341210799f868"}

{"id": "p_92fc38bfdb9c8cfe", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 72, "text": "操視之，乃關、張二人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "3b579710c40f131759a47c454a23b247968e4f9fa473c6086fc3e6a1fa317cd8"}

{"id": "p_d08c29575836f3b9", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 73, "text": "原來二人從城外射箭方回，聽得玄德被許褚、張遼請將去了，慌忙來相府打聽；聞說在後園，只恐有失，故衝突而入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "d96e4da035f007938a5f955b895dc2355fd2e20f21c8fa18f55ec0c9bdcd4df5"}

{"id": "p_c93f0480f0a39761", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 74, "text": "雲長曰：「聽知丞相和兄飲酒，特來舞劍，以助一笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "2faeb9e4a059024840d53a5438ee750560e5d58ba62fbea0fb4f3c451a78a042"}

{"id": "p_c186f8f9072d8271", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」操笑曰：「此非鴻門會，安用項莊、項伯乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "ea31898c7a0c3b939d0d9604301a7ed1b72c012e90a4d5760304e808e2024a62"}

{"id": "p_b1620f891814e2dc", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 76, "text": "操命：「取酒與『二樊噲』壓驚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "904942f87ed080544eab293f0c0c378c5a729f86859eb8ba922f43d63a0748cb"}

{"id": "p_dd8e9ee3fbc313a3", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 77, "text": "須臾席散，玄德辭操而歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "b890d797413847c4442e66842a19bed7b574e5641141f892fa70c90ca9ae4b87"}

{"id": "p_d3d66bf2cb0a319e", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 78, "text": "雲長曰：「險些驚殺我兩個！", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "59dc2e72dee85ee0aed2aba3c985f547aeb8eace5d95e12d5db2fc80ff20c730"}

{"id": "p_8ae8cfeb0ec39d4e", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 79, "text": "」玄德以落箸事說與關、張。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "909b67d8abfd7fcab17de4e2c3befdd0ea5437e4881c9c787456e0d0448f7fc6"}

{"id": "p_9739245b8b340d0c", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 80, "text": "玄德曰：「吾之學圃，正欲使操知我無大志；不意操竟指我為英雄，我故失驚落箸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "aa2ab2a9665860c5a960052505e9cc57e379c1d959f92a7703661ed22675cfea"}

{"id": "p_a5094f4bc99111d9", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 81, "text": "又恐操生疑，故借懼雷以掩飾之耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "f60d95cdf5488a58532cb5d53b3d98921438cbbd9455f5cc1f5ccb733a11347a"}

{"id": "p_d2d7a1d471fabd9d", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 82, "text": "」關、張曰：「兄真高見！", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "8ab588d4c08a14f1753034ae97e70de7c23c77ee062841ae8c011e45848fcf87"}

{"id": "p_09d085bd81ec25d5", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 83, "text": "正飲間，人報滿寵去探聽袁紹而回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "76fd7e868ebe9ac45b62b456b29c821845ef71f3768fdfd4834954b9458ff974"}

{"id": "p_7ad4ad75a955db71", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 84, "text": "寵曰：「公孫瓚已被袁紹破了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "92944b80a252bb62a23a7d39eb19caced6d5cadd826c0c203d7ce97b0161d718"}

{"id": "p_b50f2b5dd1245ece", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 85, "text": "」玄德急問曰：「願聞其詳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "ba6b6fa4f07ba3eeaacf6ba384da7dc79881c31b35171d6f2b30a718db438598"}

{"id": "p_ca470eec4f4a6c12", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 86, "text": "寵曰：「瓚與紹戰不利，築城圍圈，圈上建樓高十丈，名曰易京樓；積粟三十萬以自守，戰士出入不息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "bdf73a670f5759564487becd0e6bb3ee080fb763c9a719dfeb90cd510795ff49"}

{"id": "p_203c78e1936698a5", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 87, "text": "或有被紹圍者，眾請救之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "6cb6551bdb37ecb53135ad1fc6f0b242c02bf9d07f0143bc4e3fb0e41765c8bd"}

{"id": "p_78666d15a893efb7", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 88, "text": "瓚曰：『若救一人，後之戰者只望人救，不肯死戰矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "c85526825a0abe9a6c038aef05aae77d7f71bfe8d6b999b7e6c66ea7bd2dcf7d"}

{"id": "p_ac9d3dd33f21757e", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 89, "text": "因此袁紹兵來，多有降之者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "a0444773c4a1df06388c9da0e6252c274826e48908de9283cb2166344801a00f"}

{"id": "p_a69292a0e59971be", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 90, "text": "瓚勢孤，使人持書赴許都求救，不意中途為紹軍所獲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "e24f740ef58192eaa06c7546f0e48d0806c9bbb9c0d3d46f9e75f85199d297da"}

{"id": "p_6964a364bdc66f17", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 91, "text": "瓚又遺書張燕，暗約舉火為號，裏應外合。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "7dcd9711e2aa5509f6f3a050fe565b752b5555e0b2eacd3ea3942c51658acaad"}

{"id": "p_284d09d6a9a3f475", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 92, "text": "下書人又被袁紹擒住，卻來城外放火誘敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "3ed7068dfbae6d4d862dc70bfa861e0ac55212359c3380ae7a0796ab24cb9a5a"}

{"id": "p_7186d45fd213fc4c", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 93, "text": "瓚自出戰，伏兵四起，軍馬折其大半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "7cdeb574759920a23521bdbecc334d20e23959399a8a04429313cea16637bb2c"}

{"id": "p_ace840b4f025ce92", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 94, "text": "退守城中，被袁紹穿地直入瓚所居之樓下，放起火來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "cdb03f8326a213ccb4abb9182bfd0eac1b4c69af0e53f1c044f7cfe7b944e867"}

{"id": "p_f92fdf23c1c1b656", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 95, "text": "瓚無路走，先殺妻子，然後自縊，全家都被火焚了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "6a4284ae8c85825cafa424bef6b518fbbd77bb7c3d355e506e48feb5184d67f7"}

{"id": "p_e94cad1968b6baf0", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 96, "text": "今袁紹得了瓚軍，聲勢甚盛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "3f16e5942ba0328af707a0d695b250ca0bb07b287ff035d76e583b7631312981"}

{"id": "p_302d7a9543f18959", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 97, "text": "紹弟袁術在淮南驕奢過度，不恤軍民，眾皆背反。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "45d83cd5e18eaebfa3b5eb00df1b72a6e7dffe6de49f0ca421357c11dbe9e464"}

{"id": "p_1ab4f6ce3be2bd75", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 98, "text": "紹欲取玉璽，術約親自送至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "2af85e75110bce99d538ddac21294e11d556b53bb004f35ba1a003fbd2cf4f67"}

{"id": "p_2d0ac656965f3cb0", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 99, "text": "玄德聞公孫瓚已死，追念昔日薦己之恩，不勝傷感；又不知趙子龍如何下落，放心不下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "bb503860e763a8afc1520a8960c88d537b60acaa64aa02b6dd4b9ff535bcbec5"}

{"id": "p_850939a02fea2c4a", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 100, "text": "因暗想曰：「我不就此時尋個脫身之計，更待何時？", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "01e1af249de25cb5439c7b3b1e0ee68d7e04c7d89604e2d0060edd0528a54c52"}

{"id": "p_75d196fa46e046dc", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 101, "text": "」遂起身對操曰：「術若投紹，必從徐州過。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "0a2c8ec84bab1a7d47275babeb1719acecf10bc7da46025ecea35dbb5783b8b0"}

{"id": "p_4f70f10271830fbc", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 102, "text": "備請一軍就半路截擊，術可擒矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "085b256ef23ab59d9ea84c5711781a7d66c7650ee1f9b855fbfac50fc3cbd05e"}

{"id": "p_7d5e68684dfa701d", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 103, "text": "」操笑曰：「來日奏帝，即便起兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "71571abf49f6fc05314a1cd053dff99df8ed97588daa54ae502db0c3a12f7217"}

{"id": "p_c91ce0f691e0513d", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 104, "text": "操令玄德總督五萬人馬，又差朱靈、路昭二人同行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "b40844b504dfd9637bce44a27ffbf8c64f82dc425c3b56fd12f600526cf8e98a"}

{"id": "p_bd30327edd9b1301", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 105, "text": "玄德到寓，星夜收拾軍器鞍馬，挂了將軍印，催促便行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "7dce1284604b11b63bbb70f965549baed951d2aacb395c38f28b68c95ef70e52"}

{"id": "p_644559b1d3b1b7b1", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 106, "text": "玄德曰：「國舅忍耐，某次行必有以報命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "4a47f22557f7a0c92a9ae7edfc841c0bf7448fd905834b5bf055020f82abaeba"}

{"id": "p_d2cf0db5b38bad8a", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 107, "text": "」承曰：「公宜留意，勿負帝心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "aedf80924cfd926a07dca2071fe6a4990851cc9a30db778cd310bae7b715cc4a"}

{"id": "p_c812bbc551fda40e", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 108, "text": "關，張在馬上問曰：「兄今番出征，何故如此慌速？", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "752484f310a5a68b97fbb9347fcf67fac27b3345bc25f3e2b1e5e25c875f400b"}

{"id": "p_8f9c9fb66207ebb6", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 109, "text": "」玄德曰：「吾乃籠中鳥，網中魚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "ffe7e32d50952e450955858d5fb1246cd34915f4433599f261ad6a36424a270c"}

{"id": "p_9181fd7b5ae36390", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 110, "text": "此一行如魚入大海，鳥上青霄，不受籠網之羈絆也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "44ea76d5841986e28ffee838b956b09894077ccccc576929b715a8df749fe8fb"}

{"id": "p_90f3c95963ddfb68", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 111, "text": "」因命關、張催朱靈、路昭軍馬速行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "9e4fcb64d2773ee3ddbd8d2c33319c41e982772841c6fde5f670948876a571be"}

{"id": "p_66f4a8721071b4c7", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 112, "text": "時郭嘉、程昱，考較錢糧方回，知曹操已遣玄德進兵徐州，慌入諫曰：「丞相何故令劉備督軍？", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "b90d6178d403eab0765ef4a02d366d9aee4b4bfb6a212d3e02b78c98db3b341a"}

{"id": "p_08336a975c1f83a8", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」程昱曰：「昔劉備為豫州牧時，某等請殺之，丞相不聽；今日又與之兵，此放龍入海，縱虎歸山也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "9b057a0afa4697cb6429a2e23d26dc95ac806bec11acab2d957fa86b23381a5f"}

{"id": "p_b524be0e60b79544", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 114, "text": "」郭嘉曰：「丞相縱不殺備，亦不當使之去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "37d74536d721775476b604d3da4cff363fc03b2d9b14666a361a37775f2f6853"}

{"id": "p_a3637fdbae82dc76", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 115, "text": "古人云：『一日縱敵，萬世之患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "f4a04aeb28326ac24d1887c943553f5b780459c628185f59241d303efd7ed76c"}

{"id": "p_7bd4b2d858b3bebf", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 116, "text": "」操然其言，遂令許褚將兵五百前往，務要追玄德轉來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "35f83f078fef28176dfecaf2e86c012d5c596b0b343084a4d3b2e8b98552e59d"}

{"id": "p_f9920784c3f5e21f", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 117, "text": "卻說玄德正行之間，只見後面塵頭驟起，謂關，張曰：「此必曹兵追至也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "54093d133a19450c5840a9c535c635884d6aba69fed706af4345449bc07088d3"}

{"id": "p_2e53842ae9d561b8", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 118, "text": "」遂下了營寨，令關、張各執軍器，立於兩邊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "914409a1308106700c8b9ec2c087cc4fbac6ceecc6401bdd9c3a88a96520521a"}

{"id": "p_8ed1855ea00abd04", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 119, "text": "許褚至，見嚴兵整甲，乃下馬入營見玄德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "948a38232b50bb2b820838b3d431ddcab6cb2baeaab14907eba7db4cd7b037c6"}

{"id": "p_a6ae31d16d14d031", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 120, "text": "」褚曰：「奉丞相命，特請將軍回去，別有商議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "9d386ccbd4e51675c20035c531b4bdb0781d1b124991beba8d9c4d62a2833775"}

{"id": "p_76f461a3266d3255", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 121, "text": "」玄德曰：「『將在外，君命有所不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "955a21655eafc3aba3f1723463a290f7280b242bdfa307fb72c7d4634488ab21"}

{"id": "p_30e44e6fd2549a27", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 122, "text": "』吾面過君，又蒙丞相鈞語，今別無他議，公可速回，為我稟覆丞相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "b04b5f47630167150ab1069a680b6132a03a52fc67e3a3150e35436dbe24070f"}

{"id": "p_924259698ac16bd5", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」許褚尋思：「丞相與他一向交好，今番又不曾教我來廝殺，只得將他言語回覆，另候裁奪便了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "81a61f4472a3b73facf1289ede084f1ee8de18a9fc551ce42ce5e54471f83327"}

{"id": "p_895dd17f2474f07d", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 124, "text": "」遂辭了玄德，領兵而回；回見曹操，備述玄德之言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "8667a32d45ed3df4404840ba6d9a49b27bbd1fa1b859a198046f752fef652289"}

{"id": "p_6f78f78449a5d230", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 125, "text": "程昱、郭嘉曰：「備不肯回兵，可知心變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "badb75ded1e585742dc92bdba7a29ac1adb7e88898ea236ce4c51ff1f6f5decd"}

{"id": "p_5178de0b6bd869d1", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 126, "text": "」操曰：「我有朱靈、路昭，二人在彼，料玄德未敢心變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "adb60bb367ee843d1ff82fedde562d929544776c14b516899a5819552f0326a4"}

{"id": "p_9518cc2f7275975e", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 127, "text": "::束兵秣馬去匆匆，心念天言衣帶中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "bb367c44c153dd75bd4414ec338f513ed40ab270d33b1ca59faa9af39a876f55"}

{"id": "p_7b286e09dd7657e8", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 128, "text": "::撞破鐵籠逃虎豹，頓開金鎖走蛟龍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "30420544962a5c48f0469af0c1106bde77295dd8c80c0ac173a0ccce80d73c87"}

{"id": "p_31c23c4158897c63", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 129, "text": "卻說馬騰見玄德已去，邊報又急，亦回西涼州去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "2e90c528bd6008bc766aaa4f73a3619358925c733e15ce133e5c54333634dd9b"}

{"id": "p_816baceb70f581a7", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 130, "text": "玄德兵至徐州，刺史車冑出迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "ff8a19e99caeb08edb1f745f2c4de7a0cb818e4af525794c57373c0ec74733aa"}

{"id": "p_b1e5b11b3b11d4f7", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 131, "text": "公宴畢，孫乾、糜竺等都來參見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "e6ccb0fa2c4e9aaa9a31f584e8abf0de11a907966f0a3b1263a63385ef8a47c8"}

{"id": "p_17d02e816086f602", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 132, "text": "玄德回家探視老小，一面差人探聽袁術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "ff073334213814c0f28e2f88ed6300a766866c5e37ed3d71ad7202452bd31910"}

{"id": "p_2fdbd4423145b707", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 133, "text": "探子回報：「袁術奢侈太過，雷薄、陳蘭，皆投嵩山去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "cbcb366e0112621e23e71f2185104fc71756560fc0050a1442045984c16de8cd"}

{"id": "p_99979ba63fa9312a", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 134, "text": "術聲勢甚衰，乃作書讓帝號於袁紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "a9491fb18f2099ae7982cee836728e1a737c8bca1fbccd2d21d31579495974e0"}

{"id": "p_eebb0dbce06130d5", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 135, "text": "紹命人召術，術乃收拾人馬、宮禁御用之物，先到徐州來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "ad28b4df80303fae019b3d51a76983a7f3fa9a58b6bc4b9e14c0e6f19feca65e"}

{"id": "p_7a56737fa7e830fc", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 136, "text": "玄德知袁術將至，乃引關、張、朱靈、路昭，五萬軍出，正迎著先鋒紀靈至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "e9dce1e27a5e3070b674816a35ca4efe4119ceba570b11b9de23bdb3483c77e4"}

{"id": "p_8cefd20c65f1e4d7", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 137, "text": "張飛更不打話，直取紀靈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "6b5f63a5acc1f0fff52075b3f88e3dd0254af0eac22a29d773cbf3d6fe0c20e0"}

{"id": "p_003128affe770d54", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 138, "text": "鬥無十合，張飛大喝一聲，刺紀靈於馬下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "f4507a0a96a2544b55fc4c3b2d63db594630e28b26c01ee324ab30d0f5275098"}

{"id": "p_da8d2d0971246bb6", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 139, "text": "敗軍奔走，袁術自引軍來鬥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "2c03c813a2982a1313bdc08ae3f8d7d9df316c62704a7d211872a4d8d8311e44"}

{"id": "p_1b30b6788d220ddb", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 140, "text": "玄德分兵三路，朱靈、路昭在左，關、張在右，玄德自引兵居中，與術相見，在門旗下責罵曰：「汝反逆不道，吾今奉明詔前來討汝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "8ae729c6088990ed9da370e1498d8e6d51060681b4ac6e88837e0a1171961b7c"}

{"id": "p_2840e6af08571917", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 141, "text": "汝當束手受降，免你罪犯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "7ca4bfb64f808adbcdc3cb3b3b72aa3b4e73b18f39c59dd3593c5685974d003d"}

{"id": "p_5a97365018afe358", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 142, "text": "」袁術罵曰：「織席編屨小輩，安敢輕我！", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "93c28730d5bde3756b3b6a6a3192bd39b50f99d26693d9d6f5911adbce354237"}

{"id": "p_46a46fff66bae703", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 143, "text": "玄德暫退，讓左右兩路軍殺出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "2d10e5147df7bdae8367668e6d1a193f46961e34f6f3ff1cad06a58e3c48f44a"}

{"id": "p_b198fd9877767cc0", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 144, "text": "殺得術軍屍橫遍野，血流成渠；兵卒逃亡，不可勝計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "3f326d7f32d19634643b4d1ae13c42da5efe0f177f4ccb6cf8869e640fa108a8"}

{"id": "p_e1e48a5b69eb7eee", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 145, "text": "又被嵩山雷薄、陳蘭，劫去錢糧草料。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "269114b6301d6c2f7dffece0016a0ea454ac3e0d6004c3ddb18318f6117755ae"}

{"id": "p_9753937b44fbf5a9", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 146, "text": "欲回壽春，又被群盜所襲，只得住於江亭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "41eecbd8e2c6631fbfa3ad7ef02cffbc2c630f1ea45766916a699cba2a9e01aa"}

{"id": "p_e6fc9b2ee7f722a7", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 147, "text": "止有一千餘眾，皆老弱之輩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "2e51910813f6b466079ac92c0dcffaff24ddc50eff14f6996a6cf186e5488112"}

{"id": "p_3736c9576d3a9142", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 148, "text": "時當盛暑，糧食盡絕，只剩麥三十斛，分派軍士，家人無食，多有餓死者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "b1acc0177e972ef4dda673f60fb5583a06730709bc1378518577e98c81f159ad"}

{"id": "p_a585ffb2f6620a4f", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 149, "text": "術嫌飯粗，不能下咽，乃命庖人取蜜水止渴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "c37a2b033afe32b37d080ea3492f6ce7173526d71d79047ec97d7c89d2a00060"}

{"id": "p_1e793b1b7a593193", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 150, "text": "庖人曰：「止有血水，安得蜜水？", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "917a8056847a3c0d2424c6bba35e1a5c26603a6dc07ece77f9dda8faa6629417"}

{"id": "p_cb020842760b5bcb", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」術坐於床上，大叫一聲，倒於地下，吐血斗餘而死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "5a5549a82bf5a3a100b7e32130eb7d253cdd032120a73afad10b7f40317b07c0"}

{"id": "p_78f1a58bcb2094a7", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 152, "text": "::漢末刀兵起四方，無端袁術太猖狂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "981a48173c9be4662f05c14c4b5ceb87a2c7672428ae5291e51477dc7a9c270f"}

{"id": "p_0b959c78e73459b2", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 153, "text": "::不思累世為公相，便欲孤身做帝王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "bbdefb2cd60af69d746bbc4c584f097031034955db706e770012392881f6b168"}

{"id": "p_552cf6a0055d3498", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 154, "text": "::強暴枉誇傳國璽，驕奢妄說應天祥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "b2123d253dbc78f3484f78dbde61c955521bc18991e9682ada69156fa4e8fc65"}

{"id": "p_af7bf0cfebae76b1", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 155, "text": "::渴思蜜水無由得，獨臥空床嘔血亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "a3ce2d07c956566e06d12aa27ea3b58df6c50f38826f622c568bdf7d366200d1"}

{"id": "p_994c694344dd392e", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 156, "text": "袁術已死，姪袁胤將靈柩及妻子奔廬江來，被徐璆盡殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "d4b8a3e26d0a2f348c67d21f67133fa82b30ee27362cdda9e85b5a4fd0dce8e9"}

{"id": "p_a503906d72a949ec", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 157, "text": "璆奪得玉璽，赴許都獻於曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "c258dbf6209b0592be2f40a0b02700e7f37c0e92c74359f5adb150099842762c"}

{"id": "p_7a8a9fa9a81dd127", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 158, "text": "曹操大喜，封徐璆為高陵太守，此時玉璽歸操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "139beb3729946787626f62085a582ba8d2711365c2421fd1e669776c10729998"}

{"id": "p_da50207bd4faed86", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 159, "text": "卻說玄德知袁術已喪，寫表申奏朝廷，書呈曹操，令朱靈、路昭回許都，留下軍馬保守徐州，一面親自出城，招諭流散人民復業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "f0ee43fa9b3042817665ff3ec32ea6188b9c5e31bf980ed155fc5e6e7094e470"}

{"id": "p_3692eb47b9b3a331", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 160, "text": "且說朱靈、路昭回許都見曹操，說玄德留下軍馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "d8c09862659d24038eeea6e765460d42d1b56fa5c81f6216929ccc5bc7363494"}

{"id": "p_e76659d13df61da1", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 162, "text": "彧又曰：「可寫書與車冑就內圖之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "f6c7085184e4e9d00b73e34b7cd0403b038dbb7370c6f6c6ae4ae65ed57f0c58"}

{"id": "p_f6fb33477349135c", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 163, "text": "操從其計，暗使人來見車冑，傳曹操鈞旨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "eeb9c7a6f4c3e0d0504d74424c7d00e519e6d1f35f713177f92df2ed38ee218e"}

{"id": "p_0aaeb94deb5aa182", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 164, "text": "今劉備出城招民，不日將還；將軍可命軍士伏於甕城邊，只作接他，待馬到來，一刀斬之；某在城上射住後軍，大事濟矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "b4a586f00738b29ded76bc1b61210b9b47ed9552a1b8ed6a309f0aa50c7db571"}

{"id": "p_343aabfdac37dbb7", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 165, "text": "陳登回見父陳珪，備言其事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "f316393ae9aa534954185dcb2fa91158ad03cf33b141f0a87a614df4188f1c86"}

{"id": "p_b230dfe095b9a2fd", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 166, "text": "登領父命，飛馬去報，正迎著關、張，報說如此如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "f72c76015449fe868a75617f676fadeda92cf43ae8333b1add961befda831006"}

{"id": "p_b743e05570e77f56", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 167, "text": "原來關、張先回，玄德在後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "cdd4433f3ee8040418dcdbe7d22531abdab198efdfad1cef54e3928179f737b0"}

{"id": "p_3cd920686cf64877", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 168, "text": "雲長曰：「他伏甕城邊待我，去必有失。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "358230e2107961513a81d78e9996aa2eb56b0cdc1347e5ca7126cbd2c7414ace"}

{"id": "p_ad4c1c52b143abc5", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 169, "text": "我有一計，可殺車冑：乘夜扮作曹軍到徐州，引車冑出迎，襲而殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "a99a5a3ad0e3fb12f59d0d9343b3aca253db1dfadbf26fb40002e01d3bfac050"}

{"id": "p_6534bc150aed1bd1", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 170, "text": "那部下軍原有曹操旗號，衣甲都同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "cb95dbf3ff7b567e29cb8b150ba7a69b770a376f41e89073511294c08cd0c6d8"}

{"id": "p_a545c22d5a083065", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 171, "text": "城上問是誰，眾應是曹丞相差張文遠的人馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "92f741455820de59e034f552e6290b5a15d1c1be8244505ce9edd932cee74f24"}

{"id": "p_57ea4c406ebfe79e", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 172, "text": "報知車冑，冑急請陳登議曰：「若不迎接，誠有疑；若出迎之，又恐有詐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "93585d3496354c1802c8baf422a38e85333c36ab052fd03a6756f0b8861097e0"}

{"id": "p_23291064da101773", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 173, "text": "」冑乃上城回言：「黑夜難以分辨，待明早相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "cdb25b7a8a4eeda585ba95fed01cd58ad6b0e32a574946822cc34b103a5c82fa"}

{"id": "p_5785893dceb8ef10", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 174, "text": "」城下答應：「只恐劉備知道，疾快開門！", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "f1859598eba1b092e4b1b9438c440a0a65302495cf50a41a41ec88368e1521f1"}

{"id": "p_eb68ce9ed78f68ed", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 175, "text": "車冑猶豫未定，城外一片聲叫開門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "4c62e3b48b8b24dae55035f83e4d75d106a804a6033a1299c2fb965994c046da"}

{"id": "p_06b1f397950b1d62", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 176, "text": "車冑只得披挂上馬，引一千軍出城；跑過弔橋，大叫：「文遠何在？", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "00a54ef5eb52d4cbb010b103cea3a6f9d723033fcc6e279807c7cc36326c83df"}

{"id": "p_901c0e8a5f6928a9", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 177, "text": "」火光中只見雲長提刀縱馬直迎車冑，大叫曰：「匹夫安敢懷詐，欲殺吾兄！", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "32ae5a23db5540133e9af33ddb593e5e5ad8119e9936558b47992c707acf5151"}

{"id": "p_0bafb83fcba1b2d2", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 178, "text": "」車冑大驚，戰未數合，遮攔不住，撥馬便回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "c26c13329b80cce322c90d7d9253e2cfe9a350d385720cb478c7ee8a6034f19a"}

{"id": "p_8927c1e58f001b0b", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 179, "text": "到吊橋邊，城上陳登亂箭射下，車冑繞城而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "e9ecd27994dbd6da34e0d3f6f30bc7c60c1fa474303c784a993a16e9abe860a8"}

{"id": "p_9cbbbd3cc9a987ab", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 180, "text": "雲長趕來，手起一刀，砍於馬下，割下首級，提回望城上呼曰：「反賊車冑，吾已殺之；眾等無罪，投降免死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "2ee8ac146277905049192ad542b33e3651117150dacfd6b475de810367a3247a"}

{"id": "p_e8fccc37d89a87e8", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 181, "text": "」諸軍倒戈投降，軍民皆安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "29c9143cc1788beb7c3498b8626a174dd39ec621b6da7374c5162aa639d53da8"}

{"id": "p_264b2e4d0c22c11f", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 182, "text": "雲長將冑頭去迎玄德，具言車冑欲害之事，今已斬首。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "fbe77da3f0ede0416b3cfe81135fc4c5ce4eb15f04bc0287a14be91438c6670c"}

{"id": "p_1067d646bbdb2941", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 183, "text": "玄德大驚曰：「曹操若來，如之奈何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "d508729fdd5f1d14ca16b695c644b478f0aded100914d68e3b574ca526d19d61"}

{"id": "p_a53aedfbf6247b9d", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 184, "text": "」雲長曰：「弟與張飛迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "12e78543e8c0a4a8b1834c30a13f3dec7cc82287315258a21547f5f0afe02de5"}

{"id": "p_3bf73330f971c90b", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 186, "text": "玄德到府，尋張飛，飛已將車冑全家殺盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "d2c8df19c3c1d98ca90948c0e5ebeae0b9c6958d2907ac1679d2d4bee8fa1432"}

{"id": "p_6e753cef52053ede", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 187, "text": "玄德曰：「殺了曹操心腹之人，如何肯休？", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "6af45e31361c5318213471d66a06d34b57a28185f3c52ad9b54a9254558cc581"}

{"id": "p_7604e83235df3ed7", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 188, "text": "」陳登曰：「某有一計，可退曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "59948c794c4a46695cbb318e2a7029d805b41e9eb021f45f7752662501ef1659"}

{"id": "p_abc3c63335399fd4", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 189, "text": "::既把孤身離虎穴，還將妙計息狼煙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "fd66ea7cf2e21b036509b82acb438024eeb705cb045c2023f2494ce98004f434"}

{"id": "p_6d6e7113a49a93b6", "source_id": "src_2d953fa773812e18", "ordinal": 190, "text": "不知陳登說出甚計來，且看下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "38864af346c9444d6620810ce388fb981968c7b95d450a3220079f587a819f2d"}

{"id": "p_28124ca992175645", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說程昱獻計曰：「雲長有萬人之敵，非智謀不能取之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "05ba81c1b1a8693529fe68c6530789fa17621ed12f9a64fa7d61366f4de407fd"}

{"id": "p_041b04988a4dc070", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 1, "text": "今可即差劉備手下投降之兵，入下邳，見關公，只說是逃回的，伏於城中為內應；卻引關公出戰，詐敗佯輸，誘入他處，以精兵截其歸路，然後說之可也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "a36bacbea172399f092dc058c5ab8cdba028beb274eb9066cc0d087a55603927"}

{"id": "p_4f6e3b3c47982a83", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 2, "text": "」操聽其謀，即令徐州降兵數十，逕投下邳來降關公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "525b1e240c66531f74d15507314df622008d486d295c862fd67bf27fc7562d85"}

{"id": "p_58cc19a2554c76c4", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 3, "text": "關公以為舊兵，留而不疑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "7e1d61aeda834d5c6a79f481665f51d6d2ca6c4afc94cce664b477678d29aa79"}

{"id": "p_aba08f689a0e0a44", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 4, "text": "次日，夏侯惇為先鋒，領兵五千來搦戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "f057311f0ffade507e2df4aef1e8840fb08fd33c11f58362e9c58307a09a1269"}

{"id": "p_6b7259b97e3a5506", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 5, "text": "關公不出，惇即使人於城下辱罵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "5938b20566c74b3c0903012526159013c12307149baba0b2d36e1882bc314aa6"}

{"id": "p_ed9729835f5eecdb", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 6, "text": "關公大怒，引三千人馬出城，與夏侯惇交戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "d55ed5b600a0772435e80a7f81b1bcd7eb13f6090573c3aac8dc4c3e413cd883"}

{"id": "p_4776b88e8ccfd8b3", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 7, "text": "約戰十餘合，惇撥回馬走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "e0ee3dba2462464349ca90b7512c777b92e5d9c2b8718b2eb923ff4c656dbd48"}

{"id": "p_8a4026f23e2d00c6", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 8, "text": "關公約趕二十里，恐下邳有失，提兵便回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "3aeeed86a1c85d4c221d060aef29811daf3b206613b533fa79634672c54d3011"}

{"id": "p_201b6d2c166d4bb4", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 9, "text": "只聽得一聲砲響，左有徐晃，右有許褚，兩隊軍截住去路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "c70b4cc542238265f5d72cfec055fd09fdb6d116a152cc9aed1b4c3645051279"}

{"id": "p_4028cbe0d28a2834", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 10, "text": "關公奪路而走，兩邊伏兵排下硬弩百張，箭如飛蝗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "62cd9b2e66d684d2df55f2d73c0206ba07549d9fca132dd555202f1a5e19bf5b"}

{"id": "p_46374b34cce96747", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 11, "text": "關公不過，勒兵再回，徐晃、許褚接住交戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "c2d0511ae367df0ecea2584b93698433dad8c87bbfd0e6a22707346e596f7937"}

{"id": "p_ab54590326f5985a", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 12, "text": "關公奮力殺退二人，引軍欲回下邳，夏侯惇又截住廝殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "3bebae61762b0b1342d03be5071c170ec687caba33c742f7edf72ff07393f208"}

{"id": "p_ca122f23d3fba626", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 13, "text": "公戰至日晚，無路可歸，只得到一座土山，引兵屯於山頭，權且少歇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "fef648b424f5c1b5b4b61a8099a202d97cbc8efbe50bccdc139f80580011531c"}

{"id": "p_06af1ce4119d0f2d", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 14, "text": "關公於山上遙望下邳城中火光沖天，卻是那詐降兵卒偷開城門，曹操自提大軍殺入城中，只教舉火以惑關公之心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "840f98460a44ef0b5fe0243d8abad0d58bb9608c9a83aedadc485d088df13e9e"}

{"id": "p_76a573dde7c705b8", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 15, "text": "關公見下邳火起，心中驚惶，連夜幾番衝下山來，皆被亂箭射回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "ef0f231186091aef9a5e01d80641aaa3df1ed6e9cb2ec64ec4d74b06735c58b6"}

{"id": "p_7defad8acc48e575", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 16, "text": "捱到天曉，再欲整頓下山衝突，忽見一人跑馬上山來，視之乃張遼也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "b29ef0fbf0afad30c6994609e7fe95bc8e7f7c3127f57e2c4ae7859640bff295"}

{"id": "p_b1e4100e41e2b03e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 17, "text": "關公迎謂曰：「文遠欲來相敵耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "e459816dffbf04fa3202aeeca775fbffe51de1b2bc4ec83e2c5a889750fa580a"}

{"id": "p_8df42a20de5ba7f8", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 18, "text": "想故人舊日之情，特來相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "5f5099facd9b150978892d9a1bde0a429c4a24718a1c5c4861eddbcc19b89cf4"}

{"id": "p_753385932a1be511", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」遂棄刀下馬，與關公敘禮畢，坐於山頂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "f003778131f5822f6a67f57a17b37044085f10d9ae085e8ca22fb29e64bd5454"}

{"id": "p_961844c1a5e70b26", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 20, "text": "公曰：「文遠莫非說關某乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "24101d585e949c3e105264bc3928e0d35fdc8d8e79048da0ae7a593141fb281b"}

{"id": "p_ca8f6aa87e58c67d", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 21, "text": "昔日蒙兄救弟，今日弟安得不救兄？", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "148a61ef370ad75305ce106da4354f2e9ef64d87e848c138959f395bdfcc3e64"}

{"id": "p_7cfe28848556c78c", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 22, "text": "」公曰：「然則文遠將欲助我乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "12b5c7671abed4b47af6cb01cf076ec2b25efd7ac9e685381bdb34d1072cc4f7"}

{"id": "p_b87b377b0ab78bd6", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」公曰：「既不助我，來此何干？", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "5bacd299c727ad3810e28b3a85dc28a2cdd66b058898a298e396f6d2564d9c72"}

{"id": "p_fed0323ae71ac97a", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 24, "text": "遼曰：「玄德不知存亡，翼德未知生死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "060febc5437958003d3bf7fb14a02f45cb5063755584907dfd6f23499361144b"}

{"id": "p_972aee3b2ee52910", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 25, "text": "昨夜曹公已破下邳，軍民盡無傷害，差人護衛玄德家眷，不許驚擾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "adead18e4ee25a3f97b05e890d77957b359c477d1b114bca06716798598bdbc3"}

{"id": "p_1587bc711c3abb7b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」關公怒曰：「此言特說我也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "03c6057793305fdb4192ab040537e1e2894e8b5ec9ff2c80aaa05b16d44cbf84"}

{"id": "p_c90827e9bf58bea6", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 27, "text": "吾今雖處絕地，視死如歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "a96be3f7e9499dbeeb244ee95614c2e1026a1cbd1fa54f02315de011045c717e"}

{"id": "p_2d555a4c3b886f14", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 28, "text": "汝當速去，吾即下山迎戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "1e024085796d8ce9045755cd6754865b8f32a056fe1c1ae6fa4c77086bd8fcfa"}

{"id": "p_15280a7b046db294", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」張遼大笑曰：「兄此言豈不為天下笑乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "6ac8174bc1216abde2bbbea76352a61294743623aa91994c0558f7d1fdd83e78"}

{"id": "p_58832366e918f5f0", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 30, "text": "」公曰：「吾仗忠義而死，安得為天下笑？", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "4b42e41e6efb83f1e7996e4e61906f5f3930df33446901b0ff2a5b341ee5d602"}

{"id": "p_68cea298f5206555", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」遼曰：「兄今即死，其罪有三。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "966e055ada3040c49ba429a8b83885726798ff6ea4356dd08b6b3821fb969109"}

{"id": "p_b12d8d1ab511058c", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」公曰：「汝且說我那三罪？", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "61ff35ba143e08346ac65e52de8fd715d23b6e8ffde01afa1ef57aee66723ed8"}

{"id": "p_e7da401c131fa178", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 33, "text": "遼曰：「當初劉使君與兄結義之時，誓同生死；今使君方敗，而兄即戰死，倘使君復出，欲求兄相助，而不可復得，豈不負當年之盟誓乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "c0d651d33735d2bb09a8b1591f1a7787c2a3bb72ca4b339bd50ef834c9a0cec8"}

{"id": "p_daae262f4420a32e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 34, "text": "劉使君以家眷付託於兄，兄今戰死，二夫人無所倚賴，負卻使君依託之重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "114bcd10a59416bd86bbc0c96a8dd3a919b5092770b40977d8242d83ca68776e"}

{"id": "p_d9cccb13de79995c", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 35, "text": "兄武藝超群，兼通經史，不思共使君匡扶漢室，徒欲赴湯蹈火，以成匹夫之勇，安得為義？", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "7a81999f8d2370432f7fc8d930372ddddba9105693586a0aac60f4d5037f2fcc"}

{"id": "p_de2350f8d3f5b1ef", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 36, "text": "兄有此三罪，弟不得不告。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "77e10f52c1b8b9b9a6ccdab8c889fdc0f8a4f8508e5a35ca6f9ece473c36d805"}

{"id": "p_2892f4b9b1ade4b6", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 37, "text": "公沈吟曰：「汝說我有三罪，欲我如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "3b5f913c153e1491dc42a601437dd766c2f21f711532b2cd54c0996f09337b7f"}

{"id": "p_d28ecd927afe8f9c", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」遼曰：「今四面皆曹公之兵，兄若不降，則必死；徒死無益，不若且降曹公，卻打聽劉使君音信，知何處，即往投之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "2df700100cdd9c2233d5218bdf03be69c0780e4989bd39ca543639c6028f383e"}

{"id": "p_135b769e0b9d1c75", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 39, "text": "一者可以保二夫人，二者不背桃園之約，三者可留有用之身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "baaf2c33dae77ca501dadea38016e015c5d8ff4e190ced2333bfa520608497d0"}

{"id": "p_8cca2a18b1fc4078", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 40, "text": "公曰：「兄言三便，吾有三約。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "1ed754eb4dfaace1fa55b2a7188129506eac095c710bb9e401ddd133c3839329"}

{"id": "p_f16a7d4a8490f0a5", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 41, "text": "若丞相能從我，即當卸甲；如其不允，吾寧受三罪而死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "f74bd2e3bbbf287872fd69696a67207b00d7d950e6c4e6a5868bb3efa15ed8a0"}

{"id": "p_be1685255ef6da1a", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 42, "text": "」遼曰：「丞相寬洪大量，何所不容？", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "5456b91870ada8f6f1ccaf1b3d56872a1242e716a3f3082a4c7b9a2cc8251ca5"}

{"id": "p_0d77eca95cd70807", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 43, "text": "」公曰：「一者，吾與皇叔設誓，共扶漢室，吾今只降漢帝，不降曹操；二者，二嫂處請給皇叔俸祿贍，一應上下人等，皆不許到門；三者，但知劉皇叔去向，不管千里萬里，便當辭去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "a352fe38e6af53662379e701e3b463036f9a6c60c69f31833609b134f95e42b8"}

{"id": "p_cb61597e651d5c97", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 44, "text": "張遼應諾，遂上馬，回見曹操，先說降漢不降曹之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "c9efe2004c1310bd5eefae08b8f155fc143f46f827b57c352d9ebbbb8316fefe"}

{"id": "p_d122a764e0af4142", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 45, "text": "操笑曰；「吾為漢相，漢即吾也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "45fbb74a51190591ee0c7a075ea9b41b3db07067ff12267089b284ae4bcc5129"}

{"id": "p_c0c778a3a28d3fe5", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 46, "text": "」遼又言：「二夫人欲請皇叔俸給，並上下人等不許到門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "83fcd785459aaf145357e86268d2a6ff82179263e5c92b829c3e115c141f07d3"}

{"id": "p_fbc6c2a268a5bbda", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 47, "text": "」操曰：「吾於皇叔俸內，更加倍與之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "61f7db6c53d977c11d72cad930feda7efda9e9ee06a756efa2ef47e2c48b69af"}

{"id": "p_413dc611ea30f3ca", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 48, "text": "至於嚴禁內外，乃是家法，又何疑焉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "517d9f02cc3c3699a8ced66c752da5a9b549000ba47e2b33f92ec33c0be94d78"}

{"id": "p_e66962d29c58285b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 49, "text": "」遼又曰：「但知玄德信息，雖遠必往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "0e558c65a67df1914dc9e08a34ba22e3228d12cb3a2d9c8d90d1a6009c0b26a7"}

{"id": "p_97a8d30a6ba85936", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」操搖首曰：「然則吾養雲長何用？", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "0faac29590d2586db8470cdd676cf0be3b1b5b6be19b30d802f86460bb872c24"}

{"id": "p_fdfc74281e45ab1d", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」遼曰：「豈不聞豫讓眾人國士之論乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "e1775335554c4b84c94b5abc12b8e189f34879e478643b566d590ef1afa0a9b3"}

{"id": "p_3968f67d862e6a1f", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 52, "text": "劉玄德待雲長不過恩厚耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "d4d6a37c641fef9d365e963cc9f453d5d8301d334632e54ad97433323b2125c6"}

{"id": "p_17f416316a2e3daf", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 53, "text": "丞相更施厚恩以結其心，何憂雲長之不服也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "2361c13855cf6da693823254649602753b88b55a9d637d1dbc419c7058b95116"}

{"id": "p_65b92d0d9d2ac1ad", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 54, "text": "」操曰：「文遠之言甚當，吾願從此三事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "3dce5c9e7f5379d8e0401c5d6645d01d9dbd0867b5b64aa0ebf069058d1b4538"}

{"id": "p_fdb4cc8128fe0087", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 55, "text": "關公曰：「雖然如此，暫請丞相退軍，容我入城見二嫂，告知其事，然後投降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "40ae81210fe776a16745b100ff851e50cc26a3adf14ca320a7ca2819e3c2f395"}

{"id": "p_41fb4c431cf6f1c0", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 56, "text": "」張遼再回，以此言報曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "7f5ff6b52122b2ae803a7a85878f5fda4f1b8e1db245ce31f108e1c19e7efb06"}

{"id": "p_90222f063d8d4862", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 57, "text": "」操曰：「雲長義士，必不失信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "3b909d35650d632e32cfe646dc94c055bb033b5aee43d522a4e829a7015c6793"}

{"id": "p_63e9a75d2cee9718", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 58, "text": "關公引兵入下邳，見人民安妥不動，竟到府中，來見二嫂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "90f506af9e7a16e779cc31f4a4a8244e9f12bfd8d1dce26622d2a77e11c966f1"}

{"id": "p_0d40816c6f838c16", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 59, "text": "甘、糜二夫人聽得關公到來，急出迎之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "135d2191e1c7aa759c082d36fb052ca42057ef2316757f5fed8ef89eb8560397"}

{"id": "p_093efab092e97c39", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 60, "text": "公拜於階下曰：「使二嫂受驚，某之罪也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "9a87d966f679f4b029f54acbd62f685611bbcb38e30893a90fc3d28bf807b656"}

{"id": "p_915e0ca02d14efa7", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」二夫人曰：「皇叔今在何處？", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "bf8c3cd9ef287eef3893524ee21b85c0e6ac7d1692f69a94b2ecee877246c28d"}

{"id": "p_d316011176fec979", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」二夫人曰：「二叔今將若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "ed4f44e4231551ca76fe9d6b9ac2df2382504c2f17e1b65e5fbd48f6477870ee"}

{"id": "p_4db70104ccf7e1e2", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」公曰：「關某出城死戰，被困土山，張遼勸我投降，我以三事相約。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "9c7c3ef62941db6761c3096847b8b611dd55997e1439f8510161aedbc2e90411"}

{"id": "p_0a649a200624990c", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 64, "text": "曹操已皆允從，故特退兵，放我入城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "09ab6b5b93bf814131f12875a37556c6975c57bfea5dae1c9ede4d2db3d51e66"}

{"id": "p_c2fff465a935b8cd", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 65, "text": "我不曾得嫂嫂主意，未敢擅便。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "e7878fc521a4818fac655a5b21d789990b84efa72c662fa064598eb838ce703f"}

{"id": "p_d913fef7bbc6d2c5", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 66, "text": "關公將上項三事，備述一遍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "bd4c4668bb36971a4cfb2a71b90e4f5c37352b1c776a46efe72933b75d5178de"}

{"id": "p_b1011edc0ba6c64e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 67, "text": "甘夫人曰：「昨日曹軍入城，我等皆以為必死；誰想毫髮不動，一軍不敢入門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "5db6cd2fd9a0ceb0ec4562a1a4d56f329d929d1b50cc9e03a35d6a20dd792553"}

{"id": "p_23408a6805d93096", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 68, "text": "叔叔既已領諾，何必問我二人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "bf6add2325a4a35592120ec27ca9b8698ddd8fcad997a43e0bf85d16a603ac5e"}

{"id": "p_92f3660954f0659e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 69, "text": "只恐日後曹操不肯容叔叔去尋皇叔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "955d00217f566b520afef712aa71d977317c9175ca710a2268ff96822021845d"}

{"id": "p_4cecdf099e72abf1", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 70, "text": "」公曰：「嫂嫂放心，關某自有主張。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "16f23ecad3835dc796072280cdd5525cd86ca3323752a46e4ab4df3b52ccd6fb"}

{"id": "p_e5c12285de14aac8", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」二夫人曰：「叔叔自家裁處，凡事不必問俺女流。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "8c471afa1759a9e6fc5e2e94ef839ba73e0312fcdb72d66806ec0ffee343a3d0"}

{"id": "p_693ea0374173a2a9", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 72, "text": "關公辭退，遂引數十騎來見曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "856bcef6b065ff7daefe5293e72d166218f2a9751bf9e22713e360c03b62b0e0"}

{"id": "p_374af912182932ae", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 73, "text": "關公下馬入拜，操慌忙答禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "b880762b18750af3a92ba33f73705f6d5ee43d9cd8d1f897fc64b566411ee936"}

{"id": "p_dedd69fee3302011", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 74, "text": "關公曰：「敗兵之將，深荷不殺之恩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "3b975ab3f064a2707d068d43f06f8491f3e220463ba7eb2a7d1a82553f61bf68"}

{"id": "p_ade52f40ad1e381f", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」操曰：「素慕雲長忠義，今日幸得相見，足慰平生之望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "7f073509f2c6c1a9f0ca8eb724a3c391d1d5dd452f3be17acc8d4aa6c7a56584"}

{"id": "p_dc41ded0be6086db", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 76, "text": "」關公曰：「文遠代稟三事，蒙丞相應允，諒不食言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "e7da0cfd3364b3cef0fe9c8159d4f122d2dbe48b906c8d483edd3da21a178158"}

{"id": "p_be548907f3498b41", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」操曰：「吾言既出，安敢失信？", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "799f247d58ff35c85c3713b97088d079426a7ed28ae2100e950128f8b5d8060e"}

{"id": "p_b137a2076eb445bb", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 78, "text": "」關公曰：「關某若知皇叔所在，雖蹈水火，必往從之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "632a805e8c23f0f5a6c80ceaf7a48e8801220728f52fcf295ae5ed01486fafbe"}

{"id": "p_ee0618137af19a30", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 79, "text": "此時恐不及拜辭，伏乞見原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "5ac49994c7c68fcaef0529f6b761b073f50cb8da4ca89474b835356e76171835"}

{"id": "p_46db422287325e57", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 80, "text": "」操曰：「玄德若在，必從公去；但恐亂軍中亡矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "bf009fd1fe341df0f8a885da3caae1e882c202132d8209bf9fa74a5fc4326be9"}

{"id": "p_1cdba91013ab4b99", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 81, "text": "關公收拾車仗，請二嫂上車，親自護車而行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "f89ab5f3d69d898d2f114751e1c4a77d98235dd1ae46d1a967423fb986be03f2"}

{"id": "p_ffaf93b5b8738118", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 82, "text": "於路安歇驛館，操欲亂其君臣之禮，使關公與二嫂共處一室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "8aa3861dfc1366c848b8cca78fc101510135ef7eb9cd45b5b5f5ea16f652c975"}

{"id": "p_04dada400da26eed", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 83, "text": "關公乃秉燭立於戶外，自夜達旦，毫無倦色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "e5ff57596f024d61eeb73a212189aaab598222aaf7c0f09bc4143991e9a310df"}

{"id": "p_9e1ebb33dff5e514", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 84, "text": "既到許昌，操撥一府與關公居住。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "98da8213161b51df8201bc02ceb1ad5c4e491a1f8424288c9d1b38f3dfca6bda"}

{"id": "p_b736741ef0ee2544", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 85, "text": "關公分一宅為兩院，內門撥老軍十人把守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "1d428cc7bcc95a109dd92ad1ac26427a2b2380e39b051e57bad7cbcc35a32a2b"}

{"id": "p_54d10c07deff95fb", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 86, "text": "操引關公朝見獻帝，帝命為偏將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "ca8547a8be4e78bc263cbe83b001c958b916846cdb00201b77cac8a19c8c9dd1"}

{"id": "p_4abcdba0c201941e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 87, "text": "操次日設大宴，會眾謀臣武士，以客禮待關公，延之上座；又備綾錦及金銀器皿相送。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "4a211d3a4151f0be7ab0fe2c88571996930c5bcd71795c08767e2010280f4c5d"}

{"id": "p_da966284c51ac1ad", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 88, "text": "關公自到許昌，操待之甚厚：小宴三日，大宴五日；又送美女十人，使侍關公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "bf9455f17fdfc78a713091ce58af87cc56fb6c59ca55a7709e19bf7c4062a916"}

{"id": "p_7a9f5ee9e210d83f", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 89, "text": "關公盡送入內門，令伏侍二嫂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "893f4f25e86bf83f8e345bf5e3dbafdbb0fb34dfc68a7b650fc3ebb29f2c02bc"}

{"id": "p_e22b9127fa458da8", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 90, "text": "卻又三日一次於內門外躬身施禮，動問二嫂安否。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "86e6476df22b76672bda08afae8ad52e9b31ee96e36c45389349e504f582a36e"}

{"id": "p_a1c82e3277efb672", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 91, "text": "二夫人回問皇叔之事畢，曰：「叔叔自便。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "8ee6c5b750a4a1cd65672460952d1736ddffee5e48964c0b3bae13f8f69e5698"}

{"id": "p_9671dd1f8e8eee33", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 92, "text": "操聞之，又歎服關公不已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "8752ac4989cf722bbc2eeb099729fcdc9a3adc4f49e9466d05b441723f072f54"}

{"id": "p_be8e2b71f65b114b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 93, "text": "一日，操見關公所穿綠錦戰袍已舊，即度其身品，取異錦作戰袍一領相贈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "ea3ba85cac07101f9465a48372954716acd3a24f3427d9af990bed1df8a4b30d"}

{"id": "p_f9dc7914f31b62c4", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 94, "text": "關公受之，穿於衣底，上仍用舊袍罩之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "17c612d8368c37aa16734693a91d2a7913dd5c66a27632ff035009be83ff660d"}

{"id": "p_723174b3f8fc2f3e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 95, "text": "操笑曰：「雲長何如此之儉乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "e1b3ef4e84e1b43631b485530b668928f817421eb5e3a53f01a1c3f4fb7b618f"}

{"id": "p_621e0a808d3ca09c", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 96, "text": "舊袍乃劉皇叔所賜，某穿之如見兄面，不敢以丞相之新賜而忘兄長之舊賜，故穿於上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "cef86b6edb5d869602cbe33709ab66f7376f1ac82870ae40e205361a2a737000"}

{"id": "p_7431e7ee3e6cc12f", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」然口雖稱羨，心實不悅。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "639129e3bd1cf9b857da13675216ac77c759911d99c120fed110feb90fc0aa50"}

{"id": "p_73cade352e7c066b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 98, "text": "一日，關公在府，忽報：「內院二夫人哭倒於地，不知為何，請將軍速入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "4dd822acca710044de2241ec58a492a1370d1d7e5239958f8bf6165a468f7460"}

{"id": "p_9a2d5aad94121cfb", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 99, "text": "」關公乃整衣跪於內門外，問二嫂為何悲泣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "1bebe71dff04ca7490faae2629a733a429f279e9e1774442fa122a57b2b43b4a"}

{"id": "p_21ef7da68f2eec18", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 100, "text": "甘夫人曰：「我夜夢皇叔身陷於土坑之內，覺來與糜夫人論之，想在九泉之下矣，是以相哭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "78d47229fc30d73609248ee9978fa49389da8639522c57b4bd70afad7f08e382"}

{"id": "p_361339748e672e35", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 101, "text": "」關公曰；「夢寐之事，不可憑信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "cc2f8c5759d5785f8f59a2e9531cc12c7914d94e1851ddb05133cf337d2fc526"}

{"id": "p_d193468d3b8e6aaa", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 102, "text": "正說間，適曹操命使來請關公赴宴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "78507968140a67900b47160be99ae18e181a57506485b713187d6035ba2a3c5c"}

{"id": "p_1664271a4e740001", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 103, "text": "公曰：「二嫂思兄痛哭，不由某心不悲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "cc7ae7a91972f1798b521107725924797480decf0e2c759bbdac5462b9488ce2"}

{"id": "p_06a78e704c48a5d9", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 104, "text": "」操笑而寬解之，頻以酒相勸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "83108e866d8ccf07e338b9ca4fa89cb36d2f0b59ede80ccfcaf4ccb94320a880"}

{"id": "p_6b9317bd9d1acb9e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 105, "text": "公醉，自綽其髯而言曰：「生不能報國家，而背其兄，徒為人也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "ceec6558eb24d644d518f9a31df8bee5604b69cbdac96d2b4d85a37c78efe82f"}

{"id": "p_18d367ddd3b3123c", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」操問曰：「雲長髯有數乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "ce8ddd2b4a6e80204474f698e0c656bb2d81b68ad2d5a256be59e1f63f175a82"}

{"id": "p_42c7418546a79641", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 107, "text": "冬月多以皂紗囊裹之，恐其斷也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "553f169d2f44bc8f76b6cb6d80ce603631dff8e383e0b4b8de90eb51e5df2e72"}

{"id": "p_020c7bda72faf655", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 108, "text": "」操以紗錦作囊，與關公護髯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "c2f95c123f98bd8900ae67260c21876dc28dd74d3c6b8117f0654babd92b9f95"}

{"id": "p_e0dd2373f7f8f2fa", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 109, "text": "帝見關公一紗錦囊垂於胸次，帝問之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "241248f6f7e67d4a5f23f0195d44443dbca1e39b94742a56fcb1a6606a480ac0"}

{"id": "p_762c90a9c12d0974", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 110, "text": "關公奏曰：「臣髯頗長，丞相賜囊貯之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "b0a39b634db64b8f86cf667990f3533b9cf724bd5fe87d06f7b24ba6629f7d90"}

{"id": "p_cac71d4eb9d5dbc6", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 111, "text": "」帝令當殿披拂，過於其腹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "36f64698467545ef928020269bf081dd414c73e3d8d428fffd0e462cc5fafe6b"}

{"id": "p_6e87d32dee5175ce", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 112, "text": "臨散，送公出府，見公馬瘦，操曰：「公馬因何而瘦？", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "c306d1fd81db6412a85fe0b7e95b0aa662ba3ea9ce1ccda26318bdc885794625"}

{"id": "p_16cadd7439766b71", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」關公曰：「賤軀頗重，馬不能載，因此常瘦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "9ca752eedf9532f9faaf7b06546fe178f038c8989f4c2a45a79e2cafb918b164"}

{"id": "p_f72e3f7bbb0da6ec", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 114, "text": "那馬身如火炭，狀甚雄偉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "b5648738770f2280bbc4526ccead7407231a5257d0723f1c5a4d433439b0452d"}

{"id": "p_d944f6ef2d9d4dd6", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 115, "text": "」公曰：「莫非呂布所騎赤兔馬乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "0a969717153ca441dd72947ed18c5b7013832acba7717f1280d51fed2cebb22c"}

{"id": "p_7a5486b9b6e4afdf", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 116, "text": "操不悅曰：「吾累送美女金帛，公未嘗下拜；今吾贈馬，乃喜而再拜，何賤人而貴畜耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "55134f1943a754c7bfe183215c0a8799a257f2199d8f4d8dbd7934dfc1e3a450"}

{"id": "p_fff2c3cc861e6a56", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 117, "text": "」關公曰：「吾知此馬日行千里，今幸得之，若知兄長下落，可一日而見面矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "deb73dc0b8fbcb08ed2b805fe963284e6d84a29a75a67797f3ad6ff0cb9090e4"}

{"id": "p_f453c516f49b3aee", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 118, "text": "::威傾三國著英豪，一宅分居義氣高。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "3114162f7aeb7edfd76fe1e11217b72afda7ea8a261516cb22f4b77aba13e6fb"}

{"id": "p_3221d3d50c2cd498", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 119, "text": "::奸相枉將虛禮待，豈知關羽不降曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "1da5cfc6a5209c4f2354948d9de97421cd1da507cdb2643783766ab079973104"}

{"id": "p_cc7afbf59610b690", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 120, "text": "操問張遼曰：「吾待雲長不薄，而彼常懷去心，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "2aa925f02b0c61ce3c03ccd6fb351403e98cb0e267a3d0f0c92e9a0a3cf1b9d5"}

{"id": "p_0c03fb4f5e7d7594", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 121, "text": "禮畢，遼曰：「我薦兄在丞相處，不曾落後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "6d1d5ffd53d51af8817569db8c0d9d3ca5b9e04ad8a4083f70cc7935004c922b"}

{"id": "p_7259b33edc0adcfb", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 122, "text": "」公曰：「深感丞相厚意；只是吾身雖在此，心念皇叔，未嘗去懷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "b7578710433c040c868c9e87df27bd29f72bde8f83dc46d9cc3fc8b8245ca058"}

{"id": "p_c296bd7fc7913007", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 123, "text": "處世不分輕重，非丈夫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "27167f6e3e943cc0f21d39d8d3e99b86e0b7d1eda3fb4af7b8fe65c0d05a4de9"}

{"id": "p_89996a6bc1ee7e5b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 124, "text": "玄德待兄，未必過於丞相，兄何故只懷去志？", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "d2b17885e056ad306b8330a1ff2617a890dbda4e77331c48fe622c331ce28a6e"}

{"id": "p_a4ba75b6e838c1d6", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 125, "text": "」公曰：「吾固知曹公待吾甚厚；奈吾受劉皇叔厚恩，誓以共死，不可背之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "308787b7027802229baca467bb6e5051dac5226cb387f61b25d06cf6547c4f6c"}

{"id": "p_bbd8941199e28e2a", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 126, "text": "要必立效以報曹公，然後去耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "739cd24f24573b03d148cc84c7ec78260aa717bdb9dcc16c79471ea5712323cd"}

{"id": "p_086aa0000249a585", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」遼曰：「倘玄德已棄世，公何所歸乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "4e6d50100f5231208d413cbf52f1a5e1f8b714c8a448a674ce999e8b097822cd"}

{"id": "p_2e193f83e42e9e8e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 128, "text": "遼知公終不可留，乃告退，回見曹操，具以實告。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "7f31c0022716cb42bab16de163d861728f041632b8d1f27ed9ef5f588542fb3a"}

{"id": "p_7dec7421b079260e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 129, "text": "操歎曰：「事主不忘其本，乃天下之義士也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "3b1c076dcbe62c21d4b1f11004ec3c04b3f4aa414c2803d6dac587a89b6cf098"}

{"id": "p_393746ea56d43f27", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 130, "text": "」荀彧曰：「彼言立功方去，若不教彼立功，未必便去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "6e5aa30ebddf9e5ad5245832f6e17455b795592963c8aa4380d9d9960d465625"}

{"id": "p_a9e55ec267094f68", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 131, "text": "卻說玄德在袁紹處，旦夕煩惱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "a392446cb7a3f861a63b8341cd1343504e58be8d11b653c5900203c18ffd4e14"}

{"id": "p_868bc35e9d8396c4", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」玄德曰：「二弟不知音耗，妻小陷於曹賊；上不能報國，下不能保家，安得不憂？", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "a51be1d9957d6bb3b244a7164f6e206334277592ac0965fda51fb327ed26e903"}

{"id": "p_9058fa590bf470e0", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 133, "text": "」紹曰：「吾欲進兵赴許都久矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "7b2a5622dbd015813fa4dd72392639b744c815eeb7d068997e12f2b9e04f5197"}

{"id": "p_4b4261f6062b5a6b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 134, "text": "田豐諫曰：「前操攻徐州，許都空虛，不及此時進兵；今徐州已破，操兵方銳，未可輕敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "46005b4090e416268e964f5a273e2bfae2ac931a8d700b0932f0de69fa47df1f"}

{"id": "p_6ebdfe4ee2ee128e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 135, "text": "不如以久持之，待其有隙而後可動也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "07ab2f4465164428af8b04c9b47f37ac972668e7bf19d817eb387d72cc6c2f27"}

{"id": "p_b8a5937587cb78b7", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 136, "text": "」因問玄德曰：「田豐勸我固守，何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "5ffe8fb8c8885ca04f19d104813d546214c353eb814bbf5d400f5cd513886006"}

{"id": "p_20b8aecfb76451be", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 137, "text": "」玄德曰：「曹操欺君之賊，明公若不討之，恐失大義於天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "535cd61629036dbb22374ae546549d4d74a682f0358f420cb49e7d69eea06c78"}

{"id": "p_e1c5345dfbdc00c1", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 138, "text": "」紹曰：「玄德之言甚善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "337042cb632cc02b30110e818ea33e09d72d1c8257dc4ce858d96c11c7aeef2d"}

{"id": "p_3b09311efda84b59", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 139, "text": "紹怒曰：「汝等弄文輕武，使我失大義！", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "2b81b31b2408e2f262c0a20b2f5edbb1c5918f4f4204c05d43c3a2da7d8fc426"}

{"id": "p_b5e41437b2b2a5af", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」田豐頓首曰：「若不聽臣良言，出師不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "f447e54699217d30970a325279bf32c366fc13057b41325238c763fd0ad59bcc"}

{"id": "p_8d115576ac6199c1", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 141, "text": "沮授見田豐下獄，乃會其宗族，盡散家財，與之訣曰：「吾隨軍而去，勝則威無不加，敗則一身不保矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "5d1cd9322532f22e15bcf5587e4322acf6ea939f58eeb1b4461597c94f551fba"}

{"id": "p_d70d3efecdaf2d52", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 142, "text": "紹遣大將顏良作先鋒，進攻白馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "a7315a27e4a3b040fa23d20798ca3e61fa175787375954e4a373a1770da03183"}

{"id": "p_7f4ef5b680816daf", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 143, "text": "沮授諫曰：「顏良性狹，雖驍勇，不可獨任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "2b6eeb99dcdfc92dd968741de6c09ae1123ddd79cbd55a4188cf6e4278ed8433"}

{"id": "p_a295bfdd3cc35abc", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」紹曰：「吾之上將，非汝等可料。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "314e15588dff686476ecec91bbdd053eabc4e89207d01e8fb7e18f92b3785182"}

{"id": "p_7016e32871405da0", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 145, "text": "」大軍進發至黎陽，東郡太守劉延告急許昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "9b114da91dc5b8407a621f2a15ba2c788d4189ab3b5caf71b67974386f1f2209"}

{"id": "p_ba43149e1aee264f", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 146, "text": "關公聞知，遂入相府見操曰：「聞丞相起兵，某願為前部。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "6964a08f13745e4ae1abfefc4ed7b1730e84712b0645984e4d17b25a9028801f"}

{"id": "p_758e2751f2b3ad93", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 147, "text": "操引兵十五萬，分三面隊行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "2a67e355b34427d1f3284101f05e5578284a96c9d49af619436342cdb0b2c260"}

{"id": "p_b5666fff4cfcfc94", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 148, "text": "於路又連接劉延告急文書，操先提五萬軍親臨白馬，靠土山劄住。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "5fe183aa1fff46ec38ce8e9e379cf368f3b5b75c40e6ce725710674e05f6f585"}

{"id": "p_4e70a555de8aa17a", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 149, "text": "遙望山前平川曠野之地，顏良前部精兵十萬，排成陣勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "d654a4541f61f708749494e9453ef7aeeeb163795954af654c3814f538e59463"}

{"id": "p_1df224e78d33a66a", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 150, "text": "操駭然，回顧呂布舊將宋憲曰：「吾聞汝乃呂布部下猛將，今可與顏良一戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "f1b4ec145b4cd495e684591500a4209d89b9d2c8213a73fc5316434d9c0f16ea"}

{"id": "p_5d29184da61e36ba", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 151, "text": "宋憲領諾，綽槍上馬，直出陣前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "b7ad0a53f0cb69a04dbc116728cd980caaba41123b481d48016e7fd953c98c85"}

{"id": "p_f2fc762b5f0b4321", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 152, "text": "顏良橫刀立馬於門旗下；見宋憲馬至，良大喝一聲，縱馬來迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "cdaaad2358d8749eb6e12f9dcede5dd7bef355536c439a484614e612ce0938af"}

{"id": "p_a2731d4a99ae9789", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 153, "text": "戰不三合，手起刀落，斬宋憲於陣前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "6acabc38ad93e50af1ff7aabcfcbb350f1ef2df63f2337b006e60cef4329e03c"}

{"id": "p_7458b6753ed2772b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 154, "text": "曹操大驚曰：「真勇將也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "efaf422659ec1e7edf1b3b9160cefbfba8922983e879aa9ca003a86ee23ce2e8"}

{"id": "p_20fd09762b4d56bb", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 155, "text": "」魏續曰：「殺我同伴，願去報讎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "96ae9caa8356a77d2ebe135fa5d75216af1fefb044093cd78d7fd2e71c73213c"}

{"id": "p_0998cb7ae756ac5a", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 156, "text": "續上馬持矛，逕出陣前，大罵顏良。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "4e42cc257cee0d838b2d3ae6c5fe8b599dd8975fa75a2dd49388cdbd0324dac5"}

{"id": "p_da5c89e99364556a", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 157, "text": "良更不打話，交馬一合，照頭一刀，劈魏續於馬下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "e9b45d0657aec5e3b2f24d38778e1532a023c575f1879f2a3c2b43d060c95799"}

{"id": "p_302cbaad03134850", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 158, "text": "」徐晃應聲而出，與顏良戰二十合，敗歸本陣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "82bdcb1bcbc1fcbd80dfe65acf23a967f0d5923518e98fb69bb4a8b2eb4f8898"}

{"id": "p_202bbd60ac5042b2", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 159, "text": "曹操收軍，良亦引軍退去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "4c13ff450b2b0b268c2dfd5ecac13068b0550513a6dca5c38111a7d9c4dd3cb4"}

{"id": "p_5a0ae67a608f6e78", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 160, "text": "操見連折二將，心中憂悶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "e87dc4fcccd2aa844ee0b62d1823ecf75591da3f88cced5afe7c04dc3cbbfe86"}

{"id": "p_740a5e32a47e73c8", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 161, "text": "程昱曰：「某舉一人可敵顏良。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "17857cf72148d3fc5531acc46e666ba8649fed43b565f2c704c0926615174a9c"}

{"id": "p_c1234ecc18589fd2", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 162, "text": "」操曰：「吾恐他立了功便去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "952b9f19dbe6527fadf92bad701e54928ae4a78d46b5436b2f5ee4a979a90a2d"}

{"id": "p_aaa3cbfbf1749f01", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」昱曰：「劉備若在，必投袁紹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "8fa0069cc03b6b1d0b510506612534b1fb616f99cd1b69fe4a35f8f6e3269d1a"}

{"id": "p_e3779940495db0ce", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 164, "text": "今若使雲長破袁紹之兵，紹必疑劉備而殺之矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "166e48c60361415ef3c822a13b8b74a030c19ee6ad7dc898c5701eaab691ceb7"}

{"id": "p_f56c536545cd801b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 165, "text": "」操大喜，遂差人去請關公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "d87b034ae4a96ad987b5d10701274ea688ea61f83658bddd16324a043eb51498"}
