{"id": "p_086d148fcd843ffa", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 166, "text": "二嫂曰：「叔叔此去，可打聽皇叔消息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "42609734a87eb569a0f916fe39b78321f27d9714605990e2ad7d6ba34d2bba9f"}

{"id": "p_9201406445ac8a86", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 167, "text": "關公領諾而出，提青龍刀，上赤兔馬，引從者數人，直至白馬來見曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "ba5a9e26bb0effc7fccb1072d592610a48b3987e784fdcafe752ff99e9330d6e"}

{"id": "p_bb77ec56299ce32c", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 168, "text": "操敘說：「顏良連誅二將，勇不可當，特請雲長商議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "dc1fe1fa6d8b50f5143ffd26768480554df4d5c542fa65aad36ccd8268e26908"}

{"id": "p_2ca0a6787cb982ad", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 169, "text": "忽報顏良搦戰，操引關公上土山觀看。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "fc94c50058338e4ccdb2541324492366b3d047a5a7656024724b68687a0bf7e4"}

{"id": "p_e9eb552ffc622cbe", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 170, "text": "曹操指山下顏良排的陣勢，旗幟鮮明，槍刀森布，嚴整有威，乃謂關公曰：「河北人馬，如此雄壯！", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "8f1eca9b6015c625033ae18ced5e6b5461b0e893e70a3223108687062eee1b1a"}

{"id": "p_cb016b9d0b52b134", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 171, "text": "」關公曰：「以吾觀之，如土雞瓦犬耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "553cb58a4d2c5592d2ede9030e5e6ec77e1e4c543060e7e8d5274e42e2113c4b"}

{"id": "p_4cfa4710b7f29962", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 172, "text": "」操又指曰：「麾蓋之下，銹袍金甲，持刀立馬者，乃顏良也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "4dc57d14eb61aae56e14e1e86a44d06c6d95d318658c0339971efa14f1790b3b"}

{"id": "p_dedd43983f6933f8", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 173, "text": "」關舉目一望，謂操曰：「吾觀顏良，如插標賣首耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "e2117d07e39c0f7a392768cfccd2d353d7102d9e9000c4e3400558e8eca755d0"}

{"id": "p_98ec079a0d462b5b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 174, "text": "」關公起身曰：「某雖不才，願去萬軍中取其首級，來獻丞相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "c9017f4a5bddec1599ea5ad64d29455daec6fcd2fa9d0de5ca7f8ba6a48f8697"}

{"id": "p_c179c10d3123ab23", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 175, "text": "」張遼曰：「軍中無戲言，雲長不可忽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "b0597338bb5f586324b13a849e1ec72da10051f407a58f9c2d1874fbfd20805c"}

{"id": "p_8a1f8834cc473c04", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 176, "text": "關公奮然上馬，倒提青龍刀，跑下山來，鳳目圓睜，蠶眉直豎，直衝彼陣，河北軍如波開浪裂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "79ac0e809946c8cb88f8f902f81b34d772ced938060b2dfc3e75427681d66c5b"}

{"id": "p_5e8d8634fa0a50c0", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 177, "text": "顏良正在麾蓋下，見關公衝來，方欲問時，關公赤兔馬快，早已跑到面前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "088301834d4bd09f60c303f16580b4975b7c39e7ac1412e0379feee5cf850c6c"}

{"id": "p_d374c5aa127a9230", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 178, "text": "顏良措手不及，被雲長手起一刀，刺於馬下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "d656cba979ab2b1287d8812a0cd14ba2bcea54b81a3c955d5c42f3ee05104d88"}

{"id": "p_b90d28950723b8fc", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 179, "text": "忽地下馬，割了顏良首級，拴於馬項之下，飛身上馬，提刀出陣，如入無人之境。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "9937ca1ddeb853efc2d520853f23c172c71bde3913f3f7a4db131f10eda01af1"}

{"id": "p_44d12714514156ef", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 180, "text": "河北兵將大驚，不戰自亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "28f14c92db69d7981c7deb27c4e089c12ad6b17228c41311a05bb7841c4ccb5a"}

{"id": "p_4a8fe7499946b946", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 181, "text": "曹軍乘勢攻擊，死者不可勝數，馬匹器械，搶奪極多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "51056df431deeba86ae6782371696d8db9ffcfa4e6ffacf7c2835d8c93b32d82"}

{"id": "p_bbfa6c01515313a4", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 182, "text": "關公縱馬上山，眾將盡皆稱賀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "5619e3e3096ce952cbdcb0dcb06f3f48ed20ae7e2243023cc3842b159411d155"}

{"id": "p_c7570e322ee7ee25", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 183, "text": "」關公曰：「某何足道哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "caf331a679613e56b516dd2e643bea398d6ae8aeeb8537d96211545b5a288463"}

{"id": "p_9a61f47bc3de309d", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 184, "text": "吾弟張翼德於百萬軍中取上將之頭，如探囊取物耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "7a30c2c70c9e7bdd00f8b28384e1ceb9087cad3bf14008b31e7bf41d2de8e5dd"}

{"id": "p_a1394eabc3d1803e", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 185, "text": "」操大驚，回顧左右曰：「今後如遇張翼德，不可輕敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "8699bc6a4a51bf13eb481ae756b359cffc607e8dc943df9ae14989597437a5ed"}

{"id": "p_07c3cbc173733f9b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 186, "text": "」令寫於衣袍襟底以記之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "90da49751e735aabf6a8115ce181b49912eeb067b959426bfab5acc9c85960e9"}

{"id": "p_b64bc028fd1b5b12", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 187, "text": "卻說顏良敗軍奔回，半路迎見袁紹，報說被赤面長鬚使大刀一勇將，匹馬入陣，斬顏良而去，因此大敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "dea2bf0f71f5e262cda35acf93505921bc5eb78e16496f7c25205f62af506c24"}

{"id": "p_3142ca17952ff4d6", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 188, "text": "」沮授曰：「此必是劉玄德之弟關雲長也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "ea2524cba0cfb3bb2827caea9b1725ca6cd7bae0af84e077e29eabf48e05dcab"}

{"id": "p_03968f065a6a32f3", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 189, "text": "」紹大怒，指玄德曰：「汝弟斬吾愛將，汝必通謀，留你何用！", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "3e127d6f852e4af51226c9bc28e3a970f7a3fc8aee8a9711a2601d86cf0d6791"}

{"id": "p_9cd8ef97839a7b5b", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 190, "text": "」喚刀斧手推出玄德斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "da2f8c5031b7fd1ccde3eed53d9de3fb148b92353a84c680549e7dfba9c5509e"}

{"id": "p_9644750511aad516", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 191, "text": "::初見方為座上客，此日幾同階下囚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "d3da1c97505758ba7b3f5240e512526794bb52141607130c0247ee5a4c0e296a"}

{"id": "p_ad5584b302e83871", "source_id": "src_0bed8d9689f953f1", "ordinal": 192, "text": "未知玄德性命如何，且聽下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "e85c6538e36289b4dec2599680a298df8c13e9aec095fd415ff6647a7dc91cca"}

{"id": "p_851c4e411c151e59", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說曹操部下諸將中，自張遼而外，只有徐晃與雲長交厚，其餘亦皆敬服；獨蔡陽不服關公，故今日聞其去，欲住追之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "083d78eada020e2d7f5ca2d754097eb25e8caf51d3a518f97ba875085910b7cb"}

{"id": "p_5c16766ecf262caf", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 1, "text": "操曰：「不忘故主，來去明白，真丈夫也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "4a18bc7597bc5a0874d5eed7c9eb2a5d1319d627a473cbfc9a8c379b4f2c2f7d"}

{"id": "p_20e66a9d1641a907", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 2, "text": "」遂叱退蔡陽，不令去趕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "9dcf51b6521fdef7a3cbf82cb2cd5508527ee187e39bf542b61ab05cac43eaaa"}

{"id": "p_b4401aa143c6db18", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 3, "text": "程昱曰：「丞相待關某甚厚，今彼不辭而去，亂言片楮，冒瀆鈞威，其罪大矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "62c278b94d612cf39a4a83731c92937d8f9a8f4064de895f0c19ed83a922c11f"}

{"id": "p_b05b9fbed7290b4e", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 4, "text": "若縱之使歸袁紹，是與虎添翼也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "f5909f6174fc111da2d195990c44daa35256225debcdd6a1b034e93bcc61c274"}

{"id": "p_16fc6dc1a0fc76cf", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 5, "text": "不若追而殺之，以絕後患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "12fa044466cc81213f94f72dd3d550edcbe991fe582ca647fd7e81689e29db2d"}

{"id": "p_ac34a355545ee0af", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」操曰：「吾昔已許之，豈可失信？", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "cfab1f77c4d108935e9883b6ec146b5ae728e6b7cc1eedcb8eb341885b85e767"}

{"id": "p_9da892bffee04e8d", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 7, "text": "」因謂張遼曰：「雲長封金挂印，財賄不足以動其心，爵祿不足以移其志，此等人吾深敬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "0655c282be58ac95fbfa2ceb721c5d25baac810043fd47baeda88eca45924d14"}

{"id": "p_35c156f3153fb44d", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 8, "text": "想他去此不遠，我一發結識他做個人情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "a6b9b2650a96e21aaf2d58d0daa7a0521a034c00448f006c5f14574c38cecc6d"}

{"id": "p_474b23ff10fa9621", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 9, "text": "汝可先去請住他，待我與他送行，更以路費征袍贈之，使為後日記念。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "41ade4f9eb2f8db95042f0c3a2c3d6ed6e12aa7c71d42d2ba2b029d395ad2ed4"}

{"id": "p_5e77b5efe2d7ec25", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 10, "text": "卻說雲長所騎赤馬，日行千里，本是趕不上；因欲護送車仗，不敢縱馬，按轡徐行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "abf6794afb46e02e37c13c542d1dfa4ef234cf85b7c9200374fe095a4e179167"}

{"id": "p_05bb6e7de2c6c7c9", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 11, "text": "忽聽背後有人大叫：「雲長且慢行！", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "ee70b703f30e923d67037e31658534ea9053f5d332b90069cc51e0ea1f4a20b2"}

{"id": "p_26cb5a1d2f87c6fa", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」回頭視之，見張遼拍馬而至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "6c44d10d9d5662e9afa75c6bbd63bf7f7e95e2604c664a1856be8a8c58dafa40"}

{"id": "p_aa8e40573200e444", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 13, "text": "關公教車仗從人，只管望大路緊行；自己勒住赤兔馬，按定青龍刀，問曰：「文遠莫非欲追我回乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "46d06722b22e42de7c7f170637c3a7b9a189491956b2135b65f590a4a9675d8c"}

{"id": "p_a094701dd29be690", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 14, "text": "丞相知兄遠行，欲來相送，特先使我請住臺駕，別無他意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "9554c2744db3f86d9b6fec1ab4b92ce4dbaa5a9f9703ff295e7abd37c919f9ee"}

{"id": "p_23ddd875c156163f", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」關公曰：「便是丞相鐵騎來，吾願決一死戰！", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "3e3e1b66a23859c52eb97a38496d942a966f064a8c863c7c84762d5a47d6f567"}

{"id": "p_15db0a850df32127", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 16, "text": "見曹操引數十騎，飛奔前來；背後乃是許褚、徐晃、于禁、李典之輩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "fd2910afecbb37c1cbdf3c91c0d1aae37897acf6713651c437f2477d6d7ff52c"}

{"id": "p_286345fdde2ad06a", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 17, "text": "操見關公橫刀立馬於橋上，令諸將勒住馬匹，左右排開。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "c12642fde47c311e54523fdb95d60dc2520a93dee75f3fab2deeb7c0fdc4e7c4"}

{"id": "p_c029c9cfa017f3c8", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 18, "text": "關公見眾人手中皆無軍器，方始放心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "4461c13a73df52aaeb389fca613fc31168359102b241dfb83f0fffad9048976b"}

{"id": "p_fa42641241079645", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」關公於馬上欠身答曰：「關某前曾稟過丞相，今故主在河北，不由某不急去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "fedff09905273d6037fc4e111fbfacf56d294cc89d227ade038a72f54edc6abe"}

{"id": "p_aacc12068cc40004", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 20, "text": "累次造府，不得參見，故拜書告辭，封金挂印，納還丞相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "96b02fa0a5e0cdc359434676c05a571062040f3fa2e1e50f8f763e5575d05de5"}

{"id": "p_772ec831bc01163c", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 21, "text": "」操曰：「吾欲取信於天下，安肯有負前言？", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "4fe2a4781dc2d27aeff42250f85f6d80d99d584a07d2b5a59a60b457b9455c32"}

{"id": "p_da0108d6b2888794", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 22, "text": "恐將軍途中乏用，特具路資相送。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "74b132234da7e435d9595d689b57ca70809b7fc562204a9b668510f12f53ac4a"}

{"id": "p_985a1a9114ffbef5", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」一將便從馬上托過黃金一盤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "13dfdad62b4dbc4e3e69ec48ac6aa792b2fc41b005d5be1f028fef527f31141b"}

{"id": "p_759eb652abfd94ea", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 24, "text": "關公曰：「累蒙恩賜，尚有餘資。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "452737e6ca7931654b1ad4c47803015183b5fe7d6ffe6de342f967ff7a9afd3c"}

{"id": "p_b6d657403e489c6b", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 25, "text": "」操曰：「特以少酬大功於萬一，何必推辭？", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "960d15fad00c6ceba2ec5210e5114d0743d0de943688697b7d495a51e4c1ac40"}

{"id": "p_2421b35cbefa393d", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」關公曰：「區區微勞，何足挂齒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "a01d7c10814925168bc324eadb374aaf1b27e7568cb6fa70ee9a5b99c13804c5"}

{"id": "p_1ebf8c33a1acd3a8", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」操笑曰：「雲長天下義士，恨吾福薄，不得相留。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "9e7cff562b7b4883724fcf546be765ce934cbb92f38e158e175c49b568f56002"}

{"id": "p_633ee8f1cc5c147c", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」令一將下馬，雙手捧袍過來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "26d98bb9a9ae0cd8629785a89d266b128cc54252d533e67b19bff1dd659c2cbf"}

{"id": "p_f8342099330e18c1", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 29, "text": "雲長恐有他變，不敢下馬，用青龍刀尖挑錦袍披於身上，勒馬回頭稱謝曰：「蒙丞相賜袍，異日更得相會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "9d75934f2d8a5e87e4eae5dbe156c27c4260666f2e98f0fc2b21cdcc9b5efbb5"}

{"id": "p_11eca47e89231d2f", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 30, "text": "許褚曰：「此人無禮太甚，何不擒之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "f5457d4ebaf30fe7e3a0c2d9bc723fd5c6debe2974a35aaf5d341d2193b64c6d"}

{"id": "p_3cec1cbcb3607216", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」操曰：「彼一人一騎，吾數十餘人，安得不疑？", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "09b536146b62e3031de86744bcc753c6a0f6fed1dc27cebb3ade27a4acbe447c"}

{"id": "p_46e245536b3c2d88", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」曹操自引眾將回城，於路嘆想雲長不已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "375b15918cc4159720ef25018f38465b592dae3db9801330020209ac3e4b81a9"}

{"id": "p_9ebc5d061a3bb6b7", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 33, "text": "且說關公來趕車仗，約行三十里，卻只不見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "11fe63b0afae844ec8cbff74f866fa90c1d1813bd7c00462f11dae20b4345c2d"}

{"id": "p_92d482b60859df7e", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 34, "text": "雲長心慌，縱馬四下尋之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "076b85f06a419bf3949ed617b454e3620d813f4f83a83a7b06baa5d887adca44"}

{"id": "p_35570c3111f357c8", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 35, "text": "忽見山頭一人，高叫：「關將軍且住！", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "b6fd08931b39ffecdfed444c635552322fa83f570a9cecc5e39d8ee01ccdd458"}

{"id": "p_77c29708b1357537", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 36, "text": "」雲長舉目視之，只見一少年，黃巾錦衣，持槍跨馬，馬項下懸著首級一顆，引百餘步卒，飛奔前來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "8d138e1fd9b6fafeb8e293d3da1c25c9414b516aa47e558c1e8fc116c3b027d3"}

{"id": "p_302faadb93234371", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」少年棄槍下馬，拜伏於地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "6d5bd0095f9413cd07dc201ea521a34501038200f8a59fba9ba81d6e74313289"}

{"id": "p_9dfed8c3b59cbf56", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 38, "text": "雲長恐是詐，勒馬持刀問曰：「壯士，願通姓名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "7765b13a06442600724be0d577d628f47a5216319c4ef8768e7f500085cd4393"}

{"id": "p_22b0b55907115eb3", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」答曰：「吾本襄陽人；姓廖，名化，字元儉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "6decca461beba1f90d922c95a38862a27d46991805bbd0e5dcc43bc55860feb5"}

{"id": "p_2f00bde44efdeb84", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 40, "text": "因世亂流落江湖，聚眾五百餘人，劫掠為生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "74c2aa771648c122afc55a628afe9d2a2b29ac4fb46067c644c42a86771b0913"}

{"id": "p_3fc0833e1066a78c", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 41, "text": "恰纔同伴杜遠下山巡哨，誤將兩夫人劫掠上山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "20561f83255e4f568426366fd1ef3f4a09674ab1ee3ec266af3edb4a290f2ede"}

{"id": "p_20a32794999a64b1", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 42, "text": "吾問從者，知是大漢劉皇叔夫人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "217acb3b569397c73158cc41663af9723f19335f9532b910943e120c7c4e3db9"}

{"id": "p_6119d95c286bd7bb", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 43, "text": "且聞將軍護送在此，吾即欲送下山來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "5d7c3b10efa72b5aa56de74a5909ab74b5d50204c57e20933e85085c41a19c3e"}

{"id": "p_03a88b353ed84f5e", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 44, "text": "杜遠出言不遜，被某殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "4e02aed963f0e50411084b17af9d6813a7c0df4b244f438be90ced09bc3f6f7e"}

{"id": "p_c68eaefd92b035cd", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」關公曰：「二夫人何在？", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "f826081e4b2c01a107206f1b95cf602fcbe6c066b2060bddef3c0b3580aa179d"}

{"id": "p_e16eab92e6fe5fa9", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 46, "text": "不移時，百餘人簇擁車仗前來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "bff6217b3b0e196ac3bded9525fa207f6c0389a9ac84705e34500adff1d3b45a"}

{"id": "p_9e236b0dea4e8363", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 47, "text": "關公下馬停刀，叉手於車前問候曰：「二嫂受驚否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "406d18c25f9e04ca09e52006a74bb32c204bcbf3282267baaf26f9ab6cd8a05d"}

{"id": "p_6b4512172836de70", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 48, "text": "」二夫人曰：「若非廖將軍保全，已被杜遠所辱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "7ef64aae818353003902b04bc8832fdae776f582768a58a8b34ac42268148aea"}

{"id": "p_12541b45ff26b238", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 49, "text": "」關公問左右曰：「廖化怎生救夫人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "94b5b7646c5cc7b194ab8a46355b175a73f0b2310bb524adc02b4db048ef62d4"}

{"id": "p_3594075f26a2966c", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」左右曰：「杜遠劫上山去，就要與廖化各分一人為妻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "74698233d342fc6e3c9a43bdbf748a7275dc7d999afe84be83219b93fa076323"}

{"id": "p_3e778e9b84a56478", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 51, "text": "廖化問起根由，好生拜敬；杜遠不從，已被廖化殺了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "e35db355aed4afc6072144503888e4039a96e7f8351ff205c92d751ee13ec72e"}

{"id": "p_094db116e081a112", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 52, "text": "」關公聽言，乃拜謝廖化。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "3f7cebf371c53955520f04d2d67f45bdc3a241083e211edce05e0e9a9ba0c94f"}

{"id": "p_661b5d92fcb1ec99", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 53, "text": "關公尋思此人終是黃巾餘黨，未可作伴，乃謝卻之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "f0506aca8a1d6d28924e2c1b3c860b6535ae457a94a40962c1f61b5cb61eecee"}

{"id": "p_1b222cb87e1f70ac", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 54, "text": "廖化又拜送金帛，關公亦不受。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "8837fbe33b1c915389826cebc5b1adc6d2b8286082585fc65555edf0d5a784eb"}

{"id": "p_26568887839d2567", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 55, "text": "廖化拜別，自引人伴投山谷中去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "f1a52d9ebd74a0e4847f18fc48ebe7a661ae598144ea5afe47e01df4bab4d44a"}

{"id": "p_880cc61229230aec", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 56, "text": "雲長將曹操贈袍事，告知二嫂，催促車仗前行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "29c191648d1b3bdad2a2c0ed13845174b2464fa0b81158aab4ecdf7d8a10d8c2"}

{"id": "p_039fd8d71bfcbfef", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 57, "text": "莊主出迎，鬚髮皆白，問曰：「將軍姓甚名誰？", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "72da2e82bd0bccc5dd470aab9291c994f0f5c37b821e39d35d918819cc2520e8"}

{"id": "p_6f6bcae477d06bd9", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」關公施禮曰：「吾乃劉玄德之弟關某也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "10c5a9dbf792978adcf601d37ddf17d9423b8ac28e5916ef06503f9d74cf8064"}

{"id": "p_8fa329c49315ac66", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 59, "text": "」老人曰：「莫非斬顏良、文醜的關公否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "de755f35a3ffe923c4f3547e75e1ef4a768cd874dfe895481562764fe7814941"}

{"id": "p_97d1b7a81fb61adb", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 60, "text": "關公曰：「車上還有二位夫人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "286a84bd2ca01e700ab681df9ee7b99328f4c171555350765e7bb9a9b1fa4aac"}

{"id": "p_6c648de7f7f54798", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 61, "text": "二夫人至草堂上，關公叉手立於二夫人之側。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "80acb8ba8d3ca0506b060c5e03aa05bf53175e42cdc51e68cae36921a23b9acf"}

{"id": "p_cd62c3e12f5b0889", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 62, "text": "老人請公坐，公曰：「尊嫂在上，安敢就坐？", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "cdf9bb1fe3c36582cb263f168f7fa2a85b1f50f02b54ccb878d9fff5319f349d"}

{"id": "p_bdbe1d5e31b0a8b7", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」老人乃令妻女請二夫人入內室款待，自於草堂款待關公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "b4e7ff51ec78d8660d15afe05cdd0eb1d91e97597b226c717adeacbfea25241a"}

{"id": "p_be6e16434d4f6afc", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 64, "text": "老人曰：「吾姓胡，名華。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "f4de00f1dd0a7d8d3c67af56ba05bdab27ab8d83f6db14e99be0ed6b321d0c50"}

{"id": "p_223aeb73f77ffb4e", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 65, "text": "桓帝時曾為議郎，致仕歸鄉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "559f7a79ddf7c9f97129a153708f2bdaa961dedc01615c9e7a8e95dde25cf5c8"}

{"id": "p_7ed5e95c9f1415ae", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 66, "text": "今有小兒胡班，在滎陽太守王植部下為從事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "1c351cd59c7280ef847e139a06990ec6bccafdd9f6da2b7156700b2465845eeb"}

{"id": "p_28dece210ccc6209", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 67, "text": "將軍若從此處經過，某有一書寄與小兒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "0af8a125b2c00ca0d6f5d061e39ffc6b973e9fa9f953f4ab6cbe32372cc8f13f"}

{"id": "p_b846b7143ac3e0da", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 68, "text": "次日早膳畢，請二嫂上車，取了胡華書信，相別而行，取路投洛陽來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "f5d0b0b463e38f47c20c4ecf74ae5c669fe44deccf1e3eb818a43669ddda56f5"}

{"id": "p_3accecad3731d076", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 69, "text": "把關將姓孔，名秀，引五百軍兵在土嶺上把守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "eb6892803947a58baaff5648f79971b9827e937f2d2853fe23ec89d94c4c9dd2"}

{"id": "p_427c6386dc48b531", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 70, "text": "當日關公押車仗上嶺，軍士報知孔秀，秀出關來迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "34e08a9be7eaf0dd66061c47c1b174f986375ef7efdd16482f96dd6081c82dd3"}

{"id": "p_4a57bd0581b34e0f", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」公曰：「某辭丞相，特往河北尋兄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "d16120e5b6e3bae39e762e479df7a2f8b0c63c6f8002c9a5c7a143678e30d7a3"}

{"id": "p_f1c367033f13888b", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 72, "text": "」秀曰：「河北袁紹，正是丞相對頭；將軍此去，必有丞相文憑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "046207bf275ea7c8a255a2d75cdab8a8cbd5b63b54a4be58470526c71f84a8ad"}

{"id": "p_5fd3e00780bc5fa9", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」公曰：「因行期慌迫，不曾討得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "8d0e79ae08ac8da2cfdd321f71b8303b9e95c98b28c876f740c46b8065f67b52"}

{"id": "p_f7a9df7cbf3374ec", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 74, "text": "」秀曰：「既無文憑，待我差人稟過丞相，方可放行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "8d1205459c3b88628040d2bdc4aeb13b2dd7722f733b28bef620e80ad0243b19"}

{"id": "p_9ee2005594f0a427", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」關公曰：「待去稟時，須誤了我行程。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "002bd50f68c5a5567df312e91574a2104405bf4f716db5f90ae91577e8e89734"}

{"id": "p_5c066646d33849ed", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 76, "text": "」秀曰：「法度所拘，不得不如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "f8da66a6de4d948fb63b4cc427850c966fd9107896495e1fdbc2a52ca5aa9aa8"}

{"id": "p_73598b1c87cfa23e", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」關公曰：「汝不容我過關乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "c1ddff61ece9a14eb59cdf774adbade6b8d456c0c6d2205bcb1c27ab608110ab"}

{"id": "p_d2dde6eb1524cb82", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 78, "text": "」秀曰：「汝要過去，留下老小為質。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "578c5e244892be51ea860e15a7357630ec7a6f1800c12434bbf4354a01d06aaa"}

{"id": "p_2316a9efb2056f4c", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 79, "text": "」關公大怒，舉刀就殺孔秀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "f185a3449390569847c4a519a06596573a085c54b2b12c1de2627635d31c31d7"}

{"id": "p_ff49efe31d92732d", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 80, "text": "秀退入關去，鳴鼓聚軍，披挂上馬，殺下關來，大喝曰：「汝敢過去麼！", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "aace2a18f851bb9f9f8a2119102b735d2a7ff8c0ab6e682ae6ee25118b44c1d0"}

{"id": "p_64695243ff3757b9", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 81, "text": "」關公約退車仗，縱馬提刀，竟不打話，直取孔秀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "460753fc0d4a8298679213a796d23298e8df99e465fe2046ef72db2ffa530064"}

{"id": "p_7201be84477f3862", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 82, "text": "兩馬相交，只一合，鋼刀起處，孔秀屍橫馬下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "b27fb6219a17cc74b1e86c92ac357cd37df1922d13cb6fc231680e940c7456c3"}

{"id": "p_070c9973103e069a", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 83, "text": "吾殺孔秀，不得已也，與汝等無干。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "b3468bca1008f21db236458881e59f3772a1121b072721d8dd183624dba32b79"}

{"id": "p_71c6dfe3a432e111", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 84, "text": "借汝眾軍之口，傳語曹丞相，言孔秀欲害我，我故殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "855e9fcc1f5ecf57c0d47f915e76514981c3c35cc97bb921da06deaca7b614be"}

{"id": "p_0ca2388e4789f740", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 85, "text": "關公即請二夫人車仗出關，望洛陽進發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "d5879deacecd8f7b152299b8071c46052f6d4ae2fbefda226a680f2ab263db5a"}

{"id": "p_61417b4d0dcd9e95", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 86, "text": "早有軍士報知洛陽太守韓福。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "6d02ff6a5039f18f2b02a1959e9f013a34b42a08c98f273b554223d02a786e4d"}

{"id": "p_a60b78442f7a004b", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 87, "text": "牙將孟坦曰：「既無丞相文憑，即係私行；若不阻擋，必有罪責。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "a8737821f02b329139aa1902909eddbb1fb30287604af38f3746078e2bfc56b0"}

{"id": "p_702421bc333831d6", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 88, "text": "」韓福曰：「關公勇猛，顏良、文醜，俱為所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "861135df708dda0767bf40e79ff6c4774dc148df50111e414cb5c72e6fa1b8cf"}

{"id": "p_285c17c861e9f159", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 89, "text": "今不可力敵，只須設計擒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "6473534e5ab7fd42a2e497d991aaacfc74518862f30616294725f95c85fd834c"}

{"id": "p_dcab9366e7028297", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 90, "text": "」孟坦曰：「吾有一計：先將鹿角攔定關口，待他到時，小將引兵和他交鋒，佯敗誘他來追，公可用暗箭射之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "166560a3b52fb96d64df46a004115f6ec7a1fa3ebab7b54c75f5d02de64e79ba"}

{"id": "p_41044aec55527e70", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 91, "text": "若關某墜馬，即擒解許都，必得重賞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "369e3c8a0a6e7ac9369474c4169a5f348a20221603e4c4588a529418346a3491"}

{"id": "p_fa8f7ae51cb4f0e8", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 92, "text": "」商議停當，人報關公車仗已到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "ac6a50576a91194ebb85c6be9498f2d0ea52f3f7850574a4c31fa7e90c3b5359"}

{"id": "p_2c031802551ece86", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 93, "text": "韓福彎弓插箭，引一千人馬，排列關口，問：「來者何人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "dcc5eb1c683a5c464eda0b029e5c12f0eb6d3a47c5285eaf1a9f5fe67b1563f7"}

{"id": "p_69ffe2001fb16df9", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」關公馬上欠身言曰：「吾漢壽亭侯關某，敢借過路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "8a6e40506059918f76b2253fcc7e1c1a0e16ab6c6dd7fa9ada7ef82705fcc193"}

{"id": "p_9343054d3a65d8f3", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」韓福曰：「有曹丞相文憑否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "bb62f99161612265f3eddab67cf07ad58e5bbc5df5a7d164986d4de783841e3b"}

{"id": "p_21a7204ef8bbb393", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 96, "text": "」關公曰：「事冗不曾討得。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "b0b8ecba735cf60fd4850b211e66177182665671651d4d69f7c4d027af8e09ca"}

{"id": "p_695f4c30f630096e", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」韓福曰：「吾奉丞相鈞命，鎮守此地，專一盤詰往來奸細。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "49283a951129dff5f899401c20ae001c6c1b88854789b5f8075e5cd1f3294300"}

{"id": "p_8c847d941d2f91d8", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」關公怒曰：「東嶺孔秀，已被吾殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "2cf5884317676c834913d25bb9eda5610a29b72a550ceab7edeada29e0b4dd8e"}

{"id": "p_56bdd8a7d2b06e31", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 99, "text": "」韓福曰：「誰人與我擒之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "f3a6eb6006631c45d9e9209460868e30971ab6727c001923a315d6e2521e6f26"}

{"id": "p_7b165f421f731b2c", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 100, "text": "」孟坦出馬，輪雙刀來取關公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "8f25137beb3942fd365cfff7677b7fa24ebaf80d13edc95bbdd56fe8684a2c4c"}

{"id": "p_cce8dd3541926e1b", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 101, "text": "關公約退車仗，拍馬來迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "25539442ac4621bcbb4758a3136b48ed31dbb9fabce9e3ee2fcdf5afb354b627"}

{"id": "p_28df0c3372300476", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 102, "text": "孟坦戰不三合，撥回馬便走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "cfe63e358f77200978740f87f99da4cc1f959aa6db6ec3b7396d39cda693860e"}

{"id": "p_7b2734d70633143b", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 103, "text": "孟坦只指望引誘關公，不想關公馬快，早已趕上，只一刀砍為兩段。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "29c23b4f5eb313312fdc3ea823d872f222163a392b4a8d133cfd590d9ccd1550"}

{"id": "p_8719b720ca0a361b", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 104, "text": "關公勒馬回來，韓福閃在門首，盡力放了一箭，正射中關公左臂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "e4ceb9b638c0d99ae6a408777856ad40d11cf28c93aee4f48790b4643ce5309d"}

{"id": "p_e94219541a39b1b6", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 105, "text": "公用口拔出箭，血流不住，飛馬逕奔韓福，衝散眾軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "1dfb7bb0102041bfe67f80f75f9b2731a05957f0404453a0711196750776e5f6"}

{"id": "p_04e3e8264719988a", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 106, "text": "韓福急閃不及，關公手起刀落，帶頭連肩，斬於馬下；殺散眾軍，保護車仗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "04aecbdb87b003c7eb3dbcb0fc6ae07083d31e43954d0a346d396b248d681eee"}

{"id": "p_c0ad4570314dbd0c", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 107, "text": "關公割帛束住箭傷，於路恐人暗算，不敢久住，連夜投汜水關來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "ef067365fedede542034a62006a21c9db70b278d7063f913fdcf90b8c6c11f78"}

{"id": "p_4651482cd331a6ec", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 108, "text": "把關將乃并州人氏，姓卞，名喜，善使流星鎚；原是黃巾餘黨，後投曹操，撥來守關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "fbc830675d8debf26402936e7247824785b2a088fd729da906a24ff0df77c5ee"}

{"id": "p_ec684ffa89b790cf", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 109, "text": "當下聞知關公將到，尋思一計；就關前鎮國寺中，埋伏下刀斧手二百餘人，誘關公至寺，約擊盞為號，欲圖相害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "b562719df30970b2283638d7d1981c6aa95926d133648f979b7bad0917506119"}

{"id": "p_16fffe3712c79e6d", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 110, "text": "安排已定，出關迎接關公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "067298de3e76e606ae1e8988e5ae5fa2f4cd8a883cffd40f019e29fa424860a6"}

{"id": "p_42bb4c2245a62031", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 111, "text": "公見卞喜來迎，便下馬相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "24b2130f9e4da73375cfb03c5f5de98b32d816bcb3fb428b1f49d6431993ab0a"}

{"id": "p_b5ee470e107d951f", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 112, "text": "喜曰：「將軍名震天下，誰不敬仰！", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "3500ecee61ef069d007ef46bee51a2ed34612b32fdb809253dc27c900b16d98f"}

{"id": "p_d3ddfba4af1e051d", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」關公訴說斬孔秀、韓福之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "c987019c25939f870661ae4284e979ccd4c6546a9ed9f34e292741a62e9caf28"}

{"id": "p_03832cac585186ab", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 114, "text": "卞喜曰：「將軍殺之是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "beaf0061b39ac03bce8e1443405e45ff2004b313a5f10abd69bca88ecf7379b2"}

{"id": "p_f079595a9b863563", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 115, "text": "」關公甚喜，同上馬過了汜水關，到鎮國寺前下馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "8fa4895453908b0800bd5b7e4d901fdd257aad578e5798c19ed07fcbc605d73b"}

{"id": "p_446701fa0a0fa490", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 116, "text": "原來那鎮國寺乃漢明帝御前香火院，本寺有僧三十餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "dd470cb0757ad4f91dad4734efa4bc7a13125a9f71cb59e1a84207556273760f"}

{"id": "p_75fb9d0215d55aad", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 117, "text": "內有一僧，卻是關公同鄉人，法名普淨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "06a7dc1b0f3a9d3b7b2b25041c123067fde1164d077e18bf385141f9736b010e"}

{"id": "p_ac6abb69e506484e", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 118, "text": "當下普淨已知其意，向前與關公問訊，曰：「將軍離蒲東幾年矣？", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "a3e240802f7b76359276c38563a26c45969a99f533c65948bec5f8d2e21d9986"}

{"id": "p_2a9840d3c29760df", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 119, "text": "」關公曰：「將及二十年矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "f26da902019cbf8317aafaed1dd81130f7f2971eb4d9915bed86504ed6ab1ffd"}

{"id": "p_57ea3986722f1d0f", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 120, "text": "」普淨曰：「還認得貧僧否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "b8e97cb47b3f9c60b957390567ce37d9ecda668bf57202e166d7bc8609d82ac6"}

{"id": "p_e4a30fbba9a437fe", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 121, "text": "」公曰：「離鄉多年，不能相識。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "506e7cd4ae6fcf31ccd944da256f1b310360e1ee77cd6d9fa6e0c943ef80b470"}

{"id": "p_216bf1236cb6b4c9", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 122, "text": "」普淨曰：「貧僧家與將軍家只隔一條河。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "d37188d451a35fc3b5b36a22093d684a5455c2d5bfd4796e36b70952dd30179b"}

{"id": "p_8dc9de301ff66bd0", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」卞喜見普淨敘出鄉里之情，恐有走泄，乃叱之曰：「吾欲請將軍赴宴，汝僧人何得多言！", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "5d90ad299f75d5f8ac86728db577992edd955dd00b4a94ae6338df550ca55cf3"}

{"id": "p_1d540f9473e4cd94", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 124, "text": "鄉人相遇，安得不敘舊情耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "40839e4fa1ab019995e54c9eec4f0d57d6a8adaf8a8c760eca8a256ad608d184"}

{"id": "p_8657a4d73df8e70c", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 125, "text": "關公曰：「二位夫人在車上，可先獻茶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "642fcb151b7da86bfd32387dc2ffa2d0dbfcea979ca813b5c67853e4927fae47"}

{"id": "p_b18f25b24abaee84", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 126, "text": "」普淨教取茶先奉夫人，然後請關公入方丈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "2062e9d8b9e94f69cec79cd21c47be724954561c11907689c234f680a0448789"}

{"id": "p_ad06d49c8d67bb88", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 127, "text": "普淨以手舉所佩戒刀，以目視關公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "7b9557126b47cf0e2b2f84ed3af9c1060e625eb637b42ee90c6d7ef38223f55e"}

{"id": "p_743aa7d454a74f63", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 128, "text": "公會意，命左右持刀緊隨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "c50a09e3add81c24cd0d57a2d19005d12788d712616c0f93dbd88e0f450d9caf"}

{"id": "p_e5f83d7cb0a7a678", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 129, "text": "關公曰：「卞君請關某，是好意？", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "71125da500e73a8bd74977c06d96f2c8f82dfc4366e6cf26e4ba22a53a3ed423"}

{"id": "p_d96c5c672aedfdf4", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 130, "text": "」卞喜未及回言，關公早望見壁衣中有刀斧手，乃大喝卞喜曰：「吾以汝為好人，安敢如此！", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "e7621a7dae065d5d9d88416c27938211601657b4f5709bdcdf420cb90153a25f"}

{"id": "p_cd45ac18c9e27e98", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 131, "text": "」卞喜知事泄，大叫：「左右下手！", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "b693bf75ec81b9ba3c610dc758a71a1f3d8c5ef439f8b4221db4dcbee76b3663"}

{"id": "p_827915cf85e1b15a", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」左右方欲動手，皆被關公拔劍砍之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "de67cbad9356ffbff57a0cb0d43a9307939012fd0d3afdf23e286a45e4407f5b"}

{"id": "p_f5ecde53f6386be3", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 133, "text": "卞喜下堂遶廊而走，關公棄劍執大刀來趕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "7b36827ab9f54d77d4259cce949d508c2c58f43f428165cd26380737ac4b6db7"}

{"id": "p_ef236aede29b4a19", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 134, "text": "關公用刀隔開鎚，趕將入去，一刀劈卞喜為兩段，隨即回身來看二嫂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "70d28d79f2edf38ecdab9f4eb5ac1402bbb823c9f1654f0641b0e136b7bafbd5"}

{"id": "p_fbdd638c8fc757da", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 135, "text": "早有軍人圍住，見關公來，四下奔走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "bbb0d813e567bb7a2f36dc699ffae940fc679711990c4972e1f05ea42c7dfe5b"}

{"id": "p_e1ea093597d356f2", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 136, "text": "關公趕散，謝普淨曰：「若非吾師，已被此賊害矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "8b9d97571bae0ad34eb8d782c03fae54c5b5d595e814f225d8d05be670a0e5fa"}

{"id": "p_d7a213eb26a5ba66", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 137, "text": "」普淨曰：「貧僧此處難容，收拾衣缽，亦往他處雲游也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "c4fe798e93c8c703d4c7133aa81b34947018072a72858d3ea9790792b53332e2"}

{"id": "p_4457d84cfc0227f1", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 138, "text": "」關公稱謝，護送車仗，住滎陽進發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "fbdd71dfe10eb3e9fe57ce0d34f2a7f1d0e78366cc1967b989f7c521d91ad235"}

{"id": "p_4d758579167df44c", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 139, "text": "滎陽太守王植，卻與韓福是兩親家；聞得關公殺了韓福，商議欲暗害關公，乃使人守住關口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "39454da40689433d11befa282e5fe68223eaed8c7d8139138f9362968609d51b"}

{"id": "p_ff6ebcf94e4fe920", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 140, "text": "待關公到時，王植出關，喜笑相迎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "02fa698fe182d77b06f09acab540e5c8e2925d71ef86874cf871198614480364"}

{"id": "p_f77f5f2de0d5a552", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 141, "text": "植曰：「將軍於路驅馳，夫人車上勞困，且請入城，館驛中暫歇一宵，來日登途未遲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "d767729fcf45f99de261eeb315e579cc55c748868c7dd9565509a920ba7dd20b"}

{"id": "p_d7807903cc0af8ca", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 142, "text": "」關公見王植意甚殷勤，遂請二嫂入城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "5475f65b7d7f32d0035f76dc0f65050d7c2051cdb40df14a6b20e2f2fac8e02b"}

{"id": "p_9232900c14ef0bb7", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 143, "text": "王植請公赴宴，公辭不往；植使人送筵席至館驛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "e2c5bc53cec78b4929da6fc450ff9ab125999c3e308d9a51cda7d7d059cb3aa6"}

{"id": "p_1b021c47e7aca75b", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 144, "text": "關公因於路辛苦，請二嫂膳畢，就正房歇定；令從者各自安歇，飽餵馬匹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "e2556b6a83b97cc3648bcb5b87cbac879fa8878fcacfcb26ecddad856c155f93"}

{"id": "p_c0e5738155a975f7", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 145, "text": "卻說王植密喚從事胡班聽令曰：「關某背丞相而逃，又於路殺太守並守關將校，死罪不輕！", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "ef252bc7893ded87594cdb091619ce5d51c78cd4442962e14ef9809d27ad0389"}

{"id": "p_1236eadf0cfa8b17", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 146, "text": "汝今晚點一千軍圍住館驛，一人一個火把，待三更時分，一齊放火；不問是誰，盡皆燒死！", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "88d9d84d1bc55efc85a8b2d84e57505ce16c8cd704af0c5d223717bb74acef29"}

{"id": "p_75907292673692f7", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」胡班領命，便點起軍士，密將乾柴引火之物，搬於館驛門首，約時舉事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "852cd3846538cdcb3dcc04c5678ed52d86f4f48a7033b86469bac2757a43eae7"}

{"id": "p_fe9638a85d97a67a", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 148, "text": "胡班尋思：「我久聞關雲長之名，不識如何模樣，試往窺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "9a25ba9617fccd9224d4a909ef6ac49c0b3bff5fe551126e96e99a3a884b4c29"}

{"id": "p_c5b24dbc6e04bc87", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 149, "text": "」乃至驛中，問驛吏曰：「關將軍在何處？", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "340421ba522084af4e7af7b69c6cba2ca0a6c8e9e8ece5ef56cb423845de3dc5"}

{"id": "p_3d57ce96ba577a96", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」答曰：「正廳上觀書者是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "372100ff4aae41de467e08e7c33926796f5855b04e2e9ffd42102f4d04549365"}

{"id": "p_99bd078773c37f20", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」胡班潛至廳前，見關公左手綽髯，於燈下憑几看書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "e65968bc383705eafe3a079e0dd59b84a6c3edceed1d2720771c084eb05f263c"}

{"id": "p_dd69206d857fc0e3", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 152, "text": "班見了，失聲歎曰：「真天人也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "af81b60165a22b6addd348d1556fc14dc1c6863274c16f07653f795b02667642"}

{"id": "p_865db0f1b28e45bc", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 153, "text": "胡班入拜曰：「滎陽太守部下從事胡班。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "799767e5b3704f70611eef6a9990fd6eb670fa4166bec18469e5c316fac27f59"}

{"id": "p_84064871068062c9", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」關公曰：「莫非許都城外胡華之子否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "88415df70a5287bcabdfcbef149f97c201066ffde47752392358c77b693ae6b7"}

{"id": "p_782be17e6a263623", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 155, "text": "」公喚從者於行李中取書付班。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "0bc60d11595b77e97d10a0dc336ff6710f472051ea3728d0b44f11bc6c93cc34"}

{"id": "p_2fa11a9930c0abe7", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 156, "text": "班看畢，歎曰：「險些誤殺忠良！", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "6601aaf5cdfcb9d96dc930716415b18dca86c0d47a30452508f25f21a506975d"}

{"id": "p_49e8c22e6ffe12ae", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 157, "text": "」遂密告曰：「王植心懷不仁，欲害將軍，暗令人四面圍住館驛，約於三更放火。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "6f8126a91a23c2e64f2a054baf0e69dbba0be1b22083e610d848866ce50fee79"}

{"id": "p_04effb11adf473dd", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 158, "text": "今某當先去開了城門，將軍急收拾出城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "2f65f0e9063cafaae7c2065ac95990a00a16999bc45fa12d404724e1ed90327a"}

{"id": "p_7881cd2a45565530", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 159, "text": "」關公大驚，忙披挂提刀上馬，請二嫂上車，盡出館驛，果見軍士各執火把聽候。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "0f3b2b335f815bfd60b3b3844079b4f631131925c64df3aef65fc60acc8697f7"}

{"id": "p_6095456ab4b2eef8", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 160, "text": "關公急來到城邊，只見城門已開。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "e7b996efc3097f2339078e79aafe9f783d5b3e49b9dbf9ef55842878b93cc081"}

{"id": "p_86b898c0c66edadb", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 161, "text": "關公行不到數里，背後火把照耀，人馬趕來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "10531ac4f8b55ba8810b817126e0f0bc3f3d0ba0b5811e2ba7cda2f44d516372"}

{"id": "p_3ad8a971e344a998", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 162, "text": "當先王植大叫：「關某休走！", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "c4baf4000be9b194fe2be36bb4b3dab9ef6ceb02c09bcf6e327c4b64b9e43036"}

{"id": "p_cc4828fbec093464", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」關公勒馬，大罵：「匹夫！", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "131f963a86b0d388385dc93cb24a1d4a6ca6dab4bf9a6f739209be8ece3e0665"}

{"id": "p_6aecc6f3a695c3d6", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 164, "text": "我與你無讎，如何令人放火燒我？", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "5ceaee752f0e806157b5865e464cedc0675247062b180cf79b08361ab5dff0c5"}

{"id": "p_caea1b5cbd14d680", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 165, "text": "」王植拍馬挺槍，逕奔關公；被關公攔腰一刀，砍為兩段。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "d3cf7df420bdfad11724e3ade4d6962c36f6b06bfdfdafba992ec744ceae924d"}

{"id": "p_1f24cf3dcd8c019d", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 166, "text": "關公催車仗速行，於路感胡班不已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "9552b28e99ce5898fe9c5a3870d1f0f34e7bacebfeb9da86ed506a66f22f0e30"}

{"id": "p_e89ab12d59cd4a63", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 167, "text": "行至滑州界首，有人報與劉延。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "e286eb2171aac001a8ef1acaed63bbace23dc241b6f950bf81c09060c3ae571b"}

{"id": "p_18354cc3b63b9e2e", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 168, "text": "關公馬上欠身而言曰：「太守別來無恙！", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "d0dfb92bd218134f636aa25d3ee025a86f9a66c19cfe21304b023e045fd96108"}

{"id": "p_fbfa05570ef00de6", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 169, "text": "」公曰：「辭了丞相，去尋吾兄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "00e2a7e48f3c8056f216a918c7607756f5eb2356bfe9258432d158debc2a5c47"}

{"id": "p_41cbf79c8123696e", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 170, "text": "」延曰：「玄德在袁紹處，紹乃丞相讎人，如何容公去？", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "b69d59d4f76b6d574435591b8936d3b76f00fb059a3cbad1dca4baccad7cc327"}

{"id": "p_41fb8019dd501123", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 171, "text": "」公曰：「昔日曾言定來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "1c7631e947ff9f77f46508e406a65e41870c924583d63d34dc9d08573fb2e357"}

{"id": "p_dc06bb054675e5a5", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 172, "text": "」延曰：「今黃河渡口關隘，夏侯惇部將秦琪據守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "bb16501b56fda826fba7f94b3c1e50d8a55169e0f4b7a9b31f2ba023796f44a3"}

{"id": "p_eb212216aa3f0237", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 173, "text": "」公曰：「太守應付船隻，若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "ed95ac69249a6bcff3e79e3d9efbba1650ccad23f0eba15f72182b05d22e2dad"}

{"id": "p_3b67cd49e9774642", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 174, "text": "」延曰：「船隻雖有，不敢應付。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "e89a84387ed2b697f575b9484edc0dc1d46ab57de261239dda48f09d7d6e373f"}

{"id": "p_a4ea825c0a336c1b", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 175, "text": "」公曰：「我前者誅顏良、文醜，亦曾與足下解厄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "b469db8574e65c02dc059dc0d011bdcb16e18783f638b242f7d2165f440e2f61"}

{"id": "p_0b9ee97a5d5d992b", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 176, "text": "今日求一渡船而不與，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "775797082a50ab98d55bb6b891fa26f739ba0885a35b7b81e31a3a69bc0f7751"}

{"id": "p_35a47abfa68ba674", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 177, "text": "」延曰：「只恐夏侯惇知之，必然罪我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "fc36c8b6f4010d00b41e1f40d4c7c5d45816f29c84db9317c7d893d8a10a90d8"}

{"id": "p_ca34010fdc3d5d5d", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 178, "text": "」關公知劉延無用之人，遂自催車仗前進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "00069c438de66942a36177ceb68832b6f6929f85a67f3139734392550335db7d"}

{"id": "p_490a5eaa0d3d1245", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 179, "text": "到黃河渡口，秦琪引軍出問：「來者何人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "fcb76e47700f71f7ba57fc0cc45612e8983a1818a5af967ba011683ddf54fba2"}

{"id": "p_0c2972cdc3d9dc81", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 180, "text": "」關公曰：「漢壽亭侯關某也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "751dbb0085a3e48be33af32a5bb2e3bd78e959a25628c5a79988b34f4514fc69"}

{"id": "p_bd6e012f148ea1a2", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 181, "text": "」關公曰：「欲投河北去尋兄長劉玄德，敬來借渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "8d47bb4a9fbe23d25fd0141647c18d601879beaaa1b6d2260042fb7a1216c237"}

{"id": "p_6b6e556a65b3e218", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」琪曰：「丞相公文何在？", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "3f69e097aa0f2f86fb7b41bf382865e6b1655560e1f7063e988c88a7c933169b"}

{"id": "p_a543ec4226dc31d8", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 183, "text": "」公曰：「吾不受丞相節制，有甚公文？", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "c21d9d0a29226d533d5562e7d22441b75af0dea726f6a4330b121016f5c7fb47"}

{"id": "p_74459ac3e3aa9827", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 184, "text": "」琪曰：「吾奉夏侯將軍將令，守把關隘，你便插翅，也飛不過去！", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "ca392232860892546782947e5bff23c8a3069d8de553c55c5ac8e2f5655c06de"}

{"id": "p_1ffbd3280f2cfa76", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 185, "text": "」關公大怒曰：「你知我於路斬戮攔截者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "4d02f204307956d18f054e99e44c1ea389fc0d0ee827a0ee3c820b14a8376491"}

{"id": "p_43e6c50a9c1b72fc", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 186, "text": "」琪曰：「你只殺得無名下將，敢殺我麼？", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "28e1e5ddfef56da7f73b554415b8ce04cd47794214d11439809f9e913af5fb6d"}

{"id": "p_644c17e56fd633f2", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 187, "text": "」關公怒曰：「汝比顏良、文醜若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "76afc7e73dd48245cd3bdebca5e4e815bb1417d68b20d160c828eec56b7d4441"}

{"id": "p_5a7f06e3d45e5ee3", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 188, "text": "」秦琪大怒，縱馬提刀，直取關公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "d364cf82dd09a8002062f64e7d78644599299a076aac3371b6329ee101747c87"}

{"id": "p_7ab7b1132c90a4f8", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 189, "text": "二馬相交，只一合，關公刀起，秦琪頭落。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "3ab74fccb39245323950de93a3efd87967c85922a4ca8ac2958a7e44b209edfb"}

{"id": "p_271b8a4904dd9770", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 190, "text": "關公曰：「當吾者已死，餘人不必驚走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "9eea4b895c9e03970d2e6be41ffe290d265249c7429de199944264d616670e20"}

{"id": "p_116e74c484c03045", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 191, "text": "渡過黃河，便是袁紹地方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "3f44cf7d27d21ed61997ad7aea8de002fba18f5bd9c589b5817a46fef3694d59"}

{"id": "p_2bc62f9fa9392054", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 192, "text": "關公所歷關隘五處，斬將六員。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "903bf8d458577d728625ed90de0f445f9db9e48c725e40c001d4b0d6f78da0b2"}

{"id": "p_fd96ee002afb7326", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 193, "text": "::掛印封金辭漢相，尋兄遙望遠途還。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "6f1ce07eef0edec7f7a64fdc12f3d6de11cb8e8e869ca1d6340e30e990d67b7b"}

{"id": "p_011b78457aecd036", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 194, "text": "::馬騎赤兔行千里，刀偃青龍出五關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "ba0a49e046528652b5734b80387f1833d145160c87fcef74b30694aa0db401d9"}

{"id": "p_0aecba2580d808ac", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 195, "text": "::忠義慨然沖宇宙，英雄從此震江山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "9c80a96ee9ec0657044e42ac2de31cf370d68d952f99c18aaff573e06dfdc1b2"}

{"id": "p_0e07d323d8f221a1", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 196, "text": "::獨行斬將應無敵，今古留題翰墨間。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "9fe525d8e1bccaed4e6b48693002bff046e9618a9249d3db85164829c65e8e5a"}

{"id": "p_652d9f87fc989e0f", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 197, "text": "關公於馬上自歎曰：「吾非欲沿途殺人，奈事不得已也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "ea6160aa647811611612a1661781c212bcab76027aa628e3716897441844d344"}

{"id": "p_565c10f9fb5107d3", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 198, "text": "曹公知之，必以我為負恩之人矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "51cb26bf3bca690a98273598905c4652c80d3a67d28188e7a8e0589630a6c43d"}

{"id": "p_807c2bb213a25f9a", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 199, "text": "」正行間，忽見一騎自北而來，大叫：「雲長少住！", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "56f71e7a3db8166db290de8e036299c5a4326f88664a45adb89e6db516e60ab2"}

{"id": "p_e6382d7ead02847c", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 200, "text": "」關公勒馬視之，乃孫乾也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "146d3faff66da606f21e55fb242227ef3efe10c15b4baf0d866ddce56b795355"}

{"id": "p_b25701fabf822376", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 201, "text": "關公曰：「自汝南相別，一向消息若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "baa0148263051316427a6712ac0fc4f19b397aa0e796cb0abcf8e5546c518b3f"}

{"id": "p_30a9c703b31e5e21", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 202, "text": "」乾曰：「劉辟、龔都，自將軍回兵之後，復奪了汝南；遣某往河北結好袁紹，請玄德同謀破曹之計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "4f3f0ab40b2ba6b1c68f80c3328cc9399d4c53db3ca6a5323f294e06b5705359"}

{"id": "p_2a831f0c69b3a927", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 203, "text": "不想河北將士，各相妒忌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "b3f79597479ce0b8d3db75ef03f53aca051a0d051262f071dfb075dbed2dac93"}

{"id": "p_2cebf07ff109ff55", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 204, "text": "田豐尚囚獄中；沮授黜退不用；審配、郭圖各自爭權；袁紹多疑，主持不定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "de320993d77024e022aa1c525d26b88f42f55c8ffd6a0cba087a5567db0bd22d"}

{"id": "p_dd80fea8d77ad843", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 205, "text": "某與劉皇叔商議，先求脫身之計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "01a5d97ecd9794e0cf8294f98e4e8960cb561cf85999bcf6bbca0559626c31bf"}

{"id": "p_30d8824bf9a189e3", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 206, "text": "今皇叔已住汝南會合劉辟去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "b30d0f3187ffae351e09c4af34a7891fa05f49c852ff1abbfd24d63b88d3b0aa"}

{"id": "p_d39147c443b77185", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 207, "text": "恐將軍不知，反到袁紹處，或為所害，特遣某於路迎接將來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "d4ee80b6960c98c537186bb790da950587a88c5a33e1a0a98f03c0e887c7b6eb"}

{"id": "p_9b5f6a5ce2c2c32a", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 208, "text": "將軍可速往汝南與皇叔相會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "12dd385e9a15936bd48562715bec6d2db9e803c3625e0e04f9f808e515b50da7"}

{"id": "p_98fc13babd5cf0a3", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 209, "text": "孫乾備說：「袁紹二次欲斬皇叔，今幸脫身往汝南去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "9486c32469506b7b780b0c2a746ad36ae6abdcd38446d5a8acb400ba6c81a86f"}

{"id": "p_ee9465c15977a3dc", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 210, "text": "關公依言，不投河北去，逕取汝南來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "e29db31e2e401394a76c0c0cd2ba346a5de72e6e13f37ceb5dab7875df958ff0"}

{"id": "p_39ad61245c16518b", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 211, "text": "正行之間，背後塵埃起處，一彪人馬趕來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "054b54d1268e72a461155b972f28ff698128f972062b01716d5a69bc6958091e"}

{"id": "p_9968e2e1a9088076", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 212, "text": "當先夏侯惇大叫：「關某休走！", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "40aac72967f652404a53849987b9c6895f513896a40f81b8ccb57b618e185cde"}

{"id": "p_a660e56520f1bcc7", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 213, "text": "::六將阻關徒受死，一軍攔路復爭鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "97538942747e42ffec788f7ca07437495910152e6bf3d310690938870df87cbc"}

{"id": "p_80f24a5e3059c6bc", "source_id": "src_61cf685e9a58220c", "ordinal": 214, "text": "畢竟關公怎生脫身，且聽下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "31db0db8a666ccbb36aeed673ee0ae3190cee4c82a6c64f235ebe6ae5c9f986b"}

{"id": "p_46432d6cf07766cd", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說玄德訪孔明兩次不遇，欲再往訪之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "3eff295f4c06b7b83717b98c98d5a0912c43a73009fcb21ebe108bdb2d20f043"}

{"id": "p_d12f3899332b9210", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 1, "text": "關公曰：「兄長兩次親往拜謁，其禮太過矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "326c92662b77f394ca034795cd6ff7eb828be3345252f1d69986247e68a0cddb"}

{"id": "p_0031e491276e7b0e", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 2, "text": "想諸葛亮有虛名而無實學，故避而不敢見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "9d910a8a95290c0a16b0848703da445996be500a09e16b930f4876684519c847"}

{"id": "p_325d37f09ec9b414", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 3, "text": "昔齊桓公欲見東郭野人，五反而方得一面。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "0a20b0732468026acdaef731e2340559fc6cc4397648695feb81f664adc039b1"}

{"id": "p_b9eedc328f4f46e0", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 4, "text": "今番不須哥哥去；他如不來，我只用一條麻繩縛將來！", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "ae12a5a630c6d5b28c01a14b54f408925bffdecaf71ecdbd3754865a5bcf644c"}

{"id": "p_ad29254257478a5a", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 5, "text": "」玄德叱曰：「汝皆不聞周文王謁姜子牙之事乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "26759511ad74f4d826b3b693a01eca0494ae9cc923ead1dea76c72f7a36b0bae"}

{"id": "p_d8abf1be24b8f720", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 6, "text": "文王且如此敬賢，汝何太無禮！", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "5ca105e5d3baf9e66e5507fc229934263ff507d43d46147e71da9dec3089df17"}

{"id": "p_86fac9301b8266de", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 7, "text": "今番汝休去，我自與雲長去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "8c9fdea6b9d638795141c35912ded986331ba861838e722d4b35b1833f396ce3"}

{"id": "p_addaaecad59d90b2", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」飛曰：「既兩位哥哥都去，小弟如何落後？", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "30feb6db27226da95d8c873f51af9832334ede9fa5a6205d2aa4805a7c24bbd0"}

{"id": "p_1ffdfd951a002286", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」玄德曰：「汝若同往，不可失禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "65cf1795246f98ac4d61045a6a161e15a2f70f24cb33a78b8c4e9bfbe7a9519c"}

{"id": "p_223fa031c93c68f8", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 10, "text": "於是三人乘馬引從者住隆中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "b3624d7336097abafcb14d2814d57d9fe7638ec7646ddd5ee58a030e431f6026"}

{"id": "p_f97436567836e7b2", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 11, "text": "離草廬半里之外，玄德便下馬步行，正遇諸葛均。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "c6f718b93750eecf53830f2b9536ee7a862c2f179ed739e8a2d9af2f63b016ec"}

{"id": "p_ba5664ead56fa775", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 12, "text": "玄德忙施禮，問曰：「令兄在莊否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "3d13050aadb6d682bff7222bef42108f7f6407de2279f374773819850d2d30c5"}

{"id": "p_4b37eac4d45275ca", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 13, "text": "玄德曰：「今番僥倖，得見先生矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "2b880a9fbf737f829939bd89f0415cddc6f6edb68f6a83a4a94ce290a41667b3"}

{"id": "p_cd60624b6c2e8ba2", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」玄德曰：「彼各有事，豈可相強？", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "eae4628e6bbe440b390900035d9b8728cb55f598428386a34e1462df1cce2dee"}

{"id": "p_3745e8f31eef65bc", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 15, "text": "三人來到莊前叩門，童子開門出問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "723c2371b7d7d5a4b1a248c258c7c366238c34d47338274bd57b1cff283f54d0"}

{"id": "p_a025028a2ce4bf5e", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 16, "text": "玄德曰：「有勞仙童轉報，劉備專來拜見先生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "3ac00cc4bca29370d5bfc26d839c756e68939ecf4f4d768cd7ef5c5d8e08524d"}

{"id": "p_f602c1357ef48791", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 17, "text": "」童子曰：「今日先生雖在家，但現在草堂上晝寢未醒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "4cec288741727e6482ffa0b7d5a14cd24a9d3dbd077373f63ff7d6fdece7108d"}

{"id": "p_8d1e16458bc359b4", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 18, "text": "」玄德曰：「既如此，且休通報。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "332dc0e3636479988ec9e94aae72d3850dd4a850527caa99e73595f0e52642a7"}

{"id": "p_ea3c447e0e119c77", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」分付關、張二人，只在門首等著。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "a4b4b1aca9658403cf18f305393f75e2ecfebc352eae78e17afd744aeac8bfba"}

{"id": "p_f33c0bf72b84278b", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 20, "text": "玄德徐步而入，見先生仰臥於草堂几席之上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "cf5b9ad6dd4d857954937dd470c014f77d2f016b82e0954a53d90fc973197b3f"}

{"id": "p_9f2cdb67066ef77a", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 21, "text": "關、張在外立久，不見動靜，入見玄德，猶然侍立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "293837669c2c07da7f43186b35f0c64be3ec96ff18e67f02492142679b206053"}

{"id": "p_af1e7e8307be2153", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 22, "text": "張飛大怒，謂雲長曰：「這先生如何傲慢！", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "f243ffdc14ec7e636a38ba7bfdf7a0678c58b42cb6a9bad050e391247ccc2557"}

{"id": "p_95cbd368376a9ce2", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 23, "text": "見我哥哥侍立階下，他竟高臥，推睡不起！", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "ed8abdc7bff046655fd012fdf757c38c4cd403e62fb0c6a26600f9d9072d9219"}

{"id": "p_b7881e2b652604a1", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 24, "text": "等我去屋後放一把火，看他起不起！", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "5d48d02ba71347672d9bbfa0baaae3032e8473ae922b845985e8c0ac41a4c6eb"}

{"id": "p_04e4134acefd8473", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 25, "text": "玄德仍命二人出門外等候。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "269b877bbb9b3d1c84b58b5e2b12ac0cff58aa5553b82b6c92104cccabd40c57"}

{"id": "p_5cc75cc9c5d4e21d", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 26, "text": "望堂上時，見先生翻身將起，忽又朝裏壁睡著。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "cec5f63745b52c25d8d9084412637d79044728fc10841c3fedb164b3847bdc48"}

{"id": "p_d628b9d6e8be8bbf", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」又立了一個時辰，孔明纔醒，口吟詩曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "740ea7a51bdd4dfc7dd72afdc109aa0c0459cd5518f2e9f6f2c68f249f6f36ef"}

{"id": "p_81f4d881c81916c3", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 28, "text": "::大夢誰先覺，平生我自知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "99ecd030095655247a1ec65e1fc177b23afe00d0ee4321745ae491af6520d900"}

{"id": "p_6f8d82ac65da8691", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 29, "text": "::草堂春睡足，窗外日遲遲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "2020c7758a12703f0630f56c2f3470d4d527dd0f922e5239b1bb6601742ee4a7"}

{"id": "p_c3a2af9904aa2ba2", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 30, "text": "孔明吟罷，翻身問童子曰：「有俗客來否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "6d04c9a72945e07d551ea0e68cfb20ba1846a82fdb98dc4f19c217f7809bc19e"}

{"id": "p_2a7c7a0528843f12", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」童子曰：「劉皇叔在此，立候多時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "3a89a6ffb52cad43d2725cbdaebb771b8f9b7110aa87f6d85d11db2b2d7da3da"}

{"id": "p_0d83b4608a2f2482", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」孔明乃起身曰：「何不早報！", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "ccd86a2da666b8eabf3fae83a64a8aafcf33582a152be68798f4261c7740dc6c"}

{"id": "p_03cd3c5161937bd0", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 33, "text": "玄德見孔明身長八尺，面如冠玉，頭戴綸巾，身披鶴氅，飄飄然有神仙之概。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "91accd411e7e8fa1eab6a4cfcf8ebc4efa0bbf7fac98950a0ec1d8f29fb60025"}

{"id": "p_92dfbe60ed837e62", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 34, "text": "玄德下拜曰：「漢室末冑、涿郡愚夫，久聞先生大名，如雷貫耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "95523459236e24d01ac5b165aa73b85beba70643b8b1fdd60c062c0a24d00466"}

{"id": "p_435c9a8e3dcff675", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 35, "text": "昨兩次晉謁，不得一見，已書賤名於文几，未審得入覽否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "31a8df2a2d20527cf61011721878465bfb188f8d5efc485263f9b13b0aeb910d"}

{"id": "p_e1086ecc3905c07c", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 36, "text": "」孔明曰：「南陽野人，疏懶性成，屢蒙將軍枉臨，不勝愧赧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "4bd27a8cbf2aa6eeaf263c199feb5a04ccd8fecd33a4f8bdeab36b2496e24df5"}

{"id": "p_1e0b5309c5276d98", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 37, "text": "茶罷，孔明曰：「昨觀書意，足見將軍憂民憂國之心；但恨亮年幼才疏，有誤下問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "d759155d6830d3ce84f2eb7e08d87c27cb9c732026485a31c6b0bce39bc867c1"}

{"id": "p_979bb1a36965533e", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」玄德曰：「司馬德操之言，徐元直之語，豈虛談哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "a47a233c2dc178984318ffe424473bb906326fc0e4dd0103581a138f9da9a436"}

{"id": "p_43d2073b8feb3385", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 39, "text": "望先生不棄鄙賤，曲賜教誨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "5439f29b64f4d39fb91ff4c868f88099aaf598764980d43ea154ffda95497392"}

{"id": "p_a9adb15a8ed77190", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」孔明曰：「德操、元直，世之高士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "0b1df42a3e27bbb5ae201e814dd64b5ae68c53e3f7d0756e20d24712f1c7e086"}

{"id": "p_801645e61cf8fb2b", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 41, "text": "亮乃一耕夫耳，安敢談天下事？", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "f838ddd8a108c37d8943278dea57746fbd1443e911d7870283d50838743d60b6"}

{"id": "p_b256e3bd7e203ceb", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 42, "text": "將軍奈何舍美玉而求頑石乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "190bbbb43472b4299b76cb123952c2e36d59af83b41530e0b075434b18dbbfa8"}

{"id": "p_324552b0d6f17080", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 43, "text": "」玄德曰：「大丈夫抱經世奇才，豈可空老於林泉之下？", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "5e87eb38f12288a587dc2e335c96c9368e90a41e34206cfc64753970ebb672da"}

{"id": "p_86d2a5311740b4ee", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 44, "text": "願先生以天下蒼生為念，開備愚魯而賜教。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "acad1ed3cfe062e8a55489971df0a777777045bc12bbaf94d7956be5f8f870f7"}

{"id": "p_b025cdc2bcdcdc0e", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」孔明笑曰：「願聞將軍之志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "e1c86f5b6a5905b6eb144f70e32561a03b543cf89f5fb41d32087a85955e0d40"}

{"id": "p_a2da99039a009f56", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 46, "text": "」玄德屏人促席而告曰：「漢室傾頹，奸臣竊命，備不量力，欲伸大義於天下，而智術淺短，迄無所就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "2e1efa6fe6228f872578709cce0b7761747ad9f460cc7d869352a5b97e73bdae"}

{"id": "p_1e90cf38793eb99a", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 47, "text": "惟先生開其愚而拯厄，實為萬幸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "d02009ab6a3db5ab30226bf20014f787ca6addbf2b82656fa0a62bea0de43bb9"}

{"id": "p_efc9115f8e5ff949", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 48, "text": "孔明曰：「自董卓造逆以來，天下豪傑並起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "44ca669cae0a8ca2a0fce1056ab137c0eb58c4409b9514da93bdbeab2f2edd0c"}

{"id": "p_bb5ae4eda6ae7b48", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 49, "text": "曹操勢不及袁紹，而竟能克紹者，非惟天時，抑亦人謀也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "9444779238dcde1cd7d1810badb5049f58744bc4f2789b9c9e9e19f4caa44d62"}

{"id": "p_7d09f7aca5b672be", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 50, "text": "今操已擁百萬之眾，挾天子以令諸侯，此誠不可與爭鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "82d8bd5f39d7c4a08b84b624e835638c80800e87b12f3837851b0c6029afede4"}

{"id": "p_c87a774bce8b5797", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 51, "text": "孫權據有江東，已歷三世，國險而民附，此可用為援，而不可圖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "3ebacbaee9dfbc90f9f7b1b46bb84621280d82569c9fde0c31889ce6dbadfbe2"}

{"id": "p_4093c4064ef6a399", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 52, "text": "荊州北據漢、沔，利盡南海，東連吳會，西通巴、蜀，此用武之地，非其主不能守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "7d0e03eda83dfab0b7034d72bfd64d92f4968f9b61a33c1e5bae75970846a222"}

{"id": "p_2739afcf0f347cfd", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 53, "text": "是殆天所以資將軍，將軍豈可棄乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "dbd4ad05b9941e903fc06eea018cb12df3d909c641a11fff440f86dbfd521dbf"}

{"id": "p_7f5b4f9ce0911e4c", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 54, "text": "益州險塞，沃野千里，天府之國，高祖因之以成帝業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "eb480d0f7fad3c1a9526b31a15c434d9fed942e23b5f2ac92154b98574d3bf3f"}

{"id": "p_cd35a44dc6e7b03c", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 55, "text": "今劉璋闇弱，民殷國富，而不知存恤，智能之士，思得明君。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "c178aa2cc52f76cf5aacfcf6c0cad75f8d0e03eb01cddb03dc46c8d96594fffa"}

{"id": "p_5a5edddf834dafa7", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 56, "text": "將軍既帝室之冑，信義著於四海，總攬英雄，思賢如渴，若跨有荊、益，保其巖阻，西和諸戎，南撫彝、越，外結孫權，內修政理；待天下有變，則命一上將，將荊州之兵，以向宛、洛；將軍身率益州之眾，以出秦川，百姓有不簞食壼漿以迎將軍者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "9417ac58efc04f821e69173266ffa5579ead37c5c320832b6c9090cde4f952a9"}

{"id": "p_faa76fa9f8c801ec", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 57, "text": "誠如是，則大業可成，漢室可興矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "71c2ce4a48b003180cef18bd0ba27b8181b085c3a5878188084fcfaa5a9fd354"}

{"id": "p_b72426faa22845c5", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」言罷，命童子取出畫一軸，挂於中堂，指謂玄德曰：「此西川五十四州之圖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "ff3d1c825fef61fe18423b854e893dec9828746048894b36ee4690abf2ce5919"}

{"id": "p_25c31d38fa505766", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 59, "text": "將軍欲成霸業，北讓曹操占天時，南讓孫權占地利，將軍可占人和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "4802e1f1644253c730bbaceccebdbf4fecdcbcc2931d7120e0c65654bdc33076"}

{"id": "p_e171947f1f3c7f94", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 60, "text": "先取荊州為家，後即取西川建基業，以成鼎足之勢，然後可圖中原也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "ebfe3fe0e80f30d5c95fd7aaa9bbea8f0ca69873919e44fcb71bd7d8f608249c"}

{"id": "p_6a5e2a87114948a2", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 61, "text": "玄德聞言，避席拱手謝曰：「先生之言，頓開茅塞，使備如撥雲霧而睹青天；但荊州劉表、益州劉璋，皆漢室宗親，備安忍奪之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "3822860a83061d0221313251e310a5eff441069be59ed5324e4dce35bdd9aa4c"}

{"id": "p_b31c7a70d162d21d", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」孔明曰：「亮夜觀天象，劉表不久人世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "3668beef86dbb1ae6b3e836d7bdcf1229e2de1a1310deb1145498ad74f71f28b"}

{"id": "p_f53ef39a28a43a9e", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 63, "text": "劉璋非立業之主，久後必歸將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "73d32d7b61dcac73351376b4c12dfe49acda25ed2267f3011353ad5a8295fca9"}

{"id": "p_58d3d39545da7951", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 64, "text": "只這一席話，乃孔明未出茅廬，已知三分天下，真萬古人不及也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "24ea923179ec856a3bb6a61b97f5df751deccb38e72344d0a27c7d947f7367f7"}

{"id": "p_a27387ef7e0c7358", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 65, "text": "::豫州當日歎孤窮，何幸南陽有臥龍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "fa1952f3354ab80796f8482aa9b0fd55b5797048ceea72d7812037a72990e7e7"}

{"id": "p_11cda5440f92b518", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 66, "text": "::欲識他年分鼎處，先生笑指畫圖中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "3218951a6949b0fdcc34021578162267920711c272cab83bd5985da404aab95a"}

{"id": "p_db01d2b183449c1b", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 67, "text": "玄德拜請孔明曰：「備雖名微德薄，願先生不棄鄙賤，出山相助。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "5aa81010d753d90c2cc71dac0c009eeee08f11448840ae6d30760fb628b6891c"}

{"id": "p_6c4fdc0e1d8574e0", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 68, "text": "」孔明曰：「亮久樂耕鋤，懶於應世，不能奉命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "ece9123651754ab97b083e922d19a7bdeb693d6e17500456f239470f7a07db17"}

{"id": "p_44f9ccf08662b7a0", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」玄德泣曰：「先生不出，如蒼生何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "345f61097dbcd8fc0b44b8411500610e972ffa75de03cf4f180cddb2e446073b"}

{"id": "p_9bcd8c0e78e58b9a", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 70, "text": "」言畢，淚沾袍袖，衣襟盡濕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "848ce128c2934b8181df3fc4239de06eca44fdcec1034ba76f163f5de3b5652e"}

{"id": "p_13d86141495aa284", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 71, "text": "孔明見其意甚誠，乃曰：「將軍既不相棄，願效犬馬之勞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "7729a94689e31a593877a508f5d5396f0b283b7d8c6478c5301d84d20223cc22"}

{"id": "p_412fa16aadd7a4cd", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 72, "text": "玄德大喜，遂命關、張入拜獻金帛禮物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "cbf702497e827c0dc7e1f7bbf2755959cc0fa6c0e652514f8a20c73b3e196abc"}

{"id": "p_0040c2ecceb71b73", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 73, "text": "玄德曰：「此非聘大賢之禮，但表劉備寸心耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "627d6e8f2226751f8a850d7147868bb553bdf50809a91253f01fa9a9848a77ad"}

{"id": "p_53f184a1f0da0426", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 74, "text": "於是玄德等在莊中共宿一宵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "f2605548f830bfda64e08a76b98c5271d2437c27b5b8ae271866a4b90b40e783"}

{"id": "p_7cd7e2a7b7433638", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 75, "text": "次日，諸葛均回，孔明囑付曰：「吾受劉皇叔三顧之恩，不容不出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "483009629f1edf7fdf66f233f7889bb02cec4477350ca54eac67bc0a56082d40"}

{"id": "p_fa2715a559f9e4dc", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 76, "text": "汝可躬耕於此，勿得荒蕪田畝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "c60e160f8f7a87f0316390be0e298d1d5d584a9468b18cfeb25ac73cdaa4f8b7"}

{"id": "p_07bbc69dd93b2758", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 77, "text": "待吾功成之日，即當歸隱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "213208822f97c8644f0630d31d1bc06cdcaba2e598c7652533b999541d6f5ff0"}

{"id": "p_6503a54995b1aa7c", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 78, "text": "::身未升騰思退步，功成應憶去時言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "c1814538e99207aae338d836012c170b6b49ae5220d48fc12cb1863d3e239ff9"}

{"id": "p_a9cf94576761fce4", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 79, "text": "::只因先主丁寧後，星落秋風五丈原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "bff29de60833efa8c9fd3ecfe13f8fe006d2822df22ac57b6c86a29c20b1efc0"}

{"id": "p_feb35d5788df20f0", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 80, "text": "::高皇手提三尺雪，芒碭白蛇夜流血。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "4df49dbf3bb34c4ccd487468fc9aec73487bc82b9480955d90d6fb94599ab8e0"}

{"id": "p_9c13e4d1ea0ff708", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 81, "text": "::平秦滅楚入咸陽，二百年前幾斷絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "a6bca949b4c241a796ed547eb8e96ee4810743b5d63d194391000b0039b5a73d"}

{"id": "p_81931e82e4f46e56", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 82, "text": "::大哉光武興洛陽，傳至桓靈又崩裂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "0f01ca9364cd2485ec79a39704b5d8631f4382f27ba9c725edbfed76d547f123"}

{"id": "p_1970bafc8837ca76", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 83, "text": "::獻帝遷都幸許昌，紛紛四海生豪傑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "28d471b9c4d218f605f34a0d2d899ea8ba56b5e21c41704a4851eb056e0395e0"}

{"id": "p_07e77a9d5e02c4b4", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 84, "text": "::曹操專權得天時，江東孫氏開鴻業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "b4cb2203f9a2ea8a77f8d1e34850860c8f2b03b4c5fd2f26e6cd839259088124"}

{"id": "p_b74599a3af603b93", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 85, "text": "::孤窮玄德走天下，獨居新野愁民危。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "1ed984fccb438e2a20a311194ce8ab4cbc7ecb4770f6b94364de17e0736baf2c"}

{"id": "p_5a0b52db41345598", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 86, "text": "::南陽臥龍有大志，腹內雄兵分正奇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "4ecf7f9ba17938081cb60093a734b6ff5d64ece803a053380c03bbc706c82e57"}

{"id": "p_c8bc5c138812ea97", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 87, "text": "::只因徐庶臨行語，茅廬三顧心相知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "236b55292a23a0a6516c114760d75f56955d90ef23c1ec481b006e5b39befe96"}

{"id": "p_c9163fe165420ffe", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 88, "text": "::先生爾時年三九，收拾琴書離隴畝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "275ec8fe9e5766ee729d32e6d744fe4379bb1ff35ebd219cf028aa86a27a6bb5"}

{"id": "p_e1d825678476caa6", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 89, "text": "::先取荊州後取川，大展經綸補天手。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "d6c0721eca8b08fdec9aa7d6c322ab9d273d3a99b3b01cabb026d53a7d6877b9"}

{"id": "p_6a69a3701fc56009", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 90, "text": "::縱棋舌上鼓風雷，談笑胸中換星斗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "80f69fc2447602c3880e2cdc9d0b753927eddc92ebe1c5e19aa81395936f46ad"}

{"id": "p_feb3decfc400a293", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 91, "text": "::龍驤虎視安乾坤，萬古千秋名不朽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "72bfd84a9c055d012c0cbe2f932ea106e5b032225b7be0962b9eab07d3066885"}

{"id": "p_b8d54934ba20c538", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 92, "text": "玄德等三人別了諸葛均，與孔明同歸新野。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "d17d693d6268ef2ba3ce544ba18f221f5d631782ecc766d1ab94133a01ef8f22"}

{"id": "p_4ef271ed055f4861", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 93, "text": "玄德待孔明如師，食則同桌，寢則同榻，終日共論天下之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "10adef9198af739e923df2cac6a45f06971c36ec9e6d6da36f3ef8c882f25134"}

{"id": "p_f7c743be51939af6", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 94, "text": "孔明曰：「曹操於冀州作玄武池以練水軍，必有侵江南之意，可密令人過江探聽虛實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "d93d99409bb6475cfccd0d79cef73b2ec3053313dba30877e73793e97cc72a9f"}

{"id": "p_6febffe8142a5f66", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」玄德從之，使人往江東探聽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "8925378da6a3af4333754735e0e2072e3ab16df6d21a67993fc6a9dd9eb2fc0d"}

{"id": "p_cb20c988cbe4f358", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 96, "text": "卻說孫權自孫策死後，據住江東，承父兄基業，廣納賢士，開賓館於吳會，命顧雍、張紘延接四方賓客。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "35ecfadb0e42eada5738ef2fccbb61fb999ec28bb45e0884bb8e6ef2b716eb01"}

{"id": "p_098bb005cdbd57a7", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 97, "text": "時有會稽闞澤，字德潤；彭城嚴畯，字曼才；沛縣薛綜，字敬文；汝南程秉，字德樞；吳郡朱桓，字休穆；陸績，字公紀；吳人張溫，字惠恕；會稽駱統，字公緒；烏程吳粲，字孔休：此數人皆至江東。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "dd3eaf9237645298eac9511590217fc6099a0fbd13a526316b4ad6f12f60d2ec"}

{"id": "p_b04afa2eb9fde134", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 98, "text": "又得良將數人，乃汝陽呂蒙，字子明；吳郡陸遜，字伯言；瑯琊徐盛，字文嚮；東郡潘璋，字文珪；廬江丁奉，字承淵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "80bdc744422835255142fb3663e35de6f5ba3b7ba1f7142b1565660ad1567b51"}

{"id": "p_e2c100c91d584e61", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 99, "text": "建安七年，曹操破袁紹，遣使往江東，命孫權遣子入朝隨駕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "cb1bb57ed075546dba1ee046243fdd2af928a08012665af604b325658f59da33"}

{"id": "p_6ac8dfa2f17871b0", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 100, "text": "吳太夫人命周瑜、張昭等面議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "a29005c0e572a8fb44d65dcc28975f65def16c85a95457dd1b7736426faac043"}

{"id": "p_07b1100b69c5263e", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 101, "text": "張昭曰：「操欲令我遣子入朝，是牽制諸侯之法也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "9b942a5d9721297f361d649703e49fcc2ec45e59993881164b7b5d13921bf533"}

{"id": "p_052d6a1c0bd93c6d", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 102, "text": "然若不令去，恐其興兵下江東，勢必危矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "d500ba3bd4447d92ca2cf34c149a32af174a0daa96b85d51db8588134049ac33"}

{"id": "p_225b845665ff1061", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 103, "text": "」周瑜曰：「將軍承父兄遣業，兼六郡之眾，兵精糧足，將士用命，有何逼迫而欲送質於人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "cdd04a7acad19050c5ce29169980048d4af8f68229f251b3b22eccd36a1aeb59"}

{"id": "p_7cf928835fd64cbe", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 104, "text": "質一入，不得不與曹氏連和；彼有命召，不得不往；如此則見制於人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "c430510af1617c96a826077ed669a78b5b8aaa5e49ceac4806154cd3b8c1bf4f"}

{"id": "p_f5fdca5b9d894e2b", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 105, "text": "不如勿遣，徐觀其變，別以良策禦之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "7899c23b8f40de5f621190b2e359d37d5ddd96ed59a51b447ea8b2b6f334f25a"}

{"id": "p_2b6025b1c464a15d", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」吳太夫人曰：「公瑾之言是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "064228fce3e22fe92220a4d3d91fb3fc682a1f6db283613ef752fe14f8e52847"}

{"id": "p_298d4483c7dc1381", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 107, "text": "」權遂從其言，謝使者，不遣子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "eeebe2521cc241d421e25388cbae36dd6e6f9822bad4dfb4230cd3265c0bd842"}

{"id": "p_eb1fe75c7c52e27c", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 108, "text": "但正值北方未寧，無暇南征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "ff525b97f96725026e496b19dcd39eb8b3bb50099f1168704a340996b7e5b17a"}

{"id": "p_d2ff6dc1bd67e6de", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 109, "text": "建安八年十一月，孫權引兵伐黃祖，戰於大江之中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "cb738db1fad5d5cff2901bc90dc602f40fa3f9f846fd07a8037dd7730d93fe43"}

{"id": "p_799e8c6ae04ff7f2", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 110, "text": "權部將凌操，輕舟當先，殺人夏口，被黃祖部將甘寧一箭射死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "d4ce7cd4544ab8d4acd7884a1471ce8f50577f2779a7cb7118b217369ddaa877"}

{"id": "p_c0276b738486a279", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 111, "text": "凌操子凌統，時年方十五歲，奮力往奪父屍而歸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "aadcebb05c47dad2542a8c57f11b1ee1dc7f4db46f8b4f15807d6b8cbac171b2"}
