{"id": "p_8de6fcccf801f5fa", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 112, "text": "權見風色不利，收軍還東吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "ea79ca11ba36c21e73b43c79bf9cb839c89dc360f2bc50a6b8bce51c75164867"}

{"id": "p_5a493842855104fe", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 113, "text": "卻說孫權弟孫翊為丹陽太守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "014a1408951492d71402ccbaa8a9afc1fc1cabbca1279749d646c57505400076"}

{"id": "p_9667cb44fba74677", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 114, "text": "翊性剛好酒，醉後嘗鞭撻士卒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "644d9c7cfdc4801a73136102a035403ef8f418d42cd762123b3d8a727bd2f518"}

{"id": "p_2273b75be3804702", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 115, "text": "丹陽督將媯覽、郡丞戴員二人，常有殺翊之心，乃與翊從人邊洪結為心腹，共謀殺翊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "ba2dfc7d6a58b502a568435e7068adb7371811d5034a96258c013780625e42ae"}

{"id": "p_da08ee59f8f7dcb4", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 116, "text": "翊妻徐氏美而慧，極善卜易；是日卜一卦，其象大凶，勸翊勿出會客。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "b449d84ea8a0f7f829e210a274801eb28b574cd26b15d5365e2f4e2bdaa1c352"}

{"id": "p_5e0433d4cd9890f1", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 117, "text": "至晚席散，邊洪帶刀跟出門外，即抽刀砍死孫翊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "e521afc8c75cf5365ca2afa691cde598d5d39a96d8c97c835aef39abfabc2917"}

{"id": "p_37bfc2791e894c96", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 118, "text": "媯覽、戴員乃歸罪邊洪，斬之於市。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "e8b9c987598fd767df416303b38392b415d19630ef95f7cae22acb7d63879ba2"}

{"id": "p_7a8d3b29078d9830", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 119, "text": "媯覽見徐氏美貌，乃謂之曰：「吾為汝夫報仇，汝當從我；不從則死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "f91a1b301e4ead8bc6097e9a562605e8bd08ca92f722c9cb152c8a5395928a00"}

{"id": "p_c5c580e2b46016a2", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 120, "text": "」徐氏曰：「夫死未幾，不忍便相從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "d8ced4846a6e325516769b87b7dd63734293a5c945db9035ec2480d928bf14a3"}

{"id": "p_14664c2688ff57fe", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 121, "text": "可待至晦日，設祭除服，然後成親未遲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "ee8b5f541a76fb94130864a3340578435e15782e0b6b3dce89615727bb270b32"}

{"id": "p_5231c75d70b6e1ee", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 122, "text": "徐氏乃密召孫翊心腹舊將孫高、傅嬰二人入府，泣告曰：「先夫在日，常言二公忠義。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "d33fc18ad34d7f75cb59bc9c6b6c4e2529078e3c50b23c184a9c9aa3c2bed1c4"}

{"id": "p_a2e7f9cc07b817c9", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 123, "text": "今媯、戴二賊，謀殺我夫，只歸罪邊洪，將我家資童婢盡皆分去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "28589acff9e21c4dc1ff415c1f731211228943bdf816cf251300586abdc57a94"}

{"id": "p_9cf2d5d7b2897eae", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 124, "text": "媯覽又欲強占妾身，妾已詐許之，以安其心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "cd81129e8b3d3e9ca451d121b8ceff7112406d35d30c956cd99112718d314a85"}

{"id": "p_cbdbfe0d02796607", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 125, "text": "二將軍可差人星夜報知吳侯，一面設密計以圖二賊，雪此仇辱，生死啣恩！", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "be72d9296c6a024d2ce8cf488e6eafc3f7bf003d09461f302f8ec57196a1ced8"}

{"id": "p_65228258a1c759b4", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 126, "text": "孫高、傅嬰皆泣曰：「我等平日感府君恩遇，今日所以不即死難者，正欲為復仇計耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "6fd5c6cba5d7b910685685105b70976370eee3d7c3ced796780237fc3fa26a06"}

{"id": "p_180ac6826676e4e4", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 127, "text": "於是密遣心腹使者往報孫權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "34c2ca6fbe8c6e92a8960a11e12eb6721d8003a2abb04fda58e113f29a3c8d83"}

{"id": "p_79356cae68614f9e", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 128, "text": "至晦日，徐氏先召孫、傅二人，伏於密室幃幕之中，然後設祭於堂上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "9cc4522504cf5323683e7289120eb9893bbbcce92a5c02093b90c18438ca9f9f"}

{"id": "p_ca4091869cf3a75d", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 129, "text": "祭畢，即除去孝服，沐浴薰香，濃妝豔裹，言笑自若。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "60ddb0d92d43ab436b93b5a1e78c131934da6a0dd1ee28a14e41af093cc13d46"}

{"id": "p_ca746f3058248db2", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 130, "text": "至夜，徐氏遣婢妾請覽入府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "a3eb6a290942fb9c1c5c57f215cd730288460ec5bbc1c937315b3ce75cae7731"}

{"id": "p_4a377c9cfcd5abbc", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 131, "text": "飲既醉，徐氏乃邀覽入密室。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "0d72900461261576fd644b5d16c78230c3bf3c574c9577f4e12c0bd9c387e484"}

{"id": "p_5f4dba6594c952b3", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 132, "text": "徐氏大呼曰：「孫、傅二將軍何在？", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "6be580ed26382a9b7790df867f85974098d742e2d9c6d646bbebdbc42964750e"}

{"id": "p_52a22c60aee98de4", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 133, "text": "」二人即從幃幕中持刀躍出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "f8be66a0550aef52b571a9a37bc0efc356ee6ef6d505cdaf16b678b4f6d56a8c"}

{"id": "p_9f1612df1e0de816", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 134, "text": "媯覽措手不及，被傅嬰一刀砍倒在地，孫高再復一刀，登時殺死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "73a30aea06978c84424094616d579bdfb03ef184a19d5ef50123bca44cfd141b"}

{"id": "p_0e3cd7b81dd64f2a", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 135, "text": "員入府來，至堂中，亦被孫、傳二將所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "13d9cf9d2b5d7ef63b832904469452dfd72bbac7f6d069f1e9e3982670ae4f55"}

{"id": "p_12f72d4092922c6e", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 136, "text": "一面使人誅戮二賊家小，及其餘黨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "16b6ede439246e56c013296c6fb77d936dfa8758d96d7f8c5d187ac96923f234"}

{"id": "p_cc74cec3771a7d39", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 137, "text": "徐氏遂重穿孝服，將媯覽、戴員首級，祭於孫翊靈前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "84c260ad50601f222135f57f2152dc7cdc9bc94f80f1ae13efc0176615efb74b"}

{"id": "p_04eec5350ff2bd28", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 138, "text": "不一日，孫權自領軍馬至丹陽，見徐氏已殺媯、戴二賊，乃封孫高、傅嬰為牙門將，令守丹陽，取徐氏歸家養老。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "03dede5ef8fe4f92e03579b4204024749d633cbae85fcb47ab4bae3c745cef8b"}

{"id": "p_c871f54b79dbb51f", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 139, "text": "::才節雙全世所無，姦回一旦受摧鋤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "e7d83ca1fd476886b39c6090d4b13ea5a1833275aeff36455b87d5dde0f04319"}

{"id": "p_308006832e70d22a", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 140, "text": "::庸臣從賊忠臣死，不及東吳女丈夫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "320c08e66ae6c6837caeb45073e69ce0e22fe548d033a133bfa892f0d182b0c2"}

{"id": "p_d034a4079edecdb3", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 141, "text": "且說東吳各處山賊，盡皆平復。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "f5140843b32308dfb4f67c5dd003bd65e6cfa23c2c09cb716a0b5418fb2d615f"}

{"id": "p_12120061e6b8e850", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 142, "text": "大江之中，有戰船七千餘隻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "b9ed1de52d16a388fe26719e637d7bddc407a7689b1636627ecc1495f12a7dbe"}

{"id": "p_d57c1dd25f5dd4bf", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 143, "text": "孫權拜周瑜為大都督，總統江東水陸軍馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "0e4ec1f5f850edbe7422ae6c70af97ed7b3b9a91a9f63c0b507017daec4d0497"}

{"id": "p_9b5352dfda6fb180", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 144, "text": "建安十二年，冬十月，權母吳太夫人病危，召周瑜、張昭二人至，謂曰：「吾本吳人，幼亡父母，與弟吳景徙居越中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "8e039df024d14effe51396e993ca69f612ec7be37a8a5d8cd12e27a8122e6a2d"}

{"id": "p_6372040a7665fbc4", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 145, "text": "長子策生時，吾夢月入懷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "d04cc07e1958647c20e14387256ac43052b10c8ce89558966ea2ff0a63492b81"}

{"id": "p_38b84857ff8c5496", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 146, "text": "後生次子權，又夢日入懷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "e6801216f3b991f1ee0c3f3bf590aa5b81f061a5ea7b4d2c63115ce7c939c70f"}

{"id": "p_28561edf16b84d88", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 147, "text": "卜者云：『夢日月入懷者，其子必貴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "fda120dd1ad1749161e99dd94c2ccc7e8dedded1b0475575d5eab63752e2151e"}

{"id": "p_5640a4730dbdf392", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 148, "text": "』不幸策早喪，今將江東基業付權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "8c296d36707c82ea5d9f52d2a2704a55d5116862dcdda15f46cc17f43bb092c4"}

{"id": "p_118cafa1dfd48e5f", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 149, "text": "望公等同心助之，吾死不朽矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "5b6173e174323b3845478fcf95cdd70b148f57444767c204f132bad008b11aa1"}

{"id": "p_39f10d2603c7f24c", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」又囑權曰：「汝事子布、公瑾以師傅之禮，不可怠慢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "4db9a66ca76b502ac499e1a4ccf042379f7bc2db71da3691bfff7faa9d177565"}

{"id": "p_7298cbbbe1388614", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 151, "text": "吾妹與我共嫁汝父，則亦汝之母也，吾死之後，事吾妹如事我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "450b9be5d02eac0e7ebc0461e0733a7cfbb962b74e7ebdb197e5a6f85fd118b3"}

{"id": "p_3addaa06bc592859", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 152, "text": "汝妹亦當恩養，擇佳婿以嫁之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "339d5cad603b5f8db696ba31432e975ba9e8978977bda6748ffdc72347966f0c"}

{"id": "p_b6829b8de3c90170", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 153, "text": "孫權哀哭，具喪葬之禮，自不必說。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "95f58329eaba18365bfc75e13b45a8dc65043cc565e613478464cee2b34b462d"}

{"id": "p_f51aef3a451d2033", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 154, "text": "至來年春，孫權商議欲伐黃祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "75b8b70817ccc1bd1f5b3d0e56e6d20d44a7cab05906f2d5534f0ea53220d7b8"}

{"id": "p_8b85bd09ebc137a8", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 155, "text": "張昭曰：「居喪未及期年，不可動兵．」周瑜曰：「報仇雪恨，何待期年？", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "d37118f63cd6ffd9cc83fd40d5d9b2ecc95b330a3a3756fc54bc60f9c318ec60"}

{"id": "p_37178c4b7779613c", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 156, "text": "適北平都尉呂蒙入見，告權曰：「某把龍湫水口，忽有黃祖部將甘寧來降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "965659b41482199dd154094b3a0d9597afadf4e6c3c77593343fd73ad6a21f43"}

{"id": "p_b4605cd91b70367b", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 157, "text": "寧字興霸，巴郡臨江人也；頗通書史，有氣力，好遊俠；嘗招合亡命，縱橫於江湖之中；腰懸銅鈴，人聽鈴聲，盡皆避之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "a0d9d48fb4dfa535d92aee439294c773482f73652c8c07f1ff8140af8a3cef9b"}

{"id": "p_4596d2f6fe429cbd", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 158, "text": "又嘗以西川錦作帆幔，時人皆稱為『錦帆賊』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "6486ca5d2d3f729998f7e42f9a07d360e330d5ef8efc4197af8b43286d11125a"}

{"id": "p_db945f51a55e5104", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 159, "text": "後悔前非，改行從善，引眾投劉表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "678e791027a0b32239f773dccdc4df18f37a272d5234e270b0afc71d61a24b8f"}

{"id": "p_3f0cb8e43bb423b6", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 160, "text": "見表不能成事，即欲來投東吳，卻被黃祖留住在夏口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "94216a2000be0dd5f99286b3b7a222960e6bb07bc6624cf2fa6b9ab5a00ae50e"}

{"id": "p_9a91829ab1ab05fd", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 161, "text": "「前東吳破祖時，祖得甘寧之力，救回夏口；乃待寧甚薄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "c6ae526a1ca86494a935a754970e704ee5f937c87a123bfae07bf9fb71a4058e"}

{"id": "p_bec305107e31310d", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 162, "text": "祖曰：『寧乃劫江之賊，豈可重用？", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "b3e07ce6a6cc2ff1bf8e5989704d06e1f472a48c557e4c6af2ef95cf655a44e3"}

{"id": "p_b6ac8e8871aa7cc0", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 163, "text": "蘇飛知其意，乃置酒邀寧到家，謂之曰：『吾薦公數次，奈主公不能用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "608dde11a40349e07500b141ad391d54e9accf21456bfe2b397cee53f58ddc64"}

{"id": "p_570cdf4917a95319", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 164, "text": "日月逾邁，人生幾何，宜自遠圖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "61121ad3a0db87c58e7e7a93441313ece4d6b2a869a55fc81d1cbb2094f0c7ac"}

{"id": "p_0559c2c0629fef3c", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 165, "text": "吾當保公為鄂縣長，自作去就之計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "c1f0e5ea1f32fd9454a8c3688380a017f0bdd8ff23199fa7b084a909cb9c491d"}

{"id": "p_19b2446aff44125f", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 166, "text": "』寧因此得過夏口，欲投江東，恐江東恨其救黃祖殺凌操之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "d994065864f19560c05d9d2e1990a8419a7ad1e2c65c6dcf951366583747e71e"}

{"id": "p_ccade08ff7e80802", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 167, "text": "某具言主公求賢若渴，不記舊恨；況各為其主，又何恨焉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "9c18daf2b7dfae1bdbce218feb4ed5c18efccccae086ca1ecfaa1a786f7ca4dd"}

{"id": "p_5829f562c8e66cf2", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 168, "text": "寧欣然引眾渡江，來見主公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "8831564b2744ed65744bdd50f4a1ad49f0206acadce8b2177c4b23770c8e098a"}

{"id": "p_9877631169fca0cf", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 169, "text": "孫權大喜曰：「吾得興霸，破黃祖必矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "109681e94ea5646e40c70fa3d322575df186dbfe8001018b74106ce31beadbc9"}

{"id": "p_9595cab515e5e1b8", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 170, "text": "參拜已畢，權曰：「興霸來此，大獲我心，豈有記恨之理？", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "4c0bd0f232f580424adf88c540554c0b0092d565593fdc00045a24fecea64e5f"}

{"id": "p_0b8421fc255a5868", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 171, "text": "」寧曰：「今漢祚日危，曹操終必纂竊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "d99e8b25a1339cb68c207bf5ea14126c1d9523bd1d1af5f6d0c341594674175d"}

{"id": "p_da6b006c9007d350", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 172, "text": "劉表無遠慮，其子又愚劣，不能承業傳基。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "d7a4bf44ff7353a28995fe6aff945fe814bb62e8c22727dfa17800081a9a5be9"}

{"id": "p_0ac07fe33ab51c36", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 173, "text": "祖今年老昏邁，務於貨利；侵刻吏民，人心皆怨；戰具不修，軍無法律。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "a9ff9625f644a431fcddebf23bb9fe8ee298d26d6a480d5700c16e2d29f4d7de"}

{"id": "p_d1f07c91077762a7", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 174, "text": "明公若往攻之，其勢必破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "ecc807b798f810d78ee07bae932fd2dda270ebf2c6481122fc31de57608ee9b6"}

{"id": "p_c52fbf9a62a5754d", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 175, "text": "既破祖軍，鼓行而西，據楚關而圖巴、蜀，霸業可定也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "a0e126cb7c14c551dd144965c46ac15a3239644e2b35b8ff0844d0259e780478"}

{"id": "p_91efb82dc1be1294", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 176, "text": "孫權曰：「此金玉之論也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "20e4398c89accbb5b01e761b8a0d36e72eee20cbdc8403493c69cc284cbd153b"}

{"id": "p_8b4f22a8bb3ea2e4", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 177, "text": "」遂命周瑜為大都督，總水陸軍兵；呂蒙為前部先鋒；董襲與甘寧為副將；權自領大軍十萬，征討黃祖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "2200d4ce57967aeafc02af7a59819c99172b57f99caa7ab34025050a7cc46c3d"}

{"id": "p_56b4f5226d8adfca", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 178, "text": "黃祖急聚眾商議，令蘇飛為大將，陳就、鄧龍為先鋒，盡起江夏之兵迎敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "9908ddcf2b0c91771ef6d7f6d3f9bbdd29a0e842a49a5bb849c4489607ac95dc"}

{"id": "p_637655ad1ba0ea2d", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 179, "text": "陳就、鄧龍各引一隊艨艟截住沔口，艨艟上各設強弓硬弩千餘張，將大索繫定艨艟於水面上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "2f2dd74a7aba86a4ee4f2438bd47635bd8a501740d99a6e0b7f0ecb4393e2ab3"}

{"id": "p_68002318f921b01f", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 180, "text": "東吳兵至，艨艟上鼓響，弓弩齊發，兵不敢進，約退數里水面。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "eb72f8a9429a1d9eda1215501904f993915c009a2e6d4482a3e94eb6c077f692"}

{"id": "p_780fed18187f1db9", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 181, "text": "甘寧謂董襲曰：「事已至此，不得不進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "79bfadbbeba88ad5877f77d2a1998375dc386d37b0535b2704f1ca6a80e7d323"}

{"id": "p_24fcb4aa76ecfae7", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」乃選小船百餘隻，每船用精兵五十人，二十人撐船，三十人各披衣甲，手執鋼刀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "257cb0e0d01895e2fc7d6dde01434b8b44f64883a6d6dba3e8d7dc241ae5a0de"}

{"id": "p_678e6b8ae02e2bc3", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 183, "text": "不避矢石，直至艨艟傍邊，砍斷大索，艨艟遂橫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "0b290e0381611cbb8d3bee14b945cfdbf96ef07c3affb6313c893c819926c23a"}

{"id": "p_1304efaa8f288dee", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 184, "text": "甘寧飛上艨艟，將鄧龍砍死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "daff352c05e08550061d9cd04a93d585d067829bbbf2a052dd2148e3b8241d9c"}

{"id": "p_d2282e642301d48a", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 185, "text": "呂蒙見了，跳下小船，自舉櫓棹，直入船隊，放火燒船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "14575d3826a4226fe5b279227e9e4f5bf32e122b6cfcb4b7a7a2c1a066cd82f0"}

{"id": "p_430f418c208e5ce0", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 186, "text": "陳就急待上岸，呂蒙捨命趕到跟前，當胸一刀砍翻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "233cc657dabe1531e6796ae115e771656dbfa6cf3b7eeb457e3d1cee8cf4cf4b"}

{"id": "p_c9a819ded4ae9684", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 187, "text": "比及蘇飛引軍於岸上接應時，吳軍一齊上岸，勢不可當。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "d57cdd2a3d7eee18a5ee618ceb91f1fab4151e4bc5a66a2ce05e84962be32b55"}

{"id": "p_b4fdec810fde4602", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 188, "text": "蘇飛落荒而走，正遇東吳大將潘璋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "02c2da8b127e938ac7339fa7fceb862c2499c5ccb7f06a63c587810d24d96e9d"}

{"id": "p_3dd4462bd268335d", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 189, "text": "兩馬相交，戰不數合，被璋生擒過去，逕至船中來見孫權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "ce283dfd8d2cfeaa5839071fe2b747a6b5ccadd281a848233b2bcef91cddf864"}

{"id": "p_38801b6599aee962", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 190, "text": "權命左右以檻車囚之，待活捉了黃祖，一併誅戮；催動三軍，不分晝夜，攻打夏口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "ba740bf565c7ea14ca5abf2055055047374ef489d65c917e9c5ba60cf1633537"}

{"id": "p_88019929110e73ed", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 191, "text": "::只因不用錦帆賊，至令衝開大索船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "af418e3dde04584da0e965620f49ca217899c1f5962cbba776abe7cbdd202b2f"}

{"id": "p_a2002485c04b993d", "source_id": "src_d33ffe13dd01a981", "ordinal": 192, "text": "不知黃祖勝負如何，且看下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "a91f6da88c95152a948006168de66cb2f84e0bb73b30fd72f50698ade3cb1caf"}

{"id": "p_e651f1e99307e3a5", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說魯肅、孔明辭了玄德、劉琦，登舟望柴桑郡來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "bbfbcbd52b3601ebc293866d399b62da2a3821559f96c69478b2a1e9325da662"}

{"id": "p_a10bcd15ee6b6d57", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 1, "text": "二人在舟中共議，魯肅謂孔明曰：「先生見孫將軍，切不可實言曹操兵多將廣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "342414a13b123145d35eb79a502f01763b71729f566c4d9205247389cadc895e"}

{"id": "p_29d2791fb7d55464", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 2, "text": "」孔明曰：「不須子敬叮嚀，亮自有對答之語。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "8f5e4fd2c5788d3b41a5806f5b04e7a0a7b2a95383ee0af0e0ee169ad6d73f7d"}

{"id": "p_fd727b4a38b7b7b7", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 3, "text": "」及船到岸，肅請孔明於館驛中暫歇，先自往見孫權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "2dc2b33f2f0c40e1a5d85252442c988ef120752596328a46314c3107e8028e8d"}

{"id": "p_46a32b6c143d19d0", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 4, "text": "權正聚文武於堂上議事，聞魯肅回，急召入問曰：「子敬往江夏，體探虛實若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "40abea35f49173f54f4867d6713dc5b8757157ce66d7816a58c9dc2a988d2cdc"}

{"id": "p_d75c25772685d4b8", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 5, "text": "」肅曰：「已知其略，尚容徐稟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "a2be326bed6ca704a742504c88d56763bbf9f112b00c6fe520e4d8a503b853ae"}

{"id": "p_a088f16a79a732a3", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」權將曹操檄文示肅曰：「操昨遣使齎文至此，孤先發遣來使，現今會眾商議未定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "4c116faeeaf5ccc30be827e111324a45da40db0bb8e95a215da857c976527158"}

{"id": "p_71a96386621b35c0", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 7, "text": "::孤近承帝命，奉詔伐罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "930dbd32876fda6ff7520fd1f9ef30e2564da40cb3e2efab298eeb503852e6c6"}

{"id": "p_fc1131d7ecdbb51c", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 8, "text": "旄麾南指，劉琮束手；荊襄之民，望風歸順。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "db3a530c53c5292df23a262501d477dbbad8b3752f277ad2070044209d2cb98d"}

{"id": "p_7222653225d50449", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 9, "text": "今統雄兵百萬，上將千員，欲與將軍會獵於江夏，共伐劉備，同分土地，永結盟好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "e85048dfb146232e8d38e896f06328504e7a4efa9bbc8a17c7c5c4992304af32"}

{"id": "p_225344c358cee2be", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 10, "text": "魯肅看畢曰：「主公尊意若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "63bdc281d66f68e7d82946f9872b12ff67eecc8fd451a077220c81fdf7a1fbc9"}

{"id": "p_f6f38fa89f249417", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」張昭曰：「曹操擁百萬之眾，借天子之名，以征四方，拒之不順。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "a1f07b037e11b55797570674864d569f5aa0b991583dd0d841fbb9213f71fb7b"}

{"id": "p_15b248700d981ec1", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 12, "text": "且主公大勢可以拒操者，長江也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "c73bcf1034b9b29e4d92e053b8f2165ff74f274d9bb8a0c6468e16c703e01acb"}

{"id": "p_2124f6c1035ce520", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 13, "text": "今操既得荊州，長江之險，已與我共之矣，勢不可敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "86b1a56899e79b69448a8b5da7da4cfe08b24ef0adb32262c84a5f51a19ee788"}

{"id": "p_e7aaede2e11bdada", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 14, "text": "以愚之計，不如納降為萬安之策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "295835143ad720e0e5dbfcea1e4ef78331d69132915ac04d79a169f8fcf18376"}

{"id": "p_99cbaaf76fa23c8e", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」眾謀士皆曰：「子布之言，正合天意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "d0144783a59a0f289afe0c8a95cc89da51f724bf2ed5d122d7ffe7a9ebfd7b6b"}

{"id": "p_32fbce7d61f55b7b", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 16, "text": "張昭又曰：「主公不必多疑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "41cef48ca64a4d5cb5945a32f18c2db9163f01e395a03e91b3fe3d7ee5b25958"}

{"id": "p_9ce0b692c3a39f25", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 17, "text": "如降操則東吳民安，江南六郡可保矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "a511aefd33becc0bde50cede21f47c033ca2c3dbf64f20f5cc7fb6b783e52263"}

{"id": "p_e1ad526aa37c1fb6", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 18, "text": "須臾，權起更衣，魯肅隨於權後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "06ab39c8d88f20fc4bbfc6559c4b677c269ee14112ddd9556226b173c36a0d65"}

{"id": "p_c3dac6190b4378cb", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 19, "text": "權知肅意，乃執肅手而言曰：「卿欲如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "7e99c6bf64e3b41253ff9616273c242e3dfdfb9003f4cf98f923bcb2364d0608"}

{"id": "p_b991889dd9bdf932", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 20, "text": "」肅曰：「恰纔眾人所言，深誤將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "c11139c1a51d4f111dbf7ddd95c8d8a0398b306995fe397bc8dad5c2712c4a44"}

{"id": "p_5e1efbe03ba5ce10", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 21, "text": "眾人皆可降曹操，惟將軍不可降曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "ae9e506933cff38c50eb27d4c54db744a83a318bcc14864c68cc38f2115793a9"}

{"id": "p_18eaf348c40a5f40", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 22, "text": "」肅曰：「如肅等降操，當以肅還鄉黨，累官故不失州郡也；將軍降操，欲安所歸乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "a649eced327649f3095925876746e4d069aa10f6313898b457c4fe230e22c4a1"}

{"id": "p_86fe87aac27aa0df", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 23, "text": "位不過封侯，車不過一乘，騎不過一匹，從不過數人，豈得南面稱孤哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "4588fa689c336ee507f4d567448d009d830206df90fabaa3694ca7e66d21179e"}

{"id": "p_41b4c4135bf93777", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 24, "text": "眾人之意，各自為己，不可聽也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "286b97f93831ee5ff58a9de01235ae7a065299af74b5a988e1f11cd3a40d2c2b"}

{"id": "p_c6c54169b754d24b", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 25, "text": "權歎曰：「諸人議論，大失孤望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "1d2a2f9a41a921065d4b4c553219a4bae0cc35dd7ddac12da2e3a2448acbeb23"}

{"id": "p_0e52f7d5c7505afc", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 26, "text": "子敬開說大計，正與吾見相同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "98cb4c46b1f1e4e80e9f5bfc008d86d342a0f6ec09972cf32e4565e95ff36c3b"}

{"id": "p_620f2482feadce2d", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 27, "text": "但操新得袁紹之眾，近又得荊州之兵，恐勢大難以抵敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "264cfbc1ac5f9fc63ff436c956cbe671229d64300a5f9bf446e121cf5dc51904"}

{"id": "p_091f8e9bd7be774c", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」肅曰：「肅至江夏，引諸葛瑾之弟諸葛亮在此，主公可問之，便知虛實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "f33337acafc42fd91882d9f6d22b6b4dc54e748f37399458a67ddcf016e5978b"}

{"id": "p_e26213e480d3c0a7", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」權曰：「臥龍先生在此乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "19f181a7b421bcd90299ec247c138b0480fb140ab6fdf1eb0f4f58e48b6e0c23"}

{"id": "p_74a0441ed44a56c8", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 30, "text": "」肅曰：「現在館驛中安歇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "6c4498c74db2a27311e09d0b2d00ff03685c9d54aa490c3845a454b92af3e5f9"}

{"id": "p_ab9cc924f76abd21", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」權曰：「今日天晚，且未相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "773d874b371e85a5ca32163ea4f45b88e84aee541b896d842cefeb81986a60b8"}

{"id": "p_659653bd2ddb0cef", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 32, "text": "來日聚文武於帳下，先教見我江東英俊，然後升堂議事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "f4e913438b1199056086411a251e55c2c0171b13a9cdf04bea2a4b28a7dd110b"}

{"id": "p_9c94096869d7142d", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 33, "text": "次日至館驛中見孔明，又囑曰：「今見我主，切不可言曹操兵多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "51f6b6ef1d7df657f144e946ae422a3e7de43d2d77f7589fdc5746a76bfd8fe9"}

{"id": "p_a151d7450c0495ff", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 34, "text": "」孔明笑曰：「亮自見機而變，決不有誤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "7b3ef05e9770960cdd7075212e18077574083dd920e7aadcf66c60ef39035a62"}

{"id": "p_54cb5af1dc399fa8", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 35, "text": "早見張昭、顧雍等一班文武，二十餘人，峨冠博帶，整衣端坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "c6fdd266143c45a4579b8d323066ead8f0ed45f37466be4a040eb24c27b71837"}

{"id": "p_4fcba9f3eaaf36f8", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 36, "text": "孔明逐一相見，各問姓名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "bf201d80c215ed5a95fd7fcf2ddcc46e1759940d2f8bf454f2168e12e5a534dd"}

{"id": "p_276240429bb048c6", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 37, "text": "張昭等見孔明丰神飄灑，器宇軒昂，料道此人必來游說。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "ab4b2f86d17e18111cf5744c339f42ad345490d5dbf5c13ee7a78441848ce064"}

{"id": "p_7a2446c51b3142c6", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 38, "text": "張昭先以言挑之曰：「昭乃江東微末之士，久聞先生高臥隆中，自比管、樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "b2b4d255a8330453a7aea69599b81bbc19d3aad1dabd72d5bff60e6a698dda64"}

{"id": "p_2d8fd97ef7dd68d1", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」孔明曰：「此亮平生小可之比也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "4ab90653be8de31f08c75d16148a90bce79f16960702fe0570e926b43cf73faa"}

{"id": "p_ecc924c6b9d0a709", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」昭曰：「近聞劉豫州三顧先生於草廬之中，幸得先生，以為如魚得水，思欲席捲荊襄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "9aace8c62a2ad4e3f46af9a29aed25bc84d9df216cc766067c28dca0933dbdc2"}

{"id": "p_f87d7a0626d27ff9", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 41, "text": "今一旦以屬曹操，未審是何主見？", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "4914458bb999a6da703cbdc017ae3070ceb7d344beb47a72cd6604c45ff22b97"}

{"id": "p_10d997bac17faee6", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 42, "text": "孔明自思張昭乃孫權手下第一個謀士，若不先難倒他，如何說得孫權，遂答曰：「吾觀取漢上之地，易如反掌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "935b68f71385680fe9fc97d48b2e58c30dd4275d3e7308e46c10798569eb84ae"}

{"id": "p_7ae6d5e9bb9dbea9", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 43, "text": "我主劉豫州躬行仁義，不忍奪同宗之基業，故力辭之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "6b6b367bdf31a351ef91927f1048d20263cefaa2b6404ccb17d5c0caff90974a"}

{"id": "p_cd8c369faaaaaa4b", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 44, "text": "劉琮孺子，聽信佞言，暗自投降，致使曹操得以猖獗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "462e314b347dfd4a2e6c6008c11d6199e92d87d9ee528be8cc309a4329b5a308"}

{"id": "p_d334eface180968d", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 45, "text": "今我主屯兵江夏，別有良圖，非等閒可知也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "f6224d637b89a825dc7ac9e162338504c94eb8589bbb5f95813a95640342dbb4"}

{"id": "p_28c98d3e419adcba", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 46, "text": "昭曰：「若此，是先生言行相違也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "f3f3cc2d085c75a6adb81e01fa0c2d7209a561883d82ed3ce7d810620769a61e"}

{"id": "p_ba66791682ee4ca6", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 47, "text": "管仲相桓公，霸諸侯，一匡天下；樂毅扶持微弱之燕，下齊七十餘城；此二人者，真濟世之才也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "d869bdf149925faa8a4f5e017635a8d399ec89aca276200b3096d06fb663e11b"}

{"id": "p_d72e2ffc6c9eaa26", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 48, "text": "先生在草廬之中，但笑傲風月，抱膝危坐；今既從事劉豫州，當為生靈興利除害，剿滅亂賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "5193ae197cd57e627ba7c9d77cc35c6ae1895119403366a13c1c1b6c603def5b"}

{"id": "p_4b7fe144d0b94797", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 49, "text": "且劉豫州未得先生之時，尚且縱橫寰宇，割據城池；今得先生，人皆仰望；雖三尺童蒙，亦謂彪虎生翼，將見漢室復興，曹氏即滅矣；朝廷舊臣，山林隱士，無不拭目而待：以為拂高天之雲翳，仰日月之光輝，拯斯民於水火之中，措天下於衽席之上，在此時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "8d6099fd78dc879a9de0645973c704ce9aa78a5a5a1e6e3b6949bbbbc958205f"}

{"id": "p_269881464305d5a8", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 50, "text": "何先生自歸豫州，曹兵一出，棄甲拋戈，望風而竄；上不能報劉表以安庶民，下不能輔孤子而據疆土；乃棄新野，走樊城，敗當陽，奔夏口，無容身之地？", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "e81794734e2b3d4ae3e8887268a76efa0463f610fe3ba6995c65a4ae282f315a"}

{"id": "p_ae567c7dec63cdd7", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 51, "text": "是豫州既得先生之後，反不如其初也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "516e3399c88b4bb5823b7898e81157b212c1b7abd54c2b27b7758f50ebe65eb4"}

{"id": "p_2be9ec719fe752a1", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 52, "text": "孔明聽罷，啞然而笑曰：「鵬飛萬里，其志豈群鳥能識哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "d8303912da8f3db495745d5cb3e0417bde64dfefb156dcf92fc3099ef7a51f1f"}

{"id": "p_8b7a40d35e457453", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 53, "text": "譬如人染沈痾，當先用糜粥以飲之，和藥以服之；待其腑臟調和，形體漸安，然後用肉食以補之，猛藥以治之；則病根盡去，人得全生也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "1e5200c5eeb6a58e517aac59666c1b4bcce6cf34b2570b07b4aec9eae76dacad"}

{"id": "p_6884917810c12be9", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 54, "text": "若不待氣脈和緩，便投以猛藥厚味，欲求安保，誠為難矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "eb45b7e6f245ec80b7243c66ac3c013c2e42d96f6b8bf8fa48e9b895e0242213"}

{"id": "p_10e274c974e0ecc3", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 55, "text": "吾主劉豫州，向日軍敗於汝南，寄跡劉表，兵不滿千，將止關、張、趙雲而已；此正如病勢尪羸已極之時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "eccfa04eeafe509ffcc3836007d9365eeb68e191ceb613b0815acf050e585ef7"}

{"id": "p_d0c68aef2f4a21a7", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 56, "text": "新野山僻小縣，人民稀少，糧食鮮薄，豫州不過暫借以容身，豈真將坐守於此耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "e1720f249110ecd6eb40e78b20a0d8b7701cdbe951112dcbec338bcbb3b9103d"}

{"id": "p_7421e15213828491", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 57, "text": "夫以甲兵不完，城郭不固，軍不經練，糧不繼日，然而博望燒屯，白河用水，使夏侯惇、曹仁輩心驚膽裂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "cb390673d08369abeeaa88e3ed9a4e30550419dd24b778ee6402ae394d7b615c"}

{"id": "p_6049704f92ac68eb", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 58, "text": "竊謂管仲、樂毅之用兵，未必過此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "e146713b3205ea207823b08999a5ef08f35b96c2446461484fb3956e809f9478"}

{"id": "p_b656a88ca678f0a6", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 59, "text": "至於劉琮降操，豫州實出不知；且又不忍乘亂奪同宗之基業，此真大仁大義也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "e6598e8183633d16c6a10760df8f728dfa0a39b95ec607fdc6c1f702e5b6e6cb"}

{"id": "p_d852486a09b88217", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 60, "text": "當陽之敗，豫州見有數十萬赴義之民，扶老攜幼相隨，不忍棄之，日行十里，不思進取江陵，甘與同敗，此亦大仁大義也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "94067bf9867afdeb9529dc51ade2acb3a6522359d4fd5c3544b0db811487c622"}

{"id": "p_f27099bb2498e08a", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 61, "text": "寡不敵眾，勝負乃其常事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "3f17468b42ca2fd88696640c20cb2a3925859a2422dc4f3a6d14728ccb691bba"}

{"id": "p_a37f4c4a1f973063", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 62, "text": "昔高皇數敗於項羽，而垓下一戰成功，此非韓信之良謀乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "4cdf7a769b2d023d421e930429095f8c32909c0bde31001b91448edf680fc9dd"}

{"id": "p_64ec221c9bc63a3b", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 63, "text": "夫信久事高皇，未嘗累勝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "65927813e8396db723d82ca342094824767cf924bf163904ca18266f225598e8"}

{"id": "p_6922e227cce72e54", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 64, "text": "蓋國家大計，社稷安危，是有主謀，非比誇辯之徒，虛譽欺人，坐議立談，無人可及；臨機應變，百無一能。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "2c708c40e1bab0d853740abd07716275a70b3a8e2f55f22acd14277d89a822f7"}

{"id": "p_6097516a834ef35b", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 65, "text": "」這一篇言語，說得張昭並無一言回答。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "7218facf0b99ee703339e9cdeb45999b55eba2aa42743c6fc42ab35370b83cd0"}

{"id": "p_1553a14d07d8548e", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 66, "text": "座上忽一人抗聲問曰：「今曹公兵屯百萬，將列千員，龍驤虎視，平吞江夏，公以為何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "5e190b1bdd57045fd6c030515c0d89b552aba8953f83a044aca60f98444e605a"}

{"id": "p_d90694ddc938d136", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 67, "text": "孔明曰：「曹操收袁紹蟻聚之兵，劫劉表烏合之眾，雖數百萬不足懼也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "5eeac50a8cf31f72ae636f7f7452688399e24eaf1f540722e59f6fe39d0893a9"}

{"id": "p_bb93ef975b968dca", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 68, "text": "」虞翻冷笑曰：「軍敗於當陽，計窮於夏口，區區求救於人，而猶言不懼，此真大言欺人也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "f710869c90a48cb4e2fbb3ef0b0dad3ca10cbbf666c0090a096d29f571a2b7ea"}

{"id": "p_c0b9c90bd70435ec", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」孔明曰：「劉豫州以數千仁義之師，安能敵百萬殘暴之眾，退守夏口，所以待時也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "35b4ac3cb5cff312754ca9714ff3a6a516ee9b3d2e58ce519117f1cc82dbf523"}

{"id": "p_de15d787bbbc5dcf", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 70, "text": "今江東兵精糧足，且有長江之險，猶欲使其主屈膝降賊，不顧天下恥笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "a86092764b2b800efbca38528b444338ea7d26e1f189b5bf68f8c91e00b4f153"}

{"id": "p_5c0923ea7ee558f5", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 71, "text": "由此論之，劉豫州真不懼操賊者矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "03f7d65c6a0b85a63a4aa892f97ce7f2029b530c113363ba6da1b8e1b7d699ac"}

{"id": "p_f7c6a8eb13a167e0", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 72, "text": "座間又一人問曰：「孔明欲效儀、秦之舌，游說東吳耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "25c413a9f51bd48811b02c4c7fd75ab8c1928bef1fe373f0358f0f27aca4d75e"}

{"id": "p_54bf494f99a50e44", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 73, "text": "孔明曰：「步子山以蘇秦、張儀為辯士，不知蘇秦、張儀亦豪傑也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "6cd603c053120e4f22e6a33bca4e2411c00a8759d012b678643befeff5e8a134"}

{"id": "p_a28e5495f2cc2ad3", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 74, "text": "蘇秦佩六國相印，張儀兩次相秦，皆有匡扶人國之謀，非比畏強凌弱，懼刀避劍之人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "1f753aa64aebed70e7a1de62ae49a5345a368cc47bda3afa1d37943e6534c762"}

{"id": "p_56f7fd92f83ea16d", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 75, "text": "君等聞曹操虛發詐偽之詞，便畏懼請降，敢笑蘇秦、張儀乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "d6a1752289fe78d00ee39fdd4f9cd064ed42d4b9c306c63abab51feb0416cdc5"}

{"id": "p_960f81ec665fdae8", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 76, "text": "忽一人問曰：「孔明以操何如人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "3cf4a64cdf19f9a2dc80d9f2e480bc2e2b0e46888a1d9b443e30089dfcb2bd4f"}

{"id": "p_d77c1ca23e87b7c1", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」孔明視其人，乃薛綜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "0a665fe2d4902737ebd8e440a7be31d400c5900391e27665482d2af9257595aa"}

{"id": "p_16b1b51303322bba", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 78, "text": "孔明答曰：「曹操乃漢賊也，又何必問？", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "f2f43966a93a046b4f361623986268271d9a8cbedcae23961879966e24fcab12"}

{"id": "p_4cf93e525f3a51aa", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 79, "text": "今曹公已有天下三分之二，人皆歸心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "424676a01b5f10b1fd1aab468bb941d59afe6a7794bf8e0e91b7923f8909cec2"}

{"id": "p_be5a139f1944da8f", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 80, "text": "劉豫州不識天時，強欲與爭，正如以卵擊石，安得不敗乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "3798524da4c2c8bb80fc89fadbb67220fdeecd828e8af127a2e674b0d287af71"}

{"id": "p_3adfce3c5a66635f", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 81, "text": "」孔明厲聲曰：「薛敬文安得出此無父無君之言乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "927c48f2bfaa2f7c174022f4ed3bd384551a6a69d63f3ac11eecc583ac032de3"}

{"id": "p_efcb9a1756cc893f", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 82, "text": "夫人生天地間，以忠孝為立身之本。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "d0e56787e11c81ce94794d7d009c310bd67fcf38254920488242e4b74c4d01b8"}

{"id": "p_8b06adf96c948c1f", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 83, "text": "公既為漢臣，則見有不臣之人，當誓共戮之，臣之道也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "3178d0ec592ebd33b9d73cb3a3015d11e47512aa2798f519cdfe78aa907e1a53"}

{"id": "p_6c6c0218de27f5f2", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 84, "text": "今曹操祖宗叨食漢祿，不思報效，反懷篡逆之心，天下之所共憤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "67286b45fabca0ec244d4534c84ecd8e98ee07177fb9f2f805e580d1a54c4174"}

{"id": "p_407e6eca935f4cf2", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 85, "text": "公乃以天數歸之，真無父無君之人也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "9b365e5f4b63f033320d9556f4e1113f2266d1a808ec0efdf79c367e238e625e"}

{"id": "p_96616dea64168d9d", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 86, "text": "」薛綜滿面羞慚，不能對答。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "f1cb8716e8ed173854a3620899ad7efd62d57073875aad5c02e8560083a0fc15"}

{"id": "p_5f9c9e608cd3b79e", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 87, "text": "座上又一人應聲問曰：「曹操雖挾天子以令諸侯，猶是相國曹參之後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "629390bdfe55dc61699f729f218cdd2ab20b74deee2004721e54a8c5eea4b20e"}

{"id": "p_45f82d8b4694ba5a", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 88, "text": "劉豫州雖云中山靖王苗裔，卻無可稽考，眼見只是織蓆販屨之夫耳，何足與曹操抗衡哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "106e70f79e2d7c8e6dbcd09be1c97997cc51fe355cb2a8e295f107cb08c44196"}

{"id": "p_a823f66aa92d31ae", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 89, "text": "孔明笑曰：「公非袁術座間懷橘之陸郎乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "0bb4d5e828f3f9eecbe71de802e2d6c97f99da54a5efcf462f1806f3b4a5687b"}

{"id": "p_cbd5bd942de0062e", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 90, "text": "曹操既為曹相國之後，則世為漢臣矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "4241d5a3f76ae1b7b4def907179d094f4ce443a50bf3328075a9f7eaacff92b8"}

{"id": "p_3d83f934ca39ac15", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 91, "text": "今乃專權肆橫，欺凌君父，是不惟無君，亦且蔑祖；不惟漢室之亂臣，亦曹氏之賊子也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "811811158a4e77b75586b28e00ede976464c0bd54fb63b5ec8b15d8673b7fa83"}

{"id": "p_637488c4754f38d6", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 92, "text": "劉豫州堂堂帝冑，當今皇帝，按譜賜爵，何云無可稽考？", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "52b52c0b5fbe35ba2e2cc6786e9b9a515a8e02dddc8507691711e1b511ca8fb5"}

{"id": "p_5daf8fc4f41449c2", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 93, "text": "且高祖起身亭長，而終有天下；織蓆販屨，又何足為辱乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "6621ddba3f10d7fea20e5f3b8177d8ebfa5e0a80faba642f27f4a3f80ba0f5f1"}

{"id": "p_e824034dba96dbaf", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 94, "text": "公小兒之見，不足與高士共語！", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "2976573ccb7066f630c1b65e2bcc2b234818b2e81ed27f3011b86916728f4c6d"}

{"id": "p_e04f78394a076c4c", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 95, "text": "座上一人忽曰：「孔明所言，皆強詞奪理，均非正論，不必再言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "061bb31dbdc4429d8264d4fd81afb7f2a421c10b59a775e4d827112a3bce086b"}

{"id": "p_712eb72b9a0e1445", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 96, "text": "孔明曰：「尋章摘句，世之腐儒也，何能興邦立事？", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "05b0335ad32d3462fa8304a83db0dbca1e518469cbbd135c3c3814091fe1d589"}

{"id": "p_30dc8a7572e54af7", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 97, "text": "且古耕莘伊尹，釣渭子牙，張良、陳平之流，鄧禹、耿弇之輩，皆有匡扶宇宙之才，未審其生平治何經典。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "3f96fc546af0364ac098f10d6789733facb6d60e570ff4577bff0da5760c8033"}

{"id": "p_fc0871c35f206245", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 98, "text": "豈亦效書生區區於筆硯之間，數黑論黃，舞文弄墨而已乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "cb8812d1589d16731afd3e7212ef3ffd3476bfc806cc7e1bbd15b900ba8f032f"}

{"id": "p_b4ac07bffd60683c", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 99, "text": "」嚴畯低頭喪氣而不能對。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "a22a5cc4b467f597fbc664a8de9da72179712cc7754d7e71dffd5e10a22e352d"}

{"id": "p_509ced3e99673663", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 100, "text": "忽又一人大聲曰：「公好為大言，未必真有實學，恐適為儒者所笑耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "88865a3acc097e540231800aff8b28dfae85249d430e5c369d275805da921883"}

{"id": "p_111120e063cf8b39", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 101, "text": "」孔明視其人，乃汝南程德樞也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "1f3dafa7325665ae91f34bbf7b285b6751cb3af32ddab8b894e83d6a4c9f7a5d"}

{"id": "p_8cff4a95981df82c", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 102, "text": "孔明答曰：「儒有君子小人之別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "6b62816a21bae22f2b21e213573d4972055d2d1f2cbb85e862d25137d117ebe9"}

{"id": "p_5fdc6181fbf5eb89", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 103, "text": "君子之儒，忠君愛國，守正惡邪，務使澤及當時，名留後世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "43977312e40e0a82a84d8f61c291e2a270a1fc1b0dd623331813cc838d7b4c3e"}

{"id": "p_bfec8c04d1b2881b", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 104, "text": "若夫小人之儒，惟務雕蟲，專工翰墨，青春作賦，皓首窮經，筆下雖有千言，胸中實無一策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "9b658b5475cad635852195a0bcadb61c21676aafde72de4f8ac0c3cd02e9d77b"}

{"id": "p_5f676a8729c26c92", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 105, "text": "且如揚雄以文章名世，而屈身事莽，不免投閣而死，此所謂小人之儒也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "df55332c9a9fb12e989077e4da86c650bacab804aeda3af38721201f44f91dab"}

{"id": "p_3dacc3e9ccca152a", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 106, "text": "眾人見孔明對答如流，盡皆失色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "cc9a6baefa6c697d457b9b7e868d5fc6217ec935bd302ba7f393effa89b8a69b"}

{"id": "p_f33c6cbee65fb4ad", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 107, "text": "時座上張溫、駱統二人，又欲問難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "cb65cbe849958ad4c80aef5404599892a7bf45c32888e8968035318ed4de992a"}

{"id": "p_2d07ee032e9f53a3", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 108, "text": "忽一人自外而入，厲聲言曰：「孔明乃當世奇才，君等以脣舌相難，非敬客之禮也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "df797db108a3690aa9a2433e31917c29938a9636754b4b7bea7561a96b464c37"}

{"id": "p_dafc3afdec7ca5bb", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 109, "text": "曹操大軍臨境，不思退敵之策，乃徒鬥口耶！", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "c2db643e3117025a236583b98cfb215943f63a9a67928ce42360b9ae640a93f3"}

{"id": "p_afc6e64a857945cf", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 110, "text": "」眾視其人，乃零陵人，姓黃，名蓋，字公覆，現為東吳糧官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "998b83e250caf0e2b04b6f17c23a303057be47a9741645fc484d365cd96f15fc"}

{"id": "p_26b407fb4c174c3d", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 111, "text": "當時黃蓋謂孔明曰：「愚聞多言獲利，不如默而無言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "683bc1a722fb71df9bfe0975006bd71aa8fb05fb5e66c119514dfc94a5f76a45"}

{"id": "p_2f27a8731e235372", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 112, "text": "何不將金石之論為我主言之，乃與眾人辯論也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "c510416a774bd5395d943d7fd24582baa7e343846ab6809c7eafd1e04cc43caf"}

{"id": "p_7c0ebe715bdb5352", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」孔明曰：「諸君不知世務，互相問難，不容不答耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "70a349acf394ce37c38be4748d12e8a7a0e85db496970e52cbf9d65f6ddf2439"}

{"id": "p_264775bac7d2d09b", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 114, "text": "於是黃蓋與魯肅引孔明入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "e4a604ff495107dc1cee585dfdd34541b01961c962c3899dceb7ba7dd21fbeca"}

{"id": "p_222733d836ad6e7c", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 115, "text": "至中門，正遇諸葛瑾，孔明施禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "cd730f51223def03fb0ecb288cb3c749be208bb533d86de9840d9be6a2db7433"}

{"id": "p_230cbbc32e9d3546", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 116, "text": "瑾曰：「賢弟既到江東，如何不來見我？", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "d6d72674f5d38fae54a2760604bf25d17988e127777a89fccf54ae51b9bdeccf"}

{"id": "p_16b7a9dcf4dec978", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 117, "text": "」孔明曰：「弟既事豫州，理宜先公後私，公事未畢，不敢及私。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "8d8091bacf9bbf7e5c4bf0c7177a733d932e72e702052367141b29a1e639d8d2"}

{"id": "p_48af09a9cb8b0511", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 118, "text": "」瑾曰：「賢弟見過吳侯，卻來敘話。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "7a1109696982c7044a2613fab6b8009089639b032049ad4a6ea315adc68a6e55"}

{"id": "p_ca7bec7fe6abb3cf", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 119, "text": "魯肅曰：「適間所囑，不可有誤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "188972a24c21125703c3a51f42c240e5abf3a23503c55475d8dad0b2b938f185"}

{"id": "p_701ebf5bb0db97d0", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 120, "text": "引至堂上，孫權降階而迎，優禮相待。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "206fbc71c6bb5f6263e36aceac310952e061be78b4a9f8e54d12bef83d1c8fd5"}

{"id": "p_561a505a4486522f", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 121, "text": "魯肅立於孔明之側，只看他講話。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "6ed6e56fab28fb0837af9289ba21e359cac91e7185a55a6eec546bee1a0b16a4"}

{"id": "p_2c1a9ef53090d8fa", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 122, "text": "孔明致玄德之意畢，偷眼看孫權：碧眼紫髯，堂堂一表。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "8cbf1defba298d7abe4de0649da51e4880da57c370ad5625ffc50687291e9897"}

{"id": "p_49e6404eea480181", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 123, "text": "孔明暗思：「此人相貌非常，只可激，不可說。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "cbe1ee505fceef3091085ac22e9a516a17de5ca1ba5dd2603db4adbc19451ed3"}

{"id": "p_a00201527c17d709", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 124, "text": "等他問時，用言激之便了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "3c4b189e1e89d27c7c4f5cefbb89e0930176bab5e7710091f4c8a06ec5d4b305"}

{"id": "p_589da23d31031ad2", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 125, "text": "獻茶已畢，孫權曰：「多聞魯子敬談足下之才，今幸得相見，敢求教益。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "adb96be2a5dd368c7a58db5f899d6f0766863939291bf4b1e6a4d21d4346eee1"}

{"id": "p_d142043d9cacac58", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 126, "text": "」孔明曰：「不才無學，有辱明問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "adf94d6307d14af6acf6222affa1886c147ee4eb4c645dd7ae0cd112888b80d5"}

{"id": "p_917137e3e8d74ce5", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」權曰：「足下近在新野，佐劉豫州與曹操決戰，必深知彼軍虛實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "777267924459fe1b7d411a868a81d9a2754c27cfdaa350276e2caf924e510536"}

{"id": "p_9593cad286b7ff0d", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 128, "text": "」孔明曰：「劉豫州兵微將寡，更兼新野城小無糧，安能與曹操相持？", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "db71db2628660d71dcebef10001e09396fc7cad50803c2630eb0e7021a52d17b"}

{"id": "p_f164cddda9328b2c", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 129, "text": "」權曰：「曹兵共有多少？", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "86b1ca8dd6fcdca4f504007d71ad7bb68496bb669354b39f61bea972983bbac7"}

{"id": "p_a92329a840b63813", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 130, "text": "」孔明曰：「馬步水軍，約有一百餘萬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "9b93bf13d99a015c2c9fe68ca575f456ba4439b03036d58dc56620628a9bb278"}

{"id": "p_3dbb4f9758eb76bc", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 131, "text": "曹操就兗州已有青州軍二十萬；平了袁紹，又得五六十萬；中原新招之兵三四十萬；今又得荊州之軍二三十萬：以此計之，不下一百五十萬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "3c47e8ced9d523657a708e3845c25b12d3d1f0893fc94114d072d70d2f7a4a3a"}

{"id": "p_eadad4821785f2d8", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 132, "text": "亮以百萬言之，恐驚江東之士也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "0a6f05770587b9a336d2ef9d0839875aa224b9d24fdc0114d0f429c430a6c724"}

{"id": "p_06d222f73abd2d95", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 133, "text": "魯肅在旁，聞言失色，以目視孔明，孔明只做不見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "2f1319fb7dc00172160a6962f511905dad63e77a002ab0d964592141a299a8a2"}

{"id": "p_2d2637c36ba8fbaa", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 134, "text": "權曰：「曹操部下戰將，還有多少？", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "467653d8799e7fdfb1d9ec71ca8d0702973282aaf43ffdd660a6de5da8c4bbaa"}

{"id": "p_d92e7d73e93b5a97", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 135, "text": "」孔明曰：「足智多謀之士，能征慣戰之將，何止一二千人！", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "da75f89077515e1bb1c298e21f7a31150529f6f9f58f0b57ed914f4f39ae364b"}

{"id": "p_28ca54f1f2533dc1", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 136, "text": "」權曰：「今曹操平了荊楚，復有遠圖乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "fff531c2f40a9b300395797b29b745aaaa3191cc998a515d917a7927cb827314"}

{"id": "p_5f3546aa129b601e", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 137, "text": "」孔明曰：「即今沿江下寨，準備戰船，不欲圖江東，待取何地？", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "e759e3dc705c46465060914cd2e666e0f27bab79a81267adab43e76a74ee32d8"}

{"id": "p_dbc8f58e88b6d8a7", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 138, "text": "」權曰：「若彼有吞併之意，戰與不戰，請足下為我一決。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "10a80cf9163485b1cd51416719785542d49f4e8718e1c546e43035d0dd87a703"}

{"id": "p_80c85750e14145db", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 139, "text": "」孔明曰：「亮有一言，但恐將軍不肯聽從。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "a447bb45c4b6134d683927c45457f48c34fa0f1ad2c88ab0ea5fc8d2a58b9cba"}

{"id": "p_5093103375acfb88", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」孔明曰：「向者宇內大亂，故將軍起江東，劉豫州收眾漢南，與曹操並爭天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "6720b5cdea85f78b85393ba7c255ba0a6101d5168fafb3bfa39d2636753743c5"}

{"id": "p_08460bd1db444aeb", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 141, "text": "今操芟除大難，略已平矣；近又新破荊州，威震海內；縱有英雄，無用武之地：故豫州遁逃至此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "c648c9d395b8b00dd20cdf5c8259ba8fa75a54c338712cfc2b93f1cfe6e647b5"}

{"id": "p_c0475e70dbf2f5a9", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 142, "text": "若能以吳越之眾，與中國抗衡，不如早與之絕；若其不能，何不從眾謀士之論，按兵束甲，北面而事之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "54ca7902b59d8a4fd86da957e95777b6f85e9ac721ffec8c880bde9792c9f136"}

{"id": "p_44c03da61f4eb406", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 143, "text": "孔明又曰：「將軍外託服從之名，內懷疑貳之見，事急而不斷，禍至無日矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "95db2ffe3504e9efb1eef7be2096c8d1f1494653629988624a891574e140a273"}

{"id": "p_fd9a7417d1fd0516", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」權曰：「誠如君言，劉豫州何不降操？", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "d299134ab3ca35d2aac83311805c60a1b6de50473240d7bbdb7628e97387401a"}

{"id": "p_e5c4bf5c3863e708", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 145, "text": "」孔明曰：「昔田橫，齊之壯士耳，猶守義不辱；況劉豫州王室之冑，英才蓋世，眾士仰慕？", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "cea0aee0562b22dd5f2a96be9ddd820c6f0542bb3a602738af36a63976e6c2ce"}

{"id": "p_48e5b3dc2ba6f041", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 146, "text": "事之不濟，此乃天也，又安能屈處人下乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "cd0676b8e1e597b7f027039ee4e7a6e178ad231d9320ad8816dcc52116c41f9b"}

{"id": "p_98475153e5d4c852", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 147, "text": "孫權聽了孔明此言，不覺勃然變色，拂衣而起，退入後堂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "9b04833b00f273b53612cd335c2ebd1a92038b68943256777a756c8ff04f09d5"}

{"id": "p_77621735e8277ebf", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 148, "text": "魯肅責孔明曰：「先生何故出此言？", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "0528edba42ea2d703ed48e26e62bb67a2913cbb13ef874072ac0239b29b515ec"}

{"id": "p_56c230ba62f1e931", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 149, "text": "幸是吾主寬洪大度，不即面責。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "4171a7f123f8a288d392be6a0445de2e7e3d124012966b3666f547b5cf001abc"}

{"id": "p_27200eb440c9aa36", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 150, "text": "先生之言，藐視吾主甚矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "6240a2355a8990b7ee30f8db28e7744ac0feacdc5b0cb53757a49926b3974a14"}

{"id": "p_c9d542c3196a0626", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」孔明仰面笑曰：「何如此不能容物耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "500d76d0dae3712d5def3e3c670498a5fbc341fc27fdd993848ab23c7c390232"}

{"id": "p_e40bac24a47a8e9d", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 152, "text": "我自有破曹之計，彼不問我，我故不言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "0d28792201a385c3fcdffbe54a5e52608ad3347328839709cbf8421d65cdbfcc"}

{"id": "p_f7b5e753c7a03bc5", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 153, "text": "」肅曰：「果有良策，肅當請主公求教。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "27ad001dfc598f2934d7f35b08593c9b85f635049650bb9882b010f0a3127ca1"}

{"id": "p_293bef0b2956feb4", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」孔明曰：「吾視曹操百萬之眾，如群蟻耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "9be6021a9c78b6ac64ab59bdb883ecf9e5543745289cf29927dafa4c86acfd0e"}

{"id": "p_bbce39f7ffd9a1b3", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 155, "text": "但我一舉手，則皆為虀粉矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "84ed0342e7e4f127274e9bb274a0096c1d22509fe300c8b307fa92a0f458fc93"}

{"id": "p_d9d94b2ee7bd8789", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 156, "text": "肅聞言，便入後堂，見孫權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "a93f6b98da916d814b3eadd554a214fbcff1e8142142bb076479b9b6f9339d71"}

{"id": "p_2448a7e26ba987f4", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 157, "text": "權怒氣未息，顧謂肅曰：「孔明欺吾太甚！", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "0f353401bd56136f604a167fa360b778fd0b5f31735182749a93be8a9fc02cdb"}

{"id": "p_dbcb8324d31f7ba7", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 158, "text": "」肅曰：「臣亦以此責孔明，孔明反笑主公不能容物，破曹之策，孔明不肯輕言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "9c98c6d835d5e0f0c9912352392b3d1deba6fd3d075ba125e71563668dee7e1d"}

{"id": "p_bca30895c9e01ff0", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 159, "text": "」權回嗔作喜曰：「原來孔明有良謀，故以言詞激我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "546bd56804264d864447b2ced4d1f9313242f3f99f90fc2de9f8e7dc364d0f26"}

{"id": "p_e6c6322fa980e9b9", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 160, "text": "」便同魯肅重復出堂，再請孔明敘話。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "428dc7d4ed93baf8ef3fdfa86c9492598951219293defadd7a26eafb7753dc84"}

{"id": "p_0bf42d19046a9b6a", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 161, "text": "權見孔明，謝曰：「適來冒瀆威嚴，幸勿見罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "a58804c2da29271b78bfd314471aa2bc7dfb051a6162b8bb642ab43a5d6ae8f6"}

{"id": "p_2f57f6deb5d0ba83", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 162, "text": "」孔明亦謝曰：「亮言語冒犯，望乞恕罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "69919e344cf069724a4be3638fd922d2eb85bd4fb64ce6edced4b56bda3618f4"}

{"id": "p_9182f34c29f84c4d", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」權邀孔明入後堂，置酒相待。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "406c15c0192df79a86fd7a353bf6770e7d7645d82cfb53dbf265ea034855a493"}

{"id": "p_c00aec15f169784a", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 164, "text": "數巡之後，權曰：「曹操平生所惡者，呂布、劉表、袁紹、袁術、豫州與孤耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "fa9d1ff6eafe2b850fc132a489f3c02da442e5c6a76edf52b68c4283eb6ad942"}

{"id": "p_a2e18fc55da4b314", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 165, "text": "今數雄已滅，獨豫州與孤尚存。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "332f69bc8328093fc4b739169e7280b5224a818398062c9d1f94ff5efccf19a3"}

{"id": "p_ccccac4a2f241114", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 166, "text": "孤不能以全吳之地，受制於人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "565e51abc680005e2a083590199fdbda06a62205ddb6ed480f46fd822cff4e07"}

{"id": "p_7e8b9d95e20f2bb7", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 167, "text": "然豫州新敗之後，安能抗此難乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "c29e5a0888a816a6bfae8fac3edf71aa70767299b6cfcba58e43bdac0fb7ecc1"}

{"id": "p_59fe3c0e8ef8fc70", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 168, "text": "」孔明曰：「豫州雖新敗，然關雲長猶率精兵萬人；劉琦領江夏戰士，亦不下萬人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "4bbb6ad9492faf2c82aaa02f6777be57f1e95e8b4fb4a63661af402ac2e83a50"}

{"id": "p_182145d85019e4d7", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 169, "text": "曹操之眾，遠來疲憊，近追豫州，輕騎一日夜行三百里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "0d9013a81fd0735ede85184eab59d15f1d82f4c8dcbcbb9134693e10fc1a8665"}

{"id": "p_49c174411ddfa531", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 170, "text": "此所謂『強弩之末，勢不能穿魯縞』者也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "12a19bf93d392a9d2113b843e377bfa81cf004e59269d3c2c80e8db1fa11cb90"}

{"id": "p_a9156471cfb7819f", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 171, "text": "荊州士民附操者，迫於勢耳，非本心也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "bbd9ec382106cfd50c8fda0cb1b4118ed95547ecde17fa35536486f53abed428"}

{"id": "p_0e7a7f347ae410e6", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 172, "text": "今將軍誠能與豫州協力同心，破曹軍必矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "f699c2dcc62c387d802380a355df1397c5f2e1adc528ef27116c4e111f3f34d3"}

{"id": "p_d1f3d1d3b16ead7b", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 173, "text": "操軍破必北還，則荊、吳之勢強，而鼎足之形成矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "16a298de307d82b3a007ba5b8cb1ef651a6a1912fc6deb293d50cd38c5b6ec2e"}

{"id": "p_b0ec2ac43eef93fa", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 174, "text": "權大悅曰：「先生之言，頓開茅塞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "939bffb3beeac6e776c2235bf72ba7a94450db6e4056af83dc1f77d12826d72b"}

{"id": "p_5b0e8e0ac15c1656", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 175, "text": "即日商議起兵，共滅曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "1650e44f9edbec0c3978b397a78dbeb42cc942163885b68bf157479d4e1fbec6"}

{"id": "p_06e36fcf08d34126", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 176, "text": "」遂令魯肅將此意傳諭文武官員，就送孔明於館驛安歇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "4380bd85e5ecfeb5a637baa5955a12dc6c1c064e64e59058b0f15c34ae5a4340"}

{"id": "p_e4004f7f3a02bb3f", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 177, "text": "張昭知孫權欲興兵，遂與眾議曰：「中了孔明之計也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "a0804cfc18dab00e981c67da9ec95e06b60f5270dd403eaebaa4e4eab9b5e2ef"}

{"id": "p_90949d09ff0147b1", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 178, "text": "」急入見權曰：「昭等聞主公將興兵與曹操爭鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "11c32d48f755b457346affe1986bbc661cd8d69397b68da867a419981ad91e94"}

{"id": "p_12d7238328c92fbc", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 179, "text": "曹操向日兵微將寡，尚能一鼓克袁紹，何況今日擁百萬之眾南征，豈可輕敵？", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "33c2abe9229d0e00a70307d705792ed30a5c1ddd8b27b406f7874ed48aa5dc84"}

{"id": "p_b74aa5caa6c12d06", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 180, "text": "若聽諸葛亮之言，妄動甲兵，此所謂負薪救火也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "0609fe1585f5e58f19e3b3b615c26c7438a7dc37e6b811f100325b184ebc38b1"}

{"id": "p_d923ea86c3274465", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 181, "text": "顧雍曰：「劉備因為曹操所敗，故欲借我江東之兵以拒之，主公奈何為其所用乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "6bf2341d61c3c6fc40676c371966dd8fd6ee3da78835f7daab64ba72e2b9144b"}

{"id": "p_68d7577babf7a5a8", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 182, "text": "張昭等出，魯肅入見曰：「適張子布等，又勸主公休動兵，力主降議，此皆全軀保妻子之臣，為自謀之計耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "92917122830378d85de3552b4862564fab17f5696a317d1d4f9cf466d243d737"}

{"id": "p_9a4b6892efbcfccd", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 183, "text": "肅曰：「主公若遲疑，必為眾人誤矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "08fe100ea5b5c020e819ef1f0138abd8ac7efedba35c22641ac277a6647ee988"}

{"id": "p_64744798cbadef10", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 184, "text": "」權曰：「卿且暫退，容我三思。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "7e455adaefeca4ca3546e7f11c4fc9613d0f7ecc886b055f90f1a243e87452c7"}

{"id": "p_faefd790076e156f", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 185, "text": "時武將或有要戰的，文官都是要降的，議論紛紛不一。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "b48131d06ff603112a6445bc6cc2355e5f1a0585695768257d3d4f8841718e60"}

{"id": "p_39b3cd6cdd89e459", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 186, "text": "且說孫權退入內宅，寢食不安，猶豫不決。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "e8f4b79bf79415f4718b75743a0d68e88865b3441bd680ed57c36e8790fe741b"}

{"id": "p_cec0c936f7031492", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 187, "text": "吳國太見權如此，問曰：「何事在心，寢食俱廢？", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "070235b364121d1cdd26a5d15a3a39f47b6a82a4d5251e7c5028e60b81938fc2"}

{"id": "p_ae76cdcbf0e5b5f8", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 188, "text": "」權曰：「今曹操屯兵於江、漢，有下江南之意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "05d14222686b39e3884b6ec3fad611aaa94bfe4b9f45661294ea4f8ec9bc7895"}

{"id": "p_90cbc6da4c49c7b1", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 189, "text": "問諸文武，或欲降者，或欲戰者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "2fa07e971b0fa6f3cf91773f5fc38f1553fe17ae82efb9242fb4db92490d7d9f"}

{"id": "p_0c4542a96a099a5b", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 190, "text": "欲待戰來，恐寡不敵眾；欲待降來，又恐曹操不容。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "8f0c733d5c776b4ad7dae546517a984cdd2513638018cfb4c05d53b59b91f400"}

{"id": "p_6f471a8646db173c", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 191, "text": "」吳國太曰：「汝何不記吾姐臨終之語乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "842716e30ee57b257a4874c1ce3a6c705553150d9751d933d1f9e8a7a3927fc1"}

{"id": "p_fd43454826a74aca", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 192, "text": "」孫權如醉方醒，似夢初覺，想出這句話來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "6640ee149da3631a30a9c7726abcac692adf5f65638086806b49e7511492f269"}

{"id": "p_5f51a33ff1642fe5", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 193, "text": "::追思國母臨終語，引得周郎立戰功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "7682920fb25de6fdcfdf4fc2db407e4afa375fd3e07272032d3ac340576edcd9"}

{"id": "p_8a3a144a3097cac2", "source_id": "src_c2444c6dca986c37", "ordinal": 194, "text": "畢竟說著甚的，且看下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "3a2547779a17d52318d8a5c38ac8ba239df420deaf2ffe3f730c60bdf7737a8c"}

{"id": "p_a6cd5428afabd845", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說吳國太見孫權疑惑不決，乃謂之曰：「先姊遺言云：『伯符臨終有言：內事不決問張昭，外事不決問周瑜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "b5b41c15fad32df80aabe49bbd4dd281fe1137f6a24175b0deba1ceb28a74e55"}

{"id": "p_9c327f8daaa7a4b4", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 1, "text": "」權大喜，即遣使往鄱陽請周瑜議事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "8798f7b7995cf5563ee03face6661711d17935e3179350df1be1fc57f929b48e"}

{"id": "p_df384a34bdf653ec", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 2, "text": "原來周瑜在鄱陽湖訓練水師，聞曹操大軍至漢上，便星夜回柴桑郡議軍機事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "2334cfda514f458643829245bb398ef5d2ac7916abc2fcdbc06504fe77eac300"}

{"id": "p_5be8900e60257ef2", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 3, "text": "魯肅與瑜最厚，先來接著，將前項事細述一番。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "2312c380a684e108239e24d56755117d4942012eaef1faa59da044886e8d23a9"}

{"id": "p_5e2632bb2f0ca94c", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 4, "text": "周瑜曰：「子敬休憂，瑜自有主張。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "91dce17a6d44b7f27447937770ede9e3027a0dedb723fe25d50c08afa26453b6"}

{"id": "p_8897bfe11b37d5c1", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 5, "text": "忽報張昭、顧雍、張紘、步騭四人來相探。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "e451075335937d59a4b3c63abc528447700a067f037f5488c369025cdaccf3a0"}

{"id": "p_e5e084ab1a810503", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 6, "text": "瑜接入堂中坐定，敘寒溫畢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "0b68a70ab3edfa3b50b8eac9bbfb044944c6be13583fe21854c7c8f703f8c52d"}

{"id": "p_f97f3a4598d34623", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 7, "text": "張昭曰：「都督知江東之利害否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "f1558a4e578a1a48110c5d0fd0c91a8e3aeb215eed0c5ec641a1b63c683237ae"}

{"id": "p_2f7d1a5296ddccb4", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」昭曰：「曹操擁眾百萬，屯於漢上，昨傳檄文至此，欲請主公會獵於江夏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "fcfdd6871738a710c50dca01a9b4db1d76da6ef2a73ea04a3ca9eaf07137c4fe"}

{"id": "p_c22c1f0e59fe53f5", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 9, "text": "雖有相吞之意，尚未露其形。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "29bb35610cd564b4b46b6ece377d35515f2ff697c5a1d6abfeb159faa6ecad79"}

{"id": "p_22c4c4da1c15e59b", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 10, "text": "昭等勸主公且降之，庶免江東之禍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "6df81d9f4430184ddd1da6d2270437816ab5e2e77f5d7c547c1ec26db029e365"}

{"id": "p_6ccf46267ca160e5", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 11, "text": "不想魯子敬從江夏帶劉備軍師諸葛亮至此，彼因自欲雪憤，特下說詞以激主公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "5c2e9204a822f9a8d2344209261941e752f04986374237cdaccd3c9d89251180"}

{"id": "p_0dad173ffa9280ff", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」瑜曰：「公等之見皆同否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "da2b6b84e6d027003a8184023c4dc5769dbad72def497d040a3660067342670b"}

{"id": "p_30ec9ab92b03d5f6", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 13, "text": "」顧雍等曰：「所議皆同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "42be2791d865758a4a6134e3c25df1b027e06678a5dd9062179c6ad3124949a0"}

{"id": "p_5fce92577c5dbe6a", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」瑜曰：「吾亦欲降久矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "f408196ac1fbf01dab176395ff9d8626164688c029adb92b25e8b1b45f0b7993"}

{"id": "p_8befac64f0774e3d", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 15, "text": "少頃，又報程普、黃蓋、韓當等一班戰將來見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "833fc81bf6dd857352dcc68b13ba86f0560084cae586dd306e93fd5b9502ff15"}

{"id": "p_73e6a3390a5f84f1", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 16, "text": "程普曰：「都督知江東早晚屬他人否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "74a62b4232102ad9e8af76084ca1335a33f931135993c135d739179602ec5516"}

{"id": "p_6b531bed690cbf8e", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 17, "text": "」普曰：「吾等自隨孫將軍開基創業，大小數百戰，方纔戰得六郡城池。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "cd41cc11b72f062d6931ac94bd0f6288585e60b9d75aa0bf72744e4ba74bdd51"}

{"id": "p_216fad1b2f24da7d", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 18, "text": "今主公聽謀士之言，欲降曹操，此真可恥可惜之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "e41910851a5efe380be76a332109ff5cbe35ea73bc3e04d11ca37b31f3354c02"}

{"id": "p_89cffb56cee91dc7", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」瑜曰：「將軍等所見皆同否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "fc635569356359e2d9fb7b16d5971775589dce7dd459dfa900ce408393ead99f"}

{"id": "p_8c8d5c66d5067c07", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 20, "text": "」黃蓋忿然而起，以手拍額曰：「吾頭可斷，誓不降曹！", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "bd7f3ef2ade188661128b53333d72b4da752995588f78bb62003f42906cd3488"}

{"id": "p_eaf750380abeaf7b", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 21, "text": "」眾人皆曰：「吾等皆不願降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "d17631cc9007368c9e8248cf31266ec368fba8511ccb51be7af076ea67ade99e"}

{"id": "p_478c99b22e3472f8", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 22, "text": "」瑜曰：「吾正欲與曹操決戰，安肯投降？", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "679f56591066d69003a37a6e6fa79f0a74656fde0a9e27a0f952eb280e45a88b"}

{"id": "p_277711474dc2c91c", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 23, "text": "又未幾，諸葛瑾、呂範等一班兒文官相候。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "f93d22e6ba3010afa6d28cbd890b8f46f2582b687a5d3186adced1cc77b0b9e6"}

{"id": "p_36d7f38abd5ea430", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 24, "text": "諸葛瑾曰：「舍弟諸葛亮自漢上來，言劉豫州欲結東吳，共伐曹操，文武商議未定。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "56c906af733d010d9e5b6039426f140e554b9742f98f67357e8e478d3f750862"}

{"id": "p_300ece34710e27b1", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 25, "text": "因舍弟為使，瑾不敢多言，專候都督來決此事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "3af594cef4b85633f009b89bba887988a4d12452ffb26a2044c6a4c291ecf5ef"}

{"id": "p_74a9b66946bb5e34", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」瑜曰：「以公論之若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "165d5bcf73988c8bc8ef3aab0ce544ad5ee024e8412a5ff73fee7e53c1fb83ea"}

{"id": "p_5fd5391ffaac5d51", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」瑾曰：「降者易安，戰者難保。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "405be655f6f94ca3c17cfb04386300a8c6428ed903b206766d8a363b3e30a58c"}

{"id": "p_25faabb34840ba66", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」周瑜笑曰：「瑜自有主張。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "779dcc98a0bc406af47ae3f80e671fe7da16b929b65f3fdb19403d4c38a6f8a4"}

{"id": "p_978fe6faf667ae3b", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 29, "text": "忽又報呂蒙、甘寧等一班兒來見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "1a41304d88a4350a953ebf83a73138e7b99d31bdfd9ded9893c581a05ba28c10"}

{"id": "p_df304c69dd8eef00", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 30, "text": "有要戰者，有要降者，互相爭論。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "5c9049dbea414cbfb25df97ef91b1b5dbfcbefe26bdd717bada42a33692c7471"}

{"id": "p_384529ad5ffb9fe2", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 31, "text": "瑜曰：「不必多言，來日都到府下公議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "ba6108e2649ec10941407199447c3bec5a50e7cb68330ead22ee5cf9223ba9ec"}

{"id": "p_0f7ce7976ff58d8d", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 32, "text": "至晚，人報魯子敬引孔明來拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "b8e2843efd1a5ded74b12fb97ccf34e4c4b3f5c59b4f0a6bc223f95f4098d2ed"}

{"id": "p_5225f01f9d8b633a", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 33, "text": "肅先問瑜曰：「今曹操驅眾南侵，和與戰二策，主公不能決，一聽於將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "72e76dccb0e82acf4ceb351a846b6f08902283582c62b49fa285a5a7eb9ed4dd"}

{"id": "p_40592c08203fba83", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 34, "text": "」瑜曰：「曹操以天子為名，其師不可拒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "b9e9c577053d77e997414600710130ecddce1285cc1e1c8a0cf7207056e8c87d"}

{"id": "p_b2dde43c0fd639c1", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 35, "text": "來日見主公，便當遣使納降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "0e36399b127e22cc5720a839dd30255f4c3faa628fa5eba9688dc6011a824813"}

{"id": "p_4fadadeaac0f0f79", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 36, "text": "魯肅愕然曰：「君言差矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "819b9e680a2738cc21a9ead9ff48cf5eaae8fae5b52df732ce9e47f4922e2969"}

{"id": "p_6fa645ab62db7ec8", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 37, "text": "江東基業，已歷三世，豈可一旦棄於他人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "6d0b1224bbb56067e88db8547dae751698ab561f89bc517b02c91af3a3645283"}

{"id": "p_5926f2fde5f2aa07", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 38, "text": "伯符遺言，外事付託將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "10c7da2396ff19f8db4db39b18bc1c629b95609ceca4fa76cac113aafa4e56b1"}

{"id": "p_3dfdb1793c079c8a", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 39, "text": "今正欲仗將軍保全國家，為泰山之靠，奈何亦從懦夫之議耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "6549fe9190bec3debda6edb1f690d06b7f2df1cb162ad3a4e108f4a7d129b971"}

{"id": "p_93ad4e2ea372a31b", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」瑜曰：「江東六郡，生靈無限；若罹兵革之禍，必有歸怨於我，故決計請降耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "516a17b4007ce0e1ee17a16092720bf600ebd3c2bf036fe4b675edb06ee1c111"}

{"id": "p_a5823720ad64573a", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 41, "text": "以將軍之英雄，東吳之險固，操未必便能得志也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "d64b8a10480ea588a062d891721cbec796601571687b9ee1d35f6d26190ec973"}

{"id": "p_1772aa33ded20724", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 42, "text": "二人互相爭辯，孔明只袖手冷笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "672c7d3060e8ca5aabc34ad81fa98c7d5cb7618594917c4c53dc6727659f1dd0"}

{"id": "p_6acd21dc8ff8dd95", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 43, "text": "」孔明曰：「亮不笑別人，笑子敬不識時務耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "a9330ef3b58981563dde01dacf10f7e568262384fe0e80830d20adecdc2cf52d"}

{"id": "p_7991cfb98b2d22ca", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 44, "text": "」肅曰：「先生如何反笑我不識時務？", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "785f3853bd4f4136aa2ed8dd03c55307a2ea7b49516ca786f885f5865d53c6ff"}

{"id": "p_a7947845c9f65738", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」孔明曰：「公瑾主意欲降操，甚為合理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "9ad9f418fd77f0be770c1b9e411e1905e6d57ef78efb18096087931b80d46165"}

{"id": "p_96ee5220e606d2bc", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 46, "text": "」瑜曰：「孔明乃識時務之士，必與吾有同心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "6c1ed83c6cf2badfa2d43fffd315a34f79900710a22f6986b2954dd4c4a3cd71"}

{"id": "p_64060ecf416337b9", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 47, "text": "」肅曰：「孔明，你也如何說此？", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "abf56ffce142094d27839be5859b324f134e2f7600331ea394f573a329afe256"}

{"id": "p_16bae559accdcd00", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 48, "text": "」孔明曰：「操極善用兵，天下莫敢當。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "e408e6d5fb40f03d53f67e82b8b7919a33d7c55a530fe46db4ce3bcc058d44ef"}

{"id": "p_908fff8b12f764b0", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 49, "text": "向只有呂布、袁紹、袁術、劉表敢與對敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "05d5a453a3ee061409e01c524b41d365a53ee76a86ce0ade0af495266f6cf68a"}

{"id": "p_3b339a08d111f060", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 50, "text": "今數人皆被操滅，天下無人矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "18542ccefa4a672a013c5d4f21df36d7bbec9a1fac8932118a0ba328a5b1e2d6"}

{"id": "p_097ebc05ff6dfbf2", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 51, "text": "獨有劉豫州不識時務，強與爭衡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "00e8a19b68881dd4d76ac0ee420f907aee228e8c45edb39af95062e43eedec73"}

{"id": "p_241b49f4694470a2", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 52, "text": "將軍決計降曹，可以保妻子，可以全富貴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "01bd8654402a0d8f9193615900502fa9276994fdf7c1ccb5f88870baef9fc704"}

{"id": "p_bd4c99d4c4869f65", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 53, "text": "國祚遷移，付之天命，何足惜哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "32935ede5da1c89deb4f5163cedd70f20a2c01efd7e2568208515d38fa98330d"}

{"id": "p_cfb25fdf1ba0332d", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 54, "text": "魯肅大怒曰：「汝教吾主屈膝受辱於國賊乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "c89e6460bd853cd1f4228f73b2a71155f138fd4eddc0785d9279d82cde7c5398"}

{"id": "p_ae05e0c3c4288ba9", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 55, "text": "並不勞牽羊擔酒，納土獻印；亦不須親自渡江；只須遣一介之使，扁舟送兩個人到江上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "d59d537211c25040dbf9b69f6e2b58bc945d969b1c2e56d2d2448de64156b170"}

{"id": "p_74c62040d7686a28", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 56, "text": "操若得此兩人，百萬之眾，皆卸甲捲旗而退矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "d29a18bf838c45401951f3c495d8642c166eb995344ea072499f5e0ad4fbefeb"}

{"id": "p_841b087e0d2c4f29", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 57, "text": "」瑜曰：「用何二人，可退操兵？", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "38165f0f00633c7a160bdcf1bf5708e210ef1f64417b802a36c632e336a3468d"}

{"id": "p_b534370ccb04edcd", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 58, "text": "」孔明曰：「江東去此兩人，如大木飄一葉，太倉減一粟耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "3a9c615d8b0b3fb7372b9883e9445abd315297173f97b832e3e6b79abd2e723e"}

{"id": "p_bf0616ba2bd19175", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 59, "text": "」孔明曰：「亮居隆中時，即聞操於漳河新造一臺，名曰『銅雀』，極其壯麗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "f18332fbb33a211a535b1648645312a77fdc708eb0934b022b1741d7ffb87144"}

{"id": "p_9536a99c5c72987a", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 60, "text": "操本好色之徒，久聞江東喬公有二女，長曰大喬，次曰小喬，有沈魚落雁之容，閉月羞花之貌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "3cc3349adfc3fbe240b1bf68d65259636cbde408a503489f15c786a08d693f5f"}

{"id": "p_b08fbcf969e234e5", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 61, "text": "操曾發誓曰：『吾一願掃平四海，以成帝業；一願得江東二喬，置之銅雀臺，以樂晚年，雖死無恨矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "357be596a0c25dc4eaf71d5a526966c79cf9f10a5d6f0844f600301eb5d70458"}

{"id": "p_a69086970ae37cac", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 62, "text": "』今雖引百萬之眾，虎視江南，其實為此二女也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "5eb9038fadb1db0fabc479a24fd3b86f20e24aa701e2b38b686605af7febe64d"}

{"id": "p_9c7b116e7b81abf8", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 63, "text": "將軍何不去尋喬公，以千金買此二女，差人送與曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "e827d6bfff446938b48c13cb704c6879a0ab23905709887f095c5ec0af46563c"}

{"id": "p_912380c6eb458dec", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 64, "text": "操得二女，稱心滿意，必班師矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "26a50fb493883769fba650c0afbd8d352b5d2d8508c7ae831c91744c0234cbae"}

{"id": "p_421ba59792bdcee1", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 65, "text": "此范蠡獻西施之計，何不速為之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "a2ce2dd799a4ca413dabecf64db7e615b57500d7a7949dd8dc5b9f3e1f523478"}

{"id": "p_cf25cb0f98833061", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 66, "text": "瑜曰：「操欲得二喬，有何證驗？", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "790d1ddab88a6a1895b4466e5b0c3e0d58aab56f85c2e073ebfef3e63128e6f1"}

{"id": "p_8b3597a084c2341a", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 67, "text": "」孔明曰：「曹操幼子曹植，字子建，下筆成文。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "771c1943f06592b2f6422a2374d68aa9a797dd69c438107333fe683198a109aa"}

{"id": "p_1f31541ff0a29100", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 68, "text": "操嘗命作一賦，名曰《銅雀臺賦》。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "6139d7dc9c117bcacc6c4e45033eba834a499b3f3e9be51c7fb09bcdb36d8f1d"}

{"id": "p_974a21a51f846770", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 69, "text": "賦中之意，單道他家合為天子，誓取二喬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "38461b5788d86dba44e9382a19d625902af93608934db9181ca8b7fdd391aa5c"}

{"id": "p_8c4394e2b8c57705", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 70, "text": "」瑜曰：「此賦公能記否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "a4f929e50db3928be7547da2cda4dc327a3a2e7b5ff3ac4eafd850d5c3515e25"}

{"id": "p_bb699574a0a598a2", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」孔明曰：「吾愛其文華美，嘗竊記之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "a923c436d6642980739676ccf18e5e3740008794d5fc2e0872f2f843c5524000"}

{"id": "p_62d72d4eeb284f9f", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 72, "text": "」孔明即時誦《銅雀臺賦》云：", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "3df72a30978a34b1cdd6f2943b96d59484a892bc707c5b9f1321008303b6179d"}

{"id": "p_88aa831efc059216", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 73, "text": "::從明後以嬉游兮，登層臺以娛情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "5bfd6f9807e6f9e4f9e87712ad08394af4c3b79e08209d08c29b5f1401e6282e"}

{"id": "p_59c5169acca04fa0", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 74, "text": "::見太府之廣開兮，觀聖德之所營。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "0287b71b063285f62aff7eb9083bd3869373597ef8897c625159ee0bd6fc1b99"}
