{"id": "p_2afeebb821ffdb83", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 75, "text": "::建高門之嵯峨兮，浮雙闕乎太清。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "d06a3f4f69acf60963bff0988faaae1b8c96e2852c82314f8c8e1b7acfb89925"}

{"id": "p_adcbf1210df80123", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 76, "text": "::立中天之華觀兮，連飛閣乎西城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "44601e6bcae473782cf3d2a43cc104822881d0587e44442d3858a1d55668ac95"}

{"id": "p_9b1531814fafc15c", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 77, "text": "::臨漳水之長流兮，望園果之滋榮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "9d5ce247d7abea1e82a535358f1cba3ff61fbf748d59732fc21aedc78016d8e2"}

{"id": "p_d34d679cc42426e4", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 78, "text": "::立雙臺於左右兮，有玉龍與金鳳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "bb7d0a76e6e7c03e7f3ff0a06da4e2090bdd1be48677dcc18e4ec4bd264c407b"}

{"id": "p_ad4470e7f1c0053e", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 79, "text": "::攬二喬於東南兮，樂朝夕之與共。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "76dfca4e05eb6d1492a53f8878c5bbe94c8928fb9ce2b4cc79089c7fde1134c4"}

{"id": "p_785d7dd048c51685", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 80, "text": "::俯皇都之宏麗兮，瞰雲霞之浮動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "f1686e8cdff96155808ae105d1ddd6af88b9128439165cb2630e8f1ea8c31c35"}

{"id": "p_fb6dc23a376e9690", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 81, "text": "::欣群才之來萃兮，協飛熊之吉夢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "4110aa88c86e4e809b1ad1d2fdddb449d05dcdb1d638eecdb8d81b04ee057429"}

{"id": "p_90f5d011ca871ac9", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 82, "text": "::仰春風之和穆兮，聽百鳥之悲鳴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "a1a97df622927b7c191c2ed444583d6182a7d3a8c0fec66a0c15270341b6b21d"}

{"id": "p_997dbab57399e8c8", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 83, "text": "::雲天亙其既立兮，家願得乎雙逞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "e005ef5071048e15812ee6924728db6df38c26239b152c7c4ff37ba451a1ed40"}

{"id": "p_97426e3b5f1562d9", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 84, "text": "::揚仁化於宇宙兮，盡肅恭於上京。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "bcfc4aa3055e023305dc77e1b1dc50a52d352c79d0fe2b5ac7c8fd547b2ab4ff"}

{"id": "p_02580249b6faa917", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 85, "text": "::惟桓文之為盛兮，豈足方乎聖明？", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "b1247ca7d8920ea078eca6eeea6c6aa14af76d9eed988a9f6cd97725704bb7bf"}

{"id": "p_a3d147c3eacf8dbb", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 86, "text": "::翼佐我皇家兮，寧彼四方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "66396f3b545c943bd7a203e65e7618f031cdc91342c7bee6f4683d0b8eeacc73"}

{"id": "p_41e384edcf809691", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 87, "text": "::同天地之規量兮，齊日月之輝光。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "89a932a883afffde4bf167c9c6e3cb1c8284cca6ae4f4e010ba077f808de9bc6"}

{"id": "p_3b1f3abae707ef2e", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 88, "text": "::永貴尊而無極兮，等君壽於東皇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "52143c0856f6a05a7b7813d67afdae8438eac6a31f566e2e2f36940b87f46b37"}

{"id": "p_06b64feaeceacba5", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 89, "text": "::御龍旂以遨遊兮，迴鸞駕而周章。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "2ee0590b33f010e60e5d8a4577938d050582d8f0a19339aa8190e652f1887471"}

{"id": "p_eca71ec5bce005e9", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 90, "text": "::恩化及乎四海兮，嘉物阜而民康。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "b72185a5c05abd0bb9776ea8dd310bd03eabd2dfd51be001201c5c1e8c3493d4"}

{"id": "p_8bcec6dd2aad2bba", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 91, "text": "::願斯臺之永固兮，樂終古而未央！", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "2a6fd26a4939502ac795004be37ca464d76b7bbb11e3e10f82b03beff6f096de"}

{"id": "p_3d68eb7d4f538c83", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 92, "text": "周瑜聽罷，勃然大怒，離座指北而罵曰：「老賊欺吾太甚！", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "e8277044c9b269e0926ff6bbc3f7fe2fb0739a9d90858593590c5729c4af076d"}

{"id": "p_6a0927b5922c14fc", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 93, "text": "」孔明急起止之曰：「昔單于屢侵疆界，漢天子許以公主和親，今何惜民間二女乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "05dd209c31d96b1b40d0e63314b2e42cff50defc19c3429a8eb861d964a97625"}

{"id": "p_0c7fb33c205445d2", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 94, "text": "大喬是孫伯符將軍主婦，小喬乃瑜之妻也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "e7da4fc88b916547550d3995059dc60732bdeafe747a3649da60cf1954d8a94f"}

{"id": "p_e49ff16233b198ef", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」孔明佯作惶恐之狀，曰：「亮實不知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "708a0d35718f4bedfaf0c531a94c7232390f33db897df0947289794979c02291"}

{"id": "p_dfd858a2cee53575", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 96, "text": "」瑜曰：「吾與老賊誓不兩立！", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "b3b0f5928e13fbfaee420ed4b70a9ccac13e3463cafdcfc41756b0fba2b6c6f6"}

{"id": "p_1ffbc7033a64badc", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」孔明曰：「事須三思，免致後悔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "d5ab617c087d6fc99385c124badbead04a5c948ebcd5861e35ebfd836b413a43"}

{"id": "p_1f65f5fcd94f6e2c", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」瑜曰：「吾承伯符寄託，安有屈身降操之理？", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "bc20fa87739fbc003eaea613460adf80e140c9499e2f8ea9374df729e2e702a2"}

{"id": "p_fcac5f792faf472d", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 99, "text": "吾自離鄱陽湖，便有北伐之心，雖刀斧加頭，不易其志也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "9deb8f7f8901cc2fbcb76d662a4f3f6464e5caa6aaba9b7a226008653c9257f6"}

{"id": "p_dba6e03dd06365f7", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 100, "text": "望孔明助一臂之力，同破曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "39925466f28c33af4f3b707b53626ee0fd2963b8091985724282bd39983c18d3"}

{"id": "p_1eb340930ce44f2b", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 101, "text": "」孔明曰：「若蒙不棄，願效犬馬之勞，早晚拱聽驅策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "aba559fb4946c91b5506e084f2a2c4396c454feba877cecdc3a10fd2c424a95a"}

{"id": "p_e529969618cf3416", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 102, "text": "」瑜曰：「來日入見主公，便議起兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "df014c1b16e80d7b8f205068b898a0618dcf2e92fdf16fd473aae10e765bf8f0"}

{"id": "p_71f8ec7feaf7b84e", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 103, "text": "」孔明與魯肅辭出，相別而去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "a51cfc026dfa7b59ac03132c545dd1660b7f8aab3d8894e494789b2e10b8a08a"}

{"id": "p_a7f949e7227c5af4", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 104, "text": "左邊文官張昭、顧雍等三十餘人；右邊武官程普、黃蓋等三十餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "393e459020d5f5b7c0f727851225050d13814c2c2bc0972b766dc324fb5dbf7c"}

{"id": "p_e4374522955be742", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 105, "text": "衣冠濟濟，劍佩鏘鏘，分班侍立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "afcf595fa645a99106c0e71b0740ebdf881fa8fc1b0493adb1ea08288c0d7958"}

{"id": "p_fbeb2c719000846f", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 106, "text": "瑜曰：「近聞曹操引兵屯漢上，馳書至此，主公尊意若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "b36c357c554efacf165bbffc7024b13308a3640cf1249e5ab4bb3aa52998c208"}

{"id": "p_3af067cbd1362fa5", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 107, "text": "」權即取檄文與周瑜看，瑜看畢，笑曰：「老賊以我江東無人，敢如此相侮耶！", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "f65a4ca101c5129e8fe411c10bc0930bc64e77d1358911fa3ec1ad195a522da6"}

{"id": "p_0f06312350b65eeb", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 108, "text": "」瑜曰：「主公曾與眾文武商議否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "6d697c7e7865e7b3e6ee07a708ffa86fe0e42f4704ea2b7f7383be03e4eb3d03"}

{"id": "p_c81296c937885490", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 109, "text": "」權曰：「連日議此事，有勸我降者，有勸我戰者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "ab4dc21f31db345e002bf172ac145032e434c4cd7153cbd132af6f3bea3dcc49"}

{"id": "p_385b42327b0c0fab", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 110, "text": "吾意未定，故請公瑾一決。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "8d23ab0013d81ad1cadbf650ff9d3e569ea9376897d1943f9e90316b9f8be740"}

{"id": "p_cd7321ad9e71cd60", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 111, "text": "」權曰：「張子布等皆主其意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "8588bd9f3b96bebf527bb2455c247e1f676fbaad610c675b76201dc2e4f8714c"}

{"id": "p_66a8e115fb172825", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 112, "text": "」瑜即問張昭曰：「願聞先生所以主降之意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "f5d1daa48dbbb1842a6037977f6e22dc6de337fb8f951455884b9af7ca805cd8"}

{"id": "p_e892f653e56526dd", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」昭曰：「曹操挾天子而征四方，動以朝廷為名；近又得荊州，威勢愈大。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "8775118e32011cdbb8bec17cccf2c4913f314cc2a6654b3bd4da387a62aecf17"}

{"id": "p_c1e1486ada871b53", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 114, "text": "吾江東可以拒操者，長江耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "293bbe6581577d30aad7dff1a70c1e4b440d8e9ef97fdeaf2d8a4754a01f2e9c"}

{"id": "p_b73e11adef7a281f", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 115, "text": "今操艨艟戰艦，何止千百？", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "d11a89c0e4a197bdd671923360617854fed132c0afa74fd1768dff0e4b03a816"}

{"id": "p_f1509e8a4b6f0b86", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 116, "text": "」瑜曰：「此迂儒之論也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "598ad9f68876d7e998a975644f0be10dba20bb2b82735bd3a27a60ba480c0150"}

{"id": "p_26d3aa2e7da65471", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 117, "text": "江東自開國以來，今歷三世，安忍一旦廢棄！", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "d981c23a293c8a119e173193532ce3fd3c5265131035c008ea95ae2f46e8d608"}

{"id": "p_5efa9e2021f9cc8c", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 118, "text": "」權曰：「若此計將安出？", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "fcfbce7b0107a9c64d223f09f4ef08085fb5deec12f3b4ac2039261693f69943"}

{"id": "p_7cbf0617d328f69e", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 119, "text": "瑜曰：「操雖託名漢相，實為漢賊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "bc8fde04182f811f02b65dd34035a8965fee3862a71969a8cc6b2095f9870119"}

{"id": "p_50fece7e53ae15fc", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 120, "text": "將軍以神武雄才，仗父兄餘業，據有江東，兵精糧足，正當橫行天下，為國家除殘去暴，奈何降賊耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "b4e7648e39132973d2dff6fb6f0ea3787c2baed16e45cd853d776293e6128d8c"}

{"id": "p_37379a352703a7c5", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 121, "text": "且操今此來，多犯兵家之忌：北土未平，馬騰、韓遂為其後患，而操久於南征，一忌也；北軍不諳水戰，操捨鞍馬，仗舟楫，與東吳爭衡，二忌也；又時值隆冬盛寒，馬無蒿草，三忌也；驅中國士卒，遠涉江湖，不服水土，多生疾病，四忌也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "169d4fcefd11bb7fb6516e77231166ffae65b752675710446fd8b19a79a3471b"}

{"id": "p_3b1efb220cac6dbf", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 122, "text": "操兵犯此數忌，雖多必敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "90625b7ad489de49bd5fa78d62638956e9aaec8cc21e45d66eb9bc776ad000b4"}

{"id": "p_2fa443f5f3ba8456", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 123, "text": "瑜請得精兵數千，進屯夏口，為將軍破之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "9e9c8d122411387407fc68d8df4f2f29a7c56319093cb712d719d053fac5202c"}

{"id": "p_11e6807c7c2a88ea", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 124, "text": "權矍然起曰：「老賊欲廢漢自立久矣，所懼二袁、呂布、劉表與孤耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "481225da62dde505b03c2e8f41908620cc79cf60876298dda8c57ad910b545e3"}

{"id": "p_215b6c7800f87a39", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 125, "text": "」瑜曰：「臣為將軍決一血戰，萬死不辭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "b57a6093ad9e65e15fd54eb8cf0048c4dd22823ca51018081c0e4aa1744a2511"}

{"id": "p_704e76bcabcb415b", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 126, "text": "」權拔佩劍砍面前奏案一角曰：「諸官將有再言降操者，與此案同！", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "32ef7d9534c4c90d4541076d0241aa761091cd7e0884a1213795a312e478f669"}

{"id": "p_d76db4393e66bc2d", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」言罷，便將此劍賜周瑜，即封瑜為大都督，程普為副都督，魯肅為贊軍校尉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "5c8f1db2e75188a4da1ce882e3c096228cb89e661e8e4918ae550526b99d120a"}

{"id": "p_c3b519d7b0f99b94", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 128, "text": "如文武官將有不聽號令者，即以此劍誅之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "198a3c87355bee796e82205a9973cae72a30825a42ff33f9678798032e753b6a"}

{"id": "p_051f2fd49ab11d52", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 129, "text": "瑜受了劍，對眾言曰：「吾奉主公之命，率眾破曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "a5e5235f31f80754136405aa89607c5c22dbc2ade30396e698692b12e9546153"}

{"id": "p_ca8748765935fe2c", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 130, "text": "諸將官吏來日俱於江畔行營聽令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "82408cad745e6a8f1ac5df8858f75069b215a069edb6c49f635662b81a90a0e2"}

{"id": "p_ad09abeca2d0cdf6", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 131, "text": "如遲誤者，依七禁令五十四斬施行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "bc1bdb85b24778cfa02ba62e06ff4d969a6553a60b5b633435900b0a47e7f498"}

{"id": "p_c1a6844ce72b071b", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」言罷，辭了孫權，起身出府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "0f36d1383950d4daa20ea051055d8654829e5fe0e1dc66602ede2588d0b23743"}

{"id": "p_47bfb661004f233f", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 133, "text": "周瑜回到下處，便請孔明議事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "f0d57b7500db45f257296f01e596bfa824fdbbfb7788de878895cbce1ee60c3b"}

{"id": "p_d30329ab6a561027", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 134, "text": "瑜曰：「今日府下公議已定，願求破曹良策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "ad61eeeb7e082b74657781b4d3eeec08e6864125a5f1edf20203a3e6ae7740c4"}

{"id": "p_985238d6adde52bd", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 135, "text": "」孔明曰：「孫將軍心尚未穩，不可以決策也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "2c427e6e542eb2f7783d6972bb7f9b42520ab12d6868b2c3ad8ee7a04f2874c9"}

{"id": "p_234a1beb83915460", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 136, "text": "」孔明曰：「心怯曹兵之多，懷寡不敵眾之意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "4bb02b3dbbfe47c4d0dab87d7863f9dcd9948f9f0b1bbd96adc718545c2aee81"}

{"id": "p_bced8ef97918c755", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 137, "text": "將軍以軍數開解，使其了然無疑，然後大事可成。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "0e0cf7fe42ab3df848f59f5dfc01cec0fab714cd6666dc8d2af582615d86bdfe"}

{"id": "p_f9683cb86562e9a5", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 138, "text": "」瑜曰：「先生之論甚善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "b30437aaca15f955afe4138bcdd4177cd457e47186f633223367139247137f74"}

{"id": "p_5d84620d9948060e", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 139, "text": "權曰：「公瑾夜至，必有事故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "e0223620e3761f3f80e2c1c3baa736a4544b021c85ac689f411bfe6ec4487288"}

{"id": "p_53bd720f80bc8485", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」瑜曰：「來日調撥軍馬，主公心有疑否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "ae6099630d5111c47f7146d1097e6e24eae491a6b10f1725097421a597c63461"}

{"id": "p_eeccaf7f8f58612f", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 141, "text": "」權曰：「但憂曹操兵多，寡不敵眾耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "e52cac5aa22f5604778978ceadbe46541b7a883b0a6fd4677b7773bab8566ff9"}

{"id": "p_135ed7c67f39acd3", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 142, "text": "」瑜笑曰：「瑜正為此，特來開解主公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "183e4115cb243c80a03ab1a34053cf87e460929d554580a48ec4eba37387c52e"}

{"id": "p_1b7c7e4b60965ace", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 143, "text": "主公因見操檄文，言水陸大軍百萬，故懷疑懼，不復料其虛實。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "34d7a3b979fea15bca76792afd6cd3fcd5a504a76de46c311c9006d9e23d7a97"}

{"id": "p_2439f1ec47bb3a07", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 144, "text": "今以實較之：彼將中國之兵，不過十五六萬，且已久疲；所得袁氏之眾，亦止七八萬耳，尚多懷疑未服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "9896bc8b32e934ea5272336f4966f8146a9498da502808233e52a668e7675d1d"}

{"id": "p_5868b40e669fc634", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 145, "text": "夫以久疲之卒，御狐疑之眾，其數雖多，不足畏也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "a528fedb2e66bc208eeb5b8e4558f9d6c7cd6786500a672814f567573af8cb32"}

{"id": "p_f2bcc5ad2c2b0468", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」權撫瑜背曰：「公瑾此言，足釋吾疑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "ace7af250ec63e28399eae1ea64aeba4190c4f2c3517ff2f5541459f6a7a960a"}

{"id": "p_5e5c9c7ab137ffec", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 147, "text": "卿可與子敬、程普，即日選軍前進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "f9c5050fb4ab352029d2f208d03135048f7f49e709572f840cdf61acfbb5f7f2"}

{"id": "p_9f298c4e5057df53", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 148, "text": "孤當續發人馬，多載資糧，為卿後應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "b0e164380e760a681fb0abe61b266d1dabcde3f2c75533cf8feba542dc931c19"}

{"id": "p_e808014b0e2289d5", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 149, "text": "卿前軍倘不如意，便還就孤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "e81371ea29a489d6bbace6c2bfd5666858553b48dc30aca1e7619897e58bcc76"}

{"id": "p_aa9622824f55af17", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 150, "text": "孤當親與曹賊決戰，更無他疑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "6559750bfc785cef15fcb6bed35c9dd89576d6352401f8d86bde2952a2b5ee5e"}

{"id": "p_9de5b6ae55cb2773", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 151, "text": "周瑜謝出，暗忖曰：「孔明早已料著吳侯之心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "86310265e424e60e995e36c93d8c118adeabb5901f373205965a508aa12d2c2f"}

{"id": "p_2aadbf794ba16e6c", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 152, "text": "久必為江東之患，不如殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "86a7be19b5bda97f650c0cbab5c357e5f6aaa4a05bf4a591446a4069f8278fc1"}

{"id": "p_ad31bddcf5521c89", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 153, "text": "」乃令人連夜請魯肅入帳，言欲殺孔明之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "d98ed5004e79ebabbb2ba3d9c6ea7f9f70c95f7e7d940560ee8e79a99792c8f0"}

{"id": "p_e6c9e395ab218a23", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 154, "text": "今操賊未破，先殺賢士，是自去其助也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "304d8dbd35464b4e70d140d055961d3ebc016328c10239b1bdd26b9ddd7d5a65"}

{"id": "p_b49f662e96d8d9c9", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 155, "text": "」瑜曰：「此人助劉備，必為江東之患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "252d09ca7ae218590a7479968e30c3fa42b03b4bc4cc9ba007e8dc40f3b4f78c"}

{"id": "p_c4ee05058a0fd793", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 156, "text": "」肅曰：「諸葛瑾乃其親兄，可令招此人同事東吳，豈不妙哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "7260f415fe3bd734ea9db0f7a3d8078a5e8a15e1b1ed90941460c217c4a2581d"}

{"id": "p_7e0f96dd63bb691d", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 157, "text": "次日平明，瑜赴行營，升中軍帳高坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "0ed0ba72921afe4466d4b8d1846906485f6c543fedb4352d1e2f82a2f80b05b2"}

{"id": "p_a2ef46b0af7df535", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 158, "text": "左右立刀斧手，聚集文官武將聽令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "8d87f7e0cf1d620e98f02b8dc17d0782a87e7af6b73fe20bdc81f4772352e06a"}

{"id": "p_90fb0e256b50bcd3", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 159, "text": "原來程普年長於瑜，今瑜爵居其上，心中不樂；是日乃託病不出，令長子程咨自代。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "c7913153ae4ef29fbc40debfed134772834eacb8409fdeeea2ff25ea7fc32679"}

{"id": "p_820bc8120eef9ca2", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 160, "text": "瑜令眾將曰：「王法無親，諸君各守乃職。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "4e632ad42df3375af8e7efe8b9d15195236e50865457cbfbfadd574384218fd2"}

{"id": "p_7ed3513e7d9f9436", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 161, "text": "方今曹操弄權，甚於董卓囚天子於許昌，屯暴兵於境上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "a1ec11f2c98d7756419775cd9975ffaffe4f61861dce2abb5c24402fd13ca244"}

{"id": "p_93529134202cb6c5", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 162, "text": "吾今奉命討之，諸君幸皆努力向前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "545325a6fa5e0625223bda5545108ba2a8ba5fa1261051b167ff78dfc64a0b5a"}

{"id": "p_6f2d62b2e472c07d", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 163, "text": "令畢，即差韓當、黃蓋，為前部先鋒，領本部戰船，即日起行，前至三江口下寨，別聽將令；蔣欽、周泰，為第二隊；凌統、潘璋，為第三隊；太史慈、呂蒙，為第四隊；陸遜、董襲為第五隊；呂範、朱治為四方巡警使。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "e3d7c5d4f03e936769533bcbf2b6898e0fe2f19c7b68ef76e99cd0981e88bc7b"}

{"id": "p_87442af19d92d860", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 164, "text": "催督六隊官軍，水陸並進，剋期取齊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "29b86bcfce5f26666d0ee364fd02eb9cf0b293d50775b584a7709540dc80a658"}

{"id": "p_5d38cf134c4b92b6", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 165, "text": "調撥已畢，諸將各自收拾船隻軍器起行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "01b3182da7d68e52367661fed660f60f56e9a45da84a8a9f566c946148668308"}

{"id": "p_d15a70915e402f90", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 166, "text": "程咨回見父程普，說周瑜調兵，動止有法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "809ca78c69fe865955d589e00044798b4fac61c5357c076ba663408e197bccb6"}

{"id": "p_ad9e19f0929c65f9", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 167, "text": "普大驚曰：「吾素欺周郎懦弱，不足為將；今能如此，真將才也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "68dcfc34ae5f2106bc7f4627d96a0d19ac23b13e4529318077bda4187ce0adc2"}

{"id": "p_5314df8b2a1878f9", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 168, "text": "次日，瑜請諸葛瑾，謂曰：「令弟孔明有王佐之才，如何屈身事劉備？", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "cc36a8fb838203d37f6f75e7bc336201964a0458b6f31b66145e07b65fbd209b"}

{"id": "p_37922c5447835363", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 169, "text": "今幸至江東，欲煩先生不惜齒牙餘論，使令弟棄劉備而事東吳，則主公既得良輔，而先生兄弟又得相見，豈不美哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "2f981d80afb479d13d7f06483814615558a3c72a1d89c68c323bcd937d0403ac"}

{"id": "p_6795ac5b26c6de75", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 170, "text": "」瑾曰：「瑾自至江東，愧無寸功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "ccb6bb41ed21b45cf07fb5e6007b436facf4ab93a069c7227d8c06976e5667e0"}

{"id": "p_641e6271aad5fe29", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 171, "text": "」即時上馬，逕投驛亭來見孔明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "0901e01f94ec324dd27249578043534b0031f41e25e036859dfbd137cc6e9141"}

{"id": "p_c88d66bb525e8b90", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 172, "text": "孔明接入，哭拜，各訴闊情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "63558f15a4cfafe5d5848fc23e24ecfc7eb12752d3bd2744773f33d28c69a949"}

{"id": "p_1c433fb83994801a", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 173, "text": "瑾泣曰：「弟知伯夷、叔齊乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "1b3edbe367d46f3f9dbaf487986f977dd919e764bf376a6f970484a4d05e5be1"}

{"id": "p_ff120394863bf0ea", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 174, "text": "」孔明暗思：「此必周郎教來說我也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "93cfe8120c43fc2b3aa63849ccca02dbbb00e17357c56d36fa4252e1967a0612"}

{"id": "p_268ba75c60d768b7", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 175, "text": "」遂答曰：「夷、齊，古之聖賢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "cd823d8f5f750ef8f6f5e4345f3e0f3504619b66601f8938e2b7b3e4839d1262"}

{"id": "p_2301c2020543af82", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 176, "text": "」瑾曰：「夷、齊雖至餓死首陽山下，兄弟二人亦在一處。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "d44d3ef587a38a4b8f35e33f3eaa893efad55bd4619c542e28fa67b075385527"}

{"id": "p_069cb7d057c6dc06", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 177, "text": "我今與你同胞共乳，乃各事其主，不能旦暮相聚，視夷、齊之為人，能無愧乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "511d7b240dea505856c48c5a54f1ad5a2c8717bb171b3bea8e8d9d16bbe7c36e"}

{"id": "p_eb0bb36c05f98e4a", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 178, "text": "」孔明曰：「兄所言者，情也；弟所守者，義也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "c271917887246d94ac733b0304e2d95aa7decf22d79b438c21ed990604dcbd07"}

{"id": "p_05839140fab9a0f9", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 179, "text": "今劉皇叔乃漢室之冑，兄若能去東吳，而與弟同事劉皇叔，則上不愧為漢臣，而骨肉又得相聚，此情義兩全之策也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "9a3a724c48334324ef67fefec852cf65d91da3862c83316579ed7e6f35eaa8b8"}

{"id": "p_e75866222bb1afd0", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 180, "text": "瑾思曰：「我來說他，反被他說了我也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "9e34b002b8d16e44d44b91c0e59c637adf2f4a3458852d6a57b9a2db4f8a2fb7"}

{"id": "p_1b071c4acc106bc1", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 181, "text": "」遂無言回答，起身辭去，回見周瑜，細述孔明之言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "ea5d99dd7a46abe185dd805eed2f85ac9ae55e10bd195aad5607e9c8a62ca251"}

{"id": "p_da49fdddb04cba32", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」瑾曰：「吾受孫將軍厚恩，安肯相背？", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "e33e1c4586138e1ee36765a6d149cb86977deed152099902f5e82d63ccade904"}

{"id": "p_80fded85ce58b545", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 183, "text": "」瑜曰：「公既忠心事主，不必多言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "4d81501a5e28b2706268f27c66c2c985e23751aa18c7d9d94a1c3676f2975c70"}

{"id": "p_c5659fcb0045629b", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 184, "text": "::智與智逢宜必合，才和才角又難容。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "c9a9ed0770745fc2b0881156d08207db38cf49ee6415a6c180d38fa25a02aed6"}

{"id": "p_bd4958d7a5991475", "source_id": "src_195afc0d40bddd68", "ordinal": 185, "text": "畢竟周瑜何計伏孔明，且看下回分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "6fd981cc93af5d9d510fa031eb180c1c245e9ba9c09eb9ba22f64942cbfe7141"}

{"id": "p_3c778dd9109bb8bc", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說魯肅領了周瑜言語，逕來舟中相探孔明，孔明接入小舟對坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "d6380e6e614fc5cd35ef999c1ec97844b16de04ab38f6b66e98483e8a558337f"}

{"id": "p_fde45e8249737903", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 1, "text": "肅曰：「連日措辦軍務，有失聽教。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "806a3cb71cbfb2e04cf9729ad5cc80a363706aa528ecd8252ec07a8f318bb821"}

{"id": "p_1c380e84314afd41", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 2, "text": "」孔明曰：「便是亮亦未與都督賀喜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "adbd30e6ccfb382882d7061765ba652eb2e1a9aeb3c2e5b581b18854d8241cb3"}

{"id": "p_64c0e6305e49db39", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 3, "text": "」孔明曰：「公瑾使先生來探亮知也不知，便是這件事可賀喜耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "a1380abb6c2f3bbc4ca8db323efaeca47395180546a0f5a2c13a8d1f4681196d"}

{"id": "p_b695603bdb43f0da", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 4, "text": "」諕得魯肅失色問曰：「先生何由知之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "a30ddc448e359bc137d43c98d804632c71181fb73149708d6f58ba3a3655421e"}

{"id": "p_9a58bc791dcff3c5", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 5, "text": "」孔明曰：「這條計只好弄蔣幹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "9a7c3c79bcf078f647ac7a5950cfa94a876a11f9621aef1d6bd8bbb9fdd65863"}

{"id": "p_f0859eb63472b8c8", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 6, "text": "曹操雖被一時瞞過，必然便省悟，只是不肯認錯耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "a719a2152cdf422a37a5718a2ae05c5f92946bedbbca503855ce6b46dfbd8736"}

{"id": "p_3cd138deed937a9e", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 7, "text": "今蔡、張兩人既死，江東無患矣，如何不賀喜？", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "af7eaa975cc96ec6e0d66befef12407f8f3bc2bc105c5268b06aa64afffd14c7"}

{"id": "p_9cbd3e0a08535799", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 8, "text": "吾聞曹操換毛玠，于禁為水軍都督，則這兩個手裏，好歹送了水軍性命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "736d80869f3a81ea07327d04590c18e50b9d4b9b64435d88fceebcb79d99d4e4"}

{"id": "p_adf7cb96dd4d9343", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 9, "text": "魯肅聽了，開口不得，把些言語支吾了半晌，別孔明而回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "d58e925652cedb2863d5e06028c1d3ffc9439353ceca41d56f6f87800d1c256a"}

{"id": "p_445ee3b386c31caf", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 10, "text": "孔明囑曰：「望子敬在公瑾面前勿言亮先知此事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "2f0f6f763bc31ae84a62c75aa2031aab284af6bb33a2adc40f5ad2b8cdc6a8c0"}

{"id": "p_08fe5c8bc96ba413", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 11, "text": "恐公瑾心懷妒忌，又要尋事害亮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "b079280264287432a7a871d316abc5f74022eeef1088e89126ea3e80c5c31bcd"}

{"id": "p_6990890165dff70f", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」魯肅應諾而去，回見周瑜，把上項事只得實說了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "e294be1f701379ac7241a64f16aa2c91f079e5c23a8bc245a66c1cca676b87f6"}

{"id": "p_1ff27c076efa1fd7", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 13, "text": "瑜大驚曰：「此人決不可留！", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "a740669d63fb87f7da8db015b5eda9a01e21fec26f82b09fc1226e5d27ef6012"}

{"id": "p_b8b05d5462b88227", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」肅勸曰：「若殺孔明，卻被曹操笑也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "991722af8218765484ca6bf7cded7297fb5a26a6d223802702e06798deee0ccf"}

{"id": "p_ba8fe58b102573c5", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」瑜曰：「吾自有公道斬之，教他死而無怨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "127ccc2c47415e4d2b4c05bd38b6c2939d162ee6ac89fa2f2fcb38f1636e8525"}

{"id": "p_c23a10e708219912", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 16, "text": "」肅曰：「以何公道斬之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "5f6e9976bddf8549f4c67b80039ca888f23a865a3e797db3f82163aa62b1b64e"}

{"id": "p_0b655e4843a9c2a1", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 17, "text": "」瑜曰：「子敬休問，來日便見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "ff860471210ae0d9e7ee7c842ab9153ea48358ec52c9c09d9c8ad382c5211729"}

{"id": "p_0826c4ed5c994cf3", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 18, "text": "次日，聚眾將於帳下，教請孔明議事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "8e813d7e12802f99945c3c52f24a022a6833a7e9d898d399f5c3866ed03845d3"}

{"id": "p_c831286c2de1b576", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 19, "text": "坐定，瑜問孔明曰：「即日將與曹軍交戰，水路交兵，當以何兵器為先？", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "67f9b5794a4290999323247454574a586a7563072977ceb271e42a9c93fa3137"}

{"id": "p_8cfbc045819ee9ae", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 20, "text": "」孔明曰：「大江之上，以弓箭為先。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "b3de99f6f0873811954740db3a445f92d60c3f7833cbc7e918b76556b7c3b3cb"}

{"id": "p_82f52a1cbef8b3af", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 21, "text": "」瑜曰：「先生之言，甚合愚意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "46adfc909266efce5bea7b3ef4aebaea0982f4bc7c907c4dbaa195b1e92be4dc"}

{"id": "p_50cc1039aa77c67b", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 22, "text": "但今軍中正缺箭用，敢煩先生監造十萬枝箭，以為應敵之具。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "532b0a2fbec68d55317126adf5c183cd942eef64b6c2e8f54d7f01fb14e12252"}

{"id": "p_5b8bed548f14fb4d", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 23, "text": "此係公事，先生幸勿推卻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "7feb19208248333ccf019ffa8f08c860be3e0396ee84d0fcf57cb9a898ead185"}

{"id": "p_9f73b52510f3737e", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」孔明曰：「都督見委，自當效勞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "cd6b38a0be8dff6e5d168b4feb51e9ab28ed9097a1eecd454c2e24b877121f92"}

{"id": "p_e41106c089ab71b1", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 25, "text": "敢問十萬枝箭，何時要用？", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "92a1e9a3fefb37d7b8cb9449702bca5a83d3ded136e4b7bcd39c6d6ca2fe6e5d"}

{"id": "p_79d19008e8c6de80", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」瑜曰：「十日之內，可辦完否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "c0a558ed28a875775ade25b7a874ff710bb83f19319bd51a337c7b1c1ae060ba"}

{"id": "p_dd2415e35b46374b", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」孔明曰：「操軍即日將至，若候十日，必誤大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "aa63d18d0f362b25aca520ef97c424f1d3cdb5cf92503cd4ce25e5a40e4092c0"}

{"id": "p_09b3facce9258314", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」瑜曰：「先生料幾日可辦完？", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "cb7cb743bea91e6a2f193a046faf4f94c16859a796bda316ec3b1216107f1712"}

{"id": "p_bf4cf97e30c53870", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」孔明曰：「只消三日，便可拜納十萬枝箭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "c70c7f53dc409bcc236c077d72c3469dd5d454789d7893a53d5fcd126cf028ca"}

{"id": "p_856af1b90edfbfcf", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 30, "text": "」孔明曰：「怎敢戲都督！", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "672355f9b79e7cf342c0a15d1b80ae8647c755a9c80548897240c5c8e0d44045"}

{"id": "p_1b8a964b2901eb95", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 31, "text": "願納軍令狀：三日不辦，甘當重罰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "cb93d437ad21f745f7324d456ea90f04eea21da96f530bc52aec7b77b3e21d09"}

{"id": "p_1f17faf20d5c118e", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 32, "text": "瑜大喜，喚軍政司當面取了文書，置酒相待曰：「待軍事畢後，自有酬勞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "3a9127b0d80f7ec0edcbeba2c23e478686fa693eadb3429417b62427322cbb00"}

{"id": "p_12b8b819ff185faa", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」孔明曰：「今日已不及，來日造起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "cb616ad5020f6ec6eabb4ac0da05538e2408f84524b706ca33edd56a7bacd57a"}

{"id": "p_21b0c60f9e74d1a4", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 34, "text": "至第三日，可差五百小軍到江邊搬箭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "eb32f639f877d07b2fd6110f77d925633f06163eeade915387f89f05a41ab1b5"}

{"id": "p_b2013db638edde54", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 35, "text": "魯肅曰：「此人莫非詐乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "1e65c822d63f6ef20f8f9ff6922c8ce7156b35fd3e927c7ecc2151847553140c"}

{"id": "p_bf041aba608e2e11", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 36, "text": "」瑜曰：「他自送死，非我逼他。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "06792aea114b1ace34fe54563d235f5424df629d3559a6708eedbe205fbe3c5e"}

{"id": "p_8921633a1c3e07dd", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 37, "text": "今明白對眾要了文書，他便兩脅生翅，也飛不去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "68b192bc207c201fe5117a7b65d6fdd95814340c874f0e6c6a9044797760bfdf"}

{"id": "p_088c0e457f7f3b91", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 38, "text": "我只分付軍匠人等，教他故意遲延，凡應用物件，都不與齊備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "344bcaa59a7a081984f0d5610e7e37c252841762cc5fe05db27d179acbb7ffa0"}

{"id": "p_a715fc496083bc35", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 39, "text": "公今可去探他虛實，卻來回報。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "d74e460c4ca0df304966a6edf474d312dfecd9e1fffc5b28377e2b7d1fddb147"}

{"id": "p_f4cabb43dfba2389", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 40, "text": "孔明曰：「吾曾告子敬，休對公瑾說，他必要害我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "80b1949c32e9c8cbac0c795743e328f81c92bd32c121cdf04d8b6f3cb3ca5969"}

{"id": "p_3654395e07a71e28", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 41, "text": "不想子敬不肯為我隱諱，今日果然又弄出事來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "854a82b512f0c270d0ae729073b785d9327b7818bf1fc3fc9ef2c4de56fc2792"}

{"id": "p_97cf81eed0671bc2", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 42, "text": "」肅曰：「公自取其禍，我如何救得你？", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "97385cf40eb7129cce936d76b93f3b199f9c6cfd0e42db69580aacaf17d8e420"}

{"id": "p_75e55daa560697ee", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 43, "text": "」孔明曰：「望子敬借我二十隻船，每船要軍士三十人，船上皆用青布為幔，各束草千餘個，分布兩邊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "6a06653f4ea3cc5f22e4acdc95065aa9d95b22b889c26210b2e2f54a86b7e2d3"}

{"id": "p_4a1c551a6bd6753b", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 44, "text": "只不可又教公瑾得知，若彼知之，吾計敗矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "046b2eb76edee85640c163661e63da91b84062679914107a94da91abf0762d31"}

{"id": "p_ed175eddb538beba", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」肅應諾，卻不解其意，回報周瑜，果然不提起借船之事；只言孔明並不用箭竹、翎毛、膠漆等物，自有道理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "99898295c296560f029652041e1a27069fe99c8b3809096f2ac3647095de2fc6"}

{"id": "p_aa7b522a4c2c7ed1", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 46, "text": "瑜大疑曰：「且看他三日後如何回覆我！", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "7decd24c9cf296626fd16dfbd30ddd2e6b9f505a7a3a339350ea0672dbfa5f7a"}

{"id": "p_ef4ad6081beb329c", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 47, "text": "卻說魯肅私自撥輕快船二十隻，各船三十餘人，並布幔束草等物，盡皆齊備，候孔明調用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "de50bba49ae4a3bbf34c828d3bbd88724a2d9002b5b4b74ec4b99c134eddda54"}

{"id": "p_d777f3f96df269a9", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 48, "text": "第一日卻不見孔明動靜，第二日亦只不動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "4492ff531562c264d2a5caee6d8dc3116091338e347b7353eb385b977e02a8ef"}

{"id": "p_1f9b1fbbc5229d02", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 49, "text": "至第三日四更時分，孔明密請魯肅到船中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "af4df4110a3984e576ef74627936b020de09dec74deae9cb57bb13fd77561099"}

{"id": "p_dcf3352519b0ff50", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 50, "text": "肅問曰：「公召我來何意？", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "643bd600dadd1876a7928a4b6e797385fc9090207f08c6b5bc631ed59b860584"}

{"id": "p_d844ece2db3c7bf2", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」孔明曰：「特請子敬同往取箭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "1f9ceb137f0863ebc7be2038201bfc638f61f7b00573921d8e9ee719476c4c4a"}

{"id": "p_0375254ee1cb98ee", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 52, "text": "」孔明曰：「子敬休問，前去便見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "b1f33ce51511f79dd77544ad02dc343e794981ab4f320a84a7429f237d00f2d8"}

{"id": "p_1108caee8b93c076", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 53, "text": "」遂命將二十隻船，用長索相連，逕望北岸進發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "b3374d8a207b3d9e44329741a1085e993f4422beade40eed1e0da1419dd076dc"}

{"id": "p_fa6842f780a0cf35", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 54, "text": "是夜大霧漫天，長江之中，霧氣更甚，對面不相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "df16db66295a3e3107e4d2e97f4a1b08414b0e4b4ab771e5e487728579ebbb5e"}

{"id": "p_0892a4e7f7823a19", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 55, "text": "孔明促舟前進，果然是好大霧！", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "6580673b4e4c253eef4cb5ea8ef428754c421ebd113264c72f69cb7d575fa2eb"}

{"id": "p_2b365f6f98348710", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 56, "text": "前人有篇《大霧垂江賦》曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "c873401333919ad00acd0c7fb9aa553465bc6ba0975aacb92b61009031fda3cc"}

{"id": "p_d43273f98c91996c", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 57, "text": "::大哉長江，西接岷峨，南控三吳，北帶九河。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "129b971eec9698ec272cc75c9d277cfd7fc80a4df8d8490e991de31186c68292"}

{"id": "p_c2560d32060ba8c3", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 58, "text": "::匯百川而入海，歷萬古以揚波。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "214924f7adda7420b3c420a4d6268b4bd8c5848bfed0aabcbfb9eb49d2aaf915"}

{"id": "p_c388140ad9972c67", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 59, "text": "::至若龍伯、海若、江妃、水母，長鯨千丈，天蜈九首，鬼怪異類，咸集而有。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "ae7c2fce64815742b84bdcc88b1258cc3f718e693594290f3423154b775a82ca"}

{"id": "p_9313fb04a18a4cca", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 60, "text": "::蓋夫鬼神之所憑依，英雄之所戰守也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "f863d57b59eae9ce3cd18c01e23a25bfe378e2435357ae6fdc812e60e6931cbf"}

{"id": "p_bcae3665b00091bc", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 61, "text": "::時而陰陽既亂，昧爽不分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "df20db5015cae7031dca56b9b6f4050d2b01e8c8b1548da10a6c88ff7845deb4"}

{"id": "p_de71fa2e875ec56a", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 62, "text": "::訝長空之一色，忽大霧之四屯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "dd3230964564834e3eb79644edcff5d813e079a444ef1b2de06f67512fcf1367"}

{"id": "p_41400224cf5a9920", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 63, "text": "::雖輿薪而莫睹，惟金鼓之可聞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "189fb40ab42db00fcbe88743c52df4aedeee5a730a6d7fe3e2268924375eebc4"}

{"id": "p_eb847d79a712c181", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 64, "text": "::初若溟濛，纔隱南山之豹；", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "053606715317994774cfe31b8f2bb849f6e4ab4f6c2fba2dddd30b60f0bd7dac"}

{"id": "p_50e9f64fc4c3efab", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 65, "text": "::漸而充塞，欲迷北海之鯤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "e57af50211a3b3e5eb3afa7f890ae32d0edb7c2439668e8bbdf84183405ca2da"}

{"id": "p_9277e1ac63091ef4", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 66, "text": "::然後上接高天，下垂厚地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "d28a9f16804015cf1891b7e1a2042810ce470be603f10ea856e841a8f5d86171"}

{"id": "p_2d97bc8abc245edc", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 67, "text": "::渺乎蒼茫，浩乎無際。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "160064d2c34761f2d89df5111431806e3f773cc17211fe6b36db0a3db9fd8626"}

{"id": "p_e22b5b0e5d5f8f74", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 68, "text": "::鯨鯢出水而騰波，蛟龍潛淵而吐氣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "c40804e161f0a59443ade35952e00fd518bac5517a279822e7cca3276e6e079a"}

{"id": "p_7c77a04c18a32117", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 69, "text": "::又如梅霖收溽，春陰釀寒；", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "ef24264cda7fb72de8338365472f552201715a77e395c7b54b5bbb57a664059f"}

{"id": "p_5b73bb4fdcd5aded", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 70, "text": "::溟溟濛濛，浩浩漫漫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "8ff410e5188cf7cc8cc01a334f4fc82be7313376d229e9e7733923984d5cf871"}

{"id": "p_993932d4301ab95e", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 71, "text": "::東失柴桑之岸，南無夏口之山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "26e762fb32f615ae533d8e46a969146d48ba6bca5fc9fa4dcf481fb2e66bf2a9"}

{"id": "p_1603735c252e81ef", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 72, "text": "::戰船千艘，俱沈淪於巖壑；", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "6bd56fa67519ea84f52d06597da49000a9afc65d8c3967f45f232bf75fd0aec4"}

{"id": "p_8b042ec212547ab7", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 73, "text": "::漁舟一葉，驚出沒於波瀾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "ea526e6bd0695bfcb620ab592f6aa7635963e5f361e3b36e752afc024ef77834"}

{"id": "p_3709e9ab4175ef67", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 74, "text": "::甚則穹昊無光，朝陽失色；", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "317935fb7cd12a4f7bc42115aea2572170d3c5402e47f4622989c74f47075c23"}

{"id": "p_a678c5a368ef8f83", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 75, "text": "::返白晝為昏黃，變丹山為水碧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "81ae01b8d308960254fea5ce5b7ad09113a565fc99d9fbe58b5fd055046e84fc"}

{"id": "p_eef663d5e3e960a3", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 76, "text": "::雖大禹之智，不能測其淺深；", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "487f89c0fb64427187cd6e91c132e7b8685751c4f7c7b4601f973909a86595d3"}

{"id": "p_2975bbaa8a3fbdae", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 77, "text": "::離婁之明，焉能辨乎咫尺？", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "5400a088504e5ef28f5ea65d730cec55357f476b5aa1bd74da12293f9d133284"}

{"id": "p_f74dff106f388387", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 78, "text": "::於是馮夷息浪，屏翳收功；", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "e2eea40d6ef771cfd5ddaab291980259f4e84f3514eaea0c79519ac000510faa"}

{"id": "p_557e0116a4a59416", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 79, "text": "::魚鱉遁跡，鳥獸潛蹤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "4048888bae903d42a7829befeb206eaa83e11e60b452d5e72c83a4b295296609"}

{"id": "p_d63c6bba962adbe0", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 80, "text": "::隔斷蓬萊之島，暗圍閶闔之官。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "4f48454f0d85770b59119ed5ed78c906dabf7f6c2796ffe33fb4c78bfbb7c84d"}

{"id": "p_f44915db906339cb", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 81, "text": "::恍惚奔騰，如驟雨之將至；", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "905170a7e2ba626c03a20b65c65c4e2c51f55b7817c66b0279678929a8929a65"}

{"id": "p_c8cbac6534e31755", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 82, "text": "::紛紜雜沓，若寒雲之欲同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "6e30031bd1b0b31d120184891c144858f67f9187d6e8474badb56fb20c8d6344"}

{"id": "p_60500561c76bcf85", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 83, "text": "::乃復中隱毒蛇，因之而為瘴癘；", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "04aab16d5cefa1b6b11e8497f85276b735c507360206be5f05f01ae9ea4bba0d"}

{"id": "p_21663583a3ea97e4", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 84, "text": "::內藏妖魅，憑之而為禍害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "9ad5048e9c273de1f7aa481a9926958190beafcb28389defa6c68040b2ebae28"}

{"id": "p_4e054dfeb497f42e", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 85, "text": "::降疾厄於人間，起風塵於塞外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "216d01444ffed7a952c9be5665eef7f31a23585a8374f6296d235aadd4c84639"}

{"id": "p_6e89a5f742f5bcc8", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 86, "text": "::小民遇之失傷，大人觀之感慨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "79279ddb2065f2cc949c0932e9c99a7b837f88ae0e0c432a1015e2b984acf978"}

{"id": "p_5b3b9aebfcd5297a", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 87, "text": "::蓋將返元氣於洪荒，混天地為大塊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "6a0c4c6835660a26490f7b964bdaa77b5ced54fa138e8f743b8bcb79e6262e50"}

{"id": "p_1ed8e938c0e28484", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 88, "text": "當夜五更時候，船已近曹操水寨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "7f8c32aa330daf27ffca72df85fe319b23529a870aefd7c2977cf117251d6af7"}

{"id": "p_375ea22f7314c4c8", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 89, "text": "孔明教把船隻頭西尾東，一帶擺開，就船上擂鼓吶喊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "c63a2395590384555b8f667db8bb13878c2f089eb85e6e275f280fb4f3db5f08"}

{"id": "p_8eb00909cebdfc06", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 90, "text": "魯肅驚曰：「倘曹兵齊出，如之奈何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "9abf2124f0df077150a39c9fe041be89538b83900deb574c474057154f89a94b"}

{"id": "p_21246003271203ac", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 91, "text": "」孔明笑曰：「吾料曹操於重霧中必不敢出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "dff38e6441db426790e3105187c0e4b6c6e135678d97803b2f03f5f2710bc425"}

{"id": "p_7104bb85fe1baa4f", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 92, "text": "吾等只顧酌酒取樂，待霧散便回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "a7bd98ce2bcd1a1b0182455b121df2ab088bb62d5db4c4efd4e58e3729f310c0"}

{"id": "p_b27e04beffe9d063", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 93, "text": "卻說曹操寨中，聽得擂鼓吶喊，毛玠、于禁二人慌忙飛報曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "2216c2785dec1781edbff19b58fecea0daf0f4b92e9cb734916b3a32cb4143ff"}

{"id": "p_d9196047febf7544", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 94, "text": "操傳令曰：「重霧迷江，彼軍忽至，必有埋伏，切不可輕動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "24ab454cdd8a9d48e62d8d19ff32ea4298d89682c6c5a5857b861b84c0bbf64c"}

{"id": "p_0229d751e8fb3193", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」又差人往旱寨內喚張遼、徐晃，各帶弓弩軍三千，火速到江邊助射。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "0baf441d0f6a23beb25996f7922dac8ec566daf9842d418a56a9bd3ada970e9b"}

{"id": "p_1641127db669b44f", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 96, "text": "比及號令到來，毛玠、于禁怕南軍搶入水寨，已差弓弩手在寨前放箭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "3474165bdda9dcb9340f74318e6595ab7aa5c5fb5129aba8ecb516a0be79b7c2"}

{"id": "p_2e54acbd52bbb1a3", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 97, "text": "少頃，旱寨內弓弩手亦到，約一萬餘人，盡皆向江中放箭，箭如雨發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "3743dc5da727cb044dc8ce91c410cc6906dc8e9b31559951f4f01700a10e9f0f"}

{"id": "p_e4edbde0c1000036", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 98, "text": "孔明教把船掉轉，頭東尾西，逼近水寨受箭，一面擂鼓吶喊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "a1dcd8073b1d5f9ec4f0a787ed6b46b665ec182050646fbd35d353c05feec795"}

{"id": "p_ee931a6bddc7acb4", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 99, "text": "待至日高霧散，孔明令收船急回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "facea4ebfcb6b99a0f320da991aae2a9ac327617da0466f64c1731208eaf8a68"}

{"id": "p_3e1fc8dec2f24bb4", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 100, "text": "二十隻船兩邊束草上，排滿箭枝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "fa0739f2d6a4c47708ec0acf92e3d78a42f012933b9459a0cc41d2f8dd0267d5"}

{"id": "p_7643dfad60ac28d0", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 101, "text": "孔明令各船上軍士齊聲叫曰：「謝丞相箭！", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "bfe18ab9d68f94590bef2a6f146d9a68b24d3c3d3be3a0c74948b1e95ba957f4"}

{"id": "p_1da6f195bce7ca23", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 102, "text": "」比及曹軍寨內報知曹操時，這裏船輕水急，已放回二十餘里，追之不及，曹操懊悔不已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "d878718fbf396c735be4a28a3fa08619081a75e610e81db463c53e8785f99621"}

{"id": "p_68eb890db313b088", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 103, "text": "卻說孔明回船謂魯肅曰：「每船上箭約五六千矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "e1038bb4207a73eb3c0f97327666f90e14bc938ad09a6ef27077c1673c50dd39"}

{"id": "p_20cb4cca1800197c", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 104, "text": "不費江東半分之力，已得十萬餘箭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "ede7ec7e7b540d081906f739dc1024acfd188843a8ce761f641f07bac7e270eb"}

{"id": "p_ba051a3fc54d3f9b", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 105, "text": "明日即將來射曹軍，卻不甚便？", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "ce2db28a150cd6992437ec816c472b31dbd8a33d62b481ba07642b5f86b87690"}

{"id": "p_c44f57cd67d59bab", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」肅曰：「先生真神人也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "ffab0552cff3a541823c4b99e8eeccf82c696f533b388e9d4726f3bc80937575"}

{"id": "p_fbdcaaaf1a2300ff", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 107, "text": "」孔明曰：「為將而不通天文，不識地利，不知奇門，不曉陰陽，不看陣圖，不明兵勢，是庸才也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "94d1299931830d0b871ecdbbbe51712a7e932737dda8eb54e99766dc72845070"}

{"id": "p_8e8df702288faff0", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 108, "text": "亮於三日前已算定今日有大霧，因此敢任三日之限。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "078599166e573a16fe09909649280e8ab73d459fcf562f826f3816bedfd272e6"}

{"id": "p_aa22864dc172a6a9", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 109, "text": "公瑾教我十日完辦，工匠料物，都不應手，將這一件風流罪過，明白要殺我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "847a3ec78d7b32ea28aa6f113709caa58f8a34da5df1214a794c9e206a841a8b"}

{"id": "p_68ac91a893e5a8b5", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 110, "text": "我命繫於天，公瑾焉能害我哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "75dee6b2d740595ec0541e13ff53a45bfa1e00c18163a235afb58c94aaa67c83"}

{"id": "p_a96ef3a489c9dfd2", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 111, "text": "船到岸時，周瑜已差五百軍在江邊等候搬箭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "2778e4fbf5f6622e3cfa7324f5c361e8d1e400c2cad8b7e4fad4ef72cfc59a46"}

{"id": "p_32a6514f1478d5a0", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 112, "text": "孔明教於船上取之，可得十餘萬枝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "1dea1395af42cbfd688fa8e5554a8d0ca8d6154d39dff32748b6dd989483d1c0"}

{"id": "p_235939772d62092d", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 113, "text": "魯肅入見周瑜，備說孔明取箭之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "c8e8fa9859da9ca966ca9a9c521324ae9ec84e05c41ca885ffd14841fe882598"}

{"id": "p_d54b4ddfe2b61599", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 114, "text": "瑜大驚，慨然歎曰：「孔明神機妙算，吾不如也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "7eae793571024542fbf74bcbf18e218443a3346bafc1b4b652e595deeda654bc"}

{"id": "p_4f61653652fb1c72", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 115, "text": "::一天濃霧滿長江，遠近難分水渺茫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "1e503c40ceeb30580d46f0ad51edeb7495f5a6ef0eafce6c4d7ef9f52ed0a26e"}

{"id": "p_892c4916c8a97ee3", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 116, "text": "::驟雨飛蝗來戰艦，孔明今日伏周郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "2464138bb009df47e2e11f8289c8e9a13471c75b0962de15f40870e4fc5ff69b"}

{"id": "p_11b05ae255b910ce", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 117, "text": "瑜下帳迎之，稱羨曰：「先生神算，使人敬服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "525a30891d8cd41b65c3247f523dac5a36a7b66e1bf8bd4d095c68c175852f8d"}

{"id": "p_d31af924b7da6e9f", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 118, "text": "」孔明曰：「詭譎小計，何足為奇？", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "fc13d04fcaf2fffcaf10404f11177891ba805cb9e9bb66cb51255d7025d79f5f"}

{"id": "p_461b2cd820ca9ef5", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 119, "text": "瑜曰：「昨吾主遣使來催督進軍，瑜未有奇計，願先生教我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "a899e9497e9fdbf8409dcc115c36637eee965f87d7326e0d0e3367ef03b89ad6"}

{"id": "p_4ec6b4463695a724", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 120, "text": "」孔明曰：「亮乃碌碌庸才，安有妙計？", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "2cb5fece7f7e462b553c6c9eece5a7e0804df336957bf0814e1624e2f5de0032"}

{"id": "p_a96cd5947304601d", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 121, "text": "」瑜曰：「某昨觀曹操水寨，極其嚴整有法，非等閒可攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "719993d409defbedec93b06928dbec812fb7f882ad143802031a7e9b756f4452"}

{"id": "p_7f063bb28bf5fc94", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 122, "text": "思得一計，不知可否，先生幸為我一決之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "dd1b6ecb95e6f4f5209a13676565d5b7423d0fd7f4d67c38f85c1ba414177361"}

{"id": "p_91048d49bc69d8a5", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」孔明曰：「都督且休言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "e0352cc4d75b006a8c9b5104342d90cb58b39b01ce834729b63efdae913f446d"}

{"id": "p_bab5c0fe1fcd241c", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 124, "text": "各自寫於手內，看同也不同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "740972cfd1ae3ad3cc89e8a1d674314112201cbf6c176df5d7619278c26936aa"}

{"id": "p_a0e408e00a2e7996", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 125, "text": "瑜大喜，教取筆硯來，先自暗寫了，卻送與孔明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "fbe4bce801ca5bdc9bbc231e3f95fab9ac58164afd171ff19530202f86ba27c9"}

{"id": "p_f505acb8d15aaa9b", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 126, "text": "孔明亦暗寫了，兩個移近坐榻，各出掌中之字，互相觀看，皆大笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "e215a97dfb6d857806af589c00b1923ba1b7bfcad1357841c73f1a22f8bb6f59"}

{"id": "p_451bf0161f6a3e28", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 127, "text": "原來周瑜掌中字，乃一『火』字，孔明掌中，亦一『火』字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "764508270d55463d3afd9cd88aaa66473bc44b730844c6eab5c52b752db7ed44"}

{"id": "p_a3fdb9c34ef7cdf3", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 128, "text": "瑜曰：「既我兩人所見相同，更無疑矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "53c84cba2b5a6f785c5d9dc8638db8c48c9df13a465ee3a77dacd9ca8cf7c680"}

{"id": "p_2f22c3ce69e89079", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 129, "text": "」孔明曰：「兩家公事，豈有漏泄之理？", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "28351b4bd45c06a0132d4fd494806a46c20f0b16d10f40e8910d60bd1e90183b"}

{"id": "p_5652345a1ee605c4", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 130, "text": "吾料曹操雖兩番經我這條計，然必不為備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "2133e54482e22eaf0f37d53197a834a679f1af7aa42e6b9a91c1acc524a8f6ed"}

{"id": "p_c8e277c40eefda98", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 131, "text": "」飲罷分散，諸將皆不知其事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "0a51738e1e4ece4c75ac07a7d64c92a3144a2abb04fac177a7ba444c826dbe2f"}

{"id": "p_4204aa88e5ca6c9f", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 132, "text": "卻說曹操平白折了十五六萬箭，心中氣悶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "848e7698c538eafbab5069fd2ad8a111cc159abb063381ade1528bf547339f4c"}

{"id": "p_b2a72b7a1c0a4607", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 133, "text": "荀攸進計曰：「江東有周瑜、諸葛亮二人用計，急切難破；可差人去東吳詐降，為奸細內應，以通消息，方可圖也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "1906a25982e298bd6b8a5e19848318b963868f80b4680fc69b9a3333ac74e70e"}

{"id": "p_d9819232e7e88281", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 134, "text": "」操曰：「此言正合吾意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "da48bd59749bad8c3edb37ed3113deea1500ba04519ab6163ae4c2d958c0f988"}

{"id": "p_4470b7fa65bbffcc", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 135, "text": "」攸曰：「蔡瑁被誅，蔡氏宗族，皆在軍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "99afb2cc2e682678b7427196559d9ae80d718ea0918e66c36926a27c94030375"}

{"id": "p_f3bd43c8e498a137", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 136, "text": "瑁之族弟蔡中、蔡和，現為副將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "f86c52efe36301f33441d50da5d1c6518fbaef6e39d76bee39caff29927bb030"}

{"id": "p_dac71f504a04923c", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 137, "text": "丞相可以恩結之，差往詐降，東吳必不見疑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "c04acfc628cdce62d327304191372cc2440ade13acd13d52e8606e73501b620f"}

{"id": "p_c0ae249438d8f82e", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 138, "text": "」操從之，當夜密喚二人入帳囑付曰：「汝二人可引些少軍士，去東吳詐降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "1484acbe04c1204a7f9d74a7c757de601d8ca5c5ad831e3c719691723d06d60f"}

{"id": "p_40efa1ab6bac9937", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 139, "text": "」二人曰：「吾等妻子俱在荊州，安敢懷二心，丞相勿疑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "d03421add7fff217951ab8e2489f28932f4a5b8a228587723e1906f34464ff92"}

{"id": "p_8403196e8904f6f2", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 140, "text": "某二人必取周瑜、諸葛亮之首，獻於麾下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "a56948897585b756c04c3cdf6f7e2e1cf5dd16708672e542f0ef8036ecac082d"}

{"id": "p_c999eacffc624f4e", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 141, "text": "次日，二人帶五百軍士，駕船數隻，順風望著南岸來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "e49a9ed59ca8d36e6ccaa1e35e354f4ec0f2a4ca7239bfff2e4d7e2a930378a2"}

{"id": "p_936d5917f735a168", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 142, "text": "且說周瑜正理會進兵之事，忽報江北有船來到江口，稱是蔡瑁之弟蔡和、蔡中，特來投降，瑜喚入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "3b5fbcf4f393a4234efd525e7e5800e0b0e1c6f771a1231420e577473cdaffac"}

{"id": "p_d4e44b90ac9b16dc", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 143, "text": "二人哭拜曰：「吾兄無罪，被曹賊所殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "c6baf3f110c2854fee1f423f80e5aebc20d0d1f1ee72eb7a13ae4caaee3a925c"}

{"id": "p_0b363184c6ae8736", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 144, "text": "吾二人欲報兄仇，特來投降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "29fd6925ecc4461f434b6ad7e0e9728bfd9e72624981e2981fa905a938eeb469"}

{"id": "p_177425761bc6622d", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 145, "text": "」瑜大喜，重賞二人，即命與甘寧引軍為前部。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "0a92aed83979ce1c0e631b74b2d391de87772bde9d97e2b90b12b5e5ce165913"}

{"id": "p_ef02f7e4f0457eed", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 146, "text": "瑜密喚甘寧分付曰：「此二人不帶家小，非真投降，乃曹操使來為奸細者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "964e283214343dc81b3d47b6bea0ccddeab7a917b2c3383c7251dd220004d0b4"}

{"id": "p_498f9ef8b17b193a", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 147, "text": "吾今欲將計就計，教他通報消息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "2d488f8759ca97fdc4cb07b127f47adeb937ed084aa3234369cf5bc8f88bccdc"}

{"id": "p_80515a73f352a305", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 148, "text": "汝可慇懃相待，就裏隄防。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "6f792c5a6e30fa7d2b43ab907af868a03c3e24b71a6dfff6592961c6d52300df"}

{"id": "p_05ab4313240d3d87", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 149, "text": "至出兵之日，先要殺他兩個祭旗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "04f6acf5cd5dedbd4c8245b6b715d172ccd3cf1aba8f087284865441b45c17cc"}

{"id": "p_05b0d3d762f2b942", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 150, "text": "魯肅入見周瑜曰：「蔡中、蔡和之降，多應是詐，不可收用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "7f9a92682ff2d1d2ecfdd6c97940ddf8866f1d4ebfbcca6e6db1895b960e8723"}

{"id": "p_e97899497dbcff6f", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」瑜叱曰：「彼因曹操殺其兄，欲報仇而來降，何詐之有？", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "57397bb662df1c4a0be1eb1fc9e5196dc92d6bc4f1c6a66a0410a9b416e13481"}

{"id": "p_263dfa2dd19ca069", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 152, "text": "你若如此多疑，安能容天下之士乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "11f4556c0abfaa82c840c3e1d6a90181ba8119a69b2c624ffb1748c4600fdf81"}

{"id": "p_69929d34df4d57a7", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 153, "text": "」肅默然而退，乃往告孔明，孔明笑而不言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "065a29718d34a6f349273bcd2e4e41bf3f20d945590a8997994a9b32f30ac145"}

{"id": "p_20a8082db5c40cb7", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」孔明曰：「吾笑子敬不識公瑾用計耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "75e164a141d4f256ebf9db59d67f7eee025ebd37671d8f8379ad20299a391591"}

{"id": "p_3e7b76a7d15778a9", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 155, "text": "大江隔遠，細作極難往來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "eafae3e2ce92b836ec64c485e8371c0ecd9fd559e555ae4879680d486ed9c29b"}

{"id": "p_f2ed989196476ae9", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 156, "text": "操使蔡中、蔡和詐降，竊探我軍中事，公瑾將計就計，正要他通報消息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "5b567430010ceedd3db65a47006d19f6f955171223b83456940083fe05308f49"}

{"id": "p_46169caa7dd22f19", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 157, "text": "兵不厭詐，公瑾之謀是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "2919e367becc85ea9da0d5468ba83544f6d4afa0da0be7bae7943bff419ce154"}

{"id": "p_473f9a701c45d765", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 158, "text": "卻說周瑜夜坐帳中，忽見黃蓋潛入軍中來見周瑜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "aa008cf09a5507e676f7e8ccc598f74298f16cb50aa9955c93c4978f4edae723"}

{"id": "p_64d046009c6722c7", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 159, "text": "瑜問曰：「公覆夜至，必有良謀見教。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "b3f7a74c7a28be096466a1c51eca886eaeceb4263def8444024277e685382381"}

{"id": "p_6e8e61602b34677e", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 160, "text": "」蓋曰：「彼眾我寡，不宜久持，何不用火攻之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "13350428a3f60d77e9a2c6a1d066a52c47e52afe583ea8ececaf04a7f3b1a5f4"}

{"id": "p_4967c3d1fa75e71f", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 161, "text": "」瑜曰：「誰教公獻此計？", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "736bb6cb8e3472c49c337da8c703af713780d101e3884cd999fb958cb16de5fe"}

{"id": "p_f67c6deafc699ea3", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 162, "text": "」蓋曰：「某出自己意，非他人之所教也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "1ed784749a145e6916c9b769463a3867a9bc3f2170c331211948e3ded133cf41"}

{"id": "p_b767263e9c4eb639", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 163, "text": "」瑜曰：「吾正欲如此，故留蔡中、蔡和詐降之人，以通消息；但恨無一人為我行詐降計耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "a6255796fe8e4920a17c7afe548acd59aeada89a19d50096d2bcbbccdfd971ce"}

{"id": "p_62e0d946e7ebb42a", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 164, "text": "」瑜曰：「不受些苦，彼如何肯信？", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "28cb289ca17101b81117b41b2575f31fa5fcc04f8de89ddcd4ea8f28e2d245db"}

{"id": "p_3dbff62c781c461f", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 165, "text": "」蓋曰：「某受孫氏厚恩，雖肝腦塗地，亦無怨悔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "d950f4b89906e0fa0216fa06f2db530007820d30a2646012191a990fc8e63edc"}

{"id": "p_441b71aa4f30a449", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」瑜拜而謝之曰：「君若肯行此苦肉計，則江東之萬幸也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "1bef39c76a4cf67eece5d9a82010d2eb084157a48bf7552472806b06f0e1ef7f"}

{"id": "p_02029f3352988ad0", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 167, "text": "次日，周瑜鳴鼓大會諸將於帳下，孔明亦在座。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "9eae7c81a8594cae45ebec3ecbda8a6e4c7bb4b699070cb17d28d62733030190"}

{"id": "p_32c541ea28a1d4f8", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 168, "text": "周瑜曰：「操引百萬之眾，連絡三百餘里，非一日可破。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "c5e02066a2bc622e85826e78142ef4eba223606e43af473b246468d01a7a9a98"}

{"id": "p_5abf634dd1b22999", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 169, "text": "今令諸將各領三個月糧草，準備禦敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "cae95609385bc8db322d00c048f9ca0712643cd3e1faf1bd8f079f1220803001"}

{"id": "p_681321a242e132a1", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 170, "text": "」言未訖，黃蓋進曰：「莫說三個月；便支三十個月糧草，也不濟事！", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "562cf33f1a4c038ddafe68ff75a9dcc69b5300aa1c77cf7320b56726dbbeb36f"}

{"id": "p_a8e7f84e1d3397be", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 171, "text": "若是這個月破的便破；若是這個月破不的，只可依張子布之言，棄甲倒戈，北面而降之耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "3cf821c84a344bdd62e9950eaacac2c450050a2d756594aac4f54d466dd02f9e"}

{"id": "p_9a87ed64c837aa86", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 172, "text": "」周瑜勃然變色大怒曰：「吾奉主公之命，督兵破曹，敢有再言降者必斬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "f3e6900ccc42eb09ab710afbae89d8d21b8cfc11e5b1ae798151fe41dd865688"}

{"id": "p_1bbab80b46c2f8e3", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 173, "text": "今兩軍相敵之際，汝敢出此言，慢我軍心，不斬汝首，難以服眾！", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "1a2a8a7fc0c457d3432d70df4d163cb189292c12dcc18c92df69c2361775b29b"}

{"id": "p_23465e79560d7f3b", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 174, "text": "」喝左右將黃蓋斬訖報來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "fa373016953b355ca86ebc4e56c83641be07a304d2f7bcf35a20db1be6935464"}

{"id": "p_21720c62ba23fba5", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 175, "text": "黃蓋亦怒曰：「吾自隨破虜將軍，縱橫東南，已歷三世，那有你來？", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "93b48f983d7b0c5fba53fb8a38ffd31d4007ad53941c46b817a0c204872ef451"}

{"id": "p_e008da85f76abeb4", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 176, "text": "甘寧進前告曰：「公覆乃東吳舊臣，望寬恕之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "a7b684b7e931b6f7506720390ee09a3f749b4b754584b2118fdd1e2387c7564c"}

{"id": "p_1fe2701e03a4ff23", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 177, "text": "」瑜喝曰：「汝何敢多言，亂吾法度！", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "f192242dbeac259b1a317873416c1eb8f93d2ae81dceaa03bf78f7e1f4e37313"}

{"id": "p_889eb354082667bf", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 178, "text": "」先叱左右將甘寧亂棒打出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "288405614359fd1572bf2895cf7906b69bcb215a44992737d22e84e310bdd2cf"}

{"id": "p_3eaf154ed4cb8e10", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 179, "text": "眾官皆跪告曰：「黃蓋罪固當誅，但於軍不利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "3ba5466bc2a9d88e2cfae0cf5b2d59a827781402593248893c878eb9be6aa1cf"}

{"id": "p_f9c007bc2ff57f7a", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 180, "text": "」瑜怒未息，眾官苦苦告求。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "3fb554ab4afecc39a36448e7a34289764d350c029481270037260bdc4f0222b8"}

{"id": "p_0f38a7593ad7483c", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 181, "text": "瑜曰：「若不看眾官面皮，決須斬首！", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "aa2dffd691981c06cb1e8bdb03d5be374c7b4c9084459114a69d79c34e53d031"}

{"id": "p_7e89c075e4f4beae", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」命左右拖翻，打一百脊杖，以正其罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "8ef8de8111cc5d135ebb00da99b1d004b73d5625ea55c7cb3bc586753b076223"}

{"id": "p_920669738b56a78d", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 183, "text": "眾官又告免，瑜推翻案桌，叱退眾官，喝教行杖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "9fb31a6c5d1293df7640f12efab026a2ab5b1d7e8d24a483be99030686c26de5"}

{"id": "p_b1ead9569c960133", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 184, "text": "將黃蓋剝了衣服，拖翻在地，打了五十脊杖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "04267b863a081a7e8f4d6c77854b1298fb60a993bf99fcb99dd0ae1a328a3423"}

{"id": "p_360315ea923a2b00", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 185, "text": "眾官又復苦苦求免，瑜躍起指蓋曰：「汝敢小覷我耶！", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "8dad24cabb4cd653d453e451d8687506c5e9e465a05ee95cdbcfb5f7f504927e"}

{"id": "p_618cd5bf29c0aca7", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 186, "text": "眾官扶起黃蓋，打得皮開肉綻，鮮血迸流，扶歸本寨，昏絕幾次。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "3cd8c532d1d95b1a1c8c1adb41f890eef503b117e3e88526c3d4f055b1444f0b"}

{"id": "p_f1c43df58e5552d0", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 187, "text": "魯肅也往看問了，來至孔明船中，謂孔明曰：「今日公瑾怒責公覆，我等皆是他部下，不敢犯顏苦諫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "9b9d27f1c94e3b50d8f30200c7c0579dd6d7ed44249b9b0fc8e7f49a0f86bd88"}

{"id": "p_cda93605e470e6b8", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 188, "text": "先生是客，何故袖手旁觀，不發一語？", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "c3f00cd60b8e74d5154dddb1d7e3049ebbfd68e3d558889d01e6d9cee606090c"}

{"id": "p_2372b0e8d3fd5ac3", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 189, "text": "」孔明笑曰：「子敬欺我。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "7b5ebfb10e410fc689d5932fc7e2772cda42489716f3cafb5fdb09962c156093"}

{"id": "p_67b0635b793ea435", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 190, "text": "」肅曰：「肅與先生渡江以來，未嘗一事相欺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "f916dd84de0cdad3f98dea449a1e05346a33ae3302ca442592f3526622ca9ec7"}

{"id": "p_1f138a3a9e911b08", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 191, "text": "」孔明曰：「子敬豈不知公瑾今日毒打黃公覆，乃其計耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "2174e35a2239d93312c37395ca5ea6b38611c62b279740d71e283e97c7f0fb4b"}

{"id": "p_9f230482b817e289", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 192, "text": "孔明曰：「不用苦肉計，何能瞞過曹操？", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "141fd9572aa661b755f2e61ef62dfee40bd5f0f6c4eec5c33eb0acc97140a588"}

{"id": "p_b449f82f66b92a42", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 193, "text": "今必令黃公覆去詐降，卻教蔡中，蔡和報知其事矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "883e9f8e2d46f4cf3e92eb0a6e9b99fa8c525b852fbb8fa4ff3b2b5d67a8034e"}

{"id": "p_d82cba2396aae0f5", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 194, "text": "子敬見公瑾時，切勿言亮先知其事，只說亮也埋怨都督便了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "1b9480d9d853fb24229d0093cf0fa27831e2c883242357c1596e60917dd9b1d2"}

{"id": "p_4719de96246caa2b", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 195, "text": "肅辭去，入帳見周瑜，瑜邀入帳後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "b6ca68e2690a0eda0e260067f7a525c905011c16b0b4bf405ca470c2605a9269"}

{"id": "p_aff9905ce1f84ac9", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 196, "text": "肅曰：「今日何故痛責黃公覆？", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "a3acb0e2f0c09b014ca29dd31d2bd24f99fecb3faee2fcaea2fb95dbc786d89a"}

{"id": "p_fa038f378272532a", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 197, "text": "」肅曰：「多有心中不安者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "d58f58a8387c083955169d6542bdba52edac89c56413d688a847250e07a3cafa"}

{"id": "p_d123ad665ee65fde", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 198, "text": "」瑜曰：「孔明之意若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "43ff304ce63a06ab5bb4eb34180679b629171cae74738a1041bb90ab5d9602f9"}

{"id": "p_6afb2915bcb9c880", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 199, "text": "」肅曰：「他也埋怨都督忒薄情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "703d87da96f204fe05322652e9148f85991732cd6dc3c245563c98656abfee6e"}

{"id": "p_9773638242b039bc", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 200, "text": "」瑜笑曰：「今番須瞞過他也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "06d4547a266e0fd979b2578d23a7dcc518a9378115769ed70b02388ea532e6c3"}

{"id": "p_949d9ab0d4656fde", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 201, "text": "」瑜曰：「今日痛打黃蓋，乃計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "8f6a3b509d8be4c0204f284b4003aca23702353ac98324673ce8ebfd37b3b88e"}

{"id": "p_e43f0c19e4a89c89", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 202, "text": "吾欲令他詐降，先須用苦肉計，瞞過曹操，就中用火攻之，可以取勝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "ecfddd4cab587618e3762ef92cdaeb10474d89d201d2545b14f3d7436797ecd9"}

{"id": "p_7817b0df0bcd813d", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 203, "text": "」肅乃暗思孔明之高見，卻不敢明言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "93c06218ba87f36680196f3d32c5d2937237e1f8e3397e508dd5a63d58d0b933"}

{"id": "p_2205da64938a0c58", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 204, "text": "且說黃蓋臥於帳中，眾將皆來動問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "7b8696c549c92969a4b0693669ad5e8d19c35904d8d743fd30a2eb80ee0d14fc"}

{"id": "p_69f5a223b5783255", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 205, "text": "蓋令請入臥內，叱退左右。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "2a7f5e9864d4a216730b40dd9700935674059929e33cf29ba79b67e146b01f3b"}

{"id": "p_c04ef5d8bba262a2", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 206, "text": "闞澤曰：「將軍莫非與都督有讎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "ab1136b24273fb287ef05bcf570660714366855884fa359ab74f6f1f1f03ec7d"}

{"id": "p_42c6c158f8ff5d3b", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 207, "text": "」澤曰：「然則公之受責，莫非苦肉計乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "02ae7315230bb2030c9eb4273e8bf0d5664e0ae2515477531e7874d75288b8e5"}

{"id": "p_0007cb9ef45cf5d5", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 208, "text": "」澤曰：「某觀公瑾舉動，已料著八九分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "e728ad52088f8ac4c6c1d1dfa516604f37076c0748adc738eb967e3d6c2c009c"}

{"id": "p_adffbeb3e64fc72e", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 209, "text": "」蓋曰：「某受吳侯三世厚恩，無以為報，故獻此計，以破曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "dda5de5c07ce18805c121f63c81495a09a03ea9bd47a0d325045cc80c860c5de"}

{"id": "p_fee847dbef529899", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 210, "text": "吾遍觀軍中，無一人可為心腹者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "6c0bb4cc9f291c905f10ba3fd8cefcd717bd605769b0204667c9fe2238628b7f"}

{"id": "p_e25363f098179f3d", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 211, "text": "惟公素有忠義之心，敢以心腹相告。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "4858af3280b37b220e6c4016b2c5bfd532c1aefa35725862843579a9489e9275"}

{"id": "p_2db5840c9b24e96d", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 212, "text": "」澤曰：「公之告我，無非要我獻詐降書耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "adc231b9c46ce071e7ce000bf13ed8835658ccb85c985123be5e984020320ca2"}

{"id": "p_bcd9a20235075834", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 213, "text": "::勇將輕身思報主，謀臣為國有同心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "ec1545f2663adb1ef9c22afd9ccf7ae7e93b6fca4ad4fee0a1fab19bcb6f2801"}

{"id": "p_8dea56f71054b2e6", "source_id": "src_a2dd3590941eeec3", "ordinal": 214, "text": "未知闞澤所言若何，且看下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "08a2b2e0a6c352c76fad2f039ebd725c1336492b1ad714207f6507662262715f"}

{"id": "p_28d7c29b0337e336", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說周瑜立於山頂，觀望良久，忽然望後而倒，口吐鮮血，不省人事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "9f62c83178c0e6017b1e3670e7200d11b7fd13a5599548b8fc1d6d4575d7a57d"}

{"id": "p_113fc3b7d8cfcb57", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 1, "text": "諸將皆來動問，盡皆愕然，相顧曰：「江北百萬之眾，虎踞鯨吞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "2e065501464ee9ab2f301a092f2aedcdcc78da894eb7dc0914fac48302c47551"}

{"id": "p_943d12a3f2027996", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 2, "text": "不料都督如此，倘曹兵一至，如之奈何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "a39005e0943064d060158ae4c96f68f625ebb7b08c01a391fceeb7bba92fc055"}

{"id": "p_d89838ce9c21f640", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 3, "text": "」慌忙差人申報吳侯，一面求醫調治。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "c8297fd225f409ae9f40fcf7f666ee19b0fc2984894fddcc819701ba14e0c493"}

{"id": "p_378f65edd31c86f9", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 4, "text": "卻說魯肅見周瑜臥病，心中憂悶，來見孔明，言周瑜猝病之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "1c0e5280d123930dfcccf1d2b864e523a74bc952310378e8a3c40565c67f07e9"}

{"id": "p_9ab4a460d0af041a", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 5, "text": "」肅曰：「此乃曹操之福，江東之禍也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "250a0273935d9b8e31e2415f00737944b689507f38033dfc564a20caf5a50309"}

{"id": "p_17d31ebb1db35b64", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」孔明笑曰：「公瑾之病，亮亦能醫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "37e96076a5d48a4e84ce05697b0cf02f59029dd708b07cf0251783d38afe6d9a"}

{"id": "p_e2bd34d3b031ae6c", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 7, "text": "」肅曰：「誠如此，則國家幸甚！", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "f5a42113a8321878887c8257bb6a48c2c291fb8c54dc67e7bf6478a04335fafc"}

{"id": "p_8d5ee60403329e9c", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」周瑜曰：「心腹攪痛，時復昏迷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "f3b03ce93b73d3542402f80273e5b3b583faeee8b465009459c62a9ac299a100"}

{"id": "p_39a6d5e889faf1dc", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」瑜曰：「心中嘔逆，藥不能下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "94e7c0010399f3c8a47f8eec4e89799393a092f9812ec4419c63f02c12726c52"}

{"id": "p_7e28fde23908d2a2", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」肅曰：「適來去望孔明，言能醫都督之病。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "355112759735bb9f646e232682c79291ee6897c35d906b752a39c0a092e55cf6"}

{"id": "p_4173d38e8b4228f3", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 11, "text": "現在帳外，煩來醫治，何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "96247a4619797e2944cec9c6d88ee1fc15869e1d5ca0201f258fe83153e7ae07"}

{"id": "p_c0704b022c3aebc2", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 12, "text": "瑜命請入，教左右扶起，坐於床上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "4da7daa2e183c862dff120edd906b8e20a85f9ec6c8c9b1aee0de326354a5494"}

{"id": "p_2859474bbcb535a1", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 13, "text": "孔明曰：「連日不晤君顏，何期貴體不安！", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "9040089766304e8642af4ca240e714d9ae26ff0a45105533c4cbb93b9dbf1623"}

{"id": "p_ea751ae8d9eef1e2", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」瑜曰：「『人有旦夕禍福』，豈能自保？", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "9ef6c38246b8fb6593b3ab3ef477ab0c87912a59bd17471b08bc5cc02924533e"}

{"id": "p_3a1c8000e3a22493", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 15, "text": "」孔明笑曰：「『天有不測風雲』，人又豈能料乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "42b88540cfc997d30372b773748b1e14f29abf4ee6b61f922587287e72b0374f"}

{"id": "p_f7469cc71e9ea371", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 16, "text": "」瑜聞失色，乃作呻吟之聲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "19ca24c787bd0edd89c37b167b85b9e0a49c56d7eb2fc4ae170251512a41f1fd"}

{"id": "p_2071b4b4aa8a2860", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 17, "text": "孔明曰：「都督心中似覺煩積否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "debeb2483eea90b09825cc78f48adc9901050518ae77408a742b42e343054380"}

{"id": "p_1c28cef9f614d0d7", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 18, "text": "」孔明曰：「必須用涼藥以解之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "049346c1b7b7cbd68125546daee5119d8e374d7b3891d0df03425b9a4396d8f1"}

{"id": "p_5761a3d74782f9da", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」瑜曰：「已服涼藥，全然無效。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "42f81ebe19a8b321d161699d7fa16cffeb718de8abd7c72fe57a5acc6e07a261"}

{"id": "p_31b8d3098942fc94", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 20, "text": "」孔明曰：「須先理其氣；氣若順，則呼吸之間，自然痊可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "70a08ea26dafc33dfb21b183e4b861b97686a6914a9e151d3bb694512e8d09c1"}

{"id": "p_9674d78e93336064", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 21, "text": "瑜料孔明必知其意，乃以言挑之曰：「欲得順氣，當服何藥？", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "5c058ccc8b8378de1931e03d96fdf384ca631e1b1ced50579c3adfff1f18304a"}

{"id": "p_658d771282ae8a69", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 22, "text": "」孔明笑曰：「亮有一方，便教都督氣順。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "1010b4f1ca2c1c8855d2ae1a24721260806ce7df5d6e9c84c492688bdd43debd"}

{"id": "p_94cc24f51ff9af49", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 23, "text": "」孔明索紙筆，屏退左右，密書十六字曰：「欲破曹公，宜用火攻；萬事俱備，只欠東風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "87565e0b28b2339ced707a526e5e328dbe6fb284582eb085a13728b528923209"}

{"id": "p_03ea706da68d726d", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」寫畢，遞與周瑜曰：「此都督病源也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "f15858691b51e82773474effcc9c42d19ba0f4d364007985091799be121cd817"}

{"id": "p_ec29495a323412e3", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 25, "text": "瑜見了大驚，暗思：「孔明真神人也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "adea9f75b81ec968acde75fcec2ee9bd9ce195be5dd0ed72d27952ca19944676"}

{"id": "p_00ad78046788890c", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 26, "text": "」乃笑曰：「先生已知我病源，將用何藥治之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "ac5e61986b0106d398650318c050b33a5d4ff4c1939c94b773ca459c86e1ba42"}

{"id": "p_4258204b105448ac", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」孔明曰：「亮雖不才，曾遇異人，傳授奇門遁甲天書，可以呼風喚雨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "910cef05332871a851595f06eeca5bb9b075d388034f023f1d9bd9f90da4ac62"}

{"id": "p_d595791972b532fc", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 28, "text": "都督若要東南風時，可於南屏山建一臺，名曰『七星壇』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "f7023c4d36faddff56e67121f923b021635bd32f4e3a113a21353ed9eb1daf91"}
