{"id": "p_a145159ab3f58ff5", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 29, "text": "高九尺，作三層，用一百二十人，手執旗旛圍遶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "e7c6344a04f04d9e249fbd93e98acfae462bd1c7fc6d66532646bdcf1b53d2d1"}

{"id": "p_e14c82aa14e425f7", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 30, "text": "亮於臺上作法，借三日三夜東南大風，助都督用兵，何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "ffc06d119b652040de6ca00ae067930cd3eedf88e8d46c50c7392957877c8c39"}

{"id": "p_9c05b633e02aed13", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」瑜曰：「休道三日三夜，只一夜大風，大事可成矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "f2d1655a3c7dfe0793414273740423d5122ebf6dc438888e01d50fc0beb81d2d"}

{"id": "p_5212171900b91d62", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 32, "text": "只是事在目前，不可遲緩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "375de1cd089ced8f06031ea2e477778e689348518785d60e1be55e2d381a6026"}

{"id": "p_ea6589c6a9065806", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」孔明曰：「十一月二十日甲子祭風，至二十二日丙寅風息，如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "d55d65a5992c1c72c6d8398af60cd3cadda151bf834b1e0a1b9307128bc91108"}

{"id": "p_4701750ca8988a9e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 34, "text": "便傳令差五百精壯軍士，往南屏山築壇；撥一百二十人，執旗守壇，聽候使令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "730acfd1c8c62840f09cb5c92aa152ad3a2f6e7127fdfebcbe478887db427e9e"}

{"id": "p_77aaf172808229bf", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 35, "text": "孔明辭別出帳，與魯肅上馬，來南屏山相度地勢，令軍士取東南方赤土築壇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "25c7957005ec9fd16c6a7a352427b8e312b0345819e6dbd985cfeb5bf72ed0a6"}

{"id": "p_15ddee98ac8be754", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 36, "text": "方圓二十四丈，每一層高三尺，共是九尺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "df045df0d5879a8a9b6728c4ad104046a4649511a6ca67ed979e0c91d107bffd"}

{"id": "p_e33d3bcde0c6e4a6", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 37, "text": "下一層插二十八宿旗：東方七面青旗，按角、亢、氐、房、心、尾、箕，布蒼龍之形；北方七面皂旗，按斗、牛、女、虛、危、室、壁，作玄武之勢；西方七面白旗，按奎、婁、冑、昴、畢、觜、參，踞白虎之威；南方七面紅旗，按井、鬼、柳、星、張、翼、軫，成朱雀之狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "80888b15b1348a210fd6dfc982d8debd36e11b7579932f4e572ffb05276d8e5b"}

{"id": "p_7e52ae78e2e3fc97", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 38, "text": "第二層周圍黃旗六十四面，按六十四卦，分八位而立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "1cd5b3bf0e085fa20eaaeea13693d2dba521d43ae1f43fdc48e8b04e5e98da38"}

{"id": "p_0bfbcd7b4e21cc3a", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 39, "text": "上一層用四人，各人戴束髮冠，穿皂羅袍，鳳衣博帶，朱履方裾，前左立一人，手執長竿，竿尖上用雞羽為葆，以招風信；前右立一人，手執長竿，竿上繫七星號帶，以表風色；後左立一人，捧寶劍；後右立一人，捧香爐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "2d1cf7b31e833e786bc75d4f7028c0534d5bedd215b01ee56fe8ba9d03b597de"}

{"id": "p_27bbac3796fc143d", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 40, "text": "壇下二十四人，各持旌旗、寶蓋、大戟、長戈、黃旄、白銊、朱旛、皂縣，環遶四面。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "4a3bf79bd3ffa6eb1244d1859982d2988278330810984b445a400f067fd5098a"}

{"id": "p_1e2c43593cdc258a", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 41, "text": "孔明於十一月二十日甲子吉辰，沐浴齋戒，身披道衣，跣足散髮，來到壇前，分付魯肅曰：「子敬自往軍中相助公瑾調兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "e2688fe06f37a074502cdf8fe8fecf329e5bd3187d54bcf64067a81e5d18ed93"}

{"id": "p_95b0cc1bd39b6fb5", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 42, "text": "倘亮所祈無應，不可有怪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "668e03f4aceb5ff1e49c1618e4e497287058ca75bf93fd4d8a72d75ec5bff6da"}

{"id": "p_a6677a7ae2195f1c", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 43, "text": "孔明囑付守壇將士：「不許擅離方位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "1f554a1dc2c9a34770502764f96e91789d637eebd31eccffc73028fa6be9bab7"}

{"id": "p_a70ed431ac106fdb", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 44, "text": "孔明緩步登壇，觀瞻方位已定，焚香於爐，注水於盂，仰天暗祝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "3a03fb65842edea8625dd3d92386f7898c3ebb2921fa00c217dc985f4635cb32"}

{"id": "p_7e26bba9d072cbea", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 45, "text": "下壇入帳中少歇，令軍士更替吃飯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "a85441365bf76cf05eea9b833cca7f2e4cbbbdb1f9562f990855ae4995d15274"}

{"id": "p_f53c3404b2e95f70", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 46, "text": "孔明一日上壇三次，下壇三次，卻不見有東南風。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "33ab999dddbf3fbbe7a3c2bf800280cc4638b47eef09ed70540ed0ba044be32d"}

{"id": "p_07250970e33533cc", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 47, "text": "且說周瑜請程普、魯肅一班軍官，在帳中伺侯，只等東南風起，便調兵出；一面關報孫權接應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "449a976ce9127acc889664d950e864a4b41b1967187d680c4183f1df467e6ba1"}

{"id": "p_c3c5ed4935ddca41", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 48, "text": "黃蓋已自準備火船二十隻，船頭密布大釘，船內裝載蘆葦乾柴，灌以魚油，上鋪硫黃、燄硝引火之物，各用青布油單遮蓋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "210da00fecd3533f5a239384abe65771c82627fa340094901950572f2c751e78"}

{"id": "p_497262cd7271655e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 49, "text": "船頭上插青龍牙旗，船尾各繫走舸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "763c95da5de5bfa7513371e0e5ba4bf2dfc91d4612769f041cf8a8d46e499362"}

{"id": "p_4e7d35cf58d04353", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 50, "text": "在帳下聽侯，只等周瑜號令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "c395ad866ac0164b5d5551baae244ac6ae466f48d815b5a0a4a8a05c1514350c"}

{"id": "p_52ee17f498d04ecd", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 51, "text": "甘寧、闞澤窩盤蔡和、蔡中在水寨中，每日飲酒，不放一卒登岸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "413fea6eacc7eea49e5bb2c0bfa2a0ec1e1bfebd89cc9580653e7ee84e91fe12"}

{"id": "p_6618525fcbfc33e3", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 52, "text": "周圍盡是東吳軍馬，把得水洩不通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "50348ab7d5c6ca3b5245eaed8f197bd2b9b021ad49d95969fee651df22c5a8f2"}

{"id": "p_27dcc9b69d2dc486", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 53, "text": "周瑜正在帳中坐議，探子來報：「吳侯船隻離寨八十五里停泊，只等都督好音。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "9fe968fd5c13809a292ae20c4f42d1d48220e094cbd9e870d1987c53389ffea2"}

{"id": "p_34f91d2e5f54ba9e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 54, "text": "」瑜即差魯肅遍告各部下官兵將士：「俱各收拾船隻、軍器、帆櫓等物。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "4bdccc277c10f23c4b8271413791abb2ef73b129adbbf70b1d2aaa8b29e2af8b"}

{"id": "p_71c86604dcb420a8", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」眾兵將得令，一個個磨拳擦掌，準備廝殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "09ea7b56b27f3751faa2abf8e0d15e0b9ffc491c27ad730c1594e5bfca6a430b"}

{"id": "p_6c4df04e68ff3877", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 56, "text": "是日看看近夜，天色清明，微風不動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "27fec5d0c7c50929e41d491171dbae4e21ed4a5c5fc3c4843e35a502e3db8123"}

{"id": "p_06116a248611fc35", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 57, "text": "瑜謂魯肅曰：「孔明之言謬矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "d029a4484cad68ceb854083cbbe3eac47c692809151e258dfccb46340501d81a"}

{"id": "p_0b66875e4bb4142e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 58, "text": "隆冬之時，怎得東南風乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "55967ad1a2eb03404b78eb0a6b38e76d89a811c12c644c1ca533af3f32f569f0"}

{"id": "p_d70d8121e7209057", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 59, "text": "」肅曰：「吾料孔明必不謬談。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "fb6a7c3c60b267ad93d6402712d00277dfa2b6c2b7ab62d975d0320203841d85"}

{"id": "p_863215d303c44def", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 60, "text": "」將近三更時分，忽聽風聲響，旗旛轉動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "9bc613c56d7971b775159e55e95b24f3d01e4d5cceab7a6c6af506cc87661aa7"}

{"id": "p_dc6cab597eb6cfc3", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 61, "text": "瑜出帳看時時，旗腳竟飄西北，霎時間東南風大起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "b90edf95e343874589f846ecda63f80bb53dc68afbc22204c7c339aa39993e50"}

{"id": "p_552d8ed41b0079f4", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 62, "text": "瑜駭然曰：「此人有奪天地造化之法，鬼神不測之術！", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "1e285331ef89bba1d12fee08cbe9a383165ca3bdba8824471142241404a8de68"}

{"id": "p_4551f3558f389ae6", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 63, "text": "若留此人，乃東吳禍根也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "4b88b92d00dcfdf6d886de96e1bb3d8c59cde88b881ad317878c3b50ac689988"}

{"id": "p_ca6d1c14ec64b864", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 64, "text": "及早殺卻，免生他日之憂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "79b22ea3e912df268f882781b9a9bfbee827b99b0e37c5192e031fc11add2628"}

{"id": "p_68b5228a7f8f0166", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 65, "text": "」急喚帳前護軍校尉丁奉、徐盛二將：「各帶一百人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "65755986d7e4c632d495319ee4d13eb3178efd4741c50ed6a52f1b2bfb9363ee"}

{"id": "p_ba44efdfab510f57", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 66, "text": "徐盛從江內去，丁奉從旱路去，都到南屏山七星壇前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "d99137c0af795ec6321eeb5a68dc5e014e0cdb0c52484afc309db0a1808410cf"}

{"id": "p_9971fc523cc9f2a4", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 67, "text": "休問長短，拏住諸葛亮便行斬首，將首級來請功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "59484dcee48e8242e5668ed8646f54e8172ffb802ca54476cc894cb066f43ade"}

{"id": "p_3adc8f0e24096999", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 68, "text": "徐盛下船，一百刀斧手，蕩開棹槳；丁奉上馬，一百弓弩手，各跨征駒，往南屏山來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "3345637a63c74d8d85bdd95da3062bc060d415175f44995550cee0e456633b4a"}

{"id": "p_23356709f2ab9eef", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 69, "text": "::七星壇上臥龍登，一夜東風江水騰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "3a38534646a3c4d2ad7d4d8065c3e61d414c70199e6f3577caff034821e13452"}

{"id": "p_d90d1e7dd58a9c65", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 70, "text": "::不是孔明施妙計，周郎安得逞才能？", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "ab6fe1bf1d1464322788ab6906c63068f7415ff5f6c5429cefe44a0373b7bb33"}

{"id": "p_67cc6c754a43ceb5", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 71, "text": "丁奉馬軍先到，見壇上執旗將士，當風而立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "786adf16d157a4298e0d8801c68d526c8dfcc4aea80ac8c73f7391c0e1284cb7"}

{"id": "p_1f744ce637b3d6d6", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 72, "text": "丁奉下馬提劍上壇，不見孔明，慌問守壇將士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "1a18de2dba126fb09fb25e594ce1996149584692e687351bfd9a4aff195240fe"}

{"id": "p_8db861a604c60199", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」丁奉忙下壇尋時，徐盛船已到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "216bff8efc0095be37431eec3243b824aa72323ff7a0049fe75a8fffcb88d7ef"}

{"id": "p_5ae6a7cc8cbf5b5b", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 74, "text": "小卒報曰：「昨晚一隻快船停在前灘口，適間卻見孔明披髮下船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "eea1872fdfccab53f4e8033b823f000dd95ec0315cbbc1b2cef2e888d4f728a3"}

{"id": "p_1fe8b354421c539d", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」丁奉、徐盛便分水陸兩路追襲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "46bfa53846418735846cfc6d0e65d0cfd5fac79d167d764cf07f4b5457cf0447"}

{"id": "p_5c6f2ccec45b60ba", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 76, "text": "徐盛教拽起滿帆，搶風而使。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "0e8e80caebddef0712770d104c09c1cc385b703172f662ef4a47ef1f0b816eea"}

{"id": "p_b8aeae74678dc1aa", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 77, "text": "遙望前船不遠，徐盛在船頭高聲大叫：「軍師休去！", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "d8478e9ee2c6ec60e9391eba10348a8af7b15555bbf275f0917e608db752b0f7"}

{"id": "p_ba63eec72c0de7ae", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 78, "text": "」只見孔明立於船尾大笑曰：「上覆都督：好好用兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "edb1a1bf24b3da6168c88b5a92dc97731dda004e46de96fdf1ac31e953aea07d"}

{"id": "p_a1eb3d60faa61300", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 79, "text": "諸葛亮暫回夏口，異日再容相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "f887d088096debef12ba9b554eb84b375b4efb9b5f43aa228162314d776b6c06"}

{"id": "p_7de82e23633fcd93", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 80, "text": "」徐盛曰：「請暫少住，有緊話說。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "4be0abadea24cf1f9f684c71891baf52732ab4392315d56c8588bcaa3981eb63"}

{"id": "p_5ef524c8b71f4816", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 81, "text": "」孔明曰：「吾已料定都督不能容我，必來加害，預先教趙子龍來相接。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "a442927193a5fe95fd743034c037fa2a53b47f58a7c8259fa75de04f4c4b2682"}

{"id": "p_65d8c729ac73840f", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 83, "text": "看看至近，趙雲拈弓搭箭，立於船尾大叫曰：「吾乃常山趙子龍也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "8dd9432ed6b169f2f916dbd3456ed49cf6f53361fe0d3a498f7b5669c52ad2b0"}

{"id": "p_f34a5081ffa2410e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 84, "text": "本待一箭射死你來，顯得失了兩家和氣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "3ac4bcaa1563101fe829b8dfe0c68afdf8994ce24d33ec23ad6c1e659c011400"}

{"id": "p_8068ab9296a92bd8", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 85, "text": "」言迄，箭到處，射斷徐盛船上篷索。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "03bef25bb44ab611aba29c4866a54bc58679e45d81ef0be162d31f7b3a034384"}

{"id": "p_fb50b5037c3cd7e1", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 86, "text": "那篷墮落下水，其船便橫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "7e34b2be3dd3d0abab6375a204ba96dab8feb03668eae240e221ab40f55c6bec"}

{"id": "p_70b3998ed385dce6", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 87, "text": "趙雲卻教自己船上拽起滿帆，乘順風而去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "dea39be73c668809e8efb54e329580af720e9ea4490f4255cb65969907b4e4d3"}

{"id": "p_8ed488e8c0533ecb", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 88, "text": "岸上丁奉喚徐盛船近岸，言曰：「諸葛亮神機妙算，人不可及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "499b0d5acd7b418d174c8f818fa4387c76fbe20f68a8835166341ef518b02e2e"}

{"id": "p_e49c9ed931f0492d", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 89, "text": "更兼趙雲有萬夫不當之勇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "eec33eca9a3b5e40eacc2c8b5161f50f567bf756786237ab1c71f0e7cfcd8a94"}

{"id": "p_48b6e375fd62da07", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 90, "text": "」於是二人回見周瑜，言孔明預先約趙雲迎接去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "0cea8fc1c5a5bb763fece641e1464991a9e56b0e75fa6d9e51b8ff7f0de3212e"}

{"id": "p_f79a79e87c8186b4", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 91, "text": "周瑜大驚曰：「此人如此多謀，使我曉夜不安矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "9093769f8abe3dd9745bafa814cb7284b32ee90e0c2d92e6bc542364548f7cdb"}

{"id": "p_bee9f9ba64cefaa1", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 92, "text": "」魯肅曰：「且待破曹之後，卻再圖之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "1b66d000902c8a9c071a477a640139d5247560fdd8d515dd93ffdbff4a331c35"}

{"id": "p_5763c14b09a8f076", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 93, "text": "瑜從其言，喚集諸將聽令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "78f8cc2c554004458d4c9ef38a7bd8cb94fbcaba99b9c36f410d506d07e456b5"}

{"id": "p_38d62151717172fb", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 94, "text": "先教甘寧：「帶了蔡中並降卒沿南岸而走，只打北軍旗號，直取烏林地面，正當曹操屯糧之所。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "b87c0200f00df321ce8ff44c4ab7b4919076c71ed0d9bad2be6d7aca2c5ed3dc"}

{"id": "p_3a2328f1cd8f5510", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 95, "text": "只留下蔡和一人在帳下，我有用處。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "60228add70192980dd6374e2b4b68213df92127676caa149bbc4435a3dc590f4"}

{"id": "p_ad1aea0a31478c4d", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 96, "text": "」第二喚太史慈分付：「你可領三千兵，直奔黃州地界，斷曹操合淝接應之兵，就逼曹兵，放火為號。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "596e6d9cf746976d0c0268e00d5941e33a43e7bbeb7a985b9d93282a2f989de0"}

{"id": "p_f30d4c80f89a2956", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 97, "text": "只看紅旗，便是吳侯接應兵到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "b9201832358df9c225843bfa8735e392db4cc684e66a1314535b0c1cd160ba82"}

{"id": "p_afb0ca942df8a821", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 98, "text": "第三喚呂蒙領三千兵去烏林接應，甘寧焚燒曹操寨柵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "4f5012c6f46c4643d888dd17dfb4f436308a7a91b3aa1e4b1851982eca788cc0"}

{"id": "p_3bdd6acb0aa7cdf5", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 99, "text": "第四喚凌統領三千兵，直接彝陵界首，只看烏林火起，以兵應之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "f49dcacf0fb89bc2ada7845c08b671991891fd6aa8fa60be2fde316035a01458"}

{"id": "p_6044c631bfc7e728", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 100, "text": "第五喚董襲領三千兵，直取漢陽，從漢川殺奔曹操寨中，看白旗接應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "c3b8bb27f9577297aca3b19c518292819a07b2951ae5c0c8c2dd8b4fa71066f8"}

{"id": "p_ab347ad9dc7c4e79", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 101, "text": "第六喚潘璋領三千兵，盡打白旗，往漢陽接應董襲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "ea6ca18eadf1d8b5a16073cf09ebfdfd1b7832e0c6e09989bbfbd44d9a176b12"}

{"id": "p_d4f1d4f8d4a1e563", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 102, "text": "卻令黃蓋安排火船，使小卒馳書約曹操今夜來降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "cacd67a7bff4c43bb9aa531cc16b7964cd6e030744b91443a4c4f90a7804fa91"}

{"id": "p_8066e04ca06f9a5c", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 103, "text": "一面撥戰船四隻，隨於黃蓋船後接應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "e5df0624983298b073b16d339266759ba5f02d7f8c9ead0a13fa50743e1ed72b"}

{"id": "p_5d4c6577fa55a173", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 104, "text": "第一隊領兵軍官韓當，第二隊領兵軍官周泰，第三隊領兵軍官蔣欽，第四隊領兵軍官陳武：四隊各引戰船三百隻，前面各擺列火船二十隻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "372c8af20c04e2cf261cca5f999fadfa84a33922d35047ce7a34f92c6986817f"}

{"id": "p_dce5360db47003ed", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 105, "text": "周瑜自與程普在大艨艟上督戰，徐盛、丁奉為左右護衛，只留魯肅共闞澤及眾謀士守寨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "03fe9cae5d112dc5ac2bf70e3edd8bf271ac6b7344205bc9dea713b56ba33f52"}

{"id": "p_837e482859679e19", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 106, "text": "程普見周瑜調軍有法，甚相敬服。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "6e6913a8ef7f3e304342f944a81f0c9fd07010c42e94f90141ff4e917c065754"}

{"id": "p_f79721d5f12371f8", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 107, "text": "卻說孫權差使命持兵符至，說已差陸遜為先鋒，直抵蔪、黃地面進兵，吳侯自為後應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "a7ec415b0208fb613744699ce53ac4fd9540f565b3a9303b94ecb9c2b042328a"}

{"id": "p_63835c3e4509699e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 108, "text": "瑜又差人西山放火砲，南屏山舉號旗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "aa41f390e1dda7af562c54737f88eca1ccaf2a22809917e7e0de0b96cd26d91c"}

{"id": "p_0e46971e2af35997", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 109, "text": "各各準備停當，只等黃昏舉動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "d9e9bb26643ea4f9ef4c6f61c2539b19e18b7bb658a362e6edf035ea7496c31e"}

{"id": "p_aed900a694562c12", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 110, "text": "話分兩頭：且說劉玄德在夏口專候孔明回來，忽見一隊船到，乃是公子劉琦自來探聽消息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "a966a1b9fc4302d3404ff1e4944e1a0d0ece7093553b87b8c5d8733f2181b425"}

{"id": "p_0e0a120c68a9ae10", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 111, "text": "玄德請上敵樓坐定，說：「東南風起多時，子龍去接孔明，至今不見到，吾心甚憂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "b3ad93d820ced972a440ac9c5b6ce2b0793f70b0db85378e906c194691f72a82"}

{"id": "p_74cbc778049c753e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 112, "text": "」小校遙指樊口港上：「一帆風送扁舟來到，必軍師也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "a2183e9dfcce0349a41aefec43b0fedf1d11ad65e807df89be596ccb294adbfc"}

{"id": "p_acc6f3b6d22cb741", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 113, "text": "須臾到，孔明、子龍登岸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "811745fab6e9dd22a9b225015dfbab3fc814d90c76a2407879a9c7e79c179ba3"}

{"id": "p_154c9ad819f2f7e0", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 114, "text": "問候畢，孔明曰：「且無暇告訴別事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "fafcf74033620a3269a01eae49fe33028c06f24cdca40069484585da88b01f6c"}

{"id": "p_52e856e137fadf6f", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 115, "text": "前者所約軍馬戰船，皆已辦否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "f8a1b314095c12ecf436e260b05b2ec2f0f9591b505e4e6def4b9774e09725a4"}

{"id": "p_745fc50c697262d5", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 116, "text": "」玄德曰：「收拾久矣，只候軍師調用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "e8a6d144df773c56a0b3fbb74e113103adb51310afefa2c34499acab0855fb59"}

{"id": "p_5410d5fe61ff72b4", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 117, "text": "孔明便與玄德、劉琦升帳坐定，謂趙雲曰：「子龍可帶三千軍馬，渡江逕取烏林小路，揀樹木蘆葦密處埋伏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "df66d5998f4b398ed4f7c731ff37b60e6b4035b4b07203d0a3e791dc85a0210b"}

{"id": "p_f30ea7c9ba312ca6", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 118, "text": "今夜四更已後，曹操必然從那條路奔走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "77c05edf5182458f80a4559324c45bcd5aa1c2f3edde61f9265aa61718682f76"}

{"id": "p_fa65817ffe832179", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 119, "text": "等他軍馬過，就半中間放起火來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "d0c08161aec0d0b169b1ecffd5a8dd53c5b673eb75acf86668feda817df80ab2"}

{"id": "p_1cef5ca3ac0d6b23", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 120, "text": "雖然不殺他盡絕，也殺一半。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "6b739969b52b953535bbcf56afddb54ed2527ca9dbde81b9c93c63546ac64838"}

{"id": "p_38f0f52dae3e9161", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 121, "text": "」雲曰：「烏林有兩條路：一條通南郡，一條取荊州。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "59cd85aa52e98b7b9af25b9df48e8beca63f9fe016947887220679e8ff6814b6"}

{"id": "p_eb88bbdbe1006ba5", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 122, "text": "」孔明曰：「南郡勢迫，曹操不敢往，必來荊州，然後大軍投許昌而去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "952ee2ed91bb68ee019660f814793b754fe038151907a97e2768eaf9882179b0"}

{"id": "p_043e124578d23691", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 123, "text": "又喚張飛曰：「翼德可領三千兵渡江，截斷彝陵這條路，去葫蘆谷口埋伏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "c72d46ede67c9d5a0812382fb76d0c3a65b86354e3f6c6808d62bb7cca7fb8f6"}

{"id": "p_177adf84b1b36d2c", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 124, "text": "曹操不敢走南彝陵，必望北彝陵去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "c45d80d3115ff555ab577814b87a9481c8bfe504b1d2671aa675cbb205cff140"}

{"id": "p_102bfd37743d2dfb", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 125, "text": "來日雨過，必然來埋鍋造飯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "fe15811fdc826378fe80c3341806de70f7a6d6b63d787f3507b633d63a69e595"}

{"id": "p_71be62a3627dd5b3", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 126, "text": "只看煙起，便就山邊放起火來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "207c383920958b707ec5d3ad94ed6ba0a332dd519a40127b4ddafbf0cd7ff273"}

{"id": "p_0ba7801a7a419a32", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 127, "text": "雖然不捉得曹操，翼德這場功料也不小。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "174c7289215877dc351fa187f9e6c8897ff39370cfbb75ab89cb33bf10d6ba76"}

{"id": "p_f7076585314e3231", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 128, "text": "又喚糜竺、糜芳、劉封三人，各駕船隻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "2f3b6a7a84fc13f722c6e0230d5fba1ce78e7dc23829164bd7ada074062d886b"}

{"id": "p_3380633ccbfd1a6a", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 129, "text": "遶江剿擒敗軍，奪取器械。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "a5b2d7ff8b83389c307821eb06f55a5889b8e22995d9826ca4934870e9b25733"}

{"id": "p_002bf0af49bd835d", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 130, "text": "孔明起身，謂公子劉琦曰：「武昌一望之地，最為緊要。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "d7ce7dc966b39455b4db4716b12917c697fda2ff2521251048f563c9fb7d6f75"}

{"id": "p_7bd97c2e461c23d1", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 131, "text": "率領所部之兵，陳於岸口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "ce8de44c30355a7d29956ce80719b45232bf913f0e5a2e715d4b672346f01261"}

{"id": "p_dfb6e835b229fa0c", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 132, "text": "操一敗必有逃來者，就而擒之，卻不可輕離城郭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "88d2829361e4ddcb06c9470fc3f26b2b2fb731c944a26481eee807c6db8e6fe6"}

{"id": "p_c197da46053ed441", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 133, "text": "」劉琦便辭玄德，孔明去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "0e5dc51179f0654afae4787fcdac815a778108b5837112516c7ca5ab44d29af8"}

{"id": "p_840fe8329812e882", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 134, "text": "孔明謂玄德曰：「主公可於樊口屯兵，憑高而望，坐看今夜周郎成大功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "cb65a3316d486759f78f744bf609144cfcff7dce59585f30775ffdf4f4f21ca0"}

{"id": "p_8f5f01ff67e88fc0", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 135, "text": "時雲長在側，孔明全然不睬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "c9f5f5ffab450ca8c858954f5d27b3ed78b18fd1ab5f998eacbfc5c6386ad9e2"}

{"id": "p_a65bef4c343cabc3", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 136, "text": "雲長忍耐不住，乃高聲曰：「關某自隨兄長征戰多年來，未嘗落後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "c827c9c43a4fb9fcf9378b5b141b424cb21882a437d46ade8de84380bbf381cc"}

{"id": "p_0afafbea7c2607ab", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 137, "text": "今日逢大敵，軍師卻不委用，此是何意？", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "ba6f01f5384d2d464cd526b39c302ce05290e9394257dbda39ed43015874db04"}

{"id": "p_de5848c14916ee78", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 138, "text": "」孔明笑曰：「雲長勿怪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "77ab965a29c800ee6f60ceaccc472155db5590063df7e0ecca48509697b3fa8c"}

{"id": "p_c45db940cc93c2f0", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 139, "text": "某本欲煩足下把一個最緊要的隘口，怎奈有些違礙處，不敢教去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "71d9e9ec95d2c89dedab72f660d74389092b306f079a5e241f4344145e906842"}

{"id": "p_c62155b5d38edd7d", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」孔明曰：「昔日曹操待足下甚厚，足下當有以報之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "d8f23aae6b2b07f433f83ea933c6698df3bacd2a17b853d5307de832b1f77f52"}

{"id": "p_18df15b273dc2ddc", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 141, "text": "今日操兵敗，必走華容道。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "271c2d6677967ec3e6a552d41392ff941c9c9c1e252fbdd1c3b3ca40c4ef50fb"}

{"id": "p_88cee1401a7dd8f5", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 142, "text": "若令足下去時，必然放他過去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "72598d9d703d5058a2f8a9c6871433e6ee9121045c70ef337bb7a1872348ede9"}

{"id": "p_93012a838facb6f7", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 143, "text": "當日曹操果是重待某，某已斬顏良，誅文醜，解白馬之圍，報過他了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "bb59f679c62c06faa6c578278bfc02287ae003c4bdd64e51dfe8ee5c27d62d61"}

{"id": "p_c447574b4d703667", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」孔明曰：「倘若放了時，卻如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "dc79ae6291bdb28ea159456e61d02e33dcd4454f10f535a050385ec6c5f7ad3d"}

{"id": "p_b45fac9a0dc71f48", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 145, "text": "」孔明曰：「如此，立下文書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "93b5fa089b907e47d1725d5b76dced36390a7da4209917cfe900c248a073ce9e"}

{"id": "p_713bcdedae56efb3", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 146, "text": "雲長曰：「若曹操不從那條路上來，如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "37b52a3542888153bc47d198c015be6e80aa119ae1efe1988204e8800a2a32cc"}

{"id": "p_8f4755ef7e1ece59", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」孔明曰：「我亦與你軍令狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "b9a56520f00cb8a2f506f1c73af1ed44cd9cb83b0b41234308d1d154ea564f9f"}

{"id": "p_2f8c110228e6978a", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 148, "text": "孔明曰：「雲長可於華容小路高山之處，堆積柴草，放起一把火煙，引曹操來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "b2f740bcd641ee190903fcc94d5559942955222f6c1b1789c12abf7770f2d20d"}

{"id": "p_e9ef7cba22136360", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 149, "text": "」雲長曰：「曹操望見煙，知有埋伏，如何肯來？", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "5e10d02514d3982f64eda1215b2e62b2e9b025ae9daf04269dc6d87a53d7929b"}

{"id": "p_a24ca22532fd97f0", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」孔明笑曰：「豈不聞兵法虛虛實實之論？", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "ff817addb9b4c1433801a42fc10c478a64579938dea78b7555a58912d62023f1"}

{"id": "p_f954a48413759d54", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 151, "text": "操雖能用兵，只此可以瞞過他也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "8b643e2120ec788a6b0c61f4b78969bb715805add4a9de95cead96402dfd73ca"}

{"id": "p_a7e4f1fb53d06e06", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 152, "text": "他見煙起，將謂虛張聲勢，必然投這條路來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "54e2f5e42205b540fd76771f2fcf22dc14f0d8c83d753407b52c8eb683982e85"}

{"id": "p_f49791ed44f39126", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 153, "text": "雲長領了將令，引關平、周倉並五百校刀手，投華容道埋伏去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "5567d12180a240f15b9cf15a86a189aa1793964791ff0be504bcd96eac02dac1"}

{"id": "p_3ebbf1609687f905", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 154, "text": "玄德曰：「吾弟義氣深重，若曹操果然投華容道去時，只恐端的放了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "2653e6642d3f9ffc5f933d5c0e685a504e67aca80e034c8a4558fa3dd211612f"}

{"id": "p_d54cebd38936b41d", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 155, "text": "」孔明曰：「亮夜觀乾象，操賊未合身亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "e29c7a073b252bfeb7d4586bc12281b918e5ec24107e77061ca5fa866f184e82"}

{"id": "p_4d66b77a8a19f814", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 156, "text": "留這人情，教雲長做了，亦是美事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "9caab481bf30906e1e24e27b1e6d600bd39776c7661f41b237cd2fc40da7a767"}

{"id": "p_5f3da22fec4d52b9", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 157, "text": "」玄德曰：「先生神算，世所罕及！", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "1ca267da2131f869e9179821311edeccca2308fd929281c2f3a832714179a53a"}

{"id": "p_1ced2cdb6dd84f71", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 158, "text": "」孔明遂與玄德往樊口看周瑜用兵，留孫乾、簡雍守城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "cbaa3fb7b98970de30d92c107c29abe0fe24488b6c28071fbc73480386ca8e84"}

{"id": "p_5f8125efe9563cfc", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 159, "text": "卻說曹操在大寨中，與眾將商議，只等黃蓋消息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "09596e6b78bed7468deda6cc467ffd8e3eb6c0b6f0ddd5835c694181c126838f"}

{"id": "p_704424b47022bf2e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 160, "text": "當日東南風起甚緊，程昱入告曹操曰：「今日東南風起，宜預隄防。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "12849778746d67b6c2aa9cb73418da2c2360492f3ec114d75412de9c680f007e"}

{"id": "p_b7578b251d18c369", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 161, "text": "」操笑曰：「冬至一陽生，來復之時，安得無東南風？", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "f695c23617b396fffec8edd080784d3bb7e55f5c6e5de9a9d2f9e5697edad81b"}

{"id": "p_3ee5038066f3ffa4", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 162, "text": "」軍士忽報江東一隻小船來到，說有黃蓋密書，操急喚入，其人呈上書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "7cd56419192925121ae9d30f751563f5f2377c564ea534be4cddf002148a3454"}

{"id": "p_377025b6eb0faa4c", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 163, "text": "書中訴說：「周瑜關防嚴緊，因此無計脫身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "99dedbeefe04bd0479f1737b86dd7de3d50466d96836ed42babc560512091451"}

{"id": "p_5c027629bffc45a2", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 164, "text": "今有鄱陽湖新運到糧，周瑜差蓋巡哨，已有方便。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "a8a73566e8a0d02bec310bd6cb43e835a8a7cc4245bc0558496267cd190b7cf3"}

{"id": "p_cfc3e2bf1218cec8", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 165, "text": "好歹殺江東名將，獻首來降。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "1b4fbc3d23a7b136d90a823d710c26c32af4ea69fe7ef9cca60368b753a89a52"}

{"id": "p_7d594f90ac359af1", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 166, "text": "只在今晚三更，船上插青龍牙旗者，即糧船也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "b707653491e60cac4251cc518c937958a8d730d430d81815da6a566c26dfd430"}

{"id": "p_2b4b858372507e9d", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 167, "text": "」操大喜，遂與眾將來到水寨中大船上，觀望黃蓋船到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "43755e99af7a5ac70eb08eaf386413d2ccaf19acfe3fb737f698758fcf0b6dd5"}

{"id": "p_584493bbb6bf09af", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 168, "text": "且說江東，天色向晚，周瑜喚出蔡和，令軍士縛倒，和叫：「無罪！", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "e367fd9701e6d263050cdc61941b73ed48f86a9330e66b0e85a6113e0e3cb03d"}

{"id": "p_385c69cd1c7dd08a", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 169, "text": "」瑜曰：「汝是何等人，敢來詐降！", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "fe334c0571df5687ec7acef20f0590cc3e3ae312a56561ff118f6c89f7ff39a5"}

{"id": "p_3059f70148ddb3fc", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 170, "text": "吾今缺少福物祭旗，願借你首級。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "72c386eb9f409bf84db71e95d9083bd094cf0504e389bf8c4ca0c2ea8875cf8d"}

{"id": "p_5099c5a417564bee", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 171, "text": "」和抵賴不過，大叫曰：「汝家闞澤、甘寧，亦曾與謀！", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "b8adb21a8eb067e3e3afd5510dc2d399b3f154be539b08eaaeb607806156ed14"}

{"id": "p_667ad9decdd018ca", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 172, "text": "」瑜曰：「此乃吾之所使也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "ef7dd525bacfa57fe7df19f4ed15a93b63a7e8ea99b1a94a3d3651334e3aeccc"}

{"id": "p_24ee41044702e9b3", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 173, "text": "瑜令捉至江邊皂纛旗下，奠酒燒紙，一刀斬了蔡和，用血祭旗畢，便令開船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "93d47e19f5c7ec1118c1bcfa11ab9dbb300a1903b3824d4d3e7e3f14dabf1783"}

{"id": "p_d87292f28c7c501d", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 174, "text": "黃蓋在第三隻火船上，獨披掩心甲，手提利刃，旗上大書「先鋒黃蓋」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "8c3ad866a30441e4c32bfac9403b28d99c44341fbec959213685514584963191"}

{"id": "p_9c4fb9058559b3fc", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 175, "text": "蓋乘一天順風，望赤壁進發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "6ad14ac44c08879da02a33f532e3818ac518940fa2365898e3f10b61ee25b20f"}

{"id": "p_5d7d7896868b93e1", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 176, "text": "是時東風大作，波浪洶湧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "6d7b64123670fea6b9e0339d84ba6a678a4259fd7af2b253f90856db004e2b64"}

{"id": "p_3bcc357bd7613190", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 177, "text": "操在中軍遙望隔江，看看月上照耀江水，如萬道金蛇，翻波戲浪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "f43a38f7916874e4c68d9b9d54251f70deb0dae04640dab829de843b05e76f58"}

{"id": "p_f8cd7994ddf40aa4", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 178, "text": "操迎風大笑，自以為得志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "df068d884f6b871ca8ebfb69823ec3aed13667086bf4dfa25061307b3d5a06e7"}

{"id": "p_30065703328cf366", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 179, "text": "忽一軍指說：「江南隱隱一簇帆幔，使風而來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "1f76a8a31a40142171bacd4db3b098db8578ef7b9f2675fa29dd4923980d0123"}

{"id": "p_80d3b7455a48aa27", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 180, "text": "」操憑高望之，報稱：「皆插青龍牙旗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "3af9ce18b4f50a8a1018298c34082ff4cee51278691d83ab71b7812621382d08"}

{"id": "p_0b1d935f9e166dac", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 181, "text": "內中有大旗，上書先鋒黃蓋名字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "38524dcfab18186db8337b1c439b4a8628e0650f7c1c5783d63d7e1b746382ab"}

{"id": "p_eceb89ed0bf6606e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」操笑曰：「公覆來降，此天助我也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "24b2a9c07d464b07a3601ed5984a325b339c4ec95e8cc2c06237dad90a518b0b"}

{"id": "p_1f85f43c0f69ae50", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 183, "text": "程昱觀望良久，謂操曰：「來船必詐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "e7521539edd207d9c75cc37e617f220a8f445a6164149d1c10d5e26bc5939352"}

{"id": "p_cd3db179c50968ca", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 184, "text": "」程昱曰：「糧在船中，船必穩重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "593cc5fd7176f5318c3face920cf9b1f3fe6d2c8b731744967d6fa0eebcb05a8"}

{"id": "p_931a5c21cd8e8c68", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 185, "text": "今觀來船，輕而且浮；更兼今夜東南風甚緊；倘有詐謀，何以當之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "af8b69a14a6bd0c39ed35de7eceadea28403e16698b9994e53d00b133b96a763"}

{"id": "p_1b1db6096b9ed936", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 186, "text": "」操省悟，便問：「誰去止之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "bf4c2f17dacb800c342970f3774ecb300ca542aae3ca4cc28789bf3714367cf7"}

{"id": "p_99d61ac09959fec0", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 187, "text": "」文聘曰：「某在水上頗熟，願請一往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "2c570dfbcc2c4f2d1fd82644185bf6300f7065c81e841f58b827dbdee1c7fc14"}

{"id": "p_d84347525450098b", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 188, "text": "」言畢，跳下小船，用手一指，十數隻巡船，隨文聘船出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "8f846b6edf0d03d4ca2c47d99c6c80feefc23ac42b852b3ffe21640b689f92b1"}

{"id": "p_b1696a8b1159795e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 189, "text": "聘立在船頭，大叫：「丞相鈞旨，南船且休近寨，就江心拋住。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "1586f3bd55eb7ee03f86878974e8ccb151b8035d36fd78c23ffbcdd294ac9c72"}

{"id": "p_946c79d5e951fc60", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 190, "text": "」眾軍齊喝：「快下了篷！", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "15551478c117c5af35bb72324a9114b48931eea5607c55d5efa18fc8ddc36dde"}

{"id": "p_7feeea12102af34b", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 191, "text": "言未絕，弓弦響處，文聘被箭射中左臂，倒在船中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "62da7315db3022025a0167bed79a3b0a255f35443197877a2a0cf0edc0a7086b"}

{"id": "p_08d5f11853a18373", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 192, "text": "南船距操寨止隔二里水面。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "96fdf5aca892acad612998522221f0f2445489d1dd3936412fb91610888adb46"}

{"id": "p_71ae5e394d4685fe", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 193, "text": "黃蓋用刀一招，前船一齊發火。", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "a50aa24ff2b2631c50841816bc9e240e90ea0f4a073aed9134a2fe32e95c8980"}

{"id": "p_004d06145ee3d38a", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 194, "text": "火趁風威，風助火勢，船如箭發，煙燄障天。", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "43b1f801f6308a55579bcd54f2b13562f71bcf4fb5aef076ab11dc87c561ed88"}

{"id": "p_612097ea5136978e", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 195, "text": "曹寨中船隻一時盡著；又被鐵環銷住，無處逃避。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "03580fa0d925b50cb1022bc2c3b11c3c3954f922d738942701c6545c47fa80a9"}

{"id": "p_4665742368bd94f3", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 196, "text": "隔江砲響，四下火船齊到，但見三江面上，火逐風飛，一派通紅，漫天徹地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "576d5ae9e75a976e1d2a8b2d4ebb3321707657d66cd1abcaad0f37db1a385612"}

{"id": "p_92b8a0a40f41a468", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 197, "text": "曹操回觀岸上營寨，幾處煙火。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "01a0c0325fd0ef9f25e6fabec1784086642383632bffca6e5470f2634bfa1080"}

{"id": "p_2cdc893cb9df820f", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 198, "text": "黃蓋跳在小船上，背後數人駕舟，冒煙突火，來尋曹操，操見勢急，方欲跳上岸，忽張遼駕一小腳船，扶操下得船時，那隻大船，已自著了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "b958abde8edf6f92f739e0b6a129d9cbae37de8429c9ce4d00ec75ca4debd783"}

{"id": "p_47c113918c9d47d0", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 199, "text": "張遼與十數人保護曹操，飛奔岸口。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "91d50741a5bd9474bc512f6915a4a94e5ff961709d5059ffb5d6cb5f81c5be1c"}

{"id": "p_cc489251f9d31173", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 200, "text": "黃蓋望見穿絳紅袍者下船，料是曹操，乃催船速進，手提利刃，高聲大叫：「曹賊休走！", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "8ad2e723abd21f6acfc4578bcfc62df0585bfe052f4e67a1ab0b0055d530466a"}

{"id": "p_fc233310bb59c0f7", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 201, "text": "張遼拈弓搭箭，覷著黃蓋較近，一箭射去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "18e1a219e6c844fc5dcc833a57220d3539c6ded4ee8c225fa44fb30d11c7e491"}

{"id": "p_7d5654c1fe47132b", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 202, "text": "此時風聲正大，黃蓋在火光中，那裏聽得弓弦響？", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "d24776ed10675038febbe31a4ace734fc6fa6364de59fa9bbe75e193a2f8b842"}

{"id": "p_5e041438772cf4ff", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 203, "text": "::火厄盛時遭水厄，棒瘡愈後患金瘡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "da421cb11d364f358be7653f3ebbe49fbd73ef105785287e8c580dbbc7879c6c"}

{"id": "p_064388af155fdd30", "source_id": "src_ca69bb01982a705c", "ordinal": 204, "text": "未知黃蓋性命如何，且看下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "ac62e0716fc3115ada13302ffef8827a25d2504305151edbc053c4010940f3ee"}

{"id": "p_27681d03a9098ebb", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說當夜張遼一箭射黃蓋下水，救得曹操登岸，尋著馬匹走時，軍已大亂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "ca2c5a09874a8015a8724f5056f3e417ee48653f8a68a43f5e8ded875edebb97"}

{"id": "p_6a6e18fb11e3e3b3", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 1, "text": "韓當冒煙突火來攻水寨，忽聽得士卒報道：「後梢舵上一人，高叫將軍表字。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "e82d2e7a2ce31faaba67ebf41b42a2877891d643e71c2ea23797017dd41d75c9"}

{"id": "p_d73efb31c9edf7fc", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 2, "text": "」韓當細聽，但聞高叫：「義公救我！", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "80877175f95a1994db9af070cf487213a3c0bbebd90875f981b685f9685580e4"}

{"id": "p_947eadf0af5d3cbc", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 3, "text": "見黃蓋負箭著傷，咬出箭桿，箭頭陷在肉內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "cd06af1759bca797c7b2f5cbe6252e5affd4ddf1c8f9e3ddbb193f424a20175e"}

{"id": "p_4a6e2922f6e22695", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 4, "text": "韓當急為脫去濕衣，用刀剜出箭頭，扯旗束之，脫自己戰袍與黃蓋穿了，先令別船送回大寨醫治。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "a54323ebbba281524d09e20cef3e433e9ff72183a8a86e8b5b60200a01ec169a"}

{"id": "p_7ab15346178c3fa6", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 5, "text": "原來黃蓋深知水性，故大寒之時，和甲墮江，也逃得性命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "2c36f92d68c1a399f0609fa4365c8086d45254e90503ea9fb55e82f416e768e1"}

{"id": "p_2be775fd5c50ac16", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 6, "text": "卻說當日滿江火滾，喊聲震地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "aea0bbb55751610a6853f2963798370f80ff65fcec8049c3c1226302d0353a4c"}

{"id": "p_75a836ecabd95981", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 7, "text": "左邊是韓當、蔣欽兩軍從赤壁西邊殺來；右邊是周泰、陳武兩軍從赤壁東邊殺來；正中是周瑜、程普、徐盛、丁奉大隊船隻都到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "45f3c5392070bb308b54d510291359d269c0ac76c625c941b51c2ac80d2058ea"}

{"id": "p_bd520e376da18373", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 8, "text": "此正是：三江水戰，赤壁鏖兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "eb15e612ffa6f071725424ccf8df710d2366bd2ac08871e8430fc817c2d53c9f"}

{"id": "p_c512581b57fb9fc6", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 9, "text": "曹軍著槍中箭、火焚水溺者，不計其數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "7d8be0217346550bf6171c75a6dccfa5fa95db87adf4dd7eb6d2ba6d37ad6789"}

{"id": "p_0d23b6b0756503f5", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 10, "text": "::魏吳爭鬥決雌雄，赤壁樓船一掃空。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "8eb5a7fd474bb9a177b3433e69010f571ac951ff6c7e38282316799674a46947"}

{"id": "p_5d08d39a21764b40", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 11, "text": "::烈火初張照雲海，周郎曾此破曹公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "c1de3645304ba103e236ab5fde0a6bb004ce508ef67eb324a8fd108ccd095022"}

{"id": "p_d0ea154f11aea7a4", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 12, "text": "::山高月小水茫茫，追歎前朝割據忙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "78924fdfe20ee3b3856b510f546d219747e14d1020940e88f1f0ad0ea6f5c4fa"}

{"id": "p_3464ce62f37fe3d2", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 13, "text": "::南士無心迎魏武，東風有意便周郎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "98e64d4a98948fbb3c4940749be3adbd897d09a9afcb94093418a8a91ad96dd4"}

{"id": "p_e5d1ce8b5ac566d2", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 14, "text": "且說甘寧令蔡中引入曹寨深處，寧將蔡中一刀砍於馬下，就草上放起火來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "305f9f310df3302b5a89924e812dd5939fd6cf72a76e4bcf45cee9afc2e92e7e"}

{"id": "p_5af265987d67156c", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 15, "text": "呂蒙遙望中軍火起，也放十數處火，接應甘寧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "b6d813264eb6b5484b6ae06e87d3bb42b5be4694cfe198610c9696bdc6d0ca7f"}

{"id": "p_83ad93bb812562ca", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 16, "text": "潘璋、董襲分頭放火吶喊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "0c6e14f812f9e5b95a868785b7c62a97846056f99e35c4961ec84b4eb548f8c1"}

{"id": "p_36cb26e406687c53", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 17, "text": "曹操與張遼引百餘騎，在火林內走，看前面無一處不著。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "572b4da435dfc21ece6d79b690eeabc00cf708903420a51fdb411219269795c7"}

{"id": "p_ffdcd8866cf33227", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 18, "text": "正走之間，毛玠救得文聘，引十數騎到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "57493e4231496147d4f39ea4effd0a38d526d3bc834fd2893c077d85f8175b66"}

{"id": "p_dfed9f38d139c9d8", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 19, "text": "張遼指道：「只有烏林，地面空闊可走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "d6add23ce9710103f3af1d3e018a999e45fb7d0e6e385c969dd8b15fe75e0767"}

{"id": "p_5572b1d916bb10bf", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 20, "text": "正走間，背後一軍趕到，大叫：「曹賊休走！", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "e3b1312c179181a1b417934e39fe92951776231c72c4bb2a9333b8dc09a8bac6"}

{"id": "p_3eeca9ec4d0cc372", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 21, "text": "操催軍馬向前，留張遼斷後，抵敵呂蒙。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "3552a5d43144a39d09445b46a897683d4e700fdf73e7a06f9a3be38642cd2fac"}

{"id": "p_56a4ca4aad70393d", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 22, "text": "卻見前面火把又起，從山谷中擁出一軍，大叫：「凌統在此！", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "7a5e670939d0e71ed682884c3b4231bb8077288afb8691810cd8ae8e5288b357"}

{"id": "p_4ebff83994696108", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 23, "text": "忽刺斜裏一彪軍到，大叫：「丞相休慌！", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "d1ba218031110c295a7a2b829e90c6c28cb67d1d330eefec6aa958b704b044ab"}

{"id": "p_adb7076786212a9b", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」彼此混戰一場，奪路望北而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "25faa44a4ca819eef6cc77e11055c314e5bbd30e34f2d4c8c8b4d7d8f7fd8a50"}

{"id": "p_edeff0fe06976d25", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 25, "text": "忽見一隊軍馬屯在山坡前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "bee0de77ab301a87e03dc503655cc1deac21abca253429e86c58e89462402eae"}

{"id": "p_a4b77c2c7688f04a", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 26, "text": "徐晃出問，乃是袁紹手下降將馬延、張顗，有三千北地軍馬，列寨在彼；當夜見滿天火起，未敢轉動，恰好接著曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "3bc9046b2096a8eb0c560d178aea777f0d6fb5100550709595696e2731a9aa98"}

{"id": "p_a59c327a1af46f33", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 27, "text": "操教二將引一千軍馬開路，其餘留著護身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "2c9b8b2b4bfae3c03597b3c87d6a9fbf9a31feb0706d548be67409cd712053e7"}

{"id": "p_0b4cf168380f94fb", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 28, "text": "操得這枝生力軍馬，心中稍安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "a52118d1738389a68ea9f586102004cbc4803fbcedf2b38ed5530082cc08f14c"}

{"id": "p_7f9e788e30329eee", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 29, "text": "馬延、張顗二將飛騎前行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "125962fed53a899802e5111f1878cf7bc07d9d7b3635193d95ff031fe069c08c"}

{"id": "p_210d5c5d6f43d07e", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 30, "text": "不到十里，喊聲起處，一彪軍出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "d3abfb37a7e69fa5f414a1e09d1acb9038503d95e3d63208f2f2c79405146687"}

{"id": "p_4c2cb31cd2a99d53", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 31, "text": "為首一將，大呼曰：「吾乃東吳甘興霸也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "c6877d84c36de444f89a9d065b22e6faea6ada72fb1fd13da1a48d9b943f0e26"}

{"id": "p_69806d80fbe25ab7", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」馬延正欲交鋒，早被甘寧一刀斬於馬下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "43b797014493d774290fdf50bebc44fc6adda3e1ceaa2b150956a43d396f3a73"}

{"id": "p_5fa4a24c848397ce", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 33, "text": "張顗挺槍來迎，寧大喝一聲，顗措手不及，被寧手起一刀，翻身落馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "609c04ea3438b8d07d2610a98bf8360ec6b38c61e6a80990c462457147d9299b"}

{"id": "p_bb01abc17925ab84", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 34, "text": "操此時指望合淝有兵救應，不想孫權在合淝路口，望見江中火光，知是我軍得勝，便教陸遜舉火為號；太史慈見了，與陸遜合兵一處，衝殺將來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "6cd2bb937e154d328b3d0983a4a4188228f2898c5f87794cc61cfbae98b3d8ce"}

{"id": "p_25d32363c75a4d77", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 35, "text": "路上撞見張郃，操令斷後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "31f69dc9783aca64e6b64b097cb39ccb14950b3f0063d1352765a8fa23a6a93a"}

{"id": "p_6025e929fcf6f89e", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 36, "text": "縱馬加鞭，走至五更，回望火光漸遠，操心方定，問曰：「此是何處？", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "3f66e1ce0b9b9662fbe450e0e60ba8f47486dd07a1c0bdc337e98f86fbc76268"}

{"id": "p_f364eb918f8b2bf7", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」左右曰：「此是烏林之西，宜都之北。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "7dc2bbc768774ccc2163e6cf35c47d85041a1c276b81d6e8ef3dffb78e56ff51"}

{"id": "p_d156f8f812b93112", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」操見樹林叢雜，山川險峻，乃於馬上仰面大笑不止。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "397b4816679a674fd31c647bb3e3e8072ed5526ba08c37ff4ed59ec29357ad13"}

{"id": "p_e383bfe9d3c62c21", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 39, "text": "諸將問曰：「丞相何故大笑？", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "168ee2d3e544a2d539146a5d114db8b0b1bb312a8242dbbb0fd89944821ccadb"}

{"id": "p_b1b4e74a9c8b9688", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」操曰：「吾不笑別人，單笑周瑜無謀，諸葛亮少智。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "564c5a7f9f04772482ce5f14c82b37a81ce0d39db3a90eeeda75cab118f27074"}

{"id": "p_21a5cfec9335cf70", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 41, "text": "若是吾用兵之時，預先在這裏伏下一軍，如之奈何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "286f153934a37bcd180c5131b5410729df99ac2caf3d253e155e3e7f680088a7"}

{"id": "p_48225ebdb61cf16f", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 42, "text": "說猶未了，兩邊鼓聲震響，火光沖天而起，驚得曹操幾乎墜馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "fb136812ac8ecaaed812851c1eafef3b8ff8569deb3673e593bf90ad33558b0b"}

{"id": "p_6e2fa32863e8cd68", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 43, "text": "刺斜裏一彪軍殺出，大叫：「我趙子龍奉軍師將令，在此等候多時了！", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "922c897fdf42b891ad98affc84c3cc9b14f979da03e8f49caeea3e46393647cd"}

{"id": "p_2eb2ffdab3429787", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 44, "text": "」操教徐晃、張郃雙敵趙雲，自己冒煙突火而去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "4aa353a51f9735983f4e29c3a2711ebd245f235c209bbae202c4fac4199c74aa"}

{"id": "p_2774a57fa3fd3f0e", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 45, "text": "子龍不來追趕，只顧搶奪旗幟，曹操得脫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "dc43036c113f01d91690b0c08caa266e64b05631554486321918c6e9a7265187"}

{"id": "p_90d50bd0f4ebdb75", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 46, "text": "天色微明，黑雲罩地，東南風尚不息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "a38687126baec8984c4498bfd6dd5995434a06d3861bb645393fb1882d3aea25"}

{"id": "p_b17ea0273f72b632", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 47, "text": "忽然大雨傾盆，濕透衣甲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "2fb812c863ed329b3ac9aaf75d68d2a6d4cba5416e270f166159f15e625f2507"}

{"id": "p_a2e3225eb3a9bc72", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 48, "text": "操與軍士冒雨而行，諸軍皆有飢色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "19b4c12f354cf31debf7ff956140658165c3e3f76b5e7f10d9b4627ddd79419d"}

{"id": "p_803dd029f7bee3e5", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 49, "text": "操令軍士往村落中劫掠糧食，尋覓火種。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "b759bbe70993e42e2a94fe61cf549534eb297758ac2fec8b9dc05b2f35651950"}

{"id": "p_fa829e49374c939f", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 50, "text": "方欲造飯，後面一軍趕到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "300526f8ed8d7f66baaf3e2328539a95982fa1416e1c252106fa0fe8fdd44ffd"}

{"id": "p_0033d1b907139b19", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 51, "text": "原來卻是李典、許褚保謢著眾謀士來到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "fe91cda83a1bfb1213c6301de74ce104202ec279977fe9c8ec61e098b15be14c"}

{"id": "p_adbaf99aee283299", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 52, "text": "操大喜，令軍馬且行，問：「前面是那裏地面？", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "29777b1d185f68948956d30ea087faae87436baaa44e229313dfba5eb8075bda"}

{"id": "p_ffabfdd1ef29e2f7", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 53, "text": "」人報：「一邊是南彝陵大路，一邊是北彝陵山路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "990560ee9b55ee143bb993a2df8a7d8b25f2756ede0a4eb69e7a5f006ceb024f"}

{"id": "p_7fac5d61934b2370", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 54, "text": "」操問：「那裏投南郡江陵去近？", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "b8d26ea190b92f685806d6e3c23f2af0d1a36baca55844a8c2ef2fe3d12a0bc7"}

{"id": "p_90659cae0484e90c", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 55, "text": "」軍士稟曰：「取南彝陵過葫蘆口去最便。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "a8b3f0d5548ca4963750e5729ec240280592c877f4f5d262691fd0691f8666b0"}

{"id": "p_db720a5590b28f02", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 56, "text": "行至葫蘆口，軍皆飢餒，行走不上，馬亦困乏，多有倒於路者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "9734fa196abafb73f2dd78869bf480be50330cfe90e8e5181b66f28e5c230d8b"}

{"id": "p_1824f2f7bfc9e9e3", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 57, "text": "馬上有帶得鑼鍋的，也有村中掠得糧米的，便就山邊揀乾處埋鍋造飯，割馬肉燒吃，盡皆脫去濕衣，於風頭吹晒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "b9c15a1e858cb3478df4df065843bbfd552e2fc79bc198876bf891056f115838"}

{"id": "p_ef0267affe850cc6", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 58, "text": "馬皆摘鞍野放，咽咬草根。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "e33e123885e81ad5a6620247e37623a393d166dc198a12e55d9fa89527bf53ba"}

{"id": "p_fda7a2ec3bf96827", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 59, "text": "操坐於疏林之下，仰面大笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "3d09c7c7f26e57f4bfcdcf421e7f13ddeb36a9afa4a315754a7637cfaee54a09"}

{"id": "p_0644a550d9388ff6", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 60, "text": "眾官問曰：「適來丞相笑周瑜、諸葛亮，引惹出趙子龍來，又折了許多人馬，如今為何又笑？", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "8173e88f065e9797d038065c1e008b304988b6ee33344cc368542e6890bee0e1"}

{"id": "p_851fc0711e9e5726", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」操曰：「吾笑諸葛亮、周瑜，畢竟智謀不足。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "2d06cc206a10041b7a3812233e11208f23948eeefc8074af5fd6cde3b61db1e9"}

{"id": "p_7a669724bc678aa4", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 62, "text": "若是我用兵時，就這個去處，也埋伏一彪軍馬，以逸待勞；我等縱然脫得性命，也不免重傷矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "6dd2fcd61ed035dbb62a87a7447ead36dd18733f8a4ca33158eaf5aa5ccc3c91"}

{"id": "p_0996263ad50cdc5d", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 63, "text": "彼見不到此，我是以笑之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "966bc40611591ade39ad7d9e830f99ac92f77670bd86155cdf35b023ad77f058"}

{"id": "p_b819c19a31539134", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 64, "text": "正說間，前軍後軍一齊發喊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "880c4a0260e320db4e87556ea82c0522e9d287fcb4efc46480e9d718345b5161"}

{"id": "p_660acb015e2d43fe", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 65, "text": "早見四下火煙布合山口，一軍擺開。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "e5022526571fb657d5ea5bbc02e265875e9ac12434e578c79d04e4c5a7f92774"}

{"id": "p_06403ab1a59e53f1", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 66, "text": "為首乃燕人張翼德，橫矛立馬，大叫：「操賊走那裏去！", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "ecf3eab9e3dea38bbab109ad89a41404a79957227956331b2c7d6363d03f3658"}

{"id": "p_7b0f50adb8cb1aa1", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 67, "text": "」諸軍眾將見了張飛，盡皆膽寒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "9bec6a9786f04ef2ea3da6b2c1791ba352f087a5756a485a076849b3f536bc4d"}

{"id": "p_d41c899444b88f16", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 68, "text": "張遼、徐晃二將，縱馬也來夾攻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "5ecc7d5a55941579445f9977af360b21f78ff89c4b5ab63ed5b4f4260233a2fb"}

{"id": "p_11e850f9a9bfad33", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 69, "text": "操先撥馬走脫，諸將各自脫身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "948ebff8fa1fceef6cb0cb766a8e016da14a73f72ad24daaf4a22c9a76162878"}

{"id": "p_219d667c0d7c48a6", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 70, "text": "操迤邐奔逃，追兵漸遠，回顧眾將多已帶傷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "7c33a1c7f3ea0510aa4cf4a43d6dda69d595a88a9a0cb792cb6ca29d8c4ed445"}

{"id": "p_43d4a552cccc0d05", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 71, "text": "正行間，軍士稟曰：「前面有兩條路，請問丞相從那條路去？", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "6e284f9bb5d6a61a9ee043ed87af82388db9509b02eff5c51058ecdd5c291364"}

{"id": "p_903fa59ec59a477d", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 72, "text": "」軍士曰：「大路稍平，卻遠五十餘里；小路投華容道，卻近五十餘里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "c30e7e3116588d07a1b90af46d3ce7935efe6df271baf706c300e2da0448ca8d"}

{"id": "p_7e89e02d231cbaa3", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 73, "text": "只是地窄路險，坑坎難行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "5e6609acdbfc854aac4ce6a87c00c436da6c4c333ac307de5b0a0662042b9dbd"}

{"id": "p_cdcfd8f03afddf07", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 74, "text": "」操令人上山觀望，回報：「小路山邊有數處煙起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "67eb3581bafe607a0833441b15241ceb73b572cc84aec289577508c1e31b01df"}

{"id": "p_85e0b002fd96c0b0", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」操教前軍便走華容道小路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "f5d4676ceca92b251ded3d5e6fc7f799ee5a73e344e7fad0d8d779180a98639c"}

{"id": "p_b532efa58f6fcf8d", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 76, "text": "諸將曰：「烽煙起處，必有軍馬，何故反走這條路？", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "a6885dacb011430b522ed3d9253fd588fbe4314f0d533f8a4a98538772fd538e"}

{"id": "p_3f27167cb92a7af9", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」操曰：「豈不聞兵書有云：『虛則實之，實則虛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "2c917ec2bd88e2f0373bd3249dab32b5b9c5741fb1722a48c80817c9660a3e33"}

{"id": "p_5a6d3bddb6775694", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 78, "text": "』諸葛亮多謀，故使人於山僻燒煙，使我軍不敢從這條山路走，他卻伏兵於大路等著。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "655b5347ad8ee05d166b4073504301334a690e9eb698a2d13220b67bf7ac9476"}

{"id": "p_5681ef542e3f6f45", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 79, "text": "吾料已定，偏不教中他計！", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "d9925ffd39d13a129e1a1ecfa266128b0bd0812dfdc623e9862f527fd87d4e10"}

{"id": "p_8e8b0cb5284e4309", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 80, "text": "」諸將皆曰：「丞相妙算，人所不及。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "6e81bde3d34937e8ec3290caff414080932fbbfa48b487cdb808ca3ea7a1c07f"}

{"id": "p_7c47e58e552371d0", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 81, "text": "此時人皆飢倒，馬盡困乏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "95a8815db0eb186fd167b69917e15a984fb057a7aa4653d5936ecfdbb48cd54b"}

{"id": "p_8adbaa29de98d356", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 82, "text": "焦頭爛額者扶策而行，中箭著槍者勉強而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "5c2777b26a8588cfa497625cde125080180c9f8917dff4e29013b1807832a517"}

{"id": "p_876404db1e4392ae", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 83, "text": "衣甲濕透，個個不全；軍器旗旛，紛紛不整。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "45bb8ade1e373da2643f90f775cb9fb45dac42608826309a7c7eec1a767c3a27"}

{"id": "p_b0840a796493604f", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 84, "text": "大半皆是彝陵道上被趕得慌，只騎得禿馬，鞍轡衣服，盡皆拋棄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "3407ef90182ac51e2b340a0733747629c898880bdc793ba72d509e04fde8d51b"}

{"id": "p_7fda3289a1904133", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 85, "text": "正值隆冬嚴寒之時，其苦何可勝言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "e1a218b533b410fb8f7d33dea1917cfe15ead854a0d5ec09c8def757dbc2c048"}

{"id": "p_f255182e2ac59b78", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 86, "text": "操見前軍停馬不進，問是何故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "a33bb63220690ce8e9f7a25582df6bdb99783299cbf27329a63ad83d1fd55090"}

{"id": "p_b3592f80e2994902", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 87, "text": "回報曰：「前面山僻路小，因早晨下雨，坑塹內積水不流，泥陷馬蹄，不能前進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "c9781d175253b4bdad8ee8fd0621d17e8de60ae88e1da7e300b7f4d2d497d9f6"}

{"id": "p_df6283c16342788a", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 88, "text": "」操大怒，叱曰：「軍旅逢山開路，遇水疊橋，豈有泥濘不堪行之理！", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "2e54e34039a6814bb4931a5278b660ce40910636754f016b70880664018e5d87"}

{"id": "p_61578e2f6fe8f36a", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 89, "text": "」傳下號令，教老弱中傷軍士在後慢行，強壯者擔土束柴，搬草運蘆，填塞道路，務要即時行動；如違令者斬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "234ee851bf60e1e7d3cf7b662a407b8f248852e85ee64ad5f78d5258f2f7f768"}

{"id": "p_b820348a19c13323", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 90, "text": "眾軍只得都下馬，就路旁砍伐竹木，填塞山路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "1382cd785a390c58e6f390e2dc1e712b833c837853a10e5971d9a2b9fcaee472"}

{"id": "p_59f70f09ce1a1543", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 91, "text": "操恐後軍來趕，令張遼、許褚、徐晃引百騎執刀在手，但遲慢者便斬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "dc7030f0cdc3f214cd61d7f71605ffc0172aee81a041ed658ef74fb16117eefe"}

{"id": "p_621046966f05e14f", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 92, "text": "操喝令人馬沿棧而行，死者不可勝數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "cbbe738415ac7a18b4327e42d72ed725b76b6cfe4f45f215b4c64b6e47c8ce50"}

{"id": "p_630501f2af28e91b", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 93, "text": "操怒曰：「生死有命，何哭之有！", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "56a2800ebad1245901daae7ce3965f236d7d922cb8bd9068b5ed0acdcd82e369"}

{"id": "p_fd90df4169f4f825", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」三停人馬：一停落後，一停填了溝壑，一停跟隨曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "081d873d3d0d9584a426ada83289e899b455d91eec503ea534e985820031b477"}

{"id": "p_9d6ed4585d620f71", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 95, "text": "操回顧止有三百餘騎隨後，並無衣甲袍鎧整齊者。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "1822b6a82a993b08997e136b4e15c44b3e7b309b6a0bb6886a608d451002e08b"}

{"id": "p_1ae77f0057d4a6d9", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 96, "text": "眾將曰：「馬盡乏矣，只好少歇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "cca146d2c7e524796fb339f5b9fd4e52fab06bbfd462b3a8d00f76b63afb5029"}

{"id": "p_4de0a0e9203e2f53", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」操曰：「趕到荊州將息未遲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "7f550a553f49dbfbd8b91e7ca4a3d83746f9562d26e0169280f344742452d5c2"}

{"id": "p_c78625a511d981ad", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」又行不到數里，操在馬上揚鞭大笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "6696960bc15e55ba97f93244153ad1dde0e9d7d6b1dea1cb2249787575592601"}

{"id": "p_fe02a27410c276ef", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 99, "text": "眾將問：「丞相何又大笑？", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "e67da3e6bb9a9a0fefe342a34e588bf5abfcadab7fa9137df284d9afb43e7c47"}

{"id": "p_cadf3945f8a3e150", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 100, "text": "」操曰：「人皆言周瑜、諸葛亮足智多謀，以吾觀之，到底是無能之輩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "ef5124c314d891290fe2a5e44f22395f5f3352903f9adc87af58a672abdba272"}

{"id": "p_829a961bb22e3b95", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 101, "text": "若使此處伏一旅之師，吾等皆束手受縛矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "bfe0c30813a9d8e0b5bcaeb0e720f1cdcc507cba7f99caa04549fab3627387cb"}

{"id": "p_6d6c7e6afe68e9c7", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 102, "text": "言未畢，一聲砲響，兩邊五百校刀手擺開，為首大將關雲長，提青龍刀，跨赤兔馬，截住去路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "f6d6fc0da33909bfc45e9e2277b01bf909fe5b8f4b734fbf5c0b21690f1f6ed4"}

{"id": "p_aa7cb7c083845b50", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 103, "text": "操軍見了，亡魂喪膽，面面相覷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "1c82c5924673eaa2743f3302812914dfb9de2c9185a43ebb73d67630819f4361"}

{"id": "p_0606b90de27a069c", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 104, "text": "操曰：「既到此處，只得決一死戰！", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "bb78be9cb51c484f32915f4d3029b4a96269b6d6d133074e6eec993c668bb3e8"}

{"id": "p_f63cf6971e36f2ff", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 105, "text": "」眾將曰：「人縱然不怯，馬力已乏，安能復戰？", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "131618d81c27ea35c3c5e0eafc06be72246958f0bf17a9337afd84c703fa34f4"}

{"id": "p_2db311dcebf40c50", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」程昱曰：「某素知雲長傲上而不忍下，欺強而不凌弱；恩怨分明，信義素著。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "890e6c4ddf15c2aae3c9f742d16ee1481991b1b814225e6f5f808780d898fd87"}

{"id": "p_5a0a3a5552302814", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 107, "text": "丞相昔日有恩於彼，今只親自告之，可脫此難。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "5a85766813fb1b5209a2fc611d8b6b63c29d22857f001d00c959e22ad8fc5327"}

{"id": "p_3236ef87a2c89594", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 108, "text": "操從其說，即縱馬向前，欠身謂雲長曰：「將軍別來無恙？", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "8b9808d75776c4d9303e93eee8a856d2be4cdde7b88cedb573cf541bb16a7220"}

{"id": "p_70280532270e96ae", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 109, "text": "」雲長亦欠身答曰：「關某奉軍師將令，等候丞相多時。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "f7be71a70ff7afdc9f8e5d2d1bf84c2287af3c7bfe3cf2a6a63abf9b3aa016f3"}

{"id": "p_4cf77d2507353aee", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 110, "text": "」操曰：「曹操兵敗勢危，到此無路，望將軍以昔日之情為重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "4b9599e4a81a249129e273e8d0ff0280e33cb16ca54e17b8a70773cc52293528"}

{"id": "p_e375dcdd1ed0ce34", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 111, "text": "」雲長曰：「昔日關某雖蒙丞相厚恩，然已斬顏良，誅文醜，解白馬之圍，以奉報矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "5e6a20ab6bcc3dc26054ba1441bf28731adc7cc8f314604d466bd54be641c2f9"}

{"id": "p_4c671a979fd4bfe7", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 112, "text": "今日之事，豈敢以私廢公？", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "0aa1a51c1175ddf71371643d788ae8b37496d2f1ea45fb36f04af347f197519a"}

{"id": "p_6188214808727d1d", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」操曰：「五關斬將之時，還能記否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "b2e1b9c35373b837d7d21e84479e924ab5938216e3e4c303fa6f5e0cc8a0655c"}

{"id": "p_dd0eed32fa49ebab", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 114, "text": "將軍深明《春秋》，豈不知庾公之斯追子濯孺子之事乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "896c14268599bc9450022f5800d592205a654b63bcbac3b2bb9fd11ca5409518"}

{"id": "p_daae87210f852cd3", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 115, "text": "雲長是個義重如山之人，想起當日曹操許多恩義，與後來五關斬將之事，如何不動心？", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "ce564b05493b8312705226b7382f82510972ee7af6f030127c311635fc441523"}

{"id": "p_c9735464249e50c6", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 116, "text": "又見曹軍惶惶皆欲垂淚，越發心中不忍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "6a6f418ca7e2aa0dd856f883ee2abc61d8fafc098f854d37a81a9ed201f4f411"}

{"id": "p_0af421df67a44cd2", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 117, "text": "於是把馬頭勒回，謂眾軍曰：「四散擺開。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "5bbfc3608e93d1f55e81618b02f5520f6abb9d36aac3027863f1574bff193f16"}

{"id": "p_7157ab37192a2b02", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 118, "text": "」這個分明是放曹操的意思。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "766399983b88161195a4cd209e34ac35f0ba0dce3a68e87affb0a824daf3c09c"}

{"id": "p_73f3b245c7e1f8b1", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 119, "text": "操見雲長回馬，便和眾將一齊衝將過去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "e24a5594c90df0b3f97f8ac5f76eab688d96f571067554b9343b6084695648be"}

{"id": "p_351573bc304ab87d", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 120, "text": "雲長回身時，曹操已與眾將過去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "d1a96c0173a646922c55264a17eeef6e57b8e2ae2020b411e7621987179f06f9"}

{"id": "p_586cb863b5442b68", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 121, "text": "雲長大喝一聲，眾軍皆下馬，哭拜於地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "ba9c4cb5850466520140534fe2ecef071fce540ce4e0bf05b0cb26f1dae9354f"}

{"id": "p_67a94c78b9e629a9", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 122, "text": "正猶豫間，張遼驟馬而至，雲長見了，又動故舊之情；長歎一聲，並皆放去，後人有詩曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "2a9ba41820e8a68a41dcef3ba5e82d2f650f48b09b7ae6afe4ef6cb4d2ca2b93"}

{"id": "p_e582bc4fb2bf6163", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 123, "text": "::曹瞞兵敗走華容，正與關公狹路逢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "84f1ff3ba609ac5df63b9d97b80604c9e3cfab6bef89bf551475f3ba5b352700"}

{"id": "p_70920657b77f5c7f", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 124, "text": "::只為當初恩義重，放開金鎖走蛟龍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "0802f307eabbf89edd020c22ca87fabb42bd61f91bd4616d93a3bc74a139db49"}

{"id": "p_b96a720859d6126f", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 125, "text": "曹操既脫華容之難，行至谷口，回顧所隨軍兵，止有二十七騎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "93bd60609cb8294df362ab4af0d124fd4bf1f3ed2622afd521da0d760f017847"}

{"id": "p_22821b6b327068f7", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 126, "text": "比及天晚，已近南郡，火把齊明，一簇人馬攔路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "548e50440842e0236d359207a93c794da5452865e643235f4587610ddc29c31f"}

{"id": "p_9dbab339bcc2dc1b", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」只見一群哨馬衝到，方認得是曹仁軍馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "c63d2826c3bd36a13c16e648258a3d3b15ebf3610b45117440ecc5a2ca89e9d1"}

{"id": "p_f055098ceea1f084", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 128, "text": "曹仁接著，言：「雖知兵敗，不敢遠離，只得在附近迎接。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "c2cde7924a781e6a7839f1c4cb2c8d8f48e52719b1ff8c7913736953802bbddd"}

{"id": "p_7dc3c81e2868caaa", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 129, "text": "」操曰：「幾與汝不相見也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "3356342e0c17e98eb541fd27fc12f916d6b51892a3154c556e22aee82f65d860"}

{"id": "p_f8dc1622c5f28a0b", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 130, "text": "隨後張遼也到，說雲長之德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "89cd3bd4ca65dc38a32e9f339d133606c08285dac0db19f366354849757e8a75"}

{"id": "p_da04ce8a919f9d0e", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 131, "text": "操點將校，中傷者極多，操皆令將息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "f04c1bc0e0f0c55c9fcacfcfdf860bf07543d05fd29a9f4b8f1af56cb2a8c304"}

{"id": "p_bf5ae64bd41aec63", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 132, "text": "曹仁置酒與操解悶，眾謀士俱在座。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "2cc49e1fd3bbb2e61593cb9d19d68bd2f5048ffc00861bf625068cc2dca339c6"}

{"id": "p_252827a0eead66ee", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 133, "text": "眾謀士曰：「丞相於虎窟中逃難之時，全無懼怯；今到城中，人已得食，馬已得料，正須整頓軍馬復仇，何反痛哭？", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "29cf6de1897a249dd02aba99c0b7d07aaa046c94eb99a9a70dfe48e7d75038d3"}

{"id": "p_be7d7313b76d8e72", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 134, "text": "」操曰：「吾哭郭奉孝耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "9025a5b51339c4bdb195e8d51dc9cc21f7c1b37a48b91505f778ee0895ea3476"}

{"id": "p_89293823d77ab6e0", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 135, "text": "若奉孝在，決不使吾有此大失也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "58a78deff2dcfcd72c52c89c846ad54f614e9b898a99c53d036f3df372f41f4b"}

{"id": "p_5e329fa03e0b5fd9", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 136, "text": "」遂搥胸大哭曰：「哀哉，奉孝！", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "3fa2c53bcb1cc068836ffc544d953c435bc282cf59085c95d8043e495e2cd10c"}

{"id": "p_1193b0fd5baddfdd", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 137, "text": "次日，操喚曹仁曰：「吾今暫回許都，收拾軍馬，必來報讎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "cdf1756cdafae5d9da334718e9a76d211395b499559f3c1918a6d23795b64bae"}

{"id": "p_32cfb75290b224fd", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 138, "text": "吾有一計，密留在此，非急休開，急則開之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "f72e53561fd40edfb8bf3eaeaef3f0b00c6692e0922e17cbe45801a4531bfe9d"}

{"id": "p_c0d9da4f147d6fd4", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 139, "text": "依計而行，使東吳不敢正視南郡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "9feb83d03dd1215a56eb14c1a317a206a88d10765c0a7737d519eb3728019426"}

{"id": "p_efd2f7929118d216", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」仁曰：「合淝、襄陽，誰可保守？", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "a726c1df2d6adbe9c4cdc459552e197d9ddb2e3b45e9be79d0ab8c02d622fd89"}

{"id": "p_3d76142e6a098804", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 141, "text": "」操曰：「荊州託汝管領；襄陽吾已撥夏侯惇守把。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "aa1e356966de89013e6b8b7b9e3cd6552ee68bf646422ab672d6f1bf1988c808"}

{"id": "p_505795a23a8fbf53", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 142, "text": "合淝最為緊要之地，吾命張遼為主將，樂進、李典為副將，保守此地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "6ff6db71cab34d1b72c2c034e3de84e9dba26d7e7ac33f833c33fcff6d447211"}

{"id": "p_18357da3a24f95c6", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 143, "text": "操分撥已定，遂上馬引眾奔回許昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "76207215cf5401d235b17e600bfd5d5d5f29aa1a5dcdbfcdd6213bfea0a74ed5"}

{"id": "p_ed889102c94472ce", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 144, "text": "荊州原降文武各官，依舊帶回許昌調用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "7a3fe9ae2fe6dfbcb7ad6bf3ebe828e3ca006dc4b665af9ebaf3afa41c529289"}

{"id": "p_eb1f358bdb45ac31", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 145, "text": "曹仁自遺曹洪據守彝陵、南郡，以防周瑜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "41eb3b6b2d367048ab1445c38c247ae3de0083f4ef7b9fe1c0024d603205e87c"}

{"id": "p_95cf08bc112bcd68", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 146, "text": "卻說關雲長放了曹操，引軍自回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "282f7dbee1dc2456f6edd02269d63ce1bc8311f745167a8b14b7432253dea700"}

{"id": "p_abc772f44ec7b17a", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 147, "text": "此時諸路軍馬，皆得馬匹、器械、錢糧，已回夏口；獨雲長不獲一人一騎，空身回見玄德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "16416d0ba35fe02f6ce7b199a6527732ca2754d435bc2c98f3f2670310f23abd"}

{"id": "p_e9430e3d05459f12", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 148, "text": "孔明正與玄德作賀，忽報雲長至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "88b600e1bcd8db3389610eabc9fd85840316e4a15bf6538a91007a971115fdfa"}

{"id": "p_3125b8d20a65298f", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 149, "text": "孔明忙離坐席，執盃相迎曰：「且喜將軍立此蓋世之功，與普天下除大害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "08eb0a3fd55ec8e32054d8ec0f3740903cf6443986b01f784a812b10b5b50e80"}

{"id": "p_422126a5a60b52ea", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 150, "text": "孔明曰：「將軍莫非因吾等不曾遠接，故而不樂？", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "6a72df3b48f080d182da9a5ee6bf6904ac8f677273ae4b037a8688d3b5b96bac"}

{"id": "p_71005ef69d112347", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」回顧左右曰：「汝等緣何不先報？", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "e934209fb8b0f60a21ca29b4735d6c771c7957cb7a9c6a5d332ca67acedbe74f"}

{"id": "p_c8bac0690c895a7a", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 152, "text": "」雲長曰：「關某特來請死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "5ea02c21dc7c57ca66840fe8b00faf8b930f8e62d30367e76117522f79b10086"}

{"id": "p_238ea0e86349f639", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 153, "text": "」孔明曰：「莫非曹操不曾投華容道上來？", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "b1b6ed76c8306a595abd9139a47c5d5e7d29ceaf98732383ef8dcf96b2c2f4f4"}

{"id": "p_b65748ef15901c58", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」雲長曰：「是從那裏來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "96240420024a297bf8d768ffe16f479eaacf0ce8ed5586ca6cc8628405a285c4"}

{"id": "p_4b716705f58b61f8", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 156, "text": "」孔明曰：「拏得甚將士來？", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "bef938963b3e52ce0f429524d2e799d10677b2c60d2c357e6a80acf8875a1fe1"}

{"id": "p_9fc81c983f897f45", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 157, "text": "」孔明曰：「此是雲長想曹操昔日之恩，故意放了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "a2cd0132827449021372710e88c00a6408169f596009bbff089d339a2ddc8675"}

{"id": "p_78eb1382abffd6d0", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 158, "text": "但既有軍令狀在此，不得不按軍法。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "5963eb9148ea95067b662fe3c28562b357061600e0de6f7b1afe2dbeff35b673"}

{"id": "p_7a0f1aa877a04e52", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 159, "text": "::拚將一死酬知己，致令千秋仰義名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "e1263bd923639fada19267d2d83854e028509476c731a80ddf705971a0e3dd90"}

{"id": "p_7ac592ff290de504", "source_id": "src_645f42b6027c794a", "ordinal": 160, "text": "未知雲長性命如何，且看下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "210035ba8791362e7ba3142805187aca48f90be3d94bf1a2c3cc005b39b27915"}

{"id": "p_413caaf209dc5a85", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說周瑜怒氣填胸，墜於馬下，左右急救歸船。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "06439770920ef720077597099dd412e3578958d3566860304861b8dae4588520"}

{"id": "p_e6e050f17f7a5cc3", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 1, "text": "軍士傳說：「玄德、孔明在前山頂上飲酒取樂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "c3367ed5b1a9bbff83b5185f9a0f4a6e1c98176edfa51aa9d0b551389807f9cf"}

{"id": "p_664d084b5930bea0", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 2, "text": "」瑜大怒，咬牙切齒曰：「你道我取不得西川，吾誓取之！", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "6f9b7cf39b70ba75a2c29cac47c1fd9ce10baa7166d6d878c0c5bee3f016cd33"}

{"id": "p_67c3f71f280e2406", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 3, "text": "」正恨間，人報吳侯遣弟孫瑜到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "8d38a87961428f8ed4949a8b513a0b89757d7bf9b30f8ee06dbc03954b55fa2e"}

{"id": "p_0acd94437bdf1c24", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 4, "text": "孫瑜曰：「吾奉兄命來助都督。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "a6b25ca174938655cb18887515d480d9d4dc03fc5795a4506ceef03915658a28"}

{"id": "p_dd2d7c90e5293e8c", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 5, "text": "行至巴丘，人報上流有劉封、關平二人領軍截住水路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "122f7d376c136e9b01c0d9afed34fd48b0aafcda4d6eb28a00f5b8940f3a0685"}

{"id": "p_0ed3918c6c14ae01", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 6, "text": "::「漢軍師中郎將諸葛亮，致書於東吳大都督公瑾先生麾下：自柴桑一別，至今戀戀不忘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "87e0decdd3100e523df40c17ee7f9227ee840df5da0f1ad3366fdf9507979462"}

{"id": "p_259cc6a596c41714", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 7, "text": "聞足下欲取西川，亮竊以為不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "b085c800a1cef55fe812b8359369da3cd37edee4824aa47b568136a191e779e9"}

{"id": "p_a6cae06cdd0bdf31", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 8, "text": "益州民強地險，劉璋雖暗弱，足以自守；今勞師遠征，轉運萬里，欲收全功，雖吳起不能定其規，孫武不能善其後也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "25cff19d28ce06ec2483239131cae239eb98924d04ee53b4171dd5ac810fca18"}

{"id": "p_91bc5ab6d9fd19f9", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 9, "text": "曹操失利於赤壁，志豈須臾忘報讎哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "40d68392670da8adc0eb08c46c97de203843d4c81e8586a0ca856d2665acb347"}

{"id": "p_5b3397628255cb08", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 10, "text": "今足下興兵遠征，倘操乘虛而至，江南虀粉矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "c7407587d7ea844d30b5c5006d9de38702ccb4bfe1fad3c02f3bf2f5ac5d6df3"}

{"id": "p_86b9e2cec8b69c60", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 11, "text": "亮不忍坐視，特此告知，幸垂照鑒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "22d1bca822c4b7f24e19043c646853335f5b7ac335e724ffb2e4b98ec6700cd8"}

{"id": "p_98f9733de3fac5d2", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 12, "text": "周瑜覽畢，長歎一聲，喚左右取紙筆作書上吳侯，乃聚眾將曰：「吾非不欲盡忠報國，奈天命已絕矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "fc1f4f6de768e4947a3caf9b800f28ab65f0a833bbd3ae25e99ab1b10e852c9d"}

{"id": "p_e1602b7c847a50dc", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 13, "text": "汝等善事吳侯，共成大業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "ff4abdfd60956697bf4c21bb385380bc67515a7a1a2cd90498dc12d3a12120b0"}

{"id": "p_58919a6a2e4b4cd2", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 14, "text": "徐徐又醒，仰天長歎曰：「既生瑜，何生亮！", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "56d3c81a88824c3d1cb89ec70aff64b03565863e9c2878256770b81b303388b4"}

{"id": "p_20e2e9dbe9f7137d", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 15, "text": "::赤壁遺雄烈，青年有駿聲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "2826ff7364f5f0863bac10b1103aac9f6b66e4bbccb54714f74922a73c82ce26"}

{"id": "p_cdcd18fa6c9ec485", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 16, "text": "::絃歌知雅意，盃酒謝良朋。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "59bf5767a8ecd181ddaf4b6087db861e1021abb569d920581430303abe986ef2"}

{"id": "p_de7924aedd51539a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 17, "text": "::曾謁三千斛，常驅十萬兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "6d753a37e3e0dae138f621be5090501226517402c6b035c92be42c9a5c546f41"}
