{"id": "p_a5db3370b4246507", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 18, "text": "::巴丘終命處，憑弔欲傷情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "d8690d43d8e2d61a19a8704c016355936dd6373bf82e6d7cf84d0a219f15295d"}

{"id": "p_642ad8afe6ba73dd", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 19, "text": "眾將將所遺書緘，遣人飛報孫權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "83f80a3059eb267f8f43340dd2ba2610e3e4ca5817ef473973fcb56e69726503"}

{"id": "p_1b57dc895e8cdd17", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 20, "text": "拆視其書，乃薦魯肅以自代也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "6f2b107925c8145da98a01c925475bf50a55585e79dac04500414f1059ff7e70"}

{"id": "p_80cd86993ed1c601", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 21, "text": "::「瑜以凡才，荷蒙殊遇，委任腹心，統御兵馬，敢不竭股肱之力，以圖報效？", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "c2129b843be54665d01a40e2b47e07f8acbb10a23bfdf94576b83a8885002fa3"}

{"id": "p_13d596b03191a336", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 22, "text": "奈死生不測，修短有命；愚志未展，微軀已殞，遺恨何極！", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "10d18a2f1970912c2b2d83b44bc069747426d352672b4f90c2c6d4213b4abc9a"}

{"id": "p_aafe377e46b99b4c", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 23, "text": "方今曹操在北，疆場未靜；劉備寄寓，有似養虎；天下之事，尚未可知。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "6696c99737d3e09ed720277264e272006f81efc28ca61b6175ed8804869c8b46"}

{"id": "p_4f11fe356ff37599", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 24, "text": "此正朝士旰食之秋，至尊垂慮之日也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "b07f95be580dbefd74c3f90dcba812373ca307609d90b53f6359c69e27671b26"}

{"id": "p_cdeabaddf7787e14", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 25, "text": "魯肅忠烈，臨事不苟，可以代瑜之任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "d3fd215403a87a772d0259232f70d4596534dd37a5752c4d1efbcec20dacc071"}

{"id": "p_32143bbfc0c9e8a0", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 26, "text": "『人之將死，其言也善』。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "4e75a399bde7a6d4a4bc27c1f13700ec1543dc48825483552ffe8df24851649e"}

{"id": "p_a60947065a1b4e80", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 27, "text": "孫權覽畢，哭曰：「公瑾有王佐之才，今忽短命而死，孤何賴哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "2246ae26ef3ac83038f85fc405b569984054ffbef1537092c30f9b8ee2f04df2"}

{"id": "p_cd5c7a1bc0d9f233", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 28, "text": "既遺書特薦子敬，孤敢不從之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "5d36cfad54a66764ba815154a513e5fd15b556f9fb89b2442d701b46031c1d35"}

{"id": "p_6e553991170046a0", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」既日便命魯肅為都督，總統兵馬；一面教發周瑜靈柩回葬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "fb001143e03b540a6dcea39787f97ffaae5c48c3c864fd37c25975eab2322ffa"}

{"id": "p_1364888e209a964c", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 30, "text": "卻說孔明在荊州，夜觀天文，見將星墜地，乃笑曰：「周瑜死矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "8518b04ae45c082e08a32feeb6b933f068ea9254edc75e28e8a9b499c45b9783"}

{"id": "p_835a5cea081c1adb", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 31, "text": "玄德使人探之，果然死了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "792628d08cac471cb271a453fe084f7db06ede340b5d51ba8b05da2174b77ecd"}

{"id": "p_7d13b0fa8e683187", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 32, "text": "玄德問孔明曰：「周瑜既死，還當如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "bc1076dbaea173f1028265405faef26053b3d5dd9d6aeaa132d8c89f7e0e5c02"}

{"id": "p_5ea3b20dd806efb5", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」孔明曰：「代瑜領兵者，必魯肅也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "bf60a27dea67cb6d2196f0a42ce58d3998da8589841cbb458dced112f3cf81ed"}

{"id": "p_f9315e94ce64cfc1", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 34, "text": "亮觀天象，將星聚於東方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "9c4b59b9a7fb146fbec44e276af7007a1950964bcfee8c049d47e5e70a535098"}

{"id": "p_758b055e70e291d2", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 35, "text": "亮當以弔喪為由，往江東走一遭，就尋賢士佐助主公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "e677ade2a421e783cf53527eb2282b02c673a20b61f1fbca9c0ba7a586a9c34b"}

{"id": "p_acf9f2da0356d8ab", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 36, "text": "」玄德曰：「只恐吳中將士加害於先生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "60b6fcf7ee69dd1cce79ed0f7d716ea3980a71b40c311b20bc2cb6c2328e9192"}

{"id": "p_ebc3af414a38da67", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」孔明曰：「瑜在之日，亮猶不懼；今瑜已死，又何患乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "e503ce9c204e4c8380912ea52ae2b28c9258627cd5f980acc75053e103866bb5"}

{"id": "p_1b5fdad737e99859", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」乃與趙雲引五百軍，具祭禮，下船赴巴丘弔喪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "0161cfadaebb34ce1ed21499a4abf52913670bc19934e47d0f75802e69beaba4"}

{"id": "p_b29fa14d6c9b27b3", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 39, "text": "於路探聽得孫權已令魯肅為都督，周瑜靈柩已回柴桑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "55472c88db4a9e9cf98151307388ee67a1ffbe19f14e3d470f505c51df605822"}

{"id": "p_9f715518bbb9b388", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 40, "text": "孔明逕至柴桑，魯肅以禮迎接。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "b0fd0fc1340168e8ca6451498c0509b70a9b77c670b775b6545a846fc4b9d0bd"}

{"id": "p_7a0b9a6baaa0dfe0", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 41, "text": "周瑜部將皆欲殺孔明，因見趙雲帶劍相隨，不敢下手。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "730374442a65d5c83445f250f6b4b839371660a83380a142be32cd31645aee16"}

{"id": "p_eab7d3e40a085e5a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 42, "text": "孔明教設祭物於靈前，親自奠酒，跪於地下，讀祭文曰：", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "06544865645d4f7419fc9fffe3d61fa4149fe46e1fdea7802eaaeebad674c389"}

{"id": "p_c985ca652ca4c6ef", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 43, "text": "::「嗚呼公瑾，不幸夭亡，修短故天，人豈不傷？", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "b822cb5fee8828288319a0a7155d6e2da76258c520bea1a8862bbf19e413956e"}

{"id": "p_0d1a6b3c7baa9816", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 44, "text": "::我心實痛，酹酒一觴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "fcb3bb45523e6cac185dbe392ab73be14975ac1bc89549d0a11db2958a6a2875"}

{"id": "p_f5f662103c6131ea", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 45, "text": "::弔君幼學，以交伯符；仗義疏財，讓舍以居。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "55e077e9a46da619f6a384cfdf3df44d30a77230350ea688e5d8a45f0ca6c6ef"}

{"id": "p_56cc3fcaf6c42d01", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 46, "text": "::弔君弱冠，萬里鵬摶；定建霸業，割據江南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "25c028546dddd3e3101eeffc2b6750f90dddee912aa8cda0facfb416308b21b6"}

{"id": "p_0c554c3121212c21", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 47, "text": "::弔君壯力，遠鎮巴丘；景升懷慮，討逆無憂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "35e17912ed2f8a5bee3f46803f5baa6421a133180d89ce85cb22f49b2fc18387"}

{"id": "p_ca3e50deaa0c6e4a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 48, "text": "::弔君風度，佳配小喬；漢臣之婿，不愧當朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "74041fb5b223a9c98d879c9926a22f72ff656de6772fccd78e70491ae7fa6c9f"}

{"id": "p_600516e49ca43128", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 49, "text": "::弔君氣概，諫阻納質；始不垂翅，終能奮翼。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "26028948ea3165111dcb5a54dea456b73c1b78f7ea706160041e4c2ebbe8ce04"}

{"id": "p_c829d69607fa8b96", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 50, "text": "::弔君鄱陽，蔣幹來說；揮灑自如，雅量高志。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "4fdfb0c8234c2fecdb2de1b17928b110b7f675b5c5e9c8fd7ef7d179b4bae2e2"}

{"id": "p_68b34e4b006095c1", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 51, "text": "::弔君弘才，文武籌略；火攻破敵，挽強為弱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "1d4d739d66faac026a2fa962c72dc81c3e49c64c25625623bf2827298cc2a545"}

{"id": "p_a672f7543b5da956", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 52, "text": "::想君當年，雄姿英發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "e83777256562dae612993f414393d165823c6d8fd7ec75e785f07a0f6d70cfd0"}

{"id": "p_84839a25b088eff4", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 53, "text": "::忠義之心，英靈之氣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "0b70036dc2d1a0e7a181f3eddc4952c2289de18e13c814d4d966ffca929bff81"}

{"id": "p_a8c499c60bab9640", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 54, "text": "::哀君情切，愁腸千結。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "d353b3a3020c758343259c9f01d151be36f36a74ad63751a1f6ba05ed600e390"}

{"id": "p_63c3e4b0d60a2505", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 55, "text": "::昊天昏暗，三軍愴然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "5fb67719c4b3bb1cc9f5b1f804d0f11709efdd99b85bd25f7b85b57d605f69b5"}

{"id": "p_bba58671b28255ac", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 56, "text": "::亮也不才，丐計求謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "657a4906f29900c3bb2ac17edcb56fca7f518c79f06c478619418c54fb4cb3dd"}

{"id": "p_7917b049c012dd9a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 57, "text": "::犄角之援，首尾相儔。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "97b81bef0811f9ff23ec64d9fa800cb3303cc5466d2570ac9c10a5ccf49158cd"}

{"id": "p_61e19bf550c4a103", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 58, "text": "::魂如有靈，以鑒我心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "c28ffb36c8c4c18d55fc2ae5063256c896b3930c3c6794cd4ca1612bcbf5a996"}

{"id": "p_330b26d0c2dbadff", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 59, "text": "孔明祭畢，伏地大哭，淚如湧泉，哀慟不已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "ca17a3a9046acce36776106882d80ab504c54ef60f69d29c46d196574250ab78"}

{"id": "p_89c07df3e65c7469", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 60, "text": "眾將相謂曰：「人盡道公瑾與孔明不睦，今觀其祭奠之情，人皆虛言也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "b9f421ba16885f6fffad462499da866c65fc68a65fcb8d94ae4035591ca7b781"}

{"id": "p_55f88c8c49f6881c", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 61, "text": "」魯肅見孔明如此悲切，亦為感傷，自思曰：「孔明自是多情，乃公瑾量窄，自取死耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "f6886fe65f877de908867053776a7073224458fb1d264c8ee154d3e24e261ac0"}

{"id": "p_2d8df4a1aac571e2", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 62, "text": "::臥龍南陽睡未醒，又添列曜下舒城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "fd50654ef890be80c402d45ee7bd87aeaae7b7451649d1414dba3be391c6925d"}

{"id": "p_8d8592ff325599aa", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 63, "text": "::蒼天既已生公瑾，塵世何須出孔明？", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "9652009f2cc2bff477d3b697f71314eda923e1b6892da4bd46855c024d6b1c81"}

{"id": "p_b16e13e374f1973b", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 64, "text": "方欲下船，只見江邊一人道袍竹冠，皂縧素履，一手揪住孔明大笑曰：「汝氣死周郎，卻又來弔孝，明欺東吳無人耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "08ee5c4125a8e2bdf0c824709ee31dfd3ebd81b2c6b7399111196b5429fea356"}

{"id": "p_3c19959e2b13289c", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 65, "text": "」孔明急視其人，乃鳳雛先生龐統也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "2213001e2f13115b0e4b26e72902880d4d6d2cd7a81eeeb0f74aa4232ee4c471"}

{"id": "p_ad2be8380c342c3e", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 66, "text": "兩人攜手登舟，各訴心事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "4661f490137b6b2a94e627fb54c1ce631ee2d3199f9cf2a682410e02040d1ae5"}

{"id": "p_ca6bdd70bd9bb95a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 67, "text": "孔明乃留書一封與統，囑曰：「吾料孫仲謀必不能重用足下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "bd1efd788f6b0802b25bdf4f0c1d689359be9debd0319b74c00bea09c50873bb"}

{"id": "p_8fd3a5574bc9a2d7", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 68, "text": "稍有不如意，可來荊州共扶玄德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "0803c9477fe20675057ff4e58b16e5481d8be6df87840a16038dee091825931a"}

{"id": "p_6b1e8f0a86adda16", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 69, "text": "此人寬仁厚德，必不負公平生之所學。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "ff9d4adb5f0d0b79c82b60d315cce9d3d946db0695328991df571395eb3c0b78"}

{"id": "p_191f3c497582b78c", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 70, "text": "卻說魯肅送周瑜靈柩至蕪湖，孫權接著，哭祭於前，命厚葬於本鄉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "9e58e1d4928434afe49c0bea8d76692171885d256c341e4e162cff14061835af"}

{"id": "p_f8cf55bd83a18b9a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 71, "text": "瑜有兩男一女，長男循，次男胤。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "5d7556ff1a9833a2f1155718490cbceeffb23ac58f8f24f6be878107ad59733d"}

{"id": "p_65b5b879031ac749", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 72, "text": "魯肅曰：「肅碌碌庸才，誤蒙公瑾重薦，其實不稱所職。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "4cbbd2f8eb9de53404a114b9cde9c22fa7c177fffc6464c75c1b415bf12024a3"}

{"id": "p_de869d8af8f75c06", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 73, "text": "此人上通天文，下曉地理；謀略不減於管、樂，樞機可並於孫、吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "a2f94cc241ed0abba32f65707df03901d8fc770fe1a290571384a3b6dc725fc9"}

{"id": "p_e672003ee14419cb", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 74, "text": "往日周公瑾多用其言，孔明亦深服其智。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "70a56325428dcb8992d817dcd9ac2d846576e2c8b31ac5bc2212412b2c5e2358"}

{"id": "p_9a681024bdc3bd22", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 75, "text": "權聞言大喜，便問此人姓名。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "5d16753e301c5bff07e339b75a8fc5301f7df7456a1147aa2bcf11a1ae88244d"}

{"id": "p_16ca3414fb5da0fe", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 76, "text": "肅曰：「此人乃襄陽人，姓龐，名統，字士元，道號鳳雛先生。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "4017133c33d51533faa20947a61a4f6cdc7d8a10ae021f96fba0d5eecf76d893"}

{"id": "p_c4ea7d5a659361b1", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」權曰：「孤亦聞其名久矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "5cf08eecf456d7eee2d38511ac410ff6ab49d8c3c00a0fe2207c2cbebc666af0"}

{"id": "p_1154941178ea197e", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 78, "text": "今既來此，可即請來相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "ac4d69d9dfb0cec2d8e2f44e3b6c9d472844d2cf6813309361710572d27e1bfa"}

{"id": "p_59970cd983b4c250", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 79, "text": "」於是魯肅邀請龐統入見孫權，施禮畢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "8b1148f9a49f4a0aab3afe3d9ec59770db2c2dab3b10fed846587a4095d9e615"}

{"id": "p_5aa3db32c596aad0", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 80, "text": "權見其人濃眉掀鼻，黑面短髯，形容古怪，心中不喜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "4732fda65494843fc1b1d3680494289ec43ae6e0aefe4d8a1b1026e39fd83024"}

{"id": "p_cc14e298ff72fa92", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 81, "text": "乃問曰：「公平生所學，以何為主？", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "5017d29ea7c10d37386845aea73ff2ae7ce64e1cecce6a1897ec8b7c6d276577"}

{"id": "p_08e046a822343ffb", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 82, "text": "」統曰：「不必拘執，隨機應變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "8eaf5549f17a4fd2f36c186d9e39bbcf183ab3d2b4c85e0c67f223811838ff71"}

{"id": "p_a679bcf1a8ac9876", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 83, "text": "」權曰：「公之才學，比公瑾何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "19852b28af1f7defc494f1b049864fdb37afa9a58f6f852a68a77c6cbe7732df"}

{"id": "p_1f2f0384603dcf9a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」統笑曰：「某之才學，與公瑾大不相同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "13bdfacba5be3ac01f4b3c401b1c6e0b35fc85f7d476e74779cf345f65e9262c"}

{"id": "p_5c7874c0090da7c4", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 85, "text": "」權平生最喜周瑜，見統輕之，心中愈不樂，乃謂統曰：「公且退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "805e2adb4bdc2aeac7d6e6ac6999fdde7f106cdacfb1e1289a74624c6eec20df"}

{"id": "p_bceab6e763de7aeb", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 86, "text": "待有用公之時，卻來相請。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "e3452dd5253daf28c650651d2ac32d39ef911b06582eabbe6da646410f65376b"}

{"id": "p_da7165b86b72633c", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 87, "text": "魯肅曰：「主公何不用龐士元？", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "908b6220de14ee430a9ccec7361fae74b2add13728f229f16be34239456e1f9b"}

{"id": "p_28a0f044610a0dbd", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 88, "text": "」權曰：「狂士也，用之何益？", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "928ed97dd570465bb6e9cd3c54e28067a1608777b2797f98d45dfb910b7051f2"}

{"id": "p_b5bb6e09913c479a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 89, "text": "」肅曰：「赤壁鏖兵之時，此人曾獻連環策，成第一功。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "8737f3531c983ecffc4139ca726f9e349c29199d80057f7b0b05ebed96951f4e"}

{"id": "p_0452763269c1e095", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 90, "text": "」權曰：「此時乃曹操自欲釘船，未必此人之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "13741f87c94a727d2e8d1e0d7d0d8d2a3148694f423b30fa0c4f5ca272cbc8fc"}

{"id": "p_73a937cf8ae48b39", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 91, "text": "」魯肅出謂龐統曰：「非肅不薦足下，奈吳侯不肯用公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "e71d5a7ae5f034d043139d9f5675f120cdd5d1c9201a333f090c64a00f5328c5"}

{"id": "p_b63bb83d57d4d4de", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 92, "text": "肅曰：「公莫非無意於吳中乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "9ab4fbe987529e458dcf8e7761c8085a88aaf3fbe5b2bcb99dcc589788679864"}

{"id": "p_cc162fafc1dbdd6d", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 93, "text": "肅曰：「公抱匡濟之才，何往不利？", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "6349c1cd3e926647db1b94a07b444df88298ecffafbd3aa7d86703d6ab08aace"}

{"id": "p_354aefa16d2d1e7e", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 94, "text": "」統曰：「吾欲投曹操去也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "991bb7d676c6e92a5da122859b7e056c89ffa6c9c76c311a45d285e7678b5b40"}

{"id": "p_ef67d007add83fae", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 95, "text": "」肅曰：「此明珠暗投矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "145edbbd3392d114171b7942073d5e090f4ea74d6cf56cc53fb299a62dbf20d2"}

{"id": "p_d202e1ff5f9cc192", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 96, "text": "可往荊州投劉皇叔，必然重用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "d99316b71378655503a03b374c71ee6c420c3cca21ae3c853ace5c5c803ee487"}

{"id": "p_47178ed9c61cffb6", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」統曰：「統意實欲如此，前言戲耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "ae61f6373a0c36d4e6de24c5eda0a8556459c87cda1b04babd71887443ec54c1"}

{"id": "p_17f13bf6494bb41a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 98, "text": "」肅曰：「某當作書奉薦。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "6843e94396559a55e5fc6e8c821ca61c34262c44a85446c622e9e915311a3a4e"}

{"id": "p_0a8d9ebea0fe9917", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 99, "text": "公輔玄德，必令孫、劉兩家，無相攻擊，同力破曹。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "217652290e6d0f95bc9a78c48ec6c9c5bfd389b5e653857d9d39cb80ab3140a2"}

{"id": "p_372fbf385563e6c4", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 100, "text": "」統曰：「此某平生之素志也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "78f074c1d5b2f3ad00de9c5f9add8957755a306e30aae9c15fdff60d215496ed"}

{"id": "p_09ed12f80f41e1c7", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 101, "text": "」乃求肅書，逕往荊州來見玄德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "69ff5c07427e06210d64cf9be810c4aa2ebf3b844700ad953cb079df05f77218"}

{"id": "p_270e280eab23ed38", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 102, "text": "門吏傳報江東名士龐統，特來相投。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "ade0e57d7004fb0809cafe7086ed9ea5a21d79c2ebde548657ae7e38c33804d9"}

{"id": "p_48f5499d8ed80276", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 103, "text": "玄德久聞統名，便教請入相見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "d75e88889e621f05a73dcaa7e1ffbdffcc6ae55b6d8391de84ea7ceac5059632"}

{"id": "p_18f408f646cefd9b", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 104, "text": "統見玄德，長揖不拜，玄德見統貌陋，心中亦不悅，乃問統曰：「足下遠來不易？", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "efd385e5e09cdd1e81658642c733c4aebf4535bc02dc68c516a52f9c04ee5393"}

{"id": "p_776278287623cde4", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 105, "text": "」統不即取出魯肅書並孔明投呈，但答曰：「聞皇叔招賢納士，特來相投。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "dea164dc0e643d1408f4ddcb2b7d0c889fc243f02bbdac3540ae77c60609a88c"}

{"id": "p_fba04dd55de92160", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 107, "text": "此去東南數百里，有一縣名耒陽縣，缺一縣宰，屈公任之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "c63db01f20a1c4f95dd4ca52da59f8fe590b095d0e5f9a0d3145656015952501"}

{"id": "p_9b45c2b1dc83c77d", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 108, "text": "統思玄德待我何薄，欲以才學動之；見孔明不在，只得勉強相辭而去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "d4a177d7ff5c37b3f5f4c9ca00fb1e7f4a2e1b1f975971908916ea2684da4cf5"}

{"id": "p_343dd22402c2ff72", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 109, "text": "統到耒陽縣，不理政事，終日飲酒為樂；一應錢糧詞訟，並不理會。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "b4e9506536b7568f4cfe4ec992726b0e0c04adb05f79701377fa86b5121c2bfa"}

{"id": "p_330ef3b5a2c7a582", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 110, "text": "有人報知玄德，言龐統將耒陽縣事盡廢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "b34a1c488b33ec6bd08e9cd1bbaf5b8c5c6621994ee2f27a300cdd957bbf650a"}

{"id": "p_5e6b01ff584a6832", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 111, "text": "玄德怒曰：「豎儒焉敢亂吾法度！", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "1fea943d1977f3a976405b17ba118690ea11b334ce36ad508105a15e79b9b172"}

{"id": "p_8cb6e6c08f8af14b", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 112, "text": "」遂喚張飛分付：「引從人去荊南諸縣巡視。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "d9e1c0fedfcc28ec059b6e5cfcf86da802b97632631da8c1e1e897168450dd1b"}

{"id": "p_06d65869727b7184", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 113, "text": "如有不公不法者，就便究問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "7382c2a9f824b88ea214cc9c33e7a8cc3d0e7172d73cc5a0752d8af7bea9c49a"}

{"id": "p_55b46b0f2fdbdb32", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 114, "text": "恐於事有不明處，可與孫乾同去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "c8553fd5d4ecbd3c7c066e0b362cc63319c886ce41a929c1ef2e8ed2d8304b18"}

{"id": "p_718fa1f2e9721326", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 115, "text": "張飛領了言語，與孫乾同至耒陽縣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "66e218b4a8fc7ef6473ffcea40ca45936c0e5d00e874b8c071518bb41e278e07"}

{"id": "p_1c154e5a82230e3f", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 116, "text": "軍民官吏，皆出郭迎接，獨不見縣令。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "9425aeaf88ae062306a7abaed833f94f483237096a1f523eca5f9abaedaee4c1"}

{"id": "p_719d6f6acf674ae1", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 117, "text": "」同僚覆曰：「龐縣令自到任及今，將百餘日，縣中之事，並不理問，每日飲酒，自旦及夜，只在醉鄉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "25e0999ec1026d95a161118e688ea1423236d7e799b4a0df42f495aa2a5e7730"}

{"id": "p_087ad29a794cd1a4", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 118, "text": "今日宿酒未醒，猶臥不起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "1b7c6440af9a157470e8fb430b7b316b678f79694b1252d99ed4e4eede94d9db"}

{"id": "p_467e638dfdf6dcf2", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 119, "text": "孫乾曰：「龐士元乃高明之人，未可輕忽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "c18d0d7c8bafbbaffb30b540052a99fb092c6ad6c230c5dd7f9143fa621b0006"}

{"id": "p_16382cebec35de82", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 120, "text": "如果於理不當，治罪未晚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "f5875ecf32c0d958925df8960360d99bebb8afcdbd59c148e69de00e0139e436"}

{"id": "p_5ae1e361d08db81c", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 121, "text": "」飛乃入縣，正廳上坐定，教縣令來見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "e682e6cd2cfc919dd39d8c0592b2de33310fad5b93d00b4a316ba7879cad077c"}

{"id": "p_876b6baa925a0c64", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 122, "text": "飛怒曰：「吾兄以汝為人，令作縣宰，汝焉敢盡廢縣事？", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "ad4c923d2883d5b80a1bf79a7dd439a87f9bd2e99f13023adc3d435563dfcf96"}

{"id": "p_370252e6d7a2cfaf", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」統笑曰：「將軍以吾廢了縣中何事？", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "a8b5d24ceb0d6dcacf290b47dcf872d1aeec313517c496f133c445aee1874f2d"}

{"id": "p_a163f0711f4b7b9e", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 124, "text": "」飛曰：「汝到任百餘日，終日在醉鄉，安得不廢政事？", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "b0bc6a78429b640fc7ca52794f233129097f47363740eea0c200bb38420b1fb5"}

{"id": "p_4ea1c00bf0d77460", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 125, "text": "」統曰：「量百里小縣，些許公事，何難決斷？", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "d959f7539505e2f723d742fae4ad5a5511ea350204e0ba2c82adff5f20dac610"}

{"id": "p_1960dc3310cbcfc0", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 126, "text": "」隨即喚公吏，將百餘日所積公務，都取來剖斷，吏皆紛然齎抱案卷，上廳訴詞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "ab8a0e3cd1601dc8c057cfb6daaedde22de9e9d2bd9bdd994497b1b5498a9b16"}

{"id": "p_0acae104f1c65132", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 127, "text": "統手中批判，口中發落，耳內聽詞，曲直分明，並無分毫差錯，民皆叩首拜伏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "ad42a84920daa168b795d5ea95b984b315b17796270c6c9b487f7b740544809a"}

{"id": "p_b0cea9442135995b", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 128, "text": "不到半日，將百餘日之事，盡斷畢了，投筆於地，而對張飛曰：「所廢之事何在？", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "0d86093245f000ad52e4bb65c69e22976e7959a81c8e7d73440682ba1e804e75"}

{"id": "p_8bf6cdde62675d74", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 129, "text": "曹操、孫權，吾視之若掌上觀文，量此小縣，何足介意！", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "2f19a5b32744e6186446079bd6c106ef6544c7d7ab1c3ba07ac16aa91a12df3c"}

{"id": "p_21fde85d82adb655", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 130, "text": "飛大驚，下席謝曰：「先生大才，小子失敬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "eb43cbe0e374eb31afcc1f3da1acf6a1d89e0ab6cf03d361108480e2c258ede3"}

{"id": "p_1cd3fb315d88041f", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 131, "text": "飛曰：「先生初見吾兄，何不將出？", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "d434ada61be3b87bd1ff6877c9308307dc78d3d97bcbe17be2d1ab8b45a5445c"}

{"id": "p_4f6e26070e5ce6dd", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」統曰：「若便將出，似乎專藉薦書來干謁矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "9b007e6b8428e10f5329fea8c06dfe44bfc9f2d790b26f92f80bb6c1e8765810"}

{"id": "p_23abd9d40e451a43", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 133, "text": "」飛顧謂孫乾曰：「非公則失一大賢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "4db4a2ac7823914adba9123a4aeb8b62434f9571adafef3b1bf72ef54a5e6e38"}

{"id": "p_62a04ce64af8c6aa", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 134, "text": "」遂辭統回荊州見玄德，具說龐統之才。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "cc680c011af25b57633c169dec5b462c71a17006f096000096c57ce2313f4dd2"}

{"id": "p_0846ba6a86204660", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 135, "text": "玄德大驚曰：「屈待大賢，吾之過也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "6a8872434d8808574925eb04cb104c2088d3dfc8fb51b552f1dfc35132659bab"}

{"id": "p_542af012b57cfeca", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 136, "text": "書略曰：「龐士元非百里之才，使處治中別駕之任，始當展其驥足。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "7f9c6079aafb52dda5fa4217a051fb1503fc26fed180f5eba728deea787bb571"}

{"id": "p_a7be11f8b9c1773b", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 137, "text": "如以貌取之，恐負所學，終為他人所用，實可惜也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "aa814f6fb0ae9f3bed299d7c779dd30e63cd174df69bd433194f94c5e524eb67"}

{"id": "p_be5938c1cb44442d", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 138, "text": "玄德看畢，正在嗟歎，忽報孔明回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "8755875f3a0677d9529b08f7f8f34ed3d3dcfd3451e876c3a4f177683826d791"}

{"id": "p_7327f5848aa5462e", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 139, "text": "孔明先問曰：「龐軍師近日無恙否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "c8b1d0c3a51f1f2831f73fcdaebb5466ab5dbe464615a286a57646fd2bfe6cea"}

{"id": "p_1bebd155735986e1", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」玄德曰：「近治耒陽縣，好酒廢事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "86930b18e982a672b04ffa2ec2135e86869ebfef6167bb71df2c3e4b32a19dc6"}

{"id": "p_0f5c20e4869a2275", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 141, "text": "」孔明笑曰：「士元非百里之才，胸中之學，勝亮十倍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "cb07521c38f17f90d0f9cbc8d97e0fd00aab0b8e69229bcf3e9807eed629130f"}

{"id": "p_48c9f486659d4949", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 142, "text": "亮曾有薦書在士元處，曾達主公否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "0d02b0b827dd109ee427709596b136771e2f1cccaed9f43e11aff87005cc83a8"}

{"id": "p_d98d42f9cab451df", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 143, "text": "」玄德曰：「今日方得子敬書，卻未見先生之書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "96d8beef418cd87045fef076d464fa78f1c349e607d80c649019dadf594f4694"}

{"id": "p_d2954f61c7d710ba", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」孔明曰：「大賢若處小任，往往以酒糊塗，倦於視事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "4b3f8490fb80ef1c1b4b09f720e24f119618e92a3ac07bc5627eda2996146bf2"}

{"id": "p_565e020f2389fc26", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 145, "text": "」玄德曰：「若非吾弟所言，險失大賢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "603e61a4a339c285cee393db9087f26ddfde44d61d4cc8daddc2aef83a13c1ef"}

{"id": "p_6d454aeb667468e9", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」隨即令張飛往耒陽縣請龐統到荊州，玄德下階請罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "c2379cbb2c39d708d79a0415a48481d598fefcec8e2804246902db60b67eac1d"}

{"id": "p_d089fd0c60875945", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 147, "text": "玄德看書中之意，言鳳雛到日，宜即重用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "2fb49395072cd8b2a051e93c3a62ad575502286d748eb0782a1a2c57647ec94d"}

{"id": "p_13e065e14baf344d", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 148, "text": "玄德喜曰：「昔司馬德操言：『伏龍、鳳雛，兩人得一，可安天下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "5fc59b47557baa82e9fc9aaffbbc72cf2acc63de3de33eb3c3a8070284c3bab7"}

{"id": "p_137ea90d5bfbcf39", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 149, "text": "』今吾二人皆得，漢室可興矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "3ba2b589ea08697c3cafb070e96c3b3d1cc2fc5391f515f85ae63bf1b44cb627"}

{"id": "p_617edc7b6c3240a2", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」遂拜龐統為副軍師中郎將，與孔明共贊方略，教練軍士，聽候征伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "49f1f0c47d4c1269871b7a902949253115f7476147d0708e3a1943c0ffd1ac1e"}

{"id": "p_8670fb2b82ea7a43", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 151, "text": "早有人報到許昌，言劉備有諸葛亮、龐統為謀士，招軍買馬，積草屯糧，連結東吳，早晚必興兵北伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "577ebe7ddd48f6e80d475f46a7224b87da7718b3c1d2d3e79a97f9013195fa72"}

{"id": "p_3155d87c12e03b42", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 152, "text": "曹操聞之，遂聚謀士商議南征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "7b203cf5e3ccf056eaa76597c1b5de0eec266a356c1d5e0ad5885ff27cecf98f"}

{"id": "p_03a7fad79d20b3b8", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 153, "text": "荀攸進曰：「周瑜新死，可先取孫權，次攻劉備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "807111f07561d90dea50da33f5bb6da92cb91fe212ca36248ba62e456e9204c8"}

{"id": "p_556e723e14c989e3", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」操曰：「我若遠征，恐馬騰來襲許都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "ad9c1cfae0d23551d37616668ba15124b81858f2be8390756babc5e42151f7f2"}

{"id": "p_85b8a26e3ea25fa7", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 155, "text": "前在赤壁之時，軍中有訛言，亦傳西涼入寇之事，今不可不防也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "ed9dd5d688cdd296c4e439f0f64ce1baea2784a5c2f0a8650c152af0257d5e91"}

{"id": "p_f181ae78aea5d0d4", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 156, "text": "」荀攸曰：「以愚所見，不若降詔，加馬騰為征南將軍，使討孫權；誘入京師，先除此人，則南征無患矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "def761b5e7e014cdd459aa9807ab1c5a3c76f55668a81adc8d0c7b33195b0f7c"}

{"id": "p_bbc4abd22857bc5f", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 157, "text": "」操大喜，即日遣人齎詔至西涼召馬騰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "216f845380057a62126d13e1d2899ccb07e8595e9e0063adede46eb1f167f214"}

{"id": "p_80a7b3a1785b2dda", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 158, "text": "卻說騰字壽成，漢伏波將軍馬援之後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "aecb4efd4e2d678b80457a30d71451c232ee73c33fdc7406ffa8de37f46631db"}

{"id": "p_979106b15046e192", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 159, "text": "父名肅，字子碩，桓帝時為天水闌干縣尉；後失官流落隴西，與羌人雜處，遂娶羌女生騰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "d9f2804ce0c1a3a504b1c9921b7c8a8336242e7f98040d9a106c377c89e9a604"}

{"id": "p_9316a23eb21e4f26", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 160, "text": "騰身長八尺，體貌雄異，稟性溫良，人多敬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "54c328b2bc75cdea91bb18ca5b7147fe7d5da963d8cafcecd7281ff63011485e"}

{"id": "p_3dfbf965ab1639f5", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 161, "text": "靈帝未年，羌人多叛，騰招募民兵破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "f16b7e67068f4bb0e31b7ff8e48cf125c4349462d497e8a669c91539f069b86e"}

{"id": "p_989503750ad184b2", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 162, "text": "初平中年，因討賊有功，拜征西將軍，與鎮西將軍韓遂為兄弟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "df0d5de6f56268d9e88970896f38f08f3180be62867420e827e0f2fa0a4b5cf8"}

{"id": "p_0b9bb372cbb13cd6", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 163, "text": "當日奉詔，乃與長子馬超商議曰：「吾自與董承受衣帶詔以來，與劉玄德約共討賊，不幸董承已死，玄德屢敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "56a3eacb501db65d4aad3fc0ff92ffba2643c01c8d42671b99be0b1ea6f97e05"}

{"id": "p_db5cb10935a1920d", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 164, "text": "我又僻處西涼，未能協助玄德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "ebaf6db7b63a38088f46313e2c10618098565386bef8afb54e3195381f57a6a6"}

{"id": "p_37125c0b6193125c", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 165, "text": "今聞玄德已得荊州，我正欲展昔日之志，而曹操反來召我，當是如何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "680b9b80d992349966b304fc4b9365715a0e1ee46590992b2685d85c291d7fc5"}

{"id": "p_e02d29119ba59413", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 166, "text": "」馬超曰：「操奉天子之命以召父親，今若不往，彼必以逆命責我矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "cb77f6b712e844cc645271618ebd0026cd0dab7ac5612d64d0ff0117e8570f03"}

{"id": "p_510d1003fc51a746", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 167, "text": "當乘其來召，竟往京師，於中取事，則昔日之志可展也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "5e49089bd728a6b549a11dd7bf710333576afbc83e2a2cc1b205e89301ce72b1"}

{"id": "p_abf754499839eebd", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 168, "text": "馬騰兄子馬岱諫曰：「曹操心懷叵測，叔父若往，死遭其害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "e840a298d37afedf060ead19380774d07fbb159ccd8ad274e25fb97a4df024d9"}

{"id": "p_e80b8361195fa16f", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 169, "text": "」超曰：「兒願盡起西涼之兵，隨父親殺入許昌，為天下除害，有何不可？", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "e59b6de90ef2509c5adfe4e0c411ecf8791424e706b38abd7e189a5f56e95093"}

{"id": "p_cb1f686dc28209aa", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 170, "text": "」騰曰：「汝自統羌兵保守西涼，只教次子馬休、馬鐵並姪馬岱隨我同往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "0d2254ec6fe867ac02d55f1d9b224bbe6910ba3c0b73a98909d3b2a9c2b1f08b"}

{"id": "p_fe3eedf698379b96", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 171, "text": "曹操見有汝在西涼，又有韓遂相助，諒不敢加害於我也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "0c1e30e894b8daec203686c3928b8ac9c3ee214510ca0419f5d7560b6e8b91ac"}

{"id": "p_8e3a57d23878fe05", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 172, "text": "」超曰：「父親若往，切不可輕入京師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "c48f56f224544ceb82f72d8d65eb8671e8011cb6c7817ac9c2ff31de2c67f8ed"}

{"id": "p_4edf832305ff4674", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 173, "text": "」騰曰：「吾自有區處，不必多慮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "a03d05bed6c4c8130ffaeaa715848a601f55dca7a13a48ace5177ae5e0d68c36"}

{"id": "p_a7785eb358e71596", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 174, "text": "於是馬騰乃引西涼兵五千，先教馬休、馬鐵為前部，留馬岱在後接應，迤灑望許昌而來，離許昌二十里屯住軍馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "5ef673faf4c3d1233f2d2102c90cf996231283d2a2f8a6090fbff297e26ae3ed"}

{"id": "p_424ce7206ab8811a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 175, "text": "曹操聽知馬騰已到，喚門下侍郎黃奎分付曰：「目今馬騰南征，吾命汝為行軍參謀，先至馬騰寨中勞軍，可對馬騰說：西涼路遠，運糧甚難，不能多帶人馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "ca304d28925e367125ad826133ada01c57b426ff44d49e59770ba692ed2ae7c2"}

{"id": "p_95a07b566a117a28", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 176, "text": "我當更遣大兵，協同前進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "0de767016338be56f965bb8fe971432126d8b30d74f514b7e22ddabeb283379e"}

{"id": "p_e36b02751ca47ff1", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 177, "text": "來日教他入城面君，吾就應付糧草與之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "d6fadfef4921e976a25d8a3898f41880e2194e79fc353414c8405be07dea3e30"}

{"id": "p_1deca494b63f6ab4", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 178, "text": "奎酒半酣而言曰：「吾父黃琬死於李傕、郭汜之難，嘗懷痛恨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "fa665844e9416fc3070bf3dcda30e726e02f459aad8b4b9558294455e3b0e867"}

{"id": "p_fd0243e3ef19b6dd", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 179, "text": "」騰曰：「誰為欺君之賊？", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "8b8b6fab7c621b3d3bd40bf00afa9e81b4523a427f61673ac0eb8aabbedf5d3c"}

{"id": "p_b02fffb7b351265f", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 180, "text": "」奎曰：「欺君者操賊也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "dac6b69412c432012a4d06f496ce58ef9b4d09d01a874ac29401befbb4e703c1"}

{"id": "p_79f07ffdae7ef698", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 181, "text": "」騰恐是操使來相探，急止之曰：「耳目較近，休得亂言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "c9cba3eba29f3dbcedd204714279663d02b482d64f33e393a0e1f701ec1c6992"}

{"id": "p_885f8df2a7820828", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」奎叱曰：「公竟忘卻衣帶詔乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "92332f0624213118cd4cb8929aaa4dcaa23d0386e51aeb0749818b96c9d55cca"}

{"id": "p_ba886c49d43b8e4a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 183, "text": "」騰見他說出心事，乃密以實情告之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "55dc5bc4c1c1669fd7f3ba185ce16a75e7ea3a15b130c15dff62264bc2400e94"}

{"id": "p_5a5945d6f7de1aeb", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 184, "text": "奎曰：「操欲公入城面君，必非好意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "b2d186257fe21ffb2a76346b8bcca4efffe5047f252491f2f2c873df0844b738"}

{"id": "p_282fd7fdf46f7548", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 185, "text": "待曹操出城點軍，就點軍處斬之，大事濟矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "eaef090837d6b8cdd7a2fe55094345c8cf7eafb21e6b9883b06ff7045a55fa57"}

{"id": "p_7707667c8d728351", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 186, "text": "二人商議已定，黃奎回家，恨氣未息。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "d18d06cc428a365d70d487c9eacb0d4932a933d331cb26524989604724b72c68"}

{"id": "p_e54317d5bc82bfa7", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 187, "text": "其妻再三問之，奎不肯言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 187}, "text_hash": "c7735e499d1d7c8ef15fbbfe2017b6da5102f9ea865c5b50d4e655597fe00dd2"}

{"id": "p_2a2bb246cdf192ff", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 188, "text": "不料其妾李春香，與奎妻弟苗澤私通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 188}, "text_hash": "18d5d8f566b1e05ec5b0a10ef5797503232f88b22190d2edbb854df83525d339"}

{"id": "p_5e49c2d1869b6fe7", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 189, "text": "澤欲得春香，正無計可施。", "locator": {"ordinal": 189}, "text_hash": "bb12d33e90b6e191fea17c78030d42c52ea4254387274c44583f2b71d9303c14"}

{"id": "p_2604631ade349e24", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 190, "text": "妾見黃奎憤恨，遂對澤曰：「黃侍郎今日商議軍情回，意甚憤恨，不知為何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 190}, "text_hash": "800123e9474059fa7b723bec0f1d0f24fbf6de8087cf18686a692f4310b487f6"}

{"id": "p_ea1e4a5436c3be6f", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 191, "text": "」澤曰：「汝可以言挑之曰：『人皆說劉皇叔仁德，曹操奸雄，何也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 191}, "text_hash": "527fecaab0ede39af52815723b90983b6e2eaccd27c079ed55f827fe9961016f"}

{"id": "p_40c3ee33a1d44d8b", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 192, "text": "」是夜黃奎果到春香房中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 192}, "text_hash": "3df5bce532ddf3369879c9fc524b5ce7220d6d604a360cbe562a62128f1fe8c9"}

{"id": "p_be45d01926334684", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 193, "text": "奎乘醉言曰：「汝乃婦人，尚知邪正，何況我乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 193}, "text_hash": "5378f5bb87e9b4b9b8ab5298bf3215990f6df9b03c727b88a10af3d1f8d2384c"}

{"id": "p_27e143ee1ff641bd", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 194, "text": "」妾曰：「若欲殺之，如何下手？", "locator": {"ordinal": 194}, "text_hash": "348c9345faa913e453480fa65ae1a85f10eb3ae11cf64fb24e121e3a15c7394c"}

{"id": "p_f515033a25faee39", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 195, "text": "」奎曰：「吾已約定馬將軍，明日在城外點兵時殺之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 195}, "text_hash": "c33bb88ce5160fc9956af4b410b7b865d2d61fcc7679824177c074efc64476a5"}

{"id": "p_4fc52fc05121ccfa", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 196, "text": "」妾告於苗澤，澤報知曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 196}, "text_hash": "b05bdc3e326b517d50bd4e734251d1dfb52de2cc8e3cb53fb8caec92cdbbc3c9"}

{"id": "p_e58e614dc1dae988", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 197, "text": "操便密喚曹洪，許褚分付如此如此；又喚夏侯淵、徐晃分付如此如此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 197}, "text_hash": "1da73a9a342cbf17c1026b9e06cb96fea745681a6036b891c592d2760f0ee008"}

{"id": "p_14154fca64074585", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 198, "text": "各人領命去了，一面先將黃奎一家老小拏下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 198}, "text_hash": "119030e1e9e2c4932a20e3ac6273f0e877210d519fba23d3344415709a523534"}

{"id": "p_7a9e2d10fe26de93", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 199, "text": "次日，馬騰領著西涼兵馬，將次近城，只見前面一簇紅旗，打著丞相旗號。", "locator": {"ordinal": 199}, "text_hash": "459820a4d2fba38709e19b0073e450534ecc3ea5e4e34855efe51f86a8f6e04c"}

{"id": "p_1fb266a7b9d59a12", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 200, "text": "馬騰只道曹操自來點軍，拍馬向前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 200}, "text_hash": "d04a055afbd2fbfd68fd6ba3c54d024acb100b15382fe83d45545cb377ecb369"}

{"id": "p_c0b20f661d30c0f1", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 201, "text": "忽聽得一聲砲響，紅旗開處，弓弩齊發。", "locator": {"ordinal": 201}, "text_hash": "9329b82ac09c6d585c4e3903b5d3e24926be0912314fc94ba9a343249f944f4a"}

{"id": "p_e9aa7717d3f9bff9", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 202, "text": "馬騰急撥馬回時，兩下喊聲又起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 202}, "text_hash": "3a32caea2674444e236a4ec9f4f3c4fe295456f075180fb096843aec3192ef84"}

{"id": "p_16a2d15decba6f55", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 203, "text": "左邊許褚殺來，右邊夏侯淵殺來，後面又是徐晃領兵殺至，截斷西涼軍馬，將馬騰父子三人困在垓心。", "locator": {"ordinal": 203}, "text_hash": "e16dfdc79e7de81e1f81173b4987d90db9de98881cfdae147abe784599fec978"}

{"id": "p_b81503c092f64eb4", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 204, "text": "馬騰見不是頭，奮力衝殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 204}, "text_hash": "9afb83376b3dc891f680659f618228ccb05e41f133c9a6014b51bdec590bd4de"}

{"id": "p_cd80afca42718f8c", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 205, "text": "馬休隨著馬騰左衝右突，不能得出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 205}, "text_hash": "71f4a7f0cd2c70969605827d5baa17eae25c8e5ddcf422ed939b088e1b855e89"}

{"id": "p_4ab0d93f678a8a51", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 206, "text": "二人身帶重傷，坐下馬又被箭射倒，父子二人俱被執。", "locator": {"ordinal": 206}, "text_hash": "f6759256dc30ed7b3c3f428bb39980959c2952d134372fbf82dca423d585649b"}

{"id": "p_2d3d4a6ac7b1399a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 207, "text": "曹操教將黃奎與馬騰父子，一齊綁至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 207}, "text_hash": "6ccff172267f681f4035fc889c2b41e11014f19a14993f7d237a51fbaad9ac08"}

{"id": "p_d4a232e774370380", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 208, "text": "馬騰大罵曰：「豎儒誤我大事！", "locator": {"ordinal": 208}, "text_hash": "e57e8580d9367ef87ac6e03f2a5c802a31f1624f69bd62fffacc348f10053839"}

{"id": "p_7d114a46a1066d32", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 209, "text": "我不能為國殺賊，是乃天也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 209}, "text_hash": "48e0bff08f98fc716009425bce24596e7d0502774eb27c946949953c2fbabca4"}

{"id": "p_3eac8689a8f9764e", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 210, "text": "馬騰罵不絕口，與其子馬休，及黃奎一同遇害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 210}, "text_hash": "44c657d80ef111d3e8b4e37e75693321ab18095fde366cf5503a272b44df3a9c"}

{"id": "p_cc625a01a1850ad6", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 211, "text": "::父子齊芳烈，忠貞著一門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 211}, "text_hash": "3a8f61098a38c88807ba4894cde48a0cf534ea79f04e06f2de711303863bfa40"}

{"id": "p_4db255c10f2d4762", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 212, "text": "::捐生圖國難，誓死答君恩。", "locator": {"ordinal": 212}, "text_hash": "847ae50ac05a1a00fbd0ded3db4292e46381bd5afb9ab5c84dc90caa97707c52"}

{"id": "p_7048dcc8e49df97b", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 213, "text": "::嚼血盟言在，誅奸義狀存。", "locator": {"ordinal": 213}, "text_hash": "17173d350ca5532a175a1793acc6024d5dd279f9c80a58b73318c8e8f691a374"}

{"id": "p_091e209cd32c8878", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 214, "text": "::西涼推世冑，不愧伏波孫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 214}, "text_hash": "059811f7bee38bb37dbae3c0746a3c84f0dcfa751be793d0b2f81c0151d78f35"}

{"id": "p_fbd808a6b375346a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 215, "text": "苗澤告操曰：「不願加賞，只求李春香為妻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 215}, "text_hash": "f9e0ed7d813cac76df2e65a945a4913ad6a8e9505ee242c344d4ef4fd5bdbf30"}

{"id": "p_b4ae7d84de5a771a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 216, "text": "」操笑曰：「你為了一婦人，害了你姐夫一家，留此不義之人何用！", "locator": {"ordinal": 216}, "text_hash": "e9d697e9c57124fc96f10f93ed0a94eca6c8818995b3d9a1d304b3681746cf83"}

{"id": "p_7350f8b81d085d37", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 217, "text": "」便教將苗澤、李春香與黃奎一家老小並斬於市。", "locator": {"ordinal": 217}, "text_hash": "32168b0c9fb10cbf0e0c9ea53e2243f1db46a0c5c66817b03b8a6af31725ae16"}

{"id": "p_dbdff384857ed2b0", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 218, "text": "::苗澤因私害藎臣，春香未得反傷身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 218}, "text_hash": "9316b87e86b3354a51235cce27afa26a49f4652e6aa377fc4289395e485ca1f7"}

{"id": "p_f6c35394cbe1b75d", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 219, "text": "::奸雄亦不相容恕，枉自圖謀作小人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 219}, "text_hash": "40b8c94b72ba6b3808dd7f3ab8a72645d5f6e956a83e6bfc9197f6d6703571c7"}

{"id": "p_0cb4759dee473c0a", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 220, "text": "曹操教招安西涼兵馬諭之曰：「馬騰父子謀反，不干眾人之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 220}, "text_hash": "4ec64fb8138419c6c9e779321faf1677f0d6731baa6a54447b3d7c958795d0a5"}

{"id": "p_65b63a204e85320e", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 221, "text": "」一面使人分付把住關隘，休教走了馬岱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 221}, "text_hash": "4d34093915a4695ea6f19c61106efd16d9d49c88fb24f7c1b7c2facd085bde0c"}

{"id": "p_ba42ab4254b3903e", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 222, "text": "且說馬岱自引一千兵在後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 222}, "text_hash": "7bb06cdad03899e978f4e607386b6ef6a4727c000764a4961df87045759c2e27"}

{"id": "p_6c3bdb11a6311c83", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 223, "text": "早有許昌城外逃回軍士、報知馬岱。", "locator": {"ordinal": 223}, "text_hash": "8bef71a871f1c9525cdd0ff54e783a71df34b4a1b32b54285921d318d5e4afaf"}

{"id": "p_2e80186d546810e6", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 224, "text": "岱大驚，只得棄了兵馬，扮作客商，連夜逃遁去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 224}, "text_hash": "05525c4c191bc321acc0cc79aec192d17992e506b23868c23c89348b71b62129"}

{"id": "p_1cd646e0bba6a967", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 225, "text": "曹操殺了馬騰等，便決意南征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 225}, "text_hash": "6433b43b02357ebc5bc575db419f4ea6aa0dcdda29c208f527ed07715a90fc95"}

{"id": "p_eb8793f8313d7997", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 226, "text": "忽人報曰：「劉備調練軍馬，收拾器械，將欲取川。", "locator": {"ordinal": 226}, "text_hash": "fab286b4857986c04d680bad5e553be203b73f42e3344eea37791a7379684196"}

{"id": "p_8efaaf076284eba3", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 227, "text": "操驚曰：「若劉備收川，則羽翼成矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 227}, "text_hash": "61a73e2652a1a185c48a6f6ebbfa35817a6f17fa617140522a720438b18b91ec"}

{"id": "p_465d82774ea68f30", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 228, "text": "言未畢，階下一人進言曰：「某有一計，使劉備、孫權不能相願；江南、西川皆歸丞相。", "locator": {"ordinal": 228}, "text_hash": "22094ffb74d857aea9b253bf8db87b896e6994c12227dd369d15400a840af492"}

{"id": "p_6352b5c70736d336", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 229, "text": "::西川豪傑方遭戮，南國英雄又受殃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 229}, "text_hash": "8e3bc1ce933107f80f2383e7a421edd4b9eae623cf56b9dd0faf9a20d623178b"}

{"id": "p_bfd2ba28590601f7", "source_id": "src_0f12dc35f240128c", "ordinal": 230, "text": "未知獻計者是誰，且看下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 230}, "text_hash": "6248b15052e79793443c45e7a03561e3b1bfe5489a70be449da2402f6c916154"}

{"id": "p_3ca06e313c2a634e", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 0, "text": "蒙曰：「吾料關某兵少，必不從大路而逃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "49128008651f86d87fc3ba52c7a878a300b459435bdeeb1cfedcd76962b3105b"}

{"id": "p_2eb02ac35424ba87", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 1, "text": "麥城正北有險峻小路，必從此路而去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "4e88243e1e1f01efab9ac6f9981cdd0b718f1bd8c8d40609efaac21085e6ded7"}

{"id": "p_ee43f4aa7f820000", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 2, "text": "可令朱然引精兵五千，伏於麥城之北二十里。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "0e24b35dd28a02f8a13d0afd6e82524b35c0aa54ddc32c0e3204faa512c003c7"}

{"id": "p_2db2fffaea989437", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 3, "text": "彼軍至，不可與敵，只可隨後掩殺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "53970d58ee8f4aab7e65e851453367f7c342e777addb03ac559c8d59ed9d4987"}

{"id": "p_2c5e22f811a88b82", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 4, "text": "彼軍定無戰心，必奔臨沮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "b9c30b21fe6900f485c5f6149fa46fa3de42868765e3cb70f3e6f51d59867a8c"}

{"id": "p_65a360be4680ae43", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 5, "text": "卻令潘璋引精兵五百，伏於臨沮山僻小路，關某可擒矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "fb704bfb75c641b1df63fe1181f3c74aca63aba050208fc66e74ddfc5670737a"}

{"id": "p_4f2854ca6e870447", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 6, "text": "今遣將士各門攻打，只空北門，待其出走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "08c8d8ab8c1dd4d951b8805c68d43e2b3bce5eac557b7aa8b62dd28909e1664e"}

{"id": "p_ac2c03a1a8a7a4dd", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 7, "text": "」權聞計，令呂範再卜之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "d7d24903650e26a809a3932c39a5e4ec783b8552a78b445fc164ce690d7ffc75"}

{"id": "p_ff2f76d3305d2841", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 8, "text": "卦成，範告曰：「此卦主敵人投西北而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "69644e8f503af3e43e823160e12cc184196c3f04e4f2266f64c663581a8a8973"}

{"id": "p_47cb38ca65239b74", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 9, "text": "」權大喜，遂令朱然、潘璋領兩枝精兵，各依軍令埋伏去訖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "96ff674438be89058887d092e8decb3b37f0c3b2083204be906ca203551d45da"}

{"id": "p_3193103503a437de", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 10, "text": "且說關公在麥城，計點馬步軍兵，止剩三百餘人；糧草又盡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "05c0d2dad8901f0037ac4aeca63f32f5b5c87ca3631ccb7a41760fd7bbce7525"}

{"id": "p_75721919fd54e094", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 11, "text": "是夜城外吳兵招喚各軍姓名，越城而去者甚多。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "33e3fbc95c6ae2b71fa0b6baf7bb9f7862549d5e4697a4d60aed8f532d4ca467"}

{"id": "p_2406b52bdf6f74d0", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 12, "text": "心中無計，謂王甫曰：「吾悔昔日不用公言！", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "eb494a23afb8d2e680bbf4df1d3902d64256348ddae5145ed2e5cb5e28424f6c"}

{"id": "p_9323a1b7bb2d9c44", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 13, "text": "」甫哭告曰：「今日之事，雖子牙復生，亦無計可施也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "d0e9df2da938050fd82961a43a4c06f84931a578856662c6bb799e7b74498787"}

{"id": "p_3e700def9cf24579", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」趙累曰：「上庸救兵不至，乃劉封、孟達按兵不動之故。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "14d351834dee32f7f72e4dda6384eacc67d3614a54d6807fcd0a425e3d5824c6"}

{"id": "p_2e8e570c9ee0277d", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 15, "text": "何不棄此孤城，奔入西川，再整兵來，以圖恢復？", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "e0c0701d1574e3bef135a72f0e48338d205ced2bac9ec0d334419e609bd24260"}

{"id": "p_3c2a04af41c38fba", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 16, "text": "見北門外敵軍不多，因問本城居民：「此去往北，地勢若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "04e85c606084047083be2605221a00477099c91b49645362a35135671ac5ce94"}

{"id": "p_72a42090d922450a", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 17, "text": "」答曰：「此去皆是山僻小路，可通西川。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "de0987695cfe5b9d317deb1a3fad1e0cccef0fab3c876f37cea4e4be598326f8"}

{"id": "p_d5b76245b84475c2", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 18, "text": "」公曰：「今夜可走此路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "9fa5557ce5015986a69975c07e247e5cbcfab8f20b0cc133e66f4fbaa0576063"}

{"id": "p_ebc0bd492e59eaf8", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 19, "text": "」王甫諫曰：「小路有埋伏，可走大路。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "2cbc08030ae21d0dd5a799303dff0ad711979c212df2b2fffa888816bb8dff5d"}

{"id": "p_d3a2f04ad36d2726", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 20, "text": "」公曰：「雖有埋伏，吾何懼哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "f1b2cc20925772a8b5cc9a5ebfe35e7caa87a2a8a28a6ea8ac200a83e4289238"}

{"id": "p_dd1fde007defbe54", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 21, "text": "」即下令：馬步官軍，嚴整裝束，準備出城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "eaa04624d2d844a62d19508b4cc0828eccd629a5bb357c22fd6eac6032d3238d"}

{"id": "p_a53c575345b9a046", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 22, "text": "甫哭曰：「君侯於路，小心保重！", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "f12f183e4717f22c16cd2e089fd3733928f920b2274457991fbcdea38be900bb"}

{"id": "p_ed6e8127bd3a16c3", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 23, "text": "某與部卒百餘人，死據此城；城雖破，身不降也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "40a0b3a0c5ca3d0f311b417ec00cea072f009d87fbcde55f0e975d7b7bfdf696"}

{"id": "p_1ee6d4329be28f2d", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 24, "text": "遂留周倉與王甫同守麥城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "3d5ff2e4708b1c837633a098b35b4cc9b47ba78edcd60265561828aa9c1f929e"}

{"id": "p_007206848ca663ce", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 25, "text": "關公自與關平、趙累引殘卒二百餘人，突出北門。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "2bbd85fb53679cd95c9cd9acbe621dd8305dfb2d034f7c33c1814eb2deb9a4cc"}

{"id": "p_4aae76682722ccea", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 26, "text": "行至初更以後，約走二十餘里，只見山凹處，金鼓齊鳴，喊聲大震，一彪軍馬；為首大將朱然，驟馬挺鎗叫曰：「雲長休走！", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "63e30dae29a778d31909acbcad0bc428a5eac905237b09831257f754e93b256d"}

{"id": "p_561639c07e1a9c90", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」公大怒，拍馬輪刀來戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "dee7e81868754b01d96b31bf2d53553373c8fecf955c95f955cf913c63236a61"}

{"id": "p_ce68196460c88a7d", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 28, "text": "一棒鼓響，四下伏兵皆起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "e3d80289111c46853ad0165302fed557a60516f411fc568d7fac4945fcd93151"}

{"id": "p_bc6d1afac16669fd", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 29, "text": "公不敢戰，望臨沮小路而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "d132eb0d2d199065796575e01421c5b6ab0f166ef21732c31b554acd00fb48c8"}

{"id": "p_40a9e6e0b6ea77e8", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 30, "text": "關公所隨之兵，漸漸稀少。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "025fdb982b66dc829099e231cf103d5b4803cab922de9bfc6702e9a0657bc019"}

{"id": "p_6cae2dbb5d12d1ca", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 31, "text": "走不得四五里，前面喊聲又震，火光大起，潘璋驟馬舞刀殺來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "9b4b95a71b7aa65f8828b6fdef7bfb44cf68e3a8beee676616ec60c2f794c4e3"}

{"id": "p_9d319e6362c3fcc1", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 32, "text": "公大怒，輪刀相迎；只三合，潘璋敗走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "a37006863ca4f19c39440fbf1cc2544c1f6308417c30088d817f1f06a8f253ee"}

{"id": "p_f07dc6bd0eb1ed2a", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 33, "text": "公不敢戀戰，急望山路而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "bc229fba14776a2aee08eff4bb093d673d0a0c751e6c1da7378805eb6fda1416"}

{"id": "p_af84d60955d9cc2f", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 34, "text": "背後關平趕來，報說趙累已死於亂軍中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "eeefd4c9fbbfc1b58e1f195eaa0cda349da1a8ae04b65e630eca827a4706e7fa"}

{"id": "p_7eb32eaea9dfa3c3", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 35, "text": "關公不勝悲惶，遂令關平斷後，公自在前開路，隨行止剩得十餘人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "5104625cdb3a0e35b703b1c8cee5365d5629e28580026f9d872357a2903d3a1f"}

{"id": "p_56e82122e2d11277", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 36, "text": "行至決石，兩下是山，山邊皆蘆葦敗草，樹木叢雜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "d21b647f47af4471dc697484f5d70db9f1952fbd9f19fd125fe62c520e30169b"}

{"id": "p_4d98af167e891b68", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 37, "text": "正走之間，一聲喊起，兩下伏兵盡出，長鉤套索，一齊並舉，先把關公坐下馬絆倒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "e32eb5c10994791bdd5aee822daea714cb4c9235d5e14ebad039518c902904e0"}

{"id": "p_7810f7d1076a13e8", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 38, "text": "關公翻身落馬，被潘璋部將馬忠所獲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "3de1eae60016b37c2dc0fbe2988c1a0c16f3f7f8a90800ba770d7cdff6727d9f"}

{"id": "p_cf40bf883b7143ee", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 39, "text": "關平知父被擒，火速來救；背後潘璋、朱然率兵齊至，把關平四下圍住。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "ba7da5e059ee0e6341d9c56ab509ff1a04b9bb203b17927ac5bc24fb0d6fe17f"}

{"id": "p_dea1aa99b8deb834", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 40, "text": "平孤身獨戰，力盡亦被執。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "85bffed1fd467353fe1f4d5e8db8743542e75a342b3256d488892e9f81879873"}

{"id": "p_5f4c5a31d6ef3f9b", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 41, "text": "至天明，孫權聞關公父子已被擒獲，大喜，聚眾將於帳中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "e59cb29255cd096917a2f0ccf7aa2d42d68bc4a56e579505a2e1d7f81604d0a2"}

{"id": "p_9f1d2a2b44e08893", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 42, "text": "少時，馬忠簇擁關公至前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "b2eab248cb5a253af00ee845c73576deeb8f8e35ca96625308644b53973d1524"}

{"id": "p_420357d3a574bc6b", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 43, "text": "權曰：「孤久慕將軍盛德，欲結秦晉之好，何相棄耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "32e983478d15bd639759aeb9655077b316ea0ff370897692ab3439bae728dc2a"}

{"id": "p_c334136fe65322ed", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 44, "text": "公平昔自以為天下無敵，今日何由被吾所擒？", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "7d399ee9dd784330b04af7f20c52b4c3ef113c52eadc3a4cd845b2b4e04ee476"}

{"id": "p_130131655351e888", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」關公厲聲罵曰：「碧眼小兒，紫髯鼠輩！", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "e994f3f314dcf1b95a47fc56dc608e7ab22445bcf84197a4273e6ed09bac3527"}

{"id": "p_3dd7d536222c0e8b", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 46, "text": "吾與劉皇叔桃園結義，誓扶漢室，豈與汝叛漢之賊為伍耶！", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "488b3c4e882ed3b3d839be96465787015ea0be591a98a262e4c7d8441d719ac4"}

{"id": "p_d38b0ac8ed313aac", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 47, "text": "我今誤中奸計，有死而已，何必多言！", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "18b379dd4a839e1f21d0af32f5e417f68e474b6507ceb93e80d980d6d002ac13"}

{"id": "p_81d7814fc7981a81", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 48, "text": "」權回顧眾官曰：「雲長世之豪傑，孤深愛之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "ea37bca43afb8015914cfc17f310dfcde33467658b3e34b5540df19183ba9304"}

{"id": "p_306e298e5d2f5166", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 49, "text": "今欲以禮相待，勸使歸降，何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "1a2107cef87c210eda8edad65dcb8a9b366bed08fceecfc8512644ced847ce44"}

{"id": "p_cd28e232033ab676", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 50, "text": "昔曹操得此人時，封侯賜爵，三日一小宴，五日一大宴；上馬一提金，下馬一提銀：如此恩禮，畢竟留之不住，聽其斬關殺將而去，致使今日反為所逼，幾欲遷都以避其鋒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "f0ad69065fc72ca21e9ed7c0204099a5791f7511e9bcb3efadebfa34c99184d0"}

{"id": "p_88dd9d363be45be1", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 51, "text": "今主公既已擒之，若不即除，恐貽後患。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "1ae394de2b820c667ad3363150ea18c9a32238844fbacd520fef4487265b8ca9"}

{"id": "p_468381f01fb1d011", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 52, "text": "」孫權沈吟半晌，曰：「斯言是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "7a1c47c4554b3f2cc7f2c2e96403f48ed69cdc329d0ad5ce15b116eab0a0808e"}

{"id": "p_9dc7a03138462158", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 53, "text": "於是關公父子皆遇害：時建安二十四年冬十二月也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "9714af5b768cc21db2756ba736e26016a14fd522b850d278750c84c87cc4762b"}

{"id": "p_4c00364df7eca811", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 54, "text": "::漢末才無敵，雲長獨出群。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "658225391b8c013ac8f82ed18bcb9178e5963c42df02516493b7fa99e127c771"}

{"id": "p_14ce4e7d945506f2", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 55, "text": "::神威能奮武，儒雅更知文。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "d96b197bf078b4e0e48d2fdec71afd43b39465164fc609d305ba3432c269251f"}

{"id": "p_cd3b8d0b04fb8058", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 56, "text": "::天日心如鏡，春秋義薄雲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "96598c2f2033cbe0bfe7bdbe44095accbd8a3ba4108a0412bf2848c5a591d520"}

{"id": "p_3729e7e4dcad4678", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 57, "text": "::昭然垂萬古，不止冠三分。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "8ded87a36df5f1c46d7da3d3a7138ba6897c308ca6d7d66619684e3a29d1616d"}

{"id": "p_8eb7d7b9730e7d89", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 58, "text": "::人傑惟追古解良，士民爭拜漢雲長。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "aaea9c9f7a1e5c337b63ebcae227c473df42f8a90d9b16c335b48ce9e641e5f1"}

{"id": "p_0ea7cf96f31218fe", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 59, "text": "::桃園一日兄和弟，俎豆千秋帝與王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "f710e7143f901143138841a5c604257a1f812cc8a02e0cf46e808d8698aa47a0"}

{"id": "p_086de5824a992692", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 60, "text": "::氣挾風雷無匹敵，志垂日月有光芒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "e6e83e24bd2b5b265ab1eb16926d18352cf0340d1a24c13bbdba374f1d6a3c1d"}

{"id": "p_8fd06618ed400689", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 61, "text": "關公既歿，坐下赤兔馬被馬忠所獲，獻與孫權。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "cb3983daf7d8df71391c17fb3cd6727362889921e262b1c54b3291df329c525d"}

{"id": "p_4cbf58e1aaf847c2", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 62, "text": "卻說王甫在麥城中，骨顫肉驚，乃問周倉曰：「昨夜夢見主公渾身血污，立於前；急問之，忽然驚覺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "e58b4caf083faf0628d293860f48106295971a68fbd25cd806ce87937bf09b7a"}

{"id": "p_078ff2c09761be18", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」正說間，忽報吳兵在城下，將關公父子首級招安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "db4e01ac95a8f8f06ff2d6c1d1a47a4190af92c28685f9c09d881d89a7568b66"}

{"id": "p_64c09f0ab97cbe65", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 64, "text": "王甫、周倉大驚，急登城視之，果關公父子首級也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "6b4831141c949fc69d72cee9774e039de06fd3b0e7f859ce66d634f6a3c57017"}

{"id": "p_bd16b0a8d293727a", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 65, "text": "王甫大叫一聲，墮城而死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "72809023120a0d2c9004f6f483406d93fb74449a2a264abd53afa71728731128"}

{"id": "p_1b946b6e9e944e4f", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 66, "text": "卻說關公英魂不散，蕩蕩悠悠，直至一處，乃荊門州當陽縣一座山，名為玉泉山。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "d9c1d4d3bc80a484e4ef07a16ea53e74559dc934109e30c639a5b5305c76fa92"}

{"id": "p_04bd19280a1e618a", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 67, "text": "山上有一老僧，法名普淨，原是汜水關鎮國寺中長老；後因雲遊天下，來到此處，見山明水秀，就此結草為庵，每日坐禪參道；身邊只有一小行者，化飯度日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "501dccd68135a459a734b115788b0cf19720e72fd28a8833ec91547079871985"}

{"id": "p_a9096bdd6087066c", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 68, "text": "是夜日白風清，三更已後，普淨正在庵中默坐，忽聞空中有人大呼曰：「還我頭來！", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "9409e250338c2d5bf4425ce757ceea0e611b2794337c2fa9b3bd259a30929155"}

{"id": "p_da8e47b25bccbde8", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」普淨仰面諦視，只見空中一人，騎赤兔馬，提青龍刀；左有一白面將軍、右有一黑臉虯髯之人相隨；一齊按落雲頭，至玉泉山頂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "d3dcf340165e0566bec20f70a783776faee1d4e9ca5168b22f5bdd0f689ad38b"}

{"id": "p_c0db97707a465d52", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 70, "text": "普靜認得是關公，遂以手中麈尾擊其戶曰：「雲長安在？", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "490654c394c8d2bc41069f7e26310c79f51056bce51b9fd8133b274cc738b191"}

{"id": "p_e8d004adb546ef7f", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 71, "text": "關公英魂領悟，即下馬乘風落於庵前，叉手問曰：「吾師何人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "d3e72f5a1bf26abbabd4001ca81c4525cc374ae44d47d00481659d8aace76c63"}

{"id": "p_4562377b8f6400f7", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 72, "text": "」普淨曰：「老僧普淨，昔日汜水關前鎮國寺中，曾與君侯相會，今日豈遂忘之耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "c6b38dd3bca58db91966b7a23d9d9f58578b85f65e4225564cf686b9331e78f0"}

{"id": "p_47642c38ecd47713", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」公曰：「向蒙相救，銘感不忘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "17d06cc8856e4c1cff0213ff0be0e246c3f1301dd685754c887c1481add605c8"}

{"id": "p_74078579545ddd95", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 74, "text": "今某已遇禍而死，願求清誨，指點迷途。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "2e1d1f58e90a53270b7e655a54653827ed36e508dc9216735f6c51f2c0df875a"}

{"id": "p_a9dc73f26ba2fc19", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 75, "text": "」普淨曰：「昔非今是，一切休論，後果前因，彼此不爽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "1dc1e4385017b0d226d1985e86ae48bd218d50a9fa8db838baa0c1aeef7071d8"}

{"id": "p_fd817b31f2a96741", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 76, "text": "今將軍為呂蒙所害，大呼『還我頭來』，然則顏良、文醜、五關六將等眾人之頭，又將向誰索耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "6aa45748aae0e31f20177375879c40c362b5afaf03b99e7c61c1a72a0fc0d624"}

{"id": "p_aa9a741ac5f9ed6f", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 77, "text": "」於是關公恍然大悟，稽首皈依而去。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "be703c0cc2c91abf19a901ce9cb5d816e8e4dddd59678677e6075d75ecc48c85"}

{"id": "p_be641d8f7c197907", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 78, "text": "後往往於玉泉山顯聖護民。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "85134be97669149eb24e457e24b7df2f0c95c9dba0d33db0dcbe6424ba7a5a25"}

{"id": "p_f6b897e38537364b", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 79, "text": "鄉人感其德，就於山頂上建廟，四時致祭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "8a9133b6c798ae78c0d3cabe12b179b1c1a252c13a4b4381755239c6ad1da046"}

{"id": "p_a567b0e123bdfc7f", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 80, "text": "::赤面秉赤心，騎赤兔追風，馳驅時無忘赤帝；", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "702514577b87bd5c51f15b7c5efe042bff209c092def09598b404dc7cf60ad93"}

{"id": "p_c392ddf10d3fa069", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 81, "text": "::青燈觀青史，仗青龍偃月，隱微處不愧青天。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "97e64b22fb74772b359b9e15e759626f298e8c5cb23be36c1b628ffa8feacef9"}

{"id": "p_1f027d452f5803f3", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 82, "text": "卻說孫權既害了關公，遂盡收荊襄之地，賞犒三軍，設宴大會諸將慶功；置呂蒙於上位，顧謂眾將曰：「孤久不得荊州，今唾手而得，皆子明之功也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "22deb759b9a740e38858073ac6c63c7e14e6c64570e0a16830f32049dd34593a"}

{"id": "p_b7a5f322f9bf72c1", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 83, "text": "權曰：「昔周郎雄略過人，破曹操於赤壁，不幸早殀，魯子敬代之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "9baab34392802c5850008d8344b5fff62ef72d3487dc08d64ae7f4a1ca65a2b8"}

{"id": "p_22dbcd3c8c64caf2", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 84, "text": "子敬初見孤時，便及帝王大略，此一快也；曹操東下，諸人皆勸孤降，子敬獨勸孤召公瑾逆而擊之，此二快也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "f399ed9d11f7459d24afa7ed1712eec18165f00d30a1ed0dd6ac343726b77644"}

{"id": "p_23a7e17cf78d31f5", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 85, "text": "惟勸吾借荊州與劉備，是其一短。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "6246d073a4d412c23dbc7a22fc3ca89316cf5b128d31798d0e2eb1b2374ab704"}

{"id": "p_1699925c0ddfb20d", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 86, "text": "今子明設計定謀，立取荊州，勝子敬、周郎多矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "04cadec962e28ea68f5b01efa7aca99068dd668f26d7e1fe5451333d8da3f5a9"}

{"id": "p_228277b4cb3f9e6c", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 87, "text": "呂蒙接酒欲飲，忽然擲盃於地，一手揪住孫權，厲聲大罵曰：「碧眼小兒！", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "f41ba348ff09c5ccc0d769d9bf2461aef377aaaf07c00b7940b6e5f37db8b218"}

{"id": "p_7d88ee70d63b0cdf", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 88, "text": "急救時，蒙推倒孫權，大步前進，坐於孫權位上，兩眉倒豎，雙眼圓睜，大喝曰：「我自破黃巾以來，縱橫天下三十餘年，今被汝一旦以奸計圖我，我生不能啖汝之肉，死當追呂賊之魂！", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "2ee86e624002c4832a83479335384ea6919456854024c9adfc39303ce05e4894"}

{"id": "p_37c2634690717494", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 89, "text": "」權大驚，慌忙率大小將士，皆下拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "441b883f244ec1a4e56ddea98fce62945ebdbc7d6977f92a9b3301eeba336d1c"}

{"id": "p_45819139c734848a", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 90, "text": "只見呂蒙倒於地上，七竅流血而死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "15f6bb8562f54c75b344afd5c78bfb688468eeae30114f483b601df43c56360d"}

{"id": "p_1b6e51730fb7a21a", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 91, "text": "權將呂蒙屍首，具棺安葬，贈南郡太守孱陵侯；命其子呂霸襲爵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "f1eb8979ad35958fd3732f686da9f0d02e466fda2efdc0b5ec2496241139d44b"}

{"id": "p_69aec3c7d5c8ff40", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 92, "text": "孫權自此感關公之事，驚訝不已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "7e8afa8e16a1168f76398bffb88c2c5e1d2951653068cc8b0016bbf65c42aafe"}

{"id": "p_38c9e4ae36ecf50b", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 93, "text": "昭曰：「今主公損了關公父子，江東禍不遠矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "6257557fe04e7c33cde28fc9631564786b7367917949abe44b4ff924d960aa55"}

{"id": "p_d45d2294fa7b7418", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 94, "text": "此人與劉備桃園結義之時，誓同生死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "3d98b30a4c5aa533c17f28c8d56c53245875c1dbea5cc35b9c366b9c9aa147b4"}

{"id": "p_7f802fc6090f8557", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 95, "text": "今劉備已有兩川之兵；更兼諸葛亮之謀，張、黃、馬、趙之勇；備若知雲長父子遇害，必起傾國之兵，奮力報讎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "ddf209f4041a5663b5ad0ffe7c1fca412e28aee6f5fc7ee9bcca52e62c6a242c"}

{"id": "p_1f8f21b98ce53657", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 96, "text": "」權聞之大驚，跌足曰：「孤失計較也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "c2590ec71192dffd01389e8a73efbaceba5d347e3515f2ad53ee7d25248e309a"}

{"id": "p_cf01749577aa2077", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 97, "text": "」昭曰：「主公勿憂，某有一計，令西蜀之兵不犯東吳，荊州如磐石之安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "4bf12cbf03aecfdb2abde54d385d4035d2ba281d8f53e9c7453fa706020d2897"}

{"id": "p_2280d1dbc276e365", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 98, "text": "昭曰：「今曹操擁百萬之眾，虎視華夏，劉備急欲報讎，必與操約和。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "11d931d69462884e62a1f6bff758d38c6a7cfed9cd08c1d6ca3f12cbe6e2ccb1"}

{"id": "p_22377c632d9d71e8", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 99, "text": "若二處連兵而來，東吳危矣；不如先遣人將關公首級，轉送與曹操，明教劉備知是操之所使，必痛恨於操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "aef7827cae93d1e3e870100458b82c286a75526428df6455bcc784c979e34964"}

{"id": "p_c1f080826a92a2a1", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 100, "text": "西蜀之兵，不向吳而向魏矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "2de88f32852afcaf48c59bba03a1aa9f2a42f2606f363db774883892a18af3ce"}

{"id": "p_8aa330d227c724ff", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 101, "text": "吾乃觀其勝負，於中取事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "bde36f79dc1529307c91f789dfbbf25b2904a1da3cbecf56bb83f5ccc8d6acfc"}

{"id": "p_8a730fb2d9bdabcb", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 102, "text": "權從其言，隨遣使者以木匣盛關公首級，星夜送與曹操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "ba549e6c65ebebaa1772a4787e2af5acb898615b98cb3570acaaa6dceb875c0d"}

{"id": "p_f564a05c929e8496", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 103, "text": "時操從摩陂班師回洛陽，聞東吳送關公首級至，喜曰：「雲長已死，吾夜眠貼席矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "c60fb9fcacbeafecbafc3eb7205389d9005fbbbd3d31f4cf984a9938d73c45b1"}

{"id": "p_e02424c490a5455d", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 104, "text": "」階下一人出曰：「此乃東吳移禍之計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "27873bb109d044fb5ca3a0b7beda5b89c18edff87c0caec706bb68bc46a15ff0"}

{"id": "p_1319546fcdbe83e2", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 105, "text": "」操視之，乃主簿司馬懿也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "4f7a851defe69ee7d3931767d58a85f70a7af5413a03729365b1bf0bb80f0098"}

{"id": "p_e3560f3c77ece759", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 106, "text": "操問其故，懿曰：「昔劉、關、張三人桃園結義之時，誓同生死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "f5de8e01a59129e2dc9b9658a7d5466541354feb0743b107ffa16714bedcdd0b"}

{"id": "p_de346937d3a30bfa", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 107, "text": "今東吳害了關公，懼其復讎，故將首級獻與大王，使劉備遷怒大王，不攻吳而攻魏，他卻於中乘便而圖事耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "93e6a8b411669ac50fd7812dce53f0397fb6b539eddcee96e2b87b562649a325"}

{"id": "p_73a08f14b3cc1082", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 108, "text": "」操曰：「仲達之言是也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "d633b35e562b8ee7581692d94b690dcb131895ad658d6bc14e4e6a0532a302dc"}

{"id": "p_389eff22a1b9840d", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 109, "text": "大王可將關公首級，刻一香木之軀以配之，葬以大臣之禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "0fc98b72b36d7dd694199e397a85759f2f24f69a909023b664e20ae0e8d660fb"}

{"id": "p_4c6ab86cba46f363", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 110, "text": "劉備知之，必深恨孫權，盡力南征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "992eddefb437f1bcdd96696d50bed3f889bfee049ea36ed91d8f60000ae8a825"}

{"id": "p_fef8d73008e3709e", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 111, "text": "我卻觀其勝負：蜀勝則擊吳，吳勝則擊蜀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "e0cb3e4d59bcdfcb4757b6d24f43f37ff6a29e68416f440a7a0e0ed411991a5c"}

{"id": "p_b2b1b51fe24e0334", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 112, "text": "二處若得一處，那一處亦不久也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "18c05c0f409a767fc1900f71400f427b9a370802f9dfc39912c9179c8c2f68be"}

{"id": "p_71781409b54f28d7", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」操大喜，從其計，遂召吳使入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "49d75eed803ff25809feb241e4b71de244962e6ac4c8004e10abed70b6aae6f1"}

{"id": "p_0cb4060a7f6cb771", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 114, "text": "操開匣視之，見關公面如平日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "d4f8c7d5aa8409cf3ccc837f673131b40e4d91855a121eb07fcb70626142c1ac"}

{"id": "p_be14b7e981adcbb8", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 115, "text": "操笑曰：「雲長公別來無恙！", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "0e7f254a58f3c416950c0b35d8e0e1e35bcd3268ccd7c1cc434cc8e76983bc11"}

{"id": "p_464e5376e6e5dfb0", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 116, "text": "」言未畢，只見關公口開目動，鬚髮皆張，操驚倒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "b964ac71df068a0317b14041fb20ae2dd02d33f42be42291c5403e2e9f5b8b2f"}

{"id": "p_b140a48ebf473b84", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 117, "text": "眾官急救，良久方醒，顧謂眾官曰：「關將軍真天神也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "2636e4ea9361c30f51e12ea37fa427425b9f3cf43f9c3bbed8f8180b3507b411"}

{"id": "p_ec4cf99e21c035cb", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 118, "text": "」吳使又將關公顯聖附體、罵孫權追呂蒙之事告操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "cab60b2c22b4dcb16b0e5f97d30cb7182a278fe2957f0a35d92ac18710d1a27c"}

{"id": "p_fbd0c225e76dd968", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 119, "text": "操愈加恐懼，遂設牲醴祭祀，刻沈香木為軀，以王侯之禮，葬於洛陽南門外。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "a1847b571ffacf7b670cbe070533095d5c60992e7d8683e7032eea1a7d2d9a07"}

{"id": "p_15c5eb9c8d67a0b2", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 120, "text": "令大小官員送殯，操自拜祭，贈為荊王，差官守墓；即遣吳使回江東去訖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "1ab54306b97e559138616fe4f558e64ebeeb859dd761abc568a0cb0daa283a0f"}

{"id": "p_3da38e98d148bc8d", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 121, "text": "卻說漢中王自東川回成都，法正奏曰：「主上先夫人去世；孫夫人又南歸，未必再來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "6d873e2c68eb058b9f29cf5bdf07e64eae7c6d237f95d3b0d50c8e2102cbf5e3"}

{"id": "p_1beb7733a7cdb479", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 122, "text": "法正復奏曰：「吳懿有一妹，美而且賢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "7b6e0e645ef95bb776373f672e47f8f197c1f485b5f1ea4904834e4150d4699e"}

{"id": "p_56fd1e7c6c0d544f", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 123, "text": "嘗聞有相者，相此女後必大貴。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "232f16ef5c35b57837252d2e540b935d1a46d741c4e638cf2b5e9dac24b763d9"}

{"id": "p_5c12be890dbca761", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 124, "text": "先曾許劉焉之子劉瑁；瑁早殀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "7ace3cb2c88b836109d09774074f309f9f44da55928d55ec1a492ab34af4efa0"}

{"id": "p_315743ffa73566be", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 125, "text": "其女至今寡居，大王可納之為妃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "9a2526e80a4648cc0d989ecd1fc3b3b739ba89a6a7af80a2861a1406ceba2802"}

{"id": "p_591eb10cdde33bc8", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 126, "text": "」漢中王曰：「劉瑁與我同宗，於理不可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "60a8c800a17040deffb3a422c7f0f9519c1d87b2912b10abf51426e0cfa79966"}

{"id": "p_8f7f6eb34146980b", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 127, "text": "」法正曰：「論其親疏，何異晉文之與懷嬴乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "08e99042e377f1e9746b6a9930ffdb94881e2211102c8c280f5f14b52086de46"}

{"id": "p_2e56d1fa6c4b6d52", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 128, "text": "」漢中王乃依允，遂納吳氏為王妃。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "ad364e1108cc2408824a2d074cd1ef973f014a01f7e48f83522dce83fe5aed5d"}

{"id": "p_053a21f2a597e148", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 129, "text": "後生二子：長劉永，字公壽；次劉理，字奉孝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "a84232f164cc9b49e4d846178372a0f3ba79772d936ff3f017edffb09e4c5730"}

{"id": "p_aae8645be208465e", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 130, "text": "且說東西兩川，民安國富，田禾大成。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "30d7aa8dfc1cb8de0de96c6043f73006d7bccc13597f83eb05c6be4ad49afa54"}

{"id": "p_d97093fb2ce34f95", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 131, "text": "忽有人自荊州來，言東吳求婚於關公，關公力拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "10f50abe75c4e527dcc0442f9a86970cc65b9f4d4ee8164b2368776621bd4775"}

{"id": "p_20c96b0deddb1677", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」正商議間，荊州捷報使命，絡繹而至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "b607b4024642b8d8cd47faa9de9da9f79588bda76c4a5abce78c771a959d8e38"}

{"id": "p_df64192032e6d2be", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 133, "text": "不一日，關興到，具言水渰七軍之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "fbf9102dde65fed840d43be670b78649d74528cd10258ed808f77084dd52f6a5"}

{"id": "p_96f3176415a8fbd2", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 134, "text": "忽又報馬到來，報說關公於江邊多設墩臺，隄防甚密，萬無一失。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "0b8a39f0b6f9d4217a915888954069be9047059b621245dcb3684864cb3efc08"}

{"id": "p_967126a26f3e94d1", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 135, "text": "忽一日，玄德自覺渾身肉顫，行坐不安；至夜不能寧睡，起坐內室，秉燭看書，覺神思昏迷，伏几而臥；室中忽起一陣冷風，燈滅復明，抬頭見一人立於燈下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "99cc4db0553cbfae0b54ebda48e69ff39e866797434f9d9dada97e445cb2fffe"}

{"id": "p_4c4f2fabfd9b32e4", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 136, "text": "玄德問曰：「汝何人，夤夜至吾內室？", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "f6ac20d649a0908133314cfc8f73cd6933cd206711892bc66c489c85af818d79"}

{"id": "p_3eb60b999300edf7", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 137, "text": "玄德疑怪，自起視之，乃是關公於燈影下，往來躲避。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "dc727c9a407256434a908683574a1be1ddaeb799ace13d220295473d2876952f"}

{"id": "p_bc2dfcb8c3916bb1", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 138, "text": "玄德曰：「賢弟別來無恙！", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "6b7cff779b8f8bc7c5c2d55b452d97dbff5ea5d32eeb11edf98f75cb75d00d29"}

{"id": "p_9d7329484c881ff7", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 139, "text": "吾與汝情同骨肉，因何迴避？", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "6f10fdd72a3f912146ae757b31db390c4792132ec6f476989a102c31bbee39ac"}

{"id": "p_03c7981d08609b2d", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」關公泣告曰：「願兄起兵，以雪弟恨！", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "ac1ca58666d70aa45e0decb12eacf1bd516a54571b674b6dac0815dc15640efc"}
