{"id": "p_e469cb8dcd946f22", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 141, "text": "」言訖，冷風驟起，關公不見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "7e924815c33d27df1d60fe26560f67fe98cbe360d743cd8ead5a69ea5af56c44"}

{"id": "p_1b7fcb0542839c5a", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 142, "text": "玄德忽然驚覺，乃是一夢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "7f6ad4abdf6e526106d2abf5b7da97c5f4e018233017dcadc1aac9b0f1a08559"}

{"id": "p_3245ab829e8fc949", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 143, "text": "玄德大疑，急出前殿，使人請孔明來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "59364b3003be51f0d692bb8b2d03f573ec392853d3eafc1c4ffe98743ece4a35"}

{"id": "p_4734a179aa1c4140", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 144, "text": "孔明曰：「此乃主上心思關公，故有此夢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "a7ac92d936016042d879a338c18521768564eba979ca73402a9d7ff6ee008fb4"}

{"id": "p_2a2f6b3a03e4eb91", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 145, "text": "」玄德再三疑慮，孔明以善言解之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "c9ad49d2e7362c1cd82902dab53cba5b6c550dfb12d7fc590c919cdd6984cb76"}

{"id": "p_c023b58019326a48", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 146, "text": "孔明辭出，至中門外，迎見許靖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "adc54ba47c730c406372e0df58071b2ec68fb6c0053f383fa7a4c6a3b1e41491"}

{"id": "p_6dcb8c09a398ffed", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 147, "text": "靖曰：「某纔赴軍師府下報一機密，聽知軍師入宮，特來至此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "9171aa0f3ae66319b3ef7631dd1d34da53091bab8605af327cead4fd57947031"}

{"id": "p_83816a7476dd43f3", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」靖曰：「某適聞外人傳說，東吳呂蒙已襲荊州，關公已遇害，故特來密報軍師。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "ec6949ed1f776d96d959e2c05cca2811a33a14641331a56dc43b2d8eae50c97d"}

{"id": "p_ee052088616d8aa7", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 149, "text": "」孔明曰：「吾夜觀天象，見將星落於荊楚之地，已知雲長必然被禍，但恐王上憂慮，故未敢言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "f60dab97194f49c8b3663c645028846d4561d6285fa92b1867e487fcbb8a9e13"}

{"id": "p_0904087ec2d8fbf8", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」二人正說之間，忽然殿內轉出一人，扯住孔明衣袖而言曰：「如此凶信，公何瞞我！", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "b85a7ca3d7b355d809c5b050cf46becefe523b425c066bd0e34a35d57dd80f90"}

{"id": "p_b1db04d7f5fedc80", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 151, "text": "孔明、許靖奏曰：「適來所言，皆傳聞之事，未足深信。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "00099a71283eda030b02a28aca97593d712a7c727075745fd9481607a77e14c2"}

{"id": "p_12045e68567a883a", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 152, "text": "」玄德曰：「吾與雲長，誓同生死；彼若有失，孤豈能獨生耶！", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "f76d7000a4fbccd41809f13bc984572bb8104b69226abfc290deb4ddcd9b4a4b"}

{"id": "p_a374cf9c3a604b83", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 153, "text": "孔明、許靖正勸解之間，忽近侍奏曰：「馬良、伊籍至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "bc5253911b55dd8762fc898908e2e848c1e9325df8602e99fd3edb5e4a9b1c66"}

{"id": "p_12b920bb802d6ae5", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 154, "text": "二人具說荊州有失，關公兵敗求救，呈上表章。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "b29f39b02e2d501441ff8978b2893faa0dbb182b9a2c80072c1487a8612ac3ee"}

{"id": "p_b3347ce4ab61b730", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 155, "text": "未及拆觀，侍臣又奏荊州廖化至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "4ebb7289004dd5de1998f7cba36d2e8a2683c5777dec91103590550bb7c90689"}

{"id": "p_fae4246ca1ae70ed", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 156, "text": "化哭拜於地，細奏劉封、孟達不發救兵之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "bc116115678ab8f9f87c65e5e16ad089bdf1848abbc355d4437fc0a88fea3396"}

{"id": "p_215b6f03a081441f", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 157, "text": "玄德大驚曰：「若如此，吾弟休矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "7f27f61db9d50f974acb0d8925b1a8f01578e313b0d95f6608154ab23f9a532f"}

{"id": "p_9d1cbdc1a936972c", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 158, "text": "」孔明曰：「劉封、孟達如此無禮，罪不容誅！", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "9c031b6d9410dab9bb78d87384152e3e2275d2365a1972c1250d6c54c99ca741"}

{"id": "p_35c06ced84fc7fc4", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 159, "text": "主上寬心，亮親提一旅之師，去救荊州之急。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "3a9db521949d768aa46135784b940a6268c22d877d44edfd57b708dc09146eec"}

{"id": "p_b60b2b403ccd86c1", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 160, "text": "」玄德泣曰：「雲長有失，孤斷不獨生！", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "29d38e5182a6304be1ef9219ed524f985e8201fb14fbbb256391a4249cb44d75"}

{"id": "p_c629bf6667f8a3c9", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 161, "text": "孤來日自提一軍去救雲長！", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "6b1439d7d2fd4d16226d2ac55d9afc591fc4c2ad7033de2756f08b5e7dd672ff"}

{"id": "p_10cd61899a512562", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 162, "text": "」遂一面差人赴閬中報知翼德，一面差人會集人馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "acffbe7f881ad0fb0d89695c322372cf70d2ed05a84e563fdd4d3ae49e995e3e"}

{"id": "p_a2af696565a29960", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 163, "text": "未及天明，一連數次報，說關公夜走臨沮，為吳將所獲，義不屈節，父子歸神。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "d0717b58bc75f44bec22fea1c81c2446dd21b903b6f9affbbf1bdf9c7006fc2b"}

{"id": "p_1337009b2d2fdad8", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 164, "text": "玄德聽罷，大叫一聲，昏絕於地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "7294d04dda49d4a0140e990bcd8caa6c9737bea76fa80a91e0434bda5c942b2d"}

{"id": "p_a6e97f81377dd1e3", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 165, "text": "::為念當年同誓死，忍教今日獨捐生！", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "08c80a564122aa40a4d5d9804c9d40a1477d6f409aa6e263110a9b3e9715a864"}

{"id": "p_2b103aec8cb5b9ca", "source_id": "src_f155599dc7e45868", "ordinal": 166, "text": "未知玄德性命如何，且看下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "008aa4ec5a87d82f3ba6d0bca6c120e058bad01ea0178bb9b0451d390ec210ac"}

{"id": "p_784e3103d707ab64", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說漢中王聞關公父子遇害，哭倒於地；眾文武急救，半晌方醒，扶入內殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "4b43aead382d352639459708a5f55fcfe9b32d4d6fd0d3511e0c9822e676469a"}

{"id": "p_6f73bc4359340caa", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 1, "text": "孔明勸曰：「主上少憂：自古道：『死生有命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "ac5d16d751a0e8abcd1204ab74deba34e0e133e0ed8be8c502e7e6ff9f65110d"}

{"id": "p_4bc275b202394e39", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 2, "text": "』關公平日剛而自矜，故今日有此禍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "6bf5801a96a01b481868269a2009e441aed3a1a0b2e44062e8d55f2bd7fda9be"}

{"id": "p_d534c188330383cf", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 3, "text": "主上且宜保養尊體，徐圖報讎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "65d58a42d54b11dc47b3d6f9892b50e83aabe5ffbf7f40c29a546d6a6513e9f1"}

{"id": "p_a6c6f5074aa20b03", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 4, "text": "」玄德曰：「孤與關、張二弟桃園結義時，誓同生死。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "4699fac90c29c36ed43570d4336bdd029ec6233c01e17773bd2b8eb61111108e"}

{"id": "p_e9629140ed071ac7", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 5, "text": "今雲長已亡，孤豈能獨享富貴乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "1d249d46127be84e66fb8980b796f40ed6393f3532c3de6706efa3f78c4029d5"}

{"id": "p_db0ec379bcf899fd", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 6, "text": "」言未已，只見關興號慟而來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "5c5b0efb141c4bf340316532a1378b662932ad99ffe3fff1aeb9f9b542ebe2a9"}

{"id": "p_3b0e4de91ce6ca6e", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 7, "text": "玄德見了，大叫一聲，又哭絕於地。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "e663e32acef390498b9ffb1df5e7553d4baa09fe92f096f5d270e53c0a03d9e0"}

{"id": "p_7cf6d9c3ac28750e", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 8, "text": "一日哭絕三五次，三日水漿不進，只是痛哭；淚濕衣襟，斑斑成血。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "4ffaec6979e2a1f9a95d24c4aa9d60024a6cdffac49628bee1b530fe886036c4"}

{"id": "p_341ae0a440482aef", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 9, "text": "玄德曰：「孤與東吳，誓不同日月也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "1245b57599245b49bffc4e6f2ae4e8f83d6904e0c5ff7665dc2c8310db4cb948"}

{"id": "p_6bcf555dea543f5a", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 10, "text": "」孔明曰：「聞東吳將關公首級獻與曹操，操以王侯禮祭葬之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "03417dc77015b5897144e616eb41870852260b5d2c48a192f2a0bdee419a49c2"}

{"id": "p_4745fe88db469e12", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」孔明曰：「此是東吳欲移禍於曹操，操知其謀，故以厚禮葬關公，令主上歸怨於吳也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "7c53c8ac930db4bd1fef24e1143b3dfc657c2caa060902aa5b2c0f3d91c02b90"}

{"id": "p_06a2ad0f35787e72", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 12, "text": "」玄德曰：「吾今即提兵問罪於吳，以雪吾恨！", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "8a66a53b984f09002d7461f61040704a1c128223828ca7a1b3520397aa86206d"}

{"id": "p_60fe904b898e81fa", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 13, "text": "」孔明諫曰：「不可：方今吳欲令我伐魏，魏亦欲令我伐吳：各懷譎計，伺隙而乘。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "1eec1802164e4678df26ee951082df5a42e5e0dc7f5874caf87a307e234efd07"}

{"id": "p_3863762b26afb04e", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 14, "text": "主上只宜按兵不動，且與關公發喪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "7e49d5b40d5d925ae944eeb5847551f7eecb50e8c3f8a2031765aa9be918e6a9"}

{"id": "p_9467e377fb4879dc", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 15, "text": "待吳、魏不和，乘時而伐之，可也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "21a7f453678b6bd2c5f4c828b219d471fcc24c0f2a7d2a8b22049985d329a637"}

{"id": "p_56bf2b837f43dd4c", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 16, "text": "」眾官又再三勸諫，玄德方纔進膳，傳旨川中大小將士，盡皆挂孝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "ef3a686b8e234ecba65bf2fc3acb70126c3f4b30e777ab051dbd26423db2bf60"}

{"id": "p_b574ce1ebdf021b7", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 17, "text": "漢中王親出南門招魂祭葬，號哭終日。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "ef3f2077ccaadd766b69d5047fb4937138b4697c32e03cc17a3c751533fba7f2"}

{"id": "p_7779f72508468395", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 18, "text": "卻說曹操在洛陽，自葬關公後，每夜合眼便見關公。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "ed2c4e028954d2eed59bd368d25fcac4682b8716a6d0961f5c1a05c044959fff"}

{"id": "p_b5e7117107c814ff", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 19, "text": "眾官曰：「洛陽行宮舊殿多妖，可造新殿居之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "f4bec94910a2b2036f941b5d7721291f0cbd16f1b04c4c87212c6e61234cd7e5"}

{"id": "p_bf2d35f93659ca42", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 20, "text": "」操曰：「吾欲起一殿，名建始殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "89a95cc9d1d7bea1d6194fb374438ba8f303412c1616406843de701969c22ac1"}

{"id": "p_cd5da27e5cbac667", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 21, "text": "」賈詡曰：「洛陽良工有蘇越者，最有巧思。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "8702ea575a98219466b26c439aefc8f7ef60ba0b2c8b58e705255694a110a4f3"}

{"id": "p_f6975372be75afd2", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 22, "text": "蘇越畫成九間大殿，前後廊廡樓閣，呈與操。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "f4c176f6028f5e641f46e26fb5aaf2baa3907e249c5801ae64193acc0378877a"}

{"id": "p_944d75461965a45b", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 23, "text": "操視之曰：「汝畫甚合孤意，但恐無棟梁之材。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "5154572c1488f979d502081d0b1fbfb5f9ff2c72820e62daaf8d5a966f75448b"}

{"id": "p_dbce248d74d0761d", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」蘇越曰：「此去離城三十里，有一潭，名躍龍潭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "99b2c8c808189b8f177b951ecbcc068ebe083a1f3c6f17ff788c80379c18209d"}

{"id": "p_32f594d0bcf22651", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 25, "text": "祠傍有一株大梨樹，高十餘丈，堪作建始殿之梁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "335e3ea21cdef0c17a28bb0f6b072bad4312d17d6f838bad22676dc86531e3ca"}

{"id": "p_9ff52b53d636249c", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 26, "text": "操大喜，即令人工到彼砍伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "52bf6b35b0350eb5868192ff7a172c0a3bc217c1c972a038f7d1fc1dc69cf8a7"}

{"id": "p_8e2c0b228c3ebd3d", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 27, "text": "次日，回報此樹鋸解不開，斧砍不入，不能斬伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "c42e8ffc9c221b487c43109979a0ccb4ba1900e8498dcbbfcc0bfe3f98c2ff05"}

{"id": "p_a3a4234b846b6921", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 28, "text": "操不信，親領數百騎，直至躍龍祠前下馬，仰觀那樹，亭亭如華蓋，直侵雲漢，並無曲節。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "c53ca808c9333be9fe155cd9d1e2aaee6a5152a8a4acbb5ed95318e8932adf28"}

{"id": "p_56f1244274c4c61b", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 29, "text": "操命砍之，鄉老數人前來諫曰：「此樹已數百年矣，常有神人居其上，恐未可伐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "24c497a32bf335af9ccb97d31903c2c6aaeae2270fe3f8e38441675588d7e19d"}

{"id": "p_fc633aa8b37f7026", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 30, "text": "」操大怒曰：「吾平生遊歷普天之下，四十餘年，上至天子，下至庶人，無不懼孤；是何妖神，敢違孤意！", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "265070353525178514a0ebdb3eac1618236cff4770813e755ff8299874cc41aa"}

{"id": "p_23bad3e3994cf3ee", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」言訖，拔所佩劍親自砍之：錚然有聲，血濺滿身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "a3cefb99bec97a2af455577701e10d2c79df13f3f5051103ebafbabc4d1bc2e7"}

{"id": "p_7e471e4497bf4d43", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 32, "text": "操愕然大驚，擲劍上馬，回至宮內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "305e4e0d1ee0c0142325ea1798b9ac288436d61ea1dc68a0e39ecc97287400b2"}

{"id": "p_99b3784dc369abeb", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 33, "text": "是夜二更，操睡臥不安，坐於殿中，隱几而寐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "02a37957d0c04598a4e91ddec7a2275404880c7f9246d03acf69cb9b0334e519"}

{"id": "p_e6e34707dd0d78fc", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 34, "text": "忽見一人披髮仗劍，身穿皂衣，直至面前，指操喝曰：「吾乃梨樹之神也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "f12081721d760673ad219a553d67e8316aa786c6a0cb84933bad51d18654ae49"}

{"id": "p_df00d0a4862eb68c", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 35, "text": "汝蓋建始殿，意欲篡逆，卻來伐吾神木！", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "4fc92ada71fadd2f6206444463a5cdc6b213cb428882d5f98c61da2e5a819e4c"}

{"id": "p_a85414416cc2f848", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 36, "text": "」操大驚，急呼：「武士安在？", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "99df8f96faa36417c383bbd0a5945c6ae526f29d0487b65c62dccd3c9fd43bc4"}

{"id": "p_32856ced924c2266", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 37, "text": "操大叫一聲，忽然驚覺，頭腦疼痛不可忍；急傳旨遍求良醫；治療不能痊可。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "8997deb28193dcf163ee1ab5838f92112427ce59ca1e089f74d821bd9fb222eb"}

{"id": "p_c882517e81274e65", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 38, "text": "華歆入奏曰：「大王知有神醫華佗否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "b2c8e73cb8622e457beaa0c1ce3af5765dcff46ef7c2ef286c3987ada99c40eb"}

{"id": "p_4f901f4d34be3d47", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」操曰：「即江東醫周泰者乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "03b51fe43e9bfc2fdc5b1d15f9db79b045f1201b62c365dbf8075e95cbb4e2f7"}

{"id": "p_3d0fb120c4dc23c9", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 40, "text": "」操曰：「雖聞其名，未知其術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "5e4c7b39db44cfdeaf74241d7976db32a48ddc0e9c96c1426acf829bf7fb023d"}

{"id": "p_393d21140c302e84", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 41, "text": "」歆曰：「華佗字元化，沛國譙郡人也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "7952f00b9ef8e52476b2bbc576fc8e4a597303cb837622d5ce456fde1e109ef9"}

{"id": "p_ed690671ed625bed", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 42, "text": "但有患者，或用藥，或用鍼，或用灸，隨手而愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "a3898e11632844c7730cb13d06a8ff7e9958b1d5aa0c23e87242b98d91604b16"}

{"id": "p_67c97960dcdd7a3b", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 43, "text": "若患五臟六腑之疾，藥不能效者，以麻肺湯飲之，令病者如醉死，卻用尖刀剖開其腹，以藥湯洗其臟腑，病人略無疼痛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "e51fec09b2347a52155708ff485c4ccec42d5e3e4aaa8b2254017d969e4065ad"}

{"id": "p_b8836bd42c65a6b0", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 44, "text": "洗畢，然後以藥線縫口，用藥敷之，或一月，或二十日，即平復矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "0260966744d37387d3e0b7229503b02667c1377a1f43e4038971a163aa11b36b"}

{"id": "p_bce7a1b2993d6c4b", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 45, "text": "一日，佗行於道上，聞一人呻吟之聲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "1e166661eb10593663be894788b678b643563dfb52795cd6404247dd80689a1a"}

{"id": "p_197b1ca65543cf74", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 46, "text": "佗曰：『此飲食不下之病。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "2a51a37323786c89bd4ae8e516566d145ffa9cb86f4fdfc8467b57f3d1e2f3ad"}

{"id": "p_784cb0da5b08f41f", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 47, "text": "佗令取蒜虀汁三升飲之，吐蛇一條，長二三尺，飲食即下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "9493842759361e11f5cdcb45482be62d1bf2b2d72d787b27c1ac14a465c68204"}

{"id": "p_9c8f5c2e7c1865a5", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 48, "text": "廣陵太守陳登，心中煩懣，面赤，不能飲食，求佗醫治。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "71546170cce93459e295dc30c46f4fc1fb023c0f57c58dc0aea99b3adcfec0e5"}

{"id": "p_9f3f8d2310e5ea95", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 49, "text": "佗以藥飲之，吐蟲三升，皆赤頭，首尾動搖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "d2d66bf3a901160de3f41c63da0dae2add5a110354f82400d7ccd12f755e643c"}

{"id": "p_72097f4c07fbcdc2", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 50, "text": "佗曰：『此因多食魚腥，故有此毒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "d8f8e8f918a6d5d8afffe45ffda714792063535d2d8f6ebc26b438474f961d5b"}

{"id": "p_bc80a6ef26e234bb", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 51, "text": "今日雖愈，三年之後，必將復發，不可救也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "bed51575616cd8d1efdffd96248c7bba75c44bf3843e862734d5f83e28a8b629"}

{"id": "p_5cb17202f3742c02", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 52, "text": "又有一人眉間生一瘤，癢不可當，令佗視之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "3fe90d48298f8479ccc9d50487f24bdc5a394c16fc041d74a716775612ae666d"}

{"id": "p_209f5dc96187cfb7", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 53, "text": "佗以刀割開，一黃雀飛去，病者即愈。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "5c83223fec694754dc396ea237e2fb7c6548e3266dd18d4e7cea28d168135b1e"}

{"id": "p_bcf9052b2dbe55ef", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 54, "text": "有一人被犬咬足指，隨長肉二塊，一痛一癢，俱不可忍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "2380919e8b924015d18559cba89cb31568ac071871ad51323716b5d156140cb7"}

{"id": "p_3aae895c31c32e2d", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 55, "text": "佗曰：『痛者內有鍼十個，癢者內有黑白棋子二枚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "baf04253d79276c9d21e3c3834dc23a981acfebb4d191c9db70240900c06845b"}

{"id": "p_d485471122a1ea72", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 56, "text": "此人真扁鵲、倉公之流也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "b1cbb4beab5aba65ef380cbb4e1e814fdaea3c851f0685809cd2d03857ca0927"}

{"id": "p_af3b8642bd6f5f71", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 57, "text": "現居金城，離此不遠，大王何不召之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "1086d8dc1109509398fc213fe8044c7b9cc8af89e5f3916d9dc41a8c431647cb"}

{"id": "p_af47b8a4d82bc850", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 58, "text": "操即差人星夜請華佗入內，令診脈視疾。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "04ed76abc2a0d31295e560aa2e940891fa8f918fbc563ceaff4d062639622be0"}

{"id": "p_e8c87ad3377d195e", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 59, "text": "佗曰：「大王頭腦疼痛，因患風而起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "52f181e33a1efafbdabde826953a8233bb041dece692ad91150b1adf1ab3bb87"}

{"id": "p_27f6b169f8263123", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 60, "text": "病根在腦袋中，風涎不能出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "be412f1d103bb13c43499a3cf5ddbf5989b87d597862289fa54c70f4806f34a3"}

{"id": "p_fe1e50f4cf5b2cb0", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 61, "text": "某有一法：先飲麻肺湯，然後用利斧砍開腦袋，取出風涎，方可除根。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "c971d6f343ea5b9de2dfefef4686872e7707d2122421e4089a3466153ff749ce"}

{"id": "p_1476d80ca6653572", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 62, "text": "」操大怒曰：「汝要殺孤耶！", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "135976614e25a083f9d5d70c0e36cb7ee9d4658457477d5cb9cfeb6cf8bed491"}

{"id": "p_3f06ed30f98f5021", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」佗曰：「大王曾聞關公中毒箭，傷其右臂，某刮骨療毒，關公略無懼色；今大王小可之疾，何多疑焉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "42e6be318326bdcd802e3a30d4f80041f041b5daf602edc7ceffc67c3c8f9549"}

{"id": "p_627290082c742478", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 64, "text": "」操曰：「臂痛可刮，腦袋安可砍開？", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "7447b2b0372bb861814529444bdf46c174e7c464252c9ead11eebec46bbe6017"}

{"id": "p_93f23ec727cac387", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 65, "text": "汝必與關公情熟，乘此機會，欲報讎耳！", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "1f4bf2831b99bb10846bd2490e6d2589ecde9dabd664ff5cf56f7854e6e88bc2"}

{"id": "p_9853a4cd0d8537c2", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 66, "text": "」呼左右拏下獄中，拷問其情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "3699768424cca026acbbc30c0805551d4e838ea25dec6948346b25b9fa8c380d"}

{"id": "p_9560063424c2fd14", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 67, "text": "賈詡諫曰：「似此良醫，世罕其匹，未可廢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "958d0b41cc52b334cd89fde12470354d3a077c51725b33436fc186245d6c7868"}

{"id": "p_1826df7fe7afd1bd", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 68, "text": "」操叱曰：「此人欲乘機害我，正與吉平無異！", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "538c4be559e7a7ee17728a7594e569565da7ce39cfde80b38981fd7127be3e50"}

{"id": "p_7bc06cac895cf227", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 69, "text": "華佗在獄，有一獄卒，姓吳，人皆稱為「吳押獄」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "da1b60ebf921615f1c3b6f53a4e5b4a336450efa646fd040c602bf7d8b801e1a"}

{"id": "p_29a6e92ea3a84ce4", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 70, "text": "此人每日以酒食供奉華佗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "5668d0494fcfbef78fec16fe430b1740e14104190d2463c4bf30177d6bf9d599"}

{"id": "p_b14bcff9542d19db", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 71, "text": "佗感其恩，乃告曰：「我今將死，恨有《青囊書》，未傳於世。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "0fac1c63ec8728bb1f02a22a5951d853848112d050e21351501a88b26d846f21"}

{"id": "p_96a185d5f107c8ac", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 72, "text": "感公厚意，無可為報；我修一書，公可遣人送與我家，取《青囊書》來贈公，以繼吾術。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "6c7cf92e9a536396eeba8f307c9073b0ff9ddf825d11d6c86893bc4754c53718"}

{"id": "p_1b124b0d1fb3939c", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」吳押獄大喜曰：「我若得此書，棄了此役，醫治天下病人，以傳先生之德。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "a6e8a471093dbecb34944b3f339b75468b45354460f8e8e2bb4155f0566e2eaf"}

{"id": "p_76c6fff13ee90f89", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 74, "text": "吳押獄直至金城，問佗之妻取了《青囊書》，回至獄中，付與華佗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "3f6f107d1026121dbb753b9401b8c111678159a5d68142ed7826d469887a8093"}

{"id": "p_ab5efe9269dbdcd3", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 75, "text": "檢看畢，佗即將書贈與吳押獄。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "3adcd06bb70d34608fb136cc319737c2ae2f5df87a288f5301ad474a82beaf5c"}

{"id": "p_8cc7160b1dafdfe9", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 76, "text": "旬日之後，華佗竟死於獄中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "108237efdd87e090d350bc107ee3ec56f8ec511b0985561639c0d3f7238cdd96"}

{"id": "p_4ab808915aabffa6", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 77, "text": "吳押獄買棺殯殮訖，脫了差役回家，欲取《青囊書》看習，只見其妻正將書在那裏焚燒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "8bc3c1a23705a68a116948a47ceb32ab90e80b5b73e919e2ed536613f7c58bc5"}

{"id": "p_1b438b32b9b4bb76", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 78, "text": "吳押獄大驚，連忙搶奪，全卷已被燒毀，只剩得一兩葉。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "9fb6a10c8ddf681f529399427d2024dc73d340712f3fc4870bea1e0256bcc523"}

{"id": "p_79cbe6d33480bdfe", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 79, "text": "妻曰：「縱然學得與華佗一般神妙，只落得死於牢中，要他何用？", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "20e53bc3432b4a525d0c03f59636adf1986e838baeae38141ff07b64dcc29d53"}

{"id": "p_30f17d298c0ce734", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 80, "text": "因此《青囊書》不曾傳於世，所傳者止閹雞豬等小法，乃燒剩一兩葉中所載也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "b9fd409e5458d67504816d2af1aedf329fb30d556e2408c8bb19bdb716dbfb08"}

{"id": "p_18d777d65661306f", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 81, "text": "::華佗仙術比長桑，神識如窺垣一方。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "de60b63a2472d23734766da7c18927726954af071c9ea8da646a3d2a256f8b9d"}

{"id": "p_9cd6912267aa7d66", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 82, "text": "::惆悵人亡書亦絕，後人無復見青囊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "b917a64b35f45ea5883d6fcabcc4f0a40e9d4c98fef7fa80c814f07d811f9881"}

{"id": "p_692648edf8ac9a9d", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 83, "text": "卻說曹操自殺華佗之後，病勢愈重，又憂吳、蜀之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "39f7e1ce1ebde8dbe2d9ef6a686ada3907b87d1c5eb67f209cfb66d58f6d9682"}

{"id": "p_3e3f0f14262de327", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 84, "text": "正慮間，近臣忽奏東吳遣使上書。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "016f9058621f2aa01a89f7dc4587cec9ee9dbf7765d5d1291ef43625a6ab1088"}

{"id": "p_301339a711189acc", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 85, "text": "::臣孫權久知天命已歸王上，伏望早正大位，遣將剿滅劉備，掃平兩川，臣即率群下納土歸降矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "97ad9622e70f4144f2a04fad6a5ab97abd50ba5986ee506704e8c28d23ae9dbd"}

{"id": "p_2b87e3e808ba511d", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 86, "text": "操觀畢大笑，出示群臣曰：「是兒欲使吾居爐火上耶！", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "91c241f7b39f2a5975351d8342bdfd1f9e37f5c4ef038eaf51c056f2a0eba245"}

{"id": "p_ce5ba2dacc616db4", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 87, "text": "」侍中陳群等奏曰：「漢室久已衰微，殿下功德巍巍，生靈仰望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "f86b228ab49a3d8f1f008d69a2cd94dd0fa0c399f3c73dd8bd0d5bac4ddcc18b"}

{"id": "p_b766c87546a30923", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 88, "text": "今孫權稱臣歸命，此天人之應，異氣齊聲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "f86b3a511c8f61dfb6a055d5c0664fee226a03d48bf452e563350eae3d186da6"}

{"id": "p_0638c4748a088593", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 89, "text": "殿下宜應天順人，早正大位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "fae9bfbcf94226e75a322fb0c08a20605ed9bbe83876e41fa779c91e87234e20"}

{"id": "p_8f4ef8244d2b50c2", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 90, "text": "」操笑曰：「吾事漢多年，雖有功德及民，然位至於王，名爵已極，何敢更有他望？", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "641fac8ab8df2f2dbea18224ebbd314dba16475c5afa776df2c81114d0178549"}

{"id": "p_baac019d017ec638", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 91, "text": "苟天命在孤，孤為周文王矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "4ff3ee397949a5ca0f02f186f558ccb2d0cd2f475f02b9b0f252eabd39165a12"}

{"id": "p_e26c7c78f2608c2c", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 92, "text": "」司馬懿曰：「今孫權既稱臣歸附，王上可封官賜爵，令拒劉備。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "7983539ea74e0e92b16004da611f10a6e7f876de76747bbcf3f8857121f31430"}

{"id": "p_71453af21148c6b2", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 93, "text": "」操從之，表封孫權為驃騎將軍南昌侯，領荊州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "ed6e66f8db1cda5e58648daf469c5568bac9547c82d7b864077b9cea75f72f58"}

{"id": "p_4042f9354ff49e87", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 94, "text": "即日遣使齎誥勅赴東吳去訖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "bb37112130290931be950d87e4447db7db0a1c71d84013ca86e8d395d4dd3713"}

{"id": "p_715872c4b67dabf3", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 95, "text": "忽一夜夢三馬同槽而食，及曉，問賈詡曰：「孤向日曾夢三馬同槽，疑是馬騰父子為禍；今騰已死，昨宵復夢三馬同槽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "6374eb40b03ffbc9170546a55bf75bae641ad8d62eee2461ca0cf194082569d9"}

{"id": "p_1794600332a95d3e", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 96, "text": "祿馬歸於曹，王上何必疑乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "e7b33bf140a32dcd8da8d45abda7071ee94d064e1b757227938bbc597a507f4b"}

{"id": "p_cd12ac1df9466b84", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 97, "text": "::三馬同槽事可疑，不知已植晉根基。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "f478b95c52311a582ca2398683d16e1397d12967bf0d11aa909a97d20433fa91"}

{"id": "p_12c74cbc6c19b23a", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 98, "text": "::曹瞞空有奸雄略，豈識朝中司馬師？", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "1d662039df8fbdecdb689c4669f408f64bca5f67e8358cd5faf3cfc3d00d2220"}

{"id": "p_7e94aa7a9b9c8198", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 99, "text": "是夜操臥寢室，至三更，覺頭目昏眩，乃起，伏几而臥。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "de439a508946204f9404a5ba1c18e6471247f59d0ccce7d0957d7999d82e1f7b"}

{"id": "p_0fa21f9a03cc2a32", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 100, "text": "忽聞殿中聲如裂帛，操驚視之，忽見伏皇后、董貴人、二皇子並伏完、董承等二十餘人，渾身血污，立於愁雲之內，隱隱聞索命之聲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "832974bf6bf99d464b6674ddabc6b71999f7e73932e495d2fdbff9a847ab1211"}

{"id": "p_522dc5394ab85287", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 101, "text": "操急拔劍望空砍去，忽然一聲響亮，震塌殿宇西南一角。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "57671300213143f1a2ebe1253f782814a245019774e80699c701a14f5b68f9f8"}

{"id": "p_4737c3c7bd9f428f", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 102, "text": "操驚倒於地，近侍救出，遷於別宮養病。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "d90dcb71cf71c70b8be4cf505af18b3600586177a2a48807c8c2c018b2817c77"}

{"id": "p_aa37402b2cab94a0", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 103, "text": "次夜又聞殿外男女哭聲不絕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "e458851134ea8e8984d8be2ee0feaf9b4974cc44de7d75146398b0a186fce166"}

{"id": "p_b505788b456aa7d8", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 104, "text": "至曉，操召群臣入曰：「孤在戎馬之中，三十餘年，未嘗信怪異之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "098076a1e7fa1c1955824ef8f989c4e0885a569cd3f81cd932999476cee0789d"}

{"id": "p_d650fdc23648eff5", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 105, "text": "」群臣奏曰：「大王當命道士設醮修禳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "748cd7cd7bb4bc2395b02acab21cb6d1ee12faf56fcd8e07bc6c135ad5f993e7"}

{"id": "p_1989d673e68605cf", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」操歎曰：「聖人云：『獲罪於天，無所禱也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "86d3d649a18778b32111eba87890395f9a57beb7956a045888eadce0521daac6"}

{"id": "p_3286b4bfbda7ee07", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 107, "text": "』孤天命已盡，安可救乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "af594591e815de3fec6a7e954fb5aea5919338c45d70bf44c38195fb26e5a47f"}

{"id": "p_ccd1e37bf13c6f5e", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 108, "text": "次日，覺氣沖上焦，目不見物，急召夏侯惇商議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "87efcaa0a5975e578b6d4ddafbf6d46fff2efcc0bcde8bf5c15fcd519671705c"}

{"id": "p_9a88f2021ef40fc7", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 109, "text": "惇至殿門前，忽見伏皇后、董貴人、二皇子、伏完、董承等，立在陰雲之中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "5bdd0d857113550a9d53cccf15c0be8be661ff5b5aeafe5cd4fd02cbd500adf4"}

{"id": "p_238241a0129d9592", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 110, "text": "惇大驚昏倒，左右扶出，自此得病。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "09ba1855750cef3c0b8e9aad79784aecd04d16872e00efb547edfff6e2841dee"}

{"id": "p_ed7605890028124d", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 111, "text": "操召曹洪、陳群、賈詡、司馬懿等，同至臥榻前，囑以後事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "28ba9d93e043c248e350a405e685ed598a4580dfc74e61f06b528850b241882e"}

{"id": "p_3001681ec63af740", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 112, "text": "曹洪等頓首曰：「大王善保玉體，不日定當霍然。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "de1a95b6eeab24413be073018062498f98aa44046840ff077ac11f5add2b36c2"}

{"id": "p_2cf688702f0c7613", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」操曰：「孤縱橫天下三十餘年，群雄皆滅，止有江東孫權，西蜀劉備，未曾剿除。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "25101151a01030c0e5edd9c43f450a7d8a09a74c0431a417bc0e44f910ff7e98"}

{"id": "p_98fb272e40f79f3e", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 114, "text": "孤今病危，不能再與卿等相敘，特以家事相託。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "2888d56737f0f97dfcc001834131a54631ee57598c54b6a6b0de840bd49310fd"}

{"id": "p_792466cadcd7999f", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 115, "text": "孤長子曹昂，劉氏所生，不幸早年歿於宛城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "ae124581af42bdf3ed2951918543f52a68bfc2a0ea67b6074696708335fef8e3"}

{"id": "p_13c53c1745615914", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 116, "text": "今卞氏生四子：丕、彰、植、熊。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "5d07f48abcf55ae30a3b894749531db95f622bb05d2da344fb425a071ee7a186"}

{"id": "p_8899e4e65c5d79e3", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 117, "text": "孤平生所愛第三子植，為人虛華少誠實，嗜酒放縱，因此不立；次子曹彰，勇而無謀；四子曹熊，多病難保；惟長子曹丕，篤厚恭謹，可繼我業。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "77575c26c00bba78242609fee0d108ba819d85806638d90a799f73f670d7c14b"}

{"id": "p_778334ee667d61c5", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 118, "text": "操令近侍取平日所藏名香，分賜諸侍妾，且囑曰：「吾死之後，汝等須勤習女工，多造絲履，賣之可以得錢自給。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "e6373d605adc20c62b21b86eab059b88e32e6fd0e72197415d0ff7f4f0fa00ca"}

{"id": "p_60402fd86abbbf03", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 119, "text": "」又命諸妾多居於銅雀臺中，每日設祭，必令女伎奏樂上食。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "c0045e88554c44a5339600bcf5f7b0191fbb0880a2796aca51e66d3975ac4642"}

{"id": "p_2351d623c60daf99", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 120, "text": "又遺命於彰德府講武城外，設立疑塚七十二，勿令後人知吾葬處，恐為人所發掘故也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "c8f4bdbced51b9a700ab44c5fc5cfe1837f24cec97522b3e8c603da82a521219"}

{"id": "p_6c2fc2ab4e278f91", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 121, "text": "囑畢，長歎一聲，淚如雨下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "172198dda4bc436d5496fe5f2dbebabf199431a93bd06d98433754b625885c9e"}

{"id": "p_954e3ff4ca284ac2", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 122, "text": "壽六十六歲，時建安二十五年春正月也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "8da7c769da6ef896b27a20e905719ed44ad0ad3ae09f78b656d4124691cd81d5"}

{"id": "p_bcf58c24b7748dc9", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 123, "text": "後人有《鄴中歌》一篇，歎曹操云：", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "e61a6bd619818ea532f13bfca3da084bcd3cdf711ac10a0ae810031feb33cb74"}

{"id": "p_6ae74fefe1bfeede", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 124, "text": "::鄴則鄴城水彰水，定有異人從此起。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "a112b809ff094cfaa193dc43035dba8afc72f5e26b3fbe1af332a8a7c18627b7"}

{"id": "p_96aa9eb07f101dc0", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 125, "text": "::雄謀韻事與文心，君臣兄弟而父子。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "a0d17c1ac4302312851cd5aa967bfd0c2a153b22d509bcddae9cbb67b9ee0106"}

{"id": "p_74ad6e9acfdcd592", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 126, "text": "::英雄未有俗胸中，出沒豈隨人眼底？", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "19bda5d662289c48acb340e469c4bd4a880e1266d9b1598b2224857bfb6a432b"}

{"id": "p_b2ddfc4ba1d661cf", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 127, "text": "::功首罪魁非兩人，遺臭流芳本一身。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "c3524213f5acc562cbe7ca5e4157f66e5d4ae3cf3994653780a70cd369e5d87c"}

{"id": "p_a528a7bba3a06389", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 128, "text": "::文章有神霸有氣，豈能苟爾化為群？", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "a5f333415489dfdd4032453e4636c2218141e96eacbdba52dd8db2cf9dbee47a"}

{"id": "p_e678c41c71b33c26", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 129, "text": "::橫流築臺距太行，氣與理勢相低昂。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "d431c7c640b3b135cacfd8594081e8b399ad675ffaaa592d22a234c62ceb1e21"}

{"id": "p_890ea9c7c30df284", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 130, "text": "::安有斯人不作逆，小不為霸大不王？", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "44d2ba7548fa841d6f554d23b73fd8cf7e3cebee3faeecd25bb4507024d836a6"}

{"id": "p_1309aeae22bcc047", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 131, "text": "::霸王降作兒女鳴，無可奈何中不平。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "e54ac3fd4531e9312c7e72f81ae5348876baa026ec2329010e6d301bc92386af"}

{"id": "p_0ad3c7af4066b828", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 132, "text": "::向帳明知非有益，分香未可謂無情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "74dfe6d6b0576f8bfdf6be1c0b0ab551c5cc0d31945277c63774b7acaf02be51"}

{"id": "p_55ed115a8e893129", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 133, "text": "古人作事無鉅細，寂寞豪華皆有意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "3367be6e1797719a91daf870676077c5f9c8f427e1506da6015871d72bc9be1c"}

{"id": "p_d73f44244efd8ff4", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 134, "text": "::書生輕議塚中人，塚中笑爾書生氣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "d94efa10a7a6ab04ea36542da7e4d76e1f9204b660893563635b63db3161dc43"}

{"id": "p_e02283e3fcf0e9f4", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 135, "text": "卻說曹操身亡，文武百官，盡皆舉哀；一面遣人赴世子曹丕、鄢陵侯曹彰、臨淄侯曹植、蕭懷侯曹熊處報喪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "2e2fd8ce13f752eab1d2f0b9149d5fdcdb43b7ef861dcde7f3c683f0df0ee7ad"}

{"id": "p_541ea653c0815ad3", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 136, "text": "眾官用金棺銀槨將操入殮，星夜舉靈櫬赴鄴郡來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "c2e474cab68561b030f219fa9c21521e2c1ff508ac52860174645be9e76660ba"}

{"id": "p_62d0b5393080b0d9", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 137, "text": "曹丕聞知父喪，放聲痛哭，率大小官員出城十里，伏道迎櫬入城，停於偏殿。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "c46806e4d0485b81c68dd4ecd26743babee1ff7cf0a5f46207db8b7d01ad9d39"}

{"id": "p_d957789661a9da08", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 138, "text": "忽一人挺身而出曰：「請世子息哀，且議大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "a9bd833ceab9ec2fa32f84e03e76b7d1a729abf169c372a6005a149fd34dfa70"}

{"id": "p_21313117752639da", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 139, "text": "」眾視之，乃中庶子司馬孚也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "0c73ec33203cbb9bfe459d28f93a1d400a11b980386f41d41f677bffdc3860a8"}

{"id": "p_07dfbcf15c391647", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 140, "text": "孚曰：「魏王既薨，天下震動；當早立嗣王，以安眾心，何但哭泣耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "59e3465afc3c393d823e252bc3b713b9dd29ce1d5fb0bbfe7efef05e889c9a18"}

{"id": "p_52b8af7b88a7ff6c", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 141, "text": "」群臣曰：「世子宜嗣位，但未得天子詔命，豈可造次而行？", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "820acb48553422731a24365bfb67ceb9a230d34537bc9943ba72cd788933cd71"}

{"id": "p_f27759e243c05c3e", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 142, "text": "」兵部尚書陳矯曰：「王薨於外，愛子私立，彼此生變，則社稷危矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "c3d7dd50749c4882de5742ddcd2cd2e0124f95db291cfae93779823e40e528c7"}

{"id": "p_daf0f01aa6f6a51a", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 143, "text": "」遂拔劍割下袍袖，厲聲曰：「即今日便請世子嗣位。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "cb570dc982bc9f6520239aed57d366f176d5814c7f87ee92613c9c86a2392783"}

{"id": "p_aa787a4b23aa062f", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 144, "text": "眾官有異議者，以此袍為例！", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "e1ede2b6eff0be69a85ab68010dcb528a211f85af50bdb1977c2e442cd08d10d"}

{"id": "p_a7d725e20270dfe3", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 145, "text": "忽報華歆自許昌飛馬而至。", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "1c864af7dfe7c5fe1296d5d452b1a651652e5d391832322e816ae18fa10c3e8a"}

{"id": "p_054e06af32be2fdd", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 146, "text": "歆曰：「今魏王薨逝，天下震動，何不早請世子嗣位？", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "7f270f2d3931ab516ae7dfa9e8d4d89e442a3d1f177b381b5f0b7658aff9a12c"}

{"id": "p_cc252126a718e26a", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 147, "text": "」眾官曰：「正因不及候詔命，方議欲以王后卞氏慈旨立世子為王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "6e1ebb2695dadf562eec74a59d41d4dcc3054a3f9c63dff80a1572f328596922"}

{"id": "p_563b04caaeac5051", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」歆曰：「吾已於漢帝處索得詔命在此。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "a33136851f14b22fc1008e08ea6fe7efa1fc2751a7672c349bf7b6b52e243ad2"}

{"id": "p_6308f6ff9e8d09ed", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 149, "text": "原來華歆諂事魏，故草此詔，威逼獻帝降之；帝只得聽從，故下詔即封曹丕為魏王、丞相、冀州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "0ae602b3d68d9d6e34fc40dc9ab6a48442bbfa183a60bd5f80545e19f2e84f8e"}

{"id": "p_fb0a49ea4235f320", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 150, "text": "丕即日登位，受大小官僚拜舞起居。", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "74580e774fb74ed28c8ea22117880ee8627206f43d5c120262c9b8215bbf1e6f"}

{"id": "p_12d3bb7f9834550e", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 151, "text": "正宴會慶賀間，忽報鄢陵侯曹彰，自長安領十萬大軍來到。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "cee60c7b45f2dd00a5f5937709652310476109eddc10b0172272dc7961c1430d"}

{"id": "p_f372de3413d908af", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 152, "text": "丕大驚，遂問群臣曰：「黃鬚小弟，平日性剛，深通武藝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "6e7d141ea8e451d72e2a85e95d11a2533436791f6ed223927bff603ef62c86e5"}

{"id": "p_fcafa25317f70b36", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 153, "text": "今提兵遠來，必與孤爭王位也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "4f9bcc1e32211f55a2160754c0ae9fe939cfb8a83d099c808f4127a39e28bde6"}

{"id": "p_dc138c26fd1f6d34", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 154, "text": "」忽階下一人應聲出曰：「臣請往見鄢陵侯，以片言折之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "c77fdab456d05057475c715ae6f36da4b33752ad141cff545e27765bf0faafed"}

{"id": "p_7abefd5aed2a3eae", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 155, "text": "」眾皆曰：「非大夫莫能解此禍也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "ab0b3eaae1e1c9f1c80eb7b5b84ba4c9073d5dec2b5f153b1bcbd02ee374b5b5"}

{"id": "p_9aaa794a469fa002", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 156, "text": "::試看曹氏丕彰事，幾作袁家譚尚爭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "ad7606f47b2b62a30a0ea4a64e8b0c1055682db555714ab2f4a80d1d0bea8b68"}

{"id": "p_46eb00498c0cd88e", "source_id": "src_5c9aa7768812eb03", "ordinal": 157, "text": "未知此人是誰，且看下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "cd91c1b642a512ec39246caf2fde2b95f489f6ab414a7b89f286921bdf5e5147"}

{"id": "p_6c1036328ccdb1dd", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說章武二年夏六月，東吳陸遜，大破蜀兵於猇亭彝陵之地；先主奔回白帝城，趙雲引兵據守。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "554d38320b4d3444656d2b9b1414c50e5820a7851f0ecab3d0a4fc0ed834ce8b"}

{"id": "p_75f3e6c95f501a0f", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 1, "text": "忽馬良至，見大軍已敗，懊悔不及，將孔明之言，奏知先主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "e4c63d77dac18811d50f6fd66c6649add234258e0b729f0db3103e3bda74dac2"}

{"id": "p_11b7f067e8129755", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 2, "text": "先主嘆曰：「朕早聽丞相之言，不致今日之敗！", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "98a3c0997532ee6c876d1d24efbc9d583e9e2dcfd68e23482e5634e33aa744d0"}

{"id": "p_6e4aeb56085eebe7", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 3, "text": "今有何面目復回成都見群臣乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "6e4d9f99d01172adb8404ca9d04acee978d869f3ca48277392264091a184e547"}

{"id": "p_216fae66a7891eba", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 4, "text": "」遂傳旨就白帝城駐紮，將館驛改為永安宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "0bc0f541d1641ef78945bceac9dd8239ee160096fa432ab00f18570c5e294148"}

{"id": "p_f082bdf48e0bb795", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 5, "text": "人報馮習、張南、傅彤、程畿、沙摩柯等皆歿於王事，先主傷感不已。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "6fa0cf5dce4ce3989d58d4fca7ab32e2ffd28c5ae9aa903dff63a4b4c0823f30"}

{"id": "p_d6d5cded894ab9ac", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 6, "text": "又近臣奏稱：「黃權引江北之兵，降魏去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "d4d05687e895e3d16ec7d8860fae49a85b34b7906bc929279ba58f9ed5dc5772"}

{"id": "p_1e60ad8a3744be76", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 7, "text": "陛下可將彼家屬送有司問罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "2673d0d671e85a5938578d295e809b843b69007a935eb1538ae03f735294f357"}

{"id": "p_2b802978944f2204", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 8, "text": "」先主曰：「黃權被吳兵隔斷在江北岸，欲歸無路，不得已降魏：是朕負權，非權負朕也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "8123c78b558b2187fe8d0d21efe99b26315813e563e264a8fa0503dd893fc25b"}

{"id": "p_8a6948a6b24d0c65", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 9, "text": "卻說黃權降魏，諸將引見曹丕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "774a210918a887979808c30841bc798e919166ffe71999fe20e009f1becaa7a5"}

{"id": "p_18291c5e7acaf52a", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 10, "text": "丕曰：「卿今降朕，欲追慕於陳、韓耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "3d68bfdd424308fdf4e786d8213c58e601bb31d41427e92f48baaf356ca727a9"}

{"id": "p_ce80e70ba523d401", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」權泣而奏曰：「臣受蜀帝之恩殊遇甚厚，令臣督諸軍於江北，被陸遜絕斷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "5a5b45a9de4b180d43ad88f03c82d969f5ccfbe26a18b0961c41ad070bcc20d4"}

{"id": "p_b2217a35fef9d37d", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 12, "text": "臣歸蜀無路，降吳不可，故來投陛下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "c7ec52d08d62a86600838cf47560e949bfb5ab112b507a69e74c53f1b8f186f5"}

{"id": "p_9d7646c5fd9c7017", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 13, "text": "敗軍之將，免死為幸，安敢追慕於古人耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "c714ed550df875960ba7c423eddd34988b30e0251ab2e98ff3a343d91f4e97ee"}

{"id": "p_34621332b3524573", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 14, "text": "」丕大喜，遂拜黃權為鎮南將軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "8b9af50ba9c9a2c0499283eb4c0ce8b7e5f9239725d64ee279cb20dded52a1ac"}

{"id": "p_0acbd87e7f1a17d6", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 15, "text": "忽近臣奏曰：「有細作人自蜀中來，說蜀主將黃權家屬盡皆誅戮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "16b24fdab0938ce1a8e04991a5f69f3142076f2ebfadb22075dedc9a7f325df8"}

{"id": "p_f7239f3e0530b543", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 16, "text": "」權曰：「臣與蜀主，推誠相信，知臣本心，必不肯殺臣之家小也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "8ee97abe90e415c889b9db7dae835c7b8c1ccf7ea3a3f0bde5ce1ce71d1a8882"}

{"id": "p_08c2f350d46545e5", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 17, "text": "::降吳不可卻降曹，忠義安能事兩朝？", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "ed93dd27eada977d7dbfc9593924b6ff8a3026923cfaed5fb51714d3ad3be91f"}

{"id": "p_53bc656e66cd2ee4", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 18, "text": "::堪嘆黃權惜一死，紫陽書法不輕饒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "457d7165694437f02fbc5c0871d1c111e5188615828decff61b9cc5d2a9405da"}

{"id": "p_4ce245d9080fced0", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 19, "text": "曹丕問賈詡曰：「朕欲一統天下：先取蜀乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "4835ca4b1d4e8ae61101e60f77d85a9ce1ddbd3979040560d3ed73c746e7dfc9"}

{"id": "p_8024d44a99129c15", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 20, "text": "」詡曰：「劉備雄才，更兼諸葛亮善能治國；東吳孫權，能識虛實，陸遜見屯兵於險要隔江泛湖，皆難卒謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "4dcc63c093920bbfbbac44de21401c8d584740a3aa4c727b9c3c3471a17a00ff"}

{"id": "p_3ed31a51a372b40c", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 21, "text": "以臣觀之，諸將之中，皆無孫權、劉備敵手。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "cae6ad4bb7cdcd8f60f57a3ce249dd94bfafea48e05e31d8446824d99bb5b6d8"}

{"id": "p_98402214b0bc76fe", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 22, "text": "雖以陛下天威臨之，亦未見萬全之勢也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "ddd99955987e20f6bea0fe95bf089188c8cd58b4784c733e8ba853f276efe06d"}

{"id": "p_94d43223c08a6756", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 23, "text": "只可持守，以待二國之變。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "dca9da8cf112f282f72634db498b2133d6b10f206462ba03dce9d45833960158"}

{"id": "p_f4a6f4292474d540", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 24, "text": "」丕曰：「朕已遣三路大兵伐吳，安有不勝之理？", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "b43067a744fbc03378117136078b4596a662c90519673a6338e94abd9d9e90b4"}

{"id": "p_fee841909c948159", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 25, "text": "」尚書劉曄曰：「近東吳陸遜，新破蜀兵七十萬，上下齊心，更有江湖之阻，不可卒制。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "8412b4c1e4a3b692f17b6e70b3129f40482fe74f6a20aaba595942a72239a761"}

{"id": "p_3a3c1a291c869648", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」曄曰：「時有不同也：昔東吳累敗於蜀，其勢頓挫，故可擊耳；今既獲全勝，銳氣百倍，未可攻也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "6b0d0416e0bb2935268aee8805393cd9180343339f6efc0782776584e82be9ed"}

{"id": "p_4ecd09b4cba4d474", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」丕曰：「朕意已決，卿勿復言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "e9185ca7aed0f2d4ed415800cf0cdba20cc1b83a0febc09a4243f5c2ae373c60"}

{"id": "p_0866f1f86b28071c", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」遂引御林軍親往接應三路兵馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "18e35cde55357bddbfea0ed9ab60caa7b901bbc42d91245ed220ec14b3e0340c"}

{"id": "p_60ef2b25bdbb43d3", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 30, "text": "早有哨馬報說東吳已有準備：令呂範引兵拒住曹休，諸葛瑾引兵在南郡拒住曹真，朱桓引兵當住濡須以拒曹仁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "6149ea886a05612e9e5fdbd037574c7233a1a67e344b9e0cadfeb2b2bb53021c"}

{"id": "p_c8dd54c413f810b3", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 31, "text": "劉曄曰：「既有準備，去恐無益。", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "841148575a01c808bb3d5d74240a901a9590126808db3a652eeccff2918ecb32"}

{"id": "p_22e9a424590bf028", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 32, "text": "卻說吳將朱桓，年方二十七歲，極有膽略，孫權甚愛之；時督軍於濡須，聞曹仁引大軍去取羨溪，桓遂盡撥軍守把羨溪去了，止留五千騎守城。", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "b3867e8ef4cca314e7f43bb4d37da54cf700269cb5160fca281370a9ee9efd0b"}

{"id": "p_b53e20ba8f8add38", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 33, "text": "忽報曹仁令大將常雕同諸葛虔、王雙，引五萬精兵飛奔濡須城來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "c8fbe6e3448f58fa197ff6c3ecdca66715e9c2bed42a6fd31a643999f61bc49d"}

{"id": "p_e954caa60181b0c9", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 34, "text": "桓按劍而言曰：「勝負在將，不在兵之多寡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "351c3962b53e4fc39ceeea67d9f26820e3c49cdabae0c39b4cdd47681204c9d8"}

{"id": "p_d05f3fae2f71082a", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 35, "text": "兵法-{云}-；『客兵倍而主兵半者，主兵尚能勝於客兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "a171ffc760b4db729b4d2e61891f38222710ccbd9bc76856e42603caa8d03776"}

{"id": "p_198bdc7ea25149dd", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 36, "text": "』今曹仁千里跋涉，人馬疲困。", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "2373a20688611cdde9ebe024e898d9f719a1d2a79d29b5952f03af75c83c252d"}

{"id": "p_34cb240f4f2cdb14", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 37, "text": "吾與汝等，共據高城，南臨大江，北背山險，以逸待勞，以主制客：此乃百戰百勝之勢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "132ed833306cb5dbf32411ec39bdf8e771a4e88f4bb9e28ecc3084c87a22c8ce"}

{"id": "p_29c18b292410ce7e", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 38, "text": "雖曹丕自來，尚不足憂，況仁等耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "e1385e306ebc226c86dcc66f8bb240f2dedaf2b6b6e0ba420bdd8465ffb1bc6c"}

{"id": "p_41d5eab43fe9b5be", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 39, "text": "」於是傳令，教眾軍偃旗息鼓，只作無人守把之狀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "5e5c3e95a2a6f943d4e48f9d1cbfa5363280eb8236f6288afa76e1ec6e5f52cc"}

{"id": "p_212357c0e09fa3b5", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 40, "text": "且說魏將先鋒常雕，領精兵來取濡須城，遙望城上並無軍馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "3e593c39a9d89f2c8917f0d0da0df508ab9ed3187f5a21fc4ab965fbe9dee865"}

{"id": "p_bc31af9599915093", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 41, "text": "雕催軍急進，離城不遠，一聲砲響，旌旗齊豎。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "24e3cd159e343d1410b8c8216e6d7ea229b97972d7659192df2c01386ea47baf"}

{"id": "p_55a812ee3a0d7eb6", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 42, "text": "朱桓橫刀飛馬而出，直取常雕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "679ec996a2d6fa0b40bf2fa187d01dd44e79295db3c3cf2c41da16db35f4b316"}

{"id": "p_7b4dd7f911d2a5ca", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 43, "text": "戰不三合，被桓一刀斬常雕於馬下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "6d9f1c973c57e6ac572af0436e771723a3250018b4efb56f1a6d01e949f0d975"}

{"id": "p_83c0951f7f8ec359", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 44, "text": "吳兵乘勢衝殺一陣，魏兵大敗，死者無數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "8d95759e8890e0b1a8e05ab4f74b504debe1aab381bb2f07b5e1d6817fc2bc8f"}

{"id": "p_e081e816948d6a60", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 45, "text": "朱桓大勝，得了無數旌旗軍器戰馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "e957224813c2b476b63505c589d1a0ba64822c1c7cc5ff640011ced37b1070cd"}

{"id": "p_bcdfdeac6999dcb6", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 46, "text": "曹仁領兵隨後到來，卻被吳兵從羨溪殺出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "0697ac96b0c183e5f2eba97abc046937f52e60d2a591ffbfac58f9b11332f80f"}

{"id": "p_c4715aa283d783ad", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 47, "text": "曹仁大敗而退，回見魏主，細奏大敗之事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "0229c262c29bf6ac7ca2b91fdfd6825f9c86a5423b2755ddeade0e0314fded10"}

{"id": "p_71d43d993753c16c", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 48, "text": "正議之間，忽探馬報：「曹真、夏侯尚圍了南郡，被陸遜伏兵於內，諸葛瑾伏兵於外，內外夾攻，因此大敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "4fba09a10070c34b3eddc3eac592447f0aed892c05fdde4c4e4fd32ce73118ae"}

{"id": "p_fee5c7c429f451d1", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 49, "text": "」言未畢，忽探馬又報：「曹休亦被呂範殺敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "144689777a16245f9c0f6751e227f8789c56987f6a9b819df8cf129c3a5e7246"}

{"id": "p_5a33903f07032e53", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 50, "text": "」丕聽知三路兵敗，乃喟然嘆曰：「朕不聽賈詡、劉曄之言，果有此敗！", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "d7d281d87acc6c48f6a7c7c8d0b5ff138ea6b14d6154b79000de952b642655ec"}

{"id": "p_5ede2f132970bd46", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」時值夏天，大疫流行，馬步軍十死六七，遂引軍回洛陽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "74cfa47c9bd7ce2f806826a011240f6fe23e87935f3439192231e3d522eb7107"}

{"id": "p_a479fcf7a1681147", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 52, "text": "卻說先主在永安宮染病不起，漸漸沈重。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "e02e8f8f92537eeb952f86911234c44c676b6567445cc5aaaa5fe5ac3287dff1"}

{"id": "p_d65cef78a2c66c7c", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 53, "text": "至章武三年夏四月，先主知病入四肢；又哭關、張二弟，其病愈深，兩目昏花，厭見侍從之人；乃叱退左右，獨臥於龍榻之上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "614ff42be6a20ceed9ee1d5c4eeb163da0c7f840b52b73a22f8c0095fe50ee4f"}

{"id": "p_b2b80d1ea7a7801b", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 54, "text": "忽然陰風驟起，將燈吹搖，滅而復明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "cb372b6e427d8d49a027c52c8471a669eaafcd000c5be9bc35159d4cad90edde"}

{"id": "p_1e8f6581ef56bfb8", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 55, "text": "只見燈影之下，二人侍立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "eed654b8b4cdbdcc64e891e0bc62aa14a21a755fa88a17f75f9cab1717fd686d"}

{"id": "p_8b7b6cd9109d4f00", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 56, "text": "先主怒曰；「朕心緒不寧，教汝等且退，何故又來！", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "f9588f5a164c1333c00a3e9996f828293613e646579f0545527165f12aaf2809"}

{"id": "p_e5ea3654a4b87c11", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 57, "text": "先主起而視之：上首乃雲長，下首乃翼德也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "5c8a22fd142d9e33cdabd6bc52816026c2d940fbc2f502e0e985bb48d05ea661"}

{"id": "p_82cc9730f3ec3bf1", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 58, "text": "先主大驚曰：「二弟原來尚在！", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "599463ef62372cb9f4f23d931810f108c9db96c44f2f5786ea1fafba2638a156"}

{"id": "p_5cad8717a576fff2", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 59, "text": "」雲長曰：「臣等非人，乃是鬼也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "7cbb4e397a7e39a1d47e27e8519df383f6db3aa836113b8fe76e08bc99ce0fbb"}

{"id": "p_1b7756e151edd249", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 60, "text": "上帝以臣二人平生不失信義，皆敕命為神。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "3c128897570a263b8dc75fdb8c2ba105db9f0184750ac4f8b3752595881a9857"}

{"id": "p_639ae149f6784f27", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 61, "text": "即喚從人問之，時正三更。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "6e01dc722386910d5698dc2e96edb7e0cd58ab14f063ea20d0bc82379fa71ea6"}

{"id": "p_633cb2ba464fb196", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 62, "text": "先主嘆曰：「朕不久於人世矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "0cdbc04a55817dc38aef826596f7050c7481b2c8a673af789a9d163e678e09a9"}

{"id": "p_b8492dcc79a54889", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 63, "text": "」遂遣使往成都，請丞相諸葛亮、尚書令李嚴等，星夜來永安宮，聽受遺命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "69e98b197b9dcb1b6118331231d6414684424c3b1c8460aa3be5fa4aa6540cd5"}

{"id": "p_032b4300c10cd615", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 64, "text": "孔明等與先主次子魯王劉永、梁王劉理，來永安宮見帝，留太子劉禪守成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "f1519f82be72bda8d1cc964382eeea7c4ae7041967566d6b13681a1d8915749d"}

{"id": "p_2fc5a8ae5ca84eec", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 65, "text": "且說孔明到永安宮，見先主病危，慌忙拜伏於龍榻之下。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "b3ae3ccb28dc563b202e9158ae9e90b4101f8892e7e729ae5330c5698d7150b2"}

{"id": "p_1825aac2d9bc6a0d", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 66, "text": "先主傳旨，請孔明坐於龍榻之側，撫其背曰：「朕自得丞相，幸成帝業；何期智識淺陋，不納丞相之言，自取其敗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "584370ae010a8c857b55d255368ac1f6c19b2c10356399b2394cdbd8654ec976"}

{"id": "p_f35bdd722901844c", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 67, "text": "嗣子孱弱，不得不以大事相託。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "47c5d7c95846b4d68b0d66f29d589669ac383050371a6ac2e3f3f2046a0490b5"}

{"id": "p_62e8e0b246a4e930", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 68, "text": "孔明亦涕泣曰：「願陛下善保龍體，以副天下之望！", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "0682d40a3336cd2dd93b7dcb81f87a457e160422ad4e3103f6ccc017a0a6232d"}

{"id": "p_be9d9248b264d2cf", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」先主以目遍視，只見馬良之弟馬謖在傍，先主令且退。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "9f409af4899c652d171140d21062db0330ca58e6613fcb5b8dfc2bd13c2ec542"}

{"id": "p_dcd84bd8ba82ba12", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 70, "text": "謖退出，先主謂孔明曰：「丞相觀馬謖之才何如？", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "20f81cfd19fa1c78724d84bfb9da73671cd860b18c1fa99dfe57bffbbc40ebc6"}

{"id": "p_9b150aeb9e99fb03", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」孔明曰：「此人亦當世之英才也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "84b7588fb61df9a08452ca455e7610c6d701677484622561403bb5289cb6913e"}

{"id": "p_6c78c6b95498dae1", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 72, "text": "朕觀此人，言過其實，不可大用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "4fe9c00e66dc786f14790b0331c0e2222575add5adbba3562a688ab5fb776ec9"}

{"id": "p_29848916c8732123", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」分付畢，傳旨召諸臣入殿，取紙筆寫了遺詔，遞與孔明而嘆曰：「朕不讀書，粗知大略。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "33998dad6a44d14a70007fa848b5f61a95d533db30c49090f59f6f42f0e76a03"}

{"id": "p_147c5f53cb2b5e58", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 74, "text": "聖人-{云}-：『鳥之將死，其鳴也哀；人之將死，其言也善。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "02f68a2f05b80f568eafd8cdd3e2e3af62e5f4c7f624d9cfecd40e76ac26a699"}

{"id": "p_9e011fdb3ef606ba", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 75, "text": "』朕本待與卿等同滅曹賊，共扶漢室；不幸中道而別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "213372507e9d361017be91d25b8fbe7b4ef5b342138b52390bf126a5ddcd7ca5"}

{"id": "p_4d8e46f9008c3448", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 76, "text": "煩丞相將詔付與太子禪，令勿以為常言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "f1fffb3821740f04a8de79c70ccbf51fc78f596abe95b3f82b90be8c00e2df7c"}

{"id": "p_79c9c273e23e25ad", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 77, "text": "孔明等泣拜於地曰：「願陛下將息龍體！", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "829c712d5a81e28370b7710d678642025e374e3b40e3478733287963a8f01d7a"}

{"id": "p_bb4714f632314023", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 78, "text": "臣等盡施犬馬之勞，以報陛下知遇之恩也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "8eba13239ea643bb6f9bcfe73986c43eccf06e1d95a29b1af7f239722fa771c6"}

{"id": "p_c2d32ef745940fcb", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 79, "text": "」先主命內侍扶起孔明，一手掩淚，一手執其手，曰：「朕今死矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "6175fabfe29c5f18ff7a9d5726b2e9556e7b2f6222f3ee0d35640f3099fee495"}

{"id": "p_8eb52d671868c086", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 80, "text": "」先主泣曰：「君才十倍曹丕，必能安邦定國，終定大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "71e46b95ebe3a150bc49b2609eed21e8df372f583c8325dab54f8189bb08f0e0"}

{"id": "p_c181cf8bbcdfc7f7", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 81, "text": "若嗣子可輔，則輔之；如其不才，君可自為成都之主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "81067ea5056b5b24f59f7af82213087eccac2ec84a8cb1d9bf13528efd220534"}

{"id": "p_9133170eac95d1af", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 82, "text": "」孔明聽畢，汗流遍體，手足失措，泣拜於地曰：「臣安敢不竭股肱之力，效忠貞之節，繼之以死乎！", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "bff7cd77b4715af05050164553814dcd17df6103d0982c1ac90fc76ad7debc5c"}

{"id": "p_5e0bd2709d5fdf6e", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 83, "text": "先主又請孔明坐於榻上，喚魯王劉永、梁王劉理近前，分付曰：「爾等皆記朕言，朕亡之後，爾兄弟三人，皆以父事丞相，不可怠慢。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "41f2c7d2becdd66cdf21f55531fa722cf5be9b7630264a75fb61eff94d0c92db"}

{"id": "p_b47c9a19962460b5", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 84, "text": "」言罷，遂命二王同拜孔明。", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "174115e3df7876e9441b6af28fb4ad707c5e772f641dbb734c54de1352b934a8"}

{"id": "p_1a0994496179bb74", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 85, "text": "二王拜畢，孔明曰：「臣雖肝腦塗地，安能報知遇之恩也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "2ab1bb93ebe56d78af4325c3781eda01d7223b25ae11d7156734f9b37a5eac6a"}

{"id": "p_da5e8dc6ee555f7e", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 86, "text": "先主謂眾官曰：「朕已託孤於丞相，令嗣子以父事之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "6181122905602e4fc9c3011fa40025ef88d2280394e47856408b58d40f25539e"}

{"id": "p_ce5a58851fecbb54", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 87, "text": "卿等俱不可怠慢，以負朕望。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "ce67fdc623514eee1f13a9c3dc561fa8ea29fafc958379dba4ba776693481c95"}

{"id": "p_6799f91af567c94c", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 88, "text": "」又囑趙雲曰：「朕與卿於患難之中，相從到今，不想於此地分別。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "bffee076c0d3bac796de07d1a170649d8a8b8df79ddfbd68126597fc522cd3b0"}

{"id": "p_9570111feda538a1", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 89, "text": "卿可想朕故交，早晚看覷吾子，勿負朕言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "a349054fe56483d547267e905f35f098f3b9915578e8f3777c716562ffbfe48b"}

{"id": "p_fcf7a3d30f7ef0e8", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 90, "text": "」雲泣拜曰：「臣敢不效犬馬之勞！", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "6a07c50b9d76b82068f5c92e31291eb315af98456b0691e8174263b6c499f523"}

{"id": "p_950a9cc0522bde58", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 91, "text": "」先主又謂眾官曰：「卿等眾官，朕不能一一分囑，願皆自愛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "142e00842b0afcebabf347ee4ccba1d9d659ebb3a8c0ab03a14419e5a636335d"}

{"id": "p_bff18656144159f3", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 92, "text": "」言畢，駕崩，壽六十三歲：時章武三年四月二十四日也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "183cf83b54b8a8efae1c9d44d019ff1964dc5771d848ac18932071ab3ab27845"}

{"id": "p_72d74b7e3950d36e", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 93, "text": "::蜀主窺吳向三峽，崩年亦在永安宮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "357263d5949c99d7659c3a9fb6d394099b5ae6cf083fee6fea53698f49ac4562"}

{"id": "p_1a3f53df50a157c6", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 94, "text": "::翠華想在空山外，玉殿虛無野室中。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "7fe5730e9c08e446e0ef7d383557a9d100bc7409463d07eca88d027dc2b5db17"}

{"id": "p_7ffd4e2d478b4a69", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 95, "text": "::古廟杉松巢水鶴，歲時伏臘走村翁。", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "d521dc2942a282e38d6825cbc396fb526ead8f95b4bff001c94a8b890285fccc"}

{"id": "p_855e375341e36dd3", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 96, "text": "::武侯祠屋長鄰近，一體君臣祭祀同。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "26282d849b90d285de4d601a0ad3661436eab495558acf657fbd09f81164f009"}

{"id": "p_3a636d81fe389076", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 97, "text": "先主駕崩，文武官僚，無不哀傷，孔明率眾官奉梓宮還成都。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "9c34489c0ab20932d768f494681122bce29531bf23919b33c861e3a4b07eda73"}

{"id": "p_93b88c240466474d", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 98, "text": "太子劉禪出城迎接靈柩，安於正殿之內。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "d5be2cb271cfb160ca8057f563712c4c97b472823c4516c9220cb9b7d3fc6147"}

{"id": "p_928a9d7dc92fbcae", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 99, "text": "::朕初得疾，但下痢耳；後轉生雜病，殆不自濟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "f282789ec83e383fd2ebc60b567f93cd8f61a035425aadc784696f4fc8152100"}

{"id": "p_b25381b1057545ab", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 100, "text": "朕聞「人年五十，不稱夭壽」。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "5b6fa1ed78989c131e06aaae269f8286935d234089e3343c825896fe90c434c5"}

{"id": "p_c7e748bfc59e75da", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 102, "text": "勿以惡小而為之，勿以善小而不為。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "4ce0d02dabf4a281588e78c1a9a38c5c0c558d43d1d64210a9fa54a658be09a7"}

{"id": "p_f86a39b2a5f56734", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 103, "text": "惟賢惟德可以服人；汝父德薄，不足效也，吾亡之後，汝與丞相從事，事之如父，勿怠！", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "7f939aa46519cbd258899cf5b7dce5e94614ca0f09a840c85ce53ab8bc1b5559"}

{"id": "p_191e7e99e36ea2c4", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 104, "text": "孔明曰：「國不可一日無君；請立嗣君，以承漢統。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "6f02bcc13ad8d5cd1048493a213ccefaaf38fec084091f6d73b04297e63fd30f"}

{"id": "p_85eb6ff28b0055d2", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 105, "text": "」乃立太子禪即皇帝諡位，改元建興。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "0239b17303b14a63360b9077c550aaa561f87762444fbd418e5d00a3f6277828"}

{"id": "p_5686ed9d01365011", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 106, "text": "加諸葛亮為武鄉侯，領益州牧。", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "dd863128ef40ec7be81a59de12511a5f6eab8bb975313757df96654722b24ea3"}

{"id": "p_544d4119d44cceea", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 107, "text": "葬先主於惠陵，諡曰昭烈皇帝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "776cf14777bb2cc55aaeb24df3d4b0985f8f913dd297814ac66e1cc536168fef"}

{"id": "p_a916a973613a351b", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 108, "text": "早有魏軍探知此事，報入中原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "99633acfa8544745c240ede1e272b92745bf9ffe16714a40004e8c8679c509f0"}

{"id": "p_6240cbd333602087", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 109, "text": "曹丕大喜曰：「劉備已亡，朕無憂矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "1f8700d026e11872941ab606fd51c67796b7821ab4a323f8a41acae80fda670f"}

{"id": "p_69daeb2f9c4121c1", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 110, "text": "何不乘其國中無主，起兵伐之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "3fce18cdea0fe4ede91454b95279c35f5ef2fda228fdb9f770d07b81cf5d7385"}

{"id": "p_b91cefa5da190f69", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 111, "text": "」賈詡諫曰：「劉備亡，必託孤於諸葛亮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "ed52b7897ef20fb4abf12d56b1561e0906a29d26810132ad04ff8ce0e3a0ee4c"}

{"id": "p_30a0a0eb57686685", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 112, "text": "亮感備知遇之恩，必傾心竭力，扶持嗣主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "694fb3d4598ef1ce68d74c44f002c1ad07e7b1d87ec80d397705ed101b948669"}

{"id": "p_e25c19ac0e860e4e", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 113, "text": "」正言間，忽一人從班部中奮然而出曰：「不乘此時進兵，更待何時？", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "a867c86c9b9ad4d30ce711a55d0f48116420ec72eb4f5976b52fe688fbf72f74"}

{"id": "p_fc7457a74b90ed77", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 114, "text": "懿曰：「若只起中國之兵，急難取勝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "1c5dee3421a48c1f6a2a889c76ad7204ec4ce24de5bbe895c5b1bf840c9f14d8"}

{"id": "p_1ce6f16d951d98c0", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 115, "text": "須用五路大兵，四面夾攻，令諸葛亮首尾不能救應，然後可圖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "4667236c558c26dfc221885b16c6e7b766eae9492b016dfc15a4b86826ca225e"}

{"id": "p_f3d4ff497bf1ca59", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 116, "text": "懿曰：「可修書一封，差使往遼東鮮卑國王軻比能，賂以金帛，令起遼西羌兵十萬，先從旱路取西平關：此一路也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "2b26f4b8e872dc6f50531249225ab5bbe46afe3656b27156edcc97f79610e23a"}

{"id": "p_28ef4c4e09b02e48", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 117, "text": "再修書遣使齎官誥賞賜，直入南蠻見蠻王孟獲，令起兵十萬，攻打益州、永昌、牂牁、越雋四郡，以擊西川之南：此二路也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "51cbb416957f329c22a9f027a47f8211d59dd67c5468c28c92c589e13a1efcbd"}

{"id": "p_5387408e864c24f8", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 118, "text": "再遣使入吳修好，許以割地，令孫權起兵十萬，攻兩川夾口，徑取涪城：此三路也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "fef7f985260ee2cdf7326e6cc48815409ea3b7fc2d72db31e0bb9072159c9c61"}

{"id": "p_21aada95c6092d87", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 119, "text": "又可遣使至降將孟達處，起上庸兵十萬，西攻漢中：此四路也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "a8eee4b95c300674dc68db2654a97e90bf760cbe7aba9ca8254f0a3b341cf9e4"}

{"id": "p_78a1460577f06130", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 120, "text": "然後命大將軍曹真為大都督，提兵十萬，由京兆徑出陽平關取西川：此五路也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "c6bb47351a64b1cc46ea426fe31c12337f172211f9a9c5947f889736cf650db9"}

{"id": "p_f07125473a44e7a3", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 121, "text": "共大兵五十萬，五路並進。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "4d4398d86f8ad45e825c365bdbce3efea73107603fb41452b51fe0a548fcedf8"}

{"id": "p_816d6978e37d5bd3", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 122, "text": "諸葛亮便有呂望之才，安能當此乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "3bc3ce1b30c03a146853a2986b56f006bd3db6a9373c6bab2a6db81bf2a89844"}

{"id": "p_8e92276e9a54f961", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 123, "text": "」丕大喜，隨即密遣能言官四員為使前去；又命曹真為大都督，領兵十萬，逕取陽平關。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "68e64621840de99b63315df3c6852dd12d07c03e1de7187b46053df0933984f6"}

{"id": "p_d686ccdba02e050c", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 124, "text": "此時張遼等一班舊將，皆封列侯，俱在冀、徐、青及合淝等處，據守關津隘口，故不復調用。", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "4eca1a83b926ca03265a96f28401065bf0bfd4261dded95a8c71de199e707ab1"}

{"id": "p_220e497f6199bf10", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 125, "text": "卻說蜀漢後主劉禪，自即位以來，舊臣多有病亡者，不能細說。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "8e1a12563ace1ad8a3e599715a6279cf54535a00f74bb17fad746882cb83c6cc"}

{"id": "p_64a6b52b465312bd", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 126, "text": "凡一應朝廷、選法、錢糧、詞訟等事，皆聽諸葛丞相裁處。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "185273cc101908781384945bbc79f6e9687b80c73422aa2e61702851bf7046f8"}

{"id": "p_b12e94f88312eec8", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 127, "text": "孔明與群臣上言曰：「故車騎將軍張飛之女甚賢，年十七歲，可納為正宮皇后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "659eb71a6adf0034ae3be085f175d225313178715f6b63a6fe0e7753aa0be20f"}

{"id": "p_a76af54be3a85412", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 128, "text": "建興元年秋八月，忽有邊報說：「魏調五路大兵，來取西川：第一路，曹真為大都督，起兵十萬，取陽平關；第二路，乃反將孟達，起上庸兵十萬，犯漢中；第三路，乃東吳孫權，起精兵十萬，取峽口入川；第四路，乃蠻王孟獲，起蠻兵十萬，犯益州四郡；第五路，乃番王軻比能，起羌兵十萬，犯西平關－此五路軍馬，甚是利害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "20d135b724a1d10c12b7efb8253d49d870d9beab7068724318c516c650e48d74"}

{"id": "p_c76de8dfedb4d3cb", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 129, "text": "已先報知丞相，丞相不知為何，數日不出視事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "ee53d5847a05c5f1c5d80d3d27b685ffd898801f4257b148fde53fb4854a5108"}

{"id": "p_aeacd293f7d80184", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 130, "text": "」後主聽罷大驚，即差近侍齎旨，宣召孔明入朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "5a61a2d14ad0af6bcb8308c4e3475c54d0aa677092ba4dbc26bc14a5054a8d19"}

{"id": "p_96157989db668d57", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 131, "text": "使命去了半日，「回報丞相府下人言，丞相染病不出。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "136e242b771eb3dceeb698ba50df0e59b1744ef7e3b4042a015a63da85f6fb42"}

{"id": "p_656a9e7c785c03d9", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 132, "text": "」後主轉慌；次日，又命黃門侍郎董允、諫議大夫杜瓊，去丞相臥榻前，告此大事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "2c8108215b8bb92d8e49816beabb5f57e160b1a616c5ae61f7a0da5c6f659c1d"}

{"id": "p_51c0d52ecbd322aa", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 133, "text": "董、杜二人，到丞相府前，皆不得入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "6988d5f0f564f98818db03b5fd0543b8123b84940f0184eb093989cb14b10f8c"}

{"id": "p_8db194030ed5ab78", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 134, "text": "杜瓊曰：「先帝託孤於丞相，今主上初登寶位，被曹丕五路兵犯境，軍情至急，丞相何故推病不出？", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "6200878aa0b49972ede58186c5d4c131e41eb15ce7f8ce9504182580a1490912"}

{"id": "p_a1febffb3c7e1dca", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 135, "text": "」良久，門吏傳丞相令，言：「病體稍可，明早出都堂議事。", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "fae0a825d92ad13d85669c94f3191a313b26e0492c2f9c784f2999d81752cbba"}

{"id": "p_18fa27823230f55b", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 136, "text": "次日，多官又來丞相府前伺侯。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "9026a4b5d42fc43c3d4baee4cff3f2f2fc6001e16bbad1c2bdcf49bef8f5658c"}

{"id": "p_a519c859a07b49be", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 137, "text": "杜瓊入奏後主曰：「請陛下聖駕，親往丞相府問計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "f3f39d25be7194b3c30149557ccf767325f5073b94d7bf88f400651ea004ec50"}

{"id": "p_469929990c5dcd6a", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 138, "text": "」後主即引多官入宮，啟皇太后。", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "6cc9d357d847731aff9c3b75bab2a11ec165f144e58f4834bb5090f7daad14ef"}

{"id": "p_5bf9ec9fe90af0ff", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 139, "text": "太后大驚，曰：「丞相何故如此？", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "f9833e692802fa9b68c33df761153651da180e5064eff51f0c7e87d167c8c3cb"}

{"id": "p_44e3e446cb09226a", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」董允奏曰：「娘娘未可輕往。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "93330dcd7c911737df314030c2ff7c2ad71f47d315282fdbb55795e5ae477bfd"}

{"id": "p_3aa9dce1e1c7a38b", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 141, "text": "臣料丞相必有有高明之見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "311abe24439bd2d1e73b7c6acf4041c249de0566ed9e79dbbb16e46fe8670aa3"}

{"id": "p_8c3953806af7b99b", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 142, "text": "如果怠慢，請娘娘於太廟中，召丞相問之未遲。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "e17e161e015cb306c57872862bb7023a9bf7d6a422199fce6caffa7714b2d245"}

{"id": "p_67ae211d6bd19573", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 143, "text": "次日，後主車駕親至相府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "b8a018a1a79feb53945fae2fe93ead4a737f9834216352cc60c32e0adfcfeb88"}

{"id": "p_3e1ae13a51c281bf", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 145, "text": "後主問曰：「丞相在何處？", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "b02b42ff1007cbe33f662def64489f0ee5bcd7c7ad3f58c5d1ba1f9b75197ed1"}

{"id": "p_5c6c84f9fb44d991", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 146, "text": "」門吏曰：「不知在何處。", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "2b23e43194694d8bc5f1f5923d0861bd3a06b8f0d45ceca1985980a281bd3657"}

{"id": "p_18b7e890dc290377", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 147, "text": "只有丞相鈞旨，教擋住百官，勿得輒入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "4e1ee4948afb80af0d9026cc8755121970d112ee5b9b21c4803b506b68b40edd"}

{"id": "p_aaa0be8f9e9ca364", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 148, "text": "」後主乃下車步行，獨進第三重門，見孔明獨倚竹杖，在小池邊觀魚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "f750b4b6de7f77dbec5e427691151b6b963a35a9f6c7f8eaccd68ae17a5a0af7"}

{"id": "p_17dd93007b1bc718", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 149, "text": "後主在後立久，乃徐徐而言曰：「丞相安樂否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "9fd1888fac32d4c94a3720f4673c9ecc67434b6909614c7fdab89def6c3e05cb"}

{"id": "p_197c401a303cf728", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 150, "text": "」孔明回顧，見是後主，慌忙棄杖，拜伏於地曰：「臣該萬死！", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "f526cf5ca24bbe85bca09dc2a5932921e8304e08ec77686f1fa57aa3655fe820"}

{"id": "p_ab5a7431e7710c9f", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」後主扶起，問曰；「今曹丕分兵五路，犯境甚急，相父緣何不肯出府視事？", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "b62d7ed1e6caa5ffd765ed42d4064ae9f8a89f66759ad2a4875a996bbdb28c08"}

{"id": "p_c69990bc696456d3", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 152, "text": "」孔明大笑，扶後主入內室坐定，奏曰：「五路兵至，臣安得不知？", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "393972ecd183cc669349c0c33a88658b232e8b36b12cc141f1bfc1abe48b26ee"}

{"id": "p_30de0340aac9c878", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 153, "text": "」孔明曰：「羌王軻比能，蠻王孟獲，反將孟達，魏將曹真：此四路兵，臣已皆退去了也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "7481413d1251308d5f88cdec5a4403ae09b20b523cc18d5564e1b1270c644341"}

{"id": "p_5131550063e9f72e", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 154, "text": "止有孫權這一路兵，臣已有退兵之計，但須一能言之人為使。", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "a484c54e076778929723873daf62cdf9ce2210f799256a660761fde0f47c42a9"}

{"id": "p_c128bea68eaf285b", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 155, "text": "後主聽罷，又驚又喜，曰：「相父果有鬼神不測之機也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "07f92fa761a499996377f32b5ea63ce3f23b252e49a0f34a7b0a96807ca61acc"}

{"id": "p_4ac2684d29c44cde", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 156, "text": "」孔明曰：「先帝以陛下付託與臣，臣安敢旦夕怠慢？", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "23193e218f729d80fc36b27ef0e92a46c9cc497e44ecf373fa185dadef2a9702"}

{"id": "p_e385cf94ad261be2", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 157, "text": "成都眾官，皆不曉兵法之妙，貴在使人不測，豈可洩漏於人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "54643419807a47844d5623b8b93e026d3063df5db6269da2e84542ddb881e231"}

{"id": "p_f7629e11094703f6", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 158, "text": "老臣先知西番國王軻比能，引兵犯西平關；臣料馬超積祖西川人氏，素得羌人之心，羌人以超為神威大將軍；臣已先遣一人，星夜馳檄，令馬超緊守西平關，伏四路奇兵，每日交換，以兵拒之：此一路不必憂矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "ff4a58d94f22623a3ae439688212423eb64601369609948b564879ebf33a93f5"}

{"id": "p_7de19fb17f48210c", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 159, "text": "又南蠻孟獲，兵犯四邵，臣亦飛檄遣魏延領一軍左出右入，右出左入，為疑兵之計；蠻兵惟勇力，其心多疑，若見疑兵，必不敢進：此一路又不足憂矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "bbbf63840db510fa53432ddce9241967add651d9fb124ef3da7b0f605d856f87"}

{"id": "p_bc218cbc1b35dfd9", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 160, "text": "又知孟達引兵出漢中；孟達與李嚴曾結生死之交；臣回成都時，留李嚴守永安宮；臣已作一書，只做李嚴親筆，令人送與孟達；達必然推病不出，以慢軍心：此一路又不足憂矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "fc2534204654ecb3bfda797926d9fbb043f059da443653a43a32ed880da1bd34"}

{"id": "p_884d6d348ad8d523", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 161, "text": "又知曹真引兵犯陽平關；此地險峻，可以保守，臣已調趙雲引一軍守把關隘，並不出戰；曹真若見我軍不出，不久自退矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "8bbbe7394ada20e3c72b3146c172bfe45017654a25fd8cf84e83e1922db2fda9"}

{"id": "p_034bbd281c807796", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 162, "text": "臣尚恐不能全保，又密調關興、張苞二將，各引兵三萬，屯於緊要之處，為各路救應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "e1688ff88b60b7cd3e8d17a817694d763e0998b5cfd0aac794c73bac7a4ca0aa"}

{"id": "p_40e7ec082d455875", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 163, "text": "此數處調遣之事，皆不曾經由成都，故無人知覺。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "945d40abc21967f432d62b8531a06c3ca84b53c24e9f15f7a0632164f2004573"}

{"id": "p_54db077c4ad48b6e", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 164, "text": "只有東吳這一路兵，未必便動：如見四路兵勝，川中危急，必來相攻；若四路不濟，安肯動乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "c493104ed4bcb51d1006a92824b9ead03c348c1892ddb8b54a4eed9d330ace3d"}

{"id": "p_7f5379b56018d9a6", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 165, "text": "臣料孫權想曹丕三路侵吳之怨，必不肯從其言。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "8e5d032048ba896665ebaf30f55803daf09818c9a59ec7dd3aabfc27e713d379"}

{"id": "p_04906945da1cf3a2", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 166, "text": "雖然如此，須用一舌辯之士，逕往東吳，以利害說之，則先退東吳；其四路之兵，何足憂乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "73c1136e2253a20f2594c9151580a964f7b7f9ae83f0cde92b7f3aca7ff434f8"}

{"id": "p_8830d684e965c702", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 167, "text": "但未得說吳之人，臣故躊躇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "abd8490719ce0cd9401f049ef73a7525d658c33ab71a29ec30d5c093d0776b94"}

{"id": "p_c87d6bccbcf34372", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 168, "text": "」後主曰：「太后亦欲來見相父。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "b132ff2312962d916dd96ac3d17aa5f3f37c0d9af62137b7e52ea388ce3b0924"}
