{"id": "p_4aad9b24a815b1eb", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 169, "text": "今朕聞相父之言，如夢初覺，復何憂哉！", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "30415d6c1b34c09c41e241ea5672e36e1e16bd3b744ffebe3606b0204a25d1f8"}

{"id": "p_673d0328af0b9808", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 170, "text": "孔明與後主共飲數盃，送後主出府。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "0c10e0a96dc2a1a544ff27c78e496c970e046d91ca84ad623556c2fe60dd1743"}

{"id": "p_e83bd2856ac0eb6f", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 171, "text": "眾官皆環立於門外，見後主面有喜色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "88c7f6279bc120e01bcc32e27cc0856ddbe99edac3f7e459daea4b1bf7366966"}

{"id": "p_cf3d6b68942098b3", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 172, "text": "後主別了孔明，上御車回朝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "da4790b979492b331c08421e94c7f735d449fd542095620c63fbbfa04cefde9e"}

{"id": "p_145a2603a94ed8af", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 173, "text": "孔明見眾官中，一人仰天而笑，面亦有喜色。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "e481a2112007dc4069598e97fe6ec6c7c490de416f3a94edae5fe1b1f341c507"}

{"id": "p_962dab0999b924b0", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 174, "text": "孔明視之，乃義陽新野人：姓鄧，名芝，字伯苗；現為戶部尚書；漢司馬鄧禹之後。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "19d8de1e79d68a0d654617445e4e3642f4805b720e3e3d10661a0df0949140d8"}

{"id": "p_db31798eb4ff5013", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 175, "text": "孔明請芝到書院中，問芝曰：「今蜀、魏、吳鼎分三國，欲討二國，一統中興，當先伐何國？", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "e31a92aceacabd10fd20aae821124b48e3b51bc374d57ff720360beb8667f864"}

{"id": "p_2fe9e35426340cae", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 176, "text": "」芝曰：「以愚意論之，魏雖漢賊，其勢甚大，急難搖動，當徐徐緩圖。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "a2c20289cae384610b0e2ee04571431af103654cfb72ef55f4a7d3863e8af925"}

{"id": "p_5f910fc15861dae7", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 177, "text": "今主上初登寶位，民心未安，當與東吳連合結為脣齒，一洗先帝舊怨，此乃長久之計也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "1c635734bcba70a8533e2aa397a566f3735b54521a4daa655f8a5d2ad93c508f"}

{"id": "p_32f83803eddc949f", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 178, "text": "」孔明大笑曰：「吾思之久矣，奈未得其人，今日方得也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "02a96ed056255eed109da89a9f1557c3b40345407cf4fd16b9546fb193e09778"}

{"id": "p_e5f7364fc592b9be", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 179, "text": "」芝曰：「丞相欲其人何為？", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "fd8b4c578d5d1a0c456ea7ad8ad8fd7eac7333653ea0503e7a1e3aeed7e637a3"}

{"id": "p_1393b84511851216", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 180, "text": "」孔明曰：「吾欲使人往結東吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "cb29a2bd44591afe00c6eedf7cc6082b39c9185d357aebc1b494a594a3a46003"}

{"id": "p_27300cb888728566", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 181, "text": "公既能明此意，必能不辱君命。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "abae2357f102cbdce2a1a8769d4bac0f34f37be8a99e84ed1d07170fd099015c"}

{"id": "p_9897858be73f023b", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 182, "text": "」芝曰：「愚才智淺，恐不堪當此重任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "2a0fee8e4f87715f592449b28df750a107fdca9fb51fab76c429056861a0ce11"}

{"id": "p_0576cee69fec5a59", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 183, "text": "」孔明曰：「吾來日奏知天子，便請伯苗一行，切勿推辭。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "434c93fe7daf09e37975b4b52d6f931c0baaf7aeb6791797e61f829c8ba9ff0d"}

{"id": "p_f39222fcfa5c7232", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 184, "text": "至次日，孔明奏准後主，差鄧芝往說東吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "5de43f36490f5fa1cb916ab133d31adf2e8d373b63aa05c4a527b46ee662be32"}

{"id": "p_8905da0523e82d6f", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 185, "text": "::吳人方見干戈息，蜀使還將玉帛通。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "2ea877ddd3aaea6942d8f8da817558625f1801c6141d10f325085efb11005ed7"}

{"id": "p_c6b5af074989d97c", "source_id": "src_88853b9509fd9934", "ordinal": 186, "text": "未知鄧芝此去若何，且看下文分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "b320116c036af171d76101cea66fc84a9711275b4813d3505d3aa9e767567560"}

{"id": "p_6e0229fe2ee028be", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 0, "text": "卻說東吳陸遜自退魏兵之後，吳王拜遜為輔國將軍江陵侯，領荊州牧；自此軍權皆歸於遜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 0}, "text_hash": "c5c2db24205ee0f03822d3fea12ee3a044d440184fd679b9743815b384a05f73"}

{"id": "p_014cd7723542b54a", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 1, "text": "張昭、顧雍啟奏吳王，請自改元。", "locator": {"ordinal": 1}, "text_hash": "9d4440e60bec9ce273b43f6ee92fc08b6f953b2f170af2acf230b50090b6b0d4"}

{"id": "p_518bfb19cbb7d6c6", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 2, "text": "權從之，遂改為黃武元年。", "locator": {"ordinal": 2}, "text_hash": "2f0b0f5929886d1da06df34dfd18e2814652bdd14e6461d7b49efbe2f4a83b93"}

{"id": "p_8acb2e184cd2ddb7", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 3, "text": "忽報魏主遣使至，權召入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 3}, "text_hash": "b2085bd1911764f4730a245975529ecaa83684ba8380395100d31e9f0f380d75"}

{"id": "p_f88bff7f63b84cd3", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 4, "text": "使命陳說：「蜀前使人求於魏，魏一時不明，故發兵應之；今已大悔，欲起四路兵取川，東吳可來接應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 4}, "text_hash": "38f903ab2ce6b2ec8f9a3c8e28b520023b17e88350b9f0bda021d5b315639b39"}

{"id": "p_fff712702d43f209", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 5, "text": "」權聞言，不能決，乃問於張昭、顧雍等。", "locator": {"ordinal": 5}, "text_hash": "cc5e5ae616490e17d37a5d4f8e76313b1879f89bf1b4ffd8fce89e2eee880926"}

{"id": "p_518c4e178aeb1251", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 6, "text": "昭曰：「陸伯言極有高見，可問之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 6}, "text_hash": "2245055da90fcf674e66b0072e8afe7644cd87d93e054cebd3aaa30c49144327"}

{"id": "p_79851db9336ee8b8", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 7, "text": "遜至，奏曰：「曹丕坐鎮中原，急不可圖；今若不從，必為讎矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 7}, "text_hash": "3abc9b53a50c50995a1bd5e0ef5949e2bb9ed5f73d7d1e41d1be10a5a75a83cb"}

{"id": "p_242206cc56a74a8c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 8, "text": "臣料魏與吳皆無諸葛亮之敵手。", "locator": {"ordinal": 8}, "text_hash": "0395127689ada4620989975deabf102ee773ba32be43c8c0036a3bda68582e5e"}

{"id": "p_d960a5d9e5a5994b", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 9, "text": "今且勉強應允，整軍預備，只探聽四路如何。", "locator": {"ordinal": 9}, "text_hash": "cc78a48e679736a5a355887c8e21360e36f514ca757f113764dbc38df38e37d8"}

{"id": "p_b8fc62d14c600a0a", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 10, "text": "若四路兵勝，川中危急，諸葛亮首尾不能救，主上則發兵以應之，先取成都，此為上策；如四路兵敗，別作商議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 10}, "text_hash": "82a08df5a98369c2dea162135fd2d13013948cf573395bfd69270e5b919805c5"}

{"id": "p_b9790e7f20357f6c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 11, "text": "」權從之，乃謂魏使曰：「軍需未辦，擇日便當起程。", "locator": {"ordinal": 11}, "text_hash": "bd4d9c75409610b24d9f4607be6334d248cfd8b051536453a19fffe6684910bf"}

{"id": "p_5b9a4be591988694", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 12, "text": "權令人探得西番兵出西平關，見了馬超，不戰自退；南蠻孟獲起兵攻四郡，皆被魏延用疑兵計殺退回洞去了；上庸孟達兵至半路，忽然染病不能行；曹真兵出陽平關，趙子龍拒住各處險道，果然一將守關，萬夫莫開。", "locator": {"ordinal": 12}, "text_hash": "5241a0f7847caa9734f5426f2e2322c13878ca0e4f8f82a2deb9d3a29d5d386f"}

{"id": "p_93613381ab50c978", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 13, "text": "曹真屯兵於斜谷道，不能取勝而回。", "locator": {"ordinal": 13}, "text_hash": "dadd96e10e24d88b6ee5aa32b44bd830175e8648e9e71f128281581b04b1d3bf"}

{"id": "p_80585c32d01c3e7c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 14, "text": "孫權知了此信，乃謂文武曰：「陸伯言真神算也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 14}, "text_hash": "a45931a70c44fed54c93b7bfe20a4505078173c2628ec2597c336c99b9947a96"}

{"id": "p_0f2cda8032bb96a7", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 15, "text": "孤若妄動，又結怨於西蜀矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 15}, "text_hash": "ea3ad50aff4b5b71b192aee0566182b8534cdf595cf1d793b78c48b0488ae169"}

{"id": "p_21f22c0596e349a7", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 16, "text": "張昭曰：「此又是諸葛亮退兵之計，遣鄧芝為說客也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 16}, "text_hash": "195eeb96c0a34cb895b6f210ef449862077f1224751bad365616f40a9aded2c4"}

{"id": "p_2864f4ac330b306d", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 17, "text": "」昭曰：「先於殿前立一大鼎盛，貯油數百斤，下用炭燒。", "locator": {"ordinal": 17}, "text_hash": "873dae8eb93e670d40bcebeca8cf8120339aba7355f4dfd70ce422c3476cadfb"}

{"id": "p_b57cb8dd61e4ea4c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 18, "text": "待其油沸，可選身長面大武士一千人，各執刀在手，從宮門前直排至殿上，卻喚芝入見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 18}, "text_hash": "81601d93f99e59c5ce51508287147a0bba9bc2953d1ce1ec7d4cafbcfd73d4a8"}

{"id": "p_e276de6ca15d9ef3", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 19, "text": "休等此人開言下說詞，責以酈食其說齊故事，效此例烹之，看其人如何對答。", "locator": {"ordinal": 19}, "text_hash": "b55ca4455324519f30d6446648e7da537d2d83938bc34f25bbeb6ebf74dd294e"}

{"id": "p_935bcff075cc534e", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 20, "text": "權從其言，遂立油鼎，命武士立於左右，各執軍器，召鄧芝入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 20}, "text_hash": "47e5ebff20eed1aac76991190186c259fc8279d09d010cfe51343d2db74de297"}

{"id": "p_bea2af0a2a9e0176", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 21, "text": "行至宮門前，只見兩行武士，威風凜凜，各持鋼刀、大斧、長劍、短戟，直列至殿前。", "locator": {"ordinal": 21}, "text_hash": "9bec5e7e7d65d803e25135020a2bcdaf962a5ac59a8d925c42c4ffa533e6d35f"}

{"id": "p_57885a17d7ad2fb0", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 22, "text": "芝曉其意，並無懼色，昂然而行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 22}, "text_hash": "211ca0f1f3e21216208d593733779715fce71b09246b5a5c9fedba62eb4d7174"}

{"id": "p_9d60339576118a25", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 23, "text": "至殿前，又見鼎鑊內熱油正沸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 23}, "text_hash": "af9f5128cfa47024b6a8c1271c51053d305d533ba5f74d17b264fdda41de73e8"}

{"id": "p_5a47fca9b56406cd", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 24, "text": "左右武士以目視之，芝但微微而笑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 24}, "text_hash": "5988d682632aac17c887130277b5d89d012f8668989a34e6d640ed856f1eb0b8"}

{"id": "p_49d1cfc75285ce31", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 25, "text": "近臣引至簾前，鄧芝長揖不拜。", "locator": {"ordinal": 25}, "text_hash": "69a99752075b4e00f83fb79a51eb3cf64be819a4dd2643dfa50aa5faf1337130"}

{"id": "p_6433c31ee5f2d9bf", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 26, "text": "權令捲起珠簾，大喝曰：「何不拜！", "locator": {"ordinal": 26}, "text_hash": "3ecb738b440afd9d572b4b7b2476bf069460f1f91756a8395d715cbe20380aa1"}

{"id": "p_e805603444868d9e", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 27, "text": "」芝昂然而答曰：「上國天使，不拜小邦之主。", "locator": {"ordinal": 27}, "text_hash": "47c770c7945925e50d8653ba964b8c325be7ade8eccc911376d350bf0b641f02"}

{"id": "p_e5237472bab5abfb", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 28, "text": "」權大怒曰：「汝不自料，欲掉三寸之舌，效酈生說齊乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 28}, "text_hash": "bf7b2252e319fa31419f9e4c598d45f6afa6cf72f74703600d9c9d8f653de16c"}

{"id": "p_659f687b4d5d01c1", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 29, "text": "」芝大笑曰：「人皆言東吳多賢，誰想懼一儒生！", "locator": {"ordinal": 29}, "text_hash": "7938c966c21c430b171efca94a645c928525c36e131cd3eda2c4b838b1e0c617"}

{"id": "p_67a2e31f1e4133d0", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 30, "text": "」權轉怒曰：「孤何懼爾一匹夫耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 30}, "text_hash": "174cc1dbd7f2bb274d49f49f3eb6cf1a8c4ec52d13d3d46ce92d1dc4bd767299"}

{"id": "p_937360172e664e4e", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 31, "text": "」芝曰：「既不懼鄧伯苗，何愁來說汝等也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 31}, "text_hash": "25776b60e7eaf8496ace9d0e793df06d66681b0b86079afe20c6df766e5cd17f"}

{"id": "p_b7dfe38713ff521c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 32, "text": "」權曰：「爾欲為諸葛亮作說客，來說孤絕魏向蜀，是否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 32}, "text_hash": "daece92d6c51ea238ad1fe1f4ca232ab362ab21b81dce63ddbe01f791a53f059"}

{"id": "p_171b03b68488760f", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 33, "text": "」芝曰：「吾乃蜀中一儒生，特為吳國利害而來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 33}, "text_hash": "074e7c013dc90ce017738436886994af366347bb37a12cd152b0b62759ebe9a7"}

{"id": "p_762b2e02a7f46874", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 34, "text": "乃設兵陳鼎，以拒一使，何其局量之不能容物耶？", "locator": {"ordinal": 34}, "text_hash": "7eb42037fb41b9da9a65e0ab329ac8a44978890b50550513794fc04f522d7333"}

{"id": "p_a9373fdb7a91f25d", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 35, "text": "權聞言惶愧，即叱退武士，命芝上殿，賜坐而問曰：「吳、魏之利害若何？", "locator": {"ordinal": 35}, "text_hash": "fbea0efd99306dc92f9b95eab16b68742ce24b54463721dcef2ad4577c241203"}

{"id": "p_098e5d5200032bf1", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 36, "text": "」芝曰：「大王欲與蜀講和，還是欲與魏講和？", "locator": {"ordinal": 36}, "text_hash": "7063045855d3e223a97d6e62294b64c3ee900d13bd91113913ff7bb722537dc2"}

{"id": "p_9173d1bb41e88e71", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 37, "text": "」權曰；「孤正欲與蜀主講和；但恐蜀主年輕識淺，不能全始全終耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 37}, "text_hash": "565c089a1daf8a48387894a82a73ed6dda3eeb3bb8df61b019348e851d4889ca"}

{"id": "p_98564591e17daaea", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 38, "text": "」芝曰：「大王乃命世之英豪，諸葛亮亦一時之俊傑；蜀有山川之險，吳有三江之固：若二國連和，共為脣齒，進則可以兼吞天下，退則可以鼎足而立。", "locator": {"ordinal": 38}, "text_hash": "1ac7a5444bce8725442cb30e2287350aa529b003680a36e055d3bf6e3fcd61a5"}

{"id": "p_49e37a27a490bb60", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 39, "text": "今大王若委贄稱臣於魏，魏必望大王朝覲，求太子以為內侍；如其不從，則興兵來攻，蜀亦順流而進取，如此則江南之地，不復為大王有矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 39}, "text_hash": "494a0c44d6796f98dfc38728dbfb74f86e589cfc4b326703979d38f491dd9fad"}

{"id": "p_ed073dd27d70c34e", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 40, "text": "若大王以愚言為不然，愚將就死於大王之前，以絕說客之名也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 40}, "text_hash": "f3632d703645667b34b80cd8ddf368447f703d97bc53cd13bc54538c6a26ef1b"}

{"id": "p_c79036a3884ad36d", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 41, "text": "」言訖，撩衣下殿，望油鼎中便跳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 41}, "text_hash": "3e5115be71c8208a3e1a92dacd91e2e2b6117e4bc9f9e92e66dec62a0199380b"}

{"id": "p_fadb180a25c0ce6c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 42, "text": "權急命止之，請入後殿，以上賓之禮相待。", "locator": {"ordinal": 42}, "text_hash": "81eebc414aa62d88e90e77426612d44dd5d14dbaa48cdd32d090b8761ea97443"}

{"id": "p_3196e3ed58954f2a", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 43, "text": "權曰：「先生之言，正合孤意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 43}, "text_hash": "6594af28d5793d07db2b48e0fe1932f6e097e0d952f6f0db9993c80fc62c6661"}

{"id": "p_9e3548a0d14e66ac", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 44, "text": "孤今欲與蜀主連和，先生肯為我介紹乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 44}, "text_hash": "0b29986719828b1b983dba2bd0ed71f77cc2d3724f377341b7c757c3d7f0668d"}

{"id": "p_e8e79bf4f4d67d34", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 45, "text": "」芝曰：「適欲烹小臣者，乃大王也；今欲使小臣者，亦大王也；大王猶自狐疑未定，安能取信於人？", "locator": {"ordinal": 45}, "text_hash": "e8e935e2f213f1250bb0e0ba3db5452499ca9a1c3030d69138a137f6c83efd99"}

{"id": "p_7207de67d1017d03", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 46, "text": "」權曰：「孤意已決，先生勿疑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 46}, "text_hash": "20ddb312929b8a9d25c44e79705394ec90dd66dfae50aa5e1c3b4211cb737299"}

{"id": "p_b9ba92a4dbee807b", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 47, "text": "於是吳王留住鄧芝，集多官問曰：「孤掌江南八十一州，更有荊楚之地，反不如西蜀偏僻之處也：蜀有鄧芝，不辱其主；吳並無一人入蜀，以達孤意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 47}, "text_hash": "e0b04642e6c13e47f3e377555abe4ccd3817d4840220137e66ed269178fbddc0"}

{"id": "p_3465be5333836609", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 48, "text": "」忽一人出班奏曰：「臣願為使。", "locator": {"ordinal": 48}, "text_hash": "1a0954842b99cec413a51f810f4980c9923699c1f913d82dbce3d925a4ea51ea"}

{"id": "p_c297b313943d8752", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 49, "text": "」眾視之，乃吳郡吳人：姓張，名溫，字惠恕，現為中郎將。", "locator": {"ordinal": 49}, "text_hash": "df0b2259913462b9db68917ae4ac671af18faa29916c769caf0c853cd69b54e4"}

{"id": "p_e7e18ce017a501a9", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 50, "text": "權曰：「恐卿到蜀見諸葛亮，不能達孤之情。", "locator": {"ordinal": 50}, "text_hash": "b57798e4c0f5b3bed8250c07af819637c2960e713fae4b88fea7e0289ee49931"}

{"id": "p_5e39c06a7bef7a09", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 51, "text": "」溫曰：「孔明亦人耳，臣何畏彼哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 51}, "text_hash": "b29e234bb2946c5f9d6a3fc1e0d87c9fee4f59a6dd3be8ea3eb12abac72439ab"}

{"id": "p_2d489644e3721cbc", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 52, "text": "」權大喜，重賞張溫，使同鄧芝入川通好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 52}, "text_hash": "2b5fe526bdf6ac083bb078bf652cdc18431a6aa986ea58f8867a92280ed1ede3"}

{"id": "p_e3511b5c2fd456ee", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 53, "text": "卻說孔明自鄧芝去後，奏後主曰：「鄧芝此去，其事必成。", "locator": {"ordinal": 53}, "text_hash": "bf4f8d46c75d7fe89eb2af86e092181f9f00abd350c1edd32681596c394b5e91"}

{"id": "p_839adad36b1a753b", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 54, "text": "吳地多賢，定有人來答禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 54}, "text_hash": "74eb8ef9c9e7d30af8a14b72a6b4c33784ec87cf2c8c57eccb7b2ce8cb8e53b9"}

{"id": "p_981f2f3d6965e9b8", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 55, "text": "陛下當禮貌之，令彼回吳，以通盟好。", "locator": {"ordinal": 55}, "text_hash": "9bbe2a342c80702faff54f210aca5c0186b085446b3260d1924d7230f9868fd3"}

{"id": "p_1eabb5e5ac041622", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 56, "text": "吳若通和，魏必不敢加兵於蜀矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 56}, "text_hash": "b31b8d47ff571a27df7442d0dd937c1e4a252c1945c2e4d15c67a57dee7e73a4"}

{"id": "p_e47661aa48b366b8", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 57, "text": "吳、魏寧靖，臣當征南，平定蠻方，然後圖魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 57}, "text_hash": "4532d7980244ca139a0ea5ead03c738e1f91229d1096a756aa8fa5704a4678f7"}

{"id": "p_8eaf545938d7a559", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 58, "text": "魏削則東吳亦不能久存，可以復一統之基業也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 58}, "text_hash": "2265af65409acd8a916361d528335e89e445ab9ddd63eda75b37b6ba2a12d18c"}

{"id": "p_483992bb01dffde0", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 59, "text": "忽報東吳遣張溫與鄧芝入川答禮，後主聚文武於丹墀，令鄧芝、張溫入。", "locator": {"ordinal": 59}, "text_hash": "cf43672aec55f754ad55b6bf9add9652dc434a981ac28435e6d2b60f8681cd03"}

{"id": "p_4dd3491bc651ee71", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 60, "text": "溫自以為得志，昂然上殿，見後主施禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 60}, "text_hash": "9590faa1cb000c7c11e1f51ce0855a9f0971dba8936b647b93c9c6449359729b"}

{"id": "p_fd53ee395667c35c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 61, "text": "後主賜錦墩，坐於殿左，設御宴待之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 61}, "text_hash": "536c7bfb8faabf61221d30351e1e9aae1afa9e9c038823bc1b697bd521038d89"}

{"id": "p_b29fe1413dff916f", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 62, "text": "宴罷，百官送張溫到館舍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 62}, "text_hash": "84d64494640ef504c8bc49dd40632b9be4d7330b51cedd4c42838a345ebb5907"}

{"id": "p_7e5acc2dfba27bb4", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 63, "text": "孔明謂張溫曰：「先帝在日，與吳不睦，今已晏駕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 63}, "text_hash": "981e8ec7fc9729adc5093d1ea1c1253148b4ab176ef22b4ff03a8ad6a57c53d0"}

{"id": "p_0977cc3a5ed244d8", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 64, "text": "當今主上：深慕吳王，欲捐舊忿，永結盟好，併力破魏。", "locator": {"ordinal": 64}, "text_hash": "ab86cc8733c7d1b6aa077342086b9b7481f272e620be8dc649671ea6388df6a7"}

{"id": "p_c75f13f4dc9c2f7b", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 65, "text": "酒至半酣，張溫喜笑自若，頗有傲慢之意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 65}, "text_hash": "74dd39d9ebebd5c73b0b7abdf6ea80729c2a81e7ad63691ab276770d6c461ff5"}

{"id": "p_d5e877dd979c6c24", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 66, "text": "次日，後主將金帛賜與張溫，設宴於城南郵亭之上，命眾官相送。", "locator": {"ordinal": 66}, "text_hash": "8170740521684839e952daab6dc814c339c5695633495a328b845cb530a2a26a"}

{"id": "p_7c8bcdb70a04e744", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 67, "text": "正飲酒間，忽一人乘醉而入，昂然長揖，入席就坐。", "locator": {"ordinal": 67}, "text_hash": "c555e2197ee8f94f758a93263d8f68c60132181c95c8f585bee7518e85c23c58"}

{"id": "p_dfa6e8c7da692367", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 68, "text": "溫怪之，乃問孔明曰：「此何人也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 68}, "text_hash": "dfde7c3536333bb5f9869ce63ad92c30b1226230214d8c8f3743d00fb9564029"}

{"id": "p_38016053ecc27b24", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 69, "text": "」孔明答曰：「姓秦，名宓，字子勑；現為益州學士。", "locator": {"ordinal": 69}, "text_hash": "04c266c2154397897022ff14f66c34b4153d7380a94e111e0cc8841b3fcd5fa1"}

{"id": "p_4e1d761c2fb42917", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 70, "text": "」溫笑曰：「名稱學士，未知胸中曾學事否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 70}, "text_hash": "0c9ec37fbfbfd9bf89ef826b272a70a61d45b21d2d59ab2cf6700142db4f21af"}

{"id": "p_fbfc0b5819bd5685", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 71, "text": "」宓正色而言曰：「蜀中三尺小童，尚皆就學，何況於我？", "locator": {"ordinal": 71}, "text_hash": "29ed8233959a7f86188d479e6757f0ca039bc74c99dc90a063b31ed4be414888"}

{"id": "p_bff7b1fecf6486c1", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 72, "text": "」溫曰：「且說公何所學？", "locator": {"ordinal": 72}, "text_hash": "6e5867c723f7de800e860559fb882df22e5e17d68316d9c54aabeeb13a888087"}

{"id": "p_69eaa99d3647f5ba", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 73, "text": "」宓對曰：「上至天文，下至地理，三教九流，諸子百家，無所不通；古今興廢，聖賢經傳，無所不覽。", "locator": {"ordinal": 73}, "text_hash": "d4ae469430870d5336b9ae804fe57f394a0fe04cdcf502670b48233769b733d6"}

{"id": "p_922dd70d0c531247", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 74, "text": "」溫笑曰：「公既出大言，請即以天為問。", "locator": {"ordinal": 74}, "text_hash": "9eb8acb14bae17e2566115c49cd6930c3c80d97dc49b2191034de920b97aca82"}

{"id": "p_0e3511d5463f0eae", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 75, "text": "』以此推之，頭在西方也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 75}, "text_hash": "23492fcbf3f1c59e77561e35de9ddd914962d812b7ea57606eb223025417d6c0"}

{"id": "p_6593d8e0a69e2170", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 76, "text": "」宓答曰：「天處高而聽卑。", "locator": {"ordinal": 76}, "text_hash": "d9673d5006499dc762efd3f2e743e61a8ea41a35446f8cb5282c3962e3b67119"}

{"id": "p_267372b2cea167cc", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 77, "text": "《詩》云：『鶴鳴於九皋，聲聞於天。", "locator": {"ordinal": 77}, "text_hash": "3b0e8eca12475df781cf5caf301780c68eea07b8b59c3cc3eed2e6d21d9c9591"}

{"id": "p_3450ae0fd1df975c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 78, "text": "」宓曰：「天子姓劉，以故知之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 78}, "text_hash": "4d4ff3b6df0c1edf9f35245e621d18ee12f2ee7813e090d38b043ccc6a8cfd78"}

{"id": "p_f7390cf992bf79b9", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 79, "text": "」溫又問曰：「日生於東乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 79}, "text_hash": "9a00bbbd7c49b83ac12dbd3984ae6ab82207914440f2a33d5a61461a04589e57"}

{"id": "p_ac3bc8f6f41eb974", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 80, "text": "」宓對曰：「雖生於東，而沒於西。", "locator": {"ordinal": 80}, "text_hash": "f7ec5e5c33f8504dfa99d8f56763ac343eed4472eb7930e1c1e75ac9897189a3"}

{"id": "p_46eb77d400485c0b", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 81, "text": "此時秦宓語言清朗，答問如流，滿座皆驚。", "locator": {"ordinal": 81}, "text_hash": "ce5964855c6230e2e0ee52e339ae1f0324cb4bf5d940a28fc1fefed31da06f32"}

{"id": "p_3907e4c850b2bd06", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 82, "text": "宓乃問曰：「先生東吳名士，既以天事下問，必能深明天之理。", "locator": {"ordinal": 82}, "text_hash": "c607e0f45d0677138c73af329ad7b3e72589f2d74194f85df913028107c61e29"}

{"id": "p_97b926d51b35010f", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 83, "text": "昔混沌既分，陰陽剖判；輕清者上浮而為天，重濁者下凝而為地；至共工氏戰敗，頭觸不周山，天柱折，地維缺；天傾西北，地陷東南。", "locator": {"ordinal": 83}, "text_hash": "4e879a74e427e7463fa6ee87b01bf6150c1268da2a01b7a586b489e850d69be4"}

{"id": "p_034801ae4f62e876", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 84, "text": "天既輕清而上浮，何以傾其西北乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 84}, "text_hash": "0292638566eeb1ea321a5ed4bd43a0f91c60da4f8e74fe07672dac1370e8790b"}

{"id": "p_83b719665e1c7a8a", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 85, "text": "又未知輕清之外，還有何物？", "locator": {"ordinal": 85}, "text_hash": "ecf82ab1618ca2bfc4213261471969351a6d2547425802858522669a1f8f8c3e"}

{"id": "p_52e3d1c36947a5d0", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 86, "text": "」張溫無言可對，乃避席而謝曰：「不意蜀中多出俊傑！", "locator": {"ordinal": 86}, "text_hash": "9d89d813e4be942f8fdd9082fd1deab0f080eee6390d4aede9b431e46d320a36"}

{"id": "p_62befd370b96f5a8", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 87, "text": "恰聞講論，使僕頓開芧塞。", "locator": {"ordinal": 87}, "text_hash": "af4c70972b13c74f3a8428942c44ae1ffbdcc0155ab970a90a9fbec9ecfd18e8"}

{"id": "p_f21e671228e19fb5", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 88, "text": "」孔明恐溫羞愧，故以善言解之曰：「席間問難，皆戲談耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 88}, "text_hash": "e09a66a2838ed91b23b706e4442e0a33941c4ad0ec3b67cd7a3350a7840c85e1"}

{"id": "p_c4261973151da3aa", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 89, "text": "足下深知安邦定國之道，何在脣齒之戲哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 89}, "text_hash": "48de2819cf95b73f42cea32f7cc6ad5673fa9e91931cf4269f100f9e746393c8"}

{"id": "p_59d9f75b12290399", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 90, "text": "孔明又令鄧芝入吳答禮，就與張溫同行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 90}, "text_hash": "0bf9c87703976e59be99420809558894f6140c7c69db263698ee834b5ff2827d"}

{"id": "p_ce7ea699dfe4bd4d", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 91, "text": "張、鄧二人拜辭孔明，望東吳而來。", "locator": {"ordinal": 91}, "text_hash": "fb30bbab67e06cc3176c6136175190212866d81b496aadc3751f0b51661a9e1b"}

{"id": "p_fe565228e14a3658", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 92, "text": "卻說吳王見張溫入蜀未還，乃聚文武商議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 92}, "text_hash": "584d0c158da5b57a3ac02030f5f5c07d1fc5ebd923a5514186542edc5022cdfe"}

{"id": "p_6dc25496a8d908e0", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 93, "text": "忽近臣奏曰；「蜀遣鄧芝同張溫入國答禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 93}, "text_hash": "e562eb3d72fa6cb5f681f3d79e8261876f1ec4a7b40000bb7ecb0ccf4a22d6f9"}

{"id": "p_5c986f8a23684c3e", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 94, "text": "張溫拜於殿前，備稱後主、孔明之德，願求永結盟好，特遣鄧尚書又來答禮。", "locator": {"ordinal": 94}, "text_hash": "30c6d37c8abd031d374f4571cb1e5227dc88085d6a16c900f1d3b0903db02b1f"}

{"id": "p_1b03cfd7ecb1aa84", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 95, "text": "權問鄧芝曰：「若吳、蜀二國同心滅魏，得天下太平，二主分治，豈不樂乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 95}, "text_hash": "f64b8e9df517946d013099c46dd7134e6828e2cdb0ed7a899389c3d917e8f193"}

{"id": "p_559606746967c231", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 96, "text": "」芝答曰：「『天無二日，民無二王。", "locator": {"ordinal": 96}, "text_hash": "730331e9cd142536f6cdc25af86a7927b144d6a0178bf3aa0430d43bff4bfd7a"}

{"id": "p_4be33548c96cc521", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 97, "text": "』如滅魏之後，未識天命所歸何人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 97}, "text_hash": "de049c6f94bb5a5158450ee526e361948c3adfa476887fd7be937662872abe49"}

{"id": "p_223fcd1c3fe0ff98", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 98, "text": "但為君者，各修其德；為臣者，各盡其忠，則戰爭方息耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 98}, "text_hash": "dc1360ebf38a41d8d61c8d3af2001618056fd6db43a5d2a629f1ecd491b501fa"}

{"id": "p_d0a551121dee2108", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 99, "text": "」權大笑曰：「君之誠款，乃如是耶！", "locator": {"ordinal": 99}, "text_hash": "411de2d4262605b61df34ab52cf6000426af37091b29eccfd67b6dfc4287e145"}

{"id": "p_ef3fd1a2f4add502", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 100, "text": "卻說魏國細作人探知此事，火速報入中原。", "locator": {"ordinal": 100}, "text_hash": "979086e950eda2366596f4e32aabbb701e6eed31d87cf32ff1fad3eca87bc4c5"}

{"id": "p_6d6314b6827d9bac", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 101, "text": "魏主曹丕聽知，大怒曰：「吳、蜀連和，必有圖中原之意也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 101}, "text_hash": "a93b4738c40192b5f7e12fbd3c6d28a5534a8fb47298fc6bb0287543a945202c"}

{"id": "p_d74fa7d4d6e64167", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 102, "text": "」於是大集文武，商議起兵伐吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 102}, "text_hash": "0aff31c2cfe21beed8c009cbaad585d81b9a26c0f021af35ccc994a61a3b8d8a"}

{"id": "p_c0f18d2986c0c668", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 103, "text": "此時大司馬曹仁、太尉賈詡已亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 103}, "text_hash": "43d2b584b8f3de82330b789c3eeb2ce447b890c37c9aa512af61e0dd56d82e3c"}

{"id": "p_ff450853c5fe72c3", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 104, "text": "侍中辛毗出班奏曰：「中原之地，土闊民稀，而欲用兵，未見其利。", "locator": {"ordinal": 104}, "text_hash": "bf41828db7a0b400499f818034b97886c0b607bfd57aff624fa0015bf3bf4f71"}

{"id": "p_9895cd4db09c831c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 105, "text": "今日之計，莫若養兵屯田十年，足食足兵，然後用之，則吳、蜀方可破也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 105}, "text_hash": "f6c8e9281347bbe8f3863632d260047f0bbb1f0a644638e84ff59ddbfc8c12ac"}

{"id": "p_6bd9d6e0731d1ca6", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 106, "text": "」丕怒曰：「此迂儒之論也！", "locator": {"ordinal": 106}, "text_hash": "1857bd3fe9d789ae105970aeece3a1a5261e8b40fe0f337a3093a6f94bf71342"}

{"id": "p_bb33a5200bc379bf", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 107, "text": "今吳、蜀連和，早晚必來侵境，何暇等待十年？", "locator": {"ordinal": 107}, "text_hash": "e38b2e9d2a0efa2a52313db44839db9e37022e56201f643dda11af5e977f1c75"}

{"id": "p_6af0f05dc4a3b494", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 108, "text": "司馬懿奏曰：「吳有長江之險，非船莫渡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 108}, "text_hash": "310dda3b6e4f5fd973c3650f913a4540cd63dd2028404af037ac05396d471b67"}

{"id": "p_471ec808e65f2d04", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 109, "text": "陛下必御駕親征，可選大小戰船，從蔡、潁而入淮，取壽春，至廣陵，渡江口，逕取南徐：此為上策。", "locator": {"ordinal": 109}, "text_hash": "0b15a6587b9cb8eaf1424d77ac48657966949bbf712acd7a9ae0ca9ce1cb93d2"}

{"id": "p_dc54edc72ff4dc64", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 110, "text": "於是日夜併工，造龍舟十隻，長二十餘丈，可容二千餘人；收拾戰船三千餘隻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 110}, "text_hash": "750ca5a3b56e7a8b66d99cd5e0f1d1798e5becc92d0bb2cf4437838f69588edf"}

{"id": "p_401fc863c37ab459", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 111, "text": "魏黃初五年秋八月，會聚大小將士，令曹真為前部，張遼、張邰、文聘、徐晃等為大將先行，許褚、呂虔為中軍護衛，曹休為合後，劉曄、蔣濟為參謀。", "locator": {"ordinal": 111}, "text_hash": "dea17d86b6b8b8a6225f43f912f479f3f83683d1bb9125a14828bd86c1df40bd"}

{"id": "p_79191cd1b2aee1a6", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 112, "text": "前後水陸軍馬三十餘萬，剋日起兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 112}, "text_hash": "47c5827b03a44a5fa7be68cfeb8ce040dffe2bad1ed9eafd6d9117d50c8e67fb"}

{"id": "p_00d6db4d413f7a0e", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 113, "text": "封司馬懿為尚書僕射，留在許昌。", "locator": {"ordinal": 113}, "text_hash": "35210e13cd9b7e195d5da4e253090525ed666217adbece828f542e137b93da6f"}

{"id": "p_1eb8f99a9e71f847", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 114, "text": "凡國政大事，並皆聽懿決斷。", "locator": {"ordinal": 114}, "text_hash": "65c701cbcedac91440ec55b11b242e4ef7bbfee4eddf404332e9f49e1de3f1d3"}

{"id": "p_185e5e9692763753", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 115, "text": "卻說東吳細作探知此事，報入吳國。", "locator": {"ordinal": 115}, "text_hash": "f0cc3ad30e4815840781f92b27e7a4c73cd8ae9b95b96bfb8b818577c7b35d1a"}

{"id": "p_afe3f58c903d6f10", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 116, "text": "近臣慌奏吳王曰：「今魏王曹丕，親自乘駕龍舟，提水陸大軍三十餘萬，從蔡、潁出淮，必取廣陵，渡江來下江南，甚為利害。", "locator": {"ordinal": 116}, "text_hash": "e031db6b3716342e255b8612767dc3ae05f262a5ef1ba835766c1a3b0aa1b400"}

{"id": "p_c04bb273ef1b65d8", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 117, "text": "」孫權大驚，即聚眾文武商議。", "locator": {"ordinal": 117}, "text_hash": "66bdca20bb70bfc0da6b287ff1609597c2af446ceaa120be1a3cacbef3d43e40"}

{"id": "p_e9ae8a93650d8e1d", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 118, "text": "顧雍曰：「今主上既與西蜀連和，可修書與諸葛孔明，令起兵出漢中，以分其勢；一面遣一大將，屯兵南徐以拒之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 118}, "text_hash": "9ce741b3c4bbee028d0ec4585563e0c6f3ce1e5a648d4a92953489e40e4b33c6"}

{"id": "p_653d0989f72a0c03", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 119, "text": "」權曰：「非陸伯言不可當此重任。", "locator": {"ordinal": 119}, "text_hash": "80a9e3f94ca604df61390a7a42df2dc00dafcc3af7effb8f5746e9c4b82d4685"}

{"id": "p_eed5a16b0fdfd5f5", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 120, "text": "」雍曰：「陸伯言鎮守荊州，不可輕動。", "locator": {"ordinal": 120}, "text_hash": "c9e969aecaf1ff8048584189d9062c43daa7809831cd96f1670eb5d81d7d6a09"}

{"id": "p_0ac4a3c9f988d5b6", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 121, "text": "」權曰：「孤非不知：奈眼前無替力之人。", "locator": {"ordinal": 121}, "text_hash": "5d2c8de068d6975caa714c10ee8b96fdd995aeaaeade56644c9467b9e7c9f53c"}

{"id": "p_44fcfb2b8bb56b98", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 122, "text": "」言未盡，一人從班部內應聲而出曰：「臣雖不才，願統一軍以當魏兵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 122}, "text_hash": "24fedc31fd3039926e0e8db15472a43981a6ad6dc6bda3aa52a0772e84e7af90"}

{"id": "p_48d526c2b04d150f", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 123, "text": "若曹丕親渡大江，臣必生擒，以獻殿下；若不渡江，亦殺魏兵大半，令魏兵不敢正視東吳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 123}, "text_hash": "22def95cb65c61c47973d871dffcc4406452dd027829557def770596bb145ce5"}

{"id": "p_d0e763f10ea202f3", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 124, "text": "權大喜曰：「如得卿守江南一帶，孤何憂哉？", "locator": {"ordinal": 124}, "text_hash": "d593f24c70b8993aba3e7b9ac4b24c6030499c56c43fa9a6b5a1d4e09dd77ecb"}

{"id": "p_59c0ccef706c77d5", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 125, "text": "」遂封徐盛為安東將軍，總鎮都督建業、南徐軍馬。", "locator": {"ordinal": 125}, "text_hash": "a8619b46893aa5c90e3ef2e6c9586a2b251f202471cc40598b43decfb7b6606c"}

{"id": "p_e415d7f9a3ee8b53", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 126, "text": "盛謝恩，領命而退；即傳令教眾官軍多置器械，多設旌旗，以為守護江岸之計。", "locator": {"ordinal": 126}, "text_hash": "a873beda4c1b7174e302d26731ee0f9397f2e456aa9cafcd430a8f8d76b96337"}

{"id": "p_a20a46d501ec417c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 127, "text": "忽一人挺身出曰：「今日大王以重任委託將軍，欲破魏兵以擒曹丕，將軍何不早發軍馬渡江，於淮南之地迎敵？", "locator": {"ordinal": 127}, "text_hash": "0eaa259bbe6f8d89f3a8715b2caa567510be8f2b80513d7d5fafde4fb99e4fc0"}

{"id": "p_8072c469bc1b9f88", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 128, "text": "直待曹丕兵至，恐無及矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 128}, "text_hash": "adec7aed538ce41e97d5b47fa49b6bbc811621335b24f4fe484da983660fbfc3"}

{"id": "p_ceec4f0a2befcfe6", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 129, "text": "」盛視之，乃吳王姪孫韶也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 129}, "text_hash": "18519be4ab909c5aaa482a77b892ac41ab84ab67b96af96c3f6d26e09b41fbe1"}

{"id": "p_838be8478fd7616e", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 130, "text": "韶字公禮，官授揚威將軍，曾在廣陵守禦；年幼負氣，極有膽勇。", "locator": {"ordinal": 130}, "text_hash": "3019d63eb90700440bf1fc44317db37ac28369e9b878bed91d20cd84cb967358"}

{"id": "p_57b101fec9dfeb73", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 131, "text": "盛曰：「曹丕勢大，更有名將為先鋒，不可渡江迎敵。", "locator": {"ordinal": 131}, "text_hash": "f4d314ffddbb39873cd4aff2c0034cf225b54c5086fe99b22bc58de14bd3f532"}

{"id": "p_f27204e3da23b7ee", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 132, "text": "待彼船皆集於北岸，吾自有計破之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 132}, "text_hash": "ac69db5ff4049428ba18384dd4eb29852112306f8bf235bdea7676a1500d9355"}

{"id": "p_3450ae29f2275def", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 133, "text": "」韶曰：「吾手下自有三千軍馬，更兼深知廣陵路勢，吾願自去江北，與曹丕決一死戰。", "locator": {"ordinal": 133}, "text_hash": "21eb044d8f3afbec7abba9d48bf659d8bc6b251e82b45327eb336d5c392095b0"}

{"id": "p_bf9cb8ea16f76ab7", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 134, "text": "盛只是不肯，韶再三要行。", "locator": {"ordinal": 134}, "text_hash": "cf9b7ce3cd8a0a9860c69b95be00c1703ccd5318cb189d1a63904072b3fbeedd"}

{"id": "p_e56c5dad2dde3b30", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 135, "text": "盛怒曰：「汝如此不聽號令，吾安能制諸將乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 135}, "text_hash": "6c263033537808a5595e7f57874e8f3623eb41b2a77da112fc2e79ffcd64e83f"}

{"id": "p_6c37cf6cb5a753a3", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 136, "text": "刀斧手擁孫韶出轅門之外，立起皂旗。", "locator": {"ordinal": 136}, "text_hash": "54931a77853542432e02299e6cf527f891d838fe8f24178aa3d5f0788379c4e9"}

{"id": "p_4ae1ee8477e6ab08", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 137, "text": "武士恰待行刑，孫權早到，喝散刀斧手，救了孫韶，韶哭奏曰：「臣往年在廣陵，深知地理；不就那裏與曹丕廝殺，直待他下了長江，東吳指日休矣！", "locator": {"ordinal": 137}, "text_hash": "4279d4846249456d29628e500ecda415f964c770869e8454d02a15487e1f918a"}

{"id": "p_cb5663762a3272f4", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 138, "text": "徐盛迎接入帳，奏曰：「大王命臣為都督，提兵拒魏；今揚威將軍孫韶，不遵軍法，違令當斬，大王何故赦之？", "locator": {"ordinal": 138}, "text_hash": "81933706b02f7e91e963b3514ab0fd1d929c860c287788f0e834543ba56c38f4"}

{"id": "p_bc729980e3936222", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 139, "text": "」權曰：「韶倚血氣之壯，誤犯軍法，萬希寬恕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 139}, "text_hash": "087fa784a4db9d3d0efcb31f16a2b5c8cfa3ba37bfdeeb8f0326f189a0a95964"}

{"id": "p_8df9edc5a992d064", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 140, "text": "」盛曰：「法非臣所立，亦非大王所立，乃國家之典刑也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 140}, "text_hash": "672d40d4b0a99a92208039ce0baeb9e0597b0af8da5e259bda1761aec5c52786"}

{"id": "p_86f669f28feffbdf", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 141, "text": "若以親而免之，何以令眾乎？", "locator": {"ordinal": 141}, "text_hash": "50317f1016ef852731b248eaec96febeabe1b6e9ec87fe7e063c53282e2d0fd0"}

{"id": "p_b81f4c55337362eb", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 142, "text": "」權曰：「韶犯法本應任將軍處治；奈此子雖本姓俞氏，然孤兄甚愛之，賜姓孫。", "locator": {"ordinal": 142}, "text_hash": "e7d30294179a87ecee9fbf63d2bcbc17eb2459a9a707e1c3f34aee2ce3ac0752"}

{"id": "p_1a4591c44af12593", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 143, "text": "於孤頗有勞績，今若殺之，負兄義矣。", "locator": {"ordinal": 143}, "text_hash": "67f12f0434005a65426973933a0d77b964306980c200017b0e48ec393cdf11d1"}

{"id": "p_e3eb07ea6617a7ca", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 144, "text": "」盛曰：「且看大王之面，寄下死罪。", "locator": {"ordinal": 144}, "text_hash": "3bb2e90390f28ff355ced006ba8257ec0bea0b4d2914c7494df71072e14f7788"}

{"id": "p_24d8612fbec9dd1d", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 145, "text": "韶不肯拜，厲聲而言曰：「據吾之見，只是引軍破曹丕！", "locator": {"ordinal": 145}, "text_hash": "a3a9aa05283d5a68850ea94ff34505701d9b4d558acccbcd1fe413482ab1faa8"}

{"id": "p_0bb6a227a93a7acc", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 146, "text": "權叱退孫韶，謂徐盛曰：「便無此子，何損於吳？", "locator": {"ordinal": 146}, "text_hash": "f0d73d70175e5f9d904eb6202b5f4160cb735a92540f15cdbebdf84b86afdb7b"}

{"id": "p_d113f2d62b56b649", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 147, "text": "是夜人報徐盛，說孫韶引本部三千精兵，潛地過江去了。", "locator": {"ordinal": 147}, "text_hash": "370081966b43492ef5375363b590efd52413dd5ebed08232a0d2eadf5969ac2a"}

{"id": "p_be19a442fe162968", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 148, "text": "盛恐有失，於吳王面上不好看，乃喚丁奉授以密計，引三千兵渡江接應。", "locator": {"ordinal": 148}, "text_hash": "b4d9d077218edc91cc964922ef4bf4fec896ab710c79560dd37c9782488f75d3"}

{"id": "p_c91a2d851b426c62", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 149, "text": "卻說魏王駕龍舟至廣陵，前部曹真已領兵列於大江之岸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 149}, "text_hash": "b189b56e6c2cd33dcb0b0877d0930e16d2e6b73b356ddf1eab592d479b446c2b"}

{"id": "p_ccf4136175203662", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 150, "text": "曹丕問曰：「江岸有多少兵？", "locator": {"ordinal": 150}, "text_hash": "83fab84bc4e7100f6dbe0434d8e8435ec89ee998a88bc0d920eee2bbe779c0f7"}

{"id": "p_f357952b9a2c2985", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 151, "text": "」真曰：「隔岸遠望，並不見一人，亦無旌旗營寨。", "locator": {"ordinal": 151}, "text_hash": "140d6e4f9372555edfd7d74e9013f1aeadecbac394ecd22ea71cdd9d71db73f6"}

{"id": "p_2abc39a5c0c281a1", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 152, "text": "」於是大開江道，放龍舟直至大江，泊於江岸。", "locator": {"ordinal": 152}, "text_hash": "b5943549c322355dbf9b495ffe0e1dfbc9d6a230963e8933bc186d1eb9c7034a"}

{"id": "p_f9c5d85118f8d51c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 153, "text": "船上建龍鳳日月五色旌旗，鑾儀簇擁，光耀射目。", "locator": {"ordinal": 153}, "text_hash": "24f6c2b08348b1b0b27ec65d65e32cf942b49d130181149d1504f27679d40961"}

{"id": "p_284f7dccc9c75428", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 154, "text": "曹丕端坐舟中，遙望江南，不見一人，回顧劉曄、蔣濟曰：「可渡江否？", "locator": {"ordinal": 154}, "text_hash": "a367d2133568117472c14ce166863070d2846bfffa8871d61aa4eb48452da2d4"}

{"id": "p_0ec2773e5a69c78b", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 155, "text": "」曄曰：「兵法實實虛虛。", "locator": {"ordinal": 155}, "text_hash": "9fb63ae89031fb3530039614ef9761ec348cbecd9946a0d7cdf33a36abf47373"}

{"id": "p_1988cda9388cfe03", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 156, "text": "彼見大軍至，如何不作整備？", "locator": {"ordinal": 156}, "text_hash": "ea38032f1b188a1bfe91c14212aec2dc1ea2978bc707cf90f702b78163f34772"}

{"id": "p_a5d9c129f1548514", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 157, "text": "且待三五日，看其動靜，然後發先鋒渡江以探之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 157}, "text_hash": "57332db9b90298486721c0fa8425f9177ee1220b44071a1742076c9e487515e0"}

{"id": "p_b63e1af2f5624762", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 158, "text": "」丕曰：「卿言正合朕意。", "locator": {"ordinal": 158}, "text_hash": "5c4c615c7424d57e0cdb174f938b2ca0d30832f157ca9938278789fa946c294f"}

{"id": "p_248e1c58f2ffeb25", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 159, "text": "軍士皆執燈火，明耀天地，恰如白晝。", "locator": {"ordinal": 159}, "text_hash": "6454c4f51be9e9b75207dbefba450e2b3e2e00133363ff9535de2e72a3c4b68f"}

{"id": "p_532695523b87c149", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 160, "text": "遙望江南，並不見半點兒火光。", "locator": {"ordinal": 160}, "text_hash": "f4d3ef514b515be5b006a964fc364512e7553b61db770b4b4b57a56006138f9a"}

{"id": "p_849e17133391ef32", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 161, "text": "丕問左右曰：「此何故也？", "locator": {"ordinal": 161}, "text_hash": "0d718c7b53b2ff14751cef39c4e08d3ce2774a3edffc6fddc46a2ef4ca59eb3e"}

{"id": "p_3622a1277679176a", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 162, "text": "」近臣奏曰：「想聞陛下天兵來到，故望風逃竄耳。", "locator": {"ordinal": 162}, "text_hash": "b0af5323a6d7a3bc2177d75e4ca3901637540b1165fdad45546fdec3d26fa1a0"}

{"id": "p_e281b385fa4bdd51", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 163, "text": "及至天曉，大霧迷漫，對面不見。", "locator": {"ordinal": 163}, "text_hash": "253ae24b460b62e3510f16ed1f1a3baa4e402ec116d8a6cadfe1dc2155f713df"}

{"id": "p_e3f2ed04a165a47d", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 164, "text": "須臾風起，霧散雲收，望見江南一帶皆是連城；城樓上鎗刀耀日，遍城盡插旌旗號帶。", "locator": {"ordinal": 164}, "text_hash": "39984672fc59a402e634993db2c07eb1bb05824c7611956c24ab994605bbfb03"}

{"id": "p_8a59f795c5601cbe", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 165, "text": "頃刻數次人來報：「南徐沿江一帶，直至石頭城：一連數百里，城郭舟車，連綿不絕，一夜成就。", "locator": {"ordinal": 165}, "text_hash": "5b55383eb37f7bef2c269e4eada9e4a4a77e0823029af14064989511602a95a0"}

{"id": "p_1bc523feab0b4342", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 166, "text": "原來徐盛束縛蘆葦為人，盡穿青衣，執旌旗，立於假城疑樓之上。", "locator": {"ordinal": 166}, "text_hash": "e51413bdaecf1c494da904adb54d387a2bf0dfe5603b5f6c5308e9b8d9cd2b85"}

{"id": "p_809125c917c9800f", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 167, "text": "魏兵見城上許多人馬，如何不膽寒？", "locator": {"ordinal": 167}, "text_hash": "00e9ef9814801691cfeef89c7806a69f3529f4162874b01f816960ba015f1670"}

{"id": "p_861273c2c16d0641", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 168, "text": "丕嘆曰：「魏雖有武士千群，無所用之。", "locator": {"ordinal": 168}, "text_hash": "ba7d423349488e62a30307c4b7f028f68619cf612eace3b7ca435b8eda6a541e"}

{"id": "p_98bf34d284da9e5b", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 169, "text": "正驚訝間，忽然狂風大作，白浪滔天，江水濺濕龍袍，大船將覆。", "locator": {"ordinal": 169}, "text_hash": "e7fc6b0ea1fdbb13c351b1a86e49f0676f1c7583a8179e0718806692ba398c1d"}

{"id": "p_e6b60fd44904df86", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 170, "text": "曹真慌令文聘撐小舟急來救駕。", "locator": {"ordinal": 170}, "text_hash": "e68d61dcc54d72a1ce4d0596218fc442bff3588927c5c4ea28be9b724d080aa4"}

{"id": "p_89232c4740df7273", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 171, "text": "文聘跳上龍舟，負丕下得小舟，奔入河港。", "locator": {"ordinal": 171}, "text_hash": "e8fa331d0882f0231c46aa2e6ee31733a29733e21b8db25fdfb58698cca36cbd"}

{"id": "p_b961db81961ef81c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 172, "text": "忽流星馬報道：「趙雲引兵出陽平關，逕取長安。", "locator": {"ordinal": 172}, "text_hash": "d45500eadbdeecba1fd6323c04bdb2f50fb2db43d4fa9752aab801a632943766"}

{"id": "p_23ee47aa9468402e", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 173, "text": "」丕聽得，大驚失色，便教收軍。", "locator": {"ordinal": 173}, "text_hash": "a12cd1b9ae6d130fb92b8fb2ffa4c3b5fbefb1134874a773c06f472d9ae42fb5"}

{"id": "p_fb3e547615e768d5", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 174, "text": "丕傳旨教盡棄御用之物而走。", "locator": {"ordinal": 174}, "text_hash": "c8e01f92cdb9e8714d0c6f0cd8ce57ff5ac180c9400b63fcc2b0918785bd84f4"}

{"id": "p_a75e0f89a01378ce", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 175, "text": "龍舟將次入淮，忽然鼓角齊鳴，喊聲大震，刺斜裏一彪軍殺到；為首大將，乃孫韶也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 175}, "text_hash": "c7ff0bca420d76563bfb31f8cbce926bee98c02cc9699014e75d8a6b9cd93bd6"}

{"id": "p_2f304f880ccddade", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 176, "text": "魏兵不能抵當，折其大半，渰死者無數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 176}, "text_hash": "c11aa31183ce96027ae4c37535a661999d07ee216912e078f9dbb002c5a9b9c7"}

{"id": "p_70309c6ba81c848e", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 177, "text": "魏主渡淮河，行不三十里，淮河中一帶蘆葦，預灌魚油，盡皆火著；順風而下，風勢甚急；火燄漫空，截住龍舟。", "locator": {"ordinal": 177}, "text_hash": "1a5c389720e7c0b6f7b77631b194df4e5c46dea20fa9dee6cfd1b561ed399c75"}

{"id": "p_d1bdceae3d1f0867", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 178, "text": "傍岸時，龍舟上早已火著。", "locator": {"ordinal": 178}, "text_hash": "64aff4163228adaac7897a742e0a8ab9ce7dd8d453d46d4060a0b307ab20f116"}

{"id": "p_7f67b03a78192a91", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 179, "text": "丕慌忙上馬，岸上一彪軍殺來，為首大將，乃丁奉也。", "locator": {"ordinal": 179}, "text_hash": "5971a861a427872c934010a03a7e738d52ad94879f0fd86768bf44c7c62d5961"}

{"id": "p_580c099d54e58dce", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 180, "text": "張遼急拍馬來迎，被奉一箭射中其腰，卻得徐晃救了，同保魏主而走；折軍無數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 180}, "text_hash": "0efb12da98977ec41a0ee6fd43f6f07dad878bd74e3d6fbdd82cb126596ce88c"}

{"id": "p_d1d32dd8de7b0a49", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 181, "text": "背後孫韶、丁奉奪得馬匹、車仗、船隻、器械，不計其數。", "locator": {"ordinal": 181}, "text_hash": "682a083614fe187a1dadda401c991f6618c8f6679dd6a0fb0f4156af60fbbe40"}

{"id": "p_87f9fb5755c9642c", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 182, "text": "張遼回到許昌，箭瘡迸裂而亡。", "locator": {"ordinal": 182}, "text_hash": "531cb04e986e73cbc8e2bc11eecbc435992763a4b6bff10c9066efc040fb06af"}

{"id": "p_6c4fa77f374dc3be", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 183, "text": "卻說趙雲引兵殺出陽平關之次，忽報丞相有文書到，說益州耆帥雍闓結連蠻王孟獲，起十萬蠻兵侵掠四郡；因此宣雲回軍，令馬超堅守陽平關，丞相欲自南征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 183}, "text_hash": "5f4e6c3e0ce63430fc3eca67f22304c1a6e637f5defdbeeebd8ce2cea02b543e"}

{"id": "p_9eb77161515f7403", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 184, "text": "此時孔明在成都整飭軍馬，親自南征。", "locator": {"ordinal": 184}, "text_hash": "c10d5a72eb503e7ea122558228a5a54bd6b483e38f3bf003ee05b8b7170b8dfb"}

{"id": "p_f68b2c47c36a1dc5", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 185, "text": "::方見東吳敵北魏，又看西蜀戰南蠻。", "locator": {"ordinal": 185}, "text_hash": "c2945be9fcd43593b3a39c6a0b4171446ee187e93d065a00bea8c145c8448ea5"}

{"id": "p_77ca05d65a4c1246", "source_id": "src_3b786559be3b2360", "ordinal": 186, "text": "未知勝負如何，且看下回分解。", "locator": {"ordinal": 186}, "text_hash": "3527887ad83ef4e1321b5926f56e0f1076c1ab94d95ecc0683aa963896dcf189"}
